translation_verse: Yiti sɔ mmenia ne kakyili bɛ nwo, betu bɛtengyɛle kyɛ bɛkɔ Sodom, nakoso Abraham de, né ɔtɛ gyi AWURADE nyunu berɛ.

english_verse: And Abraham asked him, “Lord, when you destroy the evil people, are you also going to destroy those who are good?
translation_verse: Afei Abraham pingyele ye, na obisale ye kyɛ, “Aso ɛkɔfa bɛ bɔ bɛtengyɛ ne ɛkɔfra amumuyɛɛfoɛ so ɛkɔsɛkye bɛ anaa?

english_verse: You surely wouldn't let them be killed when you destroy the evil ones. You are the judge of all the earth, and you do what is right.”
translation_verse: Wɔ de, ɛngɔyɔ sɔ nikyee ne le, kyɛ ɛkɔfa mmenia bɔ bɛtengyɛ ɛkɔfra amumuyɛɛfoɛ kɔsɛkye bɛ ɔ; bɔ ɔkɔmaa mmenia bɔ bɛtengyɛ ne b’ayieleɛ koyie bɛ kyɛ amumuyɛɛfoɛ ɔ. Ah! Ɛngɔhora sɔ yɔ! Yiti aseɛ ye aso amukoraa Ndɛenbualɛniɛ ne, ongobua ndɛen bɔ ɔtengyɛ hɔ ɔ?”

english_verse: Abraham answered, “I am nothing more than the dust of the earth. Please forgive me, Lord, for daring to speak to you like this.
translation_verse: Na Abraham buale kyɛ, “Amba, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ nde mvuture ne nzoen de, nakoso ndɛ gyi me gya nu kyɛ me ne AWURADE yɛkodwudwo.

english_verse: Then Abraham said, “I don't have any right to ask you, Lord, but what would you do if you find only
translation_verse: Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ndɛ gyi me gya nu kyɛ me ne AWURADE yɛkodwudwo. Sɛ enya mmenia aburanyɔ berɛ ɛ?” Na obuale kyɛ, “Ɔnate aburanyɔ ne ati mengɔsɛkye ye.”

english_verse: Finally, Abraham said, “Please don't get angry, Lord, if I speak just once more. Suppose you find only
translation_verse: Afei ɔhane kyɛ, “Mesrɛ wɔ, AWURADE, nnɛfɛ yaa. Maa nga edwirɛ komapɛ twe he ala: Na sɛ enya mmenia buru berɛ ɛ?” Na obuale kyɛ, “Ɔnate buru ne ati mengɔsɛkye ye.”

english_verse: After speaking with Abraham, the Lord left, and Abraham went back home.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ne Abraham bedwudwole beyiele nen, ofili berɛ hɔle; na Abraham koso osa hɔle ye awuro.

english_verse: That evening, while Lot was sitting near the city gate, the two angels arrived in Sodom. When Lot saw them, he got up, bowed down low,
translation_verse: Abɔfo nyɔ ne beedwuli Sodom nɔsoa; na né Lɔto te Sodom kuro ne tiwaa. Mmerɛ bɔ Lɔto nwuni bɛ nen, odwɔsole ooyiale bɛ, na ɔfale ye nyunu butuli berɛ.

english_verse: and said, “Gentlemen, I am your servant. Please come to my home. You can wash your feet, spend the night, and be on your way in the morning.” They told him, “No, we'll spend the night in the city square.”
translation_verse: Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Me mene mɔ, mesrɛ ɛmɔ ala, ɛmɔbra beesikye ɛmɔ akoaa awuro ɛnɛ kɔngɔen ye, ná ɛmɔnwunzi ɛmɔ gya bo; ná ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu ɛmɔadwɔso bahɔ b’atee.” Na bebuale kyɛ, “Daabi, yɛkɔla dwaaso.”

english_verse: But Lot kept insisting, until they finally agreed and went home with him. He quickly baked some bread, cooked a meal, and they ate.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔhɔle so srɛle bɛ alaa maa afei bɛ ne ye hɔle ye awuro. Ɔtole ɛpoen mane bɛ; ɔtole paanoo kabrɛdi mane bɛ, na belili.

english_verse: Before Lot and his guests could go to bed, every man in Sodom, young and old, came and stood outside his house
translation_verse: Né bennya bɛllale po, yeɛ Sodom kurotue ne amukoraa, fite mmɛɛmaa so kodwu mbanyi so, bɛɛpɛle sua ne anwo beyiale ɔ.

english_verse: and started shouting, “Where are your visitors? Send them out, so we can have sex with them!”
translation_verse: Na bɛteateane nu bebisale Lɔto kyɛ, “Mmienzua bɔ beesikyele w’awuro ɛnɛ kɔngɔen ne, bɛwɔ nisua? Ye bɛ fite brɛ yɛ ma yɛne bɛ yɛla!”

english_verse: Lot went outside and shut the door behind him.
translation_verse: Lɔto fitele kyɛ ɔkɔ ɛlɔen ne anu dɔ, na ɔtole anoa ne anu,

english_verse: Then he said, “Friends, please don't do such a terrible thing!
translation_verse: na osele kyɛ, “Aliɛmaa mɔ, mesrɛ ɛmɔ ala, nnɛma ɛmɔbɔ sɔ musue ne.

english_verse: I have two daughters who have never had sex. I'll bring them out, and you can do what you want with them. But don't harm these men. They are guests in my home.”
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie. Nne mmaa mmrasua nyɔ bɔ bennwuni biaa le ɔ. Ɛmɔma nye bɛ mvite mmrɛ ɛmɔ, na ɛmɔ ne bɛ yɔ nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔkuro ɔ. Na sɔ mmienzua hemɔ de, nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ bɛ hwee, ofikyɛ baasikye m’awuro.”

english_verse: “Don't get in our way,” the crowd answered. “You're a foreigner. What right do you have to order us around? We'll do worse things to you than we're going to do to them.” The crowd kept arguing with Lot. Finally, they rushed toward the door to break it down.
translation_verse: Nakoso besele ye kyɛ, “Dwɔso berɛ kɔ dɔ!” Na besa bɛhane kyɛ, “Sɔ akoaa he te amanvraniɛ yeɛ waatena wa ɔ, nakoso wayɛ ye nwo ndɛenbualɛniɛ! Bɔ yɛkɔfa yɛkɔyɔ wɔ ne, ɔkɔtra bɛ deɛ ne!” Afei bɛhɔle Lɔto so, na bɛhɔle anoa ne anwo kyɛ bɛkwaatu ye bo.

english_verse: But the two angels in the house reached out and pulled Lot safely inside.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmienzua ne tengyɛle bɛ sa bɛsɔle Lɔto nu; bɛhwene ye bɛwale bɛ nwo berɛ wɔ awuro berɛ, na bɛtole anoa ne anu.

english_verse: Then they struck blind everyone in the crowd, and none of them could even find the door.
translation_verse: Afei bɛmane mmenia bɔ begyigyi anoa nu berɛ ne nye sini, fite ngwadaa so kodwu mbanyi so, na bɛfale bɛ sa befuafuale bɛpenane anoa ne. Lɔto nwati fi Sodom

english_verse: Lot went to the men who were engaged to his daughters and said, “Hurry up and get out of here! The Lord is going to destroy this city.” But they thought he was joking, and they laughed at him.
translation_verse: Yiti Lɔto fitele oosele ye sia mmienzua bɔ bɛbaagyigya ye mma mmrasua nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔhã bɛ nwo befi wa, ofikyɛ AWURADE baasɛkye kuro ne.” Nakoso ye sia nemɔ dwenene kyɛ ɛhoaa bie yeɛ ɔ́to ɔ.

english_verse: Early the next morning the two angels tried to make Lot hurry and leave. They said, “Take your wife and your two daughters and get away from here as fast as you can! If you don't, every one of you will be killed when the Lord destroys the city.”
translation_verse: Na odwuli alebahyene ne, abɔfo nemɔ hane Lɔto bo kyɛ, “Ka wɔ nwo na fa ɛye ne wɔ mma mmrasua nyɔ bɔ bɛwɔ wa ne nwati, amaa bandɔ nzoen wɔ kuro ye asohwenɛ ne anu.”

english_verse: At first, Lot just stood there. But the Lord wanted to save him. So the angels took Lot, his wife, and his two daughters by the hand and led them out of the city.
translation_verse: Nakoso né ɔtwetwe ye bo ase, yiti sɔ mmienzua nyɔ ne sosɔle ye ne ɔye ne ye mma mmrasua nyɔ nemɔ sa, na bɛfale ye befili kuro ne anu, ofikyɛ AWURADE nwuni ye anwumvoin.

english_verse: When they were outside, one of the angels said, “Run for your lives! Don't even look back. And don't stop in the valley. Run to the hills, where you'll be safe.”
translation_verse: Na bɛfale bɛ befili kuro ne aso nen, besele kyɛ, “Nwati pena wɔ ti ngoa! Nnɛnea wɔ si, yeɛ nnɛgyina aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ye aso nekaa biala! Nwati kɔ mmokaa ne anu dɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ na anyera ɔ!”

english_verse: Lot answered, “You have done us a great favor, sir. You have saved our lives, but please don't make us go to the hills. That's too far away. The city will be destroyed before we can get there, and we will be killed when it happens.
translation_verse: O, anwu w’akoaa anwumvoin, na alo me paa amaa manya me ti madidi nu. Nakoso mengɔhora nwati kɔ mmokaa ne anu dɔ; annea a né sɔ amaneɛ ne ato me atunu amaa mawu.

english_verse: There's a town near here. It's only a small place, but my family and I will be safe, if you let us go there.”
translation_verse: Mesrɛ wɔ, kuro bɔ ɔwɔ dɔ ye pingye bɔ ngɔhora ngɔnwati ngɔhɔ so ɔ, na ɔte kuro ba. Ennwu kyɛ ɔte kãa ɔ? Maa nwati ngɔ berɛ, na ngonya me ti ngodidi nu.”

english_verse: “All right, go there,” he answered. “I won't destroy that town.
translation_verse: Na obuale ye kyɛ, “Nea, ɛhe anwo koso manwu wɔ anwumvoin, kyɛ mengɔsɛkye kuro bɔ aha ye nwo dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: Hurry! Run! I can't do anything until you are safely there.” The town was later called Zoar because Lot had said it was small. Sodom and Gomorrah Are Destroyed
translation_verse: Ma wɔ nwo yɛ nyera na nwati kɔ berɛ, ofikyɛ mengɔhora ngɔyɔ nikye fee, sana adwu berɛ koraka.” Ye sɔ ne ati, kuro ne li Soa [bɔ ye bo kyire: Kaaba].

english_verse: The sun was coming up as Lot reached the town of Zoar,
translation_verse: Lɔto dwuli Soa nen, né eyia apukye aseɛ so.

english_verse: and the Lord sent burning sulfur down like rain on Sodom and Gomorrah.
translation_verse: Na afei AWURADE tɔle sɔfe ne see fili anwuro guale Sodom ne Gomora so.

english_verse: He destroyed those cities and everyone who lived in them, as well as their land and the trees and grass that grew there.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛkyele sɔ nguro nemɔ ne aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne amukoraa, nguro ne anu mmenia mukoraa, yeɛ nikyee biala bɔ wafifi aseɛ ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: On the way, Lot's wife looked back and was turned into a block of salt.
translation_verse: Nakoso Lɔto aye ne neane nziɛ, na ɔkakyili ngyee sire.

english_verse: That same morning Abraham got up and went to the place where he had stood and spoken with the Lord.
translation_verse: Abraham pɛle aleɛ hɔle nekaa bɔ né ogyi AWURADE nyunu ne.

english_verse: He looked down toward Sodom and Gomorrah and saw smoke rising from all over the land—it was like a flaming furnace.
translation_verse: Ɔtole ye nye neane Sodom ne Gomora, ɔne aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne amukoraa, na onwuni kyɛ aseɛ ne aso nwosina ótu kɔ anwuro kyɛ foonoo nu nwosina.

english_verse: When God destroyed the cities of the valley where Lot lived, he remembered his promise to Abraham and saved Lot from the terrible destruction. Moab and Ammon
translation_verse: Yiti mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ sɛkyele nguro bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso nen, ɔkayele Abraham, na amaneɛ bɔ ɔtole nguro bɔ Lɔto tenane so nemɔ maa bɛbɔle ne, ɔyele Lɔto fili nu. Moabofoɛ ne Amonfoɛ

english_verse: Lot was afraid to stay on in Zoar. So he took his two daughters and moved to a cave in the hill country.
translation_verse: Lɔto tu fili Soa, na ɔne ye mma mmrasua nyɔ ne bɛɛtenane mmokaa nemɔ anu dɔ, ofikyɛ né osuro kyɛ ɔkɔtena Soa. Na ɔne ye mma mmrasua nyɔ ne bɛɛtenane nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua nu.

english_verse: One day his older daughter said to her sister, “Our father is old, and there are no men anywhere for us to marry.
translation_verse: Na ye bamuɛbaa ne sele kãa ne kyɛ, “Yɛ baba anyi, yeɛ bienzua biala koso nne aseɛ ye aso bɔ ɔne yɛ kɔla, kyɛbɔ bɛyɔ ye ewiase amukoraa ne.

english_verse: Let's get our father drunk! Then we can sleep with him and have children.”
translation_verse: Yiti maa yɛma yɛ baba nzaa ma ɔno, na yɛne ye yɛla, amaa ɔnate yɛ baba so yanya yɛ boso ama.”

english_verse: That night they got their father drunk, and the older daughter got in bed with him, but he was too drunk even to know she was there.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛmane bɛ se nzaa maa ɔnone sɔ kɔngɔen ne; na bamuɛbaa ne hɔle ɔne ɔse bɛɛlale. Nakoso wannwu ɔwa ne nnaa nu ne ye dwɔsolɛ nu.

english_verse: The next day the older daughter said to her sister, “I slept with my father last night. We'll get him drunk again tonight, so you can sleep with him, and we can each have a child.”
translation_verse: Na aleɛ hyene ne, bamuɛbaa ne sele kãa ne kyɛ, “Nea, me ne me baba yɛlale anoma kɔngɔen. Maa yɛma ye nzaa ma ɔno ɛnɛ kɔngɔen ye koso, na ɛne ye bɛɛla, amaa ɔnate yɛ baba so yanya yɛ boso ama.”

english_verse: That night they got their father drunk, and this time the younger sister slept with him. But once again he was too drunk even to know she was there.
translation_verse: Yiti sɔ kɔngɔen ne koso bɛmane bɛ se nzaa ma ɔnone; na kaaba ne dwɔsole ɔne ye bɛɛlale. Nakoso wannwu ɔwa ne nnaa nu ne ye dwɔsolɛ nu.

english_verse: That's how Lot's two daughters had children.
translation_verse: Yiti sɔ yeɛ Lɔto mma mmrasua nyɔ ne bɛ ne bɛ se nwonzɛle ɔ.

english_verse: The older daughter named her son Moab, and he is the ancestor of the Moabites.
translation_verse: Bamuɛbaa ne wole baa bienzua, na ɔtole ye dumaa Moabo; na ɛnɛ ne ɛnɛ ye, ye boso ama ole Moabofoɛ.

english_verse: The younger daughter named her son Benammi, and he is the ancestor of the Ammonites.
translation_verse: Kãa ne koso wole baa bienzua, na ɔtole ye dumaa Ben Ami; na ɛnɛ ne ɛnɛ ye, ye boso ama ole Amonfoɛ.

english_verse: he told everyone that his wife Sarah was his sister. So King Abimelech of Gerar had Sarah brought to him.
translation_verse: Na Abraham ha fale ɔye Sara nwo kyɛ, “Nniɛma brasua ɔ.” Yiti Gera hene Abimɛlɛke somane maa bɛɛfale Sara bɛbrɛle ye.

english_verse: But God came to Abimelech in a dream and said, “You have taken a married woman into your home, and for this you will die!”
translation_verse: Nyameɛ ɔɔhyene Abimɛlɛke laleɛ kɔngɔen ne, na osele ye kyɛ, “Nea, awu ayie, ɔnate braa ne bɔ aafa ye awa ne ati, ofikyɛ ɔte biaa bie aye!”

english_verse: Abimelech said to the Lord, “Don't kill me! I haven't slept with Sarah. Didn't they say they were brother and sister? I am completely innocent.”
translation_verse: Nna ye bɔbɔ yeɛ osele me kyɛ, ‘Nniɛma brasua ɔ’? Nna braa ne bɔbɔ yeɛ ɔhane kyɛ, ‘Nniɛma bienzua ɔ’? Me ti anu te fufue wɔ edwirɛ he anwo, na me tiboa mmua me foɛ.”

english_verse: Her husband is a prophet. Let her go back to him, and his prayers will save you from death. But if you don't return her, you and all your people will die.
translation_verse: Yiti sá fa biaa n’aye kɔma ye: ɔte ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ, na okoli wɔ ti dwirɛ kɔma wɔ maa ekonya ngoa. Nakoso sɛ amva ye angɔ amma ye a, ye de kaye kyɛ ewue yeɛ ekowu ɔ, ɛne wɔ nwo ama ne wɔ nyɛmmoa mukoraati.”

english_verse: Early the next morning Abimelech sent for his officials, and when he told them what had happened, they were frightened.
translation_verse: Yiti Abimɛlɛke dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu, ɔfrɛle ye somvoɛ mɔ, na ɔfale bɔ wasi ne amukoraa nwo amaneɛ bɔle bɛ, na ɛserɛ piri paa hane bɛ.

english_verse: Abimelech then called in Abraham and said: Look what you've done to us! What have I ever done to you? Why did you make me and my nation guilty of such a terrible sin?
translation_verse: Na Abimɛlɛke frɛle Abraham bisale ye kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ afa ali yɛ sɔa ye? Nzikyɛ bɔne yeɛ mafa mayɔ wɔ, bɔ yiti yeɛ ama musue piri he ato me ne m’ahennie ye? Edwirɛ bɔ ɔtte mayee yeɛ afa ali me ɔ.”

english_verse: What were you thinking when you did this?
translation_verse: Na Abimɛlɛke bisale Abraham kyɛ, “Ɛhe bɔ ɛyɔle ye, nzikyɛ adwene paa yeɛ né ɛdwene ɔ?”

english_verse: Abraham answered: I did it because I didn't think any of you respected God, and I was sure that someone would kill me to get my wife.
translation_verse: Na Abraham buale kyɛ, “Né menwa nzɛ ɛwa ama nzuro Nyameɛ koraa, na me ye ne ati bekohu me.

english_verse: Besides, she is my half sister. We have the same father, but different mothers.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛnea paa a, nniɛma brasua ɔ. Me baba awa ɛne, nakoso nna me ni awa ɔ; na ɔɔyɛle me ye.

english_verse: When God made us leave my father's home and start wandering, I told her, “If you really love me, then tell everyone that I am your brother.”
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ maa ndu mvili me se awuro ngyinikyinini nen, nga ngyirele ye kyɛ, ‘Mepena kyɛ ɛyɔ me sɔ paa he: nekaa biala bɔ yɛkɔhɔ ne, ka kyɛ, ‘Nniɛma ɔ’ ”

english_verse: After Abimelech had given Abraham some sheep, cattle, and slaves, he sent Sarah back
translation_verse: Afei Abimɛlɛke mane Abraham mmoaen, nandwie, nganga mmienzua ne mmrasua, na osa fale ɔye Sara mane ye.

english_verse: and told Abraham he could settle anywhere in his country.
translation_verse: Na Abimɛlɛke sele kyɛ, “Nea, m’aseɛ yeɛ ɔla berɛ ye; tena nekaa biala bɔ ekuro ɔ.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, God had kept Abimelech's wife and slaves from having children. But Abraham prayed, and God let them start having children again.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, ɔnate Abraham aye Sara ti, né AWURADE ama Abimɛlɛke awuro mmrasua mukoraa bapɛ aworɛ.

english_verse: The Lord was good to Sarah and kept his promise.
translation_verse: AWURADE ɔɔpasale Sara nwo kyɛbɔ ɔhane ne ala, na kyɛbɔ ɔhyɛle Sara bɔ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔyɔle ɔ.

english_verse: Although Abraham was very old, Sarah had a son exactly at the time God had said.
translation_verse: Sara nwonzɛle, na ɔne Abraham bɛwole bienzua wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né Abraham ayɛ aworowaa ɔ, wɔ mmerɛ deinn bɔ Nyameɛ fa hyɛle ye bɔ ne.

english_verse: and when the boy was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him, just as God had commanded.
translation_verse: Abraham awa Yisake lili ɛlɛbɔtwɛ nen, ɔpɛle ye bienzua, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ hyɛle ye ne.

english_verse: and Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. And now everyone will laugh with me.
translation_verse: Na Sara sele kyɛ, “Nyameɛ amaa masere; na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔte ne ɔne me kɔsere.”

english_verse: Who would have dared to tell Abraham that someday I would have a child? But in his old age, I have given him a son.”
translation_verse: Na osa sele kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ ahaa ɔkɔha kohyire Abraham kyɛ Sara kɔma baa nyɔfone ɔ? Nakoso mawo baa mama ye wɔ mmerɛ bɔ wayɛ aworowaa ɔ.”

english_verse: The time came when Sarah no longer had to nurse Isaac, and on that day Abraham gave a big feast. Hagar and Ishmael Are Sent Away
translation_verse: Akwadaa ne nyini, na bɛpɛle ye nyɔfone; na kyẽa bɔ bɛpɛle Yisake nyɔfone nen, Abraham tole ɛpoen piri. Bɛfoa Hagar ne Yismael

english_verse: One day, Sarah noticed Hagar's son Ishmael playing, and she said to Abraham, “Get rid of that Egyptian slave woman and her son! I don't want him to inherit anything. It should all go to my son.”
translation_verse: Yiti osele Abraham kyɛ, “Foa afaneɛ he ne ɔwa ne ma bɛhɔ, ofikyɛ sɔ afaneɛ he awa ɔne mma Yisake bɛngɔbɔ nu bengoli bia ko.”

english_verse: But God said, “Abraham, don't worry about your slave woman and the boy. Just do what Sarah tells you. Isaac will inherit your family name,
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ sele Abraham kyɛ, “Nnɛma akwadaa ne ne w’afaneɛ ne dwirɛ ne ɔha wɔ. Na yɔ bɔ Sara ka kyire wɔ biala, ofikyɛ ɔnate Yisake so yeɛ ekonya wɔ bosofoɛ kaenn ɔ.

english_verse: but the son of the slave woman is also your son, and I will make his descendants into a great nation.”
translation_verse: Na afaneɛ n’awa ne koso, ngɔmaa ɔkɔkakyi maen, ofikyɛ ɔte wɔ bosoniɛ.”

english_verse: Early the next morning Abraham gave Hagar an animal skin full of water and some bread. Then he put the boy on her shoulder and sent them away. They wandered around in the desert near Beersheba,
translation_verse: Yiti Abraham dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu, na ɔfale aleɛ ne kɔndoa bɔ nzue wɔ nu mane Hagar fa tole ye kɔme anwo, na oguale ye ne ɔwa ne ate. Hagar sili nu hɔle, na oohyinihyini Beɛ Hyeba ɛserɛ so.

english_verse: and after they had run out of water, Hagar put her son under a bush.
translation_verse: Kɔndoa ne anu nzue yiele nen, ɔyakyili akwadaa ne tole ndire bie abo.

english_verse: When God heard the boy crying, the angel of God called out to Hagar from heaven and said, “Hagar, why are you worried? Don't be afraid. I have heard your son crying.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ tele akwadaa ne suɛ, na Nyameɛ abɔfo frɛle Hagar fili nyameɛso bisale ye kyɛ, “Hagar, nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔha wɔ ɔ? Nnɛsuro, ofikyɛ esuɛ bɔ akwadaa ne ɔla berɛ bɔ osũ ne, Nyameɛ ate.

english_verse: Help him up and hold his hand, because I will make him the father of a great nation.”
translation_verse: Dwɔso kɔma akwadaa ne aso, na tira ye nu yé, ofikyɛ ngɔma ye boso ama kɔyɛ maen pirikua.”

english_verse: Then God let her see a well. So she went to the well and filled the skin with water, then gave some to her son.
translation_verse: Afei Nyameɛ bukyele Hagar nye, na onwuni abura bie; ɔɔsale nzue ne bie guale kɔndoa ne anu, na ɔmane akwadaa ne bie maa ɔnone.

english_verse: About this time Abimelech and his army commander Phicol said to Abraham, “God blesses everything you do!
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Abimɛlɛke ne ye safohene Fikol beesele Abraham kyɛ, “Nyameɛ li wɔ si wɔ nikyee biala bɔ ɛyɔ nu;

english_verse: Now I want you to promise in the name of God that you will always be loyal to me and my descendants, just as I have always been loyal to you in this land where you have lived as a foreigner.”
translation_verse: yiti fa Nyameɛ ta ndaen kyire me kyɛ ɛngɔlakalaka me, anaa me mma, anaa me boso ama. Na kyɛbɔ mali nahorɛ mama wɔ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ di nahorɛ ma me ne aseɛ bɔ aayɛ so ɛwɔfoɛ ne ɔ.”

english_verse: And so, Abraham promised he would.
translation_verse: Na Abraham buale kyɛ, “Meta ndaen.”

english_verse: One day, Abraham told Abimelech, “Some of your servants have taken over one of my wells.”
translation_verse: Abraham fale nzue abura bie bɔ Abimɛlɛke ngoaa mɔ bafa patapaa so bale bafi ye sa nu nwo dwirɛ tole Abimɛlɛke nyunu.

english_verse: “This is the first I've heard about it,” Abimelech replied. “Why haven't you said something before? I don't have any idea who did it.”
translation_verse: Na Abimɛlɛke yele ye noa kyɛ, “Menze sona bɔ wayɔ sɔ nikyee ne; na wɔ koso anga angyire me. Nndele ye le, sana ɛnɛ ala.”

english_verse: Abraham gave Abimelech some sheep and cattle, then the two men made a peace treaty.
translation_verse: Afei Abraham mane Abimɛlɛke mmoaen ne nandwie, na bɛ munyɔ bɛyɛle apam.

english_verse: Abraham separated seven female lambs from his flock of sheep,
translation_verse: Abraham yele mmoaen mmeleɛ nzoo fili mmoaen kure ne anu siele ahameɛ.

english_verse: Abraham replied, “I want you to accept these seven lambs as proof that I dug this well.”
translation_verse: Na obuale kyɛ, “Ndira me sa nu mmoaen mmeleɛ nzoo hemɔ mefa mema wɔ, na ɔmaa edi me adanzeɛ kyɛ me yeɛ nduli abura he ɔ.”

english_verse: So they called the place Beersheba, because they made a treaty there.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛfrɛle berɛ Beɛ Hyeba, ofikyɛ berɛ yeɛ bɛ munyɔ bɛtale ndaen ɔ.

english_verse: When the treaty was completed, Abimelech and his army commander Phicol went back to the land of the Philistines.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛle apam wɔ Beɛ Hyeba beyiele nen, Abimɛlɛke ne ye safohene Fikol bedwɔsole besa bɛhɔle Filistifoɛ aseɛ so.

english_verse: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba and worshiped the eternal Lord God.
translation_verse: Abraham luale akyea wɔ Beɛ Hyeba, na ɔsɔnene AWURADE bɔ ɔte Ɛdangama Nyameɛ ne berɛ.

english_verse: Then Abraham lived a long time as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines.
translation_verse: Na Abraham yɛle ɛwɔfoɛ wɔ Filistifoɛ aseɛ so hyɛle.

english_verse: Some years later God decided to test Abraham, so he spoke to him. Abraham answered, “Here I am, Lord.”
translation_verse: Ɛhemɔ asi ne, Nyameɛ sole Abraham neane. Ɔfrɛle ye kyɛ, “Abraham!” Na Abraham surole kyɛ, “Me ɛhe.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Go get Isaac, your only son, the one you dearly love! Take him to the land of Moriah, and I will show you a mountain where you must sacrifice him to me on the fires of an altar.”
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ sele kyɛ, “Fa ɛwa ne, ɛwa komapɛ twe Yisake, bɔ ɔla w’ahone nwo ne, kɔ Moria aseɛ so, ná fa ye bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ wɔ berɛ, wɔ mmokaa nemɔ nu ko bɔ ngohyire wɔ ne aso.”

english_verse: So Abraham got up early the next morning and chopped wood for the fire. He put a saddle on his donkey and set out with Isaac and two servants for the place where God had told him to go.
translation_verse: Yiti Abraham dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu, osiesiele ye afunum ne, na ɔfale ye somvoɛ nemɔ nu nyɔ, ɔne ɔwa Yisake bokale ye nwo so. Ɔpakyele eyein bɔ ɔkwaafa bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, na osili nu hɔle nekaa bɔ Nyameɛ hyirele ye kyɛ ɔhɔ ne.

english_verse: Three days later Abraham looked off in the distance and saw the place.
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛsa ne aso, Abraham tole ye nye anwuro, na onwuni sɔ nekaa ne kyɛ ɔwɔ dedeede.

english_verse: He told his servants, “Stay here with the donkey, while my son and I go over there to worship. We will come back.”
translation_verse: Na Abraham sele ye somvoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ ne afunum ne bɛtena wa; na me ne akwadaa ye yɛkwaasɔne Nyameɛ wɔ moa dɔ, na yɛkosa yɛkɔwa ɛmɔ nwo wa.”

english_verse: Abraham put the wood on Isaac's shoulder, but he carried the hot coals and the knife. As the two of them walked along,
translation_verse: Abraham fale eyein bɔ ɔkwaafa bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne soale ɔwa Yisake, na ye koso ɔfale see ne dadeɛ ba ne tirale. Na bɛ munyɔ besili nu bɔ bɛ́kɔ nen,

english_verse: Isaac said, “Father, we have the coals and the wood, but where is the lamb for the sacrifice?” “My son,” Abraham answered, “God will provide the lamb.” The two of them walked on, and
translation_verse: Na Abraham buale kyɛ, “Mma, Nyameɛ bɔbɔ yeɛ okohyire boaen bɔ yɛfa yɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne ɔ.” Na bɛ munyɔ besili nu bɛhɔle.

english_verse: when they reached the place that God had told him about, Abraham built an altar and placed the wood on it. Next, he tied up his son and put him on the wood.
translation_verse: Na bedwuli nekaa bɔ Nyameɛ hyirele Abraham nen, Abraham sili afɔleɛ bokyea berɛ, na ɔfale eyein ne guaguale so yé. Afei ɔkyekyele ɔwa Yisake, na ɔfale ye tole eyein ne aso wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso.

english_verse: He then took the knife and got ready to kill his son.
translation_verse: Afei Abraham tole ye sa fale dadeɛ ba ne kyɛ oku ɔwa ne.

english_verse: But the Lord's angel shouted from heaven, “Abraham! Abraham!” “Here I am!” he answered.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE abɔfo ne frɛle ye fili nyameɛso kyɛ, “Abraham! Abraham!” Na osurole kyɛ, “Me ɛhe.”

english_verse: “Don't hurt the boy or harm him in any way!” the angel said. “Now I know that you truly obey God, because you were willing to offer him your only son.”
translation_verse: Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Nnɛfa wɔ sa ka akwadaa ne, yeɛ nnɛyɔ ye hwee, ofikyɛ afei de manwu kyɛ esuro Nyameɛ, na amva ɛwa komapɛ twe ne ammɔ me aheɛ.”

english_verse: Abraham looked up and saw a ram caught by its horns in the bushes. So he took the ram and sacrificed it instead of his son.
translation_verse: Abraham mane ye nye so, na yieee, onwuni boaen nyii bie [wɔ ye si dɔ], bɔ ndire asosɔ ye mmɛen nu akyekye ye abɔ berɛ ɔ. Abraham hɔle ɔɔfale boaen nyii ne, na ɔfale boaen ne mmom sili ɔwa ne gya nu ɔbɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne.

english_verse: Abraham named that place “The Lord Will Provide.” And even now people say, “On the mountain of the Lord it will be provided.”
translation_verse: Yiti Abraham tole berɛ dumaa “Adonai Yire, [anaa AWURADE kohyire].” Na ɛnɛ ne ɛnɛ ye po, mmenia ka kyɛ, “AWURADE bokaa ne aso yeɛ okohyire ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord's angel called out from heaven a second time:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE abɔfo ne frɛle Abraham pɛen nyɔ so fili nyameɛso kyɛ,

english_verse: You were willing to offer your only son to the Lord, and so he makes you this solemn promise,
translation_verse: “AWURADE nwa nyoo, ɔnate bɔ ayɔ ne, bɔ amva ɛwa komapɛ twe ne ammɔ me aheɛ ne ati, mata me nwo ndaen kyɛ

english_verse: “I will bless you and give you such a large family, that someday your descendants will be more numerous than the stars in the sky or the grains of sand along the seashore. They will defeat their enemies and take over the cities where their enemies live.
translation_verse: ngoyira wɔ, na ngɔma wɔ boso ama kɔsone kyɛ ewienu nzramaa ne mboanoa anweaa. Na wɔ boso ama kɔfa bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ aseɛ bekoli so.

english_verse: You have obeyed me, and so you and your descendants will be a blessing to all nations on earth.”
translation_verse: Ɔnate wɔ boso ama so yeɛ aseɛ ye aso maen maen amukoraa bekonya saleɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ atie me dwirɛ.”

english_verse: Abraham and Isaac went back to the servants who had come with him, and they returned to Abraham's home in Beersheba. The Children of Nahor
translation_verse: Yiti Abraham sá hɔle ye somvoɛ nemɔ nwo berɛ, na besili nu bɛhɔle Beɛ Hyeba; na Abraham tenane Beɛ Hyeba.

english_verse: Nahor also had another wife. Her name was Reumah, and she had four sons: Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.
translation_verse: Na ye sómaa ko bie bɔ oli Rehuma koso wole Teba, Gaham, Tahase ne Maaka.

english_verse: he went to the Hittites and said,
translation_verse: Abraham dwɔsole yakyili ɔye fuin ne berɛ, na osele Hitifoɛ nemɔ kyɛ,

english_verse: “I live as a foreigner in your land, and I don't own any property where I can bury my wife. Please let me buy a piece of land.”
translation_verse: “Nde ɛwɔfoɛ ne amanvraniɛ wɔ ɛmɔ nu wa. Ɛ́mɔma me ɛmɔ aseɛ ne bie ma mva nyɛ asieleɛ, na nzie me fuin ne ma ofi berɛ.”

english_verse: “Sir,” they answered, “you are an important man. Choose the best place to bury your wife. None of us would refuse you a resting place for your dead.”
translation_verse: “Yɛ mene, tie bɔ yɛkã ye. Ɛte sona titire wɔ yɛ nu wa. Sie wɔ fuin ne wɔ yɛ asieleɛ biala bɔ ekuro ɔ so. Yɛ nu biala ngɔfa ye asieleɛ ngɔbɔ wɔ atianuserɛ, anaa ongosi wɔ ate wɔ wɔ fuin ne sielɛ nu.”

english_verse: and replied, “If you are willing to let me bury my wife here, please ask Zohar's son Ephron
translation_verse: Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛmɔkuro kyɛ mesie me fuin ne maa ofi berɛ a, nzaade mesrɛ ɛmɔ, ɛ́mɔsrɛ Soha awa Efron

english_verse: to sell me Machpelah Cave at the end of his field. I'll pay what it's worth, and all of you can be witnesses.”
translation_verse: bɛma ɔfa nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua wɔ Makepɛla ne ɔma me. Ye deɛ ɔ, na ɔwɔ ye aseɛ ne noa. Kyɛbɔ ɔkɔfa kole ne, ɛ́mɔma ole ye ɛmɔ nyunu wa, na mva nyɛ asieleɛ wɔ ɛmɔ wa.”

english_verse: Ephron was sitting there near the city gate, when Abraham made this request, and he answered,
translation_verse: Né Hitiniɛ Efron boka Hitifoɛ nemɔ so wɔ berɛ bie, na Efron buale Abraham mane Hitifoɛ amukoraa bɔ bawa kuro ne anoa nu berɛ ne tele kyɛ,

english_verse: “Sir, the whole field, including the cave, is yours. With my own people as witnesses, I freely give it to you as a burial place for your dead.”
translation_verse: “Me mene, daabi, tie me kãa. Mefa aseɛ ne mema wɔ, na nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua wɔ nu ne koso mefa mema wɔ. Mefa mema wɔ wɔ me mmenia ye anyunu wa. Fa sie wɔ fuin ne.”

english_verse: and said to Ephron, “In front of these witnesses, I offer you the full price, so I can bury my wife. Please accept my offer.”
translation_verse: na osele Efron mane Hitifoɛ ne tele kyɛ, “Wɔ koso tie bɔ meka ye. Ngotua aseɛ ne kerɛ, maa ndua wɔ kerɛ, na mahora masie me fuin ne berɛ.”

english_verse: So Abraham buried his wife Sarah in Machpelah Cave that was in the field
translation_verse: Na ɛhe asi ne, Abraham siele ɔye Sara wɔ nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua nu, wɔ Makepɛla, wɔ Mamre ndendeneɛ so , wɔ Kanaan aseɛ so.

english_verse: Abraham was now a very old man. The Lord had made him rich, and he was successful in everything he did.
translation_verse: Né Abraham anyi, yeɛ né wayɛ aworowaa; na né AWURADE ayira Abraham wɔ nningyein amukoraati nu.

english_verse: One day, Abraham called in his most trusted servant and said to him, “Solemnly promise me
translation_verse: Na Abraham sele ye somvoɛ panyi paa bɔ ɔwɔ ye awuro berɛ, na osa nea ye nningyein mukoraa so ne kyɛ, “Fa wɔ sa fua me sɔ nu,

english_verse: in the name of the Lord, who rules heaven and earth, that you won't choose a wife for my son Isaac from the people here in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: na memaa ɛfa AWURADE, nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne aseɛ Nyameɛ ne ɛta ndaen kyɛ, Kanaanfoɛ bɔ nde bɛ nu wa ye, engogya bɛ nu brasua biala ngɔma mma ye.

english_verse: Instead, go back to the land where I was born and find a wife for him from among my relatives.”
translation_verse: Na mmom kɔ me maen nu ne m’abusuafoɛ berɛ kogya braa brɛ mma Yisake.

english_verse: But the servant asked, “What if the young woman I choose refuses to leave home and come here with me? Should I send Isaac there to look for a wife?”
translation_verse: Na somvoɛ ne bisale ye kyɛ, “Ebiaa né braa ne anguro kyɛ okoli me si ɔne me kɔwa sɔ maen he anu. Sɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, né mva ɛwa ne nza ngɔ maen bɔ efili so wale ne anu anaa?”

english_verse: “No!” Abraham answered. “Don't ever do that, no matter what.
translation_verse: Na Abraham buale ye kyɛ, “Nea yé né amva mma ne anza angɔ dɔ!

english_verse: The Lord who rules heaven brought me here from the land where I was born and promised that he would give this land to my descendants forever. When you go back there, the Lord will send his angel ahead of you to help you find a wife for my son.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE, nyameɛso Nyameɛ bɔ ɔfale me fili me baba awuro, ɔne aseɛ bɔ bɛwole me wɔ so ne, odwudwo hyirele me, na ɔtale ndaen hyirele me kyɛ, ‘Wɔ bosofoɛ yeɛ ngɔfa sɔ aseɛ he ngɔma bɛ ɔ.’ Na ye ala yeɛ ɔkɔsoma ye abɔfo maa okoli wɔ nyunu ɔ, ná aagya braa dɔ abrɛ mma ne ɔ.

english_verse: If the woman refuses to come along, you don't have to keep this promise. But don't ever take my son back there.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ braa ne nguro kyɛ ɔne wɔ ba a, ye de ɛngɔto ndaen bɔ mamaa ata ne; nakoso mma ne de, nnɛfa ye sá kɔ dɔ.”

english_verse: So the servant gave Abraham his word that he would do everything he had been told to do.
translation_verse: Yiti somvoɛ ne fale ye sa fuale ye mene Abraham sɔ nu, na ɔtale edwirɛ ne nwo ndaen hyirele Abraham.

english_verse: Soon after that, the servant loaded ten of Abraham's camels with valuable gifts. Then he set out for the city in northern Syria, where Abraham's brother Nahor lived.
translation_verse: Afei somvoɛ ne fale ye mene afupɔngɔ nemɔ nu buru, na osili nu hɔle. Olele akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔsɔ anyeɛ biala bie fili ye mene berɛ hɔle. Ɔhɔle Nahɔ kuro, wɔ Mesopotamia.

english_verse: When he got there, he let the camels rest near the well outside the city. It was late afternoon, the time when the women came out for water.
translation_verse: Na ɔmane afupɔngɔ nemɔ kotokotole kuro ne tiwaa wɔ abura bie anwo. Né ɔte nɔsoa, mmerɛ bɔ mmrasua kɔsa nzue ɔ.

english_verse: The servant prayed: You, Lord, are the God my master Abraham worships. Please keep your promise to him and let me find a wife for Isaac today.
translation_verse: Na ɔbɔle mbaeɛ kyɛ, “O AWURADE, me mene Abraham Nyameɛ, mesrɛ wɔ ala, maa ɔyɛ yee ma me ɛnɛ, ná kyire kyɛ ekuro me mene Abraham dwirɛ paa.

english_verse: The young women of the city will soon come to this well for water,
translation_verse: Nea oo, ngyi abura ye aso wa, na kuro wa ama bɛ ndaluwa nemɔ bɛbaasa nzue.

english_verse: and I'll ask one of them for a drink. If she gives me a drink and then offers to get some water for my camels, I'll know she is the one you have chosen and that you have kept your promise to my master.
translation_verse: Taluwa bɔ ngɔhã ngohyire ye kyɛ, ‘Mesrɛ wɔ, ka wɔ bua ne ase ma nno nzue ne bie,’ ná ye wora ɔkɔha kyɛ, ‘No bie, na ngɔma w’afupɔngɔ nemɔ koso bie’ nen, maa ɔyɛ sona bɔ aneanea nu aye ye ama w’akoaa Yisake ɔ. Na ɛhe kɔmaa ngonwu ye kyɛ ekuro me mene dwirɛ paa.”

english_verse: While he was still praying, a beautiful unmarried young woman came by with a water jar on her shoulder. She was Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Abraham's brother Nahor and his wife Milcah. Rebekah walked past Abraham's servant, then went over to the well, and filled her water jar. When she started back,
translation_verse: Né taluwa ne nwo yɛ nyemene paa; ɔte ababunu bɔ onnwuni biaa le ɔ. Ɔhɔle abura ne anu ɔɔfale ye bua ne sale nzue, na ofili nu fitele.

english_verse: Abraham's servant ran to her and said, “Please let me have a drink of water.”
translation_verse: Somvoɛ ne tuli amirika ooyiale ye, na osele ye kyɛ, “Mesrɛ wɔ, maa nno wɔ bua ye anu nzue ye kãa.”

english_verse: “I'll be glad to,” she answered. Then she quickly took the jar from her shoulder and held it while he drank.
translation_verse: Obuale kyɛ, “Me mene, no bie.” Na osikyele ye bua ne siele ye sa nu ndɛndɛ maa ɔnone bie.

english_verse: After he had finished, she said, “Now I'll give your camels all the water they want.” She quickly poured out water for them, and she kept going back for more, until his camels had drunk all they wanted.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ndɛndɛ ohwiele ye bua ne anu nzue guale nikyee bɔ ngaka no nu nzue ne anu, na otuli amirika ɔhɔle abura ne anu ɔɔsale nzue bieku mane ye afupɔngɔ ne amukoraa none.

english_verse: Abraham's servant did not say a word, but he watched everything Rebekah did, because he wanted to know for certain if this was the woman the Lord had chosen.
translation_verse: Biaa ne yɛle dinn neane ye haa, kyɛ ɔnea sɛ AWURADE agyina ye si wɔ ye ateetulɛ ne anu, anaa wangyina.

english_verse: The servant had brought along an expensive gold ring and two large gold bracelets. When Rebekah had finished bringing the water, he gave her the ring for her nose and the bracelets for her arms.
translation_verse: Afupɔngɔ nemɔ none nzue ne yiele nen, biaa ne fale sikaa kɔkorɛ kaa bɔ nu nonɛ te kilo ko nu ngyɛmuɛ ɛyaa nyɔ wurale ye. Osa fale bɛ sa kɔm sikaa kɔkorɛ ngaa nyɔ bɔ nu nonɛ te kilo ko nu ngyɛmuɛ buru wurale ye.

english_verse: Then he said, “Please tell me who your father is. Does he have room in his house for me and my men to spend the night?”
translation_verse: Na osele ye kyɛ, “Nwa awa ole wɔ? Mesrɛ wɔ, ka kyire me. Aso yɛkonya nekaa yɛkosikye wɔ wɔ baba awuro?”

english_verse: She answered, “My father is Bethuel, the son of Nahor and Milcah.
translation_verse: Na obuale ye kyɛ, “Nahɔ ne Milka awa bienzua Betuel awa ole me.”

english_verse: We have a place where you and your men can stay, and we also have enough straw and feed for your camels.”
translation_verse: Na ɔfa sɔle so kyɛ, “Yɛle ɛserɛ ne nzenzaen pee, ɔne sua bɔ ɛmɔkɔla nu ɔ.”

english_verse: Then the servant bowed his head and prayed,
translation_verse: Na biaa ne bɔle ye ti ase sɔnene AWURADE

english_verse: “I thank you, Lord God of my master Abraham! You have led me to his relatives and kept your promise to him.”
translation_verse: kyɛ, “Animnyam hã AWURADE, me mene Abraham Nyameɛ bɔ wamma ye wora amvi ye paayɛlɛ ne ye nahorɛ bɔ odi ma me mene ɔ. Na me koso, AWURADE ayɛ me taataa wafa me wawa me mene abusuafoɛ awuro.”

english_verse: Rebekah ran straight home and told her family everything.
translation_verse: Afei taluwa ne tuli amirika hɔle oni awuro ɔɔhane edwirɛ he amukoraa.

english_verse: Her brother Laban heard her tell what the servant had said, and he saw the ring and the bracelets she was wearing. So Laban ran out to Abraham's servant, who was standing by his camels at the well.
translation_verse: Na onwuni ye bonyi anu kaa, ɔne bɛ sa kɔm ngaa bɔ ogua oliɛma brasua ne sa ne, ná ɔtele bɔ Rebɛka nwa biaa ne aha ahyire ye nen, ɔhɔle biaa ne nwo berɛ ɔɔtole ye kyɛ ogyi afupɔngɔ nemɔ nwo wɔ abura ne aso.

english_verse: Then Laban said, “The Lord has brought you safely here. Come home with me. There's no need for you to keep on standing outside. I have a room ready for you in our house, and there's also a place for your camels.”
translation_verse: Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Wɔ bɔ AWURADE ayira wɔ ɔ, bra awuro. Nzu ati yeɛ egyi tiwaa ɔ? Masiesie nekaa mama wɔ, ɔne nekaa bɔ afupɔngɔ nemɔ kɔla ɔ.”

english_verse: Abraham's servant went home with Laban, where Laban's servants unloaded his camels and gave them straw and feed. Then they brought water into the house, so Abraham's servant and his men could wash their feet.
translation_verse: Yiti biaa ne hɔle awuro. Laban nyangyele afupɔngɔ nemɔ nningyein ne, na ɔmane bɛ ɛserɛ ne nzenzaen. Na ɔmane biaa ne ne ye mmenia bɔ ɔne bɛ nate ne nzue maa benwunzini bɛ gya bo.

english_verse: After that, they brought in food. But the servant said, “Before I eat, I must tell you why I have come.” “Go ahead and tell us,” Laban answered.
translation_verse: Bɛbrɛle biaa ne aleɛ, nakoso osele kyɛ, “Mengodidi, sana mabɔ m’amaneɛ koraka.” Na Laban sele kyɛ, “Nzaade bɔ e.”

english_verse: The servant explained: I am Abraham's servant.
translation_verse: Osele kyɛ, “Nde Abraham somvoɛ.

english_verse: The Lord has been good to my master and has made him very rich. He has given him many sheep, goats, cattle, camels, and donkeys, as well as a lot of silver and gold, and many slaves.
translation_verse: AWURADE ayira me mene paa, na wayɛ sona titire. Wama ye mmoaen ne nandwie, ɛdwetɛ, sikaa kɔkorɛ, ngoaa ne afaneɛ mɔ, afupɔngɔ ne afunum mɔ.

english_verse: Sarah, my master's wife, didn't have any children until she was very old. Then she had a son, and my master has given him everything.
translation_verse: Me mene aye Sara yɛle aworowaa ne, ɔwole baa bienzua mane me mene, na ye yeɛ me mene afa ye nningyein mukoraa ama ye ɔ.

english_verse: I solemnly promised my master that I would do what he said. And he told me, “Don't choose a wife for my son from the women in this land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Me mene maa ndale ndaen. Ɔnwa: ‘Kanaanfoɛ bɔ nde b’aseɛ so ye, ɔnzɛ kyɛ egya bɛ nu brasua biala ɛma mma ne.

english_verse: Instead, go back to the land where I was born and find a wife for my son from among my relatives.”
translation_verse: Na mmom kɔ me se awuro ne m’abusuafoɛ berɛ kogya braa brɛ mma ne.’

english_verse: I asked my master, “What if the young woman refuses to come with me?”
translation_verse: Na mmisale me mene kyɛ, ‘Na sɛ braa ne ɔne me ngɔwa ɛ?’

english_verse: My master answered, “I have always obeyed the Lord, and he will send his angel to help you find my son a wife from among my own relatives.
translation_verse: Na obuale me kyɛ, ‘AWURADE bɔ me ne ye yɛnate ne, ɔkɔsoma ye abɔfo maa ɔne wɔ kɔhɔ, ná wama wɔ sa aha w’ateetulɛ botaeɛ ne; ná aagya braa afi m’abusua nu ne me se awuro abrɛ mma ne.

english_verse: But if they refuse to let her come back with you, then you are freed from your promise.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛkɔ m’abusuafoɛ berɛ na bamva braa ne bamma wɔ de a, ye de ɛndo me ndaen ne.’

english_verse: When I came to the well today, I silently prayed, “You, Lord, are the God my master Abraham worships, so please lead me to a wife for his son
translation_verse: Ɛnɛ mmale abura ne aso ne, ngane kyɛ, ‘O AWURADE, me mene Abraham Nyameɛ, sɛ ɛma me sa ka m’ateetulɛ ye anu botaeɛ a …

english_verse: while I am here at the well. When a young woman comes out to get water, I'll ask her to give me a drink.
translation_verse: Mesrɛ wɔ, ngyi abura ye aso wa. Taluwa bɔ ɔkɔwa kyɛ ɔbaasa nzue, bɔ ngose ye kyɛ, “Mesrɛ wɔ, ma me wɔ bua ye anu nzue kãa ma nno,”

english_verse: If she gives me a drink and offers to get some water for my camels, I'll know she is the one you have chosen.”
translation_verse: na ye wora okobua me kyɛ, “No bie, na ngɔɔsa bie ngɔma w’afupɔngɔ nemɔ koso” nen, maa ɔyɛ braa bɔ AWURADE asiesie ama me mene awa ne ɔ.’

english_verse: Even before I had finished praying, Rebekah came by with a water jar on her shoulder. When she had filled the jar, I asked her for a drink.
translation_verse: Manyie me dwirɛ bɔ né méka ye me ti anu ne, yeɛ Rebɛka oofitele berɛ bɔ né bua gyi ye bati so ɔ. Ɔhɔle abura ne anu ɔɔsale nzue, na nga ngyirele ye kyɛ, ‘Mesrɛ wɔ, ma me bie ma nno.’

english_verse: She quickly lowered the jar from her shoulder and said, “Have a drink. Then I'll get water for your camels.” So I drank, and after that she got some water for my camels.
translation_verse: Berɛ ne ala, osikyele ye bua ne fili ye bati so, na osele kyɛ, ‘No bie, na ngɔma w’afupɔngɔ nemɔ koso bie.’ Nnone, na ɔmane afupɔngɔ nemɔ koso bie.

english_verse: I asked her who her father was, and she answered, “My father is Bethuel the son of Nahor and Milcah.” At once I put the ring in her nose and the bracelets on her arms.
translation_verse: Na mmisale ye kyɛ, ‘Nwa awa ole wɔ?’ Obuale kyɛ, ‘Nahɔ ne ɔye Milka awa bienzua Betuel ɔwa ole me.’ Na mvale bonyi kaa ne nwurale ye, yeɛ bɛ sa kɔm ngaa ne koso mva nwurale ye.

english_verse: Then I bowed my head and gave thanks to the God my master Abraham worships. The Lord had led me straight to my master's relatives, and I had found a wife for his son.
translation_verse: Afei mmɔle me ti ase nzɔnene AWURADE, na nyele AWURADE, me mene Abraham Nyameɛ ayɛ, ye bɔ wayɛ me taataa kyɛ mmra mmangya me mene aliɛma awa mma ɔwa ne.

english_verse: Now please tell me if you are willing to do the right thing for my master. Will you treat him fairly, or do I have to look for another young woman?
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ ɛmɔkɔpene so na ɛmɔkoli nahorɛ bɛkɔma me mene a, ɛmɔhã behyire me. Na sɛ ɛmɔngɔpene koso a, ɛmɔhã, na nwu kyɛbɔ mesi meyɛ me nwo ɔ.”

english_verse: Laban and Bethuel answered, “The Lord has done this. We have no choice in the matter.
translation_verse: Na Laban ne Betuel bebuale kyɛ, “Edwirɛ he fi AWURADE berɛ, yiti yɛngɔhora yɛngosi ye nwo ate.

english_verse: Take Rebekah with you; she can marry your master's son, just as the Lord has said.”
translation_verse: Nea, Rebɛka yeɛ ogyi wɔ nyunu berɛ ne. Ɛne ye bɛhɔ ma ɔɔyɛ wɔ mene awa n’aye, kyɛbɔ AWURADE aha ne.”

english_verse: Abraham's servant bowed down and thanked the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Abraham somvoɛ ne tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, obutuli berɛ yele AWURADE ayɛ.

english_verse: Then he gave clothing, as well as silver and gold jewelry, to Rebekah. He also gave expensive gifts to her brother and her mother.
translation_verse: Afei somvoɛ ne yele ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ mbembenanneɛ ne ɛtena, na ɔfa mane Rebɛka. Osa mane oliɛma bienzua ne oni nningyein bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se ɔ.

english_verse: Abraham's servant and the men with him ate and drank, then spent the night there. The next morning they got up, and the servant told Rebekah's mother and brother, “I would like to go back to my master now.”
translation_verse: Afei ɔne mmenia bɔ bɛboka ye so ne bedidili bɛnone, na bɛlale berɛ kɔngɔen ne. Na bedwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ nen, somvoɛ ne sele kyɛ, “Mésrɛ atee mesa mekɔ me mene berɛ.”

english_verse: “Let Rebekah stay with us for a week or ten days,” they answered. “Then she may go.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Rebɛka aliɛma ne oni besele kyɛ, “Ma taluwa ne ɔtena yɛ wa kãa, kɔyɛ eleburu, na ye si ye wahɔ.”

english_verse: But he said, “Don't make me stay any longer. The Lord has already helped me find a wife for my master's son. Now let us return.”
translation_verse: Na somvoɛ ne buale bɛ kyɛ, “Nnɛmɔma mekyɛ, ofikyɛ AWURADE ama mvasoɛ awa m’ateetulɛ ne aso. Ɛmɔma me ate ma nza ngɔ me mene dɔ.”

english_verse: They answered, “Let's ask Rebekah what she wants to do.”
translation_verse: Na besele kyɛ, “Nzaade maa yɛfrɛ taluwa ne yɛbisa ye.”

english_verse: They called her and asked, “Are you willing to leave with this man at once?” “Yes,” she answered.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛfrɛle Rebɛka, na bebisale ye kyɛ, “Ɛne biaa he kɔhɔ anaa?” Na obuale kyɛ, “Yoo, ngɔhɔ.”

english_verse: So they agreed to let Rebekah and an old family servant woman leave immediately with Abraham's servant and his men.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛmane b’eliɛma Rebɛka ne ye abaawa ne, yeɛ Abraham somvoɛ ne ne ye mmenia ne ate maa bɛhɔle.

english_verse: They gave Rebekah their blessing and said, “We pray that God will give you many children and grandchildren and that he will help them defeat their enemies.”
translation_verse: Beyirayirale Rebɛka, na besele ye kyɛ, “Aliɛmaa, ɛ́kɔ ye, su mmenia apee apee; ná wɔ bosofoɛ mɔ koso beli bɛ pɔfoɛ kuro mɔ so ngonim!”

english_verse: Afterwards, Rebekah and the young women who were to travel with her prepared to leave. Then they got on camels and left with Abraham's servant and his men.
translation_verse: Afei Rebɛka ne ye abaawa nemɔ bedwɔsole; bɛtenatenane afupɔngɔ mɔ so belili Abraham somvoɛ ne si, na ɔfale Rebɛka hɔle.

english_verse: At that time Isaac was living in the southern part of Canaan near a place called “The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.”
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Yisake afi Beɛ Lahai Roi wawa, ofikyɛ né ɔte ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne aso dɔ.

english_verse: One evening he was walking out in the fields, when suddenly he saw a group of people approaching on camels. So he started toward them. Rebekah saw him coming; she got down from her camel, and asked, “Who is that man?” “He is my master Isaac,” the servant answered. Then Rebekah covered her face with her veil.
translation_verse: Na obisale somvoɛ ne kyɛ, “Aberandeɛ bɔ ɔnate ndire ye anu dɔ ɔbaayia yɛ ye, nwa ɛne? Na somvoɛ ne buale kyɛ, “Me mene ɛne.” Yiti Rebɛka yele ye duku ne fa katale ye nyunu.

english_verse: The servant told Isaac everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Somvoɛ ne fale bɔ wayɔ amukoraa nwo amaneɛ bɔle Yisake.

english_verse: Isaac took Rebekah into the tent where his mother had lived before she died, and Rebekah became his wife. He loved her and was comforted over the loss of his mother.
translation_verse: Afei Yisake fale Rebɛka hɔle oni Sara ɛtena sua nu. Ogyale Rebɛka, na ɔyɛle ɔye, na ohurole ye. Yiti Yisake nyane aworakyekyerɛ wɔ oni wue ne asi.

english_verse: and they had six sons: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah.
translation_verse: Ɔne ye bɛwole Simram, Yokesan, Medan, Midian, Yisbake ne Suwa.

english_verse: Later, Jokshan became the father of Sheba and Dedan, and when Dedan grew up, he had three sons: Asshurim, Letushim, and Leummim.
translation_verse: Yokesan wole Hyeba ne Dedan. Dedan wole Asurifoɛ, Letusifoɛ ne Leomufoɛ.

english_verse: Midian also had five sons: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah.
translation_verse: Midian wole Efa, Efɛre, Hanoke, Abida ne Eldaa. Ɛhemɔ amukoraa ole Ketura mma.

english_verse: While Abraham was still alive, he gave gifts to the sons of Hagar and Keturah. He also sent their sons to live in the east far from his son Isaac, and when Abraham died, he left everything to Isaac. The Death of Abraham
translation_verse: Nakoso Abraham sómaa nemɔ bɛ mma de, ɔhyɛle bɛ nningyein, na mmerɛ bɔ né ɔte ase ne, ɔmaa bɛhwene bɛ nwo befili ɔwa Yisake nwo bɛhɔle eyia afiteleɛ aseɛ ne aso dɔ. Abraham wue ne ye sielɛ

english_verse: God blessed Isaac after this, and Isaac moved to a place called “The Well of the Living One Who Sees Me.” Ishmael's Descendants
translation_verse: Abraham wue asi ne, Nyameɛ yirale ɔwa Yisake. Na Yisake tenane pingyele Lahai Roi abura ne. Yismael boso ama (

translation_verse: Abraham awa Yismael, bɔ Misraimniɛ Hagar, Sara afaneɛ bɔ ɔne Abraham bɛwole ne, ye boso ama mɔ ɛhe:

english_verse: Ishmael had twelve sons, in this order: Nebaioth, Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
translation_verse: Yismael mma nemɔ dumaa, kyɛbɔ belili so wɔ aworɛ nu ɛhe: Ye bamuɛbaa ole Nebayote, yeɛ afei Kedare, Adebel ne Mibesam,

english_verse: Mishma, Dumah, Massa,
translation_verse: Misma, Duma, Masa,

english_verse: Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.
translation_verse: Hadade, Tema, Yeture, Nafise ne Kedema.

english_verse: Each of Ishmael's sons was a tribal chief, and a village was named after each of them.
translation_verse: Ɛhemɔ ole Yismael mma nemɔ, na bɛ dumaa ɛne: kyɛbɔ sɔ atitirefoɛ buru ne nyɔ nemɔ bɛ dumaa ɔɔlale bɛ nguraa ne asikyeleɛ mɔ so ɛne.

english_verse: Ishmael had settled in the land east of his brothers, and his sons settled everywhere from Havilah to Shur, east of Egypt on the way to Asshur. Ishmael was
translation_verse: Ye boso ama tenane fili Hawila maa oodwuli Sure, bɔ sɛ ɛ́kɔ Asiria a ɔwɔ Misraim ndendeneɛ so ne. Na ɔne oliɛma nemɔ amukoraa banyakyi ngondii honɛ. Yakob ne Yisɔ aworɛ

english_verse: Isaac was the son of Abraham,
translation_verse: Abraham awa Yisake, ye boso ama mɔ ɛhe: Abraham wole Yisake.

english_verse: Rebekah still had no children. So Isaac asked the Lord to let her have a child, and the Lord answered his prayer.
translation_verse: Yisake fale ye mbaeɛ tole AWURADE nyunu mane ɔye, ofikyɛ né ɔye ne te mmotaen. AWURADE tiele ye mbaeɛ, na ɔye Rebɛka nwonzɛle.

english_verse: Before Rebekah gave birth, she knew she was going to have twins, because she could feel them inside her, fighting each other. She thought, “Why is this happening to me?” Finally, she asked the Lord why her twins were fighting,
translation_verse: Ngwadaa nemɔ lili apereapereɛ wɔ ye kunu, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Sɛ ɔte sɔ de a, nzaade nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ wato me ye?” Yiti ɔhɔle AWURADE sona berɛ oobisale so.

english_verse: and he told her: “Your two sons will become two separate nations. The younger of the two will be stronger, and the older son will be his servant.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele ye kyɛ, “Maen nyɔ wɔ wɔ kunu, na mmenia fekue nyɔ bɔ ɛkɔwo bɛ ne, b’afia ngɔwo fite b’aworɛ nu. Ko koli obiɛngo so, na panyi ne kɔso kãa ne.”

english_verse: the first baby was covered with red hair, so he was named Esau.
translation_verse: Bɔ olili moa wale ne te kɔkorɛ, na né enwiaa wɔ ye nwo paa; yiti bɛtole ye dumaa Yisɔ.

english_verse: As Jacob and Esau grew older, Esau liked the outdoors and became a good hunter, while Jacob lived the quiet life of a shepherd.
translation_verse: Ngwadaa nemɔ nyini. Yisɔ yɛle bɔfoɛ paa, na né okuro eburo wurawuralɛ. Nakoso Yakob de, né onguro ye nwo dwudwolɛ, na daa né owurawura ɛtena sua nu.

english_verse: Esau would take the meat of wild animals to his father Isaac, so Isaac loved him more, but Jacob was his mother's favorite son.
translation_verse: Né Yisake kuro Yisɔ dwirɛ, ofikyɛ né Yisɔ ku eburo naen maa odi; nakoso Rebɛka de, né okuro Yakob dwirɛ.

english_verse: One day, when Jacob was cooking some stew, Esau came home hungry
translation_verse: Ɛlɛho bie, né Yakob ɔyɔ ye abomu yeɛ Yisɔ fili eburo wale ɔ. Né ɛhɔen apɛ ye.

english_verse: and said, “I'm starving to death! Here and now give me some of that red stew!” That's how Esau got the name “Edom.”
translation_verse: Na Yisɔ sele Yakob kyɛ, “Mesrɛ wɔ, ɛhɔen apɛ me, yiti ma me abomu bɔ ye nye kɔkorɛ ne bie ma nni.” Ɛhe ati yeɛ ɔmaa bɛfrɛ ye Edom, bɔ ye bo kyire Kɔkorɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Jacob replied, “Sell me your rights as the first-born son.”
translation_verse: Na Yakob buale ye kyɛ, “Di moa tɔne wɔ bamuɛbaa dibea ne ma me koraka.”

english_verse: “I'm about to die,” Esau answered. “What good will those rights do me?”
translation_verse: Na Yisɔ sele kyɛ, “Mepena mewu, na bamuɛbaa dibea koso meyɛ ye sɛ?”

english_verse: But Jacob said, “Promise me your birthrights, here and now!” And that's what Esau did.
translation_verse: Na Yakob sele kyɛ, “Nzaade ta ndaen kyire me koraka. “Yiti ɔtale ndaen hyirele ye, na ɔyɛle ye bamuɛbaa dibea ne atɔen mane Yakob.

english_verse: Jacob then gave Esau some bread and some of the bean stew, and when Esau had finished eating and drinking, he just got up and left, showing how little he thought of his rights as the first-born.
translation_verse: Afei Yakob mane Yisɔ paanoo ne ngongo abomu ne bie. Odidili, ɔnone, na odwɔsole hɔle. Yiti Yisɔ ammu ye bamuɛbaa dibea ne huu.

english_verse: Once during Abraham's lifetime, the fields had not produced enough grain, and now the same thing happened. So Isaac went to King Abimelech of the Philistines in the land of Gerar,
translation_verse: Ɛhɔen piri bie wale aseɛ ne aso; asora ɛhɔen piri bɔ olili moa wale Abraham aberɛ so ne. Na Yisake hɔle Filisti hene Abimɛlɛke berɛ wɔ Gyeraa.

english_verse: because the Lord had appeared to Isaac and said: Isaac, stay away from Egypt! I will show you where I want you to go.
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE yele ye nwo ali hyirele Yisake sele ye kyɛ, “Nnɛkɔ Misraim, na mmom tena aseɛ bɔ mebaahyire wɔ ye aso.

english_verse: You will live there as a foreigner, but I will be with you and bless you. I will keep my promise to your father Abraham by giving this land to you and your descendants.
translation_verse: Tena aseɛ ye aso kyɛ ɛwɔfoɛ, na ngogyina wɔ si na mayira wɔ; ofikyɛ ngɔfa sɔ aseɛ ye mɔ amukoraa ngɔma wɔ ne wɔ bosofoɛ na mamaa bɔhyɛ bɔ nhyɛle ɛse Abraham ne awa nu.

english_verse: I will give you as many descendants as there are stars in the sky, and I will give your descendants all of this land. They will be a blessing to every nation on earth,
translation_verse: Ngɔmaa wɔ bosofoɛ kɔsone kyɛ nyameɛso nzramaa, na ngɔfa aseɛ ye amukoraa ngɔma bɛ, na ɔnate bɛ so yeɛ amaen maen mukoraa bekonya saleɛ ɔ,

english_verse: because Abraham did everything I told him to do.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ Abraham tiele me dwirɛ, olili me dwirɛ so, me mmeraa dwirɛ so, m’ahyɛdeɛ ne me mmeraa so.”

english_verse: Isaac moved to Gerar
translation_verse: Yiti Yisake tenane Gyeraa.

english_verse: with his beautiful wife Rebekah. He was afraid that someone might kill him to get her, and so he told everyone that Rebekah was his sister.
translation_verse: Na sɛ né berɛ mmienzua bisa ye dwirɛ fa ɔye nwo a, ose bɛ kyɛ, “Nniɛma brasua ɔ”. Né osuro kyɛ ɔkɔha kyɛ, “Me ye ɔ,” ofikyɛ né ɔdwene kyɛ ɔnate Rebɛka anwonyemene somaa ne ati, annea a, berɛ ama kohũ ye.

english_verse: After Isaac had been there a long time, King Abimelech looked out a window and saw Isaac hugging and kissing Rebekah.
translation_verse: Na Yisake tenane berɛ hyɛle ne, ɛlɛho bie, Filisti hene Abimɛlɛke neane mboma nu, na onwuni kyɛ Yisake ne ɔye Rebɛka bedi aweweɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Abimelech called him in and said, “Rebekah must be your wife! Why did you say she is your sister?” “Because I thought someone would kill me,” Isaac answered.
translation_verse: Yiti Abimɛlɛke frɛle Yisake, na osele ye kyɛ, “Nea, ɛye ɔ, nzu ati yeɛ ɛnwa ‘nniɛma brasua’ ahɔ ɔ?” Na Yisake buale ye kyɛ, “Ofikyɛ né medwene kyɛ annea a ɔnate ye ti bekohu me.”

english_verse: “Don't you know what you've done?” Abimelech exclaimed. “If someone had slept with her, you would have made our whole nation guilty!”
translation_verse: Abimɛlɛke sele ye kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ afa ali yɛ ye? Ahaa mmienzua ye anu bie kɔhora ne ɛye bɛkɔla na wama musue awa yɛ so.”

english_verse: Then Abimelech warned his people that anyone who even touched Isaac or Rebekah would be put to death.
translation_verse: Yiti Abimɛlɛke kanzole mmenia ne amu kyɛ, “Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔha biaa he anaa ɔye ne, ehunɛ yeɛ ngɔmaa bekohu ye ɔ.

english_verse: Isaac planted grain and had a good harvest that same year. The Lord blessed him,
translation_verse: Na Yisake yɔle eboo wɔ aseɛ ne aso, na sɔ afoɛ ne ala onyane aleɛ mmɔhoɛ ɛyaa. AWURADE yirale ye

english_verse: and Isaac was so successful that he became very rich.
translation_verse: maa onyane ye nwo, na ɔhɔle so nyane ye nwo maa oodwuli kyɛ onyane ye nwo tam.

english_verse: In fact, the Philistines were jealous of the large number of sheep, goats, and slaves that Isaac owned,
translation_verse: Onyane mmoaen ne nandwie mɔ ɔne ngoaa pee. Yiti Filistifoɛ nemɔ nye borole ye.

english_verse: Finally, Abimelech said, “Isaac, I want you to leave our country. You have become too powerful to stay here.”
translation_verse: Yiti Abimɛlɛke sele Yisake kyɛ, “Fi yɛ wa kɔ, ofikyɛ wɔ nwo suronyi atɔ yɛ so.”

english_verse: where he cleaned out those wells that the Philistines had stopped up. Isaac also gave each of the wells the same name that Abraham had given to them.
translation_verse: Na Yisake sá tuli abura bɔ betutuli ye Abraham aberɛ so ne bieku, ofikyɛ Abraham ye wue asi ne Filistifoɛ tuatuale bɛ. Osa fale dumaa bɔ ɔse fa totole bɛ ne tole bɛ.

english_verse: While his servants were digging in the valley, they found a spring-fed well.
translation_verse: Nakoso Yisake ngoaa nemɔ tuli bɔnza ne anu abura na benwuni asue ti bɔ opu ba wɔ berɛ nen,

english_verse: But the shepherds of Gerar Valley quarreled with Isaac's shepherds and claimed the water belonged to them. So this well was named “Quarrel,” because they had quarreled with Isaac.
translation_verse: Gyeraa mmoaenneafoɛ ne Yisake mmoaenneafoɛ nyane dwudwolɛ. Gyeraa mmoaenneafoɛ ne hane kyɛ, “Nzue ye te yɛ deɛ”. Yiti Yisake frɛle sɔ abura ne Eseke, ofikyɛ bɛ ne ye perele.

english_verse: Isaac's servants dug another well, and the shepherds also quarreled about it. So that well was named “Jealous.”
translation_verse: Yisake ngoaa nemɔ tuli abura foforɛ, na besa bɛ ne bɛ bedwudwole ye nwo, yiti ɔfrɛle ye Sitina.

english_verse: Finally, they dug one more well. There was no quarreling this time, and the well was named “Lots of Room,” because the Lord had given them room and would make them very successful.
translation_verse: Na ofili berɛ hɔle ootuli abura foforɛ, na ɛhene de edwudwolɛ amma ye nwo. Yiti ɔfrɛle ye Rehobote, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Afei de AWURADE ama yɛ atenaleɛ, yiti yɛ boso kɔtrɛ aseɛ ye aso.”

english_verse: Isaac went on to Beersheba,
translation_verse: Na Yisake fili berɛ ne, ɔhɔle Beɛ Hyeba.

translation_verse: Na AWURADE yele ye nwo ali hyirele Yisake sɔ kɔngɔen ne ala, na osele ye kyɛ, “Me ole wɔ baba Abraham ye Nyameɛ. Nnɛsuro, ofikyɛ ngyi wɔ si. Ɔnate m’akoaa Abraham ti ngoyira wɔ na mamaa wɔ bosofoɛ asone.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, Abimelech had left Gerar and was taking his advisor Ahuzzath and his army commander Phicol to see Isaac.
translation_verse: Na Abimɛlɛke ne ye foɛtulɛniɛ Ahusate ne ye safohene Fikole, befili Gyeraa bɛhɔle Yisake berɛ.

english_verse: When they arrived, Isaac asked, “Why are you here? Didn't you send me away because you hated me?”
translation_verse: Na Yisake bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔawa me wa ye. Ɛmɔpɔ me yeɛ ɛmɔafoa me bafi ɛmɔ maen nu ɔ?”

english_verse: They answered, “We now know for certain that the Lord is with you, and we have decided there needs to be a peace treaty between you and us. So let's make a solemn agreement
translation_verse: Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Yanwu ye pefee kyɛ AWURADE gyi wɔ si. Yiti yadwene ye nwo kyɛ yɛne wɔ baata ndaen na yɛne wɔ ayɛ apam,

english_verse: not to harm each other. Remember, we have never hurt you, and when we sent you away, we let you go in peace. The Lord has truly blessed you.”
translation_verse: kyɛ ɛngɔyɔ yɛ tɛɛ biala, kyɛbɔ yanyɔ wɔ tɛɛ biala na mmom yɛyɔle wɔ paa ngome na yɛguale wɔ ate asomdwee nu ne. Kekesaala ye, wɔ ole bɔ Nyameɛ ayira ye ne.”

english_verse: Isaac gave a big feast for them, and everyone ate and drank.
translation_verse: Yiti Yisake tole poen mane bɛ na bedidili bɛnone.

english_verse: Early the next morning Isaac and the others made a solemn agreement, then he let them go in peace.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyene ngyerɛmɔ ne, bedwɔsole ndɛ bɛtetale ndaen bɛfa bɛkyekyele bɛ nwo. Yisake guale bɛ ate, na bele asomdwee befili berɛ bɛhɔle.

english_verse: Later that same day Isaac's servants came and said, “We've struck water!”
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne ala, Yisake ngoaa mɔ wale bɛɛbɔle ye amaneɛ fa abura bɔ betuli ne nwo kyɛ, “Yaato nzue.”

english_verse: So Isaac named the well Shibah, and the town is still called Beersheba. Esau's Foreign Wives
translation_verse: Na ɔfrɛle ye Hyiba. Yiti kuro ne dumaa li Beɛ Hyeba bapem ɛnɛ. Yisɔ aye amanvrafoɛ mɔ

english_verse: But these two women brought a lot of grief to Esau's parents Isaac and Rebekah.

english_verse: Isaac was old and almost blind, when he called in his first-born son Esau, who asked him, “Father, what can I do for you?”
translation_verse: Yisake nyini, na ye nye so yɛle ye wusiwusi bɔ né onnwu nikyee ne, ɛlɛho ɔfrɛle ɔwa panyi Yisɔ sele ye kyɛ, “Mma,” na osurole kyɛ, “Baba me ɛhe.”

english_verse: Isaac replied, “I am old and might die at any time.
translation_verse: Na osele kyɛ, “Mma, me nye afi paa, menze me wue kyẽa.

english_verse: So go hunting with your bow and arrows and kill a wild animal.
translation_verse: Yiti fa wɔ nningyein bɔ ɛfa kɔ buro ne, mekyire w’agyaen ndokue ne w’agyaen, na kɔ eburo kohũ naen brɛ me,

english_verse: Cook some of that tasty food that I love so much and bring it to me. I want to eat it once more and give you my blessing before I die.”
translation_verse: na to aleɛ bɔ yeɛ ɔyɛ fɛ paa bɔ mekuro ɔ, na fa brɛ me maa nni, na nyira wɔ koraka né mawu.

english_verse: Rebekah had been listening, and as soon as Esau left to go hunting,
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Yisake ne ɔwa Yisɔ bedwudwo nen, saa né Rebɛka ótie. Yiti Yisɔ hɔle eburo kyɛ ɔkwaapena naen ba ne,

english_verse: she said to Jacob, “I heard your father tell Esau
translation_verse: Rebɛka sele ɔwa Yakob kyɛ, “Ndele kyɛ wɔ baba ka kyire eliɛma Yisɔ kyɛ,

english_verse: to kill a wild animal and cook some tasty food for him before he dies. Your father said this because he wants to bless your brother with the Lord as his witness.
translation_verse: ‘Kɔ buro kohũ naen, na baafa to aleɛ bɔ yeɛ ɔyɛ fɛ paa maa nni, na mva AWURADE saleɛ nyira wɔ koraka né mawu.’

english_verse: Now, my son, listen carefully to what I want you to do.
translation_verse: Yiti mma tie na yɔ bɔ yeɛ meka ye:

english_verse: Go and kill two of your best young goats and bring them to me. I'll cook the tasty food that your father loves so much.
translation_verse: Kɔnea ngaka ne anu na kye mbɔngye akrɔngrɔma nyemene nyɔ brɛ me maa mva ndo akɔnnɔ aleɛ kyɛbɔ ɛse kuro ɔ;

translation_verse: kɔfa ma ɛse maa oli na oyira wɔ koraka né wawu.”

english_verse: “My brother Esau is a hairy man,” Jacob reminded her. “And I am not.
translation_verse: Nakoso Yakob sele oni Rebɛka kyɛ, “Ɛse ye kyɛ nniɛma Yisɔ nwo le enwiaa paa, na me de me nwo te torometorome.

english_verse: If my father touches me and realizes I am trying to trick him, he will put a curse on me instead of giving me a blessing.”
translation_verse: Annea a, né me baba afa ye sa wafofa me nwo wanea. Na ɔkɔyɛ ye nye so kyɛ mebaalakalaka ye. Sɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, ɛnomalɛ mmom yeɛ ngɔtwetwe ngɔwa me so ɔ, nna saleɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Rebekah insisted, “Let his curse fall on me! Just do what I say and bring me the meat.”
translation_verse: Na oni sele ye kyɛ, “Mma, ma wɔ ɛnomalɛ ne ɔ́bra me so. Wɔ de tie bɔ meka ne, na kɔhye ngaka nemɔ brɛ me”.

english_verse: So Jacob brought the meat to his mother, and she cooked the tasty food that his father liked.
translation_verse: Yiti Yakob hɔle ɔɔhyele bɛ brɛle oni, na oni fa tone akɔnnɔ aleɛ bɔ ɔse kuro ɔ.

english_verse: She also covered the smooth part of his hands and neck with goatskins
translation_verse: na ɔfale kaka nwomaa ne dwirale Yakob sa nwo ne ye kɔme anwo nekaa bɔ ɔte torometorome ne.

english_verse: and gave him some bread and the tasty food she had cooked.
translation_verse: Na ɔfale akɔnnɔ aleɛ bɔ wato ne ɔne paanoo ne wurale ɔwa Yakob sa nu.

english_verse: Jacob went to his father and said, “Father, here I am.” “Which one of my sons are you?” his father asked.
translation_verse: Yiti Yakob hɔle ɔse berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, “Baba.” Na Yisake koso surole kyɛ, “Me ɛhe; mma, wɔ nwa ɔ?”

english_verse: Jacob replied, “I am Esau, your first-born, and I have done what you told me. Please sit up and eat the meat I have brought. Then you can give me your blessing.”
translation_verse: Yakob buale ɔse kyɛ, “Me ɔ, wɔ bamuɛbaa Yisɔ ɔ, mayɔ kyɛbɔ ɛhane ne pɛpɛɛpɛ, mepa wɔ kyerɛ, dwɔso na di me eburo naen bɔ mato ye, na yira me.”

english_verse: Isaac asked, “My son, how did you find an animal so quickly?” “The Lord your God was kind to me,” Jacob answered.
translation_verse: Nakoso Yisake bisale ɔwa ne kyɛ, “Mma, na ɔyɛle sɛɛ bɔ enyane naen ne bie ndɛndɛ sɔa ye?” Na obuale kyɛ, “Ofikyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ mane me ti yɛle paa.”

english_verse: “My son,” Isaac said, “come closer, where I can touch you and find out if you really are Esau.”
translation_verse: Na Yisake sele Yakob kyɛ, “Mma, twe pingye me, na maa mvuafua wɔ nwo nnea sɛ mma Yisɔ ahɔ ɔ amba a.”

english_verse: Jacob went closer. His father touched him and said, “You sound like Jacob, but your hands feel hairy like Esau's.”
translation_verse: Yiti Yakob hwene pingyele ɔse Yisake. Ɔfale ye sa fuafuale Yakob nwo na ɔhane kyɛ, “Komviɛ ne te Yakob komvi, nakoso asaa ne de ɔte Yisɔ sa.”

english_verse: Isaac asked, “Are you really my son Esau?” “Yes, I am,” Jacob answered.
translation_verse: Na obisale ye kyɛ, “Aso mma Yisɔ ole wɔ amba?” Na obuale kyɛ, “Yoo, me ɔ.”

english_verse: So Isaac told him, “Serve me the wild meat, and I can give you my blessing.” Jacob gave him some meat, and he ate it. He also gave him some wine, and he drank it.
translation_verse: Yisake sele ye kyɛ, “Mma, fa brɛ me maa nni wɔ eburo naen bɔ ahu ye ye na nyira wɔ.” Yiti ɔfa brɛle ye maa olili, na ɔfale bobe nzaa koso bokale so, na ɔnone.

english_verse: Then Isaac said, “Son, come over here and kiss me.”
translation_verse: Na ɔse Yisake sele ye kyɛ, “Mma, pingye me na baafe me noa.”

english_verse: While Jacob was kissing him, Isaac caught the smell of his clothes and said: “The smell of my son is like a field the Lord has blessed.
translation_verse: Yiti opingyele ye na ɔfele ye noa, na Yisake fofane Yakob ataadeɛ ne anu tiele, na oyirale ye kyɛ, “Nea mma ne anwo fona ne, ɔte kyɛ aseɛ bɔ Nyameɛ ayira so nwo fona!

english_verse: God will bless you, my son, with dew from heaven and with fertile fields, rich with grain and grapes.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ ɔ́tɔ nyameɛso bosue ne bie ógua wɔ so, na ɔ́ma wɔ aseɛ so nningyein paa, ɔne aburoo ne bobe nzaa pee.

english_verse: Nations will be your servants and bow down to you. You will rule over your brothers, and they will kneel at your feet. Anyone who curses you will be cursed; anyone who blesses you will be blessed.”

english_verse: Right after Isaac had given Jacob his blessing and Jacob had gone, Esau came back from hunting.
translation_verse: Yisake yirale Yakob yiele, ná Yakob ofi ɔse Yisake nyunu berɛ ɔkɔ pɛ yeɛ oliɛma Yisɔ koso fili eburo wale ɔ.

english_verse: He cooked the tasty food, brought it to his father, and said, “Father, please sit up and eat the meat I have brought you, so you can give me your blessing.”
translation_verse: Ye koso ɔtone aleɛ bɔ ɔyɛ akɔnnɔ, na ɔfa brɛle ɔse. Na osele ɔse kyɛ, “Baba, mepa wɔ kyerɛ, dwɔso na di ɛwa ye naen bɔ maahũ ye ne bie, na yira me.”

english_verse: “Who are you?” Isaac asked. “I am Esau, your first-born son.”
translation_verse: Ɔse Yisake bisale ye kyɛ, “Wɔ nwa ɔ?” Na obuale ye kyɛ, “Wɔ bamuɛbaa Yisɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: Isaac started trembling and said, “Then who brought me some wild meat right before you came in? I ate it and gave him a blessing that cannot be taken back.”
translation_verse: Yisake nwo wosole ye paa na obisale kyɛ, “Na ye de nwa yeɛ oohuni naen fa tone aleɛ brɛle me maa nnili nduli ye bo koraka yeɛ ɛba ye? Mayira ye, na okonya saleɛ amba.”

english_verse: Esau cried out in great distress, “Father, give me a blessing too!”
translation_verse: Na Yisɔ tele ɔse dwirɛ nen, ole aworabɔlɛ kandinga teateane nu suni, na ɔsrɛle ɔse kyɛ, “O baba, yira me koso bie!”

english_verse: Isaac answered, “Your brother tricked me and stole your blessing.”
translation_verse: Nakoso obuale ye kyɛ, “Eliɛma ne le nnakannaka wawa waale wɔ saleɛ ne wahɔ.”

english_verse: Esau replied, “My brother deserves the name Jacob, because he has already cheated me twice. The first time he cheated me out of my rights as the first-born son, and now he has cheated me out of my blessing.” Then Esau asked his father, “Don't you have any blessing left for me?”
translation_verse: Na Yisɔ hane kyɛ, “Aso ye dumaa Yakob ne ɔnzɛ ye anaa? Ye pɛen nyɔ so ɛhe yeɛ wapepɛ me gya ndii nu ɔ. Olili moa olele me panyi, na kekesaala ye de, wale me saleɛ.” Na obisale kyɛ, “Anyakyi me saleɛ ne bie?”

english_verse: “My son,” Isaac answered, “I have made Jacob the ruler over you and your brothers, and all of you will be his servants. I have also promised him all the grain and grapes that he needs. There's nothing left that I can do for you.”
translation_verse: Na Yisake buale Yisɔ kyɛ “Mafa ye mayɛ wɔ mene, na mafa oliɛma mɔ amu mayɛ ye ngoaa. Mayira ye kyɛ onya aburoo ne nzaa pee. Na mma, wɔ de nzu yeɛ ngɔhora ngɔyɔ ngɔma wɔ ɔ?”

english_verse: “Father,” Esau asked, “don't you have more than one blessing? You can surely give me a blessing too!” Then Esau started crying again.
translation_verse: Na Yisɔ sele ɔse kyɛ, “Baba, aso wɔ saleɛ te komapɛ twe. Baba, yira me koso bie e.” Na Yisɔ tikyele esuɛ nu.

english_verse: So his father said: “Your home will be far from that fertile land, where dew comes down from the heavens.
translation_verse: Na ɔse Yisake buale ye kyɛ, “W’atenaleɛ kɔyɛ aseɛ bɔ ɛloe ɔnne so ɔ, bɔ bosue bɔ ofi anwuro ngua so ɔ.

english_verse: You will live by the power of your sword and be your brother's slave. But when you decide to be free, you will break loose.”
translation_verse: Wɔ ngrandɛ noa yeɛ ɛkɔtena ase ɔ, na ɛkɔso eliɛma ne. Nakoso sɛ ɛbɔ mmɔden tete nu a, ekobubu ye kɔnnua kofi wɔ kɔme anu.”

english_verse: Esau hated his brother Jacob because he had stolen the blessing that was supposed to be his. So he said to himself, “Just as soon as my father dies, I'll kill Jacob.”
translation_verse: Na ɔnate saleɛ bɔ ye baba fa yirale Yakob ne ati, Yisɔ pɔle Yakob. Na Yisɔ susuli ye nwo kyɛ, “Me baba ye wue ne ye sɛen ngyẽa apingye; na ɛhe asi ne, ngohũ nniɛma Yakob.”

english_verse: When Rebekah found out what Esau planned to do, she sent for Jacob and told him, “Son, your brother Esau is just waiting for a chance to kill you.
translation_verse: Nakoso Rebɛka tele porɛ bɔ ɔwa panyi Yisɔ abɔ ne. Yiti ɔsomane maa bɛɛfrɛle ɔwa kãa Yakob, na osele ye kyɛ, “Nea, eliɛma Yisɔ asua kyɛ okohu wɔ kotua kerɛ.

english_verse: Now listen carefully and do what I say. Go to the home of my brother Laban in Haran
translation_verse: Yiti mma, tie bɔ meka ye, dwɔso na nwati kɔbɔ wɔ nwo adwaa wɔ nniɛma Laban berɛ wɔ Haran,

english_verse: and stay with him for a while. When Esau stops being angry
translation_verse: na tena berɛ maa oodwu kyɛ eliɛma ne ahone kɔtɔ ye kunu ɔ;

english_verse: and forgets what you have done to him, I'll send for you to come home. Why should I lose both of my sons on the same day?”
