english_verse: Suppose two people claim to own the same ox or donkey or sheep or piece of clothing. Then the judges must decide the case, and the guilty person will pay the owner double.
translation_verse: “Edwudwolɛ biala bɔ ɔkɔwa ne, sɛ ɔfa nandwie nwo oo, afunum nwo oo, boaen nwo oo, ndaadeɛ nwo oo, anaa nikyee bie bɔ wamini nwo oo, bɔ mmenia ne anu biala nwa: ‘Me deɛ ɔ’ nen, odi kyɛ sɔ mmenia nyɔ ne fa bɛ dwirɛ ne ba Nyameɛ nyunu. Na bɛ nu ko bɔ Nyameɛ kobua ye foɛ nen, okotua ye mmɔhoɛ nyɔ kɔma obiɛngo ne.

english_verse: Suppose a neighbor who is going to be away asks you to keep a donkey or an ox or a sheep or some other animal, and it dies or gets injured or is stolen while no one is looking.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ebie fa ye afunum, nandwie, boaen, anaa kaka biala wura obiɛngo sa, ná sɛ kaka ne wu, opura, anaa bewua ye bɔ ebiala nye ambɛ so ne,

english_verse: If you swear with me as your witness that you did not harm the animal, you do not have to replace it. Your word is enough.
translation_verse: ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛ munyɔ bɛta ndaen wɔ AWURADE nyunu; ná ɔsa ye nwo kyɛ ɔyyɔle obiɛngo kaka ne hwee. Ɔsɛ kyɛ kaka ne mene pene so, na ɔnzɛ kyɛ ode obiɛngo ne berɛ.

english_verse: But if the animal was stolen while in your care, you must replace it.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ye sa nu yeɛ bewuale de a, ye de ɔkɔfa bie kosi ye mene gya nu.

english_verse: If the animal was attacked and killed by a wild animal, and you can show the remains of the dead animal to its owner, you do not have to replace it.
translation_verse: Sɛ kaka bie yeɛ wahũ ye watete ye pasaa a, maa ɔfa bra ooli adanzeɛ; na kaka bɔ watete pasaa ne de, ɔngɔfa bie ngosi ye gya nu.

translation_verse: “Sɛ ebie fɛmo kaka fi obiɛngo berɛ, ná kaka ne pura anaa owu, wɔ aberɛ bɔ ye mene nne berɛ a, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa bie si ye mene ne gya nu.

english_verse: But if something happens to the animal while the owner is present, you do not have to replace it. If you had leased the animal, the money you paid the owner will cover any harm done to it. Laws for Everyday Life The Lord said:

translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔsisi bɛ ná besu bɛfrɛ me a, ngotie bɛ suɛ ne paa;

english_verse: In fact, I will get so angry that I will kill your men and make widows of their wives and orphans of their children.

translation_verse: “Wɔ fieso nningyein ne wɔ ngoo bɔ beli moa ne, nnɛtwetwe wɔ bo ase kyɛ ɛkɔfa kɔbɔ afɔleɛ kɔma me ɔ. Wɔ mma mmienzua nemɔ nu bamuɛbaa ne, fa ma me.

english_verse: You are my chosen people, so don't eat the meat of any of your livestock that was killed by a wild animal. Instead, feed the meat to dogs.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔkɔyɛ me mmenia krongron, yiti nnɛma ɛmɔdi naen biala bɔ kaka bie ahu ye wɔ eburo ɔ; ɛ́mɔgyi bégua bɛ́ma ngyea.

english_verse: Always tell the truth in court, even if everyone else is dishonest and stands in the way of justice.
translation_verse: Nnɛdi mmeni soma si ɛkɔyɔ bɔne. Sɛ édi dwirɛ bie nwo adanzeɛ a, nnɛdi mmeni soma noa dwirɛ si, ná angyea nahorɛ ne;

english_verse: And don't favor the poor, simply because they are poor.
translation_verse: yeɛ nnɛdi adanzewia ma ehianiɛ.

english_verse: If you find an ox or a donkey that has wandered off, take it back where it belongs, even if the owner is your enemy.
translation_verse: “Sɛ enwu kyɛ wɔ pɔfoɛ nandwie anaa ye afunum ate, ná ɔnatenate mbaen a, ka ye sá fa ye kɔma ye.

english_verse: If a donkey is overloaded and falls down, you must do what you can to help, even if it belongs to someone who doesn't like you.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ onguro wɔ dwirɛ ne, sɛ enwu kyɛ ye afunum nningyein abutu agua afunum ne aso a, nnɛyakyi ye ne kaka ne berɛ kɔ; boka ye mene ne maa ɔpagya ye gyina berɛ.

english_verse: Make sure that the poor are given equal justice in court.
translation_verse: “Nnɛbua ɛmɔ nu ehiafoɛ ndɛengyea wɔ edwirɛ hanɛ nu.

english_verse: Don't bring false charges against anyone or sentence an innocent person to death. I won't forgive you if you do.
translation_verse: Nnɛto ebiɛngo soen, yeɛ nnɛku sona bɔ odi be ná ɔtengyɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ mengobua amumuyɛɛniɛ be.

english_verse: Don't accept bribes. Judges are blinded and justice is twisted by bribes.
translation_verse: Nnede fea-ase-ma, ofikyɛ fea-ase-ma ma mbanyi bu bɛ nye gua ndɛen turoloo so, na ɔma mmenia bua bɛ bɔ bedi be ɔ ndɛengyea.

english_verse: Don't mistreat foreigners. You were foreigners in Egypt, and you know what it is like. Laws for the Sabbath The Lord said:
