english_verse: Plant and harvest your crops for six years,
translation_verse: “Fa afoɛ nzia dua w’aseɛ so nningyein, ná pɛ so aleɛ ne.

english_verse: but let the land rest during the seventh year. The poor are to eat what they want from your fields, vineyards, and olive trees during that year, and when they have all they want from your fields, leave the rest for wild animals.
translation_verse: Nakoso afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne de, ma aseɛ ne ɔla berɛ mbaen ná ole ye nwome; amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔ nu ehiafoɛ mɔ badidi so; ná eburo ngaka koso bali ye boso ne. Sɔ ala yeɛ yɔ wɔ bobe boo ne wɔ olive boo ɔ.

english_verse: Work the first six days of the week, but rest and relax on the seventh day. This law is not only for you, but for your oxen, donkeys, and slaves, as well as for any foreigners among you.
translation_verse: “Fa elesia yɔ w’adwuma, nakoso kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne de, de wɔ nwome; amaa ɔnate so wɔ nandwie ne w’afunum bale bɛ nwome, ná w’afaneɛ awa ne wɔ wɔfoɛ koso bale bɛ nwome.

english_verse: Make certain that you obey everything I have said. Don't pray to other gods or even mention their names. Three Annual Festivals (Exodus
translation_verse: Bɔ mahã mahyire ɛmɔ ne amukoraa, ɛ́mɔli so. Nnɛma ɛmɔbɔ nyameɛ foforɛ biala dumaa; yeɛ nnɛmɔma ofite ɛmɔ noa. Aluolue mbiri nza ne (Ɛksadɔso

english_verse: Do not offer bread made with yeast when you sacrifice an animal to me. And make sure that the fat of the animal is burned that same day.
translation_verse: “Mogya bɔ ɛfa bɔ afɔleɛ ma me ne, nnɛfa paanoo harewaa boka so; yeɛ nnɛma aleɛ kye ɛloe bɔ ɔwɔ m’afɔleɛ nu ne aso.

english_verse: Your women will give birth to healthy children, and everyone will live a long life.
translation_verse: Wɔ maen ne anu brasua biala ngɔpɔ baa, anaa ɔngɔyɛ mmotaen, na ngɔma wɔ ngoa tendenn.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: “Di Buberɛ aluolue ne, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ekoli moa kɔpɛ aleɛ bɔ alua ye wɔ aseɛ ne aso ne. Di Aleɛ Noa Boaboalɛ aluolue ne, wɔ afoɛ ne ayieleɛ, mmerɛ bɔ afa wɔ boo nu aleɛ ne.

english_verse: Your men must come to these three festivals each year to worship me.
translation_verse: Afoɛnoa biala, ɔsɛ kyɛ wɔ mmienzua mukoraa bɛba AWURADE Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: Celebrate three festivals each year in my honor.
translation_verse: “Afoɛnoa biala, di aluolue pɛen nza fa hyɛ me animnyam.

english_verse: Celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread by eating bread made without yeast, just as I have commanded. Do this at the proper time during the month of Abib, because it is the month when you left Egypt. And make certain that everyone brings the proper offerings.
translation_verse: “Di Paanoo Kabrɛdi aluolue ne. Fa ɛlɛsoo di paanoo kabrɛdi, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ mahyɛ ne, wɔ bosome Abibo nu, kyɛbɔ mahyɛ wɔ ne ala. Ofikyɛ sɔ bosome ne anu yeɛ etuli wɔ bo fili Misraim ɔ. Nnɛma ebiala fa ye sa mbaen ba me nyunu.

english_verse: Each year bring the best part of your first harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. A Promise and a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: “W’aseɛ so aleɛ paa bɔ ekoli moa kɔpɛ ne, fa brɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ awuro. Nnɛfa abɔngye ba oni nyɔfonesue gua ye nwo to. Anohoba ɔne nhyehyɛleɛ

english_verse: I am sending an angel to protect you and to lead you into the land I have ready for you.
translation_verse: “Tie, mésoma abɔfo maa odi wɔ nyunu, maa ɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen fa wɔ kɔ nekaa bɔ masiesie ne.

english_verse: Carefully obey everything the angel says, because I am giving him complete authority, and he won't tolerate rebellion.
translation_verse: Suro ye ná tie ye dwirɛ. Nnɛtwi fa ye dwirɛ so, na ɔngɔfa ɛmɔ mmeraatolɛ ngɔhyɛ ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ me dumaa la ye so.

english_verse: My angel will lead you into the land of the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites, and I will wipe them out.
translation_verse: Na sɛ m’abɔfo ne di wɔ nyunu fa wɔ kodwu Amorifoɛ, Hitifoɛ, Perisifoɛ, Kanaanfoɛ, Hiwifoɛ ne Yebusifoɛ berɛ a, ngokyikyi bɛ boso bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Don't worship their gods or follow their customs. Instead, destroy their idols and shatter their stone images.
translation_verse: Nnɛbɔ wɔ ti ase ma bɛ mmosoen nemɔ, nnɛsɔne bɛ, yeɛ nnɛyɔ bɛ yɔleɛ ne bie. Na mmom sɛkyesɛkye bɛ bosoen nemɔ bɔkɔɔ, ná bubu bɛ bonima nemɔ nu gɔsɔgɔsɔ.

english_verse: Worship only me, the Lord your God! I will bless you with plenty of food and water and keep you strong.
translation_verse: AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔsɔne ye ɔ, na ngoyira ɛmɔ aleɛ ne ɛmɔ nzue so, ná maye anwonyerɛ mafi ɛmɔ so.

english_verse: I will terrify those nations and make your enemies so confused that they will run from you.
translation_verse: “Ngɔma me nwo suronyi koli wɔ nyunu, na maen biala bɔ ekodwu so ne, ngɔma ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ nu mmenia so. Na ngɔma wɔ pɔfoɛ amukoraa kɔnwati kofi wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: I will make the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites panic as you approach.
translation_verse: Ngɔsoma kotokuradu mɔ maa bekoli wɔ nyunu, na bɛkɔfoa Hiwifoɛ, Kanaanfoɛ ne Hitifoɛ bekofi wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: But I won't do all this in the first year, because the land would become poor, and wild animals would be everywhere.
translation_verse: Mengɔfoa bɛ ngofi wɔ nyunu wɔ afoɛ komapɛ twe nu, ofikyɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, aseɛ ne kɔla berɛ pralaa, na so ngaka aboyaa kɔyɛ pee kɔha wɔ.

english_verse: Instead, I will force out your enemies little by little and give your nation time to grow strong enough to take over the land.
translation_verse: Ngɔfoa bɛ ngofi wɔ nyunu ngaka ngaka, kɔpem kyɛ wɔ boso kɔta, ná afa aseɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: I will see that your borders reach from the Red Sea to the Euphrates River and from the Mediterranean Sea to the desert. I will let you defeat the people who live there, and you will force them out of the land.
translation_verse: Ngɔto wɔ wɛen ngofi Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ noa maa okoodwu Filistifoɛ mboanoa, fi ɛserɛ so kodwu asue Yufreti noa. Ofikyɛ ngɔmaa ɛmɔkoli aseɛ ne asofoɛ so ngonim, ná afoa bɛ afi wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: But you must not make any agreements with them or with their gods.
translation_verse: Nnɛne bɛ, anaa bɛ bosoen mɔ yɛ apam.

english_verse: Don't let them stay in your land. They will trap you into sinning against me and worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Nnɛmaa bɛtena w’aseɛ so, anyɔ a né bamaa ayɔ bɔne atia me; ofikyɛ sɛ ɛso bɛ bosoen nemɔ a, ɔkɔyɛ wɔ so ngaen.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up to me on this mountain. Bring along Aaron, as well as his two sons Nadab and Abihu, and
translation_verse: Afei Nyameɛ sele Mose kyɛ, “Fo bra AWURADE berɛ, ɛne Aarɔn, Nadabo ne Abihu, yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ nu mbanyi aburasoo, ná ɛ́mɔgyina nziɛ nziɛ bɛsɔne .

english_verse: Moses gave the Lord's instructions to the people, and they all promised, “We will do everything the Lord has commanded!”
translation_verse: Mose wale, na ɔɔfale AWURADE dwirɛ amukoraa ne ye nhyehyɛleɛ amukoraa bɔle mmenia ne amaneɛ, na mmenia ne amukoraa bɔle nu hane kyɛ, “Edwirɛ biala bɔ AWURADE aha ne, yɛkoli so.”

english_verse: Then Moses wrote down what the Lord had said. The next morning Moses got up early. He built an altar at the foot of the mountain and set up a large stone for each of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Mose hyerɛle AWURADE dwirɛ ne amukoraati. Na ɔpɛle aleɛ dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ sili afɔleɛ bokyea wɔ bokaa ne nye abo, na ɔfale nyɔboɛ buru ne nyɔ penapenane berɛ, ɔfa gyinane berɛ mane Yisrael abusua kure buru ne nyɔ ne.

english_verse: He also sent some young men to burn offerings and to sacrifice bulls as special offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Afei ɔsomane Yisrael mmerandeɛ, na bɛfale nandwie bɛɛbɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne asomdwee afɔleɛ bɛmane AWURADE.

english_verse: Moses put half of the blood from the animals into bowls and sprinkled the rest on the altar.
translation_verse: Mose fale mogya ne bue ko guale ayaa nu, yeɛ ye bue ko wora ohwie guale afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo.

english_verse: Then he read aloud the Lord's commands and promises, and the people shouted, “We will obey the Lord and do everything he has commanded!”
translation_verse: Afei ɔfale apam nwomaa ne, ɔkengale mane mmenia ne tiele, na besele kyɛ, “Edwirɛ biala bɔ AWURADE aha ne, yɛkɔyɔ, na yɛkoli so.”

english_verse: Moses took the blood from the bowls and sprinkled it on the people. Next, he told them, “With this blood the Lord makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: Afei ɔfale mogya ne petene mmenia ne anwo, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Apam bɔ AWURADE nate edwirɛ he amukoraa so ɔne ɛmɔ bayɛ ne, mogya he yeɛ osi ye agyinayɛɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with Nadab and Abihu and the
translation_verse: Afei Mose ne Aarɔn, Nadabo, Abihu ne Yisraelfoɛ nu mbanyi aburasoo ne hɔle bokaa ne aso.

english_verse: and saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was something that looked like a pavement made out of sapphire, and it was as bright as the sky.
translation_verse: Na benwuni Yisrael Nyameɛ ne. Né nikyee bie te kyɛ safire nyɔbotɛnderɛ wɔ ye gya bo, bɔ ye nye te kyɛ ewienu ala ɔ.

english_verse: Even though these leaders of Israel saw God, he did not punish them. So they ate and drank. Moses on Mount Sinai
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ anyɔ Yisrael mbanyi nemɔ hwee. Benwuni Nyameɛ, bedidili, na bɛnone.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Come up on the mountain and stay here for a while. I will give you the two flat stones on which I have written the laws that my people must obey.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Fo bra me nwo faen wɔ bokaa ye aso, ná kɔnwondɛ berɛ. Na ngɔfa nyɔboɛ taataa ne, ɔne mmeraa ne mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ mahyerɛ kyɛ bɛfa behyirehyire bɛ ne ngɔma wɔ.”

english_verse: Moses and Joshua his assistant got ready, then Moses started up the mountain to meet with God.
translation_verse: Yiti Mose dwɔsole, ɔne ye bokafoɛ Yosua, na Mose hɔle Nyameɛ bokaa ne aso.

english_verse: Moses had told the leaders, “Wait here until we come back. Aaron and Hur will be with you, and they can settle any arguments while we are away.”
translation_verse: Na osele mbanyi nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtena wa bɛnwondɛ yɛ kɔpem kyɛ yɛkosa kɔwa ɛmɔ wa ɔ. Aarɔn ne Hure boka ɛmɔ so wɔ wa; na sɛ ebie le dwirɛ bie a, maa ɔfa hɔ bɛ gya so.”

english_verse: When Moses went up on Mount Sinai, a cloud covered it,
translation_verse: Afei Mose fo hɔle bokaa ne aso, na munungum ne katale bokaa ne aso.

english_verse: and the bright glory of the Lord came down and stayed there. The cloud covered the mountain for six days, and on the seventh day the Lord told Moses to come into the cloud.
translation_verse: AWURADE animnyam wale Sinai bokaa ne aso, na munungum ne katale so elesia. Na ye ɛlɛsoo ne aso, ɔfrɛle Mose fili munungum ne anu.

english_verse: blue, purple, and red wool; fine linen; goat hair;
translation_verse: bibire, koogyan, adaabene, nwera paa, abɔngye nwiaa,

english_verse: Tell everyone in Israel who wants to give gifts that they must bring them to you.
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ ma bɛfa ayɛyelɛ nikyee bɛbrɛ me. Ebiala bɔ ye kunu sefaa ne yeɛ ɛ́mɔle m’ayɛyelɛ nikyee béfi ye berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Here is a list of what you are to collect: Gold, silver, and bronze;
translation_verse: Sɔ ayɛyelɛ nikyee hemɔ yeɛ ɛ́mɔle béfi bɛ berɛ ɔ: esikaa kɔkorɛ, ɛdwetɛ ne kɔɔbere,

english_verse: tanned ram skins; fine leather; acacia wood;
translation_verse: mmoaen nyii nwomaa bɔ bawura ye ayire kɔkorɛ ɔ, abɔngye nwomaa, bɔsema,

english_verse: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices to mix with the incense and with the oil for dedicating the tent and ordaining the priests;
translation_verse: ngoo bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔ kanea ɔ, nningyein bɔ bɛfa bɛyɔ ɛpopalɛ ngoo, ɔne ayirefona ne;

english_verse: and onyx stones and other gems for the sacred vest and the breastpiece.
translation_verse: nyɔboɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye onike, mbembenanneɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛteta ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ nu, ɔne ye ahone so aguasoɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: I also want them to build a special place where I can live among my people.
translation_verse: Maa besi nekaa krongron bɛma me, ná matena b’afia.

english_verse: The lamp on the top and those at the end of each of its six branches must be made so as to shine toward the front of the lampstand.
translation_verse: Afei yɔ ye kanea nzoo ne, ná fa siesie so maa bɛta ye nyunu berɛ.

english_verse: Cover it inside and out with pure gold and put a gold edging around the lid.
translation_verse: Fa sikaa kɔkorɛ paa boro ye kunu ne ye si, ná fa sikaa kɔkorɛ pɛ ye nwo bra yia.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one of them to each of the four legs of the chest.
translation_verse: Fa sikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ kɔtɔkaa nna fa puro ye, ná fa sosɔ ye gya nna nemɔ anu; kɔtɔkaa nyɔ wɔ ye bue ko, yeɛ kɔtɔkaa nyɔ wora wɔ ye bue ko.

english_verse: Make two poles of acacia wood. Cover them with gold
translation_verse: Fa bɔsema se mbuna mɔ, ná fa sikaa kɔkorɛ boro bɛ nwo.

english_verse: and put them through the rings, so the chest can be carried by the poles.
translation_verse: Fa mbuna nemɔ wurawura kɔtɔkaa nemɔ anu wɔ alaka ne ngyɛnu ne ye ngyɛnu, bɔ bɛkɔsosɔ nu bɛkɔsoa alaka ne ɔ.

english_verse: Don't ever remove the poles from the rings.
translation_verse: Ma mbuna nemɔ béwurawura alaka ne kɔtɔkaa nemɔ anu; nnɛmaa bɛye befi nu.

english_verse: Then hammer out two winged creatures of pure gold and fasten them to the lid at the ends of the chest.
translation_verse: Yɔ kɛrubo ngoko siesie ye ti ne ye ti. Yɔ kɛrubim nemɔ ne mbata bia ne bɔ nu wɔ ye ti ne ye ti.

english_verse: Inside it place the two flat stones with the Ten Commandments on them and put the gold lid on top of the chest.
translation_verse: Fa mbata bia ne sie alaka ne aso anwuro, ná fa Adanzeɛ bɔ mebaafa mema wɔ ne to alaka ne anu.

english_verse: I will meet you there between the two creatures and tell you what my people must do and what they must not do. The Table for the Sacred Bread (Exodus
translation_verse: Berɛ yeɛ me ne wɔ yɛkoyia ɔ, wɔ mbata bia ne aso anwuro, wɔ kɛrubim nyɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Adanzeɛ alaka ne aso ne b’afia. Na ngɔhã me mmeraa dwirɛ mukoraati bɔ méfa méma Yisraelfoɛ ne ngohyire wɔ. Paanoo krongron poen ne (Ɛksadɔso

english_verse: Cover it with pure gold and put a gold edging around it with a border
translation_verse: Fa kaa bɔ ye piri te kyɛ bɛ sa mmɛseka pɛ ye nwo bra yia, ná fa sikaa kɔkorɛ pɛ ye nwo hangra bra yia.

english_verse: Make four gold rings and attach one to each of the legs
translation_verse: Yɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ kaa nna ma ɛpoen ne, ná fa kaa nemɔ sosɔ ndweaso nna ne, nekaa bɔ ye gya nna nemɔ wɔ ne.

english_verse: near the edging. The poles for carrying the table are to be placed through these rings and are to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Fa bɔsema se mbuna mɔ, ná fa sikaa kɔkorɛ boro bɛ nwo; na mbuna nemɔ yeɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔsoa ɛpoen ne ɔ.

english_verse: The lampstand, including its branches and decorative flowers, must be made from a single piece of hammered pure gold.
translation_verse: Ma bɛ nyerɛen nemɔ, bɛ mmaen nemɔ, ɔne kanea bakaa ne béfi sɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ kundunzii komapɛ bɔ bafa buralɛ baboro ne ala nu.

english_verse: The tongs and trays for taking care of the lamps are to be made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Akapɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛtengyɛtengyɛ kanea nyamaa noa ne, ɔne kanea nyamaa nzoen talie nemɔ, sikaa kɔkorɛ paa yeɛ fa yɔ ɔ.

english_verse: and they must be made according to the pattern I showed you on the mountain.
translation_verse: Nea kyɛ ɛkɔyɔ ye sɛso kyɛbɔ mafa mahyire wɔ wɔ bokaa ye aso ne.

english_verse: For the entrance to the tent, use a piece of fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with fancy needlework.
translation_verse: “Fa bibire, koogyan, adaabene ne gyese nwo ɛtena bɔ bɛkɔfa bekonwi ɛtena sua ne anoa nu berɛ ɔ, ɛtena bɔ bali adwii bagua nu ɔ.

english_verse: As the material for protecting the tent, use goat hair to weave eleven sections of cloth
translation_verse: Ma ɛtena ko biala tendenn nu ɔyɛ agyirɛ aburasa, ko biala tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu ɔyɛ agyirɛ nna. Ɛtena buru ne ko ne, maa bɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: The top of the sacred tent must be made from ten pieces of the finest linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool and embroidered with figures of winged creatures.
translation_verse: “Na nyianu sua ne de, fa mbɛmuɛ tena buru, bɔ bafa nwera, bibire, koogyan ne adaabene banwo ɔ si. Ma adwiililɛniɛ ɔnwo kɛrubim ndiamuɛ gua nu.

english_verse: Sew five of the sections together to make one panel. Then sew the other six together to make a second panel, and fold the sixth section double over the front of the tent.
translation_verse: Ɛtena ne, fa nnu toatoa so ma ɔyɛ ko, ná fa nzia koso toatoa so ma ɔyɛ ko. Ɛtena bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ne, bu to bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu ne aso wɔ ɛtena sua ne anoa nu berɛ.

english_verse: Make two more coverings—one with tanned ram skins and the other with fine leather. The Framework for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Fa boaen nwomaa bɔ bawura ye ayire kuru ɛtena sua ne anwo, ná fa abɔngye nwomaa koso kata boaen nwomaa ne aso.

english_verse: Inside the most holy place, put the sacred chest that has the place of mercy on its lid.
translation_verse: Fa mbata bia ne sie Adanzeɛ alaka ne aso wɔ krongron nu krongron ne anu.

english_verse: Build a framework of acacia wood for the walls of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: “Fa bɔsema yɛ nyianu sua ne ye ndaboa mɔ ma begyinagyina berɛ.

english_verse: Place two silver stands under each frame with sockets for the pegs, so the frames can be joined together. Put
translation_verse: ná fa ɛdwetɛ yɔ bɛ nyinasoɛ aburanna ne. Ma taboa bɔ oli moa ne nya nyinasoɛ nyɔ, yeɛ bɔ ɔtoa berɛ ne koso nya nyinasoɛ nyɔ.

english_verse: For the back wall along the west side use six frames
translation_verse: Nyianu sua ne si dɔ wora, wɔ eyia atɔleɛ bue nu dɔ, ma ndaboa nzia bra berɛ.

english_verse: with two more at the southwest and northwest corners. Make certain that these corner frames are joined from top to bottom.
translation_verse: Mbuna nemɔ, maa bɛ nu tete fite aseɛnwo. Nakoso ka bɔ ye nwo wɔ ye anwuro dɔ ma bewura kɔtɔkaa bɔ oli moa ne anu. Sɔ yeɛ yɔ mbuna nyɔ ne ɔ: maa bɛyɛ ye ndweaso nyɔ ne.

english_verse: Altogether, this back wall will have eight frames with two silver stands under each one.
translation_verse: Ma ndaboa nemɔ yɛ mmɔtwɛ, ɔne b’ɛdwetɛ nyinasoɛ buru ne nzia. Taboa bɔ oli moa ne, maa onya nyinasoɛ nyɔ, yeɛ bɔ ɔtoa berɛ ne koso ye nyinasoɛ nyɔ.

english_verse: with the center crossbar running the full length of the wall.
translation_verse: Kwatena bɔ ɔla afia, bɔ ɔla ndaboa nemɔ afia ne, maa ofi ye ti ɔɔhã ye ti.

english_verse: Cover the frames and the crossbars with gold and attach gold rings to the frames to run the crossbars through.
translation_verse: Fa sikaa kɔkorɛ boro ndaboa nemɔ anwo, ná fa sikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ kɔtɔkaa bɔ ɔkɔsosɔ kwatena nemɔ anu ɔ. Fa sikaa kɔkorɛ boro kwatena nemɔ anwo.

english_verse: Then set up the tent in the way I showed you on the mountain. The Curtain inside the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ masusu nyianu sua ne mahyire wɔ wɔ bokaa ye aso ne, sɔ ala yeɛ si ye ɔ.

english_verse: Outside the most holy place, as you face the curtain, put the table for the sacred bread on the right side and the gold lampstand on the left.
translation_verse: Fa ɛpoen ne sie mbɛmuɛ tena ne asi, ná fa kanea bakaa ne sie ɛpoen ne ndendeneɛ so wɔ nyianu sua ne ngwaen. Fa ɛpoen ne sie nyianu sua ne sorɔ.

english_verse: Make a curtain to separate the holy place from the most holy place. Use fine linen woven with blue, purple, and red wool, and embroidered with figures of winged creatures. Cover four acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a silver stand. Then fasten gold hooks to the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Fa mbɛmuɛ tena ne sinze tɔkorɔ nemɔ aso, ná fa Adanzeɛ alaka ne sie mbɛmuɛ tena ne asi. Mbɛmuɛ tena ne yeɛ okonwi nekaa krongron ne ɔne krongron nu krongron ne b’afia kɔma wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Cover five acacia wood posts with gold and set them each on a bronze stand. Then put gold hooks on the posts and hang the curtain there.
translation_verse: Ma ɛtena ne osinze bɔsema bonima nnu bɔ bafa sikaa kɔkorɛ baboro bɛ nwo ɔ so. Fa sikaa kɔkorɛ yɔ bɛ tɔkorɔ nemɔ, ná fa kɔɔbere yɔ bɛ nyinasoɛ nnu ne.

english_verse: Cover two acacia wood poles with bronze and put them through the rings for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Ma mbuna nemɔ béwurawura kɔtɔkaa nemɔ anu, amaa sɛ bɛsoa a, mbuna nemɔ awa afɔleɛ bokyea ne ye ngyɛnu ne ye ngyɛnu.

english_verse: All the equipment for the altar must also be made of bronze—the pans for the hot ashes, the shovels, the sprinkling bowls, the meat forks, and the fire pans.
translation_verse: Fa kɔɔbere yɔ ye nwo nningyein hemɔ amukoraati: ngukue mɔ, ye sofi mɔ, ayaa mɔ, ateɛ anoa tworɔntworɔn mɔ, ɔne ngukue bɔ bɛfa see bekogua nu ɔ.

english_verse: Halfway up the altar build a ledge around it, and cover the bottom half of the altar with a decorative bronze grating. Then attach a bronze ring beneath the ledge at the four corners of the altar.
translation_verse: Fa ngandanganda ne wura afɔleɛ bokyea kaa ne abo, ná ma ngandanganda ne ɔtrɛ oodwu afɔleɛ bokyea ne afia.

english_verse: Construct the altar in the shape of an open box, just as you were shown on the mountain. The Courtyard around the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Fa ndaboa yɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne, ná ma bɔen la ye kunu. Na kyɛbɔ mafa mahyire wɔ wɔ bokaa ne aso nen, sɔ ala yeɛ yɔ ye ɔ. Ɛtena sua aluo berɛ (Ɛksadɔso

english_verse: Command the people of Israel to supply you with the purest olive oil. Do this so the lamp will keep burning
translation_verse: “Na wɔ wora, hyɛ Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa ma bɛbrɛ wɔ olive ngoo gyengɔgyengɔ bɔ bafa bɛ sa bahwi ɔ, bɔ bɛkɔfa bekogua kanea ne anu ɔ, amaa kanea nemɔ agyina so basɔ mmerɛ biala.

english_verse: for the west. Then hang a curtain of fine linen on the posts along each of these three sides by using silver hooks and rods. Place three bronze posts on each side of the entrance at the east and hang a curtain
translation_verse: Fa kɔɔbere yɔ ye bonima aburanyɔ ne, ɔne ye nyinasoɛ aburanyɔ ne. Nakoso bonima nemɔ bɛ ndɔkorɔ, ɔne bɔ ɔbeabea nu ne de, maa ɔ́yɛ ɛdwetɛ.

english_verse: Use four more of these posts for the entrance way, then hang on them an embroidered curtain of fine linen nine meters long and woven with blue, purple, and red wool.
translation_verse: Fa ɛtena bɔ ye tendenn nu te agyirɛ aburanyɔ nwi aluo berɛ pambim ne noa. Fa bibire, koogyan, adaabene ne gyese nwo bɛen ne. Maa beli adwii begua nu. Maa bɛsosɔ bonima nna nu, ná benya nyinasoɛ nna.

english_verse: Make the rest of the equipment for the sacred tent of bronze, including the pegs for the tent and for the curtain surrounding the courtyard. The Oil for the Lamp in the Holy Place (Leviticus
translation_verse: Nyianu sua ne anu nningyein amukoraa bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔne, ye pɛmbɛen amukoraa, ɔne aluo berɛ pɛmbɛen amukoraa, fa kɔɔbere yeɛ yɔ ɔ. Kanea ne nwo mmeraa (Lewitikɔso

english_verse: in front of the curtain that separates the holy place from the most holy place, where the sacred chest is kept. Aaron and his sons are responsible for keeping the lamp burning every night in the sacred tent. The Israelites must always obey this command.
translation_verse: Ɛtena sua atenaleɛ berɛ, bɔ ɔwɔ mbɛmuɛ tena bɔ onwi Adanzeɛ ne nyunu ne, Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ yeɛ bɛkɔnea kyɛ kanea nemɔ asosɔ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, ofi nɔsoa bɔ ɔkwaadwu ngyerɛmɔ. Na sɔ ahyɛdeɛ ne kɔla berɛ daa kɔma Yisraelfoɛ wɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraati nu.

english_verse: Send for your brother Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. They are the ones I have chosen from Israel to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: “Afei, ye eliɛma Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ sie ahameɛ fi Yisraelfoɛ nu ma bɛbra wɔ berɛ, ná beeli sɔfo bɛso me. Mekyire Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua Nadabo ne Abihu, yeɛ Eleasa ne Yitama.

english_verse: Aaron is to be dedicated as my high priest, and his clothes must be made only by persons who possess skills that I have given them.
translation_verse: Ka kyire bɛ bɔ bedi adwii, bɔ mafa sɔ nworɛ ne mama bɛ amukoraati, kyɛ bɛ́pomba ndaadeɛ bɛ́ma Aarɔn ma ɔyɛ krongron, ná oli sɔfo so me.

english_verse: Here are the items that need to be made: a breastpiece, a priestly vest, a robe, an embroidered shirt, a turban, and a sash. These sacred clothes are to be made for your brother Aaron and his sons who will be my priests.
translation_verse: Ndaadeɛ bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛpomba nemɔ ɛhe: ahone so aguasoɛ, ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ, ataadeɛ tendenn, aguasoɛ bɔ banwo nningyein bagua nu ɔ, yeɛ abotire ne abɔsoɛ. Ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛpomba ndaadeɛ krongron hemɔ bɛma eliɛma Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ, maa bedi sɔfo bɛso me.

english_verse: Use only gold and fine linen, woven with blue, purple, and red wool, for making these clothes. The Vest for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: Esikaa kɔkorɛ, bibire, koogyan, adaabene ne nwera paa yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛfa bɛyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Attach two gold settings to the shoulder straps and fasten them with two braided chains of pure gold. The Breastpiece for the High Priest (Exodus
translation_verse: ɔne sikaa kɔkorɛ paa ndweaban nyɔ, bɔ banwo ye mmɛsa kyɛ nyamaa, ná fa ndweaban bɔ banwo ye mmɛsa kyɛ nyamaa ne sosɔ ye noa ne anu. Ahone so aguasoɛ ne (Ɛksadɔso

english_verse: From the same costly material make a breastpiece for the high priest to use in finding out what I want my people to do.
translation_verse: “Pa ahone so ndɛenbualɛ aguasoɛ. Maa beli adwii bɛyɔ. Yɔ ye kyɛbɔ ɛkɔyɔ ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ ne ala: fa sikaa kɔkorɛ, bibire, koogyan, adaabene ne gyese yeɛ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: with four rows of three precious stones: In the first row put a carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;
translation_verse: Fa nyɔboɛ nyemenenyemene ahoroɔ nna sesã folii wɔ nu. Ma folii bɔ oli moa ne yɛ nyɔboɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye sadonike, topase ne kabunkre;

english_verse: in the second row a turquoise, a sapphire, and a diamond;
translation_verse: ná folii bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne yɛ nyɔboɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye takuose, safire ne dɛngyɛmmoɛ;

english_verse: in the third row a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
translation_verse: ná folii bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne yɛ nyɔboɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye yasinte, agate ne amɛtise;

english_verse: and in the fourth row a beryl, an onyx, and a jasper. Mount the stones in delicate gold settings
translation_verse: ná folii bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne yɛ nyɔboɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye bɛrile, onike ne yasepa. Fa sikaa kɔkorɛ pɛ ye nwo hangra.

english_verse: Attach two gold rings to the upper front corners of the breastpiece and fasten them with two braided gold chains to gold settings on the shoulder straps.
translation_verse: Na ndweaban nyɔ bɔ banwo ye mmɛsa ne, fa ye noa nyɔ bɔ waha ne sosɔ ye noa hangra ne anu. Ná fa wurawura ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ ne ye bati so nyamaa ne anu wɔ ye nyunu.

english_verse: Then take a blue cord and tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. This will keep the breastpiece in place.
translation_verse: Ahone so aguasoɛ ne anu kaa nemɔ, fa nyamaa bibire kyekye bɛ sosɔ ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ nu kaa nemɔ; amaa ɔnate so wasosɔ ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ abɔsoɛ bɔ bali adwii bagua nu ne anu, ná ahone so aguasoɛ ne amburo amvi ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Under his vest Aaron must wear a robe of blue wool
translation_verse: “Ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ aguasoɛ tendenn ne, yɔ ye mukoraati bibire.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for his head. Be sure to bind the material around the collar to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: Pakye atee bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛ ti bekowura nu ɔ to ye afia. Nwo ɛtena fa samo ye kɔme anu maa ɔyɛ kyɛ ataadeɛ kɔme, ná wande wamva nu.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe weave pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a gold bell between each of them.
translation_verse: Sikaa kɔkorɛ adɔma li berɛ a, né akengaa wora oli berɛ; maa ɔpɛ ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ aguasoɛ tendenn ne noa bɔ babu ne amukoraa ɔbra yia.

english_verse: If Aaron wears these clothes when he enters the holy place as my high priest, the sound of the bells will be heard, and his life will not be in danger.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Aarɔn ɔ́yɔ ye ɔsɔfo adwuma ne a, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa wura, amaa sɛ ɔ́kɔ nekaa krongron ne anu wɔ AWURADE nyunu a, ɔne kyɛ ofi berɛ ófite a, bate adɔma ne wosolɛ, ná wanwu.

english_verse: On a narrow strip of pure gold engrave the words: “Dedicated to the Lord.”
translation_verse: “Boro sikaa kɔkorɛ paa yɛ ye taataa, ná di adwii kolikoli so, kyɛbɔ nzɔanoɛ so kolikolilɛ te ɔ, kyɛ, ‘Ɔte krongron ma AWURADE.’

english_verse: Fasten it to the front of Aaron's turban with a blue cord,
translation_verse: Fa nyamaa bibire kyekye ye fa sɔ abotire ne, ná maa ɔbra abotire ne nyunu.

english_verse: so he can wear it on his forehead. This will show that he will take on himself the guilt for any sins the people of Israel commit in offering their gifts to me, and I will forgive them.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔbɔ Aarɔn nwoma so. Na mvomsoɛ biala bɔ Yisraelfoɛ kɔyɔ wɔ b’akyɛdeɛ krongron bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ afɔleɛ krongron nwo ne, Aarɔn kɔfa kɔsoa. Mmerɛ biala, ɔkɔbɔ Aarɔn nwoma so, amaa ɔnate so akyɛdeɛ krongron nemɔ asɔ AWURADE nye.

english_verse: Since Aaron's sons are priests, they should also look dignified. So make robes, sashes, and special caps for them.
translation_verse: “Pomba ataadeɛ aguasoɛ, abɔsoɛ, ɔne kyerɛ mɔ ma Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ ma benya animnyam ne dibea.

english_verse: Then dress Aaron and his sons in these clothes, pour olive oil on their heads, and ordain them as my priests.
translation_verse: Ɛkɔfa kowura eliɛma Aarɔn, ɔne ye mma mmienzua mɔ bɔ bɛboka ye so ne. Afei ɛkɔfa ɛpopalɛ ngoo kogua bɛ ti so, ɛkɔyɛ bɛ sɔfo, ná ate bɛ nwo maa bayɛ krongron, ná bali sɔfo baso me.

english_verse: Make linen shorts for them that reach from the waist down to the thigh, so they won't expose themselves.
translation_verse: Fa nwera pa pieto ma bɛ maa ɔkata bɛ bienzua so. Ma ye tendenn fi bɛ sisia oodwu bɛ sɔ so.

english_verse: Whenever they enter the sacred tent or serve at the altar or enter the holy place, they must wear these shorts, or else they will be guilty and die. This same rule applies to any of their descendants who serve as priests.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ biala, sɛ Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ bɛ́kɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ, anaakyɛ sɛ bépingye afɔleɛ bokyea ne nwo bɛkɔso wɔ nekaa krongron ne anu a, ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛfa bewura; ná bamvrɛfrɛ musue bamma bɛ nwo, ná banwu. Na ɛhe kɔyɛ ahyɛdeɛ afebɔɔ kɔma Aarɔn ne ye bosofoɛ bɔ bɛkɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: Each day you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for sin and as a way of purifying the altar. In addition, you must smear the altar with olive oil to make it completely holy.
translation_verse: Daa biala, fa nandwie nyii ko bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ maa ɔyɛ mbata. Asa koso, sɛ ɛ́pata wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso a, bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ wɔ so, fa ɛpopalɛ ngoo popa ye, ná te ye nwo.

english_verse: Then from your finest flour make three batches of dough without yeast. Shape some of it into larger loaves, some into smaller loaves mixed with olive oil, and the rest into thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: paanoo kabrɛdi, taterɛ kabrɛdi bɔ bafa ngoo bafete ɔ, ɔne apiti kabrɛdi bɔ bafa ngoo bafa ye nwo ɔ. Fa atokoɔ esam paa yeɛ yɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Put all of this bread in a basket and bring it when you come to sacrifice the three animals to me.
translation_verse: Fa gua kɛndɛen ko anu, maa begua kɛndɛen ne ala nu, ná fa bra. Fa nandwie nyii ne ne mmoaen nyii nyɔ ne boka so bra.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the sacred tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Fa Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ bra ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ, ná fa nzue nwunzinwunzi bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly shirt, the robe that goes under the sacred vest, the vest itself, the breastpiece, and the sash.
translation_verse: Fa ndaadeɛ nemɔ: aguasoɛ ne ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ aguasoɛ tendenn ne, ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ ne, ɔne ahone so aguasoɛ ne wura Aarɔn, ná fa ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ abɔsoɛ bɔ bali adwii bagua nu ne bɔ ye nu.

english_verse: and then ordain him by pouring olive oil on his head.
translation_verse: Fa ɛpopalɛ ngoo ne, hwie gua ye ti so, ná fa popa ye ti so.

english_verse: Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, where Aaron and his sons will lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Fa nandwie nyii ne bra ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ, ná Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ bɛ́fa bɛ sa bégua nandwie ne ti afia.

english_verse: Kill the bull near my altar in front of the tent.
translation_verse: Afei ku nandwie ne AWURADE nyunu, wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ.

english_verse: Use a finger to smear some of its blood on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest of the blood on the ground next to the altar.
translation_verse: Fa nandwie mogya ne bie, ná fa wɔ sa mmɛseka bɔ nu fa kekã afɔleɛ bokyea mmɛen nemɔ anwo. Na mogya bɔ ɔkɔha ne de, hwie gua afɔleɛ bokyea ne abo.

english_verse: But the meat, the skin, and the food still in the bull's stomach must be burned outside the camp as an offering to ask forgiveness for the sins of the priests.
translation_verse: Nakoso nandwie naen ne, ye nwomaa ne ye fure nu nningyein de, fa see yera bɛ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ. Ɔte bɔne nwo afɔleɛ.

english_verse: Bring one of the rams to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Afei fa boaen nyii nemɔ nu ko, ná Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ bɛ́fa bɛ sa bégua boaen nyii ne ti afia.

english_verse: Kill the ram and splatter its blood against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ku boaen nyii ne, ná fa ye mogya ne petepete afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo bra yia.

english_verse: Cut up the ram, wash its insides and legs, and lay all of its parts on the altar, including the head.
translation_verse: Pepɛ boaen naen ne anu ahuronzi ahuronzi. Nwunzi ye kunu nningyein ne ye gya nemɔ anwo, ná fa bɛ gua naen ahuronzi ahuronzi ɔne ye ti ne aso.

english_verse: Then make sure that the whole animal goes up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Yera boaen nyii mumua ne wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso. Ɔte naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE. Ɔte nikyee fonafona, ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: Bring the other ram to Aaron and his sons and tell them to lay their hands on its head.
translation_verse: “Afei fa boaen nyii ko ne wora, ná Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ bɛ́fa bɛ sa bégua boaen nyii ne ti afia.

english_verse: Kill the ram and place some of its blood on Aaron's right ear lobe, his right thumb, and the big toe of his right foot. Do the same for each of his sons and splatter the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Ku boaen nyii ne, ná fa ye mogya ne bie kekã Aarɔn so famaa tɛndiaa ne, ye mma mmienzua nemɔ so famaa tɛndiaa ne, bɛ sa kokotire famaa ne, ɔne bɛ gya kokotire famaa ne. Na mogya bɔ ɔkɔha ne de, hwie gua afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo bra yia.

english_verse: Then take some of the blood from the altar, mix it with the oil used for ordination, and sprinkle it on Aaron and his clothes, and also on his sons and their clothes. This will show that they and their clothes have been dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Afei fa afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso mogya ne bie, ɔne ɛpopalɛ ngoo ne, ná fa pete Aarɔn nwo ne ye ndaadeɛ nu, ɔne ye mma nemɔ nwo ne bɛ ndaadeɛ nu. Na ɛhe kɔma Aarɔn ne ye ndaadeɛ kɔyɛ krongron, ná ye mma mɔ ne bɛ ndaadeɛ koso ayɛ krongron.

english_verse: This ram is part of the ordination service. So remove its right hind leg, its fat tail, the fat on its insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: “Boaen nyii ne, fa ye loe ne, ye dua pue ne, ɛloe bɔ wato wafa ye kunu nningyein nwo ne, bɔ osinzesinze ye boɛ nwo ne, ye saa nyɔ nemɔ ɔne bɛ nwo loe ne, ɔne ye sɔ famaa ne, .

english_verse: and put this bread, together with the meat, into the hands of Aaron and his sons. Then they will lift it all up to show that it is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: ná fa ye mukoraati gua Aarɔn sa nu, ɔne ye mma nemɔ koso bɛ sa nu, ná pagya so kɔ anwuro ma ɔyɛ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: After this, put the meat and bread on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Afei, de fi bɛ sa nu, ná yera bɛ ne naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso ma ɔbo fonafona wɔ AWURADE nyunu; ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ bɛfa see bɛyera ye bɛma AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: You may eat the choice ribs from this second ram, but you must first lift them up to show that this meat is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: “Aarɔn sɔfohyɛlɛ boaen nyii ne, fa ye sa ne, ná pagya so kɔ anwuro ma ɔyɛ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, na ɔkɔyɛ wɔ deɛ.

english_verse: After Aaron's death, his priestly clothes are to be handed down to each descendant who succeeds him as high priest, and these clothes must be worn during the seven-day ceremony of ordination.
translation_verse: Ye mma mmienzua nemɔ, bɛ nu ko bɔ okosi ye gya nu koli sɔfo ne, ko bɔ ɔkɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ ɔkɔyɔ ɔsɔfo adwuma wɔ nekaa krongron ne anu ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ owura ye ɛlɛsoo.

english_verse: Boil the meat of the ordination ram in a sacred place,
translation_verse: “Fa ɔsɔfohyɛlɛ boaen nyii ne, ná to ye naen ne wɔ nekaa krongron ne anu berɛ.

english_verse: then Aaron and his sons are to eat it together with the three kinds of bread at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ bekoli boaen naen ne, ɔne paanoo bɔ ɔwɔ kɛndɛen ne anu ne, wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ.

english_verse: At their ordination, a ceremony of forgiveness was performed for them with this sacred food, and only they have the right to eat it.
translation_verse: Nningyein bɔ bɛfa bɛyɛle mbata bɛmane bɛ, bɔ begyinane so bɛhyɛle bɛ sɔfo, ná bɛfa bɛtele bɛ nwo ne, beli. Nakoso sona bɔ ɔtte sɔfo ne de, nnɛmaa odi bie, ofikyɛ ɔte aleɛ krongron.

english_verse: If any of the sacred food is left until morning, it must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfohyɛlɛ naen ne bie, anaa paanoo ne bie ka ma aleɛ kye so a, ye de fa see yera bɔ waha ne. Ɔnzɛ kyɛ bedi, ofikyɛ ɔte krongron.

english_verse: Repeat this ordination ceremony for Aaron and his sons seven days in a row, just as I have instructed you.
translation_verse: “Sɔ yeɛ yɔ ma Aarɔn ne ye mma nemɔ ɔ, kyɛbɔ mahyɛ wɔ ne amukoraa; fa ɛlɛsoo yeɛ hyɛ bɛ sɔfo ɔ.

english_verse: Do this for seven days, and the altar will become so holy that anyone who touches it will become holy. Daily Sacrifices (Leviticus
translation_verse: Fa ɛlɛsoo pata wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso, te ye nwo, na afɔleɛ bokyea ne kɔyɛ krongron paa, na nikyee biala bɔ ye nwo kɔha afɔleɛ bokyea nen, ɔkɔyɛ krongron. Daa daa afɔleɛ ne (Numeri

english_verse: Each day you must sacrifice two lambs a year old,
translation_verse: “Ɛlɛho biala, fa ɛhe bɔ afɔleɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso: mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nyɔ bɔ ebiala ali afoɛ ko ɔ.

english_verse: one in the morning and one in the evening.
translation_verse: Fa boaen akrɔngrɔma ko bɔ afɔleɛ ngyerɛmɔ, ná fa ko ne koso bɔ afɔleɛ nɔsoa.

english_verse: With each lamb offer one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of pure olive oil, and also pour out a liter of wine as an offering. The smell of this sacrifice on the fires of the altar will be pleasing to me.
translation_verse: Boaen akrɔngrɔma ko bɔ waha ne, fa bɔ afɔleɛ nɔsoa. Fa aleɛ afɔleɛ ne anonneɛ afɔleɛ ne boka so kyɛ ngyerɛmɔ deɛ ne ala. Maa ɔbo fonafona, na ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ bɛfa see bɛyera ye bɛma AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: Because of who I am, the tent will become sacred, and Aaron and his sons will become worthy to serve as my priests.
translation_verse: Ngɔte ɛtena sua atenaleɛ berɛ ne afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo, na ngɔte Aarɔn ne ye mma mɔ nwo, ná bali sɔfo baso me.

english_verse: I will live among you as your God,
translation_verse: Ngɔtena Yisraelfoɛ nu, ná mayɛ bɛ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: and you will know that I am the Lord your God, the one who rescued you from Egypt, so that I could live among you.
translation_verse: Na bekonwu ye kyɛ me ole AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔyele bɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so ne, amaa ɔnate so matena bɛ nu. Me ole AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ ne.

english_verse: It is truly holy because it is dedicated to me, so don't ever make any for yourselves.
translation_verse: Na ayirefona bɔ ɛbaafrafra nningyein yɔ ne, nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ bie bɛfa. Bu ye kyɛ ɔte krongron ma AWURADE.

english_verse: Mix four liters of olive oil with the following costly spices: six kilograms of myrrh, three kilograms of cinnamon, three kilograms of cane, and six kilograms of cassia. Measure these according to the official standards. Then use this sacred mixture
translation_verse: Ná fa yɔ ɛpopalɛ ngoo krongron, sakyeɛfona kyɛbɔ sona bɔ ole ye nwo nimdeɛ afrafra nningyein ayɔ ɔ. Na ɔkɔyɛ ɛpopalɛ ngoo krongron.

english_verse: the altar for sacrifices, and the large bowl with its stand.
translation_verse: naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne ne ye nwo nningyein amukoraa, yeɛ ayaa ne ne ye nyinasoɛ ne.

english_verse: Build an altar of acacia wood where you can burn incense.
translation_verse: “Si afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ bɛkɔyera ɛyɛɛ so ɔ; bɔsema yeɛ fa si ɔ.

english_verse: Then below the edging on opposite sides attach two gold rings through which you can put the poles for carrying the altar.
translation_verse: Fa sikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ kɔtɔkaa nyɔ ma ye. Maa bɛbra ye hangra ne abo, wɔ ye ngyɛnu ne ye ngyɛnu, na bɛkɔsosɔ mbuna bɔ bɛfa bɛsoa afɔleɛ bokyea ne anu.

english_verse: These poles are also to be made of acacia wood covered with gold.
translation_verse: Fa bɔsema se mbuna nemɔ, ná fa sikaa kɔkorɛ boro bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Put the altar in front of the inside curtain of the sacred tent. The chest with the place of mercy is kept behind that curtain, and I will talk with you there.
translation_verse: Mbɛmuɛ tena bɔ onwi Adanzeɛ alaka ne nyunu ne, fa afɔleɛ bokyea ne sie ye nyunu, wɔ mbata bia bɔ ɔwɔ Adanzeɛ ne aso ne ye nyunu, nekaa bɔ me ne wɔ yɛkoyia ne.

english_verse: Burn only the proper incense on the altar and never use it for grain sacrifices or animal sacrifices or drink offerings.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔyera ɛyɛɛ mbaen biala wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, anaa aleɛ afɔleɛ wɔ so; yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔbɔ anonneɛ afɔleɛ biala wɔ so.

english_verse: Once a year Aaron must purify the altar by smearing on its four corners the blood of an animal sacrificed for sin, and this practice must always be followed. The altar is sacred because it is dedicated to me. The Money for the Sacred Tent
translation_verse: Afoɛ biala, ɔsɛ kyɛ Aarɔn bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ wɔ ye mmɛen nemɔ aso. Ɔkɔfa bɔne nwo mbata afɔleɛ mogya kɔpata komapɛ afoɛ biala, wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ mukoraati nu. Ɔte krongron paa ma AWURADE.” Ɛtena sua ne nwo toɔ

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: Find out how many grown men there are in Israel and require each of them to pay me to keep him safe from danger while you are counting them.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛka Yisraelfoɛ kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ekonwu bɛ noa a, ɔsɛ kyɛ ebiala tua ye ti nyɔboɛ sikaa ma AWURADE, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ egu so ɛka bɛ ne, ná musue biala ando bɛ wɔ bɛ halɛ ne anu.

english_verse: , whether rich or poor, must pay me the same amount of money, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: Na nzue he yeɛ Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ bɛkɔfa bekonwunzi bɛ sa ne bɛ gya nwo ɔ.

english_verse: This money is to be used for the upkeep of the sacred tent, and because of it, I will never forget my people. The Large Bronze Bowl (Exodus
translation_verse: Dide mbata sikaa ne fi Yisraelfoɛ berɛ, ná fa yɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ ɛsɔnenɛ nwo adwuma. Na ɔkɔyɛ Yisraelfoɛ nwo ngayeɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ɔnate ɛmɔ ti nyɔboɛ tualɛ ne ati.” Kɔɔbere ayaa

english_verse: If you ever make any of it to use as perfume, you will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfrafra nningyein kɔyɔ bie kɔfofã kotie nen, bɛkɔpɛ ye asue bekofi ye maen nu.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: By dedicating them in this way, you will make them so holy that anyone who even touches them will become holy.
translation_verse: Te bɛ nwo ma bɛyɛ krongron paa; na nikyee biala bɔ ye nwo kɔha bɛ ne, ɔkɔyɛ krongron.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: for dedicating the tent and chest,
translation_verse: Ná fa popa ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ ne Adanzeɛ alaka ne,

english_verse: the table with its equipment, the lampstand with its equipment, the incense altar with all its utensils,
translation_verse: ɛpoen ne ne ye nwo nningyein amukoraati, kanea bakaa ne ne ye nwo nningyein, ɛyɛɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne,

english_verse: When you ordain Aaron and his sons as my priests, sprinkle them with some of this oil,
translation_verse: Fa ɛpopalɛ ngoo ne gua Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ ti so, ná te bɛ nwo ma beli sɔfo bɛso me.

english_verse: and say to the people of Israel: “This oil must always be used in the ordination service of a priest. It is holy because it is dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na se Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛhe kɔyɛ ɛpopalɛ ngoo krongron kɔma me wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraati nu.

english_verse: So treat it as holy! Don't ever use it for everyday purposes or mix any for yourselves.
translation_verse: Nnɛmaa behwie begua sona foforɛ mbaen biala nwo, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔfrafra nningyein bɛyɔ bie bɔ ɔte kyɛ ɛhe ɔ. Ɔte krongron, yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ krongron ma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: If you do, you will no longer belong to the Lord's people.” The Sweet-Smelling Incense
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfrafra nningyein kɔyɔ bie, anaakyɛ ɔkɔfa kogua sona bɔ ɔtte sɔfo nwo nen, bɛkɔpɛ ye asue bekofi ye maen nu.’ ” Ayirefona

english_verse: Mix equal amounts of the costly spices stacte, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense, then add salt to make the mixture pure and holy.
translation_verse: ná yɔ sakyeɛfona, kyɛbɔ sona bɔ ole ye nwo nimdeɛ afrafra nningyein ayɔ ɔ. Fa ngyee gua nu, ma ye nye yɛ gyengɔɔ, ná maa ɔyɛ krongron.

english_verse: Pound some of it into powder and sprinkle it in front of the sacred chest, where I meet with you. Be sure to treat this incense as something very holy.
translation_verse: Tĩ bie ma ɔyɛ muhumuhu, ná fa bie sie Adanzeɛ ne nyunu wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ, nekaa bɔ me ne wɔ yɛkoyia ne. Na ɔkɔyɛ krongron paa kɔma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: I have chosen Bezalel from the Judah tribe to make the sacred tent and its furnishings.
translation_verse: “Tie, maneanea nu maye Besalel bɔ ɔse ole Yuri, bɔ ye koso ɔse ole Hure, bɔ ofi Yuda abusua kure nu ne,

english_verse: Not only have I filled him with my Spirit, but I have given him wisdom and made him a skilled craftsman who can create objects of art with gold, silver, bronze, precious stones, and wood.
translation_verse: kyɛ ose nyɔboɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛhyehyɛ nikyee ɔ, ná ose mmakaa ɔfa li adwii wɔ nikyee biala nu.

english_verse: I have appointed Oholiab from the tribe of Dan to work with him, and I have also given skills to those who will help them make everything exactly as I have commanded you:
translation_verse: Afei tie, Ahisamake awa bienzua Oholiabo bɔ ofi Dan abusua kure nu ne, maye ye kyɛ ɔboka ye so. Na mama adwiililɛfoɛ amukoraati nworɛ bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔyɔ bɔ mahyɛ wɔ ne amukoraa:

english_verse: Moses told the Israelites that the Lord had said: The Sabbath belongs to me. Now I command you and your descendants to always obey the laws of the Sabbath. By doing this, you will know that I have chosen you as my own.
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔli m’afofingyẽa ne aso, ofikyɛ ɛhe yeɛ ɔte me ne ɛmɔ y’afia sɛngyerɛnneɛ, wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraati nu ɔ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanwu ye kyɛ me, AWURADE, me yeɛ mete ɛmɔ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Keep the Sabbath holy. You have six days to do your work, but the Sabbath is mine, and it must remain a day of rest. If you work on the Sabbath, you will no longer be part of my people, and you will be put to death.
translation_verse: Elesia yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛyɔ adwuma ɔ, nakoso kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne de, ɔte nwomelelɛ kyẽa bɔkɔɔ, bɔ ɔte krongron ma AWURADE ɔ. Na sona biala bɔ ɔkɔyɔ adwuma afofikyẽa nen, ɔsɛ kyɛ beku ye.

english_verse: This day will always serve as a reminder, both to me and to the Israelites, that I made the heavens and the earth in six days, then on the seventh day I rested and relaxed.
translation_verse: Ɔte sɛngyerɛnneɛ afebɔɔ wɔ me ne Yisraelfoɛ y’afia, kyɛ elesia yeɛ AWURADE fa bɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ɔ, nakoso kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne de, wanyɔ adwuma, na olele ye nwome.”

english_verse: When God had finished speaking to Moses on Mount Sinai, he gave him the two flat stones on which he had written all his laws with his own hand.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ ne Mose bedwudwole beyiele wɔ Sinai bokaa ne aso nen, ɔfale Adanzeɛ nyɔboɛ taataa nyɔ ne mane Mose, nyɔboɛ taataa bɔ Nyameɛ afa ye sa mmɛseka wahyerɛ so ne.

english_verse: Moses, I have seen how stubborn these people are,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Manwu sɔ mmenia hemɔ, na bɛte asoserɛfoɛ mmenia.

english_verse: Moses said to them, “You obeyed the Lord and did what was right, and so you will serve as his priests for the people of Israel. It was hard for you to kill your own sons and brothers, but the Lord has blessed you and made you his priests today.”
translation_verse: Na Mose hane kyɛ, “Ɛnɛ, ɛmɔate ɛmɔ nwo bama AWURADE adwuma. Ebiala afa ɔwa bienzua ne oliɛma bienzua yeɛ wapɛ so ɔ, na ɔnate so ɛmɔanya Nyameɛ saleɛ ɛnɛ kyẽa ye.”

english_verse: After the people saw that Moses had been on the mountain for a long time, they went to Aaron and said, “Make us an image of a god who will lead and protect us. Moses brought us out of Egypt, but nobody knows what has happened to him.”
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ mmenia ne nwuni kyɛ Mose ahyɛ soma wɔ bokaa ne aso, ná ondwu mma nen, mmenia ne boaboale bɛ noa bɛhɔle Aarɔn berɛ, na besele ye kyɛ, “Dwɔso ná yɔ bosoen mɔ bɔ bekoli yɛ nyunu ma yɛ. Ofikyɛ sɔ Mose ne, akoaa he bɔ ɔɔyele yɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne de, yɛnze bɔ wato ye ɔ.”

english_verse: Aaron told them, “Bring me the gold earrings that your wives and sons and daughters are wearing.”
translation_verse: Na Aarɔn buale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔyeye sikaa kɔkorɛ asomade bɔ owurawura ɛmɔ aye mɔ, ɛmɔ mma mmienzua ne mmrasua mɔ, ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́brɛ me.”

english_verse: then he melted them and made an idol in the shape of a young bull. All the people said to one another, “This is the god who brought us out of Egypt!”
translation_verse: Olele sikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛbrɛle ye ne, ohurole ye, na ɔfa yɔle nandwie ba amoen. Na bɛhane kyɛ, “O Yisrael, wɔ nyameɛ mɔ bɔ bɛyele wɔ befili Misraim aseɛ so bɛwale ne ɛhe!”

english_verse: When Aaron saw what was happening, he built an altar in front of the idol and said, “Tomorrow we will celebrate in honor of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ Aarɔn nwuni ye sɔ nen, osili afɔleɛ bokyea wɔ amoen ne nyunu, na obukyele ye noa hane kyɛ, “Ɛhema yɛkoli AWURADE aluolue ne.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: Hurry back down! Those people you led out of Egypt are acting like fools.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Dwu kɔ aseɛnwo dɔ, ofikyɛ wɔ mmenia bɔ ɛɛyele bɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne, babɔ musue.

english_verse: They have already stopped obeying me and have made themselves an idol in the shape of a young bull. They have bowed down to it, offered sacrifices, and said that it is the god who brought them out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Atee bɔ ngyirele bɛ ne, bakwati ye ndɛndɛ so. Bahuro nikyee bafa bayɔ nandwie ba, bakoto ye, yeɛ babɔ afɔleɛ bama ye, na baha kyɛ, O Yisrael, wɔ nyameɛ mɔ bɔ bɛyele wɔ befili Misraim aseɛ so bɛwale ne ɛhe!”

english_verse: and I'm angry enough to destroy them, so don't try to stop me. But I will make your descendants into a great nation.
translation_verse: Yiti yakyi me maa mvɛ bɛ so yaa piri, ná ngyikyi bɛ boso bɔkɔɔ; nakoso wɔ de, ngɔmaa ɛkɔyɛ maen pirikua.”

english_verse: Moses tried to get the Lord God to change his mind: Our Lord, you used your mighty power to bring these people out of Egypt. Now don't become angry and destroy them.
translation_verse: Nakoso Mose pale AWURADE ye Nyameɛ kyerɛ kyɛ, “O AWURADE, wɔ mmenia bɔ ɛnate tumi piri ne anwoserɛ so ɛyele bɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne, nzu ati yeɛ afɛ bɛ so yaa piri sɔa ɔ?

english_verse: If you do, the Egyptians will say that you brought your people out here into the mountains just to get rid of them. Please don't be angry with your people. Don't destroy them!
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ Misraimfoɛ ka kyɛ, ‘Adwene tɛɛ bie ti yeɛ ɔmaa ɔɔyele bɛ hɔle ɔ, kyɛ ɔkwaahuhu bɛ wɔ mmokaa ne anu dɔ, ná okyikyi bɛ boso fi aseɛ ye aso’ ɔ? Ma w’ahone tɔ nzue nu, ná yakyi musue bɔ ɛbaamaa ɔto wɔ mmenia nemɔ ne.

english_verse: Remember the solemn promise you made to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. You promised that someday they would have as many descendants as there are stars in the sky and that you would give them land.
translation_verse: Kaye wɔ ngoaa Abraham, Yisake ne Yisrael bɔ ɛtale wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo ndaen sele bɛ kyɛ, ‘Ngɔma ɛmɔ boso ama kɔsone pee kyɛ ewienu nzramaa; na aseɛ he amukoraati bɔ mabɔ ye nwo anohoba ne, ngɔfa ngɔma ɛmɔ boso ama, na ɔkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ afebɔɔ.’ ”

english_verse: So even though the Lord had threatened to destroy the people, he changed his mind and let them live.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE sesane ye adwene wɔ musue bɔ ɔyɛle kyɛ ɔkɔmaa ɔkɔto ye mmenia ne anwo.

english_verse: Moses went back down the mountain with the two flat stones on which God had written all of his laws with his own hand, using both sides of the stones.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bɔbɔ yeɛ osele nyɔboɛ nemɔ ɔ, yeɛ nyɔboɛ nemɔ so kolikolilɛ bɔ bali adwii bakolikoli bagua so ne, ɔte Nyameɛ ahyerɛlɛ.

english_verse: When Joshua heard the noisy shouts of the people, he said to Moses, “A battle must be going on down in the camp.”
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ Yosua tele kyɛ mmenia nemɔ bɛ́bɔ ese nen, osele Mose kyɛ, “Koɛ nwo dede bie asi asikyeleɛ berɛ.”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “It doesn't sound like they are shouting because they have won or lost a battle. It sounds more like a wild party!”
translation_verse: Nakoso Mose buale kyɛ, “Nna ngonimlilɛ nwo esebɔlɛ ɔ, yeɛ nna ngoguo nwo dede koso ɔ, na mmom edweintolɛ gyegyegyegye yeɛ mete ɔ.”

english_verse: As Moses got closer to the camp, he saw the idol, and he also saw the people dancing around. This made him so angry that he threw down the stones and broke them to pieces at the foot of the mountain.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Mose pingyele asikyeleɛ ne, ná onwuni nandwie ba ne ne abiliegolɛ pɛ, ye ahone huli paa, na ogyili nyɔboɛ taataa bɔ otira ye ne guale bokaa ne nye abo berɛ maa nu bubuli.

english_verse: He melted the idol the people had made, and he ground it into powder. He scattered it in their water and made them drink it.
translation_verse: Ɔfale nandwie amoen bɔ bayɔ ne, ɔfale see yerale ye, otini ye muhumuhu, ɔto guale nzue nye so, na ɔmane Yisraelfoɛ none.

english_verse: Moses asked Aaron, “What did these people do to harm you? Why did you make them sin in this terrible way?”
translation_verse: Na Mose sele Aarɔn kyɛ “Nzikyɛ yɔleɛ paa yeɛ mmenia hemɔ fa yɔle wɔ ɔ, bɔ yiti amaa bayɔ bɔne pirikua sɔa ye?”

english_verse: Aaron answered: Don't be angry with me. You know as well as I do that they are determined to do evil.
translation_verse: Na Aarɔn buale kyɛ, “Me mene, nnɛfɛ yaa; wɔ bɔbɔ ɛse kyɛ bɔne ali mmenia hemɔ ti.

english_verse: They even told me, “That man Moses led us out of Egypt, but now we don't know what has happened to him. Make us a god to lead us.”
translation_verse: Besele me kyɛ, ‘Yɔ nyameɛ mɔ bɔ bekoli yɛ nyunu ma yɛ, ofikyɛ sɔ Mose ne, akoaa he bɔ ɔɔyele yɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne de, yɛnze bɔ wato ye ɔ.’

english_verse: Then I asked them to bring me their gold earrings. They took them off and gave them to me. I threw the gold into a fire, and out came this bull.
translation_verse: Na me koso nzele bɛ kyɛ, ‘Ebiala bɔ ole sikaa kɔkorɛ biala ne, ɔye bra!’ Yiti bɛyeyele bɛmane me, na ngyi nguale see nu, yeɛ nandwie ba he fili nu wale ɔ.”

english_verse: So Moses stood at the gate of the camp and shouted, “Everyone who is on the Lord's side come over here!” Then the men of the Levi tribe gathered around Moses,
translation_verse: Yiti ogyinane asikyeleɛ pambim ne anu, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ebiala bɔ ɔwɔ AWURADE bue nu ne, ɔ́bra me faen!” Na Lewifoɛ ne amukoraa bɛboale bɛ noa bɛhɔle ye berɛ.

english_verse: and he said to them, “The Lord God of Israel commands you to strap on your swords and go through the camp, killing your relatives, your friends, and your neighbors.”
translation_verse: Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, ‘Ɔsɛ kyɛ ebiala fa ye ngrandɛ wura ye nwo, ná okyinikyini asikyeleɛ ne anu, fi ye ti kodwu ye ti, ná okũkũ oliɛma mɔ ne ye mmango mɔ, ɔne mmenia bɔ b’awuro ne ye deɛ pingye ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: The men of the Levi tribe followed his orders, and that day they killed about
translation_verse: Na Lewifoɛ nemɔ yɔle kyɛbɔ Mose hane ne, na mmenia ne anu bie kɔyɛ apee nza totɔle sɔ kyẽa ne.

english_verse: The next day Moses told the people, “This is a terrible thing you have done. But I will go back to the Lord to see if I can do something to keep this sin from being held against you.”
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyene ne, Mose sele maen ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔayɔ bɔne piri paa. Nakoso ngɔfo ngɔhɔ AWURADE berɛ kekesaala ye; ebiaa né mahora masrɛ ɛmɔ bɔne ne nwo mbata mama ɛmɔ.”

english_verse: Moses returned to the Lord and said, “The people have committed a terrible sin. They have made a gold idol to be their god.
translation_verse: Yiti Mose sá hɔle AWURADE berɛ, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ao, maen he ayɔ bɔne piri paa! Bafa sikaa kɔkorɛ bayɔ nyameɛ mɔ bama bɛ nwo.

english_verse: But I beg you to forgive them. If you don't, please wipe my name out of your book.”
translation_verse: Nakoso mesrɛ wɔ, fa bɛ bɔne kyɛ bɛ. Na sɛ wamma ye sɔ de a, nzaade kyikyi me fi wɔ nwomaa bɔ ahyerɛ ne anu!”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “I will wipe out of my book the name of everyone who has sinned against me.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Sona biala bɔ wayɔ bɔne watia me nen, ye yeɛ ngokyikyi ye ngofi me nwomaa ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: Now take my people to the place I told you about, and my angel will lead you. But when the time comes, I will punish them for this sin.”
translation_verse: Nakoso kɔ, ná kɔfa mmenia ne kɔ nekaa bɔ mahã ye nwo dwirɛ mahyire wɔ ne. Tie, m’abɔfo koli wɔ nyunu moa, nakoso kyẽa bie kɔwa bɔ ngɔmaa bekonya bɛ bɔne nwo akatuaa ɔ.”

english_verse: So the Lord punished the people of Israel with a terrible disease for talking Aaron into making the gold idol.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE fale amaneɛ piri tole mmenia ne aso, ɔnate nandwie ba bɔ bɛmane Aarɔn yɔle ne ati.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses: You led the people of Israel out of Egypt. Now get ready to lead them to the land I promised their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Fi ɛwa kɔ, ɛne mmenia bɔ ɛɛyele bɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne. Aseɛ bɔ ndale ndaen mva mɔle Abraham, Yisake ne Yakob anohoba kyɛ, ‘Wɔ bosofoɛ yeɛ ngɔfa ngɔma bɛ ɔ’ ne, kɔ so.

english_verse: It is a land rich with milk and honey, and I will send an angel to force out those people who live there—the Canaanites, the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. But I will not go with my people. They are so rebellious that I would destroy them before they get there.
translation_verse: Kɔ aseɛ bɔ nyɔfonesue ne woɛ tengyɛ wɔ so ne aso; nakoso me de, me ne wɔ ngɔbɔ agyirɛ ngɔhɔ, annea né mama wɔ boso akyikyi wɔ atunu, ofikyɛ ɛte maen bɔ wɔ so yɛ se ɔ.

english_verse: Even before the Lord said these harsh things, he had told Moses, “These people really are rebellious, and I would kill them at once, if I went with them. But tell them to take off their fancy jewelry, then I'll decide what to do with them.” So the people started mourning,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ né AWURADE aha ahyire Mose kyɛ, “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔte mmenia bɔ bɛ so yɛ se ɔ; na sɛ me ne ɛmɔ yɛsã nu yɛkɔ kaala po a, ngɔma ɛmɔ boso konua. Yiti ɛ́mɔyeye ɛmɔ nwo mbembenanneɛ ne, amaa mahora manwu nikyee bɔ ngɔfa ngɔyɔ ɛmɔ ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: and after leaving Mount Sinai, they stopped wearing fancy jewelry. The Lord Is with His People
translation_verse: Yiti Yisraelfoɛ puropurole bɛ nwo mbembenanneɛ ne, fite mmerɛ bɔ befili Horebo bokaa ne anwo ne. Ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu

english_verse: Moses used to set up a tent far from camp. He called it the “meeting tent,” and whoever needed some message from the Lord would go there.
translation_verse: Né Mose taa fa ɛtena sua ne okosi ye wɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ nziɛ nziɛ, na ɔfrɛle ye ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu. Na sona biala bɔ né ɔpena kyɛ ɔfa ye dwirɛ to AWURADE nyunu ne, ɔyɛ a ɔkɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ, bɔ ɔwɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ ne.

english_verse: Each time Moses went out to this tent, everyone would stand at the entrance to their own tents and watch him enter.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ biala, sɛ né Mose ɔkɔ ɛtena sua ne anu a, mmenia ne amukoraa dwɔso gyina, ebiala gyina ye tena sua anoa nu, na ɔnea Mose toonn maa ɔkɔworo ɛtena sua ne anu.

english_verse: Then they would bow down because a thick cloud would come down in front of the tent, and the Lord would speak to Moses face to face, just like a friend. Afterwards, Moses would return to camp, but his young assistant Joshua would stay at the tent. The Lord Promises To Be with His People
translation_verse: Né AWURADE nate sɔ atee he aso ogyina Mose nyunu ɔne ye bedwudwo, kyɛbɔ sona ne obiɛngo bedwudwo ne ala. Na sɛ Mose sá ba asikyeleɛ ne anu a, ye bokafoɛ aberandeɛ Yosua bɔ ɔte Nun awa ne, ye de ɔka ɛtena sua ne anu dɔ. Nyameɛ hyɛ bɔ kyɛ ɔne Yisraelfoɛ kɔnate

english_verse: Moses said to the Lord, “I know that you have told me to lead these people to the land you promised them. But you have not said who will go along to help me. You have said that you are my friend and that you are pleased with me.
translation_verse: Na Mose sele AWURADE kyɛ, “Tie oo, wɔ ala yeɛ ɛkã kyire me kyɛ, ‘Fa mmenia hemɔ kɔ,’ nakoso ɛmma nnwuni sona bɔ ɛkɔsoma ye maa ɔne me kɔhɔ ɔ. Nakoso wɔ komapɛ ne ala yeɛ aha kyɛ, ‘Mese wɔ paa ne wɔ dumaa, na malo wɔ.’

english_verse: If this is true, let me know what your plans are, then I can obey and continue to please you. And don't forget that you have chosen this nation to be your own.”
translation_verse: Yiti mesrɛ wɔ, sɛ alo me de a, nzaade maa nwu wɔ ti anu adwene, amaa ɔnate so manwu wɔ, ná alo me. Afei koso, nwu ye kyɛ mmenia hemɔ te wɔ maen.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “I will go with you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE buale kyɛ, “Me bɔbɔ deinn me ne wɔ kɔhɔ, na ngɔmaa ekole wɔ nwome.”

english_verse: Then Moses replied, “If you aren't going with us, please don't make us leave this place.
translation_verse: Na Mose buale ye kyɛ, “Sɛ wɔ bɔbɔ deinn ɛne yɛ ngɔhɔ de a, nzaade nnɛfa yɛ fi wa kɔ.

english_verse: But if you do go with us, everyone will know that you are pleased with your people and with me. That way, we will be different from the rest of the people on earth.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né banwu ye kyɛ alo me ne wɔ mmenia nemɔ? Aso nna ɛhɔlɛ bɔ ɛne yɛ kɔhɔ ne ɔ? Na ɛhe kɔma me ne wɔ mmenia nemɔ yɛkɔyɛ sonongo wɔ aseɛ ye aso mmenia mukoraati nu.”

english_verse: So the Lord told him, “I will do what you have asked, because I am your friend and I am pleased with you.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Sɔ dwirɛ he bɔ aha ye, ngɔyɔ; ofikyɛ malo wɔ, na mese wɔ paa ne wɔ dumaa.”

english_verse: Then Moses said, “I pray that you will let me see you in all of your glory.”
translation_verse: Na Mose sele kyɛ, “Mesrɛ wɔ ala, maa nwu w’animnyam.”

english_verse: The Lord answered: All right. I am the Lord, and I show mercy and kindness to anyone I choose. I will let you see my glory and hear my holy name,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE buale kyɛ, “Ngɔma me paayɛlɛ mukoraati kɔsẽ kɔpɛ nu wɔ wɔ nyunu, ná mabɔ me dumaa AWURADE ne wɔ wɔ nyunu. Ofikyɛ sona bɔ ngɔlo ye ne yeɛ ngɔlo ye ɔ, yeɛ bɔ ngonwu ye anwumvoin ne yeɛ ngonwu ye anwumvoin ɔ.

english_verse: but I won't let you see my face, because anyone who sees my face will die.
translation_verse: Na ɔfa sɔle so kyɛ, nakoso ɛngɔhora ngonwu me nyunu, ofikyɛ sona nnwu me nyunu ná onnya ngoa.

english_verse: There is a rock not far from me. Stand beside it,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE hane kyɛ, Nea, nekaa wɔ me nwo wa, gyina nyɔbotaen ne aso.

english_verse: and before I pass by in all of my shining glory, I will put you in a large crack in the rock. I will cover your eyes with my hand until I have passed by.
translation_verse: Na sɛ m’animnyam ne ɔbaapɛ nu kɔ a, ngɔfa wɔ ngowura nyɔbotaen tokuro bie anu; na ngɔfa me sa ngɔkata wɔ so kodwu kyɛ ngɔpɛ nu ngɔhɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Then I will take my hand away, and you will see my back. You will not see my face.
translation_verse: Afei ngɔye me sa, na ekonwu me kɔme asi; nakoso me nyunu de, bennwu ye.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I promise to perform miracles for you that have never been seen anywhere on earth. Neighboring nations will stand in fear and know that I was the one who did these marvelous things.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE hane kyɛ, “Tie, méyɛ apam. Na anwanwadeɛ bɔ mebaayɔ ye wɔ mmenia ne amukoraati nyunu ne, ebie ossili le wɔ aseɛ so nekaa biala, anaa maen biala so. Na mmenia bɔ ɛmɔtete bɛ nu ne konwu AWURADE nnwumaa, ofikyɛ nikyee bɔ ɔyɛ suro yeɛ ngɔfa wɔ so ngɔyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Be ready tomorrow morning to come up Mount Sinai and meet me at the top.
translation_verse: Boaboa wɔ nwo ngyerɛmɔ, ná fo bra Sinai bokaa ne aso ngyerɛmɔ, ná nwondɛ me berɛ wɔ bokaa ne ti afia.

english_verse: No one is to come with you or to be on the mountain at all. Don't even let the sheep and cattle graze at the foot of the mountain.”
translation_verse: Nnɛfa sona biala boka wɔ nwo so ɛne ye bɛfo bɛba; ɔnzɛ kyɛ benwu sona biala wɔ bokaa ne anwo nekaa biala; yeɛ nnɛma mmoaen anaa nandwie biala kɔ adidie wɔ bokaa ne nyunu.”

english_verse: So Moses cut two flat stones like the first ones, and early the next morning he carried them to the top of Mount Sinai, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Yiti Mose sele nyɔboɛ taataa nyɔ bɔ ɔte kyɛ daa deɛ ne ala ɔ; na ɔpɛle aleɛ dwɔsole fo hɔle Sinai bokaa ne aso, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne, na ɔfale nyɔboɛ taataa nyɔ ne tirale.

english_verse: Then he passed in front of Moses and called out, “I am the Lord God. I am merciful and very patient with my people. I show great love, and I can be trusted.
translation_verse: AWURADE pɛle nu wɔ Mose nyunu, na AWURADE teane nu hane kyɛ, “AWURADE, AWURADE, Nyameɛ bɔ ɔse anwumvoin ná ɔdo mmenia ɔ, bɔ ye ahone nhu ndɛ, bɔ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne nahorɛlilɛ sone ɔ,

english_verse: Moses quickly bowed down to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Mose yɛle ndɛndɛ bɔle ye ti ase sɔnene AWURADE.

english_verse: He prayed, “Lord, if you really are pleased with me, I pray that you will go with us. It is true that these people are sinful and rebellious, but forgive our sin and let us be your people.” A Promise and Its Demands (Exodus
translation_verse: Na ɔhane kyɛ, “O AWURADE, sɛ alo me a, nzaade AWURADE, mesrɛ wɔ, boka yɛ so ɛne yɛ hɔ. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ mmenia hemɔ bɛ so yɛ se de, nakoso fa yɛ amumuyɛɛ ne yɛ bɔne kyɛ yɛ, ná fa yɛ wura wɔ kunu.” Bɛyɛ apam ne bieku (Ɛksadɔso

english_verse: Your men must come to worship me three times a year, because I am the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: “Afoɛ biala, ɔsɛ kyɛ wɔ mma mmienzua mukoraati ba AWURADE Nyameɛ, bɔ ɔte Yisrael Nyameɛ ne nyunu pɛen nza.

english_verse: I demand your complete loyalty—you must not worship any other god!
translation_verse: Nnɛsɔne bosoen biala, ofikyɛ AWURADE bɔ ye dumaa ole Nungunɛ nen, ɔte Nyameɛ bɔ ɔtwe nungunɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The first-born males of your families and of your flocks and herds belong to me.
translation_verse: Koɛsɛen biala nu bamuɛbaa te me deɛ: wɔ nyɛmmoa nyii bamuɛbaa mukoraati, nandwie oo, boaen oo, ɔte me deɛ.

english_verse: Don't make metal images of gods.
translation_verse: “Nnɛhuro nikyee biala fa yɔ bosoen sɔne ye.

english_verse: I will force out the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, but you must do what I command you today.
translation_verse: Di bɔ ɛnɛ méhyɛ wɔ ne aso. Tie, ngɔfoa Amorifoɛ, Kanaanfoɛ, Hitifoɛ, Perisifoɛ, Hiwifoɛ ne Yebusifoɛ ngofi wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with any of those people. If you do, it will be like falling into a trap.
translation_verse: Aseɛ bɔ ɛ́kɔ so ne, nea yé ná ɛne so ama anyɛ apam, ná wanyɛ wɔ so ngaen.

english_verse: Instead, you must destroy their altars and tear down the sacred poles they use in the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbubu b’afɔleɛ bokyea nemɔ bégua, ɛ́mɔbubu bɛ bonima nemɔ, ná ɛ́mɔpepɛ bɛ bosoen Asera dosii nemɔ begua.

english_verse: Don't make treaties with the people there, or you will soon find yourselves worshiping their gods and taking part in their sacrificial meals.
translation_verse: Nnɛne aseɛ ne aso ama yɛ apam, amaa sɛ bɛbɔ adwaman bekodi bɛ mmosoen nemɔ asi, ná bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma bɛ mmosoen nemɔ, ná bɛ nu bie to ye sa frɛ wɔ a, angɔanni ye afɔleɛ ne bie.

english_verse: Don't fail to observe the Festival of Thin Bread in the month of Abib. Obey me and eat bread without yeast for seven days during Abib, because that is the month you left Egypt.
translation_verse: “Di Paanoo Kabrɛdi aluolue ne. Di paanoo kabrɛdi ɛlɛsoo, kyɛbɔ mahyɛ wɔ ne, bosome Abibo nu mmerɛ bɔ mahyɛ ne, ofikyɛ bosome Abibo nu yeɛ etuli wɔ bo fili Misraim ɔ.

english_verse: You can save the life of a first-born donkey by sacrificing a lamb; if you don't, you must break the donkey's neck. You must save every first-born son. Bring an offering every time you come to worship.
translation_verse: Fa boaen ba sesã afunum bamuɛbaa biala, nakoso sɛ anzesã ye de a, ye de bu afunum ne kɔme anu. Wɔ mma nemɔ anu bamuɛbaa bienzua biala, odi kyɛ ɛpɔ ye fi AWURADE berɛ. Nnɛma ebiala fa ye sa mbaen ba me nyunu.

english_verse: Work for six days and rest on the seventh day, even during the seasons for plowing and harvesting.
translation_verse: “Fa elesia yɔ adwuma, nakoso kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne de, de wɔ nwome; sɛ eboosonɛ anaa mmakaammaa telɛ mmerɛ po a, de wɔ nwome.

english_verse: Celebrate the Harvest Festival each spring when you start harvesting your wheat, and celebrate the Festival of Shelters each autumn when you pick your fruit.
translation_verse: “Di Dapɛn Dapɛn aluolue ne, fa atokoɔ bɔ bedi moa bɛte ne yeɛ di ɔ. Di Aleɛ Noa Boaboalɛ aluolue ne wɔ afoɛ ne ayieleɛ.

english_verse: As you advance, I will force the nations out of your land and enlarge your borders. Then no one will try to take your property when you come to worship me these three times each year.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngɔfoa maen maen ngofi wɔ nyunu, ná mama w’aseɛ wɛen so atrɛ. Na sɛ afoɛ biala ɛfo kɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ne nyunu pɛen nza a, sona biala nye ngɔboro w’aseɛ.

english_verse: When you sacrifice an animal on the altar, don't offer bread made with yeast. And don't save any part of the Passover meal for the next day.
translation_verse: “Mogya bɔ ɛfa bɔ afɔleɛ ma me ne, nnɛfa paanoo harewaa boka so; yeɛ naen bɔ ɛfa bɔ Abɔtra aluolue afɔleɛ ne, nnɛma ebie ka ma aleɛ kye so.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must bring the first part of your harvest to the place of worship. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk.
translation_verse: “W’aseɛ so aleɛ paa bɔ ekoli moa kɔpɛ ne, fa brɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ awuro. Nnɛfa abɔngye ba oni nyɔfonesue gua ye nwo to.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to put these laws in writing, as part of his agreement with Israel.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Kyerɛ edwirɛ hemɔ, ofikyɛ edwirɛ hemɔ so yeɛ ngyi bɔ me ne wɔ ne Yisrael yayɛ apam ɔ.”

english_verse: Moses came down from Mount Sinai, carrying the Ten Commandments. His face was shining brightly because the Lord had been speaking to him. But Moses did not know at first that his face was shining.
translation_verse: Mose fili Sinai bokaa ne aso dwuli ase. Mmerɛ bɔ né ódwu fi bokaa ne aso ba ase, bɔ né otira Adanzeɛ nyɔboɛ taataa nyɔ nen, né Mose nze kyɛ ɔnate Nyameɛ bɔ ɔne ye bali ngɔmɔ ne ati, ye nyunu ata ɔ.

english_verse: When Aaron and the others looked at Moses, they saw this, and they were afraid to go near him.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ Aarɔn ne Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa nwuni Mose nen, né ye nyunu ata, na besurole kyɛ bekopingye ye ɔ.

english_verse: Moses called out for Aaron and the leaders to come to him, and he spoke with them.
translation_verse: Nakoso Mose frɛle bɛ, na Aarɔn ne ɛlɔen ne anu mbanyi amukoraati sá wale ye nwo berɛ, na Mose ne bɛ lili ngɔmɔ.

english_verse: Then the rest of the people of Israel gathered around Moses, and he gave them the laws that the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: Nziɛ ye, Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa pingyele ye nwo berɛ, na ɔhane mmeraa dwirɛ amukoraa bɔ AWURADE aha ahyire ye wɔ Sinai bokaa ne aso hyirele bɛ.

english_verse: The face of Moses kept shining, and after he had spoken with the people, he covered his face with a veil.
translation_verse: Na Mose ne bɛ dwudwo yiele nen, ɔfale ngatanyunu bie purole ye nyunu.

english_verse: Moses would always remove the veil when he went into the sacred tent to speak with the Lord. And when he came out, he would tell the people everything the Lord had told him to say.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmerɛ biala, sɛ né Mose ɔ́kɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔne ye bekodwudwo a, né ɔye ngatanyunu ne, kɔpem kyɛ okofi ye nyunu berɛ ɔ. Na mmerɛ biala, ofi berɛ kɔfa ahyɛdeɛ bɔ wahyɛ ye ne nwo amaneɛ bɔ Yisraelfoɛ a,

english_verse: They could see that his face was still shining. So after he had spoken with them, he would put the veil back on and leave it on until the next time he went to speak with the Lord.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ nwu kyɛ Mose nyunu ata. Na ɔyɛ a, Mose sá fa ngatanyunu ne puro ye nyunu kɔpem kyɛ ɔkɔhɔ nu ɔne AWURADE bekoodwudwo ɔ.

english_verse: You have six days in which to do your work. But the seventh day must be dedicated to me, your Lord, as a day of rest. Whoever works on the Sabbath will be put to death.
translation_verse: Elesia yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛyɔ adwuma ɔ, nakoso kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne de, ɔte afofikyẽa krongron ma ɛmɔ, ɔte nwomelelɛ kyẽa bɔkɔɔ ma AWURADE. Na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔyɔ adwuma sɔ kyẽa nen, ɔsɛ kyɛ beku ye.

english_verse: Don't even build a cooking fire at home on the Sabbath. Offerings for the Sacred Tent (Exodus
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔkua see afofikyẽa ne wɔ nekaa biala bɔ ɛmɔte ɔ. Nyianu sua ne anu afɔleɛ nningyein (Ɛksadɔso

english_verse: The women who were good at weaving cloth brought the blue, purple, and red wool and the fine linen they had made.
translation_verse: Na brasua biala bɔ ɔse ɛtena nwo nen, ɔfale nningyein bɔ wafa bibire, koogyan, adaabene, ne gyese wanwo ɔ wale.

english_verse: And he has given them all kinds of artistic skills, including the ability to design and embroider with blue, purple, and red wool and to weave fine linen.
translation_verse: Wama nworɛ ayi bɛ ti anu tɛkyɛ kyɛ bɛfa beli adwii biala. Mekyire: nyɔboɛ dwumvoɛ, bakaa dwumvoɛ, ɔne ɛtena nwonɛ bɔ bɛfa bibire, koogyan, adaabene ne gyese bedi nu adwii ɔ. Bɛte mmenia bɔ bɛkora bedi adwii ahoroɔ amukoraati.

english_verse: If you have any skills, you should use them to help make what I have commanded:
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔ nu biala bɔ ɔse adwii di ne, ɔ́bra ɔɔyɔ bɔ AWURADE ahyɛ ne amukoraa:

english_verse: Moses told the people of Israel that the Lord had said:
translation_verse: Na Mose sele Yisrael ɛlɔen ne amukoraati kyɛ, “Edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE ahyɛ hɔ ɛhe:

english_verse: I will welcome an offering from anyone who wants to give something. You may bring gold, silver, or bronze;
translation_verse: ɛ́mɔkeka bɛ sa ase bɛ́fa ayɛyelɛ nningyein bɛbrɛ AWURADE. Na ebiala bɔ ye kunu sefaa ne, maa ɔfa ayɛyelɛ nningyein hemɔ brɛ AWURADE: esikaa kɔkorɛ, ɛdwetɛ, kɔɔbere;

english_verse: blue, purple, or red wool; fine linen; goat hair;
translation_verse: bibire, koogyan, adaabene, nwera paa, abɔngye nwiaa,

english_verse: tanned ram skin or fine leather; acacia wood;
translation_verse: mmoaen nyii nwomaa bɔ bawura ye ayire kɔkorɛ ɔ, abɔngye nwomaa, bɔsema,

english_verse: olive oil for the lamp; sweet-smelling spices for the oil of dedication and for the incense; or
translation_verse: ngoo bɔ bɛfa begua kanea nu ɔ, nningyein bɔ bɛfa bɛyɔ ɛpopalɛ ngoo, ɔne ayirefona;

english_verse: the sacred chest with its carrying poles, its place of mercy, and the curtain in front of it;
translation_verse: alaka ne ne ye mbuna mɔ, mbata bia ne, mbɛmuɛ tena bɔ onwi berɛ ne;

english_verse: the table with its carrying poles and all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;

english_verse: To keep the breastpiece in place, a blue cord was used to tie the two lower rings on the breastpiece to those on the vest. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Clothes for the Priests (Exodus
translation_verse: Bɛfale nyamaa bibire bɛkyekyele ahone so aguasoɛ nu kaa nemɔ bɛsosɔle ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ nu kaa nemɔ; yiti ɔsosɔle ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ abɔsoɛ bɔ bali adwii bagua nu ne anu, na ahone so aguasoɛ ne amburo amvi ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ ne aso, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose nen. Ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ biemɔ (Ɛksadɔso

translation_verse: Na bɛfale nyamaa bibire bɛkyekyele bɛfa bɛsɔle abotire ne aso anwuro, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose nen. Beyie ɛtena sua ne nwo adwuma (Ɛksadɔso

english_verse: When Moses saw that the people had done everything exactly as the Lord had commanded, he gave them his blessing.
translation_verse: Na Mose neane adwuma ne amukoraa, na onwuni kyɛ bayɔ ye pɛpɛɛpɛ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ne ala. Yiti Mose yirale bɛ.

english_verse: with an opening in the center for the head. The material around the collar was bound so as to keep it from wearing out.
translation_verse: Atee bɔ bɛpakye bɛtole ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ aguasoɛ tendenn ne anu wɔ ye afia ne, ɔte kyɛ ataadeɛ kɔme, na bɛnwone ɛtena bɛsamone atee bɔ bapakye ne noa, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná wande wamva nu ɔ.

english_verse: Along the hem of the robe were woven pomegranates of blue, purple, and red wool with a bell of pure gold between each of them. This robe was to be worn by Aaron when he performed his duties.
translation_verse: Adɔma li berɛ a, né akengaa toa so, adɔma li berɛ a, né akengaa toa so, wɔ ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ aguasoɛ tendenn ne noa bɔ babu ne amukoraa bra yiale, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose nen.

english_verse: the sacred chest with its carrying poles and the place of mercy;
translation_verse: Adanzeɛ alaka ne ne ye mbuna mɔ, ɔne mbata bia ne;

english_verse: So the people of Israel finished making everything the Lord had told Moses to make.
translation_verse: Yiti nyianu ɛtena sua ne nwo adwuma mukoraa, sɔ yeɛ bɛyɔ beyiele bɔkɔɔ ɔ. Yisraelfoɛ yɔle nikyee biala pɛpɛɛpɛ kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose nen.

english_verse: Then they brought it all to Moses: the sacred tent and its equipment, including the hooks, the framework and crossbars, and its posts and stands;
translation_verse: Afei bɛfale nyianu sua ne bɛbrɛle Mose: ɛtena ne ne ye nwo nningyein amukoraa, ye ndɔkorɔ, ye ndaboa mɔ, ye kwatena mɔ, ye bonima mɔ, ɔne ye nyinasoɛ mɔ;

english_verse: the table with all that goes on it, including the sacred bread;
