translation_verse: ɛpoen ne ne ye nwo nningyein amukoraa, paanoo krongron ne;

english_verse: the gold-covered incense altar; the ordination oil and the sweet-smelling incense; the curtain for the entrance to the tent;
translation_verse: sikaa kɔkorɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne, ɛpopalɛ ngoo ne, ayirefona ne, ɔne ɛtena bɔ onwi ɛtena sua anoa nu berɛ ne;

english_verse: the bronze altar for sacrifices with its bronze grating, its carrying poles, and its equipment; the large bronze bowl with its stand;
translation_verse: kɔɔbere afɔleɛ bokyea ne, ye kɔɔbere ngandanganda ne, ye mbuna mɔ ne ye nwo nningyein amukoraa, ayaa ne ne ye nyinasoɛ ne;

english_verse: the curtain with its posts and cords, and its pegs and stands that go around the courtyard; everything needed for the sacred tent;
translation_verse: aluo berɛ mbɛmuɛ ɛtena ne, ye bonima mɔ ne ye nyinasoɛ mɔ, ɛtena bɔ onwi aluo berɛ pambim ne noa ne, ye nyamaa mɔ, ye pɛmbɛen mɔ, nyianu sua ne ne ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ ɛsɔnenɛ nningyein amukoraati;

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: Set up my tent on the first day of the year
translation_verse: “Kyẽa bɔ oli moa wɔ bosome bɔ oli moa ne anu ne, si nyianu ɛtena sua ne.

english_verse: and put the chest with the Ten Commandments behind the inside curtain.
translation_verse: Fa Adanzeɛ alaka ne sie nu, ná fa mbɛmuɛ tena ne nwi alaka ne nyunu.

english_verse: Bring in the table and set on it those things that are made for it. Also bring in the lampstand and attach the lamps to it.
translation_verse: Fa ɛpoen ne sie nu, ná siesie so nningyein bɔ bɛfa besiesie so ne. Fa kanea bakaa ne sie nu, ná fa ye nganea nemɔ siesie so.

english_verse: Then place the gold altar of incense in front of the sacred chest and hang a curtain at the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Sikaa kɔkorɛ afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ bɛyera ɛyɛɛ so ne, fa sie Adanzeɛ alaka ne nyunu, ná fa nyianu sua anoa nu berɛ tena ne nwi berɛ.

english_verse: Set the altar for burning sacrifices in front of the entrance to my tent.
translation_verse: Naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne, fa sie nyianu ɛtena sua anoa nu berɛ;

english_verse: Put the large bronze bowl between the tent and the altar and fill the bowl with water.
translation_verse: fa ayaa ne sie ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ ɔne afɔleɛ bokyea ne b’afia, ná fa nzue gua nu.

english_verse: Surround the tent and the altar with the wall of curtains and hang the curtain that was made for the entrance.
translation_verse: Dé aluo berɛ amukoraati nwo yia, ná fa ɛtena ne nwi aluo berɛ pambim ne anoa nu berɛ.

english_verse: and with the bowl and its stand.
translation_verse: Fa ɛpopalɛ ngoo popa ayaa ne ne ye nyinasoɛ ne, ná te ye nwo.

english_verse: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent and tell them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: “Fa Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ bra ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ, ná fa nzue nwunzinwunzi bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Dress Aaron in the priestly clothes, then use the sacred olive oil to ordain him and dedicate him to me as my priest.
translation_verse: Afei fa ndaadeɛ krongron nemɔ wura Aarɔn, ná fa ɛpopalɛ ngoo ne gua ye ti so, ná te ye nwo ma oli sɔfo so me.

english_verse: Put the priestly robes on Aaron's sons
translation_verse: Fa ye mma mmienzua nemɔ koso bra, ná fa ataadeɛ aguasoɛ wurawura bɛ,

english_verse: And on the first day of the first month of the second year, the sacred tent was set up.
translation_verse: Ye afoɛ nyɔ ne anu, kyẽa bɔ oli moa wɔ bosome bɔ oli moa ne anu, yeɛ besili nyianu sua ne ɔ.

english_verse: The stones with the Ten Commandments written on them were stored in the sacred chest, the place of mercy was put on top of it, and the carrying poles were attached.
translation_verse: Ɔfale Adanzeɛ ne tole apam alaka ne anu, ɔfale mbuna nemɔ wurawurale apam alaka ne anwo, na ɔfale mbata bia ne siele alaka ne aso.

english_verse: The chest was brought into the tent and set behind the curtain in the most holy place. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Ɔfale apam alaka ne wale nyianu sua ne anu, ɔfale mbɛmuɛ tena ne nwini berɛ, na ɔmaa osini Adanzeɛ alaka ne nye, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye nen.

english_verse: The table for the sacred bread was put along the north wall of the holy place,
translation_verse: Ɔfale ɛpoen ne siele ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ, wɔ nyianu sua ne sorɔ dɔ, wɔ mbɛmuɛ tena ne si dɔ.

english_verse: then the lamps were attached to it there in the presence of the Lord.
translation_verse: na ɔfale kanea nemɔ siesiele so wɔ AWURADE nyunu, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye nen.

english_verse: The gold incense altar was set up in front of the curtain,
translation_verse: Ɔfale sikaa kɔkorɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne siele ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ, wɔ mbɛmuɛ tena ne nyunu,

english_verse: and sweet-smelling incense was burned on it. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: na ɔyerale ayirefona wɔ so, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye nen.

english_verse: The curtain was hung at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Asa koso, ɔfale nyianu sua anoa nu berɛ tena ne nwini berɛ.

english_verse: Then the altar for offering sacrifices was put in front of the tent, and animal sacrifices and gifts of grain were offered there.
translation_verse: Naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne, ɔfa siele nyianu ɛtena sua anoa nu berɛ, na ɔbɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne aleɛ afɔleɛ wɔ so, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye nen.

english_verse: The large bronze bowl was placed between the altar and the entrance to the tent. It was filled with water,
translation_verse: Ɔfale ayaa ne siele ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ ɔne afɔleɛ bokyea ne b’afia, na ɔfale nzue bɔ bɛkɔfa bekonwunzi bɛ nwo ɔ guale nu.

english_verse: then Moses and Aaron, together with Aaron's sons, washed their hands and feet.
translation_verse: Na sɔ nzue ne yeɛ Mose ne Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua ne bɛfa benwunzi bɛ sa ne bɛ gya nwo ɔ.

english_verse: In fact, they washed each time before entering the tent or offering sacrifices at the altar. These things were done exactly as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ biala sɛ né bɛ́kɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ, anaakyɛ bépingye afɔleɛ bokyea ne a, benwunzi bɛ nwo, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose nen.

english_verse: Suddenly the sacred tent was covered by a thick cloud and filled with the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Afei munungum ne ɔɔkatale ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne aso, na AWURADE animnyam yili nyianu sua ne tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: Whenever the cloud moved from the tent, the people would break camp and follow;
translation_verse: Na Yisraelfoɛ ateetulɛ ne anu amukoraa, sɛ munungum ne fi nyianu sua ne aso ɔkɔ anwuro a, né bɛ koso batu bɛ bo bahɔ moa;

english_verse: then they would set up camp and stay there, until it moved again.
translation_verse: nakoso sɛ munungum ne amvi so wangɔ anwuro de a, ye de bendu bɛ bo kɔpem kyẽa bɔ ɔkɔhɔ anwuro ɔ.

english_verse: No matter where the people traveled, the Lord was with them. Each day his cloud was over the tent, and each night a fire could be seen in the cloud.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ b’ateetulɛ ne anu amukoraa, AWURADE munungum ne munduni nyianu sua ne aso alehyeleɛ nu, yeɛ alesaleɛ nu koso, né see ogye wɔ munungum ne anu bɔ Yisrael awuro ama mukoraa bɛ nye tua ɔ.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head, and I will accept the animal as a sacrifice for taking away your sins.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔfa ye sa to naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ kaka ne ati afia, ná Nyameɛ kole kɔto nu maa ɔkɔfa kɔyɛ ye ti mbata.

english_verse: After the bull is killed in my presence, some priests from Aaron's family will offer its blood to me by splattering it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Na afei ohu nandwie nyii ne wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ná Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte asɔfo ne, bɛ́fa mogya ne, ná béhwie bégua afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ ogyi ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ ne anwo bɛ́bra béyia.

english_verse: Skin the bull and cut it up,
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ obia naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ná ɔpepɛ nu ahuronzi ahuronzi.

english_verse: while the priests pile wood on the altar fire to make it start blazing.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ, odi kyɛ bɛfa see begua afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso ná bɛhyehyɛ eyein begua see ne aso.

english_verse: Wash the bull's insides and hind legs, so the priests can lay them on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. A priest will then send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Nakoso ye kunu nningyein ne ye gya nemɔ de, odi kyɛ bɛfa nzue benwunzi bɛ nwo. Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne yera ye mukoraati wɔ see ne aso fa yɛ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ; ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE ná ɔbo ye fona ɔ.

english_verse: If you sacrifice a ram or a goat, it must not have anything wrong with it.
translation_verse: “Akyɛdeɛ bɔ sona ne ɔbaafa bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, sɛ ofi mmoaen kure anaa mbɔngye kure ne anu a, odi kyɛ ɔfa nyii bɔ ollili nnɛen biala ɔ.

english_verse: Lead the animal to the north side of the altar, where it is to be killed in my presence. Then some of the priests will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ oku ye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne sorɔ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ná Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte asɔfo ne, bɛ́fa ye mogya ne, ná béhwie bégua afɔleɛ bokyea ne nwo bɛ́bra béyia.

english_verse: Cut up the animal and wash its insides and hind legs. A priest will put these parts on the altar with the head, the fat, and the rest of the animal. Then he will send all of it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Nakoso ye kunu nningyein ne ye gya ne de, ɔ́fa nzue ónwunzi bɛ nwo. Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne, ɔfa ye mukoraati ɔyera ye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso. Ɔte naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ; ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE ná ɔbo ye fona ɔ.

english_verse: If you offer a bird for this kind of sacrifice, it must be a dove or a pigeon.
translation_verse: “Sɛ nnomaa yeɛ ɔfa bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE a, ye de odi kyɛ ɔma ye afɔleɛ ne yɛ mmorɔma anaa aborɔnoma buruwa.

english_verse: A priest will take the bird to the bronze altar, where he will wring its neck and put its head on the fire. Then he will drain out its blood on one side of the altar,
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔfa ye ba afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo, ókisa ye kɔme ná ɔ́yera ye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso, ná ohwi ye mogya ne ogua afɔleɛ bokyea ne ngyɛnu.

english_verse: remove the bird's craw with what is in it, and throw them on the ash heap at the east side of the altar.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔye ye komvi abo lolaa ne, ɔne bɔ ɔwɔ nu ne ná ógyi gua afɔleɛ bokyea ne ngyɛnu wɔ ye eyia afiteleɛ, nekaa bɔ bɛfa nzoen begua ne.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to give thanks to me, you must use only your finest flour. Put it in a dish, sprinkle olive oil and incense on the flour,
translation_verse: “Sɛ ebie fa aburoo afɔleɛ brɛ AWURADE a, odi kyɛ ye afɔleɛ ne yɛ esam paa; óhwie ngoo ógua so, ɔ́fa ɛyɛɛ gua so,

english_verse: and take it to the priests from Aaron's family. One of them will scoop up the incense together with a handful of the flour and oil. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay this part on the bronze altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: ná ɔ́fa brɛ Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte asɔfo ne. Odi kyɛ ɔsa esam paa bɔ ngoo ne ɛyɛɛ fra ye ne ye sa bum ko, ná ɔsɔfo ne ɔ́yera kãa bɔ wasa ne wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso; ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE ná ɔbo ye fona ɔ.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Aburoo afɔleɛ ne ngaa ne kɔyɛ Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ deɛ; afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE ne, ɛhe yeɛ ɔte krongron paa ɔ.

english_verse: If you bake bread in an oven for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour, but without any yeast. You may make the flour into a loaf mixed with olive oil, or you may make it into thin wafers and brush them with oil.
translation_verse: “Sɛ w’afɔleɛ ne te aburoo afɔleɛ bɔ bato ye foonoo nu a, odi kyɛ ɛfa esam paa: taterɛ kabrɛdi bɔ bafa ngoo bafete ɔ, anaakyɛ apiti kabrɛdi bɔ bafa ngoo bafa ye nwo ɔ.

english_verse: If you cook bread in a shallow pan for this sacrifice, use only your finest flour. Mix it with olive oil, but do not use any yeast.
translation_verse: Na sɛ w’afɔleɛ ne te aburoo afɔleɛ bɔ bahye ye kyɛnzee nu a, odi kyɛ esam kabrɛdi paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye, yeɛ bɛfa bɛkye ɔ;

english_verse: Then break the bread into small pieces and sprinkle them with oil.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ebubu nu mmaa mmaa ná éhwie ngoo gua so; ɔte aburoo afɔleɛ.

english_verse: If you cook your bread in a pan with a lid on it, you must also use the finest flour mixed with oil.
translation_verse: Na sɛ w’afɔleɛ ne te aburoo afɔleɛ bɔ bato ye turonzemaa nu a, odi kyɛ esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye, yeɛ bɛfa bɛyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You may prepare sacrifices to give thanks in any of these three ways. Bring your sacrifice to a priest, and he will take it to the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Fa aburoo afɔleɛ bɔ bafa sɔ nningyein nemɔ bayɔ brɛ AWURADE; na sɛ ɛfa ma ɔsɔfo ne a, ye koso ɔkɔfa kɔhɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso.

english_verse: Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, the priest will lay part of it on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne sa aburoo afɔleɛ ne bie fa yɛ ngayeɛ nikye, ná ɔyera ye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso; ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE ná ɔbo ye fona ɔ.

english_verse: The rest of this sacrifice is for the priests; it is very holy because it was offered to me.
translation_verse: Aburoo afɔleɛ ne ngaa ne, ɔte Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ deɛ; afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE ne, ɛhe yeɛ ɔte krongron paa ɔ.

english_verse: Yeast and honey must never be burned on the altar, so don't ever mix either of these in a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: “Aburoo afɔleɛ biala bɔ ɛmɔbɔ bɛma AWURADE ne, onni kyɛ ɛmɔfa mɔle harewaa bɛbɔ; ofikyɛ onni kyɛ ɛmɔfa mɔle harewaa anaa woɛ bɛbɔ see so afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE.

english_verse: You may offer either of them separately, when you present the first part of your harvest to me, but they must never be burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa sɔ nningyein ye bɛ́brɛ AWURADE kyɛ fieso nningyein bɔ oli moa ɔ, nakoso nnɛma ɛmɔyera bɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso kyɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo fona ɔ.

english_verse: Salt is offered when you make an agreement with me, so sprinkle salt on these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔwura ɛmɔ aburoo afɔleɛ amukoraati ngyee; ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ AWURADE apam ngyee ne, nnɛmɔma ɔpa ɛmɔ aburoo afɔleɛ ne anu; ɛ́mɔfa ngyee bɛboka ɛmɔ afɔleɛ amukoraa so.

english_verse: Freshly cut grain, either roasted or coarsely ground, must be used when you offer the first part of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛmɔfa aburoo bɔ bekoli moa bekobu ne bie bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE a, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa aburoo monɛ bɔ bekoli moa bekobu ne bie, bɔ bahye ye see so ná basi ɔ.

english_verse: You must mix in some olive oil and put incense on top, because this is a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa ngoo bégua so, ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛyɛɛ koso bégua so; ɔte aburoo afɔleɛ.

english_verse: A priest will sprinkle all of the incense and some of the grain and oil on the altar and send them up in smoke to show that the whole offering belongs to me.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo ne kɔyera aburoo bɔ basi, ná bafa ngoo ne ɛyɛɛ ne amukoraa bafra ye ne bie kyɛ ngayeɛ nikye; ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: When you offer sacrifices to ask my blessing, you may offer either a bull or a cow, but there must be nothing wrong with the animal.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ebie afɔleɛ te asomdwee afɔleɛ a, sɛ ɔfa nandwie nyii anaa beleɛ bɔ ofi nandwie kure ne anu a, odi kyɛ ɔfa bɔ ollili nnɛen ɔ ɔbɔ afɔleɛ ne wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: Lead it to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay your hand on its head, and have it killed there. A priest from Aaron's family will splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔfa ye sa to kaka ne ti afia, ná oku ye wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ; na Aarɔn mma mmienzua bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte asɔfo ne, odi kyɛ bɛfa mogya ne behwie begua afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo bɛbra beyia.

english_verse: Some of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me, together with the sacrifice that is offered to please me.
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ, bɛfa begua naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ogua see so wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea so ne aso, ná bɛyera ye; ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE ná ɔbo ye fona ɔ.

english_verse: Instead of a bull or a cow, you may offer any sheep or goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: “Sɛ asomdwee afɔleɛ bɔ ɛbɔ ma AWURADE ne fi mmoaen kure ne anu a, nyii oo, beleɛ oo, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ kaka bɔ ollili nnɛen biala ɔ.

english_verse: If you offer a sheep, you must present it to me at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔ afɔleɛ ne te boaen ba a, ye de odi kyɛ ɛfa ba AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛfa wɔ sa to kaka ne ti afia ná eku ye wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anyunu, ná Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ béhwie ye mogya ne bégua afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo bɛ́bra béyia.

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ye saa nyɔ ne ɔne bɛ nwo loe bɔ ɔwɔ ye sisia ne anu ne, ɔne ye boɛ ne bie bɔ ɛkɔye kɔboka saa nemɔ aso ne.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering for me.
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔyera ye afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso maa ɔyɛ aleɛ bɔ bɛyera ye see so bɛma AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: If you offer a goat, you must also present it to me
translation_verse: “Sɛ w’afɔleɛ ne te abɔngye a, odi kyɛ ɛfa ba AWURADE nyunu,

english_verse: at the entrance to the sacred tent. Lay your hand on its head and have it killed there. A priest will then splatter its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: odi kyɛ ɛfa wɔ sa to kaka ne ti afia, ná beku ye wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anyunu, na odi kyɛ Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ behwie mogya ne begua afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo bɛbra beyia.

english_verse: One of the priests will put these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke as a food offering with a smell that pleases me. All fat belongs to me.
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔyera bɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso maa ɔyɛ aleɛ bɔ bɛyera ye see so ná bɔ ɔbo fona ɔ. Ɛloe ne amukoraa te AWURADE deɛ.

english_verse: So you and your descendants must never eat any fat or any blood, not even in the privacy of your own homes. This law will never change.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe kɔyɛ ahyɛdeɛ afebɔɔ kɔma ɛmɔ wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraati nu, wɔ nekaa biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔtena ɔ, kyɛ nnɛma ɛmɔdi ɛloe anaa mogya.”

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔfa ye sa mmɛseka ɔbɔ mogya ne anu ná ɔfa bie pete pɛen nzoo, AWURADE nyunu, wɔ nekaa krongron mbɛmuɛ tena ne anyunu.

english_verse: This is a sacrifice for sin. So he will lay his hand on the animal's head, before having it killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa ye sa to abɔngye ne ti afia, ná oku kaka ne wɔ nekaa bɔ yeɛ beku naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ngaka wɔ AWURADE nyunu ne; ɔte bɔne nwo afɔleɛ.

english_verse: Then a priest will dip a finger in the blood; he will smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔfa ye sa mmɛseka ɔbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ mogya ne anu ná ɔfa kekã naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bokyea mmɛen nemɔ. Mogya ne ngaa ne, odi kyɛ ohwie gua afɔleɛ bokyea ne abo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Offer a sacrifice to ask forgiveness when you sin by accidentally doing something I have told you not to do. When the High Priest Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, ‘Nningyein bɔ AWURADE akanzo ɛmɔ kyɛ nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ ne, sɛ ebie ɔyɔ nu biala, bɔ sɔ sona ne ɔnze kyɛ wayɔ bɔne a,

english_verse: When the high priest sins, he makes everyone else guilty too. And so, he must sacrifice a young bull that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: sɛ ɔsɔfo bɔ bapopa ye ngoo yeɛ ɔyɔ bɔne, ná ɔnate so ɔfa foɛbualɛ ba maen ne aso a, ɔnate bɔne bɔ wayɔ ne ati, odi kyɛ ɔfa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma bɔ ollili nnɛen biala ɔ ɔbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ma AWURADE.

english_verse: The priest will lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent, lay his hand on its head, and kill it there.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔfa nandwie nyii ne ɔba AWURADE nyunu wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ. Odi kyɛ ɔfa ye sa to nandwie ne ti so, ná oku nandwie ne wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: He will take a bowl of the blood inside the tent,
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo bɔ bapopa ye ngoo ne, ɔfa nandwie ne mogya ne bie ná ɔfa ba ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu;

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he will smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛɛ fona afɔleɛ bokyea mmɛen mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa mogya ne bie oguagua so wɔ AWURADE nyunu. Na naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ ɔwɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ ne, odi kyɛ ohwie nandwie mogya ne ngaa ne ogua ye bo.

english_verse: The skin and flesh of the bull, together with its legs, insides, and the food still in its stomach, are to be taken outside the camp and burned on a wood fire near the ash heap. When the Whole Nation Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: kaka ne mumua ne, odi kyɛ ɔsoa kɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi nekaa bɔ berɛ te sannwuu, nekaa bɔ bɛto nzoen begua ɔ, ná ɔ́yera ye wɔ see so. Nekaa bɔ bɛto nzoen begua ne yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔyera ye ɔ.

english_verse: Once you realize what has happened, you must sacrifice a young bull to ask my forgiveness. Lead the bull to the entrance of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: sɛ bɔne bɔ bayɔ ne batɔ dwaa a, odi kyɛ maen ne fa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma babɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ, na ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛfa bɛba ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ.

english_verse: where your tribal leaders will lay their hands on its head, before having it killed in my presence.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ maen mbanyi nemɔ, bɛfa bɛ sa bɛto nandwie ne ti afia wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ná beku nandwie ne wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: The priest will take a bowl of the animal's blood inside the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo bɔ bapopa ye ngoo ne, ɔfa nandwie nyii mogya ne bie ba ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu,

english_verse: dip a finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred chest behind the curtain.
translation_verse: na ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa ye sa mmɛseka bɔ mogya ne anu na ɔpete ye pɛen nzoo, AWURADE nyunu wɔ ɛtena bɔ onwi sua ne anoa ne nyunu.

english_verse: Then, in my presence, he must smear some of the blood on each of the four corners of the incense altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the bronze altar near the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: Afɔleɛ bokyea mmɛen mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ AWURADE nyunu wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔfa mogya ne bie ogua so. Na naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne bɔ ɔwɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ ne de, odi kyɛ ohwie mogya ne ngaa ne gua ye bo.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove the fat from the bull and send it up in smoke on the altar. Finally, he will burn its remains outside the camp, just as he did with the other bull. By this sacrifice the sin of the whole nation will be forgiven. When a Tribal Leader Sins The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ ɔsoa nandwie nyii ne kɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ, ná ɔ́yera ye kyɛbɔ ɔyerale nandwie nyii bɔ oli moa ne; ɔte bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ma maen ne.

english_verse: As soon as the leader realizes what has happened, he must sacrifice a goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: ná sɛ bɛfa bɔne bɔ yeɛ wayɔ ne bɛto ye nyunu a, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa abɔngye nyii bɔ ollili nnɛen biala ɔ ɔbabɔ afɔleɛ.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔfa ye sa mmɛseka bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ mogya ne anu ná ɔfa kekã naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bokyea mmɛen nemɔ. Mogya ne ngaa ne, odi kyɛ ohwie ogua naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne abo.

english_verse: Then he must send all of the fat up in smoke, just as he does when a sacrifice is offered to ask my blessing. By this sacrifice the leader's sin will be forgiven. When Ordinary People Sin The Lord said:
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔyera ye loe ne amu wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso kyɛbɔ ɔyerale asomdwee afɔleɛ ɛloe nen. Ɔsɔfo ne kɔpata wɔ sona ne bɔne nwo kɔma ye, na Nyameɛ kɔfa ye bɔne kɔhyɛ ye.

english_verse: When any of you ordinary people disobey me without meaning to, you are still guilty.
translation_verse: “‘Nningyein bɔ AWURADE akanzo ɛmɔ kyɛ nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ ne, sɛ maen baa bie ɔyɔ nu biala, bɔ sɔ sona ne ɔnze kyɛ wayɔ bɔne, maa ɔnate so odi fɔ,

english_verse: As soon as you realize what you have done, you must sacrifice a female goat that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: ná sɛ bɛfa bɔne bɔ yeɛ wayɔ ne bɛto ye nyunu a, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa abɔngye beleɛ bɔ ollili nnɛen biala ɔ ɔbabɔ afɔleɛ, ɔnate bɔne bɔ wayɔ ne ati.

english_verse: Lead the goat to the north side of the bronze altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa ye sa to bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ne ti afia, ná oku ye wɔ nekaa bɔ bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ nen.

english_verse: After this, the priest will remove all of the fat, just as he does when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. The priest will then send the fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. This animal is sacrificed so that I will forgive you ordinary people when you sin.
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ ɔye ye loe ne amu, kyɛbɔ bɛye ɛloe befi asomdwee afɔleɛ nu ne, na ɔsɔfo ne ɔ́yera ye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso maa ɔ́yɛ nikyee bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ. Ɔsɔfo ne kɔpata kɔma ye, na Nyameɛ kɔfa ye bɔne kɔhyɛ ye.

english_verse: If you offer a lamb instead of a goat as a sacrifice for sin, it must be a female that has nothing wrong with it.
translation_verse: “Sɛ boaen yeɛ ɔfa babɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ a, odi kyɛ ɔfa beleɛ bɔ ollili nnɛen biala ɔ.

english_verse: Lead the lamb to the altar and lay your hand on its head, before having it killed.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔfa ye sa to bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ne ti afia, ná oku ye fa yɛ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ wɔ nekaa bɔ yeɛ beku naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne.

english_verse: The priest will dip a finger in the blood, smear some of it on each of the four corners of the altar, and pour out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔfa ye sa mmɛseka bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ mogya ne anu ná ɔfa kekã naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne mmɛen nemɔ, ná mogya ne ngaa ne, óhwie ógua afɔleɛ bokyea ne abo.

english_verse: After this, all of the fat must be removed, just as when an animal is sacrificed to ask my blessing. Then the priest will send it up in smoke to me, together with a food offering, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ ɔye ye loe ne amukoraati, kyɛbɔ bɛye asomdwee afɔleɛ boaen nu loe ne, na odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔfa gua afɔleɛ bɔ bafa babrɛ AWURADE ne aso, ná ɔyera ye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso; na ɔsɔfo ne kɔpata kɔma ye wɔ bɔne bɔ wayɔ ne anwo, na Nyameɛ kɔfa ye bɔne kɔhyɛ ye.

english_verse: You are guilty if you find out that you have accidentally touched anything unclean that comes from a human body.
translation_verse: Anaa sɛ ye nwo ka nikyee fiɛ biala bɔ ofi kuro sona nu a: nikyee biala bɔ ogua kuro sona nwo fiɛ, ná sɛ ɔnze po a, sɛ onya nwu ye a, okoli fɔ.

english_verse: As soon as you discover that you have committed any of these sins, you must confess what you have done.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie nwu kyɛ odi ɛhemɔ biala nwo fɔ a, odi kyɛ ɔka sɔ bɔne bɔ wayɔ ne wɔ badwa nu,

english_verse: Then you must bring a female sheep or goat to me as the price for your sin. A priest will sacrifice the animal, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: ná ɔ́fa ye foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ ɔbrɛ AWURADE, ɔnate bɔne bɔ wayɔ ne ati. Odi kyɛ ɔfa boaen beleɛ anaa abɔngye beleɛ ɔbɔ foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ, na ɔsɔfo ne kɔsrɛ mbata kɔma ye, ɔnate ye bɔne ti.

english_verse: Give both birds to the priest, who will offer one as a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness. He will wring its neck without tearing off its head,
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔfa ngaka nemɔ ɔbrɛ ɔsɔfo ne, ná ɔsɔfo ne oli moa ɔfa ko ne ɔbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ, ókisa ye kɔme, nakoso nnɛmaa ɔte ye ti fi so.

english_verse: splatter some of its blood on one side of the bronze altar, and drain out the rest at the foot of the altar.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔfa bɔne nwo afɔleɛ mogya ne bie ɔpete afɔleɛ bokyea ne ngyɛnu, na mogya ne ngaa ne de, ohwi ogua afɔleɛ bokyea ne abo; ɔte bɔne nwo afɔleɛ.

english_verse: If you are so poor that you cannot afford doves or pigeons, you may bring one kilogram of your finest flour. This is a sacrifice to ask my forgiveness, so don't sprinkle olive oil or sweet-smelling incense on it.
translation_verse: “Nakoso sɛ ye nwo ngɔso mmorɔma nyɔ anaakyɛ mmorɔnoma buruwa nyɔ so a, ye de ɔnate bɔne bɔ wayɔ ne ati, ɔ́fa aburoo esam paa olonka ko ɔɔbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ. Nnɛmaa ɔfa ngoo anaa ɛyɛɛ gua so, ofikyɛ ɔte bɔne nwo afɔleɛ.

english_verse: Give the flour to a priest, who will scoop up a handful and send it up in smoke together with the other offerings. This is a reminder that all of the flour belongs to me.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔfa brɛ ɔsɔfo ne, ná ɔsɔfo ne ɔsa ye sa bum ko fa yɛ ngayeɛ nikye ogua afɔleɛ ne aso, ná ɔfa see yera ye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso ɔma AWURADE; ɔte bɔne nwo afɔleɛ.

english_verse: By offering this sacrifice, the priest pays the price for any of these sins you may have committed. The priest gets to keep the rest of the flour, just as he does with grain sacrifices. Sacrifices To Make Things Right (Leviticus
translation_verse: Yiti ɔsɔfo ne kɔpata kɔma ye wɔ bɔne bɔ wayɔ wɔ ɛhemɔ biala nu ɔ, na Nyameɛ kɔfa ye bɔne kɔhyɛ ye. Afɔleɛ ne ngaa ne koso kɔyɛ ɔsɔfo ne deɛ, kyɛ aburoo afɔleɛ ne ala. Foɛlilɛ nwo afɔleɛ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do to make things right when they find out they have cheated the Lord without meaning to: If this happens, you must either sacrifice a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay the price of a ram with the official money used by the priests.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛmɔ nu bie yɔ bɔne, bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne fa AWURADE nningyein krongron ne anu biala nwo, ná sɛ sɔ sona ne ɔnze kyɛ wayɔ bɔne a, odi kyɛ ɔfa mmoaen kure ne anu boaen nyii ko bɔ ollili nnɛen biala ɔ ɔbɔ foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE. Pɛ ye nyɔboɛ ne wɔ sikaa nu, kyɛbɔ nekaa krongron berɛ sekel te ɔ; ɔte foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ.

english_verse: The next morning you will dress in your priestly clothes, including your linen underwear. Then clean away the ashes left by the sacrifices and pile them beside the altar.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne wura ye nwera ataadeɛ ne, ná ówura ye nwera pieto ne ɔ́fa kata ye nwo. Naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ bayera ye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso ne, odi kyɛ ɔsesa ye nzoen ɔfa gua afɔleɛ bokyea ne ngyɛnu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses what the people must do when they commit other sins against the Lord: You have sinned if you rob or cheat someone, if you keep back money or valuables left in your care, or if you find something and claim not to have it.
translation_verse: anaakyɛ wanwu ye nikyee bɔ yeɛ wamini nakoso wanga nahorɛ, anaakyɛ ɔta ndaen fa kata nahorɛ so, anaakyɛ bɔne bɔ mmenia yɔ ne anu biala,

english_verse: and told him what sacrifices the priests must offer on the morning and evening of the day they are ordained: It is the same as the regular morning and evening sacrifices—half a kilogram of flour
translation_verse: “Kyẽa bɔ bɛkɔpopa Aarɔn ngoo ne, afɔleɛ bɔ ɔne ye mma mmienzua mɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛbɔ bɛma AWURADE ɛhe: daa biala aburoo afɔleɛ bɔ ɔte esam paa olonka ko; odi kyɛ bɛfa ye bue ngyerɛmɔ yeɛ ye bue nɔsoa.

english_verse: In addition, you must either bring to the priest a ram that has nothing wrong with it or else pay him for one. The priest will then offer it as a sacrifice to make things right, and you will be forgiven for what you did wrong. Daily Sacrifices (Exodus
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo ne kɔpata kɔma ye wɔ AWURADE nyunu, na Nyameɛ kɔfa ye bɔne kɔhyɛ ye wɔ nikyee biala bɔ sona yɔ a, ɔmaa odi fɔ ne anwo.” Naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy, and only the priests may have any part of it.
translation_verse: Bienzua biala bɔ ofi asɔfokure ne anu ne, ɔkora odi bie; ɔte nikyee krongron paa.

english_verse: If the meat was cooked in a clay pot, the pot must be destroyed, but if it was cooked in a bronze pot, the pot must be scrubbed and rinsed with water.
translation_verse: Na kukue bɔ bɛkɔto ye wɔ nu ne, odi kyɛ bɛbɔ ye ɔ, nakoso sɛ bɛto ye wɔ dadesɛn nu de a, odi kyɛ betwi nu ná bɛfa nzue besale nu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to tell Aaron and his sons how to offer the daily sacrifices that are sent up in smoke to please the Lord: You must put the animal for the sacrifice on the altar in the evening and let it stay there all night. But make sure the fire keeps burning.
translation_verse: “Hyɛ Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ kyɛ, ‘Naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ nwo nhyehyɛleɛ ɛhe: Odi kyɛ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ɔda agyegyemvia wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso kɔngɔen ne amukoraa maa okodwu ngyerɛmɔ, ná odi kyɛ see ne kɔ so gye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso.

english_verse: Change into your everyday clothes, take the ashes outside the camp, and pile them in the special place.
translation_verse: Afei odi kyɛ ɔye ye ndaadeɛ ne, ná owura ndaadeɛ foforɛ, ná ɔsoa nzoen ne kɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ nekaa bɔ berɛ te sannwuu ɔ.

english_verse: The fire must never go out, so put wood on it each morning. After this, you are to lay an animal on the altar next to the fat that you sacrifice to ask my blessing. Then send it all up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔma see ne kɔ so gye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso; onni kyɛ onnua ɔ. Ɔsɔfo ne ɔ́fa eyein gua nu ngyerɛmɔ biala, ɔ́hyehyɛ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne wɔ so, ná ɔyera asomdwee afɔleɛ loe ne wɔ so.

english_verse: The altar fire must always be kept burning—it must never go out. Sacrifices To Give Thanks to the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ see ne gye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso daa; onni kyɛ onnua ɔ. Aburoo afɔleɛ

english_verse: When someone offers a sacrifice to give thanks to me, the priests from Aaron's family must bring it to the front of the bronze altar,
translation_verse: “Aburoo afɔleɛ ne nwo nhyehyɛleɛ ɛhe: Odi kyɛ Aarɔn boso ama nemɔ bɛbɔ ye wɔ AWURADE nyunu wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne anyunu.

english_verse: where one of them will scoop up a handful of the flour and oil, together with all the incense on it. Then, to show that the whole offering belongs to me, he will lay all of this on the altar and send it up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Aburoo afɔleɛ esam paa ɔne ngoo ne, ɔne ɛyɛɛ amukoraa bɔ ogua aburoo afɔleɛ ne aso ne, odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne sa ye sa bum ko, ná ɔyera ye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso maa ɔyɛ ngayeɛ nikye bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ.

english_verse: The rest of it is to be baked without yeast and eaten by the priests in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent. This bread is very holy, just like the sacrifices for sin or the sacrifices for making things right, and I have given this part to the priests from what is offered to me on the altar.
translation_verse: Nnɛmaa bɛfa mɔle harewaa bɛfra ye bɛto; afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma me ne, bɛ deɛ bɔ mafa mama bɛ hɔ ɛne. Ɔte krongron paa kyɛ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ne foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ ala.

english_verse: Only the men in Aaron's family are allowed to eat this bread, and they must go through a ceremony to be made holy before touching it. This law will never change. When Priests Are Ordained
translation_verse: Aarɔn bosoniɛ baa bienzua biala, oli AWURADE afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE ne bie, kyɛbɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ daa wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraati nu ne; sona anaa nikyee biala bɔ ɔkɔfa ye nwo kɔha sɔ afɔleɛ nemɔ ne, ɔkɔyɛ krongron.

english_verse: The Lord spoke to Moses
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: mixed with olive oil and cooked in a shallow pan. The bread must then be crumbled into small pieces and sent up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛfa ngoo bɛkye ye kyɛnzee nu; fora ye yé ná toto ye mmaa mmaa kyɛ aburoo afɔleɛ, ná fa bɔ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: how the priests from Aaron's family were to offer the sacrifice for sin: This sacrifice is very sacred, and the animal must be killed in my presence at the north side of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ kyɛ, ‘Bɔne nwo afɔleɛ nwo nhyehyɛleɛ ɛhe: Nekaa bɔ beku naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ngaka nemɔ ne, berɛ yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ beku bɔne nwo afɔleɛ kaka ne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ; ɔte krongron paa.

english_verse: The priest who offers this sacrifice must eat it in the sacred courtyard of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo bɔ ɔkɔbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ne yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ odi ɔ; óli ye wɔ nekaa bɔ ɔte krongron ɔ, wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ aluo berɛ.

english_verse: and anyone or anything that touches the meat will be holy. If any of the animal's blood is splattered on the clothes of the priest, they must be washed in a holy place.
translation_verse: Nikyee biala bɔ ɔkɔfa ye nwo kɔha ye ne, ɔkɔyɛ krongron, na sɛ ye mogya ne bie bɔ pete ataadeɛ nu a, odi kyɛ ɛpo nekaa bɔ wabɔ wapete ne wɔ nekaa bɔ yeɛ ɔte krongron ɔ.

english_verse: None of the meat may be eaten from the sacrifices for sin that require blood to be brought into the sacred tent. These sacrifices must be completely burned.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɔne nwo afɔleɛ biala bɔ bafa ye mogya ne bie bawa ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ baayɛ mbata wɔ nekaa krongron ne anu ne de, onni kyɛ ebiala di ɔ; odi kyɛ bɛfa see bɛyera ye.

english_verse: One of the priests will lay these pieces on the altar and send them up in smoke to me.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo ne kɔyera bɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso kyɛ afɔleɛ bɔ bɛyera ye see so bɛma AWURADE ɔ; ɔte foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ.

english_verse: Give me one loaf or wafer from each of these four kinds of bread, after which they will belong to the priest who splattered the blood against the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛye paanoo ko fi afɔleɛ ne biala nu maa ɔyɛ akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɛfa brɛ AWURADE ɔ; ɔsɔfo bɔ ohwie asomdwee afɔleɛ mogya ne gua ne, ɔte ye deɛ.

english_verse: Don't eat any of the meat that has touched something unclean. Instead, burn it. The rest of the meat may be eaten by anyone who is clean and acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Naen bɔ ɔkɔha nikyee biala bɔ ye nwo nde ne, onni kyɛ bedi; odi kyɛ bɛfa see bɛyera ye. Naen ne de, ebiala bɔ ye nwo te ne kora di bie,

english_verse: The sacrifice to make things right is very sacred.
translation_verse: “Foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ nwo nhyehyɛleɛ ɛhe: ɔte krongron paa.

english_verse: The animal must be killed in the same place where the sacrifice to please me is killed, and the animal's blood must be splattered against the four sides of the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Nekaa bɔ beku naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ngaka ne, berɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ beku foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ kaka ne ɔ, na odi kyɛ behwie ye mogya ne begua afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo bɛbra beyia.

english_verse: Offer all of the animal's fat, including the fat on its tail and on its insides,
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛfa ye loe ne amukoraa bɛbɔ afɔleɛ, ye dua pue ɔne ɛloe bɔ wato wafa ye kunu nningyein anwo ne,

english_verse: as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat.
translation_verse: ɔne ye saa nyɔ ne ɔne bɛ nwo loe bɔ ɔwɔ ye sisia ne anu ne, ɔne ye boɛ ne bie bɔ odi kyɛ ɔye boka ye saa nemɔ aso ne.

english_verse: This sacrifice for making things right is very holy. Only the priests may eat it, and they must eat it in a holy place.
translation_verse: Bienzua biala bɔ ɔwɔ asɔfo abusua kure ne anu ne, ɔkora di bie; odi kyɛ bedi ye wɔ nekaa bɔ ɔte krongron ɔ; ɔte krongron paa.

english_verse: The ceremony for this sacrifice and the one for sin are the same, and the meat may be eaten only by the priest who performs this ceremony of forgiveness.
translation_verse: “Foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ ne, ɔte kyɛ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ne ala, ofikyɛ bɛ nwo nhyehyɛleɛ te ko; naen ne te ɔsɔfo bɔ ɔkɔbɔ sɔ afɔleɛ ne deɛ.

english_verse: In fact, the priest who offers a sacrifice to please me may keep the skin of the animal,
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo bɔ ɔkɔbɔ ebie naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ kɔma ye ne, kaka ne bɔ wafa wabɔ afɔleɛ ne nwomaa te ye deɛ.

english_verse: just as he may eat the bread from a sacrifice to give thanks to me.
translation_verse: Aburoo afɔleɛ biala bɔ bato ye foonoo nu, ɔne bɔ bato ye turonzemaa nu, anaa kyɛnzee nu ne biala kɔyɛ ɔsɔfo bɔ ɔkɔbɔ afɔleɛ ne deɛ.

english_verse: All other grain sacrifices—with or without olive oil in them—are to be divided equally among the priests of Aaron's family. Sacrifices To Ask the Lord's Blessing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Aburoo afɔleɛ biala, kyɛ bafa ngoo bafra ye oo, anaakyɛ ɔte wosee oo, Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ amu bɛ deɛ ɔ; bɛ́hyɛ ye pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Here are the instructions for offering a sacrifice to ask my blessing:
translation_verse: “Asomdwee afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ bɛma AWURADE ne anwo nhyehyɛleɛ ɛhe:

english_verse: If you offer it to give thanks, you must offer some bread together with it. Use the finest flour to make three kinds of bread without yeast—two in the form of loaves mixed with olive oil and one in the form of thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛbɔ fa da AWURADE ase a, ye de odi kyɛ ɛfa taterɛ kabrɛdi bɔ bafa ngoo bafete ɔ, apiti kabrɛdi bɔ bafa ngoo bafa ye nwo ɔ, ɔne mɔle paa taterɛ bɔ bafa ngoo bafete ɔ boka asennaa afɔleɛ ne aso.

english_verse: When you offer an animal to ask a blessing from me or to thank me, the meat belongs to you, but it must be eaten the same day.
translation_verse: Na wɔ asennaa asomdwee afɔleɛ naen ne de, odi kyɛ edi ye kyẽa bɔ ɛkɔbɔ afɔleɛ ne ala; onni kyɛ ɛma aleɛ kye ebie so.

english_verse: It is different with the sacrifices you offer when you make me a promise or voluntarily give me something. The meat from those sacrifices may be kept and eaten the next day,
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ w’afɔleɛ ne te bɔhyɛlɛ afɔleɛ anaa akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ a, odi kyɛ edi ye ɛlɛho bɔ ɛkɔbɔ afɔleɛ ne ala, na aleɛ kye a, di ye ngaa bɔ waha ne.

english_verse: but any that is left over must be destroyed. If you eat any of it after the second day, your sacrifice will be useless and unacceptable, and you will be both disgusting and guilty.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie di asomdwee afɔleɛ naen ne bie ye ɛlɛsa ne aso a, afɔleɛ ne ngɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye, yeɛ Nyameɛ ngole sona bɔ ɔbɔle ne ngɔto nu; naen ne te akyiwadeɛ na sona bɔ okoli ne, ye musue kɔbɔ ye ti so.

english_verse: But don't eat any of this meat if you have become unclean by touching something unclean from a human or an animal or from any other creature. If you do, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ebiala nwo ka nikyee bɔ ye nwo nde: sɛ nikyee fiɛ bɔ ofi sona nu oo, anaa kaka bɔ ye nwo nde oo, anaa abɔdeɛ biala bɔ ye nwo nde oo, na sɛ odi AWURADE asomdwee afɔleɛ naen ne bie a, odi kyɛ bɛpɛ sɔ sona ne asue befi maen ne anu.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the people: Don't eat the fat of cattle, sheep, or goats.
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Nnɛma ɛmɔdi nandwie loe, anaa boaen loe, anaa abɔngye loe.

english_verse: If one of your animals dies or is killed by some wild animal, you may do anything with its fat except eat it.
translation_verse: Kaka biala bɔ ye bɔbɔ okowu, anaakyɛ bɔ kaka aboyaa bie kohũ ye ne, ɛmɔkɔhora bɛkɔfa ye loe bɛkɔyɔ nikyee foforɛ, nakoso nnɛma ɛmɔdi.

english_verse: If you eat the fat of an animal that can be used as a sacrifice to me, you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Kaka bɔ bayera ye bafa babɔ afɔleɛ bama AWURADE ne, ebiala bɔ okoli ye loe ne, odi kyɛ bɛpɛ ye asue befi maen ne anu.

english_verse: And no matter where you live, you must not eat the blood of any bird or animal,
translation_verse: Afei ɛmɔ atenaleɛ biala anu, nnɛma ɛmɔdi anomaa anaakyɛ kaka biala mogya.

english_verse: or you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ okoli kaka mogya nen, odi kyɛ bɛpɛ ye asue befi maen ne anu.”

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If you want to offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, you must bring the part to be burned and lay it on the bronze altar. But you must first lift up the choice ribs with their fat to show that the offering is dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔfa afɔleɛ bɔ bɛfa see bɛbɔ bɛma AWURADE ne otira ba; odi kyɛ ɔfa ye loe ɔboka ye sa ne aso, ná ɔpagya ye sa ne maa ɔyɛ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: A priest from Aaron's family will then send the fat up in smoke, but the ribs belong to the priests.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne yera ɛloe ne wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso. Nakoso kaka ne sa ne de, Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ bɛ deɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The upper joint of the right hind leg is for the priest who offers the blood and the fat of the animal.
translation_verse: Aarɔn mma nemɔ anu ko bɔ yeɛ ɔkɔfa asomdwee afɔleɛ ye mogya ne ye loe kɔbɔ afɔleɛ ne, ye yeɛ kaka ne sɔ famaa ne kɔyɛ ye deɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I have decided that the people of Israel must always give the choice ribs and the upper joint of the right hind leg to Aaron's descendants
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ kaka sa ne, ɔne ye sɔ bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ne, maye mafi Yisraelfoɛ asomdwee afɔleɛ ne anu, na mafa mama ɔsɔfo Aarɔn ɔne ye mma mmienzua mɔ kyɛ bɛ bue deɛ bɔ ofi Yisraelfoɛ berɛ afebɔɔ ɛne.

english_verse: While Moses and the people of Israel were in the desert at Mount Sinai, the Lord commanded them to start offering these sacrifices.
translation_verse: ná ɛhemɔ yeɛ AWURADE hyɛle Mose wɔ Sinai bokaa ne aso kyẽa bɔ AWURADE hyɛle Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ bɛfa b’afɔleɛ bɛbrɛ ye AWURADE wɔ Sinai ɛserɛ so ne.

english_verse: Moses lifted up the choice ribs of the ram to show that they were dedicated to the Lord. This was the part that the Lord had said Moses could have.
translation_verse: Mose fale kaka ne sa ne, na ɔpagyale ye fa yɛle ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu; sɔfohyɛlɛ boaen nyii ne, Mose bue deɛ bɔ ɔwɔ nu hɔ ɛne, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: Send for Aaron and his sons, as well as their priestly clothes, the oil for ordination, the bull for the sin offering, the two rams, and a basket of bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: “Fa Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ, ndaadeɛ ne, ɛpopalɛ ngoo ne, bɔne nwo afɔleɛ nandwie nyii ne, mmoaen nyii nyɔ ne, kɛndɛen bɔ paanoo kabrɛdi gua nu ne;

english_verse: Then bring the whole community of Israel together at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ná ma mmenia ne amukoraa bɛbɔ dwaa wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ.”

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord, and when everyone had come together,
translation_verse: Mose yɔle kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne; ɔmane mmenia ne amu bɛbɔle dwaa wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ.

english_verse: he said, “We are here to follow the Lord's instructions.”
translation_verse: Mose sele mmenia ne kyɛ, “Nikyee bɔ AWURADE ahyɛ yɛ kyɛ yɛyɔ ɛhe.”

english_verse: After Moses told Aaron and his sons to step forward, he told them to wash themselves.
translation_verse: Afei Mose fale Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ wale anyunu, ná ɔfale nzue nwunzinwunzini bɛ nwo.

english_verse: He put the priestly shirt and robe on Aaron and wrapped the sash around his waist. Then he put the sacred vest on Aaron and fastened it with the finely woven belt.
translation_verse: Ɔfale ataadeɛ aguasoɛ ne wurale Aarɔn, ɔfale abɔsoɛ ne bɔle ye, ɔfale ataadeɛ tendenn ne wurale ye, ɔfale ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ ne wurale ye, na ɔfale ɔsɔfo ataadeɛ abɔsoɛ bɔ bali adwii bagua nu ne bɔle ye nu mane ataadeɛ ne anu miane.

english_verse: Next, he put on Aaron the sacred breastpiece that was used in finding out what the Lord wanted his people to do.
translation_verse: Ɔfale ahone so aguasoɛ ne wurale ye, na ɔfale Yurim ne Tumim ne wurale ahone so aguasoɛ ne anu.

english_verse: He placed the turban on Aaron's head, and on the front of the turban was the narrow strip of thin gold as a sign of his dedication to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔfale abotire ne bɔle ye, na ɔfale sikaa kɔkorɛ taataa ne, bɔ yeɛ ɔte krongronyɛlɛ kyerɛ ne bɔle abotire ne aso wɔ ye nyunu, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ hyɛle Mose ne ala.

english_verse: Moses then dedicated the sacred tent and everything in it to the Lord by sprinkling them with some of the oil for ordination.
translation_verse: Mose fale ɛpopalɛ ngoo ne, ɔpopale ɛtena sua ne ɔne nu nningyein amukoraati ngoo, na ɔfa tele bɛ nwo.

english_verse: He sprinkled the bronze altar seven times, and he sprinkled its equipment, as well as the large bronze bowl and its base.
translation_verse: Ɔfale ngoo ne bie petene afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo pɛen nzoo, na ɔpopale afɔleɛ bokyea ne ɔne ye ngukue amukoraa, ayaa ne ɔne ayaa nyinasoɛ ne ngoo, na ɔfa tele bɛ nwo.

english_verse: He also poured some of the oil on Aaron's head to dedicate him to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ohwiele ɛpopalɛ ngoo ne bie guale Aarɔn ti afia na ɔpopale ye ngoo fa tele ye nwo.

english_verse: Next, Moses dressed Aaron's sons in their shirts, then tied sashes around them and put special caps on them, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na Mose mane Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ koso wale anyunu, ɔfale aguasoɛ wurawurale bɛ, ɔfale abɔsoɛ bobɔle bɛ, ná ɔfale abotire bobɔle bɛ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne.

english_verse: Moses led out the bull that was to be sacrificed for sin, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
translation_verse: Mose fale bɔne nwo afɔleɛ nandwie nyii ne wale anyunu berɛ; na Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ fale bɛ sa guale bɔne nwo afɔleɛ nandwie nyii ne ti afia.

english_verse: After it was killed, Moses dipped a finger in the blood and smeared some of it on each of the four corners of the bronze altar, before pouring out the rest at the foot of the altar. This purified the altar and made it a fit place for offering the sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Mose huni kaka ne, ɔfale ye mogya ne bie, na ɔfale ye sa mmɛseka bɔle mogya ne anu yeyɛle afɔleɛ bokyea mmɛen nemɔ anwo bra yiale. Ɔpetene afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo, na ohwiele mogya ne guale afɔleɛ bokyea ne abo, ɔtele bokyea ne anwo, na ɔnate ɛhe aso fa yɛle bɔne nwo mbata mane afɔleɛ bokyea ne.

english_verse: Moses then took the fat on the bull's insides, as well as the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and sent them up in smoke on the altar fire.
translation_verse: Mose fale ɛloe bɔ wato wafa ye kunu nningyein anwo ne amukoraa, ye boɛ ne bie, ye saa nyɔ ne ɔne bɛ loe, na ɔyerale bɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso.

english_verse: Finally, he took the skin and the flesh of the bull, together with the food still in its stomach, and burned them outside the camp, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Nakoso nandwie nyii ne, ɔne ye nwomaa, ye naen, ɔne ye fure nu nningyein ne de, Mose fale see yerale bɛ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye nen.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the sacrifice to please the Lord. After Aaron and his sons had laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Ɔfale naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ boaen nyii ne wale anyunu berɛ, na Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ fale bɛ sa guale boaen nyii ne ti afia.

english_verse: Moses killed the ram and splattered its blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Mose huni kaka ne, na ohwiele ye mogya ne guale afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo bra yiale.

english_verse: Moses had the animal cut up, and he washed its insides and hind legs. Then he laid the head, the fat, and the rest of the ram on the altar and sent them up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. All this was done just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na bɛfale nzue benwunzini ye kunu nningyein ne ye gya nemɔ anwo beyiele nen, Mose yerale boaen nyii mumua ne amu wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso fa bɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo fona ná bafa see babɔ bama AWURADE ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne.

english_verse: Moses led out the ram for the ceremony of ordination. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head,
translation_verse: Ɔfale boaen nyii bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ bɔ ɔte sɔfohyɛlɛ boaen ne wale anyunu berɛ, na Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ fale bɛ sa guale boaen nyii ne ati afia.

english_verse: and it was killed. Moses smeared some of its blood on Aaron's right earlobe, some on his right thumb, and some on the big toe of his right foot.
translation_verse: Mose huni ye, na ɔfale ye mogya ne bie hane Aarɔn so famaa, ye sa kokotire famaa ɔne ye gya kokotire famaa ne.

english_verse: Moses did the same thing for Aaron's sons, before splattering the rest of the blood against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Bɛfale Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ bɛwale anyunu berɛ, na Mose fale mogya ne bie kekane bɛ so famaa, ɔne bɛ gya kokotire famaa; na Mose hwiele mogya ne ngaa ne guale afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo bra yiale.

english_verse: He took the animal's fat tail, the fat on its insides, and the lower part of the liver and the two kidneys with their fat, and the right hind leg.
translation_verse: Ɔfale ɛloe ne ye dua pue ne, ɛloe amukoraa bɔ wato wafa ye kunu nningyein anwo ne, ye boɛ ne bie, ye saa nyɔ nemɔ ɔne bɛ nwo loe ne, ɔne ye sɔ famaa ne;

english_verse: Then he took from a basket some of each of the three kinds of bread that had been made without yeast and had been dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: na ɔyele apiti kabrɛdi ko, paanoo mumua ko bɔ bafa ngoo bafra bato ɔ, ɔne taterɛ ko fili paanoo kabrɛdi kɛndɛen bɔ ogyi AWURADE nyunu ne anu, na ɔfa guale ɛloe ne ɔne ye sɔ famaa ne aso.

english_verse: Moses placed the bread on top of the meat and gave it all to Aaron and his sons, who lifted it up to show that it was dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔfale ye mukoraa guale Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ sa nu, na ɔmaa bɛpagyale so bɛyɛle ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: After this, Moses placed it on the fires of the altar and sent it up in smoke with a smell that pleased the Lord. This was part of the ordination ceremony.
translation_verse: Afei Mose lele sɔ nningyein nemɔ fili bɛ sa nu, na ɔfa bokale naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne yerale bɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso. Ɔte sɔfohyɛlɛ afɔleɛ bɔ yeɛ ɔbo fona, bɔ bɛfa see bɛyera ye bɛma AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: Finally, Moses sprinkled the priestly clothes of Aaron and his sons with some of the oil for ordination and with some of the blood from the altar. So Aaron and his sons, together with their priestly clothes, were dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Mose fale ɛpopalɛ ngoo ne bie, ɔne mogya bɔ ɔwɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso ne bie, na ɔfa petene Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ anwo ɔne bɛ ndaadeɛ nu. Yiti ɔtele Aarɔn ne ye ndaadeɛ nwo, yeɛ afei ɔtele ye mma mmienzua nemɔ ne bɛ ndaadeɛ nwo.

english_verse: Moses said to Aaron and his sons: The Lord told me that you must boil this meat at the entrance to the sacred tent and eat it there with the bread.
translation_verse: Na Mose sele Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔto naen ne wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ. Naen ne ɔne paanoo bɔ ɔwɔ sɔfohyɛlɛ afɔleɛ kɛndɛen ne anu ne, berɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔdi ye ɔ, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ hyɛle me kyɛ, ‘Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ bedi ɔ.’

english_verse: Burn what is left over
translation_verse: Naen ne paanoo bɔ ɔkɔha ne, ɛ́mɔfa see bɛ́yera ye.

english_verse: and stay near the entrance to the sacred tent until the ordination ceremony ends seven days from now.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔfi ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ befite alaa ɛlɛsoo, kɔpem kyɛ ngyẽa bɔ bɛfa bɛhyɛ ɛmɔ sɔfo ne kɔpɛ nu ɔ, ofikyɛ bɛkɔfa ɛlɛsoo yeɛ bɛkɔhyɛ ɛmɔ sɔfo ɔ.

english_verse: We have obeyed the Lord in everything that has been done today, so that your sins may be forgiven.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ yayɔ ye ɛnɛ ne, AWURADE yeɛ wahyɛ kyɛ bɛyɔ bɛfa bɛpata bɛma ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has told me that you must stay near the entrance to the tent for seven days and nights, or else you will die.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtena ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ eyia ne kɔngɔen ɛlɛsoo, ná ɛ́mɔyɔ bɔ AWURADE ahyɛ ne, amaa ɛmɔanwu ofikyɛ sɔ yeɛ AWURADE hyɛle me ɔ.”

english_verse: Aaron and his sons obeyed everything that the Lord had told Moses they must do.
translation_verse: Na Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ yɔle nningyein bɔ AWURADE nate Mose so hyɛle ne amukoraa.

english_verse: Eight days later Moses called together Aaron, his sons, and Israel's leaders.
translation_verse: Ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso Mose tole ye sa frɛle Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ ɔne Yisrael mbanyi;

english_verse: Then he said to Aaron: Find a young bull and a ram that have nothing wrong with them. Offer the bull to the Lord as a sacrifice for sin and the ram as a sacrifice to please him.
translation_verse: na osele Aarɔn kyɛ, “Fa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ma AWURADE, ná fa boaen nyii bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE. Onni kyɛ ngaka ne anu biala yɛ bɔ wali nnɛen ɔ.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that they must offer sacrifices as well. They must offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to please the Lord. The bull and the ram must be a year old and have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Na ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔfa abɔngye nyii bɛ́bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ, ná ɛ́mɔfa nandwie akrɔngrɔma ne boaen akrɔngrɔma bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko ngoko, bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ bɛ́bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ.

english_verse: Then the people must offer a bull and a ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing and also a grain sacrifice mixed with oil. Do this, because the Lord will appear to you today.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii ne boaen nyii, ɔne aburoo afɔleɛ bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ bɛbɔ asomdwee afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu; ofikyɛ ɛnɛ Nyameɛ kɔye ye nwo ali kohyire ɛmɔ.’ ”

english_verse: After the animals and the grain had been brought to the front of the sacred tent, and the people were standing there in the presence of the Lord,
translation_verse: Bɛfale bɔ Mose hyɛle bɛ ne bɛwale ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anyunu berɛ, na Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɔ pingyele beegyinane AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: Moses said: The Lord has ordered you to do this, so that he may appear to you in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Na Mose sele kyɛ, “Nikyee bɔ AWURADE hyɛle ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɛhe, amaa ɔnate so AWURADE aye ye animnyam ali wahyire ɛmɔ.”

english_verse: Aaron, step up to the altar and offer the sacrifice to please the Lord, then offer the sacrifices for the forgiveness of your sins and for the sins of the people, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Mose sele Aarɔn kyɛ, “Twe pingye afɔleɛ bokyea ne, ná bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ɔne naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ma wɔ nwo, ná yɛ mbata ma wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo ne wɔ mmenia ne; ná fa mmenia nemɔ afɔleɛ nningyein ne bra baapata ma bɛ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE ahyɛ ne.”

english_verse: Aaron stepped up to the altar and killed the bull that was to be the sacrifice for his sins.
translation_verse: Aarɔn pingyele afɔleɛ bokyea ne, na ohuni nandwie bɔ ɔfa bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ mane ye nwo ne.

english_verse: His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, smeared some on the four corners of the bronze altar, and poured out the rest at its foot.
translation_verse: Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ fale mogya ne bɛbrɛle ye. Ɔfale ye sa mmɛseka bɔle mogya ne anu fa yɛle afɔleɛ bokyea ne mmɛen nemɔ anwo, na mogya bɔ waha ne, ohwiele guale afɔleɛ bokyea ne abo.

english_verse: But he sent up in smoke the fat, the kidneys, and the lower part of the liver, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɔne nwo afɔleɛ loe ne, ye saa nemɔ, ɔne ye boɛ ne bie de, ɔyerale bɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the skin and the flesh outside the camp.
translation_verse: Na ye naen ne ye nwomaa ne de, ɔfale see yerale bɛ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi.

english_verse: After Aaron had killed the ram that was sacrificed to please the Lord, Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against all four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Afei Aarɔn huni naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ kaka ne, na ye mma mmienzua nemɔ fale kaka ne mogya ne bɛbrɛle ye, na ohwie guale afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo bra yiale.

english_verse: They brought him each piece of the animal, including the head, and he burned them all on the altar.
translation_verse: Na bɛfale naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne naenguma naenguma ɔne ye ti ne bɛbrɛle ye; na ɔyerale bɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso.

english_verse: He washed the insides and the hind legs and also sent them up in smoke.
translation_verse: Onwunzini ye kunu nningyein ne ɔne ye gya nemɔ anwo, na ɔfa bokale naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne aso ɔyerale bɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso.

english_verse: Next, Aaron sacrificed the goat for the sins of the people, as he had done with the sacrifice for his own sins.
translation_verse: Ye si ye, ɔfale maen afɔleɛ ne wale. Ɔfale maen bɔne nwo afɔleɛ abɔngye ne. Ohuni ye, na ɔfa bɔle bɔne nwo afɔleɛ kyɛbɔ ɔyɔle bɔ oli moa ne ala.

english_verse: And so, he burned this sacrifice on the altar in the proper way.
translation_verse: Ɔfale naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne wale, na ɔbɔle afɔleɛ ne kyɛbɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne te ne.

english_verse: He also presented the grain sacrifice and burned a handful of the flour on the altar as part of the morning sacrifice.
translation_verse: Ɔfale aburoo afɔleɛ ne wale. Ɔsale ye sa bum ko, ɔfa bokale ngyerɛmɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne aso, na ɔyerale bɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso.

english_verse: Finally, he killed the bull and the ram as a sacrifice to ask the Lord's blessing on the people. Aaron's sons brought him the blood, and he splattered it against the four sides of the altar.
translation_verse: Aarɔn huni nandwie nyii ne ɔne boaen nyii ne fa bɔle asomdwee afɔleɛ mane maen ne; na ye mma nemɔ fale mogya ne bɛbrɛle ye, maa ohwie guale afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo bra yiale.

english_verse: Then Aaron burned the fat on the altar and lifted up the ribs and the right hind leg to show that these were dedicated to the Lord. This was done just as the Lord had instructed Moses.
translation_verse: Nakoso ye sa nemɔ ne ye sɔ famaa ne de, Aarɔn pagyale fa bɔle ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu kyɛbɔ Mose hyɛle ne.

english_verse: Aaron held out his hand and gave the people his blessing, before coming down from the bronze altar where he had offered the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Aarɔn mane ye sa so fa hyirele mmenia ne aso, na oyirale bɛ. Ɔbɔle bɔne nwo afɔleɛ, naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ɔne asomdwee afɔleɛ yiele nen, odwu wale ase.

english_verse: He and Moses went into the sacred tent, and when they came out, they gave the people their blessing. Then the Lord appeared to the people in all of his glory.
translation_verse: Mose ne Aarɔn wurale ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu. Afei befi berɛ befitele beeyirayirale mmenia ne, na AWURADE yele ye animnyam ali hyirele mmenia ne amukoraa.

english_verse: The Lord sent fiery flames that burned up everything on the altar, and when everyone saw this, they shouted and fell to their knees to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: See fili AWURADE berɛ ɔɔyerale naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ɔne ɛloe bɔ ɔwɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso ne. Mmerɛ bɔ mmenia ne amu benwuni ye ne, bɛteateane nu, na bɛfale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli ase.

english_verse: Nadab and Abihu were two of Aaron's sons, but they disobeyed the Lord by burning incense to him on a fire pan, when they were not supposed to.
translation_verse: Aarɔn mma mmienzua Nadabo ne Abihu, bɛ nu biala fale ye see kulie. Bɛfale see beguale nu, na bɛfale ɛyɛɛ beguale so. Bɛfale see bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ bɛwale AWURADE nyunu, see bɔ nna AWURADE yeɛ wahyɛ bɛ kyɛ bɛfa bɛbra ye nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent fiery flames and burned them to death.
translation_verse: See fili AWURADE berɛ ɔɔyerale bɛ ná bɛtotɔle wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron that this was exactly what the Lord had meant when he said: “I demand respect from my priests, and I will be praised by everyone!” Aaron was speechless.
translation_verse: Na Mose sele Aarɔn kyɛ, “Bɔ AWURADE aha hɔ ɛhe: ‘Ɔnate bɛ bɔ bepingye me ne aso, ngɔmaa bekonwu me kyɛ nde krongron, na bɛkɔhyɛ me animnyam wɔ mmenia ne amukoraati nyunu.’ ” Na Aarɔn yɛle konn.

english_verse: Moses sent for Mishael and Elzaphan, the two sons of Aaron's uncle Uzziel. Then he told them, “Take these two dead relatives of yours outside the camp far from the entrance to the sacred tent.”
translation_verse: Mose tole ye sa frɛle Aarɔn ɔse aliɛma Yusiɛl ye mma mmienzua Misael ne Ɛlsafan, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔpingye wa ná ɛmɔsoa ɛmɔ aliɛma nemɔ béfi nekaa krongron ne anyunu berɛ bɛhɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ.”

english_verse: So they dragged the dead men away by their clothes.
translation_verse: Yiti kyɛbɔ Mose hyɛle ne, bepingyele berɛ na bɛsoale bɛ fuin nemɔ wɔ b’aguasoɛ nu befili asikyeleɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron and his other two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: Don't show your sorrow by messing up your hair and tearing your priestly clothes, or the Lord will get angry. He will kill the three of you and punish everyone else. It's all right for your relatives, the people of Israel, to mourn for those he destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Na Mose sele Aarɔn, ɔne Aarɔn mma mmienzua Eleasa ne Yitama kyɛ, “Nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ ti nwiaa fu gua ye nwo fusaa, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔsunzua ɛmɔ ndaadeɛ nu. Sɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, ɛmɔkowu, na AWURADE ɛyaafɛlɛ piri kɔwa maen ne amukoraa so. Nakoso ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ, Yisrael awuro ama mukoraa de, bɛkɔhora bekosu bɛ bɔ AWURADE afa see wayera bɛ ne.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's chosen priests, and you must not leave the sacred tent, or you will die. Aaron and his two sons obeyed Moses.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔfi ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anoa nu berɛ bɛkɔ, anyɔ a ɛmɔkowu, ofikyɛ AWURADE afa ɛpopalɛ ngoo wapopa ɛmɔ.” Na bɛyɔle kyɛbɔ Mose hyɛle ne ala.

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Aarɔn kyɛ,

english_verse: When you or your sons enter the sacred tent, you must never drink beer or wine. If you do, you will die right there! This law will never change.
translation_verse: “Ɛne wɔ mma mmienzua mɔ, sɛ ɛmɔkɔ ɛtena sua ne anu a, nnɛma ɛmɔno bobe nzaa anaa nzaa serɛ biala amaa ɛmɔanwu; ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ ahyɛdeɛ afebɔɔ wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: You must learn the difference between what is holy and what isn't holy and between the clean and the unclean.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔnwu nzonzoleɛ bɔ ɔla nikyee bɔ ɔte krongron ɔne nikyee bɔ ɔtte krongron b’afia, nzonzoleɛ bɔ ɔla nikyee bɔ ye nwo nde ɔne bɔ ye nwo te ɔ b’afia;

english_verse: You must also teach the people of Israel everything that I commanded Moses to say to them.
translation_verse: na odi kyɛ ɛmɔkyirekyire Yisraelfoɛ ahyɛdeɛ bɔ AWURADE nate Mose so ha hyirele bɛ ne amukoraa.”

english_verse: Moses told Aaron and his two sons, Eleazar and Ithamar: The grain sacrifice that was offered to give thanks to the Lord is very holy. So make bread without yeast from the part that wasn't sent up in smoke and eat it beside the altar.
translation_verse: Mose sele Aarɔn ɔne Aarɔn mma bɔ baha bɔ bɛ ole Eleasa ne Yitama kyɛ, “Afɔleɛ mɔ bɔ bɛbɔle ye see so bɛmane AWURADE ne, ɛ́mɔfa aburoo afɔleɛ ngaa ne, ná ɛ́mɔli ye kabrɛdi wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne ngyɛnu, ofikyɛ ɔte krongron paa.

english_verse: The Lord has said that this belongs to you and your sons, and that it must be eaten in a holy place.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔdi ye wɔ nekaa bɔ ɔte krongron ɔ, ofikyɛ afɔleɛ bɔ babɔ ye see so bama AWURADE ne, ɛne wɔ mma mɔ bɛ deɛ ɛne; sɔ yeɛ AWURADE ahyehyɛ ama me ɔ.

english_verse: But the choice ribs and the hind leg that were lifted up may be eaten by your entire family, as long as you do so in an acceptable place. These parts are yours from the sacrifices that the people offer to ask the Lord's blessing. This is what the Lord has commanded, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ne, ɔne ye sa bɔ bɛnwaha ne de, odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛboka ɛloe bɔ bɛfa see bɛyera bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ne aso bɛba, ná bɛfa bɛbɔ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, na ɔkɔyɛ wɔ ne wɔ mma mɔ deɛ afebɔɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE ahyɛ ne.”

english_verse: When Moses asked around and learned that the ram for the sin sacrifice had already been burned on the altar, he became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar and said,
translation_verse: Na bɔne nwo afɔleɛ abɔngye ne de, Mose penane ye fɛle, nakoso né bayera ye dada. Yiti ɔfɛle Eleasa ne Yitama, bɔ bɛ ole Aarɔn mma mmienzua bɔ baha ne bɛ so yaa, na obisale kyɛ,

english_verse: “Why didn't you eat the meat from this sacrifice in an acceptable place? It is very holy, and the Lord has given you this sacrifice to remove Israel's sin and guilt.
translation_verse: “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔanni bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ne wɔ nekaa bɔ ɔte krongron ɔ? Ofikyɛ ɔte nikye krongron paa, na Nyameɛ afa ama ɛmɔ, amaa ɛmɔaprapra mmenia nemɔ amumuyɛɛ bagua na ɛmɔapata bama bɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: Whenever an animal's blood isn't brought into the sacred tent, I commanded you to eat its meat in an acceptable place, but you burned it instead.”
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea, ɛmɔamva ye mogya ne bamma nekaa krongron ne anu. Ahaa odi kyɛ ɛmɔdi ye wɔ nekaa krongron ne anu berɛ, kyɛbɔ nhyɛle ɛmɔ ne.”

english_verse: Their father Aaron replied, “Today two of my sons offered the sacrifice for sin and the sacrifice to please the Lord, and look what has happened to me! Would the Lord have approved if I had eaten the sacrifice for sin?”
translation_verse: Na Aarɔn sele Mose kyɛ, “Tie, ɛnɛ bafa bɛ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ne bɛ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bawa Nyameɛ nyunu, yeɛ koso edwirɛ hemɔ ato me ye! Aso sɛ nnili bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ye ɛnɛ a, ahaa AWURADE nye kɔsɔ anaa?”

english_verse: Moses was satisfied with Aaron's reply.
translation_verse: Na Mose tele sɔ nen, ye ahone tɔle ye kunu.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You may eat
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔhã behyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, ‘Aseɛ ye aso ngaka amukoraa, bɛ nu horɛ bɔ ɛ́mɔli ɛhe:

english_verse: The only winged insects you may eat are locusts, grasshoppers, and crickets. All other winged insects that crawl are too disgusting for you to eat.
translation_verse: Nakoso ngaka ngaa bɔ bele ndaa ná bele agyirɛ nna ne de, bɛte ɛmɔ akyiwadeɛ.

english_verse: Don't even touch the dead bodies of animals that have divided hoofs but don't chew the cud. And don't touch the dead bodies of animals that have paws. If you do, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔsoa bɛ fuin ne, odi kyɛ ɔpo ye nwo nningyein, na ye nwo kogua fiɛ maa okoodwu nɔsoa; bɛ nwo nde mma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Moles, rats, mice, and all kinds of lizards are unclean.
translation_verse: ɛlaleɛ, benze, epo, bɔmɔtebɔmɔ ɔne dodowurowuro.

english_verse: Anyone who touches their dead bodies or anything touched by their dead bodies becomes unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛtwe bɛ nwo ase ne, ɛhemɔ bɛ nwo nde mma ɛmɔ. Sɛ bewu a, ebiala bɔ ye nwo kɔha bɛ fuin ne, ye nwo kogua fiɛ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: If any of these animals is found dead in a clay pot, the pot must be broken to pieces, and everything in it becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Kukue biala bɔ bɛ nu biala kɔte kɔtɔ nu ne, nikyee biala bɔ ɔwɔ sɔ kukue ne anu nwo kogua fiɛ na odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ kukue ne.

english_verse: If you pour water from this pot on any food, that food becomes unclean, and anything drinkable in the pot becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Aleɛ biala bɔ odi kyɛ bedi nakoso sɔ kukue ne anu nzue kogua so ne, ye nwo agua fiɛ, na anonneɛ biala bɔ bɛno nakoso ofi sɔ kukue ne anu ne, ye nwo agua fiɛ.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals touches anything else, including ovens and stoves, that thing becomes unclean and must be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nikyee biala bɔ bɛ nu biala fuin ye nekaa biala kɔtɔ so ne, kyɛ ɔte foonoo oo, anaa bokyea oo, odi kyɛ bebubu ye begua; ye nwo nde, na odi kyɛ ɛmɔbu ye kyɛ ye nwo nde.

english_verse: A spring or a cistern where one of these dead animals is found is still clean, but anyone who touches the animal becomes unclean.
translation_verse: Mbombonzue anaa abura nu nzue nwo te; nakoso sɛ nikyee bie la nu, ná sɔ ngaka nemɔ nu bie fuin ka ye a, sɔ nikyee ne nwo nde.

english_verse: If the dead body of one of these animals is found lying on seeds that have been set aside for planting, the seeds remain clean.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛ fuin ne, ye nekaa biala te tɔ mmakaammaa bɔ bɛkwaalua so a, mmakaammaa ne nwo te;

english_verse: But seeds that are soaking in water become unclean, if the dead animal is found in the water.
translation_verse: nakoso sɛ bɛfa mmakaammaa ne begua nzue nu, na sɛ kaka ne fuin ne nekaa biala te tɔ so a, mmakaammaa ne nwo nde mma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: If an animal that may be eaten happens to die, and you touch it, you become unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “Kaka biala bɔ ɛmɔle ate kyɛ bedi ne, sɛ owu a, sona biala bɔ ye nwo kɔha ye fuin ne, ye nwo kogua fiɛ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: If you eat any of its meat or carry its body away, you must wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Sona biala bɔ okoli ye naenmvuin ne bie ne, odi kyɛ ɔpo ye nwo nningyein, na ye nwo kogua fiɛ maa okodwu nɔsoa; sona bɔ ɔkɔsoa kaka fuin ne koso, odi kyɛ ɔpo ye nwo nningyein na ye nwo kogua fiɛ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: If you eat any of them, you will become just as disgusting and unclean as they are.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔfa kaka biala bɔ ɔtwe ye nwo ase begua ɛmɔ nwo fiɛ, nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɛ begua ɛmɔ nwo fiɛ amaa ɛmɔanyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛ nwo nde ɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must dedicate yourselves to me and be holy, just as I am holy. Don't become disgusting by eating any of these unclean creatures.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ; yiti ɛ́mɔte ɛmɔ anwo, ná ɛ́mɔyɛ krongron ofikyɛ nde krongron. Nnɛma ɛmɔfa kaka biala bɔ ɔtwe ye nwo ase begua ɛmɔ nwo fiɛ.

english_verse: I brought you out of Egypt so that I could be your God. Now you must become holy, because I am holy!
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me ole AWURADE bɔ nyele ɛmɔ mvili Misraim aseɛ so mmale ne, bɔ me yeɛ nde ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ɔ; yiti ɛ́mɔyɛ krongron, ofikyɛ nde krongron.”

english_verse: I have given these laws so that you will know what animals, birds, and fish are clean and may be eaten, and which ones are unclean and may not be eaten.
translation_verse: kyɛ ɛmɔkɔma nzonzoleɛ kɔla nningyein bɔ bɛ nwo te ɔne bɛbɔ bɛ nwo nde afia; ngaka bɔ odi kyɛ ɛmɔdi ɔne bɔ onni kyɛ ɛmɔdi ɔ afia.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If a woman gives birth to a son, she is unclean for seven days, just as she is during her monthly period.
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisrael ama kyɛ sɛ brasua ɔnwonzɛ, ná ɔwo bienzua a, ye nwo kogua fiɛ alaa ɛlɛsoo, ye nwo kogua fiɛ kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ wabu ye sa ne ala.

english_verse: Her son must be circumcised on the eighth day,
translation_verse: Na ye ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso, odi kyɛ bɛpɛ akwadaa ne bienzua.

english_verse: Any woman who gives birth to a daughter is unclean for two weeks, just as she is during her period. And she won't be completely clean for another
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɔwo brasua de a, ye de ye nwo kogua fiɛ dapɛn nyɔ, kyɛ wabu ye sa ne ala, na braa ne koli ngyẽa eleburasia ne nzia koraka né ye nwo ate wafi mogya bɔ wagua ye ne anwo.

english_verse: When the mother has completed her time of cleansing, she must come to the front of the sacred tent and bring to the priest a year-old lamb as a sacrifice to please me and a dove or a pigeon as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: “Na ngyẽa bɔ braa ne ɔfa pete ye nwo ne yie a, kyɛ baa bienzua deɛ oo, anaa baa brasua deɛ oo, odi kyɛ ɔfa ɛhemɔ brɛ ɔsɔfo ne wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne nyunu berɛ: boaen akrɔngrɔma bɔ wali afoɛ ko bɔ ɔbaafa bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, ɔne aborɔnoma buruwa ko anaa aborɔma ko bɔ ɔbaafa bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: After the priest offers the sacrifices to me, the mother will become completely clean from her loss of blood, whether her child is a boy or a girl.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa bɔ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ná ɔ́fa yɛ mbata ma braa ne. Afei braa ne nwo kɔte kofi mogya bɔ wagua ye ne anwo. Mmeraa he wɔ berɛ ma brasua biala bɔ ɔkɔwo baa bienzua anaakyɛ baa brasua ɔ.

english_verse: If she cannot afford a lamb, she can offer two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice to please me and the other as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Na sɛ braa ne nwo ngɔso boaen so a, ye de ɔ́fa mmubure nyɔ anaa mmorɔnoma buruwa nyɔ ɔ́bra; ko te naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, yeɛ ko wora te bɔne nwo afɔleɛ; odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa yɛ mbata ma braa ne ma ye nwo fi.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn kyɛ,

english_verse: If sores or boils or a skin rash should break out and start spreading on your body, you must be brought to Aaron or to one of the other priests.
translation_verse: “Sɛ asee gua ebie anwo, anaa edoee yɛ ye, anaa yira bobɔ ye ná ɔkakyi kwata wɔ ye nwo a, odi kyɛ bɛfa ye bɛbrɛ ɔsɔfo Aarɔn anaa Aarɔn mma mmienzua bɔ bɛte asɔfo nemɔ anu ko.

english_verse: If the priest discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne neanea nekaa bɔ anwonyerɛ ne agua ye ne; na sɛ berɛ nwiaa ne ayɛ hoyaa, ná berɛ ne adidi ahɔ nu atra ye nwonaen ngaa ne a, ye de né ɔte kwata anwonyerɛ; sɛ ɔsɔfo ne neanea ye nwo yie a, odi kyɛ ɔfa to dwaa kyɛ sɔ sona ne nwo nde.

english_verse: But if the infected area is white and only skin deep, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, the priest will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ye nwonaen ne berɛ te hoyaa, nakoso wannidi wangɔ nu wandra ye nwonaen ngaa ne, ná berɛ nwiaa ne wanyɛ hoyaa a, ye de odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ma yarefoɛ ne ngome ɔte ye nwo kɔtena nekaa bie ɛlɛsoo.

english_verse: Then if the disease hasn't become any worse or spread, the priest will say, “You are clean. It is only a sore. After you wash your clothes, you may go home.”
