translation_verse: Ɛlɛsoo ne aso, odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne osa neanea ye nwo, ná sɛ anwonyerɛ ne noa abrɛ ase bɔ wannidi wangɔ ye wereɛ nu a, ye de odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa to dwaa kyɛ sɔ sona ne ye nwo te; edoee mbaen ɔ; odi kyɛ sɔ sona ne, ɔpo ye nwo nningyein, ná ye nwo ɔte.

english_verse: If it is discovered that the disease has started spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne neanea ye nwo, na sɛ anwonyerɛ ne adidi ahɔ ye wereɛ nu a, ye de odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa to dwaa kyɛ ye nwo nde; kwata anwonyerɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Any of you with a skin disease must be brought to a priest.
translation_verse: “Sɛ kwata anwonyerɛ yɛ ebie a, odi kyɛ bɛfa ye bɛbrɛ ɔsɔfo ne.

english_verse: If he discovers that the sore spot is white with pus and that the hair around it has also turned white,
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne neanea yarefoɛ ne anwo, na sɛ mbɔmbɔ fufue bie anwu ye maa ye nwiaa ne ayɛ hoyaa, ná naen monɛ bie aworɔ tua mbɔmbɔ ne anu a,

english_verse: If the sores come back and turn white again, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne nea naen monɛ ne, ná ɔfa to dwaa kyɛ ye nwo nde. Naen monɛ ne nwo nde, ofikyɛ ɔte kwata anwonyerɛ.

english_verse: However, if the sores heal and only white spots remain, the priest will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne neanea ye nwo, na sɛ anwonyerɛ ne ayɛ hoyaa a, ye de odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa to dwaa kyɛ yarefoɛ ne, ye nwo te; ye nwo te.

english_verse: If you have a sore that either swells or turns reddish-white after it has healed, then you must show it to a priest.
translation_verse: ná sɛ nikyee fufue bie anaa nikyee kɔkorɛ hoyaa bie nwu nu a, ye de odi kyɛ ɔfa kokyire ɔsɔfo ne.

english_verse: If he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne neanea ye nwo, na sɛ onwu kyɛ wadidi wahɔ ye wereɛ nu ná ye nwiaa ayɛ hoyaa a, ye de odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa to dwaa kyɛ ye nwo nde; kwata anwonyerɛ ɛne, wala ali wɔ mbɔmbɔ ne anu.

english_verse: But if the white area is only on the surface of the skin and hasn't become any worse, and if the hair in it hasn't turned white, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɔsɔfo ne nea, ná sɛ so nwiaa ne ɔyyɛle hoyaa, ná wannidi wangɔ ye wereɛ ne anu, ná mmom sɛ anwonyerɛ ne aberɛ ase a, ye de odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔma ye ngome ɔte ye nwo kɔtena nekaa bie ɛlɛsoo.

english_verse: If the sore begins spreading during this time, the priest will say, “You are unclean because you have a disease.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ wadidi wɔ ye wereɛ nu a, ye de odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa to dwaa kyɛ sona ne, ye nwo nde; anwonyerɛ aha ye.

english_verse: But if it doesn't spread, and only a scar remains, he will say, “You are now clean.”
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ anwonyerɛ ne wɔ neka horɛ bɔ wandrɛ de a, ɔte mbɔmbɔ kenamvoen; odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa to dwaa kyɛ ye nwo te.

english_verse: If you have a burn that gets infected and turns red or reddish-white,
translation_verse: “Sɛ nikyee hyerɛ bie yera ebie ná ye berɛ wereɛ ne bɔ mvumvunya yɛ kɔkorɛ hoyaa anaa hyɛnn a,

english_verse: a priest must examine it. Then if he discovers that the hair in the infected area has turned white and that the infection seems more than skin deep, he will say, “The burn has turned into leprosy, and you are unclean.”
translation_verse: odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔnea, na sɛ berɛ nwiaa ne ayɛ hoyaa, ná wadidi wahɔ ye wereɛ nu a, ye de né kwata anwonyerɛ ɔ; wala ali wɔ mvumvunya ne anu. Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa to dwaa kyɛ sɔ sona ne ye nwo nde; ɔte kwata anwonyerɛ.

english_verse: But if the priest finds that the hair in the infected area hasn't turned white and that the sore is only skin deep and it is healing, he will tell you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɔsɔfo ne nea, ná sɛ berɛ nwiaa ne wanyɛ hoyaa ná wannidi wangɔ ye wereɛ nu, ná mmom wabrɛ ase a, odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ma ye ngome ɔte ye nwo kɔtena nekaa bie ɛlɛsoo.

english_verse: On the seventh day the priest will examine you again, and if the infection is spreading, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: Ɛlɛsoo ne aso, odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne neanea ye nwo. Sɛ anwonyerɛ ne adidi ahɔ ye wereɛ nu a, ye de odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa to dwaa kyɛ sɔ sona ne ye nwo nde; ɔte kwata anwonyerɛ.

english_verse: However, if the infection hasn't spread and has begun to heal, and if only a scar remains, he will say, “Only a scar remains from the burn, and you are clean.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ anwonyerɛ ne wɔ nekaa horɛ ná wandrɛ wɔ ye wereɛ nu, ná mmom wabrɛ ase a, ye de nikyee hyerɛ yeɛ wama berɛ abɔ mvumvunya ɔ; odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔfa to dwaa kyɛ sona ne ye nwo te; ofikyɛ ɔte see kenamvoen.

english_verse: If you have a sore on your head or chin,
translation_verse: “Sɛ bienzua anaa brasua bie nya anwonyerɛ wɔ ye ti so anaa ye kanza nu a,

english_verse: it must be examined by a priest. If the infection seems more than skin deep, and the hair in it has thinned out and lost its color, he will say, “This is leprosy—you are unclean.”
translation_verse: odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne neanea anwonyerɛ ne. Sɛ wadidi wahɔ ye wereɛ nu, ná sɛ berɛ nwiaa ne ayɛ hoyaa ndrɛko ndrɛko a, ye de odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa to dwaa kyɛ sɔ sona ye nwo nde; ɔte anwonyerɛ bɔ ɔyɛ kyee ɔ; ɔte kwata anwonyerɛ bɔ wayɛ ye ti so anaa ye kanza ɔ.

english_verse: On the other hand, if he discovers that the itchy spot is only skin deep, but that the hair still isn't healthy, he will order you to stay away from everyone else for seven days.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔsɔfo ne nea anwonyerɛ kyeekyee ne, ná sɛ wannidi wangɔ ye wereɛ nu, ná sɛ nwiaa tunn biala offuli nu a, ye de odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔma sɔ sona bɔ anwonyerɛ kyeekyee ayɛ ye ne ngome ɔte ye nwo kɔtena nekaa bie ɛlɛsoo.

english_verse: By that time, if the itch hasn't spread, if the hair seems healthy, and if the itch is only skin deep,
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛsoo ne aso, odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne nea anwonyerɛ kyeekyee ne; ná sɛ anwonyerɛ ne wandrɛ, ná sɛ nwiaa hoyaa ɔnne nu, ná sɛ anwonyerɛ kyeekyee ne wannidi wangɔ ye wereɛ nu a,

english_verse: you must shave off the hair around the infection, but not those on it. Then the priest will tell you to stay away from everyone else for another seven days.
translation_verse: ye de odi kyɛ ɔpoa ye nwo nwiaa, nakoso nnɛma ɔpoa anwonyerɛ kyeekyee ne anu; odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔma sona bɔ anwonyerɛ kyeekyee ayɛ ye ne ngome ɔte ye nwo kɔtena nekaa bie ɛlɛsoo bieku.

english_verse: Later, if the itch starts spreading, even though the hair is still healthy, the priest will say, “You are unclean.”
translation_verse: ye de odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔneanea ye nwo, ná sɛ anwonyerɛ ne atrɛ wɔ ye wereɛ nu a, ye de ye nwo nhia kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne kɔpena nwiaa hoyaa ne ɔ; ye nwo nde.

english_verse: If white spots break out on your skin,
translation_verse: “Sɛ ndotɔndotɔ fufue bie gua bienzua anaa brasua bie nwo a,

english_verse: but the priest discovers that it is only a rash, he will say, “You are clean.”
translation_verse: odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔneanea ye nwo, ná sɛ ndotɔndotɔ bɔ wagua ye ne te fufue hoyaa a, ye de asee yeɛ wagua ye nwo ɔ; ye nwo te.

english_verse: If you become bald on any part of your head, you are still clean.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ebie ye nwoma so pa ná ye ti angyɛnu tutu a, ye de ye nwoma so yeɛ wapa ɔ, nakoso ye nwo te.

english_verse: But if a priest discovers that a reddish-white sore has broken out on the bald spot and looks like leprosy, he will say,
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne neanea yarefoɛ ne anwo, ná sɛ nikyee bɔ wagua ye ti afia anaa ye nwoma bɔ wapa ne aso ne, ɔte kɔkorɛ hoyaa, bɔ osoma kwata anwonyerɛ wɔ ye wereɛ nu a,

english_verse: If you ever have leprosy, you must tear your clothes, leave your hair uncombed, cover the lower part of your face, and go around shouting, “I'm unclean! I'm unclean!”
translation_verse: “Sona bɔ kwata anwonyerɛ kɔyɛ ye ne, odi kyɛ owura ndaadeɛ teterewaa ná ɔma ye ti nwiaa gua so basaa. Odi kyɛ ɔkata ye noa tuin anwuro ne aso ná ɔtea nu kyɛ, ‘Me nwo nde o, me nwo nde o!

english_verse: As long as you have the disease, you are unclean and must live alone outside the camp.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ anwonyerɛ ne tɛ wɔ ye so ne de, ye de ye nwo nde. Ye nwo nde na ye ngome ɔkɔte ye nwo kɔɔtena asikyeleɛ ne asi.

english_verse: If a greenish or reddish spot appears anywhere on any of your clothing or on anything made of leather, you must let the priest examine the clothing or the leather. He will put it aside for seven days,
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne neanea ngekalewa ne, na odi kyɛ ɔmaa bɛfa ataadeɛ ne ngome begua nekaa bie ɛlɛsoo;

english_verse: he will tell you to wash the clothing or leather and put it aside for another seven days,
translation_verse: ye de odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔhyɛ maa bɛpo nikyee bɔ ngekalewa wɔ nu ne, ná afei ɔ́fa nikyee ne angome ógua nekaa bie ɛlɛsoo bieku.

english_verse: he will order someone to bring out two live birds that are acceptable for sacrifice, together with a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: ye de odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne hyɛ maa ɔnate sona bɔ bɛbaate ye nwo ne ati bɛ́fa ɛhemɔ bɛ́ba: nnomaa nyɔ bɔ bɛte ngoa nu bɔ bɛ nwo te ɔ, bakaa bɔ bɛfrɛ ye sida, adaabene ne sufiɛ.

english_verse: The priest will order someone to kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne hyɛ maa bɛfa nnomaa nemɔ nu ko besinze kukue bɔ mbombonzue gua nu ɔ so ná beku ye.

english_verse: Next, he will sprinkle you seven times with the blood and say, “You are now clean.” Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away.
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ bɛ́te ye nwo béfi kwata anwonyerɛ nwo ne, odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔfa mogya ne pete ye nwo pɛen nzoo. Afei odi kyɛ ɔfa to dwaa kyɛ sona ne nwo ate, ná ɔyakyi anomaa bɔ ɔte ngoa nu ne maa ɔkɔ buro.

english_verse: After this you must wash your clothes, shave your entire body, and take a bath before you are completely clean. You may move back into camp, but you must not enter your tent for seven days.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ bate ye nwo ne, odi kyɛ ɔpo ye nningyein, ɔpoa ye nwo nwiaa amu, ɔfa nzue bia, na ye nwo kɔte. Ye si ye, odi kyɛ osa ba asikyeleɛ nu berɛ, nakoso ɔkɔtena ye ɛtena sua asi ɛlɛsoo.

english_verse: Then you must once again shave your head, face, and eyebrows, as well as the hair on the rest of your body. Finally, wash your clothes and take a bath, and you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Na ye ɛlɛsoo ne aso, odi kyɛ ɔpoa ye nwo nwiaa amukoraa: ye ti nwiaa, ye kanza ne ye ndo nwiaa; ɔ́poa ye nwo nwiaa amukoraa. Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔpo ye nwo nningyein, ná ɔ́fa nzue bia, na ye nwo kɔte.

english_verse: On the eighth day you must bring to the priest two rams and a year-old female lamb that have nothing wrong with them; also bring
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso, odi kyɛ ɔfa mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma nyɔ bɔ bellili nnɛen biala, boaen beleɛ akrɔngrɔma ko bɔ wali afoɛ ko bɔ ollili nnɛen biala ɔ, esam paa olonka nza bɔ bafa ngoo bafra bɔ bɛ́fa bɛ́bɔ aburoo afɔleɛ ɔ, ɔne ngoo towaa ko.

english_verse: Then the priest will present you and your offerings to me at the entrance to my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo bɔ ɔte sɔ sona ne anwo ne, ɔkɔfa sɔ sona ne ɔne sɔ nningyein nemɔ kɔhɔ AWURADE nyunu wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anoa nu berɛ.

english_verse: There he will offer one of the rams, together with the oil, as a sacrifice to make things right. He will also lift them up to show that they are dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nyii nemɔ anu ko ɔboka ngoo towaa ko so, ná ɔfa bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ. Odi kyɛ ɔpagya so fa bɔ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: This sacrifice is very holy. It belongs to the priest and must be killed in the same place where animals are killed as sacrifices for sins and as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ oku boaen akrɔngrɔma ne wɔ nekaa krongron berɛ, nekaa bɔ beku bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ɔne naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ngaka ne, ofikyɛ foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ te kyɛ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ne ala; ɔte ɔsɔfo ne deɛ na ɔte krongron paa.

english_verse: The priest will smear some of the blood from this sacrifice on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔfa foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ mogya ne bie, ná ɔfa kekã sona bɔ bɛbaate ye nwo ne ye so famaa tɛndiaa ne, ye sa kokotire famaa ɔne ye gya kokotire famaa.

english_verse: He will then pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa ngoo towaa ne, ná ohwie ngoo ne bie gua ye bɔbɔ ye sa bɛen nu,

english_verse: dip a finger of his right hand into the oil, and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ná ɔ́fa ye sa mmɛseka famaa ne bɔ ngoo bɔ ɔwɔ ye sa bɛen nu ne anu, ná ɔfa ye sa mmɛseka pete ngoo ne bie pɛen nzoo, AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: Next, the priest will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot,
translation_verse: Ngoo bɔ ɔkɔha ɔsɔfo ne sa nu ne, odi kyɛ ɔfa bie kekã sona bɔ bɛbaate ye nwo ne ye so famaa tɛndiaa ne, ye sa kokotire famaa, ɔne ye gya kokotire famaa, wɔ foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ mogya ne aso.

english_verse: and he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then he will offer the other two animals—one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: ná ɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, ɔne aburoo afɔleɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso. Ɔnate ɛhe aso, ɔsɔfo ne ɔ́pata ma ye ma ye nwo te.

english_verse: Depending on what you can afford, you must also offer either two doves or two pigeons, one as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: mmorɔma nyɔ anaa mmorɔnoma buruwa nyɔ bɔ ye nwo kɔsõ so ɔ: ko te bɔne nwo afɔleɛ yeɛ ko ne koso te naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ.

english_verse: The priest will offer these to me in front of the sacred tent on the eighth day.
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso, odi kyɛ ɔfa bɛ brɛ ɔsɔfo ne ma ɔfa te ye nwo wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anoa nu berɛ, AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: The priest will kill this ram for the sacrifice to make things right, and he will lift it up with the olive oil in dedication to me. Then he will smear some of the blood on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne oku foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ boaen ne, ná ɔfa foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ mogya ne bie fa kekã sona bɔ bɛwɔ so bɛte ye nwo ne ye so famaa tɛndiaa ne, ye sa kokotire famaa ne ɔne ye gya kokotire famaa.

english_verse: The priest will pour some of the olive oil into the palm of his left hand,
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne hwie ngoo ne bie gua ye bɔbɔ ye sa bɛen nu;

english_verse: then dip a finger of his right hand in the oil and sprinkle some of it seven times toward the sacred tent.
translation_verse: ná ɔ́fa ye sa mmɛseka famaa pete ngoo bɔ ɔwɔ ye sa bɛen anu ne bie ne pɛen nzoo, AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: He will smear some of the oil on your right ear lobe, some on your right thumb, and some on the big toe of your right foot, just as he did with the blood of the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔfa ngoo bɔ ɔwɔ ye sa nu ne bie kekã sona bɔ bɛwɔ so bɛte ye nwo ne ye so famaa tɛndiaa ne, ye sa kokotire famaa, ɔne ye gya kokotire famaa wɔ nekaa bɔ ɔfale foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ mogya ɔkekane ne.

english_verse: And he will pour the rest of the oil from his palm on your head. Then, depending on what you can afford, he will offer either the doves or the pigeons together with the grain sacrifice. One of the birds is the sacrifice for sin, and the other is the sacrifice to please me. After this you will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Nnomaa ne bɔ sona ne nwo kɔsõ so ne, ko te bɔne nwo afɔleɛ yeɛ ko koso te naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ; sona bɔ bɛwɔ so bɛte ye nwo ne, odi kyɛ ɔfa aburoo afɔleɛ boka so, ná ɔsɔfo ne ɔpata ma ye wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you have leprosy and cannot afford the usual sacrifices to make you clean. When There Is Mildew in a House
translation_verse: Sona bɔ kwata anwonyerɛ kɔyɛ ye nakoso ye nwo ngɔso nningyein bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛpete ye nwo ne, sɔ mmeraa he yeɛ ɔla berɛ ma ye ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron to say to the people:
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn kyɛ,

english_verse: After I have given you the land of Canaan as your permanent possession, here is what you must do, if I ever put mildew on the walls of any of your homes.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛmɔbadwu Kanaan aseɛ bɔ méfa méma ɛmɔ maa ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ ne aso, ná sɛ mema kwata anwonyerɛ pe awuro bie anu wɔ aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔ sa baahã ye ne aso a,

english_verse: First, you must say to a priest, “I think there is mildew on the wall of my house.”
translation_verse: odi kyɛ awuro ne mene kɔka kyire ɔsɔfo ne kyɛ, ‘Ɔyɛ me kyɛ anwonyerɛ bie ape m’awuro dɔ.’

english_verse: If the priest discovers greenish or reddish spots that go deeper than the surface of the walls,
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔkɔnea; sɛ anwonyerɛ ne wakekã awuro ne terɛ ne anwo ma berɛ ayɛ kyɛ apopobibire anaa kɔkorɛ, ná sɛ osoma kyɛ wadidi wahɔ terɛ ne anu a,

english_verse: he will have the house closed for seven days.
translation_verse: ye de odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo fa anoa nu berɛ fite, ná ɔto awuro ne anu ɛlɛsoo.

english_verse: Then he will return and check to see if the mildew has spread.
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛsoo ne aso, odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo sa kɔneanea berɛ; sɛ anwonyerɛ ne atrɛ wɔ awuro ne ye trɛ ne anwo a,

english_verse: If so, he will order someone to scrape the plaster from the walls, remove the stones covered with mildew, then haul everything off and dump it in an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔmaa bɛwɔngye awuro ne akunu amukoraa. Ye kunu bɔ bɛkɔwɔngye ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ bekogyi begua kuro ne asi dɔ nekaa bie bɔ berɛ ɔnde ɔ.

english_verse: Afterwards the wall must be repaired with new stones and fresh plaster.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛsesa nyɔboɛ foforɛ bewura nyɔboɛ ɛhene mɔ boso, ná bɛ́fa ɛfaa foforɛ bɛma awuro ne anwo.

english_verse: the priest will come and say, “This house is unclean. It's covered with mildew that can't be removed.”
translation_verse: odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne kɔnea awuro berɛ. Na sɛ anwonyerɛ ne atrɛ wɔ awuro berɛ a, ye de né kwata anwonyerɛ bɔ ɔtrɛ yeɛ wape awuro berɛ ɔ, awuro ne nwo nde.

english_verse: Then he will have the house torn down and every bit of wood, stone, and plaster hauled off to an unclean place outside the town.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne maa bedwiri awuro ne begua ase; ná ɔmaa bɛsesa nu nyɔboɛ, mmakaa ne nnɛterɛ amukoraa bekogyi begua kuro ne asi dɔ nekaa bɔ berɛ ɔnde ɔ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, if any of you entered the house while it was closed, you will be unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ bato awuro ne anu ne, ebiala bɔ ɔkɔhɔ nu ne, ye nwo kogua fiɛ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: And if you either slept or ate in the house, you must wash your clothes.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔla sɔ awuro ne anu ne, odi kyɛ ɔpo ye nwo nningyein, na ebiala bɔ okodidi awuro berɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔpo ye nwo nningyein.

english_verse: On the other hand, if the priest discovers that mildew hasn't reappeared after the house was newly plastered, he will say, “This house is clean—the mildew has gone.”
translation_verse: “Nakoso sɛ bɛma awuro ne anwo beyie, ná ye si ye ɔsɔfo ne banea ná anwonyerɛ ne wandrɛ wɔ awuro berɛ a, odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa to dwaa kyɛ awuro ne ye nwo te; anwonyerɛ ne ahɔ.

english_verse: Then, to show that the house is now clean, he will get two birds, a stick of cedar wood, a piece of red yarn, and a branch from a hyssop plant and bring them to the house.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛte awuro ne anwo a, odi kyɛ ɔfa nnomaa nyɔ boka bakaa bɔ bɛfrɛ ye sida ne, adaabene ne sufiɛ so.

english_verse: He will kill one of the birds over a clay pot of spring water
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa nnomaa nemɔ nu ko osinze kukue bɔ mbombonzue gua nu ɔ so, ná oku ye.

english_verse: and let its blood drain into the pot. Then he will dip the cedar, the hyssop, the yarn, and the other bird into the mixture of blood and water. Next, he will sprinkle the house seven times with the mixture, then the house will be completely clean.
translation_verse: Atee he aso yeɛ ɔsɔfo ne kɔfa anomaa mogya ne, mbombonzue ne, anomaa bɔ ɔtɛte ase ne, bakaa bɔ bɛfrɛ ye sida ne, sufiɛ ne ɔne adaabene ne kɔte awuro ne anwo ɔ.

english_verse: Finally, he will release the bird and let it fly away, ending the ceremony for purifying the house.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔyakyi anomaa bɔ ɔtɛte ngoa nu ne wɔ kuro ne tiwaa maa ɔkɔ buro. Ɔnate ɛhe aso, ɔkɔpata kɔma awuro ne, na awuro ne anwo kɔte.

english_verse: These are the things you must do if you discover that you are unclean because of an itch or a sore, or that your clothing or house is unclean because of mildew.
translation_verse: Ɛhemɔ yeɛ ɔkɔmaa bekonwu kyɛ nikyee bie nwo te anaakyɛ ye nwo nde ɔ. Kwata anwonyerɛ mɔ nwo mmeraa ɛhe.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Any man with an infected penis is unclean,
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔhã behyire Yisrael ama kyɛ, ‘Sɛ ebie bienzua fiti a, sɔ nzue ne ma ye nwo gua fiɛ.

english_verse: and if you touch either these or him, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa ye nwo kɔha sona bɔ ye bienzua fiti ne, odi kyɛ ɔpo ye nwo nningyein, ná ɔ́fa nzue bia, na ɔkɔyɛ sona bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: If you are spit on by the man, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Sɛ sona bɔ ye bienzua fiti ne, ɔfe nwɔserɛ gua sona bɔ ye nwo te nwo a, odi kyɛ sɔ sona ne po ye nwo nningyein, ná ɔ́fa nzue bia, na ɔkɔyɛ sona bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: Any saddle or seat on which the man sits is unclean. And if you touch or carry either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ye nwo kɔha nikyee biala bɔ watena so ne, ɔkɔyɛ sona bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ maa okoodwu nɔsoa; na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔsoa sɔ nikyee ne odi kyɛ ɔpo ye nwo nningyein ná ɔ́fa nzue bia, na ɔkɔyɛ sona bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: If the man touches you without first washing his hands, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ye bienzua fiti ne, sɛ wamva nzue wanwunzi ye sa koraka, ná ɔfa ye nwo ka ebie a, odi kyɛ sɔ sona ne po ye nwo nningyein ná ɔ́fa nzue bia, na ɔkɔyɛ sona bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: Any clay pot that he touches must be destroyed, and any wooden bowl that he touches must be washed.
translation_verse: Kukue biala, sɛ sona bɔ ye bienzua fiti nwo ka ye a, odi kyɛ bɛbɔ ye; yeɛ sɛ ye nwo ka alaka biala bɔ bafa bakaa bayɔ a, odi kyɛ bɛfa nzue benwunzi ye nwo.

english_verse: Seven days after the man gets well, he will be considered clean, if he washes his clothes and takes a bath in spring water.
translation_verse: “Sona bɔ ye bienzua fiti ne, sɛ ye nwo sa a, odi kyɛ otu ɛlɛsoo sie berɛ fa pete ye nwo. Afei odi kyɛ ɔpo ye nwo nningyein ná ɔ́fa mbombonzue gyengɔɔ obia, na ye nwo kɔte.

english_verse: On the eighth day he must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso, odi kyɛ ɔfa mmorɔma nyɔ anaa mmorɔnoma buruwa nyɔ ɔba AWURADE nyunu wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ, ná ɔ́fa bɛ ma ɔsɔfo ne.

english_verse: The priest will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me, then I will consider the man completely clean.
translation_verse: Na afei odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa nnomaa nemɔ ko bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ná ɔ́fa ko koso ɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ. Ɔsɔfo ne kogyina sona ne gya nu kɔpata kɔma ye wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, ɔnate ye bienzua bɔ né ofiti ne ati.

english_verse: Any man who has a flow of semen must take a bath, but he still remains unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “Sɛ bienzua bie nwo nzue ba a, odi kyɛ ɔfa nzue bia ye nwo amukoraati, na ɔkɔyɛ sona bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: If the semen touches anything made of cloth or leather, these must be washed, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Nikyee biala bɔ bafa ɛtena anaa nwomaa bapa ne, sɛ ye nwo nzue ne bie gua so a, ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛfa nzue bɛpo, na ɔkɔyɛ nikyee bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: After having sex, both the man and the woman must take a bath, but they still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Sɛ bienzua bie ne brasua bɛda, ná ye nwo nzue ba a, ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛ munyɔ bɛfa nzue bebia, na bɛ nwo kogua fiɛ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: When a woman has her monthly period, she remains unclean for seven days, and if you touch her, you must take a bath, but you remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: “Sɛ brasua bu ye sa a, ɔkɔyɛ sona bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ ɛlɛsoo, na ebiala bɔ ye nwo kɔha sɔ sona nen, ɔkɔyɛ sona bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: Anything that she rests on or sits on is also unclean, and if you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛen oo, anaa nikyee biala bɔ ɔkɔtena so oo, sɛ ebie nwo ka ye a, ɔkɔyɛ sona bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: Any man who has sex with her during this time becomes unclean for seven days, and anything he rests on is also unclean.
translation_verse: Sɛ bienzua bie ne ye bɛda, na nikyee bɔ wama ye nwo agua fiɛ ne bie ka bienzua ne a, bienzua ne nwo kogua fiɛ ɛlɛsoo, na bɛen biala bɔ sɔ bienzua ne kɔla so ne nwo kogua fiɛ.

english_verse: If you touch either of these, you must wash your clothes and take a bath, but you still remain unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa ye nwo kɔha sɔ nningyein nemɔ nen, ye nwo kogua fiɛ; odi kyɛ ɔpo ye nwo nningyein, ná ɔfa nzue bia, na ɔkɔyɛ sona bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: On the eighth day, she must bring either two doves or two pigeons to the front of my sacred tent and give them to a priest.
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso, odi kyɛ braa ne fa mmubure nyɔ anaa mmorɔnoma buruwa nyɔ brɛ ɔsɔfo ne wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me; then I will consider the woman completely clean.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa ko bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ, ná ɔfa ko koso bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ; na ɔsɔfo ne kɔpata kɔma ye wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ɔnate mogya bɔ onwuni ye nyunu maa ye nwo guale fiɛ ne ati.

english_verse: When any of you are unclean, you must stay away from the rest of the community of Israel. Otherwise, my sacred tent will become unclean, and the whole nation will die.
translation_verse: “Sɔa yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɛfa bɛte Yisraelfoɛ nwo befi nningyein bɔ ogua bɛ nwo fiɛ nwo ɔ, amaa bamva efiɛ banga me ɛtena sua ne, ná ɔnate bɛ nwo bɔ wagua fiɛ ne ati banwuwu.”

english_verse: Two of Aaron's sons had already lost their lives for disobeying the Lord, so the Lord told Moses to say to Aaron: I, the Lord, appear in a cloud over the place of mercy on the sacred chest, which is behind the inside curtain of the sacred tent. And I warn you not to go there except at the proper time. Otherwise, you will die!
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Ka kyire eliɛma Aarɔn kyɛ, nekaa krongron bɔ ɔwɔ mbɛmuɛ tena ne asi dɔ ne, mbata bia bɔ ɔwɔ apam alaka ne aso ne, nnɛmaa ɔba ye nyunu mmerɛ biala bɔ okuro ɔ. Sɛ ɔyɔ sɔ a okowu, ofikyɛ meye me nwo ali mekyire wɔ munungum bɔ ɔwɔ mbata bia ne aso ne anu.

english_verse: Before entering this most holy place, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice for your sins and a ram as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Sɛ Aarɔn ɔba nekaa krongron ne anu a, bɔ odi kyɛ ɔyɔ ɛhe: odi kyɛ ɔfa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma ko bɔ ɔfa bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ɔ ɔne boaen nyii bɔ ɔfa bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ.

english_verse: You will take a bath and put on the sacred linen clothes, including the underwear, the robe, the sash, and the turban.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ owura nwera ataadeɛ tendenn krongron ne, ná owura nwera pieto ɔfa kata ye nwo, ná ɔbɔ nwera abɔsoɛ ne, ná ɔbɔ nwera abotire ne; ɛhemɔ te ndaadeɛ krongron. Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa nzue bia koraka né wawura ndaadeɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: Then the community of Israel will bring you a ram and two goats, both of them males. The goats are to be used as sacrifices for sin, and the ram is to be used as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ode mbɔngye nyii nyɔ fi Yisrael maen berɛ bɔ ɔfa bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ɔ, ɔne boaen nyii ko bɔ ɔfa bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Aaron, you must offer the bull as a sacrifice of forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: “Odi kyɛ Aarɔn fa nandwie nyii ne bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ma ye nwo, ná ɔpata ma ye bɔbɔ ye nwo, ɔne ye awuro ama.

english_verse: Then you will lead the two goats into my presence at the front of the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa mbɔngye nyii nyɔ nemɔ ba AWURADE nyunu wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ.

english_verse: where I will show you which goat will be sacrificed to me and which one will be sent into the desert to the demon Azazel.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ Aarɔn to mbɔngye nyɔ nemɔ aso serewa; ko te AWURADE deɛ, yeɛ ko koso te Asasɛl deɛ.

english_verse: After you offer the first goat as a sacrifice for sin,
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ Aarɔn fa abɔngye bɔ serewa ne yele ye mane AWURADE ne, ná ɔfa bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ;

english_verse: the other one must be presented to me alive, before you send it into the desert to take away the sins of the people.
translation_verse: nakoso abɔngye ko bɔ serewa ne yele ye mane Asasɛl ne de, odi kyɛ bɛfa ye bɔ ɔte ngoa nu ɔ bɛba AWURADE nyunu bɛbayɛ mbata, ná bɛkɔɔyakyi ye ɛserɛ so bɛma Asasɛl.

english_verse: You must offer the bull as a sacrifice to ask forgiveness for your own sins and for the sins of your family.
translation_verse: “Odi kyɛ Aarɔn fa nandwie nyii ne ɔbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ma ye nwo, ná ɔpata ma ye nwo ne ye awuro ama. Ɔsɛ kyɛ oku nandwie nyii ne ná ɔfa bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ma ye nwo.

english_verse: Then you will take a fire pan of live coals from the bronze altar, together with two handfuls of finely ground incense, into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ ɔfa see kulie bɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne anu see gonn ayi ye tɛkyɛ ɔ ɔba AWURADE nyunu, ɔne ɛyɛɛ fona muhumuhu bɛ sa bum nyɔ, ná ɔ́fa bra mbɛmuɛ tena ne asi.

english_verse: There you will present them to me by placing the incense on the coals, so that the place of mercy will be covered with a cloud of smoke. Do this, or you will die right there!
translation_verse: Afei odi kyɛ ɔfa ɛyɛɛ ne ogua see ne aso wɔ AWURADE nyunu, amaa mbata bia bɔ ɔwɔ Adanzeɛ ne aso ne, ɛyɛɛ nwosina ne akata so, ná wanwu.

english_verse: Next, use a finger to sprinkle some of the blood on the place of mercy, which is on the lid of the sacred chest; then sprinkle blood seven times in front of the chest.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔfa nandwie nyii mogya ne bie, ná ɔfa ye sa mmɛseka bɔ nu fa pete mbata bia ne anyunu; ɔ́fa ye sa mmɛseka ne pete mogya ne pɛen nzoo.

english_verse: Aaron, you must next sacrifice the goat for the sins of the people, and you must sprinkle its blood inside the most holy place, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: “Odi kyɛ oku maen bɔne nwo afɔleɛ abɔngye ne, ná ɔ́fa ye mogya ne ɔba mbɛmuɛ ɛtena ne asi. Kyɛbɔ ɔfale nandwie nyii mogya ne yɔle ne, sɔ ala yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔfa abɔngye mogya ne ɔyɔ ɔ; ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa mogya ne pete mbata bia ne aso ne ye nyunu.

english_verse: By doing this, you will take away the sins that make both the most holy place and the people of Israel unclean. Do the same for the sacred tent, which is here among the people.
translation_verse: Sɔa yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔyɔ mbata ma nekaa krongron ne ɔ, ɔnate Yisrael ama bɛ nwo bɔ wagua fiɛ, bɛ mmeraatolɛ, ɔne bɛ bɔne amukoraa ti. Sɔ ala yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔyɔ ma ɛtena sua atenaleɛ bɔ ɔwɔ mmenia bɔ bɛ nwo nde ne b’afia ne ɔ.

english_verse: After leaving the tent, you will purify the bronze altar by smearing each of its four corners with some of the blood from the bull and from the goat.
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ ofite ɔkɔ afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ ɔwɔ AWURADE nyunu ne anwo, ná ɔpata ma afɔleɛ bokyea ne; odi kyɛ ɔfa nandwie nyii mogya ne bie, ɔne abɔngye mogya ne bie kekã afɔleɛ bokyea mmɛen ne anu biala nwo bra yia.

english_verse: Use a finger to sprinkle the altar seven times with the blood, and it will be completely clean from the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔfa ye sa mmɛseka pete mogya ne bie gua so pɛen nzoo, ná ɔte ye nwo ɔyɛ ye krongron fi Yisraelfoɛ nwo bɔ wagua fiɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: After you have purified the most holy place, the sacred tent, and the bronze altar, you must bring the live goat to the front of the tent.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɔsɔfo ne yɛ mbata ma nekaa krongron ne, ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne, ɔne afɔleɛ bokyea ne yie a, odi kyɛ ɔfa abɔngye bɔ ɔte ngoa nu ne ɔba.

english_verse: There you will lay your hands on its head, while confessing every sin the people have committed, and you will appoint someone to lead the goat into the desert, so that it can take away their sins.
translation_verse: Afei odi kyɛ Aarɔn fa ye sa munyɔ gua abɔngye bɔ ɔte ngoa nu ne ye ti afia, ná ɔka Yisraelfoɛ amumuyɛɛ amukoraa, bɛ mmeraatolɛ amukoraa ɔne bɛ bɔne amukoraa gua abɔngye ne aso, ná ɔprapra ye mukoraati gua ye so. Odi kyɛ ɔyakyi abɔngye ne ma bienzua bie bɔ bafa sɔ adwuma ne bawura ye sa maa berɛ ne ala ɔkɔyakyi kaka ne eburo maa ɔkɔ.

english_verse: Finally, this goat that carries the heavy burden of Israel's sins must be released deep in the desert.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ bɛ bɔne amukoraa, abɔngye ne kɔsoa kɔhɔ aseɛ bɔ kuro sona biala ɔtte so ɔ so; na odi kyɛ ɔkɔyakyi abɔngye ne wɔ eburo dɔ.

english_verse: Aaron, after this you must go inside the sacred tent, take a bath, put on your regular priestly clothes, and leave there the clothes you put on before entering the most holy place. Then you will come out and offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices for your sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ ɔfa nzue obia wɔ nekaa bɔ ɔte krongron ɔ, ná owura ye ataadeɛ ne, ná osa ofite babɔ ye naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, ɔne maen naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ná ɔpata ma ye bɔbɔ ye nwo ɔne maen ne.

english_verse: The fat from these sacrifices for sin must be sent up in smoke on the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Ɛloe bɔ ɔwɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ne anu ne, odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne yera ye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso.

english_verse: The one who led the goat into the desert and sent it off to the demon Azazel must take a bath and wash his clothes before coming back into camp.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔyɛ a, ɔkɔyakyi abɔngye ne ma Asasɛl ne, odi kyɛ ɔpo ye ndaadeɛ ná ɔfa nzue bia koraka né wahora wawa asikyeleɛ ne anu.

english_verse: The remains of the bull and the goat whose blood was taken into the most holy place must be taken outside the camp and burned.
translation_verse: Bɔne nwo afɔleɛ nandwie nyii ne, ɔne bɔne nwo afɔleɛ abɔngye ne bɔ bɛfale bɛ mogya bɛɛpatale wɔ nekaa krongron ne anu ne, odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛ bɛkɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi; na bɛ nwomaa, bɛ naen ɔne bɛ fure ne, odi kyɛ bɛfa see bɛyera bɛ.

english_verse: And whoever does this must take a bath and change clothes before coming back into camp. The Lord told Moses to say to the people:
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔkɔyera bɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔpo ye ndaadeɛ ná ɔ́fa nzue bia koraka né wahora wawa asikyeleɛ ne anu.

english_verse: On the tenth day of the seventh month of each year, you must go without eating to show sorrow for your sins, and no one, including foreigners who live among you, is allowed to work.
translation_verse: “Odi kyɛ ɛhe yɛ ahyɛdeɛ ma ɛmɔ: bosome nzoo ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔkye ɛhɔen; kuromani oo, ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ waatena ɛmɔ nu oo, nnɛma ebiala yɔ adwuma biala.

english_verse: This is the day on which the sacrifice for the forgiveness of your sins will be made in my presence,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɔ kyẽa ne yeɛ bɛpata bɛma ɛmɔ, ná bɛfa bɛte ɛmɔ nwo befi ɛmɔ bɔne amukoraa nwo, ma ɛmɔ nwo te wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: and from now on, it must be celebrated each year. Go without eating and make this a day of complete rest just like the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Ɔte afofikyẽa bɔ odi mu paa ma ɛmɔ ɔ. Odi kyɛ ɛmɔkye ɛhɔen; ɔte ahyɛdeɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: The high priest must offer the sacrifices for cleansing from sin, while wearing the sacred linen clothes.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo bɔ bapopa ye ngoo ná bate ye nwo maa waasi ye baba gya nu wayɛ ɔsɔfo ne, ye yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ mbata ne ɔ; odi kyɛ owura nwera ataadeɛ krongron ne.

english_verse: He will offer these sacrifices for the most holy place, the sacred tent, the bronze altar, all the priests, and for the whole community.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔpata ma nekaa krongron ne, ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne, ɔne afɔleɛ bokyea ne; ná afei ɔ́pata ɔ́ma asɔfo nemɔ, ɔne maen ne amukoraa.

english_verse: You must celebrate this day each year—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness for all the sins of the people of Israel. Moses did exactly as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Ɛhe te ahyɛdeɛ afebɔɔ ma ɛmɔ: afoɛ biala odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɛ Yisraelfoɛ bɛ bɔne amukoraa nwo mbata ko. Na Mose yɔle kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to tell Aaron, his sons, and everyone else in Israel:
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua, ɔne Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa kyɛ, ‘Bɔ AWURADE ahyɛ hɔ ɛhe:

english_verse: Whenever you kill any of your cattle, sheep, or goats as sacrifices to me, you must do it at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you don't, you will be guilty of pouring out blood, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: ná wamva ye wamma ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ, wamma ammɔ afɔleɛ wamma AWURADE wɔ AWURADE ɛtena sua ne anyunu a, okoli mogya hagualɛ nwo fɔ. Waha mogya wagua, na odi kyɛ bɛpɛ ye asue befi maen ne anu.

english_verse: And so, when you sacrifice an animal to ask my blessing, it must not be done out in a field,
translation_verse: Ɛhe kɔma Yisraelfoɛ kɔfa b’afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye wɔ ɛserɛ so ne bɛkɔbrɛ AWURADE. Odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛbrɛ ɔsɔfo ne maa ɔfa ma AWURADE wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ, ná ɔ́fa bɔ asomdwee afɔleɛ ma AWURADE.

english_verse: but in front of the sacred tent. Then a priest can splatter its blood against the bronze altar and send its fat up in smoke with a smell that pleases me.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne hwie mogya ne gua AWURADE afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ, ná ɔ́yera ɛloe ne maa ɔyɛ nwosina bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ.

english_verse: except at the entrance to the sacred tent. If you do, you will no longer belong to my people. Do Not Eat Blood The Lord said:
translation_verse: ná wamva wamma ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ wamma ammɔ afɔleɛ ne wamma AWURADE a, odi kyɛ bɛpɛ ye asue befi maen ne anu. Onni kyɛ bedi mogya

english_verse: I will turn against any of my people who eat blood. This also includes any foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ebiala bɔ ofi Yisrael awuro anaakyɛ ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ baatena bɛ nu, odi mogya biala a, ngotu me nye ngosie sɔ sona ne aso, na ngɔpɛ ye asue ngofi maen ne anu.

english_verse: Life is in the blood, and I have given you the blood of animals to sacrifice in place of your own.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ anwoɔnaen biala, ye ngoa wɔ ye mogya nu; na mafa mogya mama ɛmɔ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso kyɛ ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́yɛ mbata bɛ́ma ɛmɔ kra. Ngoa wɔ mogya nu, yiti mogya yeɛ odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛyɛ mbata ɔ.

english_verse: Even if you should hunt and kill a bird or an animal, you must drain out the blood and cover it with soil.
translation_verse: Na Yisraelniɛ biala anaa ɛwɔfoɛ biala bɔ waatena ɛmɔ nu ne, sɛ oku kaka anaa anomaa biala bɔ bedi a, odi kyɛ ohwie ye mogya gua ase ná otu nnɛterɛ kata so.

english_verse: The life of every living creature is in its blood. That's why I have forbidden you to eat blood and why I have warned you that anyone who does will no longer belong to my people.
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ anwoɔnaen biala, ye mogya yeɛ ɔte ye ngoa ɔ; yiti mahã mahyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Nnɛma ɛmɔdi abɔdeɛ biala ye mogya, ofikyɛ anwoɔnaen biala ye mogya yeɛ ɔte ye ngoa ɔ; na ebiala bɔ okoli mogya ne, odi kyɛ bɛpɛ ye asue.

english_verse: If you happen to find a dead animal and eat it, you must take a bath and wash your clothes, but you are still unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Sona biala, kuromani oo, ɛwɔfoɛ oo, bɔ okoli naenmvuin anaa naen biala bɔ kaka aboyaa bie ahu ye atete ye ne, odi kyɛ ɔpo ye nwo nningyein, ná ɔ́fa nzue bia, na ye nwo kogua fiɛ maa okoodwu nɔsoa koraka né ye nwo ate.

english_verse: If you don't take a bath, you will suffer for what you did wrong.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ wambo ye ndaadeɛ anaakyɛ wammia a, ye de, ye musue kɔbɔ ye ti so.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, ‘Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: So don't follow the customs of Egypt where you used to live or those of Canaan where I am bringing you.
translation_verse: Misraim aseɛ bɔ né ɛmɔte so ne, nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ bɛ yɔleɛ ne bie, yeɛ Kanaan aseɛ bɔ méfa ɛmɔ mékɔ so ne, bɛ yɔleɛ ne, nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ bie. Nnɛma ɛmɔdi b’ahyɛdeɛ so.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and you must obey my teachings.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔli me nhyehyɛleɛ ne m’ahyɛdeɛ so, ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́bɔ bɛ bra: Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Obey them and you will live. I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔli m’ahyɛdeɛ ne me nhyehyɛleɛ so, na sona bɔ okoli so ne, okonya ngoa: Me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't have sex with any of your close relatives,
translation_verse: “Nnɛma ɛmɔ nu biala ne ye abusuaniɛ beyia nnaa. Me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: especially your own mother. This would disgrace your father.
translation_verse: Nnɛne eni bɛda ná ɛfa gua ɛse nyunu ase; eni ɛne, nnɛne ye bɛda.

english_verse: And don't disgrace him by having sex with any of his other wives.
translation_verse: Nnɛne ɛse aye bɛda; ɛse aye ɛne.

english_verse: Don't have sex with your sister or stepsister, whether you grew up together or not.
translation_verse: Nnɛne eliɛma brasua, bɔ yeɛ ɔte ɛse awa brasua anaa eni awa brasua bɛda, kyɛ bɛwole ye awuro berɛ oo, anaa bɛwole ye nekaa bie oo.

english_verse: Don't disgrace yourself by having sex with your granddaughter
translation_verse: Nnɛne ɛwa bienzua awa brasua bɛda, ofikyɛ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ mogya ɔ, na ɔte nyanzoen nikye.

english_verse: or a sister of your father or mother.
translation_verse: Nnɛne eni aliɛma brasua bɛda, ofikyɛ eni ne ye bɛte mogya ko.

english_verse: Don't disgrace your uncle by having sex with his wife.
translation_verse: Nnɛne ɛse aliɛma bienzua aye bɛda, nnɛkɔ ɔye anwo; wɔ maame ɛne.

english_verse: Don't have sex with your daughter-in-law
translation_verse: Nnɛne wɔ sia brasua bɛda; ɛwa bienzua aye ɛne; nnɛne ye bɛda.

english_verse: And don't have sex with the daughter or granddaughter of any woman that you have earlier had sex with. You will be having sex with her closest relatives, and that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Nnɛne brasua bɛda ná esa ne ɔwa brasua koso bɛda; yeɛ nnɛne ye anomaa brasua bɛda; ɛne bɛ bayɛ mogya ko, yiti ɔte musue.

english_verse: As long as your wife is alive, don't cause trouble for her by taking one of her sisters as a second wife.
translation_verse: Yeɛ nnɛgya brasua boka oliɛma brasua so, nnɛne ye da wɔ aberɛ bɔ oliɛma brasua ne tɛ te ase ɔ.

english_verse: When a woman is having her monthly period, she is unclean, so don't have sex with her.
translation_verse: “Nnɛkɔ brasua nwo ɛne ye bɛda wɔ mmerɛ bɔ wabu ye sa ɔ.

english_verse: Don't have sex with another man's wife—that would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Nnɛne ebiɛngo aye bɛda, ná angua wɔ ne brasua ne nwo fiɛ.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice your children on the altar fires to the god Molech. I am the Lord your God, and that would disgrace me.
translation_verse: Nnɛfa wɔ mma mɔ nu biala maa bɛfa see bɛyera ye bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma bosoen Moleke, amaa ɔnate so angua wɔ Nyameɛ dumaa nwo fiɛ. Me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: It is disgusting for a man to have sex with another man.
translation_verse: Nnɛma bienzua biala ɔne bienzua bɛda kyɛbɔ ɔne brasua bɛda ɔ; ɔte musue.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves unclean by any of these disgusting practices of those nations that I am forcing out of the land for you. They made themselves
translation_verse: “Nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ ɛhemɔ anu biala begua ɛmɔ nwo fiɛ, ofikyɛ maen maen bɔ méfoa bɛ méfi ɛmɔ nyunu ne, ɔnate sɔ yɔleɛ hemɔ aso yeɛ beguale bɛ nwo fiɛ ɔ,

english_verse: and the land so unclean, that I punished the land because of their sins, and I made it vomit them up.
translation_verse: Efiɛ hane aseɛ ne, maa yiti nduale ye amumuyɛɛ so kerɛ, na mmane aseɛ ne pole so mmenia.

english_verse: Then the land won't become sick of you and vomit you up, just as it did them.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔfa efiɛ bɛka aseɛ ne a, AWURADE kɔma aseɛ ne kɔpo ɛmɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔmane aseɛ ne pole maen bɔ né bɛte so daa ne.

english_verse: If any of you do these vulgar, disgusting things, you will be unclean and no longer belong to my people. I am the Lord your God, and I forbid you to follow their sickening way of life.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔli m’ahyɛdeɛ so, na mmenia bɔ né bɛte aseɛ ne aso daa ne, akyiwadeɛ bɔ bɛyɔle ne, nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ bie, ná ɔnate so ɛmɔangua ɛmɔ nwo fiɛ: Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I am the Lord your God. I am holy, and you must be holy too!
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisrael maen ne amukoraati kyɛ, Ɛ́mɔyɛ krongron ofikyɛ me AWURADE, ɛmɔ Nyameɛ, nde krongron.

english_verse: Respect your father and your mother, honor the Sabbath, and don't make idols or images. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔdi mmosoen si, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔhuro nikyee biala bɛfa bɛyɔ amoen biala bɛfa: Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, be sure to follow my instructions.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛmɔbɔ asomdwee afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE a, odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ ye kyɛbɔ ɔkɔsɔ AWURADE nye ɔ.

english_verse: You may eat the meat either on the day of the sacrifice or on the next day, but you must burn anything left over on the third day.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔdi ye kyẽa bɔ ɛmɔkɔbɔ ye ne ala, anaakyɛ ye alehyeleɛ ne ala; na bɔ yeɛ ɔkɔha berɛ maa okodwu ɛlɛsa ne aso nen, odi kyɛ bɛfa see bɛyera ye.

english_verse: If you eat any of it on the third day, the sacrifice will be disgusting to me, and I will reject it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bedi ye ɛlɛsa ne aso a, ɔte musue; ɔngɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye.

english_verse: In fact, you will be punished for not respecting what I say is holy, and you will no longer belong to the community of Israel.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ okoli bie ne, ye musue kɔbɔ ye ti so, ofikyɛ wafa efiɛ waha bɔ ɔte krongron ma AWURADE; na sɔ sona ne odi kyɛ bɛpɛ ye asue befi maen ne anu.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing along the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ fieso aleɛ a, nnɛma ɛmɔbu maa okodwu eboo ne noa, yeɛ nnɛsesa ye bo nwɔngyerɛmma ne.

english_verse: Don't strip your grapevines clean or gather the grapes that fall off the vines. Leave them for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Wɔ bobe boo koso, nnɛporo so mmaa ne amukoraa, yeɛ bɔ waporo wagua ye bo ne koso, nnɛsesa. Yakyi ye berɛ ma ehiafoɛ ne ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ. Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Do not steal or tell lies or cheat others.
translation_verse: “Nnɛma ɛmɔwua, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔlakalaka bɛ biɛngo; nnɛma ɛmɔpepɛ anoanu bekyirekyire bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name by making promises you don't intend to keep. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: “Nnɛma ɛmɔfa me dumaa bɛta edwirɛ bɔ nahorɛ ɔnne nu ɔ nwo ndaen, ná angua wɔ Nyameɛ dumaa nwo fiɛ: Me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: Do not steal anything or cheat anyone, and don't fail to pay your workers at the end of each day.
translation_verse: “Nnɛdi ebiɛngo ndurum, nnɛwua ye, yeɛ nnɛfa paaniɛ akatuaa wura wɔ nwo ma aleɛ kye so.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I command you not to make fun of the deaf or to cause a blind person to stumble.
translation_verse: Nnɛnoma asotiniwaaniɛ, yeɛ nnɛfa nikyee to anyesiniwaaniɛ atee nu maa ɔfofo so, ná mmom suro wɔ Nyameɛ: Me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't be a gossip, but never hesitate to speak up in court, especially if your testimony can save someone's life.
translation_verse: Nnɛkyinikyini kekã mmenia nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ, nnɛdi adanzewia ma ebiɛngo nya ewue, ná enya ye wue si mvasoɛ: Me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't hold grudges. On the other hand, it's wrong not to correct someone who needs correcting.
translation_verse: Nnɛdwene ebiɛngo nwo adwene tɛɛ, na mmom fa edwirɛ tɛɛ bɔ wayɔ ne to ye nyunu, ná anza ye nwo anyɔ bɔne.

english_verse: Don't be angry or try to take revenge. I am the Lord, and I command you to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Nnɛtɔ wɔ mmenia ne anu biala so wereɛ, yeɛ nnɛfa ebiala nwo dwirɛ sie wɔ ti anu, na mmom kuro ebiɛngo dwirɛ kyɛ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo: me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: Breed your livestock animals only with animals of the same kind, and don't plant two kinds of seed in the same field or wear clothes made of different kinds of material.
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔli m’ahyɛdeɛ so. Wɔ nyɛmmoa mɔ, sɛ bɛte ahoroɔ ahoroɔ a, nnɛmaa bedi mvrafra bɛfo bɛ nwo; nnɛdua mmakaammaa ahoroɔ nyɔ wɔ wɔ fieso, yeɛ nnɛwura ataadeɛ bɔ bafa ɛtena ahoroɔ nyɔ batoto ye nzaasaa ɔ.

english_verse: If a man has sex with a slave woman who is promised in marriage to someone else, he must pay a fine, but they are not to be put to death. After all, she was still a slave at the time.
translation_verse: “Sɛ bienzua bie ne brasua bie bɔ ɔte afaneɛ bɔ bafa ye babɔ bienzua bie asiwa bɛda a, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bienzua bɔ bafa ye babɔ ye asiwa ne onnya ottuale brasua ne ti kerɛ ɔffa ɔppɔle ye, yeɛ brasua ne sa onnya ɔhhane ye fawɔnwodi de, nakoso odi kyɛ bɛtwe bɛ so. Onni kyɛ beku bɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ né afaneɛ ne olle ye nwo.

english_verse: The man must bring a ram to the entrance of the sacred tent and give it to a priest, who will then offer it as a sacrifice to me, so the man's sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ boaen nyii ne pata ma bienzua ne wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ɔnate bɔne bɔ wayɔ ne ati; na AWURADE kɔfa bɔne bɔ wayɔ ne kɔhyɛ ye.

english_verse: After you enter the land, you will plant fruit trees, but you are not to eat any fruit from them for the first three years.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛmɔbadwu aseɛ ne aso, ná ɛmɔdua fieso mmakaammaa ahoroɔ a, ɛ́mɔbu bɛ mma bɔ bekosu ne kyɛ akyiwadeɛ; ɛ́mɔma ɔ́yɛ ɛmɔ akyiwadeɛ afoɛ nza, na onni kyɛ ɛmɔdi ɔ.

english_verse: In the fourth year the fruit must be set apart, as an expression of thanks
translation_verse: Ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne aso, mmaa bɔ bekosu ne amukoraati kɔyɛ krongron, bɔ ɔte ayɛyelɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: to me, the Lord God. Do this, and in the fifth year, those trees will produce an abundant harvest of fruit for you to eat.
translation_verse: Nakoso ye afoɛ nnu ne aso de, ɛ́mɔli bɛ mma bɔ bekosu ne bie, amaa ɔnate so basu pee bama ɛmɔ: Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Don't eat the blood of any animal. Don't practice any kind of witchcraft.
translation_verse: “Nnɛma ɛmɔdi naen bɔ ye mogya wɔ ye nu ɔ. Nnɛma ɛmɔkɔ abisa, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ bayie.

english_verse: I forbid you to shave any part of your head or beard or to cut and tattoo yourself as a way of worshiping the dead.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie wu a, nnɛma ɛmɔfa nikyee bɛtete ɛmɔ nwonaen. Nnɛma ɛmɔdi ngyerɛleɛ begua ɛmɔ nwonaen nu.

english_verse: Don't let your daughters serve as temple prostitutes—this would bring disgrace both to them and the land.
translation_verse: “Nnɛma ɛwa brasua bɔ gyandera ma ye nwo gua fiɛ, amaa aseɛ ne angakyi gyanderafoɛ aseɛ, ná nzɛmmɔne anzone wɔ so.

english_verse: I command you to respect the Sabbath and the place where I am worshiped.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔli m’afofingyẽa so, ná ɛ́mɔli me nekaa krongron ne ni: Me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't make yourselves disgusting to me by going to people who claim they can talk to the dead.
translation_verse: “Nnɛma ɛmɔkɔ nzamangɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne ahɔmeɛ mɔ berɛ bɛkɔpena mmokalɛ befi bɛ berɛ maa begua ɛmɔ nwo fiɛ: Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: I command you to show respect for older people and to obey me with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: “Fa ebulɛ ma panyi, di nworowaa ni, ná suro wɔ Nyameɛ: Me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: Don't mistreat any foreigners who live in your land.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛwɔfoɛ bie batena ɛmɔ nu wɔ ɛmɔ aseɛ ne aso a, nnɛma ɛmɔhyɛ ye so.

english_verse: Instead, treat them as well as you treat your own people and love them as much as you love yourself. Remember, you were once foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ waatena ɛmɔ nu ne, ɛ́mɔfa ye kyɛ ɔte kuromani; ná kuro ɛwɔfoɛ ne dwirɛ kyɛ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo, ofikyɛ né ɛmɔte ɛwɔfoɛ wɔ Misraim aseɛ so: Me ole AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Use honest scales and don't cheat when you weigh or measure anything. I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt,
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ tonyi, ɛmɔ asusudeɛ nyɔboɛ, graa ɔne galɔn bɔ ɛmɔfa besusu nikyee ne, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ turoloo: Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ bɔ nyele ɛmɔ mvili Misraim aseɛ so mmale ne.

english_verse: and I command you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔli m’ahyɛdeɛ amukoraa ne me nhyehyɛleɛ amukoraa so, ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́bɔ bɛ bra: Me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Death by stoning is the penalty for any citizens or foreigners in the country who sacrifice their children to the god Molech.
translation_verse: “Sá ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ: Yisraelniɛ biala anaa ɛwɔfoɛ biala bɔ ɔte Yisraelfoɛ maen nu, bɔ yeɛ ɔkɔfa ɔwa biala kɔbɔ afɔleɛ kɔma bosoen Moleke ne, odi kyɛ beku ye; aseɛ ne aso mmenia bɛ́boro ye nyɔboɛ béhu ye.

english_verse: They have disgraced both the place where I am worshiped and my holy name, and so I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people.
translation_verse: Me bɔbɔ deinn ngotu me nye ngosie sɔ sona ne aso, na ngɔpɛ ye asue ngofi ye maen nu, ofikyɛ wafa ɔwa wama Moleke; wafa efiɛ waha me nekaa krongron ne, na wagua me dumaa krongron ne anyunu ase.

english_verse: Some of you may let them get away with human sacrifice,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔfa ɔwa ma Moleke, ná maen ne anu mmenia bu bɛ nye begua so, ná bangu ye a,

english_verse: but not me. If any of you worship Molech, I will turn against you and your entire family, and I will no longer let you belong to my people.
translation_verse: ye de me bɔbɔ ngotu me nye ngosie sɔ sona ne ɔne ye abusuafoɛ so, na ngɔpɛ bɛ asue ngofi bɛ maen nu; sɔ sona ne ɔne mmenia amukoraa bɔ bali ye si bɛ ne ye baaso Moleke ne.

english_verse: I will be your enemy if you go to someone who claims to speak with the dead, and I will destroy you from among my people.
translation_verse: “Na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔhɔ nzamangɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne ahɔmeɛ so, ná okoli bɛ si ne, ngotu me nye ngosie sɔ sona ne aso, na ngɔpɛ ye asue ngofi ye maen nu.

english_verse: Dedicate yourselves to me and be holy because I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔte ɛmɔ nwo, ná ɛ́mɔyɛ krongron, ofikyɛ me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: I have chosen you as my people, and I expect you to obey my laws.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔli m’ahyɛdeɛ so, ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́bɔ bɛ bra: Me ole AWURADE, Me yeɛ mete ɛmɔ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: If you curse your father or mother, you will be put to death, and it will be your own fault.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔnoma ɔse anaa oni ne, odi kyɛ beku ye, ɔnate kyɛ wanoma ɔse anaa oni, na ye wue kɔbɔ ye bɔbɔ ye ti so.

english_verse: If any of you men have sex with another man's wife, both you and the woman will be put to death.
translation_verse: “Sɛ bienzua bie ne obiɛngo aye bɛbɔ adwaman a, odi kyɛ beku bienzua ne ɔne brasua bɔ babɔ adwaman ne bɛ munyɔ.

english_verse: Having sex with one of your father's wives disgraces him. So both you and the woman will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Bienzua bɔ ɔne ɔse aye bɛkɔla ne, wagua ɔse nyunu ase; odi kyɛ beku bɛ munyɔ: baa ne ɔne braa ne, na bɛ wue kɔbɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti so.

english_verse: It isn't natural to have sex with your daughter-in-law, and both of you will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Sɛ bienzua bie ne ɔwa bienzua aye bɛda a, odi kyɛ beku bɛ munyɔ: baba ne ɔne sia ne; na bɛ wue kɔbɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti so.

english_verse: It's disgusting for men to have sex with one another, and those who do will be put to death, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Sɛ bienzua bie ne obiɛngo bienzua bɛda kyɛbɔ ɔne brasua bɛda a, bɛ munyɔ babɔ musue. Odi kyɛ beku bɛ ɔ, na bɛ wue kɔbɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti so.

english_verse: It isn't natural for a man to marry both a woman and her daughter, and so all three of them will be burned to death.
translation_verse: Sɛ bienzua gya braa ná osa gya braa ne maame boka so a, wabɔ musue; odi kyɛ bɛyera bɛ: biaa ne ɔne mmrasua nemɔ, amaa musue anga ɛmɔ.

english_verse: If any of you have sex with an animal, both you and the animal will be put to death, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: Sɛ brasua bie fa ye nwo ma kaka bie maa ɔne ye bɛda a, ku brasua ne ɔne kaka ne; odi kyɛ beku bɛ ɔ, na bɛ wue kɔbɔ bɛ ti so.

english_verse: If you have sex with a woman during her monthly period, both you and the woman will be cut off from the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Sɛ bienzua bie ne brasua bɔ wabu ye sa bɛda a, wabukye nekaa bɔ brasua ne mogya fi ba ɔ so, yeɛ brasua ne koso wabukye nekaa bɔ ye bɔbɔ ye mogya fi ba ɔ so; odi kyɛ bɛpɛ bɛ munyɔ asue befi maen ne anu.

english_verse: The sisters of your father and mother are your own relatives, and you will be punished for having sex with any of them.
translation_verse: Nnɛne eni aliɛma brasua anaa wɔ sewaa bɛda; sɛ ɛyɔ sɔ a, wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwoniɛ yeɛ ɛne ye ala ɔ; odi kyɛ bɛtwe bɛ so.

english_verse: If you have sex with your uncle's wife, neither you nor she will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie ne ye wɔfa aye bɛda a, wagua ye wɔfa nyunu ase, na ɔne brasua ne bɛ musue kɔbɔ bɛ ti so. Bɛ mma amukoraati kofi bɛ sa koraka né bawu.

english_verse: And if you marry your sister-in-law, neither of you will ever have any children.
translation_verse: Sɛ bienzua bie ne oliɛma aye bɛda a, wabɔ musue; wagua oliɛma ne nyunu ase na ɔne braa ne, bɛ mma amukoraati kofi bɛ sa koraka né bawu.

english_verse: Obey my laws and teachings. Or else the land I am giving you will become sick of you and throw you out.
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔli m’ahyɛdeɛ amukoraa ne me nhyehyɛleɛ amukoraa so, ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́bɔ bɛ bra, ná mamma aseɛ bɔ méfa ɛmɔ mékɔ so ne wambo ɛmɔ.

english_verse: The nations I am chasing out did these disgusting things, and I hated them for it, so don't follow their example.
translation_verse: Maen maen bɔ mefoa bɛ mefi ɛmɔ nyunu ne, bɛ yɔleɛ nemɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ bie. Ɔnate kyɛ bɛyɔle sɔ nningyein nemɔ ati, mvɛle bɛ so yaa paa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have promised you their land that is rich with milk and honey. I have chosen you to be different from other people.
translation_verse: Nakoso mahã mahyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, Ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔkɔfa b’aseɛ ne ɔ, na ngɔfa aseɛ bɔ nyɔfonesue ne woɛ tengyɛ wɔ so ɔ ngɔma ɛmɔ maa ɔkɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ, na maye ɛmɔ masie ahameɛ mafi maen maen ngaa nemɔ anu.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the holy God. You have been chosen to be my people, and so you must be holy too.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔyɛ krongron bɛ́ma me, ofikyɛ me AWURADE, nde krongron, na maye ɛmɔ masie ahameɛ mafi maen ngaa nemɔ anu mayɛ me deɛ.

english_verse: If you claim to receive messages from the dead, you will be put to death by stoning, just as you deserve.
translation_verse: “Bienzua anaa brasua bɔ ɔte nzamangɔmhyɛlɛniɛ anaa kɔmeɛ ne, odi kyɛ beku ye ɔ; bɛ́boro bɛ nyɔboɛ béhu bɛ, na bɛ wue kɔbɔ bɛ ti so.”

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses these instructions for Aaron's sons, the priests: Touching a dead body will make you unclean. So don't go near a dead relative,
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Ka kyire Aarɔn mma mmienzua asɔfo nemɔ kyɛ, Nnɛma ɛmɔ nu biala kɔ ye abusuafoɛ fuin nwo ma ye nwo gua fiɛ,

english_verse: or an unmarried sister, who has no husband to take care of her.
translation_verse: yeɛ oliɛma brasua kaenn bɔ ɔte ababunu bɔ onnwuni biaa le ɔ, ofikyɛ onnya oggyale biaa. Ɔnate oliɛma brasua ne ati, ɔkora gua ye nwo fiɛ.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by attending the funeral of someone related to you by marriage.
translation_verse: Nakoso nnɛmaa ɔyɔ huɛ asɛdeɛ ma ye abusuaniɛ biala bɔ ogya biaa ɔ, ná wangua ye bɔbɔ ye nwo fiɛ.

english_verse: Don't shave any part of your head or trim your beard or cut yourself to show that you are mourning.
translation_verse: Nnɛmaa bepiapia bɛ ti nwiaa maa ɔyɛ nguruwa nguruwa, nnɛmaa bepiapia bɛ kanza nwiaa bɛyɛ ye basaa, yeɛ nnɛmaa bɛfa nikyee bɛtete bɛ nwonaen.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I have chosen you alone to offer sacrifices of food to me on the altar. That's why you must keep yourselves holy.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛyɛ krongron bɛma bɛ Nyameɛ, na ɔnzɛ kyɛ begua bɛ Nyameɛ dumaa nwo fiɛ; ofikyɛ afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE, bɔ ɔte bɛ Nyameɛ aleɛ ne, bɛ yeɛ bɛbɔ ɔ; yiti odi kyɛ bɛyɛ krongron.

english_verse: Don't marry a divorced woman or a woman who has served as a temple prostitute. You are holy,
translation_verse: Onni kyɛ begya gyanderaniɛ anaa brasua bɔ ebie ne ye ala le ɔ; yeɛ nnɛmaa begya brasua bɔ ohu ayira ye ɔ, ofikyɛ asɔfo mɔ te krongron ma bɛ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: because I am holy. And so, you must be treated with proper respect, since you offer food sacrifices to me, the God of holiness.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ Yisraelniɛ biala nwu asɔfo mɔ kyɛ bɛte krongron, ofikyɛ bɛ yeɛ bɛbɔ aleɛ afɔleɛ bɛma wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ; nwu bɛ kyɛ bɛte krongron, ofikyɛ me AWURADE bɔ mete ɛmɔ nwo ne, nde krongron.

english_verse: If any of you priests has a daughter who disgraces you by serving as a temple prostitute, she must be burned to death.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔsɔfo awa brasua bɔ adwaman fa gua ye bɔbɔ ye nwo fiɛ a, ye de wagua ye baba nwo fiɛ, odi kyɛ bɛyera baa brasua ne.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must not mess up your hair or tear your clothes in order to mourn for the dead.
translation_verse: “Ɔsɔfo panyi paa, bɔ ye yeɛ bahwie ɛpopalɛ ngoo bagua ye ti so, ná bate ye nwo kyɛ ówura asɔfo ndaadeɛ ne, onni kyɛ ɔma ye ti nwiaa gua so basaa, yeɛ nnɛmaa osunzua ye ndaadeɛ nu.

english_verse: Don't make yourself unclean by going near a dead body, not even that of your own father or mother.
translation_verse: Onni kyɛ ɔkɔ efuin biala nwo, onni kyɛ ogua ye nwo fiɛ, kyɛ ɔse fuin ahɔ oo, anaa oni deɛ ahɔ oo.

english_verse: If you leave the sacred place to attend a funeral, both you and the sacred place become unclean, because you are the high priest.
translation_verse: Onni kyɛ ofi nekaa krongron berɛ kɔ ɛsɛen bo, na wangua ye Nyameɛ nekaa krongron ne nwo fiɛ; ofikyɛ bafa ye Nyameɛ ɛpopalɛ ngoo bate ye nwo: Me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: If you are the high priest, you must marry only a virgin
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ brasua bɔ onnwuni biaa le angome yeɛ ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne ogya ye ɔ.

english_verse: from your own tribe. Don't marry a divorced woman or any other woman who has already had sex, including a temple prostitute.
translation_verse: Onni kyɛ ogya brasua kunaniɛ, anaa brasua bɔ bayira ye ɔ, anaa brasua bɔ ebie ne ye ala le ɔ, anaa gyanderaniɛ. Ye bɔbɔ ye abusua nu brasua bɔ onnwuni biaa le yeɛ odi kyɛ ogya ye ɔ;

english_verse: In this way, your descendants will be qualified to serve me. Remember—I am the Lord, and I have chosen you.
translation_verse: amaa ye boso ama nwo angua fiɛ wɔ ye abusua nu; ofikyɛ me ole AWURADE bɔ mete ye nwo ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to Aaron: No descendant of yours can ever serve as my priest if he is blind or lame, if his face is disfigured, if one leg is shorter than the other,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ onni kyɛ ebiala bɔ wali nnɛen ba afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo: kyɛ anyesiniwaaniɛ oo, bubuaniɛ oo, bɔ wali nnɛen wɔ ye nyunu oo anaa sona bɔ watɔ bue oo,

english_verse: if either a foot or a hand is paralyzed,
translation_verse: bɔ ye gya nu anaa ye sa nu abu oo,

english_verse: if he is a hunchback or a dwarf, if an eye or his skin is diseased, or if his testicles have been damaged.
translation_verse: afu oo, twɛtwerɛbɛdɛ oo, bɔ ɛtɛen asi ye nye so oo, bɔ anwonyerɛ kyeekyee agua ye nwo oo, bɔ ngena atutu ye oo, anaa bɔ ye ndɔma abɔ hɔ oo.

english_verse: They may eat the food offerings presented to me,
translation_verse: Ye Nyameɛ aleɛ ne, bɔ ɔte krongron paa ɔne bɔ ɔte krongron ne, ɔkɔhora koli bie.

english_verse: but they may not enter the sacred place or serve me at the altar. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔnate kyɛ wali nnɛen ne ati, nnɛmaa opingye mbɛmuɛ tena ne anaakyɛ ɔba afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo, ná wamva efiɛ wanga nekaa krongron ne, ɔne nu nningyein; ofikyɛ me ole AWURADE bɔ mete bɛ nwo ɔ.”

english_verse: Moses told all of this to Aaron, his sons, and the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Yiti Mose hane sɔ dwirɛ hemɔ hyirele Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ ne Yisrael maen amukoraati.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to Aaron and his sons: I am the Lord God, and I demand that you honor my holy name by showing proper respect for the offerings brought to me by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ kyɛ, Yisraelfoɛ akyɛdeɛ krongron bɔ batu basie berɛ bama me ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛnea ye yé, ná bangua me dumaa krongron ne anwo fiɛ: Me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: None of you may take part in the sacred meals while you have a skin disease or an infected penis, or after you have been near a dead body or have had a flow of semen,
translation_verse: Aarɔn bosoniɛ biala bɔ ɔte kwataniɛ, anaakyɛ ye bienzua afiti ne, mmɛɛmaa odi sɔ akyɛdeɛ krongron ne bie kɔpem kyɛ ye nwo kofi ɔ. Sɛ bɛ nu bie nwo ka ɛhemɔ anu biala a, ye nwo kogua fiɛ: nikyee biala bɔ ye nwo kɔha fuin ma ye nwo kogua fiɛ ɔ, bienzua bɔ ye nwo nzue kɔwa ɔ,

english_verse: Once you are unclean, you must take a bath, but you still cannot eat any of the sacred food until evening.
translation_verse: Sɛ eyia kɔtɔ a yeɛ ye nwo kɔte ɔ, na ye si ye ɔkɔhora koli akyɛdeɛ krongron ne bie, ofikyɛ aleɛ ne te ye deɛ.

english_verse: I command you not to eat anything that is killed by a wild animal or dies a natural death. This would make you unclean.
translation_verse: Naenmvuin anaa naen bɔ kaka aboyaa bie ahu ye atete ye de, nnɛmaa odi ná wamva wangua ye nwo fiɛ: Me ole AWURADE.’

english_verse: Obey me, or you will die on duty for disgracing the place of worship. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes a priest holy.
translation_verse: Asɔfo nemɔ beli m’ahyɛdeɛ so, amaa bangua me nekaa krongron ne anwo fiɛ, ná banni fɔ ná banwuwu: Me ole AWURADE bɔ mete bɛ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Only you priests and your families may eat the food offerings; these are too sacred for any of your servants.
translation_verse: “Ebiala bɔ ɔbboka asɔfo abusua kure ne aso ne, nnɛmaa odi akyɛdeɛ krongron ne bie. Ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ waasikye ɔsɔfo, anaa sona biala bɔ ɔsɔfo bie abɔ ye paa ne, ɔnzɛ kyɛ odi akyɛdeɛ krongron ne bie.

english_verse: If your daughter marries someone who isn't a priest, she can no longer have any of this food.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔsɔfo bie awa brasua gya biaa bɔ nna asɔfo abusua kure ne anu yeɛ ofi hɔ a, ye de sɔ braa ne, ɔnzɛ kyɛ odi akyɛdeɛ krongron bɔ bafa babɔ afɔleɛ ne bie.

english_verse: But if she returns to your home, either widowed or divorced, and has no children, she may join in the meal. Only members of a priestly family can eat this food,
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɔsɔfo awa brasua bayɛ kunaniɛ, anaa ohu yira ye bɔ olle ba, ná osa batena ye baba awuro kyɛbɔ ye ndaluwa nu ɔtenane berɛ ne a, ye de ɔkora odi ye baba aleɛ ne bie. Sona biala bɔ nna ɔsɔfo abusua kure ne anu yeɛ ofi ne de, ɔnzɛ kyɛ odi bie ɔ.

english_verse: must have nothing wrong with them, or else I won't accept them. Bulls or rams or goats are the animals to be used for these sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔfa kaka biala bɔ wali nnɛen bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE, ofikyɛ ɔngɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye.

english_verse: I warn you not to treat lightly the offerings that are brought by the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ akyɛdeɛ krongron bɔ bɛfa bɛma AWURADE ne, nnɛma ebiala gua ye nwo fiɛ,

english_verse: Don't let them become guilty of eating this sacred food. Remember—I am the Lord, the one who makes these offerings holy. Acceptable Sacrifices
translation_verse: amaa sɛ bedi b’akyɛdeɛ krongron bɔ ye nwo agua fiɛ ne a, sona bɔ ɔfale afɔleɛ ne wale ne wanni ye nwo fɔ bɔ okohia kyɛ ɔkɔbɔ foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ ɔ; ofikyɛ me ole AWURADE bɔ mete bɛ nwo ne.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to tell Aaron and his sons and everyone else the rules for offering sacrifices. He said: The animals that are to be completely burned on the altar
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ ne Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati kyɛ, ‘Sɛ ebiala bɔ ofi Yisrael awuro anaa ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ baatena Yisrael maen nu ɔfa afɔleɛ brɛ AWURADE a, kyɛ aboadeɛ yeɛ otua oo, anaakyɛ akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔfa bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ oo,

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to ask my blessing, there must be nothing wrong with the animal. This is true, whether the sacrifice is part of a promise or something you do voluntarily.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie bɔ asomdwee afɔleɛ ma AWURADE a, kyɛ aboadeɛ yeɛ otua oo, anaa ɔte akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ oo, kyɛ ofi nandwie kure nu anaa mmoaen kure nu oo, odi kyɛ odi mu koraka né wasɔ Nyameɛ nye; onni kyɛ ɔyɛ bɔ wali nnɛen biala ɔ.

english_verse: If one of your cattle or lambs has a leg that is longer or shorter than the others, you may offer it voluntarily, but not as part of a promise.
translation_verse: Nandwie biala anaa boaen biala bɔ ye nekaa bie ayɛ tendenn anaa tika watra ko ne, ɛkɔhora kɔfa kɔbɔ akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ, nakoso ɛfa yɛ aboadeɛ de a, Nyameɛ nye ngɔsɔ.

english_verse: And don't bring me animals you bought from a foreigner. I won't accept them, because they are no better than one that has something wrong with it.
translation_verse: yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔde sɔ ngaka nemɔ bie befi ɛwɔfoɛ bie berɛ bɛfa bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma ɛmɔ Nyameɛ. Ɔnate kyɛ ngekalewa wɔ bɛ nwo ná bali nnɛen ne ati, Nyameɛ nye ngɔsɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: Newborn cattle, sheep, or goats must remain with their mothers for seven days, but on the eighth day, you may send them up in smoke to me, and I will accept the offering.
translation_verse: “Sɛ bɛwo nandwie anaa boaen anaa abɔngye a, ɔkɔtena oni anwo ɛlɛsoo. Ofi ye ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso ne, sɛ bɛyera ye bɛfa bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE a, ye nye kɔsɔ.

english_verse: Don't sacrifice a newborn animal and its mother on the same day.
translation_verse: Sɛ nandwie oo, sɛ boaen oo, nnɛma ɛmɔku kaka oni ne ɔwa ɛlɛho.

english_verse: When you offer a sacrifice to give thanks to me, you must do it in a way that is acceptable.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔbɔ asennaa afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE a, ɛ́mɔbɔ ye kyɛbɔ ɔkɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ.

english_verse: Eat all of the meat that same day and don't save any for the next day. I am the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bedi afɔleɛ ne ɛlɛho ne ala; nnɛma ɛmɔyakyi bie ma aleɛ kye so: Me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: I demand respect from the people of Israel, so don't disgrace my holy name. Remember—I am the one who chose you to be priests and rescued all of you from Egypt, so that I would be your Lord.
translation_verse: Me ole AWURADE bɔ nyele ɛmɔ mvili Misraim aseɛ so mmale ne, bɔ me yeɛ nde ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ɔ: Me ole AWURADE.”

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: I have chosen certain times for you to come together and worship me.
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Ɛhemɔ ole aluolue ahoroɔ bɔ AWURADE atu asie berɛ ɔ, na ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́to dwaa kyɛ bɛte nyianu krongron; m’aluolue nemɔ mmerɛ ɛne. Afofikyẽa

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work, but the seventh day of each week is holy because it belongs to me. No matter where you live, you must rest on the Sabbath and come together for worship. This law will never change. Passover and the Festival of Thin Bread (Numbers
translation_verse: Elesia yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛ́yɔ adwuma ɔ, nakoso kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne de, ɔte nwomelelɛ kyẽa bɔkɔɔ. Ɔte nyianu krongron, ná onni kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala; ɔte afofikyẽa ma AWURADE wɔ nekaa biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔtena ɔ. Abɔtra Aluolue ne Paanoo Kabrɛdi Aluolue

english_verse: No one is to work on that day—it is the Great Day of Forgiveness, when sacrifices will be offered to me, so that I will forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala sɔ kyẽa ne amukoraa, ofikyɛ ɔte mbata kyẽa bɔ yeɛ bɛpata bɛma ɛmɔ wɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: Passover is another time when you must come together to worship me, and it must be celebrated on the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
translation_verse: Bosome bɔ oli moa ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nna ne, ye nɔsoa, odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ Abɔtra afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE.

english_verse: Each day of this festival you must offer sacrifices. Then on the final day you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship. Offering the First Part of the Harvest
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ see so afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE ɛlɛsoo; na kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne, ɛ́mɔyɛ nyianu krongron; nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala. Eboo nu aleɛ bɔ oli moa ɔ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land I am giving you, the first bundle of wheat from each crop must be given to me. So bring it to a priest
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Sɛ ɛmɔbadwu aseɛ bɔ méfa méma ɛmɔ ne aso, ná ɛmɔfa so aleɛ a, ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ aleɛ bɔ oli moa ne taperɛ ko bɛbrɛ ɔsɔfo.

english_verse: and two kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil. Then he will place these on the bronze altar and send them up in smoke with a smell that pleases me. Together with these, you must bring a liter of wine as a drink offering.
translation_verse: Na aburoo afɔleɛ bɔ ɔboka so ne, odi kyɛ bɛfa esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ olonka nyɔ; ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ bɛma see so bɛma AWURADE ná ɔbo ye fona ɔ. Anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔboka so ne, odi kyɛ bɛfa bobe nzaa towaa ko ne bue.

english_verse: I am your God, and I forbid you to eat any new grain or anything made from it until you have brought these offerings. This law will never change. The Harvest Festival (Numbers
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔdi aburoo monɛ ne bie, kyɛ bafa bayɛ paanoo oo, kyɛ bahye oo, anaakyɛ ye monɛ oo, kɔpem kyẽa bɔ ɛmɔkɔfa ɛmɔ Nyameɛ afɔleɛ bɛkɔbrɛ ye ɔ. Ɔte ahyɛdeɛ afebɔɔ ma ɛmɔ wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraati nu, wɔ nekaa biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔtena ɔ. Dapɛn Dapɛn aluolue (Numeri

english_verse: The Lord God said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: None of my people are ever to do any work on that day—not now or in the future. And I will wipe out those who do!
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala: ɔte ahyɛdeɛ afebɔɔ ma ɛmɔ wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraati nu, wɔ nekaa biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔtena ɔ.

english_verse: Seven weeks after you offer this bundle of grain, each family must bring another offering of new grain.
translation_verse: “Kyẽa bɔ ɔtoa afofikyẽa ne aso, bɔ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa aleɛ taperɛ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ bɛba ne, ɛ́mɔhyɛ ye bo bɛha dapɛn nzoo pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Bring two loaves of bread to be lifted up in dedication to me. Each loaf is to be made with yeast and with two kilograms of the finest flour from the first part of your harvest.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa paanoo mumua nyɔ befi ɛmɔ atenaleɛ nemɔ anu bɛbabɔ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ maa ɔyɛ aleɛ bɔ bali moa bate afɔleɛ ma AWURADE. Odi kyɛ paanoo ko biala bɛfa esam paa bɔ bafa mɔle harewaa bafra ɔ olonka nyɔ yeɛ bɛto ɔ.

english_verse: At this same time, the entire community of Israel must bring seven lambs that are a year old, a young bull, and two rams. These animals must have nothing wrong with them, and they must be offered as a sacrifice to please me. You must also offer the proper grain and wine sacrifices with each animal.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa ɛhemɔ bɛboka paanoo ne aso: mmoaen nzoo bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko bɔ bellili nnɛen ɔ, nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma ko, ɔne mmoaen nyii nyɔ; odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE. Aburoo afɔleɛ ne anonneɛ afɔleɛ ne koso boka so, na ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE ná ɔbo ye fona ɔ.

english_verse: Offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin, and two rams a year old as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Afei koso, ɛ́mɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛ́bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ, ná ɛ́mɔfa mmoaen nyii nyɔ bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko bɛbɔ asomdwee afɔleɛ.

english_verse: The priest will lift up the rams together with the bread in dedication to me. These offerings are holy and are my gift to the priest.
translation_verse: Ngaka nemɔ, ɔne paanoo bɔ bafa aleɛ bɔ bali moa bate yeɛ bato ne, odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne pagya bɛ fa bɔ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, mmoaen nyɔ ne boka so. Bɛte krongron ma AWURADE, na bɛkɔyɛ ɔsɔfo ne deɛ.

english_verse: This is a day of celebration and worship, a time of rest from your work. You and your descendants must obey this law.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne ala, odi kyɛ ɛmɔyia nu; ɔte nyianu krongron. Nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala. Ɛhe te ahyɛdeɛ afebɔɔ ma ɛmɔ wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraati nu, wɔ nekaa biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔtena ɔ.

english_verse: When you harvest your grain, always leave some of it standing around the edges of your fields and don't pick up what falls on the ground. Leave it for the poor and for those foreigners who live among you. I am the Lord your God! The Festival of Trumpets (Numbers
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ fieso aleɛ a, nnɛbu maa okodwu fie ne noa, yeɛ nnɛsesa ye bo nwɔngyerɛmma ne; yakyi ɛhene mɔ ma ehiafoɛ ne ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ: Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.” Totorobɛndo aluolue (Numeri
