english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. It is a solemn day of worship; everyone must go without eating to show sorrow for their sins, and sacrifices must be burned.
translation_verse: “Sɔ bosome nzoo ne ala, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne, ɔte mbata kyẽa; ɛ́mɔyɛ nyianu krongron. Odi kyɛ ɛmɔkye ɛhɔen ná ɛ́mɔbɔ see so afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE.

english_verse: This is a time of complete rest just like the Sabbath, and everyone must go without eating from the evening of the ninth to the evening of the tenth. The Festival of Shelters (Numbers
translation_verse: Ɔkɔyɛ nwomelelɛ kyẽa bɔkɔɔ kɔma ɛmɔ, na odi kyɛ ɛmɔkye ɛhɔen fi bosome ne, ye ɛlɛhona ne nɔsoa; ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdi afofikyẽa ne aso fi nɔsoa kodwu nɔsoa.” Asese aluolue (Numeri

english_verse: Pick the best fruit from your trees and cut leafy branches to use during the time of this joyous celebration in my honor.
translation_verse: Kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, ɛ́mɔfa mmakaa paa bɛ mma, ɛberɛ, bakaa kusuu mmaen frɔmfrɔm, ɔne asuenoa mmakaa; ná ɛ́mɔli ahurusi AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ nyunu ɛlɛsoo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Bosome nzoo ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nnu ne, odi kyɛ bedi Asese aluolue ɛlɛsoo bɛma AWURADE.

english_verse: No one is to do any work on the first day of the festival—it is a time when everyone must come together for worship.
translation_verse: Kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɛ nyianu krongron; nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala.

english_verse: For seven days, sacrifices must be offered on the altar. The eighth day is also to be a day of complete rest, as well as a time of offering sacrifices on the altar and of coming together for worship.
translation_verse: Ɛlɛsoo yeɛ ɛ́mɔbɔ see so afɔleɛ bɛ́ma AWURADE ɔ; na ye ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso, ɛ́mɔyɛ nyianu krongron ná ɛ́mɔbɔ see so afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE; ɔte nyianu krongron; nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala.

english_verse: I have chosen these festivals as times when my people must come together for worship and when animals, grain, and wine are to be offered on the proper days.
translation_verse: “Ɛhemɔ ole AWURADE aluolue ahoroɔ bɔ odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɛ nyianu krongron bedi ɔ. Na kyɛbɔ kyẽa bɔ watu wasie berɛ wama aluolue biala te nen, ɛ́mɔbɔ see so afɔleɛ bɛ́ma AWURADE: naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, aburoo afɔleɛ, ngaka afɔleɛ ne anonneɛ afɔleɛ.

english_verse: These festivals must be celebrated in addition to the Sabbaths and the times when you offer special gifts or sacrifices to keep a promise or as a voluntary offering.
translation_verse: AWURADE afofingyẽa nemɔ koso, odi kyɛ ɛmɔdi so, ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ ayɛyɛdeɛ, ɛmɔ aboadeɛ afɔleɛ amukoraa, ɔne ɛmɔ akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔfa bɛbrɛ AWURADE ne bɛboka so.

english_verse: Remember to begin the Festival of Shelters on the fifteenth day of the seventh month after you have harvested your crops. Celebrate this festival for seven days in honor of me and don't do any work on the first day or on the day following the festival.
translation_verse: “Afei, bosome nzoo ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nnu ne, mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔafa aseɛ ne aso aleɛ bayie ne, ɛ́mɔli AWURADE aluolue ne ɛlɛsoo. Kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, ɔne ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne, ɛ́mɔli afofi bele bɛ nwome bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: I command you and all of your descendants to celebrate this festival during the seventh month of each year.
translation_verse: Afoɛ biala, ɛ́mɔli sɔ aluolue ne ɛlɛsoo bɛ́ma AWURADE; ɛ́mɔli ye bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne anu, na ɛ́mɔma ɔyɛ ahyɛdeɛ ma ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: For seven days every Israelite must live in a shelter,
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔtena asese nu ɛlɛsoo; ebiala bɔ ɔte Yisraelniɛ ne kɔtena asese nu,

english_verse: so future generations will know that I made their ancestors live in shelters when I brought them out of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.
translation_verse: amaa ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ anwu kyɛ mmane Yisrael ama tenane asese nu mmerɛ bɔ nyele bɛ mvili Misraim aseɛ so ne: Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: This is how Moses instructed the people of Israel to celebrate the Lord's festivals.
translation_verse: Yiti Mose fale AWURADE aluolue ahoroɔ bɔ AWURADE ahyehyɛ ne tole Yisraelfoɛ nyunu.

english_verse: It's possible to pay the owner for an animal that has been killed, but death is the penalty for murder.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ okohu ebie kaka ne, odi kyɛ ɔfa bie si ye gya nu; nakoso ebiala bɔ okohu sona ne de, odi kyɛ beku ye ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: You must supply the purest olive oil for the lamps in the sacred tent, so they will keep burning.
translation_verse: “Hyɛ Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ bɛ́fa olive ngoo bɔ bahwi ye gyengɔgyengɔ ɔ bɛbrɛ wɔ, maa ɛfa gua kanea ne anu, ná kanea ne ahɔ so agye daa.

english_verse: Use your finest flour to bake twelve loaves of bread about two kilograms each,
translation_verse: “Odi kyɛ ɛfa esam paa, ná ɛfa to paanoo buru ne nyɔ. Fa esam ne olonka nyɔ to paanoo ko biala.

english_verse: then take them into the sacred tent and lay them on the gold table in two rows of six loaves.
translation_verse: Hyehyɛ bɛ folii nyɔ wɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ paa poen ne aso; ma folii ko biala ɔyɛ paanoo nzia.

english_verse: Alongside each row put some pure incense that will be sent up by fire in place of the bread as an offering to me.
translation_verse: Fa ɛyɛɛ paa gua folii biala so, maa ɔ́yɛ ngayeɛ nikye bɔ ɔboka paanoo ne aso ɔ, ná ɔ́yɛ afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: Aaron must lay fresh loaves on the table each Sabbath, and priests in all generations must continue this practice as part of Israel's agreement with me.
translation_verse: Afofikyẽa biala, odi kyɛ Aarɔn gyina Yisraelfoɛ gya nu, ná ɔ́hyehyɛ paanoo ne wɔ AWURADE nyunu daa, amaa wayɛ apam afebɔɔ.

english_verse: This bread will always belong to Aaron and his family; it is very holy because it was offered to me, and it must be eaten in a holy place. Punishment for Cursing the Lord
translation_verse: Paanoo nemɔ kɔyɛ Aarɔn ne ye boso ama deɛ, na odi kyɛ bedi ye wɔ nekaa bɔ ɔte krongron ɔ. Ofikyɛ afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE ne, Aarɔn bue deɛ bɔ ɔte krongron paa ma ye ɛne, na ɔte bɛ deɛ afebɔɔ.” Musuebɔlɛ nwo asohwenɛ

english_verse: Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri from the tribe of Dan, had married an Egyptian, and they had a son. One day their son got into a fight with an Israelite man in camp and cursed the name of the Lord. So the young man was dragged off to Moses,
translation_verse: Biaa bɔ oni yeɛ ɔte Yisraelniɛ ne, ɔbɔle Dumaa bɔ bɛmmɔ ne ɔfa nomale, na ɔkekane musue dwirɛ tiale ye dumaa. Bɛfale ye bɛwale Mose nyunu. Oni dumaa ole Selomite, bɔ oni ole Dibri bɔ ofi Dan abusua kure nu ne.

english_verse: who had him guarded while everyone waited for the Lord to tell them what to do.
translation_verse: Bɛfale ye bɛtole kuku nu maa odwuli kyɛ bɛtele bɔ AWURADE le ye ka wɔ edwirɛ ne anwo ɔ.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: This man has cursed me! Take him outside the camp and tell the witnesses to lay their hands on his head. Then command the whole community of Israel to stone him to death.
translation_verse: “Fa biaa bɔ wabɔ musue ne kɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ; ná ma mmenia bɔ bɛtele edwirɛ ne bɛ so anu ne amukoraa, bɛ́fa bɛ sa bégua ye ti so, ná ma maen ne amu bɛ́boro ye nyɔboɛ béhu ye.

english_verse: And warn the others that everyone else who curses me will die in the same way, whether they are Israelites by birth or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔha musue dwirɛ kotia AWURADE dumaa ne, odi kyɛ beku ye ɔ; sona bɔ ɔkɔha musue dwirɛ ne, odi kyɛ maen ne amukoraa bɛboro ye nyɔboɛ beku ye. Ɛwɔfoɛ oo, kuromani oo, sɛ bɛ nu biala ka musue dwirɛ tia Nyameɛ Dumaa a, odi kyɛ beku ye ɔ.

english_verse: Death is also the penalty for murder,
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ okoli awue ne, odi kyɛ beku ye bie.

english_verse: but the killing of an animal that belongs to someone else requires only that the animal be replaced.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ okohu ebie kaka ne, odi kyɛ ɔfa bie si ye gya nu, ngoa yeɛ bɛ́fa bési ngoa gya nu ɔ.

english_verse: Personal injuries to others must be dealt with in keeping with the crime—
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ okoli obiɛngo nnɛen ne, odi kyɛ ye koso bedi ye sɔ nnɛen ne bie ala betua kerɛ:

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I demand equal justice both for you Israelites and for those foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: Mmeraa bɔ bɛfa bedi kuromani ne, ye ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛfa bedi ɛwɔfoɛ koso ɔ: ofikyɛ Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.”

english_verse: When Moses finished speaking, the people did what the Lord had told Moses, and they stoned to death the man who had cursed the Lord.
translation_verse: Yiti sɔ ala yeɛ Mose sele Yisraelfoɛ ɔ. Bɛfale sona bɔ wakekã musue dwirɛ ne bɛhɔle asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ, na bɛborole ye nyɔboɛ behuni ye. Yisraelfoɛ yɔle kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne ala.

english_verse: So when you buy or sell farmland, the price is to be determined by the number of crops it can produce before the next Year of Celebration. Don't try to cheat.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛtɔ nikyee fi ebiɛngo berɛ a, afoɛ bɔ waha kora ne Yubilee ne aso ne yeɛ okohyire ye nyɔboɛ ɔ; bɔ ɔtɔne ye ne koso, afoɛ somaa bɔ ɛkɔfa kɔyɛ so adwuma ne yeɛ odi kyɛ ogyina so pɛ ye nyɔboɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When Moses was on Mount Sinai, the Lord told him
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose wɔ Sinai bokaa ne aso kyɛ,

english_verse: This is a year of complete celebration, so don't plant any seed or harvest what your fields or vineyards produce.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma afoɛ aburannu ne ɔyɛ Yubilee ɔma ɛmɔ. Nnɛma ɛmɔdua hwee; sɛ ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ fieso aleɛ a, aleɛ bɔ okofifi ye si ne, nnɛma ɛmɔbu, yeɛ bobe mmakaa bɔ ambepɛ bɔ wafifi bɛ nwo ne, nnɛma ɛmɔtete bɛ mma.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: After you enter the land that I am giving you, it must be allowed to rest one year out of every seven.
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, ‘Sɛ ɛmɔdwu aseɛ bɔ méfa méma ɛmɔ ne aso a, afoɛ nzoo biala, odi kyɛ ɛmɔma aseɛ ne da berɛ de ye nwome ma AWURADE.

english_verse: This is to be a time of complete rest for your fields and vineyards, so don't harvest anything they produce.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛfa wɔ fieso aleɛ ne yie a, aleɛ bɔ okofifi ye si ne, nnɛfa; yeɛ wɔ bobe mmakaa bɔ ambepɛ bɔ wafifi ye nwo ne, nnɛtete ye mma: ma aseɛ ne ole ye nwome bɔkɔɔ sɔ afoɛ ne.

english_verse: However, you and your slaves and your hired workers, as well as any domestic or wild animals, may eat whatever grows on its own. The Year of Celebration The Lord said to his people:
translation_verse: wɔ nyɛmmoa koso, ɔne eburo ngaka bɔ bɛwɔ w’aseɛ ne aso ne, sɔ aleɛ ne amukoraa kɔyɛ b’aleɛ. Yubilee afoɛ

english_verse: or uncle or cousin, or some other family member. In fact, if you ever get enough money, you may buy your own freedom
translation_verse: Ye baba aliɛma bienzua, anaakyɛ ye baba aliɛma bienzua awa bienzua anaa ye nwoniɛ kaenn kɔhora kɔpɔ ye. Anaakyɛ ye bɔbɔ sɛ sikaa ba ye sa nu a, ɔkɔhora kɔpɔ ye nwo.

english_verse: on the tenth day of the seventh month, which is also the Great Day of Forgiveness, trumpets are to be blown everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Na bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne, eleburu ne aso bɔ yeɛ ɔte mbata kyẽa ne, maa behu totorobɛndo serɛserɛ; maa behũ ye wɔ ɛmɔ maen ne anu amukoraa.

english_verse: In this time of sacred celebration you may eat only what grows on its own.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔte Yubilee afoɛ; na odi kyɛ ɔyɛ krongron ma ɛmɔ: ɛ́mɔli aleɛ bɔ ye bɔbɔ okofifi wɔ aseɛ ne aso angome.

english_verse: During this year, all property must go back to its original owner.
translation_verse: “Sɔ Yubilee afoɛ ye, odi kyɛ ɛmɔ nu biala ye sa osa ka ye aseɛ bɔ wafi ye sa ɔ.

english_verse: If it is a long time before the next Year of Celebration, the price will be higher, because what is really being sold are the crops that the land can produce.
translation_verse: Sɛ afoɛ bɔ waha ne sone a, to ye nyɔboɛ ne anu, nakoso sɛ afoɛ bɔ waha ne anzo a, te ye nyɔboɛ ne aso; ofikyɛ afoɛnoa afoɛnoa aleɛ bɔ ekonya ye ne yeɛ ɔtɔne ye ma wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, so obey me and don't cheat anyone.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔ nu biala sisi obiɛngo, na mmom suro wɔ Nyameɛ; ofikyɛ me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ. Afoɛ nzoo ne anwo ahunundetelɛ

english_verse: If you obey my laws and teachings, you will live safely in the land and enjoy its abundant crops.
translation_verse: Aseɛ ne kɔhye aleɛ, na ɛmɔkoli ma ɛmɔ ko koyi, ná ɛmɔatena aseɛ ne aso asomdwee nu.

english_verse: Don't ever worry about what you will eat during the seventh year when you are forbidden to plant or harvest.
translation_verse: Ebiaa né ɛmɔabisa kyɛ, ‘Sɛ yɛngolua hwee anaakyɛ yɛngɔfa yɛ boo nu noa de a, né nzaade nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛkoli ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne anu ɔ?’

english_verse: I will see to it that you harvest enough in the sixth year to last for three years.
translation_verse: Ngɔma me saleɛ kohwie kogua ɛmɔ so wɔ afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ne anu, ná aseɛ ne kɔma ɛmɔ afoɛ nza aleɛ.

english_verse: In the eighth year you will live on what you harvested in the sixth year, but in the ninth year you will eat what you plant and harvest in the eighth year.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔdua nningyein afoɛ mmɔtwɛ ne anu a, ɛmɔkɔhɔ so bekoli aleɛ daa ne; ɛmɔkɔhɔ so bekoli aleɛ daa ne maa okoodwu afoɛ ngona ne bɔ afoɛ mmɔtwɛ ne anu aleɛ koti ɔ.

english_verse: No land may be permanently bought or sold. It all belongs to me—it isn't your land, and you only live there for a little while.
translation_verse: Onni kyɛ bɛte aseɛ ne terama, ofikyɛ aseɛ ne te me deɛ, na me nyunu de, ɛmɔte ɛwɔfoɛ ne hwɛsofoɛ.

english_verse: When property is being sold, the original owner must be given the first chance to buy it.
translation_verse: Aseɛ biala bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ sa nu ne, ɛ́mɔma ye nwo ate ma bɛpɔ ye.

english_verse: If any of you Israelites become so poor that you are forced to sell your property, your closest relative must buy it back,
translation_verse: “Sɛ ebiɛngo nwo kyere ye, ná ɔtɔne ye agyapadeɛ bie ma wɔ a, odi kyɛ ye nwoniɛ kaenn ɔbapɔ bɔ ye abusuaniɛ ne atɔne ye ne.

english_verse: if that relative has the money. Later, if you can afford to buy it,
translation_verse: Sɛ sona ne olle ebiala bɔ ɔkɔpɔ agyapadeɛ ne, nakoso nziɛ ye ye bɔbɔ ɔbayɛ yee, ná onya sikaa bɔ ɔkɔhora kɔpɔ agyapadeɛ ne a,

english_verse: you must pay enough to make up for what the present owner will lose on it before the next Year of Celebration, when the property would become yours again.
translation_verse: odi kyɛ bɛnea afoɛ somaa bɔ watɔne agyapadeɛ ne maa wali ye berɛ ɔ, ná bɛsesẽ afoɛ bɔ waha ne nwo sikaa betua bɛma sona bɔ ɔtɔle agyapadeɛ ne, ná agyapadeɛ ne osa ooli ye mene ne sa nu.

english_verse: But if you don't have the money to pay the present owner a fair price, you will have to wait until the Year of Celebration, when the property will once again become yours.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ olle sikaa bɔ ɔkɔso agyapadeɛ ne pɔ a, agyapadeɛ bɔ watɔne ye ne kɔha sona bɔ watɔ ne berɛ maa okoodwu Yubilee afoɛ ne; sɛ Yubilee afoɛ ne so a, odi kyɛ ɔfa ye mene ne nikyee ma ye, ná agyapadeɛ ne sa bayɛ ye mene deɛ.

english_verse: If you sell a house in a walled city, you have only one year in which to buy it back.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ebie tɔne awuro, wɔ kuro bɔ bato ye nwo fasue nu, ná onnya ɔbbole afoɛ ko a, sona ne kɔhora kɔpɔ ye; ole ye nwo ate alaa maa okodwu afoɛ ko kyɛ ɔkora pɔ ye ɔ.

english_verse: If you don't buy it back before that year is up, it becomes the permanent property of the one who bought it, and it will not be returned to you in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Sɛ wambɔ ye ná afoɛ ko pɛ nu a, ye de awuro bɔ ɔwɔ kuro bɔ bato ye nwo fasue nu ne kɔyɛ bɔ ɔtɔle ne deɛ afebɔɔ wɔ ye aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ nu; onni kyɛ bɔ ɔtɔle ne kakyi ma ye mene Yubilee afoɛ ne anu.

english_verse: But a house out in a village may be bought back at any time just like a field. And it must be returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Nakoso awuro mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ nguraa mɔ bɔ fasue ɔnne bɛ nwo nu ne de, odi kyɛ bebu bɛ kyɛ bɛte namue; bɛkɔhora bɛkɔpɔ bɛ, na odi kyɛ besa bɛkakyi bɛma bɛ mene mɔ Yubilee afoɛ ne anu.

english_verse: If any Levites own houses inside a walled city, they will always have the right to buy them back.
translation_verse: Na Lewifoɛ nguro nemɔ de, Lewifoɛ le ye nwo ate afebɔɔ kyɛ bɛpɔ bɛ nguro nemɔ anu awuro mɔ ɔ.

english_verse: And any houses that they do not buy back will be returned to them in the Year of Celebration, because these homes are their permanent property among the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Sɛ Lewiniɛ bie wambɔ ye awuro bɔ batɔne ye wɔ bɛ nguro ne bie aso a, ye de odi kyɛ besa bɛkakyi awuro ne bɛma ye mene wɔ Yubilee afoɛ ne anu; ofikyɛ awuro mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Lewifoɛ nguro nemɔ anu ne, bɛte Lewifoɛ mɔ agyapadeɛ wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nu.

english_verse: No pastureland owned by the Levi tribe can ever be sold; it is their permanent possession. Help for the Poor The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nakoso aseɛ bɔ wapɛ Lewifoɛ nguro nemɔ anwo wayia ne de, onni kyɛ bɛtɔne ye; ofikyɛ ɔte Lewifoɛ mɔ agyapadeɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: If any of your people become poor and unable to support themselves, you must help them, just as you are supposed to help foreigners who live among you.
translation_verse: “Sɛ wɔ nwoniɛ bie kɔ anwokyere nu, ná ɔfa ye anwokyere ne bato wɔ so a, odi kyɛ ɛboka ye ɔ; maa ɔne wɔ bɛtena kyɛ ɛwɔfoɛ anaa bataniɛ bɔ waasikye wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of them by charging any kind of interest or selling them food for profit. Instead, honor me by letting them stay where they now live.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛbɔ ye bosea a, nnɛde ye dɔ nzihoɛ, yeɛ w’aleɛ bɔ ɛfa ma ye ne, nnɛhuru ye nyɔboɛ.

english_verse: Remember—I am the Lord your God! I rescued you from Egypt and gave you the land of Canaan, so that I would be your God.
translation_verse: Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ bɔ nyele ɛmɔ mvili Misraim aseɛ so kyɛ mefa Kanaan aseɛ mema ɛmɔ ɔ, na me yeɛ nde ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Suppose some of your people become so poor that they have to sell themselves and become your slaves.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ohia ebiɛngo Yisraelniɛ bie alaa maa ɔyɛ ye nwo atɔen ma wɔ a, nnɛfa ye yɛ kanganiɛ.

english_verse: Then you must treat them as servants, rather than as slaves. And in the Year of Celebration they are to be set free,
translation_verse: Maa ɔne wɔ bɛtena kyɛ paaniɛ anaa bataniɛ, ná ɔso wɔ maa oodwu kyɛ Yubilee afoɛ ne kodwu ɔ.

english_verse: so they and their children may return home to their families and property.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe asi ye, ɔne ye mma mɔ bekofi wɔ bo, bekosa bɛkɔhɔ b’abusua nu ná basa baafa bɛ nana mɔ agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: I brought them out of Egypt to be my servants, not to be sold as slaves.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛte me ngoaa bɔ nyele bɛ mvili Misraim aseɛ so ɔ; onni kyɛ bɛtɔne bɛ kyɛbɔ bɛtɔne nganga ɔ.

english_verse: So obey me, and don't be cruel to the poor.
translation_verse: Nnɛhyɛ bɛ so, na mmom suro wɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: or from the foreigners who live in your own country, and make them your property.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkɔhora koso bɛkɔtɔ bie bekofi ɛhemɔ anu: ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ baatena ɛmɔ nu, yeɛ b’abusuafoɛ bɔ baawo bɛ wɔ ɛmɔ maen nu, amaa bayɛ ɛmɔ deɛ.

english_verse: You can own them, and even leave them to your children when you die, but do not make slaves of your own people or be cruel to them.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkɔhora bɛkɔfa bɛ bɛkɔyɛ agyapadeɛ bɛkɔyakyi ɛmɔ mma mɔ, yeɛ ɛmɔkɔhora bɛkɔfa bɛ bɛkɔyɛ ɛmɔ nganga. Nakoso ɛmɔ mmango Yisraelfoɛ de, nnɛma ebiala hyɛ obiɛngo so.

english_verse: Even if some of you Israelites become so much in debt that you must sell yourselves to foreigners in your country,
translation_verse: “Na sɛ ɛwɔfoɛ bie bɔ waatena ɛmɔ nu bayɛ sikaniɛ, ná sɛ ohia eliɛma Yisraelniɛ bie ma ye sɔ ti ɔtɔne ye nwo ma ɛwɔfoɛ ne anaakyɛ ɛwɔfoɛ ne sasoniɛ biala a,

english_verse: you still have the right to be set free by a relative, such as a brother
translation_verse: sɛ ɔtɔne ye nwo yie a, atee wɔ berɛ ma ye kyɛ bɛpɔ ye ɔ; oliɛma Yisraelniɛ kɔhora kɔɔpɔ ye.

english_verse: And even while you are the slaves of foreigners in your own country, your people must make sure that you are not mistreated.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɔtɛwura ɛwɔfoɛ ne bo de a, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ afoɛnoa afoɛnoa paaniɛ ma ye mene ne. Na ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ ye mene ne, ɔngɔhyɛ ye so ɔ.

english_verse: If you cannot gain your freedom in any of these ways, both you and your children will still be set free in the Year of Celebration.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bamva sɔ atee he biala so bambɔ ye a, ye de sana Yubilee afoɛ ne anu yeɛ ɔne ye mma mɔ bekonya bɛ fawɔnwodi ɔ.

english_verse: People of Israel, I am the Lord your God, and I brought you out of Egypt to be my own servants.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Yisraelfoɛ te me ngoaa, bɛte me ngoaa bɔ nyele bɛ mvili Misraim aseɛ so ɔ: Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Respect the Sabbath and honor the place where I am worshiped, because I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔli m’afofingyẽa ne aso ná ɛ́mɔli me nekaa krongron ne ni: Me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: and I will send rain to make your crops grow and your trees produce fruit.
translation_verse: ngɔma esue kɔtɔ kɔma ɛmɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu, aseɛ ne kɔhye aleɛ, ná fieso nningyein asu mmaa.

english_verse: I will bless your country with peace, and you will rest without fear. I will wipe out the dangerous animals and protect you from enemy attacks.
translation_verse: Ngɔma maen ne konya asomdwee, na ɛmɔkɔla wɔ aberɛ bɔ ebiala ngonwunanwuna ɛmɔ ɔ; ngɔfoa ngaka bɔ bɛte awerɔm ɔ ngofi aseɛ ne aso, na koɛ biala ngɔhɔ so wɔ ɛmɔ aseɛ ne aso.

english_verse: You will chase and destroy your enemies,
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkɔfoa ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ, na bɛkɔtotɔ ɛmɔ ngrandɛ noa.

english_verse: I will treat you with such kindness that your nation will grow strong, and I will also keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Ngɔlo ɛmɔ, ngɔma ɛmɔkɔwo, ná ɛmɔata pee; ngɔma apam bɔ me ne ɛmɔ yayɛ ne kotimu.

english_verse: I will live among you and never again look on you with disgust.
translation_verse: Ngɔyɛ m’atenaleɛ wɔ ɛmɔ afia, na mengɔpɔ ɛmɔ.

english_verse: I will walk with you—I will be your God, and you will be my people.
translation_verse: Me ne ɛmɔ kɔnate; nde ɛmɔ Nyameɛ, na ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔkɔyɛ me mmenia.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, and I rescued you from Egypt, so that you would never again be slaves. I have set you free; now walk with your heads held high. Punishment for Disobeying the Lord The Lord said:
translation_verse: Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ bɔ nyele ɛmɔ mvili Misraim aseɛ so kyɛ, mengɔma ɛmɔ ngɔyɛ bɛ nganga ko ne. Mabubu ɛmɔ kɔnnua ná mamaa ɛmɔanate bafa bɛ sa basi bɛ hue. Asoserɛ nwo asohwenɛ (Deuteronomi

english_verse: If you disobey me and my laws, and if you break our agreement,
translation_verse: sɛ ɛmɔpo m’ahyɛdeɛ, ná ɛmɔtwi bɛfa me nhyehyɛleɛ so, ná ɛmɔanni me mmeraa dwirɛ amukoraa so, ná ɛmɔbu m’apam so a,

english_verse: I will punish you terribly, and you will be ruined. You will be struck with incurable diseases and with fever that leads to blindness and depression. Your enemies will eat the crops you plant,
translation_verse: bɔ me koso ngɔfa ngɔyɔ ɛmɔ ɛhe: ngɔmaa asane kandinga kɔto ɛmɔ; anwonyerɛ koangɔ kɔbɔ ɛmɔ, yeɛ ebunu bɔ ɔma bɛ nye yɛ wusiwusi ná ɔma sona ngoa so te ɔ kɔhye ɛmɔ. Sɛ ɛmɔdua nningyein a, ɛmɔkɔfɛ bekogua mbaen, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ yeɛ bekoli ɔ.

english_verse: and I will turn from you and let you be destroyed by your attackers. You will even run at the very rumor of attack.
translation_verse: Ngotu me nye ngosie ɛmɔ so, na ɛmɔkɔtotɔ ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ ngrandɛ noa. Ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ koli ɛmɔ so, na ɛmɔkɔnwati wɔ aberɛ bɔ ebiala ɔmvoa ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Then, if you still refuse to obey me, I will punish you seven times for each of your sins,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛhe amukoraa si ye po, ɛmɔanyɛ sotie bamma me a, ɔnate ɛmɔ bɔne ti, ngɔhɔ so ngɔhwe ɛmɔ so mmɔhoɛ nzoo.

english_verse: until your pride is completely crushed. I will hold back the rain, so the sky above you will be like iron, and the ground beneath your feet will be like copper.
translation_verse: Ngɔbrɛ anwoserɛ bɔ ɛmɔfa bekyire bɛ nwo ne ase, ngɔma ewienu bɔ ɔkata ɛmɔ so ne kɔyɛ kyɛ buralɛ, ná aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔte so ne ayɛ kyɛ kɔɔbere.

english_verse: All of your hard work will be for nothing—and there will be no harvest of grain or fruit.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkɔsɛkye ɛmɔ anwoserɛ mbaen: ɛmɔ aseɛ ngɔhye aleɛ, yeɛ aseɛ ne aso mmakaa ngosu mmaa.

english_verse: If you keep rebelling against me, I'll punish you seven times worse, just as your sins deserve!
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛmɔkɔso bedwɔso betia me, na ɛmɔandie me dwirɛ a, ɔnate ɛmɔ bɔne ti, ngɔhɔ so ngɔfa amaneɛ piri ngɔto ɛmɔ so pɛen nzoo.

english_verse: I'll send wild animals to attack you, and they will gobble up your children and livestock. So few of you will be left that your roads will be deserted.
translation_verse: Ngɔsoma ngaka aboyaa maa bɛkɔwa ɛmɔ so, na bekohũhũ ɛmɔ mma mɔ maa bekofi ɛmɔ sa; bekohũhũ ɛmɔ nyɛmmoa. Bɛkɔma ɛmɔ somaa so kɔte, bɔ ɔnate so sona fee ngɔfa ɛmɔ atee nemɔ aso ɔ.

english_verse: War will break out because you broke our agreement, and if you escape to your walled cities, I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and you will be captured by your enemies.
translation_verse: Na ngɔhwe ɛmɔ so ngrandɛ, ná matɔ ɛmɔ so wereɛ, ɔnate apam bɔ ɛmɔabu so ne ati. Na sɛ ɛmɔkɔfeafea ɛmɔ nguro nemɔ anu a, ngɔsoma anwonyerɛ tɛɛ maa ɔkɔbɔ ɛmɔ, na ngɔfa ɛmɔ ngowura ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa.

english_verse: You will have such a shortage of bread, that ten women will be able to bake their bread in the same oven. Each of you will get only a few crumbs, and you will go hungry.
translation_verse: Ngɔma ɛhɔen kɔwa ɛmɔ aseɛ so; mmrasua buru yeɛ bɛkɔto ɛmɔ aleɛ wɔ bokyea komapɛ aso ɔ. Mmrasua nemɔ kosusu aleɛ ne mmaa mmaa bie yeɛ bɛkɔma ɛmɔ ɔ, yiti sɛ ɛmɔdi a, ɛmɔ ko ngoyi.

english_verse: I'll really get furious and punish you terribly for your sins!
translation_verse: ye de nne ɛyaa piri ngodwɔso ngotia ɛmɔ, na ɔnate ɛmɔ bɔne ti, me bɔbɔ ngɔhwe ɛmɔ so pɛen nzoo.

english_verse: In fact, you will be so desperate for food that you will eat your own children.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkohũhũ ɛmɔ mma mmienzua mɔ ɔne ɛmɔ mma mmrasua mɔ bekoli.

english_verse: I'll destroy your shrines and tear down your incense altars, leaving your dead bodies piled on top of your idols. And you will be disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Ngɔsɛkye ɛmɔ asɔneyɛɛ so nemɔ ná mabubu ɛmɔ ɛyɛɛ afɔleɛ bokyea nemɔ magua. Ngɔboaboa ɛmɔ fuin noa ngogua ɛmɔ mmosoen wuruwaa nemɔ aso. Na ngɔpɔ ɛmɔ.

english_verse: I'll wipe out your towns and your places of worship and will no longer be pleased with the smell of your sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ngɔma ɛmɔ nguro nemɔ kɔbɔ, ná masɛkye ɛmɔ nekaa krongron nemɔ, na me nye ngɔgye ɛmɔ afɔleɛ fonafona nemɔ anwo.

english_verse: Your land will become so desolate that even your enemies who settle there will be shocked when they see it.
translation_verse: Ngɔsɛkye ɛmɔ aseɛ ne pasaa, maa ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ bekotu bɛkɔɔtena nu ne, ɔkɔyɛ bɛ nwanwa.

english_verse: After I destroy your towns and ruin your land with war, I'll scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ de, ngɔma ɛmɔ kɔbɔ aya bɛkɔhɔ maen maen mɔ so, na ngɔhwe ɛmɔ so ngrandɛ; ɛmɔ aseɛ nemɔ kɔsɛkye bɔkɔɔ, ná ɛmɔ nguro nemɔ koso kɔbɔ.

english_verse: While you are prisoners in foreign lands, your own land will enjoy years of rest and refreshment, as it should have done each seventh year when you lived there.
translation_verse: Afoɛ mɔ bɔ ɛmɔtenane aseɛ ne aso belili afofi ne, sɛ aseɛ ne da berɛ mbaen a yeɛ okole ye nwome ɔ.

english_verse: In the land of your enemies, you will tremble at the rustle of a leaf, as though it were a sword. And you will become so weak that you will stumble and fall over each other, even when no one is chasing you.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ebiala mvoa bɛ de, nakoso bekofifi ase bɛkɔfofo bɛ nwo so kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛnwati befi ngrandɛ noa ɔ. Na ɛmɔngonya anwoserɛ bengogyina ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ nyunu.

english_verse: Many of you will die in foreign lands,
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkowuwu wɔ maen maen so maa bekosie ɛmɔ wɔ ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ aseɛ so.

english_verse: Then suppose you realize that I turned against you and brought you to the land of your enemies because both you and your ancestors had stubbornly sinned against me. If you humbly confess what you have done and start living right,
translation_verse: maa ɔnate so me koso ngɔle so ndwɔso ndiale bɛ, na mvale bɛ mmale bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ aseɛ so; sɛ bɛbrɛ b’ahone bɔ wapini ne ase, ná bede bɛto nu kyɛ bedi fɔ a,

english_verse: I'll keep the promise I made to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. I will bless your land
translation_verse: ye de ngɔkaye m’apam bɔ me ne Yakob yɛyɛle ne. Ngɔkaye m’apam bɔ me ne Yisake yɛyɛle ne ɔne bɔ me ne Abraham yɛyɛle ne koso, na ngɔkaye aseɛ ne.

english_verse: and let it rest during the time that you are in a foreign country, paying for your rebellion against me and my laws.
translation_verse: Na bɛkɔyakyi aseɛ ne berɛ maa okoli ye afofi afoɛ mɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔla berɛ mbaen ɔ; bekole bɛkɔto nu kyɛ bedi fɔ, ɔnate kyɛ bɛpole me nhyehyɛleɛ, na m’ahyɛdeɛ nwo yɛle bɛ kra nya.

english_verse: No matter what you have done, I am still the Lord your God, and I will never completely reject you or become absolutely disgusted with you there in the land of your enemies.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛhe amukoraa asi ye, sɛ bɛwɔ bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ aseɛ so po a, mengɔpo bɛ, yeɛ mengɔpɔ bɛ bɔ ɔkɔmaa bɛ boso konua, bɔ ɔkɔmaa ngɔsɛkye apam bɔ ɔla me ne b’afia ne ɔ; ofikyɛ me ole AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: While nations watched, I rescued your ancestors from Egypt so that I would be their God. Yes, I am your Lord, and I will never forget our agreement.
translation_verse: Nakoso apam bɔ me ne bɛ nana mɔ bɔ nyele bɛ mvili Misraim aseɛ so yɛyele, kyɛ nde bɛ Nyameɛ, bɔ maen maen amukoraa nye tua ne, ɔnate bɛ bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ne ati ngɔkaye; Me ole AWURADE.”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws and teachings for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɛhe mɔ ole ahyɛdeɛ, nhyehyɛleɛ ne mmeraa bɔ AWURADE nate Mose so hyehyɛle tole ye ne Yisraelfoɛ afia wɔ Sinai bokaa aso ne.

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If you ever want to free someone who has been promised to me,
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Sɛ ebie to ye noa nu tui fa kuro sona ye ti nyɔboɛ bɔ AWURADE anohoba sonongo a, odi kyɛ otua ye kyɛbɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ ne ala.

english_verse: you may do so by paying the following amounts, weighed according to the official standards:
translation_verse: Na sɛ sona ne ali afoɛ aburasia bɔ ɔkɔ ne a, bienzua ti nyɔboɛ te sekel buru ne nnu, yeɛ brasua deɛ te sekel buru.

english_verse: Ten percent of everything you harvest is holy and belongs to me, whether it grows in your fields or on your fruit trees.
translation_verse: “Aseɛ ne aso aleɛ buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne, kyɛ betu befili aseɛnwo oo, anaakyɛ ɔte mmakaammaa oo, ye mukoraa te AWURADE deɛ; bɛte krongron bɛma AWURADE.

english_verse: If you have promised to give someone to me and can't afford to pay the full amount for that person's release, you will be taken to a priest, and he will decide how much you can afford.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔnate ehiaa ti sona bɔ wabɔ anohoba ne ɔngɔhora ye ti nyɔboɛ ne tua a, odi kyɛ ɔfa sona bɔ wafa ye wabɔ anohoba ne ɔba ɔsɔfo ne nyunu maa ɔsɔfo ne pɛ ye ti nyɔboɛ. Ɔsɔfo ne kɔsesẽ nyɔboɛ ne, kyɛbɔ sona bɔ wahyɛ bɔ ne ye nwo kɔsõ so ɔ.

english_verse: If you promise to sacrifice an animal to me, it becomes holy, and there is no way you can set it free.
translation_verse: “Sɛ aboadeɛ ne te kaka bɔ bɛkora bɛfa bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE a, kaka biala bɔ bɛfa bɛma AWURADE ne, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ krongron.

english_verse: Donkeys are unfit for sacrifice, so if you promise me a donkey, you must bring it to the priest,
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔte kaka bɔ ye nwo nde bɔ bɛmva bɛmmɔ afɔleɛ mma AWURADE a, ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛfa kaka ne bɛba ɔsɔfo ne nyunu.

english_verse: But if you want to buy it back, you must pay an additional
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ kaka ne mene kuro kyɛ ɔpɔ kaka ne a, odi kyɛ ye nyɔboɛ ne, ɔfa nnu nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ɔboka so.

english_verse: If you promise part of your family's land to me, its value must be determined by the amount of seed needed to plant the land, and the rate will be ten pieces of silver for every
translation_verse: “Sɛ ebie tu aseɛ bie bɔ bawu bafa bayakyi ye sie berɛ ma AWURADE a, ye nyɔboɛ ne sesenɛ kogyina nningyein somaa bɔ ɛkora dua ye so ne aso: odi kyɛ ɔfa ɛdwetɛ sekel aburannu otua ayuo angora ko biala kerɛ.

english_verse: If this promise is made in the Year of Celebration, the land will be valued at the full price.
translation_verse: Na sɛ sɔ sona ne otu aseɛ sie berɛ ma AWURADE Yubilee afoɛ ne anu a, ye nyɔboɛ ne kɔyɛ kyɛbɔ apɛ ato berɛ ne ala.

english_verse: When the Year of Celebration comes, the land becomes holy because it belongs to me, and it will be given to the priests.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ Yubilee afoɛ ne so, bɔ odi kyɛ ebiala sa ka ye agyapadeɛ ne a, aseɛ ne kɔyɛ krongron kɔma AWURADE kyɛ aseɛ bɔ batu basie berɛ bama AWURADE ne ala; ɔkɔyɛ ɔsɔfo ne deɛ.

english_verse: its value will be decided by a priest, according to the number of years before the next Year of Celebration, and the money you pay will be mine.
translation_verse: odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔsese ye nyɔboɛ fi sɔ mmerɛ ne kodwu Yubilee afoɛ ne, na kyɛbɔ ye nyɔboɛ te nen, odi kyɛ sɔ kyẽa ne ala, ye mene ne ótua fa yɛ akyɛdeɛ krongron ma AWURADE.

english_verse: However, on the next Year of Celebration, the land will go back to the family of its original owner.
translation_verse: Yubilee afoɛ ne anu, aseɛ ne kosa kɔyɛ sona bɔ bɛtɔ befili ye berɛ, bɔ ye agyapadeɛ ahɔ ɔ ne deɛ.

english_verse: Every price will be set by the official standards. Various Offerings The Lord said:
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛfa nekaa krongron berɛ sekel ne yeɛ bɛsesẽ nyɔboɛ ne amukoraa ɔ: gyera aburanyɔ te sekel ko.

english_verse: All first-born animals of your flocks and herds are already mine, and so you cannot promise any of them to me.
translation_verse: “Nnɛma ebiala tu kaka biala bamuɛbaa sie berɛ ma AWURADE; ɔnate kyɛ ɔte bamuɛbaa ne ati, ɔte AWURADE deɛ. Kyɛ nandwie ahɔ oo, anaa boaen ahɔ oo, AWURADE deɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Anything that you completely dedicate to me must be completely destroyed. It cannot be bought back or sold. Every person, animal, and piece of property that you dedicate completely is only for me.
translation_verse: “Nakoso ebiala ye nikyee biala bɔ okotu kosie berɛ kɔma AWURADE ne, kyɛ sona oo, kyɛ kaka oo, anaa aseɛ bɔ bawu bafa bayakyi ye oo, ɔngɔhora ngɔtɔne ye, yeɛ ɔngɔhora ngɔpɔ ye. Nikyee biala bɔ batu basie berɛ bama AWURADE ne, ɔte krongron paa ma AWURADE.

english_verse: In fact, any humans who have been promised to me in this way must be put to death.
translation_verse: Sona biala bɔ babua kyɛ behũ ye ne, bɛngɔhora bɛngɔpɔ ye; odi kyɛ beku ye ɔ.

english_verse: If you want to buy back this part of your harvest, you may do so by paying what it is worth plus an additional
translation_verse: Na sɛ ebie kuro kyɛ osa fa ye buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne anu bie a, ye de odi kyɛ ye nyɔboɛ ne, ɔfa nnu nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ɔboka so.

english_verse: When you count your flocks and herds, one out of ten of every newborn animal is holy and belongs to me,
translation_verse: Nandwie kure ne mmoaen kure nemɔ buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne, sɛ mmoaenneafoɛ ne bukye bɛ na bɛbaase bɛfa ye pɔmaa ne abo a, bɛ nu biala bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne, bɛkɔyɛ krongron bɛkɔma AWURADE.

english_verse: no matter how good or bad it is. If you substitute one animal for another, both of them become holy, and neither can be bought back.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ebiala sa ngaka nemɔ anu kyɛ ɔte paa anaa ɔtte mayee, yeɛ nnɛmaa ɔfa ebie sesã ye; sɛ ɔsesã ye a, ye de sɔ kaka ne ɔne bɔ wafa wasesã ye ne bɛkɔyɛ krongron, na bɛ mene pɔ bɛ a ɔnyɛ yé.”

english_verse: Moses was on Mount Sinai when the Lord gave him these laws for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɛhemɔ ole mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ AWURADE nate Mose so fa mane Yisraelfoɛ wɔ Sinai bokaa ne aso ne.

english_verse: The people of Israel had left Egypt and were living in the Sinai Desert. Then on the first day of the second month of the second year, when Moses was in the sacred tent the Lord said:
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ tu fili Misraim aseɛ so ne asi, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu, bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ, ye kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, AWURADE sele Mose wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu wɔ Sinai ɛserɛ ne aso kyɛ,

english_verse: I want you and Aaron to find out how many people are in each of Israel's clans and families. And make a list of all the men
translation_verse: ebiala bɔ ɔwɔ Yisrael, bɔ wali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɔ ɔkora kɔ koɛ ne. Odi kyɛ ɛne Aarɔn yeɛ ɛmɔka bɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ kure kure ɔ.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron, together with these twelve tribal leaders,
translation_verse: Mose ne Aarɔn fale mmienzua hemɔ bɔ babobɔ bɛ dumaa ne bɛbokale bɛ nwo so,

english_verse: called together the people that same day. They were counted according to their clans and families. Then Moses and the others listed the names of the men twenty years and older,
translation_verse: na bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne, ye kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, bɛmane maen ne amukoraa bɛbɔle dwaa. Bɛhyerɛhyerɛle bɛ dumaa kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua ɔne bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ɔ, na mmienzua bɔ bali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ ne, bɛhyerɛle bɛ dumaa ngoko ngoko,

english_verse: The people of Israel did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ yɔle sɔ ala; bɛyɔle kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne.

english_verse: But the Levites will camp around the sacred tent to make sure that no one goes near it and makes me furious with the Israelites.
translation_verse: nakoso Lewifoɛ mɔ de, odi kyɛ besi b’asikyeleɛ maa ɔbra adanzeɛ ɛtena sua ne anwo yia, amaa ɔnate so AWURADE yaafɛlɛ piri ne wamma Yisraelfoɛ so. Odi kyɛ Lewifoɛ mɔ bɛbɔ adanzeɛ ɛtena sua ne anwo waen.”

english_verse: But those from the Levi tribe were not included
translation_verse: Bɛhale mmusua kure ngaa nemɔ, nakoso Lewifoɛ mɔ de, banga bɛ.

english_verse: because the Lord had said to Moses:
translation_verse: Né AWURADE aha ahyire Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: When you count the Israelites, do not include those from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: “Lewi abusua kure ne angome yeɛ nnɛka bɛ ɔ; nnɛka bɛ fra Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne aso.

english_verse: Instead, give them the job of caring for the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the objects used for worship. They will camp around the tent, and whenever you move, they will take it down, carry it to the new camp, and set it up again. Anyone else who tries to go near it must be put to death.
translation_verse: Sɛ mmerɛ dwu kyɛ ɛmɔtutu nyianu sua ne bɛkɔ a, odi kyɛ Lewifoɛ nemɔ yeɛ betutu ɔ. Na odwu ye silɛ so a, odi kyɛ Lewifoɛ mɔ besa bɛnea bɛhyehyɛ. Na sɛ ebiala bɔ nna Lewiniɛ ahɔ ɔ opingye ɛtena sua ne a, odi kyɛ beku ye.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites will camp in their own groups and under their own banners.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ ngaa nemɔ de, odi kyɛ ebiala si ye asikyeleɛ wɔ bɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ kure kure nemɔ anu;

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn kyɛ,

english_verse: how the Israelites should arrange their camp: Each tribe must set up camp under its own banner and under the flags of its ancestral families. These camps will be arranged around the sacred tent, but not close to it.
translation_verse: “Odi kyɛ Yisraelniɛ biala ɔkyekye ye asikyeleɛ wɔ ye koɛhonɛfoɛ kure nu. Ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛboa bɛ noa wɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ frangaa nwo; odi kyɛ bɛma b’asikyeleɛ nemɔ pɛ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anwo bra yia, ná ebiala ma ye deɛ nye kyire ɛtena sua ne.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the east side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: Na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburasoo ne nna ɔne ɛyaa nzia.

english_verse: On one side of Judah will be the tribe of Issachar, with Nethanel son of Zuar as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburannu ne nna ɔne ɛyaa nna.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab son of Helon as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburannu ne nzoo ɔne ɛyaa nna.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the south side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanna ne nzia ɔne ɛyaa nnu.

english_verse: On one side of Reuben will be the tribe of Simeon, with Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburannu ne ngona ɔne ɛyaa nza.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph son of Deuel as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanna ne nnu ɔne ɛyaa nzia ne aburannu.

english_verse: Marching behind Reuben will be the Levites, arranged in groups, just as they are camped. They will carry the sacred tent and their own banners.
translation_verse: “Odi kyɛ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne, ɔne Lewifoɛ asikyeleɛ nemɔ, bɛba asikyeleɛ ngaa nemɔ afia. Kyɛbɔ besi bɛhyehyɛle asikyeleɛ nemɔ ne, odi kyɛ abusua kure biala di ye nekaa.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the west side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanna ɔne ɛyaa nnu.

english_verse: On one side of Ephraim will be the tribe of Manasseh, with Gamaliel son of Pedahzur as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburasa ne nyɔ ɔne ɛyaa nyɔ.

english_verse: So all the Israelites in the camp were counted according to their ancestral families. The troops were arranged by divisions and totaled
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛ somaa ɛne, kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ bɛ sasofoɛ te ɔ. Asikyeleɛ ahoroɔ nemɔ anu mmenia bɔ bɛhale bɛ kure kure ne amukoraa, bɛ somaa te apee ɛyaa nzia ne nza ɔne ɛyaa nnu ne aburannu.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan son of Gideoni as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburasa ne nnu ɔne ɛyaa nna.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that march with it must set up camp on the north side of the sacred tent, under their own banner. The
translation_verse: na ye lɔen bɔ bɛhale bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburasia ne nyɔ ɔne ɛyaa nzoo.

english_verse: On one side of Dan will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel son of Ochran as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanna ne ko ɔne ɛyaa nnu.

english_verse: On the other side will be the tribe of Naphtali with Ahira son of Enan as the leader of its
translation_verse: na ye lɔen bɔ baha bɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburannu ne nza ɔne ɛyaa nna.

english_verse: The only Israelites not included were the Levites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
translation_verse: Nakoso kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose nen, Lewifoɛ mɔ de, banga bɛ bammoka Yisraelfoɛ ngaa nemɔ aso.

english_verse: Israel did everything the Lord had told Moses. They arranged their camp according to clans and families, with each tribe under its own banner. And that was the order by which they marched into battle.
translation_verse: Na Yisraelfoɛ yɔle kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne ala. Bɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ kure kure; na sɔ ala koso yeɛ besili nu ɔ. Ebiala li ye abusua nu, kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ɔ.

english_verse: Aaron's four sons, Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar,
translation_verse: Aarɔn mma mmienzua bɛ dumaa ɛhe: Nadabo bɔ ɔte bamuɛbaa, Abihu, Eleasa ɔne Yitama.

english_verse: But the Lord killed Nadab and Abihu in the Sinai Desert when they used fire that was unacceptable in their offering to the Lord. And because Nadab and Abihu had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests with their father Aaron. The Duties of the Levites
translation_verse: Nakoso Nadabo ne Abihu de, bewuwuli wɔ AWURADE nyunu wɔ Sinai ɛserɛ ne aso, ofikyɛ né bɛmvata kyɛ bɛfa see bɛbɔ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, nakoso bɛyɔle sɔ. Né belle ba. Na Eleasa ne Yitama yeɛ belili sɔfo mmerɛ bɔ né bɛ baba Aarɔn te ase ɔ. Lewifoɛ adwuma

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: who have been appointed to be priests. Anyone else who tries to perform the duties of a priest must be put to death.
translation_verse: Tu Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ sie berɛ, na bɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ bɛyɔ sɔfo adwuma ne ɔ. Sɛ ebie mbaen kɔ ɔsɔfo adwuma ne anwo a, odi kyɛ beku ye.”

english_verse: Moses, I have chosen these Levites from all Israel, and they will belong to me in a special way. When I killed the first-born sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in every Israelite family and the first-born males of their flocks and herds would be mine. But now I accept these Levites in place of the first-born sons of the Israelites. The Levites Are Counted
translation_verse: ofikyɛ bamuɛbaa amukoraa te me deɛ. Mmerɛ bɔ ngukuni Misraim aseɛ so bamuɛbaa amukoraa ne, nduli Yisrael bamuɛbaa amukoraa nziele berɛ mane me nwo, kyɛ mmenia deɛ oo, kyɛ ngaka deɛ oo; bɛte me deɛ. Me ole AWURADE.”

english_verse: In the Sinai Desert the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose wɔ Sinai ɛserɛ ne aso kyɛ,

english_verse: “Now I want you to count the men and boys in the Levi tribe by families and by clans. Include every one at least a month old.”
translation_verse: “Ka Lewifoɛ mɔ. Nea bɛ nana mɔ saso ɔne mmusua mmusua ná fa ka bɛ. Bienzua biala bɔ wali ofi bosome ko bɔ ɔkɔ ne, ka ye bie.”

english_verse: Levi's three sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari, had become the heads of their own clans.
translation_verse: Lewi mma mmienzua mɔ, bɛ dumaa ɛhe: Gɛsɔn, Kohate ne Merari.

english_verse: And Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. These were the sons and grandsons of Levi, and they had become the leaders of the Levite clans.
translation_verse: Merari mma mmienzua mɔ, sɛ ɛnea bɛ mmusua mmusua a, bɛ ole Maheli ne Musi. Lewifoɛ mmusua nemɔ, sɛ ɛnea bɛ nana mɔ saso a, bɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The two Gershon clans were the Libnites and Shimeites,
translation_verse: Gɛsɔn boso ama deɛ ole Libini abusua ne Simei abusua; Gɛsɔnfoɛ mmusua nemɔ ɛne.

english_verse: The Gershonites, under the leadership of Eliasaph son of Lael, were to camp on the west side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: na Layel awa bienzua Eliasafe yeɛ né ɔla Gɛsɔnfoɛ b’abusua ne noa ɔ.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the tent itself, along with its outer covering, the curtain for the entrance,
translation_verse: Gɛsɔn boso ama nemɔ, b’adwuma wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu ole kyɛ, bɛ́nea ɛhemɔ amukoraa so: nyianu sua ne, pumbu ne ɔne ye ngatasoɛ, ɛtena bɔ onwi ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ ne,

english_verse: the curtains hanging inside the courtyard around the tent, as well as the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard and its altar. The Gershonites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: aluo berɛ mbɛmuɛ tena nemɔ; aluo berɛ bɔ wapɛ nyianu sua ne ne afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo wayia ne, ye nyunu berɛ ɛtena bɔ onwi berɛ ne, ɔne ye nyamaa nemɔ, ɔne bɛ nwo adwuma amukoraa.

english_verse: The four Kohath clans were the Amramites, Izharites, Hebronites, and the Uzzielites,
translation_verse: Kohate boso ama deɛ ole Amramfoɛ abusua, Yisarefoɛ abusua, Hebronfoɛ abusua ɔne Yusiɛlfoɛ abusua; Kohatefoɛ mmusua nemɔ ɛne.

english_verse: The Kohathites, under the leadership of Elizaphan son of Uzziel, were to camp on the south side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: na Yusiɛl awa bienzua Elisafan yeɛ né ɔla Kohatefoɛ b’abusua ne noa ɔ.

english_verse: Their duties at the tent included taking care of the sacred chest, the table for the sacred bread, the lampstand, the altars, the objects used for worship, and the curtain in front of the most holy place. The Kohathites were responsible for setting these things up and taking them down.
translation_verse: B’adwuma ole kyɛ bɛkɔnea ɛhemɔ aso: apam alaka ne, ɛpoen ne, kanea bakaa ne, afɔleɛ bokyea nemɔ, nekaa krongron berɛ nningyein bɔ asɔfo nemɔ fa yɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne, ɔne mbɛmuɛ ɛtena ne, ɔne sɔ nningyein nemɔ nwo adwuma amukoraa.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron was the head of the Levite leaders, and he made sure that the work at the sacred tent was done.
translation_verse: Né ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Eleasa yeɛ ɔla Lewifoɛ mbanyi nemɔ noa, na ye yeɛ né ɔnea bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ nekaa krongron berɛ adwuma ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: The two Merari clans were the Mahlites and the Mushites,
translation_verse: Merari boso ama deɛ ole Mahelifoɛ abusua ɔne Musifoɛ abusua; bɛ yeɛ bɛte Merarifoɛ mmusua ɔ.

english_verse: The Merarites, under the leadership of Zuriel son of Abihail, were to camp on the north side of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Na Abihail awa bienzua Suriɛl yeɛ né ɔla Merari mmusua nemɔ bɛ noa ɔ; odi kyɛ bɛkyekye b’asikyeleɛ wɔ nyianu sua ne sorɔ.

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and his sons were to camp in front of the sacred tent, on the east side, and to make sure that the Israelites worshiped in the proper way. Anyone else who tried to do the work of Moses and Aaron was to be put to death.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛkyekye b’asikyeleɛ wɔ nyianu sua ne nyunu, wɔ ye eyia afiteleɛ so yeɛ ole Mose ne Aarɔn ne Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ. Nekaa krongron berɛ sɔnenɛ adwuma biala bɔ odi kyɛ bɛyɔ bɛma Yisraelfoɛ ne, bɛ yeɛ owura bɛ sa ɔ. Sɛ ebie mbaen pingye nekaa krongron ne a, odi kyɛ beku ye.

english_verse: So Moses and Aaron obeyed the Lord and counted the Levites by their clans. The total number of Levites at least one month old was
translation_verse: Lewifoɛ mmienzua amukoraa bɔ Mose ne Aarɔn gyinane AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ so hale bɛ mmusua mmusua ne, bɛ bɔ bali ofi bosome ko bɔ ɔkɔ ne, bɛ somaa te apee aburanyɔ ne nyɔ. Pɔ wɔ bamuɛbaa mɔ fi AWURADE berɛ

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Make a list and count the first-born sons at least one month old in each of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Ka Yisraelfoɛ bamuɛbaa mmienzua amukoraa, bɛ bɔ bali ofi bosome ko bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, ná kyerɛ bɛ dumaa.

english_verse: They belong to me, but I will accept the Levites as substitutes for them, and I will accept the Levites' livestock as substitutes for the Israelites' first-born livestock.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Lewifoɛ de, ye bɛ sie berɛ ma me; Me ole AWURADE, ná fa bɛ si Yisraelfoɛ bamuɛbaa amukoraati bɛ gya nu. Lewifoɛ bɛ nyɛmmoa koso, fa bɛ si Yisraelfoɛ mɔ nyɛmmoa bamuɛbaa amukoraa bɛ gya nu.”

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord and counted the first-born sons;
translation_verse: Yiti Mose hale Yisraelfoɛ bamuɛbaa nemɔ amu, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne.

english_verse: Then the Lord said,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: “The Levites will belong to me and will take the place of the first-born sons; their livestock will take the place of the Israelites' first-born livestock.
translation_verse: “Fa Lewifoɛ mɔ si Yisraelfoɛ bamuɛbaa amukoraati bɛ gya nu, ná Lewifoɛ bɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ koso, fa bɛ si Yisraelfoɛ bɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ gya nu, na Lewifoɛ mɔ kɔyɛ me deɛ: Me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: But since there are more first-born sons than Levites, the extra
translation_verse: Na kyɛ ɔkɔyɛ ná ɛkɔpɔ Yisraelfoɛ bamuɛbaa ɛyaa nyɔ ne aburasoo ne nza, bɔ bɛbo Lewifoɛ ne somaa so nen,

english_verse: For each one, you are to collect five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: de bɛ nu biala ye ti nyɔboɛ sekel nnu, kyɛbɔ nekaa krongron berɛ sekel te nen; sekel bɔ nu nonɛ te gyera aburanyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: This money must then be given to Aaron and his sons.”
translation_verse: Na sikaa bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔpɔ bɛ bɔ bɛbo so nen, odi kyɛ ɛfa ma Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ.”

english_verse: Then he gave it to Aaron and his sons, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Na Mose gyinane AWURADE dwirɛ so fale bɛ ti nyɔboɛ sikaa ne mane Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn kyɛ,

english_verse: The Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects used in worship at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Kohatefoɛ mɔ, b’adwuma wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu ole kyɛ bɛkɔnea nningyein krongron paa nemɔ aso.

english_verse: When the Israelites are ready to move their camp, Aaron and his sons will enter the tent and take down the curtain that separates the sacred chest from the rest of the tent. They will cover the chest with this curtain,
translation_verse: Sɛ mmerɛ dwu kyɛ ɛmɔtutu asikyeleɛ ne bɛkɔ a, odi kyɛ Aarɔn ne ye mma bɛkɔ ɛtena sua ne anu bɛkɔye mbɛmuɛ tena ne bɛfa bɛkyekye Adanzeɛ alaka ne anwo.

english_verse: and then with a piece of fine leather, and cover it all with a solid blue cloth. After this they will put the carrying poles in place.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛfa abɔngye nwomaa ngatasoɛ bɛkata so; bɛ́fa ɛtena bibire bɛ́sɛ so, ná bɛ́fa ye mbuna nemɔ bewurawura nu.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will use another blue cloth to cover the table for the sacred bread. On the cloth they will place the dishes, the bowls for incense, the cups, the jugs for wine, as well as the bread itself.
translation_verse: Na paanoo krongron poen ne, odi kyɛ bɛfa ɛtena bibire bɛsɛ so, ná bɛ́fa ɛhemɔ bégua so: ndalie ne ɛyɛɛ kulie nemɔ, turonzemaa ne bua mɔ bɔ bɛkɔfa bekohwie afɔleɛ nzaa ɔ; odi kyɛ bɛfa daa biala paanoo ne koso bɛto so.

english_verse: With another blue cloth they will cover the lampstand, along with the lamps, the lamp snuffers, the fire pans, and the jars of oil for the lamps.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛfa ɛtena bibire bɛkata ɛhemɔ anwo: kanea bakaa ne ɔne ye nganea nemɔ, akapɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛtengyɛtengyɛ kanea nyamaa ne noa ne, kanea nyamaa nzoen ndalie nemɔ, yeɛ ngoo ndowaa amukoraa bɔ behwie nu ngoo begua kanea ne anu ne.

english_verse: All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather and placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛfa abɔngye nwomaa bɛkyekye kanea bakaa ne ɔne ye nwo nningyein amukoraati nwo, ná bɛ́fa bésie ndaboa bɔ bɛfa bɛsoa ɛtena sua ne aso.

english_verse: The gold incense altar is to be covered with a blue cloth, and then with a piece of fine leather, before its carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛfa ɛtena bibire bɛsɛ afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ bafa sikaa kɔkorɛ bayɔ ne aso, ná bɛ́fa abɔngye nwomaa ngatasoɛ bɛ́kata so, ná bɛ́fa ye mbuna nemɔ bewurawura nu.

english_verse: Next, Aaron and his sons will take blue cloth and wrap all the objects used in worship at the sacred tent. These will need to be covered with a piece of fine leather, then placed on a carrying frame.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛsesa nningyein bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔne wɔ nekaa krongron berɛ ne amukoraa, ná bɛ́fa bégua ɛtena bibire nu. Bɛ́fa nwomaa paa ngatasoɛ bɛkata so, ná bɛ́fa bésie ye mbuna ne aso.

english_verse: They are to remove the ashes from the bronze altar and cover it with a purple cloth.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ betu nzoen ne befi afɔleɛ bokyea ne anu, ná bɛ́fa koogyan bɛ́sɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso;

english_verse: On that cloth will be placed the utensils used at the altar, including the fire pans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the sprinkling bowls. All of this will then be covered with a piece of fine leather, before the carrying poles are put in place.
translation_verse: ná bɛ́fa nningyein hemɔ amukoraati bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔne wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso ne begua so: ngukue bɔ bɛfa see begua nu ɔ, ateɛ anoa tworɔntworɔn nemɔ, sofi nemɔ, ayaa nemɔ, afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso nningyein amukoraati; bɛ́fa nwomaa paa ngatasoɛ bɛkata so, ná bɛ́fa ye mbuna nemɔ béwurawura nu.

english_verse: When the camp is ready to be moved, the Kohathites will be responsible for carrying the sacred objects and the furnishings of the sacred tent. But Aaron and his sons must have already covered those things so the Kohathites won't touch them and die.
translation_verse: Sɛ Aarɔn ne ye mma mɔ bɛkata nekaa krongron ne ɔne nekaa krongron ne anu nningyein anwo beyie, ná sɛ mmenia ne betu bɛ bo befi asikyeleɛ berɛ a, odi kyɛ Kohatefoɛ basoa sɔ nningyein nemɔ. Nakoso onni kyɛ bɛ nwo ka nningyein krongron ne, ná banwu. Ɛhemɔ ole ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu nningyein mɔ bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ Kohatefoɛ mɔ bɛsoa ɔ.

english_verse: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest will be in charge of the oil for the lamps, the sweet-smelling incense, the grain for the sacrifices, and the olive oil used for dedications and ordinations. Eleazar is responsible for seeing that the sacred tent, its furnishings, and the sacred objects are taken care of.
translation_verse: “Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Eleasa yeɛ ɔnea ɛhemɔ aso ɔ: ngoo bɔ bɛfa begua kanea ne anu ne, ɛyɛɛ fona ne, daa biala aburoo afɔleɛ ne, ɛpopalɛ ngoo ne, nyianu sua ne ɔne nu nningyein amukoraa so nealɛ, nekaa krongron ne ɔne nu nningyein amukoraati.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: for carrying the curtains of the sacred tent, its two outer coverings, the curtain for the entrance to the tent,
translation_verse: odi kyɛ bɛsoa nyianu sua mbɛmuɛ tena nemɔ, ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne ɔne ye ngatasoɛ, abɔngye nwomaa bɔ ɔsɛ so ne, ngatasoɛ bɔ ɔsɛ so ne, ɔne ɛtena bɔ onwi ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ ne,

english_verse: the curtains hanging around the courtyard of the tent, and the curtain and ropes for the entrance to the courtyard. The Gershonites are to do whatever needs to be done to take care of these things,
translation_verse: aluo berɛ mbɛmuɛ tena nemɔ, aluo berɛ bɔ wapɛ nyianu sua ne afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo wayia ne, ye ɛtena bɔ onwi ye anoa nu berɛ ne ɔne ye nyamaa nemɔ, yeɛ nikyee biala bɔ ohia kyɛ bɛfa bɛyɔ bɛ nwo adwuma ɔ. Na odi kyɛ bɛyɔ adwuma biala bɔ ɔfa sɔ nningyein nemɔ anwo ɔ.

english_verse: These are the duties of the Gershonites at the sacred tent, and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Duties of the Merarite Clans
translation_verse: Gɛsɔnfoɛ mmusua mmusua ne, b’adwuma bɔ ɔfa ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nwo ɛne; na ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Yitama yeɛ ɔnea bɛ so maa bɛyɔ b’adwuma ɔ.

english_verse: The Merarites will be responsible for carrying the frames of the tent and its other pieces, including the bars, the posts, and the stands,
translation_verse: Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔte b’asɛdeɛ kyɛ bɛsoa ɔ. Ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu nningyein amukoraa, bɔ odi kyɛ bɛsoa hɔ ɛhe: nyianu sua ndaboa nemɔ, ye kwatena nemɔ, ye bonima nemɔ, ye nyinasoɛ nemɔ,

english_verse: as well as the posts that support the courtyard, together with their stands, tent pegs, and ropes. The Merarites are to be told exactly what objects they are to carry,
translation_verse: bonima mɔ bɔ bapɛ aluo berɛ amukoraa nwo bayia ne, bɛ nyinasoɛ, pɛmbɛen nemɔ, nyamaa nemɔ, ɔne bɛ nwo nningyein amukoraati, ɔne adwuma bɔ ɔboka so amukoraati. Na ɛ́mɔhyire ebiala nningyein bɔ odi kyɛ ɔsoa ɔ.

english_verse: and Ithamar son of Aaron will make sure they do their work. The Levites Are Counted Again
translation_verse: Ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nwo adwuma ne, Merarifoɛ mmusua mmusua ne b’adwuma amukoraa ɛne, na ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Yitama yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔnea bɛ so ɔ. Bɛhale Lewifoɛ

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelite leaders obeyed the Lord and counted the Levi tribe by families and clans, to find out how many men there were between the ages of
translation_verse: Bɛfale ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ahoroɔ ɔne nningyein soalɛ adwuma ahoroɔ bewurale bɛ sa, kyɛbɔ AWURADE nate Mose so hyɛle bɛ ne. Yiti Mose hale bɛ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne.

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Put out of the camp everyone who has leprosy or a bodily discharge or who has touched a dead body. Now that I live among my people, their camp must be kept clean.”
translation_verse: Kyɛ bienzua ahɔ oo, anaa brasua ahɔ oo, ɛ́mɔtu ye maa ɔhɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ. Onni kyɛ b’asikyeleɛ bɔ me ne bɛ yɛte nu ne, bɛfa efiɛ bɛka ye.”

english_verse: The Israelites obeyed the Lord's instructions. The Penalty for Committing a Crime (Leviticus
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ yɔle sɔ. Betuli bɛ maa bɛhɔle asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ. Kyɛbɔ AWURADE ha hyirele Mose ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ yɔle ɔ. Bɔnehanɛ ne mbatatualɛ

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you commit a crime against someone, you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Sɛ bienzua bie anaa brasua bie yɔ obiɛngo tɛɛ, maa ɔnate so ti ɔyɔ bɔne tia AWURADE a, sɔ sona ne di fɔ,

english_verse: You must confess your guilt and pay the victim in full for whatever damage has been done, plus a fine of
translation_verse: na odi kyɛ sɔ sona ne ka bɔne bɔ wayɔ ne. Odi kyɛ ɔfa nikyee si ye gya nu otua kerɛ; ósa fa nnu nu ngyɛmuɛ ko boka so ná ɔfa ma sona bɔ wayɔ ye tɛɛ ne.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: If the victim has no relative who can accept this money, it belongs to me and will be paid to the priest. In addition to that payment, you must take a ram for the priest to sacrifice so your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ bayɔ ye tɛɛ ne, sɛ wawu ná olle abusuaniɛ kaenn biala bɔ bɛkɔfa nikyee bɔ bɛfa besi ye gya nu ne bɛkɔma ye a, ye de sɔ nikyee ne te AWURADE deɛ, na odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛma ɔsɔfo ne. Mbata boaen nyii bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔpata bɛkɔma sona bɔ wayɔ tɛɛ ne, bɛ́fa bɛ́boka so.

english_verse: When you make a donation to the sacred tent, that money belongs only to the priest, and each priest will keep what is given to him. A Suspicious Husband
translation_verse: Ebiala ye akyɛdeɛ krongron te ɔsɔfo nemɔ deɛ. Nikyee biala bɔ ebiala kɔfa kɔbrɛ ɔsɔfo biala ne, ɔkɔyɛ sɔ ɔsɔfo ne deɛ.” Braa bɔ wabɔ ature ɔ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: Suppose a man becomes jealous and suspects that his wife has been unfaithful, but he has no proof.
translation_verse: sɛ nungunɛ wura biaa ne anu maa ɔtwe ɔye bɔ ye nwo agua fiɛ ne anwo nungunɛ, anaakyɛ nungunɛ wura biaa ne anu maa ɔtwe ɔye ne anwo nungunɛ wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɔye ne nwo ogguale fiɛ a,

english_verse: He must take his wife to the priest, together with one kilogram of ground barley as an offering to find out if she is guilty. No olive oil or incense is to be put on that offering.
translation_verse: ye de odi kyɛ biaa ne fa ɔye ne ba ɔsɔfo ne nyunu. Odi kyɛ ɔfa braa ne ti afɔleɛ bɔ ɔte ayuo esam olonka ko ne ɔba. Nnɛmaa ɔfa ngoo gua so, yeɛ nnɛmaa ɔfa ɛyɛɛ ogua so, ofikyɛ ɔte nungunɛhwenɛ aburoo afɔleɛ. Ɔte ngayeɛ aburoo afɔleɛ, bɔ bɛfa bɛkaye amumuyɛɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The priest will lead the woman to my altar and make her stand there.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa braa ne bagyina AWURADE nyunu;

english_verse: He will then pour sacred water into a clay jar and stir in some dust from the floor of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa nzue krongron bɔ ɔwɔ bua nu, ná ɔsa nyianu sua nu aseɛnwo mvuture ne bie gua nzue ne anu.

english_verse: The priest will write these curses on special paper and wash them off into the bitter water,
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne kyerɛ sɔ ɛnomalɛ dwirɛ ne gua nwomaa so, ná onwunzi gua nzue weewee ne anu.

english_verse: so that when the woman drinks this water, the curses will enter her body.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ma braa ne no nzue weewee bɔ ɛnomalɛ wɔ nu ne, na ɛnomalɛ nzue ne koogua ye kunu kɔmaa ɔkɔte yealɛ serɛserɛ paa.

english_verse: He will take the barley offering from her and lift it up in dedication to me, the Lord. Then he will place it on my altar
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne de nungunɛhwenɛ aburoo afɔleɛ ne fi braa ne sa nu, ná ɔnwaha ye wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ná ɔfa ba afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso.

english_verse: and burn part of it as a sacrifice. After that, the woman must drink the bitter water.
translation_verse: Aburoo afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne sa ye sa bum ko fa yɛ ngayeɛ nikye ná ɔyera ye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso. Afei odi kyɛ ɔma braa ne no nzue ne.

english_verse: But if she is innocent, her body will not be harmed, and she will still be able to have children.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ braa ne ogguale ye nwo fiɛ, ná mmom ye nwo te a, ye de hwee ngɔyɔ ye, na ɔkɔhora kɔwo baa.

english_verse: This is the ceremony that must take place at my altar when a husband suspects that his wife has been unfaithful. The priest must tell the woman to stand in my presence and carefully follow these instructions.
translation_verse: Anaa sɛ nungunɛhwenɛ wura bienzua nu maa ɔtwe ɔye anwo nungunɛ a, ye de odi kyɛ ɔfa brasua ne bagyina AWURADE nyunu ma ɔsɔfo ne fa braa ne fa nhyehyɛleɛ he amukoraati nu.

english_verse: If the husband is wrong, he will not be punished; but if his wife is guilty, she will be punished.
translation_verse: Bienzua ne ngoli amumuyɛɛ biala nwo fɔ, nakoso brasua ne de, ye amumuyɛɛ kɔbɔ ye ti so.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: If any of you want to dedicate yourself to me by vowing to become a Nazirite,
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Sɛ bienzua anaa brasua bie bɔ anohoba sonongo, bɔ ɔte nasiritefoɛ anohoba, kyɛ watu ye nwo wasie berɛ wama AWURADE a,

english_verse: you must no longer drink any wine or beer or use any kind of vinegar. Don't drink grape juice or eat grapes or raisins—
translation_verse: odi kyɛ otua ye nwo bobe nzaa ne nzaa serɛ. Onni kyɛ ɔno bobe nzaa kekarekekare anaa nzaa kekarekekare biala. Onni kyɛ ɔno bobe nzue anaa odi ye aleɛ, kyɛ ye monɛ oo, anaa ye worowaa oo.

english_verse: The hair of a Nazirite is sacred to me, and as long as you are a Nazirite, you must never cut your hair.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ amukoraa bɔ watu ye nwo wasie berɛ wayɛ nasiriteniɛ ne, onni kyɛ ɔtete ye ti. Kɔpem kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ watu ye nwo wasie berɛ wama AWURADE kɔpɛ nu ne, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ krongron; ɔ́ma ye ti nwiaa mbɛsɛmbɛsɛ ne ofu gua ye ti anwo.

english_verse: During the time that you are a Nazirite, you must never go close to a dead body,
translation_verse: Mmerɛ amukoraa bɔ watu ye nwo wasie berɛ wama AWURADE ne, onni kyɛ ɔkɔ fuin nwo.

english_verse: If someone suddenly dies near you, your hair is no longer sacred, and you must shave it seven days later during the ceremony to make you clean.
translation_verse: Sɛ mvum nu ebie wu wɔ ye nyunu maa ɔnate so efiɛ ka ye ti bɔ watu wasie berɛ wama AWURADE ne a, ye de kyẽa bɔ ɔpete ye nwo ne, odi kyɛ ɔpoa ye ti. Ɛlɛsoo ne aso yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔpoa ye ti ɔ.

english_verse: Then on the next day, bring two doves or two pigeons to the priest at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso, odi kyɛ ɔfa mmubure nyɔ anaa mmorɔnoma buruwa nyɔ brɛ ɔsɔfo ne wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ.

english_verse: He will offer one of the birds as a sacrifice for sin and the other as a sacrifice to please me. You will then be forgiven for being too near a dead body, and your hair will again become sacred.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa ko bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ, ná ɔfa ko koso bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, ná ɔpata ma ye, ofikyɛ ɔnate efuin ne ati wali fɔ. Odi kyɛ osa te ye ti ne anwo maa ɔyɛ krongron sɔ kyẽa ne ala,

english_verse: But the dead body made you unacceptable, so you must make another vow to become a Nazirite and be dedicated once more. Finally, a year-old ram must be offered as the sacrifice to make things right.
translation_verse: ná otu ye nwo sie berɛ ma AWURADE mmerɛ biala bɔ ɔtɛ te nasiriteniɛ ɔ. Odi kyɛ ɔfa boaen nyii akrɔngrɔma ko bɔ wali afoɛ ko ɔbabɔ foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ. Mmerɛ daa bɔ olili moa tuli ye nwo siele berɛ mane AWURADE ne de, wayera wagua, ofikyɛ efiɛ hane ye ti bɔ ɔyɛle ye krongron ne.

english_verse: When you have completed your promised time of being a Nazirite, go to the sacred tent
translation_verse: Sɛ mmerɛ bɔ nasiriteniɛ ne wafa watu ye nwo wasie berɛ wama AWURADE ne ɔba ayieleɛ a, ye nwo mmeraa ɛhe: odi kyɛ bɛfa ye bɛbagyina ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ.

english_verse: and offer three animals that have nothing wrong with them: a year-old ram as a sacrifice to please me, a year-old female lamb as a sacrifice for sin, and a full-grown ram as a sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔfa ye akyɛdeɛ hemɔ ɔbrɛ AWURADE: boaen nyii akrɔngrɔma ko bɔ wali afoɛ ko, bɔ ollili nnɛen biala, bɔ ɔ́fa bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ɔ; boaen beleɛ akrɔngrɔma ko bɔ wali afoɛ ko, bɔ ollili nnɛen biala, bɔ ɔ́fa bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ɔ; boaen nyii ko bɔ ollili nnɛen biala ɔ, bɔ ɔ́fa bɔ asomdwee afɔleɛ ɔ,

english_verse: Wine offerings and grain sacrifices must also be brought with these animals. Finally, you are to bring a basket of bread made with your finest flour and olive oil, but without yeast. Also bring some thin wafers brushed with oil.
translation_verse: paanoo kabrɛdi kɛndɛen ko, taterɛ bɔ bafa esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye bayɔ ɔ; apiti kabrɛdi bɔ bafa ngoo bafa ye nwo ɔ, yeɛ bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne bɛ nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ.

english_verse: The priest will take these gifts to my altar and offer them, so that I will be pleased and will forgive you.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa nningyein hemɔ ba AWURADE nyunu ná ɔbɔ nasiriteniɛ ne ye bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ne naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne.

english_verse: After that, you will stand at the entrance to the sacred tent, shave your head, and put the hair in the fire where the priest has offered the sacrifice to ask my blessing.
translation_verse: Nasiriteniɛ ne, ye ti bɔ watu wasie berɛ wama AWURADE ne, odi kyɛ ɔpoa ye wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ, na tire bɔ watu wasie berɛ wama AWURADE ne aso nwiaa ne, ɔ́fa ógua asomdwee afɔleɛ ne abo see ne anu.

english_verse: Once the meat from the ram's shoulder has been boiled, the priest will take it, along with one loaf of bread and one wafer brushed with oil, and give them to you.
translation_verse: Sɛ nasiriteniɛ ne, ɔpoa ye ti bɔ watu wasie berɛ wama AWURADE ne oyie a, odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa ɛhemɔ gua nasiriteniɛ ne ye sa munyɔ nu: sɔ boaen nyii ne ye waen bɔ bato ɔ, taterɛ kabrɛdi ko bɔ baye bafi kɛndɛen ne anu ɔ, ɔne apiti kabrɛdi ko.

english_verse: You will hand them back to the priest, who will lift them up in dedication to me. Then he can eat the meat from the ram's shoulder, its choice ribs, and its hind leg, because this is his share of the sacrifice. After this, you will no longer be a Nazirite, and you will be free to drink wine.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne pagya nningyein nemɔ aso bɔ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu; bɛ ne ye sa bɔ bɛnwaha ne, ɔne ye gya bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ne, bɛte krongron, ná ɔsɔfo bue deɛ ɛne. Ye si ye, nasiriteniɛ ne le ye nwo ate kyɛ ɔno nzaa ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: “When Aaron and his sons bless the people of Israel, they must say:
translation_verse: “Kã kyire Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ kyɛ: Edwirɛ he yeɛ ɛmɔhã bɛfa beyira Yisraelfoɛ ɔ. Ɛmɔhã behyire bɛ kyɛ,

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless and protect you,
translation_verse: ‘AWURADE yira wɔ, ná ɔnea wɔ so;

english_verse: and that he will show you mercy and kindness.
translation_verse: AWURADE ɔ́ma ye nyunu ɔta hyireinn ɔma wɔ, ná ɔlo wɔ;

english_verse: May the Lord be good to you and give you peace.”
translation_verse: AWURADE ɔ́te ye nyunu hyire wɔ, ná ɔma wɔ asomdwee.’

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “If Aaron and his sons ask me to bless the Israelites, I will give them my blessing.”
translation_verse: “Yiti odi kyɛ bɛma me dumaa da Yisraelfoɛ so, na ngoyira bɛ.”

english_verse: When Moses had finished setting up the sacred tent, he dedicated it to the Lord, together with its furnishings, the altar, and its equipment.
translation_verse: Kyẽa bɔ Mose sili nyianu sua ne yiele ne, ɔfale ɛpopalɛ ngoo popale ye, na ɔtele ye ne nu nningyein amukoraati nwo. Ɔfale ɛpopalɛ ngoo popale afɔleɛ bokyea ne, na ɔtele ye ne ye nwo nningyein amukoraati nwo.

english_verse: Then the twelve tribal leaders of Israel, the same men who had been in charge of counting the people, came to the tent
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, Yisrael mbanyi, yeɛ mbanyi bɔ bɛlela bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ noa, yeɛ mmusua kure nu mbanyi bɔ bɛlela mmenia bɔ bɛhale bɛ nemɔ noa ne, bɛbɔle afɔleɛ.

english_verse: with gifts for the Lord. They brought six strong carts and twelve oxen—one ox from each leader and a cart from every two.
translation_verse: Bɛfale b’afɔleɛ hemɔ bɛwale AWURADE nyunu: teaseɛnam nzia bɔ bakata so ɔ, ɔne nandwie buru ne nyɔ; mbanyi nyɔ biala bɛ teaseɛnam ko, yeɛ panyi biala ye nandwie ko. Bɛfale bɛ bɛbrɛle AWURADE wɔ nyianu sua ne anyunu.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: “Accept these gifts, so the Levites can use them here at the sacred tent for carrying the sacred things.”
translation_verse: “Dé sɔ nningyein nemɔ fi bɛ berɛ, maa bɛfa bɛyɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu ɛsolɛ adwuma, ná fa ma Lewifoɛ mɔ biala kyɛbɔ adwuma bɔ owura ye sa te ɔ.”

english_verse: Then Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites,
translation_verse: Yiti Mose lele teaseɛnam nemɔ ne nandwie nyii nemɔ, na ɔfa mane Lewifoɛ mɔ.

english_verse: who were under the leadership of Ithamar son of Aaron. Moses gave two carts and four oxen to the Gershonites for their work, and four carts and eight oxen to the Merarites for their work.
translation_verse: yeɛ ɔneane Merarifoɛ b’adwuma nwo mane bɛ teaseɛnam nna ne nandwie nyii mmɔtwɛ, na ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Yitama yeɛ né ɔnea Merarifoɛ nemɔ aso maa bɛyɔ b’adwuma ɔ.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any to the Kohathites, because they were in charge of the sacred objects that had to be carried on their shoulders.
translation_verse: Nakoso Kohatefoɛ de, wamma bɛ bie, ofikyɛ bɛ de, nningyein krongron bɔ owura bɛ sa ne, bɛsoa ye wɔ bɛ bati.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to give his offering for the dedication.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Odi kyɛ ɛlɛho biala mbanyi ne anu ko fa ye afɔleɛ ba, maa bɛfa betu afɔleɛ bokyea ne bewura me sa.”

english_verse: kilograms, according to the official standards;
translation_verse: abɔngye nyii ko bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ɔ;

english_verse: rams a year old as sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing.
translation_verse: Kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so ngona ne, Gideoni awa Abidan bɔ otua Benyamin abusua kure noa ne, ɔfale ye afɔleɛ deɛ wale.

english_verse: Whenever Moses needed to talk with the Lord, he went into the sacred tent, where he heard the Lord's voice coming from between the two winged creatures above the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Sɛ né Mose kɔ ɛtena sua ne anu kyɛ ɔne AWURADE bɛkwaadwudwo a, né ɔte komviɛ ne kyɛ odwudwo kyire ye fi Adanzeɛ alaka ne aso mbata bia bɔ ɔwɔ kɛrubim nyɔ ne b’afia ne, ye anwuro ɔ; né komviɛ ne ɔne Mose bedwudwo.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: “Tell Aaron to put the seven lamps on the lampstand so they shine toward the front.”
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Aarɔn kyɛ, Sɛ ɛ́fa nganea nemɔ siesie kanea bakaa ne aso a, odi kyɛ ɛfa nganea nzoo nemɔ siesie so maa bɛta kanea bakaa ne nyunu berɛ.”

english_verse: The lampstand was made of hammered gold from its base to the decorative flowers on top, exactly like the pattern the Lord had described to Moses. Instructions for Ordaining the Levites
translation_verse: Sɔa yeɛ bɛyɔle kanea bakaa ne ɔ: bɛborole sikaa kɔkorɛ yeɛ bɛfa bɛyɔle ɔ. Ofi ye nyinasoɛ so kodwu ye nyerɛen ne aso ne, ɔte sikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ baboro ɔ. Kyɛbɔ AWURADE fa hyirele Mose ne sɛso te ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔyɔle kanea bakaa ne ɔ. Betu Lewifoɛ besie berɛ bɛma AWURADE

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: and sprinkle them with the water that washes away their sins. Then have them shave their entire bodies and wash their clothes.
translation_verse: Ɛhe yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛyɔ ná ɛfa te bɛ nwo ɔ: Fa nzue bɔ bɛfa bɛte bɛ nwo ne pete bɛ nwo. Maa bɛfa dɛmaa bɛpoa bɛ nwo nwiaa amukoraa ná bɛpo bɛ nwo nningyein, amaa ɔnate so bɛ nwo ate.

english_verse: They are to bring a bull and its proper grain sacrifice of flour mixed with olive oil. And they must bring a second bull as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Afei maa bɛfa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma ko, ɔne ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ bɔ bafa esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ, na odi kyɛ esa fa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma ko babɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ.

english_verse: Then you, Moses, will call together all the people of Israel and send the Levites to my sacred tent,
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛma Lewifoɛ mɔ bagyina ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anyunu, ná ɛma Yisrael maen ne amukoraa babɔ dwaa.

english_verse: where the people will place their hands on them.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛma Lewifoɛ mɔ bagyina AWURADE nyunu a, odi kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ fa bɛ sa gua Lewifoɛ mɔ aso.

english_verse: Aaron will present the Levites to me as a gift from the people, so that the Levites will do my work.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ Aarɔn fa Lewifoɛ mɔ bagyina AWURADE nyunu maa bɛyɛ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ofi Yisraelfoɛ berɛ ɔ, amaa ɔnate so Lewifoɛ bayɔ AWURADE adwuma.

english_verse: After this, the Levites are to place their hands on the heads of the bulls. Sacrifice one of the bulls for the forgiveness of sin, and the other to make sure that I am pleased. Then the Levites will be acceptable to me.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ Lewifoɛ mɔ bɛfa bɛ sa begua nandwie nyii nemɔ ti afia; ná Aarɔn ɔ́fa ko ɔ́bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ, ná ɔ́fa ko koso ɔ́bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE, ná ɔfa pata ma Lewifoɛ mɔ.

english_verse: They will stand at my altar in front of Aaron and his sons, who will dedicate the Levites to me.
translation_verse: Afei ma Lewifoɛ mɔ beegyina Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ nyunu, ná fa bɛ yɛ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE.

english_verse: This ceremony will show that the Levites are different from the other Israelites and belong to me in a special way.
translation_verse: “Fa sɔ atee ye aso ye Lewifoɛ sie ahameɛ fi Yisraelfoɛ ngaa nemɔ anu, na Lewifoɛ mɔ kɔɔyɛ me deɛ.

english_verse: After they have been made acceptable and have been dedicated, they will be allowed to work at my sacred tent.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛte Lewifoɛ mɔ anwo yie, ná ɛfa bɛ yɛ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu a, ye si ye, odi kyɛ Lewifoɛ mɔ bɛkɔhyɛ b’adwuma bo wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu berɛ.

english_verse: When I killed the oldest sons of the Egyptians, I decided that the first-born sons in each Israelite family would be mine, as well as every first-born male from their flocks and herds.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Yisraelfoɛ bamuɛbaa amukoraa, kyɛ sona oo, kyɛ kaka oo, ɔte me deɛ. Kyẽa bɔ nguni bamuɛbaa amukoraa wɔ Misraim aseɛ so ne yeɛ nduli bɛ nziele berɛ mane me nwo ɔ.

english_verse: But now I have chosen these Levites as substitutes for the first-born sons,
translation_verse: Mafa Lewifoɛ mɔ masi Yisraelfoɛ bamuɛbaa mmienzua amukoraa bɛ gya nu.
