english_verse: and I have given them as gifts to Aaron and his sons to serve at the sacred tent. I will hold them responsible for what happens to anyone who gets too close to the sacred tent. The Levites Are Dedicated to the Lord
translation_verse: Afei koso, maye Lewifoɛ masie ahameɛ mafi Yisraelfoɛ nu, na mafa bɛ mayɛ akyɛdeɛ mama Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ, kyɛ bɛyɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma bɛma Yisraelfoɛ wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu, ná bɛpata bɛma Yisraelfoɛ, amaa sɛ Yisraelfoɛ bepingye nekaa krongron ne a, amaneɛ biala ando bɛ.”

english_verse: Moses, Aaron, and the other Israelites made sure that the Levites did everything the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Yiti Mose ne Aarɔn ne Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati betuli Lewifoɛ besiele berɛ bɛmane AWURADE. Yisraelfoɛ tuli Lewifoɛ siele berɛ kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose fale bɛ nwo ne ala.

english_verse: The Levites sprinkled themselves with the water of forgiveness and washed their clothes. Then Aaron brought them to the altar and offered sacrifices to forgive their sins and make them acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Lewifoɛ mɔ petene bɛ nwo, na bɛpole bɛ nwo nningyein. Afei Aarɔn fale bɛ yɛle ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, na Aarɔn patale mane bɛ fa tele bɛ nwo.

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses,
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: They may help the other Levites in their duties, but they must no longer be responsible for any work themselves. Remember this when you assign their duties.”
translation_verse: Bɛkɔhora bɛkɔbokaboka b’eliɛma mɔ maa bɛkɔyɔ b’adwuma wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu, nakoso onni kyɛ bɛyɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne bie. Sɔ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛfa Lewifoɛ nemɔ adwuma wura bɛ sa ɔ.

english_verse: During the first month of Israel's second year in the Sinai Desert, the Lord had told Moses
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ tu fili Misraim aseɛ so ne asi, bosome bɔ oli moa wɔ afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu, AWURADE sele Mose wɔ Sinai ɛserɛ ne aso kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the people, “Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: “Ma Yisraelfoɛ beli Abɔtra aluolue ne wɔ mmerɛ bɔ mahyɛ mato berɛ ɔ nu.

english_verse: in the evening of the fourteenth day of this month and do it by following all the regulations.”
translation_verse: Sɔ bosome he, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nna ne, sɛ aleɛ dwo a, ɛ́mɔli ye kyɛbɔ ye nwo ahyɛdeɛ ne ye nwo nhyehyɛleɛ te ɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ mahyɛ ɔ nu.”

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had said, and they celebrated Passover there in the desert in the evening of the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Belili Abɔtra aluolue ne wɔ bosome bɔ oli moa ne anu, wɔ ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nna ne aso. Aleɛ dwole ne, belili ye wɔ Sinai ɛserɛ ne aso. Kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ lili ye ɔ.

english_verse: Some people in Israel's camp had touched a dead body and had become unfit to worship the Lord, and they could not celebrate Passover. But they asked Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Né mmenia ne biemɔ bɛ nwo aha fuin ama bɛ nwo agua fiɛ, yiti bangora banni Abɔtra aluolue ne bie sɔ kyẽa ne. Bɛwale Mose ne Aarɔn nyunu sɔ kyẽa ne,

english_verse: “Even though we have touched a dead body, why can't we celebrate Passover and offer sacrifices to the Lord at the same time as everyone else?”
translation_verse: na beebisale Mose kyɛ, “Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ yɛ nwo aha fuin ama yɛ nwo agua fiɛ de, nakoso nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ besi yɛ ate maa ye sɔ ti yɛngora yɛmva yɛ afɔleɛ yɛmmrɛ AWURADE wɔ mmerɛ bɔ wahyehyɛ wato berɛ ɔ nu, kyɛbɔ Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne de bayɔ ne?”

english_verse: Moses said, “Wait here while I go into the sacred tent and find out what the Lord says about this.”
translation_verse: Mose buale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔnwondɛ maa ndie mmeraa bɔ AWURADE kɔhyɛ kɔfa ɛmɔ nwo ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the community of Israel: If any of you or your descendants touch a dead body and become unfit to worship me, or if you are away on a long journey, you may still celebrate Passover.
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Ɛmɔ nu biala anaa ɛmɔ bosoniɛ biala bɔ ye nwo kɔha fuin kɔma ye nwo kogua fiɛ, anaakyɛ ebiala bɔ watu atee ne, ye koso ɔsɛ kyɛ odi AWURADE Abɔtra aluolue ne bie.

english_verse: But it must be done in the second month, in the evening of the fourteenth day. Eat the Passover lamb with thin bread and bitter herbs,
translation_verse: Kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nna wɔ bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu ne, aleɛ dwo a yeɛ odi kyɛ bedi Abɔtra ne ɔ. Odi kyɛ bɛfa paanoo kabrɛdi ne awɔwee nyaa yeɛ bɛboka so bedi ɔ.

english_verse: and don't leave any of it until morning or break any of the animal's bones. Be sure to follow these regulations.
translation_verse: Nnɛmaa bɛyakyi bie ma aleɛ kye so, yeɛ nnɛmaa bɛbɔ naen ne bowue nu. Beli ye kyɛbɔ Abɔtra aluolue ne nwo nhyehyɛleɛ amukoraa te ɔ.

english_verse: But if any of you are fit to worship me, and yet refuse to celebrate Passover when you are not away on a journey, you will no longer belong to my people. You will be punished because you did not offer sacrifices to me at the proper time.
translation_verse: Nakoso ebiala bɔ ye nwo te, bɔ ottuli atee, nakoso wanni Abɔtra aluolue ne bie ne, odi kyɛ bɛpɛ ye asue befi ye mmenia nu, ofikyɛ wamva AWURADE afɔleɛ wammrɛ ye wɔ mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE ahyɛ ɔ nu. Sɔ sona ne, ye bɔne kɔbɔ ye ti so.

english_verse: As soon as the sacred tent was set up, a thick cloud appeared and covered it. The cloud was there each day, and during the night, a fire could be seen in it.
translation_verse: Daa biala sɔ ala yeɛ né ɔte ɔ: sɛ aleɛ kye a, munungum ne mundu so, na aleɛ sa a né wakakyi kyɛ see.

english_verse: whether it was only one night, a few days, a month, or even a year. As long as the cloud remained over the tent, the Israelites stayed where they were. But when the cloud moved, so did the Israelites.
translation_verse: Na sɛ munungum ne toa so mundu nyianu sua ne aso elenyɔ, anaa bosome, anaa mmerɛ tendenn biala a, Yisraelfoɛ kɔ so tena asikyeleɛ berɛ bɔ bendu bɛ bo ɔ. Nakoso sɛ munungum ne ma ye nwo so a, né batu bɛ bo.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: Have someone make two trumpets out of hammered silver. These will be used to call the people together and to give the signal for moving your camp.
translation_verse: “Boro ɛdwetɛ fa yɔ totorobɛndo nyɔ bɔ ɛkɔfa kɔfrɛ maen ne maa bɛkɔbɔ dwaa, ná asa ahu amaa batu bɛ bo bafi asikyeleɛ ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: If both trumpets are blown, everyone is to meet with you at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Sɛ behu bɛ munyɔ ne a, odi kyɛ maen ne amukoraa babɔ dwaa wɔ wɔ nyunu wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ.

english_verse: But if just one is blown, only the twelve tribal leaders need to come together.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ behu komapɛ a, mbanyi mɔ bɔ bɛlela Yisrael mmusua kure nemɔ anoa ne yeɛ beeyia wɔ wɔ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: Give a signal on a trumpet when it is time to break camp. The first blast will be the signal for the tribes camped on the east side, and the second blast will be the signal for those on the south.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔhu ye bɔ ɔtɔ so pɛen nyɔ maa okyire kyɛ edwirɛ asi a, odi kyɛ asikyeleɛ mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ ngwaen ne betu bɛ bo. Mmerɛ biala bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ betu bɛ bo ne, odi kyɛ behu maa okyire kyɛ edwirɛ asi.

english_verse: But when you want everyone to come together, sound a different signal on the trumpet.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ odi kyɛ maen ne amu bɛbɔ dwaa a, ye de ɛ́mɔhu, nakoso nnɛma ɛ́mɔhu maa okyire kyɛ edwirɛ asi.

english_verse: The priests of Aaron's family will be the ones to blow the trumpets, and this law will never change.
translation_verse: Aarɔn mma mmienzua nemɔ bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte asɔfo ne yeɛ odi kyɛ behu totorobɛndo ne ɔ. Ɛ́mɔma ɔyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ ɔma ɛmɔ wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: Whenever you go into battle against an enemy attacking your land, give a warning signal on the trumpets. Then I, the Lord, will hear it and rescue you.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛtane ɛmɔ nye bɛko koɛ wɔ ɛmɔ aseɛ ne aso a, ɛ́mɔhu totorobɛndo nemɔ maa ohyire kyɛ edwirɛ asi, amaa ɔnate so AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ waboka ɛmɔ, ná ɛmɔanya ɛmɔ ti badidi nu bafi ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu.

english_verse: During the celebration of the New Moon Festival and other religious festivals, sound the trumpets while you offer sacrifices. This will be a reminder that I am the Lord your God. The Israelites Begin Their Journey
translation_verse: Afei koso, ngyẽa bɔ ɛmɔfa bɛgye bɛ nye, ɔne ɛmɔ aluolue ngyẽa, ɔne kyẽa bɔ bosome kofi ne, ɛ́mɔhu totorobɛndo nemɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔbɔ ɛmɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ɔne ɛmɔ asomdwee afɔleɛ ɔ. Bɛkɔyɛ ngayeɛ nikyee bɛkɔma ɛmɔ wɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ nyunu: Me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ. Betu bɛ bo befi Sinai

english_verse: On the twentieth day of the second month of that same year, the cloud over the sacred tent moved on.
translation_verse: Befili Misraim ne, afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne, ye bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne, munungum ne mane ye nwo so fili adanzeɛ ɛtena sua ne aso.

english_verse: So the Israelites broke camp and left the Sinai Desert. And some time later, the cloud stopped in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Afei Yisraelfoɛ sili nu kure kure fili Sinai ɛserɛ ne aso, na munungum ne oogyinane Paran ɛserɛ ne aso.

english_verse: This was the first time the Lord had told Moses to command the people of Israel to move on.
translation_verse: Betuli bɛ bo bɔ oli moa ne, begyinane AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔnate Mose so hane ne aso yeɛ betuli ɔ.

english_verse: Judah and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out first, carrying their banner. Nahshon son of Amminadab was the leader of the Judah tribe,
translation_verse: Yuda asikyeleɛ ne anu ama yeɛ bɛfale bɛ frangaa belili moa betuli bɛ bo kure kure ɔ. Aminadabo awa Nason yeɛ né otua Yuda ɛlɔen ne amukoraa bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: Nethanel son of Zuar was the leader of the Issachar tribe,
translation_verse: Né Suare awa Netanɛl yeɛ otua Yisaka abusua kure ɛlɔen ne noa ɔ;

english_verse: and Eliab son of Helon was the leader of the Zebulun tribe.
translation_verse: yeɛ né Helon awa Eliabo yeɛ otua Sebulɔn abusua kure ɛlɔen ne noa ɔ.

english_verse: The sacred tent had been taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites carried it, marching behind the Judah camp.
translation_verse: Afei betutuli nyianu sua ne, na Gɛsɔnfoɛ ne Merarifoɛ bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛsoa nyianu sua ne, betuli bɛ bo.

english_verse: Reuben and the tribes that camped alongside it marched out second, carrying their banner. Elizur son of Shedeur was the leader of the Reuben tribe,
translation_verse: Ruben asikyeleɛ ne anu ama bɛfale bɛ frangaa ne betuli bɛ bo kure kure, na Sedɛre awa Elisure yeɛ né otua Ruben ɛlɔen ne amukoraa bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was the leader of the Simeon tribe,
translation_verse: Né Surisadai awa Selumiɛl yeɛ otua Simeon abusua kure ɛlɔen ne noa ɔ;

english_verse: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was the leader of the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: yeɛ né Dewel awa Eliasafe yeɛ otua Gade abusua kure ɛlɔen ne noa ɔ.

english_verse: Next were the Kohathites, carrying the objects for the sacred tent, which was to be set up before they arrived at the new camp.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Kohatefoɛ bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛsoa nningyein krongron ne, betuli bɛ bo, na Gɛsɔnfoɛ ne Merarifoɛ bɛhyehyɛle nyianu sua ne koraka yeɛ Kohatefoɛ bedwu berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Ephraim and the tribes that camped alongside it marched next, carrying their banner. Elishama son of Ammihud was the leader of the Ephraim tribe,
translation_verse: Afei, Efraim asikyeleɛ ne anu ama bɛfale bɛ frangaa betuli bɛ bo kure kure, na Amihude awa Elisama yeɛ né otua Efraim ɛlɔen ne amukoraa bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was the leader of the Manasseh tribe,
translation_verse: Né Pedasure awa Gamaliɛl yeɛ otua Manase abusua kure ɛlɔen ne noa ɔ;

english_verse: and Abidan son of Gideoni was the leader of the Benjamin tribe.
translation_verse: yeɛ né Gideoni awa Abidan yeɛ otua Benyamin abusua kure ɛlɔen ne noa ɔ.

english_verse: Dan and the tribes that camped alongside it were to protect the Israelites against an attack from behind, and so they marched last, carrying their banner. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was the leader of the tribe of Dan,
translation_verse: Afei Dan asikyeleɛ ne anu ama, bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ beli nziɛ bɛbɔ ɛlɔen ne amukoraati bɛ nwo waen ne, bɛfale bɛ frangaa betuli bɛ bo kure kure. Né Amisadae awa Ahiesa yeɛ otua Dan ɛlɔen ne amukoraa bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: Pagiel son of Ochran was the leader of the Asher tribe,
translation_verse: Né Okran awa Pagyiɛl yeɛ otua Asɛ abusua kure ɛlɔen ne noa ɔ;

english_verse: and Ahira son of Enan was the leader of the Naphtali tribe.
translation_verse: yeɛ né Enan awa Ahira yeɛ otua Nafetali abusua kure ɛlɔen ne noa ɔ.

english_verse: This was the order in which the Israelites marched each time they moved their camp.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ biala, sɛ né Yisraelfoɛ betu bɛ bo befi asikyeleɛ ne anu a, bɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ kure kure nemɔ, sɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne yeɛ né begyina so bɛfa bɛkɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Hobab the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, was there. And Moses said to him, “We're leaving for the place the Lord has promised us. He has said that all will go well for us. So come along, and we will make sure that all goes well for you.”
translation_verse: Mose sele Midianniɛ Rewel bɔ yeɛ ɔte ye sia bienzua ne, ɔwa Hobabo kyɛ, “Yɛtu yɛkɔ nekaa bɔ AWURADE aha ye nwo dwirɛ kyɛ, ‘Ngɔfa ngɔma ɛmɔ’ ne. Ɛne yɛ hɔ, na yɛkɔnea wɔ yé; ofikyɛ AWURADE ahyɛ Yisrael bɔ kyɛ ɔkɔmaa okoyie ye yé.”

english_verse: “No, I won't go,” Hobab answered. “I'm returning home to be with my own people.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Hobabo buale ye kyɛ, “Mengɔhɔ, na mmom mesa mekɔ me bɔbɔ me maen nu ne m’abusuafoɛ dɔ.”

english_verse: “Please go with us!” Moses said. “You can be our guide because you know the places to camp in the desert.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Mose sele kyɛ, “Nnɛyakyi yɛ nu, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛse nekaa bɔ odi kyɛ yɛkyekye asikyeleɛ wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso ɔ, na wɔ yeɛ ɛkɔhora kohyire yɛ atee ɔ.

english_verse: Besides that, if you go, we will give you a share of the good things the Lord gives us.”
translation_verse: Asa koso, sɛ ɛne yɛ kɔ a, nikyee paa biala bɔ AWURADE kɔfa kɔlo yɛ ne, yɛ koso yɛkɔmaa ekonya bie.”

english_verse: The people of Israel began their journey from Mount Sinai. They traveled three days, and the Levites who carried the sacred chest led the way, so the Lord could show them where to camp.
translation_verse: Yiti besili nu befili AWURADE bokaa ne aso bɛpɛle atee bɔ bɛfa ɛlɛsa yeɛ bɛpɛ ɔ. Né AWURADE apam alaka ne li bɛ nyunu wɔ sɔ ɛlɛsa ateetulɛ ne anu kyɛ ɔkwaapena nekaa maa bɛkyekye asikyeleɛ.

english_verse: Each day as the Israelites began their journey, Moses would pray, “Our Lord, defeat your enemies and make them run!”
translation_verse: Mmerɛ biala bɔ alaka ne kotu ye bo ne, Mose ka kyɛ, “O AWURADE dwɔso, ná ma wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛbɔ aya, ná ma bɛ bɔ bekyi wɔ ɔ bɛnwati befi wɔ nyunu.”

english_verse: And when they stopped to set up camp, he would pray, “Our Lord, stay close to Israel's thousands and thousands of people.”
translation_verse: Mmerɛ biala bɔ apam alaka ne kogyina neka horɛ ne, Mose ka kyɛ, “Sá bra, O Yisraelfoɛ apee apee b’AWURADE.”

english_verse: One day the Israelites started complaining about their troubles. The Lord heard them and became so angry that he destroyed the outer edges of their camp with fire.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ penepenene bɛ komvi fale amaneɛ bɔ benwu ye ɔ nwo maa odwuli AWURADE nyunu. AWURADE tele, na ɔfɛle yaa paa. Yiti AWURADE see ne tɔle wɔ b’asikyeleɛ ne anu, na ɔyerale asikyeleɛ berɛ bondua ne bie.

english_verse: When the people begged Moses to help, he prayed, and the fire went out.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmenia ne sũ frɛle Mose. Mose srɛle AWURADE na see ne nuane.

english_verse: One day some foreigners among the Israelites became greedy for food, and even the Israelites themselves began moaning, “We don't have any meat!
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ bɛɛfrafrale Yisraelfoɛ nu ne bɛ komvi wale aleɛ biemɔ aso. Na Yisraelfoɛ sá bɔle awuye kyɛ, “Yɛnyane naen a ahaa yɛkoli!

english_verse: In Egypt we could eat all the fish we wanted, and there were cucumbers, melons, all kinds of onions, and garlic.
translation_verse: Yɛkaye nzue nu naen bɔ né yɛfa ye mbaen wɔ Misraim, ɔne ndropo, ferɛ, ngondomire, gyeene ne galeke bɔ né yɛdi ɔ.

english_verse: But we're starving out here, and the only food we have is this manna.”
translation_verse: Nakoso kekesaala ye de, ɛhɔen yeɛ oku yɛ ɔ, na yɛnnya hwee, sana mana ye angome.”

english_verse: The manna was like small whitish seeds
translation_verse: Mana te kyɛ mviɛlɛ, na ye nwo sue te kyɛ anengyene.

english_verse: He prayed: I am your servant, Lord, so why are you doing this to me? What have I done to deserve this? You've made me responsible for all these people,
translation_verse: Yiti Mose bisale AWURADE kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛne w’akoaa bali ye weewee sɔa ye? Nzu ati yeɛ annwu me anwumvoin bɔ afa mmenia ne amukoraa bɛ nwo ngyeleɛ ahye me ye?

english_verse: They keep whining for meat, but where can I get meat for them?
translation_verse: Nisua yeɛ mekwaanya naen mema mmenia hemɔ amukoraa ɔ? Baasu bagua me so kyɛ, ‘Ma yɛ naen maa yɛli!’

english_verse: This job is too much for me. How can I take care of all these people by myself?
translation_verse: Me ngome mengɔhora mmenia hemɔ amukoraati so nea, ofikyɛ ɔbo m’anwoserɛ so.

english_verse: If this is the way you're going to treat me, just kill me now and end my miserable life! Seventy Leaders Are Chosen To Help Moses
translation_verse: Sɛ sɔ yeɛ ɛfa di me de a, ye de ku me pɛen ko. Nakoso sɛ anya alo me de a, nnɛma aworabɔlɛ to me.” Mbanyi aburasoo ne

english_verse: While I am talking with you there, I will give them some of your authority, so they can share responsibility for my people. You will no longer have to care for them by yourself.
translation_verse: Ngodwu ngɔwa me ne wɔ yɛkoodwudwo wɔ berɛ, na ngɔfa sunzum bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ nu ne bie ngowura bɛ nu. Ɛne bɛ ɛmɔkɔfa mmenia ne anwo fɛɛ bɛkɔto ɛmɔ nwo so, amaa wanna wɔ ngome wɔ so.

english_verse: As for the Israelites, I have heard them complaining about not having meat and about being better off in Egypt. So tell them to make themselves acceptable to me, because tomorrow they will have meat.
translation_verse: Na se mmenia ne kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔyɛ ɛmɔ nwo krongron bɛfa bɛnwondɛ ɛhema, na ɛmɔkoli naen; ofikyɛ ɛmɔasu maa AWURADE ate, bɔ ɛmɔnwa: ‘Yɛpena naen yɛdi! Amba yɛwɔ Misraim ne po, né ɔte paa ma yɛ.’ Yiti AWURADE kɔma ɛmɔ naen ma ɛmɔkoli.

english_verse: . They turned against me and wanted to go back to Egypt. Now they will eat meat until they get sick of it.
translation_verse: na mmom ɛmɔkoli ye bosome ko mumua, kɔpem kyɛ ɔkɔfa ɛmɔ bonyi anu, ná wabɔ ɛmɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔapo AWURADE bɔ ɔne ɛmɔ te ne, na ɛmɔabɔ awuye wɔ ye nyunu kyɛ, ‘Nzu ati po yeɛ yɛtu yɛfili Misraim ye?’ ”

english_verse: Even if we butchered all our sheep and cattle, or caught every fish in the sea, we wouldn't have enough to feed them.”
translation_verse: Aso yɛkonya bɛ noa mmoaen ne nandwie bɔ bekohu bɛ bɛkɔma bɛ ɔ? Aso yɛkonya bɛ noa naen yɛkɔhye bɛ wɔ ɛpo nu?”

english_verse: Eldad and Medad were two leaders who had not gone to the tent. But when the Spirit took control of them, they began shouting like prophets right there in camp.
translation_verse: Mmienzua nyɔ hale asikyeleɛ ne anu. Bɛfrɛ ko Eldade, yeɛ bɛfrɛ ko koso Medade. Sunzum ne wale bɛ so. Né bɛboka mbanyi bɔ Mose yele bɛ ne aso de, nakoso bamma ɛtena sua ne anwo dɔ bie, yiti bɛhyɛle ngɔm wɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu.

english_verse: A boy ran to Moses and told him about Eldad and Medad.
translation_verse: Aberandeɛ bie le amirika ɔɔbɔle Mose amaneɛ kyɛ, “Eldade ne Medade bɛwɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu dɔ bɛhyɛ ngɔm.”

english_verse: Joshua was there helping Moses, as he had done since he was young. And he said to Moses, “Sir, you must stop them!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nun awa Yosua bɔ ɔte Mose bokafoɛ fite ye mmerandeɛ nu, bɔ ɔboka mmienzua bɔ Mose yele bɛ ne aso ne, ɔhane kyɛ, “Me mene Mose, bera bɛ!”

english_verse: But Moses replied, “Are you concerned what this might do to me? I wish the Lord would give his Spirit to all his people so everyone could be a prophet.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Mose buale ye kyɛ, “Ɛ́ko me ti ngondii anaa? Ɔhale me ngome a, ahaa AWURADE mmenia amukoraati bɛte ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ; ahaa AWURADE afa ye sunzum wawura bɛ nu!”

english_verse: Some time later the Lord sent a strong wind that blew quails in from the sea until Israel's camp was completely surrounded with birds, piled up about a meter high for many kilometers in every direction.
translation_verse: AWURADE mane mvrama bie tuli, na ɔbɔle ayenzii fili ɛpo so maa beeguale asikyeleɛ ne ngyɛnu. Asikyeleɛ ne bue ko ne, ayenzii ne tete guale toonn kɔyɛ atee bɔ bɛfa ɛlɛho yeɛ bɛpɛ ɔ, yeɛ ye bue ko ne koso, beguale toonn kɔyɛ atee bɔ bɛfa ɛlɛho yeɛ bɛpɛ ɔ, maa bɛpɛle asikyeleɛ ne anwo amu beyiale. Né bataataa so bawa anwuro alaa kɔyɛ agyirɛ nyɔ.

english_verse: The people picked up quails for two days—each person filled at least ten large baskets. Then they spread them out to dry.
translation_verse: Yiti maen ne boaboale ayenzii ne noa sɔ kyẽa ne amukoraa eyia ne kɔngɔen, na aleɛ hyene ne koso, besa bɛtoale so kyẽa ne amukoraa. Sona bɔ wanzesa bie koraa ne, nna angora buru ɔ, na bɛworɛle bɛpɛle asikyeleɛ ne anwo beyiale.

english_verse: But before the meat could be eaten, the Lord became angry and sent a deadly disease through the camp.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ begu so bedi naen ne, bɔ né bennya belli beyyiele ne, AWURADE fɛle mmenia ne aso yaa paa, na AWURADE fale amaneɛ piri paa tole bɛ so.

english_verse: After they had buried the people who had been so greedy for meat, they called the place “Graves for the Greedy.”
translation_verse: Yiti bɛfrɛle berɛ Kibrote Hataawa, ofikyɛ berɛ yeɛ besiele mmenia bɔ benyane akɔnnɔ tɛɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: Israel then broke camp and traveled to Hazeroth.
translation_verse: Mmenia ne fili Kibrote Hataawa ne, bɛtoale so bɛhɔle Haserote.

english_verse: and told Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to come to the entrance of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Mvum nu, AWURADE sele Mose, Aarɔn ɔne Miriam kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ amɛsa, ɛmɔbra ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu.” Yiti bɛ mmɛsa befite bɛwale.

english_verse: There the Lord appeared in a cloud and told Aaron and Miriam to come closer.
translation_verse: AWURADE nate munungum ningɔnn nu dwu wale ase, na oogyinane ɛtena sua ne anoa nu berɛ. Ɔfrɛle Aarɔn ne Miriam, na bɛ munyɔ bɛwale anyunu.

english_verse: Then after commanding them to listen carefully, he said: “I, the Lord, speak to prophets in visions and dreams.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtie edwirɛ bɔ meka ye: Sɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ bie wɔ ɛmɔ nu a, me AWURADE yeɛ mefa nyekyire nu meye me nwo ali mekyire ye ɔ; medwudwo mekyire ye wɔ laleɛ nu.

english_verse: But my servant Moses is the leader of my people.
translation_verse: Nakoso Mose deɛ de, ɔtte sɔ; me maen amukoraati wura ye sa.

english_verse: He sees me face to face, and everything I say to him is perfectly clear. You have no right to criticize my servant Moses.”
translation_verse: Ye de megyina ye nyunu me ne ye yɛdwudwo pefee; mendwudwo mengyire ye anyandera nu; na onwu kyɛbɔ AWURADE ye sue te ɔ. Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔanzuro kyɛ ɛmɔkodwudwo bekotia me somvoɛ Mose ɔ?”

english_verse: The Lord became angry with Aaron and Miriam. And after the Lord left
translation_verse: AWURADE fɛle bɛ so yaa paa, na ofili bɛ berɛ hɔle.

english_verse: and the cloud disappeared from over the sacred tent, Miriam's skin turned white with leprosy. When Aaron saw what had happened to her,
translation_verse: Munungum ne fili ɛtena sua ne aso hɔle ne, né kwata anwonyerɛ ayɛ Miriam maa ye nwo ayɛ horaenn kyɛ asukɔtwea. Aarɔn pɛnene ye nye neane Miriam, na onwuni kyɛ kwata anwonyerɛ ayɛ ye.

english_verse: he said to Moses, “Sir, please don't punish us for doing such a foolish thing.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Aarɔn sele Mose kyɛ, “Ao, me mene, nnɛtwe yɛ so wɔ bɔne bɔ yali ngwaseasɛm yayɔ ye anwo.

english_verse: Don't let Miriam's flesh rot away like a child born dead!”
translation_verse: Nnɛmaa Miriam yɛ kyɛ baa bɔ bapɔ ye ɔ, bɔ ofi oni kunu wale ne, né ye nwonaen bue asɛkye dada ɔ.”

english_verse: Moses prayed, “Lord God, please heal her.”
translation_verse: Na Mose sũ frɛle AWURADE kyɛ, “Ao Nyameɛ, mesrɛ wɔ, sa ye anwonyerɛ.”

english_verse: But the Lord replied, “Miriam would be disgraced for seven days if her father had punished her by spitting in her face. So make her stay outside the camp for seven days, before coming back.”
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE buale Mose kyɛ, “Sɛ ɔse fele nwɔserɛ guale ye nyunu a, aso ahaa ye nyunu ngogua ase ɛlɛsoo? Maa bɛye ye maa ɔɔtena asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ ɛlɛsoo, ná ye si né basa bafa ye bawa asikyeleɛ ne anu.”

english_verse: The people of Israel did not move their camp until Miriam returned seven days later.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛyele Miriam bɛhɔle asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ ɛlɛsoo; na mmenia ne andoa ateetulɛ ne aso maa odwuli kyɛ besa bɛfale Miriam bɛwale asikyeleɛ ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: Then they left Hazeroth and set up camp in the Paran Desert.
translation_verse: Ɛhe asi ye, mmenia ne tuli bɛ bo fili Haserote, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Paran ɛserɛ ne aso.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: In fact, we saw the Nephilim who are the ancestors of the Anakim. They were so big that we felt as small as grasshoppers.”
translation_verse: Yɛnwuni Nefilifoɛ wɔ berɛ ; na yɛnea yɛ nwo a, né yɛte kyɛ torɔka mɔ, na sɔ ala yeɛ bɛ koso benwu yɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: “Choose a leader from each tribe and send them into Canaan to explore the land I am giving you.”
translation_verse: “Soma mmenia maa bɛɛtetɛ Kanaan aseɛ bɔ méfa méma Yisraelfoɛ ne. Ye sona ko fi b’abusua kure biala anu, bɔ ɔte abusua kure ne anu mbanyi nemɔ ko ɔ.”

english_verse: So Moses sent twelve tribal leaders from Israel's camp in the Paran Desert
translation_verse: Yiti Mose somane bɛ fili Paran ɛserɛ ne aso, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne. Né bɛ nu biala te Yisraelfoɛ nu sona titire.

english_verse: Before Moses sent them into Canaan, he said: After you go through the Southern Desert of Canaan, continue north into the hill country
translation_verse: Mose somane bɛ kyɛ bɛɛtetɛ Kanaan aseɛ ne, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔɔfa ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne aso bɛfo bɛhɔ mmokaa aseɛ ne aso,

english_verse: and find out what those regions are like. Be sure to remember how many people live there, how strong they are,
translation_verse: ná ɛmɔɔnea kyɛbɔ aseɛ ne osi te ɔ; kyɛ so mmenia ne bɛ nwo yɛ se anaa bɛ nwo nyɛ se; kyɛ banzo anaa bɛsone;

english_verse: and if they live in open towns or walled cities. See if the land is good for growing crops and find out what kinds of trees grow there. It's time for grapes to ripen, so try to bring back some of the fruit that grows there.
translation_verse: ɔne kyɛ aseɛ ne ɔkye aleɛ anaa ɔngye aleɛ; kyɛ mmakaa wɔ so anaa mmakaa nne so. Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ hue yɛ se, ná ɛ́mɔfa aseɛ ne aso mmakaammaa ne bie bɛ́bra.” Né sɔ mmerɛ ne te mmerɛ bɔ bobe ɔhyɛ ye bo ɔboro ɔ.

english_verse: The twelve men left to explore Canaan from the Zin Desert in the south all the way to the town of Rehob near Lebo-Hamath in the north.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛhɔle bɛɛtetɛle aseɛ ne fi Sen ɛserɛ ne aso maa oodwuli Rehobo bɔ opingye Lebo Hamate ne.

english_verse: As they went through the Southern Desert, they came to the town of Hebron, which was seven years older than the Egyptian town of Zoan. In Hebron, they saw the three Anakim clans of Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai.
translation_verse: Bɛfo bɛɛfale ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne aso. Beedwuli Hebron, na berɛ yeɛ né Anake bosofoɛ Ahiman, Sesayi ɔne Talmae bɛte ɔ.

english_verse: After exploring the land of Canaan for
translation_verse: Ye eleburanna ne aso, befili nekaa bɔ bɛɛtetɛle aseɛ ne besa bɛwale.

english_verse: the twelve men returned to Kadesh in the Paran Desert and told Moses, Aaron, and the people what they had seen. They showed them the fruit
translation_verse: Bɛwale Mose ne Aarɔn ɔne Yisrael maen amukoraa berɛ wɔ Kadese bɔ ɔwɔ Paran ɛserɛ ne aso ne. Bɛfale amaneɛ bɛɛbɔle bɛ ne maen ne amukoraa, na bɛfale aseɛ ne aso mmakaammaa ne behyirele bɛ.

english_verse: and said: Look at this fruit! The land we explored is rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle Mose amaneɛ kyɛ, “Yɛɛdwuli aseɛ bɔ ɛsomane yɛ wɔ so ne aso. Nyɔfonesue ne woɛ tengyɛ wɔ so, na so mmakaammaa ne bie ɛhe.

english_verse: But the people who live there are strong, and their cities are large and walled. We even saw the three Anakim clans.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmenia bɔ bɛtete aseɛ ne aso ne, bɛ nwo yɛ se. Bato ɛwaen bafa bɛ nguro nemɔ anwo, na nguro nemɔ te mbiri. Asa koso, yɛnwuni Anake bosofoɛ nemɔ wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: Besides that, the Amalekites live in the Southern Desert; the Hittites, Jebusites, and Amorites are in the hill country; and the Canaanites live along the Mediterranean Sea and the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Amalɛkefoɛ nemɔ bɛte ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne aso; Hitifoɛ, Yebusifoɛ, ɔne Amorifoɛ nemɔ bɛte mmokaa aseɛ ne aso, yeɛ Kanaanfoɛ te mboanoa ne asue Yɔɔdan noa.”

english_verse: Caleb calmed down the crowd and said, “Let's go and take the land. I know we can do it!”
translation_verse: Nakoso Kalebo tuli mmenia ne noa dwirɛ guale wɔ Mose nyunu, na ɔhane kyɛ, Ɛ́mɔma yɛhã yɛ nwo yɛhɔ kekesaala ye yɛɛfa aseɛ ne, ofikyɛ yɛkɔhora yɛkɔho yɛkɔfa.”

english_verse: But the other men replied, “Those people are much too strong for us.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ mmienzua bɔ bɛ ne ye hɔle ne hane kyɛ, “Yɛngɔhora yɛne mmenia hemɔ ngɔho, ofikyɛ bɛ nwo yɛ se tra yɛ.”

english_verse: Then they started spreading rumors and saying, “We won't be able to grow anything in that soil. And the people are like giants.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛfale aseɛ bɔ bɛɛtetɛle ne nwo amaneɛ tɛɛ bɛɛbɔle Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, “Aseɛ bɔ yɛɛtetɛle yɛhyinini so ne, ɔte aseɛ bɔ ɔngye aleɛ mma so ama nnya bie benni ɔ. Na mmenia bɔ yɛnwuni bɛ berɛ ne, bɛ mukoraa bɛte kwabranoa paa.

english_verse: and complained to Moses and Aaron, “We wish we had died in Egypt or somewhere out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Na Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɛpenepenene bɛ komvi beguale Mose ne Aarɔn so. Maen ne amukoraa sele bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ yɛwuwuli wɔ Misraim aseɛ so po a, ahaa ɔte paa! Sɛ yɛwuwuli wɔ ɛserɛ ye aso po a, ahaa ɔte paa!

english_verse: Is the Lord leading us into Canaan, just to have us killed and our women and children captured? We'd be better off in Egypt.”
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ AWURADE ɔfa yɛ ba aseɛ he aso maa yɛbatotɔ wɔ ngrandɛ noa ye? Yɛ ye mɔ ne yɛ mma mɔ kɔyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ. Sɛ yɛsa yɛ si yɛkɔ Misraim a, aso ahaa ɔtte paa mma yɛ?”

english_verse: Then they said to one another, “Let's choose our own leader and go back.”
translation_verse: Yiti besisele bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma yɛpena safohene maa oli yɛ nyunu ɔfa yɛ sá hɔ Misraim.”

english_verse: Moses and Aaron bowed down to pray in front of the crowd.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Mose ne Aarɔn fale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli ase wɔ Yisrael maen amukoraa bɔ babɔ dwaa ne nyunu.

english_verse: and said: We saw the land ourselves, and it's very good.
translation_verse: na besele Yisrael maen ne amukoraati kyɛ, “Aseɛ bɔ yɛɛtetɛle yɛhyinini so ne, ɔte aseɛ paa paa.

english_verse: If we obey the Lord, he will surely give us that land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Sɛ AWURADE do yɛ a, aseɛ he bɔ nyɔfonesue ne woɛ tengyɛ wɔ so ye, ɔkɔfa yɛ kɔhɔ so ná wafa wama yɛ.

english_verse: So don't rebel. We have no reason to be afraid of the people who live there. The Lord is on our side, and they won't stand a chance against us!
translation_verse: Mmom, nnɛma ɛmɔdwɔso betia AWURADE, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔsuro aseɛ ne aso ama, ofikyɛ bɛte yɛ sa nu ngwadaa koraa. AWURADE bɔ ɔbɔ bɛ nwo waen ne, waye ye sa wafi bɛ bo, nakoso yɛ de, AWURADE gyi yɛ si; nnɛma ɛmɔsuro bɛ.”

english_verse: The crowd threatened to stone Moses and Aaron to death. But just then, the Lord appeared in a cloud at the sacred tent. Moses Prays for the People
translation_verse: Nakoso maen ne amu yɛle b’adwene kyɛ bɛkɔboro bɛ nyɔboɛ. Yeɛ AWURADE animnyam yele ye nwo ali ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu hyirele Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “I have done great things for these people, and they still reject me by refusing to believe in my power.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Mmenia hemɔ kobu me animtia maa okoodwu kyinzu? Nzɛngyerɛnneɛ amukoraa bɔ mayɔ mama bɛ ye asi ye, kyinzu yeɛ bekole me bekoli ɔ?

english_verse: So they will no longer be my people. I will destroy them, but I will make you the ancestor of a nation even stronger than theirs.”
translation_verse: Ngɔfa ewue anwonyerɛ ngɔto bɛ so ná mapo bɛ, na ngɔfa wɔ ngɔyɛ maen bɔ ɔte piri bɔ ye nwo yɛ se tra bɛ ɔ.” Mose srɛ ma Yisraelfoɛ

english_verse: that you love to show mercy and kindness. And you said that you are very patient, but that you will punish everyone guilty of doing wrong—not only them but their children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: ‘AWURADE ahone nhu ndɛ, na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi sone; ɔfa amumuyɛɛ ne mmeraatolɛ kyɛ, nakoso ɔmma sona bɔ odi fɔ ne, ɔmva ye nwo tɔtorɔtɔɔ; ɔprapra seɛ mɔ bɔne nwo asohwenɛ gua bɛ boso ama mɔ so, maa okodwu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ nza ne nna so.’

english_verse: You are merciful, and you treat people better than they deserve. So please forgive these people, just as you have forgiven them ever since they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɔdɔ pindinn ne, kyɛbɔ osi te piri ne, fa wɔ nye to ná fa mmenia ye b’amumuyɛɛ kyɛ bɛ, kyɛbɔ afa ahyɛ bɛ fi Misraim maa waadwu ɛnɛ ye.”

english_verse: But as surely as I live and my power has no limit,
translation_verse: Nakoso, kyɛ nde ase ye, ɔne kyɛ AWURADE animnyam koyi aseɛ ye aso amukoraa tɛkyɛɛ ye,

english_verse: I swear that not one of these Israelites will enter the land I promised to give their ancestors. These people have seen my power in Egypt and in the desert, but they will never see Canaan. They have disobeyed and tested me too many times.
translation_verse: bɛ nu biala ngonwu aseɛ bɔ ndale ye nwo ndaen kyɛ ngɔfa ngɔma bɛ nana mɔ ne. Bɛ bɔ bebuli me animtia ne, bɛ nu biala ngonwu aseɛ ne.

english_verse: But my servant Caleb isn't like the others. So because he has faith in me, I will allow him to cross into Canaan, and his descendants will settle there.
translation_verse: Nakoso me somvoɛ Kalebo de, ɔnate kyɛ ye suban deɛ te sonongo ná wali nahorɛ wama me ne ati, ngɔfa ye ngɔhɔ aseɛ bɔ yeɛ ɔhɔle so ne aso, na aseɛ ne kɔyɛ ye boso ama bɛ deɛ.

english_verse: Now listen, Moses! The Amalekites and the Canaanites live in the valleys of Canaan. And tomorrow, you'll need to turn around and head back into the desert toward the Red Sea. The Israelites Are Punished for Complaining
translation_verse: Na afei, ɔnate kyɛ Amalɛkefoɛ ne Kanaanfoɛ bɛte bɔnza nemɔ anu ne ati, ɛhema ɛ́mɔkakyi bɛ nwo ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛ nye behyire Ɛpo kɔkorɛ atee ne aso bɛhɔ ɛserɛ ne aso dɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn kyɛ,

english_verse: to give this message to the people of Israel: You sinful people have complained against me too many times! Now I swear by my own life that I will give you exactly what you wanted.
translation_verse: Se bɛ kyɛ, AWURADE nwa nyoo, ‘Kyɛ nde ase ye, edwirɛ mɔ bɔ mate kyɛ ɛmɔaha ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ngɔfa ngoli ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You will die right here in the desert, and your dead bodies will cover the ground. You have insulted me, and none of you men who are over
translation_verse: Ɛserɛ ye aso yeɛ ɛmɔkowu bekogua ɔ, na ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ bɛhale ɛmɔ ne, ebiala bɔ wali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ, bɔ wapenepene ye komvi wagua me so ne,

english_verse: will enter the land that I solemnly promised to give you as your own—only Caleb and Joshua will go in.
translation_verse: ɛmɔ nu ko po ngodwu aseɛ bɔ ndale ndaen kyɛ ngɔfa ɛmɔ ngɔɔtena so ne aso, sana Yefune awa Kalebo ɔne Nun awa Yosua.

english_verse: You were worried that your own children would be captured. But I, the Lord, will let them enter the land you have rejected.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ mma mmaa mmaa bɔ ɛmɔnwa bɛkɔhye bɛ nnure ne, ngɔfa bɛ ngɔhɔ aseɛ ne aso maa bekonwu aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔato ye nwo ne.

english_verse: You will die here in the desert!
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔkowuwu bekogua ɛserɛ ye aso.

english_verse: So they got up early the next morning and got ready to head toward the hill country of Canaan. They said, “We were wrong to complain about the Lord. Let's go into the land that he promised us.”
translation_verse: Bedwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ tutututu bɛhɔle mmokaa aseɛ ne ati afia, na besele kyɛ, “Yɛ ɛhe. Yɛkɔhɔ nekaa bɔ AWURADE fa hyɛle yɛ bɔ ne, ofikyɛ yayɔ bɔne.”

english_verse: Ten of the men sent to explore the land had brought back bad news and had made the people complain against the Lord.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ Mose somane bɛ maa bɛɛtetɛle aseɛ ne, bɔ besa bɛwale bɛɛbɔle aseɛ ne nwo amaneɛ tɛɛ maa yiti maen ne amukoraa bɛpenepenene bɛ komvi beguale Mose so ne,

english_verse: So he sent a deadly disease that killed those men,
translation_verse: mmenia bɔ bɛɛbɔle aseɛ ne anwo amaneɛ tɛɛ ne, ewue te pene bɛ so maa bewuwuli wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: but he let Joshua and Caleb live. The Israelites Fail To Enter Canaan (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Na mmenia bɔ bɛɛtetɛle aseɛ nen, Nun awa Yosua ɔne Yefune awa Kalebo angome yeɛ bɛhale ɔ.

english_verse: But Moses replied, “You're disobeying the Lord! Your plan won't work,
translation_verse: Nakoso Mose sele kye, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔtɛbu AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ so ye? Sɔ ngɔboka ɛmɔ.

english_verse: The Amalekites and the Canaanites came down from the hill country, defeated the Israelites, and chased them as far as the town of Hormah.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Amalɛkefoɛ ne Kanaanfoɛ bɔ bɛte mmokaa aseɛ ne aso ne beeyiale bɛ ɔ. Belili Yisraelfoɛ so ngonim, na bɛfoane bɛ toonn beedwuli Hɔma.

english_verse: The people of Israel were very sad after Moses gave them the Lord's message.
translation_verse: Mose hane edwirɛ hemɔ hyirele Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa ne, besuni hahii.

english_verse: so don't even try it. The Lord refuses to help you, because you turned your backs on him. The Amalekites and the Canaanites are your enemies, and they will attack and defeat you.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Amalɛkefoɛ ne Kanaanfoɛ kɔfa koɛ kɔtoa ɛmɔ wɔ dɔ, na ɛmɔkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa. Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔayɛ AWURADE nwo lɔen ne ati, AWURADE ngogyina ɛmɔ si.”

english_verse: But the Israelites ignored Moses and marched toward the hill country, even though the sacred chest and Moses did not go with them.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ né AWURADE apam alaka ne, ɔne Mose bɛtɛ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu berɛ de, nakoso Yisraelfoɛ tuli bɛ bo kyɛ bɛfo bɛkɔ mmokaa aseɛ ne aso dɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to give the Israelites the following laws about offering sacrifices:
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Sɛ ɛmɔbadwu aseɛ bɔ mefa mema ɛmɔ ma ɛmɔtena so ne aso,

english_verse: Bulls or rams or goats are the animals that you may burn on the altar as sacrifices to please me. You may also offer sacrifices voluntarily or because you made a promise, or because they are part of your regular religious ceremonies. The smell of the smoke from these sacrifices is pleasing to me.
translation_verse: ná ɛmɔbɔ afɔleɛ wɔ see so bɛma AWURADE a, kyɛ kaka ne ofi nandwie kure nu oo, anaa mmoaen kure nu oo, kyɛ ɔte naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ oo anaa afɔleɛ biala oo; sɛ ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ ɛmɔfa betua aboadeɛ, anaakyɛ ɔte akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ, anaa sɛ ɛmɔdi ɛmɔ aluolue bɔ mahyehyɛ mama ɛmɔ ne a, bɔ ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona a,

english_verse: If you sacrifice a young ram or goat, you must also offer a kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of olive oil as a grain sacrifice. A liter of wine must also be poured on the altar.
translation_verse: Afei koso, boaen akrɔngrɔma ko biala, fa bobe nzaa towaa ko ne bue yɛ anonneɛ afɔleɛ boka naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ anaa afɔleɛ ne aso.

english_verse: If a bull is offered as a sacrifice to please me or to ask my blessing,
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛfa nandwie nyii bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ anaa afɔleɛ biala a, kyɛ ɛfa tua aboadeɛ oo, anaakyɛ ɛfa bɔ asomdwee afɔleɛ ma AWURADE oo,

english_verse: you must offer three kilograms of flour mixed with two liters of olive oil.
translation_verse: ye de fa ɛhemɔ boka nandwie nyii ne aso: aburoo afɔleɛ bɔ ɔte esam paa olonka nza bɔ bafa ngoo towaa nza ne bue bafra ɔ,

english_verse: Two liters of wine must also be poured on the altar. The smell of this smoke is pleasing to me.
translation_verse: na fa bobe nzaa towaa nza ne bue bɔ anonneɛ afɔleɛ wɔ see so, bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ.

english_verse: If you are a native Israelite, you must obey these rules each time you offer a bull, a ram, or a goat as a sacrifice.
translation_verse: Yisrael maen baa biala, sɛ ɔbɔ afɔleɛ wɔ see so, bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona a, sɔ ala yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔyɔ ye ɔ.

english_verse: This law will never change. I am the Lord, and I consider all people the same, whether they are Israelites or foreigners living among you.
translation_verse: Mmeraa komapɛ ne ala ne nhyehyɛleɛ komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɛmɔ ne ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ waatena ɛmɔ nu ne odi kyɛ ɛmɔdi so ɔ.”

english_verse: When you eat food in the land that I am giving you, remember to set aside some of it as an offering to me.
translation_verse: mmerɛ biala bɔ ɛmɔkoli aseɛ ne aso aleɛ ne, ɛ́mɔfa akyɛdeɛ bɛ́brɛ AWURADE.

english_verse: From the first batch of bread dough that you make after each new grain harvest, make a loaf of bread and offer it to me, just as you offer grain.
translation_verse: Mɔle bɔ ofi aburoo bɔ ɛmɔkoli moa bekobu nu ne, ɛ́mɔfa bie bɛyɔ taterɛ bɛyɛ akyɛdeɛ bɛbrɛ AWURADE. Ɛ́mɔfa bɛbrɛ ye kyɛbɔ ɛmɔfa akyɛdeɛ bɔ ofi nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo bɛbrɛ ye ne.

english_verse: All your descendants must follow this law and offer part of the first batch of bread dough.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu, aburoo bɔ ɛmɔkoli moa bekobu ne, ɛ́mɔfa bie bɛ́yɔ mɔle bɛ́fa bɛ́yɛ akyɛdeɛ bɛ́brɛ AWURADE. Bɔne bɔ bɛmmoa pa nwo afɔleɛ

english_verse: The Lord also told Moses to tell the people what must be done if they ever disobey his laws:
translation_verse: nikyee biala bɔ AWURADE nate Mose so wahyɛ, ofi kyẽa bɔ AWURADE mane ɛmɔ ahyɛdeɛ ne bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraati nu,

english_verse: If all of you disobey one of my laws without knowing it, you must offer a bull as a sacrifice to please me, together with a grain sacrifice, a wine offering, and a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: ná sɛ ɛmɔanhyɛ da yeɛ ɛmɔbuli so bɔ maen ne nze ye nwo hwee a, ye de odi kyɛ maen ne amukoraati bɛfa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma ko bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ. Odi kyɛ bɛfa ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ɔne ye nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɛboka so, kyɛbɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne te ne, ná bɛ́fa abɔngye nyii ko bɛ́bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ.

english_verse: Then the priest will pray and ask me to forgive you. And since you did not mean to do wrong, and you offered sacrifices,
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne pata ma Yisrael maen ne amu, na AWURADE kɔfa bɛ bɔne kɔhyɛ bɛ. Banhyɛ da, yeɛ afei babɔ afɔleɛ wɔ see so bama AWURADE, na babɔ bɛ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ɔnate bɛ mvomsoɛ ti.

english_verse: But if one of you does wrong without knowing it, you must sacrifice a year-old female goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Sona biala bɔ wanhyɛ da ná ɔkɔyɔ bɔne ne, odi kyɛ ɔfa abɔngye beleɛ bɔ wali afoɛ ko ɔ ɔbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ.

english_verse: The priest will then ask me to forgive you, and your sin will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie anhyɛ da ná ɔyɔ mvomsoɛ a, ɔsɔfo ne kɔpata kɔma sɔ sona ne wɔ AWURADE nyunu, na AWURADE kɔfa ye mvomsoɛ kɔhyɛ ye.

english_verse: The law will be the same for anyone who does wrong without meaning to, whether an Israelite or a foreigner living among you.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma mmeraa komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔla berɛ ma ebiala bɔ ɔkɔyɔ mvomsoɛ ɔ, kyɛ ɔte Yisrael maen baa oo, anaa ɛwɔfoɛ biala bɔ waatena ɛmɔ nu oo.

english_verse: But if one of you does wrong on purpose, whether Israelite or foreigner, you have sinned against me by disobeying my laws. You will no longer belong to my people. A Man Put to Death for Gathering Firewood on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ sɔ sona ne wabu AWURADE noa dwirɛ animtia, ná wabu ye mmeraa dwirɛ so ne ati, odi kyɛ bɛpɛ ye asue korakora, na ye musue kɔbɔ ye ti so.” Afofikyẽa tonɛ nwo asohwenɛ

english_verse: Once, while the Israelites were traveling through the desert, a man was caught gathering firewood on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né Yisraelfoɛ wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso ne, afofikyẽa bie, benwuni kyɛ biaa bie obubu eyein ɔ.

english_verse: He was taken to Moses, Aaron, and the rest of the community.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ benwuni kyɛ obubu eyein ne fale ye wale Mose, Aarɔn ɔne maen ne amukoraati bɛ nyunu.

english_verse: But no one knew what to do with him, so he was not allowed to leave.
translation_verse: Bɛfale ye bɛtole kuku nu, ofikyɛ né bennya bennwuni bɔ odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛyɔ ye ɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to Moses, “Tell the people to take that man outside the camp and stone him to death!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Odi kyɛ beku biaa ne; ma mmenia ne amukoraa bɛboro ye nyɔboɛ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ.”

english_verse: So he was killed, just as the Lord had commanded Moses. The Tassels on the People's Clothes
translation_verse: Mmenia ne amukoraa bɛfale ye bɛwale asikyeleɛ ne asi, na bɛborole ye nyɔboɛ behuni ye, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne ala. Ndaadeɛ noa nwonɛ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel, “Sew tassels onto the bottom edge of your clothes and tie a blue string to each tassel.
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, wɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu, odi kyɛ bɛnwo nikyee besinzesinze bɛ ndaadeɛ noa, ná bɛ́fa nyamaa bibire bɛ́sosɔ nningyein bɔ bafa basinzesinze ye noa ne anu.

english_verse: These will remind you that you must obey my laws and teachings. And when you do, you will be dedicated to me and won't follow your own sinful desires.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe kɔma ɛmɔkɔkaye me mmeraa dwirɛ amukoraati ná ɛmɔali so, amaa ɛmɔayɛ krongron bama ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Korah son of Izhar was a Levite from the Kohathite clan. One day he called together Dathan, Abiram, and On from the Reuben tribe, and the four of them decided to rebel against Moses. So they asked
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ mmienzua ɛyaa nyɔ ne aburannu, bɔ bɛte maen mbanyi, bɔ bapa nu baye bɛ, bɔ bɛte atitirefoɛ ɔ, na bɛhɔle Mose so.

english_verse: and Aaron and said, “Why do you think you're so much better than everyone else? We're part of the Lord's holy people, and he's with all of us. What makes you think you're the only ones in charge?”
translation_verse: Bɛyɛle lɔen betiale Mose ne Aarɔn, na besele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔduo boɛ! Maen ne anu mmenia amu te krongron, ebiala te krongron, na AWURADE gyi bɛ si. Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔafo batena AWURADE mmenia kɔme so ɔ?”

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he knelt down to pray.
translation_verse: Mose tele ɛhe ne, ɔfale ye nyunu butuli ase.

english_verse: Then he said to Korah and his followers: Tomorrow morning the Lord will show us the person he has chosen to be his priest, and that man will faithfully serve him.
translation_verse: Na osele Kora ne ye lɔen ne amukoraa kyɛ, “Ɛhema ngyerɛmɔ, AWURADE kɔmaa yɛkonwu sona horɛ bɔ ɔte AWURADE deɛ ɔ, bɔ ɔte krongron ɔ, ɔne bɔ ɔkɔpene so maa okopingye ye ɔ. Sona bɔ AWURADE kɔnea nu kɔye ye ne, ɔkɔmaa okopingye ye.

english_verse: Korah, here is what you and your followers must do: Get some fire pans, fill them with coals and incense, and place them near the sacred tent. And the man the Lord chooses will be his priest. Korah, this time you Levites have gone too far!
translation_verse: Ɛhema ɛ́mɔfa see begua bɛ nu, na ɛ́mɔfa ɛyɛɛ bégua so wɔ AWURADE nyunu. Na sona bɔ AWURADE kɔnea nu kɔye ye ne, ye yeɛ ɔte krongronniɛ ne ɔ. Ɛmɔ Lewifoɛ, ɛmɔduo boɛ!”

english_verse: You know that the God of Israel has chosen you Levites from all Israel to serve him by being in charge of the sacred tent and by helping the community to worship in the proper way. What more do you want?
translation_verse: Aso ɔte nikyee ba ma ɛmɔ, kyɛ Yisrael Nyameɛ waneanea Yisraelfoɛ nu waye ɛmɔ, ná wama ɛmɔ ate kyɛ ɛmɔbra ye nyunu bɛɛyɔ AWURADE nyianu sua ne anu adwuma, ná ɛmɔgyina maen ne anyunu bɛso bɛ ɔ?

english_verse: The Lord has given you a special responsibility, and now, Korah, you think you should also be his priest.
translation_verse: Wama wɔ ne eliɛma mɔ Lewifoɛ amukoraa ate ama ɛmɔawa ye nyunu; nakoso afei de ɛmɔpere asɔfo adwuma ne bɛboka so!

english_verse: Then Moses sent for Dathan and Abiram, but they sent back this message: “We won't come!
translation_verse: Mose somane maa bɛɛfrɛle Eliabo mma Datan ne Abiram; nakoso besele kyɛ, “Yɛngɔwa!

english_verse: It's bad enough that you took us from our rich farmland in Egypt to let us die here in the desert. Now you also want to boss us around!
translation_verse: Aso ɔte edwirɛ baa kyɛ aaye yɛ afi aseɛ bɔ nyɔfonesue ne woɛ tengyɛ wɔ so ɔ so, kyɛ ɛbaahu yɛ wɔ ɛserɛ ye aso, bɔ yeɛ esa hyɛ yɛ so ɔ?

english_verse: Moses was very angry and said to the Lord, “Don't listen to these men! I haven't done anything wrong to them. I haven't taken as much as a donkey.”
translation_verse: Mose fɛle yaa paa, na osele AWURADE kyɛ, “Nnɛde b’afɔleɛ ne to nu. Nnnele afunum ko po mmvili bɛ berɛ, yeɛ nnyɔle bɛ nu biala tɛɛ.”

english_verse: Then he said to Korah, “Tomorrow you and your followers must go with Aaron to the Lord's sacred tent.
translation_verse: Afei Mose sele Kora kyɛ, “Ɛne wɔ lɔen ne amukoraa, ɛhema ɛmɔɔgyina AWURADE nyunu, ɛne bɛ ne Aarɔn;

english_verse: The next day the men placed incense and coals in their fire pans and stood with Moses and Aaron at the entrance to the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Yiti ebiala fale ye see kulie, bɛfale see beguale nu, bɛfale ɛyɛɛ beguale so, na bɛ ne Mose ne Aarɔn beegyinane ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, Korah had convinced the rest of the Israelites to rebel against their two leaders. When that happened, the Lord appeared in all his glory
translation_verse: Yeɛ Kora boaboale maen ne amukoraa noa maa begyinane Mose ne Aarɔn bɛ ndendeneɛ so wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ. Na AWURADE animnyam yele ye nwo ali hyirele maen ne amu.

english_verse: and said to Moses and Aaron,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn kyɛ,

english_verse: “Get away from the rest of the Israelites so I can kill them at once!”
translation_verse: “Nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɛ nwo bɛkɔfra sɔ ɛlɔen he anu, na mebaanua bɛ boso kekesaala ye.”

english_verse: But the two men bowed down and prayed, “Our God, you gave these people life. Why would you punish everyone here when only one man has sinned?”
translation_verse: Na Mose ne Aarɔn fale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli ase, na besele kyɛ, “O Nyameɛ, anwoɔnaen amukoraa bɛ sunzum Nyameɛ, aso sona ko yɔ bɔne maa ɔnate so ɛfɛ maen ne amukoraa so yaa anaa?”

english_verse: The Lord answered Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: “Tell the people to stay away from the tents of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.”
translation_verse: “Ka kyire ɛlɔen ne kyɛ, Ɛ́mɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi Kora, Datan ne Abiram b’atenaleɛ nwo.”

english_verse: Moses walked over to Dathan and Abiram, and the other leaders of Israel followed.
translation_verse: Yiti Mose dwɔsole hɔle Datan ne Abiram berɛ. Na Yisrael mbanyi lili ye si.

english_verse: Then Moses warned the people, “Get away from the tents of these sinful men! Don't touch anything that belongs to them or you'll be wiped out.”
translation_verse: Mose sele maen ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi amumuyɛɛfoɛ hemɔ b’ɛtena sua nemɔ anwo. Nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ nwo ka bɛ nikye fee; anyɔ a, ɔnate bɛ bɔne amukoraa ti AWURADE konua ɛmɔ aboso.”

english_verse: Moses said to the crowd, “The Lord has chosen me and told me to do these things—it wasn't my idea. And here's how you will know:
translation_verse: Yeɛ Mose sele kyɛ, “Ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔmaa ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ AWURADE yeɛ wasoma me kyɛ mmanyɔ sɔ nningyein he amu ɔ; na mmom nna me bɔbɔ yeɛ medi me ti piri ɔ.

english_verse: If these men die a natural death, it means the Lord hasn't chosen me.
translation_verse: Sɛ mmenia hemɔ bewu bɛ bɔbɔ b’ɛdangama wue, anaa sɛ bɔ ɔto kuro sona biala yeɛ ɔto bɛ a, ye de nna AWURADE yeɛ wasoma me ɔ.

english_verse: But suppose the Lord does something that has never been done before. For example, what if a huge crack appears in the ground, and these men and their families fall into it and are buried alive, together with everything they own? Then you will know they have turned their backs on the Lord!”
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ AWURADE yɔ anwanwadeɛ bie, ná aseɛ bukye ye noa nu meme bɛ ne bɛ nwo ama amukoraa ɔne bɛ nwo nningyein amukoraa, wɔ aberɛ bɔ bɛ nye gua so maa bɛkɔ ɛborɔ a, ye de ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ mmenia hemɔ abu AWURADE animtia.”

english_verse: As soon as Moses said this, the ground under the men opened up
translation_verse: Mose noa pene pɛ, aseɛ bɔ sɔ mmenia nemɔ gyigyi so ne anu dwale.

english_verse: and swallowed them alive, together with their families and everything they owned. Then the ground closed back up, and they were gone.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛ ne bɛ nwo ama amukoraa bɛhɔle ɛborɔ dɔ bɔ né bɛ nye gua so ɔ. Aseɛ ne ha tuale katale bɛ so, na bɛ boso nuane fili maen ne anu.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites heard their screams, so they ran off, shouting, “We don't want that to happen to us!”
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ Kora mɔ né bɛbɔ awuye ne ati, Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɔ né bapɛ bayia berɛ ne, bɛnwatili, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Aseɛ ne kɔme yɛ koso!”

english_verse: Suddenly the Lord sent a fire that burned up the
translation_verse: Na see fili AWURADE berɛ ɔɔyerale mmienzua ɛyaa nyɔ ne aburannu bɔ né bɛbɔ ɛyɛɛ afɔleɛ ne.

english_verse: Then the Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: “Tell Aaron's son Eleazar to take the fire pans from the smoldering fire and scatter the coals. The pans are now sacred,
translation_verse: “Ka kyire ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Eleasa kyɛ ɔyeye see kulie nemɔ ofi see bɔ ogye ne anu; ná to see ne pete dededede.

english_verse: because they were used for offering incense to me. Have them hammered into a thin layer of bronze as a covering for the altar. Those men died because of their sin, and now their fire pans will become a warning for the rest of the community.”
translation_verse: Amumuyɛɛfoɛ hemɔ bɛ see kulie nemɔ ayɛ krongron, ofikyɛ bafa bɛ ngoa bapɛ so. Yiti maa bɛboro bɛ ma bɛyɛ taataa ná bɛ́fa bɛ́yɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne ngatasoɛ, ofikyɛ bafa bawa AWURADE nyunu maa bayɛ krongron. Na ngatasoɛ nemɔ kɔyɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ kɔma Yisraelfoɛ.

english_verse: Eleazar collected the pans and had them hammered into a thin layer of bronze as a covering for the altar,
translation_verse: Yiti mmenia bɔ bɛyerale nemɔ bɛ kɔɔbere kulie mɔ bɔ bɛfa bɛwale ne, ɔsɔfo Eleasa fale, na bɛborole bɛ taataa bɛfa bɛyɛle afɔleɛ bokyea ne ngatasoɛ.

english_verse: just as the Lord had told Moses. The pans were a warning to the Israelites that only Aaron's descendants would be allowed to offer incense to the Lord. Anyone else who tried to would be punished like Korah and his followers. The Israelites Rebel and Are Punished
translation_verse: Ɛhe te ngayeɛ ma Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE nate Mose so ha hyirele Eleasa ne, nnɛma eboosiniɛ biala bɔ nna Aarɔn bosoniɛ ahɔ ɔ, ɔba afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo kyɛ ɔbaayera ɛyɛɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, amaa bɔ ɔtole Kora ne ye lɔen ne bie wando ye.

english_verse: The next day the people of Israel again complained against Moses and Aaron, “The two of you killed some of the Lord's people!”
translation_verse: Nakoso aleɛ hyene ne, maen ne amukoraati bɛpenepenene bɛ komvi beguale Mose ne Aarɔn so kyɛ, “Ɛmɔahu AWURADE mmenia.”

english_verse: As the people crowded around them, Moses and Aaron turned toward the sacred tent, and the Lord appeared in his glory in the cloud covering the tent.
translation_verse: Na maen ne yɛle bɛ nwo lɔen beyiele nen, Mose ne Aarɔn kakyili bɛ nye behyirele ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne. Né munungum ne amundu so, na né AWURADE animnyam aye ye nwo ali.

english_verse: So Moses and Aaron walked to the front of the tent,
translation_verse: Yeɛ Mose ne Aarɔn wale ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anyunu,

english_verse: where the Lord said to them,
translation_verse: na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: “Stand back! I am going to wipe out these Israelites once and for all.” They immediately bowed down and prayed.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi sɔ lɔen he anwo maa nua bɛ boso kekesaala ye.” Na Mose ne Aarɔn fale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli ase.

english_verse: Then Moses told Aaron, “Grab your fire pan and fill it with hot coals from the altar. Put incense in it, then quickly take it to where the people are and offer it to the Lord, so they can be forgiven. The Lord is very angry, and people have already started dying!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Mose sele Aarɔn kyɛ, “Fa wɔ see kulie ne, fa afɔleɛ bokyea ne anu see ne bie gua nu, fa ɛyɛɛ gua nu, ná fa kɔ maen ne berɛ ndɛndɛ kɔpata ma bɛ. Ofikyɛ AWURADE afɛ ɛyaa hahii; amaneɛ piri ne ahyɛ ye bo.”

english_verse: Aaron walked back and stood with Moses at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Amaneɛ piri ne bo pɛle ne, Aarɔn sa wale Mose berɛ wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anoa nu berɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: Call together the twelve tribes of Israel and tell the leader of each tribe to write his name on the walking stick he carries as a symbol of his authority. Make sure Aaron's name is written on the one from the Levi tribe, then collect all the sticks.
translation_verse: na kyerɛ Aarɔn dumaa gua Lewi pɔmaa deɛ anwo. Ofikyɛ sona bɔ otua bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ noa biala, odi kyɛ onya pɔmaa ko.

english_verse: Place these sticks in the tent right in front of the sacred chest where I appear to you.
translation_verse: Fa gua ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu wɔ Adanzeɛ ne anyunu, nekaa bɔ me ne ɛmɔ yɛyia ne.

english_verse: I will then choose a man to be my priest, and his stick will sprout. After that happens, I won't have to listen to any more complaints about you.
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ ngɔneanea nu ngɔye ye ne, ye pɔmaa deɛ kɔfefɛ. Na ɔnate so ngɔma Yisraelfoɛ bɛ komvi bɔ bɛpenepene begua ɛmɔ so daa biala ne, ye bo kɔpɛ.”

english_verse: Moses told the people what the Lord had commanded, and they gave him the walking sticks from the twelve tribal leaders, including Aaron's from the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Mose ha hyirele Yisraelfoɛ, na bɛ mbanyi nemɔ amu bɛmane ye pɔmaa: panyi biala deɛ ko, pɔmaa buru ne nyɔ kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ɔ, na né Aarɔn pɔmaa deɛ boka bɛ deɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Moses took them and placed them in the Lord's sacred tent.
translation_verse: Yiti Mose fale pɔmaa nemɔ guale AWURADE nyunu wɔ apam ɛtena sua ne anu.

english_verse: The next day when Moses went into the tent, flowers and almonds were already growing on Aaron's stick.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyene ne, mmerɛ bɔ Mose hɔle apam ɛtena sua ne anu ne, né Aarɔn ye pɔmaa bɔ ɔte Lewi sasofoɛ bɛ pɔmaa ne wafefɛ. Né wabɔ nyerɛen, wanya nyaa, na wasu atonwaa bɔ waboro ɔ.

english_verse: Moses brought the twelve sticks out of the tent and showed them to the people. Each of the leaders found his own and took it.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Mose sesale pɔmaa nemɔ amu fili AWURADE nyunu fitele, na ɔfa brɛle Yisraelfoɛ amu. Bɛneane nu, na ebiala yele ye pɔmaa deɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord told Moses, “Put Aaron's stick back! Let it stay near the sacred chest as a warning to anyone who might think of rebelling. If these people don't stop their grumbling about me, I will wipe them out.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Sá fa Aarɔn pɔmaa ne baato Adanzeɛ ne nyunu, maa ɔbɔ ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ kɔkɔ, bɔ ɔnate so ɛkɔma bɛ komvi bɔ bɛpenepene begua me so ne, ye bo kɔpɛ ɔ, anyɔ sɔ a bekowuwu.”

english_verse: The Israelites cried out to Moses, “We're done for
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ sele Mose kyɛ, “Yawu oo, yawu yayie, yɛ mukoraa yawu yayie!

english_verse: and doomed if we even go near the sacred tent!”
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ okopingye AWURADE nyianu sua ne, okowu. Aso odi kyɛ yɛ mukoraa yɛtotɔ anaa?”

english_verse: You must see that they perform their duties. But if they go near any of the sacred objects or the altar, all of you will die.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛso wɔ ná bɛyɔ ɛtena sua ne anu adwuma amukoraa. Nakoso onni kyɛ bepingye nekaa krongron berɛ nningyein nemɔ, anaakyɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne, amaa ɔnate so bɛ ne ɛmɔ, ɛmɔanwuwu.

english_verse: No one else is allowed to take care of the sacred tent or do anything connected with it.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛboka wɔ so bɛyɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu adwuma, ná bɛ́yɔ adwuma biala bɔ ɔfa ɛtena sua ne anwo ɔ. Nnɛmaa ebiala bɔ nna Lewiniɛ ahɔ ɔ opingye ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Follow these instructions, so I won't become angry and punish the Israelites ever again.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔyɔ nekaa krongron berɛ adwuma ne ɔne afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo adwuma, amaa ɛyaafɛlɛ piri amma Yisraelfoɛ so ko le.

english_verse: I alone chose the Levites from all the other tribes to belong to me, and I have given them to you as your helpers.
translation_verse: Me yeɛ maneanea Yisraelfoɛ nu maye ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ Lewifoɛ ɔ. Bɛte akyɛdeɛ bɛma ɛmɔ, bɔ me AWURADE matu bɛ masie berɛ mama me nwo, kyɛ bɛyɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu adwuma ɔ.

english_verse: But only you and your sons can serve as priests at the altar and in the most holy place. Your work as priests is a gift from me, and anyone else who tries to do that work must be put to death. The Priests' Share of Offerings Given to the Lord (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛne wɔ mma mɔ bɔ bɛboka wɔ so de, ɛ́mɔye ɛmɔ kunu bɛ́yɔ ɛmɔ asɔfo adwuma wɔ nikyee biala bɔ ɔfa afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo, ɔne mbɛmuɛ tena ne asi dɔ nwo ɔ. Mafa asɔfo adwuma ne mahyɛ ɛmɔ. Ebiala bɔ nna Lewiniɛ ahɔ ɔ bɔ ɔkɔwa adwuma ne anwo ne de, odi kyɛ beku ye.” Asɔfo nemɔ kyɛfa

english_verse: You are allowed to eat the meat of those animals, just as you can eat the choice ribs and the right hind leg of the special sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ naen de, ɔte wɔ deɛ, kyɛbɔ ye sa bɔ banwaha ne, ɔne ye sɔ famaa ne te wɔ deɛ ne.

english_verse: The Lord said to Aaron: I have put you in charge of the sacred gifts and sacrifices that the Israelites bring to me. And from now on, you, your sons, and your descendants will receive part of the sacrifices for sin, as well as part of the grain sacrifices, and the sacrifices to make things right. Your share of these sacrifices will be the parts not burned on the altar.
translation_verse: Afɔleɛ krongron paa bɔ banyera bɛ wɔ see nu ne, ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ wɔ kyɛfa ɔ: b’akyɛdeɛ biala bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔbrɛ me kyɛ nikyee krongron paa ne, kyɛ ɔte aburoo afɔleɛ oo, bɔne nwo afɔleɛ oo, anaa foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ oo, ɔkɔyɛ wɔ ne wɔ mma mɔ deɛ.

english_verse: Since these things are sacred, they must be eaten near the sacred tent, but only men are allowed to eat them.
translation_verse: Ɔte nikyee krongron paa, na ɛmɔli. Bienzua biala kora odi bie; ɔkɔyɛ krongron kɔma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: You will also receive part of the special gifts and offerings that the Israelites bring to me. Any member of your family who is clean and acceptable for worship can eat these things.
translation_verse: Ɛhe koso te wɔ deɛ: akyɛdeɛ biala bɔ baye bafi Yisraelfoɛ ɛnwahanɛ afɔleɛ amukoraa nu ɔ. Mafa mama wɔ ne wɔ mma mmienzua ne wɔ mma mmrasua. Ɔte akyɛdeɛ afebɔɔ, ebiala bɔ ye nwo te wɔ w’awuro berɛ ne, ɔkora odi bie.

english_verse: For example, when the Israelites bring me the first batches of oil, wine, and grain, you can have the best parts of those gifts.
translation_verse: Ngoo ne anu paa paa, nzaa ne anu paa paa, ɔne aburoo ne anu paa paa, fieso aleɛ paa paa bɔ bɛfa bɛma AWURADE ne, mafa mama wɔ.

english_verse: And the first part of the crops from their fields and vineyards also belongs to you. The people will offer this to me, then anyone in your family who is clean may have some of it.
translation_verse: Fieso aleɛ amukoraa bɔ bekoli moa bɛkɔfa wɔ b’aseɛ ne aso, bɔ bɛfa bɛbrɛ AWURADE ne, ɔte wɔ deɛ. Ebiala bɔ ye nwo te wɔ w’awuro berɛ ne ɔkora odi bie.

english_verse: Everything in Israel that has been completely dedicated to me will now belong to you.
translation_verse: Nikyee biala bɔ batu basie berɛ bama AWURADE wɔ Yisrael ne, ɔte wɔ deɛ.

english_verse: The first-born son in every Israelite family, as well as the first-born males of their flocks and herds, belong to me. But every first-born son and first-born donkey must be bought back from me.
translation_verse: Abɔdeɛ biala, kyɛ sona oo, kyɛ kaka oo, ye bamuɛbaa bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔma AWURADE ne, ɔte wɔ deɛ. Nakoso kuro sona bamuɛbaa mɔ de, odi kyɛ ɛpɔ bɛ, yeɛ ngaka bɔ bɛ nwo nde mɔ bamuɛbaa mɔ koso, odi kyɛ ɛpɔ bɛ.

english_verse: The price for a first-born son who is at least one month old will be five pieces of silver, weighed according to the official standards.
translation_verse: Sɛ wali ofi bosome ko bɔ ɔkɔ ne a, ye ti nyɔboɛ ne, sese ye ɛdwetɛ sekel nnu kyɛbɔ nekaa krongron berɛ sekel te ɔ .

english_verse: However, all first-born cattle, sheep, and goats belong to me and cannot be bought back. Splatter their blood on the altar and send their fat up in smoke, so I can smell it and be pleased.
translation_verse: Nakoso nandwie bamuɛbaa, anaa boaen bamuɛbaa, anaa abɔngye bamuɛbaa de, nnɛpɔ bɛ; bɛte krongron. To bɛ mogya ne pete afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso, ná yera bɛ loe ne ma ɔyɛ afɔleɛ bɔ bɛfa see bɛyera ye, bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ.

english_verse: From now on, the sacred offerings that the Israelites give to me will belong to you, your sons, and your daughters. This is my promise to you and your descendants, and it will never change.
translation_verse: Afɔleɛ krongron amukoraa bɔ Yisraelfoɛ bɔ ma AWURADE ne, mafa mama wɔ ne wɔ mma mmienzua ne wɔ mma mmrasua mɔ. Ɔte ɛmɔ deɛ afebɔɔ. Ɔte ngyee apam afebɔɔ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ma wɔ ne wɔ bosofoɛ koso.”

english_verse: You will not receive any land in Israel as your own. I am the Lord, and I will give you whatever you need. What the Levites Receive The Lord said to Aaron:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Aarɔn kyɛ, “Engonya b’aseɛ ne bie, yeɛ engonya b’agyapadeɛ ne bie. Me yeɛ nde wɔ kyɛfa ne w’agyapadeɛ wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: Ten percent of the Israelites' crops and one out of every ten of their newborn animals belong to me. But I am giving all this to the Levites as their pay for the work they do at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: “Nikyee biala bɔ ɔwɔ Yisrael ne, mafa nu buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko mama Lewifoɛ. Ɛsolɛ bɔ bɛso wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu ne, ye nwo akatuaa ɛne.

english_verse: They are the only ones allowed to work at the tent, and they must not let anyone else come near it. Those who do come near must be put to death, and the Levites will also be punished. This law will never change. Since the Levites won't be given any land in Israel as their own,
translation_verse: Nakoso odi kyɛ Lewifoɛ yeɛ bɛyɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ adwuma ne ɔ, na bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ mvomsoɛ nwo musue kɔbɔ bɛ ti so. Ɔkɔyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ wɔ ɛmɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ mukoraati nu. Nakoso bengonya agyapadeɛ biala wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nu,

english_verse: they will be given the crops and newborn animals that the Israelites offer to me. What the Levites Must Give
translation_verse: ofikyɛ Yisraelfoɛ bɛ nningyein nu buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko bɔ baye basie berɛ bafa babɔ afɔleɛ bama AWURADE ne, mafa mama Lewifoɛ kyɛ b’agyapadeɛ ɛne. Yiti mahã mafa bɛ nwo kyɛ bengonya agyapadeɛ wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nu.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the Levites: When you receive from the people of Israel ten percent of their crops and newborn animals, you must offer a tenth of that to me.
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Lewifoɛ kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔ sa ka buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne befi Yisraelfoɛ berɛ, bɔ male mafi bɛ berɛ mama ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔ agyapadeɛ ɛne ne a, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa nu bie bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE, maa ɔyɛ buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne anu buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko.

english_verse: Just as the Israelites give me part of their grain and wine, you must set aside part of what you receive
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bebu sɔ afɔleɛ ne kyɛ ɛmɔ akyɛdeɛ ɛne. Ɔte kyɛ aburoo afɔleɛ bɔ mmenia fa fi nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo, ɔne anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ofi kumaa bɔ betwi nu nzaa ne ala.

english_verse: After you have dedicated the best parts to me, you can eat the rest, just as the Israelites eat part of their grain and wine after offering them to me.
translation_verse: Sa ka kyire bɛ kyɛ, Sɛ ɛmɔtu nu bie bɔ ɔte paa paa ne besie berɛ bɛma AWURADE beyie a, ye ngaa ne de ɛ́mɔfa bɛma Lewifoɛ. Ɔte kyɛ aburoo bɔ ofi nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo, ɔne nzaa bɔ ofi kumaa bɔ betwi nu nzaa ne ala.

english_verse: Your share may be eaten anywhere by anyone in your family, because it is your pay for working at the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkɔhora bekoli ye wɔ nekaa biala, ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ awuro ama; ofikyɛ ɛmɔ adwuma bɔ ɛmɔyɔ ye wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anu ne, ye nwo akatuaa ɛne.

english_verse: You won't be punished for eating it, as long as you have already offered the best parts to me. The gifts and sacrifices brought by the people must remain sacred, and if you eat any part of them before they are offered to me, you will be put to death.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔfa bɔ ɔte paa paa ne bɛma AWURADE a, ye de foɛlilɛ biala ɔnne ɛmɔ so. Nakoso nnɛma ɛmɔgua Yisraelfoɛ akyɛdeɛ krongron nemɔ anwo fiɛ, ná ɛmɔanwuwu.”

english_verse: The Lord gave Moses and Aaron the following law: The people of Israel must bring Moses a reddish-brown cow that has nothing wrong with it and that has never been used for plowing.
translation_verse: “Mmeraa bɔ AWURADE ahyɛ ne, ye nwo ahyɛdeɛ ɛhe: Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ bɛ́fa nandwie beleɛ kɔkorɛ bɔ ollili nnɛen, bɔ ngekalewa biala ɔnne ye nwo, bɔ bɛffale kɔnnua biala bɛttole ye kɔme le ɔ bɛ́brɛ wɔ.

english_verse: Moses will give it to Eleazar the priest, then it will be led outside the camp and killed while Eleazar watches.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa nandwie beleɛ ne bɛ́ma ɔsɔfo Eleasa. Odi kyɛ bɛfa nandwie ne bɛkɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi ná beku ye wɔ Eleasa nyunu.

english_verse: He will dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times in the direction of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo Eleasa fa ye sa mmɛseka bɔ nandwie mogya ne anu, ná ɔpete ye pɛen nzoo ogua ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne anyunu dɔ.

english_verse: Then the whole cow, including its skin, meat, blood, and insides must be burned.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛyera nandwie beleɛ ne wɔ Eleasa nyunu berɛ. Bɛ́yera ye nwomaa, ye naen, ye mogya, ɔne ye fure ne.

english_verse: A priest is to throw a stick of cedar wood, a hyssop branch, and a piece of red yarn into the fire.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne fa bakaa bɔ bɛfrɛ ye sida, sufiɛ ne adaabene, ná ógyi bɛ gua see bɔ bɛyera nandwie beleɛ ne wɔ nu ne anu.

english_verse: After the ceremony, the priest is to take a bath and wash his clothes. Only then can he go back into the camp, but he remains unclean and unfit for worship until evening.
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne ɔpo ye ndaadeɛ, ná ɔfa nzue obia, ná ye si ye wawa asikyeleɛ ne anu; nakoso ɔsɔfo ne nwo kogua fiɛ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: The man who burned the cow must also wash his clothes and take a bath, but he is also unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔyera nandwie beleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔfa nzue ɔpo ye ndaadeɛ ná ɔfa nzue obia; ɔkɔyɛ sona bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: A man who isn't unclean must collect the ashes of the burnt cow and store them outside the camp in a clean place. The people of Israel can mix these ashes with the water used in the ceremony to wash away sin.
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ sona bie bɔ ye nwo te ɔ sesa nandwie beleɛ nzoen ne, ná ɔ́fa kogua asikyeleɛ ne asi nekaa bɔ berɛ te sannwuu ɔ. Odi kyɛ bɛfa besie bɛma Yisrael maen ne, ná bafa bafra nzue bɔ bɛfa bɛte bɛ nwo ne. Bɛfa bɛte bɛ nwo befi bɔne nwo.

english_verse: The man who collects the ashes must wash his clothes, but will remain unclean until evening. This law must always be obeyed by the people of Israel and the foreigners living among them. What Must Be Done after Touching a Dead Body The Lord said:
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔkɔsesa nandwie beleɛ nzoen ne, odi kyɛ ɔpo ye nningyein, na ye nwo kogua fiɛ maa okoodwu nɔsoa. Ɛhe kɔyɛ ahyɛdeɛ afebɔɔ kɔla berɛ kɔma Yisraelfoɛ ne ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ waatena bɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: If you touch a dead body, you will be unclean for seven days.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ye nwo kɔha sona fuin ne, ye nwo kogua fiɛ ɛlɛsoo.

english_verse: But if you wash with the water mixed with the cow's ashes on the third day and again on the seventh day, you will be clean and acceptable for worship. You must wash yourself on those days; if you don't, you will remain unclean.
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛsa ne aso, ɔne ɛlɛsoo ne aso, odi kyɛ ɔfa sɔ nzue ne bie pete ye nwo ma ye nwo te. Nakoso sɛ wambete ye nwo ɛlɛsa ne aso ɔne ɛlɛsoo ne aso a, ye nwo ngɔte.

english_verse: Suppose you touch a dead body, but refuse to be made clean by washing with the water mixed with ashes. You will be guilty of making my sacred tent unclean and will no longer belong to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ye nwo kɔha sona fuin, ná wambete ye nwo ne, ɔfa fiɛ ka AWURADE nyianu sua ne. Sɔ sona ne, odi kyɛ bɛpɛ ye asue befi Yisrael. Ɔnate kyɛ bamva nzue bɔ bɛfa bɛpete bɛ nwo ne bie bambete ye nwo ne ati, ye nwo nde, na ye nwo bɔ wagua fiɛ ne tɛ wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: If someone dies in a tent while you are there, you will be unclean for seven days. And anyone who later enters the tent will also be unclean.
translation_verse: Sɛ sona wu wɔ ɛtena sua nu a, ye wo mmeraa ɛhe: ebiala bɔ ɔkɔhɔ sɔ ɛtena sua ne anu, ɔne ebiala bɔ ɔwɔ sɔ ɛtena sua ne anu ne, ye nwo kogua fiɛ ɛlɛsoo.

english_verse: Any open jar in the tent is unclean.
translation_verse: Na kukue biala bɔ bamva tire bangata so ne, ye nwo nde.

english_verse: If you touch the body of someone who died or was killed, or if you touch a human bone or a grave, you will be unclean for seven days.
translation_verse: Sona biala bɔ ɔkɔhɔ buro ná ye nwo kɔha sona bɔ watɔ ngrandɛ noa, anaa sona bɔ wawu ye ɛdangama wue ye fuin, anaa ye nwo kɔha kuro sona bowue, anaa asieleɛ ne, ye nwo kogua fiɛ ɛlɛsoo.

english_verse: Before you can be made clean, someone who is clean must take some of the ashes from the burnt cow and stir them into a pot of spring water. That same person must dip a hyssop branch in the water and ashes, then sprinkle it on the tent and everything in it, including everyone who was inside. If you have touched a human bone, a grave, or a dead body, you must be sprinkled with that water.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ sona bɔ ye nwo te ɔ fa sufiɛ bɔ nzue ne anu, ná ɔ́fa pete ɛtena sua ne anwo, ɔne nu nningyein amukoraa so, ɔne mmenia bɔ né bɛwɔ berɛ ne aso, ɔne ebiala bɔ ye nwo hane bowue ne anaa sona bɔ bahu ye ne, anaa fuin ne, anaa asieleɛ ne.

english_verse: If this is done on the third day and on the seventh day, you will be clean. Then after you take a bath and wash your clothes, you can worship that evening.
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛsa ne aso, ɔne ɛlɛsoo ne aso, odi kyɛ sona bɔ ye nwo te ne fa nzue ne bie pete bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo agua fiɛ nemɔ aso, ná ɔnate so ɔte bɛ nwo ɛlɛsoo ne aso. Afei odi kyɛ bɛpo bɛ ndaadeɛ ná bɛfa nzue bebia, na ye nɔsoa ne bɛ nwo kɔte.

english_verse: If you are unclean and refuse to be made clean by washing with the water mixed with ashes, you will be guilty of making my sacred tent unclean, and you will no longer belong to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Sona biala bɔ ye nwo agua fiɛ, nakoso bande ye nwo ne, sɔ sona ne odi kyɛ bɛpɛ ye asue befi mmenia ne anu, ofikyɛ wagua AWURADE nekaa krongron ne anwo fiɛ. Ɔnate kyɛ banhwie nzue krongron ne bangua ye nwo ne ati, ye nwo nde.

english_verse: These laws will never change. The man who sprinkled the water and the ashes on you when you were unclean must also wash his clothes. And whoever touches this water is unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Ɛhe kɔyɛ daa ahyɛdeɛ kɔma bɛ. Sona bɔ ɔpete nzue fa te bɛ nwo ne, odi kyɛ ɔpo ye nwo nningyein, na sona biala bɔ ye nwo kɔha nzue bɔ bɛfa bɛpete bɛ nwo ne, ye nwo kogua fiɛ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.

english_verse: When you are unclean, everything you touch becomes unclean, and anyone who touches you will be unclean until evening.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye nwo nde ne, nikyee biala bɔ ye nwo kɔha ye ne, sɔ nikyee ne nwo kogua fiɛ, na ebiala bɔ ye nwo kɔha sɔ nikyee ne, ye nwo kogua fiɛ maa okoodwu nɔsoa.”

english_verse: The people of Israel arrived at the Zin Desert during the first month and set up camp near the town of Kadesh. It was there that Miriam died and was buried.
translation_verse: Bosome bɔ oli moa ne anu, Yisrael maen ne amukoraa beedwuli Sen ɛserɛ ne aso, na mmenia ne tenane Kadese. Berɛ yeɛ Miriam wuli ɔ, na berɛ yeɛ besiele ye ɔ.

english_verse: The Israelites had no water, so they went to Moses and Aaron
translation_verse: Né mmenia ne nnya nzue wɔ berɛ, yiti bɛyɛle Mose ne Aarɔn nwo lɔen.

english_verse: and complained, “Moses, we'd be better off if we had died along with the others in front of the Lord's sacred tent.
translation_verse: Mmenia ne ne Mose nyane edwudwolɛ, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Y’eliɛma nemɔ wuwuli wɔ AWURADE nyunu ne, yɛ koso yɛwuwuli bie po a ahaa né so apɛ!”

english_verse: You brought us into this desert, and now we and our livestock are going to die!
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔafa AWURADE mmenia bawa ɛserɛ ye aso maa yɛ ne yɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ yɛbaawuwu wɔ wa ye?

english_verse: Egypt was better than this horrible place. At least there we had grain and figs and grapevines and pomegranates. But now we don't even have any water.”
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔafa yɛ bafi Misraim bawa aseɛ tɛɛtɛɛ ye aso ye? Aseɛ ye ngɔhye aburoo anaa borɔdoma anaa bobe anaa akengaa, na nzue bɔ yɛkɔno ɔ po nne wa.”

english_verse: Moses and Aaron went to the entrance to the sacred tent, where they bowed down. The Lord appeared to them in all of his glory
translation_verse: Yeɛ Mose ne Aarɔn fili mmenia ne anu bɛhɔle ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ. Bɛfale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli ase, na AWURADE animnyam yele ye nwo ali hyirele bɛ.

english_verse: and said, “Moses, get your walking stick. Then you and Aaron call the people together and command that rock to give you water. That's how you will provide water for the people of Israel and their livestock.”
translation_verse: Fa pɔmaa ne, ná ɛne eliɛma Aarɔn bɛboaboa mmenia ne anoa. Bɛ nyunu berɛ ala, ɛ́mɔdwudwo béhyire nyɔbotaen ne maa opu ye nzue bra. Ɛhe kɔmaa ekonya nzue kofi nyɔbotaen ne anu kɔma bɛ; ɔnate so ɛkɔmaa mmenia nemɔ ne bɛ nyɛmmoa konya nzue bɛkɔno.

english_verse: Moses obeyed and took his stick from the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Yiti Mose fale pɔmaa ne fili AWURADE nyunu berɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔhyɛle ye ne.

english_verse: After he and Aaron had gathered the people around the rock, he said, “Look, you rebellious people, and you will see water flow from this rock!”
translation_verse: Mose ne Aarɔn boaboale mmenia ne anoa wɔ nyɔbotaen ne anyunu, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtie, ɛmɔ, ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ! Aso nyɔbotaen he anu yeɛ odi kyɛ yɛnya nzue yɛma ɛmɔ ɔ?”
