english_verse: He raised his stick in the air and struck the rock two times. At once, water gushed from the rock, and the people and their livestock had water to drink.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Mose pagyale ye sa, na ɔfale ye pɔmaa ne fini nyɔbotaen ne aso pɛen nyɔ. Nzue pu fili nu wale pee, na mmenia nemɔ ne bɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ none bie.

english_verse: But the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you refused to believe in my power, these people did not respect me. And so, you will not be the ones to lead them into the land I have promised.”
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE sele Mose ne Aarɔn kyɛ, “Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔanne me banni, ná ɛmɔamma wanna ali wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nyunu kyɛ nde krongron ne ati, ɛmɔngɔfa mmenia hemɔ bengodwu aseɛ bɔ mafa mama bɛ ne aso.”

english_verse: The Israelites had complained against the Lord, and he had shown them his holy power by giving them water to drink. So they named the place Meribah, which means “Complaining.” Israel Isn't Allowed To Go through Edom
translation_verse: Ɛhe ole Meriba asue, nekaa bɔ Yisraelfoɛ ne AWURADE nyane dwudwolɛ, berɛ yeɛ AWURADE yele ye krongronyɛlɛ ali ɔ. Edomfoɛ amma Yisraelfoɛ ate

english_verse: Moses sent messengers from Israel's camp near Kadesh with this message for the king of Edom: We are Israelites, your own relatives, and we're sure you have heard the terrible things that have happened to us.
translation_verse: Mose tuli ɛbɔfoɛ fili Kadese maa bɛhɔle Edom hene berɛ beesele ye kyɛ, “Eliɛma Yisrael nwa: Ɛse edwirɛ tɛɛ mɔ bɔ watoto yɛ ne amukoraa.

english_verse: Our ancestors settled in Egypt and lived there a long time. But later the Egyptians were cruel to us,
translation_verse: Ɛse kyɛbɔ yɛ nana mɔ hɔle Misraim, ɔne kyɛbɔ yɛtenane Misraim yɛhyɛle, ná Misraimfoɛ hyɛle yɛ ne yɛ nana mɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: and when we begged our Lord for help, he answered our prayer and brought us out of that land. Now we are camped at the border of your territory, near the town of Kadesh.
translation_verse: Yɛsu yɛfrɛle AWURADE. Otiele yɛ suɛ, na ɔsomane abɔfo maa ɔɔyele yɛ fili Misraim. Kekesaala ye yɛwɔ Kadese, kuro bɔ ɔwɔ w’aseɛ ne noa ne aso.

english_verse: Please let us go through your country. We won't go near your fields or vineyards, and we won't drink any water from your wells. We will stay on the main road until we leave your territory.
translation_verse: Maa yɛfa w’aseɛ ye aso yɛpɛ nu yɛhɔ. Yɛngɔfa fieso anaa bobe boo nu, yeɛ yɛngɔno abura biala nu nzue. Yɛkɔfa atee bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Ɛhene Atimbire ne aso, na yɛngɔmakye yɛngɔhɔ bɛen anaa famaa kɔpem kyɛ yɛkɔpɛ nu wɔ w’aseɛ ne aso ɔ.”

english_verse: But the king of Edom answered, “No, I won't let you go through our country! And if you try, we will attack you.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Edom buale ye kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔfa yɛ aseɛ ye aso. Sɛ ɛmɔfa so a, yɛkɔhwe ngrandɛ yɛkɔwa ɛmɔ so.”

english_verse: Moses sent back this message: “We promise to stay on the main road, and if any of us or our livestock drink your water, we will pay for it. We just want to pass through.”
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ sele ye kyɛ, “Yɛkɔfa atimbire ne aso ala; na sɛ yɛ ne yɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ, yɛno ɛmɔ nzue po a, ye de yɛkotua ye kerɛ. Ɛhe de ɔnyɛ se; maa yɛbɔ ase yɛpɛ nu yɛhɔ.”

english_verse: But the king insisted, “You can't go through our land!” Then Edom sent out its strongest troops
translation_verse: Nakoso Edom hene sele kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔfa yɛ aseɛ ye aso.” Yeɛ Edom fale mmenia pee ne ɛlɔen bɔ bɛ nwo ye se wale Yisraelfoɛ so.

english_verse: to keep Israel from passing through its territory. So the Israelites had to go in another direction. Aaron Dies
translation_verse: Edom amma Yisrael ate maa wamva ye aseɛ ne aso, yiti Yisrael kakyili ye nwo hɔle. Aarɔn wue

english_verse: After the Israelites had left Kadesh and had gone as far as Mount Hor
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ tuli bɛ bo befili Kadese, na maen ne amukoraa beedwuli Hore bokaa ne anwo.

english_verse: “Aaron, this is where you will die. You and Moses disobeyed me at Meribah, and so you will not enter the land I promised the Israelites.
translation_verse: “Aarɔn kowu kɔɔtoa ye mbanyi mɔ. Ye gya baa ngotia aseɛ bɔ mafa mama Yisraelfoɛ ne aso, ofikyɛ ɛmɔyɛle m’ahyɛdeɛ nwo asoserɛ wɔ Meriba asue nwo.

english_verse: Moses, go with Aaron and his son Eleazar to the top of the mountain.
translation_verse: Fa Aarɔn ne ɔwa Eleasa, ná ɛne bɛ fo bra Hore bokaa ne aso.

english_verse: Then take Aaron's priestly robe from him and place it on Eleazar. Aaron will die there.”
translation_verse: Puro Aarɔn ndaadeɛ ne, ná fa wura ɔwa Eleasa. Nakoso Aarɔn de, okowu kɔɔtoa ye mbanyi mɔ: berɛ yeɛ okowu ɔ.”

english_verse: Moses obeyed, and everyone watched as he and Aaron and Eleazar walked to the top of Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Mose yɔle kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne ala. Bɛfole bɛhɔle Hore bokaa ne aso bɔ Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɛ nye tua bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Moses then took the priestly robe from Aaron and placed it on Eleazar. Aaron died there. When Moses and Eleazar came down,
translation_verse: Mose puropurole Aarɔn ndaadeɛ nemɔ, ɔfa wurale ɔwa Eleasa, na Aarɔn wuli wɔ bokaa ne ati afia. Mose ne Eleasa fi bokaa ne aso dwu wale ase.

english_verse: the people knew that Aaron had died, and they mourned his death for
translation_verse: Na maen ne amukoraa nwuni kyɛ Aarɔn awu ne, Yisrael awuro ama mukoraa suni ye eleburasa.

english_verse: The Israelites had to go around the territory of Edom, so when they left Mount Hor, they headed south toward the Red Sea. But along the way, the people became so impatient
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ fili Hɔre bokaa ne anwo ne, bɛtoale so bɛfale Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ atee ne aso kyɛ bɛkondo bɛfa Edom aseɛ ne asi; nakoso mmenia ne annya aboterɛ wɔ atunu.

english_verse: that they complained against God and said to Moses, “Did you bring us out of Egypt, just to let us die in the desert? There's no water out here, and we can't stand this awful food!”
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ dwudwole tiale Nyameɛ ne Mose kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔaye yɛ bafi Misraim aseɛ so kyɛ yɛɛwuwu wɔ ɛserɛ ye aso ye? Ofikyɛ aleɛ ne nzue nne wa, na sɔ aleɛ tɛɛtɛɛ he abɔ yɛ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord sent poisonous snakes that bit and killed many of them.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE somane ewoo mɔ bɔ bɛ noa te borɔ maa bɛwale mmenia ne anu, na bɛkekale Yisraelfoɛ maa bɛ nu pee wuwuli.

english_verse: Some of the people went to Moses and admitted, “It was wrong of us to insult you and the Lord. Now please ask him to make these snakes go away.” Moses prayed,
translation_verse: Yeɛ mmenia ne wale Mose berɛ beesele kyɛ, “Yayɔ bɔne kyɛ yadwudwo yatia AWURADE, ɔne wɔ ɔ; serɛ AWURADE maa ɔye ewoo nemɔ ofi yɛ wa hɔ.” Yiti Mose pale kyerɛ mane maen ne.

english_verse: and the Lord answered, “Make a snake out of bronze and place it on top of a pole. Anyone who gets bitten can look at the snake and be saved from death.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Yɔ ewoo bɔ ye noa te borɔ ɔ ye sɛso, na fa sinze mbuna so. Ebiala bɔ ewoo ne bie aha ye ne, sɛ ɔnea mbuna ne aso ewoo ne a, okonya ngoa.”

english_verse: Moses obeyed the Lord. And all of those who looked at the bronze snake lived, even though they had been bitten by the poisonous snakes. Israel's Journey to Moab
translation_verse: Yiti Mose fale kɔɔbere yɔle ewoo ne. Ɔfa sinzele mbuna so; na sɛ ewoo ka ebie ná sɔ sona ne nea kɔɔbere ewoo ne a, onya ngoa. Yisraelfoɛ toa so bɛkɔ Moabo

english_verse: As the Israelites continued their journey to Canaan, they camped at Oboth,
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ tuli bɛ bo, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Obote.

english_verse: and then in the Zered Gorge.
translation_verse: Befili berɛ ne, besili nu bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Serede bɔnza ne anu.

english_verse: After that, they crossed the Arnon River gorge and camped in the Moabite desert bordering Amorite territory. The Arnon was the border between the Moabites and the Amorites.
translation_verse: Befili berɛ ne, besili nu, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ asue Anɔn ye bue dɔ, wɔ ɛserɛ bɔ ɔtrɛ fi Amorifoɛ ɛwɛen so ne aso; ofikyɛ asue Anɔn yeɛ ɔte Moabo ne Amorifoɛ b’ɛwɛen ɔ.

english_verse: A song in The Book of the Lord's Battles mentions the town of Waheb with its creeks in the territory of Suphah. It also mentions the Arnon River,
translation_verse: Yiti yeɛ baha ye wɔ AWURADE Koɛ Nwo Nwomaa ne anu kyɛ, “Wahebo bɔ ɔwɔ Sufa ɔne bɔnza nemɔ anu. Asue Anɔn

english_verse: with its valleys that lie alongside the Moabite border and extend to the town of Ar.
translation_verse: ɔne bɔnza nemɔ ndoroleɛ, bɔ ɔtrɛ kɔ Are aseɛ bɔ mmenia wɔ so, bɔ ɔla Moabo ɛwɛen so ne.”

english_verse: From the Arnon, the Israelites went to the well near the town of Beer, where the Lord had said to Moses, “Call the people together, and I will give them water to drink.”
translation_verse: Befili berɛ ne, bɛtoale so bɛhɔle Beɛ, abura bɔ ye nwo berɛ yeɛ AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Boaboa mmenia ne noa, na ngɔma bɛ nzue” ne.

english_verse: That's also the same well the Israelites sang about in this song: Let's celebrate! The well has given us water.
translation_verse: Afei Yisrael tole edwein he: “Abura, pu nzue bra! Ɛ́mɔbɔ bele ye so!

english_verse: With their royal scepters, our leaders pointed out where to dig the well. The Israelites left the desert and camped near the town of Mattanah,
translation_verse: Abura bɔ mbanyi mɔ tuli ne, bɔ mmenia nemɔ anu atitire tuli ne, ɛhɔtɔ ne pɔmaa yeɛ bɛfa betuli ɔ.” Befili ɛserɛ ne aso bɛhɔle Matana,

english_verse: then at Nahaliel, and then at Bamoth.
translation_verse: befili Matana bɛhɔle Nahaliɛl, befili Nahaliɛl bɛhɔle Bamote,

english_verse: Finally, they reached Moabite territory, where they camped near Mount Pisgah in a valley overlooking the desert north of the Dead Sea. Israel Defeats King Sihon the Amorite (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: na befili Bamote bɛhɔle bɔnza bɔ ɔla Moabo mbɔtam, bɔ ɔwɔ Pisiga ti afia bɔ ye nye nea ɛserɛ pralaa ne aso ne. Yisraelfoɛ di Sihon so ngonim

english_verse: King Sihon had ruled from Heshbon, after defeating the Moabites and taking over their land north of the Arnon River gorge.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Hesebon te Amorifoɛ hene Sihon ye ahenguro. Né ɔne Moabo hene daa baho maa wale ye aseɛ amukoraa toonn waadwu asue Anɔn.

english_verse: The Israelites sent this message to King Sihon of the Amorites:
translation_verse: Afei Yisrael tuli ɛbɔfoɛ maa bɛhɔle Amorifoɛ hene Sihon berɛ beesele ye kyɛ,

english_verse: Please let us pass through your territory. We promise to stay away from your fields and vineyards, and we won't drink any water from your wells. As long as we're in your land, we'll stay on the main road.
translation_verse: “Maa mva w’aseɛ ye aso mbɛ nu ngɔ. Yɛngɔmakye ngɔhɔ fieso anaa bobe boo nu; yɛngɔno abura biala nu nzue. Yɛkɔfa Ɛhene Atimbire ne aso kɔpem kyɛ yɛkɔpɛ nu wɔ w’aseɛ ne aso ɔ.”

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let Israel travel through his land. Instead, he called together his entire army and marched into the desert to attack Israel near the town of Jahaz.
translation_verse: Nakoso Sihon amma Yisrael ate maa wamva ye aseɛ ne aso. Sihon boaboale ye mmenia amukoraa noa, na ɔfale koɛ toale Yisrael wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso. Ɔwale Yahase, na ɔne Yisrael bɛhone.

english_verse: Israel defeated them and took over the Amorite territory from the Arnon River gorge in the south to the Jabbok River gorge in the north. Beyond the Jabbok was the territory of the Ammonites, who were much stronger than Israel.
translation_verse: Yisrael le ngrandɛ huni ye, na bɛfale ye aseɛ ne fite asue Anɔn kɔpem Yabɔko, toonn kɔpem Amorifoɛ nemɔ dɔ; ofikyɛ né Amorifoɛ nemɔ abɔ b’ɛwɛen ne anwo waen pambee.

english_verse: The Israelites settled in the Amorite towns, including the capital city of Heshbon with its surrounding villages.
translation_verse: Yisrael fale nguro sɔ ne amukoraati, na Yisraelfoɛ tenatenane Amorifoɛ nguro nemɔ amukoraa so, wɔ Hesebon ne ye nguraa amukoraa nu.

english_verse: That's why the Amorites had written this poem about Heshbon: Come and rebuild Heshbon, King Sihon's capital city!
translation_verse: Yiti edweintolɛfoɛ nemɔ ka kyɛ, “Ɛmɔbra Hesebon. Maa besa bɛkyekye kuro ne, maa bɛpagya Sihon kuro ne besie berɛ.

english_verse: His armies marched out like fiery flames, burning down the town of Ar and destroying the hills along the Arnon River.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ see fili Hesebon wale, see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi fili Sihon kuro ne anu. Ɔɔyerale Are bɔ ɔwɔ Moabo, ɔne asue Anɔn nwo atitirefoɛ.

english_verse: You Moabites are done for! Your god Chemosh deserted your people; they were captured, taken away by King Sihon the Amorite.
translation_verse: Moabo, wɔ yaakɔ! Mmenia bɔ bɛso bosoen Kemose, ɛmɔ boso anua! Wama ye mma mmienzua ayɛ akobɔfoɛ, yeɛ wayakyi ye mma mmrasua mɔ wama Amori hene Sihon wahye bɛ nnure.

english_verse: We completely defeated Moab. The towns of Heshbon and Dibon, of Nophah and Medeba are ruined and gone.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛ boso anua, ofi Hesebon bɔ ɔkwaadwu Dibɔn, na yɛhuhuni bɛ maa oodwuli kyɛ see trɛ hɔle Medeba ɔ.”

english_verse: After the Israelites had settled in the Amorite territory,
translation_verse: Yiti Yisrael tenane Amorifoɛ aseɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Moses sent some men to explore the town of Jazer. Later, the Israelites captured the villages surrounding it and forced out the Amorites who lived there. Israel Defeats King Og of Bashan (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Na Mose somane maa bɛɛtetɛle Yasere. Belili Yasere nwo nguraa nemɔ aso ngonim, na bɛfoane Amorifoɛ bɔ né bɛtete aseɛ ne aso ne befili berɛ. Yisraelfoɛ di Ogo so ngonim

english_verse: The Israelites headed toward the region of Bashan, where King Og ruled, and he led his entire army to Edrei to meet Israel in battle.
translation_verse: Ye si ye, Yisraelfoɛ kakyili bɛ nye bɛfo bɛhɔle Basan atee so. Basan hene Ogo ne ye mmenia amukoraa bɛfale koɛ beeyiale Yisraelfoɛ wɔ Yedrei.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “Don't be afraid of Og. I will help you defeat him and his army, just as you did King Sihon who ruled in Heshbon. Og's territory will be yours.”
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Nnɛsuro ye, ofikyɛ mafa ye mawura wɔ sa, ɔne ye mmenia amukoraa ne ye aseɛ amukoraa. Na kyɛbɔ ɛyɔle Amori hene Sihon bɔ né odi bia wɔ Hesebon ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛkɔfa kɔyɔ ye ɔ.”

english_verse: So the Israelites wiped out Og, his family, and his entire army—there were no survivors. Then Israel took over the land of Bashan.
translation_verse: Yiti Yisraelfoɛ huni Ogo ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ, ɔne ye mmenia ne amukoraa, bɔ yeɛ sona komapɛ po wanga ɔ. Na bɛfale ye aseɛ ne bɛyɛle bɛ deɛ.

english_verse: Israel moved from there to the hills of Moab, where they camped across the Jordan River from the town of Jericho. King Balak of Moab Hires Balaam To Curse Israel
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ tuli bɛ bo, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ bɔ ɔwɔ asue Yɔɔdan si bɔ opingye Yeriko ne aso.

english_verse: When King Balak of Moab and his people heard how many Israelites there were and what they had done to the Amorites, he and the Moabites were terrified and panicked.
translation_verse: Moabo surole Yisrael maen ne paa, ofikyɛ né bɛsone pee. Na Yisraelfoɛ nwo suronyi tɔle Moabo so.

english_verse: They said to the Midianite leaders, “That huge mob of Israelites will wipe out everything in sight, like a bull eating grass in a field.” So King Balak
translation_verse: Yeɛ Moabo sele Midian mbanyi nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛlɔen piri he koli nningyein amukoraa bɔ wapɛ yɛ nwo wayia ɔ, kyɛbɔ nandwie di aseɛ so ndire ɔ.” Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Sipore awa Balake yeɛ ɔte Moabo hene ɔ.

english_verse: sent a message to Balaam son of Beor who lived among his relatives in the town of Pethor near the Euphrates River. It said: I need your help. A large group of people has come here from Egypt and settled near my territory.
translation_verse: Otuli ɛbɔfoɛ maa bɛhɔle Beɔ awa Balaam berɛ wɔ Petore bɔ ɔla asue Yufreti noa, wɔ Amawo aseɛ so ne. Na bɛtole bɛ sa bɛfrɛle ye kyɛ, “Mmenia bie fi Misraim bawa; bayɛ aseɛ so mitimiti, na baatena bapingye me.

english_verse: They are too powerful for us to defeat, so would you come and place a curse on them? Maybe then we can run them off. I know that anyone you bless will be successful, but anyone you curse will fail.
translation_verse: Bra kekesaala ye ná baanoma mmenia ye mɔ ma me, ofikyɛ bɛ nwo yɛ se tra me. Ebiaa né mali bɛ so ngonim ná mafoa bɛ mafi aseɛ ye aso. Ofikyɛ mese kyɛ ebiala bɔ ekoyira ye ne, okonya saleɛ, na ebiala bɔ ɛkɔnoma ye ne, musue kɔto ye.”

english_verse: The leaders of Moab and Midian left and took along money to pay Balaam. When they got to his house, they gave him Balak's message.
translation_verse: Yiti Moabo mbanyi ne Midian mbanyi fale abisa aboadeɛ ne, na besili nu bɛhɔle Balaam berɛ bɛɛfale Balake dwirɛ ne bɛɛbɔle ye amaneɛ.

english_verse: “Spend the night here,” Balaam replied, “and tomorrow I will tell you the Lord's answer.” So the officials stayed at his house.
translation_verse: Balaam buale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔla wa ma aleɛ hye, na edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE kɔha kohyire me biala ngɔma ɛmɔ so kɔte.” Yiti Moabo mbanyi nemɔ lale Balaam berɛ.

english_verse: During the night, God asked Balaam, “Who are these people at your house?”
translation_verse: Nyameɛ wale Balaam berɛ oobisale ye kyɛ, “Nwa mɔ yeɛ bɛ ne wɔ wɔ wa ye?”

english_verse: “They are messengers from King Balak of Moab,” Balaam answered. “He sent them
translation_verse: Balaam buale Nyameɛ kyɛ, “Sipore awa Balake bɔ ɔte Moabo hene ne ɔtole me ngraa kyɛ,

english_verse: to ask me to go to Moab and put a curse on the people who have come there from Egypt. They have settled everywhere around him, and he wants to run them off.”
translation_verse: ‘Mmenia biemɔ afi Misraim bawa, na bayɛ aseɛ ye aso mitimiti, yiti bra ná baanoma bɛ ma me; ebiaa ngɔhora me ne bɛ yɛkɔho na mafoa bɛ mafi wa.’ ”

english_verse: But God replied, “Don't go with Balak's messengers. I have blessed those people who have come from Egypt, so don't curse them.”
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ sele Balaam kyɛ, “Nnɛne bɛ kɔ; nnɛnoma mmenia nemɔ, ofikyɛ mayira bɛ.”

english_verse: The next morning, Balaam said to Balak's officials, “Go on back home. The Lord says I cannot go with you.”
translation_verse: Yiti Balaam dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ, na osele Balake ye mbanyi nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔsa bɛhɔ ɛmɔ kuro, ofikyɛ AWURADE amma me ate kyɛ me ne ɛmɔ yɛhɔ.”

english_verse: The officials left and told Balak that Balaam refused to come.
translation_verse: Yiti Moabo mbanyi nemɔ sili nu bɛhɔle Balake berɛ na bɛɛbɔle amaneɛ kyɛ, “Balaam ambene so kyɛ ɔne yɛ kɔwa ɔ.”

english_verse: Then Balak sent a larger group of officials, who were even more important than the first ones.
translation_verse: Balake sá somane mbanyi, bɔ bɛsone na besa bedi mu bɛtra bɛ bɔ belili moa bɛhɔle nemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: They went to Balaam and told him that Balak had said, “Balaam, if you come to Moab,
translation_verse: Bɛhɔle Balaam berɛ beesele ye kyɛ, “Sipore awa Balake nwa: ‘Nnɛma hwee si wɔ ate wɔ me wa walɛ ne anwo;

english_verse: I'll pay you very well and do whatever you ask. Just come and place a curse on these people.”
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ngɔma wɔ akatuaa bɔ ɔfata paa ɔ, na bɔ ekose me ne biala ngɔyɔ. Mesrɛ wɔ, bra baanoma mmenia ye ma me.’ ”

english_verse: Balaam answered, “Even if Balak offered me a palace full of silver or gold, I wouldn't do anything to disobey the Lord my God.
translation_verse: Nakoso Balaam buale Balake ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Sɛ Balake fa ye awuro bɔ ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ ayi ye tɛkyɛɛ po ma me a, mengɔhora mengohwi mengɔfa AWURADE me Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ so mengɔyɔ ye nwo hwee.

english_verse: You are welcome to spend the night here, just as the others did. I will find out if the Lord has something else to say about this.”
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ koso, ɛ́mɔla wa ɛnɛ, kyɛbɔ ɛbɔfoɛ hene mɔ yɔle ne ala, maa ndie edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE kɔha kohyire me bieku ɔ.”

english_verse: That night, God said, “Balaam, I'll let you go to Moab with Balak's messengers, but do only what I say.”
translation_verse: Sɔ kɔngɔen ne, Nyameɛ wale Balaam berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, “Sɛ biaa nemɔ bawa baato bɛ sa bafrɛ wɔ a, dwɔso na ɛne bɛ hɔ; na mmom bɔ ngɔhã ngohyire wɔ ne ala yeɛ yɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: So Balaam got up the next morning and saddled his donkey, then left with the Moabite officials. Balaam and His Donkey Meet an Angel
translation_verse: Yiti Balaam dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ, osiesiele ye afunum, na ɔne Moabo mbanyi nemɔ besili nu bɛhɔle. Balaam afunum ne dwudwo

english_verse: Balaam was riding his donkey to Moab, and two of his servants were with him. But God was angry that Balaam had gone, so one of the Lord's angels stood in the road to stop him.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ fɛle yaa paa, ofikyɛ Balaam sili nu kyɛ ɔkɔ. Na AWURADE abɔfo oogyinane atee ne anu sili ye ate. Né Balaam te ye afunum ne aso, na né ɔne ye ngoaa nyɔ yeɛ bɛnate ɔ.

english_verse: When Balaam's donkey saw the angel standing there with a sword, it walked off the road and into an open field. Balaam had to beat the donkey to get it back on the road.
translation_verse: Afunum ne nwuni kyɛ AWURADE abɔfo ne gyi atee ne anu, bɔ yeɛ otira ngrandɛ ɔ. Yiti afunum ne makyele fili atee ne anu, na oowurale eburo. Balaam bɔle afunum ne kyɛ ɔmaa ɔfa ye nye kyire atee nu.

english_verse: Then the angel stood between two vineyards, in a narrow path with a stone wall on each side.
translation_verse: Né atee kyenɔnn bie la bobe boo nemɔ anu. Ɛwaen wɔ ye bɛen ne famaa. Na AWURADE abɔfo oogyinane atee ne anu.

english_verse: When the donkey saw the angel, it walked so close to one of the walls that Balaam's foot scraped against the wall. Balaam beat the donkey again.
translation_verse: Afunum ne nye bɔle AWURADE abɔfo ne aso ne, ɔfale ye nwo hwili ɛwaen ne mane Balaam gya hwili ɛwaen ne. Yiti Balaam bɔle kaka ne bieku.

english_verse: The angel moved once more and stood in a spot so narrow that there was no room for the donkey to go around.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ abɔfo ne wale ye nyunu, na oogyinane nekaa kyenɔnn bie, bɔ yeɛ ɛpɛne wɔ nwo kɔ bɛen anaa famaa a ɔnyɛ yee ɔ.

english_verse: So it just lay down. Balaam lost his temper, then picked up a stick and whacked the donkey.
translation_verse: Afunum ne nwuni Nyameɛ abɔfo ne, obutuli berɛ bɔ né Balaam tɛ te ye so ɔ. Balaam fɛle yaa hahii, na ɔfale ye pɔmaa bɔle afunum ne.

english_verse: When that happened, the Lord told the donkey to speak, and it asked Balaam, “What have I done that made you beat me three times?”
translation_verse: AWURADE mane afunum ne dwudwole, na obisale Balaam kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ mayɔ wɔ ɔ, bɔ yeɛ yiti abɔ me pɛen nza ye?”

english_verse: “You made me look stupid!” Balaam answered. “If I had a sword, I'd kill you here and now!”
translation_verse: Balaam buale afunum ne kyɛ, “Ofikyɛ edi me nwo angorɛ! Sɛ ndira ngrandɛ a, ahaa ngohũ wɔ kekesaala ye!”

english_verse: “But you're my owner,” answered the donkey, “and you've ridden me many times. Have I ever done anything like this before?” “No,” Balaam admitted.
translation_verse: Nakoso afunum ne bisale Balaam kyɛ, “Aso nna w’afunum ole me, bɔ yeɛ atena me so alaa maa waadwu ɛnɛ ye? Aso mayɔ wɔ sɔ le?” Na Balaam buale ye kyɛ, “Daabi.”

english_verse: Just then, the Lord let Balaam see the angel standing in the road, holding a sword, and Balaam bowed down.
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE bukyele Balaam nye, na onwuni kyɛ AWURADE abɔfo ne gyi atee ne anu, bɔ wahwe ye ngrandɛ ɔ. Balaam bɔle ye nu ase fale ye nyunu butuli ase.

english_verse: The angel said, “You had no right to treat your donkey like that! I was the one who blocked your way, because I don't think you should go to Moab.
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE abɔfo ne bisale ye kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ abɔ wɔ kaka ne pɛen nza ye? Mawa kyɛ mebaasi wɔ ate, ofikyɛ nikyee bɔ ɛyɔ ne, ɔndengyɛ wɔ me nyunu.

english_verse: If your donkey had not seen me and stopped those three times, I would have killed you and let the donkey live.”
translation_verse: Afunum ne nwuni me, na ɔmakyele fili me nyunu pɛen nza. Sɛ wammakye wamvi me nyunu a, amba, ahaa mahu wɔ dadaada, maa ye de wanya ye ti wadidi nu.”

english_verse: Balaam replied, “I was wrong. I didn't know you were trying to stop me. If you don't think I should go, I'll return home at once.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Balaam sele AWURADE abɔfo ne kyɛ, “Mayɔ bɔne, ofikyɛ né menze kyɛ agyina atee ne anu kyɛ esi me ate ɔ. Afei, sɛ bɔ meyɔ ne ɔnzɔ wɔ nye a, ye de, mesa mekɔ awuro.”

english_verse: “It's all right for you to go,” the Lord's angel answered. “But you must say only what I tell you.” So Balaam went on with Balak's officials. King Balak Meets Balaam
translation_verse: Na AWURADE abɔfo ne sele Balaam kyɛ, “Ɛne biaa nemɔ bɛhɔ, nakoso bɔ ngɔhã ngohyire wɔ ne angome yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛkã ɔ.” Yiti Balaam ne Balake mbanyi nemɔ bɛhɔle.

english_verse: When Balak heard that Balaam was coming, he went to meet him at the town of Ir on the Arnon River, which is the northern border of Moab.
translation_verse: Balake tele kyɛ Balaam awa ne, ooyiale ye wɔ Moabo kuro Yiri, bɔ ɔwɔ Anɔn ɛwɛen so, ɛwɛen ne anoa dɔ paa ne.

english_verse: Balak asked, “Why didn't you come when I invited you the first time? Did you think I wasn't going to pay you?”
translation_verse: Na Balake bisale Balaam kyɛ, “Manzoma kyɛ bɛɛfrɛ wɔ? Nzu ati yeɛ amma ɔ?” Aso mengɔhora mengɔma wɔ akatuaa bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: They left and went to the town of Kiriath-Huzoth,
translation_verse: Balaam ne Balake bɛhɔle, na beedwuli Kiriate Husote.

english_verse: where Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep and gave some of the meat to Balaam and the officials who were with him.
translation_verse: Balake fale nandwie mɔ ne mmoaen bɔle afɔleɛ, na ɔfale naen ne mane Balaam ne mbanyi bɔ né bɛboka ye so ne. Balaam ngɔmhyɛlɛ bɔ oli moa

english_verse: The next morning, Balak took Balaam to the town of Bamoth-Baal. From there, Balaam could see some of the Israelites.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyene ne, Balake fale Balaam ɔne ye bɛfo bɛhɔle Bamote Baal. Bɛwɔ berɛ ne, né Balaam nye tua Yisraelfoɛ nemɔ anu bie.

english_verse: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars here, then bring seven bulls and seven rams.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Balaam sele Balake kyɛ, “Si afɔleɛ bokyea nzoo wɔ wa ma me, ná ma me nandwie nyii nzoo ne mmoaen nyii nzoo.”

english_verse: After Balak had done this, they sacrificed a bull and a ram on each altar.
translation_verse: Balake yɔle kyɛbɔ Balaam hane ne ala, na Balake ne Balaam bɛfale nandwie nyii ko ne boaen nyii ko biala bɛbɔle afɔleɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ko biala so.

english_verse: Then Balaam said, “Wait here beside your offerings, and I'll go somewhere to be alone. Maybe the Lord will appear to me. If he does, I will tell you everything he says.” And he left.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Balaam sele Balake kyɛ, “Tena wɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne anwo, na mekɔ ahameɛ kãa. Ebiaa AWURADE ne me kooli ngitahoɛ. Bɔ ɔkɔye kohyire me biala, ngɔhã ngohyire wɔ.” Na Balaam sili nu hɔle bokaa pralaa bie aso.

english_verse: When God appeared to him, Balaam said, “I have built seven altars and have sacrificed a bull and a ram on each one.”
translation_verse: Nyameɛ yele ye nwo ali hyirele Balaam, na Balaam sele ye kyɛ, “Masiesie afɔleɛ bokyea nzoo ne, na mafa nandwie nyii ko ɔne boaen nyii ko biala mabɔ afɔleɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ko biala so.”

english_verse: The Lord gave Balaam a message, then sent him back to tell Balak.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE fale edwirɛ tuale Balaam noa kyɛ, “Sa kɔ Balake dɔ, na edwirɛ he yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛkã ɔ.”

english_verse: When Balaam returned, he found Balak and his officials standing beside the offerings.
translation_verse: Yiti Balaam sa wale Balake berɛ. Né Balake gyi ye naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne anwo berɛ, bɔ Moabo mbanyi nemɔ boka ye so ɔ.

english_verse: Balaam said: “King Balak of Moab brought me from the hills of Syria to curse Israel and announce its doom.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Balaam hyɛle ngɔm kyɛ, “Balake waafa me wafi Aram wawa, Moabo hene waafa me wafi eyia afiteleɛ mmokaa so. Ɔnwa: ‘Bra ná baanoma Yakob ma me; Bra baawa Yisrael amoen!’

english_verse: But I can't go against God! He did not curse or condemn Israel. *
translation_verse: Meyɛ sɛɛ né manoma mmenia bɔ Nyameɛ ɔnnomane bɛ ɔ? Meyɛ sɛɛ né mawa mmenia bɔ AWURADE ɔppole bɛ ɔ amoen?

english_verse: They are living alone in peace. And though they are many, they don't bother the other nations. “I hope to obey God for as long as I live and to die in such peace.”
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔha Yakob boso ama bɔ bɛ somaa te kyɛ mvuture ɔ, anaakyɛ ɔkɔhora kɔha Yisraelfoɛ nna nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ɔ? Ma me wue yɛ kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛtengyɛ ɔ bɛ wue, ná m’ayieleɛ ɔyɛ kyɛ bɛ deɛ!”

english_verse: Balak said, “What are you doing? I asked you to come and place a curse on my enemies. But you have blessed them instead!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Balake sele Balaam kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ afa ali me ye? Mvale wɔ mmale kyɛ baanoma me pɔfoɛ mɔ, nakoso eyiralɛ mmom yeɛ ayira bɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Balaam answered, “I can say only what the Lord tells me.” Balaam's Second Message
translation_verse: Balaam buale kyɛ, “Aso nna bɔ AWURADE afa atua me noa yeɛ odi kyɛ menea meka ye yé ɔ?” Balaam ngɔmhyɛlɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ

english_verse: Balak said to Balaam, “Let's go somewhere else. Maybe if you see a smaller part of the Israelites, you will be able to curse them for me.”
translation_verse: Yiti Balake sele Balaam kyɛ, “Bra ma me ne wɔ yɛhɔ nekaa foforɛ bɔ egyi berɛ a wɔ nye tua bɛ ɔ; ekonwu bɛ nu bie, engonwu bɛ mukoraati; na afei gyina berɛ na noma bɛ ma me.”

english_verse: So he took Balaam to a field on top of Mount Pisgah where lookouts were stationed. Then he built seven altars there and sacrificed a bull and a ram on each one.
translation_verse: Balake fale ye hɔle bokaa Pisiga ti afia wɔ Sofim ɛserɛ so. Osili afɔleɛ bokyea nzoo, na ɔfale nandwie nyii ko ne boaen nyii ko biala bɔle afɔleɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ko biala so.

english_verse: “Wait here beside your offerings,” Balaam said. “The Lord will appear to me over there.”
translation_verse: Balaam sele Balake kyɛ, “Gyina wɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne anwo, na maa ngɔ moa dɔ me ne AWURADE yɛɛli ngitahoɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord appeared to Balaam and gave him another message, then he told him to go and tell Balak.
translation_verse: AWURADE yele ye nwo ali hyirele Balaam, na ɔfale edwirɛ tuale ye noa kyɛ, “Sá kɔ Balake dɔ, na edwirɛ he yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛkã ɔ.”

english_verse: Balaam went back and saw him and his officials standing beside the offerings. Balak asked, “What did the Lord say?”
translation_verse: Osa hɔle Balake dɔ ne, né Balake gyi ye naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne anwo, bɔ Moabo mbanyi nemɔ boka ye so ɔ. Na Balake bisale Balaam kyɛ, “AWURADE nwa nzɛ?”

english_verse: Balaam answered: “Pay close attention to my words—
translation_verse: Yeɛ Balaam hyɛle ngɔm kyɛ, “Dwɔso, Balake, ná tie; Sipore awa, tie bɔ meka ye.

english_verse: God is no mere human! He doesn't tell lies or change his mind. God always keeps his promises.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ ɔtte kyɛ kuro sona, ná wapɛ anoanu, yeɛ ɔtte kyɛ dasaniɛ, ná wasesã ye adwene. Aso wahyɛ bɔ bɔ ongoli so anaa? Anaa waha edwirɛ bie bɔ ɔngɔma ɔngɔwa nu ɔ?

english_verse: “My command from God was to bless these people, and there's nothing I can do to change what he has done.
translation_verse: Tie, saleɛ nwo dwirɛ yeɛ wafa wasoma me ɔ, wayira bɛ, yiti mengɔhora ye sesã.

english_verse: Israel's king is the Lord God. He lives there with them and intends them no harm.
translation_verse: Wannwu amumuyɛɛ biala wɔ Yakob nu; yeɛ wannwu amaneɛ dwirɛ biala wɔ Yisrael. AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ gyi bɛ si, babɔ ye ohomoo wɔ bɛ nu kyɛ b’ɛhene ɛne.

english_verse: With the strength of a wild ox, God led Israel out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bɔ ɔyele bɛ fili Misraim ne, ye anwoserɛ te kyɛ torɔen mmɛen ma bɛ.

english_verse: No magic charms can work against them— just look what God has done for his people.
translation_verse: Amba, bɛyyele ngonyaa biala bettiale Yakob, yeɛ bɛwwale Yisrael amoen biala. Afei bɛkɔhã bɛkɔfa Yakob ne Yisrael nwo kyɛ, ‘Nea bɔ AWURADE ayɔ ɔ!’

english_verse: They are like angry lions ready to attack; and they won't rest until their victim is gobbled up.”
translation_verse: Tie, Yisrael te maen bɔ odwɔso kyɛ gyata beleɛ, na ɔpagya ye nwo kyɛ gyata nyii! Ommutu berɛ, sana wali naen bɔ wahye ye ɔ, sana wano kaka bɔ wahũ ye ɔ, ye mogya.”

english_verse: Balak shouted, “If you're not going to curse Israel, then at least don't bless them.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Balake sele Balaam kyɛ, “Nzaade a, nnɛnoma bɛ koraa, yeɛ nnɛyira bɛ koraa.”

english_verse: “I've already told you,” Balaam answered. “I will say only what the Lord tells me.” Balaam's Third Message
translation_verse: Nakoso Balaam buale Balake kyɛ, “Manga mangyire wɔ kyɛ, ‘Bɔ AWURADE kɔha biala, yeɛ odi kyɛ meyɔ ɔ’?”

english_verse: Balak said to Balaam, “Come on, let's try another place. Maybe God will let you curse Israel from there.”
translation_verse: Yiti Balake sele Balaam kyɛ, “Bra, maa mva wɔ ngɔ neka foforɛ. Ebiaa, berɛ de, Nyameɛ kɔpene so maa ɛkɔnoma mmenia nemɔ kɔma me.”

english_verse: So he took Balaam to Mount Peor overlooking the desert north of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Yiti Balake fale Balaam hɔle bokaa Peɔ so, bɔ egyi berɛ a, wɔ nye tua ɛserɛ pralaa ne.

english_verse: Balaam said, “Build seven altars here, then bring me seven bulls and seven rams.”
translation_verse: Balaam sele Balake kyɛ, “Si afɔleɛ bokyea nzoo wɔ wa ma me, ná ma me nandwie nyii nzoo ne mmoaen nyii nzoo.”

english_verse: After Balak had done what Balaam asked, he sacrificed a bull and a ram on each altar.
translation_verse: Yiti Balake yɔle kyɛbɔ Balaam hane ne, ɔfale nandwie nyii ko ne boaen nyii ko biala bɔle afɔleɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ko biala so.

english_verse: Balaam was sure that the Lord would tell him to bless Israel again. So he did not use any magic to find out what the Lord wanted him to do, as he had the first two times. Instead, he looked out toward the desert
translation_verse: Afei Balaam nwuni kyɛ ɔyɛle AWURADE fɛ kyɛ ye Balaam wayira Yisrael ɔ. Yiti wangɔ ammisa so kyɛbɔ ɔyɔle ye daa ne, na mmom ɔfale ye nye hyirele ɛserɛ ne aso.

english_verse: and saw the tribes of Israel camped below. Just then, God's Spirit took control of him,
translation_verse: Balaam mane ye ti so, na onwuni kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ baboaboa bɛ noa mmusua kure mmusua kure. Na Nyameɛ Sunzum wale ye so,

english_verse: and Balaam said: “I am the son of Beor, and my words are true, so listen to my message!
translation_verse: na ɔhyɛle ngɔm kyɛ, “Beɔ awa Balaam ye ngɔmhyɛlɛ ɛhe, sona bɔ ɔse ase ne, ye ngɔmhyɛlɛ,

english_verse: It comes from the Lord, the God All-Powerful. I bowed down to him and saw a vision of Israel.
translation_verse: sona bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ dwudwolɛ ne, ye ngɔmhyɛlɛ, bɔ onwu Ɛdangama ye nyekyire ne, bɔ ɔkata ye nye po a, ye nye nwu nikyee ne.

english_verse: “People of Israel, your camp is lovely.
translation_verse: O Yakob, wɔ ɛtena sua mɔ yɛ nyemene, O Yisrael, w’atenaleɛ mɔ yɛ nyemene!

english_verse: It's like a grove of palm trees or a garden beside a river. You are like tall aloe trees that the Lord has planted, or like cedars growing near water.
translation_verse: Bɛte kyɛ bɔnza bɔ ɔtrɛ kɔ dede ɔ, bɛte kyɛ asue noa turo mɔ, bɛte kyɛ pɛprɛ mmakaa bɔ AWURADE alua ɔ, bɛte kyɛ sida mmakaa bɔ begyigyi asue noa ɔ.

english_verse: You and your descendants will prosper like an orchard beside a stream. Your king will rule with power and be a greater king than Agag the Amalekite.
translation_verse: Nzue kofi ye bua nu kɔtengyɛ, na ye boso ama konya nzue pee, ye hene kɔyɛ titire kɔtra Agage, na ye ahennie konya ngɔsoɛ.

english_verse: With the strength of a wild ox, God led you out of Egypt. You will defeat your enemies, shooting them with arrows and crushing their bones.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bɔ ɔyele Yisrael fili Misraim ne, ye anwoserɛ te kyɛ torɔen mmɛen ma ye. Ɔkɔsɛkye maen maen bɔ bɛte ye pɔfoɛ ɔ, ná wabubu bɛ mmowue nu. Ɔkɔto ye agyaen kɔwowɔ bɛ.

english_verse: Like a lion you lie down, resting after an attack. Who would dare disturb you? “Anyone who blesses you will be blessed; anyone who curses you will be cursed.”
translation_verse: Okunduni, na obutu berɛ kyɛ gyata, ɔte kyɛ gyata beleɛ; nwa yeɛ okotingye ye ɔ? Ebiala bɔ okoyira wɔ ne, Nyameɛ koyira ye, yeɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkɔnoma wɔ ne, Nyameɛ kɔnoma ye.”

english_verse: When Balak heard this, he was so furious that he pounded his fist against his hand and said, “I called you here to place a curse on my enemies, and you've blessed them three times.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Balake fɛle Balaam so yaa hahii. Ɔfale ye sa fini ye bɔbɔ ye sa nu, na osele Balaam kyɛ, “Ndole me sa mvrɛle wɔ kyɛ baanoma me pɔfoɛ mɔ; nakoso ayira bɛ pɛen nza mmom.

english_verse: Leave now and go home! I told you I would pay you well, but since the Lord didn't let you do what I asked, you won't be paid.”
translation_verse: Fi wa kɔ! Kɔ wɔ kuro! Ngane kyɛ ahaa ngɔma wɔ akatuaa piri paa, nakoso AWURADE abɔ w’akatuaa agua.”

english_verse: that even if you offered me a palace full of silver or gold, I would still obey the Lord. And I explained that I would say only what he told me.
translation_verse: ‘Sɛ Balake fa ye awuro bɔ ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ ayi ye tɛkyɛɛ po ma me a, mengɔhora mengoli me ti piri mengobu AWURADE dwirɛ so, ná mengɔyɔ paa anaa tɛɛ biala; na mmom bɔ AWURADE kɔha ne, ye ala yeɛ ngɔhã ɔ’?

english_verse: So I'm going back home, but I'm leaving you with a warning about what the Israelites will someday do to your nation.” Balaam's Fourth Message
translation_verse: Afei, mesa mekɔ me maen nu. Na maa nga bɔ kyẽa bie maen he kɔfa kɔyɔ wɔ maen ɔ ngyire wɔ.” Balaam ngɔmhyɛlɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nna

english_verse: Balaam said: “I am the son of Beor, and my words are true, so listen to my message!
translation_verse: Afei Balaam hyɛle ngɔm kyɛ, Beɔ awa Balaam ye ngɔmhyɛlɛ, sona bɔ ɔse ase ne, ye ngɔmhyɛlɛ,

english_verse: My knowledge comes from God Most High, the Lord All-Powerful. I bowed down to him and saw a vision of Israel.
translation_verse: sona bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ dwudwolɛ ne, ye ngɔmhyɛlɛ, sona bɔ ole Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ nwo nimdeɛ, ná onwu Tuminiɛ Nyameɛ ye nyekyire, sona bɔ ɔkata ye nye po a, ye nye nwu nikyee ne, ye ngɔmhyɛlɛ:

english_verse: “What I saw in my vision hasn't happened yet. But someday, a king of Israel will appear like a star. He will wipe out you Moabites and destroy those tribes who live in the desert.
translation_verse: Bɔ menwu ye mefa ye nwo ne, nna kekesaala ye yeɛ ɔkɔwa nu ɔ; bɔ me nye tua fa ye nwo ne, ongosi kekesaala ye. Nzramaa bie kofi Yakob nu kofite, na ɛhɔtɔ bie kofi Yisrael nu kodwɔso. Okoli Moabo mbanyi so ngonim, ná wabrɛ Sɛti boso ama amukoraa ase.

english_verse: Israel will conquer Edom and capture the land of that enemy nation.
translation_verse: Edom kɔyɛ ye pɔfoɛ deɛ na Sɛre koso, ɔkɔyɛ ye pɔfoɛ deɛ, nakoso Yisrael de, ɔkɔhɔ so koli ngonim.

english_verse: The king of Israel will rule and destroy the survivors of every town there.
translation_verse: Sona bie bɔ ofi Yakob abusua nu yeɛ okoli hene ɔ, na nguro nemɔ aso ama bɔ bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ne, okohũhũ bɛ.”

english_verse: “And I saw this vision about the Amalekites: Their nation is now great, but it will someday disappear forever.
translation_verse: Afei Balaam tole ye nye neane Amalɛke, na ɔhyɛle ngɔm kyɛ, “Amalɛke yeɛ odi mu paa wɔ maen maen mɔ nu ɔ, nakoso ye ayieleɛ ole kyɛ ɔkɔbɔ koraa.”

english_verse: “And this is what I saw about the Kenites: They think they're safe, living among the rocks,
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɔtole ye nye neane Kenifoɛ, na ɔhyɛle ngɔm kyɛ, “Wɔ atenaleɛ gyi berɛ pindinn, na wɔ bue wɔ nyɔbotaen nu;

english_verse: but they will be wiped out when Assyria conquers them.
translation_verse: nakoso bɛkɔbɔ Kenifoɛ maen ne, kɔpem kyɛ Asure kɔhye wɔ nnure ɔ?”

english_verse: Ships will come from Cyprus, bringing people who will invade the lands of Assyria and Eber. But finally, Cyprus itself will be ruined.”
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛlɛen mɔ kofi Kitim kɔwa, nu koɛhonɛfoɛ ne koli Asure ne Ebere so ngonim; na Kitim koso kɔbɔ afebɔɔ.”

english_verse: After Balaam finished, he started home, and Balak also left.
translation_verse: Afei Balaam sili nu sá hɔle ye kuro, na Balake koso sili nu hɔle.

english_verse: While the Israelites were camped at Acacia, some of the men had sex with Moabite women.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Yisraelfoɛ bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ bɛtenane Sitim ne, Yisraelfoɛ hyɛle ye bo bɛ ne Moabo mmrasua nemɔ bɛlelale.

english_verse: These women then invited the men to ceremonies where sacrifices were offered to their gods. The men ate the meat from the sacrifices and worshiped the Moabite gods.
translation_verse: Moabo mmrasua nemɔ hwehwene Yisraelfoɛ hɔle Moabo mmosoen sɔnenɛ nu. Yisraelfoɛ lili mmosoen so aleɛ ne bie, na bɛkotole bɛ mmosoen nemɔ.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with Israel because they had worshiped the god Baal Peor.
translation_verse: Yisrael fale ye nwo wurale bosoen Baal Peɔ bo, yiti AWURADE fɛle Yisrael so yaa paa.

english_verse: So he said to Moses, “Take the Israelite leaders who are responsible for this and have them killed in front of my sacred tent where everyone can see. Maybe then I will stop being angry with the Israelites.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Yeye bɛ bɔ bɛlela mmenia ne noa amukoraa, ná fa nyamaa bɔ bɛ kɔme eyia nu wɔ AWURADE nyunu, amaa ɔnate so AWURADE ayakyi ye yaa piri bɔ wafɛ ye Yisrael so ne.”

english_verse: Moses told Israel's officials, “Each of you must put to death any of your men who worshiped Baal.”
translation_verse: Yiti Mose sele Yisrael mbanyi nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ anu biala ohuhu ye mmenia bɔ bafa bɛ nwo baawura bosoen Baal Peɔ bo ne.”

english_verse: Later, Moses and the people were at the sacred tent, crying, when one of the Israelite men brought a Midianite woman to meet his family.
translation_verse: Berɛ ne ala, bɔ begu so besu wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ ne, Yisraelniɛ bienzua bie ɔɔfale Midianniɛ braa bie oowurale ye ɛtena sua nu. Né Mose ne Yisrael maen ne amukoraa bɛ nye tua ye.

english_verse: Phinehas, the grandson of Aaron the priest, saw the couple and left the crowd. He found a spear
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Finehase, bɔ ɔse ole ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Eleasa nwuni ye ne, odwɔsole hwene ye nwo fili mmenia ne anu. Ɔfale pealɛɛ tirale,

english_verse: and followed the man into his tent, where he ran the spear through the man and into the woman's stomach. The Lord immediately stopped punishing Israel with a deadly disease,
translation_verse: na ɔpole Yisraelniɛ biaa ne wɔ ɛtena sua nu berɛ. Ɔfale pealɛɛ ne wɔle Yisraelniɛ biaa ne ɔne Midianniɛ braa ne bɛ munyɔ bɛ kunu. Na amaneɛ ne fili Yisraelfoɛ so.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: But instead of punishing them, I forgave them. So because of the loyalty that Phinehas showed, I solemnly promise that he and his descendants will always be my priests.”
translation_verse: Na ɛhe kɔyɛ daa sɔfolilɛ nwo apam kɔma ye ne ye boso ama, ofikyɛ wagyina ye gya nu pindinn wama ye Nyameɛ, na wapata wama Yisraelfoɛ.”

english_verse: The Israelite man that was killed was Zimri son of Salu, who was one of the leaders of the Simeon tribe.
translation_verse: Yisraelniɛ biaa bɔ ohuni ye ne Midianniɛ braa ne, bɛfrɛ ye Simri. Ye baba ole Salu bɔ né ɔla Simeonfoɛ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ kure ko anoa ne.

english_verse: And the Midianite woman killed with him was Cozbi, the daughter of a Midianite clan leader named Zur.
translation_verse: Midianniɛ braa bɔ ohuni ye ne, bɛfrɛ ye Kosibi. Sure bɔ ɔla Midian abusua ko anoa ne, ɔwa brasua ɛne.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses,
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: “The Midianites are now enemies of Israel, so attack and defeat them! They tricked the people of Israel into worshiping their god at Peor, and they are responsible for the death of Cozbi, the daughter of one of their own leaders.”
translation_verse: ofikyɛ bɛnate nnakannaka so baha ɛmɔ. Balakalaka ɛmɔ wɔ edwirɛ hemɔ anwo: Baal Peɔ sɔnenɛ nwo, yeɛ b’eliɛma brasua Kosibi bɔ ɔte Midian panyi bie awa ne anwo. Kyẽa bɔ Peɔ sɔnenɛ hwene amaneɛ wale ne yeɛ behuni Kosibi ɔ.”

english_verse: After the Lord had stopped the deadly disease from killing the Israelites, he said to Moses and Eleazar son of Aaron,
translation_verse: Amaneɛ ne bo pɛle ne, AWURADE sele Mose ne ɔsɔfo Aarɔn awa Eleasa kyɛ,

english_verse: “I want you to find out how many Israelites are in each family. Then make a list of every man
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔha Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa: Yisraelniɛ biala bɔ wali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɔ ɔkora kɔ koɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ɔ.”

english_verse: years and older, just as Moses and their ancestors had done when they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Yuda boso ama bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛhe: Hyelafoɛ bɔ bɛte Hyela sasofoɛ; Pɛrɛsefoɛ bɔ bɛte Pɛrɛse sasofoɛ; Serafoɛ bɔ bɛte Sera sasofoɛ.

english_verse: Israel was now camped in the hills of Moab across the Jordan River from the town of Jericho. Moses and Eleazar told them
translation_verse: Na Mose ne ɔsɔfo Eleasa, bɛ ne mmenia nemɔ bedwudwole, wɔ Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan bue nu dɔ bɔ opingye Yeriko ne kyɛ,

english_verse: Pallu was the father of Eliab
translation_verse: Palu awa ole Eliabo.

english_verse: and the grandfather of Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the same Dathan and Abiram who had been chosen by the people, but who followed Korah and rebelled against Moses, Aaron, and the Lord.
translation_verse: Eliabo mma mɔ ole Nemuel, Datan ne Abiram. Sɔ Datan ne Abiram hemɔ ala yeɛ né bɛte mbanyi wɔ Yisrael, bɔ bɛ ne Kora bedwɔsole betiale Mose ne Aarɔn, ná bɛyɔle AWURADE nwo lɔen ne.

english_verse: That's when the Lord made the earth open up and swallow Dathan, Abiram, and Korah. At the same time, fire destroyed
translation_verse: Aseɛ bukyele ye noa nu, na ɔmemene bɛ ne Kora. Sɔ mmenia ne wuwuli ne, see yerale mmenia ɛyaa nyɔ ne aburannu, na bɛ nwo dwirɛ yɛle kɔkɔbɔlɛ.

english_verse: But the Korahite clan wasn't destroyed.
translation_verse: Nakoso Kora mma mɔ de, banwuwu bie.

english_verse: None of the people that Moses and Aaron had counted in the Sinai Desert were still alive,
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ bɔ Mose ne ɔsɔfo Aarɔn bɛhale bɛ wɔ Sinai ɛserɛ ne aso ne, bɛ nu ko po nne berɛ bɔ né ɔboka mmenia hemɔ aso ɔ.

english_verse: Aaron was the father of Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Aarɔn mma ole Nadabo, Abihu, Eleasa ɔne Yitama.

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: “Divide the land of Canaan among these tribes, according to the number of people in each one,
translation_verse: “Ɛhemɔ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛkyɛ aseɛ ne ma bɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmenia bɔ baha bɛ ne somaa te ɔ, maa ɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: The total number of Israelite men listed was
translation_verse: Bɛhale Yisraelfoɛ ne, bɛ somaa te apee ɛyaa nzia ne ko, ɛyaa nzoo ɔne aburasa.

english_verse: I will show you what land to give each tribe, and they will receive as much land as they need, according to the number of people in it.”
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ egyina serewagualɛ so ɛkyɛ aseɛ ne ma mmusua kure mbiri ne mmaa mmaa nemɔ.”

english_verse: The tribe of Levi included the clans of the Gershonites, Kohathites, Merarites,
translation_verse: Bɛhale Lewifoɛ mmusua mmusua ne, bɛ ɛhe: Gɛsɔnfoɛ bɔ bɛte Gɛsɔn sasofoɛ; Kohatefoɛ bɔ bɛte Kohate sasofoɛ, yeɛ Merarifoɛ bɔ bɛte Merari sasofoɛ.

english_verse: as well as the clans of Libni, Hebron, Mahli, Mushi, and Korah. Kohath the Levite was the father of Amram,
translation_verse: Lewi mmusua mmusua mɔ ɛhe: Libinifoɛ abusua, Hebronfoɛ abusua, Mahelifoɛ abusua, Musifoɛ abusua, yeɛ Korafoɛ abusua. Kohate awa ole Amram.

english_verse: the husband of Levi's daughter Jochebed, who was born in Egypt. Amram and Jochebed's three children were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam.
translation_verse: Amram ɔye ole Lewi awa brasua Yokebɛde. Lewi wole Yokebɛde wɔ Misraim, na Yokebɛde ne Amram bɛwole Aarɔn ne Mose yeɛ b’eliɛma brasua Miriam.

english_verse: But Nadab and Abihu had died when they offered fire that was unacceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nadabo ne Abihu de, bewuwuli ofikyɛ né bɛmvata kyɛ bɛfa see bɛbɔ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, nakoso bɛyɔle sɔ.

english_verse: Moses and Eleazar counted the Israelites while they were camped in the hills of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ Mose ne ɔsɔfo Eleasa bɛhale bɛ nemɔ ɛne. Bɛhale Yisraelfoɛ wɔ Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan bue nu dɔ bɔ opingye Yeriko ne.

english_verse: except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun. The Lord had said that everyone else would die there in the desert.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ né AWURADE aha afa bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Bekowuwu wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso.” Bɛ nu ko po anga, sana Yefune awa Kalebo ɔne Nun awa Yosua angome.

english_verse: One day his daughters went to the sacred tent, where they met with Moses, Eleazar, and some other leaders of Israel, as well as a large crowd of Israelites. The young women said:
translation_verse: Mose, ɔsɔfo Eleasa, Yisrael mbanyi ɔne maen ne amukoraati bɛ nyunu wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ, na bɛhane kyɛ,

english_verse: You know that our father died in the desert. But it was for something he did wrong, not for joining with Korah in rebelling against the Lord. Our father left no sons
translation_verse: “Yɛ baba wuli wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso. Bɛ bɔ bɛ ne Kora yɛle AWURADE nwo lɔen ne, né ye de ɔbboka bɛ so. Nakoso ɔnate ye bɔbɔ ye bɔne ti, owuli bɔ wanwo baa bienzua biala ɔ.

english_verse: to carry on his family name. But why should his name die out for that reason? Give us some land like the rest of his relatives in our clan, so our father's name can live on.
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ ɔnate kyɛ yɛ baba wanwo baa bienzua ne ati, odi kyɛ bɛma ye dumaa mini wɔ ye abusua nu ɔ? Yɛ baba aliɛma mmienzua nemɔ b’agyapadeɛ deɛ ne, fa nu bie ma yɛ.”

english_verse: Moses asked the Lord what should be done,
translation_verse: Mose fale bɛ dwirɛ ne tole AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: and the Lord answered:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE buale Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: Zelophehad's daughters are right. They should each be given part of the land their father would have received.
translation_verse: “Edwirɛ bɔ Selofehade mma mmrasua nemɔ bɛka ne, ɔte turoloo. Odi kyɛ ɛma bɛ koso benya bɛ baba aliɛma mmienzua nemɔ b’aseɛ deɛ ne bie, amaa ɔnate so bɛ sa aha bɛ baba agyapadeɛ deɛ.

english_verse: If he has no daughter, his brothers will inherit the land.
translation_verse: Sɛ olle baa brasua a, ye de ɛ́mɔfa ye agyapadeɛ bɛ́ma oliɛma mmienzua mɔ.

english_verse: But if he has no brothers, his father's brothers will inherit the land.
translation_verse: Na sɛ olle aliɛmaa bienzua a, ye de ɛ́mɔfa ye agyapadeɛ bɛ́ma ye baba aliɛma mmienzua mɔ.

english_verse: And if his father has no brothers, the land must be given to his nearest relative in the clan. This is my law, and the Israelites must obey it. Joshua Is Appointed Israel's Leader (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Na sɛ ye baba olle aliɛmaa bienzua a, ye de ɛ́mɔfa ye agyapadeɛ ne bɛ́ma ye abusuaniɛ kaenn, maa ɔfa. Ɛhe kɔyɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ kɔma Yisraelfoɛ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne.” Yosua si Mose gya nu

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses, “One day you will go up into the Abarim Mountains, and from there you will see the land I am giving the Israelites.
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Fo Abarim mmokaa he, ná to wɔ nye nea aseɛ bɔ mafa mama Yisraelfoɛ ne.

english_verse: After you have seen it, you will die, just like your brother Aaron,
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛnea yie a, ɛkɔtoa wɔ mbanyi mɔ kyɛbɔ eliɛma Aarɔn toale bɛ ne.

english_verse: because both of you disobeyed me at Meribah near the town of Kadesh in the Zin Desert. When the Israelites insulted me there, you didn't believe in my holy power.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ maen ne dwɔso tiale me wɔ Sen ɛserɛ ne aso ne, ɛmɔyɛle me mmeraa dwirɛ nwo asoserɛ. Ɛmɔamma wanna ali wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nyunu kyɛ nde krongron, wɔ nekaa bɔ nzue wale ne.”

english_verse: “You are the Lord God, and you know what is in everyone's heart. So I ask you to appoint a leader for Israel.
translation_verse: “AWURADE bɔ ɛte anwoɔnaen amukoraati, bɛ sunzum Nyameɛ ne, ye sona maa otua maen ye anoa,

english_verse: Your people need someone to lead them into battle, or else they will be like sheep wandering around without a shepherd.”
translation_verse: sona bɔ okoli bɛ nyunu wɔ nikyee biala anu, na afei watua bɛ noa wɔ bɛ koɛhonɛ nu, amaa AWURADE mmenia banyɛ kyɛ mmoaen bɔ belle neafoɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Joshua son of Nun can do the job. Place your hands on him to show that he is the one to take your place.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE buale Mose kyɛ, “Ye Nun awa Yosua, bɔ sunzum ne akanyane ye ne, ná fa wɔ sa gua ye so.

english_verse: Then go with him and tell him to stand in front of Eleazar the priest and the Israelites. Appoint Joshua as their new leader
translation_verse: Maa oogyina ɔsɔfo Eleasa ne maen ne amukoraa bɛ nyunu, na fa ye tua maen ne anoa wɔ bɛ nyunu.

english_verse: and tell them they must now obey him, just as they obey you.
translation_verse: Fa wɔ tumi ne bie wura ye sa, amaa ɔnate so Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bayɛ sotie bama ye.

english_verse: But Joshua must depend on Eleazar to find out from me what I want him to do as he leads Israel into battle.”
translation_verse: Nakoso odi kyɛ ɔba ɔsɔfo Eleasa nyunu maa ɔfa Yurim so obisa AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɔma ye wɔ AWURADE nyunu. AWURADE noa dwirɛ so yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔne Yisrael maen ne amukoraa begyina bɛyɔ nikyee biala ɔ.”

english_verse: Moses followed the Lord's instructions and took Joshua to Eleazar and the people,
translation_verse: Yiti Mose yɔle kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne ala. Ɔyele Yosua, na ɔmaa oogyinane ɔsɔfo Eleasa ɔne maen ne amukoraa bɛ nyunu.

english_verse: then he placed his hands on Joshua and appointed him Israel's leader.
translation_verse: Mose fale ye sa guale Yosua so, na ɔfale ye tuale maen ne anoa, kyɛbɔ AWURADE nate Mose so hyɛle ne.

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa olonka ko bɛboka mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nzoo ne anu biala so.

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams. The smell of the smoke from these sacrifices will please me.
translation_verse: Esam paa olonka ko bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛbɔ aburoo afɔleɛ bɛboka boaen akrɔngrɔma ko biala so. Ɔte naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo fona, bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to the people of Israel: Offer sacrifices to me at the appointed times of worship, so that I will smell the smoke and be pleased.
translation_verse: “Fa sɔ ahyɛdeɛ he ma Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, M’afɔleɛ, aleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma me, bɔ ɔbo me fona ne, ɛ́mɔnea yé kyɛ ɛmɔkɔbɔ bɛkɔma me mmerɛ bɔ m’ahyɛ ne pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Each day offer two rams a year old as sacrifices to please me. The animals must have nothing wrong with them;
translation_verse: Na se bɛ kyɛ, afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɔ odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ bɛma AWURADE ne ɛhe: daa biala, ɛ́mɔfa mmoaen nyii nyɔ bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko, bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ, bɛbɔ afɔleɛ.

english_verse: Along with each of them, one kilogram of your finest flour mixed with a liter of olive oil must be offered as a grain sacrifice.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛfa esam paa olonka ko, bɔ bafa ngoo bɔ bahwi towaa ko ne bue bafra ɔ, ɛbɔ aburoo afɔleɛ boka so.

english_verse: Finally, along with each of these two sacrifices, a liter of wine must be poured on the altar as a drink offering.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ boaen akrɔngrɔma ko biala bɛfa anonneɛ afɔleɛ towaa ko ne bue bɛboka so. Odi kyɛ ehwie nzaa serɛ fa bɔ anonneɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE wɔ nekaa krongron berɛ.

english_verse: On the first day of each month, bring to the altar two bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔhyɛ bosome biala bo a, odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE. Ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma nyɔ, boaen nyii ko, mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma nzoo bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko, bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Afei odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa esam paa olonka nza bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ bɛbɔ aburoo afɔleɛ bɛboka nandwie nyii ko biala so. Asa koso, esam paa olonka nyɔ bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ne, ɛ́mɔfa bɛbɔ aburoo afɔleɛ bɛboka boaen nyii ko ne aso.

english_verse: Celebrate Passover in honor of me on the fourteenth day of the first month of each year.
translation_verse: Bosome bɔ oli moa ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nna ne, odi kyɛ bɛbɔ Abɔtra afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE.

english_verse: The following day will begin the Festival of Thin Bread, which will last for a week. During this time you must honor me by eating bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Sɔ bosome ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nnu ne, ɔte aluolue. Odi kyɛ bedi paanoo kabrɛdi ɛlɛsoo.

english_verse: On the first day of this festival, you must rest from your work and come together for worship.
translation_verse: Kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɛ nyianu krongron; nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala.

english_verse: Bring to the altar two bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. And then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ wɔ see so bɛma AWURADE: ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma nyɔ, boaen nyii ko, ɔne mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma nzoo bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko ɔ. Nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɔ wali nnɛen biala ɔ.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ: ɛ́mɔfa olonka nza bɛ́boka nandwie nyii ko biala so, ná ɛ́mɔfa olonka nyɔ bɛ́boka boaen nyii ko biala so.

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa olonka ko bɛboka mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nzoo ne anu biala so.

english_verse: All of these are to be offered each day of the festival in additional to the regular sacrifices, and the smoke from them will please me.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ sɔ ɛlɛsoo ne, daa biala, odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ see so aleɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo fona ɔ bɛma AWURADE ɔ. Odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ bɛboka daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ɔne anonneɛ afɔleɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Then on the last day of the festival, you must once again rest from work and come together for worship. The Sacrifices during the Harvest Festival (Leviticus
translation_verse: Na ye ɛlɛsoo ne aso, odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɛ nyianu krongron; nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala. Dapɛn Dapɛn aluolue afɔleɛ

english_verse: On the first day of the Harvest Festival, you must rest from your work, come together for worship, and bring a sacrifice of new grain.
translation_verse: Fieso aleɛ bɔ bekoli moa bɛkɔfa ne, ye aluolue kyẽa ne, sɛ ɛmɔfa aburoo foforɛ bɛbɔ aburoo afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE wɔ ɛmɔ Dapɛn Dapɛn aluolue ne anu a, odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɛ nyianu krongron; nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala.

english_verse: Offer two young bulls, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ bɛma ye: ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma nyɔ, boaen nyii ko, mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nzoo bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko ɔ.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ: ɛ́mɔfa olonka nza bɛ́boka nandwie nyii ko biala so, ná ɛ́mɔfa olonka nyɔ bɛ́boka boaen nyii ko biala so.

english_verse: Also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛ́boka so maa ɔyɛ mbata ma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: The animals must have nothing wrong with them and are to be sacrificed along with the regular daily sacrifices.
translation_verse: Sɔ afɔleɛ nemɔ ne b’anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ, odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ bɛboka daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne ɔne ye aburoo afɔleɛ ne aso. Onni kyɛ bɛ nu biala nwo nya ngekalewa biala.

english_verse: On the first day of the seventh month, you must rest from your work and come together to celebrate at the sound of the trumpets.
translation_verse: “Bosome nzoo ne, ye kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, ɛ́mɔyɛ nyianu krongron; nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala. Ɔte kyẽa bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔhu totorobɛndo nemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with the bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ bɛfa esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ yeɛ bɛbɔ ɔ. Bɛ́fa olonka nza bɛ́boka nandwie nyii ne aso, ná bɛ́fa olonka nyɔ bɛ́boka boaen nyii ne aso,

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: ná bɛ́fa olonka ko bɛ́boka mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nzoo ne anu biala so.

english_verse: You must also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Afei koso, ɛ́mɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛ́bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ maa ɔyɛ mbata ma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: These sacrifices will be made in addition to the regular daily sacrifices and the sacrifices for the first day of the month. The smoke from these sacrifices will please me. The Sacrifices on the Great Day of Forgiveness (Leviticus
translation_verse: Naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɛsraen fi a bɛbɔ ne, ɔne ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, yeɛ daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne ɔne ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, yeɛ bɛ nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa sɔ afɔleɛ nemɔ bɛboka so, kyɛbɔ bɛ nwo nhyehyɛleɛ te ɔ. Ɔte afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE bɔ ɔbo ye fona ɔ. Mbata kyẽa afɔleɛ

english_verse: The tenth day of the seventh month is the Great Day of Forgiveness. On that day you must rest from all work and come together for worship. Show sorrow for your sins by going without food,
translation_verse: “Sɔ bosome nzoo ne ala, ye eleburu ne aso, ɛ́mɔyɛ nyianu krongron. Ɛ́mɔhye hɔen, na nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala.

english_verse: and bring to the altar one young bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ bɛma ye: ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma ko, boaen nyii ko, yeɛ mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma nzoo bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko, bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with the bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with the ram,
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ: ɛ́mɔfa olonka nza bɛ́boka nandwie nyii ne aso, ná ɛ́mɔfa olonka nyɔ bɛ́boka boaen nyii ne aso,

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: ná ɛ́mɔfa olonka ko bɛ́boka mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nzoo ne anu biala so.

english_verse: A goat must also be sacrificed for the sins of the people. You will offer these sacrifices in addition to the sacrifice to ask forgiveness and the regular daily sacrifices. The Sacrifices during the Festival of Shelters (Leviticus
translation_verse: Afei koso, bɔne nwo mbata afɔleɛ ne, daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ɔne ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, yeɛ bɛ nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɛ́boka so. Asese aluolue afɔleɛ

english_verse: Beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and continuing for seven days, everyone must celebrate the Festival of Shelters in honor of me.
translation_verse: Bosome nzoo ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nnu ne, ɛ́mɔyɛ nyianu krongron; Nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala. Ɛ́mɔli aluolue ɛlɛsoo bɛma AWURADE.

english_verse: Three kilograms of your finest flour mixed with olive oil must be offered with each bull as a grain sacrifice. Two kilograms of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the rams,
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ esam paa bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ɔ: ɛ́mɔfa olonka nza bɛ́boka nandwie nyii buru ne nza ne anu ko biala so, ná ɛ́mɔfa olonka nyɔ bɛ́boka mmoaen nyii nyɔ ne anu ko biala so,

english_verse: and one kilogram of flour mixed with oil must be offered with each of the young rams.
translation_verse: ná ɛ́mɔfa olonka ko bɛ́boka mmoaen akrɔngrɔma buru ne nna ne anu ko biala so.

english_verse: You must also offer a goat as a sacrifice for sin. These are to be offered in addition to the regular daily sacrifices.
translation_verse: Afei koso, daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, ɔne ye nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɛboka so.

english_verse: For the next six days of the festival, you will sacrifice one less bull than the day before, so that on the seventh day, seven bulls will be sacrificed. The other sacrifices and offerings must remain the same for each of these days.
translation_verse: Asa koso, daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, ɔne ye nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɛboka so.

english_verse: On the eighth day, you must once again rest from your work and come together for worship.
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso, odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɛ nyianu krongron; nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ adwuma biala.

english_verse: Bring to the altar one bull, one full-grown ram, and seven rams a year old that have nothing wrong with them. Then offer these as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔbo AWURADE fona ɔ wɔ see so bɛma ye: ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii ko, boaen nyii ko, mmoaen nyii akrɔngrɔma nzoo bɔ bali afoɛ ngoko, bɔ bellili nnɛen biala ɔ;

english_verse: You must also offer the proper grain sacrifices and drink offerings of wine with each animal.
translation_verse: ná ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii ne, boaen nyii ne ɔne mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nemɔ bɛ nwo aburoo afɔleɛ, ɔne bɛ nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ bɛboka so, kyɛbɔ bɛ somaa nwo nhyehyɛleɛ te ɔ.

english_verse: And offer a goat as the sacrifice to ask forgiveness for the people. These sacrifices are made in addition to the regular daily sacrifices.
translation_verse: Asa koso, daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, ɔne ye nwo aburoo afɔleɛ ne, yeɛ ye nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa abɔngye nyii ko bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɛboka so.

english_verse: You must offer all these sacrifices to me at the appointed times of worship, together with any offerings that are voluntarily given or given because of a promise.
translation_verse: Ɛhemɔ ole aluolue bɔ AWURADE ahyehyɛ wato berɛ wama ɛmɔ ɔ. Odi kyɛ ɛmɔ bɔhyɛlɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ ɔne ɛmɔ akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ, ɔne ɛmɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, ɔne ɛmɔ aburoo afɔleɛ nemɔ, ɔne ɛmɔ anonneɛ afɔleɛ ɔne ɛmɔ asomdwee afɔleɛ nemɔ koso, ɛmɔbɔ.”

english_verse: Moses told the people of Israel everything the Lord had told him about the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Yiti Mose hane edwirɛ ne amukoraa hyirele Yisraelfoɛ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne ala.

english_verse: The Lord told Moses to say to Israel's tribal leaders:
translation_verse: Na Mose sele mbanyi bɔ bɛlela Yisraelfoɛ mmusua kure nemɔ noa kyɛ, “Ahyɛdeɛ bɔ AWURADE ahyɛ ato berɛ hɔ ɛhe:

english_verse: Suppose a young woman who is still living with her parents makes a promise to the Lord.
translation_verse: Sɛ brasua bie hyɛ AWURADE bɔ, anaakyɛ ɔta ndaen fa foa edwirɛ bie aso a, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔte taluwa bɔ ɔtɛ te ɔse awuro,

english_verse: But if he hears about it and objects, then she no longer has to keep her promise. The Lord will forgive her, because her father did not agree with the promise.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ye baba te ye dwirɛ ne, ná ɔne ye anyɛ adwene a, ye bɔ bɔ wahyɛ ne, anaa ndaen bɔ wata wafa wafoa edwirɛ so ne, nu biala ngɔyɛ adwuma. AWURADE kɔfa kɔhyɛ ye, ofikyɛ ye baba amaa wanwu ye kyɛ ɔne ye nyɛ adwene.

english_verse: Suppose a woman makes a promise to the Lord and then gets married. If her husband later hears about the promise but says nothing, she must do what she said, whether she meant it or not.
translation_verse: ná sɛ ohu te dwirɛ ne, nakoso mmerɛ bɔ yeɛ ɔkɔte ne wanga hwee wangyire ye a, ye de bɔhyɛlɛ ne tɛ la ye so, na ndaen bɔ wata wafa wafoa edwirɛ so ne koso tɛ la ye so.

english_verse: Suppose a married woman makes a promise to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na sɛ né ɔtɛwɔ agyaa bo yeɛ ɔbɔle sɔ anohoba ne, anaa ɔtale ndaen fa foale edwirɛ bie aso,

english_verse: But if he hears about the promise and does object, she no longer has to keep it. The Lord will forgive her, because her husband would not allow her to keep the promise.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ohu ne te edwirɛ ne, ná sɔ mmerɛ ne ala a, okyikyi bɔhyɛ ne ɔne anohoba ne fi berɛ a, ye de anohoba biala bɔ braa ne wafa ye noa wabɔ, anaa ndaen biala bɔ wata wafa wafoa edwirɛ so ne, ɔnzɛ kyɛ odi so. Ohu ne akyikyi afi berɛ, na AWURADE kɔfa kɔhyɛ braa ne.

english_verse: Her husband has the final say about any promises she makes to the Lord.
translation_verse: Anohoba biala anaa ndaen biala bɔ braa ne ta fa tua ye nwo nikyee biala de, ohu ne kɔhora kɔmaa ɔkɔyɔ adwuma, anaa ɔkɔhora kokyikyi kofi berɛ.

english_verse: If her husband hears about a promise and says nothing about it for a whole day, she must do what she said—since he did not object, the promise must be kept.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ohu ne wanga ye nwo hwee wangyire braa ne, ná ɔma aleɛ kye so a, ye de né wale braa ne bɔhyɛ ne amukoraa, anaa ye anohoba bɔ ɔla ye so ne amukoraa wato nu. Wale wato nu, ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ ɔtele dwirɛ ne, wanga ye nwo hwee wangyire braa ne.

english_verse: But if he waits until the next day to stop her from keeping her promise, he is the one who must be punished.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ohu ne te edwirɛ ne, nakoso ɔma aleɛ kye so koraka né wakyikyi wafi berɛ a, ye de ɔkɔsoa braa ne amumuyɛɛ.”

english_verse: These are the laws that the Lord gave Moses about husbands and wives, and about young daughters who still live at home.
translation_verse: Ɛhemɔ ole ahyɛdeɛ mɔ bɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose, bɔ ɔfa biaa ne ɔye nwo, ɔne bɔ ɔfa baba ne ɔwa brasua ababunu bɔ ɔtɛ te ɔse awuro nwo ɔ.

english_verse: “Before you die, make sure that the Midianites are punished for what they did to Israel.”
translation_verse: “Tɔ Midianfoɛ so wereɛ ma Yisraelfoɛ; na ɛhe asi ye, ɛkɔtoa wɔ mbanyi mɔ.”

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “The Lord wants to punish the Midianites. So tell our men to prepare for battle.
translation_verse: Yiti Mose sele Yisrael maen ne kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ mmenia ne bie noa maa bɛhɔ koɛ, ná bɛ ne Midian bɛɛho, ma AWURADE wereɛtɔlɛ ɔ́bra Midian so.

english_verse: Twelve thousand men were picked from the tribes of Israel, and after they were prepared for battle,
translation_verse: Yiti Yisrael mmenia worawora ne, abusua kure biala anu, bɛyele mmenia apee ko; mmenia apee buru ne nyɔ yeɛ bɛboaboale bɛ nwo kyɛ bɛkɔ koɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: Moses sent them off to war. Phinehas the son of Eleazar went with them and took along some things from the sacred tent and the trumpets for sounding the battle signal.
translation_verse: Mose somane bɛ maa bɛhɔle koɛ ne; abusua kure biala anu mmenia apee ko. Né ɔsɔfo Eleasa awa Finehase boka bɛ so. Né ye yeɛ otira nekaa krongron berɛ ndalie nemɔ ɔne totorobɛndo mɔ bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ ese ne ɔ.

english_verse: The Israelites fought against the Midianites, just as the Lord had commanded Moses. They killed all the men,
translation_verse: Bɛfale koɛ bɛtetale Midian, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne, na behuni Midian bienzua biala.

english_verse: including Balaam son of Beor and the five Midianite kings, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba.
translation_verse: Behuhuni Midian ahemvo hemɔ bɛbokale mmenia bɔ behuhuni bɛ ne aso: Ewi, Rekem, Sure, Hure ne Reba. Besa bɛfale ngrandɛ behuni Beɔ awa Balaam.

english_verse: The Israelites captured every woman and child, then led away the Midianites' cattle and sheep, and took everything else that belonged to them.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ hyele Midian mmrasua, bɛ ne bɛ mma mmaa mmaa mɔ nnure. Bɛfale bɛ nandwie amukoraa, bɛ mmoaen amukoraa, ɔne bɛ nningyein amukoraa bɛyɛle koɛ nu nzesadeɛ.

english_verse: They also burned down the Midianite towns and villages.
translation_verse: Bɛyerale bɛ nguro bɔ né bɛtete so amukoraati, ɔne b’asikyeleɛ amukoraati.

english_verse: Israel's soldiers gathered together everything they had taken from the Midianites, including the captives and the animals.
translation_verse: Nakoso koɛ nu nningyein amukoraa ɔne koɛ nu nzesadeɛ amukoraa de, kyɛ mmenia oo, kyɛ ngaka oo, bɛfa bɛhɔle.

english_verse: and said, “I can't believe you let the women live!
translation_verse: Mose bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔama mmrasua hemɔ amu banya bɛ ti badidi nu?

english_verse: You must put to death every boy and all the women who have ever had sex.
translation_verse: Yiti kekesaala ye, ɛ́mɔhu ngwadaa ne anu bienzua biala, ná ɛ́mɔhu brasua biala bɔ ɔne bienzua bala le ɔ.

english_verse: But do not kill the young women who have never had sex. You may keep them for yourselves.”
translation_verse: Nakoso abaayaa biala bɔ ɔne bienzua bɛllale le ne de, ɛ́mɔma onya ye ti odidi nu na ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ.

english_verse: Then Moses said to the soldiers, “If you killed anyone or touched a dead body, you are unclean and have to stay outside the camp for seven days. On the third and seventh days, you must go through a ceremony to make yourselves and your captives clean.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtena asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ ɛlɛsoo. Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔahu sona anaakyɛ ɛmɔ nu biala bɔ ye nwo aha fuin ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔpete ɛmɔ nwo ɔne mmenia bɔ ɛmɔahye bɛ nnure nemɔ anwo ye ɛlɛsa ne aso ɔne ɛlɛsoo ne aso.

english_verse: Eleazar then explained, “If you need to purify something that won't burn, such as gold, silver, bronze, iron, tin, or lead, you must first place it in a hot fire. After you take it out, sprinkle it with the water that purifies. Everything else should only be sprinkled with the water. Do all of this, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
translation_verse: yeɛ nikyee biala bɔ bɛfa see bɛka ye a onhuro ne, ɛ́mɔfa see bɛ́te ye nwo, na ye nwo kofi. Nakoso odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa anwotelɛ nzue koso bɛte ye nwo. Na nikyee biala bɔ bɛfa see bɛka ye a ohuro ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa bewura nzue ne anu.

translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛsoo ne aso, odi kyɛ ɛmɔpo ɛmɔ nwo nningyein, amaa ɛmɔ nwo afi. Ye si ye, ɛmɔkora bɛba asikyeleɛ ne anu.” Koɛ nu nzesadeɛ hyɛlɛ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses:
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: Make a list of everything taken from the Midianites, including the captives and the animals. Then divide them between the soldiers and the rest of the people. Eleazar the priest and the family leaders will help you.
translation_verse: Kyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ ne anu nyɔ: fa bue ko ma koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ bɛhɔle koɛ ne, ná fa bue ko koso ma Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne amukoraa.

english_verse: From the half that belongs to the soldiers, set aside for the Lord one out of every
translation_verse: Ye fi bɛ bue deɛ ne anu ná fa ma ɔsɔfo Eleasa. Ɔte afɔleɛ ma AWURADE.

english_verse: So we want to give the Lord all the gold jewelry we took from the Midianites. It's our gift to him for watching over us and our troops.”
translation_verse: Na bɔ yɛ nu biala nwuni ye ne: sikaa kɔkorɛ mbembenanneɛ, bɛ bati ngaa ne bɛ sa kɔm ngaa, nzɔanoɛ ngaa, asomade ne akomuade, yafa AWURADE afɔleɛ yabrɛ ye, na yafa yapata yama yɛ kra wɔ AWURADE nyunu.”

english_verse: Moses and Eleazar followed the Lord's instructions
translation_verse: Na Mose ne ɔsɔfo Eleasa yɔle kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose ne ala:

translation_verse: Koɛ nu nzesadeɛ bɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ sesale ne, ye ngaa ne somaa te mmoaen apee ɛyaa nzia ne aburasoo ne nnu,

english_verse: and listed everything that had been taken from the Midianites. The list included
translation_verse: ɔne mmenia apee aburasa ne nyɔ, bɔ bɛte mmrasua bɔ bennwuni biaa le ɔ.

english_verse: and said, “Sir, we have counted our troops, and not one soldier is missing.
translation_verse: na beesele ye kyɛ, “Wɔ ngoaa mɔ yaha koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ bewura yɛ bo ne, na yɛ nu biala nne berɛ bɔ wafi nu ɔ.

english_verse: Moses and Eleazar accepted the jewelry from the commanders,
translation_verse: Na sikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ bafa ye mukoraa bayɔ mbembenanneɛ ne, Mose ne ɔsɔfo Eleasa le fili bɛ berɛ.

english_verse: then after the Lord helps Israel capture the land, you can return to your own land. You will no longer have to stay with the others.
translation_verse: ná AWURADE di aseɛ ne aso ngonim a, ye si ye, ɛmɔkɔhora bekosa bɛ si. Sɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, né ɛmɔnni AWURADE ne Yisrael nyunu fɔ, na aseɛ he kɔyɛ ɛmɔ agyapadeɛ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben and Gad owned a lot of cattle and sheep, and they saw that the regions of Jazer and Gilead had good pastureland.
translation_verse: Né Ruben boso ama mɔ ne Gade boso ama mɔ bele nyɛmmoa pee paa. Mmerɛ bɔ Gadefoɛ ne Rubenfoɛ nwuni kyɛ Yasere aseɛ ɔne Gileade aseɛ te paa ma ngaka sielɛ ne,

english_verse: So they went to Moses, Eleazar, and the other leaders of Israel and said,
translation_verse: bɛhɔle Mose, ɔsɔfo Eleasa ne Yisrael mbanyi berɛ beesele bɛ kyɛ,

english_verse: “The Lord has helped us capture the land around the towns of Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon. That's good pastureland, and since we own cattle and sheep,
translation_verse: AWURADE lili sɔ aseɛ nemɔ aso ngonim wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nyunu. Ɔte aseɛ paa ma nyɛmmoa, na wɔ ngoaa koso yɛle nyɛmmoa.”

english_verse: would you let us stay here east of the Jordan River and have this land as our own?”
translation_verse: Bɛtoale so kyɛ, “Sɛ anya alo yɛ de a, ye de maa bɛfa aseɛ ye bɛma wɔ ngoaa ma ɔyɛ yɛ agyapadeɛ. Nnɛmaa yɛpɛ asue Yɔɔdan yɛkɔ ye si.”

english_verse: Moses answered: You mean you'd stay here while the rest of the Israelites go into battle?
translation_verse: Nakoso Mose bisale Gadefoɛ ne Rubenfoɛ kyɛ, “Aso odi kyɛ ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ kɔ koɛ ma ɛmɔ de ɛmɔtena wa?

english_verse: If you did that, it would discourage the others from crossing over into the land the Lord promised them.
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔbu Yisraelfoɛ abasa nu maa ɔnate so bɛngɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan bɛngɔhɔ aseɛ bɔ AWURADE afa ama bɛ ne aso ɔ?

english_verse: This is exactly what happened when I sent your ancestors from Kadesh-Barnea to explore the land.
translation_verse: Nzomane ɛmɔ nana mɔ mvili Kadese Banea kyɛ bɛɛnea aseɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛyɔle ɔ.

english_verse: They went as far as Eshcol Valley, then returned and told the people that we should not enter it.
translation_verse: Beedwuli Ɛseko bɔnza ne anu ná benwuni aseɛ nen, bebuli Yisraelfoɛ abasa nu kyɛ nnɛmaa bɛkɔ aseɛ bɔ AWURADE afa ama bɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Moses said: You promised that you would be ready to fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Mose sele bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɛhemɔ a: sɛ ɛmɔfa akodeɛ ná ɛmɔkɔ koɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu,

english_verse: but he was so angry with the others that he forced them to wander around in the desert for
translation_verse: Na AWURADE fɛle Yisrael so yaa paa, na ɔmaa behyinihyinini ɛserɛ so toonn afoɛ aburanna, kɔpem kyɛ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ bayɔ bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ne, bɛ mukoraa bewuwuli ɔ.

english_verse: So Moses gave the Machirites the region of Gilead, and they settled there.
