translation_verse: Yiti Mose fale Gileade mane Manase awa Makyiri ye bosofoɛ maa bɛtenane berɛ.

english_verse: Now you people of Reuben and Gad are doing the same thing and making the Lord even angrier.
translation_verse: Afei ɛmɔ, bɔnefoɛ boso ama, ɛmɔasi ɛmɔ nana mɔ gya nu, ɛmɔahɔ so bahu AWURADE ahone maa wafɛ Yisrael so yaa piri paa.

english_verse: If you reject the Lord, he will once again abandon his people and leave them here in the desert. And you will be to blame!
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔyakyi ye si lilɛ a, okosa kɔyakyi mmenia hemɔ bɛ nu wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso, na ɛmɔkɔmaa mmenia he amukoraa bɛ boso konua.”

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad replied: Let us build places to keep our sheep and goats, and towns for our wives and children,
translation_verse: Afei bɛwale Mose berɛ beesele ye kyɛ, “Yɛkosisi mmoaennduin wɔ wa yɛkɔma yɛ mmoaen mɔ, na yɛkɔkyekye nguro yɛkɔma yɛ mma mɔ.

english_verse: where they can stay and be safe. Then we'll prepare to fight and lead the other tribes into battle.
translation_verse: Nakoso yɛkɔfa akodeɛ yɛkoli Yisrael ama anyunu yɛkɔɔho, kɔpem kyɛ yɛkɔfa bɛ yɛkodwu b’aseɛ so ɔ. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, ɔnate porɛ ye anu mmenia ne ati, yɛ ngwadaa mɔ kɔtena nguro bɔ yabɔ bɛ nwo waen nemɔ anu.

english_verse: We will stay with them until they have settled in their own tribal lands.
translation_verse: Yɛngosa yɛ si yɛngɔhɔ yɛ awuro kɔpem kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɛ sa kɔha b’agyapadeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The land on this side of the Jordan River will be ours, so we won't expect to receive any on the other side.
translation_verse: Yɛ ne bɛ ngɔhyɛ Yɔɔdan si dɔ aseɛ ne, ofikyɛ yɛ sa aha yɛ agyapadeɛ deɛ wɔ Yɔɔdan ye bue faen bɔ ɔkɔ eyia afiteleɛ dɔ ne.”

english_verse: You also agreed to cross the Jordan and stay with the rest of the Israelites, until the Lord forces our enemies out of the land. If you do these things,
translation_verse: ná ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔtira akodeɛ ne, sɛ ɛmɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan wɔ AWURADE nyunu, kɔpem kyɛ ɔkɔfoa ye pɔfoɛ mɔ kofi ye nyunu,

english_verse: But if you don't keep your promise, you will sin against the Lord and be punished.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔanyɔ sɔ a, ye de ɛmɔayɔ bɔne batia AWURADE, na ɛ́mɔkaye kyɛ ɛmɔ bɔne nwo asohwenɛ kɔwa ɛmɔ so.

english_verse: Go ahead and build towns for your wives and children, and places for your sheep and goats. Just be sure to do what you have promised.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔkyekye nguro bɛ́ma ɛmɔ ngwadaa mɔ, ná ɛ́mɔsisi tuin bɛ́ma ɛmɔ mmoaen mɔ. Nakoso odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɛmɔahyɛ ye nwo bɔ ne.”

english_verse: The men from Reuben and Gad answered: Sir, we will do just what you have said.
translation_verse: Na Gadefoɛ ne Rubenfoɛ ne sele Mose kyɛ, “Wɔ ngoaa kɔyɔ kyɛbɔ me mene ahyɛ ne.

english_verse: Our wives and children and sheep and cattle will stay here in the towns in Gilead.
translation_verse: Yɛ mma mɔ, yɛ ye mɔ, yɛ mmoaen kure mɔ, ɔne yɛ nyɛmmoa amukoraa kɔhɔ so bɛkɔtena Gileade nguro nemɔ anu.

english_verse: But those of us who are prepared for battle will cross the Jordan and fight for the Lord.
translation_verse: Nakoso wɔ ngoaa mɔ, yɛ nu biala aboaboa ye nwo kyɛ ɔkɔhɔ koɛ kɔma AWURADE, na yɛkɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan ne kyɛbɔ me mene ahyɛ ne ala.”

english_verse: “Make sure that the tribes of Gad and Reuben prepare for battle and cross the Jordan River with you. If they do, then after the land is in your control, give them the region of Gilead as their tribal land.
translation_verse: Na Mose sele bɛ kyɛ, “Gadefoɛ ne Rubenfoɛ, bɔ bɛ nu biala waboaboa ye nwo kyɛ ɔkɔ koɛ ma AWURADE ne, sɛ bɛ ne ɛmɔ pɛ asue Yɔɔdan ná ɛmɔkodi aseɛ ne aso ngonim a, ye de ɛ́mɔfa Gileade aseɛ ne bɛ́ma bɛ ma ɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: But if they break their promise, they will receive land on the other side of the Jordan, like the rest of the tribes.”
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ bamva b’akodeɛ bɛ ne ɛmɔ bangɔambɛ asue Yɔɔdan a, ye de odi kyɛ bɛ ne ɛmɔ nya agyapadeɛ wɔ neka horɛ wɔ Kanaan aseɛ so.”

english_verse: The tribes of Gad and Reuben replied, “We are your servants and will do whatever the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Gadefoɛ ne Rubenfoɛ nemɔ buale kyɛ, “Kyɛbɔ AWURADE aha ahyire wɔ ngoaa ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛkɔyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: We will cross the Jordan River, ready to fight for the Lord in Canaan. But the land we will inherit as our own will be on this side of the river.”
translation_verse: Yɛkɔfa yɛ akodeɛ, yɛkɔpɛ asue ne AWURADE nyunu yɛkɔhɔ Kaanan aseɛ so. Nakoso y’aseɛ bɔ yanya ye wɔ asue Yɔɔdan bue faen ne, ɔkɔhɔ so kɔyɛ yɛ deɛ.”

english_verse: So Moses gave the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half of Manasseh the territory and towns that King Sihon the Amorite had ruled, as well as the territory and towns that King Og of Bashan had ruled.
translation_verse: Amorifoɛ hene Sihon ye ahennie ɔne Basan hene Ogo ye ahennie: b’aseɛ ne bɛ nguro, ɔne nguro bɔ wapɛ bɛ nwo wayia nemɔ aseɛ ne, Mose fa mane Gadefoɛ, Rubenfoɛ ɔne Yosef awa Manase abusua kure ne bue.

english_verse: The tribe of Gad rebuilt the towns of Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
translation_verse: Gadefoɛ kyekyele nguro hemɔ bieku: Dibɔn, Atarote, Aroye,

english_verse: Atroth-Shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
translation_verse: Atrote Sofan, Yasere, Yobeha,

english_verse: Beth-Nimrah, and Beth-Haran. They built walls around them and also built places to keep their sheep and goats.
translation_verse: Bete Nimra, ne Bete Haran. Bɛtole nguro nemɔ anwo fasue, yeɛ besisili mmoaen nduin wɔ bɛ nu.

english_verse: The tribe of Reuben rebuilt Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
translation_verse: Rubenfoɛ kyekyele nguro hemɔ bieku: Hesebon, Eleale, Kiriatim,

english_verse: Sibmah, as well as the towns that used to be known as Nebo and Baal-Meon. They renamed all those places.
translation_verse: Nebo, ɔne Baal Meon , ɔne Sibima. Nguro bɔ besa bɛkyekyele nemɔ, bɛtotole bɛ dumaa foforɛ.

english_verse: The clan of Machir from the tribe of East Manasseh went to the region of Gilead, captured its towns, and forced out the Amorites.
translation_verse: Manase awa Makyiri ye bosofoɛ mɔ, bɛhɔle Gileade beelili so ngonim, na bɛfoane Amorifoɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ berɛ ne.

english_verse: Jair from the Manasseh tribe captured villages and renamed them “Villages of Jair.”
translation_verse: Manase awa Yari hɔle oolili bɛ nguraa nemɔ aso ngonim, na osa tole bɛ dumaa Hawote Yari.

english_verse: Nobah captured the town of Kenath with its villages and renamed it Nobah.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Noba hɔle oolili Kenate ne ye nwo nguraa nemɔ so ngonim, na ɔsesane kuro ne dumaa fa tole ye nwo Noba.

english_verse: Moses kept a list of the places they camped, just as the Lord had instructed. Here is the record of their journey:
translation_verse: Mose hyerɛhyerɛle nekaa ahoroɔ bɔ betuli bɛ bo befili ne, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle bɛ ne. Na nekaa ahoroɔ bɔ betuli bɛ bo befili nemɔ ɛhe.

english_verse: Israel left the Egyptian city of Rameses on the fifteenth day of the first month. This was the day after the Lord had punished Egypt's gods by killing the first-born sons in every Egyptian family. So while the Egyptians were burying the bodies, they watched the Israelites proudly leave their country.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Misraimfoɛ begu so besie bɛ bamuɛbaa mɔ amukoraa bɔ AWURADE ahũhũ bɛ wafi bɛ nu ne. Misraimfoɛ nyameɛ nemɔ koso, AWURADE amva bɛ nwo angyɛ bɛ.

english_verse: After the Israelites left Rameses, they camped at Succoth,
translation_verse: Yiti Yisraelfoɛ tuli bɛ bo fili Ramese, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Sukote.

english_verse: and from there, they moved their camp to Etham on the edge of the desert.
translation_verse: Betuli bɛ bo befili Sukote, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Etam, bɔ ɔwɔ ɛserɛ ne anoa dɔ ne.

english_verse: Then they turned back toward Pi-Hahiroth, east of Baal-Zephon, and camped near Migdol.
translation_verse: Betuli bɛ bo befili Etam, na besale bɛ si bɛhɔle Pi Hahirote, bɔ ɔwɔ Baal Sefon ndendeneɛ so ne, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Migidol nyunu.

english_verse: They left Pi-Hahiroth, crossed the Red Sea, then walked three days into the Etham Desert and camped at Marah.
translation_verse: Betuli bɛ bo befili Pi Hahirote, bɛpɛle ɛpo ne bɛhɔle ɛserɛ ne aso, bɛpɛle atee bɔ bɛfa ɛlɛsa yeɛ bɛpɛ ɔ wɔ Etam ɛserɛ ne aso, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Mara.

english_verse: They left Elim and camped near the Red Sea,
translation_verse: Betuli bɛ bo befili Elim, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ ne anoa.

english_verse: then turned east and camped along the western edge of the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: Betuli bɛ bo befili Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ ne anoa, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Sin ɛserɛ ne aso.

english_verse: From there they went to Dophkah, Alush, and Rephidim, where they had no water.
translation_verse: Betuli bɛ bo befili Aluse, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Refidim. Né mmenia ne bennya nzue bɛnno wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: They left Rephidim and finally reached the Sinai Desert.
translation_verse: Betuli bɛ bo befili Refidim, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Sinai ɛserɛ ne aso.

english_verse: When they left Kadesh, they came to Mount Hor, on the border of Edom.
translation_verse: Betuli bɛ bo befili Kadese, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Hore bokaa ne anwo. Ɔwɔ Edom aseɛ ne wɛen so.

english_verse: That's where the Lord commanded Aaron the priest to go to the top of the mountain. Aaron died there on the first day of the fifth month,
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so ne, ye afoɛ aburanna ne anu, kyẽa bɔ oli moa wɔ bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu ne anu ne, ɔsɔfo Aarɔn fo hɔle Hore bokaa ne aso kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye ne, na oowuli wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: It was then that the Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Southern Desert of Canaan, heard that Israel was headed that way.
translation_verse: Na Arade hene, bɔ ɔte Kanaanniɛ bɔ né ɔte Kanaan aseɛ ne ye ngwaen dɔ ne, ɔtele Yisraelfoɛ nga kyɛ bɛba.

english_verse: The Israelites left Mount Hor and headed toward Moab. Along the way, they camped at Zalmonah, Punon, Oboth, Iye-Abarim in the territory of Moab, Dibon-Gad, Almon-Diblathaim, at a place near Mount Nebo in the Abarim Mountains,
translation_verse: Betuli bɛ bo befili Almɔn Diblatayim, na bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Abarim mmokaa nemɔ anu, wɔ Nebo ndendeneɛ so.

english_verse: Their camp stretched from Beth-Jeshimoth to Acacia. The Lord's Command To Conquer Canaan
translation_verse: Bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Yɔɔdan noa, fi Bete Yesimote alaa beedwuli Abel Sitim wɔ Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso. Kanaan aseɛ ne aso ngonimlilɛ

english_verse: While Israel was camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho, the Lord told Moses
translation_verse: Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan bue nu dɔ bɔ opingye Yeriko ne, berɛ yeɛ AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to give the people of Israel this message: When you cross the Jordan River and enter Canaan,
translation_verse: “Kã kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Sɛ ɛmɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan bɛkɔ Kanaan aseɛ ne aso a,

english_verse: you must force out the people living there. Destroy their idols and tear down their altars.
translation_verse: ye de ɛ́mɔfoa aseɛ ne aso ama mukoraa béfi ɛmɔ nyunu. Bɛ mmosoen bɔ bafa nyɔboɛ base ɔne b’amoen mɔ bɔ bahuro nikyee bafa bayɔ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔsɛkye bɛ. Ɛ́mɔbubu b’asɔneyɛɛ amukoraa bégua,

english_verse: Then settle in the land—I have given it to you as your own.
translation_verse: ná ɛ́mɔfa aseɛ ne bɛtena so, ofikyɛ mafa aseɛ ne mama ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔfa.

english_verse: I will show you how to divide the land among the tribes, according to the number of clans in each one, so that the larger tribes will have more land than the smaller ones.
translation_verse: Na ɛ́mɔfa serewagualɛ so bɛ́hyɛ aseɛ ne kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ mmusua mmusua nemɔ bɛ mbiri si te ɔ. Abusua bɔ ɔte piri ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔma bɛ aseɛ piri, yeɛ bɔ ɔte kãa ne koso ɛ́mɔma bɛ aseɛ ne kaaba. Nekaa bɔ serewagualɛ ne kɔye kɔma ebiala ne, ma berɛ ɔyɛ ye deɛ. Ebiala konya ye agyapadeɛ wɔ ye nana mɔ abusua kure deɛ nu.

english_verse: If you don't force out all the people there, they will be like splinters in your eyes and thorns in your back. They will always be trouble for you,
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔamvoa aseɛ ne aso ama bamvi ɛmɔ nyunu a, ye de bɛ bɔ ɛmɔkɔmaa bɛkɔha aseɛ ne aso ne, bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ mmakaa bɛkɔwowɔ ɛmɔ nye, bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ mmowue bɛkɔwowɔ ɛmɔ mvenu, na bɛkɔha ɛmɔ adwene wɔ aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔkwaatena so ne aso.

english_verse: and I will treat you as severely as I planned on treating them.
translation_verse: Na nikyee bɔ nyɛle m’adwene kyɛ ngɔfa ngɔyɔ bɛ ne, ɛmɔ yeɛ ngɔfa ngɔyɔ ɛmɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord told Moses
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel that their land in Canaan would have the following borders:
translation_verse: “Fa ahyɛdeɛ he ma Yisraelfoɛ ná ka kyire bɛ kyɛ, Sɛ ɛmɔkodwu Kanaan aseɛ ne aso a ,

english_verse: The southern border will be the Zin Desert and the northwest part of Edom. This border will begin at the south end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: ɛmɔ aseɛ ne, ye ngwaen dɔ wɛen ne, ɔkɔtrɛ kofi Sen ɛserɛ so ná ɔne Edom babɔ wɛen. Ɛmɔ ngwaen dɔ wɛen ne, ɔkɔtrɛ kofi Ngyee Ɛpo ne anoa wɔ eyia afiteleɛ.

english_verse: It will go west from there, but will turn southward to include Scorpion Pass, the village of Zin, and the town of Kadesh-Barnea. From there, the border will continue to Hazar-Addar and on to Azmon.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ wɛen ne kɔkondo kɔfa Akrabim pambaa ne ngwaen, ná wapɛ nu wahɔ Sen, na ye noa kɔɔpem Kadese Banea ngwaen. Ɔkɔtoa so kɔhɔ Hasa Ada, na wapɛ nu waadwu Asimɔn.

english_verse: It will run along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Ɛwɛen ne kɔtrɛ kofi Asimɔn koodwu Misraim bɔnza ne anu, na ye noa kɔɔpem ɛpo ne.

english_verse: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean, then continue eastward to Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ ɛmɔ sorɔ dɔ wɛen ɔ: ɛ́mɔto wɛen ne béfi Ɛpo Piri ne beedwu Hore bokaa ne.

english_verse: After that, it will run to Lebo-Hamath and across to Zedad, which is the northern edge of your land.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔto wɛen ne befi Hore bokaa ne maa oodwu Lebo Hamate, ná ye noa ɔɔpem Sedade.

english_verse: From Zedad, the border will continue east to Ziphron and end at Hazar-Enan.
translation_verse: Afei ɛwɛen ne kɔtrɛ koodwu Sifron, na ye noa kɔɔpem Hasa Enan; berɛ yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ ɛmɔ sorɔ dɔ wɛen ɔ.

english_verse: The eastern border will begin at Hazar-Enan in the north, then run south to Shepham,
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔto ɛmɔ eyia afiteleɛ ɛwɛen ne befi Hasa Enan beedwu Sefam;

english_verse: and on down to Riblah on the east side of Ain. From there, it will go south to the eastern hills of Lake Galilee,
translation_verse: na ɛwɛen ne kɔtorotoro kofi Sefam koodwu Ribla bɔ ɔwɔ Ayin eyia afiteleɛ ne. Ɛwɛen ne kɔtorotoro koodwu Kinerete Ɛpo eyia afiteleɛ ndoroleɛ nu.

english_verse: then follow the Jordan River down to the north end of the Dead Sea. The land within those four borders will belong to you.
translation_verse: Ɛwɛen ne kɔtorotoro kɔhɔ Asue Yɔɔdan noa, na ye noa kɔɔpem Ngyee Ɛpo ne. Ɛmɔ aseɛ ne, ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ ye noa wɛen mɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: Then Moses told the people, “You will receive the land inside these borders. It will be yours, but the Lord has commanded you to divide it among the nine and a half tribes.
translation_verse: Na Mose fale ahyɛdeɛ he mane Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Aseɛ he yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa serewagualɛ so bɛkyɛ ɔ. AWURADE ahyɛ kyɛ bɛ́fa bɛ́ma mmusua kure ngona ne bue ne.

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh have already been given their land
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Rubenfoɛ abusua kure bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ, bɛ ne Gadefoɛ abusua kure bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ, yeɛ Manase abusua kure ne bue de, bale b’aseɛ deɛ.

english_verse: across from Jericho, east of the Jordan River.” The Leaders Who Will Divide the Land
translation_verse: Sɔ mmusua kure nyɔ ne bue ne, bale b’aseɛ deɛ wɔ Yɔɔdan bɔ opingye Yeriko ne, ye si dɔ, wɔ eyia afiteleɛ. Mbanyi bɔ bɛkɔhyɛ aseɛ ne ɔ

english_verse: The Lord said to Moses,
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: “Eleazar the priest and Joshua son of Nun will divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: “Mmenia bɔ bɛkɔhyɛ aseɛ ne bɛkɔma ɛmɔ maa ɔkɔyɛ ɛmɔ agyapadeɛ ne, bɛ dumaa ɛhe: Ɔsɔfo Eleasa ne Nun awa Yosua.

english_verse: These are the men the Lord commanded to help Eleazar and Joshua divide the land for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Mmenia hemɔ yeɛ AWURADE fa wurale bɛ sa kyɛ bɛhyɛ aseɛ ne bɛma Yisraelfoɛ maa ɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ wɔ Kanaan aseɛ so ne.”

english_verse: That way, the Levites will have towns to live in and pastures for their animals.
translation_verse: Nguro nemɔ kɔyɛ b’atenaleɛ, na nguro nemɔ nwo aseɛ ne, so yeɛ bɛ nandwie mɔ, bɛ nyɛmmoa ne bɛ ngaka amukoraa bekodidi ɔ.

english_verse: The pasture around each of these towns must be in the shape of a square, with the town itself in the center. The pasture is to measure
translation_verse: Kuro ne asi dɔ ne, ɛmɔsusu agyirɛ apee nyɔ wɔ eyia afiteleɛ, apee nyɔ wɔ ngwaen, apee nyɔ wɔ eyia atɔleɛ, yeɛ apee nyɔ wɔ sorɔ, maa kuro ne ɔla afia. Sɔ aseɛ ne kɔyɛ bɛ deɛ, na ɔkɔyɛ bɛ nguro nemɔ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa kodidi so ɔ.

english_verse: Six of the towns you give them will be Safe Towns where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection. But you will also give the Levites
translation_verse: Nguro bɔ ɛmɔkɔfa bɛkɔma Lewifoɛ ne, mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ nguro nzia nemɔ, bɔ ɛmɔkɔma sona bɔ wali awue ate maa ɔkɔɔbɔ ye nwo adwaa wɔ nu ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛboka so. Ɛ́mɔfa nguro aburanna ne nyɔ bɛ́boka so bɛma bɛ.

english_verse: by one of the victim's relatives. He will take revengefor his relative's death as soon as he finds you.
translation_verse: Wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne yeɛ odi kyɛ oku kodiawuniɛ ne ɔ. Sɛ wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne nwu kodiawuniɛ ne a, odi kyɛ oku ye.

english_verse: There are to be six of these Safe Towns,
translation_verse: Nguro bɔ ɛmɔkɔye bekosie berɛ ne, bɛkɔyɛ mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ nguro nzia kɔma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord then told Moses
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: to tell the people of Israel: After you have crossed the Jordan River and are settled in Canaan,
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, Sɛ ɛmɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan bɛkɔ Kaanan aseɛ ne aso a,

english_verse: choose Safe Towns, where a person who has accidentally killed someone can run for protection.
translation_verse: odi kyɛ ɛmɔye nguro nemɔ bie besie berɛ maa bɛyɛ mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ nguro bɛma ɛmɔ, amaa sona biala bɔ ɔmmoapa ná okoli awue ne, wanwati wahɔ berɛ.

english_verse: If the victim's relatives think it was murder, they might try to take revenge. Anyone accused of murder can run to one of these Safe Towns for protection and not be killed before a trial is held.
translation_verse: Sɔ nguro nemɔ, ɛmɔkɔfa bɛkɔbɔ ɛmɔ nwo waen bekofi wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne sa nu. Ɛhe kɔmaa bengohu sona bɔ wali awue ne wɔ aberɛ bɔ bennya bellili ye dwirɛ wɔ badwa nu ɔ.

english_verse: They will be places of protection for anyone who lives in Israel and accidentally kills someone. Laws about Murder and Accidental Killing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Sɔ nguro nzia nemɔ kɔyɛ mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ nguro kɔma Yisraelfoɛ, ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ wanya amandena, ɔne ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ ɔngɔhyɛ Yisrael maen nu ɔ, amaa sona biala bɔ ɔmmoapa ná okoli awue ne, wanwati wahɔ berɛ. Awuelilɛ ne ye nwo wereɛtɔlɛ

english_verse: Suppose you hit someone with a piece of iron or a large stone or a dangerous wooden tool. If that person dies, then you are a murderer and must be put to death
translation_verse: Anaakyɛ, ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa bakaa bɔ ɔte akodeɛ kɔbɔ obiɛngo maa okowu ne, ɔte kodiawuniɛ, na odi kyɛ beku ye bie.

english_verse: Or suppose you get angry and kill someone by pushing or hitting or by throwing something. You are a murderer and must be put to death by one of the victim's relatives.
translation_verse: anaa sɛ ebie pɔ obiɛngo, ná ɔtwe ye sa bɔ ye maa owu a, ye de sɔ sona bɔ ɔtole twɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ beku ye; ɔte kodiawuniɛ. Sɛ wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne nwu kodiawuniɛ ne a, odi kyɛ oku ye.

english_verse: But if you are not angry and accidentally kill someone in any of these ways, the townspeople must hold a trial and decide if you are guilty.
translation_verse: ye de maen ne kogyina nhyehyɛleɛ hemɔ aso koli sona bɔ wali awue ne ɔne wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne b’afia dwirɛ.

english_verse: If they decide that you are innocent, you will be protected from the victim's relative and sent to stay in one of the Safe Towns until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: Na maen ne kole sona bɔ wali awue ne kofi wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne sa nu. Afei maen ne kɔfa sona bɔ wali awue ne kɔhɔ mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ kuro bɔ ɔnwati hɔle nu ne aso. Sona bɔ wali awue ne kɔtena kuro ne aso kɔpem kyɛ ɔsɔfo panyi bɔ bapopa ye ngoo krongron ne okowu ɔ.

english_verse: and are killed by the victim's relative, he cannot be punished for killing you.
translation_verse: ná sɛ wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne nwu ye wɔ mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ kuro ne asi, ná wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne ku ye a, ye de onni ye mogya nwo fɔ.

english_verse: Death is the penalty for murder. But no one accused of murder can be put to death unless there are at least two witnesses to the crime.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ebie ku obiɛngo a, odi kyɛ begyina adanzefoɛ noa dwirɛ so beku kodiawuniɛ ne bie; nakoso onni kyɛ begyina adanzeniɛ komapɛ noa dwirɛ so beku ebiala.

english_verse: You cannot give someone money to escape the death penalty; you must pay with your own life!
translation_verse: Afei koso, kodiawuniɛ bɔ ɔfata ewue ne, onni kyɛ ɛmɔde mbata bɛfa bɛsesã ye ngoa; odi kyɛ beku kodiawuniɛ.

english_verse: And if you have been proven innocent of murder and are living in a Safe Town, you cannot pay to go back home; you must stay there until the high priest dies.
translation_verse: Yeɛ sona bɔ wanwati wahɔ mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ kuro bie aso ne, onni kyɛ ɛmɔde mbata befi ye berɛ maa onya ate osa batena maen ne anu koraka né ɔsɔfo panyi ne awu.

english_verse: One day the family leaders from the Gilead clan of the Manasseh tribe went to Moses and the other family leaders of Israel
translation_verse: Manase awa Makyiri ɔwa Gileade boso ama mɔ befi Yosef abusua nu. Bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ mbanyi bɛɛfale bɛ dwirɛ bɛtole Mose ne Yisrael mbanyi, ɔne Yisraelfoɛ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ mbanyi nyunu.

english_verse: and said, “Sir, the Lord has said that he will show what land each tribe will receive as their own. And the Lord has commanded you to give the daughters of our relative Zelophehad the land that he would have received.
translation_verse: Bɛhane kyɛ, “AWURADE hyɛle me mene kyɛ ɔfa serewagualɛ so ɔhyɛ aseɛ ne ma Yisraelfoɛ; na AWURADE hyɛle me mene kyɛ ɔfa y’eliɛma Selofehade agyapadeɛ ɔma ye mma mmrasua mɔ.

english_verse: But if they marry men from other tribes of Israel, the land they receive will become part of that tribe's inheritance and will no longer belong to us.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ begya biaa wɔ Yisrael abusua kure foforɛ nu a, ye de bekole b’aseɛ deɛ bekofi yɛ nana mɔ aseɛ deɛ nu, ná bafa baaboka abusua kure bɔ bahɔ nu agyaa ne b’aseɛ deɛ so. Sɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, yɛ aseɛ deɛ ne, so kɔte.

english_verse: Even when land is returned to its original owner in the Year of Celebration, we will not get back Zelophehad's land—it will belong to the tribe into which his daughters married.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ Yisraelfoɛ Yubilee afoɛ ne so a, ye de odi kyɛ bɛfa b’aseɛ deɛ bɛboka abusua kure bɔ bahɔ nu agyaa ne bɛ deɛ so; na bekole b’aseɛ deɛ bekofi yɛ nana mɔ abusua kure aseɛ deɛ nu.”

english_verse: So Moses told the people that the Lord had said: These men from the Manasseh tribe are right.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Mose gyinane AWURADE dwirɛ so fale sɔ ahyɛdeɛ he mane Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, “Edwirɛ bɔ Yosef boso ama nemɔ baha ne, ɔte nahorɛ.

english_verse: I will allow Zelophehad's daughters to marry anyone, as long as those men belong to one of the clans of the Manasseh tribe.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE ka fa Selofehade mma mmrasua nemɔ nwo ɛhe: Bɛkɔhora bekogya biaa biala bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bekuro ɔ; na mmom abusua bɔ ɔwɔ bɛ nana mɔ abusua kure ne anu yeɛ odi kyɛ begya nu biaa ɔ;

english_verse: Tribal land must not be given to another tribe—it will remain the property of the tribe that received it.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so bamva Yisraelfoɛ abusua kure biala aseɛ bamma abusua kure foforɛ; ofikyɛ Yisraelfoɛ bɛ nana mɔ abusua kure aseɛ ne, odi kyɛ bɛ nu biala maa ɔka abusua kure ne anu.

english_verse: In the future, any daughter who inherits land must marry someone from her own tribe. Israel's tribal land is never to be passed from one tribe to another.
translation_verse: Onni kyɛ bɛfa abusua kure biala aseɛ bɛma abusua kure foforɛ; ofikyɛ Yisraelfoɛ abusua kure biala b’aseɛ ne, odi kyɛ bɛmaa ɔka abusua kure ne anu.”

english_verse: Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah the daughters of Zelophehad obeyed the Lord and married their uncles' sons
translation_verse: Mahela, Tisa, Hogela, Milka ɔne Nowa bɔ yeɛ bɛte Selofehade mma mmrasua ne begyigyale bɛ baba aliɛma mmienzua mɔ bɛ mma mmienzua ne bie.

english_verse: and remained part of the Manasseh tribe. So their land stayed in their father's clan.
translation_verse: Yosef awa Manase abusua kure ne, nu mmusua nemɔ anu mmienzua yeɛ begyigyale bɛ ɔ. Na b’aseɛ hale bɛ baba abusua nu wɔ abusua kure ne anu.

english_verse: These are the laws that the Lord gave to Moses and the Israelites while they were camped in the lowlands of Moab across the Jordan River from Jericho.
translation_verse: Ɛhemɔ ole mmeraa dwirɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ AWURADE nate Mose so fa mane Yisraelfoɛ ɔ. Ɔfa mane bɛ wɔ Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan bue nu dɔ bɔ opingye Yeriko ne.

english_verse: Now, turn around and go back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛ́mɔsa ɛmɔ si bɛɛfa ɛserɛ ne aso, wɔ Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ atee ne aso dɔ.’

english_verse: People of Israel, when we were in our camp at Mount Sinai, the Lord our God told us: You have stayed here long enough.
translation_verse: “AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ha hyirele yɛ wɔ Horebo kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔatena bokaa he anwo wa bahyɛ.

english_verse: Leave this place and go into the land that belongs to the Amorites and their neighbors the Canaanites. This land includes the Jordan River valley, the hill country, the western foothills, the Southern Desert, the Mediterranean seacoast, the Lebanon Mountains, and all the territory as far as the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtu ɛmɔ bo bɛ́toa ɛmɔ ateetulɛ ne aso, ná ɛmɔhɔ Amorifoɛ mmokaa aseɛ ne aso dɔ, ɔne mbɔtam berɛ mɔ: mekyire Araba ne anu, mmokaa aseɛ ne aso, ɔne kongonyi nemɔ anu, ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne aso, mboanoa, Kanaanfoɛ aseɛ so ne Lebanon alaa bɔ ɔkwaadwu asue piri Yufreti noa ne.

english_verse: I give you this land, just as I promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Now you must go and take the land. Leaders Were Appointed (Exodus
translation_verse: Tie! Aseɛ bɔ maye masie berɛ mama ɛmɔ ne yeɛ ɔla ɛmɔ nyunu dɔ ne. Yiti ɛmɔhɔ bɛɛfa aseɛ bɔ me bɔbɔ AWURADE ndale ndaen ngyirele ɛmɔ nana mɔ Abraham, Yisake ne Yakob kyɛ ngɔfa ngɔma bɛ ne bɛ bosofoɛ bɔ bɛkɔwa nziɛ ye ne.’ Mose ye maenbulɛfoɛ (Ɛksadɔso

english_verse: After I gave these instructions to the judges, I taught you the Lord's commands. Men Were Sent To Explore the Hill Country (Numbers
translation_verse: Na nikyee biala bɔ né ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ye sɔ mmerɛ nen, nhyɛle ye nwo mmeraa mane ɛmɔ. Bɛsoma maentetɛlɛfoɛ (Numeri

english_verse: You stayed in your tents and grumbled, “The Lord must hate us—he brought us out of Egypt, just so he could hand us over to the Amorites and get rid of us.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔyɛle nwuhunwuhu wɔ ɛmɔ tena sua nemɔ anu kyɛ, “Ɛpɔlɛ bɔ AWURADE pɔ yɛ ne ati yeɛ ɔmaa ɔɔyele yɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so ɔ, kyɛ ɔbaafa yɛ wura Amorifoɛ sa maa bekuku yɛ.

english_verse: Right after the Lord commanded us to leave Mount Sinai, I told you: Israel, being your leader is too big a job for one person.
translation_verse: “Sɔ mmerɛ ne, nga ngyirele ɛmɔ kyɛ, ‘Me ngome twe de, mengɔhora ɛmɔ so nea.

english_verse: God has even promised to bless us a thousand times more, and I pray that he will.
translation_verse: Mesrɛ kyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔ́ma ɛmɔ boso trɛ mmɔhoɛ apee apee, ná óyira ɛmɔ, kyɛbɔ wahyɛ ɛmɔ bɔ ne!

english_verse: But I cannot take care of all your problems and settle all your arguments alone.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né me ngome mahora manea ɛmɔ so, ná masa masiesie ɛmɔ afia dwirɛ?

english_verse: Then I took these men, who were already wise and respected leaders, and I appointed them as your official leaders. Some of them became military officers in charge of groups of
translation_verse: Yiti mvale ɛmɔ mmusua kure nemɔ anu atitirefoɛ nworɛfoɛ bɔ mmenia bu bɛ ɔ, na mmɔle bɛ panyi wɔ ɛmɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ nu mmenia apee apee, ɛyaa ɛyaa, aburannu aburannu ne buru buru so, na mmane ebiemɔ koso lelale ɛmɔ mmusua ne amukoraati noa.

english_verse: and others became judges. I gave these judges the following instructions: When you settle legal cases, your decisions must be fair. It doesn't matter if the case is between two Israelites, or between an Israelite and a foreigner living in your community.
translation_verse: Na sɔ mmerɛ ne, nhyɛle ɛmɔ ndɛenbualɛfoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔtie edwirɛ bɔ ɔkɔwa ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ afia ɔ, ná ɛmɔbua ndɛen turoloo, ɔmva ye nwo kyɛ sona ne te ɛmɔ aliɛma Yisraelniɛ, anaakyɛ ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ waatena ɛmɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: And it doesn't matter if one is helpless and the other is powerful. Don't be afraid of anyone! No matter who shows up in your court, God will help you make a fair decision. If any case is too hard for you, bring the people to me, and I will make the decision.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔbua ndɛengyea, na mmom ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ bétie kwahweabaa mɔ dwirɛ kyɛbɔ ɛmɔtie atitirefoɛ ne ala. Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro sona nyunu, ofikyɛ ndɛenbualɛ ne te Nyameɛ deɛ. Na edwirɛ biala bɔ ɔbo ɛmɔ so ne, ɛ́mɔfa bɛbra me gya so, na ngoli.’

english_verse: even though he had always been with us in the desert. During the daytime, the Lord was in the cloud, leading us in the right direction and showing us where to camp. And at night, he was there in the fire.
translation_verse: Ye bɔ olili ɛmɔ nyunu wɔ atunu penane nekaa bɔ ɛmɔsi ɛmɔ asikyeleɛ ɔ, wɔ see nu kɔngɔen fa hyirele ɛmɔ atee bɔ ɛmɔfa so ɔ, ɔne munungum nu koso eyia. AWURADE fɛ Yisraelfoɛ so yaa (Numeri

english_verse: The Lord had commanded us to leave Mount Sinai and go to the hill country that belonged to the Amorites, so we started out into the huge desert. You remember how frightening it was, but soon we were at Kadesh-Barnea,
translation_verse: Na yɛtuli yɛ bo yɛfili Horebo yɛɛfale sɔ ɛserɛ pirikua suronyisuronyi bɔ ɛmɔnwuni ye ne amukoraa aso, wɔ atee bɔ ɔkɔ Amorifoɛ mmokaa aseɛ ne aso ne, kyɛbɔ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ hyɛle yɛ nen, kɔpem kyɛ yɛɛdwuli Kadese Banea ɔ.

english_verse: and I told you, “We have reached the hill country. It belongs to the Amorites now, but the Lord our God is giving it to us. He is the same God our ancestors worshiped, and he has told us to go in and take this land, so don't hesitate and be afraid.”
translation_verse: Tie, AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ afa aseɛ ne wama wɔ. Kɔ ná kɔfa tena so, kyɛbɔ AWURADE wɔ nana mɔ Nyameɛ wahyɛ wɔ bɔ ne. Nnɛsuro, yeɛ nnɛma wɔ kunu tete wɔ.

english_verse: Then all of you came to me and said, “Before we go into the land, let's send some men to explore it. When they come back, they can tell us about the towns we will find and what roads we should take to get there.”
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛwale me berɛ beesele kyɛ, ‘Maa yɛsoma mmenia ma beli moa bɛɛneanea aseɛ ne aso besie bɛma yɛ, ná bɛɛfa atee bɔ yɛkɔfa yɛkɔhɔ so, ɔne nguro bɔ yɛkɔhɔ so nemɔ nwo amaneɛ bɛbɔ yɛ.’

english_verse: It seemed like a good idea, so I chose twelve men, one from each tribe.
translation_verse: Sɔ nzusuleɛ ne yɛle me fɛ, yiti nyeyele ɛmɔ anu mmenia buru ne nyɔ, abusua kure biala nu sona ko.

english_verse: and even brought back some of the fruit. They said, “The Lord our God is giving us good land.” Israel Refused To Obey the Lord (Numbers
translation_verse: Bɛtetele aseɛ ne aso mmakaammaa ne bie, na bɛfa bɛbrɛle yɛ. Bɛfale berɛ amaneɛ bɛɛbɔle yɛ kyɛ, ‘Aseɛ bɔ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma yɛ ne, ɔte aseɛ paa.’

english_verse: You did not want to go into the land, and you refused to obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nakoso né ɛmɔnguro kyɛ ɛmɔkɔfo bɛkɔhɔ so ɔ, na mmom ɛmɔhwi bɛfale AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ye mmeraa dwirɛ so.

english_verse: We are afraid, because the men who explored the land told us that the cities are large, with walls that reach to the sky. The people who live there are taller and stronger than we are, and some of them are Anakim. We have nowhere to go.”
translation_verse: Nisua paa yeɛ yɛkɔ ye? Y’eliɛma mɔ amaneɛ bɔ bɛɛbɔle ne ama y’ahone atu. Bɛnwa: ‘Mmenia nemɔ mbiri ne bɛ ndendenn tra yɛ; nguro nemɔ te mbiri, na bale bɛ nwo waen bahɔ anwuro anwuro paa. Yɛnwuni Anake ye bosofoɛ po wɔ berɛ!’ ”

english_verse: The Lord our God will lead the way. He will fight on our side, just as he did when we saw him do all those things to the Egyptians.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ bɔ oli ɛmɔ nyunu ne, ye bɔbɔ ɔkɔho kɔma ɛmɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔho mane ɛmɔ wɔ Misraim bɔ ɛmɔ nye tua ne.

english_verse: And you know that the Lord has taken care of us the whole time we've been in the desert, just as you might carry one of your children.”
translation_verse: Ɛserɛ ne aso koso ɛmɔnwuni kyɛbɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ dodole ɛmɔ, kyɛbɔ sona dodo ɔwa ɔ, wɔ atee biala bɔ ɛmɔfale so kɔpem kyɛ ɛmɔɔdwuli wa ɔ.

english_verse: But you still would not trust the Lord,
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛhemɔ amukoraa asi ne po, ɛmɔnne AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ benni.

english_verse: You had made the Lord angry, and he said:
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE tele ɛmɔ somoɛbɔlɛ nen, ye ahone huli, na ɔtale ndaen kyɛ,

english_verse: You people of this generation are evil, and I refuse to let you go into the good land that I promised your ancestors.
translation_verse: ‘Sɔ bɔne aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ he, nu sona ko po ngonwu aseɛ paa bɔ ndale ndaen kyɛ ngɔfa ngɔma ɛmɔ nana mɔ ne,

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh is the only one of your generation that I will allow to go in. He obeyed me completely, so I will give him and his descendants the land he explored.
translation_verse: sana Yefune awa Kalebo ngome. Ye yeɛ okonwu ye ɔ, na ɔne ye bosofoɛ yeɛ ngɔfa aseɛ bɔ ye gya atia so ne ngɔma bɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ wanya gyidie wɔ AWURADE nu.’

english_verse: The Lord was even angry with me because of you people, and he said, “Moses, I won't let you go into the land either.
translation_verse: Ɔnate ɛmɔ ti, me koso AWURADE ahone huli me so, na osele kyɛ, ‘Wɔ koso, wɔ gya baa ngotia berɛ.

english_verse: Instead, I will let Joshua your assistant lead Israel to conquer the land. So encourage him.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Nun awa Yosua bɔ ɔte wɔ bokafoɛ ne de, ɔkɔhɔ berɛ. Hyɛ ye nguraen, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ okoli Yisrael nyunu maa ye sa kɔha aseɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord spoke to you again: People of Israel, you said that your innocent young children would be taken prisoner in the battle for the land. But someday I will let them go into the land, and with my help they will conquer it and live there.
translation_verse: Afei koso, ɛmɔ mma ndɔtɔfee nemɔ bɔ ɛmɔdwenene kyɛ bɛkɔhye bɛ nnure ne, ɔne ɛmɔ mma mɔ bɔ kekesaala ye bɛnze paa anaa bɔne ne, bɛ yeɛ bɛkɔhɔ aseɛ ne aso ɔ. Bɛ yeɛ ngɔfa ngɔma bɛ ɔ, na bɛkɔfa kɔyɛ bɛ deɛ.

english_verse: Then you told me, “We disobeyed the Lord our God, but now we want to obey him. We will go into the hill country and fight, just as he told us to do.” So you picked up your weapons, thinking it would be easy to take over the hill country.
translation_verse: “Na ɛmɔbuale me kyɛ, ‘Yayɔ bɔne yatia AWURADE. Yɛ bɔbɔ yɛkɔfo yɛkɔɔho, kyɛbɔ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ hyɛle yɛ ne.’ Yiti ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔfale ɛmɔ akodeɛ besini, na ɛmɔsusuli kyɛ mmokaa aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔfo bɛkɔɔfa ne, ɛmɔkɔfa ye fo.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Moses, warn them not to go into the hill country. I won't help them fight, and their enemies will defeat them.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, ‘Ka kyire bɛ kyɛ, Nnɛma ɛmɔfo bɛkɔ aseɛ ne aso bɛkɔko, ofikyɛ me de, mmmoka ɛmɔ so. Sɛ ɛmɔkɔ a, ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ koli ɛmɔ so ngonim.’

english_verse: I told you what the Lord had said, but you paid no attention. You disobeyed him and went into the hill country anyway. You thought you were so great!
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ nga ngyirele ɛmɔ de, nakoso ɛmɔandie, na ɛmɔhwi bɛfale AWURADE noa dwirɛ so. Ɛmɔlili bɛ ti piri, na ɛmɔfo bɛhɔle mmokaa aseɛ ne aso dɔ.

english_verse: But when the Amorites in the hill country attacked from their towns, you ran from them as you would run from a swarm of bees. The Amorites chased your troops into Seir as far as Hormah, killing them as they went.
translation_verse: Na Amorifoɛ bɔ bɛte sɔ mmokaa aseɛ ne aso nen, bɛwale ɛmɔ so, na bɛfoane ɛmɔ kyɛbɔ ɛwommaa foa mmenia ɔ, na bɛbole ɛmɔ wɔ Sɛre toonn beedwuli Hɔma.

english_verse: After we had been in Kadesh for a few months, we obeyed the Lord and headed back into the desert by way of Red Sea Road.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, ngyẽa pee bɔ ɛmɔlili ye berɛ nen, Kadese yeɛ ɛmɔtenane ɔ.

english_verse: until the Lord said: Moses,
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE sele me kyɛ,

english_verse: Israel has wandered in these hills long enough. Turn and go north.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔahyinihyini sɔ mmokaa aseɛ he anwo bahyɛ, yiti ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ nye behyire ye sorɔ dɔ.

english_verse: And give the people these orders: “Be very careful, because you will soon go through the land that belongs to your relatives, the descendants of Esau. They are afraid of you,
translation_verse: Ná se maen ne kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ Yisɔ bosofoɛ bɔ bɛte Sɛre ne, waha kãa né ɛmɔkwaapɛ nu wɔ b’aseɛ so. Bekosuro ɛmɔ, yiti ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé,

english_verse: but don't start a war with them. I have given them the hill country of Seir, so I won't give any of it to you, not even enough to set a foot on.
translation_verse: ná ɛmɔ ne bɛ annya ngondii, ofikyɛ mengɔfa b’aseɛ ne agyirɛ ko po mengɔma ɛmɔ, ɔnate kyɛ mafa Sɛre mmokaa aseɛ ne mama Yisɔ kyɛ ɔ́fa.

english_verse: And as you go through their land, you will have to buy food and water from them.”
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkɔfa sikaa bɛkɔtɔ aleɛ bɔ ɛmɔkoli ɔ bekofi bɛ berɛ; na nzue bɔ ɛmɔkɔno ɔ koso, ɛmɔkɔfa sikaa bɛkɔtɔ bekofi bɛ berɛ.

english_verse: We went past the territory that belonged to our relatives, the descendants of Esau. We followed Arabah Road that starts in the south at Elath and Ezion-Geber, then we turned onto the desert road that leads to Moab.
translation_verse: Yiti y’eliɛma mɔ Yisɔ bosofoɛ bɔ bɛte Sɛre ne, yɛɛpɛle nu bɛ berɛ. Yamva Araba atee bɔ ɔkɔ Elate ne Esion Gebɛre ne aso, na mmom yɛfale yɛ nye yɛhyirele Moabo ɛserɛ atee ne aso.

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Don't try to start a war with Moab. Leave them alone, because I gave the land of Ar to them, and I will not let you have any of it.” Tribes That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, ‘Nnɛha Moabo, yeɛ nnɛfa koɛ kɔtoa ye, ofikyɛ mengɔfa ye aseɛ ne kaala po mengɔma wɔ kyɛ ɛfa, ɔnate kyɛ mafa Are mama Lɔto bosofoɛ kyɛ bɛfa.’

english_verse: Before the Lord gave the Moabites their land, a large and powerful tribe lived there. They were the Emim, and they were as tall as the Anakim.
translation_verse: (Né berɛ yeɛ Emimfoɛ bɛte ɔ. Né Emimfoɛ bɛte maen pirikua, bɛsone, na bɛwoware kyɛ Anakefoɛ ne ala.

english_verse: The Moabites called them Emim, though others sometimes used the name Rephaim for both the Anakim and the Emim.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ né bebu Anakefoɛ kyɛ bɛte Refaimfoɛ nen, sɔ ala yeɛ né bebu Emimfoɛ ɔ, nakoso né Moabofoɛ frɛ bɛ Emimfoɛ.

english_verse: The Horites used to live in Seir, but the Edomites took over that region. They killed many of the Horites and forced the rest of them to leave, just as Israel did to the people in the land that the Lord gave them. Israel Crossed the Zered Gorge Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Daa ne de, né Horifoɛ yeɛ bɛte Sɛre ɔ, nakoso Yisɔ bosofoɛ tuli bɛ fili berɛ. Behuhuni bɛ, na bɛtenane b’aseɛ ne aso, kyɛbɔ Yisraelfoɛ yɔle ye wɔ aseɛ bɔ AWURADE fa mane bɛ kyɛ bɛfa ne aso ne.)

english_verse: When we came to the Zered Gorge along the southern border of Moab, the Lord told us to cross the gorge into Moab, and we did.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele kyɛ, ‘Afei ɛ́mɔdwɔso, ná ɛmɔɔpɛ Serede bɔnza ne.’ Yiti yɛɛpɛle Serede bɔnza ne.

english_verse: The Lord kept getting rid of them until finally none of them were left.
translation_verse: “Koɛhonɛfoɛ ne amukoraati wuwuli ná bɛ boso yerale fili mmenia ne anu nen,

english_verse: Then the Lord told me,
translation_verse: AWURADE sele me kyɛ,

english_verse: “Moses, now go past the town of Ar and cross Moab's northern border
translation_verse: ‘Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛkɔpɛ nu wɔ Are, wɔ Moabo ɛwɛen so;

english_verse: into Ammon. But don't start a war with the Ammonites. I gave them their land, and I won't give any of it to Israel.” More Nations That Lived near Canaan
translation_verse: na sɛ edwu Amonfoɛ ɛwɛen so a, nnɛha bɛ, yeɛ nnɛfa koɛ kɔtoa bɛ, ofikyɛ mengɔfa Amonfoɛ aseɛ ne kaala po mengɔma wɔ kyɛ ɛfa, ɔnate kyɛ mafa mama Lɔto bosofoɛ kyɛ bɛfa.’

english_verse: Before the Ammonites conquered the land that the Lord had given them, some of the Rephaim used to live there, although the Ammonites called them Zamzummim.
translation_verse: (Bebu sɔ aseɛ ne kyɛ Refaimfoɛ aseɛ. Daa ne, né Refaimfoɛ yeɛ bɛte berɛ ɔ, nakoso Amonfoɛ frɛ Refaimfoɛ Samsumin.

english_verse: The Lord helped them as he had helped the Edomites, who killed many of the Horites in Seir and forced the rest to leave before settling there themselves.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ AWURADE yɔ mane Yisɔ bosofoɛ bɔ bɛte Sɛre ne ɔ. Ohuhuni Horifoɛ fili bɛ nyunu. Yisɔ bosofoɛ tuli bɛ fili berɛ, na batena b’aseɛ so toonn maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

english_verse: A group called the Avvim used to live in villages as far south as Gaza, but the Philistines killed them and settled on their land. Israel Crossed the Arnon Gorge Moses said:
translation_verse: Na Awifoɛ koso bɔ né bɛtete namue nemɔ anu wɔ Gasa mbɔtam ne, Kafitorimfoɛ bɔ befi Kafito bɛwale ne huhuni bɛ, na bɛtenane b’aseɛ ne aso.)

english_verse: After we went through Ammon, the Lord told us: Israel, pack up your possessions, take down your tents, and cross the Arnon River gorge. The territory of the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon lies on the other side of the river, but I now give you his land. So attack and take it!
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔdwɔso bɛ́toa ɛmɔ atee ne aso bɛɛpɛ asue Anɔn bɔnza ne. Tie, Hesebon hene Sihon bɔ ɔte Amoriniɛ ne, mafa ye ne ye aseɛ mawura wɔ sa. Fa koɛ toa ye, ná hyɛ ye bo kyɛ ɛkɔfa aseɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: Today I will start making all other nations afraid of you. They will tremble with fear when anyone mentions you, and they will be terrified when you show up. The Defeat of King Sihon of Heshbon (Numbers
translation_verse: Ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, ngɔma wɔ nwo suronyi ne esurolɛ piri kɔtɔ mmenia bɔ bɛwɔ ewiase amukoraati so. Na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔte wɔ nga nen, ɔnate wɔ ti ye nwo kɔwosowoso ye, na ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ ye so.’ Yisrael di ɛhene Sihon so ngonim (Numeri

english_verse: After we had crossed the Arnon and had set up camp in the Kedemoth Desert, I sent messengers to King Sihon of Heshbon, telling him that his nation and ours could be at peace. I said:
translation_verse: “Yiti nzomane ɛbɔfoɛ wɔ Kedemote ɛserɛ ne aso maa bɛfale asomdwee nwo ngraa bɛɛmane Hesebon hene Sihon kyɛ,

english_verse: Please let Israel go across your country. We will walk straight through, without turning off the road.
translation_verse: ‘Ma me ate ma mbɛ nu wɔ w’aseɛ ne aso. Atee ne aso ala yeɛ ngɔfa ɔ, mengɔmakye ngɔfa famaa so anaa bɛen so.

english_verse: You can even sell us food and water, and we will pay with silver. We need to reach the Jordan River and cross it, because the Lord our God is giving us the land on the west side. The Edomites and Moabites have already let us cross their land. Please let us cross your land as well.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ Yisɔ bosofoɛ bɔ bɛte Sɛre, ɔne Moabofoɛ bɔ bɛte Are yɔ mane me ne ala, kɔpem kyɛ ngɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan ngɔhɔ aseɛ bɔ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma yɛ ne aso ɔ.’

english_verse: But Sihon refused to let us go across his country, because the Lord made him stubborn and eager to fight us. The Lord told me, “I am going to help you defeat Sihon and take his land, so attack him!”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, ‘Tie, mahyɛ ye bo mafa Sihon ne ye aseɛ ne mawura wɔ sa; hyɛ ye bo kyɛ ɛkɔho kɔfa ye aseɛ ne ɔ.’

english_verse: We met Sihon and his army in battle at Jahaz,
translation_verse: Afei Sihon wale yɛ so, ɔne ye lɔen amukoraati, kyɛ bɛ ne yɛ baaho koɛ wɔ Yahase.

english_verse: and the Lord our God helped us defeat them. We killed Sihon, his sons, and everyone else in his army.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ fale ye wurale yɛ sa, yɛhuhuni ye ne ye mma ne ye mmenia mukoraati.

english_verse: The Lord helped us capture every town from the Arnon River gorge north to the boundary of Gilead, including the town of Aroer on the edge of the gorge and the town in the middle of the gorge.
translation_verse: Fite Aroye bɔ ɔwɔ Anɔn bɔnza ne noa dɔ, ɔne kuro bɔ ɔwɔ bɔnza ne anu ne, bɔ ɔkwaadwu Gileade ne, kuro biala nne berɛ bɔ yangora yanni so ngonim ɔ. AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ fale nikyee biala wurale yɛ sa.

english_verse: However, we stayed away from all the Ammonite towns, both in the hill country and near the Jabbok River, just as the Lord had commanded.
translation_verse: Nakoso Amonfoɛ aseɛ de, amva wɔ sa anga ye; yeɛ amva wɔ sa anga aseɛ bɔ ɔla Yabɔko bɔnza noa, ɔne mmokaa aseɛ ne aso nguro nemɔ, ɔne nekaa biala bɔ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ berale yɛ kyɛ nnɛmaa yɛkɔ ne.

english_verse: But the Lord told me, “Moses, don't be afraid of King Og. I am going to help you defeat him and his army and take over his land. Destroy him and his people, just as you did with the Amorite King Sihon of Heshbon.”
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE sele me kyɛ, ‘Nnɛsuro ye, ofikyɛ mafa ye ne ye lɔen amukoraati ne ye aseɛ mawura wɔ sa. Na nikyee bɔ ɛfa yɔle Amorifoɛ hene Sihon bɔ né ɔte Hesebon nen, sɔ ala yeɛ fa yɔ ye ɔ.’

english_verse: The Lord our God helped us destroy Og and his army and conquer his entire kingdom of Bashan, including the Argob region. His kingdom had lots of villages and
translation_verse: Yɛsɛkyele bɛ bɔkɔɔ, kyɛbɔ yɛyɔle Hesebon hene Sihon ne: yɛsɛkyele kuro biala, na yɛhuhuni mmienzua ne mmrasua ne ngwadaa mukoraati.

english_verse: but keeping the livestock and everything else of value.
translation_verse: Nakoso yɛfale nguro nemɔ anu nyɛmmoa yɛyɛle yɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ, na yɛfene nu nningyein yɛfale.

english_verse: Sihon and Og had ruled Amorite kingdoms east of the Jordan River. Their land stretched from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, and we captured it all.
translation_verse: Yiti sɔ mmerɛ ne, asue Yɔɔdan si dɔ aseɛ ne, fite Anɔn bɔnza nu kodwu Hɛmɔn bokaa ne, yɛle yɛfili Amorifoɛ hene nyɔ nemɔ sa nu.

english_verse: We captured all the towns in the highlands, all of Gilead, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, two of the towns that Og had ruled. Og's Coffin
translation_verse: Nguro amukoraati bɔ bɛwɔ bokaa frɛtɛɛ ne aso, ɔne Gileade ne Basan aseɛ amukoraati, kodwu nguro Saleka ne Yedrei bɔ bɛwɔ ɛhene Ogo maen nu wɔ Basan ne, yɛlili bɛ so ngonim.

english_verse: King Og was the last of the Rephaim, and his coffin is in the town of Rabbah in Ammon. It is made of hard black rock and is four meters long and almost two meters wide. The Land East of the Jordan River Is Divided (Numbers
translation_verse: Refaimfoɛ bɛ bosofoɛ ne, né Basan hene Ogo ngome twe yeɛ waha ɔ. Né ye mba te buralɛ. Ye tendenn nu te agyirɛ ngona, yeɛ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ nna, kyɛbɔ sona agyirɛ nzusuleɛ te ɔ. Na ɔtɛ gyi Amonfoɛ kuro Raba so. Bɛhyɛle asue Yɔɔdan si aseɛ ne (Numeri

english_verse: The Lord will let them defeat the enemy nations on the west side of the Jordan and take their land. Afterwards, you can come back here to the land I gave you.
translation_verse: kɔpem kyɛ AWURADE kɔma ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ konya nekaa kole bɛ nwome, kyɛbɔ wayɔ wama ɛmɔ ne; kɔpem kyɛ bɛ koso bɛ sa kɔha aseɛ bɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma bɛ wɔ asue Yɔɔdan si dɔ ne ɔ. Na ɛhe asi ne, ebiala kɔhora kosa kɔɔfa ye aseɛ bɔ mafa mama ɛmɔ ne.’

english_verse: At that time I prayed and begged,
translation_verse: “Sɔ mmerɛ ne, nzrɛle AWURADE kyɛ,

english_verse: “Our Lord, it seems that you have just begun to show me your great power. No other god in the sky or on earth is able to do the mighty things that you do.
translation_verse: ‘O AWURADE Nyameɛ, bekye ala po yeɛ ahyɛ ye bo bɔ ɛma w’akoaa nwu kyɛbɔ esi te piri, ɔne kyɛbɔ wɔ tumi te ɔ, na nyameɛ foforɛ beni yeɛ ɔwɔ anwuro anaa ase bɔ ɔkɔhora kɔyɔ nningyein mbiri mbiri ne anwanwadeɛ bɔ ɛyɔ ye ɔ?

english_verse: The land west of the Jordan is such good land. Please let me cross the Jordan and see the hills and the Lebanon Mountains.”
translation_verse: Mesrɛ wɔ ala, maa mbɛ asue Yɔɔdan ngɔ ye si dɔ ngɔnea aseɛ paa bɔ ɔla dɔ ne: sɔ mmokaa aseɛ nyemenenyemene ne, ɔne Lebanon.’

english_verse: But the Lord was angry with me because of you people, and he refused to listen. “That's enough!” he said. “I don't want to hear any more.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔnate ɛmɔ ti AWURADE fɛle me so yaa, na wandɛ me so. Na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, ‘Wayɛ yee! Nnɛkã sɔ dwirɛ ne kyire me ko!

english_verse: Climb to the top of Mount Pisgah and look north, south, east, and west. Take a good look, but you are not going to cross the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Fo kɔ Pisiga bokaa ne aso, ná toto wɔ nye nea eyia atɔleɛ, sorɔ ne ngwaen ne eyia afiteleɛ. Fa wɔ nye nea aseɛ ne yé, ofikyɛ asue Yɔɔdan ye de, ɛngɔpɛ ye ngɔhɔ ye si.

english_verse: Joshua will lead Israel across the Jordan to take the land, so help him be strong and brave and tell him what he must do.”
translation_verse: Nakoso fa w’adwuma ne wura Yosua sa, kanyane ye ná hyɛ ye nguraen, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ okotua mmenia hemɔ noa maa bɛkɔpɛ asue ne ɔ, na ye yeɛ ɔkɔma bɛ sa kɔha aseɛ bɔ ekonwu ye ne ɔ.’

english_verse: After this we stayed in the valley at Beth-Peor.
translation_verse: Yiti yɛtenane bɔnza ne anu, wɔ Bete Peɔ ndendeneɛ so.

english_verse: Israel, listen to these laws and teachings! If you obey them, you will live, and you will go in and take the land that the Lord is giving you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped,
translation_verse: “Afei Yisrael, tie ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ mekyirekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔli so ne, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanya ngoa, ná ɛmɔahɔ baafa aseɛ bɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma ɛmɔ ne.

english_verse: and now he is your God. I am telling you everything he has commanded, so don't add anything or take anything away.
translation_verse: Mmeraa bɔ méfa méma ɛmɔ ne, nnɛma ɛmɔfa bie bɛboka so, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔye bie befi nu, na mmom ɛ́mɔli AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ méhyehyɛ méma ɛmɔ ne aso.

english_verse: But all of you that were faithful to the Lord your God are still alive today.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔfale bɛ nwo bɛbɔle AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ne de, ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛtɛ te ase.

english_verse: You must be very careful not to forget the things you have seen God do for you. Keep reminding yourselves, and tell your children and grandchildren as well.
translation_verse: “Nakoso ɛ́mɔnea yé, ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé, ná ɛmɔ wora amvi nningyein bɔ ɛmɔ nye anwu ye ne, yeɛ nnɛmɔma ofi ɛmɔ ti anu le wɔ mmerɛ biala bɔ ɛmɔte ngoa nu ɔ. Ɛ́mɔfa béhyirehyire ɛmɔ mma ne ɛmɔ nnomaa;

english_verse: Do you remember the day you stood in the Lord's presence at Mount Sinai? The Lord said, “Moses, bring the people of Israel here. I want to speak to them so they will obey me as long as they live, and so they will teach their children to obey me too.”
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ daa bie ɛmɔgyinane AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ nyunu wɔ Horebo, bɔ AWURADE sele me kyɛ, ‘Boaboa mmenia ne noa ma me, ná nga me noa nu dwirɛ ngyire bɛ, amaa ɔnate so basua kyɛ bekosuro me wɔ mmerɛ biala bɔ bɛte ase ɔ, ná bafa bahyirehyire bɛ mma mɔ.’

english_verse: Mount Sinai was surrounded by deep dark clouds, and fire went up to the sky. You came to the foot of the mountain,
translation_verse: Ɛmɔpingyele berɛ, na ɛmɔgyinane bokaa ne nye abo, wɔ aberɛ bɔ né bokaa ne gye wuronyiwuronyi kɔ anwuro anwuro wɔ munungum kabii ne awosii tunn nu ɔ.

english_verse: and the Lord spoke to you from the fire. You could hear him and understand what he was saying, but you couldn't see him.
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE dwudwo hyirele ɛmɔ fili see ne anu. Ɛmɔtele edwudwolɛ de, nakoso ɛmɔannwu AWURADE, komviɛ ne ala yeɛ ɛmɔtele ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said he was making an agreement with you, and he told you that your part of the agreement is to obey the Ten Commandments. Then the Lord wrote these Commandments on two flat stones.
translation_verse: Na ye apam, bɔ ye ole mmeraa dwirɛ buru ne, ɔha hyirele ɛmɔ. Ɔhyɛle ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔli so, na ɔhyerɛle bɛ guale nyɔboɛ taataa nyɔ so.

english_verse: That's when the Lord commanded me to give you the laws and teachings you must obey in the land that you will conquer west of the Jordan River. Don't Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na sɔ mmerɛ ne, AWURADE hyɛle me kyɛ ngyirekyire ɛmɔ ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdi so wɔ aseɛ bɔ ɛ́mɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan bɛkɔɔfa ne aso ɔ. Bosoensolɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: When God spoke to you from the fire, he was invisible. So be careful
translation_verse: “Kyẽa bɔ AWURADE dwudwo hyirele ɛmɔ fili see ne anu wɔ Horebo nen, ɛmɔannwu AWURADE, yiti ɛmɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé paa,

english_verse: not to commit the sin of worshiping idols. Don't make idols to be worshiped, whether they are shaped like men, women,
translation_verse: ná ɛmɔangua ɛmɔ nwo fiɛ banyɔ amoen bamma bɛ nwo: mekyire nikyee bɔ ye sue te kyɛ bienzua anaa brasua,

english_verse: And when you see the sun or moon or stars, don't be tempted to bow down and worship them. The Lord put them there for all the other nations to worship.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛto wɔ nye anwuro ná enwu eyia, ɛsraen, nzramaa ne anwuro abɔdeɛ pembepembe mukoraati a, nnɛmaa ɔtwetwe wɔ maa egua ndwerɛ wɔ bɛ nyunu, ná anzɔne bɛ, ofikyɛ bɛte nningyein bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ afa ama mmenia mukoraati bɔ bɛwɔ wiase nekaa biala ɔ.

english_verse: But you are the Lord's people, because he rescued you from Egypt, that fiery furnace.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ de, AWURADE afa ɛmɔ, na waye ɛmɔ wafi buralɛ afaa hyerɛhyerɛ nu, mekyire Misraim, kyɛ ɛmɔɔyɛ ye bɔbɔ deinn ye deɛ, kyɛbɔ kekesaala ye ɛmɔte ye.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with me because of what you said, and he told me that he would not let me cross the Jordan River into the good land that he is giving you.
translation_verse: “Ɔnate ɛmɔ ti AWURADE fɛle me so yaa, na ɔtale ndaen kyɛ mengɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan, yeɛ me gya baa koso ngotia aseɛ paa bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ maa ɔyɛ wɔ deɛ ne aso.

english_verse: So I must stay here and die on this side of the Jordan, but you will cross the river and take the land.
translation_verse: Me de, sɔ aseɛ he aso ala yeɛ ngowu ɔ, na mengɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan; nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔkɔpɛ ye bɛkɔhɔ ye si bɛkɔɔfa sɔ aseɛ paa ne bɛkɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ.

english_verse: Always remember the agreement that the Lord your God made with you, and don't make an idol in any shape or form.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔnea yé ná ɛmɔ wora amvi apam bɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ɔne ɛmɔ yɛle ne, ná ɛmɔanyɔ amoen biala sɛso, kyɛbɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ abera wɔ ne.

english_verse: The Lord will be angry if you worship other gods, and he can be like a fire destroying everything in its path.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔte see bɔ ɔyera motoo ɔ, Nyameɛ bɔ ɔtwe nungunɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Only a few of you will survive, and the Lord will force you to leave the land and will scatter you among the nations.
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔbɔ ɛmɔ kɔsande kɔhɔ maen maen nemɔ aso, na ɛmɔ nu kãa bie yeɛ bekonya ngoa wɔ maen maen bɔ AWURADE kɔhwe ɛmɔ kɔhɔ so ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: There you will have to worship gods made of wood and stone, and these are nothing but idols that can't see or hear or eat or smell.
translation_verse: Na dɔ yeɛ ɛmɔkɔso nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ bɔ kuro sona afa ye sa ayɔ ɔ, nikyee bɔ bɛte mmakaa ne nyɔboɛ, bɔ bennwu nikye, bɛnde dwirɛ, bennidi, anaa bɛmvofa nikye ɔ.

english_verse: In all of your troubles, you may finally decide that you want to worship only the Lord. And if you turn back to him and obey him completely, he will again be your God.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛkɔ anwokyere nu, ná kyẽa bie sɔ nningyein hemɔ amukoraa toto wɔ a, ekosa kɔwa AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ berɛ, ná atie ye dwirɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God will have mercy—he won't destroy you or desert you. The Lord will remember his promise, and he will keep the agreement he made with your ancestors.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ te anwumvoinnwunɛ Nyameɛ ne ati, ɔngɔyakyi wɔ nu, yeɛ ongohu wɔ; na ɔne wɔ nana mɔ apam bɔ bɛyɛle, bɔ ɔfale ndaen foale so ne, ye wora ngofi.

english_verse: When the Lord your God brought you out of Egypt, you saw how he fought for you and showed his great power by performing terrifying miracles. You became his people, and at Mount Sinai you heard him talking to you out of fiery flames. And yet you are still alive! Has anything like this ever happened since the time God created humans? No matter where you go or who you ask, you will get the same answer. No one has ever heard of another god even trying to do such things as the Lord your God has done for you.
translation_verse: Anaakyɛ nyameɛ bie wɔ berɛ bɔ wasi ye ahone le kyɛ ɔkwaaye maen bie fi maen foforɛ so ɔfa yɛ ye deɛ, bɔ nzɔhwɛ, nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ, koɛ, tumi nnwumaa, ɔne tumi asaa, yeɛ ɔfa yɔle sɔ ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ yɔ mane ɛmɔ wɔ Misraim maa enwuni ye ne?

english_verse: The Lord wants you to know he is the only true God, and he wants you to obey him. That's why he let you see his mighty miracles and his fierce fire on earth, and why you heard his voice from that fire and from the sky.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa ɛtele ye komvi fili nyameɛso, kyɛ ɔ́fa tengyɛtengyɛ wɔ. Na aseɛ ye aso koso, ɔmaa enwuni ye see pirikua ne, na ɛtele ye dwudwolɛ fili see ne anu.

english_verse: The Lord loved your ancestors and decided that you would be his people. So the Lord used his great power to bring you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ ohurole wɔ nana mɔ dwirɛ ne ati, ɔpale nu yele bɛ bosofoɛ. Na ye bɔbɔ deinn ɔnate ye tumi piri so yeɛ ɔyele wɔ fili Misraim ɔ.

english_verse: Now you face other nations more powerful than you are, but the Lord has already started forcing them out of their land and giving it to you.
translation_verse: Na ɔfoane maen maen bɔ bɛ mbiri ne b’anwoserɛ tra wɔ ɔ fili wɔ nyunu, kyɛ ɔ́fa wɔ batena b’aseɛ so, ná ɔfa ma wɔ maa ɔyɛ wɔ deɛ, kyɛbɔ kekesaala ye ɔte ye.

english_verse: So remember that the Lord is the only true God, whether in the sky above or on the earth below.
translation_verse: Yiti, te ye bo ɛnɛ, ná fa sie wɔ ti anu, kyɛ AWURADE te Nyameɛ bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso anwuro anwuro ne aseɛ so ɔ, na nyameɛ foforɛ biala nne berɛ ko.

english_verse: Today I am explaining his laws and teachings. And if you always obey them, you and your descendants will live long and be successful in the land the Lord is giving you. Safe Towns
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, di ye ahyɛdeɛ ne ye mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ méhyehyɛ méma wɔ ɛnɛ kyẽa ye aso, amaa ɔnate so wayie wɔ ne wɔ bosofoɛ yé, ná atena aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ afebɔɔ ne aso ahyɛ.” Mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ nguro biemɔ

english_verse: The Israelites had come from Egypt and were camped east of the Jordan River near Beth-Peor, when Moses gave these laws and teachings. The land around their camp had once belonged to King Sihon of Heshbon. But Moses and the Israelites defeated him
translation_verse: wɔ asue Yɔɔdan si, bɔnza ne anu, wɔ Bete Peɔ ndendeneɛ so, wɔ Amorifoɛ hene Sihon bɔ né odi hene wɔ Hesebon n’aseɛ so. Ye yeɛ Mose ne Yisraelfoɛ lili ye so ngonim wɔ mmerɛ bɔ befili Misraim bɛwale ne ɔ.

english_verse: and King Og of Bashan, and took their lands. These two Amorite kings had ruled the territory east of the Jordan River
translation_verse: Bɛfale ye aseɛ ne, ɔne Basan hene Ogo aseɛ ne. Sɔ Amorifoɛ hene nyɔ ne, né bedi hene wɔ asue Yɔɔdan eyia afiteleɛ;

english_verse: from the town of Aroer on the edge of the Arnon River gorge, north to Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: fite Aroye bɔ ɔwɔ Anɔn bɔnza ne noa kodwu Sion bokaa ne nwo;

english_verse: Their land included the eastern side of the Jordan River valley, as far south as the Dead Sea below the slopes of Mount Pisgah.
translation_verse: ɔne Araba mukoraati bɔ ɔla asue Yɔɔdan eyia afiteleɛ ne, bɔ ɔkwaadwu Araba ɛpo ne noa wɔ Pisiga bokaa ne aseɛnwo dɔ ne.

english_verse: Moses called together the people of Israel and said: Today I am telling you the laws and teachings that you must follow, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Mose mane Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati beeyiale, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “O Yisrael, ɛ́mɔtie ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ méka ma ɛmɔte ye ɛnɛ kyẽa ye. Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔsua ná ɛmɔdi so pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Do not murder.
translation_verse: “ ‘Nnɛdi awue.

english_verse: The Lord our God made an agreement with our nation at Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ne yɛ yɛle apam wɔ Horebo.

english_verse: That agreement wasn't only with our ancestors but with us, who are here today.
translation_verse: Nna yɛ nana mɔ yeɛ AWURADE ne bɛ yɛle apam he ɔ, na mmom ɔne yɛ, yɛ mukoraati bɔ kekesaala ye yɛte ase ye.

english_verse: The Lord himself spoke to you out of the fire,
translation_verse: AWURADE gyinane ɛmɔ nyunu dwudwo hyirele ɛmɔ fili see ne anu wɔ bokaa ne aso.

english_verse: but you were afraid of the fire and refused to go up the mountain. So I spoke with the Lord for you, then I told you that he had said:
translation_verse: Na sɔ mmerɛ ne, me de ngyinane AWURADE ne ɛmɔ afia, kyɛ méka AWURADE noa dwirɛ mékyire ɛmɔ; ofikyɛ né ɔnate see ne ati ɛmɔsuro, na ɛmɔamvo bangɔ bokaa ne aso. Na ɔhane kyɛ,

english_verse: I am the Lord your God, the one who brought you out of Egypt where you were slaves.
translation_verse: “ ‘Me ole AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ nyele wɔ mvili Misraim aseɛ so, fili ngoaasolɛ nu ne.

english_verse: Do not worship any god except me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Nnɛnya nyameɛ foforɛ biala ɛboka me so.

english_verse: Do not make idols that look like anything in the sky or on earth or in the ocean under the earth.
translation_verse: “ ‘Nnɛyɔ amoen biala ɛso ye, anaa nikyee biala bɔ ye sue te kyɛ ewienu anwuro anwuro nikye, anaa aseɛ so nikye, anaa aseɛ bo dɔ nzue nu nikye.

english_verse: Don't bow down and worship idols. I am the Lord your God, and I demand all your love. If you reject me and worship idols, I will punish your families for three or four generations.
translation_verse: Nnɛkoto bɛ, yeɛ nnɛso bɛ; ofikyɛ me, AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ne, nde nungunɛ Nyameɛ, na meprapra seɛ mɔ bɛ bɔne nwo asohwenɛ megua bɛ mma mɔ so, maa okodwu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ nza ne nna bɔ bɛpɔ me so.

english_verse: But if you love me and obey my laws, I will be kind to your families for thousands of generations.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ bɔ bekuro me dwirɛ, ná bedi me mmeraa dwirɛ so ne de, mekuro bɛ dwirɛ maa okodwu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ apee apee so.

english_verse: Do not misuse my name. I am the Lord your God, and I will punish anyone who misuses my name.
translation_verse: Nnɛbɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dumaa mbaen mbaen; ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkɔbɔ AWURADE dumaa mbaen mbaen ne, ɔngɔma ɔngɔfa ye nwo ngoli tɔtorɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Show respect for the Sabbath Day—it belongs to me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Di afofikyẽa ne, ná yɛ ye krongron, kyɛbɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ahyɛ wɔ ne.

english_verse: You have six days when you can do your work,
translation_verse: Elesia yeɛ fa yɔ adwuma, ná yɔ wɔ nningyein mukoraati ɔ.

english_verse: but the seventh day of the week belongs to me, your God. No one is to work on that day—not you, your children, your oxen or donkeys or any other animal, not even those foreigners who live in your towns. And don't make your slaves do any work.
translation_verse: Nakoso kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne de, ɔte afofikyẽa ma AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ. Nnɛyɔ adwuma biala sɔ kyẽa ne: wɔ oo, ɛwa bienzua oo, ɛwa brasua oo, w’akoaa oo, w’afaneɛ oo, wɔ nandwie oo, w’afunum oo, wɔ nyɛmmoa mɔ nu biala oo, anaa ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ ɔte wɔ kuro ɔ, amaa ɔnate so w’akoaa ne w’afaneɛ bale bɛ nwome kyɛ wɔ ala.

english_verse: This special day of rest will remind you that I reached out my mighty arm and rescued you from slavery in Egypt.
translation_verse: Kaye kyɛ né ɛte kanga wɔ Misraim aseɛ so, na AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ nate tumi piri ne tumi asaa so yele wɔ fili berɛ. Ye sɔ ne ati, AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ahyɛ wɔ kyɛ eli afofikyẽa ne aso.

english_verse: Respect your father and mother, and you will live a long and successful life in the land I am giving you.
translation_verse: “ ‘Di ɛse ne eni ni, kyɛbɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ahyɛ wɔ ne, amaa ɔnate so anya ngoa tendenn, ná wayie wɔ yé wɔ aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ ne aso.

english_verse: Do not steal.
translation_verse: “ ‘Nnɛwua.

english_verse: When we were gathered at the mountain, the Lord spoke to us in a loud voice from the dark fiery cloud. The Lord gave us these commands, and only these. Then he wrote them on two flat stones and gave them to me. The People Were Afraid (Exodus
translation_verse: Sɔ dwirɛ hemɔ, AWURADE fale komviɛ piri dwudwo hyirele ɛmɔ maen ye amukoraa wɔ see ne anu, wɔ munungum ne anu, ɔne awosii kabii ne anu wɔ bokaa ne aso; na wamva edwirɛ biala wammoka so. Ɔhyerɛle bɛ guale nyɔboɛ taataa nyɔ so yeɛ ɔfa mane me ɔ. Ɛserɛ hane mmenia ne (Ɛksadɔso

english_verse: When fire blazed from the mountain, and you heard the voice coming from the darkness, your tribal leaders came to me
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔtele komviɛ ne befili awosii ne anu, bɔ né bokaa ne ɔ́yera nen, ɛmɔ abusua kure nu mbanyi mukoraati ne ɛmɔ mbanyi mɔ wale me berɛ.

english_verse: and said: Today the Lord our God has shown us how powerful and glorious he is. He spoke to us from the fire, and we learned that people can live, even though God speaks to them.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔsele kyɛ, ‘AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ waye ye animnyam ne ye tumi piri wahyire yɛ, na yate ye komvi yafi see ne anu. Ɛnɛ de, yanwu ye kyɛ, sɛ Nyameɛ ne sona dwudwo a, saa sɔ sona ne kora nya ngoa.

english_verse: But we don't want to take a chance on being killed by that terrible fire, and if we keep on hearing the Lord's voice, we will die.
translation_verse: Nzaade nzu ati yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛwu ɔ? Ofikyɛ sɔ see piri he kɔyera yɛ. Na sɛ yɛte AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ komvi bieku a, ye de yɛkowuwu.

english_verse: Has anyone else ever heard the only true God speaking from fire, as we have? And even if they have, would they live to tell about it?
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ dasaniɛ beni yeɛ wate Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne komvi kyɛ odwudwo fi see nu, kyɛbɔ yate ye, ná wanya ngoa ɔ?

english_verse: Moses, go up close and listen to the Lord. Then come back and tell us, and we will do everything he says.
translation_verse: Wɔ de, pingye berɛ, ná tie edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ kɔha amukoraa; ná ka bɔ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ kɔha kohyire wɔ amukoraa kyire yɛ. Yɛkotie ná yali so.’

english_verse: The Lord heard you and said: Moses, I heard what the people said to you, and I approve.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔhane bɛ dwirɛ ne behyire me nen, AWURADE tele, na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, ‘Mate mmenia hemɔ dwirɛ bɔ baha bahyire wɔ ne, na bɔ baha ne amukoraa te nahorɛ.

english_verse: I wish they would always worship me with fear and trembling and be this willing to obey me! Then they and their children would always enjoy a successful life.
translation_verse: O, sɛ ahaa daa biala bele sɔ adwene ne, kyɛ bekosuro me ná bali me mmeraa dwirɛ mukoraati so a, ahaa okoyie bɛ ne bɛ mma mɔ yé afebɔɔ!

english_verse: Now, tell them to return to their tents,
translation_verse: Kɔ ná kɔha kyire bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔsa bɛhɔ ɛmɔ tena sua nemɔ nu.”

english_verse: but you come back here to me. After I tell you my laws and teachings, you will repeat them to the people, so they can obey these laws in the land I am giving them. Moses said:
translation_verse: Nakoso wɔ de, gyina me nwo wa, na ngɔhã mmeraa dwirɛ ne ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ mukoraa bɔ ɛkɔfa kohyirehyire bɛ ɔ ngohyire wɔ, amaa ɔnate so bali so wɔ aseɛ bɔ méfa memaa ɔyɛ bɛ deɛ ne aso.’

english_verse: Follow them, because they make a path that will lead to a long successful life in the land the Lord your God is giving you.
translation_verse: Atee amukoraati bɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ wahyɛ kyɛ ɛ́mɔfa so bɛ́bɔ bɛ bra ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa so, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanya ngoa, ná wayie ɛmɔ yé, ná ɛmɔatena aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔ sa baahã ye ne aso bahyɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told me to give you these laws and teachings, so you can obey them in the land he is giving you. Soon you will cross the Jordan River and take that land.
translation_verse: “Afei mmeraa dwirɛ, ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ hyɛle me kyɛ ngyirekyire ɛmɔ ma ɛmɔli so wɔ aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔkwaapɛ asue Yɔɔdan bɛkɔɔfa ne ɛhe;

english_verse: And if you and your descendants want to live a long time, you must always worship the Lord and obey his laws.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so ɛne wɔ mma ne wɔ nnomaa ɛmɔasuro AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ, wɔ w’asetena mukoraati nu, ná ali ye ahyɛdeɛ ne ye mmeraa dwirɛ mukoraati bɔ méhyɛ wɔ ne aso, ná anya ngoa tendenn.

english_verse: Pay attention, Israel! Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he promised to give us this land that is rich with milk and honey. Be careful to obey him, and you will become a successful and powerful nation.
translation_verse: Yiti, Yisrael, tie, ná nea kyɛ ekoli so ɔ, amaa ɔnate so wayie wɔ yé, ná wɔ boso atrɛ pee wɔ aseɛ bɔ nyɔfonesue ne woɛ tengyɛ wɔ so ne aso, kyɛbɔ AWURADE wɔ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ahyɛ wɔ bɔ ne.

english_verse: Listen, Israel! The Lord our God is the only true God!
translation_verse: “Yisrael, tie, AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ne ole AWURADE komapɛ ne.

english_verse: So love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.
translation_verse: Fa w’ahone mukoraati, wɔ kra mukoraati, ɔne w’anwoserɛ mukoraati kuro AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ.

english_verse: and tell them to your children over and over again. Talk about them all the time, whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Fa kyirekyire wɔ mma mɔ paa. Na sɛ ɛte w’awuro oo, ɛnate atee so oo, ɛda oo, anaakyɛ edwɔso oo, ɔsɛ kyɛ edi ye nwo ngɔmɔ.

english_verse: Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: Kyekye fa bɔ wɔ sa ma ɔyɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ, ná fa bɔ wɔ nwoma so ma ɔyɛ ngayeɛ,

english_verse: Write these laws on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates. Worship Only the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: ná kyerɛ gua w’awuro aponnwaa nwo ne wɔ pambim mɔ nwo. Asoserɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: The Lord promised your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that he would give you this land. Now he will take you there and give you large towns, with good buildings that you didn't build,
translation_verse: “Na sɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ fa wɔ kodwu aseɛ bɔ ɔtale ndaen hyirele wɔ nana mɔ Abraham, Yisake ne Yakob kyɛ ɔkɔfa kɔma wɔ ne aso a: aseɛ bɔ nguro mbiri nyemenenyemene bɔ nna wɔ yeɛ ɛkyekyele ɔ wɔ so,

english_verse: and houses full of good things that you didn't put there. The Lord will give you wells that you didn't have to dig, and vineyards and olive orchards that you didn't have to plant. But when you have eaten so much that you can't eat any more,
translation_verse: aseɛ bɔ sua mɔ nu nningyein paa mukoraati ayi bɛ tɛkyɛ bɔ nna wɔ yeɛ ɛfa guale nu ɔ, aseɛ bɔ abura mɔ bɔ nna wɔ yeɛ etuli ɔ wɔ so ɔ, aseɛ bɔ bobe boo ne olive boo bɔ nna wɔ yeɛ ɛyɔle ɔ wɔ so ne: ná sɛ edidi ma wɔ ko yi a,

english_verse: don't forget it was the Lord who set you free from slavery and brought you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: nea yé né wɔ wora amvi AWURADE bɔ ɔyele wɔ fili Misraim aseɛ so, fili ngoaasolɛ nu ne.

english_verse: Worship and obey the Lord your God with fear and trembling, and promise that you will be loyal to him.
translation_verse: Suro AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ, ye yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛso ye ɔ, na ye dumaa ngome yeɛ fa ta ndaen ɔ.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with gods that are worshiped by the nations around you.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔdi nyameɛ foforɛ biala si; mmenia bɔ bapɛ ɛmɔ nwo bayia ne, nnɛma ɛmɔdi bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ nu biala si,

english_verse: If you worship other gods, the Lord will be furious and wipe you off the face of the earth. The Lord your God is with you,
translation_verse: ofikyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔne wɔ nate ne, ɔte nungunɛ Nyameɛ. AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔfɛ wɔ so yaa piri paa, na okohu wɔ kokyikyi wɔ boso kofi aseɛ ye aso.

english_verse: so don't try to make him prove that he can help you, as you did at Massah.
translation_verse: “Nnɛma ɛmɔso AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ne bɛnea, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔsole ye bɛneane wɔ Masa ne.

english_verse: Always obey the laws that the Lord has given you
translation_verse: AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ, ye dwirɛ ne ye ahyɛdeɛ bɔ wahyɛ wama ɛmɔ ne, ɛ́mɔli so pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why did the Lord give us these laws and teachings?”
translation_verse: “Na sɛ kyẽa bie ɛwa bisa wɔ kyɛ, ‘Edwirɛ ne ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ hemɔ bɔ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ahyɛ ama ɛmɔ ne, ye bo kyire sɛɛ?’ a,

english_verse: Then you will answer: We were slaves of the king of Egypt, but the Lord used his great power and set us free.
translation_verse: wɔ koso bua ɛwa ne kyɛ, ‘Né yɛte Faro nganga wɔ Misraim, nakoso AWURADE nate tumi piri so yeɛ ɔyele yɛ fili Misraim ɔ;

english_verse: We saw him perform miracles and make horrible things happen to the king, his officials, and everyone else.
translation_verse: na AWURADE fale nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ mbiri mbiri bɔ ɔyɛ suro hwene Misraim ne Faro ne ye awuro ama mukoraati so, bɔ né yɛ nye tua ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord rescued us from Egypt, so he could bring us into this land, as he had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: Nakoso yɛ de, ɔyele yɛ fili berɛ kyɛ ɔ́fa yɛ ba aseɛ bɔ ɔtale ye nwo ndaen hyirele yɛ nana mɔ ne aso, maa yɛfa yɛyɛ yɛ deɛ.

english_verse: That's why the Lord our God demands that we obey his laws and worship him with fear and trembling. And if we do, he will protect us and help us be successful.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛdi mmeraa dwirɛ he amukoraati so pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ nyunu, kyɛbɔ wahyɛ yɛ ne a, ye de yɛkɔtengyɛ wɔ ye nyunu.’

english_verse: So be sure to obey his laws and teachings I am giving you today. The Lord Will Bless You if You Obey (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Yiti mmeraa dwirɛ ne ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ méfa méma wɔ ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, di so pɛpɛɛpɛ. Sotie nwo saleɛ (Deuteronomi

english_verse: When the Lord helps you defeat your enemies, you must destroy them without pity! And don't get trapped into worshiping their gods.
translation_verse: Na ekohũhũ mmenia bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔfa bɛ kowura wɔ sa ne amukoraati. Nnɛnwu bɛ anwumvoin, yeɛ nnɛso bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ, ofikyɛ ɛhe kɔyɛ wɔ so ngaen.

english_verse: the Lord will force them out of the land. Then you must destroy them without mercy. Don't make any peace treaties with them,
translation_verse: ná sɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ fa bɛ wura wɔ sa, ná edi bɛ so ngonim a, ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ ekuku bɛ bɔkɔɔ. Nnɛne bɛ yɛ apam, yeɛ nnɛnwu bɛ anwumvoin.

english_verse: If you do, those people will lead your descendants to worship other gods and to turn their backs on the Lord. That will make him very angry, and he will quickly destroy Israel.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛkɔkakyi wɔ mma nemɔ adwene bɔ bengoli me si ɔ, maa bɛkɔɔso nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ. Na ɔba ye sɔ a, AWURADE kɔfɛ ɛmɔ so yaa piri paa, na okohu wɔ ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: So when you conquer these nations, tear down the altars where they worship their gods. Break up their sacred stones, cut down the poles that they use in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and throw their idols in the fire. The Lord's Chosen People Moses said:
translation_verse: Nakoso bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛyɔ bɛ hɔ ɛhe: Ɛ́mɔdwiri b’afɔleɛ bokyea nemɔ bégua, ná ɛ́mɔbubu bɛ bonima nemɔ nu gɔsɔgɔsɔ; ɛ́mɔpepɛ bosoen Asera dosii nemɔ bégua, ná ɛ́mɔfa see bɛ́yera b’amoen nemɔ.

english_verse: Israel, you are the chosen people of the Lord your God. There are many nations on this earth, but he chose only Israel to be his very own.
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ ɛmɔte mmenia krongron bɛma AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ; na ɛmɔ yeɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ waneanea aseɛ ye aso mmenia mukoraati nu waye ɛmɔ ɔ, kyɛ ɛ́mɔyɛ ye bɔbɔ ye mmenia bɔ ye ahone la bɛ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: but the Lord chose you because he loves you and because he had made a promise to your ancestors. Then with his mighty arm, he rescued you from the king of Egypt, who had made you his slaves.
translation_verse: Na mmom, AWURADE kuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ, yeɛ osa di ndaen bɔ ɔta hyirele ɛmɔ nana mɔ ne aso. Na ɛhe ati yeɛ ɔmaa AWURADE nate tumi piri so yele ɛmɔ ɔ, na ɔyele ɛmɔ fili ngoaasolɛ nu, fili Misraim hene Faro sa nu.

english_verse: You know that the Lord your God is the only true God. So love him and obey his commands, and he will faithfully keep his agreement with you and your descendants for a thousand generations.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ enwu ye kyɛ, AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ne, ye ole Nyameɛ; Nyameɛ nahorɛlilɛniɛ bɔ odi ye adɔeɛ apam so ma mmenia bɔ bekuro ye dwirɛ ná bedi ye mmeraa dwirɛ so ɔ, kodwu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ apee so.

english_verse: God will bless you more than any other nation—your families will grow and your livestock increase.
translation_verse: Ekonya saleɛ kɔtra maen biala, na bienzua anaa brasua biala ngɔyɛ mmotaen wɔ wɔ nu, anaa wɔ nyɛmmoa nu.

english_verse: so destroy it. If you bring it home with you, both you and your house will be destroyed. Stay away from those disgusting idols!
translation_verse: Nnɛfa akyiwadeɛ biala ba w’awuro, ná wɔ koso angakyi akyiwadeɛ kyɛ ye ala. Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmaa ɔyɛ wɔ tɛ ná ekyi ye bɔkɔɔ, ofikyɛ ɔte akyiwadeɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will love you and bless you by giving you many children and plenty of food, wine, and olive oil. Your herds of cattle will have many calves, and your flocks of sheep will have many lambs.
translation_verse: Okohuro wɔ dwirɛ, okoyira wɔ, na ɔkɔma wɔ boso kɔta pee. Okoyira wɔ kunu mmaa, w’aseɛ so aleɛ, w’aburoo ne wɔ nzaa ne wɔ ngoo, wɔ nandwie ne wɔ mmoaen kɔta pee; wɔ aseɛ bɔ ɔtale ye nwo ndaen hyirele wɔ nana mɔ kyɛ ɔkɔfa kɔma wɔ ne aso.

english_verse: If you completely obey these laws, the Lord your God will be loyal and keep the agreement he made with you, just as he promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: “Na sɛ ɛmɔyɛ asoɛ betie sɔ nhyehyɛleɛ hemɔ, ná ɛmɔdi so pɛpɛɛpɛ a, ye de adɔeɛ apam bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ tale ye nwo ndaen hyirele wɔ nana mɔ ne, AWURADE koli so kɔma wɔ.

english_verse: You will no longer suffer with the same horrible diseases that you sometimes had in Egypt. You will be healthy, but the Lord will make your enemies suffer from those diseases. Destroy the Nations and Their Gods Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen kofi anwonyerɛ amukoraati nwo, na Misraim anwonyerɛ tɛɛ bɔ enwuni ye ne, ɔngɔma nu ko po ngɔbɔ wɔ. Nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛpɔ wɔ ne de, ɔkɔprapra anwonyerɛ nemɔ kogua bɛ so.

english_verse: You may be thinking, “How can we destroy these nations? They are more powerful than we are.”
translation_verse: “Ebiaa ɛkɔha ye wɔ wɔ ti anu kyɛ, ‘Maen hemɔ bɛsone bɛtra me; ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né mahora mafoa bɛ mafi berɛ?’

english_verse: But stop worrying! Just remember what the Lord your God did to Egypt and its king.
