translation_verse: Nakoso nnɛsuro bɛ, na mmom kaye bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ fa yɔle Faro ne Misraim amukoraati ne,

english_verse: You saw how the Lord used his tremendous power to work great miracles and bring you out of Egypt. And he will again work miracles for you when you face these enemies you fear so much.
translation_verse: nzɔhwɛ mbiri mbiri bɔ ɛfale wɔ nye nwuni ye, nzɛngyerɛnneɛ, anwanwadeɛ, tumi piri ne tumi asaa bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ fa yele wɔ fili berɛ ɔ. Na sɔ yeɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔfa kɔyɔ mmenia bɔ esuro bɛ ne amukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: Some of them may try to survive by hiding from you, but the Lord will make them panic, and soon they will be dead.
translation_verse: Asa koso, AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔsoma kotokuradu mɔ maa bɛkɔhɔ bɛ so, kɔpem kyɛ bɛ bɔ baha bɔ baabɔ bɛ nwo adwaa ne po bekowuwu koraa ɔ.

english_verse: So don't be frightened when you meet them in battle. The Lord your God is great and fearsome, and he will fight at your side.
translation_verse: Nnɛma bɛ nwo suronyi tɔ wɔ so, ofikyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ogyi wɔ si ne, ɔte Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte piri, bɔ ye nwo yɛ suro ɔ.

english_verse: As you attack these nations, the Lord will force them out little by little. He won't let you get rid of them all at once—if he did, there wouldn't be enough people living in the land to keep down the number of wild animals.
translation_verse: AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔfoa sɔ maen hemɔ kofi wɔ nyunu ngaka ngaka. Ɛngɔhora ngohũhũ bɛ mukoraati berɛ ne ala, anyɔ a ngaka aboyaa nemɔ kɔsone pee kɔha wɔ.

english_verse: But when you attack your enemies, the Lord will make them panic, and you will easily destroy them. You will defeat their kings one after another until they are gone, and no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔfa bɛ hene mɔ kowura wɔ sa, na odi kyɛ ɛma bɛ dumaa mini fi aseɛ ye aso. Na sona biala ngɔhora wɔ nyunu gyina kɔpem kyɛ ekohũhũ bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: After you conquer a nation, burn their idols. Don't get trapped into wanting the silver or gold on an idol. Even the metal on an idol is disgusting to the Lord,
translation_verse: Amoen mɔ bɔ bafa bayɛ bɛ nyameɛ mɔ ne, ɛ́mɔfa see bɛ́yera bɛ. Nnɛma wɔ nye boro ɛdwetɛ anaa esikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ bafa baboro amoen nemɔ nwo ne, ná amva bie ma wanyɛ ngaen wangye wɔ, ofikyɛ ɔte AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ akyiwadeɛ.

english_verse: Israel, do you want to go into the land the Lord promised your ancestors? Do you want to capture it, live there, and become a powerful nation? Then be sure to obey every command I am giving you.
translation_verse: “Mmeraa dwirɛ amukoraa bɔ méhyehyɛ méma ɛmɔ ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, ɛ́mɔli so yé, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanya ngoa ná ɛmɔasone pee, ná ɛmɔahɔ baafa aseɛ bɔ AWURADE tale ye nwo ndaen kyɛ ɔkɔfa kɔma ɛmɔ nana mɔ ne.

english_verse: so he made you go hungry. Then he gave you manna, a kind of food that you and your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was teaching you that people need more than food to live—they need every word that the Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Ɔmane ɛhɔen huni wɔ fa brɛle wɔ ase, na mana bɔ né ɛnze nikye horɛ, bɔ wɔ nana mɔ koso bɛnze nikye horɛ ne, ɔmane wɔ bie maa elili. Ɔyɔle sɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔmaa ekonwu ye kyɛ, nna aleɛ ngome yeɛ ɔma sona nya ngoa ɔ, na mmom AWURADE noa nu dwirɛ biala yeɛ ɔma sona nya ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: So keep in mind that the Lord has been correcting you, just as parents correct their children.
translation_verse: Na nwu ye kyɛ, kyɛbɔ sona tea ɔwa ne, sɔ ala yeɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ tea wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Obey the commands the Lord your God has given you and worship him with fear and trembling.
translation_verse: Yiti di AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ so, fa ye atee so ná suro ye.

english_verse: The Lord your God is bringing you into a good land with streams that flow from springs in the valleys and hills.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa wɔ kɔ aseɛ paa so, aseɛ bɔ asue mɔ ne asue mmaa mmaa ne mbombonzue wɔ ye bɔnza mɔ nu, ɔne ye mmokaa so,

english_verse: You can dig for copper in those hills, and the stones are made of iron ore. And you won't go hungry. Wheat and barley fields are everywhere, and so are vineyards and orchards full of fig, pomegranate, and olive trees, and there is plenty of honey. Don't Forget the Lord Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: aseɛ bɔ aleɛ nwo nyɛ se wɔ so ɔ, nekaa bɔ nikye fee nwo ngohia wɔ ɔ, aseɛ bɔ so nyɔboɛ te buralɛ ɔ, na ekonya kɔɔbere kotu wɔ ye mmokaa nemɔ anu.

english_verse: After you eat and are full, give praise to the Lord your God for the good land he gave you.
translation_verse: Na sɛ edidi ma wɔ ko yi a, ye AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ayɛ, ɔnate aseɛ paa bɔ wafa wama wɔ ne ati.

english_verse: Make sure that you never forget the Lord or disobey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. If you always obey them,
translation_verse: “Nea yé né wɔ wora amvi AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ, kyɛ engoli ye mmeraa dwirɛ ne ye nhyehyɛleɛ ne ye ahyɛdeɛ bɔ méhyɛ méma wɔ ɛnɛ ye aso ɔ:

english_verse: you will have plenty to eat, and you will build good houses to live in.
translation_verse: Na sɛ edidi ma wɔ ko yi, ná esisi sua nyemenenyemene ɛtena nu,

english_verse: You will get more and more cattle, sheep, silver, gold, and other possessions.
translation_verse: ná wɔ nandwie ne wɔ mmoaen mɔ ta pee, ná enya ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ pee, ná bɔ ele ye biala sone pee a,

english_verse: But when all this happens, don't be proud! Don't forget that you were once slaves in Egypt and that it was the Lord who set you free.
translation_verse: ye de nea yé né anwomasoɛ amma wɔ nu, ná wɔ wora amvi AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔyele wɔ fili Misraim aseɛ so, fili ngoaasolɛ nu ne;

english_verse: Remember how he led you in that huge and frightening desert where poisonous snakes and scorpions live. There was no water, but the Lord split open a rock, and water poured out so you could drink.
translation_verse: ye bɔ olili wɔ nyunu moa ɔfale wɔ fale ɛserɛ pirikua suronyisuronyi so, aseɛ pralaa bɔ ewoo ne anyanyangyeleɛ bɔ bɛ noa te borɔ wɔ so ne. Ɔmane nzue fili nyɔbotaen nu pu wale mane wɔ,

english_verse: He also gave you manna, a kind of food your ancestors had never even heard about. The Lord was testing you to make you trust him, so that later on he could be good to you.
translation_verse: na ɔmane wɔ mana bɔ wɔ nana mɔ bɛnze nikye horɛ maa elili wɔ ɛserɛ so, kyɛ ɔ́fa brɛ wɔ ase ná oso wɔ nea, maa oyie wɔ yé.

english_verse: When you become successful, don't say, “I'm rich, and I've earned it all myself.”
translation_verse: Nnɛyɛ w’adwene kyɛ, ‘Ɔnate m’anwoserɛ ne m’abasa nu serɛ so yeɛ manya me nwo ɔ.’

english_verse: Instead, remember that the Lord your God gives you the strength to make a living. That's how he keeps the promise he made to your ancestors.
translation_verse: Na mmom kaye AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔma wɔ anwoserɛ maa ɛfa nya wɔ nwo ɔ, kyɛbɔ kekesaala ye ɔwɔ so ɔyɔ ye; amaa ɔnate so apam bɔ ɔtale ye nwo ndaen hyirele wɔ nana mɔ ne, wasi ye agyinayɛɛ.

english_verse: But I'm warning you—if you forget the Lord your God and worship other gods, the Lord will destroy you, just as he destroyed the nations you fought.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ AWURADE sɛkye maen maen bɔ bɛko betia wɔ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ sɛ andie AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ a, ɔkɔsɛkye wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, listen to me! You will soon cross the Jordan River and go into the land to force out the nations that live there. They are more powerful than you are, and the walls around their cities reach to the sky.
translation_verse: “Yisrael, tie! Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, maen maen bɔ bɛ mbiri ne b’anwoserɛ tra wɔ ɔ, ɛkwaapɛ asue Yɔɔdan ekode b’aseɛ, ɔne bɛ nguro mbiri bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue bahɔ ewienu ɔ;

english_verse: Some of these nations are descendants of the Anakim. You know how tall and strong they are, and you've heard that no one can defeat them in battle.
translation_verse: bɛte mmenia ndendenn bɔ bɛ nwo yɛ se ɔ, Anake bosofoɛ, kyɛbɔ ɛse bɛ ne, ɔne kyɛbɔ ate bɛ nwo dwirɛ kyɛ, ‘Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina Anake bosofoɛ nyunu ɔ?’

english_verse: But the Lord your God has promised to go ahead of you, like a raging fire burning everything in its path. So when you attack your enemies, it will be easy for you to destroy them and take their land.
translation_verse: Yiti nwu ye ɛnɛ kyẽa ye kyɛ, AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ yeɛ oli wɔ nyunu ɔkwaapɛ asue ɔ, na ɔte see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi ɔ. Okoli bɛ so ngonim, ná wabrɛ bɛ ase wɔ wɔ nyunu; amaa ɔnate so afoa bɛ afi berɛ, ná ahũhũ bɛ ndɛndɛ so, kyɛbɔ AWURADE ahyɛ wɔ bɔ ne.

english_verse: Don't ever forget how you kept rebelling and making the Lord angry the whole time you were in the desert. You rebelled from the day you left Egypt until the day you arrived here.
translation_verse: Kaye, na nnɛma wɔ wora fi kyɛbɔ ewurale AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ apue mane ye ahone huli wɔ ɛserɛ so ne, ofi kyẽa bɔ efili Misraim aseɛ so wale, kɔpem kyɛ ɛmɔɔdwuli wa ɔ; AWURADE dwirɛ so alaa yeɛ ɛmɔahwi bafa ɔ.

english_verse: At Mount Sinai you made the Lord so angry that he was going to destroy you.
translation_verse: Na Horebo bokaa ne anwo po, ɛmɔwurale AWURADE apue mane ye ahone huli, na AWURADE fɛle ɛmɔ so yaa bɔ ahaa oku ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: he said: Moses, hurry down the mountain to those people you led out of Egypt. They have already disobeyed me and committed the terrible sin of making an idol.
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE sele me kyɛ, ‘Dwɔso ná fi wa dwu kɔ aseɛnwo dɔ ndɛndɛ, ofikyɛ wɔ mmenia bɔ ɛɛyele bɛ fili Misraim wale ne babɔ musue. Edwirɛ bɔ nhyɛle bɛ kyɛ beli so ne, bali ye nwo makyebu ndɛndɛ so; na bahuro nikyee bayɔ amoen baso ye.’

english_verse: I've been watching the Israelites, and I've seen how stubborn and rebellious they are.
translation_verse: “Na AWURADE sá sele me kyɛ, ‘Manwu sɔ mmenia hemɔ, kyɛ amba, bɛ so yɛ se.

english_verse: So don't try to stop me! I am going to wipe them out, and no one on earth will remember they ever lived. Then I will let your descendants become an even bigger and more powerful nation than Israel. Moses said:
translation_verse: Yakyi me ma ngu bɛ, ná ngyikyi bɛ dumaa mvi aseɛ ye aso; na ngɔmaa ɛkɔyɛ maen pirikua bɔ ye nwo yɛ se tra bɛ ɔ.’

english_verse: Fire was raging on the mountaintop as I went back down, carrying the two stones with the commandments on them.
translation_verse: Yiti ngakyili me nwo ndwu mvili bokaa ne aso male ase. Né see la bokaa ne anu, na né ndira apam nyɔboɛ taataa nyɔ ne wɔ me sa nyɔ nu.

english_verse: I saw how quickly you had sinned and disobeyed the Lord your God. There you were, worshiping the metal idol you had made in the shape of a calf.
translation_verse: Nneane, na nwuni kyɛ amba ɛmɔayɔ bɔne batia AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ: ɛmɔhurole nikyee bɛyɔle nandwie ba bɛsole ye, na edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE hyɛle ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔli so nen, ɛmɔhwi bɛfale so ndɛndɛ so.

english_verse: So I threw down the two stones and smashed them before your very eyes.
translation_verse: Yiti mbagyale nyɔboɛ nyɔ ne, na ngyi nguale maa nu bubuli, bɔ né ɛmɔ nye tua ɔ.

english_verse: I bowed down at the place of worship and prayed to the Lord, without eating or drinking for
translation_verse: AWURADE fɛle Aarɔn so yaa piri paa bɔ ahaa oku ye ɔ, nakoso mbale kyerɛ mane Aarɔn koso sɔ mmerɛ ne.

english_verse: It was a sin for you to make that idol, so I threw it into the fire to melt it down. Then I took the lump of gold, ground it into powder, and threw the powder into the stream flowing down the mountain.
translation_verse: Afei mvale nandwie ba ne, bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ bɔne bɔ ɛmɔyɔle ne. Mvale see nyerale ye, mmubuli nu, na ndini ye muhumuhu kyɛ mvuture, na ngyili ye mvuture ne nguale asue ba bɔ ɔtengyɛ fi bokaa ne aso ɔba ne anu.

english_verse: You also made the Lord angry when you were staying at Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth-Hattaavah.
translation_verse: “Na ɛmɔdwuli Tabera, yeɛ afei Masa ne Kibrote Hataawa nen, ɛmɔwurale AWURADE apue mane ye ahone huli.

english_verse: Then at Kadesh-Barnea the Lord said, “I am giving you the land, so go ahead and take it!” But since you didn't trust the Lord, you rebelled and disobeyed his command.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE yɛle kyɛ ɛ́mɔtu béfi Kadese Banea nen, ɔhane kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔfo bɛɛfa aseɛ bɔ mafa mama ɛmɔ ne.’ Nakoso ɛmɔhwi bɛfale AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ so, na ɛmɔanne ye banni, yeɛ ɛmɔandie ye dwirɛ koso.

english_verse: In fact, you've rebelled against the Lord for as long as he has known you.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔahwi bafa AWURADE dwirɛ so toonn fite kyẽa bɔ nwuni ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: After you had made the idol in the shape of a calf, the Lord said he was going to destroy you. So I lay face down in front of the Lord for
translation_verse: “Yiti ndole me nwo nyele aseɛnwo berɛ mvale me nyunu mutuli AWURADE nyunu, eleburanna, eyia ne kɔngɔen, ofikyɛ né AWURADE aha kyɛ ɔbaahu ɛmɔ.

english_verse: and prayed: Our Lord, please don't wipe out your people. You used your great power to rescue them from Egypt and to make them your very own.
translation_verse: Na nzrɛle AWURADE kyɛ, ‘O AWURADE Nyameɛ, nnɛkuku wɔ mmenia bɔ bɛte wɔ nnehyeɛ bɔ ɛnate wɔ tumi so elele bɛ ne, bɔ ɛnate w’abasa nu serɛ so ɛyele bɛ fili Misraim wale ne.

english_verse: Israel's ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob obeyed you faithfully. Think about them, and not about Israel's stubbornness, evil, and sin.
translation_verse: Kaye wɔ ngoaa Abraham, Yisake ne Yakob, ná bu wɔ nye gua mmenia hemɔ b’asoserɛ, b’amumuyɛɛ ne bɛ bɔne so.

english_verse: If you destroy your people, the Egyptians will say, “The Lord promised to give Israel land, but he wasn't powerful enough to keep his promise. In fact, he hated them so much that he took them into the desert and killed them.”
translation_verse: Anyɔ a, aseɛ bɔ ɛɛyele yɛ fili so wale ne, sofoɛ kɔha kyɛ, “AWURADE angora wamva bɛ wangɔ aseɛ bɔ ɔfa hyɛle bɛ bɔ ne aso, na ɔpɔ bɛ ne ati, yeɛ ɔmaa ɔɔyele bɛ kyɛ ɔbaahuhu bɛ wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso ɔ.”

english_verse: But you, our Lord, chose the people of Israel to be your own, and with your mighty power you rescued them from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛte wɔ mmenia ne wɔ nnehyeɛ, bɔ ɛnate wɔ tumi piri ne tumi asaa so ɛɛyele bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told me to chisel out two flat stones, just like the ones he had given me earlier. He also commanded me to make a wooden chest, then come up the mountain and meet with him.
translation_verse: “Sɔ mmerɛ ne, AWURADE sele me kyɛ, ‘Se nyɔboɛ taataa nyɔ bɔ bɛte kyɛ daa deɛ ne ala ɔ, ná fo bra me nwo wa wɔ bokaa ne aso. Fa bakaa koso bobɔ alaka.

english_verse: He told me that he would write on the new stones the same words he had written on the ones I broke, and that I could put these stones in this sacred chest.
translation_verse: Na edwirɛ bɔ ɔwɔ daa deɛ bɔ ebubuli ye ne aso ne, ngɔhyerɛ ngogua so, né afa agua alaka ne anu.’

english_verse: So I made a chest out of acacia wood, and I chiseled two flat stones like the ones I broke. Then I carried the stones up the mountain,
translation_verse: Yiti mvale bɔsema mobɔle alaka, na nzele nyɔboɛ taataa nyɔ kyɛ daa deɛ ne ala, na mvale nyɔboɛ taataa nyɔ ne ndirale me sa nu mvo ngɔle bokaa ne aso.

english_verse: where the Lord wrote the Ten Commandments on them, just as he had done the first time. The commandments were exactly what he had announced from the fire, when you were gathered at the mountain. After the Lord returned the stones to me,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE hyerɛle edwirɛ daa ne ala guale nyɔboɛ taataa nemɔ aso: mekyire mmeraa dwirɛ buru bɔ ɔha hyirele ɛmɔ wɔ bokaa ne aso fili see ne anu, wɔ nyianu kyẽa nen; na AWURADE fa mane me.

english_verse: I took them down the mountainside and put them in the chest, just as he had commanded. And they are still there. Aaron Died (Numbers
translation_verse: Afei ngakyili me nwo mvili bokaa ne aso ndwu male ase, mvale nyɔboɛ taataa nemɔ nguale alaka bɔ mobɔle ne anu, na begua nu, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle me ne.

english_verse: Respect the Lord your God, be faithful, and serve only him, making promises in his name.
translation_verse: AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ esuro ye ɔ; ye ngome twe yeɛ sɔne ye ɔ; ye yeɛ fa wɔ nwo bɔ ye ɔ, na ye dumaa yeɛ fa ta ndaen ɔ.

english_verse: Later we set up camp at the wells belonging to the descendants of Jaakan. Then we moved on and camped at Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and his son Eleazar became the priest.
translation_verse: (Yisraelfoɛ tuli bɛ bo befili Beerote Bene Yaakan bɛhɔle Mosera. Berɛ yeɛ Aarɔn wuli ɔ, besiele ye berɛ, na ɔwa bienzua Eleasa sili ye gya nu lili sɔfo.

english_verse: Next, we camped at Gudgodah and then at Jotbathah, where there are flowing streams. The Levites Were Appointed To Carry the Chest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Befili berɛ betu bɛhɔle Gudegoda, na befili Gudegoda bɛhɔle Yotebata, aseɛ bɔ asue mmaa mmaa wɔ so ne.

english_verse: After I put the two stones in the sacred chest, the Lord chose the tribe of Levi, not only to carry the chest, but also to serve as his priests at the place of worship and to bless the other tribes in his name. And they still do these things.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, AWURADE tuli Lewifoɛ siele berɛ, kyɛ bɛ́soa AWURADE apam alaka ne, ná bégyina AWURADE nyunu bɛ́so ye, ná bɛ́fa ye dumaa béyira mmenia, kyɛbɔ bayɔ toonn maa waadwu ɛnɛ ye.

english_verse: Instead, he told me, “Moses, get ready to lead the people into the land that I promised their ancestors.” What the Lord Wants Moses said:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, ‘Aseɛ bɔ nhyɛle bɛ nana mɔ bɔ kyɛ ngɔfa ngɔma bɛ ne, dwɔso koli mmenia nemɔ nyunu maa bɛɛfa.’ Bɔ Nyameɛ pena ɔ

english_verse: People of Israel, what does the Lord your God want from you? The Lord wants you to respect and follow him, to love and serve him with all your heart and soul,
translation_verse: “Yiti afei, Yisrael, nzikyɛ yeɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ pena fi wɔ berɛ ɔ? Bɔ ɔpena ole kyɛ ekosuro AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ, ná ɛkɔfa ye atee mukoraa so, ná ekohuro ye dwirɛ, ná ɛkɔfa w’ahone mukoraati ne wɔ kra mukoraati ɛkɔso AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ,

english_verse: and to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today. Do this, and all will go well for you.
translation_verse: ɔne kyɛ ekoli AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ ne ye ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔnate wɔ yeeyɛlɛ ti méfa méma wɔ ɛnɛ ye aso ɔ.

english_verse: Everything belongs to the Lord your God, not only the earth and everything on it, but also the sky and the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ anwuro ne nyameɛso anwuro anwuro, yeɛ aseɛ ne nu nningyein amukoraati te AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ deɛ de,

english_verse: Yet the Lord loved your ancestors and wanted them to belong to him. So he chose them and their descendants rather than any other nation, and today you are still his people.
translation_verse: nakoso AWURADE fale wɔ nana mɔ ngome wurale ye kunu, na ɔneaneane nu yele ɛmɔ bɔ bɛte bɛ bosofoɛ ne fili mmenia mukoraati nu, kyɛbɔ kekesaala ye ɔte ye.

english_verse: Remember your agreement with the Lord and stop being so stubborn.
translation_verse: Yiti odi kyɛ ɛmɔye ɛmɔ ahone nwo bɔne ndwirahoɛ ne, na nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ asoserɛ ko.

english_verse: The Lord your God is more powerful than all other gods and lords, and his tremendous power is to be feared. His decisions are always fair, and you cannot bribe him to change his mind.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔte nyameɛ mɔ nu Nyameɛ ɔne meneɛ mɔ nu Meneɛ, Nyameɛ piri bɔ ye nwo yɛ suro, bɔ ɔnyɛ nyeyemuɛ, bɔ onne fea-ase-ma ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord defends the rights of orphans and widows. He cares for foreigners and gives them food and clothing.
translation_verse: Ye bɔ odi nyisiaafoɛ ne akunafoɛ dwirɛ ma bɛ ɔ, ye bɔ okuro ɛwɔfoɛ dwirɛ, ná ɔma ye aleɛ ne ɛtena ɔ.

english_verse: And you should also care for them, because you were foreigners in Egypt.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔkuro ɛwɔfoɛ dwirɛ, ofikyɛ né ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔte wɔfoɛ wɔ Misraim aseɛ so.

english_verse: Offer your praises to him, because you have seen him work such terrifying miracles for you.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔfata w’ayɛyelɛ ɔ; ye yeɛ ɔte wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ wayɔ nningyein mbiri mbiri ne anwanwadeɛ nningyein hemɔ wama wɔ ɔ, nningyein bɔ wɔ nye tua ye.

english_verse: The Lord is your God, so you must always love him and obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: “Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ ekuro AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, ná edi ye dwirɛ, ye ahyɛdeɛ, ye nhyehyɛleɛ ne ye mmeraa dwirɛ so mmerɛ biala.

english_verse: Remember, he corrected you and not your children. You are the ones who saw the Lord use his great power
translation_verse: Na ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔkaye ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, kyɛ nna ɛmɔ mma mɔ , na mmom ɛmɔ yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔkaye kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ si te piri ɔ, ɔne ye tumi piri ne tumi asaa ne,

english_verse: when he worked miracles in Egypt, making terrible things happen to the king and all his people.
translation_verse: ye nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne ye yɔleɛ bɔ ɔyɔle ye wɔ Misraim hene Faro so, ɔne ye aseɛ ne aso amukoraa;

english_verse: And when the Egyptian army chased you in their chariots, you saw the Lord drown them and their horses in the Red Sea. Egypt still suffers from that defeat!
translation_verse: ɔne bɔ ɔfa yɔle Misraim asraafoɛ, ɔne bɛ mbɔngɔ mɔ ne bɛ teaseɛnam mɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔmane Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ yi fale bɛ, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né bɛ́po ɛmɔ so ne, ɔne kyɛbɔ AWURADE ahũhũ bɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ ye;

english_verse: You saw what the Lord did for you while you were in the desert, right up to the time you arrived here.
translation_verse: ɔne bɔ ɔyɔ mane ɛmɔ wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso kɔpem kyɛ ɛmɔwale wa ɔ;

english_verse: And you saw how the Lord made the ground open up in the middle of our camp underneath the tents of Dathan and Abiram, who were swallowed up along with their families, their animals, and their tents.
translation_verse: ɔne bɔ ɔfa yɔle Ruben bosoniɛ Eliabo ye mma Datan ne Abiram, kyɛbɔ aseɛ bukyele ye noa nu memene bɛ, bɛ ne b’abusuafoɛ, bɛ tena sua mɔ, ɔne bɛ somvoɛ ne nyɛmmoa bɔ beli bɛ si ɔ, bɔ Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɛ nye tua ɔ.

english_verse: With your own eyes, you saw the Lord's mighty power do all these things.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bɛ nye nwuni nningyein mbiri mbiri bɔ AWURADE yɔle ɔ. Bɔhyɛ aseɛ ne nwo saleɛ

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River, and if you obey the laws and teachings I'm giving you today, you will be strong enough to conquer the land
translation_verse: “Yiti mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ méhyɛ méma ɛmɔ ɛnɛ ye, ɛ́mɔli ye mukoraati so, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanya anwoserɛ baafa aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔkwaapɛ asue Yɔɔdan bɛfa ne,

english_verse: that the Lord promised your ancestors and their descendants. It's rich with milk and honey, and you will live there and enjoy it for a long time.
translation_verse: amaa amɔanya ngoa tendenn wɔ aseɛ bɔ AWURADE fa hyɛle ɛmɔ nana mɔ bɔ, kyɛ ɔkɔfa kɔma bɛ ne bɛ bosofoɛ ne aso, aseɛ bɔ nyɔfonesue ne woɛ tengyɛ wɔ so ne.

english_verse: It's better land than you had in Egypt, where you had to struggle just to water your crops.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ aseɛ bɔ ɛkwaafa ne de, ɔtte kyɛ Misraim aseɛ bɔ efili so wale ne, nekaa bɔ eluale nningyein, bɔ ɛyɔle adwuma serɛ fa guaguale so nzue ne, kyɛbɔ sona guagua pɛtra so nzue ne.

english_verse: But the hills and valleys in the promised land are watered by rain from heaven,
translation_verse: Nakoso aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔkwaapɛ asue ne bɛkɔɔfa ne de, ɔte mmokaa ne bɔnza aseɛ, bɔ nyameɛso nzue tɔ gua so ɔ.

english_verse: because the Lord your God keeps his eye on this land and takes care of it all year long.
translation_verse: Ɔte aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ nea so ɔ, na AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ nye wɔ so mmerɛ biala, fite afoɛ bohyɛlɛ kodwu ye ayieleɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God commands you to love him and to serve him with all your heart and soul. If you obey him,
translation_verse: “Na sɛ ɛmɔtie me mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ méhyɛ méma ɛmɔ ɛnɛ ye, ná ɛmɔkuro AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, ná ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ ahone mukoraati ne ɛmɔ kra mukoraati bɛso ye a,

english_verse: But watch out! You will be tempted to turn your backs on the Lord. And if you worship other gods,
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea yé ná bannakalaka ɛmɔ, ná ɛmɔanni makyebu bangɔanzo nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ, ná ɛmɔangoto bɛ;

english_verse: the Lord will become angry and keep the rain from falling. Nothing will grow in your fields, and you will die and disappear from the good land that the Lord is giving you.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, AWURADE kɔfɛ ɛmɔ so yaa piri paa, ná ɔkɔto nyameɛso nu bɔ esue ngɔtɔ ɔ, na aseɛ ngɔma aleɛ biala ko, na ɛmɔkowuwu ndɛndɛ so bekofi aseɛ paa bɔ AWURADE ɔ́fa ma ɛmɔ ne aso.

english_verse: Memorize these laws and think about them. Write down copies and tie them to your wrists and your foreheads to help you obey them.
translation_verse: “Yiti ɛ́mɔfa me dwirɛ hemɔ besie ɛmɔ ahone ne ɛmɔ ti anu, ná ɛ́mɔkyekye bɛ́bɔ ɛmɔ sa ma ɔyɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ, ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́bɔ ɛmɔ nwoma so ma ɔyɛ ngayeɛ.

english_verse: Teach them to your children. Talk about them all the time—whether you're at home or walking along the road or going to bed at night, or getting up in the morning.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa béhyirehyire ɛmɔ mma mɔ. Na sɛ ɛte w’awuro oo, ɛnate atee so oo, ɛkɔ nnaa nu oo, anaakyɛ edwɔso oo, di ye nwo ngɔmɔ.

english_verse: Write them on the door frames of your homes and on your town gates.
translation_verse: Kyerɛ gua w’awuro aponnwaa nwo ne wɔ pambim mɔ nwo,

english_verse: Then you and your descendants will live a long time in the land that the Lord promised your ancestors. Your families will live there as long as the sky is above the earth.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so wɔ ngoa, ɔne wɔ mma mɔ ngoa ayɛ tendenn wɔ aseɛ bɔ AWURADE tale ye nwo ndaen hyirele wɔ nana mɔ kyɛ ɔkɔfa kɔma bɛ ne aso, kyɛbɔ anwuro kata aseɛ ye aso ye de.

english_verse: Love the Lord your God faithfully and obey all the laws and teachings I'm giving you today. If you live the way the Lord wants,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmeraa dwirɛ amukoraati bɔ méhyɛ méma ɛmɔ ye, sɛ ɛmɔdi so yé, ná ɛmɔkuro AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, ná ɛmɔnate ye atee amukoraati so, ná ɛmɔfa bɛ nwo bɛbɔ ye a,

english_verse: he will help you take the land. And even though the nations there are more powerful than you, the Lord will force them to leave when you attack.
translation_verse: ye de AWURADE kɔfoa maen maen hemɔ amukoraati kofi ɛmɔ nyunu, na ɛmɔkɔɔfa maen maen bɔ bɛ mbiri ne b’anwoserɛ tra ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You will capture the land everywhere you go, from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains, and from the Euphrates River west to the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Nekaa biala bɔ ɛmɔ gya kotia ne, ɔkɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ: ɛmɔ aseɛ kɔtrɛ kofi ɛserɛ so kɔɔhã Lebanon, fite asue Yufreti kɔɔhã eyia atɔleɛ ɛpo ne.

english_verse: No one will be able to stand up to you. The Lord will make everyone terrified of you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Kuro sona biala ngɔhora ngogyina ɛmɔ nyunu. Na kyɛbɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ahyɛ ɛmɔ bɔ ne, ɔkɔma ɛmɔ nwo suronyi ne ɛmɔ nwo surolɛ piri kɔtɔ aseɛ mukoraati bɔ ɛmɔ gya kotia so ɔ so.

english_verse: You have a choice—do you want the Lord to bless you, or do you want him to put a curse on you?
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔtie! Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, mafa saleɛ ne musue masie ɛmɔ nyunu:

english_verse: Today I am giving you his laws, and if you obey him, he will bless you.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔdi AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ méhyɛ méma ɛmɔ ɛnɛ ye aso a, ye de ɛmɔkonya saleɛ;

english_verse: But if you disobey him and worship those gods that have never done anything for you, the Lord will put a curse on you.
translation_verse: nakoso sɛ ɛmɔanni AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ so, ná mmom ɛmɔkwati ahyɛdeɛ bɔ méhyɛ méma ɛmɔ ɛnɛ ye bekodi nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ bɔ ɛmɔnze bɛ si de a, ye de ɔkɔyɛ musue kɔma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: After the Lord your God helps you take the land, you must have a ceremony where you announce his blessings from Mount Gerizim and his curses from Mount Ebal.
translation_verse: Na sɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ fa wɔ kodwu aseɛ bɔ ɛkwaafa ne aso a, bɔ saleɛ nwo dawure wɔ Gerisim bokaa ne aso, ná bɔ musue koso nwo dawure wɔ Ebal bokaa ne aso.

english_verse: Soon you will cross the Jordan River to conquer the land that the Lord your God is giving you. And when you have settled there,
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkwaapɛ asue Yɔɔdan bɛkɔfa aseɛ bɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma ɛmɔ ne. Na sɛ ɛmɔkɔfa bɛtena so a,

english_verse: be careful to obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ mukoraati bɔ ɛnɛ mafa mato ɛmɔ nyunu ne ɛmɔkoli so ɔ.

english_verse: Now I'll tell you the laws and teachings that you have to obey as long as you live. Your ancestors worshiped the Lord, and he is giving you this land.
translation_verse: “Aseɛ bɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ nana mɔ Nyameɛ wafa wama ɛmɔ, kyɛ ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́yɛ ɛmɔ deɛ wɔ ɛmɔ asetena mukoraati nu ne, ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ hemɔ yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdi so nahorɛ nu wɔ aseɛ ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: But the nations that live there worship other gods. So after you capture the land, you must completely destroy their places of worship—on mountains and hills or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Maen maen bɔ ɛmɔkwaatu bɛ befi berɛ ne, nekaa biala bɔ bɛsɔne bɛ nyameɛ mɔ nen, kyɛ mmokaa mbiri so oo, mmaa mmaa so oo, anaa bakaa monɛ biala bo oo, odi kyɛ ɛmɔsɛkye berɛ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Wherever these nations worship their gods, you must tear down their altars, break their sacred stones, burn the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah, and smash their idols to pieces. Destroy these places of worship so completely that no one will remember they were ever there.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔdwiri b’afɔleɛ bokyea nemɔ bégua, ɛ́mɔbubu bɛ bonima nemɔ nu, ná ɛ́mɔfa see bɛ́yera bosoen Asera dosii nemɔ. Ɛ́mɔpepɛ amoen mɔ bɔ bafa bayɛ bɛ nyameɛ ne begua, ná ɛ́mɔkyikyi bɛ dumaa béfi porɛ ne anu berɛ.

english_verse: Don't worship the Lord your God in the way those nations worship their gods.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔfa sɔ atee ne aso bɛso AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ne.

english_verse: The Lord has promised that later on he will give Israel more land, and some of you may not be able to travel all the way from your homes to the place of worship each time you are hungry for meat. But the Lord will give you cattle, sheep, and goats, and you can butcher any of those animals at home and eat as much as you want.
translation_verse: Nekaa bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔye kosie berɛ kɔfa ye dumaa kɔto so ne, sɛ ɔne nekaa bɔ ɛte ne anu twe a, ye de ɛkɔhora kohũ wɔ nandwie anaa wɔ mmoaen bɔ AWURADE afa ama wɔ ne anu bie, kyɛbɔ mahyɛ wɔ ne, na di naen ne wɔ wɔ kuro ne anu mmerɛ biala bɔ ekuro ɔ.

english_verse: It is the same as eating the meat from a deer or a gazelle that you kill when you go hunting. And in this way, anyone who is unclean and unfit for worship can have some of the meat.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ bedi ɛwanzane anaa dabɔɔ nen, sɔ ala yeɛ di naen ne ɔ. Sona bɔ ye nwo nde oo, bɔ ye nwo te oo, ɔkora di bie.

english_verse: Do you want the Lord to make you successful? Do you want your children to be successful even after you are gone? Then do what pleases the Lord and don't eat blood.
translation_verse: Nnɛdi mogya ne, amaa ɔnate so wayie wɔ ne wɔ si ama yé; ofikyɛ ɛyɔ sɔ a, yeɛ né ɛ́yɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: All sacrifices and offerings to the Lord must be taken to the place where he chooses to be worshiped. If you offer a sacrifice to please the Lord, all of its meat must be burned on the altar. You can eat the meat from certain kinds of sacrifices, but you must always pour out the animal's blood on the altar.
translation_verse: Fa naen ne ne mogya ne bɔ wɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso. W’afɔleɛ ngaa nemɔ, hwie bɛ mogya ne gua AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne ngyɛnu, nakoso naen ne de, di.

english_verse: If you obey these laws, you will be doing what the Lord your God says is right and good. Then he will help you and your descendants be successful. Worship the Lord in the Right Way Moses said:
translation_verse: Nea kyɛ ekoli edwirɛ bɔ méhyɛ wɔ ne aso ɔ, amaa ɔnate so wayie wɔ ne wɔ si ama mɔ yé afebɔɔ; ofikyɛ ɛyɔ sɔ a, yeɛ né ɛ́yɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ. Bosoensolɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: Israel, as you go into the land and attack the nations that are there, the Lord will get rid of them, and you can have their land.
translation_verse: “Maen maen mɔ bɔ ɛkwaatu bɛ fi berɛ ne, sɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ maa sɔ maen nemɔ bɛbɔ, ná etu bɛ fi berɛ, ná ɛfa aseɛ ne yɛ wɔ deɛ tena so a,

english_verse: But that's when you must be especially careful not to ask, “How did those nations worship their gods? Shouldn't we worship the Lord in the same way?”
translation_verse: nea wɔ nwo yé ná sɛ AWURADE sɛkye bɛ fi wɔ nyunu yie a, amma nikyee fee wandwetwe wɔ ma angɔanni bɛ si, ná ammisa bɛ mmosoen nemɔ nwo dwirɛ kyɛ, ‘Atee beni yeɛ maen hemɔ bɛfa so bɛso bɛ nyameɛ mɔ ɔ? Me koso mepena kyɛ meyɔ sɔ bie.’

english_verse: No, you should not! The Lord hates the disgusting way those nations worship their gods, because they even burn their sons and daughters as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nnɛfa sɔ atee ne aso sɔne AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ, ofikyɛ musue nningyein mukoraati bɔ ɔte AWURADE akyiwadeɛ ne yeɛ bayɔ bama bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ ɔ. Bɛyera bɛ mma mmienzua ne mmrasua po wɔ see nu bɛfa bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: Obey all the laws and teachings I am giving you. Don't add any, and don't take any away.
translation_verse: “Bɔ méhyehyɛ méma ɛmɔ biala, ɛ́mɔnea yé kyɛ ɛmɔkoli so ɔ. Nnɛfa bie boka so, yeɛ nnɛye bie fi nu.

english_verse: Someday a prophet may come along who is able to perform miracles or tell what will happen in the future. Then the prophet may say, “Let's start worshiping some new gods—some gods that we know nothing about.”
translation_verse: ná sɛ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ bɔ ɔka kyire wɔ ne ba nu, ná ɔka kyɛ, ‘Maa yɛɛli nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ si, ná yɛso bɛ’ a,

english_verse: If the prophet says this, don't listen! The Lord your God will be watching to find out whether or not you love him with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: ye de nnɛtie sɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ anaa sɔ sona bɔ ɔnate laleɛ so hyɛ ngɔm ne dwirɛ. Ofikyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ óso ɛmɔ nea onwu ye kyɛ, aso ɛmɔ ahone mukoraati ne ɛmɔ kra mukoraati yeɛ ɛmɔfa bekuro AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne a.

english_verse: because he rescued you from slavery in Egypt. If a prophet tells you to disobey the Lord your God and to stop worshiping him, then that prophet is evil and must be put to death.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ anaa sɔ sona bɔ ɔnate laleɛ so hyɛ ngɔm ne de, ɛ́mɔhu ye, ofikyɛ wafa ye noa dwirɛ wabɔ mmenia asɔne wafi AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔyele ɛmɔ fili Misraim aseɛ so, ná olele wɔ fili ngoaasolɛ nu ne nwo. Na ɔtwetwe wɔ fi atee bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ hyɛle wɔ kyɛ ɛfa so ne aso. Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ etu bɔne ne bo fi wɔ nu.

english_verse: And when the rest of Israel hears about it, they will be afraid, and no one else will ever do such an evil thing again.
translation_verse: Na Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati bɛkɔte, bekosuro, na bɛngɔyɔ amumuyɛɛ bɔ ɔte sɔaa ko wɔ ɛmɔ nu.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives you towns to live in, you may hear a rumor about one of the towns.
translation_verse: “Nguro bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ kyɛ ɛtena so ne, sɛ ɛte ye kyɛ bɛ́keka bɛ́fa ko anwo kyɛ,

english_verse: You may hear that some worthless people have talked everyone there into worshiping other gods, even though these gods had never done anything for them.
translation_verse: busuefoɛ biemɔ adwɔso wɔ ɛmɔ nu, na balakalaka kuro ne anu mmenia kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔma yɛɛso nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ’ ,

english_verse: You must carefully find out if the rumor is true. Then if the people of that town have actually done such a disgusting thing in your own country,
translation_verse: ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛneanea edwirɛ ne anu, ná ebisa nu yé paa nea. Na sɛ ɔte nahorɛ kyɛ babɔ sɔ musue ne wɔ ɛmɔ nu a,

english_verse: you must take your swords and kill every one of them, and their livestock too.
translation_verse: ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛfa ngrandɛ kuku kuro ne aso ama. Sɛkye kuro ne bɔkɔɔ, nu nningyein amukoraati, nu mmenia ne nu nyɛmmoa.

english_verse: That's why you must do what the Lord your God says is right. I am giving you his laws and teachings today, and you must obey them.
translation_verse: Nakoso, sana etie AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, edi ye mmeraa dwirɛ mukoraati bɔ méhyɛ méma wɔ ɛnɛ ne aso, ná ɛyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu koraka.

english_verse: Out of all the nations on this earth, the Lord your God chose you to be his own. You belong to the Lord, so don't behave like those who worship other gods. Animals That Can Be Eaten (Leviticus
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛte maen krongron ma AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ, na AWURADE aneanea nu waye wɔ wafi aseɛ so mmenia mukoraati nu kyɛ ɛyɛ ye bɔbɔ ye maen. Ngaka bɔ bɛ nwo te ne bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo nde (Lewitikɔso

english_verse: You can eat any clean bird.
translation_verse: “Anomaa biala bɔ ye nwo te ne, ɛmɔkora bedi.

english_verse: Don't eat any disgusting animals.
translation_verse: “Nnɛdi akyiwadeɛ biala.

english_verse: It is all right to eat meat from any animals that have divided hoofs and also chew the cud.
translation_verse: Kaka biala bɔ ye gya ne anu apakye, bɔ nu apakye ndaa nyɔ, ná opu ye aleɛ sá pesa ne, ye de ɛmɔkora bedi.

english_verse: But don't eat camels, rabbits, and rock badgers. These animals chew the cud but do not have divided hoofs. You must treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Nakoso ngaka bɔ bepu b’aleɛ besa bɛpesa, anaa bɛ gya mbaboa ne anu apakye koraa ne, bɛ nu hemɔ de, nnɛma ɛmɔdi: afupɔngɔ, adango, yeɛ akrande. Ofikyɛ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bepu b’aleɛ besa bɛpesa de, nakoso bɛ gya mbaboa ne anu mbakye nyɔ. Bɛ nwo nde mma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: And don't eat pork, since pigs have divided hoofs, but they do not chew their cud. Don't even touch a dead pig!
translation_verse: Prako koso, ofikyɛ ye gya mbaboa ne anu apakye de, nakoso ombu ye aleɛ nza mbesa. Yiti ye nwo nde mma ɛmɔ. Nnɛma ɛmɔdi ye naen, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔka ye fuin.

english_verse: You can eat any fish that has fins and scales. But there are other creatures that live in the water,
translation_verse: “Nzue nu naen amukoraa, ɛmɔkora bedi ɛhemɔ: ebiala bɔ ye si ole ndɛtɛ ne ɛboen ne, ɛmɔkora bedi.

english_verse: and if they do not have fins and scales, you must not eat them. Treat them as unclean.
translation_verse: Nakoso ebiala bɔ ye si olle ndɛtɛ ne ɛboen ne de, nnɛma ɛmɔdi. Ye nwo nde mma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Swarming insects are unclean, so don't eat them.
translation_verse: Ngaka mmaa mukoraati bɔ bele ndaa betu ne, bɛ nwo nde mma ɛmɔ; nnɛma ɛmɔdi.

english_verse: However, you are allowed to eat certain kinds of winged insects.
translation_verse: Nakoso nnomaa bɔ bɛ nwo te amukoraati de, ɛ́mɔli.

english_verse: You belong to the Lord your God, so if you happen to find a dead animal, don't eat its meat. You may give it to foreigners who live in your town or sell it to foreigners who are visiting your town. Don't boil a young goat in its mother's milk. Give the Lord Ten Percent of Your Harvest Moses said:
translation_verse: “Nnɛma ɛmɔdi kaka fuin biala. Ɛkɔhora kɔfa kɔma ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ kuro maa okoli, anaakyɛ ɛkɔhora kɔyɛ ye atɔen kɔma ɛwɔfoɛ; ofikyɛ ɛte maen krongron ma AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ. “Nnɛfa abɔngye ba oni nyɔfonesue gua ye nwo to. Buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko nwo mmeraa

english_verse: People of Israel, every year you must set aside ten percent of your grain harvest.
translation_verse: “Afoɛnoa biala, fa wɔ fieso nningyein buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko .

english_verse: Also set aside ten percent of your wine and olive oil, and the first-born of every cow, sheep, and goat. Take these to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped, and eat them there. This will teach you to always respect the Lord your God.
translation_verse: W’aburoo, wɔ nzaa ne wɔ ngoo, yeɛ wɔ nandwie ne wɔ mmoaen bamuɛbaa nemɔ, so buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne, di wɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, wɔ nekaa bɔ okohyire kyɛ ɔ́ma ye dumaa da so ne; amaa ɔnate so asua kyɛ ekosuro AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ daa.

english_verse: But suppose you can't carry that ten percent of your harvest to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. If you live too far away, or if the Lord gives you a big harvest,
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ yira wɔ, ná sɛ atee ne wale bɔ ɛngɔhora ngɔfa buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne ngɔhɔ, ofikyɛ nekaa bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔye kosie berɛ kyɛ ɔ́ma ye dumaa da so ne, ɔne nekaa bɔ ɛwɔ ne anu twe a,

english_verse: When you and your family arrive, spend the money on food for a big celebration. Buy cattle, sheep, goats, wine, beer, and if there are any other kinds of food that you want, buy those too.
translation_verse: Fa sikaa ne tɔ nikyee biala bɔ ekuro ɔ: nandwie, boaen, bobe nzaa, nzaa serɛ, anaa nikyee biala bɔ wɔ komvi wɔ so ɔ. Na ɛne w’awuro ama beli ye berɛ wɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, ná ɛ́mɔli ahurusi.

english_verse: And since people of the Levi tribe won't own any land for growing crops, remember to ask the Levites to celebrate with you.
translation_verse: Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛte wɔ nguro nemɔ anu ne, nnɛbu wɔ nye gua bɛ so, ofikyɛ bɛ de belle kyɛfa anaa agyapadeɛ biala kyɛbɔ wɔ de anya ye ne.

english_verse: Every third year, instead of using the ten percent of your harvest for a big celebration, bring it into town and put it in a community storehouse.
translation_verse: “Afoɛ nza biala ayieleɛ, fieso nningyein bɔ ekonya ye sɔ afoɛ ne anu ne, fa buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko sie wɔ wɔ nguro nemɔ anu.

english_verse: The Levites have no land of their own, so you must give them food from the storehouse. You must also give food to the poor who live in your town, including orphans, widows, and foreigners. If they have enough to eat, then the Lord your God will be pleased and make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Lewiniɛ , yeɛ afei ɛwɔfoɛ, nyisiaafoɛ ne akunafoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ wɔ kuro ne anu ne, bɛkɔwa bekooli kɔma bɛ ko koyi; na ɔnate so AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ koyira wɔ wɔ wɔ sa noa adwuma mukoraati bɔ ɛkɔyɔ ɔ nu.

english_verse: After the Lord your God gives land to each of you, there may be poor Israelites in the town where you live. If there are, then don't be mean and selfish with your money.
translation_verse: “Sɛ eliɛma bie te ehianiɛ wɔ kuro bie anu, wɔ w’aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ ne aso a, nnɛbɔ eliɛma ne atianuserɛ, yeɛ nnɛma wɔ sa bo yɛ se ma eliɛma bɔ ye nwo ahyere ye ɔ.

english_verse: Every seven years you must announce, “The Lord says loans do not need to be paid back.” Then if you have loaned money to another Israelite, you can no longer ask for payment.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ ɛkɔmaa ɔkɔfa ye nwo koli ɛhe: ebiala bɔ wafa nikyee wafɛmo oliɛngo Yisraelniɛ nen, odi kyɛ ɔfa kyɛ ye. Nnɛmaa ɔhyɛ oliɛngo Yisraelniɛ anaa oliɛma kyɛ otua, ofikyɛ batu basie berɛ bama AWURADE kyɛ ɔte kerɛ-fahyɛlɛ afoɛ.

english_verse: This law applies only to loans you have made to other Israelites. Foreigners will still have to pay back what you have loaned them.
translation_verse: Amanvoraniɛ de, ɛkɔhora kɔhyɛ ye maa okotua; nakoso sɛ afa nikyee afɛmo eliɛma Yisraelniɛ a, ye de fa kyɛ ye.

english_verse: No one in Israel should ever be poor. The Lord your God is giving you this land, and he has promised to make you very successful, if you obey his laws and teachings that I'm giving you today. You will lend money to many nations, but you won't have to borrow. You will rule many nations, but they won't rule you.
translation_verse: AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ koyira wɔ, kyɛbɔ wahyɛ wɔ bɔ ne. Ɛkɔfa kɔfɛmo maen maen pee, nakoso wɔ de, ɛngɔfɛmo bie. Ekoli maen maen pee so, nakoso wɔ de, bengoli wɔ so.

english_verse: Be careful! Don't say to yourself, “Soon it will be the seventh year, and then I won't be able to get my money back.” It would be horrible for you to think that way and to be so selfish that you refuse to help the poor. They are your relatives, and if you don't help them, they may ask the Lord to decide whether you have done wrong. And he will say that you are guilty.
translation_verse: Nea yé né annya adwene tɛɛ bie kyɛ, ‘Afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo, bɔ ɔte kerɛ-fahyɛlɛ afoɛ ne apingye,’ ná amva eliɛma hianiɛ nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ anzie wɔ ti anu, kyɛ ɛngɔma ye hwee. Eliɛma ne kosũ kogua wɔ so kohyire AWURADE, na ɔkɔkakyi bɔne kotia wɔ.

english_verse: You should be happy to give the poor what they need, because then the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Fia wɔ kunu ma ye nikye, na sɛ ɛma ye nikyee a, ɔyɛ a nnɛsũ gua wɔ kunu; na ɔnate ɛhe aso AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ koyira wɔ wɔ w’adwuma mukoraati nu, ɔne wɔ sa noa adwuma mukoraati nu.

english_verse: But if the animal is lame or blind or has something else wrong with it, you must not sacrifice it to the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ kaka ne ali nnɛen, ɔtɔ gua so anaa ye nye asi, anaakyɛ watɔ bue a, ye de nnɛfa bɔ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: If any of you buy Israelites as slaves, you must set them free after six years.
translation_verse: “Sɛ bɛyɛ eliɛma Hebriniɛ bienzua anaa brasua atɔen bɛma wɔ a, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔso wɔ afoɛ nzia, na ye afoɛ nzoo ne aso, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmaa ɔfa ye nwo di tɔtorɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: And don't just tell them they are free to leave—
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛ́maa ɔfa ye nwo di tɔtorɔtɔɔ fi wɔ berɛ kɔ a, nnɛmaa ɔfa nzanza kɔ.

english_verse: give them sheep and goats and a good supply of grain and wine. The more the Lord has given you, the more you should give them.
translation_verse: Fia wɔ kunu ma ye wɔ mmoaen ne w’aburoo ne wɔ nzaa ne bie; na kyɛbɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ayira wɔ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ma ye bie ɔ.

english_verse: But one of your slaves may say, “I love you and your family, and I would be better off staying with you, so please don't make me leave.”
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɔka kyire wɔ kyɛ, ‘Menguro kyɛ ngofi wɔ nwo wa ngɔhɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ mekuro wɔ dwirɛ, ɛne w’awuro ama,’ ɔnate kyɛ ye nwo tɔ ye wɔ wɔ berɛ a,

english_verse: Take the slave to the door of your house and push a sharp metal rod through one earlobe and into the door. Such slaves will belong to you for life, whether they are men or women.
translation_verse: ye de fa ye so bata aponnwaa nwo, ná fa tulie tofi ye so anu, na ɔkɔyɛ wɔ kanganiɛ afebɔɔ. Wɔ kanganiɛ brasua koso, sɔ ala yeɛ yɔ ye ɔ.

english_verse: If the first-born animal of a cow or sheep or goat is a male, it must be given to the Lord. Don't put first-born cattle to work or cut wool from first-born sheep.
translation_verse: “Wɔ nandwie ne mmoaen mɔ bɛ bamuɛbaa bienzua biala, tu bɛ sie berɛ ma AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ. Nnɛfa wɔ nandwie bamuɛbaa yɔ adwuma, yeɛ nnɛpepɛ wɔ boaen bamuɛbaa nwiaa.

english_verse: Instead, each year you must take the first-born of these animals to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped. You and your family will sacrifice them to the Lord and then eat them as part of a sacred meal.
translation_verse: Afoɛ biala, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛne w’awuro ama beku bɛ bedi wɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, nekaa bɔ AWURADE kɔneanea nu kɔye kosie berɛ ne.

english_verse: You can butcher it where you live, and eat it just like the meat of a deer or gazelle that you kill while hunting. Even those people who are unclean and unfit for worship can have some.
translation_verse: Di naen ne wɔ wɔ kuro. Sona bɔ ye nwo nde oo, bɔ ye nwo te oo, ɔkora di bie, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔdi ɛwanzane ne dabɔɔ nen.

english_verse: But you must never eat the blood of an animal—let it drain out on the ground.
translation_verse: Ye mogya ne angome yeɛ nnɛdi ɔ; hwie gua aseɛnwo kyɛ nzue.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must celebrate Passover in the month of Abib, because one night in that month years ago, the Lord your God rescued you from Egypt.
translation_verse: Di Abɔtra aluolue ne hyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ animnyam wɔ bosome Abibo nu, ofikyɛ bosome Abibo nu yeɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ yele wɔ fili Misraim kɔngɔen ɔ.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you want to enjoy a long and successful life, make sure that everyone is treated with justice in the land the Lord is giving you. Don't Set Up Sacred Poles or Stones Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Fa wɔ nye sie pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ngome so, na ɔnate so ekonya ngoa, ná atena aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ ne aso.

english_verse: Eat thin bread for the next six days. Then on the seventh day, don't do any work. Instead, come together and worship the Lord. The Harvest Festival (Exodus
translation_verse: Di paanoo kabrɛdi toonn elesia, na kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ nyianu krongron hyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ animnyam, nnɛyɔ adwuma biala. Fieso aleɛ falɛ aluolue (Ɛksadɔso

english_verse: The Passover sacrifice must be a cow, a sheep, or a goat, and you must offer it at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Abɔtra afɔleɛ ne, ku mmoaen ne nandwie ma AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ, wɔ nekaa bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔneanea nu kɔye kosie berɛ kyɛ ɔ́ma ye dumaa da so ne.

english_verse: Don't offer the Passover sacrifice in just any town where you happen to live.
translation_verse: Nguro bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ ne, nnɛbɔ Abɔtra afɔleɛ ne wɔ nu biala so.

english_verse: It must be offered at the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. Kill the sacrifice at sunset, the time of day when you left Egypt.
translation_verse: Sana nekaa bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔneanea nu kɔye kosie berɛ kyɛ ɔ́ma ye dumaa da so ne. Berɛ angome yeɛ bɔ Abɔtra afɔleɛ ne ɔ, nɔsoa bɔ eyia kwaatɔ ne, bɔ ɔte mmerɛ bɔ etuli wɔ bo fili Misraim nen.

english_verse: Then cook it and eat it there at the place of worship, returning to your tents the next morning.
translation_verse: To naen ne, ná di ye wɔ nekaa bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔneanea nu kɔye kosie berɛ ne. Na aleɛ kye ngyerɛmɔ a, sá kɔ wɔ tena sua nu.

english_verse: And don't set up a sacred stone! The Lord hates these things.
translation_verse: yeɛ nnɛfa nyɔboɛ biala pena berɛ kyɛ ɔte bosoen atenaleɛ, bɛte nningyein bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kyi ɔ.

english_verse: When you build the altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God, don't set up a sacred pole for the worship of the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: “Nnɛdua bakaa biala fa kakyi bosoen Asera dosii wɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ ekosi ne anwo;

english_verse: go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped and celebrate the Harvest Festival in honor of the Lord your God. Bring him an offering as large as you can afford, depending on how big a harvest he has given you. Be sure to take along your sons and daughters and all your servants. Also invite the poor, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: Di ahurusi wɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, ɛne wɔ mma mmienzua ne mmrasua, wɔ nganga mmienzua ne mmrasua, Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛte wɔ kuro, ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ, nyisiaafoɛ ne kunafoɛ bɔ bɛte wɔ kuro ɔ, wɔ nekaa bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔneanea nu kɔye kosie berɛ kyɛ ɔ́ma ye dumaa da so ne.

english_verse: The bigger the harvest the Lord gives you, the bigger your gift should be. Treat Everyone with Justice Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ma ebiala ɔfa bɔ ye sa kɔsõ so ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ wasi wayira wɔ ɔ. Ndɛenbualɛ turoloo

english_verse: Each year there are three festivals when all Israelite men must go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped. These are the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters. And don't forget to take along a gift for the Lord.
translation_verse: “Afoɛ biala, ɔsɛ kyɛ wɔ mmienzua mukoraati ba AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu pɛen nza, wɔ nekaa bɔ okohyire ne: wɔ Paanoo Kabrɛdi aluolue ne, Dapɛn Dapɛn aluolue ne, yeɛ Asese aluolue ne anu. Nnɛmaa bɛfa bɛ sa mbaen bɛba AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: If an ox or a sheep has something wrong with it, don't offer it as a sacrifice to the Lord your God—he will be disgusted! Put To Death People Who Worship Idols Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Nnɛfa nandwie bɔ wali nnɛen, anaa boaen bɔ wali nnɛen, anaakyɛ bɔ nikyee tɛɛ bie wɔ ye nwo ɔ bɔ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ, ofikyɛ ɔte AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ akyiwadeɛ.

english_verse: So when you hear that someone in your town is committing this disgusting sin, you must carefully find out if that person really is guilty.
translation_verse: ná sɛ bɛbɔ wɔ amaneɛ, anaakyɛ ɛte, ná sɛ ebisabisa tie nu yé, ná sɛ ɔte nahorɛ kyɛ babɔ sɔ musue ne wɔ Yisrael a,

english_verse: But you will need two or three witnesses—one witness isn't enough to prove a person guilty. Get rid of those who are guilty of such evil. Take them outside your town gates and everyone must stone them to death. But the witnesses must be the first to throw stones. Difficult Cases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Adanzefoɛ nemɔ, ɔsɛ kyɛ bedi moa bɛboro sona bɔ babua ye ewue foɛ ne nyɔboɛ koraka, ná afei mmenia ne amukoraati baboro ye nyɔboɛ bie. Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ etu bɔne ne bo fi wɔ nu.

english_verse: When other Israelites hear about it, they will be afraid and obey the decisions of the court. The King Moses said:
translation_verse: Mmenia ne amukoraati bɛkɔte ná basuro, na bɛngɔyɛ anwomasoɛ ko. Ɛhenelilɛ nwo foɛtulɛ

english_verse: People of Israel, after you capture the land the Lord your God is giving you, and after you settle on it, you will say, “We want a king, just like the nations around us.”
translation_verse: “Sɛ edwu aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ ne aso, wɔ sa ka ye, ná ɛtena so, ná afei ɛkã kyɛ, ‘Ngɔfa sona maa okoli me so hene, kyɛbɔ maen maen mukoraa bɔ bapɛ me nwo bayia ne bayɔ ne’ a,

english_verse: Go ahead and appoint a king, but make sure that he is an Israelite and that he is the one the Lord has chosen.
translation_verse: ye de, sona bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔneanea nu kɔye ye ne, ye yeɛ maa oli wɔ so hene ɔ. Wɔ bɔbɔ eliɛma nemɔ anu bie yeɛ fa ye ma oli wɔ so hene ɔ. Amanvoraniɛ de, nna eliɛma ɔ, yiti nnɛfa ye maa odi wɔ so hene.

english_verse: And the king must not have a lot of wives—they might tempt him to be unfaithful to the Lord. Finally, the king must not try to get huge amounts of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Nnɛmaa ogyigya mmraa pee, ná ye wora amvi Nyameɛ. Nnɛmaa ɔsesa ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ pee bɔ so.

english_verse: The official copy of God's laws will be kept by the priests of the Levi tribe. So, as soon as anyone becomes king, he must go to the priests and write out a copy of these laws while they watch.
translation_verse: Na sɛ odi bia ne a, ɔ́nea kyɛ ɔkɔmaa bɛkɔhyerɛ mmeraa he bie bɛkɔma ye wɔ Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛte asɔfo ne nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: Each day the king must read and obey these laws, so that he will learn to worship the Lord with fear and trembling
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa to ye nwo, ná ɔkenga ye mmerɛ biala bɔ ɔte ngoa nu ɔ, amaa ɔnate so wasua kyɛ okosuro AWURADE ye Nyameɛ, ná wali mmeraa ne anu dwirɛ amukoraa ne ahyɛdeɛ hemɔ aso.

english_verse: and not think that he's better than everyone else. If the king completely obeys the Lord's commands, he and his descendants will rule Israel for many years.
translation_verse: Ɔba ye sɔ a, ɔngɔdwene kyɛ ɔte paa tra ye mmango Yisraelfoɛ, yeɛ ɔngɔhwe ye nwo ngofi mmeraa dwirɛ ne anwo ngɔhɔ bɛen anaa famaa so; amaa ɔnate so ye, yeɛ ye bosofoɛ bali hene bahyɛ wɔ Yisrael.

english_verse: So when I want to speak to them, I will choose one of them to be a prophet like you. I will give my message to that prophet, who will tell the people exactly what I have said.
translation_verse: Ngɔye ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ wɔ, bɔ ofi b’eliɛma nemɔ anu ngɔma bɛ. Ngɔfa me dwirɛ ngotua ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne noa, na ɔkɔha bɔ ngɔhyɛ ye kyɛ ɔha ne amukoraati kohyire bɛ.

english_verse: Some Levites may have money from selling family possessions, and others may not. But all Levites serving at the place of worship will receive the same amount of food from the sacrifices and gifts brought by the people. Don't Do Disgusting Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ onya ye kyɛfa pɛpɛɛpɛ odi, kyɛ asɔfo ngaa ne ala, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ wanya sikaa wafi ɔse agyapadeɛ bɔ bayɛ ye atɔen ne anu de. Amaenmaensofoɛ akyiwadeɛ yɔleɛ

english_verse: The people of the Levi tribe, including the priests, will not receive any land. Instead, they will receive part of the sacrifices that are offered to the Lord,
translation_verse: “Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛte asɔfo ne, mekyire Lewi abusua kure ne amukoraa, ɔnzɛ kyɛ benya kyɛfa anaa agyapadeɛ biala wɔ Yisrael. See so afɔleɛ bɔ mmenia kɔbɔ kɔma AWURADE, ɔne nningyein bɔ bɛkɔfa kɔma ye ne yeɛ bekoli ɔ.

english_verse: because he has promised to provide for them in this way.
translation_verse: Ɔnzɛ kyɛ benya agyapadeɛ bɔ b’eliɛma mɔ anya ye ne bie; AWURADE yeɛ ɔte b’agyapadeɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔhyɛle bɛ bɔ ne.

english_verse: When you sacrifice a bull or sheep, the priests will be given the shoulder, the jaws, and the stomach.
translation_verse: Asɔfo nemɔ kyɛfa bɔ bekonya bekofi mmenia bɔ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ne berɛ ne, sɛ ɔte nandwie oo, anaa boaen oo, ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛfa ye waen ne, ye awogyee nyɔ ne, ɔne ye fure ne bɛma bɛ.

english_verse: In addition, they will receive the first part of your grain harvest and part of your first batches of wine and olive oil. You must also give them the first wool that is cut from your sheep each year.
translation_verse: W’aburoo, wɔ nzaa ne wɔ ngoo bɔ ekoli moa konya ye ne, ɔne wɔ mmoaen nwo nwiaa bɔ ekoli moa kɔpepɛ ne, fa ma ɔsɔfo.

english_verse: Give these gifts to the priests, because the Lord has chosen them and their descendants out of all the tribes of Israel to be his special servants at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ waneanea nu waye Lewi wafi w’abusua kure ne amukoraa nu, kyɛ ɔne ye bosofoɛ bégyina bɛ́yɔ ɔsɔfo adwuma wɔ AWURADE dumaa nu mmerɛ biala.

english_verse: Any Levite can leave his hometown, and go to the place where the Lord chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: “Sɛ Lewiniɛ bie tu ye bo fi wɔ nguro nemɔ bie aso, nekaa bɔ ɔte wɔ Yisrael ne, ná mmerɛ biala bɔ okuro ne ɔba nekaa bɔ AWURADE kɔneanea nu kɔye kosie berɛ ne a,

english_verse: and then be a special servant of the Lord there, just like all the other Levites.
translation_verse: ye de ɔkora yɔ ɔsɔfo adwuma wɔ AWURADE ye Nyameɛ dumaa nu, kyɛbɔ ye mmango Lewifoɛ begyina AWURADE nyunu berɛ bɛyɔ ɔsɔfo adwuma ne.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land that the Lord your God is giving you. The nations that live there do things that are disgusting to the Lord, and you must not follow their example.
translation_verse: “Sɛ edwu aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ ne aso a, nnɛsua kyɛ ɛkɔyɔ maen maen nemɔ b’akyiwadeɛ yɔleɛ ne bie.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with anyone who does these things, and that's why he will help you destroy the nations that are in the land.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ sɔ nningyein nen, wayɛ ye nwo akyiwadeɛ wama AWURADE. Na ɔnate sɔ akyiwadeɛ yɔleɛ nemɔ ati yeɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́foa bɛ fi wɔ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: You will go in and take the land from nations that practice magic and witchcraft. But the Lord your God won't allow you to do those things.
translation_verse: Maen hemɔ bɔ ɛkwaatu bɛ ne, bekyini ngonyaayelɛfoɛ ne ahɔmeɛ so, nakoso wɔ de, AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔmma wɔ ate kyɛ ɛyɔ sɔ bie. Nyameɛ kɔsoma ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ

english_verse: Instead, he will choose one of your own people to be a prophet just like me, and you must do what that prophet says.
translation_verse: AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔye ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ me kofi eliɛma nemɔ nu, kofi wɔ nu kɔma wɔ, na ye yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔtie ye ɔ.

english_verse: You were asking for a prophet the day you were gathered at Mount Sinai and said to the Lord, “Please don't let us hear your voice or see this terrible fire again—if we do, we will die!”
translation_verse: Na ɛhe yeɛ ɛsrɛle AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ wɔ Horebo bokaa ne anwo, wɔ nyianu kyẽa ne kyɛ, ‘Nnɛmaa mete AWURADE me Nyameɛ dwudwolɛ ko, yeɛ nnɛmaa menwu sɔ see totohyia ne ko, ná manwu.’

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Moses, they have said the right thing.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE buale me kyɛ, ‘Bɔ baha ne te nahorɛ.

english_verse: Since the message comes from me, anyone who doesn't obey the message will have to answer to me.
translation_verse: Na sona biala bɔ ondie me dwirɛ bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne kɔha ye me dumaa nu nen, me bɔbɔ ngɔmaa okobu ye nwo ngondaa.

english_verse: But if I haven't spoken, and a prophet claims to have a message from me, you must kill that prophet, and you must also kill any prophet who claims to have a message from another god. Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nakoso ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ biala bɔ okodwudwo nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ dumaa nu, anaa bɔ okoli ye bɔbɔ ye ti piri kɔfa me dumaa kɔha edwirɛ bɔ nnhyɛle ye kyɛ ɔhã nen, ɔsɛ kyɛ beku ye.

english_verse: You may be asking yourselves, “How can we tell if a prophet's message really comes from the Lord?”
translation_verse: Ebiaa ekobisa wɔ nwo kyɛ, ‘Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né yanwu edwirɛ bɔ nna AWURADE yeɛ ɔhane ɔ?’

english_verse: You will know, because if the Lord says something will happen, it will happen. And if it doesn't, you will know that the prophet was falsely claiming to speak for the Lord. Don't be afraid of any prophet whose message doesn't come from the Lord.
translation_verse: Tie, sɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ bie dwudwo AWURADE dumaa nu, nakoso edwirɛ ne anzi anaa wamma nu a, né ɔte edwirɛ bɔ nna AWURADE yeɛ waha ɔ. Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne wabɔ ye bɔbɔ ye ti anu yeɛ waha ɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔsuro ye.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord your God has promised that if you obey his laws and teachings I'm giving you, and if you always love him, then he will give you the land he promised your ancestors. When that happens, you must name three more Safe Towns in the new territory.
translation_verse: nakoso sana edi mmeraa dwirɛ he amukoraati bɔ méhyehyɛ méma wɔ ɛnɛ kyẽa ye aso nahorɛ nu, bɔ ekuro AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, ná ɛnate ye atee mukoraati so mmerɛ biala ɔ. Sɛ AWURADE yɔ sɔ ma wɔ a, ye nguro nza sie berɛ fa boka nguro nza nemɔ so.

english_verse: Soon you will go into the land and attack the nations. The Lord your God will destroy them and give you their lands, towns, and homes. Then after you are settled,
translation_verse: “Sɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔsɛkye maen maen bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa b’aseɛ ma wɔ ne, ná etu bɛ fi berɛ, ná ɛtena bɛ nguro ne b’awuro nemɔ nu a,

english_verse: For example, suppose you and a friend go into the forest to cut wood. You are chopping down a tree with an ax, when the ax head slips off the handle, hits your friend, and kills him. You can run to one of the Safe Towns and save your life.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie ne obiɛngo bɛkɔ eburo kyɛ bɛkwaabubu eyein, ná sɛ bɛ nu ko fa akumaa ne bɔ eyein ne anu, ma akumaa buralɛ ne tu fi ye bakaa ne anu kɔbɔ obiɛngo ne maa owu a, ye de sona bɔ wahũ obiɛngo ne ɔkora nwati kɔ nguro nemɔ ko aso kɔbɔ ye nwo adwaa.

english_verse: You don't deserve to die, since you did not mean to harm your friend. But he did get killed, and his relatives might be very angry. They might even choose one of the men from their family to track you down and kill you. If it is too far to one of the Safe Towns, the victim's relative might be able to catch you and kill you.
translation_verse: Sɛ atee ne wale a, wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne kɔfɛ ɛyaa piri paa kɔpo sona bɔ wahũ obiɛngo ne so koohu ye. Ahaa ɔnzɛ kyɛ beku sona bɔ wahũ obiɛngo ne ɔ, ofikyɛ né edwirɛ tɛɛ biala nne bɛ munyɔ b’afia.

english_verse: That's why I said there must be three Safe Towns.
translation_verse: Yiti méhyɛ wɔ kyɛ, ye nguro nza sie berɛ.

english_verse: You will need them, so innocent people won't be killed on your land while they are trying to reach a Safe Town that is too far away. You will be guilty of murder, if innocent people lose their lives because you didn't name enough Safe Towns in the land the Lord your God will give you.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ngɔma bɛngɔhã mogya bɔ odi be bengogua aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ maa ɔyɛ wɔ deɛ ne aso, ná anni mogya nwo fɔ.

english_verse: But what if you really do commit murder? Suppose one of you hates a neighbor. So you wait in a deserted place, kill the neighbor, and run to a Safe Town.
translation_verse: “Nakoso sɛ ebie pɔ obiɛngo, ná ɔtɛ ye atunu bobɔ ye ku ye, ná ɔnwati kɔ sɔ nguro nemɔ ko aso a,

english_verse: If that happens, the leaders of your town must send messengers to bring you back from the Safe Town. They will hand you over to one of the victim's relatives, who will put you to death.
translation_verse: ye de wudiniɛ ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ ye kuro mbanyi soma maa bɛkɔfa ye befi dɔ bɛba, ná bɛfa ye bewura wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne sa maa oku ye.

english_verse: Israel, for the good of the whole country, you must kill anyone who murders an innocent person. Never show mercy to a murderer! Property Lines Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nnɛnwu ye anwumvoin; tu mogya bɔ odi be nwo foɛlilɛ bo fi Yisrael, ná wayie wɔ yé. Ɛwɛenpimbinɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: In the land the Lord is giving you, there are already stones set up to mark the property lines between fields. So don't move those stones. Witnesses Must Tell the Truth Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ maa ɔyɛ wɔ deɛ ne, agyapadeɛ bɔ ekonya ye wɔ so ne, ɔyɛ a nnɛpimbi ebiɛngo wɛen bɔ daa ama mɔ bali moa bato ne. Adanzeɛlilɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: If you accuse someone of a crime, but seem to be lying,
translation_verse: Sɛ adanzewianiɛ bie di adanzeɛ fa tia ebie kyɛ wayɔ yɔleɛ tɛɛ bie a,

english_verse: then you will be punished without mercy. You will receive the same punishment the accused would have received if found guilty, whether it means losing an eye, a tooth, a hand, a foot, or even your life. Israel, the crime of telling lies in court must be punished. And when people hear what happens to witnesses that lie, everyone else who testifies in court will tell the truth.
translation_verse: Nnɛnwu ye anwumvoin: bɛkɔfa ngoa bekotua ngoa kerɛ; bɔ ɛkɔfa kɔyɛ ebie nye ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛkɔyɛ wɔ bie bekotua kerɛ ɔ; bɔ ɛkɔfa kɔyɛ ebie gye ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛkɔyɛ wɔ bie bekotua kerɛ ɔ; bɔ ɛkɔfa kɔyɛ ebie sa ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛkɔyɛ wɔ bie bekotua kerɛ ɔ; bɔ ɛkɔfa kɔyɛ ebie gya ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛkɔyɛ wɔ bie bekotua kerɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If you have to go to war, you may find yourselves facing an enemy army that is bigger than yours and that has horses and chariots. But don't be afraid! The Lord your God rescued you from Egypt, and he will help you fight.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛne wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛkwaaho koɛ, ná sɛ enwu mbɔngɔ mɔ ne teaseɛnam mɔ, ɔne ɛlɔen bɔ bɛsone bɛtra wɔ a, nnɛsuro bɛ; ofikyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔyele wɔ fili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne, ogyi wɔ si.

english_verse: Before you march into battle, a priest will go to the front of the army
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔbaagyina koɛ noa a, odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne bagyina ɛlɔen ne nyunu dwudwo kyire bɛ.

english_verse: and say, “Soldiers of Israel, listen to me! Today when you go into battle, don't be afraid of the enemy, and when you see them, don't panic.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ha hyire bɛ kyɛ, ‘Yisrael, tie, ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, ɛne wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛkwaaho koɛ. Nnɛma wɔ kunu tete wɔ, nnɛsuro, nnɛma wɔ nwo wosowoso wɔ, yeɛ nnɛma bɛ nwo suronyi tɔ wɔ so.

english_verse: The Lord your God will fight alongside you and help you win the battle.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔne ɛmɔ nate ɔ, kyɛ ɔne ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ kwaaho ma ɛmɔ, ná odi ngonim ma ɛmɔ.’

english_verse: Then the tribal officials will say to the troops: If any of you have built a new house, but haven't yet moved in, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to live in your new house.
translation_verse: “Afei ɔsɛ kyɛ mbanyi nemɔ dwudwo kyire ɛlɔen ne kyɛ, ‘Aso ebie wɔ yɛ nu bɔ wasi sua bɔ onnya ɔffa owwurale Nyameɛ sa ɔ? Osa hɔ ye awuro; anyɔ a né wawu koɛ nu amaa sona foforɛ afa sua ne wawura Nyameɛ sa.

english_verse: If any of you have planted a vineyard but haven't had your first grape harvest, you may go home. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to enjoy your grapes.
translation_verse: Aso ebie alua bobe boo bɔ onnya ollili ye mma ne bie ɔ? Osa hɔ ye awuro; anyɔ a né wawu koɛ nu amaa sona foforɛ ali moa wali ye mma ne bie.

english_verse: If any of you are engaged to be married, you may go back home and get married. It isn't right for you to die in battle and for somebody else to marry the woman you are engaged to.
translation_verse: Aso ebie abɔ brasua bie asiwa bɔ onnya oggyale ye ɔ? Osa hɔ ye awuro; anyɔ a né wawu koɛ nu amaa sona foforɛ agya braa ne.’

english_verse: When the officials are finished giving these orders, they will appoint officers to be in command of the army.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mbanyi nemɔ dwudwo kyire mmenia ne yie a, ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛyeye safohene mɔ bɔ bɛkɔlela mmenia ne noa ɔ.

english_verse: Whenever you capture towns in the land the Lord your God is giving you, be sure to kill all the people and animals.
translation_verse: Nakoso maen maen hemɔ bɛ nguro bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ maa ɔyɛ w’agyapadeɛ nen, nnɛma nu nikyee biala bɔ nwomeɛ wɔ ye nu onya ngoa.

english_verse: He has commanded you to completely wipe out the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ enua bɛ boso bɔkɔɔ: Hitifoɛ ne Amorifoɛ, Kanaanfoɛ ne Perisifoɛ, Hiwifoɛ ne Yebusifoɛ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ hyɛle wɔ ne;

english_verse: If you allow them to live, they will persuade you to worship their disgusting gods, and you will be unfaithful to the Lord.
translation_verse: ná bangyirekyire ɛmɔ ma ɛmɔanyɔ akyiwadeɛ mukoraati bɔ bɛyɔ bɛma bɛ mmosoen nemɔ bie, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanyɔ bɔne bandia AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ne.

english_verse: When you are attacking a town, don't chop down its fruit trees, not even if you have had the town surrounded for a long time. Fruit trees aren't your enemies, and they produce food that you can eat, so don't cut them down.
translation_verse: “Sɛ etua kuro bie maa ɔkyɛ, bɔ ɛne ye bɛko koɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ né afa kuro nen, nnɛfa akumaa sɛkye ye nwo mmakaa ne. Ɛkɔhora koli mmakaammaa ne bie, nakoso nnɛbubu bɛ gua. Aso eburo mmakaa bɛte mmenia bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛfa koɛ tetale bɛ ɔ?

english_verse: You may need wood to make ladders and towers to help you get over the walls and capture the town. But use only trees that you know are not fruit trees.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔba kyɛ ɛ́pepɛ mmakaa a, mmakaa bɔ ɛse kyɛ benzu mmaa bɔ bedi ne yeɛ ɛkɔhora kɔpepɛ ɔ. Bubu bɛ, fa yɛ nyinasoɛ, ná fo kɔ kuro bɔ ɔne wɔ bɛko koɛ ne anu, kɔpem kyɛ kuro berɛ ama kɔma bɛ sa so ɔ.

english_verse: Suppose the body of a murder victim is found in a field in the land the Lord your God is giving you, and no one knows who the murderer is.
translation_verse: “Aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ maa ɔyɛ wɔ deɛ ne, sɛ benwu kyɛ bahu ebie bato buro wɔ so, bɔ bannwu sona bɔ ohuni ye ne a,

english_verse: The judges and other leaders from the towns around there must find out what town is the closest to where the body was found.
translation_verse: ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ wɔ mbanyi mɔ ne wɔ ndɛenbualɛfoɛ bekoosusu kyɛbɔ atee ne si wale, fite efuin ne anwo, bɔ ɔkwaadwu nguro bɔ bepingyepingye berɛ nemɔ aso.

english_verse: The leaders from that town will go to their cattle herds and choose a young cow that has never been put to work.
translation_verse: Na kuro bɔ opingye efuin ne paa ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ nu mbanyi fa nandwie beleɛ akrɔngrɔma bɔ bɛffale ye bɛyyɔle adwuma le, bɔ bɛffale kɔnnua bɛttole ye kɔme le ɔ;

english_verse: They and some of the priests will take this cow to a nearby valley where there is a stream, but no crops. Once they reach the valley, the leaders will break the cow's neck. The priests must be there, because the Lord your God has chosen them to be his special servants at the place of worship. The Lord has chosen them to bless the people in his name and to be judges in all legal cases, whether property or injury is involved.
translation_verse: Afei Lewi bosofoɛ bɔ bɛte asɔfo ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛkɔ berɛ, ofikyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ waneanea nu waye bɛ kyɛ bégyina ye nyunu bɛ́so ye, ná bɛ́fa AWURADE dumaa béyirayira mmenia. Na bɛ noa dwirɛ yeɛ bekogyina so bekobua aporowaa ne ngondii mukoraa nwo ndɛen ɔ.

english_verse: The town leaders will wash their hands over the body of the dead cow
translation_verse: Nandwie akrɔngrɔma bɔ bebuli ye kɔme anu wɔ bɔnza ne anu ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ kuro bɔ opingye efuin ne, nu mbanyi mukoraa benwunzi bɛ sa begua ye so;

english_verse: and say, “We had no part in this murder, and we don't know who did it.
translation_verse: ná afei bɛpakye nu bɛka kyɛ, ‘Nna yɛ yeɛ yɛhane sɔ mogya he yɛguale ɔ, yeɛ yɛ nye ambɛ so kyɛ bɛ́kã bégua ɔ.

english_verse: But since an innocent person was murdered, we beg you, our Lord, to accept this sacrifice and forgive Israel. We are your people, and you rescued us. Please don't hold this crime against us.” If you obey the Lord and do these things, he will forgive Israel. Marrying a Woman Taken Prisoner in War Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Yiti mogya bɔ odi be ne, tu ye nwo foɛlilɛ bo fi wɔ nu, ofikyɛ odi kyɛ ɛyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Mmrasua bɔ bɛkye bɛ nnure ɔ

english_verse: From time to time, you men will serve as soldiers and go off to war. The Lord your God will help you defeat your enemies, and you will take many prisoners.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛne wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛko koɛ, ná AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ fa bɛ wura wɔ sa, ná ɛkye bɛ nnure,

english_verse: One of these prisoners may be a beautiful woman, and you may want to marry her. But first you must bring her into your home, and have her shave her head, cut her nails, get rid of her foreign clothes, and start wearing Israelite clothes. She will mourn a month for her father and mother, then you can marry her.
translation_verse: Afei maa ogyi ye nnure tena ne gua, ná maa ɔtena w’awuro berɛ osũ ɔse ne oni bosome ko mumua. Na ɛhe asi ne, ɛkora ne ye bɛda, ná ayɛ ohu amaa ye koso wayɛ ɛye.

english_verse: Later on, if you are not happy with the woman, you can divorce her, and she can go free. But you have slept with her as your wife, so you cannot sell her as a slave or make her into your own slave. Rights of a First-Born Son Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na nziɛ ye, sɛ wɔ nye ngye ye nwo ko a, maa ɔfa ye nwo li tɔtorɔtɔɔ ɔhɔ nekaa biala bɔ okuro ɔ. Nakoso nnɛyɛ ye atɔen de sikaa, yeɛ nnɛyɛ ye kyɛ ɔte afaneɛ, ofikyɛ afa wɔ nwo aha ye. Bamuɛbaa dibea

english_verse: Suppose a man has two wives and loves one more than the other. The first son of either wife is the man's first-born son, even if the boy's mother is the wife the man doesn't love. Later, when the man is near death and is dividing up his property, he must give a double share to his first-born son, simply because he was the first to be born. A Son Who Rebels Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ biaa ne fa braa bɔ onguro ye n’awa bamuɛbaa dibea ma ye, ná ɔma ye bɔ ole ye amukoraa nza nu ngyɛmuɛ nyɔ, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔte ye bienzua nu anwoserɛ bɔ oli moa ɔ, na bamuɛbaa dibea ne te ye deɛ. Asoserɛ ba

english_verse: A father and a mother may have a stubborn and rebellious son who refuses to obey them even after he has been punished.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ebie le baa bienzua asoserɛniɛ bɔ ommu hwee, bɔ ondie ɔse ne oni dwirɛ, bɔ bɛtea ye de, nakoso ondie bɛ dwirɛ a,

english_verse: If a son is like that, his parents must drag him to the town gate, where the leaders of the town hold their meetings.
translation_verse: ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔse ne oni bɛkye ye bɛba ye kuro berɛ mbanyi nyunu, wɔ kuro berɛ pambim ne anyunu,

english_verse: The parents will tell the leaders, “This son of ours is stubborn and never obeys. He spends all his time drinking and partying.”
translation_verse: ná bɛka bekyire ye kuro berɛ mbanyi kyɛ, ‘Yɛ wa he te asoserɛniɛ bɔ ommu hwee; yɛkã dwirɛ a ɔmva, ɔte sɛkyefoɛ ne akɔnomnzaniɛ.’

english_verse: The men of the town will stone that son to death, because they must get rid of the evil he brought into the community. Everyone in Israel will be afraid when they hear how he was punished. The Body of a Criminal Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na afei ɔsɛ kyɛ kuro berɛ ama mukoraati boro ye nyɔboɛ beku ye. Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ etu bɔne ne bo fi wɔ nu; na Yisrael mukoraati kɔte ná basuro. Mmeraa ahoroɔ biemɔ

english_verse: If a criminal is put to death, and you hang the dead body on a tree,
translation_verse: “Sɛ ebie di bɔne bie bɔ ɔfata ewue, ná beku ye bɛfa ye besinze bakaa so a,

english_verse: you must not leave it there overnight. Bury it the same day, because the dead body of a criminal hanging on a tree will bring God's curse on the land. The Lord your God is giving this land to you, so don't make it unclean by leaving the bodies of executed criminals on display.
translation_verse: nnɛyakyi ye fuin ne bakaa ne aso kɔngɔen ne amu. Sie ye sɔ kyẽa ne ala, ofikyɛ sona bɔ basinze ye bakaa so ne, Nyameɛ anoma ye. Yiti aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ maa ɔyɛ w’agyapadeɛ ne, nnɛfa efiɛ ka ye.

english_verse: If you see a cow or sheep wandering around lost, take the animal back to its owner.
translation_verse: “Sɛ enwu kyɛ eliɛngo nandwie anaa boaen ate, ná wamini a, nnɛyakyi ye maa ɔkɔ, na mmom fa ye sá kɔma ye mene.

english_verse: If the owner lives too far away, or if you don't know who the owner is, take the animal home with you and take care of it. The owner will come looking for the animal, and then you can give it back.
translation_verse: Nekaa bɔ eliɛngo ne te ne, sɛ ɔne wɔ berɛ nu twe, anaakyɛ sɛ ɛnze kaka ne mene a, ye de fa kaka ne kɔ w’awuro. Maa ɔwɔ wɔ berɛ toonn kɔpem kyɛ eliɛngo ne kɔwa kɔɔpena ye ɔ; na odi kyɛ esa fa ye nikyee ma ye.

english_verse: That's what you should do if you find anything that belongs to someone else. Do whatever you can to help, whether you find a cow or sheep or donkey or some clothing.
translation_verse: Eliɛngo afunum koso, yɔ ye sɔ ala; ye tena, anaa ye nikyee biala bɔ okomini ná ekonwu ye ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɔ ye ɔ. Nnɛyakyi ye berɛ.

english_verse: Women must not pretend to be men, and men must not pretend to be women. The Lord your God is disgusted with people who do that. Don't Take a Mother Bird Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Nnɛma brasua fa bienzua nikyee wura, yeɛ nnɛma bienzua fa brasua tena kera; ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ sɔ nningyein nen, wayɛ ye nwo akyiwadeɛ wama AWURADE.

english_verse: If you build a house, make sure to put a low wall around the edge of the flat roof. Then if someone falls off the roof and is killed, it won't be your fault. Laws against Mixing Different Things Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Sɛ esi sua foforɛ a, sua ne anwuro nekaa bɔ basamo ne, to ɛwaen fa ye nwo bra yia. Anyɔ ye sɔ, ná ebie fi so te tɔ a, mogya nwo foɛlilɛ kɔla wɔ sua ne aso.

english_verse: If you plant a vineyard, don't plant any other fruit tree or crop in it. If you do plant something else there, you must bring to the place of worship everything you harvest from the vineyard.
translation_verse: “Nnɛdua nikye foforɛ bieku wɔ wɔ bobe boo nu. Ɛyɔ sɔ a, bekole nikyee bɔ alua ne mma, ɔne bobe mmaa ne amukoraa bekofi wɔ sa nu.

english_verse: Don't hitch an ox and a donkey to your plow at the same time.
translation_verse: “Nnɛfa kɔnnua to nandwie ne afunum kɔme bɔ nu fa bɛ fundam aseɛ.

english_verse: When you weave cloth for clothing, you can use thread made of flax or wool, but not both together.
translation_verse: “Nnɛkera ɛtena bɔ bafa boaen nwiaa ne gyese babɔ nu banwo ɔ.

english_verse: And when you make a coat, sew a tassel on each of the four corners. When a Husband Accuses His Wife Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Ɛtena bɔ ɛfa gurɔ wɔ nwo ne, nwo nikyee fa sosɔ ye ahinanan nemɔ aso. Agyaa nu animguaseɛ

english_verse: Suppose a man starts hating his wife soon after they are married.
translation_verse: “Sɛ bienzua bie gya braa, ná ɔfa ye nwo ka ye, nakoso onguro ye ko,

english_verse: He might tell ugly lies about her, and say, “I married this woman, but when we slept together, I found out she wasn't a virgin.”
