translation_verse: ná ɔto ye soen, ná ogua ye nyunu ase kyɛ, ‘Ngyale sɔ braa he, nakoso mvale me nwo ngane ye nen, nikyee fee ngyire kyɛ ɔte ababunu bɔ onnwuni biaa le hɔ ɔ’ a,

english_verse: If this happens, the bride's father and mother must go to the town gate to show the town leaders the proof that the woman was a virgin.
translation_verse: ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ taluwa ne baba ne ye maame bɛfa nikyee bɔ odi adanzeɛ kyɛ taluwa ne te ababunu bekokyire kuro berɛ mbanyi wɔ pambim ne anu.

english_verse: Her father will say, “I let my daughter marry this man, but he started hating her
translation_verse: Taluwa ne baba ɔɔhã hyire mbanyi nemɔ kyɛ, ‘Mafa mma brasua mama biaa he agya, nakoso onguro ye ko.

english_verse: and accusing her of not being a virgin. But he is wrong, because here is proof that she was a virgin!” Then the bride's parents will show them the bed sheet from the woman's wedding night.
translation_verse: Na afei de po, wato ye soen. Ɔnwa: Nikyee fee ngyire kyɛ ɛwa ne te ababunu bɔ onnwuni biaa le ɔ. Nakoso ɛhe te mma n’ababunuyɛlɛ nwo adanzeɛ.’ Na ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛtrɛ nnasoɛ ne anu wɔ kuro berɛ mbanyi nyunu.

english_verse: The town leaders will beat the man with a whip
translation_verse: Afei ɔsɛ kyɛ kuro berɛ mbanyi bɛkye biaa bɔ ogyale braa ne befi ye mbire;

english_verse: But if the man was right and there is no proof that his bride was a virgin,
translation_verse: “Nakoso sɛ edwirɛ ne te nahorɛ, ná ɔda adi kyɛ saa taluwa ne wanwu biaa le a,

english_verse: the men of the town will take the woman to the door of her father's house and stone her to death. This woman brought evil into your community by sleeping with someone before she got married, and you must get rid of that evil by killing her. Laws about Illegal Sex Moses said:
translation_verse: ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛfa taluwa ne befite bɛbagyina ye baba awuro anoa nu, ma ye kuro berɛ mmienzua bɛboro ye nyɔboɛ beku ye, ofikyɛ wabɔ nyanzoen bra wɔ Yisrael, kyɛ wabɔ adwaman wɔ ɔse awuro ɔ. Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ etu bɔne ne bo fi wɔ nu.

english_verse: People of Israel, if a man is caught having sex with someone else's wife, you must put them both to death. That way, you will get rid of the evil they have done in Israel.
translation_verse: “Sɛ bɛkye bienzua bie kyɛ ɔne ebie aye bɛda a, odi kyɛ beku bɛ munyɔ: bienzua bɔ ɔne braa ne lale ne, yeɛ braa ne. Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ etu bɔne ne bo fi Yisrael.

english_verse: If a man is caught in town having sex with an engaged woman who isn't screaming for help, they both must be put to death. The man is guilty of having sex with a married woman. And the woman is guilty because she didn't call for help, even though she was inside a town and people were nearby. Take them both to the town gate and stone them to death. You must get rid of the evil they brought into your community.
translation_verse: odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛ munyɔ bɛba kuro berɛ pambim ne anu, ná ɛmɔboro bɛ nyɔboɛ beku bɛ. Ɛ́mɔhu braa ne, ofikyɛ né ɔwɔ kuro nu, nakoso wandeatea nu wamvrɛ mmenia; ɛ́mɔhu biaa ne koso, ofikyɛ wafa obiɛngo aye. Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ etu bɔne ne bo fi wɔ nu.

english_verse: If an engaged woman is raped out in the country, only the man will be put to death.
translation_verse: “Nakoso sɛ bienzua bie nwu taluwa bɔ babɔ ye asiwa wɔ eburo, ná bienzua ne kye ye ɔne ye bɛda a, ye de bienzua bɔ ɔne ye bɛlale ne ngome yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ beku ye ɔ.

english_verse: Do not punish the woman at all; she has done nothing wrong, and certainly nothing deserving death. This crime is like murder,
translation_verse: Taluwa ne de, nnɛyɔ ye hwee; taluwa ne ɔyyɔle bɔne biala bɔ ɔfata ewue ɔ, ofikyɛ, kyɛbɔ sona kɔ obiɛngo so koku ye ne, sɔ ala yeɛ sɔ dwirɛ he te ɔ.

english_verse: because the woman was alone out in the country when the man attacked her. She screamed, but there was no one to help her.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ biaa ne nwuni taluwa bɔ babɔ ye asiwa ne wɔ eburo, na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ taluwa ne teateane nu de, nakoso né ebiala nne berɛ bɔ okole ye ɔ.

english_verse: Suppose a woman isn't engaged to be married, and a man forces her to have sex with him. If he is caught,
translation_verse: “Sɛ bienzua bie nwu ababunu bɔ onnwuni biaa le ɔ, bɔ bennya bɛbbɔle ye asiwa, ná ɔkye ye ɔne ye bɛda, ná bɛkye bɛ a,

english_verse: A man must not marry a woman who was married to his father. This would be a disgrace to his father.
translation_verse: “Nnɛma bienzua biala gya ɔse aye, ná wannwu ɔse mvealeɛ nu nningyein nwo.

english_verse: If a man's private parts have been crushed or cut off, he cannot fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: “Bienzua biala bɔ ye ndɔma abɔ anaa bapɛ ye bienzua so ne, nnɛmaa ɔba AWURADE badwa nu.

english_verse: No one born outside of a legal marriage, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can fully belong to the Lord's people.
translation_verse: “Ebiala bɔ bɛbɔle adwaman bɛwole ye ne, nnɛmaa ɔba AWURADE badwa nu. Ye boso ama bɔ ɔkwaadwu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so buru po, nnɛma ebiala ba AWURADE badwa nu.

english_verse: No Ammonites or Moabites, or any of their descendants for ten generations, can become part of Israel, the Lord's people.
translation_verse: “Nnɛma Amonniɛ anaa Moaboniɛ biala ba AWURADE badwa nu. Bɛ boso ama bɔ ɔkwaadwu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so buru po, nnɛma ebiala ba AWURADE badwa nu;

english_verse: This is because when you came out of Egypt, they refused to provide you with food and water. And besides, they hired Balaam to put a curse on you.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ né ɛmɔfi Misraim bɛ́ba nen, bamva aleɛ ne nzue bamma anyia ɛmɔ ate. Asa koso Beɔ awa Balaam, bɔ ofi Petore bɔ ɔwɔ Mesopotamia ne, bɛbɔle ye paa kyɛ ɔnoma wɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord your God loves you, so he refused to listen to Balaam and turned Balaam's curse into a blessing.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ wandɛ Balaam so, na mmom AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kakyili ɛnomalɛ ne maa ɔyɛle saleɛ mane wɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kuro wɔ dwirɛ.

english_verse: Don't even think of signing a peace treaty with Moab or Ammon.
translation_verse: Nnɛpena bɛ ne asomdwee, yeɛ nnɛpena bɛ paa, mmerɛ biala bɔ ɛte ase ɔ.

english_verse: But Edomites are your relatives, and you lived as foreigners in the country of Egypt. Now you must be kind to Edomites and Egyptians
translation_verse: “Nnɛpɔ Edomniɛ, ofikyɛ ɔte eliɛma. Nnɛpɔ Misraimniɛ, ofikyɛ né ɛte ɛwɔfoɛ wɔ ye aseɛ so.

english_verse: and let their great-grandchildren become part of Israel, the Lord's people. Keep the Army Camp Acceptable Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ofi b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne aso de, bɛ bosofoɛ kora ba AWURADE badwa nu. Bɛ nwo ni lilɛ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu

english_verse: When you men go off to fight your enemies, make sure your camp is acceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛne wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛkwaaho, ná ɛkyekye asikyeleɛ a, twe wɔ nwo fi nikyee biala bɔ ɔmma wɔ nwo nde nwo.

english_verse: For example, if something happens at night that makes a man unclean and unfit for worship, he must go outside the camp and stay there
translation_verse: Sɛ bienzua bie wɔ wɔ nu bɔ ye nwo nde, ɔnate kyɛ ye nwo nzue wale kɔngɔen a, ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ ofite kɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi; nnɛmaa ɔba asikyeleɛ ne anu.

english_verse: until late afternoon. Then he must take a bath, and at sunset he can go back into camp.
translation_verse: Sɛ aleɛ baadwo a, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa nzue bia; na sɛ eyia tɔ a, ye de ɔkora sá ba asikyeleɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Set up a place outside the camp to be used as a toilet area.
translation_verse: “Pena nekaa bie wɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ bɔ ɛkɔhɔ bakaa so ɔ.

english_verse: And make sure that you have a small shovel in your equipment. When you go out to the toilet area, use the shovel to dig a hole. Then, after you relieve yourself, bury the waste in the hole.
translation_verse: Fa bakaa boka w’akodeɛ ne aso, amaa sɛ ɛkɔ bakaa so wɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ a, afa afu kumaa, na sɛ eyie a, akata so.

english_verse: You must keep your camp clean of filthy and disgusting things. The Lord is always present in your camp, ready to rescue you and give you victory over your enemies. But if he sees something disgusting in your camp, he may turn around and leave. Runaway Slaves from Other Countries Moses said:
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ natenate w’asikyeleɛ ne anu, kyɛ ɔbaale wɔ, ná ɔfa wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ wura wɔ sa ne ati, ma w’asikyeleɛ ne anu yɛ krongron, ná wannwu nikyee tɛɛ biala wɔ wɔ nu, ná wanyakyi wɔ berɛ wangɔ. Mmeraa ahoroɔ biemɔ

english_verse: When runaway slaves from other countries come to Israel and ask for protection, you must not hand them back to their owners.
translation_verse: “Sɛ kanganiɛ bie nwati fi ye mene berɛ ba wɔ berɛ a, nnesa fa ye kɔma ye mene.

english_verse: Instead, you must let them choose which one of your towns they want to live in. Don't be cruel to runaway slaves. Temple Prostitutes Moses said:
translation_verse: Maa ɔne wɔ bɛtena, wɔ wɔ berɛ, wɔ wɔ nguro nemɔ ko aso nekaa bɔ okuro kyɛ ɔkɔtena ɔ; nnɛhyɛ ye so.

english_verse: People of Israel, don't any of you ever be temple prostitutes.
translation_verse: “Nnɛma Yisrael brasua biala yɛ ye nwo asɔneyɛɛ so adwamanbɔlɛniɛ; yeɛ nnɛma Yisrael bienzua biala yɛ ye nwo asɔneyɛɛ so adwamanbɔlɛniɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God is disgusted with men and women who are prostitutes of any kind, and he will not accept a gift from them, even if it had been promised to him. Interest on Loans Moses said:
translation_verse: Brasua bɔ adwaman nya sikaa, anaakyɛ kyea bɔ adwaman nya sikaa a, nnɛfa sikaa ne ba AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ awuro batua bɔhyɛ biala, ofikyɛ bɛ munyɔ bayɛ bɛ nwo akyiwadeɛ bama AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: When you lend money, food, or anything else to another Israelite, you are not allowed to charge interest.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛfa nikyee fɛmo eliɛma Yisraelniɛ a, nnɛfa nzihoɛ si ye nwo: mekyire sikaa nwo nzihoɛ, aleɛ nwo nzihoɛ, anaa nikyee biala bɔ ɛfa fɛmo nwo nzihoɛ.

english_verse: You can charge a foreigner interest. But if you charge other Israelites interest, the Lord your God will not let you be successful in the land you are about to take. Sacred Promises to the Lord Moses said:
translation_verse: Ɛfa fɛmo amanvraniɛ a, ye de, de ye nwo nzihoɛ. Nakoso ɛfa fɛmo eliɛma Yisraelniɛ de a, ye de, nnɛde ye nwo nzihoɛ, na ɔnate so AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ koyira wɔ wɔ wɔ sa noa adwuma mukoraati nu, wɔ aseɛ bɔ ɛkwaafa tena so ne aso.

english_verse: People of Israel, if you make a sacred promise to give a gift to the Lord, then do it as soon as you can. If the Lord has to come looking for the gift you promised, you will be guilty of breaking that promise.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛhyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ a, nnɛtwetwe wɔ bo ase wɔ ye tualɛ nu; ofikyɛ ɔyɛ sɛɛ ala a AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kobisa kofi wɔ berɛ, na ɔkɔkakyi wɔ so bɔne.

english_verse: On the other hand, if you never make a sacred promise, you can't be guilty of breaking it.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ anhyɛ bɔ biala de a, ye de ɔngɔkakyi wɔ so bɔne.

english_verse: You must keep whatever promises you make to the Lord. After all, you are the one who chose to make the promises. Eating Someone Else's Produce
translation_verse: Wɔ noa dwirɛ biala, nea kyɛ ekoli so ɔ, ofikyɛ wɔ noa bɔ ɛfa hyɛle AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ne, ebiala anhyɛ wɔ so.

english_verse: If you go into a vineyard that belongs to someone else, you are allowed to eat as many grapes as you want while you are there. But don't take any with you when you leave.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛkɔ ebiɛngo bobe boo nu a, ɛkora di ye mma ne somaa bɔ ekuro ɔ ma wɔ ko yi, nakoso nnɛfa bie gua wɔ kɛndɛen nu.

english_verse: In the same way, if you are in a grain field that belongs to someone else, you can pick heads of grain and eat the kernels. But don't cut down the stalks of grain and take them with you.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛkɔ ebiɛngo aburoo boo nu a, ɛkora fa wɔ sa pomba ye mma ne bie, nakoso nnɛfa dadeɛ koateɛ bu ebiɛngo aburoo ne.

english_verse: Suppose a woman was divorced by her first husband because he found something disgraceful about her. He wrote out divorce papers, gave them to her, and sent her away.
translation_verse: “Sɛ bienzua gya braa, ná ɔba kyɛ ye nye ngye braa ne nwo, ofikyɛ wanwu nikyee tɛɛ bie wɔ braa ne anwo a, ye de odi kyɛ ɔkyerɛ agyaayiralɛ krataa wura ye sa nu, ná ogua ye wure maa ofi ye awuro berɛ kɔ.

english_verse: Later she married another man,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ofi ye awuro berɛ kogya biaa foforɛ,

english_verse: Since she has slept with her second husband, she cannot marry her first husband again. Their marriage would pollute the land that the Lord your God is giving you, and he would be disgusted. Newlyweds Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: ye de ohu bɔ oli moa, bɔ oguale ye wure maa ɔhɔle ne, atee nne berɛ kyɛ sɛ braa ne nwo agua efiɛ ayie a, osa kogya braa ne bieku ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛhe te akyiwadeɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu. Na ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɛma bɔne ba aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ maa ɔyɛ wɔ deɛ ne aso. Mmeraa biemɔ

english_verse: If a man and a woman have been married less than one year, he must not be sent off to war or sent away to do forced labor. He must be allowed to stay home for a year and be happy with his wife. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Sɛ bienzua gya braa, ná ɔhhyɛle a, ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɔkɔ koɛ, yeɛ ɔnzɛ kyɛ bɛfa maen adwuma biala begua ye so. Ole atee kyɛ ɔtena awuro afoɛ ko, ná ɔne ɔye bɔ wagya ye ne bɛgye bɛ nye.

english_verse: When you lend money to people, you are allowed to keep something of theirs as a guarantee that they will pay back the loan. But don't take one or both of their millstones, or else they may starve. They need these stones for grinding grain into flour to make bread. Kidnapping Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Nyɔboɛ ne ye nyɔkoa bɔ bɛfa beti aburoo ne, nnɛma ebiala de fa si ye berɛ awowaa, ofikyɛ ɛyɔ sɔ a, ye mene ngoa yeɛ afa asi awowaa ɔ.

english_verse: If you are guilty of kidnapping Israelites and forcing them into slavery, you will be put to death to remove this evil from the community. Skin Diseases Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Sɛ bɛkye ebie kyɛ ɔ́kye oliɛma Yisraelniɛ nnure, anaa ɔ́hyɛ ye so kyɛ kanganiɛ, anaa ɔ́yɛ ye atɔen a, ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ beku sɔ sona ne. Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ etu bɔne ne bo fi wɔ nu.

english_verse: I have told the priests what to do if any of you have leprosy, so do exactly what they say.
translation_verse: “Sɛ kwata anwonyerɛ yɛ wɔ a, nikyee biala bɔ Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛte asɔfo ne kohyire wɔ kyɛ ɛyɔ ne, nea kyɛ ɛkɔyɔ ye pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ; na kyɛbɔ mahyɛ bɛ nen, sɔ ala yeɛ yɔ ɔ.

english_verse: And remember what the Lord your God did to Miriam after you left Egypt. Loans Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Kaye nikyee bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ fa yɔle Miriam wɔ atunu, mmerɛ bɔ né ɛmɔfi Misraim bɛ́ba ne.

english_verse: Wait outside, and they will bring out the item you have agreed on.
translation_verse: Gyina aluo berɛ, ná ma sona bɔ afa nikyee afɛmo ye ne ɔfa awowaa nikyee ne ɔbrɛ wɔ.

english_verse: Suppose someone is so poor that a coat is the only thing that can be offered as a guarantee on a loan. Don't keep the coat overnight.
translation_verse: Sɛ sona ne te ehianiɛ a, nnɛfa ye tena bɔ wafa wasi awowaa ne sie ma aleɛ kye.

english_verse: Instead, give it back before sunset, so the owner can keep warm and sleep and ask the Lord to bless you. Then the Lord your God will notice that you have done the right thing. Poor People's Wages Moses said:
translation_verse: Sɛ eyia kwaatɔ a, fa awowaa nikyee ne sá kɔma ye maa onya ye tena ogurɔ ye nwo, ná óyira wɔ. Na ɔkɔyɛ yɔleɛ bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu kɔma wɔ.

english_verse: If you hire poor people to work for you, don't hold back their pay, whether they are Israelites or foreigners who live in your town.
translation_verse: “Paaniɛ ehianiɛ bɔ ye nwo aworabɔlɛ ne, nnɛsisi ye. Kyɛ ɔte Yisraelniɛ oo, anaa ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ ɔte wɔ kuro ne bie aso, wɔ w’aseɛ ne aso oo.

english_verse: Pay them their wages at the end of each day, because they live in poverty and need the money to survive. If you don't pay them on time, they will complain about you to the Lord, and he will punish you. The Death Penalty Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Kyẽa biala bɔ ɔkɔyɔ adwuma ne, tua ye kerɛ koraka né eyia atɔ, ofikyɛ ɔte ehianiɛ, na ye nyunu ne ye si ɛne. Anyɔ a, okosũ kohyire AWURADE kogua wɔ so, na ɔkɔkakyi bɔne kɔma wɔ.

english_verse: Parents must not be put to death for crimes committed by their children, and children must not be put to death for crimes committed by their parents. Don't put anyone to death for someone else's crime. Don't Mistreat the Powerless Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Nnɛmaa begyina mmaa mɔ bɛ bɔne so beku awofoɛ, yeɛ nnɛmaa begyina awofoɛ bɛ bɔne so beku mmaa; na mmom ebiala ye bɔne so yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ begyina beku ye ɔ.

english_verse: You were slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws. Leave Some of Your Harvest for the Poor Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Kaye kyɛ né ɛte kanga wɔ Misraim, na AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ lele wɔ fili berɛ; yiti méhyɛ wɔ kyɛ di sɔ dwirɛ he aso.

english_verse: If you forget to bring in a stack of harvested grain, don't go back in the field to get it. Leave it for the poor, including foreigners, orphans, and widows, and the Lord will make you successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ebu wɔ boo nu aburoo, ná wɔ wora fi aburoo bɔ akyekye ye tire tire ne bie wɔ fie ne aso a, nnesa kɔfa. Yakyi ye berɛ ma ɛwɔfoɛ, ayisiaa ne kunafoɛ, na ɔnate so AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ koyira wɔ wɔ wɔ sa noa adwuma mukoraati nu.

english_verse: When you harvest your olives, don't try to get them all for yourself, but leave some for the poor.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛte wɔ olive mmaa a, nnesa kɔtweetwee bɔ waha so ne. Yakyi ye so ma ɛwɔfoɛ, ayisiaa ne kunafoɛ.

english_verse: And when you pick your grapes, go over the vines only once, then let the poor have what is left.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛte wɔ bobe boo nu mmaa a, nnesa kɔtete ngoko ngoko bɔ waha so ne. Yakyi ye so ma ɛwɔfoɛ, ayisiaa ne kunafoɛ.

english_verse: You lived in poverty as slaves in Egypt until the Lord your God rescued you. That's why I am giving you these laws.
translation_verse: Kaye kyɛ né ɛte kanga wɔ Misraim aseɛ so; yiti méhyɛ wɔ kyɛ di sɔ dwirɛ he aso.

english_verse: Suppose you and someone else each accuse the other of doing something wrong, and you go to court, where the judges decide you are guilty. If your punishment is to be beaten with a whip, one of the judges will order you to lie down, and you will receive the number of lashes you deserve.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛbo sona bɔ odi fɔ ne a, ndɛenbualɛniɛ ne kɔmaa ɔkɔla berɛ, ná wamaa bafi ye mbire wɔ ye nyunu berɛ, somaa biala bɔ ɔfata ye bɔne ɔ.

english_verse: Forty lashes is the most that you can be given, because more than that might make other Israelites think you are worthless. Don't Muzzle an Ox Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Nnɛmaa befi ye mbire bɔ ɔbo aburanna ɔ. Sɛ befi ye mbire maa ɔtra sɔ a, né ama eliɛma ne akakyi sona mbaen bie wɔ wɔ nye so.

english_verse: Don't muzzle an ox while it is threshing grain. A Son for a Dead Brother Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: “Sɛ nandwie boro aburoo a, nnɛkyekye ye noa. Yɔ asɛdeɛ ma eliɛma bɔ wawu ɔ

english_verse: Suppose two brothers are living on the same property, when one of them dies without having a son to carry on his name. If this happens, his widow must not marry anyone outside the family. Instead, she must marry her late husband's brother, and their first son will be the legal son of the dead man.
translation_verse: Na bamuɛbaa bienzua bɔ braa ne kɔwo ye ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ biaa ne fa ye to oliɛma bɔ wawu ne, amaa ɔnate so oliɛma bɔ wawu ne dumaa boso ammini amvi Yisrael.

english_verse: But suppose the brother refuses to marry the widow. She must go to a meeting of the town leaders at the town gate and say, “My husband died without having a son to carry on his name. And my husband's brother refuses to marry me so I can have a son.”
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ biaa ne nguro kyɛ okogya oliɛma n’aye ne a, ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ kunaniɛ ne kɔ mbanyi mɔ nyunu wɔ nekaa bɔ bedi dwirɛ ɔ, ná ɔka kyɛ, ‘Me hu aliɛma ne nguro kyɛ ɔkɔma oliɛma ne dumaa kɔha Yisrael ɔ, onguro kyɛ ɔkɔyɔ huɛ aliɛmaa asɛdeɛ kɔma me ɔ.’

english_verse: The leaders will call the living brother to the town gate and try to persuade him to marry the widow. But if he doesn't change his mind and marry her,
translation_verse: Afei ɔsɛ kyɛ kuro berɛ mbanyi to bɛ sa bɛfrɛ biaa ne ná bebisa ye. Na sɛ ɔkɔ so ka kyɛ, ‘Menguro kyɛ ngogya ye’ a,

english_verse: she must go over to him while the town leaders watch. She will pull off one of his sandals and spit in his face, while saying, “That's what happens to a man who won't help provide descendants for his dead brother.”
translation_verse: ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ oliɛma n’aye ne kogyina ye nwo berɛ wɔ mbanyi nemɔ nyunu berɛ, ná opuro biaa ne gya nu mbaboa, ná ɔ́fe nwɔserɛ gua ye nyunu, ná ɔka kyɛ, ‘Sona bɔ onguro kyɛ ɔboka ma oliɛma bɔ wawu nya bosofoɛ ne, bɔ bɛfa bɛyɔ ye hɔ ɛne.’

english_verse: From then on, that man's family will be known as “the family of the man whose sandal was pulled off.” When Two Men Fight Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na bɛkɔfrɛ ye awuro wɔ Yisrael amukoraa kyɛ, ‘Biaa bɔ bɛyele ye gya nu mbaboa n’awuro.’ Mmeraa ahoroɔ

english_verse: If two men are fighting, and the wife of one man tries to rescue her husband by grabbing the other man's private parts,
translation_verse: “Sɛ mmienzua bɛ́ko, ná ko aye ba kyɛ ɔbaale ohu fi ko ne bɔ ɔ́bo ohu ne sa nu, ná braa ne buma ko ne bienzua a,

english_verse: you must cut off her hand. Don't have any mercy. Be Honest in Business Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: ye de pɛ braa ne sa fi berɛ, nnɛnwu ye anwumvoin.

english_verse: If you weigh and measure things honestly, the Lord your God will let you enjoy a long life in the land he is giving you.
translation_verse: Asusudeɛ nyɔboɛ bɔ ɔte pɛpɛɛpɛ yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ enya ɔ; asusudeɛ bɔ ɔte pɛpɛɛpɛ yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ enya ɔ, amaa ɔnate so anya ngoa tendenn wɔ aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ ne aso.

english_verse: But the Lord is disgusted with anyone who cheats or is dishonest. Wipe Out Amalek Moses said:
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ sɔ nningyein nemɔ ne, ebiala bɔ odi aminɛ nen, wayɛ ye nwo akyiwadeɛ wama AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ. Nyameɛ hyɛ kyɛ behũ Amalɛkefoɛ

english_verse: People of Israel, do you remember what the Amalekites did to you after you came out of Egypt?
translation_verse: “Kaye nikyee bɔ Amalɛkefoɛ fa yɔle wɔ wɔ atunu, mmerɛ bɔ né ɛmɔfi Misraim bɛ́ba ne;

english_verse: You were tired, and they followed along behind, attacking those who could not keep up with the others. This showed that the Amalekites have no respect for God.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ bɛwale wɔ so wɔ atunu, mmerɛ bɔ né afɛ, ná ayɛ berebrɛɛ ne. Amalɛkefoɛ huhuni Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bɛhale nziɛ ne amukoraati, ofikyɛ Amalɛkefoɛ anzuro Nyameɛ.

english_verse: The Lord your God will help you capture the land, and he will give you peace. But when that day comes, you must wipe out Amalek so completely that no one will remember they ever lived.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ma wɔ nwo tɔ wɔ fi wɔ pɔfoɛ amukoraati bɔ bapɛ wɔ nwo bayia ne sa nu, wɔ aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ maa ɔyɛ wɔ deɛ ne aso a, kyikyi Amalɛkefoɛ bɛ boso bɔkɔɔ fi ewiase. Nnɛma wɔ wora fi!

english_verse: The Lord is giving you the land, and soon you will conquer it, settle down,
translation_verse: “Aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ maa ɔyɛ wɔ deɛ ne, sɛ edwu so, wɔ sa ka ye, ná ɛtena so a,

english_verse: and plant crops. And when you begin harvesting each of your crops, the very first things you pick must be put in a basket. Take them to the place where the Lord your God chooses to be worshiped,
translation_verse: so mmakaammaa mukoraa bɔ ekoli moa kɔte ne, bɔ ekonya kofi aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ ne aso ne, fa bie gua kɛndɛen nu, ná fa kɔ nekaa bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔneanea nu kɔye kosie berɛ kyɛ ɔ́ma ye dumaa da so ne.

english_verse: and tell the priest, “Long ago the Lord our God promised our ancestors that he would give us this land. And today, I thank him for keeping his promise and giving me a share of the land.”
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo bɔ dibea wura ye sa sɔ mmerɛ nen, kɔ ye berɛ kɔha kyire ye kyɛ, ‘Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, méto me noa nu tui mekã mekyire AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kyɛ, mawa aseɛ bɔ AWURADE fa hyɛle yɛ nana mɔ bɔ kyɛ ɔkɔfa kɔma yɛ ne aso.’

english_verse: The priest will take the basket and set it in front of the Lord's altar.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔsɔfo ne de kɛndɛen ne fi wɔ sa nu, ná ɔfa sie AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne nyunu.

english_verse: Then, standing there in front of the place of worship, you must pray: My ancestor was homeless, an Aramean who went to live in Egypt. There were only a few in his family then, but they became great and powerful, a nation of many people.
translation_verse: Na wɔ koso odi kyɛ ɛkã edwirɛ he wɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu kyɛ, ‘Né me nana te Aramniɛ bɔ olle amandena ɔ, na otu ɔɔtenane Misraim yɛle berɛ wɔfoɛ. Né ɔne ye nwo ama bɛte mmenia kãa bie, nakoso me nana yɛle maen pirikua bɔ ole tumi, bɔ nu mmenia sone pee ɔ.

english_verse: The Egyptians were cruel and had no pity on us. They mistreated our people and forced us into slavery.
translation_verse: Misraimfoɛ hyɛle yɛ so, bɛteetee yɛ, na bɛmaa yɛyɔle adwuma bɔ ɔbo yɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: We called out for help to you, the Lord God of our ancestors. You heard our cries; you knew we were in trouble and abused.
translation_verse: Yɛsu yɛfrɛle AWURADE yɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne; AWURADE tele yɛ suɛ ne, onwuni kyɛ yɛyɛ anwumvo, na onwuni yɛ hawo ne y’amaneɛ ne.

english_verse: Then you terrified the Egyptians with your mighty miracles and rescued us from Egypt.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE nate tumi piri ne tumi asaa so, tumi nnwumaa, nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ so yele yɛ fili Misraim.

english_verse: You brought us here and gave us this land rich with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Wafa yɛ wawa wa, na wafa aseɛ he bɔ nyɔfonesue ne woɛ tengyɛ wɔ so ne wama yɛ.

english_verse: Now, Lord, I bring to you the best of the crops that you have given me. After you say these things, place the basket in front of the Lord's altar and bow down to worship him.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, aseɛ bɔ wɔ, AWURADE, afa ama me ne, kekesaala ye mafa so aleɛ bɔ oli moa ne mawa.’ Afei fa sie AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, ná koto AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Then you and your family must celebrate by eating a meal at the place of worship to thank the Lord your God for giving you such a good harvest. And remember to invite the Levites and the foreigners who live in your town. Ten Percent of the Harvest Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Na ɔnate nningyein paa mukoraati bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ wafa wama wɔ ne w’awuro ama ne ati, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛne Lewifoɛ ne ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ wɔ berɛ ne bedi ahurusi.

english_verse: Every year you are to give ten percent of your harvest to the Lord. But every third year, this ten percent must be given to the poor who live in your town, including Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows. That way, they will have enough to eat.
translation_verse: “Afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne anu, bɔ ɔte buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko afoɛ ne, sɛ ɛye wɔ boo nu aleɛ buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko mukoraati yie, ná ɛfa ma Lewifoɛ, ɛwɔfoɛ, ayisiaa ne akunafoɛ, maa bedi ma bɛ ko yi wɔ wɔ kuro berɛ a,

english_verse: Then you must pray: Our Lord and our God, you have said that ten percent of my harvest is sacred. I have obeyed your command and given this to the poor, including the Levites, foreigners, orphans, and widows.
translation_verse: ye de, ka ye wɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu kyɛ, ‘Ngyɛmuɛ bɔ ɔte krongron ne, maye mafi m’awuro, na mafa mama Lewifoɛ, ɛwɔfoɛ, awisiafoɛ ne akunafoɛ, kyɛbɔ wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ mukoraati bɔ ahyɛ ama me ne te ɔ. Mammu wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne anu biala so, yeɛ me wora amvi bɛ nu biala koso.

english_verse: I have not eaten any of this sacred food while I was in mourning; in fact, I never touched it when I was unclean. And none of it has been offered as a sacrifice to the spirits of the dead. I have done everything exactly as you commanded.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né médi aworabɔlɛ ne, manni bie; mmerɛ bɔ né me nwo nde ne, manye so; yeɛ mamva bie mammɔ afɔleɛ mamma awufoɛ. Matie AWURADE me Nyameɛ dwirɛ, na mayɔ bɔ ahyɛ me ne amukoraati.

english_verse: Our Lord, look down from your temple in heaven and bless us and our land. You promised our ancestors that you would give us this land rich with milk and honey, and you have kept your promise. The Lord Is Your God, and You Are His People Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: To wɔ nye fi nyameɛso, w’atenaleɛ krongron ne, ná nea aseɛnwo, ná yira wɔ mmenia ne aseɛ bɔ nyɔfonesue ne woɛ tengyɛ wɔ so, bɔ afa ama yɛ ne, kyɛbɔ ɛtale ndaen hyirele yɛ nana mɔ ne.’ AWURADE bɔbɔ ye mmenia Yisraelfoɛ

english_verse: Today the Lord your God has commanded you to obey these laws and teachings with all your heart and soul.
translation_verse: “Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔhyɛ wɔ kyɛ, di ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ hemɔ so; fa w’ahone mukoraati ne wɔ kra mukoraati di so nahorɛ nu.

english_verse: In response, you have agreed that the Lord will be your God, that you will obey all his laws and teachings, and that you will listen when he speaks to you.
translation_verse: Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, ale ato nu kyɛ AWURADE te wɔ Nyameɛ, yiti ɛkɔnate ye atee so, ekoli ye ahyɛdeɛ ne ye mmeraa dwirɛ ne ye nhyehyɛleɛ so, na ekotie ye dwirɛ.

english_verse: Since you have agreed to obey the Lord, he has agreed that you will be his people and that you will belong to him, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, AWURADE aha afa wɔ nwo kyɛ, ɛkɔyɛ ye bɔbɔ ye maen, kyɛbɔ ɔhyɛle wɔ bɔ ne, yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ edi ye mmeraa dwirɛ mukoraati so.

english_verse: The Lord created all nations, but he will make you more famous than any of them, and you will receive more praise and honor. You will belong only to the Lord your God, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate so ɔkɔpagya wɔ wɔ anidie nu, dumaa nu ne animnyam nu kɔtra maen maen bɔ wakyekye amukoraati; na ɛkɔyɛ maen krongron kɔma AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ, kyɛbɔ wahyɛ bɔ ne.”

english_verse: Moses stood together with the leaders and told the people of Israel: Obey all the laws and teachings that I am giving you today.
translation_verse: Afei Mose ne Yisrael mbanyi yɔle nhyehyɛleɛ he mane mmenia ne amukoraa kyɛ, “Mmeraa dwirɛ mukoraa bɔ ɛnɛ méhyɛ méma ɛmɔ ne, ɛ́mɔli so.

english_verse: Soon you will enter the land that the Lord your God is giving to you. He is the God your ancestors worshiped, and he has promised that this land is rich with milk and honey. After you cross the Jordan River, go to Mount Ebal. Set up large slabs of stone, then cover them with white plaster and write on them a copy of these laws.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ ɛmɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan bɛkɔ ye si a, nyɔboɛ hemɔ bɔ ɛnɛ kyẽa ye méka ye nwo dwirɛ mekyire ɛmɔ ye, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛpenapena Ebal bokaa ne aso, ná ɛmɔfa ɛfaa bɛfa ye nwo amu.

english_verse: At this same place, build an altar for offering sacrifices to the Lord your God. But don't use stones that have been cut with iron tools.
translation_verse: Fa nyɔboɛ si afɔleɛ bokyea berɛ ma AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ, nyɔboɛ bɔ nna buralɛ yeɛ bɛfa besele ɔ.

english_verse: Look for stones that can be used without being cut. Then offer sacrifices to please the Lord, burning them completely on the altar.
translation_verse: Nyɔboɛ mumua mumua yeɛ fa si AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne ɔ, ná bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ wɔ so ma AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ;

english_verse: Next, offer sacrifices to ask the Lord's blessing, and serve the meat at a sacred meal where you will celebrate in honor of the Lord.
translation_verse: bɔ asomdwee afɔleɛ, ná di ye berɛ, ná gye wɔ nye wɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: Moses stood together with the priests and said, “Israel, be quiet and listen to me! Today you have become the people of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Afei Mose ne Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛte asɔfo ne sele Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati kyɛ, “O Yisrael, ma wɔ so bra wa ná tie! Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, ayɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ maen.

english_verse: So you must obey his laws and teachings that I am giving you.”
translation_verse: Yiti tie AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, ná di ye mmeraa dwirɛ ne ye ahyɛdeɛ bɔ mehyehyɛ mema wɔ ɛnɛ ye aso. Asoserɛ nwo musue

english_verse: That same day, Moses gave them the following instructions:
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne ala, Mose yɛle sɔ nhyehyɛleɛ he mane maen ne:

english_verse: The Lord will make your businesses and your farms successful.
translation_verse: “Ɛwɔ kuro a, Nyameɛ koyira wɔ, yeɛ ɛwɔ buro koso a, okoyira wɔ.

english_verse: You will have many children. You will harvest large crops, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats will produce many young.
translation_verse: “Nyameɛ koyira wɔ maa ekonya mmaa pee, w’aseɛ so aleɛ pee, nyɛmmoa pee, nandwie mmaa pee ne mmoaen mmaa pee.

english_verse: You will have plenty of bread to eat.
translation_verse: “Nyameɛ koyira wɔ bɔ aleɛ ngɔpa wɔ kɛndɛen nu ne wɔ kukue nu ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will make you successful in your daily work.
translation_verse: “Ɛba awuro a, Nyameɛ koyira wɔ; yeɛ efite a, Nyameɛ koyira wɔ.

english_verse: The Lord your God is giving you the land, and he will make sure you are successful in everything you do. Your harvests will be so large that your storehouses will be full.
translation_verse: “AWURADE saleɛ kɔma aleɛ koyi wɔ pata so tɛkyɛɛ, na wɔ sa noa adwuma mukoraati kɔyɛ saleɛ. Okoyira wɔ wɔ aseɛ bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma wɔ ne aso.

english_verse: If you follow and obey the Lord, he will make you his own special people, just as he promised.
translation_verse: “Sɛ edi AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ so, ná ɛnate ye atee so a, AWURADE kɔfa wɔ kɔyɛ ye maen krongron, kyɛbɔ wata ye nwo ndaen wahyire wɔ ne.

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will know that you belong to the Lord, and they will be afraid of you.
translation_verse: Na aseɛ so mmenia mukoraati konwu ye kyɛ AWURADE dumaa la wɔ so, na bekosuro wɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will give you a lot of children and make sure that your animals give birth to many young. The Lord promised your ancestors that this land would be yours, and he will make it produce large crops for you.
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔma wɔ nningyein paa maa ɔkɔbo so: wɔ kunu mmaa kɔyɛ pee, wɔ nyɛmmoa kɔyɛ pee, na w’aseɛ so aleɛ kɔyɛ pee, wɔ aseɛ bɔ AWURADE tale ndaen hyirele wɔ nana mɔ kyɛ ɔkɔfa kɔma wɔ ne aso.

english_verse: The Lord will open the storehouses of the skies where he keeps the rain, and he will send rain on your land at just the right times. He will make you successful in everything you do. You will have plenty of money to lend to other nations, but you won't need to borrow any yourself.
translation_verse: AWURADE kobukye anwuro, nekaa bɔ osie ye nningyein paa ne kɔma wɔ; ɔkɔtɔ nzue kogua w’aseɛ so mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu, na okoyira wɔ sa noa adwuma mukoraati. Ɛkɔfa nningyein kɔfɛmo maen maen pee, nakoso wɔ de, ɛngɔfɛmo nikye fee ngofi ebiala berɛ.

english_verse: Obey the laws and teachings that I'm giving you today, and the Lord your God will make Israel a leader among the nations, and not a follower. Israel will be wealthy and powerful, not poor and weak.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛyɛ sotie ma AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ méhyɛ méma wɔ ɛnɛ ye, ná edi so nahorɛ nu a, ye de AWURADE kɔma wɔ so, na ɔngɔma ɛngɔhɔ ase; ekoli bɛ so, na engowura bɛ bo.

english_verse: and no one will disturb the birds and wild animals while they eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Wɔ fuin kɔyɛ ewienu nnomaa mukoraati ne aseɛ so ngaka aleɛ, na bengonya sona biala ma ɔngɔfoa bɛ.

english_verse: Then everyone will look at you and your descendants and realize that the Lord has placed you under a curse.
translation_verse: Na musue ne kɔkakyi nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ kotia wɔ ne wɔ bosofoɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Israel, today I am giving you the laws and teachings of the Lord your God. And if you don't obey them all, he will put many curses on you.
translation_verse: “Nakoso sɛ andie AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, ná anni ye mmeraa dwirɛ ne ye ahyɛdeɛ bɔ mehyɛ mema wɔ ɛnɛ ye aso nahorɛ nu a, ye de sɔ musue ye amukoraa kɔto wɔ, na okobu kɔfa wɔ so:

english_verse: Your businesses and farms will fail.
translation_verse: Musue kɔto wɔ wɔ kuro, na musue kɔto wɔ wɔ buro.

english_verse: You won't have enough bread to eat.
translation_verse: Musue kɔto wɔ kɛndɛen ne wɔ kukue.

english_verse: You'll have only a few children, your crops will be small, and your herds of cattle and flocks of sheep and goats won't produce many young.
translation_verse: Musue kɔto wɔ kunu mmaa, w’aseɛ ngɔhye aleɛ, musue kɔto wɔ nandwie mmaa ne wɔ mmoaen mmaa.

english_verse: The Lord will make you fail in everything you do.
translation_verse: Ɛba awuro a, musue kɔto wɔ; yeɛ efite a, musue kɔto wɔ.

english_verse: No matter what you try to accomplish, the Lord will confuse you, and you will feel his anger. You won't last long, and you may even meet with disaster, all because you rejected the Lord.
translation_verse: “AWURADE kɔprapra musue, amaneɛ ne anyesotanɛ kogua wɔ so wɔ nikyee biala bɔ ɛkɔyɔ ɔ nu, kɔpem kyɛ w’amumuyɛɛ ti ɔkɔsɛkye wɔ ɔ, na okohu wɔ ndɛndɛ, ofikyɛ apo me.

english_verse: He will send dust and sandstorms instead of rain, and you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Nzoen ne mvuture yeɛ AWURADE kɔtɔ kogua w’aseɛ so kyɛ nzue ɔ, na ɔkɔtɔ kofi anwuro kogua wɔ so toonn kɔpem kyɛ ekowu ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will let you be defeated by your enemies, and you will scatter in all directions. You will be a horrible sight for the other nations to see,
translation_verse: “AWURADE kɔmaa ekoli ngoguo wɔ wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ nyunu. Ɛkɔfa atee ko aso kɔhɔ bɛ so, nakoso ɛkɔfa atee ahoroɔ nzoo so ɛkɔnwati kofi bɛ nyunu. Na edwirɛ bɔ ɔkɔto wɔ ne kɔyɛ aseɛ so ahennie mukoraati nwanwa.

english_verse: You will become insane and go blind. The Lord will make you so confused,
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔfa ɛlaenbɔlɛ, anyesiniwaa ne anyesotanɛ kɔto wɔ so.

english_verse: that even in bright sunshine you will have to feel your way around like a blind person, who cannot tell day from night. For the rest of your life, people will beat and rob you, and no one will be able to stop them.
translation_verse: Ekofuafua eyia ketee kyɛbɔ anyesiniwaaniɛ fuafua kɔngɔen ɔ, nakoso engonwu atee. Bekoli wɔ aminɛ, ná bafe wɔ nningyein bafa daa, nakoso ebiala ngoole wɔ.

english_verse: Your cattle will be killed while you watch, but you won't get to eat any of the meat. Your donkeys and sheep will be stolen from you, and no one will be around to force your enemies to give them back.
translation_verse: Bekohu wɔ nandwie bɔ wɔ nye tua ɔ, nakoso engonya bie ngoli. Bɛkɔhye w’afunum bɔ wɔ nye tua ɔ, nakoso bɛngɔfa ngɔma wɔ. Bɛkɔfa wɔ boaen bɛkɔma wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ, nakoso engonya sona maa ɔngɔhã bie ngɔma wɔ.

english_verse: Your sons and daughters will be dragged off to a foreign country, while you stand there helpless. And even if you watch for them until you go blind, you will never see them again.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔsesa wɔ mma mmienzua ne mmrasua bɛkɔɔma maen foforɛ wɔ aberɛ bɔ wɔ nye tua ɔ, ɛkɔhenahena wɔ nye kɔpena bɛ alehyeleɛ biala, nakoso ɛngɔhora ngosi ye nwo ate.

english_verse: You will work hard on your farms, but everything you harvest will be eaten by foreigners, who will mistreat you and abuse you for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: W’aseɛ so aleɛ, yeɛ wɔ sa noa adwuma so mvasoɛ ne, maen bɔ ɛnze ye ne, nu ama yeɛ bekoli ɔ. Bekoli wɔ aminɛ, ná basisi wɔ daa;

english_verse: What you see will be so horrible that you will go insane,
translation_verse: na nningyein bɔ ekonwu ye wɔ nye so ne, ɔkɔbɔ kɔfa wɔ ti anu.

english_verse: and the Lord will punish you from head to toe with boils that never heal.
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔma mbɔmbɔ yeayea koangɔ kɔbobɔ wɔ nangoroma ne wɔ gya, fite wɔ gya kunu kodwu wɔ ti so.

english_verse: The Lord will let you and your king be taken captive to a country that you and your ancestors have never even heard of, and there you will have to worship idols made of wood and stone.
translation_verse: “Wɔ, ɛne sona bɔ ɛkɔfa ye koli wɔ so hene ne, AWURADE kɔsesa ɛmɔ kɔhɔ maen bɔ ɛne wɔ nana mɔ bɛnze so ɔ so, na berɛ yeɛ ɛkɔso nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ bɔ bafa mmakaa ne nyɔboɛ bayɔ ɔ.

english_verse: People of nearby countries will shudder when they see your terrible troubles, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: Maen maen mukoraati bɔ AWURADE kɔfa wɔ kɔhɔ so ne, bɔ ɔkɔto wɔ ne kɔyɛ bɛ nwanwa, na ɛmɔkɔkakyi berɛ ama mɔ bɛ noa nu anyandera ne ngorohoɛ dwirɛ.

english_verse: You will plant a lot of seed, but gather a small harvest, because locusts will eat your crops.
translation_verse: “Ekolua nningyein pee fieso, nakoso kãa bie yeɛ ekobu ɔ, ofikyɛ mmɛbɛ koli.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards and work hard at taking care of them, but you won't gather any grapes, much less get any wine, because the vines themselves will be eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Ɛkɔyɔ bobe boo, ɛkɔbɔ ye nwo, nakoso ye nzaa ne de, ɛngɔno bie, yeɛ ye mma wora ɛngɔte bie, ofikyɛ alɔponɛ koli.

english_verse: Even if your olive trees grow everywhere in your country, the olives will fall off before they are ready, and there won't be enough olive oil for combing your hair.
translation_verse: Ekonya olive mmakaa wɔ w’aseɛ so amukoraati, nakoso engonya ye ngoo ne bie ngɔfa ngɔpopa, ofikyɛ wɔ olive mma ne kɔporo kogua.

english_verse: Even your children will be taken as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: Ɛkɔwo mmaa mmienzua ne mmrasua, nakoso bɛngɔyɛ wɔ deɛ, ofikyɛ ebiemɔ kɔhye bɛ nnure.

english_verse: Locusts will eat your crops and strip your trees of leaves and fruit.
translation_verse: Ɛsaa koli wɔ mmakaa ne w’aseɛ so mmakaammaa mukoraati.

english_verse: Foreigners in your towns will become wealthy and powerful, while you become poor and powerless.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ wɔ maen nu kɔhɔ so koli mu kɔtra wɔ, nakoso wɔ de, ɛkɔhɔ so kɔbɔ ase.

english_verse: You will be so short of money that you will have to borrow from those foreigners. They will be the leaders in the community, and you will be the followers. More Curses for Disobedience Moses said:
translation_verse: Bɛkɔfa nningyein bɛkɔfɛmo wɔ, nakoso wɔ de, engonya bie ngɔfa ngɔfɛmo bɛ. Bekonya ngɔsoɛ, nakoso wɔ de, ɛkɔbɔ ase.

english_verse: Israel, if you don't obey the laws and teachings that the Lord your God is giving you, he will send these curses to chase, attack, and destroy you.
translation_verse: “Musue hemɔ amukoraati kɔto wɔ, okoli wɔ si, na okobu kɔfa wɔ so, kɔpem kyɛ ekowu ɔ, ofikyɛ andie AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, na anni ye mmeraa dwirɛ ne ye ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔhyɛ mane wɔ ne aso.

english_verse: If the Lord makes you wealthy, but you don't joyfully worship and honor him,
translation_verse: “Mmerɛ bɔ enyane wɔ nwo wɔ nikyee biala nu ne, amva anigye ne adwene paa anzo AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ,

english_verse: he will send enemies to attack you and make you their slaves. Then you will live in poverty with nothing to eat, drink, or wear, and your owners will work you to death.
translation_verse: yiti wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ AWURADE kɔsoma bɛ maa bɛkɔwa wɔ so ne, ɛkɔfa ɛhɔen ne nzuhɔen nu, wɔ nwo bɔ ɔla so nu, ɔne nningyein mukoraa bɔ okohia wɔ ɔ nu yeɛ ɛkɔso bɛ ɔ. Na AWURADE kɔfa buralɛ kɔnnua kɔto wɔ kɔme kɔpem kyɛ okohu wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Foreigners who speak a strange language will be sent to attack you without warning, just like an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔma maen bie bɔ ɔwɔ dedeede, bɔ ofi aseɛ noa dɔ ɔ, ɔkɔɔto kɔhye wɔ kyɛ kɔleɛ. Ɔkɔyɛ maen bɔ ɛnde ye dwudwolɛ ɔ,

english_verse: They won't show any mercy, and they will have no respect for old people or pity for children.
translation_verse: maen bɔ ye ti anu yɛ se, ye nye nzɔ aworowaa, ná onnwu ababunu koso anwumvoin ɔ.

english_verse: All over the land that the Lord your God gave you, the enemy army will surround your towns. You may feel safe inside your town walls, but the enemy will tear them down,
translation_verse: Ɔkɔha wɔ komia wɔ wɔ nguro ne amukoraati nu, kɔpem kyɛ wɔ fasue pindinn ndendenn ndendenn, bɔ afa wɔ nye ato so ne kodwiri kogua wɔ w’aseɛ ne amukoraati so ɔ. Ɔkɔha wɔ komia wɔ wɔ nguro ne amukoraati nu, wɔ w’aseɛ amukoraati bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ wafa wama wɔ ne aso.

english_verse: while you wait in horror. Finally, you will get so hungry that you will eat the sons and daughters that the Lord gave you.
translation_verse: “Sɛ wɔ pɔfoɛ ne tua nguro nemɔ a, ɔnate ateetee ne amaneɛ bɔ ɔkɔmaa ɔkɔto wɔ ne ati, ekohu wɔ kunu mmaa koli, wɔ mma mmienzua ne mmrasua bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ wafa wama wɔ ne, ekoli bɛ naen.

english_verse: Because of hunger, a man who had been gentle and kind will eat his own children and refuse to share the meal with his brother or wife or with his other children.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ódi ye mma nemɔ naen a, ɔngɔma bɛ nu biala bie, ofikyɛ ye aleɛ bɔ waha ala ɛne: ɔnate ateetee ne amaneɛ bɔ wɔ pɔfoɛ tua wɔ nguro nemɔ amukoraati a, ɔkɔmaa ɔkɔto wɔ ne ati.

english_verse: A woman may have grown up in such luxury that she never had to put a foot on the ground. But times will be so bad that she will secretly eat both her newborn baby and the afterbirth, without sharing any with her husband or her other children. Disobedience Brings Destruction Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: Ɔwo mmaa a, okoli ye si bɔ ɔkɔwa ne, ɔne mmaa nemɔ. Ɔkɔfea ye nwo koli, ofikyɛ ongonya aleɛ biala, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ wɔ pɔfoɛ kotua wɔ nguro nemɔ maa ɛkɔhɔ ateetee ne amaneɛ nu ne.

english_verse: You must obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Because if you don't respect the Lord,
translation_verse: “Mmeraa he anu dwirɛ mukoraati bɔ bahyerɛ ye sɔ nwomaa he anu ne, sɛ anni so nahorɛ nu, ná anzuro sɔ animnyam dumaa suronyisuronyi, bɔ ye ole AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ne a,

english_verse: like those you were so afraid of in Egypt.
translation_verse: Misraim anwonyerɛ amukoraati bɔ né esuro ne, ɔkɔmaa okosa kɔbɔ wɔ, na bɛkɔyɛ koangɔ.

english_verse: Remember! If the Lord decides to destroy your nation, he can use any disease or disaster, not just the ones written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: Asa koso, anwonyerɛ biala ne amaneɛ biala bɔ bangyerɛ ye wɔ sɔ mmeraa nwomaa he anu ne, AWURADE kɔprapra kogua wɔ so kɔpem kyɛ ekowu ɔ.

english_verse: There are as many of you now as the stars in the sky, but if you disobey the Lord your God, only a few of you will be left.
translation_verse: Daa ne de, né ɛmɔsone pee kyɛ ewienu nzramaa, nakoso ɛmɔkɔha kãa bie, ofikyɛ andie AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is happy to make you successful and to help your nation grow while you conquer the land. But if you disobey him, he will be just as happy to pull you up by your roots.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ AWURADE nye gyele kyɛ ɔkɔmaa okosi ɛmɔ yé, ná ɛmɔata pee nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ AWURADE fɛ kyɛ okohũhũ ɛmɔ, ná wama ɛmɔ boso anua ɔ. Na okotu ɛmɔ kofi aseɛ bɔ ɛkwaafa tena so ne aso.

english_verse: Those of you that survive will be scattered to every nation on earth, and you will have to worship stone and wood idols that never helped you or your ancestors.
translation_verse: “AWURADE kɔmaa ɛkɔbɔ aya wɔ maen maen mukoraati so, fite aseɛ ti kɔka ye ti; na berɛ yeɛ ɛkɔso nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ bɔ bafa mmakaa ne nyɔboɛ bayɔ ɔ, bɔ wɔ anaa wɔ nana mɔ bɛnze bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Each morning you will wake up to such terrible sights that you will say, “I wish it were night!” But at night you will be terrified and say, “I wish it were day!”
translation_verse: Aleɛ kye ngyerɛmɔ a, ɛkɔha kyɛ, ‘Me kunu a ahaa aleɛ adwo!’ yeɛ aleɛ dwo koso a, ɛkɔha kyɛ, ‘Me kunu a ahaa aleɛ ahye!’ ɔnate wɔ kunu bɔ ɔkɔtete wɔ, ɔne nningyein bɔ wɔ nye konwu ye ne ati.

english_verse: I told you never to go back to Egypt. But now the Lord himself will load you on ships and send you back. Then you will even try to sell yourselves as slaves, but no one will be interested.
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔsesa ɛmɔ kogua ɛlɛen mɔ nu kosa kɔfa ɛmɔ kɔhɔ Misraim. Ɔkɔfa ɛmɔ kɔfa atee bɔ ɔhyɛle ɛmɔ bɔ kyɛ ɛmɔ nye ngonwu ye ko ne aso; na berɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkɔyɛ bɛ nwo atɔen bɛkɔma ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ, kyɛ bɛ́fa ɛmɔ bɛ́yɛ nganga mmienzua ne mmrasua ɔ, nakoso ebiala ngɔtɔ ɛmɔ po.”

english_verse: When we first camped here, King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan attacked, but we defeated them.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔdwuli wa nen, Hesebon hene Sihon ne Basan hene Ogo fale koɛ bɛɛtetale yɛ, nakoso yɛlili bɛ so ngonim.

english_verse: Then we captured their land and divided it among the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. Keep the Agreement Moses said:
translation_verse: Yɛfale b’aseɛ ne, na yɛfa yɛmane Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue maa ɔyɛle b’agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord has made an agreement with you, and if you keep your part, you will be successful in everything you do.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔli apam he anu dwirɛ so nahorɛ nu, amaa ɔnate so bɔ ɛmɔkɔyɔ biala wasi ɛmɔ yé.

english_verse: Today everyone in our nation is standing here in the Lord's presence, including leaders and officials, parents and children, and even those foreigners who cut wood and carry water for us. We are at this place of worship to promise that we will keep our part of the agreement with the Lord our God.
translation_verse: kyɛ ɛ́fa wɔ nwo wura AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ apam ne anu, apam bɔ ndaen foa so, bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔne wɔ bɛ́yɛ ye ɛnɛ kyẽa ye;

english_verse: When we lived in Egypt, you saw the Egyptians worship disgusting idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold. Then as we traveled through other nations, you saw those people worship other disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔnwuni bɛ nningyein mɔ bɔ ɔwɔ bɛ berɛ bɔ bɛte Nyameɛ akyiwadeɛ ne: mmosoen fiɛ bɔ bafa mmakaa ne nyɔboɛ bayɔ ɔ, ɔne mmosoen bɔ bafa ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ bayɔ ɔ.

english_verse: So make sure that everyone in your tribe remains faithful to the Lord and never starts worshiping gods of other nations. If even one of you worships idols, you will be like the root of a plant that produces bitter, poisonous fruit.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea yé ná ɛmɔ nu biala, bienzua oo, brasua oo, abusua oo, anaa abusua kure oo, wandwe ye nwo ɛnɛ kyẽa ye wamvi AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ nwo, kyɛ ɔkwaaso sɔ maen maen nemɔ bɛ mmosoen nemɔ. Nnɛma ɛmɔ nu bie yɛ ye nwo bakaa weewee bɔ ye noa le ɛborɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You may be an Israelite and know all about the Lord's agreement with us, but he won't bless you if you rebel against him. You may think you can get away with it, but you will cause the rest of Israel to be punished along with you.
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔte apam ndaen he anu dwirɛ, ná ɔkɔdwene saleɛ kɔma ye nwo kyɛ, ‘Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ meyɛ asoserɛ de, nakoso ngonya asomdwee’ nen, ,

english_verse: The Lord will be furious, and instead of forgiving you, he will separate you from the other tribes. Then he will destroy you, by piling on you all the curses in The Book of God's Law, and you will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔye ye ngome twe kofi Yisrael abusua kure mukoraa nu, ná wama musue ato ye, kyɛbɔ apam ne anu musue amukoraa bɔ bahyerɛ ye mmeraa nwomaa he anu te ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will strike your country with diseases and disasters. Your descendants and foreigners from distant countries will see that your land
translation_verse: Na kyẽa bie aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ, bɔ bɛte ɛmɔ boso ama ne, ɔne ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ bekofi dedeede maen so bɛkɔwa ne, sɛ benwu amaneɛ ne anwonyerɛ worawora bɔ AWURADE ate agua aseɛ ne aso a,

english_verse: has become a scorching desert of salt and sulfur, where nothing is planted, nothing sprouts, and nothing grows. It will be as lifeless as the land around the cities of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, after the Lord became angry and destroyed them.
translation_verse: aseɛ bɔ sɔfe ne ngyee ayera ye mukoraati ɔ, bɔ bennua hwee so ɔ, bɔ nikye fee mvifi so ɔ, bɔ bakaa anaa aleɛ biala nyɛ yee wɔ so ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE fɛle ɛyaa piri sɛkyele Sodom, Gomora, Adema ne Seboyim a,

english_verse: People from other nations will ask, “Why did the Lord destroy this country? Why was he so furious?”
translation_verse: bɛ ne maen maen mukoraati kɔha kyɛ, ‘Nzu ati yeɛ AWURADE ayɛ aseɛ ye sɔa ye? Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔmane sɔ ɛyaa piri he wale ye?’

english_verse: And they will be given this answer: Our ancestors worshiped the Lord, but after he brought them out of Egypt and made an agreement with them, they rejected the agreement
translation_verse: Na bɛkɔhã kyɛ, ‘AWURADE, bɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ apam bɔ ɔne bɛ yɛle, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔɔyele bɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne, banni so ti ɔ.

english_verse: and decided to worship gods that had never helped them. The Lord had forbidden Israel to worship these gods,
translation_verse: Beelili nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ asi bɛsɔnene bɛ, nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ bɔ bɛnze bɛ ɔ, bɔ nna Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔfa mane bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and so he became furious and punished the land with all the curses in The Book of God's Law. Then he pulled up Israel by the roots and tossed them into a foreign country, where they still are today.
translation_verse: AWURADE fɛle yaa. Ole ɛyaa piri ne ɛyaa hahii yeɛ otuli bɛ fili b’aseɛ so ɔ, na waagyi bɛ wagua aseɛ foforɛ so, kyɛbɔ kekesaala ye ɔte ye.’

english_verse: The Lord our God hasn't explained the present or the future, but he has commanded us to obey the laws he gave to us and our descendants.
translation_verse: “Mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ te AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ deɛ, nakoso edwirɛ bɔ wala ye ali ne de, ɔte yɛ ne yɛ mma mɔ deɛ afebɔɔ, amaa ɔnate so yali mmeraa he anu dwirɛ amukoraati so.

english_verse: I have told you everything the Lord your God will do for you, and I've also told you the curses he will put on you if you reject him. He will scatter you in faraway countries, but when you realize that he is punishing you,
translation_verse: “Na sɛ edwirɛ he amukoraa: saleɛ ne musue bɔ mafa masie wɔ nyunu ne ba wɔ so, ná ɛkayekaye edwirɛ hemɔ wɔ maen maen mukoraa bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ wafoa wɔ wahɔ so ne aso,

english_verse: return to him with all your heart and soul and start obeying the commands I have given to you today.
translation_verse: ná esa ba AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ berɛ, ná ɛne wɔ mma mɔ bɛfa ɛmɔ ahone mukoraati ne ɛmɔ kra mukoraati bedi ye dwirɛ so, kyɛbɔ méhyɛ wɔ ɛnɛ kyẽa ye a,

english_verse: Then he will stop punishing you and treat you with kindness. He may have scattered you to the farthest countries on earth, but he will bring you back
translation_verse: Sɛ ewiase aseɛ noa dedeede dɔ po yeɛ bɛhyele wɔ nnure bɛhɔle a, AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔboaboa wɔ noa kofi berɛ, na ɔkɔɔfa wɔ kofi dɔ kɔwa.

english_verse: to the land that had belonged to your ancestors and make you even more successful and powerful than they ever were.
translation_verse: AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔfa wɔ kɔwa aseɛ bɔ wɔ nana mɔ nyane ye ne aso, na wɔ sa kɔha ye. Nyameɛ kɔmaa okoyie wɔ yé kɔtra wɔ nana mɔ, na ɛkɔta pee kɔtra bɛ.

english_verse: You and your descendants are stubborn, but the Lord will make you willing to obey him and love him with all your heart and soul, and you will enjoy a long life.
translation_verse: “AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔmaa ɛne wɔ bosofoɛ bekotie ye dwirɛ, amaa ɔnate so afa w’ahone mukoraati ne wɔ kra mukoraati ahuro AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, ná anya ngoa.

english_verse: Then the Lord your God will remove the curses from you and put them on those enemies who hate and attack you.
translation_verse: Na wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ ne bɛ bɔ bekyi wɔ, bɔ bɛtanene wɔ nye ne, AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔprapra musue he amukoraati kogua bɛ so.

english_verse: You will again obey the laws and teachings of the Lord,
translation_verse: Na afei ekosa kotie AWURADE dwirɛ, ná ali ye mmeraa dwirɛ mukoraati bɔ méhyɛ méma wɔ ɛnɛ ye aso.

english_verse: and he will bless you with many children, large herds and flocks, and abundant crops. The Lord will be happy to do good things for you, just as he did for your ancestors.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔmaa okoyie wɔ yé maa ɔkɔbo so, wɔ wɔ sa noa adwuma mukoraati nu, wɔ kunu mmaa, wɔ nyɛmmoa ne w’aseɛ so aleɛ nu; ofikyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ nye kosa kɔgye kyɛ ɔkɔmaa okoyie wɔ yé, kyɛbɔ ye nye gyele kyɛ ɔkɔmaa okoyie wɔ nana mɔ yé nen;

english_verse: But you must decide once and for all to worship him with all your heart and soul and to obey everything in The Book of God's Law. Choose Life, Not Death Moses said to Israel:
translation_verse: nakoso sana etie AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, ná edi ye mmeraa dwirɛ ne ye ahyɛdeɛ bɔ bahyerɛ ye mmeraa nwomaa he anu so; sana esa fa w’ahone mukoraati ne wɔ kra mukoraati ɛbadi AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ si koraka.

english_verse: You know God's laws, and it isn't impossible to obey them.
translation_verse: “Mmeraa dwirɛ he bɔ méhyɛ méma wɔ ɛnɛ ye, ɔnyɛ se mma wɔ, yeɛ ɔne wɔ b’afia koso wanwa.

english_verse: His commands aren't in heaven, so you can't excuse yourselves by saying, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are in heaven, and no one can go up to get them, then bring them down and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Ɔnne nyameɛso, ná aha kyɛ, ‘Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔfo kɔhɔ nyameɛso kɔma yɛ, bɔ ɔkɔɔfa kɔbrɛ yɛ maa yɛkɔte ná yali so ɔ?’

english_verse: And you can't say, “How can we obey the Lord's commands? They are across the sea, and someone must go across, then bring them back and explain them to us.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɔnne ɛpo asi dɔ, ná aha kyɛ, ‘Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔpɛ ɛpo ne kɔhɔ ye si kɔma yɛ, bɔ ɔkɔɔfa kɔbrɛ yɛ maa yɛkɔte ná yali so ɔ?’

english_verse: No, these commands are nearby and you know them by heart. All you have to do is obey!
translation_verse: Daabi, edwirɛ ne pingye wɔ paa, ɔwɔ wɔ noa nu ne w’ahone nu, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná ali so ɔ.

english_verse: Today I am giving you a choice. You can choose life and success or death and disaster.
translation_verse: “Tie, ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, mafa ngoa ne saleɛ, yeɛ ewue ne musue masie wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: Now I call the sky and the earth to be witnesses that I am offering you this choice. Will you choose for the Lord to make you prosperous and give you a long life? Or will he put you under a curse and kill you? Choose life!
translation_verse: Na ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, méfrɛ anwuro ne aseɛ maa bedi adanzeɛ bétia wɔ, kyɛ mafa ngoa ne ewue, yeɛ saleɛ ne musue masie wɔ nyunu: yiti fa ngoa, amaa ɔnate so ɛne wɔ boso ama banya ngoa.

english_verse: Be completely faithful to the Lord your God, love him, and do whatever he tells you. The Lord is the only one who can give life, and he will let you live a long time in the land that he promised to your ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Kuro AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, tie ye dwirɛ, ná fa wɔ nwo bɔ ye; ofikyɛ, sɔ yeɛ ɔkɔmaa ekonya ngoa ná anyi ahyɛ ɔ. Na ɛkɔtena aseɛ bɔ AWURADE tale ndaen kyɛ ɔkɔfa kɔma wɔ nana mɔ Abraham, Yisake ne Yakob ne aso.”

english_verse: Moses again spoke to the whole nation of Israel:
translation_verse: Afei Mose hane sɔ dwirɛ ne hyirele Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa yiele nen,

english_verse: Be brave and strong! Don't be afraid of the nations on the other side of the Jordan. The Lord your God will always be at your side, and he will never abandon you.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔgyina pindinn, ná ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ ahone yɛ se. Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro, yeɛ nnɛmɔma bɛ nwo suronyi tɔ ɛmɔ so, ofikyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ne, ye yeɛ ɔne wɔ nate ɔ. Ongoli wɔ ngasi, yeɛ ɔngɔyakyi wɔ nu.”

english_verse: Then Moses called Joshua up in front of the crowd and said: Joshua, be brave and strong as you lead these people into their land. The Lord made a promise long ago to Israel's ancestors that this land would someday belong to Israel. That time has now come, and you must divide up the land among the people.
translation_verse: Afei Mose frɛle Yosua, na osele ye wɔ Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati bɛ nyunu berɛ kyɛ, “Gyina pindinn, ná ma w’ahone yɛ se, ofikyɛ aseɛ bɔ AWURADE ata ye nwo ndaen wahyire mmenia hemɔ bɛ nana mɔ kyɛ ɔkɔfa kɔma bɛ ne, wɔ yeɛ ɛkɔfa bɛ kɔhɔ so ɔ, na wɔ yeɛ ɛkɔhyɛ kɔma bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will lead you into the land. He will always be with you and help you, so don't ever be afraid of your enemies. Read These Laws
translation_verse: AWURADE yeɛ oli wɔ nyunu ɔ; okoli wɔ si, ongoli wɔ ngasi, yeɛ ɔngɔyakyi wɔ nu. Nnɛsuro, yeɛ nnɛma wɔ kunu tete wɔ.” Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔkenga mmeraa ne afoɛ nzoo biala

english_verse: Moses wrote down all of these laws and teachings and gave them to the priests and the leaders of Israel. The priests were from the Levi tribe, and they carried the sacred chest that belonged to the Lord.
translation_verse: Afei Mose hyerɛle sɔ mmeraa he, na ɔfa mane asɔfo nemɔ, bɔ bɛte Lewi bosofoɛ bɔ bɛsoa AWURADE apam alaka ne, yeɛ afei Yisrael mbanyi amukoraati koso.

english_verse: Everyone must come—men, women, children, and even the foreigners who live in your towns. And each new generation will listen and learn to worship the Lord their God with fear and trembling and to do exactly what is said in God's Law. Israel Will Reject the Lord
translation_verse: Na ɔnate so bɛ mma mɔ, bɔ bɛnze mmeraa he nen, bɛkɔte ná basua kyɛbɔ besuro AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ɔ, mmerɛ biala bɔ ɛmɔte aseɛ bɔ yeɛ ɛ́mɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan bɛkɔɔfa ne aso ɔ.” AWURADE ne Mose ngitahoɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ

english_verse: The Lord told Moses, “You will soon die, so bring Joshua to the sacred tent, and I will appoint him the leader of Israel.” Moses and Joshua went to the sacred tent,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Ɔngɔhyɛ biala né awu. Frɛ Yosua ná ɛne ye bɛbra ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ, ná mva m’adwuma nwura ye sa.” Yiti Mose ne Yosua bɛhɔle ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ.

english_verse: and the Lord appeared in a thick cloud right over the entrance to the tent.
translation_verse: AWURADE yele ye nwo ali munungum ningɔnn nu wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu berɛ, na munungum ningɔnn ne oogyinane ɛtena sua atenaleɛ nu anoa nu berɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Moses, you will soon die. But Israel is going into a land where other gods are worshiped, and Israel will reject me and start worshiping these gods. The people will break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ, “Ɔngɔhyɛ biala, ɛkɔtoa wɔ mbanyi mɔ. Nakoso mmenia hemɔ de, Amaenmaensofoɛ nyameɛ mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ bɔ bɛ́kɔ so ne aso ne, bɛkɔbɔ adwaman bekooli bɛ si. Bɛkɔpo me, yeɛ bekobu m’apam bɔ me ne bɛ yɛyɛle ne aso.

english_verse: and I will be so furious that I will abandon them and ignore their prayers. I will send disasters and suffering that will nearly wipe them out. Finally, they will realize that the disasters happened because I abandoned them.
translation_verse: M’ahone kohu bɛ so sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔpo bɛ, ngɔye me nye ngofi bɛ so, bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ kohũhũ bɛ, na musue ne amaneɛ pee kɔtoto bɛ. Na sɔ kyẽa ne yeɛ bɛkɔhã kyɛ, ‘Aso nna yɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔnne yɛ nu wa bie ye ati yeɛ amaneɛ hemɔ atoto yɛ ye?’

english_verse: They will pray to me, but I will ignore them because they were evil and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate bɔne amukoraati bɔ bayɔ, bɔ baali nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ asi ne ati, ngɔye me nye ngofi bɛ so sɔ kyẽa ne.

english_verse: I am bringing them into the land that I promised their ancestors. It is a land rich with milk and honey, and the Israelites will have more than enough food to eat. But they will get fat and turn their backs on me and start worshiping other gods. The Israelites will reject me and break the agreement that I made with them.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, mefa bɛ mekodwu aseɛ bɔ nyɔfonesue ne woɛ tengyɛ wɔ so, bɔ ndale ndaen kyɛ ngɔfa ngɔma bɛ nana mɔ ne aso, ná bedidi ma bɛ ko yi, ná bɛyɛ mbiri mbiri a, bekooli nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ si bɛkɔso bɛ, bɛkɔpo me, ná babu m’apam ne aso.

english_verse: When I punish the Israelites and their descendants with suffering and disasters, I will remind them that they know the words to this song, so they have no excuse for not obeying me. I will give them the land that I promised, but I know the way they are going to live later on.
translation_verse: Na sɛ musue ne amaneɛ pee toto bɛ a, sɔ dwein he koli adanzeɛ kotia bɛ, ofikyɛ ongofi bɛ bosofoɛ ti anu. Na aseɛ bɔ ndale ndaen kyɛ ngɔfa ngɔma bɛ ne, anzana ngɔfa bɛ ngoodwu so ne po, mese porɛ horɛ bɔ kekesaala ye babɔ ye bɛ ti anu ɔ.”

english_verse: Moses at once wrote down the words to the song, and he taught it to the Israelites.
translation_verse: Mose hyerɛle sɔ dwein ne sɔ kyẽa ne ala, na ohyirele Yisraelfoɛ.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Be brave and strong! I will help you lead the people of Israel into the land that I have promised them.”
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE fale ye adwuma wurale Nun awa Yosua sa kyɛ, “Gyina pindinn, ná ma w’ahone yɛ se; ofikyɛ aseɛ bɔ ndale ndaen kyɛ ngɔfa ngɔma Yisraelfoɛ ne, wɔ yeɛ ɛkɔfa bɛ kɔhɔ so ɔ, na ngogyina wɔ si.

english_verse: Moses wrote down all these laws and teachings in a book,
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ Mose hyerɛle mmeraa he anu dwirɛ guale nwomaa nu yiele bɔkɔɔ nen,

english_verse: then he went to the Levites who carried the sacred chest and said:
translation_verse: Mose hyɛle Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛsoa AWURADE apam alaka ne kyɛ,

english_verse: This is The Book of God's Law. Keep it beside the sacred chest that holds the agreement the Lord your God made with Israel. This book is proof that you know what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔle mmeraa nwomaa he, ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́to AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ apam alaka ne anwo. Maa ɔla berɛ oli adanzeɛ tia wɔ.

english_verse: I know how stubborn and rebellious you and the rest of the Israelites are. You have rebelled against the Lord while I have been alive, and it will only get worse after I am gone.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mese wɔ nye bɔ ɔnzɔ nikye ɔne w’asoserɛ. Me ne ɛmɔ yɛte ase ye po yeɛ ɛmɔahwi bafa AWURADE dwirɛ so sɔa ye, na me wue asi koso ɛ!

english_verse: So call together the leaders and officials of the tribes of Israel. I will bring this book and read every word of it to you, and I will call the sky and the earth as witnesses that all of you know what you are supposed to do.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ abusua kure mbanyi mukoraati ne mbanyi mɔ bɛɛbɔ dwaa wɔ me nwo wa, ná nga edwirɛ he amukoraa ma bɛte, ná mvrɛ anwuro ne aseɛ ma beli adanzeɛ betia bɛ.

english_verse: I am going to die soon, and I know that in the future you will stop caring about what is right and what is wrong, and so you will disobey the Lord and stop living the way I told you to live. The Lord will be angry, and terrible things will happen to you. The Song of Moses
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, mese kyɛ me wue asi ne, edwirɛ tɛɛ ala yeɛ ɛmɔkoli ɔ, na mmeraa bɔ mahyɛ mama ɛmɔ ne, ɛmɔkobu so. Na musue kɔto ɛmɔ kyẽa bie, ofikyɛ ɛmɔkɔyɔ AWURADE nyunu bɔne, na ɛmɔ sa noa adwuma kɔma ye ahone kohu.” Mose dwein ne

english_verse: Moses called a meeting of all the people of Israel, so he could teach them the words to the song that the Lord had given him. And here are the words:
translation_verse: Afei Mose kengale edwein he anu dwirɛ amukoraati, fite ye ti kɔka ye bo, maa Yisrael maen ye amukoraa bɛtele.

english_verse: Earth and Sky, listen to what I say!
translation_verse: “O anwuro, yɛ asoɛ tie, na mebaadwudwo; Aseɛ, tie me noa dwirɛ ye.

english_verse: Israel, I will teach you. My words will be like gentle rain on tender young plants, or like dew on the grass.
translation_verse: Me ngyerɛkyerɛ ne ɔ́tɔ kyɛ esue, me dwudwolɛ ne ógua kyɛ bosue, ɔ́yɛ kyɛ nyenyenzue bɔ ogua ndire so ɔ, ɔne nyaanyaa so nyasue.

english_verse: Join with me in praising the wonderful name of the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngɔbɔ AWURADE dumaa dawure. Ɛ́mɔhã kyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ te piri!

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty rock, and he never does wrong. God can always be trusted to bring justice.
translation_verse: Nyɔbotaen ne, ye adwuma te pɛpɛɛpɛ, na ye atee mukoraa tengyɛ. Ɔte nahorɛ Nyameɛ, bɔ nnakannaka nne ye nu ɔ, ɔte pɛpɛɛpɛ, na ɔtengyɛ.

english_verse: But you lie and cheat and are unfaithful to him. You have disgraced yourselves and are no longer worthy to be his children.
translation_verse: Nakoso ye mma ayɔ bɔne batia ye, na ɔnate bɛ nwo ngekalewa ne ati, nna ye mma ole bɛ ko, bɛte amumuyɛɛ ne nnakannaka aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord is your Father, the one who created you, but you repaid him by being foolish.
translation_verse: Yiti akatuaa bɔ ɛfa ma AWURADE hɔ ɛne? Ngwaseafoɛ bɔ nworɛ nne bɛ ti anu ɔ! Aso nna wɔ baba bɔ ɔbɔle wɔ hɔ ɛne? Ye bɔ ɔyɔle wɔ, bɔ ɔmaa enyane nyinasoɛ ne!

english_verse: Think about past generations. Ask your parents or any of your elders. They will tell you
translation_verse: Kaye daa tete ne, ná nea afoɛ bɔ wapɛ nu wahɔ ɔ; bisa wɔ baba, na okohyire wɔ; bisa wɔ mbanyi mɔ, na bɛkɔhã bekohyire wɔ.

english_verse: that God Most High gave land to every nation. He assigned a guardian angel to each of them,
translation_verse: Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ hyɛle aseɛ mane maen maen mɔ nen, ohyirele nekaa bɔ ebiala ɔtena nen, ɔtotole maen maen nemɔ wɛen, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ mma nemɔ bɛ somaa te ɔ.

english_verse: but the Lord himself takes care of Israel.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE de, ye kyɛfa ole ye mmenia, Ye agyapadeɛ ole Yakob.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord discovered you in a barren desert filled with howling winds. God became your fortress, protecting you as though you were his own eyes.
translation_verse: “Onwuni ye wɔ ɛserɛ so, ɛserɛ pralaa suronyisuronyi so; ɔfale ye wurale ye kunu, ɔneane ye so, na ɔbɔle ye nwo waen kyɛ ye nye kyiremvua.

english_verse: The Lord was like an eagle teaching its young to fly, always ready to swoop down and catch them on its back.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ kɔleɛ si bɔ ye saen nwo waen, ná otu faafaa wɔ ye mma so, ná ɔtrɛtrɛ ye ndaa nu sesa bɛ, ná ɔsoa bɛ wɔ ye ndaa so ne,

english_verse: Israel, the Lord led you, and without the aid of a foreign god,
translation_verse: AWURADE ngome twe yeɛ ohyirele ye atee ɔ; na nyameɛ foforɛ biala wammoka ye so.

english_verse: he helped you capture the land. Your fields were rich with grain. Olive trees grew in your stony soil, and honey was found among the rocks.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔle ye atenaseɛ wɔ aseɛ ne aso mmokaa so, na ɔmane ye aseɛ ne aso aleɛ maa olili; ɔmane ye nyɔbotaen nu woɛ maa olili, ɔne nyɔboɛ aseɛ so olive ngoo,

english_verse: Your flocks and herds produced milk and yogurt, and you got choice meat from your sheep and goats that grazed in Bashan. Your wheat was the finest, and you drank the best wine.
translation_verse: ɔmane ye nandwie nyɔfonesue nye loe, ɔne boaen nyɔfonesue, mmoaen bɔ balɔ ɔ, Basan mmoaen nyii ne mbɔngye; ɔne atokoɔ paa, na ɛnone bobe mmaa nzaa bɔ bahwi ye gyengɔgyengɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, you grew fat and rebelled against God, your Creator you rejected the Mighty Rock, your only place of safety.
translation_verse: “Yakob didili mane ye ko yili, Yesurun yɛle branoa, na ɔyɛle lɔen. Ɛyɛle twɔtwɔfee, ɛyɛle piri bɔ ɛpakye ɔ. Afei ɔyakyili Nyameɛ bɔ ɔbɔle ye ne si lilɛ, na ɔpole Nyɔbotaen bɔ ɔte ye ngoalelɛ ne.

english_verse: You made God jealous and angry by worshiping disgusting idols and foreign gods.
translation_verse: Bɛsole nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ mane Nyameɛ hwene ye nwo nungunɛ, na bɛfale akyiwadeɛ behuli ye ahone.

english_verse: You offered sacrifices to demons, those useless gods that never helped you, new gods that your ancestors never worshiped.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛmane mmosoen, bɔ nna Nyameɛ ahɔ ɔ, nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ bɔ bɛnze bɛ ɔ, ɔne nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ bɔ anomasi wa ala yeɛ bɛwale ɔ, bɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ anzuro bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You turned away from God, your Creator; you forgot the Mighty Rock, the source of your life.
translation_verse: Nyɔbotaen bɔ ɔfale wɔ wale wiase ne de, andwene ye nwo, na wɔ wora fili Nyameɛ bɔ ɔwole wɔ ne.

english_verse: You were the Lord's children, but you made him angry. Then he rejected you
translation_verse: “Na AWURADE nwuni ye sɔ nen, ɔnate ye mma mmienzua ne mmrasua mɔ bɛ nwo ahi ti, ɔpole bɛ.

english_verse: and said, “You are unfaithful and can't be trusted. So I won't answer your prayers; I'll just watch and see what happens to you.
translation_verse: Na osele kyɛ, ‘Ngɔye me nye ngofi bɛ so, ná manea kyɛbɔ b’ayieleɛ kosi koyie bɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ bɛte amumuyɛɛ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ, mmaa bɔ nahorɛ nne bɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: You worshiped worthless idols, and made me jealous and angry! Now I will send a cruel and worthless nation to make you jealous and angry.
translation_verse: Bɛsole bɔ nna Nyameɛ ahɔ ɔ maa ndwene ye nwo nungunɛ, na bɛfale bɛ mmosoen fiɛ nemɔ bɛhane me anyinga. Yiti me koso, ngɔfa mmenia mbaen bie bɔ nna maen ahɔ ɔ maa bɛkɔhwe ye nwo nungunɛ, na ngɔfa ngwaseafoɛ maen ngɔhã bɛ anyinga.

english_verse: “My people, I will breathe out fire that sends you down to the world of the dead. It will scorch your farmlands and burn deep down under the mountains.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ m’ahone bɔ wahu ne asɔ see, na ogye toonn kodwu ɛborɔ ye bo dɔ, ɔyera aseɛ ne so aleɛ, na ɔfa see to mmokaa mɔ bɛ nyinasoɛ nu.

english_verse: I'll send disaster after disaster to strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: “ ‘Ngɔprapra musue ngogua bɛ so, ngɔto m’agyaen maa ɔkɔhɔ bɛ so.

english_verse: You'll be struck by starvation and deadly diseases, by the fangs of wild animals and poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔen kɔmaa bɛkɔfɔ, bɛ nwo kɔyerayera bɛ, na ewue anwonyerɛ kɔbɔ bɛ. Ngɔma ngaka aboyaa kɔɔhye bɛ koli, na ngɔma mvuture nu ewoo bɔ ye noa le borɔ kɔkeka bɛ.

english_verse: Young and old alike will be killed in the streets and terrified at home.
translation_verse: Bɛ mma kɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa wɔ dwaaso, na ɛserɛ kɔha bɛ wɔ sua nu. Mmerandeɛ ne ndaluwa kowuwu, nnɔma ne mbanyi bɔ bafu gyein koso sɔ ala.

english_verse: “I wanted to scatter you, so no one would remember that you had ever lived.
translation_verse: Ngane kyɛ, “Ngɔmaa bɛkɔbɔ aya bɛkɔhɔ dedeede, ná mama bɛ nwo ngayeɛ afi mmenia ti anu koraa.”

english_verse: But I dreaded the sound of your enemies saying, ‘We defeated Israel with no help from the Lord.’ ”
translation_verse: Nakoso né mesuro kyɛ pɔfoɛ ne kɔfa kɔhoahoa ye nwo, ofikyɛ ebiaa né bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ ande bɔ meyɔ ne abo, na bɛkɔhã kyɛ, ‘Yali ngonim; nna AWURADE yeɛ ɔyɔle sɔ nningyein he amukoraati ɔ.’

english_verse: If you did, you could see where you are headed.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛse nworɛ a, ahaa bɛkɔte ɛhe abo, ná banwu kyɛbɔ b’ayieleɛ kosi koyie bɛ ɔ!

english_verse: How could one enemy soldier chase a thousand of Israel's troops? Or how could two of theirs pursue ten thousand of ours? It can only happen if the Lord stops protecting Israel and lets the enemy win.
translation_verse: Ahaa ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né sona horɛ wahora wafoa mmenia apee, ná mmenia nyɔ ama mmenia apee buru banwati ɔ? Sana bɛ Nyɔbotaen ne waye ye sa wafi bɛ bo, sana AWURADE aye bɛ wama koraka.

english_verse: Even our enemies know that only our God is a Mighty Rock.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛ nyɔbotaen ne, ɔtte kyɛ yɛ Nyɔbotaen ne, na yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɔbɔ po bɛse.

english_verse: Our enemies are grapevines rooted in the fields of Sodom and Gomorrah. The grapes they produce are full of bitter poison;
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Sodom bobe nu yeɛ bɛ bobe fi ɔ, ofi Gomora bobe boo nu; bɛ bobe mmaa nemɔ noa te ɛborɔ, bɛ mma bɔ wasu biribiraa ne yɛ wee;

english_verse: But the Lord has written a list of their sins and locked it in his vault.
translation_verse: “Aso mmvale ɛhemɔ amukoraa nnziele, bɔ makata so wɔ nekaa bɔ mesie nningyein ɔ?

english_verse: Soon our enemies will get what they deserve— suddenly they will slip, and total disaster will quickly follow.
translation_verse: Wereɛtɔlɛ ne akatuaa te me deɛ, ɔngɔhyɛ biala, bekosoti; ofikyɛ b’amaneɛnwunɛ kyẽa ne apingye, na b’ayieleɛ ɔ́ba ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: When only a few of the Lord's people remain, when their strength is gone, and some of them are slaves, the Lord will feel sorry for them and give them justice.
translation_verse: Amba, AWURADE kobua ye mmenia be, okonwu ye ngoaa anwumvoin, mmerɛ bɔ okonwu kyɛ b’anwoserɛ ayie, bɔ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ waha, bɔ ɔte akoaa anaa dehyeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But first the Lord will say, “You ran for safety to other gods— couldn't they help you?
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE kɔha kyɛ, ‘Bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ wɔ nisua, nyɔbotaen bɔ bɛfale bɛ wora bewurale nu ne,

english_verse: You offered them wine and your best sacrifices. Can't those gods help you now or give you protection?
translation_verse: nyameɛ mɔ bɔ belili b’afɔleɛ so loe, ná bɛnone b’anonneɛ afɔleɛ nzaa nen? Ɛ́mɔma bedwɔso bɛɛboka ɛmɔ e! Ɛ́mɔma bɛ́bɔ ɛmɔ nwo waen e!

english_verse: Don't you understand? I am the only God; there are no others. I am the one who takes life and gives it again. I punished you with suffering. But now I will heal you, and nothing can stop me!
translation_verse: “Afei de, ɛ́mɔnwu ye kyɛ ME OLE YE, na nyameɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔboka me so ɔ. Me yeɛ meku, ná mesa mema ngoa ɔ; me yeɛ mepura, ná mesa mesa anwonyerɛ ɔ; na sɛ me sa sɔ ebie nu a, ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔkɔhora kole ye ɔ.

english_verse: “I make this solemn promise: Just as I live forever,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mema me sa so mekyire nyameɛso, ná meta ndaen kyɛ, Kyɛ nde ase afebɔɔ ye de,

english_verse: I will take revenge on my hateful enemies. I will sharpen my sword and let it flash like lightning.
translation_verse: sɛ mesi me ngrandɛ nahanaha ne, ná me sa sɔ nu wɔ ndɛenbualɛ nu a, ngɔtɔ me pɔfoɛ mɔ so wereɛ, na bɛ bɔ bekyi me koso, ngotua bɛ so kerɛ.

english_verse: My arrows will get drunk on enemy blood; my sword will taste the flesh and the blood of the enemy. It will kill prisoners, and cut off the heads of their leaders.”
translation_verse: Ngɔma m’agyaen kɔno mogya kɔbo, na me ngrandɛ koli naen: bɛ bɔ bawuwu ne bɛ bɔ bahye bɛ nnure mogya, ɔne pɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛ ti nwiaa afu agua bɛ nwo ɔ.’

english_verse: Tell the heavens to celebrate and all gods to bow down to the Lord, because he will take revenge on those hateful enemies who killed his people. He will forgive the sins of Israel and purify their land.
translation_verse: “O, maen maen, ɛmɔ ne ye mmenia beli ahurusi, [mmosoen amukoraa, ɛ́mɔkoto AWURADE] ofikyɛ ɔkɔtɔ ye ngoaa mɔ mogya so wereɛ, ɔkɔtɔ ye pɔfoɛ mɔ so wereɛ, [okotua bɛ bɔ bekyi ye kerɛ], ná wate aseɛ ne anwo wama ye mmenia.”

english_verse: he said, “Always remember this song I have taught you today. And let it be a warning that you must teach your children to obey everything written in The Book of God's Law.
translation_verse: osele bɛ kyɛ, “Edwirɛ bɔ ɛnɛ kyẽa ye meka mefa medi adanzeɛ metia ɛmɔ ye, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa besie ɛmɔ ti anu. Ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́tete ɛmɔ mma, amaa ɔnate so bɛ wora bali mmeraa he anu dwirɛ amukoraa so nahorɛ nu.

english_verse: The Law isn't empty words. It can give you a long life in the land that you are going to take.” Moses Will See the Land
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔtte edwirɛ mbaen biala, na mmom ɔte ɛmɔ ngoa nyamaa. Na aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔkwaapɛ asue Yɔɔdan bɛfa bɛtena so ne, sɔ edwirɛ he yeɛ ɔkɔmaa ɛmɔkɔtena so bɛkɔhyɛ ɔ.” Nyameɛ ka Mose wue nwo dwirɛ

english_verse: Later that day the Lord said to Moses:
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne ala, AWURADE sele Mose kyɛ,

english_verse: Go up into the Abarim Mountain range here in Moab across the Jordan River valley from Jericho. And when you reach the top of Mount Nebo, you will be able to see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to Israel.
translation_verse: “Fo kɔ Abarim mmokaa nemɔ aso, bɔ ɔwɔ Moabo aseɛ so ne, ná fo kɔ Nebo bokaa bɔ ɔwɔ Yeriko ndendeneɛ so ne aso, ná to wɔ nye nea Kanaan aseɛ bɔ méfa méma Yisraelfoɛ maa ɔyɛ bɛ deɛ ne.

english_verse: Then you will die and be buried on the mountaintop, just as your brother Aaron died and was buried on Mount Hor.
translation_verse: Ekowu wɔ bokaa bɔ ɛbaafo ne aso, na ɛkɔɔtoa wɔ mbanyi mɔ, kyɛbɔ eliɛma Aarɔn wuli Hɔre bokaa ne aso, ná ɔɔtoale ye mbanyi mɔ nen.
