english_verse: Both of you were unfaithful to me at Meribah Spring near Kadesh in the Zin Desert. I am God, but there in front of the Israelites, you did not treat me with the honor and respect I deserve.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ amunyɔ banni nahorɛ bamma me wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nyunu wɔ Meribate Kadese nzue nwo, wɔ Sen ɛserɛ ne aso; ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔammu me kyɛ nde krongron wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nu.

english_verse: So I will give the land to the people of Israel, but you will only get to see it from a distance.
translation_verse: Ekonwu aseɛ bɔ méfa méma Yisraelfoɛ ne kyɛ ɔla wɔ nyunu dɔ de, nakoso wɔ gya baa ngotia so.”

english_verse: Moses was a prophet, and before he died, he blessed the tribes of Israel by saying:
translation_verse: Saleɛ bɔ Nyameɛ sona Mose fa yirayirale Yisraelfoɛ koraka yeɛ owu ne ɛhe:

english_verse: The Lord came from Mount Sinai. From Edom, he gave light to his people, and his glory was shining from Mount Paran. Thousands of his warriors were with him, and fire was at his right hand.
translation_verse: Ɔnwa: “AWURADE fili Sinai wale, opukyele Sɛre kyɛ eyia tale bɛ so; ɔtale hyireinn fili Paran bokaa ne aso, ɔne krongronfoɛ apee buru yeɛ bɛwale ɔ, see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi wɔ ye sa famaa nu.

english_verse: The Lord loves the tribes of Israel, and he protects his people. They listen to his words and worship at his feet. *
translation_verse: Yoo, ohurole ye mmenia dwirɛ, ye anwoteefoɛ amukoraati bewura ye sa; bebutubutu wɔ wɔ gya bo, na bedi wɔ dwirɛ so.

english_verse: I called a meeting of the tribes of Israel and gave you God's Law.
translation_verse: Mose hyɛle mmeraa mane yɛ, kyɛ ɔte Yakob badwa agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: Tribe of Reuben, you will live, even though your tribe will always be small.
translation_verse: “Ruben abusua kure ne, mesrɛ kyɛ ɔ́tena berɛ daa, nnɛmaa ɔbɔ, yeɛ nnɛma nu mmienzua yɛ kaaba bie.”

english_verse: The Lord will listen to you, tribe of Judah, as you beg to come safely home. You fought your enemies alone; now the Lord will help you.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔha fale Yuda nwo ɛhe: “O AWURADE, tie Yuda abisadeɛ, fa ye kɔ maa ɔɔboka ye mmenia so; ko ye koɛ ma ye, ná boka ye ma oli ye pɔfoɛ mɔ so ngonim.”

english_verse: At Massah and Meribah Spring, the Lord tested you, tribe of Levi. You were faithful, and so the priesthood belongs to the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔha fale Lewi nwo ɛhe: Fa wɔ Tumim ne ma Lewi, fa wɔ Yurim ne ma wɔ krongronniɛ ne, bɔ esole ye neane wɔ Masa, ná ɛne ye perele so wɔ Meriba asue nwo ne.

english_verse: Protecting Israel's agreement with the Lord was more important to you than the life of your father or mother, or brothers or sisters, or your own children.
translation_verse: Ye bɔ ɔhane edwirɛ fale ɔse ne oni nwo kyɛ, ‘Memva bɛ menyɛ huu’; obuli ye nye guale oliɛma mɔ so, na ɔpole ye mma mɔ. Ofikyɛ Lewifoɛ lele wɔ dwirɛ bɛtole nu, na belili w’apam ne aso.

english_verse: You teach God's laws to Israel, and at the place of worship you offer sacrifices and burn incense.
translation_verse: Bekohyire Yakob wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne, ná bahyire Yisrael wɔ mmeraa ne; bɛkɔfa ayirefona bɛkɔwa wɔ nyunu, ná babɔ afɔleɛ mumua yeralɛ wɔ w’afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless everything you do, and make you strong enough to crush your enemies.
translation_verse: O AWURADE, yira Lewi agyapadeɛ so, ná ma ye sa noa adwuma sɔ wɔ nye; bubu ye pɔfoɛ mɔ dwongu, yɔ bɛ bɔ bekyi ye koso sɔ ala, ná bandwɔso ko.”

english_verse: The Lord Most High loves you, tribe of Benjamin. He will live among your hills and protect you.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔha fale Benyamin nwo ɛhe: “Ye bɔ AWURADE kuro ye dwirɛ paa ne, ɔkɔtena AWURADE nwo asomdwee nu, AWURADE kɔbɔ ye nwo waen daa biala, na ɔkɔtena AWURADE bati nemɔ afia.”

english_verse: Descendants of Joseph, the Lord will bless you with precious water from deep wells and with dew from the sky.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔha fale Yosef nwo ɛhe: “AWURADE, yira ye aseɛ, ma nyameɛso bosue guagua so, ná ma aseɛ bo dɔ nzue pu bra ɔɔloaloa so.

english_verse: Month by month, your fruit will ripen in the sunshine.
translation_verse: Maa onya aleɛ paa bɔ eyia maa beti ɔ, ɔne fieso nningyein paa bɔ bosome biala beti ɔ.

english_verse: You will have a rich harvest from the slopes of the ancient hills.
translation_verse: Ma daa tete mmokaa nemɔ bɛhye aleɛ bɛma ye, ná ma aleɛ bu wɔ mmokaa bɔ bɛwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ nemɔ aso ma ye.

english_verse: The Lord who appeared in the burning bush wants to give you the best the land can produce, and it will be a princely crown on Joseph's head.
translation_verse: Ma ye aseɛ so nningyein paa mukoraati. Mesrɛ kyɛ, Nyameɛ bɔ ɔyele ye nwo ali wɔ ngyɛkyerɛ nu ne, ɔlo ye. Ma saleɛ hemɔ amukoraati ɔ́yɛ Yosef ti so abotire, ye bɔ odi oliɛma mɔ so hene ne, maa ɔbɔ ye nwoma so.

english_verse: The armies of Ephraim and Manasseh are majestic and fierce like a bull or a wild ox. They will run their spears through faraway nations.
translation_verse: Ɔte kyɛ nandwie nyii bamuɛbaa, ole animnyam, ye mmɛen te torɔen mmɛen, ɔfa mmɛen ne si maen maen mɔ toonn, maa bɛ mukoraati bekogua aseɛ noa dɔ. Mmɛen nemɔ ole Efraim mmenia apee buru ne, yeɛ Manase mmenia apee apee ne.”

english_verse: Be happy, Zebulun, as your boats set sail; be happy, Issachar, in your tents.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔha fale Sebulɔn nwo ɛhe: “Sebulɔn, ɛpo so dwaalilɛ ne, di ahurusi wɔ nu. Yisaka, di ahurusi wɔ wɔ tena sua nu.

english_verse: The sea will make you wealthy, and from the sandy beach you will get treasure. So invite the other tribes to celebrate with you and offer sacrifices to God.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔfrɛfrɛ mmenia maa bɛkɔwa bokaa ne aso, berɛ yeɛ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔsɔ anyeɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ benya bɛ nwo befi ɛpo nu, ɔne agyapadeɛ bɔ bafa bafea anweaa nu ɔ.”

english_verse: Tribe of Gad, the Lord will bless you with more land. So shout his praises! Your tribe is like a lion ripping up its victim.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔha fale Gade nwo ɛhe: “Saleɛ te Nyameɛ bɔ ɔma Gade aseɛ trɛ ɔ deɛ! Gade suban te kyɛ gyata, ɔtete asaa ne tire nu pasaa.

english_verse: Your leaders met together and chose the best land for your tribe, but you obeyed the Lord and helped the other tribes.
translation_verse: Ɔneaneane nu yele aseɛ paa fale, ofikyɛ né berɛ te safohene kyɛfa; na maen mbanyi nemɔ bɔle dwaa nen, ɔyɔle AWURADE apɛdeɛ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ, na olili ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔfa mane Yisrael ne aso.”

english_verse: Tribe of Dan, you are like a lion cub, startled by a snake.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔha fale Dan nwo ɛhe: “Dan te gyata akrɔngrɔma, bɔ ohuruhuru fi Basan ba ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with you, people of Naphtali. He will bless you and give you the land to the west and the south.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔha fale Nafetali nwo ɛhe: “O Nafetali, bɔ AWURADE alo ye maa wabo so ɔ, bɔ wanya AWURADE saleɛ mmorosoɛ ɔ, fa aseɛ bɔ ofi mboanoa ɔkwaadwu ngwaen dɔ ne.”

english_verse: The Lord's greatest blessing is for you, tribe of Asher. You will be the favorite of all the other tribes. You will be rich with olive oil
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔha fale Asɛ nwo ɛhe: “Mesrɛ kyɛ, Nyameɛ óyira Asɛ tra mmaa nemɔ nu biala, kyɛ oliɛma nemɔ béhuro ye dwirɛ, ná ɔ́ma ye olive mmakaa su biribiraa.

english_verse: and have strong town gates with bronze and iron bolts. Your people will be powerful for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Mesrɛ kyɛ, bɔ ogyigyi wɔ pambim si ne, ɔ́yɛ buralɛ ne kɔɔbere, na kyɛbɔ wɔ ngoa tendenn te ne, sɔ ala yeɛ wɔ nwo waenbɔlɛ kɔyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, no other god is like ours— the clouds are his chariot as he rides across the skies to come and help us.
translation_verse: “Yesurun Nyameɛ ne, nyameɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ ye ɔ, ye yeɛ ɔnate ye tumi piri so fa munungum nu, ná ɔfa ewienu baboka wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The eternal God is our hiding place; he carries us in his arms. When God tells you to destroy your enemies, he will make them run.
translation_verse: Ɛdangama Nyameɛ te w’afealeɛ, ɛfea ye sa afebɔɔ ne abo, Ɔfoane pɔfoɛ ne fili wɔ nyunu, na ɔhane kyɛ, ‘Kuku bɛ!’

english_verse: Israel, you will live in safety; your enemies will be gone. The dew will fall from the sky, and you will have plenty of grain and wine.
translation_verse: Yiti Yisrael te asomdwee nu, nikye fee nha Yakob atenaleɛ, bɔ ɔwɔ aburoo ne nzaa aseɛ so ne, nekaa bɔ anwuro tɔ bosue gua ase ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has rescued you and given you more blessings than any other nation. He protects you like a shield and is your majestic sword. Your enemies will bow in fear, and you will trample on their backs.
translation_verse: O Yisrael, anya saleɛ! Nwa yeɛ ɔne wɔ bɛte pɛ ɔ? Mmenia bɔ AWURADE ale bɛ ɔ, ɔte w’akokyɛm bɔ ɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen ɔ, ɔne wɔ ngonim ngrandɛ! Wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ kɔbrɛ bɛ nwo ase wɔ wɔ nyunu, nakoso wɔ de, ekotiatia b’asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso.”

english_verse: Sometime later, Moses left the lowlands of Moab. He went up Mount Pisgah to the peak of Mount Nebo, which is across the Jordan River from Jericho. The Lord showed him all the land as far north as Gilead and the town of Dan.
translation_verse: Afei Mose fili Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso, na ɔfo hɔle Nebo bokaa ne aso, wɔ Pisiga ti afia, wɔ Yeriko ndendeneɛ so. Na AWURADE hyirele ye aseɛ ne amukoraati, fite Gileade bɔ ɔkwaadwu Dan,

english_verse: He let Moses see the territories that would soon belong to the tribes of Naphtali, Ephraim, Manasseh, and Judah, as far west as the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Nafetali amukoraati, Efraim ne Manase aseɛ, Yuda aseɛ amukoraati bɔ ɔkwaadwu eyia atɔleɛ ɛpo ne noa ne,

english_verse: The Lord also showed him the land in the south, from the valley near the town of Jericho, known as The City of Palm Trees, down to the town of Zoar.
translation_verse: ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne, ɔne aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne, bɔ ɔte ayee ayee kuro Yeriko ye bɔnza ne, bɔ ɔkwaadwu Soa.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Moses, this is the land I was talking about when I solemnly promised Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob that I would give land to their descendants. I have let you see it, but you will not cross the Jordan and go in.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele ye kyɛ, “Aseɛ he yeɛ ndale ye nwo ndaen ngyirele Abraham, Yisake ne Yakob kyɛ, ‘Wɔ bosofoɛ yeɛ ngɔfa ngɔma bɛ ɔ.’ Mama wɔ nye anwu ye, nakoso dɔ de, wɔ gya baa ngotia dɔ.”

english_verse: And so, Moses the Lord's servant died there in Moab, just as the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE somvoɛ Mose wuli dɔ wɔ Moabo aseɛ so, kyɛbɔ AWURADE noa dwirɛ te ne.

english_verse: The Lord buried him in a valley near the town of Beth-Peor, but even today no one knows exactly where.
translation_verse: Osiele ye wɔ bɔnza nu, wɔ Moabo aseɛ so, wɔ Bete Peɔ ndendeneɛ so; nakoso ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, ebiala nze nekaa bɔ ye asieleɛ wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel stayed in the lowlands of Moab, where they mourned and grieved
translation_verse: Na Yisraelfoɛ suni Mose wɔ Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso eleburasa, na ngyẽa bɔ bɛfa besuni ye ɔ, ɔne ye sɛenyɛlɛ ne wale ayieleɛ.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he had placed his hands on Joshua, and the Lord had given Joshua wisdom. The Israelites paid attention to what Joshua said and obeyed the commands that the Lord had given Moses. Moses Was a Great Prophet
translation_verse: Na nworɛ sunzum yili Nun awa Yosua ti anu tɛkyɛɛ, ofikyɛ né Mose afa ye sa wagua ye so; Yisraelfoɛ tiele Yosua dwirɛ, na belili nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ AWURADE fa mane Mose ne aso.

english_verse: There has never again been a prophet in Israel like Moses. The Lord spoke face to face with him
translation_verse: Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ foforɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ wadwɔso wɔ Yisrael bɔ ɔte kyɛ Mose ɔ. Ye yeɛ AWURADE maa ogyinane ye nyunu ɔne ye bedwudwole ɔ;

english_verse: and sent him to perform powerful miracles in the presence of the king of Egypt and his entire nation.
translation_verse: na sɔ Mose ne yeɛ AWURADE somane ye maa ɔɔyɔle nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ mukoraa wɔ Misraim aseɛ so ne. Na ɔyɔ tiale Faro ne ye mbanyi mukoraa ne ye aseɛ mukoraa.

english_verse: No one else has ever had the power to do such great things as Moses did for everyone to see.
translation_verse: Ebiala nne berɛ bɔ AWURADE afa ye so wayɔ anwanwadeɛ mbiri mbiri ne suronyisuronyi hemɔ amukoraa, kyɛbɔ Mose yɔle ye wɔ Yisraelfoɛ mukoraa nyunu ne.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, was dead. So the Lord spoke to Joshua son of Nun, who had been the assistant of Moses. The Lord said:
translation_verse: AWURADE somvoɛ Mose wue asi ne, AWURADE ha hyirele Nun awa Yosua, bɔ ɔte Mose bokafoɛ ne kyɛ,

english_verse: My servant Moses is dead. Now you must lead Israel across the Jordan River into the land I'm giving to all of you.
translation_verse: “Me somvoɛ Mose wawu. Yiti boaboa wɔ nwo kɔpɛ asue Yɔɔdan, ɛne Yisraelfoɛ hemɔ amukoraati, ná ɛmɔhɔ aseɛ bɔ méfa méma bɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Wherever you go, I'll give you that land, as I promised Moses.
translation_verse: Nekaa biala bɔ ɛmɔ gya kotia ne, mafa berɛ mama ɛmɔ, kyɛbɔ nhyɛle Mose bɔ ne.

english_verse: It will reach from the Southern Desert to the Lebanon Mountains in the north, and to the northeast as far as the great Euphrates River. It will include the land of the Hittites, and the land from here at the Jordan River to the Mediterranean Sea on the west.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ aseɛ ne fite ɛserɛ ne aso ɔne Lebanon he, toonn bɔ ɔkwaadwu asue piri Yufreti ɔne Hitifoɛ aseɛ mukoraati bɔ ɔkwaadwu Ɛpo Piri ne wɔ eyia atɔleɛ bue nu dɔ.

english_verse: Joshua, I will always be with you and help you as I helped Moses, and no one will ever be able to defeat you.
translation_verse: Sona biala ngɔhora ngogyina wɔ nyunu, mmerɛ biala bɔ ɛte ase ɔ. Na kyɛbɔ ngyinane Mose si nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ngogyina wɔ si ɔ. Mengoli wɔ ngasi, yeɛ mengɔyakyi wɔ nu.

english_verse: Long ago I promised the ancestors of Israel that I would give this land to their descendants. So be strong and brave! Be careful to do everything my servant Moses taught you. Never stop reading The Book of the Law he gave you. Day and night you must think about what it says. If you obey it completely, you and Israel will be able to take this land.
translation_verse: Nnɛyakyi Mmeraa nwomaa he kengalɛ le; na mmom dwene ye nwo alehyeleɛ ne alesaleɛ, amaa ɔnate so ali bɔ bahyerɛ ye nu amukoraati so nahorɛ nu. Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔmaa nningyein kɔhɔ so yé kɔma wɔ, ná wayie wɔ yé ɔ.

english_verse: I've commanded you to be strong and brave. Don't ever be afraid or discouraged! I am the Lord your God, and I will be there to help you wherever you go. The Eastern Tribes Promise To Help
translation_verse: Yiti méhyɛ wɔ kyɛ, gyina pindinn ná ma w’ahone yɛ se; nnɛsuro, yeɛ nnɛma wɔ kunu tete wɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ gyi wɔ si wɔ nekaa biala bɔ ɛkɔhɔ ɔ.” Yosua ma mmenia ne tu bɛ bo

english_verse: Joshua ordered the tribal leaders
translation_verse: Afei Yosua hyɛle maen mbanyi nemɔ kyɛ,

english_verse: to go through the camp and tell everyone: In a few days we will cross the Jordan River to take the land that the Lord our God is giving us. So prepare as much food as you'll need for the march into the land.
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔhyinihyini asikyeleɛ ne anu, ná ɛ́mɔfa ahyɛdeɛ he bɛ́ma mmenia ne kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ nwo bɛ́pena aleɛ bésie, ofikyɛ waha ɛlɛsa né ɛmɔkwaapɛ asue Yɔɔdan bɛkɔfa aseɛ bɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma ɛmɔ maa ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ ne.’ ”

english_verse: Joshua told the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh:
translation_verse: Na Yosua sele Rubenfoɛ ne Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue kyɛ,

english_verse: The Lord's servant Moses said that the Lord our God has given you land here on the east side of the Jordan River, where you could live in peace. Your wives and children and your animals can stay here in the land Moses gave you. But all of you that can serve in our army must pick up your weapons and lead the men of the other tribes across the Jordan River. They are your relatives, so you must help them
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ aye mɔ, ɛmɔ mma mɔ, ɔne ɛmɔ nyɛmmoa kɔha asue Yɔɔdan si aseɛ bɔ Mose fa mane ɛmɔ ne aso. Nakoso ɛmɔ nu koɛhonɛfoɛ ne amukoraa de, ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛfa b’akodeɛ bɛpɛ asue ne bedi ɛmɔ aliɛma nemɔ anyunu moa, ná bɛboka bɛ,

english_verse: conquer the land that the Lord is giving them. The Lord will give peace to them as he has given peace to you, and then you can come back and settle here in the land that Moses promised you.
translation_verse: kɔpem kyɛ AWURADE kɔbɔ ɛmɔ aliɛma nemɔ atenaseɛ asomdwee nu, kyɛbɔ wayɔ wama ɛmɔ ne, kɔpem kyɛ bɛ koso bɛ sa kɔha aseɛ bɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́fa ma bɛ ne ɔ. Ɛhe asi ne, né ɛmɔasa bawa baafa ɛmɔ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ deɛ ne, aseɛ bɔ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose fa mane ɛmɔ wɔ asue Yɔɔdan si, wɔ eyia afiteleɛ bue nu dɔ ne.”

english_verse: The men answered: We'll cross the Jordan River and help our relatives. We'll fight anywhere you send us.
translation_verse: Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ahyɛ ama yɛ ne amukoraa, yɛkɔyɔ, yeɛ nekaa biala bɔ ɛkɔha kyɛ yɛhɔ ne, yɛkɔhɔ.

english_verse: If the Lord our God will help you as he helped Moses, and if you are strong and brave, we will obey you as we obeyed Moses. We'll even put to death anyone who rebels against you or refuses to obey you.
translation_verse: Na sona biala bɔ okohwi kɔfa wɔ dwirɛ so, ná wandie wɔ dwirɛ anaa wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ biala nen, ɔsɛ kyɛ beku ye. Wɔ de, gyina pindinn ná ma w’ahone yɛ se.”

english_verse: Joshua chose two men as spies and sent them from their camp at Acacia with these instructions: “Go across the river and find out as much as you can about the whole region, especially about the town of Jericho.” The two spies left the Israelite camp at Acacia and went to Jericho, where they decided to spend the night at the house of a prostitute named Rahab.
translation_verse: Afei Nun awa Yosua somane maentetɛlɛfoɛ nyɔ kudɛɛ fili Sitim, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ bɛɛsra aseɛ ne besie, nganga Yeriko.” Yiti besili nu bɛhɔle, na bɛɛlale braa gyanderaniɛ bie bɔ oli Rahabo awuro.

english_verse: But someone found out about them and told the king of Jericho, “Some Israelite men came here tonight, and they are spies.”
translation_verse: Na ebie ɔɔbɔle Yeriko hene amaneɛ kyɛ, “Yisrael mmienzua biemɔ bawa wa ɛnɛ kɔngɔen ye kyɛ bɛbaasra y’aseɛ ye besie.”

english_verse: Rahab went back up to her roof. The spies were still awake, so she told them:
translation_verse: Anzana mmenia nyɔ ne bɛbaala ne, Rahabo hɔle bɛ nwo berɛ wɔ abuu ne aso

english_verse: I know that the Lord has given Israel this land. Everyone shakes with fear because of you.
translation_verse: oosele bɛ kyɛ, “Mese kyɛ AWURADE afa aseɛ ye wama ɛmɔ; ɛmɔ nwo suronyi atɔ yɛ so, na ɔnate ɛmɔ ti ahunundetelɛ atɔ maen he anu ama mukoraati so.

english_verse: We heard how the Lord dried up the Red Sea so you could leave Egypt. And we heard how you destroyed Sihon and Og, those two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, yate kyɛbɔ AWURADE mane Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ nu nzue wewele wɔ ɛmɔ nyunu, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né ɛmɔfi Misraim bɛ́ba ne, ɔne nikyee bɔ ɛmɔfa bɛyɔle Amorifoɛ ahemvo nyɔ nemɔ: Sihon ne Ogo, bɔ bɛwɔ asue Yɔɔdan si dɔ ne, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔhuhuni bɛ bɔkɔɔ ne.

english_verse: We know that the Lord your God rules heaven and earth, and we've lost our courage and our will to fight.
translation_verse: Yɛtele sɔ dwirɛ ne pɛ yeɛ ahunundetelɛ tɔle yɛ so ɔ, na ɔnate ɛmɔ ti yɛ mukoraati y’aba nu buli; ofikyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ne, ye ole Nyameɛ wɔ nyameɛso anwuro anwuro ne aseɛ ye aso amba.

english_verse: Please promise me in the Lord's name that you will be as kind to my family as I have been to you. Do something to show
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ mayɛ ɛmɔ paa ne ati, ɛ́mɔta AWURADE ndaen kekesaala ye, kyɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔkɔyɛ me baba awuro ama paa. Ɛ́mɔhyire me nikyee bɔ ɔkɔmaa ngole ɛmɔ ngoli,

english_verse: that you won't let your people kill my father and mother and my brothers and sisters and their families.
translation_verse: kyɛ ɛmɔngohu me baba ne me maame, nniɛma mmienzua ne mmrasua, ɔne bɛ nwo ama nu biala, na mmom ɛmɔkɔmaa yɛkonya yɛ ti yɛkodidi nu.”

english_verse: “Rahab,” the spies answered, “if you keep quiet about what we're doing, we promise to be kind to you when the Lord gives us this land. We pray that the Lord will kill us if we don't keep our promise!”
translation_verse: Na mmienzua nyɔ ne buale Rahabo kyɛ, “Sɛ yɛku ɛmɔ a, yɛ wora Nyameɛ ohu yɛ bie! Sɛ amma yɛ nwo dwirɛ amvite a, ye de AWURADE fa aseɛ ne ma yɛ a, yɛkoli nahorɛ yɛkɔma wɔ, na yɛkɔyɛ wɔ paa.”

english_verse: Rahab's house was built into the town wall, and one of the windows in her house faced outside the wall. She gave the spies a rope, showed them the window, and said, “Use this rope to let yourselves down to the ground outside the wall.
translation_verse: Afei Rahabo fale nyamaa dwurale bɛ fale mboma nu, ofikyɛ né ye sua ne wura kuro berɛ fasue ne anu, yiti fasue ne anu yeɛ né ɔte ɔ.

english_verse: Then hide in the hills. The men who are looking for you won't be able to find you there. They'll give up and come back after a few days, and you can be on your way.”
translation_verse: Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ mmokaa nemɔ anu dɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná mmenia bɔ bɛpena ɛmɔ ne bengonwu ɛmɔ ɔ. Ɛmɔɔfea dɔ ɛlɛsa, kɔpem kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛpena ɛmɔ ne kosa kɔhɔ ɔ. Na ye si ye ɛmɔkɔhora bɛkɔtoa ɛmɔ atee ne aso”

english_verse: “I'll do exactly what you said,” Rahab promised. Then she sent them on their way and tied the red rope to the window.
translation_verse: Na Rahabo buale kyɛ, “Edwirɛ bɔ ɛmɔaha ne, ɔ́yɛ sɔ ala.” Ɔmane bɛ ate, na besili nu bɛhɔle. Afei ɔfale nyamaa kɔkorɛ ne sinzele mboma ne anu.

english_verse: The spies hid in the hills for three days while the king's soldiers looked for them along the roads. As soon as the soldiers gave up and returned to Jericho,
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ nyɔ ne sili nu hɔle mmokaa ne anu dɔ, na belili berɛ ɛlɛsa, kɔpem kyɛ mmenia nemɔ sá hɔle ɔ. Né mmenia nemɔ apena bɛ dee wɔ atee ne aso, nakoso bannwu bɛ.

english_verse: the two spies went down into the Jordan valley and crossed the river. They reported to Joshua and told him everything that had happened.
translation_verse: Afei Yisraelfoɛ nyɔ ne sá torotorole mmokaa aseɛ ne bedwuli ase. Bɛpɛle asue ne, na bɛwale Nun awa Yosua berɛ bɛɛfale b’amaneɛ mukoraati bɛbɔle ye.

english_verse: “We're sure the Lord has given us the whole country,” they said. “The people there shake with fear every time they think of us.”
translation_verse: Na besele Yosua kyɛ, “Amba, AWURADE afa aseɛ ne amukoraa wawura yɛ sa. Ɔnate yɛ ti ahunundetelɛ atɔ aseɛ ne aso ama mukoraati so dada.”

english_verse: Early the next morning, Joshua and the Israelites packed up and left Acacia. They went to the Jordan River and camped there that night.
translation_verse: Yosua ne Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati bedwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ tutututu, betuli bɛ bo befili Sitim, na beedwuli asue Yɔɔdan noa. Bɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ berɛ koraka yeɛ bɛpɛ asue ne ɔ.

english_verse: Two days later their leaders went through the camp,
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛsa ne ayieleɛ, mbanyi nemɔ hyinihyini asikyeleɛ ne anu,

english_verse: shouting, “When you see some of the priests carrying the sacred chest, you'll know it is time to cross to the other side. You've never been there before, and you won't know the way, unless you follow the chest. But don't get too close! Stay about a kilometer back.”
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná ɛmɔanwu atee bɔ odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa so ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔffale atee ye aso le. Nakoso odi kyɛ ɛmɔyakyi atee kɔyɛ agyirɛ apee nyɔ bɛto ɛmɔ ne apam alaka ne afia; nnɛma ɛmɔpingye ye.”

english_verse: Joshua told the people, “Make yourselves acceptable to worship the Lord, because he is going to do some amazing things for us.”
translation_verse: Afei Yosua sele mmenia ne kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔpete ɛmɔ nwo, ofikyɛ ɛhema AWURADE kɔyɔ anwanwadeɛ wɔ ɛmɔ nu.”

english_verse: Then Joshua turned to the priests and said, “Take the chest and cross the Jordan River ahead of us.” So the priests picked up the chest by its carrying poles and went on ahead.
translation_verse: Na Yosua sele asɔfo nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔsoa apam alaka ne, ná ɛmɔse beli mmenia ne anyunu.” Yiti bɛsoale apam alaka ne, na belili mmenia ne nyunu moa.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “Beginning today I will show the people that you are their leader, and they will know that I am helping you as I helped Moses.
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Yosua kyɛ, “Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, ngɔhyɛ ye bo ngɔyɛ wɔ sona bɔ odi mu wɔ Yisraelfoɛ mukoraati bɛ nyunu, amaa ɔnate so banwu ye kyɛ, kyɛbɔ ngyinane Mose si nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ngogyina wɔ si ɔ.

english_verse: Now, tell the priests who are carrying the chest to go a little way into the river and stand there.”
translation_verse: Wɔ de, ka kyire asɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛsõ apam alaka ne kyɛ, ‘Sɛ ɛmɔdwu Yɔɔdan asue ne noa a, ɛmɔɔgyina asue ne anu dinn.’ ”

english_verse: Joshua spoke to the people: Come here and listen to what the Lord our God said he will do!
translation_verse: Afei Yosua sele Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔpingye wa beetie AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ.”

english_verse: The Canaanites, the Hittites, the Hivites, the Perizzites, the Girgashites, the Amorites, and the Jebusites control the land on the other side of the river. But the living God will be with you and will force them out of the land when you attack. And now, God is going to prove that he's powerful enough to force them out.
translation_verse: Na Yosua sele kyɛ, “Ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔmaa ɛmɔkonwu ye kyɛ Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne ogyi ɛmɔ si ɔ, na ɔkɔfoa Kanaanfoɛ, Hitifoɛ, Hiwifoɛ, Perisifoɛ, Gɛgasifoɛ, Amorifoɛ, ne Yebusifoɛ kofi ɛmɔ nyunu amba:

english_verse: Just watch the sacred chest that belongs to the Lord, the ruler of the whole earth. As soon as the priests carrying the chest step into the Jordan, the water will stop flowing and pile up as if someone had built a dam across the river. The Lord has also said that each of the twelve tribes should choose one man to represent it.
translation_verse: Asɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛsõ AWURADE bɔ ɔte aseɛ mukoraa Mene ye alaka nen, sɛ bɛ gya tia Yɔɔdan nzue ne anu pɛ a, Yɔɔdan nu nzue bɔ ɔtengyɛ fi ye sorɔ dɔ ne kɔpɛ, na ye noa kɔboa wɔ neka horɛ.”

english_verse: until they came to the Jordan River. The water in the river had risen over its banks, as it often does in springtime. But as soon as the feet of the priests touched the water,
translation_verse: Né ɔte atokoɔ telɛ mmerɛ, mmerɛ bɔ odwu a asue Yɔɔdan oyi bu fa ye boo amukoraati nu ɔ. Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ mmenia bɔ bɛsõ alaka ne dwuli Yɔɔdan noa, ná asɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛsõ alaka ne gya tiale nzue ne anu pɛ,

english_verse: the river stopped flowing, and the water started piling up at the town of Adam near Zarethan. No water flowed toward the Dead Sea, and the priests stood in the middle of the dry riverbed near Jericho while everyone else crossed over.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati bɛnate aseɛ wosee so bɛ́pɛ nu bɛ́kɔ nen, né asɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛsõ AWURADE apam alaka ne gyigyi aseɛ wosee so pindinn wɔ asue Yɔɔdan afia, kɔpem kyɛ maen ne amukoraati pɛle asue Yɔɔdan yiele ɔ.

english_verse: After Israel had crossed the Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua:
translation_verse: Maen ne amukoraati pɛle asue Yɔɔdan yiele nen, AWURADE sele Yosua kyɛ,

english_verse: Tell one man from each of the twelve tribes to pick up a large rock from where the priests are standing. Then tell the men to set up those rocks as a monument at the place where you camp tonight.
translation_verse: ná ɛmɔhã behyire bɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔsesa nyɔboɛ buru ne nyɔ béfi asue Yɔɔdan afia, nekaa bɔ né asɔfo nemɔ gyigyi pindinn ne. Ɛmɔfa bɛbra, ná ɛmɔɔfa begua nekaa bɔ ɛnɛ kɔngɔen ye ɛmɔkɔkyekye asikyeleɛ ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: and said: Go to the middle of the riverbed where the sacred chest is, and pick up a large rock. Carry it on your shoulder to our camp. There are twelve of you, so there will be one rock for each tribe.
translation_verse: Na Yosua sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔli AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ alaka ne nyunu moa bɛ́hɔ asue Yɔɔdan afia, ná ɛmɔ nu biala ɔ́fa nyɔboɛ ko ɔto ye kɔme anwo. Nyɔboɛ ko biala gyi berɛ ma Yisrael abusua kure ko,

english_verse: Someday your children will ask, “Why are these rocks here?” Then you can tell them how the water stopped flowing when the chest was being carried across the river. These rocks will always remind our people of what happened here today.
translation_verse: ɛmɔhã behyire bɛ kyɛ, Yɔɔdan nu nzue pɛle wɔ AWURADE apam alaka ne nyunu. Mmerɛ bɔ né apam alaka ne ɔ́pɛ asue Yɔɔdan nen, Yɔɔdan nu nzue pɛle. Yiti sɔ nyɔboɛ hemɔ te ngayeɛ afebɔɔ ma Yisraelfoɛ.”

english_verse: The men followed the instructions that the Lord had given Joshua. They picked up twelve rocks, one for each tribe, and carried them to the camp, where they put them down.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ lili Yosua dwirɛ ne aso. Bɛsesale nyɔboɛ buru ne nyɔ wɔ asue Yɔɔdan afia. Nyɔboɛ ko biala gyi berɛ ma abusua kure ko, kyɛbɔ AWURADE ha hyirele Yosua nen. Bɛfa bɛpɛle nu bɛwale b’asikyeleɛ berɛ, na bɛfa beguale berɛ.

english_verse: It was the tenth day of the first month of the year when Israel crossed the Jordan River. They set up camp at Gilgal, which was east of the land controlled by Jericho.
translation_verse: Bosome bɔ oli moa ne anu, ye eleburu ne aso yeɛ mmenia ne fili asue Yɔɔdan nu befite bɛwale ɔ, na bɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Gilgal, wɔ Yeriko eyia afiteleɛ.

english_verse: The men who had carried the twelve rocks from the Jordan brought them to Joshua, and they made them into a monument.
translation_verse: Na nyɔboɛ buru ne nyɔ ne, bɔ bɛsesale befili asue Yɔɔdan nu ne, Yosua fa penapenane Gilgal.

english_verse: Then Joshua told the people: Years from now your children will ask you why these rocks are here.
translation_verse: Na osele Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, “Kyẽa bie sɛ ɛmɔ mma mɔ bisa bɛ baba mɔ kyɛ, ‘Sɔ nyɔboɛ hemɔ, bɛ bo kyire sɛɛ?’ a,

english_verse: Tell them, “The Lord our God dried up the Jordan River so we could walk across. He did the same thing here for us that he did for our people at the Red Sea,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ mane Yɔɔdan nu nzue wewele mane ɛmɔ, kɔpem kyɛ ɛmɔpɛle asue ne ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ yɛle Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ ne ala, bɔ ɔmaa ɔwewele mane yɛ kɔpem kyɛ yɛpɛle asue ne ɔ.

english_verse: because he wants everyone on earth to know how powerful he is. And he wants us to worship only him.”
translation_verse: AWURADE yɔle sɔ, kyɛbɔ aseɛ so mmenia mukoraati konwu ye kyɛ AWURADE le tumi ɔ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔasuro AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ mmerɛ biala.”

english_verse: The Amorite kings west of the Jordan River and the Canaanite kings along the Mediterranean Sea lost their courage and their will to fight, when they heard how the Lord had dried up the Jordan River to let Israel go across. Israel Gets Ready To Celebrate Passover
translation_verse: Amorifoɛ ahemvo amukoraati bɔ bɛwɔ asue Yɔɔdan si eyia atɔleɛ bue nu dɔ ne, bɛ ne Kanaanfoɛ ahemvo amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ mboanoa ne, mmerɛ bɔ bɛtele kyɛ AWURADE ama Yɔɔdan nu nzue wawewe wama Yisraelfoɛ, kɔpem kyɛ bɛpɛle ye nen, ahunundetelɛ tɔle bɛ so, na ɔnate Yisraelfoɛ ti bɛ nwo ngaka nwatili. Bienzuapɛlɛ wɔ Gilgal

english_verse: While Israel was camped at Gilgal, the Lord said, “Joshua, make some flint knives and circumcise the rest of the Israelite men and boys.”
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, AWURADE sele Yosua kyɛ, “Fa twerɛboɛ yɛ dɛmaa, na Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bennya bɛppɛle bɛ bienzua ne, pɛ bɛ bienzua. Ɛhe te bienzuapɛlɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: Joshua made the knives, then circumcised those men and boys at Haaraloth Hill.
translation_verse: Yiti Yosua fale twerɛboɛ yɛle dɛmaa, na ɔpepɛle Yisraelfoɛ bienzua wɔ Gibeate Haaralɔte.

english_verse: This had to be done, because none of Israel's baby boys had been circumcised during the
translation_verse: Yiti bɛ mma bɔ Nyameɛ maa beesili bɛ gya nu ne yeɛ Yosua pɛle bɛ bienzua ɔ. Né bennya bɛppɛle bɛ bienzua, ofikyɛ bambɛ bɛ bienzua wɔ atunu.

english_verse: Everyone who had been circumcised needed time to heal, and they stayed in camp.
translation_verse: Yosua pɛle mmenia ne amukoraa bɛ bienzua yiele nen, bɛtenane asikyeleɛ ne anu berɛ kɔpem kyɛ bɛ ngena ne hɔle ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua, “It was a disgrace for my people to be slaves in Egypt, but now I have taken away that disgrace.” So the Israelites named the place Gilgal, and it still has that name.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Yosua kyɛ, “Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, maprapra Misraim animguaseɛ mafi ɛmɔ so.” Yiti bɛfrɛ berɛ Gilgal maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

english_verse: Israel continued to camp at Gilgal in the desert near Jericho, and on the fourteenth day of the same month, they celebrated Passover.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né Yisraelfoɛ wɔ asikyeleɛ berɛ wɔ Gilgal nen, bosome ne anu kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nna ne, ye nɔsoa ne, belili Abɔtra ne wɔ Yeriko aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso.

english_verse: The next day, God stopped sending the Israelites manna to eat each morning, and they started eating food grown in the land of Canaan. They ate roasted grain and thin bread made of the barley they had gathered from nearby fields. Israel Captures Jericho
translation_verse: Kyẽa bɔ belili aseɛ ne aso aleɛ ne, mana ne yakyili tɔlɛ, yiti Yisraelfoɛ annya mana ko; na mmom belili Kanaan aseɛ ne aso aleɛ sɔ afoɛ ne. Yosua ne AWURADE lɔen so safohene ne

english_verse: One day, Joshua was near Jericho when he saw a man standing some distance in front of him. The man was holding a sword, so Joshua walked up to him and asked, “Are you on our side or on our enemies' side?”
translation_verse: Ɛlɛho bie, né Yosua wɔ nekaa bie bɔ opingye Yeriko. Ɔmane ye ti so, na mvum nu, onwuni biaa bie bɔ wahwe ngrandɛ watira ɔ kyɛ ogyi ye nyunu berɛ. Na Yosua hɔle ye nwo berɛ oobisale ye kyɛ, “Ɛboka yɛ so, anaa ɛboka yɛ pɔfoɛ nemɔ so?”

english_verse: “Neither,” he answered. “I am here because I am the commander of the Lord's army.” Joshua fell to his knees and bowed down to the ground. “I am your servant,” he said. “Tell me what to do.”
translation_verse: Na obuale kyɛ, “Nna nu biala ɔ, na mmom nde AWURADE lɔen so safohene bɔ afei mawa ɔ.” Yosua fale ye nyunu butuli berɛ sɔnene ye, na obisale ye kyɛ, “Me mene, nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ ele ye ma w’akoaa ɔ?”

english_verse: “Take off your sandals,” the commander answered. “This is a holy place.” So Joshua took off his sandals.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE lɔen so safohene ne buale Yosua kyɛ, “Puropuro wɔ gya nu mbaboa ne, ofikyɛ nekaa bɔ egyi ne te krongron.” Na Yosua yɔle sɔ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Jericho had been locking the gates in their town wall because they were afraid of the Israelites. No one could go out or come in.
translation_verse: Ɔnate Yisraelfoɛ ti, né Yerikofoɛ bafa nikyee babrambram kuro berɛ pambim nemɔ asi batoto nu, bɔ ebiala ngora mvi nu mvite anaakyɛ onwura nu ɔ.

english_verse: Take along the sacred chest and tell seven priests to walk in front of it, carrying trumpets. But on the seventh day, march slowly around the town seven times while the priests blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Ma asɔfo nzoo bɛfa boaen mmɛen totorobɛndo nzoo beli alaka ne nyunu moa. Na kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo nen, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ kuro ne anwo nzra bɛbra beyia pɛen nzoo, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ asɔfo nemɔ koso béhu totorobɛndo nemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Then the priests will blast on their trumpets, and everyone else will shout. The wall will fall down, and your soldiers can go straight in from every side.
translation_verse: Sɛ behu boaen mmɛen ne anu tendetende ko, ná sɛ ɛmɔte totorobɛndo ne nga pɛ a, ɔsɛ kyɛ mmenia ne amukoraati bɛbɔ ese serɛserɛ. Kuro ne anwo fasue kodwiri kogua gyirigorɔɔ, na ɛmɔ amukoraati bɛ́hɔ bɛ nyunu tee beewura kuro ne anu.”

english_verse: Joshua called the priests together and said, “Take the chest and tell seven priests to carry trumpets and march ahead of it.”
translation_verse: Yiti Nun awa Yosua frɛfrɛle asɔfo nemɔ, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔsoa apam alaka ne, ná ɛ́mɔma asɔfo nzoo bétiratira boaen mmɛen totorobɛndo nzoo beli AWURADE alaka ne nyunu moa.”

english_verse: They obeyed Joshua's orders and carried the chest once around the town before returning to camp for the night.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE alaka ne fale kuro ne anwo bra yiale. Ɔfale ye nwo yiale komapɛ, na besa bɛwale asikyeleɛ ne anu bɛɛlale berɛ.

english_verse: On the seventh day, the army got up at daybreak. They marched slowly around Jericho the same as they had done for the past six days, except on this day they went around seven times.
translation_verse: Kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne, bɛpɛle aleɛ bedwɔsole, na bɛbɔle kuro ne anwo nzra bɛbra beyiale, kyɛbɔ bɛyɔle ye daa ne ala, sɔ alaa pɛen nzoo. Sɔ kyẽa ne angome de, bɛbɔle kuro ne anwo nzra bɛbra beyiale pɛen nzoo.

english_verse: Then the priests blew the trumpets, and Joshua yelled: Get ready to shout! The Lord will let you capture this town.
translation_verse: Ye pɛen nzoo ne aso, bɔ asɔfo nemɔ huli totorobɛndo nemɔ nen, Yosua sele mmenia ne kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔbɔ ese, ofikyɛ AWURADE afa kuro ne wawura ɛmɔ sa.

english_verse: But you must destroy it and everything in it, to show that it now belongs to the Lord. The woman Rahab helped the spies we sent, so protect her and the others who are inside her house. But kill everyone else in the town.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔsɛkye kuro ne ɔne nu nningyein amukoraati bɔkɔɔ maa ɔyɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE. Sana gyanderaniɛ Rahabo ngome, ɔne mmenia bɔ bɛwɔ ye awuro berɛ amukoraati yeɛ bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ɔ, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔfale ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ yɛsomane bɛ ne feale ɔ.

english_verse: The silver and gold and everything made of bronze and iron belong to the Lord and must be put in his treasury. Be careful to follow these instructions, because if you see something you want and take it, the Lord will destroy Israel. And it will be all your fault.
translation_verse: Nakoso nikyee biala bɔ bafa ɛdwetɛ anaa sikaa kɔkorɛ anaa kɔɔbere anaa buralɛ bayɔ de, ɔte krongron ma AWURADE; odi kyɛ yɛfa yɛkoogua AWURADE nningyein sua ne anu.”

english_verse: The priests blew their trumpets again, and the soldiers shouted as loud as they could. The walls of Jericho fell flat. Then the soldiers rushed up the hill, went straight into the town, and captured it.
translation_verse: Yiti mmenia ne bɔle ese, na asɔfo nemɔ huli totorobɛndo nemɔ. Mmerɛ bɔ mmenia ne tele kyɛ bahu totorobɛndo nemɔ pɛ, bɛbɔle ese serɛserɛ, na fasue ne bu guale gyirigorɔɔ. Na mmenia ne amukoraa hɔle bɛ nyunu tee beewura kuro ne anu, na belili so ngonim.

english_verse: After Jericho was destroyed, Joshua warned the people, “Someday a man will rebuild Jericho, but the Lord will put a curse on him, and the man's oldest son will die when he starts to build the town wall. And by the time he finishes the wall and puts gates in it, all his children will be dead.”
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Yosua payele kyɛ, “Sona biala bɔ ɔkɔkyekye Yeriko kuro he bieku nen, AWURADE prápra musue ógua ye so; sɛ ɔ́to kuro ne fapem a, ɔkɔfa ye bamuɛbaa yeɛ ɔkɔpɛ so ɔ, yeɛ sɛ ótuatua ye pambim mɔ a, ɔkɔfa ye kasiɛ yeɛ ɔkɔpɛ so ɔ!”

english_verse: The Lord helped Joshua in everything he did, and Joshua was famous everywhere in Canaan.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE gyinane Yosua si, na bɛtele ye nga wɔ aseɛ ne aso nekaa biala.

english_verse: The Lord had said that everything in Jericho belonged to him. But Achan from the Judah tribe took some of the things from Jericho for himself. And so the Lord was angry with the Israelites, because one of them had disobeyed him.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE mmeraa bɔ ɔfa nningyein bɔ watu wasie berɛ kyɛ bɛsɛkye ye ne anwo ne, Yisraelfoɛ buli so. Akan bɔ ɔse ole Karemi, bɔ ɔse ole Sabidi, bɔ ye koso ɔse ole Sera bɔ ofi Yuda abusua kure nu ne, ɔfale nningyein bɔ AWURADE atu asie berɛ kyɛ bɛsɛkye ye ne bie, yiti AWURADE fɛle Yisraelfoɛ so yaa piri paa.

english_verse: Joshua and the leaders of Israel tore their clothes and put dirt on their heads to show their sorrow. They lay facedown on the ground in front of the sacred chest until sunset.
translation_verse: Ɛhe mane Yosua sunzuale ye ndaadeɛ nu, na ɔfale ye nyunu butuli aseɛnwo wɔ AWURADE alaka ne nyunu toonn maa oodwuli nɔsoa. Ɔne Yisrael mbanyi yeɛ bɛyɔle sɔ ɔ, na betuli mvuture beguale bɛ ti so.

english_verse: Then Joshua said: Our Lord, did you bring us across the Jordan River just so the Amorites could destroy us? This wouldn't have happened if we had agreed to stay on the other side of the Jordan.
translation_verse: Na Yosua sele kyɛ, “O, AWURADE Nyameɛ! Nzu ati koraa yeɛ ɛfale maen he pɛle asue Yɔɔdan ɔ, kyɛ ɛbaafa yɛ wura Amorifoɛ sa maa bekuku yɛ ɔ? Sɛ né yɛse po a, ahaa yɛhale Yɔɔdan si dɔ!

english_verse: I don't even know what to say to you, since Israel's army has turned and run from the enemy.
translation_verse: Mesrɛ wɔ ala, AWURADE, afei bɔ Yisrael wanwati wafi ye pɔfoɛ mɔ nyunu ye, nzikyɛ dwirɛ koraa yeɛ nga ɔ?

english_verse: Everyone will think you weren't strong enough to protect your people. Now the Canaanites and everyone else who lives in the land will surround us and wipe us out.
translation_verse: Kanaanfoɛ ne aseɛ ye asofoɛ mukoraati bɛkɔte sɔ dwirɛ ye, bɛkɔpɛ yɛ nwo bekoyia, na bɛkɔma yɛ boso konua. Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛkɔyɔ kɔfa wɔ dumaa bɔ odi mu ne anwo ɔ?

english_verse: The Lord answered: Stop lying there on the ground! Get up!
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Yosua kyɛ, “Dwɔso! Nzu ati yeɛ afa wɔ nyunu abutu ase ye?

english_verse: I said everything in Jericho belonged to me and had to be destroyed. But the Israelites have kept some of the things for themselves. They stole from me and hid what they took. Then they lied about it.
translation_verse: Yisrael ayɔ bɔne. M’apam bɔ nhyɛle bɛ kyɛ beli so ne, babu so. Basesa nningyein bɔ matu masie berɛ kyɛ bɛsɛkye ye ne bie; bawua, bapɛ ngondombo, na bafa baafea bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nningyein nu.

english_verse: What they stole was supposed to be destroyed, and now Israel itself must be destroyed. I cannot help you anymore until you do exactly what I have said. That's why Israel turns and runs from its enemies instead of standing up to them.
translation_verse: Ɔnate sɔ ne ati yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ bɛngora bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ nyunu gyina ɔ; bɛnwati befi bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ nyunu, ofikyɛ bayɛ mmenia bɔ matu bɛ masie berɛ kyɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ beku bɛ ɔ. Mengogyina ɛmɔ si ko, sana nningyein bɔ matu masie berɛ kyɛ behũ bɛ ná bɛsɛkye bɛ ne, ɛ́mɔye befi ɛmɔ nu.

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel, “Tomorrow you will meet with the Lord your God, so make yourselves acceptable to worship him. The Lord says that you have taken things that should have been destroyed. You won't be able to stand up to your enemies until you get rid of those things.
translation_verse: Dwɔso! Te mmenia nemɔ nwo, ná ka kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔte ɛmɔ nwo bésie bɛ́fa bɛ́nwondɛ ɛhema, ofikyɛ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ne nwa: O Yisrael, nningyein bɔ matu masie berɛ kyɛ bɛsɛkye ye ne, ebie wɔ wɔ berɛ. Na ɛngɔhora wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ nyunu gyina, sana ɛmɔye nningyein bɔ matu masie berɛ kyɛ bɛsɛkye ye ne befi ɛmɔ nu.’

english_verse: “Tomorrow morning everyone must gather near the place of worship. You will come forward tribe by tribe, and the Lord will show which tribe is guilty. Next, the clans in that tribe must come forward, and the Lord will show which clan is guilty. The families in that clan must come, and the Lord will point out the guilty family. Finally, the men in that family must come,
translation_verse: Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ ngyerɛmɔ ɛmɔbagyina me nyunu mmusua kure mmusua kure. Na abusua kure bɔ AWURADE kɔye ye ne, nu mmenia kɔwa mmusua mmusua; yeɛ abusua bɔ AWURADE kɔye ye ne, nu mmenia kɔwa awuro ama awuro ama; na awuro ama bɔ AWURADE kɔye ye ne, nu mmenia kɔwa ngoko ngoko.

english_verse: and the Lord will show who stole what should have been destroyed. That man must be put to death, his body burned, and his possessions thrown into the fire. He has done a terrible thing by breaking the sacred agreement that the Lord made with Israel.”
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ ngɔye ye kyɛ nningyein bɔ matu masie berɛ kyɛ bɛsɛkye ye ne bie wɔ ye berɛ nen, ɛ́mɔfa see bɛ́yera ye, ɔne ye nwo ama ne ye nikyee biala, ofikyɛ wabu AWURADE apam ne aso, na wabɔ nyanzoen bra wɔ Yisrael.”

english_verse: Joshua got up early the next morning and brought each tribe to the place of worship, where the Lord showed that the Judah tribe was guilty.
translation_verse: Yiti Yosua dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu, ɔmane Yisraelfoɛ wale AWURADE nyunu abusua kure abusua kure, na serewagualɛ ne yele Yuda abusua kure ne.

english_verse: Then Joshua brought the clans of Judah to the Lord, and the Lord showed that the Zerah clan was guilty. One by one he brought the leader of each family in the Zerah clan to the Lord, and the Lord showed that Zabdi's family was guilty.
translation_verse: Ɔmane Yuda mmusua mmusua nemɔ pingyele berɛ, na serewagualɛ ne yele Serafoɛ abusua. Ɔmane Serafoɛ abusua ne anu ama pingyele berɛ bɛ sasofoɛ bɛ sasofoɛ, na serewagualɛ ne yele Sabidi sasofoɛ.

english_verse: Finally, Joshua brought each man in Zabdi's family to the Lord, and the Lord showed that Achan was the guilty one.
translation_verse: Ɔmane Sabidi sasofoɛ wale ngoko ngoko, na serewagualɛ ne yele Akan bɔ ɔse ole Karemi, bɔ ɔse ole Sabodi, bɔ ɔse ole Sera bɔ ofi Yuda abusua kure nu ne.

english_verse: “Achan,” Joshua said, “the Lord God of Israel has decided that you are guilty. So tell me what you did, and don't try to hide anything.”
translation_verse: Na Yosua sele Akan kyɛ, “Mma, fa animnyam ma AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ, ná ka nahorɛ wɔ ye nyunu. Nikyee bɔ ayɔ ne, ka kyire me kekesaala ye. Nnɛfa fea me.”

english_verse: “It's true,” Achan answered. “I sinned and disobeyed the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Akan buale Yosua kyɛ, “Ɔte nahorɛ, me yeɛ mayɔ bɔne matia AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ɔ. Bɔ nyɔle ɛhe:

english_verse: They brought them back and put them in front of the sacred chest, so Joshua and the rest of the Israelites could see them.
translation_verse: Bɛsesale nningyein ne befili ɛtena sua ne anu, bɛfa bɛbrɛle Yosua ne Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati, na bɛfa beguale AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: Then everyone took Achan and the things he had stolen to Trouble Valley. They also took along his sons and daughters, his cattle, donkeys, and sheep, his tent, and everything else that belonged to him.
translation_verse: Afei Yosua ne Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati bɛfale Sera awa Akan, ɛdwetɛ ne, aguasoɛ ne, sikaa kɔkorɛ ne, Akan mma mmienzua ne mmrasua, ye nandwie mɔ, ye afunum mɔ, ye mmoaen, ye tena sua ne, ɔne ye nwo nningyein amukoraa, na bɛfale bɛ bɛwale Akɔre Bɔnza nu.

english_verse: Joshua said, “Achan, you caused us a lot of trouble. Now the Lord is paying you back with the same kind of trouble.” The people of Israel then stoned to death Achan and his family. They made a fire and burned the bodies, together with what Achan had stolen, and all his possessions.
translation_verse: Na Yosua sele kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ amaneɛ yeɛ aahwe abrɛ yɛ ye? AWURADE kɔma amaneɛ kɔto wɔ ɛnɛ kyẽa ye.” Na Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati bɛborole ye nyɔboɛ behuni ye. Bɛfale see bɛyerale bɛ, na bɛsesale nyɔboɛ beguale bɛ so.

english_verse: They covered the remains with a big pile of rocks, which is still there. Then the Lord stopped being angry with Israel. That's how the place came to be called Trouble Valley.
translation_verse: Na bɛboaboale nyɔboɛ kure kandinga beguale ye so, bɔ nyɔboɛ kure ne tɛ wɔ berɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ ɔ. Na AWURADE mane ye ahone tɔle nzue nu. Yiti bɛfrɛ berɛ Akɔre bɔnza maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

english_verse: The rest of the army will come with me and attack near the gate. When the people of Ai come out to fight, we'll run away and let them chase us. They will think we are running from them just like the first time. But when we've let them chase us far enough away,
translation_verse: Bɛkɔfoa yɛ alaa kɔpem kyɛ yɛkɔmaa bekofi kuro ne anu bekofite ɔ; ofikyɛ bekosusu kyɛ, ‘Bɛ́nwati béfi yɛ nyunu, kyɛbɔ daa ne bɛyɔle ne.’ Yiti yɛkɔnwati yɛkofi bɛ nyunu,

english_verse: you come out of hiding. The Lord our God will help you capture the town.
translation_verse: na ɛmɔ koso, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfi nekaa bɔ ɛmɔtetɛ ne befite, ná ɛmɔkɔfa kuro ne; ofikyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ kɔfa kɔma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Then set it on fire, as the Lord has told us to do. Those are your orders,
translation_verse: Na sɛ kuro ne badi ɛmɔ sa nu a, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa see bɛto nu; ɛ́mɔyɔ kyɛbɔ AWURADE ahyɛ ne ala. Ɛ́mɔtie! Bɔ menwa ɛ́mɔyɔ hɔ ɛne.”

english_verse: Early the next morning he got his troops ready to move out, and he and the other leaders of Israel led them to Ai.
translation_verse: Yosua dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu boaboale mmenia ne noa, ɔne Yisrael mbanyi bɛfo belili mmenia ne nyunu, na bɛfale bɛ nye behyirele Aye.

english_verse: They set up camp in full view of the town, across the valley to the north.
translation_verse: Koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ né bɛboka ye so ne, bɛ mukoraati bɛfole bokaa ne bɛhɔle, bepingyele kuro berɛ pambim ne, na bɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Aye sorɔ dɔ. Né bɔnza la bɛ ne Aye b’afia.

english_verse: Now all his troops were in place. Part of the army was in the camp to the north of Ai, and the others were hiding to the west, ready to make a surprise attack. That night, Joshua went into the valley.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛmane koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ gyinagyinane: koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ bɛbaaho koɛ ne deinn ne, bɛwɔ sorɔ, yeɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ beli nziɛ bɛbɔ bɛ nwo waen ne koso bɛwɔ kuro ne atɔleɛ. Nakoso Yosua de, ɔhɔle bɔnza ne anu dɔ kɔngɔen ne.

english_verse: Finally, the Lord told Joshua, “Point your sword at the town of Ai, because now I am going to help you defeat it!” As soon as Joshua pointed his sword at the town,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Yosua kyɛ, “Buralɛ tendenn tworɔntworɔn bɔ otira wɔ sa nu ne, tengyɛ ye wɔ Aye so, ofikyɛ ngɔfa kuro ne ngowura wɔ sa.” Yiti Yosua tengyɛle buralɛ tendenn tworɔntworɔn bɔ otira ye sa nu ne wɔ kuro ne aso.

english_verse: the soldiers who had been hiding jumped up and ran into the town. They captured it and set it on fire.
translation_verse: Ɔtengyɛle ye sa pɛ, yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ bɔ baatetɛ eburo ne hane bɛ nwo befitele ɔ, na bele amirika bewurale kuro ne anu beelili so ngonim. Na berɛ ne ala, bɛtole kuro ne anu see.

english_verse: When Joshua and his troops saw smoke rising from the town, they knew that the other part of their army had captured it. So they turned and attacked. The men of Ai looked back and saw smoke rising from their town. But they could not escape, because the soldiers they had been chasing had suddenly turned and started fighting.
translation_verse: Na Yosua ne Yisrael amukoraati benwuni kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bɛɛtetɛle ne bali kuro ne aso ngonim, ná afei kuro ne anu nwosina koso ótu kɔ anwuro nen, bɛkakyili bɛ nwo beehuhuni Aye mmienzua nemɔ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the other Israelite soldiers had come from the town and attacked the men of Ai from the rear. The Israelites captured the king of Ai and brought him to Joshua. They also chased the rest of the men of Ai into the desert and killed them. The Israelite army went back to Ai and killed everyone there.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ huhuni Ayefoɛ amukoraati wɔ ɛserɛ pralaa ne aso yiele. Berɛ yeɛ Ayefoɛ foane Yisraelfoɛ hɔle ɔ, na bɛ mukoraa bɛtotɔle ngrandɛ noa maa beyiele bɔkɔɔ nen, Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa sa wale Aye, na bɛfale ngrandɛ beehuhuni mmenia bɔ baha berɛ ne.

english_verse: Joshua made sure every building in Ai was burned to the ground. He told his men to kill the king of Ai and hang his body on a tree. Then at sunset he told the Israelites to take down the body, throw it in the gateway of the town, and cover it with a big pile of rocks. Those rocks are still there, and the town itself has never been rebuilt. Joshua Reads the Blessings and Curses (Deuteronomy
translation_verse: Na Aye hene de, osinzele ye bakaa so maa oodwuli nɔsoa. Na eyia tɔle ne, Yosua mane Yisraelfoɛ yele ye fuin ne befili bakaa ne aso, befindini ye bɛtole kuro berɛ pambim ne anyunu, na ɔmaa bɛboaboale nyɔboɛ kure kandinga beguale ye so, bɔ ɔtɛwɔ berɛ kekesaala ye ɔ. Yosua kenga mmeraa ne wɔ Ebal bokaa ne aso

english_verse: The people of Gibeon had also heard what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ Gibeonfoɛ tele nikyee bɔ Yosua afa ayɛ Yeriko ne Aye nen,

english_verse: So they decided that some of their men should pretend to be messengers to Israel from a faraway country. The men put worn-out bags on their donkeys and found some old wineskins that had cracked and had been sewn back together.
translation_verse: bɛ de bɛfale nnakannaka atee so: bɛfale aleɛ, na bɛfale mmɔtɔ teterewaa, ɔne nzaa ngotoku daa bɔ nu asunzua bɔ bapomba ɔ bɛsoale b’afunum mɔ.

english_verse: Their sandals were old and patched, and their clothes were worn out. They even took along some dry and crumbly bread.
translation_verse: Bewurale mbaboa daadaa bɔ bapombapomba ɔ, ɔne ndaadeɛ teterewaa. Né b’aleɛ ne amukoraa wayɛ wosee, yeɛ né wasa wali ature.

english_verse: Then they went to the Israelite camp at Gilgal, where they said to Joshua and the men of Israel, “We have come from a country that is far from here. Please make a peace treaty with us.”
translation_verse: Bɛhɔle Yosua berɛ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu wɔ Gilgal, na besele ye ne Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, “Yɛfi maen bie anu dedeede yeɛ yawa ɔ, yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛ́yɛ apam.”

english_verse: We are your servants, and we live far from here. We came because the Lord your God is so famous. We heard what the Lord did in Egypt
translation_verse: Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dumaa bɔ watrɛ wahɔ dede ne, ɔnate ye ti yeɛ wɔ ngoaa yafi maen dedeede bie aso yawa ɔ; ofikyɛ yate ye nwo dwirɛ, bɔ ɔyɔle ye wɔ Misraim amukoraa,

english_verse: and what he did to those two Amorite kings on the other side of the Jordan: King Og of Bashan, who lived in Ashtaroth, and King Sihon of Heshbon.
translation_verse: ɔne nikyee biala bɔ ɔfa yɔle Amorifoɛ ahemvo nyɔ nemɔ: Sihon ne Hesebon bɔ né bɛwɔ Yɔɔdan si dɔ ne, ɔne Basan hene Ogo bɔ né ɔte Astarote ne.

english_verse: Our leaders and everyone who lives in our country told us to meet with you and tell you that all of us are your servants. They said to ask you to make a peace treaty with our people. They told us to be sure and take along enough food for our journey.
translation_verse: Yiti yɛ mbanyi mɔ ne yɛ maen ne anu ama mukoraa ha hyirele yɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔfa aleɛ ná ɛ́mɔsi nu beeyia bɛ, ná ɛmɔhã behyire bɛ kyɛ, “Yɛte ɛmɔ ngoaa, yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛ́yɛ apam.” ’

english_verse: See this dry, crumbly bread of ours? It was hot out of the oven when we packed the food on the day we left our homes.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea yɛ paanoo ye. Kyẽa bɔ yɛsili nu kyɛ yɛba ɛmɔ wa nen, yeɛ yɛfa yɛwurale yɛ nningyein nu wɔ awuro, kyɛ yɛbaali ye atunu ɔ, na né ɔyɛ hye. Nakoso afei de, ɛ́mɔnea, wayɛ wosee, na wali ature.

english_verse: These cracked wineskins were new when we filled them, and our clothes and sandals are worn out because we have traveled so far.
translation_verse: Sɔ nzaa nwomaa ngotoku hemɔ, yɛfale nzaa yɛguale nu maa beyiyili ne, né bɛte monɛ, nakoso ɛ́mɔnea, basunzuasunzua. Yeɛ ɔnate kyɛ atee ne wale soma ne ati, yɛ ndaadeɛ ne yɛ mbaboa hemɔ atete.”

english_verse: The Israelites tried some of the food, but they did not ask the Lord if he wanted them to make a treaty.
translation_verse: Yiti Yisraelfoɛ lili b’aleɛ ne bie, na bammisa AWURADE bandie ye noa dwirɛ.

english_verse: So Joshua made a peace treaty with the messengers and promised that Israel would not kill their people. Israel's leaders swore that Israel would keep this promise.
translation_verse: Yosua ne bɛ yɛle asomdwee apam, bɔ odi agyinamuɛ kyɛ ɔkɔmaa bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ɔ; na Yisrael ɛlɔen ne anu mbanyi tale ndaen foale so.

english_verse: A couple of days later, the Israelites found out that these people actually lived in the nearby towns of Gibeon, Chephirah, Beeroth, and Kiriath-Jearim. So the Israelites left the place where they had camped and arrived at the four towns two days later.
translation_verse: Yiti Yisraelfoɛ tuli bɛ bo befili asikyeleɛ ne anu berɛ, na ye ɛlɛsa ne aso, beedwuli Gibeonfoɛ nguro nemɔ aso. Bɛ nguro nemɔ ole: Gibeon, Kefira, Beerote ne Kiriate Yearim.

english_verse: But they did not attack the towns, because the Israelite leaders had sworn in the name of the Lord that they would let these people live. The Israelites complained about their leaders' decision not to attack,
translation_verse: Nakoso Yisraelfoɛ anguku bɛ, ofikyɛ né Yisrael ɛlɔen ne anu mbanyi bali moa bafa AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ bata ndaen bahyire bɛ. Afei ɛlɔen ne amukoraa penepenene bɛ komvi beguale mbanyi nemɔ so.

english_verse: but the leaders reminded them, “We promised these people in the name of the Lord God of Israel that we would let them live, so we must not harm them. If we break our promise, God will punish us. We'll let them live, but we'll make them cut wood and carry water for our people.”
translation_verse: Na mbanyi nemɔ sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma bénya bɛ ti bédidi nu, nakoso yɛkɔmaa bɛkɔyɔ eyeinbubulɛ ne nzuehɔlɛ adwuma bɛkɔma ɛlɔen ne amukoraati.” Yiti ɛlɔen ne tiele bɔ mbanyi nemɔ hane ne.

english_verse: Joshua told some of his soldiers, “I want to meet with the Gibeonite leaders. Bring them here.” When the Gibeonites came, Joshua said, “You live close to us. Why did you lie by claiming you lived far away?
translation_verse: Yosua frɛfrɛle Gibeonfoɛ maa bɛwale, na obisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔlakalakale yɛ kyɛ, ‘Nekaa bɔ yɛfi ne, ɔne ɛmɔ wa wale paa,’ wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɛmɔte yɛ porɛ ye anu ala ɔ?

english_verse: So now you are under a curse, and from now on your people will have to send workers to cut wood and carry water for the place of worship.”
translation_verse: Ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, Nyameɛ apaye ɛmɔ: ɛmɔ nu biemɔ kɔyɛ ngoaa daa, na bɛkɔyɛ eyeinbubulɛ ne nzuehɔlɛ adwuma wɔ me Nyameɛ awuro.”

english_verse: The Gibeonites answered, “The Lord your God told his servant Moses that you were to kill everyone who lives here and take their land for yourselves. We were afraid you would kill us, and so we tricked you into making a peace treaty. But we agreed to be your servants,
translation_verse: Na bebuale Yosua kyɛ, “Ebie ha hyirele wɔ ngoaa mɔ pefee kyɛ, AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ hyɛle ye somvoɛ Mose kyɛ ɔ́fa aseɛ ne amukoraa ɔ́ma ɛmɔ, ná ohuhu so mmenia amukoraa ofi ɛmɔ nyunu. Na ɔnate ɛmɔ ti, né yɛsuro paa kyɛ yɛ ngoa kofi yɛ sa ɔ; yiti yeɛ ɔmaa yɛyɔle sɔ ne.

english_verse: and you are strong enough to do anything to us that you want. We just ask you to do what seems right.”
translation_verse: Na afei de, yɛwura wɔ sa. Bɔ ɛnea a ɔte paa ná ɔtengyɛ wɔ wɔ nye so ne, fa yɔ yɛ.”

english_verse: but he did tell the Gibeonites that they would have to be servants of the nation of Israel. They would have to cut firewood and bring it for the priests to use for burning sacrifices on the Lord's altar, wherever the Lord decided the altar would be. The Gibeonites would also have to carry water for the priests. And that is still the work of the Gibeonites.
translation_verse: Nakoso ofi sɔ kyẽa ne, Yosua mane Gibeonfoɛ yɔle eyeinbubulɛ ne nzuehɔlɛ adwuma mane ɛlɔen ne, na bɛyɔle sɔ bɛmane AWURADE afɔleɛ bokyea ne koso, wɔ nekaa bɔ AWURADE aye asie berɛ kyɛ bɛsɔne ye ne, toonn maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

english_verse: King Adonizedek of Jerusalem heard that Joshua had captured and destroyed the town of Ai, and then killed its king as he had done at Jericho. He also learned that the Gibeonites had signed a peace treaty with Israel.
translation_verse: Yerusalem hene Adoni Sɛdɛke tele kyɛ Yosua aho afa Aye, na wasɛkye ye bɔkɔɔ, na nikyee bɔ ɔfa yɔle Yeriko ne ye hene ne, sɔ ala yeɛ wafa wayɔ Aye ne ye hene ɔ. Osa tele kyɛ Gibeonfoɛ ne Yisrael bayɛ asomdwee apam, na bɛ ne bɛ yeɛ bɛte ɔ.

english_verse: This frightened Adonizedek and his people. They knew that Gibeon was a large town, as big as the towns that had kings, and even bigger than the town of Ai had been. And all of the men of Gibeon were warriors.
translation_verse: Na osurole paa, ofikyɛ Gibeon te kuro piri kyɛ ahenguro nemɔ ko. Ye piri tra Aye, afei koso ye mmienzua mukoraati bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ.

english_verse: So Adonizedek sent messages to the kings of four other towns: King Hoham of Hebron, King Piram of Jarmuth, King Japhia of Lachish, and King Debir of Eglon. The messages said,
translation_verse: Yiti Yerusalem hene Adoni Sɛdɛke somane maa beesele Hebron hene Hoham, Yamute hene Piram, Lakise hene Yafia ɔne Eglon hene Dɛbi kyɛ,

english_verse: “The Gibeonites have signed a peace treaty with Joshua and the Israelites. Come and help me attack Gibeon!”
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔbra bɛɛboka me maa yɛɛhuhu Gibeonfoɛ; ofikyɛ bɛ ne Yosua ne Yisrael bayɛ apam.”

english_verse: the Gibeonites sent a message to the Israelite camp at Gilgal: “Joshua, please come and rescue us! The Amorite kings from the hill country have joined together and are attacking us. We are your servants, so don't let us down. Please hurry!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Gibeonfoɛ somane maa bɛhɔle Gilgal asikyeleɛ ne anu beesele Yosua kyɛ, “Nnɛyakyi wɔ ngoaa mɔ nu; ma wɔ nwo yɛ nyera ná baale yɛ ngoa, baaboka yɛ; ofikyɛ Amorifoɛ bɔ bɛtete mmokaa aseɛ ne aso dɔ ne, bɛ hene mɔ amukoraa bayɛ ko bɛ ne yɛ baaho.”

english_verse: Joshua and his army, including his best warriors, left Gilgal.
translation_verse: Yiti Yosua ne ye koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraa, yeɛ afei koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ amukoraa befili Gilgal bɛfo bɛhɔle.

english_verse: “Joshua,” the Lord said, “don't be afraid of the Amorites. They will run away when you attack, and I will help you defeat them.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Yosua kyɛ, “Nnɛsuro bɛ, ofikyɛ mafa bɛ mawura wɔ sa; na bɛ nu ko po ngɔhora ngogyina wɔ nyunu.”

english_verse: Joshua marched all night from Gilgal to Gibeon and made a surprise attack on the Amorite camp.
translation_verse: Yiti Yosua fili Gilgal natele kɔngɔen toonn hɔle Gibeon, na ɔhɔle Amorifoɛ so mvum nu.

english_verse: The Lord made the enemy panic, and the Israelites started killing them right and left. They chased the Amorite troops up the road to Beth-Horon and kept on killing them, until they reached the towns of Azekah and Makkedah.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE mane bɛ nye so tanene bɛ wɔ Yisraelfoɛ nyunu. Yisraelfoɛ huhuni bɛ paa wɔ Gibeon, na bɛfoane bɛ maa bɛɛfale Bete Horon pambaa atee ne aso, na behuhuni bɛ alaa beedwuli Aseka ne Makeda.

english_verse: And while these troops were going down through Beth-Horon Pass, the Lord made huge hailstones fall on them all the way to Azekah. More of the enemy soldiers died from the hail than from the Israelite weapons.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ bɛ́nwati béfi Yisraelfoɛ nyunu, ná beedwuli Bete Horon ndoroleɛ nu ne, AWURADE yakyili asukɔtwea kungumaboɔ fili nyameɛso guale bɛ so toonn maa beedwuli Aseka, na bewuwuli. Na mmenia bɔ asukɔtwea ne huni bɛ ne, bɛsone bɛtra mmenia bɔ bɛtotɔle Yisraelfoɛ ngrandɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord was helping the Israelites defeat the Amorites that day. So about noon, Joshua prayed to the Lord loud enough for the Israelites to hear: “Our Lord, make the sun stop in the sky over Gibeon, and the moon stand still over Aijalon Valley.” So the sun and the moon stopped and stood still until Israel defeated its enemies. This poem can be found in The Book of Jashar. The sun stood still and didn't go down for about a whole day.
translation_verse: Yiti eyia gyinane neka horɛ, na ɛsraen angɔ moa ko, kɔpem kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ tɔle bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ so wereɛ ɔ. Sɔ dwirɛ he, aso bangyerɛ ye wɔ Yasa nwomaa ne anu? Eyia gyinane afia neka horɛ wɔ ewienu, na kɔyɛ kyẽa ko mumua, wambepere ye nwo kyɛ ɔkwaatɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Never before and never since has the Lord done anything like that for someone who prayed. The Lord was really fighting for Israel.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE ho mane Yisraelfoɛ. Kyẽa bɔ ɔte sɔ de, né ebie ɔwwale le, yeɛ ofi sɔ kyẽa ne koso, sɔ kyẽa ne bie amma le, bɔ yeɛ AWURADE tiele kuro sona sufrɛ sɔa ɔ.

english_verse: After the battle, Joshua and the Israelites went back to their camp at Gilgal. Joshua Kills the Five Enemy Kings
translation_verse: Afei Yosua ne Yisrael ɛlɔen ne amukoraa besa bɛwale Gilgal. Yosua kye Amorifoɛ ahemvo nnu ne

english_verse: While the enemy soldiers were running from the Israelites, the five enemy kings ran away and hid in a cave near Makkedah.
translation_verse: Sɔ ahemvo nnu nemɔ nwatili, na bɛɛfeale nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua nu wɔ Makeda.

english_verse: Joshua's soldiers told him, “The five kings have been found in a cave near Makkedah.”
translation_verse: Na ebiemɔ bɔle Yosua amaneɛ kyɛ, “Yanwu ahemvo nnu nemɔ kyɛ baafea nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua nu wɔ Makeda.”

english_verse: Joshua answered, “Roll some big stones over the mouth of the cave and leave a few soldiers to guard it.
translation_verse: Na Yosua sele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔmunu nyɔbotaen bétua nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua ne noa, ná ɛ́mɔma mmenia gyinagyina ye nwo bɛ́wɛne.

english_verse: But you and everyone else must keep going after the enemy troops, because they will be safe if they reach their walled towns. Don't let them get away! The Lord our God is helping us get rid of them.”
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ ngaa ne de, nnɛma ɛmɔgyina berɛ. Ɛ́mɔfoa ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ nemɔ, ná ɛ́mɔfite bɛ si béhuhu bɛ. Nnɛmɔma bɛnwati bɛkɔ bɛ nguro nemɔ anu, ofikyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ wafa bɛ wawura ɛmɔ sa.”

english_verse: So Joshua and the Israelites almost wiped out the enemy soldiers. Only a few safely reached their walled towns.
translation_verse: Yosua ne Yisraelfoɛ huhuni bɛ pasaa yiele nen, bɛ nu kãa bie yeɛ benyane bɛ ti bedidili nu ɔ, na bɛnwatili bɛhɔle nguro bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue nemɔ anu bɛɛbɔle bɛ nwo adwaa.

english_verse: The Israelite army returned to their camp at Makkedah, where Joshua was waiting for them. No one around there dared say anything bad about the Israelites.
translation_verse: Nakoso Yisraelfoɛ de, bɛ mukoraa besa bɛwale Yosua berɛ asomdwee nu wɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu wɔ Makeda. Na ebiala angora wamva ye dwirɛ wamma Yisraelfoɛ so.

english_verse: Joshua told his soldiers, “Now, move the rocks from the entrance to the cave and bring those five kings to me.”
translation_verse: Na Yosua sele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔye nyɔbotaen ne béfi nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua ne noa, ná ɛ́mɔye ahemvo nnu ne béfi nu bɛ́brɛ me.”

english_verse: The soldiers opened the entrance to the cave and brought out the kings of Jerusalem, Hebron, Jarmuth, Lachish, and Eglon.
translation_verse: Bɛyɔle sɔ, na bɛyele ahemvo nnu ne befili nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua ne anu bɛbrɛle ye. Bɛ ole Yerusalem hene, Hebron hene, Yamute hene, Lakise hene ɔne Eglon hene.

english_verse: After Joshua had called the army together, he forced the five kings to lie down on the ground. Then he called his officers forward and told them, “You fought these kings along with me, so put your feet on their necks.” The officers did this,
translation_verse: Bɛfale ahemvo nemɔ bɛbrɛle Yosua nen, Yosua mane Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati beyiale, na osele koɛhonɛfoɛ mɔ so safohene mɔ bɔ bɛ ne ye hɔle koɛ ne kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔpingye wa ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ gya bétia ahemvo hemɔ kɔme so.” Yiti bepingyele berɛ, na bɛfale bɛ gya betiale bɛ kɔme so.

english_verse: and Joshua continued, “Don't ever be afraid or discouraged. Be brave and strong. This is what the Lord will do to all your enemies.”
translation_verse: Na Yosua sele safohene nemɔ kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro, yeɛ nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ kunu tete ɛmɔ; ɛ́mɔgyina pindinn ná ɛmɔma ɛmɔ ahone yɛ se; ofikyɛ ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ amukoraati bɔ ɛmɔ ne bɛ kɔho ne, sɔ yeɛ AWURADE kɔfa kɔyɔ bɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Joshua killed the five kings and told his men to hang each body on a tree. Then at sunset
translation_verse: Nziɛ ye, Yosua huhuni ahemvo nemɔ, na ɔfale bɛ sinzele mmakaa nnu so. Na besinzele mmakaa ne aso maa oodwuli nɔsoa.

english_verse: he told some of his troops, “Take the bodies down and throw them into the cave where the kings were found. Cover the entrance to the cave with big rocks.” Joshua's troops obeyed his orders, and those rocks are still there. Joshua Continues the Fighting
translation_verse: Na eyia kwaatɔ ne, Yosua maa bɛyele bɛ befili mmakaa ne aso bɛwale ase, na beegyili bɛ beguale nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua bɔ bɛɛfeale nu ne anu. Bɛfale nyɔbotaen betuale nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua ne noa, na nyɔboɛ ne tɛ wɔ berɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ. Yosua di Kanaan ngwaen so ngonim

english_verse: Later that day, Joshua captured Makkedah and killed its king and everyone else in the town, just as he had done at Jericho.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne ala, Yosua ho fale Makeda. Ɔfale ngrandɛ huhuni kuro berɛ ama ne berɛ hene; ohuhuni berɛ ama mukoraa bɔkɔɔ. Wanyakyi sona ko po. Na bɔ ɔfa yɔle Yeriko hene ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔfa yɔle Makeda hene ɔ.

english_verse: Joshua and his army left Makkedah and attacked the town of Libnah.
translation_verse: Afei Yosua ne Yisrael ɛlɔen ne amukoraa befili Makeda bɛhɔle Libina, na bɛɛfale koɛ bɛtetale Libinafoɛ.

english_verse: The Lord let them capture the town and its king, and they killed the king and everyone else, just as they had done at Jericho.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE fale Libina koso ne ye hene wurale Yisrael sa. Yisrael fale ngrandɛ huhuni kuro berɛ ama mukoraati. Wanyakyi sona ko po wɔ nu. Na bɔ ɔfa yɔle Yeriko hene ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔfa yɔle berɛ hene ne ɔ.

english_verse: Joshua then led his army to Lachish, and they set up camp around the town. They attacked,
translation_verse: Ɛhe asi ne, Yosua ne Yisrael ɛlɔen ne amukoraa befili Libina bɛhɔle Lakise, betuale kuro ne, na bɛfale koɛ bɛtetale ye.

english_verse: and the next day the Lord let them capture the town. They killed everyone, as they had done at Libnah.
translation_verse: AWURADE fale Lakise wurale Yisrael sa. Ye elenyɔ ne aso yeɛ Yisrael lili so ngonim ɔ, na ɔfale ngrandɛ huhuni kuro berɛ ama mukoraati, kyɛbɔ ɔfa yɔle Libina kuro mma ne ala.

english_verse: King Horam of Gezer arrived to help Lachish, but Joshua and his troops attacked and destroyed him and his army.
translation_verse: Gɛsɛre hene Horam fo wale ɔɔbokale Lakisefoɛ, nakoso Yosua huhuni ye ne ye lɔen ne, na wanyakyi sona ko po.

english_verse: From Lachish, Joshua took his troops to Eglon, where they set up camp surrounding the town. They attacked,
translation_verse: Afei Yosua ne Yisrael ɛlɔen ne amukoraa befili Lakise bɛhɔle Eglon; betuale kuro ne, na bɛfale koɛ bɛtetale ye.

english_verse: captured it that same day, then killed everyone, as they had done at Lachish.
translation_verse: Belili so ngonim sɔ kyẽa ne, na bɛfale ngrandɛ behuhuni kuro berɛ ama mukoraati bɔkɔɔ sɔ kyẽa ne, kyɛbɔ ɔfa yɔle Lakisefoɛ ne ala.

english_verse: Joshua and his army left Eglon and attacked Hebron.
translation_verse: Afei Yosua ne Yisrael ɛlɔen ne amukoraa befili Eglon bɛhɔle Hebron, na bɛfale koɛ bɛtetale ye.

english_verse: They captured the town and the nearby villages, then killed everyone, including the king. They destroyed Hebron in the same way they had destroyed Eglon.
translation_verse: Belili so ngonim. Bɛfale ngrandɛ behuhuni nu mmenia ne nu hene, mbɔtam berɛ nguro nemɔ nu mmenia, na behuni nu mmenia amukoraa. Wanyakyi sona ko po; na kyɛbɔ ɔfa yɔle Eglon nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔsɛkyele Hebron bɔkɔɔ ɔ, na ohuhuni nu mmenia mukoraati.

english_verse: Joshua and the Israelite army turned and attacked Debir.
translation_verse: Afei Yosua ne Yisrael ɛlɔen ne amukoraa besa bɛwale Dɛbi, na bɛfale koɛ bɛtetale ye.

english_verse: They captured the town, and its nearby villages. Then they destroyed Debir and killed its king, together with everyone else, just as they had done with Hebron and Libnah.
translation_verse: Olili kuro ne, nu hene, ɔne ye nwo nguro mɔ so ngonim. Bɛfale ngrandɛ behuhuni bɛ, na behuni kuro ne anu mmenia mukoraa bɔkɔɔ. Wanyakyi sona ko po. Na nikyee bɔ ɔfa yɔle Hebron, yeɛ Libina ne ye hene nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔfa yɔle Dɛbi ne ye hene ɔ.

english_verse: Joshua captured towns everywhere in the land: In the central hill country and the foothills to the west, in the Southern Desert and the region that slopes down toward the Dead Sea. Whenever he captured a town, he would kill the king and everyone else, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded.
translation_verse: Yiti Yosua lili ngonim wɔ aseɛ ne aso amukoraati: mmokaa aseɛ ne ne ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne, aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne, mmokaa ndoroleɛ ne anu, ɔne b’ahemvo ne amukoraa so ngonim. Wanyakyi sona ko po, na mmom ohuhuni nikyee biala bɔ nwomeɛ wɔ ye nu ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ hyɛle ne.

english_verse: Joshua wiped out towns from Kadesh-Barnea to Gaza, everywhere in the region of Goshen, and as far north as Gibeon.
translation_verse: Yosua lili bɛ so ngonim alaa fite Kadese Banea oodwuli Gasa, fite Gosen mbɔtam mukoraati maa oodwuli Gibeon.

english_verse: King Jabin of Hazor heard about Joshua's victories, so he sent messages to many nearby kings and asked them to join him in fighting Israel. He sent these messages to King Jobab of Madon, the kings of Shimron and Achshaph,
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Hasɔ hene Yabin tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, ɔsomane maa bɛɛbɔle ahemvo hemɔ amaneɛ: Madon hene Yobabo, Simron hene, Akisafe hene,

english_verse: the kings in the northern hill country and in the Jordan River valley south of Lake Galilee, and the kings in the foothills and in Naphath-Dor to the west.
translation_verse: ahemvo mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ sorɔ dɔ mmokaa aseɛ ne aso ne, bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Araba ne anu wɔ Kinerote ngwaen dɔ ne, bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Nafɔte Dɔɔ wɔ eyia atɔleɛ ne.

english_verse: He sent messages to the Canaanite kings in the east and the west, to the Amorite, Hittite, Perizzite, and Jebusite kings in the hill country, and to the Hivite kings in the region of Mizpah, near the foot of Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Bɛɛbɔle ɛhemɔ koso amaneɛ: Kanaanfoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ eyia afiteleɛ ne atɔleɛ, Amorifoɛ, Hitifoɛ, Perisifoɛ ne Yebusifoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ mmokaa aseɛ ne aso ne, ɔne Hiwifoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Hɛmɔn bokaa ne nye abo wɔ Misepa aseɛ so ne.

english_verse: The kings and their armies went to Merom Pond, where they set up camp, and got ready to fight Israel. It seemed as though there were more soldiers and horses and chariots than there are grains of sand on a beach.
translation_verse: Sɔ ahemvo ne amukoraa boaboale bɛ lɔen noa, na bɛbɔle nu bɛɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ wɔ Merom nzue nwo kyɛ bɛ ne Yisrael bɛkwaaho.

english_verse: The Lord told Joshua: Don't let them frighten you! I'll help you defeat them, and by this time tomorrow they will be dead. When you attack, the first thing you have to do is to cripple their horses. Then after the battle is over, burn their chariots.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Yosua kyɛ, “Nnɛsuro bɛ, ofikyɛ ɛhema bekye sɔa ala, ngohũhũ bɛ mukoraati ngɔma Yisrael. Na odi kyɛ ɛpepɛ bɛ mbɔngɔ mɔ gya ndii nu, ná ɛfa see yera bɛ teaseɛnam nemɔ.”

english_verse: Joshua and his army made a surprise attack against the enemy camp at Merom Pond
translation_verse: Yiti Yosua ne ye koɛhonɛfoɛ ne amukoraa bɛhɔle bɛ so mvum nu wɔ Merom nzue nwo, na bɛfale koɛ bɛtetale bɛ.

english_verse: Up to this time, the king of Hazor had controlled the kingdoms that had joined together to attack Israel, so Joshua led his army back and captured Hazor. They killed its king
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Yosua sale ye si, olili Hasɔ so ngonim, na ɔfale ngrandɛ huni berɛ hene ne. Ɔbaadwu sɔ mmerɛ nen, né Hasɔ yeɛ ɔte sɔ ahennie ne amukoraa b’ahenguro ɔ.

english_verse: Joshua captured all the towns where the enemy kings had ruled. These towns were built on small hills, and Joshua did not set fire to any of these towns, except Hazor. The Israelites kept the animals and everything of value from these towns, but they killed everyone who lived in them, including their kings. That's what the Lord had told his servant Moses to do, that's what Moses had told Joshua to do, and that's exactly what Joshua did.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye somvoɛ Mose nen, sɔ ala yeɛ Mose hyɛle Yosua ɔ, na sɔ ala yeɛ Yosua koso yɔle ɔ. Nikyee biala bɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose kyɛ ɔyɔ nen, nu ko po nne berɛ bɔ Yosua anyɔ ɔ. Yosua lili aseɛ ne amu so ngonim

english_verse: Joshua and his army took control of the northern and southern hill country, the foothills to the west, the Southern Desert, the whole region of Goshen, and the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Yiti Yosua ho fale aseɛ hemɔ amukoraati: mmokaa aseɛ ne, ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne amukoraa, Gosen aseɛ ne amukoraa, aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne, Araba ne, Yisrael mmokaa aseɛ ne ɔne ye aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne;

english_verse: The Lord had told Moses that he wanted the towns in this region destroyed and their people killed without mercy. That's why the Lord made the people in the towns stubborn and determined to fight Israel. The only town that signed a peace treaty with Israel was the Hivite town of Gibeon. The Israelite army captured the rest of the towns in battle.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE yeɛ ɔmaa bɛyɛle asoserɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ bɛ ne Yisraelfoɛ bɛkɔho koɛ ɔ, amaa ɔnate so Yisraelfoɛ ahũhũ bɛ bɔkɔɔ bama bɛ boso anua, bɔ bengonwu bɛ anwumvoin ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Mose nen.

english_verse: During this same time, Joshua and his army killed the Anakim from the northern and southern hill country. They also destroyed the towns where the Anakim had lived, including Hebron, Debir, and Anab.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Yosua hɔle oohuhuni Anakefoɛ. Na ɔmane bɛ boso nuane fili mmokaa aseɛ ne aso, Hebron, Dɛbi, Anabo, Yuda mmokaa aseɛ ne amukoraa so, ɔne Yisrael mmokaa aseɛ ne amukoraa so. Yosua huhuni bɛ bɔkɔɔ, na ɔsɛkyele bɛ nguro nemɔ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: There were not any Anakim left in the regions where the Israelites lived, although there were still some in Gaza, Gath, and Ashdod.
translation_verse: Banyakyi Anakeniɛ ko po wɔ Yisraelfoɛ aseɛ so; sana Gasa ne Gate ne Asedɔde ngome yeɛ ebiemɔ hale ɔ.

english_verse: That's how Joshua captured the land, just as the Lord had commanded Moses, and Joshua divided it up among the tribes. Finally, there was peace in the land.
translation_verse: Yiti Yosua ho fale aseɛ ne amukoraa, kyɛbɔ edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ AWURADE ha hyirele Mose te ne. Na Yosua hyehyɛle nu mane Yisraelfoɛ maa ɔyɛle b’agyapadeɛ, na ɔfale abusua kure biala ye bue deɛ mane ye. Na asomdwee wale aseɛ ne aso bɔ koɛ anzi ɔ.

english_verse: Before Moses died, he and the people of Israel had defeated two kings east of the Jordan River. These kings had ruled the region from the Arnon River gorge in the south to Mount Hermon in the north, including the eastern side of the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Aseɛ ne aso ahemvo bɔ Yisraelfoɛ lili bɛ so ngonim, bɔ Yisraelfoɛ fale b’aseɛ bɛtenane so wɔ asue Yɔɔdan si, wɔ eyia afiteleɛ bue nu dɔ, fite Anɔn Bɔnza ne anu bɔ ɔkwaadwu Hɛmɔn bokaa ne anwo, ɔne Araba bɔ ɔwɔ eyia afiteleɛ amukoraati ne, bɛ ɛhe:

english_verse: Sihon also controlled the eastern side of the Jordan River valley from Lake Galilee south to Beth-Jeshimoth and the Dead Sea. In addition to these regions, he ruled the town called Slopes of Mount Pisgah and the land south of there at the foot of the hill.
translation_verse: ɔne Araba ne bɔ ɔkwaadwu Kinerote ɛpo eyia afiteleɛ, bɔ ɔkwaadwu Araba ɛpo ne, bɔ ɔte Ngyee po ne, wɔ Bete Yesimote atee so dɔ, bɔ ɔwɔ Pisiga bokaa ne aseɛnwo, wɔ ngwaen dɔ ne;

english_verse: His kingdom stretched north to Mount Hermon, east to the town of Salecah, and included the land of Bashan as far west as the borders of the kingdoms of Geshur and Maacah. He also ruled the northern half of Gilead.
translation_verse: Olili hene wɔ Hɛmɔn bokaa ne aso bɔ ɔkwaadwu kuro Saleka so, ɔne Basan amukoraa bɔ ɔkwaadwu Gesurefoɛ ne Maakatifoɛ ɛwɛen so, ɔne Gileade bue bɔ ɔkwaadwu Hesebon hene Sihon ɛwɛen so.

english_verse: Moses, the Lord's servant, had led the people of Israel in defeating Sihon and Og. Then Moses gave their land to the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh.
translation_verse: AWURADE somvoɛ Mose ne Yisraelfoɛ lili bɛ so ngonim, na AWURADE somvoɛ Mose hyɛle b’aseɛ ne mane Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue. Ahemvo bɔ Yosua lili bɛ so ngonim ne

english_verse: Many years later, the Lord told Joshua: Now you are very old, but there is still a lot of land that Israel has not yet taken.
translation_verse: Né Yosua ayɛ panyi, yeɛ afei né wayɛ aworowaa; na AWURADE sele ye kyɛ, “Ayɛ panyi, yeɛ afei ayɛ aworowaa, nakoso aseɛ bɔ waha bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛyɛ bɛ deɛ ne, ɔte dɔnn.
