english_verse: This region stretched north from the town in the middle of the Arnon River valley, and included the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the valley. It covered the flatlands of Medeba north of Dibon,
translation_verse: Aseɛ ne trɛ fi Aroye bɔ ɔla Anɔn bɔnza ne noa ne, ɔne kuro bɔ ɔwɔ bɔnza ne afia ne, ɔne Medeba bokaa frɛtɛɛ amukoraa bɔ ɔkwaadwu Dibɔn;

english_verse: and took in the towns that had belonged to Sihon, the Amorite king of Heshbon. Some of these towns were as far east as the Ammonite border.
translation_verse: ɔne Amorifoɛ hene Sihon bɔ olili hene wɔ Hesebon ne, ye nguro amukoraati, toonn bɔ ɔkwaadwu Amonfoɛ ɛwɛen so ne.

english_verse: However, the Israelites did not force the people of Geshur and Maacah to leave, and they still live there among the Israelites. Why Moses Did Not Give Land to the Levi Tribe
translation_verse: Nakoso Gesurefoɛ ne Maakatifoɛ de, Yisraelfoɛ andu bɛ amvi berɛ, yiti Gesurefoɛ ne Maakatifoɛ tɛ te Yisraelfoɛ nu maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

english_verse: Moses did not give any land to the Levi tribe, because the Lord God of Israel had told them, “Instead of land, you will receive the sacrifices offered at my altar.” The Land Moses Gave to the Reuben Tribe
translation_verse: Lewi abusua kure ne angome de, Mose amma bɛ aseɛ ne bie. Afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye see so bɛma AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ne yeɛ ɔte b’agyapadeɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔha hyirele bɛ ne. Ruben abusua kure aseɛ

english_verse: Moses gave land to each of the clans in the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: Mose fale aseɛ ne bie mane Ruben abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ɔ.

english_verse: Their land started in the south at the town in the middle of the Arnon River valley, took in the town of Aroer on the northern edge of the valley, and went as far north as the flatlands around Medeba.
translation_verse: B’aseɛ ne, ye noa hyɛ ye bo fi Aroye bɔ ɔwɔ Anɔn bɔnza noa, ɔne kuro bɔ ɔwɔ bɔnza ne afia ne, ɔne bokaa frɛtɛɛ ne amukoraa bɔ ɔkwaadwu Medeba;

english_verse: The Amorite King Sihon had lived in Heshbon and had ruled the towns in the flatlands. Now Heshbon belonged to Reuben, and so did the following towns in the flatlands: Dibon, Bamoth-Baal, Beth-Baal-Meon, Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath, Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth-Shahar on the hill in the valley, Beth-Peor, Slopes of Mount Pisgah, and Beth-Jeshimoth. Moses defeated Sihon and killed him and the Midianite chiefs who ruled parts of his kingdom for him. Their names were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba.
translation_verse: mekyire bokaa frɛtɛɛ ne aso nguro amukoraati, yeɛ afei Amorifoɛ hene Sihon bɔ olili hene Hesebon ne, ye maen amukoraati. Mose lili ye ne Midian mbanyi hemɔ so ngonim: Ewi, Rekem, Sure, Hure ne Reba. Sɔ mmenia hemɔ tenane Sihon gya nu belili hene wɔ aseɛ ne aso.

english_verse: The Israelites also killed Balaam the son of Beor, who had been a fortuneteller.
translation_verse: Beɔ awa Balaam bɔ odi ahɔen ne, Yisraelfoɛ fale ngrandɛ huni ye bɛbokale mmenia bɔ behuni bɛ ne aso.

english_verse: This region with its towns and villages was the land for the Reuben tribe, and the Jordan River was its western border. The Land Moses Gave to the Gad Tribe
translation_verse: Asue Yɔɔdan noa yeɛ ɔte Ruben abusua kure ne wɛen ɔ. Ruben abusua kure ne, ye agyapadeɛ deɛ ɛne. Sɔ nguro nemɔ ne namue nemɔ yeɛ Ruben mmusua mmusua nemɔ nyane ye ɔ. Gade abusua kure aseɛ

english_verse: Moses also gave land to each of the clans in the Gad tribe.
translation_verse: Mose mane Gade abusua kure ne koso agyapadeɛ, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ɔ.

english_verse: It included the town of Jazer, and in the Gilead region their territory took in the land and towns as far east as the town of Aroer just west of Rabbah. This was about half of the land that had once belonged to the Ammonites.
translation_verse: B’aseɛ ne noa fa Yasere, Gileade nguro ne amukoraa, ɔne Amonfoɛ aseɛ ne bue, toonn bɔ ɔkwaadwu Aroye bɔ ɔwɔ Raba eyia afiteleɛ ne;

english_verse: The land given to Gad stretched from Heshbon in the south to Ramath-Mizpeh and Betonim in the north, and even further north to Mahanaim and Lidebor.
translation_verse: ofi Hesebon bɔ ɔkwaadwu Ramate Misepe ne Betonim, ofi Mahanaim bɔ ɔkwaadwu Dɛbi ɛwɛen so,

english_verse: Gad also received the eastern half of the Jordan River valley, which had been ruled by King Sihon of Heshbon. This territory stretched as far north as Lake Galilee, and included the towns of Beth-Haram, Beth-Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon.
translation_verse: ɔne bɔnza ne anu nguro hemɔ: Bete Haram, Bete Nimra, Sukote, Safon, yeɛ Hesebon hene Sihon ahennie ngaa ne, Yɔɔdan ɛwɛen so, toonn bɔ ɔkwaadwu Kinerete ɛpo ngwaen dɔ, ɔne Yɔɔdan si eyia atɔleɛ bue nu dɔ.

english_verse: These regions with their towns and villages were given to the Gad tribe. The Land Moses Gave to Half the Manasseh Tribe
translation_verse: Gade abusua kure ne, ye agyapadeɛ deɛ ɛne. Sɔ nguro nemɔ ne namue nemɔ yeɛ Gade mmusua mmusua nemɔ nyane ye ɔ. Manase abusua kure ne bue aseɛ

english_verse: Moses gave land east of the Jordan River to half of the clans from the Manasseh tribe.
translation_verse: Mose mane Manase abusua kure ne bue aseɛ; na ɔyɛle Manase abusua kure ne bue agyapadeɛ, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ɔ.

english_verse: Their land started at Mahanaim and took in the region that King Og of Bashan had ruled, including Ashtaroth and Edrei, the two towns where he had lived. The villages where the Jair clan settled were part of Manasseh's land, and so was the northern half of the region of Gilead. The clans of this half of Manasseh had
translation_verse: Gileade bue, Astarote ne Yedrei, Ogo ahennie nu nguro bɔ bɛwɔ Basan. Mose fale sɔ aseɛ ne amukoraa mane Manase awa Makyiri ye bosofoɛ, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ɔ; kyɛ ɔyɛ Makyirifoɛ bue nu ko deɛ.

english_verse: That was how Moses divided up the Moab Plains to the east of Jericho on the other side of the Jordan River, so these two and a half tribes would have land of their own.
translation_verse: Sɔ aseɛ nemɔ yeɛ Mose hyɛle ye wɔ Moabo aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso ɔ, asue Yɔɔdan si, wɔ Yeriko eyia afiteleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But Moses did not give any land to the Levi tribe, because the Lord had promised that he would always provide for them.
translation_verse: Nakoso Lewi abusua kure ne de, Mose amma bɛ aseɛ biala, AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte b’agyapadeɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔha hyirele bɛ ne.

english_verse: One day while the Israelites were still camped at Gilgal, Caleb the son of Jephunneh went to talk with Joshua. Caleb belonged to the Kenaz clan, and many other people from the Judah tribe went with Caleb. He told Joshua: You know that back in Kadesh-Barnea the Lord talked to his prophet Moses about you and me.
translation_verse: Afei Yudafoɛ wale Yosua berɛ wɔ Gilgal, na Kalebo bɔ ɔse ole Kenisiniɛ Yefune ne, osele Yosua kyɛ, “Wɔ bɔbɔ ala ɛse edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE ha fale me ne wɔ nwo hyirele Nyameɛ sona Mose wɔ Kadese Banea ɔ.

english_verse: The other spies said things that made our people afraid, but I completely trusted the Lord God.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ bɛ ne me hɔle ne, bɛmane ahunundetelɛ tɔle yɛ mmenia ne aso, nakoso me de, nnili nahorɛ turoloo mane AWURADE me Nyameɛ.

english_verse: The same day I came back, Moses told me, “Since you were faithful to the Lord God, I promise that the places where you went as a spy will belong to you and your descendants forever.”
translation_verse: Na Mose tale ndaen sɔ kyẽa ne kyɛ, ‘Nahorɛ nu, aseɛ bɔ wɔ gya atia so ne, ɔkɔyɛ wɔ ne wɔ mma deɛ afebɔɔ, ofikyɛ ali nahorɛ turoloo ama AWURADE me Nyameɛ.’

english_verse: So I'm asking you for the hill country that the Lord promised me that day. You were there. You heard the other spies talk about that part of the hill country and the large, walled towns where the Anakim live. But maybe the Lord will help me take their land, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Yiti, mmokaa aseɛ he bɔ AWURADE hane ye nwo dwirɛ sɔ kyẽa nen, fa ma me. Sɔ kyẽa ne, ɛtele kyɛ né Anakefoɛ ne nguro mbiri bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue mɔ wɔ berɛ. Nakoso ebiaa AWURADE kogyina me si maa ngɔfoa bɛ ngofi berɛ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hane ne.”

english_verse: Joshua prayed that God would help Caleb, then he gave Hebron to Caleb and his descendants.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yosua yirale Yefune awa Kalebo, na ɔfale Hebron mane ye maa ɔyɛle ye agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: And Hebron still belongs to Caleb's descendants, because he was faithful to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Yiti Kalebo bɔ ɔse ole Kenisiniɛ Yefune ne, Hebron ayɛ ye agyapadeɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ, ofikyɛ olili nahorɛ turoloo mane AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Hebron used to be called Arba's Town, because Arba had been one of the greatest of the Anakim. There was peace in the land.
translation_verse: Daa ne, né Hebron dumaa ole Kiriate Aba. Aba sɔ ne, né ye yeɛ ɔte branoa paa wɔ Anakefoɛ nu ɔ. Na asomdwee wale aseɛ ne aso bɔ koɛ anzi ɔ.

english_verse: Judah's southern border started at the south end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Bɛ ngwaen dɔ ɛwɛen ne, ɔhyɛ ye bo fi Ngyee Po noa dɔ, ɔne mboanoa bɔ ye nye nea ngwaen dɔ ne.

english_verse: As it went west from there, it ran south of Scorpion Pass to Zin, and then came up from the south to Kadesh-Barnea. It continued past Hezron up to Addar, turned toward Karka,
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ alaa kɔfa Akrabim pambaa ne ngwaen dɔ, toonn kodwu Sen, na ɔkɔfa Kadese Banea ngwaen dɔ. Ɔpɛ nu Hesron, na ɔfo kɔ Ada, na ɔkondo kɔ Kaka.

english_verse: and ran along to Azmon. After that, it followed the Egyptian Gorge and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. This was also Israel's southern border.
translation_verse: Ɔpɛ nu kɔ Asimɔn, na okofite Misraim bɔnza ne anu, na okogua mboanoa. Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔte ɛmɔ ngwaen dɔ wɛen ɔ.

english_verse: Judah's eastern border ran the full length of the Dead Sea. The northern border started at the northern end of the Dead Sea.
translation_verse: Ngyee Po ne yeɛ ɔte Yuda eyia afiteleɛ ɛwɛen ɔ, na ɛwɛen ne kɔ alaa kodwu asue Yɔɔdan abɔleɛ. Sorɔ dɔ ɛwɛen ne trɛ fi Ngyee Po ne noa bɔ ɔwɔ asue Yɔɔdan abɔleɛ ne.

english_verse: From there it went west up to Beth-Hoglah, continued north of Beth-Arabah, and went up to the Monument of Bohan, who belonged to the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: Ɛwɛen ne trɛ kɔ Bete Hogela, na ɔkɔpɛ nu wɔ Bete Araba, na okodwu Ruben awa Bohan nyɔboɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: From there, it went to Trouble Valley and Debir, then turned north and went to Gilgal, which is on the north side of the valley across from Adummim Pass. It continued on to Enshemesh, Enrogel,
translation_verse: Ɛwɛen ne fi Akɔre bɔnza ne anu fo kɔ Dɛbi, na ɔkondo fa sorɔ dɔ kɔ Gilgal, bɔ ɔwɔ Adumim pambaa ne ndendeneɛ so, bɔ ɔwɔ bɔnza ne ngwaen dɔ ne. Ɛwɛen ne toa so kɔfa Ɛn Semese nzue noa, na ye noa kɔpem Ɛn Rogyel.

english_verse: and up through Hinnom Valley on the land sloping south from Jerusalem. The city of Jerusalem itself belonged to the Jebusites. Next, the border went up to the top of the mountain on the west side of Hinnom Valley and at the north end of Rephaim Valley.
translation_verse: Ɛwɛen ne fo kɔfa Hinom Awa bɔnza ne anu, wɔ Yebusifoɛ bokaa ne ngwaen dɔ . Bokaa bɔ ɔwɔ Hinom bɔnza ndendeneɛ so ne, ɛwɛen ne nate ye anwuro dɔ, wɔ eyia atɔleɛ, wɔ Refaim bɔnza ne sorɔ dɔ.

english_verse: At the top of the mountain it turned and went to Nephtoah Spring and then to the ruins on Mount Ephron. From there, it went to Baalah, which is now called Kiriath-Jearim.
translation_verse: Ɛwɛen ne fi bokaa ne aso a, ɔkɔfa Nefetoa nzue ne ti, na ofi berɛ a, ɔkɔfa Efron bokaa nguro nemɔ aso. Ɛwɛen ne kondo bafa Baala ;

english_verse: From Baalah the northern border curved west to Mount Seir and then ran along the northern ridge of Mount Jearim, where Chesalon is located. Then it went down to Beth-Shemesh and over to Timnah.
translation_verse: ɛwɛen ne fi Baala a, ɔkondo fa eyia atɔleɛ kɔ Sɛre bokaa ne anwo, ɔpɛ nu kɔ Yearim bokaa ndoroleɛ nu wɔ ye sorɔ dɔ, , ɔtorotoro kɔ Bete Semese, na ɔpɛ nu kɔ Timina.

english_verse: Next, Caleb started a war with the town of Debir, which at that time was called Kiriath-Sepher.
translation_verse: Ofili berɛ ne, ɔɔfale koɛ tetale Dɛbifoɛ. Daa ne, né Dɛbi dumaa ole Kiriate Sefa.

english_verse: Joshua gave Caleb some land among the people of Judah, as God had told him to do. Caleb's share was Hebron, which at that time was known as Arba's Town, because Arba was the famous ancestor of the Anakim.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle Yosua nen, ɔfale Yuda abusua kure aseɛ ne bie mane Yefune awa Kalebo. Aseɛ ne ole Kiriate Aba, bɔ ye ole Hebron ne. .

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Eshtaol, Zorah, Ashnah, Zanoah, En-Gannim, Tappuah, Enam, Jarmuth, Adullam, Socoh, Azekah, Shaaraim, Adithaim, Gederah, and Gederothaim.
translation_verse: Kalebo foane Anake bosofoɛ nza nemɔ fili berɛ. Bɛ ole Sesayi, Ahiman ne Talmae.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Zenan, Hadashah, Migdalgad, Dilan, Mizpeh, Joktheel, Lachish, Bozkath, Eglon, Cabbon, Lahmas, Chitlish, Gederoth, Beth-Dagon, Naamah, and Makkedah.
translation_verse: Na Kalebo sele kyɛ, “Bienzua biala bɔ ɔkɔho koli Kiriate Sefa so ngonim nen, ngɔfa mma brasua Akesa maa okogya.”

english_verse: Right after the wedding, Achsah started telling Othniel that he ought to ask her father for a field. She went to see her father, and while she was getting down from her donkey, Caleb asked her, “What's bothering you?”
translation_verse: Na braa ne hɔle agyaa bo wɔ Otiniɛl awuro nen, osele ohu kyɛ ɔ́srɛ aseɛ ófi ye baba Kalebo berɛ. Na braa ne fili ye afunum ne aso dwuli ase nen, Kalebo bisale ye kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ ekuro ɔ?”

english_verse: She answered, “I need your help. The land you gave me is in the Southern Desert, so I really need some spring-fed ponds for a water supply.” Caleb gave her a couple of small ponds, named Higher Pond and Lower Pond. Towns in Judah's Land
translation_verse: Na obuale ye kyɛ, “Kyɛ me nikye. Ofikyɛ aseɛ bɔ afa ama me wɔ ngwaen dɔ ne, ɔte wosee. Yiti ma me mbombonzue koso.” Yiti Kalebo fale sorɔ dɔ mbombonzue ne ngwaen dɔ mbombonzue bokale ye so. Yuda nguro nemɔ

english_verse: The following is a list of the towns in each region given to the Judah clans:
translation_verse: Yuda abusua kure ne, ye agyapadeɛ deɛ ɛne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ne.

english_verse: The first region was located in the Southern Desert along the border with Edom, and it had the following
translation_verse: Lebaote, Silihim, Ayin ne Rimon. Nguro ne amukoraa bɛte aburanyɔ ne ngona, bɛ ne bɛ namue mɔ.

english_verse: The second region was located in the northern part of the lower foothills, and it had the following
translation_verse: Saaraim, Aditim, Gedera, Gederotim. Nguro nemɔ te buru ne nna, bɛ ne bɛ namue mɔ.

english_verse: The third region was located in the southern part of the lower foothills, and it had the following
translation_verse: Gederote, Bete Dagɔn, Naama ne Makeda. Nguro nemɔ te buru ne nzia, bɛ ne bɛ namue mɔ.

english_verse: The fifth region was located along the Mediterranean seacoast, and it had the following towns with their surrounding settlements and villages: Ekron and the towns between there and the coast, Ashdod and the larger towns nearby, Gaza, the towns from Gaza to the Egyptian Gorge, and the towns along the coast of the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Asedɔde ne ye nwo nguro ne ye namue mɔ; Gasa ne ye nwo nguro ne ye namue mɔ; bɔ ɔkwaadwu Misraim bɔnza ne, yeɛ afei Ɛpo Piri ne noa.

english_verse: The Jebusites lived in Jerusalem, and the people of the Judah tribe could not capture the city and get rid of them. That's why Jebusites still live in Jerusalem along with the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Nakoso Yebusifoɛ bɔ né bɛte Yerusalem ne de, Yudafoɛ angora andu bɛ bamvi berɛ; yiti Yebusifoɛ ne Yudafoɛ batena Yerusalem toonn maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

english_verse: The following is a description of the land that was divided among the clans of the Ephraim tribe. Their southern border started at Ataroth-Addar and went west to Upper Beth-Horon
translation_verse: Efraim abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ ye mmusua mmusua te ne, b’aseɛ ne wɛen ɛhe: b’aseɛ ne, ye wɛen wɔ eyia afiteleɛ ole Atarote Ada bɔ ɔkwaadwu Bete Horon sorɔ dɔ ne.

english_verse: Ephraim also had some towns and villages that were inside Manasseh's tribal land.
translation_verse: Afei koso, nguro bɔ bɛye befili Manasefoɛ agyapadeɛ nu bɛmane Efraimfoɛ ne, bɛboka aseɛ ne aso, nguro ne amukoraa ne bɛ namue mɔ.

english_verse: Ephraim could not force the Canaanites out of Gezer, so there are still some Canaanites who live there among the Israelites. But now these Canaanites have to work as slaves for the Israelites.
translation_verse: Nakoso Kanaanfoɛ bɔ né bɛte Gɛsɛre ne de, Yisraelfoɛ andu bɛ amvi berɛ; yiti Kanaanfoɛ atena Efraimfoɛ nu toonn maa waadwu ɛnɛ, nakoso Efraimfoɛ hyɛ bɛ maa bɛyɔ adwuma.

english_verse: The land of the Manasseh tribe went from its northern border with the Asher tribe south to Michmethath, which is to the east of Shechem. The southern border started there, but curved even farther south to include the people who lived around Tappuah Spring.
translation_verse: Manase aseɛ ne wɛen fi Asɛ kɔka Mikimeta bɔ ɔwɔ Sɛkem eyia afiteleɛ dɔ ne, na ɛwɛen ne fi berɛ kɔ ngwaen dɔ, wɔ Ɛn Tapuafoɛ bue nu dɔ.

english_verse: The town of Tappuah was on Manasseh's border with Ephraim. Although the land around Tappuah belonged to Manasseh, the town itself belonged to Ephraim.
translation_verse: Tapua aseɛ ne yɛle Manase deɛ, nakoso Tapua kuro bɔ ɔwɔ Manase ɛwɛen so ne de, ɔyɛle Efraimfoɛ deɛ.

english_verse: Manasseh was supposed to have the following towns with their surrounding villages inside the borders of Issachar's and Asher's tribal lands: Beth-Shan, Ibleam, Endor, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, which is also called Naphath.
translation_verse: Yisaka ne Asɛ aseɛ ne, nguro hemɔ wɔ so bɔ bɛte Manase deɛ ɔ: Bete Sean ne ye nwo namue mɔ, Yiblim ne ye nwo namue mɔ, Dɔɔ kuro berɛ ama ne ye nwo namue mɔ, Ɛn Dɔɔ kuro berɛ ama ne ye nwo namue mɔ, Taanake kuro berɛ ama ne ye nwo namue mɔ, Megido kuro berɛ ama ne ye nwo namue mɔ .

english_verse: But the people of Manasseh could not capture these towns, so the Canaanites kept on living in them.
translation_verse: Nakoso Kanaanfoɛ bɔ bɛtete sɔ nguro nemɔ aso ne, Manasefoɛ bangora bandu bɛ bamvi berɛ, yiti Kanaanfoɛ hɔle so tenane sɔ aseɛ ne aso.

english_verse: When the Israelites grew stronger, they made the Canaanites in these towns work as their slaves, though they never did force them to leave. Joseph's Descendants Ask for More Land
translation_verse: Na nziɛ ye bɔ Yisraelfoɛ nwo yɛle se ne, bɛhyɛle Kanaanfoɛ nemɔ maa bɛyɔle adwuma bɛmane bɛ, nakoso bandu bɛ bamvi aseɛ ne aso. Yosef boso ama pena aseɛ bieku

english_verse: One day the Joseph tribes came to Joshua and asked, “Why didn't you give us more land? The Lord has always been kind to us, and we have too many people for this small region.”
translation_verse: Yosef abusua kure ne sele Yosua kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ afa agyapadeɛ aseɛ porɛ komapɛ ama me ɔ? Me bosofoɛ sone, ofikyɛ AWURADE ayira me alaa maa waadwu ɛnɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua replied, “If there's not enough room for you in the hill country of Ephraim, then go into the forest that belonged to the Perizzites and the Rephaim. Clear out the trees and make more room for yourselves there.”
translation_verse: Na Yosua buale bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ wɔ boso atrɛ a, nzaade kɔ ɛhɔayeɛ nu dɔ, wɔ Perisifoɛ ne Refaimfoɛ aseɛ ne aso kɔsoso dɔ fa, ofikyɛ Efraim mmokaa aseɛ ne te kãa ma wɔ.”

english_verse: “Even if we do that,” they answered, “there still won't be enough land for us in the hill country. And we can't move down into Jezreel Valley, because the Canaanites who live in Beth-Shan and in other parts of the valley have iron chariots.”
translation_verse: Na Yosef abusua kure ne buale kyɛ, “Mmokaa aseɛ ne te kãa ma yɛ. Afei koso, Kanaanfoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso ne, bele buralɛ teaseɛnam mɔ: bɛwɔ Bete Sean ne ye namue mɔ nu, ɔne Yesreel bɔnza ne anu.”

english_verse: “Your tribes do have a lot of people,” Joshua admitted. “I'll give you more land. Your tribes are powerful,
translation_verse: Na Yosua sele Efraimfoɛ ne Manasefoɛ, bɔ bɛte Yosef boso ama ne kyɛ, “Wɔ boso atrɛ amba, na wɔ nwo yɛ se; yiti nna aseɛ porɛ komapɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ enya ɔ,

english_verse: so you can have the rest of the hill country, but it's a forest, and you'll have to cut down the trees and clear the land. You can also have Jezreel Valley. Even though the Canaanites there are strong and have iron chariots, you can force them to leave the valley.”
translation_verse: na mmom mmokaa aseɛ ne kɔyɛ wɔ deɛ. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɔte ɛhɔayeɛ de, nakoso kɔso fa, na ofi ye ti bɔ ɔkwaaha ye ti ne kɔyɛ wɔ deɛ. Kanaanfoɛ ne, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bele buralɛ teaseɛnam, yeɛ afei bɛ nwo yɛ se de, nakoso ɛkɔhora kɔfoa bɛ kofi berɛ.”

english_verse: After Israel had captured the land, they met at Shiloh and set up the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ lili aseɛ ne aso ngonim yiele nen, bɛ mukoraa bɛbɔle dwaa wɔ Silo, na besili ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: There were still seven tribes without any land,
translation_verse: Né waha Yisraelfoɛ abusua kure nzoo bɔ né bɛ de bennyane agyapadeɛ ne bie ɔ.

english_verse: Just before the men left camp, Joshua repeated their orders: “Explore the land and write a description of it. Then come back to Shiloh, and I will find out from the Lord how to divide the land.”
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ bɛkwaafa aseɛ ne aso ná bɛkyerɛ ye nwo dwirɛ nen, anzana bɛbaasi nu ne, Yosua hyɛle bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ bɛɛfa aseɛ ne amukoraati so, ɛmɔhyerɛ ye nwo dwirɛ, ná ɛmɔsa bɛbra me wa; na ngogua serewa wɔ Silo wa, wɔ AWURADE nyunu ngɔma ɛmɔ.”

english_verse: The men left and went across the land, dividing it into seven regions. They wrote down a description of each region, town by town, and returned to Joshua at the camp at Shiloh.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ hɔle bɛɛfale aseɛ ne aso, bɛhyerɛle kyɛbɔ besi bɛhyɛle nu nzoo ne, ɔne nguro somaa bɔ bɛwɔ bɛ nu biala nu beguale nwomaa bie anu, na afei besa bɛwale Yosua berɛ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu wɔ Silo.

english_verse: Joshua found out from the Lord how to divide the land, and he told the tribes what the Lord had decided. Benjamin's Land
translation_verse: Yosua guale serewa mane bɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu wɔ Silo, na afei Yosua mane Yisrael abusua kure ngaa ne anu biala sa hane ye aseɛ. Benyamin aseɛ deɛ

english_verse: Benjamin was the first tribe chosen to receive land. The region for its clans lay between the Judah tribe on the south and the Joseph tribes on the north.
translation_verse: Serewagualɛ ne lili moa yele Benyamin abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ne, na aseɛ bɔ Yosua fa mane ye ne ɔla Yuda abusua kure ne Yosef abusua kure bɛ deɛ afia.

english_verse: Benjamin's northern border started at the Jordan River and went up the ridge north of Jericho, then on west into the hill country as far as the Beth-Aven Desert.
translation_verse: Bɛ sorɔ dɔ wɛen ne ɔhyɛ ye bo fi asue Yɔɔdan noa. Ɛwɛen ne kɔ Yeriko ndoroleɛ nu wɔ ye sorɔ dɔ. Ɔsẽ kɔfa mmokaa aseɛ ne aso kɔ eyia atɔleɛ bue nu dɔ, na ye noa kɔpem Bete Awen ɛserɛ so.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth, Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah, Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah, Zelah, Haeleph, Gibeah, Kiriath-Jearim, and Jerusalem, which is also called Jebusite Town. These regions are the tribal lands of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Ɛwɛen ne buka fa neka foforɛ, na ɔkondo kɔ eyia atɔleɛ. Ɔfa aseɛnwo dɔ bokaa ne ngwaen wɔ Bete Horon ndendeneɛ so, na ɔkɔpem Kiriate Baal , bɔ ɔte Yuda abusua kure kuro ne. Aseɛ ne, ye eyia atɔleɛ dɔ ɛwɛen ɛne.

english_verse: Benjamin's southern border started at the edge of Kiriath-Jearim and went east to the ruins and on to Nephtoah Spring.
translation_verse: Ye ngwaen dɔ wɛen ne hyɛ ye bo fi Kiriate Yearim tiwaa, ɔtoa so kɔ Efron, na ɔkɔ alaa kodwu Nefetoa nzue ne ti.

english_verse: From there it went to the bottom of the hill at the northern end of Rephaim Valley. The other side of this hill faces Hinnom Valley, which is on the land that slopes south from Jerusalem. The border went down through Hinnom Valley until it reached Enrogel.
translation_verse: Bokaa bɔ ɔwɔ Hinom Awa bɔnza ndendeneɛ so, bɔ ɔwɔ Refaim bɔnza ne sorɔ dɔ ne, ɛwɛen ne torotoro kɔ ye nye abo. Ɔkɔ Hinom bɔnza ne ngwaen dɔ, wɔ Yebusifoɛ ndoroleɛ nu ngwaen dɔ, na ɔtorotoro kɔ Ɛn Rogyel.

english_verse: At Enrogel the border curved north and went to Enshemesh and on east to Geliloth, which is across the valley from Adummim Pass. Then it went down to the Monument of Bohan, who belonged to the Reuben tribe.
translation_verse: Afei ɛwɛen ne kondo fa sorɔ dɔ kɔ Ɛn Semese, na ɔtoa so kɔ Gelilote bɔ ɔwɔ Adumim pambaa ndendeneɛ so ne, na ɔtorotoro kɔ Ruben awa Bohan Nyɔboɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: The border ran along the hillside north of Beth-Arabah, then down into the Jordan River valley.
translation_verse: Ɔpɛ nu kɔ Bete Araba ndoroleɛ nu sorɔ dɔ, na ɔtorotoro kɔ Araba.

english_verse: Inside the valley it went south as far as the northern hillside of Beth-Hoglah. The last section of the border went from there to the northern end of the Dead Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Ɛwɛen ne pɛ nu kɔ Bete Hogela ndoroleɛ nu sorɔ dɔ, na ye noa kɔpem Ngyee Po ne sorɔ, wɔ ye boo ne anu, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan ngwaen dɔ. Aseɛ ne, ye ngwaen dɔ ɛwɛen ɛne.

english_verse: The Jordan River itself was Benjamin's eastern border. These were the borders of Benjamin's tribal land, where the clans of Benjamin lived.
translation_verse: Asue Yɔɔdan yeɛ ɔte ye wɛen wɔ eyia afiteleɛ ɔ. Benyamin abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne, ye aseɛ deɛ ɛne, na ye nwo wɛen amukoraa ɛne.

english_verse: Simeon was the second tribe chosen to receive land, and the region for its clans was inside Judah's borders.
translation_verse: Serewagualɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne yele Simeon, Simeon abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne. B’aseɛ ne, Yuda abusua kure aseɛ deɛ ne wapɛ ye nwo wayia.

english_verse: In one region of Simeon's tribal land there were the following
translation_verse: Bete Lebaote ne Saruhen: bɛte nguro buru ne nza ne bɛ namue mɔ;

english_verse: and continued north to Gath-Hepher, Ethkazin, and Rimmonah, where it curved toward Neah
translation_verse: Ofi berɛ a, ɔfa eyia afiteleɛ dɔ kɔ Gate Hefa, ɔkɔ Ete Kasin, na Rimon bue nu dɔ wora ɔkondo kɔ Nea.

english_verse: In another region, Simeon had the following four towns with their surrounding villages: Enrimmon, Tachan, Ether, and Ashan.
translation_verse: Ayin, Rimon, Eta, Asan: bɛte nguro nna ne bɛ namue mɔ;

english_verse: Simeon's land also included all the other towns and villages as far south as Baalath-Beer, which is also called Ramah of the South.
translation_verse: yeɛ afei namue amukoraa bɔ bapɛ nguro hemɔ nwo bayia, bɔ ɔkwaadwu Baalate Beɛ, ɔne Rama bɔ ɔwɔ ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne aso ne. Simeon abusua kure ne, ye aseɛ deɛ ɛne, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua nemɔ te ne.

english_verse: Simeon's tribal land was actually inside Judah's territory. Judah had received too much land for the number of people in its tribe, so part of Judah's land was given to Simeon. Zebulun's Land
translation_verse: Yuda abusua kure aseɛ ne bie yeɛ bɛpɛ bɛmane Simeon abusua kure ne ɔ, ofikyɛ Yuda abusua kure aseɛ ne, né ye piri bo bɛ so. Yiti b’aseɛ ne bie yeɛ bɛfa bɛmane Simeon abusua kure ne maa ɔyɛle ye agyapadeɛ ɔ. Sebulɔn aseɛ deɛ

english_verse: and became the northern border. Then it curved south around Hannathon and went as far west as Iphtahel Valley.
translation_verse: Ye sorɔ dɔ ne, ɛwɛen ne kondo kɔ Hanaton, na ye noa kogua Yifta Ɛl bɔnza ne anu;

english_verse: Zebulun had twelve towns with their surrounding villages. Some of these were Kattath, Nahalal, Shimron, Jiralah, and Bethlehem.
translation_verse: yeɛ Katate, Nahalale, Simron, Yidala ne Betlehem boka so: bɛte nguro buru ne nyɔ ne bɛ namue mɔ.

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages: Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem, Hapharaim, Shion, Anaharath, Debirath, Kishion, Ebez, Remeth, En-Gannim, Enhaddah, Beth-Pazzez, Tabor, Shahazumah and Beth-Shemesh. Asher's Land
translation_verse: Sebulɔn abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne, ye aseɛ deɛ ɛne: sɔ nguro nemɔ ne bɛ namue mɔ. Yisaka aseɛ deɛ

english_verse: Issachar was the fourth tribe chosen to receive land. The northern border for its clans went from Mount Tabor east to the Jordan River. Their land included the following
translation_verse: Yisaka abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne, ye aseɛ deɛ ɛne: nguro nemɔ ne bɛ namue mɔ. Asɛ aseɛ deɛ

english_verse: then east to Beth-Dagon. On the southeast, Asher shared a border with Zebulun along the Iphtahel Valley. On the eastern side their border ran north to Beth-Emek, went east of Cabul, and then on to Neiel,
translation_verse: Afei ɔkondo kɔ eyia afiteleɛ kɔfa Bete Dagɔn, ɔkɔpem Sebulɔn ne Yifta Ɛl bɔnza ne wɔ Bete Emeke ne Neyiɛl sorɔ dɔ, na ɔtoa so fa ye sorɔ dɔ kɔ Kabul,

english_verse: Abdon, Rehob, Hammon, Kanah, and as far north as the city of Sidon.
translation_verse: Ebron, Rehobo, Hamon ne Kana alaa kodwu Sidon Piri.

english_verse: Then it turned west to become the northern border and went to Ramah and the fortress-city of Tyre. Near Tyre it turned toward Hosah and ended at the Mediterranean Sea. Asher had a total of
translation_verse: Asɛ abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne, ye aseɛ deɛ ɛne: sɔ nguro nemɔ ne bɛ namue mɔ. Nafetali aseɛ deɛ

english_verse: towns with their surrounding villages, including Mahalab, Achzib, Acco, Aphek, and Rehob. Naphtali's Land
translation_verse: Ɛwɛen ne fa Tabɔ bokaa ne, Sahasuma, Bete Semese, na ye noa kɔpem asue Yɔɔdan: bɛte nguro buru ne nzia ne bɛ namue mɔ.

english_verse: The Naphtali clans received this region as their tribal land, and it included
translation_verse: Nafetali abusua kure ne, kyɛbɔ nu mmusua mmusua ne te ne, ye aseɛ deɛ ɛne: nguro nemɔ ne bɛ namue mɔ. Dan aseɛ deɛ

english_verse: The Israelites were still gathered in Shiloh in front of the sacred tent, when Eleazar the priest, Joshua, and the family leaders of Israel finished giving out the land to the tribes. The Lord had told the people to give Joshua whatever town he wanted. So Joshua chose Timnath-Serah in the hill country of Ephraim, and the people gave it to him. Joshua went to Timnath-Serah, rebuilt it, and lived there.
translation_verse: Sɔ aseɛ nemɔ yeɛ ɔsɔfo Eleasa, Nun awa Yosua ɔne mbanyi bɔ bɛlela Yisrael mmusua kure nemɔ noa ne beguale serewa wɔ Silo bɛhyɛle ɔ. Bɛhyɛle ye wɔ AWURADE nyunu, wɔ ɛtena sua atenaleɛ anoa nu berɛ. Yiti bɛhyɛle aseɛ ne anu beyiele.

english_verse: These Safe Towns were set up, so that if Israelites or even foreigners who lived in Israel accidentally killed someone, they could run to one of these towns. There they would be safe until a trial could be held, even if one of the victim's relatives came looking for revenge.
translation_verse: Sɔ nguro nemɔ yeɛ betu besiele berɛ bɛmane Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa, ɔne ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ baatena Yisraelfoɛ nu ɔ, amaa sɛ ebie ɔmmoapa ná oku obiɛngo a wanwati wahɔ berɛ. Na kɔpem mmerɛ bɔ bekoli ye dwirɛ badwa nu ne, wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne ngonya atee ngohũ ye.

english_verse: One day the Lord told Joshua:
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE sele Yosua kyɛ,

english_verse: When Moses was still alive, I commanded him to tell the Israelites about the Safe Towns. Now you tell them that it is time to set up these towns.
translation_verse: “Ka kyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, ‘Mmenia nwo adwaabɔlɛ nguro bɔ mvale Mose so ngane ye nwo dwirɛ ngyirele ɛmɔ ne, ɛ́mɔye bésie berɛ,

english_verse: If a person accidentally kills someone and the victim's relatives say it was murder, they might try to take revenge. Anyone accused of murder can run to one of the Safe Towns and be safe from the victim's relatives. The one needing protection will stand at the entrance to the town gate and explain to the town leaders what happened. Then the leaders will bring that person in and provide a place to live in their town.
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ wali awue ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔnwati kɔ sɔ nguro nemɔ ko aso, ná okogyina kuro berɛ pambim ne anyunu, ná okyirekyire ye dwirɛ ne anu kyire kuro berɛ mbanyi mɔ. Na ɛhe asi ye, odi kyɛ bɛfa ye bɛkɔ kuro ne anu bɛkɔɔma ye nekaa maa ɔne bɛ tena berɛ.

english_verse: One of the victim's relatives might come to the town, looking for revenge. But the town leaders must not simply hand over the person accused of murder. After all, the accused and the victim had been neighbors, not enemies.
translation_verse: Sɛ wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne ɔ́po sona bɔ wali awue ne aso a, ɔnzɛ kyɛ bɛye bɔ wali awue ne bɛma, ofikyɛ wanhyɛ da yeɛ ohuni obiɛngo ne ɔ. Afei koso, né edwirɛ biala nne b’afia daa.

english_verse: The citizens of that Safe Town must come together and hold a trial. They may decide that the victim was killed accidentally and that the accused is not guilty of murder. Everyone found not guilty must still live in the Safe Town until the high priest dies. Then they can go back to their own towns and their homes that they had to leave behind.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ sona bɔ wali awue ne tena kuro ne anu kɔpem kyɛ bekoli ye dwirɛ badwa nu bekobua ye be ɔ. Bebua ye be a, ɔkɔtena berɛ toonn kɔpem kyɛ sɔ mmerɛ ne anu ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne kowu ɔ. Na ɛhe asi ye, ɔkɔhora kosa kɔhɔ ye awuro, wɔ kuro bɔ ɔnwatili fili so ne aso.’ ”

english_verse: The Israelites decided that the following three towns west of the Jordan River would be Safe Towns: Kedesh in Galilee in Naphtali's hill country, Shechem in Ephraim's hill country, and Kiriath-Arba in Judah's hill country. Kiriath-Arba is now called Hebron.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛyele nguro hemɔ besiele berɛ: Kedese bɔ ɔwɔ Galilea, bɔ ɔwɔ Nafetali mmokaa aseɛ so, Sɛkem bɔ ɔwɔ Efraim mmokaa aseɛ so, ɔne Kiriate Aba bɔ ɔwɔ Yuda mmokaa aseɛ so ne.

english_verse: The Israelites had already decided on the following three towns east of the Jordan River: Bezer in the desert flatlands of Reuben, Ramoth in Gilead, which was a town that belonged to Gad, and Golan in Bashan, which belonged to Manasseh.
translation_verse: Na asue Yɔɔdan si, wɔ Yeriko eyia afiteleɛ dɔ wora, bɛyele nguro hemɔ besiele berɛ: Besɛre bɔ ɔwɔ ɛserɛ so bokaa frɛtɛɛ ne aso, bɔ ɔwɔ Ruben abusua kure aseɛ so; Ramote bɔ ɔwɔ Gileade, bɔ ɔwɔ Gade abusua kure aseɛ so; yeɛ Golan bɔ ɔwɔ Basan, bɔ ɔwɔ Manase abusua kure aseɛ so ne.

english_verse: While the Israelites were still camped at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, the family leaders of the Levi tribe went to speak to the priest Eleazar, Joshua, and the family leaders of the other Israelite tribes. The leaders of Levi said, “The Lord told Moses that you have to give us towns and provide pastures for our animals.”
translation_verse: wɔ Silo bɔ ɔwɔ Kanaan aseɛ so beesele bɛ kyɛ, “AWURADE fale Mose so hyɛle kyɛ, ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛma yɛ nguro maa yɛtena so, ɔne nguro nemɔ nwo aseɛ bɔ yɛ nyɛmmoa kodidi so ɔ.”

english_verse: Since the Lord had said this, the leaders of the other Israelite tribes agreed to give some of the towns and pastures from their tribal lands to Levi.
translation_verse: Yiti Yisraelfoɛ gyinane AWURADE noa dwirɛ ne aso, na bɛyele nguro hemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ befili b’agyapadeɛ nu bɛmane Lewifoɛ mɔ.

english_verse: The leaders asked the Lord to show them in what order the clans of Levi would be given towns, and which towns each clan would receive. The Kohath clans were first. The descendants of Aaron, Israel's first priest, were given
translation_verse: Serewagualɛ ne yele Kohatefoɛ mmusua nemɔ. Yiti Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛte ɔsɔfo Aarɔn bosofoɛ ne, serewagualɛ ne maa benyane nguro buru ne nza befili Yuda abusua kure, Simeon abusua kure ne Benyamin abusua kure ne berɛ.

english_verse: towns and the pastureland around them. Two of these towns were from the tribe of East Manasseh, four from Issachar, four from Asher, and three from Naphtali. Golan in Bashan and Beeshterah were from East Manasseh. Kishion, Daberath, Jarmuth, and En-Gannim were from Issachar. Mishal, Abdon, Helkath, and Rehob were from Asher. Kedesh in Galilee, Hammothdor, and Kartan were from Naphtali. Golan in Bashan and Kedesh in Galilee were also Safe Towns for people who had accidentally killed someone. Towns from Zebulun, Reuben, Gad
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo Aarɔn boso ama ne, bɛfale Hebron bɛmane bɛ. Ɔte mmenia bɔ bali awue nwo adwaabɔlɛ kuro, na ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ boka so. Besa bɛfale nguro hemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ bɛbokale bɛ so: Libina,

english_verse: The Lord had told Moses that he would show the Israelites which towns and pastures to give to the clans of Levi, and he did. Towns from Judah, Simeon, Benjamin
translation_verse: Sɔ nguro nemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ne, Yisraelfoɛ nate serewagualɛ so yeɛ bɛfa bɛmane Lewifoɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE nate Mose so hyɛle ne.

english_verse: The descendants of Aaron from the Kohath clans of Levi were priests, and they were chosen to receive towns first. They were given
translation_verse: Aarɔn bosofoɛ ne, bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte asɔfo ne, né bɛ nguro ne amukoraa te buru ne nza, bɛ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord gave the Israelites the land he had promised their ancestors, and they captured it and settled in it.
translation_verse: Yiti aseɛ bɔ AWURADE tale ye nwo ndaen hyirele Yisraelfoɛ bɛ nana mɔ kyɛ ɔkɔfa kɔma bɛ ne, ɔfale ye mukoraa mane bɛ; na bɛfale aseɛ ne bɛtenane so.

english_verse: There still were enemies around Israel, but the Lord kept his promise to let his people live in peace. And whenever the Israelites did have to go to war, no enemy could defeat them. The Lord always helped Israel win.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔle bɛ atenaseɛ asomdwee nu wɔ aseɛ ne aso nekaa biala, kyɛbɔ ɔtale ye nwo ndaen hyirele bɛ nana mɔ ne. Bɛ pɔfoɛ amukoraa nu ko po wangora bɛ nyunu gyina, ofikyɛ AWURADE maa belili bɛ mukoraa so ngonim.

english_verse: The Lord promised to do many good things for Israel, and he kept his promise every time.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ fɛɛ amukoraa bɔ AWURADE fa bɔle Yisrael awuro ama anohoba nen, wanni bɛ ngasi wɔ bɛ nu biala nu, na ye mukoraa wale nu.

english_verse: Joshua held a meeting with the men of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh, and he told them:
translation_verse: Afei Yosua tole ye sa frɛle Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue maa beyiale,

english_verse: You have obeyed every command of the Lord your God and of his servant Moses. And you have done everything I've told you to do. It's taken a long time, but you have stayed and helped your relatives.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ ye amukoraa, toonn bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, ɛmɔanyakyi ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ nu, na mmom ɛmɔali AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ so nahorɛ nu.

english_verse: The Lord promised to give peace to your relatives, and that's what he has done. Now it's time for you to go back to your own homes in the land that Moses gave you east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ wabɔ ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ atenaseɛ asomdwee nu, kyɛbɔ ɔhyɛle bɛ bɔ ne. Yiti ɛ́mɔsa ɛmɔ si bɛhɔ ɛmɔ kuro, wɔ aseɛ bɔ waayɛ ɛmɔ deɛ ne aso, aseɛ bɔ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose fa mane ɛmɔ wɔ asue Yɔɔdan si dɔ ne.

english_verse: Moses taught you to love the Lord your God, to be faithful to him, and to worship and obey him with your whole heart and with all your strength. So be very careful to do everything Moses commanded.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea yé ná ɛ́mɔli mmeraa dwirɛ ne mmeraa bɔ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose hyehyɛ mane ɛmɔ ne aso: kyɛ ɛmɔhuro AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, kyɛ ɛ́mɔli ye dwirɛ amukoraa so, kyɛ ɛ́mɔli ye mmeraa dwirɛ so, kyɛ ɛ́mɔfa bɛ nwo bɛbɔ ye, ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ ahone mukoraa ne ɛmɔ kra mukoraa bɛso ye.”

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh reached the western side of the Jordan River valley and built a huge altar there beside the river. When the rest of the Israelites heard what these tribes had done,
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne tele kyɛ Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue basi afɔleɛ bokyea wɔ Kanaan aseɛ ɛwɛen so, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan porɛ ne anu berɛ, wɔ Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne b’aseɛ so.

english_verse: the Israelite men met at Shiloh to get ready to attack the two and a half tribes.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, Yisrael maen ye amukoraa boaboale bɛ noa wɔ Silo, kyɛ bɛkwaafa koɛ bɛtoa bɛ.

english_verse: But first they sent a priest, Phinehas the son of Eleazar, to talk with the two and a half tribes.
translation_verse: Yiti Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne somane ɔsɔfo Eleasa awa Finehase maa ɔhɔle Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue berɛ wɔ Gileade aseɛ so.

english_verse: Each of the ten tribes at Shiloh sent the leader of one of its families along with Phinehas.
translation_verse: Mbanyi atitirefoɛ buru bokale ye so yeɛ bɛhɔle ɔ. Yisrael abusua kure biala nu sona ko, na bɛ nu biala la abusua noa wɔ Yisrael mmusua mmusua ne anu.

english_verse: Phinehas and these leaders went to Gilead and met with the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh. They said:
translation_verse: Ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ wale Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue berɛ wɔ Gileade aseɛ so, na bɛbɔle b’amaneɛ behyirele bɛ kyɛ,

english_verse: All of the Lord's people have gathered together and have sent us to find out why you are unfaithful to our God. You have turned your backs on the Lord by building that altar. Why are you rebelling against him?
translation_verse: “AWURADE mmenia ne amukoraa nwa nyoo: Ɔwale ye sɛ, bɔ ɛmɔayɔ musue nikyee he batia Yisrael Nyameɛ, bɔ ɛnɛ ye de ɛmɔayakyi AWURADE si lilɛ ɔ; bɔ ɛnɛ ye de ɛmɔasi ɛmɔ bɔbɔ b’afɔleɛ bokyea bafa bayɛ AWURADE nwo lɔen ɔ?

english_verse: Wasn't our people's sin at Peor terrible enough for you? The Lord punished us by sending a horrible sickness that killed many of us, and we still suffer because of that sin.
translation_verse: Bɔne bɔ yɛyɔle ye wɔ Peɔ, bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye po yɛnnya yɛppetene yɛ nwo yɛffili ye nwo ne, bɔne bɔ ɔfale amaneɛ pirikua tole AWURADE mmenia so ne, aso ɔte bɔne ba?

english_verse: Now you are turning your backs on the Lord again. If you don't stop rebelling against the Lord at once, he will be angry with the whole nation.
translation_verse: Afei de, ɛmɔayakyi AWURADE si lilɛ! Sɛ ɛmɔtwi bɛfa AWURADE dwirɛ so ɛnɛ a, ɛhema ɔkɔfɛ Yisrael mmenia mukoraa so yaa.

english_verse: If you don't think your land is a fit place to serve God, then move across the Jordan and live with us in the Lord's own land, where his sacred tent is located. But don't rebel against the Lord our God or against us by building another altar besides the Lord's own altar.
translation_verse: Nakoso, sɛ ɛmɔnea ná efiɛ aha ɛmɔ aseɛ ne a, nzaade ɛ́mɔpɛ asue ne bɛbra AWURADE aseɛ ne aso, nekaa bɔ AWURADE nyianu sua wɔ ne, ná ɛmɔɔfa yɛ aseɛ ne bie. Nnɛma ɛmɔtwi bɛfa AWURADE dwirɛ so, anaa yɛ dwirɛ so, bɔ ɔkɔmaa ɛmɔkosi afɔleɛ bokyea bɛboka AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: Don't you remember what happened when Achan was unfaithful and took some of the things that belonged to God? This made God angry with the entire nation. Achan died because he sinned, but he also caused the death of many others.
translation_verse: Nningyein bɔ AWURADE tu siele berɛ kyɛ yɛsɛkye ye ne, aso Sera awa Akan wando ye nwo mmeraa ne? Aso ɔnate sɔ ati Nyameɛ amvɛ Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati so yaa? Ye amumuyɛɛ bɔ ɔyɔle ne, ye ngome yeɛ owuli ɔ?”

english_verse: The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh answered:
translation_verse: Afei Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue buale mbanyi bɔ bɛlela Yisrael mmusua nemɔ noa kyɛ,

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God! We ask him to be our witness, because he knows whether or not we were rebellious or unfaithful when we built that altar. If we were unfaithful, then we pray that God won't rescue us today. Let us tell you why we built that altar,
translation_verse: “AWURADE, ɔte Ɛdangama Nyameɛ! AWURADE, ɔte Ɛdangama Nyameɛ! Ye yeɛ odi yɛ adanzeɛ ɔ, na yɛpena kyɛ Yisrael koso te ye bo. Sɛ yayɛ AWURADE nwo lɔen, anaakyɛ yanni nahorɛ yamma ye a, ye de ɛmɔhu yɛ ɛnɛ.

english_verse: and we ask the Lord to punish us if we are lying. We didn't build it so we could turn our backs on the Lord. We didn't even build it so we could offer animal or grain sacrifices to please the Lord or ask his blessing.
translation_verse: Sɛ yasi afɔleɛ bokyea kyɛ yɛfa yɛtwe yɛ nwo yɛfi AWURADE nwo, anaa sɛ yɛyɔle sɔ kyɛ yɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ wɔ so, anaa aburoo afɔleɛ wɔ so, anaa asomdwee afɔleɛ wɔ so a, ye de ma AWURADE bɔbɔ ɔtɔ yɛ so wereɛ.

english_verse: We built that altar because we were worried. Someday your descendants might tell our descendants, “The Lord made the Jordan River the boundary between us Israelites and you people of Reuben and Gad. The Lord is Israel's God, but you're not part of Israel, so you can't take part in worshiping the Lord.” Your descendants might say that and try to make our descendants stop worshiping and obeying the Lord.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ Rubenfoɛ ne Gadefoɛ de, AWURADE afa asue Yɔɔdan wato ɛwɛen wɔ yɛ ne ɛmɔ afia; na ɛmɔlle kyɛfa biala wɔ AWURADE nu.’ Na ɔba ye sɔ a, ɛmɔ mma mɔ kɔma yɛ mma kɔyakyi AWURADE sɔnenɛ.

english_verse: That's why we decided to build the altar. It isn't for offering sacrifices, not even sacrifices to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, yeɛ ɔmaa yɛhane kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔma yɛsi afɔleɛ bokyea, bɔ yɛngɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ anaa afɔleɛ wɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: Phinehas and the clan leaders were pleased when they heard the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh explain why they had built the altar. Then Phinehas told them, “Today we know that the Lord is helping us. You have not been unfaithful to him, and this means that the Lord will not be angry with us.”
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo Eleasa awa Finehase sele Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manasefoɛ kyɛ, “Ɛnɛ de, yanwu ye kyɛ AWURADE gyi yɛ si, ofikyɛ ɛhe de, nna musue nikye yeɛ ɛmɔayɔ batia AWURADE ɔ; na kekesaala ye de, ɛmɔale Yisraelfoɛ bafi AWURADE tumi asohwenɛ nu.”

english_verse: Phinehas and the clan leaders left Gilead and went back to Canaan to tell the Israelites about their meeting with the Reuben and Gad tribes.
translation_verse: Afei ɔsɔfo Eleasa awa Finehase ne mbanyi atitirefoɛ nemɔ fili Rubenfoɛ ne Gadefoɛ nwo berɛ wɔ Gileade aseɛ so, na besa bɛhɔle Kanaan aseɛ so bɛɛfale amaneɛ bɛbɔle Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne.

english_verse: The Israelites were happy and praised God. There was no more talk about going to war and wiping out the tribes of Reuben and Gad.
translation_verse: B’amaneɛ ne yɛle Yisraelfoɛ fɛ. Yisraelfoɛ yele Nyameɛ ayɛ, na banyɛ b’adwene ko kyɛ bɛkɔɔfa koɛ bɛkɔtoa Rubenfoɛ ne Gadefoɛ, bɔ ɔkɔmaa bekohũhũ b’aseɛ ne aso ama ná basɛkye so nningyein ɔ.

english_verse: The people of Reuben and Gad named the altar “A Reminder to Us All That the Lord Is Our God.”
translation_verse: Na Rubenfoɛ ne Gadefoɛ bɛtole afɔleɛ bokyea ne dumaa kyɛ, Adanzeɛ. Ofikyɛ bɛhane kyɛ, “Ɔte yɛ ne b’afia adanzeɛ kyɛ AWURADE ole Nyameɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord let Israel live in peace with its neighbors for a long time, and Joshua lived to a ripe old age.
translation_verse: Afoɛ pee asi ne, mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE mane Yisrael nyane asomdwee fili ye pɔfoɛ amukoraa bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia sa nu nen, mmerɛ bɔ né Yosua anyi wayɛ aworowaa ne,

english_verse: One day he called a meeting of the leaders of the tribes of Israel, including the old men, the judges, and the officials. Then he told them: I am now very old.
translation_verse: Yosua mane Yisraelfoɛ amukoraati, bɛ mbanyi ne bɛ mmusua mbanyi, bɛ ndɛenbualɛfoɛ ne b’atitirefoɛ beyiale, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Kekesaala ye de, manyi, yeɛ mayɛ aworowaa.

english_verse: You have seen how the Lord your God fought for you and helped you defeat the nations who lived in this land.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bɛ nye tua nikyee biala bɔ ɔnate ɛmɔ ti AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ wafa wayɔ sɔ maen hemɔ amukoraa ɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ne, ye yeɛ ɔho mane ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Be sure that you carefully obey everything written in The Book of the Law of Moses and do exactly what it says.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔmia ɛmɔ nye, ná ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ nikyee biala bɔ bahyerɛ ye Mose mmeraa nwomaa ne anu ne, ɛmɔkoli so ná ɛmɔkɔyɔ ɔ. Nnɛma ɛmɔdi ye nwo makyebu bɛkɔ famaa so anaa bɛen so;

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with the nations that live around you. Don't worship their gods or pray to their idols or make promises in the names of their gods.
translation_verse: amaa ɛmɔamva ɛmɔ nwo bammɔ maen maen mɔ bɔ baha wɔ ɛmɔ nwo wa ye, amaa ɛmɔammɔ bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ dumaa, amaa ɛmɔamva bɛ banda ndaen, amaa ɛmɔanzo bɛ, ná ɛmɔangoto bɛ.

english_verse: Be as faithful to the Lord as you have always been.
translation_verse: Na mmom odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bɛbɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔayɔ alaa maa waadwu ɛnɛ ye.

english_verse: When you attacked powerful nations, the Lord made them run away, and no one has ever been able to stand up to you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE afoa maen mbiri mbiri bɔ bɛ nwo yɛ se ɔ wafi ɛmɔ nyunu. Na ɛmɔ de, toonn bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, ebiala nne berɛ bɔ wahora wagyina ɛmɔ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: Any one of you can defeat a thousand enemy soldiers, because the Lord God fights for you, just as he promised.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ nu sona ko kora foa mmenia apee, ofikyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔko ma ɛmɔ ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔhyɛle ɛmɔ bɔ ne.

english_verse: Be sure to always love the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé, ná ɛmɔhuro AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ.

english_verse: Don't ever turn your backs on him by marrying people from the nations that are left in the land. Don't even make friends with them. I tell you that if you are friendly with those nations, the Lord won't chase them away when you attack. Instead, they'll be like a trap for your feet, a whip on your back, and thorns in your eyes. And finally, none of you will be left in this good land that the Lord has given you.
translation_verse: ye de ɛ́mɔnwu ye kyɛ, AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔngɔfoa maen maen hemɔ ngofi ɛmɔ nyunu ko, na mmom bɛkɔkakyi ɛmɔ so ngaen ne atodum. Bɛkɔkakyi mbire bekofi ɛmɔ, ná bakakyi mmowue bawowɔ ɛmɔ nye, kɔpem kyɛ ɛmɔkowuwu bekofi aseɛ paa he bɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ wafa wama ɛmɔ ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: I will soon die, as everyone must. But deep in your hearts you know that the Lord has kept every promise he ever made to you. Not one of them has been broken.
translation_verse: “Kekesaala ye de, waha kãa né matoa me mbanyi mɔ. Na ɛmɔ ahone nu ne ɛmɔ ti anu de, ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛse kyɛ, nningyein paa bɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ɔfa hyɛle ɛmɔ bɔ ne, nu ko po nne berɛ bɔ wali ɛmɔ ngasi wɔ nu ɔ; ye mukoraa awa nu ama ɛmɔ, ko po anni ngasi.

english_verse: Joshua called the tribes of Israel together for a meeting at Shechem. He asked the leaders, including the old men, the judges, and the officials, to come up and stand near the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Afei Yosua mane Yisrael mmusua kure ne amukoraati yiale wɔ Sɛkem. Ɔfrɛle Yisrael mbanyi, mmusua mbanyi, ndɛenbualɛfoɛ ne atitirefoɛ, na beegyinane Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: Then Joshua told everyone to listen to this message from the Lord, the God of Israel: Long ago your ancestors lived on the other side of the Euphrates River, and they worshiped other gods. This continued until the time of your ancestor Terah and his two sons, Abraham and Nahor.
translation_verse: Na Yosua sele maen ne amukoraati kyɛ, “AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, ‘Daa tete ne, ɛmɔ nana mɔ Tera ne ye mma Abraham ne Nahɔ bɛtenane asue Yufreti si, na bɛsole nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ.

english_verse: But I brought Abraham across the Euphrates River and led him through the land of Canaan. I blessed him by giving him Isaac, the first in a line of many descendants.
translation_verse: Yeɛ nyele ɛmɔ nana Abraham mvili asue ne asi dɔ, mvale ye mvale Kanaan aseɛ ne aso amukoraa, na mmane ye bosofoɛ yɛle pee. Mmaa ɔwole Yisake.

english_verse: Then I gave Isaac two sons, Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau the hill country of Mount Seir, but your ancestor Jacob and his children went to live in Egypt.
translation_verse: Na Yisake koso mmaa ɔwole Yakob ne Yisɔ. Mvale Sɛre mmokaa aseɛ mane Yisɔ kyɛ ɔfa tena so, nakoso Yakob ne ye mma mɔ de, bɛhɔle Misraim.

english_verse: Later I sent Moses and his brother Aaron to help your people, and I made all those horrible things happen to the Egyptians. I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, but the Egyptians got in their chariots and on their horses and chased your ancestors, catching up with them at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Na nyele ɛmɔ nana mɔ mvili Misraim nen, ɛmɔɔdwuli ɛpo ne noa. Na Misraimfoɛ fale teaseɛnam mɔ ne pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ bɛpole ɛmɔ nana mɔ so toonn beedwuli Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ ne noa.

english_verse: Your people cried to me for help, so I put a dark cloud between them and the Egyptians. Then I opened up the sea and let your people walk across on dry ground. But when the Egyptians tried to follow, I commanded the sea to swallow them, and they drowned while you watched. You lived in the desert for a long time,
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ sũ frɛle AWURADE, na ɔfale awosii kabii tole ɛmɔ ne Misraimfoɛ b’afia. Ɔmane ɛpo oobu fale bɛ so katale bɛ so; na ɛmɔ nye nwuni nikyee bɔ mva nyɔle Misraim ɔ. Na ɛhe asi ne, ɛmɔtenane ɛserɛ so bɛhyɛle.

english_verse: then I brought you into the land east of the Jordan River. The Amorites were living there, and they fought you. But with my help, you defeated them, wiped them out, and took their land.
translation_verse: Afei Amorifoɛ bɔ né bɛte Yɔɔdan si dɔ ne, mvale ɛmɔ male b’aseɛ so. Bɛ ne ɛmɔ hone, na mvale bɛ nwurale ɛmɔ sa. Ɛmɔfale b’aseɛ ne, na ngukuni bɛ mvili ɛmɔ nyunu.

english_verse: King Balak decided that his nation Moab would go to war against you, so he asked Balaam to come and put a curse on you.
translation_verse: Na Moabo hene Balake bɔ ɔse ole Sipore ne, ɔfale koɛ ɔɔtetale Yisrael. Ɔtole ye sa frɛle Beɔ awa Balaam kyɛ ɔɔnoma ɛmɔ,

english_verse: But I wouldn't listen to Balaam, and I rescued you by making him bless you instead of curse you.
translation_verse: nakoso mandie Balaam dwirɛ. Yiti oyirale ɛmɔ; na nnele ɛmɔ mvili ye sa nu.

english_verse: You crossed the Jordan River and came to Jericho. The rulers of Jericho fought you, and so did the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Girgashites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites. I helped you defeat them all.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔpɛle asue Yɔɔdan bɛwale Yeriko nen, Yerikofoɛ ne ɛmɔ hone. Sɔ ala yeɛ Amorifoɛ, Perisifoɛ, Kanaanfoɛ, Hitifoɛ, Gɛgasifoɛ, Hiwifoɛ ne Yebusifoɛ bɛ ne ɛmɔ hone ɔ. Na mvale bɛ nwurale ɛmɔ sa.

english_verse: Your enemies ran from you, but not because you had swords and bows and arrows. I made your enemies panic and run away, as I had done with the two Amorite kings east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Nzomane kotokuradu mɔ maa belili ɛmɔ nyunu, na bɛfoane Amorifoɛ ahemvo nyɔ nemɔ befili ɛmɔ nyunu. Nna wɔ ngrandɛ anaa w’agyaen yeɛ ɛfa yɔle sɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You didn't have to work for this land—I gave it to you. Now you live in towns you didn't build, and you eat grapes and olives from vineyards and trees you didn't plant.
translation_verse: Aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔamvɛ ye nwo, ɔne nguro bɔ nna ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔkyekyele ɔ yeɛ mva mane ɛmɔ ɔ, na ɛmɔtenane so. Bobe boo ne olive boo bɔ nna ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔyɔle ɔ yeɛ ɛmɔdi so mmaa ɔ.’

english_verse: Then Joshua told the people: Worship the Lord, obey him, and always be faithful. Get rid of the idols your ancestors worshiped when they lived on the other side of the Euphrates River and in Egypt.
translation_verse: “Yiti ɛ́mɔsuro AWURADE ná ɛ́mɔso ye ferengyemm ne nahorɛ nu. Na mmosoen bɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ sole bɛ wɔ asue Yufreti asi dɔ, ɔne Misraim nen, ɛ́mɔgyi bégua ná ɛ́mɔso AWURADE.

english_verse: But if you don't want to worship the Lord, then choose here and now! Will you worship the same idols your ancestors did? Or since you're living on land that once belonged to the Amorites, maybe you'll worship their gods. I won't. My family and I are going to worship and obey the Lord!
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔ kunu ndwo kyɛ ɛmɔkɔso AWURADE de a, nzaade ɛnɛ kyẽa ye ɛ́mɔhyire bɔ ɛmɔkɔso ye ɔ: sɛ mmosoen bɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ sole bɛ wɔ asue ne asi dɔ ne ahɔ oo, anaakyɛ Amorifoɛ bɔ ɛmɔte b’aseɛ so ye bɛ mmosoen nemɔ ahɔ oo. Nakoso me ne m’awuro ama de, yɛ de yɛkɔso AWURADE.”

english_verse: The people answered: We could never worship other gods or stop worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Yisraelfoɛ buale kyɛ, “Ɔngɔwa ye sɔ le kyɛ yɛkɔyakyi AWURADE berɛ yɛkɔɔso nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is our God. We were slaves in Egypt as our ancestors had been, but we saw the Lord work miracles to set our people free and to bring us out of Egypt. Even though other nations were all around us, the Lord protected us wherever we went.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔyele yɛ ne yɛ nana mɔ fili Misraim aseɛ so ngoaasolɛ nu wale ɔ. Na nzɛngyerɛnneɛ mbiri mbiri bɔ yɛnwuni ye ne, ye yeɛ ɔyɔle ɔ. Atee bɔ yɛfale so ne amukoraa, yeɛ maen maen mukoraa bɔ yɛɛfale so ne, ɔbɔle yɛ nwo waen fili nu.

english_verse: And when we fought the Amorites and the other nations that lived in this land, the Lord made them run away. Yes, we will worship and obey the Lord, because the Lord is our God.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE foane maen maen amukoraa, yeɛ Amorifoɛ bɔ né bɛte aseɛ ne aso ne fili yɛ nyunu. Yiti yɛ koso yɛkɔso AWURADE, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔte yɛ Nyameɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Joshua said: The Lord is fearsome; he is the one true God, and I don't think you are able to worship and obey him in the ways he demands. You would have to be completely faithful, and if you sin or rebel, he won't let you get away with it.
translation_verse: Nakoso Yosua sele maen ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔngɔhora ngɔso AWURADE, ofikyɛ ɔte Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte krongron ɔ. Ɔte nungunɛ Nyameɛ; na ɔngɔfa ɛmɔ mmeraatolɛ ne ɛmɔ bɔne ngɔhyɛ ɛmɔ.

english_verse: If you turn your backs on the Lord and worship the gods of other nations, the Lord will turn against you. He will make terrible things happen to you and wipe you out, even though he had been good to you before.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔyakyi AWURADE si lilɛ bɛkɔɔso Amaenmaensofoɛ nyameɛ mɔ a, ye de ɔmva ye nwo kyɛ AWURADE ayɛ ɛmɔ paa ɔ, ɔkɔpɛ ye nwo kɔprapra amaneɛ kogua ɛmɔ so kɔmaa ɛmɔkowuwu.”

english_verse: But the people shouted, “We won't worship any other gods. We will worship and obey only the Lord!”
translation_verse: Na maen ne buale Yosua kyɛ, “Daabi! AWURADE yeɛ yɛkɔso ye ɔ.”

english_verse: Joshua said, “You have heard yourselves say that you will worship and obey the Lord. Isn't that true?” “Yes, it's true,” they answered.
translation_verse: Na afei Yosua sele maen ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔte ɛmɔ nwo adanzefoɛ kyɛ AWURADE yeɛ ɛmɔaneanea nu baye ye kyɛ ɛmɔkɔso ye ɔ.” Na bɛ koso bebuale kyɛ, “Yɛte adanzefoɛ.”

english_verse: Joshua said, “But you still have some idols, like those the other nations worship. Get rid of your idols! You must decide once and for all that you really want to obey the Lord God of Israel.”
translation_verse: Na osele kyɛ, “Nzaade ɛ́mɔgyi Amaenmaensofoɛ nyameɛ mɔ bɔ ɛmɔle ye ne begua, ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bɛ́ma AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ.”

english_verse: The people said, “The Lord is our God, and we will worship and obey only him.”
translation_verse: Na maen ne buale Yosua kyɛ, “AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ yɛkɔso ye ɔ, na ye dwirɛ so yeɛ yɛkoli ɔ.”

english_verse: Joshua helped Israel make an agreement with the Lord that day at Shechem. Joshua made laws for Israel
translation_verse: Yiti Yosua ne Yisraelfoɛ yɛle apam sɔ kyẽa ne, na ɔmane bɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ wɔ Sɛkem.

english_verse: and wrote them down in The Book of the Law of God. Then he set up a large stone under the oak tree at the place of worship in Shechem
translation_verse: Yosua hyerɛle sɔ dwirɛ ne wɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa nwomaa ne anu. Na ɔfale nyɔboɛ kandinga bie penane eluii bakaa bɔ ogyi AWURADE nekaa krongron berɛ ne abo.

english_verse: and told the people, “Look at this stone. It has heard everything that the Lord has said to us. Our God can call this stone as a witness if we ever reject him.”
translation_verse: Na Yosua sele maen ne amukoraati kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtie, nyɔboɛ he yeɛ ɔte adanzeɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ wate AWURADE dwirɛ amukoraa bɔ waha wahyire yɛ ne. Na sɛ ɛmɔanni nahorɛ bamma ɛmɔ Nyameɛ a, nyɔboɛ ne kɔyɛ adanzeɛ kotia ɛmɔ.”

english_verse: Joshua sent everyone back to their homes. Joshua, Joseph, and Eleazar Are Buried
translation_verse: Na Yosua mane mmenia ne amukoraa betuli apo besa bɛhɔle b’aseɛ nemɔ aso. Yosua ne Eleasa wue

english_verse: Not long afterwards, the Lord's servant Joshua died at the age of
translation_verse: Na ɛhemɔ asi ne, Nun awa Yosua bɔ ɔte AWURADE somvoɛ ne, owuli. Olili afoɛ ɛyaa ko ne buru.

english_verse: The Israelites buried him in his own land at Timnath-Serah, north of Mount Gaash in the hill country of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Besiele ye wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye aseɛ so wɔ Timinate Sera, wɔ Efraim mmokaa ne anu dɔ, wɔ Gaase bokaa ne sorɔ dɔ.

english_verse: As long as Joshua lived, Israel worshiped and obeyed the Lord. There were other leaders old enough to remember everything that the Lord had done for Israel. And for as long as these men lived, Israel continued to worship and obey the Lord.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ amukoraa bɔ né Yosua te ase ne, Yisrael sole AWURADE. Na Yosua wue asi ne koso, maen ne anu mbanyi bɔ né bɛtɛ te ase, ná afei benwuni nikyee biala bɔ AWURADE ayɔ ama Yisrael nen, mmerɛ mukoraa bɔ né bɛte ase ne, Yisrael hɔle so sole AWURADE.

english_verse: When the people of Israel left Egypt, they brought the bones of Joseph along with them. They took the bones to the town of Shechem and buried them in the field that Jacob had bought for
translation_verse: Yosef mmowue bɔ Yisraelfoɛ sesa fili Misraim wale ne, besiele ye wɔ Sɛkem, wɔ aseɛ bɔ Yakob tɔ fili Sɛkem baba Hamɔ mma nemɔ berɛ ne aso. Ɔtɔle ye sikaa ɛdwetɛ ɛyaa ko. Na aseɛ ne ɔɔyɛle Yosef boso ama agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: When Eleazar the priest died, he was buried in the hill country of Ephraim on a hill that belonged to his son Phinehas.
translation_verse: Aarɔn awa Eleasa wuli, na besiele ye wɔ ɔwa Finehase kuro Gibea, bɔ bɛfa bɛmane Finehase wɔ Efraim mmokaa ne anu dɔ ne aso.

english_verse: After the death of Joshua, the Israelites asked the Lord, “Which of our tribes should attack the Canaanites first?”
translation_verse: Yosua wue asi ne, Yisraelfoɛ bisale AWURADE kyɛ, “Yɛ nu abusua kure beni yeɛ oli moa ɔfa koɛ ɔɔteta Kanaanfoɛ ɔma yɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: “Judah!” the Lord answered. “I'll help them take the land.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE buale kyɛ, “Yuda abusua kure yeɛ odi kyɛ odi moa ɔkɔ ɔ. Mafa aseɛ ne mawura ye sa.”

english_verse: The people of Judah went to their relatives, the Simeon tribe, and said, “Canaanites live in the land God gave us. Help us fight them, and we will help you.” Troops from Simeon came to help Judah.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yuda abusua kure sele oliɛma Simeon abusua kure kyɛ, “Baaboka me wɔ aseɛ bɔ bafa bama me ne aso, maa yɛ ne Kanaanfoɛ yɛho; na me koso me ne wɔ kɔhɔ ngɔɔboka wɔ ma wɔ sa kɔha w’aseɛ deɛ bɔ bafa bama wɔ ne.” Yiti Simeon ne ye bɛhɔle.

english_verse: After that, they attacked the Canaanites who lived at Hebron, defeating the three clans called Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai. At that time, Hebron was called Kiriath-Arba.
translation_verse: Yuda ɔɔfale koɛ tetale Kanaanfoɛ bɔ bɛte Hebron ne ; na belili Sesayi, Ahiman ne Talmae so ngonim. Otiniɛl di Dɛbi kuro ne so ngonim (Yosua

english_verse: The king tried to escape, but soldiers from Judah caught him. They cut off his thumbs and big toes,
translation_verse: Adoni Beseke nwatili, nakoso bɛfoane ye bɛɛhyele ye, na bɛpepɛle ye sa kokotire ne ye gya kokotire.

english_verse: They attacked Jerusalem, captured it, killed everyone who lived there, and then burned it to the ground.
translation_verse: Afei Yudafoɛ fale koɛ bɛɛtetale Yerusalem, na bɛho bɛfale kuro ne. Bele ngrandɛ behuhuni nu ama, na bɛtole kuro ne anu see.

english_verse: Judah's army fought the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, the Southern Desert, and the foothills to the west.
translation_verse: Ye si ye, Kanaanfoɛ bɔ bɛte bokaa aseɛ ne aso, ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne aso, ɔne aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso ne, Yudafoɛ hɔle bɛ ne bɛ bɛɛhone.

english_verse: From Hebron, Judah's army went to attack Debir, which at that time was called Kiriath-Sepher.
translation_verse: Befili berɛ ne, bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtetale Dɛbifoɛ .

english_verse: Caleb told his troops, “The man who captures Kiriath-Sepher can marry my daughter Achsah.”
translation_verse: Na Kalebo sele kyɛ, “Bienzua biala bɔ ɔkɔho koli Kiriate Sefa so ngonim nen, ngɔfa mma brasua Akesa maa okogya ye.”

english_verse: Caleb's nephew Othniel captured Kiriath-Sepher, so Caleb let him marry Achsah. Othniel was the son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz.
translation_verse: Na Otiniɛl bɔ ɔte Kalebo aliɛma bienzua kãa Kenase awa ne, ɔho lili Kiriate Sefa so ngonim; yiti Kalebo fale ɔwa brasua Akesa maa ogyale ye.

english_verse: Right after the wedding, Achsah started telling Othniel that he ought to ask her father for a field. She went to see her father, and while she was getting down from her donkey, Caleb asked, “What's bothering you?”
translation_verse: Braa ne hɔle agyaa bo wɔ Otiniɛl awuro nen, osele ohu kyɛ ɔ́srɛ aseɛ ófi ye baba Kalebo berɛ. Na braa ne fili ye afunum ne aso dwuli ase nen, Kalebo bisale ye kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ ekuro ɔ?”

english_verse: She answered, “I need your help. The land you gave me is in the Southern Desert, so please give me some spring-fed ponds for a water supply.” Caleb gave her a couple of small ponds named Higher Pond and Lower Pond.
translation_verse: Na obuale ye kyɛ, “Kyɛ me nikye. Ofikyɛ aseɛ bɔ afa ama me wɔ ngwaen dɔ ne, ɔte wosee. Yiti ma me mbombonzue koso.” Yiti Kalebo fale Gulote sorɔ dɔ ne Golote ngwaen dɔ bokale ye so.

english_verse: The people who belonged to the Kenite clan were the descendants of the father-in-law of Moses. They left Jericho with the people of Judah and settled near Arad in the Southern Desert of Judah not far from the Amalekites.
translation_verse: Mose sia bienzua Hobabo bɔ ɔte Keniniɛ ne, ye boso ama mɔ, bɛ ne Yuda boso ama befili ayee kuro ne anu bɛhɔle Yuda ɛserɛ ne aso. Ɛserɛ ne wɔ ngwaen dɔ aseɛ bɔ opingye Arade ne aso. Bɛ ne Amalɛkefoɛ bɛɛtenane.

english_verse: Judah's army helped Simeon's army attack the Canaanites who lived at Zephath. They completely destroyed the town and renamed it Hormah.
translation_verse: Yuda ne oliɛma Simeon besili nu bɛhɔle, na belili Kanaanfoɛ bɔ bɛte Sefate ne aso ngonim. Bɛsɛkyele kuro ne pasaa, na bɛfrɛle kuro ne Hɔma.

english_verse: The Lord helped the army of Judah capture Gaza, Ashkelon, Ekron, and the land near those towns. They also took the hill country. But the people who lived in the valleys had iron chariots, so Judah was not able to make them leave or to take their land.
translation_verse: Né AWURADE gyi Yuda si, na Yuda ho fale bokaa aseɛ ne. Nakoso wangora wandu aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso ama wamvi berɛ, ofikyɛ né bele buralɛ teaseɛnam mɔ.

english_verse: The tribe of Judah gave the town of Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had told them to do. Caleb defeated the three Anakim clans and took over the town. The Benjamin Tribe Does Not Capture Jerusalem
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ fale Hebron bɛmane Kalebo, kyɛbɔ Mose hyɛle ne; na Kalebo tuli Anake mma mmienzua nza nemɔ fili berɛ.

english_verse: The Jebusites were living in Jerusalem, and the Benjamin tribe did not defeat them or capture the town. That's why Jebusites still live in Jerusalem along with the people of Benjamin. The Ephraim and Manasseh Tribes Capture Bethel
translation_verse: Nakoso Benyaminfoɛ bandu Yebusifoɛ bɔ né bɛte Yerusalem ne bamvi berɛ. Yiti Yebusifoɛ ne Benyaminfoɛ babɔ nu batena Yerusalem maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

english_verse: While the spies were watching the town, a man came out, and they told him, “If you show us how our army can get into the town, we will make sure that you aren't harmed.”
translation_verse: Maentetɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ nwuni kyɛ biaa bie fi kuro ne anu ofite ɔ, na besele ye kyɛ, “Kyire yɛ atee bɔ ɔkɔ kuro ne anu ɔ, na yɛkɔmaa ekonya wɔ ti kodidi nu.”

english_verse: The man showed them, and the two Israelite tribes attacked Bethel, killing everyone except the man and his family. The two tribes made the man and his family leave,
translation_verse: Yiti biaa ne hyirele bɛ atee bɔ ɔkɔ kuro ne anu ɔ. Bele ngrandɛ behuhuni kuro ne anu ama, nakoso bɛyakyili biaa ne, ɔne ye abusuafoɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: so they went to the land of the Hittites, where he built a town. He named the town Luz, and that is still its name. Israel Does Not Get Rid of All the Canaanites
translation_verse: Biaa ne hɔle Hitifoɛ aseɛ so ɔɔkyekyele kuro. Ɔtole kuro ne dumaa Luse, na ɛnɛ ne ɛnɛ ye, sɔ yeɛ bɛfrɛ kuro ne ɔ.

english_verse: The Ephraim tribe did not get rid of the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, so the Canaanites lived there with Israelites all around them.
translation_verse: Efraim andu Kanaanfoɛ bɔ bɛte Gɛsɛre ne wamvi berɛ, na mmom bɛ ne Kanaanfoɛ bɛbɔle nu bɛtenane Gɛsɛre.

english_verse: The Zebulun tribe did not get rid of the Canaanites who lived in Kitron and Nahalol, and the Canaanites stayed there with Israelites around them. But the people of Zebulun did force the Canaanites into slave labor.
translation_verse: Sebulɔn andu Kitronfoɛ ne Nahalolfoɛ wamvi berɛ; na mmom bɛ ne Kanaanfoɛ bɔle nu bɛtenane, na Yisraelfoɛ hyɛle bɛ maa bɛyɔle adwuma bɛmane bɛ.

english_verse: The Asher tribe did not get rid of the Canaanites who lived in Acco, Sidon, Ahlab, Achzib, Helbah, Aphik, and Rehob, and the Asher tribe lived with Canaanites all around them.
translation_verse: na mmom Kanaanfoɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ aseɛ ne aso ne, Asɛfoɛ ne bɛ bɔle nu bɛtenane; ofikyɛ bandu bɛ bamvi berɛ.

english_verse: The Naphtali tribe did not get rid of the Canaanites who lived in Beth-Shemesh and Beth-Anath, but they did force the Canaanites into slave labor. The Naphtali tribe lived with Canaanites around them.
translation_verse: Nafetali andu Bete Semesefoɛ ne Bete Anatefoɛ wamvi berɛ, na mmom Kaananfoɛ bɔ né bɛte aseɛ ne aso ne, Nafetalifoɛ ne bɛ bɔle nu bɛtenane berɛ. Nakoso Nafetalifoɛ hyɛle Bete Semesefoɛ ne Bete Anatefoɛ maa bɛyɔle adwuma bɛmane bɛ.

english_verse: The Amorites were strong enough to keep the tribe of Dan from settling in the valleys, so Dan had to stay in the hill country.
translation_verse: Amorifoɛ foane Danfoɛ maa besale bɛ si bɛhɔle mmokaa aseɛ ne aso. Bamma bɛ ate maa bandorotoro bamma aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso.

english_verse: The Amorites on Mount Heres and in Aijalon and Shaalbim were also determined to stay. Later on, as Ephraim and Manasseh grew more powerful, they forced those Amorites into slave labor. The Amorite-Edomite Border
translation_verse: Amorifoɛ hɔle so bɛtenane Hare Herese, Ayalɔn, yeɛ Saalebim. Nakoso Yosef boso ama nemɔ nwo yɛle se trale bɛ, na bɛhyɛle bɛ maa bɛyɔle adwuma bɛmane bɛ.

english_verse: The old Amorite-Edomite border used to go from Sela through Scorpion Pass into the hill country.
translation_verse: Amorifoɛ aseɛ ne wɛen ne, ye noa hyɛ ye bo fi Akrabim pambaa ne, na ɔtoa so kɔ Sela kɔ sorɔ dɔ.

english_verse: The Lord's angel went from Gilgal to Bochim and gave the Israelites this message from the Lord: I promised your ancestors that I would give this land to their families, and I brought your people here from Egypt. We made an agreement that I promised never to break,
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE abɔfo fili Gilgal hɔle Bokim oosele Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, “Me yeɛ nyele ɛmɔ mvili Misraim, ná mvale ɛmɔ mmale aseɛ bɔ mva nhyɛle ɛmɔ nana mɔ bɔ ne aso ɔ. Ngane kyɛ, ‘Mengobu apam bɔ me ne ɛmɔ yayɛ ne aso le.

english_verse: and you promised not to make any peace treaties with the other nations that live in the land. Besides that, you agreed to tear down the altars where they sacrifice to their idols. Why haven't you kept your promise?
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ koso, nnɛma ɛmɔ ne aseɛ he aso ama bɛyɛ apam. Ɛ́mɔdwiri b’afɔleɛ bokyea nemɔ begua.’ Nakoso ɛmɔanni m’ahyɛdeɛ so. Ɛmɔanwu bɔ ɛmɔayɔ ɔ!

english_verse: And so, I'll stop helping you defeat your enemies. Instead, they will be there to trap you into worshiping their idols.
translation_verse: Yiti afei menwa, mengɔfoa bɛ mengofi ɛmɔ nyunu; na mmom bɛkɔkakyi ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ, na bɛ mmosoen nemɔ kɔyɛ ɛmɔ so ngaen.”

english_verse: and they offered sacrifices to the Lord. From then on, they called that place “Crying.” Israel Stops Worshiping the Lord
translation_verse: Yeɛ bɛfrɛle berɛ Bokim, na bɛbɔle afɔleɛ wɔ berɛ bɛmane AWURADE. Yosua wue

english_verse: Joshua had been faithful to the Lord. And after Joshua sent the Israelites to take the land they had been promised, they remained faithful to the Lord until Joshua died at the age of
translation_verse: Na besiele ye wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye aseɛ ne aso wɔ Timinate Herese, wɔ Efraim mmokaa aseɛ so, wɔ Gaase bokaa ne sorɔ dɔ.

english_verse: After a while the people of Joshua's generation died, and the next generation did not know the Lord or any of the things he had done for Israel.
translation_verse: Afei koso, sɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ne amukoraa bewuwuli bɛɛtoale bɛ mbanyi mɔ, na aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ foforɛ fifili bɛ gya nu, bɔ né bɛnze AWURADE anaa nikyee bɔ wayɔ wama Yisrael ɔ. Yisrael so mmosoen

english_verse: with the Israelites that he let other nations raid Israel and steal their crops and other possessions. Enemies were everywhere, and the Lord always let them defeat Israel in battle. The Lord had warned Israel he would do this, and now the Israelites were miserable. The Lord Chooses Leaders for Israel
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ AWURADE bɔle bɛ kɔkɔ ná osa tale ye nwo ndaen hyirele bɛ ne, mmerɛ biala bɔ bɛhɔle koɛ ne, AWURADE yele ye sa fili bɛ bo maa musue tole bɛ, na bɛ nwo hyerele bɛ paa.

english_verse: In years gone by, the Israelites had been faithful to the Lord, but now they were quick to be unfaithful and to refuse even to listen to these judges. The Israelites disobeyed the Lord, and instead of worshiping him, they worshiped other gods.
translation_verse: Nakoso maenbulɛfoɛ nemɔ po, Yisraelfoɛ andie bɛ; ofikyɛ Yisraelfoɛ beelili nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ si bɛkotole bɛ. Bɛ nana mɔ bɔ belili AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ so ne, Nyameɛ dwirɛ bɔ belili so ne, wangyɛ yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ lili ye nwo makyebu ɔ. Bɛ de, banni so.

english_verse: When enemies made life miserable for the Israelites, the Lord felt sorry for them. He would choose a judge and help that judge rescue Israel from its enemies. The Lord was kind to Israel as long as that judge lived.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ biala, sɛ né AWURADE ye maenbulɛfoɛ ma bɛ a, AWURADE gyina maenbulɛfoɛ nemɔ si. Na mmerɛ amukoraa bɔ maenbulɛniɛ ne te ase ne, AWURADE de bɛ fi bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu. Ofikyɛ ndaneanyeɛ ne nhyɛsoɛ bɔ bɛ pɔfoɛ nemɔ fa di bɛ ne, aworabɔlɛ bɔ ɔmaa bedi ne, AWURADE fa ye nye to, na onwu bɛ anwumvoin.

english_verse: But afterwards, the Israelites would become even more sinful than their ancestors had been. The Israelites were stubborn—they simply would not stop worshiping other gods or following their teachings. The Lord Lets Enemies Test Israel
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ sɔ maenbulɛniɛ ne wu pɛ, né basa bɛ si baabɔ bra tɛɛ bɔ ɔtra bɛ nana mɔ deɛ ne ɔ. Bekodi nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ si, bɛso bɛ ná bɛkoto bɛ. Bɛnyakyi bɛ yɔleɛ tɛɛ anaa b’asoserɛ ne anu biala.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with Israel and said: The Israelites have broken the agreement I made with their ancestors. They won't obey me,
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE fɛle Yisrael so yaa paa, na osele kyɛ, “Ɔnate kyɛ maen he abu m’apam bɔ nhyehyɛle mane bɛ nana mɔ ne aso, ná bandie me dwirɛ ne ati,

english_verse: so I'll stop helping them defeat their enemies. Israel still had a lot of enemies when Joshua died,
translation_verse: maen maen bɔ Yosua wanni bɛ so ngonim koraka yeɛ owu ne, mengɔfoa bɛ nu biala mengofi bɛ nyunu ko.”

english_verse: and I'm going to let those enemies stay. I'll use them to test Israel, because then I can find out if Israel will worship and obey me as their ancestors did.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná AWURADE aso Yisrael wanea, kyɛ aso bekotie ye dwirɛ kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ tiele ne, anaakyɛ bengotie,

english_verse: That's why the Lord had not let Joshua get rid of those enemy nations all at once.
translation_verse: yiti AWURADE yakyili sɔ maen nemɔ maa bɛhale berɛ, na wamvoa bɛ mukoraati berɛ ne ala, na wamva bɛ wanwura Yosua sa.

english_verse: And the Lord had another reason for letting these enemies stay. The Israelites needed to learn how to fight in war, just as their ancestors had done. Each new generation would have to learn by fighting
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle ye sɔ, amaa ɔnate so sɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ mɔ bɔ koɛ ɔttole bɛ le ne, wahyire bɛ koɛhonɛ.

english_verse: the Philistines and their five rulers, as well as the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites that lived in the Lebanon Mountains from Mount Baal-Hermon to Hamath Pass.
translation_verse: Maen nemɔ ole Filistifoɛ ahemvo nnu ne, Kanaanfoɛ amukoraa, Sidonfoɛ, ɔne Hiwifoɛ bɔ bɛte Lebanon bokaa ne aso ne, ofi Baal Hɛmɔn bokaa ne aso bɔ ɔkwaadwu Lebo Hamate ne.

english_verse: Moses had told the Israelites what the Lord had commanded them to do, and now the Lord was using these nations to find out if Israel would obey.
translation_verse: AWURADE mane maen nemɔ hale berɛ, amaa ɔnate bɛ so waso Yisrael wanea, sɛ aso ye mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ ɔnate Mose so hyɛle bɛ nana mɔ ne, Yisrael koli so anaa.

english_verse: But they refused. And some of them even married Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites who lived all around them. That's how they started worshiping foreign gods. Othniel
translation_verse: Na Yisraelfoɛ gyigyale bɛ mma mmrasua mɔ, yeɛ bɛfale bɛ mma mmrasua deɛ mɔ bɛmomane Kaananfoɛ mma mmienzua agyaa. Afei bɛsole Kanaanfoɛ mmosoen nemɔ. Otiniɛl

english_verse: The Israelites sinned against the Lord by forgetting him and worshiping idols of Baal and Astarte.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ yɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Bɛmane bɛ wora fili AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ, na bɛsɔnene Baal mɔ ne Asera mɔ.

english_verse: This made the Lord angry, so he let Israel be defeated by King Cushan Rishathaim of northern Syria, who ruled Israel eight years and made everyone pay taxes.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE fɛle Yisrael so yaa. Ɔfale bɛ wurale Mesopotamia hene Kusan Risatim sa, na Yisraelfoɛ sole Kusan Risatim afoɛ mmɔtwɛ.

english_verse: The Israelites begged the Lord for help, and so he chose Othniel to rescue them. Othniel was the son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz.
translation_verse: Nakoso Yisraelfoɛ sũ frɛle AWURADE nen, AWURADE yele defoɛ mane bɛ maa ɔɔpepɛ lele bɛ. Ye ole Otiniɛl bɔ ɔse ole Kalebo aliɛma bienzua kãa Kenase ne.

english_verse: and Israel was at peace until Othniel died about
translation_verse: Yiti asomdwee wale aseɛ ne aso afoɛ aburanna. Na Kenase awa Otiniɛl wuli. Ehude

english_verse: Once more the Israelites started disobeying the Lord. So he let them be defeated by King Eglon of Moab,
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ sa yɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Na AWURADE mane Moabo hene Eglon nyane anwoserɛ oolili Yisrael so ngonim, ofikyɛ Yisraelfoɛ yɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: who had joined forces with the Ammonites and the Amalekites to attack Israel. Eglon and his army captured Jericho.
translation_verse: Eglon fale Amonfoɛ ne Amalɛkefoɛ bokale ye nwo so, na oolili Yisrael so ngonim. Na bɛfale Ayee kuro ne.

english_verse: Then he ruled Israel for
translation_verse: Yiti Yisraelfoɛ sole Moabo hene Eglon afoɛ buru ne mmɔtwɛ.

english_verse: Ehud went with the other Israelites as far as the statues at Gilgal. Then he turned back and went upstairs to the room where Eglon had his throne.
