english_verse: Then he built an altar for the Lord. He offered sacrifices to please the Lord and to ask for his blessings. The Lord answered the prayers of the people, and no one else died from the terrible disease.
translation_verse: Dawide sili afɔleɛ bokyea mane AWURADE wɔ berɛ, na ɔbɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne asomdwee afɔleɛ. Yiti AWURADE gyinane ye sufrɛ ne aso nwuni maen ne anwumvoin, na ɔpraprale ɛhawo ne fili Yisrael.

english_verse: King David was now an old man, and he always felt cold, even under a lot of blankets.
translation_verse: Nana Dawide nyini paa yɛle aworowaa. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛfale ɛtena begurɔle ye nwo de, nakoso né ɛyerɛ tɛ ku ye.

english_verse: His officials said, “Your Majesty, we will look for a young woman to take care of you. She can lie down beside you and keep you warm.”
translation_verse: Yiti ye mbanyi mɔ sele ye kyɛ, “Nana, yɛ mene, maa yɛpena taluwa bɔ onnwuni biaa le ɔ yɛma wɔ maa ɔ́yɛ wɔ somvoɛ ɔso wɔ. Nana, yɛ mene, odi kyɛ ɛmaa ɔda wɔ kunu amaa ɔnate so wɔ nwo ayɛ wɔ hye.”

english_verse: Adonijah was the son of David and Haggith. He was Absalom's younger brother and was very handsome. One day, Adonijah started bragging, “I'm going to make myself king!” So he got some chariots and horses, and he hired
translation_verse: Ye baba anga ye nyunu, yeɛ wammisa ye le kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛyɔ sɔ ye?” Né Adoniya nwo yɛ nyemene paa, na Dawide wole Absalom koraka yeɛ ɔwo ye ɔ.

english_verse: Adonijah himself was afraid of what Solomon might do to him, so he ran to the sacred tent and grabbed hold of the corners of the altar for protection.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ né Adoniya suro Solomon ne ati, Adoniya hɔle ɔɔsosɔle afɔleɛ bokyea mmɛen nemɔ anu.

english_verse: Adonijah met with Joab the son of Zeruiah and Abiathar the priest and asked them if they would help him become king. Both of them agreed to help.
translation_verse: Adoniya ne Seruya awa Yoabo, yeɛ ɔsɔfo Abiata bɛbɔle porɛ, na begyinane Adoniya si.

english_verse: But Zadok the priest, Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, Nathan the prophet, Shimei, Rei, and David's bodyguards all refused.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔsɔfo Sadoke, Yehoada awa Benaya, ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Natan, bɛ ne Simei, Reyi, yeɛ Dawide koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ nemɔ de, bangyina Adoniya si.

english_verse: Adonijah invited his brothers and David's officials from Judah to go with him to Crawling Rock near Rogel Spring, where he sacrificed some sheep, cattle, and fat calves.
translation_verse: Adoniya fale mmoaen, nandwie nyii, ɔne nandwie sayɛɛ bɔle afɔleɛ wɔ Sohelete nyɔboɛ bɔ opingye Ɛn Rogyel ne anwo. Ɔtole ye sa frɛle Nana Dawide mma mmienzua bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte oliɛma nemɔ amukoraa, yeɛ Dawide mbanyi amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ Yuda ɔ.

english_verse: But he did not invite Nathan, Benaiah, David's bodyguards, or his own brother Solomon.
translation_verse: Nakoso ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Natan ne Benaya ne koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ nemɔ ne oliɛma Solomon de, wando ye sa wamvrɛ bɛ bie.

english_verse: When Nathan heard what had happened, he asked Bathsheba, Solomon's mother: Have you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith has made himself king? But David doesn't know a thing about it.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Natan sele Solomon maame Bahyeba kyɛ, “Aso ɛttele kyɛ Hagite awa Adoniya wasi ye nwo hene bɔ yɛ mene Dawide ɔnze ɔ?

english_verse: You and your son Solomon will be killed, unless you do what I tell you.
translation_verse: Yiti tie, maa ndu wɔ foɛ, amaa anya wɔ ti adidi nu, ná ɛwa Solomon koso wanya ye ti wadidi nu.

english_verse: Go say to David, “You promised me that Solomon would be the next king. So why is Adonijah now king?”
translation_verse: Kɔ Nana Dawide berɛ kekesaala ye kɔhã kyire ye kyɛ, ‘Nana, me mene, aso anda ndaen angyire w’afaneɛ kyɛ, Ɛwa bienzua Solomon yeɛ okoli me bia kobu maen ne ɔ? Nzu ati yeɛ Adoniya mmom yeɛ wali hene ɔ?’

english_verse: While you are still talking to David, I'll come in and tell him that everything you said is true.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ egu so ɛne Nana bedwudwo ne, ngoli wɔ si ngɔwa berɛ ná mafa maato wɔ deɛ ne aso.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, David was in his bedroom where Abishag was taking care of him because he was so old. Bathsheba went in
translation_verse: Yiti Bahyeba hɔle Nana Dawide berɛ wɔ ye sua nu. Né Dawide ayɛ aworowaa paa. Sunamniɛ Abisage yeɛ ne ɔso Dawide ɔ.

english_verse: and bowed down. “What can I do for you?” David asked.
translation_verse: Bahyeba bɔle ye nu ase kotole Dawide, na Dawide bisale kyɛ, “Na amaneɛ?”

english_verse: Bathsheba answered: Your Majesty, you promised me in the name of the Lord your God that my son Solomon would be the next king.
translation_verse: Obuale ye kyɛ, “Me mene, ɛfale AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ tale ndaen hyirele w’afaneɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛwa Solomon yeɛ okoli me bia kobu maen ne ɔ.’

english_verse: But Adonijah has already been made king, and you didn't know anything about it.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nana, me mene, Adoniya ayɛ ndɛndɛ wasi ye nwo hene bɔ ɛnze ɔ.

english_verse: He sacrificed a lot of cattle, calves, and sheep. And he invited Abiathar the priest, Joab your army commander, and all your sons to be there, except Solomon, your loyal servant.
translation_verse: Nana, wafa nandwie nyii, nandwie sayɛɛ ne mmoaen pee wabɔ afɔleɛ, na wato ye sa wafrɛ wɔ mma ne amukoraa, ɔsɔfo Abiata ne safohene Yoabo. Nakoso w’akoaa Solomon de, wando ye sa wamvrɛ ye bie.

english_verse: Your Majesty, everyone in Israel is waiting for you to announce who will be the next king.
translation_verse: Nana, me mene, Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɛnea wɔ, kyɛ Nana, w’adaworoma, ɛkɔfa sona bɔ okoli wɔ bia ye dumaa kɔto dwaa ɔ.

english_verse: If you don't, they will say that Solomon and I have rebelled. They will treat us like criminals and kill us as soon as you die.
translation_verse: Nana, me mene, wamma ye sɔ a, sɛ ɛtoa wɔ mbanyi mɔ a, bekobu me ne mma Solomon kyɛ yɛte ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ.”

english_verse: Someone told David that he was there, and Nathan came in. He bowed with his face to the ground
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle Dawide amaneɛ kyɛ, “Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Natan awa wa.” Natan oodwuli Dawide nyunu berɛ ne, ɔkotole berɛ fale ye nyunu butuli ase wɔ Dawide nyunu.

english_verse: and said: Your Majesty, did you say that Adonijah would be king?
translation_verse: Natan bisale kyɛ, “Nana, me mene, aso ahã kyɛ, ‘Adoniya yeɛ okoli me bia kobu maen ne ɔ’?

english_verse: Earlier today, he sacrificed a lot of cattle, calves, and sheep. He invited the army commanders, Abiathar, and all your sons to be there. They are already eating and drinking and shouting, “Long live King Adonijah!”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nana, ɛnɛ wafa nandwie nyii, nandwie sayɛɛ ɔne mmoaen pee wabɔ afɔleɛ, na wato ye sa wafrɛ wɔ mma nemɔ amukoraa, yeɛ safohene Yoabo ɔne ɔsɔfo Abiata. Kekesaala ye, bɛ ne ye bedidi bɛno, na bɛkã kyɛ, ‘Nana Adoniya, wɔ ngoa so oo!’

english_verse: But he didn't invite me or Zadok the priest or Benaiah or Solomon.
translation_verse: Nakoso me bɔ nde wɔ somvoɛ, yeɛ ɔsɔfo Sadoke, Yehoada awa Benaya, ɔne w’akoaa Solomon de, wando ye sa wamvrɛ yɛ bie.

english_verse: Did you say they could do this without telling the rest of us who would be the next king? Solomon Becomes King
translation_verse: Nana, me mene, saa nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ ayɔ ato berɛ hɔ ɛne, yeɛ koso Nana, w’adaworoma, amma wɔ ngoaa bannwu sona bɔ kyẽa bie oli wɔ biaa ɔ?” Dawide sie ye bia ma Solomon

english_verse: David said, “Tell Bathsheba to come here.” She came and stood in front of him.
translation_verse: Nana Dawide buale kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfrɛ Bahyeba bɛma me.” Yiti Bahyeba wale oogyinane Nana Dawide nyunu berɛ.

english_verse: Then he said, “The living Lord God of Israel has kept me safe. And so today, I will keep the promise I made to you in his name: Solomon will be the next king!”
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ mvale AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ndale ndaen ngyirele wɔ kyɛ, ‘Ɛwa Solomon yeɛ okoli me bia kobu maen ne’ nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ngɔyɔ ye ɛnɛ kyẽa ye ɔ.”

english_verse: Bathsheba bowed with her face to the ground and said, “Your Majesty, I pray that you will live a long time!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Bahyeba kotole fale ye nyunu butuli berɛ wɔ Nana Dawide nyunu. Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Me mene Nana Dawide, wɔ ngoa so oo!”

english_verse: Then David said, “Tell Zadok, Nathan, and Benaiah to come here.” When they arrived,
translation_verse: Na Nana Dawide hane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfrɛ ɔsɔfo Sadoke, ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Natan ne Yehoada awa Benaya bɛma me.” Na bɛwale Nana Dawide nyunu berɛ nen,

english_verse: he told them: Take along some of my officials and let Solomon ride my own mule to Gihon Spring.
translation_verse: Nana Dawide sele bɛ kyɛ, “Nde ɛmɔ mene, ɛmɔ ne m’awɛmvoɛ nemɔ bɛhɔ. Ɛ́mɔma mma Solomon ɔ́tena me bɔbɔ m’afunum ne aso, ná ɛ́mɔfa ye bɛhɔ mbombonzue Gihon nwo.

english_verse: When you get there, Zadok and Nathan will pour olive oil over Solomon's head to show that he is the new king of Israel. Then order someone to blow a trumpet and tell everyone to shout, “Long live King Solomon!”
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma ɔsɔfo Sadoke ne ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Natan bɛpopa ye ngoo bɛfa ye besi Yisrael so hene wɔ berɛ. Afei ɛ́mɔhu totorobɛndo ne, ná ɛmɔhã kyɛ, ‘Nana Solomon, wɔ ngoa so oo!’

english_verse: Bring him back here, and he will take my place as king. He is the one I have chosen to rule Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔli ye si besa bɛfa ye bɛbra, ná ɛ́mɔma ɔhɔ sua nu ɔɔtena m’ahennie bia ne aso. Okoli me bia kɔyɛ hene, ofikyɛ maye ye kyɛ oli Yisrael ne Yuda so hene.”

english_verse: Benaiah answered, “We will do it, Your Majesty. I pray that the Lord your God will let it happen.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yehoada awa Benaya buale Nana Dawide kyɛ, “Amen! Nana, me mene, AWURADE bɔ ɔte wɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔ́ma ɔbra nu sɔ ala.

english_verse: The Lord has always watched over you, and I pray that he will now watch over Solomon. May the Lord help Solomon to be an even greater king than you.”
translation_verse: Nana, me mene, kyɛbɔ AWURADE gyinane wɔ si ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ogyina Solomon si ɔ. Nana, me mene Dawide, mesrɛ kyɛ Nyameɛ ma Solomon ahennie ɔhɔ so ɔtra wɔ deɛ ne.”

english_verse: Zadok, Nathan, and Benaiah left and took along the two groups of David's special bodyguards. Solomon rode on David's mule as they led him to Gihon Spring.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔsɔfo Sadoke, ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Natan ɔne Yehoada awa Benaya, yeɛ Keretifoɛ ne Peletifoɛ ne, bɛɛfale Solomon bɛtenane Nana Dawide afunum ne aso, na bɛfale ye bɛhɔle mbombonzue Gihon nwo.

english_verse: Zadok the priest brought some olive oil from the sacred tent and poured it on Solomon's head to show that he was now king. A trumpet was blown and everyone shouted, “Long live King Solomon!”
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo Sadoke fale ngoo towaa fili ɛtena sua krongron ne anu hɔle, na ɔpopale Solomon ngoo wɔ berɛ. Afei behuli totorobɛndo ne, na ɛlɔen ne amukoraati bɔ lele so kyɛ, “Nana Solomon, wɔ ngoa so oo!”

english_verse: Then they played flutes and celebrated as they followed Solomon back to Jerusalem. They made so much noise that the ground shook.
translation_verse: Na ɛlɔen ne amukoraati beelili ye si bɛ ne ye besa bɛwale. Behuli awɛen belili ahurusi kandinga, na ese bɔ bɛbɔle ne mane aseɛ wosole.

english_verse: Adonijah and his guests had almost finished eating when they heard the noise. Joab also heard the trumpet and asked, “What's all that noise about in the city?”
translation_verse: Na Adoniya ne mmenia amukoraa bɔ ɔtole ye sa frɛle bɛ bɔ bɛboka ye so wɔ berɛ ne, bɛbaayie poentolɛ ne, bɛtele esebɔlɛ ne. Yoabo tele totorobɛndohulɛ ne pɛ, obisale kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ wama kuro ye anye abutu ye?”

english_verse: Just then, Jonathan son of Abiathar came running up. “Come in,” Adonijah said. “An important man like you must have some good news.”
translation_verse: Yoabo noa wɔ so odwudwo ne, ɔsɔfo Abiata awa Yonatan yele ye ti berɛ. Adoniya sele kyɛ, “Bra sua nu, ofikyɛ ɛte sona paa, na mese kyɛ ɛso ndɛenvɛen.”

english_verse: Jonathan answered: No, I don't! David has just announced that Solomon will be king.
translation_verse: Yonatan buale Adoniya kyɛ, “Daabi nna sɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ yɛ mene Dawide wafa Solomon wasi hene.

english_verse: Solomon rode David's own mule to Gihon Spring, and Zadok, Nathan, Benaiah, and David's special bodyguards went with him. When they got there, Zadok and Nathan made Solomon king. Then everyone celebrated all the way back to Jerusalem. That's the noise you hear in the city.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo Sadoke ne ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Natan bapopa ye ngoo bafa ye basi hene wɔ mbombonzue Gihon nwo; na bele ahurusi bafi berɛ basa bawa kuro bama kuro ne anye abutu. Ye nwo esebɔlɛ yeɛ ɛte ye.

english_verse: And listen to this! David's officials told him, “We pray that your God will help Solomon to be an even greater king!” David was in his bed at the time, but he bowed
translation_verse: Afei koso, yɛ mene Nana Dawide ye mbanyi nemɔ, bahɔ baayɛ Dawide mmo, na bɛnwa, ‘Nyameɛ ɔ́ma Solomon ónya dumaa piri tra wɔ deɛ, na ɔ́ma ye ahennie ɔhɔ so tra wɔ deɛ.’ Ɛhe mane Nana Dawide bɔle ye nu ase wɔ ye bɛen so sɔnene AWURADE,

english_verse: and prayed, “I praise you, Lord God of Israel. You have made my son Solomon king and have let me live to see it.”
translation_verse: na ɔtoale so bɔle mbaeɛ kyɛ, ‘AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ, bɔ ɛnɛ waye mma ko maa wali me bia, na wama me nye anwu ye ne, animnyam hã ye.’ ”

english_verse: Adonijah's guests shook with fear when they heard this news, and they left as fast as they could.
translation_verse: Yeɛ mmenia amukoraa bɔ Adoniya tole ye sa frɛle bɛ ne, ahunundetelɛ tɔle bɛ so, na ebiala fale ye atee nwati hɔle.

english_verse: Someone told Solomon, “Adonijah is afraid of you and is holding onto the corners of the altar. He wants you to promise that you won't kill him.”
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle Solomon amaneɛ kyɛ, “Nana Solomon, Adoniya suro wɔ. Nea, waasosɔ afɔleɛ bokyea mmɛen nemɔ anu. Ɔnwa, ‘Mepena kyɛ ɛnɛ Nana Solomon ta ndaen kyire me kyɛ ɔngɔfa ngrandɛ ngohũ ye akoaa.’”

english_verse: Solomon answered, “If Adonijah doesn't cause any trouble, I won't hurt him. But if he does, I'll have him killed.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Solomon buale kyɛ, “Sɛ okyire suban paa de a, ye de bɛngɔpɛ ye ti nwiaa ko po bɛngɔto ase. Nakoso sɛ ɔyɔ nikyee bɔ ɔtte mayee de a, ngɔmaa bekohu ye.”

english_verse: Then he sent someone to the altar to get Adonijah. After Adonijah came and bowed down, Solomon said, “Adonijah, go home.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana Solomon maa bɛɛfale ye befili afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo bɛwale. Ɔfale ye nyunu butuli ase wɔ Nana Solomon nyunu, na Solomon sele ye kyɛ, “Kɔ awuro.”

english_verse: Not long before David died, he told Solomon:
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Dawide wue pingyele ne, ɔfale sɔ ahyɛdeɛ he mane ɔwa Solomon,

english_verse: My son, I will soon die, as everyone must. But I want you to be strong and brave.
translation_verse: “Wahã kãa né mafi aseɛ ye aso maatoa me mbanyi mɔ. Gyina pindinn, ma wɔ hue yɛ se,

english_verse: Do what the Lord your God commands and follow his teachings. Obey everything written in the Law of Moses. Then you will be a success, no matter what you do or where you go.
translation_verse: ná di bɔ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ wahyɛ wɔ kyɛ ɛyɔ ne aso. Tie ye dwirɛ, ná di ye ahyɛdeɛ, ye mmeraa dwirɛ, ye nhyehyɛleɛ ne ye noa dwirɛ so, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ Mose mmeraa ne anu ne, amaa wayie wɔ yé wɔ nikyee biala bɔ ɛkɔyɔ ɔ nu, ɔne nekaa biala bɔ ɛkɔhɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You and your descendants must always faithfully obey the Lord. If you do, he will keep the solemn promise he made to me that someone from our family will always be king of Israel.
translation_verse: AWURADE hã fale me nwo kyɛ, ‘Sɛ wɔ koliagyaa mɔ, bɛnea bɛbɔ bra paa, ná bɛfa b’ahone amukoraa ne bɛ kra amukoraa bedi me dwirɛ so nahorɛ nu a, sona bɔ odi wɔ bia tena Yisrael ahennie bia so ne, ɔngɔbɔ wɔ le.’

english_verse: Solomon, don't forget what Joab did to me by killing Abner son of Ner and Amasa son of Jether, the two commanders of Israel's army. He killed them as if they were his enemies in a war, but he did it when there was no war. He is guilty, and now it's up to you to punish him
translation_verse: “Afei koso, wɔ bɔbɔ ɛse edwirɛ bɔ Seruya awa Yoabo fa lili me ɔ. Nɛɛ awa Abenɛ ne Yeta awa Amasa, bɔ bɛte Yisrael safohene nyɔ ne, enwuni atee bɔ ɔfale bɛ fale so ɔ. Mogya bɔ Abenɛ ne Amasa bɛhã beguale wɔ koɛ nu ne, Yoabo tɔle bɛ so wereɛ wɔ asomdwee mmerɛ nu, na ɔmane koɛ mogya hane abɔsoɛ bɔ ɔbɔ ye yaase ɔne mmaboa bɔ owura ye ɔ.

english_verse: in the way you think best. Whatever you do, don't let him die peacefully in his old age.
translation_verse: Yiti fa wɔ nwo adwene, nnɛmaa onyi ɔfa ye ti so gyein ɔkɔ ɛborɔ asomdwee nu.

english_verse: Be sure to do something about Shimei son of Gera from Bahurim in the territory of Benjamin. He cursed and insulted me the day I went to Mahanaim. But later, when he came to meet me at the Jordan River, I promised that I wouldn't kill him.
translation_verse: Benyaminniɛ Gyera bɔ ofi Bahurim ne, ɔwa Simei koso de, nnɛma wɔ wora fi ye. Kyẽa bɔ yeɛ ngɔle Mahanaim ne, ɔborole me amoen paa. Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ ooyiale me wɔ asue Yɔɔdan nwo ne, mvale AWURADE ndale ndaen ngyirele ye kyɛ, ‘Mengɔfa ngrandɛ mengohu wɔ.’

english_verse: Now you must punish him. He's an old man, but you're wise enough to know that you must have him killed. David Dies
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛmaa ɔfa ye nwo di tɔtorɔtɔɔ, ofikyɛ ɛte nworɛniɛ; ɛse nikyee bɔ odi kyɛ ɛfa yɔ ye ɔ. Nea kyɛ ɛkɔmaa bɛkɔhã ye mogya bekogua maa ɔkɔhɔ borɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: he saddled his donkey and went after them. He found them and brought them back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Simei dwɔsole siesiele ye afunum, na ɔhɔle Akise berɛ wɔ Gate kyɛ ɔkwaapena ye nganga nemɔ. Simei ɔɔfale ye nganga nemɔ fili Gate wale.

english_verse: Joab's family will always suffer because of what he did, but the Lord will always bless David's family and his kingdom with peace.
translation_verse: Bɛ mogya kɔbɔ Yoabo ne ye boso ama bɛ ti so afebɔɔ. Nakoso Dawide ne ye boso ama, ɔne ye awuro ama, ɔne ye ahennie bia de, AWURADE asomdwee kɔyɛ bɛ deɛ afebɔɔ.”

english_verse: His son Solomon became king and took control of David's kingdom. Adonijah Is Killed
translation_verse: Yiti Solomon lili ye baba Dawide bia; na ye ahennie ne bo timuni.

english_verse: One day, Adonijah went to see Bathsheba, Solomon's mother, and she asked, “Is this a friendly visit?” “Yes.
translation_verse: Na Hagite awa Adoniya hɔle Solomon maame Bahyeba berɛ. Bahyeba bisale ye kyɛ, “Ɔte bɔkɔɔ de?” Obuale kyɛ, “Bɔkɔɔ.”

english_verse: I just want to talk with you.” “All right,” she told him, “go ahead.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Adoniya sele kyɛ, “Me ne wɔ baali ngɔmɔ kãa.” Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Kɔ so.”

english_verse: “You know that I was king for a little while,” Adonijah replied. “And everyone in Israel accepted me as their ruler. But the Lord wanted my brother to be king, so now things have changed.
translation_verse: Adoniya sele kyɛ, “Ɛse ye kyɛ me yeɛ ahaa bia ne te me deɛ ɔ, na né Yisrael amukoraati bɛnea ate kyɛ ngoli hene ɔ. Nakoso ahennie ne, wakakyi waayɛ nniɛma bienzua ne deɛ, ofikyɛ AWURADE yeɛ ɔfa mane ye ɔ.

english_verse: Would you do me a favor?” “What do you want?” Bathsheba asked.
translation_verse: Kekesaala ye, mesrɛ wɔ nikyee ko, na nnɛfa bɔ me atianuserɛ.” Na osele ye kyɛ, “Kɔ so.”

english_verse: “Please ask Solomon to let me marry Abishag. He won't say no to you.”
translation_verse: Adoniya toale so kyɛ, “Mesrɛ wɔ, kã kyire Nana Solomon kyɛ ɔfa Sunamniɛ Abisage ma ngya ye, na Nana ngɔhã kyɛ daabi.”

english_verse: “All right,” she said. “I'll ask him.”
translation_verse: Bahyeba buale kyɛ, “Yoo, mate, ngɔfa wɔ dwirɛ ne ngɔto Nana nyunu ngɔma wɔ.”

english_verse: When Bathsheba went to see Solomon, he stood up to meet her, then bowed low. He sat back down and had another throne brought in, so his mother could sit at his right side.
translation_verse: Yiti Bahyeba hɔle Nana Solomon berɛ kyɛ ɔkwaafa Adoniya dwirɛ ne to ye nyunu. Nana Solomon dwɔsole ooyiale Bahyeba, na ɔbɔle ye nu ase mane Bahyeba. Afei Solomon tenane ye ahennie bia so, na ɔmaa bɛfale ahennie bia bɛbrɛle ye maame maa ɔtenane ye sa famaa so.

english_verse: Bathsheba sat down and then asked, “Would you do me a small favor?” Solomon replied, “Mother, just tell me what you want, and I will do it.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Bahyeba sele kyɛ, “Mebaafa edwirɛ kãa bie meto wɔ nyunu, na nnɛbɔ me atianuserɛ.” Na Solomon sele ye kyɛ, “Mmo, kã w’abisadeɛ ne, ná mengɔbɔ wɔ atianuserɛ.”

english_verse: “Allow your brother Adonijah to marry Abishag,” she answered.
translation_verse: Bahyeba toale so kyɛ, “Maa bɛfa Sunamniɛ Abisage bɛma eliɛma Adoniya maa ogya ye.”

english_verse: Solomon said: What? Let my older brother marry Abishag? You may as well ask me to let him rule the kingdom! And why don't you ask such favors for Abiathar and Joab?
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana Solomon buale ye maame kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛsrɛ Sunamniɛ Abisage ma Adoniya ɔ? Nzaade srɛ bia ne koso ma ye e! Ofikyɛ nniɛma panyi ɔ. Nnɛsrɛ ma ye ngome, na mmom srɛ ma ɔsɔfo Abiata ne Seruya awa Yoabo koso!”

english_verse: I swear in the name of the Lord that Adonijah will die because he asked for this! If he doesn't, I pray that God will severely punish me.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana Solomon fale AWURADE tale ndaen kyɛ, “Sɔ nikyee he bɔ Adoniya abisa ye, sɛ wamva ye ngoa wambɛ so a, ye de Nyameɛ otua me so kerɛ piri paa!

english_verse: The Lord made me king in my father's place and promised that the kings of Israel would come from my family. Yes, I swear by the living Lord that Adonijah will die today.
translation_verse: Ɔnate ye sɔ ti, AWURADE teasefoɛ bɔ wama me bo atimu ná wama mali me baba Dawide bia, ná wamaa ahennie aatɔ m’awuro kyɛbɔ ɔhyɛle bɔ ne, ngyi ye nyunu mekã kyɛ, ɛnɛ odi kyɛ beku Adoniya.”

english_verse: “Benaiah,” Solomon shouted, “go kill Adonijah.” So Adonijah died. Abiathar Is Sent Back Home
translation_verse: Yiti Nana Solomon somane Yehoada awa Benaya maa oohuni ye.

english_verse: Solomon sent for Abiathar the priest and said: Abiathar, go back home to Anathoth! You ought to be killed too, but I won't do it now. When my father David was king, you were in charge of the sacred chest, and you went through a lot of hard times with my father.
translation_verse: Nana Solomon sele ɔsɔfo Abiata kyɛ, “Kɔ w’aseɛ so wɔ Anatote, ofikyɛ ɛfata ewue. Nakoso mengohu wɔ sɔ mmerɛ ye, ofikyɛ ɛneane AWURADE Nyameɛ apam alaka ne aso wɔ me baba Dawide aberɛ so. Afei koso, amaneɛ bɔ me baba nwuni ye ne amukoraa, ɛne ye yeɛ benwuni ye ɔ.”

english_verse: But I won't let you be a priest of the Lord anymore. And so the promise that the Lord had made at Shiloh about the family of Eli came true. Joab Is Killed
translation_verse: Yiti Solomon lele AWURADE sɔfolilɛ adwuma ne fili Abiata sa nu. Na edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE hane ye wɔ Silo fale Eli boso ama nwo ne, ɛhe maa ɔwale nu.

english_verse: Joab had not helped Absalom try to become king, but he had helped Adonijah. So when Joab learned that Adonijah had been killed, he ran to the sacred tent and grabbed hold of the corners of the altar for protection.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Yoabo tele sɔ dwirɛ nen , Yoabo nwati hɔle AWURADE ɛtena sua ne anu, na ɔsosɔle afɔleɛ bokyea mmɛen nemɔ anu.

english_verse: When Solomon heard about this, he sent someone to ask Joab, “Why did you run to the altar?” Joab sent back his answer, “I was afraid of you, and I ran to the Lord for protection.” Then Solomon shouted, “Benaiah, go kill Joab!”
translation_verse: Bɛɛbɔle Nana Solomon amaneɛ kyɛ, “Yoabo anwati wahɔ AWURADE ɛtena sua ne anu, na kekesaala ye, ɔwɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo.” Na Solomon somane Yehoada awa Benaya kyɛ, “Kɔ na kohũ ye.”

english_verse: Benaiah went to the sacred tent and yelled, “Joab, the king orders you to come out!” “No!” Joab answered. “Kill me right here.” Benaiah went back and told Solomon what Joab had said.
translation_verse: Yiti Benaya hɔle AWURADE ɛtena sua ne anu oosele Yoabo kyɛ, “Nana nwa efite bra.” Nakoso Yoabo buale kyɛ, “Daabi, ku me wɔ ɛwa ala.” Yeɛ Benaya ɔɔbɔle Nana amaneɛ kyɛ, “Mmuayɛɛ bɔ Yoabo wafa wama me hɔ ɛne.”

english_verse: Solomon replied: Do what Joab said. Kill him and bury him! Then my family and I won't be responsible for what he did to Abner the commander of Israel's army and to Amasa the commander of Judah's army. He killed those innocent men without my father knowing about it. Both of them were better men than Joab. Now the Lord will make him pay for those murders.
translation_verse: Mogya ahoroɔ bɔ benni fɔ bɔ wahã wagua ne, AWURADE kɔmaa ɔkɔbɔ ye bɔbɔ ye ti so. Ofikyɛ ɔhwene ngrandɛ huni mmienzua nyɔ bɔ bɛtengyɛ ná bɛte paa bɛtra ye ɔ, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né me baba Dawide ɔnze ye nwo hwee ɔ. Bɛ yeɛ ole Nɛɛ awa Abenɛ bɔ né ɔte Yisrael koɛhonɛfoɛ safohene, ɔne Yeta awa Amasa, bɔ né ɔte Yuda koɛhonɛfoɛ safohene ne.

english_verse: Benaiah went back and killed Joab. His body was taken away and buried near his home in the desert.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yehoada awa Benaya hɔle oohuni Yoabo na besiele ye wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye awuro wɔ ɛserɛ so.

english_verse: Solomon put Benaiah in Joab's place as army commander, and he put Zadok in Abiathar's place as priest. Shimei Is Killed
translation_verse: Nana Solomon fale Yehoada awa Benaya sili Yoabo gya nu maa ɔlale koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ anoa, na Solomon fale ɔsɔfo Sadoke sili Abiata gya nu.

english_verse: Solomon sent for Shimei and said, “Build a house here in Jerusalem and live in it. But whatever you do, don't leave the city!
translation_verse: Afei Nana Solomon somane maa bɛɛfrɛle Simei bɛmane ye, na osele ye kyɛ, “Si w’awuro wɔ Yerusalem wa, ná tena berɛ. Nnɛfi kuro wa kɔ nekaa biala.

english_verse: If you ever cross Kidron Valley and leave Jerusalem, you will be killed. And it will be your own fault.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ kyẽa bɔ ekotu wɔ bo, ná ɛkɔpɛ Kidron bɔnza ne, nwu ye kyɛ wɔ wue alaa ɛne, wɔ musue kɔbɔ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ ti so.”

english_verse: “That's fair, Your Majesty,” Shimei answered. “I'll do that.” So Shimei lived in Jerusalem from then on.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Simei buale Nana Solomon kyɛ, “Nana, me mene, edwirɛ bɔ ahã ne te turoloo. Kyɛbɔ ahã ne, sɔ ala yeɛ w’akoaa kɔyɔ ɔ.” Yiti Simei tenane Yerusalem hyɛle.

english_verse: About three years later, two of Shimei's servants ran off to King Achish in Gath. When Shimei found out where they were,
translation_verse: Na ɔwale kyɛ afoɛ nza si, Simei nganga nemɔ anu nyɔ nwati hɔle Maaka awa Nana Akise bɔ ɔte Gate hene ne dɔ. Na bɛbɔle Simei amaneɛ kyɛ ‘Wɔ nganga nemɔ wɔ Gate’ ne,

english_verse: Someone told Solomon that Shimei had gone to Gath and was back.
translation_verse: Bɛɛbɔle Solomon amaneɛ kyɛ Simei afi Yerusalem wahɔ Gate wawa.

english_verse: Solomon sent for him and said: Shimei, you promised in the name of the Lord that you would never leave Jerusalem. I warned you that you would die if you did. You agreed that this was fair, didn't you?
translation_verse: Nana Solomon somane maa bɛɛfrɛle Simei bɛmane ye, na obisale ye kyɛ, “Aso mamma anda AWURADE ndaen manhyɛ wɔ kitii kyɛ, ‘Nwu ye kyɛ kyẽa biala bɔ ekofi Yerusalem kɔhɔ nekaa biala ne, ngɔmaa bekohu wɔ?’ Na wɔ koso ebuale me kyɛ, ‘Edwirɛ bɔ ahã ne te turoloo, mede meto nu.’

english_verse: You have disobeyed me and have broken the promise you made to the Lord.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ ɛfale ye tale ndaen ne, ɔne ahyɛdeɛ bɔ nhyɛle wɔ ne, nzu ati yeɛ anni so ɔ?”

english_verse: I know you remember all the cruel things you did to my father David. Now the Lord is going to punish you for what you did.
translation_verse: Na Solomon toale so sele Simei kyɛ, “Bɔne bɔ ɛfa lili me baba Dawide ne, wɔ bɔbɔ ɛse ye mukoraa. Yiti AWURADE kɔma wɔ musue kɔbɔ wɔ ti so.

english_verse: But the Lord will bless me and make my father's kingdom strong forever.
translation_verse: Nakoso me, Nana Solomon de, AWURADE koyira me, na Dawide ahennie bo kotimu AWURADE nyunu afebɔɔ.”

english_verse: “Benaiah,” Solomon shouted, “kill Shimei.” So Shimei died. Solomon was now in complete control of his kingdom.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana Solomon hã hyirele Yehoada awa Benaya kyɛ oohu Simei, na ohuni ye. Yiti ahennie ne gyinane pindinn wɔ Solomon aberɛ so.

english_verse: At that time, there was no temple for worshiping the Lord, and everyone offered sacrifices at the local shrines.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Yisraelfoɛ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso, ofikyɛ né bennya bessili sua bɛffale AWURADE dumaa bɛttole so.

english_verse: I'll also give you what you didn't ask for. You'll be rich and respected as long as you live, and you'll be greater than any other king.
translation_verse: Afei mafa bɔ anzrɛ ɔ koso maboka wɔ so: ngɔmaa ekonya anwonyadeɛ ne animnyam mmerɛ bɔ ɛte ase amukoraa. Ɛhene foforɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ bɛkɔfa ye bɛkɔtoto wɔ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Solomon loved the Lord and followed his father David's instructions, but Solomon also offered sacrifices and burned incense at the shrines.
translation_verse: Solomon hurole AWURADE dwirɛ, na olili ye baba Dawide ahyɛdeɛ so. Nakoso né ɔyɛ a, ɔbɔ afɔleɛ ná ɔyera ɛyɛɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso.

english_verse: One night while Solomon was in Gibeon, the Lord God appeared to him in a dream and said, “Solomon, ask for anything you want, and I will give it to you.”
translation_verse: Gibeon berɛ, AWURADE yele ye nwo ali hyirele Solomon kɔngɔen wɔ laleɛ nu. Na Nyameɛ sele kyɛ, “Bisa bɔ ekuro ɔ maa nyɔ mma wɔ.”

english_verse: Solomon answered: My father David, your servant, was honest and did what you commanded. You were always loyal to him, and you gave him a son who is now king.
translation_verse: Na Solomon buale kyɛ, “W’akoaa Dawide bɔ yeɛ ɔte me baba ne, ɛyɛle ye paa kandinga paa. Ofikyɛ olili wɔ dwirɛ so nahorɛ nu ɔne atee bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ so, na ɔyele ye ti anu fitaa ɔsole wɔ. Ahɔ so afa sɔ paa kandinga ne alo ye, na ɛnɛ amaa wanya baa bienzua maa wali ye bia.

english_verse: Lord God, I'm your servant, and you've made me king in my father's place. But I'm very young and know so little about being a leader.
translation_verse: O, AWURADE me Nyameɛ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ nde akwadaa kaaba de, nakoso ama w’akoaa mali ɛhene masi me baba Dawide gya nu. Kekesaala ye, mennwu me bɛen ne me famaa.

english_verse: And now I must rule your chosen people, even though there are too many of them to count.
translation_verse: Na wɔ mmenia bɔ aneanea nu aye bɛ ne, w’akoaa, me yeɛ nna bɛ noa ɔ. Bɛte maen piri bɔ bɛ somaa ti bɛngora bɛ ka ɔ.

english_verse: Please make me wise and teach me the difference between right and wrong. Then I will know how to rule your people. If you don't, there is no way I could rule this great nation of yours.
translation_verse: Yiti ma w’akoaa ndeaseɛ adwene bɔ ngɔfa ngɔla wɔ mmenia noa ɔ. Maa ngora nwu paa ne tɛɛ b’afia nzonzoleɛ; ofikyɛ wɔ maen piri ye, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔla ye noa ɔ?”

english_verse: God said: Solomon, I'm pleased that you asked for this. You could have asked to live a long time or to be rich. Or you could have asked for your enemies to be destroyed. Instead, you asked for wisdom to make right decisions.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ sele ye kyɛ, “Ɔnate kyɛ asrɛ sɔ nikyee ne, ná anzrɛ ngoa tendenn, anaa anwonyadeɛ amma wɔ nwo, yeɛ ambena wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ wue, na mmom asrɛ ndeaseɛ adwene bɔ ɛkɔfa konwu bɔ ɔte paa ɔ ne ati,

english_verse: If you obey me and follow my commands, as your father David did, I'll let you live a long time.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛkɔnate m’atee so, ná ali me ahyɛdeɛ ne me mmeraa dwirɛ so, kyɛbɔ wɔ baba Dawide yɔle ne a, ye de ngɔmaa ekonyi kɔhyɛ.”

english_verse: Solomon woke up and realized that God had spoken to him in the dream. He went back to Jerusalem and stood in front of the sacred chest, where he offered sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. Then Solomon gave a feast for his officials. Solomon Makes a Difficult Decision
translation_verse: Yeɛ Solomon fili nnaa nu tingyele, na onwuni kyɛ laleɛ yeɛ wahye ɔ. Na ɔwale Yerusalem oogyinane AWURADE apam alaka ne anyunu. Ɔbɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne asomdwee afɔleɛ, na ɔtole poen mane ye somvoɛ amukoraa. Solomon bua ndɛen nworɛ nu

english_verse: One day two women came to King Solomon,
translation_verse: Ɛhe asi ye, mmrasua gyanderafoɛ nyɔ wale Solomon berɛ bɛɛfale b’edwirɛ bɛtole ye nyunu.

english_verse: and one of them said: Your Majesty, this woman and I live in the same house. Not long ago my baby was born at home,
translation_verse: Braa ko hane kyɛ, “Me mene, mesrɛ wɔ, me ne braa ye yɛte awuro ko anu. Na nwole mmerɛ bɔ né ɔwɔ awuro berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: One night while we were all asleep, she rolled over on her baby, and he died.
translation_verse: Braa he ɔwa ne wuli kɔngɔen, ofikyɛ ɔlale ye so.

english_verse: Then while I was still asleep, she got up and took my son out of my bed. She put him in her bed, then she put her dead baby next to me.
translation_verse: Na abunnamu bɔ w’afaneɛ mala ne, odwɔsole ɔɔfale mma deɛ ne fili me nwo berɛ. Ɔfale ye tole ye kunu, yeɛ ɔfale ɔwa bɔ wawu ne koso tole me kunu ɔ.

english_verse: In the morning when I got up to feed my son, I saw that he was dead. But when I looked at him in the light, I knew he wasn't my son.
translation_verse: Ngyerɛmɔ bɔ ndwɔsole kyɛ mema mma ne nyɔfone ne, nwuni kyɛ wawu. Nakoso nneane akwadaa ne anyunu haa ngyerɛmɔ nen, nwuni ye kyɛ nna baa bɔ nwole ye ne ɔ.”

english_verse: “No!” the other woman shouted. “He was your son. My baby is alive!” “The dead baby is yours,” the first woman yelled. “Mine is alive!” They argued back and forth in front of Solomon,
translation_verse: Nakoso braa ko ne koso hane kyɛ, “Ɛlaka, baa bɔ ɔte ase ne, mma ɛne. Wɔ deɛ yeɛ wawu ne.” Na braa bɔ oli moa dwudwole ne sele kyɛ, “Ɛlaka, ɛwa deɛ yeɛ wawu ne, mma deɛ yeɛ ɔte ase ne.” Yiti bɛ munyɔ besuli bɛ nwo aporowaa wɔ Nana Solomon nyunu berɛ.

english_verse: Someone bring me a sword.” A sword was brought, and Solomon ordered,
translation_verse: Yiti Nana Solomon hane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔbrɛ me ngrandɛ.” Na bɛfale ngrandɛ bɛɛtole Nana Solomon nyunu.

english_verse: “Cut the baby in half! That way each of you can have part of him.”
translation_verse: Nana Solomon sele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔhyɛ akwadaa bɔ ɔte ase ne anu nyɔ; ɛ́mɔfa ye bue bɛ́ma ko, na ɛ́mɔfa ye bue koso bɛ́ma ko ne.”

english_verse: “Please don't kill my son,” the baby's mother screamed. “Your Majesty, I love him very much, but give him to her. Just don't kill him.” The other woman shouted, “Go ahead and cut him in half. Then neither of us will have the baby.”
translation_verse: Nakoso akwadaa bɔ ɔte ase ne maame, ɔnate ɔwa ne ati, ye nyaa wosole ye kunu. Yiti ɔhã hyirele Nana Solomon kyɛ, “Me mene, mesrɛ wɔ, fa akwadaa bɔ ɔte ase ne ma ye, na nnɛku ye!” Nakoso braa ko ne de ɔhane kyɛ, “Kyɛ ye nu; maa akwadaa ne ɔbɔ yɛ munyɔ.”

english_verse: Solomon said, “Don't kill the baby.” Then he pointed to the first woman, “She is his real mother. Give the baby to her.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana Solomon buale kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfa akwadaa bɔ ɔte ase ne bɛma braa bɔ oli moa ne. Nnɛma ɛmɔku ye. Ye maame ɛne.”

english_verse: Everyone in Israel was amazed when they heard how Solomon had made his decision. They realized that God had given him wisdom to judge fairly.
translation_verse: Yisrael amukoraa tele ndɛen bɔ Nana Solomon buale ne, na ye nwo yɛle bɛ nwanwa, ofikyɛ benwuni kyɛ Nyameɛ nworɛ wɔ ye nu bɔ ɔfa bua ndɛen turoloo ɔ.

english_verse: Solomon chose twelve regional officers, who took turns bringing food for him and his household. Each officer provided food from his region for one month of the year.
translation_verse: Yisrael amukoraa, né Solomon le mbanyi buru ne nyɔ bɔ bɛlela mbɔtam mbɔtam nemɔ noa ɔ. Né bedide aleɛ ndɔ bɛbrɛ Nana Solomon ne ye awuro ama. Afoɛ biala, bɛ nu ko biala, ɔye bosome ko ɔfa dé aleɛ ndɔ brɛ Nana Solomon.

english_verse: These were the twelve officers: The son of Hur was in charge of the hill country of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Bɛ dumaa ɛhe: Ben Hure bɔ ɔnea Efraim mmokaa aseɛ ne asɔ

english_verse: The son of Deker was in charge of the towns of Makaz, Shaalbim, Beth-Shemesh, and Elon-Beth-Hanan.
translation_verse: Ben Dekɛre bɔ ɔnea Makase, Saalebim, Bete Semese ne Elon Bete Hanan so,

english_verse: The son of Abinadab was in charge of Naphath-Dor and was married to Solomon's daughter Taphath.
translation_verse: Ben Abinadabo bɔ ɔnea Nafate Dɔɔ amukoraati so, ,

english_verse: Ahinadab son of Iddo was in charge of the territory of Mahanaim.
translation_verse: Yido awa Ahinadabo bɔ ɔnea Mahanaim so,

english_verse: Baana son of Hushai was in charge of the territory of Asher and the town of Bealoth.
translation_verse: Husae awa Baana, bɔ ɔnea Asɛ ne Bealote so,

english_verse: Jehoshaphat son of Paruah was in charge of the territory of Issachar.
translation_verse: Paruwa awa Yehosafate bɔ ɔnea Yisaka so,

english_verse: Shimei son of Ela was in charge of the territory of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Ela awa Simei bɔ ɔnea Benyamin so,

english_verse: Geber son of Uri was in charge of Gilead, where King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan had lived. And one officer was in charge of the territory of Judah. The Size of Solomon's Kingdom
translation_verse: yeɛ Yuri awa Gebɛre bɔ ɔnea Gileade aseɛ ne aso ne. Berɛ yeɛ né Amori hene Sihon ɔne Ogo hene Baasan bedi hene ɔ. Né panyi ko wora ɔnea Yuda aseɛ so. Solomon ahennie ne anwonya

english_verse: Solomon ruled every kingdom between the Euphrates River and the land of the Philistines down to Egypt. These kingdoms paid him taxes as long as he lived.
translation_verse: Né Solomon di hene wɔ ahennie amukoraa so, fi asue Yufreti kɔka Filistifoɛ aseɛ noa, maa ɔkɔ alaa kodwu Misraim wɛen so. Betuale toɔ bɛmane Solomon, na bɛsole ye mmerɛ bɔ ɔte ase amukoraa.

english_verse: Solomon ruled the whole region west of the Euphrates River, from Tiphsah to Gaza, and he was at peace with all of the countries around him.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ maen maen amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ asue Yufreti eyia atɔleɛ so, ofi Tifesa bɔ ɔkwaadwu Gasa, ɔne ahemvo amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ Yufreti eyia atɔleɛ so ne, ye yeɛ né odi bɛ so ɔ; na onyane asomdwee maa ɔpɛle ye nwo bra yiale.

english_verse: Everyone living in Israel, from the town of Dan in the north to Beersheba in the south, was safe as long as Solomon lived. Each family sat undisturbed beneath its own grape vines and fig trees.
translation_verse: Solomon te ase ne, Yuda ne Yisrael maen ne nyane asomdwee; ofi Dan kodwu Beɛ Hyeba, bɛ mukoraati benyane asomdwee bɛtenatenane bɛ bobe boo ne borɔdoma boo mɔ anu.

english_verse: Each of the twelve regional officers brought food to Solomon and his household for one month of the year. They provided everything he needed,
translation_verse: Nana Solomon ne mmenia amukoraa bɔ né bɛ ko wura ye sa nu ne, né sɔ mbanyi buru ne nyɔ nemɔ yeɛ bɛbrɛ bɛ aleɛ ɔ. Bɛ nu biala fa ba bosome ko bɔ bahyehyɛ bama ye ɔ nu, na bamma hwee anhia ye.

english_verse: Solomon was brilliant. God had blessed him with insight and understanding.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ mane Solomon nworɛ ne ndeaseɛ piri paa. Ye ndeaseɛ ne, ɔtrɛ kyɛ mboanoa anweaa,

english_verse: He was wiser than anyone else in the world, including the wisest people of the east and of Egypt. He was even wiser than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Mahol's three sons, Heman, Calcol, and Darda. Solomon became famous in every country around Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Né ɔse nworɛ tra sona biala. Ɔse nworɛ tra Ɛsraniɛ Etan ɔne Maholi mma Heman, Kalkole ne Dareda. Olele dumaa wɔ maen maen bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia ne amukoraa nu.

english_verse: He could talk about all kinds of plants, from large trees to small bushes, and he taught about animals, birds, reptiles, and fish.
translation_verse: Mmakaa mɔ, ofi sida bakaa bɔ ɔwɔ Lebanon kodwu sufiɛ bɔ ofifi terɛ nwo ne, obuli anyandera fale bɛ nwo. Obuli bie koso fale ngaka, nnomaa, ngaka bɔ bɛtwe bɛ nwo ase, ɔne nzue nu naen mɔ anwo.

english_verse: Kings all over the world heard about Solomon's wisdom and sent people to listen to him teach.
translation_verse: Mmenia fili maen maen amukoraa so beetiele Solomon nworɛ dwirɛ ne bie. Aseɛ ye aso ahemvo amukoraa bɔ bɛtele Solomon nworɛ dwirɛ ne, betuli mmenia maa bɛwale ye berɛ.

english_verse: King Hiram of Tyre had always been friends with Solomon's father David. When Hiram learned that Solomon was king, he sent some of his officials to meet with Solomon.
translation_verse: Tiro hene Hiram tele kyɛ bapopa Solomon ngoo maa wali ye baba bia. Na ɔsomane ye somvoɛ mɔ wɔ Solomon berɛ, ofikyɛ né Hiram te Dawide obiɛngo fi tete.

english_verse: The Lord God promised my father that when his son became king, he would build a temple for worshiping the Lord. So I've decided to do that.
translation_verse: Yiti mepena kyɛ mesi sua mefa AWURADE me Nyameɛ dumaa meto so, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hã hyirele me baba Dawide kyɛ, ‘Ɛwa bɔ ngɔfa ye ngosi wɔ gya nu maa okoli wɔ bia ne, ye yeɛ okosi sua kɔfa me dumaa kɔto so ɔ.’

english_verse: I'd like you to send your workers to cut down cedar trees in Lebanon for me. I will pay them whatever you say and will even have my workers help them. We both know that your workers are more experienced than anyone else at cutting lumber.
translation_verse: Yiti maa bebu sida mmakaa béfi Lebanon bɛbrɛ me. Me somvoɛ mɔ kɔɔboka wɔ somvoɛ mɔ so, na akatuaa biala bɔ ɛkɔhã kyɛ mva mma wɔ somvoɛ nemɔ ne, ngɔfa ngɔma wɔ; ofikyɛ ɛse kyɛ ebiala nne yɛ wa bɔ ɔse mmakaa bu kyɛ Sidonfoɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Hiram was so happy when he heard Solomon's request that he said, “I am grateful that the Lord gave David such a wise son to be king of that great nation!”
translation_verse: Hiram tele Solomon ngraa nen, ye nye gyele paa, na ɔhane kyɛ, “AWURADE bɔ ɛnɛ ye waye baa nworɛniɛ wama Dawide kyɛ ooli maen kandinga ye aso ne, animnyam ɔyɛ ye deɛ.”

english_verse: Then he sent back his answer: I received your message and will give you all the cedar and pine logs you need.
translation_verse: Hiram tole Solomon ngraa kyɛ, “Mate ngraa bɔ afa abrɛ me ne. Na sida ne ɛframmire bɔ ehia ne, ngɔfa ye mukoraa ngɔbrɛ wɔ.

english_verse: My workers will carry them down from Lebanon to the Mediterranean Sea. They will tie the logs together and float them along the coast to wherever you want them. Then they will untie the logs, and your workers can take them from there. To pay for the logs, you can provide the grain I need for my household.
translation_verse: Me somvoɛ mɔ kɔhwe mmakaa ne kofi Lebanon kɔwa mboanoa. Ngɔkyekye ngogua ɛpo ne anye ngɔfa ngɔhɔ nekaa biala bɔ ekohyire ɔ. Ngɔmaa bɛkɔsangye nu berɛ maa ɛkɔsesa kɔhɔ. Na wɔ koso, bɔ mepena mefi wɔ berɛ ole kyɛ ɛkɔma m’awuro ama bɛ noa aleɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord kept his promise and made Solomon wise. Hiram and Solomon signed a treaty and never went to war against each other. Solomon's Workers
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE mane Solomon nworɛ kyɛbɔ ɔhyɛle ye bɔ ne. Né Hiram ne Solomon b’afia te wosee, na bɛ munyɔ bɛyɛle apam.

english_verse: He ordered the workers to cut and shape large blocks of good stone for the foundation of the temple.
translation_verse: Nana Solomon hyɛle mmeraa maa bedwale nyɔboɛ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ, na nyɔboɛ bɔ base ne yeɛ bɛfa bɛtole sua ne fapem ɔ.

english_verse: Solomon's and Hiram's men worked with men from the city of Gebal, and together they got the stones and logs ready for the temple.
translation_verse: Yiti Solomon suasilɛfoɛ nemɔ, bɛ ne Hiram suasilɛfoɛ nemɔ, yeɛ Gebalfoɛ yeɛ bedwale nyɔboɛ ne ɔ. Na bɛpakyele mmakaa ne ne nyɔboɛ ne bɛfa besili sua ne.

english_verse: The roof of the temple was made out of beams and cedar boards. The workers finished building the outside of the temple.
translation_verse: Yiti osili sua ne yiele. Ɔfale sida mbuna ne ndaboa yeɛ ɔyɔle ye abuu ne ɔ.

english_verse: Along the sides and back of the temple, there were three levels of storage rooms. The rooms on the bottom level were just over two meters wide, the rooms on the middle level were over two and a half meters wide, and those on the top level were just over three meters wide. There were ledges on the outside of the temple that supported the beams of the storage rooms, so that nothing was built into the temple walls.
translation_verse: Sua bɔ ɔbata fasue ne, ye pumbu bɔ ɔwɔ ye bo ne, ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ nnu; bɔ ɔwɔ ye afia ne, ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ nzia, yeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro ne, ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ nzoo. Ogyinagyinane mbuna fa batale asɔneyɛɛ sua fasue ne anwo. Na osisili pumbu nemɔ fa batale mbuna nemɔ, amaa ɔnate so wandofi fasue nemɔ anu.

english_verse: Solomon did not want the noise of hammers and axes to be heard at the place where the temple was being built. So he gave orders for the workers to shape the blocks of stone at the quarry.
translation_verse: Nyɔboɛ bɔ bɛfa besili sua ne, besele ye wɔ nekaa bɔ bedwa nyɔboɛ ɔ, na ɔnate sɔ ti mmerɛ bɔ besi sua ne, bande bɔsobaka anaa akumaa anaa buralɛ biala nga wɔ nekaa bɔ besili asɔneyɛɛ sua ne.

english_verse: Storage rooms just over two meters high were all around the temple, and they were attached to the temple by cedar beams.
translation_verse: Osili pumbu nemɔ fa batale asɔneyɛɛ sua fasue ne; pumbu biala, fi ye aseɛnwo bɔ ɔkwaadwu ye anwuro, ɔte agyirɛ nnu. Mbuna nemɔ bɔ bɛfa bɛbatale asɔneyɛɛ sua nen, besili pumbu nemɔ bɛbatale sɔ mbuna nemɔ.

english_verse: The floor of the temple was made out of pine, and the walls were lined with cedar from floor to ceiling.
translation_verse: Sua ne, ye kunu terɛ nemɔ, ɔfale sida ndaboa mane ye nwo. Ofi sua ne aseɛnwo bɔ ɔkwaadwu ye abuu ne, ɔfale ndaboa ne bie mane ye kunu. Na ɔfale ɛframmire ndaboa samono aseɛnwo berɛ.

english_verse: The most holy place was in the back of the temple, and it was nine meters square. Cedar boards standing from floor to ceiling separated it from the rest of the temple.
translation_verse: Sua ne akunu dɔ paa, osili pumbu fa yɛle krongron nu krongron ne. Ɔfale sida mane pumbu ne anwo fili aseɛnwo oodwuli abuu ne. Efi pumbu ne anwo bɔ ɛkɔ sua ne bo dɔ paa ne, ɔte agyirɛ aburanyɔ.

english_verse: The inside walls were lined with cedar to hide the stones, and the cedar was decorated with carvings of gourds and flowers.
translation_verse: Sida bɔ bɛfa bɛmane ye kunu ne, né bali kɔndoa adwii ɔne bakaa nyerɛen adwii bagua so. Ye mukoraa te sida, bɔ né bafa bakata terɛ ne anwo nyɔboɛ biala so ɔ.

english_verse: The sacred chest was kept in the most holy place.
translation_verse: Nekaa krongron ne, osili ye wɔ sua ne kunu dɔ paa, kyɛ ɔfa AWURADE apam alaka ne sie dɔ.

english_verse: This room was nine meters long, nine meters wide, and nine meters high, and it was lined with pure gold. There were also gold chains across the front of the most holy place. The inside of the temple, as well as the cedar altar in the most holy place, was covered with gold.
translation_verse: Afei ɔfale esikaa kɔkorɛ borole sua ne amukoraati nu maa sua ne anu yɛle nyemene. Afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ ɔwɔ nekaa krongron berɛ ne po, ɔfale esikaa kɔkorɛ borole ye nwo amukoraa.

english_verse: Solomon had two statues of winged creatures made from olive wood to put in the most holy place. Each creature was four and a half meters tall
translation_verse: Ɔfale olive bakaa sele kɛrubim nyɔ siele nekaa krongron ne anu. Ko biala, ofi ye aseɛnwo bɔ ɔkwaadwu ye anwuro ne, ɔte agyirɛ buru.

english_verse: and four and a half meters across. They had two wings, and the wings were just over two meters long.
translation_verse: Kɛrubo ko ne, ofi ye aseɛnwo bɔ ɔkwaadwu ye anwuro ne, ɔte agyirɛ buru, na sɔ ala yeɛ kɛrubo ko ne koso te ɔ.

english_verse: The creatures were also covered with gold.
translation_verse: Ɔfale esikaa kɔkorɛ borole kɛrubim nemɔ anwo.

english_verse: The walls of the two rooms were decorated with carvings of palm trees, flowers, and winged creatures.
translation_verse: Sua ne, ye pumbu nu ne ye asa so ne, olili kɛrubim adwii, ayee mmakaa adwii ɔne bakaa nyerɛen adwii guale terɛ nemɔ anwo bra yiale.

english_verse: The two doors to the most holy place were made out of olive wood and were decorated with carvings of palm trees, flowers, and winged creatures. The doors and the carvings were covered with gold. The door frame came to a point at the top.
translation_verse: Olive bakaa anoa nyɔ nemɔ, olili kɛrubim adwii, ayee mmakaa adwii ɔne nyerɛen adwii guale bɛ nwo. Ɔfale esikaa kɔkorɛ borole bɛ nwo, na ɔfale esikaa kɔkorɛ ne bie borole kɛrubim ne ayee mmakaa nemɔ anwo.

english_verse: The doors were covered with gold and were decorated with carvings of palm trees, flowers, and winged creatures.
translation_verse: Olili kɛrubim adwii, ayee mmakaa adwii ɔne nyerɛen adwii guale anoa nemɔ anwo, na ɔfale esikaa kɔkorɛ borole adwii bɔ wali nemɔ anwo pɛpɛɛpɛ.

translation_verse: Ye afoɛ nna ne anu, bosome bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Siwe nu yeɛ ɔtole AWURADE awuro ne fapem ɔ.

english_verse: Seven years later the workers finished building it during Bul, the eighth month of the year. It was built exactly as it had been planned.

english_verse: He put five stands on the south side of the temple, five stands on the north side, and the large bowl at the southeast corner of the temple.

translation_verse: Masi sua nyemene paa mama wɔ, nekaa bɔ ɛkɔtena afebɔɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: Solomon turned toward the people standing there. Then he blessed them
translation_verse: Né Yisrael maen ne amukoraa begyigyi berɛ, na Nana Solomon pɛnene ye nye hyirele bɛ dɔ yirale bɛ mukoraa.

english_verse: and said: Praise the Lord God of Israel! Long ago he brought his people out of Egypt. He did not choose a city from any tribe in Israel where his temple would be built, but he kept his promise to make my father David the king of Israel.
translation_verse: ‘Ofi kyẽa bɔ nyele me maen Yisrael mvili Misraim mmale ɔ, nnneane Yisrael mmusua kure ne biala anu nnyele kuro bɔ ngosi sua ngosie so ngɔma me dumaa kɔla so ɔ. Nakoso nneane nu nyele Dawide kyɛ oli me maen Yisrael so.’

english_verse: So when David wanted to build a temple for the Lord God of Israel,
translation_verse: Me baba Dawide yɛle ye adwene kyɛ okosi sua kɔfa AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ dumaa kɔto so.

english_verse: the Lord said, “It's good that you want to build a temple where I can be worshiped.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE sele me baba Dawide kyɛ, ‘Ayɛ nikyee kyɛ adwene ye nwo kyɛ ekosi sua kɔfa me dumaa kɔto so ɔ.

english_verse: But you're not the one to do it. Your son will build a temple to honor me.”
translation_verse: Nakoso nna wɔ yeɛ ekosi sua ne ɔ, na mmom wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ kunu ba bienzua yeɛ okosi sua ne kɔfa me dumaa kɔto so ɔ.’

english_verse: The Lord has done what he promised. I am the king of Israel like my father, and I've built a temple for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE ama ye dwirɛ bɔ ɔhane ne awa nu; ofikyɛ mali me baba Dawide bia, na matena Yisrael ahennie bia so, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle bɔ ne. Na masi sua ne mafa AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ dumaa mato so.

english_verse: I've also made a place in the temple for the sacred chest. And in that chest are the two flat stones on which is written the solemn agreement the Lord made with our ancestors when he led them out of Egypt. Solomon Prays at the Temple (
translation_verse: AWURADE apam bɔ ɔne yɛ nana mɔ yɛle mmerɛ bɔ ɔyele bɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne, alaka bɔ apam ne wɔ nu ne, mapena nekaa wɔ sua ne anu mafa masie.” Solomon tu sua ne wura AWURADE sa

english_verse: and prayed: Lord God of Israel, no other god in heaven or on earth is like you! You never forget the agreement you made with your people, and you are loyal to anyone who faithfully obeys your teachings.
translation_verse: Ɔhane kyɛ, “Ao, AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ, nyameɛso bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro, anaakyɛ aseɛ ye aso, nyameɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ wɔ ɔ, bɔ odi apam so ná okyire ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne kyire ye ngoaa bɔ bɛye bɛ kunu fitaa bedi ye dwirɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: My father David was your servant, and today you have kept every promise you made to him.
translation_verse: Ama ɛbɔ bɔ ɛhyɛle wɔ somvoɛ me baba Dawide ne wawa nu. Ɛtele wɔ noa ɛhyɛle ye bɔ, na ɛnɛ ɛnate wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ tumi so amaa wawa nu.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you promised my father that someone from his family would always be king of Israel, if they do their best to obey you, just as he did.
translation_verse: Yiti ao, AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ, ma ɛbɔ bɔ ɛhyɛle wɔ somvoɛ me baba Dawide ne, ɔhɔ so tena berɛ. Ɛhane kyɛ, ‘Sɛ wɔ boso ama bɛye bɛ kunu bedi me dwirɛ so kyɛbɔ ayɔ ne ala a, ye de wɔ bosoniɛ bɔ ɔkɔtena Yisrael bia so wɔ me nyunu ne, ɔngɔbɔ wɔ le.’

english_verse: Please keep this promise you made to your servant David.
translation_verse: Ao Yisrael Nyameɛ, ma wɔ bɔhyɛlɛ bɔ ɛhyɛle wɔ somvoɛ me baba Dawide ne, ɔ́bra nu.

english_verse: There's not enough room in all of heaven for you, Lord God. How could you possibly live on earth in this temple I have built?
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ, aso ɛkɔtena aseɛ ye aso amba? Eh! Nyameɛso ne nyameɛso anwuro anwuro po, ɔte kãa ma wɔ, ná wayɛ kyɛ sua he bɔ masi ye!

english_verse: This is the temple where you have chosen to be worshiped. Please watch over it day and night and listen when I turn toward it and pray.
translation_verse: amaa sɛ eyia oo, kɔngɔen oo, sua ye bɔ ɔte nekaa bɔ ahã kyɛ, ‘Me dumaa kɔla so’ ye, wɔ nye ali ye si; amaa ɔnate so, atie mbaeɛ bɔ w’akoaa kɔfa ye nye kohyire ɛwa kɔbɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I am your servant, and the people of Israel belong to you. So whenever any of us look toward this temple and pray, answer from your home in heaven and forgive our sins.

translation_verse: Nakoso ɔnate wɔ baba Dawide ti, mengole ahennie ne mmerɛ bɔ ɛte ase ɔ, na mmom ɛwa yeɛ ngole ngofi ye sa nu ɔ.

english_verse: When I do, I will still let him rule one tribe, because I have not forgotten that David was my servant and Jerusalem is my chosen city. Hadad Becomes an Enemy of Solomon
translation_verse: Mengole ahennie ne amukoraati. Ɔnate m’akoaa Dawide ɔne Yerusalem bɔ maneanea nu maye masie berɛ ne ati, ngɔfa abusua kure ko ngɔma ɛwa ne.” Solomon pɔfoɛ mɔ

english_verse: Hadad was from the royal family of Edom, and here is how the Lord made him Solomon's enemy:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE mane pɔfoɛ bie dwɔso tiale Solomon. Ye ole Edomniɛ Hadade bɔ ɔte Edom hene dehyeɛ ne.

english_verse: Hadad and his wife had a son named Genubath, and the queen let the boy grow up in the palace with her own children.
translation_verse: Hadade ne Tapenese aliɛma brasua ne bɛwole baa bienzua Gyenubate. Tapenese tetele akwadaa ne wɔ Faro ahemvie. Gyenubate ne Faro mma mɔ bɛbɔle nu benyini wɔ Faro ahemvie berɛ.

english_verse: When Hadad heard that David and Joab were dead, he said to the king, “Your Majesty, please let me go back to my own country.”
translation_verse: Hadade wɔ Misraim ne, ɔtele kyɛ Dawide atoa ye mbanyi mɔ, na afei safohene Yoabo koso wawu. Yiti Hadade sele Faro kyɛ, “Mepena kyɛ mesrɛ ate mekɔ me bɔbɔ me maen nu.”

english_verse: “Why?” asked the king. “Do you want something I haven't given you?” “No, I just want to go home.” Rezon Becomes an Enemy of Solomon
translation_verse: Nakoso Faro buale kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ ohia wɔ me wa bɔ yiti yeɛ ɛpena kyɛ esa kɔ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ maen nu ye?” Yeɛ Hadade sele kyɛ, “Hwee nhia me, nakoso maa ngɔ.”

english_verse: Here is how God made Rezon son of Eliada an enemy of Solomon: Rezon had run away from his master, King Hadadezer of Zobah.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ mane pɔfoɛ foforɛ dwɔsole tiale Solomon. Ye ole Eliada awa Reson, bɔ ɔnwati fili ye mene Soba hene Hadadesa berɛ ne.

english_verse: He formed his own small army and became its leader after David had defeated Hadadezer's troops. Then Rezon and his army went to Damascus, where he became the ruler of Syria and an enemy of Israel. Both Hadad and Rezon were enemies of Israel while Solomon was king, and they caused him a lot of trouble. The Lord Makes a Promise to Jeroboam
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Solomon di Yisrael hene ne amukoraa, Reson yɛle Yisrael pɔfoɛ, na ɔhale adwene kyɛbɔ Hadade yɔle ne ala. Reson hyili Yisrael, na olili hene wɔ Damasko. Yeroboam yɛ Solomon nwo lɔen

english_verse: Jeroboam was from the town of Zeredah in Ephraim. His father Nebat had died, but his mother Zeruah was still alive. Jeroboam was one of Solomon's officials, but even he rebelled against Solomon.
translation_verse: Nebate awa Yeroboam te Efraimniɛ. Ofi Sereda. Né ɔte Solomon somvoɛ, na oni ole kunaniɛ bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Serua. Yeroboam yɛle Nana Solomon nwo lɔen.

english_verse: Here is how it happened: While Solomon's workers were filling in the land on the east side of Jerusalem and repairing the city walls,
translation_verse: Edwirɛ bɔ ɔmaa ɔyɛle Nana Solomon nwo lɔen ne ɛhe: Solomon sili sua bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Milo ne, na ndokuro bɔ ɔlela ye baba Dawide kuro fasue ne anu ne, otuatuale bɛ.

english_verse: Solomon noticed that Jeroboam was a hard worker. So he put Jeroboam in charge of the work force from Manasseh and Ephraim.
translation_verse: Né Yeroboam te anwoserɛniɛ paa. Na Solomon nwuni kyɛ sɔ aberandeɛ ne ɔbɔ ye nwo mmɔden ne, Yosef boso ama amukoraa bɔ bɛhyɛ bɛ maa bɛyɔ adwuma ne, ɔmaa ɔneane bɛ so.

english_verse: One day when Jeroboam was leaving Jerusalem, he met Ahijah, a prophet from Shiloh. No one else was anywhere around. Suddenly, Ahijah took off his new coat and ripped it into twelve pieces.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Ahiya sɔle ɛtena monɛ bɔ ɔhera ye ne anu, na osunzuale nu sii sii buru ne nyɔ.

english_verse: But Solomon will still rule one tribe, since he is the son of David my servant, and Jerusalem is my chosen city.
translation_verse: Nakoso abusua kure ko kɔhã ye sa nu, ɔnate m’akoaa Dawide ɔne Yerusalem bɔ ɔte kuro bɔ maneanea Yisrael mmusua kure amukoraa nu maye ne ati.

english_verse: “Solomon and the Israelites are not like their ancestor David. They will not listen to me, obey me, or do what is right. They have turned from me to worship Astarte the goddess of Sidon, Chemosh the god of Moab, and Milcom the god of Ammon.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Solomon apo me waasɔne Sidonfoɛ bosoen brasua Asetate ɔne Moabofoɛ bosoen Kemose, yeɛ Amonfoɛ bosoen Milkom, na wanni me dwirɛ so. Wanyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ me nye so ɔ, yeɛ wanni m’ahyɛdeɛ ne me nhyehyɛleɛ so kyɛbɔ ye baba Dawide de olili so ne.

english_verse: “Solomon is David's son, and David was my chosen leader, who did what I commanded. So I will let Solomon be king until he dies.
translation_verse: Nakoso mengole ahennie ne anu bie mengofi ye sa nu, na mmom ngɔmaa okoli hene mmerɛ bɔ ɔte ase ne amukoraati, ɔnate m’akoaa Dawide bɔ nneaneane nu nyele ye, ná olili me mmeraa dwirɛ ne m’ahyɛdeɛ amukoraa so ne ati.

english_verse: Then I will give you ten tribes to rule,
translation_verse: Ngole ahennie ne ngofi Solomon awa ne asa nu, ná mafa nu mmusua kure buru mama wɔ.

english_verse: but Solomon's son will still rule one tribe. This way, my servant David will always have a descendant ruling in Jerusalem, the city where I have chosen to be worshiped.
translation_verse: Nakoso ngɔfa abusua kure ko ngɔma ɔwa, amaa ɔnate so me somvoɛ Dawide wahɔ so wanya kanea wɔ me nyunu, wɔ Yerusalem kuro bɔ matu masie berɛ kyɛ bɛsɔne me wɔ nu ne anu.

english_verse: “You will be king of Israel and will rule every nation you want.
translation_verse: Ngɔye wɔ ngosie berɛ, na ekoli hene kɔɔhã nekaa biala bɔ ekuro kyɛ w’ahennie kodwu ɔ. Ekoli Yisrael so hene.

english_verse: I'll help you if you obey me. And if you do what I say, as my servant David did, I will always let someone from your family rule in Israel, just as someone from David's family will always rule in Judah. The nation of Israel will be yours.
translation_verse: Sɛ ekotie bɔ mahyɛ wɔ ne amukoraa, ɛkɔnate m’atee so, ɛkɔyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ me nye so, ná ekoli m’ahyɛdeɛ ne me mmeraa dwirɛ so, kyɛbɔ me somvoɛ Dawide lili so ne a, ye de ngogyina wɔ si. Na ngɔma wɔ boso ama koli bia ne afebɔɔ kyɛbɔ nyɔ mane Dawide ne, na ngɔmaa ekoli Yisrael so hene.

english_verse: “I will punish the descendants of David, but not forever.”
translation_verse: Ɔnate Solomon bɔne ne ati, ngɔhwe Dawide boso ama bɛ so, nakoso ɔngɔyɛ afebɔɔ.”

english_verse: Everything else Solomon did while he was king is written in the book about him and his wisdom.
translation_verse: Afei Solomon nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, nningyein bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, ɔne ye nworɛ nwo dwirɛ amukoraa, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Solomon nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: he died and was buried there in the city of his father David. His son Rehoboam then became king.
translation_verse: Solomon toale ye mbanyi mɔ, na besiele ye wɔ ye baba Dawide kuro. Na ɔwa bienzua Rehoboam lili ye bia.

english_verse: But the people from the northern tribes of Israel sent for him. Then together they went to Rehoboam and said,
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ somane maa bɛɛfrɛle Yeroboam, na ɔne Yisrael maen ne amukoraa bɛɛfa bɛtole Rehoboam nyunu kyɛ,

english_verse: “Give me three days to think about it,” Rehoboam replied, “then come back for my answer.” So the people left.
translation_verse: Na Rehoboam buale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma me ɛlɛsa maa ndwene ye nwo, ná ɛ́mɔsa bɛ́bra me wa beele mmuayɛɛ.” Yiti mmenia ne sili nu besa bɛhɔle.

english_verse: Rehoboam went to some leaders who had been his father's senior officials, and he asked them, “What should I tell these people?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ mbanyi bɔ bɛ nye afi, bɔ mmerɛ bɔ Nana Rehoboam baba Solomon te ase ne, né betu ye foɛ ne, Rehoboam ne bɛ dwenene edwirɛ ne anwo, na obisale bɛ kyɛ, “Mmenia ye, nzikyɛ mmuayɛɛ yeɛ ɛmɔsusu kyɛ mva mma bɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: They answered, “If you want them to serve and obey you, then you should do what they ask today. Tell them you will make their work easier.”
translation_verse: Bebuale ye kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛnɛ ɛkɔyɛ wɔ nwo akoaa kɔma maen ye ná ɛkɔso bɛ, ná sɛ ɛkɔma bɛ mmuayɛɛ paa a, ye de bɛkɔyɛ wɔ ngoaa afebɔɔ.”

english_verse: But Rehoboam refused their advice and went to the younger men who had grown up with him and were now his officials.
translation_verse: Nakoso foɛ bɔ mbanyi nemɔ tuli Rehoboam ne, ɔfa tole ahameɛ. Na mmerandeɛ bɔ ɔne bɛ bɔ tipɛen bɔ ɔne bɛ tu nu, bɔ né baayɛ ye foɛtulɛfoɛ ne, ɔne bɛ dwenene edwirɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: He asked, “What do you think I should say to these people who asked me to make their work easier?”
translation_verse: Obisale bɛ kyɛ, “Mmenia ye, bɔ bafa bato me nyunu kyɛ, ‘Adwuma serɛserɛ bɔ wɔ baba fa tole yɛ so ne, te so’ ne, nzikyɛ mmuayɛɛ yeɛ yɛfa yɛma bɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: He spoke bluntly and told them exactly what his own advisors had suggested: “My father made you work hard, but I'll make you work even harder. He punished you with whips, but I'll use whips with pieces of sharp metal!”
translation_verse: na ogyinane mmerandeɛ nemɔ foɛtulɛ so sele bɛ kyɛ, “Me baba maa ɛmɔyɔle adwuma bɔ ɔyɛ se paa ɔ, na me wora, ngɔfa bieku ngɔboka so. Me baba de, ole mbire yeɛ ɔhwene ɛmɔ so ɔ, nakoso me de ngɔfa anyanyangyeleɛ yeɛ ngɔhwe ɛmɔ so ɔ.”

english_verse: When the Israelites heard that Jeroboam was back, they called everyone together. Then they sent for Jeroboam and made him king of Israel. Only the people from the tribe of Judah remained loyal to David's family. Shemaiah Warns Rehoboam (
translation_verse: Yisrael amukoraa tele kyɛ Yeroboam asa awa ne, bɛsomane maa bɛɛfrɛle ye bɛwale dwaa bɔ babɔ ne abo. Na bɛfale ye besili Yisrael amukoraa so hene. Dawide ahennie bia ne, ebiala wanne wando nu, sana Yuda abusua kure ngome.

english_verse: Meanwhile, God told Shemaiah the prophet
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ fale ye noa dwirɛ somane Nyameɛ sona Semaya kyɛ,

english_verse: “Don't go to war against the people from Israel—they are your relatives. Go home! I am the Lord, and I made these things happen.” Rehoboam and his army obeyed the Lord and went home. Jeroboam Makes Religious Changes
translation_verse: ‘AWURADE nwa nyoo: Nnɛma ɛmɔkɔfa koɛ bɛtoa ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ Yisraelfoɛ. Ebiala ɔhɔ ye awuro, ofikyɛ bɔ wasi ne, me yeɛ mamaa wasi ɔ.’ ” Yiti betiele AWURADE dwirɛ ne, na besa bɛhɔle b’awuro, kyɛbɔ AWURADE nate ye dwirɛ so ɔhyɛle bɛ ne ala. Yeroboam yɔ esikaa kɔkorɛ amoen

english_verse: Jeroboam rebuilt Shechem in Ephraim and made it a stronger town, then he moved there. He also fortified the town of Penuel.
translation_verse: Sɛkem bɔ ɔwɔ Efraim mmokaa aseɛ ne aso ne, Yeroboam tole fasue fale ye nwo tenane berɛ. Ofili berɛ yeɛ ɔɔtole fasue fale Penuel nwo ɔ.

english_verse: One day, Jeroboam started thinking, “Everyone in Israel still goes to the temple in Jerusalem to offer sacrifices to the Lord. What if they become loyal to David's family again? They will kill me and accept Rehoboam as their king.”
translation_verse: AWURADE awuro bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne, sɛ maen ye toa so bɛkɔ nu bɛkɔbɔ afɔleɛ a, b’adwene kɔkakyi maa bekosa bekooli bɛ mene Yuda hene Rehoboam si. Ɔba ye sɔ a, bekohu me ná basa baaso Yuda hene Rehoboam.”

english_verse: Jeroboam asked for advice and then made two gold statues of calves. He showed them to the people and said, “Listen everyone! You won't have to go to Jerusalem to worship anymore. Here are your gods who rescued you from Egypt.”
translation_verse: Yiti Nana Yeroboam fale adwene, na ɔfale esikaa kɔkorɛ yɔle nandwie mmaa nyɔ. Osele maen ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔahɔ Yerusalem bie a, ɔte paa. Yisrael ee, ɛmɔ nyameɛ mɔ bɔ bɛyele ɛmɔ befili Misraim aseɛ so bɛwale ne, bɛ ɛhe.”

english_verse: Jeroboam built small places of worship at the shrines and appointed men who were not from the tribe of Levi to serve as priests.
translation_verse: Yeroboam sisili sua wɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso, na ɔneane maen ne anu yeyele kwahweabaa biemɔ bɔ nna Lewifoɛ ahɔ ɔ hyɛle bɛ sɔfo.

english_verse: He also decided to start a new festival for the Israelites on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, just like the one in Judah. On that day, Jeroboam went to Bethel and offered sacrifices on the altar to the gold calf he had put there. Then he assigned the priests their duties.
translation_verse: Bosome mmɔtwɛ bɔ ɔte bosome bɔ wali ye bɔbɔ ye ti piri waye wasie berɛ ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nnu ne, sɛ odwu a, né ɔkɔ afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ wasi wasie Betel ne aso. Ɔhyehyɛle aluolue mane Yisrael maen, na né ɔfo kɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso ɔkɔyera ɛyɛɛ.

english_verse: One day, Jeroboam was standing at the altar in Bethel, ready to make an offering. Suddenly one of God's prophets arrived from Judah and shouted: The Lord sent me with a message about this altar. A child named Josiah will be born into David's family. He will sacrifice on this altar the priests who make offerings here, and human bones will be burned on it.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ sona ne teane nu fale AWURADE dwirɛ dwudwo tiale Betel afɔleɛ bokyea ne kyɛ, “Afɔleɛ bokyea, afɔleɛ bokyea, AWURADE nwa nyoo, ‘Bɛkɔwo baa bienzua bie wɔ Dawide awuro ama nu bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Yosia ɔ. Na asɔneyɛɛ so asɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛfa ɛyɛɛ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ wɔ wɔ so ne, wɔ so yeɛ Yosia kɔfa bɛ kɔbɔ afɔleɛ ɔ. Na ɔkɔyera kuro sona mmowue wɔ wɔ so.’ ”

english_verse: You will know that the Lord has said these things when the altar splits in half, and the ashes on it fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne ala, ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne hyirele sɛngyerɛnneɛ bie bɔ okosi ɔ. Ɔnwa, “Ɛhe ole sɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ okyire kyɛ AWURADE yeɛ wadwudwo ɔ: Afɔleɛ bokyea ne, okobubu. Na afei, so nzoen ne koso, okohwie kogua ase.”

english_verse: The altar split in half, and the ashes fell to the ground, just as the prophet had warned.
translation_verse: Afɔleɛ bokyea ne koso bubuli, na nzoen ne hwie guale ase, kyɛbɔ sɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ Nyameɛ sona ne ɔnate AWURADE dwirɛ so hane ne, ɔte ne ala.

english_verse: “Please pray to the Lord your God and ask him to heal my hand,” Jeroboam begged. The prophet prayed, and Jeroboam's hand was healed.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana Yeroboam sele Nyameɛ sona ne kyɛ, “Srɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ maa onwu me anwumvoin, ná bɔ mbaeɛ ma me maa me sa ne osa ɔyɛ paa.” Yiti Nyameɛ sona ne srɛle AWURADE mane Nana Yeroboam sa ne yɛle paa, na ɔyɛle kyɛ ye daa ne ala.

english_verse: “Come home with me and eat something,” Jeroboam said. “I want to give you a gift for what you have done.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana Yeroboam sele Nyameɛ sona ne kyɛ, “Bra maa yɛhɔ awuro kodidi, na ngɔhyɛ wɔ nikye.”

english_verse: “No, I wouldn't go with you, even if you offered me half of your kingdom. I won't eat or drink here either.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ sona ne buale ye kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛfa w’ahennie ne bue po kyɛ me a, me ne wɔ ngɔhɔ. Afei koso mengodidi yeɛ mengɔno nzue wɔ ɛwa.

english_verse: The Lord said I can't eat or drink anything and that I can't go home the same way I came.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE dwirɛ ahyɛ me kyɛ: nnɛdi hwee, nnɛno nzue, yeɛ atee bɔ ɛnate so hɔle ne, sɛ esa kɔ a, nnɛfa so.”

english_verse: Then he started home down a different road. An Old Prophet from Bethel
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne fale atee foforɛ so, na wanza wamva atee bɔ ɔnate so hɔle Betel ne aso.

english_verse: At that time an old prophet lived in Bethel, and one of his sons told him what the prophet from Judah had said and done.
translation_verse: Né ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ biaa aworowaa bie te Betel. Ye mma mmienzua mɔ fale nningyein amukoraa bɔ Nyameɛ sona ne waayɔ ye wɔ Betel sɔ kyẽa ne bɛɛbɔle ye amaneɛ. Na edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ ɔhã hyirele Nana Yeroboam ne koso, bɛhã hyirele bɛ baba.

english_verse: “Show me which way he went,” the old prophet said, and his sons pointed out the road.
translation_verse: Bɛ baba bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Atee beni yeɛ ɔfale so hɔle ɔ?” Na atee bɔ Nyameɛ sona bɔ ofi Yuda wale ne ɔfale so hɔle ne, biaa ne mma mmienzua nemɔ hyirele ye.

english_verse: “Put a saddle on my donkey,” he told them. After they did, he got on the donkey
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ aworowaa ne sele ye mma mmienzua nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔsiesie afunum ko bɛma me.” Yiti besiesiele afunum bɛmane ye, na ɔfo tenane so.

english_verse: and rode off to look for the prophet from Judah. The old prophet found him sitting under an oak tree and asked, “Are you the prophet from Judah?” “Yes, I am.”
translation_verse: Ɔpole Nyameɛ sona ne aso, na ɔɔtole ye kyɛ ɔte eluii bie abo ɔ. Obisale ye kyɛ, “Nyameɛ sona bɔ ofi Yuda wale ne, aso yeɛ ole wɔ?” Na obuale ye kyɛ, “Yoo, me ɔ.”

english_verse: “Come home with me,” the old prophet said, “and have something to eat.”
translation_verse: Na ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ aworowaa ne sele ye kyɛ, “Bra maa yɛhɔ awuro ná kodidi.”

english_verse: “I can't go back with you,” the prophet replied, “and I can't eat or drink anything with you.
translation_verse: Nakoso obuale kyɛ, “Me ne wɔ sá kɔ a, ɔnyɛ yé, yeɛ me ne wɔ ngɔhɔ w’awuro. Me ne wɔ ngoli hwee, yeɛ yɛngɔno nzue wɔ wa.

english_verse: The Lord warned me not to eat or drink or to go home the same way I came.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔhã hyirele me ole kyɛ, Nnɛdi hwee, yeɛ nnɛno nzue wɔ dɔ, na atee bɔ ɛnate so hɔle ne, sɛ esa kɔ a, nnɛfa so.”

english_verse: The old prophet said, “I'm a prophet too. One of the Lord's angels told me to take you to my house and give you something to eat and drink.” The prophet from Judah did not know that the old prophet was lying,
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ aworowaa ne sele ye kyɛ, “Me koso nde ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ kyɛ wɔ ala. Na abɔfo nate AWURADE dwirɛ so wahã wahyire me kyɛ, ‘Kɔhã kyire ye maa osa ye si ɔbra w’awuro wa oodidi na ɔno nzue.’ ” Nakoso né ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ aworowaa ne ɔlakalaka ye.

english_verse: so he went home with him and ate and drank.
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ sona ne sale ye si ɔne ye bɛhɔle ye awuro oodidili ɔnone nzue.

english_verse: a message for the prophet from Judah: Listen to the Lord's message. You have disobeyed the Lord your God.
translation_verse: na ɔfa tole Nyameɛ sona bɔ ofi Yuda wale ne nyunu kyɛ, “AWURADE nwa nyoo: Ɔnate kyɛ ahwi afa AWURADE dwirɛ so, ná anni AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ ɔhyɛle wɔ ne aso,

english_verse: He told you not to eat or drink anything here, but you came home and ate with me. And so, when you die, your body won't be buried in your family tomb.
translation_verse: na mmom asa wɔ si awa aadidi ano nzue wɔ nekaa bɔ ɔhane ye nwo dwirɛ hyirele wɔ kyɛ, ‘Nnɛdidi yeɛ nnɛno nzue’ ne ati, bengonya wɔ fuin bengosie ye wɔ wɔ nana mɔ asieleɛ so.”

english_verse: and the prophet from Judah left. Along the way, a lion attacked and killed him, and the donkey and the lion stood there beside his dead body.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate atee so ɔkɔ ne, gyata bie yiale ye atunu ohuni ye. Gyata ne gyili ye fuin ne tole atee ne anu. Afunum ne gyinane ye fuin ne anwo berɛ na gyata ne koso gyinane ye fuin ne anwo berɛ.

english_verse: Some people walked by and saw the body with the lion standing there. They ran into Bethel, telling everyone what they had seen.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ bɛpɛle nu berɛ ne, benwuni efuin bɔ ɔla atee ne anu, bɔ gyata ne gyi ye nwo berɛ ne. Na bɛɛbɔle edwirɛ ne anwo amaneɛ wɔ kuro bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ aworowaa ne te so ne aso.

english_verse: When the old prophet heard the news, he said, “That must be the prophet from Judah. The Lord warned him, but he disobeyed. So the Lord sent a lion to kill him.”
translation_verse: Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ aworowaa bɔ ɔmaa Nyameɛ sona sale ye si fili atee ne aso dɔ wale ne, ɔtele edwirɛ ne, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Nyameɛ sona bɔ ohwi fale AWURADE dwirɛ so ne ɔ. Ye sɔ ti, yeɛ AWURADE afa ye awura gyata sa maa watete ye nu wahũ ye ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔhã hyirele ye ne te ne ala.”

english_verse: The old prophet told his sons to saddle his donkey, and when it was ready,
translation_verse: Na osele ye mma mmienzua nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔsiesie afunum bɛma me.” Yiti besiesiele afunum ko,

english_verse: he left. He found the body lying on the road, with the donkey and lion standing there. The lion had not eaten the body or attacked the donkey.
translation_verse: na ɔhɔ onwuni kyɛ efuin ne la atee ne anu, bɔ afunum ne ɔne gyata ne begyigyi ye nwo berɛ ɔ. Né gyata ne ollili fuin ne, yeɛ né ohhuni afunum ne koso.

english_verse: The old prophet picked up the body, put it on his own donkey, and took it back to Bethel, so he could bury it and mourn for the prophet from Judah.
translation_verse: Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ aworowaa ne tamone Nyameɛ sona ne fuin ne tole afunum ne aso, na ɔfa sale ye si wale ye bɔbɔ ye kuro berɛ kyɛ ɔbaasũ ye ná osie ye.

english_verse: He buried the body in his own family tomb and cried for the prophet.
translation_verse: Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ aworowaa ne, osiele efuin ne wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye asieleɛ kumaa nu, na besuni ye kyɛ, “Aliɛmaa, yaakɔ oo!”

english_verse: I'm sure that everything he said about the altar in Bethel and the shrines in Samaria will happen.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ edwirɛ bɔ ɔnate AWURADE dwirɛ so hã tiale afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ ɔwɔ Betel ne, ɔne Samaria nguro nu asɔneyɛɛ so amukoraati ne, ɔkɔwa nu amba.”

english_verse: But Jeroboam kept on doing evil things. He appointed men to be priests at the local shrines, even if they were not Levites. In fact, anyone who wanted to be a priest could be one.
translation_verse: Nakoso edwirɛ bɔ osili ye asi po, Yeroboam wanzakyera ye adwene wamvi ye bɔne nwo, na mmom ɔneaneane maen ne amukoraati nu hyɛle mmenia kwahweabaa sɔfo bieku bɔ bɛkɔyɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso adwuma ɔ. Ebiala bɔ okuro kyɛ ɔyɛ sɔfo ne, ɔhyɛle ye sɔfo maa ɔyɔle asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso adwuma.

english_verse: About the same time, Abijah son of Jeroboam got sick.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, anwonyerɛ bɔle Yeroboam awa bienzua Abiya.

english_verse: But when Ahijah heard her walking up to the door, he said: Come in! I know you're Jeroboam's wife—why are you pretending to be someone else? I have some bad news for you.
translation_verse: Nakoso odwuli anoa nu berɛ bɔ owura awuro ne anu nen, Ahiya tele ye gya boso, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Yeroboam aye, bra nu. Nzu ati yeɛ ɛyɛ wɔ nwo kyɛ sona foforɛ ahɔ ye? Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ afa edwirɛ piri bie watua me noa kyɛ nga ngyire wɔ.

english_verse: Give your husband this message from the Lord God of Israel: “Jeroboam, you know that I, the Lord, chose you over anyone else to be the leader of my people Israel.
translation_verse: Kɔhã kyire Yeroboam kyɛ, ‘AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Nneaneane maen ne anu nyele wɔ, mvale wɔ nduale me maen Yisrael noa,

english_verse: I even took David's kingdom away from his family and gave it to you. But you are not like my servant David. He always obeyed me and did what was right.
translation_verse: na nnele ahennie ne mvili Dawide awuro ama sa nu mva mane wɔ. Nakoso ammɔ wɔ bra kyɛ me somvoɛ Dawide bɔ olili me mmeraa dwirɛ so ne. Ɔfale ye adwene amukoraati lili me si, na bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ me nye so ɔ angome yeɛ ɔyɔle ɔ.

english_verse: “You have made me very angry by rejecting me and making idols out of gold. Jeroboam, you have done more evil things than any king before you.
translation_verse: Na mmom bɛ bɔ belili wɔ nyunu bebuli maen ne, ali bɔne atra bɛ mukoraa. Ɔnate kyɛ ayɔ nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ afa, agyina amoen afa awura me apue, ná apo me ne ati,

english_verse: “Because of this, I will destroy your family by killing every man and boy in it, whether slave or free. I will wipe out your family, just as fire burns up trash.
translation_verse: yiti ngɔma musue kɔto Yeroboam abusuafoɛ. Ngohũ Yeroboam bosoniɛ bienzua biala bɔ ɔwɔ Yisrael, kyɛ ɔte kanga anaakyɛ ɔte dehyeɛ, na ngonua Yeroboam abusuafoɛ boso, kyɛbɔ bɛyera fofoɛ maa ɔtɔ nzoen ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel will mourn at his funeral. But he will be the last one from Jeroboam's family to receive a proper burial, because he's the only one the Lord God of Israel is pleased with.
translation_verse: Yisrael amukoraa bekosu ye ná basie ye. Na Yeroboam awuro ama de, akwadaa ne angome yeɛ bekonya ye fuin bekosie ye ɔ, ofikyɛ Yeroboam abusuafoɛ nu, AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ wanwu nikyee bie bɔ ɔsɔ ye nye ɔ wɔ akwadaa ne anu.

english_verse: The Lord will soon choose a new king of Israel, who will destroy Jeroboam's family. And I mean very soon.
translation_verse: Asa koso, AWURADE kɔye sona kɔma ye nwo maa okoli Yisrael so hene, bɔ sɔ sona ne okonua Yeroboam abusuafoɛ bɛ boso ɛnɛ ala ɔ. Wahyɛ ye bo kekesaala ye po!

english_verse: The people of Israel have made the Lord angry by setting up sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah. So the Lord will punish them until they shake like grass in a stream. He will take them out of the land he gave to their ancestors, then scatter them as far away as the Euphrates River.
translation_verse: “AWURADE kɔwoso Yisrael ahennie, kyɛbɔ nzue woso elemmire ɔ. Aseɛ paa he bɔ ɔfa mane bɛ nana mɔ ne, ɔkɔpɛ bɛ asue kofi so, na ɔkɔbɔ bɛ aya maa bɛkɔhɔ asue Yufreti asi, ofikyɛ bagyinagyina bosoen Asera dosii mɔ bafa bawura AWURADE apue maa wafɛ yaa.

english_verse: years from Jerusalem, the city where the Lord had chosen to be worshiped. His mother Naamah was from Ammon.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yeroboam aye ne dwɔso sili nu hɔle, na oodwuli Tisa. Ye gya tiale ye awuro ne anoa nu berɛ pɛ yeɛ akwadaa ne wuli ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel came and mourned at his funeral, just as the Lord's servant Ahijah had said. Jeroboam Dies
translation_verse: Yisrael amukoraa besiele ye besuni ye, kyɛbɔ AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔnate ye somvoɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Ahiya so hane ne, ɔte ne ala. Yeroboam wue

english_verse: Everything else Jeroboam did while he was king, including the battles he won, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Afei Yeroboam nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, kyɛbɔ osi hone koɛ ɔne kyɛbɔ osi buli maen ne, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yisrael ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: The people of Judah disobeyed the Lord and made him even angrier than their ancestors had.
translation_verse: Na Yuda yɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Bɛ bɔne bɔ bɛyɔle ne, ɔtra bɔne amukoraa bɔ bɛ nana mɔ yɔle ɔ, na bɛmane AWURADE hwene bɛ nwo nungunɛ.

english_verse: They also built their own local shrines and stone images of foreign gods, and they set up sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah on every hill and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ besa besisili asɔneyɛɛ mɔ, bosoen bonima mɔ ne bosoen Asera dosii mɔ bɛmane bɛ nwo wɔ bokaa biala so, ɔne bakaa monɛ biala abo.
