english_verse: Even worse, they allowed prostitutes at the shrines, and followed the disgusting customs of the foreign nations that the Lord had forced out of Canaan.
translation_verse: Né asɔneyɛɛ so gyanderafoɛ mmienzua koso wɔ maen ne anu. Maen maen mɔ bɔ AWURADE foane bɛ fili Yisraelfoɛ nyunu ne, b’amumuyɛɛ ne amukoraa, Yudafoɛ yɔle bie.

english_verse: After Rehoboam had been king for four years, King Shishak of Egypt attacked Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nana Rehoboam lili bia ne, ye afoɛ nnu ne anu, Misraim hene Sisake fale koɛ ɔɔtoale Yerusalem.

english_verse: He took everything of value from the temple and the palace, including Solomon's gold shields.
translation_verse: Ɔsesale AWURADE awuro berɛ nningyein amukoraa ɔne ahemvie berɛ nningyein amukoraa hɔle. Afei koso esikaa kɔkorɛ akokyɛm bɔ Solomon yɔle ne amukoraa, ɔsesa hɔle.

english_verse: Rehoboam had bronze shields made to replace the gold ones, and he ordered the guards at the city gates to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Yiti nziɛ ye, Nana Rehoboam yɔle kɔɔbere akokyɛm mɔ fa sili bɛ gya nu, na ɔfa wurale awɛmvoɛ mbanyi bɔ ne bɛwɛne ahemvie berɛ anoa nemɔ sa.

english_verse: Whenever Rehoboam went to the Lord's temple, the guards carried the shields. But they always took them back to the guardroom as soon as he was finished.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ biala, sɛ né Nana Rehoboam ɔkɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ a, awɛmvoɛ nemɔ bɛye akokyɛm nemɔ befite, ná basa bafa bagua akodeɛ sua ne anu.

english_verse: Everything else Rehoboam did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Afei Rehoboam nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yuda ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: He and Jeroboam were constantly at war.
translation_verse: Na Rehoboam ne Yeroboam bɛhɔle so bɛhone koɛ mmerɛ pee.

english_verse: Rehoboam's mother Naamah was from Ammon, but when Rehoboam died, he was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Abijam then became king.
translation_verse: Rehoboam toale ye mbanyi mɔ, na besiele ye wɔ nekaa bɔ besiele ye mbanyi mɔ ɔ, wɔ Dawide kuro ne anu. Oni ole Amonniɛ bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Naama. Na Rehoboam wa bienzua Abiyam lili Rehoboam bia.

english_verse: His own grandmother Maacah had made an idol of Asherah, and Asa took it and burned it in Kidron Valley. Then he removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.
translation_verse: Osa tuli ye nana brasua Maaka fili ɛhemmaa bia ne aso, ofikyɛ né Maaka wagyina Asera bosoen dosii bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ ɔ. Asa bubuli bosoen ne guale, na ɔyerale ye wɔ Kidron bɔnza ne anu.

english_verse: Abijam became king of Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year as king of Israel,
translation_verse: Nebate awa Nana Yeroboam lili bia ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne mmɔtwɛ ne anu, Abiyam lili Yuda so hene.

english_verse: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to strengthen the town of Ramah. Then he used these same stones and wood to fortify the town of Geba in the territory of Benjamin and the town of Mizpah.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana Asa maa bɛbɔle dawure wɔ Yuda amukoraati kyɛ ebiala ɔɔyɔ maen adwuma, na ebiala wanye ye nwo wamvi nu. Nyɔboɛ ne ndaboa bɔ né Baasa wafa watua Rama kuro ne, bɛsesa bɛhɔle, na Nana Asa fa kyekyele nguro hemɔ: Geba bɔ ɔwɔ Benyamin, yeɛ Misepa.

english_verse: Abijam did not truly obey the Lord his God as his ancestor David had done. Instead, he was sinful just like his father Rehoboam.
translation_verse: Ye baba Rehoboam bɔ olili ye bia ne, ye bɔne bɔ ɔyɔle ne, ye koso ɔyɔle ye mukoraati bie. Wamvi ye ahone nu wanni nahorɛ wamma AWURADE ye Nyameɛ kyɛbɔ ye nana Dawide de olili nahorɛ ne.

english_verse: David had always obeyed the Lord's commands by doing right, except in the case of Uriah. And since Abijam was David's great-grandson, the Lord kept Jerusalem safe and let Abijam have a son who would be the next king.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ Dawide yɔle bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, na mmerɛ bɔ Dawide te ase ne amukoraa, sɛ ɛfa Hitiniɛ Yuria dwirɛ ne to ahameɛ a, mmeraa biala bɔ AWURADE hyɛle ne, olili so.

english_verse: The war that had broken out between Rehoboam and Jeroboam continued during the time that Abijam was king. Everything else Abijam did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Afei Abiyam nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yuda ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu. Koɛ lale Abiyam ne Yeroboam bosofoɛ b’afia.

english_verse: Abijam died and was buried in Jerusalem, and his son Asa became king. King Asa of Judah (
translation_verse: Abiyam toale ye mbanyi mɔ, na besiele ye wɔ Dawide kuro. Na ɔwa bienzua Asa lili ye bia. Asa di Yuda so hene

english_verse: He placed in the temple all the silver and gold objects that he and his father had dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ye baba aboadeɛ afɔleɛ ne ye bɔbɔ ye aboadeɛ afɔleɛ, bɔ bɛte ɛdwetɛ, esikaa kɔkorɛ ne ngukue nemɔ, ɔfa wale AWURADE awuro. Asa ne Ben Hadade bɛyɛ apam betia Yisrael

english_verse: Asa was always at war with King Baasha of Israel.
translation_verse: Koɛ tɔle Asa ne Yisrael hene Baasa b’afia mmerɛ bɔ bɛte ase amukoraa.

english_verse: Asa obeyed the Lord, as David had done.
translation_verse: Asa yɔle bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ kyɛbɔ ye Nana Dawide yɔle ne ala.

english_verse: Asa became king of Judah in the twentieth year of Jeroboam's rule in Israel,
translation_verse: Nana Yeroboam lili Yisrael bia ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne anu, Asa lili Yuda so hene.

english_verse: He forced the prostitutes at the shrines to leave the country, and he got rid of the idols his ancestors had made.
translation_verse: Asa pɛle asɔneyɛɛ so gyanderafoɛ mmienzua nemɔ asue fili maen ne anu, na mmosoen bɔ ye nana mɔ gyinane ne, ogyili bɛ mukoraa guale.

english_verse: As long as Asa lived, he was completely faithful to the Lord, even though he did not destroy the local shrines.
translation_verse: Nakoso asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ de, wanzɛkye bɛ. Na mmom Asa fili ye ahone nu lili nahorɛ mane AWURADE mmerɛ bɔ né ɔte ngoa nu amukoraa.

english_verse: One time, Baasha invaded Judah and captured the town of Ramah. He started making the town stronger, so he could put troops there to stop people from going in and out of Judah.
translation_verse: Yisrael hene Baasa fale koɛ ɔɔtoale Yuda maen. Ɔtole fasue fale Rama nwo kyɛ ɔngɔma sona biala ngofi Yuda hene Asa berɛ ngofite, yeɛ ɔngɔma ebiala koso ngɔhɔ ye berɛ.

english_verse: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord's temple. He gave it to some of his officials and sent them to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:
translation_verse: Afei ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ amukoraa bɔ né wahã AWURADE awuro fotoɛ ɔne ahemvie fotoɛ ne anu ne, Nana Asa sesale, na ɔfa somane ye somvoɛ mɔ. Ɔmaa bɛɛfa bɛmane Nana Ben Hadade bɔ né ɔte Damasko, bɔ ye baba ole Tabrimon bɔ ye baba ole Sirianiɛ Hesion ne. Asa tole Ben Hadade ngraa kyɛ,

english_verse: “Our fathers signed a peace treaty. Why don't we do the same thing? This silver and gold is a present for you. So, would you please break your treaty with Baasha and force him to leave my country?”
translation_verse: “Maa me ne wɔ yɛyɛ apam, kyɛbɔ me baba ne wɔ baba bɛyɛle apam ne. Mefa ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ akyɛdeɛ mebrɛ wɔ. Yiti kɔ ná kɔpɛ apam bɔ ɛne Yisrael hene Baasa bayɛ ne anu, amaa ɔnate so wayakyi koɛ bɔ ɔfa taataa me ne.”

english_verse: Benhadad did what Asa asked and sent the Syrian army into Israel. They captured the towns of Ijon, Dan, and Abel-Bethmaacah, and the territories of Chinneroth and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Ben Hadade lele Nana Asa dwirɛ ne tole nu, na ɔsomane ye safohene mɔ maa bɛɛho belili Yisrael nguro hemɔ aso ngonim: Yiyon, Dan, Abel Bete Maaka, Kinerote amukoraa, ɔne Nafetali aseɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: When Baasha heard about it, he left Ramah and went back to Tirzah.
translation_verse: Baasa tele bɔ wasi ne pɛ, ɔyakyili etualɛ bɔ watua Rama kuro ne, na ɔɔtenane Tisa.

english_verse: Everything else Asa did while he was king, including his victories and the towns he rebuilt, is written in The History of the Kings of Judah. When he got older, he had a foot disease.
translation_verse: Afei Asa nwo dwirɛ ngaa amukoraa, ngonim bɔ olili wɔ koɛ nu amukoraa, bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, ɔne nguro bɔ ɔkyekyele, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yuda ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu. Nakoso Asa yɛle aworowaa ne, anwonyerɛ bie yɛle ye gya.

english_verse: Nadab son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in Asa's second year as king of Judah, and he ruled two years.
translation_verse: Nana Asa lili Yuda so hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu, Yeroboam awa Nadabo lili Yisrael so hene. Olili Yisrael so hene afoɛ nyɔ.

english_verse: Nadab disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of his father, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Nikyee bɔ ye baba yɔle, ɔne bɔne bɔ ɔyɔle ɔfa hwene Yisrael hɔle bɔne nu ne, ye koso ɔyɔle bie.

english_verse: The Lord's prophet Ahijah had earlier said, “Not one man or boy in Jeroboam's family will be left alive.” And, as soon as Baasha became king, he killed everyone in Jeroboam's family,
translation_verse: Baasa lili bia ne pɛ, ohuhuni Yeroboam abusuafoɛ amukoraa. Wanyakyi Yeroboam abusuaniɛ ko po maa wanya ye ti wannidi nu, kɔpem kyɛ ohuhuni bɛ mukoraa ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔnate ye somvoɛ Silonniɛ Ahiya so hane ne, ɔte ne ala.

english_verse: because Jeroboam had made the Lord God of Israel angry by sinning and causing the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle sɔ, ɔnate Yeroboam bɔne bɔ ɔyɔle, ɔne bɔne bɔ ɔhwene Yisrael hɔle nu, ɔne ɛyaa bɔ owurale AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ apue maa ɔfɛle ne ati.

english_verse: Everything else Nadab did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Afei Nadabo nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yisrael ahemvo bɛ nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: King Asa of Judah and King Baasha of Israel were always at war. King Baasha of Israel
translation_verse: Koɛ tɔle Asa ne Yisrael hene Baasa b’afia mmerɛ bɔ bɛte ase amukoraa. Baasa di Yisrael so hene

english_verse: Baasha son of Ahijah became king of Israel in Asa's third year as king of Judah, and he ruled
translation_verse: Nana Asa lili Yuda so hene ne, ye afoɛ nza ne anu, Ahiya awa Baasa lili Yisrael amukoraa so hene wɔ Tisa. Ɔtenane bia ne aso afoɛ aburanyɔ ne nna.

english_verse: Baasha also disobeyed the Lord by acting like Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Nikyee bɔ Yeroboam yɔle, ɔne bɔne bɔ ɔyɔle ɔfa hwene Yisrael hɔle bɔne nu ne, ye koso ɔyɔle bie.

english_verse: The Lord sent Jehu son of Hanani to say to Baasha:
translation_verse: AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali fale Baasa nwo hyirele Hanani awa Yehu kyɛ,

english_verse: Nobody knew who you were until I, the Lord, chose you to be the leader of my people Israel. And now you're acting exactly like Jeroboam by causing the Israelites to sin. What you've done has made me so angry
translation_verse: “Mmane wɔ so mvili asefuo nu mvale wɔ nduale me maen Yisrael noa. Nakoso ayɔ bɔ Yeroboam yɔle ne bie, na ama me maen Yisrael bayɔ bɔne, ná bafa bɛ bɔne bawura AWURADE apue.

english_verse: that I will destroy you and your family, just as I did the family of Jeroboam.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, wɔ Baasa, ngonua wɔ ne w’abusuafoɛ bɛ boso, na ngɔma bɔ ɔkɔto w’abusuafoɛ ne kɔyɛ kyɛ Nebate awa Yeroboam abusuafoɛ deɛ ne bie.

english_verse: Dogs will eat the bodies of your relatives who die in town, and vultures will eat the bodies of those who die in the country.
translation_verse: Baasa abusuaniɛ biala bɔ okowu wɔ kuro ne, ngyea koli ye naen. Na bɛ nu biala bɔ okowu wɔ eburo ne, ewienu nnomaa kosuso ye naen koli.”

english_verse: Baasha made the Lord very angry, and that's why the Lord gave Jehu this message for Baasha and his family. Baasha constantly disobeyed the Lord by following Jeroboam's sinful example—but even worse, he killed everyone in Jeroboam's family! Everything else Baasha did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. Baasha died and was buried in Tirzah, and his son Elah became king. King Elah of Israel
translation_verse: AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ bɔ ɔfa Baasa ne ye abusuafoɛ nwo ali hyirele ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yehu bɔ ye baba ole Hanani ne. Sɔ dwirɛ ne buale bɛ fɔ ɔnate ɛhemɔ ati: bɔne amukoraa bɔ ɔyɔle ye wɔ AWURADE nyunu, kyɛbɔ Yeroboam ne ye abusua bɛyɔle bɛfa bewurale AWURADE apue maa ɔfɛle yaa ne; yeɛ afei ɔnate kyɛ Baasa nuane Yeroboam abusuafoɛ bɛ bo ne ati. Ela di Yisrael so hene

english_verse: Elah son of Baasha became king of Israel after Asa had been king of Judah for
translation_verse: Nana Asa lili Yuda so hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne nzia ne anu, Baasa awa Ela lili Yisrael so hene wɔ Tisa. Ɔtenane bia ne aso afoɛ nyɔ.

english_verse: Omri did more evil things than any king before him.
translation_verse: Omri yɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Ɔyɔle bɔne trale ahemvo bɔ belili ye nyunu moa ne amukoraati.

english_verse: Zimri commanded half of Elah's chariots, and he made plans to kill Elah. One day, Elah was in Tirzah, getting drunk at the home of Arza, his prime minister,
translation_verse: Nakoso Ela somvoɛ Simri, bɔ ɔte safohene bɔ ɔnea teaseɛnam nemɔ bue so ne, ɔbɔle Ela nwo porɛ. Ɛlɛho bie, né Ela wɔ Tisa, bɔ wano nzaa wabo paa wɔ awuro ɔ. Aasa yeɛ né ɔnea Tisa ahemvie berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: when Zimri went there and killed Elah. So Zimri became king in the twenty-seventh year of Asa's rule in Judah.
translation_verse: Na Simri bɔ wurale berɛ oohuni Ela. Ohuni ye ne, né Yuda hene Asa wali afoɛ aburanyɔ ne nzoo wɔ bia ne aso. Na Simri fale Ela bia ne lili.

english_verse: As soon as Zimri became king, he killed everyone in Baasha's family. Not one man or boy in his family was left alive—even his close friends were killed.
translation_verse: Simri fale bia ne lili pɛ, ohuhuni Baasa abusuafoɛ amukoraati. Wanyakyi Baasa abusuaniɛ bienzua anaa ye damvo ko po maa wanya ye ti wannidi nu.

english_verse: Baasha's family was completely wiped out, just as the Lord's prophet Jehu had warned.
translation_verse: Yiti Simri nuane Baasa abusuafoɛ amukoraa bɛ bo, kyɛbɔ AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔnate ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yehu so hã fa buale Baasa fɔ ne, ɔte ne ala.

english_verse: Everything else Elah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Zimri of Israel
translation_verse: Afei Ela nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yisrael ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu. Simri di Yisrael so hene

english_verse: Zimri became king of Israel in Asa's twenty-seventh year as king of Judah, but he ruled only seven days from Tirzah. Israel's army was camped near Gibbethon in Philistia under the command of Omri. The soldiers heard that Zimri had killed Elah, and they made Omri their king that same day.
translation_verse: Na koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ batua kuro ne, bɛtele kyɛ, “Simri ayɛ lɔen, na wahũ Nana Ela.” Yiti sɔ kyẽa ne, Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɛbɔle safohene Omri Yisrael so hene wɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu.

english_verse: At once, Omri and his army marched to Tirzah and attacked.
translation_verse: Omri ne Yisrael koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraa befili Gibeton beetuale Tisa.

english_verse: When Zimri saw that the town was captured, he ran into the strongest part of the palace and killed himself by setting it on fire.
translation_verse: Simri nwuni kyɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ bali kuro ne aso ngonim ne, oowurale ahemvie berɛ abandenden ne anu. Ɔtole ahemvie ne anu see maa ɔyerale ahemvie ne ne ye bɔbɔ maa owuli.

english_verse: Zimri had disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Ɛhe sili, ofikyɛ ɔyɔle bɔne. Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Ɔyɔle bɔne bɔ Yeroboam yɔle ne bie, na bɔne bɔ ɔyɔle ne, ɔfa ɔhwene Yisrael hɔle bɔne nu.

english_verse: Everything else Zimri did while he was king, including his rebellion against Elah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Omri of Israel
translation_verse: Afei Simri nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ɛlɔen bɔ ɔyɛle ne, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yisrael ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu. Omri di Yisrael so hene

english_verse: After Zimri died, some of the Israelites wanted Tibni son of Ginath to be king, but others wanted Omri.
translation_verse: Yisrael maen ne anu hyɛle nyɔ: bɛ bue lili Gyinate awa Tibini si, na besili ye hene, yeɛ bɛ bue koso belili Omri si.

english_verse: in the thirty-first year of Asa's rule in Judah. Omri ruled Israel for twelve years. The first six years he ruled from Tirzah,
translation_verse: Nana Asa lili Yuda so hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburasa ne ko ne anu, Omri lili Yisrael so hene. Ɔtenane bia ne aso afoɛ buru ne nyɔ; afoɛ nzia bɔ oli moa ne, né ɔte Tisa. Yisrael kyekye ahenguro foforɛ wɔ Samaria

english_verse: He acted just like Jeroboam and made the Lord God of Israel angry by causing the Israelites to sin and to worship idols.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔyɔle bɔne bɔ Nebate awa Yeroboam yɔle ne amukoraa bie. Bɔne bɔ ɔnate so ɔfa hwene Yisrael maen maa bɛyɔle bɔne, bɔ bɛfale bɛ mmosoensolɛ bewurale AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ apue maa ɔfɛle yaa ne, Omri yɔle bie.

english_verse: Everything else Omri did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Afei Omri nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, nningyein bɔ ɔyɔle, ɔne ngonim bɔ olili ye wɔ koɛ nu, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yisrael ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: Omri died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Ahab became king. King Ahab of Israel
translation_verse: Omri toale ye mbanyi mɔ, besiele ye wɔ Samaria, na ɔwa bienzua Ahabo lili ye bia. Ahabo di Yisrael so hene

english_verse: Ahab son of Omri became king of Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Asa's rule in Judah, and he ruled
translation_verse: Nana Asa lili Yuda so hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburasa ne mmɔtwɛ ne anu, Omri awa Ahabo lili Yisrael so hene. Omri awa Ahabo lili Yisrael so hene wɔ Samaria afoɛ aburanyɔ ne nyɔ.

english_verse: Ahab did more things to disobey the Lord than any king before him.
translation_verse: Omri awa Ahabo yɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, trale ahemvo bɔ belili ye nyunu moa ne amukoraa. Ahabo gya Yesebɛl

english_verse: He acted just like Jeroboam. Even worse, he married Jezebel the daughter of King Ethbaal of Sidon and started worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: Nebate awa Yeroboam bɔne bɔ Ahabo yɔle bie ne, sɔ bɔne ne po saa né ɔte kãa: Ahabo oogyale Sidonfoɛ hene Etebaal ɔwa brasua Yesebɛl, na ɔsole bosoen Baal sɔnene ye.

english_verse: Ahab built an altar and temple for Baal in Samaria
translation_verse: Osili afɔleɛ bokyea mane Baal wɔ Baal awuro bɔ osili ye wɔ Samaria ne anu.

english_verse: and set up a sacred pole for worshiping the goddess Asherah. Ahab did more to make the Lord God of Israel angry than any king of Israel before him.
translation_verse: Ahabo sa yɔle bosoen Asera dosii fa penane berɛ. Ahabo yɔle bɔne somaa trale Yisrael ahemvo amukoraa bɔ belili ye nyunu moa ne, na ɔfa wurale AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ apue maa ɔfɛle yaa.

english_verse: While Ahab was king, a man from Bethel named Hiel rebuilt the town of Jericho. But while Hiel was laying the foundation for the town wall, his oldest son Abiram died. And while he was finishing the gates, his youngest son Segub died. This happened just as the Lord had told Joshua to say many years ago.
translation_verse: Ahabo mmerɛ so yeɛ Hiɛl bɔ ofi Betel ne osa kyekyele Yeriko ɔ. Na kyɛbɔ AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔnate Nun awa Yosua so hane ne ɔte ne, Hiɛl ɔ́to kuro ne fapem ne, ye bamuɛbaa bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Abiram fili ye sa, yeɛ ótuatua ye pambim nemɔ ne, ye kasiɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Segubo koso fili ye sa.

english_verse: Elijah was a prophet from Tishbe in Gilead. One day he went to King Ahab and said, “I'm a servant of the living Lord, the God of Israel. And I swear in his name that it won't rain until I say so. There won't even be any dew on the ground.”
translation_verse: Tisibeniɛ Elia bɔ ofi Tisibe bɔ ɔwɔ Gileade ne, osele Ahabo kyɛ, “AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ teasefoɛ bɔ yeɛ ngyi ye nyunu ne, kyɛbɔ ɔte ase ye de, mekã kyɛ, bosue anaa esue ngɔpe ase afoɛ ye mɔ anu, sana mafa me noa dwirɛ mama ye nwo ate koraka.”

english_verse: Later, the Lord said to Elijah,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Elia kyɛ,

english_verse: “Leave and go across the Jordan River so you can hide near Cherith Creek.
translation_verse: “Fi wa fa wɔ nye kyire eyia afiteleɛ, na Kereti bɔnza bɔ ɔwɔ asue Yɔɔdan eyia afiteleɛ so ne, kɔfea berɛ.

english_verse: You can drink water from the creek, and eat the food I've told the ravens to bring you.”
translation_verse: No bɔnza ne anu nzue ne bie, na mahyɛ adene nemɔ kyɛ bɛbrɛ wɔ aleɛ.”

english_verse: Ravens brought him bread and meat twice a day, and he drank water from the creek.
translation_verse: Na adene nemɔ brɛle ye aleɛ ne naen daa ngyerɛmɔ biala ne nɔsoa biala, na bɔnza ne anu yeɛ né onya nzue no ɔ.

english_verse: But after a while, it dried up because there was no rain. Elijah Helps a Widow in Zarephath
translation_verse: Nakoso mmerɛ kãa pɛle nu ne, bɔnza ne anu nzue ne wewele, ofikyɛ né esue ndɔ wɔ maen ne anu. Sarefate braa kunaniɛ ne

english_verse: The Lord told Elijah,
translation_verse: AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Elia kyɛ,

english_verse: “Go to the town of Zarephath in Sidon and live there. I've told a widow in that town to give you food.”
translation_verse: “Kɔ Sarefate bɔ ɔwɔ Sidon mbɔtam nu ne kekesaala ye kɔtena dɔ; ofikyɛ mafa ahyɛdeɛ mama braa bie wɔ dɔ kyɛ ɔma wɔ aleɛ.”

english_verse: When Elijah came near the town gate of Zarephath, he saw a widow gathering sticks for a fire. “Would you please bring me a cup of water?” he asked.
translation_verse: Yiti Elia sili nu hɔle Sarefate. Oodwuli kuro berɛ pambim ne anwo ne, né braa kunaniɛ bie obubu eyein wɔ berɛ. Ɔfrɛle braa ne, na osele braa ne kyɛ, “Mesrɛ wɔ, fa kwangoa sa nzue kãa brɛ me maa nno.”

english_verse: As she left to get it, he asked, “Would you also please bring me a piece of bread?”
translation_verse: Braa ne sili nu bɔ ɔkwaasa nzue ne pɛ, Elia frɛle ye, na osele kyɛ, “Fa aleɛ kãa boka so brɛ me.”

english_verse: The widow answered, “In the name of the living Lord your God, I swear that I don't have any bread. All I have is a handful of flour and a little olive oil. I'm on my way home now with these few sticks to cook what I have for my son and me. After that, we will starve to death.”
translation_verse: Nakoso braa ne buale kyɛ, “Kyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ te ase ye, nnne aleɛ biala wɔ berɛ, sana esam me sa bum ko bɔ ɔwɔ kukue nu, yeɛ ngoo kaaba bie bɔ ɔwɔ towaa nu ɔ. Mebaapena eyein kãa mefa mekɔ awuro mekɔyɛ aleɛ maa me ne mma yɛdi. Sɛ yɛdi yɛyie a, ɛhɔen yeɛ okohu yɛ maa yɛkowu ɔ.”

english_verse: Elijah said, “Everything will be fine. Do what you said. Go home and fix something for you and your son. But first, please make a small piece of bread and bring it to me.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Elia sele braa ne kyɛ, “Nnɛsuro, wɔ de kɔyɔ kyɛbɔ ahã ne ala, nakoso di moa fa esam ne bie yɔ taterɛ kãa brɛ me, na afei ayɔ bie ɛne ɛwa ne bali.

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel has promised that your jar of flour won't run out and your bottle of oil won't dry up before he sends rain for the crops.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa: Kukue ne anu esam ne, ye bo ngotu, yeɛ towaa ne anu ngoo ne, so ngɔte, kɔpem kyẽa bɔ AWURADE kɔma esue kɔtɔ kogua aseɛ so ɔ.”

english_verse: The widow went home and did exactly what Elijah had told her. She and Elijah and her family had enough food for a long time.
translation_verse: Ɔɔyɔle kyɛbɔ Elia hane ne ala. Na braa ne, ɔne Elia, ɔne braa ne awuro ama benyane aleɛ belili ngyẽa pee.

english_verse: The Lord kept the promise that his prophet Elijah had made, and she did not run out of flour or oil. Elijah Brings a Boy Back to Life
translation_verse: Kukue ne anu mɔle ne bo andu, yeɛ towaa ne anu ngoo ne aso ande, kyɛbɔ AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔnate Elia so hane ne, ɔte ne ala. Elia tingye kunaniɛ ne awa ne fi ewue nu

english_verse: Several days later, the son of the woman who owned the house got sick, and he kept getting worse, until finally he died.
translation_verse: Ɛhe asi ne, braa ne bɔ ɔte awuro ne mene ne, ɔwa bienzua ne fokyɛle. Anwonyerɛ ne anu yɛle se paa kɔpem kyɛ akwadaa ne wuli ɔ.

english_verse: The woman shouted at Elijah, “What have I done to you? I thought you were God's prophet. Did you come here to cause the death of my son as a reminder that I've sinned against God?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ braa ne sele Elia kyɛ, “Nyameɛ sona, nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ afa ali me ye? Ɛwale wa kyɛ ɛbaakaye me me bɔne, ná ɛma mma ne wu anaa?”

english_verse: “Bring me your son,” Elijah said. Then he took the boy from her arms and carried him upstairs to the room where he was staying. Elijah laid the boy on his bed
translation_verse: Nakoso Elia sele braa ne kyɛ, “Fa ɛwa ne ma me.” Elia lele ye fili braa ne asa nu, na ɔfale ye fo hɔle aborɔsaen ne aso nekaa bɔ oosikyele ne, na ɔfale ye tole ye Elia ye bɔbɔ ye bɛen so.

english_verse: and prayed, “Lord God, why did you do such a terrible thing to this woman? She's letting me stay here, and now you've let her son die.”
translation_verse: Elia teane nu hã hyirele AWURADE kyɛ, “O AWURADE me Nyameɛ, braa bɔ maasikye ye ye, amaa asane ato ye, ɔnate kyɛ ahu ɔwa ye.”

english_verse: Elijah stretched himself out over the boy three times, while praying, “Lord God, bring this boy back to life!”
translation_verse: Na ɔtengyɛle ye nu butuli akwadaa ne aso pɛen nza, na ɔteane nu hã hyirele AWURADE kyɛ, “O AWURADE me Nyameɛ, ma akwadaa ye osa onya ngoa bieku.”

english_verse: The Lord answered Elijah's prayer, and the boy started breathing again.
translation_verse: AWURADE tiele Elia dwirɛ ne. Ngoa sa wale akwadaa ne anu, na ye nye so tetele ye.

english_verse: Elijah picked him up and carried him downstairs. He gave the boy to his mother and said, “Look, your son is alive.”
translation_verse: Elia pagyale akwadaa ne fili aborɔsaen ne aso pumbu ne anu dɔ odwu wale ase. Ɔfale akwadaa ne mane oni, na Elia hane kyɛ, “Nea, ɛwa ne anya ngoa.”

english_verse: “You are God's prophet!” the woman replied. “Now I know that you really do speak for the Lord.”
translation_verse: Yiti braa ne sele Elia kyɛ, “Afei de manwu kyɛ ɛte Nyameɛ sona, na amba AWURADE dwirɛ yeɛ otua wɔ noa ɔ.”

english_verse: For three years no rain fell in Samaria, and there was almost nothing to eat anywhere. The Lord said to Elijah, “Go and meet with King Ahab. I will soon make it rain.” So Elijah went to see Ahab.
translation_verse: Yiti Elia sili nu hɔle kyɛ ɔkwaafa ye nwo kyire Ahabo. Né ɛhɔen ne noa yɛ se paa wɔ Samaria.

english_verse: At that time Obadiah was in charge of Ahab's palace, but he faithfully worshiped the Lord. In fact, when Jezebel was trying to kill the Lord's prophets, Obadiah hid
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Yesebɛl okũkũ AWURADE ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ ne, Obadia fale ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ɛyaa ko, ɔhyɛle bɛ nu aburannu aburannu, ɔfale bɛ ɔɔfeale nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua ɔ nu, na né ɔma bɛ aleɛ ne nzue.)

english_verse: and said, “We have to find something for our horses and mules to eat. If we don't, we will have to kill them. Let's look around every creek and spring in the country for some grass.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Ahabo sele Obadia kyɛ, “Kyini aseɛ ye aso mbombonzue ne bɔnza amukoraati nu. Ebiaa yɛkonya ɛserɛ yɛkɔma mbɔngɔ ne afunum nemɔ bekoli bekonya ngoa, amaa ngaka nemɔ anu bie wanwu.”

english_verse: You go one way, and I'll go the other.” Then they left in separate directions.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛhyɛle maen ne anu nyɔ kyɛ bɛkwaahyini so: Ahabo hɔle bue ko yeɛ Obadia koso hɔle bue ko.

english_verse: As Obadiah was walking along, he met Elijah. Obadiah recognized him, bowed down, and asked, “Elijah, is it really you?”
translation_verse: Obadia nate atee so bɔ ɔkɔ ne, Elia yiale ye. Obadia nwuni kyɛ Elia ɔ. Obadia kotole fale ye nyunu butuli ase mane ye, na osele ye kyɛ, “Me mene Elia, wɔ ɛhe?”

english_verse: Obadiah replied: King Ahab would kill me if I told him that. And I haven't even done anything wrong.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Obadia bisale kyɛ, “Bɔne beni yeɛ mayɔ ɔ, bɔ ɛfa w’akoaa wura Ahabo sa maa oku me ye?

english_verse: I swear to you in the name of the living Lord your God that the king has looked everywhere for you. He sent people to look in every country, and when they couldn't find you, he made the leader of each country swear that you were not in that country.
translation_verse: Kyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ te ase ye, maen biala anaa ahennie biala nne berɛ bɔ yeɛ me mene Ahabo, ɔssomane maa bɛhhɔle so bɛɛpenane wɔ ɔ. Na sɛ berɛ ama kã kyɛ, ‘Ɔnne wa’ a, ɔmaa sɔ maen ne anaa ahennie ne ta ndaen kyɛ bennwuni wɔ.

english_verse: Do you really want me to tell him you're here?
translation_verse: Nakoso kekesaala ye ɛnwa, ‘Kɔhã kyire wɔ mene kyɛ, ‘Manwu Elia.’

english_verse: What if the Lord's Spirit takes you away as soon as I leave? When Ahab comes to get you, he won't find you. Then he will surely kill me. I have worshiped the Lord since I was a boy.
translation_verse: Sɛ menya mefi wɔ nwo wa mekɔ pɛ, AWURADE Sunzum kɔfa wɔ kɔhɔ nekaa bie bɔ menze ɔ. Na sɛ mekã mekyire Ahabo maa ɔba, ná sɛ wannwu wɔ a, okohu me, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ w’akoaa, ofi me ngwadaa nu yeɛ masuro AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: Elijah said, “I'm a servant of the living Lord All-Powerful, and I swear in his name that I will meet with Ahab today.”
translation_verse: Elia buale kyɛ, “Asafo AWURADE bɔ yeɛ ngyi ye nyunu ne, kyɛbɔ ɔte ase ye de, kyɛ ɔkɔyɛ biala ɛnɛ ngɔfa me nwo ngoohyire Ahabo.”

english_verse: Obadiah left and told Ahab where to find Elijah. Ahab went to meet Elijah,
translation_verse: Yiti Obadia ɔɔpenane Ahabo ɔbɔle ye amaneɛ, na Ahabo sili nu kyɛ ɔkwaayia Elia.

english_verse: and when he saw him, Ahab shouted, “There you are, the biggest troublemaker in Israel!”
translation_verse: Ahabo nwuni Elia ne, osele Elia kyɛ, “Nna wɔ ɛhe, wɔ bɔ ɛmma Yisrael nwo ndɔ ye ɔ!”

english_verse: Elijah answered: You're the troublemaker—not me! You and your family have disobeyed the Lord's commands by worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: Elia buale kyɛ, “Nnhale Yisrael biala, na mmom wɔ ɛne wɔ baba abusuafoɛ yeɛ ɛmɔahã Yisrael ɔ. Ofikyɛ ɛmɔabu AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ so, na ɛmɔaasɔne mmosoen Baal mɔ.

english_verse: Ahab got everyone together, then they went to meet Elijah on Mount Carmel.
translation_verse: Ahabo somane mmenia maa bɛhɔle Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa berɛ, na ɔmane ahɔmeɛ nemɔ beeyiale wɔ Kamɛl bokaa so.

english_verse: Elijah stood in front of them and said, “How much longer will you try to have things both ways? If the Lord is God, worship him! But if Baal is God, worship him!” The people did not say a word.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Elia wale mmenia ne amukoraa nwo berɛ, na obisale kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ adwene kɔyɛ ndaa ndaa maa okoodwu kyinzu? Sɛ AWURADE yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ a, ye de ɛmɔso ye. Nakoso sɛ Baal ahɔ de a, ye de ye yeɛ ɛmɔso ye ɔ.” Na maen ne amma ye mmuayɛɛ.

english_verse: Then Elijah continued: I am the Lord's only prophet, but Baal has
translation_verse: Yeɛ Elia sele maen ne kyɛ, “AWURADE ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne, me ngome twe yeɛ mahã ɔ; nakoso Baal ahɔmeɛ nemɔ de, bɛte ɛyaa nna aburannu.

english_verse: Bring us two bulls. Baal's prophets can take one of them, kill it, and cut it into pieces. Then they can put the meat on the wood without lighting the fire. I will do the same thing with the other bull, and I won't light a fire under it either.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma yɛ nandwie nyii nyɔ: ɛ́mɔma ahɔmeɛ nemɔ bɛye nu ko, ná bɛpepɛ ye ahuronzi ahuronzi begua eyein ne aso. Nakoso nnɛmaa bɛfa see bɛsɔ nu. Nandwie nyii ko bɔ waha ne, me koso ngɔpepɛ nu ahuronzi ahuronzi ngogua eyein ne aso, nakoso mengɔfa see mengɔsɔ nu.

english_verse: The prophets of Baal will pray to their god, and I will pray to the Lord. The one who answers by starting the fire is God. “That's a good idea,” everyone agreed.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔsu bɛ́frɛ ɛmɔ nyameɛ ne, na me koso ngosu ngɔfrɛ AWURADE. Bɛ nu horɛ bɔ ɔkɔmaa see kɔyera afɔleɛ ne nen, ye yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ amba ɔ.” Na maen ne amukoraa hane kyɛ, “Yɛde yɛto nu.”

english_verse: Elijah said to Baal's prophets, “There are more of you, so you go first. Pick out a bull and get it ready, but don't light the fire. Then pray to your god.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Elia sele Baal ahɔmeɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔsone ne ati, ɛ́mɔli moa bɛnea nu bɛye nandwie nyii ko bɛpepɛ ye ahuronzi ahuronzi. Afei ɛmɔsu bɛfrɛ ɛmɔ nyameɛ ne, nakoso nnɛma ɛmɔfa see bɛsɔ afɔleɛ ne anu.”

english_verse: They chose their bull, then they got it ready and prayed to Baal all morning, asking him to start the fire. They danced around the altar and shouted, “Answer us, Baal!” But there was no answer.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛyele nandwie nyii ne ko, behuni ye bɛpepɛle nu ahuronzi ahuronzi, na besu bɛfrɛle Baal fi ngyerɛmɔ maa oodwuli eyiagyina. Bɛteateane nu kyɛ, “O Baal, tie yɛ e!” Nakoso ebiala andɛ bɛ so, bannya mmuayɛɛ biala. Na afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ basi ne, behuruhuru bego bɛfale ye nwo.

english_verse: At noon, Elijah began making fun of them. “Pray louder!” he said. “Baal must be a god. Maybe he's daydreaming or using the toilet or traveling somewhere. Or maybe he's asleep, and you have to wake him up.”
translation_verse: Odwuli eyiagyina ne, Elia hane bɛ ayinga kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtea nu serɛ! Ɔte nyameɛ. Bekye ɔdwene nikyee bie anwo, anaakyɛ ebiaa wahɔ bondua anaa wahɔ atee, anaakyɛ walafe bɔ odi kyɛ betingye ye ɔ.”

english_verse: The prophets kept shouting louder and louder, and they cut themselves with swords and knives until they were bleeding. This was the way they worshiped,
translation_verse: Bɛteateane nu serɛserɛ, na kyɛbɔ né bɛsɔne bɛ nyameɛ a bɛyɔ ne, bɛfale ngrandɛ ne pealɛɛ bɛpepɛle bɛ nwonaen kɔpem kyɛ mogya guale bɛ takaa ɔ.

english_verse: and they kept it up until time for the evening sacrifice. But there was no answer of any kind.
translation_verse: Eyiagyina pɛle nu ne, bɛhɔle so belili ahɔen alaa kɔpem kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛbɔ aburoo afɔleɛ ne dwuli ɔ. Nakoso ebiala andɛ bɛ so, bannya mmuayɛɛ biala, yeɛ ebiala anye bɛ noa.

english_verse: Then he used twelve stones to build an altar in honor of the Lord. Each stone stood for one of the tribes of Israel, which was the name the Lord had given to their ancestor Jacob. Elijah dug a ditch around the altar, large enough to hold about
translation_verse: Ɔfale nyɔboɛ nemɔ sili afɔleɛ bokyea wɔ AWURADE dumaa nu. Yeɛ ɔpɛle ɛkã fale afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo bra yiale. Ɛka ne, ye piri kora fa aburoo kɔyɛ olonka nza.

english_verse: He placed the wood on the altar, then they cut the bull into pieces and laid the meat on the wood. He told the people, “Fill four large jars with water and pour it over the meat and the wood.” After they did this,
translation_verse: Afei ɔhyehyɛle eyein ne guale afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso, ɔpepɛle nandwie nyii ne anu ahuronzi ahuronzi fa guale eyein ne aso. Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔsa nzue bua nna behwie begua naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne ɔne eyein ne aso.”

english_verse: until finally, the water ran down the altar and filled the ditch.
translation_verse: maa ɔnate so nzue ne bu fale afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo amukoraa yili kumaa ne.

english_verse: When it was time for the evening sacrifice, Elijah prayed: Our Lord, you are the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel. Now, prove that you are the God of this nation, and that I, your servant, have done this at your command.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ aburoo afɔleɛ ne dwuli ne, ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Elia pingyele berɛ, na osele kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE, Abraham, Yisake ne Yisrael Nyameɛ, ɛnɛ maa benwu ye kyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte Nyameɛ wɔ Yisrael ɔ, na nde wɔ somvoɛ, na wɔ noa dwirɛ so yeɛ ngyi bɔ mayɔ ɛhe amukoraati ye.

english_verse: Please answer me, so these people will know that you are the Lord God, and that you will turn their hearts back to you.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, tie me, amaa ɔnate so maen he anwu kyɛ, ao AWURADE, ɛte Nyameɛ, na wɔ yeɛ ɛma b’adwene kakyi ba wɔ berɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord immediately sent fire, and it burned up the sacrifice, the wood, and the stones. It scorched the ground everywhere around the altar and dried up every drop of water in the ditch.
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE see ne fili anwuro ɔɔyerale naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, eyein ne, nyɔboɛ nemɔ ne berɛ nnɛterɛ ne, na ɔwewele nzue bɔ ogyi ɛkã ne anu ne.

english_verse: When the crowd saw what had happened, they all bowed down and shouted, “The Lord is God! The Lord is God!”
translation_verse: Mmenia ne amukoraa benwuni ye ne, bɛfale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli ase, na besele kyɛ, “AWURADE te Nyameɛ amba; AWURADE te Nyameɛ amba.”

english_verse: Just then, Elijah said, “Grab the prophets of Baal! Don't let any of them get away.” So the people captured the prophets and took them to Kishon River, where Elijah killed every one of them. It Starts To Rain
translation_verse: Elia sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔhye Baal ahɔmeɛ nemɔ. Nnɛmɔma bɛ nu ko po nwati.” Yeɛ bɛhyele bɛ, na Elia fale bɛ wale Kison bɔnza ne anwo oohuhuni bɛ wɔ berɛ. Esue sa tɔ wɔ Yisrael

english_verse: Elijah told Ahab, “Get something to eat and drink. I hear a heavy rain coming.”
translation_verse: Afei Elia sele Ahabo kyɛ, “Kɔ didi na no nzue, ofikyɛ mete esue kandinga bɔ ɔbaatɔ ɔ nga.”

english_verse: Ahab left, but Elijah climbed back to the top of Mount Carmel. Then he stooped down with his face almost to the ground
translation_verse: Yiti Ahabo hɔle oodidili na ɔnone nzue. Nakoso Elia de, ɔfo hɔle Kamɛl bokaa ne ti afia. Berɛ, Elia bɔle ye nu ase, na ɔfale ye ti wurale ye sɔ nu.

english_verse: and said to his servant, “Look toward the sea.” The servant left. And when he came back, he said, “I looked, but I didn't see anything.” Elijah told him to look seven more times.
translation_verse: Osele ye somvoɛ ne kyɛ, “Kɔ ná kɔto wɔ nye nea ɛpo ne aso dɔ.” Ɔɔtole ye nye neane na ɔhane kyɛ, “Mennwu hwee.” Yeɛ Elia nwa, “Sa kɔ sɔ alaa pɛen nzoo.”

english_verse: After the seventh time the servant replied, “I see a small cloud coming this way. But it's no bigger than a fist.” Elijah told him, “Tell Ahab to get his chariot ready and start home now. Otherwise, the rain will stop him.”
translation_verse: Ye pɛen nzoo ne aso, somvoɛ ne hane kyɛ, “Menwu munungum bie bɔ ye piri te kyɛ bɛ sa bondohuma kyɛ ofi ɛpo ne anu ofite ba ɔ.” Yeɛ Elia hane kyɛ, “Kɔhã kyire Ahabo kyɛ, ‘Fo wɔ teaseɛnam torotoro kɔ, ná esue ne anzi wɔ ate.’ ”

english_verse: A few minutes later, it got very cloudy and windy, and rain started pouring down. So Elijah wrapped his coat around himself, and the Lord gave him strength to run all the way to Jezreel. Ahab followed in his chariot.
translation_verse: Nakoso né AWURADE tumi gyi Elia si. Elia bɔle ye abɔsoɛ tuli amirika lili Ahabo teaseɛnam ne anyunu alaa oodwuli Yesreel.

english_verse: Ahab told his wife Jezebel what Elijah had done and that he had killed the prophets.
translation_verse: Bɔ Elia yɔle ne amukoraa, ɔne kyɛbɔ ole ngrandɛ huhuni Baal ahɔmeɛ nemɔ amukoraa ne, Ahabo bɔle Yesebɛl amaneɛ.

english_verse: She sent a message to Elijah: “You killed my prophets. Now I'm going to kill you! I pray that the gods will punish me even more severely if I don't do it by this time tomorrow.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesebɛl tuli ɛbɔfoɛ maa oosele Elia kyɛ, “Kyɛ odwu ɛhema bekye sɔa, sɛ mangu wɔ kyɛ mmenia bɔ ahũhũ bɛ ne anu ko a, me koso mmosoen nemɔ behũ me bie.”

english_verse: Elijah was afraid when he got her message, and he ran to the town of Beersheba in Judah. He left his servant there,
translation_verse: Né Elia suro, yiti ɔnwatili maa ɔnate so onyane ye ti didili nu. Oodwuli Yuda kuro Beɛ Hyeba, na ɔyakyili ye somvoɛ ne berɛ.

english_verse: then walked another whole day into the desert. Finally, he came to a large bush and sat down in its shade. He begged the Lord, “I've had enough. Just let me die! I'm no better off than my ancestors.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Elia bɔbɔ de, ɔpɛle atee bɔ bɛfa ɛlɛho yeɛ bɛpɛ ɔ hɔle ɛserɛ so, na ɔɔtenane tanure bie abo. Ɔyɛle ye adwene kyɛ owuli po ahaa okuro. Ɔhane kyɛ, “Afei de wayɛ yé, ao AWURADE, ku me pɛen ko, na nnde paa mendra me nana mɔ.”

english_verse: Then he lay down in the shade and fell asleep. Suddenly an angel woke him up and said, “Get up and eat.”
translation_verse: Elia lale tanure ne abo berɛ na ɔfale nu lafele. Mvum nu, abɔfo bie fale ye sa hane ye, na osele ye kyɛ, “Dwɔso ná didi.”

english_verse: Elijah looked around, and by his head was a jar of water and some baked bread. He sat up, ate and drank, then lay down and went back to sleep.
translation_verse: Elia pagyale ye ti, na onwuni apiti bɔ bato ye nyɔboɛ hyerɛhyerɛ so ɔ, ɔne nzue bua ko kyɛ begyi nekaa bɔ ye ti la ne ɔ. Odidili none nzue, na osa fale nu lafele.

english_verse: So Elijah sat up and ate and drank. The food and water made him strong enough to walk
translation_verse: Elia dwɔsole, odidili none nzue, na anwoserɛ bɔ onyane wɔ aleɛ ne anu ne, ɔfa natele eyia ne kɔngɔen sɔ alaa eleburanna, hɔle Nyameɛ bokaa Horebo so.

english_verse: and he spent the night there in a cave. The Lord Appears to Elijah While Elijah was on Mount Sinai, the Lord asked, “Elijah, why are you here?”
translation_verse: Oodwuli nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua bie anu wɔ berɛ, na ɔlale berɛ sɔ kɔngɔen ne. Yeɛ AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Elia, na obisale ye kyɛ, “Elia, w’amaneɛ wɔ wa?”

english_verse: He answered, “Lord God All-Powerful, I've always done my best to obey you. But your people have broken their solemn promise to you. They have torn down your altars and killed all your prophets, except me. And now they are even trying to kill me!”
translation_verse: Obuale kyɛ, “Matu me nwo masie berɛ kyɛ meko mema AWURADE Asafo Nyameɛ, ofikyɛ Yisraelfoɛ bahwi bafa w’apam ne aso, badwiri w’afɔleɛ bokyea mɔ bagua ase, yeɛ bele ngrandɛ bahũhũ wɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ mɔ. Waha me ngome twe, na bɛpena me beku me.” Elia yia Nyameɛ wɔ Horebo bokaa so

english_verse: “Go out and stand on the mountain,” the Lord replied. “I want you to be there when I pass by.” All at once, a strong wind shook the mountain and shattered the rocks. But the Lord was not in the wind. Next, there was an earthquake, but the Lord was not in the earthquake.
translation_verse: Afei osele Elia kyɛ, “Kɔ bokaa ne aso kogyina AWURADE nyunu, ofikyɛ AWURADE baapɛ nu.” Afei mvrama kandinga bie tuli. Né mvrama ne noa yɛ se paa, yiti odwudwale mmokaa ne nyɔbotaen mɔ nu wɔ AWURADE nyunu, nakoso né AWURADE ɔnne mvrama ne anu. Mvrama ne asi ne, aseɛ wosole, nakoso né AWURADE ɔnne aseɛwosolɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Then there was a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire. Finally, there was a gentle breeze,
translation_verse: Aseɛwosolɛ ne asi ne, Elia nwuni see, nakoso né AWURADE ɔnne see ne anu. See ne asi, ɔtele komviɛ kaaba bɛtɛɛ bie.

english_verse: and when Elijah heard it, he covered his face with his coat. He went out and stood at the entrance to the cave. A voice asked, “Elijah, why are you here?”
translation_verse: Elia tele komviɛ ne nen, ɔfale ye ataadeɛ aguasoɛ kyekyele ye nyunu, na ofitele oogyinane nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua ne anoa. Berɛ, komviɛ bie bisale ye kyɛ, “Elia, w’amaneɛ wɔ wa?”

english_verse: Elijah answered, “Lord God All-Powerful, I've always done my best to obey you. But your people have broken their solemn promise to you. They have torn down your altars and killed all your prophets, except me. And now they are even trying to kill me!”
translation_verse: Obuale kyɛ, “Matu me nwo masie berɛ kyɛ meko mema AWURADE Asafo Nyameɛ, ofikyɛ Yisraelfoɛ bahwi bafa w’apam ne aso, badwiri w’afɔleɛ bokyea mɔ bagua ase, yeɛ bele ngrandɛ bahũhũ wɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ mɔ. Waha me ngome twe, na bɛpena me beku me.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Elijah, you can go back to the desert near Damascus. And when you get there, appoint Hazael to be king of Syria.
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE sele ye kyɛ, “Sa wɔ si kɔ Damasko ɛserɛ ne aso. Sɛ edwu a, popa Hasael ngoo fa ye si Siria so hene.

english_verse: Then appoint Jehu son of Nimshi to be king of Israel, and Elisha son of Shaphat to take your place as my prophet.
translation_verse: Afei koso, popa Nimisi awa Yehu ngoo fa ye si Yisrael so hene, ná Elisa bɔ ye baba ole Safate bɔ ofi Abel Mehola ne, popa ye ngoo ma osi wɔ gya nu ɔyɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ.

english_verse: Hazael will start killing the people who worship Baal. Jehu will kill those who escape from Hazael, and Elisha will kill those who escape from Jehu.
translation_verse: Sona biala bɔ Hasael wannya ye wangu ye ne, odi kyɛ Yehu ku ye. Na sona biala bɔ Yehu wannya ye wangu ye ne, odi kyɛ Elisa ku ye.

english_verse: Elijah left and found Elisha plowing a field with a pair of oxen. There were eleven other men in front of him, and each one was also plowing with a pair of oxen. Elijah went over and put his own coat on Elisha.
translation_verse: Yiti Elia sili nu fili berɛ, na onwuni Safate awa Elisa kyɛ ofundam aseɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛyɔ eboo ɔ. Né nandwie nyɔ nyɔ bɔ kɔnnua sosɔ bɛ ɔ sɔ alaa buru ne nyɔ beli Elisa nyunu. Né Elisa ɔfa kure bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nyɔ ne ofundam aseɛ ne. Elia ɔɔfale ye nwo berɛ, na Elia tole ye ataadeɛ aguasoɛ ne guale ye so.

english_verse: Elisha stopped plowing and ran after him. “Let me kiss my parents goodbye, then I'll go with you,” he said. “You can go,” Elijah said. “But remember what I've done for you.”
translation_verse: Elisa yakyili nandwie nemɔ berɛ, otuli amirika lili Elia si, na Elisa sele kyɛ, “Maa ngɔngra me baba ne me maame, ná afei mmani wɔ si.” Yeɛ Elia buale ye kyɛ, “Sá wɔ si kɔ, nnyɔle hwee mva nnzili wɔ ate.”

english_verse: Elisha left and took his oxen with him. He killed them and boiled them over a fire he had made with the wood from his plow. He gave the meat to the people who were with him, and they ate it. Then he left with Elijah and became his assistant.
translation_verse: Elisa andoa so wanni Elia si. Elisa ɔɔfale ye nandwie nyii nyɔ bɔ bafa kɔnnua basosɔ bɛ babɔ nu nemɔ, na ohuhuni bɛ. Mmakaa bɔ ɔsosɔ bɛ ne, ɔfa sɔle see tone bɛ naen ne, na ɔfa mane mmenia nemɔ maa belili. Afei osili nu oolili Elia si, na ɔɔyɛle Elia somvoɛ.

english_verse: They dressed in sackcloth and put ropes on their heads, then they went to Ahab and said, “Your servant Benhadad asks you to let him live.” “Is he still alive?” Ahab asked. “Benhadad is like a brother to me.”
translation_verse: Yiti bɛfale ɛsɛen tena bɛpɛle bɛ bo, bɛfale nyamaa bɛbɔle bɛ ti, na bɛhɔle Yisrael hene dɔ bɛɛsrɛle ye kyɛ, “W’akoaa Ben Hadade nwa ɔsrɛ wɔ kyɛ nnɛku ye.” Na Ahabo buale kyɛ, “Ɔtɛte ase? Me ne ye yɛte kyɛ aliɛmaa.”

english_verse: Benhadad sent a messenger to tell King Ahab of Israel,
translation_verse: Afei otuli ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ maa bɛhɔle Yisrael hene Ahabo berɛ wɔ kuro ne anu beesele ye kyɛ, “Ben Hadade nwa:

english_verse: Later, Benhadad sent another messenger to say to Ahab, “I already told you to give me your silver and gold, your wives, and your children.
translation_verse: Ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ sá hɔle beesele kyɛ, “Ben Hadade nwa, ‘Nzomane maa beesele wɔ kyɛ, Fa wɔ dwetɛ, wɔ esikaa kɔkorɛ, ɛye mɔ ne wɔ mma mɔ brɛ me,’

english_verse: But tomorrow at this time, I will send my officials into your city to search your palace and the houses of your officials. They will take everything else that you own.”
translation_verse: nakoso ɛhema bekye sɔa ngɔma me somvoɛ mɔ bɛkɔwa wɔ berɛ bekooturu wɔ ne wɔ somvoɛ mɔ awuro berɛ nningyein. Na nikyee biala bɔ bekuro bɔ bɛ sa kɔtɔ so ne, bɛkɔfa bɛkɔhɔ.”

english_verse: “Don't listen to him!” they answered. “You don't have to do what he says.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ maen mbanyi ne amukoraa ɔne kuro berɛ ama amukoraa bebuale Ahabo kyɛ, “Nnɛtɛ ye so! Nnɛpene!”

english_verse: So Ahab sent someone to tell Benhadad, “Your Majesty, I'll give you my silver and gold, and even my wives and children. But I won't let you have anything else.” When Benhadad got his answer,
translation_verse: Yiti Ahabo sele Ben Hadade ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔɔse me mene Nana Ben Hadade kyɛ, ‘Bɔ elili moa ɛhane ne amukoraa de, ngɔyɔ. Nakoso nziɛ ye deɛ ne de, mengɔpene.’ ” Ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ sa bɛhɔle bɛɛbɔle Ben Hadade amaneɛ.

english_verse: he replied, “I'll completely destroy Samaria! There won't even be enough of it left for my soldiers to carry back in their hands. If I don't do it, I pray that the gods will punish me terribly.”
translation_verse: Ben Hadade sa somane maa beesele Ahabo kyɛ, “Me koɛhonɛfoɛ pee bɔ bɛ somaa ti, sɛ bɛ nu biala sa Samaria mvuture ye sa bum ko po a, ɔngɔso bɛ so ne, sɛ mamma baammanzɛkye kuro ye a, ye de nyameɛ nemɔ betua me kerɛ behũ me.”

english_verse: Ahab then answered, “Benhadad, don't brag before the fighting even begins. Wait and see if you live through it.”
translation_verse: Yisrael hene buale kyɛ, “Ɛmɔɔhã behyire ye kyɛ, ‘Sona bɔ owurawura ye nwo ɔkɔ koɛ ne, onni kyɛ ɔbɔ ye nwo nzabranoa kyɛ ebie bɔ waho wali ngonim ɔ.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, Benhadad and the other kings had been drinking in their tents. But when Ahab's reply came, he ordered his soldiers to prepare to attack Samaria, and they all got ready.
translation_verse: Né Ben Hadade ne ye ahemvo nemɔ bɛno nzaa wɔ b’asese nemɔ anu. Ɔtele edwirɛ ne pɛ yeɛ osele ye koɛhonɛfoɛ ne kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔdwɔso bɛɛho!” Na bɛɛpɛle Samaria kuro ne anwo beyiale bɛfale koɛ bɛtoale bɛ. Ahabo di Siria so ngonim

english_verse: At that very moment, a prophet ran up to Ahab and said, “You can see that Benhadad's army is very strong. But the Lord has promised to help you defeat them today. Then you will know that the Lord is in control.”
translation_verse: Afei ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ bie wale Yisrael hene Ahabo berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, “AWURADE nwa nyoo, ‘Anwu ɛlɔen kandinga he amukoraa? Tie, ngɔfa bɛ ngowura wɔ sa ɛnɛ, na ekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.’ ”

english_verse: “Who will fight the battle?” Ahab asked. The prophet answered, “The young bodyguards who serve the district officials.” “But who will lead them into battle?” Ahab asked. “You will!” the prophet replied.
translation_verse: Na Ahabo bisale kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔfa ye so koli ngonim kɔma me ɔ?” Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne buale kyɛ, “AWURADE nwa, mmerandeɛ bɔ bɛso manzini amrado nemɔ, bɛ so yeɛ ɔkɔfa ɔ.” Yeɛ afei Ahabo bisale kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ okotua koɛ ne anoa ɔ?” Na obuale kyɛ, “Wɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: At noon, King Ahab and his Israelite army marched out of Samaria, with the young soldiers in front. King Benhadad of Syria and the
translation_verse: Mmerandeɛ bɔ bɛso manzini amrado nemɔ, bɛ yeɛ belili moa befili kuro ne anu befitele ɔ. Ben Hadade somane mmenia maa bɛɛneane, na bɛɛbɔle ye amaneɛ kyɛ, “Mmenia biemɔ bafi Samaria kuro ne anu bafite bɛba.”

english_verse: “Take them alive!” Benhadad ordered. “I don't care if they have come out to fight or to surrender.”
translation_verse: Ben Hadade sele kyɛ, “Sɛ bawa ye asomdwee nu a, ɛ́mɔhye bɛ anyekaenn so. Yeɛ sɛ bawa kyɛ bɛbaaho koɛ koso a, ye wora ɛ́mɔhye bɛ anyekaenn so.”

english_verse: and each of them attacked and killed an enemy soldier. The rest of the Syrian army turned and ran, and the Israelites went after them. Benhadad and some others escaped on horses,
translation_verse: Yisrael koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ huhuni Siria koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ. Siriafoɛ nwatili na Yisraelfoɛ guli bɛ so. Nakoso Siria hene Ben Hadade tenane pɔngɔ so ɔne pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ bɛnwatili.

english_verse: but Ahab and his soldiers followed them and captured their horses and chariots. Ahab and Israel's army crushed the Syrians.
translation_verse: Yisrael hene fitele fale koɛ ɔɔtoale mbɔngɔ nemɔ ne teaseɛnam nemɔ, na olili ngonim wɔ Siriafoɛ so huhuni bɛ pasaa.

english_verse: Later, the prophet went back and warned Ahab, “Benhadad will attack you again next spring. Build up your troops and make sure you have some good plans.” Syria Attacks Israel Again
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne wale Yisrael hene berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, “Kɔboaboa wɔ nwo, ná bɔ odi kyɛ ɛyɔ ne, dwene ye nwo yé, ofikyɛ afoɛnoa bekye sɔa Siria hene kosa kɔfa koɛ kɔɔtoa wɔ.” Yisrael sa di Siria so ngonim

english_verse: Meanwhile, Benhadad's officials went to him and explained: Israel's gods are mountain gods. We fought Israel's army in the hills, and that's why they defeated us. But if we fight them on flat land, there's no way we can lose.
translation_verse: Siria hene mbanyi mɔ tuli ye foɛ kyɛ, “Yisraelfoɛ bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ bɛte mmokaa so nyameɛ mɔ, yiti ɔma bɛ nwo yɛ se tra yɛ. Yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛ ne bɛ yɛɛho wɔ aseɛ frɛtɛɛ so, na amba yɛkoli bɛ so ngonim.

english_verse: Here's what you should do. First, get rid of those
translation_verse: Afei koso, yeye ahemvo nemɔ fi koɛ ne anoa, ná fa safohene mɔ gyinagyina koɛ ne anoa.

english_verse: Then get more soldiers, horses, and chariots, so your army will be as strong as it was before. We'll fight Israel's army on flat land and wipe them out. Benhadad agreed and did what they suggested.
translation_verse: Na afei koɛhonɛfoɛ, mbɔngɔ ne teaseɛnam bɔ bɛ somaa te kyɛ bɛ bɔ ahwere bɛ ne, boaboa bɛ noa, na yɛne Yisraelfoɛ kɔɔho wɔ aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso, na amba yɛkoli bɛ so ngonim. Ben Hadade tiele bɛ dwirɛ ne, na ɔyɔle sɔ kyɛbɔ bɛhane ne ala.

english_verse: In the spring, Benhadad got his army together, and they marched to the town of Aphek to attack Israel.
translation_verse: Afoɛnoa pɛpɛɛpɛ, Ben Hadade boaboale Siria koɛhonɛfoɛ noa, na ɔhɔle Afeke kyɛ ɔne Yisrael bɛkwaaho.

english_verse: The prophet went to Ahab and said, “The Syrians think the Lord is a god of the hills and not of the valleys. So he has promised to help you defeat their powerful army. Then you will know that the Lord is in control.”
translation_verse: Nyameɛ sona bie hɔle Yisrael hene berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, “AWURADE nwa: Ɔnate kyɛ Siriafoɛ bahã kyɛ me AWURADE nde mmokaa so Nyameɛ na mmom nnde bɔnza nu Nyameɛ ne ati, yiti ngɔfa ɛlɔen kandinga he amukoraa ngowura wɔ sa, amaa ɛmɔanwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.”

english_verse: For seven days the two armies stayed in their camps, facing each other. Then on the seventh day the fighting broke out, and before sunset the Israelites had killed
translation_verse: Koɛhonɛfoɛ kure nyɔ ne biala kyekyele ye asikyeleɛ ɛlɛsoo wɔ obiɛngo deɛ ndendeneɛ so. Na ye ɛlɛsoo ne aso, bɛhyɛle koɛ ne abo. Yisraelfoɛ huhuni Siria koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ bɛnate ase ɔ apee ɛyaa ko ɛlɛho.

english_verse: His officials said, “Your Majesty, we've heard that Israel's kings keep their agreements. We will wrap sackcloth around our waists, put ropes around our heads, and ask Ahab to let you live.”
translation_verse: Ye mbanyi nemɔ sele ye kyɛ, “Yate kyɛ Yisrael ahemvo nemɔ, bɛte ahemvo bɔ bɛse anwumvoin ɔ. Maa yɛfa ɛsɛen tena yɛpɛ yɛ bo, yɛfa nyamaa yɛbɔ yɛ ti, ná yɛhɔ Yisrael hene berɛ. Ebiaa ɔkɔmaa ekonya wɔ ti kodidi nu.”

english_verse: Benhadad's officials were trying to figure out what Ahab was thinking, and when he said “brother,” they quickly replied, “You're right! You and Benhadad are like brothers.” “Go get him,” Ahab said. When Benhadad came out, Ahab had him climb up into his chariot.
translation_verse: Né mmenia nemɔ bɛpena kyɛ benwu nikyee bie bɔ okyire kyɛ Ahabo okole bɛ kɔto nu ɔ, na begyinane ye dwirɛ ne aso bɛhane ye ndɛndɛ kyɛ, “Amba, Ben Hadade ne wɔ bɛte kyɛ aliɛmaa.” Ahabo toale so hane kyɛ, “Ɛmɔɔfa ye bɛbra.” Yiti Ben Hadade wale Ahabo nwo berɛ, na ɔmaa Ben Hadade fo ɔɔtenane ye teaseɛnam ne anu bie.

english_verse: Benhadad said, “I'll give back the towns my father took from your father. And you can have shops in Damascus, just as my father had in Samaria.” Ahab replied, “If you do these things, I'll let you go free.” Then they signed a peace treaty, and Ahab let Benhadad go. A Prophet Condemns Ahab
translation_verse: Ben Hadade sele ye kyɛ, “Nguro bɔ me baba le fili wɔ baba sa nu ne, ngosa ngɔfa ngɔma wɔ, amaa asisi wɔ dwaa wɔ Damasko, kyɛbɔ me baba yɔle ye wɔ Samaria ne.” Yeɛ Yisrael hene buale kyɛ, “Sɛ sɔ yeɛ ɛkã de a, ye de ngɔmaa ekonya wɔ ti kodidi nu.” Yiti Ahabo ne Ben Hadade bɛyɛle apam na, ɔyakyili ye maa ɔhɔle. Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ bie twi Ahabo nyunu

english_verse: About this time the Lord commanded a prophet to say to a friend, “Hit me!” But the friend refused,
translation_verse: Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ fekue bie, bɛ nu ko gyinane AWURADE dwirɛ so osele bɛ nu ko kyɛ, “Fa nikye bɔ me maa mbura.” Nakoso wanyɔ sɔ.

english_verse: and the prophet told him, “You disobeyed the Lord, and as soon as you walk away, a lion will kill you.” The friend left, and suddenly a lion killed him.
translation_verse: Yeɛ osele ye kyɛ, “Ɔnate kyɛ ahwi afa AWURADE dwirɛ so ne ati, enya fi me nwo wa kɔ pɛ a, gyata kohũ wɔ.” Na ofili ye nwo berɛ hɔle pɛ, gyata bie yiale ye huni ye.

english_verse: The prophet found someone else and said, “Hit me!” So this man beat him up.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne nwuni biaa foforɛ na osele kyɛ, “Fa nikyee bɔ me maa mbura.” Yiti biaa ne fale nikyee bɔle ye purale ye.

english_verse: The prophet left and put a bandage over his face to disguise himself. Then he went and stood beside the road, waiting for Ahab to pass by.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne sili nu, ɔsakyerale ye nwo, ɔfale eduku kyekyele ye nye, na ɔɔnwondɛle Nana Ahabo wɔ atee ne anoa.

english_verse: When Ahab went by, the prophet shouted, “Your Majesty, right in the heat of battle, someone brought a prisoner to me and told me to guard him. He said if the prisoner got away, I would either be killed or forced to pay
translation_verse: Ahabo dwuli berɛ pɛ, ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne teane nu sele ye kyɛ, “W’akoaa, ngongyinane koɛ serɛserɛ bie noa. Na koɛhonɛniɛ bie fale ebie bɔ bahye ye nnure ɔ brɛle me. Na osele me kyɛ, ‘Nea biaa ye aso. Sɛ ɔnwati a, bekohu wɔ bie bekotua kerɛ, anaakyɛ ekotua ɛdwetɛ talɛnde ko.’

english_verse: But I got busy doing other things, and the prisoner escaped.” Ahab answered, “You will be punished just as you have said.”
translation_verse: Nakoso w’akoaa, mmerɛ bɔ me nye aboro bɔ medi akɔneaba ne, biaa ne nwatili.” Yeɛ Yisrael hene buale ye kyɛ, “Ɛhe de, wɔ bɔbɔ ahã abua wɔ nwo fɔ; sɔ ala yeɛ bekobua wɔ ndɛen ɔ.”

english_verse: The man quickly tore the bandage off his face, and Ahab saw that he was one of the prophets.
translation_verse: Na ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne yɛle ndɛndɛ sangyele eduku ne fili ye nyunu. Yisrael hene nwuni kyɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ anu ko ɔ.

english_verse: The prophet said, “The Lord told you to kill Benhadad, but you let him go. Now you will die in his place, and your people will die in place of his people.”
translation_verse: Na ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne sele Ahabo kyɛ, “AWURADE nwa, ‘Ɔnate kyɛ amaa biaa bɔ mahyɛ kyɛ behũ ye ne wahɔ ne ati, bɛkɔfa wɔ ngoa bekotua ye deɛ kerɛ, ná bafa wɔ mmenia basi ye deɛ mɔ gya nu.’ ”

english_verse: One day, Ahab said, “Naboth, your vineyard is near my palace. Give it to me so I can turn it into a vegetable garden. I'll give you a better vineyard or pay whatever you want for yours.”
translation_verse: Na Ahabo sele Nabɔto kyɛ, “Fa wɔ bobe boo ne ma me, maa mva nyɛ me mmakaammaa boo, ofikyɛ opingye m’awuro ne. Ngɔma wɔ bobe boo bɔ ɔyɛ nyemene tra ye ɔ ngosi ye gya nu. Na sɛ ekuro koso a, ngotua ye kerɛ ngɔma wɔ esikaa nu.”

english_verse: Naboth answered, “This vineyard has always been in my family. I won't let you have it.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Nabɔto buale Ahabo kyɛ, “AWURADE pa gua kyɛ ngɔfa me nana mɔ agyapadeɛ ngɔma wɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: So Ahab went home, angry and depressed because of what Naboth had told him. He lay on his bed, just staring at the wall and refusing to eat a thing.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate edwirɛ bɔ Yesreelniɛ Nabɔto hã hyirele Ahabo ne ati, Ahabo le ɛyaa ne aworabɔlɛ hɔle awuro. Ofikyɛ Nabɔto nwa, “Mengɔfa me nana mɔ agyapadeɛ mengɔma wɔ.” Ahabo ɔɔlale ye mba so, ɔfale ye nye hyirele terɛ, na wannidi.

english_verse: Jezebel his wife came in and asked, “What's wrong? Why won't you eat?”
translation_verse: Ɔye Yesebɛl wale ye berɛ oobisale ye kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ aboto bɔ engodidi ye?”

english_verse: “I asked Naboth to sell me his vineyard or to let me give him a better one,” Ahab replied. “And he told me I couldn't have it.”
translation_verse: Ahabo buale ye kyɛ, “Ofikyɛ nga ngyirele Yesreelniɛ Nabɔto kyɛ, ‘Fa wɔ bobe boo ne ma ndɔ, anaa sɛ ekuro po a, ngɔma wɔ bobe boo foforɛ maa ɛkɔfa kosi ye gya nu.’ Nakoso obuale me kyɛ, ‘Mengɔfa me bobe boo ne mengɔma wɔ.’ ”

english_verse: “Aren't you the king of Israel?” Jezebel asked. “Get out of bed and eat something! Don't worry, I'll get Naboth's vineyard for you.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɔye Yesebɛl sele ye kyɛ, “Aso nna wɔ yeɛ edi Yisrael so ɔ? Dwɔso ná didi, ná ma wɔ wora kyekye. Ngole Yesreelniɛ Nabɔto bobe boo ne ngɔma wɔ.”

english_verse: They told the people that it was a day to go without eating, and when they all came together, they seated Naboth at the front.
translation_verse: bɛfa bɛtole dwaa kyɛ odi kyɛ ebiala ɔyɔ akɔngyere. Bɛmane Nabɔto tenane atitire bia so wɔ dwaa bɔ bɛbɔle ne abo.

english_verse: The two liars came in and sat across from Naboth. Then they accused him of cursing God and the king, so the people dragged Naboth outside and stoned him to death.
translation_verse: Asanzafoɛ nyɔ nemɔ wale bɛɛtenane Nabɔto nyunu ndendeneɛ so. Na asanzafoɛ nemɔ bɔle Nabɔto kwaadu wɔ dwaa ne anu kyɛ, “Nabɔto ahã musue dwirɛ watia Nyameɛ ne Nana Ahabo.” Yiti ɛlɔen ne fale Nabɔto bɛhɔle kuro ne tiwaa bɛɛborole ye nyɔboɛ behuni ye.

english_verse: The leaders of Jezreel sent a message back to Jezebel that said, “Naboth is dead.”
translation_verse: Na bɛfale ngraa bɛɛmane Yesebɛl kyɛ, “Baboro Nabɔto nyɔboɛ bahu ye.”

english_verse: As soon as Jezebel got their message, she told Ahab, “Now you can have the vineyard Naboth refused to sell. He's dead.”
translation_verse: Yesebɛl tele kyɛ baboro Nabɔto nyɔboɛ bahu ye pɛ, osele Ahabo kyɛ, “Yesreelniɛ Nabɔto ye bobe boo, bɔ wambene wandɔne ye wamma wɔ ne, kɔ na kɔfa ofikyɛ Nabɔto ɔtte aseɛ wawu.”

english_verse: Ahab got up and went to take over the vineyard. Elijah Condemns Ahab
translation_verse: Ahabo tele kyɛ Yesreelniɛ Nabɔto wawu pɛ, osili nu kyɛ ɔkɔ Nabɔto bobe boo ne anu ɔkɔfa yɛ ye deɛ. Elia hyɛ Ahabo asohwenɛ nwo ngɔm

english_verse: The Lord said to Elijah the prophet,
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Tisibeniɛ Elia kyɛ,

english_verse: “King Ahab of Israel is in Naboth's vineyard right now, taking it over.
translation_verse: “Kɔ ná koyia Yisrael hene Ahabo, bɔ odi bia wɔ Samaria ne. Kekesaala ye, ɔwɔ Nabɔto bobe boo bɔ waafa wayɛ deɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Go tell him that I say, ‘Ahab, you murdered Naboth and took his property. And so, in the very spot where dogs licked up Naboth's blood, they will lick up your blood.’ ” When Elijah found him,
translation_verse: Se ye kyɛ, “AWURADE nwa, ‘Ali awue yeɛ asa afa agyapadeɛ ɔ?’ Ka kyire ye kyɛ, ‘AWURADE nwa: Nekaa bɔ ngyea bɛtafele Nabɔto mogya ne, berɛ ala yeɛ ngyea kɔtafe wɔ koso wɔ mogya deɛ ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Ahab said, “So, my enemy, you found me at last.” Elijah answered: Yes, I did! Ahab, you have managed to do everything the Lord hates.
translation_verse: Ahabo bisale Elia kyɛ, “Eh me pɔfoɛ, bɔ mayɔ ye, ama me bo ala so?” Na Elia buale kyɛ, “Yoo, mama wɔ bo ala so. Atu wɔ nwo asie berɛ kyɛ ɛkɔyɔ bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Ye sɔ ti,

english_verse: Now you will be punished. You and every man and boy in your family will die, whether slave or free.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa, ‘Ngɔmaa ekonwu amaneɛ, ngonua wɔ boso ama bɛ boso, na ngohũ bienzua biala ngofi Ahabo abusua nu wɔ Yisrael, kyɛ dehyeɛ oo, kyɛ kanganiɛ oo.

english_verse: Your whole family will be wiped out, just like the families of King Jeroboam and King Baasha. You've made the Lord very angry by sinning and causing the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Na ngɔma w’awuro kɔyɛ kyɛ Nebate awa Yeroboam deɛ, ɔne Ahiya awa Baasa deɛ, ofikyɛ awura me apue maa mafɛ yaa, na ahwe Yisrael ahɔ bɔne nu.

english_verse: And as for Jezebel, dogs will eat her body there in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Bɔ AWURADE ahã afa Yesebɛl koso nwo ɛhe, ‘Ngyea koli Yesebɛl naen wɔ Yesreel fasue ne anwo.’

english_verse: Dogs will also eat the bodies of your relatives who die in town, and vultures will eat the bodies of those who die in the country.
translation_verse: Ahabo abusuaniɛ biala bɔ okowu wɔ kuro ne, ngyea koli ye naen. Na bɛ nu biala bɔ okowu wɔ eburo ne, ewienu nnomaa kosuso ye naen koli.”

english_verse: When Ahab heard this, he tore his clothes in sorrow and wore sackcloth day and night. He was depressed and refused to eat. Some time later, the Lord said, “Elijah, do you see how sorry Ahab is for what he did? I won't punish his family while he is still alive. I'll wait until his son is king.” No one was more determined than Ahab to disobey the Lord. And Jezebel encouraged him. Worst of all, he had worshiped idols, just as the Amorites had done before the Lord forced them out of the land and gave it to Israel.
translation_verse: “Anwu kyɛbɔ Ahabo wasi wabrɛ ye nwo ase wɔ me nyunu ɔ? Ɔnate kyɛ wabrɛ ye nwo ase wɔ me nyunu ne ati, mengɔma sɔ amaneɛ ne ngɔto ye mmerɛ bɔ ɔte ase ɔ; na mmom amaneɛ ne kɔwa Ahabo abusuafoɛ so wɔ ɔwa bɔ okoli ye bia ne ye aberɛ so.”

english_verse: Chronicles
translation_verse: Aberɛso Dwirɛ

english_verse: Tell them to put him in prison and to give him nothing but bread and water until I come back safely.”
translation_verse: Na kã kyire bɛ kyɛ, ‘Nana nwa nyoo: Ɛ́mɔfa akoaa he bɛto kuku nu, na ɛmɔte ye aleɛ ne ye nzue so, kɔpem kyɛ ngofi koɛ ye noa ngosa ngɔwa asomdwee nu ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Ahab asked his officials, “Why haven't we tried to get Ramoth in Gilead back from the Syrians? It belongs to us.”
translation_verse: Na Yisrael hene bisale ye bɔbɔ ye mbanyi mɔ kyɛ, “Aso ɛmɔse kyɛ Ramote Gileade ɔte yɛ deɛ, nakoso yɛnyɔ ye nwo hwee kyɛ yɛkole yɛkofi Siria hene sa nu ɔ?”

english_verse: Then he asked Jehoshaphat, “Would you go to Ramoth with me and attack the Syrians?” “Just tell me what to do,” Jehoshaphat answered. “My army and horses are at your command.
translation_verse: Na obisale Yehosafate kyɛ, “Ɛkɔboka me maa yɛkɔfa koɛ yɛkɔɔtoa Ramote Gileade anaa?” Yehosafate buale Yisrael hene kyɛ, “Me ne wɔ de, yɛte sona ko. Me koɛhonɛfoɛ te wɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ, yeɛ me mbɔngɔ te wɔ mbɔngɔ.”

english_verse: But Jehoshaphat said, “Just to make sure, is there another of the Lord's prophets we can ask?”
translation_verse: Nakoso Yehosafate bisale kyɛ, “Aso AWURADE ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ biala nne maen ye anu ko bɔ yɛkɔhora yɛkobisa ye AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Then Ahab sent someone to bring Micaiah as soon as possible.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yisrael hene frɛle ahemvie panyi ko, na ɔsomane ye kyɛ, “Kɔfrɛ Yimila awa Mikaya brɛ me kekesaala ye.”

english_verse: All this time, Ahab and Jehoshaphat were dressed in their royal robes and were seated on their thrones at the threshing place near the gate of Samaria. They were listening to the prophets tell them what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Yisrael hene ne Yuda hene Yehosafate bɛtete b’ahennie bia so bɔ bahera b’ahemvo ndena, wɔ nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo wɔ Samaria pambim ne anyunu berɛ ɔ. Né ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne amukoraa bɛhyehyɛ ngɔm wɔ ahemvo nemɔ anyunu berɛ.

english_verse: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was one of the prophets. He had made some horns out of iron and shouted, “Ahab, the Lord says you will attack the Syrians like a bull with iron horns and wipe them out!”
translation_verse: Bɛ nu ko bɔ ye ole Kenaana awa Sedekia ne, ɔyɔle buralɛ mmɛen mɔ fale, na ɔhane kyɛ, “AWURADE nwa, ‘Mmɛen hemɔ yeɛ ɛkɔfa kɔpemo Siriafoɛ maa okoodwu kyɛ ekohũhũ bɛ ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: All the prophets agreed that Ahab should attack the Syrians at Ramoth, and they promised that the Lord would help him defeat them.
translation_verse: Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne amukoraa bɛ noa dwirɛ yɛle ko. Na né bɛkã kyɛ, “Kɔ Ramote Gileade na koli ngonim. Nana, AWURADE kɔfa kuro ne kowura wɔ sa.” Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Mikaya

english_verse: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah whispered, “Micaiah, all the prophets have good news for Ahab. Now go and say the same thing.”
translation_verse: Ɛbɔfoɛ bɔ betuli ye kyɛ ɔɔfa Mikaya bra ne, osele Mikaya kyɛ, “Tie, ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ amukoraa bɛ noa dwirɛ te ko. Bahã ngonimlilɛ nwo dwirɛ bahyire Nana Ahabo. Wɔ koso fa to bɛ deɛ ne aso, na kã ngonimlilɛ nwo dwirɛ kyire ye.”

english_verse: Then Micaiah went to Ahab, and Ahab asked, “Micaiah, should I attack the Syrians at Ramoth?” “Yes!” Micaiah answered. “The Lord will help you defeat them.”
translation_verse: Oodwuli Nana Ahabo berɛ ne, Nana Ahabo bisale ye kyɛ, “Mikaya, yɛhɔ yɛɛho yɛle Ramote Gileade anaakyɛ yɛyakyi?” Mikaya buale kyɛ, “Kɔ na koli ngonim. Nana, AWURADE kɔfa kuro ne kowura wɔ sa.”

english_verse: “Micaiah, I've told you over and over to tell me the truth!” Ahab shouted. “What does the Lord really say?”
translation_verse: Nakoso Nana Ahabo bisale Mikaya kyɛ, “Pɛen nyɛɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ memaa ɛta ndaen kyɛ AWURADE dumaa nu edwirɛ nahorɛ ngome yeɛ ɛkɔhã kohyire me ɔ?”

english_verse: He answered, “In a vision I saw Israelite soldiers walking around in the hills like sheep without a shepherd to guide them. The Lord said, ‘This army has no leader. They should go home and not fight.’ ”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Mikaya sele kyɛ, “Nwuni kyɛ Yisrael amukoraa babɔ aya wɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso kyɛ mmoaen bɔ belle neafoɛ ɔ; na AWURADE hane kyɛ, ‘Mmenia hemɔ, belle meneɛ. Ma ebiala ɔhɔ ye awuro asomdwee nu.’ ”

english_verse: Micaiah replied: Listen to this! I also saw the Lord seated on his throne with every creature in heaven gathered around him.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Mikaya sele kyɛ, “Nzaade tie AWURADE noa dwirɛ: Nwuni kyɛ AWURADE te ye ahennie bia so, bɔ nyameɛso koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraati begyigyi ye nwo berɛ wɔ ye bɛen ne famaa ɔ.

english_verse: This is exactly what has happened, Ahab. The Lord made all your prophets lie to you, and he knows you will soon be destroyed.
translation_verse: Yiti Nana Ahabo tie, AWURADE afa anoanu sunzum wawura wɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ hemɔ amukoraa bɛ noa nu, na amaneɛ kandinga paa yeɛ AWURADE ahyehyɛ wato berɛ wama wɔ ɔ.”
