translation_verse: Yehu sa wale ye mene ye safohene nemɔ anwo berɛ ne, bebisale ye kyɛ, “Nikyee biala te bɔkɔɔ de? Nzu ati yeɛ akoaa bɔnamvoɛ ne wale wɔ berɛ ɔ?” Yehu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Naa ɛmɔse sɔ biaa ne, ɔne kyɛbɔ osi kekã ye dwirɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: “No, we don't. What did he say?” they asked. “He had a message from the Lord,” Jehu replied. “He said that the Lord has chosen me to be the next king of Israel.”
translation_verse: Bebuale ye kyɛ, “Anoanu! Nea nu kã kyire yɛ!” Yiti Yehu sele kyɛ, “Edwirɛ bɔ ɔhã hyirele me ɛhe, ‘AWURADE nwa: Mapopa wɔ ngoo mafa wɔ masi Yisrael so hene.’ ”

english_verse: They quickly grabbed their coats and spread them out on the steps where Jehu was standing. Someone blew a trumpet, and everyone shouted, “Jehu is king!” Jehu Kills Joram and Ahaziah
translation_verse: Berɛ ne ala bɛyeyele bɛ ndaadeɛ amukoraa bɛsesɛle aseɛnwo berɛ ma Yehu natele so. Behuli totorobɛndo, na bɛbɔle ohomoo kyɛ, “Yehu ali hene oo!” Yehu ku Yisrael hene Yoram

english_verse: When the guard in the watchtower at Jezreel saw Jehu and his men riding up, he shouted to the king, “I see a large group of men coming this way.” Joram ordered, “Send someone out to ask them if this is a friendly visit.”
translation_verse: Yehu ne ye lɔen bepingyele Yesreel ne, wɛmvoɛ bɔ ogyina kuro berɛ abandenden ne aso ne, onwuni bɛ kyɛ bɛba ɔ, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Manwu ɛlɔen bie.” Yeɛ Yoram sele kyɛ, “Soma pɔngɔhanɛniɛ maa ooyia bɛ na obisa bɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɔte bɔkɔɔ anaa?’ ”

english_verse: One of the soldiers rode out and said to Jehu, “King Joram wants to know if this is a friendly visit.” “What's it to you?” Jehu asked. “Just stay behind me with the rest of my troops!” About the same time the guard in the watchtower said, “Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back.”
translation_verse: Yiti pɔngɔhanɛniɛ ne ooyiale Yehu, na osele ye kyɛ, “Nana nwa mmisa wɔ kyɛ, ‘Ɔte bɔkɔɔ anaa?’ ” Yeɛ Yehu buale kyɛ, “Asomdwee nwo dwirɛ de, ɔfa wɔ nwo nzu? Baali me si!” Wɛmvoɛ ne maa bɛɛbɔle Nana Yoram amaneɛ kyɛ, “Ɛbɔfoɛ ne waadwu bɛ nwo berɛ, nakoso wanza wamma.”

english_verse: So Joram sent out another rider, who rode up to Jehu and said, “The king wants to know if this is a friendly visit.” “What's it to you?” Jehu asked. “Just get behind me with the rest of my troops!”
translation_verse: Yiti ɔsomane pɔngɔhanɛniɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ɔ maa ɔhɔle bɛ berɛ oosele bɛ kyɛ, Nana nwa mmisa kyɛ, ‘Ɔte bɔkɔɔ anaa?’ Na Yehu buale kyɛ, “Asomdwee nwo dwirɛ de, ɔfa wɔ nwo nzu? Baali me si!”

english_verse: The guard in the watchtower said, “Your Majesty, the rider got there, but he isn't coming back either. Wait a minute! That one man is a reckless chariot driver—it must be Jehu!”
translation_verse: Wɛmvoɛ ne maa bɛɛbɔle Nana Yoram amaneɛ bieku kyɛ, “Ɛbɔfoɛ ne waadwu bɛ nwo berɛ, nakoso wanza wamma. Sona bɔ ɔkã teaseɛnam ne, ɔkã ye te kyɛ Nimisi awa Yehu, ofikyɛ ye de, ye teaseɛnamhanɛ te basabasa.”

english_verse: Joram commanded, “Get my chariot ready.” Then he and Ahaziah got in their chariots and rode out to meet Jehu. They all met on the land that had belonged to Naboth.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yoram hane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔsiesie me teaseɛnam bɛma me kekesaala ye.” Na besiesiele ye teaseɛnam bɛmane ye. Yeɛ Yisrael hene Yoram ne Yuda hene Ahasia besili nu, ebiala te ye teaseɛnam nu, na bɛhɔle kyɛ bɛkwaayia Yehu. Beyiale ye wɔ Yesreelniɛ Nabɔto ye aseɛ ne aso.

english_verse: “Ahaziah, let's get out of here!” Joram yelled. “It's a trap!” As Joram tried to escape,
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yoram kakyili ye nwo kyɛ ɔnwati, na ɔteane nu sele Ahasia kyɛ, “Ahasia, wayɛ lɔen oo!”

english_verse: Jehu shot an arrow. It hit Joram between his shoulders, then it went through his heart and came out his chest. He fell over dead in his chariot.
translation_verse: Yehu le ye anwoserɛ amukoraa tole ye agyaen ne. Agyaen ne wurale Yoram mvorɔma nu maa ɔɔwɔle ye ahone nu, na ɔtɔle wɔ ye teaseɛnam ne anu.

english_verse: Jehu commanded his assistant Bidkar, “Get Joram's body and throw it in the field that Naboth once owned. Do you remember when you and I used to ride side by side behind Joram's father Ahab? It was then that the Lord swore to Ahab that he would be punished in the same field where he had killed Naboth and his sons. So throw Joram's body there, just as the Lord said.”
translation_verse: ‘AWURADE nwa: Nabɔto mogya ne ye mma mɔ mogya bɔ nwuni ye anoma nen, meta ndaen kyɛ sɔ aseɛ ne aso ala yeɛ ngotua wɔ so kerɛ ɔ.’ Yiti pagya ye findi ye to aseɛ ye aso, kyɛbɔ AWURADE ahã ne ala.” Yehu maa beku Ahasia (

english_verse: Ahaziah saw all of this happen and tried to escape to the town of Beth-Haggan, but Jehu caught up with him and shouted, “Kill him too!” So his troops shot Ahaziah with an arrow while he was on the road to Gur near Ibleam. He went as far as Megiddo, where he died.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Yuda hene Ahasia nwuni bɔ ɔkɔ so ne, ɔfale ye nye hyirele Bete Hagan atee so kyɛ ɔnwati. Yehu foane ye, na Yehu hane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔto agyaen behũ ye koso.” Na bɛtole agyaen bɛwɔle ye wɔ teaseɛnam ne anu wɔ Gure pambaa bɔ opingye Yiblim ne aso. Yeɛ Ahasia nwati hɔle Megido, na oowuli dɔ.

english_verse: Ahaziah's officers put his body in a chariot and took it back to Jerusalem, where they buried him beside his ancestors.
translation_verse: Ye mbanyi mɔ soale ye fuin teaseɛnam nu bɛhɔle Yerusalem, na beesiele ye wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye asieleɛ nu wɔ nekaa bɔ besiele ye mbanyi mɔ ɔ, wɔ Dawide kuro.

english_verse: Ahaziah had become king of Judah in the eleventh year of the rule of Ahab's son Joram. Jehu Kills Jezebel
translation_verse: Ahabo awa Yoram lili bia ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne ko ne anu, Ahasia lili Yuda so hene. Yesebɛl wue

english_verse: Jehu headed toward Jezreel, and when Jezebel heard he was coming, she put on eye shadow and brushed her hair. Then she stood at the window, waiting for him to arrive.
translation_verse: Yehu wale Yesreel nen, Yesebɛl tele ye nga. Yesebɛl kekane ye nye asi, ɔbɔle ye ti, na ɔfale ye nye tɛle mboma nu.

english_verse: As he walked through the city gate, she shouted down to him, “Why did you come here, you murderer? To kill the king? You're no better than Zimri!”
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Yehu ɔkwaawura kuro berɛ pambim ne anu nen, Yesebɛl bisale ye kyɛ, “Simri bɔ ahu wɔ mene ɔ, aso ɛwale ye asomdwee nu?”

english_verse: He looked up toward the window and asked, “Is anyone up there on my side?” A few palace workers stuck their heads out of a window,
translation_verse: Yehu pagyale ye nye neane mboma ne anu, na obisale kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ ɔwɔ me bue nu ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ɔwɔ me bue nu ɔ?” Yeɛ sayɛɛ nyɔ anaa nza huli bɛ nye ase mboma nu bɛneane Yehu.

english_verse: and Jehu shouted, “Throw her out the window!” They threw her down, and her blood splattered on the walls and on the horses that trampled her body.
translation_verse: Yehu hane kyɛ, Ɛ́mɔfindi ye bɛto aseɛnwo faen.” Yiti befindini Yesebɛl bɛtole aseɛnwo. Ye mogya ne bie bɔ petene terɛ ne anwo ɔne mbɔngɔ bɔ betiatiale ye so nemɔ nwo.

english_verse: Jehu left to get something to eat and drink. Then he told some workers, “Even though she was evil, she was a king's daughter, so make sure she has a proper burial.”
translation_verse: Afei Yehu wurale ahemvie berɛ odidili ɔnone. Ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea bɛpena nekaa besie braa busueniɛ ne, ofikyɛ ɔse te hene.”

english_verse: But when they went out to bury her body, they found only her skull, her hands, and her feet.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛhɔle kyɛ bɛkwaasie ye ne, benwuni kyɛ waha ye ti kokuroka ne ye gya tasaa ne ye sa tasaa angome.

english_verse: They reported this to Jehu, and he said, “The Lord told Elijah the prophet that Jezebel's body would be eaten by dogs right here in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Besa bɛwale bɛɛbɔle Yehu amaneɛ ne, ɔhane kyɛ, “AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔnate ye somvoɛ Tisibeniɛ Elia so hane ne yeɛ wawa nu ɔ. AWURADE nwa, ‘Yesreel mbɔtam berɛ yeɛ ngyea koli Yesebɛl naen ɔ.

english_verse: And he warned that her bones would be spread all over the ground like manure, so that no one could tell who it was.”
translation_verse: Yesebɛl fuin kɔto kɔpete aseɛ ne aso kyɛ ewura wɔ Yesreel mbɔtam, amaa ebiala annwu kyɛ Yesebɛl ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Your town is strong, and you're protected by chariots and an armed cavalry. And I know that King Ahab's descendants live there with you. So as soon as you read this letter,
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔ mene ye mma mmienzua nemɔ, bɛwɔ ɛmɔ sa nu, na afei ɛhemɔ wura ɛmɔ sa: teaseɛnam mɔ, mbɔngɔ, kuro bɔ bato ye nwo fasue, ɔne akodeɛ.

english_verse: choose the best person for the job and make him the next king. Then be prepared to defend Ahab's family.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔneanea ɛmɔ mene mma mmienzua nemɔ anu bɛpena bɛ nu ko bɔ ɔfata paa ɔ. Ɛ́mɔma oli ɔse bia, na ɛ́mɔho bɛ́ma ɛmɔ mene ye ahennie ne ɔtoa so.”

english_verse: The officials and leaders read the letters and were very frightened. They said to each other, “Jehu has already killed King Joram and King Ahaziah! We have to do what he says.”
translation_verse: Nakoso besurole paa, na bebisabisale bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea oo! Ahemvo nyɔ po bangora ye nyunu gyina, yɛyɛ sɛɛ né yahora ye nyunu gyina?”

english_verse: The prime minister, the mayor of the city, as well as the other leaders and Ahab's supporters, sent this answer to Jehu, “We are your servants, Your Majesty, and we will do whatever you tell us. But it's not our place to choose someone to be king. You do what you think is best.”
translation_verse: Yiti ahemvie berɛ neafoɛ ne, ɔne kuro berɛ amrado ne, bɛ ne kuro berɛ mbanyi ne, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛnea Ahabo mma nemɔ aso ne, bɛsomane maa bɛfale ngraa bɛmane Yehu kyɛ, “Wɔ ngoaa ole yɛ. Yɛkɔyɔ bɔ ekose yɛ biala. Yɛngosi ebiala hene, yɔ bɔ wɔ bɔbɔ ekuro ɔ.”

english_verse: Jehu then wrote another letter which said, “If you are on my side and will obey me, then prove it. Bring me the heads of the descendants of Ahab! And be here in Jezreel by this time tomorrow.” The
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yehu hyerɛle bɛ krataa bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛmɔwɔ me bue nu, ná ɛmɔayɛ ɛmɔ adwene kyɛ ɛmɔkotie me dwirɛ de a, ye de ɛ́mɔpepɛ ɛmɔ mene mma mmienzua nemɔ ti bɛ́fa bɛ́brɛ me wɔ Yesreel ɛhema bekye sɔa ala.” Nana Ahabo mma mmienzua nemɔ, bɔ bɛ somaa te aburasoo ne, né bɛwɔ kuro berɛ mbanyi bɔ bafa bɛ bawura bɛ sa kyɛ bɛtete bɛ nemɔ berɛ.

english_verse: When Jehu was told what had happened, he said, “Put the heads in two piles at the city gate, and leave them there until morning.”
translation_verse: Ɛbɔfoɛ ɔɔbɔle Yehu amaneɛ kyɛ, “Bafa Ahabo mma mmienzua nemɔ bɛ ti bawa” nen, Yehu sele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔboa ye noa kure nyɔ bégua pambim ne anyunu maa aleɛ hye.”

english_verse: The next morning, Jehu went out and stood where everyone could hear him, and he said, “You people are not guilty of anything. I'm the one who plotted against Joram and had him killed. But who killed all these men?
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyene ngyerɛmɔ bɔ ofitele nen, oogyinane mmenia ne amukoraa bɛ nyunu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔnni fɔ. Me yeɛ mmɔle me mene Yoram ti so porɛ nguni ye ɔ, ná nwa yeɛ ohuhuni ɛhemɔ amukoraa ye?”

english_verse: Then Jehu killed the rest of Ahab's relatives living in Jezreel, as well as his highest officials, his priests, and his closest friends. No one in Ahab's family was left alive in Jezreel.
translation_verse: Yiti Yehu huhuni Ahabo ye nwo ama ngaa bɔ baha ne amukoraa wɔ Yesreel: ye mbanyi mɔ amukoraa, ye damvo paa mɔ, ye asɔfo mɔ, bɔ wanyakyi ye bosoniɛ ko po ɔ.

english_verse: Jehu left for Samaria, and along the way, he met some relatives of King Ahaziah of Judah at a place where shepherds meet. He asked, “Who are you?” “We are relatives of Ahaziah,” they answered. “We're going to visit his family.”
translation_verse: Yehu yiale Yuda hene Ahasia ye nwo ama, na obisale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔfi abusua beni anu?” Bebuale kyɛ, “Yɛte Yuda hene Ahasia nwo ama. Yawa kyɛ yɛbaapasa ɛhene mma nemɔ ne nana hemmaa mma nemɔ anwo.”

english_verse: “Take them alive!” Jehu said to his officers. So they grabbed them and led them to the well near the shepherds' meeting place, where they killed all
translation_verse: Yehu hane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔhye bɛ!” Yiti bɛhyele bɛ, na behuhuni sɔ mmenia aburanna ne nyɔ ne amukoraa wɔ Bete Ekede kumaa ne anoa bɔ wanyakyi bɛ nu ko po ɔ.

english_verse: As Jehu went on, he saw Jehonadab son of Rechab coming to meet him. Jehu greeted him, then said, “Jehonadab, I'm on your side. Are you on mine?” “Yes, I am.” “Then give me your hand,” Jehu answered. He helped Jehonadab into his chariot
translation_verse: Yehu fili berɛ ne, onwuni Rekabo awa Yehonadabo kyɛ ɔbaayia ye. Yehu bisale ye ahye, na Yehu bisale ye kyɛ, “Aso me nwo adwene paa wɔ wɔ ti anu kyɛbɔ wɔ nwo adwene paa wɔ me ti anu ye?” Yehonadabo buale kyɛ, “Yoo, ɔte sɔ ala.” Na Yehu sele kyɛ, “Sɛ ɔte sɔ de a, ye de soma me sa nu.” Yiti osomane ye sa nu. Na Yehu bokale maa ɔfo ɔɔtenane teaseɛnam ne anu.

english_verse: and said, “Come with me and see how faithful I am to the Lord.” They rode together in Jehu's chariot
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yehu hane kyɛ, “Maa yɛhɔ kɔnea kyɛbɔ matu me nwo masie berɛ mama AWURADE ɔ.” Yiti ɔmane Yehonadabo tenane ye teaseɛnam ne anu bie.

english_verse: to Samaria. Jehu killed everyone there who belonged to Ahab's family, as well as all his officials. Everyone in his family was now dead, just as the Lord had promised Elijah. Jehu Kills All the Worshipers of Baal
translation_verse: Oodwuli Samaria ne, ohuhuni Ahabo nwo ama bɔ baha wɔ Samaria ne amukoraa, kɔpem kyɛ onuane bɛ boso koraa ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔhã hyirele Elia ne, ɔte ne ala. Yehu kũkũ bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne Baal

english_verse: Jehu called together the people in Samaria and said: King Ahab sometimes worshiped Baal, but I will be completely faithful to Baal.
translation_verse: Afei Yehu mane maen ne amukoraa bɛbɔle dwaa, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ahabo sɔnene Baal kãa bie, nakoso me Yehu de ngɔsɔne ye paa.

english_verse: I'm going to offer a huge sacrifice to him. So invite his prophets and priests, and be sure everyone who worships him is there. Anyone who doesn't come will be killed. But this was a trick—Jehu was really planning to kill the worshipers of Baal.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔfrɛ Baal ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne amukoraa, bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne ye ne amukoraa, ɔne ye asɔfo nemɔ amukoraa bɛma me. Nnɛmɔma bɛ nu ko po ɔye ye nwo fi nu, ofikyɛ mebaabɔ afɔleɛ piri paa mema Baal. Bɛ nu biala bɔ wamma ne, odi kyɛ beku ye.” Nakoso né Yehu le kanda nworɛ ɔpena bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne Baal ne okũkũ bɛ.

english_verse: He said, “Announce a day of worship for Baal!” After the day had been announced,
translation_verse: Yehu hyɛle kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔyia nyianu krongron bɛma Baal.” Yiti bɛbɔle dwaa ne.

english_verse: Jehu sent an invitation to everyone in Israel. All the worshipers of Baal came, and the temple was filled from one end to the other.
translation_verse: Yehu maa bɛbɔle dawure wɔ Yisrael maen nu amukoraa. Bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne Baal ne amukoraati bɛwale, bɔ wanga bɛ nu sona ko po ɔ. Beewurale Baal asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, kɔpem kyɛ sua ne anu yili tɛkyɛ fi ye ti kɔka ye ti ɔ.

english_verse: Jehu told the official in charge of the sacred robes to make sure that everyone had a robe to wear.
translation_verse: Afei Yehu sele Baal sɔnenɛ ndaadeɛ so neafoɛ ne kyɛ, “Yeye ndaadeɛ ne brɛ bɛbɔ bɛsɔne Baal ne amukoraa.” Yiti ɔyeyele ndaadeɛ nemɔ mane bɛ.

english_verse: Jehu and Jehonadab went into the temple, and Jehu said to the crowd, “Look around and make sure that only the worshipers of Baal are here. No one who worships the Lord is allowed in.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yehu ne Rekabo awa Yehonadabo bewurale Baal asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu; na osele bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne Baal ne kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔsɔne AWURADE ne, ɔngɔfra ɛmɔ nu wɔ wa, sana bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne Baal angome.”

english_verse: As soon as Jehu finished offering the sacrifice, he told the guards and soldiers, “Come in and kill them! Don't let anyone escape.” They slaughtered everyone in the crowd and threw the bodies outside. Then they went back into the temple
translation_verse: Yehu bɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne yiele pɛ, osele awɛmvoɛ nemɔ ne mbanyi nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔbra beehũhũ bɛ, nnɛmɔma ebiala nwati.” Yiti bɛfale ngrandɛ behuhuni bɛ. Awɛmvoɛ nemɔ ne mbanyi nemɔ yeyele bɛ fuin beguale aluo. Afei besa bɛhɔle Baal asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu.

english_verse: and carried out the image of Baal. They burned it
translation_verse: Bonima bɔ né ogyi Baal asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu ne, bɛye befitele aluo bɛɛyerale ye.

english_verse: and broke it into pieces, then they completely destroyed Baal's temple. And since that time, it's been nothing but a public toilet.
translation_verse: Bɛsɛkyele Baal bonima ne. Baal asɔneyɛɛ sua ne, bedwirili beguale ase, na bɛfa bɛkakyili nekaa bɔ bɛkɔ bondua ɔ maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

english_verse: But he did not stop the worship of the gold statues of calves at Dan and Bethel that Jeroboam had made for the people to worship.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɔne bɔ Nebate awa Yeroboam hwehwene Yisrael hɔle nu, kyɛ ɔmaa bɛsɔnene esikaa kɔkorɛ nandwie mmosoen bɔ ɔwɔ Betel ne Dan ne de, Yehu wanyakyi ye yɔlɛ.

english_verse: Later the Lord said, “Jehu, you have done right by destroying Ahab's entire family, just as I had planned. So I will make sure that the next four kings of Israel will come from your own family.”
translation_verse: AWURADE sele Yehu kyɛ, “Ɔnate kyɛ abɔ mmɔden ayɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ me nyunu, ná afei ɛne Ahabo awuro ama ali ye kyɛbɔ mepena ne pɛpɛɛpɛ ne ati, wɔ boso ama bɔ ɔkwaadwu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ nna so ne, bɛkɔtena Yisrael ahennie bia so.”

english_verse: But Jehu did not completely obey the commands of the Lord God of Israel. Instead, he kept doing the sinful things that Jeroboam had caused the Israelites to do. Jehu Dies
translation_verse: Nakoso Yehu wanni AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ mmeraa ne aso nahorɛ nu. Yeɛ Yeroboam bɔne bɔ ɔyɔle, bɔ ɔnate so ɔhwehwene Yisrael hɔle bɔne nu ne, wandwe ye nwo wamvi ye nwo. Yehu wue

english_verse: In those days the Lord began to reduce the size of Israel's territory. King Hazael of Syria defeated the Israelites and took control
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, AWURADE hyɛle ye bo kyɛ ɔma Yisrael aseɛ ne bie fi bɛ sa. Siria hene Hasael lili Yisrael so ngonim wɔ maen ne amukoraati nu:

english_verse: of the regions of Gilead and Bashan east of the Jordan River and north of the town of Aroer near the Arnon River. This was the land where the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and Manasseh had once lived.
translation_verse: fite asue Yɔɔdan eyia afiteleɛ, Gileade aseɛ ne amukoraati, Gadefoɛ aseɛ, Rubenfoɛ aseɛ, Manasefoɛ aseɛ, fite Aroye bɔ ɔwɔ Anɔn bɔnza ne anwo, bɔ yeɛ ole Gileade ne Baasan ne.

english_verse: Everything else Jehu did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Afei Yehu nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, ɔne ye ngonim bɔ olili amukoraa, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yisrael ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: Jehu died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoahaz became king.
translation_verse: Yehu toale ye mbanyi mɔ. Besiele ye wɔ Samaria, na ɔwa bienzua Yehoahase lili ye bia.

english_verse: Jehoiada brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David and gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: Nana Dawide pealɛɛ mɔ ne akokyɛm mɔ bɔ né bafa basie wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ ne, ɔsɔfo ne fa mane safohene nemɔ.

english_verse: Jehoiada brought Joash outside, where he placed the crown on his head and gave him a copy of instructions for ruling the nation. Olive oil was poured on his head to show that he was now king, while the crowd clapped and shouted, “Long live the king!”
translation_verse: Afei Yehoada yele Nana Ahasia awa ne fitele. Ɔfale ahennie abotire bɔle ye, na ɔfale Adanzeɛ nwomaa ne mane ye. Bɛbɔle ye ohomoo, na bɛfale ɛpopalɛ ngoo bɛpopale ye. Bɛbɔle bɛ sa nu bɛbɔle ese kyɛ, “Nana, wɔ ngoa so oo!” Atalia wue

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with Jehosheba for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah. Jehoiada Makes Joash King of Judah (
translation_verse: Ɔne neafoɛ ne bɛfeale AWURADE awuro afoɛ nzia mmerɛ bɔ Atalia di maen ne aso ne. Yehoada popa Yoase ngoo

english_verse: Joash was only seven years old when this happened.
translation_verse: Yehoase lili hene ne, né wali afoɛ nzoo.

english_verse: Joash son of Ahaziah had hidden in the Lord's temple six years. Then in the seventh year, Jehoiada the priest sent for the commanders of the king's special bodyguards and the commanders of the palace guards. They met him at the temple, and he asked them to make a promise in the name of the Lord. Then he brought out Joash
translation_verse: Nakoso ye afoɛ nzoo ne anu, Yehoada tole ye sa frɛle Karitefoɛ safohene nemɔ ɔne awɛmvoɛ nemɔ maa bɛwale ye berɛ wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ. Ɔne bɛ yɛle apam, ɔmaa bɛtale ndaen wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ, na ɔyele Nana Ahasia awa ne ali hyirele bɛ.

english_verse: and said to them: Here's what I want you to do. Three of your guard units will be on duty on the Sabbath. I want one unit to guard the palace.
translation_verse: Ɔfale ahyɛdeɛ mane bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛhe yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ: ɛmɔ nu nza nu ngyɛmuɛ ko bɔ odwu afofikyẽa a, ɛmɔkɔ adwuma ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔwɛne ahemvie ne,

english_verse: The other two guard units are supposed to be off duty on the Sabbath. But I want both of them to stay here at the temple and protect King Joash.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ nu fekue nyɔ bɔ odwu afofikyẽa, bɛngɔ adwuma ne, odi kyɛ bɛwɛne ɛhene ne wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ.

english_verse: Make sure they follow him wherever he goes, and tell them to keep their swords ready to kill anyone who tries to get near him.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛpɛ ɛhene ne anwo beyia bɔ ebiala tira akodeɛ ɔ; na ebiala bɔ okopingye kango ne nen, odi kyɛ beku ye ɔ. Odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ ɛhene ne anwo waen nekaa bɔ ɔkɔhɔ biala.”

english_verse: The commanders followed Jehoiada's orders. Each one called together his guards—those coming on duty and those going off duty.
translation_verse: Safohene nemɔ yɔle kyɛbɔ ɔsɔfo Yehoada hyɛle ne ala pɛpɛɛpɛ. Ebiala ye mmenia bɔ bɛkɔ adwuma afofikyẽa ne, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛngɔ adwuma afofikyẽa ne, ɔfale bɛ wale ɔsɔfo Yehoada berɛ.

english_verse: Then they gave the weapons to their guards, who took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect Joash on every side.
translation_verse: Awɛmvoɛ nemɔ te gyinane, bɔ ebiala tira ye akodeɛ ɔ, fi awuro ne ngwaen kɔka ye sorɔ. Bɛpɛle afɔleɛ bokyea ne ɔne awuro ne anwo beyiale, kyɛ bɛwɛne ɛhene ne wɔ nekaa biala.

english_verse: Queen Athaliah heard the crowd and went to the temple.
translation_verse: Atalia tele ese bɔ awɛmvoɛ nemɔ ne maen ne bɛbɔ ne, ɔhɔle bɛ berɛ wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ.

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns, which was the usual place for the king. The singers and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the people were celebrating and blowing trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
translation_verse: Ɔtole ye nye neane, na onwuni kyɛ ɛhene ne gyi bonima ne anwo kyɛbɔ amammerɛ kyire ne. Né safohene nemɔ ne totorobɛndohulɛfoɛ gyigyi ɛhene ne anwo, bɔ maen ne anu mmenia amukoraa behu awɛen bedi ahurusi ɔ. Na Atalia sunzuale ye bɔbɔ ye tena nu teane nu kyɛ, “Bayɛ lɔen oo! bayɛ lɔen oo!”

english_verse: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Kill her! But don't do it anywhere near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops and kill anyone who is with her!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɔsɔfo Yehoada hyɛle safohene mɔ bɔ bɛlela koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ noa ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhwe ye bɛfa koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ anu bɛbra, na ebiala bɔ okogyina ye si ne, ɛ́mɔfa ngrandɛ behũ ye.” Na ɔsɔfo ne hane kyɛ, “Nnɛmaa ɛmɔku ye wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ.”

english_verse: So the commanders dragged her to the gate where horses are led into the palace, and they killed her there.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛhyele ye, na bɛfale ye bɛfale atee bɔ mbɔngɔ fa so bɛkɔ ahemvie berɛ ne aso, na berɛ yeɛ behuni ye ɔ.

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest asked King Joash and the people to promise that they would be faithful to each other and to the Lord.
translation_verse: Yehoada yɛle apam tole AWURADE, yeɛ Nana Yoase ne maen ne b’afia, kyɛ odi kyɛ bɛyɛ AWURADE maen. Afei koso ɔyɛle apam tole Nana Yoase ne maen ne b’afia.

english_verse: Then the crowd went to the temple built to honor Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal right in front of the altars. After Jehoiada had placed guards around the Lord's temple,
translation_verse: Yeɛ maen ne anu mmenia amukoraa bɛhɔle Baal asɔneyɛɛ so beebubuli bosoen ne beguale ase. Ye afɔleɛ bokyea mɔ ne ye amoen mɔ koso, bebubuli bɛ nu pasapasa. Behuni Matan bɔ ɔte Baal kɔmeɛ ne wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea nemɔ anyunu. Na ɔsɔfo ne mane awɛmvoɛ mɔ wɛnene AWURADE awuro ne.

english_verse: he called together all the commanders, the king's special bodyguards, the palace guards, and the people. They led Joash from the temple, through the Guards' Gate, and into the palace. He took his place on the throne and became king of Judah.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo ne tuli safohene nemɔ, Karitefoɛ nemɔ, awɛmvoɛ, ɔne maen ne anu mmenia amukoraa maa bɛɛfale Nana Yoase befili AWURADE awuro dɔ bɛwale, na bɛfale awɛmvoɛ nemɔ pambim ne anu bɛhɔle ahemvie berɛ. Ɔɔtenane ahennie bia ne aso.

english_verse: Jehoiada the priest taught Joash what was right, and so for the rest of his life Joash obeyed the Lord.
translation_verse: Yehoase yɔle bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ mmerɛ bɔ olili bia ne amukoraa, ofikyɛ né ɔsɔfo Yehoada tu ye foɛ.

english_verse: Joash became king of Judah in Jehu's seventh year as king of Israel, and he ruled
translation_verse: Yehu lili hene ne, ye afoɛ nzoo ne anu, Yehoase lili hene. Yehoase lili hene afoɛ aburanna wɔ Yerusalem. Oni ole Sibia bɔ ofi Beɛ Hyeba ne.

english_verse: The fines that had to be paid along with the sacrifices to make things right and the sacrifices for sin did not go to the temple. This money belonged only to the priests.
translation_verse: Foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ, ɔne bɔne nwo afɔleɛ esikaa ne de, bamva bangɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ bie; né ɔte asɔfo nemɔ deɛ. Hasael fa koɛ kɔtoa Yerusalem

english_verse: But even Joash did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nakoso asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ de wanzɛkye bɛ. Maen ne hɔle so bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛyerale ɛyɛɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso.

english_verse: One day, Joash said to the priests, “Collect all the money that has been given to the Lord's temple, whether from taxes or gifts,
translation_verse: Na Yehoase sele asɔfo nemɔ kyɛ, “Esikaa amukoraa bɔ ɔte akyɛdeɛ krongron bɔ mmenia fa ba AWURADE awuro, bɔ yeɛ ɔte esikaa bɔ bapɛ bama ebiala kyɛ otua ne, ɔne esikaa bɔ ofi akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛba AWURADE awuro ne anu ne,

english_verse: But the priests never started repairing the temple. So in the twenty-third year of his rule,
translation_verse: Nakoso Yehoase lili hene ne, ye afoɛ aburanyɔ ne nza ne anu, né asɔfo nemɔ bennya bɛyyɔle awuro ne nekaa biala yé.

english_verse: Joash called for Jehoiada and the other priests and said, “Why aren't you using the money to repair the temple? Don't take any more money for yourselves. It is only to be used to pay for the repairs.”
translation_verse: Yiti Nana Yehoase tole ye sa frɛle ɔsɔfo Yehoada ne asɔfo ngaa nemɔ, na obisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔnyɔ awuro ne yé ɔ? Ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, esikaa bɔ ɛmɔdide befi bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ nemɔ berɛ ne, nnɛmaa ɛmɔfa besie ko, na mmom ɛ́mɔfa esikaa ne bɛma yɛyɔ awuro ne yé.”

english_verse: The priests agreed that they would not collect any more money or be in charge of the temple repairs.
translation_verse: Yiti asɔfo nemɔ bele bɛtole nu kyɛ bengole esikaa ne bengofi bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ne berɛ ko, yeɛ afei bɛkɔmaa mmenia foforɛ kɔyɔ awuro ne nwo adwuma ne.

english_verse: Jehoiada found a wooden box; he cut a hole in the top of it and set it on the right side of the altar where people went into the temple. Whenever someone gave money to the temple, the priests guarding the entrance would put it into this box.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɔsɔfo Yehoada fale alaka, otofili bɔen wɔ ye ngatasoɛ ne anu, na ɔfa siele afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo. Sɛ ɛkwaawura AWURADE awuro ne anu a, ɔwɔ wɔ sa famaa so. Asɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛwɛne anoa ne, bɛfale esikaa bɔ mmenia fa wale AWURADE awuro ne amukoraa beguale alaka ne anu.

english_verse: When the box was full of money, the king's secretary and the chief priest would count the money and put it in bags.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ biala, sɛ benwu kyɛ esikaa bɔ bafa bagua alaka ne anu ne wasone a, Nana ye ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne, ɔne ɔsɔfo panyi ne, bɛkɔye bɛka, na bɛbɔ ye borɛ mmɔtɔ nu.

english_verse: Then they would give it to the men supervising the repairs to the temple. Some of the money was used to pay the builders, the woodworkers,
translation_verse: Bɛfa esikaa bɔ baha ne bɛma adwumayɔlɛfoɛ bɔ AWURADE awuro ne anwo adwuma wura bɛ sa ne. Na sɔ mmenia nemɔ fa esikaa ne betuatua ɛhemɔ kerɛ: bakaa dwumvoɛ mɔ ne suasilɛfoɛ bɔ bɛyɔ AWURADE awuro ne anwo adwuma ne,

english_verse: the stonecutters, and the men who built the walls. And some was used to buy wood and stone and to pay any other costs for repairing the temple.
translation_verse: bɛ bɔ bɛto sua ne, ɔne bɛ bɔ bedwa nyɔboɛ ne. Afei koso bɛfale bie bɛtɔle ndaboa ne nyɔboɛ bɔ base ɔ bɔ bɛfa bɛyɔle AWURADE awuro ne anwo adwuma ɔ, ɔne kerɛ biala bɔ odi kyɛ bɛbɔ ye wɔ awuro ne anwo ɔ.

english_verse: While the repairs were being made, the money that was given to the temple was not used to make silver bowls, lamp snuffers, small sprinkling bowls, trumpets, or anything gold or silver for the temple.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE awuro ne anu ayaa bɔ bafa ɛdwetɛ bayɔ ɔ nemɔ, akapɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛtengyɛtengyɛ kanea nyamaa nemɔ, turonzemaa nemɔ, totorobɛndo nemɔ anaa nikyee biala bɔ bafa esikaa kɔkorɛ anaa ɛdwetɛ bayɔ ɔ de, bamva esikaa bɔ bɛfa bɛwale AWURADE awuro ne bie bandɔ,

english_verse: The men in charge were honest, so no one had to keep track of the money.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmenia bɔ bɛfale esikaa ne bewurale bɛ sa kyɛ bɛfa betuatua adwumayɔlɛfoɛ ne kerɛ ne, bamma bammu ye nwo ngondaa, ofikyɛ né bedi nahorɛ.

english_verse: About the same time, King Hazael of Syria attacked the town of Gath and captured it. Next, he decided to attack Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, Siria hene Hasael ɔfale koɛ ɔɔtoale Gate, na olili so ngonim. Nakoso Hasael fale ye nye hyirele Yerusalem ɔfale koɛ ɔɔtoale ye ne,

english_verse: So Joash collected everything he and his ancestors Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, and Ahaziah had dedicated to the Lord, as well as the gold in the storage rooms in the temple and palace. He sent it all to Hazael as a gift, and when Hazael received it, he ordered his troops to leave Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yuda hene Yehoase sesale sɔ nningyein hemɔ ɔɔmane Siria hene Hasael: anohoba afɔleɛ nningyein amukoraa bɔ Yehoase ye mbanyi mɔ Yehosafate, Yehoram ne Ahasia bɔ bɛte Yuda ahemvo ne, batu basie berɛ bama AWURADE ne, ɔne ye bɔbɔ ye anohoba afɔleɛ nningyein nemɔ, yeɛ esikaa kɔkorɛ amukoraa bɔ né ɔwɔ AWURADE awuro nekaa bɔ besie nningyein ne, ɔne esikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ahemvie berɛ ne. Yiti Hasael yakyili koɛ bɔ ɔkwaafa toa Yerusalem ne. Yoase wue

english_verse: Everything else Joash did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Afei Yoase nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yuda ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: At the end of his rule, some of his officers rebelled against him. Jozabad son of Shimeath and Jehozabad son of Shomer murdered him in a building where the land was filled in on the east side of Jerusalem, near the road to Silla. Joash was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Amaziah became king.
translation_verse: Simeate awa Yosaka ɔne Somere awa Yehosabade bɔ bɛte ye mbanyi mɔ ne yeɛ behuni ye ɔ. Besiele ye wɔ nekaa bɔ besiele ye mbanyi mɔ ɔ, wɔ Dawide kuro, na ɔwa bienzua Amasia lili ye bia.

english_verse: Jehoahaz son of Jehu became king of Israel in the twenty-third year of Joash's rule in Judah. Jehoahaz ruled
translation_verse: Yuda hene Ahasia ɔwa Yoase lili Yuda so hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne nza ne anu, Yehu awa Yehoahase lili Yisrael so hene wɔ Samaria. Olili hene afoɛ buru ne nzoo.

english_verse: and said, “Open the window facing east.” When it was open, Elisha shouted, “Now shoot!” Jehoash shot an arrow and Elisha said, “That arrow is a sign that the Lord will help you completely defeat the Syrian army at Aphek.”
translation_verse: Na Elisa sele ye kyɛ, “Bukye eyia afiteleɛ mboma ne.” Na obukyele mboma ne. Elisa sele kyɛ, “To agyaen ne.” Na ɔtole. Yeɛ Elisa sele kyɛ, “AWURADE ngonimlilɛ agyaen ɛhe! Siria so ngonimlilɛ agyaen ne ɛhe! Ofikyɛ ɛne Siriafoɛ kɔho wɔ Afeke kɔpem kyɛ ekonua bɛ boso koraa ɔ.”

english_verse: and disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong. He never stopped following the example of Jeroboam, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Nebate awa Yeroboam ye bɔne bɔ ɔyɔle, bɔ ɔhwehwene Yisrael hɔle nu ne, Yehoahase koso wandwe ye nwo wamvi ye nwo, na ɔyɔle bie.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with the Israelites, so he let King Hazael of Syria and his son Benhadad rule over them for a long time.
translation_verse: AWURADE fɛle Yisrael so yaa piri, maa ɔnate so ɔfale bɛ wurale Siria hene Hasael sa mmerɛ pee, yeɛ afei ɔfale bɛ wurale Hasael awa Ben Hadade koso sa.

english_verse: Jehoahaz prayed to the Lord for help, and the Lord saw how terribly Hazael was treating the Israelites. He answered Jehoahaz
translation_verse: Nakoso Yehoahase sũ frɛle AWURADE, na AWURADE tiele ye, ofikyɛ AWURADE nwuni kyɛbɔ Siria hene osi teetee Yisraelfoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: by sending Israel a leader who rescued them from the Syrians, and the Israelites lived in peace as they had before.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE yele defoɛ mane Yisrael, maa ɔnate so benyane bɛ fawɔnwodi befili Siriafoɛ sa nu, na Yisraelfoɛ bɛtenane bɛ bɔbɔ b’awuro kyɛ daa ne ala.

english_verse: Jehoash became king of Israel in the thirty-seventh year of Joash's rule in Judah, and he ruled
translation_verse: Yuda hene Yoase lili hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburasa ne nzoo ne anu, Yehoahase awa Yehoase lili Yisrael so hene wɔ Samaria. Olili hene afoɛ buru ne nzia.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoahaz did while he was king, including his brave deeds, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Afei Yehoahase nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, ɔne ye anwoserɛ, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yisrael ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: Jehoahaz died and was buried in Samaria, and his son Jehoash became king. King Jehoash of Israel
translation_verse: Yehoahase toale ye mbanyi mɔ. Besiele ye wɔ Samaria, na ɔwa bienzua Yoase lili ye bia. Yehoase di Yisrael so hene

english_verse: “Grab a bow and some arrows,” Elisha told him, “and hold them in your hand.” Jehoash grabbed the bow and arrows and held them. Elisha placed his hand on the king's hand
translation_verse: Yeɛ Elisa sele Yisrael hene Yoase kyɛ, “Twe agyaen ne anu.” Na ɔhwene nu. Elisa fale ye sa guale Nana Yoase sa nemɔ aso.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his war against King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Afei Yoase nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, ɔne anwoserɛ bɔ ɔfa ho tiale Yuda hene Amasia ne, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yisrael ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: Jehoash died and was buried in Samaria beside the other Israelite kings. His son Jeroboam then became king. Elisha the Prophet Dies
translation_verse: Yoase toale ye mbanyi mɔ, na Yeroboam lili ye bia. Besiele Yoase wɔ Samaria wɔ Yisrael ahemvo asieleɛ. Elisa wue

english_verse: Some time before the death of King Jehoash, Elisha the prophet was very sick and about to die. Jehoash went in and stood beside him, crying. He said, “Master, what will Israel's chariots and cavalry be able to do without you?”
translation_verse: Afei mmerɛ bɔ Elisa bɔle anwonyerɛ bɔ ɔnate so maa nziɛ ye owuli ne, Yisrael hene Yoase hɔle ye berɛ, na oosuni wɔ ye nyunu berɛ sele kyɛ, “Me baba ee! Me baba ee! Yisrael teaseɛnam mɔ ne pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ ee!”

english_verse: Elisha said, “Pick up the arrows and hit the ground with them.” Jehoash grabbed the arrows and hit the ground three times, then stopped.
translation_verse: Elisa toale so hane kyɛ, “Sesa agyaen nemɔ.” Na ɔsesale. Yeɛ Elisa sele Yisrael hene kyɛ, “To agyaen nemɔ fa wowɔ ase.” Yisrael hene tole agyaen ne pɛen nza, na ɔyakyili.

english_verse: Elisha became angry with the king and exclaimed, “If you had struck it five or six times, you would completely wipe out the Syrians. Now you will defeat them only three times.”
translation_verse: Nyameɛ sona ne fɛle ye so yaa, na osele kyɛ, “Ahaa odi kyɛ ɛto pɛen nnu anaa pɛen nzia. Ye sɔ ne, ahaa ekohu Siriafoɛ alaa kɔpem kyɛ ekonua bɛ boso ɔ. Nakoso bɔ ayɔ ye de, ekoli Siria so ngonim pɛen nza pɛ.”

english_verse: Elisha died and was buried. Every year in the spring, Moab's leaders sent raiding parties into Israel.
translation_verse: Afei Elisa wuli, na besiele ye. Sɛ bɛhyɛ afoɛ bo biala a, ɔyɛ a né Moabo koɛhonɛfoɛ mɔ bɛfa koɛ bɛbateta Yisrael maen ne.

english_verse: Once, while some Israelites were burying a man's body, they saw a group of Moabites. The Israelites quickly threw the body into Elisha's tomb and ran away. As soon as the man's body touched the bones of Elisha, the man came back to life and stood up. Israel Defeats Syria
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Yisraelfoɛ wɔ so bɔ besie biaa bie ne, benwuni Moabofoɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ bɛbɔ apaa ɔ. Yiti begyili fuin ne bɛtole Elisa asieleɛ ne anu. Biaa ne fuin ne hane Elisa mmowue pɛ, otingyele fili ewue nu, na odwɔsole gyinane ye gya so. Yisrael sa de ye nguro fi Siria sa nu

english_verse: Israel was under the power of King Hazael of Syria during the entire rule of Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Siria hene Hasael tanene Yisrael nye mmerɛ bɔ né Yehoahase di hene ne amukoraa.

english_verse: But the Lord was kind to the Israelites and showed them mercy because of his solemn agreement with their ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. In fact, he has never turned his back on them or let them be completely destroyed.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE lole bɛ, na onwuni bɛ anwumvoin. Ɔnate ye apam bɔ ɔne Abraham, Yisake ne Yakob yɛle ne ati, ɔpɛnene ye nye neane Yisrael. Na wangukũ bɛ, yeɛ wambɛ bɛ asue wamvi ye nyunu maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

english_verse: Hazael died, and his son Benhadad then became king of Syria.
translation_verse: Siria hene Hasael wuli ne, ɔwa bienzua Ben Hadade lili ye bia.

english_verse: King Jehoash of Israel attacked and defeated the Syrian army three times. He took back from Benhadad all the towns Hazael had captured in battle from his father Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Na Yisrael nguro bɔ Ben Hadade baba Hasael ole fili Yehoase baba Yehoahase ye sa nu wɔ koɛ nu ne, Yehoase sa le fili Ben Hadade sa nu. Yoase lili Ben Hadade so ngonim pɛen nza, na osa lele Yisrael nguro nemɔ.

english_verse: Jeroboam extended the boundaries of Israel from Lebo-Hamath in the north to the Dead Sea in the south, just as the Lord had promised his servant Jonah son of Amittai, who was a prophet from Gath-Hepher.
translation_verse: Ɔhone koɛ osa lele Yisrael aseɛ bɔ ye wɛen fi Lebo Hamate kɔpem Araba Ɛpo ne, kyɛbɔ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ dwirɛ bɔ ɔnate ye somvoɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yona so hane ne, ɔte ne ala. Yona fi Gate Hefa, na ye baba ole Amitae.

english_verse: Amaziah son of Joash became king of Judah in the second year of Jehoash's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Yisrael hene Yoahase ɔwa bienzua Nana Yoase lili Yisrael hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu, Yuda hene Yoase ɔwa bienzua Amasia lili Yuda so hene.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord by following the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Nebate awa Yeroboam bɔne amukoraa bɔ ɔyɔle, bɔ ɔhwehwene Yisrael hɔle nu ne, Yeroboam wandwe ye nwo wamvi ye nwo.

english_verse: Jeroboam died and was buried, and his son Zechariah became king.
translation_verse: Yeroboam toale ye mbanyi Yisrael ahemvo mɔ, na ɔwa bienzua Sakaria lili ye bia.

english_verse: Amaziah followed the example of his father Joash by obeying the Lord and doing right. But he was not as faithful as his ancestor David.
translation_verse: Amasia yɔle bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ; nakoso wandwu ye nana Dawide. Bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraati te kyɛ bɔ ɔse Yoase yɔle ne pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Amaziah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nakoso asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ de wanzɛkye bɛ. Na maen ne hɔle so bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛyerale ɛyɛɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso.

english_verse: As soon as Amaziah had control of Judah, he arrested and killed the officers who had murdered his father.
translation_verse: Ahennie tumi ne oolili ye sa pɛ, ye mbanyi mɔ bɔ behuni ye baba bɔ né ɔte ɛhene ne, ohuhuni bɛ.

english_verse: But the children of those officers were not killed. The Lord had commanded in the Law of Moses that only the people who sinned were to be punished, not their parents or children.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɔ kodiawufoɛ nemɔ, bɛ mma nemɔ de, wangukũ bɛ, kyɛbɔ amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Mose mmeraa nwomaa ne anu ne. Nu yeɛ AWURADE ahyɛ kyɛ, “Nnɛmaa begyina mmaa mɔ bɛ bɔne so beku awofoɛ, yeɛ nnɛmaa begyina awofoɛ bɛ bɔne so beku mmaa; na mmom ebiala ye bɔne so yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ begyina beku ye ɔ.”

english_verse: Amaziah, you think you're so powerful because you defeated Edom. Go ahead and celebrate—but stay at home. If you cause any trouble, both you and your kingdom of Judah will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ali Edom so ngonim amba ama wɔ ti anu ayɛ wɔ fɛ. Ma wɔ nye sɔ animnyam bɔ anya ye ne, ná tena wɔ maen nu. Nzu ati yeɛ ɛtwetwe edwirɛ ba maa ɛne Yuda ɛmɔdi ngoguo ye?”

english_verse: One day, Amaziah sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel: “Come out and face me in battle!”
translation_verse: Amasia tuli ɛbɔfoɛ maa bɛhɔle Yisrael hene Yehu awa Yehoahase ɔwa Nana Yehoase berɛ kyɛ, “Bra maa yɛfa yɛbɔ so!”

english_verse: Jehoash sent back this reply: Once upon a time, a small thornbush in Lebanon announced that his son was going to marry the daughter of a large cedar tree. But a wild animal came along and trampled the small bush.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yisrael hene Yehoase koso tole ngraa ɔɔmane Yuda hene Amasia kyɛ, “Lebanon ɛfone bie somane maa beesele Lebanon sida bie kyɛ, ‘Fa ɛwa brasua ma mma bienzua ogya yeɛ’ nakoso Lebanon kaka aboyaa bie ɔɔpɛle nu berɛ otiatiale ɛfone ne aso.

english_verse: But Amaziah refused to listen. So Jehoash and his troops marched to the town of Beth-Shemesh in Judah to attack Amaziah and his troops.
translation_verse: Nakoso Amasia andɛ ye so. Yiti Yisrael hene Yehoase hɔle ɔne Yuda hene Amasia bɛɛfale koɛ bɛtetale so wɔ Yuda kuro Bete Semese.

english_verse: During the battle, Judah's army was crushed. Every soldier from Judah ran back home,
translation_verse: Yisrael lili Yuda so ngonim, na Yuda koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ amukoraa bɛnwati bɛhɔle b’awuro.

english_verse: He took the gold and silver, as well as everything of value from the Lord's temple and the king's treasury. He took hostages, then returned to Samaria.
translation_verse: Yisrael hene Yehoase sesale nningyein hemɔ amukoraa hɔle: esikaa kɔkorɛ amukoraa, ɛdwetɛ amukoraa, ɔne ngukue amukoraa bɔ ɔwɔ AWURADE awuro ɔne Nana Amasia ahemvie berɛ ɔ, yeɛ mmenia bɔ bahye bɛ nnure ne amukoraa, na ɔfa bɛ hɔle Samaria.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoash did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he defeated King Amaziah of Judah, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Afei Yehoase nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ye koɛ nu anwoserɛ, ɔne kyɛbɔ osi ɔne Yuda hene Amasia bɛhone, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yisrael ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: After his death the people of Judah made his son Azariah king, even though he was only
translation_verse: Afei Amasia awa Asaria bɔ né wali afoɛ buru ne nzia ne, Yudafoɛ amukoraa bɛfale ye belili hene maa olili ye baba bia.

english_verse: Azariah was the one who later recaptured and rebuilt the town of Elath. King Jeroboam the Second of Israel
translation_verse: Amasia toale ye mbanyi mɔ ne asi ne, Asaria sa kyekyele Elate, na osa fa bokale Yuda maen ne aso. Yisrael hene Yeroboam

english_verse: The Lord helped Jeroboam do this because he had seen how terribly the Israelites were suffering, whether slave or free, and no one was left to help them.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwuni kyɛ amaneɛ bɔ Yisrael wɔ nu ne ɔte piri. Né sona biala nne berɛ, kyɛ kanga oo anaakyɛ dehyeɛ oo, bɔ ɔkɔhora kɔpepɛ kole Yisrael ɔ.

english_verse: And since the Lord had promised that he would not let Israel be completely destroyed, he helped Jeroboam rescue them.
translation_verse: Nakoso né AWURADE ɔhhane kyɛ okonua Yisrael dumaa bo kofi wiase, yiti ɔfale Yoase awa Yeroboam so ɔpepɛ lele bɛ.

english_verse: Everything else Jeroboam did while he was king, including his brave deeds and how he recaptured the towns of Damascus and Hamath, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Afei Yeroboam nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, ɔne ye koɛ nu anwoserɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔho lele Yuda nguro Damasko ne Hamate ɔɔbokale Yisrael so ne, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yisrael ahemvo bɛ nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: Chronicles
translation_verse: Aberɛso Dwirɛ

english_verse: Everything else Pekahiah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Pekah of Israel
translation_verse: Afei Pekahia nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yisrael ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu. Peka di Yisrael so hene

english_verse: Pekahiah became king of Israel in the fiftieth year of Azariah's rule in Judah, and he ruled two years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Yuda hene Asaria lili hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburannu ne anu, Menahem awa Pekahia lili Yisrael so hene wɔ Samaria. Olili hene afoɛ nyɔ.

english_verse: Azariah obeyed the Lord by doing right, as his father Amaziah had done.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɔle bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔse Amasia yɔle ne ala.

english_verse: But Azariah did not destroy the local shrines, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nakoso asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ de wanzɛkye bɛ. Na maen ne hɔle so bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛyerale ɛyɛɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso.

english_verse: The Lord punished Azariah with leprosy for the rest of his life. He wasn't allowed to live in the royal palace, so his son Jotham lived there and ruled in his place.
translation_verse: AWURADE hwene Nana Asaria so, maa kwata anwonyerɛ bɔle ye toonn kɔpem kyɛ owuli ɔ. Ɔnate anwonyerɛ ne ati, né ye ngome waatena awuro bie anu. Ɔwa bienzua Yotam yeɛ né ɔnea ahemvie berɛ ɔ, na ye yeɛ né ɔnea maen ne anu ama so ɔ.

english_verse: Everything else Azariah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Afei Asaria nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yuda ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: Azariah died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem. His son Jotham then became king. King Zechariah of Israel
translation_verse: Asaria toale ye mbanyi mɔ. Besiele ye wɔ nekaa bɔ besiele ye mbanyi mɔ ɔ wɔ Dawide kuro, na ɔwa bienzua Yotam lili ye bia. Sakaria di Yisrael so hene

english_verse: Zechariah son of Jeroboam became king of Israel in the thirty-eighth year of Azariah's rule in Judah, but he ruled only six months from Samaria.
translation_verse: Yuda hene Asaria lili bia ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburasa ne mmɔtwɛ ne anu, Yeroboam awa Sakaria lili Yisrael so hene wɔ Samaria. Olili hene bosome nzia.

english_verse: Shallum son of Jabesh plotted against Zechariah and killed him in public. Shallum then became king.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yabese awa Salum bɔle ye nwo porɛ opurale ye huni ye wɔ badwa nu, na ɔfale ye bia ne lili.

english_verse: So the Lord had kept his promise to Jehu that the next four kings of Israel would come from his family. Everything else Zechariah did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel. King Shallum of Israel
translation_verse: Bɔhyɛ bɔ AWURADE hyɛle Yehu ole kyɛ, “Wɔ mma mmienzua mɔ koli Yisrael bia maa okoodwu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ nna so.” Na ɔwale nu sɔ ala. Salum di Yisrael so hene

english_verse: Shallum became king of Israel in the thirty-ninth year of Azariah's rule in Judah. But only one month after Shallum became king,
translation_verse: Yuda hene Yusia lili bia ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburasa ne ngona ne anu, Yabese awa Salum lili Yisrael so hene wɔ Samaria. Olili hene bosome ko.

english_verse: Menahem became king of Israel in Azariah's thirty-ninth year as king of Judah, and he ruled Israel ten years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Yuda hene Asaria lili bia ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburasa ne ngona ne anu, Gadi awa Menahem lili Yisrael so hene. Olili hene afoɛ buru wɔ Samaria.

english_verse: He constantly disobeyed the Lord by following the example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Nebate awa Yeroboam bɔne bɔ ɔyɔle, bɔ ɔhwehwene Yisrael hɔle nu ne, Mehanem wandwe ye nwo wamvi ye nwo, mmerɛ bɔ né ɔte ngoa nu amukoraa.

english_verse: During Menahem's rule, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria invaded Israel. He agreed to help Menahem keep control of his kingdom, if Menahem would pay him over
translation_verse: Asiria hene Pulu fale koɛ ɔɔtetale Yisrael maen ne, na Menahem mane Pulu ɛdwetɛ talɛnde apee ko, kyɛ ɔma ɔhɔ so ɔtena bia ne aso.

english_verse: Jotham followed the example of his father by obeying the Lord and doing right.
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔse Yusia yɔle ne ala.

english_verse: Everything else Menahem did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Afei Menahem nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yisrael ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: Menahem died, and his son Pekahiah became king. King Pekahiah of Israel
translation_verse: Menahem toale ye mbanyi mɔ, na ɔwa bienzua Pekahia lili ye bia. Pekahia di Yisrael so hene

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord and caused the Israelites to sin, just as Jeroboam son of Nebat had done.
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Nebate awa Yeroboam ye bɔne bɔ ɔyɔle, bɔ ɔhwehwene Yisrael hɔle nu ne, Pekahia wandwe ye nwo wamvi ye nwo.

english_verse: He disobeyed the Lord and followed the evil example of Jeroboam son of Nebat, who had caused the Israelites to sin.
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Nebate awa Yeroboam ye bɔne bɔ ɔyɔle, bɔ ɔhwehwene Yisrael hɔle nu ne, Peka wandwe ye nwo wamvi ye nwo.

english_verse: During Pekah's rule, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria marched into Israel. He captured the territories of Gilead and Galilee, including the towns of Ijon, Abel-Bethmaacah, Janoah, Kedesh, and Hazor, as well as the entire territory of Naphtali. Then he took Israelites from those regions to Assyria as prisoners.
translation_verse: Yisrael hene Peka aberɛ so, Asiria hene Tiglate Pilese ɔɔho fale Yisrael nguro hemɔ: Yiyon, Abel Bete Maaka, Yanoa, Kedese, Hasɔ, Gileade, Galilea, ɔne Nafetali aseɛ amukoraa; na ɔhyele mmenia nemɔ nnure fale bɛ hɔle Asiria.

english_verse: In the twentieth year of Jotham's rule in Judah, Hoshea son of Elah plotted against Pekah and murdered him. Hoshea then became king of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Yusia awa Yotam lili hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne anu, Ela awa Hosea bɔle Remalia awa Peka nwo porɛ. Opurale ye huni ye, na ɔfale ye bia lili.
