translation_verse: Afei Peka nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yisrael ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu. Yotam di Yuda so hene (

english_verse: Jotham son of Azariah became king of Judah in the second year of Pekah's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Remalia awa Peka lili Yisrael so hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu, Yotam bɔ ye baba ole Yusia ne, olili Yuda so hene.

english_verse: It was Jotham who rebuilt the Upper Gate that led into the court around the Lord's temple. But the local shrines were not destroyed, and they were still used as places for offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Nakoso asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ de wanzɛkye bɛ, na maen ne hɔle so bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛyerale ɛyɛɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso. Pambim bɔ ɔwɔ AWURADE awuro ne sorɔ dɔ ne, osili.

english_verse: Everything else Jotham did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Afei Yotam nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yuda ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: During his rule, the Lord let King Rezin of Syria and King Pekah of Israel start attacking Judah.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, AWURADE hyɛle ye bo somane Siria hene Resin, yeɛ Remalia awa Peka maa bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtetale Yuda.

english_verse: Jotham died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Ahaz became king.
translation_verse: Yotam toale ye mbanyi mɔ. Besiele ye wɔ nekaa bɔ besiele ye mbanyi mɔ ɔ, wɔ ye Nana Dawide kuro. Na ɔwa bienzua Ahase lili ye bia.

english_verse: Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah in the seventeenth year of Pekah's rule in Israel.
translation_verse: Remalia awa Peka lili hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nzoo ne anu, Ahase bɔ ye baba ole Yotam ne, olili Yuda so hene.

english_verse: Ahaz died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Hezekiah became king.
translation_verse: Ahase toale ye mbanyi mɔ. Besiele ye wɔ nekaa bɔ besiele ye mbanyi mɔ ɔ, wɔ Dawide kuro, na ɔwa bienzua Hesekia lili ye bia.

english_verse: Uriah did everything Ahaz told him.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo Yuria yɔle bɔ Nana Ahase hyɛle ye ne amukoraa.

english_verse: and was even more sinful than the kings of Israel. He sacrificed his own son, which was a disgusting custom of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel.
translation_verse: Mmom ɔyɔle bɔ Yisrael ahemvo mɔ bɛyɔle ne bie. Maen maen bɔ AWURADE foane bɛ fili Yisraelfoɛ nyunu ne, musue nningyein bɔ né bɛyɔ ne, ye koso ɔyɔle bie. Ɔfale ɔwa bienzua po bɔle afɔleɛ wɔ see nu kyɛbɔ né maen maen nemɔ bɛyɔ ne ala.

english_verse: Ahaz offered sacrifices at the local shrines, as well as on every hill and in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔle afɔleɛ ɔyerale ɛyɛɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso, wɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso, ɔne bakaa monɛ biala bo.

english_verse: Ahaz sent a message to King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria that said, “Your Majesty, King Rezin and King Pekah are attacking me, your loyal servant. Please come and rescue me.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Ahase tuli ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ maa bɛhɔle Asiria hene Tiglate Pilese berɛ kyɛ, “Nde w’akoaa ne ɛwa. Bra baale me fi Siria hene sa nu, ɔne Yisrael hene sa nu, ofikyɛ bafa koɛ baateta me.”

english_verse: Along with the message, Ahaz sent silver and gold from the Lord's temple and from the palace treasury as a gift for the Assyrian king.
translation_verse: Afei Ahase sesale ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ ɔwɔ AWURADE awuro ne, ɔne bɔ ɔwɔ ahemvie fotoɛ nu ne, na ɔfa ɔɔhyɛle Asiria hene.

english_verse: As soon as Tiglath Pileser received the message, he and his troops marched to Syria. He captured the capital city of Damascus, then he took the people living there to the town of Kir as prisoners and killed King Rezin.
translation_verse: Asiria hene tiele Ahase dwirɛ ne, yiti Asiria hene fale koɛ ɔɔtetale Damasko, na olili so ngonim. Ɔhyele Damasko nu mmenia nnure fale bɛ hɔle Kire, na ohuni Resin.

english_verse: Later, Ahaz went to Damascus to meet Tiglath Pileser. And while Ahaz was there, he saw an altar and sent a model of it back to Uriah the priest, along with the plans for building one.
translation_verse: Nana Ahase hɔle ooyiale Asiria hene Tiglate Pilese wɔ Damasko nen, onwuni afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ né ɔwɔ Damasko ne. Yiti Nana Ahase somane maa bɛfale afɔleɛ bokyea ne, ye piri ne ye tendenn nwo nhwɛsoɛ pɛpɛpɛpɛ bɛɛmane ɔsɔfo Yuria.

english_verse: Uriah followed the plans and built an altar exactly like the one in Damascus, finishing it just before Ahaz came back.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo Yuria sili afɔleɛ bokyea ne. Kyɛbɔ Nana Ahase fa somane fili Damasko brɛle ye ne, osili ye sɛso koraka yeɛ Nana Ahase ofi Damasko ɔba ɔ.

english_verse: When Ahaz returned, he went to see the altar and to offer sacrifices on it. He walked up to the altar
translation_verse: Nana Ahase fili Damasko wale ne, ɔɔneane afɔleɛ bokyea ne. Nana Ahase pingyele afɔleɛ bokyea ne, ɔfole ye simbini ne aso,

english_verse: and poured wine over it. Then he offered sacrifices to please the Lord, to give him thanks, and to ask for his blessings.
translation_verse: na ɔbɔle ye naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, ye aburoo afɔleɛ, yeɛ ye anonneɛ afɔleɛ, na ɔtole ye asomdwee afɔleɛ nemɔ mogya petene afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo.

english_verse: After that, he had the bronze altar moved aside, so his new altar would be right in front of the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Kɔɔbere afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ né ogyi AWURADE nyunu ne, Ahase ye fili AWURADE awuro ne anyunu. Ɔye fili ye afɔleɛ bokyea deɛ ne, ɔne AWURADE awuro ne b’afia, na ɔfa oosiele ye afɔleɛ bokyea deɛ ne ye sorɔ.

english_verse: He told Uriah the priest: From now on, the morning and evening sacrifices as well as all gifts of grain and wine are to be offered on this altar. The sacrifices for the people and for the king must also be offered here. Sprinkle the blood from all the sacrifices on it, but leave the bronze altar for me to use for prayer and finding out what God wants me to do.
translation_verse: Afei Nana Ahase fale ahyɛdeɛ mane ɔsɔfo Yuria kyɛ, “Ngyerɛmɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, nɔsoa aburoo afɔleɛ ne, Yuda hene ye naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne ɔne ye aburoo afɔleɛ ne, yeɛ afei maen ne anu ama amukoraa bɛ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, b’aburoo afɔleɛ ne anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔboka so ne, odi kyɛ ɛbɔ ye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea piri ne aso. Odi kyɛ ɛto naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ mogya ne amukoraa, ɔne afɔleɛ mogya ne amukoraa pete afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo. Nakoso kɔɔbere afɔleɛ bokyea ne de, so yeɛ ngɔhɔ ngoobisa Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Ahaz also had the side panels and the small bowls taken off the movable stands in the Lord's temple. He had the large bronze bowl, called the Sea, removed from the bronze bulls on which it rested and had it placed on a stand made of stone.
translation_verse: Afei Nana Ahase tutuli nyinasoɛ nemɔ, ɔpagyale ayaa ne fili so, ɔyele nzim ne fili kɔɔbere nandwie bɔ owura ye bo ne aso, na ɔfa siele nyɔboɛ simbini bie aso.

english_verse: He took down the special tent that was used for worship on the Sabbath and closed up the private entrance that the kings of Judah used for going into the temple. He did all these things to please Tiglath Pileser.
translation_verse: Yeɛ atee bɔ bɛfa so wɔ ahemvie berɛ afofikyẽa ne, ɔne Yuda hene atee bɔ ɔfa so fite fi AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu ne, apata bɔ ɔkata bɛ so ne, Ahase tutuli, ofikyɛ né ɔpena kyɛ ɔsɔ Asiria hene nye.

english_verse: Everything else Ahaz did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah.
translation_verse: Afei Ahase nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, amba, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yuda ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel in the twelfth year of Ahaz's rule in Judah, and he ruled nine years from Samaria.
translation_verse: Yuda hene Ahase lili bia ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nyɔ ne anu, Ela awa Hosea lili Yisrael so hene wɔ Samaria. Olili hene afoɛ ngona.

english_verse: Hoshea disobeyed the Lord and sinned, but not as much as the earlier Israelite kings had done.
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Nakoso ye bɔne deɛ ne, ondwu Yisrael ahemvo bɔ belili ye nyunu moa bɛtenane bia so ne.

english_verse: During Hoshea's rule, King Shalmaneser of Assyria invaded Israel; he took control of the country and made Hoshea pay taxes.
translation_verse: Asiria hene Salmanese lili Hosea so ngonim wɔ koɛ nu. Yiti Hosea ɔɔyɛle ye akoaa, na né otua toɔ ma ye.

english_verse: But later, Hoshea refused to pay the taxes and asked King So of Egypt to help him rebel. When Shalmaneser found out, he arrested Hoshea and put him in prison. Samaria Is Destroyed and the Israelites Are Taken to Assyria
translation_verse: Nakoso Asiria hene nwuni kyɛ Hosea ɔpena yɛ lɔen, ofikyɛ né Hosea watu ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ maa bahɔ Misraim hene bɔ bafrɛ ye Soo berɛ, yeɛ afei afoɛnoa afoɛnoa toɔ bɔ otua ma Asiria hene ne koso, wamva wangɔ. Yiti Asiria hene hyele Hosea tole kuku nu. Asiriafoɛ kye Yisraelfoɛ nnure

english_verse: Shalmaneser invaded Israel and attacked the city of Samaria for three years,
translation_verse: Asiria hene fale koɛ ɔɔtetale Yisrael amukoraa, na oodwuli Samaria. Otuale kuro ne afoɛ nza.

english_verse: before capturing it in the ninth year of Hoshea's rule. The Assyrian king took the Israelites away to Assyria as prisoners. He forced some of them to live in the town of Halah, others to live near the Habor River in the territory of Gozan, and still others to live in towns where the Median people lived.
translation_verse: Hosea lili hene ne, afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so ngona ne anu, Asiria hene ho fale Samaria. Ɔsesale Yisraelfoɛ hɔle Asiria. Ɔfale bɛ ooguale Hala, asue Habo bɔ ɔla Gosan ne anoa, ɔne Medese nguro nemɔ aso.

english_verse: All of this happened because the people of Israel had sinned against the Lord their God, who had rescued them from Egypt, where they had been slaves. They worshiped foreign gods,
translation_verse: Ɛhe sili ofikyɛ né Yisraelfoɛ bayɔ bɔne batia AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔyele bɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so, ɔne Misraim hene Faro sa nu ne. Yisraelfoɛ sɔnene nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ,

english_verse: followed the customs of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel, and were just as sinful as the Israelite kings.
translation_verse: na maen maen bɔ AWURADE foane bɛ fili Yisraelfoɛ nyunu ne, Yisraelfoɛ yɔle b’amammerɛ nemɔ bie. Afei belili amammerɛ bɔ Yisrael ahemvo mɔ belili bɛ ti piri bɛhyehyɛ bɛmane bɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Even worse, the Israelites tried to hide their sins from the Lord their God. They built their own local shrines everywhere in Israel—from small towns to large, walled cities.
translation_verse: Mvealeɛ nu, Yisraelfoɛ yɔle nningyein bɔ ɔtte mayee betiale AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ. Besisili asɔneyɛɛ sua mɔ bɛmane bɛ nwo wɔ bɛ nguro amukoraa nu, ofi nguro mmaa mmaa so kodwu nguro mbiri bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue ɔ so.

english_verse: They also built stone images of foreign gods and set up sacred poles for the worship of Asherah on every hill and under every shady tree.
translation_verse: Besili mmosoen bonima mɔ ne Asera dosii mɔ wɔ mmokaa ndendenn so ɔne bakaa monɛ biala abo.

english_verse: They offered sacrifices at the shrines, just as the foreign nations had done before the Lord forced them out of Israel. They did sinful things that made the Lord very angry.
translation_verse: Berɛ yeɛ bɛyerale ɛyɛɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ amukoraa so ɔ, kyɛbɔ maen mɔ bɔ AWURADE foane bɛ fili Yisraelfoɛ nyunu nemɔ bɛyɔle ne ala. Bɛyɔle bɔne bɛfa bewurale AWURADE apue maa ɔfɛle yaa.

english_verse: Even though the Lord had commanded the Israelites not to worship idols, they did it anyway.
translation_verse: Né AWURADE ahã ahyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ nnɛmaa bɛsɔne mmosoen mɔ, nakoso bɛsɔnene bɛ.

english_verse: So the Lord made sure that every prophet warned Israel and Judah with these words: “I, the Lord, command you to stop doing sinful things and start obeying my laws and teachings! I gave them to your ancestors, and I told my servants the prophets to repeat them to you.”
translation_verse: Né AWURADE nate ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ amukoraa ne ye mmenia bɔ bɛse ase amukoraa so wabɔ Yisrael ne Yuda kɔkɔ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo béfi ɛmɔ bɔne nwo, ná ɛmɔli me mmeraa dwirɛ ne m’ahyɛdeɛ so, kyɛbɔ mmeraa bɔ nhyehyɛle mane ɛmɔ nana mɔ, bɔ nnate me somvoɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ so mva mmrɛle ɛmɔ ne, ɔte ne ala.”

english_verse: But the Israelites would not listen; they were as stubborn as their ancestors who had refused to worship the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Nakoso bandie, na mmom bɛyɛle asoserɛ kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ bɔ banne AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ banni ne, bɛyɛle ne ala.

english_verse: They ignored the Lord's warnings and commands, and they rejected the solemn agreement he had made with their ancestors. They worshiped worthless idols and became worthless themselves. The Lord had told the Israelites not to do the things that the foreign nations around them were doing, but Israel became just like them.
translation_verse: Ye ahyɛdeɛ, ye apam bɔ ɔne bɛ nana mɔ yɛle, ɔne kɔkɔbɔlɛ bɔ ɔbɔle bɛ nana mɔ ne, bebuli bɛ nye beguale so. Mmosoen bɔ bɛ nwo olle mvasoɛ yeɛ beelili bɛ si ɔ, maa ɔnate so bɛ bɔbɔ koso bɛ so amma mvasoɛ. Maen maen bɔ bapɛ Yisraelfoɛ nwo bayia bɔ AWURADE ahã bɛ nwo dwirɛ ahyire Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ nnɛmaa bɛyɔ bɛ yɔleɛ ne bie ne, bɛ yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ lili bɛ si ɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel disobeyed all the commands of the Lord their God. They made two gold statues of calves and set up a sacred pole for Asherah; they also worshiped the stars and the god Baal.
translation_verse: Bɛpole AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ amukoraa, na behurole nikyee bɛfa bɛyɔle nandwie mmaa amoen nyɔ bɛfale. Begyinane Asera dosii, na bɛsɔnene nyameɛso abɔdeɛ pembepembe amukoraati, na bɛsole Baal.

english_verse: They used magic and witchcraft and even sacrificed their own children. The Israelites were determined to do whatever the Lord hated.
translation_verse: Bɛfale bɛ mma mmienzua ne bɛ mma mmrasua bɛbɔle afɔleɛ wɔ see nu. Bɛyele ngonyaa na bɛhɔle abisa. Na betuli bɛ nwo besiele berɛ bɛyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ bɛfa bewurale ye apue maa ɔfɛle yaa.

english_verse: The Lord became so furious with the people of Israel that he allowed them to be carried away as prisoners. Only the people living in Judah were left,
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE fɛle Yisrael so yaa paa, na ɔfoane bɛ fili ye nyunu; mmusua kure nemɔ anu biala wanga, sana Yuda angome.

english_verse: but they also disobeyed the Lord's commands and acted like the Israelites.
translation_verse: Yuda maen ne koso banni AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ so, na mmom amammerɛ bɔ Yisrael hyehyɛle ne, yeɛ belili so ɔ.

english_verse: So the Lord turned his back on everyone in Israel and let them be punished and defeated until no one was left.
translation_verse: AWURADE pole Yisrael boso ama amukoraa. Ɔhwene bɛ so fale bɛ wurale apaabɔlɛfoɛ mɔ sa, kɔpem kyɛ ɔfoane bɛ fili ye nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: Earlier, when the Lord took the northern tribes away from David's family, the people living in northern Israel chose Jeroboam son of Nebat as their king. Jeroboam caused the Israelites to sin and to stop worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: AWURADE pakyele Yisrael fili Dawide awuro ama nwo ne, Yisraelfoɛ fale Nebate awa Yeroboam belili bɛ so hene. Yeroboam hwehwene Yisraelfoɛ fili AWURADE sililɛ nwo, na ɔmaa bɛyɔle bɔne kandinga paa.

english_verse: until the Lord got rid of them, just as he had warned his servants the prophets. That's why the people of Israel were taken away as prisoners to Assyria, and that's where they remained. Foreigners Are Resettled in Israel
translation_verse: kɔpem kyɛ AWURADE foane bɛ fili ye nyunu, kyɛbɔ ɔnate ye somvoɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ amukoraa so ɔhyɛ tole berɛ ne. Yiti bɛsesale Yisraelfoɛ befili bɛ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ so bɛhɔle Asiria, na batena berɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ. Asiriafoɛ ma amanvrafoɛ batena Samaria

english_verse: The king of Assyria took people who were living in the cities of Babylon, Cuthah, Avva, Hamath, and Sepharvaim, and forced them to move to Israel. They took over the towns where the Israelites had lived, including the capital city of Samaria.
translation_verse: Asiria hene fale mmenia fili Babilɔn, Kuta, Awa, Hamate ne Sefawim, na ɔmaa bɛɛtenatenane Samaria nguro nemɔ aso besili Yisraelfoɛ mɔ agya nu. Bɛfale Samaria bɛyɛle bɛ deɛ, na bɛtenane ye nguro nemɔ aso.

english_verse: At first these people did not worship the Lord, so he sent lions to attack them, and the lions killed some of them.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ bɛɛtenane aseɛ ne aso ne, banzɔne AWURADE, yiti AWURADE somane gyata mɔ maa bɛwale bɛ nu beehuhuni bɛ nu biemɔ.

english_verse: A messenger told the king of Assyria, “The people you moved to Israel don't know how to worship the god of that country. So he sent lions that have attacked and killed some of them.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ bɛbɔle Asiria hene amaneɛ kyɛ, “Mmenia bɔ asoa bɛ afi maen maen mɔ so aagua Samaria nguro nemɔ aso ne, bɛnze aseɛ ne aso nyameɛ ne, ye mmeraa. Yiti wasoma gyata mɔ maa bawa bɛ so. Gyata nemɔ kũkũ bɛ, ofikyɛ bɛnze aseɛ ne aso nyameɛ ne, ye mmeraa.”

english_verse: The king replied, “Get one of the Israelite priests we brought here and send him back to Israel. He can live there and teach them about the god of that country.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Asiria hene hyɛle kyɛ, “Asɔfo nemɔ bɔ ɛmɔhyele bɛ bɛfale bɛ befili Samaria ne, ɛ́mɔma bɛ nu ko ɔhɔ dɔ ɔɔtena dɔ, ná ohyirehyire mmenia nemɔ aseɛ ne aso nyameɛ ne, ye mmeraa.”

english_verse: One of the Israelite priests was chosen to go back to Israel. He lived in Bethel and taught the people how to worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Yiti asɔfo nemɔ bɔ bɛhyele bɛ bɛfale bɛ befili Samaria ne, bɛ nu ko hɔle ɔɔtenane Betel, na ohyirehyirele bɛ kyɛbɔ besi bɛsɔne AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: But in towns all over Israel, the different groups of people made statues of their own gods, then they placed these idols in local Israelite shrines.
translation_verse: Nakoso maen maen ahoroɔ bɔ baatena berɛ ne, bɛ nu biala hɔle so bɛyɔle bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nyameɛ mɔ. Begyinagyinane bɛ wɔ mmosoen sua nu wɔ asɔneyɛɛ bɔ Samariafoɛ nemɔ besisili nemɔ aso. Maen biala anu ama yɔle bɛ deɛ wɔ kuro bɔ bɛte so ne aso:

english_verse: The people from Babylonia made the god Succoth-Benoth; those from Cuthah made the god Nergal; those from Hamath made Ashima;
translation_verse: Babilɔnfoɛ yɔle bɛ nyameɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Sukote Benote; Kutefoɛ yɔle bɛ deɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Negal Hamatefoɛ yɔle bɛ deɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Asima;

english_verse: those from Avva made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the people from Sepharvaim sacrificed their children to their own gods Adrammelech and Anammelech.
translation_verse: Awifoɛ yɔle bɛ deɛ mɔ bɔ bɛfrɛ bɛ Nibase ne Tatake. Sefawimfoɛ yerale bɛ mma mɔ wɔ see nu bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛmane Sefawim nyameɛ mɔ bɔ bɛfrɛ bɛ Adramelɛke ne Anamelɛke.

english_verse: They worshiped their own gods, just as they had before they were taken away to Israel. They also worshiped the Lord, but they chose their own people to be priests at the shrines.
translation_verse: Bɛsɔnene AWURADE de, nakoso bɛsole bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ mmosoen mɔ kyɛbɔ maen maen bɔ bɛfale bɛ befili nu bɛwale nemɔ, bɛyɔ ne ala.

english_verse: Everyone followed their old customs. None of them worshiped only the Lord, and they refused to obey the laws and commands that the Lord had given to the descendants of Jacob, the man he named Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, bɛtɛ yɔ b’amammerɛ daa nemɔ. Benzuro AWURADE. Afei Yakob bɔ AWURADE tole ye dumaa Yisrael ne, AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ ne ye nhyehyɛleɛ ne mmeraa ne mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ ɔfa mane ye bosofoɛ ne, sɔ maenmaensofoɛ nemɔ benni so.

english_verse: At the time when the Lord had made his solemn agreement with the people of Israel, he told them: Do not worship any other gods! Do not bow down to them or offer them a sacrifice.
translation_verse: Né AWURADE ne Yakob boso ama nemɔ bayɛ apam, na ɔmane bɛ ahyɛdeɛ kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔsɔne nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔkoto bɛ, nnɛma ɛmɔso bɛ, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma bɛ.

english_verse: Worship only me! I am the one who rescued you from Egypt with my mighty power. Bow down to me and offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na mmom ɛ́mɔsɔne AWURADE, bɔ ole tumi piri ne tumi asaa yele ɛmɔ fili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne. Odi kyɛ ye yeɛ ɛmɔkoto ye ná ɛmɔbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma ye ɔ.

english_verse: and remember the solemn agreement between us. I will say it again: Do not worship any god
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔ wora fi apam bɔ mene ɛmɔ yɛle ne. Nnɛma ɛmɔsɔne nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ;

english_verse: except me. I am the Lord your God, and I will rescue you from all your enemies.
translation_verse: na mmom odi kyɛ ɛmɔsɔne AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ, na okole ɛmɔ kofi ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ amukoraa bɛ sa nu.”

english_verse: But the people living in Israel ignored that command and kept on following their old customs.
translation_verse: Nakoso bandie, na mmom bɛhɔle so bɛyɔle kyɛbɔ bɛyɔ ye daa ne ala.

english_verse: They did worship the Lord, but they also worshiped their own idols. Their descendants did the same thing.
translation_verse: Yiti sɔ maen maen nemɔ sɔnene AWURADE de, nakoso besa bɛsole b’amoen mɔ bɔ base ɔ. Ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, bɛ mma mɔ ne bɛ nnomaa mɔ, bɛtɛ yɔ kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ yɔle ne ala.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by Hezekiah. He can't save you.
translation_verse: Nana nwa nyoo: Nnɛmɔma Hesekia lakalaka ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɔngɔhora ɔngɔpepɛ ngole ɛmɔ ngofi me sa nu.

english_verse: Stop listening to Hezekiah! Pay attention to my king. Surrender to him. He will let you keep your own vineyards, fig trees, and cisterns
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔtɛ Hesekia so, ofikyɛ Asiria hene nwa: Ɛ́mɔfite bɛbra ná ɛmɔɔli ɛmɔ ti dwirɛ wɔ me berɛ, amaa ɔnate so ebiala wanya ye bɔbɔ ye fieso aleɛ wali, na wanya ye bɔbɔ ye abura nu nzue wano,

english_verse: Don't forget that it was the Lord who sent me here with orders to destroy your nation!
translation_verse: Afei koso, aso nna AWURADE yeɛ wagyina me si kyɛ mva koɛ mandoa kuro ye ná nzɛkye ye ɔ? AWURADE sele me kyɛ, fa koɛ kɔteta kuro ne ná sɛkye ye.”

english_verse: Hezekiah obeyed the Lord, just as his ancestor David had done.
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ye Nana Dawide yɔle ne ala.

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines, then tore down the images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred pole for worshiping the goddess Asherah. He also smashed the bronze snake Moses had made. The people had named it Nehushtan and had been offering sacrifices to it.
translation_verse: Otutuli asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ abo, obubuli bonima nemɔ, na ɔpepɛle Asera dosii nemɔ guale. Kɔɔbere ewoo bɔ Mose yɔle ne, obubuli nu. Ofikyɛ ɔbaadwu sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Yisraelfoɛ bɛyera ɛyɛɛ wɔ kɔɔbere ne aso bɛsɔne ye: né bɛfrɛ ye Nehustan.

english_verse: He was completely faithful to the Lord and obeyed the laws the Lord had given to Moses for the people.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ olili AWURADE si yé. Wandwe ye nwo wamvi AWURADE nwo, na mmom olili AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ ɔfa mane Mose ne aso.

english_verse: The Lord helped Hezekiah, so he was successful in everything he did. He even rebelled against the king of Assyria, refusing to be his servant.
translation_verse: Nikyee biala bɔ ɔyɔle ne, oyiele ye yé ofikyɛ AWURADE gyinane ye si. Ɔyɛle Asiria hene nwo lɔen, na wanzo ye.

english_verse: Hezekiah defeated the Philistine towns as far away as Gaza—from the smallest towns to the large, walled cities.
translation_verse: Olili Filistifoɛ so ngonim alaa maa oodwuli Gasa ne ye mbɔtam. Olili nguro mmaa mmaa ne nguro mbiri bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue ɔ so ngonim.

english_verse: During the fourth year of Hezekiah's rule, which was the seventh year of Hoshea's rule in Israel, King Shalmaneser of Assyria led his troops to Samaria, the capital city of Israel. They attacked
translation_verse: Hesekia lili hene ne, ye afoɛ nna ne aso, né Yisrael hene Ela ɔwa Hosea olili Yisrael hene ɔ, ye afoɛ nzoo ɛne. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Asiria hene Salmanese fale koɛ ɔɔtetale Samaria. Otuale kuro ne,

english_verse: and captured it three years later, in the sixth year of Hezekiah's rule and the ninth year of Hoshea's rule.
translation_verse: na afoɛ nza sone ne, olili kuro ne aso ngonim. Hesekia lili hene ne, ye afoɛ nzia ne aso, né Hosea lili Yisrael hene ɔ, afoɛ ngona ɛne. Sɔ mmerɛ ne yeɛ Salmanese lili Samaria so ngonim ɔ.

english_verse: All of that happened because the people of Israel had not obeyed the Lord their God. They rejected the solemn agreement he had made with them, and they ignored everything that the Lord's servant Moses had told them. King Sennacherib of Assyria Invades Judah (
translation_verse: Sɔ dwirɛ ne tole Yisraelfoɛ, ofikyɛ bandie AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, na mmom bebuli ye apam so. Bɔ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose hyɛle ne amukoraa, bandie, na banni so. Senakeribo fa koɛ kɔtoa Yuda

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards, raise your own grain, and have plenty of olive oil and honey. Believe me, you won't starve there. Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him.
translation_verse: kɔpem kyɛ ngɔwa ngɔɔsesa ɛmɔ ngɔhɔ aseɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ ye ala so ɔ. Aseɛ bɔ nningyein hemɔ wɔ so ɔ: aburoo ne nzaa, aleɛ ne bobe boo mɔ, olive ngoo ne woɛ, amaa ɛmɔanya ngoa ná ɛmɔanwuwu. Sɛ Hesekia lakalaka ɛmɔ kyɛ AWURADE kɔpepɛ kole ɛmɔ a, nnɛma ɛmɔtɛ ye so.

english_verse: One of the Assyrian commanders told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Rabesake ne sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhã behyire Hesekia kyɛ, Asiria hene bɔ ɔte ɛhene bɔ odi mu paa ne, obisa wɔ kyɛ, Nzikyɛ yeɛ afa wɔ nwo ato so bɔ wamaa asi wɔ hue sɔ ne?

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Nakoso ebiaa ɛmɔkɔhã bekohyire me kyɛ, ‘Yafa yɛ nwo yato AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ so.’ Aso nna ye asɔneyɛɛ mɔ ne afɔleɛ bokyea mɔ yeɛ Hesekia wabubu bɛ ye? Aso Hesekia wanga wangyire Yuda ne Yerusalem kyɛ, Afɔleɛ bokyea he bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne, so yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔsɔne ɔ’?

english_verse: In the fourteenth year of Hezekiah's rule in Judah, King Sennacherib of Assyria invaded the country and captured every walled city, except Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Hesekia lili hene ne, ye afoɛ buru ne nna ne anu, Asiria hene Senakeribo fale koɛ ɔɔtoale Yuda nguro bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue ne amukoraa, na olili bɛ so ngonim.

english_verse: Hezekiah sent this message to Sennacherib, who was in the town of Lachish: “I know I am guilty of rebellion. But I will pay you whatever you want, if you stop your attack.” Sennacherib told Hezekiah to pay ten tons of silver and one ton of gold.
translation_verse: Yuda hene Hesekia somane maa bɛhɔle Asiria hene berɛ wɔ Lakise beesele ye kyɛ, “Mayɔ bɔne. Yakyi koɛ bɔ afa atoa mene, na ɛtoɔ biala bɔ ɛkɔpɛ kɔma me kyɛ ndua ne, ngotua.” Yiti Asiria hene pɛle ɛdwetɛ kilo apee buru ne esikaa kɔkorɛ kilo apee ko mane Yuda hene Hesekia kyɛ otua.

english_verse: So Hezekiah collected all the silver from the Lord's temple and the royal treasury.
translation_verse: Na ɛdwetɛ bɔ ɔwɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ amukoraa, ɔne bɔ ɔwɔ ahemvie berɛ nekaa bɔ besie nningyein ne amukoraa, Hesekia sesale ɔɔmane ye.

english_verse: He even stripped the gold that he had used to cover the doors and doorposts in the temple. He gave it all to Sennacherib.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, esikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ ɔwɔ AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua anoa nemɔ anwo ne, ɔne esikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ Yuda hene Hesekia wafa waboro aponnwaa nemɔ anwo ne, ɔwɔngyewɔngyele ɔfa ɔɔmane Asiria hene.

english_verse: The king of Assyria ordered his three highest military officers to leave Lachish and take a large army to Jerusalem. When they arrived, the officers stood on the road near the cloth makers' shops along the canal from the upper pool.
translation_verse: Nakoso Asiria hene somane ye mbanyi bɔ bɛfrɛ bɛ Tatan, Rabosari ne Rabesake maa bɛ ne koɛhonɛfoɛ pee befili Lakise bɛhɔle Nana Hesekia berɛ wɔ Yerusalem. Beedwuli Yerusalem ne, bɛfo beegyinane dodobɛen bɔ nzue tengyɛ fa nu kogua sorɔ dɔ ɛkwaa bɔ ɔwɔ atapoɛ atee so ne anwo.

english_verse: They called out to Hezekiah, and three of his highest officials came out to meet them. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: Bɛsomane kyɛ bɛfrɛ Nana Hesekia bɛma bɛ nen, Hilkia awa Eliakim bɔ ɔnea ahemvie berɛ ne, ɔne ahyerɛlɛniɛ Sebena, yeɛ Asafe awa Yoa bɔ ɔte abakɔsɛm ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne, bɛ yeɛ bɛwale ɔ.

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Ɛnwa nzɛ bɛ noa mbaen yeɛ bɛfa bɛko koɛ ɔ? Nwa yeɛ afa wɔ nwo ato ye so bɔ yiti yeɛ ayɛ me nwo lɔen ye?

english_verse: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.
translation_verse: Tie, Misraim yeɛ afa wɔ nwo ato ye so ɔ? Ɔte kyɛ pɔmaa bɔ onzo ɔ, na ebiala bɔ okokisa ye ne, okobu kɔwɔ ye sa nu. Sɔ yeɛ Misraim hene Faro fa di ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa ye nwo kɔto ye so ɔ.

english_verse: The king of Assyria wants to make a bet with you people. He will give you
translation_verse: Bra ná ɛne me mene Asiria hene bɛyɛ nhyehyɛleɛ: sɛ ekonya bɛ nwo pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ a, ahaa ngɔma wɔ mbɔngɔ apee nyɔ.

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: Me mene safohene mmaa mmaa nemɔ po, ɛyɛ sɛ né ahora agyina bɛ nu ko nyunu, wɔ aberɛ bɔ Misraim teaseɛnam mɔ ne pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ yeɛ afa wɔ nwo ato bɛ so ɔ?

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Hilkia awa Eliakim, Sebena ɔne Yoa besele Rabesake ne kyɛ, “Wɔ ngoaa, yɛsrɛ wɔ, kã edwirɛ ne kyire yɛ wɔ Aramaeke dwudwolɛ nu, ofikyɛ yɛte Aramaeke. Nnɛdwudwo kyire yɛ wɔ Yuda dwudwolɛ nu, ofikyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛwɔ fasue ne aso ne, bɛkɔte bɔ ɛkã ne.”

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Rabesake ne sele bɛ kyɛ, “Aso wɔ ne wɔ mene ne angome ti yeɛ me mene somane me kyɛ mangã edwirɛ he ɔ? Mmenia hemɔ bɔ bɛtete fasue ne aso ne bɛboka so, ofikyɛ bɛ koso edwirɛ kɔto bɛ maa bekoli bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ bondua ná bano bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ mmien kyɛ ɛmɔ ala.”

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Yeɛ Rabesake ne dwɔsole teane nu serɛserɛ wɔ Yuda dwudwolɛ nu kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtie Asiria hene bɔ ɔte ɛhene bɔ odi mu paa ne, ye noa dwirɛ!

english_verse: Don't trust him when he tells you that the Lord will protect you from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma Hesekia lakalaka ɛmɔ maa ɛmɔfa bɛ nwo bɛto AWURADE so, ná ɛmɔka kyɛ, AWURADE kɔpepɛ kole yɛ, na ɔngɔfa sɔ kuro ye ngowura Asiria hene sa.

english_verse: Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Maen maen mɔ bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ, aso bɛ nu biala wahora wale ye aseɛ wafi Asiria hene sa nu le?

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath and Arpad? What about the gods of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Hamate ne Apade nyameɛ nemɔ, bɛwɔ ni? Sefawim, Hena ne Yiwa nyameɛ nemɔ, bɛwɔ ni? Bahora bapepɛ bale Samaria bafi me sa nu anaa?

english_verse: None of these gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord your God can do any better?
translation_verse: Maen maen mɔ bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ amukoraa, bɛ nu beni yeɛ wahora wapepɛ wale ye maen wafi me sa nu ɔ. Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔmaa ɛdwene kyɛ AWURADE kɔpepɛ kole Yerusalem kofi me sa nu ɔ.”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Hilkia awa Eliakim bɔ ɔnea ahemvie berɛ ne, ahyerɛlɛniɛ Sebena, yeɛ Asafe awa Yoa bɔ ɔte abakɔsɛm ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne, besunzuale bɛ ndaadeɛ nu, na bɛhɔle Hesekia berɛ bɛɛfale Rabesake ne dwirɛ ne bɛbɔle ye amaneɛ.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɔne wɔ ye nyameɛ Nisroke asɔneyɛɛ so ne, ye mma mmienzua Adramelɛke ne Saresa bɛfale ngrandɛ behuni ye, na bɛnwati bɛhɔle Ararate maen nu. Na ɔwa bienzua Esa Hadon lili ye bia.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nana Hesekia tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, osunzuale ye bɔbɔ ye ndaadeɛ nu, ɔherale ɛsɛen tena, na ɔhɔle AWURADE awuro berɛ.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (Isaiah
translation_verse: Hamate hene, Apade hene, kuro Sefawim hene, Hena hene, ɔne Yiwa hene, bɛwɔ nisua? Hesekia bɔ mbaeɛ

english_verse: He told Prime Minister Eliakim, Assistant Prime Minister Shebna, and the senior priests to dress in sackcloth and tell the prophet Isaiah:
translation_verse: Ɔsomane Eliakim bɔ ɔnea ahemvie berɛ ne, ahyerɛlɛniɛ Sebena yeɛ asɔfo mbanyi mɔ maa bɛhɔle Amoso awa ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya berɛ. Bɛherale ɛsɛen tena yeɛ bɛhɔle ɔ.

english_verse: These are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.
translation_verse: Besele ye kyɛ, “Hesekia nwa: Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye te aworabɔlɛ, asohwenɛ ne animguaseɛ kyẽa. Mmrasua nemɔ afo aworɛ so, nakoso bennya anwoserɛ bɛmva bɛndwe bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ Rabesake ne, ye mene Asiria hene wafa wasoma ye kyɛ ɔfa ɔɔgoro Nyameɛ teasefoɛ nwo ne, ebiaa AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ wate. Na AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔhwe ye so wɔ edwirɛ bɔ wate ne anwo. Yiti mbaeɛ bɔ ɛbɔ ma yɛ bɔ yaha ne, ma nu ɔ́yɛ se.”

english_verse: When these leaders went to Isaiah,
translation_verse: Hesekia ye mbanyi nemɔ hɔle Yesaya berɛ ne,

english_verse: he told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord. Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Yesaya sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhã behyire ɛmɔ mene kyɛ, ‘AWURADE nwa: Musue dwirɛ bɔ Asiria hene ye mbanyi baha batia me maa ate ne, nnɛmaa wɔ kunu tete wɔ wɔ ye nwo.

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.
translation_verse: Me bɔbɔ ngɔfa ahunundetelɛ adwene bie ngowura ye ti anu. Ngɔmaa ɔkɔte ngraa bie bɔ ɔkɔmaa okosa ye si kɔhɔ ye kuro ɔ. Ngɔmaa ɔkɔtɔ wɔ ngrandɛ noa wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye maen nu.’ ” Asiria hene nwunanwuna Yudafoɛ (Yesaya

english_verse: Meanwhile, the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.
translation_verse: Afei Rabesake ne tele kyɛ Asiria hene wafi Lakise. Na osale ye si hɔle nen, onwuni kyɛ Asiria hene wafa koɛ waateta Libina.

english_verse: About this same time the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Asiria hene tele kyɛ Yitiopia hene Tihaka waboaboa ɛlɔen noa ɔbaafa koɛ toa ye ne, otuli ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ maa bɛhɔle Yuda hene Hesekia berɛ.

english_verse: Don't trust your God or be fooled by his promise to defend Jerusalem against me.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa beesele Hesekia kyɛ, Wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ afa wɔ nwo ato ye so ne, nnɛmaa ɔlakalaka wɔ, ná ɔhyɛ wɔ bɔ kyɛ ɔngɔfa Yerusalem ngowura Asiria hene sa.

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: Tie, nna ate bɔ Asiria hene mɔ bafa bayɔ maen maen amukoraa ɔ? Ate kyɛ bahũhũ bɛ pasaa ne? Aso ebie kɔpepɛ kole wɔ anaa?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: Maen maen mɔ bɔ me nana mɔ bɛbɔle bɛ, bɔ bɛ ole Gosan, Haran ne Resefe ne Edenfoɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ Telasa ne, aso sɔ maen nemɔ bɛ nyameɛ mɔ bɛhora bɛpepɛ belele bɛ?

english_verse: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.
translation_verse: Hesekia sa hane krataa ne fili ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ berɛ, na ɔkengale. Afei ɔhɔle AWURADE awuro berɛ, na ɔtrɛle krataa ne anu wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: Isaiah went to Hezekiah and told him that the Lord God of Israel had said: Hezekiah, I heard your prayer about King Sennacherib of Assyria.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Amoso awa Yesaya somane maa beesele Hesekia kyɛ, “AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa, ‘Mate wɔ mbaeɛ bɔ abɔ ahyire me afa Asiria hene Senakeribo nwo ne.

english_verse: He prayed: Lord God of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: Na Hesekia bɔle mbaeɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ bɔ ɛte w’ahennie bia so wɔ kɛrubim mɔ b’afia ɔ, wɔ wiase ahennie amukoraati nu, wɔ ngome yeɛ ɛte Nyameɛ ɔ. Wɔ yeɛ ɛbɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ɔ.

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ɔte amba kyɛ Asiria ahemvo mɔ babɔ maen maen mɔ tɔɔ.

english_verse: But you are our Lord and our God! We ask you to keep us safe from the Assyrian king. Then everyone in every kingdom on earth will know that you are the only God. The Lord's Answer to Hezekiah (Isaiah
translation_verse: Yiti afei, ao AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ, mesrɛ wɔ, pepɛ de yɛ fi ye sa nu, amaa ɔnate so aseɛ ye aso ahennie amukoraa banwu ye kyɛ AWURADE, wɔ ngome yeɛ ɛte Nyameɛ ɔ.” Yesaya ma Hesekia te ndɛenvɛen (Yesaya

english_verse: Now this is what I say to that king: The people of Jerusalem hate and make fun of you; they laugh behind your back.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE ahã afa ye nwo ɛhe: ‘Sion awa brasua bɔ onnwuni biaa le ne, obu wɔ animtia, yeɛ ɔgoro wɔ nwo; Yerusalem awa brasua ne, ɔsere ɔbɔ wɔ tutue di wɔ si.

english_verse: That same night the Lord sent an angel to the camp of the Assyrians, and he killed
translation_verse: Sɔ kɔngɔen ne ala, AWURADE abɔfo hɔle Asiria asikyeleɛ ne anu oohuhuni koɛhonɛfoɛ apee ɛyaa ko aburawɔtwɛ ne nnu. Aleɛ hyene ne, né efuin ngome yeɛ begua berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And this is how you bragged about yourself: “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Ɛnate wɔ bɔfoɛ mɔ so agoro AWURADE nwo, na ahã kyɛ, Mafa me teaseɛnam pee nemɔ, mafo mahɔ mmokaa nemɔ ti afia, mahɔ Lebanon ɛhɔayeɛ ne anu dɔ paa. Ye sida ndendenn nemɔ, ɔne ye ɛframmire nyemenenyemene nemɔ, mabubu bɛ magua. Mahɔ bokaa ne ti afia dɔ paa, ɔne so ɛhɔayeɛ too ne anu.

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: Matutu abura mɔ, na mano maen maen mɔ bɛ so nzue, Misraim asue amukoraa bɔ me gya atia nu ne, mafa me koɛhonɛfoɛ so mamaa bawewe.

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all this long ago. And you don't even realize that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: ‘Aso ande, kyɛ sɔ dwirɛ ne ndwenene ye nwo ahyɛ ɔ? Fi tete yeɛ nikyee bɔ meyɔ ye kekesaala ye ne, nhyehyɛ ndole berɛ ɔ, kyɛ nguro bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue nemɔ, odi kyɛ ɛsɛkye bɛ maa bɛkakyi kurofoen ɔ.

english_verse: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or tender young grass growing on a flat roof, scorched before it matures.
translation_verse: Ɔnate sɔ ati so ama nemɔ b’anwoserɛ te kãa, besuro na bɛ nyunu agua ase; bakakyi kyɛ eburo ndire, bɛyɛ mmerɛ kyɛ ɛserɛ bɔ wafifi foforɛ ɔ, bayɛ kyɛ ndire bɔ wafifi wɔ sua so anwuro ɔ, bɔ ɔkese ná onnyi ɔ.

english_verse: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Nakoso mese wɔ nyunu ne wɔ si, mese wɔ hɔlɛ ne wɔ walɛ, ɔne wɔ yaa piri bɔ afɛ ye me so ne.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: Ɔnate wɔ yaa piri bɔ afɛ ye me so, ɔne w’anwomasoɛ bɔ mate ne ati, ngɔfa me kaa ngosina wɔ bonyi anu, ná matofi wɔ noa nu mafa me nyamaa mawura nu; na ngɔmaa ɛkɔkakyi wɔ nye, ɛkɔfa atee bɔ ɛnate so wale ne aso ekosa kɔhɔ.

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: “ ‘Na Hesekia, ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ kɔma wɔ ɔ: Afoɛ he, ɛmɔkoli aleɛ bɔ ye bɔbɔ wafifi wɔ aseɛ ne aso ɔ. Afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne, ɛmɔkoli aleɛ bɔ okofifi ye si ne. Na afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne, ɛmɔkolua nningyein, ná ɛmɔafa so aleɛ; ɛmɔkolua bobe, na ɛmɔkoli so mmaa.

english_verse: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
translation_verse: Yuda awuro ama bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ne, bɛ bo kosa kotira ndii, ná bata pee.

english_verse: I promise that the king of Assyria won't get into Jerusalem, or shoot an arrow into the city, or even surround it and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: “ ‘Yiti bɔ AWURADE kã fa Asiria hene nwo ɛhe: Ongowura kuro he anu, ɔngɔto agyaen wɔ nu, ɔngɔfa akokyɛm ngɔwa ye nyunu, yeɛ ongotua kuro ye.

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Atee bɔ ɔnate so wale ne, sɔ atee ne ala yeɛ okosa kɔfa so kɔhɔ ɔ. AWURADE nwa Asiria hene ngowura kuro ne anu.

english_verse: I will protect it for myself and for my servant David. The Death of King Sennacherib (Isaiah
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngɔbɔ kuro he anwo waen ngɔpepɛ ngole ye, ɔnate me bɔbɔ me ti ɔne me somvoɛ Dawide ti.’ ” Senakeribo ngoguo ne ye wue

english_verse: After this King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Asiria hene Senakeribo fili berɛ hɔle ye kuro, na ɔɔtenane Ninewe.

english_verse: Chronicles
translation_verse: Aberɛso Dwirɛ

english_verse: Hezekiah died, and his son Manasseh became king.
translation_verse: Hesekia toale ye mbanyi mɔ, na ɔwa bienzua Manase lili ye bia.

english_verse: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried bitterly.
translation_verse: “Ao AWURADE, kyɛbɔ mafa m’ahone amukoraa mali wɔ dwirɛ so nahorɛ nu, ɔne kyɛbɔ mayɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ wɔ nyunu ne, mesrɛ wɔ, fa wɔ nye to.” Na Hesekia suni hahii.

english_verse: Before Isaiah got to the middle court of the palace,
translation_verse: Anzana Yesaya ɔbaafi ahemvie aluo berɛ ofite kɔ ne, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele ye kyɛ,

english_verse: the Lord sent him back to Hezekiah with this message: Hezekiah, you are the ruler of my people, and I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will heal you, so that three days from now you will be able to worship in my temple.
translation_verse: “Sa wɔ si kɔhã kyire Hesekia bɔ odi hene wɔ me mmenia so ne kyɛ, AWURADE wɔ nana Dawide ye Nyameɛ ne, ɔnwa nyoo: Matie wɔ mbaeɛ ne, na manwu ɛmoen bɔ ɛte ne. Nahorɛ nu, ngɔsa wɔ anwonyerɛ na ɛlɛsa ne aso, ɛkɔhɔ AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua nu berɛ.

translation_verse: Afei Yosia pɛnene ye nye, na onwuni asieleɛ mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ bokaa ne aso ne. Ɔmaa bɛɛsesale sona mmowue befili asieleɛ nemɔ anu bɛwale. english_verse: Josiah replied, “Then leave it alone. Don't dig up his bones.” So they did not disturb his bones or the bones of the old prophet from Israel who had also been buried there.
