english_verse: After Jobab's death, Husham from the land of Teman became king.
translation_verse: Yobabo wuli ne, Husam bɔ ofi Temanfoɛ aseɛ so ne, olili ye bia.

english_verse: After Husham's death, Hadad son of Bedad became king and ruled from Avith. Earlier, Bedad had defeated the Midianites in the territory of Moab.
translation_verse: Husam wuli ne, Bedade awa Hadade, bɔ olili Midian so ngonim wɔ Moabo aseɛ so ne, yeɛ olili ye bia ɔ. Né ye kuro ole Awite.

english_verse: After Hadad's death, Samlah from Masrekah became king;
translation_verse: Hadade wuli ne, Samla bɔ ofi Masereka yeɛ olili ye bia ɔ.

english_verse: after Samlah's death, Shaul from the town of Rehoboth on the Euphrates River became king;
translation_verse: Samla wuli ne, Sɔɔlo bɔ ofi Rehobote bɔ opingye asue Yufreti ne, yeɛ olili ye bia ɔ.

english_verse: and after Shaul's death, Baal Hanan son of Achbor became king.
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo wuli ne, Akibɔ awa Baal Hanan lili ye bia.

english_verse: After Baal Hanan's death, Hadad ruled from Pai. His wife was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred and granddaughter of Mezahab.
translation_verse: Baal Hanan wuli ne, Hadade yeɛ olili ye bia ɔ. Ye kuro ole Paye, na ɔye ole Mehetabel bɔ oni ole Matrede bɔ ye koso oni ole Mesahabo ne.

english_verse: The Edomite clans were Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
translation_verse: Na Hadade wuli. Edom mmusua mmusua mbanyi nemɔ ɛhe: Timina, Alia, Yetete,

english_verse: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
translation_verse: Oholibama, Ela, Pinon,

english_verse: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
translation_verse: Kenase, Teman, Mibesa,

english_verse: Judah and his Canaanite wife Bathshua had three sons: Er, Onan, and Shelah. But the Lord had Er put to death, because he disobeyed and did what the Lord hated.
translation_verse: Yuda mma mmienzua mɔ ɛhe: Ɛre, Onan ne Hyela; sɔ mmenia nza nemɔ ɔne Kanaanniɛ braa Bate Sua yeɛ bɛwole bɛ ɔ. Na Yuda bamuɛbaa Ɛre, ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte amumuyɛɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, yiti AWURADE huni ye.

english_verse: Judah and his daughter-in-law Tamar also had two sons: Perez and Zerah.
translation_verse: Yuda sia brasua Tamar koso ɔne Yuda bɛwole Pɛrɛse ne Sera. Yiti Yuda mma mmienzua nemɔ bɛ mukoraa bɛte nnu.

english_verse: Perez was the father of Hezron and Hamul.
translation_verse: Pɛrɛse mma mmienzua ole Hesron ne Hamul.

english_verse: Zerah was the father of Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Darda.
translation_verse: Sera mma mmienzua ole Simri, Etan, Heman, Kalkole ne Dara: bɛ mukoraa bɛte nnu.

english_verse: Achan, who was a descendant of Zerah and the son of Carmi, caused trouble for Israel, because he kept for himself things that belonged only to the Lord.
translation_verse: Karemi awa Akare yeɛ ɔhwehwene musue wale Yisrael so ne, ofikyɛ nningyein bɔ batu basie berɛ bama AWURADE ne, ɔfale bie.

english_verse: Ethan's son was Azariah. The Ancestors of King David
translation_verse: Na Etan awa ole Asaria. Dawide nana mɔ ne ye boso ama

english_verse: Hezron was the father of Jerahmeel, Ram, and Caleb.
translation_verse: Hesron mma mmienzua bɔ ɔwole bɛ nemɔ ɛhe: Yerameel, Ram ne Kyelubae.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Amminadab and the grandfather of Nahshon, a tribal leader of Judah.
translation_verse: Ram wole Aminadabo, yeɛ Aminadabo koso wole Nason bɔ ɔɔyɛle sona titire wɔ Yudafoɛ nu ne.

english_verse: Nahshon's descendants included Salma, Boaz,
translation_verse: Nason wole Salma, yeɛ Salma wole Boase.

english_verse: Jesse also had two daughters: Zeruiah and Abigail. Zeruiah was the mother of Abishai, Joab, and Asahel.
translation_verse: B’eliɛma mmrasua mɔ ole Seruya ne Abigail. Seruya mma mmienzua mɔ te nza: bɛ ole Abisae, Yoabo ne Asahel.

english_verse: Hezron's son Caleb married Azubah, and their daughter was Jerioth, the mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
translation_verse: Hesron awa Kalebo ne ɔye Asuba bɛwole mmaa, na ɔne Yeriote koso bɛwole: Ye mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yesere, Sobabo ne Adɔn.

english_verse: After the death of Azubah, Caleb married Ephrath. Their son Hur
translation_verse: Asuba wuli ne, Kalebo gyale Efrate, na ɔne ye bɛwole Hure.

english_verse: was the father of Uri and the grandfather of Bezalel.
translation_verse: Hure wole Yuri, na Yuri wole Besalel.

english_verse: After the death of Hezron, Caleb married Ephrath, his father's wife. Their son was Ashhur, who later settled the town of Tekoa. The Descendants of Jerahmeel
translation_verse: Hesron wuli wɔ Kalebo Efrata. Na ye si ye, Hesron aye Abiya wole Tekoa baba Asure mane ye. Yerameel boso ama

english_verse: Jerahmeel, Hezron's oldest son, was the father of Ram, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
translation_verse: Hesron bamuɛbaa Yerameel, ye mma mmienzua mɔ ɛhe: ye bamuɛbaa Ram, yeɛ Buna, Oren, Osem ne Ahiya.

english_verse: Jerahmeel had a second wife, Atarah, who gave birth to Onam.
translation_verse: Né Yerameel le braa bieku bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Atara. Onam ye maame ɛne.

english_verse: Ram was the father of Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
translation_verse: Yerameel bamuɛbaa Ram, ye mma mmienzua mɔ ole Maase, Yamin ne Ekere.

english_verse: Onam was the father of Shammai and Jada. Shammai was the father of Nadab and Abishur.
translation_verse: Onam mma mmienzua mɔ ole Samae ne Yada. Samae mma mmienzua mɔ ole Nadabo ne Abisure.

english_verse: Abishur married Abihail, and their two sons were Ahban and Molid.
translation_verse: Bɛfrɛ Abisure aye ne Abihail, na ɔne ye bɛwole Aheban ne Molide.

english_verse: Nadab was the father of Seled and Appaim. Seled had no children;
translation_verse: Nadabo mma mmienzua mɔ ole Selede ne Apayim, na Selede wuli bɔ wanwo ba ɔ.

english_verse: Appaim's son was Ishi, the father of Sheshan and the grandfather of Ahlai.
translation_verse: Apayim awa bienzua ole Yisi. Yisi awa bienzua ole Sesan. Sesan awa bienzua ole Ahelae.

english_verse: Jada was the father of Jether and Jonathan. Jether had no children,
translation_verse: Samae aliɛma bienzua Yada, ye mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yeta ne Yonatan; na Yeta wuli bɔ wanwo ba ɔ.

english_verse: but Jonathan had two sons: Peleth and Zaza.
translation_verse: Yonatan mma mmienzua mɔ ole Pelete ne Sasa. Yerameel boso ama mɔ ɛne.

english_verse: Sheshan had no sons, and so he let one of his daughters marry Jarha, his Egyptian slave. Their son was Attai,
translation_verse: Yiti Sesan fale ɔwa brasua mane ye kanganiɛ Yareha gyale, na ɔne ye bɛwole Ataye.

english_verse: the father of Nathan and the grandfather of Zabad.
translation_verse: Ataye wole Natan, na Natan wole Sabade.

english_verse: and Hebron's four sons, Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
translation_verse: Hebron mma mmienzua mɔ ole Kora, Tapua, Rekem ne Sema.

english_verse: Shema was the father of Raham and the grandfather of Jorkeam. Rekem was the father of Shammai,
translation_verse: Sema wole Yorekeam baba Raham, na Rekem wole Samae.

english_verse: the grandfather of Maon, and the great-grandfather of Bethzur.
translation_verse: Samae wole Mayɔn, yeɛ Mayɔn wole Bete Sure.

english_verse: Ephah was one of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Haran, Moza, and Gazez. Haran named his son after his brother Gazez.
translation_verse: Kalebo sómaa Efa wole Haran, Mosa ne Gasese, na Haran wole Gasese.

english_verse: Ephah was the daughter of Jahdai, who was also the father of Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, and Shaaph.
translation_verse: Yahedae mma mmienzua mɔ ole Regyem, Yotam, Gesan, Pelete, Efa ne Saafe.

english_verse: Maacah was another of Caleb's wives, and their sons were Sheber and Tirhanah.
translation_verse: Kalebo sómaa Maaka wole Sebere ne Tihana.

english_verse: Later, they had two more sons: Shaaph the father of Madmannah, and Sheva the father of Machbenah and Gibea. Caleb's daughter was Achsah.
translation_verse: Braa ne sa wole Mademana baba Saafe, yeɛ Makebena ne Gibea bɛ baba Sewa. Kalebo ɔwa brasua ole Akesa.

english_verse: Shobal, who settled the town of Kiriath-Jearim, was the ancestor of Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth clan,
translation_verse: Sobal bɔ ɔkyekyele Kiriate Yearim ne, né ole mmaa mmienzua foforɛ mɔ. Bɛ ole Haroyefoɛ, bɔ bɛte Manahatefoɛ bɛ bue ne.

english_verse: and the clans that lived near Kiriath-Jearim; they were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. The Zorathites and the Eshtaolites were descendants of the Mishraites.
translation_verse: Na mmusua mmusua bɔ bɛwɔ Kiriate Yearim ne, bɛ ɛhe: Yitrifoɛ, Putifoɛ, Sumatifoɛ, yeɛ Misirafoɛ. Bɛ boso ama mɔ ole Soratifoɛ ne Esetaofoɛ.

english_verse: Salma settled the town of Bethlehem and was the ancestor of the Netophathites, the people of Atroth-Bethjoab, half of the Manahathite clan, and the Zorites.
translation_verse: Salma boso ama mɔ ɛhe: Betlehemfoɛ, Netofafoɛ, Atrote Bete Yoabo, Manahatefoɛ nemɔ bɛ bue, yeɛ Sorifoɛ.

english_verse: Salma was also the ancestor of the clans in Jabez that kept the court and government records; they were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These clans were the descendants of Hammath the Kenite, who was also the ancestor of the Rechabites.
translation_verse: Ahyerɛlɛfoɛ mmusua mmusua bɔ bɛte Yabese ne, bɛ mmusua mɔ ɛhe: Tiratifoɛ, Simeatefoɛ, yeɛ Sukatifoɛ. Bɛte Kenifoɛ, na bɛ nana ole Hamate bɔ ye boso ama ole Rekabofoɛ ne.

english_verse: David's other sons included Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet.
translation_verse: Elisama, Eliada, Elifɛlɛte; bɛ mu bɛte ngona.

english_verse: David's other wives also gave birth to sons. Tamar was his daughter. The Descendants of King Solomon
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa bɛte Dawide mma mmienzua, asora mmaa bɔ ɔne sómaa mɔ bɛwole bɛ ne. Né Tamar te b’eliɛma brasua. Solomon boso ama

english_verse: Solomon's descendants included the following kings: Rehoboam, Abijah, Asa, Jehoshaphat, Jehoram, Ahaziah, Joash, Amaziah, Azariah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, Manasseh, Amon, and Josiah and his four sons, Johanan, Jehoiakim, Zedekiah, and Jehoahaz.
translation_verse: Yosia mma mɔ ɛhe: Yohanan yeɛ ɔte bamuɛbaa ɔ, Yehoakim tɔ so nyɔ, Sedekia tɔ so nza, yeɛ Salum tɔ so nna.

english_verse: Jehoiakim was the father of Jehoiachin and Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Yehoakim mma mmienzua mɔ ɛhe: Yekonia yeɛ Sedekia.

english_verse: Jehoiachin, who was taken to Babylon as a prisoner, had seven sons: Shealtiel,
translation_verse: Yekonia bɔ bɛhyele ye nnure ne, ye mma mɔ ole ɛhemɔ: Sɛtiɛl,

english_verse: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
translation_verse: Malkiram, Pedaya, Senasa, Yekamia, Hosama ne Nedabia.

english_verse: Pedaiah had two sons: Zerubbabel and Shimei. Zerubbabel was the father of Meshullam, Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister.
translation_verse: Pedaya mma mmienzua mɔ ole Serubabɛl ne Simei, yeɛ Serubabɛl mma mmienzua mɔ ole Mesulam ne Hanania bɔ b’eliɛma brasua ole Selomite ne.

english_verse: He also had five other sons: Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushabhesed.
translation_verse: Osa wole Hasuba, Ohel, Berekia, Hasadia ne Yusabo Hesede: bɛte nnu.

english_verse: the father of Shemaiah and the grandfather of Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat.
translation_verse: Sekania awa bienzua ole Semaya, yeɛ Semaya mma mmienzua mɔ ole Hatuse, Yigal, Baria, Nearia ne Safate; bɛte nzia.

english_verse: Neariah was the father of Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam.
translation_verse: Nearia mma mmienzua mɔ ole Elionae, Hisikia ne Asrikam; bɛte nza.

english_verse: Elioenai was the father of Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani.
translation_verse: Elionae mma mmienzua ole Hodawia, Eliasibo, Pelaya, Akubo, Yohanan, Delaya ne Anani; bɛte nzoo.

english_verse: Judah was the father of five sons: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
translation_verse: Yuda boso ama mɔ ole Pɛrɛse, Hesron, Karemi, Hure yeɛ Sobal.

english_verse: Shobal was the father of Reaiah, the grandfather of Jahath, and the great-grandfather of Ahumai and Lahad. These men all belonged to the Zorathite clan.
translation_verse: Sobal awa Reaya yeɛ ɔwole Yahate ɔ, na Yahate wole Ahumae ne Lahade. Soratifoɛ mmusua mɔ ɛne.

english_verse: Ashhur, who settled the town of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah.
translation_verse: Né Tekoa baba Asure ogya mmraa nyɔ: Hela ne Naara.

english_verse: daughters. But his brothers did not have as many children, so the Simeon tribe was smaller than the Judah tribe.
translation_verse: Ɔne Naara bɛwole Ahusam, Hefa, Temeni ne Hahasetari. Naara mma mmienzua mɔ ɛne.

english_verse: Ashhur and Helah were the parents of Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
translation_verse: Hela mma mmienzua mɔ ole Serete, Yisare ne Etenan.

english_verse: Koz, the father of Anub and Zobebah, was also the ancestor of the clans of Aharhel, the son of Harum.
translation_verse: Kose wole Anubo ne Sobeba; na Harum awa Ahahel ye abusuafoɛ bɛte Kose boso ama.

english_verse: Jabez was a man who got his name because of the pain he caused his mother during birth. But he was still the most respected son in his family.
translation_verse: Né Yabese le animnyam tra oliɛma mɔ amukoraa. Ye maame tole ye dumaa Yabese, ofikyɛ ye maame nwa, “Ye aworɛ nu, nwuni amaneɛ paa.”

english_verse: One day he prayed to Israel's God, “Please bless me and give me a lot of land. Be with me so I will be safe from harm.” And God did just what Jabez had asked.
translation_verse: Yabese sũ frɛle Yisrael Nyameɛ kyɛ, “Ao, ahaa né ayira me, ná amaa manya aseɛ piri; ná agyina me si, ná abɔ me nwo waen afi amaneɛ ne asane nu!” Na Nyameɛ yɔle ye abisadeɛ mane ye.

english_verse: Chelub was the brother of Shuhah and the father of Mehir. Later, Mehir had a son, Eshton,
translation_verse: Suha aliɛma bienzua Kelubo wole Mehiri bɔ ɔwa ole Eseton ne.

english_verse: whose three sons were Bethrapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah. It was Tehinnah who settled the town of Nahash. These men and their families lived in the town of Recah.
translation_verse: Na Eseton wole Bete Rafa, Pasea ne Tehina bɔ ɔwa ole Yiri Nahase ne. Reka boso ama mɔ ɛne.

english_verse: Kenaz was the father of Othniel and Seraiah. Othniel had two sons: Hathath and Meonothai,
translation_verse: Kenase mma mmienzua mɔ ole Otiniɛl ne Seraya; na Otiniɛl mma mmienzua mɔ ole Hatate ne Meonotae.

english_verse: who was the father of Ophrah. Seraiah was the father of Joab, who settled a place called “Valley of Crafts” because the people who lived there were experts in making things.
translation_verse: Meonotae wole Ofra, na Seraya wole Yoabo bɔ yeɛ ɔkyekyele Geharasim ne. Bɛfrɛle berɛ sɔ, ofikyɛ né berɛ ama te adwiililɛfoɛ.

english_verse: Caleb son of Jephunneh had three sons: Iru, Elah, and Naam. Elah was the father of Kenaz.
translation_verse: Yefune awa Kalebo ye mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yiru, Ela ne Naam, na Ela awa bienzua ole Kenase.

english_verse: A man named Hodiah was married to the sister of Naham. Hodiah's descendants included Keilah of the Garmite clan and Eshtemoa of the Maacathite clan.
translation_verse: Hodia aye bɔ oliɛma brasua ole Naham ne, ye mma mmienzua mɔ, bɛ boso ama ole Gaminiɛ Keila ne Maakatiniɛ Ɛsetemoa.

english_verse: Shimon was the father of Amnon, Rinnah, Benhanan, and Tilon. Ishi was the father of Zoheth and Benzoheth.
translation_verse: Simɔn mma mmienzua mɔ ole Amnɔn, Rina, Ben Hanan ne Tilɔn. Yisi mma mmienzua mɔ ole Sohete ne Ben Sohete.

english_verse: The members of these clans were the potters who lived in the towns of Netaim and Gederah and worked for the king. The Descendants of Simeon
translation_verse: Bɛ yeɛ bɛnwo ngukue ná bɛte Netaim ne Gedera ne. Né bɛte berɛ bɛyɔ adwuma bɛma hene. Simeon boso ama

english_verse: Simeon had five sons: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.
translation_verse: Simeon mma mmienzua mɔ ole Nemuel, Yamin, Yaribo, Sera ne Sɔɔlo.

english_verse: The descendants of Shaul included his son Shallum, his grandson Mibsam, and his great-grandson Mishma.
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo boso ama mɔ ole Salum, Mibesam yeɛ Misma.

english_verse: The descendants of Mishma included his son Hammuel, his grandson Zaccur, and his great-grandson Shimei.
translation_verse: Misma boso ama mɔ ole Hamuɛl, Sakure yeɛ Simei.

english_verse: Before David became king, the people of the Simeon tribe lived in the following towns: Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-Shual, Bilhah, Ezem, Tolad, Bethuel, Hormah, Ziklag, Beth-Marcaboth, Hazarsusim, Bethbiri, and Shaaraim.
translation_verse: Bete Makabote, Hasa Susim, Bete Biri ne Saaraim. Né bɛ nguro mɔ ɛne, kɔpem kyɛ Dawide oolili ɛhene ɔ.

english_verse: They also lived in the five villages of Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan,
translation_verse: Na né bɛ nguraa mɔ ole Etam, Ayin, Rimon, Tokyen yeɛ Asan; bɛte nguraa nnu,

english_verse: as well as in the nearby villages as far as the town of Baal. These are the places where Simeon's descendants had settled, according to their own family records.
translation_verse: yeɛ afei bɛ nguraa amukoraa bɔ bapɛ nguro nemɔ anwo bayia alaa kɔpem Baal ne. Né bɛ nguro mɔ ɛne, na bahyerɛ bɛ mmusua ne bɛ nguro nemɔ dumaa wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ngrataa nu.

english_verse: As their families and clans became larger, the people of Simeon had the following leaders: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah son of Amaziah, Joel, Jehu, Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah, and Ziza.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia bɔ babobɔ bɛ dumaa ne, né bɛte mbanyi wɔ bɛ mmusua mɔ nu, na bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ tale pee.

english_verse: When the people needed more pastureland for their flocks and herds, they looked as far as the eastern side of the valley where the town of Gerar is located,
translation_verse: Besili nu bɛhɔle beedwuli Gedɔ tiwaa, wɔ bɔnza ne eyia afiteleɛ so, kyɛ bɛkwaapena aleɛ bɛma bɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ.

english_verse: and they found a lot of good pastureland that was quiet and undisturbed. This had once belonged to the Hamites,
translation_verse: Benwuni ngaka aleɛ bɔ ɔte monɛ frɔmfrɔm ɔ. Né aseɛ ne te tɛtrɛtɛɛ, yeɛ so te konn bɔ basabasa biala ɔnne so ɔ, ofikyɛ daa ne, né Ham boso ama yeɛ bɛte berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: They killed the last of the Amalekites and lived there from then on.
translation_verse: Beehuhuni Amalɛkefoɛ ngaa bɔ bɛnwatili ne, na batena berɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ ye.

english_verse: Reuben was the oldest son of Jacob, but he lost his rights as the first-born son because he slept with one of his father's wives. The honor of the first-born son was then given to Joseph,
translation_verse: Yisrael bamuɛbaa Ruben ye boso ama mɔ. (Ye yeɛ né ɔte bamuɛbaa ɔ. Nakoso ɔnate kyɛ ɔfale efiɛ hane ɔse mba ne ati, ye bamuɛbaa dibea ne, bɛfa bɛmane Yisrael awa Yosef ye mma mmienzua mɔ. Ye sɔ ti, bɛkyerɛ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ne a, bangyerɛ ye dumaa kyɛ ye yeɛ ɔte bamuɛbaa ɔ.

english_verse: Reuben had four sons: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
translation_verse: Yisrael bamuɛbaa Ruben mma mmienzua mɔ ole Hanoke, Palu, Hesron ne Karemi.

english_verse: The descendants of Joel included Shemaiah, Gog, Shimei, Micah, Reaiah, Baal, and Beerah, a leader of the Reuben tribe. Later, King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria took Beerah away as prisoner.
translation_verse: yeɛ Beera bɔ Asiria hene Tilgate Pilnese hyele ye nnure fale ye hɔle ne. Ne Beera yeɛ otua Rubenfoɛ bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: The family records also include Jeiel, who was a clan leader, Zechariah, and Bela son of Azaz and grandson of Shema of the Joel clan. They lived in the territory around the town of Aroer, as far north as Nebo and Baal-Meon,
translation_verse: yeɛ Bela bɔ ye baba ole Asase, bɔ ye baba ole Sema, bɔ ye baba ole Yowel bɔ né ɔte aseɛ bɔ ofi Aroye ɔkwaadwu Nebo ne Baal Meon ne aso ne.

english_verse: and as far east as the desert just west of the Euphrates River. They needed this much land because they owned too many cattle to keep them all in Gilead.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ né bɛ nyɛmmoa nemɔ bata pee wɔ Gileade aseɛ so ne ati, bɛtenane eyia afiteleɛ so alaa beedwuli ɛserɛ bɔ ɔla asue Yufreti nwo ne, ye noa.

english_verse: When Saul was king, the Reuben tribe attacked and defeated the Hagrites, then took over their land east of Gilead. The Descendants of Gad
translation_verse: Na Sɔɔlo aberɛ so, Rubenfoɛ bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtoale Hagritefoɛ. Rubenfoɛ lili bɛ so ngonim, na bɛɛtenane Hagritefoɛ ɛtena sua mɔ anu wɔ Gileade eyia afiteleɛ amukoraa. Gade boso ama

english_verse: The tribe of Gad lived in the region of Bashan, north of the Reuben tribe. Gad's territory extended all the way to the town of Salecah.
translation_verse: Gade boso ama ne, né bɛ ne Rubenfoɛ bɛbɔ wɛen wɔ Basan aseɛ so alaa bɔ ɔkwaadwu Saleka ɔ.

english_verse: Their relatives included Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber.
translation_verse: Na b’abusuafoɛ kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ te ɛhe: Mikayɛl, Mesulam, Hyeba, Yorai, Yakan, Siya ne Heberi; bɛte nzoo.

english_verse: Ahi, the son of Abdiel and the grandson of Guni, was the leader of their clan.
translation_verse: Ahi bɔ ye baba ole Abidiɛl, bɔ ye baba ole Guni ne, ye yeɛ né ɔla bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ no ɔ.

english_verse: The people of Gad lived in the towns in the regions of Bashan and Gilead, as well as in the pastureland of Sharon.
translation_verse: Né bɛtete Gileade, Basan ne ye nwo nguro mɔ so, yeɛ afei Saron aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ne aso kɔpem ye noa.

english_verse: Their family records were written when Jotham was king of Judah and Jeroboam was king of Israel.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia nemɔ amukoraa, Yuda hene Yotam aberɛ so, ɔne Yisrael hene Yeroboam aberɛ so, begyinane b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ so bɛhale bɛ. Mmusua kure nyɔ ne bue nemɔ

english_verse: They fought against the Hagrites and the tribes of Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
translation_verse: Bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtetale Hagritefoɛ, Yeture, Nafise ne Nodabo.

english_verse: Whenever these soldiers went to war against their enemies, they prayed to God and trusted him to help. That's why the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh defeated the Hagrites and their allies.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bokale Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ yeɛ Manase abusua kure ne bue maa belili Hagritefoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛboka bɛ so ne amukoraa so ngonim, ofikyɛ besu bɛfrɛle Nyameɛ wɔ koɛ ne anu. Nyameɛ tiele bɛ mbaeɛ, ofikyɛ bɛfale bɛ nwo bɛtole ye so.

english_verse: Many of the Hagrites died in battle, because God was fighting this battle against them. The tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh lived in that territory until they were taken as prisoners to Assyria. The Tribe of East Manasseh
translation_verse: Pɔfoɛ nemɔ pee totɔle, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ho tiale bɛ, na Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ, yeɛ Manase abusua kure ne bue bɛtenane pɔfoɛ nemɔ aseɛ ne aso alaa kɔpem kyɛ ebiemɔ bɛɛhyele bɛ koso nnure bɛhɔle ɔ. Manase abusua kure ne bue

english_verse: East Manasseh was a large tribe, so its people settled in the northern region of Bashan, as far north as Baal-Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
translation_verse: Manase abusua kure ne bue ne, né bɛsone pee, na bɛtenane bɛpetene aseɛ ne aso fite Basan kodwu Baal Hɛmɔn, Seniri ne Hɛmɔn bokaa ne.

english_verse: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel were their clan leaders; they were well-known leaders and brave soldiers. The Tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh Are Defeated
translation_verse: Ɛhemɔ yeɛ né bɛlela bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ noa ɔ: Efɛre, Yisi, Eliɛl, Asriɛl, Yeremia, Hodawia ne Yahediɛl. Bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ bɔ bale dumaa ɔ, na né bɛlela bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ noa.

english_verse: The people of the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and East Manasseh were unfaithful to the God their ancestors had worshiped, and they started worshiping the gods of the nations that God had forced out of Canaan.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛyɔle bɔne betiale bɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne. Aseɛ ne aso mmenia bɔ Nyameɛ huhuni bɛ fili bɛ nyunu ne, bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ, Manasefoɛ nemɔ sɔnene bɛ.

english_verse: So God sent King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria to attack these Israelite tribes. The king led them away as prisoners to Assyria, and from then on, he forced them to live in Halah, Habor, Hara, and near the Gozan River.
translation_verse: Yiti Yisrael Nyameɛ kanyane Asiria hene Pulu bɔ besa bɛfrɛ ye Tilgate Pilnese ne, na Rubenfoɛ, Gadefoɛ ne Manase abusua kure ne bue ne, ɔhyele bɛ nnure fale bɛ ooguale Hala, Habo, Hara ne Gosan asue ne anoa, na batena berɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohate mma mmienzua mɔ ole Amram, Yisare, Hebron ne Yusiɛl.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Amram mma ole Aarɔn, Mose ne Miriam. Aarɔn mma mmienzua ole Nadabo, Abihu, Eleasa ne Yitama.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia took Jehozadak to Babylon as prisoner when the Lord let the people of Judah and Jerusalem be dragged from their land.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE mane Nebukadenesa hyele Yudafoɛ ne Yerusalemfoɛ nnure ne, ɔhyele Yehosadake koso nnure bie.

english_verse: Levi's three sons had sons of their own.
translation_verse: Lewi mma mmienzua mɔ ole Gɛsɔm, Kohate ne Merari.

english_verse: Gershon was the father of Libni and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gɛsɔm mma mmienzua mɔ ole Libini ne Simei.

english_verse: Kohath was the father of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohate mma mmienzua mɔ ole Amram, Yisare, Hebron ne Yusiɛl.

english_verse: Merari was the father of Mahli and Mushi. These descendants of Levi each became leaders of their own clans.
translation_verse: Merari mma mmienzua mɔ ole Maheli ne Musi. Lewifoɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ ɛne, kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ɔ.

english_verse: Elkanah was the father of Amasai and Ahimoth.
translation_verse: Ɛlkana mma mmienzua ole Amasae ne Ahimote.

english_verse: Samuel was the father of Joel and Abijah, born in that order.
translation_verse: Samuel mma mmienzua mɔ ɛhe: Yowel te bamuɛbaa, yeɛ Abiya tɔ so nyɔ.

english_verse: Merari's descendants included Mahli, Libni, Shimei, Uzzah, Shimea, Haggiah, and Asaiah. The Temple Musicians
translation_verse: Simea, Hagiya yeɛ Asaya. Dawide neanea nu ye edweintolɛfoɛ

english_verse: After King David had the sacred chest moved to Jerusalem, he appointed musicians from the Levi tribe to be in charge of the music at the place of worship.
translation_verse: Bɛɛfale Apam alaka ne bɛwale AWURADE awuro berɛ ne, Dawide fale AWURADE awuro berɛ edweintolɛ adwuma ne wurale mmenia biemɔ sa.

english_verse: Asaph was Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Asaph's ancestors included Berechiah, Shimea, Michael, Baaseiah, Malchijah, Ethni, Zerah, Adaiah, Ethan, Zimmah, Shimei, Jahath, Gershon, and Levi.
translation_verse: bɔ ye baba ole Yahate, bɔ ye baba ole Gɛsɔm, bɔ ye baba ole Lewi ne.

english_verse: Ethan was also Heman's relative and served as his assistant. Ethan belonged to the Merari clan, and his ancestors included Kishi, Abdi, Malluch, Hashabiah, Amaziah, Hilkiah, Amzi, Bani, Shemer, Mahli, Mushi, Merari, and Levi.
translation_verse: bɔ ye baba ole Maheli, bɔ ye baba ole Musi, bɔ ye baba ole Merari, bɔ ye baba ole Lewi ne.

english_verse: The rest of the Levites were appointed to work at the sacred tent. The Descendants of Aaron
translation_verse: B’eliɛma Lewifoɛ ngaa nemɔ de, bɛfale nyianu sua bɔ ɔte AWURADE awuro ne, nu adwuma ngaa amukoraa bewurale bɛ sa.

english_verse: Only Aaron and his descendants were allowed to offer sacrifices and incense on the two altars at the sacred tent. They were in charge of the most holy place and the ceremonies to forgive sins, just as God's servant Moses had commanded.
translation_verse: Na Aarɔn ne ye mma mmienzua nemɔ, bɛbɔle afɔleɛ wɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bokyea, ɔne ɛyɛɛ afɔleɛ bokyea nemɔ aso. Na bɛyɔle krongron nu krongron berɛ adwuma ne amu bɛfa bɛpatale bɛmane Yisrael, kyɛbɔ ahyɛdeɛ amukoraa bɔ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose hyɛ mane bɛ ne, ɔte ne ala.

english_verse: Aaron's descendants belonged to the Levite clan of Kohath, and they were the first group chosen to receive towns to live in.
translation_verse: Aarɔn boso ama bɔ befi Kohate mmusua mmusua nemɔ anu ne, bɛ nguro ne b’aseɛ bɔ bɛnate serewagualɛ so bɛfa bɛmane bɛ nemɔ ɛhe; ofikyɛ b’aseɛ deɛ yeɛ serewagualɛ ne li moa yele ɔ:

english_verse: They received the town of Hebron in the territory of Judah and the pastureland around it.
translation_verse: Hebron bɔ ɔwɔ Yuda aseɛ so ne, ɔne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ne, yeɛ bɛfa bɛmane bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But the farmland and villages around Hebron were given to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
translation_verse: Nakoso kuro ne anwo mvofoen ne ye nwo namue nemɔ de, bɛfa bɛmane Yefune awa Kalebo.

english_verse: So Aaron's descendants received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Hebron, Libnah, Jattir, Eshtemoa, Hilen, Debir, Ashan, and Beth-Shemesh.
translation_verse: Asan ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Bete Semese ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ.

english_verse: The rest of the Levite clan of Kohath received ten towns from West Manasseh.
translation_verse: Bɛnate serewagualɛ so bɛyele nguro buru befili Manase abusua kure ne bue b’aseɛ so bɛmane Kohate boso ama ngaa nemɔ.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Gershon received thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar, Asher, Naphtali, and East Manasseh in Bashan.
translation_verse: Bɛyele nguro buru ne nza befili Yisaka, Asɛ, Nafetali mmusua kure aseɛ so, yeɛ Basan mbɔtam wɔ Manase aseɛ so bɛfa bɛmane Gɛsɔm boso ama nemɔ, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ te ɔ.

english_verse: The Levite clan of Merari received twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and Zebulun.
translation_verse: Bɛyele nguro buru ne nyɔ befili Ruben abusua kure, Gade abusua kure ne Sebulɔn abusua kure aseɛ so bɛmane Merari boso ama nemɔ, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua nemɔ te ɔ.

english_verse: So the people of Israel gave the Levites towns to live in and the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Yiti Yisraelfoɛ fale sɔ nguro nemɔ ne bɛ nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ bɛmane Lewifoɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: All the towns were chosen with the Lord's help, including those towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
translation_verse: Bɛnate serewagualɛ so bɛyeyele sɔ nguro bɔ babobɔ bɛ dumaa nemɔ befili Yuda abusua kure, Simeon abusua kure yeɛ Benyamin abusua kure b’aseɛ so bɛfa bɛmane bɛ.

english_verse: Some of the families of the Kohath clan received their towns from the tribe of Ephraim.
translation_verse: Bɛyele nguro ne bie befili Efraim abusua kure b’aseɛ so yeɛ bɛfa bɛmane Kohate boso ama nemɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ bie ɔ.

english_verse: These families received the following Safe Towns and the pastureland around them: Shechem in the hill country, Gezer, Jokmeam, Beth-Horon, Aijalon, and Gath-Rimmon.
translation_verse: Ayalɔn ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Gate Rimon ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ.

english_verse: The Gershonite clan received two towns from the tribe of East Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and Ashtaroth, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Bɛyele nguro hemɔ befili Manase abusua kure ne bue b’aseɛ nu bɛmane Gɛsɔm boso ama nemɔ: Golan bɔ ɔwɔ Basan ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Astarote ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ.

english_verse: The Gershonites also received four towns from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh, Daberath, Ramoth, and Anem, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Ramote ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Anem ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ.

english_verse: The Gershonites received four towns from the tribe of Asher: Mashal, Abdon, Hukok, and Rehob, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Hukoke ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Rehobo ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ.

english_verse: The rest of the Merari clan received the towns of Rimmono and Tabor and their pastureland from the tribe of Zebulun.
translation_verse: Bɛyele nguro hemɔ befili Sebulɔn abusua kure b’aseɛ nu bɛmane Merari boso ama ngaa nemɔ: Rimono ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Tabɔ ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ.

english_verse: They also received four towns east of the Jordan River from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the flatlands, Jahzah, Kedemoth, and Mephaath, including the pastures around them.
translation_verse: Kedemote ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Mefaate ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ.

english_verse: And from the tribe of Gad the Merarites received the towns of Ramoth in Gilead, Mahanaim, Heshbon, and Jazer, including the pastureland around them.
translation_verse: Hesebon ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ, yeɛ Yasere ne ye nwo aseɛ bɔ nyɛmmoa didi so ɔ.

english_verse: Issachar was the father of four sons: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron.
translation_verse: Yisaka mma mmienzua mɔ, bɛte nna. Bɛ ole Tola, Pua, Yasubo, yeɛ Simron.

english_verse: Tola was the father of Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, who were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their clan. There were
translation_verse: Tola mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yusi, Refaya, Yeriɛl, Yamae, Yibesam, yeɛ Semuel. Bɛ mu bɛlela bɛ mmusua mmusua nemɔ noa. Na Dawide aberɛ so, né Tola boso ama bɔ bɛkora bɛkɔ koɛ ɔ, bɛte apee aburanyɔ ne nyɔ ne ɛyaa nzia.

english_verse: Ephraim mourned for his sons a long time, and his relatives came to comfort him.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛ baba Efraim suni bɛ ngyẽa pee, na oliɛma mmienzua mɔ wale bɛɛkyekyele ye wora.

english_verse: Uzzi was the father of Izrahiah and the grandfather of Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, who were also family leaders.
translation_verse: Yusi ɔwa bienzua ole Yisrahia, na Yisrahia mma mmienzua mɔ ole Mikayɛl, Obadia, Yowel ne Yisia. Bɛte nnu, na bɛ mukoraa bɛlela bɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ noa.

english_verse: Zophah was the father of Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
translation_verse: Sofa mma mmienzua mɔ ole Sua, Hanefere, Soale, Beri, Yimira,

english_verse: Benjamin was the father of three sons: Bela, Becher, and Jediael.
translation_verse: Benyamin mma mmienzua nemɔ, bɛte nza. Bɛ ole Bela, Bekya yeɛ Yediayɛl.

english_verse: Bela was the father of Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri. They were all brave soldiers and family leaders in their father's clan. The number of soldiers in their clan was
translation_verse: Bela mma mmienzua mɔ te nnu. Bɛ ole Esebon, Yusi, Yusiɛl, Yerimote yeɛ Yiri. Né bɛlela bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ nemɔ noa. Bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ, na bɛhale bɛ boso ama kyɛbɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ te ne, bɛte apee aburanyɔ ne nyɔ ɔne aburasa ne nna.

english_verse: Becher was the father of Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth.
translation_verse: Bekya mma mmienzua mɔ ole Semira, Yoase, Eliesa, Elionae, Omri, Yeremote, Abiya, Anatote yeɛ Alemete. Bɛ mukoraa bɛte Bekya mma mmienzua,

english_verse: Ephraim was the father of Shuthelah and the ancestor of Bered, Tahath, Eleadah, Tahath,
translation_verse: Efraim awa bienzua ole Sutela, bɔ ɔwole Berede, bɔ ɔwole Tahate, bɔ ɔwole Eleada, bɔ ɔwole Tahate, bɔ ɔwole

english_verse: Jediael was the father of Bilhan and the grandfather of Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
translation_verse: Yediayɛl awa bienzua ole Bilhan, na Bilhan mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yeyuse, Benyamin, Ehude, Kenaana, Setan, Tasise yeɛ Ahisahare.

english_verse: Ulam was the father of Bedan. These were all descendants of Gilead, the son of Machir and the grandson of Manasseh.
translation_verse: Yulam awa bienzua ole Bedan. Gileade bɔ ye baba ole Makyiri, bɔ ye baba ole Manase ne, ye boso ama mɔ ɛne.

english_verse: Ir was the father of Shuppim and Huppim, who also belonged to this clan. Dan was the father of Hushim. The Descendants of Naphtali
translation_verse: Yiri mma mmienzua mɔ ole Supim ne Hupim, yeɛ Ahere awa bienzua ole Husim. Nafetali boso ama

english_verse: Naphtali's mother was Bilhah, and he was the father of Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum. The Descendants of Manasseh
translation_verse: Nafetali boso ama mɔ ole Yahesiɛl, Guni, Yesare yeɛ Salum. Bɛte Bilha ye boso ama. Manase boso ama

english_verse: Manasseh and his Syrian wife were the parents of Asriel and Machir the father of Gilead.
translation_verse: Manase mma mmienzua bɔ ɔne ye sómaa Sirianiɛ braa bie bɛwole bɛ nemɔ, bɛ ole Aseriɛl ne Makyiri bɔ ɔwa ole Gileade ne.

english_verse: Machir found a wife for Huppim and one for Shuppim. Machir had a sister named Maacah. Zelophehad was also a descendant of Manasseh, and he had five daughters.
translation_verse: Na Makyiri gyale bra mane Hupim ne Supim. Makyiri aliɛma brasua ole Maaka. Makyiri bosoniɛ ne bie ole Selofehade, na Selofehade wole mmrasua ngome.

english_verse: Machir and his wife Maacah were the parents of Peresh and Sheresh. Peresh was the father of Ulam and Rekem.
translation_verse: Makyiri aye Maaka wole baa bienzua, na ɔtole ye dumaa Perese. Perese aliɛma bienzua li Sɛrese, na ye mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yulam ne Rekem.

english_verse: Gilead's sister Hammolecheth was the mother of Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
translation_verse: Gileade aliɛma brasua Hamolekete wole Yisdode, Abiesa yeɛ Mahela.

english_verse: Shemida, another descendant of Manasseh, was the father of Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam. The Descendants of Ephraim
translation_verse: Semida mma mmienzua mɔ ole Ahian, Sɛkem, Liki yeɛ Aniam. Efraim boso ama

english_verse: Zabad, and Shuthelah. Ephraim had two other sons, Ezer and Elead. But they were killed when they tried to steal livestock from the people who lived in the territory of Gath.
translation_verse: Sabade, bɔ ɔwole Sutela ne. Efraim mma mmienzua bieku mɔ ole Esere ne Eleade. Na Gatefoɛ bɔ bɛwole bɛ wɔ aseɛ ne aso ne, behuni bɛ munyɔ, ofikyɛ bɛhɔle Gatefoɛ nemɔ dɔ bɛɛbɔle bɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ so apaa.

english_verse: Some time later his wife gave birth to another son, and Ephraim named him Beriah, because he was born during a time of misery.
translation_verse: Na Efraim ne ɔye bɛlale. Braa ne nwonzɛle wole baa bienzua, na Efraim tole ye dumaa Beria, ofikyɛ edwirɛ piri yeɛ né wato ye awuro ama ɔ.

english_verse: Ephraim's daughter was Sheerah. She built the towns of Lower Beth-Horon, Upper Beth-Horon, and Uzzen-Sheerah.
translation_verse: Efraim awa brasua ole Seera bɔ ɔkyekyele Bete Horon ngwaen ne sorɔ, yeɛ Yusen Seera ne.

english_verse: Ephraim also had a son named Rephah, and his descendants included Resheph, Telah, Tahan,
translation_verse: Efraim awa ole Refa, bɔ ɔwole Resefe, bɔ ɔwole Tela, bɔ ɔwole Tahan, bɔ ɔwole

english_verse: Nun, and Joshua.
translation_verse: Nun, bɔ ɔwole Yosua ne.

english_verse: The descendants of Ephraim took over the territory as far south as Bethel, as far east as Naaran, and as far west as Gezer. Their territory included all the villages around these towns, as well as Shechem, Ayyah, and the nearby villages.
translation_verse: B’agyapadeɛ ne b’atenaleɛ mɔ ole Betel ne ye nwo nguro mɔ, yeɛ Naaran bɔ ɔwɔ eyia afiteleɛ so, Gɛsɛre bɔ ɔwɔ eyia atɔleɛ so ne ye nwo nguro, Sɛkem ne ye nwo nguro, toonn kodwu Aya ne ye nwo nguro,

english_verse: The descendants of Manasseh settled in the territory that included Beth-Shan, Taanach, Megiddo, Dor, and the nearby villages. The descendants of Joseph lived in these towns and villages. The Descendants of Asher
translation_verse: kɔfa Manasefoɛ wɛen so, Bete Sean ne ye nwo nguro, Taanake ne ye nwo nguro, Megido ne ye nwo nguro, yeɛ Dɔɔ ne ye nwo nguro. Sɔ nguro nemɔ aso yeɛ né Yisrael awa Yosef ye boso ama bɛtete ɔ. Asɛ boso ama

english_verse: Asher had four sons, Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and one daughter, Serah.
translation_verse: Asɛ mma mmienzua mɔ ole Yimina, Yisiwa, Yisiwi yeɛ Beria, na b’eliɛma brasua ole Sera.

english_verse: Beriah was the father of Heber and Malchiel the father of Birzaith.
translation_verse: Beria mma mmienzua mɔ ole Heberi ne Malkiɛl bɔ ɔwa ole Birisate ne.

english_verse: Heber was the father of three sons, Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and one daughter, Shua.
translation_verse: Heberi wole Yaflete, Somere, Hotam ne b’eliɛma brasua Sua.

english_verse: Japhlet was the father of Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath.
translation_verse: Yaflete mma mmienzua mɔ ole Pasake, Bimihale yeɛ Asiwate. Yaflete mma mmienzua mɔ ɛne.

english_verse: Shomer was the father of Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
translation_verse: Semere mma mmienzua mɔ ole Ahi, Rohega, Yehuba ne Aram.

english_verse: And Japhlet's brother Hotham was the father of Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
translation_verse: Semere aliɛma Helem, ye mma mmienzua mɔ ole Sofa, Yimina, Selese ne Amale.

english_verse: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
translation_verse: Besɛre, Hode, Sama, Silisa, Yitrane yeɛ Beera.

translation_verse: Yerusalem bɔ né besa bɛfrɛ ye Yebusi, bɔ ɔte nekaa bɔ né Yebusifoɛ bɛte ne, Dawide ne Yisrael amukoraa bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtoale kuro ne.

english_verse: Later, David moved to the fortress—that's why it's called the City of David.
translation_verse: Dawide kyekyele ye atenaleɛ wɔ anwoserɛ afealeɛ berɛ, yiti bɛfrɛle berɛ Dawide kuro.

english_verse: David became a great and strong ruler, because the Lord All-Powerful was on his side. The Three Warriors (
translation_verse: Dawide hɔle so nyane ngɔsoɛ, ofikyɛ Asafo AWURADE gyinane ye si. Dawide koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ nemɔ (

english_verse: Another time he killed an Egyptian who was over two meters tall and was armed with a spear. Benaiah only had a club, so he grabbed the spear from the Egyptian and killed him with it.
translation_verse: Osa huni Misraimniɛ biaa branoa bie bɔ ye tendenn te agyirɛ nnu ɔ. Né Misraimniɛ ne tira pealɛɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ mbuna bɔ bɛfa nyamaa bɛsosɔ nu bɛnwo ɛtena ɔ. Nakoso Benaya fale abopura hɔle ye so. Ofotili pealɛɛ ne fili Misraimniɛ ne sa nu, na ɔfale Misraimniɛ ne bɔbɔ ye pealɛɛ ne huni ye.

english_verse: and he said, “I'm very thirsty. I wish I had a drink of water from the well by the gate to Bethlehem.”
translation_verse: Na Dawide le aworadɔlɛ hane kyɛ, “Abura bɔ ɔwɔ Betlehem kuro berɛ pambim ne anwo ne, sɛ ebie sa nu nzue brɛ me maa meno a, ahaa mekuro.”

english_verse: The first of these warriors was Jashobeam the son of Hachmoni, the leader of the Three Warriors. In one battle he killed
translation_verse: Dawide koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ nemɔ, bɛ nwo dwirɛ ɛhe: Hakemoni awa Yasobeam yeɛ ne ɔla atitirefoɛ nza nemɔ noa ɔ. Mmerɛ bie, ɔfale ye pealɛɛ huni mmenia ɛyaa nza wɔ koɛ komapɛ anu.

english_verse: Another one of the Three Warriors was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite.
translation_verse: Sɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ nza ne, Dodo awa Eleasa bɔ ɔte Ahohiniɛ ne, sɛ Yasobeam nne berɛ a, ye yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: except Eleazar, who stayed with David. They took their positions in a nearby barley field and defeated the Philistines! The Lord gave Israel a great victory that day.
translation_verse: Nakoso Eleasa ne Dawide begyinane pindinn wɔ ayuo boo ne afia bɛho belele aseɛ ne, na behuhuni Filistifoɛ nemɔ. AWURADE pepɛ lele bɛ, na ɔmaa belili ngonim piri paa.

english_verse: One time the Three Warriors went to meet David among the rocks at Adullam Cave. The Philistine army had set up camp in Rephaim Valley
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bie, né Dawide wɔ Adulam nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua ne anu. Né Filistifoɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ koso bakyekye asikyeleɛ wɔ Refaim bɔnza ne anu. Na koɛhonɛfoɛ atitire aburasa nemɔ, bɛ nu nza hɔle Dawide berɛ.

english_verse: and had taken over Bethlehem. David was in a fortress,
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Dawide wɔ anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne anu, na né Filistifoɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ atenaleɛ ne wɔ Betlehem.

english_verse: and said, “Drinking this water would be like drinking the blood of these men who risked their lives to get it for me.” The Three Warriors did these brave deeds. The Thirty Warriors (
translation_verse: Na Dawide hane kyɛ, “Me Nyameɛ pa gua kyɛ ngɔno nzue ye ɔ. Sɛ meno a, mmenia bɔ bɛfale bɛ ngoa bɛtole serewa bɛɛsale nzue ne bɛwale ne, né mano bɛ mogya!” Yiti wanno. Sɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ nza ne yeɛ bɛyɔle sɔ nikyee ne ɔ.

english_verse: Joab's brother Abishai was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and in one battle he killed
translation_verse: Yoabo aliɛma Abisae, né ɔla koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ aburasa nemɔ noa. Ɔhwene ye pealɛɛ ɔne mmenia ɛyaa nza bɛhone. Ohuhuni bɛ, na olele dumaa kyɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ nza nemɔ ala.

english_verse: and was more famous than the rest of the Thirty Warriors. He was their commander, but he never became one of the Three Warriors.
translation_verse: Koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ nza ne, ye yeɛ olele dumaa piri paa trale nyɔ ne ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔyɛle bɛ so safohene. Nakoso wando koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ nza bɔ beli moa ne.

english_verse: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was a brave man from Kabzeel who did some amazing things. One time he killed two of Moab's best fighters, and one snowy day he went into a pit and killed a lion.
translation_verse: Yehoada awa Benaya bɔ ofi Kabeseel ne, né ɔte koɛhonɛniɛ ahoneserɛniɛ bɔ ye hue yɛ se paa wɔ nningyein pee anu ɔ. Ohuni Moabofoɛ nyɔ bɔ bɛ hue yɛ se ɔ. Asa koso, oohuni gyata wɔ kumaa bie anu ɛlɛho bie bɔ né asukɔtwea tɔ gua ɔ.

english_verse: Benaiah did things like that; he was just as brave as the Three Warriors,
translation_verse: Ahoneserɛ nningyein bɔ Yehoada awa Benaya yɔle ɛne. Na olele dumaa kyɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ nza nemɔ ala.

english_verse: even though he never became one of them. And he was certainly as famous as the rest of the Thirty Warriors. So David made him the leader of his own bodyguard.
translation_verse: Olele dumaa paa wɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ aburasa nemɔ anu, nakoso wando koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ nza nemɔ. Na Dawide nwo ɛwaenbɔlɛfoɛ nemɔ, ɔbɔle ye bɛ so panyi.

english_verse: Several of these warriors were from King Saul's own tribe of Benjamin. They were experts at using a bow and arrows, and they could shoot an arrow or sling a stone with either hand.
translation_verse: Bɛte agyaentolɛfoɛ, na né bɛkora bɛfa bɛ sa bɛen anaa famaa bɛto agyaen anaa taya. Sɔɔlo abusuafoɛ Benyaminfoɛ koso bɛboka so.

english_verse: Men from the tribe of Gad also joined David at his fortress in the desert and served as his warriors. They were also brave soldiers—fierce as lions and quick as gazelles. They were always prepared to fight with shields and spears.
translation_verse: Gade abusua kure nu, koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ bɔ babe wɔ koɛhonɛ nu ne, bɛɛbokale Dawide so wɔ anwoserɛ afealeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ɛserɛ so ne anu. Né bɛkora bɛfa akokyɛm ne pealɛɛ bɛko paa. Bɛ nye yɛ se kyɛ gyata, yeɛ bɛ nwo koso yɛ nyera kyɛ bokaa so ɛwanzane.

english_verse: All these men were army officers; some were high-ranking officers over a thousand troops, and others were officers over a hundred troops.
translation_verse: Sɔ Gadefoɛ nemɔ, né bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ anu mbanyi. Bɔ ye dibea te kãa ne po, né ɔnea koɛhonɛfoɛ ɛyaa ko so, yeɛ bɔ ye dibea te piri ne koso, ɔnea koɛhonɛfoɛ apee ko bɛ so.

english_verse: Earlier, they had crossed the Jordan River when it flooded, and they chased out the people who lived in the valleys on each side of the river. Warriors from the Benjamin and Judah tribes
translation_verse: Bosome bɔ oli moa ne anu, mmerɛ bɔ né asue Yɔɔdan wayi wabu wafa ye boo ne anu ne, sɔ mmenia hemɔ pɛle asue ne, na bɛfoane bɛ bɔ bɛte bɔnza ne anu amukoraa, wɔ eyia afiteleɛ so ne eyia atɔleɛ so.

english_verse: One time a group of men from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah went to the fortress where David was staying.
translation_verse: Benyaminfoɛ ne Yudafoɛ biemɔ bɛhɔle Dawide berɛ wɔ anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne anu.

english_verse: David met them outside and said, “If you are coming as friends to fight on my side, then stay and join us. But if you try to turn me over to my enemies, the God our ancestors worshiped will punish you, because I have done nothing wrong.”
translation_verse: Dawide fitele ooyiale bɛ, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛmɔawa me berɛ abiɛngoɛ so, kyɛ ɛmɔbaaboka me de a, ye de mene ɛmɔ kɔyɛ ko. Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔawa kyɛ ɛmɔbaaye me bɛma me pɔfoɛ mɔ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ nnyɔle bɔne biala a, ye de yɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne, wanwu ye, na okotua ɛmɔ kerɛ.”

english_verse: and brave soldiers, and so David made them officers in his army. They fought on his side when enemy troops attacked.
translation_verse: Bɛbokale Dawide maa ɔho tiale apaabɔlɛfoɛ ne, ofikyɛ né bɛ mukoraa bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ, na bɛɛyɛle ye koɛhonɛfoɛ nu safohene.

english_verse: Other Israelites from as far away as the territories of Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali brought cattle and sheep to slaughter for food. They also brought donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen that were loaded down with flour, dried figs and raisins, wine, and olive oil. Everyone in Israel was very happy.
translation_verse: Afei koso, b’eliɛma mɔ bɔ befi dede te kyɛ Yisaka, Sebulɔn ne Nafetali ne, bɛ koso bɛfale aleɛ pee beguale afunum, afupɔngɔ ne nandwie mɔ so bɛwale, ofikyɛ né anigye awa Yisrael. Aleɛ nemɔ ole esam, borɔdoma bɔ babobɔ ye kunguma, bobe bɔ babobɔ ye kunguma, nzaa, ngoo, nandwie yeɛ mmoaen.

english_verse: All of these soldiers voluntarily came to Hebron because they wanted David to become king of Israel. In fact, everyone in Israel wanted the same thing.
translation_verse: Sɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ, bɔ basiesie bɛ nwo bama koɛ ne, bɛ mukoraa bɛwale Hebron kyɛ bɛbaafa Dawide besie Yisrael amukoraa so hene. Sɔ ala yeɛ né Yisrael ngaa ne amukoraa bayɛ adwene ko kyɛ bɛfa Dawide besi hene ɔ.

english_verse: The soldiers stayed in Hebron three days, eating and drinking what their relatives had prepared for them.
translation_verse: Bɛ ne Dawide tenane berɛ ɛlɛsa, bɔ bedidili bɛnone, ofikyɛ né b’eliɛma mɔ basiesie bɛ si.

english_verse: Then he led them to Baalah in Judah, which was also called Kiriath-Jearim. They went there to get the sacred chest and bring it to Jerusalem, because it belonged to the Lord God, whose throne is above the winged creatures on the lid of the chest.
translation_verse: Na Dawide ne Yisrael amukoraa bɛhɔle Baala bɔ ɔte Yuda kuro bɔ besa bɛfrɛ ye Kiriate Yearim ne, kyɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte kɛrubim so ne, ye alaka bɔ ye dumaa la so ne, bɛkwaafa befi dɔ bɛba.

english_verse: David was afraid what the Lord might do to him, and he asked himself, “Should I really be the one to take care of the sacred chest?”
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, Dawide surole Nyameɛ, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né mahora mafa Nyameɛ alaka ne mahɔ m’awuro?”

english_verse: The people agreed this was the right thing to do.
translation_verse: Maen ne amukoraa bɛpenene so, ofikyɛ edwirɛ ne yɛle bɛ mukoraa fɛ.

english_verse: The sacred chest was still at Abinadab's house, and when David and the crowd arrived there, they brought the chest outside and placed it on a new ox cart. Abinadab's sons Uzzah and Ahio guided the cart,
translation_verse: Bɛfale Nyameɛ alaka ne besiele teaseɛnam monɛ so. Bɛfa befili Abinadabo awuro. Yusa ne Ahio yeɛ né bɛkã teaseɛnam ne ɔ.

english_verse: while David and the crowd danced and sang praises to the Lord with all their might. They played music on small harps and other stringed instruments, and on tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
translation_verse: Na Dawide ne Yisrael maen ne amukoraa bɛfale sangoo, awɛen, akasaa, firikyiwa ne totorobɛndo bɛfale b’anwoserɛ mu bɛtole dwein begole abilie.

english_verse: But when they came to Chidon's threshing place, the oxen stumbled, and Uzzah reached out and took hold of the chest to stop it from falling.
translation_verse: Na beedwuli nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo wɔ Kidɔn nen, nandwie nemɔ sotili, yiti Yusa tengyɛle ye sa sɔle Nyameɛ alaka ne anu.

english_verse: The Lord God was very angry with Uzzah for doing this, and he killed Uzzah right there beside the chest.
translation_verse: AWURADE fɛle Yusa so yaa. Ɔbɔle ye tole ase wɔ berɛ, ofikyɛ ɔtengyɛle ye sa sɔle alaka ne anu; na owu tɔle berɛ ala wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: David then got angry with God for killing Uzzah. So he named that place “Attack on Uzzah,” and it's been called that ever since.
translation_verse: Dawide fɛle yaa, ɔnate kyɛ AWURADE fɛle yaa tuale Yusa so kerɛ. Yiti bafrɛ berɛ Pɛrɛse Yusa maa waadwu ɛnɛ ye.

english_verse: So instead of taking it to Jerusalem, David decided to take it to the home of Obed-Edom, who lived in the town of Gath.
translation_verse: Yiti né Dawide nguro kyɛ ɔfa alaka ne ɔkɔ ye awuro wɔ Dawide kuro ne anu. Mmom Dawide makyele fale alaka ne hɔle Gitiniɛ Obɛde Edom awuro.

english_verse: The chest stayed there for three months, and the Lord blessed Obed-Edom, his family, and everything he owned.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ alaka ne lili Obɛde Edom awuro bosome nza, na AWURADE yirale Obɛde Edom ne ye awuro ama mukoraa ne ye nwo nningyein amukoraa.

english_verse: David and his army marched to Baal-Perazim, where they attacked and defeated the Philistines. He said, “I defeated my enemies because God broke through them like a mighty flood.” So he named the place “The Lord Broke Through.”
translation_verse: Yiti Dawide hɔle Baal Perasim, na olili bɛ so ngonim wɔ berɛ. Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Nyameɛ nate me so wahwi wafa me pɔfoɛ mɔ so kyɛbɔ asue yi twi fa nningyein so ɔ.” Yiti bɛfrɛle berɛ Baal Perasim.

english_verse: David obeyed God and he defeated the Philistines. He even chased them all the way from Gibeon to the entrance to Gezer.
translation_verse: Dawide yɔle kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ hyɛle ye ne ala, na ohuhuni Filistifoɛ nemɔ toonn ofi Gibeon oodwuli Gɛsɛre.

english_verse: King Hiram of Tyre sent some officials to David. They brought along carpenters and stone workers, and enough cedar logs to build David a palace.
translation_verse: Tiro hene Hiram tuli mmenia maa bɛhɔle Dawide berɛ. Bɛfale sida mmakaa, suasilɛfoɛ ne bakaa dwumvoɛ mɔ bɛbokale so yeɛ bɛhɔle ɔ, kyɛ beesi awuro bɛma Dawide.

english_verse: After David moved to Jerusalem, he married more women and had more sons and daughters.
translation_verse: Dawide sa gyigyale mmraa pee wɔ Yerusalem, na Dawide wole mmaa mmienzua ne mmaa mmrasua pee.

english_verse: From then on, David became even more famous, and the Lord made all the nations afraid of him.
translation_verse: Dawide lele dumaa wɔ maen nemɔ amukoraa so, na AWURADE mane ye nwo suronyi tɔle maen maen ne amukoraa so.

english_verse: When the Philistines heard that David had become king of Israel, they came to capture him. But David heard about their plan and marched out to meet them in battle.
translation_verse: Filistifoɛ tele kyɛ bapopa Dawide ngoo bafa ye basi Yisrael so hene ne, bɛboale bɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraa noa kyɛ bɛkwaapena Dawide . Dawide tele sɔ dwirɛ ne, yiti ɔfale koɛ ɔɔtetale bɛ.

english_verse: The Philistines had already camped in Rephaim Valley and were raiding the nearby villages.
translation_verse: Ne Filistifoɛ baatetɛ wɔ Refaim bɔnza ne anu.

english_verse: David asked God, “Should I attack the Philistines? Will you help me win?” The Lord told David, “Yes, attack them! I will give you victory.”
translation_verse: Na Dawide bisale Nyameɛ kyɛ, “Mva koɛ ngɔndoa Filistifoɛ anaa? Aso ɛkɔfa bɛ kowura me sa?” Na AWURADE buale ye kyɛ, “Kɔ na ngɔfa bɛ ngowura wɔ sa.”

english_verse: Then David ordered his troops to burn the idols that the Philistines had left behind.
translation_verse: Filistifoɛ nwatili bɛyakyili bɛ nyameɛ mɔ berɛ, na Dawide maa bɛyerale bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: Some time later, the Philistines came back into the hill country and camped in Rephaim Valley.
translation_verse: Filistifoɛ nemɔ sa wale bieku bɛɛtetɛle wɔ bɔnza ne anu.

english_verse: David asked God what he should do, and God answered, “Don't attack them from the front. Circle around behind them where the balsam trees are.
translation_verse: Na Dawide sa bisale Nyameɛ nen, Nyameɛ buale ye kyɛ, “Nnɛkɔ wɔ nyunu tee, na mmom kakyi wɔ nwo kɔfa bɛ si, ná kɔ bɛ so wɔ mmakaa bɔ bɛfrɛ ye basam ne ndendeneɛ so.

english_verse: Wait there until you hear the treetops making the sound of marching troops. That sound will mean I have marched out ahead of you to fight the Philistine army. So you must then attack quickly!”
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛte ebie gya boso nga wɔ basam mmakaa nemɔ aso a, ye de kɔ bɛ so. Na ɛhe kyire kyɛ Nyameɛ ali wɔ nyunu moa okũkũ Filistifoɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ.”

english_verse: David had several buildings built in Jerusalem, and he had a tent set up where the sacred chest would be kept.
translation_verse: Dawide sisili ye bɔbɔ ye sua wɔ Dawide kuro. Na osiesiele nekaa bie sili ɛtena sua bɔ ɔkɔfa Nyameɛ alaka ne kosie nu ɔ.

english_verse: Next, David invited everyone to come to Jerusalem and watch the sacred chest being carried to the place he had set up for it.
translation_verse: Dawide mane Yisrael maen ne amukoraa bɛbɔle dwaa wɔ Yerusalem kyɛ bɛɛfa AWURADE alaka ne bɛbra nekaa bɔ basiesie bama ye ne.

english_verse: He also sent for Aaron's descendants and for the Levites. The Levites that came were:
translation_verse: Yeɛ Dawide boaboale Aarɔn boso ama ne amukoraa, ɔne Lewifoɛ nemɔ bɛ noa.

english_verse: Uriel, the leader of the Kohath clan, and
translation_verse: Kohate boso ama mɔ: Yuriɛl bɔ ɔla bɛ noa, yeɛ ye nwo ama ɛyaa ko aburanyɔ;

english_verse: Joel, the leader of the Gershon clan, and
translation_verse: Gɛsɔm boso ama mɔ: Yowel bɔ ɔla bɛ noa, yeɛ ye nwo ama ɛyaa ko aburasa;

english_verse: Shemaiah, the leader of the Elizaphan clan, and
translation_verse: Elisafan boso ama mɔ: Semaya bɔ ɔla bɛ noa, yeɛ ye nwo ama ɛyaa nyɔ;

english_verse: Eliel, the leader of the Hebron clan, and
translation_verse: Hebron boso ama mɔ: Eliɛl bɔ ɔla bɛ noa, yeɛ ye nwo ama aburawɔtwɛ;

english_verse: David called together these six Levites and the two priests, Zadok and Abiathar.
translation_verse: Dawide tole ye sa frɛle asɔfo Sadoke ne Abiata, yeɛ Lewifoɛ Yuriɛl, Asaya, Yowel, Semaya, Eliɛl ne Aminadabo.

english_verse: The first time we tried to bring the chest to Jerusalem, we didn't ask the Lord what he wanted us to do. He was angry with us, because you Levites weren't there to carry the chest.”
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ nna ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔsoale ye mmerɛ bɔ oli moa ne ati, AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ fɛle yɛ so yaa paa, ofikyɛ yannea alaka ne aso yé.”

english_verse: The priests and the Levites made themselves clean. They were now ready to carry the sacred chest
translation_verse: Yiti asɔfo nemɔ ne Lewifoɛ ne, bɛpetene bɛ nwo kyɛ bɛkwaafa AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ alaka ne bɛba.

english_verse: on poles that rested on their shoulders, just as the Lord had told Moses to do.
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ alaka ne, Lewifoɛ bɛfale ye mbuna bɔ owurawura nu ne bɛtole bɛ kɔme anwo bɛsoale alaka ne, kyɛbɔ Mose gyinane AWURADE dwirɛ so fale ahyɛdeɛ mane bɛ ne ala.

english_verse: David then told the leaders to choose some Levites to sing and play music on small harps, other stringed instruments, and cymbals.
translation_verse: Dawide sa fale ahyɛdeɛ mane Lewi abusua kure mbanyi ne, kyɛ bɛye edweintolɛfoɛ maa bɛbɔ sangoo, adengum ne firikyiwa bɛto anigye dwein.

english_verse: Four Levites were then appointed to guard the sacred chest. They were Berechiah, Elkanah, Obed-Edom, and Jehiah. Finally, David chose priests to walk in front of the sacred chest and blow trumpets. They were Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer. The Sacred Chest Is Brought to Jerusalem (
translation_verse: Sebania, Yosafate, Netanɛl, Amasae, Sakaria, Benaya ne Eliesa bɔ bɛte asɔfo ne, odi kyɛ behu totorobɛndo nemɔ wɔ Nyameɛ alaka ne nyunu. Na nekaa bɔ alaka ne gyi ne, né Obɛde Edom ne Yehia bɛboka bɛ bɔ bɛwɛne pambim nemɔ aso.

english_verse: David, the leaders of Israel, and the army commanders were very happy as they went to Obed-Edom's house to get the sacred chest.
translation_verse: Yiti Dawide ne Yisrael mbanyi ne koɛhonɛfoɛ apee so safohene nemɔ, bele ahurusi bɛhɔ bɛɛfale AWURADE apam alaka ne befili Obɛde Edom awuro bɛwale.

english_verse: God gave the Levites the strength they needed to carry the chest, and so they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ Nyameɛ bokale Lewifoɛ bɔ né bɛso AWURADE apam alaka ne ati, bɛfale nandwie nyii nzoo ne mmoaen nyii nzoo bɛbɔle afɔleɛ.

english_verse: David, the Levites, Chenaniah the music director, and all the musicians were wearing linen robes, and David was also wearing a linen cloth.
translation_verse: Né Dawide hera nwera tena nyemene. Lewifoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛso alaka ne, edweintolɛfoɛ nemɔ, ɔne Kenania bɔ ɔkenga edwein ma edweintolɛfoɛ ne, sɔ tena ne ala bie yeɛ né ɔhera bɛ ɔ. Na Dawide wurale asɔfo ataadeɛ bɔ ɔte nwera ɔ.

english_verse: While the sacred chest was being carried into Jerusalem, everyone was celebrating by shouting and playing music on horns, trumpets, cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Yiti Yisrael mukoraa bele esebɔlɛ, awɛenhulɛ, totorobɛndohulɛ ne firikyiwabɔlɛ bɛɛfale AWURADE apam alaka ne bɛwale, na né bɛbɔ adengum ne sangoo bɛto dwein serɛserɛ paa.

english_verse: Saul's daughter Michal looked out her window and watched the chest being brought into David's City. But when she saw David jumping and dancing in honor of the Lord, she was disgusted.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE alaka ne oodwuli Dawide kuro berɛ nen, Sɔɔlo awa Mikal tole ye nye neane mboma nu. Onwuni kyɛ Nana Dawide ohuru pepe go abilie, na obuli Dawide animtia wɔ ye ti anu.

english_verse: After David had finished, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord
translation_verse: Dawide bɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne asomdwee afɔleɛ yiele nen, ɔsrɛle AWURADE saleɛ mane maen ne.

english_verse: and gave every person in the crowd a small loaf of bread, some meat, and a handful of raisins.
translation_verse: Na ɔhyɛle aleɛ mane Yisrael maen ne anu mmienzua ne mmrasua amukoraa. Ebiala nyane paanoo mumua ko, naen porɛ ko ne bobe taterɛ ko.

english_verse: David appointed some of the Levites to serve at the sacred chest; they were to play music and sing praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Otuli Lewifoɛ nemɔ bie siele berɛ kyɛ bɛsɔne wɔ AWURADE apam alaka ne anyunu, na bɛsrɛ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ saleɛ, na afei bɛla AWURADE ase ná bɛye ye ayɛ.

english_verse: Asaph was their leader, and Zechariah was his assistant. Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and another man named Jeiel were appointed to play small harps and stringed instruments. Asaph himself played the cymbals,
translation_verse: Asafe yeɛ né ɔla bɛ noa ɔ. Ye yeɛ ɔbɔ firikyiwa ne ɔ. Sɛ ɔne berɛ a, Sakaria yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ɔ, koraka yeɛ ɛhe mɔ lili so ɔ: Yeyiɛl, Semiramote, Yehiel, Matitia, Eliabo, Benaya, Obɛde Edom yeɛ Yeyiɛl, na bɛ yeɛ bɛbɔ adengum ne firikyiwa ne ɔ.

english_verse: and the two priests Benaiah and Jahaziel were to blow trumpets every day in front of the sacred chest. David's Song of Praise (Psalms
translation_verse: Né odi kyɛ asɔfo Benaya ne Yahasiɛl behu totorobɛndo daa wɔ Nyameɛ apam alaka ne nyunu. Dawide asennaa dwein (Edwein

english_verse: We must never forget his agreement and his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔkaye ye apam ne daa biala, bɔ ɔte edwirɛ bɔ ɔhyehyɛle mane aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ apee ko ne,

english_verse: You belong to the family of Israel, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: O, ye somvoɛ Yisrael boso ama, Yakob boso ama bɔ waneanea nu waye bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: That same day, David instructed Asaph and his relatives for the first time to sing these praises to the Lord:
translation_verse: Afei sɔ kyẽa ne, edwein bɔ bɛto bɛye AWURADE ayɛ ne, Dawide lili moa ɔfa wurale Asafe ne Asafe mmango Lewifoɛ nemɔ bɛ sa.

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: O, ɛ́mɔfa asennaa bɛma AWURADE, ɛ́mɔbɔ ye dumaa bɛsɔne ye, ɛ́mɔhã ye anwanwadeɛ ne behyire maen maen mɔ.

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔto ye nwo dwein, ɛ́mɔto ye nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein. Ɛ́mɔbɔ ye anwanwadeɛ amukoraa nwo dawure.

english_verse: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa ye dumaa krongron ne bɛhoahoa bɛ nwo. Bɛ bɔ bɛpena AWURADE si atee ne, ma bɛ nye gye.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power. Worship him always.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔpena AWURADE ne ye tumi. Ɛ́mɔpena ye si atee daa biala.

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔkaye anwanwadeɛ mɔ bɔ wayɔ ne, ye nzɛngyerɛnneɛ mɔ ɔne ye ndɛen bɔ wabua ne.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔte AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ɔ; obua aseɛ ye aso ama amukoraa ndɛen.

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né banzo, bɔ né bemmu bɛ, na bɛte ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ wɔ aseɛ ne aso,

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: bɔ bekyinikyini maen maen mɔ so, bɔ befi ahennie ko anu bɛkɔ maen foforɛ nu ne,

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: wamma ebiala andane bɛ nye; na ɔnate bɛ ti ɔhwene ahemvo mɔ so.

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: Ɔhane kyɛ, “Me mmenia bɔ mapopa bɛ ngoo ne, nnɛma ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ sa bɛkã bɛ; yeɛ me ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ koso, nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ bɛ bɔne biala.”

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Aseɛ so ama amukoraa, ɛ́mɔto dwein bɛye AWURADE ayɛ. Ɛ́mɔhã ye ngoalelɛ nwo dwirɛ daa biala.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbɔ ye animnyam ne nwo dawure wɔ maen maen mɔ so. Ɛ́mɔbɔ ye anwanwadeɛ nwo dawure wɔ maen maen amukoraa so.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE te piri, na ɔfata ayɛyelɛ piri paa; odi kyɛ sona suro ye tra nyameɛ biala.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ maen maen mɔ, bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ, bɛte mmosoen, nakoso AWURADE de, ye yeɛ ɔbɔle anwuro ɔ.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Anidie ne animnyam apɛ ye nwo ayia, tumi ne anigye wɔ ye asɔneyɛɛ sua nu.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Maen maen mɔ nu mmusua mɔ, ɛmɔhã, ɛmɔhã kyɛ animnyam ne tumi te AWURADE deɛ.

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple. Worship the Lord, majestic and holy.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa animnyam bɔ ɔfata AWURADE dumaa ɔ bɛma ye, ɛ́mɔfa afɔleɛ bɛbra ye nyunu, ɛ́mɔsɔne AWURADE wɔ animnyam krongron nu.

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble!” The world stands firm, never to be shaken.
translation_verse: Aseɛ so ama amukoraa, ɛ́mɔsuro AWURADE. Wiase timu berɛ pindinn, ye bo ngotutu le.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! And announce to the nations, “The Lord is King!”
translation_verse: Nyameɛso, ma wɔ nye gye, aseɛ koso, di ahurusi, ná bɛhã ye wɔ maen maen nemɔ aso kyɛ, “AWURADE di hene!”

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all of its creatures and the fields to rejoice with all of their crops.
translation_verse: Ɛpo ne nu nningyein amukoraa, ɛ́mɔyɛ dede; eburo ne eburo nningyein amukoraa, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye gye.

english_verse: Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth.
translation_verse: Yeɛ eburo mmakaa bele anigye bɛkɔto dwein, wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ofikyɛ ɔba babua aseɛ so ama ndɛen.

english_verse: Praise the Lord because he is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Ao, ɛmɔla AWURADE ase, ofikyɛ ɔte paa, na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Say to him, “Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: Afei koso, ɛ́mɔhã kyɛ, “Yɛ ngoalelɛ Nyameɛ, pepɛ de yɛ, boaboa yɛ noa, ná pepɛ de yɛ fi maen maen mɔ sa nu, amaa ɔnate so yafa asennaa yama wɔ dumaa krongron ne, ná yali ahurusi yaye wɔ ayɛ.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever.” After David finished, the people shouted, “Amen! Praise the Lord!” David Appoints Worship Leaders at Jerusalem and Gibeon
translation_verse: AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ne, animnyam hã ye fi tete oodwu afebɔɔ!” Yeɛ mmenia ne amukoraa besele kyɛ, “Amen!” Na bɛyele AWURADE ayɛ. Bɛsɔne AWURADE wɔ Yerusalem ne Gibeon

english_verse: David chose Asaph and the Levites in his clan to be in charge of the daily worship at the place where the sacred chest was kept.
translation_verse: Dawide yɛle nhyehyɛleɛ mane Asafe ne ye mmango Lewifoɛ, kyɛ bɛhɔ AWURADE apam alaka ne anyunu bɛɛsɔne wɔ alaka ne anyunu daa, kyɛbɔ odi kyɛ bɛyɔ ye daa biala ɔ.

english_verse: David also chose Zadok the priest and his relatives who were priests to serve at the Lord's sacred tent at Gibeon.
translation_verse: Dawide mane Sadoke ne ye mmango asɔfo nemɔ bɛtenane AWURADE nyianu sua ne anyunu wɔ asɔneyɛɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Gibeon ne aso,

english_verse: They were to offer sacrifices on the altar every morning and evening, just as the Lord had commanded in the Law he gave Israel.
translation_verse: kyɛ bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE daa biala, ngyerɛmɔ ne nɔsoa, wɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso, kyɛbɔ edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ AWURADE fa mane Yisrael, bɔ wamaa bahyerɛ ye wɔ ye mmeraa ne anu ne, ɔte ne ala.

english_verse: Heman and Jeduthun were their assistants, as well as the other men who had been chosen to praise the Lord for his never-ending love.
translation_verse: Heman ne Yedutun, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bahyɛ da baye bɛ kyɛ bɛye AWURADE ayɛ, wɔ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ daa ne ati ne, né bɛboka bɛ so.

english_verse: Heman and Jeduthun were also responsible for blowing the trumpets, and for playing the cymbals and other instruments during worship at the tent. The Levites in Jeduthun's clan were the guards at Gibeon.
translation_verse: Edwein bɔ bɛto ne, né Heman ne Yedutun yeɛ bɛbɔ totorobɛndo ne firikyiwa ne ɔ. Afei né besa bɛbɔ sangoo bɛto edwein krongron ne. Na Yedutun mma mmienzua nemɔ, bɛyele bɛ kyɛ bɛyɛ pambim awɛmvoɛ.

english_verse: After that, everyone went home, and David went home to his family.
translation_verse: Afei mmenia ne amukoraa bɛhɔle b’awuro, na Dawide hɔle ye awuro oyirayirale ye awuro ama.

english_verse: Soon after David moved into his new palace, he said to Nathan the prophet, “Look around! I live in a palace made of cedar, but the sacred chest is kept in a tent.”
translation_verse: Afei Nana Dawide tenane ye awuro asomdwee nu ne, osele ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Natan kyɛ, “Nde awuro bɔ bafa sida basi ɔ nu, nakoso AWURADE apam alaka ne de, ogyi ɛtena sua nu.”

english_verse: and yet you have promised to do even more for my descendants. You are treating me as if I am a very important person.
translation_verse: Nakoso, ao Nyameɛ, bɔ ayɔ ne po, ɔte wɔ nye so nikyee kaaba bie, ofikyɛ asa ahã kyɛ ɛkɔma wɔ somvoɛ ne ye boso ama yɛkoli hene yɛkɔhyɛ. Ao, AWURADE Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ ɛma sona so ɔ!

english_verse: to go to David and tell him: David, you are my servant, so listen carefully: You are not the one to build a temple for me.
translation_verse: “Kɔhã kyire me somvoɛ Dawide kyɛ, AWURADE nwa nyoo: Nna wɔ yeɛ ɛbaasi sua maa metena nu ɔ.

english_verse: I didn't live in a temple when I brought my people out of Egypt, and I don't live in one now. A tent has always been my home wherever I have gone with them.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ofi kyẽa bɔ nyele Yisrael mvili Misraim mmale bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ɔ, nndenane awuro nu le, na mmom ɛtena sua ne nyianu sua yeɛ medi nu tutena ɔ.

english_verse: I chose special leaders and told them to be like shepherds for my people Israel. But did I ever say anything to even one of them about building a cedar temple for me?
translation_verse: Nekaa biala bɔ mali tutena mene Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa yahɔ ne, Yisrael mbanyi bɔ maye bɛ kyɛ bɛnea me maen so ne, aso mabɔ bɛ nu bie somoɛ kyɛ, ‘Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔamva sida banzi awuro bamma me ɔ?’

english_verse: Wherever you went, I helped you and destroyed your enemies right in front of your eyes. I have made you one of the most famous people in the world.
translation_verse: Magyina wɔ si wɔ nekaa biala bɔ ahɔ ɔ, mali wɔ pɔfoɛ amukoraa so ngonim mama wɔ, na ngɔpagya wɔ dumaa maa ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ aseɛ ye aso atitirefoɛ bɛ dumaa.

english_verse: I have given my people Israel a land of their own where they can live in peace. They will no longer have to tremble with fear—evil nations won't bother them, as they did
translation_verse: Ngɔma me maen Yisrael nekaa maa ɔkɔtena. Ngɔbɔ bɛ atenaseɛ wɔ bɛ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ so, bɔ ebiala ngɔha bɛ ko, bɔ amumuyɛɛfoɛ ngɔhyɛ bɛ so ko ɔ, kyɛbɔ bɛyɔle ye daa,

english_verse: when I let judges rule my people, and I will keep your enemies from attacking you. Now I promise that like you, your descendants will be kings.
translation_verse: ofi mmerɛ bɔ nyele maenbulɛfoɛ maa beelili me maen Yisrael so ne ala. Ngoli wɔ pɔfoɛ amukoraa bɛ so ngonim. Asa koso, me AWURADE, mekã mekyire wɔ kyɛ, ngɔma wɔ boso ama bɛkɔhɔ so bekoli hene.

english_verse: I'll choose one of your sons to be king when you reach the end of your life and are buried beside your ancestors. I'll make him a strong ruler,
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔ mmerɛ so kyɛ ɛkɔtoa wɔ mbanyi mɔ a, ngɔpagya wɔ bosofoɛ nemɔ ko, bɔ ɔte wɔ kunu ba, na ngɔma ye ahennie kotindim.

english_verse: and no one will be able to take his kingdom away from him. He will be the one to build a temple for me.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ okosi sua kɔma me ɔ, na ngɔma ye ahennie kotindim afebɔɔ.

english_verse: I will be like a father to him, and he will be like a son to me. I will never put an end to my agreement with him, as I put an end to my agreement with Saul, who was king before you.
translation_verse: Ngɔyɛ ye baba, ná ye wora wayɛ mma. Na me ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne de, mengɔmaa ɔngɔbɔ ye, kyɛbɔ mmaa ɔbɔle sona bɔ olili bia koraka yeɛ ɛbaali bia nen.

english_verse: I will make sure that your son and his descendants will rule my people and my kingdom forever.
translation_verse: Na mmom, ngɔma ye bo kotindim afebɔɔ wɔ m’awuro ne m’ahennie nu, na ye ahennie bia bo kotindim afebɔɔ.”

english_verse: Nathan told David exactly what the Lord had said. David Gives Thanks to the Lord (
translation_verse: Na Natan hane edwirɛ ne amukoraa ne nyekyire ne amukoraa pɛpɛɛpɛ hyirele Dawide. Dawide asennaa mbaeɛ (

english_verse: I am your servant, and you know my thoughts. What else can I say, except that you have honored me?
translation_verse: Animnyam bɔ ahyɛ me, wɔ somvoɛ Dawide ye, nzikyɛ dwirɛ bieku koraa yeɛ nga ngyire wɔ ɔ? Wɔ yeɛ ɛse wɔ somvoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: David went into the tent he had set up for the sacred chest. He sat there and prayed: Lord God, my family and I don't deserve what you have already done for us,
translation_verse: Afei Nana Dawide ɔɔtenane AWURADE nyunu, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ao, AWURADE Nyameɛ, me ole nwa, yeɛ m’abusua gyi ye sɛ, bɔ apagya me amaa manya dibea sɔa ye?

english_verse: It was your choice to do these wonderful things for me and to make these promises.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ɔnate wɔ somvoɛ ti, ɔne wɔ ti anu dwirɛ ti, yeɛ ayɔ anwanwadeɛ hemɔ amukoraa, ná ala nningyein mbiri hemɔ amukoraa ali ɔ.

english_verse: No other god is like you, Lord—you alone are God. Everything we have heard about you is true.
translation_verse: O AWURADE, edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ yate ye wɔ yɛ so anu ne, okyire kyɛ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ wɔ ɔ, yeɛ nyameɛ biala nne berɛ kyɛ wɔ.

english_verse: And there is no other nation on earth like Israel, the nation you rescued from slavery in Egypt to be your own. You became famous by using great and wonderful miracles to force other nations and their gods out of your land, so that your people could live here.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ, aseɛ ye aso maen beni yeɛ ɔte kyɛ wɔ maen Yisrael ɔ? Yisrael bɔ ɛɛpɔle ye fa yɛle wɔ maen, bɔ ɔnate so ɛyɛle anwanwadeɛ ne nningyein mbiri mbiri mane wɔ dumaa trɛle ne. Ɛfoane maen maen mɔ fili wɔ mmenia nyunu, na ɛpepɛ lele wɔ maen fili Misraim sa nu.

english_verse: You have chosen Israel to be your people forever, and you have become their God.
translation_verse: Afa wɔ maen Yisrael ayɛ wɔ bɔbɔ deinn wɔ maen afebɔɔ, na wɔ, AWURADE, ayɛ bɛ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Then you will be famous forever, and everyone will say, “The Lord All-Powerful rules Israel and is their God.” My kingdom will be strong,
translation_verse: Na bɛkɔbɔ wɔ dumaa bɛkɔkamvo wɔ daa kyɛ, ‘Asafo AWURADE, Yisrael Nyameɛ ne, ɔte Nyameɛ bɔ odi Yisrael so ɔ.’ Na wɔ somvoɛ Dawide awuro ama kotindim wɔ wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: because you are my God, and you have promised that my descendants will be kings. That's why I have the courage to pray to you like this, even though I am only your servant.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ, me Nyameɛ, aye ahyire wɔ somvoɛ kyɛ ɛkɔma ye boso ama bɛkɔhɔ so bekoli hene. Na ɛhe yeɛ wahyɛ wɔ somvoɛ nguraen bɔ ɔmaa ɔbɔ sɔ mbaeɛ he kyire wɔ ye.

english_verse: You are the Lord God, and you have made this good promise to me.
translation_verse: O, AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ ɛte Nyameɛ ɔ, na afa sɔ ndɛenvɛen he ahyɛ wɔ somvoɛ bɔ.

english_verse: Now please bless my descendants forever, and let them always be your chosen kings. You have already blessed my family, and I know you will bless us forever.
translation_verse: Yiti mesrɛ wɔ ala, yira wɔ somvoɛ boso ama, ná maa b’ahennie ɔhɔ so otindim wɔ wɔ nyunu afebɔɔ. Ofikyɛ, AWURADE, bɔ ayira ye ne, né ayira ye afebɔɔ.”

english_verse: While King Hadadezer of Zobah was trying to gain control of the territory near the Euphrates River, David met him in battle at Hamath and defeated him.
translation_verse: Soba hene Hadadesa koso, Dawide fale koɛ ɔɔtoale ye lili ye so ngonim alaa oodwuli Hamate, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né ɔkwaaho trɛ ye ahennie ne anu wɔ asue Yufreti noa ɔ.

english_verse: Hadadezer's officers had carried gold shields, but David took these shields and brought them back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Esikaa kɔkorɛ akokyɛm bɔ né Hadadesa mbanyi mɔ betiratira ne, Dawide lele bɛ sa nu fa wale Yerusalem.

english_verse: When troops from the Syrian kingdom of Damascus came to help Hadadezer, David killed
translation_verse: Na Siriafoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Damasko ne, bɛwale kyɛ bɛbaaboka Soba hene Hadadesa nen, Dawide huni Siriafoɛ nemɔ anu apee aburanyɔ ne nyɔ.

english_verse: Then David stationed some of his troops in Damascus, and the people there had to accept David as their ruler and pay taxes to him. Everywhere David went, the Lord helped him win battles.
translation_verse: Afei Dawide ɔɔkyekyele asikyeleɛ mɔ wɔ Damasko bɔ ɔwɔ Siria, na ɔmane ye koɛhonɛfoɛ bɛɛtenane dɔ. Na Siriafoɛ bɛɛyɛle Dawide ngoaa bɔ né betua ɛtoɔ bɛma ye ɔ. Na AWURADE bɔle Dawide nwo waen wɔ nekaa biala bɔ ɔhɔle ɔ.

english_verse: King Tou of Hamath and King Hadadezer had been enemies. So when Tou heard that David had defeated Hadadezer's whole army, he sent his son Hadoram to congratulate David on his victory. Hadoram also brought him gifts made of gold, silver, and bronze.
translation_verse: Tuyu somane ɔwa bienzua Hadoram wɔ Nana Dawide berɛ maa oobisale ye ahye yɛle ye mmo, kyɛ wali Hadadesa so ngonim ɔ, ofikyɛ né Hadadesa ne Tuyu bɛtaa bɛko koɛ. Hadoram ɔkɔ Dawide berɛ ne, ɔfale mbembenanneɛ bɔ bafa esikaa kɔkorɛ, ɛdwetɛ ne kɔɔbere bayɔ ɔ yeɛ ɔhɔle ɔ.

english_verse: David gave these gifts to the Lord, just as he had done with the silver and gold he had captured from Edom, Moab, Ammon, Philistia, and Amalek.
translation_verse: Ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ Nana Dawide sesa fili maen maen amukoraa so: Edom, Moabo, Amonfoɛ, Filistifoɛ ne Amalɛke berɛ ne, ɔfale sɔ nningyein nemɔ bokale so, na otu siele berɛ mane AWURADE sɔnenɛ.

translation_verse: Seruya awa Abisae huhuni Edomfoɛ apee buru ne mmɔtwɛ wɔ Ngyee Bɔnza ne anu.
