translation_verse: Dawide sele Solomon kyɛ, “Mma, nyɛle m’adwene kyɛ ahaa mesi sua mefa AWURADE me Nyameɛ dumaa meto so.

english_verse: But some time ago, he told me, “David, you have killed too many people and have fought too many battles. That's why you are not the one to build my temple.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ, ‘Ahã mogya agua soma, yeɛ afei aho koɛ mbiri pee. Yiti nnɛsi sua fa me dumaa to so, ofikyɛ aseɛ ye aso, ahã mogya agua pee bɔ me bɔbɔ me nye tua ɔ.

english_verse: But when your son becomes king, I will give him peace throughout his kingdom. His name will be Solomon, because during his rule I will keep Israel safe and peaceful.
translation_verse: Tie, ɛkɔwo baa bienzua bie, na ɔkɔyɛ sona bɔ okuro asomdwee ɔ. Ngɔmaa okonya asomdwee kofi ye pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu wɔ nekaa biala; ofikyɛ bɛkɔfrɛ ye Solomon, na ye aberɛ so, ngɔma Yisrael konya asomdwee ná Yisrael nwo atɔ ye.

english_verse: Solomon will build my temple. He will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him. In fact, one of his descendants will always rule in Israel.”
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ okosi sua kɔfa me dumaa kɔto so ɔ. Ɔkɔyɛ mma, ná me koso mayɛ ye baba, na ngɔma ye ahennie bo kotindim wɔ Yisrael afebɔɔ.’

english_verse: Solomon, my son, I now pray that the Lord your God will be with you and keep his promise to help you build a temple for him.
translation_verse: Yiti mma, AWURADE ogyina wɔ si, amaa ɔnate so ahora asi AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ sua ne, kyɛbɔ wahã wafa wɔ nwo ne ala.

english_verse: May he give you wisdom and knowledge, so that you can rule Israel according to his Law.
translation_verse: Mesrɛ AWURADE kyɛ ɔ́ma wɔ nworɛ ne ndeaseɛ, amaa sɛ ɔfa Yisrael maen ne wura wɔ sa a, anea ali AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa ne aso.

english_verse: If you obey the laws and teachings that the Lord gave Moses, you will be successful. Be strong and brave and don't get discouraged or be afraid of anything.
translation_verse: AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ ɔnate Mose so fa mane Yisrael ne, sɛ ɛnea ná edi so a, okoyie wɔ yé. Gyina pindinn ná ma wɔ hue yɛ se. Nnɛsuro, yeɛ nnɛma wɔ kunu tete wɔ.

english_verse: I have also assigned men who will cut and lay the stone. And there are carpenters and people who are experts in working with
translation_verse: Ele sɔ adwumayɔlɛfoɛ hemɔ pee paa: nyɔboɛdwalɛfoɛ, suasilɛfoɛ, bakaa dwumvoɛ, yeɛ dwumvoɛ ahoroɔ bɔ ɛka bɛ a ennwu bɛ noa, bɔ bɛfa sɔ nningyein hemɔ bedi adwii ɔ:

english_verse: gold, silver, bronze, and iron. You have plenty of workers to do the job. Now get started, and I pray that the Lord will be with you in your work.
translation_verse: esikaa kɔkorɛ, ɛdwetɛ, kɔɔbere yeɛ buralɛ. Yiti hyɛ adwuma ne abo, na mesrɛ kyɛ AWURADE ogyina wɔ si.”

english_verse: David then gave orders for the leaders of Israel to help Solomon.
translation_verse: Afei Dawide fale ahyɛdeɛ mane Yisrael mbanyi kyɛ bɛboka ɔwa Solomon. Dawide sele bɛ kyɛ,

english_verse: David said: The Lord our God has helped me defeat all the people who lived here before us, and he has given you peace from all your enemies. Now this land belongs to the Lord and his people.
translation_verse: “AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ, aso oggyi ɛmɔ si anaa? Maen mɔ bɔ bapɛ ɛmɔ nwo bayia ye, aso ɔmmane asomdwee ɔwwale ɛmɔ ne bɛ b’afia? Ofikyɛ wafa mmenia bɔ bɛte aseɛ ne aso wawura me sa, na AWURADE ne ye mmenia bali aseɛ ne aso ngonim.

english_verse: Obey the Lord your God with your heart and soul. Begin work on the temple to honor him, so that the sacred chest and the things used for worship can be kept there.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔfa besie ɛmɔ nye so kyɛ ɛmɔkɔfa ɛmɔ adwene ne ɛmɔ ahone bekoli AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ si ɔ. Ɛmɔɔsi AWURADE Nyameɛ nekaa krongron ne, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔafa AWURADE apam alaka ne, ɔne Nyameɛ nningyein krongron ne, basie awuro bɔ ɛmɔkosi bɛkɔfa AWURADE dumaa bɛkoto so ne anu.”

english_verse: David was old when he chose his son Solomon to be king of Israel.
translation_verse: Dawide nyini yɛle aworowaa paa ne, ɔfale ɔwa Solomon sili Yisrael so hene.

english_verse: Some time later, David called together all of Israel's leaders, priests, and Levites.
translation_verse: Dawide tole ye sa frɛle Yisrael mbanyi amukoraa ne asɔfo ne Lewifoɛ maa beeyiale.

english_verse: He then counted the Levite men who were at least
translation_verse: Bɛhale Lewifoɛ bɔ bali ofi afoɛ aburasa bɔ ɔkɔ ne, né bɛ somaa te apee aburasa ne mmɔtwɛ.

english_verse: Every morning and evening, the Levites are to give thanks to the Lord and sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ begyina berɛ ngyerɛmɔ biala ne nɔsoa biala bɛda AWURADE ase bɛye ye ayɛ.

english_verse: David then divided the Levites into three groups according to the clans of Levi's sons, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
translation_verse: Na Dawide boaboale Lewi boso ama nemɔ noa kure kure. Lewi mma nemɔ Gɛsɔm, Kohate ne Merari yeɛ ogyinane so boaboale bɛ noa kure kure ɔ.

english_verse: Gershon had two sons: Ladan and Shimei.
translation_verse: Gɛsɔnfoɛ nemɔ ole Ladan ne Simei.

english_verse: Ladan was the father of Jehiel, Zetham, and Joel.
translation_verse: Ladan mma mmienzua nemɔ, Yehiel yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ, yeɛ afei Setam ne Yowel. Bɛte nza.

english_verse: They were all family leaders among their father's descendants. Shimei was the father of Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran.
translation_verse: Simei mma mmienzua mɔ ole Selemote, Hasiɛl ne Haran. Bɛte nza. Bɛ yeɛ bɛlela Ladan mmusua nemɔ noa ɔ.

english_verse: Later, Shimei had four more sons, in the following order: Jahath, Ziza, Jeush, and Beriah. But Jeush and Beriah didn't have many children, so their descendants were counted as one family.
translation_verse: Yahate yeɛ né ɔla bɛ noa ɔ. Sɛ ɔnne berɛ a, Sisa yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ɔ. Nakoso Yeyuse ne Beria de, bɛ boso ama banzo, yiti bɛfale bɛ munyɔ kyɛ abusua komapɛ twe.

english_verse: Kohath had four sons: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Kohate mma mmienzua mɔ ole Amram, Yisare, Hebron ne Yusiɛl; bɛte nna.

english_verse: Amram was the father of Aaron and Moses. Aaron and his descendants were chosen to be in charge of all the sacred things. They served the Lord by offering sacrifices to him and by blessing the people in his name.
translation_verse: Amram mma mmienzua ole Aarɔn ne Mose. Nyameɛ tuli Aarɔn siele berɛ kyɛ ɔɔte nningyein krongron paa nemɔ anwo, ná ye sɔ ti, ɔne ye boso ama bɛyera ɛyɛɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu afebɔɔ, bɛsɔne ye, ná beyira mmenia wɔ AWURADE dumaa nu afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Gershom's oldest son was Shebuel.
translation_verse: Gɛsɔm boso ama nemɔ, Sebuel yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: The second son born to Kohath was Izhar, and his oldest son was Shelomith.
translation_verse: Yisare boso ama, Selomite yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: Hebron, the third son of Kohath, was the father of Jeriah, Amariah, Jahaziel, and Jekameam.
translation_verse: Hebron mma nemɔ, Yeria yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ. Amaria tɔ so nyɔ; Yahasiɛl tɔ so nza, yeɛ Yekameam tɔ so nna.

english_verse: Merari had two sons: Mahli and Mushi. Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish.
translation_verse: Merari mma mmienzua ole Maheli ne Musi. Yeɛ Maheli mma mmienzua ole Eleasa ne Kise.

english_verse: Eleazar had no sons, only daughters, and they married their uncle's sons.
translation_verse: Eleasa wuli bɔ wanwo baa bienzua ɔ, na mmom ɔwole mmrasua ngome. Na Kise mma mmienzua bɔ bɛte b’abusuafoɛ ne, begyigyale bɛ.

english_verse: Mushi the second son of Merari, was the father of Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth.
translation_verse: Musi mma mmienzua mɔ ole Maheli, Edere ne Yeremote. Bɛte nza.

english_verse: David said: The Lord God of Israel has given his people peace, and he will live in Jerusalem forever.
translation_verse: Na Dawide hane kyɛ, “AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ wama ye mmenia banya asomdwee, na ɔte Yerusalem afebɔɔ.

english_verse: And so, the Levites won't need to move the sacred tent and the things used for worship from place to place.
translation_verse: Yiti afei de, onhia kyɛ Lewifoɛ bɛsoa nyianu sua ne, anaa nikyee biala bɔ bɛfa bɛyɔ nu ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ɔ,

english_verse: will serve the Lord by helping Aaron's descendants do their work at the temple, by keeping the courtyards and rooms of the temple clean, and by making sure that everything used in worship stays pure.
translation_verse: Na b’adwuma ole kyɛ odi kyɛ bɛboka Aarɔn boso ama nemɔ wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne anu, odi kyɛ bɛnea aluo berɛ ne pumbu nemɔ aso, odi kyɛ bɛte nningyein krongron nemɔ amukoraa nwo, ná bɛboka Nyameɛ awuro berɛ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma biala yɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: They will also be in charge of the sacred loaves of bread, the flour for the grain sacrifices, the thin wafers, any offerings to be baked, and the flour mixed with olive oil. These Levites will weigh and measure these offerings.
translation_verse: Afei odi kyɛ bɛboka ɛhemɔ koso yɔlɛ nu: paanoo bɔ bɛhyehyɛ ye folii ne, esam paa bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ aburoo afɔleɛ ne, apiti kabrɛdi ne, afɔleɛ bɔ batoto ne, afɔleɛ bɔ bafa ngoo bafra ye ne, ɔne kyɛ bekosusu afɔleɛ nningyein nemɔ ye somaa ɔ.

english_verse: They must also give thanks and sing praises when sacrifices are offered on each Sabbath, as well as during New Moon Festivals and other religious feasts. There must always be enough Levites on duty at the temple to do everything that needs to be done.
translation_verse: Afei odi kyɛ bɛyɔ sɔ mmerɛ biala bɔ bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE ɔ: afofikyẽa, ɛsraen foforɛ, ɔne aluolue amukoraa bɔ bahyehyɛ ɔ. Lewifoɛ somaa bɔ bɛ nwo kohia ne, odi kyɛ bɛyɔ adwuma ne wɔ AWURADE nyunu daa.

english_verse: They were once in charge of taking care of the sacred tent; now they are responsible for the temple and for helping Aaron's descendants.
translation_verse: Yiti odi kyɛ bɛnea ɛtena sua atenaleɛ ne ɔne nekaa krongron ne aso. Afei koso, Aarɔn boso ama bɔ yeɛ bɛte bɛ koso bɛ nwo ama ne, odi kyɛ bɛboka bɛ maa bɛyɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne.”

english_verse: Aaron's descendants were then divided into work groups. Aaron had four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
translation_verse: Aarɔn boso ama nemɔ, bɛ mmusua mmusua ne ɛhe. Aarɔn mma mmienzua ole Nadabo, Abihu, Eleasa ne Yitama.

english_verse: But Nadab and Abihu died long before their father, without having any sons. That's why Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nadabo ne Abihu bewuli bɛyakyili bɛ baba bɔ banwo ba ɔ. Yiti Eleasa ne Yitama yeɛ bɛɛyɛle asɔfo ɔ.

english_verse: David divided Aaron's descendants into groups, according to their assigned work. Zadok, one of Eleazar's descendants, and Ahimelech, one of Ithamar's descendants, helped David.
translation_verse: Sadoke bɔ ɔte Eleasa bosoniɛ ne, ɔne Ahimɛlɛke bɔ ɔte Yitama bosoniɛ ne, Dawide maa bɛbokale ye maa ɔboaboale Aarɔn bosofoɛ nemɔ noa kure kure, kyɛbɔ b’ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma bɔ owura bɛ sa ne, osi te ɔ.

english_verse: groups, and Ithamar's were divided into eight groups, because Eleazar's family included more family leaders.
translation_verse: bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne ngona ne yele Petahia, bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne yele Yehesekel,

english_verse: However, both families included temple officials and priests, and so to make sure the work was divided fairly, David asked God what to do.
translation_verse: Bɛfale serewagualɛ so yeɛ bɛhyɛle adwuma ne pɛpɛɛpɛ bɛmane bɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ Eleasa ne Yitama boso ama nemɔ, né bɛ mukoraa bele mbanyi mɔ bɔ bɛfata kyɛ bɛyɔ Nyameɛ adwuma wɔ nekaa krongron berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: As each group was assigned their duties, Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the Levite wrote down the name of the family leader in charge of that group. The witnesses were David and his officials, as well as Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the family leaders from the clans of the priests and the Levites.
translation_verse: Ahyerɛlɛniɛ Semaya bɔ ɔte Lewiniɛ bɔ ye baba ole Netanɛl ne, ɔhyerɛle bɛ nu biala ye dumaa ne ye adwuma bɔ bafa bawura ye sa ɔ, wɔ mmenia hemɔ nyunu ɔ: Nana ne ye mbanyi mɔ, ɔsɔfo Sadoke, Abiata awa Ahimɛlɛke, ɔne mbanyi bɔ bɛlela asɔfo ne Lewifoɛ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ noa ɔ. Bɛyele abusua ko befili Eleasa sasofoɛ nu, yeɛ bɛyele ko koso befili Yitama sasofoɛ nu.

english_verse: These men were assigned their duties at the temple, just as the Lord God of Israel had commanded their ancestor Aaron. The Rest of the Levites Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia nemɔ, bɛ nu biala kɔ AWURADE awuro ne anu ɔkɔyɔ ye adwuma. Nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ bɛ nana Aarɔn nate AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ dwirɛ so hyehyɛ mane bɛ ne, so yeɛ begyinane bɛyɔle b’adwuma ɔ. Lewifoɛ ngaa nemɔ

english_verse: Here is a list of the other descendants of Levi: Amram was the ancestor of Shubael and Jehdeiah.
translation_verse: Lewi boso ama ngaa nemɔ ɛhe: Amram boso ama nemɔ, Subayel yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ; Subayel boso ama nemɔ, Yedeya yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: Rehabiah was the ancestor of Isshiah, the oldest son in his family.
translation_verse: Rehabia ye boso ama nemɔ, Yisia yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: Izhar was the father of Shelomoth and the grandfather of Jahath.
translation_verse: Yisare boso ama nemɔ, Selemote yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ, yeɛ Selemote boso ama nemɔ koso, Yahate yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: Uzziel was the father of Micah and the grandfather of Shamir.
translation_verse: Yusiɛl boso ama nemɔ, Mika yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ; Mika boso ama nemɔ, Samiri yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: Isshiah, Micah's brother, was the father of Zechariah.
translation_verse: Mika aliɛma ole Yisia, na Yisia boso ama nemɔ, Sakaria yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: Mahli was the father of Eleazar and Kish. Eleazar had no sons, but Kish was the father of Jerahmeel.
translation_verse: Kise boso ama nemɔ, Yerameel yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: Mushi had three sons: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the descendants of Levi, according to their clans.
translation_verse: Musi boso ama nemɔ, Maheli, Edere ne Yerimote yeɛ bɛla bɛ noa ɔ. Lewi boso ama nemɔ, kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ te ɔ, bɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Each one was assigned his duties in the same way that their relatives the priests had been assigned their duties. David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the family leaders of the priests and Levites were the witnesses.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ b’eliɛma mɔ Aarɔn boso ama nemɔ bɛyɔle ne ala, beguale serewa bɛfa bɛhyɛle b’adwuma nemɔ. Beguale serewa ne wɔ mmenia hemɔ anyunu: Nana Dawide, Sadoke, Ahimɛlɛke ne mbanyi bɔ bɛlela Lewifoɛ ne asɔfo abusua ne bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ noa ɔ. Na bɔ bɛyɔle bɛmane bamuɛbaa ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛyɔle bɛmane aliɛmaa kasiɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: David and the temple officials chose the descendants of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to be in charge of music. They were to praise the Lord by playing cymbals, harps and other stringed instruments. Here is a list of the musicians and their duties:
translation_verse: Dawide ne safohene nemɔ, betuli mmenia befili Asafe abusua nu, Heman abusua nu ne Yedutun abusua nu besiele berɛ kyɛ bɛbɔ sangoo, adengum ne firikyiwa bɛfa bɛhyɛ ngɔm. Mmenia bɔ bɛyɛle adwuma ne ɛhe, yeɛ b’adwuma bɔ bɛyɔle ɛhe:

english_verse: Asaph's four sons, Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah, were under the direction of their father and played music whenever the king told them to.
translation_verse: Asafe abusuafoɛ ne anu, bɛyele Sakure, Yosef, Netania ne Asarela bɔ bɛte Asafe mma mmienzua ne. Asafe bɔ ogyina ɛhene ne dwirɛ so ɔhyɛ ngɔm ne yeɛ né ɔla bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: His sons were under his direction and played cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments during times of worship at the temple. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman took their orders directly from the king.
translation_verse: Edwein bɔ né bɛbɔ firikyiwa, sangoo ne adengum bɛto ye wɔ AWURADE awuro bɛfa bɛyɔ Nyameɛ awuro berɛ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne, né bɛ baba nemɔ yeɛ bɛlela bɛ mukoraa bɛ noa ɔ. Asafe, Yedutun ne Heman de, né ɛhene bɔbɔ yeɛ ɔnea bɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: David assigned them their duties by asking the Lord what he wanted. Everyone was responsible for something, whether young or old, teacher or student.
translation_verse: Mbanyi oo, ngwadaa oo, bɛ bɔ bekyire oo, bɛ bɔ besua oo, bɛfale serewagualɛ so yeɛ bɛhyɛle b’edweintolɛ adwuma ne bɛmane bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Obed-Edom had been blessed with eight sons: Shemaiah, Jehozabad, Joah, Sachar, Nethanel, Ammiel, Issachar, and Peullethai.
translation_verse: Amiɛl tɔ so nzia, Yisaka tɔ so nzoo, yeɛ Pewuletae tɔ so mmɔtwɛ, ofikyɛ AWURADE yirale Obɛde Edom.

english_verse: Shemaiah was the father of Othni, Rephael, Obed, Elzabad, Elihu, and Semachiah. They were all respected leaders in their clan.
translation_verse: Semaya mma mmienzua ole Otini, Refael, Obɛde ne Elsabade. B’eliɛma mɔ Elihu ne Semakia koso bɛte titire.

english_verse: Eighteen descendants of Meshelemiah were chosen for this work.
translation_verse: Né Meselemia le mmaa mmienzua ne aliɛmaa mmienzua buru ne mmɔtwɛ bɔ bɛte titire ɔ.

english_verse: Hosah, from the Merari clan, was the father of Shimri, Hilkiah, Tebaliah, and Zechariah. Hosah had made Shimri the family leader, even though he was not the oldest son. Thirteen men from Hosah's family were chosen to be temple guards.
translation_verse: Hilkia tɔ so nyɔ, Tebalia tɔ so nza, yeɛ Sakaria tɔ so nna. Hosa ye mma mmienzua ne oliɛma mmienzua nemɔ amukoraa, bɛte buru ne nza.

english_verse: The guards were divided into groups, according to their family leaders, and they were assigned duties at the temple, just like the other Levites.
translation_verse: Pambim awɛmvoɛ nemɔ, bɛhyehyɛle bɛ nu kure kure, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmusua mmusua te ɔ, na bɛfale AWURADE awuro ne anu adwuma bewurale bɛ sa kyɛ b’eliɛma mɔ Lewifoɛ ngaa nemɔ ala.

english_verse: Each group, no matter how large or small, was assigned a gate to guard, and they let the Lord show them what he wanted done.
translation_verse: Pambim biala, begyinane serewagualɛ so yeɛ bɛfa bɛyele abusua horɛ bɔ ɔkɔwɛne ɔ, kyɛ abusua ne te kãa oo, anaakyɛ ɔte piri oo.

english_verse: Shelemiah was chosen to guard the East Gate. Zechariah his son was a wise man and was chosen to guard the North Gate.
translation_verse: Serewagualɛ ne yele eyia afiteleɛ pambim ne mane Selemia. Ɔwa bienzua Sakaria bɔ ɔte nworɛniɛ ne, ye koso beguale serewa bɛmane ye, na serewa ne yele sorɔ dɔ pambim ne mane ye.

english_verse: Obed-Edom was then chosen to guard the South Gate, and his sons were chosen to guard the storerooms.
translation_verse: Serewagualɛ ne yele ngwaen dɔ pambim ne mane Obɛde Edom, na bɛfale nekaa bɔ besie nningyein ne bewurale ye mma mmienzua nemɔ sa.

english_verse: Shuppim and Hosah were chosen to guard the West Gate and the Shallecheth Gate on the upper road. The guards were assigned the following work schedule:
translation_verse: Eyia atɔleɛ pambim ne Salekete pambim bɔ yeɛ ɔla atee bɔ ɔfo kɔ anwuro dɔ ne anwo ne, serewagualɛ ne yele mane Supim ne Hosa. Mmerɛ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛwɛne ne, bɛhyɛle nu pɛpɛɛpɛ bɛmane awɛmvoɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: Each day six guards were on duty on the east side of the temple, four were on duty on the north side, and four were on duty on the south side. Two guards were stationed at each of the two storerooms,
translation_verse: Eyia afiteleɛ bue nu dɔ ne, daa biala né Lewifoɛ nzia yeɛ bɛwɛne berɛ ɔ; nna wɛne sorɔ dɔ daa biala, nna wɛne ngwaen dɔ daa biala, yeɛ nyɔ ahoroɔ nyɔ wɛne nekaa bɔ besie nningyein ne.

english_verse: four were stationed along the road leading to the west courtyard, and two guards stayed in the court itself.
translation_verse: Na abrannaa bɔ ɔwɔ eyia atɔleɛ dɔ ne, awɛmvoɛ nna wɔ atee ne anoa, yeɛ nyɔ koso wɔ abrannaa ne aso.

english_verse: These were the guard duties assigned to the men from the clans of Korah and Merari. Guards Are Assigned to the Treasury
translation_verse: Korafoɛ ne Merarifoɛ boso ama nemɔ, bɛ nu pambim awɛmvoɛ kure kure nemɔ ɛne. Asɔneyɛɛ sua nu berɛ adwuma ngaa ne

english_verse: The Levites who were relatives of the Korahites and the Merarites were in charge of guarding the temple treasury and the gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Lewifoɛ nemɔ anu, Nyameɛ awuro berɛ nekaa bɔ besie nningyein, ɔne nekaa bɔ besie nningyein bɔ batu basie berɛ bama Nyameɛ ne, Ahiya yeɛ né ɔnea so ɔ.

english_verse: Ladan was from the Gershon clan and was the father of Jehieli. Many of his other descendants were family leaders in the clan.
translation_verse: Ladan boso ama, bɔ ɔnate Ladan so bɛte Gɛsɔnfoɛ, bɔ bɛlela Gɛsɔnniɛ Ladan ye mmusua mmusua nemɔ noa ne, Yehieli yeɛ né ɔla bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: Jehieli was the father of Zetham and Joel, and they were responsible for guarding the treasury.
translation_verse: Yehieli mma mmienzua nemɔ, Setam ne oliɛma Yowel yeɛ né bɛwɛne AWURADE awuro nekaa bɔ besie nningyein ne ɔ.

english_verse: Other guards at the treasury were from the Kohathite clans of Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
translation_verse: Amram boso ama, Yisare boso ama, Hebron boso ama ɔne Yusiɛl boso ama,

english_verse: Shebuel was a descendant of Gershom the son of Moses. He was the chief official in charge of the temple treasury.
translation_verse: nekaa bɔ bɛfa nningyein besie ne, Sebuel bɔ ye baba ole Gɛsɔm, bɔ ye baba ole Mose ne, ye yeɛ né ɔnea so ɔ.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were in charge of all the gifts that were dedicated to the Lord. These included the gifts that King David had dedicated, as well as those dedicated by the family leaders, army officers, and army commanders.
translation_verse: Nana Dawide ne mbanyi bɔ bɛlela mmusua mmusua nemɔ noa, koɛhonɛfoɛ apee apee so safohene nemɔ, ɛyaa ɛyaa so safohene nemɔ, yeɛ safohene ngaa nemɔ, bɛ nningyein bɔ batu basie berɛ bama AWURADE ne nekaa bɔ besie sɔ nningyein nemɔ ne, sɔ Selomite ye, ɔne oliɛma mmienzua mɔ yeɛ né bɛnea so ɔ.

english_verse: And whenever valuable things were captured in battle, these men brought back some of them to make repairs to the temple.
translation_verse: Koɛ nu nzesadeɛ bɔ benyane ne, betuli nu bie besiele berɛ kyɛ bɛfa besiesie AWURADE awuro ne.

english_verse: Shelomoth and his relatives were responsible for any gifts that had been given to the temple, including those from Samuel the prophet, King Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah. Other Officers Are Assigned Their Duties
translation_verse: Afei, nningyein amukoraa bɔ Samuel bɔ ɔse ase ne, Kise awa Sɔɔlo, Nɛɛ awa Abenɛ, Seruya awa Yoabo, batu basie berɛ bama AWURADE ne, bɛfale sɔ nningyein ne amukoraa bewurale Selomite ne oliɛma mmienzua mɔ sa.

english_verse: Chenaniah from the Izhar clan and his sons were government officials and judges. They did not work at the temple.
translation_verse: Yisare boso ama nemɔ anu, Kenania ne ye mma mmienzua mɔ yeɛ betuli bɛ besiele berɛ kyɛ bɛyɛ ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne ndɛenbualɛfoɛ ɔ. B’adwuma deɛ ne de, né bɛnyɔ ye wɔ AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu.

english_verse: Joab the son of Zeruiah had begun to count the people, but he stopped when the Lord began punishing Israel. So the total number was never included in David's official records. Officials in Charge of the King's Property
translation_verse: Seruya awa Yoabo hyɛle ye bo kyɛ ɔka mmenia ne, na wanyie. Nakoso ɛhe ne po, ɔnate sɔ ti, Nyameɛ fɛle Yisrael so yaa maa ye ti bɛhale mmenia nen, bangyerɛ bɛ somaa ne bangua Nana Dawide nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu. Dawide mbanyi ngaa nemɔ

english_verse: who was the leader of the Thirty Warriors, and whose son Ammizabad was also an army commander;
translation_verse: Sɔ Benaya ne, ɔte koɛhonɛniɛ ahoneserɛniɛ bɔ ɔla Dawide koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ aburasa nemɔ bɛ noa ɔ. Ɔwa Amisabade yeɛ né ɔla ye kure deɛ ne anoa ɔ.

english_verse: When David decided to count the people of Israel, he gave orders not to count anyone under
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ bɔ né bennya bellili afoɛ aburanyɔ ne, Dawide wanga bɛ, ofikyɛ né AWURADE ahyɛ bɔ kyɛ ɔkɔma Yisraelfoɛ bɛkɔsone kyɛ ewienu nzramaa.

english_verse: years of age, because the Lord had promised long ago that Israel would have as many people as there are stars in the sky.
translation_verse: Efraimfoɛ deɛ ole Hosea, bɔ ye baba ole Asasia ne; Manase abusua kure ne bue ne, bɛ deɛ ole Yowel, bɔ ye baba ole Pedaya ne;

english_verse: Azmaveth the son of Adiel was in charge of the king's personal storage rooms. Jonathan the son of Uzziah was in charge of the king's other storerooms that were in the towns, the villages, and the defense towers in Israel.
translation_verse: Asimawete bɔ ye baba ole Adiɛl ne, ye yeɛ né ɔnea nekaa bɔ besie ɛhene nningyein ɔ. Nekaa bɔ besie nningyein wɔ manzini nemɔ anu, nguro nu, nguraa nu ne abandenden mɔ nu ne, Yusia awa Yonatan yeɛ né ɔnea so ɔ.

english_verse: Ezri the son of Chelub was in charge of the workers who farmed the king's land.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ né bɛyɔ eburo adwuma, bɔ bɛyɔ fieso adwuma ne, Kelubo awa Esiri yeɛ né ɔnea bɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: Shimei from Ramah was in charge of the vineyards, and Zabdi from Shepham was in charge of storing the wine.
translation_verse: Ramaniɛ Simei yeɛ né ɔnea bobe boo nemɔ aso ɔ, yeɛ bobe mmaa bɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ nzaa ne, Sifimniɛ Sabidi yeɛ né ɔnea so ɔ.

english_verse: Baal Hanan from Geder was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees in the western foothills, and Joash was in charge of storing the olive oil.
translation_verse: Olive mmakaa ne akyea bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ frɛtɛɛ nemɔ aso ne, Gederiniɛ Baal Hanan yeɛ né ɔnea so ɔ. Nekaa bɔ besie ngoo nemɔ, Yoase yeɛ né ɔnea so ɔ.

english_verse: Shitrai from Sharon was responsible for the cattle that were kept in Sharon Plain, and Shaphat son of Adlai was responsible for those kept in the valleys.
translation_verse: Nandwie mɔ bɔ bedidi Saron ne, Saronniɛ Sitrae yeɛ né ɔnea bɛ so ɔ. Yeɛ nandwie mɔ bɔ bedidi wɔ bɔnza nemɔ anu ne, Adlae awa Safate yeɛ né ɔnea bɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels, Jehdeiah from Meronoth was in charge of the donkeys, and Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the sheep and goats.
translation_verse: Yismaelniɛ Obil yeɛ né ɔnea afupɔngɔ nemɔ aso ɔ. Merononiɛ Yedeya yeɛ né ɔnea afunum nemɔ aso ɔ. Mmoaen ne mbɔngye ne, Hagriteniɛ Yasise yeɛ né ɔnea bɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: These were the men in charge of David's royal property. David's Personal Advisors
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia nemɔ amukoraa, né bɛnea Nana Dawide nningyein so.

english_verse: David's uncle Jonathan was a wise and intelligent advisor. He and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni taught David's sons.
translation_verse: Né Dawide baba aliɛma bienzua Yonatan te tufohene. Ɔte ahyerɛlɛniɛ bɔ ɔse nworɛ ɔ. Hakemoni awa Yehiel yeɛ né ɔte Nana Dawide mma mmienzua mɔ bɛ neafoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Ahithophel and Hushai the Archite were two of David's advisors.
translation_verse: Né Ahitofel te Nana Dawide tufohene, yeɛ Akiniɛ Husae te Nana Dawide damvo.

english_verse: Jehoiada the son of Benaiah was the king's advisor after Ahithophel, and later, Abiathar was his advisor. Joab was commander of Israel's army.
translation_verse: Benaya awa Yehoada ɔne Abiata yeɛ besili Ahitofel gya nu ɔ. Né Yoabo te Nana Dawide koɛhonɛfoɛ so safohene.

english_verse: David called a meeting in Jerusalem for all of Israel's leaders, including the tribal leaders, the government officials, the army commanders, the officials in charge of the royal property and livestock, the palace officials, and the brave warriors.
translation_verse: Dawide boaboale Yisrael mbanyi amukoraa noa wɔ Yerusalem: mmusua kure nemɔ nu mbanyi, Nana Dawide somvoɛ mɔ so mbanyi, koɛhonɛfoɛ apee apee so safohene mɔ, koɛhonɛfoɛ ɛyaa ɛyaa so safohene mɔ, Nana Dawide ne ye mma mɔ bɛ nningyein ne bɛ nyɛmmoa so neafoɛ mɔ, ahemvie mbanyi, koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ ne koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: After everyone was there, David stood up and said: Listen to me, my people. I wanted to build a place where the sacred chest would be kept, so we could go there and worship the Lord our God. I have prepared all the supplies for building a temple,
translation_verse: Na Nana Dawide dwɔso gyinane sele kyɛ, “Nniɛma mɔ ne me maen, ɛ́mɔtie. Nyɛle m’adwene kyɛ ngosi sua bɔ ɔkɔyɛ nekaa bɔ AWURADE apam alaka ne okole ye nwome, bɔ ɔkɔyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ gya bo ndiasoɛ ɔ. Na mbenane suasilɛ nwo nningyein nguale berɛ.

english_verse: but the Lord has refused to let me build it, because he said I have killed too many people in battle.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ sele me kyɛ, ‘Nna wɔ yeɛ odi kyɛ esi sua fa me dumaa to so ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛte koɛhonɛniɛ, na ahã mogya agua.’

english_verse: The Lord God chose Judah to be the leading tribe in Israel. Then from Judah, he chose my father's family, and from that family, he chose me to be the king of Israel, and he promised that my descendants will also rule as kings.
translation_verse: AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ, ɔneaneane me nana abusuafoɛ nu yele me fale me sili Yisrael so hene afebɔɔ. Ofikyɛ ɔneane nu yele Yuda abusua kure kyɛ ɔla bɛ noa. Na Yuda awuro ama nu, ɔneane nu yele me baba awuro, yeɛ me baba mma mmienzua mɔ anu koso, ɔsɔle Nyameɛ nye kyɛ wamaa mali Yisrael amukoraa so hene ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed me with many sons, but he chose my son Solomon to be the next king of Israel.
translation_verse: AWURADE alo me mmaa mmienzua pee, na me mmaa mmienzua nemɔ amukoraa, waneanea nu waye mma Solomon kyɛ ɔtena AWURADE ahennie bia so oli Yisrael so hene.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Your son Solomon will build my temple, and it will honor me. Solomon will be like a son to me, and I will be like a father to him.
translation_verse: AWURADE sele me kyɛ, ‘Ɛwa Solomon yeɛ okosi m’awuro ne m’aluo nemɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ maneanea nu maye ye kyɛ ɔyɛ mma, na me koso ngɔyɛ ye baba.

english_verse: If he continues to obey my laws and commands, his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔkɔ so gyina pindinn di me mmeraa dwirɛ ne me nhyehyɛleɛ so, kyɛbɔ odi so ɛnɛ ye a, ye de ngɔma ye ahennie bo kotindim afebɔɔ.’

english_verse: My friends, you are the Lord's people. And now, with God as your witness, I want you to promise that you will do your best to obey everything the Lord God has commanded us. Then this land will always belong to you and your descendants.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE maen Yisrael amukoraa ɛmɔ nyunu, ɔne yɛ Nyameɛ so anu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ ne, ɛmɔli ye mukoraati so, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔafa aseɛ paa he batena so, ná ɛmɔ wue asi wayɛ ɛmɔ boso ama b’agyapadeɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Solomon, my son, worship God and obey him with all your heart and mind, just as I have done. He knows all your thoughts and your reasons for doing things, and so if you turn to him, he will hear your prayers. But if you ignore him, he will reject you forever.
translation_verse: “Na afei, mma Solomon, AWURADE wɔ baba ye Nyameɛ ne, odi kyɛ enwu ye yé, ná ɛfa ahone bɔ nu te, ɔne sotie ɛso ye. Ofikyɛ AWURADE neanea ahone amukoraa nu, na ɔse nzusuleɛ ne adwene biala. Sɛ ɛpena ye si ate a, ekonwu ye, nakoso sɛ ɛpo ye a, ɔkɔye ye sa kofi wɔ bo afebɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen you to build a temple for worshiping him. Be confident and do the work you have been assigned.
translation_verse: Nea yé, ofikyɛ AWURADE awuro bɔ ɔte nekaa krongron ne, wɔ yeɛ waneanea nu waye wɔ kyɛ esi ɔ. Gyina pindinn ná yɔ adwuma ne.”

english_verse: After David finished speaking, he gave Solomon the plans for building the main rooms of the temple, including the porch, the storerooms, the rooms upstairs and downstairs, as well as the most holy place.
translation_verse: Afei kyɛbɔ odi kyɛ besi AWURADE awuro ne, Dawide fale ye nwo ngrataa mane ɔwa Solomon. Okyire kyɛbɔ odi kyɛ besi abrannaa ne, nu sua nemɔ, nekaa bɔ bɛfa nningyein besie nemɔ, ye aborɔsaen so nemɔ, pumbu nemɔ ɔne mbata bia sua ne.

english_verse: He gave Solomon his plans for the courtyards and the open areas around the temple, and for the rooms to store the temple treasures and gifts that had been dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ odi kyɛ besi ɛhemɔ amukoraa ne, Dawide fale ye nwo ngrataa mane Solomon: AWURADE awuro aluo berɛ, pumbu amukoraa bɔ bapɛ aluo berɛ nwo bayia ne, nekaa bɔ bɛfa Nyameɛ awuro nningyein besie ne, ɔne nekaa bɔ bɛfa nningyein bɔ batu basie berɛ bama Nyameɛ besie ne.

english_verse: David also gave Solomon his plans for dividing the priests and the Levites into groups, as well as for the work that needed to be done at the temple and for taking care of the objects used for worship.
translation_verse: Asɔfo kure kure nemɔ ne Lewifoɛ kure kure nemɔ koso, ebiala adwuma bɔ odi kyɛ ɔyɔ ye wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ ne, Nana Dawide fale ye nwo ahyɛdeɛ mane Solomon. Na AWURADE awuro berɛ nningyein amukoraa bɔ bɛfa bɛyɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne, ɔfale ye nwo nhyehyɛleɛ mane Solomon.

english_verse: He told Solomon how much gold and silver was to be used in making the sacred objects,
translation_verse: Dawide hyirele Solomon esikaa kɔkorɛ somaa ɔne ɛdwetɛ somaa bɔ odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛyɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma nningyein biala ɔ;

english_verse: the gold incense altar, and the gold statue of a chariot for the winged creatures which were on the lid of the sacred chest.
translation_verse: esikaa kɔkorɛ paa somaa bɔ odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛyɔ ɛyɛɛ bokyea ne ɔ. Yeɛ afei esikaa kɔkorɛ paa somaa bɔ odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛyɔ esikaa kɔkorɛ teaseɛnam, kɛrubim bɔ bɛ ndaa nu atrɛtrɛ akata AWURADE apam alaka ne aso ne.

english_verse: David then said to Solomon: The Lord showed me how his temple is to be built.
translation_verse: Na Dawide sele Solomon kyɛ, “Krataa bɔ okyire kyɛbɔ besi sua ne amukoraa, bahyerɛ, na AWURADE yeɛ ɔfa mane me ɔ.”

english_verse: But you must see that everything is done according to these plans. Be confident, and never be afraid of anything or get discouraged. The Lord my God will help you do everything needed to finish the temple, so it can be used for worshiping him.
translation_verse: Dawide toale so sele ɔwa Solomon kyɛ, “Gyina pindinn, ma wɔ hue yɛ se, ná yɔ adwuma ne. Nnɛsuro, yeɛ nnɛma wɔ kunu tete wɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ, bɔ ɔte me Nyameɛ ne, ogyi wɔ si. Ongoli wɔ ngasi, yeɛ ɔngɔyakyi wɔ nu, kɔpem kyɛ AWURADE awuro adwuma bɔ bɛfa bɛso ye ne, bekoyie ye mukoraa yɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The priests and Levites have been assigned their duties, and all the skilled workers are prepared to do their work. The people and their leaders will do anything you tell them.
translation_verse: Asɔfo kure kure ne Lewifoɛ kure kure bɔ odi kyɛ bɛyɔ Nyameɛ awuro ne anu ɛsolɛ adwuma amukoraa ne, bɛ ɛne. Na sona biala bɔ okotu ye nwo kosie berɛ bɔ ole adwuma bie nwo nimdeɛ, yeɛ afei mbanyi ne maen ne amukoraa, maa bɛboka wɔ.”

english_verse: and to make the gold and silver objects. Now, who else will show their dedication to the Lord by giving gifts for building his temple?
translation_verse: yeɛ afei esikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ nwo adwuma ngaa amukoraa bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ adwiililɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛyɔ ne. Yiti nwa yeɛ ɔkɔye ye kunu sefaa kɔbɔ afɔleɛ ɔ, amaa ɔnate so watu ye nwo wasie berɛ wama AWURADE ɛnɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Everyone who owned precious stones also donated them to the temple treasury, where Jehiel from the Levite clan of Gershon guarded them.
translation_verse: Afei koso, ebiala bɔ ole nyɔboɛ bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se ne, ɔfa wale maa bɛfa beguale sua bɔ bɛfa AWURADE awuro nningyein begua nu ne anu, na Gɛsɔnniɛ Yehiel yeɛ né ɔnea so ɔ.

english_verse: David and the people were very happy that so much had been given to the Lord, and they all celebrated. David Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Na maen ne nye gyele, ofikyɛ sɔ mmenia nemɔ bɛyele bɛ kunu sefaa bɛbɔle afɔleɛ. Bɛyɛle b’adwene ko bɛyele bɛ kunu bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛmane AWURADE. Na Nana Dawide koso nye gyele paa. Dawide bɔ mbaeɛ ye Nyameɛ ayɛ

english_verse: Then, in front of everyone, David sang praises to the Lord: I praise you forever, Lord! You are the God our ancestor Jacob worshiped.
translation_verse: Afei Dawide yele AWURADE ayɛ wɔ maen ne amukoraati bɛ nyunu. Na Dawide hane kyɛ, “Yɛye wɔ ayɛ afebɔɔ oo, AWURADE, yɛ nana Yisrael ye Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Your power is great, and your glory is seen everywhere in heaven and on earth. You are king of the entire world,
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ɛte piri, na tumi, animnyam, ngonimlilɛ ne ahennie nu animnyam te wɔ deɛ, ofikyɛ anwuro ne aseɛ so nningyein amukoraa bɛte wɔ deɛ. Ao AWURADE, ahennie ne te wɔ deɛ, na wɔ tumi te piri tra ebiala.

english_verse: We thank you, our God, and praise you.
translation_verse: Afei, yɛ Nyameɛ, yɛda wɔ ase, na yɛye wɔ animnyam dumaa ne ayɛ.

english_verse: But why should we be happy that we have given you these gifts? They belong to you, and we have only given back what is already yours.
translation_verse: “Na me ole nwa, yeɛ me maen koso ole nwa, bɔ yahora yabɔ sɔ akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ he ɔ? Ofikyɛ nikyee bɔ yɛle biala, wɔ yeɛ ɛfa mane yɛ ɔ, na wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nikyee yeɛ yafa yabrɛ wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: We are only foreigners living here on earth for a while, just as our ancestors were. And we will soon be gone, like a shadow that suddenly disappears.
translation_verse: Wɔ nyunu, yɛte ɛwɔfoɛ ne amanvrafoɛ, kyɛ yɛ nana mɔ amukoraa ala. Yɛ ngyẽa bɔ yɛdi ye aseɛ ye aso ne, ɔpɛ nu kɔ kyɛ wawoɛ, na yɛngɔhyɛ ná yatu yamini.

english_verse: Our Lord God, we have brought all these things for building a temple to honor you. They belong to you, and you gave them to us.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ, nningyein wora bɔ yatu yasie berɛ kyɛ yɛfa yɛsi sua bɔ wɔ dumaa krongron la so ne, ofi wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ dɔ, na ye mukoraa te wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ deɛ.

english_verse: Always make us eager to give, and help us be faithful to you, just as our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob faithfully worshiped you.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, Abraham, Yisake, Yisrael ne yɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ, adwene paa ne nhyehyɛleɛ paa bɔ ɔte sɔa ye, maa ɔtena wɔ mmenia bɛ ti anu daa. Maa beli nahorɛ bɛma wɔ daa.

english_verse: And give Solomon the desire to completely obey your laws and teachings, and the desire to build the temple for which I have provided these gifts.
translation_verse: Ma mma Solomon onya adwene paa bɔ ɔkɔfa kɔyɛ sotie kɔma wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ, wɔ noa dwirɛ ne w’ahyɛdeɛ, ná okoli bɛ mukoraa so, amaa wasi asɔneyɛɛ sua bɔ mapena ye nwo nningyein magua berɛ ne.”

english_verse: David then said to the people, “Now it's your turn to praise the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped!” So everyone praised the Lord, and they bowed down to honor him and David their king. Solomon Is Crowned King
translation_verse: Afei Dawide sele maen ne amukoraa kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ayɛ.” Na mmenia amukoraa bɔ babɔ dwaa ne, bɛyele AWURADE bɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne ayɛ, na bɛbɔle bɛ nu ase bɛsɔnene AWURADE, yeɛ bɛkotole Nana Dawide koso.

english_verse: The people were very happy, and they ate and drank there at the Lord's altar. That same day, Solomon was again crowned king. The people celebrated and poured olive oil on Solomon's head to show that he would be their next king. They also poured oil on Zadok's head to show that he was their priest.
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, bele anigye bedidili bɛnone wɔ AWURADE nyunu. Bɛpopale Dawide awa Solomon ngoo besili ye hene bieku. Bɛpopale ye ngoo wɔ AWURADE nyunu bɛfale ye betuale bɛ noa, yeɛ Sadoke koso bɛpopale ye ngoo maa ɔyɛle bɛ sɔfo.

english_verse: So Solomon became king after David his father. Solomon was successful, and everyone in Israel obeyed him.
translation_verse: Yiti Solomon tenane AWURADE ahennie bia so lili ye baba Dawide bia yɛle ɛhene. Oyiele ye yé, na Yisrael maen amukoraa bɛsole ye.

Solomon stood on the platform facing the altar with everyone standing behind him. Then he lifted his arms toward heaven; he knelt down
translation_verse: Né Solomon ayɔ kɔɔbere simbini wasie awuro n’aluo berɛ. Ye tendenn nu te agyirɛ nnu, ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ nnu, na ofi ye aseɛnwo bɔ ɔkwaadwu ye anwuro ne, ɔte agyirɛ nza. Ogyinane so, obuli ndwerɛ wɔ so wɔ Yisrael maen ne amukoraa bɛ nyunu, na ɔtrɛtrɛle ye sa nu hyirele nyameɛso.

english_verse: My father David was your servant, and today you have kept every promise you made to him.
translation_verse: Ama ɛbɔ bɔ ɛhyɛle wɔ somvoɛ me baba Dawide ne wawa nu. Nahorɛ nu, ɛtele wɔ noa ɛhyɛle ye bɔ, na ɛnɛ ɛnate wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ tumi so amaa wawa nu.

english_verse: Please keep this promise you made to your servant David.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ, ma wɔ bɔhyɛlɛ bɔ ɛhyɛle wɔ somvoɛ Dawide ne, ɔbra nu.

english_verse: There's not enough room in all of heaven for you, Lord God. How could you possibly live on earth in this temple I have built?
translation_verse: “Nakoso Nyameɛ, aso ɛne mmenia bɛkɔtena aseɛ ye aso amba? Eh, nyameɛso ne nyameɛso anwuro anwuro po, ɔte kãa ma wɔ, nna wayɛ kyɛ sua he bɔ masi ye!

english_verse: This is the temple where you have chosen to be worshiped. Please watch over it day and night and listen when I turn toward it and pray.
translation_verse: amaa sɛ eyia oo, kɔngɔen oo, sua ye bɔ ɔte nekaa bɔ ahyɛ bɔ kyɛ ɛkɔfa wɔ dumaa kɔto so ye, wɔ nye ali ye si; amaa ɔnate so, atie mbaeɛ bɔ w’akoaa kɔfa ye nye kohyire ɛwa kɔbɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Suppose your people Israel sin against you, and then an enemy defeats them. If they come to this temple and beg for forgiveness,
translation_verse: “Sɛ wɔ maen Yisrael bɛyɔ bɔne betia wɔ, ná ye sɔ ti bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ di bɛ so ngonim, nakoso besa benu bɛ nwo, bɛye wɔ dumaa ayɛ, ná bɛbɔ mbaeɛ besu bɛfrɛ wɔ wɔ sua ye anu a,

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven. Forgive them and bring them back to the land you gave their ancestors.
translation_verse: ye de tie bɛ wɔ nyameɛso, fa wɔ maen Yisrael bɛ bɔne kyɛ bɛ, ná aseɛ bɔ ɛfa mane bɛ ne bɛ nana mɔ ne, sa fa bɛ bra so.

english_verse: Suppose your people sin against you, and you punish them by holding back the rain. If they stop sinning and turn toward this temple to pray in your name,
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɔnate bɔne bɔ wɔ mmenia bayɔ batia wɔ ti, esi esue ate wɔ nyameɛso maa esue ɔndɔ, ná bɛfa bɛ nye bekyire ɛwa bɛbɔ mbaeɛ bɛye wɔ dumaa ayɛ, ná ɔnate kyɛ ahwe bɛ so ne ati, bɛsakyera b’adwene béfi bɛ bɔne nwo a,

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven and forgive them. The people of Israel are your servants, so teach them to live right. And send rain on the land you promised them forever.
translation_verse: ye de tie bɛ wɔ nyameɛso, ná fa wɔ ngoaa bɔ bɛ ole wɔ maen Yisrael ne bɛ bɔne kyɛ bɛ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ ekyire bɛ atee paa bɔ odi kyɛ bɛfa so ɔ. Ma esue tɔ wɔ w’aseɛ bɔ afa ama wɔ maen maa wayɛ b’agyapadeɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Sometimes the crops may dry up or rot or be eaten by locusts or grasshoppers, and your people will be starving. Sometimes enemies may surround their towns, or your people will become sick with deadly diseases.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛhɔen piri, anaa ɛhawo piri, anaa fieso nningyein kesenɛ, anaa asukuo, anaa mmɛbɛ, anaa nduro ba maen ye anu; sɛ bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ kã bɛ mia wɔ bɛ nguro ne biala so, sɛ ɛhawo piri anaa anwonyerɛ biala ba bɛ so,

english_verse: You know what is in everyone's heart. So from your home in heaven answer their prayers, according to what they do and what is in their hearts.
translation_verse: ye de tie bɛ sufrɛ wɔ nyameɛso, nekaa bɔ ɛte ne, ná fa bɛ bɔne kyɛ bɛ. Wɔ ngome yeɛ ɛse sona biala ye ti anu dwirɛ ɔ. Yɔ ma ebiala kyɛbɔ ɔfata ye ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛse kuro sona biala ti anu dwirɛ,

english_verse: Then your people will worship you and obey you for as long as they live in the land you gave their ancestors.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so ngyẽa amukoraa bɔ bekoli ye aseɛ bɔ ɛfa mane yɛ nana mɔ ne aso ne, basuro wɔ, ná bali wɔ dwirɛ so.

english_verse: Foreigners will hear about you and your mighty power, and some of them will come to live among your people Israel. If any of them pray toward this temple,
translation_verse: “Sɔ ala yeɛ amanvrafoɛ bɔ nna wɔ maen Yisraelfoɛ ahɔ ɔ, sɛ ɔnate wɔ dumaa kandinga ne, wɔ tumi piri ne, ɔne wɔ tumi asaa ne ati, befi maen bie aso dedeede bɛba, ná bɛfa bɛ nye bekyire sua ye bɛbɔ mbaeɛ a,

english_verse: listen from your home in heaven and answer their prayers. Then everyone on earth will worship you, just as your own people Israel do, and they will know that I have built this temple in your honor.
translation_verse: ye de tie bɛ mbaeɛ wɔ nyameɛso, nekaa bɔ ɛte ne, na yɔ bɔ amanvrafoɛ nemɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔto wɔ nyunu amukoraati ma bɛ, amaa aseɛ ye aso mmenia amukoraa bate wɔ dumaa ne nga ná basuro wɔ, kyɛbɔ wɔ maen Yisrael besuro wɔ ne. Ɔnate ɛhe aso, bekonwu kyɛ wɔ dumaa yeɛ ɔla sua bɔ masi ye aso ɔ.

english_verse: Sometimes you will order your people to attack their enemies. Then your people will turn toward this temple I have built for you in your chosen city, and they will pray to you.
translation_verse: “Sɛ wɔ maen bɛfa koɛ bɛkɔtoa bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ wɔ nekaa biala bɔ ɛkɔsoma bɛ kyɛ bɛhɔ koɛ, ná bɛfa bɛ nye bekyire kuro he bɔ aye asie berɛ ama wɔ nwo, ɔne sua bɔ masi mafa wɔ dumaa mato so ne, ná bɛbɔ mbaeɛ bekyire wɔ a,

english_verse: Answer their prayers from heaven and give them victory.
translation_verse: ye de tie bɛ mbaeɛ ne bɛ sufrɛ wɔ nyameɛso, ná ko bɛ koɛ ma bɛ.

english_verse: Everyone sins. But when your people sin against you, suppose you get angry enough to let their enemies drag them away to foreign countries.
translation_verse: “Sɛ bɛyɔ bɔne betia wɔ , ná ɛfɛ bɛ so yaa ɛfa bɛ wura bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa maa bɛkye bɛ nnure bɛkɔ aseɛ bie aso, kyɛ ɔwɔ dede, anaakyɛ opingye wa,

english_verse: Later, they may feel sorry for what they did and ask your forgiveness. Answer them when they pray toward this temple I have built for you in your chosen city, here in this land you gave their ancestors. From your home in heaven, listen to their sincere prayers and forgive your people who have sinned against you.
translation_verse: ye de tie bɛ mbaeɛ ɔne bɛ sufrɛ wɔ nyameɛso, nekaa bɔ ɛte ne. Di bɛ dwirɛ ma bɛ, ná wɔ mmenia bɔ bayɔ bɔne batia wɔ ne, fa bɛ bɔne kyɛ bɛ.

english_verse: Lord God, hear us when we pray in this temple.
translation_verse: Ao me Nyameɛ, ma wɔ nye li sua ye asi, ná mbaeɛ biala bɔ bɛkɔbɔ ye wɔ ɛwa ne, tie.

english_verse: Come to your new home, where we have already placed the sacred chest, which is the symbol of your strength. I pray that when the priests announce your power to save people, those who are faithful to you will celebrate what you've done for them.
translation_verse: “Ao AWURADE Nyameɛ, mesrɛ wɔ, bra baatena nekaa bɔ ekole wɔ nwome ne, ɛne wɔ tumi alaka ne. Ao, AWURADE Nyameɛ, fa ngoalelɛ yɛ ɛtena kata w’asɔfo mɔ nwo, ná wɔ mmenia bɔ bedi nahorɛ bɛma wɔ ne, maa beli ahurusi wɔ wɔ paayɛlɛ nu.

english_verse: Always remember the love you had for your servant David, so that you will not reject your chosen kings.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE Nyameɛ, nnɛpo wɔ sona bɔ apopa ye ngoo ne. Fa wɔ nye to wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi bɔ ele ye ma wɔ somvoɛ Dawide ne.”

english_verse: When the crowd of people saw the fire and the Lord's glory, they knelt down and worshiped the Lord. They prayed: “The Lord is good, and his love never ends.”
translation_verse: Na Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa benwuni kyɛ see ɔtɔ gua ase, ɔne kyɛ AWURADE animnyam amundu asɔneyɛɛ sua ne aso nen, bɛkotole bɛfale bɛ nyunu bebutuli ase, na bɛsɔnene AWURADE bɛlale ye ase kyɛ, “Ɔte paa, na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ daa.”

english_verse: Then they will answer, “It was because the people of Israel rejected the Lord their God, who rescued their ancestors from Egypt, and they started worshiping other gods.”
translation_verse: Na bekobua kyɛ, ‘AWURADE bɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔyele bɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne, bapo ye baali nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ asi baso bɛ basɔne bɛ. Ɔnate sɔ ti yeɛ AWURADE ama amaneɛ kandinga he wato bɛ ye.’ ”

english_verse: Everybody stood up during the ceremony. The priests were in their assigned places, blowing their trumpets. And the Levites faced them, playing the musical instruments that David had made for them to use when they praised the Lord for his never-ending love.
translation_verse: Asɔfo nemɔ begyinagyinane nekaa bɔ bafa bama bɛ kyɛ begyina ne. Na Lewifoɛ nemɔ koso bɛyɔle sɔ ala. Edweintolɛ nningyein bɔ Nana Dawide yɔle kyɛ bɛfa bɛye AWURADE ayɛ mmerɛ biala bɔ ɔnate b’edweintolɛ so ɔye AWURADE ayɛ ne, Lewifoɛ nemɔ bɛfa bɛtole edwein bɛlale AWURADE ase kyɛ, ‘Ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ daa.’ Né asɔfo nemɔ begyigyi Lewifoɛ nemɔ bɛ ndendeneɛ so behu totorobɛndo bɔ Yisrael maen amukoraa begyigyi berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If my own people will humbly pray and turn back to me and stop sinning, then I will answer them from heaven. I will forgive them and make their land fertile once again.
translation_verse: ná me maen bɔ me dumaa la bɛ so ɔ, bɛbrɛ bɛ nwo ase, bɛbɔ mbaeɛ, bɛpena me si atee, ná bɛsakyera b’adwene befi brabɔlɛ tɛɛ ne anwo a, ye de ngotie bɛ sufrɛ wɔ nyameɛso, ngɔfa bɛ bɔne ngɔhyɛ bɛ, ná masa b’aseɛ ne anwonyerɛ.

english_verse: Then on the twenty-third day of the seventh month, Solomon sent everyone home. They left very happy because of all the good things the Lord had done for David and Solomon, and for his people Israel. The Lord Appears to Solomon Again (
translation_verse: Bosome nzoo ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne nza ne aso, otuli mmenia ne apo maa bɛhɔle b’awuro. Bele anigye ne aworakyekyerɛ yeɛ bɛhɔle ɔ, ɔnate paa bɔ AWURADE ayɔ ama Dawide ne Solomon ɔne ye maen Yisrael ne ati.

english_verse: Some time later, the Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream and said: I heard your prayer, and I have chosen this temple as the place where sacrifices will be offered to me.
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE yele ye nwo ali hyirele Solomon kɔngɔen, na AWURADE sele ye kyɛ, “Mate wɔ mbaeɛ bɔ afa ato me nyunu ne, na maye sua ye mafa kyɛ ɔyɛ afɔleɛbɔlɛ sua.

english_verse: Suppose I hold back the rain or send locusts to eat the crops or make my people suffer with deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Sɛ mesi esue ate wɔ nyameɛso maa esue ɔndɔ, anaa mehyɛ mmɛbɛ kyɛ beli fieso nningyein, anaa mema ɛhawo piri to me maen,

english_verse: because it belongs to me, and this is where I will be worshiped forever. I will never stop watching over it.
translation_verse: Na afei, awuro he, mate ye nwo maa wayɛ krongron, amaa me dumaa ala so afebɔɔ. Me nye koli ye si, na ɔkɔla m’ahone nwo daa biala.

english_verse: Your father David obeyed me, and now, Solomon, you must do the same. Obey my laws and teachings,
translation_verse: Na wɔ de, sɛ edi me dwirɛ so kyɛbɔ wɔ baba Dawide lili so ne, ná ɛyɔ kyɛbɔ mahyɛ wɔ ne amukoraa, na edi m’ahyɛdeɛ ne me nhyehyɛleɛ so a,

english_verse: and I will keep my solemn promise to him that someone from your family will always be king of Israel.
translation_verse: ye de ngɔma w’ahennie ne, ye bo kotimu, kyɛbɔ me ne wɔ baba Dawide yɛyɛle apam kyɛ, ‘Sona bɔ odi wɔ bia odi Yisrael so hene ne, ɔngɔbɔ wɔ le’ ne.

english_verse: But if you or any of the people of Israel disobey my laws or start worshiping foreign gods,
translation_verse: “Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔyakyi me si lilɛ, ná ɛmɔanni me m’ahyɛdeɛ ne me mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ mafa mama ɛmɔ ne aso, ná mmom ɛmɔkɔso nyameɛ foforɛ biemɔ bɛsɔne bɛ a,

english_verse: I will pull you out of this land I gave you. I will desert this temple where I said I would be worshiped, so that people everywhere will think it is only a joke and will make fun of it.
translation_verse: ye de ngɔpɛ ɛmɔ asue ngofi aseɛ bɔ mafa mama ɛmɔ ne aso, na awuro he bɔ mate ye nwo mafa me dumaa mato so ne, ngɔye me nye ngofi so, na mamaa wakakyi mmenia amukoraati bɛ noa nu anyandera ne ngorohoɛ dwirɛ.

english_verse: This temple is now magnificent. But when these things happen, everyone who walks by it will be shocked and will ask, “Why did the Lord do such a terrible thing to his people and to this temple?”
translation_verse: Na ɔba ye sɔ a, sua ye bɔ kekesaala ye ole animnyam ye, ebiala bɔ ɔkɔpɛ nu wɔ ye nwo ne, ɔkɔyɛ ye nwanwa maa ɔkɔhã kyɛ, ‘Nzu ati yeɛ AWURADE ayɛ maen ye ɔne sua ye sɔa ye?’

english_verse: After that, Solomon had his workers rebuild the towns that Hiram had given him. Then Solomon sent Israelites to live in those towns.
translation_verse: Solomon sa kyekyele nguro bɔ Huram fa mane ye ne, na ɔmane Yisraelfoɛ tenatenane so.

english_verse: Solomon attacked and captured the town of Hamath-Zobah.
translation_verse: Solomon hɔle Hamate Soba oolili so ngonim, na ɔfale kuro ne.

english_verse: He ordered his workers to build the town of Tadmor in the desert and some towns in Hamath where he could keep his supplies.
translation_verse: Ɔkyekyele Tademo bɔ ɔwɔ ɛserɛ so ne ɔne nguro amukoraa bɔ bɛfa nningyein besie nu ne wɔ Hamate mbɔtam.

english_verse: He strengthened Upper Beth-Horon and Lower Beth-Horon by adding walls and gates that could be locked.
translation_verse: Osa kyekyele Bete Horon sorɔ, yeɛ Bete Horon ngwaen, maa bɛyɛle nguro bɔ babɔ bɛ nwo waen bato bɛ nwo fasue, ná bafa mmuralɛ babrambram bɛ pambim mɔ asi ɔ.

english_verse: He did the same thing to the town of Baalath and to the cities where he kept supplies, chariots, and horses. Solomon ordered his workers to build whatever he wanted in Jerusalem, Lebanon, and anywhere else in his kingdom.
translation_verse: Solomon sa kyekyele Baalate, yeɛ afei nguro amukoraa bɔ Solomon ɔmaa besie nningyein wɔ nu ne, nguro amukoraa bɔ ye teaseɛnam mɔ wɔ so ne, nguro bɔ ye pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ tete so ne, ɔne sua biala bɔ okuro kyɛ osi wɔ Yerusalem, Lebanon, ɔne aseɛ amukoraa bɔ né odi so hene ne.

english_verse: Solomon's wife, the daughter of the king of Egypt, moved from the part of Jerusalem called David's City to her new palace that Solomon had built. The sacred chest had been kept in David's City, which made his palace sacred, and so Solomon's wife could no longer live there.
translation_verse: Na Faro awa brasua ne, Solomon maa otu fili Dawide kuro ne anu ɔɔtenane awuro bɔ wasi wama ye ne anu. Ofikyɛ Solomon hane kyɛ, “Onni kyɛ me ye ɔtena Yisrael hene Dawide ahemvie ne anu, ofikyɛ nekaa bɔ bafa AWURADE alaka ne basie ne, ɔte krongron.”

english_verse: Solomon offered sacrifices to the Lord on the altar he had built in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ Solomon wasi ye wɔ awuro ne nyunu abrannaa ne aso ne, Solomon bɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ wɔ so mane AWURADE.

english_verse: He followed the requirements that Moses had given for sacrifices offered on the Sabbath, on the first day of each month, the Festival of Thin Bread, the Harvest Festival, and the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔle afɔleɛ biala bɔ odi kyɛ ɔbɔ ye kyẽa biala ɔ, kyɛbɔ Mose mmeraa nu afɔleɛ nhyehyɛleɛ te ne: ɔbɔle afofikyẽa deɛ, ɛsraen foforɛ deɛ, afoɛnoa afoɛnoa aluolue nza nemɔ deɛ bɔ bɛ ole Paanoo Kabrɛdi aluolue, Dapɛn Dapɛn aluolue ne Asese aluolue ne.

english_verse: Solomon then assigned the priests and the Levites their duties at the temple, and he followed the instructions that his father, the man of God, had given him. Some of the Levites were to lead music and help the priests in their duties, and others were to guard the temple gates
translation_verse: Solomon gyinane ye baba Dawide nhyehyɛleɛ so fale asɔfo kure kure nemɔ b’adwuma wurale bɛ sa. Afei ɔfa wurale Lewifoɛ nemɔ sa kyɛ beli maen ne nyunu maa bɛto dwein bɛye AWURADE ayɛ, ná bɛboka asɔfo nemɔ wɔ bɛ daa daa ɛsɔnenɛ adwumayɔlɛ nu. Afei koso, pambim awɛmvoɛ nemɔ, ɔfale kure biala ye pambim deɛ wurale ye sa, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ sona Dawide hyɛle ne.

english_verse: Everything Solomon had planned to do was now finished—from the laying of the temple's foundation to its completion.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE awuro ne anwo adwuma, ofi kyẽa bɔ bɛtole ye fapem kɔpem kyẽa bɔ beyiele ye nwo adwuma bɔkɔɔ ne, Solomon neane maa bɛyɔle nikyee biala pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: Solomon went to Ezion-Geber and Eloth, two Edomite towns on the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Esion Gebɛre ne Elote bɔ bɛwɔ mboanoa wɔ Edom aseɛ so ne, Nana Solomon hɔle berɛ.

english_verse: Hiram sent him ships and some of his experienced sailors. They went with Solomon's own sailors to the country of Ophir and brought back more than
translation_verse: Huram somane ye somvoɛ mɔ maa bɛfale ɛlɛen ne ɛlɛenhanɛfoɛ paa mɔ bɛɛmane Solomon. Bɛhane ɛlɛen nemɔ bɛhɔle Ofire bɛ ne Nana Solomon somvoɛ mɔ bɛɛtɔle esikaa kɔkorɛ kilo apee buru ne nnu bɛbrɛle Solomon.

english_verse: He answered every question, no matter how difficult it was.
translation_verse: Solomon yele ye adwobisa ne amukoraati noa; edwirɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ Nana Solomon wangora wangyirekyire nu wangyire ye ɔ.

english_verse: She said: Solomon, in my own country I had heard about your wisdom and all you've done.
translation_verse: Yiti osele Solomon kyɛ, “Edwirɛ bɔ ndele ye wɔ me bɔbɔ me maen nu dɔ bɔ ɔfa wɔ nningyein bɔ ayɔ ɔne wɔ nworɛ nwo ne, ɔte nahorɛ.

english_verse: But I didn't believe it until I saw it with my own eyes! And there's so much I didn't hear about. You are greater than I was told.
translation_verse: Nakoso manne edwirɛ bɔ ndele ne manni kɔpem kyɛ me bɔbɔ mvale me nye mma nwuni ye ɔ. Kyɛbɔ esi se nworɛ paa ne, bɔ ndele ne, ondwu bɔ manwu ye ne ye bue po. Wɔ nworɛ ne, ɔbo bɔ ndele ne aso koraa.

english_verse: Your people and officials are lucky to be here where they can listen to the wise things you say.
translation_verse: Wɔ mmenia mɔ bato bali. Wɔ somvoɛ hemɔ bɔ daa bɛso wɔ ná betie wɔ nworɛ dwirɛ ne, bato bali!

english_verse: I praise the Lord your God. He is pleased with you and has made you king of Israel. God loves the people of this country and will never desert them, so he has given them a king who will rule fairly and honestly.
translation_verse: Animnyam hã AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ wahuro wɔ dwirɛ, ná wafa wɔ wasie ye bia so kyɛ di hene ma AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ! Ɔnate kyɛ wɔ Nyameɛ hurole Yisrael dwirɛ ná ɔmane bɛ bo timuni afebɔɔ ne ati, wamaa ali bɛ so hene, kyɛ ɛfa ndɛen turoloobualɛ ne bra bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ ebu maen ne.”

english_verse: The Queen of Sheba gave Solomon more than four tons of gold, a large amount of jewels, and the best spices anyone had ever seen.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Hyeba hemmaa mane Nana Solomon esikaa kɔkorɛ kilo apee nna, ayirefona pee paa ɔne nyɔboɛ bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se ɔ pee. Ayirefona bɔ Hyeba hemmaa fa mane Nana Solomon ne, bannya ye sɛso ko.

english_verse: not counting what the merchants and traders brought him. The kings of Arabia and the leaders of Israel also gave him gold and silver.

english_verse: Everything else Solomon did while he was king is written in the records of Nathan the prophet, Ahijah the prophet from Shiloh, and Iddo the prophet who wrote about Jeroboam son of Nebat.

translation_verse: Nakoso yɛ de, AWURADE yeɛ ɔte yɛ Nyameɛ ɔ. Yɛ de yɛppole ye. Yɛ asɔfo bɔ bɛyɔ AWURADE ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne, bɛte Aarɔn bosofoɛ; na Lewifoɛ yeɛ bɛboka bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Two times every day they offer sacrifices and burn incense to the Lord. They set out the sacred loaves of bread on a table that has been purified, and they light the lamps in the gold lampstand every day at sunset. We follow the commands of the Lord our God—you have rejected him!
translation_verse: Ngyerɛmɔ ne nɔsoa biala, bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne ɛyɛɛ fona afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE. Na esikaa kɔkorɛ paa poen ne, bɛhyehyɛ paanoo folii begua so. Bɛnea kyɛ esikaa kɔkorɛ kanea bakaa ne, ye kanea nemɔ kɔsɔ nɔsoa biala, ofikyɛ yɛyɔ bɔ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ahyɛ yɛ kyɛ yɛyɔ ɔ. Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔapo ye.

english_verse: That's why God is on our side and will lead us into battle when the priests sound the signal on the trumpets. It's no use, Israelites. You might as well give up. There's no way you can defeat the Lord, the God your ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, Nyameɛ yeɛ otua yɛ noa ɔ. Ye asɔfo nemɔ betiratira bɛ koɛ totorobɛndo bɔ behu bɛfrɛ mmenia maa yɛne ɛmɔ bako ɔ. O Yisraelfoɛ, nnɛma ɛmɔfa koɛ bɛtoa AWURADE, ɛmɔ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne, ofikyɛ ɛmɔngɔhora bengoli ngonim.”

english_verse: But while Abijah was talking, Jeroboam had sent some of his troops to attack Judah's army from behind, while the rest attacked from the front.
translation_verse: Né Yeroboam wasoma koɛhonɛfoɛ maa baatetɛ kyɛ bɛɛfa Yudafoɛ si bɛfa koɛ bɛtoa bɛ. Yiti né ye koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛwɔ Yuda koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ nyunu, yeɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ baatetɛ ne, bɛwɔ Yudafoɛ nemɔ asi.

english_verse: Judah's army won because they had trusted the Lord God of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Yiti Yisraelfoɛ belili ngoguo sɔ mmerɛ ne, na Yudafoɛ lili ngonim, ofikyɛ Yudafoɛ fale bɛ nwo bɛtole AWURADE bɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Abijah kept up his attack on Jeroboam's army and captured the Israelite towns of Bethel, Jeshanah, and Ephron, as well as the villages around them.
translation_verse: Abiya foane Yeroboam, na olele ye nguro nemɔ bie fili ye sa nu. Nguro nemɔ ole Betel ne ye nwo nguraa mɔ, Yesana ne ye nwo nguraa mɔ, yeɛ Efron ne ye nwo nguraa mɔ.

english_verse: Jeroboam never regained his power during the rest of Abijah's rule. The Lord punished Jeroboam, and he died, but Abijah became more powerful.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né Abiya di bia ne amukoraa, Yeroboam ahennie ne wambe ye daa nu. Na AWURADE bɔle ye maa owuli.

english_verse: Everything Abijah said and did while he was king is written in the records of Iddo the prophet.
translation_verse: Abiya nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ye suban ne ye nnwumaa, bahyerɛ ye wɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yido ye nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: Asa obeyed the Lord his God and did right.
translation_verse: Asa yɔle bɔ ɔte paa ne bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ wɔ AWURADE ye Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: He destroyed the local shrines and the altars to foreign gods. He smashed the stone images of gods and cut down the sacred poles used in worshiping the goddess Asherah.
translation_verse: Asa tutuli maen maen mmosoen afɔleɛ bokyea nemɔ ne asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ abo. Obubuli mmosoen bonima nemɔ, yeɛ ɔpepɛle Asera dosii nemɔ guale ase.

english_verse: Then he told everyone in Judah to worship the Lord God, just as their ancestors had done, and to obey his laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Na ɔhyɛle kyɛ Yuda maen bɛso AWURADE, bɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne, ná beli ye mmeraa ne ye mmeraa dwirɛ so.

english_verse: The Lord blessed Judah with peace while Asa was king, and so during that time, Asa fortified many of the towns.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ asomdwee wale aseɛ ne aso ne, Asa kyekyele nguro bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue ɔ wɔ Yuda. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, wango koɛ biala ofikyɛ AWURADE mane ye asomdwee.

english_verse: He said to the people, “Let's build walls and defense towers for these towns, and put in gates that can be locked with bars. This land still belongs to us, because we have obeyed the Lord our God. He has given us peace from all our enemies.” The people did everything Asa had suggested.
translation_verse: Asa sele Yuda maen kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma yɛkyekye sɔ nguro nemɔ, ná yɛsi fasue, abandenden ne pambim bɔ babrambram bɛ si ɔ yɛ́fa yɛ́bɔ bɛ nwo waen. Aseɛ ne tɛ te yɛ deɛ, ofikyɛ yali AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ si. Yali ye si, na wamaa yanya asomdwee wɔ nekaa biala.” Yiti bɛhɔle so bɛyɔle sɔ adwuma nemɔ maa oyiele bɛ yé.

english_verse: Asa met him there, and the two armies prepared for battle in Zephathah Valley.
translation_verse: Asa fale koɛ ooyiale ye, na bɛfale koɛ ne bɛtetale so wɔ Sefata bɔnza ne anu wɔ Maresa.

english_verse: Asa prayed: Lord God, only you can help a powerless army defeat a stronger one. So we depend on you to help us. We will fight against this powerful army to honor your name, and we know that you won't be defeated. You are the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Asa sũ frɛle AWURADE ye Nyameɛ kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE, ɛkora boka sona bɔ ye nwo yɛ se, yeɛ ɛkora boka bɔ ye nwo nyɛ se koso ɔ. Ao AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ, boka yɛ, ofikyɛ yafa yɛ nwo yato wɔ so, na wɔ dumaa nu yeɛ yɛfa koɛ yɛkɔtoa ɛlɔen he ɔ. Ao AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ ɛte yɛ Nyameɛ ɔ. Nnɛma dasaniɛ biala di wɔ so ngonim.”

english_verse: The Lord helped Asa and his army defeat the Ethiopians. The enemy soldiers ran away,
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE lili Yitiopiafoɛ nemɔ aso ngonim mane Asa ne Yuda maen, na Yitiopiafoɛ nemɔ nwatili.

english_verse: but Asa and his troops chased them as far as Gerar. It was a total defeat—the Ethiopians could not even fight back! The soldiers from Judah took everything that had belonged to the Ethiopians.
translation_verse: Asa ne ye koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ bɛboka ye so ne, bɛfoane Yitiopiafoɛ nemɔ alaa beedwuli Gera, na Yitiopiafoɛ totɔle bɔ wanga bɛ nu ko po ɔ, ofikyɛ belili ngoguo wɔ AWURADE ne ye koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ nyunu. Na Yudafoɛ bɛsesale koɛ nu nzesadeɛ pee.

english_verse: The people who lived in the villages around Gerar learned what had happened and were afraid of the Lord. So Judah's army easily defeated them and carried off everything of value that they wanted from these towns.
translation_verse: Nguro bɔ bapɛ Gera nwo bayia ne, Yudafoɛ lili bɛ so ngonim, ofikyɛ AWURADE nwo suronyi tɔle sɔ nguro nemɔ aso. Bɛfene nguro nemɔ amukoraa nu nningyein, ofikyɛ né koɛ nu nzesadeɛ pee wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: They also attacked the camps where the shepherds lived and took a lot of sheep, goats, and camels. Then they went back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Afei, bɛ bɔ bele ayɛmmoa mɔ ne koso, Yudafoɛ fale koɛ bɛtoale bɛ bɛsesale bɛ mmoaen ne mbɔngye pee, ɔne b’afupɔngɔ mɔ bɛhɔle. Afei besa bɛhɔle Yerusalem.

english_verse: Some time later, God spoke to Azariah son of Oded.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ Sunzum wale Odɛde awa Asaria so.

english_verse: At once, Azariah went to Asa and said: Listen to me, King Asa and you people of Judah and Benjamin. The Lord will be with you and help you, as long as you obey and worship him. But if you disobey him, he will desert you.
translation_verse: Ɔhɔ ooyiale Asa, na osele ye kyɛ, “Asa ne Yuda maen amukoraa ne Benyamin maen amukoraa, ɛ́mɔtie! Ɛmɔso AWURADE ye de, AWURADE gyi ɛmɔ si. Sɛ ɛmɔpena ye si atee a, ɛmɔkonwu ye. Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔpo ye a, ye koso ɔkɔpo ɛmɔ.

english_verse: For a long time, the people of Israel did not worship the true God or listen to priests who could teach them about God. They refused to obey God's Law.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ tendenn bie bɔ wapɛ nu ɔ, né Yisrael ɔnze nahorɛniɛ Nyameɛ ne. Né belle ɔsɔfo bɔ okyirekyire bɛ ɔ, yeɛ belle mmeraa biala.

english_verse: But whenever trouble came, Israel turned back to the Lord their God and worshiped him.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ b’anwokyere nu besa bɛwale AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ berɛ, ná bɛpenane ye si atee ne, benwuni ye.

english_verse: There was so much confusion in those days that it wasn't safe to go anywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ nemɔ anu, né ɔyɛ suro kyɛ ekotu wɔ gya ɔ, ofikyɛ né amaneɛ mbiri mbiri atoto maen maen mɔ nu mmenia amukoraa.

english_verse: Nations were destroying each other, and cities were wiping out other cities, because God was causing trouble and unrest everywhere.
translation_verse: Bɛ nu tetele. Maen ho tiale maen, yeɛ kuro ho tiale kuro, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ mane ɛhawo ahoroɔ wale bɛ so.

english_verse: As soon as Asa heard what Azariah the prophet said, he gave orders for all the idols in Judah and Benjamin to be destroyed, including those in the towns he had captured in the territory of Ephraim. He also repaired the Lord's altar that was in front of the temple porch.
translation_verse: Asa tele ngɔm bɔ Odɛde awa Asaria hyɛle nen, osili ye hue, na akyiwadeɛ mmosoen mɔ bɔ bɛwowɔ Yuda ne Benyamin aseɛ so amukoraa, ɔne bɔ bɛwɔ nguro bɔ ɔho lele wɔ Efraim mmokaa aseɛ nemɔ aso ne, otutuli bɛ bo fili berɛ. AWURADE afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ ɔwɔ AWURADE awuro abrannaa ne anyunu berɛ ne, osa siesiele ye yɛle ye yé.

english_verse: Asa called together the people from Judah and Benjamin, as well as the people from the territories of Ephraim, West Manasseh, and Simeon who were living in Judah. Many of these people were now loyal to Asa, because they had seen that the Lord was with him.
translation_verse: Ɔboaboale Yudafoɛ ne Benyaminfoɛ amukoraa bɛ noa. Yeɛ Efraimfoɛ, Manasefoɛ ne Simeonfoɛ bɔ né baatena bɛ berɛ ne koso, ɔboaboale bɛ noa, ofikyɛ mmenia pee benwuni kyɛ AWURADE, Asa ye Nyameɛ ne, ogyi ye si ne, betu befili Yisrael bɛɛtenane ye aseɛ so.

english_verse: In the third month of the fifteenth year of Asa's rule, they all met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Asa lili bia ne, ye afoɛ buru ne nnu ne anu, bosome nza ne anu, bɛboale bɛ noa wɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: They made a solemn promise to faithfully worship the Lord God their ancestors had worshiped,
translation_verse: Bɛyɛle apam kyɛ bɛkɔfa b’ahone amukoraa ne bɛ kra amukoraa bɛkɔpena AWURADE bɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne, ye si atee.

english_verse: The crowd solemnly agreed to keep their promise to the Lord, then they celebrated by shouting and blowing trumpets and horns.
translation_verse: Bele komviɛ piri ne esebɔlɛ ne totorobɛndohulɛ ne awɛenhulɛ bɛtale ndaen behyirele AWURADE.

english_verse: Everyone was happy because they had made this solemn promise, and in return, the Lord blessed them with peace from all their enemies.
translation_verse: Ɔnate ndaen ne ati, Yuda amukoraa belili ahurusi, ofikyɛ bɛfale b’ahone amukoraa yeɛ bɛfoale so ɔ. Bɛyele bɛ kunu amukoraati yeɛ bɛpenane AWURADE si ate ɔ, na benwuni ye. Na AWURADE mane bɛ asomdwee fili bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu wɔ nekaa biala.

english_verse: Asa's grandmother Maacah had made a disgusting idol of the goddess Asherah, so he cut it down, crushed it, and burned it in Kidron Valley. Then he removed Maacah from her position as queen mother.
translation_verse: Nana Asa tuli ye bɔbɔ oni Maaka fili ɛhemmaa bia ne aso, ofikyɛ ɔyɔle Asera bosoen bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ ɔ. Asa pɛle Asera dosii ne tole ase, obubuli ye, na ɔyerale ye wɔ Kidron bɔnza ne anwo.

english_verse: As long as Asa lived, he was faithful to the Lord, even though he did not destroy the local shrines in Israel.
translation_verse: Asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ de, wandu bɛ bo wamvi Yisrael. Nakoso Asa lili nahorɛ mane AWURADE mmerɛ bɔ né ɔte ngoa nu amukoraa.

english_verse: He placed in the temple all the silver and gold objects that he and his father had dedicated to God.
translation_verse: Ye baba aboadeɛ afɔleɛ ne ye bɔbɔ ye aboadeɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ, ɔfa wale Nyameɛ awuro. Afɔleɛ nemɔ te ɛdwetɛ, esikaa kɔkorɛ ne nningyein ahoroɔ.

english_verse: There was peace in Judah until the thirty-fifth year of Asa's rule.
translation_verse: Na ebiala wamva koɛ wandoa bɛ toonn kɔpem kyɛ Asa lili afoɛ aburasa ne nnu wɔ bia ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: When Asa heard about this, he took the silver and gold from his palace and from the Lord's temple. Then he sent it to Damascus with this message for King Benhadad of Syria:
translation_verse: Yeɛ Asa sesale ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ fili AWURADE awuro fotoɛ ne anu, ɔne ahemvie fotoɛ ne anu, na ɔmaa bɛɛfa bɛmane Siria hene Ben Hadade bɔ né ɔte Damasko ne. Asa tole Ben Hadade ngraa kyɛ,

english_verse: “I think we should sign a peace treaty, just as our fathers did. This silver and gold is a present for you. Would you please break your treaty with King Baasha of Israel and force him to leave my country?”
translation_verse: “Maa me ne wɔ yɛyɛ apam, kyɛbɔ me baba ne wɔ baba bɛyɛle apam ne. Mefa ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ mebrɛ wɔ. Yiti kɔ ná kɔpɛ apam bɔ ɛne Yisrael hene Baasa bayɛ ne anu, amaa ɔnate so wayakyi koɛ bɔ ɔfa taataa me ne.”

english_verse: Benhadad did what Asa asked and sent the Syrian army into Israel. They captured the towns of Ijon, Dan, Abel-Maim, and all the towns in Naphtali where supplies were kept.
translation_verse: Ben Hadade lele Nana Asa dwirɛ ne tole nu, na ɔsomane ye safohene mɔ maa bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtoale Yisrael nguro mɔ. Bɛho belili Yiyon, Dan, Abel Mayim, ɔne Nafetali nguro bɔ besie nningyein wɔ so ne amukoraa so ngonim.

english_verse: When Baasha heard about it, he stopped his work on the town of Ramah.
translation_verse: Baasa tele bɔ wasi ne pɛ, ɔyakyili etualɛ bɔ watua Rama kuro ne.

english_verse: Asa ordered everyone in Judah to carry away the stones and wood Baasha had used to fortify Ramah. Then he fortified the towns of Geba and Mizpah with these same stones and wood. Hanani the Prophet Condemns Asa
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana Asa maa bɛboale Yudafoɛ amukoraati bɛ noa, na nyɔboɛ ne ndaboa bɔ né Baasa ɔfa otua Rama kuro ne, bɛsesa bɛhɔle. Na Nana Asa fa kyekyele Geba ne Misepa.

english_verse: Soon after that happened, Hanani the prophet went to Asa and said: You depended on the king of Syria instead of depending on the Lord your God. And so, you will never defeat the Syrian army.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Hanani bɔ ɔte sona bɔ ɔse ase ne, ɔhɔle Yuda hene Asa berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, “Ɔnate kyɛ afa wɔ nwo ato Siria hene so, na amva wɔ nwo ando AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ so ne ati, ngonim bɔ ahaa ekoli ye wɔ Siria hene koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ aso ne, wabɔ wɔ.

english_verse: Remember how powerful the Ethiopian and Libyan army was, with all their chariots and cavalry troops! You trusted the Lord to help you then, and you defeated them.
translation_verse: Yitiopia ne Libia koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ, aso né bɛnzone pee? Bɛ teaseɛnam mɔ ne bɛ pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ mɔ, aso né bɛnzone pee? Nakoso ɔnate kyɛ ɛfale wɔ nwo tole AWURADE so ne ati, ɔfale bɛ wurale wɔ sa.

english_verse: The Lord is constantly watching everyone, and he gives strength to those who faithfully obey him. But you have done a foolish thing, and your kingdom will never be at peace again.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE nye bɔ mborɔkaa wɔ aseɛ ye aso amukoraa, kyɛ bɛ bɔ bedi nahorɛ bɛma ye ne, okogyina bɛ si. Bɔ ayɔ ye, ali ngwaseasɛm. Yiti ofi sɔ mmerɛ ye bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, koɛ kɔtaataa wɔ.”

english_verse: When Asa heard this, he was so angry that he put Hanani in prison. Asa was also cruel to some of his people. Asa Dies (
translation_verse: Asa fɛle biaa bɔ ɔse ase ne aso yaa, na Asa bɔle ye panwu fale ye tole kuku nu, ofikyɛ edwirɛ ne mane Asa fɛle yaa paa. Afei sɔ mmerɛ ne, Asa tanene maen ne anu ama nemɔ bie nye. Asa wue (

english_verse: Everything Asa did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Asa nnwumaa bɔ ɔyɔle, fi ye ahyɛaseɛ bɔ ɔkwaadwu ye ayieleɛ, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yuda ne Yisrael ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: In the thirty-ninth year of his rule, he got a very bad foot disease, but he relied on doctors and refused to ask the Lord for help.
translation_verse: Asa lili bia ne, ye afoɛ aburasa ne ngona ne anu, anwonyerɛ bie yɛle ye gya tasaa nemɔ. Anwonyerɛ ne anu yɛle se paa. Nakoso ye anwonyerɛ nu ne po, wambena AWURADE si atee, na mmom safoɛ mɔ ngome yeɛ ɔpenane bɛ mmokalɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Earlier, Asa had his own tomb cut out of a rock hill in Jerusalem. So he was buried there, and the tomb was filled with spices and sweet-smelling oils. Then the people built a bonfire in his honor.
translation_verse: Asieleɛ kumaa bɔ wapɛ wato berɛ wɔ Dawide kuro kyɛ owu a besie ye wɔ nu ne, besiele ye wɔ nu. Mba bɔ bɛdedale ye wɔ so ne, ayirefona ahoroɔ bɔ bɛfa bɛpetene so ne, sona bɔ ole ye nwo nimdeɛ yeɛ ɔfrafrale nningyein fa yɔle ɔ. Na bɛsɔle buruburugya bɛfa bɛyɛle ye sɛen.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king and strengthened his defenses against Israel.
translation_verse: Asa awa Yehosafate lili ye baba bia, na ɔboaboale ye nwo amaa sɛ Yisrael fa koɛ batoa ye a, wahora ɔne ye baho.

english_verse: He assigned troops to the fortified cities in Judah, as well as to other towns in Judah and to those towns in Ephraim that his father Asa had captured.
translation_verse: Yuda nguro bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue ne amukoraa, ɔfale koɛhonɛfoɛ tenatenane berɛ, na ɔkyekyele koɛhonɛfoɛ asikyeleɛ wɔ Yuda aseɛ so, yeɛ Efraim nguro bɔ ye baba Asa ho fale nemɔ aso.

english_verse: When Jehoshaphat's father had first become king of Judah, he was faithful to the Lord and refused to worship the god Baal as the kings of Israel did. Jehoshaphat followed his father's example and obeyed and worshiped the Lord. And so the Lord blessed Jehoshaphat
translation_verse: na mmom ye baba Nyameɛ ne, ɔpenane ye si atee lili ye mmeraa dwirɛ so, na Yisraelfoɛ bɔne bɔ bɛyɔ ne, wanyɔ bie.

english_verse: and helped him keep firm control of his kingdom. The people of Judah brought gifts to Jehoshaphat, but even after he became very rich and respected,
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE mane Yehosafate ahennie ne abo timuni. Yuda amukoraa tuale ndɔ mane Yehosafate, na onyane anwonya ne animnyam paa.

english_verse: he remained completely faithful to the Lord. He destroyed all the local shrines in Judah, including the places where the goddess Asherah was worshiped.
translation_verse: Otuli ye nwo siele berɛ paa lili AWURADE dwirɛ so, yeɛ osa tutuli asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ ne bosoen Asera dosii nemɔ abo fili Yuda.

english_verse: Their assistants were the following nine Levites: Shemaiah, Nethaniah, Zebadiah, Asahel, Shemiramoth, Jehonathan, Adonijah, Tobijah, and Tob-Adonijah. Two priests, Elishama and Jehoram, also went along.
translation_verse: Né Lewifoɛ hemɔ boka bɛ so: Semaya, Netania, Sebadia, Asahel, Semiramote, Yehonatan, Adoniya, Tobiya yeɛ Toba Adoniya. Né asɔfo Elisama ne Yehoram bɛboka Lewifoɛ nemɔ aso.

english_verse: They carried with them a copy of the Lord's Law wherever they went and taught the people from it.
translation_verse: Bɛfale AWURADE mmeraa nwomaa ne, na behyirehyirele nu dwirɛ ne wɔ Yuda. Behyinihyini Yuda nguro ne amukoraa so behyirehyirele mmenia nwomaa ne anu dwirɛ.

english_verse: The nations around Judah were afraid of the Lord's power, so none of them attacked Jehoshaphat.
translation_verse: Maen maen bɔ bapɛ Yuda nwo bayia ne, AWURADE nwo suronyi tɔle b’ahennie amukoraa so, na bamva koɛ bandoa Yehosafate ko.

english_verse: Philistines brought him silver and other gifts to keep peace. Some of the Arab people brought him
translation_verse: Filistifoɛ nemɔ bie fale akyɛdeɛ bɛbrɛle Yehosafate, yeɛ bɛfale ɛdwetɛ koso betuale ndɔ bɛmane ye. Na Arabofoɛ koso bɛfale mmoaen nyii apee nzoo ɛyaa nzoo, yeɛ mbɔngye nyii apee nzoo ɛyaa nzoo bɛbrɛle ye.

english_verse: As Jehoshaphat became more powerful, he built fortresses and cities
translation_verse: Yiti Yehosafate hɔle so nyane ngɔsoɛ. Osisili abandenden mɔ ne nekaa bɔ bɛkɔfa nningyein bekosie ɔ wɔ Yuda.

english_verse: where he stored supplies. He also kept in Jerusalem some experienced soldiers
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle nningyein mbiri mbiri wɔ Yuda nguro nemɔ aso. Né ole koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ wɔ Yerusalem’.

english_verse: from the Judah and Benjamin tribes. These soldiers were grouped according to their clans. Adnah was the commander of the troops from Judah, and he had

english_verse: One day, Jehoshaphat went to visit Ahab in his capital city of Samaria. Ahab slaughtered sheep and cattle and prepared a big feast to honor Jehoshaphat and the officials with him. Ahab talked about attacking the city of Ramoth in Gilead,
translation_verse: Na ye si ye bɔ afoɛ biemɔ pɛle nu ne, Yehosafate ɔɔpasale Ahabo nwo wɔ Samaria. Ahabo huni mmoaen pee ne nandwie pee fa sole Yehosafate ne ye mmenia bɔ bɛboka ye so nemɔ wɔfoɛ. Na ɔto guale Yehosafate so anu kyɛ ɔma bɛɛfa koɛ bɛtoa Ramote Gileade.

english_verse: and finally asked, “Jehoshaphat, would you go with me to attack Ramoth?” “Yes,” Jehoshaphat answered. “My army is at your command.
