english_verse: “We could ask Micaiah son of Imlah,” Ahab said. “But I hate Micaiah. He always has bad news for me.” “Don't say that!” Jehoshaphat replied.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yisrael hene buale Yehosafate kyɛ, “Waha ko bɔ yɛkɔhora yɛkobisa ye AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɔ. Ye ole Yimila awa Mikaya. Nakoso mekyi ye kɔkɔkɔkɔ, ofikyɛ ɔnhyɛ ngɔm paa biala mva me nwo; sana musue nwo ngɔm ala.” Na Yehosafate sele kyɛ, “Nana, nnɛkã ye sɔ.”

english_verse: Then Ahab sent someone to bring Micaiah as soon as possible.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yisrael hene frɛle ahemvie panyi ko, na ɔsomane ye kyɛ, “Kɔfrɛ Yimila awa Mikaya brɛ me kekesaala ye.”

english_verse: All this time, Ahab and Jehoshaphat were dressed in their royal robes and were seated on their thrones at the threshing place near the gate of Samaria, listening to the prophets tell them what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Yisrael hene ne Yuda hene Yehosafate bɛtete b’ahennie bia so bɔ baherahera b’ahemvo ndena, wɔ nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo wɔ Samaria pambim ne anyunu berɛ ɔ. Né ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne amukoraa bɛhyehyɛ ngɔm wɔ ahemvo nemɔ anyunu berɛ.

english_verse: Zedekiah son of Chenaanah was one of the prophets. He had made some horns out of iron and shouted, “Ahab, the Lord says you will attack the Syrians like a bull with iron horns and wipe them out!”
translation_verse: Bɛ nu ko bɔ ye ole Kenaana awa Sedekia ne, ɔyɔle buralɛ mmɛen mɔ fale, na ɔhane kyɛ, “AWURADE nwa, ‘Mmɛen hemɔ yeɛ ɛkɔfa kɔpemo Siriafoɛ maa okoodwu kyɛ ekohũhũ bɛ ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: All the prophets agreed that Ahab should attack the Syrians at Ramoth and promised that the Lord would help him defeat them.
translation_verse: Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne amukoraa bɛ noa dwirɛ yɛle ko. Na né bɛkã kyɛ, “Kɔ Ramote Gileade na koli ngonim. Nana, AWURADE kɔfa kuro ne kowura wɔ sa.”

english_verse: Meanwhile, the messenger who went to get Micaiah whispered, “Micaiah, all the prophets have good news for Ahab. Now go and say the same thing.”

english_verse: “I'll say whatever the living Lord my God tells me to say,” Micaiah replied.

english_verse: Then Micaiah went up to Ahab, who asked, “Micaiah, should we attack Ramoth?” “Yes!” Micaiah answered. “The Lord will help you capture the city.”

english_verse: Ahab shouted, “Micaiah, I've told you over and over to tell me the truth! What does the Lord really say?”
translation_verse: Nakoso Nana Ahabo bisale Mikaya kyɛ, “Nea, pɛen nyɛɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ memaa ɛta ndaen kyɛ AWURADE dumaa nu edwirɛ nahorɛ ngome yeɛ ɛkɔhã kohyire me ɔ?”

english_verse: Micaiah answered, “In a vision I saw Israelite soldiers wandering around, lost in the hills like sheep without a shepherd. The Lord said, ‘These troops have no leader. They should go home and not fight.’ ”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Mikaya sele kyɛ, “Nwuni kyɛ Yisrael amukoraa babɔ aya wɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso kyɛ mmoaen bɔ belle neafoɛ ɔ; na AWURADE hane kyɛ, ‘Mmenia hemɔ, belle meneɛ. Ma ebiala ɔhɔ ye awuro asomdwee nu.’ ”

english_verse: So here's what you must do. Tomorrow the enemy armies will march through the desert around the town of Jeruel. March down and meet them at the town of Ziz as they come up the valley.
translation_verse: Ɛhema ɛ́mɔfa koɛ bɛɛtoa bɛ. Bɛkɔfa Sise pambaa ne aso bɛkɔfo bɛkɔwa. Ɛmɔkonwu bɛ wɔ bɔnza ne anoa, wɔ Yeruɛl ɛserɛ so atee ne aso dɔ.

english_verse: You won't even have to fight. Just take your positions and watch the Lord rescue you from your enemy. Don't be afraid. Just do as you're told. And as you march out tomorrow, the Lord will be there with you.
translation_verse: Koɛ he, nna ɛmɔ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔko ɔ. Ao Yuda ne Yerusalem, ɛ́mɔte begyina, ɛ́mɔyɛ konn, ná ɛmɔnea ngonim bɔ AWURADE koli kɔma ɛmɔ ɔ. Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro, yeɛ nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ kunu tete ɛmɔ. Ɛhema ɛ́mɔfa koɛ bɛɛtoa bɛ, na AWURADE kogyina ɛmɔ si.”

english_verse: Then some Levites from the Kohath and Korah clans stood up and shouted praises to the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Na Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛ nana mɔ ole Kohate ne Kora ne, bedwɔsole bɛteane nu serɛserɛ bɛyele AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ayɛ.

english_verse: Early the next morning, as everyone got ready to leave for the desert near Tekoa, Jehoshaphat stood up and said, “Listen my friends, if we trust the Lord God and believe what these prophets have told us, the Lord will help us, and we will be successful.”
translation_verse: Koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu bɛhɔle Tekoa ɛserɛ ne aso. Bɛkɔ ne, Yehosafate dwɔsole sele kyɛ, “Yuda ne Yerusalemfoɛ, ɛ́mɔtie me! Ɛ́mɔle AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ne beli, na okoyie ɛmɔ yé. Ɛ́mɔle ye ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne beli.”

english_verse: Then he explained his plan and appointed men to march in front of the army and praise the Lord for his holy power by singing: “Praise the Lord! His love never ends.”
translation_verse: Na ɔne maen ne bɛhɔle agyina beyiele ne, ɔyele mmenia bɔ beli koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ anyunu bɛ́to dwein bɛ́ye AWURADE ayɛ wɔ animnyam krongron nu kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ daa.”

english_verse: so that the Ammonite and Moabite troops attacked and completely destroyed those from Edom. Then they turned against each other and fought until the entire camp was wiped out!
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Amonfoɛ ne Moabofoɛ bɛfale koɛ bɛtoale Sɛrefoɛ nemɔ behuhuni bɛ pasaa. Na behuhuni Sɛre bokaa so ama beyiele ne, bɛpɛle bɛ nwo behuhuni bɛ nwo.

english_verse: When Judah's army reached the tower that overlooked the desert, they saw that every soldier in the enemy's army was lying dead on the ground.
translation_verse: Yudafoɛ beedwuli ɛserɛ ne aso abandenden ne anwo ne, bɛtole bɛ nye bɛneane ɛlɔen ne, na benwuni efuin ngome kyɛ begua aseɛ ne aso ɔ. Bɛ nu ko po wanya ye ti wannidi nu.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day, everyone came together in Beracah Valley and sang praises to the Lord. That's why that place was called Praise Valley.
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛnna ne aso, bɛbɔle dwaa wɔ Beraka bɔnza ne anu, ofikyɛ berɛ yeɛ bɛyele AWURADE ayɛ ɔ. Yiti bafrɛ berɛ Beraka bɔnza maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

english_verse: When the other nations heard how the Lord had fought against Judah's enemies, they were too afraid
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ maen maen amukoraa bɛtele kyɛ AWURADE waho watia Yisrael pɔfoɛ mɔ nen, Nyameɛ nwo suronyi tɔle bɛ so.

english_verse: to invade Judah. The Lord let Jehoshaphat's kingdom be at peace. Jehoshaphat Dies (
translation_verse: Na asomdwee wale Yehosafate ahennie nu, ofikyɛ ye Nyameɛ ma onyane asomdwee pɛle ye nwo amukoraa bra yiale. Yehosafate ahennie ayieleɛ

english_verse: While Jehoshaphat was king, he signed a peace treaty with Ahaziah the wicked king of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɛhe asi ne, Yuda hene Yehosafate fale ye nwo bɔle Yisrael hene Ahasia bɔ ɔfale ye nwo wurale bɔne nu ne.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat obeyed the Lord, just as his father Asa had done,
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle bɔ ye baba Asa yɔle ne bie, na wammakye wangɔ bɛen anaa famaa. Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: but he did not destroy the local shrines. So the people still worshiped foreign gods, instead of faithfully serving the God their ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Nakoso asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ de, wandu bɛ bo, na né maen ne bennya bɛyyele bɛ kunu kyɛ bɛkɔso bɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne.

english_verse: Everything else Jehoshaphat did while he was king is written in the records of Jehu son of Hanani that are included in The History of the Kings of Israel.
translation_verse: Afei Yehosafate nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ofi ye ahyɛaseɛ bɔ ɔkwaadwu ye ayieleɛ, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Hanani awa Yehu abakɔsɛm bɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yisrael ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa nu ne anu.

english_verse: They agreed to build several seagoing ships at Ezion-Geber.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle nu besele ɛlɛen bɔ ɔkɔ Tasise ɔ, na besele ɛlɛen wɔ Esion Gebɛre.

english_verse: But the prophet Eliezer warned Jehoshaphat, “The Lord will destroy these ships because you have supported Ahaziah.” The ships were wrecked and never sailed.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Eliesa bɔ ye baba ole Dodawahu bɔ ofi Maresa ne, ɔhyɛle ngɔm fale Yehosafate nwo kyɛ, “Ɔnate kyɛ afa wɔ tena abɔ Ahasia deɛ anoa ne ati, AWURADE kɔsɛkye nningyein bɔ ayɔ ne.” Na ɛlɛen nemɔ bɛsɛkyele bɔ bangora bangɔ Tasise ɔ.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat died and was buried beside his ancestors in Jerusalem, and his son Jehoram became king. King Jehoram of Judah (
translation_verse: Yehosafate toale ye mbanyi mɔ. Besiele ye wɔ nekaa bɔ besiele ye mbanyi mɔ ɔ, wɔ Dawide kuro, na ɔwa Yehoram lili ye bia. Yehoram di hene wɔ Yuda (

english_verse: years from Jerusalem. He died, and no one even felt sad. He was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs.
translation_verse: Yehoram aberɛ so, Edomfoɛ yɛle Yuda nwo lɔen, na Edomfoɛ sili bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ hene.

english_verse: The Lord later caused the Philistines and the Arabs who lived near the Ethiopians to become angry with Jehoram.
translation_verse: AWURADE kanyane Filistifoɛ ne Arabofoɛ bɔ bɛte bepingye Kusefoɛ ne maa bedwɔso betiale Yehoram.

english_verse: Jehoshaphat gave each of them silver and gold, as well as other valuable gifts. He also put them in charge of the fortified cities in Judah, but he had chosen his oldest son Jehoram to succeed him as king.
translation_verse: Bɛ baba mane bɛ akyɛdeɛ pee bɔ ɔte ɛdwetɛ, esikaa kɔkorɛ, ɔne nningyein bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se ɔ, yeɛ Yuda nguro bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue ɔ. Nakoso ahennie ne de, ɔfa mane Yehoram, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔte bamuɛbaa ɔ.

english_verse: After Jehoram had taken control of Judah, he had his brothers killed, as well as some of the nation's leaders.
translation_verse: Yehoram lili ye baba bia, ná ye ahennie bo timuni ne, ɔfale ngrandɛ huhuni oliɛma nemɔ amukoraa, yeɛ Yisrael mbanyi nemɔ bie.

english_verse: Jehoram married Ahab's daughter and followed the sinful example of Ahab's family and the other kings of Israel. He disobeyed the Lord by doing wrong,
translation_verse: Bɔne bɔ Yisrael ahemvo bɛyɔle ne, ye koso ɔyɔle bie, kyɛbɔ Ahabo boso ama bɛyɔle ne ala, ofikyɛ ogyale Ahabo awa brasua. Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: but because the Lord had made a solemn promise to King David that someone from his family would always rule in Judah, he refused to wipe out David's descendants.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔnate kyɛ AWURADE ne Dawide bayɛ apam ne ati, AWURADE wanne ahennie ne wamvi Dawide awuro ama bɛ sa nu, ofikyɛ né wahyɛ Dawide bɔ kyɛ ɔkɔmaa ɔne ye boso ama bekonya koliagyaa bɔ ɔkɔtena ye bia so ɔ afebɔɔ. Edom yɛ lɔen

english_verse: Jehoram, his officers, and his cavalry marched to Edom, where the Edomite army surrounded them. He escaped during the night,
translation_verse: Yiti Yehoram ne ye safohene mɔ ne ye teaseɛnam amukoraa besili nu bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtoale Edom. Edom koɛhonɛfoɛ pɛle Yehoram ne ye teaseɛnam safohene mɔ nwo beyiale, nakoso odwɔsole kɔngɔen ɔfale koɛ ɔɔtoale Edomfoɛ.

english_verse: but Judah was never able to regain control of Edom. Even the town of Libnah rebelled at that time. Those things happened because Jehoram had turned away from the Lord, the God his ancestors had worshiped.
translation_verse: Ɔnate sɔ ne ati, Edom ayɛ Yuda nwo lɔen maa waadwu ɛnɛ. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Libina koso yɛle Yehoram ahennie ne anwo lɔen, ofikyɛ Yehoram pole AWURADE ye nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne. Elia kyerɛ krataa

english_verse: Jehoram even built local shrines in the hills of Judah and let the people sin against the Lord by worshiping foreign gods.
translation_verse: Afei koso, Yehoram sisili asɔneyɛɛ wɔ Yuda mmokaa aseɛ ne aso, na ɔhwehwene Yerusalemfoɛ hɔle mmosoensolɛ nu, na ɔmane Yuda lili Nyameɛ dwirɛ nwo makyebu.

english_verse: One day, Jehoram received a letter from Elijah the prophet that said: I have a message for you from the Lord God your ancestor David worshiped. He knows that you have not followed the example of Jehoshaphat your father or Asa your grandfather.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Elia hyerɛle krataa ɔɔmane Yehoram kyɛ, “AWURADE wɔ nana Dawide Nyameɛ nwa, ‘Ɔnate kyɛ amva atee bɔ wɔ baba Yehosafate fale so ne bie, anaa atee bɔ Yuda hene Asa fale so ne bie,

english_verse: Instead you have acted like those sinful kings of Israel and have encouraged the people of Judah to stop worshiping the Lord, just as Ahab and his descendants did. You even murdered your own brothers, who were better men than you.
translation_verse: na mmom afa Yisrael ahemvo mɔ b’atee so, ná ahwehwe Yuda ne Yerusalemfoɛ ahɔ mmosoensolɛ nu, kyɛbɔ Ahabo abusuafoɛ hwehwene Yisrael hɔle mmosoensolɛ nu ne, ná afei ɔnate kyɛ ahũhũ eliɛma mɔ ɔne wɔ baba abusuafoɛ bɔ bɛte titire bɛtra wɔ ne ati,

english_verse: Because you have done these terrible things, the Lord will severely punish the people in your kingdom, including your own family, and he will destroy everything you own.
translation_verse: tie, AWURADE kɔma ɛhawo kandinga kɔwa wɔ maen, wɔ mma mɔ, ɛye mɔ, ɔne w’agyapadeɛ amukoraa so.

english_verse: You will be struck with a painful stomach disease and suffer until you die.
translation_verse: Na wɔ bɔbɔ deinn koso, koɛ anwonyerɛ kandinga kɔtɔ wɔ so, kɔpem kyɛ anwonyerɛ ne kɔma wɔ nyaa kɔhɔ so koturu daa biala ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: They invaded Judah and stole the royal property from the palace, and they led Jehoram's wives and sons away as prisoners. The only one left behind was Ahaziah, his youngest son.
translation_verse: Bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtoale Yuda, bebuli ye fasue mɔ, na ahemvie berɛ nningyein biala bɔ bɛ sa tɔle so ne, bɛsesale bɛbokale Yehoram mma mmienzua ne ɔye mɔ so bɛhɔle. Yiti ɔwa bienzua biala wanga, sana Yehoahase bɔ ɔte bɛ nu kãa paa ne angome. Anwonyerɛ bɔ Yehoram maa owu

english_verse: After this happened, the Lord struck Jehoram with an incurable stomach disease.
translation_verse: Ɛhe amukoraa asi ne, AWURADE tele koɛ anwonyerɛ koangɔ tole Yehoram so.

english_verse: About two years later, Jehoram died in terrible pain. No bonfire was built to honor him, even though the people had done this for his ancestors.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ kãa pɛle nu, odwuli afoɛ nyɔ ne, anwonyerɛ ne mane ye nyaa turuli, na owuli ewue yealɛ paa. Na buruburugya bɔ maen ne sɔle bɛfa bɛhyɛle ye nana mɔ animnyam wɔ bɛ sɛenyɛlɛ nu ne, ye de banzɔ bie bamma ye.

english_verse: and while Jehu was doing that, he saw some of Judah's leaders and Ahaziah's nephews who had come with Ahaziah. Jehu killed them on the spot,
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Yehu okũkũ Ahabo boso ama nemɔ nen, ɔɔtole Yuda mbanyi ɔne Ahasia aliɛma mmienzua mɔ bɛ mma mmienzua mɔ bɔ bɛso Ahasia ɔ, na ohuhuni bɛ.

english_verse: then gave orders to find Ahaziah. Jehu's officers found him hiding in Samaria. They brought Ahaziah to Jehu, who immediately put him to death. They buried Ahaziah only because they respected Jehoshaphat his grandfather, who had done his best to obey the Lord. There was no one from Ahaziah's family left to become king of Judah. Queen Athaliah of Judah (
translation_verse: Yehu penane Ahasia. Né Ahasia waafea wɔ Samaria. Bɛɛhyele ye bɛbrɛle Yehu, na ohuni ye. Besiele ye, ofikyɛ bɛhane kyɛ, “Yehosafate bɔ ɔyele ye kunu sole AWURADE ne, ye anomaa ɛne.” Na Ahasia boso ama nemɔ, bannya ebiala bɔ ɔkɔhora koli bia ne kobu maen ne ɔ. Atalia fa Yuda bia ne di (

english_verse: In fact, after his father's death, Ahaziah sinned against the Lord by appointing some of Ahab's relatives to be his advisors. Their advice led to his downfall.
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, kyɛbɔ Ahabo boso ama bɛyɔle ne ala. Ofikyɛ ye baba wue asi ne, Ahabo boso ama yeɛ bɛyɛle ye foɛtulɛfoɛ ɔ. Na bɛ foɛ bɔ betuli ye ne, wammoka ye koraa.

english_verse: He listened to them and went with King Joram of Israel to attack King Hazael and the Syrian troops at Ramoth in Gilead. Joram was wounded in that battle,
translation_verse: Otiele bɛ foɛtulɛ, na ɔne Yisrael hene Yehoram bɔ yeɛ ɔte Ahabo awa ne, bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtetale Siria hene Hasael wɔ Ramote Gileade. Siriafoɛ ne purale Yehoram.

english_verse: It was during that visit that God had Ahaziah put to death. When Ahaziah arrived at Jezreel, he and Joram went to meet with Jehu grandson of Nimshi. The Lord had already told Jehu to kill every male in Ahab's family,
translation_verse: Nakoso né Nyameɛ wahyehyɛ kyɛ ɔnate sɔ pasalɛ bɔ Ahasia ɔkwaapasa Yehoram nwo ne aso, ɔkɔmaa Ahasia ye ahennie kɔbɔ ase. Ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ ɔhɔle berɛ ne, ɔne Yehoram beeyiale Nimisi awa Yehu, bɔ AWURADE atu ye asie berɛ kyɛ ohũhũ Ahabo boso ama ne.

english_verse: but Jehosheba rescued Joash son of Ahaziah just as the others were about to be murdered. Jehosheba, who was Jehoram's daughter and Ahaziah's half sister, was married to Jehoiada the priest. So she was able to hide her nephew Joash and his personal servant in a bedroom in the Lord's temple where he was safe from Athaliah.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nana Ahasia awa brasua Yehosabeate fale Ahasia awa bienzua Yoase nwatili. Ɔfale ye nwati fili Nana Ahasia mma bɔ né bɛpena bɛ beku bɛ nemɔ anu, na ɔfale ye ne ye neafoɛ ɔɔfeale pumbu bie anu. Yiti Nana Yehoram awa brasua Yehosabeate bɔ ɔte ɔsɔfo Yehoada aye ne, ɔfale Yoase ɔɔfeale bɔ Atalia wanya ye wangu ye ɔ, ofikyɛ né Yehosabeate te Ahasia aliɛma brasua.

english_verse: As soon as Athaliah heard that her son King Ahaziah was dead, she decided to kill any relative who could possibly become king. She would have done just that,
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Ahasia maame Atalia nwuni kyɛ ɔwa Ahasia wawu ne, ɔhyɛle ye bo kyɛ okũkũ Yuda nnehyeɛ nemɔ amukoraa.

english_verse: Joash hid in the temple with them for six years while Athaliah ruled as queen of Judah.
translation_verse: Ɔfale Yoase feale Nyameɛ awuro berɛ afoɛ nzia. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Atalia yeɛ obu maen ne ɔ.

english_verse: Here is what we will do. Three groups of priests and Levites will be on guard duty on the Sabbath—one group will guard the gates of the temple,
translation_verse: Ɔfale ahyɛdeɛ mane bɛ kyɛ, “Asɔfo ne Lewifoɛ, ɛmɔ nu nza nu ngyɛmuɛ ko bɔ odwu afofikyẽa a, ɛmɔkɔ adwuma ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔwɛne pambim ne.

english_verse: After Ahaziah's son Joash had hidden in the temple for six years, Jehoiada the priest knew that something had to be done. So he made sure he had the support of several army officers. They were Azariah son of Jeroham, Ishmael son of Jehohanan, Azariah son of Obed, Maaseiah son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat son of Zichri.
translation_verse: Nakoso ye afoɛ nzoo ne anu, Yehoada mane ye hue yɛle se, na ɔne koɛhonɛfoɛ ɛyaa so safohene mɔ bɛyɛle apam. Bɛ ole Yehoram awa Asaria, Yehohanan awa Yismael, Obɛde awa Asaria, Adaya awa Maaseya, yeɛ Sikri awa Elisafate.

english_verse: and gathered at the temple, where they agreed to help Joash. Jehoiada said to them: Joash will be our next king, because long ago the Lord promised that one of David's descendants would always be king.
translation_verse: Badwa ne amukoraati bɛ ne Nana Yoase yɛle apam wɔ Nyameɛ awuro berɛ. Na Yehoada sele bɛ kyɛ, “Nana Ahasia awa ne ɛhe oo! Di bia kyɛbɔ AWURADE hyɛle bɔ fale Dawide boso ama nwo ne ala.”

english_verse: one will guard the palace, and the other will guard Foundation Gate. The rest of you will stand guard in the temple courtyards.
translation_verse: Nza nu ngyɛmuɛ ko bieku odi kyɛ bɛwɛne ahemvie ne, yeɛ nza nu ngyɛmuɛ ko koso odi kyɛ begyinagyina fapem pambim ne anwo. Na odi kyɛ maen ne amukoraa begyina AWURADE awuro ne aluo berɛ.

english_verse: Only the priests and Levites who are on duty will be able to enter the temple, because they will be the only ones who have gone through the ceremony to make themselves clean and acceptable. The others must stay outside in the courtyards, just as the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Onni kyɛ ɛ́mɔma ebiala wura AWURADE awuro berɛ, sana asɔfo nemɔ ne Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛyɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma nemɔ ala. Bɛ de bɛkɔhora bekowura nu, ofikyɛ bɛ de bɛte krongron. Nakoso mmenia ngaa nemɔ de, odi kyɛ bedi AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ ne aso.

english_verse: You Levites must protect King Joash. Don't let him out of your sight! And keep your swords ready to kill anyone who comes into the temple.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ Lewifoɛ nemɔ bɛpɛ ɛhene ne anwo beyia bɔ ebiala tira akodeɛ ɔ. Na ebiala bɔ okowura AWURADE awuro berɛ nen, odi kyɛ beku ye. Odi kyɛ ɛmɔ ne ɛhene ne bɛkɔ nekaa biala bɔ ɔkɔhɔ ɔ.” Yoase di Yuda so hene

english_verse: The Levites and the people of Judah followed Jehoiada's orders. The guards going off duty were not allowed to go home, and so each commander had all his guards available—those going off duty as well as those coming on duty.
translation_verse: Lewifoɛ nemɔ ne Yudafoɛ amukoraa bɛyɔle kyɛbɔ ɔsɔfo Yehoada hyɛle bɛ ne ala. Ebiala ye mmenia bɔ bɛkɔ adwuma afofikyẽa ne, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛngɔ adwuma afofikyẽa ne, ɔfale bɛ wale, ofikyɛ ɔsɔfo Yehoada wanye kure biala wamvi nu.

english_verse: Jehoiada went into the temple and brought out the swords and shields that had belonged to King David, and he gave them to the commanders.
translation_verse: Nana Dawide pealɛɛ mɔ ne buralɛ ataadeɛ ne akokyɛm mɔ bɔ né bafa basie wɔ Nyameɛ awuro berɛ ne, ɔsɔfo Yehoada fa mane safohene nemɔ.

english_verse: They gave the weapons to the guards, and Jehoiada then made sure that the guards took their positions around the temple and the altar to protect the king on every side.
translation_verse: Ɔmane mmenia nemɔ amukoraa begyinagyinane bɔ ebiala tira ye akodeɛ ɔ, fi awuro ne ngwaen kɔka ye sorɔ, afɔleɛ bokyea ne ɔne awuro ne anwo, kyɛ bɛwɛne Nana Yoase.

english_verse: As soon as Queen Athaliah heard the crowd cheering for Joash, she went to the temple.
translation_verse: Atalia tele kyɛ maen ne behuru bɛpepe bɛbɔ ese bɛyɛ Nana Yoase mmo. Na ɔhɔle bɛ berɛ wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ.

english_verse: There she saw Joash standing by one of the columns near the entrance, which was the usual place for the king. The commanders and the trumpet players were standing next to him, and the musicians were playing instruments and leading the people as they celebrated and blew trumpets. Athaliah tore her clothes in anger and shouted, “You betrayed me, you traitors!”
translation_verse: Ɔtole ye nye neane, na onwuni kyɛ Nana Yoase gyi ye simbini ne anwo wɔ anoa nu berɛ. Né safohene nemɔ ne totorobɛndohulɛfoɛ begyigyi Nana Yoase anwo berɛ, bɔ maen ne anu mmenia amukoraa behu totorobɛndo bedi ahurusi ɔ. Né edweintolɛfoɛ betiratira sangoo beli maen ne anyunu maa bɛbɔ ese. Na Atalia sunzuale ye bɔbɔ ye tena nu teane nu kyɛ, “Bayɛ lɔen oo! bayɛ lɔen oo!”

english_verse: At once, Jehoiada said to the army commanders, “Don't kill her near the Lord's temple. Take her out in front of the troops, and be sure to kill all of her followers!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɔsɔfo Yehoada hyɛle safohene mɔ bɔ bɛlela koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ noa ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhwe ye bɛfa koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ anu befite, na ebiala bɔ okogyina ye si ne, ɛ́mɔfa ngrandɛ behũ ye.” Na ɔsɔfo ne hane kyɛ, “Nnɛmaa ɛmɔku ye wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ.”

english_verse: Jehoiada asked King Joash and the people to join with him in being faithful to the Lord. They agreed,
translation_verse: Yehoada yɛle apam tole ye ne maen ne amukoraa ne Nana Yoase b’afia, kyɛ odi kyɛ bɛyɛ AWURADE maen.

english_verse: then rushed to the temple of the god Baal and tore it down. They smashed the altars and the idols and killed Mattan the priest of Baal in front of the altars.
translation_verse: Yeɛ maen ne anu mmenia amukoraa bɛhɔle Baal asɔneyɛɛ so beebubuli bosoen ne beguale ase. Ye afɔleɛ bokyea mɔ ne ye amoen mɔ koso, bebubuli bɛ nu pasapasa. Behuni Baal kɔmeɛ Matan wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea nemɔ anyunu.

english_verse: Jehoiada assigned the priests and Levites their duties at the temple, just as David had done. They were in charge of offering sacrifices to the Lord according to the Law of Moses, and they were responsible for leading the celebrations with singing.
translation_verse: Na Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛte asɔfo bɔ Dawide ahyehyɛ ato berɛ kyɛ bɛnea AWURADE awuro ne aso ne, Yehoada fale AWURADE awuro berɛ adwuma ne wurale bɛ sa, kyɛ bɛfa ahurusililɛ ne edweintolɛ bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ Mose mmeraa ne anu, ɔne kyɛbɔ Dawide ahyehyɛ ato berɛ ne.

english_verse: Jehoiada ordered the guards at the temple gates to keep out anyone who was unclean.
translation_verse: Ɔmane anoa awɛmvoɛ nemɔ gyinagyinane AWURADE awuro berɛ anoa nemɔ anoa, kyɛ ebiala bɔ ye nwo agua fiɛ ne, ɔnzɛ kyɛ bɛmaa owura AWURADE awuro berɛ.

english_verse: Finally, Jehoiada called together the army commanders, the most important citizens of Judah, and the government officials. The crowd of people followed them as they led Joash from the temple, through the Upper Gate, and into the palace, where he took his place as king of Judah.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo Yehoada tuli safohene nemɔ, atitirefoɛ nemɔ, maen ne aso amradofoɛ nemɔ, bɛ ne maen ne anu mmenia amukoraa, maa bɛɛfale Nana Yoase befili AWURADE awuro dɔ bɛwale. Na bɛfale anoa piri ne anu bɛhɔle ahemvie berɛ. Bɛfale Nana Yoase besiele ahennie bia ne aso.

english_verse: While Jehoiada the priest was alive, Joash obeyed the Lord by doing right.
translation_verse: Yoase yɔle bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, mmerɛ bɔ né ɔsɔfo Yehoada te ngoa nu ne.

english_verse: Joash and Jehoiada turned the money over to the men who were supervising the repairs to the temple. They used the money to hire stonecutters, carpenters, and experts in working with iron and bronze.
translation_verse: Nana Yoase ne Yehoada bɛfale esikaa ne bɛmane bɛ bɔ AWURADE awuro ne anwo adwuma ne wura bɛ sa ne. english_verse: and he was buried in the royal tombs in Jerusalem, because he had done so much good for the people of Israel, for God, and for the temple. Joash Turns Away from the Lord
translation_verse: Na besiele ye wɔ Dawide kuro wɔ ahemvo asieleɛ, ofikyɛ ɔyɛle nikyee paa wɔ Yisrael mane Nyameɛ ne Nyameɛ awuro ne.

english_verse: Jehoiada even chose two women for Joash to marry so he could have a family.
translation_verse: Yehoada gyale mmraa nyɔ mane Yoase, na Yoase ne bɛ wole mmaa mmienzua ne mmaa mmrasua.

english_verse: Some time later, Joash decided it was time to repair the temple.
translation_verse: Na nziɛ ye, Yoase yɛle ye adwene kyɛ AWURADE awuro bɔ wasɛkye ne, ɔkɔyɔ ye yé.

english_verse: He called together the priests and Levites and said, “Go everywhere in Judah and collect the annual tax from the people. I want this done at once—we need that money to repair the temple.” But the Levites were in no hurry to follow the king's orders.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔtole ye sa frɛle asɔfo nemɔ ne Lewifoɛ nemɔ sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ Yuda nguro nemɔ aso, ná ɛmɔ Nyameɛ awuro ne anwo afoɛnoa afoɛnoa nziesie ne, ɛmɔɔdide ye nwo esikaa béfi Yisrael amukoraa bɛ berɛ. Ɛ́mɔnea bɛyɔ ye ndɛ.” Nakoso Lewifoɛ nemɔ banyɔ ye ndɛ.

english_verse: So he sent for Jehoiada the high priest and asked, “Why didn't you send the Levites to collect the taxes? The Lord's servant Moses and the people agreed long ago that this tax would be collected and used to pay for the upkeep of the sacred tent.
translation_verse: Yiti Nana Yoase tole ye sa frɛle ɔsɔfo Yehoada bɔ ɔla bɛ noa ne, na obisale ye kyɛ, “Ɛtoɔ bɔ AWURADE somvoɛ Mose pɛ tole berɛ mane Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ bɛfa bɛyɔ apam ɛtena sua ne anwo adwuma ne, nzu ati yeɛ amma Lewifoɛ mɔ bannide bamvi Yuda ne Yerusalem ne?”

english_verse: Joash gave orders for a wooden box to be made and had it placed outside, near the gate of the temple.
translation_verse: Yiti Nana Yoase hyɛle maa bɛbobɔle alaka, na bɛfa besiele AWURADE awuro berɛ pambim ne anyunu.

english_verse: He then sent letters everywhere in Judah and Jerusalem, asking everyone to bring their taxes to the temple, just as Moses had required their ancestors to do.
translation_verse: Bɛfa bɛtole dwaa wɔ Yuda ne Yerusalem amukoraa kyɛ ɛtoɔ bɔ Nyameɛ somvoɛ Mose pɛ mane Yisraelfoɛ wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso dɔ ne, odi kyɛ ebiala batua ma AWURADE.

english_verse: The people and their leaders agreed, and they brought their money to Jerusalem and placed it in the box.
translation_verse: Maen ne anu mbanyi amukoraa ne maen ne amukoraa bele anigye bɛfale b’ esikaa deɛ beeguale alaka ne anu maa oyili tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: Each day, after the Levites took the box into the temple, the king's secretary and the high priest's assistant would dump out the money and count it. Then the empty box would be taken back outside. This happened day after day, and soon a large amount of money was collected.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ biala, sɛ Lewifoɛ bɛfa esikaa alaka ne bɛbrɛ Nana Yoase mbanyi mɔ, ná benwu kyɛ esikaa ne wasone wɔ alaka ne anu a, Nana Yoase ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne, ɔne ɔsɔfo panyi ye krakyeniɛ ne, bekohwie befi alaka ne anu. Na besa bɛfa alaka ne bekosie ye boso. Bɛyɔle sɔ daa biala maa ɔnate so bedidele esikaa pee.

english_verse: These workers went right to work repairing the temple, and when they were finished, it looked as good as new.
translation_verse: Yiti adwumayɔlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛfale bɛ ne, bɛyɔle adwuma paa, na ɔnate bɛ so awuro ne siesielɛ hɔle so paa. Na bɛyɔle Nyameɛ awuro ne yé bemiamiane nu.

english_verse: They did not use all the tax money for the repairs, so the rest of it was handed over to Joash and Jehoiada, who then used it to make dishes and other gold and silver objects for the temple. Sacrifices to please the Lord were offered regularly in the temple for as long as Jehoiada lived.
translation_verse: Beyiele adwuma nen, bɛfale esikaa ne ngaa ne bɛbrɛle Nana Yoase ne Yehoada, na bɛfa bɛyɔle ɛhemɔ beguale AWURADE awuro ne anu: nningyein bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔne AWURADE, ɔne bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, ateɛ mɔ, yeɛ ayaa bɔ bafa esikaa kɔkorɛ bayɔ ne bɔ bafa ɛdwetɛ bayɔ ɔ. translation_verse: Yehoada nyini yɛle aworowaa paa, na owuli. Olili afoɛ ɛyaa ko aburasa koraka yeɛ owu ɔ.

english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the leaders of Judah went to Joash and talked him into doing what they wanted.
translation_verse: Yehoada wue asi ne, Yuda mbanyi hɔle Nana Yoase berɛ bɛɛkotole ye, na otiele bɛ foɛ bɔ betuli ye ne.

english_verse: The people of Judah soon stopped worshiping in the temple of the Lord God and started worshiping idols and the symbols of the goddess Asherah. These sinful things made the Lord God angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem,
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ ɔte bɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne, ye awuro ne, bɛyakyili nu sɔnenɛ, na bɛsɔnene Asera dosii mɔ ne mmosoen mɔ. Na sɔ bɔne bɔ Yuda ne Yerusalem bɛyɔle ne ati, AWURADE fɛle bɛ so yaa piri.

english_verse: but he still sent prophets who warned them to turn back to him. The people refused to listen.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE somane ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ maa besele bɛ kyɛ besa bɛbra ye berɛ. Bɛbɔle Yudafoɛ kɔkɔ, nakoso bandɛ so.

english_verse: God's Spirit spoke to Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest, and Zechariah told everyone that God was saying: “Why are you disobeying me and my laws? This will only bring punishment! You have deserted me, so now I will desert you.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nyameɛ sunzum wale ɔsɔfo Yehoada awa Sakaria so, na ogyinane mmenia ne nyunu wɔ nekaa bɔ ebiala nwu ye ɔ, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, ‘Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔabu AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ so maa ɔnate so onyie ɛmɔ yé ye? Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔapo AWURADE ne ati, ye koso wapo ɛmɔ.’ ”

english_verse: King Joash forgot that Zechariah's father had always been a loyal friend. So when the people of Judah plotted to kill Zechariah, Joash joined them and gave orders for them to stone him to death in the courtyard of the temple. As Zechariah was dying, he said, “I pray that the Lord will see this and punish all of you.” Joash Is Killed
translation_verse: Nana Yoase wangaye paa bɔ Sakaria baba Yehoada ɔyɔ mane ye ne, na mmom ohuni ɔwa ne. Mmerɛ bɔ beku Sakaria ne, ɔteane nu kyɛ, “AWURADE ɔ́nea bɔ ɛmɔyɔ ye, ná otua ɛmɔ so kerɛ!”

english_verse: In the spring of the following year, the Syrian army invaded Judah and Jerusalem, killing all of the nation's leaders. They collected everything of value that belonged to the people and took it back to their king in Damascus.
translation_verse: Sɔ afoɛ ne ayieleɛ, Siria koɛhonɛfoɛ bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtoale Yoase. Bɛhɔle Yuda ne Yerusalem beehuhuni mmenia nemɔ bɛ nu atitirefoɛ nemɔ amukoraa. Na bɛfale koɛ nu nzesadeɛ bɔ benyane ye ne amukoraa bɛɛmane Damasko hene.

english_verse: The Syrian army was very small, but the Lord let them defeat Judah's large army, because he was punishing Joash and the people of Judah for turning away from him.

english_verse: The History of the Kings also tells more about the sons of Joash, what the prophets said about him, and how he repaired the temple. Amaziah son of Joash became king after his father's death.

english_verse: One of God's prophets said, “Your Majesty, don't let these Israelite soldiers march into battle with you. The Lord has refused to help anyone from the northern kingdom of Israel,

translation_verse: Amasia mane ye hue yɛle se, na olili ye koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ anyunu. Ɔhɔle Ngyee Bɔnza ne anu, na ohuhuni Sɛrefoɛ apee buru.

english_verse: King Amaziah of Judah talked with his officials, then sent a message to King Jehoash of Israel: “Come out and face me in battle!”

english_verse: Jehoash sent back a reply that said: Once upon a time, a small thornbush in Lebanon arranged the marriage between his son and the daughter of a large cedar tree. But a wild animal came along and trampled the small bush.
translation_verse: Na Yisrael hene Yoase koso tole ngraa ɔɔmane Yuda hene Amasia kyɛ, “Lebanon ɛfone bie somane maa beesele Lebanon sida bie kyɛ, ‘Fa ɛwa brasua ma mma bienzua ogya ye.’ Nakoso Lebanon kaka aboyaa bie ɔɔpɛle nu berɛ otiatiale ɛfone ne aso.

english_verse: Amaziah, you think you're so powerful because you defeated Edom. But stay at home and do your celebrating. If you cause any trouble, both you and your kingdom of Judah will be destroyed.

english_verse: Uzziah had leprosy the rest of his life. He was no longer allowed in the temple or in his own palace. That's why his son Jotham lived there and ruled in his place.
translation_verse: Kwata anwonyerɛ ne bɔle Nana Yusia toonn maa ɔfa hɔle ewue. Ɔnate anwonyerɛ ne ati, bɛmane ye ngome ɔɔtenane ahameɛ awuro bie anu, na bambene maa wangɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ ko. Ɔwa bienzua Yotam yeɛ ɔneane ahemvie ne aso buli maen ne ɔ.

translation_verse: Yusia lili hene ne, né wali afoɛ buru ne nzia, na olili hene afoɛ aburannu ne nyɔ wɔ Yerusalem. Oni ole Yekolia bɔ ofi Yerusalem ne.

english_verse: Uzziah became proud of his power, and this led to his downfall. One day, Uzziah disobeyed the Lord his God by going into the temple and burning incense as an offering to him.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ Yusia nyane tumi ne, ɔyɛle anwomasoɛ, na ɔnate so ye ayieleɛ wanyie ye yé. Ɔyɔle bɔne tiale AWURADE ye Nyameɛ, ofikyɛ ye bɔbɔ ɔhɔle AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu ɔɔyerale ɛyɛɛ wɔ ɛyɛɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso.

english_verse: He obeyed the Lord by doing right, as his father Amaziah had done.
translation_verse: Na Yusia yɔle bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ye baba Amasia yɔle ne ala.

english_verse: Zechariah was Uzziah's advisor and taught him to obey God. And so, as long as Zechariah was alive, Uzziah was faithful to God, and God made him successful.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Sakaria te ngoa nu ne, Yusia sole Nyameɛ. Sakaria hyirehyirele ye kyɛ odi kyɛ ɔfa Nyameɛ surolɛ ɔbɔ ye bra. Na mmerɛ bɔ ɔsole AWURADE ne amukoraa, Nyameɛ maa oyiele ye yé.

english_verse: While Uzziah was king, he started a war against the Philistines. He smashed the walls of the cities of Gath, Jabneh, and Ashdod, then rebuilt towns around Ashdod and in other parts of Philistia.
translation_verse: Yusia sili nu ɔɔfale koɛ ɔtoale Filistifoɛ, na obubuli Filistifoɛ nguro hemɔ fasue guaguale ase: Gate, Yabene ne Asedɔde. Na ɔkyekyele nguro wɔ Asedɔde mbɔtam ne Filistifoɛ aseɛ nemɔ aso.

english_verse: Even the Ammonites paid taxes to Uzziah. He became very powerful, and people who lived as far away as Egypt heard about him.
translation_verse: Né Amonfoɛ betua toɔ bɛma Yusia, na ye dumaa trɛle alaa oodwuli Misraim ɛwɛen so, ofikyɛ né ye nwo yɛ se paa.

english_verse: In Jerusalem, Uzziah built fortified towers at the Corner Gate, the Valley Gate, and the place where the city wall turned inward.
translation_verse: Afei koso, Yusia sisili abandenden wɔ Ndweasoɛ Pambim ne aso, Bɔnza nu Pambim ne aso, yeɛ Ndweasoɛ ne aso wɔ Yerusalem, na ɔbrambramone bɛ si.

english_verse: He also built defense towers out in the desert. He owned such a large herd of livestock in the western foothills and in the flatlands, that he had cisterns dug there to catch the rainwater. He loved farming, so he had crops and vineyards planted in the hill country wherever there was fertile soil, and he hired farmers to take care of them.
translation_verse: Osisili abandenden mɔ wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso, na otutuli abura pee, ofikyɛ né ole nyɛmmoa pee wɔ aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aseɛ pralaa ne aso. Né osa ole akuafoɛ mɔ ne bɛ bɔ betwi bobe nzaa wɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso ne aseɛ bɔ ɔkye aleɛ nemɔ aso, ofikyɛ né ye nye gye kua nwo.

english_verse: Uzziah's army was always ready for battle. Jeiel and Maaseiah were the officers who kept track of the number of soldiers, and these two men were under the command of Hananiah, one of Uzziah's officials.
translation_verse: Afei koso, né Yusia le koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ bɛse ko ɔ apee ko. Sɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ, ahyerɛlɛniɛ Yeyiɛl ɔne ahemvie panyi Maaseya bahyerɛ bɛ dumaa kure kure, na Nana Yusia ye safohene ko bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Hanania yeɛ né ɔla bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: and said, “Your Majesty, this isn't right! You are not allowed to burn incense to the Lord. That must be done only by priests who are descendants of Aaron. You will have to leave! You have sinned against the Lord, and so he will no longer bless you.”
translation_verse: Bɛhã besili Nana Yusia nyunu kyɛ, “Nana, nna wɔ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛyera ɛyɛɛ ma AWURADE ɔ, na mmom Aarɔn boso ama asɔfo nemɔ bɔ bɛ yeɛ batu bɛ basie berɛ kyɛ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ne, bɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ bɛyɔ sɔ ɔ. Fi nekaa krongron berɛ fite, ofikyɛ ayɔ bɔne, na ɛhe ngɔma engonya animnyam wɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ nyunu.”

english_verse: Uzziah, who was standing next to the incense altar at the time, was holding the incense burner, ready to offer incense to the Lord. He became very angry when he heard Azariah's warning, and leprosy suddenly appeared on his forehead!
translation_verse: Nakoso Yusia fɛle yaa. Né otira see kulie ne anu bɔ ɔbaayera ɛyɛɛ ɔ, na ɔfɛle asɔfo nemɔ aso yaa nen, kwata anwonyerɛ bie te guale ye nwoma so, wɔ asɔfo nemɔ anyunu berɛ, wɔ ɛyɛɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ.

english_verse: Azariah and the other priests saw it and immediately told him to leave the temple. Uzziah realized that the Lord had punished him, so he hurried to get outside.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo panyi Asaria ne asɔfo nemɔ amukoraa bɛtole bɛ nye bɛneane ye ne, yieee, benwuni kyɛ kwata anwonyerɛ agua ye nwoma so! Bɛhwene ye befili sua ne anu berɛ befitele ndɛndɛ, na ye bɔbɔ koso ɔyɛle ndɛndɛ kyɛ okofi sua ne anu kofite ɔ, ofikyɛ né AWURADE ahwe ye so.

english_verse: Since Uzziah had leprosy, he could not be buried in the royal tombs. Instead, he was buried in a nearby cemetery that the kings owned. His son Jotham then became king.
translation_verse: Yusia toale ye mbanyi mɔ. Besiele ye wɔ nekaa bɔ besiele ye mbanyi mɔ ɔ, wɔ ahemvo asieleɛ so, ofikyɛ bɛhane kyɛ, “Kwata anwonyerɛ ayɛ ye.” Na ɔwa Yotam lili ye bia.

english_verse: Jotham obeyed the Lord and did right. He followed the example of his father Uzziah, except he never burned incense in the temple as his father had done. But the people of Judah kept sinning against the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ye baba Yusia yɔle ne ala. Nakoso ye de, wangɔ AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu wangɔammɔ afɔleɛ. Nakoso maen ne hɔle so bɛyɔle bɔ ɔndengyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Jotham remained faithful to the Lord his God and became a very powerful king.
translation_verse: Yiti Yotam nyane tumi, ofikyɛ ɔfale AWURADE ye Nyameɛ atee so.

english_verse: Everything else Jotham did while he was king, including the wars he fought, is written in The History of the Kings of Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: Afei Yotam nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, ye koɛ bɔ ɔhone amukoraa, ɔne bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, tie, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yisrael ne Yuda ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: He was buried in Jerusalem, and his son Ahaz became king.
translation_verse: Yotam toale ye mbanyi mɔ. Besiele ye wɔ Dawide kuro, na ɔwa Ahase lili ye bia.

english_verse: Ahaz offered sacrifices at the local shrines, as well as on every hill and in the shade of large trees. Syria and Israel Attack Judah (
translation_verse: Ɔbobɔle afɔleɛ yerale ɛyɛɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso, pambaa nemɔ aso, yeɛ bakaa monɛ biala bo. Siria ne Yisrael di Yuda so ngonim (

english_verse: So Tiglath Pileser came to Judah, but instead of helping, he made things worse.
translation_verse: Yiti Asiria hene Tiglate Pilnese hɔle ne, ɔfale koɛ ɔɔtetale Ahase, na mmom wammoka ye.

english_verse: and he offered sacrifices in Hinnom Valley. Worst of all, Ahaz sacrificed his own sons, which was a disgusting custom of the nations that the Lord had forced out of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔyerale ɛyɛɛ wɔ Hinom Awa bɔnza ne anu, na ɔfale ye mma mmienzua bɔle afɔleɛ wɔ see nu, kyɛbɔ maen maen mɔ bɔ AWURADE foane bɛ fili Yisraelfoɛ nyunu ne, bɛ musue nningyein bɔ né bɛyɔ ne, ɔte ne ala.

english_verse: Ahaz and the people of Judah sinned and turned away from the Lord, the God their ancestors had worshiped. So the Lord punished them by letting their enemies defeat them. The king of Syria attacked Judah and took many of its people to Damascus as prisoners. King Pekah of Israel later defeated Judah and killed
translation_verse: Remalia awa Peka huhuni mmenia apee ɛyaa ko aburanyɔ, bɔ bɛ mukoraa bɛte koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ ɔ, wɔ Yuda ɛlɛhomapɛ, ofikyɛ né bapo AWURADE bɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne.

english_verse: If you make slaves of the people of Judah and Jerusalem, you will be as guilty as they are of sinning against the Lord.
translation_verse: Afei de, ɛmɔayɛ ɛmɔ adwene kyɛ ɛmɔkɔfa Yudafoɛ ne Yerusalemfoɛ, mmienzua ne mmrasua bɛkɔyɛ nganga. Na ɛmɔ koso, aso ɛmɔyyɔle bɔne bettiale AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ?

english_verse: Send these prisoners back home—they are your own relatives. If you don't, the Lord will punish you in his anger.
translation_verse: Yiti, ɛ́mɔtie me dwirɛ bɔ mekã ye, ná ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ bɔ ɛmɔahye bɛ nnure ne, ɛ́mɔyakyi bɛ maa besa bɛhɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE afɛ ɛmɔ so yaa kandinga paa.”

english_verse: About the same time, four of Israel's leaders arrived. They were Azariah son of Johanan, Berechiah son of Meshillemoth, Jehizkiah son of Shallum, and Amasa son of Hadlai. They agreed with Oded that the Israelite troops were wrong,
translation_verse: Afei koso, Efraim mbanyi hemɔ: Yohanan awa Asaria, Mesilemote awa Berekia, Salum awa Yehisekia, yeɛ Hadlae awa Amasa, bɛ ne bɛ bɔ befi koɛ noa bɛwale ne banyɛ adwene,

english_verse: and they said: If you bring these prisoners into Samaria, that will be one more thing we've done to sin against the Lord. And he is already angry enough with us.
translation_verse: maa yiti besele bɛ kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔfa mmenia bɔ ɛmɔahye bɛ nnure ne bɛba wa, ofikyɛ ɛmɔpena kyɛ ɛmɔfa AWURADE nyunu foɛlilɛ bɛfoa yɛ bɔne bɔ yayɔ ne yɛ foɛ bɔ yali ne aso. Ofikyɛ yɛ foɛlilɛ ne, ɔte piri dada, na AWURADE afɛ Yisrael so yaa piri paa.”

english_verse: So in front of the leaders and the crowd, the troops handed over their prisoners and the property they had taken from Judah.
translation_verse: Yiti mmenia bɔ bahye bɛ nnure ne, bɛ ne koɛ nu nzesadeɛ ne, koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ yakyili bɛ wɔ mbanyi nemɔ ne badwa ne amukoraa bɛ nyunu.

english_verse: The four leaders took some of the stolen clothes and gave them to the prisoners who needed something to wear. They later gave them all a new change of clothes and shoes, then fixed them something to eat and drink, and cleaned their wounds with olive oil. They gave donkeys to those who were too weak to walk, and led all of them back to Jericho, the city known for its palm trees. The leaders then returned to Samaria. Ahaz Asks the King of Assyria for Help (
translation_verse: Yeɛ sɔ mmenia nemɔ bɔ babobɔ bɛ dumaa ne, bedwɔsole belele mmenia bɔ bahye bɛ nnure ne, na bɛfale nzesadeɛ ne anu ndaadeɛ ne bie bewurale ebiala bɔ né ye nwo la so ɔ. Bewurale bɛ ndaadeɛ ne mmaboa, bɛmane bɛ aleɛ ne nzue, na bɛtetale bɛ ngena nu ayire. Bɛfale bɛ bɔ bayɛ mmerɛ ne amukoraa bɛtenatenane afunum so, na bɛfale bɛ bɛɛmane b’abusuafoɛ wɔ Yeriko bɔ ɔte ayee kuro ne. Afei besale bɛ si bɛwale Samaria. Ahase pena mmokalɛ fi Asiria berɛ (

english_verse: Some time later, the Edomites attacked the eastern part of Judah again and carried away prisoners. And at the same time, the Philistines raided towns in the western foothills and in the Southern Desert. They conquered the towns of Beth-Shemesh, Aijalon, Gederoth, Soco, Timnah, and Gimzo, including the villages around them. Then some of the Philistines went to live in these places. Ahaz sent a message to King Tiglath Pileser of Assyria and begged for help.
translation_verse: Afei koso, né Filistifoɛ baabɔ apaa wɔ aseɛ frɛtɛɛ nguro nemɔ aso ne Yuda ngwaen dɔ. Né bafa Bete Semese, Ayalɔn, Gederote, Soko ne ye nwo nguraa, Timina ne ye nwo nguraa, yeɛ Gyimso ne ye nwo nguraa, na betu bɛɛtenatenane berɛ.

english_verse: But God was punishing Judah with these disasters, because Ahaz had disobeyed him and refused to stop Judah from sinning.
translation_verse: AWURADE brɛle Yuda ase, ɔnate Yisrael hene Ahase ti, ofikyɛ ɔhwehwene ye mmenia maa bɛyɔle bɔne wɔ Yuda, yeɛ ɔyɛle AWURADE so asoserɛ koso.

english_verse: Ahaz gave him gifts from the Lord's temple and the king's palace, as well as from the homes of Israel's other leaders. The Assyrian king still refused to help Ahaz. The Final Sin of Ahaz and His Death
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ Ahase sesale AWURADE awuro berɛ nningyein, ahemvie berɛ nningyein, ɔne ye mbanyi mɔ b’awuro nemɔ anu nningyein, na ɔfa ootuale toɔ mane Asiria hene, nakoso wanya ɛhe anwo mvasoɛ biala. Ahase wue

english_verse: Even after all these terrible things happened to Ahaz, he sinned against the Lord even worse than before.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ sɔ Nana Ahase ye ala onwu amaneɛ ne po ne, obubuli mmakaa tuale ye so bɔ wandie AWURADE dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: He said to himself, “The Syrian gods must have helped their kings defeat me. Maybe if I offer sacrifices to those gods, they will help me.” That was the sin that finally led to the downfall of Ahaz, as well as to the destruction of Judah.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Damasko bɔ wali ye Ahase so ngonim ne, Ahase bɔle afɔleɛ mane bɛ mmosoen. Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɔnate kyɛ Siria ahemvo bɛ mmosoen mɔ aboka bɛ ne ati, ngɔbɔ afɔleɛ ngɔma bɛ amaa ɔnate so baboka me.” Nakoso ɔnate bɛ so yeɛ AWURADE brɛle ye ne Yisrael amukoraa ase ɔ.

english_verse: Ahaz collected all the furnishings of the temple and smashed them to pieces. Then he locked the doors to the temple and set up altars to foreign gods on every street corner in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ahase sesale Nyameɛ awuro berɛ nningyein ne, na ɔsɛkyesɛkyele bɛ. Ɔtotole AWURADE awuro berɛ anoa nemɔ anu. Na osisili afɔleɛ bokyea wɔ Yerusalem borɔnoɛ biala so.

english_verse: In every city and town in Judah he built local shrines to worship foreign gods. All of this made the Lord God of his ancestors very angry.
translation_verse: Yuda kuro biala so, osisili asɔneyɛɛ bɔ bɛyera ɛyɛɛ bɛma nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ ɔ wɔ so, na ɔyɔle sɔ fa wurale AWURADE ye nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne apue.

english_verse: Everything else Ahaz did while he was king is written in The History of the Kings of Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Afei Ahase nwo dwirɛ ngaa ne, bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa, fi ahyɛaseɛ kɔpem ye ayieleɛ, bahyerɛ ye wɔ Yuda ne Yisrael ahemvo nwo dwirɛ nwomaa ne anu.

english_verse: Ahaz died and was buried in Jerusalem, but not in the royal tombs. His son Hezekiah then became king.
translation_verse: Ahase toale ye mbanyi mɔ. Besiele ye wɔ Yerusalem kuro ne anu. Nakoso banzie ye wɔ Yisrael mbanyi asieleɛ. Na ɔwa Hesekia lili ye bia.

english_verse: Hezekiah obeyed the Lord by doing right, just as his ancestor David had done. The Temple Is Purified
translation_verse: Ɔyɔle bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ye Nana Dawide yɔle ne ala. Hesekia pete asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anwo

english_verse: they went back to Hezekiah and said: Your Majesty, we have finished our work. The entire temple is now pure again, and so is the altar and its utensils, as well as the table for the sacred loaves of bread and its utensils.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Lewifoɛ nemɔ bɛhɔle Nana Hesekia berɛ bɛɛbɔle ye amaneɛ kyɛ, “AWURADE awuro ne, yate ye nwo amukoraa yayie: naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne ɔne ye nwo nningyein amukoraa, ɔne poen bɔ basa paanoo folii wɔ so ne, ɔne ye nwo nningyein.

english_verse: Next, Hezekiah assigned the Levites to their places in the temple. He gave them cymbals, harps, and other stringed instruments, according to the instructions that the Lord had given King David and the two prophets, Gad and Nathan.
translation_verse: Ɔmane Lewifoɛ nemɔ bɛtenane AWURADE awuro berɛ bɛbɔle firikyiwa, adengum ne sangoo, kyɛbɔ Dawide ne Nana ye sona bɔ ɔse ase Gade ne ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Natan bɛhane ne ala. Ofikyɛ sɔ ahyɛdeɛ ne, AWURADE nate ye ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ so yeɛ ɔhyɛle ɔ.

english_verse: After that, Hezekiah and the crowd of worshipers bowed down and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle afɔleɛ ne beyiele nen, Nana Hesekia ne bɛ bɔ bayia berɛ ne amukoraa bɛbɔle bɛ nu ase bɛsɔnene AWURADE.

english_verse: Then he called the priests and Levites to the east courtyard of the temple
translation_verse: Ɔboaboale asɔfo nemɔ ne Lewifoɛ nemɔ noa wɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua n’aluo berɛ wɔ eyia afiteleɛ so.

english_verse: and said: It's time to purify the temple of the Lord God of our ancestors. You Levites must first go through the ceremony to make yourselves clean, then go into the temple and bring out everything that is unclean and unacceptable to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Lewifoɛ, ɛ́mɔtie me! Ɛ́mɔpete ɛmɔ anwo, ɛ́mɔpete AWURADE ɛmɔ nana mɔ Nyameɛ awuro ne anwo, ná ɛ́mɔyeye akyiwadeɛ nningyein ne béfi nekaa krongron berɛ.

english_verse: Some of our ancestors were unfaithful and disobeyed the Lord our God. Not only did they turn their backs on the Lord, but they also completely ignored his temple.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ yɛ nana mɔ banni nahorɛ bamma AWURADE, yeɛ bayɔ bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ. Bapo AWURADE, baye bɛ nye bafi nekaa bɔ AWURADE te ne, na bakakyi bɛ si bama ye.

english_verse: They locked the doors, then let the lamps go out and stopped burning incense and offering sacrifices to him.
translation_verse: Afei koso batoto abrannaa nu berɛ anoa nemɔ anu, banuanua nganea nemɔ, na banyera ɛyɛɛ, yeɛ bammɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ wɔ nekaa krongron berɛ bamma Yisrael Nyameɛ.

english_verse: The Lord became terribly angry with the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and everyone was shocked and horrified at what he did to punish them. Not only were
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE afɛ Yuda ne Yerusalem so yaa piri. Na bɔ wamaa wato bɛ ne, wamaa wayɛ ebiala suro ne nwanwa, na wamaa bayɛ ngorohoɛ nikye kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔ nye tua ne.

english_verse: our ancestors killed in battle, but our own children and wives were taken captive.
translation_verse: Ɔnate sɔ ti, yɛ nana mɔ totɔle wɔ ngrandɛ noa, yeɛ bahye yɛ mma mmienzua mɔ, yɛ mma mmrasua mɔ ne yɛ ye mɔ nnure.

english_verse: So I have decided to renew our agreement with the Lord God of Israel. Maybe then he will stop being so angry with us.
translation_verse: Afei mayɛ m’adwene kyɛ me ne AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ne kɔyɛ apam, amaa ɔnate so wayakyi ye yaa piri bɔ wafɛ yɛ so ne.

english_verse: Let's not waste any time, my friends. You are the ones who were chosen to be the Lord's priests and to offer him sacrifices.
translation_verse: Me mma mɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ ngyɛkyerɛ, ofikyɛ AWURADE aneanea nu waye ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔgyina ye nyunu bɛsɔne ye, na ɛmɔyɛ ye somvoɛ mɔ bɛyera ɛyɛɛ bɛma ye.”

english_verse: These leaders gathered together the rest of the Levites, and they all went through the ceremony to make themselves clean. Then they began to purify the temple according to the Law of the Lord, just as Hezekiah had commanded.
translation_verse: Bɛboaboale b’eliɛma nemɔ anoa, bɛpetene bɛ nwo, na kyɛbɔ Nana Hesekia gyinane AWURADE dwirɛ so fale ahyɛdeɛ mane bɛ ne, bewurale AWURADE awuro berɛ kyɛ bɛkwaapete berɛ.

english_verse: The priests went into the temple and carried out everything that was unclean. They put these things in the courtyard, and from there, the Levites carried them outside the city to Kidron Valley.
translation_verse: Asɔfo nemɔ bɛhɔle AWURADE awuro ne kunu dɔ paa kyɛ bɛkwaapete ye nwo. Nningyein amukoraa bɔ bɛ nwo nde bɔ benwuni bɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu ne, asɔfo nemɔ yeyele beeguale AWURADE awuro ne afia, na Lewifoɛ nemɔ sesale beeguale Kidron bɔnza ne anu.

english_verse: The priests and Levites began their work on the first day of the first month. It took them one week to purify the courtyards of the temple and another week to purify the temple. So on the sixteenth day of that same month
translation_verse: Bosome bɔ oli moa ne, ye kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, bɛhyɛle ye bo bɛpetene sua ne anwo, na ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso wɔ bosome ne anu, bedwuli AWURADE abrannaa ne aso. Afei bɛfale ɛlɛbɔtwɛ bɛpetene AWURADE awuro ne anwo. Na bosome bɔ oli moa ne, ye eleburu elesia ne aso, beyiele adwuma ne. Besa betu asɔneyɛɛ sua ne bewura Nyameɛ sa

english_verse: And we have brought back all the things that King Ahaz took from the temple during the time he was unfaithful to God. We purified them and put them back in front of the altar. Worship in the Temple
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né Nana Ahase odi hene ne, nningyein amukoraa bɔ wanni Nyameɛ dwirɛ so, ná ogyi guale ahameɛ ne, yasiesie bɛ yapete bɛ nwo. Nana, nea, bɛwɔ AWURADE afɔleɛ bokyea ne anyunu.”

english_verse: At once, Hezekiah called together the officials of Jerusalem, and they went to the temple.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana Hesekia dwɔsole ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu, ɔboale kuro berɛ mbanyi nemɔ anoa, na ɔne bɛ fo hɔle AWURADE awuro berɛ.

english_verse: They brought with them seven bulls, seven rams, seven lambs, and seven goats as sacrifices to take away the sins of Hezekiah's family and of the people of Judah, as well as to purify the temple. Hezekiah told the priests, who were descendants of Aaron, to sacrifice these animals on the altar.
translation_verse: Bɛfale ɛhemɔ yeɛ bɛhɔle ɔ: nandwie nyii nzoo, mmoaen nyii nzoo, mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nzoo; yeɛ afei mbɔngye nyii nzoo bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ ahennie ne anwo, nekaa krongron ne, ɔne Yuda maen nwo bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ɔ. Ɔfale ahyɛdeɛ mane asɔfo nemɔ, bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte Aarɔn boso ama nemɔ, kyɛ bɛfa sɔ ngaka nemɔ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ wɔ AWURADE bokyea ne aso.

english_verse: They took the goats to Hezekiah and the worshipers, and they laid their hands on the animals.
translation_verse: Na mbɔngye nyii bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ne, bɛfa bɛwale Nana Hesekia ne maen ne anyunu maa bɛfale bɛ sa beguale bɛ so.

english_verse: The priests then killed the goats and splattered the blood on the altar as a sacrifice to take away the sins of everyone in Israel, because Hezekiah had commanded that these sacrifices be made for all the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Asɔfo nemɔ huhuni bɛ, na bɛfale bɛ mogya bɛbɔle bɔne nwo afɔleɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso; bɛfa bɛyɛle mbata bɛmane Yisrael amukoraa. Ofikyɛ Nana Hesekia hyɛle kyɛ odi kyɛ bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɛma Yisrael amukoraa.

english_verse: The Levites were ready to play the instruments that had belonged to David; the priests were ready to blow the trumpets.
translation_verse: Lewifoɛ nemɔ fale Dawide edweintolɛ nningyein nemɔ betiratirale begyinagyinane berɛ, yeɛ asɔfo nemɔ koso betiratirale totorobɛndo begyinagyinane berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah gave the signal for the sacrifices to be burned on the altar, the musicians began singing praises to the Lord and playing their instruments,
translation_verse: Na Nana Hesekia fale ahyɛdeɛ mane bɛ kyɛ bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso. Bɛhyɛle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne bɔlɛ ne abo nen, bɛhyɛle ye bo behuli totorobɛndo bɛbɔle Yisrael hene Dawide edweintolɛ nningyein ne bɛtole dwein bɛfa bɛyele AWURADE ayɛ.

english_verse: and everyone worshiped the Lord. This continued until the last animal was sacrificed.
translation_verse: Badwa ne amukoraa bɛsɔnene AWURADE, edweintolɛfoɛ ne tole dwein, yeɛ totorobɛndohulɛfoɛ nemɔ behuli. Na bɛtoale so alaa kɔpem kyɛ bɛbɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne beyiele ɔ.

english_verse: Then Hezekiah and his officials ordered the Levites to sing the songs of praise that David and Asaph the prophet had written. And so they bowed down and joyfully sang praises to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nana Hesekia ne ye mbanyi nemɔ, bɛfale ahyɛdeɛ mane Lewifoɛ ne kyɛ, edwein bɔ Dawide ne Asafe bɔ ɔse ase ne bahyehyɛ bato berɛ ne, bɛ́to bɛ́ye AWURADE ayɛ’.” Bele anigye bɛtole ayɛyelɛ dwein, na bɛbɔle bɛ nu ase bɛsɔnene Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Hezekiah said to the crowd, “Now that you are once again acceptable to the Lord, bring sacrifices and offerings to give him thanks.” The people did this, and some of them voluntarily brought animals to be offered as sacrifices.
translation_verse: Afei Hesekia hane kyɛ, “Kekesaala ye de, ɛmɔatu bɛ nwo basie berɛ bama AWURADE. Ɛmɔbra, ná ɛ́mɔfa afɔleɛ mɔ ne asennaa afɔleɛ bɛbra AWURADE awuro.” Yiti badwa ne fale afɔleɛ mɔ ne asennaa afɔleɛ bɛwale, na bɛ bɔ baye bɛ kunu sefaa ne, bɛfale naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ mɔ bɛwale.

english_verse: There were not enough priests to skin all these animals, because many of the priests had not taken the time to go through the ceremony to make themselves clean. However, since all the Levites had made themselves clean, they helped the priests until the last animal was skinned.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔnate kyɛ asɔfo nemɔ banzo ne ati, né bɛngora naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ngaka nemɔ bia. Ɔnate sɔ ne ati, kɔpem kyɛ asɔfo nemɔ ngaa ne bɛpetene bɛ nwo ne, b’eliɛma Lewifoɛ nemɔ ne, bɛbokale kɔpem kyɛ beyiele adwuma ne ɔ. Ofikyɛ né Lewifoɛ nemɔ bɛ nwo te tra asɔfo nemɔ.

english_verse: Besides all the sacrifices that were burned on the altar, the fat from the other animal sacrifices was burned, and the offerings of wine were poured over the altar. So the temple was once again used for worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛfa naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ pee bɔ bɛbɔle ne to ahameɛ a, né asomdwee afɔleɛ ɛloe ɔne naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ nwo anonneɛ afɔleɛ koso boka so. Yiti AWURADE awuro berɛ sɔnenɛ bɔ bɛyakyili beguale berɛ ne, besa bɛhyɛle ye bo.

english_verse: Hezekiah and the people of Judah celebrated, because God had helped them make this happen so quickly.
translation_verse: Na Hesekia ne maen ne amukoraa bɛ nye gyele ɔnate bɔ Nyameɛ wayɔ wama maen ne ati. Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ aboka bɛ maa bayɔ ɛhe amukoraa ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: Everyone from Beersheba in the south to Dan in the north was invited. This was the largest crowd of people that had ever celebrated Passover, according to the official records.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛhyɛle mmeraa wɔ Yisrael amukoraa, fi Beɛ Hyeba kɔpem Dan, kyɛ ebiala ɔbra ooli Abɔtra aluolue ne ɔhyɛ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ne animnyam wɔ Yerusalem; ofikyɛ né mmenia bɛmmɔ nu benni Abɔtra ne kyɛbɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ wɔ mmeraa nwomaa ne anu ne.

english_verse: Hezekiah's messengers went everywhere in Israel and Judah with the following letter: People of Israel, now that you have survived the invasion of the Assyrian kings, it's time for you to turn back to the Lord God our ancestors Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob worshiped. If you do this, he will stop being angry.
translation_verse: Yiti Nana Hesekia ne ye mbanyi mɔ ngrataa ne, ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ fa bɛhɔle Yisrael ne Yuda nekaa biala, kyɛbɔ Nana Hesekia fale ahyɛdeɛ mane bɛ ne. Ngrataa ne anu dwirɛ ole kyɛ, “Ao Yisrael maen, ɛ́mɔsa bɛ́bra AWURADE Abraham, Yisake ne Yisrael Nyameɛ ne berɛ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔ ngaa bɔ ɛmɔanya bɛ ti badidi nu bafi Asiria ahemvo mɔ sa nu ne, AWURADE wasa waagyina ɛmɔ si.

english_verse: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. Decide now to obey the Lord our God! Come to Jerusalem and worship him in the temple that will belong to him forever. Then he will stop being angry,
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ asoserɛ kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ yɛle ne, na mmom ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛ́ma AWURADE. Ɛmɔbra AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ nekaa krongron bɔ wate ye nwo afebɔɔ ne anu, ná ɛ́mɔso ye, amaa ɔnate so wayakyi ye yaa piri bɔ wafɛ ye wɔ ɛmɔ so ne.

english_verse: and the enemies that have captured your families will show pity and send them back home. The Lord God is kind and merciful, and if you turn back to him, he will no longer turn his back on you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɛ ɛmɔsa bɛbadi AWURADE si a, bɛ bɔ bahye ɛmɔ aliɛma ne ɛmɔ mma mɔ nnure ne, bekonwu bɛ anwumvoin bɛkɔyakyi bɛ maa bekosa bɛkɔwa aseɛ ye aso. Ofikyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔdo mmenia na ɔse anwumvoin. Sɛ ɛmɔsa bɛba ye berɛ a, ongoli ɛmɔ ngasi.”

english_verse: Only a few people from the tribes of Asher, West Manasseh, and Zebulun were humble and went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Nakoso Asɛfoɛ, Manasefoɛ ne Sebulɔnfoɛ de, bɛ nu biemɔ yɛle anwobrɛaseɛ bɛhɔle Yerusalem.

english_verse: God also made everyone in Judah eager to do what Hezekiah and his officials had commanded. Passover Is Celebrated
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nyameɛ tumi kanyane Yudafoɛ maa b’adwene yɛle ko kyɛ bɛkɔyɔ bɔ Nana Hesekia ne ye mbanyi bagyina AWURADE dwirɛ so bahyɛ ne.

english_verse: In the second month, a large crowd of people gathered in Jerusalem to celebrate the Festival of Thin Bread.
translation_verse: Bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu, mmenia pee beeyiale nu bɛbɔle dwaa kandinga wɔ Yerusalem kyɛ bɛbaali Paanoo Kabrɛdi aluolue ne.

english_verse: They took all the foreign altars and incense altars in Jerusalem and threw them into Kidron Valley.
translation_verse: Afɔleɛ mmokyea bɔ bɛwɔ Yerusalem nemɔ, bɛhyɛle ye bo betutuli bɛ bo, yeɛ ɛyɛɛ afɔleɛ mmokyea nemɔ koso, bɛsesale bɛ mukoraa beegyi beguale Kidron bɔnza ne anu.

english_verse: Most of the people that came from Ephraim, West Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun had not made themselves clean, but they ignored God's Law and ate the Passover lambs anyway. Hezekiah found out what they had done and prayed, “Lord God, these people are unclean according to the laws of holiness. But they are worshiping you, just as their ancestors did. So, please be kind and forgive them.”
translation_verse: ebiala bɔ waye ye ahone nu kyɛ ɔkɔso Nyameɛ, AWURADE ye nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔ́fa ye bɔne ɔ́hyɛ ye, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ wamva nekaa krongron berɛ nhyehyɛleɛ ne aso wambete ye nwo de.”

english_verse: The Lord answered Hezekiah's prayer and did not punish them.
translation_verse: AWURADE tiele Hesekia mbaeɛ ne, na ɔsale mmenia ne anwonyerɛ.

english_verse: The worshipers in Jerusalem were very happy and celebrated the Festival for seven days. The Levites and priests sang praises to the Lord every day and played their instruments.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ Yerusalem ne, bele anigye piri belili Paanoo Kabrɛdi aluolue ne ɛlɛsoo, na Lewifoɛ ne asɔfo nemɔ yele AWURADE ayɛ daa biala. Bɛfale edweintolɛ nningyein bɛyele AWURADE ayɛ.

english_verse: Hezekiah thanked the Levites for doing such a good job, leading the celebration. The worshipers celebrated for seven days by offering sacrifices, by eating the sacred meals, and by praising the Lord God of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛyɔle ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne yé ne, Hesekia hyɛle bɛ mukoraa nguraen paa. Yiti mmenia ne belili aluolue aleɛ ne ɛlɛsoo, na bɛbobɔle asomdwee afɔleɛ bɛlale AWURADE bɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne ase.

english_verse: Everyone was so excited that they agreed to celebrate seven more days.
translation_verse: Afei badwa ne amukoraa bele bɛtole nu kyɛ bekoli aluolue ne ɛlɛsoo bieku. Yiti bele anigye belili aluolue ne ɛlɛsoo bieku.

english_verse: Everyone was very happy, including those from Judah and Israel, the priests and Levites, and the foreigners living in Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Yuda badwa ne amukoraa, asɔfo nemɔ ne Lewifoɛ nemɔ, yeɛ mmenia bɔ befi Yisrael bɛwale ne, amanvrafoɛ bɔ befili Yisrael bɛwale ne, yeɛ amanvrafoɛ bɔ bɛte Yuda ne, belili ahurusi.

english_verse: It was the biggest celebration in Jerusalem since the days of King Solomon, the son of David.
translation_verse: Anigye kandinga wale Yerusalem, ofikyɛ ofi Yisrael hene Dawide awa Solomon aberɛ so, nikyee bɔ ɔte sɔ ɔ, ebie ossili wɔ Yerusalem le.

english_verse: The priests and Levites asked God to bless the people, and from his home in heaven, he did.
translation_verse: Yeɛ asɔfo nemɔ ne Lewifoɛ nemɔ bedwɔso begyinane berɛ beyirale maen ne. Nyameɛ tiele bɛ mbaeɛ, na bɛ mbaeɛ ne oodwuli ye nekaa krongron bɔ ɔte wɔ nyameɛso ne.

english_verse: Hezekiah divided the priests and Levites into groups, according to their duties. Then he assigned them the responsibilities of offering sacrifices to please the Lord and sacrifices to ask his blessing. He also appointed people to serve at the temple and to sing praises at the temple gates.
translation_verse: Hesekia hyehyɛle asɔfo nemɔ ne Lewifoɛ nemɔ anu kure kure fale ebiala ye adwuma wurale ye sa; kyɛ asɔfo nemɔ ne Lewifoɛ nemɔ bɛ́bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne asomdwee afɔleɛ, kyɛ bɛ́yɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma wɔ AWURADE asikyeleɛ pambim nemɔ anu, ná bɛ́ye AWURADE ayɛ bɛ́la ye ase.

english_verse: The official records also included their wives and children, because they had also been faithful in keeping themselves clean and acceptable to serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛhyerɛle mmenia hemɔ amukoraa bɛ dumaa: asɔfo nemɔ ne bɛ mma mmaa mmaa mɔ, bɛ ye mɔ, yeɛ bɛ mma mmienzua ne bɛ mma mmrasua. Ofikyɛ né bali nahorɛ bapete bɛ nwo.

english_verse: He told the people of Jerusalem to bring the offerings that were to be given to the priests and Levites, so that they would have time to serve the Lord with their work.
translation_verse: Ɔfale ahyɛdeɛ mane bɛ bɔ bɛte Yerusalem ne kyɛ nningyein bɔ odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛma asɔfo mɔ ne Lewifoɛ mɔ ne, bɛ́fa bɛ́ma bɛ, amaa ɔnate so asɔfo nemɔ ne Lewifoɛ nemɔ bahora batu bɛ nwo basie berɛ bama AWURADE mmeraa ne.

english_verse: After the Festival, the people went to every town in Judah and smashed the stone images of foreign gods and cut down the sacred poles for worshiping the goddess Asherah. They destroyed all the local shrines and foreign altars in Judah, as well as those in the territories of Benjamin, Ephraim, and West Manasseh. Then everyone went home. Offerings for the Priests and Levites
translation_verse: Afei belili aluolue ne beyiele ne, Yisraelfoɛ bɔ né bayia berɛ ne amukoraa, bɛhɔle Yuda nguro nemɔ aso beebubuli mmosoen bonima nemɔ beguale, bɛpepɛle Asera dosii nemɔ beguale, na bɛsɛkyele asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ ne afɔleɛ bokyea nemɔ wɔ Yuda ne Benyamin ne Efraim ne Manase amukoraa, kɔpem kyɛ bɛsɛkyele bɛ mukoraa ɔ. Afei Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa besa bɛhɔle bɛ nguro nemɔ aso, na bɛ nu biala hɔle ye aseɛ so.

english_verse: Hezekiah provided animals from his own herds and flocks to use for the morning and evening sacrifices, as well as for the sacrifices during the Sabbath celebrations, the New Moon Festivals, and the other religious feasts required by the Law of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nningyein bɔ Nana Hesekia ye fili ye bɔbɔ ye agyapadeɛ nu mane ne, ɔnwa bɛ́fa bɛ́bɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ hemɔ: ngyerɛmɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne nɔsoa deɛ, afofikyẽa naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne ɛsraen foforɛ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, ɔne aluolue bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ nemɔ bɛ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ AWURADE mmeraa ne anu ne.

english_verse: As soon as the people heard what the king wanted, they brought a tenth of everything they owned, including their best grain, wine, olive oil, honey, and other crops.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ tele sɔ dwirɛ ne pɛ, bɛfale sɔ nningyein hemɔ pee bɛwale: b’aburoo bɔ bali moa babu ɔ, nzaa, ngoo, woɛ, fieso nningyein amukoraati, na afei bɛfale nikyee biala nu buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko pee bɛwale.

english_verse: The people from the other towns of Judah brought a tenth of their herds and flocks, as well as a tenth of anything they had dedicated to the Lord.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ ne Yudafoɛ bɔ bɛtete Yuda nguro nemɔ aso ne, bɛfale nandwie ne mmoaen buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko, yeɛ nningyein krongron bɔ batu basie berɛ bama AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ ne buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko bɛwale, na bɛboale nningyein ne noa kure kure.

english_verse: The people started bringing their offerings to Jerusalem in the third month, and the last ones arrived four months later.
translation_verse: Bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne anu yeɛ bɛhyɛle ye bo kyɛ bɛboa nningyein ne noa kure kure ɔ, na beyiele ye noa boa bosome nzoo ne anu.

english_verse: When Hezekiah and his officials saw these offerings, they thanked the Lord and the people.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Hesekia ne mbanyi nemɔ bɛwale benwuni nningyein kure kure nemɔ nen, bɛyele AWURADE ayɛ, na beyirale ye maen Yisrael.

english_verse: Hezekiah asked the priests and Levites about the large amount of offerings.
translation_verse: Nningyein bɔ baboaboa ye noa kure kure ne, Hesekia bisale asɔfo nemɔ ne Lewifoɛ nemɔ ye nwo dwirɛ.

english_verse: The high priest at the time was Azariah, a descendant of Zadok, and he replied, “Ever since the people have been bringing us their offerings, we have had more than enough food and supplies. The Lord has certainly blessed his people. Look at how much is left over!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɔsɔfo panyi Asaria bɔ ɔte Sadoke bosoniɛ ne, obuale Hesekia kyɛ, “Ofi mmerɛ bɔ bɛhyɛle ye bo bɛfale sɔ nningyein nemɔ bɛwale AWURADE awuro ne, yanya aleɛ yali maa wabu yɛ so, ofikyɛ AWURADE ayira ye maen, amaa ɔnate ye sɔ ti yeɛ yanya nningyein pee maa wabu yɛ so ye.”

english_verse: So the king gave orders for storerooms to be built in the temple, and when they were completed,
translation_verse: Yeɛ Hesekia fale ahyɛdeɛ mane bɛ kyɛ besiesie sua bɔ bɛfa nningyein besie nu ɔ wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ. Na besiesiele sua nemɔ.

english_verse: all the extra offerings were taken there. Hezekiah and Azariah then appointed Conaniah the Levite to be in charge of these storerooms. His brother Shimei was his assistant, and the following Levites worked with them: Jehiel, Azaziah, Nahath, Asahel, Jerimoth, Jozabad, Eliel, Ismachiah, Mahath, and Benaiah.
translation_verse: Nana Hesekia ne Nyameɛ awuro panyi paa Asaria bɛyele Yehiel, Asasia, Nahate, Asahel, Yerimote, Yosabade, Eliɛl, Yismakia, Mahate ne Benaya, kyɛ bɛboka Konania ne oliɛma Simei maa bɛnea nningyein ne aso.

english_verse: Kore son of Imnah was assigned to guard the East Gate, and he was put in charge of receiving the offerings voluntarily given to God and of dividing them among the priests and Levites.
translation_verse: Akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ bɔ bɛbɔ bɛma Nyameɛ ne, nningyein bɔ batu basie berɛ bama AWURADE ne hyɛlɛ ne, yeɛ afɔleɛ krongron nningyein ne hyɛlɛ ne, Lewiniɛ Yimina ɔwa Kore bɔ ɔte eyia afiteleɛ pambim so neafoɛ ne, ye yeɛ né owura ye sa ɔ.

english_verse: He had six assistants who were responsible for seeing that all the priests in the other towns of Judah also got their share of these offerings. They were Eden, Miniamin, Jeshua, Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah. Every priest and every Levite over
translation_verse: Bɛhyɛle nningyein ne bɛmane mmienzua bɔ bali ofi afoɛ nza bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, ɔmva ye nwo kyɛbɔ b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ baha bɛ ne, ɔte ɔ. Nningyein ne, bɛhyɛle bɛmane bɛ bɔ né bɛba AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu bɛbayɔ bɛ daa daa adwuma, kyɛbɔ b’asɔfo kure te ɔ.

english_verse: Hezekiah also appointed other men to take food and supplies to the priests and Levites whose homes were in the pastureland around the towns of Judah. But the priests had to be descendants of Aaron, and the Levites had to be listed in the official records.
translation_verse: Na Aarɔn boso ama bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte asɔfo, bɔ né bɛtete aseɛ bɔ wapɛ bɛ nguro nemɔ anwo bayia ne aso ne, mmenia bɔ babɔ bɛ dumaa bafa adwuma ne bawura bɛ sa ne, né odi kyɛ bɛkyɛ nningyein ne bie bɛma asɔfo nemɔ anu bienzua biala ɔne Lewiniɛ biala bɔ bahyerɛ ye dumaa ɔ.

english_verse: Everything Hezekiah did while he was king of Judah, including what he did for the temple in Jerusalem, was right and good. He was a successful king, because he obeyed the Lord God with all his heart.
translation_verse: Na nikyee biala bɔ ɔyɔle ye wɔ Nyameɛ awuro berɛ ɛsɔnenɛ nu, ɔne bɔ ogyinane mmeraa ne mmeraa dwirɛ ne aso yɔle kyɛ ɔfa ɔso ye Nyameɛ ne, ofiane ye kunu ɔyɔle, na oyiele ye yé.

english_verse: The officials said all these things in Hebrew, so that everyone listening from the city wall would understand and be terrified and surrender.
translation_verse: Bɛteane nu bɛhane sɔ dwirɛ ne wɔ Yuda dwudwolɛ nu bɛfa benwunanwunane Yerusalemfoɛ bɔ bɛtete kuro berɛ fasue ne aso ne betuli bɛ kunu, amaa ɔnate so bahora bali kuro ne aso ngonim.

english_verse: You've heard what my ancestors and I have done to other nations. Were the gods of those nations able to defend their land against us?
translation_verse: Aso ɛmɔnze bɔ me ne me nana mɔ yafa yayɔ maen maen ngaa sofoɛ amukoraa ɔ? Sɔ maen maen nemɔ, bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ, aso bɛhora bɛpepɛ belele bɛ maen mɔ befili me sa nu anaa?

english_verse: The Lord rescued Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem from Sennacherib and also protected them from other enemies.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE pepɛ lele Hesekia ne Yerusalemfoɛ fili Asiria hene Senakeribo ne bɛ pɔfoɛ amukoraa bɛ sa nu. AWURADE bɔle bɛ nwo waen wɔ nekaa biala.

english_verse: he and his officials worked out a plan to cut off the supply of water outside the city, so that the Assyrians would have no water when they came to attack. The officials got together a large work force that stopped up the springs and streams near Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mmenia pee beeyiale nu, na betuatuale mbombonzue nemɔ amukoraa ne asue ba bɔ ɔtengyɛ fa aseɛ ne aso ne. Na bebisale kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ Asiria ahemvo mɔ bɛba bɛbanwu kyɛ nzue abu so wɔ wa ɔ?”

english_verse: Hezekiah's workers also repaired the broken sections of the city wall. Then they built defense towers and an outer wall to help protect the one already there. The landfill on the east side of David's City was also strengthened. He gave orders to make a large supply of weapons and shields,
translation_verse: Hesekia hyɛle ye bo yɔle adwuma serɛ, na fasue bɔ né wabu wagua ase ne, besili ye mukoraa, na osisili abandenden siesiele so. Osili fasue bieku wɔ ye si. Sua bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Milo bɔ ɔwɔ Dawide kuro berɛ ne, ɔyɔle ye yé, na ɔyɔle akodeɛ ne akokyɛm pee.

english_verse: and he appointed army commanders over the troops. Then he gathered the troops together in the open area in front of the city gate and said to them:

english_verse: I am King Cyrus of Persia. The Lord God of heaven, who is also the God of Israel, has made me the ruler of all nations on earth. And he has chosen me to build a temple for him in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. The Lord God will watch over and encourage any of his people who want to go back to Jerusalem and help build the temple.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛmɔ nu biala bɔ ɔboka ye mmenia ne aso ne, ye Nyameɛ ogyina ye si. Mama ye ate kyɛ ɔhɔ Yerusalem bɔ ɔwɔ Yuda ne oosa osi AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ye awuro ne bieku. Ye yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone else must provide what is needed. They must give money, supplies, and animals, as well as gifts for rebuilding God's temple.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ bɔ baha ne, nekaa biala bɔ bɛte ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ berɛ ama bɛfa sɔ nningyein hemɔ bɛma Yisraelfoɛ nemɔ: ɛdwetɛ, esikaa kɔkorɛ, nningyein, nyɛmmoa, ɔne akyɛdeɛ bɔ bɛkwaafa besi Nyameɛ awuro bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne.”

english_verse: The others helped by giving silver articles, gold, personal possessions, cattle, and other valuable gifts, as well as offerings for the temple.
translation_verse: Na mmenia bɔ Yisraelfoɛ ne bɛ te mbɔtam ne amukoraa bɛfale sɔ nningyein hemɔ bɛbokale bɛ: ɛdwetɛ ndalie, esikaa kɔkorɛ, nningyein, nyɛmmoa, mbembenanneɛ, ɔne akyɛdeɛ ahoroɔ bɔ befiane bɛ kunu bɛfa bɛmane bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: King Cyrus gave back the things that Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the Lord's temple in Jerusalem and had put in the temple of his own gods.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE awuro berɛ nningyein bɔ Nebukadenesa ɔɔsesa fili Yerusalem wale, bɔ ɔɔfa guale ye nyameɛ mɔ bɛ sua nu ne, Nana Karose yeye wale.

english_verse: Cyrus placed Mithredath, his chief treasurer, in charge of these things. Mithredath counted them and gave a list to Sheshbazzar, the governor of Judah.
translation_verse: Pɛsia hene Karose maa bɛfale nningyein ne bewurale Pɛsia fotoɛsoneafoɛ Mitredate sa, na ye koso obuli ye nwo ngondaa ɔfa wurale Sesebasa bɔ ɔla Yuda noa ne sa.

english_verse: Here is how many people returned whose ancestors had come from the following towns:
translation_verse: Senaa: apee nza ɛyaa nzia ne aburasa.

english_verse: from Netophah;
translation_verse: Yaala, Dakon, Gidel,

english_verse: from Nebo;
translation_verse: Basulute, Mehida, Hasa,

english_verse: Here is a list of how many returned from each family of priests:
translation_verse: Harim boso ama: bɛte apee ko buru ne nzoo.

english_verse: The families of Habaiah, Hakkoz, and Barzillai could not prove that they were priests. The ancestor of the family of Barzillai had married the daughter of Barzillai from Gilead and had taken his wife's family name. But the records of these three families could not be found, and none of them were allowed to serve as priests.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia nemɔ penane bɛ dumaa wɔ mmusua ngrataa nemɔ anu, nakoso né bɛ dumaa nne nu. Ye sɔ ne ati, bebuli bɛ kyɛ bɛ nwo nde, na bɛyele bɛ befili sɔfolilɛ adwuma ne anu.

english_verse: In fact, the governor told them, “You cannot eat the food offered to God until we find out if you really are priests.”
translation_verse: Na amrado ne sele bɛ kyɛ nnɛmaa bedi aleɛ krongron paa ne bie, kɔpem kyɛ ɔsɔfo bie kɔfa Yurim ne Tumim kobisa ɔ.

english_verse: When the people came to where the Lord's temple had been in Jerusalem, some of the family leaders gave gifts so it could be rebuilt in the same place.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu bɛwale ne, beedwuli AWURADE awuro berɛ wɔ Yerusalem pɛ, mmusua mbanyi ne biemɔ bɔle akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ kyɛ bɛfa besi Nyameɛ awuro ne besie ye boso.

english_verse: Everyone returned to the towns from which their families had come, including the priests, the Levites, the musicians, the temple guards, and the workers.
translation_verse: Afei asɔfo nemɔ, Lewifoɛ ne mmenia ne biemɔ bɛtenatenane Yerusalem ne ye nwo nguro nemɔ aso. Afei edweintolɛfoɛ ne anoa awɛmvoɛ ne asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ nemɔ koso bɛɛtenatenane bɛ nguro nemɔ aso, na Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne amukoraa bɛɛtenatenane bɛ nguro nemɔ aso.

english_verse: During the seventh month of the year, the Israelites who had settled in their towns went to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne dwuli, bɔ né Yisraelfoɛ baatenatena nguro nemɔ aso nen, bɛ mukoraa bɛbɔle nu bɛɛboale bɛ noa wɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: The priest Joshua son of Jozadak, together with the other priests, and Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel and his relatives rebuilt the altar of Israel's God. Then they were able to offer sacrifices there by following the instructions God had given to Moses, the man of God.
translation_verse: Afei Yesua bɔ ye baba ole Yosadake ne, ɔne ye mmango asɔfo mɔ, yeɛ Sɛtiɛl awa Serubabɛl ne ye abusuafoɛ bɛbɔle ye bo besili Yisrael Nyameɛ afɔleɛ bokyea, bɔ bɛkɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ wɔ so ɔ, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ Nyameɛ sona Mose mmeraa ne anu ne.

english_verse: And they built the altar where it had stood before, even though they were afraid of the people who were already living around there. Then every morning and evening they burned sacrifices and offerings to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ né besuro maen maen mɔ bɔ bapɛ bɛ nwo bayia ne de, nakoso besili afɔleɛ bokyea ne besiele ye boso, na bɛbɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ wɔ so bɛmane AWURADE ngyerɛmɔ ne nɔsoa biala.
