english_verse: The people followed the rules for celebrating the Festival of Shelters and offered the proper sacrifices each day.
translation_verse: Belili Asese aluolue ne, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ bato berɛ ne. Ngaka somaa bɔ ɛlɛho biala odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ wɔ aluolue ne anu ne, belili so kyɛbɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne te ne ala.

english_verse: They offered sacrifices to please the Lord, sacrifices at each New Moon Festival, and sacrifices at the rest of the Lord's festivals. Every offering the people had brought voluntarily was also presented to the Lord.
translation_verse: Besa bɛbɔle daa daa naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, ɛsraen foforɛ afɔleɛ, AWURADE aluolue krongron afɔleɛ ne amukoraa, ɔne akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ebiala ɔbɔ mane AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: Although work on the temple itself had not yet begun, the people started offering sacrifices on the Lord's altar on the first day of the seventh month of that year. The Rebuilding of the Temple Begins
translation_verse: Kyẽa bɔ oli moa wɔ bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne anu yeɛ bɛhyɛle ye bo bɛbɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɛmane AWURADE ɔ. Nakoso né bennya bɛttole AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua fapem ne.

english_verse: King Cyrus of Persia had said the Israelites could have cedar trees brought from Lebanon to Joppa by sea. So they sent grain, wine, and olive oil to the cities of Tyre and Sidon as payment for these trees, and they gave money to the stoneworkers and carpenters.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, bɛfale sikaa bɛbɔle suasilɛfoɛ ne bakaa dwumvoɛ mɔ paa, na bɛmane Sidonfoɛ ne Tirofoɛ aleɛ, anonneɛ ne ngoo maa bɛfale sida mmakaa beguale ɛpo so befili Lebanon bɛwale Yopa, kyɛbɔ Pɛsia hene Karose mane bɛ ate kyɛ bɛyɔ ne ala. Bɛto asɔneyɛɛ sua ne fapem

english_verse: During the second month of the second year after the people had returned from Babylonia, they started rebuilding the Lord's temple. Zerubbabel son of Shealtiel, Joshua son of Jozadak, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned started working. Every Levite over
translation_verse: Beedwuli Nyameɛ awuro ne anwo wɔ Yerusalem nen, afoɛ nyɔ ne anu, ye bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu, Sɛtiɛl awa Serubabɛl ne Yosadake awa Yesua bɛhyɛle sua ne silɛ bo. Bɛ ne Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne, asɔfo mɔ ne Lewifoɛ mɔ, yeɛ ebiala bɔ ofili nnurehyelɛ nu wale Yerusalem ne. Bɛyele Lewifoɛ bɔ bali ofi afoɛ aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ besiele berɛ kyɛ AWURADE awuro ne bɛnea ye silɛ so.

english_verse: The Levites in charge of the whole project were Joshua and his sons and relatives and Kadmiel and his sons from the family of Hodaviah. The family of Henadad worked along with them.
translation_verse: Na Yesua ne ye mma mɔ ne ye abusuafoɛ, bɛ ne Kadimiɛl ne ye mma mɔ, bɔ bɛte Yuda bosofoɛ, yeɛ Henadade bosofoɛ bɔ bɛte Lewifoɛ ne, bɛ ne bɛ mma mɔ ne b’abusuafoɛ yeɛ bɛbɔle nu bɛneane Nyameɛ awuro adwumayɔlɛfoɛ nemɔ aso ɔ.

english_verse: When the builders had finished laying the foundation of the temple, the priests put on their robes and blew trumpets in honor of the Lord, while the Levites from the family of Asaph praised God with cymbals. All of them followed the instructions given years before by King David.
translation_verse: Suasilɛfoɛ nemɔ hyɛle ye bo bɔ bɛto AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne fapem nen, asɔfo mɔ bɔ bawurawura asɔfo ndaadeɛ ɔ behuli totorobɛndo, yeɛ Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛte Asafe bosofoɛ ne koso, bɛbɔle firikyiwa bɛyele AWURADE ayɛ, kyɛbɔ Yisrael hene Dawide hyehyɛ mane bɛ ne ala.

english_verse: They praised the Lord and gave thanks as they took turns singing: “The Lord is good! His faithful love for Israel will last forever.” Everyone started shouting and praising the Lord because work on the foundation of the temple had begun.
translation_verse: Bɛtole AWURADE nwo ayɛyelɛ ne asennaa dwein fɛfɛɛfɛ kyɛ, “Nyameɛ te paa, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ daa ma Yisrael.” Na maen ne amukoraa bɛbɔle ese besurole so bɛyele AWURADE ayɛ, ofikyɛ né bahyɛ ye bo bato AWURADE awuro fapem ne.

english_verse: Many of the older priests and Levites and the heads of families wept bitterly because they remembered seeing the first temple years before. But others were so happy that they celebrated with joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Nakoso asɔfo nemɔ pee, Lewifoɛ pee ne mmusua mbanyi pee bɔ bɛ nye afi, bɔ benwuni asɔneyɛɛ sua daa nen, mmerɛ bɔ benwuni asɔneyɛɛ sua he ye fapem nen, besuni hahii. Na mmenia ne pee koso de, bɛbɔle ese bɛmane bɛ nye gyele.

english_verse: Their shouting and crying were so noisy that it all sounded alike and could be heard a long way off.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, anigye esebɔlɛ ne, ɔne esue hahii ne betu bɛfrale, bɔ né mmenia ne ngora nnwu nzonzoleɛ bɔ ɔla b’afia ɔ, ofikyɛ mmenia ne yɛle dede bɔ né sɛ ɛwɔ dedeede a ɛte ɔ.

english_verse: The enemies of the tribes of Judah and Benjamin heard that the people had come back to rebuild the temple of the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ bɛpɔ Yuda ne Benyamin ne, bɛtele kyɛ mmenia bɔ befi nnurehyelɛ nu bawa ne, begu so besi AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua.

english_verse: So they went to Zerubbabel and to the family leaders and said, “Let us help! Ever since King Esarhaddon of Assyria brought us here, we have worshiped your God and offered sacrifices to him.”
translation_verse: Yiti bɛhɔle Serubabɛl ne mmusua mbanyi nemɔ berɛ beesele bɛ kyɛ, “Yɛbaaboka ɛmɔ so maa yɛsi sua ne, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ɛmɔsɔne ye ne, ye yeɛ yɛ koso yɛsɔne ye ɔ. Na yabɔ afɔleɛ yama ye alaa, fite Asiria hene Esa Hadon bɔ ɔfale yɛ wale wa ne aberɛ so.”

english_verse: But Zerubbabel, Joshua, and the family leaders answered, “You cannot take part in building a temple for the Lord our God! We will build it ourselves, just as King Cyrus of Persia commanded us.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Serubabɛl ne Yesua ne Yisrael mmusua mbanyi ngaa nemɔ buale bɛ kyɛ, “Yɛngɔma ɛmɔ ngɔboka yɛ so wɔ yɛ Nyameɛ awuro ne ye silɛ nu, na mmom yɛ ngome yeɛ yɛkosi AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ awuro ne ɔ, kyɛbɔ Pɛsia hene Karose ahyɛ kyɛ yɛyɔ ne ala.”

english_verse: Then the neighboring people began to do everything possible to frighten the Jews and to make them stop building.
translation_verse: Na afei mmenia bɔ bɛwɔ sɔ aseɛ ne aso ne, bebuli Yudafoɛ nemɔ aba nu, na bɛmaa besurole kyɛ bekosi sua ne ɔ.

english_verse: During the time that Cyrus was king and even until Darius became king, they kept bribing government officials to slow down the work. Trouble Rebuilding Jerusalem
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle mbanyi paa kyɛ bɛbɔ Yudafoɛ bɛ botaeɛ ne begua, na ɛhe hɔle so toonn wɔ Pɛsia hene Karose aberɛ so maa oodwuli Pɛsia hene Dario aberɛ so. Ebiemɔ si Yerusalem kyekyelɛ nwo ate

english_verse: In the first year that Xerxes was king, the neighboring people brought written charges against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ahasuro ahennie aberɛ so, afoɛ bɔ oli moa wɔ ye ahennie ne anu ne, pɔfoɛ nemɔ hyerɛle Yudafoɛ ne Yerusalemfoɛ nwo krataa bɛɛtoatoale bɛ.

english_verse: Later, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and their advisors got together and wrote a letter to Artaxerxes when he was king of Persia. It was written in Aramaic and had to be translated.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Pɛsia hene Atasɛsɛse aberɛ so koso, Bislam, Mitredate, Tabeel ne bɛ mmango ngaa nemɔ bɛhyerɛle krataa bɛɛmane Pɛsia hene Atasɛsɛse. Bɛhyerɛle krataa ne Aramaeke dwudwolɛ nu, na bɛtele ye noa wɔ ye dwudwolɛ nu behyirele ye.

english_verse: This letter said: Your Majesty King Artaxerxes, we are your servants from everywhere in Western Province, and we send you our greetings.
translation_verse: Krataa bɔ bɛhyerɛ bɛɛmane Nana Atasɛsɛse ne, nu dwirɛ ɛhe): “Yɛfa krataa he yɛbrɛ Nana Atasɛsɛse. Wɔ somvoɛ mɔ bɔ yɛwɔ asue Yufreti si dɔ mbɔtam ne aso ne, yɛbisa wɔ bisabisa.

english_verse: You should know that the Jews who left your country have moved back to Jerusalem and are now rebuilding that rebellious city. In fact, they have almost finished rebuilding the walls and repairing the foundations.
translation_verse: Nana, yɛbɔ wɔ amaneɛ kyɛ, Yudafoɛ bɔ befili wɔ dɔ bɛwale yɛ wa ne, baadwu Yerusalem, na besa bɛkyekye ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ ne amumuyɛɛfoɛ kuro ne bieku. Fasue ne, basa bagua ye fapem ne maa wanya anwoserɛ, na waha kãa né bayie ye to.

english_verse: You should also know that if the walls are completed and the city is rebuilt, the Jews won't pay any kind of taxes, and there will be less money in your treasury.
translation_verse: Nana, yɛbɔ wɔ amaneɛ kyɛ, sɛ besa bɛkyekye sɔ kuro ne, ná bɛto ye nwo fasue beyie a, ye de bengotua ɛtoɔ, anaa ndɔ, anaa aseɛ nwo toɔ ne. Sɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, sikaa bɔ ɔba ahemvie dɔ ne, so kɔte.

english_verse: We are telling you this, because you have done so much for us, and we want everyone to respect you.
translation_verse: Nana, w’adaworoma, wɔ yeɛ yɛ ko wura wɔ sa nu ɔ, yiti ɔtte mayee kyɛ yɛkɔnea kɔmaa bekogua wɔ nyunu aseɛ ɔ. Ye sɔ ati yeɛ yahyerɛ krataa yɛbaafa yɛtia wɔ gya so ye,

english_verse: If you look up the official records of your ancestors, you will find that Jerusalem has constantly rebelled and has led others to rebel against kings and provinces. That's why the city was destroyed in the first place.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so aneanea wɔ nana mɔ dwirɛ bɔ bahyerɛ bato berɛ ne anu. Na ekonwu ye wɔ edwirɛ bɔ bahyerɛ bato berɛ ne anu kyɛ, sɔ kuro ne ɔte ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ kuro bɔ ɔmma ahemvo mɔ ne mbɔtam mɔ bɛ nwo ndɔ bɛ ɔ. Ofi tetetete yeɛ kuro berɛ ama bahɔ so bayɔ maen mbanyi nwo lɔen ɔ, na ɔnate sɔ ati yeɛ wɔ mbanyi mɔ bɛbɔle sɔ kuro ne ɔ.

english_verse: If Jerusalem is rebuilt and its walls completed, you will no longer have control over Western Province.
translation_verse: Nana, yɛbɔ wɔ amaneɛ kyɛ, sɛ besa bɛkyekye sɔ kuro ne, ná bɛto ye nwo fasue beyie a, ye de asue Yufreti si dɔ mbɔtam ne okofi wɔ sa.”

english_verse: King Artaxerxes answered: Greetings to Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and to your advisors in Samaria and other parts of Western Province.
translation_verse: Na Nana Atasɛsɛse maa bɛfale mmuayɛɛ he bɛɛmane bɛ, “Mefa mebrɛ Amrado Rehum ne ahyerɛlɛniɛ Simsae ne bɛ mmango mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Samaria ne asue Yufreti si dɔ mbɔtam ne aso ne. Mebisa ɛmɔ oo.

english_verse: After your letter was translated and read to me,
translation_verse: Krataa bɔ ɛmɔhyerɛ bɛbrɛle yɛ ne, bate ye noa wɔ me dwudwolɛ nu bahyire me.

english_verse: I had the old records checked. It is true that for years Jerusalem has rebelled and caused trouble for other kings and nations.
translation_verse: Yiti mahyɛ mmeraa maa baneanea edwirɛ bɔ bahyerɛ bato berɛ ne anu, na wala ali pefee kyɛ, ofi tetetete yeɛ sɔ kuro ne wahɔ so wayɛ lɔen watia ahemvo mɔ ɔ, na ɛlɔenyɛlɛ ne basabasayɔlɛ ɔmba kuro ne aso.

english_verse: And powerful kings have ruled Western Province from Jerusalem and have collected all kinds of taxes.
translation_verse: Ahemvo atitire lili Yerusalem so, bɔ b’ahennie ne ɔtrɛ hɔle asue Yufreti si dɔ mbɔtam ne aso amukoraa ɔ. Na mmenia tuale ɛtoɔ, ndɔ, ɔne aseɛ nwo toɔ bɛmane ahemvo nemɔ.

english_verse: I want you to command the people to stop rebuilding the city until I give further notice.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔhyɛ mmeraa ma mmenia nemɔ bɛyakyi, bɔ nnɛmaa bɛkyekye kuro ne ko ɔ, kɔpem kyɛ ngɔma bɛ ate ɔ.

english_verse: Do this at once, so that no harm will come to the kingdom.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ ɛmɔngobu ɛmɔ nye bengogua edwirɛ he aso ɔ. Anyɔ a, edwirɛ bɔ ɔtte mayee kɔto m’ahennie ye.”

english_verse: As soon as this letter was read, Governor Rehum, Secretary Shimshai, and their advisors went to Jerusalem and forced everyone to stop rebuilding the city. Work on the Temple Starts Again
translation_verse: Na bɛkengale Nana Atasɛsɛse krataa ne behyirele Rehum ne ahyerɛlɛniɛ Simsae ne bɛ mmango nemɔ nen, berɛ ne ala, bɛhɔle Yerusalem ndɛndɛ so, na bɛhyɛle Yudafoɛ nemɔ mbendene so maa bɛyakyili adwuma ne yɔlɛ.

english_verse: The Jews were forced to stop work on the temple and were not able to do any more building until the year after Darius became king of Persia.
translation_verse: Yiti Nyameɛ awuro bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne, bɛyakyili ye nwo adwuma ne bɛtole berɛ, na ɔhale berɛ toonn maa oodwuli Pɛsia hene Dario ye bia lilɛ afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne.

english_verse: Then the Lord God of Israel told the prophets Haggai and Zechariah to speak in his name to the people of Judah and Jerusalem. And they did.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hagae ne ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Sakaria bɔ ye baba ole Yido ne, bɛhane Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ behyirele Yudafoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Yuda ne Yerusalem. Begyinane Yisrael Nyameɛ dumaa bɔ ɔla bɛ so ne aso yeɛ bɛhane edwirɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: So Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the priest urged the people to start working on the temple again, and God's prophets encouraged them.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe mane Sɛtiɛl awa Serubabɛl ne Yosadake awa Yesua bɛhyɛle ye bo kyɛ besa besi Nyameɛ awuro ne wɔ Yerusalem. Na Nyameɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ gyinane bɛ si bɛbokale bɛ.

english_verse: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and his assistant Shethar Bozenai got together with some of their officials. Then they went to Jerusalem and said to the people, “Who told you to rebuild this temple?
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne ala, asue Yufreti si mbɔtam amrado Tatenae, ɔne Seta Bosenae ne bɛ mmango mɔ bɛwale Yudafoɛ berɛ beebisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ ɔmane ɛmɔ ate kyɛ ɛmɔsa besi sua ye, ná ɛmɔto ye nwo fasue ɔ?”

english_verse: Give us the names of the workers!”
translation_verse: Besa bebisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nwa mɔ yeɛ besi sua ye?”

english_verse: But God was looking after the Jewish leaders. So the governor and his group decided not to make the people stop working on the temple until they could report to Darius and get his advice.
translation_verse: Nakoso Yisrael Nyameɛ ne, né ye nye wɔ Yuda mbanyi nemɔ aso. Yiti Pɛsiafoɛ nemɔ anzi bɛ ate, kɔpem kyɛ bɛfale ye nwo amaneɛ bɛɛbɔle Dario maa ye koso ɔhyerɛle krataa wale ɔ.

english_verse: which said: King Darius, we wish you the best!
translation_verse: Krataa bɔ bɛfa bɛɛmane ye ne, nu dwirɛ ɛhe, “Nana Dario, wɔ ngoa so oo.

english_verse: We went to Judah, where the temple of the great God is being built with huge stones and wooden beams set in the walls. Everyone is working hard, and the building is going up quickly.
translation_verse: Nana, yɛbɔ wɔ amaneɛ kyɛ, yɛhɔle Yuda mbɔtam dɔ, nekaa bɔ Nyameɛ piri ne, ye awuro ne ɔwɔ ne. Nyɔboɛ mbiri mbiri yeɛ bɛ́fa bési ɔ, na basa bafa mbuna bagyinagyina ye fasue ne anu. Bayere bɛ nwo paa yeɛ bɛ́yɔ adwuma ne ɔ, na ɔkɔ so paa.

english_verse: We asked those in charge to tell us who gave them permission to rebuild the temple.
translation_verse: Yɛbisale bɛ mbanyi nemɔ kyɛ, ‘Nwa yeɛ ɔmane ɛmɔ ate kyɛ ɛmɔsa besi sua ye ná ɛmɔto ye nwo fasue ɔ?’

english_verse: We also asked for the names of their leaders, so that we could write them down for you.
translation_verse: Asa koso, yɛbisale bɛ dumaa, amaa ɔnate so yahora yahyerɛ mbanyi bɔ bɛla bɛ noa nemɔ dumaa yabrɛ wɔ maa anwu ye.

english_verse: They claimed to be servants of the God who rules heaven and earth. And they said they were rebuilding the temple that was built many years ago by one of Israel's greatest kings.
translation_verse: Na mmuayɛɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛmane yɛ ɛhe, ‘Anwuro ne aseɛ Nyameɛ ne, yɛte ye ngoaa. Yɛsa yɛsi awuro bɔ daa tetetete besili, bɔ ɔte awuro bɔ Yisrael hene piri bie osi yiele korakora ɔ.

english_verse: We were told that their people had made God angry, and he let them be captured by Nebuchadnezzar, the Babylonian king who took them away as captives to Babylonia. Nebuchadnezzar tore down their temple,
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔnate kyɛ yɛ nana mɔ bɛmane nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne ɔfɛle bɛ so yaa ne ati, ɔfale bɛ wurale Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa bɔ ɔte Kaldeaniɛ ne ye sa. Obubuli sua he guale, na ɔhyele maen ne anu ama nnure hɔle Babilɔn.

english_verse: Sheshbazzar then went to Jerusalem and laid the foundation for the temple, and the work is still going on.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe mane sɔ Sesebasa ne tole Nyameɛ awuro bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne fapem, na sua ne nwo adwuma ahɔ so alaa fi sɔ mmerɛ ne maa waadwu ɛnɛ, bɔ yɛnnya yɛyyiele ye si ɔ.’

english_verse: Your Majesty, please order someone to look up the old records in Babylonia and find out if King Cyrus really did give orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem. We will do whatever you think we should.
translation_verse: Nana Dario, sɛ ɔngɔha wɔ a, maa bɛneanea ahemvie ngrataa bɔ bafa basie Babilɔn ne anu bɛnea, kyɛ, aso Nana Karose hyɛle mmeraa kyɛ besi Nyameɛ awuro bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne bieku anaa. Nana, bɔ w’adwene kyire wɔ wɔ edwirɛ he anwo ne, soma maa bɛɛhã behyire yɛ.”

english_verse: King Darius ordered someone to go through the old records kept in Babylonia.
translation_verse: Afei Nana Dario hyɛle mmeraa maa bɛɛpenane sɔ ngrataa ne wɔ nekaa bɔ besie ngrataa wɔ Babilɔn ne.

english_verse: Finally, a scroll was found in Ecbatana, the capital of Media Province, and it said: This official record will show
translation_verse: Nakoso Ekobatana bɔ ɔte Media mbɔtam ahenguro ne, berɛ yeɛ beenwuni nwomaa bie bɔ bahyerɛ edwirɛ bie bagua so kyɛ, “Ngayeɛ dwirɛ.

english_verse: that in the first year Cyrus was king, he gave orders to rebuild God's temple in Jerusalem, so that sacrifices and offerings could be presented there. It is to be built
translation_verse: Nana Karose afoɛ bɔ oli moa wɔ ye ahennie ne anu ne, ɔhyɛle mmeraa tole berɛ kyɛ, Mmeraa he fa Nyameɛ awuro bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne anwo. Mama ate kyɛ besa besi sua ne bɛfa bɛyɛ nekaa bɔ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ɔ. Ofi ye aseɛnwo bɔ ɔkwaadwu ye anwuro ne, ɔkɔyɛ agyirɛ aburasia, yeɛ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu koso kɔyɛ agyirɛ aburasia.

english_verse: with one row of wooden beams for each three rows of large stones. The royal treasury will pay for everything.
translation_verse: Ye fapem ne, nyɔboɛ mbiri nza biala bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔtaataa so ne, bɛkɔfa bakaa ko bɛkɔto so. Na ye nwo kerɛ ne, yɛkotua yɛkofi ahemvie fotoɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Then the gold and silver things that Nebuchadnezzar took from the temple and brought to Babylonia are to be returned to their proper places. King Darius Orders the Work To Continue
translation_verse: Asa koso, Nyameɛ awuro sikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ nningyein bɔ Nebukadenesa sesa fili Yerusalem asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu wale Babilɔn ne, mahyɛ kyɛ besa bɛɛfa ebiala begua ye boso wɔ Yerusalem asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu. Odi kyɛ bɛfa bekogua Nyameɛ awuro berɛ.”

english_verse: King Darius sent this message: Governor Tattenai of Western Province and Shethar Bozenai, you and your advisors must stay away from the temple.
translation_verse: “Yiti wɔ Tatenae bɔ ɛte asue Yufreti si mbɔtam amrado ne, ɛne Seta Bosenae ne ɛmɔ mmango maen mbanyi bɔ bɛwɔ asue Yufreti si mbɔtam dɔ ne, nnɛma ɛmɔsi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne silɛ nwo ate.

english_verse: Let the Jewish governor and leaders rebuild it where it stood before. And stop slowing them down!
translation_verse: Nyameɛ awuro ne nwo adwuma ne, nnɛma ɛmɔsi ye nwo ate; na mmom ɛmɔhwe bɛ nwo ma Yudafoɛ amrado ne, ɔne Yudafoɛ mbanyi besa besi Nyameɛ awuro he besie ye boso.

english_verse: And don't fail to let the priests in Jerusalem have whatever they need each day so they can offer sacrifices to the God of heaven. Give them young bulls, rams, sheep, as well as wheat, salt, wine, and olive oil.
translation_verse: Asɔfo bɔ bɛwɔ Yerusalem ne, nikyee biala bɔ bɛkɔhã kyɛ behia ne, kyɛ nandwie akrɔngrɔma oo, mmoaen nyii oo, mmoaen bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɛkɔma nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne oo, atokoɔ oo, ngyee oo, nzaa oo, anaa ngoo oo, kyɛ ɔkɔyɛ biala, ɛ́mɔma bɛ sa hã ye alehyeleɛ biala;

english_verse: I want them to be able to offer pleasing sacrifices to God and to pray for me and my family.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so babɔ afɔleɛ fonafona bama nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne, ná babɔ mbaeɛ bama me, ɛhene ne me mma.

english_verse: If any of you don't obey this order, a wooden beam will be taken from your house and sharpened on one end. Then it will be driven through your body, and your house will be torn down and turned into a garbage dump.
translation_verse: Masa mahyɛ mmeraa koso kyɛ, ebiala bɔ okotu sɔ mmeraa ne kogua ne, bɛkɔye ye awuro nu mbuna ko, bekosinzi ye noa bɛkɔfa bɛkɔpena berɛ, ná bafa ye basina so, na bɛkɔfa ye awuro ne bɛkɔkakyi fofoɛ.

english_verse: I ask the God who is worshiped in Jerusalem to destroy any king or nation who tries either to change what I have said or to tear down his temple. I, Darius, give these orders, and I expect them to be followed carefully. The Temple Is Dedicated
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛhene bie anaa maen bie otu sɔ mmeraa ne gua, anaakyɛ ɔsɛkye Nyameɛ awuro he bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne a, Nyameɛ bɔ wama ye dumaa ala Yerusalem so ne, ótu sɔ hene ne anaa ɔ́bɔ sɔ maen ne. Me, Dario yeɛ mahyɛ sɔ mmeraa ye ɔ, na odi kyɛ bedi so pɛpɛɛpɛ!” Besi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne beyie

english_verse: With great success the Jewish leaders continued working on the temple, while Haggai and Zechariah encouraged them by their preaching. And so, the temple was completed at the command of the God of Israel and by the orders of kings Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes of Persia.
translation_verse: Yiti Yuda mbanyi nemɔ hɔle so benyane ngɔsoɛ wɔ sua ne silɛ nu, ɔnate Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hagae ne ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Sakaria bɔ ye baba ole Yido ne, bɛhã behyirele bɛ ne aso. Na kyɛbɔ Yisrael Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ ɔte ne, ɔne kyɛbɔ Pɛsia ahemvo Karose ne Dario ne Atasɛsɛse mmeraa bɔ bɛhyɛle ne ɔte ne, Yudafoɛ sili sua ne beyiele.

english_verse: On the third day of the month of Adar in the sixth year of the rule of Darius, the temple was finished.
translation_verse: Beyiele awuro ne si wɔ kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nza wɔ bosome bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Ada ne anu, wɔ Nana Dario ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ne anu.

english_verse: The people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, and everyone else who had returned from exile were happy and celebrated as they dedicated God's temple.
translation_verse: Afei Yisraelfoɛ, asɔfo nemɔ, Lewifoɛ ne mmenia ngaa bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu bɛwale ne, belili ahurusi betuli Nyameɛ awuro he bewurale Nyameɛ sa.

english_verse: One hundred bulls, two hundred rams, and four hundred lambs were offered as sacrifices at the dedication. Also twelve goats were sacrificed as sin offerings for the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ bétu Nyameɛ awuro ne bewura Nyameɛ sa ne, bɛfale ɛhemɔ bɛbɔle afɔleɛ: nandwie nyii ɛyaa ko, mmoaen nyii ɛyaa nyɔ, mmoaen akrɔngrɔma ɛyaa nna; yeɛ bɛfale mbɔngye nyii buru ne nyɔ bɛbɔle Yisrael bɔne nwo afɔleɛ, kyɛbɔ Yisrael mmusua kure nemɔ bɛ somaa te ɔ.

english_verse: Then the priests and Levites were assigned their duties in God's temple in Jerusalem, according to the instructions Moses had written. The Passover
translation_verse: Afei bɛmane asɔfo nemɔ hɔle bɛ kure kure nu, yeɛ Lewifoɛ nemɔ koso bɛ fekue fekue nu. Na bɛfale Nyameɛ sɔnenɛ nwo adwuma wɔ Yerusalem bewurale bɛ sa, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye Mose nwomaa ne anu ne. Bedi Abɔtra aluolue ne

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from exile celebrated Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
translation_verse: Bosome bɔ oli moa ne anu, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nna ne, mmenia bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu bɛwale ne, belili Abɔtra aluolue ne.

english_verse: The priests and Levites had gone through a ceremony to make themselves acceptable to lead in worship. Then some of them killed Passover lambs for those who had returned, including the other priests and themselves.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ né asɔfo nemɔ ne Lewifoɛ nemɔ bapete bɛ nwo bama bɛ mukoraa bɛ nwo ate. Yiti Lewifoɛ nemɔ huhuni Abɔtra boaen ne bɛmane bɛ bɔ bafi nnurehyelɛ nu bawa ne amukoraa, bɛ mmango asɔfo nemɔ, ɔne bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nwo.

english_verse: The sacrifices were eaten by the Israelites who had returned and by the neighboring people who had given up the sinful customs of other nations in order to worship the Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu bɛwale ne, bɛ ne ebiala bɔ ɔwɔ maen ne anu, bɔ waaboka Yisraelfoɛ so ɔne bɛ bate bɛ nwo bafi Amaenmaensofoɛ yɔleɛ fiɛ nwo, kyɛ bɛkɔso AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ne, bɛ yeɛ belili Abɔtra boaen ne ɔ.

english_verse: For seven days they celebrated the Festival of Thin Bread. Everyone was happy because the Lord God of Israel had made sure that the king of Assyria would be kind to them and help them build the temple.
translation_verse: Bele anigye belili Paanoo Kabrɛdi aluolue ne ɛlɛsoo. Bɛ nye gyele, ofikyɛ né AWURADE ama Asiria hene anwu bɛ anwumvoin, bɔ ɔnate so ɔbokale bɛ wɔ Nyameɛ, Yisrael Nyameɛ ne, ye awuro ne silɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: Much later, when Artaxerxes was king of Persia, Ezra came to Jerusalem from Babylonia. Ezra was the son of Seraiah and the grandson of Azariah. His other ancestors were Hilkiah, Shallum, Zadok, Ahitub, Amariah, Azariah, Meraioth, Zerahiah, Uzzi, Bukki, Abishua, Phinehas, Eleazar, and Aaron, the high priest. Ezra was an expert in the Law that the Lord God of Israel had given to Moses, and the Lord made sure that the king gave Ezra everything he asked for.
translation_verse: sɔ Ɛsra ne fili Babilɔn wale. Né ɔte ahyerɛlɛniɛ bɔ wabe paa wɔ Mose mmeraa bɔ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ fa mane Yisraelfoɛ ne anu. Ye dwirɛ bɔ ɔfa tole Nana Atasɛsɛse nyunu biala, ɔyɔ mane ye, ofikyɛ né AWURADE ye Nyameɛ gyi ye si.

english_verse: Other Jews, including priests, Levites, musicians, the temple guards, and servants, came to Jerusalem with Ezra. This happened during the seventh year that Artaxerxes was king.
translation_verse: Nana Atasɛsɛse lili hene ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne anu, Yisraelfoɛ nemɔ bie, bɛ ne asɔfo, Lewifoɛ, edweintolɛfoɛ, anoa awɛmvoɛ ne asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ mɔ bɛ koso besa bɛwale Yerusalem.

english_verse: God helped Ezra, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month of that seventh year, after leaving Babylonia on the first day of the first month.
translation_verse: Kyẽa bɔ oli moa wɔ bosome bɔ oli moa ne anu yeɛ otuli ye bo fili Babilɔn ɔ, na kyẽa bɔ oli moa wɔ bosome nnu ne anu yeɛ oodwuli Yerusalem ɔ, ofikyɛ ye Nyameɛ nwuni ye anwumvoin gyinane ye si.

english_verse: Ezra was a priest and an expert in the laws and commands that the Lord had given to Israel. One day King Artaxerxes gave Ezra a letter which said:
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo Ɛsra bɔ ɔte ahyerɛlɛniɛ bɔ wabe paa wɔ AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ ne ye ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔfa mane Yisrael ne anu ne, krataa bɔ Nana Atasɛsɛse fa mane ye ɛhe:

english_verse: Greetings from the great King Artaxerxes to Ezra the priest and expert in the teachings of the God of heaven.
translation_verse: “Me Atasɛsɛse, ahemvo mɔ nu hene, mefa krataa ye mema ɔsɔfo Ɛsra bɔ ɔte nyameɛso Nyameɛ ye mmeraa ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne. Mebisa wɔ oo. M’ahyɛdeɛ ne ɛhe:

english_verse: Any of the people of Israel or their priests or Levites in my kingdom may go with you to Jerusalem if they want to. My seven advisors and I agree that you may go to Jerusalem and Judah to find out if the laws of your God are being obeyed.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me Atasɛsɛse, me ne me foɛtulɛfoɛ nzoo nemɔ yeɛ yasoma wɔ ɔ, kyɛ kɔ Yuda ne Yerusalem kɔtoto nningyein yé, kyɛbɔ wɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa bɔ otira wɔ sa nu ne okyire ne.

english_verse: When you go, take the silver and gold that I and my advisors are freely giving to the God of Israel, whose temple is in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Asa koso, ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ me Atasɛsɛse, me ne me foɛtulɛfoɛ mɔ yaye yɛ kunu yafa yabɔ afɔleɛ yama Yisrael Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte Yerusalem ne, fa boka so kɔ.

english_verse: Take the silver and gold that you collect from everywhere in Babylonia. Also take the gifts that your own people and priests have so willingly contributed for the temple of your God in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ biala bɔ ekonya ye wɔ Babilɔn aseɛ so amukoraa ne, ɔne maen ne asɔfo akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ bɔ bɛye bɛ kunu bɛbɔ bɛma bɛ Nyameɛ awuro bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne, fa boka so kɔ.

english_verse: Use the money carefully to buy the best bulls, rams, lambs, grain, and wine. Then sacrifice them on the altar at God's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Wɔ sa kã sɔ sikaa ne a, nea kyɛ ɛkɔfa kɔtɔ nandwie nyii mɔ, mmoaen nyii, mmoaen akrɔngrɔma, yeɛ b’aburoo afɔleɛ ne anonneɛ afɔleɛ. Na sɔ nningyein ne, fa bɔ afɔleɛ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ Nyameɛ awuro wɔ Yerusalem ne aso.

english_verse: If any silver or gold is left, you and your people may use it for whatever pleases your God.
translation_verse: Afei, ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ ɔkɔha ne, nikyee biala bɔ ɛne eliɛma nemɔ bekuro kyɛ bɛfa bɛyɔ ne, ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́yɔ ye kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ te ɔ.

english_verse: Give your God the other articles that have been contributed for use in his temple.
translation_verse: Kulie mɔ bɔ bafa bawura wɔ sa kyɛ ɛɛfa yɔ wɔ Nyameɛ awuro ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne, fa kogua Nyameɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne nyunu.

english_verse: If you need to get anything else for the temple, you may have the money you need from the royal treasury.
translation_verse: Wɔ Nyameɛ awuro ne, nikyee biala bɔ waha bɔ ekohia kɔfa kɔyɔ ye nwo adwuma ne, de fi ahemvie fotoɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Ezra, you are a priest and an expert in the laws of the God of heaven, and I order all treasurers in Western Province to do their very best to help you.
translation_verse: “Me Nana Atasɛsɛse, mahyɛ mmeraa he mama fotoɛsoneafoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ asue Yufreti si mbɔtam kyɛ, nikyee biala bɔ ɔsɔfo Ɛsra bɔ ɔte nyameɛso Nyameɛ ye mmeraa ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne okobisa kofi ɛmɔ berɛ ne, ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ ɛmɔkɔma ye sa kɔhã ye ndɛndɛ ɔ;

english_verse: They must provide whatever the God of heaven demands for his temple, so that he won't be angry with me and with the kings who rule after me.
translation_verse: Nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne, ahyɛdeɛ biala bɔ ɔkɔhyɛ kɔfa ye awuro ne anwo ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ye pɛpɛɛpɛ bɛma nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne. Anyɔ a, ɔkɔfɛ me Nana Atasɛsɛse, me ne me mma y’ahennie so yaa.

english_verse: We want you to know that no priests, Levites, musicians, guards, temple servants, or any other temple workers will have to pay any kind of taxes.
translation_verse: Yɛ́ma ɛmɔte kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔde asɔfo nemɔ, anaa Lewifoɛ, anaa edweintolɛfoɛ, anaa anoa wɛmvoɛ, anaa asɔneyɛɛ sua nwo awɛmvoɛ, anaa Nyameɛ awuro he anwo somvoɛ biala toɔ, anaa ndɔ, anaa aseɛ nwo toɔ a, otia mmeraa.

english_verse: Ezra, use the wisdom God has given you and choose officials and leaders to govern the people of Western Province. These leaders should know God's laws and have them taught to anyone who doesn't know them.
translation_verse: “Na wɔ, Ɛsra, wɔ Nyameɛ nworɛ bɔ wafa wama wɔ ne, gyina so yeye edwirɛlilɛfoɛ ne maenbulɛfoɛ bɔ bɛse wɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa ne, bɔ bɛkɔla mmenia amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ asue Yufreti si mbɔtam noa bɛkɔtoto nikyee biala pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ. Bɛ bɔ bɛnze mmeraa ne koso, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔkyirekyire bɛ.

english_verse: Everyone who fails to obey God's Law or the king's law will be punished without pity. They will either be executed or put in prison or forced to leave their country, or have all they own taken away. Ezra Praises God
translation_verse: Na sona biala bɔ wanni wɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa ne aso, ɔne me, Nana Atasɛsɛse me mmeraa so ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ bebua ye fɔ bɛtwe ye so ndɛndɛ: kyɛ bekobua ye ewue foɛ oo, anaa bɛkɔpɛ ye asue oo, anaa bekole ye nwo nningyein oo, anaa bɛkɔto ye kuku nu oo.”

english_verse: Because King Artaxerxes was so kind, Ezra said: Praise the Lord God of our ancestors! He made sure that the king honored the Lord's temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “AWURADE, yɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ bɔ wafa sɔ adwene paa he wawura Nana Atasɛsɛse ti anu, kyɛ ɔfa siesie AWURADE awuro bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem maa ɔyɛ nyemene ne, animnyam hã ye,

english_verse: God has told the king, his advisors, and his powerful officials to treat me with kindness. The Lord God has helped me, and I have been able to bring many Jewish leaders back to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ walo me wamaa manya animnyam wɔ Nana Atasɛsɛse ne ye foɛtulɛfoɛ ne ye mbanyi amukoraa bɛ nyunu. AWURADE me Nyameɛ lole me gyinane me si, na ɛhe hyɛle me nguraen. Na mmoaboale mbanyi bɔ bɛlela Yisrael noa maa yɛsa yɛwale.”

english_verse: Artaxerxes was king of Persia when I led the following chiefs of the family groups from Babylonia to Jerusalem:
translation_verse: Mbanyi bɔ bɛlela bɛ mmusua nemɔ noa, bɔ bɛ ne me fili Babilɔn wale wɔ Nana Atasɛsɛse aberɛ so ne, b’aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ɛhe:

english_verse: Gershom of the Phinehas family; Daniel of the Ithamar family; Hattush son of Shecaniah of the David family; Zechariah and
translation_verse: Bigiwae bosofoɛ nu: Yutae ne Sakure, bɔ mmienzua aburasoo boka bɛ so ɔ. Ɛsra to ye sa frɛ Lewifoɛ

english_verse: I said to the priests: You belong to the Lord, the God of your ancestors, and these things also belong to him. The silver and gold were willingly given as gifts to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na nga ngyirele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔte krongron ma AWURADE, nningyein nemɔ te nningyein krongron, yeɛ ɛdwetɛ ne ne sikaa kɔkorɛ ne, bɛte akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE ɛmɔ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne.

english_verse: I brought everyone together by the river that flows to the town of Ahava where we camped for three days. Not one Levite could be found among the people and priests.
translation_verse: Mmoaboale bɛ noa wɔ asue bɔ ɔtengyɛ kɔ Ahawa ne anoa, na yɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ yɛlili berɛ ɛlɛsa. Nneaneane mmenia nemɔ ne asɔfo nemɔ nu, nakoso mannwu Lewi bosoniɛ biala berɛ.

english_verse: So I sent for the leaders Eliezer, Ariel, Shemaiah, Elnathan, Jarib, Elnathan, Nathan, Zechariah, and Meshullam. I also sent for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were very wise counselors.
translation_verse: Yiti nzomane maa bɛɛfrɛle mbanyi Eliesa, Ariɛl, Semaya, Elnatan, Yaribo, Elnatan, Natan, Sakaria ne Mesulam, yeɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ Yoaribo ne Elnatan.

english_verse: Then I sent them to Iddo, the leader at Casiphia, and I told them to ask him and his temple workers to send people to serve in God's temple.
translation_verse: Na Yido bɔ ɔte panyi wɔ Kasifia ne, nzomane bɛ maa bɛhɔle ye berɛ. Mvale ngraa mane bɛ kyɛ beese Yido ne oliɛma mɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ nemɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Kasifia ne kyɛ, asɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛkɔyɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma wɔ Nyameɛ awuro ne, bɛma bɛbra yɛ wa.

english_verse: God was kind to us and caused them to send a skillful man named Sherebiah, who was a Levite from the family of Mahli. Eighteen of his relatives came with him.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ lole yɛ ne ati, bɛmane biaa bie bɔ oli Serebia wale. Ɔte Yisrael awa Lewi ɔwa Maheli ye bosoniɛ. Ɔne ye mma mɔ ne ye mmango Lewifoɛ, bɛte buru ne mmɔtwɛ.

english_verse: We were also sent Hashabiah and Jeshaiah from the family of Merari along with
translation_verse: Besa bɛmane Hasabia ne Yehyaya bɔ bɛte Merari bosofoɛ ne bɛwale. Bɛ ne bɛ mmango Lewifoɛ ne bɛ mma mɔ, bɛte aburanyɔ.

english_verse: Beside the Ahava River, I asked the people to go without eating and to pray. We humbled ourselves and asked God to bring us and our children safely to Jerusalem with all of our possessions.
translation_verse: Yeɛ mva ndole dwaa wɔ asue Ahawa noa berɛ, kyɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ebiala yɛ akɔngyere ɔbrɛ ye nwo ase wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, ná yɛsrɛ ye maa ɔbɔ yɛ ne yɛ mma mɔ ne yɛ nningyein mukoraa nwo waen wɔ y’ateetulɛ ne anu.

english_verse: So we went without food and asked God himself to protect us, and he answered our prayers. The Gifts for the Temple
translation_verse: Yiti yɛyɛle akɔngyere yɛfale sɔ dwirɛ ne yɛtole yɛ Nyameɛ nyunu, na otiele yɛ mbaeɛ ne.

english_verse: I chose twelve of the leading priests—Sherebiah, Hashabiah and ten of their relatives.
translation_verse: Afei, asɔfo mbanyi nemɔ, nneaneane nu nyele bɛ nu buru ne nyɔ. Bɛ ole: Serebia, Hasabia, yeɛ bɛ mmango Lewifoɛ buru bɔ bɛboka bɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: Be sure to guard them and keep them safe until you reach Jerusalem. Then weigh them inside God's temple in the presence of the chief priests, the Levites, and the heads of the Israelite families.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa besie yé kɔpem kyɛ ɛmɔkɔkari bɛ wɔ asɔfo mbanyi ne Lewifoɛ ne Yisrael mmusua mbanyi nyunu, wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ pumbu ne anu wɔ Yerusalem ɔ.”

english_verse: The priests and Levites then took charge of the gifts that had been weighed, so they could take them to the temple of our God in Jerusalem. The Return to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Na asɔfo nemɔ bɛ ne Lewifoɛ nemɔ belele ɛdwetɛ, sikaa kɔkorɛ ɔne nningyein bɔ ngarili mane bɛ ne, kyɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔwa yɛ Nyameɛ awuro wɔ Yerusalem. Besa bɛba Yerusalem

english_verse: On the twelfth day of the first month, we left the Ahava River and started for Jerusalem. Our God watched over us, and as we traveled along, he kept our enemies from ambushing us.
translation_verse: Bosome bɔ oli moa ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nyɔ ne, yeɛ yɛtuli yɛ bo yɛfili asue Ahawa noa kyɛ yɛkɔ Yerusalem ɔ. Yɛ Nyameɛ gyinane yɛ si, na ɔpepɛ lele yɛ fili pɔfoɛ mɔ ne mmenia bɔ bɛɛtetɛle yɛ atunu nemɔ sa nu.

english_verse: After arriving in Jerusalem, we rested for three days.
translation_verse: Yɛɛdwuli Yerusalem, na yɛlili berɛ ɛlɛsa.

english_verse: Then on the fourth day we went to God's temple, where the silver, the gold, and the other things were weighed and given to the priest Meremoth son of Uriah. With him were Eleazar son of Phinehas and the two Levites, Jozabad son of Jeshua and Noadiah son of Binnui.
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛnna ne aso, yɛkarili ɛdwetɛ ne, sikaa kɔkorɛ ne, ɔne nningyein ne wɔ yɛ Nyameɛ awuro berɛ, na yɛfa yɛwurale Yuria awa ɔsɔfo Meremote sa. Né Finehase awa Eleasa boka ye so wɔ berɛ. Né Yesua awa Yosabade ne Binuyi awa Noadia bɔ bɛte Lewifoɛ ne koso bɛboka bɛ so wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: goats were sacrificed for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Asegade bosofoɛ nu: Hakatan awa Yohanan, bɔ mmienzua ɛyaa ko ne buru boka ye so ɔ.

english_verse: Some of those who had returned took the king's orders to the governors and officials in Western Province. Then the officials did what they could for the people and for the temple of God.
translation_verse: Asa koso, Nana Atasɛsɛse mmeraa bɔ ɔhyerɛle ye krataa nu ne, bɛye bɛmane ye mbɔtam mbanyi mɔ ne amrado mɔ bɔ begyi ye gya nu wɔ asue Yufreti si dɔ mbɔtam ne. Na bɛ koso bɛfale bɛ mmokalɛ bɛtale maen ne ne Nyameɛ awuro ne si.

english_verse: Later the Jewish leaders came to me and said: Many Israelites, including priests and Levites, are living just like the people around them. They are even guilty of some of the horrible sins of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
translation_verse: Yɛyɔle ɛhemɔ amukoraa yɛyiele nen, Yisrael mbanyi wale me berɛ beesele kyɛ, “Yisraelfoɛ, bɔ asɔfo ne Lewifoɛ mɔ boka so ɔ, bande bɛ nwo bamvi mmenia bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ nemɔ aso bɔ bɛ yɔleɛ te akyiwadeɛ ne anwo. Sɔ mmenia nemɔ ole: Kanaanfoɛ, Hitifoɛ, Perisifoɛ, Yebusifoɛ, Amonfoɛ, Moabofoɛ, Misraimfoɛ ne Amorifoɛ.

english_verse: Some Israelite men have married foreign women and have let their sons do the same thing. Our own officials and leaders were the first to commit this disgusting sin, and now God's holy people are mixed with foreigners.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bagyigya bɛ mma mmrasua nemɔ bie, yeɛ bagyigya bie koso bama bɛ mma mmienzua mɔ. Ɔnate sɔ ati, mmenia krongron mɔ ne aseɛ nemɔ so ama bali afra. Na mbɔtam mbanyi ne mbanyi bɔ bɛla yɛ noa nemɔ po yeɛ bapɛ sɔ esaa tɛɛ ne bato berɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: This news made me so angry that I ripped my clothes and tore hair from my head and beard. Then I just sat in shock
translation_verse: Ndele sɔ dwirɛ nen, nzunzuale m’ataadeɛ ne m’ataadeɛ aguasoɛ nu, ndutuli me ti nwiaa ne me kanza nwiaa, na mvale aworabɔlɛ mbofole aseɛnwo berɛ.

english_verse: until the time for the evening sacrifice. Many of our people were greatly concerned and gathered around me, because the God of Israel had warned us to stay away from foreigners. Ezra's Prayer
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu bɛwale ne, ɔnate bɛ mvomsoɛ ne ati, mmenia mukoraa bɔ Yisrael Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne mane bɛ nwo dwirili bɛ ne, bɛɛtenatenane me nwo berɛ, na mvale aworabɔlɛ mbofole berɛ toonn maa oodwuli mmerɛ bɔ bɛbɔ nɔsoa afɔleɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: At the time of the evening sacrifice, I was still sitting there in sorrow with my clothes all torn. So I got down on my knees, then lifted my arms,
translation_verse: Odwuli mmerɛ bɔ bɛbɔ nɔsoa afɔleɛ nen, mvili nekaa bɔ né maatena medi aworabɔlɛ ne ndwɔsole, bɔ né masunzua m’ataadeɛ ne m’ataadeɛ aguasoɛ nu ɔ. Mmuli ndwerɛ, ndrɛle me sa nu mɔle mbaeɛ ngyirele AWURADE me Nyameɛ,

english_verse: and prayed: I am much too ashamed to face you, Lord God. Our sins and our guilt have swept over us like a flood that reaches up to the heavens.
translation_verse: na nzele kyɛ, “O me Nyameɛ, ɔyɛ me nya paa, na mafɛre kyɛ ngɔpagya me nye ngɔnea wɔ ɔ. Ofikyɛ me Nyameɛ, y’amumuyɛɛ wasone pee, na yɛ mvomsoɛ wadwu nyameɛso.

english_verse: Since the time of our ancestors, all of us have sinned. That's why we, our kings, and our priests have often been defeated by other kings. They have killed some of us and made slaves of others; they have taken our possessions and made us ashamed, just as we are today.
translation_verse: Fite yɛ nana mɔ aberɛ so toonn bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ɔ, mvomsoɛ ali yɛ ti. Na ɔnate yɛ ne y’ahemvo mɔ ne y’asɔfo mɔ amumuyɛɛ ti, yeɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ ahemvo mɔ bɛ sa ahã yɛ bɔ beku yɛ, bɛkye yɛ nnure, bɛfẽ yɛ nningyein bɛfa, ná begua yɛ nyunu ase, kyɛbɔ kekesaala ye ɔte ye.

english_verse: But for now, Lord God, you have shown great kindness to us. You made us truly happy by letting some of us settle in this sacred place and by helping us in our time of slavery.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmerɛ kãa ye anu de, AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ walo yɛ. Wama yɛ ngaa ne yanya yɛ ti yadidi nu, na wabɔ yɛ atenaseɛ wɔ ye nekaa krongron berɛ, kyɛ ɔfa kyekye yɛ wora ná ɔma yɛ nwo tɔ yɛ kãa fi nganga tebea bɔ yahɔ nu ne anu.

english_verse: We are slaves, but you have never turned your back on us. You love us, and because of you, the kings of Persia have helped us. It's as though you have given us new life! You let us rebuild your temple and live safely in Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ yayɛ nganga de, nakoso yɛ Nyameɛ anye ye sa wamvi yɛ bo wɔ yɛ ngangayɛlɛ ne anu. Mmom, wama Pɛsia ahemvo banwu yɛ anwumvoin. Na ɔnate so bama yɛ ate kyɛ yɛsa yɛsi yɛ Nyameɛ awuro ne, kyɛ yɛhyehyɛ ye nekaa bɔ wabubu ne, na wabɔ yɛ nwo waen wɔ Yuda ne Yerusalem.

english_verse: Our God, what can we say now? Even after all this, we have disobeyed the commands
translation_verse: “O afei yɛ Nyameɛ, ɛhemɔ asi ye, nzikyɛ dwirɛ bieku koraa yeɛ yɛhã ɔ? Yapo wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ

english_verse: that were given to us by your servants the prophets. They said the land you are giving us is full of sinful and wicked people, who never stop doing disgusting things.
translation_verse: bɔ ɛnate wɔ somvoɛ mɔ so ɛhyɛle kyɛ, ‘Aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔkwaafa bɛtena so ne, ɔte aseɛ bɔ so ama nemɔ bafa bɛ bra fiɛ ne b’akyiwadeɛ yɔleɛ bahã ye ɔ. Bafa bɛ yɔleɛ fiɛ bayi ye tɛkyɛ fi ye ti kɔka ye ti.

english_verse: And we were warned not to let our daughters and sons marry their sons and daughters. Your prophets also told us never to help those foreigners or even let them live in peace. You wanted us to become strong and to enjoy the good things in the land, then someday to leave it to our children forever.
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ mma mmrasua bɛma bɛ mma mmienzua mɔ begya, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔgyigya bɛ mma mmrasua bɛma ɛmɔ mma mmienzua. Nnɛma ɛmɔpena bɛ ne asomdwee anaa paa, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔ nwo ayɛ se, ná ɛmɔali aseɛ ne aso nningyein paa, ná ɛmɔafa bayakyi ɛmɔ mma mɔ maa wayɛ agyapadeɛ afebɔɔ.’

english_verse: You punished us because of our terrible sins. But you did not punish us nearly as much as we deserve, and you have brought some of us back home.
translation_verse: Yɛ bɔne ne y’amumuyɛɛ kandinga ne ati yeɛ ɛhemɔ atoto yɛ ɔ. Nakoso ɛhe asi ye po, wɔ, yɛ Nyameɛ, y’amumuyɛɛ nwo asohwenɛ bɔ afa ama yɛ ne ɔte kãa, na ama yɛ ngaa ne yanya yɛ ti yadidi nu.

english_verse: Why should we disobey your commands again by letting our sons and daughters marry these foreigners who do such disgusting things? That would make you angry enough to destroy us all!
translation_verse: Aso odi kyɛ yɛbu wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne aso bieku, bɔ yɛne mmenia bɔ bɛbɔ sɔ akyiwadeɛ bra ne yagyigya yɛ nwo ɔ? Aso ɛngɔfɛ yɛ so yaa toonn kɔpem kyɛ ekohũhũ yɛ bɔ yɛ nu biala ngɔha anaa ongonya ye ti ngodidi nu ɔ?

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you have been more than fair by letting a few of us survive. But once again, our sins have made us ashamed to face you.
translation_verse: O AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ, ɛtengyɛ, ofikyɛ ama yɛ ngaa ne yanya yɛ ti yadidi nu, kyɛbɔ kekesaala ye ɔte ye. Yɛ amumuyɛɛ nu yeɛ yɛwɔ wɔ nyunu ɔ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ebiala ngɔhora ngɔfa sɔ amumuyɛɛ ne ngogyina wɔ nyunu.”

english_verse: While Ezra was down on his knees in front of God's temple, praying with tears in his eyes and confessing the sins of the people of Israel, a large number of men, women, and children gathered around him and cried bitterly.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Ɛsra gu so ɔbɔ mbaeɛ, bɔ ole esuɛ ode bɛ bɔne to nu, bɔ né wafa ye nyunu wabutu berɛ wɔ Nyameɛ awuro ne anyunu berɛ ne, Yisraelfoɛ pembepembe, mmienzua ne mmrasua ne ngwadaa bɛɛpɛle ye nwo beyiale, na bɛ koso besuni hahii.

english_verse: Shecaniah son of Jehiel from the family of Elam said: Ezra, we have disobeyed God by marrying these foreign women. But there is still hope for the people of Israel,
translation_verse: Na Elam bosoniɛ Yehiel ɔwa Sekania sele Ɛsra kyɛ, “Yanni nahorɛ yamma yɛ Nyameɛ, kyɛ yagyigya Amaenmaensofoɛ mmrasua bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ ne aso ɔ. Nakoso ɛhe asi ye po, anyelasoɛ wɔ berɛ ma Yisrael.

english_verse: if we follow your advice and the advice of others who truly respect the laws of God. We must promise God that we will divorce our foreign wives and send them away, together with their children.
translation_verse: Yiti kekesaala ye, odi kyɛ yɛne yɛ Nyameɛ yɛyɛ apam, kyɛ yɛ ye nemɔ, bɛ ne bɛ mma mɔ, yɛkɔfoa bɛ maa bekofi yɛ nu bɛkɔhɔ. Me mene, ɛne mmenia bɔ bedi Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ ne aso ne, odi kyɛ yɛyɔ ye sɔ kyɛbɔ mmeraa ne kyire ɔ.

english_verse: Ezra, it's up to you to do something! We will support whatever you do. So be brave!
translation_verse: Dwɔso, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ asodie ne ɔla wɔ so ɔ. Yɛgyi wɔ si, yiti si wɔ hue ná yɔ ye sɔ.”

english_verse: Ezra stood up and made the chief priests, the Levites, and everyone else in Israel swear that they would follow the advice of Shecaniah.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Ɛsra dwɔsole, na ɔmane asɔfo mbanyi ne Lewifoɛ ne Yisrael amukoraa bɛtale ndaen kyɛ bekoli sɔ dwirɛ ne aso. Na bɛtale ndaen ne.

english_verse: Then Ezra left God's temple and went to spend the night in the living quarters of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. He felt sorry because of what the people had done, and he did not eat or drink a thing.
translation_verse: Afei Ɛsra fili Nyameɛ awuro ne anyunu berɛ, na ɔhɔle Eliasibo awa Yehohanan sua nu. Ɔhɔle berɛ ne, wannidi, yeɛ wanno nzue, ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu bɛwale ne, né odi b’amumuyɛɛ nwo aworabɔlɛ.

english_verse: The officials and leaders sent a message to all who had returned from Babylonia and were now living in Jerusalem and Judah. This message told them to meet in Jerusalem within three days, or else they would lose everything they owned and would no longer be considered part of the people that had returned from Babylonia.
translation_verse: kyɛ bama bɛ ɛlɛsa, na ebiala bɔ wamma ne, mbɔtam mbanyi ne mbanyi nemɔ bahyɛ mmeraa kyɛ bele ye nwo nningyein amu, ná bɛpɛ ye asue befi mmenia bɔ bafi nnurehyelɛ nu bawa ne anu.

english_verse: Three days later, on the twentieth day of the ninth month, everyone from Judah and Benjamin came to Jerusalem and sat in the temple courtyard. It was a serious meeting, and they sat there, trembling in the rain.
translation_verse: Na ɛlɛsa ne sone ne, né bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Yuda ne Benyamin amukoraa baaboa bɛ noa wɔ Yerusalem. Né ɔte kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ wɔ bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so ngona ne anu. Mmenia ne amukoraa bɛtenatenane dwaa ne aso wɔ Nyameɛ awuro ne anyunu berɛ. Na ɔnate sɔ dwirɛ ne ɔne esue piri bɔ né ɔtɔ ne ati, bɛ nwo wosowosole bɛ.

english_verse: Ezra the priest stood up and said: You have broken God's Law by marrying foreign women, and you have made the whole nation guilty!
translation_verse: Afei ɔsɔfo Ɛsra dwɔso gyinane sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔabu mmeraa ne aso, kyɛ ɛmɔagyigya Amaenmaensofoɛ mmrasua ɔ, na ɛmɔnate ɛhe aso bama Yisrael foɛlilɛ ne wayɛ piri paa.

english_verse: Now you must confess your sins to the Lord God of your ancestors and obey him. Divorce your foreign wives and don't have anything to do with the rest of the foreigners who live around here.
translation_verse: Yiti odi kyɛ ɛmɔde ɛmɔ bɔne bɛto nu bekyire AWURADE ɛmɔ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne, ná ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔsɔ ye nye ɔ. Ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi aseɛ ne aso mmenia nwo, ɔne Amaenmaensofoɛ mmrasua nwo.”

english_verse: Everyone in the crowd shouted: You're right! We will do what you say.
translation_verse: Yeɛ mmenia bɔ bayia berɛ ne amukoraa bɛteane nu bebuale kyɛ, “Ye ala ɛne. Bɔ ahã ne ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: But there are so many of us, and we can't just stay out here in this downpour. A lot of us have sinned by marrying foreign women, and the matter can't be settled in only a day or two.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmenia ne sone, asuso koso atikye bɔ yɛngɔhora dwaaso gyina ɔ. Yeɛ nna nikyee bɔ yɛkɔhora yɛkɔfa ɛlɛho anaa elenyɔ yɛkɔyɔ hɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ yɛ bɔ yato mmeraa wɔ ɛhe anwo ne, yɛsone paa.

english_verse: Why can't our officials stay on in Jerusalem and take care of this for us? Let everyone who has sinned in this way meet here at a certain time with leaders and judges from their own towns. If we take care of this problem, God will surely stop being so terribly angry with us.
translation_verse: Yiti ma yɛ mbanyi mɔ begyina mmenia ne amukoraa yɛ gya nu, ná ebiala bɔ ɔwɔ yɛ nguro nemɔ aso bɔ wagya Amaenmaensoniɛ braa ne, maa ɔbra bɛ nyunu wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɛkɔhyɛ bɛkɔma ye ɔ nu. Sɛ bɛ́ba a, odi kyɛ bɛ kuro mbanyi ne ndɛenbualɛfoɛ bɛboka bɛ so bɛ ne bɛ bɛba. Na yɛkɔyɔ ye sɔ toonn kɔpem kyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ ɛyaa piri bɔ wafɛ ye yɛ so wɔ edwirɛ he anwo ne, ye ahone kɔtɔ nzue nu ɔ.”

english_verse: Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah were the only ones who objected, except for the two Levites, Meshullam and Shabbethai.
translation_verse: Asahel awa Yonatan ne Tikiwa awa Yahasia bɛ ngome yeɛ betiale sɔ nzusuleɛ ne anu ɔ, na Mesulam ne Lewiniɛ Sabetae bɛfoale bɛ so.

english_verse: Everyone else who had returned from exile agreed with the plan. So Ezra the priest chose men who were heads of the families, and he listed their names. They started looking into the matter on the first day of the tenth month,
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu bɛwale ne de, belele nzusuleɛ ne bɛtole nu. Na ɔsɔfo Ɛsra yeyele mmusua mbanyi nemɔ, abusua biala nu sona ko, na bɛbobɔle bɛ dumaa. Na kyẽa bɔ oli moa wɔ bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne anu ne, bɛtenane ase kyɛ bɛneanea edwirɛ ne anu.

english_verse: and they did not finish until the first day of the first month of the next year. The Men Who Had Foreign Wives
translation_verse: Na oodwuli kyẽa bɔ oli moa wɔ bosome bɔ oli moa ne anu ne, né baneanea mmienzua bɔ bagyigya Amaenmaensofoɛ mmrasua nemɔ bɛ dwirɛ ne anu bayie.

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who had agreed to divorce their foreign wives and to sacrifice a ram as a sin offering: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah from the family of Joshua son of Jozadak and his brothers;
translation_verse: Bɛhyɛle ɛbɔ kyɛ bɛkɔfoa bɛ ye nemɔ maa bekofi bɛ nu bɛkɔhɔ. Belele bɛ mvomsoɛ bɛtole nu, na bɛfale boaen nyii ko bɛbɔle mvomsoɛ afɔleɛ.

english_verse: Hanani and Zebadiah from the family of Immer;
translation_verse: Yimere bosofoɛ nemɔ: Hanani ne Sebadia.

english_verse: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah from the family of Harim;
translation_verse: Harim bosofoɛ nemɔ: Maaseya, Elia, Semaya, Yehiel ne Yusia.

english_verse: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah from the family of Pashhur.
translation_verse: Pasure bosofoɛ nemɔ: Elionae, Maaseya, Yismael, Netanɛl, Yosabade ne Elasa.

english_verse: Those Levites who had foreign wives were: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah , Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
translation_verse: Lewifoɛ nemɔ: Yosabade, Simei, Kelaya , Petahia, Yuda ne Eliesa.

english_verse: Eliashib, the musician, had a foreign wife. These temple guards had foreign wives: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
translation_verse: Edweintolɛfoɛ nemɔ: Eliasibo. Anoa awɛmvoɛ nemɔ: Salum, Telem ne Yuri.

english_verse: Here is a list of the others from Israel who had foreign wives: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Hashabiah, and Benaiah from the family of Parosh;
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne koso, Parose bosofoɛ: Ramia, Yisia, Malkiya, Miyamin, Eleasa, Malkiya ne Benaya.

english_verse: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah from the family of Elam;
translation_verse: Elam bosofoɛ nemɔ: Matania, Sakaria, Yehiel, Abidi, Yeremote ne Elia.

english_verse: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza from the family of Zattu;
translation_verse: Satu bosofoɛ nemɔ: Elionae, Eliasibo, Matania, Yeremote, Sabade ne Asisa.

english_verse: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai from the family of Bebai;
translation_verse: Bebae bosofoɛ nemɔ: Yehohanan, Hanania, Sabae ne Atelae.

english_verse: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth from the family of Bani;
translation_verse: Bani bosofoɛ nemɔ: Mesulam, Maluke, Adaya, Yasubo, Seale ne Yeremote.

english_verse: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh from the family of Pahath Moab;
translation_verse: Pahate Moabo bosofoɛ nemɔ: Adena, Kelale, Benaya, Maaseya, Matania, Basalel, Binuyi ne Manase.

english_verse: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei from the family of Hashum;
translation_verse: Hasum bosofoɛ nemɔ: Matenae, Matata, Sabade, Elifɛlɛte, Yeremae, Manase ne Simei.

english_verse: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Jaddai, Joel, and Benaiah from the family of Nebo.
translation_verse: Nebo bosofoɛ nemɔ: Yeyiɛl, Matitia, Sabade, Sebina, Yadae, Yowel ne Benaya.

english_verse: These men divorced their foreign wives, then sent them and their children away.
translation_verse: Né sɔ mmenia ne amukoraa bagyigya Amaenmaensofoɛ mmrasua, na né bɛ nu biemɔ bɛ ne bɛ bawowo.

english_verse: I am Nehemiah son of Hacaliah, and in this book I tell what I have done. During the month of Chislev in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes ruled Persia, I was in his fortress city of Susa,
translation_verse: Hakalia awa Nehemia, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe. Afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne, bosome bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Kislewi ne anu, ɛlɛho bie, né nwɔ Susa ahemvie.

english_verse: when my brother Hanani came with some men from Judah. So I asked them about the Jews who had escaped from being captives in Babylonia. I also asked them about the city of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na nniɛma nemɔ anu ko bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Hanani, ɔne mmenia biemɔ befili Yuda bɛwale. Mmisale bɛ Yudafoɛ bɔ baha dɔ bɔ bɛ de bangye bɛ nnure bangɔ bie ne, ɔne Yerusalem kuro ne, bɛ nwo dwirɛ.

english_verse: They told me, “Those captives who have come back are having all kinds of troubles. They are terribly disgraced, Jerusalem's walls are broken down, and its gates have been burned.”
translation_verse: Na bɛbɔle me amaneɛ kyɛ, “Mmenia bɔ bangye bɛ nnure bangɔ bie, ná bɛwɔ maen ne anu ne, amaneɛ ne animguaseɛ kandinga paa ato bɛ. Pɔfoɛ nemɔ babubu Yerusalem fasue ne bagua, yeɛ ye pambim nemɔ koso bato nu see bayera bɛ.”

english_verse: When I heard this, I sat down on the ground and cried. Then for several days, I mourned; I went without eating to show my sorrow, and I prayed:
translation_verse: Na ndele sɔ dwirɛ ne nen, ndenane ase nzuni, nnili aworabɔlɛ ngyẽa pee, na nyɛle akɔngyere mmɔle mbaeɛ wɔ nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne nyunu.

english_verse: Lord God of heaven, you are great and fearsome. And you faithfully keep your promises to everyone who loves you and obeys your commands.
translation_verse: Na ngane kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE, nyameɛso Nyameɛ, Nyameɛ piri bɔ wɔ nwo yɛ suro bɔ edi apam so ná ɛye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ali kyire bɛ bɔ bekuro wɔ dwirɛ ná bedi wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne aso ne,

english_verse: I am your servant, so please have mercy on me and answer the prayer that I make day and night for these people of Israel who serve you. I, my family, and the rest of your people have sinned
translation_verse: mesrɛ wɔ, yɛ asoɛ tie, ná fa wɔ nye nea, amaa ate w’akoaa me mbaeɛ bɔ mebɔ wɔ wɔ nyunu kekesaala ye mema wɔ ngoaa Yisraelfoɛ eyia ne kɔngɔen ne. Afei, Yisraelfoɛ, yɛ bɔne bɔ yayɔ yatia wɔ ne, mekã mekyire wɔ. Me ne me baba awuro ama amukoraa, nahorɛ nu, yayɔ bɔne.

english_verse: by choosing to disobey you and the laws and teachings you gave to your servant Moses.
translation_verse: Yayɔ bɔne kandinga paa yatia wɔ, na mmeraa dwirɛ ne ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ ɛhyehyɛle mane wɔ somvoɛ Mose ne, yanni so.

english_verse: Please remember the promise you made to Moses. You told him that if we were unfaithful, you would scatter us among foreign nations.
translation_verse: Kaye ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɛfa mane wɔ somvoɛ Mose kyɛ, ‘Sɛ ɛmɔanni nahorɛ bamma me a, ngɔbɔ ɛmɔ ngɔsande ngɔhɔ maen maen nemɔ aso,

english_verse: But you also said that no matter how far away we were, we could turn to you and start obeying your laws. Then you would bring us back to the place where you have chosen to be worshiped.
translation_verse: nakoso sɛ ɛmɔsa bɛba me berɛ, ná ɛmɔdi me mmeraa dwirɛ so a, ye de aseɛ ye aso nekaa biala bɔ mama ɛmɔ babɔ aya baagua ne, ngɔboaboa ɛmɔ noa ngofi dɔ; ná mafa ɛmɔ mawa nekaa bɔ maye masie berɛ mafa me dumaa mato so ne.’

english_verse: Our Lord, I am praying for your servants—those you rescued by your great strength and mighty power.
translation_verse: Bɛte wɔ somvoɛ mɔ ne wɔ maen bɔ afa wɔ tumi piri ne w’anwoserɛ kandinga ne apepɛ ale bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Please answer my prayer and the prayer of your other servants who gladly honor your name. When I serve the king his wine today, make him pleased with me and let him do what I ask.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ somvoɛ ne wɔ somvoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛ nye gye kyɛ bɛkɔfa anidie bɛkɔma wɔ dumaa ne, mesrɛ wɔ tie yɛ mbaeɛ. Ma nningyein ɔhɔ so yé ɔma wɔ somvoɛ, ná ma biaa ye onwu me anwumvoin.” Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né nde Ɛhene ne, ye nzaasulɛniɛ.

english_verse: During the month of Nisan in the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king, I served him his wine, as I had done before. But this was the first time I had ever looked depressed.
translation_verse: Nana Atasɛsɛse lili bia ne, ye afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne anu, bosome bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Nisan ne anu, ɛlɛho bie, né nzaa gyi Nana nyunu, na nzuli ye. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Nana Atasɛsɛse onnwuni kyɛ me wora abɔ wɔ ye nyunu le.

english_verse: So the king said, “Why do you look so sad? You're not sick. Something must be bothering you.” Even though I was frightened,
translation_verse: Yiti Nana bisale me kyɛ, “Ɛte apɔ, nakoso nzu ati yeɛ wɔ nyunu ayɛ bosaa ye? Ɛhe de nna hwee ɔ, wɔ wora mmom yeɛ wabɔ ɔ.” Na ɛhe mane ɛserɛ hane me paa.

english_verse: I answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever! I feel sad because the city where my ancestors are buried is in ruins, and its gates have been burned down.”
translation_verse: Na nzele Nana kyɛ, “Nana, wɔ ngoa so oo! Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ me wora ngɔbɔ ɔ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ kuro bɔ me nana mɔ asieleɛ wɔ so ne, wabɔ bɔ bafa see bayera ye pambim mɔ ɔ?”

english_verse: The king asked, “What do you want me to do?” I prayed to the God who rules from heaven.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana bisale me kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛpena kyɛ meyɔ mema wɔ ɔ?” Yiti mmɔle mbaeɛ ngyirele nyameɛso Nyameɛ bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne.

english_verse: Then I told the king, “Sir, if it's all right with you, please send me back to Judah, so that I can rebuild the city where my ancestors are buried.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ mmuale Nana kyɛ, “Nana, sɛ ɛpene so, ná anya alo wɔ somvoɛ de a, ye de mesrɛ kyɛ ma me ate maa ngɔ Yuda, kuro bɔ me nana mɔ b’asieleɛ wɔ so ne aso, ná nza ngɔngyekye kuro ne.”

english_verse: The queen was sitting beside the king when he asked me, “How long will it take, and when will you be back?” The king agreed to let me go, and I told him when I would return.
translation_verse: Na Nana Atasɛsɛse bisale me kyɛ , “Ekoli ɛlɛnyɛɛ, ná kyinzu yeɛ ekosa kɔwa ɔ?” Yiti Nana Atasɛsɛse mane me ate, na nhyɛle kyẽa bɔ ngosa ngɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: Then I asked, “Your Majesty, would you be willing to give me letters to the governors of the provinces west of the Euphrates River, so that I can travel safely to Judah?
translation_verse: Yeɛ nzele Nana Atasɛsɛse kyɛ, “Nana, sɛ ɛpene so a, maa bɛhyerɛ ngrataa maa ngɔmva mma Asue si dɔ mbɔtam amrado nemɔ, maa bɛma me ate maa mbɛ nu ngɔ kɔpem kyɛ ngodwu Yuda ɔ.

english_verse: I will need timber to rebuild the gates of the fortress near the temple and more timber to construct the city wall and to build a place for me to live. And so, I would appreciate a letter to Asaph, who is in charge of the royal forest.” God was good to me, and the king did everything I asked.
translation_verse: Afei, Nana, kyerɛ krataa maa ngɔma Asafe bɔ ɔnea wɔ ɛhɔayeɛ ne aso ne, kyɛ ɔma me mmakaa maa mva nyɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua abandenden pambim mbuna nemɔ, kuro berɛ fasue pambim nemɔ ɔne awuro bɔ mekwaatena nu ne anoa nemɔ.” Na nningyein bɔ nzrɛle ne, Nana Atasɛsɛse fa mane me, ofikyɛ né me Nyameɛ bɔ ɔdo sona ne, né ogyi me si.

english_verse: The king sent some army officers and cavalry troops along with me, and as I traveled through the Western Provinces, I gave the letters to the governors.
translation_verse: Yeɛ amrado mɔ bɔ bɛnea asue ne asi dɔ mbɔtam nemɔ aso ne, ngondwuli bɛ berɛ, na mvale Nana ngrataa nemɔ mmane bɛ. Né Nana Atasɛsɛse watu koɛhonɛfoɛ mbanyi ne pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ kyɛ bɛboka me so bɛ ne me bra.

english_verse: But when Sanballat from Horon and Tobiah the Ammonite official heard about what had happened, they became very angry, because they didn't want anyone to help the people of Israel. Nehemiah Inspects the Wall of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Nakoso Horonniɛ Sanbalate ne Amonniɛ Tobia bɔ ɔte somvoɛ ne, bɛtele bɔ ɔkɔ so ne, ɔyɛle bɛ yea paa kyɛ ebie awa bɔ ɔbaapena Yisraelfoɛ bɛ yeeyɛlɛ ɔ. Nehemia kɔneanea Yerusalem fasue nemɔ

english_verse: Three days after arriving in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Yiti mmandwuli Yerusalem, na nnili berɛ ɛlɛsa.

english_verse: I got up during the night and left my house. I took some men with me, without telling anyone what I thought God wanted me to do for the city. The only animal I took was the donkey I rode on.
translation_verse: Ɛhe asi ye, ndwɔsole kɔngɔen. Né mmenia kãa bie yeɛ bɛboka me so ɔ. Na nikyee bɔ Nyameɛ akanyane me kyɛ nyɔ ma Yerusalem ne, mangã mangyire ebiala. Né kaka biala ɔbboka me so, sana kaka bɔ nde ye so ne ala.

english_verse: I went through Valley Gate on the west, then south past Dragon Spring, before coming to Garbage Gate. As I rode along, I took a good look at the crumbled walls of the city and the gates that had been torn down and burned.
translation_verse: Nzili nu kɔngɔen mvale Bɔnza Pambim ne anu ndrale Sasrabɔnzam mbombonzue ne anwo ngɔle Fofoɛ Pambim ne anwo, na ngɔneane Yerusalem fasue mɔ bɔ badwiri bɛ bagua ase, ɔne ye pambim mɔ bɔ bafa see bayerayera bɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: On the east side of the city, I headed north to Fountain Gate and King's Pool, but then the trail became too narrow for my donkey.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ndoale so ngɔle Abura Pambim ne anwo ne Ɛhene Ɛkwaa ne anwo, na kaka bɔ nde so ne wanya nekaa fee wamva.

english_verse: So I went down to Kidron Valley and looked at the wall from there. Then before daylight I returned to the city through Valley Gate.
translation_verse: Yiti mvo mvale bɔnza ne anwo kɔngɔen ngɔneaneane fasue ne. Afei ngakyili me nwo mmamvale Bɔnza Pambim ne anu, na nzale me si.

english_verse: None of the city officials knew what I had in mind. And I had not even told any of the Jews—not the priests, the leaders, the officials, or any other Jews who would be helping in the work.
translation_verse: Né mbanyi nemɔ, bɛnze nekaa bɔ ngɔle ɔ, yeɛ bɛnze nikyee bɔ ngɔnyɔle ɔ. Yudafoɛ, asɔfo nemɔ, atitirefoɛ nemɔ, mbanyi nemɔ, bɛ ne mmenia ngaa nemɔ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛyɔ adwuma ne, né nya mmɔle bɛ amaneɛ.

english_verse: But when I got back, I said to them, “Jerusalem is truly in a mess! The gates have been torn down and burned, and everything is in ruins. We must rebuild the city wall so that we can again take pride in our city.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ nga ngyirele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔanwu edwirɛ bɔ wato yɛ ye: kyɛbɔ Yerusalem wakakyi kurofoen, bɔ ye pambim nemɔ koso bato nu see ɔ. Ɛ́mɔdwɔso maa yɛsa yɛkyekye Yerusalem fasue ne, amaa yɛ nyunu wangɔ so wangua ase.”

english_verse: Then I told them how kind God had been and what the king had said. Immediately, they replied, “Let's start building now!” So they got everything ready.
translation_verse: Ngane kyɛbɔ me Nyameɛ walo me wagyina me si, ɔne edwirɛ bɔ Nana Atasɛsɛse wahã wahyire mene ngyirele bɛ. Na bɛhane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma yɛdwɔso yɛsi!” Yiti bɛfale bɛ nwo belele sɔ adwuma paa ne anu.

english_verse: When Sanballat, Tobiah, and Geshem the Arab heard about our plans, they started insulting us and saying, “Just look at you! Do you plan to rebuild the walls of the city and rebel against the king?”
translation_verse: Nakoso Horonniɛ Sanbalate, Amonniɛ Tobia bɔ ɔte somvoɛ ne, yeɛ Araboniɛ Gesem bɛtele bɔ ɔkɔ so nen, bɛserele yɛ bɛgorole yɛ nwo kyɛ, “Na nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkyire ye? Ɛmɔyɛ Nana nwo lɔen anaa?”

english_verse: I answered, “We are servants of the God who rules from heaven, and he will make our work succeed. So we will start rebuilding Jerusalem, but you have no right to any of its property, because you have had no part in its history.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ mmuale bɛ kyɛ, “Nyameɛso Nyameɛ, ye yeɛ ɔkɔmaa yɛkoli ngonim ɔ. Yɛte ye ngoaa mɔ, na yɛkodwɔso yɛkosi. Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔlle kyɛfa anaa agyapadeɛ anaa ngayeɛ biala wɔ Yerusalem nu.”

english_verse: These are the people who helped rebuild the wall and gates of Jerusalem: The high priest Eliashib and the other priests rebuilt Sheep Gate and hung its doors. Then they dedicated Sheep Gate and the section of the wall as far as Hundred Tower and Hananel Tower.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo panyi paa Eliasibo ɔne ye mmango asɔfo nemɔ, bɛhyɛle ye bo bɛyɔle adwuma, na besili Mmoaen Pambim ne. Bɛtele Mmoaen Pambim ne anwo bɛyɛle ye krongron, na betuatuale ye anoa nemɔ. Bɛtele ye nwo alaa beedwuli Mmenia Ɛyaa Abandenden ne anwo ɔne Hananel abandenden ne anwo.

english_verse: The people of Jericho rebuilt the next section of the wall, and Zaccur son of Imri rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Na Yerikofoɛ nemɔ besi bɛtoale ye deɛ ne aso. Yeɛ Yimri awa Sakure sili fasue ne toale bɛ deɛ ne aso.

english_verse: The family of Hassenaah built Fish Gate. They put the beams in place and hung the doors, then they added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Hasenaa mma mmienzua nemɔ, besili Tire Pambim ne. Begyinagyinane ye mbuna nemɔ, betuatuale ye anoa nemɔ, na bɛfale mberɛgoo bemiamiane mmuralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram ye si ne anu.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, completed the next section of the wall. Meshullam, son of Berechiah and grandson of Meshezabel, rebuilt the next section, and Zadok son of Baana rebuilt the section beside that.
translation_verse: Hakose awa Yuriya ɔwa Meremote toale bɛ so yɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ne bie yé. Mesesabɛl ɔwa Berekia awa Mesulam koso toale so yɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ne bie yé. Baana awa Sadoke toale so yɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ne bie yé.

english_verse: The next section was to be repaired by the men of Tekoa, but their town leaders refused to do the hard work they were assigned.
translation_verse: Tekoafoɛ nemɔ, bɛtoale so bɛyɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ne bie yé, nakoso bɛ mmenia titire nemɔ de, adwuma bɔ bɛ mene nemɔ hyirele bɛ ne, bamva bɛ sa banzɔ nu bie.

english_verse: Joiada son of Paseah and Meshullam son of Besodeiah restored Ancient Gate. They put the beams in place, hung the doors, and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Pasea awa Yowada ne Besodeya awa Mesulam bɛyɔle Pambim Daa ne yé. Begyinagyinane ye mbuna nemɔ, betuatuale ye anoa nemɔ, na bɛfale mberɛgoo bemiamiane mmuralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram ye si ne anu.

english_verse: Melatiah from Gibeon, Jadon from Meronoth, and the men from Gibeon and Mizpah rebuilt the next section of the wall. This section reached as far as the house of the governor of West Euphrates Province.
translation_verse: Gibeonniɛ Melatia ne Merononiɛ Yadon, yeɛ Gibeonfoɛ ne Misepafoɛ bɔ bɛte mmenia bɔ bewura asue ne asi dɔ amrado ne abo ne, bɛtoale bɛ so bɛyɔle nekaa biemɔ bɔ né basɛkye ɔ yé.

english_verse: Uzziel son of Harhaiah the goldsmith rebuilt the next section. Hananiah the perfume maker rebuilt the section next after that, and it went as far as Broad Wall.
translation_verse: Hahayia awa Yusiɛl bɔ ɔte esikaa kɔkorɛ dwumvoɛ nemɔ ko ne, ɔtoale bɛ so yɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ɔ ne bie yé. Hanania bɔ ɔte bɛ bɔ bɛfrafra sakyeɛfona nemɔ bɛ nu ko ne, ɔtoale bɛ so yɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ɔ ne bie yé, na besa bɛkyekyele Yerusalem beedwuli Fasue Tɛtrɛtɛɛ ne.

english_verse: Rephaiah son of Hur ruled half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Hure awa Refaya bɔ ɔte Yerusalem manzini ne bue so amrado ne, ɔtoale bɛ so yɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ɔ ne bie yé.

english_verse: The section after that was close to the home of Jedaiah son of Harumaph, and he rebuilt it. Hattush son of Hashabneiah constructed the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Harumafo awa Yedaya, nekaa bɔ wasɛkye bɔ ɔwɔ ye awuro ne ndendeneɛ so ne, ɔyɔle ye yé, na Hasabeneya awa Hatuse toale ye so yɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ɔ ne bie yé.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Harim and Hasshub son of Pahath Moab rebuilt the section after that, and they also built Oven Tower.
translation_verse: Harim awa Malkiya ne Pahate Moabo awa Hasubo yɔle fasue ne nekaa foforɛ bɔ wasɛkye ɔ, ɔne Foonoo Abandenden ne yé.

english_verse: Shallum son of Hallohesh ruled the other half of the Jerusalem District, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. Shallum's daughters also worked with him.
translation_verse: Halohese bɔ ɔte Yerusalem manzini ne bue so amrado ne, ɔwa Salum ne Salum mma mmrasua mɔ, bɛtoale so bɛyɔle nekaa bɔ wasɛkye ne bie yé.

english_verse: Hanun and the people who lived in the town of Zanoah rebuilt Valley Gate. They hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. They also rebuilt the wall for
translation_verse: Hanun ne Sanoafoɛ bɛyɔle Bɔnza Pambim ne yé. Besa besili na betuatuale ye anoa nemɔ, na bɛfale mberɛgoo bemiamiane mmuralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram ye si ne anu. Fasue ne, nekaa bɔ bɛyɔle ye yé maa oodwuli Fofoɛ Pambim ne, ye tendenn te agyirɛ apee ko.

english_verse: Malchijah son of Rechab ruled the district of Beth-Haccherem, and he rebuilt Garbage Gate. He hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks.
translation_verse: Na Malkiya bɔ ye baba ole Bete Hakerem manzini Rekabo amrado ne, ɔyɔle Fofoɛ Pambim ne yé. Osa sili na otuatuale ye anoa nemɔ, na ɔfale mberɛgoo omiamiane mmuralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram ye si ne anu.

english_verse: Shallum son of Colhozeh ruled the district of Mizpah, and he rebuilt Fountain Gate. He put a cover over the gateway, then hung the doors and added metal bolts and wooden beams as locks. He also rebuilt the wall at Shelah Pool. This section was next to the king's garden and went as far as the stairs leading down from David's City.
translation_verse: Na Salum bɔ ye baba ole Misepa manzini amrado Kolhose ne, ɔyɔle Mbombonzue Pambim ne, osa sili, ɔkatale so, na otuatuale ye anoa nemɔ, na bɛfale mberɛgoo bemiamiane mmuralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram ye si ne anu. Na Sela Ɛkwaa fasue bɔ ɔwɔ Nana ye turo ne anu ne, osili alaa oodwuli atweleɛ bɔ ɔtoro kɔ Dawide kuro ne anu nwo.

english_verse: Nehemiah son of Azbuk ruled half of the district of Beth-Zur, and he rebuilt the next section of the wall. It went as far as the royal cemetery, the artificial pool, and the army barracks. Levites Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Nehemia bɔ ye baba ole Bete Sure manzini ne bue so amrado Azebuke ne, ɔtoale Salum deɛ ne aso. Nekaa bie bɔ ɔwɔ Dawide ɛbaa nu berɛ ndendeneɛ so ne, ɔyɔle ye yé, maa oodwuli ɛkwaa bɔ bahyɛ da bapɛ ne, ɔne koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ b’awuro ne ndendeneɛ so.

english_verse: The Levites who worked on the next sections of the wall were Rehum son of Bani; Hashabiah, who ruled half of the district of Keilah and did this work for his district;
translation_verse: Lewifoɛ nemɔ toale ye so bɛyoyɔle nekaa biemɔ yé: Bani awa Rehum koso toale Hasabia bɔ ɔte Keila manzini ne bue so safohene ne aso. Ɔtoale so yɔle nekaa biemɔ bɔ basɛkye wɔ ye manzini ne anu ne yé.

english_verse: Ezer son of Jeshua, who ruled Mizpah, rebuilt the section of the wall that was in front of the armory and reached to the corner of the wall;
translation_verse: Yesua bɔ ɔnea Misepa kuro ne aso ne, ɔwa Esere ɔtoale Bawayi deɛ ne aso. Nekaa foforɛ bie bɔ ɔwɔ pambaa bɔ besie akodeɛ wɔ so ne ndendeneɛ so ne, ɔyɔle ye yé.

english_verse: Baruch son of Zabbai eagerly rebuilt the section of the wall that went all the way to the door of the house of Eliashib the high priest;
translation_verse: Sabae awa Baruku yɔle fasue ne nekaa bie bɔ ofi Ndweasoɛ ne aso bɔ ɔkwaadwu ɔsɔfo panyi Eliasibo awuro ne anoa ne yé.

english_verse: Meremoth, son of Uriah and grandson of Hakkoz, built up to the far end of Eliashib's house. Priests Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: Hakose awa Yuriya ɔwa Meremote, ɔyɔle fasue ne nekaa bie fite Eliasibo awuro ne anoa maa oodwuli Eliasibo awuro ne ye ti dɔ paa.

english_verse: Here is a list of the priests who worked on the wall: Priests from the region around Jerusalem rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Asɔfo nemɔ bɔ bɛwɔ mbɔtam berɛ ne, bɛtoale Hakose deɛ ne aso bɛyɔle fasue ne yé.

english_verse: Benjamin and Hasshub rebuilt the wall in front of their own houses. Azariah, who was the son of Maaseiah and the grandson of Ananiah, rebuilt the section in front of his house.
translation_verse: Benyamin ne Hasubo bɛtoale bɛ deɛ ne aso bɛyɔle fasue ne nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ b’awuro ne ndendeneɛ so ne yé. Na Anania awa Maaseya ɔwa Asaria toale bɛ deɛ ne aso ɔyɔle nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ ye bɔbɔ ye awuro ne anwo ne yé.

english_verse: Binnui son of Henadad rebuilt the section of the wall from Azariah's house to the corner of the wall.
translation_verse: Henadade awa Binuyi toale ye deɛ ne aso yɔle fasue ne yé, fi Asaria awuro berɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ndweasoɛ ne ɔne ahameɛ dɔ ne.

english_verse: Palal son of Uzai rebuilt the next section, which began at the corner of the wall and the tower of the upper palace near the court of the guard. Pedaiah son of Parosh rebuilt the next section of the wall.
translation_verse: Ndweasoɛ ne abandenden bɔ ogyi ahemvie aborɔsaen so bɔ opingye kuku nu aluo berɛ ne, ye ndendeneɛ so, Yusae awa Palal yɔle berɛ fasue ne yé. Parose awa Pedaya toale ye deɛ ne aso;

english_verse: He stopped at a place near the Water Gate on the east and the tower guarding the temple. This was close to a section in the city called Ophel, where the temple workers lived. Other Builders Who Worked on the Wall
translation_verse: ɔne asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛte Ofel, bɛtoale so bɛyɔle fasue ne yé beedwuli Nzue Pambim bɔ ɔwɔ eyia afiteleɛ so ne ɔne abandenden bɔ ogyi sua ne aso ne, bɛ ndendeneɛ so.

english_verse: The men from Tekoa rebuilt the next section of the wall, and it was their second section. It started at a place across from the large tower that guarded the Temple, and it went all the way to the wall near Ophel.
translation_verse: Tekoafoɛ mɔ bɛtoale ye deɛ ne aso bɛyɔle fasue ne yé wɔ abandenden piri ne ndendeneɛ so maa oodwuli Ofel fasue ne.

english_verse: Some priests rebuilt the next section of the wall. They began working north of Horse Gate, and each one worked on a section in front of his own house.
translation_verse: Pɔngɔ Pambim ne anwuro dɔ, asɔfo nemɔ yɔle fasue ne yé, na ebiala yɔle nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ ye bɔbɔ ye awuro ndendeneɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: Zadok son of Immer rebuilt the wall in front of his house. Shemaiah son of Shecaniah, who looked after the East Gate, rebuilt the section after that.
translation_verse: Yimere awa Sadoke yɔle fasue ne yé wɔ nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ ye bɔbɔ ye awuro ne ndendeneɛ so ɔ. Sekania awa Semaya bɔ ɔnea Eyia Afiteleɛ Pambim ne aso ne, ɔyɔle fasue ne yé toale Sadoke deɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Hananiah and Hanun rebuilt the next section, which was the second section for them. Meshullam son of Berechiah rebuilt the next section, which happened to be in front of his house.
translation_verse: Selemia awa Hanania ne Hanun bɔ ɔte Salafe awa bienzua bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ne, bɛtoale ye deɛ ne aso bɛyɔle fasue ne yé. Berekia awa Mesulam ɔyɔle fasue ne nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ ye pumbu ndendeneɛ so ne yé.

english_verse: Malchijah, a goldsmith, rebuilt the next section, as far as the house used by the temple workers and merchants. This area was across from Gathering Gate, near the room on top of the wall at the northeast corner.
translation_verse: Malkiya bɔ ɔte esikaa kɔkorɛ dwumvoɛ nemɔ anu ko ne, ɔtoale Mesulam deɛ ne aso. Ɔyɔle pambim ne yé alaa odwuli asɔneyɛɛ sua somvoɛ ne dwadifoɛ mɔ awuro wɔ Dwaabɔlɛ Pambim ne ndendeneɛ so, kɔpem ndweasoɛ so aborɔsaen pumbu ne.

english_verse: The goldsmiths and merchants rebuilt the last section of the wall, which went from the corner room all the way to Sheep Gate.
translation_verse: Ndweasoɛ so aborɔsaen so pumbu bɔ ɔkwaadwu Mmoaen Pambim ne, esikaa kɔkorɛ dwumvoɛ ne dwadifoɛ yeɛ bɛyɔle berɛ fasue ne yé ɔ.

english_verse: When Sanballat, the governor of Samaria, heard that we were rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem, he became angry and started insulting our people.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Sanbalate tele kyɛ yɛsi fasue ne, ye ahone huli, na ɔfɛle yaa paa. Ɔhane Yudafoɛ nemɔ anyinga,

english_verse: In front of his friends and the Samaritan army he said, “What is this feeble bunch of Jews trying to do? Are they going to rebuild the wall and offer sacrifices all in one day? Do they think they can make something out of this pile of scorched stones?”
translation_verse: na ɔhane wɔ ye mmango nemɔ ɔne Samaria koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ anyunu kyɛ, “Yudafoɛ bɔ bɛ nwo anwumvoin hemɔ, nzikyɛ yeɛ bɛyɔ ye? Aso bekosa bɛkɔtoto nningyein ye anaa? Aso bɛkɔbɔ afɔleɛ anaa? Aso bekoyie adwuma ye ɛlɛho? Nyɔboɛ bɔ wadwiri wagua wahonhɔn wahɔ anwuro bɔ see ayera ye ye, aso bekonya nyɔboɛ bekofi nu?”

english_verse: Tobiah from Ammon was standing beside Sanballat and said, “Look at the wall they are building! Why, even a fox could knock over this pile of stones.”
translation_verse: Né Amonniɛ Tobia gyi Sanbalate nwo berɛ, na osele kyɛ, “Nyɔboɛ fasue bɔ besi ye, sɛ safuboa po fo so a, okodwiri kogua ase!”

english_verse: But I prayed, “Our God, these people hate us and have wished horrible things for us. Please answer our prayers and make their insults fall on them! Let them be the ones to be dragged away as prisoners of war.
translation_verse: , “Yɛ Nyameɛ, tie, ofikyɛ bemmu yɛ kyɛ yɛte mmenia po. B’anyinga bɔ bɛkã yɛ ne, maa ɔbɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti so, na maa ebiemɔ bɛfa bɛ kyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ bɛhye bɛ nnure bɛhɔ maen foforɛ aso.

english_verse: Don't forgive the mean and evil way they have insulted the builders.”
translation_verse: Nnebu wɔ nye gua b’amumuyɛɛ so. Nnɛma bɛ bɔne kyikyi fi wɔ nyunu, ofikyɛ bagyina suasilɛfoɛ nemɔ nyunu bawura wɔ apue maa afɛ yaa.”

english_verse: But Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabs, the Ammonites, and the people from the city of Ashdod saw the walls going up and the holes being repaired. So they became angry
translation_verse: Nakoso Sanbalate ne Tobia yeɛ Arabofoɛ, Amonfoɛ ne Asedɔdefoɛ bɛtele kyɛ Yerusalem fasue ne silɛ ɔkɔ so, ná yahyɛ ye bo yɛtuatua nu ndokuro nen, bɛfɛle yaa paa,

english_verse: and decided to stir up trouble, and to fight against the people of Jerusalem.
