translation_verse: na bɛ mukoraa bɛbɔle porɛ kyɛ bɛkwaafa koɛ bɛteta Yerusalem ná bɛyɛ basabasa wɔ kuro ne anu.

english_verse: But we kept on praying to our God, and we also stationed guards day and night.
translation_verse: Yiti yɛbɔle mbaeɛ yɛhyirele yɛ Nyameɛ, na yɛyele awɛmvoɛ kyɛ bɛbɔ yɛ nwo waen befi bɛ sa nu eyia ne kɔngɔen.

english_verse: Meanwhile, the people of Judah were singing a sorrowful song: “So much rubble for us to haul! Worn out and weary, will we ever finish this wall?”
translation_verse: Nakoso Yudafoɛ sele kyɛ, “Bɛ bɔ bɛsesa kungumaboɔ ne befi berɛ ne, b’anwoserɛ so ate, na kungumaboɔ ne somaa ti, yɛngora yɛnyɔ fasue ne nwo adwuma.”

english_verse: Our enemies were saying, “Before those Jews know what has happened, we will sneak up and kill them and put an end to their work.”
translation_verse: Na yɛ pɔfoɛ nemɔ hane kyɛ, “Bɛ nye kɔwa bɛ nwo so ne, né yahɔ bɛ so yahũhũ bɛ maa adwuma ne bo apɛ.”

english_verse: On at least ten different occasions, the Jews living near our enemies warned us against attacks from every side,
translation_verse: Yudafoɛ bɔ bɛte bepingye pɔfoɛ nemɔ ne, bɛwale bɛɛbɔle yɛ amaneɛ pɛen buru kyɛ, “Bekofi nekaa bɔ bɛtete ne amukoraa bɛkɔfa koɛ bɛkɔɔtoa yɛ.”

english_verse: and so I sent people to guard the wall at its lowest places and where there were still holes in it. I placed them according to families, and they stood guard with swords and spears and with bows and arrows.
translation_verse: Yiti fasue ne nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ ase ne, ye si dɔ, nekaa bɔ ndokuro lela nu ne, mmane mmenia beegyinane dɔ mmusua mmusua bɔ né betiratira bɛ ngrandɛ, bɛ pealɛɛ ne b’agyaen ɔ.

english_verse: Then I looked things over and told the leaders, the officials, and the rest of the people, “Don't be afraid of your enemies! The Lord is great and fearsome. So think of him and fight for your relatives and children, your wives and homes!”
translation_verse: Na nneane bɔ ɔkɔ so ne, ndwɔsole nga ngyirele atitire nemɔ, mbanyi nemɔ ne maen ne ngaa ne kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro bɛ. Ɛ́mɔkaye AWURADE bɔ ɔte piri bɔ ye nwo yɛ suro ne, ná ɛ́mɔho bɛpepɛ bele ɛmɔ abusuafoɛ, ɛmɔ mma mmienzua, ɛmɔ mma mmrasua, ɛmɔ aye mɔ ɔne ɛmɔ awuro ama.”

english_verse: Our enemies found out that we knew about their plot against us, but God kept them from doing what they had planned. So we went back to work on the wall.
translation_verse: Na yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ tele kyɛ yate bɛ porɛ bɔ babɔ ne, na afei Nyameɛ ama bɛ nzusuleɛ ayɛ mbaen ne, yɛ mukoraa yɛsa yɛhɔle fasue ne anwo, na ebiala ɔɔtoale ye adwuma so.

english_verse: From then on, I let half of the young men work while the other half stood guard. They wore armor and had spears and shields, as well as bows and arrows. The leaders helped the workers
translation_verse: Ofi sɔ kyẽa ne, me somvoɛ nemɔ, bɛ bue bɛyɔle fasuesilɛ adwuma ne, yeɛ bɛ bue koso betiratirale pealɛɛ, akokyɛm, agyaen ne akodeɛ mɔ, na mbanyi nemɔ beegyinagyinane Yuda awuro ama amukoraa bɛ si.

english_verse: who were rebuilding the wall. Everyone who hauled building materials kept one hand free to carry a weapon.
translation_verse: Sɔ Yudafoɛ nemɔ yeɛ né besi fasue ne ɔ. Bɛ bɔ né bɛsoasoa ne, sɔa yeɛ bɛyɔle adwuma ne ɔ: bɛ nu biala fale ye sa ko yɔle adwuma, yeɛ ɔfale ko koso tirale akodeɛ nu.

english_verse: Even the workers who were rebuilding the wall strapped on a sword. The worker who was to blow the signal trumpet stayed with me.
translation_verse: Adwumayɔlɛfoɛ ne, begu so besi sua nen, né ebiala wafa ye ngrandɛ wasi. Biaa bɔ ohu totorobɛndo ne, né ogyi me nwo berɛ.

english_verse: I told the people and their officials and leaders, “Our work is so spread out, that we are a long way from one another.
translation_verse: Na nga ngyirele atitire nemɔ, mbanyi nemɔ ne maen ne ngaa ne kyɛ, “Adwuma ne te piri, na ɔtrɛ paa, na yɛ koso yɛmbingyembingye yɛ nwo wɔ fasue ne anwo; yɛ nu atete.

english_verse: If you hear the sound of the trumpet, come quickly and gather around me. Our God will help us fight.”
translation_verse: Yiti nekaa biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔte totorobɛndo nga ne, ɛmɔhã bɛ nwo bɛbra yɛ nwo berɛ. Yɛ Nyameɛ kɔho kɔma yɛ.”

english_verse: Every day from dawn to dark, half of the workers rebuilt the walls, while the rest stood guard with their spears.
translation_verse: Yiti yɛyerele yɛ nwo yɛyɔle adwuma ne, na yɛ nu bue betiratirale pealɛɛ fi alebahyene maa oodwuli mmerɛ bɔ nzramaa fite ɔ.

english_verse: I asked the men in charge and their workers to stay inside Jerusalem and stand guard at night. So they guarded the city at night and worked during the day.
translation_verse: Afei koso sɔ mmerɛ ne, nga ngyirele maen ne kyɛ, “Odi kyɛ bienzua biala ne ye somvoɛ bɛda Yerusalem kɔngɔen biala, amaa bawɛne yɛ kɔngɔen, ná bayɔ adwuma eyia.”

english_verse: I even slept in my work clothes at night; my relatives, the workers, and the guards slept in theirs as well. And we always kept our weapons close by.
translation_verse: Yiti me oo, nniɛma nemɔ oo, me somvoɛ nemɔ oo, awɛmvoɛ bɔ beli me si nemɔ oo, yɛ nu biala wanye ye ndaadeɛ wangua berɛ le. Na ebiala fale ye akodeɛ tirale.

english_verse: and said, “We have large families, and it takes a lot of grain merely to keep us alive.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛ nu biemɔ hane kyɛ, “Yɛ ne yɛ mma mmienzua ne yɛ mma mmrasua, yɛsone. Odi kyɛ yɛnya aleɛ yɛdi ná yanya ngoa.”

english_verse: Others said, “During the famine we even had to mortgage our fields, vineyards, and homes to them in order to buy grain.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ bɛ nu biemɔ koso hane kyɛ, “Ɔnate ɛhɔen kandinga ne ati, yafa yɛ boo mɔ, yɛ bobe boo mɔ, yeɛ y’awuro mɔ yasi awowaa yapena yɛ noa aleɛ.”

english_verse: Then others said, “We had to borrow money from those in power to pay the government tax on our fields and vineyards.
translation_verse: Na né ebiemɔ koso bɛkekã kyɛ, “Ɛtoɔ bɔ odi kyɛ yɛtua yɛma Nana wɔ y’aseɛ ne yɛ bobe boo nwo ne, ɔyɛ a yɛbɔ bosea koraka né yatua.

english_verse: We are Jews just as they are, and our children are as good as theirs. But we still have to sell our children as slaves, and some of our daughters have already been raped. We are completely helpless; our fields and vineyards have even been taken from us.”
translation_verse: Yɛne y’eliɛma Yudafoɛ ne, yɛ mukoraa yɛte sona ko. Yɛ mma te kyɛ bɛ mma deɛ mɔ ala. Nakoso yɛhyɛ yɛ mma mmienzua ne yɛ mma mmrasua mɔ maa bɛyɛ nganga, na yɛ mma mmrasua nemɔ bie de yali moa yatɔne bɛ. Yɛyɔ ye nwo hwee a ɔnyɛ ye, yeɛ y’aseɛ ne yɛ bobe boo mɔ ayɛ ebiemɔ deɛ.”

english_verse: When I heard their complaints and their charges, I became very angry.
translation_verse: Ndele bɛ kwaadu ne sɔ dwirɛ bɔ ɔha bɛ ne, mvɛle yaa paa.

english_verse: So I thought it over and said to the leaders and officials, “How can you charge your own people interest?” Then I called a public meeting and accused the leaders
translation_verse: Na ndwene ye nwo alaa nen, mmɔle atitire ne mbanyi nemɔ kwaadu nzele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔde nzihoɛ befi ɛmɔ bɔbɔ deinn ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ berɛ!” Na mmɔle dwaa kandinga kyɛ mene bɛ koli,

english_verse: by saying, “We have tried to buy back all of our people who were sold into exile. But here you are, selling more of them for us to buy back!” The officials and leaders did not say a word, because they knew this was true.
translation_verse: na nzele bɛ kyɛ, “Y’eliɛma Yudafoɛ bɔ batɔne bɛ bama Amaenmaensofoɛ mɔ ne, yabɔ mmɔden bɔ yɛkɔhora biala yapɔ bɛ. Nakoso afei de ɛmɔtɔne ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔ aliɛma Yudafoɛ bɛma Yudafoɛ maa yɛsa yɛkɔpɔ bɛ!” Bɛyɛle konn, na né bennwu dwirɛ bɔ bɛhã ɔ.

english_verse: I continued, “What you have done is wrong! We must honor our God by the way we live, so the Gentiles can't find fault with us.
translation_verse: Yiti ngane kyɛ, “Nikyee bɔ ɛmɔyɔ ne, ɔtte mayee. Aso onni kyɛ ɛmɔsuro yɛ Nyameɛ, amaa ɔnate so maen maen mɔ bɔ bɛte yɛ pɔfoɛ ne, bangoro yɛ nwo ɔ?

english_verse: My relatives, my friends, and I are also lending money and grain, but we must no longer demand payment in return.
translation_verse: Afei koso, mene nniɛma mɔ ne me somvoɛ mɔ yɛma bɛ esikaa ne aleɛ. Ɛ́mɔma yɛyakyi nzihoɛlelɛ ne.

english_verse: Now give back the fields, vineyards, olive orchards, and houses you have taken and also the interest you have been paid.”
translation_verse: B’aseɛ mɔ, bɛ bobe boo mɔ, bɛ olive boo mɔ, b’awuro mɔ, bosea nwo nzihoɛ, aburoo, nzaa ne ngoo bɔ ɛmɔale bafi bɛ berɛ ne, ɛnɛ deinn ɛ́mɔsa bɛfa bɛma bɛ.”

english_verse: The leaders answered, “We will do whatever you say and return their property, without asking to be repaid.” So I made the leaders promise in front of the priests to give back the property.
translation_verse: Na bebuale kyɛ, “Yɛkosa yɛkɔfa sɔ nningyein nemɔ yɛkɔma bɛ. Yɛngole nzihoɛ ko, yeɛ yɛngɔma bɛngɔfa hwee bengosi awowaa ko. Yɛkɔyɔ kyɛbɔ ahã ne ala.” Yeɛ mvrɛle asɔfo nemɔ maa bɛtale ndaen bɛfoale bɔ bahyɛ bɔ kyɛ bɛkɔyɔ ne aso.

english_verse: Then I emptied my pockets and said, “If you don't keep your promise, that's what God will do to you. He will empty out everything you own, even taking away your houses.” The people answered, “We will keep our promise.” Then they praised the Lord and did as they had promised. Nehemiah Is Generous
translation_verse: Asa koso, esikaa abɔsoɛ bɔ ɔbɔ m’ataadeɛ ne anu ne, nye mboroporole nu. Na ngane kyɛ, “Ebiala bɔ wanni bɔhyɛ he aso ne, Nyameɛ ole ye sua ne ye agyapadeɛ ofi ye sa nu. Sɔaa yeɛ okole b’agyapadeɛ kofi bɛ sa nu maa bɛkɔbɔ hwea ɔ.” Yeɛ maen ne amukoraa sele kyɛ, “Yɛde yɛto nu”, na bɛyele AWURADE ayɛ. Na maen ne yɛle nikyee biala kyɛbɔ bahyɛ bɔ ne ala. Nehemia maen ne

english_verse: I was governor of Judah from the twentieth year that Artaxerxes was king until the thirty-second year. And during these entire twelve years, my relatives and I refused to accept the food that I was allowed.
translation_verse: Afei koso, ofi mmerɛ bɔ bɛfale me bɛyɛle Yuda aseɛ so amrado nen, ofi Nana Atasɛsɛse ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ bɔ ɔkwaadwu ye afoɛ aburasa ne nyɔ ne aso ne, sɔ afoɛ buru ne nyɔ ne, me oo, nniɛma nemɔ oo, yɛ nu biala wanne aleɛ ndɔ bɔ odi kyɛ mmenia bɛfa bɛma amrado ne.

english_verse: Each governor before me had been a burden to the people by making them pay for his food and wine and by demanding forty silver coins a day. Even their officials had been a burden to the people. But I respected God, and I didn't think it was right to be so hard on them.
translation_verse: Amrado mɔ bɔ belili me nyunu moa ne de, bɛfale anwokyere kandinga paa yeɛ bɛtole maen ne aso ɔ. Bedidele aleɛ ne nzaa befili mmenia ne berɛ, asora ɛdwetɛ sekel aburanna ne koso. Bɛ somvoɛ nemɔ po, bɛyɛle maen ne aso abakomasɛm. Nakoso me de, manyɔ sɔ, ofikyɛ mesuro Nyameɛ.

english_verse: I spent all my time getting the wall rebuilt and did not buy any property. Everyone working for me did the same thing.
translation_verse: Susu amba, nduli me nwo nziele berɛ mane fasue tolɛ adwuma ne, na mambena me ti anwo aseɛ biala. Me somvoɛ nemɔ amukoraa, mmaa bɛɛsɔle adwuma ne anu bie.

english_verse: Each day one ox, six of the best sheep, and lots of chickens were prepared. Then every ten days, a large supply of wine was brought in. I knew what a heavy burden this would have been for the people, and so I did not ask for my food allowance as governor.
translation_verse: Nandwie nyii ko ne mmoaen bɔ balɔ ɔ nzia yeɛ né mefa meyɛ aleɛ daa biala ɔ. Né beku ngokɔ bɛboka so, na eleburu biala, nzaa ahoroɔ ngomvo pee boka so. Nakoso manne amrado aleɛ ndɔ ne, ofikyɛ adesoa bɔ ɔla maen ne aso ne, né ɔte piri.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless me for everything I have done for my people.
translation_verse: Ao me Nyameɛ, kaye paa amukoraa bɔ mayɔ mama maen he ɔ.

english_verse: Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem, and our other enemies learned that I had completely rebuilt the wall. All I lacked was hanging the doors in the gates.
translation_verse: Na Sanbalate, Tobia, Araboniɛ Gesem ne pɔfoɛ ngaa nemɔ bɛtele kyɛ masi fasue ne mayie bɔ tokuro biala ɔnne ye neka fee ɔ .

english_verse: Then Sanballat and Geshem sent a message, asking me to meet with them in one of the villages in Ono Valley. I knew they were planning to harm me in some way.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Sanbalate ne Gesem bɛsomane maa beesele me kyɛ, “Bra maa yɛyia wɔ Ono aseɛ frɛtɛɛ so nguraa nemɔ ko anu.” Nakoso né babɔ me nwo porɛ tɛɛ.

english_verse: So I sent messengers to tell them, “My work is too important to stop now and go there. I can't afford to slow down the work just to visit with you.”
translation_verse: Yiti nduli ɛbɔfoɛ maa beesele bɛ kyɛ, “Meyɔ adwuma bɔ ohia paa ɔ, yiti mengɔhora ba. Nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ meyakyi adwuma ne megua berɛ na mene ɛmɔ bayia ɔ?”

english_verse: Finally, Sanballat sent an official to me with an unsealed letter,
translation_verse: Sanbalate sa somane ye somvoɛ wɔ me berɛ ye pɛen nnu so maa ɔfale krataa bɔ banda ye noa ɔ ɔbrɛle me.

english_verse: which said: A rumor is going around among the nations that you and the other Jews are rebuilding the wall and planning to rebel, because you want to be their king. And Geshem says it's true!
translation_verse: Krataa ne anu dwirɛ ole kyɛ, “Bɛkekã ye wɔ maen maen so, na Gesem koso wafa wato so, kyɛ ɛne Yudafoɛ ɛmɔbɔ porɛ kyɛ ɛmɔkɔyɛ lɔen. Ye sɔ ti yeɛ esi fasue nen. Amaneɛ bɔ baabɔ yɛ ne kyire kyɛ ɛpena kyɛ ɛyɛ bɛ so hene.

english_verse: You even have prophets in Jerusalem, claiming you are now the king of Judah. You know the Persian king will hear about this, so let's get together and talk it over.
translation_verse: Afei koso, aye ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ kyɛ bɛhyɛ wɔ nwo ngɔm wɔ Yerusalem kyɛ, ‘Yuda anya ɛhene oo!’ Kaye kyɛ bɛkɔfa sɔ dwirɛ he bɛkɔɔbɔ Nana amaneɛ. Yiti bra ma yɛdwene ye nwo.”

english_verse: I sent a message back to Sanballat, saying, “None of this is true! You are making it all up.”
translation_verse: Na mvale mmuayɛɛ ngɔmane ye kyɛ, “Sɔ edwirɛ bɔ ɛkekã ye, nu biala ɔtte nahorɛ, ɛbɔ wɔ sɔ nu yeɛ ɛkã ɔ!”

english_verse: Our enemies were trying to frighten us and to keep us from our work. But I asked God to give me strength.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ né bɛ mukoraa bɛpena kyɛ benwunanwuna yɛ. Bɛdwene kyɛ, “Bɛkɔpa aba wɔ adwuma ne anwo, na bɛkɔyakyi ye yɔlɛ.” “Ao Nyameɛ, mesrɛ wɔ, ma me hue yɛ se.”

english_verse: One day I went to visit Shemaiah. He wasn't supposed to leave his house, but he said, “Let's hurry to the holy place of the temple and hide there. We will lock the temple doors, because your enemies are planning to kill you tonight.”
translation_verse: Ɛlɛho bie, Semaya bɔ ye baba ole Delaya bɔ ye baba ole Mehetabel bɔ né ɔngora omvi ye awuro mvite ne, ngɔle ye awuro. Semaya hane kyɛ, “Maa yɛyia wɔ Nyameɛ awuro asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, ná yɛtoto asɔneyɛɛ sua anoa nemɔ anu, ofikyɛ bɛbaahu wɔ. Ɛnɛ kɔngɔen bɛbaahu wɔ.”

english_verse: I answered, “Why should someone like me have to run and hide in the temple to save my life? I won't go!”
translation_verse: Nakoso mmuale kyɛ, “Mmenia bɔ bɛnwati bɛkɔfea ne, ebie ole me? Sona bɔ ɔte kyɛ me, aso odi kyɛ ɔnwati ɔkɔfea asɔneyɛɛ sua nu amaa onya ye ti odidi nu? Mengɔhɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu!”

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that God had not given Shemaiah this message. But Tobiah and Sanballat had paid him to trick me
translation_verse: Na nwuni kyɛ nna Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔsomane ye ɔ, na mmom ɔhyɛle sɔ ngɔm ne fale me nwo, ofikyɛ Tobia ne Sanbalate yeɛ bɛbɔle ye paa ɔ.

english_verse: and to frighten me into doing something wrong, because they wanted to ruin my good name.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati yeɛ bɛbɔle ye paa ɔ: kyɛ ɔma ɛserɛ hã me, na nyɔ sɔ bɔne ne, amaa ɔnate so male dumaa tɛɛ, ná banya me basere me.

english_verse: Then I asked God to punish Tobiah and Sanballat for what they had done. I prayed that God would punish the prophet Noadiah and the other prophets who, together with her, had tried to frighten me. The Work Is Finished
translation_verse: Ao me Nyameɛ, kaye Tobia ne Sanbalate kyɛbɔ bɛ yɔleɛ si te ɔ. Afei koso, kaye ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ brasua Noadia ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ngaa nemɔ bɔ bɛpena kyɛ ɛserɛ kã mene. Bɛto fasue ne beyie

english_verse: On the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, the wall was completely rebuilt. It had taken
translation_verse: Yiti yɛyiele fasue ne tolɛ bosome bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Elul ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne nnu ne aso. Yɛfale ngyẽa aburannu ne nyɔ yeɛ yɛtole ɔ.

english_verse: When our enemies in the surrounding nations learned that the work was finished, they felt helpless, because they knew that our God had helped us rebuild the wall.
translation_verse: Na yɛ pɔfoɛ nemɔ amukoraa bɛtele nen, maen maen amukoraa bɔ bapɛ yɛ nwo bayia ne, esuronyi tɔle bɛ so, na bɛ nyunu guale ase paa. Ofikyɛ benwuni kyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ waboka maa yayɔ sɔ adwuma he ɔ.

english_verse: All this time the Jewish leaders and Tobiah had been writing letters back and forth.
translation_verse: Afei koso, sɔ mmerɛ ne, Yuda atitire nemɔ fale ngrataa pee bɛɛmane Tobia, na Tobia koso hyerɛle bɛ ngrataa.

english_verse: Many people in Judah were loyal to Tobiah for two reasons: Shecaniah son of Arah was his father-in-law, and Tobiah's son Jehohanan had married the daughter of Meshullam son of Berechiah.
translation_verse: Né Yudafoɛ pee bata ndaen kyɛ bɛ ne Tobia kɔyɛ ko, ofikyɛ né Tobia ɔye ye baba ole Ara awa Sekania. Yeɛ né Tobia awa bienzua Yehohanan koso wagya Berekia awa Mesulam ɔwa brasua.

english_verse: The people would always tell me about the good things Tobiah had done, and then they would tell Tobiah everything I had said. So Tobiah kept sending letters, trying to frighten me.
translation_verse: Na belili Tobia nwo adanzeɛ paa behyirele me, yeɛ bɛɛhane edwirɛ bɔ ngane nemɔ behyirele ye. Na Tobia hyerɛle ngrataa oonwunanwunane me.

english_verse: Although Jerusalem covered a large area, not many people lived there, and no new houses had been built.
translation_verse: Né kuro ne ɔtrɛ, yeɛ ɔte piri, nakoso nu mmenia ne banzo, yeɛ afei né bennya bessisili sua mɔ wɔ nu. Yudafoɛ bɔ befili Babilɔn bɛwale ɔ (Ɛsra

translation_verse: Gibeon boso ama te aburahona ne nnu.

translation_verse: Besae, Meyunim, Nefusesim,

english_verse: This is a list of how many returned from the families of Levites:
translation_verse: Asɔneyɛɛ sua anoa awɛmvoɛ nemɔ bɛte mmenia hemɔ boso ama: Salum, Atɛ, Talmon, Akubo, Hatita, yeɛ Sobae. Bɛte ɛyaa ko aburasa ne mmɔtwɛ.

english_verse: The families of Hobaiah, Hakkoz, and Barzillai could not prove they were priests. The ancestor of the family of Barzillai had married the daughter of Barzillai from Gilead and had taken his wife's family name. But the records of these three families could not be found, and none of them were allowed to serve as priests.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia nemɔ penane bɛ dumaa wɔ mmusua ngrataa nemɔ anu, nakoso né bɛ dumaa nne nu. Ye sɔ ne ati, bebuli bɛ kyɛ bɛ nwo nde, na bɛyele bɛ befili sɔfolilɛ adwuma ne anu.

english_verse: In fact, the governor told them, “You cannot eat the food offered to God until he lets us know if you really are priests.”
translation_verse: Na amrado ne sele bɛ kyɛ nnɛmaa bedi aleɛ krongron paa ne bie, kɔpem kyɛ ɔsɔfo bie kɔfa Yurim ne Tumim kobisa ɔ.

english_verse: Many people gave gifts to help pay for the materials to rebuild the temple. The governor himself gave
translation_verse: Na maen ne ngaa ne tuale ɛhe bɛfa bɛbokale: esikaa kɔkorɛ kilo ɛyaa ko aburasia ne mmɔtwɛ, ɛdwetɛ kilo ɛyaa ko aburanna, yeɛ asɔfo ndaadeɛ aburasia ne nzoo.

english_verse: And so, by the seventh month, priests, Levites, temple guards, musicians, workers, and many of the ordinary people had settled in the towns of Judah.
translation_verse: Yiti asɔfo nemɔ, Lewifoɛ nemɔ, anoa awɛmvoɛ nemɔ, edweintolɛfoɛ, mmenia nemɔ anu bie, asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ nemɔ ne Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa, bɛtenatenane bɛ nguro mɔ so.

english_verse: On the first day of the seventh month, the people came together in the open area in front of the Water Gate. Then they asked Ezra, who was a teacher of the Law of Moses, to read to them from this Law that the Lord had given his people. Ezra the priest came with the Law and stood before the crowd of men, women, and the children who were old enough to understand.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔsɔfo Ɛsra fale mmeraa ne wale badwa ne anyunu, wɔ mmienzua ne mmrasua ne ngwadaa amukoraa bɔ bɛte dwirɛ a, bɛkɔhora bɛkɔte ye bo ɔ, bɛ nyunu, wɔ kyẽa bɔ oli moa wɔ bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne anu.

english_verse: Ezra stood on a high wooden platform that had been built for this occasion. Mattithiah, Shema, Anaiah, Uriah, Hilkiah, and Maaseiah were standing to his right, while Pedaiah, Mishael, Malchijah, Hashum, Hash Baddanah, Zechariah, and Meshullam were standing to his left.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ahyerɛlɛniɛ Ɛsra gyinane taboa simbini bie bɔ nyianu ne ati bahyɛ da babobɔ ɔ so. Na mmenia hemɔ gyinagyinane ye ngyɛnu: Matitia, Sema, Anaya, Yuria, Hilkia ne Maaseya gyinane ye sa famaa so, yeɛ Pedaya, Misael, Malkiya, Hasum, Hasbadana, Sakaria ne Mesulam koso begyinane ye sa bɛen so.

english_verse: Ezra was up on the high platform, where he could be seen by everyone, and when he opened the book, all the people stood up.
translation_verse: Na Ɛsra bukyele nwomaa ne anu bɔ maen ne amukoraa bɛ nye tua ɔ, ofikyɛ né ogyi anwuro tra mmenia ne amukoraa. Na obukyele nwomaa ne anu nen, mmenia ne amukoraa bedwɔso begyinane.

english_verse: Ezra praised the great Lord God, and they lifted their hands, shouting “Amen! Amen!” Then they bowed with their faces to the ground and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Na Ɛsra yele AWURADE, Nyameɛ piri ne ayɛ, na mmenia ne amukoraa bɛmomane bɛ sa so besurole so kyɛ, “Amen, Amen!” Na bɛfale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli ase bɛsɔnene AWURADE.

english_verse: After this, the Levites Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, and Pelaiah went among the people, explaining the meaning of what Ezra had read.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛkengale befili Nyameɛ mmeraa nwomaa ne anu, na behyirehyirele nu pefee mane mmenia ne tele bɔ bɛkengale ne abo.

english_verse: The people started crying when God's Law was read to them. Then Nehemiah the governor, Ezra the priest and teacher, and the Levites who had been teaching the people all said, “This is a special day for the Lord your God. So don't be sad and don't cry!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nehemia bɔ né ɔte amrado ne, ɔne ɔsɔfo Ɛsra bɔ ɔte ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne, bɛ ne Lewifoɛ bɔ behyirehyirele edwirɛ ne anu behyirele mmenia nemɔ ne, besele maen ne amukoraa kyɛ, “Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, ɔte krongron ma AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ; nnɛma ɛmɔdi aworabɔlɛ, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔsu.” Ofikyɛ maen ne amukoraa bɛtele mmeraa ne anu dwirɛ ne, besuni.

english_verse: Nehemiah told the people, “Enjoy your good food and wine and share some with those who didn't have anything to bring. Don't be sad! This is a special day for the Lord, and he will make you happy and strong.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ beeli naen bɔ walɔ ɔ, ná ɛmɔno nzaa bɔ ɔyɛ fɛɛ ɔ. Bɛ bɔ belle bie ne, ɛmɔɔma bɛ bie, ofikyɛ ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, ɔte krongron ma y’AWURADE. Nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ wora bɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE nu anigye yeɛ ɔte ɛmɔ anwoserɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The Levites encouraged the people by saying, “This is a sacred day, so don't worry or mourn!”
translation_verse: Yiti Lewifoɛ nemɔ hane sɔ dwirɛ he mane mmenia ne b’ahone tɔle bɛ kunu, “Ɛ́mɔyɛ konn, ofikyɛ ɛnɛ kyẽa ye te krongron: nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ wora bɔ.”

english_verse: When the people returned to their homes, they celebrated by eating and drinking and by sharing their food with those in need, because they had understood what had been read to them. Celebrating the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Yeɛ mmenia ne amukoraa bɛhɔle beedidili bɛnone, na bɛfale bie bɛhyehyɛle. Bɛgyele bɛ nye paa, ofikyɛ edwirɛ bɔ bɛkengale behyirele bɛ ne, bɛtele ye bo. Bedi Asese aluolue

english_verse: On the second day of the seventh month, the leaders of all the family groups came together with the priests and the Levites, so Ezra could teach them the Law
translation_verse: Kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne, bɛ bɔ bɛlela mmenia ne amukoraa bɛ nana mɔ bɛ sasofoɛ noa ne, bɛ ne asɔfo nemɔ ne Lewifoɛ ne, bɛbɔle nu bɛhɔle ahyerɛlɛniɛ Ɛsra berɛ kyɛ bɛkwaasua mmeraa ne anu dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: that the Lord had given to Moses. They learned from the Law that the people of Israel were to live in shelters when they celebrated the festival in the seventh month of the year.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE mmeraa bɔ ɔnate Mose so hyɛle ne, benwuni kyɛ bahyerɛ ye wɔ nu kyɛ bosome nzoo aluolue ne anu, odi kyɛ maen Yisrael bɛtena asese nu,

english_verse: They also learned that they were to go into the woods and gather branches of leafy trees such as olives, myrtles, and palms for making these shelters.
translation_verse: na afei odi kyɛ bɛbɔ ye dawure bɛfa bɛto dwaa wɔ bɛ nguro nemɔ amukoraa ne Yerusalem nu kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso bɛɛfa olive mmaen, eburo olive mmaen, sesea mmaen, ɛberɛ ne mmakaa bɔ bebua kusuu ɔ bɛ mmaen, na ɛmɔɔfa besisi asese nemɔ, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ne.

english_verse: So the people gathered branches and made shelters on the flat roofs of their houses, in their yards, in the courtyard of the temple, and in the open areas around the Water Gate and Ephraim Gate.
translation_verse: Yiti mmenia ne hɔle bɛɛfale mmaen nemɔ bɛwale, na besisili b’asese mɔ wɔ bɛ sua nemɔ mmɔsoɛ so, b’awuro aluo, yeɛ Nyameɛ awuro aluo berɛ, yeɛ Nzue Pambim ne anwo nekaa bɔ bɛbɔ dwaa ɔne Efraim Pambim ne anwo nekaa bɔ bɛbɔ dwaa ne.

english_verse: Everyone who had returned from Babylonia built shelters. They lived in them and joyfully celebrated the Festival of Shelters for the first time since the days of Joshua son of Nun.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ befili nnurehyelɛ nu besa bɛwale ne, besisili asese bɛtenatenane nu. Ofi Nun awa Yesua aberɛ so bɔ ɔkwaadwu sɔ kyẽa ne, né Yisraelfoɛ bɛyyɔle sɔ le. Na belili ahurusi paa.

english_verse: On each of the first seven days of the festival, Ezra read to the people from God's Law. Then on the eighth day, everyone gathered for worship, just as the Law had said they must.
translation_verse: Na daa biala, ofi kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne kɔpem kyẽa bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ne, ɔkengale Nyameɛ mmeraa nwomaa ne. Belili aluolue ne ɛlɛsoo. Na ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso, bɛyɔle nyianu krongron kyɛbɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne te ne.

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of the seventh month, the people of Israel went without eating, and they dressed in sackcloth and threw dirt on their heads to show their sorrow.
translation_verse: Sɔ bosome ne ala, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so aburanyɔ ne nna ne aso, Yisrael maen bɔle dwaa bɛyɔle akɔngyere. Bɛherale ɛsɛen tena bɛfale mbaen beguale bɛ ti so.

english_verse: They refused to let foreigners join them, as they met to confess their sins and the sins of their ancestors.
translation_verse: Na Yisraelfoɛ ne, bɛhwene bɛ nwo befili amanvrafoɛ amukoraa anwo, na begyinane bɛ gya so bɛhane bɛ bɔne ne bɛ nana mɔ b’amumuyɛɛ.

english_verse: For three hours they stood and listened to the Law of the Lord their God, and then for the next three hours they confessed their sins and worshiped the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛhɔle so begyinane bɛ gya so bɛkengale AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ mmeraa nwomaa ne dɔnhwere nza, yeɛ bɛfale dɔnhwere nza bieku bɛhane bɛ bɔne, na bɛsɔnene AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Jeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani stood on the special platform for the Levites and prayed aloud to the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Afei Yesua, Bani, Kadimiɛl, Sebania, Buni, Serebia, Bani ne Kenani begyinane Lewifoɛ b’atweleɛ ne aso, na bele komviɛ piri bɛteane nu bɛsrɛle AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Then the Levites Jeshua, Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah said: “Stand and shout praises to your Lord, the eternal God! Praise his wonderful name, though he is greater than words can express.” The People Pray
translation_verse: Yeɛ Lewifoɛ hemɔ: Yesua, Kadimiɛl, Bani, Hasabeneya, Serebia, Hodia, Sebania ne Petahia besele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔdwɔso bɛye AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ayɛ ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ. W’animnyam dumaa bɔ ɔbo animnyam ne ayɛyelɛ amukoraa so ne, yɛye ye ayɛ.”

english_verse: You alone are the Lord, Creator of the heavens and all the stars, Creator of the earth and those who live on it, Creator of the ocean and all its creatures. You are the source of life, praised by the stars that fill the heavens.
translation_verse: Na Ɛsra sele kyɛ, “Wɔ ngome yeɛ ɛte AWURADE ɔ. Wɔ yeɛ abɔ nyameɛso, nyameɛso bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro ne nu abɔdeɛ amukoraa; aseɛ ɔne so nningyein amukoraa; ɛpo ne nu nningyein amukoraa. Ɛma bɛ mukoraa ngoa, na nyameɛso abɔdeɛ amukoraa bɛsɔne wɔ.

english_verse: You are the Lord our God, the one who chose Abram— you brought him from Ur in Babylonia and named him Abraham.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ ole AWURADE Nyameɛ bɔ ɛneaneane nu yele Abram fili Kaldeafoɛ kuro Yure so, ná ɛtole ye dumaa Abraham ɔ.

english_verse: Because he was faithful, you made an agreement to give his descendants the land of the Canaanites and Hittites, of the Amorites and Perizzites, and of the Jebusites and Girgashites. Now you have kept your promise, just as you always do.
translation_verse: Enwuni kyɛ ye ahone nu te wɔ wɔ nyunu, na ɛne ye bɛyɛle apam kyɛ ɛkɔfa Kanaanfoɛ, Hitifoɛ, Amorifoɛ, Perisifoɛ, Yebusifoɛ ne Gɛgasifoɛ b’aseɛ kɔma ye boso ama; na wɔ bɔhyɛ bɔ ɛhyɛle ne, ali so, ofikyɛ ɛtengyɛ.

english_verse: When our ancestors were in Egypt, you saw their suffering; when they were at the Red Sea, you heard their cry for help.
translation_verse: “Yɛ nana mɔ bɔ né bɛwɔ Misraim ne, enwuni amaneɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ nu ɔ, na etiele bɛ sufrɛ wɔ Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ noa.

english_verse: You knew that the King of Egypt and his officials and his nation had mistreated your people. So you worked fearsome miracles against the Egyptians and earned a reputation that still remains.
translation_verse: Ɛyɔle nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ tiale Faro ne ye mbanyi amukoraa ne ye aseɛ ne aso ama mukoraa, ofikyɛ enwuni kyɛ bɛyɔle aniammɔwoho betiale yɛ nana mɔ. Elele dumaa, na sɔ dumaa ne watena berɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ ye.

english_verse: You divided the deep sea, and your people walked through on dry land. But you tossed their enemies in, and they sank down like a heavy stone.
translation_verse: Na ɛpakyele ɛpo ne anu wɔ bɛ nyunu, amaa ɔnate so bɛfale aseɛ wosee so bɛpɛle ɛpo ne, nakoso mmenia bɔ né bɛfoa yɛ nana mɔ ne de, egyili bɛ guale buma ne anu kyɛ nyɔboɛ bɔ bagyi bagua asue piri nu ɔ.

english_verse: Each day you led your people with a thick cloud, and at night you showed the way with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Afei koso, ɛfale munungum ningɔnn lili bɛ nyunu eyia, yeɛ ɛfale see ningɔnn lili bɛ nyunu kɔngɔen maa ɔtale maa benwuni ase bɛhɔle nekaa bɔ bɛkɔ ɔ.

english_verse: At Sinai you came down from heaven, and you gave your people good laws and teachings that are fair and honest.
translation_verse: Edwu wale Sinai bokaa ne aso, na ɛne bɛ dwudwole fili nyameɛso, na ɛmane bɛ tenenee nhyehyɛleɛ, mmeraa turoloo, yeɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne mmeraa dwirɛ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ.

english_verse: You commanded them to respect your holy Sabbath, and you instructed your servant Moses to teach them your laws.
translation_verse: Ɛmaa benwuni w’afofikyẽa krongron ne, yeɛ ɛnate wɔ somvoɛ Mose so mane bɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ ne mmeraa.

english_verse: When they were hungry, you sent bread from heaven, and when they were thirsty, you let water flow from a rock. Then you commanded them to capture the land that you had solemnly promised. *
translation_verse: Ɛmane bɛ aleɛ fili nyameɛso kyɛ bɛfa bɛho bɛ hɔen, yeɛ ɛmane bɛ nzue fili nyɔbotaen ne anu kyɛ bɛfa bɛho bɛ nzuhɔen, na ɛhã hyirele bɛ kyɛ aseɛ bɔ ɛtale ndaen kyɛ ɛkɔfa kɔma bɛ ne, bɛhɔ bɛɛfa.

english_verse: Our stubborn ancestors refused to obey— they forgot about the miracles you had worked for them, and they were determined to return to Egypt and become slaves again.
translation_verse: “Nakoso bɛ ne yɛ nana mɔ bɛyɛle anwomasoɛ ne asoserɛ, na banni wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne aso.

english_verse: not even when they made an idol shaped like a calf and insulted you by claiming, “This is the god who rescued us from Egypt.”
translation_verse: Ye po, mmerɛ bɔ behurole nikyee bɛyɔle nandwie ba amoen bɛfale ná besele kyɛ, ‘Wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔyele wɔ fili Misraim wale ne, ye ɛhe’, ná bɛbɔle musue mbiri mbiri nen,

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, you never abandoned them in the desert. And you always guided them with a cloud by day and a fire at night.
translation_verse: ɔnate w’anwumvoinnwunɛ kandinga ne ati, anyakyi bɛ nu wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso. Munungum ningɔnn bɔ olili bɛ nyunu wɔ atee ne aso ne, wanyakyi bɛ nu eyia; yeɛ see ningɔnn bɔ ɔtale kɔngɔen ne, ɔmaa benwuni ase bɛhɔle nekaa bɔ bɛkɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You took good care of them, and for forty years they never lacked a thing. Their clothes didn't wear out, and their feet were never swollen.
translation_verse: Ɛneane bɛ wɔ ɛserɛ so afoɛ aburanna maa ɔnate ye sɔ ti, hwee anhia bɛ. Bɛ ndaadeɛ andete, yeɛ bɛ gya bo anwunwu.

english_verse: You let them conquer kings and take their land, including King Sihon of Heshbon and King Og of Bashan.
translation_verse: Ɛfale ahennie ne maen maen mɔ mane bɛ, na ɛmane wɔ mmenia tenane aseɛ ne aso nekaa biala, maa ɔnate so bɛho bɛfale Hesebon hene Sihon aseɛ ne, yeɛ Basan hene Ogo aseɛ ne.

english_verse: You brought them into the land that you had promised their ancestors, and you blessed their nation with people that outnumbered the stars in the sky.
translation_verse: Ɛmane bɛ boso ama bɛtale kyɛ ewienu nzramaa, na aseɛ bɔ ɛhã hyirele bɛ nana mɔ kyɛ bɛɛfa bɛyɛ bɛ deɛ ne, ɛfale bɛ wale so.

english_verse: They captured strong cities and rich farmland; they took furnished houses, as well as cisterns, vineyards, olive orchards, and numerous fruit trees. They ate till they were satisfied, and they celebrated your abundant blessings.
translation_verse: Na bɛho bɛfale nguro bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue ne aseɛ bɔ ɔkye aleɛ ɔ. Na bɛfale awuro mɔ bɔ nningyein paa ayi bɛ tɛkyɛ ɔ, abura mɔ bɔ batutu ɔ, bobe boo mɔ, olive boo mɔ ne mmakaa bɔ basu biribiraa ɔ bɛyɛle bɛ deɛ. Yiti bedidili ma bɛ ko yili na bɛyɛle mbiri, na wɔ paa kandinga bɔ ɛyɛle bɛ ne ati bɛgyele bɛ nye.

english_verse: In spite of this, they rebelled and disobeyed your laws. They killed your prophets, who warned them to turn back to you, and they cursed your name.
translation_verse: “Nakoso bɛyɛle asoserɛ, na bɛyɛle wɔ nwo lɔen, bɛfale wɔ mmeraa ne bɛtole ahameɛ, na wɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛbɔle bɛ kɔkɔ kyɛ besa beeli wɔ si ne, behuhuni bɛ maa ɔnate so bɛbɔle musue mbiri mbiri paa.

english_verse: So you handed them over to their enemies, who treated them terribly. But in their sufferings, they begged you to help. From heaven you listened to their prayers and because of your great mercy, you sent leaders to rescue them.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛfale Yisraelfoɛ wurale bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa maa bɛhyɛle bɛ so. Na b’amaneɛnwunɛ nu ne, besu bɛfrɛle wɔ, na etiele bɛ mbaeɛ fili nyameɛso. Na kyɛbɔ w’anwumvoinnwunɛ piri ne te ne, ɛyele defoɛ mɔ mane bɛ maa bɛpepɛ belele bɛ befili bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu.

english_verse: But when they were at peace, they would turn against you, and you would hand them over to their enemies. Then they would beg for help, and because you are merciful, you rescued them over and over again.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ nwo tɔle bɛ ne, besa bɛyɔle bɔne betiale wɔ, na ɛfale bɛ wurale bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa maa belili bɛ so. Na bɛsesane b’adwene besa besu bɛfrɛle wɔ ne, etiele bɛ fili nyameɛso, na kyɛbɔ w’anwumvoinnwunɛ te ne, ɛpepɛ lele bɛ mmerɛ pee.

english_verse: For years, you were patient, and your Spirit warned them with messages spoken by your prophets. Still they refused to listen, and you handed them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: Afoɛ pee yeɛ enyane bɛ nwo aboterɛ ɔ, na ɛnate wɔ Sunzum so fale wɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ so bɔle bɛ kɔkɔ; nakoso bandie. Yiti ɛfale bɛ wurale aseɛ nemɔ aso ama bɛ sa.

english_verse: But you are merciful and kind, and so you never forgot them or let them be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔnate w’anwumvoinnwunɛ kandinga ne ati, annua bɛ boso, yeɛ anye wɔ sa amvi bɛ bo, ofikyɛ ɛte Nyameɛ bɔ ɛdo sona ná ɛse anwumvoin ɔ.

english_verse: Our God, you are powerful, fearsome, and faithful, always true to your word. So please keep in mind the terrible sufferings of our people, kings, leaders, priests, and prophets, from the time Assyria ruled until this very day.
translation_verse: “Yiti afei, yɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɛte piri bɔ wɔ nwo yɛ suro, bɔ edi apam so ná ekyire ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ɔ, amaneɛ amukoraa bɔ wato yɛ ne y’ahemvo, yɛ mbanyi mɔ, y’asɔfo mɔ, yɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ, yɛ nana mɔ, ɔne wɔ mmenia amukoraa, ofi Asiria ahemvo mɔ aberɛ so bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, nnebu ye nikyee ba.

english_verse: You have always been fair when you punished us for our sins.
translation_verse: Amaneɛ bɔ wato yɛ ne amukoraa, edi be, ofikyɛ edi nahorɛ, na yɛ de yayɔ bɔne.

english_verse: Our kings and leaders, our priests and ancestors have never obeyed your commands or heeded your warnings.
translation_verse: Yɛ ahemvo mɔ, yɛ mbanyi mɔ, y’asɔfo mɔ ne yɛ nana mɔ banni wɔ mmeraa ne aso, yeɛ wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne wɔ dwirɛ bɔ ɛfa mane bɛ ne, banni so.

english_verse: You blessed them with a kingdom and with an abundance of rich, fertile land, but they refused to worship you or turn from their evil.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ hene mɔ di bɛ so ne po, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ehyirele ɔdɔ kandinga hyirele bɛ, na ɛmane bɛ aseɛ kandinga bɔ ɔkye aleɛ de, nakoso banzo wɔ, yeɛ banyakyi bɛ bɔne bɔ bɛyɔ ne koso.

english_verse: Its plentiful harvest is taken by kings you placed over us because of our sins. Our suffering is unbearable, because they do as they wish to us and our livestock. The People Make an Agreement
translation_verse: Ahemvo mɔ bɔ ɔnate yɛ bɔne bɔ yayɔ ti amaa bali yɛ so ne, bɛ mmom yeɛ bedi aseɛ ne aso aleɛ paa ne ɔ. Bele yɛ nipadua ne y’ayɛmmoa mɔ so tumi. Bɔ bekuro yeɛ bɛfa bedi yɛ ɔ, na edwirɛ piri paa yeɛ wato yɛ ɔ.” Maen ne de apam ne to nu

english_verse: And so, a firm agreement was made that had the official approval of the leaders, the Levites, and priests.
translation_verse: “Ɔnate ɛhe amukoraa ti, yahyɛ bɔ kitii yahyerɛ yagua nwomaa so. Sɔ nwomaa ne, yɛ mbanyi mɔ, yɛ Lewifoɛ mɔ ne y’asɔfo mɔ yeɛ bafa bɛ nzɔanoɛ basɔ ye noa ɔ.

english_verse: As governor, I signed the agreement together with Zedekiah and the following priests:
translation_verse: Nwomaa ne, mmenia hemɔ yeɛ bɛfale bɛ nzɔanoɛ bɛsɔle ye noa ɔ: Hakalia awa Nehemia bɔ ɔte amrado ne, ɔne Sedekia;

english_verse: The Levites who signed were: Jeshua son of Azaniah, Binnui from the clan of Henadad, Kadmiel,
translation_verse: Na Lewifoɛ nemɔ ɛhe: Yesua bɔ ye baba ole Asania ne, Binuyi bɔ ɔte Henadade bosoniɛ ne, Kadimiɛl,

english_verse: Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
translation_verse: ne bɛ mmango Lewifoɛ Sebania, Hodia, Kelita, Pelaya, Hanan,

english_verse: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,
translation_verse: Mika, Rehobo, Hasabia,

english_verse: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
translation_verse: Sakure, Serebia, Sebania,

english_verse: Hodiah, Bani, and Beninu.
translation_verse: Hodia, Bani, Beninu.

english_verse: The leaders who signed were: Parosh, Pahath Moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛlela mmenia nemɔ anoa ɛhe: Parose, Pahate Moabo, Elam, Satu, Bani,

english_verse: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
translation_verse: Buni, Asegade, Bebae,

english_verse: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
translation_verse: Adoniya, Bigiwae, Adin,

english_verse: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,
translation_verse: Atɛ, Hesekia, Asure,

english_verse: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,
translation_verse: Hodia, Hasum, Besae,

english_verse: Hariph, Anathoth, Nebai,
translation_verse: Harife, Anatote, Nebae,

english_verse: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
translation_verse: Magepiase, Mesulam, Hesire,

english_verse: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
translation_verse: Mesesabɛl, Sadoke, Yadua,

english_verse: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
translation_verse: Pelatia, Hanan, Anaya,

english_verse: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,
translation_verse: Hosea, Hanania, Hasubo,

english_verse: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
translation_verse: Halohese, Piliha, Sobeke,

english_verse: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
translation_verse: Rehum, Hasabena, Maaseya

english_verse: Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,
translation_verse: Ahia, Hanan, Anan,

english_verse: Malluch, Harim, and Baanah. The Agreement
translation_verse: Maluke, Harim ne Baana. Apam ne anu dwirɛ

english_verse: All of us, including priests, Levites, temple guards, singers, temple workers and leaders, together with our wives and children, have separated ourselves from the foreigners in this land and now enter into an agreement with a complete understanding of what we are doing. And so, we now place ourselves under the curse of the Lord our God, if we fail to obey his laws and teachings that were given to us by his servant Moses.
translation_verse: bɛ ne bɛ nwo ama ne b’atitire mɔ bɛnomane bɛtale ndaen, kyɛ Nyameɛ mmeraa bɔ ɔnate ye somvoɛ Mose so ɔfa mane bɛ ne, bekoli so, kyɛ bekoli AWURADE, yɛ Mene ye mmeraa dwirɛ ne ye nhyehyɛleɛ ne ye ahyɛdeɛ amukoraa so.

english_verse: We won't buy goods or grain on the Sabbath or on any other sacred day, not even from foreigners. Every seven years we will let our fields rest, and we will cancel all debts.
translation_verse: Na aseɛ ne aso ama, sɛ bɛfa bɛ nningyein anaa b’aleɛ biala bɛba kyɛ bɛbayɛ ye atɔen afofikyẽa a, yɛngɔtɔ ngofi bɛ brɛ afofikyẽa anaa kyẽa krongron biala. Afei, afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne, yɛngɔyɛ boo wɔ aseɛ ne aso. Afei yɛkɔfa kerɛ biala bɔ ebiala ma yɛ ɔ yɛkɔhyɛ ye.

english_verse: Once a year we will each donate a small amount of silver to the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Afei koso, yɛde yɛto yɛ nwo so kyɛ, afoɛ biala yɛ nu biala kotua ɛtoɔ sekel ko nu ngyɛmuɛ nza maa bɛkɔfa bɛkɔyɛ Nyameɛ awuro berɛ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma hemɔ:

english_verse: This is to pay for the sacred bread, as well as for the daily sacrifices and special sacrifices such as those offered on the Sabbath and during the New Moon Festival and the other festivals. It will also pay for the sacrifices to forgive our sins and for all expenses connected with the worship of God in the temple.
translation_verse: paanoo krongron, daa daa aburoo afɔleɛ, daa daa naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, afofingyẽa mɔ, ɛsraen foforɛ aluolue, aluolue bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ nemɔ, akyɛdeɛ krongron ne, bɔnefakyɛ afɔleɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ mbata bɛma Yisrael ne, yeɛ yɛ Nyameɛ awuro ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne amukoraa.

english_verse: We have decided that the families of priests, Levites, and ordinary people will supply firewood for the temple each year, so that sacrifices can be offered on the altar, just as the Lord our God has commanded.
translation_verse: Afei koso, y’asɔfo, Lewifoɛ ne maen ne, yagua serewa yafa yaye mmerɛ bɔ afoɛ biala anu yɛ nu biala ye abusua kɔfa eyein kɔwa Nyameɛ awuro maa bɛkɔyera ye wɔ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ mmeraa ne anu ne.

english_verse: Each year we will bring to the temple the first part of our harvest of grain and fruit.
translation_verse: Yale yato yɛ nwo so kyɛ afoɛ noa biala, yɛ fieso aleɛ bɔ yɛkoli moa yɛkɔfa biala, yeɛ aseɛ ne aso bakaa biala, ye mmaa bɔ yɛkoli moa yɛkɔte ne, yɛkɔfa yɛkɔwa AWURADE awuro.

english_verse: We will bring our first-born sons and the first-born males of our herds and flocks and offer them to the priests who serve in the temple, because this is what is written in God's Law.
translation_verse: Afei koso, yɛkɔfa yɛ bamuɛbaa mmienzua mɔ ne yɛ nandwie mɔ, mmoaen mɔ ne abɔngye mɔ bɛ mma mɔ bɔ oli moa ne yɛkɔhɔ yɛ Nyameɛ awuro yɛkɔɔma asɔfo bɔ bɛyɔ Nyameɛ awuro berɛ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ mmeraa ne anu ne.

english_verse: To the priests in the temple of our God, we will bring the bread dough from the first harvest, together with our best fruit, and an offering of new wine and olive oil. We will bring ten percent of our grain harvest to those Levites who are responsible for collecting it in our towns.
translation_verse: Yɛkɔfa ɛhemɔ yɛkɔbrɛ asɔfo nemɔ maa bɛkɔfa bekogua Nyameɛ awuro berɛ pumbu nemɔ anu: yɛ mɔle nu paa paa ne, y’akyɛdeɛ mɔ, bakaa biala so mmaa, nzaa ne ngoo. Yɛ fieso aleɛ wora, yɛkɔfa buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko yɛkɔbrɛ Lewifoɛ nemɔ, ofikyɛ Lewifoɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ bede buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne befi yɛ nguraa nemɔ amukoraa nu ɔ.

english_verse: A priest from the family of Aaron must be there when we give this to the Levites. Then the Levites will put one tenth of this part in the temple storeroom,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo ne, bɔ ɔte Aarɔn bosoniɛ ne, sɛ Lewifoɛ nemɔ bede buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne a, odi kyɛ ɔboka bɛ so. Na buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne, odi kyɛ Lewifoɛ nemɔ bɛfa nu buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko bɛba yɛ Nyameɛ awuro berɛ pumbu mɔ bɔ bɛfa nningyein besie nu nemɔ anu.

english_verse: which is also the place for the sacred objects used by the priests, the temple guards, and the singers. Levites and everyone else must bring their gifts of grain, wine, and olive oil to this room. We will not neglect the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ odi kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ ne Lewi bosofoɛ ne bɛfa b’akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔte aburoo, nzaa ne ngoo bɛba pumbu mɔ bɔ bɛfa nningyein krongron besie nu nemɔ anu, ɔne nekaa bɔ asɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛyɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne, anoa wɛmvoɛ nemɔ ne edweintolɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛwɔ ne. Yɛngobu yɛ nye ngogua yɛ Nyameɛ awuro ne aso.

english_verse: The nation's leaders and their families settled in Jerusalem. But there was room for only one out of every ten of the remaining families, and so they asked God to show them who would live there.
translation_verse: Né maen mbanyi nemɔ bɛtete Yerusalem. Na maen ne anu ama ngaa ne guale serewa kyɛ bɛfa so bɛyeye mmenia ne anu buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko maa bɛbatena kuro krongron Yerusalem nu, ná buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ngona koso bɛtena nguro ngaa nemɔ aso.

english_verse: Then everyone else asked God to bless those who were willing to live in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na maen ne yirale bɛ bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ deinn bɛyele bɛ kunu kyɛ bɛkɔɔtena Yerusalem ne.

english_verse: Some of the people of Israel, the priests, the Levites, the temple workers, and the descendants of Solomon's servants lived on their own property in the towns of Judah. But the leaders of the province lived in Jerusalem with their families. The Judah Tribe
translation_verse: Mbɔtam mbanyi ne, né bɛtete Yerusalem. Nakoso Yuda nguro ngaa nemɔ aso de, Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne, asɔfo, Lewifoɛ, asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ ne Solomon somvoɛ nemɔ bɛ boso ama nemɔ, né ebiala te ye bɔbɔ ye aseɛ so.

english_verse: Joel son of Zichri was their leader, and Judah son of Hassenuah was second in command. Priests
translation_verse: Sikri awa Yowel yeɛ né ɔnea bɛ so ɔ, na sɛ ɔne berɛ a, Hasenua awa Yuda yeɛ ɔnea kuro ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: Four priests settled in Jerusalem. The first was Jedaiah; he was the son of Joiarib and the uncle of Jachin.
translation_verse: Na asɔfo nemɔ ɛhe: Yedaya bɔ ye baba ole Yoaribo, Yakin,

english_verse: The second priest to settle there was Seraiah son of Hilkiah. His ancestors were Meshullam, Zadok, Meraioth, and Ahitub, who had been a high priest.
translation_verse: Seraya bɔ ye baba ole Hilkia, bɔ ye baba ole Mesulam, bɔ ye baba ole Sadoke, bɔ ye baba ole Merayote, bɔ ye baba ole Ahitubo bɔ ɔnea Nyameɛ awuro ne aso ne,

english_verse: Several Levites settled in Jerusalem. First, there was Shemaiah son of Hasshub. His ancestors were Azrikam, Hashabiah, and Bunni.
translation_verse: Na Lewifoɛ nemɔ ɛhe: Semaya bɔ ye baba ole Hasubo bɔ ye baba ole Asrikam bɔ ye baba ole Hasabia bɔ ye baba ole Buni,

english_verse: Next, there were Shabbethai and Jozabad, the Levite leaders in charge of the work outside the temple.
translation_verse: ne Sabetae ne Yosabade bɔ bɛla Lewifoɛ noa, bɔ bɛnea Nyameɛ awuro ne anwo adwuma ne aso,

english_verse: Then there was Mattaniah son of Mica. His ancestors were Zabdi and Asaph. Mattaniah led the temple choir in the prayer of praise. Bakbukiah, who also settled in Jerusalem, was his assistant. Finally, there was Abda son of Shammua; his grandfather was Galal, and his great-grandfather was Jeduthun.
translation_verse: yeɛ Matania bɔ olili bɛ nyunu maa bɛbɔle mbaeɛ bɛtole ayɛyelɛ dwein, bɔ ye baba ole Mika bɔ ye baba ole Sabidi bɔ ye baba ole Asafe ne, ɔne Bakebukia bɔ ye abusuafoɛ nemɔ anu, Matania nne berɛ a, ye yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ne, yeɛ Aboda bɔ ye baba ole Samua bɔ ye baba ole Galal bɔ ye baba ole Yedutun ne.

english_verse: One hundred seventy-two temple guards settled in Jerusalem; their leaders were Akkub and Talmon.
translation_verse: Pambim awɛmvoɛ bɔ bɛ ole Akubo, Talmon ne bɛ mmango pambim awɛmvoɛ nemɔ ne, bɛ somaa te ɛyaa ko aburasoo ne nyɔ.

english_verse: The rest of the Israelites, including priests and Levites, lived on their own property in the other towns of Judah.
translation_verse: Na Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne, bɛ ne asɔfo ne Lewifoɛ ngaa ne, né bɛwɔ Yuda nguro ne amukoraa so bɔ ebiala ɔte ye aseɛ deɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: But the temple workers lived in the section of Jerusalem known as Ophel, and the two men in charge of them were Ziha and Gishpa.
translation_verse: Nakoso asɔneyɛɛ sua somvoɛ nemɔ de, né bɛte Ofel, na Siha ne Gisepa yeɛ né bɛnea asɔneyɛɛ sua nu somvoɛ nemɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: Uzzi son of Bani was the leader of the Levites in Jerusalem. His grandfather was Hashabiah, his great-grandfather was Mattaniah, and his great-great-grandfather was Mica. He belonged to the Asaph clan that was in charge of the music for the temple services,
translation_verse: Lewifoɛ bɔ né bɛtete Yerusalem ne, Yusi yeɛ né ɔnea bɛ so ɔ. Ɔse ole Bani bɔ ye baba ole Hasabia bɔ ye baba ole Matania bɔ ye baba ole Mika bɔ ɔte Asafe bosofoɛ edweintolɛfoɛ nemɔ anu ko ne. Asafe bosofoɛ ne, bɛ yeɛ né bɛnea Nyameɛ awuro berɛ adwuma ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: though the daily choice of music and musicians was decided by royal decree of the Persian king.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛhene ne fale ahyɛdeɛ bie tole dwaa fale bɛ nwo wɔ nningyein bɔ odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛma bɛ daa biala ɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel were represented at the Persian court by Pethahiah son of Meshezabel from the Zerah clan of the Judah tribe. The People in the Other Towns and Villages
translation_verse: Na Yuda awa Sera ye boso ama nemɔ, Petahia bɔ ye baba ole Mesesabɛl yeɛ né otu ɛhene ne foɛ wɔ nikyee biala bɔ ɔfa maen ne anwo ɔ. Yerusalem nwo nguraa

english_verse: Jeshua, Moladah, Beth-Pelet,
translation_verse: Yesua, Molada ne Bete Pelete,

english_verse: Enrimmon, Zorah, Jarmuth,
translation_verse: Ɛn Rimon, Sora, Yamute,

english_verse: Zanoah, Adullam, Lachish, and Azekah. In fact, they settled the towns from Beersheba in the south to Hinnom Valley in the north.
translation_verse: Sanoa, Adulam ne bɛ nwo nguraa mɔ, Lakise ne ye nwo aseɛ mɔ, yeɛ Aseka ne ye nwo nguraa mɔ. Yiti bɛkyekyele asikyeleɛ fi Beɛ Hyeba beedwuli Hinom bɔnza ne anu.

english_verse: The people of Benjamin lived in the towns of Geba, Michmash, Aija, Bethel with its nearby villages,
translation_verse: Benyaminfoɛ nemɔ koso bɛtenane nguro bɔ ofi Geba bɔ ɔkɔ nemɔ aso: Mikimase, Aiya, Betel ne ye nwo nguraa mɔ,

english_verse: Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
translation_verse: Anatote, Nɔbo, Anania,

english_verse: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
translation_verse: Hasɔ, Rama, Gitaim,

english_verse: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
translation_verse: Hadidi, Seboyim, Nebalate,

english_verse: Lod, and Ono, as well as in Craft Valley.
translation_verse: Lode ne Ono bɔ ɔte adwiililɛfoɛ bɔnza ne.

english_verse: Several groups of Levites from the territory of Judah were sent to live among the people of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Na Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Yuda ne, bɛmane bɛ nu biemɔ bɛɛtenane Benyaminfoɛ nu.

english_verse: Many priests and Levites had returned from Babylonia with Zerubbabel and Joshua as their leaders. Those priests were Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
translation_verse: Asɔfo ne Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛ ne Sɛtiɛl awa Serubabɛl, yeɛ Yesua bɛwale nemɔ ɛhe: Seraya, Yeremia, Ɛsra,

english_verse: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
translation_verse: Amaria, Maluke, Hatuse,

english_verse: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
translation_verse: Sekania, Rehum, Meremote,

english_verse: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,
translation_verse: Yido, Gyinetoye, Abiya,

english_verse: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
translation_verse: Miyamin, Maadia, Bilega,

english_verse: Shemaiah, Joiarib, Jedaiah,
translation_verse: Semaya, Yoaribo, Yedaya,

english_verse: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, and another Jedaiah. These were the leading priests and their assistants during the time of Joshua.
translation_verse: Salu, Amoko, Hilkia, yeɛ Yedaya. Sɔ mmenia nemɔ, né bɛlela asɔfo nemɔ ne bɛ mmango nemɔ noa wɔ Yesua aberɛ so.

english_verse: The Levites who returned were Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah. They and their assistants were responsible for the songs of praise,
translation_verse: Na Lewifoɛ nemɔ ɛhe: Yesua, Binuyi, Kadimiɛl, Serebia, Yuda yeɛ Matania bɔ ɔne ye mmango Lewifoɛ mɔ yeɛ né bɛnea ayɛyelɛ edweintolɛ ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: while Bakbukiah and Unno, together with their assistants, were responsible for the choral responses. Descendants of Joshua the High Priest
translation_verse: Na sɛ bɛto ayɛyelɛ dwein a, b’eliɛma Bakebukia ne Yuno gyina bɛ ndendeneɛ so.

english_verse: Joshua was the father of Joiakim, the grandfather of Eliashib, and the great-grandfather of Joiada.
translation_verse: Yesua awa ole Yoakim; Yoakim awa ole Eliasibo, Eliasibo awa ole Yowada,

english_verse: Joiada was the father of Jonathan and the grandfather of Jaddua. Leaders of the Priestly Clans
translation_verse: Yowada awa ole Yonatan, yeɛ Yonatan awa ole Yadua.

english_verse: When Joiakim was high priest, the following priests were leaders of their clans: Meraiah of the Seraiah clan, Hananiah of Jeremiah,
translation_verse: Yoakim aberɛ so, asɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛte bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ mbanyi mɔ ɛhe: Seraya boso ama deɛ ole Meraya; Yeremia boso ama deɛ ole Hanania;

english_verse: Meshullam of Ezra, Jehohanan of Amariah,
translation_verse: Ɛsra boso ama deɛ ole Mesulam; Amaria boso ama deɛ ole Yehohanan;

english_verse: Jonathan of Malluchi, Joseph of Shebaniah,
translation_verse: Maluki boso ama deɛ ole Yonatan; Sebania boso ama deɛ ole Yosef;

english_verse: Adna of Harim, Helkai of Meraioth,
translation_verse: Harim boso ama deɛ ole Adena; Merayote boso ama deɛ ole Helkae;

english_verse: Zechariah of Iddo, Meshullam of Ginnethon,
translation_verse: Yido boso ama deɛ ole Sakaria; Gyineton boso ama deɛ ole Mesulam;

english_verse: Shammua of Bilgah, Jehonathan of Shemaiah,
translation_verse: Bilega boso ama deɛ ole Samua; Semaya boso ama deɛ ole Yehonatan;

english_verse: Mattenai of Joiarib, Uzzi of Jedaiah,
translation_verse: Yoaribo boso ama deɛ ole Matenae; Yedaya boso ama deɛ ole Yusi;

english_verse: Kallai of Sallai, Eber of Amok,
translation_verse: Salae boso ama deɛ ole Kalae; Amoko boso ama deɛ ole Ebere;

english_verse: Hashabiah of Hilkiah, and Nethanel of Jedaiah. The Priestly and Levite Families
translation_verse: Hilkia boso ama deɛ ole Hasabia; yeɛ Yedaya boso ama deɛ ole Netanɛl.

english_verse: During the time of the high priests Eliashib, Joiada, Johanan, and Jaddua, and including the time that Darius was king of Persia, a record was kept of the heads of the Levite and priestly families.
translation_verse: Eliasibo, Yowada, Yohanan ne Yadua b’aberɛ so, bɛhyerɛle Lewifoɛ nemɔ bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ mbanyi bɛ dumaa, yeɛ bɛhyerɛle asɔfo nemɔ koso bɛ deɛ maa oodwuli Pɛsia hene Dario ye aberɛ so.

english_verse: However, no official record was kept of the heads of the Levite clans after the death of Johanan, the grandson of Eliashib.
translation_verse: Lewifoɛ nemɔ, bɔ bɛte bɛ nana mɔ sasofoɛ mbanyi ne, bɛhyerɛle bɛ dumaa wɔ abakɔsɛm nwomaa ne anu maa oodwuli Yohanan bosoniɛ Eliasibo aberɛ so.

english_verse: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, Jeshua son of Kadmiel, and their assistants organized two choirs of Levites to offer praises to God, just as King David, the man of God, had commanded.
translation_verse: Lewifoɛ mbanyi bɔ né bɛlela bɛ noa ɛhe: Hasabia, Serebia, yeɛ Yesua bɔ ye baba ole Kadimiɛl ne, bɛ ne b’eliɛma mɔ bɔ né begyina bɛ ndendeneɛ so besuro ayɛyelɛ ne asennaa dwein ne aso, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ sona Dawide hyɛle ne. Kure ko to ye deɛ yie a, né ko koso wato ye deɛ.

english_verse: Mattaniah, Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, and Akkub were responsible for guarding the storerooms near the temple gates.
translation_verse: Né Matania, Bakebukia, Obadia, Mesulam, Talmon ne Akubo bɛte pambim awɛmvoɛ bɔ bɛwɛne sua bɔ bɛfa nningyein besie nu nemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: All of these men lived during the time of Joiakim and during the time that I was governor and Ezra, a teacher of the Law of Moses, was priest. Nehemiah Dedicates the City Wall
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne te Yoakim bɔ ye baba ole Yesua bɔ ye baba ole Yosadake ne, yeɛ amrado Nehemia ne ɔsɔfo Ɛsra bɔ ɔte ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne b’aberɛ so. Betu fasue ne bewura AWURADE sa

english_verse: When the city wall was dedicated, Levites from everywhere in Judah were invited to join in the celebration with songs of praise and with the music of cymbals, small harps, and other stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ betu Yerusalem fasue ne bewura Nyameɛ sa ne, bɛpenane Lewifoɛ nemɔ wɔ nekaa bɔ bɛtete amukoraa. Na bɛfale bɛ bɛwale Yerusalem kyɛ bɛfa ahurusililɛ ne asennaa dweintolɛ, bɛbɔ firikyiwa, adengum ne sangoo bɛboka dwumadie ne wɔ anigye so.

english_verse: The Levite singers lived in villages around Jerusalem, and so they came from there, as well as from the villages around Netophah, Beth-Gilgal, Geba, and Azmaveth.
translation_verse: Bete Gilgal, yeɛ Geba ne Asimawete mbɔtam, ofikyɛ né edweintolɛfoɛ nemɔ bakyekye nguraa wɔ Yerusalem nwo batenatena nu.

english_verse: The priests and Levites held special ceremonies to make themselves holy, and then they did the same for the rest of the people and for the gates and walls of the city.
translation_verse: Na asɔfo nemɔ ne Lewifoɛ petene bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nwo, na bɛpetene mmenia ne, pambim nemɔ, ɔne fasue ne anwo.

english_verse: I brought the leaders of Judah to the top of the city wall and put them in charge of the two groups that were to march around on top of the wall, singing praises to God. One group marched to the right in the direction of Garbage Gate.
translation_verse: Afei mmane Yuda mbanyi beegyinagyinane fasue ne aso, na nduli edweintolɛfoɛ kure mbiri nyɔ maa bɛtole sandene bɛtole ayɛyelɛ dwein. Kure ko fale fasue ne aso famaa so, na ɔfale ye nye hyirele Fofoɛ Pambim ne.

english_verse: Hoshaiah and half of the leaders followed them.
translation_verse: Mmenia hemɔ lili bɛ si: Hosaya ne Yuda mbanyi ne bɛ bue,

english_verse: Then came the priests Azariah, Ezra, Meshullam,
translation_verse: yeɛ Asaria, Ɛsra, Mesulam,

english_verse: Judah, Benjamin, Shemaiah, and Jeremiah,
translation_verse: Yuda, Benyamin, Semaya ne Yeremia,

english_verse: and his relatives, Shemaiah, Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel, Judah, and Hanani. They played musical instruments like those that had been played by David, the man of God. And they marched behind Ezra, the teacher of the Law.
translation_verse: ne ye abusuafoɛ Semaya, Asarel, Milalae, Gilalae, Mayi, Netanɛl, Yuda ne Hanani. Né betiratira Nyameɛ sona Dawide ye nningyein bɔ ɔfa bɔ edwein ne, na né ahyerɛlɛniɛ Ɛsra oli bɛ nyunu.

english_verse: When they reached Fountain Gate, they climbed the steps to David's City and went past his palace, before stopping at the Water Gate near the eastern wall of the city.
translation_verse: Bedwuli Abura Pambim ne anwo ne, bɛhɔle bɛ nyunu tee bɛɛfole Dawide kuro atweleɛ bɔ ɔwɔ fasue ne anwuro dɔ ne, na bɛfale Dawide awuro ne anwuro dɔ beedwuli Nzue Pambim bɔ ɔwɔ eyia afiteleɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: The second group of singers marched along the wall in the opposite direction, and I followed them, together with the other half of the leaders of Judah. We went past Oven Tower, Broad Wall,
translation_verse: Edweintolɛfoɛ kure bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ, bɔ bɛye Nyameɛ ayɛ ne, bɛhɔle bɛ sa bɛen so. Na mene mmenia ne bue yɛfale fasue ne aso yɛlili bɛ si. Yɛfale Foonoo Abandenden ne aso yɛɛdwuli Fasue Tɛtrɛtɛɛ ne aso,

english_verse: Ephraim Gate, Old Gate, Fish Gate, Hananel Tower, Hundred Tower, and on to Sheep Gate. Finally, we stopped at Gate of the Guard,
translation_verse: wɔ Efraim Pambim ne anwuro wɔ Pambim Daa ne anwo ne Tire Pambim ne Hananel Abandenden ne, ɔne Ɛyaa Abandenden ne anwo yɛɛdwuli Mmoaen Pambim ne anwo. Na beegyinane Awɛmvoɛ Pambim ne anwo.

english_verse: where we stood in front of the temple with the other group, praising God. In the group with me were half of the leaders,
translation_verse: Yiti edweintolɛfoɛ kure nyɔ bɔ bɛye Nyameɛ ayɛ ne, beegyinane Nyameɛ awuro ne anu berɛ. Yeɛ mene mbanyi nemɔ anu bue, yɛ koso yɛɛgyinane berɛ bie.

english_verse: as well as the priests Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, who were blowing trumpets.
translation_verse: Yeɛ asɔfo Eliakim, Maaseya, Miniamin, Mikaya, Elionae, Sakaria ne Hanania bɔ betiratira totorobɛndo ɔ, bɛ koso beegyinane berɛ bie;

english_verse: Maaseiah, Shemaiah, Eleazar, Uzzi, Jehohanan, Malchijah, Elam, and Ezer also stood there, as Jezrahiah led the singers.
translation_verse: yeɛ Maaseya, Semaya, Eleasa, Yusi, Yehohanan, Malkiya, Elam ne Esere koso beegyinane berɛ bie. Na edweintolɛfoɛ ne tole dwein, na né Yesrahia yeɛ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: God had made the people very happy, and so on that day they celebrated and offered many sacrifices. The women and children joined in the festivities, and joyful shouts could be heard far from the city of Jerusalem. Preparation for Worship
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, bɛbɔle afɔleɛ mbiri mbiri belili ahurusi, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ maa bele anigye belili ahurusi. Mmrasua mbanyi nemɔ bɛ ne ngwadaa nemɔ koso bɛgyele bɛ nye. Anigye bɔ bɛgyele wɔ Yerusalem ne, né bɛte ye dedeede. Asɔneyɛɛ sua nu adwuma

english_verse: On that same day, some leaders were appointed to be responsible for the safekeeping of gifts for the temple and to be in charge of receiving the first part of the harvest and the ten percent of the crops and livestock that was offered to God. These same leaders also collected the part of crops that the Law of Moses taught was to be given to the Levites. Everyone was pleased with the work of the priests and Levites,
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, sua mɔ bɔ bɛfa akyɛdeɛ nemɔ, fieso aleɛ bɔ bekoli moa bɛkɔfa nemɔ, yeɛ buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko nemɔ besie nu ne, bɛyele mmenia kyɛ bɛnea so. Mbɔtam berɛ nguro nemɔ, bɛ fieso nningyein kyɛfa bɔ mmeraa ne kyire kyɛ bɛfa bɛma asɔfo ne Lewifoɛ nemɔ ne, né odi kyɛ sɔ mmenia bɔ baye bɛ ne, bɛboaboa ye noa begua nu, ofikyɛ né Yudafoɛ bɛ nye gye asɔfo ne Lewifoɛ b’adwuma bɔ bɛyɔ ne anwo.

english_verse: when they performed the ceremonies to make people acceptable to worship God. And the singers and the temple guards did their jobs according to the instructions given by David and his son Solomon.
translation_verse: Bɛyɔle bɛ Nyameɛ solɛ adwuma ne, ɔne bɛ nwo petenɛ sɔnenɛ adwuma ne, kyɛbɔ edweintolɛfoɛ ne awɛmvoɛ nemɔ bɛyɔle ne, kyɛbɔ ahyɛdeɛ bɔ Dawide ne ɔwa Solomon bɛhyɛle ne, ɔte ne ala.

english_verse: In fact, ever since the days of David and Asaph, there had been song leaders and songs of praise and worship.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ofi tete, fi Dawide ne Asafe aberɛ so, edweintolɛfoɛ nemɔ bele sona bɔ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ, bɔ odi bɛ nyunu maa bɛto dwein bɛye Nyameɛ ayɛ ná bɛda ye ase ɔ.

english_verse: During the time that Zerubbabel and I were in charge, everyone in Israel gave what they were supposed to give for the daily needs of the singers and temple guards from the Levi tribe. Then the Levites would give the priests their share from what they had received.
translation_verse: Serubabɛl aberɛ so ne Nehemia aberɛ so, daa daa aleɛ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛma edweintolɛfoɛ ne pambim awɛmvoɛ ne, Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɛfa bɛbrɛle bɛ. Bɛyele bɔ ɔte krongron ne besiele ahameɛ bɛmane Lewifoɛ nemɔ, na bɔ odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛma Aarɔn boso ama nemɔ ne, Lewifoɛ nemɔ ye siele ahameɛ bɛfa bɛmane bɛ.

english_verse: On that day when the Law of Moses was read aloud to everyone, it was discovered that Ammonites and Moabites were forbidden to belong to the people of God.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, bɛkengale Mose nwomaa ne anu dwirɛ behyirele maen ne. Na benwuni kyɛ bahyerɛ ye wɔ nu kyɛ onni kyɛ Amonniɛ anaa Moaboniɛ biala ɔkɔ Nyameɛ badwa nu le,

english_verse: This was because they had refused to give food and water to Israel and had hired Balaam to call down a curse on them. However, our God turned the curse into a blessing.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ bamva aleɛ ne nzue banzo Yisraelfoɛ wɔfoɛ, na mmom bɛbɔle Balaam paa kyɛ ɔɔnoma bɛ. Nakoso yɛ Nyameɛ mane ɛnomalɛ ne kakyili saleɛ.

english_verse: Following the reading of the Law of Moses, the people of Israel started sending away anyone who had any foreign ancestors. Nehemiah Makes Other Changes
translation_verse: Na maen ne tele mmeraa ne anu dwirɛ ne, betuli amanvrafoɛ amukoraa befili Yisrael. Nehemia nzesãleɛ ne

english_verse: The priest Eliashib was a relative of Tobiah and had earlier been put in charge of the temple storerooms.
translation_verse: Anzana ɛhe baasi ne, ɔsɔfo Eliasibo bɔ bɛyele ye kyɛ ɔnea Nyameɛ awuro sua bɔ bɛfa nningyein besie nu ne aso, bɔ ye nwoniɛ ole Tobia ne,

english_verse: So he let Tobiah live in one of these rooms, where all kinds of things had been stored—the grain offerings, incense, utensils for the temple, as well as the tenth of the grain, wine, and olive oil that had been given for the use of the Levites, singers, and temple guards, and the gifts for the priests.
translation_verse: né wasiesie sua piri ko wama Tobia. Sɔ sua ne, né bɛfa sɔ nningyein hemɔ besie nu: aburoo afɔleɛ, ɛyɛɛ, ngukue, aburoo ngyɛmuɛ buru nu ko, nzaa ngyɛmuɛ buru nu ko ne ngoo ngyɛmuɛ buru nu ko bɔ bahyɛ kyɛ bɛfa bɛma Lewifoɛ, edweintolɛfoɛ ɔne pambim awɛmvoɛ, yeɛ afei akyɛdeɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛma asɔfo nemɔ ne.

english_verse: This happened in the thirty-second year that Artaxerxes ruled Babylonia. I was away from Jerusalem at the time, because I was visiting him. Later I received permission from the king
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ ɛhe amukoraa ɔkɔ so nen, né nne Yerusalem, ofikyɛ Babilɔn hene Atasɛsɛse ye ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so aburasa ne nyɔ ne anu, ngɔle ye berɛ. Na mmerɛ kãa pɛle nu ne, nzrɛle Nana ate,

english_verse: to return to Jerusalem. Only then did I find out that Eliashib had done this terrible thing of letting Tobiah have a room in the temple.
translation_verse: na nza mmale Yerusalem. Sɔ mmerɛ ne yeɛ nwuni dwirɛ tɛɛ bɔ ɔnate Tobia ti Eliasibo wali ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ né wasiesie sua wama Tobia wɔ Nyameɛ awuro ne akunu.

english_verse: It upset me so much that I threw out every bit of Tobiah's furniture.
translation_verse: Mvɛle yaa paa, na ngyili Tobia nningyein amukoraa nguale dwaaso.

english_verse: Then I ordered the room to be cleaned and the temple utensils, the grain offerings, and the incense to be brought back into the room.
translation_verse: Afei nhyɛle maa bɛpetene sua nemɔ anu, na mmaa bɛfale Nyameɛ awuro ngukue nemɔ ne aburoo afɔleɛ ne, ɔne ɛyɛɛ ne besa beeguale sua nemɔ anu.

english_verse: I also found out that the temple singers and several other Levites had returned to work on their farms, because they had not been given their share of the harvest.
translation_verse: Afei koso nwuni kyɛ Lewifoɛ nemɔ bɛ bue deɛ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛma bɛ ne, saa bɛmva bɛmma bɛ. Ɔnate ye sɔ ti, né Lewifoɛ nemɔ ne edweintolɛfoɛ nemɔ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛyɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne, basa baatenatena bɛ namue nemɔ anu bɛyɛ eboo.

english_verse: I called the leaders together and angrily asked them, “Why is the temple neglected?” Then I told them to start doing their jobs.
translation_verse: Yiti ngane mbanyi nemɔ anyunu, na mmisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ Nyameɛ awuro berɛ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne, ɛmɔayakyi bagua berɛ ye?” Na mmoaboale Lewifoɛ ne edweintolɛfoɛ nemɔ noa maa besa bɛtoale b’adwuma so.

english_verse: After this, everyone in Judah brought a tenth of their grain, wine, and olive oil to the temple storeroom.
translation_verse: Yeɛ maen ne amukoraa besa bɛfale aburoo, nzaa ne ngoo so buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne bɛwale asɔneyɛɛ sua nu berɛ nekaa bɔ bɛfa nningyein besie ne.

english_verse: Finally, I appointed three men with good reputations to be in charge of what was brought there and to distribute it to the others. They were Shelemiah the priest, Zadok the teacher of the Law, and Pedaiah the Levite. Their assistant was Hanan, the son of Zaccur and the grandson of Mattaniah.
translation_verse: Na nyele ɛhemɔ kyɛ bɛnea sua bɔ bɛfa nningyein besie nu nemɔ aso: ɔsɔfo Selemia, ahyerɛlɛniɛ Sadoke, yeɛ Lewiniɛ Pedaya. Hanan bɔ ye baba ole Sakure bɔ ye baba ole Matania ne, ɔkɔboka bɛ wɔ sɔ adwuma ne anu, ofikyɛ sɔ mmenia nemɔ, mmenia de bɛ di kyɛ bedi nahorɛ. Na b’adwuma ole kyɛ bɛkɔhyɛ aleɛ ne nningyein bɛkɔma b’eliɛma mɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that my God will remember these good things that I have done for his temple and for those who worship there. The Sabbath
translation_verse: Ao me Nyameɛ, kaye me wɔ ɛhe anwo. Me Nyameɛ, me nningyein paa bɔ mayɔ ɔfa wɔ sua ne ɔne nu ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne anwo ne, nnɛma wɔ wora fi. Besa bedi afofikyẽa

english_verse: I also noticed what the people of Judah were doing on the Sabbath. Not only were they trampling grapes to make wine, but they were harvesting their grain, grapes, figs, and other crops, and then loading these on donkeys to sell in Jerusalem. So I warned them not to sell food on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, nwuni ye wɔ Yuda kyɛ mmenia betwi nzaa, yeɛ afei bɛsoa aburoo bɛteta afunum mɔ si afofikyẽa. Sɔ ala yeɛ né bɛfa nzaa, bobe, borɔdoma ne nningyein ahoroɔ bɛsoa ngaka nemɔ bɛba Yerusalem afofikyẽa ɔ, na mmɔle bɛ kɔkɔ kyɛ nnɛmaa bɛtɔne nningyein afofikyẽa.

english_verse: People who had moved to Jerusalem from the city of Tyre were bringing in fish and other things to sell there on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Tirofoɛ bɔ ne bɛte kuro ne aso ne, bɛ koso bɛfale tiré ne dwaa nningyein ahoroɔ bɛɛtɔnene bɛ afofikyẽa bɛmane Yudafoɛ wɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: I got angry and said to the leaders of Judah, “This evil you are doing is an insult to the Sabbath!
translation_verse: Yiti ngane Yuda atitire nemɔ nyunu kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ musue yeɛ ɛmɔbɔ ye? Ɛmɔgua afofikyẽa ne anwo fiɛ?

english_verse: Didn't God punish us and this city because our ancestors did these very same things? And here you are, about to make God furious again by disgracing the Sabbath!”
translation_verse: Aso nna sɔ yeɛ ɛmɔ nana mɔ bɛyɔle ɔ, bɔ ɔnate so yɛ Nyameɛ ɔpraprale musue he amukoraa oguale yɛ ne kuro he aso ɔ’?” Nakoso ɛmɔtɛgua afofikyẽa ne anwo fiɛ maa ɔnate so Nyameɛ ɔtɛfɛ Yisrael so yaa.

english_verse: I ordered the gates of Jerusalem to be closed on the eve of the Sabbath and not to be opened until after the Sabbath had ended. Then I put some of my own men in charge of the gates to make certain that nothing was brought in on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Yiti nhyɛle kyɛ, afofikyẽa ne baadwu, na sɛ ewienu hyɛ ye bo kyɛ opini a, odi kyɛ bɛtoto Yerusalem pambim anoa nemɔ anu, na onni kyɛ bebukye, sana afofikyẽa ne apɛ nu koraka. Na mmane me somvoɛ nemɔ bie bɛtenatenane pambim nemɔ anoa, kyɛbɔ mmenia bɛngɔfa nningyein bengowura kuro ne anu afofikyẽa ɔ.

english_verse: Once or twice some merchants spent the night outside Jerusalem with their goods.
translation_verse: Yiti dwadifoɛ nemɔ, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛtɔne nningyein ahoroɔ nemɔ, bɛlale Yerusalem fasue ne asi ma aleɛ hyene bɛ komapɛ anaa pɛen nyɔ.

english_verse: But I warned them, “If you do this again, I'll have you arrested.” From then on, they did not come on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Na mmɔle bɛ kɔkɔ mmisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzi ati yeɛ ɛmɔda fasue ne asi maa aleɛ kye ɔ’? Sɛ ɛmɔyɔ sɔ bieku a, ngɔhye ɛmɔ.” Ofi sɔ mmerɛ ne, bamma afofikyẽa ko.

english_verse: I ordered the Levites to make themselves holy and to guard the gates on the Sabbath, so that it would be kept holy. God is truly merciful, and I pray that he will treat me with kindness and bless me for doing this. Mixed Marriages
translation_verse: Na mvale ahyɛdeɛ mmane Lewifoɛ nemɔ kyɛ bɛpete bɛ nwo ná bɛbra bɛɛwɛne pambim nemɔ, amaa ɔnate so bama afofikyẽa ne wayɛ krongron. Ao me Nyameɛ, kaye me wɔ sɔ nikyee he anwo koso, na nwu me anwumvoin, kyɛbɔ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ye piri te ɔ. Bɛbra ɛwɔfoɛ agyaa

english_verse: I discovered that some Jewish men had married women from Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, nwuni Yudafoɛ bɔ bagyigya Asedɔde, Amon ne Moabo mmrasua ɔ.

english_verse: About half of their children could not speak Hebrew—they spoke only the language of Ashdod or some other foreign language.
translation_verse: Bɛ mma nemɔ, né bɛ bue kã Asedɔde dwudwolɛ. Né bɛnde Yuda dwudwolɛ, na mmom mmenia biemɔ bɛ dwudwolɛ yeɛ né bɛkã ɔ.

english_verse: So in my anger, I called down curses on those men. I had them beaten and even pulled out the hair of some of them. Then I made them promise: In the name of God we solemnly promise not to let our sons and daughters marry foreigners.
translation_verse: Na ndwili bɛ nyunu nnomale bɛ, mmole bɛ nu biemɔ ndutuli bɛ ti nwiaa, na mmaa bɛfale Nyameɛ dumaa bɛtale ndaen kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ mma mmrasua nemɔ bɛma bɛ mma mmienzua nemɔ agyaa, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔde bɛ mma mmrasua nemɔ agyaa bɛma ɛmɔ mma mmienzua, yeɛ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ koso nnɛma ɛmɔgyigya bɛ.

english_verse: So we will obey you and not rebel against our God by marrying foreign women.
translation_verse: Aso odi kyɛ yɛtie ɛmɔ dwirɛ ná yɛyɔ sɔ bɔne kandinga he ná yɛgyigya amanvrafoɛ mmrasua yɛfa yɛyɔ yɛ Nyameɛ nwo lɔen anaa?”

english_verse: Jehoiada, the son of the high priest Eliashib, had a son who had married a daughter of Sanballat from Horon, and I forced his son to leave.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo panyi paa Eliasibo, ɔwa Yehoada, ye mma mmienzua nemɔ anu ko bɔ né ogya Horonniɛ Sanbalate ɔwa brasua ne, mvoane ye mvili me nyunu maa ɔhɔle.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish them for breaking their priestly vows and disgracing the Levi tribe.
translation_verse: Ao me Nyameɛ, kaye bɛ ná ɛne bɛ li, ofikyɛ sɔfolilɛ adwuma ne, yeɛ sɔfolilɛ ne Lewifoɛ apam ne, bagua ye nwo fiɛ.

english_verse: Then I made sure that the people were free from every foreign influence, and I assigned duties for the priests and Levites.
translation_verse: Yiti mbetene bɛ nwo mvili amanvrafoɛ nningyein biala anwo, na asɔfo ne Lewifoɛ nemɔ, mvale ebiala adwuma nwurale ye sa,

english_verse: I also arranged for the people to bring firewood to the altar each day and for them to bring the first part of their harvest to the temple. I pray that God will bless me for the good I have done.
translation_verse: na mmerɛ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛfa afɔleɛ bɔlɛ eyein ɔne fieso aleɛ bɔ bali moa bafa bɛba ne, nyɛle ye nwo nhyehyɛleɛ ndole berɛ. Ao me Nyameɛ, kaye me maa oyie me yé.

english_verse: King Xerxes of Persia lived in his capital city of Susa and ruled
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Nana Ahasuro bia bɔ olili ne, né Susa ahemvie yeɛ ɔte ɔ.

english_verse: During the third year of his rule, Xerxes gave a big dinner for all his officials and officers. The governors and leaders of the provinces were also invited, and even the commanders of the Persian and Median armies came.
translation_verse: Olili bia ne, ye afoɛ nza ne anu, ɔtole poen mane ye mbanyi ne ye somvoɛ amukoraa. Ɔtole ye sa frɛle Pɛsia ne Media safohene mɔ, atitirefoɛ ne manzini amrado mɔ maa bɛwale ye bo bie.

english_verse: At the end of this time, King Xerxes gave another dinner and invited everyone in the city of Susa, no matter who they were. The eating and drinking lasted seven days in the beautiful palace gardens.
translation_verse: Sɔ ngyẽa ne wale ayieleɛ ne, Nana Ahasuro tole poen mane ebiala bɔ ɔwɔ Susa ahemvie berɛ, atitirefoɛ ne kwahweabaa mɔ. Ɛpoentolɛ ne hɔle so ɛlɛsoo wɔ Nana Ahasuro ahemvie n’anyunu berɛ turo ne anu.

english_verse: The area was decorated with blue and white cotton curtains tied back with purple linen cords that ran through silver rings fastened to marble columns. Couches of gold and silver rested on pavement that had all kinds of designs made from costly bright-colored stones and marble and mother-of-pearl.
translation_verse: Bɛfale mbɛmuɛ tena fufue ne bibire, bɔ nwera ne koogyan sinzesinze so, bɔ ɛdwetɛ ngaa ne nyɔboɛ fufue sosɔ bɛ noa ɔ yeɛ besiesiele berɛ. Né mba bɔ bafa sikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ baboro bɛ nwo ɔ gyigyi berɛ. Aseɛ bɔ mba nemɔ gyigyi so ne, né bafa nyɔboɛ kɔkorɛ ne nyɔboɛ fufue ne nyɔboɛ hyɛnn ne nyɔboɛ hyɛnhyɛnn yeɛ basiesie berɛ.

english_verse: The guests drank from gold cups, and each cup had a different design. The king was generous
translation_verse: Besuli bɛ nzaa ne wɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ kulie nu, yeɛ kulie ahoroɔ mɔ nu. Na Nana Ahasuro yele ye kunu mane bɛ nzaa maa obuli bɛ so, kyɛbɔ ye anwonya te ɔ.

english_verse: and said to them, “Drink all you want!” Then he told his servants, “Keep their cups full.”
translation_verse: Ebiala none nzaa somaa bɔ ɔkɔhora ye no ɔ, ofikyɛ Nana Ahasuro hyɛle ye ahemvie berɛ somvoɛ nemɔ kitii kyɛ, nzaa somaa bɔ ebiala kɔhora ye no ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ besu ye.

english_verse: While the men were enjoying themselves, Queen Vashti gave the women a big dinner inside the royal palace.
translation_verse: Na Nana hemmaa Wasiti koso tole poen mane mmrasua mɔ wɔ Nana Ahasuro ahemvie berɛ.

english_verse: By the seventh day, King Xerxes was feeling happy because of so much wine. And he asked his seven personal servants, Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, and Carkas,
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛsoo ne aso bɔ né nzaa ama Nana Ahasuro ye ti anu ayɛ ye fɛfɛɛfɛ ne, osele ye somvoɛ sayɛɛ nzoo, bɔ bɛ ole Mehuman, Bisita, Habona, Bigita, Abagita, Seta ne Kakase,

english_verse: to bring Queen Vashti to him. The king wanted her to wear her crown and let his people and his officials see how beautiful she was.
translation_verse: kyɛ bɛɛfa Nana hemmaa Wasiti bɛbra ye nyunu. Ɔnwa ɔsɛ kyɛ Nana hemmaa ne ɔbɔ ahennie abotire; bɔ ɔkɔma mmenia ne ye mbanyi mɔ bekonwu ye anwonyemene ɔ, ofikyɛ né ye nwo yɛ nyemene.

english_verse: The king's servants told Queen Vashti what he had said, but she refused to go to him, and this made him terribly angry.
translation_verse: Sayɛɛ nemɔ fale Nana Ahasuro ngraa ne bɛɛmane Nana hemmaa Wasiti, nakoso wamma. Ye sɔ ati, Nana Ahasuro ahone huli, na ɔfɛle yaa hahii.

english_verse: The king called in the seven highest officials of Persia and Media. They were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan. These men were very wise and understood all the laws and customs of the country, and the king always asked them what they thought about such matters.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ ɔyɛ a Nana Ahasuro ɔne bɛ betu asure paa ole Kasena, Seta, Adimata, Tasise, Merese, Masena ne Memukan. Bɛ yeɛ bɛte mbanyi nzoo bɔ bɛwɔ Pɛsia ne Media bɔ né bɛtaa bɛ ne Nana Ahasuro bedi ngitahoɛ ɔ, na bɛ yeɛ betira ahennie ne anu dibea piri paa ɔ.)

english_verse: The king said to them, “Queen Vashti refused to come to me when I sent my servants for her. What does the law say I should do about that?”
translation_verse: Na Nana Ahasuro bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzomane me sayɛɛ nemɔ kyɛ bɛɛhã behyire Nana hemmaa Wasiti ma ɔbra, nakoso wandɛ me so. Sɛ yɛnea yɛ mmeraa ne anu a, nzikyɛ asohwenɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ yɛfa yɛma ye ɔ?”

english_verse: Then Memucan told the king and the officials: Your Majesty, Queen Vashti has not only embarrassed you, but she has insulted your officials and everyone else in all the provinces.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Memukan mane Nana Ahasuro ne mbanyi nemɔ mmuayɛɛ wɔ bɛ nyunu berɛ kyɛ, “Nna Nana Ahasuro angome yeɛ Nana hemmaa Wasiti wayɔ ye tɛɛ ɔ, na mmom wayɔ mbanyi ne amukoraa tɛɛ, ɔne mmenia amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ Nana Ahasuro manzini amukoraa nu koso tɛɛ.

english_verse: The women in the kingdom will hear about this, and they will refuse to respect their husbands. They will say, “If Queen Vashti doesn't obey her husband, why should we?”
