translation_verse: Sɛ medi be po a, mengɔhora ngɔye me noa ngohyire ye, na mmom ngɔsrɛ me ndɛenbualɛniɛ ne, kyɛ onwu me anwumvoin.

english_verse: And if God came into court when I called him, he would not hear my case.
translation_verse: Sɛ mefrɛ ye ndɛenbualɛniɛ nyunu ná ɔba a, menne menni kyɛ bɔ meka ye ɔkɔtɛ me so ɔ.

english_verse: He would strike me with a storm and increase my injuries for no reason at all.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔnate edwirɛ kãa bie ati opura me, na ɔma me nwo yɛ ngena ngena bɔ nnyɛle hwee ɔ.

english_verse: Before I could get my breath, my miseries would multiply.
translation_verse: Ɔmma menne me nwome, na mmom waprapra aworabɔlɛ wagua me so.

english_verse: God is much stronger than I am, and who would call me into court to give me justice?
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔba kyɛ yɛli ye anwoserɛ so a, ye yeɛ ɔte anwoserɛniɛ ɔ! Yeɛ sɛ ɔba ndɛenbualɛ koso a, ndɛenbualɛniɛ beni nyunu yeɛ ɔkɔhɔ ɔ?

english_verse: I am not guilty, but I no longer care what happens to me.
translation_verse: Mvomsoɛ biala nne me nwo de, nakoso menze me bɔbɔ me nwo yé; afei de, ewiase afono me.

english_verse: When a good person dies a sudden death, God sits back and laughs.
translation_verse: Sɛ asane si ma mmenia wuwu mvum nu a, mmenia bɔ bedi be ne, b’amaneɛnwunɛ ɔyɛ ye sere.

english_verse: And who else but God blindfolds the judges, then lets the wicked take over the earth? My Life Is Speeding By
translation_verse: Wafa aseɛ wawura bɔnefoɛ sa, ɔma nu ndɛenbualɛfoɛ bebu bɛ nye begua nahorɛ so. Sɛ nna ye ahɔ a, né nzaade nwa ɔ?

english_verse: Each day passes swifter than a sailing ship or an eagle swooping down.
translation_verse: Ɔpɛ nu kɔ ndɛndɛ kyɛ ɛlɛen bɔ ɔla asue nye ɔ, ɔkɔ ndɛndɛ kyɛ kɔleɛ bɔ ɔto kye naen ɔ.

english_verse: but my sufferings frighten me, because I know that God still considers me guilty.
translation_verse: né m’amaneɛnwunɛ ne amukoraa afa ɛserɛ wato me so, ofikyɛ mese kyɛ engobua me be.

english_verse: So what's the use of trying to prove my innocence?
translation_verse: Na sɛ ekobua me fɔ a, nzu ati yeɛ meha me nwo mbaen ɔ?

english_verse: Even if I washed myself with the strongest soap,
translation_verse: Sɛ mefa nzue gyengɔgyengɔ mebia, ná mefa kondu menwunzi me sa po a,

english_verse: God would throw me into a pit of stinking slime, leaving me disgusting to my clothes.
translation_verse: ekofindi me kɔto kumaa pikapika nu, na me nwo kɔyɛ me bɔbɔ me ndaadeɛ po tɛ.

english_verse: God isn't a mere human like me. I can't put him on trial.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ye de, ɔtte dasaniɛ kyɛ me, ná mahora masa me nwo mahyire ye, ná yahora yagyina yabɔ nguro.

english_verse: Who could possibly judge between the two of us?
translation_verse: Ndɛenbualɛniɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ ogyi yɛ afia, bɔ okoli yɛ munyɔ yɛ afia dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Can someone snatch away the stick God carries to frighten me?
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔye amaneɛ bɔ wafa wato me so ne ofi me so, ná wamma ye nwo suronyi wandɔ me so a,

english_verse: Then I could speak up without fear of him, but for now, I cannot speak.
translation_verse: ye de mengɔfa ye nwo suronyi yeɛ ngodwudwo ɔ, ofikyɛ me de, mese kyɛ nna sɔ yeɛ nde ɔ.

english_verse: I am sick of life! And from my deep despair, I complain to you, my God.
translation_verse: “Ewiase afono me, afei de, ngɔhã edwirɛ bɔ ɔha me ɔ, edwirɛ yealɛ bɔ ɔwɔ me nu ne, ngɔhã.

english_verse: Why do you take such delight in destroying those you created and in smiling on sinners?
translation_verse: Aso ɔte paa ma wɔ kyɛ ɛkɔfa me kɔfa ateetee nu ɔ, kyɛ ɛkɔpo wɔ sa noa adwuma ɔ, ɔne kyɛ ɛkɔma wɔ nye kɔgye amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛ porɛbɔlɛ nwo ɔ?

english_verse: Do you look at things the way we humans do?
translation_verse: Aso kuro sona anyeɛ yeɛ ele ye ɔ? Kyɛbɔ sona nwu nikyee ne, aso sɔ yeɛ enwu ye ɔ?

english_verse: Is that why you are so quick to find fault with me?
translation_verse: bɔ me nwo mvomsoɛ yeɛ ɛneanea nu ɛpena ɔ, ɔne kyɛ me bɔne yeɛ ɛfeefee nu ɛpena ɔ?

english_verse: You know I am innocent, but who can defend me against you?
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛse kyɛ menni fɔ, yeɛ ebiala koso nne berɛ bɔ okole me kofi wɔ sa nu ɔ.

english_verse: Remember that you molded me like a piece of clay. So don't turn me back into dust once again.
translation_verse: Kaye kyɛ ɛfale nnɛterɛ yeɛ ɛnwone me ɔ; na ɛkɔmaa ngosa ngɔkakyi nnɛterɛ anaa?

english_verse: As cheese is made from milk, you created my body from a tiny drop.
translation_verse: Aso amma manyɛ kyɛ nyɔfonesue bɔ wala ɔ, ɔne nyɔfonesue bɔ babɔ ye kunguma ɔ?

english_verse: Then you tied my bones together with muscles and covered them with flesh and skin.
translation_verse: Ɛfale wereɛ ne anwoɔnaen edwirale me nwo, yeɛ ɛfale mmowue ne ndii ɛpombale me sosɔle so.

english_verse: You, the source of my life, showered me with kindness and watched over me. You Have Not Explained
translation_verse: Ama me ngoa, yeɛ aye ɔdɔ pindinn ali ahyire me, na ɛnealɛ bɔ ɛnea me so ne yeɛ ɔbɔ me sunzum nwo waen ɔ.

english_verse: but you catch and punish me each time I sin.
translation_verse: Ɛtetɛ me nea sɛ aso ngɔyɔ bɔne a, na ɛngɔfa me nwo ngɔhyɛ me wɔ me mvomsoɛ nwo.

english_verse: No matter how hard I try, you keep hunting me down like a powerful lion.
translation_verse: Sɛ mema me nwo so a, ɛyɛ kyɛ gyata bɔ ye nye aboro ɔ ɛfoa me, na esa yɔ anwanwadeɛ nningyein etia me.

english_verse: You never stop accusing me; you become furious and attack over and over again.
translation_verse: Ɛfa amaneɛ foforɛ to me so maa ɔyɛ adanzeɛ tia me, ɛfɛ me nwo yaa piri paa, na ɛfa ɛlɔen foforɛ ɛba me so.

english_verse: Why did you let me be born? I would rather have died before birth
translation_verse: “Ao! Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmaa me ni wole me ɔ? Sɛ nwuli koraka yeɛ bɛ nye pɛ me so a, ahaa ɔte paa.

english_verse: I have only a few days left. Why don't you leave me alone? Let me find some relief, *
translation_verse: Aso me ngoa ɔtte tikaape bie? Ma ye bo ɔpɛ. Yakyi me maa me wora kyekye kãa,

english_verse: of darkness and despair, the place of no return.
translation_verse: awosii tunn ne basabasa maen ne, bɔ berɛ kanea te kyɛ awosii ne.”

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Yeɛ Naamaniɛ Sofa buale kyɛ,

english_verse: Your words have silenced others and made them ashamed; now it is only right for you to be put to shame.
translation_verse: Wɔ dwudwolɛ mbaen mbaen ne, ɔkɔmaa mmenia komua bɛ noa anaa? Sɛ ɛgoro ebie nwo a, aso ebie wora ongogua wɔ nyunu ase anaa?

english_verse: You claim to be innocent and argue that your beliefs are acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛnwa: ‘Me ngyerɛkyerɛ te sannwuu, na me nwo te wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu.’

english_verse: and let you know that wisdom has many different sides. You would then discover that God has punished you less than you deserve.
translation_verse: ahaa ɔkɔha nworɛ nwo mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ kohyire wɔ, ofikyɛ nworɛ gua ahoroɔ pee. Nwu ye kyɛ, wɔ mvomsoɛ nwo asohwenɛ bɔ anya ye ne, Nyameɛ abu ye nye wagua mvomsoɛ ne bie aso.

english_verse: They are higher than the heavens and deeper than the grave. So what can you do when you know so little,
translation_verse: Ye nworɛ ne, ye konguronn tra nyameɛso. Ɛyɛ sɛɛ né ate ye bo? Ye kuronn tra ɛborɔ. Ɛyɛ sɛɛ né anwu sɔ nworɛ ne?

english_verse: and these mysteries outreach the earth and the ocean?
translation_verse: Ye tendenn nu tra aseɛ, yeɛ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu tra ɛpo.

english_verse: If God puts you in prison or drags you to court, what can you do?
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔba ná ɔfa mmenia gua kuku nu, ná ɔfa mmenia kɔ nekaa bɔ bedi dwirɛ a, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kosi ye ate ɔ?

english_verse: God has the wisdom to know when someone is worthless and sinful,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ye de ɔse mmenia bɔ benni nahorɛ ɔ, na sɛ onwu bɔne wɔ sona nwo a, aso okobu ye nye kogua so?

english_verse: but it's easier to tame a wild donkey than to make a fool wise. Surrender Your Heart to God
translation_verse: Nakoso anzana kwaseambane konwu nworɛ ne, sana eburo afunum wawo sona koraka.

english_verse: Surrender your heart to God, turn to him in prayer,
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛma wɔ bra yɛ sannwuu a, yeɛ ɛkɔfa w’abisadeɛ ɛkɔto ye nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: and give up your sins— even those you do in secret.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɔne wɔ wɔ nu a, yakyi ye yɔlɛ korakorakora, yeɛ nnɛma amumuyɛɛ tena w’awuro.

english_verse: Then you won't be ashamed; you will be confident and fearless.
translation_verse: Ɔba ye sɔ a, ɛkɔpagya wɔ ti bɔ wɔ tiboa ngobua wɔ fɔ ɔ, ekogyina pirim, na engosuro.

english_verse: Your troubles will go away like water beneath a bridge,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, wɔ wora kofi w’aworabɔlɛ, na ɛkɔkaye ye kyɛ nzue bɔ wasẽ wahɔ ɔ.

english_verse: and your darkest night will be brighter than noon.
translation_verse: Wɔ ngoa kɔta hyireinn kɔtra eyia ketee, na ye awosii po ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ ngyerɛmɔ.

english_verse: You will rest safe and secure, filled with hope and emptied of worry.
translation_verse: Ekogyina pindinn, ofikyɛ anyelasoɛ wɔ berɛ, ɔkɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen, na ɛkɔla asomdwee nu.

english_verse: You will sleep without fear and be greatly respected.
translation_verse: Ɛkɔla bɔ ebiala ngonwunanwuna wɔ ɔ, na mmeni pee kɔpena mmokalɛ kofi wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: But those who are evil will go blind and lose their way. Their only escape is death!
translation_verse: Nakoso amumuyɛɛfoɛ de, bɛ nye so kɔyɛ bɛ wusiwusi, bengonya neka fee bɛngɔnwati ngɔhɔ, na b’anyelasoɛ ala ole ewue.”

english_verse: Job said to his friends:
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yob buale kyɛ,

english_verse: You think you are so great, with all the answers.
translation_verse: “Ɔnyɛ nwanwa! Ɛmɔ yeɛ mmenia noa dwirɛ tua ɛmɔ noa ɔ, na ɛmɔwu a, né nworɛ bo apɛ.

english_verse: But I know as much as you do, and so does everyone else.
translation_verse: Nakoso me wora, adwene wɔ me ti anu kyɛ ɛmɔ ala, ɛmɔ nworɛ ndra me deɛ. Nwa ala yeɛ ɔnze edwirɛ hemɔ ɔ?

english_verse: I have always lived right, and God answered my prayers; now friends make fun of me.
translation_verse: Me nwo yɛ me mmango mɔ sere, me bɔ mesu mefrɛ Nyameɛ a ɔma me mmuayɛɛ ɔ, sona bɔ metengyɛ, bɔ mvomsoɛ nne me nwo yeɛ me nwo yɛ mmenia sere ye.

english_verse: It's easy to condemn those who are suffering, when you have no troubles.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛ so anu atɔ bɛ ne, bebu bɛ bɔ amaneɛ ato bɛ ɔ animtia, na amaneɛ asiesie ye nwo ɔnwondɛ bɛ bɔ basoti ɔ.

english_verse: Robbers and other godless people live safely at home and say, “God is in our hands!” If You Want To Learn
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛhawo ɔnne awerɔm awuefoɛ b’awuro, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bewura Nyameɛ apue ne koso, banya asomdwee, eh, aso bɛ yeɛ Nyameɛ maa oyie bɛ yé ɔ?

english_verse: If you want to learn, then go and ask the wild animals and the birds,
translation_verse: “Nakoso, bisa ngaka mɔ, na bekohyirehyire wɔ, bisa ewienu nnomaa, na bɛkɔhã bekohyire wɔ.

english_verse: Any of them can tell you what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa bɛ nu beni yeɛ ɔnze ɔ, kyɛ AWURADE yeɛ wayɔ sɔ nikyee ne ɔ?

english_verse: We hear with our ears, taste with our tongues,
translation_verse: Aso asoɛ nde nzonzoleɛ bɔ ɔwɔ edwirɛ nu, kyɛbɔ temverema koso tafe aleɛ nea ne?

english_verse: and gain some wisdom from those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Mbanyi mɔ berɛ yeɛ nworɛ wɔ ɔ, yeɛ ndeaseɛ koso wɔ bɛ bɔ banyi bahyɛ ɔ berɛ.

english_verse: But God is the real source of wisdom and strength.
translation_verse: “Nyameɛ berɛ yeɛ nworɛ ne tumi wɔ ɔ, ye berɛ yeɛ foɛtulɛ ne ndeaseɛ wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: No one can rebuild what he destroys, or release those he has imprisoned.
translation_verse: Sɛ odwiri nikyee gua a, ebiala ngɔhora ngosa ngosi, sɛ ɔto sona kuku nu a, ebiala ngɔhora ye bukye.

english_verse: just as he rules over liars and those they lie to.
translation_verse: Ye berɛ yeɛ anwoserɛ ne nworɛ wɔ ɔ, sona bɔ bɛlakalaka ye ne, ɔne nnakannakaniɛ ne, bɛ munyɔ bewura ye bo.

english_verse: God shames counselors, turns judges into fools,
translation_verse: Ɔma foɛtulɛfoɛ bɛ nworɛ fi bɛ ti anu, yeɛ ɔma ndɛenbualɛfoɛ bɛyɛ ngwaseaa.

english_verse: God removes priests and others who have great power—
translation_verse: Opuro asɔfo mɔ bɛ ndaadeɛ, na otu tumifoɛ fi bia so.

english_verse: puts mighty kings to shame, and takes away their power.
translation_verse: Ɔma mmenia bu atitirefoɛ animtia, na ogoho anwoserɛfoɛ b’abɔsoɛ nu.

english_verse: lost in the dark, staggering like someone drunk.
translation_verse: Befuafua awosii bɔ kanea nne nu ɔ nu, na ɔmaa bɛnate fofalifofali kyɛ akɔnomnzaniɛ.

english_verse: I know and understand every bit of this.
translation_verse: “Tie, ɛhe amukoraa me nye anwu ye, yeɛ me so ate, na mate ye bo.

english_verse: None of you are smarter than I am; there's nothing you know that I don't.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɛmɔse ne, me koso mese, ɛmɔ nworɛ ndra me deɛ.

english_verse: you are merely useless doctors, who treat me with lies.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔ noa nu yeɛ ɛmɔbobɔ ɔ, ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛte safoɛ bɔ mvasoɛ nne ɛmɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: The wisest thing you can do is to keep quiet
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔmua ɛmɔ noa mmom a, ahaa okyire kyɛ ɛmɔse nworɛ!

english_verse: and not telling the whole truth when you argue his case?
translation_verse: Aso ɛmɔgyi Nyameɛ si anaa, anaakyɛ ɛmɔka bie bɛma ye?

english_verse: If he took you to court, could you fool him, just as you fool others?
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔneanea ɛmɔ nu a, aso ɛmɔ nwo kɔyɛ sannwuu? Anaakyɛ, ɛmɔkɔhora bɛkɔlakalaka ye kyɛbɔ sona lakalaka sona anaa?

english_verse: If you were secretly unfair, he would correct you,
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, sɛ ɛmɔfea ɛmɔ nwo bɛka bie bɛma ye a, okohwi ɛmɔ nyunu.

english_verse: and his glorious splendor would make you terrified.
translation_verse: Ye tumi totohyia ne, aso ɔngɔma ɛmɔngosuro? Ye nwo suronyi ne, aso ɔngɔtɔ ɛmɔ so?

english_verse: Your wisdom and arguments will blow away like dust. Be Quiet While I Speak
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ anyandera ne, yɛte ye daa, mvasoɛ nne so, yeɛ ɛmɔ kurobɔlɛ ne koso, ɔndɔ asoɛ nu.

english_verse: Be quiet while I speak, and we'll see what happens.
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔma nya me so, ná ndwudwo, bɔ ɔkɔto me biala, maa ɔto me!

english_verse: I will be responsible for what happens to me.
translation_verse: Nzu ɔ? Ngɔyɔ bɔ ɔkɔma me ti kɔkeka ɔ, ngɔfa me ngoa ngɔto serewa.

english_verse: God may kill me, but still I will trust him and offer my defense.
translation_verse: Sɛ oku me po a, ye yeɛ ɔte m’anyelasoɛ ɔ, nakoso me ne ye yɛkɔbɔ kuro.

english_verse: This may be what saves me, because no guilty person would come to his court.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ me ngoalelɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ amumuyɛɛniɛ biala ngogyina ye nyunu.

english_verse: I have prepared my case well, and I am certain to win.
translation_verse: Me dwirɛ ne, madwene ye nwo masie, na mese kyɛ me nwo kofi.

english_verse: If you can prove me guilty, I will give up and die. Job Prays I Ask Only Two Things
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔne me yɛbaabɔ kuro ɔ? Ahaa ye de ngomua me noa ná mawu. Yob bisa Nyameɛ pena bɔne bɔ wayɔ ɔ

english_verse: I ask only two things of you, my God, and I will no longer hide from you—
translation_verse: Oo Nyameɛ, nikyee nyɔ pɛ yeɛ mebisa mefi wɔ berɛ ɔ, ɔba ye sɔ a, mengɔfa me nwo ngɔfea wɔ:

english_verse: Then speak, and I will reply; or else let me speak, and you reply.
translation_verse: Na afei, to wɔ sa frɛ me, na ngɔye me noa, anaakyɛ maa mmɔ me kuro ma ɛye ye noa.

english_verse: Please point out my sins, so I will know them.
translation_verse: Me mvomsoɛ ne me bɔne, ye somaa te nyɛɛ? Maa nwu me mmeraatolɛ ne me bɔne.

english_verse: Why have you turned your back and count me your enemy?
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ afa wɔ nyunu afea me e, bɔ afa me ayɛ wɔ pɔfoɛ ye?

english_verse: Do you really enjoy frightening a fallen leaf?
translation_verse: Nyaa bɔ mvrama bɔ ye kɔ ɔ, aso ekonwunanwuna ye? Aso ɛkɔfoa ɛserɛ worowaa?

english_verse: Why do you accuse me of horrible crimes and make me pay for sins I did in my youth?
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ edwirɛ tɛɛ yeɛ ɛkyerɛ tia me ɔ, na ɛfa me mmerandeɛ nu bɔne nwo akatuaa etua me so kerɛ.

english_verse: I am rotting away like cloth eaten by worms.
translation_verse: Sona de, ɔte kyɛ dufure, ɔporɔ, na ɔtete kyɛ ɛtena bɔ mvrɔlɔ ali ɔ.

english_verse: Life is short and sorrowful for every living soul.
translation_verse: “Dasaniɛ bɔ brasua awo ye ɔ, ye ngoa te tika, na amaneɛ ngome.

english_verse: We are flowers that fade and shadows that vanish.
translation_verse: Opukye kyɛ bakaa nyerɛen, na ɔkese, ɔpɛ nu kɔ kyɛ wawoɛ, na ɔngyɛ né watu wamini.

english_verse: There's no way a human can be completely pure.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora konya bɔ ye nwo te okofi bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ nu ɔ? Ebiala ngɔhora!

english_verse: Why don't you leave us alone and let us find some happiness while we toil and labor? When a Tree Is Chopped Down
translation_verse: nzaade yakyi ye ma ye nwo ɔtɔ ye e, kyɛbɔ paaniɛ yie ye adwuma a, ole anigye ɔnwondɛ kyɛ okonya ye ɛlɛho akatuaa ɔ.

english_verse: When a tree is chopped down, there is always the hope that it will sprout again.
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ bakaa po, anyelasoɛ wɔ berɛ ma ye, kyɛ bɛpɛ ye bɛto a, okosa kɔfefɛ, na okosa konya nyaa foforɛ.

english_verse: but at the touch of water, it sprouts once again.
translation_verse: nakoso sɛ onya nzue kaala pɛ a, ɔfefɛ, na ɔyeye mmaen kyɛ bakaa bɔ batu batɛ ɔ.

english_verse: We are like streams and lakes after the water has gone;
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ ɛkwaa nu nzue wewe, ná asue koso otu ɔbɔ mvuture ne,

english_verse: we fall into the sleep of death, never to rise again, until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: sɔ ala yeɛ dasaniɛ da berɛ, bɔ ondwɔso ko ɔ. Na anwuro onnya ɔppɛle nu ye de, bengotingye, yeɛ bengotingye bɛ ngofi bɛ nnaa nu.

english_verse: Please hide me, God, deep in the ground— and when you are angry no more, remember to rescue me. Will We Humans Live Again?
translation_verse: Oo, me ngome a, ahaa afa me afea wɔ ɛborɔ, ahaa afa me asie kɔpem kyɛ w’ahone kɔtɔ nzue nu ɔ, ahaa ahyɛ mmerɛ bɔ medi ye wɔ ɛborɔ dɔ ɔ, ná akaye me.

english_verse: Will we humans live again? I would gladly suffer and wait for my time.
translation_verse: Sɛ dasaniɛ wu a, ɔkɔtena ngoa nu bieku anaa? Koɛ noa bɔ ngyi wɔ m’asetena nu ye, ngɔnwondɛ, kɔpem kyɛ ngɔpɔno ngole me nwome ɔ.

english_verse: My Creator, you would want me; you would call out, and I would answer.
translation_verse: Ɛkɔfrɛ me, na ngosuro wɔ so, na wɔ wora kɔlɔ wɔ sa noa adwuma ne.

english_verse: You would take care of me, but not count my sins—
translation_verse: Afei, ɛkɔfa wɔ nye kɔsra m’agyirɛ biala bɔ ngotu ɔ, na mmom ɛngɔtetɛ me ngɔnea me bɔne.

english_verse: you would put them in a bag, tie it tight, and toss them away.
translation_verse: Ekowura me mmeraatolɛ kotoku nu kɔkyekye ye noa, na ɛkɔkata me bɔne so.

english_verse: But in the real world, mountains tumble, and rocks crumble;
translation_verse: “Nakoso, kyɛbɔ bokaa dwiri gua ase ɔnyoko, ná nyɔbotaen tu fi ye boso,

english_verse: streams wear away stones and wash away soil. And you destroy our hopes!
translation_verse: ná asue twi fa nyɔboɛ nwo maa ohi, ná asue yi pia aseɛnwo nnɛterɛ kɔ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛma dasaniɛ anyelasoɛ otu mini ɔ.

english_verse: You change the way we look, then send us away, wiped out forever.
translation_verse: Edi ye so tumi afebɔɔ, na ewue fa ye kɔ, ɛma ye nyunu sesã bɔ onzoma ye ɔ, na ede ye ngoa fi ye sa nu.

english_verse: We never live to know if our children are praised or disgraced.
translation_verse: Sɛ ye mma mɔ benya animnyam po a, ɔnze, yeɛ sɛ mmenia gua bɛ nyunu ase koso a, onnwu ye.

english_verse: We feel no pain but our own, and when we mourn, it's only for ourselves.
translation_verse: Ye bɔbɔ ye nwonaen nu yealɛ angome yeɛ ɔte ɔ, na ye kra sũ ye bɔbɔ ye nwo.”

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said: *
translation_verse: Yeɛ Temanniɛ Elifase buale kyɛ,

english_verse: you would stop spreading all of this hot air.
translation_verse: Aso odi kyɛ osu edwirɛ mbaen mbaen nwo aporowaa, ná ɔkekã edwirɛ bɔ mvasoɛ nne so anaa?

english_verse: Your words are enough to make others turn from God and lead them to doubt.
translation_verse: Ama Nyameɛ nwo surolɛ afi wɔ nu, na ɛmaa ɔyɛ se ma wɔ kyɛ ɛkɔbɔ mbaeɛ kohyire Nyameɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And your sinful, scheming mind is the source of all you say.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ bɔne yeɛ okyire wɔ edwirɛ bɔ ɛkeka ɔ, na nnakannakafoɛ dwirɛ yeɛ ɛkã ɔ.

english_verse: I am not here as your judge; your own words are witnesses against you.
translation_verse: Wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ noa dwirɛ yeɛ obua wɔ fɔ ɔ, na mmom nna me ɔ, amba, wɔ noa dwudwolɛ yeɛ odi adanzeɛ tia wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Were you the first human? Are you older than the hills?
translation_verse: “Aso wɔ yeɛ ɛte kuro sona bɔ belili moa bɛwole wɔ ɔ? Bɛwole wɔ koraka yeɛ bɛbɔ mmokaa ɔ?

english_verse: Have you ever been present when God's council meets? Do you alone have wisdom?
translation_verse: Nyameɛ mvealeɛ nu nhyehyɛleɛ ne, atie nu dwirɛ? Wɔ ngome yeɛ ɛse nworɛ ɔ?

english_verse: And you have been offered comforting words from God. Isn't this enough?
translation_verse: Nyameɛ aworakyekyerɛ dwirɛ ne, ɔne ye akorɔkorɔ dwirɛ ne, aso ebu ye kyɛ ɔte nikyee ba bie anaa?

english_verse: Your emotions are out of control, making you look fierce;
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ ɛpe dwirɛ nwo sɔa ye? Nzu ati yeɛ ama wɔ nye aboro ɔ,

english_verse: that's why you attack God with everything you say.
translation_verse: bɔ ɔnate so ama w’ahone ahu Nyameɛ so, bɔ ama sɔ dwirɛ ne afite wɔ noa ɔ?

english_verse: and neither are angels— not in the sight of God. If God doesn't trust his angels,
translation_verse: Tie, Nyameɛ ye krongronfoɛ po, ɔmva ye nwo ndo bɛ so, yeɛ anwuro po ye nwo nde wɔ ye nye so.

english_verse: what chance do humans have? We are so terribly evil that we thirst for sin. Just Listen to What I Know
translation_verse: Né nzaade busueniɛ bɔ ye suban aporɔ, bɔ wafa amumuyɛɛ wayɛ ye nzue ne, ogyi ye sɛ!

english_verse: Just listen to what I know, and you will learn
translation_verse: “Ngohyirehyire nu ngohyire wɔ, na tie me, bɔ manwu ye ne yeɛ ngɔhã ngohyire wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: wisdom known by others since ancient times.
translation_verse: Ɔte edwirɛ bɔ nworɛfoɛ baha bato berɛ, bɔ bɛ nana mɔ bamva banzie bɛ,

english_verse: Those who gained such insights also gained the land, and they were not influenced by foreign teachings.
translation_verse: bɔ bɛ nana mɔ ngome yeɛ Nyameɛ fale aseɛ ne mane bɛ ɔ, bɔ ɛwɔfoɛ biala wambɛ nu wɔ bɛ berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Even in times of success, they constantly hear the threat of doom.
translation_verse: Ahunundetelɛ ma ye so anu ndɔ ye, na ye asomdwee mmerɛ nu po, sɛkyefoɛ ne ba ye so.

english_verse: Darkness, despair, and death are their destiny.
translation_verse: Onne nni kyɛ okosa kofi awosii nu ɔ, na ye ayieleɛ ole ngrandɛ noa.

english_verse: They scrounge around for food, all the while dreading the approaching darkness.
translation_verse: Okyinikyini pena aleɛ, na obisa kyɛ, ‘Nisua yeɛ aleɛ wɔ ɔ?’ Na ɔse kyɛ ɔngɔhyɛ né awosii kyẽa ato ye.

english_verse: They are overcome with despair, like frightened soldiers facing a fearsome king in battle.
translation_verse: Aworabɔlɛ ne ahunundetelɛ nwunanwuna ye, na bɛba ye so kyɛ ɛhene bɔ waboaboa ye nwo ɔkɔ koɛ ɔ.

english_verse: This is because they rebelled against God All-Powerful
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ watengyɛ ye sa Nyameɛ nyunu, na wadwɔso watia Tuminiɛ ne.

english_verse: and have attacked him with their weapons.
translation_verse: Otira akokyɛm kubuu, bɔ wayɛ ye nwo lɔen wafa wahɔ ye so ɔ.

english_verse: but they will live in the ruins of deserted towns.
translation_verse: ɔkɔtena kurofoen so, ɔne awuro bɔ wakakyi dandue, bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ kyɛ okobu kogua ɔ.

english_verse: Their property and wealth will shrink and disappear.
translation_verse: Ongonya ye nwo, ye anwonya ne ngɔhyɛ, na ye anwonya ngotira ndii wɔ aseɛ so.

english_verse: They won't escape the darkness, and the blazing breath of God will set their future aflame. *
translation_verse: Ongofi awosii nu ngofite le, ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ bakaa, see kɔyera ye nyaa, na mvrama kohu ye nyerɛen ne kɔhɔ.

english_verse: Or like vineyards or orchards whose blossoms and unripe fruit drop to the ground.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔporo ye mma amui kogua kyɛbɔ bobe bakaa yɔ ne ala, yeɛ ɔkɔwoso ye nyerɛen kogua kyɛbɔ olive bakaa yɔ ne ala.

english_verse: Yes, the godless and the greedy will have nothing but flames feasting on their homes,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛ boso konua, na see kɔyera sua bɔ bafa fea-ase-ma basi ɔ.

english_verse: because they are the parents of trouble and vicious lies.
translation_verse: Bɛnwonzɛ nzɛmmɔne, na bɛwo musue, na nnakannaka ayi b’ahone nu.”

english_verse: I have often heard this, and it offers no comfort.
translation_verse: “Edwirɛ sɔaa mɔ de, mate pee, ɛmɔ amukoraa bayɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdodo me, nakoso ɛmɔgoro me nwo!

english_verse: If I were in your place, it would be easy to criticize or to give advice.
translation_verse: Tebea bɔ nwɔ nu ye, sɛ nu yeɛ ɛmɔ wɔ a, ahaa me koso ngɔhora ngodwudwo kyɛ ɛmɔ ala; ahaa ngɔhora ngodwudwo worɔworɔ ngogua ɛmɔ so, ná masere ɛmɔ.

english_verse: If I speak, or if I don't, I hurt all the same. My torment continues.
translation_verse: “Sɛ medwudwo a, me nwo tutulɛ ne ndɔ me, yeɛ sɛ mandɛ me noa nu koso a, nzikyɛ yakyilɛ yeɛ me nwo tutulɛ ne yakyi ɔ?

english_verse: God has worn me down and destroyed my family;
translation_verse: Amba, Nyameɛ amaa madwɔso me sonaluwaa so, wanua me nwo ama amukoraa bɛ boso.

english_verse: God is my hateful enemy, glaring at me and attacking with his sharp teeth.
translation_verse: Okyi me, na wafɛ yaa watete me nu pasapasa, wanwose ye gye wahyire me, me pɔfoɛ ne henahena ye nye kyire me.

english_verse: Everyone is against me; they sneer and slap my face.
translation_verse: Batu bɛ noa bagua me so, babobɔ me so anu bagoro me nwo, na bɛboa bɛ noa bɛko betia me.

english_verse: And God is the one who handed me over to this merciless mob. Everything Was Going Well
translation_verse: Nyameɛ afa me wawura busuefoɛ mɔ sa, na wasumu me wato nzɛmmɔnefoɛ bɛ sa nu.

english_verse: Everything was going well, until God grabbed my neck and shook me to pieces. God set me up as the target
translation_verse: Ahaa né me nwo atɔ me, nakoso wabu me nu gyein, obumane me kɔme, na ɔtetele me nu pasapasa; na watu ye nye wasie me so.

english_verse: for his arrows, and without showing mercy, he slashed my stomach open, spilling out my insides.
translation_verse: Ye agyaentolɛfoɛ bapɛ me nwo bayia, ɔpakyepakye me saa nu bɔ onnwu me anwumvoin ɔ, na otu m’abɔwee gua ase.

english_verse: and so, in my sorrow I dress in sackcloth and sit in the dust.
translation_verse: Mapa ɛsɛen tena mahera, na magyi m’anwoserɛ mato asefuo nu.

english_verse: My face is red with tears, and dark shadows circle my eyes,
translation_verse: Esuɛ ama me nyunu ayɛ yurohaa, na me nye asi apini wayɛ awosii tunn.

english_verse: though I am not violent, and my prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: Nakoso nnyɔle nzɛmmɔne biala, yeɛ me mbaeɛ nwo koso te.

english_verse: If I should die, I beg the earth not to cover my cry for justice.
translation_verse: “Oo aseɛ, nnɛkata me mogya so, nnɛma me sufrɛ ne ye bo pɛ.

english_verse: Even now, God in heaven is both my witness and my protector.
translation_verse: Na kekesaala ye po, tie, m’adanzeniɛ wɔ nyameɛso, yeɛ bɔ ɔka bie ma me ne koso ɔwɔ anwuro.

english_verse: My friends have rejected me, but God is the one I beg
translation_verse: Me damvo mɔ po bɛgoro me nwo, nakoso Nyameɛ yeɛ meporo moen mekyire ye ɔ,

english_verse: to show that I am right, just as a friend should.
translation_verse: kyɛ okoli sona ne Nyameɛ b’afia dwirɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ sona di obiɛngo ti dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Because in only a few years, I will be dead and gone.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ waha m’afoɛ kãa bie, né mahɔ nekaa bɔ bɛkɔ a benza bɛmma ɔ.

english_verse: My hopes have died, my time is up, and the grave is ready.
translation_verse: Me kra nwo ato, ewue apingye me, asieleɛ la berɛ ɔnwondɛ me.

english_verse: All I can see are angry crowds, making fun of me.
translation_verse: Susu amba kyɛ, ngorohoɛfoɛ bapɛ me nwo bayia, na me nye tua ngorohoɛ bɔ bɛgoro me nwo ɔ.

english_verse: If you, Lord, don't help, who will pay the price for my release?
translation_verse: “Gyina me gya nu fa wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo si awowaa; nwa yeɛ okoli me agyinamuɛ ɔ?

english_verse: My friends won't really listen, all because of you, and so you must be the one to prove them wrong.
translation_verse: Ato b’adwene nu ama bɛ ndeaseɛ abɔ bɛ, yiti ɛngɔma bengoli ngonim.

english_verse: They have condemned me, just to benefit themselves; now blind their children.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔye ye damvo mɔ ma, maa ɔnate so onya b’agyapadeɛ nu kyɛfa ne, sɔ bɔne ne nwo akatuaa kɔwa ye mma so.

english_verse: You, God, are the reason I am insulted and spit on.
translation_verse: “Wamaa mayɛ mmenia bɛ noa nu ngorohoɛ dwirɛ, na makakyi sona bɔ mmenia tiatia ye nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: I am almost blind with grief; my body is a mere shadow.
translation_verse: Aworabɔlɛ ama me nye mmaa apakye, na madwɔso me sonaluwaa so mayɛ kyɛ wawoɛ.

english_verse: People who are truly good would feel so alarmed, that they would become angry with my worthless friends.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ bɛtengyɛ ne, benwu me a, bɛ nwo dwiri bɛ, na sona bɔ odi be ne, ɔfɛ amumuyɛɛniɛ so yaa.

english_verse: They would do the right thing and because they did, they would grow stronger.
translation_verse: Nakoso sona bɔ ɔtengyɛ de, ye atee so yeɛ ɔnate ɔ, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛ bra te sannwuu ne, bɛkɔ so benya anwoserɛ.

english_verse: But none of my friends show any sense.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔhã bɔ ɛmɔkekã ne bieku, na mengonwu nworɛniɛ ko po wɔ ɛmɔ nu.

english_verse: My life is drawing to an end; hope has disappeared.
translation_verse: Ewue apingye me; me nzusuleɛ ayɛ mbaen, yeɛ bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo bɔ mepena ne koso, wayɛ mbaen.

english_verse: But all my friends can do is offer empty hopes.
translation_verse: Bɛfa alesaleɛ bɛkakyi alehyeleɛ, bɛka kyɛ, ‘Ɔngɔhyɛ né wata hyireinn, wɔ aberɛ bɔ awosii awa ɔ.’

english_verse: I could tell the world below to prepare me a bed.
translation_verse: Sɛ me nye la so kyɛ ɛborɔ kɔyɛ m’awuro, sɛ meto me mba wɔ awosii nu,

english_verse: Then I could greet the grave as my father and say to the worms, “Hello, mother and sisters!”
translation_verse: ná mekã mekyire asieleɛ kumaa kyɛ, ‘Me se ole wɔ,’ ɔne nnɔboakoma kyɛ, ‘Me ni ne nniɛma brasua ole wɔ’ a,

english_verse: But what kind of hope is that?
translation_verse: né m’anyelasoɛ wɔ ni? Nwa yeɛ okonwu m’anyelasoɛ ne ɔ?

english_verse: Will it keep me company in the world of the dead?
translation_verse: M’anyelasoɛ ne, aso ɔne me koowura ɛborɔ dɔ pambim ne anu? Aso yɛkɔbɔ nu yɛkɔhɔ mvuture nu?

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Yeɛ Suhiniɛ Bildade buale kyɛ,

english_verse: How long will you talk? Be sensible! Let us speak.
translation_verse: “Kyinzu yeɛ ɛmɔkɔyakyi edwirɛ mbaen mbaen ne kekanɛ ɔ? Ɛ́mɔfa bɛhɔ adwenedwene nu, ná afei yɛtoa so yɛdwudwo.

english_verse: You cut yourself in anger. Will that shake the earth or even move the rocks? *
translation_verse: Wɔ bɔ wɔ yaafɛlɛ amaa atete pasapasa ɔ. Ɔnate wɔ ti odi kyɛ mmenia tu fi aseɛ so anaa, anaakyɛ odi kyɛ betutu nyɔbotaen mɔ befi bɛ boso anaa?

english_verse: The lamps of sinful people soon are snuffed out,
translation_verse: “Nahorɛ nu, amumuyɛɛniɛ kanea nua, na ye see te mosonomosono.

english_verse: Their powerful legs become weak, and they stumble on schemes of their own doing. *
translation_verse: Ye natelɛ nu anwoserɛ noa kɔbrɛ ase, na ye bɔbɔ ye porɛ bɔ ɔbɔ ɔ yeɛ ofi ye ase ɔ.

english_verse: they are trapped in a net,
translation_verse: Kafoli kɔsɔ ye gya ndii nu, ná tukɔ ahye ye asie berɛ.

english_verse: Terror strikes and pursues from every side.
translation_verse: Ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ ye so wɔ nekaa biala, na ahunundetelɛ kɔfoa ye koli ye si.

english_verse: Starving, they run, only to meet disaster,
translation_verse: Ɛhɔen kɔma ye anwoserɛ koyie, na musue asiesie ye nwo kyɛ ɔkɔmaa okosoti.

english_verse: then afterwards to be eaten alive by death itself.
translation_verse: Anwonyerɛ didi ye nwonaen, na ewue anwonyerɛ suronyisuronyi didi ye gya ne ye sa.

english_verse: Those sinners are dragged from the safety of their tents to die a gruesome death.
translation_verse: Ye awuro bɔ ɔte ye anyelasoɛ ne, betu ye befi nu, na bɛtwe ye bɛkɔ ɛhene atianuserɛniɛ ne nyunu.

english_verse: Then their tents and possessions are burned to ashes,
translation_verse: Ebiala kora tena nu, ofikyɛ nna ye awuro ahɔ ko, na bɛfa sɔfe bɛpetepete berɛ.

english_verse: and they are left like trees, dried up from the roots.
translation_verse: Ye ndii twindwam wɔ aseɛnwo, na ye mmaen koso kese wɔ anwuro.

english_verse: thrown far from the light into a world of darkness,
translation_verse: Befindi ye befi nekaa bɔ ɔte hyireinn nu bɛto awosii nu, na betu ye befi wiase.

english_verse: Everyone, from east to west, is overwhelmed with horror.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ bɔ ɔkɔto ye ne, ɔkɔma eyia atɔleɛfoɛ bɛ nwo kodwiri bɛ, na ɛserɛ kɔha eyia afiteleɛfoɛ.

english_verse: Such is the fate of sinners and their families who don't know God.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, sɔ yeɛ amumuyɛɛfoɛ b’ayieleɛ yie bɛ ɔ, na bɛ bɔ bɛnze Nyameɛ ne, bɔ ɔto bɛ hɔ ala ɛne.”

english_verse: How long will you torture me with your words?
translation_verse: “Kyinzu koraa yeɛ ɛmɔkɔyakyi me halɛ ɔ? Kyinzu koraa yeɛ ɛmɔkɔyakyi edwirɛ bɔ ɛmɔka bɛteetee me ye ɔ?

english_verse: Isn't ten times enough for you to accuse me? Aren't you ashamed?
translation_verse: Pɛen buru mumua ɛhe yeɛ ɛmɔadwudwo batia me ɔ, aso ɔnyɛ ɛmɔ nya kyɛ ɛmɔmaa mefa yealɛ nu ɔ?

english_verse: Even if I have sinned, you haven't been harmed.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔte nahorɛ po kyɛ mayɔ mvomsoɛ a, me mvomsoɛ mata me.

english_verse: You boast of your goodness, claiming I am suffering because I am guilty.
translation_verse: Susu amba kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔdwene kyɛ ɛmɔte paa bɛtra me, ná ɛmɔbu m’amaneɛnwunɛ ne kyɛ ɔte me bɔne nwo adanzeɛ a,

english_verse: But God is the one at fault for finding fault with me.
translation_verse: ye de memaa ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ, Nyameɛ yeɛ wama ɛhe ato me ɔ, na wagua ye asawu wahye me.

english_verse: Though I pray to be rescued from this torment, no whisper of justice answers me.
translation_verse: Na sɛ metea nu kyɛ, ‘Ebie le me oo!’ a, ebiala ndɛ me so, yeɛ metea nu mepena mmokalɛ koso a, ebiala nga bie mma me.

english_verse: God has me trapped with a wall of darkness
translation_verse: Wayɔ aberedwaa wafa me nwo, bɔ mengora menze mengɔ ɔ, na wama m’atee so ayɛ awosii.

english_verse: and attacks with fierce anger, as though I were his enemy.
translation_verse: Wama ye ahone ahu me so, na obu me ye pɔfoɛ.

english_verse: and when I call my servants, they pay no attention.
translation_verse: Mefrɛ me somvoɛ a, ɔndɛ me so, sana mebukye me noa mesrɛ ye koraka.

english_verse: My breath disgusts my wife; everyone in my family turns away.
translation_verse: Me ye po, me nwomeɛ bo ye, na me kunu mmaa po, bɛmbena me nyunu bɛnnea.

english_verse: Young children can't stand me, and when I come near, they make fun.
translation_verse: Ngwadaa mmaa mmaa po, bebu me animtia, na sɛ meyɛ kyɛ menatenate a, né bɛgoro me nwo.

english_verse: I am skin and bones— just barely alive.
translation_verse: Me nwo ayeye mmowue mmowue, na mawu mayie, bɔ ewue li me mvanvando ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you for pity! God has made me his target.
translation_verse: Ao, me damvo mɔ, ɛ́mɔnwu me anwumvoin e, ɛ́mɔnwu me anwumvoin e, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ate ye sa wapura me!

english_verse: I wish that my words could be written down
translation_verse: “O, sɛ ahaa bɛkyerɛ me dwirɛ ne a! Sɛ ahaa bɛkyerɛ begua nwomaa nu a!

english_verse: I know that my Protector lives, and at the end he will stand on this earth.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me de, mese kyɛ me Defoɛ ne ɔte ase, na ayieleɛ ne, okoli me dwirɛ kɔma me wɔ aseɛ ye aso.

english_verse: My flesh may be destroyed, yet from this body I will see God.
translation_verse: Na sɛ anwonyerɛ didi me wereɛ sɛkye ye yie a, ndɛ wɔ anwoɔnaen nu ye de, ngonwu Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Yes, I will see him for myself, and I long for that moment.
translation_verse: Ye bɔ me bɔbɔ ngonwu ye, me nye konwu ye ɔ, ná ɔngɔyɛ me nye so wɔfoɛ ɔ. Me wora dɔ kyɛ sɔ mmerɛ ne kodwu!

english_verse: My friends, you think up ways to blame and torment me, saying I brought it on myself.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔka kyɛ, ‘Yɛkɔyɔ sɛɛ né yatane ye nye?’ ɔne kyɛ, ‘Amaneɛ bɔ onwu ye ne, ofi ye bɔbɔ’ a,

english_verse: Zophar from Naamah said:
translation_verse: Afei Naamaniɛ Sofa buale kyɛ,

english_verse: You have accused and insulted me, and reason requires a reply.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ bɔ mate kyɛ ɛkeka ne, otwi me, na me ndeaseɛ kanyane me kyɛ mma wɔ mmuayɛɛ.

english_verse: Since the time of creation, everyone has known
translation_verse: Yiti ɛnze kyɛ ofi tetetete, ofi mmerɛ bɔ Ɛdangama bɔle sona tole aseɛ ye aso ɔ,

english_verse: Though their pride and power may reach to the sky,
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɔmoma ye nwo so kodwu anwuro anwuro, ma ye ti kɔka munungum de,

english_verse: they will disappear like dust, and those who knew them will wonder what happened.
translation_verse: nakoso ye boso komini kyɛ ye bɔbɔ ye bondua; na bɛ bɔ banwu ye ne, bekobisa kyɛ, ‘Ɔwɔ nisua?’

english_verse: They will be forgotten like a dream
translation_verse: Okotu komini kyɛ laleɛ, bengonwu ye ko; ye boso komini kyɛ kɔngɔen nyekyire.

english_verse: Their children will have to repay what the parents took from the poor.
translation_verse: Ye mma mɔ kɔfa mbata kɔma ehiafoɛ, na ye anwonya bɔ wanya ye ne, okopu kɔwa.

english_verse: Indeed, the wicked will die and go to their graves in the prime of life. Sinners Love the Taste of Sin
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ye mmerandeɛ nu anwoserɛ ma ye mmowue nu yɛ se de, nakoso ɔkɔfa kɔhɔ kumaa nu.

english_verse: Sinners love the taste of sin; they relish every bite
translation_verse: “Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ amumuyɛɛ te ye noa nu menemene, yeɛ ɔfa fea ye temverema bo de,

english_verse: But their food will turn sour and poison their stomachs.
translation_verse: nakoso ye aleɛ dwu ye kunu dɔ a, ɔkakyi yɛ weewee, na ɔyɛ ɛkyenebene noa borɔ wɔ ye nu.

english_verse: Then God will make them lose the wealth they gobbled up.
translation_verse: Ɔsesa anwonya ɔbɔ so meme, nakoso osa fe bɛ ba, Nyameɛ tu anwonya ne fi ye kunu dɔ gua.

english_verse: They will die from the fangs of poisonous snakes
translation_verse: Ɔkɔtafe ɛkyenebene borɔ, na ɛbɔnaa yeɛ ɔkɔha ye kohũ ye ɔ.

english_verse: and never enjoy rivers flowing with milk and honey.
translation_verse: Ye nye ngonwu asue mmaa mmaa mɔ, ongonwu woɛ ne nyɔfonesue asue bɔ ɔtengyɛ ne.

english_verse: But when nothing remains for them to grab, they will be nothing.
translation_verse: Odidi a, ɔnyakyi bie, yiti ye anwonya ngosi pasiliwa biala.

english_verse: Once they have everything, distress and despair will strike them down,
translation_verse: Ye anwonya mmorosoɛ ne asi ne po, ye nwo ngɔtɔ ye, na musue amukoraa kɔtoto ye.

english_verse: While running from iron spears, they will be killed by arrows of bronze,
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔnwati fi buralɛ akodeɛ noa a, kɔɔbere agyaen kosina ye.

english_verse: whose shining tips go straight through their bodies. They will be trapped by terror,
translation_verse: Agyaen ne sina ye fite, ye noa ne sina ye abɔwee nu fite, na ewue nwo suronyi tɔ ye so.

english_verse: and what they treasure most will be lost in the dark. God will send flames to destroy them in their tents with all their property.
translation_verse: Basiesie awosii tunn bato berɛ bama ye anwonyadeɛ, see bɔ nna sona yeɛ ofita nu ɔ yeɛ ɔkɔyera ye ɔ, na ebiala bɔ waha ye awuro berɛ ne, ɔkɔyera kɔtɔ nzoen.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth will testify against them,
translation_verse: Nyameɛso kɔma ye amumuyɛɛ nwo kɔla berɛ, na aseɛ kodwɔso kotia ye.

english_verse: and all their possessions will be dragged off when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: Nzue koyi kɔfa ye awuro agyapadeɛ, okopia agyapadeɛ ne kɔhɔ wɔ Nyameɛ ɛyaafɛlɛ kyẽa ne.

english_verse: This is what God has decided for those who are evil.
translation_verse: Sɔ yeɛ Nyameɛ ma amumuyɛɛniɛ ayieleɛ yie ye ɔ, agyapadeɛ bɔ Nyameɛ ahyehyɛ wato berɛ wama ye hɔ ɛne.”

english_verse: If you want to offer comfort, then listen to me.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ betie me dwirɛ ye yé, ná ɔyɛ aworakyekyerɛ bɔ ngonya ngofi ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And when I have finished, you can start your insults all over again.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma me koso ndwudwo bie, na sɛ medwudwo meyie a, afei né ɛmɔagoro me nwo.

english_verse: My complaint is against God; that's why I am impatient.
translation_verse: Me de, aso dasaniɛ yeɛ mebɔ ye somoɛ anaa? Nzu ati yeɛ ɔnzɛ kyɛ mefɛ yaa ɔ?

english_verse: Just looking at me is enough to make you sick,
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea tebea bɔ nwɔ nu ɔ, na ɔkɔyɛ ɛmɔ aworabɔ maa ɛmɔkɔfa ɛmɔ sa bɛkɔsɔ ɛmɔ noa.

english_verse: and the very thought of myself fills me with disgust.
translation_verse: Sɛ medwene ye nwo a, né ɔyɛ me suro, na ɔma me nwo wosowoso me.

english_verse: Why do evil people live so long and gain such power?
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ bɔnefoɛ mɔ bɛkɔ so benya ngoa ɔ, benyi bɛkyɛ, ná bɛkɔ so benya ngɔsoɛ mbiri mbiri ɔ?

english_verse: They have no worries at home, and God never punishes them.
translation_verse: Asomdwee wɔ b’awuro, bɔ ahunundetelɛ biala nne berɛ ɔ, yeɛ Nyameɛ asohwenɛ ne bie ɔmma bɛ so.

english_verse: Their cattle have lots of calves without ever losing one;
translation_verse: Ye nandwie nyii ɔkɔ so wo, na ye nandwie beleɛ kɔ so wo mmaa, bɔ ɔmbɔ ba ɔ.

english_verse: These people sing and celebrate to the sound of tambourines, small harps, and flutes,
translation_verse: Bɛfa akasaa ne sangoo bɛkenga dwein bɛto, na behu awɛen bɛma bɛ nye gye.

english_verse: and they are successful, without a worry, until the day they die. Leave Us Alone!
translation_verse: Amumuyɛɛfoɛ di bɛ mmerɛ wɔ anwonya nu, na afei, bɛkɔ ɛborɔ.

english_verse: Those who are evil say to God All-Powerful, “Leave us alone! Don't bother us with your teachings.
translation_verse: Bɛka bekyire Nyameɛ kyɛ, ‘Fi yɛ so kɔ! Ofikyɛ yɛmbena kyɛ yɛnya w’atee nwo nimdeɛ biala.

english_verse: We succeeded all on our own.” And so, I keep away from them and their evil schemes.
translation_verse: Tie, bɛ ngɔsoɛ ne, aso nna bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ sa nu yeɛ ɔwɔ ɔ? Mekyi bɔnefoɛ foɛtulɛ kɔkɔkɔkɔ.

english_verse: How often does God become angry and send disaster and darkness to punish sinners?
translation_verse: “Nea kyɛbɔ bɔnefoɛ ye kanea ɔtaa nua ɔ! Nea kyɛbɔ musue taa toto ye ɔ! Nea kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ osi kyekyɛ aworabɔlɛ wɔ ye yaafɛlɛ nu ɔ!

english_verse: How often does he strike them like a windstorm that scatters straw?
translation_verse: Pɛen nyɛɛ yeɛ mvrama ɔbɔ bɛ kɔ kyɛ ɛserɛ ɔ? Pɛen nyɛɛ yeɛ mvrama piri ɔbɔ bɛ kɔ kyɛ afafu ɔ?

english_verse: You say, “God will punish those sinners' children in place of those sinners.” But I say, “Let him punish those sinners themselves until they really feel it.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔnwa: ‘Bɔnefoɛ amumuyɛɛ nwo asohwenɛ ne, Nyameɛ boaboa ye noa gua berɛ ma ye mma mɔ.’ Na mesrɛ kyɛ, ótua ye bɔbɔ ye kerɛ ma onwu ye.

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful force them to drink their own destruction from the cup of his anger.
translation_verse: Mesrɛ kyɛ ye bɔbɔ ye nye onwu musue bɔ ɔkɔto ye ɔ, mesrɛ kyɛ onwu amaneɛ wɔ Tuminiɛ ne ye ɛyaafɛlɛ nu.

english_verse: Because after they are dead, they won't care what happens to their children.” Who Can Tell God What To Do?
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, sɛ ye ngoa bo pɛ a, nikyee biala bɔ ɔkɔto ye abusua bɔ wayakyi ye berɛ ne, ɔmva ye nwo.

english_verse: Who can tell God what to do? He judges powerful rulers. *
translation_verse: Aso ebie kɔhora kohyire Nyameɛ nworɛ, ye bɔ obua nyameɛsofoɛ ndɛen ɔ?

english_verse: while others die in poverty, having known only pain.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ebie wora, ye kra di aworabɔlɛ kɔ ewue nu, bɔ onnya asetena nu anigye ɔ.

english_verse: But we all end up dead, beneath a blanket of worms.
translation_verse: Nakoso besie bɛ mukoraa wɔ nnɛterɛ nu, na nnɔboakoma to fa bɛ nwo.

english_verse: My friends, I know that you are plotting against me.
translation_verse: “Nea, manwu ɛmɔ adwene, ɔne porɛ bɔ ɛmɔabɔ bafa me nwo ɔ.

english_verse: You ask, “Where is the home of that important person who does so much evil?”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔnwa: ‘Sona titire ne, ye awuro ne wɔ ni? Ɛtena sua bɔ amumuyɛɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛtenane nu ne, ɔwɔ ni?’

english_verse: that those who do wrong never suffer disaster, when God becomes angry.
translation_verse: kyɛ kyẽa bɔ asane kosi ne, amumuyɛɛniɛ onya ye ti didi nu ɔ, kyɛ ɛyaafɛlɛ kyẽa ne, bɛpepɛ bede ye ɔ?

english_verse: Then at their funerals, they are highly praised;
translation_verse: Sɛ bekosie ye a, bɛwɛne ye asieleɛ ne.

english_verse: Eliphaz from Teman said:
translation_verse: Temanniɛ Elifase buale kyɛ,

english_verse: What use are we humans to God, even the wisest of us?
translation_verse: “Aso dasaniɛ nwo kɔhora konya mvasoɛ kɔma Nyameɛ anaa? Nworɛniɛ po, aso ye nwo le mvasoɛ ma ye anaa?

english_verse: If you were completely sinless, that would still mean nothing to God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛtengyɛ a, ɔfa Tuminiɛ ne nwo nzu, yeɛ sɛ ngekalewa nne wɔ bra nu a, nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ onya ye ɔ?

english_verse: No! It's because of your terrible and endless sins.
translation_verse: Aso nna wɔ bɔne bɔ ɔte piri ti ɔ? W’amumuyɛɛ ne, ɔtra so.

english_verse: To guarantee payment of a debt, you have taken clothes from innocent people.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ama eliɛma mɔ bafa bɛ nningyein basi wɔ berɛ awowaa mbaen, na apa bɛ nwo tena ama bɛ nwo ala so.

english_verse: And you refused bread and water to the hungry and thirsty,
translation_verse: Sona bɔ wayɛ bɛtɛɛ ne, amma ye nzue, yeɛ bɔ ɛhɔen ku ye ne koso, afa aleɛ abɔ ye aheɛ.

english_verse: You have turned away widows and have broken the arms of orphans.
translation_verse: Ama akunafoɛ mmrasua bele nzanza basa bahɔ, na asisi awisiafoɛ.

english_verse: blinded by darkness, and drowned in a flood. God Lives in the Heavens
translation_verse: Awosii asi wɔ nye bɔ ennwu nikye ɔ, na nzue ayi afa wɔ nwo nekaa biala.

english_verse: God lives in the heavens above the highest stars, where he sees everything.
translation_verse: “Aso nna nyameɛso anwuro anwuro yeɛ Nyameɛ wɔ ɔ? To wɔ nye nea anwuro anwuro nzramaa mɔ, ná nwu kyɛbɔ besi bɛwɔ dededede ɔ!

english_verse: Do you think the deep darkness hides you from God?
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛnwa: ‘Nyameɛ ɔse nzu? Awosii kabii ye, aso okonwu yɛ kobua yɛ ndɛen?

english_verse: Do thick clouds cover his eyes, as he walks around heaven's dome high above the earth?
translation_verse: Munungum kabii amundu ye nwo, bɔ ɔmma onnwu nikye ɔ, na ɔnate anwuro kango ne aso.

english_verse: Give up those ancient ideas believed by sinners,
translation_verse: Tete atennaa bɔ amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛfale so ne, so yeɛ ɛkɔfa hɔ anaa?

english_verse: although he had been kind to their families. The beliefs of these sinners are truly disgusting.
translation_verse: Nakoso ye yeɛ wafa nningyein paa wayi b’awuro tɛkyɛɛ ɔ, na me de, mekyi bɔnefoɛ bɛ foɛtulɛ kɔkɔkɔkɔ.

english_verse: saying, “Our enemies are gone, and fire has destroyed their possessions.” Surrender to God All-Powerful
translation_verse: ‘Amba, yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ boso anua, na agyapadeɛ bɔ bayakyi ye berɛ ne, see ayera ye.’

english_verse: Listen to his teachings and take them to heart.
translation_verse: Di ye noa dwirɛ so, ná fa ye dwirɛ sie wɔ ti anu.

english_verse: If you return to God and turn from sin, all will go well for you.
translation_verse: Sɛ esa kɔ Tuminiɛ ne berɛ a, ɔkɔmaa ekosa kɔpe wɔ daa nu; sɛ etu bra fiɛ bo efi w’awuro kɔ dededede a,

english_verse: So get rid of your finest gold, as though it were sand.
translation_verse: sɛ ebu sikaa kɔkorɛ kyɛ mvuture a, ɔne Ofire sikaa kɔkorɛ kyɛ asue nu nyɔboseka,

english_verse: Let God All-Powerful be your silver and gold,
translation_verse: ná ɛfa Tuminiɛ ne ɛyɛ wɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ, ɔne wɔ dwetɛ paa paa a,

english_verse: and you will find happiness by worshiping him.
translation_verse: ye de ekonya anika wɔ Tuminiɛ ne anu, ná ama wɔ nye so anea Nyameɛ.

english_verse: God will answer your prayers, and you will keep the promises you made to him.
translation_verse: Ɛkɔfa wɔ dwirɛ kɔto ye nyunu, na okotie wɔ, ná atua w’aboadeɛ.

english_verse: He will do whatever you ask, and life will be bright.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɛkɔfa kosie wɔ nye so biala, ɔkɔyɛ berɛ kɔma wɔ, na kanea kɔta w’atee so.

english_verse: When others are disgraced, God will clear their names in answer to your prayers.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔbrɛ ebiemɔ ase a, ɛnwa anwomasoɛ ti ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔpepɛ de anwobrɛaseɛniɛ.

english_verse: Even those who are guilty will be forgiven, because you obey God.
translation_verse: Sɛ sona bɔ onni be po, okole ye a, nzaade wɔ nwo bɔ ɔte ne, okogyina so kole wɔ.”

english_verse: Today I complain bitterly, because God has been cruel and made me suffer.
translation_verse: “Ɛnɛ koso, me nye aboro yeɛ mebɔ somoɛ ɔ, me penenɛ bɔ mepene ne asi ne po, wasa wafa amaneɛ wato me so.

english_verse: If I knew where to find God, I would go there
translation_verse: Ao! Sɛ ahaa mese nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ hɔ a, sɛ ngɔhora ngoodwu nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ hɔ a!

english_verse: Then I would discover what he wanted to say.
translation_verse: Ahaa ngɔte ye mmuayɛɛ bɔ ɔkɔfa kɔma me ɔ, ná mate bɔ ɔkɔha kohyire me ne abo.

english_verse: Would he overwhelm me with his greatness? No! He would listen
translation_verse: Ye tumi piri ne, so yeɛ okogyina ɔne me kɔbɔ nguro anaa? Daabi, ɔkɔyɛ asoɛ kotie me dwirɛ deɛ.

english_verse: because I am innocent, and he would say, “I now set you free!”
translation_verse: Berɛ de, sona bɔ ɔtengyɛ ne, ɔkora ne ye bɛbɔ nguro, na me ndɛenbualɛniɛ ne, okobua me be afebɔɔ.

english_verse: I cannot find God anywhere— in front or back of me,
translation_verse: “Tie, sɛ mekɔ me nyunu a, ɔnne berɛ, yeɛ mekɔ me si koso a, mennwu ye.

english_verse: to my left or my right. God is always at work, though I never see him.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔyɔ adwuma wɔ me bɛen so a, mennwu ye, yeɛ sɛ mekɔ famaa so koso a, me nye mbɛ ye so.

english_verse: But he knows what I am doing, and when he tests me, I will be pure as gold. *
translation_verse: Nakoso ye de, ɔse atee bɔ mefa so ɔ, na sɛ oso me nea a, ngofi nu ngofite ma me nwo kɔyɛ hyɛmm kyɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ.

english_verse: I have never refused to follow any of his commands,
translation_verse: Mafa ye gya boso atee so pɛpɛɛpɛ, na mali ye dwirɛ so bɔ manni ye nwo makyebu ɔ.

english_verse: But he alone is God, and who can oppose him? God does as he pleases,
translation_verse: Ye de, ye adwene nzesã, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora maa ɔkɔkakyi ye adwene ɔ? Bɔ okuro ne yeɛ ɔyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: and he will do exactly what he intends with me. *
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, bɔ wahyehyɛ wato berɛ wama me ne, ɔkɔmaa ɔkɔwa nu, na ole sɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne pee wɔ ye ti anu.

english_verse: God has covered me with darkness, but I refuse to be silent.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mandu mammini wɔ awosii ne anu, nakoso wafa awosii kabii wamundu me nyunu.

english_verse: Why doesn't God set a time for court? Why don't his people know where he can be found?
translation_verse: “Tuminiɛ ne, nzu ati yeɛ ondu mmerɛ bie nzie berɛ mva mmua bɔnefoɛ mɔ ndɛen ɔ? Bɛ bɔ bedi ye dwirɛ so ne, nzu ati yeɛ bennwu ye ndɛenbualɛ mmerɛ ne ɔ?

english_verse: Sinners remove boundary markers and take care of sheep they have stolen.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ mɔ pimbi ɛwɛen, bewua nyɛmmoa besie bɛ bɛfa.

english_verse: They cheat orphans and widows by taking their donkeys and oxen.
translation_verse: Bɛkye awisiafoɛ b’afunum mɔ bɛkɔ, bede akunafoɛ mmrasua bɛ nandwie nyii bɛfa besi awowaa.

english_verse: in the desert, where they and their children must live like wild donkeys and search for food.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ eburo afunum ɔyɔ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ehiafoɛ dwɔso kɔyɔ adwuma ɔ, bɛpɛ aleɛ bɛkɔpena bɛ noa aleɛ, na ɛserɛ so yeɛ bɛkɔtweetwee bɛpena aleɛ bɛma bɛ mma ɔ.

english_verse: If they want grain or grapes, they must go to the property of these sinners.
translation_verse: Bɛpɛ ngaka aleɛ wɔ eburo, na bɔnefoɛ fieso aleɛ bɔ bafa ne, ye si bɔ waha berɛ ne yeɛ ehiafoɛ bɛsesa ɔ.

english_verse: They sleep naked in the cold, because they have no cover,
translation_verse: Kɔngɔen bɛda kwaterekwa bɔ bennya ɛtena ɔ, na ɛyerɛ ku bɛ a, bennya nikyee fee mva ngurɔ bɛ nwo.

english_verse: and during a storm their only shelters are caves among the rocky cliffs.
translation_verse: Mmokaa so esue bo bɛ ma bɛ nwo doa, na bennya nekaa bɛmvea ne ati, bɛte bɛmata nyɔbotaen.

english_verse: Children whose fathers have died are taken from their mothers as payment for a debt.
translation_verse: “Bɔnefoɛ mɔ bɛte adɔma awisianiɛ befi nyɔfone noa, na bɛfa ye besi oni ehianiɛ kerɛ nu awowaa.

english_verse: Then they are forced to work naked in the grain fields because they have no clothes, and they go hungry.
translation_verse: Ehiafoɛ natenate bɔ bɛ nwo la so ɔ, ofikyɛ belle ɛtena, na bɛ kunu hɔen yeɛ bɛfa bɛsoa ebiemɔ aburoo bɔ babu ɔ.

english_verse: They crush olives to make oil and grapes to make wine— but still they go thirsty.
translation_verse: Ehiafoɛ betwi ngoo wɔ nyɔboɛ nyɔ b’afia, betwi bobe mmaa nu bɛyɔ nzaa, nakoso nzuhɔen ku bɛ.

english_verse: And along the city streets, the wounded and dying cry out, yet God does nothing. Some Reject the Light
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ bɛla awusu ne, yɛte bɛ penelɛ ne nga wɔ kuro piri ne aso, na bɛ bɔ bapira ne, bɛ kra bɔ awuye bɛpena mmokalɛ, nakoso Nyameɛ ndɛ bɛ so.

english_verse: Soon after sunset they murder the poor and the needy, and at night they steal.
translation_verse: Wudiniɛ dwɔso alebahyene, kyɛ ɔkwaahu sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ɔ, ɔne ehianiɛ, na odwu kɔngɔen a, ɔte kyɛ awueniɛ.

english_verse: Others wait for the dark, thinking they won't be seen if they sleep with the wife or husband of someone else.
translation_verse: Bienzua bɔ ɔsɛkye agyaa ne, ɔnwondɛ kyɛ aleɛ kɔsa ɔ, ɔka kyɛ, ‘Ebiala nye ngɔpɛ me so’, na ɔfa nikyee kata ye nyunu.

english_verse: Robbers hide during the day, then break in after dark because they reject the light.
translation_verse: Awosii ba a, otofi sua terɛ nu tokuro, aleɛ kye koso a, ɔto ye nwo anoa nu, na ɔnze kyɛbɔ alehyeleɛ si te hyireinn ɔ.

english_verse: They prefer night to day, since the terrors of the night are their friends. Sinners Are Filthy Foam
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia ne amukoraa, awosii kabii yeɛ ɔte bɛ ngyerɛmɔ ɔ, na bɛfa awosii kabii nu nningyein suronyisuronyi abiɛngoɛ.

english_verse: Those sinners are filthy foam on the surface of the water. And so, their fields and vineyards will fall under a curse and won't produce.
translation_verse: “Otu mini kyɛ ahure bɔ ɔwɔ nzue nye so ɔ, ye aseɛ bɔ ole ye wɔ aseɛ ye aso ne, banoma ye, na sona biala ngɔ ye bobe boo nu.

english_verse: Just as the heat of summer swallows the snow, the world of the dead swallows those who sin.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ wawa ne ahuhuro ma asukɔtwea nzue huro ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛborɔ dɔ ma bɔnefoɛ betu bemini ɔ.

english_verse: Forgotten here on earth, and with their power broken, they taste sweet to worms.
translation_verse: Koɛsɛen bɔ ɔwole ye ne, ye wora fi ye, ɔkakyi nnɔboakoma mɔ b’aleɛ, mmenia ngaye ye ko, na sɔ yeɛ amumuyɛɛ nu bubu kyɛ bakaa ɔ.

english_verse: Sinners take advantage of widows and other helpless women.
translation_verse: “Brasua mmotaen bɔ ɔnnwo ɔ po, osisi ye, na onnwu brasua kunaniɛ anwumvoin.

english_verse: But God's mighty strength destroys those in power. Even if they seem successful, they are doomed to fail.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ nate ye tumi so ɔma tumifoɛ ngoa tendenn, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛ bo tindim de, nakoso belle anyelasoɛ.

english_verse: God may let them feel secure, but they are never out of his sight.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔ bɛ nwo waen ogyina bɛ si, nakoso ye nye li b’atee bɔ bɛnate so ɔ si.

english_verse: Great for a while; gone forever! Sinners are mowed down like weeds, then they wither and die.
translation_verse: Benya ngɔsoɛ, nakoso ɔngyɛ né bɛnne berɛ ko, bɛkese, na betwindwam kyɛ ngyɛngyɛma, na bɛpɛ bɛ begua kyɛ aburoo.

english_verse: Bildad from Shuah said:
translation_verse: Yeɛ Suhiniɛ Bildade buale kyɛ,

english_verse: God is the one to fear, because God is in control and rules the heavens.
translation_verse: “Nyameɛ yeɛ ole tumi ná ye nwo yɛ suro ɔ, ɔhyehyɛ asomdwee wɔ ye nyameɛso anwuro anwuro.

english_verse: Who can count his army of stars? Isn't God the source of light?
translation_verse: Ye lɔen ne, aso ɛka bɛ a ekonwu ye noa? Nwa yeɛ Nyameɛ kanea nda ye so ɔ?

english_verse: To him, not even the light of the moon and stars can ever be pure.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛsraen po ɔnda hyireinn wɔ ye nye so, yeɛ nzramaa mɔ po bɛ nwo nde wɔ ye nyunu a,

english_verse: So how can we humans, when we are merely worms?
translation_verse: né nzaade dasaniɛ bɔ ɔte nnɔboakoma ɔ, kuro sona bɔ ɔte esuronyi ɔ, ogyi ye sɛ!”

english_verse: You have given great advice and wonderful wisdom to someone truly in need.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔnze nworɛ ne, foɛ bɔ atu ye hɔ ɛne! Eh! Foɛ paa pee bɔ afa ama ye hɔ ɛne!

english_verse: Remember the terrible trembling of those in the world of the dead below the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Awufoɛ mɔ bɛ nwo wosowoso bɛ wɔ aseɛ bo dɔ, asue mɔ ne bɛ nu nningyein koso sɔ ala.

english_verse: Nothing in that land of death and destruction is hidden from God,
translation_verse: Ɛborɔ nwo la so wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, yeɛ Abadɔn koso, ngatasoɛ biala nne so.

english_verse: God stores water in clouds, but they don't burst,
translation_verse: Ɔbɔ esue nonongu wura ye munungum nu, nakoso nu nonɛ ne, ɔmma munungum ne anu nzua.

english_verse: and he wraps them around the face of the moon.
translation_verse: Ɔkata ye ahennie bia ne nyunu, na ɔtrɛtrɛ ye munungum nu fa kata so.

english_verse: On the surface of the ocean, God has drawn a boundary line between light and darkness.
translation_verse: Wafa ɛwɛen wato nzue anye, na berɛ yeɛ ɔte kanea ne awosii b’ayieleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And columns supporting the sky tremble at his command.
translation_verse: Anwuro dɔ nyinasoɛ mɔ wosowoso, na sɛ otwi bɛ nyunu a, bɛ nwo dwiri bɛ.

english_verse: By his power and wisdom, God conquered the force of the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: Ɔfale ye tumi brɛle ɛpo ase, na ɔfale ye nimdeɛ lili ɛpo nu sasrabɔnzam so ngonim.

english_verse: The heavens became bright when he breathed, and the escaping sea monster died at his hands.
translation_verse: Ɔfale ye nwomeɛ mane ewienu tele kaenn, yeɛ ɔfale ye sa sinane ewoo bɔ ɔnwati ne.

english_verse: These things are merely a whisper of God's power at work. How little we would understand if this whisper ever turned into thunder!
translation_verse: Tie, bɔ Nyameɛ tumi kora yɔ ne, sɔ nningyein nemɔ te nu mmaa mmaa bie, na kaaba bie yeɛ yate yafa Nyameɛ nwo ɔ. Ye tumi totohyia ne, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔte ye bo ɔ?”

english_verse: I am desperate because God All-Powerful refuses to do what is right. As surely as God lives,
translation_verse: “Nyameɛ bɔ ɔne me anni ye yé, Tuminiɛ ne bɔ wama me kra odi aworabɔlɛ ne, kyɛ ɔte ase ye de,

english_verse: I will tell only the truth.
translation_verse: me noa ngɔpɛ ngondombo, yeɛ me temverema ngɔhã nnakannaka dwirɛ.

english_verse: Until the day I die, I will refuse to do wrong by saying you are right,
translation_verse: Nyameɛ pa gua kyɛ ngɔhã kyɛ ɛmɔdi be ɔ, na me nahorɛlilɛ de, mengɔyakyi nu kɔpem kyɛ ngowu ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that my enemies will suffer no less than the wicked.
translation_verse: “Mesrɛ kyɛ oyie me pɔfoɛ kyɛbɔ oyie amumuyɛɛniɛ ɔ, ná oyie bɔ ɔko tia me ne kyɛbɔ oyie sona bɔ ɔndengyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: without listening when they beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Sɛ edwirɛ to ye a, aso Nyameɛ kotie ye sufrɛ?

english_verse: And that is what God should do, because they don't like him or ever pray.
translation_verse: Aso ole anigye wɔ Tuminiɛ ne anu? Aso osũ frɛ Nyameɛ mmerɛ biala anaa?

english_verse: Now I will explain in detail what God All-Powerful does.
translation_verse: Ngohyirehyire ɛmɔ Nyameɛ tumi ne nwo dwirɛ, na Tuminiɛ ne, mengɔfa ye atee mengɔfea ɛmɔ.

english_verse: All of you have seen these things for yourselves. So you have no excuse. How God Treats the Wicked
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ amukoraa, sɛ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔanwu ye a, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔkekã sɔ dwirɛ mbaen mbaen he ɔ?

english_verse: They may have many children, but most of them will go hungry or suffer a violent death.
translation_verse: Sɛ ye mma mɔ bɛsone bɛyɛ pee a, ngrandɛ noa yeɛ bɛtotɔ ɔ, yeɛ ye bosofoɛ ngonya aleɛ ngoli ngɔma bɛ ko ngoyi.

english_verse: Others will die of disease, and their widows won't be able to weep.
translation_verse: Ye bosofoɛ bɔ bɛkɔha ne, ewue anwonyerɛ kohũ bɛ, na ye kunafoɛ mmrasua ngosu.

english_verse: The wicked may collect riches and clothes in abundance as easily as clay.
translation_verse: Ɔboaboa ɛdwetɛ noa kyɛ mvuture, yeɛ ɔsoa ɛtena bɔ so kyɛ nnɛterɛ;

english_verse: But God's people will wear clothes taken from them and divide up their riches.
translation_verse: ɔsoa bɔ so de, nakoso sona bɔ ɔtengyɛ yeɛ ɔkɔhera ɔ, sona bɔ odi be yeɛ ɛdwetɛ ne kooli ye sa ɔ.

english_verse: No homes built by the wicked will outlast a cocoon or a shack.
translation_verse: Osi ye sua a, nu yɛ mmerɛ kyɛ mvrɔlɔ, ɔte kyɛ asese bɔ wɛmvoɛ wasi ɔ.

english_verse: Those sinners may go to bed rich, but they will wake up poor.
translation_verse: Sikaniɛ fa anwonya kɔda, nakoso ye ayieleɛ ala ɛne, sɛ ye nye te a, ye anwonya ne ɔnne berɛ ko.

english_verse: Terror will strike at night like a flood or a storm.
translation_verse: Ahunundetelɛ kakyi kyɛ asue oyi fa ye, na mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ fa ye kɔ kɔngɔen.

english_verse: Then a scorching wind will sweep them away
translation_verse: Eyia afiteleɛ mvrama pagya ye kɔ, na ɔpra ye fi ye awuro kɔ.

english_verse: At last, the wind will celebrate because they are gone.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔ ye sa nu gua ye so, na onwunanwuna ye wɔ nekaa biala bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ.

english_verse: the same is done with iron and copper.
translation_verse: Betu buralɛ aseɛnwo, na nyɔboɛ yeɛ behuro ye bɛyɔ kɔɔbere ɔ.

english_verse: Miners carry lanterns deep into the darkness to search for these metals.
translation_verse: Sona sɔ kanea maa otu awosii bo, ofu kumaa maa ɔkɔ kuronguronn, na odwu kɔpena nyɔboɛ wɔ awosii kabii ne anu.

english_verse: Far beneath the grain fields, fires are built to break loose those rocks
translation_verse: Aseɛ nu yeɛ aleɛ fi ba ɔ, nakoso aseɛ bo dɔ de, ɔte kyɛ see bɔ bahua ɔ.

english_verse: Miners go to places unseen by the eyes of hawks;
translation_verse: “Sɔ atee ne, anomaa bɔ ɔkye ngaka di biala nze, yeɛ ɛpɛtɛ biala nye ɔppɛle so.

english_verse: they walk on soil unknown to the proudest lions.
translation_verse: Kaka aboyaa biala, ye gya baa ottiale so, yeɛ gyata koso ɔffale so le.

english_verse: With their own hands they remove sharp rocks and uproot mountains.
translation_verse: “Kuro sona dwudwa twerɛboɛ ne anu, na ofumvu mmokaa mɔ bo odwiri bɛ gua.

english_verse: They dig through the rocks in search of jewels and precious metals.
translation_verse: Ɔpakyepakye atee gua nyɔbotaen mɔ nu, na ye nye nwu nyɔboɛ biala bɔ ɔte sikaa ɔ.

english_verse: They also uncover the sources of rivers and discover secret places. Where Is Wisdom Found?
translation_verse: Otuatua asue mɔ bɛ ti bɔ ɔmma bemmu mva so ɔ, na nikyee bɔ wafea ne, ɔye ba petee nu.

english_verse: Nor can it be discovered in the deepest sea. *
translation_verse: Aseɛ bo dɔ buma nwa: ‘Ɔnne me nu,’ yeɛ ɛpo wora ɔnwa: ‘Ɔnne me berɛ.’

english_verse: It is worth much more than silver or pure gold
translation_verse: Ɛngɔhora ngɔfa sikaa kɔkorɛ ngɔtɔ, yeɛ ɛngɔhora ngɔkari ɛdwetɛ ngotua ye kerɛ.

english_verse: Nothing is its equal— not gold or costly glass.
translation_verse: Esikaa kɔkorɛ ne neanu, bɛ ne ye nzɛ, yeɛ ɛngɔhora ngɔfa sikaa kɔkorɛ mbembenanneɛ ngɔsesa ye.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than coral, jasper, or rubies.
translation_verse: Nyɔboɛ nahanaha ne nyɔboɛ hyɛnhyɛnn po, yɛngɔhora ngɔfa bɛ ngɔtoto ye nwo, ofikyɛ nworɛ nwo le mvasoɛ tra agudeɛ.

english_verse: All the topaz of Ethiopia and the finest gold cannot compare with it.
translation_verse: Yitiopia nyɔboɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye krisolite ne, ɔne nworɛ bɛnzɛ, yeɛ ɛngɔhora ngɔpɛ ye nyɔboɛ wɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ nu.

english_verse: It is hidden from human eyes and even from birds.
translation_verse: Bafa bafea bɔ ateasefoɛ amukoraa bɛ nye nnwu ye ɔ, yeɛ bakata so bɔ ewienu nnomaa bennwu ye ɔ.

english_verse: Death and destruction have merely heard rumors about where it is found.
translation_verse: Abadɔn ne Ewue bɛnwa: ‘Yate ye nwo dwirɛ wɔ yɛ so anu.’

english_verse: God is the only one who knows the way to wisdom;
translation_verse: “Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔse nworɛ atee ɔ, na ye yeɛ ɔse nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ ɔ.

english_verse: and when he decided the path for rain and lightning,
translation_verse: mmerɛ bɔ ɔyɔle nhyehyɛleɛ tole berɛ mane esue, ná ɔpɛle atee tole berɛ mane agralaa ne,

english_verse: God told us, “Wisdom means that you respect me, the Lord, and turn from sin.”
translation_verse: Na osele kuro sona kyɛ, ‘Tie, nworɛ ole kyɛ ekosuro AWURADE ɔ, yeɛ nimdeɛ ole kyɛ ɛkɔhwe wɔ nwo kofi bɔne nwo ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: and the light from his lamp showed me the way through the dark.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né ye kanea ta wɔ me ti so, bɔ né mefa ye kanea menate awosii nu ne;

english_verse: I was in the prime of life, God All-Powerful was my closest friend,
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ né nde wɔ me mmerandeɛ nu ne, mmerɛ bɔ né Nyameɛ ɔbɔ me tena sua nwo waen ne;

english_verse: My herds gave enough milk to bathe my feet, and from my olive harvest flowed rivers of oil. *
translation_verse: mmerɛ bɔ né m’anwonya wabu me so tam ne, bɔ né olive ngoo pu fi nyɔbotaen nu kyɛ asue ma me ne.

english_verse: When poor people or orphans cried out for help, I came to their rescue.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ mmokale mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo bɔ besu bɛpena mmokalɛ ɔ, ɔne awisiafoɛ bɔ belle bokafoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And I was highly praised for my generosity to widows and others in poverty.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ né bɛwɔ anwokyere piri paa nu ne, beyirayirale me, na mmane akunafoɛ mmrasua bɛ wora kyekyele.

english_verse: I was helpful to the blind and to the lame.
translation_verse: Mvale me nwo nyɛle anyeɛ mane anyesiniwaafoɛ, yeɛ mvale me nwo nyɛle agyirɛ mane mmubuafoɛ.

english_verse: I was a father to the needy, and I defended them in court, even if they were strangers.
translation_verse: Nyɛle bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ bɛ baba, na ngane bie mane ɛwɔfoɛ bɔ menze ye ɔ.

english_verse: When criminals attacked, I broke their teeth and set their victims free.
translation_verse: Mmubuli amumuyɛɛniɛ ye gye so, na naen bɔ wafa ye gye watira ye nu ne, mmaa ɔyakyili ye nu.

english_verse: I felt certain that I would live a long and happy life, then die in my own bed.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngane kyɛ, ‘Me ngyẽa kɔsone pee kyɛ anweaa, na ngɔto me kɔme ngowu wɔ m’awuro.

english_verse: In those days I was strong like a tree with deep roots and with plenty of water,
translation_verse: Me ndii hɔle alaa oodwuli nzue nu, na bosue tɔ guale me mmaen mɔ so kɔngɔen amukoraa.

english_verse: Everyone listened in silence to my welcome advice,
translation_verse: “Mmenia nwondɛle betiele me noa dwirɛ, na bɛyɛle konn betiele me foɛtulɛ ne.

english_verse: and when I finished speaking, nothing needed to be said.
translation_verse: Sɛ né medwudwo meyie a, bendwudwo ko, ofikyɛ né me dwirɛ ne ɔtɔ bɛ so anu.

english_verse: My words were eagerly accepted like the showers of spring,
translation_verse: Bɛnwondɛle me kyɛbɔ sona nwondɛ esue ɔ, na bebukyele bɛ noa nu belele edwirɛ ne, kyɛ ebiaa bokyisue ahɔ ɔ.

english_verse: and the smile on my face renewed everyone's hopes.
translation_verse: Sɛ b’anyelasoɛ yie a, né mesere mekyire bɛ, na me nyunu sereserelɛ ne hyɛle bɛ nguraen.

english_verse: My advice was followed as though I were a king leading my troops, or someone comforting those in sorrow.
translation_verse: Nyɛle bɛ so panyi, ngyirele bɛ ate, na me ne bɛ yɛtenane kyɛ ɛhene bɔ ɔne ye lɔen bɛte ɔ, kyɛ ebie bɔ ɔkyekye mmenia bɔ bedi aworabɔlɛ ɔ bɛ wora ɔ.

english_verse: And those who insult me are helpless themselves.
translation_verse: Mvasoɛ beni yeɛ ahaa ngonya ye ngofi b’anwoserɛ nu ɔ? Bɛte mmenia bɔ b’anwoserɛ ayie ɔ.

english_verse: They must claw the desert sand in the dark for something to satisfy their hunger.
translation_verse: Ehiaa ne ɛhɔen amaa batwindwam, wamaa bekyinikyini ɛserɛ so, aseɛ bɔ nikye fee nne so ɔ so.

english_verse: They gather tasteless shrubs for food and firewood,
translation_verse: Bɛtete nyaa weewee wɔ eburo, na mmakaa bo ndii yeɛ ɔte b’aleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and they are run out of towns, as though they were thieves.
translation_verse: Bapɛ b’asue bafi mmenia nu, na behute bɛ kyɛ awuefoɛ.

english_verse: Their only homes are ditches or holes between rocks,
translation_verse: Bɔnza noa ngumaa nu yeɛ bɛtete ɔ, bɛtete bɔen ne nyɔbotaen nu ngumaa nu.

english_verse: where they bray like donkeys gathering around shrubs.
translation_verse: Besu wɔ mvofoen bo kyɛ ngaka, na bapeepee so wɔ ndetema bo.

english_verse: And like senseless donkeys they are chased away. Those Worthless Nobodies
translation_verse: Bɛte mmenia mbaen bie bɔ bɛnze nworɛ ɔ, na batu bɛ bafi aseɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Those worthless nobodies make up jokes and songs to disgrace me.
translation_verse: “Afei de, bɛgoro me nwo bɛfa me bɛto dwein, na makakyi bɛ noa nu ngorohoɛ dwirɛ.

english_verse: They are hateful and keep their distance, even while spitting in my direction.
translation_verse: Bekyi me, bɛnga bɛmma me nwo; bɛ nye bɔ me nyunu a, bɛfefe nwɔserɛ.

english_verse: God has destroyed me, and so they don't care what they do.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ asangye m’agyaen nyamaa nu wabrɛ me ase, na edwirɛ bɔ bekuro biala yeɛ bɛfa bedi me ɔ.

english_verse: Their attacks never stop, though I am defenseless, and my feet are trapped.
translation_verse: Ɛlɔen patapaafoɛ badwɔso batia me wɔ me famaa so, besua ngaen wɔ m’atee nu, na badwɔso me so bɛpena me beku me.

english_verse: Without any help, they prevent my escape, destroying me completely
translation_verse: Betua me atee, bɛpena me ne asefinɛ, bɔ ebiala nga kyɛ bɛyakyi ɔ.

english_verse: Terror has me surrounded; my reputation and my riches have vanished like a cloud. I Am Sick at Heart
translation_verse: Ahunundetelɛ atɔ me so, bama m’anidie abɔ me kyɛ nikyee bɔ mvrama ɔbɔ ye kɔ ɔ, na m’anwonya atu amini kyɛ munungum.

english_verse: I am sick at heart! Pain has taken its toll.
translation_verse: “Afei de, me kra anwati afi me nwo, amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ yeɛ matɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: Night chews on my bones, causing endless torment,
translation_verse: Odwu kɔngɔen a, me mmowue nu tutu me, na me nwo tutulɛ ne ɔndɔ me.

english_verse: and God has shrunk my skin, choking me to death.
translation_verse: Wapari wasɔ m’ataadeɛ nu, na wasɔ m’ataadeɛ ne kɔme wafa wamia me.

english_verse: I have been thrown in the dirt and now am dirt myself.
translation_verse: Wafindi me wato asaa nu, na makakyi kyɛ mvuture ne nzoen.

english_verse: I beg God for help, but there is no answer; and when I stand up, he simply stares.
translation_verse: O AWURADE, mesu mefrɛ wɔ a, ɛndɛ me so; meba wɔ nyunu a, ɛnea me haa mbaen.

english_verse: Soon he will send me home to the world of the dead, where we all must go.
translation_verse: Amba, mese kyɛ ɛkɔfa me kɔhɔ ewue nu, awuro bɔ ebiala bɔ ɔte ase ne, ɔkɔhɔ nu bie ne anu.

english_verse: But when I beg for relief and light, all I receive are disaster and darkness.
translation_verse: Ahaa né mepena asetena paa, nakoso bɔ ɔtte mayee yeɛ wato me ɔ; ahaa né me nye la kanea ate, nakoso awosii yeɛ wato me ɔ.

english_verse: My stomach is tied in knots; pain is my daily companion.
translation_verse: Me kunu tete me, na ɔnyakyi; daa biala, m’amaneɛ toatoa so.

english_verse: My days are dark and gloomy and in the city council I stand and cry out,
translation_verse: Nna eyia yeɛ wamaa mapini ɔ, na mmom aworabɔlɛ ɔ, na megyina badwa nu mesu mepena mmokalɛ.

english_verse: making mournful sounds like jackals and owls.
translation_verse: Makakyi ɛserɛ so kyea oliɛma, ɔne soholi abiɛngo.

english_verse: My skin is so parched, that it peels right off, and my bones are burning.
translation_verse: Me nwonaen apini bɔ ɔwɔngyewɔngye gua ɔ, na me mmowue nu dɔ yerayera me.

english_verse: I promised myself never to stare with desire at a young woman.
translation_verse: “Me ne me nye yayɛ apam, nzu ati yeɛ brasua bɔ onnwuni biaa le ne, odi kyɛ menea ye wɔ ehurolɛ atee so ɔ.

english_verse: and he keeps a close watch on everything I do.
translation_verse: Aso onnwu nikyee biala bɔ meyɔ ɔ, aso ɔnga agyirɛ biala bɔ metu ɔ?

english_verse: then others can eat my harvest and uproot my crops.
translation_verse: ye de maa nnua ma sona foforɛ oli, yoo, ye de ma me bosofoɛ bɛ boso onua.

english_verse: then let some stranger steal my wife from me.
translation_verse: ye de ma me ye osi bienzua foforɛ aburoo, maa mmienzua biemɔ bebutu ye so.

english_verse: If I took someone's wife, it would be a horrible crime,
translation_verse: Sɛ mabɔ sɔ bra ne a, ahaa ye de ɔte musue piri, ahaa ye de ɔte nzɛmmɔne piri paa wɔ mbanyi nyunu;

english_verse: When my servants complained against me, I was fair to them.
translation_verse: “Sɛ mabu me nye magua m’akoaa anaa m’afaneɛ dwirɛ so, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɛbɔle me somoɛ hɔ a,

english_verse: After all, God is the one who gave life to each of us before we were born. I Have Never Cheated Anyone
translation_verse: Ye bɔ ɔbɔle me tole me ni akunu ne, aso nna ye ala yeɛ ɔnwone yɛ tole yɛ ni mɔ akunu ɔ?

english_verse: and I have always shared my food with orphans.
translation_verse: Anaakyɛ, mayɛ angomedi, bɔ nyisiaafoɛ banni aleɛ ne bie ɔ?

english_verse: Since the time I was young, I have cared for orphans and helped widows.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, ofi me ngwalaa nu yeɛ manea nyisiaafoɛ mayɛ kyɛ bɛ se ɔ, na mahyire akunafoɛ mmrasua ate ofi kyɛ bɛwole me ɔ.

english_verse: If I have ever raised my arm to threaten an orphan when the power was mine,
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔnate kyɛ ndɛenbualɛfoɛ begyi me si ti, matengyɛ me sa wɔ ayisiaaniɛ so manwunanwuna ye a,

english_verse: I could not have been abusive; I was terrified at the thought that God might punish me.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ né mesuro kyɛ Nyameɛ kɔma musue kɔto me ɔ, yeɛ ahaa mengɔhora ye animnyam ne anyunu gyina.

english_verse: I have never laughed when my enemies were struck by disaster.
translation_verse: “Sɛ me nye agye kyɛ me pɔfoɛ onwu amaneɛ, anaa wayɛ me fɛ kyɛ musue ato ye a,

english_verse: and travelers were always welcome.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔfoɛ biala anna dwaaso, mabukye m’anoa mato berɛ mama ateetulɛfoɛ.

english_verse: Many have attempted to hide their sins from others— but I refused.
translation_verse: Sɛ makata me mmeraatolɛ so kyɛbɔ adasa yɔ ne, bɔ mafa m’amumuyɛɛ mafea me ti anu,

english_verse: And the fear of public disgrace never forced me to keep silent about what I had done. Why Doesn't God Listen?
translation_verse: ɔnate kyɛ né mesuro mmenia worawora ne, yeɛ né mesuro kyɛ mmusua mmusua mɔ kobu me animtia, yiti ɔmaa nyɛle konn, na mamvite aluo.

english_verse: Why doesn't God All-Powerful listen and answer? If God has something against me, let him speak up or put it in writing!
translation_verse: O, sɛ ahaa nyane ebie bɔ okotie me dwirɛ ye bie kɔma me a! O, ahaa né me kwaadubɔlɛniɛ ne wahyerɛ kwaadu bɔ wafa wabɔ me ne!

english_verse: Then I would wear his charges on my clothes and forehead.
translation_verse: Ahaa ngɔfa ngɔto me kɔme anwo, ahaa ngɔfa ngopuro me ti kyɛ abotire;

english_verse: And with my head held high, I would tell him everything I have ever done.
translation_verse: ahaa ngɔhã bɔ mayɔ amukoraa ngohyire ye, ahaa ngɔhɔ ye nyunu kyɛbɔ ɛhene kɔ ye nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: I have never mistreated the land I farmed and made it mourn.
translation_verse: “Sɛ m’aseɛ asu agua me so, yeɛ sɛ ye ngofie babɔ nu basu;

english_verse: Nor have I cheated my workers and caused them pain.
translation_verse: sɛ mali so aleɛ bɔ mandua kerɛ, yeɛ sɛ mamaa bahu ye mene mɔ a,

english_verse: If I had, I would pray for weeds instead of wheat to grow in my fields. After saying these things, Job was silent.
translation_verse: ye de, nnɛma atokoɔ fifi so, na mmom ma mmowue, nnɛma ayuo fifi so, na mmom ma ndetema.” Yob noa ape.

english_verse: Finally, these three men stopped arguing with Job, because he refused to admit he was guilty.
translation_verse: Yiti sɔ mmienzua nza nemɔ bamma Yob mmuayɛɛ ko, ofikyɛ né Yob bu ye nwo kyɛ ɔtengyɛ.

english_verse: Elihu from Buz was there, and he had become upset with Job for blaming God instead of himself.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Elihu, bɔ ɔse ole Businiɛ Barakɛl, bɔ ofi Ram abusua nu ne, ɔfɛle yaa ɔ. Ɔfɛle Yob so yaa, kyɛ wabua ye nwo be, ná wammua Nyameɛ mmom be ɔ.

english_verse: He was also angry with Job's three friends for not being able to prove that Job was wrong.
translation_verse: Ye ahone huli Yob nnamvo nza nemɔ koso so, kyɛ bangora banye Yob dwirɛ ne noa ɔ, nakoso babua ye fɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Elihu was younger than these three, and he let them speak first.
translation_verse: Elihu nwondɛle mane Yob dwudwo yiele koraka, ofikyɛ né bɛtra Elihu panyi.

english_verse: But he became irritated when they could not answer Job,
translation_verse: Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ Elihu nwuni kyɛ mmenia nza ne bannya edwirɛ ne anwo mmuayɛɛ biala ne, ɔfɛle yaa.

english_verse: and he said to them: I am much younger than you, so I have shown respect by keeping silent.
translation_verse: Na Elihu, bɔ ɔse ole Businiɛ Barakɛl ne, obuale ye nwo bie kyɛ, “Nnyini, na ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔte mbanyi, na ɛhe yeɛ né ɔmaa mesuro bɔ yiti ngane me noa ndole nu, bɔ ɔmaa mangyire m’adwene ɔ.

english_verse: That's why I ask you to listen to me. I Eagerly Listened *
translation_verse: Yiti menwa: ‘Ɛ́mɔtie me, Me koso ngohyire m’adwene.’

english_verse: You shouldn't say, “We know what's right! Let God punish him.”
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔka kyɛ, ‘Yanwu nworɛ; nna sona, na mmom Nyameɛ yeɛ okobua Yob fɔ ɔ.’

english_verse: Job hasn't spoken against me, and so I won't answer him with your arguments.
translation_verse: Nna me yeɛ Yob aha dwirɛ watia me ɔ, yiti mengɔfa ɛmɔ mmuayɛɛ ne bie mengobua ye.

english_verse: All of you are shocked; you don't know what to say.
translation_verse: “Edwirɛ ne abɔ bɛ, belle mmuayɛɛ biala ko, bɛ noa nu dwirɛ ayie.

english_verse: No! I will give my opinion,
translation_verse: Me koso ngɔma me mmuayɛɛ deɛ, me koso ngohyire m’adwene.

english_verse: because I have so much to say, that I can't keep quiet.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ edwirɛ bɔ mebaaha ne, ɔsone paa, na sunzum bɔ ɔwɔ me nu ne yeɛ ɔtwe me sa ɔ.

english_verse: I am like a swollen wineskin, and I will burst
translation_verse: Me komvi dɔ ayɛ kyɛ nzaa bɔ batua so ɔ, wayɛ kyɛ nzaa ngotoku monɛ bɔ ɔpena osua ɔ.

english_verse: I don't know how to be unfair or to flatter anyone—
translation_verse: Mengɔyɛ nyeyemuɛ biala, yeɛ mengɔhã adɛfɛdɛfɛ dwirɛ ngɔfa ebiala nwo.

english_verse: Job, listen to me! Pay close attention. *
translation_verse: “Yob, afei de tie me dwirɛ deɛ, ná yɛ asoɛ tie me noa dwirɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: just as surely as the Spirit of God All-Powerful gave me the breath of life.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ Sunzum yeɛ ɔbɔle me ɔ, na Tuminiɛ ne, ye nwomeɛ yeɛ ɔma me ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: Now line up your arguments and prepare to face me.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛkɔhora a, ma me mmuayɛɛ, dwene edwirɛ bɔ ɛkɔha ɔ nwo, ná gyina me nyunu.
