english_verse: We each were made from clay, and God has no favorites,
translation_verse: Nea, Nyameɛ nyunu de, nde kyɛ wɔ ala, me koso nnɛterɛ yeɛ ɔfa nwone me ɔ.

english_verse: so don't be afraid of me or what I might do. I Have Heard You Argue
translation_verse: Nea, nnɛma me nwo suronyi tɔ wɔ so, yeɛ mengɔma wɔ nwo ngɔhyere wɔ.

english_verse: You claim that God has made you his enemy,
translation_verse: Amba, Nyameɛ anwu me nwo mvomsoɛ, na obu me ye pɔfoɛ.

english_verse: that he has bound your feet and blocked your path.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔ me panwu, na ɔfa ye nye sra agyirɛ biala bɔ metu ɔ.’

english_verse: But, Job, you're wrong— God is greater than any human.
translation_verse: “Nakoso edwirɛ he anwo de, ɛndengyɛ. Na ngɔma wɔ mmuayɛɛ, kyɛ Nyameɛ te piri tra dasaniɛ biala.

english_verse: God speaks in different ways, and we don't always recognize his voice. *
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ fa atee ko aso ɔne atee foforɛ so odwudwo, nakoso sona mma ye adwene ngɔ edwirɛ ne aso.

english_verse: God does this to make us turn from sin and pride
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so wahwe mmenia wafi bɛ yɔleɛ nwo, ná waye bɛ wafi anwomasoɛ nu.

english_verse: and to protect us from being swept away to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ɔnate so, ɔmma ye kra ngɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu, yeɛ ode ye ngoa fi ngrandɛ wue noa.

english_verse: Sometimes we are punished with a serious illness and aching joints.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ maa osa fa yealɛ nu wɔ ye mba so ɔfa twe ye so, na ye mmowue nu tutu ye daa,

english_verse: Merely the thought of our favorite food makes our stomachs sick,
translation_verse: maa ɔnate so ye noa nu to, bɔ aleɛ bɔ ɔyɛ akɔnnɔ po ɔnyɛ ye fɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and we become so skinny that our bones stick out.
translation_verse: Ɔfɔ maa odwɔso ye sonaluwaa so, na ye nwo yeye mmowue maa afei de benwu mmowue ne.

english_verse: We feel death and the grave taking us in their grip.
translation_verse: Ye kra twe pingye ɛborɔ kumaa, na ye ngoa pingye ewue bɔfoɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: One of a thousand angels then comes to our rescue by saying we are innocent.
translation_verse: “Nakoso sɛ abɔfo kamafoɛ bie gyina ye si, abɔfo bɔ ɔte apee nemɔ anu ko, bɔ ɔma sona nwu tenenee bra bɔ odi kyɛ ɔbɔ ɔ a,

english_verse: The angel shows kindness, commanding death to release us, because the price was paid.
translation_verse: onwu sɔ sona ne anwumvoin ɔka kyɛ, ‘De ye ngoa, nnɛmaa ɔkɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu, ofikyɛ manya bɔ mefa meyɛ ye ti nyɔboɛ mede ye ngoa ɔ;

english_verse: and we ask God to accept us. Then we joyfully worship God, and we are rewarded because we are innocent.
translation_verse: ye de, sɔ sona ne bɔ mbaeɛ srɛ Nyameɛ a, ode ye, ɔfa anika ba Nyameɛ nyunu, na ɔfa ye bɔne kyɛ ye maa ɔtengyɛ.

english_verse: When that happens, we tell everyone, “I sinned and did wrong, but God forgave me
translation_verse: Na sɔ sona ne to dwein kyire mmenia kyɛ, ‘Nyɔle bɔne, nyɔle bɔ ɔtte mayee ɔ, nakoso wandua me so kerɛ kyɛbɔ ɔfata ɔ.

english_verse: and rescued me from death! Now I will see the light.”
translation_verse: Na mmom wapepɛ wale me kra, wamma wangɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu, na wamaa matena ngoa nu manwu kanea ne.’

english_verse: God gives each of us chance after chance
translation_verse: “Amba, ɛhemɔ amukoraa, Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔyɔ ɔ, na ɔyɔ ye mmerɛ pee ɔma sona,

english_verse: to be saved from death and brought into the light that gives life.
translation_verse: kyɛ ɔfa de ye kra fi ɛborɔ kumaa nu, amaa ɔnate so ngoa kanea ata ye so.

english_verse: So, Job, pay attention and don't interrupt,
translation_verse: Yob, yɛ asoɛ tie me, yɛ dinn maa ndwudwo.

english_verse: though I would gladly listen to anything you say that proves you are right.
translation_verse: Sɛ ele edwirɛ bie ka a, ma me mmuayɛɛ, dwudwo, ofikyɛ mepena kyɛ edi be.

english_verse: You men think you are wise, but just listen to me!
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔ, nworɛfoɛ, ɛ́mɔtie me dwirɛ ye, nimdeɛfoɛ, ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ betie me,

english_verse: Think about my words, as you would taste food.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ asoɛ oso edwirɛ nea, kyɛbɔ temverema koso tafe aleɛ nea ne.

english_verse: Then we can decide the case and give a just verdict.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma yɛneanea nu yɛpena bɔ ɔte nahorɛ ɔ, ɛ́mɔma yɛ bɔbɔ yɛhyire bɔ ɔte paa ɔ.

english_verse: Job claims he is innocent and God is guilty of mistreating him.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Yob aha kyɛ, ‘Medi be, nakoso Nyameɛ abua me ndɛengyea.

english_verse: Job also argues that God considers him a liar and that he is suffering severely in spite of his innocence.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ me dwirɛ yɛ fɛ de, nakoso bɛnwa menga nahorɛ; bɔne nne me nu, nakoso agyaen kena koangɔ atutu me.’

english_verse: But to tell the truth, Job is shameless!
translation_verse: “Sona beni koraa yeɛ ɔte kyɛ Yob, bɔ ɔno musue dwirɛ kyɛ nzue e?

english_verse: He spends his time with sinners,
translation_verse: Ɔne bɔnefoɛ yeɛ bɛbɔ afɛ ɔ, na ɔne amumuyɛɛfoɛ yeɛ bɛnate ɔ.

english_verse: because he has said, “It doesn't pay to please God.” If Any of You Are Smart
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔnwa: ‘Mvasoɛ biala nne so kyɛ sona kɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ.’

english_verse: If any of you are smart, you will listen and learn that God All-Powerful does what is right.
translation_verse: “Yiti ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔte dwirɛ bo ɔ, ɛ́mɔtie me, bɔne te nikyee bɔ Nyameɛ ngɔyɔ bie le ɔ, yeɛ amumuyɛɛ te nikyee bɔ Tuminiɛ ne ngɔyɔ bie le ɔ.

english_verse: and he is never unfair.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, Nyameɛ ngɔyɔ bɔne, Tuminiɛ ne, ongobua ndɛengyea.

english_verse: From the very beginning, God has been in control of all the world.
translation_verse: Aso ebie yeɛ ɔfale aseɛ wurale ye sa ɔ? Aso ebie yeɛ ɔhyehyɛle ewiase amukoraa ɔ?

english_verse: If God took back the breath that he breathed into us,
translation_verse: Ye sunzum ne, sɛ osa de ye nikye, ná ye nwomeɛ ne koso osa de ye nikye a,

english_verse: we humans would die and return to the soil.
translation_verse: ahaa abɔdeɛ mukoraa bɔ bɛte ase ne, bekowu bɛkɔbɔ nu, na adasa mukoraa bekosa bɛkɔhɔ nnɛterɛ nu.

english_verse: The mighty God is the one who brings about justice, and you are condemning him.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie kyi nahorɛlilɛ a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né wanea maen so? Yeɛ bɔ ɔtengyɛ paa tra ebiala ne, aso ebua ye fɔ anaa?

english_verse: Indeed, God is the one who condemns unfair rulers.
translation_verse: Ye bɔ ɔka kyire ɛhene kyɛ, ‘Ɛte sona mbaen!’ ná osa ka kyire atitirefoɛ kyɛ, ‘Nzɛmmɔnefoɛ!’ ne,

english_verse: And God created us all; he has no favorites, whether rich or poor.
translation_verse: ye bɔ ɔnnea atitirefoɛ bɛ dibea, ná ommu sikafoɛ ndra ehiafoɛ ne, ofikyɛ bɛ mukoraa bɛte ye sa noa adwuma.

english_verse: Even powerful rulers die in the darkness of night when they least expect it, just like the rest of us. God Watches Everything We Do
translation_verse: Bewu mvum nu, bɛ nwo wosowoso bɛ abunnamu, na ewue fa bɛ kɔ, na atitirefoɛ po, ɔye bɛ fi berɛ bɔ ɔmva sona so ɔ.

english_verse: No evil person can hide in the deepest darkness.
translation_verse: Awosii, anaa awosii kabii biala nne berɛ, bɔ bɔnefoɛ kɔfea nu bɔ ongonwu bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And so, God doesn't need to set a time for judgment.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ nhyehyɛ mmerɛ bie ndo berɛ mma sona koraka né waagyina ye nyunu maa wabua ye ndɛen.

english_verse: Without asking for advice, God removes mighty leaders and puts others in their place.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ betira tumi ne, otu bɛ bɔ ɔnneanea bɛ dwirɛ nu ɔ, na ɔfa mmeni foforɛ osi bɛ gya nu.

english_verse: He knows what they are like, and he wipes them out in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔse bɔ bɛyɔ ɔ, otu bɛ kɔngɔen, na ɔma b’ayieleɛ yie bɛ.

english_verse: And while others look on, he punishes them because they were evil
translation_verse: Ɔtwe bɛ so kyɛ bɔnefoɛ bɔ mmenia nye tua ɔ,

english_verse: The persons they mistreated had prayed for help, until God answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Bɛmane mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ bɛ suɛ dwuli ye nyunu, na wate bɛ bɔ benwu amaneɛ ɔ bɛ suɛ.

english_verse: But still, he punishes rulers who abuse their people.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná sona bɔ onzuro Nyameɛ ɔ ngoli hene, ná wangakyi ngaen wɔ maen ne aso.

english_verse: Job, you should tell God that you are guilty and promise to do better.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ebie ka kyire Nyameɛ kyɛ, ‘Menwu amaneɛ, mengɔyɔ bɔne ko;

english_verse: Then ask him to point out what you did wrong, so you won't do it again.
translation_verse: bɔ mannwu ye bɔ mayɔ ne, kyirekyire me, sɛ mayɔ amumuyɛɛ a, mengɔyɔ sɔ ko’ a,

english_verse: Do you make the rules, or does God? You have to decide— I can't do it for you; now make up your mind.
translation_verse: wɔ, ɔnate kyɛ apo sɔ dwirɛ ne ati, ɛdwene kyɛ Nyameɛ kɔhwe ye so anaa? Nna me, na mmom wɔ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛdwene ye nwo ɔ, yiti bɔ ɛse ne, ka.

english_verse: that you are speaking nonsense and lack good judgment.
translation_verse: ‘Yob dwudwo a, aba nne nu, yeɛ ye dwirɛ wora, ndeaseɛ nne nu.’

english_verse: So I pray for you to suffer as much as possible for talking like a sinner.
translation_verse: Ɔhale me ngome a, ahaa baso Yob banea maa wapem ye bo, ofikyɛ ye mmuayɛɛ bɔ ɔma ne, ɔte kyɛ amumuyɛɛfoɛ mmuayɛɛ.

english_verse: You have rebelled against God, time after time, and have even insulted us.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ wafa ɛlɔenyɛlɛ wafoa ye bɔne ne aso, ɔne yɛ su aporowaa, na odwudwo worawora otia Nyameɛ.”

english_verse: Job, are you really innocent in the sight of God?
translation_verse: “Ɛnwa nzɛ ɔte paa ma wɔ, kyɛ ɛkɔha kyɛ, ‘Metengyɛ metra Nyameɛ’ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't you honestly believe it pays to obey him?
translation_verse: Sɛ ebisa kyɛ, ‘Nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ menya ɔ? Manyɔ bɔne ye, nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ manya ɔ?’ a,

english_verse: I will give the answers to you and your friends. *
translation_verse: me de, ngɔma wɔ mmuayɛɛ, ɛne wɔ damvo mɔ bɔ bɛboka wɔ so ne.

english_verse: Is any good you may have done at all helpful to him?
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛtengyɛ a, nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ ɛfa ma ye ɔ, yeɛ nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ onya fi wɔ berɛ ɔ?

english_verse: In times of trouble, everyone begs the mighty God to have mercy.
translation_verse: “Mmenia bɔ awuye, ɔnate nhyɛsoɛ worawora ti, besu bɛpena mmokalɛ, ofikyɛ bewura tumifoɛ atianuserɛfoɛ bɛ sa.

english_verse: But after their Creator helps them through hard times, they forget about him,
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ nu biala nga kyɛ, ‘Me Nyameɛ bɔ ɔbɔle me ne, ɔwɔ nisua? Ye bɔ ɔma edwein kɔngɔen ne,

english_verse: God won't listen to the prayers of proud and evil people.
translation_verse: Berɛ yeɛ bɛbɔ awuye ɔ, nakoso ebiala ndɛ bɛ so, ɔnate bɔnefoɛ b’anwomasoɛ ti.

english_verse: If God All-Powerful refuses to answer their empty prayers,
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, Nyameɛ ndie esuɛ mbaen mbaen, yeɛ Tuminiɛ ne ɔmva nyɛ huu.

english_verse: Job, you were wrong to say God doesn't punish sin.
translation_verse: Afei koso, ɔnate kyɛ ɔndwe sona so wɔ ye yaafɛlɛ nu, ná onni mmeraatolɛ si pee ne ati,

english_verse: Be patient a while longer; I have something else to say in God's defense.
translation_verse: “Nya aboterɛ ma me kãa, maa ngyirekyire wɔ, ofikyɛ edwirɛ bɔ ngyi Nyameɛ gya nu meka ne, nnyiele ye ka.

english_verse: God always does right— and this knowledge comes straight from God.
translation_verse: Ngohyire kyɛ me nimdeɛ ne ɔtrɛ paa, na ngɔfa ngohyire kyɛ me Nyameɛ bɔ ɔbɔle me ne ɔtengyɛ.

english_verse: You can rest assured that what I say is true.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, nna ngondombo yeɛ mepɛ ɔ; sona bɔ ye nimdeɛ di mu yeɛ ogyi wɔ nyunu wa ye.

english_verse: Although God is mighty, he cares about everyone and makes fair decisions.
translation_verse: “Tie, Nyameɛ te piri, na ommu ebiala animtia; ye ndeaseɛ tumi ne, ɔte totohyia.

english_verse: The wicked are cut down, and those who are wronged receive justice.
translation_verse: Ɔmma bɔnefoɛ bɛngɔ so bennya ngoa, na ɔma bɛ bɔ mmenia hyɛ bɛ so ɔ benya bɛ fawɔnwodi.

english_verse: God watches over good people and places them in positions of power and honor forever.
translation_verse: Ɔnyakyi teneneefoɛ bɛ so nealɛ, ɔmaa bɛ ne ahemvo mɔ bedi bia daa, na ɔbɔ b’aba so.

english_verse: But when people are prisoners of suffering and pain, *
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛbɔ bɛ panwu, ná bɛfa amaneɛnwunɛ nyamaa bɛkyekye bɛ a,

english_verse: then he warns them to turn back to him.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa bɛyɛ asoɛ bɛma ye maa ɔtengyɛtengyɛ bɛ, na ɔhyɛ bɛ kyɛ bɛhwe bɛ nwo befi bɔne nwo.

english_verse: And if they obey, they will be successful and happy from then on.
translation_verse: Sɛ betie ye ná bɛso ye a, bɛ ngoa bɔ waha ne, oyie bɛ yé, na b’afoɛ bɔ waha ne, bedi ye anigye nu.

english_verse: But if they foolishly refuse, they will be rewarded with a violent death. Godless People Are Too Angry
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ bandie ye a, bɛtotɔ ngrandɛ noa, na bewuwu bɔ nimdeɛ abɔ bɛ.

english_verse: Godless people are too angry to ask God for help when he punishes them.
translation_verse: “Bɛ bɔ benzuro Nyameɛ ne, bɛte nzɛmmɔtia, na sɛ Nyameɛ twe bɛ so po a, benzu bɛmvrɛ ye.

english_verse: So they die young in shameful disgrace.
translation_verse: Bennyi, na bebu gyein, na b’ayieleɛ yie bɛ kyɛbɔ oyie adwamanbɔlɛfoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And at this very moment, God deeply desires to lead you from trouble and to spread your table with your favorite food.
translation_verse: Wɔ koso, ɔkɔye wɔ kofi aworabɔlɛ nu, ɔkɔfa wɔ kɔhɔ nekaa bɔ anwokyere nne berɛ ɔ, na ɔkɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen, na aleɛ paa kɔyɛ wɔ poen so tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: Now that the judgment for your sins has fallen upon you,
translation_verse: “Nakoso wɔ de, bɔnefoɛ ndɛenbualɛ mumua yeɛ wɔ sa aha ye ɔ, na ndɛenbualɛ ne asohwenɛ yeɛ wawa wɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: don't let your anger and the pain you endured make you sneer at God.
translation_verse: Nea yé né anwonya annakalaka wɔ, yeɛ nnɛma fea-ase-ma osi wɔ nye.

english_verse: Your reputation and riches cannot protect you from distress,
translation_verse: Aso w’anwonya anaa w’anwoserɛ tumi amukoraa, ɔkɔhora kole wɔ kofi w’amaneɛ nu?

english_verse: nor can you find safety in the dark world below.
translation_verse: Nnɛpere kyɛ alesaleɛ kɔwa ɔ, mmerɛ bɔ benua mmenia boso befi nekaa bɔ bɛwɔ ne.

english_verse: Be on guard! Don't turn to evil as a way of escape.
translation_verse: Nea yé! Nnɛkɔdi bɔne si, ofikyɛ ɔnate sɔ ati yeɛ amaneɛnwunɛ oso wɔ nea ɔ.

english_verse: God's power is unlimited. He needs no teachers
translation_verse: “Tie, Nyameɛ tumi te piri, kyerɛkyerɛniɛ beni yeɛ yɛkɔhora yɛkɔfa ye yɛkɔtoto ye nwo ɔ?

english_verse: Others have praised God for what he has done, so join with them.
translation_verse: Kaye kyɛ ɛkɔkamvo nningyein bɔ ɔyɔ ɔ, bɔ adasa bɛto ye nwo dwein bɛkamvo ye ne.

english_verse: From down here on earth, everyone has looked up and seen
translation_verse: Mmenia mukoraa benwu nningyein ne, ebiala ɔwɔ dededede po a onwu ye.

english_verse: how great God is— God is more than we imagine; no one can count the years he has lived. *
translation_verse: Tie, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ si te piri ne, yɛngɔhora ngonwu ye ngoyie, na ye afoɛ somaa de, ɔbo sona ndeaseɛ so.

english_verse: Who can understand how God scatters the clouds and speaks from his home in the thunderstorm?
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ osi trɛtrɛ munungum nu, ɔne kyɛbɔ osi bɔ nu kurudududu ofi nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ ne, aso ebie kɔhora kɔte ye bo?

english_verse: And when God sends lightning, it can be seen at the bottom of the sea.
translation_verse: Tie, ɔtete ye agralaa fa pɛ ye nwo bra yia, na ɔkata ɛpo ye bo dɔ paa ne aso.

english_verse: By producing such rainstorms, God rules the world and provides us with food.
translation_verse: Ɔnate sɔ nningyein nemɔ aso yeɛ obua maen maen ndɛen ɔ, na ɔma bɛ aleɛ pee.

english_verse: Each flash of lightning is one of his arrows striking its target,
translation_verse: Ɔfa agralaa kata ye sa nwo, na ɔhyɛ ye maa ɔpe nekaa bɔ okuro kyɛ ɔpe ɔ.

english_verse: and the thunder tells of his anger against sin.
translation_verse: Nu bɔlɛ kurudududu ne, odi ye nwo adanzeɛ, na ngaka po bɛse kyɛ mvrama piri baatu.

english_verse: when I hear the roaring voice of God in the thunder,
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, ɛ́mɔtie ye komvi bɔ ɔbobɔ nu kurudududu ɔ, ɔne nu bobolɛ bɔ ofi ye noa nu ɔba ɔ.

english_verse: and when I see his lightning flash across the sky.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔ nu kurudududu wɔ ewienu nekaa biala, na ɔma ye agralaa tete kodwu aseɛ ti ne ye ti.

english_verse: and the breath of God freezes streams and rivers.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ nwomeɛ yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnya asukɔtwea ɔ, na ɔma nzue bɔ ɔla berɛ tɛtrɛtɛɛ ɔ kakyi asukɔtwea.

english_verse: Rain clouds filled with lightning appear at God's command,
translation_verse: Ɔfa nzue gyina munungum nu, na ɔma ye agralaa tete fi munungum nu.

english_verse: to release their cargo— sometimes as punishment for sin, sometimes as kindness. Consider Carefully
translation_verse: Kyɛ asohwenɛ ti ahɔ oo, anaa ye aseɛ ti ahɔ oo, anaa ye anwumvoinnwunɛ ti ahɔ oo, ɔma sɔ nningyein nemɔ besisi.

english_verse: Job, consider carefully the many wonders of God.
translation_verse: “Yob, tie sɔ dwirɛ he; yɛ konn ná dwene Nyameɛ anwanwadeɛ nnwumaa nwo.

english_verse: of God who knows all things? Or how he hangs the clouds in empty space?
translation_verse: Aso ɛse kyɛbɔ osi ma munungum sinze berɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ, ye bɔ ye nimdeɛ di mu ne, ye anwanwadeɛ nnwumaa ɛne?

english_verse: You almost melt in the heat of fierce desert winds when the sky is like brass.
translation_verse: Wɔ bɔ mvifire te wɔ ma wɔ ndaadeɛ doa, mmerɛ bɔ ngwaen dɔ mvrama hyerɛhyerɛ ɔbɔ ma aseɛ taa dinn ne,

english_verse: God can hammer out the clouds in spite of the oppressive heat, but can you?
translation_verse: aso ɛne ye yeɛ bɛtrɛtrɛle ewienu bɔ ɔhata berɛ ne, maa ɔyɛle kyɛ neanu bɔ bahuro ye maa wala ɔ?

english_verse: Tell us what to say to God! Our minds are in the dark, and we don't know how to argue our case.
translation_verse: Maa yɛnwu bɔ odi kyɛ yɛkã yɛkyire Nyameɛ ɔ, yɛ noa nu dwirɛ ayie, ofikyɛ yɛ adwene nu mbi.

english_verse: Should I risk my life by telling God that I want to speak?
translation_verse: Sɛ mepena kyɛ medwudwo a, sana bɛka bekyire ye anaa? Sona beni yeɛ ɔpena kyɛ bɛhyɛ ye so ɔ?

english_verse: No one can stare at the sun after a breeze has blown the clouds from the sky.
translation_verse: Sɛ mvrama bɔ ná opia munungum fi berɛ a, mmenia ngɔhora ngɔnea eyia bɔ ɔbɔ gyeingyein wɔ ewienu ne.

english_verse: God cannot be seen— but his power is great, and he is always fair.
translation_verse: Tuminiɛ ne, nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ ne, yɛngɔhora ngonwu ye, ye tumi ne ye nahorɛlilɛ te piri, na ye tenenee totohyia ne ati, ommua ndɛengyea.

english_verse: And so we humans fear God, because he shows no respect for those who are proud and think they know so much.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, adasa suro ye, na ebiala bɔ obu ye nwo kyɛ ɔse nworɛ ne, Nyameɛ mva ye nyɛ huu.”

english_verse: From out of a storm, the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE dwudwole fili mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ne anu obuale Yob kyɛ,

english_verse: Why do you talk so much when you know so little?
translation_verse: “Sona beni ɛne, bɔ nimdeɛ nne ye dwudwolɛ nu, bɔ ɔfa sɛkye me nhyehyɛleɛ ye?

english_verse: Now get ready to face me! Can you answer the questions I ask?
translation_verse: Bɔ w’abɔsoɛ kyɛ bienzua, mebaabisa wɔ dwirɛ, na ye ye noa kyire me.

english_verse: How did I lay the foundation for the earth? Were you there?
translation_verse: “Mmerɛ bɔ ndole aseɛ fapem ne, né ɛwɔ nisua? Sɛ ele ye nwo nimdeɛ a, ka kyire me.

english_verse: When the ocean was born, I set its boundaries
translation_verse: “Nwa yeɛ ɔtole ɛpo poen nu ɔ, mmerɛ bɔ ofili aseɛ kunu dɔ wale ne,

english_verse: and wrapped it in blankets of thickest fog.
translation_verse: mmerɛ bɔ mvale munungum nyɛle ye tena, bɔ mvale awosii kabii ngurɔle ye nwo,

english_verse: Then I built a wall around it, locked the gates,
translation_verse: bɔ ndole ɛwɛen kyɛ nnɛma ɔtra, bɔ nduatuale ye anoa mɔ, ná mvale buralɛ mbrambramone bɛ si,

english_verse: and said, “Your powerful waves stop here! They can go no farther.” Did You Ever Tell the Sun To Rise?
translation_verse: ná ngane kyɛ, ‘Nekaa bɔ bra baadwu hɔ ɛne, nnɛtra, na ɛwa yeɛ w’asorɔkye bɔ obu fa so ne ɔkɔbɔ koodwu ɔ’ ne?

english_verse: Did you ever tell the sun to rise? And did it obey?
translation_verse: “Ofi mmerɛ bɔ bɛwole wɔ ɔ, ahyɛ kyɛ alehyeleɛ ɔbra le, anaakyɛ, ahyire alebahyene mmerɛ bɔ odi kyɛ ɔba ɔ,

english_verse: Did it take hold of the earth and shake out the wicked like dust from a rug?
translation_verse: bɔ ɔnate so wama maen nu atete fite aseɛ ti waahã ye ti, bɔ ɔma bɔnefoɛ nwati kɔfea ɔ?

english_verse: Early dawn outlines the hills like stitches on clothing or sketches on clay.
translation_verse: Ɔsesã ɔyɛ kyɛ ɛfaa, na ye nye yɛ kyɛ ɛtena bɔ bawura ye ayire ɔ?

english_verse: But its light is too much for those who are evil, and their power is broken.
translation_verse: Kanea ma bɔnefoɛ bɛ nwo kyere bɛ, na obu b’aba nu bɔ ɔmma benni nzɛmmɔne ɔ.

english_verse: Have you seen the gate to the world of the dead?
translation_verse: Ɛborɔ atee pambim ne, aso ebie aye ahyire wɔ le? Anaa, ɛborɔ dɔ awosii kabii ye pambim ne, anwu ye le?

english_verse: And how large is the earth? Tell me, if you know!
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ aseɛ tɛtrɛtɛɛ osi te ne, aso ɛte ye bo? Sɛ ɛse ɛhemɔ amu a, kã e!

english_verse: Where is the home of light, and where does darkness live?
translation_verse: “Kanea ye atenaleɛ ne, ye atee wɔ ni, yeɛ awosii koso, nisua yeɛ ɔte ɔ?

english_verse: I'm certain you must be able to, since you were already born when I created everything.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɛse! yoo, ofikyɛ mebɔ bɛ ne, yeɛ né bawo wɔ, na ali afoɛ pembepembe!

english_verse: Have you been to the places where I keep snow and hail,
translation_verse: “Nekaa bɔ mesie asukɔtwea ne, ahɔ berɛ le, yeɛ nekaa bɔ mesie asukɔtwea ne, anwu ye le,

english_verse: until I use them to punish and conquer nations?
translation_verse: bɔ bɛte nningyein bɔ mafa masie mefa menwondɛ amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ, ngondii ne koɛ kyẽa ne ɔ?

english_verse: Rain that changes barren land to meadows green with grass.
translation_verse: kyɛ ɔma aseɛ katerepee ne aseɛ mbaen benya nzue bɛno, ná ɔma aseɛ fifi ndire ɔ?

english_verse: Who is the father of the dew and of the rain?
translation_verse: “Aso esue ole baba? Bosue bɔ ɔpepe gua ne, nwa yeɛ ɔwole ye ɔ?

english_verse: Who gives birth to the sleet and the frost
translation_verse: Nwa akunu yeɛ asukɔtwea fi wale ɔ, yeɛ nyameɛso asukɔtwea ne, nwa yeɛ ɔwole ye ɔ?

english_verse: that fall in winter, when streams and lakes freeze solid as a rock? Can You Arrange Stars?
translation_verse: Nzue kyengye yɛ kyɛ nyɔboɛ, yeɛ buma kuronguronn ye nye kyengye yɛ asukɔtwea.

english_verse: Can you arrange stars in groups such as Orion and the Pleiades?
translation_verse: “Aso ɛkɔhora kɔkyekye Akɔtaen-ne-ye-mma nzramaa kɔbɔ nu, anaakyɛ ɛkɔhora kɔsangye nzramaa kure bɔ ɔwɔ ewienu afia ne?

english_verse: Do you control the stars or set in place the Big Dipper and the Little Dipper?
translation_verse: Ɛkɔhora kɔma alehyeleɛ nu nzramaa mɔ bɛkɔwa ewienu wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛba ɔ, anaa sorɔ dɔ nzramaa ɔne ye mma bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia ne, ɛkɔhora kohyire ye atee?

english_verse: Do you know the laws that govern the heavens, and can you make them rule the earth?
translation_verse: Ɛse nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ewienu ɔ? Ɛkɔhora kɔfa bɛ nhyehyɛleɛ ne kɔwa aseɛ ye aso?

english_verse: Can you order the clouds to send a downpour,
translation_verse: “Ɛkɔhora kɔtea nu kɔhyɛ munungum kɔma esue kandinga kɔtɔ kogua wɔ so?

english_verse: or will lightning flash at your command?
translation_verse: Ɛkɔhora kɔsoma agralaa mɔ maa bɛkɔtete, maa bekose wɔ kyɛ, ‘Yɛ ɛhe’ anaa?

english_verse: Did you teach birds to know that rain or floods are on their way?
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ wafa nworɛ wawura sona ti anu ɔ, anaa, nwa yeɛ wama sona adwene nimdeɛ ɔ?

english_verse: When lions are hungry, do you help them hunt?
translation_verse: “Ɛkɔhora kɔpena gyata beleɛ ye noa aleɛ kɔma ye, anaa ɛkɔhora kɔma gyata akrɔngrɔma mɔ bɛ ko koyi

english_verse: Do you send an animal into their den?
translation_verse: wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bebutubutu b’afealeɛ nu, anaa bɛtɛ wɔ sosorɛ bo ɔ?

english_verse: And when starving young ravens cry out to me for food, do you satisfy their hunger?
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔpena adene noa aleɛ ma ye ɔ, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ye mma mɔ besu bɛfrɛ Nyameɛ, bɔ ɛhɔen apɛ bɛ maa bɛposa bɛ nwo ɔ?

english_verse: When do mountain goats and deer give birth? Have you been there when their young are born? *
translation_verse: “Eburo mbɔngye bɔ bɛwɔ mmokaa so ne, ɛse mmerɛ horɛ bɔ bɛwo ɔ? Dabɔɔ mɔ fo aworɛ so a, wɔ yeɛ ɛnea bɛ maa bɛwo ɔ?

english_verse: Soon their young grow strong and then leave to be on their own.
translation_verse: Bɛ mma mɔ bɛ nwo mia, benyi wɔ eburo, bɛpakye bɛ nwo, bɔ benza bɛmma bɛ nwo ko ɔ.

english_verse: I alone help them survive in salty desert sand.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ mafa ɛserɛ so mayɛ ye awuro, ná mafa ngyee aseɛ mayɛ ye atenaleɛ ɔ?

english_verse: They stay far from crowded cities and refuse to be tamed.
translation_verse: Okyi dede bɔ ɔwɔ kuro nu ne, na sona bɔ ɔka ye so ne, ɔtea ye a ɔnde.

english_verse: Instead, they roam the hills, searching for pastureland.
translation_verse: Mmokaa so yeɛ onya ye noa aleɛ ɔ, na okyinikyini pena nyaa monɛ biala di.

english_verse: Would a wild ox agree to live in your barn and labor for you?
translation_verse: “Aso torɔen kɔpene so kyɛ ɔkɔso wɔ ɔ? Aso ɔkɔla wɔ tuin nu kɔngɔen?

english_verse: Could you force him to plow or to drag a heavy log to smooth out the soil?
translation_verse: Ɛkɔhora kɔfa nyamaa kɔsosɔ ye maa okofundam aseɛnwo, anaa okofundam bɔnza nu koli wɔ si?

english_verse: Can you depend on him to use his great strength and do your heavy work?
translation_verse: Aso ye anwoserɛ ti ɛkɔfa wɔ wora kowura ye nu, anaa ɛkɔyakyi w’adwuma kowura ye sa kyɛ ɔyɔ?

english_verse: Can you trust him to harvest your grain or take it to your barn from the threshing place? An Ostrich Proudly Flaps Her Wings
translation_verse: Aso ede ye di kyɛ okosa kɔwa, kyɛ ɔkɔfa w’aburoo ne kɔwa nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo ɔ?

english_verse: An ostrich proudly flaps her wings, but not because she loves her young.
translation_verse: “Soholi ɔbɔ ye ndaa nu anigye so, nakoso, ye ndɛkra ne ye ndaa ne, aso bɛ ne asukɔngɔn deɛ bɛsɛ?

english_verse: She abandons her eggs and lets the dusty ground keep them warm.
translation_verse: Soholi yakyi ye ngyiremvua wɔ anweaa nu, ɔma bɛ nwo yɛ hye wɔ aseɛnwo berɛ,

english_verse: And she doesn't seem to worry that the feet of an animal could crush them all.
translation_verse: na ye wora fi kyɛ agyirɛ bie kɔgyerɛgyerɛ bɛ, anaakyɛ kaka aboyaa bie kotiatia so ɔ.

english_verse: She treats her eggs as though they were not her own, unconcerned that her work might be for nothing.
translation_verse: Ye ti anu yɛ se wɔ ye mma mmaa mmaa mɔ so, kyɛ ebiaa nna ye bɔbɔ ye mma ahɔ ɔ, na ɔmva ye nwo kyɛ ye fɛɛ kɔyɛ mbaen ɔ;

english_verse: I myself made her foolish and without common sense.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ Nyameɛ amma wannwu nworɛ, na ɔhyɛle nimdeɛ ne, wamma ye bie.

english_verse: But once she starts running, she laughs at a rider on the fastest horse. Did You Give Horses Their Strength?
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɔbɔ ye ndaa nu kyɛ otu a, ɔsere pɔngɔ ne sona bɔ ɔte ye so ɔka ne.

english_verse: Did you give horses their strength and the flowing hair along their necks?
translation_verse: “Aso wɔ yeɛ ɛma pɔngɔ anwoserɛ ɔ? Wɔ yeɛ ɛma ye kɔme nya anwoserɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Did you make them able to jump like grasshoppers or to frighten people with their snorting?
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ ɛmaa ohuruhuru kyɛ abɛbɛ ɔ? Ye nwomeɛlelɛ foofoo ne, ɔyɛ suro.

english_verse: Before horses are ridden into battle, they paw at the ground, proud of their strength.
translation_verse: Ofumvu aseɛnwo, na odi ye anwoserɛ nwo ahurusi, na ɔkɔ ye nyunu moa okogyina koɛ noa.

english_verse: Laughing at fear, they rush toward the fighting,
translation_verse: Esurolɛ nwo yɛ ye sere, na onzuro, na ɔnnwati mvi ngrandɛ nyunu.

english_verse: while the weapons of their riders rattle and flash in the sun.
translation_verse: Agyaen ndokue, pealɛɛ hyɛmhyɛm ne buralɛ tendenn tworɔntworɔn bɛwosowoso wɔ ye nwo.

english_verse: Unable to stand still, they gallop eagerly into battle when trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Otu amirika nyeranyera wɔ anyeborolɛ ne ɛyaa so, na ɔte totorobɛndo hulɛ a, ogyina a ongyina.

english_verse: Stirred by the distant smells and sounds of war, they snort in reply to the trumpet.
translation_verse: Behu totorobɛndo a, ɔtea nu kyɛ, ‘Yieee!’ Koɛ wɔ dedeede a, ɔte ye nwo mverɛ, yeɛ safohene mɔ b’esebɔlɛ ne koɛ esebɔlɛ koso, ɔwɔ dede a, ɔte.

english_verse: Did you teach hawks to fly south for the winter? *
translation_verse: “Aso wɔ nworɛ yeɛ ɔma akorɔma tu kɔ anwuro anwuro, ná ɔtrɛtrɛ ye ndaa nu kyire ngwaen ɔ?

english_verse: Then their young gather to feast wherever the victim lies.
translation_verse: Mogya yeɛ ye mma mɔ bɛno ɔ, na nekaa bɔ bahu mmenia bagua ne, berɛ yeɛ ɔkɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful,
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE toale so bisale Yob kyɛ,

english_verse: Job said to the Lord:
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yob buale AWURADE kyɛ,

english_verse: Then out of the storm the Lord said to Job:
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE dwudwole fili mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ne anu obuale Yob kyɛ,

english_verse: Face me and answer the questions I ask!
translation_verse: “Bɔ w’abɔsoɛ kyɛ bienzua, mebaabisa wɔ dwirɛ, na ye ye noa kyire me.

english_verse: Are you trying to prove that you are innocent by accusing me of injustice?
translation_verse: Ɛnwa nzɛ mebua ndɛengyea anaa? Ebua me fɔ maa wɔ de edi be anaa?

english_verse: Do you have a powerful arm and a thundering voice that compare with mine?
translation_verse: Aso ele tumi kyɛ Nyameɛ deɛ, wɔ komvi kɔhora kɔbɔ nu kurudududu kyɛbɔ ye deɛ ɔbɔ nu ne?

english_verse: If so, then surround yourself with glory and majesty. *
translation_verse: Nzaade fa ahennie ne anidie siesie wɔ nwo e! Nzaade fa animnyam ne nyemene kera e!

english_verse: Show your furious anger! Throw down and crush
translation_verse: Ma w’ahone hu hahii e! Nea anwomasoɛniɛ biala, ná brɛ ye ase.

english_verse: Wrap them in grave clothes and bury them together in the dusty soil.
translation_verse: Fu bɛ mukoraa wura ase, fa bɛ gua kuku nu wɔ afealeɛ e.

english_verse: Do this, and I will agree that you have won this argument. I Created You
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛkora sɔ yɔ a, me bɔbɔ ngɔbɔ w’aba so, kyɛ wɔ bɔbɔ w’anwoserɛ kora de wɔ ngoa.

english_verse: I created both you and the hippopotamus. It eats only grass like an ox,
translation_verse: “Nea nzue nu ɛsoen, bɔ ɔte m’abɔdeɛ kyɛ wɔ ala ne, odi ndire kyɛ nandwie ala.

english_verse: but look at the mighty muscles in its body
translation_verse: Ye anwoserɛ wɔ ye afia, na ye tumi wɔ ndii bɔ ɔwɔ ye kunu ne anu.

english_verse: and legs. Its tail is like a cedar tree, and its thighs are thick.
translation_verse: Ɔma ye dua yɛ kyeinn kyɛ bakaa bɔ bɛfrɛ ye sida, na banwo ye sɔ ndii nemɔ babɔ nu.

english_verse: The bones in its legs are like bronze or iron.
translation_verse: Ye mmowue nu yɛ se te kyɛ kɔɔbere, na ye mmowue te kyɛ buralɛ.

english_verse: I made it more powerful than any other creature, yet I am stronger still.
translation_verse: “Ɔte sonongo wɔ Nyameɛ sa noa adwuma nu, sana me bɔ mmɔle ye ne yeɛ mekora mefa ngrandɛ meku ye ɔ.

english_verse: Undisturbed, it eats grass while the other animals play nearby. *
translation_verse: Mmokaa mɔ yeɛ bɛma ye aleɛ ɔ, nekaa bɔ eburo ngaka mukoraa bedi angorɛ ɔ.

english_verse: It rests in the shade of trees along the riverbank
translation_verse: Aprokotaa bo yeɛ ɔda ɔ, na ngyɛngyɛma nu ne asaa nu yeɛ ɔfea ɔ.

english_verse: There is no way to capture a hippopotamus— not even by hooking its nose or blinding its eyes.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔhye ye anyekaenn so, anaa ɔkɔhora kɔfa buralɛ kotofi ye bonyi anu ɔ?

english_verse: Can you catch a sea monster by using a fishhook? Can you tie its mouth shut with a rope?
translation_verse: “Ɛkɔhora kɔfa koaa kɔhye ɛlɛngyɛen suronyisuronyi kɔhwe ye kofite, anaa ɛkɔhora kɔfa nyamaa kɔkyekye ye temverema?

english_verse: Can it be led around by a ring in its nose or a hook in its jaw?
translation_verse: Ɛkɔhora kɔfa nyamaa kowura ye bonyi anu, anaa ɛkɔhora kɔfa koaa kɔbɔ ye awogyee?

english_verse: Will it surrender as a slave for life?
translation_verse: Aso ɔne wɔ kɔyɛ apam, kyɛ fa ye yɛ w’akoaa afebɔɔ anaa?

english_verse: Can it be tied by the leg like a pet bird for little girls?
translation_verse: Ɛne ye bekoli angorɛ kyɛ anomaa, anaa ɛkɔto ye kɔme nyamaa kɔfa ye kɔma w’afaneɛ mɔ anaa?

english_verse: Is it ever chopped up and its pieces bargained for in the fish-market?
translation_verse: Aso dwadifoɛ bekoli ye noa bɛkɔtɔne ye? Aso dwadifoɛ bekosi ye koso anaa?

english_verse: Can it be killed with harpoons or spears?
translation_verse: Ɛkɔhora kɔfa pealɛɛ kɔwowɔ ye wereɛ nu, anaa ɛkɔhora kɔfa egyein pealɛɛ kɔwɔ ye ti anu?

english_verse: Wrestle it just once— that will be the end.
translation_verse: Fa wɔ sa sɔ ye nu nea, na bɔ ɔkɔfa kɔyɔ wɔ ne, ɛngɔhɔ ye nwo ko!

english_verse: Merely a glimpse of this monster makes all courage melt.
translation_verse: Eh! Sɛ ɛpena ye kye ye a, ɛkɔfɛ kogua mbaen, wɔ nye bɔ ye so a, aso emvi ase?

english_verse: And if it is too fierce for anyone to attack, who would dare oppose me?
translation_verse: Ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔkɔhora kosi ye ahone kɔɔgyegye ye ɔ. Né nzaade, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina me nyunu ɔ?

english_verse: Who could strip off its armor or bring it under control with a harness?
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kopuro ye si boen ɔ? Buralɛ ndaasoɛ bɔ ɔkata ye hue so ne, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kotofi nu ɔ?

english_verse: Who would try to open its jaws, full of fearsome teeth? *
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kobukye ye awogyee nu ɔ? Ye gye bɔ ogua ye noa nu amukoraa ɔyɛ suro.

english_verse: Its back is covered with shield after shield,
translation_verse: Ye si boen ne, wasa folii, na bahã babatabata so kyɛ nikyee bɔ basosɔ ɔ.

english_verse: firmly bound and closer together
translation_verse: Bamatamata so, bɔ mvrama ngora mva ye afia ɔ.

english_verse: than breath to breath. When This Monster Sneezes
translation_verse: Bepingyepingye so, baha batoatoa nu, bɔ ɛte nu a ɔnyɛ yee ɔ.

english_verse: When this monster sneezes, lightning flashes, and its eyes glow like the dawn.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔpɛ ɛyaen a, né ɔtete see, ye nye mmaa te kyɛ ngyerɛmɔ eyia bɔ wapukye ɔ.

english_verse: Sparks and fiery flames explode from its mouth.
translation_verse: See wuronyiwuronyi fi ye noa nu fite, na ye noa nu pa see.

english_verse: And smoke spews from its nose like steam from a boiling pot,
translation_verse: Nwosina tu fi ye bonyi anu, kyɛ etutue bɔ otu fi kukue bɔ ogyi see so ɔ nu, kyɛ ngyɛngyɛma bɔ ɔyera ɔ nu.

english_verse: while its blazing breath scorches everything in sight.
translation_verse: Ye nwomeɛ ma see tɔ ebunaen nu, na see nzramaa tete fi ye noa nu.

english_verse: Its neck is so tremendous that everyone trembles,
translation_verse: Anwoserɛ wɔ ye kɔme bakaa nu, na nikyee bɔ ɔyɛ suro ne, ɔnyɛ ye suro.

english_verse: the weakest parts of its body are harder than iron,
translation_verse: Ye nwonaen bɔ wabu wagua so ne, nu mia, ɔyɛ se kateree gua ye nwo, na ɔnwoso.

english_verse: When this noisy monster appears, even the most powerful turn and run in fear.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔma ye nwo so a, ɛserɛ ka tumifoɛ, na ɔkekã ye nwo a, besa bɛ si.

english_verse: and weapons of bronze or iron are as useless as straw or rotten wood.
translation_verse: Buralɛ te ye nye so ngyɛngyɛma, yeɛ kɔɔbere koso, obu ye kyɛ dufure bie.

english_verse: Rocks thrown from a sling cause it no more harm than husks of grain. This monster fears no arrows,
translation_verse: Agyaen ngora mma ɔnwati, yeɛ obu taya nyɔboɛ kyɛ afafu.

english_verse: it simply smiles at spears, and striking it with a stick is like slapping it with straw.
translation_verse: Abopura te ye nye so ngyɛngyɛma, yeɛ sɛ bɛto buralɛ tendenn tworɔntworɔn hwii a, ɔyɛ ye sere.

english_verse: As it crawls through the mud, its sharp and spiny hide tears the ground apart.
translation_verse: Ye kunu boen yɛ nna te kyɛ nyangaa bue, na ɔbea asaa nu kyɛ ndaboa bɔ bɛboro so aburoo ɔ.

english_verse: And when it swims down deep, the sea starts churning like boiling oil,
translation_verse: Ɔwoso buma kyɛ nzue bɔ ohu wɔ kukue nu ɔ, na ɔma ɛpo hu kyɛ kukue nu sakyeɛ bɔ ogyi see so ɔ.

english_verse: and it leaves behind a trail of shining white foam.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ a, ɔyakyi ahure fitaa atee wɔ ye si, bɔ ɔmaa esusu kyɛ ɛpo afu gyein ɔ.

english_verse: No other creature on earth is so fearless.
translation_verse: Ye sɛso nne aseɛ so, ɔte abɔdeɛ bɔ onzuro hwee ɔ.

english_verse: It is king of all proud creatures, and it looks upon the others as nothing.
translation_verse: Ɔnea kaka biala bɔ ɔmoma ye nwo so ɔ, na odi hene wɔ ngaka anwomasoɛ amukoraa so.”

english_verse: No one can oppose you, because you have the power to do what you want.
translation_verse: “Mese kyɛ ɛkora yɔ nikyee biala, na ebiala ngɔhora ngosi wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ate.

english_verse: You asked why I talk so much when I know so little. I have talked about things that are far beyond my understanding.
translation_verse: ‘Sona bɔ nimdeɛ abɔ ye beni ɛne, bɔ obu me nhyehyɛleɛ animtia ye?’ Yiti nahorɛ nu, mahã edwirɛ bɔ né mende ye bo ɔ, edwirɛ anwanwasoɛ bɔ ɔbo me so, bɔ né menze ɔ.

english_verse: You told me to listen and answer your questions.
translation_verse: Mesrɛ wɔ, tie, na mebaadwudwo! Ngobisa wɔ dwirɛ, na kyirekyire me.

english_verse: I heard about you from others; now I have seen you with my own eyes.
translation_verse: Me so yeɛ mva ndele wɔ nga ɔ, nakoso afei de, me nye nwu wɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Eliphaz: What my servant Job has said about me is true, but I am angry with you and your two friends for not telling the truth.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE hane sɔ dwirɛ ne hyirele Yob yiele nen, AWURADE sele Temanniɛ Elifase kyɛ, “Mafɛ wɔ ne wɔ damvo nyɔ nemɔ so yaa piri paa, ofikyɛ ɛmɔanga me nwo dwirɛ nahorɛ nu, kyɛbɔ me somvoɛ Yob de waha ye nahorɛ nu ne.

english_verse: So I want you to go over to Job and offer seven bulls and seven goats on an altar as a sacrifice to please me. After this, Job will pray, and I will agree not to punish you for your foolishness.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔfa nandwie nyii nzoo ne mmoaen nyii nzoo, ná ɛmɔhɔ me somvoɛ Yob berɛ bɛɛbɔ ɛmɔ ti naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ. Me somvoɛ Yob kɔbɔ mbaeɛ kɔma ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ngotie ye mbaeɛ, na mengogyina ɛmɔ ngwaseasɛm ne aso me ne ɛmɔ ngoli. Ofikyɛ ɛmɔanga me nwo dwirɛ nahorɛ nu, kyɛbɔ me somvoɛ Yob de waha ye nahorɛ nu ne.”

english_verse: Eliphaz, Bildad, and Zophar obeyed the Lord, and he answered Job's prayer. A Happy Ending
translation_verse: Yiti Temanniɛ Elifase, Suhiniɛ Bildade ne Naamaniɛ Sofa bɛhɔle bɛɛyɔle bɔ AWURADE ha hyirele bɛ ne, na AWURADE tiele Yob mbaeɛ ne. Nyameɛ ma Yob sa si ye gya nu

english_verse: After Job had prayed for his three friends, the Lord made Job twice as rich as he had been before.
translation_verse: Yob bɔle mbaeɛ mane ye damvo nemɔ yiele nen, AWURADE maa osa sili ye gya nu bieku. Bɔ né Yob ole ye daa ne amukoraa, AWURADE fale ye mmɔhoɛ nyɔ mane ye.

english_verse: Then Job gave a feast for his brothers and sisters and for his old friends. They expressed their sorrow for the suffering the Lord had brought on him, and they each gave Job some silver and a gold ring.
translation_verse: Afei Yob aliɛma mmienzua mukoraa ne oliɛma mmrasua mukoraa ne ebiala bɔ né ɔse Yob daa ne, bɛwale ye berɛ, na bɛ ne ye didili wɔ ye awuro. Bɛdodole ye, na bɛkyekyele ye wora wɔ amaneɛ amukoraa bɔ AWURADE maa ɔtole ye ne anwo. Bɛ nu biala mane ye sikaa ne sikaa kɔkorɛ kaa ko.

english_verse: In addition to seven sons, Job had three daughters,
translation_verse: Osa wole mmienzua nzoo ne mmrasua nza.

english_verse: They were the most beautiful women in that part of the world, and Job gave them shares of his property, along with their brothers.
translation_verse: Aseɛ ne aso amukoraa, né brasua biala nne berɛ bɔ ye anwonyemene te kyɛ Yob mma mmrasua nemɔ ɔ. Na bɛ baba mane bɛ ne b’eliɛma mmienzua nemɔ agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: and when he finally died, he was very old.
translation_verse: Na Yob nyini yɛle aworowaa posoposo koraka yeɛ owu ɔ.

english_verse: God blesses those people who refuse evil advice and won't follow sinners or join in sneering at God.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ondie amumuyɛɛfoɛ foɛtulɛ, ná ɔmva bɔnefoɛ atee so, ná ɔne mmenia bɔ bɛgoro Nyameɛ nwo ne bendu nu ne, onya saleɛ.

english_verse: Instead, they find happiness in the Teaching of the Lord, and they think about it day and night.
translation_verse: Sɔ sona ne, ye nye gye AWURADE mmeraa ne anwo, na ye mmeraa ne yeɛ ɔdwene ye nwo eyia ne kɔngɔen ɔ.

english_verse: They are like trees growing beside a stream, trees that produce fruit in season and always have leaves. Those people succeed in everything they do.
translation_verse: Ɔte kyɛ bakaa bɔ balua ye asue noa, bɔ osu ye mma wɔ mmerɛ bɔ odi kyɛ osu ɔ nu, bɔ ye nyaa ɔngese ɔ. Nikyee bɔ ɔyɔ biala, oyie ye yé.

english_verse: That isn't true of those who are evil— they are like straw blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Nakoso amumuyɛɛfoɛ de, nna sɔ yeɛ bɛte ɔ, na mmom bɛte kyɛ afafu bɔ mvrama hu ye kɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Sinners won't have an excuse on the day of judgment, and they won't have a place with the people of God.
translation_verse: Yiti amumuyɛɛfoɛ, bengoli be wɔ ndɛenbualɛ ne anu, yeɛ teneneefoɛ nyianu koso, bɔnefoɛ bengonya berɛ bie bɛngɔhɔ;

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who follows him, but the wicked follow a road that leads to ruin.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ AWURADE se teneneefoɛ b’atee bɔ bɛnate so ɔ, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, b’atee bɔ bɛnate so ne, ongoyie bɛ yé.

english_verse: Why do the nations plot, and why do their people make useless plans?
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ maen maen mɔ bɛyɔ lɔen ɔ, ná maen mɔ bɛbɔ porɛ bɔ ongonzi pasiliwa biala ɔ?

english_verse: The kings of this earth have all joined together to turn against the Lord and his chosen king.
translation_verse: Aseɛ ye aso ahemvo boaboa bɛ nwo, na maenbulɛfoɛ bɛbɔ nu bɛfa adwene betia AWURADE ne bɔ AWURADE wapopa ye ngoo ne kyɛ,

english_verse: They say, “Let's cut the ropes and set ourselves free!”
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔma yɛle yɛ nwo yɛfi bɛ tumi bo, ná yɛpuropuro panwu bɔ babɔ yɛ ne yɛfi yɛ gya.”

english_verse: In heaven the Lord laughs as he sits on his throne, making fun of the nations.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔte nyameɛso ne, ɔsere; bɛ nwo yɛ AWURADE sere.

english_verse: The Lord becomes furious and threatens them. His anger terrifies them as he says,
translation_verse: Afei okodwudwo kohyire bɛ wɔ ye ɛyaafɛlɛ nu, ná wafa ye ahonehulɛ ne wama ahunundetelɛ atɔ bɛ so, kyɛ,

english_verse: “I've put my king on Zion, my sacred hill.”
translation_verse: “Me AWURADE, me bɔbɔ, masi me hene mafa ye matena me bokaa krongron Sion so.”

english_verse: I will tell the promise that the Lord made to me: “You are my son, because today I have become your father.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ ne ngɔto dwaa: Osele me kyɛ, “Mma ole wɔ, ɛnɛ mawo wɔ.

english_verse: Ask me for the nations, and every nation on earth will belong to you.
translation_verse: Bisa me, na ngɔma maen maen mɔ kɔyɛ w’agyapadeɛ, ná ofi aseɛ ti bɔ ɔkwaahã ye ti ayɛ wɔ deɛ.

english_verse: You will smash them with an iron rod and shatter them like dishes of clay.”
translation_verse: Ɛkɔfa buralɛ pɔmaa kobubu bɛ, ná anyoko bɛ kyɛ ngukuenwonɛniɛ ye bua.”

english_verse: Be smart, all you rulers, and pay close attention.
translation_verse: Yiti afei, ahemvo, ɛ́mɔsua nworɛ; ewiase maenbulɛfoɛ, ɛ́mɔtie kɔkɔbɔlɛ.

english_verse: Serve and honor the Lord; be glad and tremble.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa esuronyi bɛso AWURADE, ná ɛ́mɔfa anwopopolɛ koso beli ahurusi.

english_verse: Show respect to his son because if you don't, the Lord might become furious and suddenly destroy you. But he blesses and protects everyone who runs to him.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛma Baa ne, ná wamvɛ yaa ama ɛmɔanwuwu atunu, ofikyɛ ye ahone kohu ndɛndɛ. Bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ wora bewura AWURADE nu ne, bɛ mukoraa benya saleɛ.

english_verse: I have a lot of enemies, Lord. Many fight against
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, me pɔfoɛ mɔ sone! Mmenia pee bedwɔso betia me.

english_verse: me and say, “God won't rescue you!”
translation_verse: Mmenia pee bɛkã bekyire me kyɛ, “Ongonya mmokalɛ biala ngofi Nyameɛ berɛ.” Sela

english_verse: But you are my shield, and you give me victory and great honor.
translation_verse: Nakoso ao AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’akokyɛm, m’animnyam ne me worakyekyelɛniɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I pray to you, and you answer from your sacred hill.
translation_verse: Ndeane nu nzu mvrɛle AWURADE, na otiele me sufrɛ fili ye bokaa krongron ne aso. Sela

english_verse: I sleep and wake up refreshed because you, Lord, protect me.
translation_verse: Metɔ berɛ medafe; na mesa metingye, ofikyɛ AWURADE gyi me si.

english_verse: Ten thousand enemies attack from every side, but I am not afraid.
translation_verse: Menzuro mmenia apee apee bɔ babɔ me nwo porɛ bapɛ me nwo bayia ne.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God! Break my enemies' jaws and shatter their teeth,
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, dwɔso e! Pepɛ de me, ao me Nyameɛ! Ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ebubu me pɔfoɛ amukoraa b’awogyee, ná ebubu amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛ gye ɔ.

english_verse: because you protect and bless your people.
translation_verse: Ngoalelɛ fi AWURADE berɛ; wɔ saleɛ ne, maa ɔbra wɔ mmenia so! Sela

english_verse: You are my God and protector. Please answer my prayer. I was in terrible distress, but you set me free. Now have pity and listen as I pray.
translation_verse: Ao, me Nyameɛ bɔ edi me dwirɛ ma me ɔ, mefrɛ wɔ a tie me e! Me nwo hyerele me ne, wɔ yeɛ ɛpepɛ lele me ɔ. Nwu me anwumvoin, ná tie me mbaeɛ.

english_verse: How long will you people refuse to respect me? You love foolish things, and you run after what is worthless.
translation_verse: Ao adasa, ɛmɔkogua me nyunu ase maa okoodwu kyinzu? Ɛmɔkoli edwirɛ mbaen mbaen ne ngondombo dwirɛ si maa okoodwu kyinzu? Sela

english_verse: The Lord has chosen everyone who is faithful to be his very own, and he answers my prayers.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛ́mɔkaye kyɛ sona bɔ ɔtengyɛ ne, AWURADE aneanea nu waye ye wasie berɛ wama ye nwo; sɛ mesu mefrɛ AWURADE a, otie me sufrɛ.

english_verse: But each of you had better tremble and turn from your sins. Silently search your heart as you lie in bed.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma ye nwo yɛ ɛmɔ suro, na nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ bɔne; ɛ́mɔdwene edwirɛ ne anwo wɔ ɛmɔ bɛen so, ná ɛ́mɔyɛ konn. Sela

english_verse: Offer the proper sacrifices and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbɔ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ; ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ wora bewura AWURADE nu.

english_verse: There are some who ask, “Who will be good to us?” Let your kindness, Lord, shine brightly on us.
translation_verse: Mmeni pee yeɛ bebisa kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔmaa yɛkonwu yɛ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ?” Ao AWURADE, ma w’adom ne ɔta wɔ yɛ so!”

english_verse: You brought me more happiness than a rich harvest of grain and grapes.
translation_verse: Afa anigye awura m’ahone nu atra mmerɛ bɔ b’aburoo ne bɛ nzaa sonene pee ne.

english_verse: I can lie down and sleep soundly because you, Lord, will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ngɔla ngɔlafe asomdwee nu, ofikyɛ AWURADE, wɔ ngome yeɛ ɛmaa metena ase wɔ asomdwee nu ɔ.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! Pay attention when I groan.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, tie me noa dwirɛ, ná yɛ asoɛ tie adwenedwene bɔ watɔ me so ɔ.

english_verse: You are my King and my God. Answer my cry for help because I pray to you.
translation_verse: Tie me sufrɛ, me Hene ne me Nyameɛ, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ mebɔ mbaeɛ mekyire wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Each morning you listen to my prayer, as I bring my requests to you and wait for your reply.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ngyerɛmɔ ɛte me komvi, ngyerɛmɔ mefa me dwirɛ meto wɔ nyunu, na menwondɛ wɔ mmuayɛɛ.

english_verse: You are not the kind of God who is pleased with evil. Sinners can't stay with you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛte Nyameɛ bɔ wɔ nye ngye bɔne nwo ɔ; bɔne ngora ne wɔ bɛndena.

english_verse: No one who boasts can stand in your presence, Lord, and you hate evil people.
translation_verse: Nduhoɛniɛ ɔngora ngyina wɔ nyunu; na ekyi bɔnefoɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: You destroy every liar, and you despise violence and deceit.
translation_verse: Ɛma ngondombofoɛ b’ayieleɛ yie bɛ, na kodiawufoɛ ne ndurumfoɛ de, AWURADE kyi bɛ.

english_verse: Because of your great mercy, I come to your house, Lord, and I am filled with wonder as I bow down to worship at your holy temple.
translation_verse: Nakoso, ɔnate wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, ngɔwa w’awuro; ɔnate kyɛ mesuro wɔ ne ati, ngɔfa me nye ngohyire w’asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron ne ngɔsɔne wɔ.

english_verse: You do what is right, and I ask you to guide me. Make your teaching clear because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ɔnate me pɔfoɛ mɔ ati, fa wɔ tenenee ne kyire me atee; ma w’atee ne ɔla me nyunu turoloo.

english_verse: Nothing they say is true! They just want to destroy. Their words are deceitful like a hidden pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛnga nahorɛ kaala, aborɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ bɛ ti anu ɔ; bɛ komvi te asieleɛ kumaa bɔ ɔla berɛ too ɔ, na bɛfa bɛ noa bɛdɛfɛdɛfɛ mmenia.

english_verse: Punish them, God, and let their own plans bring their downfall. Get rid of them! They keep committing crimes and turning against you.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, ma bɛ bɔne ɔbɔ bɛ ti so, na bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ngaen bɔ basua ne, maa ɔhye bɛ. Bɛ mmeraatolɛ worawora ne ati, foa bɛ fi wɔ nyunu, ofikyɛ bayɛ wɔ nwo lɔen.

english_verse: Let all who run to you for protection always sing joyful songs. Provide shelter for those who truly love you and let them rejoice.
translation_verse: Nakoso ebiala bɔ ɔbafea wɔ nu ne de, ma ye nye gye; maa bɛfa anigye bɛto dwein daa. Bɔ bɛ nwo waen, amaa ɔnate so bɛ bɔ bɛ nye gye wɔ dumaa nwo ne, banya wɔ nu anigye.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who live right, and you shield them with your kindness.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE, eyira sona bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ, ɛfa adom ɛpɛ ye nwo yia kyɛ akokyɛm.

english_verse: Don't punish me, Lord, or even correct me when you are angry!
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nnɛkã me nyunu wɔ wɔ yaafɛlɛ nu, yeɛ nnɛtwe me so wɔ wɔ yaafɛlɛ piri nu.

english_verse: Have pity on me and heal my feeble body. My bones tremble with fear,
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nwu me anwumvoin, ofikyɛ menwu amaneɛ. Ao AWURADE, sa me anwonyerɛ, ofikyɛ me mmowue nu tutu me.

english_verse: and I am in deep distress. How long will it be?
translation_verse: Me kra afokyɛ, na ao AWURADE, ɔkwaadwu kyinzu?

english_verse: Turn and come to my rescue. Show your wonderful love and save me, Lord.
translation_verse: Sa bra, ao AWURADE, de me kra ngoa; pepɛ de me, ɔnate wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati.

english_verse: If I die, I cannot praise you or even remember you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sona wu a, ɔngora ngaye wɔ; nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔye wɔ ayɛ wɔ ɛborɔ ɔ?

english_verse: My groaning has worn me out. At night my bed and pillow are soaked with tears.
translation_verse: Ɛpenenɛ amaa mayɛ hodwoo; kɔngɔen biala, ɛmoen ma me bɛen doa fotii, na me suɛ ma me mba doa.

english_verse: Sorrow has made my eyes dim, and my sight has failed because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Aworabɔlɛ ama me nye ayɛ samɔnn, na ɔnate me pɔfoɛ amukoraa bɛ ti, me nye ayɛ musinamusina.

english_verse: You, Lord, heard my crying, and those hateful people had better leave me alone.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ amumuyɛɛfoɛ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔfi me so bɛhɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE ate me suɛ ne.

english_verse: You have answered my prayer and my plea for mercy.
translation_verse: AWURADE ate me sufrɛ; AWURADE kole me mbaeɛ ne kɔto nu.

english_verse: My enemies will be ashamed and terrified, as they quickly run away in complete disgrace.
translation_verse: Me pɔfoɛ mɔ amukoraa, bɛ nyunu kogua ase, ná ahunundetelɛ atɔ bɛ so paa; bekosa bɛ si, na bɛ nyunu kogua ase mvum nu.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my protector. Rescue me and keep me safe from all who chase me.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ, wɔ nu yeɛ menwati mebafea ɔ, bɛ bɔ bɛfoa me ne amukoraa, de me fi bɛ sa nu, ná pepɛ de me.

english_verse: Or else they will rip me apart like lions attacking a victim, and no one will save me.
translation_verse: Wamma ye sɔ a, bɛkɔtete me nu pasapasa kyɛ gyata tete sona nu ɔ, na bɛkɔpoa me ase bɛkɔhɔ bɔ mengonya defoɛ biala ɔ.

english_verse: I have not betrayed a friend or had pity on an enemy who attacks for no reason.
translation_verse: sɛ mafa bɔne matua sona bɔ ɔne me te asomdwee nu kerɛ, anaakyɛ mafa atee tɛɛ so mafa me pɔfoɛ nningyein a,

english_verse: If I have done any of this, then let my enemies chase and capture me. Let them trample me to death and leave me in the dirt.
translation_verse: ye de ma me pɔfoɛ ɔfoa me ɔɔto me; maa otiatia me ngoa so wɔ nnɛterɛ nu, ná ɔ́fa me kra owura mvuture nu. Sela

english_verse: Get angry, Lord God! Do something! Attack my furious enemies. See that justice is done.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, fɛ yaa ná dwɔso e; kekã wɔ nwo dwɔso tia me pɔfoɛ mɔ b’ɛyaafɛlɛ; ao me Nyameɛ, dwɔso gyina me si, wɔ bɔ ahyehyɛ ndɛenbualɛ ato berɛ ɔ’.

english_verse: Make the nations come to you, as you sit on your throne above them all.
translation_verse: Ma maen maen so mmenia amukoraa bɛpɛ wɔ nwo beyia, ná tena w’ahennie bia so wɔ bɛ ti so anwuro anwuro.

english_verse: Our Lord, judge the nations! Judge me and show that I am honest and innocent.
translation_verse: AWURADE kobua maen maen mɔ ndɛen. Ao AWURADE, nea me tengyɛlɛ so ɔne nahorɛ bɔ medi so, ná di me dwirɛ ma me.

english_verse: You know every heart and mind, and you always do right. Now make violent people stop, but protect all of us who obey you.
translation_verse: Ao bɔnefoɛ b’amumuyɛɛ ne, ma ye bo ɔpɛ, nakoso sona bɔ ɔtengyɛ ne de, ma ye bo otindim. Ao Nyameɛ bɔ ɛtengyɛ ɔ, wɔ yeɛ ɛse mmenia ti anu ne b’ahone nu dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You, God, are my shield, the protector of everyone whose heart is right.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ te m’akokyɛm, ye yeɛ ɔpepɛ de bɛ bɔ b’ahone nu te ɔ.

english_verse: You see that justice is done, and each day you take revenge.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ te ndɛenbualɛniɛ nahorɛniɛ, ɔne Nyameɛ bɔ ɔfɛ bɔnefoɛ so yaa daa biala ɔ.

english_verse: Whenever your enemies refuse to change their ways, you sharpen your sword and string your bow.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie anzakyera ye adwene a, Nyameɛ kosi ye ngrandɛ ne; wakondo ye agyaen, na wasina.

english_verse: Your deadly arrows are ready with flaming tips.
translation_verse: Wasiesie ye akodeɛ suronyisuronyi ne, na wasiesie ye agyaen mmakaa bɔ ogye see ne.

english_verse: An evil person is like a woman about to give birth to a hateful, deceitful, and rebellious child.
translation_verse: Nea, amumuyɛɛniɛ ɔnwonzɛ bɔne, ɔnwonzɛ musue, na ɔwo ngondombo.

english_verse: Such people dig a deep hole, then fall in it themselves.
translation_verse: Ofu kumaa maa ɔkɔ kuronn, na ɔtɔ ye bɔbɔ ye kumaa bɔ wafu ɔ nu.

english_verse: The trouble they cause comes back on them, and their heads are crushed by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Ye musue bɔ ye bɔbɔ ye ti so, na basabasa bɔ wahyehyɛ ne, odwiri gua ye bɔbɔ ye ti so.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You always do right. I will sing about you, the Lord Most High.
translation_verse: AWURADE tengyɛ, yiti ngɔfa asennaa bɔ ɔfata ye ɔ ngɔma ye, na AWURADE bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro anwuro ne, ngɔto dwein ngɔye ye dumaa ayɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth! You let your glory be seen in the heavens above.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, yɛ Mene, wɔ dumaa piri paa ne kata aseɛ ye aso amukoraa! Wɔ bɔ w’animnyam wɔ ewienu anwuro anwuro ɔ!

english_verse: With praises from children and from tiny infants, you have built a fortress. It makes your enemies silent, and all who turn against you are left speechless.
translation_verse: Ɔnate wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ ti, yeɛ kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ɛkɔhã pɔfoɛ ne ne wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne bɛ noa kɔto nu ne ati, nnɔma ne ngwadaa mmaa mmaa bɛ noa, yeɛ ɛfa so ma mmenia te w’animnyam nwo dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I often think of the heavens your hands have made, and of the moon and stars you put in place.
translation_verse: Sɛ menea w’anwuro anwuro ne, bɔ ɔte wɔ sa noa adwuma ne, ɛsraen ne nzramaa bɔ afa atuatua berɛ a,

english_verse: Then I ask, “Why do you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for us weaklings?”
translation_verse: né dasaniɛ te nzu koraa bɔ ɛdwene ye nwo ɔ, yeɛ sona awa te nzu, bɔ ɔla w’ahone nwo ɔ?

english_verse: You made us a little lower than you yourself, and you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Nakoso amaa wahɔ ase kãa bie watra abɔfo mɔ, na afa animnyam ne anidie abɔ ye abotire.

english_verse: You let us rule everything your hands have made. And you put all of it under our power—
translation_verse: Ama ye tumi wɔ wɔ sa noa nnwumaa so, afa nningyein amukoraa awura ye gya bo:

english_verse: the sheep and the cattle, and every wild animal,
translation_verse: mmoaen ne nandwie nyii amukoraa, yeɛ eburo ngaka koso,

english_verse: the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and all ocean creatures.
translation_verse: ewienu nnomaa, ɛpo nu naen, ɔne kaka biala bɔ ɔla ɛpo nu ɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and Ruler, your name is wonderful everywhere on earth!
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, yɛ Mene, wɔ dumaa piri paa ne kata aseɛ ye aso amukoraa!

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, with all my heart and tell about the wonders you have worked.
translation_verse: AWURADE, ngɔfa m’ahone amukoraa ngɔla wɔ ase; ngɔbɔ w’anwanwadeɛ amukoraa nwo dawure.

english_verse: God Most High, I will rejoice; I will celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Ɔnate wɔ ti ngɔma me nye kɔgye, ná mali ahurusi; ao, Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ, ngɔto wɔ dumaa nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein.

english_verse: When my enemies face you, they run away and stumble and are destroyed.
translation_verse: Me pɔfoɛ mɔ sale bɛ si, na befifini ase bewuwuli wɔ wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: You take your seat as judge, and your fair decisions prove that I was in the right.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ali me dwirɛ ama me, na atena ahennie bia so bɔ ebua ndɛen turoloo ɔ.

english_verse: You warn the nations and destroy evil people; you wipe out their names forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ahwi maen maen mɔ nyunu, ama bɔnefoɛ b’ayieleɛ ayie bɛ, na anunu bɛ dumaa boso afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Our enemies are destroyed completely for all time. Their cities are torn down, and they will never be remembered again.
translation_verse: Pɔfoɛ nemɔ b’ayieleɛ ayie bɛ afebɔɔ maa bɛ boso anunu. Abɔ bɛ nguro nemɔ maa bayɛ kurofoen, na bɛ nwo ngayeɛ atu amini.

english_verse: You rule forever, Lord, and you are on your throne, ready for judgment.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE de, ɔte ye ahennie bia so afebɔɔ, na wafa ye ahennie bia wasie berɛ bɔ obua ndɛen ɔ.

english_verse: You judge the world fairly and treat all nations with justice.
translation_verse: Obua wiase ndɛen bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ; ɔfa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ yeɛ obua maen maen mɔ ndɛen ɔ.

english_verse: The poor can run to you because you are a fortress in times of trouble.
translation_verse: AWURADE te anwoserɛ afealeɛ ma bɛ bɔ ebiemɔ hyɛ bɛ so ɔ, anwoserɛ afealeɛ wɔ amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu.

english_verse: Everyone who honors your name can trust you, because you are faithful to all who depend on you.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bɛse wɔ dumaa ne, bɛfa bɛ wora bewura wɔ nu, ofikyɛ wɔ, ao AWURADE, bɛ bɔ bɛpena wɔ si atee ne, anye wɔ sa amvi bɛ bo.

english_verse: You rule from Zion, Lord, and we sing about you to let the nations know everything you have done.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔto AWURADE bɔ ɔte Sion ne nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein. Ɛmɔhã bɔ wayɔ ɔ wɔ maen maen mɔ so.

english_verse: You did not forget to punish the guilty or listen to the cries of those in need.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ye bɔ ɔtɔ mogya so wereɛ ne, ɔkaye bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ amaneɛ nu ɔ, na ɔmma ye wora mvi bɛ sufrɛ.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! My enemies mistreat me. Keep me from the gates that lead to death,
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nwu me anwumvoin. Wɔ bɔ ɛpepɛ de me fi ɛborɔ atee pambim nu ɔ, nea amaneɛ bɔ menwu ye wɔ me pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu ɔ,

english_verse: and I will sing about you at the gate to Zion. I will be happy there because you rescued me.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so mabɔ w’ayɛyelɛ amukoraa nwo dawure. Na ɔnate elelɛ bɔ ale me ne ati, ngoli ahurusi wɔ Sion awa brasua pambim ne anu.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations fell into their own pits, and their feet were caught in their own traps.
translation_verse: Kumaa bɔ maen maen mɔ batu ne, batete bagua nu; ngaen bɔ besuale bɛfa bɛfeale ne, wasɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ gya.

english_verse: You showed what you are like, and you made certain that justice is done, but evil people are trapped by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: AWURADE nate ye ndɛen turoloo bɔ obua ne aso waye ye nwo ali wahyire; wama bɔnefoɛ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ yɔleɛ wayɛ ngaen wahye bɛ.

english_verse: The wicked will go down to the world of the dead to be with those nations that forgot about you.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ bekowu bɛkɔhɔ ɛborɔ, maen maen amukoraa bɔ bɛ wora fi Nyameɛ ne koso, sɔ ala.

english_verse: The poor and the homeless won't always be forgotten and without hope.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ne, ye wora ngofi bɛ mmerɛ biala le, yeɛ ɔngɔma ehiafoɛ b’anyelasoɛ ngotu ngomini afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Don't let the nations win. Make them stand trial in your court of law.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, dwɔso e, nnɛma adasa di ngonim; bua maen maen mɔ ndɛen wɔ wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: Make the nations afraid and let them all discover just how weak they are.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ma ɛserɛ tɔ bɛ so; ma maen maen benwu kyɛ bɛte adasa mmaa mbaen. Sela

english_verse: Why are you far away, Lord? Why do you hide yourself when I am in trouble?
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nzu ati yeɛ aagyina dedeede sɔa ye? Nzu ati yeɛ amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu, afa wɔ nwo afea ye?

english_verse: Proud and brutal people hunt down the poor. But let them get caught by their own evil plans!
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ bele anwomasoɛ bɛtane bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ, bɛ nye; porɛ bɔ babɔ ne, maa obu sa bɛ.

english_verse: The wicked brag about their deepest desires. Those greedy people hate and curse you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔnefoɛ bɛfa bɔ ɔla b’ahone nwo bɛhoahoa bɛ nwo, yeɛ adifuuniɛ ɔnoma AWURADE odwudwo otia ye.

english_verse: The wicked are too proud to turn to you or even think about you.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ ye anwomasoɛ maa ɔmbena Nyameɛ si atee; ye adwene amukoraa ole kyɛ, “Nyameɛ biala nne berɛ.”

english_verse: They are always successful, though they can't understand your teachings, and they keep sneering at their enemies.
translation_verse: Nningyein kɔ so yé ma ye mmerɛ biala; wɔ ndɛenbualɛ ne, ɔwɔ anwuro anwuro bɔ ye de ɔmva ye nwo ɔ; ɔgoro ye pɔfoɛ mɔ amukoraa bɛ nwo.

english_verse: In their hearts they say, “Nothing can hurt us! We'll always be happy and free from trouble.”
translation_verse: Ɔka ye wɔ ye ti anu kyɛ, “Mengofi ase”; aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu, mengoyia amaneɛ biala.”

english_verse: They curse and tell lies, and all they talk about is how to be cruel or how to do wrong.
translation_verse: Ɛnomalɛ, nnakannaka ne anwunanwuna ayi ye noa nu to, na ye temverema bo te nzɛmmɔne ne amumuyɛɛ.

english_verse: They are hungry lions hiding in the bushes, hoping to catch some helpless passerby. They trap the poor in nets and drag them away.
translation_verse: Ɔtetɛ mvealeɛ nu kyɛ gyata bɔ wafea poen nu ɔ; ɔtetɛ kyɛ okonya bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ ɔkɔhye bɛ. Ɔkye bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ, na ɔpoa bɛ ase kowura ye ngaen nu.

english_verse: They crouch down and wait to grab a victim.
translation_verse: Ɔkoto, na okundu berɛ, na ɔfa ye anwoserɛ ɔma mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ne bɛtɔ ye ngaen nu.

english_verse: They say, “God can't see! He's got on a blindfold.”
translation_verse: Ɔka ye wɔ ye ti anu kyɛ, “Nyameɛ wora afi, wafa ye nyunu wafea, na ongonwu ye le.”

english_verse: Do something, Lord God, and use your powerful arm to help those in need.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, dwɔso e! Ao Nyameɛ, kyire wɔ tumi! Nnɛma wɔ wora fi sona bɔ onwu amaneɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The wicked don't respect you. In their hearts they say, “God won't punish us!”
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ bɔnefoɛ odwudwo tia Nyameɛ, ná ɔkã ye wɔ ye ti anu kyɛ, “Ɛngɔhwe me so” ye?

english_verse: But you see the trouble and the distress, and you will do something. The poor can count on you, and so can orphans.
translation_verse: Nakoso enwu ye. Amba, wɔ nye tua amaneɛ ne aworabɔlɛ bɔ ɔba ɔ, maa yiti ɛkɔhwe ye so wɔ ye nwo. Sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ne, ɔfa ye nwo wura wɔ sa; wɔ yeɛ ɛte ayisiaaniɛ bokafoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Now break the power of all merciless people. Punish them for doing wrong and make them stop.
translation_verse: De bɔnefoɛ ne amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛ sa nu tumi; tua ye bɔne so kerɛ kɔpem kyɛ engonwu ko po ɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will always rule, but every godless nation will vanish from the earth.
translation_verse: AWURADE te hene afebɔɔ, na maen maen mɔ bɛ boso konua kofi ye aseɛ so.

english_verse: You listen to the longings of those who suffer. You offer them hope, and you pay attention to their cries for help.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, etie anwobrɛaseɛniɛ ye abisadeɛ; ɛhyɛ ye nguraen, etie ye sufrɛ,

english_verse: You defend orphans and everyone else in need, so that no one on earth can terrify others again.
translation_verse: na edi ayisiaaniɛ ne sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ɔ bɛ dwirɛ ma bɛ, amaa ɔnate so dasaniɛ bɔ ofi nnɛterɛ nu wanyɛ anwunanwuna ko.

english_verse: The Lord is my fortress! Don't say to me, “Escape like a bird to the mountains!”
translation_verse: AWURADE nu yeɛ me wora wura ɔ. Ɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ ɛmɔse me kra kyɛ, “Nwati kyɛ anomaa kɔ wɔ bokaa so;

english_verse: You tell me, “Watch out! Those evil people have put their arrows on their bows, and they are standing in the shadows, aiming at good people.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ nea, bɔnefoɛ bakondo agyaen, basina agyaen bakaa ne kyɛ bɛto ye awosii nu besina sona bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: What can an honest person do when everything crumbles?”
translation_verse: Na sɛ bedwiri fapem ne begua a, nzikyɛ yeɛ teneneefoɛ bɛkɔhora ye yɔ ɔ”?

english_verse: The Lord is sitting in his sacred temple on his throne in heaven. He knows everything we do because he sees us all.
translation_verse: AWURADE wɔ ye asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron ne anu; AWURADE ahennie bia ne wɔ nyameɛso. Ye nye tua ebiala, na ɔkari adasa mmaa bɛ yɔleɛ nea.

english_verse: The Lord tests honest people, but despises those who are cruel and love violence.
translation_verse: AWURADE so teneneefoɛ ne bɔnefoɛ nea, nakoso ye kra kyi sona bɔ okuro basabasayɔlɛ ɔ.

english_verse: He will send fiery coals and flaming sulfur down on the wicked, and they will drink nothing but a scorching wind.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔtɔ see ne sɔfe kogua bɔnefoɛ so; mvrama hyerɛhyerɛ yeɛ ɔkɔfa kotua bɛ kerɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord always does right and wants justice done. Everyone who does right will see his face.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE te teneneeniɛ, okuro bra bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ; na sona bɔ ɔtengyɛ ne, okonwu AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord! All who were faithful and all who were loyal have disappeared.
translation_verse: Boka me, ao AWURADE, ofikyɛ teneneeniɛ de, ebie nne berɛ ko; na nahorɛlilɛfoɛ, bɛ boso anunu afi adasa mmaa nu.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies, and no one is sincere.
translation_verse: Bɛpepɛ anoanu bekyirekyire bɛ nwo. Bɛfa bɛ noa bɛdɛfɛdɛfɛ, ná bama bɛ noa ayɛ nyɔ.

english_verse: Won't you chop off all flattering tongues that brag so loudly?
translation_verse: AWURADE, bɛ bɔ bɛdɛfɛdɛfɛ ne, kã bɛ noa to nu, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ noa bɛkã anwomasoɛ dwirɛ mbiri ne,

english_verse: They say to themselves, “We are great speakers. No one else has a chance.”
translation_verse: ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛkã kyɛ, “Yɛkɔfa yɛ noa yɛkɔbɔ yɛ nwo waen; yɛ bɔbɔ deinn yeɛ yɛle yɛ noa ɔ, yɛlle meneɛ biala!” ne.

english_verse: But you, Lord, tell them, “I will do something! The poor are mistreated and helpless people moan. I'll rescue all who suffer.”
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ɔnate kyɛ sona bɔ olle bie ne, bɛhyɛ ye, ná bɛma sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ne odi aworabɔlɛ ne ati, ngɔkekã me nwo. Ye nwo waenbɔlɛ bɔ yeɛ ɔpena ne, ngɔfa ngɔma ye.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are true to your promises, and your word is like silver heated seven times in a fiery furnace.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔhyɛ te bɔhyɛ bɔ ye nwo te ɔ, ɔte kyɛ ɛdwetɛ bɔ bapɔ ye nwo wɔ ɛfaa afaa nu ɔ, bɔ bapɔ ye nwo pɛen nzoo ɔ.

english_verse: You will protect us and always keep us safe from those people.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nea yɛ so; bɔ yɛ nwo waen fi sɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ he anu afebɔɔ.

english_verse: But all who are wicked will keep on strutting, while everyone praises their shameless deeds.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ abu so wɔ nekaa biala, na adasa mmaa sosɔ bɔne so.

english_verse: How much longer, Lord, will you forget about me? Will it be forever? How long will you hide?
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, na kyinzu? Aso ɛkɔma wɔ wora kofi me afebɔɔ anaa? Ɛkɔye wɔ nye kɔfea me maa okoodwu kyinzu?

english_verse: How long must I be confused and miserable all day? How long will my enemies keep beating me down?
translation_verse: Me kra oli yealɛ maa oodwu kyinzu? Nni aworabɔlɛ wɔ m’ahone nu daa biala anaa? Me pɔfoɛ koli me so ngonim maa okoodwu kyinzu?

english_verse: Please listen, Lord God, and answer my prayers. Make my eyes sparkle again, or else I will fall into the sleep of death.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, me Nyameɛ, nea ná ma me mmuayɛɛ! Ma me nwo sande me, nna manna ewue nnaa;

english_verse: My enemies will say, “Now we've won!” They will be greatly pleased when I am defeated.
translation_verse: nna me pɔfoɛ wanga kyɛ, “Mali ye so ngonim”, nna mamvi ase amma me pɔfoɛ mɔ banni ahurusi.

english_verse: I trust your love, and I feel like celebrating because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Na me de, mafa me nwo mato wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne aso; na wɔ ngoalelɛ ne, ngoli ahurusi wɔ nu.

english_verse: You have been good to me, Lord, and I will sing about you.
translation_verse: Ngɔto dwein ngɔye AWURADE ayɛ, ofikyɛ walo me paa.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless; they are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Kwaseaa kã ye wɔ ti anu kyɛ, “Nyameɛ biala nne berɛ.” Olle adwene paa, na amumuyɛɛ bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ yeɛ ɔyɔ ɔ, ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ye bra te sannwuu ɔ.

english_verse: From heaven the Lord looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: AWURADE to ye nye fi nyameɛso ɔnea adasa mmaa, kyɛ aso okonwu ebie bɔ ɔse nworɛ, bɔ ɔpena Nyameɛ si atee ɔ.

english_verse: Won't you evil people learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ amukoraa, aso nimdeɛ abɔ bɛ anaa; bɛ yeɛ bedi me mmenia aminɛ kyɛbɔ bedi aleɛ, ná bɛnzɔne AWURADE ɔ?

english_verse: But you will be frightened, because God is on the side of every good person.
translation_verse: Berɛ, ahunundetelɛ kandinga kɔtɔ bɛ so, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ gyi teneneefoɛ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɛ si.

english_verse: You may spoil the plans of the poor, but the Lord protects them.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ne, ɛmɔama ye nzusuleɛ ayɛ basaa, nakoso AWURADE yeɛ ɔte ye afealeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our Lord, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Ao, ahaa né Yisrael ngoalelɛ wafi Sion wawa! Mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE kosa kɔfa ye maen agyapadeɛ kɔma ye ne, Yakob koli ahurusi; Yisrael nye kɔgye.

english_verse: Who may stay in God's temple or live on the holy mountain of the Lord?
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nwa yeɛ okosikye wɔ tena sua ne anu ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔtena wɔ bokaa krongron ne aso ɔ?

english_verse: Only those who obey God and do as they should. They speak the truth
translation_verse: Sana bɔ ye bra te sannwuu, bɔ ɔyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ, bɔ ofi ye ahone nu ɔkã nahorɛ,

english_verse: and don't spread gossip; they treat others fairly and don't say cruel things.
translation_verse: bɔ ɔmva ye noa ngeka mmenia nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ, bɔ ɔnyɔ obiɛngo bɔne, ná ommu obiɛngo animtia ɔ.

english_verse: They hate worthless people, but show respect for all who worship the Lord. And they keep their promises, no matter what the cost.
translation_verse: Sɔ sona ne, amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛla ye nye so mbaen, na ɔfa anidie ma bɛ bɔ besuro AWURADE ɔ. Sɛ ɔta ndaen ma ye nwo kyere ye po a, ommu so;

english_verse: They lend their money without charging interest, and they don't take bribes to hurt the innocent. Those who do these things will always stand firm.
translation_verse: ɔmmɔ bosea mva nzihoɛ nzi ye nwo, yeɛ onne fea-ase-ma mmua bɔ odi be ɔ ndɛengyea. Ebiala bɔ odi sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ aso ne, ye bo ngotutu.

english_verse: Protect me, Lord God! I run to you for safety,
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, bɔ me nwo waen, ofikyɛ wɔ nu yeɛ menwati mebafea ɔ.

english_verse: and I have said, “Only you are my Lord! Every good thing I have is a gift from you.”
translation_verse: Meka mekyire AWURADE kyɛ, “Wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Mene ɔ; nnne nikye paa biala, sana wɔ ngome.”

english_verse: but worshipers of other gods will have much sorrow. I refuse to offer sacrifices of blood to those gods or worship in their name.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛso nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ ne de, bɛtwetwe aworabɔlɛ pee bɛbrɛ bɛ nwo; mengɔbɔ mogya anonneɛ afɔleɛ mengɔma sɔ nyameɛ foforɛ nemɔ, yeɛ mengɔbɔ bɛ dumaa mengɔsɔne bɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are all I want! You are my choice, and you keep me safe.
translation_verse: AWURADE te m’agyapadeɛ bɔ mafa ɔ, ɔne me ngrabea; wɔ sa nu yeɛ me nwo amukoraa wura ɔ.

english_verse: You make my life pleasant, and my future is bright.
translation_verse: Nningyein paa yeɛ afa ama me ɔ; amba, agyapadeɛ paa yeɛ me sa ahã ɔ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for being my guide. Even in the darkest night, your teachings fill my mind.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ otu me foɛ ne, meye ye ayɛ; meda kɔngɔen po a, me tiboa kyire me bɔ nyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I will always look to you, as you stand beside me and protect me from fear.
translation_verse: Metwe m’adwene mesie AWURADE so daa; na ɔnate kyɛ ogyi me sa famaa so ne ati, mengofi ase.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will celebrate, and I can safely rest.
translation_verse: Yiti me nye agye, yeɛ me kra di ahurusi; me nwo atɔ me fɔnwoo.

english_verse: I am your chosen one. You won't leave me in the grave or let my body decay.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛngɔma me kra ngɔha ɛborɔ, yeɛ ɛngɔma w’anwoteeniɛ ne ngɔporɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu.

english_verse: You have shown me the path to life, and you make me glad by being near to me. Sitting at your right side, I will always be joyful.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ ekyire me ngoa atee ɔ. Wɔ nyunu yeɛ nningyein bɔ ɔyɛ ahomeka mu wɔ ɔ, na wɔ sa famaa nu yeɛ anigye wɔ afebɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord! Won't you listen as I pray and beg for help? I am honest! Please hear my prayer.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, tie me dwirɛ bɔ ɔyɛ fɛ, yeɛ tie me sufrɛ; tie me mbaeɛ bɔ ofi noa bɔ nnakannaka ɔnne nu ɔ nu.

english_verse: Only you can say that I am innocent, because only your eyes can see the truth.
translation_verse: Nea ná bua me be, ma wɔ nye nwu edwirɛ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You know my heart, and even during the night you have tested me and found me innocent. I have made up my mind never to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛneanea m’ahone nu, ná ɛpɛnzɛpɛnzɛ me ti anu dwirɛ nu kɔngɔen, ná eso me nea a, engonwu bɔne biala wɔ me nu; mayɛ m’adwene kyɛ mengɔfa me noa mengɔhã edwirɛ bɔ ɔte bɔne ɔ.

english_verse: I don't do like others. I obey your teachings and am not cruel.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɛ yɔleɛ ne, ngyi wɔ noa dwirɛ so mahwe me nwo mafi basabasayɔlɛfoɛ bɛ yɔleɛ nwo.

english_verse: I have followed you, without ever stumbling.
translation_verse: W’atee ne ala yeɛ nnate so ɔ, yeɛ me gya koso ossotili offili so.

english_verse: I pray to you, God, because you will help me. Listen and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Ao, Nyameɛ, mesu mefrɛ wɔ, ofikyɛ ekotie me; yɛ asoɛ tie me, tie me dwirɛ.

english_verse: Protect me as you would your very own eyes; hide me in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Bɔ me nwo waen kyɛ sona nye kyiremvua; fa me fea wɔ ndaa ne abo fɔnwoo ne anu.

english_verse: They refuse to show mercy, and they keep bragging.
translation_verse: Bennwu sona anwumvoin koraa, na bɛfa bɛ noa bɛkekã anwomasoɛ dwirɛ.

english_verse: They have caught up with me! My enemies are everywhere, eagerly hoping to smear me in the dirt.
translation_verse: Bahã me bamia, na bapɛ me nwo bayia; bafa basie bɛ nye so kyɛ bɛkɔhã me bɛkɔto ase.

english_verse: They are like hungry lions hunting for food, or like young lions hiding in ambush.
translation_verse: Bɛte kyɛ gyata bɔ ɔpena kaka bie kye ye ɔ; bɛte kyɛ gyata akrɔngrɔma bɔ wafea ɔtetɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! Attack and defeat them. Take your sword and save me from those evil people.
translation_verse: Ao, AWURADE, dwɔso fa koɛ toa bɛ, ná di bɛ so ngonim! Fa wɔ ngrandɛ ne pepɛ de me ngoa fi bɔnefoɛ sa nu.

english_verse: Use your powerful arm and rescue me from the hands of mere humans whose world won't last. You provide food for those you love. Their children have plenty, and their grandchildren will have more than enough.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, fa wɔ tumi ne pepɛ de me fi adasa mmaa sa nu; adasa mmaa bɔ b’akatuaa wɔ wiase wa ala ne, de me fi bɛ sa nu. Akatuaa bɔ ahyehyɛ ato berɛ ama bɛ ne, fa tua bɛ so kerɛ piri paa; ma bɛ mma mɔ benya akatuaa ne mmorosoɛ, ná bɛ́fa bie bɛ́yakyi bɛ nnomaa mɔ.

english_verse: I am innocent, Lord, and I will see your face! When I awake, all I want is to see you as you are.
translation_verse: Na me de, ɔnate kyɛ metengyɛ ne ati, ngonwu wɔ nyunu; sɛ medafe metingye a, m’ahone kɔtɔ me kunu, kyɛ manwu wɔ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: I love you, Lord God, and you make me strong.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE bɔ ɛte m’anwoserɛ ɔ, mekuro wɔ dwirɛ.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock, my fortress, my protector, the rock where I am safe, my shield, my powerful weapon, and my place of shelter.
translation_verse: AWURADE te me nyɔbotaen, m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne me defoɛ, me Nyameɛ, me nyɔbotaen bɔ mebɔ me nwo waen wɔ wɔ nu ɔ, me buralɛ ataadeɛ ne me ngoalelɛ anwoserɛ ɔne m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! I prayed, and you rescued me from my enemies.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ ɔfata ayɛyelɛ ne, ye yeɛ mesu mefrɛ ye ɔ, na ɔpepɛ de me fi me pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu.

english_verse: Death had wrapped its ropes around me, and I was almost swallowed by its flooding waters.
translation_verse: Ewue nyamaa brabrale me, na ewue bu fale me so kyɛ asue;

english_verse: Ropes from the world of the dead had coiled around me, and death had set a trap in my path.
translation_verse: ɛborɔ dɔ nyamaa mendale me, na ewue ngaen wale me so kyɛ ɔbaahye me.

english_verse: I was in terrible trouble when I called out to you, but from your temple you heard me and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Nzu mvrɛle AWURADE wɔ m’amaneɛ nu, na ndeane nu mvrɛle me Nyameɛ kyɛ ɔboka me. Ɔwɔ ye asɔneyɛɛ sua nu dɔ yeɛ ɔtele me komvi ɔ, na me sufrɛ dwuli ye so anu.
