english_verse: The earth shook and shivered, and the mountains trembled down to their roots. You were angry
translation_verse: Yeɛ aseɛ pusuli, na ɔwosole; mmokaa mɔ nyinasoɛ ye bo kekane, na ɔwosole, ɔnate kyɛ ye ahone huli.

english_verse: and breathed out smoke. Scorching heat and fiery flames spewed from your mouth.
translation_verse: Nwosina fili ye bonyi anu pu wale; see wuronyiwuronyi fili ye noa nu wale, na see bɔ wasɔ gonn fili ye nwo tutu guale.

english_verse: You opened the heavens like curtains, and you came down with storm clouds under your feet.
translation_verse: Ɔmoamoane ewienu, na odwuli ase, na né awosii kabii wɔ ye gya bo.

english_verse: You rode on the backs of flying creatures and swooped down with the wind as wings.
translation_verse: Ɔtenane kɛrubo so tuli, na ɔnate mvrama ye ndaa so wale ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: Darkness was your robe; thunderclouds filled the sky, hiding you from sight.
translation_verse: Ɔfale awosii munduni ye nwo, ɔfale munungum kusuu, bɔ ɔte esue bɔ wamuna ɔ katale ye nwo.

english_verse: Hailstones and fiery coals lit up the sky in front of you.
translation_verse: Kanea hyireinn bɔ oli ye nyunu ne, asukɔtwea kungumaboɔ ne see gonn fili nu bɔ wurale ye munungum ne anu.

english_verse: Lord Most High, your voice thundered from the heavens, as hailstones and fiery coals poured down like rain.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔle nu kurudududu wɔ nyameɛso, na Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne dwudwole nen, asukɔtwea kungumaboɔ ne see gonn tete guale.

english_verse: You roared at the sea, and its deepest channels could be seen. You snorted, and the earth shook to its foundations.
translation_verse: Afei ɛpo ye bo dɔ aseɛ yele ye nwo ali, na aseɛ nyinasoɛ nwo lale berɛ, ofikyɛ, ao AWURADE, ɛhane bɛ nyunu, yeɛ nwomeɛ koso fili wɔ bonyi anu tu wale ne ati ɔ.

english_verse: You reached down from heaven, and you lifted me from deep in the ocean.
translation_verse: Ɔtengyɛle ye sa fili anwuro ɔɔsɔle me nu, na ɔyele me fili buma nu.

english_verse: You rescued me from enemies, who were hateful and too powerful for me.
translation_verse: Olele me fili me pɔfoɛ anwoserɛniɛ sa nu, ɔne bɛ bɔ bekyi me ɔ, bɛ sa nu; ofikyɛ né bɛ nwo yɛ se tra me koraa.

english_verse: On the day disaster struck, they came and attacked, but you defended me.
translation_verse: M’amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu yeɛ bɛwale me so ɔ, nakoso AWURADE gyinane me si.

english_verse: When I was fenced in, you freed and rescued me because you love me.
translation_verse: Ɔyele me fili amaneɛ nu mane me nwo tɔle me, ɔpepɛ lele me, ofikyɛ okuro me dwirɛ.

english_verse: You are good to me, Lord, because I do right, and you reward me because I am innocent.
translation_verse: AWURADE neane kyɛbɔ mesi metengyɛ ɔ so mane me ye nwo akatuaa; ogyinane kyɛbɔ me bra si te sannwuu ɔ so mane me ye nwo akatuaa.

english_verse: I do what you want and never turn to do evil.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mali AWURADE dwirɛ so, na nnyɔle bɔne nngakyili me si mmmane Nyameɛ.

english_verse: I keep your laws in mind and never look away from your teachings.
translation_verse: Mali ye nhyehyɛleɛ amukoraa so, yeɛ ye ahyɛdeɛ koso, nndwene me nwo mmvili ye nwo.

english_verse: I obey you completely and guard against sin.
translation_verse: M’atee tengyɛ wɔ ye nyunu, na mate me nwo mafi bɔne nwo.

english_verse: You have been good to me because I do right; you have rewarded me for being innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, AWURADE agyina me tengyɛlɛ so wama me ye nwo akatuaa; wagyina kyɛbɔ me bra te sannwuu wɔ ye nyunu ɔ so.

english_verse: You are always loyal to your loyal people, and you are faithful to the faithful.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ odi nahorɛ ma wɔ ne, wɔ wora edi nahorɛ ma ye, yeɛ sona bɔ mvomsoɛ nne ye nwo ne, wɔ wora ɛmaa onwu kyɛ mvomsoɛ nne wɔ nwo.

english_verse: With all who are sincere, you are sincere, but you treat the unfaithful as their deeds deserve.
translation_verse: Bɔ ye nwo te ne, wɔ wora ɛmaa onwu kyɛ wɔ nwo te, nakoso sona bɔ ɔte kanda de, ɛmaa onwu kyɛ ɛse nworɛ tra ye.

english_verse: You rescue the humble, but you put down all who are proud.
translation_verse: Ɛpepɛ de anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ, nakoso anwomasoɛfoɛ de, ɛbrɛ bɛ ase.

english_verse: You, the Lord God, keep my lamp burning and turn darkness to light.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ ɛsɔ me kanea ɔ, AWURADE me Nyameɛ ɔta ma m’awosii yɛ hyereinn.

english_verse: Your way is perfect, Lord, and your word is correct. You are a shield for those who run to you for help.
translation_verse: Sɔ Nyameɛ he, ye atee tengyɛ, AWURADE bɔhyɛ te nahorɛ, na ebiala bɔ ɔbɔ ye nwo waen wɔ Nyameɛ nu ne, Nyameɛ te ye buralɛ ataadeɛ.

english_verse: You alone are God! Only you are a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ ɔ? Sana AWURADE angome. Nwa yeɛ ɔte nyɔbotaen ɔ? Sana yɛ Nyameɛ angome.

english_verse: You give me strength and guide me right.
translation_verse: Sɔ Nyameɛ he bɔ ɔma me anwoserɛ ne, ɔma me brabɔlɛ tengyɛ.

english_verse: You make my feet run as fast as those of a deer, and you help me stand on the mountains.
translation_verse: Ɔma me gya boso yɛ nyera kyɛ kɛtɛbɔɔ, na ɔmaa megyina pindinn wɔ mmokaa so.

english_verse: You teach my hands to fight and my arms to use a bow of bronze.
translation_verse: Okyire me koɛhonɛ, amaa ɔnate so mekora mekondo kɔɔbere agyaen nu.

english_verse: You alone are my shield. Your right hand supports me, and by coming to help me, you have made me famous.
translation_verse: Afa wɔ ngoalelɛ akokyɛm ne ama me, na wɔ mmokalɛ amaa mayɛ sona titire.

english_verse: You clear the way for me, and now I won't stumble.
translation_verse: Ɛbɔ atee pralaa maa mefa so bɔ ɔmaa menzoti ɔ.

english_verse: I kept chasing my enemies, until I caught them and destroyed them.
translation_verse: Mvoane me pɔfoɛ mɔ, na ngɔndole bɛ, na manza me si kɔpem kyɛ ngukuni bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I stuck my sword through my enemies, and they were crushed under my feet.
translation_verse: Mmobɔle bɛ nguale berɛ bɔ bangora dwɔso ko ɔ, na bɛtotɔle beguale me gya bo.

english_verse: You helped me win victories, and you forced my attackers to fall victim to me.
translation_verse: Ɛmane me koɛ nu anwoserɛ, na ɛmane me pɔfoɛ mɔ lili ngoguo wɔ me nyunu.

english_verse: You made my enemies run, and I killed them.
translation_verse: Ɛmane me pɔfoɛ mɔ nwati fili me nyunu, bɛ bɔ bekyi me ne, nnuane bɛ boso.

english_verse: They cried out for help, but no one saved them; they called out to you, but there was no answer.
translation_verse: Bɛteateane nu bɛpenane mmokalɛ, nakoso bannya defoɛ biala, besu bɛfrɛle AWURADE, nakoso wandɛ bɛ so.

english_verse: I ground them to dust blown by the wind, and I poured them out like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Ndini bɛ muhumuhu kyɛ mvuture bɔ mvrama hu ye kɔ ɔ, na mvindini bɛ nguale kyɛ dwaaso nnɛterɛ.

english_verse: You rescued me from stubborn people, and you made me the leader of foreign nations, who are now my slaves.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ bɛyɔle me nwo lɔen ne, ɛpepɛ lele me fili bɛ sa nu. Ɛfale me tuale maen maen mɔ noa, na mmenia bɔ né menze bɛ ɔ bɛsole me.

english_verse: They have lost all courage, and from their fortresses, they come trembling.
translation_verse: Ahunundetelɛ tɔle maen maen so ama so, na bɛfale anwopopolɛ befili b’anwoserɛ afealeɛ mɔ nu befite bɛwale.

english_verse: You are the living Lord! I will praise you. You are a mighty rock. I will honor you for keeping me safe.
translation_verse: AWURADE te ase! Me nyɔbotaen, meye wɔ ayɛ! Me ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ, mekamvo wɔ!

english_verse: You took revenge for me, and you put nations in my power.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bɔ ɔtɔ me pɔfoɛ so wereɛ ma me ɔ, ye bɔ ɔbrɛ maen maen mɔ ase wura me bo ɔ,

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and I will honor you among the nations.
translation_verse: Yiti, O AWURADE, ngɔkamvo wɔ wɔ maen maen mɔ so, ná mabɔ wɔ dumaa mato ayɛyelɛ dwein.

english_verse: You give glorious victories to your chosen king. Your faithful love for David and for his descendants will never end.
translation_verse: Odi ngonim piri paa ma ye hene ne, ɔye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ɔ ali kyire sona bɔ wapopa ye ngoo ne, ɔye ye ali kyire Dawide ne ye boso ama afebɔɔ.

english_verse: The heavens keep telling the wonders of God, and the skies declare what he has done.
translation_verse: Nyameɛso ye Nyameɛ animnyam kyire, yeɛ ewienu bɔ ye sa noa adwuma nwo dawure.

english_verse: They don't speak a word, and there is never the sound of a voice.
translation_verse: Bemmukye bɛ noa, bɛnga edwirɛ biala, ebiala nde bɛ komvi;

english_verse: Yet their message reaches all the earth, and it travels around the world. In the heavens a tent is set up for the sun.
translation_verse: nakoso bɛ komvi dwu aseɛ ye aso nekaa biala, na bɛ dwirɛ fi aseɛ ti kɔka ye ti. Wasi ɛtena sua wama eyia wɔ nyameɛso,

english_verse: It rises like a bridegroom and gets ready like a hero eager to run a race.
translation_verse: eyia pukye kyɛ atɔmvorɛ biaa bɔ ofi ye sua nu ofite ɔ, kyɛ bienzua anwoserɛniɛ bɔ ole anigye otu amirika ɔ.

english_verse: It travels all the way across the sky. Nothing hides from its heat.
translation_verse: Eyia pukye fi nyameɛso ye ti dɔ, ɔpɛ ye atee kɔka ye ti dɔ, na hwee ngora mva ye nwo mvea mvi ye hyerɛ ne abo.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is perfect; it gives us new life. His teachings last forever, and they give wisdom to ordinary people.
translation_verse: AWURADE mmeraa ne te pɛpɛɛpɛ, ɔkanyane sona kra; AWURADE dwirɛ te nahorɛ, na ɔma sona tetekwaa onwu nworɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's instruction is right; it makes our hearts glad. His commands shine brightly, and they give us light.
translation_verse: AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ te turoloo, ɔma sona ahone tɔ ye kunu; AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ nwo te, na obukye sona nye.

english_verse: Worshiping the Lord is sacred; he will always be worshiped. All his decisions are correct and fair.
translation_verse: AWURADE surolɛ te krongron, na esurolɛ ne tena berɛ afebɔɔ. AWURADE nhyehyɛleɛ te nahorɛ, na ye mukoraa tengyɛ.

english_verse: They are worth more than the finest gold and are sweeter than honey from a honeycomb.
translation_verse: Nhyehyɛleɛ ne di mu tra esikaa kɔkorɛ, ɔtra esikaa kɔkorɛ paa po. Ɔte menemene tra woɛ, na ɔtra woɛ bɔ ofi nzasameɛ nu ɔpepe ɔ.

english_verse: By your teachings, Lord, I am warned; by obeying them, I am greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Afei koso, ɔnate so yeɛ ɛbɔ wɔ somvoɛ kɔkɔ ɔ; na sona di so a, onya akatuaa piri.

english_verse: None of us know our faults. Forgive me when I sin without knowing it.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ye nye kora ba ye nwo so wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye mvomsoɛ nwo ɔ? Me mvomsoɛ bɔ wafea me ne, fa kyɛ me.

english_verse: Don't let me do wrong on purpose, Lord, or let sin have control over my life. Then I will be innocent, and not guilty of some terrible fault.
translation_verse: Bɔne bɔ bɛboapa bɛyɔ ne, twe w’akoaa fi ye nwo. Sɔ bɔne nemɔ, nnɛmaa bedi me so, amaa ɔnate so mali be wɔ wɔ nyunu, ná manni mmeraatolɛ piri ne anwo fɔ.

english_verse: Let my words and my thoughts be pleasing to you, Lord, because you are my mighty rock and my protector.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, me nyɔbotaen ne me defoɛ, edwirɛ bɔ ngɔte me noa ngɔhã, ɔne bɔ ngosusu ye nwo wɔ me ti anu ne, maa ɔsɔ wɔ nye.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
translation_verse: Mesrɛ kyɛ AWURADE otie wɔ sufrɛ wɔ amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu! Yakob Nyameɛ ne, ye dumaa ɔ́bɔ wɔ nwo waen!

english_verse: May the Lord send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ɔ́soma mmokalɛ ofi ye nekaa krongron berɛ ɔɔboka wɔ, ná ófi Sion bokaa so oogyina wɔ si.

english_verse: May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
translation_verse: AWURADE ɔ́kaye w’afɔleɛ amukoraa, ná ɔ́ma ye nye sɔ wɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ. Sela

english_verse: May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
translation_verse: Ɔ́ma wɔ sa hã bɔ w’ahone nu ɛpena ɔ, ná ɔ́ma wɔ nzusuleɛ amukoraa ɔ́yɛ berɛ.

english_verse: Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord answer all your prayers!
translation_verse: Maa yɛfa ahurusililɛ yɛbɔ wɔ ngoalelɛ nwo ese, ná yɛpagya yɛ frangaa wɔ yɛ Nyameɛ dumaa nu. AWURADE ɔ́yɔ w’abisadeɛ amukoraa ɔ́ma wɔ.

english_verse: I am certain, Lord, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
translation_verse: Afei, manwu kyɛ AWURADE boka ye sona bɔ wapopa ye ngoo ne; otie ye sufrɛ wɔ ye nyameɛso krongron dɔ, na AWURADE ye anwoserɛ asaa famaa ne ɔpepɛ de ye.

english_verse: Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Ebiemɔ fa bɛ wora bewura teaseɛnam mɔ nu, yeɛ ebiemɔ koso bɛfa bɛ deɛ bewura mbɔngɔ nu; nakoso yɛ de, yɛ wora wura AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ dumaa nu.

english_verse: Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
translation_verse: Bɛ de, besoti befifi ase, nakoso yɛ de, yɛdwɔso yɛgyina berɛ kyirebeinn.

english_verse: Give the king victory, Lord, and answer our prayers.
translation_verse: Ao, AWURADE, pepɛ de ɛhene ne, na sɛ yɛsu yɛfrɛ wɔ a, tie yɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, your mighty power makes the king glad, and he celebrates victories that you have given him.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, w’anwoserɛ ne ati ɛhene ne nye gye; na wɔ ngoalelɛ ne ati, nea kyɛbɔ osi di ahurusi paa ɔ!

english_verse: You did what he wanted most and never told him “No.”
translation_verse: Ama ye sa ahã bɔ ye ahone nu ɔpena ɔ, na bɔ wate ye noa wabisa ne, amva ammɔ ye atianuserɛ.

english_verse: You truly blessed the king, and you placed on him a crown of finest gold.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛfa saleɛ kandinga yia ye, na ɛfa esikaa kɔkorɛ paa abotire bɔ ye.

english_verse: He asked to live a long time, and you promised him life that never ends.
translation_verse: Ɔsrɛle wɔ berɛ ngoa, na ɛfa mane ye; ɛmane ye ngoa tendenn afebɔɔ.

english_verse: The king is highly honored. You have let him win victories that have made him famous.
translation_verse: Wɔ ngoalelɛ ti, ye animnyam te piri; na afa anidie ne ahennie alo ye.

english_verse: You have given him blessings that will last forever, and you have made him glad by being so near to him.
translation_verse: Amba, ɛmaa onya saleɛ piri afebɔɔ, na anika bɔ onya ye wɔ wɔ nyunu ne ati, ɛma ye nye gye.

english_verse: Lord Most High, the king trusts you, and your kindness keeps him from defeat.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛhene ne wafa ye nwo wato AWURADE so, na Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ, ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, ongofĩ ase.

english_verse: With your mighty arm, Lord, you will strike down all of your hateful enemies.
translation_verse: Wɔ sa kɔhã wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ amukoraa. Na bɛ bɔ bekyi wɔ ne, wɔ sa famaa kɔhyehye bɛ mukoraa.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by fire once you are here, and because of your anger, flames will swallow them.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛye wɔ nwo ali a, ɛkɔmaa bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ foonoo nu see. AWURADE kohũhũ bɛ wɔ ye yaafɛlɛ ne anu, na see kɔyera bɛ.

english_verse: You will wipe their families from the earth, and they will disappear.
translation_verse: Ekonua bɛ mma boso kofi aseɛ ye aso, ɔne bɛ boso ama kofi adasa mmaa nu.

english_verse: All their plans to harm you will come to nothing.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛbɔ wɔ nwo porɛ, yeɛ sɛ bɛfa wɔ nwo adwene tɛɛ a, ɔngɔyɛ yé.

english_verse: You will make them run away by shooting your arrows at their faces.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛkɔfoa bɛ maa bɛkɔnwati; ɛkɔfa w’agyaen ne kohyire bɛ so.

english_verse: Show your strength, Lord, so that we may sing and praise your power.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, gyina w’anwoserɛ so ma wɔ nwo so! Yɛkɔto dwein yɛkɔye wɔ tumi ne ayɛ.

english_verse: My God, my God, why have you deserted me? Why are you so far away? Won't you listen to my groans and come to my rescue?
translation_verse: Me Nyameɛ, me Nyameɛ, nzu ati yeɛ apo me ye? Nzu ati yeɛ mepene mepena mmokalɛ, nakoso aye wɔ nye afi me so ye?

english_verse: I cry out day and night, but you don't answer, and I can never rest.
translation_verse: Ao me Nyameɛ, alehyeleɛ biala mesu mefrɛ wɔ, nakoso ɛndɛ me so; mesu mefrɛ wɔ kɔngɔen biala, nakoso me nwo ndɔ me.

english_verse: Yet you are the holy God, ruling from your throne and praised by Israel.
translation_verse: Nakoso wɔ yeɛ ɛte krongron ɔ, na Yisrael ayɛyelɛ yeɛ ɔte w’ahennie bia ɔ.

english_verse: When they cried out for help, you saved them, and you did not let them down when they depended on you.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ besu bɛfrɛle wɔ ɔ, na ɛpepɛ lele bɛ; wɔ yeɛ bɛfale bɛ nwo bɛtole wɔ so ɔ, na bɛ nyunu angua ase.

english_verse: But I am merely a worm, far less than human, and I am hated and rejected by people everywhere.
translation_verse: Nakoso me de, nde esuronyi, na nnde sona, mmenia sere me, adasa bu me animtia.

english_verse: Everyone who sees me makes fun and sneers. They shake their heads,
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ onwu me ne, ɔgoro me nwo; besobi bɛ noa begua me so, ná bawoso bɛ ti :

english_verse: and say, “Trust the Lord! If you are his favorite, let him protect you and keep you safe.”
translation_verse: “Ɔfa ye nwo to AWURADE so; maa ɔpepɛ ole ye e; maa ɔpepɛ ole ye, ofikyɛ ɔla ye ahone nwo.”

english_verse: You, Lord, brought me safely through birth, and you protected me when I was a baby at my mother's breast.
translation_verse: Nakoso wɔ yeɛ ɛyele me fili me ni akunu ɔ; ndua me maame nyɔfone noa ne, wɔ yeɛ ɛbɔle me nwo waen ɔ.

english_verse: From the day I was born, I have been in your care, and from the time of my birth, you have been my God.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ belele m’aworɛ bɛtole wɔ gya so ɔ, na ofi me ni akunu, wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Nyameɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't stay far off when I am in trouble with no one to help me.
translation_verse: Nnɛyakyi me nu, ofikyɛ edwirɛ pena to me, na nnne bokafoɛ biala.

english_verse: Enemies are all around like a herd of wild bulls. Powerful bulls from Bashan are everywhere.
translation_verse: Nandwie nyii pee bapɛ me nwo bayia, Basan nandwie nyii anwoserɛ nemɔ, bapɛ me nwo kango;

english_verse: My enemies are like lions roaring and attacking with jaws open wide.
translation_verse: babukye bɛ noa nu hambonnwu bawa me so, kyɛ gyata bɔ ɔteatea nu ɔtete kaka bɔ wahye ye ɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: I have no more strength than a few drops of water. All my bones are out of joint; my heart is like melted wax.
translation_verse: Behwie me begua ase kyɛ nzue, na me mmowue amukoraa bahodwo wɔ m’aporɛ so; m’ahone akakyi kyɛ nguɛ, wahuro wagua me kunu.

english_verse: My strength has dried up like a broken clay pot, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You, God, have left me to die in the dirt.
translation_verse: Me komvi ayɛ wosee kyɛ nyangaa bue, na me temverema amata me nnaalɔ; afa me ato ewue kumaa nu.

english_verse: Brutal enemies attack me like a pack of dogs, tearing at my hands and my feet.
translation_verse: Ngyea apɛ me nwo bayia, nzɛmmɔnefoɛ fekue bapɛ me nwo kango; bafa nikyee basinasina me gya ne me sa.

english_verse: I can count all my bones, and my enemies just stare and sneer at me.
translation_verse: Mekora meka me mmowue amukoraa. Mmenia bɛnea me haa, na bɛkã me anyinga.

english_verse: They took my clothes and gambled for them.
translation_verse: Bɛkyɛ me ndena bɛfa, na begua serewa bɛkyɛ me ndaadeɛ.

english_verse: Don't stay far away, Lord! My strength comes from you, so hurry and help.
translation_verse: Nakoso, ao AWURADE, nnɛtwe wɔ nwo fi me nwo! Ao, wɔ bɔ ɛte m’anwoserɛ ɔ, yɛ ndɛ baaboka me!

english_verse: Rescue me from enemy swords and save me from those dogs.
translation_verse: Pepɛ de me kra fi ngrandɛ noa; pepɛ de me ngoa fi ngyea ye mɔ sa nu!

english_verse: Don't let lions eat me. You rescued me from the horns of wild bulls,
translation_verse: Pepɛ de me fi gyata noa nu! Ofikyɛ apepɛ ale me afi torɔen mmɛen noa.

english_verse: and when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ngɔbɔ wɔ dumaa ngohyire nniɛma mɔ; ngɔye wɔ ayɛ wɔ badwa nu.

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, now praise him! You belong to Jacob's family and to the people of Israel, so fear and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsuro AWURADE ne, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ! Ɛmɔ, Yakob boso ama amukoraa, ɛ́mɔhyɛ ye animnyam; Yisrael boso ama amukoraa, ɛ́mɔsuro AWURADE!

english_verse: The Lord doesn't hate or despise the helpless in all of their troubles. When I cried out, he listened and did not turn away.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ amaneɛnwunɛniɛ ne, ye amaneɛ ne, wammu ye nye wangua so, yeɛ wanye ye nye wamvea ye, na mmom osũ frɛle ye ne, otiele ye sufrɛ.

english_verse: When your people meet, you will fill my heart with your praises, Lord, and everyone will see me keep my promises to you.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ ɛmaa mekora meye wɔ ayɛ wɔ badwa kandinga nu ɔ, na bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ ne, bɛ nyunu yeɛ ngotua m’aboadeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The poor will eat and be full, and all who worship you will be thankful and live in hope.
translation_verse: Anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ bekodidi bɛkɔma bɛ ko koyi; bɛ bɔ bɛpena AWURADE si atee ne, bɛ yeɛ bɛkɔye ye ayɛ ɔ. Nyameɛ ɔ́ma ɛ́mɔnya anika afebɔɔ!

english_verse: Everyone on this earth will remember you, Lord. People all over the world will turn and worship you,
translation_verse: Ofi aseɛ ti kɔka ye ti, bɛkɔkaye, ná basa bawa AWURADE berɛ; na maen maen mɔ so mmusua amukoraa, bɛkɔkoto wɔ ye nyunu.

english_verse: because you are in control, the ruler of all nations.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ahennie te AWURADE deɛ, na odi maen maen mɔ so hene.

english_verse: All who are rich and have more than enough will bow down to you, Lord. Even those who are dying and almost in the grave will come and bow down.
translation_verse: Amba, ye yeɛ aseɛ ye aso anwomasoɛfoɛ amukoraa bɛkɔkoto ye ɔ; adasa mukoraa, bɛ bɔ bɛngora bɛmma bɛ nwo ngoa ɔ, ye yeɛ bɛkɔkoto ye ɔ.

english_verse: In the future, everyone will worship and learn about you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ kɔso ye, bɛkɔhã AWURADE nwo dwirɛ bekohyire kyẽa bie ama.

english_verse: People not yet born will be told, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Bɛkɔhã ye ngoalelɛ nwo dwirɛ bekohyire bɛ bɔ bennya bɛwwole bɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “AWURADE yeɛ wayɔ sɔ nikyee ye ɔ.”

english_verse: You, Lord, are my shepherd. I will never be in need.
translation_verse: AWURADE yeɛ ɔte me neafoɛ ɔ, yiti hwee ngohia me.

english_verse: You let me rest in fields of green grass. You lead me to streams of peaceful water,
translation_verse: Ɔmaa meda nekaa bɔ menya nyaa monɛ medi ɔ. Odi me nyunu fa me kɔ nzue bɔ ɔla berɛ dinn ɔ nwo,

english_verse: and you refresh my life. You are true to your name, and you lead me along the right paths.
translation_verse: ɔma me kra nwo sande ye. Odi me nyunu fa me fa tenenee atee so, ye dumaa ne ati.

english_verse: I may walk through valleys as dark as death, but I won't be afraid. You are with me, and your shepherd's rod makes me feel safe.
translation_verse: Sɛ nnate ewue bɔnza awosii kabii nu po a, menzuro musue biala, ofikyɛ ɛne me yeɛ yɛnate ɔ; wɔ bakaa ne wɔ pɔmaa yeɛ bɛkyekye me wora ɔ.

english_verse: You treat me to a feast, while my enemies watch. You honor me as your guest, and you fill my cup until it overflows.
translation_verse: Ɛto me poen wɔ me pɔfoɛ mɔ nyunu; ɛfa ngoo popa me ti so; me kulie yi bu fa so.

english_verse: Your kindness and love will always be with me each day of my life, and I will live forever in your house, Lord.
translation_verse: Amba, saleɛ ne anwumvoinnwunɛ bekoli me si wɔ mmerɛ bɔ nde ngoa nu amukoraa, na ngɔtena AWURADE awuro afebɔɔ.

english_verse: The earth and everything on it, including its people, belong to the Lord. The world and its people belong to him.
translation_verse: Aseɛ ye, ɔne so nningyein amukoraa bɛte AWURADE deɛ; ewiase ne bɔ ɔwɔ nu amukoraa bɛte ye deɛ,

english_verse: The Lord placed it all on the oceans and rivers.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ye yeɛ wagyina ye wɔ ɛpo so, ná wafa ye watimu asue mɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: Who may climb the Lord's hill or stand in his holy temple?
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔfo AWURADE bokaa ne ɔ? Nwa yeɛ okogyina ye nekaa krongron berɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Only those who do right for the right reasons, and don't worship idols or tell lies under oath.
translation_verse: Sana sona bɔ ye bra te sannwuu, ná ye ahone nu koso te, bɔ ye kra nye ngye ngondombo nwo, ná ɔnda ngondombo ndaen ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God, who saves them, will bless and reward them,
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ okonya AWURADE sa nu saleɛ ɔ, na Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte ye ngoadefoɛ ne, okobua ye be.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Ao pambim mɔ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nwo so! Ɛmɔ, tete anoa mɔ, ɛ́mɔpagya ɛmɔ nwo, ná animnyam Hene ne oowura nu.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, a strong and mighty warrior.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔte animnyam Hene ne ɔ? AWURADE ɔ, anwoserɛniɛ ne tuminiɛ ne, AWURADE bɔ ɔte koɛ nu katakyie ne.

english_verse: Open the ancient gates, so that the glorious king may come in.
translation_verse: Ao pambim mɔ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nwo so! Ɛmɔ, tete anoa mɔ, ɛ́mɔpagya ɛmɔ nwo, ná animnyam Hene ne oowura nu.

english_verse: Who is this glorious king? He is our Lord, the All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔte sɔ animnyam Hene ne ɔ? Asafo AWURADE ɔ, ye yeɛ ɔte animnyam Hene ne ɔ. Sela

english_verse: I offer you my heart, Lord God,
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ mefa me kra mewura wɔ sa nu ɔ.

english_verse: and I trust you. Don't make me ashamed or let enemies defeat me.
translation_verse: Ao me Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ me wora wura wɔ nu ɔ; nnɛma me nyunu gua ase; nnɛma me pɔfoɛ mɔ bedi m’asefinɛ nwo ahurusi.

english_verse: Show me your paths and teach me to follow;
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, maa nwu w’atee ne; fa me fa wɔ saa bɔ apɛ ato berɛ ne aso.

english_verse: guide me by your truth and instruct me. You keep me safe, and I always trust you.
translation_verse: Di me nyunu maa nnate wɔ nahorɛ ne anu, ná kyirekyire me, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte me ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ ɔ; wɔ yeɛ me nye la wɔ so daa biala ɔ.

english_verse: Please, Lord, remember, you have always been patient and kind.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, kaye w’anwumvoinnwunɛ ɔne wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ofikyɛ bɛwɔ berɛ fi tete.

english_verse: Forget each wrong I did when I was young. Show how truly kind you are and remember me.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ɔnate wɔ paayɛlɛ ne ati, nnɛkaye me ngwadaa nu bɔne, ɔne me mmeraatolɛ; gyina wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne aso ná kaye me!

english_verse: You are honest and merciful, and you teach sinners how to follow your path.
translation_verse: AWURADE te paa, na ɔtengyɛ; yiti okyire bɔnefoɛ atee maa bɛfa so.

english_verse: You lead humble people to do what is right and to stay on your path.
translation_verse: Odi anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ nyunu maa bɛfa tenenee nu, na okyirekyire anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ maa bɛfa ye atee so.

english_verse: In everything you do, you are kind and faithful to everyone who keeps our agreement with you.
translation_verse: AWURADE atee amukoraa te ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne nahorɛ ma bɛ bɔ bedi ye apam ne ye dwirɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, by forgiving each one of my terrible sins.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ dumaa ti, fa me bɔne kyɛ me, ofikyɛ ɔte piri.

english_verse: You will show the right path to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔte sona bɔ osuro AWURADE ɔ? Ye yeɛ AWURADE kohyire ye atee bɔ odi kyɛ ɔfa so ɔ.

english_verse: Then they will have plenty, and their children will receive the land.
translation_verse: Ye kra kɔtena asomdwee nu, na ye boso ama konya aseɛ ne maa ɔkɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the friend of your worshipers, and you make an agreement with all of us.
translation_verse: AWURADE ne bɛ bɔ besuro ye ne yeɛ betu asure ɔ, na ɔye ye apam ne ali kyire bɛ.

english_verse: I always look to you, because you rescue me from every trap.
translation_verse: Me nye la AWURADE so afebɔɔ, ofikyɛ ɔkɔye me gya kofi ngaen nu.

english_verse: I am lonely and troubled. Show that you care and have pity on me.
translation_verse: Pɛne wɔ nye baanea me, ná nwu me anwumvoin, ofikyɛ waha me ngome, na menwu amaneɛ.

english_verse: My awful worries keep growing. Rescue me from sadness.
translation_verse: Adwenedwene bɔ ɔla me so ne te piri, ao, ye me fi m’amaneɛnwunɛ nu.

english_verse: See my troubles and misery and forgive my sins.
translation_verse: Nea yealɛ ne amaneɛ bɔ menwu ye ɔ, ná fa me bɔne amukoraa kyɛ me.

english_verse: Look at all my enemies! See how much they hate me.
translation_verse: Nea me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ somaa, ná nea ɛpɔen kandinga bɔ bɛpɔ me ɔ.

english_verse: I come to you for shelter. Protect me, keep me safe, and don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Ao, bɔ me kra nwo waen ná pepɛ de me; nnɛma me nyunu gua ase, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ menwati mebafea wɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: I obey you with all my heart, and I trust you, knowing that you will save me.
translation_verse: Ma pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ne nahorɛlilɛ ɔnea me so, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ mafa me nwo mato wɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: Our God, please save Israel from all its troubles.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, pepɛ de Yisrael fi ye amaneɛ amukoraati nu.

english_verse: Show that I am right, Lord! I stay true to myself, and I have trusted you without doubting.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, bua me be, ofikyɛ mafa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ manate; na mafa me nwo mato AWURADE so bɔ mengɔnwɔngye mengɔtɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Test my thoughts and find out what I am like.
translation_verse: Neanea me nu ná so me nea, pɛnzɛpɛnzɛ m’ahone nu ne me ti anu.

english_verse: I never forget your kindness, and I am always faithful to you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ daa biala mekaye wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, na wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne anu yeɛ menate ɔ.

english_verse: I don't spend my time with worthless liars
translation_verse: Me ne asanzafoɛ yɛndu nu, yeɛ me ne nyaatwomfoɛ yɛmva abiɛngoɛ.

english_verse: I wash my hands, Lord, to show my innocence, and I worship at your altar,
translation_verse: Menwunzi me sa mefa mekyire kyɛ menni fɔ, na mepɛ w’afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo mebra meyia, ao AWURADE;

english_verse: while gratefully singing about your wonders.
translation_verse: metea nu meto asennaa dwein, na mebɔ w’anwanwadeɛ amukoraa nwo dawure.

english_verse: I love the temple where you live, and where your glory shines.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, awuro bɔ ɛte nu ne, ɔla m’ahone nwo, nekaa bɔ w’animnyam te ne.

english_verse: Don't sweep me away, as you do sinners. Don't punish me with death as you do those people who are brutal
translation_verse: Nnɛpra me kra boka bɔnefoɛ so, yeɛ nnɛpra me ngoa fra kodiawufoɛ so,

english_verse: I stay true to myself. Be kind and rescue me.
translation_verse: Nakoso me de, nahorɛlilɛ yeɛ mefa menate ɔ; pepɛ de me, ná nwu me anwumvoin.

english_verse: Now I stand on solid ground! And when your people meet, I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Me gya gyi berɛ pindinn wɔ aseɛ frɛtɛɛ so, na badwa kandinga nu yeɛ ngɔye AWURADE ayɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the light that keeps me safe. I am not afraid of anyone. You protect me, and I have no fears.
translation_verse: AWURADE te me kanea ne me ngoalelɛ, nwa yeɛ mesuro ye ɔ? AWURADE te me ngoa ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ, nwa nwo suronyi yeɛ ɔkɔtɔ me so ɔ?

english_verse: Brutal people may attack and try to kill me, but they will stumble. Fierce enemies may attack, but they will fall.
translation_verse: Sɛ nzɛmmɔnefoɛ ba me so kyɛ bɛbaatete me nu pasapasa a, sɛ me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛba me so a, bekosoti bekofifi ase.

english_verse: Armies may surround me, but I won't be afraid; war may break out, but I will trust you.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛlɔen kyekye asikyeleɛ kyɛ bɛbaafa koɛ bɛtoa me po a, me kunu ngɔtete me; sɛ bɛfa koɛ bɛbateta me po a, ngogyina pindinn.

english_verse: I ask only one thing, Lord: Let me live in your house every day of my life to see how wonderful you are and to pray in your temple.
translation_verse: Nikyee komapɛ yeɛ masrɛ AWURADE ɔ, sɔ nikyee ne yeɛ mepena ye si atee ɔ: ye ole kyɛ ngɔtena AWURADE awuro mmerɛ bɔ nde ase amukoraa, ná manea AWURADE animnyam, ɔne kyɛ me ne ye yɛkoli ngitahoɛ wɔ ye asɔneyɛɛ sua nu ɔ.

english_verse: In times of trouble, Lord, you will protect me. You will hide me in your tent and keep me safe on top of a mighty rock.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔfa me sie ye afealeɛ ne anu wɔ amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu; ɔfa me fea ye tena sua afealeɛ ne anu, na ɔfa me gyina nyɔbotaen so.

english_verse: You will let me defeat all my enemies. Then I will celebrate, as I enter your tent with animal sacrifices and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Afei ɔmaa medi ngonim wɔ me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ bapɛ me nwo bayia ɔ so, ná ngɔfa esebɔlɛ ngɔbɔ afɔleɛ wɔ ye tena sua ne anu. Ngɔto anigye dwein ngɔye AWURADE ayɛ.

english_verse: Please listen when I pray! Have pity. Answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, sɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ a, tie me, nwu me anwumvoin, ná tie me sufrɛ!

english_verse: My heart tells me to pray. I am eager to see your face,
translation_verse: Ahã ahyire me kyɛ, “Pena me si atee!” Na mmuale kyɛ, “AWURADE, wɔ si atee yeɛ mepena ɔ.”

english_verse: so don't hide from me. I am your servant, Lord, and you have helped me. Don't turn from me in anger. You alone keep me safe. Don't reject or desert me.
translation_verse: Nnɛye wɔ nye fea me, nnɛfɛ yaa foa w’akoaa, na wɔ yeɛ ɛte me bokafoɛ ɔ. Nnɛpo me, yeɛ nnɛyakyi me nu, ao Nyameɛ, me ngoadefoɛ!

english_verse: Even if my father and mother should desert me, you will take care of me.
translation_verse: Sɛ me baba ne me maame bɛpo me po a, AWURADE de, okole me.

english_verse: Teach me to follow, Lord, and lead me on the right path because of my enemies.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, kyire me w’atee ne, ná fa me fa atimbire frɛtɛɛ so, ɔnate me pɔfoɛ mɔ ati.

english_verse: Don't let them do to me what they want. People tell lies about me and make violent threats,
translation_verse: Nnɛmaa mekɔtɔ me pɔfoɛ mɔ ngaen nu, ofikyɛ adanzefoɛ ngondombofoɛ badwɔso batia me, na bɛpepɛ edwirɛ mbiri mbiri begua me so.

english_verse: but I know I will live to see how kind you are.
translation_verse: Mede medi kyɛ ngonwu AWURADE paayɛlɛ ne wɔ ateasefoɛ aseɛ ye aso.

english_verse: Trust the Lord! Be brave and strong and trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Ma wɔ nye ɔla AWURADE so, gyina pindinn ná ma wɔ hue yɛ se; nahorɛ nu, ma wɔ nye ɔla AWURADE so!

english_verse: Only you, Lord, are a mighty rock! Don't refuse to help me when I pray. If you don't answer me, I will soon be dead.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ ɔ, me nyɔbotaen, nnɛtuatua wɔ so bɔ ɛngɔtɛ me so ɔ, ofikyɛ sɛ andɛ me so a, ngɔyɛ kyɛ bɛ bɔ bawu bahɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu ne.

english_verse: Please listen to my prayer and my cry for help, as I lift my hands toward your holy temple.
translation_verse: Tie me sufrɛ wɔ aberɛ bɔ mesu mefrɛ wɔ mepena mmokalɛ ye, wɔ aberɛ bɔ mema me sa so mekɔ anwuro mefa mekyire wɔ nekaa krongron paa berɛ ne.

english_verse: Don't drag me away, Lord, with those cruel people, who speak kind words, while planning trouble.
translation_verse: Nnɛfa me fra bɔnefoɛ ne nzɛmmɔnefoɛ ɛtwe me so. Bɛ yeɛ bɛkã asomdwee nwo dwirɛ bekyire bɛ mmango, nakoso bɔne yeɛ ɔwɔ bɛ ti anu ɔ.

english_verse: They don't pay any attention to your wonderful deeds. Now you will destroy them and leave them in ruin.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ bemmu nningyein bɔ AWURADE wayɔ, anaa ye sa noa adwuma nikyee titire biala ne ati, ɔkɔhwe bɛ so bɔ ɔngɔma bɛ so ko ɔ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord, for answering my prayers.
translation_verse: Animnyam hã AWURADE, ofikyɛ watie me sufrɛ.

english_verse: You are my strong shield, and I trust you completely. You have helped me, and I will celebrate and thank you in song.
translation_verse: AWURADE te m’anwoserɛ ne m’akokyɛm, ye yeɛ me nye la ye so ɔ; yiti ɔboka me, na me nye gye. Ngɔfa me dweintolɛ ngɔla ye ase.

english_verse: You give strength to your people, Lord, and you save and protect your chosen ones.
translation_verse: AWURADE yeɛ ɔte ye mmenia b’anwoserɛ ɔ, na ɔte ngoalelɛ afealeɛ ma bɔ wapopa ye ngoo ne.

english_verse: Come save us and bless us. Be our shepherd and always carry us in your arms.
translation_verse: Ao, pepɛ de wɔ maen, ná yira w’agyapadeɛ; yɛ bɛ so neafoɛ, na nea bɛ so afebɔɔ.

english_verse: All you angels in heaven, honor the glory and power of the Lord!
translation_verse: Ao nyameɛso ama, ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ, ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ kyɛ ye yeɛ animnyam ne tumi te ye deɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Honor the wonderful name of the Lord, and worship the Lord most holy and glorious.
translation_verse: Animnyam bɔ ɔfata AWURADE dumaa ne, ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́ma ye; ɛ́mɔsɔne AWURADE wɔ animnyam krongron nu.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord echoes over the oceans. The glorious Lord God thunders above the roar of the raging sea,
translation_verse: Yɛte AWURADE komvi wɔ asue nemɔ aso, animnyam Nyameɛ ɔbobɔ nu kurudududu, AWURADE bobɔ nu wɔ asue mbiri mbiri nemɔ aso.

english_verse: and his voice is mighty and marvelous.
translation_verse: AWURADE komvi ne, tumi wɔ nu; AWURADE komvi ne, nu animnyam te totohyia.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord destroys the cedar trees; the Lord shatters cedars on Mount Lebanon.
translation_verse: AWURADE komvi bubu sida mmakaa; AWURADE bubu Lebanon sida mmakaa.

english_verse: God makes Mount Lebanon skip like a calf and Mount Hermon jump like a wild ox.
translation_verse: Ɔma Lebanon huru pepe kyɛ nandwie ba, yeɛ ɔma Sirion huru pepe kyɛ torɔen akrɔngrɔma.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes lightning flash
translation_verse: AWURADE komvi tete see yerɛmyerɛm.

english_verse: and the desert tremble. And because of the Lord, the desert near Kadesh shivers and shakes.
translation_verse: AWURADE komvi ma ɛserɛ so woso, AWURADE ma Kadese ɛserɛ so woso.

english_verse: The voice of the Lord makes deer give birth before their time. Forests are stripped of leaves, and the temple is filled with shouts of praise.
translation_verse: AWURADE komvi ma dabɔɔ mɔ bɛwo, ɔma ɛhɔayeɛ mɔ nu da berɛ pralaa, na ye asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, ebiala tea nu kyɛ, “Animnyam hã Nyameɛ!”

english_verse: Pray that our Lord will make us strong and give us peace.
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔma ye maen anwoserɛ! AWURADE kɔfa asomdwee koyira ye maen!

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord! You saved me from the grave and kept my enemies from celebrating my death.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ngɔkamvo wɔ, ofikyɛ apepɛ ale me, na amma me pɔfoɛ mɔ banni me nwo ahurusi.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord God, and you healed me,
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, me Nyameɛ, nzu mvrɛle wɔ kyɛ ɛboka me, na asa me anwonyerɛ.

english_verse: Your faithful people, Lord, will praise you with songs and honor your holy name.
translation_verse: Ao ɛmɔ, AWURADE anwoteefoɛ, ɛ́mɔto dwein bɛye ye ayɛ, ná ɛmɔla ye dumaa krongron ne ase.

english_verse: Your anger lasts a little while, but your kindness lasts for a lifetime. At night we may cry, but when morning comes we will celebrate.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ye ɛyaafɛlɛ ndena berɛ ngyɛ, na ye anwumvoinnwunɛ wɔ berɛ ma sona mmerɛ bɔ sona ne te ase amukoraa. Sona poro moen kɔngɔen amukoraa, nakoso aleɛ kye a, onya anika.

english_verse: I felt secure and thought, “I'll never be shaken!”
translation_verse: Me de, mmerɛ bɔ me so anu tɔle me ne, ngane kyɛ, “Edwirɛ tɛɛ biala ngɔto me le.”

english_verse: You, Lord, were my friend, and you made me strong as a mighty mountain. But when you hid your face, I was crushed.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ɔnate kyɛ ɛlole me ne ati, ɛmane me bo timuni serɛserɛ kyɛ bokaa; nakoso ɛyele wɔ nye feale me ne, me kunu tetele me.

english_verse: I prayed to you, Lord, and in my prayer I said,
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nzu mvrɛle wɔ, na AWURADE, ngoto nzrɛle wɔ kyɛ,

english_verse: “What good will it do you if I am in the grave? Once I have turned to dust, how can I praise you or tell how loyal you are?
translation_verse: “Sɛ mewu a, anaa sɛ mekɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu a, nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ so ɔ? Aso mvuture kɔye wɔ ayɛ anaa? Aso ɔkɔbɔ wɔ nahorɛlilɛ nwo dawure anaa?

english_verse: You have turned my sorrow into joyful dancing. No longer am I sad and wearing sackcloth.
translation_verse: Ama m’aworabɔlɛlilɛ wakakyi ahurusililɛ; aye me nwo ɛsɛen tena ne agua berɛ, na afa anigye ahera me,

english_verse: I thank you from my heart, and I will never stop singing your praises, my Lord and my God.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so me kra wanga ye noa wandu nu, na mmom waye wɔ ayɛ. Ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ, ngɔla wɔ ase afebɔɔ.

english_verse: I come to you, Lord, for protection. Don't let me be ashamed. Do as you have promised and rescue me.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ nu yeɛ menwati mebafea ɔ, nnɛma me nyunu gua ase le; wɔ tenenee ti, pepɛ de me.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hurry to save me. Be my mighty rock and the fortress where I am safe.
translation_verse: Yɛ asoɛ tie me, pepɛ de me ndɛndɛ. Mepena kyɛ ɛyɛ me nyɔbotaen bɔ menwati mebafea nu ɔ, anwoserɛ afealeɛ bɔ ɔpepɛ de me ɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my mighty rock and my fortress. Lead me and guide me, so that your name will be honored.
translation_verse: Amba, wɔ yeɛ ɛte me nyɔbotaen ne m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ɔ; wɔ dumaa ti, di me nyunu ná kyire me atee ne.

english_verse: Protect me from hidden traps and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ye me fi ngaen bɔ basua bafea me ne anu, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’anwoserɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You are faithful, and I trust you because you rescued me.
translation_verse: Wɔ sa nu yeɛ mefa me sunzum mewura ɔ; ao AWURADE, nahorɛniɛ Nyameɛ, apepɛ ale me.

english_verse: I hate the worshipers of worthless idols, but I trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Mekyi bɛ bɔ bɛso mmosoen bɔ bɛ nwo olle mvasoɛ biala ɔ, nakoso me de, me wora wura AWURADE nu.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because you are kind. You saw all my suffering, and you cared for me.
translation_verse: Me nye kɔgye ná mali ahurusi, ɔnate wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, ofikyɛ anwu m’amaneɛnwunɛ ne, na wɔ nye tua aworabɔlɛ bɔ me kra odi ɔ.

english_verse: You kept me from the hands of my enemies, and you set me free.
translation_verse: Amva me anwura pɔfoɛ ne sa; afa me agyina nekaa bɔ berɛ baye ɔ.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! I am hurting and almost blind. My whole body aches.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nwu me anwumvoin, ofikyɛ edwirɛ ato me; Aworabɔlɛ ama me nye ayɛ wusiwusi, na aworabɔlɛ amaa me kra ne me nipadua baboto.

english_verse: I have known only sorrow all my life long, and I suffer year after year. I am weak from sin, and my bones are limp.
translation_verse: Aworabɔlɛ piapia me kɔ ewue nu, na m’afoɛ amukoraa wayɛ ɛpenenɛ ngome. M’amumuyɛɛ ama m’anwoserɛ so ate, na m’aporɛ nu ayɛ me hodwoo.

english_verse: My enemies insult me. Neighbors are even worse, and I disgust my friends. People meet me on the street, and they turn and run.
translation_verse: Mayɛ sona bɔ me pɔfoɛ mɔ amukoraa bɛgoro me nwo ɔ, na mayɛ nikyee suronyisuronyi wɔ me mmango mɔ nu. Me manifoɛ mɔ besuro me; mmenia nwu me wɔ dwaaso a né bɛnwati.

english_verse: I am completely forgotten like someone dead. I am merely a broken dish.
translation_verse: Mmenia wora afi me kyɛ sona bɔ wawu ɔ; mayɛ kyɛ nyangaa bue.

english_verse: I hear the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid!” They are plotting and scheming to murder me.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mate nwuhunwuhu bɔ mmenia bɛyɔ ne, anwunanwuna apɛ me nwo wayia: bɔ bɛbɔ me ti so porɛ, ná bɛpena me beku me ɔ.

english_verse: But I trust you, Lord, and I claim you as my God.
translation_verse: Nakoso ao AWURADE, mafa me wora mawura wɔ nu, menwa, “Me Nyameɛ ole wɔ.”

english_verse: My life is in your hands. Save me from enemies who hunt me down.
translation_verse: Wɔ sa nu yeɛ me hyɛberɛ wura ɔ; me pɔfoɛ mɔ ne bɛ bɔ bɛtane me nye ne, pepɛ de me fi bɛ sa nu.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant. Have pity and rescue me.
translation_verse: Ma wɔ nyunu ɔta hyireinn ma wɔ somvoɛ! Gyina wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne aso pepɛ de me.

english_verse: I pray only to you. Don't disappoint me. Disappoint my cruel enemies until they lie silent in their graves.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nnɛma me nyunu gua ase, ofikyɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ. Ma amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛ nyunu ogua ase, ma bɛ noa omua maa bɛfa bɛhɔ ɛborɔ.

english_verse: Silence those proud liars! Make them stop bragging and insulting your people.
translation_verse: Ma ngondombofoɛ bɛtɔ mumu, bɛ bɔ bɛfa anwomasoɛ ne dwɛɛ bɛkekã edwirɛ tɛɛ betia teneneefoɛ ne.

english_verse: You are wonderful, and while everyone watches, you store up blessings for all who honor and trust you.
translation_verse: Ao, wɔ lolɛ bɔ ahyehyɛ ato berɛ ama bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ ne, ɔyɛ nwanwa soma! Bɛ bɔ bɛnwati bɛbafea wɔ nu ne, ye yeɛ ɛfa bɔ bɛ nwo waen bɔ adasa bɛ nye tua ɔ!

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for showing great kindness when I was like a city under attack.
translation_verse: Animnyam hã AWURADE, ofikyɛ waye ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ali wahyire me, mmerɛ bɔ me nwo hyerele me kyɛ kuro bɔ batua ye ɔ ne.

english_verse: I was terrified and thought, “They've chased me far away from you!” But you answered my prayer when I shouted for help.
translation_verse: Me kunu tele me ne, ngane kyɛ, “Afoa me afi wɔ nyunu ahɔ dedeede.” Nakoso nzu mvrɛle wɔ ne, etiele me sufrɛ.

english_verse: All who belong to the Lord, show how you love him. The Lord protects the faithful, but he severely punishes everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, anwoteefoɛ amukoraa, ɛmɔhuro AWURADE dwirɛ. AWURADE bɔ anwoteefoɛ nwo waen, nakoso ebiala bɔ ɔma ye nwo so ne, otua ye so kerɛ piri paa.

english_verse: All who trust the Lord, be cheerful and strong.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔgyina pindinn, ná ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ hue yɛ se, ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔ nye la AWURADE so ɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone whose sins you forgive and wipe away.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ Nyameɛ afa ye mmeraatolɛ wahyɛ ye, ná wakyikyi ye bɔne ne, onya saleɛ.

english_verse: You bless them by saying, “You told me your sins, without trying to hide them, and now I forgive you.”
translation_verse: Sona bɔ AWURADE mva ye amumuyɛɛ mmɔ ye kwaadu, bɔ nnakannaka suban biala nne ye nu ne, onya saleɛ.

english_verse: Before I confessed my sins, my bones felt limp, and I groaned all day long.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ ngane me noa ndole nu ne, m’aporɛ so yɛle me hodwoo, ɔnate ɛpenenɛ bɔ né mepene daa biala ne ati.

english_verse: Night and day your hand weighed heavily on me, and my strength was gone as in the summer heat.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ sa gyi me nwo eyia ne kɔngɔen; m’anwoserɛ amukoraa yiele kyɛbɔ asue wewe wɔ wawa mmerɛ ɔ. Sela

english_verse: So I confessed my sins and told them all to you. I said, “I'll tell the Lord each one of my sins.” Then you forgave me and took away my guilt.
translation_verse: Afei ngane me bɔne ngyirele wɔ, na mangata m’amumuyɛɛ so. Ngane kyɛ, “Ngɔhã me mmeraatolɛ ngohyire AWURADE,” na ɛfale me bɔne nwo foɛlilɛ hyɛle me. Sela

english_verse: We worship you, Lord, and we should always pray whenever we find out that we have sinned. Then we won't be swept away by a raging flood.
translation_verse: Yiti ebiala bɔ ɔtengyɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔbɔ mbaeɛ okyire wɔ. Amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu, sɛ amaneɛnwunɛ ba ye so kyɛ asue bɔ wayi bɔ ɔse wuruwuru a, ye de ɔngoto ye.

english_verse: You are my hiding place! You protect me from trouble, and you put songs in my heart because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’afealeɛ ɔ, wɔ yeɛ ɛbɔ me nwo waen fi amaneɛ nu ɔ; ɛfa wɔ ngoalelɛ dwein ɛpɛ me nwo yia. Sela

english_verse: You said to me, “I will point out the road that you should follow. I will be your teacher and watch over you.
translation_verse: : Ngohyirehyire wɔ ná mahyire wɔ atee bɔ ɛfa so ɔ; me nye wɔ wɔ so, na ngotu wɔ foɛ.

english_verse: Don't be stupid like horses and mules that must be led with ropes to make them obey.”
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ kyɛ pɔngɔ anaa afunum bɔ olle nimdeɛ, bɔ odi kyɛ ɛfa nyamaa ne buralɛ ewura ye noa nu koraka né watena wɔ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: All kinds of troubles will strike the wicked, but your kindness shields those who trust you, Lord.
translation_verse: Amaneɛ pee yeɛ ɔtoto bɔnefoɛ ɔ, nakoso sona bɔ ɔfa ye nwo to AWURADE so ne de, AWURADE ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔpɛ ye nwo bra yia.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people. Obey him and celebrate! He deserves your praise.
translation_verse: Ao ɛmɔ, teneneefoɛ, ɛmɔli ahurusi wɔ AWURADE nu. Ɔfata teneneefoɛ kyɛ bɛye AWURADE ayɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Praise the Lord with harps! Use harps with ten strings to make music for him.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa sangoo bɛye AWURADE ayɛ; ɛ́mɔfa sangoo bɔ ye nyamaa buru ne bɛto ye nwo anigye dwein.

english_verse: Sing a new song. Shout! Play beautiful music.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔto ye nwo edwein foforɛ; ɛ́mɔbɔ sangoo ne yé, ná ɛ́mɔtea nu bɛ́to dwein.

english_verse: The Lord is truthful; he can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE dwirɛ ne ɔtengyɛ, na odi nahorɛ wɔ bɔ ɔyɔ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: He loves justice and fairness, and he is kind to everyone everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: AWURADE nye gye teneneeyɛlɛ ne ndɛenbualɛ turoloo nwo; na AWURADE ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne wayi aseɛ ye aso tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: The Lord made the heavens and everything in them by his word.
translation_verse: AWURADE noa dwirɛ yeɛ ɔfa bɔle ewienu ɔ, na ye noa nu nwomeɛ yeɛ ɔfa bɔle nu nningyein ɔ.

english_verse: He scooped up the ocean and stored the water.
translation_verse: Ɔboaboa ɛpo nu nzue noa kyɛ esire, na ɔboa buma mɔ noa gua sua nu.

english_verse: Everyone in this world should worship and honor the Lord!
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ aseɛ ye aso ama amukoraa besuro AWURADE, ná mmenia bɔ bɛwɔ wiase amukoraa bɛ́fa ebuo bɛ́ma ye.

english_verse: As soon as he spoke the world was created; at his command, the earth was formed.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ odwudwole, na ɔyɛle berɛ; ɔhyɛle, na ogyinane berɛ pindinn.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the plans and spoils the schemes of the nations.
translation_verse: AWURADE ma maen maen mɔ b’agyinatulɛ ɔyɛ mbaen, na maen maen mɔ bɛ nhyehyɛleɛ yɛ basaa.

english_verse: But what the Lord has planned will stand forever. His thoughts never change.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE agyinatulɛ de, ogyi berɛ afebɔɔ, na ye ti anu nzusuleɛ wɔ berɛ ma aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: The Lord blesses each nation that worships only him. He blesses his chosen ones.
translation_verse: Maen bɔ AWURADE te ye Nyameɛ ne, wanya saleɛ. Ɔte maen bɔ waneanea nu waye ye maa wayɛ ye agyapadeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: from his throne in heaven, and he watches us all.
translation_verse: Ɔte ye ahennie bia so wɔ ye atenaleɛ dɔ, na ɔto ye nye nea aseɛ so ama amukoraa.

english_verse: The Lord gave us each a mind, and nothing we do can be hidden from him.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔbɔle bɛ mukoraa b’adwene ɔ, na onwu bɔ bɛyɔ amukoraa.

english_verse: Mighty armies alone cannot win wars for a king; great strength by itself cannot keep a soldier safe.
translation_verse: Ɛhene biala, nna ye koɛhonɛfoɛ somaa yeɛ bɛkora bɛpepɛ bede ye ɔ; yeɛ koɛhonɛniɛ koso, nna ye anwoserɛ kandinga yeɛ ɔpepɛ de ye ɔ.

english_verse: In war the strength of a horse cannot be trusted to take you to safety.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛfa wɔ nye to pɔngɔ so wɔ koɛ nu a, ɔte mbaen; ye anwoserɛ kandinga ne ngɔhora ngɔpepɛ ngole wɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord watches over all who honor him and trust his kindness.
translation_verse: Amba, bɛ bɔ besuro AWURADE, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛ nye la ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne aso ne, bɛla ye ahone nwo,

english_verse: We depend on you, Lord, to help and protect us.
translation_verse: Yɛ kra nye la AWURADE so; ɔte yɛ bokafoɛ ne y’akokyɛm.

english_verse: You make our hearts glad because we trust you, the only God.
translation_verse: Yɛ nye agye wɔ ye nu, ofikyɛ yɛ wora wura ye dumaa krongron ne anu.

english_verse: I will always praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Ngɔye AWURADE ayɛ mmerɛ biala; ye ayɛyelɛ kɔla me noa daa.

english_verse: With all my heart, I will praise the Lord. Let all who are helpless, listen and be glad.
translation_verse: AWURADE nu yeɛ me kra hoahoa ye nwo ɔ, odi kyɛ anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ betie, ná bɛ nye gye.

english_verse: Honor the Lord with me! Celebrate his great name.
translation_verse: Ao, ɛ́mɔboka me so maa yɛkamvo AWURADE, na ɛ́mɔma yɛbɔ nu yɛbɔ ye abodin.

english_verse: I asked the Lord for help, and he saved me from all my fears.
translation_verse: Mbenane AWURADE si atee, na obuale me, na ɔpepɛ lele me fili nikyee bɔ mesuro biala ɔ nu.

english_verse: Keep your eyes on the Lord! You will shine like the sun and never blush with shame.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto ye so ne, bɛ nye gye; na bɛ nyunu ngua ase.

english_verse: I was a nobody, but I prayed, and the Lord saved me from all my troubles.
translation_verse: Sɔ anwumvoinniɛ he, osuni, na AWURADE tiele ye sufrɛ, ná ɔpepɛ lele ye fili ye amaneɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: If you honor the Lord, his angel will protect you.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ besuro AWURADE ne, ye abɔfo bɔ bɛ nwo waen bra yia, na ɔpepɛ de bɛ.

english_verse: Discover for yourself that the Lord is kind. Come to him for protection, and you will be glad.
translation_verse: Ao, baafa wɔ nwo bɔ AWURADE nea, na ekonwu kyɛ AWURADE te paa; sona bɔ ɔnwati ɔkɔfea ye nu ne, onya saleɛ.

english_verse: Honor the Lord! You are his special people. No one who honors the Lord will ever be in need.
translation_verse: Ao, AWURADE mmenia krongron, ɛ́mɔsuro ye, ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ besuro ye ne, hwee nhia bɛ.

english_verse: Young lions may go hungry or even starve, but if you trust the Lord, you will never miss out on anything good.
translation_verse: Gyata akrɔngrɔma mɔ po, nikyee hia bɛ, na ɛhɔen koso ku bɛ. Nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto AWURADE so ne de, nikye paa biala nhia bɛ.

english_verse: Come, my children, listen as I teach you to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Ao me mma mɔ, ɛmɔbra beetie me noa dwirɛ, na ngohyire ɛmɔ AWURADE surolɛ ne.

english_verse: Do you want to live and enjoy a long life?
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ ɔpena ngoa, ngoa tendenn bɔ nningyein kɔhɔ so yé kɔma ye ɔ?

english_verse: Then don't say cruel things and don't tell lies.
translation_verse: Nnɛte wɔ noa kã edwirɛ tɛɛ, yeɛ nnebukye wɔ noa pɛ ngondombo.

english_verse: Do good instead of evil and try to live at peace.
translation_verse: Twe wɔ nwo fi bɔne nwo, ná yɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ, pena asomdwee si atee, na fa bɔ wɔ bra.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, he will watch over you and answer your prayers.
translation_verse: AWURADE nye wɔ teneneefoɛ so, na ɔyɛ asoɛ tie bɛ sufrɛ.

english_verse: But God despises evil people, and he will wipe them all from the earth, till they are forgotten.
translation_verse: AWURADE tu ye nye sie bɔnefoɛ so, kyɛ okonua bɛ boso kofi aseɛ so.

english_verse: When his people pray for help, he listens and rescues them from their troubles.
translation_verse: Sɛ teneneefoɛ besu bɛpena mmokalɛ a, AWURADE tie bɛ sufrɛ, na ɔpepɛ de bɛ fi b’amaneɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: The Lord is there to rescue all who are discouraged and have given up hope.
translation_verse: AWURADE pingye bɛ bɔ bɛ wora abɔ ɔ, na ɔpepɛ de bɛ bɔ bɛ kra aboto ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord's people may suffer a lot, but he will always bring them safely through.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ amaneɛ ɔsone, nakoso AWURADE pepɛ de ye fi ye mukoraa nu.

english_verse: Not one of their bones will ever be broken.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔ ye mmowue amukoraa nwo waen, bɔ bɛ nu ko po nu mmu ɔ.

english_verse: Wicked people are killed by their own evil deeds, and if you hate God's people you will be punished.
translation_verse: Bɔne kohũ amumuyɛɛfoɛ, na bɛ bɔ bɛpɔ teneneefoɛ ne, ongoyie bɛ yé.

english_verse: The Lord saves the lives of his servants. Run to him for protection, and you won't be punished.
translation_verse: AWURADE de ye somvoɛ mɔ ngoa, na ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔkɔɔfea ye nu, bɔ ongoyie ye yé ɔ.

english_verse: Shield me and help me.
translation_verse: Fa akokyɛm ne buralɛ ataadeɛ, ná dwɔso baaboka me!

english_verse: Aim your spear at everyone who hunts me down, but promise to save me.
translation_verse: Twe pealɛɛ ne buralɛ tendenn tworɔntworɔn ne wɔ bɛ bɔ bɛfoa me nemɔ aso; kã kyire me kra kyɛ, “Me ole wɔ ngoalelɛ.”

english_verse: Let all who want to kill me be disgraced and put to shame. Chase away and confuse all who plan to harm me.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛpena me beku me ne, maa bɛ nyunu ogua ase, ná bɛfɛre. Bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ me nwo porɛ ne, maa bɛfa animguaseɛ besa bɛ si bɛhɔ.

english_verse: Send your angel after them and let them be like straw in the wind.
translation_verse: Maa bɛyɛ kyɛ afafu bɔ mvrama hu ye kɔ ɔ, ma AWURADE abɔfo osumu bɛ gua.

english_verse: Make them run in the dark on a slippery road, as your angel chases them.
translation_verse: Ma b’atee so ɔyɛ awosii ne ndonondono, ma AWURADE abɔfo ogu bɛ so.

english_verse: I did them no harm, but they hid a net to trap me, and they dug a deep pit to catch and kill me.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ basua me ngaen wɔ aberɛ bɔ nnyɔle hwee ɔ; bapɛ kumaa bama me kra wɔ aberɛ bɔ nnyɔle hwee ɔ.

english_verse: Surprise them with disaster! Trap them in their own nets and let them fall and rot in the pits they have dug.
translation_verse: Ma b’ayieleɛ oyie bɛ mvum nu, ná ma ngaen bɔ basua bafea me ne hye bɛ; maa bɛtɔ nu ma b’ayieleɛ oyie bɛ.

english_verse: I will celebrate and be joyful because you, Lord, have saved me.
translation_verse: Na afei, me kra koli ahurusi wɔ AWURADE nu, ná wama ye nwo asande ye wɔ AWURADE ngoalelɛ nu.

english_verse: Every bone in my body will shout: “No one is like the Lord!” You protect the helpless from those in power; you save the poor and needy from those who hurt them.
translation_verse: Me mmowue amukoraa kɔhã kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE, nwa yeɛ ɔte kyɛ wɔ ɔ? Wɔ bɔ ɛpepɛ de sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo fi ebie bɔ ɔkora ye ɔ sa nu ɔ; wɔ bɔ ede sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ne ehianiɛ fi ebie bɔ osisi ye ɔ sa nu ɔ.”

english_verse: Liars accuse me of crimes I know nothing about.
translation_verse: Adanzewiafoɛ bedwɔso begyina, na edwirɛ bɔ menze ye nwo hwee ɔ yeɛ bebisa me ɔ.

english_verse: They repay evil for good, and I feel all alone.
translation_verse: Bɛfa bɔne betua me paa so kerɛ, na me kra aboto.

english_verse: When they were sick, I wore sackcloth and went without food. I truly prayed for them,
translation_verse: Nakoso me de, anwonyerɛ bɔle bɛ ne, ngerale ɛsɛen tena ; ngyele ɛhɔen mva mmrɛle me kra ase. Nzili me ti ase mmɔle mbaeɛ

english_verse: as I would for a friend or a relative. I was in sorrow and mourned, as I would for my mother.
translation_verse: kyɛ ebiaa mesu me damvo anaa nniɛma bie; nzili me ti ase nnili aworabɔlɛ, kyɛ ebie bɔ osũ oni ɔ.

english_verse: I have stumbled, and worthless liars I don't even know surround me and sneer.
translation_verse: Nakoso ngɔle anwokyere nu ne, bɛ nye gyele, bɛyɛle ko bedwɔsole betiale me; asanzafoɛ bie bɔ menze bɛ ɔ, bɛhɔle so bɛsɛkyele me dumaa;

english_verse: Worthless people make fun and never stop laughing.
translation_verse: asanzafoɛ bɔ benzuro Nyameɛ ɔ bɛgorole me nwo yea yea paa, bɛnwosene bɛ gye behyirele me.

english_verse: But all you do is watch! When will you do something? Save me from the attack of those vicious lions.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ɛnea alaa maa okodwu kyinzu? Pepɛ de me kra fi bɛ nzɛmmɔnelilɛ nu, de me ngoa fi gyata nemɔ sa nu!

english_verse: And when your people meet, I will praise you and thank you, Lord, in front of them all.
translation_verse: Na afei ngɔla wɔ ase wɔ badwa kandinga ne anu; ngɔye wɔ ayɛ wɔ ɛlɔen kandinga ne anyunu.

english_verse: Don't let my brutal enemies be glad because of me. They hate me for no reason. Don't let them wink behind my back.
translation_verse: Pɔfoɛ ngondombofoɛ nemɔ, nnɛmaa bedi me nwo ahurusi, bɛ bɔ bɛpɔ me mbaen ne, nnɛmaa bebu me kangyerɛ.

english_verse: They say hurtful things, and they lie to people who want to live in peace.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛnga asomdwee dwirɛ, na mmom bɛbɔ porɛ bɛpɛ edwirɛ bɛto aseɛ so mmenia bɔ benguro bɛ nwo dwirɛ ɔ so.

english_verse: They are quick to accuse me. They say, “You did it! We saw you ourselves.”
translation_verse: Bɛtrɛ bɛ noa nu bɛteatea nu bɛkã me nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ kyɛ, “Ehee! Ehee! yɛ nye anwu ye.”

english_verse: You see everything, Lord! Please don't keep silent or stay so far away.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, naa anwu ye; nnɛkã wɔ noa to nu! Ao AWURADE, nnɛyakyi me nu!

english_verse: and prove that I am right by your standards. Don't let them laugh at me
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ, gyina wɔ tenenee so bua me be, na nnɛmaa bedi me nwo ahurusi.

english_verse: or say to each other, “Now we've got what we want! We'll gobble him up!”
translation_verse: Nnɛma bɛkekã ye wɔ bɛ ti anu kyɛ, “Ehee, yɛ sa ahã bɔ yɛpena ɔ.” Nnɛmaa bɛkã kyɛ, “Yayie ye pasaa.”

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who are glad to see me in trouble; disgrace and embarrass my proud enemies who say to me, “You are nothing!”
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bedi ahurusi wɔ m’anwokyere mmerɛ nu ne, ma bɛ mukoraa bɛ nyunu ogua ase, ná bɛfɛre; bɛ bɔ bɛmoma bɛ bati so bekyire me ne, maa bɛfa animguaseɛ ne nyanzoen bɛhera.

english_verse: Let all who want me to win be happy and joyful. From now on let them say, “The Lord is wonderful! God is glad when all goes well for his servant.”
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛ kunu a ahaa babua me be ne, maa bɛbɔ ese beli ahurusi ná bɛ nye gye, ná bɛhã ye daa kyɛ, AWURADE te piri, na ye nye gye ye somvoɛ ye yeeyɛlɛ nwo.”

english_verse: Then I will shout all day, “Praise the Lord God! He did what was right.”
translation_verse: Afei ngɔte me noa ngɔbɔ wɔ tenenee ne w’ayɛyelɛ nwo dawure daa amukoraa.

english_verse: Sinners don't respect God; sin is all they think about.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛɛ dwudwo kyire bɔnefoɛ wɔ ye ti anu; bɔnefoɛ nye so de, Nyameɛ nwo nyɛ suro.

english_verse: They like themselves too much to hate their own sins or even to see them.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ode ye nwo di alaa maa ɔnate so ɔngora nwu ye amumuyɛɛ, maa ɔnate so ɔngora ngyi ye amumuyɛɛ ne.

english_verse: They tell deceitful lies, and they don't have the sense to live right.
translation_verse: Ye noa nu dwirɛ te bɔne ne nnakannaka; na bra bɔ nworɛ wɔ nu ná ɔte paa de, wayakyi ye bɔlɛ.

english_verse: Those people stay awake, thinking up mischief, and they follow the wrong road, refusing to turn from sin.
translation_verse: Ɔla ye bɛen so a, nzɛmmɔne yeɛ osusu ye nwo ɔ; wape bɔne atee so, na ongyi bɔne.

english_verse: Your love is faithful, Lord, and even the clouds in the sky can depend on you.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔkɔkã ewienu dɔ paa, yeɛ wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne, okodwu munungum nemɔ anu.

english_verse: Your decisions are always fair. They are firm like mountains, deep like the sea, and all people and animals are under your care.
translation_verse: Wɔ tenenee kɔ anwuro anwuro te kyɛ Nyameɛ mmokaa, na wɔ ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ne, ye kuronn te kyɛ ɛpo buma. Ao AWURADE, ɛpepɛ de kuro mmenia ne ngaka.

english_verse: Your love is a treasure, and everyone finds shelter in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, kyɛbɔ ye nwo osi le mvasoɛ ɔ! Na adasa mmaa bɛnwati bɛbafea wɔ ndaa ne abo fɔnwoo ne anu.

english_verse: You give your guests a feast in your house, and you serve a tasty drink that flows like a river.
translation_verse: Bedi aleɛ bɔ wabu so wɔ w’awuro ne ma bɛko yi, na ɛma bɛ nzue bɔ ofi w’anigye asue nu maa bɛno.

english_verse: The life-giving fountain belongs to you, and your light gives light to each of us.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte ngoa asue ti ɔ, na wɔ kanea ne anu yeɛ yɛnwu kanea ɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, keep showing love to everyone who knows you, and use your power to save all whose thoughts please you.
translation_verse: Ao, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, kɔ so ye kyire bɛ bɔ bɛse wɔ ɔ, na ye wɔ ngoalelɛ ne kyire bɛ bɔ bɛtengyɛ ɔ!

english_verse: Don't let those proud and merciless people kick me around or chase me away.
translation_verse: Nnɛma anwomasoɛfoɛ betwi bɛfa me so, yeɛ nnɛma amumuyɛɛfoɛ betu me bo.

english_verse: Look at those wicked people! They are knocked down, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Nea, kyɛbɔ bɔnefoɛ batotɔ ɔ, bafindifindi bɛ bagua ase, bɔ bɛngɔhora dwɔso ko ɔ.

english_verse: Don't be annoyed by anyone who does wrong, and don't envy them.
translation_verse: Nnɛma bɔnefoɛ bɛ nwo adwenedwene tɔ wɔ so, yeɛ nnɛma wɔ nye boro amumuyɛɛfoɛ,

english_verse: They will soon disappear like grass without rain.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ɔngɔhyɛ né bapɛ bɛ bagua kyɛ ɛserɛ, ná bakese kyɛ ndire.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and live right! The land will be yours, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: De AWURADE di, na yɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ; amaa ɔnate so anya aseɛ ne aso atena, ná wɔ nwo atɔ wɔ.

english_verse: Do what the Lord wants, and he will give you your heart's desire.
translation_verse: Ma wɔ nye gye wɔ AWURADE nu, na ɔkɔma wɔ sa kɔhã bɔ w’ahone bu ɛpena ɔ.

english_verse: Let the Lord lead you and trust him to help.
translation_verse: Fa wɔ nwo ma AWURADE, fa wɔ wora wura ye nu, na okoli kɔma wɔ.

english_verse: Then it will be as clear as the noonday sun that you were right.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔma wɔ tenenee kɔla ali kyɛ kanea, ná wɔ belilɛ ne wata kyɛ eyiagyina.

english_verse: Be patient and trust the Lord. Don't let it bother you when all goes well for those who do sinful things.
translation_verse: Yɛ konn wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ná to wɔ bo ase nwondɛ ye. Sona bɔ ɔnate ye bɔbɔ ye atee so onya ye nwo, yeɛ sona bɔ ɔdwene nikyee tɛɛ nwo, ná ɔyɔ ne, nnɛma ye nwo adwenedwene tɔ wɔ so.

english_verse: All sinners will disappear, but if you trust the Lord, the land will be yours.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bekonua bɔnefoɛ bɛ boso, nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛ nye la AWURADE so ne de, bɛ sa kɔhã aseɛ ne.

english_verse: Sinners will soon disappear, never to be found,
translation_verse: Ɔngɔhyɛ biala, bɔnefoɛ bɛ boso konua; ɛmɔkɔyere bɛ nwo bɛkɔpena bɛ boso, nakoso ɛmɔngonwu bɛ.

english_verse: but the poor will take the land and enjoy a big harvest.
translation_verse: Nakoso anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ bɛ sa kɔhã aseɛ ne; ɔnate asomdwee kandinga ne ati, bɛ nye kɔgye.

english_verse: Merciless people make plots against good people and snarl like animals,
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ bɛbɔ teneneefoɛ mɔ nwo porɛ, na bɛnwose bɛ gye bekyire bɛ.

english_verse: but the Lord laughs and knows their time is coming soon.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɔnefoɛ nwo yɛ AWURADE sere, ofikyɛ ɔse kyɛ ye kyẽa ne wapingye.

english_verse: The wicked kill with swords and shoot arrows to murder the poor and the needy and all who do right.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ twe ye ngrandɛ, na osina ye agyaen mɔ kyɛ ɔfa kã ehiafoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ ogua ase, ná okũkũ teneneefoɛ.

english_verse: But they will be killed by their own swords, and their arrows will be broken.
translation_verse: Ye ngrandɛ ne kɔwɔ ye bɔbɔ ye ahone nu, na ye agyaen nemɔ anu kobubu.

english_verse: It is better to live right and be poor than to be sinful and rich.
translation_verse: Nikyee kãa biala bɔ teneneeniɛ ole ye ne, odi mu tra bɔnefoɛ pee b’anwonya.

english_verse: The wicked will lose all of their power, but the Lord gives strength to everyone who is good.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔnefoɛ b’abasa nu kobu, nakoso teneneefoɛ de, AWURADE tira bɛ nu.

english_verse: Those who obey the Lord are daily in his care, and what he has given them will be theirs forever.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ bɛ bra te sannwuu ne, bɛ ngyẽa la AWURADE nyunu; na b’agyapadeɛ kɔtena berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: They won't be in trouble when times are bad, and they will have plenty when food is scarce.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ ɔtte mayee nu, bɛ nyunu ngogua ase, na ɛhɔen piri ba a, aleɛ kobu bɛ so.

english_verse: Wicked people are enemies of the Lord and will vanish like smoke from a field on fire.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, bɛ boso konua, na AWURADE pɔfoɛ mɔ, bɛte kyɛ ndire nyerɛen; bekotu bekomini, bekotu bekomini kyɛ nwosina.

english_verse: An evil person borrows and never pays back; a good person is generous and never stops giving.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ bebisa bosea a, bendua, nakoso teneneefoɛ de, bɛse anwumvoin, na bɛyɛ ayɛ.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord blesses will receive the land; everyone the Lord curses will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ AWURADE ayira bɛ ne, bɛ yeɛ bɛ sa kɔhã aseɛ ne ɔ; nakoso bɛ bɔ wanoma bɛ ne de, bɛ boso konua.

english_verse: If you do what the Lord wants, he will make certain each step you take is sure.
translation_verse: AWURADE yeɛ otutu sona gya siesie yé ɔ, sɛ ye atee sɔ ye nye a, ɔmaa otindim.

english_verse: The Lord will hold your hand, and if you stumble, you still won't fall.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔtɔ ase po a, ɔngɔtɔ ase tim, ofikyɛ AWURADE tira ye sa.

english_verse: As long as I can remember, good people have never been left helpless, and their children have never gone begging for food.
translation_verse: Mayɛ akwadaa le, na kekesaala ye de manyi, nakoso nnwuni ye le kyɛ Nyameɛ apo teneneeniɛ ɔ, anaakyɛ ye boso ama bɛsrɛsrɛ aleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: They gladly give and lend, and their children turn out good.
translation_verse: Onwu anwumvoin daa, na ofia ye kunu fa nikyee fɛmo, na ye boso ama benya saleɛ.

english_verse: If you stop sinning and start doing right, you will keep living and be secure forever.
translation_verse: Twe wɔ nwo fi bɔne nwo, ná yɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ; na ɛkɔtena berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord loves justice, and he won't ever desert his faithful people. He always protects them, but destroys the children of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE kuro ndɛenbualɛ turoloo, na ɔngɔpo ye anwoteefoɛ. Ɔkɔbɔ anwoteefoɛ nwo waen afebɔɔ, nakoso bɔnefoɛ boso ama de, bɛ boso konua.

english_verse: God's people will own the land and live here forever.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɛ bɛ sa kɔhã aseɛ ne, na bɛkɔtena so afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come when good people speak for justice.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ kã nworɛ dwirɛ, na ye noa dwirɛ te nahorɛ turoloo.

english_verse: They remember God's teachings, and they never take a wrong step.
translation_verse: Ye Nyameɛ mmeraa ne wɔ ye ahone nu; na onni ye nwo makyebu.

english_verse: The wicked try to trap and kill good people,
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ bɛtetɛ teneneefoɛ, kyɛ bɛpena bɛ beku bɛ.

english_verse: but the Lord is on their side, and he will defend them when they are on trial.
translation_verse: AWURADE ngɔyakyi teneneeniɛ ngowura bɔnefoɛ sa; yeɛ bedi teneneeniɛ dwirɛ a, ɔngɔma bengobua ye fɔ.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and follow him. He will give you the land, and you will see the wicked destroyed.
translation_verse: Ma wɔ nye la AWURADE so, ná nate ye atee so, na ɔkɔpagya wɔ maa aseɛ ne kɔyɛ w’agyapadeɛ; na wɔ nye konwu kyɛbɔ bɔnefoɛ bɛ boso onua ɔ.

english_verse: I have seen brutal people abuse others and grow strong like trees in rich soil.
translation_verse: Manwu bɔnefoɛ atianuserɛniɛ, bɔ wanyi tendenn kyɛ Lebanon sida ɔ.

english_verse: Suddenly they disappeared! I looked, but they were gone and no longer there.
translation_verse: Nakoso tie, mbɛle nu berɛ nen, né ɔnne berɛ ko; mbenane ye, nakoso mannwu ye.

english_verse: Think of the bright future waiting for all the families of honest, innocent, and peace-loving people.
translation_verse: Hyɛ sona bɔ ye bra te sannwuu ɔ nzorɛ, ná nea teneneeniɛ, ofikyɛ sɔ sona ne, ye ayieleɛ te asomdwee.

english_verse: But not a trace will be left of the wicked or their families.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmeraatolɛfoɛ de, bɛ mukoraa bekowuwu; bɔnefoɛ boso ama bɛ boso konua.

english_verse: The Lord protects his people, and they can come to him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɛ de, bɛ ngoalelɛ fi AWURADE, na bɛkɔ amaneɛ nu a, ye yeɛ ɔte b’afealeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord helps his people and saves them from the wicked because they run to him.
translation_verse: AWURADE boka bɛ, na ɔpepɛ de bɛ; ɔpepɛ de bɛ fi bɔnefoɛ sa nu, na ode bɛ ngoa, ofikyɛ bɛnwati bɛkɔfea ye nu.

english_verse: When you are angry, Lord, please don't punish me or even correct me.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nnɛtwi me nyunu wɔ wɔ yaafɛlɛ nu, yeɛ nnɛtwe me so wɔ w’ahonehulɛ nu.

english_verse: You shot me with your arrows, and you struck me with your hand.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ w’agyaen nemɔ basinasina me, na w’asohwenɛ awa me so.

english_verse: My body hurts all over because of your anger. Even my bones are in pain, and my sins
translation_verse: Ɔnate wɔ yaa bɔ afɛ ne ati, me nwo ndɔ me wɔ me wereɛ nu; ɔnate me bɔne ti, me mmowue nu we me.

english_verse: are so heavy that I am crushed.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ m’amumuyɛɛ abungam afa me so; na nu nonɛ obu me kɔme anu.

english_verse: Because of my foolishness, I am covered with sores that stink and spread.
translation_verse: Me nwo ngena batu, na bɛbo, ɔnate me ngwaseasɛm bɔ mali ne ati.

english_verse: My body is twisted and bent, and I groan all day long.
translation_verse: Me nu akondo, nna ayanga pakayaa, na daa biala medi aworabɔlɛ.

english_verse: Fever has my back in flames, and I hurt everywhere.
translation_verse: Me nwo yerayera me wuronyiwuronyi, me nwo ndɔ me wɔ me wereɛ nu.

english_verse: I am worn out and weak, moaning and in distress.
translation_verse: Me nwo ayɛ me bɛtɛɛ, yeɛ mayɛ hodwoo; mepene, ɔnate aworabɔlɛ bɔ medi ne ati.

english_verse: You, Lord, know every one of my deepest desires, and my noisy groans are no secret to you.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, bɔ mepena amukoraa la wɔ nyunu, na me penelɛ ne ɔmvea wɔ.

english_verse: My heart is beating fast. I feel weak all over, and my eyes are red.
translation_verse: M’ahone bɔ palipali, m’anwoserɛ so ate, na me nye so ayɛ me wusiwusi.

english_verse: Because of my sickness, no friends or neighbors will come near me.
translation_verse: M’adɔfo mɔ ne me mmango mɔ, baye bɛ nye wɔ amaneɛnwunɛ ne anwo, na m’abusuafoɛ mɔ bahwe bɛ nwo baagyina dedeede.

english_verse: All who want me dead set traps to catch me, and those who want to harm and destroy me plan and plot all day.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛpena me beku me ne, basunzua me ngaen; bɛ bɔ bɛpena me bepura me ne, m’asefinɛ nwo dwirɛ yeɛ bɛkã ɔ, na daa biala bɛbɔ me nwo porɛ.

english_verse: I am not able to hear or speak a word;
translation_verse: Nakoso mayɛ kyɛ asotiniwaaniɛ bɔ ɔnde dwudwolɛ ɔ; mayɛ kyɛ emumu bɔ ɔngora dwudwo ɔ.

english_verse: I am completely deaf and can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Amba, mayɛ kyɛ sona bɔ ɔnde dwudwolɛ ɔ, bɔ ɔngora nye edwirɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: I trust you, Lord God, and you will do something.
translation_verse: Nakoso ao AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ me nye la wɔ so ɔ; ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ ekobua me ɔ.

english_verse: I said, “Don't let them laugh or brag when I slip and fall.”
translation_verse: Na me mbaeɛ ole kyɛ, “Bɛ bɔ mesoti a, né ɔyɛ bɛ fɛ ne, nnɛmaa bedi m’asefinɛ nwo ahurusi.”

english_verse: I am about to collapse from constant pain.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mayie ase tɔ, na daa me nwo tutu me.

english_verse: I told you my sins, and I am sorry for them.
translation_verse: Mefa m’amumuyɛɛ meto dwaa, na medi yealɛ wɔ me bɔne nwo.

english_verse: and they repay evil for good because I try to do right.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɔne betua me paa so kerɛ ne, bɛte me pɔfoɛ mɔ, ofikyɛ me de, meyɔ nikyee bɔ ɔte paa ɔ.

english_verse: You are the Lord God! Stay nearby and don't desert me.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nnɛpo me, ao me Nyameɛ, nnɛtwe wɔ nwo fi me nwo.

english_verse: You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Yɛ ndɛ baaboka me, ao AWURADE, me ngoadefoɛ.

english_verse: I told myself, “I'll be careful not to sin by what I say, and I'll muzzle my mouth when evil people are near.”
translation_verse: Ngane kyɛ, “Ngɔnea m’atee bɔ nnate so ɔ yé, amaa mamva me noa mangekã edwirɛ bɔ ɔte bɔne ɔ; ngɔfa krado ngɔto me noa nu, wɔ aberɛ bɔ bɔnefoɛ begyigyi me nyunu ye.”

english_verse: I kept completely silent, but it did no good, and I hurt even worse.
translation_verse: Nyɛle dinn, na mandwudwo, nyɛle konn bɔ nikye paa po mangã ye nwo hwee ɔ; m’amaneɛnwunɛ ne yɛle piri.

english_verse: I felt a fire burning inside, and the more I thought, the more it burned, until at last I said:
translation_verse: Edwirɛ ne yɛle me ateetee, na medwenedwene ye nwo ne, ɔhɔle so yɛle me ateetee, na afei ndele me noa ngane kyɛ,

english_verse: You made my life short, so brief that the time means nothing to you. “Human life is but a breath,
translation_verse: Amba, ama me ngoa ayɛ tikaape bie, na m’afoɛ mɔ bɛtte huu wɔ wɔ nye so. Nahorɛ nu, kuro sona biala ye ngoa te kyɛ nwomeɛ mbaen. Sela

english_verse: and it disappears like a shadow. Our struggles are senseless; we store up more and more, without ever knowing who will get it all.
translation_verse: Amba, ebiala nate berɛ kyɛ wawoɛ bie. Amba, sona ha ye nwo mbaen, sona pena agyapadeɛ pee, nakoso ɔnze sona bɔ okooli ye sa ɔ.

english_verse: “What am I waiting for? I depend on you, Lord!
translation_verse: Na afei AWURADE, nzikyɛ yeɛ mva me nye ndo so ɔ? Wɔ yeɛ me nye la wɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: Save me from my sins. Don't let fools sneer at me.
translation_verse: De me fi me mmeraatolɛ amukoraa nu. Nnɛmaa mekakyi ngwaseafoɛ sa nu ngorohoɛ nikye.

english_verse: You treated me like this, and I kept silent, not saying a word.
translation_verse: Mayɛ konn; memmukye me noa, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ahyehyɛ ye sɔ ɔ.

english_verse: “Won't you stop punishing me? You have worn me down.
translation_verse: Nnɛfa wɔ mbire gyina me nwo ko; wɔ sa bɔ afa agyina me nwo ne, wamaa mabubu.

english_verse: You punish us severely because of our sins. Like a moth, you destroy what we treasure most. We are as frail as a breath.
translation_verse: Ɛtwe adasa mmaa so, sɛ ɛtwe sona so wɔ ye bɔne nwo a, ɛsɛkye nikyee bɔ okuro ye paa ne, kyɛbɔ mvrɔlɔ sɛkye nikye ɔ; amba, sona biala te kyɛ nwomeɛ mbaen. Sela

english_verse: “Listen, Lord, to my prayer! My eyes are flooded with tears, as I pray to you. I am merely a stranger visiting in your home as my ancestors did.
translation_verse: “Ao AWURADE, tie me mbaeɛ, ná tie me sufrɛ; nnɛye wɔ nye fi me moenporolɛ ne anwo; ofikyɛ nde kyɛ wɔ wɔfoɛ bɔ ɔngɔhyɛ ɔ, nde amanvraniɛ kyɛ me nana mɔ amukoraa.

english_verse: Stop being angry with me and let me smile again before I am dead and gone.”
translation_verse: Nnɛtu wɔ nye sie me so, amaa ɔnate so masa manya anigye koraka né mafi wa mahɔ bɔ bengonwu me ko ɔ.”

english_verse: I patiently waited, Lord, for you to hear my prayer. You listened
translation_verse: Nzili aboterɛ mvale me nye ndole AWURADE so, na ɔyɛle asoɛ otiele me sufrɛ.

english_verse: and pulled me from a lonely pit full of mud and mire. You let me stand on a rock with my feet firm,
translation_verse: Ɔyele me fili ewue kumaa nu, ɔyele me fili asaa nu, na ɔfale me gya siesiele nyɔbotaen so mane me gya bo tindimuni.

english_verse: and you gave me a new song, a song of praise to you. Many will see this, and they will honor and trust you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ɔfale edwein foforɛ tuale me noa, ɔte yɛ Nyameɛ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein. Mmenia pee konwu ye ná basuro, ná bafa bɛ wora bawura AWURADE nu.

english_verse: You bless all of those who trust you, Lord, and refuse to worship idols or follow false gods.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔfa ye wora owura AWURADE nu ne, onya saleɛ; sɔ sona ne, ɔmva ye nwo ndo anwomasoɛfoɛ so, ɔne bɛ bɔ bedi makyebu bɛkɔso mmosoen mɔ ɔ bɛ so.

english_verse: You, Lord God, have done many wonderful things, and you have planned marvelous things for us. No one is like you! I would never be able to tell all you have done.
