translation_verse: Ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ, w’anwanwadeɛ bɔ ayɔ ne, ɔne adwene bɔ ele ye ma yɛ ne, bɛsone paa; ebiala ngɔhora ngɔfa ye nwo ngɔtoto wɔ nwo. Sɛ mekã kyɛ meka ná mebɔ ye nwo dawure a, ɔsone bɔ mengɔhora ye ka ɔ.

english_verse: Sacrifices and offerings are not what please you; gifts and payment for sin are not what you demand. But you made me willing to listen and obey.
translation_verse: Nna ngaka afɔleɛ ne ayɛyɛdeɛ yeɛ wɔ nye gye ye nwo ɔ, na mmom ama me asoɛ bɔ ɔte dwirɛ ɔ. Nna naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne bɔne nwo afɔleɛ yeɛ ɛpena ɔ.

english_verse: And so, I said, “I am here to do what is written about me in the book, where it says,
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngane kyɛ, “Me ɛhe; kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ bafa me nwo wɔ nwomaa bɔ babobɔ ne anu ne ala.

english_verse: ‘I enjoy pleasing you. Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
translation_verse: Ao me Nyameɛ, bɔ mekuro ole kyɛ ngɔyɔ w’apɛdeɛ ɔ; wɔ mmeraa ne wɔ me ti anu.”

english_verse: When your people worshiped, you know I told them, “Our Lord always helps!”
translation_verse: Mahã tenenee nwo ndɛenvɛen ne wɔ badwa kandinga ne anu. Ao AWURADE, kyɛbɔ wɔ bɔbɔ ɛse ne, amba, mangã me noa mando nu.

english_verse: When all your people met, I did not keep silent. I said, “Our Lord is kind. He is faithful and caring, and he saves us.”
translation_verse: Wɔ tenenee nwo dwirɛ ne, mamva mamvea wɔ me ti anu; mabɔ wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne wɔ ngoalelɛ nwo dawure. Wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔne wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne, mamva ye nwo dwirɛ mamvea badwa kandinga ne.

english_verse: You, Lord, never fail to have pity on me; your love and faithfulness always keep me secure.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nnɛyakyi anwumvoinnwunɛ bɔ enwu me ne. Wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔne wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne, maa ɔbɔ me nwo waen afebɔɔ.

english_verse: I have more troubles than I can count. My sins are all around me, and I can't find my way. My sins outnumber the hairs on my head, and I feel weak.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ amaneɛ bɔ bɛka a bennwu ye noa ɔ, bapɛ me nwo bayia, m’amumuyɛɛ mɔ babungam bafa me so, bɔ ɔmma mengora mennwu nikye ɔ; bɛsone bɛtra me ti nwiaa, na wamaa ahunundetelɛ atɔ me so.

english_verse: Please show that you care and come to my rescue. Hurry and help me!
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, maa ɔyɛ wɔ fɛ kyɛ ɛkɔpepɛ kole me ɔ, ao AWURADE, yɛ ndɛ baaboka me.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame everyone who says, “Just look at you now!”
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bese me kyɛ, “Ehee, ehee!” ne, ma b’animguaseɛ ne ɔma bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nwo dwiri bɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, let your worshipers rejoice and be glad. They love you for saving them, so let them always say, “The Lord is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛpena wɔ si atee ne de, maa bɛ mukoraa beli ahurusi, ná bɛ nye gye wɔ wɔ nu; bɛ bɔ bɛ nye gye wɔ ngoalelɛ nwo ne, maa daa bɛhã kyɛ, “AWURADE te piri!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but, Lord God, you care about me, and you come to my rescue. Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Meyɛ anwumvo, yeɛ nde hianiɛ de, nakoso AWURADE dwene me nwo. Wɔ yeɛ ɛte me bokafoɛ ne me defoɛ ɔ; ao me Nyameɛ, nnɛkyɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord God, bless everyone who cares for the poor, and you rescue those people in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔdwene anwumvoinniɛ nwo ne, onya saleɛ. AWURADE pepɛ de ye wɔ ye amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu.

english_verse: You protect them and keep them alive. You make them happy here in this land, and you don't hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ ye nwo waen, na ɔmaa onya ngoa, oyira ye wɔ aseɛ so. Bɔ ye pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛpena kyɛ ɔto ye ne, ɛmma ɔndo ye.

english_verse: You always heal them and restore their strength when they are sick.
translation_verse: Anwonyerɛ kã ye to mba so a, AWURADE nea ye; sɛ anwonyerɛ bɔ ye a, ɛma ye nwo sande ye.

english_verse: I prayed, “Have pity, Lord! Heal me, though I have sinned against you.”
translation_verse: Ngane kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE, nwu me anwumvoin; sa me anwonyerɛ, ofikyɛ mayɔ bɔne matia wɔ.”

english_verse: My vicious enemies ask me, “When will you die and be forgotten?”
translation_verse: Me pɔfoɛ mɔ bele adwene tɛɛ bɛkekã me nwo dwirɛ kyɛ, “Kyinzu yeɛ okowu ma ye dumaa boso konunu ɔ?”

english_verse: and they say, “You have some fatal disease! You'll never get well.”
translation_verse: Bɛkekã kyɛ, “Anwonyerɛ bɔ wabɔ ye ne ɔte piri, ongodwɔso ngofi ye bɛen so ko.”

english_verse: My most trusted friend has turned against me, though he ate at my table.
translation_verse: Mmiɛngo bɔ mede ye medi paa, bɔ yeɛ me ne ye yɛto asaa yɛdidi ne, ye yeɛ waye me wama ɔ.

english_verse: Have pity, Lord! Heal me, so I can pay them back.
translation_verse: Nakoso, ao AWURADE, nwu me anwumvoin, maa nde apɔ, ná ngora ndua bɛ so kerɛ!

english_verse: Then my enemies won't defeat me, and I will know that you really care.
translation_verse: Amma me pɔfoɛ wanni me so ngonim; na ɛhe amaa manwu kyɛ ekuro me dwirɛ.

english_verse: You have helped me because I am innocent, and you will always be close to my side.
translation_verse: Ɔnate me nahorɛlilɛ ti, atira me nu, na afa me atena wɔ nyunu afebɔɔ.

english_verse: You, the Lord God of Israel, will be praised forever! Amen and amen.
translation_verse: AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ne, animnyam hã ye ofi tete bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ! Amen ne Amen.

english_verse: ) Longing for God
translation_verse: Kora boso ama dwein. Ɔfa mane edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne

english_verse: As a deer gets thirsty for streams of water, I truly am thirsty for you, my God.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, kyɛbɔ dabɔɔ ye komvi de asue ba bɔ ɔse ɔ nu nzue ne, sɔ ala yeɛ me kra pena wɔ si atee ɔ.

english_verse: In my heart, I am thirsty for you, the living God. When will I see your face?
translation_verse: Me kra wora dɔ Nyameɛ, ye wora dɔ Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne. Kyinzu yeɛ ngɔwa ngoodwu Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ?

english_verse: Day and night my tears are my only food, as everyone keeps asking, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Me nye moen yeɛ wakakyi m’aleɛ eyia ne kɔngɔen ɔ; daa biala mmenia bisa me kyɛ, “Wɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔwɔ nisua?”

english_verse: Sorrow floods my heart, when I remember leading the worshipers to your house. I can still hear them shout their joyful praises.
translation_verse: Mekaye sɔ dwirɛ hemɔ a, né me kra wora abɔ: kyɛbɔ me ne ɛlɔen ne yɛhɔle, ɛlɔen kandinga bɔ bedi aluolue ne, bɔ nne esebɔlɛ ne asennaa dwein, nnili folii ne nyunu ngɔle Nyameɛ awuro ne.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I should trust you, Lord. I will praise you again because you help me,
translation_verse: Ao me kra, nzu ati yeɛ aboto sɔaa ye, nzu ati yeɛ wɔ wora abɔ wɔ me nu ye? Fa wɔ wora wura Nyameɛ nu, ofikyɛ ngosa ngɔye ye ayɛ. Ɔte me bokafoɛ ne me Nyameɛ.

english_verse: and you are my God. I am deeply discouraged, and so I think about you here where the Jordan begins at Mount Hermon and at Mount Mizar.
translation_verse: Me kra aboto wɔ me nu, yiti mekaye wɔ mefi Yɔɔdan ne Hɛmɔn aseɛ so, ɔne Misa bokaa so.

english_verse: Your vicious waves have swept over me like an angry ocean or a roaring waterfall.
translation_verse: Sɛ w’asue nemɔ bɛse wuruwuru a, né buma frɛ buma; w’asorɔkye ne wɔ nzue bɔ ɔse wuruwuru ne, babu bafa me so.

english_verse: Every day, you are kind, and at night you give me a song as my prayer to you, the God of my life.
translation_verse: AWURADE ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔye ye ali eyia, na kɔngɔen meto ye dwein mefa mebɔ mbaeɛ mekyire Nyameɛ bɔ otira me ngoa nyamaa nu ɔ.

english_verse: You are my mighty rock. Why have you forgotten me? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Mebisa AWURADE bɔ ɔte me nyɔbotaen ne kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ wɔ wora afi me e? Nzu ati yeɛ ɔnate ɛhyɛlɛ bɔ pɔfoɛ ne ɔhyɛ me so ti, odi kyɛ menate berɛ anwumvoin anwumvoin ɔ?”

english_verse: Even my bones are in pain, while all day long my enemies sneer and ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Me pɔfoɛ mɔ b’anyinga bɔ bɛkã me ne, ɔte kyɛ kena wɔ me wereɛ nu, na daa bebisa me kyɛ, “Wɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔwɔ nisua?”

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Ao me kra, nzu ati yeɛ aboto sɔaa ye, nzu ati yeɛ wɔ wora abɔ wɔ me nu ye? Fa wɔ wora wura Nyameɛ nu, ofikyɛ ngosa ngɔye ye ayɛ. Ɔte me bokafoɛ ne me Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Show that I am right, God! Defend me against everyone who doesn't know you; rescue me from each of those deceitful liars.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, bua me be, ná di me dwirɛ ma me fi amumuyɛɛ maen sa nu; pepɛ de me fi nnakannakafoɛ ne ndɛengyeafoɛ bɛ sa nu!

english_verse: I run to you for protection. Why do you turn me away? Why must enemies mistreat me and make me sad?
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte Nyameɛ bɔ menwati mebafea wɔ nu ɔ; na nzu ati yeɛ apo me e? Nzu ati yeɛ ɔnate ɛhyɛlɛ bɔ pɔfoɛ ne ɔhyɛ me so ti, odi kyɛ menate berɛ anwumvoin anwumvoin ɔ?

english_verse: Send your light and your truth to guide me. Let them lead me to your house on your sacred mountain.
translation_verse: Ao, soma wɔ kanea ne, ɔne wɔ nahorɛ ne maa beli me nyunu; maa bɛfa me bɛbra wɔ bokaa krongron ne aso, ɔne w’atenaleɛ berɛ.

english_verse: Then I will worship at your altar because you make me joyful. You are my God, and I will praise you. Yes, I will praise you as I play my harp.
translation_verse: Na ngɔhɔ Nyameɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo, ngɔhɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte m’anigye mmorosoɛ ne berɛ; ao Nyameɛ, me Nyameɛ, ngɔbɔ sangoo ngɔye wɔ ayɛ.

english_verse: Why am I discouraged? Why am I restless? I trust you, Lord! And I will praise you again because you help me, and you are my God.
translation_verse: Ao me kra, nzu ati yeɛ aboto sɔaa ye, nzu ati yeɛ wɔ wora abɔ wɔ me nu e? Fa wɔ wora wura Nyameɛ nu, ofikyɛ ngosa ngɔye ye ayɛ. Ɔte me bokafoɛ ne me Nyameɛ.

english_verse: You chased off the nations by causing them trouble with your powerful arm. Then you let our ancestors take over their land.
translation_verse: Wɔ bɔbɔ deinn wɔ tumi yeɛ ɛfa foane maen maen nemɔ ɔ, nakoso yɛ nana mɔ de, ɛfale bɛ ɛɛtenane aseɛ ne aso; ɛpraprale amaneɛ guale maen maen nemɔ aso, nakoso yɛ nana mɔ de, ɛbɔle bɛ atenaseɛ.

english_verse: Their strength and weapons were not what won the land and gave them victory! You loved them and fought with your powerful arm and your shining glory.
translation_verse: Nna bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ngrandɛ yeɛ bɛfa bɛhone belele aseɛ ne ɔ, yeɛ nna bɛ bɔbɔ b’anwoserɛ yeɛ ɔmaa belili ngonim ɔ; na mmom wɔ sa famaa ne, w’anwoserɛ ne, ɔne wɔ nyunu kanea bɔ ɔbokale bɛ ne ɔ, ofikyɛ ekuro bɛ dwirɛ.

english_verse: You are my God and King, and you give victory to the people of Jacob.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Hene ɔ; wɔ yeɛ ɛma Yakob di ngonim ɔ.

english_verse: By your great power, we knocked our enemies down and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Wɔ tumi yeɛ yɛfa yɛdi yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ so ngonim ɔ, na wɔ dumaa nu yeɛ yɛtiatia bɛ bɔ bedwɔso betia yɛ ɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: I don't depend on my arrows or my sword to save me.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ memva me nwo mendo m’agyaen so, yeɛ me ngrandɛ ngɔhora ngɔpepɛ ngole me.

english_verse: But you saved us from our hateful enemies, and you put them to shame.
translation_verse: Nakoso apepɛ ale yɛ afi yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu, na bɛ bɔ benguro yɛ dwirɛ ne, ama bɛ nye so atã.

english_verse: We boast about you, our God, and we are always grateful.
translation_verse: Na wɔ, Nyameɛ de, wɔ nu yeɛ yɛhoahoa yɛ nwo daa amukoraa ɔ, na yɛkɔye wɔ dumaa ne ayɛ afebɔɔ. Sela

english_verse: But now you have rejected us; you don't lead us into battle, and we look foolish.
translation_verse: Nakoso afei de, apo yɛ agua yɛ nyunu ase, na ɛne yɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛngɔ koɛ ko.

english_verse: You made us retreat, and our enemies have taken everything we own.
translation_verse: Amaa yanwati yafi yɛ pɔfoɛ ne nyunu, na yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ bafe yɛ nningyein bafa.

english_verse: You let us be slaughtered like sheep, and you scattered us among the nations.
translation_verse: Ayɛ yɛ kyɛ mmoaen bɔ bɛkwaahũ bɛ ɔ, na abɔ yɛ asande aagua maen maen mɔ so.

english_verse: You sold your people for little or nothing, and you earned no profit.
translation_verse: Atɔne wɔ mmenia bɔ anne huu ɔ, amva bɛ anne nyɔboɛ serɛ biala.

english_verse: You made us look foolish to our neighbors; people who live nearby insult us and sneer.
translation_verse: Amaa yɛ mmango mɔ bɛkã yɛ anyinga, na maen maen bɔ bapɛ yɛ nwo bayia ne, amaa bɛsere yɛ bɛgoro yɛ nwo.

english_verse: I am embarrassed every day, and I blush with shame.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ biala, me nwo nyanzoen li me nyunu, na animguaseɛ abia me,

english_verse: But others mock and sneer, as they watch my enemies take revenge on me.
translation_verse: ɔnate bɛ bɔ bɛkã me anyinga bɛpepɛ me nzoaa ne, bɛ noa dwirɛ ti, yeɛ afei ɔnate pɔfoɛ ne ɔne wereɛtɔlɛniɛ ne ati.

english_verse: All this happened to us, though we didn't forget you or break our agreement.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛhe amukoraati ato yɛ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ yɛmmane yɛ wora offili wɔ, yeɛ yɛllili w’apam ne nwo fɔ.

english_verse: We always kept you in mind and followed your teaching.
translation_verse: Yambo wɔ wɔ y’ahone nu, yeɛ yanni wɔ dwirɛ ne anwo makyebu,

english_verse: But you crushed us, and you covered us with deepest darkness where wild animals live.
translation_verse: nakoso abubu yɛ pasaa wɔ nekaa bɔ ɛserɛ so ngyea bɛwɔ ɔ, na afa awosii kabii akata yɛ so.

english_verse: We did not forget you or lift our hands in prayer to foreign gods.
translation_verse: Sɛ yɛ wora afi yɛ Nyameɛ dumaa a, anaa sɛ yatrɛtrɛ yɛ sa nu yasɔne nyameɛ foforɛ bie po a,

english_verse: You would have known it because you discover every secret thought.
translation_verse: aso ahaa Nyameɛ ongonwu ye anaa? Ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔse sona ti anu mvealeɛ dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: We face death all day for you. We are like sheep on their way to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Ɔnate wɔ ti beku yɛ daa biala, na bebu yɛ kyɛ mmoaen bɔ bɛfa bɛ bɛkɔ akumyɛɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Don't desert us forever.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, tingye! Nzu ati yeɛ ɛda e? Dwɔso, na nnɛgyi yɛ to afebɔɔ!

english_verse: Why do you keep looking away? Don't forget our sufferings and all our troubles.
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ aye wɔ nye afea e? Nzu ati yeɛ wɔ wora afi y’amaneɛnwunɛ ne yɛ ndaneanyeɛ ye?

english_verse: We are flat on the ground, holding on to the dust.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ babrɛ yɛ kra ase bawura mvuture nu; na yɛ nipadua butu nnɛtefue nu.

english_verse: Do something! Help us! Show how kind you are and come to our rescue.
translation_verse: Dwɔso ná baaboka yɛ. Wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, pepɛ de yɛ.

english_verse: My thoughts are filled with beautiful words for the king, and I will use my voice as a writer would use pen and ink.
translation_verse: Ndɛenvɛen ayi m’ahone nu tɛkyɛ, na ɛhene ne nwo dwein yeɛ meto ɔ, me temverema te kyɛ ahyerɛlɛniɛ bɔ waboa ye nwo ɔ ye pɛn.

english_verse: No one is as handsome as you! Your words are always kind. That is why God will always bless you.
translation_verse: Wɔ nwo yɛ nyemene tra sona biala; wɔ noa dwirɛ yɛ fɛ, yiti Nyameɛ ayira wɔ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: and ride out in splendor! Win victories for truth and mercy and justice. Do fearsome things with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Kɔ so di ngonim wɔ w’ahennie animnyam nu, ɔnate nahorɛlilɛ, anwobrɛaseɛ ne tenenee ti; wɔ nningyein suronyisuronyi nemɔ, ma wɔ sa famaa ne ohyirehyire wɔ.

english_verse: Send your sharp arrows through enemy hearts and make all nations fall at your feet.
translation_verse: W’agyaen nemɔ noa yɛ nna, besinasina nana pɔfoɛ mɔ b’ahone nu; maen maen mɔ tete gua wɔ gya bo.

english_verse: You are God, and you will rule forever as king. Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: “O Nyameɛ, w’ahennie bia wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ! W’ahennie hɔtɔ ne, ɔte pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ hɔtɔ.

english_verse: You love justice and hate evil. And so, your God chose you and made you happier than any of your friends.
translation_verse: Ekuro tenenee, na ekyi amumuyɛɛ. Ɛhe ati yeɛ Nyameɛ, wɔ Nyameɛ ne, wafa anika ngoo wapopa wɔ maa wabo wɔ mmango mɔ deɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: The sweet aroma of the spices myrrh, aloes, and cassia covers your royal robes. You enjoy the music of harps in palaces decorated with ivory.
translation_verse: Korobo, pɛprɛ ne kandanguru ma wɔ tena nu bo fona. Ahemvie bɔ bafa ɛsoen gye baboro ye nwo ne, nu yeɛ bɛbɔ dwein bɛgyegye wɔ nye ɔ.

english_verse: Daughters of kings are here, and your bride stands at your right side, wearing a wedding gown trimmed with pure gold.
translation_verse: Ahemvo mma mmrasua nemɔ, bɛboka wɔ ndaluwa titire nemɔ aso, na ahenyerɛ ne, ogyi wɔ sa famaa so bɔ wafa Ofire esikaa kɔkorɛ wasiesie ye nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Bride of the king, listen carefully to me. Forget your own people and your father's family.
translation_verse: Ao mma brasua, tie bɔ mekã ye, ná dwene ye nwo; ma wɔ wora fi wɔ mmenia ne wɔ baba awuro ama,

english_verse: The king adores you. He is your master, so do what he desires.
translation_verse: na ɛhene ne, ye nye kɔgye w’anwonyemene nwo. Ɔnate kyɛ ɔte wɔ mene ne ati, bɔ wɔ nu ase ma ye.

english_verse: All of the richest people from the city of Tyre will try to influence you
translation_verse: Tirofoɛ bɛkɔfa akyɛdeɛ pee bɛkɔwa, bɛ nu sikafoɛ paa nemɔ po; bɛkɔfa akyɛdeɛ ahoroɔ bɛkɔɔpena wɔ berɛ animnyam.

english_verse: with precious treasures. Your bride, my king, has inward beauty, and her wedding gown is woven with threads of gold.
translation_verse: Ɛhene awa brasua ne, ɔwɔ ye animnyam nu, na owura ataadeɛ bɔ bafa esikaa kɔkorɛ batuatua nu ɔ.

english_verse: Wearing the finest garments, she is brought to you, followed by her young friends, the bridesmaids.
translation_verse: Wawura ataadeɛ bɔ bali adwii bagua nu ɔ, na bɛfa ye bɛkɔ ɛhene ne berɛ; ye mmango ndaluwa ababunu nemɔ beli ye si, na bɛfa ye bɛbrɛ wɔ.

english_verse: Everyone is excited, as they follow you to the royal palace.
translation_verse: Bɛkwaawura Nana ahemvie berɛ, na bele anigye ne ahurusi yeɛ bɛfa bɛ bɛba ɔ.

english_verse: Your sons and your grandsons will also be kings as your ancestors were. You will make them rulers everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Wɔ mma mɔ bekosi bɛ nana mɔ gya nu; ɛkɔfa bɛ koli hene wɔ aseɛ ye aso amukoraa.

english_verse: I will make your name famous from now on, and you will be praised forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ngɔmaa bɛkɔkaye wɔ dumaa wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu; yiti maen maen mɔ kɔye wɔ ayɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: God is our mighty fortress, always ready to help in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ te yɛ nwo ɛwaenbɔlɛ ne y’anwoserɛ, bokafoɛ paa bɔ opingye yɛ wɔ amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: And so, we won't be afraid! Let the earth tremble and the mountains tumble into the deepest sea.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ aseɛ kakyi butu, ná mmokaa tutu kogua ɛpo buma nu,

english_verse: Let the ocean roar and foam, and its raging waves shake the mountains.
translation_verse: ná ɛpo nu nzue yɛ wuruwuru obu fa so, ná sɛ ye asorɔkye ma mmokaa bɛwoso po a, ɛserɛ ngɔhã yɛ. Sela

english_verse: A river and its streams bring joy to the city, which is the sacred home of God Most High.
translation_verse: Asue bie wɔ berɛ bɔ ye sa mɔ fa anigye bɛba Nyameɛ kuro ɔ, Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne, ye atenaleɛ krongron berɛ.

english_verse: God is in that city, and it won't be shaken. He will help it at dawn.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ wɔ kuro ne afia, yiti bɛngɔhora so ngonim di; Nyameɛ kofi ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu kɔboka ye ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: Nations rage! Kingdoms fall! But at the voice of God the earth itself melts.
translation_verse: Amaen maen mɔ bɛteatea nu, ahennie mɔ batete bapanzam; ɔbobɔ nu kurudududu, na aseɛ woso.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE gyi yɛ si; Yakob Nyameɛ te y’anwoserɛ afealeɛ. Sela

english_verse: Come! See the fearsome things the Lord has done on earth.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔbra bɛɛnea AWURADE sa noa nnwumaa, kyɛbɔ wasi wayɔ anwanwadeɛ mbiri mbiri wɔ aseɛ ye aso ɔ.

english_verse: God brings wars to an end all over the world. He breaks the arrows, shatters the spears, and burns the shields.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa koɛ bo ɔpɛ alaa kɔka aseɛ noa dɔ; obubu agyaen nu, na obubu pealɛɛ nu gɔsɔgɔsɔ, na ɔfa see yera teaseɛnam mɔ.

english_verse: Our God says, “Calm down, and learn that I am God! All nations on earth will honor me.”
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔyɛ konn, ná ɛ́mɔnwu kyɛ me ole Nyameɛ! Medi hene wɔ maen maen mɔ so, medi aseɛ ye aso hene.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is with us. The God of Jacob is our fortress.
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE gyi yɛ si; Yakob Nyameɛ te y’anwoserɛ afealeɛ. Sela

english_verse: All of you nations, clap your hands and shout joyful praises to God.
translation_verse: Amaenmaen amukoraa, ɛ́mɔbɔ ɛmɔ sa nu; ɛ́mɔbɔ se bɛto Nyameɛ nwo ahurusi dwein.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is fearsome, the ruler of all the earth.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE, Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne, ye nwo yɛ suro, ɔte ɛhene piri bɔ odi wiase amukoraa so ɔ.

english_verse: God has put every nation under our power,
translation_verse: Ɔbrɛ maen maen ase wura yɛ bo, ɔfa maen maen mɔ wura yɛ gya bo.

english_verse: and he chose for us the land that was the pride of Jacob, his favorite.
translation_verse: Ɔye y’agyapadeɛ sie berɛ ma yɛ, Yakob bɔ okuro ye dwirɛ ne, agyapadeɛ ne te ye animnyam. Sela

english_verse: God goes up to his throne, as people shout and trumpets blast.
translation_verse: Esebɔlɛ nu yeɛ Nyameɛ fa fo kɔ anwuro ɔ, totorobɛndohulɛ nu yeɛ AWURADE ɔfa fo kɔ ɔ.

english_verse: the ruler of all the earth! Praise God with songs.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ te aseɛ ye amukoraa so Hene, ɛ́mɔfa ndeaseɛ bɛto ayɛyelɛ dwein.

english_verse: God rules the nations from his sacred throne.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ di maen maen mɔ so hene, Nyameɛ te ye ahennie bia krongron ne aso.

english_verse: Their leaders come together and are now the people of Abraham's God. All rulers on earth surrender their weapons, and God is greatly praised!
translation_verse: Maen maen ahemvo baboa bɛ noa, Abraham Nyameɛ ye maen ne. Ofikyɛ aseɛ ye aso akokyɛm te Nyameɛ deɛ, ɔte ɛhene piri paa wɔ ebiala so.

english_verse: The Lord God is wonderful! He deserves all praise in the city where he lives. His holy mountain,
translation_verse: AWURADE te piri, na ɔfata ayɛyelɛ piri paa wɔ yɛ Nyameɛ kuro ne anu. Ye bokaa krongron ne,

english_verse: beautiful and majestic, brings joy to all on earth. Mount Zion, truly sacred, is home for the Great King.
translation_verse: bɔ ogyi berɛ tendenn nyemenenyemene ne, ɔte aseɛ ye amukoraa anika; Sion bokaa, bɔ ɔwɔ sorɔ dɔ dedeede ne, ɔte Ɛhene piri ne, ye kuro.

english_verse: God is there to defend it and has proved to be its protector.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ wɔ kuro berɛ anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne anu, na wahyire kyɛ ye yeɛ ɔbɔ kuro ne anwo waen ɔ amba.

english_verse: Kings joined forces to attack the city,
translation_verse: Tie, ahemvo mɔ bɛboaboale bɛ noa, bɛhane bɛ nwo bɛbɔle nu bɛwale Sion so.

english_verse: but when they saw it, they were terrified and ran away.
translation_verse: Bɛ nye bɔle kuro ne aso pɛ, bɛbɔle binim; bɛ kunu tele bɛ, na bɛnwatili.

english_verse: or like seagoing ships wrecked by eastern winds.
translation_verse: Ɛfale eyia afiteleɛ mvrama ebubuli Tasise ɛlɛen nemɔ.

english_verse: We had heard about it, and now we have seen it in the city of our God, the Lord All-Powerful. This is the city that God will let stand forever.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ yate ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yanwu ye, wɔ Asafo AWURADE ye kuro, yɛ Nyameɛ ye kuro, kuro bɔ Nyameɛ wafa watimu berɛ afebɔɔ ne aso ɔ. Sela

english_verse: Our God, here in your temple we think about your love.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, yɛdwenedwene wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne anwo, wɔ w’asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu.

english_verse: You are famous and praised everywhere on earth, as you win victories with your powerful arm.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, kyɛbɔ wɔ dumaa te ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛye wayɛ kɔpem aseɛ ye noa dɔ paa ɔ. Tenenee ayi wɔ sa famaa ne anu tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: Mount Zion will celebrate, and all Judah will be glad, because you bring justice.
translation_verse: Ɔnate wɔ ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ti, odi kyɛ Sion bokaa nye gye, ná Yuda mma mmrasua bedi ahurusi.

english_verse: Let's walk around Zion and count its towers.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnate behyini Sion nwo bɛbra beyia, ɛmɔha ye abandenden nemɔ;

english_verse: We will see its strong walls and visit each fortress. Then you can say to future generations,
translation_verse: ɛ́mɔgyene ɛmɔ nye bɛnea ye fasue nemɔ yé, ɛ́mɔneanea ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ anu yé, amaa amɔahora bahã ye nwo dwirɛ bahyire aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ ɔkɔwa nziɛ ye ne,

english_verse: “Our God is like this forever and will always guide us.”
translation_verse: kyɛ Nyameɛ he, ɔte yɛ Nyameɛ afebɔɔ. Ye yeɛ okohyire yɛ atee kɔpem kyɛ ewue kɔfa yɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Maen maen amukoraa, ɛ́mɔtie edwirɛ he, wiase mmenia amukoraa, ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ betie,

english_verse: Listen, no matter who you are, rich or poor.
translation_verse: kwahweabaa mɔ ne atitire, sikafoɛ ne ehiafoɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: I speak words of wisdom, and my thoughts make sense.
translation_verse: Me noa kɔhã nworɛ dwirɛ, na me ti anu nzusuleɛ te nimdeɛ.

english_verse: I have in mind a mystery that I will explain while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Ngɔyɛ asoɛ konn ngotie anyandera, ngɔbɔ sangoo ngɔpena m’anyandera nwo ndeaseɛ.

english_verse: Why should I be afraid in times of trouble, when I am surrounded by vicious enemies?
translation_verse: Sɛ amaneɛ to me, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛtane me nye ne, sɛ b’amumuyɛɛ pɛ me nwo bra yia a, nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ mesuro ɔ?

english_verse: They trust in their riches and brag about all their wealth.
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ nzuro bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto b’anwonyadeɛ so, bɔ bɛfa b’anwonya bɛhoahoa bɛ nwo ɔ?

english_verse: You cannot buy back your life or pay off God!
translation_verse: Amba, ebiala ngɔhora ngɔpɔ ye nwo; yeɛ ɔngɔhora ngotua ye ngoa ti nyɔboɛ ngɔma Nyameɛ.

english_verse: It costs far too much to buy back your life. You can never pay God enough
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sona kra nyɔboɛ yɛ se paa, na esikaa biala ngɔso ye nwo kerɛ tua

english_verse: to stay alive forever and safe from death.
translation_verse: bɔ ɔkɔma sona kɔtena ase afebɔɔ, bɔ ɔngɔhɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu ɔ.

english_verse: We see that wise people die, and so do stupid fools. Then their money is left for someone else.
translation_verse: Ye nye tua kyɛ nworɛfoɛ bewu; yeɛ ngwaseafoɛ ne gyiminiwaafoɛ koso bewu, na bɛyakyi b’agyapadeɛ berɛ maa okodi mmeni foforɛ sa nu.

english_verse: The grave will be their home forever and ever, although they once had land of their own.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛfale bɛ dumaa bɛtole b’aseɛ so de, nakoso b’asieleɛ yeɛ ɔte b’awuro afebɔɔ ɔ, na ɔte bɛ daberɛ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: Dasaniɛ ngɔhora ngɔtena ye anwonya nu afebɔɔ, owu kyɛ ngaka ne ala.

english_verse: Here is what happens to fools and to those who trust the words of fools:
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bede bɛ nwo bedi ne, sɔ yeɛ b’ayieleɛ te ɔ, bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto b’anwonya so ne, b’ayieleɛ ɛne. Sela

english_verse: They are like sheep with death as their shepherd, leading them to the grave. In the morning God's people will walk all over them, as their bodies lie rotting in their home, the grave.
translation_verse: Bɛte kyɛ mmoaen, na bɛ mukoraa bewu. Ewue yeɛ odi bɛ nyunu fa bɛ kɔ ɔ; teneneefoɛ koli bɛ so tumi ngyerɛmɔ, na b’anwonyemene kɔsɛkye wɔ ewue kumaa nu; na ɛborɔ yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ b’awuro ɔ.

english_verse: But God will rescue me from the power of death.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ kɔpɔ me kra kofi ɛborɔ sa nu, ofikyɛ okole me. Sela

english_verse: Don't let it bother you when others get rich and live in luxury.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie yɛ sikaniɛ, sɛ onya ye nwo tam a, nnɛmaa ɔyɛ wɔ anyeboro.

english_verse: Soon they will die and all their wealth will be left behind.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɛ owu a, ɔngɔfa hwee ngɔhɔ, yeɛ ye sikaa ngoli ye si ngɔhɔ bie.

english_verse: We humans are praised when we do well, and all of us are glad to be alive.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ ɔte ngoa nu ne, obuli ye nwo kyɛ wayie ye yé, ofikyɛ sɛ sona nya ye nwo a, mmenia kamvo ye.

english_verse: But we each will go down to our ancestors, never again to see the light of day.
translation_verse: Nakoso ye mbanyi mɔ bɔ bengonwu eyia ko le ne, ɔkɔɔtoa bɛ.

english_verse: Our human glory disappears, and, like animals, we die.
translation_verse: Dasaniɛ ngɔhora ngɔtena ye anwonya nu afebɔɔ, owu kyɛ ngaka ne ala.

english_verse: From east to west, the powerful Lord God has been calling together everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Tuminiɛ ne, Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte AWURADE ne, wadwudwo, wato ye sa wafrɛ aseɛ ye aso ama amukoraa, fi eyia afiteleɛ kɔka eyia atɔleɛ.

english_verse: God shines brightly from Zion, the most beautiful city.
translation_verse: Sion bɔ ye anwonyemene di mu ne, Nyameɛ ta hyireinn fi berɛ.

english_verse: Our God approaches, but not silently; a flaming fire comes first, and a storm surrounds him.
translation_verse: Yɛ Nyameɛ ɔba, na ɔngɔyɛ konn, see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi li ye nyunu, na mvrama piri apɛ ye nwo amukoraa wayia.

english_verse: God comes to judge his people. He shouts to the heavens and to the earth,
translation_verse: Ɔfrɛ nyameɛso bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro, ɔne aseɛ, kyɛ bɛɛnea kyɛ obua ye maen ndɛen ɔ.

english_verse: “Call my followers together! They offered me a sacrifice, and we made an agreement.”
translation_verse: Ɔnwa, “M’anwoteefoɛ bɔ bɛnate afɔleɛ so bɛ ne me ayɛ apam ne, ɛ́mɔboaboa bɛ noa bɛma me!”

english_verse: The heavens announce, “God is the judge, and he is always honest.”
translation_verse: Ewienu bɔ ye tenenee nwo dawure, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ bɔbɔ te ndɛenbualɛniɛ. Sela

english_verse: My people, I am God! Israel, I am your God. Listen to my charges against you.
translation_verse: “Ao me maen, tie na mebaadwudwo. Ao Yisrael, ngɔbɔ wɔ kwaadu. Me ole Nyameɛ, wɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: I won't accept your offerings of bulls and goats.
translation_verse: W’awuro nandwie nyii, yeɛ wɔ tuin nu mbɔngye ne, menhia.

english_verse: Every animal in the forest belongs to me, and so do the cattle on a thousand hills.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ eburo kaka biala te me deɛ, yeɛ mmokaa apee apee so nandwie nemɔ, bɛte me deɛ.

english_verse: I know all the birds in the mountains, and every wild creature is in my care.
translation_verse: Mese ewienu nnomaa mukoraa, na eburo kaka biala koso te me deɛ.

english_verse: If I were hungry, I wouldn't tell you, because I own the world and everything in it.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛhɔen ku me a, ahaa nna ɛmɔ yeɛ ngosu hɔen ngohyire ɛmɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ wiase ne bɔ ɔwɔ nu amukoraa te me deɛ.

english_verse: I don't eat the meat of bulls or drink the blood of goats.
translation_verse: Aso nandwie naen yeɛ medi ɔ, anaa mbɔngye mogya yeɛ meno ɔ?

english_verse: I am God Most High! The only sacrifice I want is for you to be thankful and to keep your word.
translation_verse: Fa asennaa yɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ma AWURADE, ná tua w’aboadeɛ ma Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne.

english_verse: Pray to me in time of trouble. I will rescue you, and you will honor me.
translation_verse: Sũ frɛ me wɔ w’amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu, na ngɔpepɛ ngole wɔ, amaa ɔnate so ahyɛ me animnyam.”

english_verse: But to the wicked I say: “You don't have the right to mention my laws or claim to keep our agreement!
translation_verse: Nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, Nyameɛ kã kyire ye kyɛ, “Atee beni yeɛ ele ye kyɛ ɛfa wɔ noa kekã m’ahyɛdeɛ, anaa ɛfa wɔ noa bɔ m’apam so ɔ.

english_verse: You refused correction and rejected my commands.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ekyi kyɛ ngɔtea wɔ ɔ, yeɛ afa me dwirɛ ato ahameɛ.

english_verse: You made friends with every crook you met, and you liked people who break their wedding vows.
translation_verse: Sɛ enwu awueniɛ a, ɛne ye betira abiɛngoɛ, na ɛne agyaasɛkyelɛfoɛ yeɛ betu nu ɔ.

english_verse: You talked only about violence and told nothing but lies;
translation_verse: Ɔnyɛ wɔ se kyɛ ɛte wɔ noa kekã musue dwirɛ ɔ, na nnakannaka wɔ wɔ noa nu.

english_verse: you sat around gossiping, ruining the reputation of your own relatives.”
translation_verse: Ɛtena ase ɛkekã eliɛma nwo dwirɛ; na eni awa po, ɛpepɛ ye gya ndii nu.

english_verse: When you did all this, I didn't say a word, and you thought, “God is just like us!” But now I will accuse you.
translation_verse: Ɛyɔle sɔ nningyein nemɔ bɔ mandɛ wɔ so ne ati, ɛdwene kyɛ nde kyɛ wɔ ala. Na afei de, mekã wɔ nyunu ná mebɔ wɔ kwaadu.

english_verse: You have ignored me! So pay close attention or I will tear you apart, and no one can help you.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔ wora ofi Nyameɛ ne, ɛ́mɔdwene ɛhe anwo, ná mandete ɛmɔ nu pasapasa bɔ ɛmɔngonya defoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The sacrifice that honors me is a thankful heart. Obey me, and I, your God, will show my power to save.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔfa asennaa ɔbɔ afɔleɛ ma me ne, ɔhyɛ me animnyam; sona bɔ ye atee tengyɛ ne, ngɔmaa okonwu Nyameɛ ngoalelɛ ne.”

english_verse: You are kind, God! Please have pity on me. You are always merciful! Please wipe away my sins.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, gyina wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne aso ná nwu me anwumvoin, gyina w’anwumvoinnwunɛ kandinga ne aso, ná kyikyi me mmeraatolɛ.

english_verse: Wash me clean from all of my sin and guilt.
translation_verse: Nwunzi me nwo sannwuu fi m’amumuyɛɛ nwo, ná pete me nwo fi me bɔne nwo.

english_verse: I know about my sins, and I cannot forget the burden of my guilt.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mede me mmeraatolɛ meto nu, na me bɔne la me nyunu daa.

english_verse: You are really the one I have sinned against; I have disobeyed you and have done wrong. So it is right and fair for you to correct and punish me.
translation_verse: Wɔ ngome, wɔ ngome twe, yeɛ mayɔ bɔne matia wɔ ɔ, na mayɔ bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ wɔ nyunu ɔ. Yiti sɛ ebua me fɔ a, ɔte turoloo, na sɛ ebua me ndɛen a, edi be.

english_verse: I have sinned and done wrong since the day I was born.
translation_verse: Amba, amumuyɛɛ nu yeɛ bɛwole me ɔ, na bɔne nu yeɛ me maame nwonzɛle me ɔ.

english_verse: But you want complete honesty, so teach me true wisdom.
translation_verse: Amba, ɛpena nahorɛlilɛ wɔ sona nu, yiti maa nwu nworɛ wɔ me nu mvealeɛ nu dɔ.

english_verse: Wash me with hyssop until I am clean and whiter than snow.
translation_verse: Fa sufiɛ pete me nwo, na me nwo kofi; nwunzi me nwo, na me nwo kɔyɛ fufue kɔtra ewure.

english_verse: Let me be happy and joyful! You crushed my bones, now let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Maa nde ahurusi ne anigye dwirɛ, mmowue bɔ agorɔgorɔ bɛ ne, maa beli ahurusi.

english_verse: Turn your eyes from my sin and cover my guilt.
translation_verse: Nnɛnea me bɔne bɔ mayɔ ɔ, na mmom kyikyi m’amumuyɛɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: Create pure thoughts in me and make me faithful again.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, bɔ ahone bɔ nu te ɔ wura me nu, ná fa sunzum bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ wura me nu.

english_verse: Don't chase me away from you or take your Holy Spirit away from me.
translation_verse: Nnɛfoa me fi wɔ nyunu, yeɛ nnɛye wɔ krongronyɛlɛ sunzum ne fi me nu.

english_verse: Make me as happy as you did when you saved me; make me want to obey!
translation_verse: Wɔ ngoalelɛ nu anigye ne, sa fa ma me, ná fa sotie sunzum tira me nu.

english_verse: I will teach sinners your Law, and they will return to you.
translation_verse: Na afei ngohyire mmeraatolɛfoɛ w’atee, na bɔnefoɛ kosa kɔwa wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: Keep me from any deadly sin. Only you can save me! Then I will shout and sing about your power to save.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, me ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ, pepɛ de me fi mogya nwo foɛlilɛ nu, na ngɔfa me noa ngɔto wɔ tenenee nwo dwein serɛ paa.

english_verse: Help me to speak, and I will praise you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, bukye me noa, na ngɔfa me noa ngɔbɔ dawure ngɔye wɔ ayɛ.

english_verse: The way to please you is to be truly sorry deep in our hearts. This is the kind of sacrifice you won't refuse.
translation_verse: Afɔleɛ bɔ Nyameɛ nye gye ye nwo ole ahone bɔ wabrɛ ye nwo ase ɔ; ao Nyameɛ, ahone bɔ wabrɛ ye nwo ase, ná ye wora abɔ de, ɛngɔpo.

english_verse: Please be willing, Lord, to help the city of Zion and to rebuild its walls.
translation_verse: Maa ɔyɛ wɔ anigye kyɛ ɛkɔma Sion konya ngɔsoɛ ɔ; si Yerusalem fasue nemɔ.

english_verse: Then you will be pleased with the proper sacrifices, and we will offer bulls on your altar once again.
translation_verse: Na wɔ nye kɔsɔ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ nwo: naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne afɔleɛ mumua yeralɛ nwo; na bɛkɔbɔ nandwie nyii afɔleɛ wɔ w’afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso.

english_verse: You people may be strong and brag about your sins, but God can be trusted day after day.
translation_verse: Wɔ, anwoserɛniɛ, nzu ati yeɛ ɛfa bɔne bɔ edi ɔ hoahoa wɔ nwo ye? Nyameɛ nahorɛ wɔ berɛ daa.

english_verse: You plan brutal crimes, and your lying words cut like a sharp razor.
translation_verse: Wɔ noa kekã musue dwirɛ, wɔ temverema te kyɛ dɛmaa nnaennaen.

english_verse: You would rather do evil than good, and tell lies than speak the truth.
translation_verse: Wɔ nye gye bɔne nwo tra paa, yeɛ ekuro anoanupɛlɛ tra nahorɛhanɛ. Sela

english_verse: You love to say cruel things, and your words are a trap.
translation_verse: Wɔ, nnakannaka sona, wɔ nye gye edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ ɔsɛkye sona dumaa nwo.

english_verse: God will destroy you forever! He will grab you and drag you from your homes. You will be uprooted and left to die.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ kobubu wɔ kogua berɛ afebɔɔ; ɔkɔpra wɔ boso kɔhwe wɔ kofi wɔ tena sua nu; okotu wɔ bo kofi teasefoɛ aseɛ so. Sela

english_verse: When good people see this fearsome sight, they will laugh and say,
translation_verse: Teneneefoɛ konwu ye kɔma bɛ nwo kodwiri bɛ, bɛkɔsere bɔnefoɛ ná bahã kyɛ,

english_verse: “Just look at them now! Instead of trusting God, they trusted their wealth and their cruelty.”
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔnea sona bɔ wamva Nyameɛ wanyɛ ye afealeɛ, na mmom ɔfale ye wora wurale ye anwonya worawora nu, ná ɔfale ye nwo tole ye agyapadeɛ so ne!”

english_verse: But I am like an olive tree growing in God's house, and I can count on his love forever and ever.
translation_verse: Nakoso me de, nde kyɛ olive bakaa monɛ wɔ Nyameɛ awuro; me wora wura Nyameɛ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne anu afebɔɔ.

english_verse: I will always thank God for what he has done; I will praise his good name when his people meet.
translation_verse: Ɔnate bɔ ayɔ ne ati, ngɔla wɔ ase daa. Ngɔfa me wora ngowura wɔ dumaa nu wɔ w’anwoteefoɛ mɔ nyunu, ofikyɛ ɔte paa.

english_verse: Only a fool would say, “There is no God!” People like that are worthless! They are heartless and cruel and never do right.
translation_verse: Kwaseaa kã ye wɔ ye ti anu kyɛ, “Nyameɛ biala nne berɛ.” Belle adwene paa, na amumuyɛɛ bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ yeɛ bɛyɔ ɔ, ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ.

english_verse: From heaven God looks down to see if anyone is wise enough to search for him.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ to ye nye fi nyameɛso ɔnea kuro mmenia, kyɛ aso okonwu ebie bɔ ɔse nworɛ, bɔ ɔpena Nyameɛ si atee ɔ.

english_verse: But all of them are crooked and corrupt. Not one of them does right.
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa bali makyebu, bɛ mukoraa adwene paa ɔnne bɛ ti anu, bɛ nu biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ; daabi, ko po nne berɛ.

english_verse: Won't you lawbreakers learn? You refuse to pray, and you gobble up the people of God.
translation_verse: Aso nimdeɛ abɔ amumuyɛɛfoɛ anaa? Bɛ yeɛ bedi me maen aminɛ kyɛ bedi aleɛ ne ala, ná bɛmbena Nyameɛ si atee ɔ.

english_verse: But you will be terrified worse than ever before. God will scatter the bones of his enemies, and you will be ashamed when God rejects you.
translation_verse: Berɛ yeɛ esuronyi kandinga kɔtɔ bɛ so ɔ, esuronyi bɔ ebie ɔhhane bɛ le ɔ. Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛko betia wɔ ne, Nyameɛ kɔto bɛ mmowue kɔpete, ɛkɔma bɛ nyunu kogua ase, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ aye ye sa wafi bɛ bo.

english_verse: I long for someone from Zion to come and save Israel! Our God, when you bless your people again, Jacob's family will be glad, and Israel will celebrate.
translation_verse: Ao, ahaa né Yisrael ngoalelɛ wafi Sion wawa! Na sɛ Nyameɛ ma ye maen bɛ sa kã b’agyapadeɛ bieku a, Yakob koli ahurusi, na Yisrael nye kɔgye.

english_verse: Save me, God, by your power and prove that I am right.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, fa wɔ dumaa pepɛ de me, ná fa wɔ tumi di me dwirɛ ma me.

english_verse: Listen to my prayer and hear what I say.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, tie me mbaeɛ; yɛ asoɛ tie me noa dwirɛ.

english_verse: Cruel strangers have attacked and want me dead. Not one of them cares about you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ badwɔso batia me, atianuserɛfoɛ bɛpena me beku me; bɛmva Nyameɛ bɛnyɛ huu. Sela

english_verse: You will help me, Lord God, and keep me from falling;
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte me bokafoɛ ɔ; AWURADE yeɛ me kra wura ye sa ɔ.

english_verse: you will punish my enemies for their evil deeds. Be my faithful friend and destroy them.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔfa me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ bɔne kotua bɛ so kerɛ. Wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ti, nua bɛ boso.

english_verse: I will bring a gift and offer a sacrifice to you, Lord. I will praise your name because you are good.
translation_verse: Ngɔbɔ akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ ngɔma wɔ. Ao AWURADE, ngɔfa asennaa ngɔma wɔ dumaa, ofikyɛ ɔte paa.

english_verse: You have rescued me from all my troubles, and my own eyes have seen my enemies fall.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wapepɛ wale me wafi amaneɛ amukoraa nu, na mafa me nye manwu me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ ngoguo.

english_verse: Listen, God, to my prayer! Don't reject my request.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, yɛ asoɛ tie me mbaeɛ; nnɛma m’abisadeɛ ogua wɔ so asi.

english_verse: Please listen and help me. My thoughts are troubled, and I keep groaning
translation_verse: Tie me, ná bua me; m’amaneɛnwunɛ abungam afa me so. Mahɔ ateetee nu,

english_verse: because my enemies attack with loud shouts. They treat me terribly and hold angry grudges.
translation_verse: ɔnate me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ dede ne ati, ɔne bɔnefoɛ mɔ bɛ ndaneanyeɛ ne ati. Ofikyɛ bɛmaa menwu amaneɛ, na bele ɛyaa bɛpɔ me.

english_verse: My heart is racing fast, and I am afraid of dying.
translation_verse: M’ahone di aworabɔlɛ wɔ me nu, ewue nwo suronyi atɔ me so.

english_verse: I am trembling with fear, completely terrified.
translation_verse: Esuronyi ne ahunundetelɛ atɔ me so, na ɛserɛ akyekye me.

english_verse: I wish I had wings like a dove, so I could fly far away and be at peace.
translation_verse: Me dwirɛ ole kyɛ, “Ahaa né manya ndaa te kyɛ abubure! Ahaa ngotu ngɔɔpena nekaa bie ngɔtena;

english_verse: I would go and live in some distant desert.
translation_verse: nahorɛ nu, ahaa ngɔnwati ngɔhɔ dedeede, ná maatena ɛserɛ so. Sela

english_verse: I would quickly find shelter from howling winds and raging storms.
translation_verse: Ahaa nne amirika ngɔɔpena nekaa ngɔbɔ me nwo adwaa ngofi mvrama ne mvrama piri bɔ otu ne anu.”

english_verse: Confuse my enemies, Lord! Upset their plans. Cruelty and violence are all I see in the city,
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, sɛkye bɛ porɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ɔ, ma bɛ noa ɔto fofo, ofikyɛ kyɛ menwu basabasayɔlɛ ne ngondiihonɛ wɔ kuro ne anu.

english_verse: and they are like guards on patrol day and night. The city is full of trouble, evil,
translation_verse: Eyia ne kɔngɔen bɛnate fasue nemɔ aso bɛpɛ kuro ne anwo bɛbra beyia, na amumuyɛɛ ne amaneɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ kuro ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: and corruption. Troublemakers and liars freely roam the streets.
translation_verse: Nningyein ayɛ basaa wɔ kuro ne anu; ndaneanyeɛ ne asisie ye bo ndu mvi kuro berɛ dwaaso.

english_verse: My enemies are not the ones who sneer and make fun. I could put up with that or even hide from them.
translation_verse: Nna me pɔfoɛ yeɛ ɔkã me anyinga ɔ, ɛhene de, ahaa ngɔhora ye noa gyina; nna sona bɔ okyi me yeɛ ɔbɔ me alapaa ɔ, ye de, ahaa ngɔhora ngɔfa me nwo ngɔfea ye.

english_verse: But it was my closest friend, the one I trusted most.
translation_verse: Na mmom wɔ bɔ ɛte me tipɛen ɔ, mmiɛngo bɔ me ne wɔ kɔ ba ɔ,

english_verse: We enjoyed being together, when we went with others to your house, our God.
translation_verse: wɔ bɔ né me ne wɔ yɛtu nu paa ɔ; bɔ né me ne wɔ yɛbɔ nu yɛnate wɔ Nyameɛ awuro ɔ.

english_verse: All who hate me are controlled by the power of evil. Sentence them to death and send them down alive to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ma ewue ɔte pe bɛ so; maa bɛhɔ ɛborɔ anyekaenn so, ofikyɛ bɔne wɔ b’awuro ne b’afia.

english_verse: I ask for your help, Lord God, and you will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Na me de, mesu mefrɛ Nyameɛ, na AWURADE kɔpepɛ kole me.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night you hear my concerns and my complaints.
translation_verse: Nɔsoa, ngyerɛmɔ ne eyia, mekã me yealɛ mesu, na okotie me mbaeɛ.

english_verse: I am attacked from all sides, but you will rescue me unharmed by the battle.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔpepɛ kole me kra kofi koɛ bɔ bafa batoa me ye anu, ofikyɛ mmenia pee badwɔso batia me.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you will hear me. You will defeat my enemies because they won't turn and worship you.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bɔ odi hene fi tete ne, okotie me, ná wali bɛ so ngonim, ofikyɛ bɛnzakyera b’adwene, na benzuro Nyameɛ. Sela

english_verse: My friend turned against me and broke his promise.
translation_verse: Mmiɛngo ne, odwɔso tiale ye mmango nemɔ, na obuli ye apam ne aso,

english_verse: His words were smoother than butter, and softer than olive oil. But hatred filled his heart, and he was ready to attack with a sword.
translation_verse: ye noa dwirɛ te menemene tra woɛ, nakoso koɛ nwo adwene yeɛ ɔwɔ ye ti anu ɔ; ye noa nu dwirɛ te bɛtɛɛ kyɛ aloko, nakoso edwirɛ ne te ngrandɛ bɔ bahwe ɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, we belong to you. We tell you what worries us, and you won't let us fall.
translation_verse: Fa w’adesoa to AWURADE so, na ɔkɔsɔ wɔ nu; ɔngɔnea ngɔma teneneeniɛ ngofi ase.

english_verse: But what about those people who are cruel and brutal? You will throw them down into the deepest pit long before their time. I trust you, Lord!
translation_verse: Nakoso wɔ, ao Nyameɛ, ekofindi bɛ kogua ewue kumaa ne abo dɔ; kodiawufoɛ ne ngondombofoɛ de, bengoli b’aseɛ ye aso ngoa ye bue po. Nakoso me de, mefa me wora mewura wɔ nu.

english_verse: Have pity, God Most High! My enemies chase me all day.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, nwu me anwumvoin, ofikyɛ mmenia bɛpena me beku me. Mmerɛ biala me pɔfoɛ mɔ tane me nye,

english_verse: but even when I am afraid, I keep on trusting you.
translation_verse: Sɛ esuronyi tɔ me so a, mefa me wora mewura wɔ nu.

english_verse: I praise your promises! I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bɔ meye ye dwirɛ ne ayɛ ne, Nyameɛ yeɛ mefa me wora mewura ye nu ɔ, yiti menzuro hwee; nzikyɛ yeɛ kuro sona kɔhora kɔfa kɔyɔ me ɔ?

english_verse: Enemies spend the whole day finding fault with me; all they think about is how to do me harm.
translation_verse: Daa biala bɛpena kyɛ me noa tɔ, me nwo porɛ alaa yeɛ bɛbɔ ɔ.

english_verse: They attack from ambush, watching my every step and hoping to kill me.
translation_verse: Bɛboa bɛ noa, bɛtetɛ me; beli me mvanvando, na bɛpena me ne ewue.

english_verse: They won't get away with these crimes, God, because when you get angry, you destroy people.
translation_verse: Yiti tua bɛ bɔne so kerɛ; ao Nyameɛ, fɛ ɛyaa, ná bɔ maen maen nemɔ!

english_verse: You have kept record of my days of wandering. You have stored my tears in your bottle and counted each of them.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ anwu aworabɔlɛ worawora bɔ medi ɔ, fa wɔ towaa ne sɔ me nye moen. Aso ɔnne wɔ ngrataa nu anaa?

english_verse: When I pray, Lord God, my enemies will retreat, because I know for certain that you are with me.
translation_verse: Na afei kyẽa bɔ ngosu ngɔfrɛ wɔ ne, me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛkɔtete bekosa. Mese ye sɔ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ gyi me si.

english_verse: I trust you and am not afraid. No one can harm me.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ yeɛ mefa me wora mewura ye nu ɔ, yiti menzuro hwee; nzikyɛ yeɛ kuro sona kɔhora kɔfa kɔyɔ me ɔ?

english_verse: I will keep my promises to you, my God, and bring you gifts.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, odi kyɛ metua m’aboadeɛ mema wɔ. Ngɔbɔ asennaa afɔleɛ ngɔma wɔ.

english_verse: You protected me from death and kept me from stumbling, so that I would please you and follow the light that leads to life.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ apepɛ ale me kra afi ewue nu, yeɛ amma manzoti mamvi ase, amaa ɔnate so manate Nyameɛ nyunu, wɔ ngoa kanea ne anu.

english_verse: God Most High, have pity on me! Have mercy. I run to you for safety. In the shadow of your wings, I seek protection till danger dies down.
translation_verse: Nwu me anwumvoin, ao Nyameɛ, nwu me anwumvoin, ofikyɛ wɔ nu yeɛ me kra nwati bafea ɔ; wɔ ndaa ne abo fɔnwoo ne anu yeɛ menwati mebafea ɔ, kɔpem kyɛ asetena nu mvrama piri ne abo kɔpɛ nu kɔhɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You will send help from heaven and save me, but you will bring trouble on my attackers. You are faithful, and you can be trusted.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔsoma kofi nyameɛso kɔɔpepɛ kole me, na bɛ bɔ bɛpena me beku me ne, okogua bɛ nyunu ase. Sela Nyameɛ kɔsoma ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔne ye nahorɛlilɛ ne.

english_verse: My enemies are fierce, much worse than lions! They have spears and arrows instead of teeth, and they have sharp swords instead of tongues.
translation_verse: Gyata mɔ yeɛ me kra la b’afia ɔ. Bɛ gye te pealɛɛ ne agyaen, bɛ temverema te ngrandɛ nnaennaen.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, kyire kyɛbɔ esi te piri ɔ wɔ anwuro anwuro! Ma w’animnyam kata aseɛ ye aso amukoraa.

english_verse: Enemies set traps for my feet and struck me down. They dug a pit in my path, but fell in it themselves.
translation_verse: Basua me ngaen, me kra wora abɔ. Betuli kumaa wɔ m’atee nu, nakoso bapɛ bɛ nwo batete bagua nu. Sela

english_verse: I am faithful to you, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you, my God.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, m’ahone asiesie ye nwo, m’ahone asiesie ye nwo! Ngɔto dwein ngɔye wɔ ayɛ.

english_verse: I feel wide awake! I will wake up my harp and wake up the sun.
translation_verse: M’animnyam, tingye! Sangoo ne adengum, ɛ́mɔtingye! Me koso ngotingye alebahyene.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear, and I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ngɔfa asennaa ngɔma wɔ wɔ maen maen mɔ nu; ngɔto wɔ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein wɔ maen nemɔ anu.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens; your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ye piri kɔka ewienu dɔ paa, yeɛ wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne, okodwu munungum nemɔ anu.

english_verse: May you, my God, be honored above the heavens; may your glory be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, kyire kyɛbɔ esi te piri ɔ wɔ anwuro anwuro. Ma w’animnyam kata aseɛ so amukoraa.

english_verse: Do you mighty people talk only to oppose justice? Don't you ever judge fairly?
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, tumifoɛ mɔ, edwirɛ bɔ ɛmɔka ne, aso ɔtengyɛ? Ao kuro mmenia, aso ɛmɔbua ndɛen turoloo?

english_verse: You have done wrong and lied from the day you were born.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ befi bɛ ni akunu yeɛ bedi makyebu ɔ; befi b’aworɛ nu yeɛ bɛyɔ mvomsoɛ ɔ, na bɛnga nahorɛ.

english_verse: Your words spread poison like the bite of a cobra
translation_verse: Bɛ noa borɔ te kyɛ ewoo deɛ ne ala, bɛte kyɛ ɛbɔnaa asotiniwaa bɔ watuatua ye so,

english_verse: My enemies are fierce as lions, Lord God! Shatter their teeth. Snatch out their fangs.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, bubu bɛ gye bɔ ogua bɛ noa nu ɔ, ao AWURADE, tutu gyata akrɔngrɔma nemɔ bɛ gye!

english_verse: Make them disappear like leaking water, and make their arrows miss.
translation_verse: Maa betu bemini kyɛ nzue bɔ ɔse ɔ, maa betiatia bɛ so, ná bɛkese kyɛ ɛserɛ.

english_verse: Let them dry up like snails or be like a child that dies before seeing the sun.
translation_verse: Maa bɛyɛ kyɛ ebuhye bɔ ɔporɔ wɔ ye konguroma nu ɔ, kyɛ baa bɔ bapɔ ye, bɔ wannwu eyia le ɔ.

english_verse: Wipe them out quicker than a pot can be heated by setting thorns on fire.
translation_verse: Ole ɛyaa kɔpra teasefoɛ kɔhɔ kyɛ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ, na ɔkɔyɔ sɔ ndɛndɛ kɔtra kyɛbɔ wɔ kukue bɔ ogyi mmowue see so ɔ okosi kɔyɛ hye ɔ.

english_verse: Good people will be glad when they see the wicked getting what they deserve, and they will wash their feet in their enemies' blood.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ nwu kyɛ batɔ bɔnefoɛ so wereɛ a, ye nye gye; okonwunzi ye gya bo wɔ bɔnefoɛ mogya nu.

english_verse: Everyone will say, “It's true! Good people are rewarded. God does indeed rule the earth with justice.”
translation_verse: Mmenia kɔhã kyɛ, “Amba, akatuaa wɔ berɛ ma teneneefoɛ; amba, Nyameɛ bɔ obua ndɛen wɔ aseɛ ye aso ne, ɔwɔ berɛ.”

english_verse: Keep me safe from brutal people who want to kill me.
translation_verse: Pepɛ de me fi amumuyɛɛfoɛ mɔ sa nu, ná de me ngoa fi kodiawufoɛ bɛ sa nu.

english_verse: Merciless enemies, Lord, are hiding and plotting, hoping to kill me. I have not hurt them in any way at all.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nndole mmeraa biala, yeɛ nnyɔle bɔne biala, nakoso kekesaala ye po, bɛtetɛ me beku me; nzɛmmɔnefoɛ bɛboa bɛ noa bɛbɔ me ti so porɛ.

english_verse: But they are ready to attack. Do something! Help me! Look at what's happening.
translation_verse: Nnyɔle tɛɛ biala, nakoso bɛpena me bepura me. Dwɔso baanea me ná boka me!

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you are the God of Israel. Punish the other nations and don't pity those terrible and rebellious people.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ, ɛte Yisrael Nyameɛ. Dwɔso twe maen maen amukoraa bɛ so; amumuyɛɛfoɛ nnakannakafoɛ ne, nnɛma bɛ nu biala fa ye nwo di tɔtorɔtɔɔ. Sela

english_verse: My enemies return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Nɔsoa biala besa bɛba, bepo kyɛ ngyea, na bekyini kuro ne anu bɛbra beyia.

english_verse: They curse, and their words cut like swords, as they say to themselves, “No one can hear us!”
translation_verse: Tie, edwirɛ mbiri mbiri bɔ bele bɛ noa bɛkekã ɔ, edwirɛ yealɛ bɔ otua bɛ noa ɔ, B’adwene ole kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔte yɛ nga ɔ.”

english_verse: You, Lord, laugh at them and sneer at the nations.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE, wɔ de, ɛsere bɛ, na ɛgoro maen maen amukoraa bɛ nwo.

english_verse: You are my mighty fortress, and I depend on you.
translation_verse: Ao m’anwoserɛ, me nye la wɔ so, ofikyɛ ao Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You love me and will let me see my enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Ɔnate me Nyameɛ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, ɔkɔɔboka me; me Nyameɛ koli me pɔfoɛ mɔ so ngonim maa ngonwu ye.

english_verse: Don't kill them, or everyone may forget! Just use your mighty power to make them tremble and fall. You are a shield for your people.
translation_verse: Nnɛkũkũ bɛ: ɔba ye sɔ a, me maen bɛ wora kofi; fa wɔ tumi maa bɛbɔ asesa, ná brɛ bɛ ase; ao AWURADE, ɛte y’akokyɛm.

english_verse: Get angry and destroy them. Leave them in ruin. Then all the nations will know that you rule in Israel.
translation_verse: fɛ bɛ so yaa kũkũ bɛ; kũkũ bɛ ma bɛ boso onua. Na ɛhe kɔmaa ofi aseɛ ti kɔka ye ti, mmenia konwu kyɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ odi Yakob so hene ɔ. Sela

english_verse: Those liars return at evening, growling like dogs roaming the city.
translation_verse: Nɔsoa biala besa bɛba, bepo kyɛ ngyea, na bekyini kuro ne anu.

english_verse: They search for scraps of food, and they snarl until they are stuffed.
translation_verse: Bekyini bɛpena aleɛ, na sɛ bɛ ko anyi a, bɛyɛ dede.

english_verse: But I will sing about your strength, my God, and I will celebrate because of your love. You are my fortress, my place of protection in times of trouble.
translation_verse: Nakoso me de, ngɔto w’anwoserɛ nwo dwein; na ngyerɛmɔ ngɔto wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne anwo dwein. Ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne m’amaneɛnwunɛ kyẽa nu afealeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I will sing your praises! You are my mighty fortress, and you love me.
translation_verse: Ao m’anwoserɛ, ngɔto dwein ngɔye wɔ ayɛ, ofikyɛ ao Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ɔ, Nyameɛ bɔ ɔye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ali kyire me ɔ.

english_verse: You, God, are angry with us! We are rejected and crushed. Make us strong again!
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, apo yɛ, abɔ yɛ asande; afɛ yaa, ao yɛsrɛ wɔ, maa yɛpe yɛ daa nu!

english_verse: You made the earth shake and split wide open; now heal its wounds and stop its trembling.
translation_verse: Ama aseɛ awoso, adwa aseɛ nu; fa ye nekaa bɔ wadwudwa nemɔ siesie ye nye, ofikyɛ ɔkekã.

english_verse: You brought hard times on your people, and you gave us wine that made us stagger.
translation_verse: Ama amaneɛ paa yeɛ wato wɔ maen ɔ, ama yɛ nzaa maa yano bɔ yɛnate fofalifofali ɔ.

english_verse: You gave a signal to those who worship you, so they could escape from enemy arrows.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ ne, asi frangaa ama bɛ, kyɛ bɛfa behyire, ɔnate nahorɛ ti. Sela

english_verse: Answer our prayers, God! Use your powerful arm and give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná ɛkɔpepɛ kole bɛ bɔ ekuro bɛ dwirɛ ne ati, fa wɔ sa famaa ne de yɛ ngoa, ná tie yɛ.

english_verse: Our God, you solemnly promised, “I would gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ ahã ye wɔ ye nekaa krongron berɛ kyɛ, “Ngoli ahurusi, ngɔhyehyɛ Sɛkem nu, na ngosusu Sukote bɔnza ne.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is the symbol of my royal power.
translation_verse: Gileade te me deɛ, yeɛ Manase koso te me deɛ; Efraim te me buralɛ kyerɛ; Yuda te me hɔtɔ.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin. Edom belongs to me, and I shout in triumph over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Moabo te me nyanzɛen, Edom so yeɛ mefindi me mbaboa megua ɔ; na Filistia so yeɛ mebɔ ngonimlilɛ ese ɔ.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress, or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Kuro bɔ bato ye nwo fasue ne, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔfa me kɔhɔ so ɔ? Nwa yeɛ odi me nyunu fa me kɔ Edom ɔ?

english_verse: Have you rejected us and deserted our armies?
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, aso ɛppole yɛ anaa? Ao Nyameɛ, aso ɛyyakyili yɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ bɛ si gyinalɛ anaa?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Ao, boka yɛ de yɛ fi amaneɛ nu, ofikyɛ kuro sona mmokalɛ te mbaen!

english_verse: You will give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Sɛ AWURADE boka yɛ so a, yɛkoli ngonim; ye yeɛ okotiatia yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: Please listen, God, and answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, tie me sufrɛ, tie me mbaeɛ.

english_verse: I feel hopeless, and I cry out to you from a faraway land. Lead me to the mighty rock high above me.
translation_verse: Sɛ m’abasa nu bu a, mvi aseɛ noa dɔ yeɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ ɔ. Di me nyunu fa me kɔ nyɔbotaen bɔ ɔwale tra me ne anwo,

english_verse: You are a strong tower, where I am safe from my enemies.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’afealeɛ ɔ, abandenden serɛserɛ bɔ ɔko tia me pɔfoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Let me live with you forever and find protection under your wings, my God.
translation_verse: Ngɔtena wɔ tena sua ne anu afebɔɔ, ná manya afealeɛ wɔ wɔ ndaa bo fɔnwoo ne abo. Sela

english_verse: You heard my promises, and you have blessed me, just as you bless everyone who worships you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ, Nyameɛ, ate me bɔhyɛ ne, bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ dumaa ne, afa b’agyapadeɛ ama me.

english_verse: Let the king have a long and healthy life.
translation_verse: Ma ɛhene ne ye ngoa ɔyɛ tendenn, na ye afoɛ mɔ ɔyɛ tendenn oodwu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu!

english_verse: May he always rule with you, God, at his side; may your love and loyalty watch over him.
translation_verse: Maa oli bia afebɔɔ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu; ma ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔne nahorɛlilɛ bɛbɔ ye nwo waen!

english_verse: I will sing your praises forever, God, and will always keep my promises.
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔto wɔ dumaa nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein daa, ná matua m’aboadeɛ daa biala.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe and the fortress where I am secure.
translation_verse: Ye ngome yeɛ ɔte me nyɔbotaen ne me ngoalelɛ ɔ, m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ɛne; hwee ngopusu me.

english_verse: I feel like a shaky fence or a sagging wall. How long will all of you attack and assault me?
translation_verse: Ɔkwaadwu kyinzu yeɛ ɛmɔkotu ɛmɔ nye bekosie sona horɛ so ɔ, bɔ ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔpena ye beku ye ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔdwiri fasue bɔ wahyea ɔ begua ase ɔ.

english_verse: You want to bring me down from my place of honor. You love to tell lies, and when your words are kind, hatred hides in your heart.
translation_verse: Bɛ botaeɛ ala ole kyɛ bekotu ye bekofi bia so ɔ. Bɛ nye gye ngondombo nwo; bɛfa bɛ noa beyira sona, nakoso bɛ ti anu de, bɛnoma ye. Sela

english_verse: Only God gives inward peace, and I depend on him.
translation_verse: Me kra, Nyameɛ ngome yeɛ ma wɔ nye ɔla ye so ɔ, na ye berɛ yeɛ m’anyelasoɛ fi ba ɔ.

english_verse: God alone is the mighty rock that keeps me safe, and he is the fortress where I feel secure.
translation_verse: Ye ngome yeɛ ɔte me nyɔbotaen ne me ngoalelɛ ɔ, m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ɛne; hwee ngopusu me.

english_verse: God saves me and honors me. He is that mighty rock where I find safety.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ sa nu yeɛ me ngoalelɛ ne m’animnyam wɔ ɔ; Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte m’afealeɛ ɔ; me nyɔbotaen bɔ ɔma me anwoserɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Trust God, my friends, and always tell him each of your concerns. God is our place of safety.
translation_verse: Ao kuro mmenia, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛ nwo bɛto ye so mmerɛ biala, ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ ahiasɛm bɛto ye nyunu, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ te y’afealeɛ. Sela

english_verse: We humans are only a breath; none of us are truly great. All of us together weigh less than a puff of air.
translation_verse: Adasa mmaa te mvrama, yeɛ kuro mmenia te nnakannaka nikye; sɛ bɛkari bɛ wɔ tonyi so a, bɛ nu nyɛ no, sɛ ɛfa bɛ munyɔ bɔ nu a, bɛ nu yɛ nyera tra mvrama.

english_verse: Don't trust in violence or depend on dishonesty or rely on great wealth.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bɛto apoobɔlɛ so, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔ nye gye awue nwo; sɛ ɛmɔ anwonyadeɛ sone po a, nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɛ nwo bɛto so.

english_verse: I heard God say two things: “I am powerful,
translation_verse: Nyameɛ dwudwole komapɛ, na mate ye pɛen nyɔ so kyɛ, Tumi te Nyameɛ deɛ’.

english_verse: and I am very kind.” The Lord rewards each of us according to what we do.
translation_verse: Na wɔ, ao AWURADE, ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne te wɔ deɛ, na etua sona biala kerɛ kyɛbɔ ye nnwumaa te ɔ.

english_verse: You are my God. I worship you. In my heart, I long for you, as I would long for a stream in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Nyameɛ ɔ, mepena wɔ serɛserɛ; me kra wora adɔ wɔ, me nwonaen ayɛ hodwoo ɔpena wɔ kyɛ aseɛ wosee katerepee bɔ ɔpena nzue ɔ.

english_verse: I have seen your power and your glory in the place of worship.
translation_verse: Amba, manwu wɔ wɔ nekaa krongron berɛ, bɔ menea wɔ tumi ne w’animnyam ɔ.

english_verse: Your love means more than life to me, and I praise you.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔte paa tra ngoa; ye sɔ ati, me noa kɔye wɔ ayɛ.

english_verse: I will sing joyful praises and be filled with excitement like a guest at a banquet.
translation_verse: Me kra ko koyi kyɛ ama ye aleɛ bɔ ɔyɛ fɛ ne bɔ naen bɔ walɔ ɔ, na ngɔfa me noa ngɔto ahurusi dwein ngɔye wɔ ayɛ.

english_verse: I think about you, God, before I go to sleep, and my thoughts turn to you during the night.
translation_verse: Sɛ mekaye wɔ wɔ me bɛen so a, medwenedwene wɔ nwo abunnamu;

english_verse: You have helped me, and I sing happy songs in the shadow of your wings.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte me bokafoɛ ɔ, na wɔ ndaa ne abo fɔnwoo ne anu yeɛ medi ahurusi ɔ.

english_verse: I stay close to you, and your powerful arm supports me.
translation_verse: Me kra te mata wɔ, wɔ sa famaa ne tira me nu.

english_verse: All who want to kill me will end up in the ground.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛpena me kra beku ye ne, bɛkɔhɔ aseɛ bo dɔ kumaa nu’.

english_verse: Swords will run them through, and wild dogs will eat them.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa, na bɛkɔyɛ ɛserɛ so ngyea bɛ naen.

english_verse: Because of you, our God, the king will celebrate with your faithful followers, but liars will be silent.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛhene ne koli ahurusi wɔ Nyameɛ nu; na ebiala bɔ ɔfa ye dumaa ta ndaen ne, ɔkɔhoahoa ye nwo, ofikyɛ bɛkɔhã ngondombofoɛ noa bɛkɔto nu.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns, God, and protect me from my enemies' threats.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, tie me mbaeɛ wɔ me dwirɛ yealɛ bɔ mekã ye anu; bɔ me ngoa nwo waen fi me pɔfoɛ nwo suronyi nu.

english_verse: Their words cut like swords, and their cruel remarks sting like sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Bɛ yeɛ besi bɛ noa kyɛ ngrandɛ, besina bɛ noa dwirɛ yeayea kyɛ agyaen;

english_verse: They are determined to do evil, and they tell themselves, “Let's set traps! No one can see us.”
translation_verse: Bɛhyehyɛ bɛ nwo nguraen wɔ bɔneyɔlɛ nu, bɛbɔ porɛ besua mmenia ngaen wɔ mvealeɛ nu, na bɛdwene kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ okonwu yɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: They make evil plans and say, “We'll commit a perfect crime. No one knows our thoughts.”
translation_verse: Bɛpena amumuyɛɛ bɛyɔ, na bɛbɔ mmɔden bɛyɔ amumuyɛɛ ne. Nahorɛ nu, kuro sona ti anu adwene, ɔne adwene nu nzusuleɛ bɛ nu pi!

english_verse: But God will shoot his arrows and quickly wound them.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ kɔto ye agyaen ne kɔwɔ bɛ, na bekopura mvum nu.

english_verse: They will be destroyed by their own words, and everyone who sees them will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Bɛ noa dwirɛ ti, ɔkɔmaa amaneɛ kɔto bɛ, na ebiala bɔ okonwu bɛ ne, ye nwo kodwiri ye.

english_verse: They will be afraid and say, “Look at what God has done and keep it all in mind.”
translation_verse: Afei ɛserɛ kɔtɔ mmenia amukoraa so, na bɛkɔbɔ bɔ Nyameɛ wayɔ ɔ nwo dawure, ná badwene bɔ wayɔ ɔ nwo.

english_verse: May the Lord bless his people with peace and happiness and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɛ bekoli ahurusi wɔ AWURADE nu, na bɛkɔbɔ bɛ nwo adwaa wɔ ye nu. Bɛ bɔ b’ahone nu te sannwuu ne, bɛkɔhoahoa bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Our God, you deserve praise in Zion, where we keep our promises to you.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, ayɛyelɛ fata wɔ wɔ Sion, na wɔ yeɛ bekotua aboadeɛ bɛkɔma wɔ ɔ’.

english_verse: Everyone will come to you because you answer prayer.
translation_verse: Ao, wɔ bɔ etie mbaeɛ ɔ, wɔ berɛ yeɛ mmenia amukoraa bɛkɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: When our sins get us down, you forgive us.
translation_verse: Sɛ m’amumuyɛɛ bungam fa me so a, wɔ yeɛ ekyikyi m’amumuyɛɛ efi me so ɔ.

english_verse: You bless your chosen ones, and you invite them to live near you in your temple. We will enjoy your house, the sacred temple.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ ɛneanea nu ɛtwe bɛ bata wɔ nwo, kyɛ bɛɛtena w’abrannaa nu ne, benya saleɛ. W’awuro bɔ yeɛ ole w’asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron ne, nu nningyein paa ne, ɔma yɛ nwo tɔ yɛ.

english_verse: Our God, you save us, and your fearsome deeds answer our prayers for justice! You give hope to people everywhere on earth, even those across the sea.
translation_verse: Ɛnate anwanwadeɛ nningyein bɔ ɔtengyɛ so ɛma yɛ mmuayɛɛ; ao yɛ ngoalelɛ Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ ɛte anyelasoɛ ma aseɛ ti kɔka ye ti amukoraa, ɔne ɛpo nziɛ nziɛ dɔ paa ɔ.

english_verse: You are strong, and your mighty power put the mountains in place.
translation_verse: W’anwoserɛ yeɛ ɔfale mmokaa penapenane berɛ ɔ, afa tumi abɔ abɔsoɛ.

english_verse: You silence the roaring waves and the noisy shouts of the nations.
translation_verse: Ɛpo bɔ obu fa so ne, ye asorɔkye wuruwuru ne, ɔne maen maen mɔ bagyabagyayɛle ne, ɛmaa bɛyɛ konn.

english_verse: People far away marvel at your fearsome deeds, and all who live under the sun celebrate and sing because of you.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛte aseɛ noa dɔ dedeede ne, wɔ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ma ɛserɛ tɔ bɛ so. Ɛma eyia afiteleɛ ne eyia atɔleɛ maen maen mɔ bele ahurusi bɛbɔ ese.

english_verse: You take care of the earth and send rain to help the soil grow all kinds of crops. Your rivers never run dry, and you prepare the earth to produce abundant grain.
translation_verse: Ɛba bapasa aseɛ ye anwo, na eguagua so nzue, ɛmaa nningyein paa ba so. Nyameɛ asue ne, nzue ayi ye to, ɛmaa yɛnya aleɛ yɛdi, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ahyehyɛ ye sɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You water all its fields and level the lumpy ground. You send showers of rain to soften the soil and help the plants sprout.
translation_verse: Ɛtɔ nzue gua ye ngofie nemɔ aso, na etuatua aseɛ ngumaa nemɔ; ɛma bosue doadoa aseɛ ne aso maa ɔyɛ mmerɛ, na eyira so nningyein maa ɔyɛ yé.

english_verse: Meadows are filled with sheep and goats; valleys overflow with grain and echo with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Nekaa bɔ ngaka didi nemɔ, mmoaen ayi so tɛkyɛ, bɔnza nemɔ anu, aburoo ayi bɛ nu tɛkyɛ, na bɛbɔ ese bɛto dwein bedi ahurusi.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to shout praises to God!
translation_verse: Aseɛ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔfa ahurusi bɛbɔ Nyameɛ nwo ese; ɛ́mɔto ye dumaa nwo animnyam dwein;

english_verse: Sing about his glorious name. Honor him with praises.
translation_verse: ɛ́mɔfa ayɛyelɛ bɔ animnyam wɔ nu ɔ bɛ́ma ye.

english_verse: Say to God, “Everything you do is fearsome, and your mighty power makes your enemies come crawling.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhã behyire Nyameɛ kyɛ, “Wɔ nnwumaa yɛ nwanwa! Ɔnate wɔ tumi kandinga ne ati, wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ koto wɔ gya bo.

english_verse: You are worshiped by everyone! We all sing praises to you.”
translation_verse: Aseɛ so nikyee biala sɔne wɔ; bɛto wɔ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein, bɛto wɔ dumaa nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein.” Sela

english_verse: Come and see the fearsome things our God has done!
translation_verse: Ɛmɔbra bɛɛnea bɔ AWURADE ayɔ ɔ: ye nnwumaa bɔ ɔyɔ ye adasa mmaa nu ne, ɔyɛ suro.

english_verse: When God made the sea dry up, our people walked across, and because of him, we celebrated there.
translation_verse: Ɔmane ɛpo kakyili aseɛ wosee maa bɛnatele bɛ gya kunu bɛpɛle nzue ne. Berɛ yeɛ yɛlili ahurusi wɔ ye nu ɔ,

english_verse: His mighty power rules forever, and nothing the nations do can be hidden from him. So don't turn against God.
translation_verse: ye yeɛ ɔfa ye tumi ne di hene afebɔɔ ɔ, ye yeɛ ye nye kɔ aporɔ wɔ wiase amukoraa ɔ, nnɛma ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ bɛmoma bɛ nwo so. Sela

english_verse: All of you people, come praise our God! Let his praises be heard.
translation_verse: Ao maen maen, ɛ́mɔye yɛ Nyameɛ ayɛ, ɛ́mɔma mmenia bɛte ayɛyelɛ bɔ ɛmɔye ye ne.

english_verse: God protects us from death and keeps us steady.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ wamaa yɛtɛ boka ateasefoɛ so, bɔ wamma yanzoti ɔ.

english_verse: Our God, you tested us, just as silver is tested.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ, ao Nyameɛ, aso yɛ anea; aso yɛ anea kyɛbɔ bɛpɔ ɛdwetɛ nwo wɔ see nu ɔ.

english_verse: You trapped us in a net and gave us heavy burdens.
translation_verse: Ɛfale yɛ wurale ɛtɛen ne anu, na ɛfale amaneɛnwunɛ adesoa tetale yɛ si.

english_verse: You sent war chariots to crush our skulls. We traveled through fire and through floods, but you brought us to a land of plenty.
translation_verse: Amaa mmenia bahwi bafa yɛ ti so, yɛfale see nu ne nzue nu, nakoso aye yɛ afite afa yɛ awa nekaa bɔ anwonya pee wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I will bring sacrifices into your house, my God, and I will do what I promised
translation_verse: Ngɔfa naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ mɔ ngɔwa w’awuro berɛ; ngotua m’aboadeɛ mɔ ngɔma wɔ,

english_verse: I will sacrifice my best sheep and offer bulls and goats on your altar.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa ngaka bɔ balɔ ɔ ngɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ mɔ ngɔma wɔ, ɔne mmoaen nyii afɔleɛ nwosina. Ngɔbɔ nandwie nyii ne mbɔngye afɔleɛ. Sela

english_verse: All who worship God, come here and listen; I will tell you everything God has done for me.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔsuro Nyameɛ ɔ, ɛmɔbra beetie, na bɔ wayɔ wama me ne, ngɔhã ngohyire ɛmɔ.

english_verse: I prayed to the Lord, and I praised him.
translation_verse: Ndeane nu nzu mvrɛle ye, na mvale me noa ngamvole ye.

english_verse: If my thoughts had been sinful, he would have refused to hear me.
translation_verse: Sɛ ndwenene bɔne nwo wɔ me ti anu a, ahaa AWURADE andie me sufrɛ.

english_verse: But God did listen and answered my prayer.
translation_verse: Nakoso, amba, Nyameɛ atie me; wayɛ asoɛ watie me mbaeɛ.

english_verse: Let's praise God! He listened when I prayed, and he is always kind.
translation_verse: Animnyam hã Nyameɛ ofikyɛ wambo me mbaeɛ, yeɛ wamma ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne wammɔ me.

english_verse: Our God, be kind and bless us! Be pleased and smile.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, nwu yɛ anwumvoin ná yira yɛ, ma wɔ nyunu ɔta hyireinn ma yɛ, Sela

english_verse: Then everyone on earth will learn to follow you, and all nations will see your power to save us.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so banwu w’atee wɔ aseɛ ye aso, ná banwu wɔ ngoalelɛ tumi ne wɔ maen maen amukoraa nu.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, odi kyɛ maen maen bɛye wɔ ayɛ, odi kyɛ maen amukoraa bɛye wɔ ayɛ.

english_verse: Make everyone praise you, God, and shout your praises.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, odi kyɛ maen maen mɔ bɛye wɔ ayɛ, amba, odi kyɛ maen amukoraa bɛye wɔ ayɛ.

english_verse: Our God has blessed the earth with a wonderful harvest!
translation_verse: Aseɛ ahye aleɛ; Nyameɛ, yɛ Nyameɛ ne, wayira yɛ.

english_verse: Pray for his blessings to continue and for everyone on earth to worship our God.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ koyira yɛ, na odi kyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ so nekaa biala besuro ye.

english_verse: Do something, God! Scatter your hateful enemies. Make them turn and run.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ, dwɔso, ná ma wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛbɔ aya; bɛ bɔ bekyi wɔ ne, maa bɛnwati befi wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: But let your people be happy and celebrate because of you.
translation_verse: Nakoso teneneefoɛ de, ma bɛ nye ɔgye, maa beli ahurusi wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu; maa benya anigye mmorosoɛ.

english_verse: Our God, you are the one who rides on the clouds, and we praise you. Your name is the Lord, and we celebrate as we worship you.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔto Nyameɛ nwo dwein, ɛ́mɔto ye dumaa nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein, ɛ́mɔpɛ atimbire bɛ́ma bɔ ɔte nikyee so ɔnate munungum so ne; ye dumaa ole AWURADE, na ɛmɔli ahurusi wɔ ye nyunu.

english_verse: Our God, from your sacred home you take care of orphans and protect widows.
translation_verse: Ayisiaafoɛ baba ne akunafoɛ neafoɛ, ye ole Nyameɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ye atenaleɛ krongron nu ne.

english_verse: You find families for those who are lonely. You set prisoners free and let them prosper, but all who rebel will live in a scorching desert.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔma sona bɔ olle bie ɔ awuro maa ɔtena nu ɔ; ɔye kukunufoɛ fite maa oyie bɛ yé, nakoso ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ de, bɛtena aseɛ katerepee so.

english_verse: You set your people free, and you led them through the desert.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, mmerɛ bɔ elili wɔ maen nyunu, bɔ ɛnate fale ɛserɛ so ne, Sela

english_verse: God of Israel, the earth trembled, and rain poured down. You alone are the God who rules from Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: aseɛ wosole, na nyameɛso tɔle esue guale ase wɔ Nyameɛ, Yisrael Nyameɛ nyunu, na Sinai wosole wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: When your land was thirsty, you sent showers to refresh it.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, ɛmane esue tɔle pee guale nekaa biala; ɛfa siesiele w’agyapadeɛ mmerɛ bɔ ɔyɛle basaa ne.

english_verse: Your people settled there, and you were generous to everyone in need.
translation_verse: Wɔ mmenia nyane nekaa wɔ so bɛtenane; ao Nyameɛ, wɔ paa ti ɛmane ehiafoɛ bɛ sa hane bɔ behia ɔ.

english_verse: You gave the command, Lord, and a chorus of women told what had happened:
translation_verse: AWURADE fa ye noa dwirɛ ne ɔma, na bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye nwo dawure ne, bɛsone pee.

english_verse: “Kings and their armies retreated and ran, and everything they left is now being divided.
translation_verse: “Koɛhonɛfoɛ b’ahemvo mɔ bɛnwatinwati!” Mmrasua bɔ bɛwɔ awuro yeɛ bɛkyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ ne ɔ,

english_verse: And for those who stayed back to guard the sheep, there are metal doves with silver-coated wings and shiny gold feathers.”
translation_verse: ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛlela mmoaennduin nu de, nakoso bɛte kyɛ abubure bɔ ɛdwetɛ kata ye ndaa nwo, ye ndɛkra te kyɛ esikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ ɔte yerɛmyerɛm ɔ.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, you scattered the kings like snow falling on Mount Zalmon.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Ɛdangama bɔle ahemvo mɔ sandene wɔ berɛ ne, ɔyɛle kyɛ asukɔtwea wɔ Salmon bokaa so.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, Bashan is a mighty mountain covered with peaks.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bokaa, Basan bokaa; mmokaa ndendenn, Basan bokaa!

english_verse: Why is it jealous of Zion, the mountain you chose as your home forever?
translation_verse: Mmokaa ndendenn, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔ nye boro bokaa bɔ Nyameɛ kuro kyɛ ɔfa yɛ ye atenaleɛ ne ɔ? Amba, nekaa bɔ AWURADE kɔtena afebɔɔ ne.

english_verse: When you, Lord God, appeared to your people at Sinai, you came with thousands of mighty chariots.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ ye teaseɛnam mɔ bɛte apee aburanyɔ sɔ alaa buburugyaa, AWURADE boka bɛ so, kyɛbɔ ɔboka bɛ so wɔ Sinai, nekaa krongron berɛ ne.

english_verse: When you climbed the high mountain, you took prisoners with you and were given gifts. Your enemies didn't want you to live there, but they gave you gifts.
translation_verse: Ɛfole bokaa tendenn ne, elili bɛ bɔ ahye bɛ nnure ne nyunu wɔ mmerɛ bɔ elele akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔte mmenia ɔ, bɔ ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ po bɛboka so ɔ amaa ɔnate so AWURADE Nyameɛ watena bɛ nu.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God! You treat us with kindness day after day, and you rescue us.
translation_verse: Animnyam hã AWURADE bɔ otira yɛ nu daa biala ne; Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte yɛ ngoadefoɛ ɔ. Sela

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, your terrible enemies are ready for war, but you will crush their skulls.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ ye pɔfoɛ mɔ de, ɔkɔpɛkyɛ bɛ ti, bɛ bɔ bɛnate bɔne atee so ne, ɔkɔpakyepakye bɛ ti kwangoa.

english_verse: You promised to bring them from Bashan and from the deepest sea.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa: “Ngosa ngɔfa bɛ ngofi Basan ngɔwa, ngosa ngɔye bɛ ngofi ɛpo ye bo dɔ paa ngɔwa,

english_verse: Then we could wash our feet in their blood, and our dogs could chew on their bones.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so afa wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ mogya anwunzi wɔ gya bo, ná wɔ ngyea mɔ bɛ temverema anya mogya ne bie batafe.”

english_verse: We have seen crowds marching to your place of worship, our God and King.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, yanwu wɔ sandene krongron ne, sandene bɔ me Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte me hene ne, ɔto kɔ nekaa krongron berɛ ne.

english_verse: Singers come first, and then the musicians, surrounded by young women playing tambourines.
translation_verse: Edweintolɛfoɛ nemɔ li moa, sangoobɔlɛfoɛ nemɔ li nziɛ, ndaluwa li bɛ nu bɛwoso akasaa kyɛ,

english_verse: They come shouting, “People of Israel, praise the Lord God!”
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔhyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam wɔ badwa kandinga ne anu, ɛmɔ bɔ Yisrael suli ɛmɔ ne, ɛ́mɔhyɛ AWURADE animnyam!”

english_verse: The small tribe of Benjamin leads the way, followed by the leaders from Judah. Then come the leaders from Zebulun and Naphtali.
