translation_verse: Benyamin bɔ yeɛ ɔte abusua kure kaaba paa ne, ye yeɛ oli bɛ nyunu ɔ; Yuda mbanyi baboa bɛ noa, Sebulɔn mbanyi, Nafetali mbanyi.

english_verse: Our God, show your strength! Show us once again.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, kyire wɔ tumi, ao Nyameɛ, kyire w’anwoserɛ, kyɛbɔ ɛyɛ mane yɛ daa ne.

english_verse: Then kings will bring gifts to your temple in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɔnate w’asɔneyɛɛ sua bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne ati, ahemvo kɔbrɛ wɔ akyɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Punish that animal that lives in the swamp! Punish that nation whose leaders and people are like wild bulls. Make them come crawling with gifts of silver. Scatter those nations that enjoy making war.
translation_verse: Ngaka aboyaa bɔ bɛwɔ nekaa bɔ elemmire wɔ ne, nandwie nyii kure bɔ bafra maen maen nandwie mmaa mɔ nu ne, twi bɛ nyunu. Bɛ bɔ ndɔlelɛ yɛ bɛ fɛ ne, fa bɛ wura wɔ gya bo, bɛ bɔ bɛ nye gye koɛ nwo ne, bɔ bɛ sande.

english_verse: Force the Egyptians to bring gifts of bronze; make the Ethiopians hurry to offer presents.
translation_verse: Atitire kofi Misraim kɔwa; Yitiopia kɔyɛ ndɛndɛ kɔma ye sa so kohyire Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Now sing praises to God! Every kingdom on earth, sing to the Lord!
translation_verse: Aseɛ so ahennie mɔ, ɛ́mɔto Nyameɛ nwo dwein; ɛ́mɔto AWURADE nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein. Sela

english_verse: Praise the one who rides across the ancient skies; listen as he speaks with a mighty voice.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔnate ewienu anwuro anwuro, tetetete nyameɛso ne, ɛ́mɔto ye nwo dwein; ɛ́mɔtie, ye komvi piri ne, ɔbɔ nu kurudududu.

english_verse: Tell about God's power! He is honored in Israel, and he rules the skies.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bɔ odi Yisrael so hene, bɔ ye tumi wɔ ewienu ne, ɛmɔhã kyɛ ole tumi.

english_verse: The God of Israel is fearsome in his temple, and he makes us strong. Let's praise our God!
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, wɔ nwo yɛ suro wɔ w’atenaleɛ krongron berɛ. Yisrael Nyameɛ ne, ye yeɛ ɔma ye maen tumi ne anwoserɛ ɔ. Animnyam hã Nyameɛ!

english_verse: Save me, God! I am about to drown.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, pepɛ de me, ofikyɛ nzue ne ayi waadwu me kɔme anu.

english_verse: I am sinking deep in the mud, and my feet are slipping. I am about to be swept under by a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Meme mekɔ aseɛnwo wɔ asaa pɛkyɛpɛkyɛ nu, bɔ mennya nekaa memva me gya mendindim ɔ; maadwu buma nu, na asue ne wayi wabu wafa me so.

english_verse: I am worn out from crying, and my throat is dry. I have waited for you till my eyes are blurred.
translation_verse: Masu dee mayɛ mmerɛ; me komvi ayɛ wosee. Manea me Nyameɛ ate alaa ama me nye ape atee bo.

english_verse: There are more people who hate me for no reason than there are hairs on my head. Many terrible enemies want to destroy me, God. Am I supposed to give back something I didn't steal?
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛpɔ me mbaen ne, bɛsone bɛtra me ti nwiaa; bɛ bɔ bɛpena me beku me, bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛpɛ edwirɛ bɛto me so ne, bɛ nwo yɛ se. Nikyee bɔ nnwuale ɔ, aso odi kyɛ mefa bie mesi ye gya nu?

english_verse: You know my foolish sins. Not one is hidden from you.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ ɛse ngwaseasɛm bɔ mali ɔ; me mvomsoɛ mvea wɔ wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: It is for your sake alone that I am insulted and blush with shame.
translation_verse: Ɔnate wɔ ti yeɛ male animguaseɛ ye, animguaseɛ bɔ ɔmata me ye.

english_verse: I am like a stranger to my relatives and like a foreigner to my own family.
translation_verse: Makakyi ɛwɔfoɛ wɔ nniɛma mɔ nu, mayɛ amanvraniɛ wɔ me ni akunu mmaa mɔ nu.

english_verse: My love for your house burns in me like a fire, and when others insult you, they insulted me as well.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ w’awuro nwo ɔdɔ bɔ nne ye ne, ɔte see bɔ ogye wɔ me nu ɔ, bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ wɔ alapaa ne, b’alapaa ne waagua me so.

english_verse: I cried and went without food, but they still insulted me.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ nyɔle akɔngyere mva mmrɛle me kra ase ne, ɔnate so maa bɛbɔle me alapaa.

english_verse: They sneered at me for wearing sackcloth to show my sorrow.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ mvale ɛsɛen tena nyɛle me tena ne, ngakyili bɛ noa nu ngorohoɛ dwirɛ.

english_verse: Rulers and judges gossip about me, and drunkards make up songs to mock me.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ kuro berɛ pambim ne anu ne, me nwo dwirɛ ala yeɛ bɛkã ɔ, na me yeɛ akɔnomnzafoɛ bɛfa me bɛto dwein ɔ.

english_verse: But I pray to you, Lord. So when the time is right, answer me and help me with your wonderful love.
translation_verse: Nakoso, ao AWURADE, me de, wɔ yeɛ mebɔ me mbaeɛ mekyire wɔ ɔ. Ao Nyameɛ, mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu, wɔ ɔdɔ totohyia bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, bua me. Wɔ ngoalelɛ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati,

english_verse: Don't let me sink in the mud, but save me from my enemies and from the deep water.
translation_verse: pepɛ de me, amaa ɔnate so mammi wɔ asaa pɛkyɛpɛkyɛ ne anu; pepɛ de me fi me pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu, ɔne buma ne anu.

english_verse: Don't let me be swept away by a flood or drowned in the ocean or swallowed by death.
translation_verse: Nnɛma nzueyilɛ ne obungam fa me so, nnɛma buma ne ɔme me, yeɛ nnɛma ɛborɔ kumaa ne noa ɔkã tua sie me.

english_verse: Answer me, Lord! You are kind and good. Pay attention to me! You are truly merciful.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE,‘ tie me, ofikyɛ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔte paa; gyina w’anwumvoinnwunɛ kandinga ne aso, ná pɛne wɔ nye baanea me.

english_verse: Don't turn away from me. I am your servant, and I am in trouble. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Nnɛye wɔ nye fea wɔ somvoɛ, ofikyɛ edwirɛ ato me, yiti yɛ ndɛ bua me.

english_verse: You know how I am insulted, mocked, and disgraced; you know every one of my enemies.
translation_verse: Ɛse alapaa bɔ bɛbɔ me ɔ, yeɛ m’animguaseɛ ne me ɛsopalɛ, ɛse me pɔfoɛ mɔ amukoraa.

english_verse: I am crushed by insults, and I feel sick. I had hoped for mercy and pity, but there was none.
translation_verse: Alapaa ama me wora abɔ, maa ɔnate so wabɔ me anwonyerɛ. Ahaa mepena sona bɔ ɔkɔdodo me ɔ, nakoso mbaen ɔ; yeɛ ahaa mepena aworakyekyerɛfoɛ, nakoso mannya ko po.

english_verse: Enemies poisoned my food, and when I was thirsty, they gave me vinegar.
translation_verse: Bɛfale ɛborɔ beguale m’aleɛ nu, yeɛ nzuhɔen ku me ne, bɛmane me nzaa kekarekekare kyɛ nno.

english_verse: Show them how angry you are! Be furious and catch them.
translation_verse: Ma wɔ nye boro bɛ so, ná ma wɔ yaa bɔ afɛ ye hahii ne ɔhɔ bɛ so.

english_verse: Destroy their camp and don't let anyone live in their tents.
translation_verse: Ma b’atenaleɛ ɔkakyi kurofoen, yeɛ nnɛma ebiala tena b’ɛtena sua nemɔ anu.

english_verse: They cause trouble for people you have already punished; their gossip hurts those you have wounded.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sona bɔ abɔ ye apura ye ne, bɛtane ye nye, na bɛ bɔ apura bɛ ne, besa bɛmaa bɛfa yealɛ nu.

english_verse: Make them guiltier than ever and don't forgive them.
translation_verse: Ma bɛ so hwenɛ ne, ɔtaataa so, nnɛmaa bennya wɔ sa nu bɔnefakyɛ.

english_verse: Wipe their names from the book of the living; remove them from the list of the innocent.
translation_verse: Kyikyi bɛ dumaa fi ateasefoɛ nwomaa ne anu; nnɛmaa bɛka bɛ bɛfra teneneefoɛ.

english_verse: I am mistreated and in pain. Protect me, God, and keep me safe!
translation_verse: Na me de, nwɔ amaneɛ nu, yeɛ medi aworabɔlɛ; ao Nyameɛ, wɔ ngoalelɛ ne, maa ɔpagya me.

english_verse: I will praise the Lord God with a song and a thankful heart.
translation_verse: Ngɔto dwein ngɔye Nyameɛ dumaa ayɛ, ngɔfa asennaa ngɔhyɛ ye animnyam.

english_verse: This will please the Lord better than offering an ox or a full-grown bull.
translation_verse: AWURADE kohuro ɛhe kɔtra nandwie, anaa nandwie nyii bɔ ole mmɛen bɔ ye gya nu apakye ɔ.

english_verse: When those in need see this, they will be happy, and the Lord's worshipers will be encouraged.
translation_verse: Anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ bekonwu ye na bɛ nye kɔgye; ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔpena Nyameɛ si atee ne, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ wora ɔ́kyekye.

english_verse: The Lord will listen when the homeless cry out, and he will never forget his people in prison.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE tie ehiafoɛ sufrɛ, ná ye mmenia bɔ bɛwɔ amaneɛ nu ne, ommu bɛ animtia.

english_verse: Heaven and earth will praise our God, and so will the oceans and everything in them.
translation_verse: Ma nyameɛso ne aseɛ, yeɛ ɛpo ne nu ngaka amukoraa bɛye ye ayɛ.

english_verse: God will rescue Jerusalem, and he will rebuild the towns of Judah. His people will live there on their own land,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ kɔpepɛ kole Sion, na okosa kɔkyekye Yuda nguro nemɔ, na bɛkɔtena berɛ bɛkɔfa berɛ bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ.

english_verse: and when the time comes, their children will inherit the land. Then everyone who loves God will also settle there.
translation_verse: Ye somvoɛ mɔ, bɛ mma mɔ kɔfa berɛ bɛkɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ, na bɛ bɔ bɛ nye gye ye dumaa nwo ne, bɛkɔtena so.

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, yɛ ndɛ pepɛ de me. Ao AWURADE, yɛ ndɛ baaboka me!

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛpena me beku me ne, ma bɛ nyunu gua ase, ná bɛ nye so ɔtã. Bɛ bɔ bɛpena me ne tɛɛ ne, maa bɛtete besa bɛ si ná bɛ nyunu gua ase.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛkekã kyɛ, “Ehee, Ehee!” ne, bɛ nwo nyanzoen ti, maa bɛtete besa bɛ si.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛpena wɔ si atee ne amukoraa, maa beli ahurusi, ná bɛ nye gye wɔ wɔ nu. Bɛ bɔ bɛ nye gye wɔ ngoalelɛ nwo ne, maa bɛhã ye afebɔɔ kyɛ, “Nyameɛ te piri!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Nakoso wahia me, yeɛ meyɛ anwumvo. Ao Nyameɛ, yɛ ndɛ bra me berɛ! Wɔ yeɛ ɛte me bokafoɛ ne me defoɛ ɔ; Ao AWURADE, nnɛkyɛ!

english_verse: Save me, Lord God! Hurry and help.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, yɛ ndɛ pepɛ de me. Ao AWURADE, yɛ ndɛ baaboka me!

english_verse: Disappoint and confuse all who want to kill me. Turn away and disgrace all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛpena me beku me ne, ma bɛ nyunu gua ase, ná bɛ nye so ɔtã. Bɛ bɔ bɛpena me ne tɛɛ ne, maa bɛtete besa bɛ si ná bɛ nyunu gua ase.

english_verse: Embarrass and shame those who say, “We told you so!”
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛkekã kyɛ, “Ehee, Ehee!” ne, bɛ nwo nyanzoen ti, maa bɛtete besa bɛ si.

english_verse: Let your worshipers celebrate and be glad because of you. They love your saving power, so let them always say, “God is wonderful!”
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛpena wɔ si atee ne amukoraa, maa beli ahurusi, ná bɛ nye gye wɔ wɔ nu. Bɛ bɔ bɛ nye gye wɔ ngoalelɛ nwo ne, maa bɛhã ye afebɔɔ kyɛ, “Nyameɛ te piri!”

english_verse: I am poor and needy, but you, the Lord God, care about me. You are the one who saves me. Please hurry and help!
translation_verse: Nakoso wahia me, yeɛ meyɛ anwumvo. Ao Nyameɛ, yɛ ndɛ bra me berɛ! Wɔ yeɛ ɛte me bokafoɛ ne me defoɛ ɔ; Ao AWURADE, nnɛkyɛ!

english_verse: I run to you, Lord, for protection. Don't disappoint me.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ nu yeɛ mebɔ me nwo waen ɔ; nnɛma me nyunu gua ase le.

english_verse: You do what is right, so come to my rescue. Listen to my prayer and keep me safe.
translation_verse: Wɔ tenenee ti, pepɛ de me, ná maa nya me ti nnidi nu. Yɛ asoɛ tie me, ná pepɛ de me.

english_verse: Be my mighty rock, the place where I can always run for protection. Save me by your command! You are my mighty rock and my fortress.
translation_verse: Yɛ me nyɔbotaen bɔ menwati mebafea wɔ nu daa ɔ. Ayɛ nhyehyɛleɛ kyɛ ɛkɔpepɛ ekole me ngoa, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte me nyɔbotaen ne m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Come and save me, Lord God, from vicious and cruel and brutal enemies!
translation_verse: Ao me Nyameɛ, pepɛ de me fi bɔnefoɛ sa nu, pepɛ de me fi amumuyɛɛfoɛ ne atianuserɛfoɛ sa nu.

english_verse: I depend on you, and I have trusted you since I was young.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ao AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’anyelasoɛ ɔ, ao AWURADE, ofi me ngwadaa nu, wɔ yeɛ me wora wura wɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: I have relied on you from the day I was born. You brought me safely through birth, and I always praise you.
translation_verse: Ofi mmerɛ bɔ bɛwole me ɔ, wɔ yeɛ mafa me nwo mato wɔ so ɔ; wɔ yeɛ ɛfale me fili me ni akunu wale ɔ. Ngɔye wɔ ayɛ daa biala.

english_verse: Many people think of me as something evil. But you are my mighty protector,
translation_verse: Mayɛ kyɛ anwanwadeɛ wɔ mmenia pee nye so, nakoso wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and I praise and honor you all day long.
translation_verse: W’ayɛyelɛ ne w’animnyam yeɛ mete me noa mekã ye daa biala ɔ.

english_verse: Don't throw me aside when I am old; don't desert me when my strength is gone.
translation_verse: Me nworowaa nu, nnɛyakyi me nu; sɛ menyi meyɛ mmerɛ a, nnɛpo me.

english_verse: They say, “Now we'll catch you! God has deserted you, and no one can save you.”
translation_verse: Bɛkekã kyɛ, “Nyameɛ apo ye, yiti ɛ́mɔfoa ye bɛhye ye, ofikyɛ ongonya defoɛ biala.”

english_verse: Come closer, God! Please hurry and help.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, nnɛyakyi me nu, ao me Nyameɛ, yɛ ndɛ baaboka me!

english_verse: Embarrass and destroy all who want me dead; disgrace and confuse all who want to hurt me.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ me kwaadu ne, ma bɛ nyunu gua ase ná bewuwu, bɛ bɔ bɛpena me bepura me ne, ma nyanzoen ne animguaseɛ obia bɛ.

english_verse: I will never give up hope or stop praising you.
translation_verse: Nakoso me de, ngonya anyelasoɛ daa, na ngɔhɔ so ngɔye wɔ ayɛ.

english_verse: All day long I will tell the wonderful things you do to save your people. But you have done much more than I could possibly know.
translation_verse: Wɔ tenenee nnwumaa ne wɔ ngoalelɛ nnwumaa ne, meka bɛ a, ɔbo me ndeaseɛ so de, nakoso ngɔfa me noa ngɔbɔ bɛ nwo dawure mmerɛ biala.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord God, for your mighty deeds and your power to save.
translation_verse: Ngɔwa wɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ anwoserɛ ne anu, wɔ tenenee deɛ angome yeɛ ngɔye ye ayɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You have taught me since I was a child, and I never stop telling about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, ofi me mmerandeɛ nu yeɛ ahyirehyire me ɔ, na mekɔ so mebɔ w’anwanwadeɛ nwo dawure.

english_verse: Don't leave me when I am old and my hair turns gray. Let me tell future generations about your mighty power.
translation_verse: Yiti menyi meyɛ aworowaa ma me ti anu yɛ gyein a, ao Nyameɛ, nnɛpo me, kɔpem kyɛ ngɔbɔ w’anwoserɛ nwo dawure ngohyire aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ he, ɔne wɔ tumi nwo dawure ngohyire ebiala bɔ ɔbaawa ɔ.

english_verse: Your deeds of kindness are known in the heavens. No one is like you!
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, wɔ tenenee kodwu anwuro anwuro. Ao Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ ayɛ nnwumaa mbiri mbiri ɔ; nwa yeɛ ɔte kyɛ wɔ ɔ?

english_verse: You made me suffer a lot, but you will bring me back from this deep pit and give me new life.
translation_verse: Wɔ bɔ amaa manwu amaneɛ pee ye, ekosa kɔmaa ngonya ngoa; na ekosa kɔye me kofi aseɛ bo dɔ kɔwa.

english_verse: You will make me truly great and take my sorrow away.
translation_verse: Ɛkɔmaa ngonya animnyam bɔ ɔte piri ɔ, ná ekosa kɔkyekye me wora.

english_verse: I will praise you, God, the Holy One of Israel. You are faithful. I will play the harp and sing your praises.
translation_verse: Ao me Nyameɛ, ɔnate wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ti, ngosa ngɔbɔ adengum ngɔye wɔ ayɛ; Ao Yisrael Krongronniɛ, ngɔfa sangoo ngɔto wɔ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein.

english_verse: You have rescued me! I will celebrate and shout, singing praises to you with all my heart.
translation_verse: Me noa kɔbɔ ese koli ahurusi mmerɛ bɔ meto wɔ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein ɔ, yeɛ me kra bɔ apepɛ ale ye ne koso, ɔkɔyɔ sɔ ala.

english_verse: All day long I will announce your power to save. I will tell how you disgraced and disappointed those who wanted to hurt me.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ biala, me noa koso kɔhã wɔ tenenee nwo dwirɛ, ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛpena me bepura me ne, bafɛre, na bɛ nyunu agua ase.

english_verse: Please help the king to be honest and fair just like you, our God.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, fa wɔ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ne ma ɛhene ne, ná fa wɔ tenenee ne ma ɛhene awa ne.

english_verse: Let him be honest and fair with all your people, especially the poor.
translation_verse: Maa ɔfa tenenee obu wɔ maen ne, na ɔfa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ɔnea bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ so.

english_verse: Let peace and justice rule every mountain and hill.
translation_verse: Ma mmokaa nemɔ bɛfa asomdwee bɛbrɛ wɔ maen, ná ma pambaa nemɔ koso bɛfa tenenee bɛbra.

english_verse: Let the king defend the poor, rescue the homeless, and crush everyone who hurts them.
translation_verse: Maa oli maen ne anu ehiafoɛ bɛ dwirɛ ɔma bɛ; maa ɔpepɛ ole bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ, ná obubu aminɛlilɛfoɛ nu gɔsɔgɔsɔ.

english_verse: Let the king live forever like the sun and the moon.
translation_verse: Kyɛ eyia tɛbɔ ye, ɔne kyɛ ɛsraen tɛta ye, ma wɔ maen besuro wɔ wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: Let him be as helpful as rain that refreshes the meadows and the ground.
translation_verse: Ɛhene ne, maa ɔyɛ kyɛ esue bɔ ɔtɔ gua ɛserɛ bɔ bapɛ so ɔ so, kyɛ nyenyenzue bɔ ɔdoadoa aseɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: Let the king be fair with everyone, and let there be peace until the moon falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Ye aberɛ so, ma tenenee obu so, ná asomdwee pee ɔbra, kɔpem kyɛ ɛsraen ɔnne berɛ ko ɔ.

english_verse: Let his kingdom reach from sea to sea, from the Euphrates River across all the earth.
translation_verse: Ma ye ahennie ɔtrɛ fi ɛpo ɔɔhã ɛpo, ofi asue ne ɔɔhã aseɛ noa.

english_verse: Force the desert tribes to accept his rule, and make his enemies crawl in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ma bɛ bɔ bɛte ɛserɛ so ne bɛkoto wɔ ye nyunu, ná ma ye pɔfoɛ mɔ beli mvuture.

english_verse: Force the rulers of Tarshish and of the islands to pay taxes to him. Make the kings of Sheba and of Seba bring gifts.
translation_verse: Tasise ahemvo ne dedeede aseɛ ahemvo nemɔ, maa betua ndɔ bɛma ye; ma Hyeba ne Seba ahemvo mɔ bɛfa akyɛdeɛ bɛbrɛ ye.

english_verse: Make other rulers bow down and all nations serve him.
translation_verse: Maa ahemvo amukoraa bɛkoto wɔ ye nyunu, ná maen maen amukoraa bɛso ye.

english_verse: Do this because the king rescues the homeless when they cry out, and he helps everyone who is poor and in need.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo, ehiafoɛ ne bɛ bɔ belle bokafoɛ ne, besu bɛfrɛ ye a, ɔkɔpepɛ kole bɛ.

english_verse: The king has pity on the weak and the helpless and protects those in need.
translation_verse: Okonwu ehiafoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ anwumvoin, na okole ehiafoɛ kra ngoa.

english_verse: He cares when they hurt, and he saves them from cruel and violent deaths.
translation_verse: Okole bɛ ngoa kofi nhyɛsoɛ ne nzɛmmɔne nu, na bɛ mogya koli mu wɔ ye nye so.

english_verse: Long live the king! Give him gold from Sheba. Always pray for the king and praise him each day.
translation_verse: Maa onyi ɔhyɛ! Maa bɛfa Hyeba esikaa kɔkorɛ bɛma ye. Maa bɛbɔ mbaeɛ bɛma ye daa, ná bɛsrɛ saleɛ bɛma ye daa biala.

english_verse: Let cities overflow with food and hills be covered with grain, just like Mount Lebanon. Let the people in the cities prosper like wild flowers.
translation_verse: Ma aleɛ obu so wɔ aseɛ ne aso, maa aleɛ ɔhye wɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso po, ma ye aleɛ ɔyɛ kyɛ Lebanon; na ma mmenia benyi frɔmfrɔm wɔ nguro nemɔ aso kyɛ aseɛ so ndire.

english_verse: May the glory of the king shine brightly forever like the sun in the sky. Let him make nations prosper and learn to praise him.
translation_verse: Ma ye dumaa ɔtena berɛ afebɔɔ, na kyɛ eyia wɔ berɛ ye, maa ɔhɔ so onya dumaa, ma mmenia bɛfa ye so benya saleɛ, na ma maen maen amukoraa bɛfrɛ ye sona bɔ wanya saleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, we praise you. Only you can work miracles.
translation_verse: Animnyam hã AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ, bɔ ye ngome yeɛ ɔyɔ anwanwadeɛ ne.

english_verse: We will always praise your glorious name. Let your glory be seen everywhere on earth. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Ye animnyam dumaa ne, odi kyɛ bɛye ye ayɛ daa, na ma ye animnyam oyi aseɛ ye amukoraa so tɛkyɛ. Amen, Amen.

english_verse: This ends the prayers of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_verse: Yese awa Dawide ye mbaeɛ ne, ye ayieleɛ ɛne.

english_verse: God is truly good to Israel, especially to everyone with a pure heart.
translation_verse: Amba, Nyameɛ te paa ma Yisrael, ɔte paa ma bɛ bɔ bɛ ti anu te fufue ɔ.

english_verse: But I almost stumbled and fell,
translation_verse: Nakoso me de, ahaa mesoti; ɔhale sɔaa maa mvini ase.

english_verse: because it made me jealous to see proud and evil people and to watch them prosper.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me nye borole mmeraatolɛfoɛ, mmerɛ bɔ nwuni bɔnefoɛ bɛ ngɔsoɛ ne.

english_verse: They never have to suffer, they stay healthy,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nikye fee nha bɛ; bɛte apɔ, yeɛ bɛ nwonaen te mmenanwo mmenanwo.

english_verse: and they don't have troubles like everyone else.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ ndoto bɛ kyɛ mmenia ngaa nemɔ, yeɛ ɛhawo ndoto bɛ kyɛ mmenia ngaa nemɔ.

english_verse: Their pride is like a necklace, and they commit sin more often than they dress themselves.
translation_verse: Yiti bafa anwomasoɛ baya kyɛ akomuade; bahera basabasayɔlɛ kyɛ ɛtena.

english_verse: Their eyes bulge with fat, and their minds are flooded with foolish thoughts.
translation_verse: Bayɛ piri ma bɛ nye asi ayɛ kutukutuu, ngwaseasɛm yeɛ wayi bɛ ti anu to ɔ.

english_verse: They sneer and say cruel things, and because of their pride, they make violent threats.
translation_verse: Bɛgoro mmenia nwo, na bɛ noa dwirɛ te bɔne, bele anwomasoɛ benwunanwuna mmenia.

english_verse: They dare to speak against God and to order others around.
translation_verse: Bedwudwo betia nyameɛso, yeɛ bɛ noa tia ebiala wɔ aseɛ ye aso.

english_verse: God will bring his people back, and they will drink the water he so freely gives.
translation_verse: Ɔnate sɔ ati, bɛ mmenia fa bɛ nwo kɔbɔ bɛ, na benya bɛ nwo bedidi.

english_verse: Only evil people would say, “God Most High cannot know everything!”
translation_verse: Na bebisa kyɛ, “Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né Nyameɛ wanwu ye? Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne, aso ɔse bɔ ɔkɔ so ɔ?”

english_verse: Yet all goes well for them, and they live in peace.
translation_verse: Nea, kyɛ bɔnefoɛ bɛte hɔ ɛne: bɛ nwo atɔ bɛ daa, na bɛkɔ so benya bɛ nwo.

english_verse: What good did it do me to keep my thoughts pure and refuse to do wrong?
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, m’ahone bɔ mate nu sannwuu ne, ɔne me sa bɔ manwunzi mafa mahyire kyɛ medi be ne, mafɛ magua mbaen.

english_verse: I am sick all day, and I am punished each morning.
translation_verse: Daa biala, ɛhawo angome yeɛ ɔba me so ɔ, na ngyerɛmɔ biala bɛtwe me so.

english_verse: If I had said evil things, I would not have been loyal to your people.
translation_verse: Sɛ ngane kyɛ, “Ngɔma sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ kofite me noa” a, ahaa né manni nahorɛ mamma wɔ mma aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ mɔ.

english_verse: Then I went to your temple, and there I understood what will happen to my enemies.
translation_verse: kɔpem kyɛ ngɔle Nyameɛ nekaa krongron berɛ, ná nwuni kyɛbɔ okosi koyie bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You will make them stumble, never to get up again.
translation_verse: Amba, ɛfa bɛ gyina nekaa bɔ ɔyɛ ndono ɔ, ɛmaa befi ase ma b’ayieleɛ yie bɛ.

english_verse: They will be terrified, suddenly swept away and no longer there.
translation_verse: Nea, b’ayieleɛ yie bɛ mvum nu, bɔ amaneɛ ama bɛ boso anua koraa!

english_verse: They will disappear, Lord, despised like a bad dream the morning after.
translation_verse: Sɛ sona da dwɔso a, bɛte kyɛ laleɛ bie, yeɛ wɔ AWURADE koso, sɛ ɛkekã wɔ nwo a, ebu bɛ kyɛ laleɛ bie.

english_verse: Once I was bitter and brokenhearted.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ me kra lili aworabɔlɛ ne, mmerɛ bɔ mmotole ne,

english_verse: I was stupid and ignorant, and I treated you as a wild animal would.
translation_verse: né nde kyɛ sona kwaseaa bɔ ɔnze hwee ɔ, nyɛle kyɛ kaka bie wɔ wɔ nye so.

english_verse: But I never really left you, and you hold my right hand.
translation_verse: Nakoso me de, ngɔtena wɔ nwo daa; etira me sa famaa ne anu.

english_verse: Your advice has been my guide, and later you will welcome me in glory.
translation_verse: Ɛfa wɔ foɛtulɛ ekyire me atee, na ye si ye, ekole me kɔhɔ animnyam nu.

english_verse: In heaven I have only you, and on this earth you are all I want.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ nne ye wɔ nyameɛso ɔ, sana wɔ ala? Yeɛ membena hwee wɔ aseɛ ye aso, sana wɔ ala.

english_verse: My body and mind may fail, but you are my strength and my choice forever.
translation_verse: Me nwonaen ne m’ahone kɔyɛ mmerɛ de, nakoso Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte m’ahone anwoserɛ ne me kyɛfa afebɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: All-Powerful Lord God, those who stay far from you will be lost, and you will destroy those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ amba, bɛ bɔ bɛtwe bɛ nwo befi wɔ nwo ne, bɛ boso konua, na bɛ bɔ bɛyakyi wɔ si lilɛ bɛtwe bɛ nwo befi wɔ nwo ne, enua bɛ boso.

english_verse: It is good for me to be near you. I choose you as my protector, and I will tell about your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Nakoso me de, ɔte paa ma me kyɛ ngopingye Nyameɛ ɔ; mafa AWURADE Nyameɛ mayɛ m’afealeɛ, amaa ɔnate so mabɔ wɔ nnwumaa mukoraa nwo dawure.

english_verse: Our God, why have you completely rejected us? Why are you so angry with the ones you care for?
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, nzu ati yeɛ apo yɛ afebɔɔ ye? Wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ mmoaen bɔ ɛma bɛ aleɛ ne, nzu ati yeɛ afɛ yɛ so yaa kandinga ye?

english_verse: Remember the people you rescued long ago, the tribe you chose for your very own. Think of Mount Zion, your home;
translation_verse: Kaye wɔ mmenia bɔ ɛtɔle bɛ tetetete ne, bɛ bɔ ɛpɔle bɛ fale bɛ yɛle abusua kure bɔ ɔte w’agyapadeɛ ne. Kaye Sion bokaa bɔ aatena so ne.

english_verse: walk over to the temple left in ruins forever by those who hate us.
translation_verse: Tu agyirɛ bra nekaa bɔ wakakyi kurofoen bɔkɔɔ ne; pɔfoɛ ne wasɛkye nekaa krongron berɛ nningyein amukoraa.

english_verse: Your enemies roared like lions in your holy temple, and they have placed their banners there.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bekyi wɔ ne, bɛbɔ ese wɔ wɔ nekaa krongron berɛ; bafa bɛ ngonim frangaa mɔ bapenapena berɛ.

english_verse: It looks like a forest chopped to pieces.
translation_verse: Bɛte kyɛ mmenia bɔ betiratira akumaa, bɔ bebu mmakaa wɔ ɛhɔayeɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: They used axes and hatchets to smash the carvings.
translation_verse: Na afei bele akumaa ne bɔsobaka babubu nu nningyein bɔ base amukoraa.

english_verse: They said to themselves, “We'll crush them!” Then they burned every one of your meeting places all over the country.
translation_verse: Bɛhane ye wɔ bɛ ti anu kyɛ, “Yɛkoli bɛ so ngonim bɔkɔɔ,” na bayera Nyameɛ nyianu nekaa biala wɔ aseɛ ne aso.

english_verse: There are no more miracles and no more prophets. Who knows how long it will be like this?
translation_verse: Yɛnnwu yɛ frangaa nemɔ; ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ biala nne berɛ ko; na yɛ nu biala nze kyẽa bɔ ɛhe bo kɔpɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Our God, how much longer will our enemies sneer? Won't they ever stop insulting you?
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, bɛ bɔ bekyi wɔ ne, kyinzu koraa yeɛ bɛ ngorohoɛ ne okoodwu ɔ? Pɔfoɛ ne, aso ɔkɔsɛkye wɔ dumaa afebɔɔ anaa?

english_verse: Our God and King, you have ruled since ancient times; you have won victories everywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ, ɛte me hene fi tete bɔ ede ngoa wɔ aseɛ ye aso ɔ.

english_verse: By your power you made a path through the sea, and you smashed the heads of sea monsters.
translation_verse: Wɔ tumi yeɛ ɛfa pakyepakyele ɛpo nu ɔ, na wɔ yeɛ ɛpɛkyɛle sasrabɔnzam nemɔ ti wɔ nzue nemɔ anu ɔ.

english_verse: You crushed the heads of the monster Leviathan, then fed him to wild creatures in the desert.
translation_verse: Ɛlɛngyɛen ne, ɛgorɔgorɔle ye ti nemɔ, na ɛfa mane ɛserɛsofoɛ maa belili.

english_verse: You opened the ground for streams and springs and dried up mighty rivers.
translation_verse: Ebukyele asue mɔ ne asue ba mɔ maa bɛtengyɛle, nakoso ɛmane asue mbiri mɔ bɛwewele.

english_verse: You rule the day and the night, and you put the moon and the sun in place.
translation_verse: Alehyeleɛ te wɔ deɛ, yeɛ alesaleɛ koso te wɔ deɛ; ɛsraen ne eyia koso, wɔ yeɛ ɛfale bɛ tuatuale berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You made summer and winter and gave them to the earth.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ ɛtole aseɛ ye noa amukoraa ɛwɛen ɔ, wɔ yeɛ ɛhyehyɛle ahuhuro ne prakasua mmerɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Remember your enemies, Lord! They foolishly sneer and won't respect you.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, kaye ɛhe: kyɛbɔ pɔfoɛ ne ɔyɛ ngorohoɛ ɔ, ɔne kyɛbɔ ngwaseafoɛ begua wɔ dumaa nwo fiɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You treat us like pet doves, but they mistreat us. Don't keep forgetting us and letting us be fed to those wild animals.
translation_verse: W’aborɔma ne, nnɛfa ye kra wura ngaka aboyaa mɔ sa; yeɛ wɔ mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ne, nnɛma wɔ wora fi bɛ ngoa le.

english_verse: Remember the agreement you made with us. Violent enemies are hiding in every dark corner of the earth.
translation_verse: Kaye apam ne, ofikyɛ aseɛ ne aso nekaa bɔ wayɛ awosii kabii ne, nzɛmmɔnelilɛ ayi berɛ tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: Don't disappoint those in need or make them turn from you, but help the poor and homeless to shout your praises.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ bɛhyɛ ye so ne, nnɛmaa ɔfa animguaseɛ osa ba, yeɛ ehiafoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ne, odi kyɛ bɛye wɔ dumaa ayɛ.

english_verse: Do something, God! Defend yourself. Remember how those fools sneer at you all day long.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, dwɔso, dwudwo nu maa benwu kyɛ edi be; kaye kyɛbɔ ngwaseafoɛ bɛgoro wɔ nwo daa biala ɔ.

english_verse: Our God, we thank you for being so near to us! Everyone celebrates your wonderful deeds.
translation_verse: Yɛda wɔ ase, ao Nyameɛ, yɛda wɔ ase; wɔ dumaa pingye. Wɔ sa noa nnwumaa nwanwa ne, mmenia bɔ ye nwo dawure.

english_verse: You have set a time to judge with fairness.
translation_verse: Sɛ mmerɛ bɔ mahyɛ ne ɔso a, ngɔfa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ yeɛ ngobua ndɛen ɔ.

english_verse: The earth trembles, and its people shake; you alone keep its foundations firm.
translation_verse: Sɛ aseɛ ɔne bɔ ɔwɔ so amukoraa bɛwoso a, me yeɛ mema ye bonima mɔ begyina pindinn ɔ. Sela

english_verse: You tell every bragger, “Stop bragging!” And to the wicked you say, “Don't boast of your power!
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔhoahoa ye nwo ne, mekã mekyire ye kyɛ, “Nnɛhoahoa wɔ nwo,” yeɛ mekã mekyire bɔnefoɛ kyɛ, “Nnɛfa wɔ tumi hoahoa wɔ nwo;

english_verse: Stop bragging! Quit telling me how great you are.”
translation_verse: nnɛfa wɔ tumi hoahoa wɔ nwo koraa, yeɛ nnɛdwudwo ahandaen so.”

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, victory doesn't come from the east or the west or from the desert.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngɔsoɛ mvi eyia afiteleɛ anaa eyia atɔleɛ yeɛ ɔba ɔ, yeɛ omvi ngwaen koso,

english_verse: You are the one who judges. You can take away power and give it to others.
translation_verse: na mmom Nyameɛ yeɛ obua ndɛen ɔ: ɔbrɛ ebie ase, ná wapagya ebie koso.

english_verse: You hold in your hand a cup filled with wine, strong and foaming. You will pour out some for every sinful person on this earth, and they will have to drink until it is gone.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE tira kwangoa bie wɔ ye sa nu, bɔ nzaa bɔ ye noa yɛ hye, bɔ opu ahure wɔ nu ɔ; okohwie nzaa ne bie, na wiase bɔnefoɛ amukoraa bɛkɔno bekotu ye bo.

english_verse: But I will always tell about you, the God of Jacob, and I will sing your praise.
translation_verse: Nakoso me de, ngɔbɔ ye nwo dawure afebɔɔ; ngɔto Yakob Nyameɛ ayɛyelɛ dwein.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will destroy the power of evil people, but you will give strength to those who are good.
translation_verse: Ngotu bɔnefoɛ b’anwoserɛ amukoraa bo, nakoso teneneefoɛ b’anwoserɛ de, ɔkɔhɔ anwuro.

english_verse: You, our God, are famous in Judah and honored in Israel.
translation_verse: Ebiala se Nyameɛ wɔ Yuda, na ye dumaa te piri wɔ Yisrael.

english_verse: Your home is on Mount Zion, the city of peace.
translation_verse: Ye tena sua wɔ Salem, na ye atenaleɛ wɔ Sion.

english_verse: There you destroyed fiery arrows, shields, swords, and all the other weapons.
translation_verse: Berɛ yeɛ obubuli agyaen bɔ bɛte see yerɛmyerɛm, akokyɛm mɔ, ngrandɛ ne akodeɛ mɔ nu ɔ. Sela

english_verse: You are more glorious than the eternal mountains.
translation_verse: Ele animnyam, ele ahennie nu animnyam tra mmokaa bɔ betimu berɛ afebɔɔ ne.

english_verse: Brave warriors were robbed of what they had taken, and now they lie dead, unable to lift an arm.
translation_verse: Bale ahoneserɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛ sa nu koɛ nzesadeɛ; batotɔ, na koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ, bɛ nu biala wangora wango.

english_verse: God of Jacob, when you roar, enemy chariots and horses drop dead in their tracks.
translation_verse: Ao Yakob Nyameɛ, ɛteateane bɛ ne, pɔngɔhanɛniɛ ne ɔne ye pɔngɔ ne, bɛlale berɛ pakayaa.

english_verse: Our God, you are fearsome, and no one can oppose you when you are angry.
translation_verse: Nakoso wɔ de, wɔ nwo yɛ suro! Sɛ ɛfɛ yaa a, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora wɔ nyunu gyina ɔ?

english_verse: From heaven you announced your decisions as judge! And all who live on this earth were terrified and silent
translation_verse: Ebuale ndɛen wɔ nyameɛso maa yɛtele; ɛserɛ hane aseɛ, na ɔyɛle dinn,

english_verse: when you took over as judge, ready to rescue everyone in need.
translation_verse: mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ dwɔsole buale ndɛen, kyɛ ɔfa pepɛ ode aseɛ ye aso anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ amukoraa ne. Sela

english_verse: Even the most angry people will praise you when you are furious.
translation_verse: “Amba, mmenia yaafɛlɛ po, ɔkakyi ayɛyelɛ ma wɔ; wɔ yaafɛlɛ piri ne, ɛfa ye ngaa bɔ abɔsoɛ.

english_verse: Everyone, make your promises to the Lord your God and do what you promise. The Lord is fearsome, and all his servants should bring him gifts.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔhyehyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ bɔ, na ɛmɔtua, bɛ bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia ne amukoraa, odi kyɛ ebiala ɔfa akyɛdeɛ ɔbrɛ ye bɔ ye nwo yɛ suro ne.

english_verse: God destroys the courage of rulers and kings and makes cowards of them.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔbrɛ ahemvo mɔ b’ahandaen ase ɔ, na ye yeɛ ye nwo yɛ aseɛ so ahemvo mɔ suro ɔ.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord God, and I beg you to listen.
translation_verse: Metea nu mesu mefrɛ Nyameɛ, metea nu serɛ mefrɛ Nyameɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔte me sufrɛ ɔ.

english_verse: In days filled with trouble, I search for you. And at night I tirelessly lift my hands in prayer, refusing comfort.
translation_verse: M’amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu, mepena AWURADE si atee; sɛ odwu kɔngɔen a, metrɛtrɛ me sa nu bɔ me sa onnya ɔ; me kra mbene so kyɛ bɛkɔkyekye ye wora ɔ.

english_verse: When I think of you, I feel restless and weak.
translation_verse: Sɛ mekaye Nyameɛ a, me wora bɔ, medwene ye dwirɛ nwo, na me sunzum boto. Sela

english_verse: Because of you, Lord God, I can't sleep. I am restless and can't even talk.
translation_verse: Ɛmma me nye ngo. Menwu amaneɛ maa mengora dwudwo po.

english_verse: I think of times gone by, of those years long ago.
translation_verse: Mekaye daa tete mmerɛ ne, tetetete afoɛ mɔ bɔ bapɛ nu bahɔ ne.

english_verse: Each night my mind is flooded with questions:
translation_verse: Mekaye me kɔngɔen dwein; medwenedwene ye nwo wɔ me ti anu, na me sunzum pɛnzɛpɛnzɛ nu.

english_verse: “Have you rejected me forever? Won't you be kind again?
translation_verse: Aso AWURADE kɔpo me afebɔɔ bɔ ongonwu me anwumvoin ko ɔ?

english_verse: Have you forgotten how to have pity? Do you refuse to show mercy because of your anger?”
translation_verse: Aso Nyameɛ wora afi kyɛ ɔkɔlo sona ɔ? Aso wafɛ yaa maa wayakyi ye anwumvoinnwunɛ ne anaa? Sela

english_verse: Then I said, “God Most High, what hurts me most is that you no longer help us with your mighty arm.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ menwa, “Sɔ dwirɛ ne yeɛ ɔyɛ me yea ɔ, nakoso ngɔkaye afoɛ mɔ bɔ Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne ohyirele ye tumi ne.”

english_verse: Our Lord, I will remember the things you have done, your miracles of long ago.
translation_verse: Ngɔkaye AWURADE nnwumaa bɔ ɔyɔ ne; amba, ngɔkaye wɔ daa tete anwanwadeɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: I will think about each one of your mighty deeds.
translation_verse: Ngɔdwenedwene wɔ nnwumaa amukoraa nwo, ná masusu w’anwanwadeɛ mɔ nwo.

english_verse: Everything you do is right, and no other god compares with you.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, w’atee te krongron. Nzikyɛ nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte piri kyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ ye ɔ?

english_verse: You alone work miracles, and you have let nations see your mighty power.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ ɛte Nyameɛ bɔ ɛyɛ anwanwadeɛ mɔ ɔ, bɔ ahyire wɔ tumi wɔ maen maen mɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: With your own arm you rescued your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph.
translation_verse: Wɔ maen bɔ ye ole Yakob ne Yosef boso ama ne, ɛfale wɔ tumi asaa ne yeɛ ɛpepɛ lele bɛ ɔ. Sela

english_verse: Water flowed from the clouds. Thunder was heard above as your arrows of lightning flashed about.
translation_verse: Munungum hwiele esue guale tatatata, ewienu bobɔle nu kurudududu; na w’agyaen nemɔ koso tetele yerɛmyerɛm.

english_verse: Your thunder roared like chariot wheels. The world was made bright by lightning, and all the earth trembled.
translation_verse: Bɛtele w’agralaa ne nga wɔ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ nu; w’agralaa tale wiase hyireinn, na aseɛ wosole gigigigi.

english_verse: You walked through the water of the mighty sea, but your footprints were never seen.
translation_verse: W’atimbire la ɛpo nu, w’atee la asue mbiri mɔ nu, nakoso bennwu wɔ gya boso.

english_verse: You guided your people like a flock of sheep, and you chose Moses and Aaron to be their leaders.
translation_verse: Ɛnate Mose ne Aarɔn so elili wɔ maen nyunu kyɛbɔ bedi mmoaen kure nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to listen as I teach.
translation_verse: Ao me maen, ɛ́mɔtie me ngyerɛkyerɛ; ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ betie me noa dwirɛ!

english_verse: I will give instruction and explain the mystery of what happened long ago.
translation_verse: Ngobukye me noa ngobu anyandera. Ngɔhã tete dwirɛ bɔ ye bo telɛ yɛ se ɔ,

english_verse: These are things we learned from our ancestors,
translation_verse: edwirɛ bɔ yate ná yanwu ye, bɔ yɛ nana mɔ bahã bahyire yɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and we will tell them to the next generation. We won't keep secret the glorious deeds and the mighty miracles of the Lord.
translation_verse: Yɛngɔfa yɛngɔfea bɛ mma mɔ, na mmom aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ ɔba ye, yɛkɔhã yɛkohyire bɛ: AWURADE animnyam nnwumaa ne ye tumi, ɔne anwanwadeɛ mɔ bɔ wayɔ ɔ.

english_verse: God gave his Law to Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel. And he told our ancestors to teach their children,
translation_verse: Ɔhyehyɛle ahyɛdeɛ wɔ Yakob nu, na ɔhyɛle mmeraa wɔ Yisrael nu. Ɔfa yɛle ahyɛdeɛ mane yɛ nana mɔ, kyɛ bɛfa behyirehyire bɛ mma mɔ,

english_verse: so that each new generation would know his Law and tell it to the next.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ ɔkɔwa ne, bɔ bɛ ole ngwadaa bɔ bennya bɛwwole bɛ ne, banwu mmeraa ne, ná badwɔso bahã bahyire bɛ maa mɔ,

english_verse: Then they would trust God and obey his teachings, without forgetting anything God had done.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so bafa bɛ wora bawura Nyameɛ nu, ná bɛ wora amvi Nyameɛ sa noa nnwumaa, na mmom bali ye mmeraa dwirɛ so.

english_verse: The warriors from Ephraim were armed with arrows, but they ran away when the battle began.
translation_verse: Efraimfoɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ betiratira agyaen ɔ, bɛnwati befili koɛ noa koɛhonɛ kyẽa ne.

english_verse: They broke their agreement with God, and they turned their backs on his teaching.
translation_verse: Banni Nyameɛ apam ne aso, yeɛ bɛyɛle b’adwene kyɛ bengoli mmeraa ne aso.

english_verse: They forgot all he had done, even the mighty miracles
translation_verse: Bɛmane bɛ wora fili bɔ wayɔ ɔ, ɔne anwanwadeɛ mɔ bɔ wala ye ali wahyire bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: God made a path in the sea and piled up the water as he led them across.
translation_verse: Ɔpakyele ɛpo nu maa bɛfale nu, na ɔmane nzue ne boale ye noa gyinane berɛ kyɛ fasue.

english_verse: He guided them during the day with a cloud, and each night he led them with a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Alehyeleɛ nu, né ɔfa munungum di bɛ nyunu, na alesaleɛ nu amukoraa, né ɔfa see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi yeɛ odi bɛ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: God made water flow from rocks he split open in the desert, and his people drank freely, as though from a lake.
translation_verse: Odwudwale nyɔbotaen mɔ nu wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso, na ɔmane bɛ nzue pee kyɛ buma nu nzue maa bɛnone.

english_verse: He made streams gush out like rivers from rocks.
translation_verse: Ɔmane asue mɔ pukyele fili nyɔbotaen ne anu, na ɔmane nzue tengyɛle kyɛ asue.

english_verse: But in the desert, the people of God Most High kept sinning and rebelling.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛhɔle so bɛyɔle bɔne betiale ye, na bɛyɔle Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne nwo lɔen wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso.

english_verse: They stubbornly tested God and demanded from him what they wanted to eat.
translation_verse: Besole Nyameɛ bɛneane wɔ b’ahone nu, ofikyɛ bebisale aleɛ bɔ bɛ komvi wɔ so ɔ kitii.

english_verse: They challenged God by saying, “Can God provide food out here in the desert?
translation_verse: Bedwudwo betiale Nyameɛ kyɛ, “Aso Nyameɛ kɔhora kɔma yɛ aleɛ wɔ ɛserɛ so?

english_verse: It's true God struck the rock and water gushed out like a river, but can he give his people bread and meat?”
translation_verse: Ɔpakyele nyɔbotaen nu mane nzue pu wale, na asue mɔ yi bu fale so de, nakoso aso ɔkɔhora kɔma aleɛ, anaa naen bɔ ɔkɔso ye maen ɔ?”

english_verse: When the Lord heard this, he was angry and furious with Jacob's descendants, the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, ye ahone huli paa, ye yaa sɔle kyɛ see tiale Yakob, ye ahone huli Yisrael so paa,

english_verse: They had refused to trust him, and they had doubted his saving power.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ banne Nyameɛ banni, na bamva bɛ wora banwura ye ngoalelɛ ne anu.

english_verse: But God gave a command to the clouds, and he opened the doors in the skies.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔhyɛle ewienu bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro, na obukyele nyameɛso anoa nemɔ;

english_verse: From heaven he sent grain that they called manna.
translation_verse: na ɔtɔle manna kyɛ esue guale bɛ so kyɛ beli, na ɔmane bɛ nyameɛso aleɛ.

english_verse: He gave them more than enough, and each one of them ate this special food.
translation_verse: Adasa mmaa belili abɔfo aleɛ; Nyameɛ mane bɛ aleɛ maa obuli bɛ so.

english_verse: God's mighty power sent a strong wind from the southeast,
translation_verse: Ɔmane eyia afiteleɛ mvrama bɔle wɔ ewienu, na ɔnate ye tumi so mane ngwaen dɔ mvrama bɔle.

english_verse: and it brought birds that covered the ground, like sand on the beach.
translation_verse: Ɔtɔle naen guale bɛ so kyɛ mvuture, ɔne nnomaa bɔ bele ndaa kyɛ mboanoa anweaa.

english_verse: Then God made the birds fall in the camp of his people near their tents.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa bɛtete beguale b’asikyeleɛ ne anu bɛpɛle b’atenaleɛ nemɔ anwo bɛbra beyiale.

english_verse: God gave his people all they wanted, and each of them ate until they were full.
translation_verse: Belili mane bɛ ko yili paa, ofikyɛ ɔmane bɛ bɔ bɛ komvi wɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: God became angry and killed the strongest and best from the families of Israel.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ fɛle bɛ so yaa, ohuhuni bɛ nu anwoserɛfoɛ nemɔ, na ɔbobɔle Yisraelfoɛ mmerandeɛ nemɔ guale berɛ.

english_verse: But the rest kept on sinning and would not trust God's miracles.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛhe amukoraa si ne, bɛhɔle so bɛyɔle bɔne, banne ye anwanwadeɛ ne banni.

english_verse: So he cut their lives short and made them terrified.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔpɛle bɛ ngoa so kyɛ nwomeɛ, bɔ b’afoɛ bɔ wahã ne ɔɔyɛle ahunundetelɛ ɔ.

english_verse: After he killed some of them, the others turned to him with all their hearts.
translation_verse: Ohuhuni bɛ ne, bɛpenane ye si atee; bɛsakyerale b’adwene bɛpenane Nyameɛ si atee yé paa.

english_verse: They remembered God Most High, the mighty rock that kept them safe.
translation_verse: Afei bɛkayele kyɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte bɛ nyɔbotaen ɔ, na Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔte bɛ Defoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But they tried to flatter God, and they told him lies;
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ noa yeɛ bɛfa bɛdɛfɛdɛfɛle ye ɔ, nnakannaka dwirɛ yeɛ bɛkã bekyire ye ɔ.

english_verse: they were unfaithful and broke their promises.
translation_verse: B’ahone nu, banni nahorɛ bamma ye, banni ye apam ne anwo nahorɛ.

english_verse: Yet God was kind. He kept forgiving their sins and didn't destroy them. He often became angry, but never lost his temper.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔnate kyɛ ɔse anwumvoin ne ati, ɔfale b’amumuyɛɛ hyɛle bɛ, na wangukũ bɛ. Né ɔtaa ɔtwe ye yaa sa nziɛ, na wamva ye yaa ne amukoraa wangua bɛ so.

english_verse: God remembered that they were made of flesh and were like a wind that blows once and then dies down.
translation_verse: Ɔkayele kyɛ bɛte kuro mmenia, bɛte kyɛ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ bɔ onza mma ko ɔ.

english_verse: While they were in the desert, they often rebelled and made God sad.
translation_verse: Amba, bɛyɛle ye nwo lɔen wɔ ɛserɛ so mmerɛ pee, na bɛmane ye wora bɔle wɔ ɛserɛ so!

english_verse: They kept testing him and caused terrible pain for the Holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: Besole Nyameɛ bɛneane mmerɛ pee, na bewurale Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne apue.

english_verse: They forgot about his power and how he had rescued them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Bangaye ye tumi ne, anaa kyẽa bɔ olele bɛ fili pɔfoɛ ne sa nu ɔ,

english_verse: God showed them all kinds of wonderful miracles near Zoan in Egypt.
translation_verse: mmerɛ bɔ ɔyɔle ye nzɛngyerɛnneɛ wɔ Misraim, ɔne ye anwanwadeɛ wɔ Soan aseɛ pralaa so ne.

english_verse: He turned the rivers of Egypt into blood, and no one could drink from the streams.
translation_verse: Ɔkakyili b’asue mɔ mogya, amaa ɔnate so bangora banno b’asue ba mɔ nu nzue.

english_verse: He sent swarms of flies to pester the Egyptians, and he sent frogs to cause them trouble.
translation_verse: Ɔsomane atuin pembepembe paa wɔ bɛ berɛ maa bɛɛkekale bɛ, ɔne mborohyɛen maa bɛɛteeteele bɛ.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees with hail and floods.
translation_verse: Ɔtɔle asukɔtwea fa sɛkyele bɛ bobe mɔ, na ɔfale ɛborɔ sɛkyele b’akyea mmakaa mɔ.

english_verse: Then he killed their cattle with hail and their other animals with lightning.
translation_verse: Ɔtɔle asukɔtwea huhuni bɛ nandwie mɔ, yeɛ ɔtetele agralaa huhuni bɛ mmoaen mɔ.

english_verse: God was so angry and furious that he went into a rage and caused them great trouble by sending swarms of destroying angels.
translation_verse: Ɔsomane ye ahonehulɛ piri, ye yaafɛlɛ piri, anyeborolɛ ne amaneɛ, yeɛ abɔfo kure bɔ bɛsɛkye nningyein ɔ maa bɛhɔle bɛ so.

english_verse: Then God led his people out of Egypt and guided them in the desert like a flock of sheep.
translation_verse: Na afei olili ye mmenia nyunu kyɛ mmoaen, na ohyirele bɛ atee kyɛ mmoaen kure wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso.

english_verse: He led them safely along, and they were not afraid, but their enemies drowned in the sea.
translation_verse: Olili bɛ nyunu wɔ asomdwee nu ma yiti banzuro, nakoso bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ de, ɛpo ne bu fale bɛ so.

english_verse: God brought his people to the sacred mountain that he had taken by his own power.
translation_verse: Ɔfale bɛ wale ye aseɛ krongron ne aso, bokaa bɔ ye tumi asaa ne waho wale ne aso.

english_verse: He made nations run from the tribes of Israel, and he let the tribes take over their land.
translation_verse: Ɔfoane maen maen mɔ fili bɛ nyunu; ɔhyɛle b’aseɛ maa bɛfa bɛyɛle b’agyapadeɛ, na ɔmane Yisrael mmusua kure nemɔ bɛtenatenane b’ɛtena sua nemɔ anu.

english_verse: But the people tested God Most High, and they refused to obey his laws.
translation_verse: Nakoso besole Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne bɛneane, bɛyɛle ye nwo lɔen. Banni ye noa dwirɛ so,

english_verse: They were as unfaithful as their ancestors, and they were as crooked as a twisted arrow.
translation_verse: na mmom belili ye nwo makyebu, na banni nahorɛ kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ yɔle ne ala; bɛmane bɛ bra hyeale kyɛ agyaen bɔ wakondo ɔ.

english_verse: God demanded all their love, but they made him angry by worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛfale b’asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ bewurale ye apue maa ɔfɛle yaa; na b’amoen nemɔ ati, Nyameɛ hwene bɛ nwo nungunɛ.

english_verse: So God became furious and completely rejected the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ nwuni ye sɔ ne, ɔfɛle yaa paa, na ɔpole Yisrael koraa.

english_verse: Then he deserted his home at Shiloh, where he lived here on earth.
translation_verse: Ye atenaleɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Silo, ɛtena sua bɔ ɔtenane nu wɔ adasa mmaa nu ne, ɔpole ye.

english_verse: He let enemies capture the sacred chest and let them dishonor him.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa bɛhyele ye anwoserɛ ne nnure, yeɛ ɔfale ye animnyam wurale ye pɔfoɛ sa.

english_verse: God took out his anger on his chosen ones and let them be killed by enemy swords.
translation_verse: Ɔmane ye mmenia totɔle ngrandɛ noa, na ɔfɛle ye agyapadeɛ so yaa piri paa.

english_verse: Fire destroyed the young men, and the young women were left with no one to marry.
translation_verse: See yerale bɛ mmerandeɛ mɔ, na ye sɔ ti, bɛ ndaluwa mɔ bannya ebiala maa wangya bɛ.

english_verse: Priests died violent deaths, but their widows were not allowed to mourn.
translation_verse: B’asɔfo mɔ totɔle ngrandɛ noa, bɔ bɛ kunafoɛ mɔ bangora banzu bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Finally the Lord woke up, like a soldier startled from a drunken sleep.
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE dwɔsole kyɛ sona bɔ ofi nnaa nu ɔ, kyɛ anwoserɛniɛ bɔ nzaa maa ɔteatea nu ɔ.

english_verse: God scattered his enemies and made them ashamed forever.
translation_verse: Ohuhuni ye pɔfoɛ mɔ pasapasa, na oguale bɛ nyunu ase afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord decided not to make his home with Joseph's descendants in Ephraim.
translation_verse: Ɔpole Yosef ɛtena sua ne, na ɔneaneane nu ne, wanye Efraim abusua kure;

english_verse: Instead he chose the tribe of Judah, and he chose Mount Zion, the place he loves.
translation_verse: na mmom ɔneaneane nu yele Yuda abusua kure, bɔ ye ole Sion bokaa bɔ okuro ye dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: There he built his temple as lofty as the mountains and as solid as the earth he made to last forever.
translation_verse: Osili ye nekaa krongron bɔ ɔte kyɛ nyameɛso anwuro anwuro ne, bɔ ɔte kyɛ aseɛ bɔ wafa watimu berɛ afebɔɔ ne.

english_verse: The Lord God chose David to be his servant and took him from tending sheep
translation_verse: Ɔneaneane nu yele ye somvoɛ Dawide, ɔyele ye fili mmoaen so nealɛ nu,

english_verse: and from caring for lambs. Then God made him the leader of Israel, his own nation.
translation_verse: mmoaen bɔ bɛma bɛ mma nyɔfone ne, ɔmaa ɔyakyili bɛ so nealɛ, kyɛ ɔɔnea ye maen Yakob, bɔ ye ole Yisrael bɔ ɔte ye agyapadeɛ ne aso.

english_verse: David treated the people fairly and guided them with wisdom.
translation_verse: Dawide yele ye ti anu fitaa neane bɛ so, na ɔfale nimdeɛ atee so lili bɛ nyunu.

english_verse: Our God, foreign nations have taken your land, disgraced your temple, and left Jerusalem in ruins.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, maen maen mɔ bafa koɛ baateta w’agyapadeɛ, bafa efiɛ bahã w’asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron ne, babɔ Yerusalem kuro ne.

english_verse: They have fed the bodies of your servants to flesh-eating birds; your loyal people are food for savage animals.
translation_verse: Bafa wɔ somvoɛ mɔ bɛ fuin bama ewienu nnomaa maa bali, bafa w’anwoteefoɛ bɛ naen bama aseɛ so ngaka.

english_verse: All Jerusalem is covered with their blood, and there is no one left to bury them.
translation_verse: Bahã bɛ mogya bagua kyɛ nzue bapɛ Yerusalem nwo bayia, na ebiala nne berɛ bɔ okosie bɛ bɔ batotɔ nemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, will you keep on being angry? Will your angry feelings keep flaming up like fire?
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ɔkwaapem kyinzu? Aso ɛkɔfɛ yɛ so yaa afebɔɔ anaa? Wɔ nungunɛhwenɛ ne, aso okogye kyɛ see?

english_verse: Get angry with those nations that don't know you and won't worship you!
translation_verse: Amaen maen mɔ bɔ bɛnze wɔ ne, bɛ ne ahennie mɔ bɔ bɛmmɔ wɔ dumaa ne, ma w’ahone hu bɛ so paa.

english_verse: They have gobbled up Jacob's descendants and left the land in ruins.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bayɛ Yakob pasapasa, na bama ye atenaleɛ akakyi kurofoen.

english_verse: Don't make us pay for the sins of our ancestors. Have pity and come quickly! We are completely helpless.
translation_verse: Yɛ nana mɔ amumuyɛɛ ne, nnɛfa ye nwo ngyeleɛ kye yɛ, na nwu yɛ anwumvoin ndɛndɛ, ofikyɛ babrɛ yɛ ase bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Our God, you keep us safe. Now help us! Rescue us. Forgive our sins and bring honor to yourself.
translation_verse: Ao, yɛ ngoalelɛ Nyameɛ, boka yɛ, ɔnate wɔ dumaa nwo animnyam ti; pepɛ de yɛ, ná fa yɛ bɔne kyɛ yɛ, ɔnate wɔ dumaa ti.

english_verse: Why should nations ask us, “Where is your God?” Let us and the other nations see you take revenge for your servants who died a violent death.
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ maen maen mɔ bebisa kyɛ, “Bɛ Nyameɛ ne, ɔwɔ nisua” ɔ? Wɔ somvoɛ mɔ bɛ mogya so wereɛtɔlɛ ne, ma maen maen mɔ benwu ye bɔ yɛ koso yɛ nye tua ɔ.

english_verse: Listen to the prisoners groan! Let your mighty power save all who are sentenced to die.
translation_verse: Ma kukunufoɛ bɛ penenɛ bɔ bɛpene ne, odwu wɔ nyunu; gyina wɔ tumi piri ne aso pepɛ de bɛ bɔ bɛbaahu bɛ ne.

english_verse: Each of those nations sneered at you, our Lord. Now let others sneer at them, seven times as much.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ngorohoɛ bɔ maen maen bɔ bapɛ yɛ nwo bayia bɛgoro wɔ nwo ne, tua bɛ so kerɛ pɛen nzoo.

english_verse: Then we, your people, will always thank you. We are like sheep with you as our shepherd, and all generations will hear us praise you.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate so yɛ bɔ yɛte wɔ maen, mmoaen bɔ yɛdidi wɔ sa nu ne, yɛkɔla wɔ ase afebɔɔ; ofi aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ kɔka aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ, yɛkɔhɔ so yɛkɔye wɔ ayɛ.

english_verse: Shepherd of Israel, you lead the descendants of Joseph, and you sit on your throne above the winged creatures. Listen to our prayer and let your light shine
translation_verse: Ao Yisrael Neafoɛ, yɛ asoɛ tie, wɔ bɔ eli Yosef nyunu kyɛ mmoaen kure ɔ! Wɔ bɔ ɛte kɛrubim mɔ so ɔ, ta hyireinn

english_verse: for the tribes of Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Save us by your power.
translation_verse: wɔ Efraim, Benyamin ne Manase so. Kyire wɔ tumi, ná bra baapepɛ de yɛ!

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, maa yɛsa yɛbra wɔ berɛ; te wɔ nyunu kyire yɛ, amaa ɔnate so yanya ngoa.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, how much longer will the prayers of your people make you angry?
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ, wɔ maen mbaeɛ ne, ɛkɔfɛ ye nwo yaa maa okoodwu kyinzu?

english_verse: You gave us tears for food, and you made us drink them by the bowlful.
translation_verse: Afa bɛ nye moen ayɛ aleɛ maa bali, yeɛ ama bɛ moen pembepembe maa bano.

english_verse: Because of you, our enemies who live nearby laugh and joke about us.
translation_verse: Maen maen bɔ bapɛ yɛ nwo bayia ne, amaa bedi yɛ nwo apereapereɛ, na yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛsere yɛ.

english_verse: Our God, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Ao Asafo Nyameɛ, maa yɛsa yɛbra wɔ berɛ; te wɔ nyunu kyire yɛ, amaa ɔnate so yanya ngoa.

english_verse: We were like a grapevine you brought out of Egypt. You chased other nations away and planted us here.
translation_verse: Etuli bobe bo fili Misraim wale, ɛfoane amaen maen mɔ fili aseɛ ne aso, na eluale.

english_verse: Then you cleared the ground, and we put our roots deep, spreading over the land.
translation_verse: Esiesiele aseɛ ne aso mane ye, otirale ndii, na ɔtrɛtrɛ katale aseɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Shade from this vine covered the mountains. Its branches climbed the mighty cedars
translation_verse: Ye bo fɔnwoo ne katale mmokaa nemɔ aso, na ye mmaen frɔmfrɔm ne katale sida mbiri ne aso.

english_verse: and stretched to the sea; its new growth reached to the river.
translation_verse: Ye mmaen frɔmfrɔm trɛtrɛle alaa ooguale ɛpo nu, yeɛ ye nyaa ne ɔɔhane Asue ne anwo.

english_verse: Our Lord, why have you torn down the wall from around the vineyard? You let everyone who walks by pick the grapes.
translation_verse: Na nzu ati yeɛ abubu ye nwo fasue mɔ agua ye maa ebiala bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ ne, ɔtete ye mma ne bie e?

english_verse: Now the vine is gobbled up by pigs from the forest and other wild animals.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔayeɛ nu kɔkɔte tiatia so, na eburo ngaka amukoraa bɛtete bedi.

english_verse: God All-Powerful, please do something! Look down from heaven and see what's happening to this vine.
translation_verse: Ao Asafo Nyameɛ, sa baanea yɛ; to wɔ nye fi nyameɛso nea, ná baanea bobe ye aso,

english_verse: With your own hands you planted its roots, and you raised it as your very own.
translation_verse: bobe boo bɔ ɛnate wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ tumi so ayɛ ne, ɔne mmaen bɔ afa atindim berɛ ama wɔ nwo ne.

english_verse: Enemies chopped the vine down and set it on fire. Now show your anger and destroy them.
translation_verse: Bafa see bayera ye, bapɛ bato ase; sɛ wɔ nye boro bɛ so a, bewuwu!

english_verse: But help the one who sits at your right side, the one you raised to be your very own.
translation_verse: Nakoso sona bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ sa famaa so ne, sona awa bɔ wɔ ti amaa wanya anwoserɛ ne, nea ye so, ná bɔ ye nwo waen.

english_verse: Then we will never turn away. Put new life into us, and we will worship you.
translation_verse: Ɔba ye sɔ a, yɛngɔkakyi yɛ si yɛngɔma wɔ. Maa yɛnya ngoa, na yɛkɔbɔ wɔ dumaa.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, make us strong again! Smile on us and save us.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ, maa yɛsa yɛbra wɔ berɛ; te wɔ nyunu kyire yɛ, amaa ɔnate so yanya ngoa.

english_verse: Be happy and shout to God who makes us strong! Shout praises to the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte y’anwoserɛ ne, ɛ́mɔtea nu bɛto ye nwo dwein; ɛ́mɔfa ahurusi bɛbɔ Yakob Nyameɛ ne nwo ese.

english_verse: Sing as you play tambourines and the lovely sounding stringed instruments.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔkenga edwein, ɛ́mɔwoso akasaa ne, ɛ́mɔbɔ sangoo fɛɛfɛɛ ne adengum ne.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and start the New Moon Festival. We must also celebrate when the moon is full.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhu totorobɛndo wɔ ɛsraen foforɛ aluolue ne, mmerɛ bɔ ɛsraen kɔyɛ mumua ne, wɔ y’aluolue kyẽa ne.

english_verse: This is the law in Israel, and it was given to us by the God of Jacob.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔte ahyɛdeɛ ma Yisrael, ɔte Yakob Nyameɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ.

english_verse: The descendants of Joseph were told to obey it, when God led them out from the land of Egypt. In a voice unknown to me, I heard someone say:
translation_verse: Ɔmaa ɔyɛle ahyɛdeɛ mane Yosef, mmerɛ bɔ ohwi fale Misraim aseɛ so hɔle, nekaa bɔ ndele dwudwolɛ bie bɔ nndele bie le ne.

english_verse: “I lifted the burden from your shoulder and took the heavy basket from your hands.
translation_verse: “Nyele adesoa piri ne mvili ye bati so, ye sa yakyili kɛndɛen kukulɛ.

english_verse: When you were in trouble, I rescued you, and from the thunderclouds, I answered your prayers. Later I tested you at Meribah Spring.
translation_verse: Esu frɛle me wɔ w’amaneɛnwunɛ nu, na mbepɛ nnele wɔ; nekaa bɔ agralaa wɔ wɔ mvealeɛ nu ne, berɛ yeɛ mmane wɔ mmuayɛɛ, na nzole wɔ neane wɔ Meriba asue anwo. Sela

english_verse: “Listen, my people, while I, the Lord, correct you! Israel, if you would only pay attention to me!
translation_verse: Me maen, ɛ́mɔtie maa ndu ɛmɔ foɛ. Ao Yisrael, sɛ ahaa ekotie me dwirɛ a!

english_verse: Don't worship foreign gods or bow down to gods you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Onni kyɛ enya nyameɛ foforɛ biala wɔ wɔ nu; nnɛso maenmaensofoɛ nyameɛ biala.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I rescued you from Egypt. Just ask, and I will give you whatever you need.
translation_verse: Me ole AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ, bɔ ɔyele wɔ fili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne. Bukye wɔ noa nu hambonnwu, na ngɔfa nningyein ngowura ye tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: “But, my people, Israel, you refused to listen, and you would have nothing to do with me!
translation_verse: “Nakoso me maen bandie me dwirɛ, Yisrael wammrɛ ye nwo ase wamma me.

english_verse: So I let you be stubborn and keep on following your own advice.
translation_verse: Yiti nyakyili maa bɛyɔle bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bekuro ɔ, maa bɛyɔle bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ b’adwene ma bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: “My people, Israel, if only you would listen and do as I say!
translation_verse: Ao, sɛ ahaa me maen kotie me dwirɛ a, sɛ ahaa Yisrael kɔnate m’atee so a!

english_verse: I, the Lord, would quickly defeat your enemies with my mighty power.
translation_verse: Ahaa ngɔbrɛ bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ ase ndɛndɛ, ná mafa me tumi mali bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ so ngonim.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me would come crawling, and that would be the end of them.
translation_verse: Sɛ ahaa AWURADE pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛkɔkoto ye nyunu a, ahaa bɛ mmerɛ kɔyɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: But I would feed you with the finest bread and with the best honey until you were full.”
translation_verse: Ahaa ngɔma bɛ aleɛ paa maa bekoli, na ngɔma bɛ nyɔbotaen nu woɛ ma bɛ ko koyi.”

english_verse: When all the other gods have come together, the Lord God judges them and says:
translation_verse: Nyameɛ atena ye bia nu wɔ nyameɛso badwa ne anu, na obua nyameɛ mɔ ndɛen kyɛ,

english_verse: “How long will you keep judging unfairly and favoring evil people?
translation_verse: “Kyinzu koraa yeɛ ɛmɔkobua ndɛengyea, ná ɛmɔayɛ nyeyemuɛ bagyina bɔnefoɛ si maa waadwu ɔ. Sela

english_verse: Be fair to the poor and to orphans. Defend the helpless and everyone in need.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔli ehiafoɛ ne nyisiaafoɛ bɛ dwirɛ bɛma bɛ; ɛ́mɔbua bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ne bɛ bɔ belle bie ɔ ndɛen turoloo.

english_verse: Rescue the weak and homeless from the powerful hands of heartless people.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔpepɛ bele bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ ne ehiafoɛ, ɛ́mɔpepɛ bele bɛ befi bɔnefoɛ mɔ sa nu.”

english_verse: “None of you know or understand a thing. You live in darkness, while the foundations of the earth tremble.
translation_verse: Belle nimdeɛ, yeɛ belle ndeaseɛ, bɛnate awosii nu; aseɛ fapem amukoraati ɔwoso.

english_verse: “I, the Most High God, say that all of you are gods and also my own children.
translation_verse: Menwa nyoo, “Ɛmɔte nyameɛ mɔ, ɛmɔ amukoraa, ɛmɔte Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne, ye mma mmɔ.

english_verse: But you will die, just like everyone else, including powerful rulers.”
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔkowuwu kyɛ adasa mmaa, na ɛmɔkɔtotɔ kyɛ ɛhene biala.

english_verse: Do something, God! Judge the nations of the earth; they belong to you.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, dwɔso ná bua aseɛ so ama ndɛen, ofikyɛ maen maen amukoraa bɛte w’agyapadeɛ!

english_verse: Our God, don't just sit there, silently doing nothing!
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, nnɛkã wɔ noa to nu; ao Nyameɛ, nnɛmua wɔ noa, yeɛ nnɛyɛ konn!

english_verse: Your hateful enemies are turning against you and rebelling.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛyɛ bagyabagya, bɛ bɔ bekyi wɔ nemɔ, bɛyɛ lɔen.

english_verse: They are sly, and they plot against those you treasure.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔ wɔ maen nwo nwandanwona porɛ, na bɛkɔ mmenia bɔ ɛbɔ bɛ nwo waen ne nwo agyina tɛɛ.

english_verse: They say, “Let's wipe out the nation of Israel and make sure that no one remembers its name!”
translation_verse: Bɛnwa, “Ɛmɔbra maa yɛnua bɛ maen ne aboso, amaa ɔnate so ebiala wangaye Yisrael dumaa ko.”

english_verse: All of them fully agree in their plans against you, and among them are
translation_verse: Bɛyɛ adwene ko bɛbɔ porɛ; bɛyɛ apam betia wɔ:

english_verse: Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagrites;
translation_verse: Edomfoɛ ne Yismaelfoɛ, Moabo ne Hagritefoɛ,

english_verse: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia and Phoenicia.
translation_verse: Gebal ne Amon ne Amalɛke, Filistia ne Tirofoɛ.

english_verse: Even Assyria has joined forces with Moab and Ammon.
translation_verse: Asiria koso ɔɔbokale bɛ so, bɛfale b’anwoserɛ beegyinane Lɔto boso ama nemɔ bɛ si. Sela

english_verse: Our Lord, punish all of them as you punished Midian. Destroy them, as you destroyed Sisera and Jabin at Kishon Creek
translation_verse: Bɔ ɛfa yɛle Midian, Sisera ne Yabin wɔ asue Kison nwo ne, fa sɔ alaa yɛ bɛ.

english_verse: Treat their leaders as you did Oreb and Zeeb, Zebah and Zalmunna.
translation_verse: Ma bɛ mmenia titire mɔ bɛyɛ kyɛ Orebo ne Seebo, ma b’ahemvo mɔ bɛyɛ kyɛ Seba ne Samuna

english_verse: All of them said, “We'll take God's valuable land!”
translation_verse: bɔ bɛhane kyɛ, “Nyameɛ atenaleɛ ne, ɛ́mɔma yɛho yɛfa yɛyɛ yɛ deɛ” ne.

english_verse: Our God, scatter them around like dust in a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Ao me Nyameɛ, maa bɛyɛ kyɛ atendirehuo, maa bɛyɛ kyɛ afafu bɔ mvrama bɔ ye ɔ.

english_verse: Just as flames destroy forests on the mountains,
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ see yera ɛhɔayeɛ too ne, kyɛbɔ buruburugya yera mmokaa motoo ne,

english_verse: Make them blush with shame, until they turn and worship you, our Lord.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ma animguaseɛ bia bɛ, amaa ɔnate so bapena wɔ dumaa si atee.

english_verse: Let them be forever ashamed and confused. Let them die in disgrace.
translation_verse: Ma bɛ nyunu gua ase, ná bɛteetee daa, maa bewu animguaseɛ wue.

english_verse: Make them realize that you are the Lord Most High, the only ruler of earth!
translation_verse: Maa benwu kyɛ wɔ bɔ wɔ ngome yeɛ wɔ dumaa ole AWURADE ne, wɔ yeɛ ɛte Anwuro Anwuro hene bɔ edi aseɛ amukoraa so ɔ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, your temple is so lovely!
translation_verse: Ao Asafo AWURADE, w’atenaleɛ ne, kyɛbɔ osi yɛ nyemene ɔ!

english_verse: Deep in my heart I long for your temple, and with all that I am I sing joyful songs to you.
translation_verse: Amba, me kra tena a ɔndena, na ye wora dɔ AWURADE awuro aluo berɛ ne; m’ahone ne me nwonaen bɛto Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne anwo anigye dwein.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, my King and my God, sparrows find a home near your altars; swallows build nests there to raise their young.
translation_verse: Ao Asafo AWURADE, me Hene ne me Nyameɛ, akatipire po wanya atenaleɛ, yeɛ nandwinoma anya ye saen wɔ w’afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo bɔ ɔkɔfa ye mma kogua nu ɔ.

english_verse: You bless everyone who lives in your house, and they sing your praises.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛtena w’awuro berɛ ne, benya saleɛ, na bɛto wɔ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein daa. Sela

english_verse: You bless all who depend on you for their strength and all who deeply desire to visit your temple.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ wɔ nu yeɛ b’anwoserɛ wɔ ne, benya saleɛ, na Sion atimbire wɔ b’ahone nu.

english_verse: When they reach Dry Valley, springs start flowing, and the autumn rain fills it with pools of water.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛnate Baka bɔnza nu a, bɛmaa ɔkakyi mbombonzue aseɛ, na asuso ma saleɛ ba so.

english_verse: Your people grow stronger, and you, the God of gods, will be seen in Zion.
translation_verse: Bɛnate a, befi anwoserɛ nu bɛkɔ anwoserɛ nu, na bɛ nu biala bafite Nyameɛ nyunu wɔ Sion.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, the God of Jacob, please answer my prayer!
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ, tie me mbaeɛ. Ao Yakob Nyameɛ, yɛ asoɛ tie! Sela

english_verse: You are the shield that protects your people, and I am your chosen one. Won't you smile on me?
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, y’akokyɛm, tie, ná bɔ apopa ye ngoo ne, do ye.

english_verse: One day in your temple is better than a thousand anywhere else. I would rather serve in your house, than live in the homes of the wicked.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛlɛhomapɛ bɔ ngoli ye wɔ w’aluo berɛ ne, ɔte paa tra ngyẽa apee bɔ ngoli ye nekaa bie ɔ. Mekuro kyɛ ngɔyɛ me Nyameɛ awuro berɛ anoa wɛmvoɛ tra kyɛ ngɔtena bɔnefoɛ ɛtena sua nu ɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you are like the sun and also like a shield. You treat us with kindness and with honor, never denying any good thing to those who live right.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ te eyia ne akokyɛm; ye yeɛ ɔdo sona ná ɔmaa onya animnyam ɔ, na bɛ bɔ bɛ bra te sannwuu ne, ɔmva nikye paa biala mmɔ bɛ atianuserɛ.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful, you bless everyone who trusts you.
translation_verse: Ao Asafo AWURADE, ebiala bɔ ye wora wura wɔ nu ne, onya saleɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have blessed your land and made all go well for Jacob's descendants.
translation_verse: AWURADE, ɛlole wɔ maen; ɛfale Yakob fili nnurehyelɛ nu sa wale.

english_verse: You have forgiven the sin and taken away the guilt of your people.
translation_verse: Ɛfale wɔ maen ye amumuyɛɛ hyɛle ye; ɛfale bɛ bɔne amukoraa hyɛle bɛ. Sela

english_verse: Your fierce anger is no longer aimed at us.
translation_verse: Ɛhwene wɔ yaa piri ne amukoraa sale, ɛmane w’ahone tɔle nzue nu.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you save us! Please bring us back home and don't be angry.
translation_verse: Ao yɛ ngoalelɛ Nyameɛ, maa yɛsa yɛbra wɔ berɛ, na ɛyaa bɔ afɛ ye wɔ yɛ so ne, yakyi maa ɔha.

english_verse: Will you always be angry with us and our families?
translation_verse: Aso ɛkɔfɛ yɛ so yaa afebɔɔ? Aso ɛkɔma wɔ yaa ne kɔhɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa bɛ so?

english_verse: Won't you give us fresh life and let your people be glad because of you?
translation_verse: Aso engosa ngɔpagya yɛ ko, amaa ɔnate so wɔ maen bali ahurusi wɔ wɔ nu anaa?

english_verse: I will listen to you, Lord God, because you promise peace to those who are faithful and no longer foolish.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte AWURADE ne, ngotie bɔ ɔkɔhã ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔkɔhã asomdwee dwirɛ kohyire ye maen ne ye anwoteefoɛ, nakoso onni kyɛ besa bekodi ngwaseasɛm.

english_verse: You are ready to rescue everyone who worships you, so that you will live with us in all your glory.
translation_verse: Amba, ye ngoalelɛ pingye bɛ bɔ besuro ye ɔ, na ye animnyam ne kɔtena ye aseɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Love and loyalty will come together; goodness and peace will unite.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔne nahorɛlilɛ bekoyia; tenenee ne asomdwee bɛkɔyɛ bɛ nwo awaawaatuu.

english_verse: Loyalty will sprout from the ground; justice will look down from the sky above.
translation_verse: Nahorɛlilɛ kopukye kofi aseɛnwo, ná tenenee wato ye nye wafi nyameɛso wanea aseɛnwo.

english_verse: Our Lord, you will bless us; our land will produce wonderful crops.
translation_verse: Amba, AWURADE kɔfa nningyein paa kɔma, na y’aseɛ kɔhye aleɛ.

english_verse: Justice will march in front, making a path for you to follow.
translation_verse: Tenenee koli ye nyunu, na ɔkɔbɔ atimbire bɔ ɔkɔfa so ɔ kɔma ye.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord, and answer my prayer! I am poor and helpless.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, yɛ asoɛ tie me, ná bua me, ofikyɛ wahia me, yeɛ meyɛ anwumvo.

english_verse: Protect me and save me because you are my God. I am your faithful servant, and I trust you.
translation_verse: Bɔ me ngoa nwo waen, ofikyɛ me nwo te. Wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Nyameɛ ɔ; pepɛ de wɔ somvoɛ bɔ wafa ye wora wawura wɔ nu ne.

english_verse: Be kind to me! I pray to you all day.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nwu me anwumvoin, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ daa mesu mefrɛ wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Make my heart glad! I serve you, and my prayer is sincere.
translation_verse: Ma wɔ somvoɛ ye kra nye gye, ofikyɛ ao AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ mema me kra sũ frɛ wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You willingly forgive, and your love is always there for those who pray to you.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ɛte paa, na ɛfa bɔne kyɛ; wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ɔsone ma bɛ bɔ besu bɛfrɛ wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Please listen, Lord! Answer my prayer for help.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, mesrɛ wɔ, tie me mbaeɛ; tie me sufrɛ bɔ ofi me noa ne.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray, knowing you will listen.
translation_verse: M’anwokyere mmerɛ nu, mesu mefrɛ wɔ, ofikyɛ ebua me.

english_verse: You created each nation, and they will all bow down to worship and honor you.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, amaen maen amukoraa bɔ ɛyɔle ne, bɛkɔwa bɛkɔɔbɔ bɛ nu ase wɔ wɔ nyunu, ná bahyɛ wɔ dumaa animnyam.

english_verse: You perform great wonders because you alone are God.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛte piri, na ɛyɔ anwanwadeɛ, wɔ ngome yeɛ ɛte Nyameɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Teach me to follow you, and I will obey your truth. Always keep me faithful.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, kyire me w’atee ne, amaa ɔnate so mali wɔ nahorɛ dwirɛ ne aso. Maa nzi m’adwene pi mva nzuro wɔ dumaa.

english_verse: With all my heart I thank you. I praise you, Lord God.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ, ngɔfa m’ahone amukoraa ngɔye wɔ ayɛ, na ngɔhyɛ wɔ dumaa animnyam afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Your love for me is so great that you protected me from death and the grave.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi bɔ ɛye ye ali kyire me ne, ɔte piri, na apepɛ ale me kra afi ɛborɔ kumaa nu.

english_verse: Proud and violent enemies, who don't care about you, have ganged up to attack and kill me.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, anwomasoɛfoɛ badwɔso batia me, atianuserɛfoɛ bɛpena me beku me, na bɛmva wɔ bɛnyɛ huu.

english_verse: But you, the Lord God, are kind and merciful. You don't easily get angry, and your love can always be trusted.
translation_verse: Nakoso, ao AWURADE, ɛte Nyameɛ bɔ ɛse anwumvoin ná ɛdo mmenia ɔ; w’ahone nhu ndɛ, na wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne, ɔsone.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord, and I am the child of one of your servants. Look on me with kindness. Make me strong and save me.
translation_verse: Baanea me ná nwu me anwumvoin; fa w’anwoserɛ ne ma wɔ somvoɛ, ná pepɛ de w’afaneɛ awa ne.

english_verse: Show that you approve of me! Then my hateful enemies will feel like fools, because you have helped and comforted me.
translation_verse: Kyire me wɔ ɛlolɛ ne nwo sɛngyerɛnneɛ, amaa ɔnate so me pɔfoɛ mɔ banwu ye ná bafɛre, ofikyɛ AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ aboka me akyekye me wora ɔ.

english_verse: Zion was built by the Lord on the holy mountain,
translation_verse: AWURADE kuro bɔ wakyekye ne, ye fapem gyi bokaa krongron ne aso.

english_verse: and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
translation_verse: AWURADE kuro Sion pambim nemɔ dwirɛ tra Yakob atenaleɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
translation_verse: Ao, Nyameɛ kuro, animnyam dwirɛ yeɛ bɛkã bɛfa wɔ nwo ɔ. Sela

english_verse: Egypt, Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia, and Ethiopia are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛse me ne, mebɔ Rahabo ne Babilɔn dumaa wɔ b’afia; Filistia, Tiro yeɛ Yitiopia bɛnwa, “Berɛ yeɛ bɛwole ɛhe ɔ.”

english_verse: God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
translation_verse: Na bɛkɔhã bɛkɔfa Sion nwo kyɛ, “Sona he ne asomasi koso, kuro ne anu berɛ yeɛ bɛwole bɛ ɔ”; ofikyɛ Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne bɔbɔ kɔmaa kuro ne kogyina.

english_verse: The Lord will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
translation_verse: AWURADE hyerɛle tole berɛ mmerɛ bɔ né ɔkyerɛkyerɛ maen maen mɔ dumaa ne kyɛ, “Ɛhe, bɛwole ye wɔ berɛ.” Sela

english_verse: All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
translation_verse: Edweintolɛfoɛ ne abiliegolɛfoɛ bɛkã kyɛ, “Wɔ nu yeɛ me saleɛ amukoraa wɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: You keep me safe, Lord God. So when I pray at night,
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, me ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ, mesu wɔ wɔ nyunu eyia ne kɔngɔen.

english_verse: please listen carefully to each of my concerns.
translation_verse: Ma me mbaeɛ odwu wɔ nyunu, yɛ asoɛ tie me sufrɛ.

english_verse: I am deeply troubled and close to death;
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ amaneɛ pee atoto me kra, na me kra apingye ɛborɔ.

english_verse: I am as good as dead and completely helpless.
translation_verse: Bebu me bɛfra bɛ bɔ bapingye ɛborɔ kumaa ne, nde kyɛ sona bɔ olle mmokalɛ biala ɔ.

english_verse: I am no better off than those in the grave, those you have forgotten and no longer help.
translation_verse: Mayɛ kyɛ ebie bɔ bayakyi ye bato awufoɛ nu ɔ, kyɛ bɛ bɔ bahu bɛ bagua asieleɛ kumaa nu ɔ, kyɛ bɛ bɔ ɛngaye bɛ ko, bɔ aye wɔ sa afi bɛ bo ɔ.

english_verse: You have put me in the deepest and darkest grave;
translation_verse: Agyi me ato ɛborɔ kumaa kuronn ne anu, wɔ nekaa kuronn tunn ne anu dɔ.

english_verse: your anger rolls over me like ocean waves.
translation_verse: Afɛ me so yaa piri, na ɛma w’asorɔkye amukoraa bungam fa me so. Sela

english_verse: You have made my friends turn in horror from me. I am a prisoner who cannot escape,
translation_verse: Ama me mmango mɔ bapo me, amaa makakyi bɛ nye so akyiwadeɛ bie. Bato me nu bɔ mengora fite ɔ.

english_verse: and I am almost blind because of my sorrow. Each day I lift my hands in prayer to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Aworabɔlɛ ama me nye mmaa apakye. Ao AWURADE, daa mesu mefrɛ wɔ; metrɛ me sa nu mebɔ mbaeɛ mekyire wɔ.

english_verse: Do you work miracles for the dead? Do they stand up and praise you?
translation_verse: Aso ɛyɔ anwanwadeɛ ma awufoɛ? Aso awufoɛ bɛkora bedwɔso bɛye wɔ ayɛ anaa? Sela

english_verse: Do they know of your miracles or your saving power in the dark world below where all is forgotten?
translation_verse: Aso benwu w’anwanwadeɛ wɔ awosii ne anu, anaa benwu wɔ ngoalelɛ mmokalɛ ne wɔ aseɛ bɔ bɛngaye mmenia wɔ so ne aso?

english_verse: Why do you reject me? Why do you turn from me?
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nzu ati yeɛ apo me kra ye? Nzu ati yeɛ aye wɔ nye afea me ye?

english_verse: Ever since I was a child, I have been sick and close to death. You have terrified me and made me helpless.
translation_verse: Ofi me ngwadaa nu yeɛ manwu amaneɛ, bɔ ewue li me mvanvando ɔ; manwu amaneɛ piri wɔ wɔ sa nu, na meteetee.

english_verse: Your anger is like a flood! And I am shattered by your furious attacks
translation_verse: Wɔ yaa piri ne wabungam wafa me so, wɔ ɛteeteelɛ ne, wamaa mawu bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: My friends and neighbors have turned against me because of you, and now darkness is my only companion.
translation_verse: Ama m’adɔfo mɔ ne me damvo mɔ bapo me; na awosii yeɛ ɔte mmiɛngo ɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, I will sing of your love forever. Everyone yet to be born will hear me praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ngɔto wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne anwo dwein daa, na ngɔte me noa ngɔbɔ wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne anwo dawure ngohyire aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: I will tell them, “God's love can always be trusted, and his faithfulness lasts as long as the heavens.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mahã kyɛ, Ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ye bo atindim afebɔɔ; wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne, ama ye bo atimu wɔ nyameɛso.

english_verse: You said, “David, my servant, is my chosen one, and this is the agreement I made with him:
translation_verse: Me ne me sona bɔ maneanea nu maye ye ne yayɛ apam, mata ndaen mahyire me somvoɛ Dawide kyɛ,

english_verse: Our Lord, let the heavens now praise your miracles, and let all your angels praise your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nyameɛso kɔkamvo w’anwanwadeɛ, bɛkamvo wɔ nahorɛlilɛ wɔ krongronfoɛ badwa nu.

english_verse: None who live in the heavens can compare with you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nwa yeɛ ɔwɔ ewienu bɔ bɛkɔfa ye bɛkɔtoto AWURADE nwo ɔ? Nyameɛsofoɛ mɔ, nwa yeɛ ɔte kyɛ AWURADE ɔ?

english_verse: You are the most fearsome of all who live in heaven; all the others fear and greatly honor you.
translation_verse: Ɔte Nyameɛ bɔ besuro ye wɔ krongronfoɛ badwa nu ɔ, ɔte piri, na ye nwo yɛ suro tra bɛ bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia amukoraa.
