english_verse: You are Lord God All-Powerful! No one is as loving and faithful as you are.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ, nwa yeɛ ole anwoserɛ kyɛ wɔ ɔ, ao AWURADE? Wɔ nahorɛlilɛ apɛ wɔ nwo ayia.

english_verse: You crushed the monster Rahab, and with your powerful arm you scattered your enemies.
translation_verse: Ɛpɛkyɛle Rahabo kyɛ naenmvuin, na ele wɔ tumi ne mane wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛbɔle aya.

english_verse: The heavens and the earth belong to you. And so does the world with all its people because you created them
translation_verse: Nyameɛso te wɔ deɛ, yeɛ aseɛ koso te wɔ deɛ; wiase ne nu nningyein amukoraa, wɔ yeɛ ɛbɔle bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and everything else. Mount Tabor and Mount Hermon gladly praise you.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ ɛbɔle sorɔ ne ngwaen ɔ, Tabɔ ne Hɛmɔn bele anigye bɛye wɔ dumaa ayɛ.

english_verse: Your kingdom is ruled by justice and fairness with love and faithfulness leading the way.
translation_verse: Tenenee ne ndɛenbualɛ turoloo te w’ahennie bia nyinasoɛ; ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ɔne nahorɛlilɛ beli wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless those who join in the festival and walk in the brightness of your presence.
translation_verse: Maen bɔ bɛse ayɛyelɛ nwo esebɔlɛ ne, benya saleɛ; bɛ yeɛ bɛnate wɔ nyunu hyireinn ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: We are happy all day because of you, and your saving power brings honor to us.
translation_verse: Bedi ahurusi wɔ wɔ dumaa nu daa, na wɔ tenenee ne anu yeɛ oyie bɛ yé ɔ.

english_verse: Your own glorious power makes us strong, and because of your kindness, our strength increases.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ ɛte b’anwoserɛ animnyam ɔ, na w’adom yeɛ ɔmaa yɛdi ngonim ɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our King, the Holy One of Israel, you are truly our shield.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE yeɛ ɔte y’akokyɛm ɔ, Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne yeɛ ɔte yɛ Hene ɔ.

english_verse: In a vision, you once said to your faithful followers: “I have helped a mighty hero. I chose him from my people and made him famous.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bie, ɛnate nyekyire so dwudwo hyirele wɔ nahorɛniɛ ne kyɛ, “Mafa mmokalɛ mama ebie bɔ ye nwo yɛ se ɔ, na sona bɔ maneanea maen ne anu maye ye ne, mapagya ye.

english_verse: David, my servant, is the one I chose to be king,
translation_verse: Manwu me somvoɛ Dawide, mafa me ngoo krongron ne mapopa ye.

english_verse: and I will always be there to help and strengthen him.
translation_verse: Me tumi kogyina ye si, na m’abasa ne kɔma ye anwoserɛ.

english_verse: “No enemy will outsmart David, and he won't be defeated by any hateful people.
translation_verse: Pɔfoɛ ne ngɔhora ngɔlakalaka ye, na bɔnefoɛ ne ngɔhora ngoli ye so.

english_verse: I will strike down and crush his troublesome enemies.
translation_verse: Ngɔpɛkyɛ ye pɔfoɛ mɔ wɔ ye nyunu, ná mahũhũ bɛ bɔ bekyi ye ɔ.

english_verse: He will always be able to depend on my love, and I will make him strong with my own power.
translation_verse: Me nahorɛlilɛ ne me ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, bekogyina ye si; na me dumaa nu yeɛ ɔkɔhɔ so konya anwoserɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I will let him rule the lands across the rivers and seas.
translation_verse: Ngɔmaa ye sa konya ɛpo so tumi, ná mama ye sa famaa anya asue mɔ so tumi.

english_verse: He will say to me, ‘You are my Father and my God, as well as the mighty rock where I am safe.’
translation_verse: Okose me kyɛ, ‘Wɔ yeɛ ɛte me baba, me Nyameɛ ne me ngoalelɛ Nyɔbotaen ɔ!

english_verse: “I have chosen David as my first-born son, and he will be the ruler of all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa ye ngɔyɛ me bamuɛbaa, aseɛ so ahemvo amukoraa bɛ nu titire paa.

english_verse: My love for him will last, and my agreement with him will never be broken.
translation_verse: Ngɔye me ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ali ngohyire ye afebɔɔ, na m’apam ne bo kotindim kɔma ye.

english_verse: “One of David's descendants will always be king, and his family will rule until the sky disappears.
translation_verse: Ngɔma ye boso ama bekoli hene afebɔɔ, na kyɛ nyameɛso tɛwɔ berɛ ye de, ye ahennie kɔtena berɛ.

english_verse: Suppose some of his children should reject my Law and refuse my instructions.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ye boso ama bɛpo me mmeraa ne, ná bamva me nhyehyɛleɛ bammɔ bɛ bra,

english_verse: Or suppose they should disobey all of my teachings.
translation_verse: sɛ betwi bɛfa m’ahyɛdeɛ so, ná bandie me mmeraa dwirɛ a,

english_verse: Then I will correct and punish them because of their sins.
translation_verse: ye de ngɔfa mbire ngɔhwe bɛ so wɔ bɛ mmeraatolɛ nwo, ná mafa bakaa mahwe bɛ so wɔ b’amumuyɛɛ nwo.

english_verse: But I will always love David and faithfully keep all of my promises to him.
translation_verse: Nakoso mengɔye me ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne mengofi ye so, yeɛ mengɔkakyi me si mengɔma me nahorɛlilɛ ne.

english_verse: “I won't break my agreement or go back on my word.
translation_verse: Mengobu m’apam ne aso, yeɛ mengɔsesã me noa.

english_verse: I have sworn once and for all by my own holy name, and I won't lie to David.
translation_verse: Mafa me krongronyɛlɛ mata ndaen komapɛ twe; mengɔpɛ anoanu mengohyire Dawide.

english_verse: His family will always rule. I will let his kingdom last as long as the sun
translation_verse: Ye boso ama koli hene afebɔɔ, na kyɛ eyia tɛwɔ berɛ ye de, ye ahennie kɔtena berɛ wɔ me nyunu.

english_verse: and moon appear in the sky.”
translation_verse: Okotimu afebɔɔ kyɛ ɛsraen, bɔ ɔte adanzeniɛ nahorɛniɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ewienu ɔ.

english_verse: You are now angry, Lord, and you have turned your back on your chosen king.
translation_verse: Nakoso ato ye aye apo ye; afɛ wɔ sona bɔ apopa ye ngoo ne aso ɛyaa piri paa.

english_verse: You broke off your agreement with your servant, the king, and you completely destroyed his kingdom.
translation_verse: W’apam bɔ ɛne wɔ somvoɛ bayɛ ne, afa ato ahameɛ, ye ahennie abotire ne, agyi ato ase agua ye nwo fiɛ.

english_verse: The walls of his city have been broken through, and every fortress now lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Abɔngyebɔngye ye fasue amukoraa nu ndokuro, na adwiri ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ mɔ agua ase.

english_verse: All who pass by take what they want, and nations everywhere joke about the king.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛpɛ nu berɛ bɛkɔ ne, bɛfẽ ye nningyein; wayɛ ngorohoɛ dwirɛ wɔ ye mmango nu.

english_verse: You made his enemies powerful and let them celebrate.
translation_verse: Ama bɛ bɔ bɛhyɛ ye so ne bali ye so ngonim, ama ye pɔfoɛ amukoraa bali ahurusi.

english_verse: But you forced him to retreat because you did not fight on his side.
translation_verse: Afei koso, ama ye ngrandɛ noa atiri, na angyina ye si wɔ koɛ nu.

english_verse: You took his crown and threw his throne in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ale ɛhɔtɔ ne afi ye sa nu, yeɛ afindi ye ahennie bia ne ato ase.

english_verse: You made an old man of him and put him to shame.
translation_verse: Apɛ ye animnyam mmerɛ so; yeɛ amaa animguaseɛ abia ye. Sela

english_verse: How much longer, Lord? Will you hide forever? How long will your anger keep burning like fire?
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ɛkɔfa wɔ nwo kɔfea maa okoodwu kyinzu? W’ahone kohu kogye kyɛ see maa okoodwu kyinzu?

english_verse: Remember, life is short! Why did you empty our lives of all meaning?
translation_verse: Kaye kyɛbɔ me ngoa si te tikaape ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɛbɔle adasa mmaa mane nningyein bɔ ɔte mbaen ɔ!

english_verse: No one can escape the power of death and the grave.
translation_verse: Dasaniɛ beni yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔtena ase alaa bɔ ongowu ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kole ye kra kofi ɛborɔ sa nu ɔ? Sela

english_verse: Our Lord, where is the love you have always shown and that you promised so faithfully to David?
translation_verse: AWURADE, wɔ daa tete ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ nisua, ɔdɔ bɔ ɛnate wɔ nahorɛlilɛ so ɛfa tale ndaen hyirele Dawide ne?

english_verse: Remember your servant, Lord! People make jokes about me, and I suffer many insults.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, kaye kyɛbɔ besi bɛgoro w’akoaa nwo ɔ, kyɛbɔ mesi mede maen maen amukoraa b’alapaa megua me wereɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: I am your chosen one, but your enemies chase and make fun of me.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nea anyinga bɔ wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛkã ɔ, kyɛ bɛsere wɔ sona bɔ apopa ye ngoo ne, ye agyirɛ bɔ otu ɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, we praise you forever. Amen and amen.
translation_verse: Animnyam hã AWURADE afebɔɔ, Amen! Amen!

english_verse: Our Lord, in all generations you have been our home.
translation_verse: AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ ɛte y’afealeɛ wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu ɔ.

english_verse: You have always been God— long before the birth of the mountains, even before you created the earth and the world.
translation_verse: Anzana ɛbaabɔ mmokaa mɔ ne, anaa ɛbaahyehyɛ aseɛ ne wiase ne, ofi tete bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ, ɛte Nyameɛ.

english_verse: At your command we die and turn back to dust,
translation_verse: Esa ma dasaniɛ kakyi mvuture, na ɛkã kyɛ, “Adasa mmaa, ɛmɔsa bɛbra ɛmɔ mvuture nu.”

english_verse: but a thousand years mean nothing to you! They are merely a day gone by or a few hours in the night.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ nye so de, afoɛ apee, ɔte kyɛ anoma ala bɔ wapɛ nu ɔ, anaakyɛ kɔngɔen abunnamu.

english_verse: You bring our lives to an end just like a dream. We are merely tender grass
translation_verse: Ɛpra adasa mmaa bo egyi bɛ gua; bɛte kyɛ laleɛ, kyɛ ndire bɔ ofifi frɔmfrɔm ngyerɛmɔ ɔ;

english_verse: that sprouts and grows in the morning, but dries up by evening.
translation_verse: ofifi ngyerɛmɔ yɛ frɔmfrɔm, nakoso odwu nɔsoa a, ɔkese, na ɔyera.

english_verse: Your furious anger frightens and destroys us,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ yaafɛlɛ ne kũkũ yɛ, na w’ahonehulɛ ne fa yɛ kɔ amaneɛ nu.

english_verse: and you know all our sins, even those we do in secret.
translation_verse: Afa y’amumuyɛɛ agua wɔ nyunu, na afa yɛ mvealeɛ nu bɔne awa wɔ nyunu hyireinn ne anu.

english_verse: Your anger is a burden each day we live, then life ends like a sigh.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ yɛ ngyẽa amukoraa pɛ nu kɔ bɔ afɛ yɛ so yaa ɔ, na y’afoɛ bɔ yɛdi ne ɔba ayieleɛ kyɛ ɛhoaa bie.

english_verse: We can expect seventy years, or maybe eighty, if we are healthy, but even our best years bring trouble and sorrow. Suddenly our time is up, and we disappear.
translation_verse: Ngyẽa bɔ yɛdi ye aseɛ ye aso te afoɛ aburasoo, anaa sɛ anwoserɛ wɔ nu po a, ɔte afoɛ aburawɔtwɛ, na ɛhene po, nu fɛɛ ne amaneɛ! Ɔngyɛ né wapɛ nu, ná yatu yamini.

english_verse: No one knows the full power of your furious anger, but it is as great as the fear that we owe to you.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔse wɔ ɛyaafɛlɛ ne noa hyerɛ ɔ? W’ahonehulɛ ne, ɔne esurolɛ bɔ odi kyɛ besuro wɔ ne, bɛte pɛ.

english_verse: Teach us to use wisely all the time we have.
translation_verse: Yiti kyire yɛ maa yɛnwu kyɛbɔ yɛkosi yɛkɔha yɛ ngyẽa ɔ, amaa ɔnate so yafa nworɛ yabɔ yɛ bra.

english_verse: Help us, Lord! Don't wait! Pity your servants.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, sa baanea yɛ! Okoodwu kyinzu? Nwu wɔ somvoɛ mɔ anwumvoin!

english_verse: When morning comes, let your love satisfy all our needs. Then we can celebrate and be glad for what time we have left.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, maa obu so ma yɛ ngyerɛmɔ, amaa ɔnate so yali ahurusi ná yɛ nye agye wɔ yɛ ngyẽa amukoraa nu.

english_verse: Make us happy for as long as you caused us trouble and sorrow.
translation_verse: Maa yɛ nye gye, kyɛbɔ ngyẽa bɔ afa ahwe yɛ so ne, ye somaa te ɔ, kyɛbɔ afoɛ bɔ yanwu amaneɛ ne, ye somaa te ɔ.

english_verse: Do wonderful things for us, your servants, and show your mighty power to our children.
translation_verse: Ma wɔ somvoɛ mɔ benwu wɔ nnwumaa, w’animnyam ne, ye ye ali kyire bɛ mma mɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, treat us with kindness and let all go well for us. Please let all go well!
translation_verse: Mesrɛ kyɛ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ adom ne ɔbra yɛ so, ma yɛ sa noa adwuma ɔ́yɛ yee ɔ́ma yɛ. Ao, ma yɛ sa noa nnwumaa ɔ́yɛ yee!

english_verse: Live under the protection of God Most High and stay in the shadow of God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔtena Anwuro Anwuroniɛ n’afealeɛ nu, bɔ yeɛ ɔtena Tuminiɛ ne, ye fɔnwoo ne anu ne,

english_verse: Then you will say to the Lord, “You are my fortress, my place of safety; you are my God, and I trust you.”
translation_verse: okose AWURADE kyɛ, “Ɛte m’afealeɛ ne m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ, me Nyameɛ bɔ me wora wura ye nu ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord will keep you safe from secret traps and deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Amba, ye yeɛ okole wɔ kofi ngaensualɛniɛ ne ngaen nu, ɔne ewue anwonyerɛ tɛɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: He will spread his wings over you and keep you secure. His faithfulness is like a shield or a city wall.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔfa ye ndɛkra kɔkata wɔ so, na ye ndaa ne abo yeɛ ekonya afealeɛ ɔ; ye nahorɛlilɛ ne te akokyɛm ne buralɛ ataadeɛ.

english_verse: You won't need to worry about dangers at night or arrows during the day.
translation_verse: Engosuro nningyein bɔ onwunanwuna sona kɔngɔen ɔ, anaa agyaen bɔ otu nate eyia ɔ,

english_verse: And you won't fear diseases that strike in the dark or sudden disaster at noon.
translation_verse: anaa ewue anwonyerɛ bɔ ɔnate awosii nu ɔ, anaa anwonyerɛ bɔ okũkũ mmenia eyiagyina ɔ.

english_verse: You will not be harmed, though thousands fall all around you.
translation_verse: Apee kɔtotɔ wɔ wɔ ngyɛnu, yeɛ apee buru kɔtotɔ wɔ wɔ sa famaa so, nakoso wɔ de, ebie ngɔto wɔ.

english_verse: And with your own eyes you will see the punishment of the wicked.
translation_verse: Wɔ nye mbaen yeɛ ɛkɔfa kɔnea ɔ, na ekonwu bɔnefoɛ b’akatuaa.

english_verse: The Lord Most High is your fortress. Run to him for safety,
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ afa AWURADE ayɛ w’afealeɛ, ná afa Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne ayɛ w’atenaleɛ ne ati,

english_verse: and no terrible disasters will strike you or your home.
translation_verse: edwirɛ tɛɛ biala ngɔto wɔ, ɛhawo piri biala ngopingye w’awuro.

english_verse: God will command his angels to protect you wherever you go.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔnate wɔ ti, ɔkɔfa ahyɛdeɛ kɔma ye abɔfo mɔ, kyɛ bɛnea wɔ so wɔ w’atee amukoraa so.

english_verse: They will carry you in their arms, and you won't hurt your feet on the stones.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔsoa wɔ wɔ bɛ sa so, amaa ɔnate so wɔ gya ambura nyɔboɛ.

english_verse: You will overpower the strongest lions and the most deadly snakes.
translation_verse: Ɛkɔnate gyata ne ɛbɔnaa so, na ekotiatia gyata akrɔngrɔma ne sasrabɔnzam so.

english_verse: The Lord says, “If you love me and truly know who I am, I will rescue you and keep you safe.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ wafa ye nwo wabata me ne ati, ngɔpepɛ ngole ye. Ɔnate kyɛ ɔse me dumaa ne ati, ngɔpagya ye.

english_verse: When you are in trouble, call out to me. I will answer and be there to protect and honor you.
translation_verse: Sɛ osũ frɛ me a, ngotie ye sufrɛ. Ngogyina ye si wɔ ye amaneɛnwunɛ nu; ngɔpepɛ ngole ye, ná mahyɛ ye animnyam.

english_verse: You will live a long life and see my saving power.”
translation_verse: Ngɔma ye ngoa tendenn ma ye ahone kɔtɔ ye kunu, na ngɔmaa okonwu me ngoalelɛ ne.

english_verse: It is wonderful to be grateful and to sing your praises, Lord Most High!
translation_verse: Ɔte paa kyɛ bɛkɔfa asennaa bɛkɔma AWURADE ɔ, kyɛ bɛkɔto wɔ dumaa nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein ɔ, ao Anwuro Anwuroniɛ;

english_verse: It is wonderful each morning to tell about your love and at night to announce how faithful you are.
translation_verse: kyɛ bɛkɔbɔ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne anwo dawure ngyerɛmɔ, ɔne wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne anwo dawure kɔngɔen,

english_verse: I enjoy praising your name to the music of harps,
translation_verse: mmerɛ bɔ bɛbɔ sangoo bɔ ye nyamaa buru ɔne adengum ne, odi kyɛ bɛfa sangoo bɛto dwein.

english_verse: because everything you do makes me happy, and I sing joyful songs.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ AWURADE, ɛnate bɔ ayɔ ɔ so ɛma me nye agye; medi ahurusi meto wɔ sa noa adwuma ne anwo dwein.

english_verse: You do great things, Lord. Your thoughts are too deep
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ nnwumaa te mbiri mbiri paa! W’adwene nu pi paa!

english_verse: for an ignorant fool to know or understand.
translation_verse: Sona kwaseaa de, ɔnze, sona bɔ wagyimi de, ɔnde ɛhe abo:

english_verse: Though the wicked sprout and spread like grass, they will be pulled up by their roots.
translation_verse: sɛ bɔnefoɛ befifi kama kyɛ ndire, ná amumuyɛɛfoɛ benya ngɔsoɛ a, ɔla berɛ ma bɛ kyɛ bekowu ewue afebɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: But you will rule over all of us forever,
translation_verse: Nakoso ao AWURADE, wɔ de, edi ebiala so hene afebɔɔ.

english_verse: and your hateful enemies will be scattered and then destroyed.
translation_verse: Amba, ao AWURADE, wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ, wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ de bekowuwu, bɔnefoɛ amukoraa bɛkɔbɔ aya.

english_verse: You have given me the strength of a wild ox, and you have chosen me to be your very own.
translation_verse: Nakoso amaa manya anwoserɛ kyɛ torɔen, na ahwie ngoo foforɛ agua me so.

english_verse: My eyes have seen, and my ears have heard the doom and destruction of my evil enemies.
translation_verse: Me nye anwu me pɔfoɛ mɔ b’asefinɛ; bɛ bɔ bɛpena me bepura me ne, me so ate b’ayieleɛ bɔ wayie bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Good people will prosper like palm trees, and they will grow strong like the cedars of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɛ befifi kama kyɛ ayee, na benyi kyɛ sida bɔ ɔwɔ Lebanon ɔ.

english_verse: They will take root in your house, Lord God, and they will do well.
translation_verse: Balua bɛ wɔ AWURADE awuro, na befifi frɔmfrɔm wɔ yɛ Nyameɛ aluo berɛ.

english_verse: They will be like trees that stay healthy and fruitful, even when they are old.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔ so besu mmaa wɔ bɛ nworowaa nu, daa bɛte frɔmfrɔm ne monɛ,

english_verse: And they will say about you, “The Lord always does right! God is our mighty rock.”
translation_verse: bɛfa bekyire kyɛ AWURADE tengyɛ; me Nyɔbotaen ɛne, na bɔ ɔndengyɛ biala ɔnne ye nu.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! Majesty and power are your royal robes. You put the world in place, and it will never be moved.
translation_verse: AWURADE di hene, wafa animnyam wahera; AWURADE afa ahera, wafa anwoserɛ wabɔ abɔsoɛ. Amba, wiase bo atimu, bɛngɔhora ye bo tutu.

english_verse: You have always ruled, and you are eternal.
translation_verse: W’ahennie bia bo atimu fi tete; ɛwɔ berɛ fi tete.

english_verse: Its mighty waves are majestic, but you are even more majestic, and you rule over all.
translation_verse: Anwuro Anwuro AWURADE ole anwoserɛ, ole anwoserɛ tra kyɛbɔ asue mbiri mbiri bebu bɛfa so ɔ, ole anwoserɛ tra ɛpo asorɔkye!

english_verse: Your decisions are firm, and your temple will always be beautiful and holy.
translation_verse: Wɔ noa dwirɛ te nahorɛ turoloo; ao AWURADE, krongronyɛlɛ fata w’awuro afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Lord God, you punish the guilty. Show what you are like and punish them now.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wereɛtɔlɛ Nyameɛ, wereɛtɔlɛ Nyameɛ, kyire wɔ tumi!

english_verse: You judge the earth. Come and help us! Pay back those proud people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Ao, aseɛ ye aso ndɛenbualɛniɛ, kekã wɔ nwo e, ná tua anwomasoɛfoɛ bɛ so kerɛ!

english_verse: How long will the wicked celebrate and be glad?
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ɔkwaadwu kyinzu yeɛ bɔnefoɛ, ɔkwaadwu kyinzu yeɛ bɔnefoɛ bɛ nye kɔgye ɔ?

english_verse: All of those cruel people strut and boast,
translation_verse: Bɛkekã b’anwomasoɛ dwirɛ nemɔ, bɔnefoɛ amukoraa bɛkekã ahandaen dwirɛ.

english_verse: and they crush and wound your chosen nation, Lord.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, bɛtane wɔ maen nye, bedi w’agyapadeɛ so anyandim.

english_verse: They murder widows, foreigners, and orphans.
translation_verse: Bekũkũ akunafoɛ mmrasua ne ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ, yeɛ bedi nyisiaafoɛ awue,

english_verse: Then they say, “The Lord God of Jacob doesn't see or know.”
translation_verse: na bɛkekã kyɛ, “AWURADE onnwu ye, yeɛ Yakob Nyameɛ ɛhemɔ mva ye nwo.”

english_verse: God gave us ears and eyes! Can't he hear and see?
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔfale asoɛ tuale berɛ ne, aso ɔnde dwudwolɛ? Bɔ ɔbɔle anyeɛ ne, aso onnwu nikye?

english_verse: God instructs the nations and gives knowledge to us all. Won't he also correct us?
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔtwe maen maen mɔ so ne, aso ɔngɔhwe asoɛ? Ye yeɛ okyire mmenia nimdeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord knows how useless our plans really are.
translation_verse: AWURADE se kuro sona ti anu adwene, kyɛ ɔte kyɛ nwomeɛ mbaen.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone that you instruct and teach by using your Law.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, sona bɔ ɛtwe ye so, ɔne bɔ ekyirekyire ye wɔ mmeraa ne, onya saleɛ.

english_verse: You give them rest from their troubles, until a pit can be dug for the wicked.
translation_verse: Ɔnate so ɛmaa ode ye nwome fi amaneɛ mmerɛ nu, kɔpem kyɛ bekotu kumaa maa bɔnefoɛ kɔtɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: You won't turn your back on your chosen nation.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE ngɔye ye sa ngofi ye maen bo, yeɛ ɔngɔpo ye agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: Justice and fairness will go hand in hand, and all who do right will follow along.
translation_verse: Na bekosa bɛkɔfa teneneeyɛlɛ bekobua ndɛen, na bɛ bɔ b’ahone nu te ne, bekoli so.

english_verse: Who will stand up for me against those cruel people?
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ okodwɔso kotia bɔnefoɛ kɔma me ɔ? Nwa yeɛ okodwɔso kogyina kotia amumuyɛɛfoɛ kɔma me ɔ?

english_verse: If you had not helped me, Lord, I would soon have gone to the land of silence.
translation_verse: Sɛ nna AWURADE yeɛ ɔte me bokafoɛ a, ahaa ɔngɔhyɛ né me kra waatena nekaa bɔ berɛ te konn ne aso.

english_verse: When I felt my feet slipping, you came with your love and kept me steady.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, mmerɛ bɔ ngane kyɛ, “Mepena mesoti oo” ne, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne tirale me nu.

english_verse: And when I was burdened with worries, you comforted me and made me feel secure.
translation_verse: Sɛ adwenedwene pee tɔ me so a, w’aworakyekyerɛ ma me kra nye gye.

english_verse: You, Lord God, are my fortress, that mighty rock where I am safe.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE yeɛ ɔte m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ, ɔne me Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte m’afealeɛ nyɔbotaen ɔ.

english_verse: You will pay back my enemies, and you will wipe them out for the evil they did.
translation_verse: Okotua bɛ b’amumuyɛɛ so kerɛ, ná ɔnate bɛ bɔne ti wanua bɛ boso. Amba, AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ konua bɛ boso.

english_verse: Sing joyful songs to the Lord! Praise the mighty rock where we are safe.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔbra maa yɛto dwein yɛye AWURADE ayɛ; ɛ́mɔma yɛ́fa ahurusi yɛ́bɔ yɛ ngoalelɛ nyɔbotaen ne nwo ese!

english_verse: Come to worship him with thankful hearts and songs of praise.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma yɛ́fa asennaa yɛbra ye nyunu! Ɛ́mɔma yɛ́fa ayɛyelɛ dwein yɛli ahurusi yɛbɔ ye nwo ese.

english_verse: The Lord is the greatest God, king over all other gods.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE te Nyameɛ piri, ɔte Ɛhene piri bɔ ɔtra nyameɛ mɔ amukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: He holds the deepest part of the earth in his hands, and the mountain peaks also belong to him.
translation_verse: Ye sa nu yeɛ aseɛ bo dɔ kuronn ne wɔ ɔ; na mmokaa mɔ so anwuro anwuro koso te ye deɛ.

english_verse: The ocean is the Lord's because he made it, and with his own hands he formed the dry land.
translation_verse: Ɛpo te ye deɛ, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔbɔle ɔ, yeɛ aseɛ wosee koso, ye sa yeɛ ɔhyehyɛle ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and we are his people, the sheep he takes care of in his own pasture. Listen to God's voice today!
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔte yɛ Nyameɛ, na yɛte ye mmenia bɔ ɔma bɛ aleɛ ɔ, ɔne ye sa nu mmoaen. Ao, sɛ ahaa ɛnɛ ɛmɔkotie ye noa dwirɛ a!

english_verse: Don't be stubborn and rebel as your ancestors did at Meribah and Massah out in the desert.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ asoserɛ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔyɛle wɔ Meriba ne, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔyɛle ye sɔ kyẽa ne wɔ Masa wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso ne,

english_verse: For forty years they tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ sole me bɛneane, ná bɛgyegyele me ne, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ né banwu me nnwumaa de.

english_verse: Then God got tired of them and said, “You never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.”
translation_verse: Afoɛ aburanna yeɛ sɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ne bɛ nwo yɛle me ahi ɔ, na ngane kyɛ, “Bɛte maen bɔ b’adwene ali makyebu, bɔ bɛnze m’atee ɔ.”

english_verse: In his anger, God told them, “You people will never enter my place of rest.”
translation_verse: Yiti mvɛle yaa ndale ndaen kyɛ, “Bengowura me nwomelelɛ ne anu bie.”

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! Everyone on this earth, sing praises to the Lord,
translation_verse: Ao, ɛ́mɔto dwein foforɛ bɛ́ye AWURADE ayɛ; aseɛ so ama amukoraa, ɛ́mɔto dwein bɛye AWURADE ayɛ.

english_verse: sing and praise his name. Day after day announce, “The Lord has saved us!”
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔto dwein bɛye AWURADE ayɛ, ɛ́mɔhyɛ ye dumaa animnyam, ɛmɔhã ye ngoalelɛ nwo dwirɛ daa biala.

english_verse: Tell every nation on earth, “The Lord is wonderful and does marvelous things!
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbɔ ye animnyam nwo dawure wɔ maen maen mɔ so; ɛ́mɔbɔ ye anwanwadeɛ nwo dawure wɔ maen maen amukoraa so.

english_verse: The Lord is great and deserves our greatest praise! He is the only God worthy of our worship.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE te piri, na ɔfata ayɛyelɛ piri paa; odi kyɛ sona suro ye tra nyameɛ biala.

english_verse: Other nations worship idols, but the Lord created the heavens.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ maen maen mɔ bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ, bɛte mmosoen mbaen, nakoso AWURADE de, ye yeɛ ɔbɔle anwuro ɔ.

english_verse: Give honor and praise to the Lord, whose power and beauty fill his holy temple.”
translation_verse: Anidie ne animnyam wɔ ye nyunu, na tumi ne nyemene wɔ ye nekaa krongron berɛ.

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation, “Praise the glorious power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ao maen maen mɔ nu mmusua mmusua mɔ, ɛmɔhã; ɛmɔhã kyɛ animnyam ne tumi te AWURADE deɛ.

english_verse: He is wonderful! Praise him and bring an offering into his temple.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa animnyam bɔ ɔfata AWURADE dumaa ɔ bɛma ye; ɛ́mɔfa afɔleɛ bɛbra ye awuro n’aluo berɛ.

english_verse: Everyone on earth, now tremble and worship the Lord, majestic and holy.”
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔsɔne AWURADE wɔ animnyam krongron nu, aseɛ so ama amukoraa, ɛ́mɔsuro AWURADE.

english_verse: Announce to the nations, “The Lord is King! The world stands firm, never to be shaken, and he will judge its people with fairness.”
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhã ye wɔ maen maen amukoraa nu kyɛ, “AWURADE di hene! Amba, wiase timu berɛ pindinn, ye bo ngotutu le. Ɔkɔfa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ kobua maen maen nemɔ ndɛen.”

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to be glad and celebrate! Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures
translation_verse: Nyameɛso, ma wɔ nye gye, aseɛ koso, di ahurusi, ɛpo ne nu nningyein amukoraa, ɛ́mɔyɛ dede.

english_verse: and the fields to rejoice with all their crops. Then every tree in the forest will sing joyful songs
translation_verse: Eburo ne eburo nningyein amukoraa, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye gye, yeɛ eburo mmakaa amukoraa bele anigye bɛkɔto dwein

english_verse: to the Lord. He is coming to judge all people on earth with fairness and truth.
translation_verse: wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ofikyɛ ɔ́ba, ɔbaabua aseɛ so ama ndɛen. Ɔkɔfa tenenee yeɛ okobua wiase ndɛen ɔ, na ɔkɔfa ye nahorɛlilɛ yeɛ okobua maen maen mɔ ndɛen ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is King! Tell the earth to celebrate and all islands to shout.
translation_verse: AWURADE di hene! Aseɛ, di ahurusi; mboanoa worawora mɔ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye gye!

english_verse: Dark clouds surround him, and his throne is supported by justice and fairness.
translation_verse: Munungum ne awosii kabii bapɛ ye nwo bayia; tenenee ne ndɛenbualɛ turoloo, bɛte ye ahennie bia nyinasoɛ.

english_verse: Fire leaps from his throne, destroying his enemies,
translation_verse: See li ye nyunu, na ɔyera ye pɔfoɛ mɔ bra yia.

english_verse: and his lightning is so bright that the earth sees it and trembles.
translation_verse: Ye agralaa ta wiase; aseɛ nwu ye, na ye nwo wosowoso.

english_verse: Mountains melt away like wax in the presence of the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Mmokaa huro kyɛ nguɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, wɔ aseɛ amukoraa AWURADE ye nyunu.

english_verse: The heavens announce, “The Lord brings justice!” Everyone sees God's glory.
translation_verse: Ewienu bɔ ye tenenee nwo dawure, na maen maen amukoraa nwu ye animnyam ne.

english_verse: Those who brag about the useless idols they worship are terribly ashamed, and all the false gods bow down to the Lord.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ bɛsɔne mmosoen, bɔ bɛfa amoen mɔ bɛhoahoa bɛ nwo ne, bɛ mukoraa bɛ nyunu agua ase; nyameɛ mɔ amukoraa, odi kyɛ ɛmɔkoto ye.

english_verse: When the people of Zion and of the towns of Judah hear that God brings justice, they will celebrate.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, Sion ɔte, na ye nye gye, yeɛ Yuda mma mmrasua bedi ahurusi, ɔnate wɔ ndɛenbualɛ nemɔ ati.

english_verse: The Lord rules the whole earth, and he is more glorious than all the false gods.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ ɛte Anwuro Anwuroniɛ paa wɔ aseɛ amukoraa so ɔ; ɛte totohyia tra nyameɛ mɔ amukoraa.

english_verse: Love the Lord and hate evil! God protects his loyal people and rescues them from violence.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔkuro AWURADE dwirɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔkyi bɔne; ɔbɔ ye anwoteefoɛ bɛ kra nwo waen, na ɔpepɛ de bɛ fi bɔnefoɛ mɔ sa nu.

english_verse: If you obey and do right, a light will show you the way and fill you with happiness.
translation_verse: Kanea ta ma teneneefoɛ, yeɛ bɛ bɔ b’ahone nu te ne koso, benya anigye.

english_verse: You are the Lord's people! So celebrate and praise the only God.
translation_verse: Ao ɛmɔ, teneneefoɛ, ɛmɔli ahurusi wɔ AWURADE nu, ná ɛ́mɔkaye ye krongronyɛlɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔfa ye asennaa bɛma ye ɔ!

english_verse: Sing a new song to the Lord! He has worked miracles, and with his own powerful arm, he has won the victory.
translation_verse: Ao, ɛ́mɔto dwein foforɛ bɛ́ye AWURADE ayɛ, ofikyɛ wayɛ anwanwadeɛ mɔ, Ye anwoserɛ asaa ne ye sa krongron ne yeɛ wafa wali ngonim ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has shown the nations that he has the power to save and to bring justice.
translation_verse: AWURADE amaa yanwu ye ngoalelɛ ne; wala ye tenenee ali wɔ maenmaensofoɛ nyunu.

english_verse: God has been faithful in his love for Israel, and his saving power is seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Wakaye ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔne ye nahorɛlilɛ bɔ wala ye ali wahyire Yisrael awuro ama ne. Aseɛ so nekaa amukoraa banwu yɛ Nyameɛ ye ngoalelɛ ne.

english_verse: Tell everyone on this earth to sing happy songs in praise of the Lord.
translation_verse: Aseɛ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔfa ahurusi bɛ́bɔ AWURADE nwo ese; ɛ́mɔtea nu beli ahurusi, ná ɛ́mɔto ayɛyelɛ dwein.

english_verse: Make music for him on harps. Play beautiful melodies!
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa sangoo bɛ́to AWURADE nwo dwein, ɛ́mɔfa sangoo ne edweintolɛ.

english_verse: Sound the trumpets and horns and celebrate with joyful songs for our Lord and King!
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa totorobɛndo ne awɛenhulɛ beli ahurusi bɛbɔ ese wɔ AWURADE bɔ ɔte hene ne nyunu.

english_verse: Command the ocean to roar with all its creatures, and the earth to shout with all its people.
translation_verse: Ɛpo ne nu nningyein amukoraa, ɛ́mɔyɛ dede; ewiase ne bɔ ɔwɔ nu amukoraa, ɛ́mɔyɛ dede!

english_verse: Order the rivers to clap their hands, and all the hills to sing together.
translation_verse: Asue mbiri mɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ ɛmɔ sa nu; mmokaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ nu bɛto dwein beli ahurusi

english_verse: Let them worship the Lord! He is coming to judge everyone on the earth, and he will be honest and fair.
translation_verse: wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ofikyɛ ɔ́ba, ɔbaabua aseɛ so ama ndɛen. Ɔkɔfa tenenee yeɛ okobua wiase ndɛen ɔ, yeɛ ɔkɔfa ye pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ yeɛ okobua maen maen mɔ ndɛen ɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King! You rule from your throne above the winged creatures, as people tremble and the earth shakes.
translation_verse: AWURADE di hene, maen maen mɔ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nwo wosowoso! Ɔte kɛrubim mɔ so; aseɛ, woso!

english_verse: You are praised in Zion, and you control all nations.
translation_verse: AWURADE te piri wɔ Sion, na odi maen maen amukoraa so.

english_verse: Only you are God! And your power alone, so great and fearsome, is worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛye wɔ dumaa piri ne wɔ dumaa nwanwa ne ayɛ. Ɔte krongron!

english_verse: You are our mighty King, a lover of fairness, who sees that justice is done everywhere in Israel.
translation_verse: Ɛhene piri bɔ ekuro ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ɔ, ama pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ bo atimu, ama ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ne tenenee wagyina wɔ Yakob nu.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, we praise you and kneel down to worship you, the God of holiness!
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔkamvo AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ne, ɛ́mɔsɔne wɔ ye gya bo ndiasoɛ ne anwo, ofikyɛ ɔte krongron!

english_verse: Moses and Aaron were two of your priests. Samuel was also one of those who prayed in your name, and you, our Lord, answered their prayers.
translation_verse: Né Mose ne Aarɔn bɛboka ye asɔfo nemɔ aso; né Samuel boka bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ye dumaa bɛsɔne ye nemɔ aso. Besu bɛfrɛle AWURADE, na otiele bɛ.

english_verse: You spoke to them from a thick cloud, and they obeyed your laws.
translation_verse: Odwudwo hyirele bɛ fili munungum ningɔnn ne anu. Belili ye noa dwirɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ ɔfa mane bɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you answered their prayers and forgave their sins, but when they did wrong, you punished them.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ, ebuale bɛ; ɛyɛle bɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɛfa bɔne kyɛ ɔ, nakoso ɛyɛle bɛ bɔne so wereɛtɔlɛniɛ.

english_verse: We praise you, Lord God, and we worship you at your sacred mountain. Only you are God!
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔkamvo AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ne, ná ɛ́mɔsɔne wɔ ye bokaa krongron ne aso, ofikyɛ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ne, ɔte krongron.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord, everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Aseɛ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔfa ahurusi bɛ́bɔ AWURADE nwo ese.

english_verse: Be joyful and sing as you come in to worship the Lord!
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa anigye bɛ́so AWURADE; ɛ́mɔfa edweintolɛ bɛbra ye nyunu.

english_verse: You know the Lord is God! He created us, and we belong to him; we are his people, the sheep in his pasture.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnwu ye kyɛ AWURADE yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ ɔ, ye yeɛ ɔbɔle yɛ ɔ, na yɛte ye deɛ; yɛte ye maen ne ye mmoaen bɔ ɔma bɛ aleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Be thankful and praise the Lord as you enter his temple.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa asennaa béwura ye anoa piri ne anu, ná ɛ́mɔfa ayɛyelɛ bɛbra ye aluo berɛ. Ɛmɔla ye ase, ɛ́mɔhyɛ ye dumaa animnyam!

english_verse: The Lord is good! His love and faithfulness will last forever.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE te paa, ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ, na ye nahorɛlilɛ wɔ berɛ ma aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: I will sing to you, Lord! I will celebrate your kindness and your justice.
translation_verse: Ngɔto anwumvoinnwunɛ ne ndɛenbualɛ turoloo nwo dwein; ao AWURADE, wɔ nwo dwein yeɛ ngɔto ɔ.

english_verse: Please help me learn to do the right thing, and I will be honest and fair in my own kingdom.
translation_verse: Atee bɔ ɔte pɛpɛɛpɛ ne, so yeɛ ngɔfa ɔ. Ao, kyinzu yeɛ ɛkɔwa me nwo wa ɔ? Ngɔfa ahone bɔ nu te ɔ ngɔnate m’awuro berɛ.

english_verse: and I won't be dishonest or deceitful.
translation_verse: Ngondombo adwene de, mengɔmaa ongopingye me le. Mengɔfa me nwo mengɔfɔlefɔle bɔne biala.

english_verse: Anyone who spreads gossip will be silenced; no one who is conceited will be my friend.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔfea toatoa obiɛngo ne, ngɔmaa ɔkɔhã ye noa kɔto nu. Sona bɔ ɔte nduhoɛ ne anwomasoɛ ne de, mengɔpene ye.

english_verse: I will find trustworthy people to serve as my advisors; only an honest person will serve as an official.
translation_verse: Maen ne anu nahorɛlilɛfoɛ nemɔ, ngɔlo bɛ, amaa ɔnate so bɛ ne me atena. Sona bɔ ɔnate atee bɔ ɔtengyɛ so ne, ye yeɛ ɔkɔso me ɔ.

english_verse: No one who cheats or lies will have a position in my royal court.
translation_verse: Nnakannakaniɛ biala de, ɔngɔtena m’awuro berɛ; yeɛ ngondomboniɛ biala koso, ongogyina me nyunu.

english_verse: Each morning I will silence any lawbreakers I find in the countryside or in the city of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ngyerɛmɔ biala, ngohũhũ aseɛ ne aso bɔnefoɛ amukoraa, amaa ɔnate so matu amumuyɛɛfoɛ amukoraa bɛ bo mafi AWURADE kuro ne anu.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, tie me mbaeɛ; ma me sufrɛ oodwu wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: Don't hide from me in my time of trouble. Pay attention to my prayer and quickly give an answer.
translation_verse: Nnɛye wɔ nye fea me wɔ m’amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu. Yɛ asoɛ tie me; sɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ a, bua me ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: My days disappear like smoke, and my bones are burning as though in a furnace.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me ngyẽa pɛ nu kɔ kyɛ nwosina, na me mmowue nu yerayera me kyɛ see.

english_verse: I am wasting away like grass, and my appetite is gone.
translation_verse: M’ahone akese wayɛ twindwann kyɛ ndire, na me wora afi kyɛ ngodidi ɔ po.

english_verse: My groaning never stops, and my bones can be seen through my skin.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ mepene serɛserɛ ne ati, me nwo ayeye mmowue.

english_verse: I am like a lonely owl in the desert
translation_verse: Mayɛ kyɛ ɛserɛ so pɛtɛ, mayɛ kyɛ kurofoen so patue.

english_verse: or a restless sparrow alone on a roof.
translation_verse: Nnakorɔkorɔ atɔ me so, mayɛ kyɛ anomaa bɔ waha ye ngome wɔ sua so ɔ.

english_verse: My enemies insult me all day, and they use my name for a curse word.
translation_verse: Daa biala, me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛkã me anyinga; bɛ bɔ bɛgoro me nwo ne, bɛfa me dumaa bɛwa amoen.

english_verse: Instead of food, I have ashes to eat and tears to drink,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ medi nzoen kyɛ aleɛ, na mefa me nye moen mefra me nzue,

english_verse: because you are furious and have thrown me aside.
translation_verse: ɔnate wɔ ɛyaafɛlɛ ne w’ahonehulɛ ne ati; ofikyɛ apagya me afindi me ato.

english_verse: My life fades like a shadow at the end of day and withers like grass.
translation_verse: Me ngyẽa ba ayieleɛ kyɛ nɔsoa wawoɛ; na mekese kyɛ ndire.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are King forever and will always be famous.
translation_verse: Nakoso, ao AWURADE, ɛte w’ahennie bia so afebɔɔ; wɔ dumaa timu berɛ daa wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: You will show pity to Zion because the time has come.
translation_verse: Ekodwɔso konwu Sion anwumvoin, ofikyɛ mmerɛ aso kyɛ ɛdo ye ɔ, mmerɛ bɔ ahyehyɛ ato berɛ ne waso.

english_verse: We, your servants, love each stone in the city, and we are sad to see them lying in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ye nyɔboɛ mɔ bedi mu ma wɔ somvoɛ mɔ, na wɔ somvoɛ benwu ye mvuture anwumvoin.

english_verse: Our Lord, the nations will honor you, and all kings on earth will praise your glory.
translation_verse: Maen maen mɔ bekosuro wɔ dumaa ne, na aseɛ so ahemvo amukoraa bekosuro w’animnyam ne.

english_verse: You will rebuild the city of Zion. Your glory will be seen,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE kosa kɔkyekye Sion; ɔkɔye ye nwo ali wɔ ye animnyam nu.

english_verse: and the prayers of the homeless will be answered.
translation_verse: Okotie sona bɔ olle bie ɔ ye mbaeɛ, ná ɔngɔpo bɛ mbaeɛ.

english_verse: “From his holy temple, the Lord looked down at the earth.
translation_verse: Ɔtole ye nye fili ye nekaa krongron bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro ne, ɔneane ase, AWURADE tole ye nye fili nyameɛso neane ase,

english_verse: He listened to the groans of prisoners, and he rescued everyone who was doomed to die.”
translation_verse: kyɛ okotie kukunufoɛ bɛ penenɛ, kyɛ ɔkɔpepɛ kole bɛ bɔ bɛbaahu bɛ ɔ,

english_verse: when people from every nation meet to worship you.
translation_verse: wɔ mmerɛ bɔ maen maen mɔ ne ahennie mɔ bɛkɔboa bɛ noa kyɛ bɛsɔne AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: I should still be strong, but you, Lord, have made an old person of me.
translation_verse: Wama m’anwoserɛ so ate wɔ me mmerandeɛ nu, na wapɛ me ngyẽa so.

english_verse: You will live forever! Years mean nothing to you. Don't cut my life in half!
translation_verse: Menwa, “Ao me Nyameɛ, wɔ bɔ ɛwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu ɔ, nnɛde me ngoa fi me sa nu wɔ me mmerandeɛ nu.”

english_verse: In the beginning, Lord, you laid the earth's foundation and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Daa tetetete yeɛ ɛtole aseɛ fapem ɔ, na anwuro te wɔ sa noa adwuma.

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes. You change them, as you would a coat, but you last forever.
translation_verse: Bɛ boso konua, nakoso wɔ de, ɛwɔ berɛ daa; amba, bɛ mukoraa bɛkɔtete kyɛ ɛtena. Ɛkɔsesã bɛ kyɛ ndaadeɛ, na bɛ boso komini.

english_verse: You are always the same. You are God for all time.
translation_verse: Nakoso wɔ de, bɔ ɛte ala yeɛ ɛte ɔ, wɔ ngyẽa olle ayieleɛ.

english_verse: Every generation of those who serve you will live in your presence.
translation_verse: Wɔ somvoɛ mɔ, bɛ mma mɔ kɔtena ase asomdwee nu, bɛ boso ama mɔ, bɛ bo kotimu wɔ wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord, and with all that I am I praise his holy name!
translation_verse: Ao me kra, ye AWURADE ayɛ, yeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ me nu amukoraa, ɛ́mɔye ye dumaa krongron ne ayɛ.

english_verse: With all my heart I praise the Lord! I will never forget how kind he has been.
translation_verse: Ao me kra, ye AWURADE ayɛ, na nnɛma wɔ wora fi ye nningyein paa nemɔ anu biala.

english_verse: The Lord forgives our sins, heals us when we are sick,
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔfa w’amumuyɛɛ amukoraa kyɛ wɔ ɔ, ye yeɛ ɔsa w’anwonyerɛ amukoraa ɔ;

english_verse: and protects us from death. His kindness and love are a crown on our heads.
translation_verse: ye yeɛ ɔpepɛ de wɔ ngoa fi ɛborɔ kumaa nu ɔ, ye yeɛ ɔfa ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne anwumvoinnwunɛ ɔbɔ w’abotire ɔ;

english_verse: Each day that we live, he provides for our needs and gives us the strength of a young eagle.
translation_verse: ye yeɛ ɔmaa enya nningyein paa wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛte ase ɔ, amaa ɔnate so wɔ mmerandeɛ nu osa kakyi foforɛ kyɛ kɔleɛ deɛ.

english_verse: He taught his Law to Moses and showed all Israel what he could do.
translation_verse: Ɔlale ye atee ali hyirele Mose, na ɔlale ye nnwumaa ali hyirele Yisraelfoɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is merciful! He is kind and patient, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: AWURADE se anwumvoin, na ɔdo mmenia, ye ahone nhu ndɛ, na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ɔsone.

english_verse: The Lord won't always be angry and point out our sins;
translation_verse: Ɔngɔma ye ahone ngohu yɛ so daa, yeɛ ɔngɔma ye yaa ne ngɔtena berɛ daa.

english_verse: he doesn't punish us as our sins deserve.
translation_verse: Ɔnnea yɛ bɔne nwo ɔne yɛ nni, yeɛ ɔnnea y’amumuyɛɛ nwo ndua yɛ so kerɛ.

english_verse: How great is God's love for all who worship him? Greater than the distance between heaven and earth!
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ anwuro ne aseɛ b’afia si wale ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ɔte piri ma bɛ bɔ besuro ye ɔ.

english_verse: How far has the Lord taken our sins from us? Farther than the distance from east to west!
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ eyia afiteleɛ ne eyia atɔleɛ b’afia si wale ne, sɔ ala yeɛ wamaa yɛne yɛ mmeraatolɛ y’afia atete ɔ.

english_verse: Just as parents are kind to their children, the Lord is kind to all who worship him,
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ seɛ si nwu ye mma anwumvoin ne, sɔ ala yeɛ AWURADE nwu bɛ bɔ besuro ye ɔ anwumvoin ɔ.

english_verse: because he knows we are made of dust.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔse kyɛbɔ osi bɔle yɛ ɔ, na ɔkaye kyɛ yɛte mvuture.

english_verse: We humans are like grass or wild flowers that quickly bloom.
translation_verse: Dasaniɛ de, ye ngyẽa te kyɛ ɛserɛ; ɔyɛ frɔmfrɔm kyɛ eburo bakaa nyerɛen.

english_verse: But a scorching wind blows, and they quickly wither to be forever forgotten.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ mvrama bɔ ye a, né waporo, na ye boso nekaa bɔ otua ne, ɔnze ye ko.

english_verse: The Lord is always kind to those who worship him, and he keeps his promises to their descendants
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ ofi tetetete bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ ma bɛ bɔ besuro ye ɔ, na ye tenenee wɔ berɛ ma bɛ mma ne bɛ nnomaa mɔ;

english_verse: God has set up his kingdom in heaven, and he rules the whole creation.
translation_verse: AWURADE afa ye ahennie bia watimu anwuro, na ye ahennie di nikyee biala so.

english_verse: All of you mighty angels, who obey God's commands, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE abɔfo mɔ, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ: ɛmɔ anwoserɛfoɛ bɔ ɛmɔyɔ ye apɛdeɛ ná ɛmɔyɔ sotie bɛma ye dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: All of you thousands who serve and obey God, come and praise your Lord!
translation_verse: AWURADE asafo amukoraa, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ, ye somvoɛ mɔ bɔ ɛmɔyɔ ye apɛdeɛ ɔ!

english_verse: All of God's creation and all that he rules, come and praise your Lord! With all my heart I praise the Lord!
translation_verse: AWURADE sa noa nnwumaa amukoraa, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ wɔ nekaa biala bɔ odi hene ɔ. Ao me kra, ye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: I praise you, Lord God, with all my heart. You are glorious and majestic, dressed in royal robes
translation_verse: Ao me kra, ye AWURADE ayɛ. Ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ, ɛte piri paa. Afa animnyam ne ahennie nu animnyam ahera.

english_verse: and surrounded by light. You spread out the sky like a tent,
translation_verse: Afa kanea agurɔ wɔ nwo kyɛ ɛtena; atrɛtrɛ ewienu nu kyɛ ɛtena sua.

english_verse: and you built your home over the mighty ocean. The clouds are your chariot with the wind as its wings.
translation_verse: Wɔ sua mbuna mɔ, begyigyi nzue mɔ so, ɛfa munungum yɛ wɔ teaseɛnam, na mvrama ye ndaa so yeɛ ɛnate ɔ.

english_verse: The winds are your messengers, and flames of fire are your servants.
translation_verse: Ɛfa mvrama yɛ wɔ bɔfoɛ mɔ, yeɛ ɛfa see wuronyiwuronyi yɛ wɔ somvoɛ mɔ.

english_verse: You built foundations for the earth, and it will never be shaken.
translation_verse: Ɛfale aseɛ gyinane ye nyinasoɛ mɔ so, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ɔngɔwoso le ɔ.

english_verse: You covered the earth with the ocean that rose above the mountains.
translation_verse: Ɛfale buma katale so kyɛ ɛtena, na nzue mɔ katale mmokaa nemɔ aso.

english_verse: Then your voice thundered! And the water flowed
translation_verse: Na ɛteateane bɛ ne, bɛnwatili; bɛtele kyɛ ɛbɔle nu kurudududu ne, bɛnwati bɛhɔle.

english_verse: down the mountains and through the valleys to the place you prepared.
translation_verse: Bebu bɛfale mmokaa nemɔ aso, na bɛwale ase beeguale bɔnza nemɔ anu, nekaa bɔ ɛhyehyɛle mane bɛ ne.

english_verse: Now you have set boundaries, so that the water will never flood the earth again.
translation_verse: Ɛtole wɛen bɔ onni kyɛ bɛtra ye ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ bengosa bɛngɔkata aseɛ so ko ɔ.

english_verse: You provide streams of water in the hills and valleys,
translation_verse: Ɛma mbombonzue pu nzue wɔ bɔnza nemɔ anu, bɛtengyɛ bɛfa mmokaa nemɔ afia,

english_verse: so that the donkeys and other wild animals can satisfy their thirst.
translation_verse: bɛma eburo kaka biala nya bie no; eburo afunum mɔ bɛfa bɛsɔ bɛ nzuhɔen noa.

english_verse: Birds build their nests nearby and sing in the trees.
translation_verse: Asue nemɔ anoa yeɛ ɔte ewienu nnomaa b’atenaleɛ ɔ; bɛto dwein wɔ ye mmaen nemɔ anu.

english_verse: From your home above you send rain on the hills and water the earth.
translation_verse: Efi w’atenaleɛ berɛ yeɛ eguagua mmokaa nemɔ aso nzue ɔ; na wɔ sa noa nnwumaa yi aseɛ so tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: wine to cheer us up, olive oil for our skin, and grain for our health.
translation_verse: ɔne nzaa bɔ ɔma sona nye gye ɔ, ɔne sakyeɛ bɔ ɔma sona nyunu yɛ mmenanwo mmenanwo ɔ, yeɛ aleɛ bɔ ɔma sona wora kyekye ɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, your trees always have water, and so do the cedars you planted in Lebanon.
translation_verse: AWURADE guagua ye mmakaa so nzue pee paa, Lebanon sida bɔ olualuale ne.

english_verse: Birds nest in those trees, and storks make their home in the fir trees.
translation_verse: So yeɛ nnomaa bɛnwo bɛ saen ɔ; na asia mmakaa nemɔ aso yeɛ ɔte akyemvona katakyie nemɔ b’awuro ɔ.

english_verse: Wild goats find a home in the tall mountains, and small animals can hide between the rocks.
translation_verse: Mmokaa ndendenn nemɔ bɛte gyane mɔ b’afealeɛ, yeɛ nyɔbotaen nemɔ koso bɛte ngrande mɔ b’afealeɛ.

english_verse: You created the moon to tell us the seasons. The sun knows when to set,
translation_verse: Ɛbɔle ɛsraen kyɛ ɔma yɛnwu mmerɛ nu nzakyerayɛɛ, na eyia se mmerɛ bɔ odi kyɛ ɔkɔtɔ ɔ.

english_verse: and you made the darkness, so the animals in the forest could come out at night.
translation_verse: Ɛma awosii ba, na aleɛ sa, na sɔ mmerɛ ne yeɛ ɛhɔayeɛ nu ngaka amukoraa befitefite ɔ.

english_verse: But when morning comes, they return to their dens,
translation_verse: Sɛ eyia fite a, bɛworoworo, na bɛkɔlela b’afealeɛ mɔ nu.

english_verse: then we go out to work until the end of day.
translation_verse: Sona fite ɔkɔ ye adwuma nu, na ɔyɔ adwuma toonn ma aleɛ dwo.

english_verse: Our Lord, by your wisdom you made so many things; the whole earth is covered with your living creatures.
translation_verse: Ao, AWURADE wɔ sa noa nnwumaa sone paa! Ɛfale nworɛ tole ye nwo yeɛ ɛbɔle bɛ mukoraa ɔ; w’abɔdeɛ mɔ bayi aseɛ so tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: But what about the ocean so big and wide? It is alive with creatures, large and small.
translation_verse: Ɛpo yeɛ ɔla dɔ kandinga tɛtrɛtɛɛ ne, ngaka bɔ bɛkongo pembepembe wɔ nu bɔ bɛka a bennwu bɛ noa ɔ, bɛte abɔdeɛ mbiri mbiri ne mmaa mmaa.

english_verse: And there are the ships, as well as Leviathan, the monster you created to splash in the sea.
translation_verse: So yeɛ ɛlɛen mɔ bɛnate ɔ, na ɛbɔle Ɛlɛngyɛen suronyisuronyi ne kyɛ oli angorɛ wɔ nu.

english_verse: All of these depend on you to provide them with food,
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa bɛ nye la wɔ so, kyɛ ɛkɔma bɛ sa kɔhã bɛ noa aleɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu.

english_verse: and you feed each one with your own hand, until they are full.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛfa ma bɛ a, bɛboaboa ye noa; sɛ ɛtrɛ wɔ sa nu a, ɛma nningyein paa bu bɛ so.

english_verse: But when you turn away, they are terrified; when you end their life, they die and rot.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛye wɔ nye fea bɛ a, bɛ kunu te bɛ, sɛ etua bɛ nwomeɛ a, bewuwu, na besa bɛkɔ bɛ mvuture nu.

english_verse: You created all of them by your Spirit, and you give new life to the earth.
translation_verse: Ɛsoma wɔ nwomeɛ yeɛ ɛfa bɔ bɛ ɔ; na ɛma aseɛ so nningyein yɛ foforɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord, we pray that your glory will last forever and that you will be pleased with what you have done.
translation_verse: AWURADE animnyam kɔtena berɛ afebɔɔ; AWURADE nye kɔgye ye nnwumaa nwo,

english_verse: You look at the earth, and it trembles. You touch the mountains, and smoke goes up.
translation_verse: Ɔto ye nye nea aseɛ a, aseɛ woso, ná ɔte ye sa kã mmokaa a, betu nwosina ɔ!

english_verse: As long as I live, I will sing and praise you, the Lord God.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ nde ngoa nu ye, ngɔto dwein ngɔye AWURADE ayɛ, Kyɛ nde ase ye, ngɔto me Nyameɛ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein.

english_verse: I hope my thoughts will please you, because you are the one who makes me glad.
translation_verse: Mesrɛ kyɛ ɔma bɔ medwene ye nwo ne ɔsɔ ye nye, ofikyɛ AWURADE nu yeɛ medi ahurusi ɔ.

english_verse: Destroy all wicked sinners from the earth once and for all. With all my heart I praise you, Lord! I praise you!
translation_verse: Ma bɔnefoɛ bewuwu befi aseɛ so, nnɛma amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛtena ngoa nu ko. Ao me kra, ye AWURADE ayɛ. Kamvo AWURADE!

english_verse: Praise the Lord and pray in his name! Tell everyone what he has done.
translation_verse: Ao, ɛ́mɔfa asennaa bɛma AWURADE, ɛ́mɔsu bɛfrɛ ye dumaa, ɛmɔhã ye anwanwadeɛ ne behyire maen maen mɔ!

english_verse: Sing praises to the Lord! Tell about his miracles.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔto ye nwo dwein, ɛ́mɔto ye nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein. Ɛ́mɔbɔ ye anwanwadeɛ amukoraa nwo dawure.

english_verse: Celebrate and worship his holy name with all your heart.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa ye dumaa krongron ne bɛhoahoa bɛ nwo. Bɛ bɔ bɛpena AWURADE si atee ne, ma bɛ nye gye.

english_verse: Trust the Lord and his mighty power.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔpena AWURADE ne ye tumi. Ɛ́mɔpena ye si atee daa biala.

english_verse: Remember his miracles and all his wonders and his fair decisions.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔkaye anwanwadeɛ mɔ bɔ wayɔ ne, ye nzɛngyerɛnneɛ mɔ ɔne ye ndɛen bɔ wabua ne.

english_verse: You belong to the family of Abraham, his servant; you are his chosen ones, the descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: O, ye somvoɛ Abraham boso ama, Yakob boso ama bɔ waneanea nu waye bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, bringing justice everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔte AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ɔ; obua aseɛ ye aso ama amukoraa ndɛen.

english_verse: He will never forget his agreement or his promises, not in thousands of years. *
translation_verse: Ɔkaye ye apam ne daa, bɔ ɔte edwirɛ bɔ ɔhyehyɛle mane aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ apee ko ne,

english_verse: At the time there were only a few of us, and we were homeless.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né banzo, bɔ né bemmu bɛ, ná bɛte ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ wɔ aseɛ ne aso,

english_verse: We wandered from nation to nation, from one country to another.
translation_verse: bɔ bekyinikyini maen maen mɔ so, bɔ befi ahennie ko anu bɛkɔ maen foforɛ nu ne,

english_verse: God did not let anyone mistreat our people. Instead he protected us by punishing rulers
translation_verse: wamma ebiala wandane bɛ nye; na ɔnate bɛ ti ɔhwene ahemvo mɔ so.

english_verse: and telling them, “Don't touch my chosen leaders or harm my prophets!”
translation_verse: Ɔhane kyɛ, “Me mmenia bɔ mapopa bɛ ngoo ne, nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ sa bɛkã bɛ; yeɛ me ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ koso, nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ bɛ bɔne biala!”

english_verse: God kept crops from growing until food was scarce everywhere in the land.
translation_verse: Ɔmane ɛhɔen wale aseɛ ne aso, ná ɔsɛkyele b’aleɛ amukoraa ne,

english_verse: But he had already sent Joseph, sold as a slave into Egypt,
translation_verse: ɔyele biaa bie maa olili bɛ nyunu moa. Ye ole Yosef bɔ bɛtɔnene ye maa ɔɔyɛle akoaa ne.

english_verse: with chains of iron around his legs and neck.
translation_verse: Beguale ye gya ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ ma omiane ye, bɛfale ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ bɛsɔle ye kɔme,

english_verse: Joseph remained a slave until his own words had come true, and the Lord had finished testing him.
translation_verse: kɔpem kyɛ edwirɛ bɔ ɔhane ne wale nu ɔ: AWURADE dwirɛ ne mane ye nwo sale.

english_verse: and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: Ɔmaa ɔyɛle ye awuro ne aso meneɛ, ɔne bɔ ole ye amukoraa so neafoɛ,

english_verse: Joseph was in command of the officials, and he taught the leaders how to use wisdom.
translation_verse: kyɛ ɔ́fa ahyɛdeɛ ma ye safohene mɔ kyɛbɔ okuro ɔ, ná otu ye mbanyi mɔ foɛ.

english_verse: Jacob and his family came and settled in Egypt as foreigners.
translation_verse: Afei Yisrael wale Misraim; Yakob oosikyele Ham aseɛ so.

english_verse: They were the Lord's people, so he let them grow stronger than their enemies.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE mane ye mmenia bɛtale pee, na ɔmaa benyane anwoserɛ bɛtrale bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ.

english_verse: They served the Lord, and he made the Egyptians plan hateful things against them.
translation_verse: Ɔmane pɔfoɛ nemɔ adwene sesane maa bɛpɔle ye mmenia nemɔ. Na bɛfale nworɛ atee so bɛhyɛle ye somvoɛ nemɔ aso.

english_verse: God sent his servant Moses. He also chose and sent Aaron
translation_verse: Ɔsomane ye somvoɛ Mose, yeɛ Aarɔn bɔ ɔneaneane nu yele ye ne.

english_verse: to his people in Egypt, and they worked miracles and wonders there.
translation_verse: Bɛyɔle ye nzɛngyerɛnneɛ wɔ bɛ nu, ɔne ye anwanwadeɛ wɔ Ham aseɛ so.

english_verse: Moses and Aaron obeyed God, and he sent darkness to cover Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɔsomane awosii, na ɔmane aseɛ ne aso yɛle tunn; nakoso bamva ye dwirɛ ne banyɛ huu.

english_verse: God turned their rivers into streams of blood, and the fish all died.
translation_verse: Ɔkakyili bɛ nzue mɔ mogya, na ɔmane b’asue nu naen mɔ wuwuli.

english_verse: Frogs were everywhere, even in the royal palace.
translation_verse: Mborohyɛen lele b’aseɛ ne fale, maa belele b’ahemvo mɔ bɛ pumbu nu po bɛfale.

english_verse: When God gave the command, flies and gnats swarmed all around.
translation_verse: Odwudwole, na atuin pembepembe paa yeɛ ngondia wale bɛ maen ne anu nekaa biala.

english_verse: In place of rain, God sent hailstones and flashes of lightning.
translation_verse: Ɔmane asukɔtwea tɔle kyɛ esue guale bɛ so, na agralaa tetele wɔ bɛ maen ne anu amukoraa.

english_verse: He destroyed their grapevines and their fig trees, and he made splinters of all the other trees.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛkyele bɛ bobe ne bɛ borɔdoma mmakaa, na obubuli bɛ maen ne anu mmakaa.

english_verse: God gave the command, and more grasshoppers came than could be counted.
translation_verse: Odwudwole, na mmɛbɛ wale, yeɛ nduro bɔ ɛka a ennwu bɛ noa ɔ;

english_verse: They ate every green plant and all the crops that grew in the land of Egypt.
translation_verse: belili b’aseɛ ne aso nyaa amukoraa, na belili b’aseɛ ne aso aleɛ.

english_verse: Then God took the life of every first-born son.
translation_verse: Ohuhuni bɛ maen ne anu bamuɛbaa amukoraa, bɔ bɛte bɛ bienzua nu anwoserɛ amukoraa bɔ oli moa ne.

english_verse: When God led Israel from Egypt, they took silver and gold, and no one was left behind.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɔmane Yisrael nyane ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ, na ɔyele bɛ fili berɛ hɔle, na ebiala nne ye mmusua kure nemɔ anu bɔ ɔyɛle mmerɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Egyptians were afraid and gladly let them go.
translation_verse: Befili berɛ ne, Misraim nye gyele, ofikyɛ né bɛ nwo suronyi atɔ ye so.

english_verse: God hid them under a cloud and guided them by fire during the night.
translation_verse: Ɔtrɛle munungum nu maa ɔyɛle ngatasoɛ, yeɛ ɔmane see yɛle bɛ kanea kɔngɔen.

english_verse: When they asked for food, he sent more birds than they could eat.
translation_verse: Bebisale, na ɔfale ayenzii mɔ brɛle bɛ, na ɔmane bɛ aleɛ fili nyameɛso mane bɛ ko yili.

english_verse: God even split open a rock, and streams of water gushed into the desert.
translation_verse: Ɔpakyele nyɔbotaen ne anu, na nzue pu wale, na ɔtengyɛ fale ɛserɛ ne aso kyɛ asue.

english_verse: God never forgot his sacred promise to his servant Abraham.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔkayele ye bɔhyɛ krongron ne, ɔne ye somvoɛ Abraham.

english_verse: When the Lord rescued his chosen people from Egypt, they celebrated with songs.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔyele ye mmenia fili berɛ wɔ anigye nu, bɛ yeɛ waneanea nu waye bɛ ɔ, na bɛfale edweintolɛ bɛhɔle.

english_verse: The Lord gave them the land and everything else the nations had worked for.
translation_verse: Ɔfale maen maen mɔ b’aseɛ mane Yisraelfoɛ, ɔmane Yisraelfoɛ bɛ sa hane bɔ maen maen nemɔ bafɛ banya ɔ,

english_verse: He did this so that his people would obey all his laws. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so Yisraelfoɛ bali ye ahyɛdeɛ so, ná bali ye mmeraa so. Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: We will celebrate and praise you, Lord! You are good to us, and your love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ! Ao, ɛmɔla AWURADE ase, ofikyɛ ɔte paa; na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: No one can praise you enough for all the mighty things you have done.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔhã AWURADE nnwumaa mbiri mbiri ne ɔ, anaa ɔkɔhora kɔbɔ ye ayɛyelɛ amukoraa nwo dawure ɔ?

english_verse: You bless those people who are honest and fair in everything they do.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bebua ndɛen turoloo ne, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ daa biala ne, benya saleɛ.

english_verse: Remember me, Lord, when you show kindness by saving your people.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, sɛ ɛdo wɔ maen a, kaye me bie; sɛ ɛpepɛ de bɛ a, de me bie;

english_verse: Let me prosper with the rest of your chosen ones, as they celebrate with pride because they belong to you.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so manwu bɛ bɔ aneanea nu aye bɛ ne bɛ ngɔsoɛ, ná mali ahurusi wɔ wɔ maen anigye ne anu, ná me ne w’agyapadeɛ yahoahoa yɛ nwo.

english_verse: We and our ancestors have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: Yɛne yɛ nana mɔ yayɔ bɔne; yayɔ amumuyɛɛ, na yayɔ bɔne piri.

english_verse: When they were in Egypt, they paid no attention to your marvelous deeds or your wonderful love. And they turned against you at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: Yɛ nana mɔ, mmerɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ Misraim ne, bande w’anwanwadeɛ nemɔ abo, yeɛ bangaye wɔ ɔdɔ kandinga bɔ onni ngasi ne, na mmom bɛyɛle Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne aso lɔen wɔ Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: But you were true to your name, and you rescued them to prove how mighty you are.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔnate ye dumaa ti, ɔpepɛ lele bɛ, amaa ɔnate so wala ye tumi kandinga ne ali.

english_verse: You said to the Red Sea, “Dry up!” Then you led your people across on land as dry as a desert.
translation_verse: Ɔhane Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ ne anyunu maa ɔwewele koraa; olili bɛ nyunu maa bɛfale buma ne anu kyɛ ɛserɛ so ahɔ ɔ.

english_verse: and drowned every one of their enemies.
translation_verse: Nzue ne mene bɛ pɔfoɛ nemɔ bɔ bɛ nu ko po wanga ɔ.

english_verse: Then your people trusted you and sang your praises.
translation_verse: Afei Yisraelfoɛ lele ye dwirɛ ne belili, na bɛtole ye nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein.

english_verse: But they soon forgot what you had done and rejected your advice.
translation_verse: Nakoso wangyɛ yeɛ bɛ wora fili ye nnwumaa ɔ, na banwondɛ bandie ye ahyɛdeɛ.

english_verse: They became greedy for food and tested you there in the desert.
translation_verse: Na mmom benyane akɔnnɔ tɛɛ wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso, na besole Nyameɛ bɛneane wɔ aseɛ pralaa ne aso.

english_verse: So you gave them what they wanted, but later you destroyed them with a horrible disease.
translation_verse: Ɔfale bɔ bɛpena ɔ mane bɛ, nakoso ɔtele anwonyerɛ tɛɛ guale bɛ so.

english_verse: Everyone in camp was jealous of Moses and of Aaron, your chosen priest.
translation_verse: Bɛ nye borole Mose wɔ asikyeleɛ ne anu, ɔne AWURADE krongronniɛ Aarɔn koso.

english_verse: Dathan and Abiram rebelled, and the earth opened up and swallowed them.
translation_verse: Aseɛ nu pakyele, na ɔmene Datan, na ɔkatale Abiram kure ne aso siele bɛ.

english_verse: Then fire broke out and destroyed all of their followers.
translation_verse: See koso sɔle wɔ bɛ kure ne anu, na buruburugya ne yerale bɔnefoɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: At Horeb your people made and worshiped the statue
translation_verse: Bɛyɔle nandwie ba wɔ Horebo, na bɛsɔnene amoen bɔ bahuro nikyee bayɔ ɔ.

english_verse: of a bull, instead of you, their glorious God.
translation_verse: B’animnyam ne, bɛfale nandwie bɔ odi ndire ɔ ye sɛso besili ye gya nu.

english_verse: You worked powerful miracles to save them from Egypt, but they forgot about you
translation_verse: Bɛ wora fili Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte bɛ Defoɛ ne, bɔ ɔyɔle nningyein mbiri mbiri wɔ Misraim ne,

english_verse: and the fearsome things you did at the Red Sea.
translation_verse: bɔ ɔyɔle anwanwadeɛ wɔ Ham aseɛ so ne, ɔne nningyein suronyisuronyi wɔ Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ nwo ne.

english_verse: You were angry and started to destroy them, but Moses, your chosen leader, begged you not to do it.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔhane kyɛ okohũhũ bɛ. Nakoso Mose bɔ waneanea nu waye ye ne, ɔpale kyerɛ mane bɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, kyɛ ɔma ye ahone ɔtɔ nzue nu, ná nnɛmaa okũkũ bɛ.

english_verse: They would not trust you, Lord, and they did not like the promised land.
translation_verse: Afei aseɛ kamakama ne, bɛtole ye nwo, na bannya gyidie wɔ ye bɔhyɛ ne anu.

english_verse: They would not obey you, and they grumbled in their tents.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛle nwuhunwuhu wɔ b’ɛtena sua nemɔ anu, na bandie AWURADE dwirɛ.

english_verse: So you threatened them by saying, “I'll kill you out here in the desert!
translation_verse: Yiti ɔmane ye sa so tale ndaen guale bɛ so kyɛ, ɔkɔmaa bɛkɔtotɔ wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso,

english_verse: Your people became followers of a god named Baal Peor, and they ate sacrifices offered to the dead.
translation_verse: Afei bɛfale bɛ nwo bɛɛbɔle bosoen Baal Peɔ, na belili afɔleɛ mɔ bɔ babɔ bama awufoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: They did such terrible things that you punished them with a deadly disease.
translation_verse: Bɛfale bɛ yɔleɛ bewurale AWURADE apue, na amaneɛ pirikua tole bɛ.

english_verse: But Phinehas helped them, and the sickness stopped.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Finehase dwɔso gyinane lili bɛ ti dwirɛ mane bɛ, na ewue anwonyerɛ ne abo pɛle.

english_verse: Now he will always be highly honored.
translation_verse: Ɔnate ɛhe ati bebuli ye kyɛ ɔtengyɛ wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu afebɔɔ.

english_verse: At Meribah Spring they turned against you and made you furious.
translation_verse: Behuli AWURADE ahone wɔ Meriba nzue ne anwo, na ɔnate bɛ ti Mose nyane edwirɛ.

english_verse: Then Moses got into trouble for speaking in anger.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛmane Mose ahone huli, na ole ɛyaa dwudwole.

english_verse: Our Lord, they disobeyed you by refusing to destroy the nations.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ banguku maen maen nemɔ so mmenia bɔ AWURADE fale bɛ nwo ahyɛdeɛ mane bɛ ne,

english_verse: Instead they were friendly with those foreigners and followed their customs.
translation_verse: na mmom bɛ ne bosoensolɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛtenane bɛbɔle nu, na besuane bɛ yɔleɛ nemɔ bɛyɔle bie.

english_verse: Then they fell into the trap of worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Bɛsɔnene bɛ mmosoen nemɔ, na ɛhe yɛle bɛ so ngaen.

english_verse: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons
translation_verse: Bɛfale bɛ mma mmienzua ne mmrasua bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛmane sunzummɔne mɔ.

english_verse: and to the gods of Canaan. Then they poured out the blood of these innocent children and made the land filthy.
translation_verse: Bɛhane mogya bɔ onni fɔ ɔ beguale, bɔ ɔte bɛ mma mmienzua ne mmrasua bɛ mogya, bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛmane Kanaan mmosoen mɔ ɔ; na mogya ne mane efiɛ hane aseɛ ne.

english_verse: By doing such gruesome things, they also became filthy.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛ yɔleɛ mane bɛ nwo guale fiɛ, na bɛ yɔleɛ ne kakyili adwamanbɔlɛ.

english_verse: Finally, Lord, you were angry and terribly disgusted with your people.
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE fɛle ye maen ne aso yaa paa, na ohyili ye agyapadeɛ ne.

english_verse: So you put them in the power of nations that hated them.
translation_verse: Ɔfale bɛ wurale maen maen mɔ sa maa ɔnate so bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ lili bɛ so.

english_verse: They were mistreated and abused by their enemies,
translation_verse: Bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ hyɛle bɛ so, na belili bɛ so tumi maa bewurale bɛ bo.

english_verse: but you saved them time after time. They were determined to rebel, and their sins caused their downfall.
translation_verse: AWURADE pepɛ lele bɛ mmerɛ pee, nakoso bɛhyɛle da bɛhɔle so bɛyɛle ye so asoserɛ, na ɔnate b’amumuyɛɛ ti, bɛbrɛle bɛ ase.

english_verse: You answered their prayers when they were in trouble.
translation_verse: Nakoso onwuni amaneɛ bɔ né benwu ye ne, na otiele bɛ sufrɛ.

english_verse: that their enemies had pity on them.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bɛhyele Yisraelfoɛ nnure amukoraa, Nyameɛ maa benwuni Yisraelfoɛ anwumvoin.

english_verse: Save us, Lord God! Bring us back from among the nations. Let us celebrate and shout in praise of your holy name.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ, pepɛ de yɛ, ná boa yɛ noa fi maen maen nemɔ aso, amaa ɔnate so yala wɔ dumaa krongron ne ase, ná yahoahoa yɛ nwo wɔ w’ayɛyelɛ nu.

english_verse: Lord God of Israel, you deserve to be praised forever and ever. Let everyone say, “Amen! Shout praises to the Lord!”
translation_verse: AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ne, animnyam hã ye ofi tetetete bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ ɔ! Ma maen ne amukoraa bɛhã kyɛ, “Amen.” Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: ) The Lord Is Good to His People
translation_verse: Nyameɛ nwu ye mma anwumvoin

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! He is good to us, and his love never fails.
translation_verse: Ao, ɛmɔla AWURADE ase, ofikyɛ ɔte paa, na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Everyone the Lord has rescued from trouble should praise him,
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ AWURADE apepɛ ale bɛ ne, odi kyɛ bɛkã sɔ; bɛ bɔ wapepɛ wale bɛ wafi amaneɛ nu,

english_verse: everyone he has brought from the east and the west, the north and the south.
translation_verse: ná waboaboa bɛ noa wafi aseɛ mɔ aso, ofi eyia afiteleɛ bɔ ɔkwaadwu eyia atɔleɛ, ofi sorɔ bɔ ɔkwaadwu ngwaen ne.

english_verse: Some of you were lost in the scorching desert, far from a town.
translation_verse: Behyinihyinini aseɛ pralaa so wɔ atee bɔ ebiala mva so ɔ so, bɔ bannwu kuro biala bandena so ɔ.

english_verse: You were hungry and thirsty and about to give up.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔen ne nzuhɔen huni bɛ, na bɛ kra botole wɔ bɛ nu.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Yeɛ besu bɛfrɛle AWURADE wɔ b’amaneɛnwunɛ nu, na ɔpepɛ lele bɛ fili b’anwokyere nu.

english_verse: At once he brought you to a town.
translation_verse: Olili bɛ nyunu fale bɛ fale atee tee so maa benyane kuro bɛtenane so.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛye AWURADE ayɛ wɔ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, wɔ ye anwanwadeɛ bɔ ɔyɔ ma adasa mmaa ne ati.

english_verse: To everyone who is thirsty, he gives something to drink; to everyone who is hungry, he gives good things to eat.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔma sona kra bɔ nzuhɔen ku ye ɔ nzue, na ɔfa aleɛ paa ma sona kra bɔ ɛhɔen ku ye ɔ ma ye ko yi.

english_verse: Some of you were prisoners suffering in deepest darkness and bound by chains,
translation_verse: Ebiemɔ tenane awosii ne ewue bɔnza awosii kabii nu, kukunufoɛ bɔ benwuni amaneɛ ná beguale bɛ ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ ɔ.

english_verse: because you had rebelled against God Most High and refused his advice.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛyɔle Nyameɛ dwirɛ nwo lɔen, na bebuli Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne nhyehyɛleɛ animtia.

english_verse: You were worn out from working like slaves, and no one came to help.
translation_verse: Ɔfale amaneɛ piri tole bɛ so brɛle b’ase, befifini ase bɔ bannya bokafoɛ biala ɔ.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Yeɛ besu bɛfrɛle AWURADE wɔ b’amaneɛnwunɛ nu, na ɔpepɛ lele bɛ fili b’anwokyere nu.

english_verse: He brought you out of the deepest darkness and broke your chains.
translation_verse: Ɔyele bɛ fili awosii ne ewue bɔnza awosii kabii nu, na obubuli ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ bɔ ogua bɛ ne anu.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛye AWURADE ayɛ wɔ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, wɔ ye anwanwadeɛ bɔ ɔyɔ ma adasa mmaa ne ati.

english_verse: He breaks down bronze gates and shatters iron locks.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wabubu kɔɔbere anoa mɔ, na wapepɛ buralɛ nu ahuronzi ahuronzi.

english_verse: Some of you had foolishly committed a lot of sins and were in terrible pain.
translation_verse: Ebiemɔ yɛle ngwaseafoɛ ɔnate bɛ mmeraatolɛ ti, na ɔnate b’amumuyɛɛ ti benwuni amaneɛ.

english_verse: The very thought of food was disgusting to you, and you were almost dead.
translation_verse: Bɛ kra noa nu tole wɔ aleɛ biala nwo, na bepingyele ɛborɔ atee pambim.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Yeɛ besu bɛfrɛle AWURADE wɔ b’amaneɛnwunɛ nu, na ɔpepɛ lele bɛ fili b’anwokyere nu.

english_verse: By the power of his own word, he healed you and saved you from destruction.
translation_verse: Ɔsomane ye dwirɛ ne, na ɔsale bɛ anwonyerɛ, na ɔpepɛ lele bɛ fili b’amaneɛnwunɛ nu.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛye AWURADE ayɛ wɔ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, wɔ ye anwanwadeɛ bɔ ɔyɔ ma adasa mmaa ne ati.

english_verse: You should celebrate by offering sacrifices and singing joyful songs to tell what he has done.
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ bɛbɔ asennaa afɔleɛ, ná bɛfa ahurusi dwein bɛbɔ ye nnwumaa nwo dawure.

english_verse: Some of you made a living by sailing the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Ebiemɔ fale ɛlɛen bɛhɔle ɛpo, na belili dwaa wɔ asue mbiri nemɔ aso.

english_verse: and you saw the miracles the Lord performed there.
translation_verse: Benwuni AWURADE nnwumaa, ye anwanwadeɛ nnwumaa wɔ buma ne anu.

english_verse: At his command a storm arose, and waves covered the sea.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔhyɛle mvrama piri maa otuli, na mvrama ne mane ɛpo asorɔkye pagyale.

english_verse: You were tossed to the sky and to the ocean depths, until things looked so bad that you lost your courage.
translation_verse: Ɔfo hɔle anwuro anwuro, na osa ooguale buma nemɔ anu; edwirɛ bɔ ɔtole bɛ ne ati, b’anwoserɛ tu minini.

english_verse: You were in serious trouble, but you prayed to the Lord, and he rescued you.
translation_verse: Yeɛ besu bɛfrɛle AWURADE wɔ b’amaneɛnwunɛ nu, na ɔpepɛ lele bɛ fili b’anwokyere nu.

english_verse: He made the storm stop and the sea be quiet.
translation_verse: Ɔmane mvrama piri ne yɛle konn, na ɛpo asorɔkye ne yɛle dinn.

english_verse: You were happy because of this, and he brought you to the port where you wanted to go.
translation_verse: Afei ɔyɛle bɛ fɛ kyɛ mvrama ne asorɔkye ne noa abrɛ ase ɔ, na ɔfale bɛ hɔle b’ɛlɛen agyinaleɛ bɔ bɛpena ne anu.

english_verse: You should praise the Lord for his love and for the wonderful things he does for all of us.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛye AWURADE ayɛ wɔ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, wɔ ye anwanwadeɛ bɔ ɔyɔ ma adasa mmaa ne ati.

english_verse: Honor the Lord when you and your leaders meet to worship.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛkamvo ye wɔ maen nyianu ne anu, ná bɛye ye ayɛ wɔ mbanyi badwa ne anu.

english_verse: If you start doing wrong, the Lord will turn rivers into deserts,
translation_verse: Ɔkakyi asue mɔ maa bɛyɛ ɛserɛ, na ɔkakyi mbombonzue mɔ maa bɛyɛ aseɛ wosee,

english_verse: flowing streams into scorched land, and fruitful fields into beds of salt.
translation_verse: ɔkakyi aseɛ bɔ ɔkye aleɛ ɔ maa ɔyɛ ɛgyɛhyerɛ, ɔnate aseɛ ne aso ama bɛ bɔne ti.

english_verse: But the Lord can also turn deserts into lakes and scorched land into flowing streams.
translation_verse: Ɔkakyi ɛserɛ maa ɔyɛ ɛkwaa, ɔkakyi aseɛ wosee maa ɔyɛ mbombonzue.

english_verse: If you are hungry, you can settle there and build a town.
translation_verse: Na berɛ yeɛ ɔma bɛ bɔ ɛhɔen ku bɛ ne bɛtena ɔ, na bɛkyekye kuro bɛtena so;

english_verse: You can plant fields and vineyards that produce a good harvest.
translation_verse: bɛyɔ boo, bedua bobe, na benya fieso aleɛ pee.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you with many children and with herds of cattle.
translation_verse: Oyira bɛ maa bɛta pee, na ɔmma bɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ bɛ somaa so nde.

english_verse: Sometimes you may be crushed by troubles and sorrows, until only a few of you are left to survive.
translation_verse: Bɛ somaa so te, na bedi bɛ so ngonim, ɔnate nhyɛsoɛ, amaneɛ ne aworabɔlɛ ti.

english_verse: But the Lord will take revenge on those who conquer you, and he will make them wander across desert sands.
translation_verse: Obu atitirefoɛ animtia, na ɔmaa bekyinikyini wɔ ɛserɛ so bɔ atee ɔnne so ɔ so.

english_verse: When you are suffering and in need, he will come to your rescue, and your families will grow as fast as a herd of sheep.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔma bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ so fi amaneɛ nu, na ɔma bɛ mmusua yɛ pee kyɛ mmoaen kure.

english_verse: You will see this because you obey the Lord, but everyone who is wicked will be silenced.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɛ nwu ye, na bɛ nye gye; na amumuyɛɛ amukoraa bɛkã bɛ noa bɛto nu.

english_verse: Be wise! Remember this and think about the kindness of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔse nworɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔdwene sɔ edwirɛ hemɔ anwo, odi kyɛ ɔdwene AWURADE ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne anwo yee.

english_verse: Our God, I am faithful to you with all my heart, and you can trust me. I will sing and play music for you with all that I am.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, m’ahone gyi berɛ pindinn, m’ahone gyi berɛ pindinn! Ngɔto dwein ngɔye wɔ ayɛ. Me kra, tingye!

english_verse: I will start playing my harps before the sun rises.
translation_verse: Sangoo ne adengum, ɛ́mɔtingye! Me koso ngotingye alebahyene.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, for everyone to hear; I will sing hymns to you in every nation.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ngɔfa asennaa ngɔma wɔ wɔ maen maen mɔ nu; ngɔto wɔ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein wɔ maen nemɔ anu.

english_verse: Your love reaches higher than the heavens, and your loyalty extends beyond the clouds.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ye piri kɔ anwuro tra ewienu dɔ paa, yeɛ wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne, okodwu munungum nemɔ anu dɔ.

english_verse: Answer my prayers and use your powerful arm to give us victory. Then the people you love will be safe.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná ɛkɔpepɛ kole bɛ bɔ ekuro bɛ dwirɛ ne ati, fa wɔ sa famaa ne de yɛ ngoa, ná tie me.

english_verse: Our God, from your holy place you made this promise: “I will gladly divide up the city of Shechem and give away Succoth Valley piece by piece.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ ahã ye wɔ ye nekaa krongron berɛ kyɛ, “Ngɔfa ahurusililɛ nu ngɔhyehyɛ Sɛkem nu, ná mapakyepakye Sukote bɔnza ne anu.

english_verse: The lands of Gilead and Manasseh are mine. Ephraim is my war helmet, and Judah is my symbol of royal power.
translation_verse: Gileade te me deɛ, yeɛ Manase koso te me deɛ; Efraim te me buralɛ kyerɛ, Yuda te me hɔtɔ.

english_verse: Moab is merely my washbasin, and Edom belongs to me. I shout with victory over the Philistines.”
translation_verse: Moabo te me nyanzɛen, Edom so yeɛ mefindi me mbaboa megua ɔ; na Filistia so yeɛ mebɔ ngonimlilɛ ese ɔ.”

english_verse: Our God, who will bring me to the fortress or lead me to Edom?
translation_verse: Kuro bɔ bato ye nwo fasue ne, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔfa me kɔhɔ so ɔ? Nwa yeɛ okoli me nyunu kɔfa me kɔhɔ Edom ɔ?

english_verse: Have you rejected us? You don't lead our armies.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, aso ɛppole yɛ anaa? Ao Nyameɛ, aso ɛyyakyili yɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ bɛ si gyinalɛ?

english_verse: Help us defeat our enemies! No one else can rescue us.
translation_verse: Ao, boka yɛ de yɛ fi amaneɛ nu, ofikyɛ kuro sona mmokalɛ te mbaen!

english_verse: Only you give us victory and crush our enemies.
translation_verse: Sɛ AWURADE boka yɛ so a, yɛkoli ngonim; ye yeɛ okotiatia yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: I praise you, God! Don't keep silent.
translation_verse: Ao me Nyameɛ bɔ meye wɔ ayɛ ɔ, nnɛmua wɔ noa,

english_verse: and hateful things are said for no reason.
translation_verse: Bafa ɛpɔen dwirɛ babɔ me nwo mborɔkaa bayia, na bɛfa ngondii bɛtoa me mbaen.

english_verse: I had pity and prayed for my enemies, but their words to me were harsh and cruel.
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo ɔdɔ bɔ manya ye ne, bɛto me soen bɛfa besi ye gya nu, wɔ aberɛ bɔ mebɔ mbaeɛ po ɔ.

english_verse: For being friendly and kind, they paid me back with meanness and hatred.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛfa bɔne betua me paa so kerɛ, yeɛ bɛfa ɛpɔen betua me ɔdɔ so kerɛ.

english_verse: My enemies said, “Find some worthless fools to accuse him of a crime.
translation_verse: Ye bɔnefoɛ maa ɔho tia ye; ma Abɔnzam ogyina ye sa famaa so.

english_verse: Try him and find him guilty! Consider his prayers a lie.
translation_verse: Ndɛenbualɛ nu, maa oli fɔ; ma ye mbaeɛ ɔkakyi ye so bɔne.

english_verse: Cut his life short and let someone else have his job.
translation_verse: Ma ye ngoa ɔyɛ tika, ma sona foforɛ ole ye dibea ne.

english_verse: Make orphans of his children and a widow of his wife;
