translation_verse: Ma ye mma mɔ bɛyɛ nyisiaa, ná ɔye koso ɔyɛ kunaniɛ.

english_verse: make his children beg for food and live in the slums.
translation_verse: Ma ye mma mɔ bɛbɔ asesa ná bɛsrɛsrɛ; maa betu bɛ befi b’awuro buburuwaa bɔ bɛte nu ne anu.

english_verse: “Let the people he owes take everything he owns. Give it all to strangers.
translation_verse: Ma sona bɔ wabisa ye berɛ bosea ne, ole ye nwo nningyein amukoraa, ná ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ bɛɛfẽ bɔ wafɛ wanya ye ɔ bɛfa.

english_verse: Don't let anyone be kind to him or have pity on the children he leaves behind.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ebiala yɛ ye paa, yeɛ nnɛma ebiala nwu ye mma ayisiaafoɛ nemɔ anwumvoin.

english_verse: Bring an end to his family, and from now on let him be a forgotten man.
translation_verse: Ma ye boso ama bɛ boso onua, nnɛmaa bɛkaye bɛ dumaa wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ ɔtoa so ne anu.

english_verse: “Don't let the Lord forgive the sins of his parents and his ancestors.
translation_verse: Mesrɛ kyɛ AWURADE ɔkaye ye nana mɔ b’amumuyɛɛ wɔ ye nyunu, yeɛ nnɛmaa okyikyi oni bɔne fi berɛ.

english_verse: Don't let the Lord forget the sins of his family, or let anyone remember his family ever lived.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔne ne, ɔ́tena AWURADE nyunu daa, na bɛ boso ngayeɛ okyikyi fi aseɛ ye aso.

english_verse: He was so cruel to the poor, homeless, and discouraged that they died young.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wangaye kyɛ okonwu anwumvoin ɔ, na mmom ɔtanene ehiafoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔne bɛ bɔ baboto ɔ nye kyɛ ɔpena bɛ ne ewue.

english_verse: “He cursed others. Now place a curse on him! He never wished others well. Wish only trouble for him!
translation_verse: Ohurole amoenwaa, yiti maa obu osa ye. Né ɔmbena saleɛ mma ye mmango, yiti maa saleɛ ɔbɔ ye.

english_verse: He cursed others more often than he dressed himself. Let his curses strike him deep, just as water and olive oil soak through to our bones.
translation_verse: Ɔfale amoenwaa yɛle kyɛ ataadeɛ wurale, yiti maa ɔmeme hɔ ye nwonaen nu kyɛ nzue, kyɛ ngoo oowura ye mmowue nu.

english_verse: Let his curses surround him, just like the belt and clothes he wears each day.”
translation_verse: Maa ɔyɛ kyɛ ɛtena bɔ ɔkera ɔ, kyɛ abɔsoɛ bɔ ɔbɔ ye daa ɔ.

english_verse: Those are the cruel things my enemies wish for me. Let it all happen to them!
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛto me soen ne bɛ bɔ bɛkã me nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ ne, maa ɛhe ɔyɛ b’akatuaa bɔ ofi AWURADE berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord God! Show your great kindness and rescue me.
translation_verse: Nakoso, ao Nyameɛ m’AWURADE, wɔ dumaa ti, di me dwirɛ ma me; pepɛ de me, ofikyɛ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ɔte paa.

english_verse: I am poor and helpless, and I have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nde ehianiɛ, na meyɛ anwumvo, na me kra aboto wɔ me nu.

english_verse: I am fading away like an evening shadow; I am tossed aside like a crawling insect.
translation_verse: Me boso kyikyi kyɛ nɔsoa wawoɛ, na mvrama bɔ me kɔ kyɛ abɛbɛ.

english_verse: I have gone without eating, until my knees are weak, and my body is bony.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔenhyelɛ ama m’aporɛ nu ayɛ hodwoo, na mafɔ kangenaen.

english_verse: When my enemies see me, they say cruel things and shake their heads.
translation_verse: Makakyi ngorohoɛ nikyee mama bɛ; sɛ benwu me a, bɛwoso bɛ ti.

english_verse: Please help me, Lord God! Come and save me because of your love.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ, boka me! Pepɛ de me kyɛbɔ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne osi te ɔ.

english_verse: Let others know that you alone have saved me.
translation_verse: Maa benwu kyɛ wɔ tumi ɔ; kyɛ AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ ayɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I don't care if they curse me, as long as you bless me. You will make my enemies fail when they attack, and you will make me glad to be your servant.
translation_verse: Bɛ de bɛnoma, nakoso wɔ de eyira. Sɛ bɛba me so a, ma bɛ nyunu gua ase, nakoso wɔ somvoɛ de, ma ye nye gye.

english_verse: You will cover them with shame, just as their bodies are covered with clothes.
translation_verse: Ma me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛfa nyanzoen bɛhera, ma bɛ bɔbɔ b’animguaseɛ owura bɛ kyɛ ataadeɛ.

english_verse: I will sing your praises and thank you, Lord, when your people meet.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa me noa ngɔla AWURADE ase paa; ngɔye ye ayɛ wɔ ɛlɔen kandinga nu.

english_verse: The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right side, until I make your enemies into a footstool for you.”
translation_verse: AWURADE sele me mene kyɛ, “Tena me sa famaa so kɔpem kyɛ ngɔfa wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ ngɔyɛ wɔ gya bo ndiasoɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord will let your power reach out from Zion, and you will rule over your enemies.
translation_verse: Wɔ tumi hɔtɔ ne, AWURADE kɔtengyɛ kofi Sion. Di hene wɔ wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ b’afia.

english_verse: Your glorious power will be seen on the day you begin to rule. You will wear the sacred robes and shine like the morning sun in all of your strength.
translation_verse: Kyẽa bɔ ekoli wɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ nyunu, wɔ mmokaa krongron nemɔ aso ne, wɔ maen kofia bɛ kunu bekotu bɛ nwo bekosie berɛ, ofi ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu, wɔ mmerandeɛ kɔwa wɔ berɛ kyɛ bosue.

english_verse: The Lord has made a promise that will never be broken: “You will be a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: AWURADE ata ndaen, na ɔngɔsesã ye adwene: “Ɛte sɔfo afebɔɔ, kyɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛke deɛ ne ala.”

english_verse: The Lord is at your right side, and when he gets angry he will crush the other kings.
translation_verse: AWURADE wɔ wɔ sa famaa so; ye yaafɛlɛ kyẽa ne, ɔkɔtete ahemvo mɔ nu pasapasa.

english_verse: He will judge the nations and crack their skulls, leaving piles of dead bodies all over the earth.
translation_verse: Okobua maen maen mɔ ndɛen, na ɔkɔmaa mmenia fuin koyi bɛ so to; ɔkɔgorɔgorɔ mmenia ti wɔ aseɛ so amukoraa.

english_verse: He will drink from any stream that he chooses, while winning victory after victory.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔno atee noa asue nu nzue. Ye sɔ ati, ɔkɔma ye ti so.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all my heart I will thank the Lord when his people meet.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ! Ngofi m’ahone nu amukoraa ngɔfa asennaa ngɔma AWURADE wɔ teneneefoɛ badwa nu, ɔne nyianu ne anu.

english_verse: The Lord has done many wonderful things! Everyone who is pleased with God's marvelous deeds will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: AWURADE nnwumaa te mbiri mbiri, na mmenia amukoraa bɔ bɛ nye gye nnwumaa ne anwo ne, bɛdwenedwene ye nwo.

english_verse: Everything the Lord does is glorious and majestic, and his power to bring justice will never end.
translation_verse: Ye nnwumaa te anidie ne animnyam, na ye tenenee wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God is famous for his wonderful deeds, and he is kind and merciful.
translation_verse: Wamaa bɛkaye ye anwanwadeɛ nnwumaa nemɔ; AWURADE do mmenia, na ɔse anwumvoin.

english_verse: He gives food to his worshipers and always keeps his agreement with them.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ besuro ye ne, ɔma bɛ aleɛ, na ye nye wɔ ye apam so daa.

english_verse: He has shown his mighty power to his people and has given them the lands of other nations.
translation_verse: Wala ye nnwumaa tumi ali wahyire ye maen, ofikyɛ wafa maen maen mɔ b’agyapadeɛ wama ye maen.

english_verse: God is always honest and fair, and his laws can be trusted.
translation_verse: AWURADE sa noa nnwumaa te nahorɛ ne turoloo, ye ahyɛdeɛ amukoraa timu berɛ pindinn.

english_verse: They are true and right and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Betimu berɛ afebɔɔ, kyɛ bɛ́fa atee bɔ ɔtengyɛ ná ɔte turoloo so beli so.

english_verse: God rescued his people, and he will never break his agreement with them. He is fearsome and holy.
translation_verse: Ɔpepɛ lele ye maen; wahyɛ kyɛ ye apam tena berɛ afebɔɔ. Ye dumaa te Krongron, na ɔyɛ suro!

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the first step to wisdom and good sense. God will always be respected.
translation_verse: AWURADE surolɛ te nworɛnwunɛ ye bohyɛlɛ; bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ sɔ ne, benya nimdeɛ paa. Odi kyɛ bɛye ye ayɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! The Lord blesses everyone who worships him and gladly obeys his teachings.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ! Sona bɔ osuro AWURADE, ná ye nye gye ye mmeraa dwirɛ nwo paa ne, onya saleɛ.

english_verse: Their descendants will have great power in the land, because the Lord blesses all who do right.
translation_verse: Ye boso ama kɔyɛ titire wɔ aseɛ ye aso; teneneeniɛ ye aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ konya saleɛ.

english_verse: They will get rich and prosper and will always be remembered for their fairness.
translation_verse: Anwonyadeɛ ne esikaa wɔ ye awuro, na ye tenenee wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Life will go well for those who freely lend and are honest in business.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye ti anu yɛ mmerɛ, ná ɔfa fɛmo ye mmango, ná ɔfa nahorɛlilɛ bɔ ye bra ne, oyie ye yé.

english_verse: They won't ever be troubled, and the kind things they do will never be forgotten.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ okogyina pindinn, na ye nwo ngayeɛ kɔtena berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Bad news won't bother them; they have decided to trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Onzuro ahunundetelɛ dwirɛ; ye adwene si ye pi, na ye wora wura AWURADE nu.

english_verse: They are dependable and not afraid, and they will live to see their enemies defeated.
translation_verse: Ye adwene gyi berɛ pindinn, na ongosuro kɔpem kyɛ bɔ ɔpena kyɛ ɔto ye pɔfoɛ mɔ ne, okonwu ye ɔ.

english_verse: They will always be remembered and greatly praised, because they were kind and freely gave to the poor.
translation_verse: Ɔye ye kunu fa nningyein kyekyɛ, ɔyɛ ehiafoɛ paa; ye tenenee wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ, na ye anwoserɛ kɔhɔ so animnyam nu.

english_verse: When evil people see this, they angrily bite their tongues and disappear. They will never get what they really want.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ nwu ye, na ɔyɛ ye ahi; ɔkɔnwose ye gye ná waboto; bɔ bɔnefoɛ wafa wasie ye nye so ne, ɔngɔyɛ berɛ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Everyone who serves him, come and praise his name.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ! Ao AWURADE somvoɛ mɔ, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ. Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE dumaa ne ayɛ.

english_verse: Let the name of the Lord be praised now and forever.
translation_verse: Animnyam hã AWURADE dumaa, ofi ɛnɛ kodwu afebɔɔ.

english_verse: From dawn until sunset the name of the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Ofi eyia ye fitelɛ kodwu ye tɔlɛ, odi kyɛ bɛye AWURADE dumaa ayɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is far above all of the nations; he is more glorious than the heavens.
translation_verse: AWURADE wɔ anwuro anwuro tra maen maen amukoraa, na ye animnyam kɔ anwuro tra ewienu.

english_verse: No one can compare with the Lord our God. His throne is high above,
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔte kyɛ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ye atenaleɛ wɔ anwuro anwuro,

english_verse: and he looks down to see the heavens and the earth.
translation_verse: bɔ ɔbere ye nye ase nea ewienu ne aseɛ so ɔ?

english_verse: God lifts the poor and needy from dust and ashes,
translation_verse: Ɔma ehianiɛ so fi asefuo nu, na ɔma sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ɔ so fi fofoɛ so,

english_verse: and he lets them take part in ruling his people.
translation_verse: kyɛ ɔmaa ɔtena atitirefoɛ nu, ɔtena ye maen atitirefoɛ nu.

english_verse: When a wife has no children, he blesses her with some, and she is happy. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ɔmaa mmotaen brasua ɔbɔ taen, maa ɔyɛ brataen bɔ ye nye agye ɔ. Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: God brought his people out of Egypt, that land with a strange language.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Yisrael fili Misraim ne, bɔ Yakob boso ama fili maen bɔ bɛkã dwudwolɛ foforɛ so ne,

english_verse: He made Judah his holy place and ruled over Israel.
translation_verse: Yuda yɛle Nyameɛ nekaa krongron, Yisrael yɛle ye maen bɔ odi so ɔ.

english_verse: When the sea looked at God, it ran away, and the Jordan River flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Ɛpo nwuni ye, na ɔnwatili; asue Yɔɔdan sale ye si.

english_verse: The mountains and the hills skipped around like goats.
translation_verse: Mmokaa nemɔ huruhuruli kyɛ mmoaen nyii, pambaa nemɔ huruhuruli kyɛ mmoaen mmaa.

english_verse: Ask the sea why it ran away or ask the Jordan why it flowed upstream.
translation_verse: Ao ɛpo, nzikyɛ yeɛ wayɔ wɔ maa anwati ye? Ao asue Yɔɔdan, nzikyɛ yeɛ wamaa asa wɔ si ye?

english_verse: Ask the mountains and the hills why they skipped like goats!
translation_verse: Ao mmokaa mɔ, nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔmaa ɛmɔhuruhuruli kyɛ mmoaen nyii ye? Ao pambaa mɔ, nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔma ɛmɔhuruhuruli kyɛ mmoaen mmaa ye?

english_verse: Earth, you will tremble, when the Lord God of Jacob comes near,
translation_verse: Ao aseɛ, ma wɔ nwo wosowoso wɔ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ma wɔ nwo wosowoso wɔ wɔ Yakob Nyameɛ nyunu,

english_verse: because he turns solid rock into flowing streams and pools of water.
translation_verse: ye bɔ ɔmane nyɔbotaen ne kakyili ɛkwaa, ná ɔmane twerɛboɛ ne kakyili mbombonzue ne.

english_verse: We don't deserve praise! The Lord alone deserves all of the praise, because of his love and faithfulness.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nna yɛ, nna yɛ, na mmom wɔ dumaa yeɛ ɔfata animnyam ɔ, ɔnate wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔne wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne ati.

english_verse: Why should the nations ask, “Where is your God?”
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ maen maen bɛkã kyɛ, “Bɛ Nyameɛ ne, ɔwɔ nisua?” ɔ.

english_verse: Our God is in the heavens, doing as he chooses.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, yɛ Nyameɛ ne ɔwɔ anwuro, na bɔ okuro biala yeɛ ɔyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Bɛ mmosoen nemɔ te ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ, bɛte mmenia sa noa adwuma.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Bele noa, nakoso bɛngora dwudwo, bele anyeɛ, nakoso bennwu nikye.

english_verse: Their ears can't hear, and their noses can't smell.
translation_verse: Bele asoɛ, nakoso bɛnde dwirɛ, bele bonyi, nakoso bɛnde pambaen.

english_verse: Their hands have no feeling, their legs don't move, and they can't make a sound.
translation_verse: Bele asaa, nakoso bɛngora bɛnzɔ nikyee nu; bele agyirɛ, nakoso bɛngora nate, yeɛ bɛngora bɛmva bɛ komvi bendwudwo.

english_verse: Everyone who made the idols and all who trust them are just as helpless as those useless gods.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ mmosoen nemɔ ne, bɛte kyɛ mmosoen nemɔ ala; na ebiala bɔ ɔfa ye wora wura mmosoen nemɔ anu ne, ɔte kyɛ mmosoen nemɔ ala.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Ao Yisrael, fa wɔ wora wura AWURADE nu! Ye yeɛ ɔte wɔ bokafoɛ ne w’akokyɛm ɔ.

english_verse: Family of Aaron the priest, you must trust the Lord to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Ao Aarɔn awuro ama, ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ wora béwura AWURADE nu! Ye yeɛ ɔte ɛmɔ bokafoɛ ne ɛmɔ akokyɛm ɔ.

english_verse: All of you worship the Lord, so you must trust him to help and protect you.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsuro AWURADE ne, ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ wora béwura AWURADE nu! Ye yeɛ ɔte ɛmɔ bokafoɛ ne ɛmɔ akokyɛm ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will not forget to give us his blessing; he will bless all of Israel and the family of Aaron.
translation_verse: AWURADE nye wɔ yɛ so, okoyira yɛ; okoyira Yisrael awuro ama, okoyira Aarɔn awuro ama;

english_verse: All who worship the Lord, no matter who they are, will receive his blessing.
translation_verse: okoyira bɛ bɔ besuro AWURADE ɔ, kwahweabaa mɔ ne atitire mɔ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will let your family and your descendants always grow strong.
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔma ɛmɔ kɔta pee, ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ bosofoɛ mɔ.

english_verse: May the Lord who created the heavens and the earth give you his blessing.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ ɔbɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ne, óyira ɛmɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has kept the heavens for himself, but he has given the earth to us humans.
translation_verse: Anwuro te Nyameɛ ye deɛ, nakoso aseɛ de, wafa wama adasa mmaa.

english_verse: The dead are silent and cannot praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Awufoɛ bɛnye AWURADE ayɛ, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛkɔ ɛborɔ dɔ konn nu ne, bɛ koso bɛnye ye ayɛ.

english_verse: but we will praise him now and forevermore. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Nakoso yɛ de, yɛkɔkamvo AWURADE, ofi ɛnɛ kodwu afebɔɔ. Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: I love you, Lord! You answered my prayers.
translation_verse: Mekuro AWURADE dwirɛ, ofikyɛ watie me mbaeɛ ne me sufrɛ.

english_verse: You paid attention to me, and so I will pray to you as long as I live.
translation_verse: Wayɛ asoɛ watie me, yiti ngosu ngɔfrɛ ye wɔ mmerɛ bɔ nde ngoa nu ɔ.

english_verse: Death attacked from all sides, and I was captured by its painful chains. But when I was really hurting,
translation_verse: Ewue nyamaa brabrale me. Ɛborɔ dɔ yealɛ sɔle me nu; nwuni amaneɛ ne aworabɔlɛ.

english_verse: I prayed and said, “Lord, please don't let me die!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ nzu mvrɛle AWURADE dumaa kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE, mesrɛ wɔ, pepɛ de me kra.”

english_verse: You are kind, Lord, so good and merciful.
translation_verse: AWURADE do sona, ná ɔtengyɛ; amba, yɛ Nyameɛ se anwumvoin.

english_verse: You protect ordinary people, and when I was helpless, you saved me
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ awiɛmvoɛ nwo waen; mmerɛ bɔ ngɔle amaneɛ nu ne, ɔpepɛ lele me.

english_verse: and treated me so kindly that I don't need to worry anymore.
translation_verse: Ao me kra, sa kɔ nekaa bɔ ede wɔ nwome ne, ofikyɛ AWURADE alo wɔ paa.

english_verse: You, Lord, have saved my life from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
translation_verse: Apepɛ ale me kra afi ewue nu, akyikyi me nye moen, na amma manzoti.

english_verse: Now I will walk at your side in this land of the living.
translation_verse: Ngɔnate AWURADE nyunu wɔ ateasefoɛ aseɛ ye aso.

english_verse: I was faithful to you when I was suffering,
translation_verse: Male mali, mmerɛ bɔ ngane kyɛ, “Nwɔ amaneɛ nu paa” ne po.

english_verse: though in my confusion I said, “I can't trust anyone!”
translation_verse: Nne ahunundetelɛ ngane kyɛ, “Kuro sona biala te ngondomboniɛ.”

english_verse: What must I give you, Lord, for being so good to me?
translation_verse: Ɛlolɛ amukoraa bɔ AWURADE alo me ye, nzikyɛ yeɛ me wora ngɔyɔ ngɔma ye ɔ?

english_verse: I will pour out an offering of wine to you, and I will pray in your name because you have saved me.
translation_verse: Ngɔma ngoalelɛ kulie ne aso, ná mabɔ AWURADE dumaa masɔne ye.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people meet.
translation_verse: Ngotua m’aboadeɛ ngɔma AWURADE, wɔ ye mmenia amukoraa bɛ nyunu.

english_verse: You are deeply concerned when one of your loyal people faces death.
translation_verse: AWURADE ye teneneefoɛ bɛ wue, odi mu wɔ ye nyunu.

english_verse: I worship you, Lord, just as my mother did, and you have rescued me from the chains of death.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nde wɔ somvoɛ, nde wɔ somvoɛ, w’afaneɛ awa ole me. Asangye nyamaa bɔ wakyekye me ne.

english_verse: I will offer you a sacrifice to show how grateful I am, and I will pray.
translation_verse: Ngɔbɔ asennaa afɔleɛ ngɔma wɔ, ná masu mafrɛ AWURADE dumaa.

english_verse: I will keep my promise to you when your people
translation_verse: Ngotua m’aboadeɛ ngɔma AWURADE, wɔ ye mmenia amukoraa bɛ nyunu,

english_verse: gather at your temple in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: wɔ AWURADE awuro n’aluo berɛ, wɔ w’afia, ao Yerusalem. Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: All of you nations, come praise the Lord! Let everyone praise him.
translation_verse: Maen maen amukoraa, ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ! Maen maen amukoraa ɛ́mɔkamvo ye!

english_verse: God's love for us is wonderful; his faithfulness never ends. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi bɔ ole ye ma yɛ ne, ɔte piri, na AWURADE nahorɛlilɛ ne ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ. Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Ao, ɛmɔla AWURADE ase, ofikyɛ ɔte paa, na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ!

english_verse: Let Israel shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ Yisrael kã kyɛ, “Ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ!”

english_verse: Let the family of Aaron the priest shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ Aarɔn awuro ama bɛkã kyɛ, “Ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ!”

english_verse: Let every true worshiper of the Lord shout, “God is always merciful!”
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ besuro AWURADE ne, odi kyɛ bɛkã kyɛ, “Ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ!”

english_verse: When I was really hurting, I prayed to the Lord. He answered my prayer, and took my worries away.
translation_verse: M’amaneɛnwunɛ ne anu, nzu mvrɛle AWURADE; AWURADE buale me, na ɔyele me fili nu.

english_verse: The Lord is on my side, and I am not afraid of what others can do to me.
translation_verse: AWURADE gyi me si, yiti menzuro, nzikyɛ yeɛ sona kɔhora kɔfa kɔyɔ me ɔ?

english_verse: With the Lord on my side, I will defeat my hateful enemies.
translation_verse: AWURADE gyi me si kyɛ ɔboka me, na ngonwu bɔ mepena kyɛ ɔto me pɔfoɛ mɔ ɔ.

english_verse: It is better to trust the Lord for protection than to trust anyone else,
translation_verse: Ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔfa wɔ nwo kɔto AWURADE so tra kyɛ ɛkɔfa wɔ wora kowura sona nu ɔ.

english_verse: Nations surrounded me, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Maen maen amukoraa bɛpɛle me nwo beyiale, nakoso AWURADE dumaa nu ti, ngane bɛ nguale!

english_verse: They attacked from all sides, but I got rid of them by the power of the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛpɛle me nwo beyiale, amba, bɛpɛle me nwo beyiale, nakoso AWURADE dumaa nu ti, ngane bɛ nguale!

english_verse: They swarmed around like bees, but by the power of the Lord, I got rid of them and their fiery sting.
translation_verse: Bɛpɛle me nwo beyiale kyɛ ɛwommaa, nakoso benuane kyɛ mmowue see, ofikyɛ AWURADE dumaa nu ti, ngane bɛ nguale!

english_verse: Their attacks were so fierce that I nearly fell, but the Lord helped me.
translation_verse: Besumuni me serɛserɛ paa bɔ ahaa mete metɔ ɔ, nakoso AWURADE bokale me.

english_verse: My power and my strength come from the Lord, and he has saved me.
translation_verse: AWURADE te m’anwoserɛ ne me dwein, na ɔte me ngoadefoɛ.

english_verse: From the tents of God's people come shouts of victory: “The Lord is powerful!
translation_verse: Esebɔlɛ ne ngonim dwein bɛgyegye wɔ teneneefoɛ ɛtena sua mɔ nu kyɛ, “AWURADE sa famaa ne di ngonim;

english_verse: With his mighty arm the Lord wins victories! The Lord is powerful!”
translation_verse: AWURADE ama ye sa famaa ne aso, AWURADE sa famaa ne di ngonim.”

english_verse: And so my life is safe, and I will live to tell what the Lord has done.
translation_verse: Mengowu, na mmom ngɔtena ngoa nu, ná mabɔ bɔ AWURADE ayɔ ɔ nwo dawure.

english_verse: He punished me terribly, but he did not let death lay its hands on me.
translation_verse: AWURADE ahwe me so paa, nakoso wamva me wanwura ewue sa.

english_verse: Open the gates of justice! I will enter and tell the Lord how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbukyebukye tenenee anoa mbiri nemɔ bɛ́ma me maa mva nu ngɔmva ayɛyelɛ mma AWURADE.

english_verse: Here is the gate of the Lord! Everyone who does right may enter this gate.
translation_verse: AWURADE anoa piri ne ɛhe, teneneefoɛ kowura nu.

english_verse: I praise the Lord for answering my prayers and saving me.
translation_verse: Meda wɔ ase kyɛ abua me, ná ɛte me ngoadefoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The stone that the builders tossed aside has now become the most important stone.
translation_verse: Nyɔboɛ bɔ suasilɛfoɛ bɛpole ye ne, ye ala yeɛ waayɛ sua ne ndweasoɛ nyɔboɛ titire ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has done this, and it is amazing to us.
translation_verse: AWURADE yeɛ wayɔ ɛhe ɔ, na ɔyɛ nwanwa wɔ yɛ nye so.

english_verse: This day belongs to the Lord! Let's celebrate and be glad today.
translation_verse: Ɛnɛ ole kyẽa bɔ AWURADE wahyehyɛ ne, ɛ́mɔma yɛli ahurusi ná yɛ́ma yɛ nye gye wɔ nu.

english_verse: We'll ask the Lord to save us! We'll sincerely ask the Lord to let us win.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, yɛsrɛ wɔ, pepɛ de yɛ! Ao AWURADE, yɛsrɛ wɔ, maa yɛnya ngɔsoɛ!

english_verse: God bless the one who comes in the name of the Lord! We praise you from here in the house of the Lord.
translation_verse: Saleɛ hã bɔ ɔ́ba wɔ AWURADE dumaa nu ne, yɛwɔ AWURADE awuro wa yeɛ yɛyira wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is our God, and he has given us light! Start the celebration! March with palm branches all the way to the altar.
translation_verse: AWURADE te Nyameɛ, na wama kanea ata ama yɛ. Ɛ́mɔfa ɛberɛ bɛ́pɛ aluoluefoɛ nemɔ anwo beyia maa oodwu afɔleɛ bokyea mmɛen nemɔ anwo.

english_verse: The Lord is my God! I will praise him and tell him how thankful I am.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Nyameɛ ɔ, ngɔye wɔ ayɛ; wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Nyameɛ, ngɔpagya wɔ.

english_verse: Tell the Lord how thankful you are, because he is kind and always merciful.
translation_verse: Ao, ɛmɔla AWURADE ase, ofikyɛ ɔte paa, na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, you bless everyone who lives right and obeys your Law.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛ bra te sannwuu, ná bedi AWURADE mmeraa so ne, benya saleɛ.

english_verse: You bless all those who follow your commands from deep in their hearts
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bedi ye noa dwirɛ so, ná bɛfa b’ahone amukoraa bedi ye si ne, benya saleɛ.

english_verse: and who never do wrong or turn from you.
translation_verse: Afei koso bɛnyɔ mvomsoɛ, na mmom bɛnate ye atee so.

english_verse: You have ordered us always to obey your teachings;
translation_verse: Afa wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ayɛ ahyɛdeɛ, kyɛ yɛli so nahorɛ nu.

english_verse: I don't ever want to stray from your laws.
translation_verse: Ao, ahaa né me bra atengyɛ fɔngɔnn, bɔ medi w’ahyɛdeɛ so ɔ!

english_verse: Thinking about your commands will keep me from doing some foolish thing.
translation_verse: Ɔba ye sɔ a, me nyunu ngogua ase, ofikyɛ me nye wɔ wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne amukoraa so.

english_verse: I will do right and praise you by learning to respect your perfect laws.
translation_verse: Sɛ mesua wɔ tenenee nhyehyɛleɛ ne a, ngɔfa ahone bɔ nu te sannwuu ɔ ngɔye wɔ ayɛ.

english_verse: I will obey all of them! Don't turn your back on me.
translation_verse: Ngoli w’ahyɛdeɛ so, ao, nnɛpo me korakora.

english_verse: Young people can live a clean life by obeying your word.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né aberandeɛ ama ye bra ayɛ sannwuu? Sana ɔnea wɔ dwirɛ ne aso ɔbɔ ye bra.

english_verse: I worship you with all my heart. Don't let me walk away from your commands.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa m’ahone amukoraa ngoli wɔ si; nnɛmaa medi wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne anwo makyebu.

english_verse: I treasure your word above all else; it keeps me from sinning against you.
translation_verse: Mafa wɔ dwirɛ ne masie me ti anu, amaa ɔnate so manyɔ bɔne mandia wɔ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, yɛye wɔ ayɛ, kyirekyire me w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: With my own mouth, I tell others the laws that you have spoken.
translation_verse: Mepakye nu mefa me noa mebɔ wɔ noa nu nhyehyɛleɛ amukoraa nwo dawure.

english_verse: Obeying your instructions brings as much happiness as being rich.
translation_verse: Me nye gye kyɛ ngoli wɔ noa dwirɛ so tra anwonyadeɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: I will study your teachings and follow your footsteps.
translation_verse: Ngɔdwene wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ anwo, ná mama me nye awa wɔ atee nemɔ aso.

english_verse: I will take pleasure in your laws and remember your words.
translation_verse: Ngɔma me nye kɔgye w’ahyɛdeɛ nwo, na mengɔma me wora ngofi wɔ dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: Treat me with kindness, Lord, so that I may live and do what you say.
translation_verse: Do wɔ somvoɛ paa, amaa ɔnate so matena ngoa nu mali wɔ dwirɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Open my mind and let me discover the wonders of your Law.
translation_verse: Bukye me nye maa nwu anwanwadeɛ wɔ wɔ mmeraa ne anu.

english_verse: I live here as a stranger. Don't keep me from knowing your commands.
translation_verse: Nde ɛwɔfoɛ wɔ aseɛ ye aso, nnɛfa wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne fea me.

english_verse: What I want most and at all times is to honor your laws.
translation_verse: Me kra ngora tena, na ye wora dɔ wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne mmerɛ biala.

english_verse: You punish those boastful, worthless nobodies who turn from your commands.
translation_verse: Anwomasoɛfoɛ bɔ banoma bɛ, bɔ bedi wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ nwo makyebu ne, etwi bɛ nyunu.

english_verse: Don't let them sneer and insult me for following you.
translation_verse: Nnɛmaa bɛgoro me nwo, yeɛ nnɛmaa begua me nyunu ase, ofikyɛ mali wɔ noa dwirɛ so.

english_verse: I keep thinking about your teachings, Lord, even if rulers plot against me.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ahemvo bɛtena ase bɛbɔ me ti so porɛ, nakoso wɔ somvoɛ kɔdwene w’ahyɛdeɛ nwo.

english_verse: Your laws are my greatest joy! I follow their advice.
translation_verse: Wɔ noa dwirɛ yeɛ me nye gye ye nwo ɔ, na ɔte me foɛtulɛfoɛ.

english_verse: I am at the point of death. Let your teachings breathe new life into me.
translation_verse: Me kra la mvuture nu pakayaa, maa nya ngoa kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ ne kyire ne.

english_verse: When I told you my troubles, you answered my prayers. Now teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ngane m’atee bɔ nnate so nwo dwirɛ ne, ɛmane me mmuayɛɛ; kyirekyire me w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: Help me to understand your teachings, and I will think about your marvelous deeds.
translation_verse: Maa nde w’ahyɛdeɛ atee ne abo, na ngɔbɔ w’anwanwadeɛ nnwumaa ne anwo dawure.

english_verse: I am overcome with sorrow. Encourage me, as you have promised to do.
translation_verse: Aworabɔlɛ ama me kra aboto; hyɛ me nguraen kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ ne te ɔ.

english_verse: Keep me from being deceitful, and be kind enough to teach me your Law.
translation_verse: Ye ngondombo bra fi me so kɔ, ná fa wɔ mmeraa ne do me.

english_verse: I am determined to be faithful and to respect your laws.
translation_verse: Maneanea nu maye nahorɛlilɛ atee ne, na mafa wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ masie me nye so.

english_verse: I follow your rules, Lord. Don't let me be ashamed.
translation_verse: Mafa me nwo mamata wɔ noa dwirɛ ne, ao AWURADE, nnɛma me nyunu gua ase.

english_verse: I am eager to learn all that you want me to do; help me to understand more.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ atee ne aso wɔ anwokekanɛ nu, ofikyɛ ɛtrɛ me nimdeɛ nu.

english_verse: Point out your rules, Lord, and I won't disobey even one of them.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, kyirekyire me w’ahyɛdeɛ atee ne, na ngoli so ngoodwu ye bo.

english_verse: Help me to understand your Law; I promise to obey it with all my heart.
translation_verse: Ma me nimdeɛ, amaa ɔnate so mali wɔ mmeraa ne aso, na ngɔfa m’ahone amukoraa ngoli so.

english_verse: Direct me by your commands! I love to do what you say.
translation_verse: Di me nyunu fa me fa wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ atee ne aso, ofikyɛ me nye gye ye nwo.

english_verse: Make me want to obey you, rather than to be rich.
translation_verse: Ma m’ahone ooli wɔ noa dwirɛ si, na nnɛmaa okodi anyeboroborolɛ si.

english_verse: Take away my foolish desires, and let me find life by walking with you.
translation_verse: Nningyein bɔ mvasoɛ nne so ne, ye me nye fi bɛ nealɛ so, maa nya ngoa wɔ w’atee ne aso.

english_verse: I am your servant! Do for me what you promised to those who worship you.
translation_verse: Ma wɔ bɔhyɛ ne, ɔbra nu ma w’akoaa bɔ watu ye nwo wasie berɛ osuro wɔ ne.

english_verse: Your wonderful teachings protect me from the insults that I hate so much.
translation_verse: Animguaseɛ bɔ mesuro ne, pa gua ma me, ofikyɛ wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ te paa.

english_verse: I long for your teachings. Be true to yourself and let me live.
translation_verse: Amba, me wora adɔ wɔ mmeraa ne; gyina wɔ tenenee ne aso maa nya ngoa.

english_verse: Show me your love and save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ye ye ali kyire me, yeɛ wɔ ngoalelɛ ne, kyɛbɔ wɔ bɔhyɛ te ɔ,

english_verse: Then I will have an answer for everyone who insults me for trusting your word.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so manya mmuayɛɛ mama bɛ bɔ bɛgoro me nwo ne, ofikyɛ mafa me wora mawura wɔ dwirɛ ne anu.

english_verse: I rely on your laws! Don't take away my chance to speak your truth.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ nahorɛ ne hanɛ ne, nnɛmaa ɔbɔ me koraa, ofikyɛ mafa me wora mawura wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne anu.

english_verse: I will keep obeying your Law forever and ever.
translation_verse: Ngoli wɔ mmeraa ne aso mmerɛ biala maa okoodwu afebɔɔ.

english_verse: I have gained perfect freedom by following your teachings,
translation_verse: Ngɔnate bɔ hwee nha me ɔ, ofikyɛ mapena w’ahyɛdeɛ ne si atee.

english_verse: and I trust them so much that I tell them to kings.
translation_verse: Ngɔhã wɔ noa dwirɛ nwo dwirɛ ngohyire ahemvo mɔ koso, na me nyunu ngogua ase.

english_verse: I love your commands! They bring me happiness.
translation_verse: Menya anigye wɔ wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ nwo, ofikyɛ ɔla m’ahone.

english_verse: I love and respect them and will keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Mekuro wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne, na mefa anidie mema ye, na ngɔdwene w’ahyɛdeɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: Don't forget your promise to me, your servant. I depend on it.
translation_verse: Kaye wɔ dwirɛ bɔ ahã ahyire wɔ somvoɛ ne, bɔ amaa mafa me wora mawura nu ne.

english_verse: When I am hurting, I find comfort in your promise that leads to life.
translation_verse: M’amaneɛnwunɛ nu aworakyekyerɛ ole kyɛ, wɔ bɔhyɛ ne maa menya ngoa.

english_verse: Conceited people sneer at me, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Anwomasoɛfoɛ bɛgoro me nwo paa, nakoso menni wɔ mmeraa ne anwo makyebu.

english_verse: I find true comfort, Lord, because your laws have stood the test of time.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, sɛ medwene wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ ofi tete ne anwo a, né me wora akyekye.

english_verse: I get furious when evil people turn against your Law.
translation_verse: Ɔnate bɔnefoɛ bɔ bɛpo wɔ mmeraa ne ati, m’ahone ahu paa.

english_verse: No matter where I am, your teachings fill me with songs.
translation_verse: Awuro bɔ mayɛ ɛwɔfoɛ maatena nu ne, w’ahyɛdeɛ yeɛ ɔte me dwein ɔ.

english_verse: Even in the night I think about you, Lord, and I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, odwu kɔngɔen a mekaye wɔ dumaa, na medi wɔ mmeraa ne aso.

english_verse: You have blessed me because I have always followed your teachings.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ayɛ me deɛ, ofikyɛ mali wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ so.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my choice, and I will obey you.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE wɔ yeɛ ɛte me kyɛfa ɔ; mehyɛ bɔ kyɛ ngoli wɔ dwirɛ ne aso.

english_verse: With all my heart I beg you to be kind to me, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Mefa m’ahone amukoraa mesrɛ kyɛ do me; nwu me anwumvoin kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ te ɔ.

english_verse: I pay careful attention as you lead me, and I follow closely.
translation_verse: Sɛ medwenedwene me bra nwo a, mesa metu agyirɛ mebadi wɔ noa dwirɛ so.

english_verse: As soon as you command, I do what you say.
translation_verse: Mema me nwo yɛ nyera, na menyɛ ngyɛkyerɛ kyɛ ngoli wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: Evil people may set a trap, but I obey your Law.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɔnefoɛ nyamaa abrabra me de, nakoso me wora mvi wɔ mmeraa ne.

english_verse: Your laws are so fair that I wake up and praise you in the middle of the night.
translation_verse: Medwɔso abunnamu meda wɔ ase, ɔnate wɔ tenenee nhyehyɛleɛ ne ati.

english_verse: I choose as my friends everyone who worships you and follows your teachings.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ ne, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bedi w’ahyɛdeɛ so ne, nde bɛ mukoraa bɛ biɛngo.

english_verse: Our Lord, your love is seen all over the world. Teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, wayi aseɛ ye aso to; kyirekyire me w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord, and you have kept your promise to treat me with kindness.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, alo wɔ somvoɛ kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ te ɔ.

english_verse: Give me wisdom and good sense. I trust your commands.
translation_verse: Kyirekyire me wɔ ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ne wɔ nimdeɛ ne, ofikyɛ mede wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne medi.

english_verse: Once you corrected me for not obeying you, but now I do obey.
translation_verse: Anzana ɛbaahwe me so ne, né mali makyebu, nakoso afei de, medi wɔ dwirɛ so.

english_verse: You are kindhearted, and you do good things, so teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ɛte paa, na ɛyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ, kyirekyire me w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: My reputation is being ruined by conceited liars, but with all my heart I follow your teachings.
translation_verse: Anwomasoɛfoɛ bato me soen, nakoso mefa m’ahone amukoraa medi wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ so.

english_verse: Those liars have no sense, but I find happiness in your Law.
translation_verse: B’adwene ala kyɛ nguɛ, nakoso me de, me nye gye wɔ mmeraa ne anwo.

english_verse: When you corrected me, it did me good because it taught me to study your laws.
translation_verse: Ɔte paa ma me kyɛ ɛhwene me so ɔ, amaa ɔnate so masua w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: I would rather obey you than to have a thousand pieces of silver and gold.
translation_verse: Wɔ noa nu mmeraa te paa ma me tra esikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ apee apee.

english_verse: You created me and put me together. Make me wise enough to learn what you have commanded.
translation_verse: Wɔ sa yeɛ ɛfa bɔle me ná esiesiele me ɔ; ma me ndeaseɛ maa mva nzua wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: Your worshipers will see me, and they will be glad that I trust your word.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ ne, bekonwu me bekoli ahurusi, ofikyɛ mafa me wora mawura wɔ dwirɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Your decisions are correct, and you were right to punish me.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, mese kyɛ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ te turoloo, na ɛnate nahorɛlilɛ so ahwe me so.

english_verse: I serve you, Lord. Comfort me with your love, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Ma wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ɔkyekye me wora, kyɛbɔ ahyɛ wɔ somvoɛ bɔ ne ala.

english_verse: I love to obey your Law! Have mercy and let me live.
translation_verse: Ma w’anwumvoinnwunɛ ne odwu me so maa nya ngoa, ofikyɛ wɔ mmeraa yeɛ ɔte m’anigye ɔ.

english_verse: Put down those proud people who hurt me with their lies, because I have chosen to study your teachings.
translation_verse: Ma anwomasoɛfoɛ bɛ nyunu ogua ase, ofikyɛ bafa kanda nworɛ banwo me bo; nakoso me de, ngɔdwenedwene w’ahyɛdeɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: Let your worshipers come to me, so they will learn to obey your rules.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ ne, bɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛse wɔ noa dwirɛ ne, maa bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛɛbɔ me.

english_verse: Let me truly respect your laws, so I won't be ashamed.
translation_verse: Maa m’ahone nu ɔyɛ sannwuu wɔ w’ahyɛdeɛ so lilɛ nwo, amaa ɔnate so me nyunu wangua ase.

english_verse: I long for you to rescue me! Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Me kra wora dɔ wɔ ngoalelɛ ne paa; mefa me wora mewura wɔ dwirɛ ne anu.

english_verse: I am worn out from waiting for you to keep your word. When will you have mercy?
translation_verse: Manea wɔ bɔhyɛ ate alaa ama me nye ayɛ samoo, na mebisa kyɛ, “Kyinzu yeɛ ɛkɔkyekye me wora ɔ?”

english_verse: My life is wasting away like a dried-up wineskin, but I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mayɛ kyɛ kɔndoa bɔ osinze nwosina nu ɔ, nakoso me wora mvi w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: I am your servant! How long must I suffer? When will you punish those troublemakers?
translation_verse: Wɔ somvoɛ kɔnwondɛ maa okoodwu kyinzu? Bɛ bɔ bɛtane me nye ne, kyinzu yeɛ ekobua bɛ ndɛen ɔ?

english_verse: Those proud people reject your teachings, and they dig pits for me to fall in.
translation_verse: Anwomasoɛfoɛ batutu ngumaa kyɛ ndɔ nu; bɛte mmenia bɔ benni wɔ mmeraa so ɔ.

english_verse: Your laws can be trusted! Protect me from cruel liars.
translation_verse: Wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne amukoraa te turoloo. Bɛtane me nye mbaen, yiti boka me!

english_verse: They have almost killed me, but I have been faithful to your teachings.
translation_verse: Bayie me boso nua wɔ aseɛ ye aso, nakoso mmbole wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne.

english_verse: Show that you love me and let me live, so that I may obey your commands.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, maa nya me ti nnidi nu, amaa ɔnate so mali wɔ noa dwirɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Our Lord, you are eternal! Your word will last as long as the heavens.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ dwirɛ ne wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ, ye bo atimu wɔ nyameɛso.

english_verse: You remain faithful in every generation, and the earth you created will keep standing firm.
translation_verse: Wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne wɔ berɛ ma aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa; afa aseɛ atimu berɛ, na ogyi berɛ pindinn.

english_verse: All things are your servants, and the laws you made are still in effect today.
translation_verse: Ɔnate wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ti yeɛ bɛwɔ berɛ ɛnɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ nikyee biala te wɔ somvoɛ.

english_verse: If I had not found happiness in obeying your Law, I would have died in misery.
translation_verse: Sɛ nna wɔ mmeraa yeɛ me nye gye ye nwo a, ahaa mawu wɔ m’amaneɛnwunɛ nu.

english_verse: I won't ever forget your teachings, because you give me new life when I follow them.
translation_verse: Me wora ngofi wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ le, ofikyɛ ɔnate so yeɛ amaa manya ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: I belong to you, and I have respected your laws, so keep me safe.
translation_verse: Nde wɔ deɛ; pepɛ de me, ofikyɛ medi wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ so.

english_verse: Brutal enemies are waiting to ambush and destroy me, but I obey your rules.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ bɛtetɛ me bɛpena me beku me, nakoso me de, wɔ noa dwirɛ yeɛ medwenedwene ye nwo ɔ.

english_verse: I deeply love your Law! I think about it all day.
translation_verse: Ao, kyɛbɔ mesi mekuro wɔ mmeraa ne ɔ! Ye nwo yeɛ medwenedwene daa ɔ.

english_verse: Your laws never leave my mind, and they make me much wiser than my enemies.
translation_verse: Wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ maa menwu nworɛ metra me pɔfoɛ mɔ, ofikyɛ ɔte me nu daa.

english_verse: Thinking about your teachings gives me better understanding than my teachers,
translation_verse: Me nimdeɛ tra bɛ bɔ bekyire me nikyee amukoraa, ofikyɛ wɔ noa dwirɛ nwo yeɛ medwenedwene ɔ.

english_verse: and obeying your laws makes me wiser than those who have lived a long time.
translation_verse: Me nimdeɛ tra mbanyi mɔ, ofikyɛ medi wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ so.

english_verse: I obey your word instead of following a way that leads to trouble.
translation_verse: Metwe me nwo mefi bɔne atee biala so, amaa ɔnate so mali wɔ dwirɛ ne aso.

english_verse: You have been my teacher, and I won't reject your instructions.
translation_verse: Nnnili wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ nwo makyebu, ofikyɛ ahyirehyire me.

english_verse: They give me understanding and make me hate all lies.
translation_verse: Wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ nu yeɛ menya nimdeɛ ɔ; yiti mekyi ngondombo atee biala.

english_verse: Your word is a lamp that gives light wherever I walk.
translation_verse: Wɔ dwirɛ ne te me gya bo kanea, yeɛ ɔte hyireinn wɔ m’atee so.

english_verse: Your laws are fair, and I have given my word to respect them all.
translation_verse: Mata ndaen, na ngoli so, kyɛ ngoli wɔ tenenee nhyehyɛleɛ ne aso.

english_verse: I am in terrible pain! Save me, Lord, as you have promised.
translation_verse: Manwu amaneɛ paa; ao AWURADE, maa nya ngoa kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ ne te ɔ.

english_verse: Accept my offerings of praise and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, de m’ayɛyelɛ afɔleɛ ne to nu, ná kyirekyire me wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne.

english_verse: I never forget your teachings, although my life is always in danger.
translation_verse: Ahaa me kra kora yɔ bɔ okuro ɔ daa, nakoso memma me wora mvi wɔ mmeraa ne.

english_verse: Some merciless people are trying to trap me, but I never turn my back on your teachings.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ basua me ngaen, nakoso menni w’ahyɛdeɛ nwo makyebu.

english_verse: They will always be my most prized possession and my source of joy.
translation_verse: Wɔ noa dwirɛ ne te m’agyapadeɛ afebɔɔ; na ɔma me anigye wɔ m’ahone nu.

english_verse: I have made up my mind to obey your laws forever, no matter what.
translation_verse: Masiesie m’ahone kyɛ ngoli w’ahyɛdeɛ so daa ngoodwu ayieleɛ.

english_verse: I hate anyone whose loyalty is divided, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Mekyi mmenia bɔ b’adwene yɛ bɛ ndaa ndaa ɔ, nakoso wɔ mmeraa ne de, mekuro.

english_verse: You are my place of safety and my shield. Your word is my only hope.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’afealeɛ ne m’akokyɛm ɔ; mefa me wora mewura wɔ dwirɛ ne anu.

english_verse: All you worthless people, get away from me! I am determined to obey the commands of my God.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ, ɛ́mɔfi me so bɛhɔ maa nni me Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Be true to your word, Lord. Keep me alive and strong; don't let me be ashamed because of my hope.
translation_verse: Tira me nu kyɛbɔ wɔ bɔhyɛ te ɔ maa nya ngoa; na nnɛmaa me nyunu gua ase wɔ m’anyelasoɛ nu.

english_verse: Keep me safe and secure, so that I will always respect your laws.
translation_verse: Sɔ me nu ma nya me ti nnidi nu, na daa biala ngoli w’ahyɛdeɛ ne aso.

english_verse: You reject all deceitful liars because they refuse your teachings.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bedi w’ahyɛdeɛ nwo makyebu ne, ɛpo bɛ mukoraa, ofikyɛ bɛ nnakannaka ne ɔte mbaen.

english_verse: As far as you are concerned, evil people are garbage, and so I follow your rules.
translation_verse: Aseɛ ye aso bɔnefoɛ amukoraa, ebu bɛ kyɛ ewura, yiti me nye gye wɔ noa dwirɛ nwo.

english_verse: I tremble all over when I think of you and the way you judge.
translation_verse: Ɔnate wɔ nwo suronyi ti, me nwonaen wosowoso me, na mesuro wɔ ndɛenbualɛ ne.

english_verse: I did what was fair and right! Don't hand me over to those who want to mistreat me.
translation_verse: Mayɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ná ɔte nahorɛ ɔ; nnɛyakyi me wura bɛ bɔ bɛhyɛ me so ɔ nemɔ sa.

english_verse: Take good care of me, your servant, and don't let me be harmed by those conceited people.
translation_verse: Gyina wɔ somvoɛ si maa onya ngɔsoɛ; nnɛma ahandaenfoɛ besisi me.

english_verse: My eyes are weary from waiting to see you keep your promise to come and save me.
translation_verse: Wɔ ngoalelɛ ne wɔ tenenee bɔhyɛ ne, manea bɛ ate alaa ama me nye ayɛ samoo.

english_verse: Show your love for me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Gyina wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne aso boka wɔ somvoɛ, ná kyirekyire me w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: I serve you, so let me understand your teachings.
translation_verse: Wɔ somvoɛ ole me; ma me nimdeɛ, amaa ɔnate so manwu wɔ noa dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: Do something, Lord! They have broken your Law.
translation_verse: AWURADE, mmerɛ aso kyɛ ɛkɔkekã wɔ nwo ɔ, ofikyɛ babu wɔ mmeraa ne aso.

english_verse: Your laws mean more to me than the finest gold.
translation_verse: Amba, me nye gye wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne anwo tra esikaa kɔkorɛ, tra esikaa kɔkorɛ paa.

english_verse: I follow all your commands, but I hate anyone who leads me astray.
translation_verse: Yiti megyina wɔ dwirɛ so yeɛ mebɔ me bra ɔ; na mekyi ngondombo atee biala.

english_verse: Your teachings are wonderful, and I respect them all.
translation_verse: Wɔ noa dwirɛ ne yɛ nwanwa, yiti yeɛ me kra di so ɔ.

english_verse: Understanding your word brings light to the minds of ordinary people.
translation_verse: Wɔ dwirɛ nu ngyirekyiremuɛ ma kanea; ɔma sona bɔ ye adwene te kãa ɔ nya nimdeɛ.

english_verse: I honestly want to know everything you teach.
translation_verse: Mebukye me noa nu metee so, ofikyɛ me wora adɔ wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: Think about me and be kind, just as you are to everyone who loves your name.
translation_verse: Pɛne wɔ nye baanea me, ná do me, kyɛbɔ ɛyɔ ma bɛ bɔ bekuro wɔ dumaa dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: Keep your promise and don't let me stumble or let sin control my life.
translation_verse: Gyina wɔ dwirɛ so tutu me gya siesie yé, na nnɛma amumuyɛɛ biala di me so.

english_verse: Protect me from abuse, so I can obey your laws.
translation_verse: Pepɛ de me fi kuro sona nhyɛsoɛ nu, amaa ɔnate so mali wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ so.

english_verse: Smile on me, your servant, and teach me your laws.
translation_verse: Ye w’adom ne ali kyire wɔ somvoɛ, ná kyirekyire me w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: When anyone disobeys you, my eyes overflow with tears.
translation_verse: Mebɔ me nye a, ɛmoen ngome tatatata, ofikyɛ mmenia nni wɔ mmeraa ne aso.

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and your decisions are fair.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ɛtengyɛ, na wɔ ndɛenbualɛ te turoloo.

english_verse: All your teachings are true and trustworthy.
translation_verse: Tenenee nu ne nahorɛlilɛ amukoraa nu yeɛ ahyehyɛ wɔ noa dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: It upsets me greatly when my enemies neglect your teachings.
translation_verse: Me mmɔdenbɔlɛ ogye wɔ me nu kyɛ see, ofikyɛ me pɔfoɛ mɔ wora afi wɔ dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: Your word to me, your servant, is like pure gold; I treasure what you say.
translation_verse: Wɔ dwirɛ ne, efiɛ biala nne ye nwo, yiti wɔ somvoɛ nye gye ye nwo.

english_verse: Everyone calls me a nobody, but I remember your laws.
translation_verse: Nde kãa, yeɛ mmenia mmu me, nakoso memma me wora mvi wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne.

english_verse: You will always do right, and your teachings are true.
translation_verse: Wɔ tenenee ne, ɔte tenenee afebɔɔ, na wɔ mmeraa yeɛ ɔte nahorɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I am in deep distress, but I love your teachings.
translation_verse: Amaneɛ ne ahunundetelɛ atɔ me so, nakoso wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ yeɛ ɔma me anika ɔ.

english_verse: Your rules are always fair. Help me to understand them and live.
translation_verse: Wɔ noa dwirɛ te tenenee daa; ma me nimdeɛ, amaa ɔnate so manya ngoa.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please answer me. I promise to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Mefa m’ahone amukoraa mesu; ao AWURADE, bua me, ngoli w’ahyɛdeɛ so.

english_verse: I beg you to save me, so I can follow your rules.
translation_verse: Mesu mefrɛ wɔ; pepɛ de me, amaa ɔnate so mali w’ahyɛdeɛ so.

english_verse: Even before sunrise, I pray for your help, and I put my hope in what you have said.
translation_verse: Mepɛ aleɛ medwɔso mesu mepena mmokalɛ; mefa me wora mewura wɔ dwirɛ ne anu.

english_verse: I lie awake at night, thinking of your promises.
translation_verse: Me nye gua so kɔngɔen amukoraa, na ɔnate so medwenedwene wɔ dwirɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: Show that you love me, Lord, and answer my prayer. Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Gyina wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne aso tie me mbaeɛ; ao AWURADE, bɔ me ngoa nwo waen kyɛbɔ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ne te ɔ.

english_verse: People who disobey your Law have made evil plans and want to hurt me,
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bedi bɔne asi ne, bɛtwe bepingye; bɛ ne wɔ mmeraa afia atee wale.

english_verse: but you are with me, and all your commands can be trusted.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE, wɔ, epingye, na wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ amukoraa te nahorɛ.

english_verse: From studying your laws, I found out long ago you made them to last forever.
translation_verse: Nzua mvili wɔ noa dwirɛ ne anu dadadada, kyɛ afa ahyɛdeɛ ne atimu berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: I have not forgotten your Law! Look at the trouble I am in, and rescue me.
translation_verse: Nea m’amaneɛ bɔ menwu ye ɔ, ná pepɛ de me, ofikyɛ memma me wora mvi wɔ mmeraa ne.

english_verse: Be my defender and protector! Remember your promise and save my life.
translation_verse: Di me dwirɛ ma me, ná pepɛ de me; ma me ngoa kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ ne te ɔ.

english_verse: Evil people won't obey you, and so they have no hope of being saved.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ bɛ ne ngoalelɛ b’afia atee wale, ofikyɛ bɛmbena w’ahyɛdeɛ si atee.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! Please do the right thing and save my life.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, w’anwumvoinnwunɛ ne te piri; maa nya ngoa kyɛbɔ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ne te ɔ.

english_verse: I have a lot of brutal enemies, but still I never turn from your laws.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛtane me nye, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛpɔ me ne, bɛsone, nakoso menni wɔ noa dwirɛ nwo makyebu.

english_verse: Those unfaithful people who refuse to obey you are disgusting to me.
translation_verse: Menwu bɛ bɔ benni wɔ dwirɛ ne aso ne a, né bɛ nwo yɛ me ahi, ofikyɛ benni wɔ mmeraa so.

english_verse: Remember how I love your laws, and show your love for me by keeping me safe.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nea kyɛbɔ me nye si gye w’ahyɛdeɛ nwo ɔ! Bɔ me ngoa nwo waen kyɛbɔ wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne si te ɔ.

english_verse: All you say can be trusted; your teachings are true and will last forever.
translation_verse: Wɔ dwirɛ te nahorɛ fi tetetete, wɔ tenenee nhyehyɛleɛ ne anu biala wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Rulers are cruel to me for no reason. But with all my heart I respect your words,
translation_verse: Maen mbanyi bɛtane me nye mbaen, nakoso mesuro kyɛ mengotie wɔ dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: because they bring happiness like treasures taken in war.
translation_verse: Medi ahurusi wɔ wɔ dwirɛ ne anwo, kyɛ ebie bɔ wanya koɛ nu nzesadeɛ pee ɔ.

english_verse: I can't stand liars, but I love your Law.
translation_verse: Mekyi ngondombo, mepɔ ye, nakoso me nye gye wɔ mmeraa nwo.

english_verse: I praise you seven times a day because your laws are fair.
translation_verse: Ɛlɛho biala, meye w’ayɛ pɛen nzoo, ɔnate wɔ tenenee nhyehyɛleɛ ne ati.

english_verse: You give peace of mind to all who love your Law. Nothing can make them fall.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛ nye gye wɔ mmeraa nwo ne, benya asomdwee kandinga; hwee ngɔtoatoa bɛ gya nu.

english_verse: You are my only hope for being saved, Lord, and I do all you command.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, menea wɔ ngoalelɛ ate, na medi wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ so.

english_verse: I love and obey your laws with all my heart.
translation_verse: Me kra di wɔ noa dwirɛ so, me nye gye ye nwo paa.

english_verse: You know everything I do. You know I respect every law you have given.
translation_verse: Medi w’ahyɛdeɛ ne wɔ noa dwirɛ so, ofikyɛ m’atee amukoraa la wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: Please, Lord, hear my prayer and give me the understanding that comes from your word.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ma me sufrɛ odwu wɔ nyunu, ma me nimdeɛ kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ te ɔ.

english_verse: Listen to my concerns and keep me safe, just as you have promised.
translation_verse: Ma me mbaeɛ oodwu wɔ nyunu; pepɛ de me kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ te ɔ.

english_verse: If you will teach me your laws, I will praise you
translation_verse: Me noa kɔhã ayɛyelɛ dwirɛ, ofikyɛ ekyirekyire me w’ahyɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: and sing about your promise, because all your teachings are what they ought to be.
translation_verse: Me temverema kɔto wɔ dwirɛ nwo dwein, ofikyɛ wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ amukoraa tengyɛ.

english_verse: Be ready to protect me because I have chosen to obey your laws.
translation_verse: Ma wɔ tumi ne ɔɔboka me, ofikyɛ w’ahyɛdeɛ yeɛ maneanea nu mafa ɔ.

english_verse: I am waiting for you to save me, Lord. Your Law makes me happy.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, me wora adɔ wɔ ngoalelɛ ne, ofikyɛ wɔ mmeraa yeɛ ɔte m’anigye ɔ.

english_verse: Keep me alive, so I can praise you, and let me find help in your teachings.
translation_verse: Ma me kra ɔtena ngoa nu ná ɔye wɔ ayɛ, ná ma wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne ɔboka me.

english_verse: I am your servant, but I have wandered away like a lost sheep. Please come after me, because I have not forgotten your teachings.
translation_verse: Mali makyebu kyɛ boaen bɔ wamini ɔ; pena wɔ somvoɛ, ofikyɛ memma me wora mvi wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: When I am in trouble, I pray,
translation_verse: Mesu mefrɛ AWURADE wɔ m’amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu, na otie me.

english_verse: “Come and save me, Lord, from deceitful liars!”
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, pepɛ de me kra fi ngondombofoɛ bɛ sa nu ɔne nnakannakafoɛ bɛ sa nu.

english_verse: What punishment is fitting for you deceitful liars?
translation_verse: Wɔ, nnakannakaniɛ, nzikyɛ yeɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔma wɔ ɔ? Nzikyɛ yeɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔyɔ wɔ ɔ?

english_verse: Your reward should be sharp and flaming arrows!
translation_verse: Koɛhonɛniɛ agyaen anoa tworɔntworɔn kɔwɔ wɔ, ná esaa see gonn wayera wɔ!

english_verse: But I must live as a foreigner among the people of Meshech and in the tents of Kedar.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ ato me oo, kyɛ nde amanvraniɛ wɔ Meseke, kyɛ nde Kedare ɛtena sua nemɔ anu ɔ!

english_verse: I have spent too much time living among people who hate peace.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ bekyi asomdwee ne, me kra ne bɛ atena ahyɛ paa.

english_verse: I am in favor of peace, but when I speak of it, all they want is war.
translation_verse: Me de mekuro asomdwee, nakoso sɛ medwudwo a, né bɛbaafa ngondii bɛtoa me!

english_verse: I look to the hills! Where will I find help?
translation_verse: Mema me ti so mefa me nye mekyire mmokaa nemɔ. Nisua yeɛ me mmokalɛ fi ba ɔ?

english_verse: It will come from the Lord, who created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Me mmokalɛ fi AWURADE bɔ ɔbɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ne berɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, and he won't go to sleep or let you stumble.
translation_verse: Ɔngɔma wɔ gya ngosoti; ye bɔ ɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen ne, ɔngɔtɔ ngosie.

english_verse: The protector of Israel doesn't doze or ever get drowsy.
translation_verse: Tie, bɔ ɔnea Yisrael so ne, ɔngɔtɔ ngosie, yeɛ ɔngɔla.

english_verse: The Lord is your protector, there at your right side to shade you from the sun.
translation_verse: AWURADE yeɛ ɔte wɔ neafoɛ ɔ; AWURADE yeɛ ɔte wɔ fɔnwoo ɔ, wɔ wɔ sa famaa so.

english_verse: You won't be harmed by the sun during the day or by the moon at night.
translation_verse: Eyia ngɔyera wɔ eyia, yeɛ ɛsraen ngɔyɔ wɔ huu kɔngɔen.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you and keep you safe from all dangers.
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen kofi musue amukoraa nu; ɔkɔbɔ wɔ kra nwo waen.

english_verse: The Lord will protect you now and always wherever you go.
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔbɔ wɔ hɔlɛ ne wɔ walɛ nwo waen ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: It made me glad when they said, “Let's go to the house of the Lord!”
translation_verse: Besele me kyɛ, “Maa yɛhɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ” nen, me nye gyele.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we are standing inside your gates.
translation_verse: Ao Yerusalem, yɛ gya gyigyi wɔ pambim nemɔ anu.

english_verse: Jerusalem, what a strong and beautiful city you are!
translation_verse: Yerusalem, bakyekye ye kyɛ kuro bɔ bakyekye bama nu amia ɔ.

english_verse: Every tribe of the Lord obeys him and comes to you to praise his name.
translation_verse: Berɛ yeɛ mmusua kure nemɔ bɛkɔ ɔ, AWURADE mmusua kure nemɔ; kyɛ bɛkwaafa asennaa bɛma AWURADE dumaa, kyɛbɔ wahyehyɛ wama Yisrael ne.

english_verse: Jerusalem, we pray that you will have peace, and that all will go well for those who love you.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ kyɛ Yerusalem onya asomdwee: “Bɛ bɔ bekuro wɔ dwirɛ ne, mesrɛ kyɛ oyie bɛ yé.

english_verse: May there be peace inside your city walls and in your palaces.
translation_verse: Asomdwee ɔ́tena wɔ nu, ná ngɔsoɛ ɔtena w’ahemvie nemɔ anu.”

english_verse: Because of my friends and my relatives, I will pray for peace.
translation_verse: Nniɛma mɔ ne me mmango mɔ ati, ngɔhã kyɛ, “Asomdwee ɔ́tena wɔ nu.”

english_verse: And because of the house of the Lord our God, I will work for your good.
translation_verse: Ɔnate AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ye awuro ne ati, ngɔpena wɔ yeeyɛlɛ.

english_verse: Please have mercy, Lord! We have been insulted more than we can stand,
translation_verse: Nwu yɛ anwumvoin, ao AWURADE, nwu yɛ anwumvoin, ofikyɛ animguaseɛ ato yɛ maa wafono yɛ.

english_verse: The Lord was on our side! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: Sɛ nna AWURADE yeɛ ogyinane yɛ si a, afei, Yisrael kã e:

english_verse: “The Lord was on our side! Otherwise, the enemy attack
translation_verse: sɛ nna AWURADE yeɛ ogyinane yɛ si a, mmerɛ bɔ mmenia bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtetale yɛ ne,

english_verse: would have killed us all, because it was furious.
translation_verse: mmerɛ bɔ b’ahone huli yɛ so paa ne, ahaa bɛmemene yɛ anyekaenn so;

english_verse: We would have been swept away in a violent flood
translation_verse: ahaa asue ayi apia yɛ wahɔ, ahaa asorɔkye wabungam wafa yɛ kra so;

english_verse: of high and roaring waves.”
translation_verse: ahaa nzue bɔ ɔse wuruwuru ɔ, opiane yɛ hɔle.

english_verse: Let's praise the Lord! He protected us from enemies who were like wild animals,
translation_verse: Animnyam hã AWURADE, ye bɔ wamma bamva yɛ banyɛ naen bammɔ bɛ gye so ɔ!

english_verse: The Lord made heaven and earth, and he is the one who sends us help.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ ɔbɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ne, ye dumaa nu yeɛ yɛ mmokalɛ wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who trusts the Lord is like Mount Zion that cannot be shaken and will stand forever.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ wora bewura AWURADE nu ne, bɛte kyɛ Sion bokaa bɔ ɔnwoso, ná mmom otimu berɛ daa ne.

english_verse: Just as Jerusalem is protected by mountains on every side, the Lord protects his people by holding them in his arms now and forever.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ mmokaa apɛ Yerusalem nwo ayia ne, sɔ ala yeɛ AWURADE apɛ ye maen nwo wayia, ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: He won't let the wicked rule his people or lead them to do wrong.
translation_verse: Ahemvo bɔnefoɛ mɔ bɛ hɔtɔ ngɔhɔ so ngoli tumi wɔ aseɛ bɔ bafa bama teneneefoɛ ne aso, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ teneneefoɛ bɛngɔfa bɛ nwo bɛngɔfɔlefɔle amumuyɛɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Let's ask the Lord to be kind to everyone who is good and completely obeys him.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, yɛ mmeni paa ne bɛ bɔ b’ahone nu te ɔ paa.

english_verse: When the Lord punishes the wicked, he will punish everyone else who lives an evil life. Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Nakoso mmenia bɔ bedi makyebu bɛfa b’atee bɔ ɔndengyɛ so ne de, AWURADE kɔfa bɛ kɔfra amumuyɛɛfoɛ so kɔfoa bɛ kofi berɛ. Asomdwee ɔ́tena Yisrael!

english_verse: It seemed like a dream when the Lord brought us back to the city of Zion.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE fale Sion fili nnurehyelɛ nu sa wale ne, edwirɛ ne yɛle yɛ kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛkye laleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: We celebrated with laughter and joyful songs. In foreign nations it was said, “The Lord has worked miracles for his people.”
translation_verse: Ɛserelɛ yili yɛ noa nu to, na anigye dwein yili yɛ temverema so. Na bɛkekane ye wɔ maen maen mɔ nu kyɛ, AWURADE ayɔ nningyein mbiri mbiri wama bɛ.

english_verse: And so we celebrated because the Lord had indeed worked miracles for us.
translation_verse: AWURADE ayɔ nningyein mbiri mbiri wama yɛ, na yɛ nye agye.

english_verse: Our Lord, we ask you to bless our people again, and let us be like streams in the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, sa fa yɛ fi nnurehyelɛ nu bra, kyɛ ngwaen dɔ aseɛ asue.

english_verse: We cried as we went out to plant our seeds. Now let us celebrate as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bele ɛmoen bedua nningyein ne, bele anigye yeɛ bɛkɔte ɔ.

english_verse: We cried on the way to plant our seeds, but we will celebrate and shout as we bring in the crops.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ole esuɛ fite kɔ, bɔ otira mmakaammaa paa kyɛ ɔkwaalua ne, nahorɛ nu, ɔkɔfa ahurusi kosa kɔwa awuro, bɔ otiratira ye fieso aleɛ bɔ bakyekye ye tire tire ɔ.

english_verse: Without the help of the Lord it is useless to build a home or to guard a city.
translation_verse: Sɛ AWURADE anzi sua ne a, suasilɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛfɛ ye nwo mbaen. Sɛ AWURADE wanwɛne kuro ne a, wɛmvoɛ ne osiri ye nwo pɛ mbaen.

english_verse: It is useless to get up early and stay up late in order to earn a living. God takes care of his own, even while they sleep.
translation_verse: Ɔte mbaen kyɛ ɛmɔkɔpɛ aleɛ bekodwɔso, ná ɛmɔanna ndɛ, ná ɛmɔfɛ tetanwuu bɛpena ɛmɔ noa aleɛ ɔ; ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ okuro bɛ dwirɛ ne, sɛ bɛda po a, ɔma bɛ bɔ behia ɔ.

english_verse: Children are a blessing and a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Amba, mmaa te AWURADE sa nu agyapadeɛ, na aworɛ te ye sa nu saleɛ.

english_verse: Having a lot of children to take care of you in your old age is like a warrior with a lot of arrows.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ agyaen te wɔ koɛhonɛniɛ ye sa nu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ sona ye mmerandeɛ mmerɛ nu mmaa bɛte ɔ.

english_verse: The more you have, the better off you will be, because they will protect you when your enemies attack you in court.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ sɔ agyaen nemɔ ayi ye ndokue nu tɛkyɛ ne, onya saleɛ. Sɛ ɔne ye pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛkã edwirɛ wɔ kuro berɛ nekaa bɔ bedi dwirɛ a, ye nyunu ngua ase.

english_verse: The Lord will bless you if you respect him and obey his laws.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ osuro AWURADE, ná ɔnate ye atee so ne, onya saleɛ.

english_verse: Your fields will produce, and you will be happy— all will go well.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ekoli wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ sa noa adwuma nwo mvasoɛ; wɔ nye kɔgye, na okoyie wɔ yé.

english_verse: Your wife will be as fruitful as a grapevine, and just as an olive tree is rich with olives, your home will be rich with healthy children.
translation_verse: Ɛye kɔyɛ kyɛ bobe bɔ osu biribiraa ɔ wɔ w’awuro, na wɔ mma kɔyɛ kyɛ olive mmaen, bɔ wapɛ wɔ poen nwo wayia ɔ.

english_verse: This is how the Lord will bless everyone who respects him.
translation_verse: Amba, sona bɔ osuro AWURADE ne, sɔa yeɛ onya saleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion and let Jerusalem prosper as long as you live.
translation_verse: AWURADE kofi Sion koyira wɔ, na ekonwu Yerusalem ngɔsoɛ, mmerɛ bɔ ɛte ngoa nu amukoraa.

english_verse: May you live long enough to see your grandchildren. Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_verse: Amba, ekonwu wɔ nana nganzowa mɔ. Asomdwee ɔhã Yisrael!

english_verse: Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! Let everyone in Israel say:
translation_verse: “Ofi me ngwadaa nu, mmerɛ pee yeɛ bafa koɛ baateta me ɔ, afei, Yisrael kã e:

english_verse: “Since the time I was young, enemies have often attacked! But they have not defeated me,
translation_verse: Ofi me ngwadaa nu, mmerɛ pee yeɛ bafa koɛ baateta me ɔ, nakoso bangora banni me so ngonim.

english_verse: though my back is like a field that has just been plowed.”
translation_verse: Nhyɛsoɛfoɛ babo me bama me si apakyepakye; bamaa wabeabea berɛ ndendenn ndendenn.”

english_verse: I pray that all who hate the city of Zion will be made ashamed and forced to turn and run.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛpɔ Sion amukoraa, ma bɛ nyunu ogua ase, ná besa bɛ si.

english_verse: May they be like grass on the flat roof of a house, grass that dries up as soon as it sprouts.
translation_verse: Maa bɛyɛ kyɛ ndire bɔ wafifi sua so, bɔ ɔkese ná onnyi ɔ,

english_verse: And don't let anyone who passes by say to them, “The Lord bless you! I give you my blessing in the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛpɛ nu bɛkɔ ne, bɛnga kyɛ, “AWURADE óyira ɛmɔ oo! Yɛyira ɛmɔ wɔ AWURADE dumaa nu oo!”

english_verse: From a sea of troubles I cry out to you, Lord.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, mvi kumaa kuronguronn nu yeɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Won't you please listen as I beg for mercy?
translation_verse: AWURADE, tie me mbaeɛ! Yɛ asoɛ ná tie me, tie me sufrɛ.

english_verse: If you kept record of our sins, no one could last long.
translation_verse: AWURADE, sɛ ɛsesẽ amumuyɛɛ a, ao Yɛ Mene, ahaa nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina ɔ?

english_verse: But you forgive us, and so we will worship you.
translation_verse: Nakoso wɔ de bɔnefakyɛ wɔ wɔ nu, amaa ɔnate so yasuro wɔ.

english_verse: With all my heart, I am waiting, Lord, for you! I trust your promises.
translation_verse: Me nye la AWURADE so, me kra nye la ye so, na ye dwirɛ nu yeɛ me wora wura ɔ.

english_verse: I wait for you more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn. Yes, I wait more eagerly than a soldier on guard duty waits for the dawn.
translation_verse: Me kra nye la AWURADE so tra awɛmvoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛnea alehyeleɛ ate ɔ, yoo, ɔtra awɛmvoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛnea alehyeleɛ ate ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, trust the Lord! God is always merciful and has the power to save you.
translation_verse: Ao Yisrael, fa wɔ wora wura AWURADE nu! Ofikyɛ AWURADE yeɛ ole ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ɔ, na ye yeɛ ɔpepɛ de sona mmorosoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord will save you from all your sins.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔkɔpepɛ kole Yisrael kofi ye amumuyɛɛ amukoraa nu ɔ.

english_verse: I am not conceited, Lord, and I don't waste my time on impossible schemes.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, m’ahone nyɛ anwomasoɛ, me nye ndra me ndo nwiaa, yeɛ menha me nwo nningyein mbiri mbiri nwo, anaa anwanwadeɛ bɔ ɔbo me so ɔ nwo.

english_verse: But I have learned to feel safe and satisfied, like a young child in its mother's arms.
translation_verse: Amba, mama me kra anya asomdwee maa wayɛ konn, kyɛ baa bɔ bapɛ ye nyɔfone bɔ ɔte oni so ɔ: me kra ayɛ kyɛ baa bɔ bapɛ ye nyɔfone ɔ.

english_verse: People of Israel, you must trust the Lord now and forever.
translation_verse: Ao Yisrael, ma wɔ nye ɔla AWURADE so, ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, don't forget David and how he suffered.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, kaye Dawide ɔne ye amaneɛnwunɛ amukoraa,

english_verse: Mighty God of Jacob, remember how he promised:
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ ɔtale ndaen hyirele AWURADE, ná ɔhyɛle Yakob ye Tuminiɛ ne bɔ kyɛ,

english_verse: “I won't go home or crawl into bed
translation_verse: “Amba, mengowura m’awuro ɛtena sua ne anu, yeɛ mengɔla me bɛen so.

english_verse: or close my eyelids,
translation_verse: Mengɔla, yeɛ mengɔhã me nye mengogua so,

english_verse: until I find a home for you, the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
translation_verse: kɔpem kyɛ ngɔpena nekaa ngɔma AWURADE, Yakob ye Tuminiɛ ne, ye atenaleɛ koraka ɔ.”

english_verse: When we were in Ephrath, we heard that the sacred chest was somewhere near Jaar.
translation_verse: Amba, yɛtele ye wɔ Efrata; yɛnwuni ye wɔ ɛhɔayeɛ aseɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Then we said, “Let's go to the throne of the Lord and worship at his feet.”
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔma yɛhɔ ye atenaleɛ berɛ; ɛ́mɔma yɛsɔne wɔ ye gya bo ndiasoɛ ne anyunu.”

english_verse: Come to your new home, Lord, you and the sacred chest with all its power.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, dwɔso ná kɔ wɔ nekaa bɔ ede wɔ nwome ne, ɛne wɔ tumi alaka ne.

english_verse: Let victory be like robes for the priests; let your faithful people celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Ma w’asɔfo mɔ bɛfa tenenee bɛhera, ná ma w’anwoteefoɛ mɔ bɛfa ahurusi bɛbɔ ese.

english_verse: David is your chosen one, so don't reject him.
translation_verse: Ɔnate wɔ somvoɛ Dawide ti, nnɛye wɔ sa fi wɔ sona bɔ apopa ye ngoo ne abo.

english_verse: You made a solemn promise to David, when you said, “I, the Lord, promise that someone in your family will always be king.
translation_verse: AWURADE tale ndaen kitii hyirele Dawide, bɔ ongoli ye nwo ngasi ɔ, kyɛ, “Wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ kunu mmaa nemɔ anu ko yeɛ ngɔmaa okoli wɔ bia ɔ.

english_verse: If they keep our agreement and follow my teachings, then someone in your family will rule forever.”
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔ mma mɔ bedi m’apam ne me noa dwirɛ bɔ ngohyirehyire bɛ ne aso a, bɛ mma mɔ koso bekoli wɔ bia afebɔɔ.

english_verse: You have gladly chosen Zion as your home, our Lord.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE aneanea nu waye Sion; wahuro kyɛ ɔkɔfa berɛ kɔyɛ ye atenaleɛ:

english_verse: You said, “This is my home! I will live here forever.
translation_verse: “Ɛwa yeɛ ɔte me nekaa bɔ mede me nwomeɛ ɔ afebɔɔ; ɛwa yeɛ ngɔtena ɔ, ofikyɛ mekuro ɛwa.

english_verse: I will bless Zion with food, and even the poor will eat until they are full.
translation_verse: Ngoyira Sion ye nningyein so paa, na ngɔma ye ehiafoɛ mɔ aleɛ ma bɛ ko koyi.

english_verse: Victory will be like robes for the priests, and its faithful people will celebrate and shout.
translation_verse: Ye asɔfo mɔ, ngɔfa ngoalelɛ ngɔhera bɛ, na ye teneneefoɛ bɛkɔfa ahurusi bɛkɔbɔ ese.

english_verse: I will give mighty power to the kingdom of David. Each of my chosen kings will shine like a lamp
translation_verse: Berɛ yeɛ ngɔmaa mmɛen bie kofifi kɔma Dawide ɔ; masiesie kanea mama me sona bɔ mapopa ye ngoo ne.

english_verse: and wear a sparkling crown. But I will disgrace their enemies.”
translation_verse: Ngɔfa animguaseɛ ngɔhera ye pɔfoɛ mɔ, nakoso ye de, ye ahennie abotire bɔ ɔbɔ ye ne, ɔkɔta hyireinn.”

english_verse: It is truly wonderful when the people of God live together in peace.
translation_verse: Nea kyɛbɔ osi te paa ná ɔyɛ nyemene ɔ, kyɛ aliɛmaa mɔ bɛkɔtena bɛkɔyɛ ko ɔ!

english_verse: It is as beautiful as olive oil poured on Aaron's head and running down his beard and the collar of his robe.
translation_verse: Ɔte kyɛ ngoo nyɔboɛ serɛ bɔ ogua sona ti so, bɔ osongyi gua ye kanza nu, ɔte kyɛ bɔ osongyi gua Aarɔn kanza nu, bɔ ɔtengyɛ gua ye ataadeɛ kɔme anu ɔ.

english_verse: It is like the dew from Mount Hermon, falling on Zion's mountains, where the Lord has promised to bless his people with life forevermore.
translation_verse: Ɔte kyɛ Hɛmɔn bosue bɔ ɔtɔ gua Sion mmokaa so ɔ. Ofikyɛ berɛ yeɛ AWURADE ahyehyɛ saleɛ, bɔ ɔte ngoa afebɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who serves the Lord, come and offer praises. Everyone who has gathered in his temple tonight,
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, AWURADE somvoɛ amukoraa, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsɔne wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ kɔngɔen ɔ, ɛmɔbra bɛɛye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: lift your hands in prayer toward his holy place and praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ sa so behyire nekaa krongron berɛ, ná ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is the Creator of heaven and earth, and I pray that the Lord will bless you from Zion.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ ɔbɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ne, ófi Sion oyira wɔ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! You are his servants, so praise his name.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ! Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE dumaa ne ayɛ! O AWURADE somvoɛ mɔ, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ,

english_verse: All who serve in the temple of the Lord our God,
translation_verse: ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsɔne wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ, wɔ yɛ Nyameɛ awuro n’aluo berɛ ɔ!

english_verse: come and shout praises. Praise the name of the Lord! He is kind and good.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ, ofikyɛ AWURADE te paa; ɛ́mɔto ye dumaa nwo dwein, ofikyɛ ɔyɛ fɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is much greater than any other god.
translation_verse: Na me de, mese kyɛ AWURADE te piri; yɛ Mene ne tra nyameɛ mɔ amukoraa.

english_verse: He does as he chooses in heaven and on earth and deep in the sea.
translation_verse: Bɔ AWURADE kuro biala yeɛ ɔyɔ ɔ, wɔ nyameɛso ne aseɛ so, wɔ ɛpo nu ne buma mɔ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: The Lord makes the clouds rise from far across the earth, and he makes lightning to go with the rain. Then from his secret place he sends out the wind.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔma munungum fi aseɛ noa dɔ kɔ anwuro ɔ; esue tɔ a, ɔma agralaa tete, na ɔma mvrama tu fi nekaa bɔ osie ye nningyein ne.

english_verse: God used miracles and wonders to fight the king of Egypt and all of his officials.
translation_verse: Ao Misraim, ɔsomane nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ maa ɔwale wɔ nu, ɔfa tiale Faro ne ye somvoɛ mɔ amukoraa.

english_verse: He destroyed many nations and killed powerful kings,
translation_verse: Ɔsɛkyele maen maen mɔ pee, na ohuhuni ahemvo tumifoɛ mɔ:

english_verse: including King Sihon of the Amorites and King Og of Bashan. He conquered every kingdom in the land of Canaan
translation_verse: Amorifoɛ hene Sihon, ne Basan hene Ogo, ne Kanaan ahennie amukoraa,

english_verse: and gave their property to his people Israel.
translation_verse: na ɔfale b’aseɛ ne kakyili agyapadeɛ, ɔfa kakyili agyapadeɛ mane ye maen Yisrael.

english_verse: The name of the Lord will be remembered forever, and he will be famous for all time to come.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ dumaa timu berɛ daa, Ao AWURADE, wɔ nwo ngayeɛ wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: The Lord will bring justice and show mercy to all who serve him.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE kobua ye maen be, na okonwu ye somvoɛ mɔ anwumvoin. (Edwein

english_verse: Idols of silver and gold are made and worshiped in other nations.
translation_verse: Amaen maen mɔ bɛ mmosoen nemɔ, bɛte ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ, bɛte mmenia sa noa adwuma.

english_verse: They have a mouth and eyes, but they can't speak or see.
translation_verse: Bele noa, nakoso bendwudwo, bele anyeɛ, nakoso bennwu nikye,

english_verse: They are completely deaf, and they can't breathe.
translation_verse: bele asoɛ, nakoso bɛnde dwirɛ, na nwomeɛ biala nne bɛ nu.

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who trust them will end up as helpless as their idols.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ mmosoen nemɔ ne, bɛte kyɛ mmosoen nemɔ ala; na ebiala bɔ ɔfa ye wora wura mmosoen nemɔ anu ne, ɔte kyɛ mmosoen nemɔ ala.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel, come praise the Lord! All the family of Aaron
translation_verse: Ao Yisrael awuro ama, ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ! Ao Aarɔn awuro ama, ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: and all the tribe of Levi, come praise the Lord! All of his worshipers, come praise the Lord.
translation_verse: Ao Lewi awuro ama, ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ! Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsuro AWURADE ne, ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: Praise the Lord from Zion! He lives here in Jerusalem. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ ɔte Yerusalem ne, animnyam hã ye wɔ Sion, Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: Praise the Lord! He is good. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ao, ɛmɔla AWURADE ase, ofikyɛ ɔte paa, na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Praise the God of all gods. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ao, ɛmɔla nyameɛ mɔ nu Nyameɛ ne ase, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Praise the Lord of lords. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ao, ɛmɔla meneɛ mɔ nu Meneɛ ne ase, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: With wisdom he made the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ye bɔ yeɛ ole nimdeɛ ɔbɔle anwuro ɔ, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;

english_verse: The Lord stretched the earth over the ocean. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ye bɔ ɔtrɛtrɛle aseɛ nu tole nzue so ɔ, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;

english_verse: He made the bright lights in the sky. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ye bɔ ɔbɔle kanea mbiri mbiri nemɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: He lets the sun rule each day. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ɔbɔle eyia kyɛ oli tumi wɔ alehyeleɛ nu, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;

english_verse: He lets the moon and the stars rule each night. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ɔbɔle ɛsraen ne nzramaa kyɛ beli tumi wɔ alesaleɛ nu, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: God struck down the first-born in every Egyptian family. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ye bɔ ohuhuni Misraimfoɛ bɛ bamuɛbaa mɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;

english_verse: He rescued Israel from Egypt. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ye bɔ ɔyele Yisrael fili bɛ nu ɔ, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;

english_verse: God used his great strength and his powerful arm. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ye bɔ ole tumi piri ne tumi asaa yeɛ ɔyele bɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;

english_verse: He split the Red Sea apart. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ye bɔ ɔpakyele Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ nu nyɔ ne, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;

english_verse: The Lord brought Israel safely through the sea. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: na ɔfale Yisrael pɛle nu hɔle, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;
