english_verse: He destroyed the Egyptian king and his army there. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: nakoso Faro ne ye lɔen de, ɔhane bɛ guale Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ ne anu, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;

english_verse: The Lord led his people through the desert. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ye bɔ olili ye maen nyunu fale ɛserɛ ne aso ɔ, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;

english_verse: Our God defeated mighty kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ye bɔ ohuhuni ahemvo titire mɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;

english_verse: And he killed famous kings. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: na ohuhuni ahemvo mɔ bɔ bale dumaa ɔ, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;

english_verse: One of them was Sihon, king of the Amorites. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Amorifoɛ hene Sihon, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;

english_verse: Another was King Og of Bashan. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: yeɛ Basan hene Ogo, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;

english_verse: God took away their land. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: na ɔfale b’aseɛ ne kakyili agyapadeɛ, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;

english_verse: He gave their land to Israel, the people who serve him. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ɔfa kakyili agyapadeɛ mane ye somvoɛ Yisrael, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: God saw the trouble we were in. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔkayele yɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né yɛyɛ anwumvo ne ɔ, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;

english_verse: He rescued us from our enemies. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: na ɔpepɛ lele yɛ fili yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ;

english_verse: He gives food to all who live. God's love never fails.
translation_verse: ye bɔ ɔma abɔdeɛ biala aleɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Beside the rivers of Babylon we thought about Jerusalem, and we sat down and cried.
translation_verse: Babilɔn asue mɔ noa, berɛ yeɛ yɛtenane ase yɛsuni ɔ, mmerɛ bɔ yɛkayele Sion ɔ.

english_verse: We hung our small harps on the willow trees.
translation_verse: Asue noa mmakaa nemɔ aso yeɛ yɛfale yɛ sangoo mɔ yɛsinzele ɔ.

english_verse: Our enemies had brought us here as their prisoners; now they wanted us to sing and entertain them. They insulted us and shouted, “Sing about Zion!”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛhyele yɛ nnure ne, berɛ yeɛ besele yɛ kyɛ yɛto dwein ɔ, na bɛ bɔ bɛteetee yɛ ne, besele yɛ kyɛ yɛgyegye bɛ nye. Bɛnwa: “Sion dwein ne, ɛ́mɔto ko behyire yɛ!”

english_verse: Here in a foreign land, how can we sing about the Lord?
translation_verse: Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né yato AWURADE nwo dwein, wɔ maen foforɛ bie aso?

english_verse: Jerusalem, if I forget you, let my right hand go limp.
translation_verse: Ao Yerusalem, sɛ mema me wora fi wɔ a, ma me sa famaa ɔnwenwe!

english_verse: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth, if I don't think about you above all else.
translation_verse: Sɛ mangaye wɔ a, ma me temverema ɔmata me nnaalɔ, sɛ manguro Yerusalem dwirɛ mandra nikyee biala bɔ ɔma me anigye paa hɔ a!

english_verse: Our Lord, punish the Edomites! On the day Jerusalem fell, they shouted, “Completely destroy the city! Tear down every building!”
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, kaye bɔ Edomfoɛ bɛyɔle ye kyẽa bɔ Yerusalem bɔle ne, na tua bɛ so kerɛ; kyɛbɔ bɛhane kyɛ, Ɛ́mɔbubu ye bégua ase! ɛ́mɔbubu ye bégua ase! Ɛ́mɔbubu ye bégua ase maa ɔɔhã ye fapem!” ne.

english_verse: Babylon, you are doomed! I pray the Lord's blessings on anyone who punishes you for what you did to us.
translation_verse: Ao Babilɔn awa brasua bɔ bɛbaasɛkye wɔ pasapasa ɔ, bɔ okotua wɔ so kerɛ wɔ bɔ afa ayɛ yɛ ne anwo ne, okonya saleɛ!

english_verse: May the Lord bless everyone who beats your children against the rocks!
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔkɔhye wɔ mma mmaa mmaa kɔte bɛ ti kɔbɔ nyɔbotaen so ne, okonya saleɛ!

english_verse: With all my heart I praise you, Lord. In the presence of angels I sing your praises.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ngɔfa m’ahone amukoraa ngɔla wɔ ase; nyameɛ mɔ anyunu yeɛ meto wɔ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein ɔ.

english_verse: I worship at your holy temple and praise you for your love and your faithfulness. You were true to your word and made yourself more famous than ever before.
translation_verse: Mebɔ me nu ase mefa me nye mekyire w’asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron ne, na mefa asennaa mema wɔ dumaa, ɔnate wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne ati; ofikyɛ apagya wɔ dumaa ne wɔ dwirɛ maa batra nikyee biala.

english_verse: When I asked for your help, you answered my prayer and gave me courage.
translation_verse: Kyẽa bɔ nzu mvrɛle wɔ ne, etiele me sufrɛ, na ɛmane me kra hɔle so nyane anwoserɛ.

english_verse: All kings on this earth have heard your promises, Lord, and they will praise you.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, aseɛ ye aso ahemvo amukoraa kɔye wɔ ayɛ, ofikyɛ bate wɔ noa nu dwirɛ.

english_verse: You are so famous that they will sing about the things you have done.
translation_verse: Amba, bɛkɔto AWURADE atee mɔ nwo dwein, ofikyɛ AWURADE animnyam te piri.

english_verse: Though you are above us all, you care for humble people, and you keep a close watch on everyone who is proud.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔwɔ nu kyɛ AWURADE wɔ anwuro anwuro de, nakoso ɔdo anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ; na anwomasoɛfoɛ de, ɔbrɛ bɛ ase fi dedeede.

english_verse: I am surrounded by trouble, but you protect me against my angry enemies. With your own powerful arm you keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ mefa amaneɛ nu de, nakoso ɛbɔ me ngoa nwo waen. Ɛtengyɛ wɔ sa fa tia me pɔfoɛ mɔ b’ɛyaafɛlɛ, na wɔ sa famaa ne yeɛ ɔpepɛ de me ɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord, will always treat me with kindness. Your love never fails. You have made us what we are. Don't give up on us now!
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔma bɔ wahyehyɛ wafa me nwo ne kɔwa nu; ao AWURADE, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ: nnɛpo wɔ sa noa nnwumaa.

english_verse: You have looked deep into my heart, Lord, and you know all about me.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, aneanea me nu, na anwu me.

english_verse: You know when I am resting or when I am working, and from heaven you discover my thoughts.
translation_verse: Ɛse m’asetenalɛ ne me dwɔsolɛ mmerɛ; na enwu me ti anu adwene fi dedeede.

english_verse: You notice everything I do and everywhere I go.
translation_verse: Ɛneanea m’atee bɔ nnate so ɔ, ɔne me nnaa nu, na wɔ nye tua bɔ meyɔ amukoraa.

english_verse: Before I even speak a word, you know what I will say,
translation_verse: Anzana mebaabukye me noa medwudwo ne po, ao AWURADE, né ɛse bɔ mebaahã amukoraa.

english_verse: and with your powerful arm you protect me from every side.
translation_verse: Abɔ me nyunu ne me si nwo waen, na afa wɔ sa ato me so.

english_verse: I can't understand all of this! Such wonderful knowledge is far above me.
translation_verse: Sɔ nimdeɛ ne, ɔyɛ me nwanwa soma; ɔwɔ anwuro soma, bɔ me sa ngora ndwu so ɔ.

english_verse: Where could I go to escape from your Spirit or from your sight?
translation_verse: Nisua yeɛ ngɔhora ngofi wɔ Sunzum nyunu ngɔhɔ ɔ? Anaakyɛ nisua yeɛ ngɔnwati ngofi wɔ nyunu ngɔhɔ ɔ?

english_verse: If I were to climb up to the highest heavens, you would be there. If I were to dig down to the world of the dead you would also be there.
translation_verse: Sɛ mefo mekɔ nyameɛso a, ɛwɔ dɔ; sɛ mesɛ me bɛen wɔ ɛborɔ a, yieee, ɛwɔ dɔ.

english_verse: Suppose I had wings like the dawning day and flew across the ocean.
translation_verse: Sɛ mefa ngyerɛmɔ ye ndaa metu, na mekɔtena ɛpo ye noa nziɛ nziɛ dɔ a,

english_verse: Even then your powerful arm would guide and protect me.
translation_verse: dɔ po, wɔ sa koli me nyunu, na wɔ sa famaa kotira me nu.

english_verse: Or suppose I said, “I'll hide in the dark until night comes to cover me over.”
translation_verse: Sɛ mekã kyɛ, “Amba, awosii ɔbra ɔɔkata me so, ná kanea bɔ wapɛ me nwo wayia ne, ɔkakyi kɔngɔen” a,

english_verse: But you see in the dark because daylight and dark are all the same to you.
translation_verse: amba, awosii po ɔnyɛ alesaleɛ mma wɔ; kɔngɔen ta hyireinn kyɛ eyia, ofikyɛ awosii te kyɛ kanea ma wɔ.

english_verse: You are the one who put me together inside my mother's body,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛbɔle me kunu nningyein ɔ; wɔ yeɛ ɛfale m’akwaa mɔ toatoale so wɔ me ni akunu ɔ.

english_verse: and I praise you because of the wonderful way you created me. Everything you do is marvelous! Of this I have no doubt.
translation_verse: Meye wɔ ayɛ, ofikyɛ kyɛbɔ asi abɔ me ne, ɔyɛ suro yɛ nwanwa. Wɔ sa noa nnwumaa yɛ nwanwa, na me kra se ye sɔ paa.

english_verse: Nothing about me is hidden from you! I was secretly woven together out of human sight,
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ ɛbɔle me wɔ mvealeɛ nu ne, bɔ ɛtole wɔ bo ase ɛhyehyɛle me wɔ aseɛ bo dɔ ne, me mmowue mɔ bamvea wɔ.

english_verse: but with your own eyes you saw my body being formed. Even before I was born, you had written in your book everything about me.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né nde mogya kokrobetoa ne, wɔ nye nwuni me. Me ngyẽa bɔ ahyehyɛ ato berɛ ama me ne, bɛhyerɛle ye mukoraa wɔ wɔ nwomaa ne anu, koraka yeɛ nu ko po ɔhyɛ ye bo ɔ.

english_verse: Your thoughts are far beyond my understanding, much more than I could ever imagine.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, w’adwene ne, kyɛbɔ osi bo me ndeaseɛ so ɔ! Ɛkã bɔ nu a, kyɛbɔ osi te totohyia ɔ!

english_verse: I try to count your thoughts, but they outnumber the grains of sand on the beach. And when I awake, I will find you nearby.
translation_verse: Sɛ meka a, ye somaa tra anweaa; sɛ meda medwɔso a, né ndɛwɔ wɔ nwo berɛ.

english_verse: How I wish that you would kill all cruel and heartless people and protect me from them!
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, sɛ ahaa ekohũhũ bɔnefoɛ, ná kodiawufoɛ bahwe bɛ nwo bafi me nwo a,

english_verse: They are always rebelling and speaking evil of you.
translation_verse: bɛ bɔ bɛkekã musue dwirɛ betia wɔ, ɔne wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛbɔ wɔ dumaa mbaen mbaen ɔ!

english_verse: You know I hate anyone who hates you, Lord, and refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, bɛ bɔ bɛpɔ wɔ ne, aso membɔ bɛ? Na bɛ bɔ bedwɔso betia wɔ ne, aso bɛ nwo nyɛ me ahi?

english_verse: They are my enemies too, and I truly hate them.
translation_verse: Mekyi bɛ kɔkɔkɔkɔ; mebu bɛ me pɔfoɛ mɔ.

english_verse: Look deep into my heart, God, and find out everything I am thinking.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, neanea me nu, ná nwu m’ahone nu dwirɛ; so me nea, ná nwu me ti anu adwene.

english_verse: Don't let me follow evil ways, but lead me in the way that time has proven true.
translation_verse: Nea sɛ bra tɛɛ bie wɔ me nu a, na di me nyunu fa me fa atee bɔ ɔla berɛ afebɔɔ ne aso.

english_verse: Rescue me from cruel and violent enemies, Lord!
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, pepɛ de me fi bɔnefoɛ sa nu, bɔ me nwo waen fi patapaafoɛ nwo,

english_verse: They think up evil plans and always cause trouble.
translation_verse: bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ porɛ tɛɛ wɔ bɛ ti anu, ná bɛtwetwe koɛ bɛba daa ɔ.

english_verse: Their words bite deep like the poisonous fangs of a snake.
translation_verse: Basi bɛ gye nnaennaen kyɛ ewoo deɛ, na ɛbɔnaa borɔ yeɛ ɔwɔ bɛ noa nu ɔ. Sela

english_verse: Protect me, Lord, from cruel and brutal enemies, who want to destroy me.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nea me so ye me fi bɔnefoɛ sa nu; patapaafoɛ bɔ bɛpena m’asefinɛ ne, bɔ me nwo waen fi bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Those proud people have hidden traps and nets to catch me as I walk.
translation_verse: Anwomasoɛfoɛ basua me ngaen bafea, na bafa nyamaa bayɛ ɛtɛen, basunzua me kafoli wɔ atee noa. Sela

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! Please listen to my prayer.
translation_verse: Nzele AWURADE kyɛ, “Wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Nyameɛ ɔ; ao AWURADE, yɛ asoɛ tie me sufrɛ.”

english_verse: You have the power to save me, and you keep me safe in every battle.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, me Mene, me Defoɛ anwoserɛniɛ, ɛfa akokyɛm wura me ti wɔ koɛ kyẽa.

english_verse: Don't let the wicked succeed in doing what they want, or else they might never stop planning evil.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, nnɛyɔ bɔnefoɛ b’apɛdeɛ ma bɛ; nnɛmaa bɛ porɛ tɛɛ ne ɔba nu ná banhoahoa bɛ nwo. Sela

english_verse: They have me surrounded, but make them the victims of their own vicious lies.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bapɛ me nwo bayia ne, bamoma bɛ nwo so; ma bɛ noa nu musue dwirɛ ne ɔbɔ bɛ ti so!

english_verse: Dump flaming coals on them and throw them into pits where they can't climb out.
translation_verse: Ma see gonn ogua bɛ so! Maa befindi bɛ begua see nu, kumaa kuronn nu bɔ bengodwɔso ko ɔ!

english_verse: Our Lord, I know that you defend the homeless and see that the poor are given justice.
translation_verse: Mese kyɛ AWURADE di bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ bɛ dwirɛ ma bɛ, na obua ndɛen turoloo ma ehiafoɛ.

english_verse: Your people will praise you and will live with you because they do right.
translation_verse: Amba, teneneefoɛ kɔla wɔ dumaa ase, na bɛ bɔ bɛ bra te sannwuu ne, bɛkɔtena wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! Please listen when I pray and hurry to help me.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, mesu mefrɛ wɔ; yɛ ye ndɛ baaboka me; sɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ a, tie me sufrɛ.

english_verse: Think of my prayer as sweet-smelling incense, and think of my lifted hands as an evening sacrifice.
translation_verse: Ma me mbaeɛ ɔyɛ kyɛ ɛyɛɛ wɔ wɔ nyunu, ná me sa bɔ mema so ne, ɔ́yɛ kyɛ nɔsoa afɔleɛ.

english_verse: Help me to guard my words whenever I say something.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, kyire me bɔ nga ɔ, ná maa nwu bɔ odi kyɛ mefa me noa mekã ɔ.

english_verse: Don't let me want to do evil or waste my time doing wrong with wicked people. Don't let me even taste the good things they offer.
translation_verse: Nnɛmaa mekakyi m’adwene mekɔ bɔne nwo, nnɛmaa mefa me nwo mebɔ amumuyɛɛfoɛ, nnɛfa mefa bɔne meyɛ me nwo buru ne nnu, nnɛmaa medi b’akɔnnɔdeɛ ne bie.

english_verse: Let your faithful people correct and punish me. My prayers condemn the deeds of those who do wrong, so don't let me be friends with any of them.
translation_verse: Ma teneneeniɛ ɔbo me, ná ohwi me nyunu wɔ ɔdɔ nu. Nnɛmaa bɔnefoɛ bɛfa bɛ ngoo bɛpopa me ti so, ofikyɛ mebɔ mbaeɛ daa metia b’amumuyɛɛ ne.

english_verse: Everyone will admit that I was right when their rulers are thrown down a rocky cliff,
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛ mbanyi mɔ bɛfa bɛ bewura bɛ bɔ bekobua bɛ foɛ mɔ sa a, ye de bekonwu kyɛ me dwirɛ yɛ fɛ paa.

english_verse: and their bones lie scattered like crushed rocks on top of a grave.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ bebubu nyɔbotaen nu bɛto bɛpete aseɛnwo ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bapete yɛ mmowue bagua ɛborɔ kumaa noa ɔ.

english_verse: You are my Lord and God, and I look to you for safety. Don't let me be harmed.
translation_verse: Nakoso, ao AWURADE Nyameɛ, wɔ yeɛ me nye la wɔ so ɔ, wɔ nu yeɛ menwati mebafea ɔ; nnɛyakyi me nwo waenbɔlɛ.

english_verse: Protect me from the traps of those violent people,
translation_verse: Bɔ me nwo waen fi ngaen bɔ basunzua me ne anu, ɔne bɔnefoɛ kafoli nemɔ anwo.

english_verse: and make them fall into their own traps while you help me escape.
translation_verse: Ma bɔnefoɛ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ngaen ɔhye bɛ, na me de, maa nya atee nwati.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord. I beg for mercy.
translation_verse: Metea nu mesu mefrɛ AWURADE; metea nu mefa m’abisadeɛ meto AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: I tell you all my worries and my troubles,
translation_verse: Meprapra me dwirɛ yealɛ megua ye nyunu; mefa m’amaneɛ meto ye nyunu.

english_verse: and whenever I feel low, you are there to guide me. A trap has been hidden along my pathway.
translation_verse: Sɛ me kra boto a, wɔ yeɛ ɛse m’atee ɔ. Atee bɔ mefa so ne, basua me ngaen bafea wɔ so.

english_verse: Even if you look, you won't see anyone who cares enough to walk beside me. There is no place to hide, and no one who really cares.
translation_verse: Sɛ menea me sa famaa so a, menwu ye kyɛ me nwo nhia ebiala; mennya afealeɛ biala, sona biala ndwene me ngoa nwo.

english_verse: I pray to you, Lord! You are my place of safety, and you are my choice in the land of the living. Please answer my prayer. I am completely helpless.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, mesu mefrɛ wɔ. Menwa, “Wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’afealeɛ ɔ, ɛte me bue deɛ wɔ ateasefoɛ aseɛ so.”

english_verse: Rescue me from this prison, so I can praise your name. And when your people notice your wonderful kindness to me, they will rush to my side.
translation_verse: Ye me kra fi kuku nu, amaa ɔnate so maye wɔ dumaa ayɛ. Teneneefoɛ bɛkɔpɛ me nwo bekoyia, ofikyɛ alo me paa.

english_verse: Listen, Lord, as I pray! You are faithful and honest and will answer my prayer.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, tie me mbaeɛ; yɛ asoɛ tie me sufrɛ; wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ɔne wɔ tenenee ti, tie m’abisadeɛ.

english_verse: I am your servant. Don't try me in your court, because no one is innocent by your standards.
translation_verse: W’akoaa, nnɛfa me wura ndɛenbualɛ nu, ofikyɛ teasefoɛ biala nni be wɔ wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: My enemies are chasing me, crushing me in the ground. I am in total darkness, like someone long dead.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ pɔfoɛ ne atu ye nye wasie me kra so, wabɔ me ngoa wato ase, na wamaa matena awosii nu kyɛ bɛ bɔ bawuwu dada ɔ.

english_verse: I have given up hope, and I feel numb all over.
translation_verse: Yiti me sunzum aboto wɔ me nu; m’ahone bɔ ɔla me kunu ɔ, ye wora abɔ.

english_verse: I remember to think about the many things you did in years gone by.
translation_verse: Mekaye daa tete ne, medwenedwene wɔ nnwumaa amukoraa nwo. Mekayekaye wɔ sa noa nnwumaa.

english_verse: Then I lift my hands in prayer, because my soul is a desert, thirsty for water from you.
translation_verse: Metrɛ me sa nu mekyire wɔ; wɔ nwo nzuhɔen ku me kra kyɛ aseɛ bɔ wayɛ wosee ɔ. Sela

english_verse: Please hurry, Lord, and answer my prayer. I feel hopeless. Don't turn away and leave me here to die.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, yɛ ndɛ bua me; me sunzum wora abɔ. Nnɛye wɔ nye fea me; ɔba ye sɔ a, ngɔyɛ kyɛ bɛ bɔ bawu bahɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu ne.

english_verse: Each morning let me learn more about your love because I trust you. I come to you in prayer, asking for your guidance.
translation_verse: Maa nde wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne nga ngyerɛmɔ, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ mefa me wora mewura wɔ nu ɔ. Maa nwu atee bɔ mva so ɔ; ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ mepagya me kra mekyire wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Please rescue me from my enemies, Lord! I come to you for safety.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, pepɛ de me fi me pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu; wɔ berɛ yeɛ menwati mebabɔ me nwo adwaa ɔ.

english_verse: You are my God. Show me what you want me to do, and let your gentle Spirit lead me in the right path.
translation_verse: Kyirekyire me maa nyɔ w’apɛdeɛ, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Nyameɛ ɔ. Ma wɔ Sunzum paa ne oli me nyunu, maa ɔfa me fa atimbire frɛtɛɛ so.

english_verse: Be true to your name, Lord, and keep my life safe. Use your saving power to protect me from trouble.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ dumaa ti, bɔ me ngoa nwo waen, wɔ tenenee ti, ye me kra fi amaneɛ nu.

english_verse: I am your servant. Show how much you love me by destroying my enemies.
translation_verse: Wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ati, nua me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ boso, ná kũkũ bɛ bɔ bekyi me ɔ amukoraa, ofikyɛ nde wɔ somvoɛ.

english_verse: I praise you, Lord! You are my mighty rock, and you teach me how to fight my battles.
translation_verse: Animnyam hã AWURADE me Nyɔbotaen ne bɔ okyire me koɛhonɛ, ɔne me sa mmaa kyɛbɔ besi bɛko ɔ.

english_verse: You are my friend, my fortress, where I am safe. You are my shield, and you made me the ruler of our people.
translation_verse: Me nyɔbotaen ne m’afealeɛ, m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne me defoɛ, m’akokyɛm bɔ mebɔ me nwo adwaa wɔ nu ɔ, bɔ ɔfa maen maen mɔ wura me bo ɔ.

english_verse: Why do we humans mean anything to you, our Lord? Why do you care about us?
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, dasaniɛ te nzu koraa bɔ wɔ nye ku ye nwo ye, yeɛ kuro sona te nzu bɔ ɛdwene ye nwo ye?

english_verse: We disappear like a breath; we last no longer than a faint shadow.
translation_verse: Sona te kyɛ nwomeɛ; ye ngyẽa te kyɛ wawoɛ bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Open the heavens like a curtain and come down, Lord. Touch the mountains and make them send up smoke.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ ewienu ne, bobɔ ná dwu bra ase; fa wɔ sa kã mmokaa maa betu nwosina.

english_verse: Use your lightning as arrows to scatter my enemies and make them run away.
translation_verse: Tete agralaa yerɛmyerɛm, ná bɔ bɛ pete; soma w’agyaen nemɔ maa behũhũ bɛ pasaa.

english_verse: Reach down from heaven and set me free. Save me from the mighty flood
translation_verse: Tengyɛ wɔ sa fi anwuro dɔ; maa nya me ti nnidi nu, ná pepɛ de me fi asue mbiri nu, fi amanvrafoɛ bɛ sa nu.

english_verse: of those lying foreigners who never tell the truth.
translation_verse: Bɛfa bɛ noa bɛkekã edwirɛ mbaen mbaen, na bɛ sa famaa ne te ngondombo asaa.

english_verse: In praise of you, our God, I will sing a new song, while playing my harp.
translation_verse: Ao Nyameɛ, ngɔto edwein foforɛ ngɔye wɔ ayɛ; sangoo bɔ ye nyamaa buru yeɛ ngɔbɔ ngɔye wɔ ayɛ ɔ.

english_verse: By your power, kings win wars, and your servant David is saved from deadly swords.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ ɛma ahemvo bedi ngonim ɔ; wɔ yeɛ ɛpepɛ de wɔ somvoɛ Dawide fi ngrandɛ bɔ odi awue noa ɔ.

english_verse: Won't you keep me safe from those lying foreigners who never tell the truth?
translation_verse: Pepɛ de me, ná de me fi ɛwɔfoɛ mma mɔ sa nu, bɛ yeɛ bɛ noa kekã edwirɛ mbaen mbaen, ná bɛ sa famaa te ngondombo asaa ɔ.

english_verse: Let's pray that our young sons will grow like strong plants and that our daughters will be as lovely as columns in the corner of a palace.
translation_verse: Ahaa né yɛ mma mmienzua mɔ bɛ mmerandeɛ nu wayɛ kyɛ mmakaa bɔ bahye ɔ, ná yɛ mma mmrasua mɔ koso bayɛ kyɛ ndweasoɛ bonima, bɔ bapakye ye kyɛ bɛfa besi ahemvie ɔ.

english_verse: May our barns be filled with all kinds of crops. May our fields be covered with sheep by the thousands,
translation_verse: Ahaa né yɛ pata mɔ so ayi to bɔ aleɛ ahoroɔ gua so ɔ; ahaa né yɛ mmoaen bawo apee apee, apee buru apee buru wɔ yɛ aseɛ mɔ aso.

english_verse: and every cow have calves. Don't let our city be captured or any of us be taken away, and don't let cries of sorrow be heard in our streets.
translation_verse: Ahaa né yɛ nandwie mɔ banwonzɛnwonzɛ bɔ bɛngɔpɔ baa anaa bengoli abawuo ɔ. Nnɛmaa yɛte aworabɔlɛ esuɛ wɔ yɛ dwaa mɔ so.

english_verse: Our Lord and our God, you give these blessings to all who worship you.
translation_verse: Maen bɔ sɔ nningyein nemɔ wɔ so ne, benya saleɛ, maen bɔ AWURADE te bɛ Nyameɛ ne, benya saleɛ!

english_verse: I will praise you, my God and King, and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Me Nyameɛ ne me Hene, ngɔkamvo wɔ, na ngɔhyɛ wɔ dumaa animnyam afebɔɔ.

english_verse: I will praise you each day and always honor your name.
translation_verse: Daa biala ngɔhyɛ wɔ animnyam, na ngɔye wɔ dumaa ayɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: You are wonderful, Lord, and you deserve all praise, because you are much greater than anyone can understand.
translation_verse: AWURADE te piri, na ɔfata ayɛyelɛ piri paa; ye piri ne bo sona ndeaseɛ so.

english_verse: Each generation will announce to the next your wonderful and powerful deeds.
translation_verse: Aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ko kɔkamvo wɔ nnwumaa kohyire aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ foforɛ, ná wabɔ wɔ nnwumaa mbiri mbiri ne anwo dawure.

english_verse: I will keep thinking about your marvelous glory and your mighty miracles.
translation_verse: W’ahennie animnyam bɔ ɔta hyireinn ne w’anwanwadeɛ nemɔ, bɛ yeɛ medwenedwene bɛ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone will talk about your fearsome deeds, and I will tell all nations how great you are.
translation_verse: Wɔ nnwumaa suronyisuronyi ne, wɔ tumi ne, mmenia kɔbɔ ye nwo dawure, na ngɔfa kyɛbɔ esi te piri ɔ ngɔto dwaa.

english_verse: They will celebrate and sing about your matchless mercy and your power to save.
translation_verse: Wɔ paayɛlɛ piri nwo ngayeɛ ne, bɛkɔbɔ ye nwo dawure, na bɛkɔto wɔ tenenee nwo dwein.

english_verse: You are merciful, Lord! You are kind and patient and always loving.
translation_verse: AWURADE do mmenia, na ɔse anwumvoin; ye ahone nhu ndɛ, na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔsone.

english_verse: You are good to everyone, and you take care of all your creation.
translation_verse: AWURADE te paa ma sona biala, na ye anwumvoinnwunɛ ne, ɔkata ye nnwumaa mukoraa so.

english_verse: All creation will thank you, and your loyal people will praise you.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ sa noa nnwumaa amukoraa bɛda wɔ ase, yeɛ w’anwoteefoɛ amukoraa bɛye wɔ ayɛ.

english_verse: They will tell about your marvelous kingdom and your power.
translation_verse: Bɛka w’ahennie nwo animnyam nwo dwirɛ, na bɛkã wɔ tumi ne anwo dwirɛ,

english_verse: Then everyone will know about the mighty things you do and your glorious kingdom.
translation_verse: kyɛ bɛkɔma adasa mmaa bekonwu wɔ nnwumaa mbiri mbiri nemɔ, ɔne w’ahennie animnyam hyireinn ne.

english_verse: Your kingdom will never end, and you will rule forever. Our Lord, you keep your word and do everything you say.
translation_verse: W’ahennie ne te daa ahennie, na wɔ tumi ne wɔ berɛ wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu. [AWURADE di nahorɛ wɔ ye dwirɛ amukoraa nu, na onwu anwumvoin wɔ nikyee biala bɔ ɔyɔ ɔ nu].

english_verse: When someone stumbles or falls, you give a helping hand.
translation_verse: AWURADE sɔ bɛ bɔ bɛtete begua ɔ amukoraa nu, na ɔma bɛ bɔ baboto ɔ so.

english_verse: Everyone depends on you, and when the time is right, you provide them with food.
translation_verse: Mmenia amukoraa bɛ nye la wɔ so, na ɛma bɛ bɛ noa aleɛ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu.

english_verse: By your own hand you satisfy the desires of all who live.
translation_verse: Ebukye wɔ sa nu, na ɛma teasefoɛ amukoraa benya bɔ bɛpena ɔ.

english_verse: Our Lord, everything you do is kind and thoughtful,
translation_verse: AWURADE tengyɛ wɔ bɔ ɔyɔ ɔ amukoraa nu, na ɔte krongron wɔ ye nnwumaa amukoraa nu.

english_verse: and you are near to everyone whose prayers are sincere.
translation_verse: AWURADE pingye bɛ bɔ besu bɛfrɛ ye ɔ amukoraa, amba, bɛ bɔ besu bɛfrɛ ye nahorɛ nu amukoraa.

english_verse: You satisfy the desires of all your worshipers, and you come to save them when they ask for help.
translation_verse: Ɔyɔ bɛ bɔ besuro ye ɔ b’apɛdeɛ ma bɛ; afei koso otie bɛ sufrɛ, na ɔpepɛ de bɛ.

english_verse: You take care of everyone who loves you, but you destroy the wicked.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ bɛ bɔ bekuro ye dwirɛ ɔ amukoraa nwo waen, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, okohũhũ bɛ.

english_verse: I will praise you, Lord, and everyone will respect your holy name forever.
translation_verse: Me noa kɔhã AWURADE nwo ayɛyelɛ dwirɛ, odi kyɛ abɔdeɛ amukoraa bɛye ye dumaa krongron ne ayɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! With all that I am, I will shout his praises.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ! Ao me kra, ye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: I will sing and praise the Lord God as long as I live.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ nde ngoa nu amukoraa, ngɔye AWURADE ayɛ; ngɔto Nyameɛ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein mmerɛ bɔ nwomeɛ wɔ me nu ye.

english_verse: Once they die and are buried, that will be the end of all their plans.
translation_verse: Sɛ sona nwomeɛ fi ye nu a, sona sa kɔ ye nnɛterɛ nu; sɔ kyẽa ne ala, ye nhyehyɛleɛ ye bo pɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God of Jacob blesses everyone who trusts him and depends on him.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye bokafoɛ ole Yakob Nyameɛ, bɔ ye wora wura AWURADE ye Nyameɛ nu ne, onya saleɛ.

english_verse: God made heaven and earth; he created the sea and everything else. God always keeps his word.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bɔ odi ye dwirɛ so afebɔɔ ne, ye yeɛ ɔbɔle anwuro ne aseɛ, ɛpo ne nu nningyein amukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: He gives justice to the poor and food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free
translation_verse: Sona bɔ besisi ye ne, ye yeɛ odi ye dwirɛ ma ye ɔ, na ye yeɛ ɔma bɔ ɛhɔen ku ye ɔ aleɛ ɔ. AWURADE ma kukunufoɛ benya fawɔnwodi.

english_verse: and heals blind eyes. He gives a helping hand to everyone who falls. The Lord loves good people
translation_verse: AWURADE te anyesiniwaafoɛ bɛ nye, AWURADE ma bɛ bɔ baboto ɔ so, AWURADE kuro teneneefoɛ bɛ dwirɛ.

english_verse: and looks after strangers. He defends the rights of orphans and widows, but destroys the wicked.
translation_verse: AWURADE yeɛ ɔbɔ ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ nwo waen ɔ; ɔnea nyisiaafoɛ ne akunafoɛ, nakoso bɔnefoɛ atee de, ɔmaa ɔyɛ basaa.

english_verse: The Lord God of Zion will rule forever! Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: AWURADE koli hene afebɔɔ, ao Sion, wɔ Nyameɛ di hene aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu. Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Our God is kind, and it is right and good to sing praises to him.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ! Ofikyɛ ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔto yɛ Nyameɛ nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein ɔ; ɔse anwumvoin, na ayɛyelɛ dwein fata ye.

english_verse: The Lord rebuilds Jerusalem and brings the people of Israel back home again.
translation_verse: AWURADE yeɛ ɔkyekye Yerusalem ɔ, na Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bahye bɛ nnure bahɔ ne, ɔboaboa bɛ noa.

english_verse: He renews our hopes and heals our bodies.
translation_verse: Ɔkyekye bɛ bɔ bɛ wora abɔ ɔ wora, na ɔteta bɛ ngena nu.

english_verse: He decided how many stars there would be in the sky and gave each one a name.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔse nzramaa mɔ bɛ somaa ɔ, na ɔtoto bɛ mukoraa bɛ dumaa.

english_verse: Our Lord is great and powerful! He understands everything.
translation_verse: Y’AWURADE te piri, na ye tumi te piri, ye nimdeɛ ne, sona nze ye ti ne ye bo.

english_verse: The Lord helps the oppressed, but he smears the wicked in the dirt.
translation_verse: AWURADE ma anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ so, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ofindi ye to ase.

english_verse: Celebrate and sing! Play your harps for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔto AWURADE nwo asennaa dwein; ɛ́mɔbɔ sangoo beli yɛ Nyameɛ nwo ahurusi!

english_verse: He fills the sky with clouds and sends rain to the earth, so that the hills will be green with grass.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔfa munungum kata ewienu ɔ, ɔboaboa esue noa maa ɔtɔ gua aseɛ so, na ɔma ndire fifi mmokaa so.

english_verse: He provides food for cattle and for the young ravens, when they cry out.
translation_verse: Ɔma eburo ngaka aleɛ, bɛ ne adene mma bɔ besu nemɔ.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't care about the strength of horses or powerful armies.
translation_verse: Nna pɔngɔ anwoserɛ yeɛ ye nye gye ye nwo ɔ, yeɛ nna sona amirika yeɛ ɔsɔ ye nye ɔ;

english_verse: The Lord is pleased only with those who worship him and trust his love.
translation_verse: na mmom AWURADE nye gye bɛ bɔ besuro ye ɔ nwo, bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne aso ne.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, come and praise the Lord your God!
translation_verse: Ao Yerusalem, ye AWURADE ayɛ; Ao Sion, ye wɔ Nyameɛ ayɛ!

english_verse: He makes your city gates strong and blesses your people.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wamiamia wɔ pambim si mmuralɛ nemɔ anu, wayira wɔ mma bɔ bɛwɔ wɔ nu ne.

english_verse: God lets you live in peace, and he gives you the very best wheat.
translation_verse: Ɔma asomdwee ba w’aseɛ so, na ɔma wɔ atokoɔ paa ma wɔ ko yi.

english_verse: As soon as God speaks, the earth obeys.
translation_verse: Ɔsoma ye mmeraa dwirɛ maa ɔba aseɛ so, na ye dwirɛ ne tu amirika ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: God sends down hailstones like chips of rocks. Who can stand the cold?
translation_verse: Ɔto ye asukɔtwea gua kyɛ nyɔboseka. Ye ɛyerɛ ne, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora ye noa gyina ɔ?

english_verse: At his command the ice melts, the wind blows, and streams begin to flow.
translation_verse: Ɔsomane ye noa dwirɛ, na ɔmaa behurole, ɔma ye mvrama bɔ, na nzue tengyɛ.

english_verse: God gave his laws and teachings to the descendants of Jacob, the nation of Israel.
translation_verse: Ɔlale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Yakob, ɔfale ye ahyɛdeɛ ne ye nhyehyɛleɛ mane Yisrael.

english_verse: But he has not given his laws to any other nation. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Wanyɔ sɔ wamma maen foforɛ, bɛnze ye nhyehyɛleɛ. Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Shout the Lord's praises in the highest heavens.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ! Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ béfi anwuro dɔ. Ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ wɔ anwuro dɔ!

english_verse: All of you angels, and all who serve him above, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Ye abɔfo mɔ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ; ye koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ!

english_verse: Sun and moon, and all of you bright stars, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Eyia ne ɛsraen, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ; nzramaa mɔ bɔ bɛta amukoraa, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ!

english_verse: Highest heavens, and the water above the highest heavens, come and offer praise.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, nyameɛso anwuro anwuro, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ, yeɛ ɛmɔ, nzue nzue bɔ ɛmɔwɔ ewienu anwuro ɔ, ɛmɔ koso sɔ ala.

english_verse: Let all things praise the name of the Lord, because they were created at his command.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛye AWURADE dumaa ayɛ, ofikyɛ ye ahyɛdeɛ ne yeɛ ɔfa bɔle bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: He made them to last forever, and nothing can change what he has done.
translation_verse: Ɔfale bɛ tindimuni berɛ afebɔɔ; na ɔmane bɛ ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔngɔpɛ nu le ɔ.

english_verse: All creatures on earth, you obey his commands, so come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ béfi aseɛ ye aso: ɛmɔ, ɛpo nu ngaka mbiri ne buma amukoraa,

english_verse: Sea monsters and the deep sea, fire and hail, snow and frost, and every stormy wind, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: see ne asukɔtwea nyɔboɛ, asukɔtwea ne ɛborɔ, mvrama bɔ otu serɛserɛ di Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ so ɔ,

english_verse: All mountains and hills, fruit trees and cedars,
translation_verse: mmokaa ne pambaa amukoraa, mmakaa bɔ besu ne sida amukoraa,

english_verse: every wild and tame animal, all reptiles and birds, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: eburo ngaka ne nyɛmmoa amukoraa, ngaka bɔ bɛkongo ne nnomaa bɔ betu ɔ,

english_verse: Every king and every ruler, all nations on earth,
translation_verse: aseɛ ye aso ahemvo ne maen maen amukoraa, atitire ne aseɛ ye aso maenbulɛfoɛ amukoraa,

english_verse: every man and every woman, young people and old, come praise the Lord!
translation_verse: mmerandeɛ ne ndaluwa mɔ, mbanyi ne ngwadaa!

english_verse: All creation, come praise the name of the Lord. Praise his name alone. The glory of God is greater than heaven and earth.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛye AWURADE dumaa ne ayɛ, ofikyɛ ye ngome yeɛ ye dumaa te piri ɔ; ye animnyam trɛ ɔbo aseɛ ne nyameɛso so.

english_verse: Like a bull with mighty horns, the Lord protects his faithful nation Israel, because they belong to him. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Wama ye maen anya anwoserɛ, amaa ɔnate so ye anwoteefoɛ amukoraa baye ye ayɛ, Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte mmenia bɔ bepingye ye ne. Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Sing him a new song of praise when his loyal people meet.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ! Ɛ́mɔto dwein foforɛ bɛ́ye AWURADE ayɛ, ye nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein wɔ anwoteefoɛ badwa nu.

english_verse: People of Israel, rejoice because of your Creator. People of Zion, celebrate because of your King.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ Yisrael nye gye, ɔnate bɔ yeɛ ɔbɔle ye ne ati, odi kyɛ Sion mma bɛ nye gye, ɔnate bɛ Hene ne ati.

english_verse: Praise his name by dancing and playing music on harps and tambourines.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛfa abilie bɛye ye dumaa ayɛ, odi kyɛ bɛfa akasaa ne adengum bɛto ye nwo dwein.

english_verse: The Lord is pleased with his people, and he gives victory to those who are humble.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE nye gye ye maen nwo, na ɔfa ngoalelɛ ɔbɔ anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ abotire.

english_verse: All of you faithful people, praise our glorious Lord! Celebrate and worship.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ anwoteefoɛ bedi ahurusi wɔ animnyam nu; odi kyɛ bɛfa anigye bɛto dwein wɔ bɛ bɛen so.

english_verse: Praise God with songs on your lips and a sword in your hand.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛ noa bɛbɔ Nyameɛ nzabranoa, ná bétira sɛpɔ wɔ bɛ sa nu,

english_verse: Put chains of iron on their kings and rulers.
translation_verse: ná bafa buralɛ bakyekye b’ahemvo mɔ, ná bafa ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ bagua b’atitire mɔ,

english_verse: Punish them as they deserve; this is the privilege of God's faithful people. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: ná bafa ndɛenbualɛ bɔ bahyerɛ bato berɛ ne babua bɛ ndɛen. Ɛhe te animnyam ma AWURADE anwoteefoɛ amukoraa. Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: Shout praises to the Lord! Praise God in his temple. Praise him in heaven, his mighty fortress.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ! Ɛ́mɔye Nyameɛ ayɛ wɔ ye nekaa krongron ne anu. Ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ wɔ ye tumi ewienu ne anu.

english_verse: Praise our God! His deeds are wonderful, too marvelous to describe.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ wɔ ye nnwumaa mbiri mbiri nemɔ anwo; ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ, kyɛbɔ osi te totohyia ɔ!

english_verse: Praise God with trumpets and all kinds of harps.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa totorobɛndo dwein bɛ́ye ye ayɛ; ɛ́mɔfa adengum ne sangoo bɛ́ye ye ayɛ!

english_verse: Praise him with tambourines and dancing, with stringed instruments and woodwinds.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa akasaa ne abilie bɛ́ye ye ayɛ; ɛ́mɔfa sangoo ne awɛen bɛ́ye ye ayɛ!

english_verse: Let every living creature praise the Lord. Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_verse: Nikyee biala bɔ ode nwomeɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔye AWURADE ayɛ! Ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ!

english_verse: These are the proverbs of King Solomon of Israel, the son of David.
translation_verse: Yisrael hene Solomon, Dawide awa ne, ye anyandera mɔ bɔ obuli ne ɛhe. Anyandera nemɔ botaeɛ

english_verse: Proverbs will teach you wisdom and self-control and how to understand sayings with deep meanings.
translation_verse: Anyandera nemɔ botaeɛ ole kyɛ: sona kɔfa so konwu nworɛ, ná okonya ngyerɛkyerɛ, ná ɔkɔte edwirɛ bɔ nu pi ɔ bo;

english_verse: You will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: kyɛ ɔkɔfa konya nworɛ dwirɛ nu ngyerɛkyerɛ, yeɛ tenenee, ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ.

english_verse: From these, an ordinary person can learn to be smart, and young people can gain knowledge and good sense.
translation_verse: Ɔma sona bɔ ye adwene te kãa ɔ onwu nworɛ, na ɔma mmerandeɛ nimdeɛ ne adwene nu bukyelɛ.

english_verse: If you are already wise, you will become even wiser. And if you are smart, you will learn to understand
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ nworɛfoɛ betie benya nimdeɛ pee, ná nimdeɛfoɛ koso fa so bɛma b’adwene nu pi,

english_verse: proverbs and sayings, as well as words of wisdom, and all kinds of riddles.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so bate anyandera ne nworɛ dwirɛ bo, nworɛfoɛ dwirɛ ne b’anyandera bo.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of knowledge. Only a fool rejects wisdom and good advice. Warnings against Bad Friends
translation_verse: AWURADE surolɛ yeɛ ɔte nimdeɛnyanɛ ye bohyɛlɛ ɔ, na ngwaseafoɛ de, bɛmva nworɛ ne ngyerɛkyerɛ bɛnyɛ huu. Kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: My child, obey the teachings of your parents,
translation_verse: Mma, tie wɔ baba dwirɛ, yeɛ nnɛpo wɔ maame foɛtulɛ,

english_verse: and wear their teachings as you would a pretty hat or a lovely necklace.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ bɛte animnyam abotire bɔ ɔbɔ wɔ ti ɔ, ɔne akomuade bɔ ɔya wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't be tempted by sinners or listen
translation_verse: Mma, sɛ bɔnefoɛ mɔ diedie wɔ kɔ bɔne nu a, nnɛpene so.

english_verse: when they say, “Come on! Let's gang up and kill somebody, just for the fun of it!
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛkã kyɛ, “Bra maa yɛɛtetɛ yɛli awue, bɛ bɔ bedi be ne, maa yɛɛtɛ atunu yɛhu bɛ mbaen;

english_verse: They're well and healthy now, but we'll finish them off once and for all.
translation_verse: maa yɛhu bɛ anyekaenn so kyɛbɔ asieleɛ ɔme sona ɔ, maa yɛsie bɛ mumua ne kyɛbɔ mmenia kɔda ɛborɔ kumaa nu ɔ;

english_verse: We'll take their valuables and fill our homes with stolen goods.
translation_verse: yɛkonya nningyein bɔ bɛ nyɔboɛ yɛ se ɔ, na yɛkɔfa sɔ nzesadeɛ nemɔ yɛkogua yɛ awuro maa berɛ koyi tɛkyɛ;

english_verse: If you join our gang, you'll get your share.”
translation_verse: yiti fa wɔ nwo bɔ yɛ, na yɛ mukoraa yɛkɔhyɛ nningyein bɔ yɛkonya ye ne” a,

english_verse: Don't follow anyone like that or do what they do.
translation_verse: mma, nnɛne bɛ bɔ afɛ. Nekaa bɔ bekotia ne, nnɛtia berɛ bie;

english_verse: They are in a big hurry to commit some crime, perhaps even murder.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ amirika yeɛ betu bekodi bɔne ɔ, na bɛma bɛ nwo yɛ nyera bedi awue.

english_verse: They are like a bird that sees the bait, but ignores the trap.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, sɛ anomaa biala nye tua kyɛ asua ye ngaen a, asua ngaen ne mbaen.

english_verse: They gang up to murder someone, but they are the victims.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɔ mmenia nemɔ bɛtetɛ bedi bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nwo awue, na bɛtetɛ bekuku bɛ nwo.

english_verse: The wealth you get from crime robs you of your life. Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: Sɔ yeɛ oyie mmenia mukoraa bɔ bɛpena anwonya wɔ atee tɛɛ so ɔ, na anwonya tɛɛ ne ɔpɛ ye nwo okũkũ bɛ. Tie foɛtulɛ

english_verse: Wisdom shouts in the streets wherever crowds gather.
translation_verse: Nworɛ tea nu serɛserɛ wɔ mmorɔnoɛ mɔ so, wama ye komvi so wɔ dwaa nemɔ aso.

english_verse: She shouts in the marketplaces and near the city gates as she says to the people,
translation_verse: Ɔtea nu wɔ nekaa bɔ mmenia ayɛ birikabirika, ɔtea nu wɔ kuro berɛ pambim ne anu kyɛ,

english_verse: “How much longer will you enjoy being stupid fools? Won't you ever stop sneering and laughing at knowledge?
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔ adwene te nganga ɔ, ɛmɔpena kyɛ ɛmɔ adwene yɛ nganga kodwu kyinzu? Ngorohoɛfoɛ nye kɔgye bɛ ngorohoɛ nwo koodwu kyinzu? Yeɛ ngwaseafoɛ kohyi nimdeɛ koodwu kyinzu?

english_verse: Listen as I correct you and tell you what I think.
translation_verse: Metwi ɛmɔ nyunu a, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔtie, ngɔhã m’ahone nu dwirɛ ngohyire ɛmɔ, na ngɔmaa ɛmɔkonwu me ti anu dwirɛ.

english_verse: you rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: bɔ me foɛtulɛ amukoraa gua ɛmɔ so asi, ná ɛmɔmva ɛmɔ nyunu bɔ metwi ne bɛnyɛ huu ne ati,

english_verse: “So when you are struck by some terrible disaster,
translation_verse: me koso ngɔsere ɛmɔ wɔ ɛmɔ amaneɛnwunɛ nu; ahunundetelɛ tɔ ɛmɔ so a, ngɔgoro ɛmɔ nwo;

english_verse: or when trouble and distress surround you like a whirlwind, I will laugh and make fun.
translation_verse: mmerɛ bɔ ahunundetelɛ kɔyɛ kyɛ mvrama piri kɔto ɛmɔ ne, mmerɛ bɔ amaneɛ kɔyɛ kyɛ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo kɔto ɛmɔ ne, mmerɛ bɔ aworabɔlɛ ne yealɛ kɔto ɛmɔ ne.

english_verse: You will ask for my help, but I won't listen; you will search, but you won't find me.
translation_verse: Afei bekosu bɛkɔfrɛ me, nakoso mengɔtɛ bɛ so, bɛkɔpena me paa, nakoso bengonwu me.

english_verse: No, you would not learn, and you refused to respect the Lord.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ behyili nimdeɛ, banguro kyɛ bekosuro AWURADE,

english_verse: You rejected my advice and paid no attention when I warned you.
translation_verse: bandie me foɛtulɛ ne anu biala, na bɛpole bɛ nyunu hwilɛ bɔ ndwili ne amukoraa.

english_verse: “Now you will eat the fruit of what you have done, until you are stuffed full with your own schemes.
translation_verse: Yiti, bɛ yɔleɛ nwo akatuaa yeɛ bɛ sa kɔhã ye ɔ, na bɛ porɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ne, ɔkɔbɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti so.

english_verse: But if you listen to me, you will be safe and secure without fear of disaster.”
translation_verse: Nakoso ebiala bɔ otie me dwirɛ de, ɔkɔtena asomdwee nu, okonya anwotɔ, na ye kunu ngɔtete ye kyɛ musue kɔto ye ɔ.”

english_verse: My child, you must follow and treasure my teachings and my instructions.
translation_verse: Mma, sɛ etie me dwirɛ, ná ɛma me mmeraa dwirɛ nemɔ ka wɔ ti anu,

english_verse: Keep in tune with wisdom and think what it means to have common sense.
translation_verse: sɛ ɛyɛ asoɛ tie nworɛ dwirɛ, ná ɛma w’adwene nya ndeaseɛ,

english_verse: Beg as loud as you can for good common sense.
translation_verse: amba, sɛ ɛtea nu frɛ kyɛ ɛpena adwene bɔ nu pi, ná ɛma wɔ komvi so kyɛ ɛpena ndeaseɛ,

english_verse: Search for wisdom as you would search for silver or hidden treasure.
translation_verse: sɛ ɛpena ye si atee kyɛbɔ ɛpena ɛdwetɛ, ná ɛpena ye kyɛ agyapadeɛ bɔ bafa bafea ɔ hɔ a,

english_verse: Then you will understand what it means to respect and to know the Lord God.
translation_verse: ye de ɛkɔte kyɛbɔ AWURADE surolɛ osi te ɔ bo, na ekonya Nyameɛ nwo nimdeɛ.

english_verse: All wisdom comes from the Lord, and so do common sense and understanding.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE yeɛ ɔma nworɛ ɔ, na ye noa nu yeɛ nimdeɛ ne ndeaseɛ fi ba ɔ.

english_verse: God gives helpful advice to everyone who obeys him and protects those who live as they should.
translation_verse: Ɔfa nworɛ bɔ nu pi ɔ osie ma teneneefoɛ, ɔte akokyɛm ma bɛ bɔ bɛ bra te sannwuu ɔ;

english_verse: God sees that justice is done, and he watches over everyone who is faithful to him.
translation_verse: ɔbɔ ndɛenbualɛ turoloo nwo waen, na ɔnea ye anwoteefoɛ b’atee bɔ bɛnate so ɔ so.

english_verse: With wisdom you will learn what is right and honest and fair.
translation_verse: Na afei ɛkɔte tenenee, nahorɛlilɛ, pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ne atee bɔ ɔte paa biala bo.

english_verse: Wisdom will control your mind, and you will be pleased with knowledge.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ekonwu nworɛ, nimdeɛ kɔma wɔ kra nye kɔgye,

english_verse: Sound judgment and good sense will watch over you.
translation_verse: adwene nu bukyelɛ kɔnea wɔ so, na ndeaseɛ kɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen;

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from evil schemes and from those liars
translation_verse: ɔkɔpepɛ kole wɔ kofi bɔne atee so, kofi mmenia bɔ bɛ noa dwirɛ te kanda ɔ bɛ sa nu,

english_verse: who turned from doing good to live in the darkness.
translation_verse: kofi bɛ bɔ bali nahorɛ atee nwo makyebu baafa awosii atee so ɔ bɛ sa nu.

english_verse: They are dishonest themselves, and so are all their deeds. Wisdom and Sexual Purity
translation_verse: B’atee te kanda atee, na bɛ suban te nnakannaka.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you from the smooth talk of a sinful woman,
translation_verse: Nworɛ kole wɔ kofi brasua sanzaniɛ sa nu, kofi gyanderaniɛ bɔ ye noa dwirɛ te menemene ɔ sa nu.

english_verse: who breaks her wedding vows and leaves the man she married when she was young.
translation_verse: Ye bɔ wapo ye ndaluwa nu biaa, ná wama ye wora afi ye Nyameɛ apam ne ɔ.

english_verse: The road to her house leads down to the dark world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ye awuro diedie sona kɔ ewue nu, na ye atee fa sona kɔ ɛborɔ.

english_verse: Visit her, and you will never find the road to life again.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔ sɔ braa ne nekaa ne, onza mma ko, yeɛ ɔmbe ngoa atee so ko.

english_verse: Follow the example of good people and live an honest life.
translation_verse: Yiti agyirɛ bɔ mmeni paa betu ne, tu bie, ná fa teneneefoɛ b’atee ne aso bie.

english_verse: if you do wrong and can never be trusted, you will be rooted out.
translation_verse: nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, bekonua bɛ boso bekofi aseɛ so, na amumuyɛɛfoɛ wora, bɛkɔprapra bɛ boso bekofi so.

english_verse: My child, remember my teachings and instructions and obey them completely.
translation_verse: Mma, nnɛma wɔ wora fi me foɛtulɛ ne, na mmom fa me mmeraa dwirɛ nemɔ sie wɔ ti anu;

english_verse: They will help you live a long and prosperous life.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ bɛkɔmaa ekonyi kɔhyɛ, ekonya ngoa tendenn, ná wayie wɔ yé.

english_verse: Let love and loyalty always show like a necklace, and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: Nnɛma pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ne nahorɛlilɛ bɛpa wɔ nwo, kyekye fa ya wɔ kɔme, ná kyerɛ ye wɔ w’ahone nu.

english_verse: God and people will like you and hold you in high esteem.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe kɔmaa Nyameɛ ne mmenia bɛkɔlo wɔ, ná babɔ wɔ dumaa paa.

english_verse: With all your heart you must trust the Lord and not your own judgment.
translation_verse: Fa wɔ wora amukoraa wura AWURADE nu, na nnɛfa wɔ nwo to wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nworɛ so.

english_verse: Always let him lead you, and he will clear the road for you to follow.
translation_verse: Wɔ bra mukoraa, maa Nyameɛ bra nu, na okohyire wɔ atee maa ɛkɔfa so.

english_verse: Don't ever think that you are wise enough, but respect the Lord and stay away from evil.
translation_verse: Nnɛbu wɔ nwo nworɛniɛ, suro AWURADE, ná twe wɔ nwo fi bɔne nwo.

english_verse: This will make you healthy, and you will feel strong.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔyɛ aporɛnuserɛ kɔma wɔ nwonaen, ɔne wɔ mmowue nu anwoserɛ.

english_verse: Honor the Lord by giving him your money and the first part of all your crops.
translation_verse: Fa bɔ ele ye ɔ hyɛ AWURADE animnyam, wɔ fieso aleɛ bɔ ekoli moa kɔfa amukoraa koso,

english_verse: Then you will have more grain and grapes than you will ever need.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so aleɛ ayi wɔ pata mɔ so tɛkyɛtɛkyɛɛ, na wɔ kumaa bɔ etwi nzaa nu ne, nzaa koyi kobu kɔfa so.

english_verse: My child, don't turn away or become bitter when the Lord corrects you.
translation_verse: Mma, ɔyɛ a nnɛpo AWURADE tealɛ bɔ ɔfa tengyɛtengyɛ wɔ ne, yeɛ sɛ ɔkã wɔ nyunu a, nnɛmaa ɔyɛ wɔ ahi,

english_verse: The Lord corrects everyone he loves, just as parents correct a child they dearly love. The Value of Wisdom
translation_verse: ofikyɛ sona bɔ AWURADE kuro ye dwirɛ ne yeɛ ɔkã ye nyunu ɔ, kyɛbɔ seɛ ɔyɛ ɔwa bɔ ɔla ye ahone nwo ne ala.

english_verse: Wisdom is worth more than silver; it makes you much richer than gold.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔ enya ye fi nu ne, ɔte paa tra ɛdwetɛ, yeɛ so mvasoɛ ne ɔte paa tra sikaa kɔkorɛ.

english_verse: Wisdom is more valuable than precious jewels; nothing you want compares with her.
translation_verse: Nworɛ nyɔboɛ yɛ se tra agudeɛ, na bɔ wɔ nye gye ye nwo biala, ɛngɔhora ngɔfa ngɔtoto nworɛ nwo.

english_verse: In her right hand Wisdom holds a long life, and in her left hand are wealth and honor.
translation_verse: Ngoa tendenn wɔ ye sa famaa nu, yeɛ anwonya ne animnyam wɔ ye sa bɛen nu.

english_verse: Wisdom makes life pleasant and leads us safely along.
translation_verse: Ye atee te anika atee, na ye saa amukoraa te asomdwee.

english_verse: Wisdom is a life-giving tree, the source of happiness for all who hold on to her.
translation_verse: Ɔte ngoa bakaa ma bɛ bɔ betira ye nu ɔ, na bɛ bɔ bɛsɔ ye nu bum ne, benya saleɛ.

english_verse: By his wisdom and knowledge the Lord created heaven and earth.
translation_verse: AWURADE nate nworɛ so yeɛ ɔbɔle aseɛ bo ɔ, ɔnate ndeaseɛ so yeɛ ɔfale ewienu sɛle berɛ ɔ;

english_verse: By his understanding he let the ocean break loose and clouds release the rain.
translation_verse: ɔnate ye nimdeɛ so yeɛ buma mɔ nu nzue pu wale ɔ, yeɛ ɔnate so yeɛ munungum mɔ koso bɛpepe bosue begua ase ɔ.

english_verse: My child, use common sense and sound judgment! Always keep them in mind.
translation_verse: Mma, fa nworɛ bɔ nu pi ɔ, ɔne adwene bɔ nu abukye ɔ sie, nnɛmaa befi wɔ nye so,

english_verse: They will help you to live a long and beautiful life.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so bayɛ ngoa bama wɔ kra, ɔne animnyam bɔ ɔla wɔ kɔme ɔ.

english_verse: You will walk safely and never stumble;
translation_verse: Ɔba ye sɔ a, ɛkɔfa w’atee so asomdwee nu, na wɔ gya ngopoli.

english_verse: you will rest without a worry and sleep soundly.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛkɔda a, engosuro, yeɛ sɛ ɛda a, wɔ nnaa kɔyɛ wɔ fɛ.

english_verse: So don't be afraid of sudden disasters or storms that strike those who are evil.
translation_verse: Nnɛsuro mvum nu ahunundetelɛ, anaa asane bɔ ɔto bɔnefoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You can be sure that the Lord will protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE kɔyɛ w’anyelasoɛ, na ɔkɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen bɔ ɛngɔtɔ ngaen biala nu ɔ.

english_verse: Do all you can for everyone who deserves your help.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ohia mmokalɛ ne, nnɛfa paayɛlɛ bɔ ye atianuserɛ, na sɛ ɛkɔhora kɔboka a, boka.

english_verse: Don't tell your neighbor to come back tomorrow, if you can help today.
translation_verse: Nnɛkã kyire ebiɛngo kyɛ, “Kɔ bra, na ngɔfa ngɔma wɔ ɛhema,” wɔ aberɛ bɔ ele nikyee ne bie wɔ berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't try to be mean to neighbors who trust you.
translation_verse: Nnɛbɔ ebiɛngo anwo porɛ tɛɛ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɔne wɔ bɛte ye asomdwee nu ɔ.

english_verse: Don't argue just to be arguing, when you haven't been hurt.
translation_verse: Nnɛne ebiala benya edwudwolɛ mbaen mbaen, wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɔyyɔle wɔ tɛɛ biala ɔ.

english_verse: Don't be jealous of cruel people or follow their example.
translation_verse: Nnɛma wɔ nye boro asisiefoɛ, yeɛ esaa bɔ bapɛ bato berɛ ne, nnɛfa nu biala so.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is dishonest, but he lets good people be his friends.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sona bɔ ɔte kanda ne, ɔte AWURADE akyiwadeɛ, nakoso teneneeniɛ de, AWURADE kã ye ti anu dwirɛ kyire ye.

english_verse: He places a curse on the home of everyone who is evil, but he blesses the home of every good person.
translation_verse: AWURADE ɛnomalɛ wɔ bɔnefoɛ awuro nu, nakoso nekaa bɔ teneneeniɛ te de, oyira berɛ.

english_verse: The Lord sneers at those who sneer at him, but he is kind to everyone who is humble.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, ɔgoro ngorohoɛfoɛ nwo, nakoso anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ de, ɔdo bɛ.

english_verse: You will be praised if you are wise, but you will be disgraced if you are a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Animnyam kooli nworɛfoɛ bɛ sa nu, nakoso ngwaseafoɛ de, animguaseɛ kɔmata bɛ.

english_verse: My child, listen closely to my teachings and learn common sense.
translation_verse: Mmaa, ɛ́mɔtie ɛmɔ baba mɔ foɛtulɛ, ná ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ betie, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔsua nworɛ.

english_verse: My advice is useful, so don't turn away.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ paa yeɛ mefa mema ɛmɔ ɔ, na nnɛma ɛmɔpo me foɛtulɛ ne.

english_verse: When I was still very young and my mother's favorite child, my father
translation_verse: Me ngwadaa nu bɔ né me ne me baba yɛwɔ berɛ ne, bɔ né nde kãa, ná me ni di me bahorɛ ne,

english_verse: said to me: “If you follow my teachings and keep them in mind, you will live.
translation_verse: me baba tuli me foɛ sele me kyɛ, “Fa me dwirɛ bɔ mekã ne to wɔ ti anu, di me mmeraa dwirɛ so, ná nya ngoa.

english_verse: Be wise and learn good sense; remember my teachings and do what I say.
translation_verse: Sua nworɛ, sua nworɛ bɔ nu pi ɔ. Nnɛma wɔ wora fi, yeɛ nnɛyakyi me noa dwirɛ so lilɛ.

english_verse: “If you love Wisdom and don't reject her, she will watch over you.
translation_verse: Nnɛpo nworɛ, na ɔkɔnea wɔ so, kuro ye dwirɛ, na ɔkɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen.

english_verse: The best thing about Wisdom is Wisdom herself; good sense is more important than anything else.
translation_verse: Nworɛ te nikye titire, yiti sua nworɛ, w’anwonya mukoraa si ne, pena ndeaseɛ.

english_verse: If you value Wisdom and hold tightly to her, great honors will be yours.
translation_verse: Nwu ye kyɛ odi mu, na ɔkɔpagya wɔ; na sɛ ɛtɔ ye nu ɛyɛ ye atuu a, ɔkɔhyɛ wɔ animnyam.

english_verse: It will be like wearing a glorious crown of beautiful flowers.” The Right Way and the Wrong Way
translation_verse: Ɔkɔfa animnyam abotire kɔbɔ wɔ, ɔkɔfa abotire nyemenenyemene kɔbɔ wɔ.”

english_verse: My child, if you listen and obey my teachings, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Mma, tie me dwirɛ ná di so, amaa ɔnate so anya ngoa tendenn.

english_verse: I have shown you the way that makes sense; I have guided you along the right path.
translation_verse: Mahyirehyire wɔ nworɛ atee ne, mafa wɔ mafa atimbire turoloo ne aso.

english_verse: Your road won't be blocked, and you won't stumble when you run.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ ɛnate a, wɔ gya ngɔto ngɔbrabra nu, yeɛ etu amirika koso a, engosoti.

english_verse: Hold firmly to my teaching and never let go. It will mean life for you.
translation_verse: Sɔ foɛtulɛ nu yé, nnɛyakyi nu, fa sie yé, ofikyɛ wɔ ngoa ɛne.

english_verse: Don't follow the bad example of cruel and evil people.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ atee ne, nnɛfa so bie, yeɛ nnɛfa amumuyɛɛfoɛ atee so.

english_verse: Turn aside and keep going. Stay away from them.
translation_verse: Twe wɔ nwo fi so, nnɛfa so bie, makye fi so, ná pɛ nu kɔ.

english_verse: They can't sleep or rest until they do wrong or harm some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛ de bɛnna, sana bayɔ bɔne koraka, nnakorɔkorɔ tɔ bɛ so, sana bama ebie afi ase koraka.

english_verse: Their food and drink are cruelty and wickedness.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔne yɔleɛ te be gye aleɛ, yeɛ basabasayɔlɛ te bɛ nzaa bɔ bɛno ɔ.

english_verse: The lifestyle of good people is like sunlight at dawn that keeps getting brighter until broad daylight.
translation_verse: Nakoso teneneefoɛ de, b’atee te kyɛ ngyerɛmɔ yia bɔ wapukye ɔ, na ɔbɔ toonn kodwu eyia ketee.

english_verse: The lifestyle of the wicked is like total darkness, and they will never know what makes them stumble.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, b’atee te kyɛ awosii tunn, bennwu nikyee bɔ bɛfofo so ɔ.

english_verse: My child, listen carefully to everything I say.
translation_verse: Mma, tie me dwirɛ, yɛ asoɛ tie edwirɛ bɔ mekã ne.

english_verse: Don't forget a single word, but think about it all.
translation_verse: Nnɛmaa befi wɔ nye so, fa sie w’ahone nu dɔ paa.

english_verse: Knowing these teachings will mean true life and good health for you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ onwu bɛ ne, bɛte ngoa ma ye, na ɔma ye aporɛ nu amukoraa sande ye.

english_verse: Carefully guard your thoughts because they are the source of true life.
translation_verse: Adwene bɔ ɛkɔfa ne, dwene ye nwo yé paa, ofikyɛ nu yeɛ ngoa ofi ba ɔ.

english_verse: Never tell lies or be deceitful in what you say.
translation_verse: Nnɛfa wɔ noa kekã nnakannaka dwirɛ, twe wɔ nwo fi ngondombo dwirɛ kekanɛ nwo.

english_verse: Know where you are headed, and you will stay on solid ground.
translation_verse: Dwene nekaa bɔ ekotu wɔ gya kotia ɔ nwo, amaa ɔnate so w’atee amukoraa ayie wɔ yé.

english_verse: Don't make a mistake by turning to the right or the left.
translation_verse: Nnɛmakye kɔ famaa anaa bɛen, twe wɔ gya fi bɔne nwo.

english_verse: My son, if you listen closely to my wisdom and good sense,
translation_verse: Mma, tie me nworɛ dwirɛ ne, yɛ asoɛ tie me nworɛ bɔ nu pi ne,

english_verse: you will have sound judgment, and you will always know the right thing to say.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so w’adwene nu abukye, ná wɔ noa ahã nimdeɛ dwirɛ.

english_verse: The words of an immoral woman may be as sweet as honey and as smooth as olive oil.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ brasua sanzaniɛ ye noa dwirɛ te kyɛ woɛ bɔ ɔpepe ɔ, na ye noa te menemene tra aloko;

english_verse: But all that you really get from being with her is bitter poison and pain.
translation_verse: nakoso ɔkwaayie ye bo ne, ɔyɛ wee te kyɛ awɔwee, na ɔyɛ nna te kyɛ sɛpɔ.

english_verse: If you follow her, she will lead you down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ye gya diedie sona kɔ ewue nu, na ye agyirɛtulɛ fa sona kɔ ɛborɔ.

english_verse: She has missed the path that leads to life and doesn't even know it.
translation_verse: Ɔmva atee bɔ ɔkɔ ngoa nu ɔ so, na ye atee te makyebu bɔ ɔnze ɔ.

english_verse: My son, listen to me and do everything I say.
translation_verse: Afei, me mma mɔ, ɛ́mɔtie me, nnɛma ɛmɔyakyi me noa dwirɛ so lilɛ.

english_verse: Stay away from a bad woman! Don't even go near the door of her house.
translation_verse: Twe wɔ nwo fi sɔ brasua ne anwo, na nnɛpingye ye awuro anoa ne;

english_verse: You will lose your self-respect and end up in debt to some cruel person for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so amva w’animnyam amma ebiemɔ, ná amva wɔ ngoa anwura atianuserɛniɛ bie sa;

english_verse: Strangers will get your money and everything else you have worked for.
translation_verse: ná ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ banzesa wɔ nningyein, ná bɔ afɛ anya ye ne, wangɔanni amanvrafoɛ sa nu;

english_verse: When it's all over, your body will waste away, as you groan
translation_verse: ná wɔ ngoa ayieleɛ ne, wando wɔ ne ɛpenenɛ, mmerɛ bɔ anwonyerɛ adidi wɔ sonaluwaa ne anwoɔnaen ne,

english_verse: I paid no attention to my teachers,
translation_verse: Mandie m’akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ dwirɛ, yeɛ mamva me foɛtulɛfoɛ bɛ dwirɛ manyɛ huu.

english_verse: and now I am disgraced in front of everyone.”
translation_verse: Ao, ɔhale kãa mane m’ayieleɛ yiele me wɔ mmenia badwa nyunu.”

english_verse: You should be faithful to your wife, just as you take water from your own well.
translation_verse: No wɔ bɔbɔ w’abura nu nzue, nzue bɔ opu fi wɔ bɔbɔ w’asue ti ɔ.

english_verse: And don't be like a stream from which just any woman may take a drink.
translation_verse: Aso odi kyɛ wɔ mbombonzue obu fa so kogua nekaa bie, anaakyɛ w’asueba tengyɛ kɔfa dwaaso?

english_verse: Save yourself for your wife and don't have sex with other women.
translation_verse: Maa bɛyɛ wɔ ngome wɔ deɛ, nnɛma ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ bɛno bie bɛboka wɔ so.

english_verse: Be happy with the wife you married when you were young.
translation_verse: Ma wɔ mbombonzue ne ɔyɛ saleɛ, ná nya wɔ mmerandeɛ nu braa nwo anigye.

english_verse: She is beautiful and graceful, just like a deer; you should be attracted to her and stay deeply in love.
translation_verse: Ɔte dabɔɔ beleɛ anwonyemene ne wanzane beleɛ bɔ ole animnyam ɔ, ma wɔ nye gye ye nyɔfone nwo mmerɛ biala, ná ma ye hurolɛ oli wɔ ti mmerɛ biala.

english_verse: Don't go crazy over a woman who is unfaithful to her own husband!
translation_verse: Mma, nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛma brasua sanzaniɛ ye hurolɛ di wɔ ti maa ɛsosɔ brasua foforɛ nyɔfone nu ɔ?

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, and he watches us closely.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔ sona yɔ ne, ɔla AWURADE nyunu, na ɔneanea ye atee bɔ ɔnate so amukoraa nu.

english_verse: Sinners are trapped and caught by their own evil deeds.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ ye bɔbɔ ye amumuyɛɛ yeɛ osua ye ngaen kye ye ɔ, na ye bɔne nyamaa yeɛ ɔkyekye ye ɔ.

english_verse: They get lost and die because of their foolishness and lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Ɔnde fo, yiti okowu, na ɔnate ye gyiminɛ somaa ti, okomini kofi atee ne aso.

english_verse: My child, suppose you agree to pay the debt of someone, who cannot repay a loan.
translation_verse: Mma, sɛ ali eliɛngo agyinamuɛ, sɛ afa wɔ nwo asie kerɛ nu ama ɛwɔfoɛ,

english_verse: Then you are trapped by your own words,
translation_verse: maa ɔnate so wɔ noa dwirɛ asua wɔ ngaen wahye wɔ a,

english_verse: and you are now in the power of someone else. Here is what you should do: Go and beg for permission to call off the agreement.
translation_verse: ye de mma, yɔ ɛhe fa tete wɔ nwo, ofikyɛ atɔ eliɛngo ngaen nu: kɔ kɔkoto eliɛngo ne, ná pa ye kyerɛ.

english_verse: Do this before you fall asleep or even get sleepy.
translation_verse: Nnɛma nnaa ba wɔ nye so, yeɛ nnɛtɔ ngosie.

english_verse: Save yourself, just as a deer or a bird tries to escape from a hunter.
translation_verse: De wɔ nwo kyɛbɔ ɛwanzane ode ye nwo fi bɔfoɛ sa nu ɔ, kyɛbɔ anomaa ode ye nwo fi sona bɔ osua nnomaa ngaen sa nu ɔ.

english_verse: You lazy people can learn by watching an anthill.
translation_verse: Ɛfoen sona, kɔ ngyiregyiraa berɛ, nea kyɛbɔ ɔyɔ ye nningyein ɔ, ná sua nworɛ.

english_verse: How long will you lie there doing nothing at all? When are you going to get up and stop sleeping?
translation_verse: O, ɛfoen sona, ɛkɔla maa okoodwu kyinzu? Mmerɛ beni yeɛ ekofi wɔ nnafelɛ nu kodwɔso ɔ?

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: ‘Maa nna kãa, maa ndɔ ngosie kãa, maa ndengyɛ me nu kãa.’

english_verse: Suddenly, everything is gone, as though it had been taken by an armed robber.
translation_verse: Na ehiaa kɔwa wɔ so kyɛ awerɔm awueniɛ, yeɛ anwokyere kɔwa wɔ so kyɛ koɛhonɛniɛ bɔ otira akokyɛm ɔ.

english_verse: Worthless liars go around
translation_verse: Sona mbaen, busueniɛ, ɔnate kekã nnakannaka dwirɛ,

english_verse: winking and giving signals to deceive others.
translation_verse: ɔbɔ ye nye kyire, ɔfa ye gya dwudwo, yeɛ ɔfa ye sa mmɛseka dwudwo.

english_verse: They are always thinking up something cruel and evil, and they stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Ye ti anu adwene te tɛ, ɔbɔ nzɛmmɔne porɛ daa, na ɔkekã mmenia ti bobɔ nu.

english_verse: But they will be struck by sudden disaster and left without a hope.
translation_verse: Yiti musue kɔto sɔ sona ne mvum nu, na ɔkɔto ye mvum nu bɔ ongonya ye sɔbea ɔ.

english_verse: There are six or seven kinds of people the Lord doesn't like:
translation_verse: Sɔ nningyein nzia hemɔ bɛyɛ AWURADE tɛ, amba, nningyein nzoo hemɔ bɛte ye akyiwadeɛ:

english_verse: Those who are too proud or tell lies or murder,
translation_verse: anyeɛ bɔ ɔtra ye ndo nwiaa, noa bɔ ɔnga nahorɛ ɔ, asaa bɔ ɔkã mogya bɔ odi be gua ɔ,

english_verse: those who make evil plans or are quick to do wrong,
translation_verse: sona bɔ adwene tɛɛ ali ye ti ɔ, agyirɛ bɔ ye nwo yɛ nyera wɔ bɔneyɔlɛ nwo,

english_verse: those who tell lies in court or stir up trouble in a family.
translation_verse: sona bɔ odi adanzewia ɔ, yeɛ sona bɔ ɔkekã aliɛmaa mɔ bɛ ti bobɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: Obey the teaching of your parents—
translation_verse: Mma, di wɔ baba mmeraa dwirɛ so, yeɛ nnɛpo wɔ maame foɛtulɛ.

english_verse: always keep it in mind and never forget it.
translation_verse: Bɔ ye borɛ fa to wɔ ti anu daa, ná kyekye fa ya wɔ kɔme.

english_verse: Their teaching will guide you when you walk, protect you when you sleep, and talk to you when you are awake.
translation_verse: Ɛnate a, bekohyire wɔ atee, ɛda a, bɛkɔnea wɔ so, yeɛ sɛ edwɔso a, bɛ ne wɔ kotu asure.

english_verse: The Law of the Lord is a lamp, and its teachings shine brightly. Correction and self-control will lead you through life.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmeraa dwirɛ ne te kanea, yeɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne te hyireinn, na betwi wɔ nyunu bɛtengyɛtengyɛ wɔ a, ɔte asetena nu esaa bɔ ɔla berɛ ɔ;

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: bɔ ɔtwe wɔ fi musue brasua nwo, ofi adwaman brasua ye noa dwirɛ menemene nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Don't let yourself be attracted by the charm and lovely eyes of someone like that.
translation_verse: Nnɛdi ye anwonyemene si ekuro ye, yeɛ nnɛmaa ɔfa ye ndo nwiaa ne ɔkye w’adwene.

english_verse: A woman who sells her love can be bought for as little as the price of a meal. But making love to another man's wife will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ paanoo sii ko yeɛ bɛfa benya brasua adwamanbɔlɛniɛ ɔ, nakoso ebie aye de, ɛfa wɔ ngoa yeɛ ɛpɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: If you carry burning coals, you burn your clothes;
translation_verse: Aso sona kɔhora kɔfa see kowura ye hue so bɔ ye ndaadeɛ ngɔyera ɔ?

english_verse: if you step on hot coals, you burn your feet.
translation_verse: Aso sona kɔhora kotiatia see gonn so bɔ ye gya ngɔyera ɔ?

english_verse: And if you go to bed with another man's wife, you pay the price.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ ɔkɔto ebiala bɔ ɔkɔ ebie aye nwo ɔ, na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔ sɔ braa ne nwo ne, ɔngɔfa ye nwo ngoli tɔtorɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: We don't put up with thieves, not even with one who steals for something to eat.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛhɔen ku awueniɛ maa owua aleɛ kyɛ odi ma ye ko yi a, ɔnzɛ kyɛ yɛbu ye animtia.

english_verse: And thieves who get caught must pay back seven times what was stolen and lose everything.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ bɛkye ye a, okotua ye nwo mmɔhoɛ nzoo, ɔkɔhwere ye awuro nningyein amukoraa.

english_verse: But if you go to bed with another man's wife, you will destroy yourself by your own stupidity.
translation_verse: Nakoso bienzua bɔ ɔne ebie aye bɛda ne de, adwene nne ye ti anu, sona bɔ ɔyɔ sɔ ne, ɔfa sɛkye ye bɔbɔ ye kra.

english_verse: You will be beaten and forever disgraced,
translation_verse: Ye sa kɔhã epuralɛ ne animguaseɛ, na ye nyanzoen ne ngofi ye so.

english_verse: because a jealous husband can be furious and merciless when he takes revenge.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nungunɛ ma bienzua fɛ yaa piri paa, na kyẽa bɔ ɔkɔtɔ sɔ biaa ne so wereɛ ne, ongonwu ye anwumvoin.

english_verse: He won't let you pay him off, no matter what you offer.
translation_verse: Ongole mbata biala, yeɛ sɛ ɛma ye akyɛdeɛ pee po a, ɔngɔpene.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention and don't forget what I tell you to do.
translation_verse: Mma, di me dwirɛ so, ná fa me mmeraa dwirɛ ne sie wɔ ti anu.

english_verse: Obey me, and you will live! Let my instructions be your greatest treasure.
translation_verse: Di me mmeraa dwirɛ so ná nya ngoa; ma me ngyerɛkyerɛ nwo hia wɔ kyɛ wɔ nye kyiremvua;

english_verse: Keep them at your fingertips and write them in your mind.
translation_verse: kyekye fa bɔ wɔ sa mmɛseka, ná kyerɛ ye wɔ w’ahone nu.

english_verse: Let wisdom be your sister and make common sense your closest friend.
translation_verse: Kã kyire nworɛ kyɛ, “Ɛte nniɛma brasua,” ná frɛ adwene bɔ nu pi ɔ kyɛ wɔ busuaniɛ;

english_verse: They will protect you from the flattering words of someone else's wife.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so babɔ wɔ nwo waen bafi brasua sanzaniɛ sa nu, bafi brasua sanzaniɛ bɔ ye noa dwirɛ te menemene ɔ sa nu.

english_verse: From the window of my house, I once happened to see
translation_verse: Né ngyi m’awuro berɛ mboma ne anu, ndole me nye nneane me mboma nu,

english_verse: It was late in the evening, sometime after dark.
translation_verse: Né ɔnate dwaaso nekaa bie bɔ opingye braa n’awuro ɔ, ɔfale atee bɔ ɔkɔ braa n’awuro so,

english_verse: One of these young men turned the corner and was walking by the house of an unfaithful wife.
translation_verse: mmerɛ bɔ né aleɛ adwo, bɔ né maen nu apinipini ɔ, kɔngɔen ne awosii nu.

english_verse: She was dressed fancy like a woman of the street with only one thing in mind.
translation_verse: Na yieee, braa bie wale ooyiale ye. Né wahera ye tena kyɛ gyanderaniɛ, na né otira nnakannaka adwene.

english_verse: She was one of those women who are loud and restless and never stay at home,
translation_verse: Braa ne te sona bɔ wasɛkye, na ɔnze nyanzoen, na ɔndena ye awuro.

english_verse: who walk street after street, waiting to trap a man.
translation_verse: Odi mmorɔnoɛ nemɔ aso ne dwaaso akɔneaba, na ɔtetɛ wɔ ahameɛ biala.

english_verse: She grabbed him and kissed him, and with no sense of shame, she said:
translation_verse: Yeɛ braa ne to brale ye, na ɔfele ye noa, na braa ne totone ye nye lili sele ye kyɛ,

english_verse: So I came looking for you, and here you are!
translation_verse: ye sɔ ati, mafite mawa kyɛ mebaayia wɔ, mepena wɔ paa, na manwu wɔ.

english_verse: The sheets on my bed are bright-colored cloth from Egypt.
translation_verse: Mafa bomo masɛ me bɛen, yeɛ Misraim mbasotam bɔ bali adwii bagua nu ɔ.

english_verse: And I have covered it with perfume made of myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.
translation_verse: Mafa korobo, pɛprɛ ne ayirefona mapete me mba so fonafona.

english_verse: “Let's go there and make love all night.
translation_verse: Bra ma yɛɛgye yɛ nye mba so toonn kɔpem ngyerɛmɔ, maa yɛɛsɛpɛ yɛ nwo.

english_verse: My husband is traveling, and he's far away.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me hu nne awuro, watia ye gya si wahɔ dedeede.

english_verse: He took a lot of money along, and he won't be back home before the middle of the month.”
translation_verse: Ɔfale bɔtɔ bɔ sikaa dɔnn wɔ nu yeɛ ɔhɔle ɔ, sana bɛpakye bosome nu koraka né wasa wawa awuro.”

english_verse: And so, she tricked him with all of her sweet talk and her flattery.
translation_verse: Ɔfale ye noa dwirɛ menemene pee tole ye mmralɛ, ɔfale ye noa dwirɛ menemene ne nyane ye.

english_verse: At once he followed her like an ox on the way to be slaughtered, or like a fool on the way to be punished
translation_verse: Na berɛ ne ala, olili braa ne asi kyɛ nandwie bɔ bɛfa ye bɛkɔ akumyɛɛ ɔ, kyɛ kwaseaa bɔ bagua ye ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ bɛkwaahwe ye so ɔ,

english_verse: and killed with arrows. He was no more than a bird rushing into a trap, without knowing it would cost him his life.
translation_verse: kɔpem kyɛ agyaen kosina ye fure nu ɔ, kyɛ anomaa bɔ ɔpere ye nwo kowura ngaen nu, bɔ ɔnze kyɛ ɔkɔfa ye ngoa kɔpɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Afei, me mma mɔ, ɛ́mɔtie me e, ná ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ bétie me noa dwirɛ.

english_verse: Don't even think about that kind of woman or let yourself be misled by someone like her.
translation_verse: Nnɛma w’adwene kakyi okodi sɔ braa ne asi, nnɛdi makyebu kɔfa ye atee so,

english_verse: Such a woman has caused the downfall and destruction of a lot of men.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ wama amaneɛ ato mmenia pee, na mmeni titire pee yeɛ wahũhũ bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Her house is a one-way street leading straight down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Ye awuro te ɛborɔ atee, na ɔtorotoro kɔ ewue ye pumbu mɔ nu.

english_verse: With great understanding, Wisdom is calling out
translation_verse: Aso nworɛ ɔndea nu mvrɛ? Aso ndeaseɛ ɔmma ye komvi so ndwudwo?

english_verse: as she stands at the crossroads and on every hill.
translation_verse: Mmokaa ti afia, wɔ atee noa, ngwandaa so yeɛ ogyi ɔ,

english_verse: She stands by the city gate where everyone enters the city, and she shouts:
translation_verse: wɔ kuro berɛ pambim ne anwo, ɔtea nu wɔ tiwaa berɛ pambim ne anu kyɛ,

english_verse: “I am calling out to each one of you!
translation_verse: “Kuro mmenia ee, ɛmɔ yeɛ metea nu mefrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ, adasa amukoraa yeɛ mefrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Listen, because what I say is worthwhile and right.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, ofikyɛ edwirɛ bɔ ohia yeɛ mekã ɔ, na edwirɛ paa paa yeɛ ofi me noa nu ɔ.

english_verse: I always speak the truth and refuse to tell a lie.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ yeɛ mekã ɔ, me noa kyi amumuyɛɛ dwirɛ kekanɛ.

english_verse: Every word I speak is honest, not one is misleading or deceptive.
translation_verse: Me noa dwirɛ amukoraa tengyɛ, nnakannaka anaa ngondombo biala nne nu.

english_verse: “If you have understanding, you will see that my words are just what you need.
translation_verse: Ye mukoraa nu la berɛ ma bɛ bɔ b’adwene nu pi ɔ, na ɔte paa ma bɛ bɔ benya nimdeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Let instruction and knowledge mean more to you than silver or the finest gold.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa me foɛtulɛ ne, na nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛdwetɛ, ɛ́mɔfa nimdeɛ, na nnɛma ɛmɔfa sikaa kɔkorɛ paa;

english_verse: Wisdom is worth much more than precious jewels or anything else you desire.” Wisdom Speaks
translation_verse: ofikyɛ nworɛ te paa tra agudeɛ, na bɔ ɛpena kyɛ enya ye biala, ɛngɔhora ngɔfa ngɔtoto nworɛ nwo.

english_verse: I am Wisdom—Common Sense is my closest friend; I possess knowledge and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Me, nworɛ, me ne adwene bɔ nu abukye yeɛ yɛte ɔ, na manya ndeaseɛ nwo nimdeɛ.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will hate evil. I hate pride and conceit and deceitful lies.
translation_verse: Esuro AWURADE a, né ekyi bɔne: mekyi anwomasoɛ ne ahandaen, bɔne yɔleɛ ne ngondombopɛlɛ.

english_verse: I am strong, and I offer sensible advice and sound judgment.
translation_verse: Foɛtulɛ ne nworɛ paa te me deɛ, me ole ndeaseɛ, na me nwo yɛ se.

english_verse: By my power kings govern, and rulers make laws that are fair.
translation_verse: Ahemvo mɔ fa me so yeɛ bedi hene ɔ, na atitirefoɛ fa me so yeɛ bɛhyɛ mmeraa bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ;

english_verse: I love everyone who loves me, and I will be found by all who honestly search.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bekuro me dwirɛ ne, mekuro bɛ dwirɛ, na bɛ bɔ bɛ nye boro bɛpena me ne, benwu me.

english_verse: I can make you rich and famous, important and successful.
translation_verse: Me berɛ yeɛ anwonya ne animnyam wɔ ɔ, anwonyadeɛ bɔ ɔkyɛ, ɔne tenenee.

english_verse: What you receive from me is more valuable than even the finest gold or the purest silver.
translation_verse: Me mmaa bɔ mesu ne, ɔte paa tra sikaa kɔkorɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ paa po, na me fieso aleɛ te paa tra ɛdwetɛ paa.

english_verse: I always do what is right,
translation_verse: Tenenee atimbire so yeɛ mefa ɔ, mefa ndɛenbualɛ turoloo atee so.

english_verse: and I give great riches to everyone who loves me.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bekuro me dwirɛ ne, memaa benya bɛ nwo, na nekaa bɔ besie bɛ nningyein ne, ngɔmaa okoyi tɛkyɛɛ.

english_verse: From the beginning, I was with the Lord. I was there before he began
translation_verse: AWURADE ɔ́hyɛ ye adwuma bo ne yeɛ ɔbɔle me ɔ, koraka yeɛ ɔ́hyɛ ye adwuma bɔ ofi tetetete ne abo ɔ.

english_verse: to create the earth. At the very first, the Lord gave life to me.
translation_verse: Ɔhyehyɛle me fili tetetete, ɔ́hyɛ ye bo ne, koraka yeɛ ɔ́bɔ aseɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When I was born, there were no oceans or springs of water.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né buma nne berɛ ne, mmerɛ bɔ né asue ti bɔ opu nzue pee ɔnne berɛ ne yeɛ bɛwole me ɔ.

english_verse: My birth was before mountains were formed or hills were put in place.
translation_verse: Anzana bɛbaafa mmokaa mɔ begyinagyina berɛ ne, anzana pambaa mɔ bɛbaawa ne, né bawo me;

english_verse: It happened long before God had made the earth or any of its fields or even the dust.
translation_verse: anzana ɔbaabɔ aseɛ ne ɛhɔayeɛ mɔ ne, anaakyɛ ewiase nnɛterɛ bɔ oli moa ne.

english_verse: I was there when the Lord put the heavens in place and stretched the sky over the surface of the sea.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ ɔfale ewienu sɛle berɛ ne, né nwɔ berɛ, mmerɛ bɔ ɔpɛle kango fale ɛpo nye ne;

english_verse: I was with him when he placed the clouds in the sky and created the springs that fill the ocean.
translation_verse: mmerɛ bɔ ɔfale munungum sinzele anwuro pindinn ne, mmerɛ bɔ ɔfale ɛpo ye ti bɔ opu nzue siele berɛ ne,

english_verse: I was there when he set boundaries for the sea to make it obey him, and when he laid foundations to support the earth.
translation_verse: mmerɛ bɔ ɔtole ɛpo wɛen, kyɛbɔ nzue ne ngobu ye mmeraa dwirɛ so ne, mmerɛ bɔ ɔtole aseɛ fapem ne,

english_verse: I was right beside the Lord, helping him plan and build. I made him happy each day, and I was happy at his side.
translation_verse: né nwɔ ye nwo berɛ, kyɛ dwumvoɛ titire paa, né nde ye anika daa, na né medi ahurusi wɔ ye nyunu mmerɛ biala.

english_verse: I was pleased with his world and pleased with its people.
translation_verse: Né me nye gye wɔ ye wiase ne anu, na nyane adasa mmaa nwo anika.

english_verse: Pay attention, my children! Follow my advice, and you will be happy.
translation_verse: “Afei, me mma mɔ, ɛ́mɔtie me e, bɛ bɔ bɛnate m’atee so ne, benya saleɛ.

english_verse: Listen carefully to my instructions, and you will be wise.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie foɛtulɛ ná ɛmɔnwu nworɛ, na nnɛma ɛmɔpo ye.

english_verse: Come to my home each day and listen to me. You will find happiness.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ otie me, bɔ ɔwɛne daa biala wɔ me pambim nu, ná ɔnwondɛ wɔ m’anoa nu ne, onya saleɛ.

english_verse: By finding me, you find life, and the Lord will be pleased with you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔpena me ne, onya ngoa, na AWURADE do ye;

english_verse: But if you don't find me, you hurt only yourself, and if you hate me, you are in love with death.
translation_verse: nakoso bɔ ɔkɔyɔ bɔne kotia me ne de, ɔyɛ ye bɔbɔ ye kra aborɛ, ebiala bɔ ɔpɔ me ne, né ewue yeɛ okuro ɔ.”

english_verse: Wisdom has built her house with its seven columns.
translation_verse: Nworɛ asi ye sua, wase ye bonima nzoo nemɔ.

english_verse: She has prepared the meat and set out the wine. Her feast is ready.
translation_verse: Wahũ ye naen nemɔ, wafrafra ye nzaa, na wato ye poen koso.

english_verse: She has sent her servant women to announce her invitation from the highest hills:
translation_verse: Wasoma ye afaneɛ nemɔ, ɔɔteane nu wɔ kuro berɛ mmokaa nemɔ aso kyɛ,
