english_verse: All of you are welcome to my meat and wine.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔbra beeli m’aleɛ ne bie, ná ɛ́mɔno me nzaa bɔ mafrafra ne bie.

english_verse: If you want to live, give up your foolishness and let understanding guide your steps.” True Wisdom
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bɛbɔ ngwaseafoɛ, na ɛmɔkonya ngoa, na ɛ́mɔfa ndeaseɛ atee so.”

english_verse: Correct a worthless bragger, and all you will get are insults and injuries.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔtengyɛtengyɛ ngorohoɛniɛ ne, ode animguaseɛ, yeɛ ebiala bɔ otwi bɔnefoɛ nyunu ne, ode nzoaa.

english_verse: Any bragger you correct will only hate you. But if you correct someone who has common sense, you will be loved.
translation_verse: Nnɛtwi ngorohoɛniɛ nyunu, ná wambɔ wɔ; sɛ etwi nworɛniɛ nyunu a, okohuro wɔ dwirɛ.

english_verse: If you have good sense, instruction will help you to have even better sense. And if you live right, education will help you to know even more.
translation_verse: Tu nworɛniɛ foɛ, na ɔkɔhɔ so konwu nworɛ; yeɛ kyirekyire teneneeniɛ nikye, na ɔkɔhɔ so konya nimdeɛ.

english_verse: Respect and obey the Lord! This is the beginning of wisdom. To have understanding, you must know the Holy God.
translation_verse: AWURADE surolɛ yeɛ ɔte nworɛnwunɛ ye bohyɛlɛ ɔ, na Krongronniɛ ne nwo nimdeɛ yeɛ ɔma nworɛ bɔ nu pi ɔ.

english_verse: I am Wisdom. If you follow me, you will live a long time.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛfa me so a, ekonyi kɔhyɛ, na ngɔma wɔ ngoa kɔyɛ tendenn.

english_verse: Good sense is good for you, but if you brag, you hurt yourself. A Foolish Invitation
translation_verse: Sɛ enwu nworɛ a, enwu ma wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo, yeɛ sɛ ɛyɛ ngorohoɛ a, ɔkɔbɔ wɔ ngome wɔ ti so.

english_verse: Stupidity is reckless, senseless, and foolish.
translation_verse: Brasua kwaseaa dwudwo mbaen mbaen, ye adwene te kãa, na ɔnze huu.

english_verse: She sits in front of her house and on the highest hills in the town.
translation_verse: Ɔtena ase wɔ ye awuro anoa nu, ɔtena bia so wɔ nekaa bɔ ɔte bokaa ɔ so, wɔ kuro berɛ,

english_verse: “If you are stupid, come on inside!” And to every fool she says,
translation_verse: “Wɔ bɔ w’adwene te kãa ne, makye fa wa oo!” Na bienzua bɔ ɔnze nworɛ ne, braa ne kã kyire ye kyɛ,

english_verse: “Stolen water tastes best, and the food you eat in secret tastes best of all.”
translation_verse: “Awue nzue yɛ fɛ, na aleɛ bɔ ɛkɔfea wɔ nwo koli ne, ɔyɛ fɛ.”

english_verse: None who listen to Stupidity understand that her guests are as good as dead.
translation_verse: Nakoso bienzua ne, ɔnze kyɛ berɛ te ewue kuro ɔ, na mmienzua bɔ bɛkɔ ye nekaa ne, ɛborɔ bo dɔ yeɛ baagua ɔ.

english_verse: Here are some proverbs of Solomon: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children make them sad.
translation_verse: Solomon anyandera mɔ. Baa nworɛniɛ ma ye baba nye gye, nakoso baa kwaseaa de, ɔma ye maame wora bɔ.

english_verse: What you gain by doing evil won't help you at all. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Anwonya bɔ amva atee paa so annya ye ne, mvasoɛ biala nne so, nakoso tenenee bra de, ode wɔ fi ewue nu.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you won't go hungry; if you are wicked, God won't let you have what you want.
translation_verse: AWURADE mma ɛhɔen ngu teneneeniɛ kra, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ɔbɔ bɔ wanya ye ɔ ogua.

english_verse: Everyone praises good people, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ nya saleɛ, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ɔfa ye noa kata bɔne so.

english_verse: Good people are remembered long after they are gone, but the wicked are soon forgotten.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ nwo ngayeɛ ɔte saleɛ, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ye dumaa komini.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will listen and obey; if all you do is talk foolishly, you will destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔse nworɛ ne, otie mmeraa dwirɛ, nakoso kwaseaa de, ye dwudwolɛ mbaen mbaen ne fa ye kɔ amaneɛ nu.

english_verse: You will be safe, if you always do right, but you will get caught, if you are dishonest.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ odi nahorɛ ne, ɔnate a ye nwo sonn, nakoso ebiala bɔ ɔnate atee tɛɛ so ne de, ye nwo dwirɛ kofite.

english_verse: The words of good people are a source of life, but evil hides behind the words of the wicked.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ ye noa dwirɛ te ngoa asue ti, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ɔfa ye noa kata bɔne so.

english_verse: Hatred stirs up trouble; love overlooks the wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Ɛpɔen twetwe ngondii ba, nakoso ɔdɔ de, ɔkata mvomsoɛ amukoraa so.

english_verse: If you have good sense, it will show when you speak. But if you are stupid, you will be beaten with a stick.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye adwene nu pi ne, nworɛ wɔ ye noa dwirɛ nu, nakoso sona bɔ adwene nne ye ti anu de, ye si fata mbire.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will learn all you can, but foolish talk will soon destroy you.
translation_verse: Nworɛfoɛ boaboa nimdeɛ noa, nakoso kwaseaa de, ye noa dwirɛ twetwe ye kɔ amaneɛ nu.

english_verse: Great wealth can be a fortress, but poverty is no protection at all.
translation_verse: Sikaniɛ anwonya yeɛ ɔte ye kuro bɔ wato ye nwo fasue ɔ, yeɛ ehianiɛ ye hiaa yeɛ ɔte ye aworabɔlɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If you live right, the reward is a good life; if you are evil, all you have is sin.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ akatuaa fa ye kɔ ngoa nu, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ye mvasoɛ fa ye kɔ bɔne nu.

english_verse: Accept correction, and you will find life; reject correction, and you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ otie foɛtulɛ ne, ɔnate ngoa atee so, nakoso bɔ ɔpo bɛ nyunu hwilɛ ne de, odi makyebu fi atee ne aso.

english_verse: You can hide your hatred by telling lies, but you are a fool to spread lies.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔpɔ sona, nakoso ɔkatakata so ne, ɔnga nahorɛ, yeɛ bɔ ɔkekã obiɛngo nwo dwirɛ sɛkye ye ne, ɔte kwaseaa.

english_verse: You will say the wrong thing if you talk too much— so be sensible and watch what you say.
translation_verse: Mvomsoɛ mba edwudwolɛ worawora nu, nakoso sona bɔ ondwudwo pee ne, ɔte nworɛniɛ.

english_verse: The words of a good person are like pure silver, but the thoughts of an evil person are almost worthless.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ ye noa dwirɛ te kyɛ ɛdwetɛ paa, nakoso bɔnefoɛ adwene de, mvasoɛ biala nne so.

english_verse: Many are helped by useful instruction, but fools are killed by their own stupidity.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ ye noa dwirɛ, mmeni pee fa nu aba, nakoso ngwaseafoɛ de, adwene nne bɛ ti anu, yiti bewuwu.

english_verse: When the Lord blesses you with riches, you have nothing to regret.
translation_verse: AWURADE saleɛ yeɛ ɔma sona nya ye nwo ɔ, na ɔmva aworabɔlɛ biala mmoka so.

english_verse: Fools enjoy doing wrong, but anyone with good sense enjoys acting wisely.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛɛyɔlɛ te kyɛ angorɛ wɔ kwaseaa nye so, nakoso sona bɔ ye adwene nu pi ne de, ye nye gye nworɛ nwo.

english_verse: What evil people dread most will happen to them, but good people will get what they want most.
translation_verse: Bɔ bɔnefoɛ suro ne yeɛ ɔkɔto ye ɔ, nakoso teneneefoɛ de, bɛkɔyɔ bɔ bɛpena ɔ bɛkɔma bɛ.

english_verse: Those crooks will disappear when a storm strikes, but God will keep safe all who obey him.
translation_verse: Sɛ mvrama piri otu pɛ nu a, bɔnefoɛ boso mini, nakoso teneneeniɛ de, ɔte nyinasoɛ bɔ otimu berɛ daa ɔ.

english_verse: Having a lazy person on the job is like a mouth full of vinegar or smoke in your eyes.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ nzaa kekarekekare ma sona ye gye onya, ná nwosina ma sona nye yɛ ye yea ne, sɔ ala yeɛ sona bɔ ɔte foen ne, ɔte ma bɛ bɔ bɛsoma ye ɔ.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you will live longer; if you keep doing wrong, your life will be cut short.
translation_verse: AWURADE surolɛ ma ngoa tendenn, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ye ngoa so pɛ tika.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will be happy, but there is no future for the wicked.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ ye anyelasoɛ oyie ye anigye nu, nakoso bɔ bɔnefoɛ nye la so de, ɔyɛ mbaen.

english_verse: The Lord protects everyone who lives right, but he destroys anyone who does wrong.
translation_verse: AWURADE atee te anwoserɛ afealeɛ ma bɛ bɔ bɛ bra te sannwuu ɔ, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, bɛkɔ sɛkyelɛ nu.

english_verse: Good people will stand firm, but the wicked will disappear from the land.
translation_verse: Bengotu teneneeniɛ bengofi ye boso, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ɔngɔtena aseɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Honest people speak sensibly, but deceitful liars will be silenced.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ ye noa dwirɛ te nworɛ dwirɛ, nakoso temverema bɔ ɔlakalaka ne de, bɛkɔpɛ bɛkɔto.

english_verse: If you obey the Lord, you will always know the right thing to say. But no one will trust you if you tell lies.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ ye noa se edwirɛ bɔ bɛkã a ɔtɔ asoɛ nu ɔ, nakoso bɔnefoɛ noa de, ɔkã nnakannaka dwirɛ.

english_verse: The Lord hates anyone who cheats, but he likes everyone who is honest.
translation_verse: Tonyi bɔ bawura nu te AWURADE akyiwadeɛ, nakoso ye nye sɔ asusudeɛ nyɔboɛ bɔ ɔkã nahorɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Too much pride can put you to shame. It's wiser to be humble.
translation_verse: Anwomasoɛ ne animguaseɛ yeɛ bɛnate ɔ, nakoso anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ de, benwu nworɛ.

english_verse: If you do the right thing, honesty will be your guide. But if you are crooked, you will be trapped by your own dishonesty.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye bra te sannwuu ne, ye nahorɛlilɛ kyire ye atee, nakoso ngondombofoɛ bɛ nnakannaka fa bɛ kɔ ɛsɛkyelɛ nu.

english_verse: When God is angry, money won't help you. Obeying God is the only way to be saved from death.
translation_verse: Ɛyaafɛlɛ piri kyẽa ne dwu a, anwonya te mbaen, nakoso bra bɔ ɔtengyɛ de, ode sona fi ewue nu.

english_verse: If you are truly good, you will do right; if you are wicked, you will be destroyed by your own sin.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye bra te sannwuu ne, ye tenenee ma ye atee tengyɛ, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ye bɔbɔ ye bɔne yeɛ okotua ye kerɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Honesty can keep you safe, but if you can't be trusted, you trap yourself.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye bra te sannwuu ne, ye tenenee kɔpepɛ kole ye, nakoso ngondomboniɛ de, ye anyeboroborolɛ kakyi ngaen kye ye.

english_verse: When the wicked die, their hopes die with them.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɔnefoɛ wu a, ye anyelasoɛ ba ayieleɛ, na bɔ amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛ nye la so ne, ɔyɛ mbaen.

english_verse: Trouble goes right past the Lord's people and strikes the wicked.
translation_verse: Bede teneneeniɛ befi amaneɛ nu, na amaneɛ ne kakyi ba bɔnefoɛ so mmom.

english_verse: Dishonest people use gossip to destroy their neighbors; good people are protected by their own good sense.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛɛniɛ fa ye noa sɛkye obiɛngo, nakoso teneneeniɛ nimdeɛ yeɛ ɔpepɛ de ye ɔ.

english_verse: When honest people prosper and the wicked disappear, the whole city celebrates.
translation_verse: Sɛ oyie teneneeniɛ yé a, kuro ne di ahurusi, nakoso sɛ bɔnefoɛ wu de a, ye de bɛbɔ ese.

english_verse: Good people bring prosperity to their city, but deceitful liars can destroy a city.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛ bra te sannwuu ne, ɔnate bɛ saleɛ so yeɛ kuro nya ngɔsoɛ ɔ, nakoso bɔnefoɛ noa dwirɛ de, ɔma kuro bɔ.

english_verse: It's stupid to say bad things about your neighbors. If you are sensible, you will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ obu obiɛngo animtia ne, né adwene nne ye ti anu, nakoso sona bɔ ɔse nworɛ ne de, ɔndɛ ye noa nu.

english_verse: A city without wise leaders will end up in ruin; a city with many wise leaders will be kept safe.
translation_verse: Nekaa bɔ foɛtulɛ nne berɛ ne, maen ne bɔ; nakoso nekaa bɔ foɛtulɛfoɛ pee wɔ berɛ ne, anwotɔ wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: It's a dangerous thing to guarantee payment for someone's debts. Don't do it!
translation_verse: Sona bɔ odi agyinamuɛ ma ɛwɔfoɛ ne, okonu ye nwo, nakoso sona bɔ okyi agyinamuɛlilɛ ne, ye nwo sonn.

english_verse: A gracious woman will be respected, but a ruthless man will only get rich.
translation_verse: Brasua bɔ ye nyunu te ne, onya animnyam, yeɛ mmienzua bɔ bekuro adwuma ne, benya bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Kindness is rewarded— but if you are cruel, you hurt yourself.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔyɛ paa ne, ɔyɛ paa ma ye kra, nakoso atianuserɛniɛ de, ɔyɛ ye bɔbɔ ye nwo.

english_verse: Meanness gets you nowhere, but goodness is rewarded.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ anwonya te mbaen, nakoso sona bɔ odua tenenee de, onya nahorɛ akatuaa.

english_verse: Always do the right thing, and you will live; keep on doing wrong, and you will die.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye bra tengyɛ ne, onya ngoa, nakoso bɔ odi bɔne si ne de, onya ewue.

english_verse: The Lord hates sneaky people, but he likes everyone who lives right.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛte kanda ne, bɛte AWURADE akyiwadeɛ, nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛ bra te sannwuu ne de, bɛsɔ ye nye.

english_verse: You can be sure of this: All crooks will be punished, but God's people won't.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, bɔnefoɛ ngɔfa ye nwo ngoli tɔtorɔtɔɔ, nakoso teneneefoɛ de, bɛ bosofoɛ konya bɛ ti bekodidi nu.

english_verse: A beautiful woman who acts foolishly is like a gold ring on the snout of a pig.
translation_verse: Brasua anwonyemene bɔ ɔnze nworɛ ne, ɔte kyɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ kaa bɔ owura prako bonyi anu ɔ.

english_verse: Good people want what is best, but troublemakers hope to stir up trouble.
translation_verse: Bɔ teneneefoɛ bɛpena ne, oyie bɛ yé, nakoso bɔnefoɛ b’anyelasoɛ de, ɔkakyi bɛ so ɛyaafɛlɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes you can become rich by being generous or poor by being greedy.
translation_verse: Ebiemɔ bɛye bɛ kunu bɛyɔ paa paa, nakoso bɛkɔ so benya bɛ nwo, yeɛ ebiemɔ wora bɛfa bɛ nningyein bɛbɔ atianuserɛ, nakoso bɛkɔ so bedi hiaa.

english_verse: Generosity will be rewarded: Give a cup of water, and you will receive a cup of water in return.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔtaa kyɛ nikyee ne, okonya ye nwo, yeɛ sona bɔ ɔboka ebiemɔ maa bɛyɛ yee ne, ye koso ɔkɔyɛ yee.

english_verse: Charge too much for grain, and you will be cursed; sell it at a fair price, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔndɔne ye aburoo wɔ mmerɛ bɔ mmenia hia ne, mmenia paye ye, nakoso bɔ ɔtɔne ye deɛ ne de, onya saleɛ.

english_verse: Try hard to do right, and you will win friends; go looking for trouble, and you will find it.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie ɔpena paa si atee a, né ɔpena bɔ ɔsɔ anyeɛ ɔ, nakoso sɛ ebie di bɔne si a, bɔne to ye.

english_verse: Trust in your wealth, and you will be a failure, but God's people will prosper like healthy plants.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔfa ye wora wura ye anwonyadeɛ nu ne, ɔbɔ ase, nakoso teneneeniɛ de, ɔkɔyɛ frɔmfrɔm kyɛ nyaa monɛ.

english_verse: Fools who cause trouble in the family won't inherit a thing. They will end up as slaves of someone with good sense.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔha ye abusua ne, agyapadeɛ biala kɔbɔ ye, na kwaseaa kɔyɛ nworɛniɛ akoaa.

english_verse: Live right, and you will eat from the life-giving tree. And if you act wisely, others will follow.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ ye mma bɔ osu te ngoa bakaa, na sona bɔ ɔtwetwe akra ne, ɔte nworɛniɛ.

english_verse: If good people are rewarded here on this earth, all who are cruel and mean will surely be punished.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛbɔ teneneeniɛ aba so wɔ aseɛ ye aso a, ye de ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ amumuyɛɛniɛ ne bɔnefoɛ bengotua bɛ so kerɛ ɔ!

english_verse: To accept correction is wise, to reject it is stupid.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ okuro kyɛ bɛtengyɛtengyɛ ye ne, okuro nimdeɛ, nakoso bɔ okyi kyɛ bɛkɔhã ye nyunu ne de, wagyimi.

english_verse: The Lord likes everyone who lives right, but he punishes everyone who makes evil plans.
translation_verse: Sona paa sɔ AWURADE nye, nakoso sona bɔ ɔdwene adwene tɛɛ de, AWURADE bua ye fɔ.

english_verse: Sin cannot offer security! But if you live right, you will be as secure as a tree with deep roots.
translation_verse: Sona ngora mva bɔneyɔlɛ nu mma onyie ye yé, nakoso teneneeniɛ de, okotira ndii bɔ ye bo ngotutu ɔ.

english_verse: A helpful wife is a jewel for her husband, but a shameless wife will make his bones rot.
translation_verse: Braa paa ɔte ohu abotire, nakoso nyanzoen braa de, ɔte kyɛ kokoram wɔ ohu mmowue nu.

english_verse: Good people have kind thoughts, but you should never trust the advice of someone evil.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ ye ti anu adwene te paa, nakoso bɔnefoɛ foɛtulɛ de, ɔte nnakannaka.

english_verse: Bad advice is a deadly trap, but good advice is like a shield.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ noa dwirɛ, ɔtetɛ sona di ye awue, nakoso teneneeniɛ de, ye noa dwirɛ pepɛ de mmenia.

english_verse: Once the wicked are defeated, they are gone forever, but no one who obeys God will ever be thrown down.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ b’ayieleɛ yie bɛ, na bɛ boso mini, nakoso teneneeniɛ de, ye abusua kogyina.

english_verse: Good sense is worthy of praise, but stupidity is a curse.
translation_verse: Begyina sona ye nworɛ so yeɛ bɛkamvo ye ɔ, nakoso bɔ adwene nne ye ti anu de, bebu ye animtia.

english_verse: It's better to be ordinary and have only one servant than to think you are somebody and starve to death.
translation_verse: Ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔyɛ wɔ nwo awiɛmvoɛ, bɔ ele akoaa tra kyɛ ɛkɔmoma wɔ nwo so, nakoso wɔ noa aleɛ abɔ wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Good people are kind to their animals, but a mean person is cruel.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ ɔdwene ye nyɛmmoa nwo, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ye anwumvoinnwunɛ po ɔte atianuserɛ.

english_verse: Hard working farmers have more than enough food; daydreamers are nothing more than stupid fools.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔyɔ ye aseɛ so adwuma ne, odidi ma ye ko yi, nakoso bɔ odi nningyein mbaen mbaen si ne de, adwene nne ye ti anu.

english_verse: An evil person tries to hide behind evil; good people are like trees with deep roots.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛɛniɛ ye nye boro nningyein bɔ bɔnefoɛ benya ɔ, nakoso teneneeniɛ de, ye ndii tindim.

english_verse: We trap ourselves by telling lies, but we stay out of trouble by living right.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ noa dwirɛ tɛɛ osua ye bɔbɔ ye ngaen kye ye, nakoso teneneeniɛ de, onya ye ti didi nu fi amaneɛ nu.

english_verse: We are rewarded or punished for what we say and do.
translation_verse: Sona noa dwirɛ maa onya nikye paa bɔ ɔma ye kunu dwo ɔ, yeɛ sona nya ye sa noa adwuma nwo akatuaa.

english_verse: Fools think they know what is best, but a sensible person listens to advice.
translation_verse: Kwaseaa dwene kyɛ ye atee bɔ ɔnate so ɔ te paa, nakoso bɔ otie foɛtulɛ ne de, ɔte nworɛniɛ.

english_verse: Losing your temper is foolish; ignoring an insult is smart.
translation_verse: Kwaseaa fɛ yaa a, ye yaafɛlɛ ne da ali ndɛndɛ, nakoso badwemma de, ɛpepɛ ye nzoaa a, ɔndɛ wɔ so.

english_verse: An honest person tells the truth in court, but a dishonest person tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔkã nahorɛ ne, ɔda pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ali, nakoso bɔ odi adanzewia de, ɔpɛ ngondombo.

english_verse: Sharp words cut like a sword, but words of wisdom heal.
translation_verse: Edwudwolɛ fumfum kora pura sona kyɛ ngrandɛ, nakoso nworɛniɛ ye noa dwirɛ de, ɔsa anwonyerɛ.

english_verse: Truth will last forever; lies are soon found out.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ nahorɛ timu berɛ daa, nakoso ngondombo dwirɛ de, ɔngyɛ koraa.

english_verse: Good people never have trouble, but troublemakers have more than enough.
translation_verse: Musue biala ndo teneneeniɛ, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, wafa amaneɛ wasĩ.

english_verse: The Lord hates every liar, but he is the friend of all who can be trusted.
translation_verse: Noa bɔ ɔnga nahorɛ ne, ɔte AWURADE akyiwadeɛ, nakoso bɛ bɔ bedi nahorɛ de, bɛsɔ ye nye.

english_verse: Be sensible and don't tell everything you know— only fools spread foolishness everywhere.
translation_verse: Badwemma feafea ye nimdeɛ so, nakoso ngwaseafoɛ de, bɛbɔ egyiminɛ dawure.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will be a leader; be lazy, and you will end up a slave.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ okuro adwuma ne, odi mmenia so panyi, nakoso ɛfoen sona de, bɛmaa ɔyɔ kanganiɛ adwuma.

english_verse: Worry is a heavy burden, but a kind word always brings cheer.
translation_verse: Ahunundetelɛ ma sona di aworabɔlɛ yɛ bosaa, nakoso edwirɛ paa ma ye wora kyekye.

english_verse: You are better off to do right, than to lose your way by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ kyire ye mmango atee paa, nakoso bɔnefoɛ atee de, ɔmaa bemini.

english_verse: Anyone too lazy to cook will starve, but a hard worker is a valuable treasure.
translation_verse: Ɛfoen sona nnya eburo naen ngu ye, nakoso sona bɔ okuro adwuma de, onya nikyee bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se ɔ.

english_verse: Living right is a pathway that leads to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Tenenee bra ɔfa sona kɔ ngoa nu, nakoso mvomsoɛ atee de, ɔkɔ ewue nu.

english_verse: Children with good sense accept correction from their parents, but stubborn children ignore it completely.
translation_verse: Baa nworɛniɛ tie ye baba dwirɛ, nakoso ngorohoɛniɛ de, etwi ye nyunu a ogua ye so asi.

english_verse: You will be well rewarded for saying something kind, but all some people think about is how to be cruel and mean.
translation_verse: Sona paa noa dwirɛ maa onya nningyein paa, nakoso ngondomboniɛ de, basabasayɔlɛ te ye kra aleɛ.

english_verse: Keep what you know to yourself, and you will be safe; talk too much, and you are done for.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ondwudwo mbaen mbaen ne, ɔpena ye ti ngoa, nakoso bɔ ye noa te kurokuro ne de, onya amaneɛ.

english_verse: No matter how much you want, laziness won't help a bit, but hard work will reward you with more than enough.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɛfoen sona ɔpena biala, ongonya ye, nakoso sona bɔ okuro adwuma de, ye kra sa kã bɔ ɔpena ɔ.

english_verse: A good person hates deceit, but those who are evil cause shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ kyi ngondombo, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ɔbɔ nyanzoen ne animguaseɛ bra.

english_verse: Live right, and you are safe! But sin will destroy you.
translation_verse: Tenenee bra, okyire nahorɛlilɛniɛ atee, nakoso bɔne de, obu sa bɔnefoɛ.

english_verse: Some who have nothing may pretend to be rich, and some who have everything may pretend to be poor.
translation_verse: Ebie yɛ ye nwo kyɛ ye sa nu le bie, nakoso olle huu; yeɛ ebie koso yɛ ye nwo kyɛ wahia ye, nakoso wanya ye nwo tam.

english_verse: The rich may have to pay a ransom, but the poor don't have that problem.
translation_verse: Sona fa ye anwonyadeɛ otua ye ti nyɔboɛ ɔpepɛ de ye ngoa, nakoso ehianiɛ de, bɛ nyunu hwilɛ po ɔnde bie.

english_verse: The lamp of a good person keeps on shining; the lamp of an evil person soon goes out.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɛ kanea ta hyireinn, nakoso bɔnefoɛ kanea de, onua.

english_verse: Too much pride causes trouble. Be sensible and take advice.
translation_verse: Anwomasoɛ ne basabasayɔlɛ yeɛ bɛnate ɔ, nakoso bɛ bɔ betie foɛtulɛ ne de, nworɛ ne bɛ yeɛ bɛnate ɔ.

english_verse: Money wrongly gained will disappear bit by bit; money earned little by little will grow and grow.
translation_verse: Ambe atee paa so ambena anwonyadeɛ a, ofi wɔ sa, nakoso bɔ ɔfɛ onya ye ne de, onya pee.

english_verse: Not getting what you want can break your heart, but a wish that comes true is a life-giving tree.
translation_verse: Sɛ w’anyelasoɛ wɔ nikyee bie anwo ɔkyɛ a, ɔmaa ɛboto, nakoso bɔ wɔ nye la so ne ɔba nu a, ɔte ngoa bakaa.

english_verse: If you reject God's teaching, you will pay the price; if you obey his commands, you will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔmva foɛtulɛ nyɛ huu ne, ɔtwetwe amaneɛ brɛ ye nwo, nakoso bɔ odi mmeraa dwirɛ so ne de, okonya akatuaa wɔ so.

english_verse: Sensible instruction is a life-giving fountain that helps you escape all deadly traps.
translation_verse: Nworɛniɛ foɛtulɛ ɔte ngoa asue ti, na sona di so a ɔndɔ ewue ngaen nu.

english_verse: Sound judgment is praised, but people without good sense are on the way to disaster.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ole nimdeɛ paa ne, mmenia bɛdo ye, nakoso ngondomboniɛ atee fa ye kɔ amaneɛ nu.

english_verse: If you have good sense, you will act sensibly, but fools act like fools.
translation_verse: Badwemma fa adwene to bɔ ɔyɔ amukoraa nwo, nakoso kwaseaa de, ɔda ye gyiminɛ ali.

english_verse: Whoever delivers your message can make things better or worse for you.
translation_verse: Somafoɛ tɛɛ twetwe amaneɛ ba, nakoso ɛbɔfoɛ nahorɛniɛ de, ɔma mmenia nwo sande bɛ.

english_verse: All who refuse correction will be poor and disgraced; all who accept correction will be praised.
translation_verse: Betu wɔ foɛ ná endie a, ehiaa ne animguaseɛ kã wɔ, nakoso sɛ ede wɔ nyunu hwilɛ to nu a, enya animnyam.

english_verse: It's a good feeling to get what you want, but only a stupid fool hates to turn from evil.
translation_verse: Sɛ wɔ sa kã bɔ ɛpena a, ɔyɛ wɔ kra fɛ, na ɔte ngwaseafoɛ akyiwadeɛ kyɛ bɛkɔhwe bɛ nwo bekofi bɔne nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Wise friends make you wise, but you hurt yourself by going around with fools.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛne nworɛniɛ nate a, enwu nworɛ, nakoso sɛ ɛne ngwaseafoɛ bɛbɔ afɛ a, edwirɛ to wɔ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you sin, but you will be rewarded if you live right.
translation_verse: Musue foa bɔnefoɛ, nakoso teneneefoɛ de, saleɛ te b’akatuaa.

english_verse: If you obey God, you will have something to leave your grandchildren. If you don't obey God, those who live right will get what you leave.
translation_verse: Sona paa yakyi ye nnomaa agyapadeɛ, nakoso bɔnefoɛ anwonyadeɛ de, okooli teneneefoɛ sa nu.

english_verse: Even when the land of the poor produces good crops, they get cheated out of what they grow.
translation_verse: Ehianiɛ boo nu aleɛ ba pee, nakoso bedi ye aminɛ bede befi ye sa nu.

english_verse: If you love your children, you will correct them; if you don't love them, you won't correct them.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔmva mbire ndea ɔwa ne, né ɔpɔ ɔwa ne, nakoso sɛ ekuro ye dwirɛ a, ɛhyɛ ye bo tea ye ndɛ.

english_verse: If you live right, you will have plenty to eat; if you don't live right, you will go away empty.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ didi ma ye kra ko yi, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ye kunu too.

english_verse: A woman's family is held together by her wisdom, but it can be destroyed by her foolishness.
translation_verse: Brasua nworɛniɛ osi ye sua, nakoso brasua kwaseaa de, ɔfa ye sa dwiri ye gua.

english_verse: By living right, you show that you respect the Lord; by being deceitful, you show that you despise him.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔnate nahorɛlilɛ atee so ne, osuro AWURADE, nakoso bɔ ɔnate atee tɛɛ so ne de, obu ye animtia.

english_verse: Proud fools are punished for their stupid talk, but sensible talk can save your life.
translation_verse: Kwaseaa noa dwirɛ te mbire bɔ ɔfa hoahoa ye nwo ɔ, nakoso nworɛfoɛ noa dwirɛ pepɛ de bɛ.

english_verse: Without the help of an ox there can be no crop, but with a strong ox a big crop is possible.
translation_verse: Nekaa bɔ nandwie nyii nne berɛ ne, aleɛ nne berɛ, na nandwie nyii anwoserɛ yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnya fieso aleɛ pee ɔ.

english_verse: An honest witness tells the truth; a dishonest witness tells nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Danzeniɛ nahorɛniɛ mbɛ anoanu, nakoso danzeniɛ ngondomboniɛ de, odi adanzewia.

english_verse: Make fun of wisdom, and you will never find it. But if you have understanding, knowledge comes easily.
translation_verse: Ngorohoɛniɛ pena nworɛ, na onnwu ye, nakoso sona bɔ ye adwene nu pi de, nimdeɛ nyanɛ nyɛ se mma ye.

english_verse: Stay away from fools, or you won't learn a thing.
translation_verse: Twe wɔ nwo fi kwaseaa nwo, ofikyɛ ɛngɔte nimdeɛ dwirɛ ngofi ye noa.

english_verse: Wise people have enough sense to find their way, but stupid fools get lost.
translation_verse: Badwemma ye nworɛ ne, ɔmaa ɔdwene bɔ ɔyɔ ɔ nwo, nakoso ngwaseafoɛ bɛ gyiminɛ te nnakannaka.

english_verse: Fools don't care if they are wrong, but God is pleased when people do right.
translation_verse: Ngwaseafoɛ goro foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ nwo, nakoso teneneefoɛ de, Nyameɛ do bɛ.

english_verse: The tent of a good person stands longer than the house of someone evil.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ mɔ, b’awuro kɔbɔ, nakoso teneneefoɛ de, bɛ tena sua kogyina.

english_verse: You may think you are on the right road and still end up dead.
translation_verse: Atee bie wɔ berɛ a, ɔte paa wɔ kuro sona nye so, nakoso ye ayieleɛ te ewue atee.

english_verse: Sorrow may hide behind laughter, and happiness may end in sorrow.
translation_verse: Aserekyekye nu ne po, aworabɔlɛ wɔ berɛ, na anigye ayieleɛ oyie aworabɔlɛ.

english_verse: You harvest what you plant, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛɛniɛ ye bɔbɔ ye yɔleɛ obu sa ye, yeɛ sona paa wora onya bɔ ɔyɔ ɔ nwo akatuaa.

english_verse: Don't be stupid and believe all you hear; be smart and know where you are headed.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye adwene te kãa ne, ode edwirɛ biala di, nakoso badwemma de, ɔdwene ye agyirɛtulɛ nwo yé.

english_verse: Only a stupid fool is never cautious— so be extra careful and stay out of trouble.
translation_verse: Nworɛniɛ suro, na ɔtwe ye nwo fi bɔne nwo, nakoso kwaseaa de, ɔyɛ dwirɛ a ɔndwene ye nwo.

english_verse: Fools have quick tempers, and no one likes you if you can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye ahone pingye ye ne, ɔyɔ ye nningyein ngwaseaa nu, yeɛ kanda sona koso, mmenia kyi ye.

english_verse: Stupidity leads to foolishness; be smart and learn.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ b’adwene te nganga ne, egyiminɛ te bɛ kyɛfa, nakoso badwemma de, nimdeɛ te b’abotire.

english_verse: The wicked will come crawling to those who obey God.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ bɛkoto mmeni paa, yeɛ amumuyɛɛfoɛ kɔkoto wɔ teneneefoɛ b’anoa nu.

english_verse: You have no friends if you are poor, but you have lots of friends if you are rich.
translation_verse: Ehianiɛ mmango mɔ po bekyi ye, nakoso sikaniɛ de, ye damvo mɔ bɛsone pee.

english_verse: It's wrong to hate others, but God blesses everyone who is kind to the poor.
translation_verse: Bɔ obu ye mmango animtia ne, ɔte bɔne, nakoso bɔ ɔdo sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ne, onya saleɛ.

english_verse: It's a mistake to make evil plans, but you will have loyal friends if you want to do right.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ porɛ tɛɛ ne, aso bɛnyɔ mvomsoɛ anaa? Na bɛ bɔ bɛdwene adwene paa ne, benya pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ne nahorɛlilɛ.

english_verse: Hard work is worthwhile, but empty talk will make you poor.
translation_verse: Adwumayɔlɛ serɛ ma mvasoɛ, nakoso bɛ noa dwirɛ mbaen de, ɔne ehiaa yeɛ bɛnate ɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom can make you rich, but foolishness leads to more foolishness.
translation_verse: Anwonya te nworɛfoɛ b’abotire, na ngwaseafoɛ de, egyiminɛ ala yeɛ bagyimi ɔ.

english_verse: An honest witness can save your life, but liars can't be trusted.
translation_verse: Danzeniɛ nahorɛniɛ ode sona ngoa, nakoso danzeniɛ ngondomboniɛ de, ɔye sona ma.

english_verse: If you respect the Lord, you and your children have a strong fortress
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ besuro AWURADE ne, bɛ wora wura ye nu pindinn, na ɔbɔ bɛ mma nwo waen.

english_verse: and a life-giving fountain that keeps you safe from deadly traps.
translation_verse: AWURADE surolɛ te ngoa asue ti, na sona di so a ɔndɔ ewue ngaen nu.

english_verse: Rulers of powerful nations are held in honor; rulers of weak nations are nothing at all.
translation_verse: Ɛhene bɔ ole mmenia pee ne, bɛte ye animnyam, nakoso ɛhene bɔ olle mmenia ne, ye tumi kɔ ase.

english_verse: It's smart to be patient, but it's stupid to lose your temper.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye ahone nhu ndɛ ne, ole ndeaseɛ paa, nakoso bɔ ye ahone pingye ye ne de, odi ngwaseasɛm.

english_verse: It's healthy to be content, but envy can eat you up.
translation_verse: Wɔ so anu tɔ wɔ a, enya anwoɔnaen nu anwoserɛ, nakoso ahoɔyea de, ɔte mmowue nu kokoram.

english_verse: If you mistreat the poor, you insult your Creator; if you are kind to them, you show him respect.
translation_verse: Ɛhyɛ sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo so a, né agua ye Nyameɛ bɔ ɔbɔle ye ne nyunu ase, na ebiala bɔ onwu ehianiɛ anwumvo ne, ɔhyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam.

english_verse: In times of trouble the wicked are destroyed, but even at death the innocent have faith.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ ye bɔne yeɛ ɔbrɛ ye ase ɔ, nakoso teneneeniɛ de, ole anyelasoɛ wɔ ye wue nu.

english_verse: Wisdom is found in the minds of people with good sense, but fools don't know it.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ole ndeaseɛ ne, nworɛ wɔ ye ti anu, nakoso bɔ ɔwɔ ngwaseafoɛ nu de, ɔda ali pefee.

english_verse: Doing right brings honor to a nation, but sin brings disgrace.
translation_verse: Tenenee ma maen nya ngɔsoɛ, nakoso bɔne de, ogua maen biala nyunu ase.

english_verse: Kings reward servants who act wisely, but they punish those who act foolishly.
translation_verse: Akoaa bɔ ɔse nworɛ ne, ɛhene ne kɔlo ye, nakoso ɔfɛ bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ nyanzoen bra so yaa.

english_verse: A kind answer soothes angry feelings, but harsh words stir them up.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ wɔ noa bɛtɛɛ ɛma mmuayɛɛ a, ɔma ahone tɔ nzue nu, nakoso edwudwo fumfum a, ye de ɔma ahone hu.

english_verse: Words of wisdom come from the wise, but fools speak foolishness.
translation_verse: Nworɛfoɛ noa dwirɛ ma nimdeɛ yɛ nyemene, nakoso ngwaseafoɛ noa kekã ngwaseasɛm.

english_verse: The Lord sees everything, whether good or bad.
translation_verse: AWURADE nye wɔ nekaa biala, na ɔnea bɔnefoɛ ne mmeni paa.

english_verse: Kind words are good medicine, but deceitful words can really hurt.
translation_verse: Ɛyɛ wɔ noa bɛtɛɛ a, ɔte ngoa bakaa, nakoso ngondombo dwirɛ de, oku sunzum.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and disobey your parents. Be smart! Accept correction.
translation_verse: Kwaseaa mva ye baba foɛtulɛ nyɛ huu, nakoso sona bɔ betwi ye nyunu a otie ne, ɔte badwemma.

english_verse: Good people become wealthy, but those who are evil will lose what they have.
translation_verse: Anwonya pee wɔ teneneeniɛ awuro, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ye anwonya te musue.

english_verse: Words of wisdom make good sense; the thoughts of a fool make no sense at all.
translation_verse: Nworɛfoɛ noa dwirɛ ma nimdeɛ trɛ, nakoso ngwaseafoɛ b’adwene de, ɔtte sɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted by gifts from the wicked, but it makes him happy when his people pray.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ afɔleɛ te AWURADE akyiwadeɛ, nakoso teneneefoɛ mbaeɛ de, ɔte ye nikyee bɔ ye nye gye ye nwo ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is disgusted with all who do wrong, but he loves everyone who does right.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ mɔ atee te AWURADE akyiwadeɛ, nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛfa tenenee besie bɛ nye so de, okuro bɛ dwirɛ.

english_verse: If you turn from the right way, you will be punished; if you refuse correction, you will die.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ odi atee ne anwo makyebu ne, asohwenɛ piri la berɛ ma ye, yeɛ bɔ okyi bɛ nyunu hanɛ ne wora, okowu.

english_verse: If the Lord can see everything in the world of the dead, he can see in our hearts.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛborɔ ne Abadɔn po bɛla berɛ too wɔ AWURADE nyunu a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ kuro sona ti anu adwene kɔfea ye ɔ!

english_verse: Those who sneer at others don't like to be corrected, and they won't ask help from someone with sense.
translation_verse: Ngorohoɛniɛ nguro kyɛ bɛkɔhã ye nyunu ɔ, yiti ɔngɔ nworɛfoɛ berɛ.

english_verse: Anyone with good sense is eager to learn more, but fools are hungry for foolishness.
translation_verse: Badwemma adwene pena nimdeɛ si atee, nakoso ngwaseafoɛ de, ngwaseasɛm te bɛ noa aleɛ.

english_verse: The poor have a hard life, but being content is as good as an endless feast.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ onwu amaneɛ ne, kyẽa biala ɔtte mayee mma ye, nakoso bɔ ye nye agye de, mmerɛ biala te ɛpoentolɛ ma ye.

english_verse: It's better to obey the Lord and have only a little, than to be very rich and terribly anxious.
translation_verse: Kyɛ ekosuro AWURADE ná ekonya nikyee kaaba ne, ɔte paa tra anwonyadeɛ pee bɔ amaneɛ boka so ɔ.

english_verse: A simple meal with love is better than a feast where there is hatred.
translation_verse: Sɛ edi mburuhu wɔ ɔdɔ nu a, ɔte paa tra kyɛ ekoli nandwie nyii bɔ walɔ ɔ wɔ ɛpɔen nu ɔ.

english_verse: Losing your temper causes a lot of trouble, but staying calm settles arguments.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye ahone pingye ye ne, ye nwo te ngondii, nakoso bɔ ye ahone nhu ndɛ ne de, ɔma mmenia ahone tɔ nzue nu.

english_verse: A lazy person refuses to clear a thorny path, but everyone who does right walks on a smooth road.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔte foen ne, ye atee te mmowue mmowue, nakoso teneneeniɛ de, ye atee te atimbire.

english_verse: Children with good sense make their parents happy, but foolish children despise them.
translation_verse: Baa nworɛniɛ ma ye baba nya anika, na sona kwaseaa de, obu ye maame animtia.

english_verse: Stupidity brings happiness to senseless fools, but everyone with good sense follows the straight path.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ nworɛ nne ye ti anu ne, ngwaseasɛm yɛ ye fɛ, nakoso badwemma de, ɔyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Without good advice everything goes wrong— it takes careful planning for things to go right.
translation_verse: Ɛkwati foɛtulɛ ɛfa adwene a, ɔte mbaen, nakoso sɛ ɛfa foɛtulɛfoɛ pee b’adwene a, ogyina.

english_verse: All who are wise follow a road that leads upward to life and away from death.
translation_verse: Ngoa atee bɔ ɔkɔ anwuro yeɛ nworɛniɛ fa so ɔ, amaa ɔnate so wangɔ ɛborɔ wɔ aseɛ bo dɔ.

english_verse: The Lord destroys the homes of those who are proud, but he protects the property of widows.
translation_verse: AWURADE dwiri anwomasoɛfoɛ b’awuro gua, nakoso ɔbɔ akunafoɛ mmrasua bɛ wɛen nwo waen.

english_verse: The Lord hates evil thoughts, but kind words please him.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ bɛ porɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ne, ɔte AWURADE akyiwadeɛ, nakoso anwoteefoɛ de, bɛ dwirɛ nwo te.

english_verse: Being greedy causes trouble for your family, but you protect yourself by refusing bribes.
translation_verse: Sɛ sona nya ye nwo fi aminɛlilɛ nu a, ɔtwetwe amaneɛ brɛ ye abusua, nakoso sona bɔ okyi fea-ase-ma de, okonya ngoa.

english_verse: Good people think before they answer, but the wicked speak evil without ever thinking.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ dwene dwirɛ nwo koraka né wama mmuayɛɛ, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ye noa kekã musue dwirɛ.

english_verse: The Lord never even hears the prayers of the wicked, but he answers the prayers of all who obey him.
translation_verse: AWURADE ne bɔnefoɛ b’afia atee wale, nakoso teneneefoɛ de, otie bɛ mbaeɛ.

english_verse: A friendly smile makes you happy, and good news makes you feel strong.
translation_verse: Wɔ nyunu yɛ ɛsereserelɛ a, ɔma wɔ nye gye, yeɛ ndɛenvɛen maa sona aporɛ nu yɛ se.

english_verse: Healthy correction is good, and if you accept it, you will be wise.
translation_verse: Asoɛ bɔ otie anyunuhanɛ bɔ ɔma ngoa ne, ɔne nworɛfoɛ yeɛ bɛtena ɔ.

english_verse: You hurt only yourself by rejecting instruction, but it makes good sense to accept it.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔpo foɛtulɛ ne, obu ye bɔbɔ ye kra animtia, na bɔ otie anyunuhanɛ ne de, ɔyɛ badwemma.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord will make you wise, and being humble will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: AWURADE surolɛ te nworɛ bɔ ɔtengyɛtengyɛ sona ɔ, na anwobrɛaseɛ ne animnyam yeɛ bɛnate ɔ.

english_verse: We humans make plans, but the Lord has the final word.
translation_verse: Kuro sona yɛ nhyehyɛleɛ wɔ ye ti anu, nakoso temverema ye mmuayɛɛ ofi AWURADE berɛ.

english_verse: We may think we know what is right, but the Lord is the judge of our motives.
translation_verse: Kuro sona bra amukoraa tengyɛ wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye nye so, nakoso AWURADE yeɛ ɔkari sona ti anu dwirɛ nea ɔ.

english_verse: Share your plans with the Lord, and you will succeed.
translation_verse: Fa w’adwuma wura AWURADE sa, na wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ koli mu.

english_verse: The Lord has a reason for everything he does, and he lets evil people live only to be punished.
translation_verse: AWURADE le botaeɛ bɔ yiti yeɛ wayɔ nikyee biala ɔ, bɔnefoɛ mɔ po, amaneɛnwunɛ kyẽa ne la berɛ ma bɛ.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like anyone who is conceited— you can be sure they will be punished.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔte ahandaen ne, AWURADE kyi ye, nahorɛ nu, ɔngɔfa ye nwo ngoli tɔtorɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: If we truly love God, our sins will be forgiven; if we show him respect, we will keep away from sin.
translation_verse: Bɛfa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ne nahorɛlilɛ yeɛ bɛyɛ bɔne nwo mbata ɔ, na AWURADE surolɛ yeɛ ɔma sona twe ye nwo fi bɔne nwo ɔ.

english_verse: When we please the Lord, even our enemies make friends with us.
translation_verse: Sɛ sona atee ɔsɔ AWURADE nye a, ɔma ye pɔfoɛ mɔ po bɛ ne ye tena asomdwee nu.

english_verse: It's better to be honest and poor than to be dishonest and rich.
translation_verse: Ɛpe atee paa so enya nikyee kaaba bie a, ɔte paa tra kyɛ ekoli aminɛ ekonya wɔ nwo tam ɔ.

english_verse: We make our own plans, but the Lord decides where we will go.
translation_verse: Sona fa ye adwene susu bɔ ɔkɔyɔ ɔ nwo, nakoso AWURADE yeɛ okyire ye atee ɔ.

english_verse: Rulers speak with authority and are never wrong.
translation_verse: Ɛhene noa dwirɛ te ngɔmhyɛlɛ, na ye ndɛenbualɛ nu, ye noa nyɛ mvomsoɛ.

english_verse: The Lord watches to see if we are fair or if we cheat others.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ asusudeɛ ne nahorɛ tonyi te AWURADE deɛ, yeɛ kariboɔ amukoraa bɔ ɔwɔ kotoku ne anu ne, ɔte ye sa noa adwuma.

english_verse: An angry ruler can put you to death. So be wise! Don't make one angry.
translation_verse: Ɛhene ahonehulɛ te ewue bɔfoɛ, nakoso nworɛniɛ ma ahone ne tɔ nzue nu.

english_verse: When a ruler is happy and pleased with you, it's like refreshing rain, and you will live.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛhene nyunu yɛ sereserelɛ a, ɔte ngoa, yeɛ sɛ ɔdo wɔ a, ɔte kyɛ munungum bɔ ɔtɔ bamborɔ ɔ.

english_verse: It's much better to be wise and sensible than to be rich.
translation_verse: Ɛse nworɛ a, kyɛbɔ osi te paa tra sikaa kɔkorɛ ɔ! Yeɛ sɛ ɛte badwemma a, ɔte paa tra kyɛ ekonya ɛdwetɛ ɔ.

english_verse: God's people avoid evil ways, and they protect themselves by watching where they go.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ atimbire ɔmmakye ngɔ bɔne nu, yiti ebiala bɔ ɔnea ye agyirɛtulɛ nu yé ne, onya ngoa.

english_verse: You are better off to be humble and poor than to get rich from what you take by force.
translation_verse: Ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔbrɛ wɔ nwo ase ɛkɔboka bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ so, tra kyɛ ɛne anwomasoɛfoɛ bɛkɔhyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If you know what you're doing, you will prosper. God blesses everyone who trusts him.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔdwene edwirɛ nwo yé ne, oyie ye yé, yeɛ bɔ ɔfa ye wora wura AWURADE nu ne, onya saleɛ.

english_verse: Good judgment proves that you are wise, and if you speak kindly, you can teach others.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔyɔ ye nningyein nworɛ nu ne, bɛfrɛ ye badwemma, yeɛ sɛ sona noa dwirɛ yɛ fɛ a, ɔma mmenia nya nikyeesualɛ nu ngɔsoɛ.

english_verse: Good sense is a fountain that gives life, but fools are punished by their foolishness.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ole nimdeɛ ne, ɔte ngoa asue ti ma ye, na ngwaseafoɛ de, bɛ gyiminɛ yeɛ ɔtwe bɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: You can persuade others if you are wise and speak sensibly.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔse nworɛ ne, odwudwo nworɛ nu, na ɔnate so ma ye noa nya nikyeesualɛ nu ngɔsoɛ.

english_verse: Kind words are like honey— they cheer you up and make you feel strong.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ bɔ ɔyɛ fɛ ne, ɔte kyɛ woɛ bɔ ɔwɔ nzasameɛ nu ɔ, ɔte menemene ma sona kra, na ɔma aporɛnuserɛ.

english_verse: Sometimes what seems right is really a road to death.
translation_verse: Atee bie wɔ berɛ a, ɔte paa wɔ kuro sona nye so, nakoso ye ayieleɛ te ewue atee.

english_verse: The hungrier you are, the harder you work.
translation_verse: Bɔ adwumayɔlɛniɛ ɔpena ne ati, ɔmaa ɔyɔ adwuma, bɔ okoli ɔ yeɛ opiapia ye ɔ.

english_verse: Worthless people plan trouble. Even their words burn like a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Busueniɛ bɔ porɛ tɛɛ, na ye noa dwirɛ te kyɛ see bɔ ogye ɔ.

english_verse: Gossip is no good! It causes hard feelings and comes between friends.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ adwene paa nne ye ti anu ne, ɔma ngondii tɔ mmenia b’afia, na nzekurebɔlɛniɛ tete abiɛngoɛ mɔ b’afia.

english_verse: Don't trust violent people. They will mislead you to do the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Nzɛmmɔneniɛ sisi obiɛngo, odiedie ye maa ɔfa atee tɛɛ so;

english_verse: When someone winks or grins behind your back, trouble is on the way.
translation_verse: ɔbɔ ye nye kyire ɔfa dwene adwene tɛɛ, yeɛ ɔbesebese ye noa ɔbɔ porɛ tɛɛ.

english_verse: Gray hair is a glorious crown worn by those who have lived right.
translation_verse: Egyein te animnyam abotire, sɛ ɔba kyɛ enya ye wɔ tenenee bra nu a.

english_verse: We make our own decisions, but the Lord alone determines what happens.
translation_verse: Mmenia gua serewa de, nakoso nu ngyerɛmuɛ ne amukoraa ofi AWURADE.

english_verse: A dry crust of bread eaten in peace and quiet is better than a feast eaten where everyone argues.
translation_verse: Edi nzammoa bɔ wawo ná wɔ so anu tɔ wɔ a, ɔte paa tra awuro bɔ afɔleɛbɔlɛ ngome, nakoso nu te ngondii ɔ.

english_verse: A wise slave will be placed in charge of a no-good child, and that slave will be given the same inheritance that each child receives.
translation_verse: Kanganiɛ bɔ ɔse nworɛ ne, okoli baa bɔ ɔbɔ nyanzoen bra so tumi, na okonya aliɛmaa nemɔ b’agyapadeɛ ne bie.

english_verse: Silver and gold are tested by flames of fire; our thoughts are tested by the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛfa bokyea bɛpɔ ɛdwetɛ nwo, yeɛ bɛfa afaa bɛpɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ nwo, nakoso AWURADE yeɛ oso adwene nea ɔ.

english_verse: Troublemakers listen to troublemakers, and liars listen to liars.
translation_verse: Nzɛmmɔneniɛ tie nnakannakafoɛ bɛ noa dwirɛ, yeɛ ngondomboniɛ koso tie sona bɔ ɔte kanda ɔ dwirɛ.

english_verse: By insulting the poor, you insult your Creator. You will be punished if you make fun of someone in trouble.
translation_verse: Ɛgoro sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo nwo a, né agua ye Nyameɛ bɔ ɔbɔle ye ne nyunu ase, yeɛ sona bɔ edwirɛ to obiɛngo a ɔyɛ ye fɛ ne, ɔngɔfa ye nwo ngoli tɔtorɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: Grandparents are proud of their grandchildren, and children should be proud of their parents.
translation_verse: Nnomaa te nworowaa b’abotire, yeɛ mmaa b’animnyam ole bɛ baba.

english_verse: It sounds strange for a fool to talk sensibly, but it's even worse for a ruler to tell lies.
translation_verse: Kwaseaa nze edwirɛ bɔ bɛkã ye kama ɔ, yeɛ nnakannaka dwirɛ hanɛ koso mvata dehyeɛ.

english_verse: You will keep your friends if you forgive them, but you will lose your friends if you keep talking about what they did wrong.
translation_verse: Sona fa mvomsoɛ kyɛ a, né ɔpena koyɛlɛ, nakoso bɔ ɔsɔ dwirɛ nu a ɔnyakyi ne de, ɔtete abiɛngoɛ nu.

english_verse: A sensible person accepts correction, but you can't beat sense into a fool.
translation_verse: Sɛ etwi badwemma nyunu a, ɔkɔ ye nu tra kyɛ ekofi kwaseaa mbire ɛyaa ɔ.

english_verse: Cruel people want to rebel, and so vicious attackers will be sent against them.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ mbena hwee te kyɛ ɛlɔenyɛlɛ, yiti bɛkɔsoma ɛbɔfoɛ atianuserɛniɛ maa ɔkɔhɔ ye so.

english_verse: A bear robbed of her cubs is far less dangerous than a stubborn fool.
translation_verse: Ɔte paa kyɛ ɛne kwabrafo bɔ bahye ye mma ɔ bɛkɔbɔ numbunumbu tra kyɛ ɛne kwaseaa bɔ ye gyiminɛ awa ɔ kɔbɔ numbunumbu ɔ.

english_verse: You will always have trouble if you are mean to those who are good to you.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔfa bɔne tua paa so ne, bɔne ngɔpa ye awuro le.

english_verse: The start of an argument is like a water leak— so stop it before real trouble breaks out.
translation_verse: Ngondii bohyɛlɛ te kyɛ asue bɔ batikye ye ɔ, yiti anzana ɔkɔkakyi ngondii bɔ nu yɛ se nen, pɛ so.

english_verse: The Lord doesn't like those who defend the guilty or condemn the innocent.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ obua bɔnefoɛ be, ɔne ebiala bɔ obua teneneeniɛ fɔ ne, AWURADE kyi bɛ munyɔ kɔkɔkɔkɔ.

english_verse: Why should fools have money for an education when they refuse to learn?
translation_verse: Mvasoɛ beni yeɛ ɔwɔ so kyɛ kwaseaa kotua sikaa kɔtɔ nworɛ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ onnya ɔyyɛle ye adwene kyɛ okosua nworɛ ɔ?

english_verse: A friend is there to help, in any situation, and relatives are born to share our troubles.
translation_verse: Adamvoa kuro wɔ dwirɛ mmerɛ biala, yeɛ w’amaneɛnwunɛ nu ti yeɛ bɛwole eliɛma ɔ.

english_verse: The wicked and the proud love trouble and keep begging to be hurt.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ okuro ngondii ne, okuro mmeraatolɛ, yeɛ sona bɔ ɔfa anwomasoɛ anoa otua ye awuro noa ne, ɔtwetwe amaneɛ brɛ ye nwo.

english_verse: Dishonesty does you no good, and telling lies will get you in trouble.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔte kanda ne, onyie ye yé, yeɛ nnakannaka sona wora musue to ye.

english_verse: It's never pleasant to be the parent of a fool and have nothing but pain.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔwo kwaseaa ne, odi aworabɔlɛ, na baa bɔ wagyimi wora, ye baba nye ngye.

english_verse: If you are cheerful, you feel good; if you are sad, you hurt all over.
translation_verse: Sona nye gye a, ɔte ayire paa, nakoso aworabɔlɛ de, ɔkweekwee mmowue nu.

english_verse: Crooks accept secret bribes to keep justice from being done.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ ɔfea ye nwo ode fea-ase-ma, kyɛ ogyina so obua ndɛengyea.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom knows what makes good sense, but fools can never make up their minds.
translation_verse: Badwemma sona fa nworɛ sie ye nye so, nakoso kwaseaa de, ye adwene la nekaa bie dededede.

english_verse: Foolish children bring sorrow and pain to their parents.
translation_verse: Baa bienzua kwaseaa ma ye baba di aworabɔlɛ, na ɔma ye maame bɔ ɔwole ye ne teetee.

english_verse: It isn't fair to punish the innocent and those who do right.
translation_verse: Ɔtte mayee kyɛ bɛkɔbɔ sona bɔ odi be ɔ kerɛ, yeɛ onni kyɛ sona titire ye nahorɛlilɛ ti bɛbo ye ɔ.

english_verse: It makes a lot of sense to be a person of few words and to stay calm.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ole nimdeɛ ne, ondwudwo pee, yeɛ sona bɔ ole aboterɛ ne, ɔte badwemma.

english_verse: It's selfish and stupid to think only of yourself and to sneer at people who have sense.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔpena ye ngome ye yeeyɛlɛ ne, ɔpena ye ngome ye deɛ, na onne nzusuleɛ paa biala ndo nu.

english_verse: Fools have no desire to learn, instead they would rather give their own opinion.
translation_verse: Kwaseaa nye ngye kyɛ okonya nimdeɛ ɔ, na mmom bɔ ɔwɔ ye adwene nu angome yeɛ ɔkã ɔ.

english_verse: Words of wisdom are a stream that flows from a deep fountain.
translation_verse: Sona noa dwirɛ te kyɛ asue buma, yeɛ nworɛ dwirɛ te kyɛ asue bɔ ɔsẽ ɔ.

english_verse: It's wrong to favor the guilty and keep the innocent from getting justice.
translation_verse: Ɔtte mayee kyɛ ɛkɔma bɔnefoɛ koli be, ná ekobua teneneeniɛ ndɛengyea ɔ.

english_verse: Foolish talk will get you into a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Kwaseaa dwudwolɛ ma ngondii ba, yeɛ ye noa dwirɛ frɛfrɛ ɛbolɛ.

english_verse: Saying foolish things is like setting a trap to destroy yourself.
translation_verse: Kwaseaa ye dwudwolɛ fa ye kɔ amaneɛ nu, na ye noa dwirɛ sua ye kra ngaen.

english_verse: There's nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Nzekurebɔlɛniɛ ye noa dwirɛ te menemene, na edwirɛ ne woroworo wɔ.

english_verse: Being lazy is no different from being a troublemaker.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔte foen wɔ ye adwuma nwo ne, oliɛma ole sona bɔ ɔsɛkye nningyein ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is a mighty tower where his people can run for safety—
translation_verse: AWURADE dumaa ne te abandenden pindinn, nu yeɛ teneneeniɛ nwati kɔbɔ ye nwo waen maa onya ye ti didi nu ɔ.

english_verse: the rich think their money is a wall of protection.
translation_verse: Sikaniɛ anwonya yeɛ ɔte ye kuro bɔ wato ye nwo fasue ɔ, osusu kyɛ ɔte fasue tendenn.

english_verse: Pride leads to destruction; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Anwomasoɛ mma onyie sona yé, na anwobrɛaseɛ ne animnyam yeɛ bɛnate ɔ.

english_verse: It's stupid and embarrassing to give an answer before you listen.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ondie edwirɛ nyie koraka né wabua ye nwo bie ne, ɔmaa ɔyɛ kwaseaa, na ogua ye nyunu ase.

english_verse: Being cheerful helps when you are sick, but nothing helps when you give up.
translation_verse: Sona nde apɔ a, ye sunzum maa ogyina anwonyerɛ ne noa, nakoso sunzum bɔ ye wora abɔ de, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina sɔ tebea ne noa ɔ?

english_verse: Everyone with good sense wants to learn.
translation_verse: Sona badwemma osua nimdeɛ, yeɛ nworɛfoɛ bɛ so pena nimdeɛ.

english_verse: A gift will get you in to see anyone.
translation_verse: Sona akyɛdeɛ bukye atee ma ye, na ɔmaa onya atee kɔ mmeni titire nyunu.

english_verse: You may think you have won your case in court, until your opponent speaks.
translation_verse: Sona di moa bɔ ye nguro a, ɛnwanzɛ odi be kɔpem kyɛ bɔ ɔne ye bɛbɔ nguro ne kobisabisa ye dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Drawing straws is one way to settle a difficult case.
translation_verse: Serewagualɛ ma aporowaa so pɛ, na obua tumifoɛ mɔ b’afia ndɛen.

english_verse: Make your words good— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Sona noa dwirɛ ma ye ko yi, ye noa dwirɛ ma ye nwo tɔ ye.

english_verse: Words can bring death or life! Talk too much, and you will eat everything you say.
translation_verse: Sona noa dwirɛ maa onya ewue anaa ngoa, na bɔ okuro edwudwolɛ ne, onya ye nwo amaneɛ.

english_verse: A man's greatest treasure is his wife— she is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Bienzua bɔ okonya yeɛ ne, wanya nikye paa, na AWURADE alo ye.

english_verse: The poor must beg for help, but the rich can give a harsh reply.
translation_verse: Ehianiɛ noa dwirɛ te kyerɛpalɛ, nakoso sikaniɛ de, ɔma mmuayɛɛ fumfum.

english_verse: Some friends don't help, but a true friend is closer than your own family.
translation_verse: Abiɛngoɛ biemɔ fa sona kɔ sɛkyelɛ nu, nakoso abiɛngoɛ bie bata wɔ tra aliɛmaa.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right than to be a stupid liar.
translation_verse: Ehianiɛ bɔ ye bra te sannwuu ne, ɔte paa tra sona bɔ ɔte nnakannaka ne kwaseaa ɔ.

english_verse: Willingness and stupidity don't go well together. If you are too eager, you will miss the road.
translation_verse: Ɔtte mayee mma sona kyɛ nimdeɛ kɔbɔ ye ɔ, yeɛ bɔ otutu amirika yɔ nikyee ne, ɔyɛ mvomsoɛ.

english_verse: We are ruined by our own stupidity, though we blame the Lord.
translation_verse: Sona bɔbɔ ye gyiminɛ yeɛ ɔma ye ayieleɛ yie ye ɔ, nakoso ɔpɛ ye nwo fɛ AWURADE so yaa.

english_verse: The rich have many friends; the poor have none.
translation_verse: Sikaa ma sona nya adamvoa pee, nakoso ehianiɛ de, ye mmango mɔ bɛnga bɛmma ye nwo.

english_verse: Dishonest witnesses and liars won't escape punishment.
translation_verse: Adanzewianiɛ ngɔfa ye nwo ngoli tɔtorɔtɔɔ, yeɛ nnakannakaniɛ wora ɔngɔfa ye nwo ngoli mbaen.

english_verse: If you are poor, your own relatives reject you, and your friends are worse. When you really need them, they are not there.
translation_verse: Sɛ ehianiɛ oliɛma mɔ amukoraa po bɛpɔ ye a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ ye damvo mɔ bɛngɔhwe bɛ nwo ngofi ye nwo ɔ! Ɔpena bɛ ɔne bɛ dwudwo a, onnya bɛ.

english_verse: Do yourself a favor by having good sense— you will be glad you did.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ osua nworɛ ne, okuro ye kra dwirɛ, yeɛ bɔ onya nimdeɛ ne, onya ngɔsoɛ.

english_verse: Dishonest witnesses and liars will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Adanzewianiɛ ngɔfa ye nwo ngoli tɔtorɔtɔɔ, yeɛ nnakannakaniɛ wora okowu.

english_verse: It isn't right for a fool to live in luxury or for a slave to rule in place of a king.
translation_verse: Anwonya mvata kwaseaa, yeɛ ɔtte mayee kyɛ kanganiɛ koli nnehyeɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: It's wise to be patient and show what you are like by forgiving others.
translation_verse: Anwohyɛsoɛniɛ ye ahone nhu ndɛ, na ɔte animnyam ma ye kyɛ okobu ye nye kogua mvomsoɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: An angry king roars like a lion, but when a king is pleased, it's like dew on the crops.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛhene fɛ yaa a, ɔte kyɛ gyata bɔ opo ɔ, nakoso ye anwumvoinnwunɛ te kyɛ ndire so ebosue.

english_verse: Foolish children bring disgrace to their fathers. A nagging wife goes on and on like the drip, drip, drip of the rain.
translation_verse: Baa kwaseaa ma ye baba nwu amaneɛ, yeɛ braa bɔ okuro ngondii ne, ɔte kyɛ nzue bɔ mmerɛ biala ɔpepe ɔ.

english_verse: You may inherit all you own from your parents, but a sensible wife is a gift from the Lord.
translation_verse: Awuro ne anwonya te agyapadeɛ bɔ seɛ fa yakyi mma ɔ, nakoso braa badwemma de, ofi AWURADE berɛ.

english_verse: If you are lazy and sleep your time away, you will starve.
translation_verse: Ɛfoen ma sona da hatee, yeɛ akwadworɔ sona di hɔen.

english_verse: Obey the Lord's teachings and you will live— disobey and you will die.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ odi mmeraa dwirɛ ne aso ne, ɔpena ye kra ngoa, nakoso bɔ ɔnnea ye atee bɔ ɔnate so yé ne, okowu.

english_verse: Caring for the poor is lending to the Lord, and you will be well repaid.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔyɛ sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo paa nen, ɔfa fɛmo AWURADE, na paa bɔ wayɛ ne, AWURADE kɔyɛ ye bie kotua kerɛ.

english_verse: Correct your children before it's too late; if you don't punish them, trouble will come their way.
translation_verse: Tea ɛwa wɔ mmerɛ bɔ anyelasoɛ wɔ berɛ ɔ, nnɛfa wɔ nye sie ye so kyɛ ɛkɔmaa ɔkɔhɔ ɛsɛkyelɛ nu.

english_verse: People with bad tempers are always in trouble, and they need help over and over again.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye ahone hu mbiri mbiri ne, okonya ye nwo asohwenɛ, sɛ ɛpepɛ de ye a, sana esa pepɛ de ye bieku.

english_verse: Pay attention to advice and accept correction, so you can live sensibly.
translation_verse: Tie foɛtulɛ ná de ngyerɛkyerɛ to nu, amaa ɔnate so anwu nworɛ kyẽa bie.

english_verse: We may make a lot of plans, but the Lord will do what he has decided.
translation_verse: Kuro sona fa ye adwene yɛ nhyehyɛleɛ pee, nakoso bɔ AWURADE ahyehyɛ ne yeɛ okogyina ɔ.

english_verse: What matters most is loyalty. It's better to be poor than to be a liar.
translation_verse: Nahorɛlilɛ yeɛ bɛpena ye wɔ sona nu ɔ, na ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔyɛ hianiɛ tra kyɛ ɛkɔyɛ nnakannakaniɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Showing respect to the Lord brings true life— if you do it, you can relax without fear of danger.
translation_verse: AWURADE surolɛ ma sona nya ngoa, enya ye a, ɛkɔtena asomdwee nu, na edwirɛ biala ngɔto wɔ.

english_verse: Some people are too lazy to lift a hand to feed themselves.
translation_verse: Ɛfoen sona fa ye sa to talie nu a, ye sa po ɔngora mva ngɔ ye noa.

english_verse: Stupid fools learn good sense by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being corrected.
translation_verse: Bo ngorohoɛniɛ, na sona bɔ ye adwene te kãa ne kosua nworɛ, kã sona badwemma nyunu, na okonya nimdeɛ.

english_verse: Disgraceful children rob their father and chase their mother away.
translation_verse: Baa bɔ ɔbo ɔse ná osa foa oni fi awuro ne, ɔte nyanzoen ne animguaseɛ ba.

english_verse: If you stop learning, you will forget what you already know.
translation_verse: Mma, ɛyakyi foɛtulɛ tielɛ a, ɛne nimdeɛ dwirɛ kɔbɔ nzahoɛ.

english_verse: A lying witness makes fun of the court system, and criminals think crime is really delicious.
translation_verse: Adanzewianiɛ ɔgoro ndɛenbualɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ nwo, yeɛ bɔnefoɛ ye noa aleɛ ole amumuyɛɛ.

english_verse: A stupid fool should expect to be punished.
translation_verse: Besiesie asohwenɛ bɛto berɛ bɛma ngorohoɛfoɛ, yeɛ mbirefinɛ koso bɛma ngwaseafoɛ si.

english_verse: It isn't smart to get drunk! Drinking makes a fool of you and leads to fights.
translation_verse: Nzaa te ngorohoɛniɛ, nzaa serɛ maa ekuro ngondii, na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa ye ti kowura nu ne, ɔnze nworɛ.

english_verse: An angry ruler is like a roaring lion— make either one angry, and you are dead.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛhene fɛ yaa hahii a, ɔte kyɛ gyata bɔ opo ɔ, ebiala bɔ okohu ye ahone ne, ɔfa ye ngoa pɛ so.

english_verse: It makes you look good when you avoid a fight— only fools love to quarrel.
translation_verse: Sona twe ye nwo fi ngondii nwo a, ɔte animnyam ma ye, na kwaseaa biala kuro ngondii.

english_verse: If you are too lazy to plow, don't expect a harvest.
translation_verse: Prakasua ti, ɛfoen sona nzo boo, yiti fieso aleɛ falɛ dwu a, né ɔpena bie, nakoso onnya bie.

english_verse: Someone's thoughts may be as deep as the ocean, but if you are smart, you will discover them.
translation_verse: Kuro sona ti anu adwene te kyɛ buma, badwemma sona yeɛ ɔkora sa bie ɔ.

english_verse: There are many who say, “You can trust me!” But can they be trusted?
translation_verse: Mmeni pee nwa bɛ bɔbɔ bɛte paa, nakoso sona bɔ odi nahorɛ de, nwa yeɛ okonwu bie ɔ?

english_verse: Good people live right, and God blesses the children who follow their example.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ ye bra te sannwuu, na ye mma konya saleɛ wɔ ye si.

english_verse: When rulers decide cases, they weigh the evidence.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛhene tena ndɛenbualɛ bia so a, ɔfa ye nye kari nwu bɔ ɔte bɔne amukoraa.

english_verse: Can any of us really say, “My thoughts are pure, and my sins are gone”?
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔhã kyɛ, “Mate m’ahone nu sannwuu, me nwo ate afi me bɔne nwo” ɔ?

english_verse: Two things the Lord hates are dishonest scales and dishonest measures.
translation_verse: Asusudeɛ mɔ bɔ nzonzoleɛ wɔ nu, ɔne tonyi mɔ bɔ nzonzoleɛ wɔ nu ɔ, AWURADE kyi bɛ munyɔ kɔkɔkɔkɔ.

english_verse: The good or bad that children do shows what they are like.
translation_verse: Akwadaa po, ye yɔleɛ maa benwu ye suban, sɛ ye yɔleɛ nwo te oo, anaa ɔte paa oo.

english_verse: Hearing and seeing are gifts from the Lord.
translation_verse: Asoɛ bɔ ɔte dwirɛ, yeɛ anyeɛ bɔ onwu nikye, AWURADE yeɛ ɔyɔle bɛ munyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: If you sleep all the time, you will starve; if you get up and work, you will have enough food.
translation_verse: Nnɛma nnafelɛ yɛ wɔ fɛ, ná wanhia wɔ, tete wɔ nye, na ekonya aleɛ pee kɔma wɔ ko koyi.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie di ɛwɔfoɛ agyinamuɛ a, de sɔ sona ne tena fa sie, yeɛ sɛ odi ebie bɔ ofi maen bie aso agyinamuɛ a, de awowaa fa sie.

english_verse: The food you get by cheating may taste delicious, but it turns to gravel.
translation_verse: Aleɛ bɔ sona fa nnakannaka so nya ye ne, ɔyɛ fɛ, nakoso ye si ye, nyɔboseka yi ye noa nu to.

english_verse: Be sure you have sound advice before making plans or starting a war.
translation_verse: Egyina foɛtulɛ so ɛfa adwene a, odi mu, sɛ ɛbaahɔ koɛ a, gyina foɛtulɛ paa so.

english_verse: Children who curse their parents will go to the land of darkness long before their time.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔnoma ɔse anaa oni ne, ye kanea konua wɔ awosii kabii nu.

english_verse: Getting rich quick may turn out to be a curse.
translation_verse: Agyapadeɛ bɔ ɛpere wɔ nwo nya ye ahyɛaseɛ ne, ye ayieleɛ ngɔyɛ saleɛ.

english_verse: Don't try to get even. Trust the Lord, and he will help you.
translation_verse: Nnɛkã kyɛ, “Ngɔfa bɔne ngotua bɔne kerɛ.” Na mmom fa wura AWURADE sa, na ɔkɔboka wɔ.

english_verse: The Lord hates dishonest scales and dishonest weights. So don't cheat!
translation_verse: Asusudeɛ mɔ bɔ nzonzoleɛ wɔ nu ne, bɛte AWURADE akyiwadeɛ, yeɛ tonyi bɔ bawura nu ne koso ɔtte mayee.

english_verse: How can we know what will happen to us when the Lord alone decides?
translation_verse: Kuro sona agyirɛ bɔ otutu ne, ogyi AWURADE so, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né sona ate ye bɔbɔ ye atee bɔ ɔnate so ɔ bo?

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of making promises to God before you think!
translation_verse: Ɔte musue ma sona kyɛ ɔkɔpere ye nwo kɔhã kyɛ, “Ɛhe te krongron,” ná koso ɔbɔ anohoba yie a, afei ɔhyɛ ye bo ɔdwenedwene ɔ.

english_verse: Our inner thoughts are a lamp from the Lord, and they search our hearts.
translation_verse: Sona sunzum te AWURADE kanea, na ɔneanea ye nu amukoraa onwu ye nekaa biala.

english_verse: Rulers are protected by God's mercy and loyalty, but they must be merciful for their kingdoms to last.
translation_verse: Pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ne nahorɛlilɛ ɔbɔ ɛhene nwo waen, na pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ yeɛ ɔma ye ahennie gyina ɔ.

english_verse: Young people take pride in their strength, but the gray hairs of wisdom are even more beautiful.
translation_verse: Mmerandeɛ b’animnyam ole b’anwoserɛ, yeɛ egyein te nworowaa mɔ b’anwonyemene.

english_verse: A severe beating can knock all of the evil out of you!
translation_verse: Bakaa bɔ ɔma bɛ nwo pakyepakye ne, otu bɔne bo, na sɔ ala yeɛ mbire koso ɔworoworo sona nu osiesie ye nu ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord controls rulers, just as he determines the course of rivers.
translation_verse: Ɛhene adwene, ɔte kyɛ asue bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ wɔ AWURADE sa nu, nekaa bɔ okuro ɔ yeɛ obiri ye fa ɔ.

english_verse: We may think we are doing the right thing, but the Lord always knows what is in our hearts.
translation_verse: Bɔ sona yɔ biala, ɔtengyɛ wɔ ye nye so, nakoso AWURADE yeɛ ɔkari ye ti anu dwirɛ nea ɔ.

english_verse: Doing what is right and fair pleases the Lord more than an offering.
translation_verse: Tenenee bra ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ, ɔsɔ AWURADE nye tra afɔleɛbɔlɛ.

english_verse: Evil people are proud and arrogant, but sin is the only crop they produce.
translation_verse: Anyeɛ bɔ ɔnzɔ sona ne anwomasoɛ, bɛte bɔnefoɛ kanea, bɛte bɔne.

english_verse: If you plan and work hard, you will have plenty; if you hurry to get rich, you will end up poor.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ okuro adwuma ne, ye nhyehyɛleɛ maa onya ye nwo tam, nakoso sona bɔ ɔpere ye nwo de, onnya huu.

english_verse: Cheating to get rich is a foolish dream and no less than suicide.
translation_verse: Anwonya bɔ bɛfa nnakannaka so benya ye ne, ɔte mbaen, na ɔte bɛ so ewue ngaen.

english_verse: You destroy yourself by being cruel and violent and refusing to live right.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛ nzɛmmɔne kɔpra bɛ bo kɔhɔ, ofikyɛ bɛpo kyɛ bɛkɔyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: All crooks are liars, but anyone who is innocent will do right.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛɛniɛ yɔleɛ ndengyɛ, nakoso sona bɔ ye nwo te ne de, ye atee tengyɛ.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔtena sua anwuro pumbu ahameɛ bie anu tra kyɛ ɛne braa bɔ ye nwo te ngondii ɔ bɛkɔtena awuro ɔ.

english_verse: Evil people want to do wrong, even to their friends.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛɛniɛ, ye kra gye aleɛ ole bɔne, na onnwu ye mmango anwumvoin.

english_verse: An ignorant fool learns by seeing others punished; a sensible person learns by being instructed.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛtwe ngorohoɛniɛ so a, sona bɔ ye adwene te kãa ɔ nwu nworɛ, yeɛ sɛ betu nworɛniɛ foɛ a, ye nimdeɛ kɔ anwuro.

english_verse: God is always fair! He knows what the wicked do and will punish them.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ ɔfa ye nye nea bɔ ɔkɔ so wɔ bɔnefoɛ awuro ɔ, na bɔnefoɛ bɛ bɔne ti, b’ayieleɛ nyie bɛ yé.

english_verse: If you won't help the poor, don't expect to be heard when you cry out for help.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ besu bɛfrɛ ye a otuatua ye so ne, ye koso osũ frɛ a, ebiala ngɔtɛ ye so.

english_verse: A secret bribe will save you from someone's fierce anger.
translation_verse: Mvealeɛ nu akyɛdeɛ brɛ ɛyaafɛlɛ ase, yeɛ fea-ase-ma kudɛɛ ma ahonehulɛ tɔ nzue nu.

english_verse: When justice is done, good citizens are glad and crooks are terrified.
translation_verse: Sɛ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ yɛ adwuma a, teneneeniɛ nye gye, nakoso bɔnefoɛ mɔ de, pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ nwunanwuna bɛ.

english_verse: If you stop using good sense, you will find yourself in the grave.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ odi nimdeɛ atee nwo makyebu ne, awufoɛ mɔ nu yeɛ ɔkɔtena ɔ.

english_verse: Heavy drinkers and others who live only for pleasure will lose all they have.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔfa anigye sie ye nye so ne, odi hiaa, yeɛ bɔ okuro nzaa ne ngoo ne, ɔngɔyɛ sikaniɛ.

english_verse: God's people will escape, but all who are wicked will pay the price.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ yeɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔpɔ teneneeniɛ ɔ, na sɔ ala yeɛ bɛkɔfa amumuyɛɛniɛ bɛkɔpɔ sona bɔ odi nahorɛ ɔ.

english_verse: It's better out in the desert than at home with a nagging, complaining wife.
translation_verse: Ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔtena aseɛ akwaweɛ so tra kyɛ ɛne braa bɔ ye nwo te ngondii bɔ odwane wɔ nwo ɔ bɛkɔtena ɔ.

english_verse: Be sensible and store up precious treasures— don't waste them like a fool.
translation_verse: Agudeɛ bɔ odi mu ne ngoo wɔ nworɛniɛ awuro, nakoso kwaseaa de, onya ye a ɔsɛkye ye.

english_verse: If you try to be kind and good, you will be blessed with life and goodness and honor.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔfa tenenee bra ne paayɛlɛ osie ye nye so ne, okonya ngoa, tenenee ne animnyam.

english_verse: One wise person can defeat a city full of soldiers and capture their fortress.
translation_verse: Nworɛniɛ fo fasue kɔ anwoserɛfoɛ bɛ kuro, na anwoserɛ afealeɛ bɔ bafa bɛ wora bawura nu ne, odwiri gua.

english_verse: Watching what you say can save you a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔnea ye noa ne ye dwudwolɛ so yé ne, ɔtwe ye kra fi amaneɛ nu.

english_verse: If you are proud and conceited, everyone will say, “You're a snob!”
translation_verse: Anwomasoɛniɛ bɔ otu ye nwo ne, ye dumaa ole ngorohoɛniɛ, na ɔbɔ ye bra anwomasoɛ ndrasoɛ nu.

english_verse: If you want too much and are too lazy to work, it could be fatal.
translation_verse: Ɛfoen sona, nikyee bɔ ye komvi wɔ so ne yeɛ oku ye ɔ, ofikyɛ ye sa nga ye gya nga.

english_verse: But people who obey God are always generous.
translation_verse: Ebie nye boro nikyee kɔkɔkɔkɔ daa biala, nakoso teneneeniɛ de, ofia ye kunu ɔkyɛ nikye.

english_verse: The Lord despises the offerings of wicked people with evil motives.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ afɔleɛ te akyiwadeɛ, na sɛ ɔfa adwene tɛɛ ɔbɔ afɔleɛ ne po de a, ye de né wasram so!

english_verse: If you tell lies in court, you are done for; only a reliable witness can do the job.
translation_verse: Danzeniɛ ngondomboniɛ kowu, nakoso sona bɔ ɔyɛ asoɛ tie ne de, ye dwirɛ yeɛ okotindim ɔ.

english_verse: Wicked people bluff their way, but God's people think before they take a step.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ kumgum ye nyunu, nakoso teneneeniɛ de, ɔdwene ye agyirɛtulɛ nwo.

english_verse: No matter how much you know or what plans you make, you can't defeat the Lord.
translation_verse: Nworɛ anaa nimdeɛ anaa foɛtulɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔkɔhora kogyina AWURADE nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: Even if your army has horses ready for battle, the Lord will always win.
translation_verse: Besiesie pɔngɔ bɛfa bɛnwondɛ koɛ kyẽa, nakoso ngonimlilɛ de, ɔwɔ AWURADE sa nu.

english_verse: Teach your children right from wrong, and when they are grown they will still do right.
translation_verse: Tete akwadaa ma onwu atee paa bɔ odi kyɛ ɔfa so ɔ, amaa sɛ onyi a wamvi so.

english_verse: The poor are ruled by the rich, and those who borrow are slaves of moneylenders.
translation_verse: Sikafoɛ di ehiafoɛ so, yeɛ sona bɔ obisa bosea ne, ɔte bɔ ɔbɔ bosea n’akoaa.

english_verse: Troublemakers get in trouble, and their terrible anger will get them nowhere.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ odua amumuyɛɛ ne, ɔkɔpɛ musue, na ye ɛyaafɛlɛ mbire nu kobubu.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who freely gives food to the poor.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ofia ye kunu ɔkyɛ nikyee ne, onya saleɛ, ofikyɛ ɔfa ye aleɛ ne bie ma ehiafoɛ.

english_verse: Arguments and fights will come to an end, if you chase away those who insult others.
translation_verse: Foa ngorohoɛniɛ ne, na ngondii so kɔpɛ; aporowaa ne nzoaa bo kɔpɛ.

english_verse: The king is the friend of all who are sincere and speak with kindness.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ okuro bra sannwuu bɔlɛ, bɔ ye noa dwirɛ yɛ fɛ ne, ɛhene ne kɔyɛ ye damvo.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who shows good sense, but he frustrates the plans of deceitful liars.
translation_verse: AWURADE nye bɔ nimdeɛfoɛ nwo waen, nakoso amumuyɛɛniɛ de, ɔbɔ ye dwirɛ gua.

english_verse: Don't be so lazy that you say, “If I go to work, a lion will eat me!”
translation_verse: Ɛfoen sona dwirɛ bɔ ɔkã ole kyɛ, “Gyata wɔ aluo dɔ, bekohu me wɔ mmorɔnoɛ nemɔ aso!”

english_verse: The words of a bad woman are like a deep pit; if you make the Lord angry, you will fall right in.
translation_verse: Nyanzoen brasua noa dwirɛ te kumaa kuronn, bienzua bɔ AWURADE afɛ ye so yaa ne, ɔtɔ nu.

english_verse: All children are foolish, but firm correction will make them change.
translation_verse: Ngwaseade yɔlɛ ayi akwadaa ti anu tɛkyɛ, ɛfa mbire tea ye a, otu ngwaseade ne fi ye nwo.

english_verse: Cheat the poor to make profit or give gifts to the rich— either way you lose. Thirty Wise Sayings
translation_verse: Sona bɔ osisi ehiafoɛ fa nya ye nwo, ɔne bɔ ɔfa ye anwonya kyɛ sikafoɛ ne, ehiaa yeɛ okohia ye ɔ. Nworɛ dwirɛ biemɔ

english_verse: Here are some sayings of people with wisdom, so listen carefully as I teach.
translation_verse: Yɛ asoɛ tie nworɛfoɛ noa dwirɛ, ma w’adwene hɔ me nimdeɛ ne aso,

english_verse: You will be glad that you know these sayings and can recite them.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ɔte paa ma wɔ kyɛ ɛkɔfa kosie wɔ ti anu, bɔ ye mukoraa ɔla wɔ noa ɔ.

english_verse: I am teaching them today, so that you may trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Matu wɔ sɔ foɛ ne ɛnɛ, yoo, wɔ, amaa ɔnate so afa wɔ wora awura AWURADE nu.

english_verse: I have written thirty sayings filled with sound advice.
translation_verse: Mahyerɛ edwirɛ bɔ nu pi ɔ aburasa mama wɔ, foɛtulɛ ne nimdeɛ dwirɛ mɔ,

english_verse: You can trust them completely to give you the right words for those in charge of you. –
translation_verse: kyɛ memaa enwu kyɛbɔ nahorɛ dwirɛ ne ɔte turoloo, amaa ɔnate so afa nahorɛ mmuayɛɛ aama bɛ bɔ bɛsomane wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't take advantage of the poor or cheat them in court.
translation_verse: Nnɛdi sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ɔ aminɛ, ofikyɛ ɔyɛ anwumvo, yeɛ nnɛsisi ehianiɛ wɔ nekaa bɔ bedi dwirɛ ɔ;

english_verse: The Lord is their defender, and what you do to them, he will do to you. –
translation_verse: ofikyɛ AWURADE koli bɛ dwirɛ kɔma bɛ, na bɛ bɔ besisi ehiafoɛ ne, okole bɛ kra kofi bɛ sa nu.

english_verse: Don't make friends with anyone who has a bad temper.
translation_verse: Nnɛfa sona bɔ ye ahone pingye ye ɔ abiɛngoɛ, yeɛ nnɛne bɔ ɔfɛ yaa mbaen mbaen ɔ bɛbɔ afɛ,

english_verse: You might turn out like them and get caught in a trap. –
translation_verse: anyɔ a ekosua ye suban ne bie, ná aprɛprɛ wɔ kra ato ngaen nu.

english_verse: Don't guarantee to pay someone else's debt.
translation_verse: Nnɛboka bɛ bɔ bedi agyinamuɛ ne aso, bɛ bɔ bedi kerɛ nu agyinamuɛ ne.

english_verse: If you don't have the money, you might lose your bed. –
translation_verse: Sɛ annya nikyee bie amva andua a, nzu ati yeɛ ongole wɔ bɛen bɔ ɛla so ɔ?

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker set up by your ancestors. –
translation_verse: Nnɛtutu daa tete ɛwɛen bɔ wɔ nana mɔ bato ne.

english_verse: If you do your job well, you will work for a ruler and never be a slave.
translation_verse: Aso anwu sona bɔ ɔyɛ ye adwuma ferengyemm ɔ? Ahemvo mɔ yeɛ okonya atee kɔso bɛ ɔ, ɔngɔso kwahweabaa mɔ.

english_verse: Don't accept an invitation to eat a selfish person's food, no matter how good it is.
translation_verse: Nnɛdi sona bɔ ɔte aheɛ ɔ aleɛ, nnɛma wɔ komvi ba ye aleɛ fɛfɛɛfɛ ne aso,

english_verse: When you are invited to eat with a king, use your best manners.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛne panyi bie bɛtena ase kyɛ ɛmɔdidi a, edidi a fa adwene to ye nwo paa;

english_verse: Don't go and stuff yourself! That would be just the same as cutting your throat.
translation_verse: sɛ ɛte sona bɔ wɔ nye boro aleɛ a, ye de te w’adidie so.

english_verse: Don't be greedy for all of that fancy food! It may not be so tasty. –
translation_verse: Nnɛma wɔ nye boro ye aleɛ fɛfɛɛfɛ ne, ofikyɛ ɔte nnakannaka aleɛ.

english_verse: People like that take note of how much you eat. They say, “Take all you want!” But they don't mean it.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ɔyɔ sɔ sona nye so mbaen, na ose wɔ kyɛ, “Didi ná no,” nakoso nna ye kunu ɔ.

english_verse: Give up trying so hard to get rich.
translation_verse: Nnɛha wɔ nwo pee pena anwonya, nnɛdi wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nworɛ si.

english_verse: Your money flies away before you know it, just like an eagle suddenly taking off. –
translation_verse: Kyɛ ɛbɔ wɔ nye perɛ ne, né watu wamini, ofikyɛ anwonya le ndaa, na otu kyɛ kɔleɛ ɔkɔ anwuro anwuro.

english_verse: Each bite will come back up, and all your kind words will be wasted. –
translation_verse: Kãa bɔ ali ne, ɛkɔfe, na wɔ noa dwirɛ bɔ ɛfa kamvo ye ne kɔyɛ mbaen.

english_verse: Don't talk to fools— they will make fun of you. –
translation_verse: Nnɛkã dwirɛ gua kwaseaa so anu, ofikyɛ ɔngɔfa wɔ nworɛ dwirɛ ne ngɔyɛ huu.

english_verse: Don't move a boundary marker or take the land that belongs to orphans.
translation_verse: Nnɛtutu daa tete ɛwɛen, yeɛ nnɛpimbi nyisiaa mɔ b’aseɛ,

english_verse: Listen to me, my children! Be wise and have enough sense to follow the right path.
translation_verse: Mma, wɔ de, tie ná nwu nworɛ, ná twe w’adwene sie atee ne aso.

english_verse: Don't be a heavy drinker or stuff yourself with food.
translation_verse: Nnɛne akɔnomnzafoɛ bɛbɔ afɛ, yeɛ nnɛne anoanufɛɛfoɛ bɛbɔ afɛ;

english_verse: It will make you feel drowsy, and you will end up poor with only rags to wear. –
translation_verse: ofikyɛ akɔnomnzafoɛ ne adifuufoɛ bekoli hiaa, yeɛ ngosietɔlɛ ɔfa ndangurɛ kera sona.

english_verse: Pay attention to your father, and don't neglect your mother when she grows old.
translation_verse: Tie wɔ baba bɔ ɔwole wɔ ne dwirɛ, yeɛ sɛ wɔ maame yɛ aworowaa a, nnɛbu ye animtia.

english_verse: Invest in truth and wisdom, discipline and good sense, and don't part with them.
translation_verse: Tɔ nahorɛ, na nnɛyɛ ye atɔen; yeɛ tɔ nworɛ, foɛtulɛ, ne nimdeɛ.

english_verse: Make your father truly happy by living right and showing sound judgment.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ ye baba di ahurusi paa, yeɛ seɛ bɔ ɔwo baa nworɛniɛ ne, seɛ ne nye gye ye nwo.

english_verse: My son, pay close attention, and gladly follow my example.
translation_verse: Mma, fa w’adwene ma me, ná ma wɔ nye gye m’atee nwo.

english_verse: Bad women and unfaithful wives are like a deep pit—
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ brasua gyanderaniɛ te kumaa kuronn, yeɛ brasua sanzaniɛ te abura bɔtɔfee.

english_verse: they are waiting to attack you like a gang of robbers with victim after victim. –
translation_verse: Ɔtɛ kyɛ awerɔm awueniɛ, na ɔma mmienzua bɔ bɛsɛkye agyaa ɔ bɛsone pee.

english_verse: Who is always in trouble? Who argues and fights? Who has cuts and bruises? Whose eyes are red?
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ edwirɛ ato ye ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ye wora ɔbɔ ɔ? Nwa yeɛ okuro ngondiihonɛ? Nwa yeɛ okuro aporowaasulɛ ɔ? Nwa yeɛ wapurapura mbaen ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ye nye mmaa ayɛ kɔɔ ɔ?

english_verse: Everyone who stays up late, having just one more drink.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛtena nzaa bo bɛkyɛ ne ɔ, bɛ bɔ bekyini bɛno nzaa mvrafra ne ɔ.

english_verse: Don't even look at that colorful stuff bubbling up in the glass! It goes down so easily,
translation_verse: Nnɛma wɔ nye yɛ nzaa bɔ ye nye apakye ɔ nwo koakoa, bɔ ye nye pɛ ahure wɔ kwangoa nu, bɔ ogua wɔ komvi a ɔkɔ yɔɔ ne.

english_verse: but later it bites like a poisonous snake.
translation_verse: Nziɛ ye, ɔka wɔ kyɛ ewoo, na ye noa borɔ te kyɛ bɔnaa.

english_verse: You will see weird things, and your mind will play tricks on you.
translation_verse: Nningyein suronyisuronyi kogyinagyina wɔ nye so, na w’adwene kɔmaa ekodwudwo basabasa.

english_verse: You will feel tossed about like someone trying to sleep on a ship in a storm.
translation_verse: Wɔ nye so kɔyɛ wɔ kyɛ ebie bɔ ɔla ɛpo afia ɔ, okohyini wɔ kyɛ ebie bɔ waala ɛlɛen noa ɔ.
