english_verse: You will be bruised all over, without even remembering how it all happened. And you will lie awake asking, “When will morning come, so I can drink some more?”
translation_verse: Na ɛkɔhã kyɛ, “Bafa nikyee babɔ me, nakoso mambura, babo me, nakoso ɔnyɛ me yea. Mmerɛ beni yeɛ me nye so kɔtete me maa ngɔɔpena nzaa bieku ngɔno ɔ?”

english_verse: Don't let evil people worry you or make you jealous.
translation_verse: Nnɛha wɔ nwo wɔ bɔnefoɛ nwo, nnɛma wɔ nye boro amumuyɛɛfoɛ,

english_verse: Don't be jealous of crooks or want to be their friends.
translation_verse: Nnɛma wɔ nye boro bɔnefoɛ, yeɛ nnɛmaa ɔyɛ wɔ nyemene kyɛ ɛne bɛ kɔbɔ afɛ ɔ;

english_verse: All they think about and talk about is violence and cruelty. –
translation_verse: ofikyɛ bɛbɔ porɛ tɛɛ, na bɛ noa kekã musue dwirɛ.

english_verse: They will soon be gone like the flame of a lamp that burns out. –
translation_verse: ofikyɛ bɔnefoɛ ayieleɛ ngoyie ye yé, na bɔnefoɛ kanea konua.

english_verse: Use wisdom and understanding to establish your home;
translation_verse: Sona fa nworɛ yeɛ osi sua ɔ, na bɛfa ndeaseɛ yeɛ bɛmaa ogyina ɔ;

english_verse: let good sense fill the rooms with priceless treasures. –
translation_verse: bɛfa nimdeɛ so yeɛ bɛfa anwodeɛ nyɔboɛserɛ nyemenenyemene amukoraa besiesie ye pumbu nemɔ anu ɔ.

english_verse: My children, you must respect the Lord and the king, and you must not make friends with anyone who rebels against either of them.
translation_verse: Mma, suro AWURADE ne ɛhene ne, na nnɛfa wɔ nwo bɔ mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ lɔen ne,

english_verse: Battles are won by listening to advice and making a lot of plans. –
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ɛyɔ nhyehyɛleɛ paa koraka né ahɔ koɛ, na ngonimlilɛ gyi foɛtulɛfoɛ pee so.

english_verse: Who knows what sudden disaster the Lord or a ruler might bring? More Sayings That Make Good Sense
translation_verse: ofikyɛ amaneɛ kɔto bɛ mvum nu, na nwa yeɛ ɔse asohwenɛ bɔ ofi bɛ munyɔ bɛ berɛ kɔwa ne ɔ? Nworɛ dwirɛ bieku mɔ

english_verse: Wisdom is too much for fools! Their advice is no good. –
translation_verse: Nworɛ te nikyee bɔ ɔbo ngwaseafoɛ adwene so, kwaseaa dwu nekaa bɔ bedi dwirɛ a, ommukye ye noa.

english_verse: Here are some more sayings that make good sense: When you judge, you must be fair.
translation_verse: Nworɛniɛ ne, ɛhemɔ koso te ye noa dwirɛ: Ɔtte mayee kyɛ ekobua ndɛengyea ɔ.

english_verse: No one but troublemakers think up trouble.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔbɔ porɛ tɛɛ ne, bɛfrɛ ye busueniɛ.

english_verse: Everyone hates senseless fools who think up ways to sin. –
translation_verse: Ngwaseasɛm nwo adwene falɛ te bɔne, yeɛ ngorohoɛniɛ te mmenia akyiwadeɛ.

english_verse: If you let the guilty go free, people of all nations will hate and curse you.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ okose bɔnefoɛ kyɛ, “Edi be” nen, mmenia kɔnoma ye, na maen maen kohyi ye.

english_verse: Don't give up and be helpless in times of trouble. –
translation_verse: Kyẽa bɔ edwirɛ kɔto wɔ ne, sɛ w’aba nu bu a, ye de né w’anwoserɛ te kãa.

english_verse: But if you punish the guilty, things will go well for you, and you will prosper.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛtwe bɔnefoɛ so de, okoyie bɛ yé, na bekonya saleɛ piri.

english_verse: Don't fail to rescue those who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Sɛ ambepɛ anne bɛ bɔ babua bɛ ndɛengyea bɛkwaahũ bɛ, bɛ bɔ babua bɛ kumfɔ bɛkwaahũ bɛ a;

english_verse: Don't say, “I didn't know it!” God can read your mind. He watches each of us and knows our thoughts. And God will pay us back for what we do. –
translation_verse: ná sɛ ɛkã kyɛ, “Tie, né yɛnze” a, Nyameɛ bɔ ɔse sona ti anu dwirɛ ne, aso onnwuni wɔ anaa? Ye bɔ ɔnea wɔ kra so ne, aso ɔnze anaa? Aso ongotua ebiala kerɛ kyɛbɔ ye yɔleɛ te anaa?

english_verse: Giving an honest answer is a sign of true friendship.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔma mmuayɛɛ paa ne, ɔte kyɛ sona bɔ wayɛ wɔ atuu ɔ.

english_verse: Honey is good for you, my children, and it tastes sweet.
translation_verse: Mma, di woɛ, ofikyɛ ɔte paa, ná di woɛ bɔ ɔwɔ nzasameɛ nu bɔ ɔyɛ wɔ temverema so fɛfɛɛfɛ ne.

english_verse: Wisdom is like honey for your life— if you find it, your future is bright. –
translation_verse: Nwu ye kyɛ, sɔ ala yeɛ nworɛ te ma wɔ kra ɔ, sɛ enwu ye a, ekonya so mvasoɛ kyẽa bie, na w’anyelasoɛ ne bo ngɔpɛ.

english_verse: Get your fields ready and plant your crops before starting a home.
translation_verse: Siesie w’adwuma wɔ nekaa bie, duadua wɔ fieso nningyein yie, ná afei asi w’awuro.

english_verse: Don't be a cruel person who attacks good people and hurts their families.
translation_verse: O, bɔnefoɛ, nnɛtɛ teneneeniɛ wɔ ye awuro, nnɛbɔ apaa wɔ ye nekaa bɔ ɔte ɔ,

english_verse: Even if good people fall seven times, they will get back up. But when trouble strikes the wicked, that's the end of them. –
translation_verse: ofikyɛ, teneneeniɛ kɔhora kofĩ ase pɛen nzoo, nakoso osa dwɔso, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, musue to ye ma ye ayieleɛ yie ye.

english_verse: Don't accuse anyone who isn't guilty. Don't ever tell a lie
translation_verse: Nnɛdi adanzewia tia ebiɛngo, yeɛ nnɛfa wɔ noa kekã nnakannaka dwirɛ.

english_verse: Don't be happy to see your enemies trip and fall down.
translation_verse: Wɔ pɔfoɛ fĩ ase a, nnɛmaa ɔyɛ wɔ fɛ, yeɛ sɛ osoti koso a, nnɛma wɔ nye gye,

english_verse: The Lord will find out and be unhappy. Then he will stop being angry with them. –
translation_verse: ɔba ye sɔ a, AWURADE konwu ye, ɔngɔyɛ ye fɛ, na ɔkɔyakyi ye yaa bɔ wafɛ wɔ ye so ne.

english_verse: I once walked by the field and the vineyard of a lazy fool.
translation_verse: Ngɔmvale ɛfoen sona bie ye fieso, yeɛ ngɔmvale ebie bɔ adwene nne ye ti anu ɔ ye bobe boo nu;

english_verse: When I saw this, it taught me a lesson:
translation_verse: Nwuni ye ne, ndwenene ye nwo yé, nneane, na nzuane nworɛ he mvili nu:

english_verse: Sleep a little. Doze a little. Fold your hands and twiddle your thumbs.
translation_verse: Maa nna kãa, maa ndɔ ngosie kãa, maa ndengyɛ me nu kãa,

english_verse: Here are some more of Solomon's proverbs. They were copied by the officials of King Hezekiah of Judah.
translation_verse: Ɛhemɔ koso te Solomon anyandera bɔ obuli, bɔ Yuda hene Hesekia ahyerɛlɛfoɛ bɛneane bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ daa ne aso bɛhyerɛ ɔ.

english_verse: God is praised for being mysterious; rulers are praised for explaining mysteries.
translation_verse: Mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ te Nyameɛ ye animnyam, na ahemvo mɔ b’animnyam ole kyɛ bɛkɔfeefee edwirɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: Who can fully understand the thoughts of a ruler? They reach beyond the sky and go deep in the earth.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ nyameɛso si wale kɔ anwuro, ná aseɛ bo dɔ kɔ kuronn ne, sɔ ala yeɛ sɛ ɛfeefee bɔ ɔwɔ ahemvo mɔ ti anu a ɔnyɛ yee ɔ.

english_verse: Silver must be purified before it can be used to make something of value.
translation_verse: Ye efiɛ ne fi ɛdwetɛ nu, na dwumvoɛ konya ye kɔfa koli adwii.

english_verse: Evil people must be removed before anyone can rule with justice.
translation_verse: Foa bɔnefoɛ ne fi ɛhene ne nyunu, na ye ahennie bia kotimu wɔ tenenee nu.

english_verse: Don't try to seem important in the court of a ruler.
translation_verse: Nnɛmoma wɔ nwo so wɔ ɛhene ne nyunu, yeɛ nnɛkogyina atitirefoɛ nekaa,

english_verse: It's better for the ruler to give you a high position than for you to be embarrassed in front of royal officials. Be sure you are right
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ɔte paa kyɛ bekose wɔ kyɛ, “Bra anwuro faen,” tra kyɛ bekogua wɔ nyunu ase wɔ sona titire ne anyunu. Edwirɛ bɔ wɔ nye anwu ye ne,

english_verse: When you and someone else can't get along, don't gossip about it.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛne ebiɛngo benya dwirɛ a, ɛne ye ngome bɛhã, na ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɛsa ebiɛngo ne bo gua so;

english_verse: Others will find out, and your reputation will then be ruined.
translation_verse: ɔba ye sɔ a, ebiala bɔ ɔkɔte ne, okogua wɔ nyunu ase, na w’animguaseɛ ne ngofi wɔ so.

english_verse: The right word at the right time is like precious gold set in silver.
translation_verse: Ɛkã edwirɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔfata nu a, ɔte kyɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ bafa bali adwii bagua ɛdwetɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: Listening to good advice is worth much more than jewelry made of gold.
translation_verse: Sɛ nworɛniɛ tu wɔ foɛ ná ɛfa a, ɔte kyɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ asomade ne agudeɛ.

english_verse: Patience and gentle talk can convince a ruler and overcome any problem.
translation_verse: Enya aboterɛ a, ɔkora ma ndɛenbualɛniɛ kakyi ye adwene, yeɛ sɛ ɛyɛ wɔ noa bɛtɛɛ a, ɔkora ma maen mbanyi betie wɔ dwirɛ.

english_verse: Eating too much honey can make you sick.
translation_verse: Sɛ enwu woɛ a, nnɛtafe ye adifuu, anyɔ a, ɔkɔfo wɔ boɛ so maa ɛkɔfe.

english_verse: Don't visit friends too often, or they will get tired of it and start hating you.
translation_verse: Nnɛyɛ eliɛngo awuro drɛdrɛ, anyɔ a, wɔ nwo kɔfone ye maa ɔkɔpɔ wɔ.

english_verse: Telling lies about friends is like attacking them with clubs and swords and sharp arrows.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ okoli oliɛngo nwo adanzewia ne, ɔte kyɛ koɛ abopura, ngrandɛ ne agyaen nnaennaen.

english_verse: A friend you can't trust in times of trouble is like having a toothache or a sore foot.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ to wɔ ná ɛfa wɔ wora wura ngɔngɔnzaaniɛ nu a, ɔte kyɛ agyee bɔ ɔkekã ɔ, ɔne agyirɛ bɔ wafondo ɔ.

english_verse: If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛhɔen ku wɔ pɔfoɛ a, ma ye aleɛ ma oli, yeɛ sɛ nzuhɔen ku ye a, ma ye nzue ma ɔno;

english_verse: This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads. And the Lord will reward you.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ sɛ ɛyɔ sɔ a, né asuso see nzramaa agua ye ti afia, na AWURADE kɔma wɔ ye nwo akatuaa paa.

english_verse: As surely as rain blows in from the north, anger is caused by cruel words.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ sorɔ dɔ mvrama fa esue ba ne, sɔ ala yeɛ sɛ ɛkã ebie si dwirɛ a ɔfa ɛyaafɛlɛ ba ɔ.

english_verse: It's better to stay outside on the roof of your house than to live inside with a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔtena sua anwuro pumbu ahameɛ bie anu tra kyɛ ɛne braa bɔ ye nwo te ngondii ɔ bɛkɔtena awuro ɔ.

english_verse: Good news from far away refreshes like cold water when you are thirsty.
translation_verse: Ndɛenvɛen bɔ okofi dedeede kɔwa ne, ɔte kyɛ afa nzue frɔlɔɔ ama sona bɔ nzuhɔen ku ye ɔ.

english_verse: When a good person gives in to the wicked, it's like dumping garbage in a stream of clear water.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ bɔ ɔkɔma ye nwo ate kɔma bɔnefoɛ kɔsɛkye ye ne, ɔte kyɛ mbombonzue bɔ baponda ye, anaa abura nu nzue bɔ basɛkye ye ɔ.

english_verse: Don't eat too much honey or always want praise.
translation_verse: Woɛtafelɛ pee ɔtte mayee, na sɔ ala yeɛ sɛ ɛpena animnyam ma wɔ nwo a ɔtte mayee ɔ.

english_verse: Losing self-control leaves you as helpless as a city without a wall.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔngora nhyɛ ye nwo so ne, ɔte kyɛ kuro bɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ awura nu, bɔ ye nwo fasue abubu agua ɔ.

english_verse: Expecting snow in summer and rain in the dry season makes more sense than honoring a fool.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ asukɔtwea mvata ahuhuro mmerɛ, ná esue koso mvata fieso aleɛfalɛ mmerɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ animnyam mvata kwaseaa ɔ.

english_verse: A curse you don't deserve will take wings and fly away like a sparrow or a swallow.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ akatipire tu tenatena, ná nandwinoma koso tu kyinikyini ne, sɔ ala yeɛ amoenwaa bɔ olle nyinasoɛ ne ongonzi huu ɔ.

english_verse: Horses and donkeys must be beaten and bridled— and so must fools.
translation_verse: Pɔngɔ fata bakaa, afupɔngɔ fata nyamaa, yeɛ kwaseaa si fata mbire.

english_verse: Don't make a fool of yourself by answering a fool.
translation_verse: Kwaseaa kã ngwaseasɛm a, nnɛtɛ ye so, anyɛ a, wɔ koso ɛkɔyɛ kwaseaa kyɛ ye ala.

english_verse: But if you answer any fools, show how foolish they are, so they won't feel smart.
translation_verse: Ma kwaseaa ye ngwaseasɛm nwo mmuayɛɛ, anyɛ a, ɔkɔdwene kyɛ ɔse nworɛ.

english_verse: Sending a message by a fool is like chopping off your foot just to spite yourself.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛfa ngraa soma kwaseaa a, ɔpepɛ ye bɔbɔ ye gya gua, yeɛ ɔtwetwe musue dwirɛ ba.

english_verse: A fool with words of wisdom is like an athlete with legs that can't move.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ bubuaniɛ ye gya sinze berɛ fɛngyɛfɛngyɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ kwaseaa noa nu anyandera te ɔ.

english_verse: Are you going to honor a fool? Why not shoot a slingshot with the rock tied tight?
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛhyɛ kwaseaa animnyam a, ɔte kyɛ afa nyɔboɛ awura taya nu ɔ.

english_verse: A thornbush waved around in the hand of a drunkard is no worse than a proverb in the mouth of a fool.
translation_verse: Kwaseaa noa nu anyandera te kyɛ akɔnomnzaniɛ bɔ ɔnwaha bakaa mmowue mmowue ɔ.

english_verse: It's no smarter to shoot arrows at every passerby than it is to hire a bunch of worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔbɔ kwaseaa anaa akɔnomnzaniɛ paa ne, ɔte kyɛ agyaentolɛniɛ bɔ opurapura mmenia mukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: Dogs return to eat their vomit, just as fools repeat their foolishness.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ kyea fe a osa kodi ne, sɔ ala yeɛ kwaseaa osa kɔyɔ ngwaseade ɔ.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who says, “I'm really smart!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ anwu sona bɔ obu ye nwo kyɛ ye de ɔse nworɛ ɔ? Sɔ sona ne, anyelasoɛ wɔ berɛ ma ngwaseafoɛ tra ye. Nnɛyɛ foen

english_verse: Don't be lazy and keep saying, “There's a lion outside!”
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔte foen ne, ye dwirɛ ole: “Gyata wɔ atunu dɔ! Gyata wɔ dwaaso dɔ!”

english_verse: A door turns on its hinges, but a lazy person just turns over in bed.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ anoa ɔpɛ ye nwo wɔ ye ndenasoɛ so ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛfoen sona yɔ wɔ ye bɛen so ɔ.

english_verse: Some of us are so lazy that we won't lift a hand to feed ourselves.
translation_verse: Ɛfoen sona fa ye sa to talie nu a, ɔyɛ ye akwadworɔ kyɛ ɔkɔfa kɔhɔ ye noa ɔ.

english_verse: A lazy person says, “I am smarter than everyone else.”
translation_verse: Ɛfoen sona bu ye nwo nworɛniɛ tra badwemmafoɛ nzoo. Nnɛyɛ ngɔngɔnzaa

english_verse: It's better to take hold of a mad dog by the ears than to take part in someone else's argument.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔfa ye nwo wurawura edwirɛ bɔ ɔmva ye nwo nu ne, ɔte kyɛ ebie bɔ ɔsɔ kyea bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ ɔ ye so nu ɔ.

english_verse: It's no crazier to shoot sharp and flaming arrows
translation_verse: Bɔnamvoɛ bɔ ofindi see, agyaen ne ewue ne, kyɛbɔ ɔte ne,

english_verse: than to cheat someone and say, “I was only fooling!”
translation_verse: sɔ ala yeɛ sona bɔ ɔlakalaka obiɛngo, ná ɔkã kyɛ, “Oo, né mefa medi angorɛ” nen, ye koso ɔte ɔ.

english_verse: Where there is no fuel a fire goes out; where there is no gossip arguments come to an end.
translation_verse: Sɛ eyein nne see nu a, onua, yeɛ sɛ nzekurebɔlɛniɛ nne berɛ a, ngondii bo pɛ.

english_verse: There is nothing so delicious as the taste of gossip! It melts in your mouth.
translation_verse: Nzekurebɔlɛniɛ ye noa dwirɛ te menemene, edwirɛ ne woroworo wɔ.

english_verse: Hiding hateful thoughts behind smooth talk is like coating a clay pot with a cheap glaze.
translation_verse: Sona noa dwirɛ menemene bɔ bɔne adwene wɔ ye si ne, ɔte kyɛ ɛdwetɛ fiɛ bɔ bafa bama kukue nwo ɔ.

english_verse: The pleasant talk of an enemy hides more evil plans
translation_verse: Pɔfoɛ noa dwirɛ te menemene, nakoso ɔbɔ nnakannaka porɛ wɔ ye ti anu.

english_verse: than can be counted— so don't believe a word!
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔkã ye dwirɛ fɛfɛɛfɛ a, nnede ye di, ofikyɛ akyiwadeɛ nzoo wɔ ye ti anu.

english_verse: If you dig a pit, you will fall in; if you start a stone rolling, it will roll back on you.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔpɛ kumaa ne, ɔkɔte kɔtɔ nu, yeɛ sona bɔ omunu nyɔboɛ ne, nyɔboɛ ne kosa ye si kɔɔtɔ ye so.

english_verse: Watch out for anyone who tells lies and flatters— they are out to get you.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔlakalaka ye mmango ne, okyi bɛ, yeɛ bɔ ɔfa ye noa dɛfɛdɛfɛ ne, ɔma mmenia kɔ amaneɛ nu.

english_verse: Don't brag about tomorrow! Each day brings its own surprises.
translation_verse: Nnɛfa ɛhema hoahoa wɔ nwo, ofikyɛ ɛnze alehyeleɛ nu dwirɛ.

english_verse: Stones and sand are heavy, but trouble caused by a fool is a much heavier load.
translation_verse: Nyɔboɛ te kubuu, yeɛ anweaa nu yɛ no de, nakoso kwaseaa ye yaafɛlɛ tra bɛ munyɔ.

english_verse: An angry person is dangerous, but a jealous person is even worse.
translation_verse: Ɛyaafɛlɛ ti anu yɛ se, yeɛ ahonehulɛ tra so, nakoso nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina nungunɛ noa ɔ?

english_verse: You can trust a friend who corrects you, but kisses from an enemy are nothing but lies.
translation_verse: Wɔ damvo twi wɔ nyunu a, nahorɛ wɔ nu, nakoso sɛ pɔfoɛ yɛ wɔ atuu po a, ɔte nnakannaka.

english_verse: If you have had enough to eat, honey doesn't taste good, but if you are really hungry, you will eat anything.
translation_verse: Sona ko yi a, woɛ nyɛ ye akɔnnɔ; nakoso bɔ ɛhɔen ku ye de, aleɛ weewee biala yɛ ye fɛ.

english_verse: When you are far from home, you feel like a bird without a nest.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ofi ye awuro kokyinikyini ne, ɔte kyɛ anomaa bɔ ofi ye saen nu kokyinikyini ɔ.

english_verse: The sweet smell of incense can make you feel good, but true friendship is better still.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ sakyeɛfona ne ayirefona ma sona nye gye ne, sɔ ala yeɛ adamvoa nu fɛɛ, bɔ ɔte foɛtulɛ paa bɔ ɔfa ma wɔ te ɔ.

english_verse: Don't desert an old friend of your family or visit your relatives when you are in trouble. A friend nearby is better than relatives far away.
translation_verse: Nnɛpo wɔ damvo ne wɔ baba damvo; yeɛ sɛ edwirɛ to wɔ a, nnɛkɔ eliɛma awuro, na mmom sona bɔ ɔte pingye wɔ ne, ɔkɔhora kɔboka wɔ kɔtra eliɛma bɔ ɔwɔ dedeede ɔ.

english_verse: My child, show good sense! Then I will be happy and able to answer anyone who criticizes me.
translation_verse: Mma, sua nworɛ ma me nye gye, amaa ɔnate so manya mmuayɛɛ mama ebiala bɔ okodwudwo kotia me ɔ.

english_verse: Be cautious and hide when you see danger— don't be stupid and walk right into trouble.
translation_verse: Badwemma nwu musue bɔ ɔkɔwa ɔ, na ɔtwe ye nwo kɔfea, nakoso bɛ bɔ b’adwene te nganga de, bɛfa bɛ ti bekowura nu benwu amaneɛ.

english_verse: You deserve to lose your coat if you loan it to someone to guarantee payment for the debt of a stranger.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie di ɛwɔfoɛ agyinamuɛ a, de sɔ sona ne tena fa sie, yeɛ sɛ odi ebie bɔ ofi maen bie aso agyinamuɛ a, de awowaa fa sie.

english_verse: A loud greeting early in the morning is the same as a curse.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔpɛ aleɛ teatea nu kã saleɛ dwirɛ kyire obiɛngo ne, bekobu ye dwirɛ ne kyɛ ɔte amoenwaa.

english_verse: The steady dripping of rain and the nagging of a wife are one and the same.
translation_verse: Braa bɔ okuro ngondii ne, ɔne asuso mmerɛ nzue bɔ ɔnyakyi pepenɛ ɔ bɛte pɛ.

english_verse: It's easier to catch the wind or hold olive oil in your hand than to stop a nagging wife.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛpena kyɛ ɛma braa ne yakyi a, ɔte kyɛ ɛma mvrama yakyi tulɛ ɔ, anaa ɔte kyɛ ɛfa wɔ sa famaa ebuma ngoo ɔ.

english_verse: Just as iron sharpens iron, friends sharpen the minds of each other.
translation_verse: Bɛfa buralɛ yeɛ besi buralɛ ɔ, na sɔ ala yeɛ sona ma sona adwene nu bukye ɔ.

english_verse: Take care of a tree, and you will eat its fruit; look after your master, and you will be praised.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔnea borɔdoma bakaa so ne, odi ye mma ne bie, yeɛ bɔ ɔso ye mene ne koso, ye mene kɔhyɛ ye animnyam.

english_verse: You see your face in a mirror and your thoughts in the minds of others.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ sona nea nzue nu a onwu ye nyunu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ sona ye ti anu adwene okyire ye sona sue ɔ.

english_verse: Death and the grave are never satisfied, and neither are humans.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ ɛborɔ ne Abadɔn bɛ ko nyi le ne, sɔ ala yeɛ kuro sona nye ɔneanea a ɔmvɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Gold and silver are tested in a red-hot furnace, but we are tested by praise.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ bɛfa bokyea bɛpɔ ɛdwetɛ nwo, ná bɛfa afaa bɛpɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ nwo ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛbɔ sona aba so a, benwu kyɛbɔ osi te ɔ.

english_verse: No matter how hard you beat a fool, you can't pound out the foolishness.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛfa dwɔmaa si kwaseaa ɛfra aburoo wɔ duwaa nu po a, ye gyiminɛ ne ngofi ye nu ngotu.

english_verse: You should take good care of your sheep and goats,
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ enwu kyɛbɔ wɔ mmoaen b’aporɛnuserɛ osi te ɔ, yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛnea wɔ nyɛmmoa mɔ so yé;

english_verse: After the hay is cut and the new growth appears and the harvest is over,
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛpɛ ɛserɛ, ná foforɛ fifi, ná bɛpɛ mmokaa nemɔ aso ndire bɛboaboa ye noa besie a,

english_verse: you can sell lambs and goats to buy clothes and land.
translation_verse: ye de ekonya mmoaen nwo nwiaa kɔfa kɔyɛ wɔ tena, ekonya mbɔngye kɔtɔne bɛ kɔfa kɔtɔ aseɛ;

english_verse: From the milk of the goats, you can make enough cheese to feed your family and all your servants.
translation_verse: ekonya mbɔngye nyɔfonesue somaa kɔyɛ w’aleɛ, w’awuro ama aleɛ, ɔne w’afaneɛ mmaayaa mɔ bɛ noa aleɛ.

english_verse: Wicked people run away when no one chases them, but those who live right are as brave as lions.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ nwati wɔ aberɛ bɔ ebiala mvoa ye ɔ, na teneneeniɛ de, ye hue yɛ se te kyɛ gyata.

english_verse: In time of civil war there are many leaders, but a sensible leader restores law and order.
translation_verse: Sɛ mmeraatolɛ wɔ maen nu a, nu maenbulɛfoɛ bɛyɛ pee; nakoso sɛ onya maenbulɛniɛ nimdeɛniɛ bɔ ɔte badwemma a, nu dwo fɔnwoo maa ogyina ye gya so.

english_verse: When someone poor takes over and mistreats the poor, it's like a heavy rain destroying the crops.
translation_verse: Ehianiɛ bɔ okosisi ehianiɛ ne, ɔte kyɛ esue bɔ ɔtɔ titititi sɛkye eboo nu aleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Criminals don't know what justice means, but all who respect the Lord understand it completely.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ nde pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ bo, nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛpena AWURADE si atee ne de, bɛte ye mukoraa bo.

english_verse: It's better to be poor and live right, than to be rich and dishonest.
translation_verse: Ehianiɛ bɔ ye bra te sannwuu ne, ɔte paa tra sikaniɛ bɔ ye suban ɔtte mayee ɔ.

english_verse: It makes good sense to obey the Law of God, but you disgrace your parents if you make friends with worthless nobodies.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ odi mmeraa so ne, ɔte baa nworɛniɛ, nakoso bɔ ɔfa ye nwo bɔ asanzafoɛ ne de, ɔtwetwe animguaseɛ brɛ ɔse.

english_verse: If you make money by charging high interest rates, you will lose it all to someone who cares for the poor.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔnate aminɛlilɛ ne bosea nwo nzihoɛ so onya ye nwo ne, ye anwonya bɔ ɔboaboa ye noa ne, okodi ebie bɔ ɔse ehiafoɛ anwumvoin ɔ ye berɛ.

english_verse: God cannot stand the prayers of anyone who disobeys his Law.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie prapra ye so asi wɔ mmeraa ne anwo a, ye mbaeɛ po ɔte akyiwadeɛ.

english_verse: By leading good people to sin, you dig a pit for yourself, but all who live right will have a bright future.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ odiedie teneneefoɛ maa bɛyɔ bɔne ne, ɔkɔtɔ ye bɔbɔ ye kumaa bɔ wafu ɔ nu; nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛ bra te sannwuu ne de, okoyie bɛ yé.

english_verse: The rich think highly of themselves, but anyone poor and sensible sees right through them.
translation_verse: Sikaniɛ bu ye nwo kyɛ ɔte nworɛniɛ, nakoso ehianiɛ bɔ ɔte badwemma ne de, ɔma sikaniɛ ne bo da so.

english_verse: When an honest person wins, it's time to celebrate; when crooks are in control, it's best to hide.
translation_verse: Teneneefoɛ di ngonim a, ɔte anigye piri, nakoso sɛ bɔnefoɛ nya tumi a, mmenia nwati bɛkɔfea.

english_verse: If you don't confess your sins, you will be a failure. But God will be merciful if you confess your sins and give them up.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔkata ye mmeraatolɛ so ne, ongoyie ye yé, nakoso bɔ ɔkã, ná ɔyakyi ye yɔlɛ ne, bekonwu ye anwumvoin.

english_verse: The Lord blesses everyone who is afraid to do evil, but if you are cruel, you will end up in trouble.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ mmerɛ biala osuro Nyameɛ ne, onya saleɛ, nakoso bɔ ye so yɛ se ne de, musue kɔto ye.

english_verse: A ruler who mistreats the poor is like a roaring lion or a bear hunting for food.
translation_verse: Maen panyi bɔ ɔfa atianuserɛ di mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo so ne, ɔte kyɛ gyata bɔ opo anaa kwabrafo bɔ ye nye aboro ɔ.

english_verse: A heartless leader is a fool, but anyone who refuses to get rich by cheating others will live a long time.
translation_verse: Maen panyi bɔ ɔnze nworɛ ne, ɔhyɛ ye mmenia so paa, nakoso bɔ okyi anwonya fiɛ ne de, okonyi kɔhyɛ.

english_verse: Don't give help to murderers! Make them stay on the run for as long as they live.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie di obiɛngo wue nwo fɔ a, ɔkɔnwati toonn kɔfa kɔhɔ ewue nu, na nnɛma ebiala si ye ate.

english_verse: Honesty will keep you safe, but everyone who is crooked will suddenly fall.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ odi nahorɛ ne, okonya ngoa, nakoso bɔ ɔnate atee tɛɛ so ne de, ye ayieleɛ koyie ye mvum nu.

english_verse: Work hard, and you will have a lot of food; waste time, and you will have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ ye aseɛ so boo ne, onya aleɛ pee, nakoso bɔ odi nningyein mbaen mbaen si ne de, ehiaa te mata ye.

english_verse: God blesses his loyal people, but punishes all who want to get rich quick.
translation_verse: Nahorɛniɛ konya saleɛ pee, nakoso sona bɔ ɔpere ye nwo onya ye nwo ndɛndɛ ne de, ɔngɔfa ye nwo ngoli tɔtorɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: It isn't right to be unfair, but some people can be bribed with only a piece of bread.
translation_verse: Mmenia nu nyeyemuɛ ɔtte mayee, nakoso aleɛ kaaba bie po ɔkora ma sona yɔ bɔne.

english_verse: Don't be selfish and eager to get rich— you will end up worse off than you can imagine.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔperepere ye nwo nya ye nwo ne, ɔte anyeboroborolɛniɛ, na ɔndwene kyɛ ehiaa kɔwa ye so ɔ.

english_verse: If you cheat your parents and don't think it's wrong, you are a common thief.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ owua ɔse ne oni, ná ose kyɛ, “Ɛhe de, nna mmeraatolɛ ɔ” ahɔ ne, obiɛngo ole awerɔm awueniɛ.

english_verse: Selfish people cause trouble, but you will live a full life if you trust the Lord.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye nye boro nikyee ne, ɔtwetwe ngondii ba, nakoso bɔ ɔfa ye wora wura AWURADE nu ne de, okoyie ye yé.

english_verse: Only fools would trust what they alone think, but if you live by wisdom, you will do all right.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔfa ye nwo to ye nworɛ so ne, ɔte kwaseaa, nakoso ebiala bɔ ɔfa nworɛ to ye brabɔlɛ nwo ne, okonya ngoa.

english_verse: Giving to the poor will keep you from poverty, but if you close your eyes to their needs, everyone will curse you.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔkyɛ ehiafoɛ nikyee ne, nikye fee nwo ngohia ye, nakoso bɔ okobu ye nye kogua bɛ mmokalɛ so ne de, amoenwaa pee kɔwa ye so.

english_verse: When crooks are in control, everyone tries to hide, but when they lose power, good people are everywhere.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ nya tumi a, mmenia nwati bɛkɔfea, na sɛ bɔnefoɛ bɛ boso nua a, teneneefoɛ bɛyɛ pee.

english_verse: If you keep being stubborn after many warnings, you will suddenly discover you have gone too far.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ bɛtaa betwi ye nyunu a ogua ye so asi ne, musue bɔ ɔkɔto ye mvum nu ne, ongonya ye sɔbea.

english_verse: When justice rules a nation, everyone is glad; when injustice rules, everyone groans.
translation_verse: Sɛ teneneefoɛ bedi maen so a, nu mmenia di ahurusi, nakoso sɛ bɔnefoɛ di so a, nu mmenia sũ gua bɛ kunu.

english_verse: If you love wisdom your parents will be glad, but chasing after bad women will cost you everything.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye nye gye nworɛ nwo ne, ɔma ye baba nye gye, nakoso sona bɔ ɔne gyanderafoɛ yeɛ betu nu ne de, ɔbɔ hwea.

english_verse: An honest ruler makes the nation strong; a ruler who takes bribes will bring it to ruin.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛhene fa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ bu maen a, maen ne nya ngɔsoɛ, nakoso bɔ ode fea-ase-ma de, ɔbɔ maen ne.

english_verse: Flattery is nothing less than setting a trap.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔkã adɛfɛdɛfɛ dwirɛ kyire obiɛngo ne, né osua obiɛngo ne gya ngaen.

english_verse: Your sins will catch you, but everyone who lives right will sing and celebrate.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ, ye mmeraatolɛ kakyi ngaen kye ye, nakoso teneneeniɛ de, ɔto dwein di ahurusi.

english_verse: The wicked don't care about the rights of the poor, but good people do.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ dwene bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ nwo, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, olle sɔ adwene ne.

english_verse: Sneering at others is a spark that sets a city on fire; using good sense can put out the flames of anger.
translation_verse: Ngorohoɛfoɛ bɛto kuro nu see, nakoso nworɛfoɛ de, bɛma ahone tɔ nzue nu.

english_verse: Be wise and don't sue a fool. You won't get satisfaction, because all the fool will do is sneer and shout.
translation_verse: Sɛ nworɛniɛ ne kwaseaa bɛbɔ nguro a, kwaseaa ne teatea nu, anaa ɔsere bɔ ɔmbɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: A murderer hates everyone who is honest and lives right.
translation_verse: Kodiawufoɛ bɛpɔ sona bɔ ye bra te sannwuu ɔ, nakoso teneneefoɛ de, bɛpena ye kra ngoa.

english_verse: Don't be a fool and quickly lose your temper— be sensible and patient.
translation_verse: Kwaseaa fɛ yaa a, ɔda ye ali, nakoso nworɛniɛ de, ɔfɛ yaa a ɔhyɛ ye nwo so.

english_verse: A ruler who listens to lies will have corrupt officials.
translation_verse: Maenbulɛniɛ bɔ otie ngondombo dwirɛ ne, ye mbanyi amukoraa bɛyɛ bɔnefoɛ.

english_verse: The poor and all who abuse them must each depend on God for light.
translation_verse: Nikyee ko he ma ehianiɛ ne apoobɔlɛniɛ bɛte pɛ: AWURADE yeɛ ɔma bɛ munyɔ bɛ nye nwu nikye ɔ.

english_verse: Kings who are fair to the poor will rule a long time.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛhene fa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ di ehiafoɛ dwirɛ a, ye ahennie bo kotimu berɛ daa.

english_verse: Correct your children, and they will be wise; children out of control disgrace their mothers.
translation_verse: Mbire ne bɛ nyunu hanɛ ma nworɛ, nakoso baa bɔ bato ye asaworam ne de, ɔtwetwe animguaseɛ brɛ oni.

english_verse: Crime increases when crooks are in power, but law-abiding citizens will see them fall.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɔnefoɛ bɛsone a, mmeraatolɛ sone pee, na teneneefoɛ konwu bɔnefoɛ nemɔ b’asefinɛ.

english_verse: If you correct your children, they will bring you peace and happiness.
translation_verse: Tea ɛwa, na ɔkɔma wɔ so anu kɔtɔ wɔ, amba, ɔkɔma wɔ nye kɔgye.

english_verse: Without guidance from God law and order disappear, but God blesses everyone who obeys his Law.
translation_verse: Nekaa bɔ mmenia bɛndwene kyẽa bie ngɔsoɛ nwo ne, maen ne anu yɛ basaa, nakoso sona bɔ odi mmeraa ne aso ne, onya saleɛ.

english_verse: Even when servants are smart, it takes more than words to make them obey.
translation_verse: Bɛmva bɛ noa mbaen bɛndea akoaa, ofikyɛ ɔte edwirɛ ne abo po a, ongoli so.

english_verse: There is more hope for a fool than for someone who speaks without thinking.
translation_verse: Yeɛ anwu sona bɔ ɔpe dwirɛ nwo ɔ? Anyelasoɛ wɔ berɛ ma kwaseaa tra sɔ sona ne.

english_verse: Slaves that you treat kindly from their childhood will cause you sorrow.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛkorɔkorɔ wɔ kanganiɛ fi ye ngwadaa nu a, nziɛ ye ɔkɔyɛ ye nwo kyɛ baa.

english_verse: A person with a quick temper stirs up arguments and commits a lot of sins.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ okuro ɛyaafɛlɛ ne, ɔtwetwe ngondii ba, yeɛ bɔ ɔma ye ahone hu ne, ɔto mmeraa pee.

english_verse: Too much pride brings disgrace; humility leads to honor.
translation_verse: Sona ye anwomasoɛ brɛ ye ase, nakoso bɔ ɔte sunzum nu awiɛmvoɛ ne de, okonya animnyam.

english_verse: If you take part in a crime you are your worst enemy, because even under oath you can't tell the truth.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔne awueniɛ bekotu nu ne, ɔpɔ ye bɔbɔ ye kra, ɔte amoenwaa ne de, nakoso ɔnga nahorɛ.

english_verse: Don't fall into the trap of being a coward— trust the Lord, and you will be safe.
translation_verse: Esuro sona a, né asua wɔ nwo ngaen, nakoso ebiala bɔ ɔfa ye wora wura AWURADE nu ne de, ye nwo sonn.

english_verse: Many try to make friends with a ruler, but justice comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Mmenia pee bɛpena maenbulɛniɛ ye nyunu animnyam, nakoso AWURADE berɛ yeɛ sona nya pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Good people and criminals can't stand each other.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛɛniɛ te teneneeniɛ akyiwadeɛ, yeɛ sona bɔ ye bra te sannwuu ne, ɔte bɔnefoɛ akyiwadeɛ.

english_verse: These are the sayings and the message of Agur son of Jakeh. Someone cries out to God, “I am completely worn out! How can I last?
translation_verse: Yake awa Agure noa dwirɛ bɔ ɔte ngɔmhyɛlɛ ne, ye ɛhe. Biaa ne sele Yitiɛl, osele Yitiɛl ne Yukale kyɛ,

english_verse: I am far too stupid to be considered human.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, nde sona mbaen bɔ nnde sona ɔ; nimdeɛ bɔ sona le ye ne, nnne bie.

english_verse: I never was wise, and I don't understand what God is like.”
translation_verse: Nnzuane nworɛ, yeɛ Krongronniɛ ne koso, nnne ye nwo nimdeɛ biala.

english_verse: Has anyone gone up to heaven and come back down? Has anyone grabbed hold of the wind? Has anyone wrapped up the sea or marked out boundaries for the earth? If you know of any who have done such things, then tell me their names and their children's names.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ wafo wahɔ nyameɛso ná wadwu wawa ɔ? Nwa yeɛ waboaboa mvrama noa wɔ ye sa nu ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ɔfa ɛtena ɔbɔ nzue mɔ nonongu ɔ? Nwa yeɛ wafa aseɛ ye ti ne ye ti amukoraa wasiesie berɛ ɔ? Ye dumaa li sɛɛ, yeɛ ɔwa wora ye dumaa li sɛɛ? Sɛ ɛse a, kã kyire me e!

english_verse: Everything God says is true— and it's a shield for all who come to him for safety.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ biala te sannwuu, ɔte akokyɛm ma bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ wora bewura ye nu ɔ.

english_verse: Don't change what God has said! He will correct you and show that you are a liar.
translation_verse: Nnɛfa edwirɛ biala boka ye noa dwirɛ ne aso, ɔba ye sɔ a, okohwi wɔ nyunu maa bekonwu kyɛ ɛte anoanu.

english_verse: There are two things, Lord, I want you to do for me before I die:
translation_verse: Nningyein nyɔ yeɛ mesrɛ mefi wɔ berɛ ɔ: nnɛfa bɔ me atianuserɛ koraka né mawu.

english_verse: Make me absolutely honest and don't let me be too poor or too rich. Give me just what I need.
translation_verse: Ye bra mbaen mbaen ne nnakannaka fi me so kɔ dedeede, nnɛmaa medi hiaa, yeɛ nnɛmaa menya me nwo tam, na mmom, ma me me noa aleɛ bɔ mehia ɔ;

english_verse: If I have too much to eat, I might forget about you; if I don't have enough, I might steal and disgrace your name.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so mannya me nwo tam, ná mambo wɔ manga kyɛ, “Nwa ole AWURADE?” Afei koso, ná wanhia me ma manwua, ná mamva fiɛ manga me Nyameɛ dumaa.

english_verse: Don't tell a slave owner something bad about one of the slaves. That slave will curse you, and you will be in trouble.
translation_verse: Nnɛkã akoaa nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ kyire ye mene, ɛyɔ sɔ a, ɔkɔwa wɔ amoen, na ekoli fɔ.

english_verse: Some people curse their father and even their mother;
translation_verse: Mmenia biemɔ wɔ berɛ a, bɛnoma bɛ baba, yeɛ bɛnga kyɛ bɛ maame onya saleɛ.

english_verse: Some people are stuck-up and act like snobs;
translation_verse: Mmenia biemɔ wɔ berɛ a, bɛ nye nzɔ sona, na bɛ nye tra bɛ ndo nwiaa!

english_verse: The world of the dead and a childless wife, the thirsty earth and a flaming fire.
translation_verse: Bɛ ole: Ɛborɔ, koɛ bɔ ɔte mmotaen, aseɛ bɔ ɔmeme nzue a ɔnde ye, yeɛ see bɔ ɔnga kyɛ, “Ɔte paa, maa nnua” ɔ.

english_verse: Don't make fun of your father or disobey your mother— crows will peck out your eyes, and buzzards will eat the rest of you.
translation_verse: Anyeɛ bɔ ɔgoro ye baba anwo, ɔne bɔ ɔpo kyɛ okotie ye maame dwirɛ ne, bɔnza nu anene mɔ kotutu sɔ anyeɛ ne, na kɔleɛ mma mɔ kosuso koli.

english_verse: There are three or four things I cannot understand:
translation_verse: Nningyein nza yeɛ bɛyɛ me nwanwa paa ɔ; yoo, nna de, mende ye bo. Bɛ ole:

english_verse: How eagles fly so high or snakes crawl on rocks, how ships sail the ocean or people fall in love.
translation_verse: kɔleɛ atee bɔ otu fa so wɔ ewienu ɔ, ewoo atee bɔ ɔnate so wɔ nyɔbotaen so ɔ, ɛlɛen atee bɔ ɔnate so wɔ ɛpo so ɔ, atee bɔ bienzua ne taluwa b’adwene si yia wɔ ehurolɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: An unfaithful wife says, “Sleeping with another man is as natural as eating.”
translation_verse: Brasua bɔ ɔsɛkye agyaa ne, sɔaa yeɛ ye suban te ɔ: odidi, ná afei waprapra ye noa nwo wahã kyɛ, “Nnyɔle bɔne biala.”

english_verse: There are three or four things that make the earth tremble and are unbearable:
translation_verse: Nningyein nza yeɛ ɔma aseɛ woso ɔ, yeɛ nningyein nna yeɛ ɔngora ye noa gyina ɔ. Bɛ ole:

english_verse: A slave who becomes king, a fool who eats too much,
translation_verse: Kanganiɛ bɔ okoli hene ɔ, kwaseaa bɔ okodidi kɔma ye ko koyi ɔ,

english_verse: a hateful woman who finds a husband, and a slave who takes the place of the woman who owns her.
translation_verse: brasua bɔ benguro ye ná afei wanya biaa wagya ɔ, yeɛ abaawa bɔ okoli ye mene brasua bia ɔ.

english_verse: On this earth four things are small but very wise:
translation_verse: Nningyein nna biemɔ wɔ aseɛ ye aso bɔ bɛte mmaa mmaa, nakoso bɛte nworɛfoɛ paa. Bɛ ɛhe:

english_verse: Ants, who seem to be feeble, but store up food all summer long;
translation_verse: Ngyiregyiraa te ngaka bɔ bɛ nwo nyɛ se ɔ, nakoso wawa pe a yeɛ bɛpena b’aleɛ besie ɔ;

english_verse: badgers, who seem to be weak, but live among the rocks;
translation_verse: Amoakua mɔ bɛte ngaka bɔ bɛ nwo nyɛ se ɔ, nakoso bɛpɛ bɛ bɔen wɔ nyɔboɛ nyɔboɛ nu;

english_verse: locusts, who have no king, but march like an army;
translation_verse: Mmɛbɛ mɔ belle hene biala, nakoso sɛ bɛ mukoraa besi nu bɛkɔ a, bɛ nnidisoɛ ne te dibea dibea;

english_verse: lizards, which can be caught in your hand, but sneak into palaces.
translation_verse: sona kora kye laleɛ ɔfa tira ye sa nu, nakoso ahemvie yeɛ laleɛ mɔ bɛwɔ ɔ.

english_verse: those proud roosters, those mountain goats, and those rulers who have no enemies.
translation_verse: akɔnyima, abɔngye nyii, yeɛ ɛhene bɔ bɛyyɛle ye so ɛlɔen biala ɔ.

english_verse: If you are foolishly bragging or planning something evil, then stop it now!
translation_verse: Sɛ ayɛ kwaseaa amoma wɔ nwo so, anaakyɛ abɔ porɛ tɛɛ a, ye de fa wɔ sa to wɔ noa.

english_verse: If you churn milk you get butter; if you pound on your nose, you get blood— and if you stay angry, you get in trouble.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ betwi nandwie nyɔfonesue maa ɔbɔ kunguma, ná bemia bonyi pee a mogya fi nu ba ne, sɔ ala yeɛ sɛ ehu sona ahone a, ngondii si ɔ.

english_verse: These are the sayings that King Lemuel of Massa was taught by his mother.
translation_verse: Ɛhe te Nana Lemuel noa dwirɛ, foɛ bɔ ye maame tuli ye ɔ:

english_verse: My son Lemuel, you were born in answer to my prayers, so listen carefully.
translation_verse: Nzu ɔ, mma bienzua, me kunu ba, nzu ɔ? Nzu ɔ, mma bienzua bɔ ɔnate bɔhyɛ so yeɛ nwole wɔ ɔ?

english_verse: Don't waste your life chasing after women! This has ruined many kings.
translation_verse: Nnɛsɛkye w’anwoserɛ wɔ mmrasua nwo, nnɛfa wɔ nwo ma bɛ bɔ bɛma ahemvo mɔ bɛtɔ ase ne.

english_verse: Kings and leaders should not get drunk or even want to drink.
translation_verse: O Lemuel, ɔtte mayee mma ahemvo mɔ kyɛ bɛkɔno nzaa ɔ, ɔtte mayee mma ahemvo mɔ; anaa maenbulɛfoɛ kyɛ bekohuro nzaa serɛ ɔ;

english_verse: Drinking makes you forget your responsibilities, and you mistreat the poor.
translation_verse: bɛno a, anyɔ a bɛ wora kofi mmeraa ne, na bekobua ebiala bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ɔ ndɛengyea.

english_verse: Beer and wine are only for the dying or for those who have lost all hope.
translation_verse: Fa nzaa serɛ ma sona bɔ ɔla awusu ɔ, ná fa bobe nzaa ma sona bɔ odi aworabɔlɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Let them drink and forget how poor and miserable they feel.
translation_verse: Maa ɔno ma ye wora fi ye anwokyere ne, ná wangaye amaneɛ bɔ ɔfa nu ne ko.

english_verse: But you must defend those who are helpless and have no hope.
translation_verse: Kã bie ma bɛ bɔ bɛ noa ndwu dwaa nu ɔ, nea kyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ne bengosisi ye ɔ.

english_verse: Be fair and give justice to the poor and homeless. In Praise of a Good Wife
translation_verse: Te wɔ noa dwudwo, bua ndɛen bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ, di ehiafoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ bɛ dwirɛ ma bɛ. Braa paa nwo ayɛyelɛ

english_verse: A truly good wife is the most precious treasure a man can find!
translation_verse: Braa paa, nwa yeɛ okonya ɔ? Odi mu tra agudeɛ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Her husband depends on her, and she never lets him down.
translation_verse: Ohu fa ye wora wura ye nu, na ɔnate so ohu nhia hwee.

english_verse: She is good to him every day of her life,
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ ohu paa bɔ ɔmva edwirɛ tɛɛ biala nni ye, mmerɛ biala bɔ braa ne te ase ɔ.

english_verse: and with her own hands she gladly makes clothes.
translation_verse: Ɔpena boaen nwiaa ne gyese si atee, na ofia ye kunu ɔfa ye sa yɔ adwuma.

english_verse: She is like a sailing ship that brings food from across the sea.
translation_verse: Ɔte kyɛ dwadiniɛ ye lɛen mɔ, ɔfa ye aleɛ fi dedeede ba.

english_verse: She gets up before daylight to prepare food for her family and for her servants.
translation_verse: Ɔpɛ aleɛ dwɔso, ɔyɛ aleɛ ma ye awuro ama, na okyire ye mmaawa mɔ adwuma maa bɛyɔ.

english_verse: She knows when to buy or sell, and she stays busy until late at night.
translation_verse: Onwu kyɛ ye adwuma kɔ so, na ye kanea nnua kɔngɔen.

english_verse: and she helps the poor and the needy.
translation_verse: Ɔma ye sa sõ ehiafoɛ so, na ɔboka bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ.

english_verse: Her family has warm clothing, and so she doesn't worry when it snows.
translation_verse: Sɛ asukɔtwea tɔ a, ye kunu ndete ye wɔ ye awuro ama nwo, ofikyɛ ye awuro ama mukoraa bɛhera kundu nyɔboɛ serɛ nyemenenyemene.

english_verse: She does her own sewing, and everything she wears is beautiful.
translation_verse: Ɔnwo ye bɔbɔ ye bomo, ɔhera nwera paa ne kende.

english_verse: Her husband is a well-known and respected leader in the city.
translation_verse: Ohu te sona bɔ mmenia bu ye badwa nu ɔ, na kuro berɛ mbanyi bɛbɔ dwaa a, ɔte nu bie.

english_verse: She makes clothes to sell to the shop owners.
translation_verse: Ɔnwo nwera ndaadeɛ tɔne ye, na ye berɛ yeɛ dwadifoɛ betu abɔsoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: She is strong and graceful, as well as cheerful about the future.
translation_verse: Anwoserɛ ne anidie te ye tena bɔ ɔkera ɔ, na mmerɛ bɔ ɔla ye nyunu ne, odi ye nwo ahurusi.

english_verse: Her words are sensible, and her advice is thoughtful.
translation_verse: Odwudwo nworɛ nu, na otu paayɛlɛ nwo foɛ.

english_verse: She takes good care of her family and is never lazy.
translation_verse: Ɔnea toto bɔ ɔkɔ so wɔ ye awuro ɔ yé, na ɔtte foen wɔ nikyee biala nwo.

english_verse: Her children praise her, and with great pride her husband says,
translation_verse: Ye mma dwɔso gyina, na bɛfrɛ ye “Saleɛ braa,” na ohu koso ɔye ye ayɛ kyɛ,

english_verse: “There are many good women, but you are the best!”
translation_verse: “Mmrasua pee bɛte mmrasua bɔ begya bɛ ɔ, nakoso wɔ de, ɛpɛ bɛ mukoraa.”

english_verse: Charm can be deceiving, and beauty fades away, but a woman who honors the Lord deserves to be praised.
translation_verse: Sokooyɛlɛ te nnakannaka, yeɛ anwonyemene te mbaen, nakoso brasua bɔ osuro AWURADE de, ɔfata kyɛ bɛye ye ayɛ.

english_verse: Show her respect— praise her in public for what she has done.
translation_verse: Adwuma bɔ wayɔ ne, ɛ́mɔbɔ ye aba so, bɔ wayɔ ne, ɛ́mɔma onya ye nwo animnyam wɔ badwa nu.

english_verse: When the son of David was king in Jerusalem, he was known to be very wise, and he said:
translation_verse: Dawide awa Nworɛ Dwirɛhanɛniɛ, bɔ odi hene wɔ Yerusalem ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe.

english_verse: Nothing makes sense! Everything is nonsense. I have seen it all— nothing makes sense!
translation_verse: “Mbaen nu mbaen.” Nworɛ Dwirɛhanɛniɛ ne nwa nyoo: Mbaen nu mbaen! Ye mukoraa te mbaen!

english_verse: What is there to show for all of our hard work here on this earth?
translation_verse: Ɛfɛɛ worawora bɔ sona fɛ wɔ ewiase ye, nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ onya fi nu ɔ?

english_verse: People come, and people go, but still the world never changes.
translation_verse: Aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ko pɛ nu kɔ, né foforɛ koso awa, nakoso aseɛ de, otimu berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: The sun comes up, the sun goes down; it hurries right back to where it started from.
translation_verse: Eyia pukye, yeɛ eyia tɔ, na ɔma ye nwo yɛ nyera osa kɔ nekaa bɔ opukye fili ne.

english_verse: The wind blows south, the wind blows north; round and round it blows over and over again.
translation_verse: Mvrama bɔ kɔ ngwaen, ɔkakyi ye nwo osa kɔ sorɔ, mvrama ne pɛnepɛne ye nwo alaa, na ɔpɛ ye nwo tee osa ba ye boso.

english_verse: All rivers empty into the sea, but it never spills over; one by one the rivers return to their source.
translation_verse: Asue amukoraa bɛtengyɛ bɛkɔ ɛpo nu, nakoso ɛpo onyi; nzue sa ba asue nemɔ anu wɔ nekaa bɔ bɛtengyɛ befi ne, na bɛkɔ so besa bɛtengyɛ.

english_verse: All of life is far more boring than words could ever say. Our eyes and our ears are never satisfied with what we see and hear.
translation_verse: Nningyein amukoraa yie ɛfɛɛ, ɛfɛɛ bɔ sona ngora ye kã ɔ; anyeɛ nea nikyee a ɔnde ye, yeɛ asoɛ tie dwirɛ a onyi.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before; nothing is new, nothing under the sun.
translation_verse: Nikyee biala bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ ne, ɔkɔhɔ so kɔwɔ berɛ, bɔ bayɔ ye daa ne, bekosa bɛkɔyɔ, na nikyee foforɛ biala nne wiase.

english_verse: Someone might say, “Here is something new!” But it happened before, long before we were born.
translation_verse: Aso nikyee bie wɔ berɛ bɔ bɛkã ye nwo dwirɛ kyɛ, “Nea, ɛhe te nikye foforɛ” ɔ? Ɔwɔ berɛ fite tetetete koraka yeɛ yɛba ɔ.

english_verse: No one who lived in the past is remembered anymore, and everyone yet to be born will be forgotten too. It Is Senseless To Be Wise
translation_verse: Daa tete nningyein ne, bɛ nwo ngayeɛ biala nne berɛ, yeɛ nningyein bɔ kyẽa bie bɛbaawa ne koso, bengonya ngayeɛ wɔ bɛ bɔ bɛkɔwa nziɛ nemɔ bɛ berɛ. Nimdeɛ te mbaen

english_verse: I said these things when I lived in Jerusalem as king of Israel.
translation_verse: Me, Nworɛ Dwirɛhanɛniɛ, né nde Yisrael so hene wɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I tried to understand everything that happens here on earth. And God has made this so hard for us humans to do.
translation_verse: Mva nziele me nye so kyɛ, nikyee biala bɔ bɛyɔ ye wɔ ewiase ne, mefa nworɛ mepɛnzɛpɛnzɛ nu mete ye bo. Ɔte adwuma serɛ paa bɔ ye yɔlɛ nyɛ fɛ, bɔ Nyameɛ afa ato adasa so kyɛ bɛyere bɛ nwo bɛyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I have seen it all, and everything is just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Manwu nikyee biala bɔ bɛyɔ ye wiase ɔ, na tie, ye mukoraa te mbaen, na ɔte dadwene mbaen.

english_verse: If something is crooked, it can't be made straight; if something isn't there, it can't be counted.
translation_verse: Nikyee bɔ wakondo ne, bɛngɔhora ye tengyɛ, yeɛ nikyee bɔ ɔne berɛ ne, bɛka a ɔnyɛ yee.

english_verse: I said to myself, “You are by far the wisest person who has ever lived in Jerusalem. You are eager to learn, and you have learned a lot.”
translation_verse: Na ngane ye me ti anu kyɛ, “Masua nworɛ pee paa matra ebiala bɔ olili me nyunu moa wɔ Yerusalem ɔ, na nworɛ ne nimdeɛ ayɛ me ti anu tɛkyɛ.”

english_verse: Then I decided to find out all I could about wisdom and foolishness. Soon I realized that this too was as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Yiti mva nziele me nye so kyɛ ngɔpena nworɛ si atee, yeɛ afei kyɛ ngonwu ɛlaenbɔlɛ ne ngwaseasɛm ɔ. Na nwuni kyɛ ɛhe koso te dadwene mbaen.

english_verse: The more you know, the more you hurt; the more you understand, the more you suffer.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nworɛ pee nwunɛ ne ɛhawo pee yeɛ bɛnate ɔ, na ebiala bɔ onya nimdeɛ pee ne, ɔtwetwe amaneɛ pee brɛ ye nwo.

english_verse: I said to myself, “Have fun and enjoy yourself!” But this didn't make sense.
translation_verse: Ngane ye me ti anu kyɛ, “Bɔ sɔ bra ne bie, gye wɔ nye nea kyɛbɔ anigye si te ɔ.” Na ɛhe koso, ɔte mbaen.

english_verse: Laughing and having fun is crazy. What good does it do?
translation_verse: Na ngane kyɛ, “Ɛserelɛ te ɛlaenbɔlɛ! Yeɛ anigye koso, nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ so ɔ?”

english_verse: I wanted to find out what was best for us during the short time we have on this earth. So I decided to make myself happy with wine and find out what it means to be foolish, without really being foolish myself.
translation_verse: Mvale adwene kyɛ ngɔfa nzaa ngɔgye me nye, wɔ aberɛ bɔ mepena nworɛ si atee ɔ, yeɛ afei kyɛ ngɔyɔ ngwaseade ɔ, kɔpem kyɛ ngonwu bɔ ɔte paa ma adasa kyɛ bɛkɔyɔ ye wɔ ewiase, wɔ bɛ ngoa tikaape ye anu ɔ.

english_verse: I did some great things. I built houses and planted vineyards.
translation_verse: Nyɔle m’agyapadeɛ mbiri mbiri, nzisili me sua mɔ, na nyɔle me bobe boo mɔ.

english_verse: I had flower gardens and orchards full of fruit trees.
translation_verse: Nyɔle me bɔbɔ me turo mɔ, ɔne mmakaammaa boo, na nnuale mmakaa ahoroɔ bɔ besu mmaa ɔ.

english_verse: And I had pools where I could get water for the trees.
translation_verse: Mbepɛle abura mɔ, na nzesale nu nzue nguaguale mmakaa bɔ malua bɔ benyi frɔmfrɔm ne aso.

english_verse: I owned slaves, and their sons and daughters became my slaves. I had more sheep and goats than anyone who had ever lived in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ndotɔle nganga mmienzua ne mmrasua, na nyane nganga mɔ bɔ bɛwole bɛ wɔ m’awuro ɔ. Nyane nandwie ne mmoaen pee ndrale ebiala bɔ olili me nyunu moa wɔ Yerusalem ɔ.

english_verse: Foreign rulers brought me silver, gold, and precious treasures. Men and women sang for me, and I had many wives who gave me great pleasure.
translation_verse: Asa koso, mmoaboale ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ pee noa mvale, yeɛ nyane agudeɛ mvili ahemvo mɔ ne mbɔtam mbɔtam mɔ berɛ. Nyane edweintolɛfoɛ mmienzua ne mmrasua, bɔ bienzua kohia biala, ɔne sómaa pee.

english_verse: I was the most famous person who had ever lived in Jerusalem, and I was very wise.
translation_verse: Yiti nyɛle sona titire ndrale ebiala bɔ olili me nyunu moa wɔ Yerusalem ɔ, na ngɔle so nwuni nworɛ.

english_verse: Then I thought about everything I had done, including the hard work, and it was simply chasing the wind. Nothing on earth is worth the trouble. Wisdom Comes from God
translation_verse: Afei ndole me nye nneane me sa noa adwuma mukoraa, ɔne nningyein bɔ mafɛ mayɔ ne, na nwuni kyɛ ye mukoraa te mbaen, ɔte dadwene mbaen, na mvasoɛ biala nne so wɔ wiase. Nworɛ ne anigye

english_verse: I asked myself, “What can the next king do that I haven't done?” Then I decided to compare wisdom with foolishness and stupidity.
translation_verse: Yiti nhyɛle ye bo ndwenene nworɛ, ɛlaenbɔlɛ ne ngwaseasɛm nwo, ofikyɛ bɔ okoli me bia koli hene ne, nzikyɛ bieku yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔyɔ ɔ? Sana bɔ bali moa bayɔ ne ala.

english_verse: And I discovered that wisdom is better than foolishness, just as light is better than darkness.
translation_verse: Na nwuni kyɛ mvasoɛ wɔ nworɛ so tra ngwaseasɛm, kyɛbɔ mvasoɛ wɔ kanea so tra awosii ne.

english_verse: Wisdom is like having two good eyes; foolishness leaves you in the dark. But wise or foolish, we all end up the same.
translation_verse: Nworɛniɛ se nekaa bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, nakoso kwaseaa de, awosii nu yeɛ ɔnate ɔ. Nakoso nwuni kyɛ ayieleɛ komapɛ ne ala yeɛ oyie bɛ mukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: Finally, I said to myself, “Being wise got me nowhere! The same thing will happen to me that happens to fools. Nothing makes sense.
translation_verse: Na afei nzele me nwo kyɛ, “Ayieleɛ bɔ okoyie kwaseaa ne, me koso ebie ala yeɛ okoyie me ɔ. Sɛ ɔte sɔ de a, né nzu ati yeɛ manwu nworɛ matra bɛ ɔ?” Na mmuale me nwo kyɛ, ɛhe koso te mbaen.

english_verse: This made me hate life. Everything we do is painful; it's just as senseless as chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Yiti asetena yɛle me tɛ, ofikyɛ nikyee biala bɔ ɔkɔ so wɔ wiase ne, ɔte ɛhawo ma me; ye mukoraa te mbaen, na ɔte dadwene mbaen. Adwumayɔlɛ ne sikaa te mbaen

english_verse: Suddenly I realized that others would someday get everything I had worked for so hard, then I started hating it all.
translation_verse: Amba, adwuma worawora bɔ mafɛ me nwo mayɔ ye wɔ wiase ne, ɔyɛle me tɛ, ofikyɛ, nwuni kyɛ mebaayakyi ye berɛ mema me koliagyaa.

english_verse: Who knows if those people will be sensible or stupid? Either way, they will own everything I have earned by hard work and wisdom. It doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔse ɔ, kyɛ sɔ sona ne kɔyɛ nworɛniɛ oo, anaakyɛ kwaseaa oo? Nakoso agyapadeɛ biala bɔ mafa m’anwoserɛ ne me nworɛ mapena manya ye wɔ wiase ne, ye yeɛ okooli ye sa ɔ: Ɛhe koso te mbaen.

english_verse: When we use our wisdom, knowledge, and skill to get what we own, why do we have to leave it to someone who didn't work for it? This is senseless and wrong.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, ɔtɔ mmerɛ bie a, ebie bɔ wafa ye nworɛ ne ye nimdeɛ ne ye adwene wapena agyapadeɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔyakyi ye berɛ ma sona bɔ wamvɛ ye nwo ɔ bafa: Ɛhe koso te mbaen, na ɔte edwirɛ yealɛ piri paa.

english_verse: What do we really gain from all of our hard work?
translation_verse: Kuro sona ɛfɛɛ amukoraa ne adwenedwene bɔ ɔla ye so wɔ wiase ne, nzikyɛ mvasoɛ koraa yeɛ onya fi nu ɔ?

english_verse: Our bodies ache during the day, and work is torture. Then at night our thoughts are troubled. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, yealɛlilɛ wayi ye asetena nu tɛkyɛ, yeɛ ye adwuma koso te ye hawo. Odwu kɔngɔen po a, né wato ye ne adwenedwene: Ɛhe koso te mbaen.

english_verse: The best thing we can do is to enjoy eating, drinking, and working. I believe these are God's gifts to us,
translation_verse: Nikye paa biala nne berɛ mma sona ndra kyɛ okodidi, ɔkɔno ná ɔkɔfa bɔ wafɛ wanya ye ɔ ɔkɔgye ye nye ɔ. Na ɛhe koso, nwuni kyɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔfa ma ɔ;

english_verse: and no one enjoys eating and living more than I do.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ sɛ ɔnne nu a, ahaa nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kodidi, anaa nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora konya anigye ɔ?

english_verse: If we please God, he will make us wise, understanding, and happy. But if we sin, God will make us struggle for a living, then he will give all we own to someone who pleases him. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sona bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ne, ɔma ye nworɛ, nimdeɛ ne anigye; nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, Nyameɛ maa ɔpena agyapadeɛ gua berɛ ma sona bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ: Ɛhe koso te mbaen, na ɔte dadwene mbaen.

english_verse: Everything on earth has its own time and its own season.
translation_verse: Nikyee biala le ye mmerɛ bɔ ɔla berɛ ma ye ɔ, na edwirɛ biala le ye mmerɛ wɔ wiase:

english_verse: There is also a time for love and hate, for war and peace. What God Has Given Us To Do
translation_verse: sona dwirɛ hurolɛ le ye mmerɛ, yeɛ ɛpɔen le ye mmerɛ; koɛhonɛ le ye mmerɛ, yeɛ asomdwee le ye mmerɛ.

english_verse: What do we gain by all our hard work?
translation_verse: Nzikyɛ mvasoɛ koraa yeɛ adwumayɔlɛniɛ onya fi ye fɛɛ nu ɔ?

english_verse: I have seen what difficult things God demands of us.
translation_verse: Manwu adwuma serɛ bɔ Nyameɛ afa awura adasa sa kyɛ bɛfɛ bɛ nwo bɛyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: God makes everything happen at the right time. Yet none of us can ever fully understand all he has done, and he puts questions in our minds about the past and the future.
translation_verse: Wayɔ nikyee biala nyemenenyemene wɔ ye mmerɛ nu. Wafa mmerɛ bɔ olle ayieleɛ nwo adwene wawura kuro sona adwene nu, nakoso sona ngora nnwu bɔ Nyameɛ ayɔ ɔ, ofi ye bohyɛlɛ bɔ ɔkwaadwu ayieleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I know the best thing we can do is to always enjoy life,
translation_verse: Bɔ mese ole kyɛ, bɛte ase ye de, nikye paa biala nne berɛ mma bɛ ndra kyɛ bɛkɔgye bɛ nye, ná bɛkɔsɛpɛ bɛ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: because God's gift to us is the happiness we get from our food and drink and from the work we do.
translation_verse: Asa koso, sɛ sona biala didi, ɔno, ná ɔfa bɔ wafɛ wanya ye ɔ ɔgye ye nye a, né Nyameɛ akyɛdeɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Everything God has done will last forever; nothing he does can ever be changed. God has done all this, so that we will worship him.
translation_verse: Mese kyɛ nikyee biala bɔ Nyameɛ yɔ ne, ɔkɔtena berɛ daa. Ɛngɔhora ngɔfa bie ngɔboka so, yeɛ ɛngɔhora ngɔye bie ngofi nu. Nyameɛ yɔ ye sɔ, amaa ɔnate so sona biala asuro ye.

english_verse: Everything that happens has happened before, and all that will be has already been— God does everything over and over again. The Future Is Known Only to God
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ kekesaala ye ne, ɔwɔ berɛ dadadada; yeɛ bɔ ɔbaawa ne, ɔwɔ berɛ dadadada, na Nyameɛ ma bɔ wasi daa ne osa si bieku. Nyameɛ kobua sona biala ndɛen

english_verse: So I told myself that God has set a time and a place for everything. He will judge everyone, both the wicked and the good.
translation_verse: Na ngane ye me ti anu kyɛ, “Nyameɛ kobua teneneefoɛ ne bɔnefoɛ ndɛen, ofikyɛ wahyehyɛ mmerɛ wato berɛ wama edwirɛ biala ne adwuma biala.”

english_verse: I know God is testing us to show us that we are merely animals.
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔfa adasa nwo ne, ngane ye wɔ me ti anu kyɛ, Nyameɛ so bɛ nea maa benwu kyɛ bɛte ngaka.

english_verse: Like animals we breathe and die, and we are no better off than they are. It just doesn't make sense.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ adasa mmaa ne ngaka b’ayieleɛ te ko. Nikyee komapɛ yeɛ ɔto bɛ ɔ. Kyɛbɔ sona owu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ kaka wu ɔ. Ngoa nwomeɛ wɔ bɛ mukoraa nu; yiti sona ndra kaka: ofikyɛ nikyee biala te mbaen.

english_verse: All living creatures go to the same place. We are made from earth, and we return to earth.
translation_verse: Nningyein mukoraa bɛkɔ neka horɛ, nningyein mukoraa befi nnɛterɛ nu, na nningyein mukoraa besa bɛkɔ nnɛterɛ nu.

english_verse: Who really knows if our spirits go up and the spirits of animals go down into the earth?
translation_verse: Sona sunzum, sɛ ɔfo kɔ anwuro oo, anaakyɛ kaka sunzum, sɛ odwu kɔ aseɛ bo dɔ oo, nwa yeɛ ɔse ɔ?

english_verse: I looked again and saw people being mistreated everywhere on earth. They were crying, but no one was there to offer comfort, and those who mistreated them were powerful.
translation_verse: Nza nwuni nhyɛsoɛ amukoraa bɔ ɔkɔ so wɔ wiase ɔ. Bɛ bɔ mmenia hyɛ bɛ so ne, nea bɛ nye moen, belle aworakyekyerɛniɛ biala. Tumi wura bɛ bɔ bedi anyandim ne sa. Ao, amaneɛnwunɛfoɛ nemɔ, belle aworakyekyerɛniɛ biala!

english_verse: I said to myself, “The dead are better off than the living.
translation_verse: Na nyane adwene kyɛ, awufoɛ bɔ bawuwu ne po, bɛ ti te paa tra ateasefoɛ bɔ bɛtɛ te ase ne.

english_verse: But those who have never been born are better off than anyone else, because they have never seen the terrible things that happen on this earth.”
translation_verse: Nakoso sona bɔ bennya bɛwwole ye, bɔ onnya nnwuni bɔne yɔleɛ bɔ ɔkɔ so wɔ wiase ne de, ye ti te paa tra bɛ munyɔ.

english_verse: Then I realized that we work and do wonderful things just because we are jealous of others. This makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Na nwuni kyɛ, ɛfɛɛ mukoraa bɔ sona fɛ, ɔne ye sa noa adwuma mukoraa bɔ ɔyɔ ye yé ne, ɔnate ye nye bɔ ɔboro kyɛ ɔne obiɛngo bɛkɔyɛ pɛ ti ɔ: Ɛhe koso te mbaen, na ɔte dadwene mbaen.

english_verse: Fools will fold their hands and starve to death.
translation_verse: Sona kwaseaa ye gya nga ye sa nga, na ɔyɛ ye bɔbɔ ye nwo aborɛ.

english_verse: Yet a very little food eaten in peace is better than twice as much earned from overwork and chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Wɔ sa bum ko bɔ asomdwee wɔ nu ne, ɔte paa tra wɔ sa bum nyɔ bɔ ɛfɛɛ ne dadwene boka so ɔ.

english_verse: Once again I saw that nothing on earth makes sense.
translation_verse: Nza nwuni nikyee bieku bɔ ɔte mbaen wɔ wiase ɔ:

english_verse: For example, some people don't have friends or family. But they are never satisfied with what they own, and they never stop working to get more. They should ask themselves, “Why am I always working to have more? Who will get what I leave behind?” What a senseless and miserable life! It Is Better To Have a Friend
translation_verse: Sona bɔ wayɛ angonam bɔ olle ba anaa aliɛmaa ɔ, nakoso adwuma serɛ alaa yeɛ ɔkɔ so yɔ ɔ, na ye nye nzɔ ye anwonya bɔ wanya ye ɔ. Na obisa ye nwo kyɛ, “Adwuma bɔ mefɛ me nwo meyɔ, bɔ mama m’anigye abɔ me ye, nwa yeɛ mefɛ mema ye ɔ?” Ɛhe koso te mbaen ne adwuma fuin. Adamvoa nwo mvasoɛ

english_verse: You are better having a friend than to be all alone, because then you will get more enjoyment out of what you earn.
translation_verse: Mmenia nyɔ te paa tra sona horɛ, ofikyɛ bɛbɔ nu bɛyɔ adwuma a, benya nu akatuaa paa.

english_verse: If you fall, your friend can help you up. But if you fall without having a friend nearby, you are really in trouble.
translation_verse: Sɛ ko tɔ ase a, obiɛngo ne pagya ye; nakoso sona bɔ ɔte angonam ne de, ɔtɔ ase a, ye yaakɔ, ofikyɛ onnya ebie mma ɔmmoka ye.

english_verse: If you sleep alone, you won't have anyone to keep you warm on a cold night.
translation_verse: Asa koso, sɛ mmenia nyɔ bɛda bɛen ko a, bɛkã bɛ nwo hyerɛ. Nakoso sɛ sona horɛ ngome da a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né wahã ye nwo hyerɛ?

english_verse: Someone might be able to beat up one of you, but not both of you. As the saying goes, “A rope made from three strands of cord is hard to break.”
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie fa ngondii toa sona horɛ, ná odi ye so ngonim a, mmenia nyɔ de, ɔngora nni bɛ so ngonim. Nyamaa bɔ banwo ye mmɛsa ne, nu telɛ nyɛ mmerɛ.

english_verse: You may be poor and young, but if you are wise, you are better off than a foolish old king who won't listen to advice.
translation_verse: Aberandeɛ hianiɛ bɔ ɔse nworɛ ne, ye nwo le mvasoɛ tra ɛhene kwaseaa bɔ ye nye afi bɔ ondie foɛtulɛ ko ɔ.

english_verse: Even if you were not born into the royal family and have been a prisoner and poor, you can still be king.
translation_verse: Ebie fi kuku nu badi hene, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛwole ye bɛtole ehiaa nu wɔ ye maen nu.

english_verse: I once saw everyone in the world follow a young leader who came to power after the king was gone.
translation_verse: Na aberandeɛ bɔ osili sɔ hene ne gya nu ne, nwuni ateasefoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛnate wiase kyɛ baali ye si.

english_verse: His followers could not even be counted. But years from now, no one will praise him—this makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Mmenia pembepembe bɔ olili bɛ so ne, ɛka bɛ a ennwu ye noa. Nakoso bɛ bɔ nziɛ ye bɛwale ne de, banguro ye dwirɛ. Nahorɛ nu, ɛhe koso te mbaen, na ɔte dadwene mbaen.

english_verse: Be careful what you do when you enter the house of God. Fools go there to offer sacrifices, because all they do is sin. But it's best just to listen when you go to worship.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛkɔ Nyameɛ awuro a, nea wɔ nwo yé wɔ bɔ ɛkɔyɔ ɔ nwo. Ɛkɔ berɛ kotie ye a, ɔte paa tra afɔleɛ bɔ ngwaseafoɛ bɛbɔ ɔ. Ofikyɛ bɛ de, bɛnze kyɛ bɔne yeɛ bɛyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't talk before you think or make promises to God without thinking them through. God is in heaven, and you are on earth, so don't talk too much.
translation_verse: Nnɛperepere wɔ nwo bukye wɔ noa, yeɛ nnɛperepere wɔ nwo ma edwirɛ fite wɔ noa wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu. Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ wɔ nyameɛso, yeɛ wɔ wora ɛwɔ aseɛ ye aso, yiti ma wɔ dwirɛ yɛ ndika ndika.

english_verse: If you keep thinking about something, you will dream about it. If you talk too much, you will say the wrong thing.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ adwenedwene pee ma sona kye laleɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ edwudwolɛ pee maa yɛnwu sona kwaseaa ɔ.

english_verse: God doesn't like fools. So don't be slow to keep your promises to God.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛhyɛ Nyameɛ bɔ a, nnɛtwetwe wɔ gya ase wɔ ye tualɛ nwo, ofikyɛ ɔngyegye ngwaseafoɛ so. Tua bɔ ahyɛ ye nwo bɔ ne.

english_verse: It's better not to make a promise at all than to make one and not keep it.
translation_verse: Ɔte paa kyɛ ɛngɔhyɛ bɔ tra kyɛ ɛkɔhyɛ bɔ ná anni so ɔ.

english_verse: Don't let your mouth get you in trouble! And don't say to the worship leader, “I didn't mean what I said.” God can destroy everything you have worked for, so don't say something that makes God angry.
translation_verse: Nnɛma wɔ noa diedie wɔ kɔ bɔne nu, yeɛ nnɛkã kyire bɔfoɛ ne kyɛ wɔ noa fone. Nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ Nyameɛ fɛ wɔ noa dwirɛ nwo yaa ná ɔsɛkye wɔ sa noa adwuma ɔ.

english_verse: Respect and obey God! Daydreaming leads to a lot of senseless talk.
translation_verse: Ɛkye laleɛ pee a, né wɔ dwudwolɛ mbaen mbaen asone pee, nakoso suro Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Don't be surprised if the poor of your country are abused, and injustice takes the place of justice. After all, the lower officials must do what the higher ones order them to do.
translation_verse: Sɛ enwu kyɛ manzini bie anu besisi ehianiɛ, kyɛ bebua ndɛengyea, ɔne kyɛ bɛkatakata nahorɛ so a, nnɛma sɔ dwirɛ ne yɛ wɔ nwanwa, ofikyɛ panyi bie yeɛ ɔnea sɔ panyi ne so ɔ, na bewura mbanyi paa biemɔ abo.

english_verse: And since the king is the highest official, he benefits most from the taxes paid on the land.
translation_verse: Aseɛ ne aso mvasoɛ ne, ɔwɔ berɛ ma ebiala, na ɛhene bɔbɔ po, aseɛ ne aso yeɛ odidi ɔ.

english_verse: If you love money and wealth, you will never be satisfied with what you have. This doesn't make a bit of sense.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye nye boro sikaa ne, onya sikaa a ye nye nzɔ; yeɛ bɔ ye nye boro anwonyadeɛ ne koso, ye nye nzɔ bɔ wanya ye ɔ: Ɛhe koso te mbaen.

english_verse: The more you have, the more everyone expects from you. Your money won't do you any good—others will just spend it for you.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ sona anwonyadeɛ ɔkɔ so yɛ pee ne, né bɛ bɔ bedi ne koso bayɛ pee. Yiti anwonyadeɛ mene ne, nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ onya ɔ? Sana ye nye bɔ ɔfa nwu ye angome.

english_verse: If you have to work hard for a living, you can rest well at night, even if you don't have much to eat. But if you are rich, you can't even sleep.
translation_verse: Sɛ paaniɛ nya aleɛ kãa di oo, anaa pee di oo, ɔdafe hatee; nakoso sikaniɛ de, ye anwonya mmorosoɛ ne mma onnya nnaa nna.

english_verse: I have seen something terribly unfair. People get rich, but it does them no good.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ yealɛ paa bie wɔ berɛ bɔ manwu ye wɔ wiase ɔ. Ye ole kyɛ, sona fa ye anwonya sie toonn maa ɔkakyi ye so musue,

english_verse: Suddenly they lose everything in a bad business deal, then have nothing to leave for their children.
translation_verse: na asane to ye ma sɔ anwonya ne amukoraa fi ye sa. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ wawo baa de, nakoso ye mukoraa fi baa ne sa.

english_verse: They came into this world naked, and when they die, they will be just as naked. They can't take anything with them, and they won't have anything to show for all their work.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ ye nwo la so yeɛ ofili oni akunu wale ne, sɔ ala yeɛ okosa kɔhɔ ɔ. Na bɔ wafɛ wanya ye ne, ɔngɔfa nu biala ngotira ye sa nu ngɔhɔ.

english_verse: That's terribly unfair. They leave the world just as they came. They gained nothing from running after the wind.
translation_verse: Ɛhe koso te edwirɛ yealɛ paa: kyɛbɔ osi wale ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔkɔhɔ ye ɔ. Na ɛfɛɛ mbaen bɔ wafɛ ne, nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ onyane ye ɔ?

english_verse: Besides all this, they are always gloomy at mealtime, and they are troubled, sick, and bitter.
translation_verse: Awosii akata ye ngyẽa mukoraa so, na ɔfa ɛyaafɛlɛ, anwonyerɛ ne aworabɔlɛ pee nu.

english_verse: What is the best thing to do in the short life God has given us? I think we should enjoy eating, drinking, and working hard. This is what God intends for us to do.
translation_verse: Tie, bɔ manwu ye kyɛ ɔte paa ɛhe: Ngoa tikaape bɔ Nyameɛ afa ama sona ne, ɔte paa kyɛ sona kodidi, ɔkɔno, ná ɔkɔfa bɔ wafɛ wanya ye amukoraa wɔ wiase ɔkɔgye ye nye ɔ, ofikyɛ ye bue nu deɛ ɛne.

english_verse: God will keep you so happy that you won't have time to worry about each day.
translation_verse: Sɔ sona ne ngɔma ye ngoa mmerɛ nwo adwenedwene ngɔtɔ ye so, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ma ye asetena nu anigye odi ye ti.

english_verse: There is something else terribly unfair, and it troubles everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ yealɛ bie wɔ berɛ bɔ manwu ye wɔ wiase ɔ, na opuro adasa kɔme paa:

english_verse: God may give you everything you want—money, property, and wealth. Then God doesn't let you enjoy it, and someone you don't even know gets it all. That's senseless and terribly unfair!
translation_verse: Nyameɛ ma ebie sikaa, anwonya ne animnyam, bɔ nikyee fee biala nne berɛ bɔ ye kra pena a ongonya ɔ; nakoso Nyameɛ ɔmma ye anwoserɛ mma ɔmva sɔ nningyein ne ngye ye nye, na ɛwɔfoɛ mmom yeɛ ɔbadi ɔ. Ɛhe te mbaen, na ɔte edwirɛ yealɛ paa.

english_verse: You may live a long time and have a hundred children. But a child born dead is better off than you, unless you enjoy life and have a decent burial.
translation_verse: Sɛ sona wo mmaa ɛyaa ko ná onyi di afoɛ pee a, ɔmva ye nwo afoɛ worawora bɔ wali ɔ, sɛ wamva asetena nu nningyein paa wangye ye nye, anaakyɛ banzie ye a, ye de menwa, baa bɔ bapɔ ye ɔ po ɔte paa tra ye.

english_verse: That child will never live to see the sun or to have a name, and it will go straight to the world of darkness. But it will still find more rest than you,
translation_verse: Asa koso, wannwu eyia, yeɛ ɔnze nikye fee, nakoso onya ye nwome ode tra sɔ sona ne.

english_verse: even if you live two thousand years and don't enjoy life. As you know, we all end up in the same place.
translation_verse: Sɛ sɔ sona ne di afoɛ apee nyɔ po, ná wannya anigye paa biala a, aso nna neka horɛ yeɛ bɛ mukoraa bɛkɔ ɔ?

english_verse: We struggle just to have enough to eat, but we are never satisfied.
translation_verse: Ɛfɛɛ amukoraa bɔ sona ɔfɛ ye, ye noa aleɛ ti ɔ, nakoso odidi a ɔnde ye.

english_verse: We may be sensible, yet we are no better off than a fool. And if we are poor, it still doesn't do us any good to try to live right.
translation_verse: Nzikyɛ yeɛ nworɛfoɛ bɛfa bɛtra ngwaseafoɛ ɔ? Yeɛ ehianiɛ bɔ ye koso ɔse asetena bɔ odi kyɛ ɔne ateasefoɛ bɛtena ne, nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ onya ye ɔ?

english_verse: It's better to enjoy what we have than to always want something else, because that makes no more sense than chasing the wind.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ bɔ wɔ nye tua ye ne, ɔte paa tra bɔ w’akɔnnɔ susu kyɛ ekonya ye ɔ. Ɛhe koso te mbaen, na ɔte dadwene mbaen.

english_verse: Everything that happens was decided long ago. We humans know what we are like, and we can't argue with God, because he is too strong for us.
translation_verse: Nikyee biala bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ ne, bato ye dumaa dadadada. Ebiala se kyɛbɔ kuro sona osi te ɔ. Ebiala se kyɛ, sona ngora nne ebie bɔ ye nwo yɛ se tra ye ɔ benni apereapereɛ.

english_verse: The more we talk, the less sense we make, so what good does it do to talk?
translation_verse: Edwudwo pee a, wɔ dwudwolɛ ne yɛ mbaen; mvasoɛ beni yeɛ sona nya ɔ?

english_verse: Life is short and meaningless, and it fades away like a shadow. Who knows what is best for us? Who knows what will happen after we are gone?
translation_verse: Kuro sona ngoa tikaape bɔ ɔte mbaen, bɔ ɔsẽ kɔ kyɛ wawoɛ ne, nwa yeɛ ɔse bɔ ɔte paa ma kuro sona wɔ nu ɔ? Bɔ okosi sona ye wue asi wɔ wiase ne, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔla ye ali kohyire ye ɔ?

english_verse: A good reputation at the time of death is better than loving care at the time of birth.
translation_verse: Dumaa paa te paa tra ayirefona bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se ɔ, yeɛ ewue kyẽa te paa tra aworɛ kyẽa.

english_verse: It's better to go to a funeral than to attend a feast; funerals remind us that we all must die.
translation_verse: Ɔte paa kyɛ ɛkɔhɔ awuro bɔ bɛyɛ sɛen wɔ nu tra kyɛ ɛkɔhɔ awuro bɔ bato poen bedidi wɔ nu ɔ nu; ofikyɛ sona biala ye ayieleɛ ɛne, na ateasefoɛ fa sɔ dwirɛ ne sie bɛ ti anu.

english_verse: Choose sorrow over laughter because a sad face may hide a happy heart.
translation_verse: Aworabɔlɛ te paa tra ɛserelɛ, wɔ nyunu yɛ anwumvoin anwumvoin de, nakoso wɔ wora kyekye.

english_verse: Correction from someone wise is better by far than praise from fools.
translation_verse: Nworɛniɛ twi wɔ nyunu a, ɔte paa kyɛ ekotie tra kyɛ ekotie ngwaseafoɛ edweintolɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Foolish laughter is stupid. It sounds like thorns crackling in a fire.
translation_verse: Ɛfa agurɛ gua see nu a, kyɛbɔ osi yɛ titetite ne, sɔ ala yeɛ kwaseaa serelɛ te ɔ; na ɛhe koso ɔte mbaen.

english_verse: Corruption makes fools of sensible people, and bribes can ruin you.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, nhyɛsoɛ ma nworɛfoɛ bɛbɔ laen, yeɛ fea-ase-ma koso ɔma sona bu ye nye gua nahorɛ so.

english_verse: Something completed is better than something just begun; patience is better than too much pride.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ ayieleɛ te paa tra ye bohyɛlɛ; aboterɛ nyanɛ te paa tra anwomasoɛ.

english_verse: Only fools get angry quickly and hold a grudge.
translation_verse: Nnɛma w’ahone hu ndɛndɛ, ofikyɛ ngwaseafoɛ yeɛ ahonehulɛ wɔ bɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: It isn't wise to ask, “Why is everything worse than it used to be?”
translation_verse: Nnɛbisa kyɛ, “Mmerɛ bɔ wapɛ nu wahɔ ne, nzu ati yeɛ ɔte paa tra ɛnɛ mmerɛ ye ɔ?” Ofikyɛ nworɛ biala nne nu kyɛ ekobisa ɛhe ɔ.

english_verse: Wisdom will protect you just like money; knowledge with good sense will lead you to life.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nworɛ ɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen kyɛbɔ sikaa ɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen ne, na nimdeɛ nwo mvasoɛ ole kyɛ, nworɛniɛ ye nworɛ maa onya ngoa.

english_verse: Think of what God has done! If God makes something crooked, can you make it straight?
translation_verse: Bɔ Nyameɛ ayɔ ne, fa kɔ adwenedwene nu: Nikyee bɔ wakondo nu ne, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora ye tengyɛ ɔ?

english_verse: When times are good, you should be cheerful; when times are bad, think about what it means. God makes them both to keep us from knowing what will happen next. Some of Life's Questions
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ okoyie wɔ yé ne, ma wɔ nye gye, nakoso sɛ mmerɛ tɛɛ to wɔ a, fa kɔ adwenedwene nu. Nyameɛ bɔ ɔmane sɔ tebea ne wale ne, ye ala yeɛ wama ɛhe koso wawa ɔ, amaa ɔnate so kuro sona wannwu nikyee biala bɔ okosi wɔ ye si ɔ.

english_verse: I have seen everything during this senseless life of mine. I have seen good citizens die for doing the right thing, while criminals live and prosper.
translation_verse: M’asetena mbaen ye anu, manwu nikyee biala: Teneneeniɛ bɔ owu wɔ ye tenenee nu, yeɛ bɔnefoɛ koso bɔ onya ngoa tendenn wɔ ye bɔne nu ɔ.

english_verse: Don't die before your time by being too evil or acting like a fool.
translation_verse: Nnɛma awosii ba wɔ ti anu tra so, yeɛ nnɛyɛ kwaseaa. Nzu ati yeɛ ɛpena kyɛ ɛpe wu ɔ?

english_verse: Wisdom will make you stronger than the ten most powerful leaders in your city.
translation_verse: Nworɛ ma nworɛniɛ nya tumi tra mbanyi buru bɔ bɛnea kuro so ɔ.

english_verse: Don't listen to everything that everyone says, or you might hear your servant cursing you.
translation_verse: Nnɛma w’adwene kɔ edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ mmenia kekã ɔ so, amaa ɔnate so ande kyɛ wɔ somvoɛ ɔnoma wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I told myself that I would be smart and try to understand all this, but it was too much for me.
translation_verse: Mafa nworɛ mapɛnzɛpɛnzɛ ɛhemɔ amukoraa nu manea; na ngane kyɛ, “Ngonwu nworɛ,” nakoso ɔne m’afia atee wale.

english_verse: The truth is beyond us. It's far too deep.
translation_verse: Sɔ nikyee ne bɔ ɔwɔ dededede, nziɛ nziɛ, kumaa kuronguronn nu ne, nwa yeɛ okonwu ye ɔ?

english_verse: So I decided to learn everything I could and become wise enough to discover what life is all about. At the same time, I wanted to understand why it's stupid and senseless to be an evil fool.
translation_verse: Mvale m’adwene nziele so kyɛ ngonwu nworɛ, ɔne kyɛ ngɔfeefee nu ngɔpena nworɛ ne nningyein bɛ bo telɛ ɔ, ɔne kyɛ ngonwu amumuyɛɛ kyɛ ɔte ngwaseasɛm, ná ngonwu ngwaseasɛm kyɛ ɔte ɛlaenbɔlɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Here is what I discovered: A bad woman is worse than death. She is a trap, reaching out with body and soul to catch you. But if you obey God, you can escape. If you don't obey, you are done for.
translation_verse: Na nwuni bɔ ye nwo yɛ suro tra ewue ɔ: Ye ole brasua bɔ ye adwene te ngaen ne ɛtɛen ɔ, bɔ ye sa te ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ ɔ. Sona bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ne, ode ye nwo fi sɔ braa ne sa nu, nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, ɔtɔ braa ne ngaen nu.

english_verse: With all my wisdom I have tried to find out how everything fits together,
translation_verse: Tie, bɔ manwu ye hɔ ɛhe: Nworɛ Dwirɛhanɛniɛ ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛne. Mvale edwirɛ ne ndotole ye nwo ngoko ngoko kyɛ ngonya ye nwo ndeaseɛ ɔ.

english_verse: but so far I have not been able to. I do know there is one good man in a thousand, but never have I found a good woman.
translation_verse: Ngɔle so alaa mbenane ndeaseɛ ne, nakoso mannwu bɔ mepena ne. Nwuni bienzua ko wɔ mmienzua apee ko nu, nakoso mmrasua mɔ nu de, mannwu brasua.

english_verse: I did learn one thing: We were completely honest when God created us, but now we have twisted minds.
translation_verse: Tie, ɛhe angome yeɛ manwu ye ɔ: Nyameɛ bɔle kuro sona ferengyemm, nakoso kuro sona ama nningyein pee bo telɛ ali ye ti.

english_verse: Who is smart enough to explain everything? Wisdom makes you cheerful and gives you a smile. Obey the King
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔte kyɛ nworɛniɛ ne ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ɔse edwirɛ bo kyire ɔ: Sona nworɛ ma ye nyunu yɛ gyenegyene, na ye nyunu kusuu ne sesã. Yɛ sotie ma wɔ hene

english_verse: If you promised God that you would be loyal to the king, I advise you to keep that promise.
translation_verse: Menwa, yɛ sotie ma ɛhene n’ahyɛdeɛ, ofikyɛ ata ndaen ahyire Nyameɛ, [na nnɛmaa ɔha wɔ].

english_verse: Don't quickly oppose the king or argue when he has already made up his mind.
translation_verse: Sɛ edwirɛ ne ɔtte mayee a, nnɛtwetwe wɔ gya ase, fi ye nyunu berɛ kɔ, ofikyɛ bɔ okuro biala yeɛ ɔyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The king's word is law. No one can ask him, “Why are you doing this?”
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, ɛhene noa dwirɛ te tumi, na nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kobisa ye kyɛ, “Na nzu yeɛ ɛyɔ ye?”

english_verse: If you obey the king, you will stay out of trouble. So be wise and learn what to do and when to do it.
translation_verse: Sona biala bɔ odi mmeraa so ne, edwirɛ ndo ye, amba, nworɛniɛ adwene ɔse mmerɛ ne ne ndɛenbualɛ ne.

english_verse: Life is hard, but there is a time and a place for everything,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmerɛ ne ndɛenbualɛ wɔ berɛ ma nikyee biala, na amaneɛ ayɛ adesoa piri wɔ kuro sona so.

english_verse: We cannot control the wind or determine the day of our death. There is no escape in time of war, and no one can hide behind evil.
translation_verse: Sona biala nne berɛ bɔ ole nwomeɛ so tumi, bɔ ɔkora si nwomeɛ ate maa ɔtena ye nu ɔ, anaa ole ye wue kyẽa so tumi ɔ? Ɛsrɛ atee wɔ koɛ nu a, engonya ye, yeɛ amumuyɛɛyɔlɛ mbepɛ nne bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ amumuyɛɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I noticed all this and thought seriously about what goes on in the world. Why does one person have the power to hurt another? Who Can Understand the Ways of God?
translation_verse: Manwu ɛhemɔ amukoraa, na medwene nningyein amukoraa bɔ bɛyɔ ye wiase ne anwo: Mmerɛ bie wɔ berɛ a, sona fa ye tumi sisi obiɛngo maa ɔkakyi ye so amaneɛ.

english_verse: I saw the wicked buried with honor, but God's people had to leave the holy city and were forgotten. None of this makes sense.
translation_verse: Afei nwuni amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɔ besiele bɛ ɔ. Mmerɛ bɔ bɛte ase ne, né bedi nekaa krongron berɛ akɔneaba. Na kuro bɔ né bɛyɔ amumuyɛɛ wɔ so ne, mmenia wora fili bɛ yɔleɛ ne. Ɛhe koso te mbaen.

english_verse: When we see criminals commit crime after crime without being punished, it makes us want to start a life of crime.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ bɔne yɔleɛ nwo akatuaa ɔmma ndɛndɛ so ne ati, kuro sona ama bɔne yɔleɛ ali ye ti.

english_verse: They commit hundreds of crimes and live a long time, in spite of the saying: Everyone who lives right and respects God will prosper,
