english_verse: These people have refused the gentle waters of Shiloah and have gladly gone over to the side of King Rezin and King Pekah.
translation_verse: “Ɔnate kyɛ maen he apo Siloa asue bɔ ɔsẽ dinn ne, ná bama Resin ne Remalia awa ne nwo suronyi atɔ bɛ so ne ati,

english_verse: Now I will send the king of Assyria against them with his powerful army, which will attack like the mighty Euphrates River overflowing its banks.
translation_verse: yiti tie, AWURADE kɔfa asue Yufreti nu nzue worawora bɔ ye noa yɛ hye, bɔ ɔte Asiria hene ne ye animnyam amukoraa ne, na okoyi kobu kɔfa ye boo ne ye noa amukoraa.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers will cover Judah like a flood reaching up to your neck. But God is with us. He will spread his wings and protect our land.
translation_verse: Okoyi kɔɔsẽ kɔfa Yuda, okobu kɔfa ye so, ɔkɔla bɛ kɔme anu, na ɔkɔtrɛ ye ndaa nu kɔfa w’aseɛ ne amukoraa so, O Yimanuel!” Maen maen mɔ koli ngoguo

english_verse: Get together and make plans, but you will fail because God is with us.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔhɔ agyina, nakoso ɔkɔyɛ mbaen, ɛ́mɔbɔ porɛ, nakoso ɔngɔyɛ yee, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ne yɛ yeɛ yɛwɔ berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord took hold of me with his powerful hand and said: I'm warning you! Don't act like these people.
translation_verse: AWURADE dwudwo hyirele me wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né ye tumi wɔ me so serɛserɛ, na ɔbɔle me kɔkɔ kyɛ, maen he atee bɔ ɔnate so ne, nnɛmaa mefa so bie. Ɔnwa:

english_verse: Don't call something a rebellious plot, just because they do, and don't be afraid of something, just because they are.
translation_verse: “Nikyee biala bɔ maen he frɛ ye ‘bɛ ti so porɛbɔlɛ’ nen, nnɛma ɛmɔfrɛ ye sɔ bie; yeɛ bɔ besuro ne koso, nnɛma ɛmɔsuro bie, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔsuro.

english_verse: I am the one you should fear and respect. I am the holy God, the Lord All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE ngome yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔbu ye kyɛ ɔte krongron ɔ. Ye yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔsuro ye, ye yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔma ye nwo suronyi tɔ ɛmɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: My message and my teachings are to be sealed and given to my followers.
translation_verse: Bobɔ adanzeɛ ne, na ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ mefa mema m’asuafoɛ ne, fa nzɔanoɛ sɔ ye noa.

english_verse: Meanwhile, I patiently trust the Lord, even though he is no longer pleased with Israel.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ waye ye nye wato buro wafea Yakob boso ama ne, ngɔfa me wora ngowura ye nu, ngɔpena ye si atee.

english_verse: My children and I are warning signs to Israel from the Lord All-Powerful, who lives on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, me ne me mma bɔ AWURADE afa bɛ ama me ne, yɛte sɛngyerɛnneɛ ne kɔkɔbɔlɛ bɔ ofi Asafo AWURADE bɔ ɔte Sion bokaa so ne berɛ yɛma Yisrael.

english_verse: Someone may say to you, “Go to the fortunetellers who make soft chirping sounds or ask the spirits of the dead. After all, a nation ought to be able to ask its own gods
translation_verse: Na sɛ mmenia kã kyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, “Nzamangɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne ahɔmeɛ bɔ bɛ dwudwolɛ te katekate ne boborɔboborɔ ne, ɛmɔhɔ bɛ so abisa” a, aso nna maen bɛ Nyameɛ berɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ bebisa nikye ɔ? Aso odi kyɛ bebisa ateasefoɛ ti wɔ awufoɛ berɛ anaa?

english_verse: what it should do.” None of those who talk like that will live to see the light of day!
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔpena mmeraa ne ne adanzeɛ ne si atee! Nahorɛ nu, sɛ banga ye kyɛbɔ edwirɛ ne ɔte ne a, ye de né nahorɛ biala nne bɛ nu.

english_verse: They will go around in great pain and will become so hungry that they will angrily curse their king and their gods. And when they try to find help in heaven
translation_verse: Bɛkɔfa ɛhɔen ne aworabɔlɛ bekohyinihyini aseɛ ne aso. Na sɛ ɛhɔen ku bɛ a, b’ahone kohu, na bɛkɔwa bɛ hene ne bɛ Nyameɛ amoen. Bɛkɔto bɛ nye bɛkɔnea anwuro,

english_verse: and on earth, they will find only trouble and darkness, terrible trouble and deepest darkness.
translation_verse: bɛkɔto bɛ nye bɛkɔnea aseɛ so, nakoso aworabɔlɛ, awosii ne amaneɛ yeɛ bekonwu ye ɔ; na bekogyi bɛ bekogua awosii kabii nu.

english_verse: But those who have suffered will no longer be in pain. The territories of Zebulun and Naphtali in Galilee were once hated. But this land of the Gentiles across the Jordan River and along the Mediterranean Sea will be greatly respected. War Is Over
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛ wora abɔ ne, b’amaneɛnwunɛ ne ngɔha berɛ. Daa ne, obuli Sebulɔn aseɛ ne Nafetali aseɛ animtia, nakoso kyẽa bie de, atee bɔ ɔla mboanoa ne, yeɛ aseɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Yɔɔdan si dɔ ne, ɔne Galilea bɔ ɔte Amaenmaensofoɛ mbɔtam ne, ɔkɔhyɛ bɛ animnyam.

english_verse: Those who walked in the dark have seen a bright light. And it shines upon everyone who lives in the land of darkest shadows.
translation_verse: Maen bɔ né ɔnate awosii nu ne, wanwu kanea piri ne, bɛ bɔ né bɛte awosii kabii aseɛ so ne, kanea ata bɛ so.

english_verse: Our Lord, you have made your nation stronger. Because of you, its people are glad and celebrate like workers at harvest time or like soldiers dividing up what they have taken.
translation_verse: Ama maen ne anu mmenia bata bayɛ pee, amaa banya anika piri, benya ahurusi wɔ wɔ nyunu kyɛbɔ mmenia nya anigye wɔ fieso aleɛ falɛ nu ɔ, kyɛbɔ mmenia di ahurusi wɔ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ hyɛlɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: You have broken the power of those who abused and enslaved your people. You have rescued them just as you saved your people from Midian.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ b’adesoa bɔ ɔso bɛ ne, bakaa bɔ ɔla bɛ kɔme anwo ne, yeɛ mmenia bɔ bɛhyɛ bɛ so nemɔ b’abopura ne, abubu nu kyɛ kyẽa bɔ elili Midian so ngonim ne.

english_verse: The boots of marching warriors and the blood-stained uniforms have been fed to flames and eaten by fire. A Child Has Been Born
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mbaboa biala bɔ koɛhonɛniɛ wafa watia ase kum kum ne, ɔne ataadeɛ biala bɔ bafa bafɔrefɔre mogya ne, bɛkɔfa bɛkɔyɛ eyein bɛkɔsɔ see.

english_verse: A child has been born for us. We have been given a son who will be our ruler. His names will be Wonderful Advisor and Mighty God, Eternal Father and Prince of Peace.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bawo akwadaa bama yɛ, bama yɛ baa bienzua, ye yeɛ ahennie ne kowura ye sa ɔ, na ye dumaa ne, bɛkɔfrɛ ye kyɛ, “Foɛtulɛniɛ Nwanwaniɛ, Nyameɛ Tuminiɛ, Seɛ bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ Afebɔɔ, Asomdwee Hene.”

english_verse: His power will never end; peace will last forever. He will rule David's kingdom and make it grow strong. He will always rule with honesty and justice. The Lord All-Powerful will make certain that all of this is done. God Will Punish Israel
translation_verse: Ye ahennie, yeɛ ye asomdwee kɔhɔ so kɔtrɛ bɔ olle ayieleɛ ɔ; ɔkɔtena Dawide ahennie bia ne aso, okoli ye ahennie ne aso, na ɔkɔfa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ne tenenee koli bia ne maa okotindim kogyina, ofi kekesaala ye maa okoodwu afebɔɔ. Asafo AWURADE ye nungunɛhwenɛ sonongo ne yeɛ ɔkɔyɔ ɛhe ɔ. AWURADE afɛ Yisrael so yaa

english_verse: The Lord had warned the people of Israel,
translation_verse: AWURADE ato Yakob ngraa, na ndɛenbualɛ ne awa Yisrael so.

english_verse: and all of them knew it, including everyone in the capital city of Samaria. But they were proud and stubborn and said,
translation_verse: Na maen ne anu ama mukoraa, bɔ bɛ ole Efraim ne Samariafoɛ ne, bekonwu ye, bɛ yeɛ bɛkekã edwirɛ mbiri mbiri bɛmoma bɛ nwo so kyɛ,

english_verse: “Houses of brick and sycamore have fallen to the ground, but we will build houses with stones and cedar.”
translation_verse: “Mmerekese sua nemɔ adwiri agua, nakoso yɛkɔfa nyɔboɛ bɔ base ɔ yɛkosi; babubu akyea nemɔ bagua, nakoso yɛkɔfa sida yɛkosi bɛ gya nu.”

english_verse: He sent the Arameans from the east and the Philistines from the west, and they swallowed up Israel. But even this did not stop him from being angry, so he kept on punishing them.
translation_verse: Siriafoɛ kofi eyia afiteleɛ, yeɛ Filistifoɛ kofi eyia atɔleɛ, na bɛkɔbaye bɛ noa nu bɛkɔme Yisrael. Na ɛhemɔ amukoraa nu ne, ye ahone andɔ nzue nu, na ɔtɛ dwɔso tia bɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel still did not turn back to the Lord All-Powerful and worship him.
translation_verse: Nakoso maen ne anza angɔ ye bɔ ɔhwene bɛ so ne berɛ, yeɛ bambena Asafo AWURADE si atee.

english_verse: In one day he cut off their head and tail, their leaves and branches.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE kɔpɛ Yisrael ye ti ne ye dua, ye ɛberɛ ne elemmire ɛlɛho komapɛ kofi berɛ.

english_verse: Their rulers and leaders were the head, and the lying prophets were the tail.
translation_verse: Panyi titireniɛ ne, ye ole tire ne, yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ bɔ ye ngyerɛkyerɛ te nnakannaka ne, ye ole dua ne.

english_verse: They had led the nation down the wrong path, and the people were confused.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bekyire maen he atee ne, bɛmaa bemini, na bediedie mmenia bɔ bekyire b’atee ne maa bɛkɔ ewue nu.

english_verse: The Lord was angry with his people and kept punishing them, because they had turned against him. They were evil and spoke foolishly. That's why he did not have pity on their young people or on their widows and orphans.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, AWURADE nye ngɔgye bɛ mmerandeɛ nemɔ nwo, yeɛ ongonwu bɛ nyisiaa ne b’akunafoɛ mmrasua anwumvoin; ofikyɛ bɛ mukoraa benzuro Nyameɛ, bɛte bɔnefoɛ, na ebiala kekã ngwaseasɛm. Na ɛhemɔ amukoraa nu ne, AWURADE ahone andɔ nzue nu, na ɔtɛ dwɔso tia bɛ.

english_verse: Evil had spread like a raging forest fire sending thornbushes up in smoke.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, amumuyɛɛ ogye kyɛ see, ɔyera agurɛ ne mmowue, ɔyera ɛhɔayeɛ too, na bɛyɛ nwosina ningɔnn bɛkɔ anwuro.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful was angry and used the people as fuel for a fire that scorched the land. They turned against each other
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE ɛyaafɛlɛ piri ne, wama aseɛ ne ayera, na mmenia ne ayɛ kyɛ eyein bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔ see ɔ, na ebiala wannwu obiɛngo anwumvoin.

english_verse: like wild animals attacking and eating everyone around them, even their own relatives. But still they were not satisfied.
translation_verse: Befoti aleɛ wɔ famaa so, nakoso ɛhɔen tɛ ku bɛ, bedidi wɔ bɛ sa bɛen so, nakoso bɛ ko nyi, na ebiala keka ye bɔbɔ ye sa nwo naen di.

english_verse: The tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh turned against each other, then joined forces to attack Judah. But the Lord was still angry and ready to punish the nation even more.
translation_verse: Manase keka Efraim di, yeɛ Efraim koso keka Manase di, na bɛ munyɔ bɛko betia Yuda, Na ɛhemɔ amukoraa nu ne, wanyakyi bɛ so yaa fɛlɛ, na ɔtɛ dwɔso tia bɛ.

english_verse: You people are in for trouble! You have made cruel and unfair laws
translation_verse: Bɛ yaakɔ! Bɛ bɔ bɛhyɛ mmeraa tɛɛ ɔ, ɔne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛkyerɛ nhyɛsoɛ mmeraa ɔ,

english_verse: But what will you do when you are fiercely attacked and punished by foreigners? Where will you run for help? Where will you hide your valuables?
translation_verse: Nzu yeɛ ɛmɔkɔyɔ ye wɔ asohwenɛ kyẽa ne ɔne amaneɛnwunɛ bɔ okofi dedeede kɔwa ne anu ɔ? Nwa berɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkɔnwati bɛkɔɔpena mmokalɛ ɔ, nisua yeɛ ɛmɔkɔyakyi ɛmɔ anwonya ne ɔ?

english_verse: How will you escape being captured or killed? The Lord is still angry, and he isn't through with you yet! The Lord's Purpose and the King of Assyria
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkokundukundu berɛ wɔ kukunufoɛ nemɔ anu, anaakyɛ bekohu ɛmɔ bɛkɔfra bɛ bɔ batotɔ ne. Na ɛhemɔ amukoraa nu ne, AWURADE ahone ngɔtɔ nzue nu, na okodwɔso kotia bɛ.

english_verse: The Lord says: I am furious! And I will use the king of Assyria as a club
translation_verse: Aa, Asiria, me yaafɛlɛ mbire, pɔmaa bɔ otira bɛ sa nu ne, ɔte m’ahonehulɛ piri!

english_verse: to beat down you godless people. I am angry with you, and I will send him to attack you. He will take what he wants and walk on you like mud in the streets.
translation_verse: Maen bɔ benzuro Nyameɛ yeɛ masoma ye kyɛ ɔɔhwe bɛ so ɔ, mahyɛ ye kyɛ ɔɔhwe maen bɔ mafɛ ye so yaa piri paa ne so, kyɛ ɔɔfẽ ye nningyein ɔfa yɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ, ná otiatia bɛ so te kyɛ dwaaso nnɛterɛ.

english_verse: The king of Assyria says: My army commanders are kings!
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔnwa: “Me safohene mɔ, aso bɛtte hene hɔ ɔ?

english_verse: The gods of Jerusalem and Samaria are weaker than the gods of those powerful nations. And I will destroy Jerusalem, together with its gods and idols, just as I did Samaria.
translation_verse: aso mengɔfa sɔ mengoli Yerusalem ne ye mmosoen, kyɛbɔ mafa mali Samaria ne ye amoen mɔ ne?”

english_verse: The Lord will do what he has planned against Jerusalem and Mount Zion. Then he will punish the proud and boastful king of Assyria,
translation_verse: Sɛ AWURADE yɔ ye adwuma mukoraa wɔ Sion bokaa so ne Yerusalem yie a, ɔkɔhwe Asiria hene so wɔ ye anwomasoɛ mvamva ne ye dwɛɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: who says: I did these things by my own power because I am smart and clever. I attacked kings like a wild bull, and I took the land and the treasures of their nations.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Asiria hene nwa: “Me bɔbɔ m’anwoserɛ ne me nworɛ yeɛ mafa mayɔ ɛhe ɔ, ofikyɛ m’adwene nu pi; matutu maen maen nemɔ bɛ wɛen magua, mafẽ bɛ nningyein mafa; mayɛ kyɛ katakyie bɔ mapemo bɛ hene mɔ maa batete bagua ase ɔ.

english_verse: The mighty Lord All-Powerful will send a terrible disease to strike down your army, and you will burn with fever under your royal robes.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE, Asafo AWURADE ɔkɔte ɛfɔen anwonyerɛ kogua ye koɛhonɛfoɛ pindipindinn nemɔ aso, na ɔkɔsɔ see wɔ Asiria hene animnyam ne abo kyɛ see bɔ ogye ɔ.

english_verse: The holy God, who is the light of Israel, will turn into a fire, and in one day you will go up in flames, just like a thornbush.
translation_verse: Yisrael kanea ne kɔkakyi see, ye Krongronniɛ ne kɔkakyi see wuronyiwuronyi; na okogye kɔyera ye agurɛ ne ye mmowue nemɔ ɛlɛhomapɛ.

english_verse: There will be so few trees that even a young child can count them. Only a Few Will Come Back
translation_verse: Ye hɔayeɛ ne anu mmakaa bɔ bɛkɔha ne, ɔkɔyɛ kaaba bie bɔ akwadaa po ɔkɔhora kɔha kɔhyerɛ ye somaa ɔ. Yisraelfoɛ kãa bie kosa kɔwa

english_verse: A time is coming when the survivors from Israel and Judah will completely depend on the holy Lord of Israel, instead of the nation that defeated them.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, Yisraelfoɛ ngaa ne, bɛ ne Yakob awuro ama bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ne, bɛngɔfa bɛ nwo bɛngɔto bɔ ɔbole bɛ ne aso ko, na mmom bɛkɔfa bɛ nwo bɛkɔto AWURADE, Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne aso nahorɛ nu.

english_verse: There were as many people as there are grains of sand along the seashore, but only a few will survive to come back to Israel's mighty God. This is because he has threatened to destroy their nation, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ wɔ maen Yisrael bɛsone pee kyɛ mboanoa anweaa de, nakoso bɛ nu kaaba bie yeɛ bekosa bɛkɔwa ɔ. Nyameɛ ahyehyɛ bɔ ɔbaato bɛ ne wato berɛ, na ɔnate pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ mmorosoɛ so yeɛ ɔkɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised that everyone on this earth will be punished.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ wahyehyɛ wato berɛ kyɛ ɔkɔsɛkye aseɛ amukoraa ne, ɔkɔmaa ɔkɔwa nu.

english_verse: Now the Lord God All-Powerful says to his people in Jerusalem: The Assyrians will beat you with sticks and abuse you, just as the Egyptians did. But don't be afraid of them.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, “O me maen bɔ ɛte Sion ɔ, nnɛsuro Asiria. Ɔkɔfa bakaa kɔbo wɔ, yeɛ ɔkɔfa pɔmaa kɔwa wɔ so kyɛbɔ Misraim yɔle ne.

english_verse: Soon I will stop being angry with you, and I will punish them for their crimes.
translation_verse: Ɔngɔhyɛ biala, ɛyaafɛlɛ ne bo kɔpɛ, na m’ahone kohu bɛ so kohũhũ bɛ.

english_verse: I will beat the Assyrians with a whip, as I did the people of Midian near the rock at Oreb. And I will show the same mighty power that I used when I made a path through the sea in Egypt.
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE kofi ye mbire, kyɛbɔ ohuni Midian wɔ Orebo nyɔbotaen ne anwo ne, na ɔkɔma ye pɔmaa ne aso kohyire ɛpo ne aso, kyɛbɔ ɔyɔle ye Misraim ne.

english_verse: Then they will no longer rule your nation. All will go well for you, and your burden will be lifted.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɔ mmerɛ ne, ye adesoa bɔ ɔfa tole wɔ kɔme anwo ne ɔkɔye kofi berɛ, na ye kɔnnua ne anu kobubu kɔye kofi wɔ kɔme. Na ɔnate nomenome bɔ ɛkɔyɛ ne ati, kɔnnua ne anu kobubu.”

english_verse: Enemy troops have reached the town of Aiath. They have gone through Migron, and they stored their supplies at Michmash,
translation_verse: Wawa Ayate, waapɛ nu wɔ Migron, wayakyi ye nningyein wɔ Mikimase.

english_verse: before crossing the valley and spending the night at Geba. The people of Ramah are terrified; everyone in Gibeah, the hometown of Saul, has run away.
translation_verse: Baafa kongonyi ne anu dɔ, baasikye kɔngɔen wɔ Geba. Ahunundetelɛ atɔ Rama so, Sɔɔlo kuro Gibea so ama banwati.

english_verse: Loud crying can be heard in the towns of Gallim, Laishah, and sorrowful Anathoth.
translation_verse: O Galim awa brasua, sũ serɛserɛ! O Laisa, tie! O Anatote, bua ye!

english_verse: No one is left in Madmenah or Gebim.
translation_verse: Mademena anwati, Gebimfoɛ banwati bɛkwaabɔ bɛ nwo adwaa.

english_verse: Today the enemy will camp at Nob and shake a threatening fist at Mount Zion in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, Asiria koogyina wɔ Nɔbo, ɔkɔkoakoa twɔleɛ kohyire Sion awa brasua bokaa ne, Yerusalem pambaa ne.

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful will use his fearsome might to bring down the tallest trees and chop off every branch.
translation_verse: Tie, AWURADE, Asafo AWURADE kɔfa tumi bɔ ɔyɛ suro ɔ kɔpomba bakaa mmaen ne kogua, okobubu mmakaa ndendenn nemɔ kogua, na ɔkɔbrɛ bɔ wama ye nwo so ne ase.

english_verse: With an ax, the glorious Lord will destroy every tree in the forests of Lebanon.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔfa akumaa kobu ɛhɔayeɛ too kogua, na tumi piri kɔma Lebanon ɛhɔayeɛ nu mmakaa kobubu.

english_verse: Like a branch that sprouts from a stump, someone from David's family will someday be king.
translation_verse: Bakaa ye nye bie kopukye kofi Yese dosii ne anu, na mmaen bie kofifi kofi ye ndii nemɔ anu kosu mmaa.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord will be with him to give him understanding, wisdom, and insight. He will be powerful, and he will know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: AWURADE Sunzum kɔwa ye so, nworɛ ne ndeaseɛ sunzum, foɛtulɛ ne tumi sunzum, nimdeɛ ne AWURADE surolɛ sunzum.

english_verse: His greatest joy will be to obey the Lord. This king won't judge by appearances or listen to rumors.
translation_verse: Ye nye kɔgye AWURADE surolɛ nwo. Nna bɔ ye nye nwu ye ɔ yeɛ okogyina so kobua ndɛen ɔ, yeɛ nna bɔ ye so te ɔ so yeɛ okogyina kɔyɛ ye adwene ɔ,

english_verse: The poor and the needy will be treated with fairness and with justice. His word will be law everywhere in the land, and criminals will be put to death.
translation_verse: na mmom tenenee yeɛ ɔkɔfa kobua anwumvoinfoɛ ndɛen ɔ, na pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ yeɛ ɔkɔfa koli anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ bɛ dwirɛ kɔma bɛ ɔ. Ye noa nu dwirɛ yeɛ ɔkɔfa kɔyɛ mbire kofi aseɛ ɔ, na ɔkɔfa ye noa nu nwomeɛ kohũhũ bɔnefoɛ.

english_verse: Honesty and fairness will be his royal robes.
translation_verse: Tenenee kɔyɛ abɔsoɛ bɔ ɔkɔfa kɔbɔ ye nu ɔ, yeɛ nahorɛlilɛ kɔyɛ abɔsoɛ kɔbɔ ye yaase.

english_verse: Leopards will lie down with young goats, and wolves will rest with lambs. Calves and lions will eat together and be cared for by little children.
translation_verse: Pataku ne boaen ba bɛkɔtena, aboa ne abɔngye ba bɛkɔla neka horɛ, nandwie ba ne gyata ne nandwie bɔ walɔ ɔ bɛkɔla neka horɛ, na akwadaa ba yeɛ okoli bɛ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: Cows and bears will share the same pasture; their young will rest side by side. Lions and oxen will both eat straw.
translation_verse: Nandwie beleɛ ne kwabrafo bɛkɔbɔ nu bekodidi, bɛ mma mɔ kɔla neka horɛ, na gyata koli ndire kyɛ nandwie ala.

english_verse: Little children will play near snake holes. They will stick their hands into dens of poisonous snakes and never be hurt.
translation_verse: Akwadaa bɔ otua nyɔfone noa ne, okoli angorɛ wɔ ɛkyenebene bɔen noa, yeɛ bɔ wapɛ nyɔfone ne wora, ɔkɔfa ye sa kowura ewobire bɔen nu.

english_verse: Nothing harmful will take place on the Lord's holy mountain. Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord. God's People Will Come Back Home
translation_verse: Ebiala ngohũ anaa ongopura ebiala wɔ me bokaa krongron ne aso amukoraa; ofikyɛ AWURADE nwo nimdeɛ koyi aseɛ so tɛkyɛ, kyɛbɔ nzue ayi ɛpo nu tɛkyɛ ne. Bɛ bɔ bahye bɛ nnure ne kosa kɔwa

english_verse: The time is coming when one of David's descendants will be the signal for the people of all nations to come together. They will follow his advice, and his own nation will become famous.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, Yese ndii ne kogyina berɛ kɔyɛ frangaa kɔma maen ne; maen maen kɔpena ye si atee, na nekaa bɔ ɔte ne kɔyɛ animnyam nekaa.

english_verse: When that day comes, the Lord will again reach out his mighty arm and bring home his people who have survived in Assyria, Egypt, Pathros, Ethiopia, Elam, Shinar, Hamath, and the land along the coast.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɔ kyẽa ne, AWURADE kɔtengyɛ ye sa ye pɛen nyɔ so kole ye mmenia bɔ baha ne kofi Asiria, Misraim, Patrose, Yitiopia, Elam, Sinari, Hamate nu, yeɛ mboanoa supɔ mɔ so.

english_verse: He will give a signal to the nations, and he will bring together the refugees from Judah and Israel, who have been scattered all over the earth.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔfa frangaa kɔpena berɛ kɔma maen maen mɔ, bɛ bɔ bapɛ b’asue bafi Yisrael ne, ɔkɔboaboa bɛ noa, yeɛ bɛ bɔ babɔ aya bafi Yuda ne, ɔkɔboaboa bɛ noa kofi aseɛ ndweasoɛ nna ne aso.

english_verse: Israel will stop being jealous of Judah, and Judah will no longer be the enemy of Israel.
translation_verse: Efraim anyeboroborolɛ ne bo kɔpɛ, Yuda pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ boso komini, Efraim nye ngɔboro Yuda ko, yeɛ Yuda ngɔpɔ Efraim ko.

english_verse: Instead, they will get together and attack the Philistines in the west. Then they will defeat the Edomites, the Moabites, and the Ammonites in the east. They will rule those people and take from them whatever they want.
translation_verse: Na mmom bɛkɔhɔ Filistifoɛ so wɔ eyia atɔleɛ bue nu dɔ, bɛkɔbɔ nu bɛkɔfẽ eyia afiteleɛ maen maen mɔ bɛ nningyein. Bekoli Edom ne Moabo so ngonim, na Amonfoɛ kɔbrɛ bɛ nwo ase bekowura bɛ bo.

english_verse: The Lord will dry up the arm of the Red Sea near Egypt, and he will send a scorching wind to divide the Euphrates River into seven streams that anyone can step across.
translation_verse: Misraim ɛpo ne noa bɔ wadidi wahɔ nu ne, AWURADE kɔwewe ye bɔkɔɔ. Ɔkɔfa ye mvrama hyerɛhyerɛ ne kɔnwaha ye sa wɔ asue Yufreti so, ɔkɔpakyepakye nu maa ɔkɔyɛ asue mmaa mmaa nzoo, bɔ sona pɛ ye a ye gya bo ngɔloa ɔ.

english_verse: Then for his people who survive, there will be a good road from Assyria, just as there was a good road for their ancestors when they left Egypt.
translation_verse: Yiti ye mmenia ngaa bɔ baha ne, atimbire kɔla berɛ kofi Asiria kɔma bɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔlale berɛ mane Yisrael mmerɛ bɔ ofili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “I thank you, Lord! You were angry with me, but you stopped being angry and gave me comfort.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, ekose kyɛ, “O AWURADE, meda wɔ ase, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛfɛle me so yaa, nakoso w’ahone tɔle nzue nu, na ɛkyekyele me wora.

english_verse: I trust you to save me, Lord God, and I won't be afraid. My power and my strength come from you, and you have saved me.”
translation_verse: Amba, Nyameɛ te me ngoalelɛ, ngɔfa me wora ngowura ye nu, na mengosuro, ofikyɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ te m’anwoserɛ ne me dwein, na wayɛ me ngoalelɛ.”

english_verse: With great joy, you people will get water from the well of victory.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkɔfa anigye yeɛ bɛkɔto nzue bekofi ngoalelɛ abura mɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: At that time you will say, “Our Lord, we are thankful, and we worship only you. We will tell the nations how glorious you are and what you have done.
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ɛmɔkose kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfa asennaa bɛ́ma AWURADE, ɛ́mɔbɔ ye dumaa, ɛ́mɔbɔ ye anwanwadeɛ ne dawure wɔ maen maen mɔ nu, ɛ́mɔbɔ ye dawure kyɛ ye dumaa ne te piri.

english_verse: Because of your wonderful deeds we will sing your praises everywhere on earth.”
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔto AWURADE nwo ayɛyelɛ dwein, ofikyɛ wayɔ anwanwadeɛ nningyein; ɛ́mɔma bénwu sɔ dwirɛ ne wɔ aseɛ amukoraa so.

english_verse: Sing, people of Zion! Celebrate the greatness of the holy Lord of Israel. God is here to help you.
translation_verse: O ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔte Sion ɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ ese bɛ́to dwein anigye so, ofikyɛ Yisrael Krongronniɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ afia ne, ɔte piri.”

english_verse: This is the message that I was given about Babylon:
translation_verse: Babilɔn nwo nyekyire bɔ Amoso awa Yesaya nyane ye ne, ye ɛhe:

english_verse: From high on a barren hill give a signal, shout the orders, and point the way to enter the gates of Babylon's proud rulers.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa frangaa bɛ́pena bokaa pralaa ti afia, ɛ́mɔtea nu bɛ́frɛ bɛ, ɛ́mɔbɔ bɛ ba ma beewurawura atitirefoɛ nemɔ b’anoa nu.

english_verse: The Lord has commanded his very best warriors and his proud heroes to show how angry he is.
translation_verse: Me yeɛ mafa ahyɛdeɛ mama me mmenia krongron nemɔ ɔ; masa mato me sa mafrɛ me koɛhonɛfoɛ, bɔ bedi me ngonim nwo ahurusi ne, kyɛ bégyina me yaafɛlɛ ne aso bɛ́yɔ bɔ mepena ɔ.

english_verse: Listen to the noisy crowds on the mountains! Kingdoms and nations are joining forces. The Lord All-Powerful is bringing together an army for battle.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie! Esebɔlɛ bie ɔkɔ so wɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso kyɛ ɛlɔen pirikua bie komvi. Ɛ́mɔtie! Ɔte ahennie mɔ b’esebɔlɛ piri, maen maen mɔ bɔ baboaboa bɛ noa ɔ! Asafo AWURADE ɔ́boaboa ye lɔen noa maa bɛkɔ koɛ.

english_verse: From a distant land the Lord is coming fierce and furious— he brings his weapons to destroy the whole earth.
translation_verse: Befi dedeede aseɛ bie aso ne ewienu noa dɔ paa yeɛ bɛ́ba ɔ, AWURADE ne ye ahonehulɛ akodeɛ ne, kyɛ ɔbaasɛkye aseɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: Cry and weep! The day is coming when the mighty Lord will bring destruction. *
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye, ofikyɛ AWURADE kyẽa ne apingye; kyẽa ne kɔwa, bɔ Tuminiɛ ne kɔfa kohũhũ mmenia ɔ!

english_verse: All people will be terrified. Hands will grow limp; courage will melt away.
translation_verse: Yiti asaa mukoraa nu kohodwo, ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ sona biala so,

english_verse: Everyone will tremble with pain like a woman giving birth; they will stare at each other with horror on their faces. There Will Be No Mercy
translation_verse: na bɛ nwo kodwiri bɛ. Yealɛ ne aworabɔlɛ kotira bɛ, na bɛkɔte yealɛ kyɛ brasua bɔ wafo aworɛ so ɔ. Ebiala kɔfa anwodwiri kɔnea obiɛngo nyunu, na bɛ nyunu kɔyɛ bosabosaa.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will show no mercy or pity when that time comes. In my anger I will destroy the earth and every sinner who lives on it.
translation_verse: Tie, AWURADE kyẽa ne ɔ́ba, ɔ́ba ye atianuserɛ ne ahonehulɛ ne anyeborolɛ so, kyɛ ɔbaasɛkye aseɛ ye bɔkɔɔ, ná okũkũ so bɔnefoɛ fi so.

english_verse: Light will disappear from the stars in the sky; the dawning sun will turn dark, and the moon will lose its brightness.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ewienu nzramaa ne nzramaa kure kure mɔ bɛngɔta, eyia pukye a, ɔkɔyɛ tunn, yeɛ ɛsraen koso ngɔta.

english_verse: I will punish this evil world and its people because of their sins. I will crush the horrible pride of those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Mebaahwe ewiase so wɔ ye bɔne nwo, ngɔhwe bɔnefoɛ so wɔ b’amumuyɛɛ nwo, ngɔpɛ ahandaenfoɛ b’anwomasoɛ ne aso, yeɛ ngɔbrɛ atianuserɛfoɛ bɛ nduhoɛ ne ase.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am terribly angry— I will make the sky tremble and the earth shake loose.
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔwoso anwuro, aseɛ kopusu kofi ye boso, wɔ Asafo AWURADE ahonehulɛ ne anu, ɔne ye ɛyaafɛlɛ piri kyẽa ne.

english_verse: Everyone will run to their homelands, just as hunted deer run, and sheep scatter when they have no shepherd.
translation_verse: Sona biala kɔhɔ ye nwo ama berɛ, bɛ mukoraa bɛkɔnwati bɛkɔhɔ bɛ maen nu, na bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ ɛwanzane bɔ bɛfoa ye ɔ, anaa mmoaen bɔ babɔ aya ɔ.

english_verse: Those men who are captured will be killed by a sword.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ bekonwu ye ne, bɛkɔwɔ ye dadeɛ, yeɛ bɔ bɛkɔhye ye ne koso, ɔkɔtɔ ngrandɛ noa.

english_verse: They will see their children beaten against rocks, their homes robbed, and their wives abused.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔtete bɛ mma mmaa mmaa mɔ nu pasapasa bɔ bɛ nye tua ɔ. Bɛkɔfẽ b’awuro nningyein, na bɛkɔhyɛ bɛ ye mɔ bɛkɔto bɛ mmɔnaa.

english_verse: The Medes can't be bought off with silver or gold, and I'm sending them to attack Babylonia.
translation_verse: Tie, ngɔkanyane Medesefoɛ maa bekodwɔso bekotia bɛ, Medesefoɛ de, bemmu dwetɛ, yeɛ bɛ nye ngye sikaa kɔkorɛ nwo.

english_verse: Their arrows will slaughter the young men; no pity will be shown to babies and children. The Lord Will Destroy Babylon
translation_verse: B’agyaen kohũhũ mmerandeɛ nemɔ, bengonwu nnɔma mɔ anwumvoin, yeɛ ngwadaa koso ngɔyɛ bɛ anwumvo.

english_verse: The city of Babylon is glorious and powerful, the pride of the nation. But it will be like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah after I, the Lord, destroyed them.
translation_verse: Na Babilɔn bɔ ɔte ahennie mɔ nu animnyam ne, Kaldeafoɛ b’anwohoahoa piri ne, ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ Sodom ne Gomora bɔ Nyameɛ huhuni bɛ ne.

english_verse: No one will live in Babylon. Even nomads won't camp nearby, and shepherds won't let their sheep rest there.
translation_verse: Sona biala ngɔtena nu le, yeɛ ebiala ngɔtena nu wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ mukoraa nu. Arabofoɛ tutenafoɛ ne, bɛ nu biala ngosi ɛtena sua wɔ berɛ, yeɛ mmoaenneafoɛ biala ngɔma ye mmoaen ngɔla berɛ.

english_verse: Only desert creatures, hoot owls, and ostriches will live in its ruins, and goats will leap about.
translation_verse: Ɛserɛ so ngaka aboyaa yeɛ bɛkɔfa berɛ bɛkɔyɛ bɛ dabea ɔ, patue mɔ koyi bɛ sua nemɔ anu tɛkyɛ, soholi mɔ kɔfa berɛ kɔyɛ b’awuro, na berɛ yeɛ eburo mbɔngye kogo abilie ɔ.

english_verse: Hyenas and wolves will howl from Babylon's fortresses and beautiful palaces. Its time is almost up!
translation_verse: Kangane mɔ kopo wɔ ye abandenden nemɔ anu, ɛserɛ so ngyea kopo wɔ ye ahemvie nyemenenyemene nemɔ anu. Ye mmerɛ ne apingye, na ɔngɔhyɛ biala né wato ye.

english_verse: The Lord will have mercy on Israel and will let them be his chosen people once again. He will bring them back to their own land, and foreigners will join them as part of Israel.
translation_verse: Amba, AWURADE konwu Yakob anwumvoin. Okosa kɔneanea nu kɔye Yisrael, na ɔkɔfa bɛ koolua bɛ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ so. Na amanvrafoɛ kɔɔboka bɛ so bɛkɔfa bɛ nwo bɛkɔbɔ Yakob boso ama.

english_verse: Other nations will lead them home, and Israel will make slaves of them in the land that belongs to the Lord. Israel will rule over those who once governed and mistreated them. Death to the King of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Maen maen mɔ kɔfa Yisraelfoɛ bɛkɔwa Yisraelfoɛ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ so, na Yisrael awuro ama kɔfa maen maen nemɔ kɔyɛ nganga ne afaneɛ mɔ wɔ AWURADE aseɛ ne aso. Na mmenia bɔ bɛhyele Yisrael nnure ne, Yisrael koso kɔhye bɛ nnure, na bekoli sɔ mmenia bɔ bɛhyɛle bɛ so ne aso. Babilɔn hene ayieleɛ

english_verse: The Lord will set you free from your sorrow, suffering, and slavery.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, kyẽa bɔ AWURADE kɔye wɔ kofi wɔ yealɛ, amaneɛ ne kanga adwuma bɔ bɛhyɛle wɔ maa ɛyɔle ne anu ne,

english_verse: Then you will make fun of the King of Babylonia by singing this song: That cruel monster is done for! He won't attack us again.
translation_verse: kã ngorohoɛ dwirɛ he fa Babilɔn hene nwo: “Anyandimlilɛniɛ ne, ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ ye ayieleɛ ayie ye ɔ! Ye ahandaen ne, ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ ye bo apɛ ɔ!

english_verse: The Lord has crushed the power of those evil kings,
translation_verse: AWURADE abubu bɔnefoɛ pɔmaa ne anu, wabubu maenbulɛfoɛ b’ɛhɔtɔ nemɔ anu.

english_verse: Now all the world is at peace; its people are celebrating with joyful songs.
translation_verse: Aseɛ amukoraa so adwo, asomdwee awa, bɛto dwein anigye so.

english_verse: King of Babylonia, even the cypress trees and the cedars of Lebanon celebrate and say, “Since you were put down, no one comes along to chop us down.”
translation_verse: Bɔ wato wɔ ne, ɔyɛ ɛframmire mɔ fɛ, ɔne Lebanon sida mɔ koso fɛ, na bɛkã kyɛ, ‘Ofi mmerɛ bɔ bɛbrɛle wɔ ase ɔ, sona biala ɔmma kyɛ ɔbaabu yɛ gua.’

english_verse: Each one of them will say, “Now you are just as weak as any of us!
translation_verse: Na bɛ mukoraa bekobukye bɛ noa bekose wɔ kyɛ, ‘Eh, wɔ koso ayɛ mmerɛ kyɛ yɛ ala! Ɛne yɛ yayɛ pɛ!’

english_verse: Your pride and your music have ended here in the world of the dead. Worms are your blanket, maggots are your bed.”
translation_verse: W’anwomasoɛ ne, ye bo aapɛ wɔ ɛborɔ, w’adengum bɔ bɛbɔ ne koso sɔ ala; bɛen bɔ ɛla so ne te nnɔboakoma, na esuronyi yeɛ bafa bagurɔ wɔ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: You, the bright morning star, have fallen from the sky! You brought down other nations; now you are brought down.
translation_verse: “O, Alehyeleɛ Nzramaa, Alebahyene ɔwa, ɛtetɔlɛ yeɛ efi nyameɛso ate atɔ ase sɔaa e! Wɔ bɔ elili maen maen mɔ so ngonim ne, aseɛnwo yeɛ bafindi wɔ bato sɔaa ye!

english_verse: You said to yourself, “I'll climb to heaven and place my throne above the highest stars. I'll sit there with the gods far away in the north.
translation_verse: Ɛhane ye wɔ wɔ ti anu kyɛ, ‘Ngɔfo ngɔhɔ nyameɛso, ngɔfa m’ahennie bia ngoosie anwuro anwuro maa ɔkɔtra Nyameɛ nzramaa mɔ. Bokaa ne aso nyianu ne, ngɔɔtena nu wɔ sorɔ dɔ paa aseɛ ne aso.

english_verse: I'll be above the clouds, just like God Most High.”
translation_verse: Ngɔfo ngɔhɔ munungum nemɔ ti afia dɔ, na ngɔyɛ kyɛ Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne.’

english_verse: But now you are deep in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Nakoso bagyi wɔ bato ɛborɔ, ɛborɔ kumaa kuronguronn ne abo paa.

english_verse: Those who see you will stare and wonder, “Is this the man who made the world tremble and shook up kingdoms?
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ benwu wɔ ne, bɛkɔnea wɔ haa, na bɛkɔdwene bɔ wato wɔ ne anwo bɛkɔhã kyɛ, ‘Eh, biaa bɔ ɔmane aseɛ wosole ná opusuli ahennie mɔ ne, aso ye ɛhe anaa?

english_verse: Did he capture every city and make earth a desert? Is he the one who refused to let prisoners go home?”
translation_verse: Ye bɔ ɔkakyili ewiase kyɛ ɛserɛ so, bɔ ɔbɔle nu nguro mɔ pasaa, bɔ wanyakyi nu kukunufoɛ ate ma bangɔ b’awuro ne, aso ye ɛhe anaa?’

english_verse: When kings die, they are buried in glorious tombs.
translation_verse: Maen maen ahemvo amukoraa balela wɔ animnyam nu, ebiala la ye asieleɛ nu;

english_verse: But you will be left unburied, just another dead body lying underfoot like a broken branch. You will be one of many killed in battle and gone down to the deep rocky pit.
translation_verse: nakoso wɔ de, bafindi wɔ bato bafi w’asieleɛ nu kyɛ bakaa mmaen bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ ɔ, kyɛ bɛ bɔ batotɔ ngrandɛ noa, bɔ bɛkɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nyɔboɛ nu, kyɛ efuin bɔ batiatia ye so ɔ.

english_verse: You won't be buried with kings; you ruined your country and murdered your people. You evil monster! We hope that your family will be forgotten forever.
translation_verse: Bengosie wɔ ne bɛ ngɔbɔ nu, ofikyɛ asɛkye w’aseɛ, yeɛ ahũhũ wɔ mmenia. “Bɔnefoɛ bɛ bosofoɛ de, bɛngɔbɔ bɛ dumaa paa ko le!

english_verse: We will slaughter your sons to make them pay for the crimes of their ancestors. They won't take over the world or build cities anywhere on this earth.
translation_verse: Ɔnate bɛ se mɔ amumuyɛɛ ti, ɛ́mɔsiesie akumyɛɛ bɔ bekohu ye mma wɔ berɛ ɔ; amaa ɔnate so bandwɔso bamva aseɛ ne banni so tumi ná bangyekye nguro wɔ ewiase nekaa biala.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has promised to attack Babylonia and destroy everyone there, so that none of them will ever be remembered again.
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ngodwɔso ngotia bɛ, na ngonunu ɛhemɔ bɛ boso ngofi Babilɔn: dumaa, bɛ bɔ baha ne, mmaa, yeɛ bɛ boso ama. AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The Lord will sweep out the people, and the land will become a swamp for wild animals. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Ngɔmaa ɔkɔyɛ mbɛsɛ mɔ b’agyapadeɛ, na ɛkwaa kɔtaataa so, na ngɔfa ɛsɛkyelɛ saen ngɔsɛkye ye ngɔpra ye boso, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.” Asiria nwo ngɔm

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has made this promise: Everything I have planned will happen just as I said.
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE ata ndaen kyɛ, “Kyɛbɔ masusu ye nwo ne, sɔ ala yeɛ okosi ɔ, kyɛbɔ mayɛ m’adwene ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔkɔwa nu ɔ:

english_verse: I will wipe out every Assyrian in my country, and I will crush those on my mountains. I will free my people from slavery to the Assyrians.
translation_verse: kyɛ ngɔsɛkye Asiria pasaa wɔ m’aseɛ so, yeɛ ngotiatia ye so wɔ me mmokaa nemɔ aso, ye kɔnnua ne kɔye kofi bɛ kɔme anu, na ye adesoa bɔ ɔla bɛ bati ne kɔye kofi berɛ.”

english_verse: I have planned this for the whole world, and my mighty arm controls every nation.
translation_verse: Nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ ɔla berɛ fa aseɛ amukoraa nwo ɛne; na ɛhe te asaa bɔ watengyɛ ye wɔ maen maen mukoraa so ɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have made these plans. No one can stop me now! The Philistines Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE ayɛ ye adwene, na nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔbɔ kogua ɔ? Watengyɛ ye sa nu, na nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔhwe ye sa ne kosa nziɛ ɔ? Filistia nwo ngɔm

english_verse: This message came from the Lord in the year King Ahaz died:
translation_verse: Afoɛ bɔ Nana Ahase wuli ne, nu ala yeɛ sɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛ he wale ɔ:

english_verse: Philistines, don't be happy just because the rod that punished you is broken. That rod will become a poisonous snake, and then a flying fiery dragon.
translation_verse: Filistia amukoraa, nnɛdi ahurusi, kyɛ mbire bɔ ofini wɔ ne, nu abubu ɔ, ofikyɛ ewoo ne, ye ndii nu yeɛ ɛkyenebene kofi kɔwa ɔ, na ɔwa ne kɔyɛ see ewoo bɔ otu ɔ.

english_verse: The poor and needy will find pastures for their sheep and will live in safety. But I will starve some of you, and others will be killed.
translation_verse: Ehiafoɛ bɛ bamuɛbaa mɔ konya aleɛ koli, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ne wora, bɛkɔla berɛ asomdwee nu, nakoso wɔ de, ngɔfa ɛhɔen ngonua wɔ mma bɛ boso, yeɛ ngohũhũ wɔ boso ama koso.

english_verse: Cry and weep in the gates of your towns, you Philistines! Smoke blows in from the north, and every soldier is ready.
translation_verse: O pambim, bɔ awuye; kuro piri, sũ serɛserɛ, O Filistia amukoraa, ma wɔ kunu tete wɔ! Ofikyɛ nwosina fi sorɔ dɔ ótu ba, na ye lɔen ne, ebiala ngɔte ye nwo ngɔha nziɛ.

english_verse: If a messenger comes from a distant nation, you must say: “The Lord built Zion. Even the poorest of his people will find safety there.”
translation_verse: Ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ befi sɔ maen ne aso ne, nzikyɛ mmuayɛɛ yeɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔma bɛ ɔ? Yɛkobua kyɛ, ‘AWURADE akyekye Sion, na ye maen ne anu mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ne, bɛkɔbɔ bɛ nwo adwaa wɔ nu.’

english_verse: This is a message about Moab: The towns of Ar and Kir were destroyed in a night. Moab is left in ruins!
translation_verse: Moabo nwo nyekyire. Kɔngɔen komapɛ yeɛ bɛsɛkyele Are kuro ne ɔ, yiti Moabo abɔ ayɛ kurofoen; Kɔngɔen komapɛ yeɛ bɛsɛkyele Kire kuro ne ɔ, yiti Moabo abɔ ayɛ kurofoen.

english_verse: Everyone in Dibon has gone up to the temple and the shrines to cry and weep. All of Moab is crying. Heads and beards are shaved because of what happened at Nebo and Medeba.
translation_verse: Dibɔn awa brasua ne afo ahɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua nemɔ anu kyɛ ɔkwaasu, Moabo bɔ awuye wɔ Nebo ne Medeba, bɛ mukoraa babɔ tikwa, ebiala apoa ye kanza;

english_verse: In the towns and at home, everyone wears sackcloth and cries loud and long.
translation_verse: baherahera ɛsɛen tena wɔ bɛ mmorɔnoɛ nemɔ aso, ebiala ɔbɔ awuye osũ hahii wɔ bɛ sua nemɔ ti afia ne dwaaso.

english_verse: From Heshbon and Elealeh, weeping is heard in Jahaz; Moab's warriors scream while trembling with fear. Pity Moab
translation_verse: Hesebon ne Eleale besu serɛserɛ, bɛte bɛ suɛ alaa kodwu Yahase, yiti Moabo koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛteatea nu, na ye nwo ngaka anwati.

english_verse: I pity Moab! Its people are running to Zoar and to Eglath-Shelishiyah. They cry on their way up to the town of Luhith; on the road to Horonaim they tell of disasters.
translation_verse: Medi Moabo nwo aworabɔlɛ, ye mmenia bɔ bɛnwati ne, banwati baadwu Soa, baadwu Eglate Selisiya. Ofikyɛ Luhite pambaa ne, bele esuɛ yeɛ bɛfo ɔ; na atee bɔ ɔkɔ Horonaim ne, awuye yeɛ bɛbɔ bɛfa so ɔ.

english_verse: The streams of Nimrim and the grasslands have dried up. Every plant is parched.
translation_verse: Nimrim asue nemɔ babɔ mvuture, ɛserɛ ne akese, ndire nemɔ ayera, na ndire monɛ nne berɛ ko.

english_verse: The people of Moab are leaving, crossing over Willow Creek, taking everything they own and have worked for.
translation_verse: Yiti anwonya bɔ banya ye, ɔne nningyein bɔ baboaboa ye noa basie ne, bɛsoa bɛfa bɛpɛ asuenoa mmakaa bɔnza ne.

english_verse: In the towns of Eglaim and of Beerelim and everywhere else in Moab mournful cries are heard.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ esuɛ ne adwu Moabo aseɛ so amukoraa, ye awuyebɔlɛ ne adwu Eglaim, awuyebɔlɛ ne adwu Beɛ Elim.

english_verse: The streams near Dimon are flowing with blood. But the Lord will bring even worse trouble to Dimon, because all in Moab who escape will be attacked by lions.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Dimon nzue amukoraa akakyi mogya, na ngɔma bɔ ɔtra so ɔ kɔto Dimon: gyata kɔhye Moabofoɛ bɔ bɛkɔnwati ne, ɔkɔhye bɛ bɔ bɛkɔha aseɛ ne aso ne.

english_verse: Send lambs as gifts to the ruler of the land. Send them across the desert from Sela to Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa mmoaen mmaa bɛɛma aseɛ ne aso hene, ɛ́mɔfa bɛ béfi Sela bɛɛfa ɛserɛ atee ne aso bɛhɔ Sion awa brasua bokaa ne aso.

english_verse: The women of Moab crossing the Arnon River are like a flock of birds scattered from their nests.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ nnomaa mmaa bɔ bafoa bɛ bafi bɛ saen nu bɔ bekyinikyini ne bɛte ne, sɔ yeɛ Moabo mma mmrasua nemɔ bɛkɔyɛ wɔ Anɔn apɛleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Moab's messengers say to the people of Judah, “Be kind and help us! Shade us from the heat of the noonday sun. Hide our refugees! Don't turn them away.
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔtu yɛ foɛ, ɛ́mɔbua ndɛen turoloo, na eyia ketee po, ma wɔ waenbɔlɛ fɔnwoo ne anu ɔyɛ kyɛ kɔngɔen; fa bɛ bɔ bapɛ bɛ asue nemɔ fea, mmenia bɔ bɛnwati ne, nnɛye bɛ ma.

english_verse: Let our people live in your country and find safety here.” Moab, your cruel enemies will disappear; they will no longer attack and destroy your land.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ bafoa bɛ bafi Moabo ne, maa beesikye wɔ berɛ, bɔ bɛ nwo waen fi bɔ ɔpena bɛ ku bɛ ne sa nu.” Sɛ nhyɛsoɛniɛ nne berɛ, ná mmenia hunɛ bo apɛ, ná apaabɔlɛfoɛ betu bemini befi aseɛ ne aso a,

english_verse: Then a kingdom of love will be set up, and someone from David's family will rule with fairness. He will do what is right and quickly bring justice. Moab's Pride Is Destroyed
translation_verse: yeɛ bɛkɔfa ahennie bia ne bekotimu berɛ wɔ ɔdɔ nu ɔ, na ɔkɔtena so nahorɛlilɛ nu wɔ Dawide ɛtena sua nu, ɔte ebie bɔ ɔfa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ obu maen ɔ, na okobua ndɛen turoloo ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: We have heard of Moab's pride. Its people strut and boast, but without reason.
translation_verse: Moabo anwomasoɛ ne, yate ye nga, ɔte anwomasoɛ paa, ye ahandaen, ye anwomasoɛ ne ye ahonehulɛ ne: ɔbobɔ ye noa nu mbaen.

english_verse: Tell everyone in Moab to mourn for their nation. Tell them to cry and weep for those fancy raisins of Kir-Hareseth.
translation_verse: Yiti ma Moabo osũ Moabo, ma ebiala osũ, Kire Haresete bobe mmaa taterɛ ne ati, ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye paa.

english_verse: Vineyards near Heshbon and Sibmah have turned brown. The rulers of nations used to get drunk on wine from those vineyards that spread to Jazer, then across the desert and beyond the sea.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Hesebon eboo nemɔ asɛkye, Sibima bobe nemɔ koso sɔ ala. Maen maen mbanyi mɔ bapomba bɛ mmaen nemɔ bagua. Mmaen nemɔ bɛtrɛ bekodwu Yasere, na bɛkondokondo alaa bɛkɔ ɛserɛ so. Ye mmaen ne, bɛtrɛ bɛkɔ dedeede, na bɛpɛ ɛpo bɛkɔ ye si.

english_verse: Now I mourn like Jazer for the vineyards of Sibmah. I shed tears for Heshbon and for Elealeh. There will be no more harvest celebrations
translation_verse: Yiti Yasere esuɛ bɔ osũ ne, ebie yeɛ mefa mesũ Sibima bobe ne ɔ. Meporo me nye moen megua wɔ so, O Hesebon ne Eleale, ofikyɛ ese bɔ wɔ mmakaammaa telɛ dwu a bɛbɔ, ɔne bɔ bebu w’aburoo a bɛbɔ ne, ye bo apɛ.

english_verse: or joyful and happy times, while bringing in the crops. Singing and shouting are gone from the vineyards. There are no joyful shouts where grapes were pressed. God has silenced them all.
translation_verse: Baye anika ne anigye bafi eboo bɔ aleɛ wɔ nu ne anu, yeɛ bobe boo nemɔ anu koso, bɛndo anigye dwein wɔ nu ko, bɛmmɔ ese wɔ nu ko, kumaa bɔ betwi nzaa wɔ nu ne, bendwi nzaa berɛ ko, mmakaammaa telɛ nwo esebɔlɛ ne, mama ye bo apɛ.

english_verse: It's useless for Moab's people to wear themselves out by going to their altars to worship and pray.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɛ Moabo kɔ asɔneyɛɛ so kɔsɔne ɔfɛ ye nwo, ná ɔkɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua nu ɔkɔbɔ mbaeɛ a, ongosi huu.

english_verse: The Lord has already said all of this about Moab.
translation_verse: Daa ne, edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE hã fale Moabo nwo ɛne.

english_verse: Now he says, “The contract of a hired worker is good for three years, but Moab's glory and greatness won't last any longer than that. Only a few of its people will survive, and they will be left helpless.”
translation_verse: Nakoso kekesaala ye de, AWURADE nwa, “Kyɛ odwu afoɛ nza, kyɛbɔ paaniɛ osi ka ye afoɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ne, Moabo animnyam nyunu kogua ase. Ɔmva ye nwo kyɛ ye lɔen ne sone pee ɔ; na bɛ bɔ bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ne, bɛkɔyɛ kaaba bie bɔ bɛ nwo nyɛ se ɔ.”

english_verse: This is a message about Damascus: Damascus is doomed! It will end up in ruins.
translation_verse: Damasko nwo nyekyire. Tie, Damasko ngɔyɛ kuro ko, ɔkɔkakyi esire.

english_verse: The villages around Aroer will be deserted, with only sheep living there and no one to bother them.
translation_verse: Aroye nguro nemɔ kɔkakyi kurofoen, bɛkɔyɛ nyɛmmoa mɔ deɛ, na bɛkɔlela berɛ bɔ ebiala ngɔma bengosuro ɔ.

english_verse: Israel will lose its fortresses. The kingdom of Damascus will be destroyed; its survivors will suffer the same fate as Israel. The Lord All-Powerful has promised this. Sin and Suffering
translation_verse: Bɛkɔsɛkye Efraim abandenden ne, bɛkɔbɔ Damasko ahennie ne tɔɔ, na Siriafoɛ bɔ bɛkɔha ne, b’animnyam kɔhɔ ase kyɛ Yisraelfoɛ deɛ ne ala, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: When that time comes, the glorious nation of Israel will be brought down; its prosperous people will be skin and bones.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɔ kyẽa ne, Yakob animnyam kɔhɔ ase, na ye nwo naen bɔ walɔ ɛloe ne, ɔkɔfɔ.

english_verse: It will be like an olive tree beaten with a stick, leaving two or three olives or maybe four or five on the highest or most fruitful branches. The Lord God of Israel has promised this.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛte bobe a ebie ka nu, kyɛbɔ bɛwoso olive bakaa a ebie ka so ne, mmaa nyɔ anaa nza ka bakaa mmaen frɔmfrɔm ne aso anwuro, bɔ nna anaa nnu ka ye mmaen bɔ wasu dɔsɔɔ ne aso ɔ, AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: At that time the people will turn and trust their Creator, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, kuro sona kɔfa ye nwo kɔto Nyameɛ bɔ ɔbɔle ye ne aso, na ɔkɔma ye nye kɔla Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne so.

english_verse: They have built altars and places for burning incense to their goddess Asherah, and they have set up sacred poles for her. But they will stop worshiping at these places.
translation_verse: Ɔngɔfa ye nwo ngɔto afɔleɛ mmokyea bɔ ɔte ye sa noa adwuma ne aso. Yeɛ Asera dosii anaa ɛyɛɛ afɔleɛ mmokyea bɔ wafa ye sa mmaa wayɔ ne koso, ɔngɔfa ye nye ngɔto so.

english_verse: Israel captured powerful cities and chased out the people who lived there. But these cities will lie in ruins, covered over with weeds and underbrush.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, ye nguro bɔ bɛ nwo yɛ se nemɔ, bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ Hiwifoɛ ne Amorifoɛ nguro bɔ ɔnate Yisraelfoɛ ti bɛnwati bɛyakyili bɛ berɛ ne. Bɛkɔkakyi kurofoen.

english_verse: Israel, you have forgotten the God who saves you, the one who is the mighty rock where you find protection. You plant the finest flowers to honor a foreign god.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ ngoalelɛ Nyameɛ ne, wɔ wora afi ye, na angaye Nyɔbotaen bɔ ɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen ne. Ye sɔ ne ati, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ edua nningyein paa paa de, edua nningyein bɔ ofi maen bie aso de,

english_verse: The plants may sprout and blossom that very same morning, but it will do you no good, because you will suffer endless agony. God Defends His People
translation_verse: ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛmaa befifi kyẽa bɔ edua ne ala de, ɛmaa bɛbɔ nyerɛen ngyerɛmɔ ne ala bɔ edua ne de, nakoso aworabɔlɛ ne anwonyerɛ koangɔ kyẽa ne, ye mmaa bɔ wasu ne kotu komini.

english_verse: But even if they roar like a fearsome flood, God will give the command to turn them back. They will be like dust, or like a tumbleweed blowing across the hills in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Maen maen mɔ bɛyɛ dede kyɛ asue mɔ bɔ bɛse wuruwuru ɔ, nakoso Nyameɛ twi bɛ nyunu, na bɛnwati bɛkɔ dede, ɔfoa bɛ kyɛ afafu bɔ mvrama bɔ ye fi bokaa so ɔ, kyɛ mvuture bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo wɔ mvrama piri nu ɔ.

english_verse: In the evening their attack is fierce, but by morning they are destroyed. This is what happens to those who raid and rob us.
translation_verse: Tie, odwu nɔsoa a, ahunundetelɛ! Anzana aleɛ baahye ne, né bɛnne berɛ ko. Bɛ bɔ bɛfa koɛ bɛtoa yɛ ne, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ yɛ so apaa ne, b’ayieleɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Downstream from Ethiopia lies the country of Egypt, swarming with insects.
translation_verse: Wɔ yaakɔ oo, aseɛ bɔ bɛbɔ bɛ ndaa nu papapapa wɔ so, bɔ ɔwɔ Yitiopia asue nemɔ si dɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Egypt sends messengers up the Nile River on ships made of reeds. Send them fast to Ethiopia, whose people are tall and have smooth skin. Their land is divided by rivers; they are strong and brutal, feared all over the world.
translation_verse: Wɔ bɔ etu ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ maa bɛfa ɛpo so, bɔ bɛtena elemmire ɛlɛen nu wɔ nzue so bɛkɔ ɔ! Ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ ɛmɔ nwo yɛ nyera ɔ, ɛmɔhɔ maen bɔ nu mmenia te ndendenn anwonyemenefoɛ nemɔ berɛ, maen bɔ bɛ nwo suronyi atɔ mmenia bɔ bepingye bɛ ɔ so, ɔne nziɛnziɛfoɛ so ɔ, anwoserɛ ne ngonimlilɛ maen ne, maen bɔ asue mɔ bahyehyɛ ye aseɛ nu ne.

english_verse: Everyone on this earth, listen with care! A signal will be given on the mountains, and you will hear a trumpet.
translation_verse: Ewiase mmenia mukoraa, ebiala bɔ ɔte aseɛ so ɔ, sɛ ɔfa frangaa pena mmokaa nemɔ aso a, ɛ́mɔnea! Sɛ ohu totorobɛndo a, ɛ́mɔtie!

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “I will calmly look down from my home above— as calmly as the sun at noon or clouds in the heat of harvest season.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔ AWURADE ahã ahyire me ɛhe: “Ngɔtena nekaa bɔ nde ne konn ngɔto me nye ngɔnea, kyɛbɔ eyia bɔ a, ahuhuro ba ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɛborɔ gua pee wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɛfa fieso aleɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Before the blossoms can turn into grapes, God will cut off the sprouts and hack off the branches.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, anzana fieso aleɛ falɛ kodwu, mmerɛ bɔ nyerɛen nemɔ baporo bagua, bɔ nyerɛen nemɔ bati bayɛ bobe gyegyerewaa ne, ɔkɔfa asɔsɔaa kɔpepɛ mmaen bɔ wafefɛ ye nwo ne kogua, na okodwaadwaa mmaen nemɔ kogua.

english_verse: Those Ethiopians are tall and their skin is smooth. They are feared all over the world, because they are strong and brutal. But at that time they will come from their land divided by rivers, and they will bring gifts to the Lord All-Powerful, who is worshiped on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Na sɔ mmerɛ ne, bɛkɔfa akyɛdeɛ bɛkɔbrɛ Asafo AWURADE, bɛkɔfa bekofi maen bɔ nu mmenia te ndendenn anwonyemenefoɛ, bɔ bɛ nwo suronyi atɔ mmenia bɔ bepingye bɛ ɔ so, ɔne nziɛnziɛfoɛ mɔ so ɔ, anwoserɛ ne ngonimlilɛ maen ne, bɔ asue mɔ ahyehyɛ b’aseɛ nu ne, bɛkɔfa bɛkɔbrɛ Asafo AWURADE wɔ Sion bokaa ne aso, nekaa bɔ AWURADE dumaa la so ne.

english_verse: This is a message about Egypt: The Lord comes to Egypt, riding swiftly on a cloud. The people are weak from fear. Their idols tremble as he approaches and says,
translation_verse: Misraim nwo nyekyire. Tie, AWURADE te munungum bɔ ye nwo yɛ nyera ɔ so ɔ́ba Misraim. Misraim mmosoen mɔ nwo kɔhã bɛ tɛtɛtɛtɛ wɔ ye nyunu, na ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ Misraim so.

english_verse: “I will punish Egypt with civil war— neighbors, cities, and kingdoms will fight each other.
translation_verse: Ngɔkanyane Misraimfoɛ maa bekodwɔso bekotia Misraimfoɛ, bɛkɔho, aliɛmaa ne aliɛmaa bɛkɔho, abiɛngoɛ ne abiɛngoɛ bɛkɔho, kuro ne kuro bɛkɔho, na ahennie ne ahennie bɛkɔho.

english_verse: “Egypt will be discouraged when I confuse their plans. They will try to get advice from their idols, from the spirits of the dead, and from fortunetellers.
translation_verse: Misraim sunzum bɔ ɔwɔ ye nu ɔ ye nwo kɔto, bɛkɔ agyina a, ngɔmaa ɔkɔyɛ mbaen, bɛkɔhɔ abisa wɔ mmosoen ne musueyelɛfoɛ, nzamangɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne ngɔndwemahwenɛfoɛ so.

english_verse: I will put the Egyptians under the power of a cruel, heartless king. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have promised this.” Trouble along the Nile
translation_verse: Na ngɔfa Misraimfoɛ ngowura meneɛ atianuserɛniɛ bie sa, ɛhene bɔ ye nwo yɛ suro ɔ yeɛ okoli bɛ so ɔ, AWURADE, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The Nile River will dry up and become parched land.
translation_verse: Asue Naele nu nzue kɔwewe, asue ne kɔwewe kɔbɔ mvuture,

english_verse: Its streams will stink, Egypt will have no water, and the reeds and tall grass will dry up.
translation_verse: asue ne sa nemɔ, bɛkɔbo mvamva, Misraim Naele ye sa nemɔ, bɛkɔwewe bɛkɔbɔ mvuture, na elemmire ne ngyɛngyɛma nemɔ kɔkese.

english_verse: Fields along the Nile will be completely barren; every plant will disappear.
translation_verse: Asue Naele noa kɔyɛ pralaa, ye noa ndire nemɔ kɔyera, nningyein amukoraa bɔ balua ye Naele noa ne, okowu, na ɔkɔyera bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: None of the cloth makers will know what to do, and they will turn pale.
translation_verse: Adwumayɔlɛfoɛ bɔ bebribri gyese, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛnwo nwera ne, bɛ wora kɔbɔ.

english_verse: Weavers will be confused; paid workers will cry and mourn. Egypt's Helpless Leaders
translation_verse: Maen ne, ye nyinasoɛ nemɔ kodwiri kogua, na apaafoɛ amukoraa bekoli aworabɔlɛ.

english_verse: The king's officials in Zoan are foolish themselves and give stupid advice. How can they say to him, “We are very wise, and our families go back to kings of long ago?”
translation_verse: Soan nnehyeɛ mɔ bɛte ngwaseafoɛ paa, Faro foɛtulɛfoɛ nu nworɛfoɛ nemɔ betu foɛ tɛɛ. Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔkora bese Faro kyɛ, “Nde nworɛniɛ awa, nde daa tete ahemvo nemɔ b’anomaa”?

english_verse: Where are those wise men now? If they can, let them say what the Lord All-Powerful intends for Egypt.
translation_verse: Bɛwɔ ni? Wɔ nworɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛwɔ ni? Maa bɛhã behyire wɔ maa enwu nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ Asafo AWURADE ahyehyɛ kyɛ ɔkɔmaa ɔkɔto Misraim ɔ.

english_verse: The royal officials in Zoan and in Memphis are foolish and deceived. The leaders in every state have given bad advice to the nation.
translation_verse: Soan nnehyeɛ nemɔ bakakyi ngwaseafoɛ, mmenia alakalaka Memfise nnehyeɛ mɔ, mbanyi bɔ bɛlela ye mmusua nemɔ noa ne, balakalaka Misraim maa wali makyebu.

english_verse: The Lord has confused Egypt; its leaders have made it stagger and vomit like a drunkard.
translation_verse: AWURADE ama anyesotanɛ sunzum ate ape ye so, na bɔ Misraim yɔ biala, ɔte mvomsoɛ, kyɛbɔ akɔnomnzaniɛ ohimu so wɔ ye feɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: When the Lord All-Powerful punishes Egypt with his mighty arm, the Egyptians will become terribly weak and will tremble with fear.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, Misraim kɔyɛ kyɛ mmrasua, na ɛserɛ kɔma bɛ nwo kɔwoso bɛ tɛtɛtɛtɛ wɔ Asafo AWURADE nyunu, ɔnate ye tumi bɔ ɔfa tea bɛ ne ati.

english_verse: They will be so terrified of Judah that they will be frightened by the very mention of its name. This will happen because of what the Lord All-Powerful is planning against Egypt. The Lord Will Bless Egypt, Assyria, and Israel
translation_verse: Yuda maen ne nwo suronyi kɔtɔ Misraim so. Sɛ ebiala te kyɛ babɔ Yuda dumaa a, ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ ye so, ɔnate Asafo AWURADE nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ wahyehyɛ kyɛ okotua Misraim so kerɛ ne ati.

english_verse: The time is coming when Hebrew will be spoken in five Egyptian cities, and their people will become followers of the Lord. One of these cities will be called City of the Sun.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, Misraim aseɛ so nguro nnu bɛkɔhã Kanaan dwudwolɛ, na bɛkɔta ndaen kyɛ bɛkɔso Asafo AWURADE. Bɛkɔfrɛ bɛ nu ko kyɛ: Eyia Kuro.

english_verse: In the heart of Egypt an altar will be set up for the Lord; at its border a shrine will be built to honor him.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, bekosi afɔleɛ bokyea wɔ Misraim aseɛ ne afia bɛkɔma AWURADE, na bɛkɔfa ngayeɛ nyɔboɛ bɛkɔpena ye wɛen so bɛkɔma AWURADE.

english_verse: These will remind the Egyptians that the Lord All-Powerful is with them. And when they are in trouble and ask for help, he will send someone to rescue them from their enemies.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe kɔyɛ Asafo AWURADE nwo sɛngyerɛnneɛ ne adanzeɛ wɔ Misraim aseɛ so. Na sɛ mmenia hyɛ bɛ so ná besu bɛfrɛ AWURADE a, ɔkɔsoma defoɛ ne komafoɛ maa ɔkɔɔpepɛ kole bɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will show the Egyptians who he is, and they will know and worship the Lord. They will bring him sacrifices and offerings, and they will keep their promises to him.
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔye ye nwo ali kohyire Misraim; Misraimfoɛ konwu AWURADE sɔ kyẽa ne, bɛkɔbɔ afɔleɛ ne naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔsɔne ye, bɛkɔhyɛ AWURADE bɔ, na bekoli so.

english_verse: After the Lord has punished Egypt, the people will turn to him. Then he will answer their prayers, and the Egyptians will be healed.
translation_verse: AWURADE kopura Misraim, okopura ye de, nakoso ɔkɔsa ye anwonyerɛ. Bekosa bɛkɔwa AWURADE berɛ, okotie bɛ sufrɛ, na ɔkɔsa bɛ anwonyerɛ.

english_verse: At that time a good road will run from Egypt to Assyria. The Egyptians and the Assyrians will travel back and forth from Egypt to Assyria, and they will worship together.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, efi Misraim ɛkɔ Asiria a, ɔkɔyɛ atimbire. Na Asiriafoɛ kɔwa Misraim, yeɛ Misraimfoɛ koso bɛkɔhɔ Asiria, na Misraimfoɛ ne Asiriafoɛ bɛkɔbɔ nu bɛkɔsɔne.

english_verse: Israel will join with these two countries. They will be a blessing to everyone on earth,
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, Yisrael kɔboka Misraim ne Asiria so maa bɛkɔyɛ nza, na ɔkɔyɛ saleɛ wɔ aseɛ so.

english_verse: then the Lord All-Powerful will bless them by saying, “The Egyptians are my people. I created the Assyrians and chose the Israelites.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Asafo AWURADE koyira bɛ kyɛ, “Mayira me maen Misraim, ɔne Asiria bɔ ɔte me sa noa adwuma, yeɛ m’agyapadeɛ Yisrael.”

english_verse: King Sargon of Assyria gave orders for his army commander to capture the city of Ashdod.
translation_verse: Afoɛ bɔ Asiria hene Sagon somane ye safohene maa ɔɔfale koɛ toale Asedɔde lili so ngonim ne,

english_verse: About this same time the Lord had told me, “Isaiah, take off everything, including your sandals!” I did this and went around naked and barefoot
translation_verse: sɔ mmerɛ ne, AWURADE fale Amoso awa Yesaya so hane kyɛ, “Kɔye ɛsɛen tena bɔ afa apɛ wɔ bo ne gua berɛ, ná puropuro wɔ mbaboa ne fi wɔ gya gua berɛ.” Ɔyɔle sɔ, na ɔyele ye nwo tole so fale ye gya guale ase.

english_verse: for three years. Then the Lord said: What Isaiah has done is a warning to Egypt and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele kyɛ, “Kyɛbɔ me somvoɛ Yesaya waye ye nwo wato so wafa ye gya wagua ase toonn afoɛ nza, bɔ ɔte sɛngyerɛnneɛ ne kɔkɔbɔlɛ tia Misraim ne Yitiopia nen,

english_verse: Everyone in these two countries will be led away naked and barefoot by the king of Assyria. Young or old, they will be taken prisoner, and Egypt will be disgraced.
translation_verse: sɔ ala yeɛ Asiria hene kɔhye Misraimfoɛ nnure, ná wasa wahye Yitiopiafoɛ nnure wahɔ ɔ. Ɔkɔhye mmerandeɛ ne mbanyi, bɛ nwo kɔlela so, bɛ gya kogua ase, bɛ bo kɔlela so, na Misraim nyunu kogua ase.

english_verse: They will be confused and frustrated, because they depended on Ethiopia and bragged about Egypt.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ Yitiopia te b’anyelasoɛ, bɔ Misraim koso te b’anwohoahoa ne ati, bekosuro, na bɛ nyunu kogua ase.

english_verse: When this happens, the people who live along the coast will say, “Look what happened to them! We ran to them for safety, hoping they would protect us from the king of Assyria. But now, there is no escape for us.”
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, sɔ mboanoafoɛ nemɔ bekose kyɛ, ‘Yieee, yɛ anyelasoɛ bɔ yɛnwatili yɛhɔle bɛ berɛ, kyɛ bɛpepɛ bele yɛ befi Asiria hene sa nu ne, edwirɛ bɔ wato bɛ hɔ ɛne oo! Nzaade, yɛkɔyɛ sɛɛ né yanya yɛ ti yadidi nu?’ ”

english_verse: This is a message about a desert beside the sea: Enemies from a hostile nation attack like a whirlwind from the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Mboanoa ɛserɛ nwo nyekyire. Ngwaen dɔ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ne, kyɛbɔ osi tu ba ne, sɔ ala yeɛ otu fi ɛserɛ so dɔ ba ɔ, ofi aseɛ bɔ so yɛ suro ɔ so.

english_verse: What a horrible vision was shown to me— a vision of betrayal and destruction. Tell Elam and Media to surround and attack the Babylonians. The Lord has sworn to end the suffering they caused.
translation_verse: Nyekyire suronyisuronyi yeɛ nyane ye ɔ: Apaabɔlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛbɔ apaa, yeɛ bɔ ɔsɛkye nningyein ne koso ɔsɛkye bɛ. O Elam, fo kɔ, O Media, tua kuro ne; aworabɔlɛ biala bɔ wamaa wawa ne, ngɔma ye bo kɔpɛ.

english_verse: I'm in terrible pain like a woman giving birth. I'm shocked and hurt so much that I can't hear or see.
translation_verse: Yiti mete yealɛ wɔ me sisia nu, na ɔyɛ me yea te kyɛ brasua bɔ wafo aworɛ so ɔ. Edwirɛ bɔ ndele ne, ɔhale me, bɔ nwuni ye ne mane me nwo dwirili me.

english_verse: My head spins; I'm horrified! Early evening, my favorite time, has become a nightmare.
translation_verse: M’adwene ayɛ me nwunyaenn, ahunundetelɛ atɔ me so; nɔsoa fɔnwoo bɔ ahaa me nye la so ne, wakakyi ahunundetelɛ wama me.

english_verse: In Babylon the high officials were having a feast. They were eating and drinking, when someone shouted, “Officers, take your places! Grab your shields.”
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔto poen ne, ɛmɔwɛne wɔ abandenden ne aso, ɛ́mɔdidi, ɛ́mɔno. O safohene mɔ, ɛ́mɔdwɔso! Ɛ́mɔfa ngoo bɛ́popa akokyɛm ne!

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Send guards to find out what's going on.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Kɔ, ma wɛmvoɛ ogyina berɛ, bɔ okonwu ye ne, maa ɔbɔ ye dawure.

english_verse: When they see cavalry troops and columns of soldiers on donkeys and camels, tell them to be ready!”
translation_verse: Na onwuni teaseɛnam mɔ bɔ pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛte nyɔ nyɔ, bɔ mmenia tete afunum mɔ ne afupɔngɔ mɔ so ɔ, na ɔyɛle asoɛ tiele paa.”

english_verse: Then a guard said, “I have stood day and night on this watchtower, Lord.
translation_verse: Na wɛmvoɛ ne teane nu kyɛ gyata, kyɛ, “O AWURADE, ngyi fasue ye aso mewɛne daa biala, alehyeleɛ biala, ngyi nekaa bɔ megyina mewɛne ne.

english_verse: Now I see column after column of cavalry troops.” At once someone shouted, “Babylon has fallen! Every idol in the city lies broken on the ground.”
translation_verse: Yieee, mmenia yeɛ bɛtete teaseɛnam mɔ nu bɛ́ba ye, pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛtete so nyɔ nyɔ!” Na osa teane nu sele kyɛ, “Babilɔn abɔ oo! wabɔ oo! Amoen amukoraa bɔ bɛte ye nyameɛ mɔ ne, babubu bɛ bagua aseɛnwo.”

english_verse: Then I said, “My people, you have suffered terribly, but I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.” How Much Longer?
translation_verse: Ao, wɔ bɔ maboro wɔ mahuhu wɔ so ɔ, edwirɛ bɔ mate mafi Asafo AWURADE, Yisrael Nyameɛ berɛ ne, mahã mahyire wɔ. Edom nwo nyekyire

english_verse: This is a message about Dumah: From the country of Seir, someone shouts to me, “Guard, how much longer before daylight?”
translation_verse: Duma nwo nyekyire ɛhe: Ebie to me huuu fi Sɛre ose me kyɛ, “Wɛmvoɛ ee, kɔngɔen ne anu dwirɛ te sɛɛ? Wɛmvoɛ ee, kɔngɔen ne anu dwirɛ te sɛɛ?”

english_verse: From my guard post, I answered, “Morning will soon be here, but night will return. If you want to know more, come back later.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ wɛmvoɛ ne buale kyɛ, “Aleɛ kye ngyerɛmɔ, né alesaleɛ koso awa. Sɛ ɛmɔkobisa a, ɛ́mɔbisa; ɛ́mɔsa bɛbra, ɛmɔbra.” Arabia nwo nyekyire

english_verse: This is a message for Arabs who live in the barren desert in the region of Dedan: You must order your caravans
translation_verse: Arabia nwo nyekyire ɛhe: O Dedanimfoɛ bɔ bɛtete mbɔngɔ so betu atee ɔ, Arabia ɛhɔayeɛ nu yeɛ ɛmɔkosikye kɔngɔen ɔ.

english_verse: to bring water for those who are thirsty. You people of Tema must bring food for the hungry refugees.
translation_verse: O, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔte Tema aseɛ so ɔ, ɛ́mɔfa nzue beeyia bɛ bɔ nzuhɔen ku bɛ ɔ, ɛ́mɔfa aleɛ beeyia mmenia bɔ bɛfoa bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: They are worn out and weary from being chased by enemies with swords and arrows.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ banwati bafi ngrandɛ noa, ngrandɛ bɔ bahwe, agyaen bɔ bahwe ɔ nu, ɔne koɛ nwo suronyi noa.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: A year from now the glory of the people of Kedar will all come to an end, just as a worker's contract ends after a year.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ edwirɛ he yeɛ AWURADE hã hyirele me ɔ: “Kyɛ odwu afoɛnoa ne, kyɛbɔ paaniɛ osi ka ye afoɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ne, Kedare animnyam amukoraa kɔwa ayieleɛ.

english_verse: Only a few of their warriors will be left with bows and arrows. This is a promise that I, the Lord God of Israel, have made.
translation_verse: Na Kedare agyaentolɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ kãa bie yeɛ bɛkɔha ɔ; ofikyɛ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: This is a message about Vision Valley: Why are you celebrating on the flat roofs of your houses?
translation_verse: Edwirɛ bɔ ɔfa Bɔnza nyekyire ne nwo. Nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ wato wɔ ɔ bɔ wɔ nu ama mukoraa bafo bahɔ sua ti afia ye?

english_verse: Your city is filled with noisy shouts. Those who lie drunk in your streets were not killed in battle.
translation_verse: Kuro bɔ esebɔlɛ ayi wɔ tɛkyɛ, kuro bɔ nu te dede, bɔ anigye wɔ nu ɔ! Wɔ nu mmenia bɔ batotɔ ne, bandotɔ ngrandɛ noa, yeɛ banwu koɛ nu.

english_verse: Your leaders ran away, but they were captured without a fight. No matter how far they ran, they were found and caught.
translation_verse: Wɔ mbanyi amukoraa babɔ nu banwati, bamva agyaen yeɛ bɛhyele bɛ ɔ. Wɔ mmenia amukoraa bɔ benwuni bɛ ne, bɛhyele bɛ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛnwatili bɛhɔle dedeede de.

english_verse: Then I said, “Leave me alone! Let me cry bitter tears. My people have been destroyed, so don't try to comfort me.”
translation_verse: Yiti yeɛ ngane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔyakyi me, ɛ́mɔma nzu hahii, nnɛma ɛmɔha bɛ nwo kyɛ ɛmɔkɔkyekye me wora wɔ edwirɛ piri bɔ wato me maen awa brasua ne anwo.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful had chosen a time for noisy shouts and confusion to fill Vision Valley, and for everyone to beg the mountains for help.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔte Asafo AWURADE ye kyẽa, bɔ ɔte amaneɛnwunɛ, ahunundetelɛ ne anyesotanɛ, wɔ Nyekyire Bɔnza ne anu, kyẽa bɔ bedwiri fasue mɔ begua, bɔ bɛbɔ awuye besu bɛfrɛ mmokaa mɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The people of Elam and Kir attacked with chariots and carried shields.
translation_verse: Na Elam fale agyaen ndokue sini, ɔne teaseɛnam mɔ ne pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ bɛ́ba, yeɛ Kire waye akokyɛm wafite.

english_verse: Your most beautiful valleys were covered with chariots; your cities were surrounded by cavalry troops.
translation_verse: Teaseɛnam mɔ ayi wɔ bɔnza nyemenenyemene nemɔ anu to, yeɛ pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ koso bagyinagyina pambim ne anu.

english_verse: Judah was left defenseless. At that time you trusted in the weapons you had stored in Forest Palace.
translation_verse: Waye Yuda nwo waen ne wafi berɛ. Sɔ kyẽa ne, ɛmɔfale ɛmɔ nye bɛtole akodeɛ bɔ ogua sua bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Ɛhɔayeɛ nu Awuro ne aso.

english_verse: You saw the holes in the outer wall of Jerusalem, and you brought water from the lower pool.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔnwuni kyɛ Dawide kuro fasue ne, wapakyepakye pee, na ɛmɔsesale aseɛnwo dɔ abura ne anu nzue besiele.

english_verse: You counted the houses in Jerusalem and tore down some of them, so you could get stones to repair the city wall.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhale Yerusalem sua nemɔ, na ɛmɔbubuli ebie beguale, kyɛ ɛmɔfa besuasua fasue ne maa onya anwoserɛ.

english_verse: Then you built a large tank between the walls to store the water. But you refused to trust the God who planned this long ago and made it happen. A Time To Weep
translation_verse: Fasue nyɔ ne, ɛmɔpɛle abura wɔ b’afia maa nzue bɔ ɔwɔ ɛkwaa daa ne anu ooguale nu, nakoso bɔ ɔyɔle ɛkwaa ne de, ɛmɔammisa ye berɛ mmokalɛ, yeɛ ye bɔ ɔhyehyɛle ye dadadada ne, ɛmɔammu ye.

english_verse: When all of this happened, the Lord All-Powerful told you to weep and mourn, to shave your heads, and wear sackcloth.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, Asafo AWURADE Nyameɛ frɛfrɛle mmenia kyɛ besu bɛbɔ awuye, kyɛ bɛbɔ tikwa ná bɛhera ɛsɛen tena.

english_verse: But instead, you celebrated by feasting on beef and lamb and by drinking wine, because you said, “Let's eat and drink today! Tomorrow we may die.”
translation_verse: Nakoso nea: anwosɛpɛlɛ ne anigye, nandwie ne mmoaen hunɛ, naenlilɛ ne nzaanonɛ. “Ɛ́mɔma yɛdidi ná yɛno, ofikyɛ ɛhema né yawu.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has spoken to me this solemn promise: “I won't forgive them for this, not as long as they live.” Selfish Officials Are Doomed
translation_verse: Na Asafo AWURADE waye me asotire kyɛ, “Susu amba kyɛ, sɔ amumuyɛɛ ne ati, mengɔfa ɛmɔ nwo ngɔhyɛ ɛmɔ kɔpem mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔkowu ɔ,” Asafo AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is sending me with this message for Shebna, the prime minister:
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa, “Somvoɛ Sebena bɔ ɔte ahemvie berɛ neafoɛ ne, kɔ ye berɛ kose ye kyɛ,

english_verse: Shebna, what gives you the right to have a tomb carved out of rock in this burial place of royalty? None of your relatives are buried here.
translation_verse: Wɔ, nzikyɛ yeɛ ele ye yɔ wɔ wa ɔ? Nwa yeɛ wama wɔ sɔ tumi ne ɔ, bɔ yiti apɛ asieleɛ ato berɛ ama wɔ nwo wɔ ɛwa ɔ? Wɔ bɔ apɛ w’asieleɛ ato bokaa so, ná asa apɛ wɔ daberɛ ato nyɔbotaen nu ɔ?

english_verse: You may be powerful, but the Lord is about to snatch you up and throw you away.
translation_verse: Wɔ, anwoserɛniɛ, tie, AWURADE kofindi wɔ anyeborolɛ so kɔto nekaa bie. Ɔkɔsɔ wɔ nu bum,

english_verse: He will roll you into a ball and throw you into a wide open country, where you will die and your chariots will be destroyed. You're a disgrace to those you serve.
translation_verse: okobri wɔ kyɛ aterɛ, na okofindi wɔ kyɛ bɔɔlo kɔto aseɛ tɛtrɛtɛɛ bie aso. Dɔ yeɛ ekowu ɔ, na teaseɛnam mɔ bɔ ɛfa hoahoa wɔ nwo ne koso, bɛkɔyɛ wɔ mene awuro animguaseɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is going to take away your job!
translation_verse: Ngɔye wɔ bo bia, na ngole wɔ dibea ne ngofi wɔ sa nu.

english_verse: He will give your official robes and your authority to his servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah. Eliakim will be like a father to the people of Jerusalem and to the royal family of Judah.
translation_verse: ngɔfa w’ataadeɛ ne ngowura ye, ngɔfa w’abɔsoɛ ne ngɔbɔ ye, ngɔfa wɔ panyililɛ ne ngowura ye sa, na ɔkɔyɛ Yerusalemfoɛ ne Yuda awuro ama bɛ baba.

english_verse: The Lord will put him in charge of the key that belongs to King David's family. No one will be able to unlock what he locks, and no one will be able to lock what he unlocks.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa Dawide awuro ama nzafoaa ne ngowura ye sa. Sɛ obukye a, ebiala ngɔto nu, yeɛ sɛ ɔto nu a, ebiala ngobukye.

english_verse: The Lord will make him as firm in his position as a tent peg hammered in the ground, and Eliakim will bring honor to his family.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa ye ngɔpena berɛ kyɛ pɛmbɛen bɔ omi nekaa bɔ berɛ yɛ se ɔ, na ɔkɔyɛ animnyam bia kɔma ye baba awuro ama.

english_verse: His children and relatives will be supported by him, like pans hanging from a peg on the wall.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔfa ye baba awuro animnyam amukoraa bekowura ye sa, ye bosofoɛ ne ye nnomaa, ngukue mmaa mmaa amukoraa, ofi kulie mɔ so kodwu bua amukoraa so.

english_verse: That peg is fastened firmly now, but someday it will be shaken loose and fall down. Then everything that was hanging on it will be destroyed. This is what the Lord All-Powerful has promised.
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo, sɔ kyẽa ne, pɛmbɛen bɔ omi nekaa bɔ berɛ yɛ se ne, ye bo kɔyɛ gɔhɔgɔhɔ, bɛkɔpɛ maa ɔkɔtɔ ase, na adesoa bɔ osinze so ne kɔsɛkye, ofikyɛ AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: This is a message from distant islands about the city of Tyre: Cry, you seagoing ships! Tyre and its houses lie in ruins.
translation_verse: Tiro nwo nyekyire ɛhe: O, Tasise ɛlɛen mɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye, ofikyɛ Tiro abɔ, bɔ sua ko po wanga ɔ, yeɛ ɛlɛen agyinaleɛ koso wanga. Ngraa ne fi Kitim aseɛ so yeɛ waadwu bɛ berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Mourn in silence, you shop owners of Sidon, you people on the coast. Your sailors crossed oceans, making your city rich.
translation_verse: O mboanoafoɛ, ɛ́mɔyɛ konn! O Sidon dwadifoɛ, bɛ bɔ bɛpɛle ɛpo ne, bɛmaa enyane wɔ nwo,

english_verse: Your merchants sailed the seas, making you wealthy by trading with nation after nation. They brought back grain that grew along the Nile.
translation_verse: bɛfale ɛpo tɛtrɛtɛɛ so. Né enya wɔ sikaa fi Sihɔ aburoo nu, ɔne Naele noa fieso nningyein nu, na ɛɛyɛle nekaa bɔ maen maen mɔ bedi dwaa ɔ.

english_verse: Sidon, you are a mighty fortress built along the sea. But you will be disgraced like a married woman who never had children.
translation_verse: O Sidon, ɛpo nu anwoserɛ afealeɛ, maa ɔyɛ wɔ nya, ofikyɛ ɛpo nwa: “Mmvole aworɛ so le, yeɛ nnwole baa le, nndetele mmerandeɛ le, yeɛ nndetele ndaluwa le.”

english_verse: When Egypt hears about Tyre, it will tremble.
translation_verse: Sɛ sɔ dwirɛ ne odwu Misraim a, bekoli bɔ wato Tiro ne nwo aworabɔlɛ.

english_verse: All of you along the coast had better cry and sail far across the ocean.
translation_verse: O mboanoafoɛ, ɛ́mɔpɛ nu bɛhɔ Tasise! Ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye!

english_verse: Can this be the happy city that has stood for centuries? Its people have spread to distant lands;
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ kuro bɔ anigye wɔ nu, bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ fi daa tetetete, bɔ ye gya fale ye hɔle dedeede maa ɔɔtenane dɔ ne, aso ye ayieleɛ ɛne?

english_verse: its merchants were kings honored all over the world. Who planned to destroy Tyre?
translation_verse: Tiro bɔ osi ɛhene mɔ, bɔ ye dwadifoɛ te nnehyeɛ, bɔ ye dwadifoɛ te mmeni titire wɔ wiase ɔ, nwa yeɛ ɔyɔle sɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne tiale wɔ ye?

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful planned it to bring shame and disgrace to those who are honored by everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE yeɛ wayɔ sɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne ɔ, kyɛ ɔkɔma animnyam amukoraa b’anwomasoɛ nyunu kogua ase, kyɛ ɔkɔbrɛ aseɛ so atitirefoɛ amukoraa ase.

english_verse: People of Tyre, your harbor is destroyed! You will have to become farmers just like the Egyptians. Tyre Will Be Forgotten
translation_verse: O Tasise awa brasua, yi fa w’aseɛ ne aso kyɛ asue Naele, ofikyɛ ɛlɛen agyinaleɛ biala nne berɛ ko.

english_verse: The Lord's hand has reached across the sea, upsetting the nations. He has given a command to destroy fortresses in the land of Canaan.
translation_verse: Watengyɛ ye sa wahyire ɛpo so, wapusu ahennie mɔ, na AWURADE ahyɛ mmeraa wafa Kanaan nwo, kyɛ bɛsɛkye ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has said to the people of Sidon, “Your celebrating is over— you are crushed. Even if you escape to Cyprus, you won't find peace.”
translation_verse: Na wahã kyɛ, “O Sidon awa brasua, ababunu bɔ bɛhyɛ wɔ so ɔ, ɛngɔhɔ so ngoli ahurusi ko, dwɔso, pɛ nu kɔ Kitim, na dɔ po, engonya wɔ nwome ngole.”

english_verse: Look what the Assyrians have done to Babylonia! They have attacked, destroying every palace in the land. Now wild animals live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Nea, Kaldeafoɛ b’aseɛ ne! Nna Asiriafoɛ, na mmom Kaldeafoɛ yeɛ bɛmane ngaka aboyaa fale Tiro kuro ne ɔ. Kaldeafoɛ yeɛ betuale kuro ne, ná besa bebubuli ye nwo waen beguale gyirigorɔɔ maa ɔkakyili kurofoen ɔ.

english_verse: Not a fortress will be left standing, so tell all the seagoing ships to mourn.
translation_verse: O Tasise ɛlɛen mɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye, ofikyɛ babubu ɛmɔ anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne.

english_verse: You're gone and forgotten, you evil woman! So strut through the town, singing and playing your favorite tune to be remembered again.
translation_verse: Wɔ, gyanderaniɛ bɔ mmenia wora afi wɔ ɔ, fa adengum, natenate kuro ne anu! To edwein fɛfɛɛfɛ, to edwein pee, amaa ɔnate so bakaye wɔ.

english_verse: but none of what is earned will be kept in the city. That money will belong to the Lord, and it will be used to buy more than enough food and good clothes for those who worship the Lord.
translation_verse: Nakoso ye dwaa nningyein ne ye mvasoɛ ne, ɔkɔyɛ krongron kɔma AWURADE. Bɛngɔfa ngosie, yeɛ bɛngɔfa ngɔfea, na mmom ye dwaa nningyein ne kɔyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ bɛ deɛ, na ɔkɔmaa bekonya aleɛ pee bekoli, ɔne ɛtena paa bɛkɔhera.

english_verse: The Lord is going to twist the earth out of shape and turn it into a desert. Everyone will be scattered,
translation_verse: Tie, AWURADE kɔsɛkye aseɛ maa ɔkɔla berɛ mbaen, okobutu aseɛ nye ase, ná wabɔ so ama wasande.

english_verse: The earth will be stripped bare and left that way. This is what the Lord has promised.
translation_verse: Aseɛ kɔsɛkye pasapasa, bɛkɔfẽ so nningyein bɔkɔɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The earth wilts away; its mighty leaders melt to nothing.
translation_verse: Aseɛ di aworabɔlɛ, na watwindwam, ewiase ayɛ bosaa, na watwindwam, aseɛ so atitirefoɛ bayɛ bosaa.

english_verse: The earth is polluted because its people disobeyed the laws of God, breaking their agreement that was to last forever.
translation_verse: Efiɛ ahã aseɛ ye, so ama bɛ yɔleɛ ti, ofikyɛ bato mmeraa ne, batu ahyɛdeɛ ne bagua, yeɛ babu apam afebɔɔ ne aso.

english_verse: The earth is under a curse; its people are dying out because of their sins.
translation_verse: Ɔnate sɔ ati, musue ahã aseɛ, na so ama benwu amaneɛ. Yiti aseɛ so ama bɛ́yera, na waha mmenia kaaba bie.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up: wine is almost gone— mournful sounds are heard instead of joyful shouts.
translation_verse: Ndungum bɔ awuye, bobe ayɛ bosaa, na bɛ bɔ né bɛgye bɛ nye ne amukoraa, bɛ wora abɔ.

english_verse: No one plays tambourines or stringed instruments; all noisy celebrating has come to an end.
translation_verse: Akasaa nu ahurusililɛ ne, bɛnde ye ko, bɛ bɔ bɛ nye gye ne, bɛ ndeateamuɛ ne bo apɛ, sangoo nu ahurusililɛ ne, bɛnde ye ko.

english_verse: They no longer sing as they drink their wine, and it tastes sour.
translation_verse: Bɛ́no nzaa a bɛndo dwein ko, na nzaa serɛ yɛ bɛ bɔ bɛno ne weewee.

english_verse: Towns are crushed and in chaos; houses are locked tight.
translation_verse: Kuro bɔ so te basabasa ne, badwiri bagua, batoto awuro biala nu bɔ sona biala ngora nwura nu ɔ.

english_verse: Happy times have disappeared from the earth, and people shout in the streets, “We're out of wine!”
translation_verse: Mmenia teatea nu bɛpena nzaa wɔ mmorɔnoɛ nemɔ aso, anigye amukoraa bo apɛ, yeɛ aseɛ so anika atu amini.

english_verse: Cities are destroyed; their gates are torn down.
translation_verse: Kuro ne akakyi kurofoen, babubu ye pambim nemɔ bagua gyirigorɔɔ.

english_verse: Nations will be stripped bare, like olive trees or vineyards after the harvest season. Praise the God of Justice
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ okosi aseɛ so wɔ maen maen mɔ nu ɔ. Ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ olive bakaa bɔ baporo ye mma bagua ɔ, anaakyɛ bobe bɔ bate ye mma maa waha ye si kãa bie ɔ.

english_verse: People in the west shout; they joyfully praise the majesty of the Lord.
translation_verse: Bɛ de, bɛkɔma bɛ komvi so bɛkɔto anigye dwein, bɛkɔtea nu bekofi ɛpo so bɛkɔye AWURADE animnyam ayɛ.
