english_verse: And so, everyone in the east and those on the islands should praise the Lord, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ wɔ eyia afiteleɛ, ɛpo nu supɔ mɔ so koso, ɛ́mɔye AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ne dumaa ayɛ.

english_verse: From all over the world songs of praise are heard for the God of justice. But I feel awful, terribly miserable. Can anyone be trusted? So many are treacherous! There's No Escape
translation_verse: Yɛte ayɛyelɛ dwein yɛfi aseɛ so nekaa biala kyɛ, Animnyam hã Teneneeniɛ ne. Nakoso ngane kyɛ, “Mawu oo, mawu oo, edwirɛ ato me oo! Nnakannakafoɛ begu so bɛlakalaka, nnakannakafoɛ bɛ nnakalɛ ne wayɛ piri.”

english_verse: Terror, traps, and pits are waiting for everyone.
translation_verse: Wɔ bɔ ɛte aseɛ ye aso ɔ, ahunundetelɛ ne kumaa ne ngaen la berɛ ma wɔ!

english_verse: If you are terrified and run, you will fall into a pit; if you crawl out of the pit, you will get caught in a trap. The sky has split apart like a window thrown open. The foundations of the earth have been shaken;
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sona bɔ ɔte ahunundetelɛ ne nga, ná ɔnwati ne, ɔkɔɔtɔ kumaa ne anu, yeɛ bɔ okofi kumaa ne anu kɔfo kɔwa ne koso, ngaen ne kɔhye ye. Ofikyɛ nyameɛso mboma nemɔ abukyebukye, na aseɛ nyinasoɛ nemɔ bɛwosowoso.

english_verse: the earth is shattered, ripped to pieces.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ piri ato aseɛ paa, aseɛ nu adwudwa, aseɛ ye apusu piri paa.

english_verse: It staggers and shakes like a drunkard or a hut in a windstorm. It is burdened down with sin; the earth will fall, never again to get up.
translation_verse: Aseɛ nate fofalifofali kyɛ akɔnomnzaniɛ, ɔwosowoso kyɛ namue, ye mmeraatolɛ nwo asohwenɛ kandinga la ye so, na okodwiri kogua bɔ ongodwɔso ko ɔ.

english_verse: On that day the Lord will punish the powers in the heavens and the kings of the earth.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɔ kyẽa ne, AWURADE kɔhwe anwuro abɔdeɛ mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ ewienu ɔ bɛ so, yeɛ ɔkɔhwe aseɛ so ahemvo mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ so ɔ bɛ so.

english_verse: He will put them in a pit and keep them prisoner. Then later on, he will punish them.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔboaboa bɛ mukoraa noa kyɛbɔ bɛboaboa kukunufoɛ noa wɔ kumaa nu ɔ, ɔkɔto bɛ nu wɔ kuku nu, na ngyẽa pee asi ne, ɔkɔhwe bɛ so.

english_verse: Both the moon and sun will be embarrassed and ashamed. The Lord All-Powerful will rule on Mount Zion in Jerusalem, where he will show its rulers his wonderful glory.
translation_verse: Na afei ɛsraen kɔfɛre, yeɛ eyia nyunu kogua ase, ofikyɛ Asafo AWURADE koli hene wɔ Sion bokaa ne aso ne Yerusalem, na ɔkɔye ye animnyam ali wɔ ye mbanyi mɔ nyunu.

english_verse: You, Lord, are my God! I will praise you for doing the wonderful things you had planned and promised since ancient times.
translation_verse: O AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ ɛte me Nyameɛ ɔ, ngɔkamvo wɔ, ngɔye wɔ dumaa ayɛ, ofikyɛ ayɔ anwanwadeɛ nningyein, ofi tetetetetete yeɛ ɛyɔle sɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne ɔ, na ali so nahorɛ nu.

english_verse: You have destroyed the fortress of our enemies, leaving their city in ruins. Nothing in that foreign city will ever be rebuilt.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ akakyi kuro maa wayɛ esire, ama kuro bɔ bato ye nwo fasue ɔ wakakyi kurofoen, maen maen mɔ b’ahemvie ne, nna kuro ahɔ ko, na bengosi ye ko le.

english_verse: Now strong and cruel nations will fear and honor you.
translation_verse: Yiti maen maen anwoserɛfoɛ bɛkɔhyɛ wɔ animnyam, na maen maen atianuserɛfoɛ, bɛ kuro ne kosuro wɔ.

english_verse: You have been a place of safety for the poor and needy in times of trouble. Brutal enemies pounded us like a heavy rain or the heat of the sun at noon, but you were our shelter.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛte bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ b’anwoserɛ afealeɛ, ehiafoɛ b’anwoserɛ afealeɛ wɔ b’anwokyere nu, afealeɛ wɔ mvrama piri nu, ɔne nekaa fɔnwoo wɔ eyia gyireingyirein nu, ofikyɛ atianuserɛfoɛ b’anyandimlilɛ ne, ɔte kyɛ mvrama bɔ otu kofĩ fasue ɔ,

english_verse: Those wild foreigners struck like scorching desert heat. But you were like a cloud, protecting us from the sun. You kept our enemies from singing songs of victory. The Lord Has Saved Us
translation_verse: kyɛ aseɛ wosee so ahuhuro. Ɛbrɛ ɛwɔfoɛ maen mɔ bɛ dede ne ase, kyɛbɔ munungum ma ahuhuro noa brɛ ase ɔ, na sɔ ala yeɛ apɛ anyandimlilɛfoɛ bɛ dwein so ɔ.

english_verse: On this mountain the Lord All-Powerful will prepare for all nations a feast of the finest foods. Choice wines and the best meats will be served.
translation_verse: Bokaa he aso yeɛ Asafo AWURADE kɔto poen kɔma maen amukoraa ɔ: Ɔkɔma bɛ aleɛ paa, nzaa paa, naen bɔ bowue nu fonyi wɔ nu, yeɛ nzaa bɔ basongyi so ɔ.

english_verse: Here the Lord will strip away the burial clothes that cover the nations.
translation_verse: Sɔ bokaa he aso ala yeɛ ɔkɔsɛkye ɛtena bɔ ɔkyekye maen amukoraa bɛ nyunu ne, ɔne ngatanyunu bɔ ɔkata maen mukoraa bɛ so ne.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will destroy the power of death and wipe away all tears. No longer will his people be insulted everywhere. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: Okonunu ewue boso kofi berɛ afebɔɔ. AWURADE Nyameɛ kokyikyi ebiala nye moen, na ɔkɔye ye maen animguaseɛ kofi aseɛ so amukoraa; ofikyɛ AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne!

english_verse: The powerful arm of the Lord will protect this mountain. The Moabites will be put down and trampled on like straw in a pit of manure.
translation_verse: AWURADE tumi asaa ne kɔtena bokaa he aso, nakoso Moabo de, okotiatia ye so kɔbɛtɛ ye, kyɛbɔ betiatia ewura so wɔ fofoɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: They will struggle to get out, but God will humiliate them no matter how hard they try.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɔkɔtrɛtrɛ ye sa nu wɔ bokaa ne anu, kyɛbɔ sona trɛtrɛ ye sa nu obia asue nu ɔ, nakoso ye anwomasoɛ ne ye yɔleɛ ne, AWURADE kɔbrɛ ye ase.

english_verse: The walls of their fortresses will be knocked down and scattered in the dirt.
translation_verse: Na wɔ fasue ndendenn pindinn nemɔ, okobu kogua, na okodwiri ye kogua ase kogua mvuture nu.

english_verse: The time is coming when the people of Judah will sing this song: “Our city is protected. The Lord is our fortress, and he gives us victory.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, bɛkɔto sɔ dwein he wɔ Yuda aseɛ so: “Yɛle kuro bɔ ye nwo yɛ se ɔ, wafa ngoalelɛ wayɛ yɛ nwo fasue ne ɛwaen.

english_verse: Open the city gates for a law-abiding nation that is faithful to God.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbukye pambim nemɔ bɛ́ma tenenee maen bɔ odi nahorɛ ne oowura nu.

english_verse: So always trust the Lord because he is forever our mighty rock.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ wora béwura AWURADE nu afebɔɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ ɔte afebɔɔ nyɔbotaen.

english_verse: God has put down our enemies in their mountain city and rubbed it in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔbrɛ bɛ bɔ betira tumi ɔ ase, kuro bɔ babɔ ye nwo waen pambee ne, ɔbrɛ ye ase, odwiri ye gua ase, obu ye gua mvuture nu.

english_verse: Now the poor and abused trample all over that city.” The Lord Can Be Trusted
translation_verse: Agyirɛ tiatia so, bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ betiatia so, yeɛ ehiafoɛ koso betiatia so.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you always do right, and you make the path smooth for those who obey you.
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ atee tengyɛ, ɛma teneneeniɛ atimbire da so yɔɔ.

english_verse: You are the one we trust to bring about justice; above all else we want your name to be honored.
translation_verse: O AWURADE, yɛ nye la wɔ ate wɔ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ atee ne aso, yɛ kra wora adɔ wɔ dumaa, ɔne wɔ nwo ngayeɛ.

english_verse: Throughout the night, my heart searches for you, because your decisions show everyone on this earth how to live right.
translation_verse: Me kra wora dɔ wɔ kɔngɔen, amba, me sunzum bɔ ɔwɔ me nu ne, ɔpena wɔ paa, ofikyɛ sɛ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ wɔ aseɛ so a, ewiase ama besua bra bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Even when the wicked are treated with mercy in this land of justice, they do wrong and are blind to your glory, our Lord.
translation_verse: Sɛ enwu amumuyɛɛniɛ anwumvoin a, amumuyɛɛniɛ ne nzua kyɛ ɔkɔbɔ bra bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ; na aseɛ bɔ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ wɔ so ne, sɔ sona ne de, amumuyɛɛ yeɛ ɔyɔ ɔ, na onnwu kyɛbɔ AWURADE osi te piri ɔ.

english_verse: Your hand is raised and ready to punish them, but they don't see it. Put them to shame! Show how much you care for us and throw them into the fire intended for your enemies.
translation_verse: O AWURADE, apagya wɔ sa so, nakoso bennwu ye. Maa benwu kyɛbɔ esi kuro wɔ maen dwirɛ ɔ, ná bɛ nyunu ogua ase. See bɔ asiesie ama wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ ne, maa ɔyera bɛ.

english_verse: You will give us peace, Lord, because everything we have done was by your power.
translation_verse: O AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ ahyehyɛ asomdwee ama yɛ ɔ, na bɔ yɛkora ye yɔ amukoraa, wɔ yeɛ ɛyɔ ma yɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Others have ruled over us besides you, our Lord God, but we obey only you.
translation_verse: O AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ, meneɛ biemɔ bɔ nna wɔ ahɔ ɔ bali yɛ so, nakoso wɔ ngome wɔ dumaa yeɛ yɛde yɛto nu ɔ.

english_verse: Those enemies are now dead and can never live again. You have punished them— they are destroyed, completely forgotten.
translation_verse: Bawuwu, bɛngɔtena ngoa nu, bayɛ awufoɛ, bengodwɔso, ofikyɛ ahwe bɛ so ahũhũ bɛ bɔkɔɔ, na akyikyi bɛ nwo ngayeɛ amukoraa boso afi berɛ.

english_verse: Our nation has grown because of you, our Lord. We have more land than before, and you are honored. The Lord Gives Life to the Dead
translation_verse: Nakoso, O AWURADE, ama maen ne ayɛ piri, ama maen ne ayɛ piri, bahyɛ wɔ animnyam, aseɛ ne, atrɛ ye wɛen amukoraa nu.

english_verse: When you punished our people, they turned and prayed to you, our Lord.
translation_verse: O AWURADE, bɛpenane wɔ si atee wɔ b’amaneɛnwunɛ nu, besu bɛfrɛle wɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né ɛtwe bɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: Because of what you did to us, we suffered like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ brasua ɔnwonzɛ, ɔfo aworɛ so, ná ye ko ka ye maa osũ ne, O AWURADE, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛte wɔ wɔ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: But instead of having a child, our terrible pain produced only wind. We have won no victories, and we have no descendants to take over the earth.
translation_verse: Yɛnwonzɛle, yɛ ko hale yɛ, nakoso bɔ yɛwole ye ne, ɔte kyɛ mvrama: yangora yamva ngoalelɛ yamma aseɛ so, ná waayɛ kyɛ po yɛngɔma ewiase mmenia bengonya ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: Your people will rise to life! Tell them to leave their graves and celebrate with shouts. You refresh the earth like morning dew; you give life to the dead.
translation_verse: W’awufoɛ mɔ bekonya ngoa, bɛ fuin nemɔ bekotingye. O ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔla nnɛterɛ nu ɔ, ɛ́mɔdwɔso bɛ́to dwein beli ahurusi! O AWURADE, wɔ bosue ne, ɔte kanea bosue, na aseɛ kɔye bɛ bɔ bawuwu ɔ kɔwa.

english_verse: Go inside and lock the doors, my people. Hide there for a little while, until the Lord is no longer angry. The Earth and the Sea Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Me maen, bra, baawura wɔ pumbu mɔ nu, ná toto wɔ nwo anoa nu; fa wɔ nwo fea kãa kɔpem kyɛ ahonehulɛ ne kɔtɔ nzue nu ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will come out to punish everyone on earth for their sins. And when he does, those who did violent crimes will be known and punished.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE fi ye atenaleɛ berɛ ɔ́ba, kyɛ aseɛ so ama b’amumuyɛɛ ti ɔbaahwe bɛ so. Aseɛ kɔma mogya bɔ bahã bagua so ɔ nwo kɔla ali, na ɔngɔfa bɛ bɔ bahu bɛ wɔ so ne ngɔfea ko.

english_verse: On that day, Leviathan, the sea monster, will squirm and try to escape, but the Lord will kill him with a cruel, sharp sword. Protection and Forgiveness The Lord said:
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, AWURADE kɔfa ye ngrandɛ serɛserɛ pirikua suronyisuronyi ne kɔhwe ɛlɛngyɛen suronyisuronyi, bɔ ɔte ewoo bɔ ye nwo yɛ nyera ne ye so. Ɔte ɛlɛngyɛen suronyisuronyi bɔ ɔbenzebenze ye nu ɔ, na AWURADE kosa kohũ sasrabɔnzam bɔ ɔwɔ ɛpo nu ne.

english_verse: At that time you must sing about a fruitful vineyard.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, ɛ́mɔto bobe boo nyemenenyemene ne nwo dwein!

english_verse: I, the Lord, will protect it and always keep it watered. I will guard it day and night to keep it from harm.
translation_verse: Me, AWURADE, me yeɛ menea so ɔ, mmerɛ biala meguagua so nzue, mebɔ ye nwo waen kɔngɔen ne eyia, kyɛbɔ ebiala ngɔɔsɛkye ye ɔ.

english_verse: I am no longer angry. But if it produces thorns, I will go to war against it and burn it to the ground.
translation_verse: M’ahone atɔ nzue nu. Sɛ menwu agurɛ ne mmowue a, ahaa ngɔfa koɛ ngɔtoa bɛ, ahaa ngɔyera bɛ ngɔbɔ nu.

english_verse: Yet if the vineyard depends on me for protection, it will become my friend and be at peace with me.
translation_verse: Sana bɛbabɔ bɛ nwo adwaa wɔ me berɛ maa ɔnate so bɛ ne me tena asomdwee nu, maa bɛ ne me tena asomdwee nu.

english_verse: Someday Israel will take root like a vine. It will blossom and bear fruit that covers the earth.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bie baawa, Yakob kotira ndii, Yisrael kɔfefɛ kɔbɔ nyerɛen, na ɔkɔma ye mma koyi ewiase amukoraa tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, didn't punish and kill the people of Israel as fiercely as I punished and killed their enemies.
translation_verse: Aso wabo ye kyɛbɔ ɔbole bɛ bɔ bɛbole ye ne anaa? Anaakyɛ wahũ ye kyɛbɔ ohuhuni mmenia bɔ behuni ye ne anaa?

english_verse: I carefully measured out Israel's punishment and sent the scorching heat to chase them far away.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔne so yeɛ egyinane pɛle bɛ asue ɔ. Ɔfale ye nwomeɛ suronyisuronyi ne foane bɛ kyɛ eyia afiteleɛ mvrama anoa serɛserɛ kyẽa ne.

english_verse: There's only one way that Israel's sin and guilt can be completely forgiven: They must crush the stones of every pagan altar and place of worship. The Lord Will Bring His People Together
translation_verse: Yiti ɔnate ɛhe aso, okokyikyi Yakob amumuyɛɛ kofi berɛ, na ye bɔne bɔ baye bafi berɛ ne, so mmaa mukoraa bɔ okosu ɛhe: Okobubu afɔleɛ bokyea nyɔboɛ ne amukoraa, okofurofuro bɛ koti bɛ muhumuhu kyɛ nnɛterɛ, bɔ Asera dosii ne ɛyɛɛ bokyea biala ngogyinagyina berɛ ko ɔ.

english_verse: When broken branches fall to the ground, women pick them up to feed the fire. But these people are so stupid that the God who created them will show them no mercy.
translation_verse: Sɛ ye mmaen frɔmfrɔm nemɔ bewu a, bebubu begua, na mmrasua basesa bɛfa bɛyɛ eyein. Ofikyɛ bɛte maen bɔ ndeaseɛ abɔ bɛ ɔ; ye sɔ ne ati, bɔ ɔbɔle bɛ ne ngonwu bɛ anwumvoin, bɔ ɔnwone bɛ ne ɔngɔlo bɛ.

english_verse: The time is coming when the Lord will shake the land between the Euphrates River and the border of Egypt, and one by one he will bring all of his people together.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɔ kyẽa ne, ofi asue Yufreti kodwu Misraim bɔnza ne, AWURADE kɔboro ye aburoo, na ɛmɔ Yisraelfoɛ, ɔkɔpa nu kɔyeye ɛmɔ ngoko ngoko.

english_verse: A loud trumpet will be heard. Then the people of Israel who were dragged away to Assyria and Egypt will return to worship the Lord on his holy mountain in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, bekohu totorobɛndo pirikua ne, na bɛ bɔ beminini bɛhɔle Asiria aseɛ so, bɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛsesale bɛ bɛhɔle Misraim aseɛ so ne, bɛkɔwa bɛkɔɔsɔne AWURADE wɔ bokaa krongron ne aso, wɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: The city of Samaria above a fertile valley is in for trouble! Its leaders are drunkards, who stuff themselves with food and wine. But they will be like flowers that dry up and wilt.
translation_verse: Wɔ yaakɔ, Efraim akɔnomnzafoɛ anwomasoɛ abotire ne, ɔne ye nyerɛen nyemenenyemene bɔ ye nyemene gu so okyikyi ne, abotire bɔ ɔwɔ bɔnza bɔ ɔkye aleɛ ne ti afia, akɔnomnzafoɛ bɛ kuro ne!

english_verse: Only the Lord is strong and powerful! His mighty hand will strike them down with the force of a hailstorm or a mighty whirlwind or an overwhelming flood.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, AWURADE le ebie bɔ ɔte anwoserɛniɛ ne katakyie ɔ; ɔte kyɛ asukɔtwea bɔ ɔtɔ gua ɔ, mvrama piri bɔ ɔsɛkye nikye ɔ, ɔte kyɛ asue bɔ wayi bɔ opia nningyein kɔ ɔ, na ɔkɔfa ye sa kogyi ye kɔto aseɛ so.

english_verse: Every drunkard in Ephraim takes pride in Samaria, but it will be crushed.
translation_verse: Na bekotiatia Efraim akɔnomnzafoɛ anwomasoɛ abotire ne aso;

english_verse: Samaria above a fertile valley will quickly lose its glory. It will be gobbled up like the first ripe fig at harvest season.
translation_verse: bɛ ne ye nyerɛen nyemenenyemene bɔ ye nyemene gu so okyikyi, bɔ ɔwɔ bɔnza bɔ ɔkye aleɛ ne ti afia ne. Bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ borɔdoma mmaa bɔ bekoli moa bɛkɔboro koraka né borɔdoma telɛ adwu ɔ. Sona biala bɔ okonwu ye ne, ɔte ala a né wali.

english_verse: When this time comes, the Lord All-Powerful will be a glorious crown for his people who survive.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, Asafo AWURADE kɔyɛ animnyam abotire ne ahemvo kyerɛ nyemenenyemene kɔma ye mmenia bɔ baha ne.

english_verse: He will see that justice rules and that his people are able to defend their cities. Corrupt Leaders Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Ɔkɔyɛ ndɛenbualɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ sunzum wɔ sona bɔ obua ndɛen ɔ nu, yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ anwoserɛ kɔma bɛ bɔ bɛfoa koɛhonɛfoɛ mɔ befi kuro pambim nu maa besa bɛkɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Priests and prophets stumble because they are drunk. Their minds are too confused to receive God's messages or give honest decisions.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia hemɔ koso, bɛfa nzaa bebia, na nzaa serɛ maa bɛnate fofalifofali: Asɔfo mɔ ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɛfa nzaa serɛ bebia, nzaa ama b’adwene ayɛ nwunyaenn, nzaa serɛ maa bɛnate fofalifofali, bɛyɛ mvomsoɛ wɔ nyekyire nu, na bɛ ndɛenbualɛ ɔtte mayee.

english_verse: Their tables are covered, completely covered, with their stinking vomit.
translation_verse: Ɛpoen nemɔ amukoraa so ayɛ ɛfeɛ ngome, neka fee nne berɛ bɔ efiɛ nne berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You drunken leaders are like babies! How can you possibly understand or teach the Lord's message?
translation_verse: “Nwa yeɛ okohyire ye nimdeɛ ɔ? Nwa yeɛ okohyirehyire ngyerɛkyerɛ ne anu kohyire ye ɔ? Bɛ bɔ bapɛ bɛ nyɔfone anaa? Bɛ bɔ bate bɛ bafi nyɔfone noa anaa?

english_verse: You don't even listen— all you hear is senseless sound after senseless sound.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ahyɛdeɛ tia ahyɛdeɛ, ahyɛdeɛ tia ahyɛdeɛ, edwirɛ tia edwirɛ, edwirɛ tia edwirɛ, ɛwa kãa, yeɛ dɔ kãa”

english_verse: So, the Lord will speak to his people in strange sounds and foreign languages.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, pɔtɔfoɛ dwudwolɛ ne maen bie aso dwudwolɛ yeɛ ɔkɔfa so kodwudwo kohyire sɔ maen he ɔ.

english_verse: Now his message to you will be senseless sound after senseless sound. Then you will fall backwards, injured and trapped. False Security Is Fatal
translation_verse: Ɔnate sɔ ati, AWURADE dwirɛ ne kɔyɛ bɛ so anu: ahyɛdeɛ tia ahyɛdeɛ, ahyɛdeɛ tia ahyɛdeɛ, edwirɛ tia edwirɛ, edwirɛ tia edwirɛ, ɛwa kãa, yeɛ dɔ kãa” Yiti bɛkɔhɔ bɛ nyunu moa, na bekofi ase bɛkɔtɔ nziɛ, bekopura, bɛkɔtɔ ngaen nu, ná bahye bɛ nnure bahɔ.

english_verse: You rulers of Jerusalem do nothing but sneer; now you must listen to what the Lord says.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛmɔ, ngorohoɛfoɛ, bɔ ɛmɔdi maen he aso wɔ Yerusalem ɔ, ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE noa dwirɛ!

english_verse: Do you think you have an agreement with death and the world of the dead? Why do you trust in your lies to keep you safe from danger and the mighty flood?
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔnwa, “Yɛne ewue ayɛ apam, yɛne ɛborɔ yayɛ nhyehyɛleɛ, sɛ mbire bɔ ye noa yɛ yea tra so ne ɔbaapɛ nu a, ongonya yɛ ngofi yɛ, ofikyɛ yafa kanda yayɛ yɛ afealeɛ, yeɛ yafa nnakannaka yabɔ yɛ nwo waen.”

english_verse: And so the Lord says, “I'm laying a firm foundation for the city of Zion. It's a valuable cornerstone proven to be trustworthy; no one who trusts it will ever be disappointed.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: “Ɛ́mɔtie, méfa nyɔboɛ bie méto fapem wɔ Sion, nyɔboɛ bɔ maso manea, ndweasoɛ nyɔboɛ bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se bɔ otimu berɛ pindinn ɔ: ‘Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa ye nwo kɔto so ne, ɔngɔte ngɔtɔ.’

english_verse: Justice and fairness will be the measuring lines that help me build.” Hailstones and floods will destroy and wash away your shelter of lies.
translation_verse: Ngɔma pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ kɔyɛ asusudeɛ nyamaa, yeɛ ngɔma tenenee kɔyɛ tonyi; asukɔtwea koopia kanda afealeɛ ne kɔhɔ, na nzue koyi kɔfa afealeɛ ne.”

english_verse: Your agreement with death and the world of the dead will be broken. Then angry, roaring waves will sweep over you.
translation_verse: Afei ɛmɔ ne ewue b’apam ne, okokyikyi kofi berɛ, ɛmɔ ne ɛborɔ bɛ nhyehyɛleɛ ne, ongogyina. Na sɛ mbire bɔ ye noa yɛ yea tra so ne ɔbaapɛ nu a, okohwi kɔfa ɛmɔ so.

english_verse: Morning, noon, and night an overwhelming flood will wash you away. The terrible things that happen will teach you this lesson:
translation_verse: Mmerɛ biala bɔ ɔbaapɛ nu ne, ɔkɔhye ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɔkɔɔpɛ nu ngyerɛmɔ biala, eyia ne kɔngɔen koso ɔkɔɔpɛ nu, Na ɔkɔyɛ ɛmɔ ahunundetelɛ kyɛ ɛmɔkɔte edwirɛ he abo ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will fiercely attack as he did at Mount Perazim and in Gibeon Valley. But this time the Lord will do something surprising, not what you expect.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE kodwɔso kyɛbɔ ɔyɔle ye wɔ Perasim bokaa ne aso ne, ye ahone kohu kyɛbɔ ɔyɔle ye wɔ Gibeon bɔnza ne anu ne, amaa ɔnate so wahyire ye tumi, ye anwanwadeɛ tumi ne, ná wayɔ ye adwuma, ye anwanwadeɛ adwuma ne!

english_verse: So you had better stop sneering or you will be in worse shape than ever before. I heard the Lord All-Powerful threaten the whole country with destruction. All Wisdom Comes from the Lord
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔdi ngorohoɛ ko, anyɔ a, bekomia ɛmɔ panwu ne anu; ofikyɛ mate ehuhunɛ pasaa nwo dwirɛ mafi Asafo AWURADE Nyameɛ berɛ, kyɛ, ɔkɔmaa ɔkɔto aseɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: Pay close attention to what I am saying.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔyeye bɛ so anu bétie bɔ mekã ye; ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ bétie me dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: When a field is ready, they scatter the seeds of dill and cumin; they plant the seeds of wheat and barley in the proper places and sow other grains around the edges.
translation_verse: Sɛ osiesie aseɛ ne maa ɔda so frɛtɛɛ a, aso ongua ɛmeɛ, ɔndo ɛkaberɛ mbete, aso onnua atokoɔ ɔnza ye folii wɔ so, aso ɔmva ayuo mmobɔ nu, aso onnua aburoo wɔ eboo ne noa?

english_verse: After dill and cumin have been harvested, the stalks are pounded, not run over with a wagon.
translation_verse: Bɛmva ndaboa bɔ bɛboro so aburoo ɔ bɛndete ɛmeɛ, yeɛ bɛmva teaseɛnam bendwi bɛmva ɛkaberɛ so, na mmom mbapaa yeɛ bɛfa bɛtete ɛmeɛ ɔ, yeɛ bɛfa bakaa ba yeɛ bɛboro ɛkaberɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Wheat and barley are pounded, but not beaten to pulp; they are run over with a wagon, but not ground to dust.
translation_verse: Kuaniɛ otĩ ayuo yeɛ ɔfa yɛ paanoo ɔ, yiti onhia kyɛ ɔkɔboro ayuo ne kɔhyɛ ɔ. Na sɛ ɔfa ye teaseɛnam mɔ bɛ gya otwi fa so, ná ɔma ye mbɔngɔ natenate so a, ondi ayuo ne.

english_verse: This wonderful knowledge comes from the Lord All-Powerful, who has such great wisdom.
translation_verse: Ɛhe koso ofi Asafo AWURADE berɛ, ye foɛtulɛ te nikyee bɔ ɔyɛ nwanwa, na ye nworɛ ne te piri paa.

english_verse: Jerusalem, city of David, the place of my altar, you are in for trouble! Celebrate your festivals year after year.
translation_verse: Ariɛl, Ariɛl, kuro bɔ Dawide ɔɔtenane so ne, wɔ yaakɔ oo! Afoɛnoa afoɛnoa biala, ɛ́mɔli aluolue nemɔ,

english_verse: I will still make you suffer, and your people will cry when I make an altar of you.
translation_verse: nakoso ngɔma Ariɛl kɔhɔ anwokyere nu, ɔkɔyɛ esuɛ ne awuyebɔlɛ, na ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ Ariɛl kɔma me.

english_verse: I will surround you and prepare to attack from all sides.
translation_verse: Ngotua wɔ ngɔbra ngoyia, ngosisi abandenden ngɔpɛ wɔ nwo ngɔbra ngoyia, na ngɔkyekye nyinasoɛ bɔ bɛkɔfo so bɛkɔhɔ kuro ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: Then your cruel enemies will suddenly be swept away like dust in a windstorm.
translation_verse: Asa koso, wɔ pɔfoɛ worawora nemɔ, bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ mvuture, yeɛ atianuserɛfoɛ worawora ne, bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ afafu bɔ mvrama bɔ ye kɔ ɔ. Na ɔkɔwa mvum nu.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will come to your rescue with a thundering earthquake and a fiery whirlwind.
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE kɔɔpasa wɔ nwo: Ɔkɔfa agralaa, aseɛwosolɛ ne dededede kandinga, mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo, mvrama piri ne see wuronyiwuronyi yeɛ ɔkɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: Every brutal nation that attacks Jerusalem and makes it suffer will disappear like a dream when night is over.
translation_verse: Na maen maen pee mukoraa bɔ bɛfa koɛ bɛteta Ariɛl ne, bɛ mukoraa bɔ bɛfa koɛ bɛteta ye ne ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ bɔ bɛmaa onwu amaneɛ ne, bekotu bekomini kyɛ laleɛ, kyɛ kɔngɔen nyekyire bie.

english_verse: Those nations that attack Mount Zion will suffer from hunger and thirst. They will dream of food and drink but wake up weary and hungry and thirsty as ever. Prophets Who Fool Themselves
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ ɛhɔen ku ye, kyɛbɔ ɔkye laleɛ a né odidi, nakoso otingye a né ɛhɔen tɛ ku ye ne, anaakyɛ, sona bɔ nzuhɔen ku ye, kyɛbɔ ɔkye laleɛ a né ɔno nzue, nakoso otingye a né nzuhɔen ahu ye ama ye komvi awo ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔkɔto maen maen pee amukoraa bɔ bɛfa koɛ bɛteta Sion bokaa ne ɔ.

english_verse: Be shocked and stunned, you prophets! Refuse to see. Get drunk and stagger, but not from wine.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma ɔyɛ ɛmɔ nwanwa ná ɛmɔ nwo dwiri ɛmɔ, Ɛ́mɔmuamua ɛmɔ nye ma ɛmɔ nye si! Babobo, nakoso nna nzaa yeɛ bano ɔ, Bɛnate fofalifofali, nakoso nna nzaa serɛ yeɛ bano ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has made you drowsy; he put you into a deep sleep and covered your head.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE afa nnafelɛ hatee sunzum wato ɛmɔ so, ɛmɔ nye bɔ yeɛ ɔte ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne, wamuamua ye, ɛmɔ ti bɔ yeɛ ɔte mmenia bɔ bɛse ase ne, wamundu so.

english_verse: Now his message is like a sealed letter to you. Some of you say, “We can't read it, because it's sealed.”
translation_verse: Nyekyire he amukoraa, wakakyi ɛmɔ nye so kyɛ edwirɛ bɔ ɔwɔ nwomaa bɔ nzɔanoɛ sɔ ye noa ɔ nu. Sɛ bɛfa bɛma ebie bɔ ɔse nwomaa kyɛ, “Mesrɛ wɔ, kenga ɛhe” a, ɔkã kyɛ, “Mengɔhora, ofikyɛ nzɔanoɛ sɔ ye noa.”

english_verse: Others say, “We can't read it, because we don't know how to read.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ sɛ bɛfa bɛma ebie bɔ ɔnze nwomaa kyɛ “Mesrɛ wɔ kenga ɛhe” a, ɔkã kyɛ, “Menze nwomaa.”

english_verse: The Lord has said: “These people praise me with their words, but they never really think about me. They worship me by repeating rules made up by humans.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele kyɛ, “Maen he, bɛfa bɛ noa mbaen yeɛ bɛtwe bepingye me ɔ, bɛ noa mbaen yeɛ bɛfa bedi me ni ɔ, nakoso b’ahone nu de, bembingye me koraa, na esurolɛ bɔ besuro me ne, ɔte kuro sona ahyɛdeɛ bɔ basua ye mbaen ɔ;

english_verse: So once again I will do things that shock and amaze them, and I will destroy the wisdom of those who claim to know and understand.”
translation_verse: yiti, tie, ngɔhɔ so ngɔyɔ nikyee bɔ ɔyɛ nwanwa bɔ ɔkɔma me maen he nwo kodwiri ye ɔ. Bɛ nworɛfoɛ nemɔ, bɛ nworɛ kɔyɛ mbaen, na bɛ badwemma mɔ bɛ nworɛ ne, so kɔkata.”

english_verse: You are in for trouble, if you try to hide your plans from the Lord! Or if you think what you do in the dark can't be seen.
translation_verse: Bɛ yaakɔ, bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ nhyehyɛleɛ bɛfea AWURADE fee ɔ, bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ bɛ yɔleɛ wɔ awosii nu, bɔ bɛkã kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ onwu yɛ ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ɔse yɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: You have it all backwards. A clay dish doesn't say to the potter, “You didn't make me. You don't even know how.” Hope for the Future
translation_verse: Ɛmɔasisi nningyein ti ase, bɔ ɛmɔbu ngukuenwonɛniɛ ne kyɛ ɔne ɛfaa bɛte pɛ ɔ! Aso bua kɔhora kose sona bɔ ɔnwone ye ne kyɛ, “Nna ye yeɛ ɔnwone me ɔ”? Anaakyɛ, nikyee bɔ banwo ne, ɔkɔhora kose sona bɔ wanwo ye ne kyɛ, “Olle nimdeɛ huu”?

english_verse: Soon the forest of Lebanon will become a field with crops, thick as a forest.
translation_verse: Aso nna mmerɛ kãa bie yeɛ waha ɔ bɔ Lebanon kɔkakyi aseɛ bɔ ɔkye aleɛ ɔ, bɔ bekobu aseɛ bɔ ɔkye aleɛ koso kyɛ ɛhɔayeɛ ɔ?

english_verse: The deaf will be able to hear whatever is read to them; the blind will be freed from a life of darkness.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, asotiniwaaniɛ kɔte nwomaa ne anu dwirɛ, na anyesiniwaafoɛ bɛ nye kofi awosii kabii nu konwu nikye.

english_verse: The poor and the needy will celebrate and shout because of the Lord, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Na mmenia bɔ bedwo ne, bekonya AWURADE nu anika pee, na mmenia nu ehiafoɛ bekoli ahurusi wɔ Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne anu.

english_verse: All who are cruel and arrogant will be gone forever. Those who live by crime will disappear,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ atianuserɛfoɛ bɛ boso konua, ngorohoɛfoɛ bekowuwu bɔkɔɔ, na bekohu bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ porɛ tɛɛ amukoraa:

english_verse: together with everyone who tells lies in court and keeps innocent people from getting a fair trial.
translation_verse: bɛ yeɛ bɛ noa dwirɛ ma sona di fɔ, besua bɛ bɔ bedi dwirɛ ɔ ngaen, na bɛfa ngondombo atee so bebua ndɛengyea.

english_verse: The Lord who rescued Abraham has this to say about Jacob's descendants: “They will no longer be ashamed and disgraced.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE bɔ olele Abraham ne, bɔ ɔkã fa Yakob boso ama nwo ɛhe: “Yakob nyunu ngogua ase ko, ye nyunu ngɔyɛ anwumvoin anwumvoin ko.

english_verse: When they see how great I have made their nation, they will praise and honor me, the holy God of Israel.
translation_verse: Na sɛ onwu ye mma, me sa noa adwuma ne wɔ ye nu a, bekobu me dumaa ne krongron, bekobu Yakob Krongronniɛ ne krongron, na bekosuro Yisrael Nyameɛ ne.

english_verse: Everyone who is confused will understand, and all who have complained will obey my teaching.”
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bali sunzum nu makyebu ne, bekonya ndeaseɛ, na bɛ bɔ bɛpenepene bɛ komvi ne, bekosua ngyerɛkyerɛ.”

english_verse: This is the Lord's message for his rebellious people: “You follow your own plans instead of mine; you make treaties without asking me, and you keep on sinning.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Mmaa bɔ bayɛ lɔen, bɛ yaakɔ, bɛbɔ porɛ bɔ nna me nhyehyɛleɛ ahɔ ɔ, bɛyɛ apam bɔ me sunzum mvoa so ɔ, bɛyɔ bɔne bɛtoatoa bɔne so.

english_verse: You trust Egypt for protection. So you refuse my advice and send messengers to Egypt to beg their king for help.
translation_verse: Besi nu bɛkɔ Misraim bɔ bemmisa me bennwu m’adwene ɔ, kyɛ bɛkɔ Faro berɛ maa ɔbɔ bɛ nwo waen, kyɛ bɛkwaapena Misraim fɔnwoo nu bewura.

english_verse: “You will be disappointed, completely disgraced for trusting Egypt.
translation_verse: Nakoso Faro berɛ waenbɔlɛ ne, ɔkɔkakyi ɛmɔ animguaseɛ, yeɛ Misraim fɔnwoo nu wuralɛ ne, ɔkɔkakyi ɛmɔ nyanzoen.

english_verse: The king's power reaches from the city of Zoan as far south as Hanes.
translation_verse: Yuda hene safohene mɔ baadwu Soan, yeɛ ye somafoɛ mɔ koso baadwu Hanese de,

english_verse: This is a message about the animals of the Southern Desert: “You people carry treasures on donkeys and camels. You travel to a feeble nation through a troublesome desert filled with lions and flying fiery dragons.
translation_verse: Ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne aso ngaka nwo nyekyire ɛhe: Bɛfa amaneɛ ne yealɛ aseɛ so, aseɛ bɔ gyata beleɛ ne gyata nyii wɔ so ɔ, bɔ ɛbɔnaa ne ewoo bɔ otu ɔ wɔ so ɔ, bɛfa b’anwonyadeɛ bɛsoa afunum mɔ, yeɛ bɛfa b’agyapadeɛ bɛteta afupɔngɔ mɔ si akyakya ne aso, kyɛ bɛkwaafa bɛma maen bɔ bengonya ye so mvasoɛ biala ɔ.

english_verse: Egypt can't help you! That's why I call that nation a helpless monster.” Israel Refuses To Listen
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Misraim mmokalɛ ne ɔte mbaen bɔ mvasoɛ nne so ɔ. Yiti mato ye dumaa “Rahabo bɔ ɔngora huu yɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord told me to write down his message for his people, so that it would be there forever.
translation_verse: Afei kɔ, kyerɛ edwirɛ ne nyɔboɛ so wɔ bɛ nyunu, ná kyerɛ gua nwomaa nu maa kyẽa bie ɔyɛ adanzeɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: They have turned against the Lord and can't be trusted. They have refused his teaching
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛte maen bɔ bɛyɛ lɔen ɔ, mmaa nnakannakafoɛ, mmaa bɔ bɛnyɛ sotie bɛmma AWURADE mmeraa ɔ.

english_verse: and have said to his messengers and prophets: Don't tell us what God has shown you and don't preach the truth. Just say what we want to hear, even if it's false.
translation_verse: Na bese mmenia bɔ bɛse ase ne kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔnwu nikye”; yeɛ bese ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ koso kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔhyɛ edwirɛ nahorɛ nwo ngɔm bekyire yɛ; na mmom ɛmɔhã edwirɛ bɔ ɔyɛ yɛ so anu fɛ ɔ behyire yɛ, ɛ́mɔli ngɔndorɔ,

english_verse: Stop telling us what God has said! We don't want to hear any more about the holy One of Israel.
translation_verse: ɛ́mɔmakye béfi atimbire ne aso, ɛ́mɔfi atee ne aso, nnɛmɔmaa yɛte Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne nwo dwirɛ ko.”

english_verse: Now this is the answer of the holy One of Israel: “You rejected my message, and you trust in violence and lies.
translation_verse: Yiti Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne nwa: “Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔapo sɔ dwirɛ he, ná ɛmɔafa ɛmɔ wora bawura nhyɛsoɛ ne nnakannaka nu, ná ɛmɔafa bɛ nwo bato so ne ati,

english_verse: and shatter like a crushed bowl. There's not a piece left big enough to carry hot coals or to dip out water.” Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Okobubu ye kyɛ ngukuenwonɛniɛ ye bua bɔ babobɔ ye nyokonyoko bɔ ebie nga mma bennya ye bue ne bie bɔ bɛkɔfa bekosuso bokyea nu see ɔ, anaakyɛ bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔsa abura nu nzue ɔ.”

english_verse: The holy Lord God of Israel had told all of you, “I will keep you safe if you turn back to me and calm down. I will make you strong if you quietly trust me.” Then you stubbornly
translation_verse: Na AWURADE Nyameɛ, Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne, ɔnwa: “Sɛ ɛmɔsa bɛba me berɛ, ɔne kyɛ ɛmɔde bɛ nwome wɔ me nu a, yeɛ ɛmɔkonya ngoa ɔ; konnyɛlɛ ne anyelasoɛ nu yeɛ ɛmɔ anwoserɛ wɔ ɔ.” Nakoso ɛmɔanguro ye sɔ,

english_verse: As few as five of them, or even one, will be enough to chase a thousand of you. Finally, all that will be left will be a few survivors as lonely as a flag pole on a barren hill. The Lord Will Show Mercy
translation_verse: Bɛ nu ko nwo suronyi ɔkɔma mmenia apee kɔnwati, bɛ nu nnu nwo suronyi ɔkɔma ɛmɔkɔnwati, kɔpem kyɛ ɛmɔ ayieleɛ kɔyɛ kyɛ frangaa bɔ ogyi bokaa ti afia ɔ, kyɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ ogyi pambaa so ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God is waiting to show how kind he is and to have pity on you. The Lord always does right; he blesses those who trust him.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, AWURADE ɔnwondɛ kyɛ ɔkɔlo ɛmɔ ɔ, na waboaboa ye nwo kyɛ okonwu ɛmɔ anwumvoin ɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE te pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ Nyameɛ, na ebiala bɔ ɔfa ye wora wura ye nu ne, onya saleɛ.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, you don't need to cry anymore. The Lord is kind, and as soon as he hears your cries for help, he will come.
translation_verse: Amba, maen ne kɔtena Sion wɔ Yerusalem, engosũ ko. Sɛ esũ frɛ ye a, okonwu wɔ anwumvoin paa; ɔte ala a, ɔkɔtɛ wɔ so.

english_verse: The Lord has given you trouble and sorrow as your food and drink. But now you will again see the Lord, your teacher, and he will guide you.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ AWURADE ma ɛmɔ amaneɛnwunɛ aleɛ ne yealɛ nzue de, nakoso wɔ Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ ne ɔngɔfa ye nwo ngɔfea wɔ ko, na mmom wɔ nye konwu wɔ Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ ne.

english_verse: Whether you turn to the right or to the left, you will hear a voice saying, “This is the road! Now follow it.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔdi makyebu bɛkɔfa famaa anaa bɛen a, wɔ so kɔte edwirɛ bie wɔ wɔ si dɔ kyɛ, “Atee ne ɛhe, ɛ́mɔfa so!”

english_verse: Then you will treat your idols of silver and gold like garbage; you will throw them away like filthy rags.
translation_verse: Na w’amoen mɔ bɔ bafa ɛdwetɛ baboro bɛ nwo, ɔne bɔ bafa sikaa kɔkorɛ baboro bɛ nwo ne, ɛkɔfa efiɛ kɔhã bɛ, ekofindi bɛ kogua kyɛ manzaa asiaa, na ekose bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfi me so bɛhɔ!”

english_verse: The Lord will send rain to water the seeds you have planted—your fields will produce more crops than you need, and your cattle will graze in open pastures.
translation_verse: Na afei ɔkɔtɔ esue kogua nningyein bɔ edua ye wɔ aseɛ so ɔ so, ɔne aseɛ ne aso aleɛ bɔ ɔkɔwa ɔ so, na bɛkɔyɛ mbiri mbiri ne pee. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, wɔ nyɛmmoa kodidi wɔ aseɛ pirikua bɔ ngaka aleɛ wɔ so ɔ so.

english_verse: Even the oxen and donkeys that plow your fields will be fed the finest grain.
translation_verse: Na nandwie mɔ ne afunum mɔ bɔ bɛyɔ fieso adwuma ne, bekoli aleɛ paa bɔ bafa ɛkorɛ ne kɛndɛen bahuhu so ɔ.

english_verse: On that day people will be slaughtered and towers destroyed, but streams of water will flow from high hills and towering mountains.
translation_verse: Na mmenia hunɛ kyẽa piri ne, bɔ abandenden mɔ kobubu kogua ne, asue mɔ ne asue ba mɔ bɛkɔtengyɛ wɔ bokaa tendenn biala ne pambaa tendenn biala so.

english_verse: Then the Lord will bandage his people's injuries and heal the wounds he has caused. The moon will shine as bright as the sun, and the sun will shine seven times brighter than usual. It will be like the light of seven days all at once. Assyria Will Be Punished
translation_verse: Asa koso, ɛsraen talɛ ne kɔyɛ kyɛ eyia talɛ, yeɛ eyia talɛ ne kɔyɛ mmɔhoɛ nzoo kyɛ bafa ye talɛ ɛlɛsoo babɔ nu ɔ, wɔ kyẽa bɔ AWURADE kɔkyekye ye maen ngena so, bɔ ɔkɔma bɛ nwo pakyepakyelɛ ne kɔhɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is coming from far away with his fiery anger and thick clouds of smoke. His angry words flame up like a destructive fire;
translation_verse: Tie, AWURADE dumaa fi dedeede yeɛ ɔ́ba ɔ, ye ahone ahu piri paa, wɔ nwosina munguu bɔ otu kɔ anwuro ɔ nu, ɛyaafɛlɛ ayi ye noa nu to, na ye temverema te kyɛ see bɔ ɔ́yera nikye ɔ.

english_verse: he breathes out a flood that comes up to the neck. He sifts the nations and destroys them. Then he puts a bridle in every foreigner's mouth and leads them to doom.
translation_verse: Ye nwomeɛ te kyɛ asue bɔ wayi wabu wafa so bɔ odwu bɛ kɔme anu ɔ, kyɛ ɔfa ɛsɛkyelɛ huhuamoa ohuhu maen mɔ so, ná ɔfa nyamaa bɔ ɔkɔma maen mɔ bekoli makyebu ɔ ɔsosɔ bɛ noa.

english_verse: The Lord's people will sing as they do when they celebrate a religious festival at night. The Lord is Israel's mighty rock, and his people will be as happy as they are when they follow the sound of flutes to the mountain where he is worshiped.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkɔto dwein bɔ ɔte kyɛ aluolue krongron dwein bɔ ɛmɔto ye kɔngɔen ne; na ɛmɔ nye kɔgye kyɛbɔ ɛmɔhu aweɛn besi nu bɛkɔ AWURADE bokaa ne aso, Yisrael Nyɔbotaen ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will get furious. His fearsome voice will be heard, his arm will be seen ready to strike, and his anger will be like a destructive fire, followed by thunderstorms and hailstones.
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔmaa bɛkɔte ye komvi totohyia ne, na ɔkɔmaa bekonwu ye tumi asaa bɔ odwu ba ase ne, wɔ ɛyaafɛlɛ pirikua ne see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi nu, wɔ esue titititi ne mvrama piri ne asukɔtwea kungumaboɔ nu.

english_verse: When the Assyrians hear the Lord's voice and see him striking with his iron rod, they will be terrified.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE komvi ne ati, Asiria nwo kɔwoso ye tɛtɛtɛtɛ, mmerɛ bɔ ɔkɔfa ye mbire ne kofi ye ne.

english_verse: He will attack them in battle, and each time he strikes them, it will be to the music of tambourines and harps.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, asotwe mbire bɔ AWURADE kɔfa kofi ye biala ne, ɔkɔgyegye kyɛ akasaa ne sangoo, na ɔkɔfa ye tumi piri ne ɔne ye bɛkɔho.

english_verse: Long ago the Lord got a place ready for burning the body of the dead king. The place for the fire is deep and wide, the wood is piled high, and the Lord will start the fire by breathing out flaming sulfur.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, ofi tetetete yeɛ wasiesie kumaa bɔ bɛyera fofoɛ nu ɔ, wasiesie wama Asiria hene, nu te kuronn, ɔtrɛ, na see ne eyein pee wɔ nu. Na AWURADE nwomeɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ sɔfe bɔ ɔtengyɛ kɔ ne yeɛ ɔmaa ɔsɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You are in for trouble if you go to Egypt for help, or if you depend on an army of chariots or a powerful cavalry. Instead you should depend on and trust the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: Bɛ yaakɔ, bɛ bɔ bɛkɔ Misraim bɛkɔpena mmokalɛ, bɔ bɛfa bɛ nye bɛto mbɔngɔ so, bɔ ɔnate teaseɛnam mɔ bɛ somaa ti bɛfa bɛ wora bewura bɛ nu, bɔ ɔnate pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ mɔ b’anwoserɛ ti bɛfa bɛ wora bewura bɛ nu, nakoso bɛmva bɛ nwo bɛndo Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne so ɔ, anaakyɛ bɛmbena AWURADE si atee ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord isn't stupid! He does what he promises, and he can bring doom. If you are cruel yourself, or help those who are evil, you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔte nworɛniɛ, na ɔkɔma musue kɔwa, ɔkã dwirɛ a ɔndwe nza, okodwɔso kotia bɔnefoɛ awuro ne bɛ bɔ bedi bɛboka amumuyɛɛfoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Egyptians are mere humans. They aren't God. Their horses are made of flesh; they can't live forever. When the Lord shows his power, he will destroy the Egyptians and all who depend on them. Together they will fall.
translation_verse: Misraimfoɛ bɛte mmenia oo, na bɛtte Nyameɛ; bɛ mbɔngɔ nemɔ bɛte anwoɔnaen, na bɛtte sunzum. Sɛ AWURADE tengyɛ ye sa a, bokafoɛ ne kosoti, yeɛ bɔ bokafoɛ ne boka ye ne koso, okofi ase, na bɛ mukoraa bekowu bɛkɔbɔ nu.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me, “I will roar and attack like a fearless lion not frightened by the shouts of shepherds trying to protect their sheep. That's how I will come down and fight on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE sele me kyɛ: Kyɛbɔ gyata anaa gyata akrɔngrɔma ɔyɛ ye komvi hoohoo gua naen bɔ wahye ye ɔ so, bɔ mmoaenneafoɛ kure bɛba ye so a onzuro kyɛ bɛteatea nu begua ye so, anaakyɛ ɔndɛ b’anwunanwuna ne aso ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Asafo AWURADE kodwu kɔwa kɔɔho koɛ wɔ Sion bokaa ne ye pambaa ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will protect Jerusalem like a mother bird circling over her nest.” Come Back to the Lord
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ nnomaa betu bɛbɔ mborɔkaa ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Asafo AWURADE kɔbɔ Yerusalem nwo waen ɔ; ɔkɔbɔ ye nwo waen okole ye, okogyina ye si, na ɔkɔpepɛ kole ye.

english_verse: People of Israel, come back! You have completely turned from the Lord.
translation_verse: O Yisraelfoɛ, ɛmɔsa bɛbra bɔ ɛmɔayɛ ye nwo lɔen piri paa ne berɛ.

english_verse: The time is coming when you will throw away your idols of silver and gold, made by your sinful hands.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɔ kyẽa ne, ɛdwetɛ amoen ne sikaa kɔkorɛ amoen bɔ ɛmɔyɔ bafa, maa ɔnate so ɛmɔayɔ bɔne ne, ebiala kofindi kogua.

english_verse: The Assyrians will be killed, but not by the swords of humans. Their young men will try to escape, but they will be captured and forced into slavery.
translation_verse: “Afei, Asiria kɔtɔ ngrandɛ bɔ nna sona deɛ ahɔ ɔ ye noa, ngrandɛ bɔ nna sona yeɛ otira ɔ okohu ye, ɔkɔnwati kofi ngrandɛ ne noa, na bɛkɔhyɛ ye mmerandeɛ maa bɛkɔyɔ nhyɛsoɛ adwuma.

english_verse: Their fortress will fall when terror strikes; their army officers will be frightened and run from the battle. This is what the Lord has said, the Lord whose fiery furnace is built on Mount Zion.
translation_verse: Ɛserɛ kɔmaa ɔkɔnwati kofi ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ nu, yeɛ ahunundetelɛ kɔma ye safohene mɔ bɛkɔnwati bɛkɔyakyi bɛ frangaa berɛ.” AWURADE bɔ ye see wɔ Sion, bɔ ye foonoo wɔ Yerusalem ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: They will be a place of safety from stormy winds, a stream in the desert, and a rock that gives shade from the heat of the sun.
translation_verse: Bɛ nu biala kɔyɛ kyɛ afealeɛ bɔ mvrama tu a sona fea nu ɔ, nekaa bɔ mvrama piri tu a sona bɔ ye nwo waen ɔ, kyɛ aseɛ wosee so asue bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ, kyɛ aseɛ pralaa so nyɔbotaen piri bo fɔnwoo ne.

english_verse: Then everyone who has eyes will open them and see, and those who have ears will pay attention.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ benwu nikyee ne, bɛ nye so ngɔyɛ bɛ wusiwusi, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛte dwirɛ ne, bɛ koso bekotie.

english_verse: All who are impatient will take time to think; everyone who stutters will talk clearly.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛpere dwirɛ nwo ne, bekonya ndeaseɛ, yeɛ bɔ ɔtɔ mmɛberɛ ne wora, ye noa kɔte paa.

english_verse: Fools will no longer be highly respected, and crooks won't be given positions of honor.
translation_verse: Bɛngɔfrɛ kwaseaa kyɛ sona bɔ odi mu ɔ ko, yeɛ bengobu nnakannakaniɛ kyɛ ɔfata anidie.

english_verse: Fools talk foolishness. They always make plans to do sinful things, to lie about the Lord, to let the hungry starve, and to keep water from those who are thirsty.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ kwaseaa kekã ngwaseaa dwirɛ, na ɔdwene adwene tɛɛ bɔ ɔmaa ɔyɔ amumuyɛɛ ɔ, ɔkekã AWURADE nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ, ɔma bɔ ɛhɔen ku ye ɔ ye noa aleɛ bɔ ye, na ɔmma bɔ nzuhɔen ku ye ɔ nnya nzue nno.

english_verse: Cruel people tell lies— they do evil things, and make cruel plans to destroy the poor and needy, even when they beg for justice.
translation_verse: Nnakannakaniɛ ye kanda nworɛ ne te bɔne, ɔbɔ porɛ tɛɛ kyɛ ɔkɔfa kanda nworɛ konya bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ, ɔmva ye nwo kyɛ ehianiɛ ne ye dwirɛ yɛ fɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But helpful people can always be trusted to make helpful plans. Punishment for the Women of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Nakoso sona bɔ odi mu ne de, ɔdwene nningyein bɔ bedi mu ɔ nwo, na bɔ ɔyɔ amukoraa te paa. Ɛfoen mmrasua

english_verse: You may not have worries now, but in about a year, the grape harvest will fail, and you will tremble.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, mmrasua bɔ ɛmɔ nwo atɔ ɛmɔ ɔ, kyɛ odwu afoɛ ko ne kãa bie ne, ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ ɛmɔ so, ofikyɛ bobe ne ngosu, na ɛmɔngonya ye mma ngɔboaboa ye noa.

english_verse: Slap your breasts in sorrow because of what happened to the fruitful fields and vineyards,
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ sa bégua ɛmɔ ahone so beli ɛhemɔ anwo aworabɔlɛ: ɛmɔ boo nyemenenyemene ne,, ɛmɔ bobe bɔ osu dɔsɔɔ ne,

english_verse: and to the happy homes in Jerusalem. The land of my people is covered with thorns.
translation_verse: agurɛ ne mmowue bɔ befifi me maen aseɛ ne aso, yoo, anigye awuro amukoraa bɔ ɔwɔ anigye kuro ne anu ne.

english_verse: The palace will be deserted, the crowded city empty. Fortresses and towers will forever become playgrounds for wild donkeys and pastures for sheep. God's Spirit Makes the Difference
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ahemvie ne kɔkakyi dandue, kuro bɔ nu mmenia worawora ne, bekotu bekofi so; na ye pambaa ne ye abandenden kɔkakyi ngaka atenaleɛ daa, ɔkɔyɛ anika atenaleɛ kɔma eburo afunum mɔ, ɔne nekaa bɔ nyɛmmoa bedidi ɔ,

english_verse: When the Spirit is given to us from heaven, deserts will become orchards thick as fertile forests.
translation_verse: kɔpem kyɛ bekofi anwuro bekohwie Sunzum ne bekogua yɛ so, kɔpem kyɛ ɛserɛ so kɔkakyi aseɛ bɔ ɔkye aleɛ ɔ, ɔne kyɛ bekobu aseɛ bɔ ɔkye aleɛ kyɛ ɛhɔayeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and justice will produce lasting peace and security.
translation_verse: Ɔnate tenenee so asomdwee kɔwa, na tenenee kɔfa bɛ soanutɔlɛ ne bɛ nwo waenbɔlɛ kɔwa afebɔɔ.

english_verse: You, the Lord's people, will live in peace, calm and secure,
translation_verse: Me maen kɔtena asomdwee atenaleɛ, anwotɔ atenaleɛ nu, ɔne nwomelelɛ atenaleɛ konn nu.

english_verse: You will have God's blessing, as you plant your crops beside streams, while your donkeys and cattle roam freely about.
translation_verse: ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔdua nningyein wɔ nzue mukoraa nwo ne, ɛmɔkonya saleɛ, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔyakyi nandwie ne afunum mɔ maa bɛ bɔbɔ bɛkɔ adidie ne.

english_verse: You defeated my people. Now you're in for trouble! You've never been destroyed, but you will be destroyed; you've never been betrayed, but you will be betrayed. When you have finished destroying and betraying, you will be destroyed and betrayed in return.
translation_verse: Sɛkyefoɛ, wɔ yaakɔ, wɔ bɔ wɔ de, bɛssɛkyele wɔ ɔ; wɔ, nnakannakaniɛ, bɔ wɔ de ebiala ɔllakalakale wɔ ɔ! Sɛ enya yie ye sɛkyelɛ a, wɔ koso bɛkɔsɛkye wɔ, yeɛ sɛ eyie wɔ nnakannaka ne a, wɔ koso bɛkɔlakalaka wɔ.

english_verse: Please, Lord, be kind to us! We depend on you. Make us strong each morning, and come to save us when we are in trouble.
translation_verse: O AWURADE, do yɛ, wɔ yeɛ yɛ nye la wɔ so ɔ. Maa yɛnya w’anwoserɛ ne ngyerɛmɔ biala, yeɛ wɔ ngoalelɛ ne wɔ anwokyere mmerɛ nu.

english_verse: Nations scatter when you roar and show your greatness.
translation_verse: Ɛbɔ nu kurududududu a, maen maen mɔ bɛnwati, sɛ ekyire wɔ tumi a, maen maen mɔ bɛbɔ aya.

english_verse: We attack our enemies like swarms of locusts; we take everything that belongs to them.
translation_verse: Na mmenia bɛfẽ ɛmɔ nningyein bɛyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ kyɛbɔ ɛsaa di ndire ɔ; na kyɛbɔ mmɛbɛ mbiri behuru bɛpepe ne, sɔ ala yeɛ mmenia behuru bɛpepe so ɔ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are above all others, and you live in the heavens. You have brought justice and fairness to Jerusalem;
translation_verse: AWURADE te totohyia, ofikyɛ ɔte anwuro anwuro dɔ paa, wama pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ne tenenee bayi Sion tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: you are the foundation on which we stand today. You always save us and give true wisdom and knowledge. Nothing means more to us than obeying you. The Lord Will Do Something
translation_verse: Ɔkɔyɛ wɔ mmerɛ so nyinasoɛ pindinn, ɔte ngoalelɛ, nworɛ ne nimdeɛ mmorosoɛ, na AWURADE surolɛ yeɛ ɔte ye agyapadeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Listen! Our bravest soldiers are running through the streets, screaming for help. Our messengers hoped for peace, but came home crying.
translation_verse: Tie, bɛ kwabranoa nemɔ bɛteatea nu wɔ mmorɔnoɛ nemɔ aso, asomdwee ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ besu hahii.

english_verse: No one travels anymore; every road is empty. Treaties are broken, and no respect is shown to any who keep promises.
translation_verse: Atimbire nemɔ aso ayɛ kenananana, mmenia mva so bendu atee ko, bɛpepɛ apam mɔ nu, bebu adanzefoɛ animtia, na bɛmva sona bɛnyɛ huu.

english_verse: Fields are dry and barren; Mount Lebanon wilts with shame. Sharon Valley is a desert; the forests of Bashan and Carmel have lost their leaves.
translation_verse: Aseɛ di aworabɔlɛ, na wayɛ katerepee, Lebanon nyunu agua ase, na watwindwam; Saron ayɛ kyɛ ɛserɛ so; na Basan ne Kamɛl so mmakaa nyaa baporo.

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Now I will do something and be greatly praised.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Afei ngodwɔso, afei ngohyire me tumi, afei ngɔmaa bekonwu me tumi.

english_verse: Your deeds are straw that will be set on fire by your very own breath.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkɔnwonzɛ afafu, na ɛmɔkɔwo ngyɛngyɛma; ɛmɔ nwomeɛ te see bɔ ɔkɔyera ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You will be burned to ashes like thorns in a fire.
translation_verse: Maen maen mɔ bɛkɔyera bɛkɔtɔ nzoen kyɛ mmakaa mmowue bɔ bapepɛ, bɔ bɛkɔyera ye see nu ɔ.”

english_verse: Everyone, both far and near, come look at what I have done. See my mighty power!” Punishment and Rewards
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔwɔ dedeede ne, ɛ́mɔtie bɔ mayɔ ɔ, yeɛ ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔpingye ne koso, ɛ́mɔle me tumi ne bɛ́to nu.

english_verse: Those terrible sinners on Mount Zion tremble as they ask in fear, “How can we possibly live where a raging fire never stops burning?”
translation_verse: Ɛserɛ ahã bɔnefoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Sion ɔ, ahunundetelɛ atɔ bɛ bɔ benzuro Nyameɛ ɔ so. “Yɛ nu nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora ɔne see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi ne bɛkɔtena ɔ? Yɛ nu nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora ɔne see wuronyiwuronyi bɔ ogye afebɔɔ ne bɛkɔtena ɔ?”

english_verse: But there will be rewards for those who live right and tell the truth, for those who refuse to take money by force or accept bribes, for all who hate murder and violent crimes.
translation_verse: Sana teneneeniɛ bɔ ɔkã nahorɛ, bɔ okyi aminɛlilɛ nu mvasoɛ, bɔ ɔnwaha ye sa kyɛ ongole fea-ase-ma, bɔ otuatua ye so kyɛ ongotie sona hunɛ nwo porɛ bɔ babɔ ɔ, bɔ omuamua ye nye kyɛ ɔngɔma ongonwu bɔne ɔ;

english_verse: They will live in a fortress high on a rocky cliff, where they will have food and plenty of water. The Lord Is Our King
translation_verse: ye yeɛ ɔkɔtena anwuro anwuro ɔ, nyɔbotaen afealeɛ nu kɔyɛ ye nwo waenbɔlɛ, ɔkɔmaa okonya ye noa aleɛ, na ye nzue ngɔbɔ ye.

english_verse: With your own eyes you will see the glorious King; you will see his kingdom reaching far and wide.
translation_verse: Wɔ nye konwu ɛhene ne wɔ ye anwonyemene nu, anyeɛ ne konwu aseɛ bɔ ɔtrɛ kɔ dedeede ɔ.

english_verse: Then you will ask yourself, “Where are those officials who terrified us and forced us to pay such heavy taxes?”
translation_verse: Na w’adwene kɔdwene nningyein suronyisuronyi nwo kyɛ, “Sona bɔ odide ndɔ ne, ɔwɔ nisua? Sona bɔ né ɔkari ɛtoɔ sikaa ne, ɔwɔ nisua? Sona bɔ né ɔka abandenden nemɔ ne, ɔwɔ nisua?”

english_verse: You will never again have to see the proud people who spoke a strange and foreign language you could not understand.
translation_verse: Engonwu atianuserɛfoɛ nemɔ ko, mmenia bɔ bɛ dwudwolɛ te boborɔboborɔ bɔ ɛnde ye bo, bɔ bɛpɔtɔ bɔ ɛngɔhora ngɔte ye bo ɔ.

english_verse: Look to Mount Zion where we celebrate our religious festivals. You will see Jerusalem, secure as a tent with pegs that cannot be pulled up and fastened with ropes that can never be broken.
translation_verse: To wɔ nye nea Sion, kuro bɔ yɛdi yɛ aluolue nemɔ wɔ so ne! Wɔ nye konwu Yerusalem, bɔ ɔte asomdwee atenaleɛ, ɛtena sua bɔ bendutu ye bo, bɔ bengotutu ye pɛmbɛen nemɔ bo le ne, bɔ ye nyamaa ne anu biala ngɔtete ne.

english_verse: Our wonderful Lord will be with us! There will be deep rivers and wide streams safe from enemy ships. The Lord Is Our Judge
translation_verse: Amba, animnyam AWURADE ne, berɛ yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ yɛ kuro bɔ asue mbiri mbiri ne asue mmaa mmaa bɛwɔ ɔ, nekaa bɔ ɛlɛen bɔ bɛfa tabɔnga bɛkã ɔ ngora berɛ kɔ ɔ, nekaa bɔ ɛlɛen mbiri koso bɛngora nu berɛ pɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is our judge and our ruler; the Lord is our king and will keep us safe.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE yeɛ ɔte yɛ ndɛenbualɛniɛ ɔ, AWURADE yeɛ ɔte yɛ mmeraahyɛlɛniɛ ɔ, AWURADE yeɛ ɔte yɛ hene ɔ, na ye yeɛ ɔkɔpepɛ kole yɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But your nation is a ship with its rigging loose, its mast shaky, and its sail not spread. Someday even you that are lame will take everything you want from your enemies.
translation_verse: Wɔ nyamaa ne anu agoho, ɔngora nzosɔ ɛlɛen bakaa ne anu pindinn, yeɛ ɔngora ndrɛtrɛ ɛlɛen frangaa ne anu. Bɛkɔhyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ pee bɔ banya ye ɔ, bubuafoɛ kɔfẽ nningyein bɛkɔfa.

english_verse: The Lord will forgive your sins, and none of you will say, “I feel sick.”
translation_verse: Maen baa biala ngɔhã kyɛ, “Mafokyɛ.” Na bɛ bɔ bɛte maen ne anu ne, bɛkɔfa b’amumuyɛɛ bɛkɔhyɛ bɛ.

english_verse: The Lord is terribly angry with the nations; he has condemned them to be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE afɛ maen maen amukoraa so yaa, ye ahone ahu b’ɛlɔen amukoraa, wanoma bɛ bɔkɔɔ, na waye bɛ wama ehunɛ.

english_verse: Their dead bodies will be left to rot and stink; their blood will flow down the mountains.
translation_verse: Bekofindi bɛ mmenia bɔ bekohu bɛ ne bekogua, bɛ fuin nemɔ kɔbo mvamva, bɛ mogya kɔtengyɛ wɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso.

english_verse: Each star will disappear— the sky will roll up like a scroll. Everything in the sky will dry up and wilt like leaves on a vine or fruit on a tree. Trouble for Edom
translation_verse: Anwuro abɔdeɛ amukoraa bekohuro, bɛkɔbobɔ ewienu kyɛ nwomaa, nu abɔdeɛ amukoraa bɛkɔporo bekogua, kyɛbɔ bobe nyaa poro gua ɔ, kyɛbɔ borɔdoma nyaa poro fi ye bakaa so gua ɔ.

english_verse: After the sword of the Lord has done what it wants to the skies above, it will come down on Edom, the nation that the Lord has doomed for destruction.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me ngrandɛ ne, wano wama ye ko ayi wɔ anwuro, na nea, ódwu ba Edom so, ódwu ba maen bɔ manoma ye ne aso ɔbabua ye ndɛen.

english_verse: The sword of the Lord is covered with blood from lambs and goats, together with fat from kidneys of rams. This is because the Lord will slaughter many people and make a sacrifice of them in the city of Bozrah and everywhere else in Edom.
translation_verse: Mogya ayɛ AWURADE ngrandɛ ne anwo takaa, ɛloe afɔrefɔre ye nwo, mmoaen mmaa mogya ne mbɔngye mogya wayɛ ngrandɛ ne anwo, mmoaen nyii mɔ, bɛ saa nwo loe wayɛ ye nwo, ofikyɛ AWURADE asiesie afɔleɛ wɔ Bosra, ɔne ehunɛ afɔleɛ kandinga wɔ Edom aseɛ so.

english_verse: Edom's leaders are wild oxen. They are powerful bulls, but they will die with the others. Their country will be soaked with their own blood, and its soil made fertile with their own fat.
translation_verse: Torɔen mɔ ne bɛ bɛkɔbɔ nu bɛkɔtotɔ, yeɛ nandwie ne nandwie nyii mbiri mɔ koso. Mogya kɔloa b’aseɛ ne aso takaa, na ɛloe kɔma bɛ nnɛterɛ ne kɔyɛ twɔfee.

english_verse: The Lord has chosen the year and the day, when he will take revenge and come to Zion's defense.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔte AWURADE wereɛtɔlɛ kyẽa, ɔne afoɛ bɔ ɔkɔma Sion kosa konya bɔ wafi ye sa ne ɔ.

english_verse: Edom's streams will turn into tar and its soil into sulfur— then the whole country will go up in flames.
translation_verse: Edom asue mmaa mmaa kɔkakyi amena pikaa, ye nnɛterɛ kɔkakyi sɔfe, na ye aseɛ ne kɔkakyi amena bɔ see la nu ogye ɔ.

english_verse: It will burn night and day and never stop smoking. Edom will be a desert, generation after generation; no one will ever travel through that land.
translation_verse: Kɔngɔen oo, eyia oo, ongonua, na ye nwosina kotu kɔhɔ anwuro afebɔɔ. Aseɛ ne kɔkakyi kurofoen fi aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ so kodwu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ so, na sona biala ngɔɔpɛ nu berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Owls, hawks, and wild animals will make it their home. God will leave it in ruins, merely a pile of rocks. The End of Edom
translation_verse: Ɔkɔyɛ akorɔma ne kɔtɔkɔ mɔ b’aseɛ, patue ne adene mɔ b’atenaleɛ. AWURADE kɔfa basabasayɔlɛ nyamaa kɔsã aseɛ ne aso, yeɛ ɔkɔfa kurofoen nyɔboɛ koguagua so.

english_verse: Edom will be called “Kingdom of Nothing.” Its rulers will also be nothing.
translation_verse: Na bɛkɔfrɛ berɛ kyɛ: Ahennie Biala Nne Berɛ, na ye mbanyi amukoraa bɛ boso komini.

english_verse: Its palaces and fortresses will be covered with thorns; only wolves and ostriches will make their home there.
translation_verse: Mmowue kofifi ye ahemvie nemɔ anu, yeɛ ndetema ne ɛfone kofifi ye abandenden nemɔ anu. Ɛserɛ so ngyea kole aseɛ ne kɔfa, na ɔkɔkakyi soholi mɔ b’atenaleɛ.

english_verse: Wildcats and hyenas will hunt together, demons will scream to demons, and creatures of the night will live among the ruins.
translation_verse: Ɛserɛ so ngaka aboyaa ne supɔ so ngaka aboyaa bekooyia berɛ, eburo abɔngye kosũ kɔfrɛ ye mmango wɔ berɛ, kɔngɔen patue kɔɔtena berɛ, na ɔkɔfa berɛ kɔyɛ ye nwomelelɛ atenaleɛ.

english_verse: Owls will nest there to raise their young among its shadows, while families of vultures circle around.
translation_verse: Berɛ yeɛ patue kɔnwo ye saen ɔ, ɔkɔto, ɔkɔhɔ abu, ɔkɔbobɔ, ɔkɔfa ye ndaa kobutu ye mma nemɔ aso, ɛkompɛtɛ mɔ kɔboa bɛ noa berɛ, ebiala ne obiɛngo.

english_verse: In The Book of the Lord you can search and find where it is written, “The Lord brought together all of his creatures by the power of his Spirit. Not one is missing.”
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔpena AWURADE nwomaa ne bɛ́kenga. Ɛhemɔ anu ko po ngomini, ebiala nne berɛ bɔ obiɛngo kɔhwere ye ɔ, ofikyɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne fi AWURADE noa nu, na ye Sunzum yeɛ waboaboa bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has decided where they each should live; they will be there forever, generation after generation.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ wahyehyɛ aseɛ ne anu wafa wama bɛ ɔ, ye sa afa nyamaa wahyehyɛ nu wama bɛ, bɛkɔfa bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ afebɔɔ, na bɛkɔtena so kofi aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ so kodwu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ so.

english_verse: Thirsty deserts will be glad; barren lands will celebrate and blossom with flowers.
translation_verse: Ɛserɛ so ne aseɛ katerepee ne, bɛ nye kɔgye, aseɛ pralaa ne koli ahurusi, na ɔkɔbɔ nyerɛen kyɛ sukooko.

english_verse: Deserts will bloom everywhere and sing joyful songs. They will be as majestic as Mount Lebanon, as glorious as Mount Carmel or Sharon Valley. Everyone will see the wonderful splendor of the Lord our God. God Changes Everything *
translation_verse: Ɔkɔbɔ nyerɛen pee, na ɔkɔfa anika kɔto dwein koli ahurusi. Bɛkɔfa Lebanon animnyam ne bɛkɔma ye, Kamɛl ne Saron nyemene ne, bɛ yeɛ bekonwu AWURADE animnyam ne, yɛ Nyameɛ tumi ne ɔ.

english_verse: Here is a message for all who are weak, trembling, and worried:
translation_verse: Asaa bɔ nu ayɛ bɛtɛɛ ne, ɛ́mɔma nu yɛ se, yeɛ nangoroma bɔ nu ayɛ hodwoo ne, ɛ́mɔmiamia nu.

english_verse: “Cheer up! Don't be afraid. Your God is coming to punish your enemies. God will take revenge on them and rescue you.”
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhã behyire bɛ bɔ ahunundetelɛ atɔ bɛ so ne kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔgyina pindinn, nnɛma ɛmɔsuro! Ɛ́mɔtie, ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ɔ́ba batɔ wereɛ! Nyameɛ bɔ ɔma ɛmɔ sa kã bɔ wafi ɛmɔ sa ne, ɔbaapepɛ de ɛmɔ ngoa.”

english_verse: The blind will see, and the ears of the deaf will be healed.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe kɔma anyesiniwaafoɛ bɛ nye kɔte, asotiniwaafoɛ bɛ so kɔte dwirɛ;

english_verse: Those who were lame will leap around like deer; tongues once silent will shout for joy. Water will rush through the desert.
translation_verse: bubuafoɛ bekohuruhuru kyɛ dabɔɔ, na emumu temverema kɔto ahurusi dwein. Ofikyɛ asue mɔ kopu kofi ɛserɛ so, yeɛ asue mmaa mmaa kopu kofi aseɛ pralaa so;

english_verse: Scorching sand will turn into a lake, and thirsty ground will flow with fountains. Grass will grow in deserts, where packs of wild dogs once made their home. God's Sacred Highway
translation_verse: anweaa futuu hyerɛhyerɛ kɔkakyi ɛkwaa, mbombonzue kopu kofi aseɛ katerepee so, na ɛserɛ so kyea ye atenaleɛ bɔ ɔda berɛ ne, nzenzaen ne elemmire ne ngyɛngyɛma kofifi berɛ.

english_verse: A good road will be there, and it will be named “God's Sacred Highway.” It will be for God's people; no one unfit to worship God will walk on that road. And no fools can travel on that highway.
translation_verse: Atimbire kɔɔla berɛ, na bɛkɔto ye dumaa Atee Krongron. Sona bɔ ye nwo nde ne, ɔngɔfa so bie, atee ne kɔyɛ Nyameɛ mmenia bɛ deɛ, na ngwaseafoɛ po bengomini wɔ atee ne aso.

english_verse: No lions or other wild animals will come near that road; only those the Lord has saved will travel there.
translation_verse: Gyata biala ngɔwa berɛ, yeɛ kaka aboyaa biala ngɔpe so, bengonwu bie wɔ berɛ, na mmom bɛ bɔ Nyameɛ apepɛ ale bɛ ne yeɛ bɛkɔfa so ɔ.

english_verse: The people the Lord has rescued will come back singing as they enter Zion. Happiness will be a crown everyone will always wear. They will celebrate and shout because all sorrows and worries will be gone far away.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ AWURADE apɔ bɛ wafi ngoaasolɛ nu ne, bekosa bɛkɔwa, bɛkɔfa edweintolɛ yeɛ bɛkɔwa Sion ɔ, bekonya anigye bɔ olle ayieleɛ ɔ, bɛ nye kɔgye, bekoli ahurusi, na aworabɔlɛ ne yealɛlilɛ kotu komini.

english_verse: Hezekiah claims the Lord will save you. But don't be fooled by him. Were any other gods able to defend their land against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma Hesekia lakalaka ɛmɔ kyɛ, ‘AWURADE kɔpepɛ kole yɛ!’ Maen maen mɔ bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ, aso bɛ nu bie wahora wale ye aseɛ wafi Asiria hene sa nu le?

english_verse: Then, in a voice loud enough for everyone to hear, he shouted out in Hebrew: Listen to what the great king of Assyria says!
translation_verse: Yeɛ safohene ne dwɔsole teane nu serɛserɛ wɔ Yuda dwudwolɛ nu kyɛ, “Asiria hene bɔ ɔte ɛhene bɔ odi mu paa ne, ɛ́mɔtie ye noa dwirɛ oo!

english_verse: What happened to the gods of Hamath, Arpad, and Sepharvaim? Were the gods of Samaria able to protect their land against the Assyrian forces?
translation_verse: Hamate ne Apade nyameɛ nemɔ, bɛwɔ ni? Sefawim nyameɛ nemɔ, bɛwɔ ni? Bahora bapepɛ bale Samaria bafi me sa nu anaa?

english_verse: Don't be fooled by Hezekiah. He can't save you.
translation_verse: Nana nwa nyoo: Nnɛmɔma Hesekia lakalaka ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɔngɔhora ngɔpepɛ ngole ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Three of the king's highest officials came out of Jerusalem to meet him. One of them was Hilkiah's son Eliakim, who was the prime minister. The other two were Shebna, assistant to the prime minister, and Joah son of Asaph, keeper of the government records.
translation_verse: Na Hilkia awa Eliakim bɔ ɔnea ahemvie berɛ ne, ɔne ahyerɛlɛniɛ Sebena, yeɛ Asafe awa Yoa bɔ ɔte abakɔsɛm ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne, beeyiale ye.

english_verse: The Assyrian commander told them: I have a message for Hezekiah from the great king of Assyria. Ask Hezekiah why he feels so sure of himself.
translation_verse: Yeɛ safohene ne sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhã behyire Hesekia kyɛ, Asiria hene bɔ ɔte ɛhene bɔ odi mu paa ne, obisa wɔ kyɛ: Nzikyɛ yeɛ afa wɔ nwo ato so bɔ wamaa asi wɔ hue sɔaa e?

english_verse: Does he think he can plan and win a war with nothing but words? Who is going to help him, now that he has turned against the king of Assyria?
translation_verse: Ɛnwa nzɛ bɛ noa mbaen yeɛ bɛfa bɛko koɛ ɔ? Nwa yeɛ afa wɔ nwo ato ye so bɔ yiti ayɛ me nwo lɔen e?

english_verse: Is he depending on Egypt and its king? That's the same as leaning on a broken stick, and it will go right through his hand.
translation_verse: Tie, Misraim bɔ afa wɔ nwo ato ye so ne, ɔte pɔmaa bɔ onzo ɔ, na ebiala bɔ okokisa ye ne, okobu kɔwɔ ye sa nu. Sɔ yeɛ Misraim hene Faro ɔfa di ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa ye nwo kɔto ye so ɔ.

english_verse: Is Hezekiah now depending on the Lord, your God? Didn't Hezekiah tear down all except one of the Lord's altars and places of worship? Didn't he tell the people of Jerusalem and Judah to worship at that one place?
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔkã bekyire me kyɛ: Yafa yɛ nwo yato AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ so a, aso nna ye asɔneyɛɛ mɔ ne afɔleɛ mmokyea yeɛ Hesekia wabubu bɛ ye? Aso Hesekia wanga wangyire Yuda ne Yerusalem kyɛ, ‘Afɔleɛ bokyea he, so yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔsɔne ɔ’?

english_verse: The king of Assyria wants to make a bet with you people! He will give you
translation_verse: Yiti bra ná ɛne me mene Asiria hene bɛyɛ nhyehyɛleɛ. Sɛ ekonya mbɔngɔ mɔ nwo pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ a, ahaa ngɔma wɔ mbɔngɔ apee nyɔ.

english_verse: How could you even defeat our lowest ranking officer, when you have to depend on Egypt for chariots and cavalry?
translation_verse: Me mene ye safohene mmaa mmaa nemɔ po, ɛyɛ sɛɛ né ahora agyina bɛ nu ko po nyunu, wɔ aberɛ bɔ Misraim teaseɛnam mɔ ne pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ yeɛ afa wɔ nwo ato bɛ so ɔ?

english_verse: Don't forget that it was the Lord who sent me here with orders to destroy your nation!
translation_verse: Afei koso, aso nna AWURADE yeɛ wagyina me si kyɛ mva koɛ mandoa maen ye ná nzɛkye ye ɔ? AWURADE sele me kyɛ, ‘Fa koɛ kɔteta maen he ná sɛkye ye.’ ”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said, “Sir, we don't want the people listening from the city wall to understand what you are saying. So please speak to us in Aramaic instead of Hebrew.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Eliakim, Sebena ne Yoa besele safohene ne kyɛ, “Wɔ ngoaa, yɛsrɛ wɔ, kã edwirɛ ne kyire yɛ wɔ Aramaeke dwudwolɛ nu, ofikyɛ yɛte Aramaeke. Nnɛdwudwo kyire yɛ wɔ Yuda dwudwolɛ nu, ofikyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛwɔ fasue ne aso ne, bɛkɔte bɔ ɛkã ne.”

english_verse: The Assyrian army commander answered, “My king sent me to speak to everyone, not just to you leaders. These people will soon have to eat their own body waste and drink their own urine! And so will the three of you!”
translation_verse: Nakoso safohene ne sele kyɛ, “Aso ɛne wɔ mene angome ti yeɛ me mene somane me kyɛ mmra manga edwirɛ he ɔ? Mmenia bɔ bɛtete fasue ne aso ne, bɛboka so, ofikyɛ bɛ koso edwirɛ kɔto bɛ maa bekoli bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ bondua ná bano bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ mmien kyɛ ɛmɔ ala.”

english_verse: Don't trust him when he tells you that the Lord will protect you from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma Hesekia lakalaka ɛmɔ maa ɛmɔfa bɛ nwo bɛto AWURADE so, maa ɛmɔkã kyɛ, ‘Amba, AWURADE kɔpepɛ kole yɛ, na ɔngɔfa sɔ kuro ye ngowura Asiria hene sa.’

english_verse: Stop listening to Hezekiah. Pay attention to my king. Surrender to him. He will let you keep your own vineyards, fig trees, and cisterns
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔtɛ Hesekia so, ofikyɛ Asiria hene nwa: Ɛ́mɔfite bɛbra beeli ɛmɔ ti dwirɛ wɔ me berɛ. Ɔba ye sɔ a, ɛmɔ nu biala konya ye bɔbɔ ye bobe ne ye borɔdoma koli, na okonya ye bɔbɔ ye abura nu nzue kɔno,

english_verse: for a while. Then he will come and take you away to a country just like yours, where you can plant vineyards and raise your own grain.
translation_verse: kɔpem kyɛ ngɔwa ngɔɔsesa ɛmɔ ngɔhɔ aseɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ ye ala so ɔ. Aseɛ bɔ aburoo ne nzaa, aleɛ ne bobe boo mɔ bɛwɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: None of those gods kept their people safe from the king of Assyria. Do you think the Lord, your God, can do any better?
translation_verse: Maen maen hemɔ bɛ nyameɛ nemɔ amukoraa, bɛ nu beni yeɛ wahora wapepɛ wale ye maen wafi me sa nu, bɔ yiti yeɛ AWURADE kɔpepɛ kole Yerusalem kofi me sa nu ɔ.”

english_verse: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah had been warned by King Hezekiah not to answer the Assyrian commander. So they tore their clothes in sorrow and reported to Hezekiah everything the commander had said.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Hilkia awa Eliakim bɔ ɔnea ahemvie berɛ ne, ahyerɛlɛniɛ Sebena, yeɛ Asafe awa Yoa bɔ ɔte abakɔsɛm ahyerɛlɛniɛ ne, besunzuale bɛ ndaadeɛ nu, na bɛhɔle Hesekia berɛ bɛɛfale safohene ne dwirɛ ne bɛbɔle ye amaneɛ.

english_verse: As soon as Hezekiah heard the news, he tore off his clothes in sorrow and put on sackcloth. Then he went into the temple of the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ɔwale kyɛ, Nana Hesekia tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, osunzuale ye bɔbɔ ye ndaadeɛ nu, ɔherale ɛsɛen tena, na ɔhɔle AWURADE awuro berɛ.

english_verse: The kings of Hamath, Arpad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivvah have all disappeared. Hezekiah Prays (
translation_verse: Hamate hene, Apade hene, kuro Sefawim hene, Hena hene, yeɛ Yiwa hene, bɛwɔ nisua?’ ” Hesekia mbaeɛ

english_verse: Isaiah, these are difficult and disgraceful times. Our nation is like a woman too weak to give birth, when it's time for her baby to be born.
translation_verse: Na besele ye kyɛ, “Hesekia nwa: ‘Ɛnɛ te aworabɔlɛ kyẽa, asohwenɛ ne animguaseɛ kyẽa. Mmrasua afo aworɛ so, nakoso bennya anwoserɛ bɛmva bɛndwe bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Please pray for those of us who are left alive. The king of Assyria sent his army commander to insult the living God. Perhaps the Lord heard what he said and will do something, if you will pray.
translation_verse: Safohene ne, edwirɛ bɔ ye mene Asiria hene wafa wasoma ye, kyɛ ɔfa ɔɔgoro Nyameɛ teasefoɛ nwo ne, ebiaa AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ wate. Na AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ kɔhwe ye so wɔ edwirɛ bɔ wate ne anwo. Yiti bɔ mbaeɛ bɔ nu yɛ se ɔ ma yɛ bɔ yaha ne.’ ”

english_verse: When these leaders came to me,
translation_verse: Na Hesekia mbanyi nemɔ hɔle Yesaya berɛ ne,

english_verse: I told them that the Lord had this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord. Don't worry about the insulting things that have been said about me by these messengers from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Yesaya sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhã behyire ɛmɔ mene kyɛ, ‘AWURADE nwa: Musue dwirɛ bɔ Asiria hene ye mbanyi mɔ bahã batia me maa ate ne, nnɛmaa wɔ kunu tete wɔ wɔ ye nwo.

english_verse: I will upset him with rumors about what's happening in his own country. He will go back, and there I will make him die a violent death.
translation_verse: Tie, ngɔfa sunzum bie ngowura ye nu. Ngɔmaa ɔkɔte ngraa bie bɔ ɔnate so okosa ye si kɔhɔ ye kuro ɔ. Na ngɔmaa ɔkɔtɔ ngrandɛ noa wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye maen nu.’ ” Asiria nwunanwuna Yuda bieku (

english_verse: Meanwhile the commander of the Assyrian forces heard that his king had left the town of Lachish and was now attacking Libnah. So he went there.
translation_verse: Afei safohene ne tele kyɛ Asiria hene wafi Lakise. Yiti osale ye si hɔle, na onwuni kyɛ Asiria hene wafa koɛ waateta Libina.

english_verse: About this same time, the king of Assyria learned that King Tirhakah of Ethiopia was on his way to attack him. Then the king of Assyria sent some messengers with this note for Hezekiah:
translation_verse: Na Asiria hene tele edwirɛ fale Yitiopia hene Tihaka nwo kyɛ, “Ɔbaafa koɛ toa wɔ.” Na ɔtele ne, otuli ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ maa bɛhɔle Hesekia berɛ besele ye kyɛ,

english_verse: Don't trust your God or be fooled by his promise to defend Jerusalem against me.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔhã behyire Yuda hene Hesekia kyɛ, ‘Wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ afa wɔ nwo ato ye so ne, nnɛmaa ɔlakalaka wɔ, ná ɔhyɛ wɔ bɔ kyɛ ɔngɔfa Yerusalem ngowura Asiria hene sa.

english_verse: You have heard how we Assyrian kings have completely wiped out other nations. What makes you feel so safe?
translation_verse: Tie! Naa ate bɔ Asiria ahemvo mɔ bafa bayɛ maen maen amukoraa ɔ? Ate kyɛ bahuhu bɛ pasaa ɔ? Aso ebie kɔpepɛ kole wɔ anaa?

english_verse: The Assyrian kings before me destroyed the towns of Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and everyone from Eden who lived in Telassar. What good did their gods do them?
translation_verse: Maen maen mɔ bɔ me nana mɔ bɛbɔle bɛ pasaa, bɔ bɛ ole: Gosan, Haran ne Resefe ne Edenfoɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ Telasa ne, aso sɔ maen nemɔ bɛ nyameɛ mɔ bɛhora bɛpepɛ belele bɛ?

english_verse: After Hezekiah had read the note from the king of Assyria, he took it to the temple and spread it out for the Lord to see.
translation_verse: Hesekia sa hane krataa ne fili ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ berɛ, na ɔkengale. Afei ɔfo hɔle AWURADE awuro berɛ, na ɔtrɛle krataa ne anu wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: Lord God All-Powerful of Israel, your throne is above the winged creatures. You created the heavens and the earth, and you alone rule the kingdoms of this world.
translation_verse: “Ao Asafo AWURADE, Yisrael Nyameɛ bɔ ɛte kɛrubim mɔ b’afia ɔ, aseɛ so ahennie amukoraati nu, wɔ ngome yeɛ ɛte Nyameɛ ɔ. Wɔ yeɛ ɛbɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ɔ.

english_verse: It is true, our Lord, that Assyrian kings have turned nations into deserts.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ɔte amba kyɛ Asiria ahemvo mɔ basɛkye maen maen mɔ ne b’aseɛ bɔkɔɔ,

english_verse: As surely as I am the Lord, he will return by the way he came and will never enter Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Atee bɔ ɔfale so wale ne, sɔ atee ne ala yeɛ okosa kɔfa so kɔhɔ ɔ. AWURADE nwa Asiria hene ngowura kuro ne anu.

english_verse: I went to Hezekiah and told him that the Lord God of Israel had said: Hezekiah, you prayed to me about King Sennacherib of Assyria. Now this is what I say to that king: The people of Jerusalem hate and make fun of you; they laugh behind your back.
translation_verse: edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE ahã afa ye nwo ɛhe: “ ‘Sion awa brasua ababunu ne, obu wɔ animtia, yeɛ ɔgoro wɔ nwo; Yerusalem awa brasua ne, ɔsere wɔ ɔbɔ wɔ tutue odi wɔ si.

english_verse: You let your officials insult me, the Lord. And here is what you have said about yourself, “I led my chariots to the highest heights of Lebanon's mountains. I went deep into its forest, cutting down the best cedar and cypress trees.
translation_verse: Ɛnate wɔ somvoɛ mɔ so agoro AWURADE nwo, na ahã kyɛ, Mafa me teaseɛnam pee nemɔ mafo mahɔ mmokaa nemɔ bɛ ti afia, mahɔ Lebanon ɛhɔayeɛ ne anu dɔ paa. Ye sida ndendenn paa nemɔ, ɔne ye ɛframmire nyemenenyemene nemɔ, mabubu bɛ magua. Mahɔ bokaa ne ti afia dɔ paa, ɔne ye ɛhɔayeɛ too ne anu.

english_verse: I dried up every stream in the land of Egypt, and I drank water from wells I had dug.”
translation_verse: Matutu abura mɔ, na mano bɛ nu nzue, Misraim asue amukoraa bɔ me gya atia nu ne, mamaa bawewe.

english_verse: Sennacherib, now listen to me, the Lord. I planned all of this long ago. And you don't even know that I alone am the one who decided that you would do these things. I let you make ruins of fortified cities.
translation_verse: “ ‘Aso ande, kyɛ sɔ dwirɛ ne, ndwenene ye nwo ahyɛ ɔ? Ofi tetetete yeɛ nikyee bɔ meyɔ ye kekesaala ye ne nhyehyɛ ndole berɛ ɔ, kyɛ nguro bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue nemɔ, odi kyɛ ɛsɛkye bɛ maa bɛkakyi kurofoen ɔ.

english_verse: Their people became weak, terribly confused. They were like wild flowers or like tender young grass growing on a flat roof or like a field of grain before it matures.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, so ama nemɔ b’anwoserɛ te kãa, besuro, na bɛ nyunu agua ase; bakakyi kyɛ eburo ndire, bɛyɛ mmerɛ kyɛ ɛserɛ bɔ wafifi foforɛ ɔ, bayɛ kyɛ ndire bɔ wafifi wɔ sua so anwuro, bɔ ɔkese ná onnyi ɔ.

english_verse: I know all about you, even how fiercely angry you are with me.
translation_verse: “ ‘Mese w’asetena nu dwirɛ, wɔ hɔlɛ ne wɔ walɛ, ɔne wɔ yaa piri bɔ afɛ ye me so ne.

english_verse: I have seen your pride and the tremendous hatred you have for me. Now I will put a hook in your nose, a bit in your mouth, then I will send you back to where you came from.
translation_verse: Ɔnate wɔ yaa piri bɔ afɛ ye me so, ɔne w’anwomasoɛ bɔ mate ne ati, ngɔfa me koaa ne ngosina wɔ bonyi anu, ná matofi wɔ noa nu mafa me nyamaa mawura nu; na atee bɔ ɛfale so wale ne, ngɔmaa ɛkɔkakyi wɔ nwo ɛkɔfa so ekosa kɔhɔ.’

english_verse: Hezekiah, I will tell you what's going to happen. This year you will eat crops that grow on their own, and the next year you will eat whatever springs up where those crops grew. But the third year, you will plant grain and vineyards, and you will eat what you harvest.
translation_verse: “Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ kɔma wɔ ɔ: Afoɛ he, ɛmɔkoli aleɛ bɔ ye bɔbɔ wafifi wɔ aseɛ ne aso ɔ. Afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne, ɛmɔkoli aleɛ bɔ okofifi ye si ne. Na afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne, ɛmɔkolua nningyein, ná ɛmɔafa so aleɛ; ɛmɔkolua bobe, na ɛmɔkoli so mmaa.

english_verse: Those who survive in Judah will be like a vine that puts down deep roots and bears fruit.
translation_verse: Na Yuda awuro ama bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ne, bɛ bo kosa kotira ndii, ná basu mmaa wɔ anwuro.

english_verse: I promise that the king of Assyria won't get into Jerusalem, or shoot an arrow into the city, or even surround it and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: “Yiti bɔ AWURADE kã fa Asiria hene nwo ɛhe: Ongowura kuro he anu, ɔngɔto agyaen wɔ nu, ɔngɔfa akokyɛm ngɔwa kuro ne nyunu, yeɛ ongotua kuro ye.

english_verse: After this, King Sennacherib went back to Assyria and lived in the city of Nineveh.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Asiria hene Senakeribo fili berɛ hɔle. Osa hɔle ɔɔtenane Ninewe.

english_verse: One day he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, when his sons, Adrammelech and Sharezer, killed him with their swords. They escaped to the land of Ararat, and his son Esarhaddon became king.
translation_verse: Na ɔwale kyɛ, mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɔne wɔ ye nyameɛ Nisroke asɔneyɛɛ so ne, ye mma mmienzua Adramelɛke ne Saresa bɛfale ngrandɛ behuni ye, na bɛnwati bɛhɔle Ararate aseɛ so. Na ɔwa bienzua Esa Hadon lili ye bia.

english_verse: Hezekiah turned toward the wall and prayed,
translation_verse: Yeɛ Hesekia fale ye nye hyirele terɛ bɔle mbaeɛ hyirele AWURADE kyɛ,

english_verse: You, Lord, will save me, and every day that we live we will sing in your temple to the music of stringed instruments. Isaiah's Advice to Hezekiah
translation_verse: AWURADE kole me ngoa, na yɛkɔbɔ sangoo yɛkɔto dwein mmerɛ biala bɔ yɛte ase ɔ wɔ AWURADE awuro.

english_verse: About this time, Hezekiah got sick and was almost dead. So I went in and told him, “The Lord says you won't ever get well. You are going to die, and so you had better start doing what needs to be done.”
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, anwonyerɛ bɔle Hesekia bɔ né ɔla awusu ɔ. Na ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya bɔ ye baba ole Amoso ne, ɔwale Hesekia berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, “AWURADE nwa nyoo: Toto wɔ si yé, ofikyɛ ɛbaawu, na ɛngɔte apɔ.”

english_verse: I thought I would never again see you, my Lord, or any of the people who live on this earth.
translation_verse: Ngane kyɛ, Mengonwu AWURADE ko wɔ ateasefoɛ aseɛ so; mengonwu sona ko wɔ mmenia bɔ bɛte wiase ɔ nu.

english_verse: “Don't forget that I have been faithful to you, Lord. I have obeyed you with all my heart, and I do whatever you say is right.” After this, he cried hard.
translation_verse: “Ao AWURADE, mesrɛ wɔ ala, fa wɔ nye to kyɛbɔ mafa m’ahone amukoraa mali wɔ dwirɛ so nahorɛ nu, ɔne kyɛbɔ mayɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ wɔ wɔ nyunu ne.” Na Hesekia suni hahii.

english_verse: Then the Lord sent me
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Yesaya kyɛ,

english_verse: with this message for Hezekiah: I am the Lord God, who was worshiped by your ancestor David. I heard you pray, and I saw you cry. I will let you live
translation_verse: “Kɔhã kyire Hesekia kyɛ, AWURADE, wɔ nana Dawide ye Nyameɛ ne, ɔnwa nyoo: Matie wɔ mbaeɛ ne, na manwu ɛmoen bɔ ɛporo ne. Tie, ngɔto wɔ ngoa nu afoɛ buru ne nnu.

english_verse: There's nothing I can say in answer to you, since you are the one who has done this to me. My life has turned sour; I will limp until I die.
translation_verse: Nakoso nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ mékã ɔ? Ofikyɛ wahã wahyire me, na ye bɔbɔ deinn yeɛ wayɔ sɔ ɔ. M’afoɛ amukoraa bɔ medi ne, me kra di aworabɔlɛ.

english_verse: while I protect you and your city from the king of Assyria.
translation_verse: Ngɔpepɛ ngole wɔ ne kuro he ngofi Asiria hene sa nu, na ngɔbɔ kuro ye anwo waen.
