english_verse: Now I will prove to you that I will keep my promise.
translation_verse: “Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ ofi AWURADE ɔ, bɔ okyire kyɛ AWURADE kɔyɔ edwirɛ bɔ wahã ne ɔ:

english_verse: Do you see the shadow made by the setting sun on the stairway built for King Ahaz? I will make the shadow go back ten steps. Then the shadow went back ten steps. King Hezekiah's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Tie, eyia bɔ ɔkwaatɔ ne, wawoɛ bɔ wamaa waatɔ Ahase atweleɛ ne aso ne, ngɔmaa okosa ye si mmerɛ nu ngyɛmuɛ buru.” Yiti wawoɛ ne sale ye si mmerɛ nu ngyɛmuɛ buru bɔ né watra ɔkwaatɔ ɔ. Hesekia ayɛyelɛ dwein

english_verse: This is what Hezekiah wrote after he got well:
translation_verse: Anwonyerɛ bɔle Yuda hene Hesekia, ná afei ye nwo sandene ye ne, edwirɛ bɔ ɔhyerɛle ɛhe:

english_verse: I thought I would die during my best years and stay as a prisoner forever in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ me ngoa hale kaaba bie ne, ngane kyɛ: Mebaafi wa, mebaahɔ ɛborɔ dɔ pambim ne anu, m’afoɛ bɔ waha ne, béde béfi me sa nu.

english_verse: My life was taken from me like the tent that a shepherd pulls up and moves. You cut me off like thread from a weaver's loom; you make a wreck of me day and night.
translation_verse: Batutu m’atenaleɛ ne abo bafi me nwo bahɔ, kyɛ mmoaenneafoɛ ɛtena sua; kyɛbɔ sona bɔ ɔnwo ɛtena ɔ ɔyɔ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ mabobɔ me ngoa o; wate me wafi bakaa bɔ bɛnwo ɛtena wɔ so ne anwo; na ɛma me ngoa ohi fi alehyeleɛ kodwu alesaleɛ.

english_verse: Until morning came, I thought you would crush my bones just like a hungry lion; both night and day you make a wreck of me.
translation_verse: Mesu mepena mmokalɛ alaa kodwu ngyerɛmɔ; obubu me mmowue mukoraa nu kyɛ gyata; ɛma me ngoa ohi fi alehyeleɛ kodwu alesaleɛ.

english_verse: I cry like a swallow; I mourn like a dove. My eyes are red from looking to you, Lord. I am in terrible trouble. Please come and help me.
translation_verse: Mesu meteatea nu kyɛ nandwinoma anaa bɔlanoma, mepene kyɛ abubure. Mepagya me nye menea anwuro toonn ma me nye mmaa yɛ mmosonoo. O AWURADE, mali amia, pepɛ de me!

english_verse: Your words and your deeds bring life to everyone, including me. Please make me healthy and strong again.
translation_verse: O AWURADE, sɔ atee ne yeɛ mmenia bɛnate so bɛtena ase ɔ, na ɛhemɔ amukoraa nu yeɛ me kra ye ngoa wɔ ɔ, nzaade, ma me nwo ɔsande me, ná maa nza nya ngoa.

english_verse: It was for my own good that I had such hard times. But your love protected me from doom in the deep pit, and you turned your eyes away from my sins.
translation_verse: Amba, me yeeyɛlɛ ti yeɛ nwuni amaneɛ piri ɔ. Ɛnate wɔ ɔdɔ so aye me kra afi ewue kumaa nu, ofikyɛ agyi me bɔne amukoraa agua wɔ si dɔ.

english_verse: No one in the world of the dead can thank you or praise you; none of those in the deep pit can hope for you to show them how faithful you are.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ ɛborɔ ngɔhora ngɔla wɔ ase, ewue ngɔhora ngɔye wɔ ayɛ, bɛ bɔ bahɔ ewue kumaa nu ne, bɛngɔhora bengonya wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne nwo anyelasoɛ.

english_verse: Only the living can thank you, as I am doing today. Each generation tells the next about your faithfulness.
translation_verse: Ateasefoɛ, ateasefoɛ yeɛ bɛda wɔ ase ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɛnɛ meda wɔ ase ye; baba yeɛ okyire mmaa wɔ nahorɛlilɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: I had told King Hezekiah's servants to put some mashed figs on the king's open sore, and he would get well.
translation_verse: Né Yesaya wali moa wahã kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfa borɔdoma bɔ babɔ ye kunguma ɔ bɛɛyɛ mbɔmbɔ ne aso, na ɔkɔte apɔ.”

english_verse: Then Hezekiah asked for proof that he would again worship in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Né Hesekia abisa kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ yeɛ okyire kyɛ ngɔhɔ AWURADE awuro ne anu ɔ?”

english_verse: Hezekiah welcomed the messengers and showed them all the silver, the gold, the spices, and the fine oils that were in his storehouse. He even showed them where he kept his weapons. Nothing in his palace or in his entire kingdom was kept hidden from them.
translation_verse: Hesekia lele ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ nyemene so, na ye sua bɔ osie nningyein hemɔ amukoraa nu ne, obukye maa bɛneane nu: ɛdwetɛ, esikaa kɔkorɛ, ayirefona ne ngoo paa; ye koɛhonɛ nningyein amukoraa sua, yeɛ nningyein amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ ye sua mɔ bɔ osie nningyein nu ne koso, obukyebukye hyirele bɛ. Na nikye fee nne Hesekia ahemvie berɛ anaa ye ahennie ne anu amukoraa bɔ wamva wangyire bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Merodach Baladan, the son of Baladan, was now king of Babylonia. And when he learned that Hezekiah was well, he sent messengers with letters and a gift for him.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, Babilɔn hene Merodake Baladan bɔ ye baba ole Baladan ne, otuli ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ fale krataa ne akyɛdeɛ maa bɛɛmane Hesekia, ofikyɛ né wate kyɛ anwonyerɛ abɔ Hesekia ná afei wate apɔ.

english_verse: I asked Hezekiah, “Where did these men come from? What did they want?” “They came all the way from Babylonia,” Hezekiah answered.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya hɔle Nana Hesekia berɛ oobisale ye kyɛ, “Mmenia hemɔ b’amaneɛ, na befi nisua yeɛ bɛwale wɔ berɛ ɔ?” Na Hesekia buale kyɛ, “Befi maen bie anu dedeede yeɛ bawa me wa ɔ. Befi Babilɔn.”

english_verse: Then I told Hezekiah: I have a message for you from the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesaya sele Hesekia kyɛ, “Tie Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ:

english_verse: One day everything you and your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylonia. The Lord has promised that nothing will be left.
translation_verse: Tie, nningyein bɔ ɔwɔ w’ahemvie wa, ɔne agyapadeɛ bɔ wɔ nana mɔ bapena bagua berɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ ye, mmerɛ bie baawa bɔ bɛkɔsoa ye mukoraa bɛkɔhɔ Babilɔn ɔ. AWURADE nwa nyoo, bɛngɔyakyi nikye fee wa.

english_verse: Some of your own sons will be taken to Babylonia, where they will be disgraced and made to serve in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔsesa wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ mma bɔ awo bɛ ne biemɔ bɛkɔhɔ, na bɛkɔyɛ sayɛɛ wɔ Babilɔn hene ahemvie.”

english_verse: Hezekiah thought, “At least our nation will be at peace for a while.” So he told me, “The message you brought from the Lord is good.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Hesekia sele Yesaya kyɛ, “AWURADE noa dwirɛ bɔ ahã ne, ɔte paa.” Ɔhane sɔ, ofikyɛ onyane adwene kyɛ, “M’aberɛ so, maen ne konya asomdwee, na nu kodwo fɔnwoo.”

english_verse: Our God has said: “Encourage my people! Give them comfort.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, “Ɛ́mɔkyekye, ɛ́mɔkyekye me maen wora.

english_verse: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and announce: Your slavery is past; your punishment is over. I, the Lord, made you pay double for your sins.”
translation_verse: Kã aworakyekyerɛ dwirɛ kyire Yerusalem, ná bɔ ye dawure kyire ye, kyɛ ye ngoaasolɛ mmerɛ ne wawa ayieleɛ, kyɛ mafa ye amumuyɛɛ ne mahyɛ ye; ofikyɛ ye bɔne ne, wanya ye mukoraa nwo akatuaa mmɔhoɛ nyɔ wafi AWURADE berɛ.”

english_verse: Someone is shouting: “Clear a path in the desert! Make a straight road for the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Ebie tea nu wɔ ɛserɛ so kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔbɔ AWURADE atee bɛ́to berɛ, ɛ́mɔpakye atimbire bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ wɔ aseɛ pralaa so bɛ́ma yɛ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Fill in the valleys; flatten every hill and mountain. Level the rough and rugged ground.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtuatua bɔnza biala, ɛ́mɔdwiri mmokaa ne pambaa biala maa ɔbra ase, ɛ́mɔtengyɛ atee kondonowaa ne ma ɔtengyɛ, ná ɛ́mɔtuatua mmɔnga mmɔnga nemɔ ma ɔla so.

english_verse: Then the glory of the Lord will appear for all to see. The Lord has promised this!”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE animnyam ne kɔla ali, na anwoɔnaen amukoraa kɔbɔ nu konwu ye, ofikyɛ AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: Someone told me to shout, and I asked, “What should I shout?” We humans are merely grass, and we last no longer than wild flowers.
translation_verse: Komviɛ bie nwa, “Tea nu kã!” Na mmisale kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ ndea nu nga ɔ?” Anwoɔnaen biala te ndire, na ye anwonyemene amukoraa te kyɛ nyerɛen bɔ ɔwɔ eburo ɔ.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, flowers and grass disappear, and so do we.
translation_verse: Ndire kese, yeɛ nyerɛen ye nyemene koso otu, ofikyɛ AWURADE nwomeɛ otu fa so. Amba, sona te ndire.

english_verse: Flowers and grass fade away, but what our God has said will never change. Your God Is Here!
translation_verse: Ndire kese, yeɛ nyerɛen nyemene koso otu, nakoso yɛ Nyameɛ dwirɛ de, otimu berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: There is good news for the city of Zion. Shout it as loud as you can from the highest mountain. Don't be afraid to shout to the towns of Judah: “Your God is here!”
translation_verse: O Sion bɔ ɛso ndɛenvɛen ɔ, fo kɔ bokaa tendenn ne aso; O Yerusalem bɔ ɛso ndɛenvɛen ɔ, tea nu kã ye serɛserɛ, tea nu kã, na nnɛsuro. Kã kyire Yuda nguro nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtie, ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ne ɛhe!”

english_verse: Look! The powerful Lord God is coming to rule with his mighty arm. He brings with him what he has taken in war, and he rewards his people.
translation_verse: Nea, AWURADE Nyameɛ le tumi ɔ́ba, ye tumi asaa ne yeɛ ɔfa di hene ɔ, tie, otira ye akatuaa, yoo, ye akatuaa li ye nyunu.

english_verse: The Lord cares for his nation, just as shepherds care for their flocks. He carries the lambs in his arms, while gently leading the mother sheep. Who Compares with God?
translation_verse: Ɔkɔma ye mmoaen nemɔ aleɛ kyɛ mmoaenneafoɛ, ɔkɔfa ye sa kɔboaboa ye mmoaen mmaa nemɔ noa, ɔkɔfa bɛ kɔbɔ ye hue so, na okoli mmoaen mmrataen nemɔ anyunu ngaka ngaka.

english_verse: Did any of you measure the ocean by yourself or stretch out the sky with your own hands? Did you put the soil of the earth in a bucket or weigh the hills and mountains on balance scales?
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ wabɔ ye sa nonongu wasusu ɛpo nzue ɔ, anaa wafa ye sa mmɛseka wasusu ewienu ɔ, anaa wafa kwangoa wasusu aseɛ so mvuture ɔ, anaa wafa tonyi wahari mmokaa mɔ ɔ, anaa wafa asusudeɛ wahari pambaa mɔ ɔ?

english_verse: Has anyone told the Lord what he must do or given him advice?
translation_verse: Aso ebie ahyire bɔ odi kyɛ AWURADE Sunzum yɔ ɔ, anaa nwa yeɛ ɔte ye foɛtulɛniɛ bɔ otu ye foɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Did the Lord ask anyone to teach him wisdom and justice? Who gave him knowledge and understanding?
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ Nyameɛ ne ye baatu agyina wapena adwene ɔ, nwa yeɛ ohyirele ye pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ atee ne ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ohyirele ye nimdeɛ ɔ, nwa yeɛ ohyirele ye ndeaseɛ atee ne ɔ?

english_verse: To the Lord, all nations are merely a drop in a bucket or dust on balance scales; all of the islands are but a handful of sand.
translation_verse: Tie, maen maen mɔ bɛte kyɛ nzue bɔ wape bokiti nu ko ɔ, bɛte kyɛ mvuture kaaba bie bɔ ɔla tonyi so ɔ. Tie, otira supɔ mɔ wɔ ye sa nu kyɛ mvuture kaaba bie.

english_verse: The cattle on the mountains of Lebanon would not be enough to offer as a sacrifice to God, and the trees would not be enough for the fire.
translation_verse: Lebanon mmakaa ngɔso afɔleɛ see sɔ, yeɛ nu ngaka koso ngɔso naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ.

english_verse: God thinks of the nations as far less than nothing.
translation_verse: AWURADE nyunu de, maen maen mukoraa bɛtte huu, obu bɛ kyɛ nikyee mbaen bie bɔ bɛtte hwee ɔ.

english_verse: Who compares with God? Is anything like him?
translation_verse: Nwa nwo yeɛ ɛmɔkɔfa Nyameɛ bɛkɔto ɔ, anaakyɛ nzikyɛ sue yeɛ ɛmɔkɔfa bɛkɔtoto ye nwo ɔ?

english_verse: Is an idol at all like God? It is made of bronze with a thin layer of gold, and decorated with silver.
translation_verse: Amoen de, adwiililɛniɛ yeɛ ɔyɔ ɔ, yeɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ dwumvoɛ fa sikaa kɔkorɛ boro ye nwo ɔ, na ɔfa ɛdwetɛ ndweaban ɔyɛ ye nwo nyemenenyemene.

english_verse: Or special wood may be chosen because it doesn't rot— then skilled hands take care to make an idol that won't fall on its face. God Rules the Whole Earth
translation_verse: Ehianiɛ de, ɔfa bakaa serɛserɛ bɔ ɔmborɔ ɔ yeɛ ogyina amoen ne ɔ; na ɔpena sona bɔ ɔse adwii di paa ɔ maa ogyina amoen bɔ ɔngekã ye nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? Hasn't it been clear since the time of creation?
translation_verse: Aso ɛmɔnze? Aso ɛmɔttele? Aso banga bangyire ɛmɔ fi tetetete? Aso ɛmɔttele ye bo ofi mmerɛ bɔ Ɛdangama bɔle aleɛ?

english_verse: God is the one who rules the whole earth, and we that live here are merely insects. He spread out the heavens like a curtain or an open tent.
translation_verse: Aseɛ noa dɔ kango ne, ye yeɛ ɔte so ɔ, bɔ aseɛ so ama bɛte kyɛ torɔka ɔ. Ye yeɛ ɔtrɛtrɛ anwuro nu kyɛ mbɛmuɛ tena ɔ, na ɔbayebaye nu kyɛ ɛtena sua bɔ bɛtena nu ɔ.

english_verse: God brings down rulers and turns them into nothing.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔbrɛ atitirefoɛ ase maa bɛyɛ mmenia mbaen ɔ, na ɔma aseɛ so maenbulɛfoɛ bɛkakyi kwahweabaa mɔ.

english_verse: They are like flowers freshly sprung up and starting to grow. But when God blows on them, they wilt and are carried off like straw in a storm.
translation_verse: Betu bɛ bɛtɛ ala a, bedua bɛ ala a, bɛ bakaa tira ndii wɔ aseɛnwo ala a, ohu mvrama gua bɛ so maa bɛkese, na mvrama piri pia bɛ kɔ kyɛ afafu.

english_verse: The holy God asks, “Who compares with me? Is anyone my equal?”
translation_verse: Nwa nwo yeɛ ɛmɔkɔfa me bɛkɔtoto ɔ, anaa, nwa yeɛ ɔne me bɛsɛ ɔ? Krongronniɛ ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Look at the evening sky! Who created the stars? Who gave them each a name? Who leads them like an army? The Lord is so powerful that none of the stars are ever missing. The Lord Gives Strength
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔto ɛmɔ nye anwuro bɛ́nea, nwa yeɛ ɔbɔle sɔ nningyein nemɔ ɔ? Ye bɔ ɔye b’ɛlɔen ne fite ɔka bɛ ɔ, bɔ ɔfa bɛ mukoraa bɛ dumaa frɛ bɛ ɔ; na ɔnate ye anwoserɛ piri ne ye tumi totohyia ne ati, bɛ nu biala mmini.

english_verse: You people of Israel say, “God pays no attention to us! He doesn't care if we are treated unjustly.” But how can you say that?
translation_verse: O Yakob, nzu ati yeɛ ɛnwa, O Yisrael, nzu ati yeɛ ɛkã kyɛ, “Atee bɔ nnate so ne, ɔmva AWURADE nwo, yeɛ me Nyameɛ abu ye nye wagua so bɔ onni me dwirɛ mma me ɔ”?

english_verse: Don't you know? Haven't you heard? The Lord is the eternal God, Creator of the earth. He never gets weary or tired; his wisdom cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Aso ɛnze? Aso ɛttele? AWURADE te Ɛdangama Nyameɛ, bɔ ɔbɔle aseɛ fi ye ti kɔkã ye ti ɔ. Ɔmvɛ, yeɛ ye nwo nyɛ ye bɛtɛɛ, na ye nworɛ bo sona ndeaseɛ so.

english_verse: Even young people get tired, then stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Mmabunu po bɛfɛ, na bɛ nwo yɛ bɛ bɛtɛɛ, yeɛ mmerandeɛ wora befi ase buramm,

english_verse: But those who trust the Lord will find new strength. They will be strong like eagles soaring upward on wings; they will walk and run without getting tired.
translation_verse: nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛnwondɛ AWURADE ne de, bekonya anwoserɛ foforɛ; bɛkɔfa ndaa bekotu kyɛ kɔleɛ, bekotu amirika, na bɛngɔfɛ, bɛkɔnate, na bɛ nwo ngɔyɛ bɛ bɛtɛɛ.

english_verse: Be silent and listen, every island in the sea. Have courage and come near, every one of you nations. Let's settle this matter!
translation_verse: Supɔ mɔ, ɛ́mɔyɛ dinn bétie me! Odi kyɛ maen maen mɔ bɛkanyane b’anwoserɛ, odi kyɛ bepingye wa bɛbɔ bɛ nguro, odi kyɛ yɛyia nu yɛdi dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: Who appointed this ruler from the east? Who puts nations and kings in his power? His sword and his arrows turn them to dust blown by the wind.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ tenenee li ye si wɔ nekaa biala bɔ otia ne, nwa yeɛ wakanyane ye wafi eyia afiteleɛ ɔ? Nwa yeɛ wafa maen maen mɔ wawura ye sa, ɔne ahemvo mɔ wawura ye bo ɔ? Ye ngrandɛ maa bɛkakyi kyɛ mvuture, na ye agyaen to bɛ pete kyɛ afafu.

english_verse: He goes after them so quickly that his feet barely touch the ground— he doesn't even get hurt.
translation_verse: Ɔfoa bɛ ɔpɛ nu kɔ bɔ ye nwo sonn ɔ, wɔ atee bɔ ye gya baa ottiale so le ɔ so.

english_verse: Who makes these things happen? Who controls human events? I do! I am the Lord. I was there at the beginning; I will be there at the end.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔyɔle sɔ ɔ, ná wamaa ɛhe awa nu ɔ, bɔ ɔfrɛ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ fi tetetete ɔ? Me ɔ. Me AWURADE bɔ nde ahyɛaseɛ, bɔ nza nde ayieleɛ ne, me ɔ.

english_verse: Islands and foreign nations saw what I did and trembled as they came near. What Can Idols Do?
translation_verse: Supɔ mɔ banwu bɔ mayɔ ɔ, na besuro, aseɛ noa dɔ paa nwo wosowoso ye, bapingye wa, bawa.

english_verse: Worshipers of idols comfort each other, saying, “Don't worry!”
translation_verse: Ebiala boka obiɛngo, na ose oliɛma kyɛ, “Ma w’ahone yɛ se!”

english_verse: Woodcarvers, goldsmiths, and other workers encourage one another and say, “We've done a great job!” Then they nail the idol down, so it won't fall over. The Lord's Chosen Servant
translation_verse: Dwumvoɛ hyɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ dwumvoɛ nguraen, yeɛ bɔ ɔfa bɔsobaka tengyɛtengyɛ buralɛ ne koso, ɔhyɛ sona bɔ ɔbobɔ buralɛ so ne nguraen, na ɔkã kyɛ, “Mmuralɛ sosɔlɛ ne, ye mmerɛ ne adwu”, na bɛfa mberɛgoo bemiamia nu bɔ ondutu ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, you are my servant. I chose you, the family of my friend Abraham.
translation_verse: Nakoso wɔ, me somvoɛ Yisrael, Yakob bɔ maneanea nu maye wɔ ɔ, me damvo Abraham bosoniɛ;

english_verse: From far across the earth I brought you here and said, “You are my chosen servant. I haven't forgotten you.”
translation_verse: wɔ bɔ maye wɔ mafi aseɛ noa dɔ paa, bɔ mafrɛ wɔ mafi ye wɛen so dɔ dedeede mawa ɔ, wɔ bɔ nzele wɔ kyɛ, “Ɛte me somvoɛ, maneanea nu maye wɔ, na mengɔye me sa mengofi wɔ bo.”

english_verse: Don't be afraid. I am with you. Don't tremble with fear. I am your God. I will make you strong, as I protect you with my arm and give you victories.
translation_verse: Nnɛsuro, ofikyɛ ngyi wɔ si, nnɛma ɛserɛ kã wɔ, ofikyɛ me ole wɔ Nyameɛ. Ngɔmaa ekogyina pindinn, ngɔboka wɔ, ngɔfa me tenenee asaa famaa ne ngotira wɔ nu.

english_verse: Everyone who hates you will be terribly disgraced; those who attack will vanish into thin air.
translation_verse: Tie, bɛ bɔ bafɛ wɔ so yaa ne amukoraa, bɛ nyunu kogua ase, na bɛkɔfɛre; na bɛ bɔ bɛko betia wɔ ne, b’ayieleɛ koyie bɛ, na bekowuwu.

english_verse: You will look around for those brutal enemies, but you won't find them— they will be gone.
translation_verse: Ɛkɔpena bɛ bɔ bɛmbena wɔ yé ne, nakoso engonwu bɛ, na bɛ bɔ bɛfa koɛ bɛtoa wɔ ne, b’ayieleɛ koyie bɛ pasaa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. I am holding your hand, so don't be afraid. I am here to help you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me, AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ, ndira wɔ sa famaa, na me yeɛ mekã mekyire wɔ kyɛ, ‘Nnɛsuro, na ngɔboka wɔ.’

english_verse: People of Israel, don't worry, though others may say, “Israel is only a worm!” I am the holy God of Israel, who saves and protects you.
translation_verse: Nnɛsuro, wɔ, esuronyi Yakob, ɔne ɛmɔ, Yisraelfoɛ! Ofikyɛ me yeɛ ngɔboka wɔ ɔ. AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne; na wɔ Defoɛ ne ole Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne.

english_verse: I will let you be like a log covered with sharp spikes. You will grind and crush every mountain and hill until they turn to dust.
translation_verse: Tie, ngɔfa wɔ ngɔyɛ ngaen bɔ bɛboro so aburoo, bɔ ɔte monɛ, ɔyɛ nna, bɔ ye gye tuatua nu ɔ. Ɛkɔfa kodwiri mmokaa ekoti bɛ nyokonyoko, na ɛkɔyɛ pambaa mɔ kyɛ afafu.

english_verse: A strong wind will scatter them in all directions. Then you will celebrate and praise me, your Lord, the holy God of Israel. The Lord Helps the Poor
translation_verse: Ekohuhu bɛ so, mvrama kɔbɔ bɛ kɔhɔ, na mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ kɔto bɛ kɔsande. Na afei ekoli ahurusi wɔ AWURADE nu, na ɛkɔhoahoa wɔ nwo wɔ Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne anu.

english_verse: When the poor and needy are dying of thirst and cannot find water, I, the Lord God of Israel, will come to their rescue. I won't forget them.
translation_verse: Sɛ ehiafoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ bɛpena nzue, ná ebie nne berɛ, bɔ nzuhɔen ama bɛ komvi awo ne, me AWURADE, ngotie bɛ sufrɛ, me, Yisrael Nyameɛ, mengɔpo bɛ.

english_verse: I will make rivers flow on mountain peaks. I will send streams to fill the valleys. Dry and barren land will flow with springs and become a lake.
translation_verse: Ngɔma asue mɔ kɔtengyɛ wɔ pambaa pralaa mɔ aso, ná mama asue mmaa mmaa atengyɛ wɔ bɔnza nemɔ anu. Ngɔma ɛkwaa kɔwa ɛserɛ so, ná mama mbombonzue apu afi aseɛ wosee so.

english_verse: I will fill the desert with all kinds of trees— cedars, acacias, and myrtles; olive and cypress trees; fir trees and pines.
translation_verse: Ngolua sida, bɔsema, sesea ne olive mmakaa wɔ ɛserɛ so, ngɔma ɛframmire, pataboɛ ne dɔma kɔbɔ nu kogyina aseɛ wosee so,

english_verse: Everyone will see this and know that I, the holy Lord God of Israel, created it all. Idols Are Useless
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so mmenia anwu ye bate ye bo, ná badwene ye nwo banya ye nwo ndeaseɛ, kyɛ AWURADE tumi yeɛ wayɔ ɛhe ɔ, kyɛ Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne yeɛ ɔbɔle ye ɔ. Mmosoen te mbaen wɔ AWURADE nyunu

english_verse: I am the Lord, the King of Israel! Come argue your case with me. Present your evidence.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo: Ɛ́mɔbɔ bɛ nguro, Yakob Hene nwa nyoo: ɛ́mɔhyire edwirɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Come near me, you idols. Tell us about the past, and we will think about it. Tell us about the future, so we will know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ amoen nemɔ bɛbra ma behyire yɛ bɔ ɔbaasi ɔ. Ɛ́mɔma bɛhã bɔ daa bie osisili ne nwo dwirɛ behyire yɛ, amaa ɔnate so yadwenedwene bɛ nwo yanwu b’ayieleɛ; anaa ɛ́mɔhã bɔ ɔbaasi ne behyire yɛ.

english_verse: Prove that you are gods by making your predictions come true. Do something good or evil, so we can be amazed and terrified.
translation_verse: Bɔ kyẽa bie okosi ne, ɛmɔhã behyire yɛ maa yɛnwu kyɛ ɛmɔte nyameɛ mɔ; ɛ́mɔyɔ paa anaa bɔne, amaa ɔnate so yɛ kunu atete yɛ ná yasuro.

english_verse: You idols are nothing, and you are powerless. To worship you would be disgusting.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie! Ɛmɔtte huu, yeɛ bɔ ɛmɔyɔ ne ɔte mbaen, na sona bɔ ɔkɔneanea nu kɔye ɛmɔ ne, ɔte akyiwadeɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, appointed a ruler in the north; now he comes from the east to honor my name. He tramples kings like mud, as potters trample clay.
translation_verse: Makanyane ebie mafi sorɔ dɔ maa wawa, okofi eyia afiteleɛ dɔ ɔkɔye me dumaa ayɛ. Okoti ahemvo mɔ kyɛ oti nnɛterɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ ngukuenwonɛniɛ dɔne ɛfaa ɔ.

english_verse: Did any of you idols predict what would happen? Did any of you get it right? None of you told about this or even spoke a word.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔhã tole berɛ fili tetetete, kyɛbɔ yɛkonwu ye ɔ, anaa wahã wato berɛ dadadada, kyɛbɔ yɛkɔhã kyɛ, “Ɔte nahorɛniɛ” ɔ? Amba, ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔhane ɔ, amba, ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔbɔle ye dawure ɔ, amba, ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔtele ɛmɔ noa dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I was the first to tell the people of Jerusalem, “Look, it's happening!” I was the one who announced this good news to Zion.
translation_verse: Me yeɛ nnili moa nga ngyirele Sion kyɛ, Tie, bɛ ɛhe, ngɔsoma sona bɔ ɔso ndɛenvɛen ɔ maa ɔkɔhɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: They are nothing, and they can do nothing— they are merely a passing breeze.
translation_verse: Tie, bɛ mukoraa bɛte mbaen, bɔ bɛyɔ ne, ɔtte huu, b’amoen mɔ bɔ bahuro nikyee bafa bayɔ ne, bɛte mvrama ne nikyee mbaen.

english_verse: Here is my servant! I have made him strong. He is my chosen one; I am pleased with him. I have given him my Spirit, and he will bring justice to the nations.
translation_verse: Nea, me somvoɛ bɔ ngyi ye si pindinn ne ɛhe, ye bɔ maneanea nu maye ye, bɔ me kra nye gye ye nwo ne; mafa me Sunzum magua ye so, na ye yeɛ okobua maen maen mɔ ndɛen turoloo ɔ.

english_verse: He won't shout or yell or call out in the streets.
translation_verse: Ɔngɔteatea nu, ongodwudwo serɛserɛ, yeɛ ɔngɔma bɛngɔte ye komvi wɔ dwaaso;

english_verse: He won't break off a bent reed or put out a dying flame, but he will make sure that justice is done.
translation_verse: elemmire bɔ ɔte fɛngyɛfɛngyɛ ne, ongobu nu, yeɛ kanea nyamaa bɔ ogye monɛɛmonɛɛ ne, ongonua ye, na okobua ndɛen turoloo.

english_verse: He won't quit or give up until he brings justice everywhere on earth, and people in foreign nations long for his teaching.
translation_verse: Ye de, ongogye monɛɛmonɛɛ, yeɛ ye abasa nu ngobu, kɔpem kyɛ ɔkɔma ndɛenbualɛ turoloo kotira ndii wɔ aseɛ so ɔ, na supɔ mɔ bɛnwondɛ ye mmeraa ne.

english_verse: I am the Lord God. I created the heavens like an open tent above. I made the earth and everything that grows on it. I am the source of life for all who live on this earth, so listen to what I say.
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ bɔ ɔbɔle anwuro ná ɔtrɛtrɛle nu ne, ye bɔ ɔbayele aseɛ nu, ɔne bɔ ofi nu ba biala nu tole berɛ ne, ye bɔ ɔma so mmenia nwomeɛ, ná ɔma bɛ bɔ bɛnate so sunzum ne, ɔnwa nyoo:

english_verse: I chose you to bring justice, and I am here at your side. I selected you and sent you to bring light and my promise of hope to the nations.
translation_verse: “Me, AWURADE, mafrɛ wɔ wɔ tenenee nu, ngotira wɔ sa ngɔfa wɔ ngosie, ngɔfa wɔ ngɔyɛ apam ngɔma maen ne, ɔne kanea ngɔma maen maen mɔ,

english_verse: You will give sight to the blind; you will set prisoners free from dark dungeons.
translation_verse: kyɛ, ɛ́tete anyeɛ mɔ bɔ basi ɔ, kyɛ ɛ́ye kukunufoɛ efi kuku nu, ɔne kyɛ ɛ́ye bɛ bɔ bɛte awosii nu ɔ efi kuku nu.

english_verse: My name is the Lord! I won't let idols or humans share my glory and praise.
translation_verse: Me ole AWURADE, me dumaa ɛne, memva m’animnyam memma ebiala, yeɛ m’ayɛyelɛ koso, memva memma amoen mɔ.

english_verse: Everything has happened just as I said it would; now I will announce what will happen next. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Tie, nningyein daa ne, bawa nu, na méfa nningyein foforɛ meto dwaa, na mékã bɛ nwo dwirɛ mekyire ɛmɔ koraka né basi.” Ayɛyelɛ dwein

english_verse: Tell the whole world to sing a new song to the Lord! Tell those who sail the ocean and those who live far away to join in the praise.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔkɔ ɛpo, ɔne ɛpo nu nningyein amukoraa, yeɛ supɔ mɔ nu ama, ɛ́mɔto dwein foforɛ bɛ́ye AWURADE ayɛ, ɛ́mɔto ye ayɛyelɛ dwein ne béfi ewiase noa dɔ paa.

english_verse: The Lord is marching out like an angry soldier, shouting with all his might while attacking his enemies. The Lord Will Help His People
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔhɔ ye nyunu kyɛ katakyie, ɔkɔma ye ahone kohu kyɛ koɛhonɛniɛ, ɔkɔtea nu, ɔkɔbɔ ese, na okoli ye pɔfoɛ mɔ so ngonim.

english_verse: For a long time, I, the Lord, have held my temper; now I will cry out and groan like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Ngane me noa ndole nu ɔ wahyɛ, mayɛ konn, na mafa me yaafɛlɛ ne makongɔm berɛ, nakoso kekesaala ye de, ngɔtea nu kyɛ brasua bɔ wafo aworɛ so ɔ, ngɔtee so, ná male nwomeɛ ngoko ngoko.

english_verse: I will destroy the mountains and what grows on them; I will dry up rivers and ponds.
translation_verse: Ngɔsɛkye mmokaa ne pambaa mɔ, ná mama so nyaa amukoraa akese; ngɔkakyi asue mɔ supɔ mɔ, ná mawewe ɛkwaa mɔ.

english_verse: I will lead the blind on roads they have never known; I will guide them on paths they have never traveled. Their road is dark and rough, but I will give light to keep them from stumbling. This is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: Na ngɔyɛ anyesiniwaafoɛ taataa ngɔfa atee bɔ bɛnze so ɔ so; ngoli bɛ nyunu ngɔfa atimbire bɔ bɛnze so ɔ so. Ngɔma awosii kɔkakyi hyireinn wɔ bɛ nyunu, na ngɔma mmɔnga mmɔnga atee ne kɔla so. Bɔ ngɔyɔ ngɔma bɛ hɔ ɛne, na mengɔye me sa mengofi bɛ bo.

english_verse: Everyone who worships idols as though they were gods will be terribly ashamed. God's People Won't Obey
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ wora bewura mmosoen nu, bɛ bɔ bɛkã bekyire amoen mɔ bɔ bahuro nikyee bafa bayɔ ɔ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔte yɛ nyameɛ mɔ” ne, bɛkɔtete bekosa, na bɛ nyunu kogua ase bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: You people are deaf and blind, but the Lord commands you to listen and to see.
translation_verse: Asotiniwaafoɛ, ɛ́mɔtie! Anyesiniwaafoɛ, ɛ́mɔnea, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanwu ye!

english_verse: who sees and hears so much, but pays no attention.
translation_verse: Anwu nningyein pee, nakoso ɛmvete wɔ nye nnea, wɔ so tokuro ne, nu la berɛ, nakoso ɛnde dwirɛ.

english_verse: The Lord always does right, and so he wanted his Law to be greatly praised.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ AWURADE tengyɛ ne ati, ye nye gyele kyɛ ɔkɔpagya mmeraa ne maa okonya animnyam ɔ.

english_verse: But his people were trapped and imprisoned in holes with no one to rescue them. All they owned had been taken, and no one was willing to give it back.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛte maen bɔ ebiemɔ bali bɛ aminɛ bafẽ bɛ nningyein bafa ɔ, bahã bɛ mukoraa bapua wɔ bɔen mɔ nu, bafa bɛ baafea kuku nu, baha ngaen nu bɔ defoɛ biala nne berɛ ɔ, bakakyi koɛ nu nzesadeɛ bɔ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔkɔhã kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔsa bɛfa bɛ bɛhɔ!”

english_verse: Israel sinned and refused to obey the Lord or follow his instructions. So the Lord let us be robbed of everything we owned.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔfale Yakob wurale apaabɔlɛfoɛ mɔ bɛ sa, ná ɔfale Yisrael wurale awerɔm awuefoɛ bɛ sa ɔ? AWURADE bɔ yayɔ bɔne yatia ye, bɔ bamva ye atee so, bɔ banni ye mmeraa so ne, aso nna ye ɔ?

english_verse: He was furious with us and punished our nation with the fires of war. Still we paid no attention. We didn't even care when we were surrounded and scorched by flames.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, ɔmane ye ahone huli Yisrael so paa, na ɔmane koɛ piri paa tole ye. Ye ahonehulɛ ne, ogyele kyɛ see fale ye nwo amu, nakoso wande ye bo, ɔyerale ye, nakoso wanzua nworɛ wamvi nu.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I, the Lord, created you and formed your nation. Israel, don't be afraid. I have rescued you. I have called you by name; now you belong to me.
translation_verse: Na afei, O Yakob, AWURADE bɔ ɔbɔle wɔ, O Yisrael, ye bɔ ɔnwone wɔ ne, ɔnwa nyoo: “Nnɛsuro, ofikyɛ maapɔ wɔ male wɔ, mabɔ wɔ dumaa mafrɛ wɔ, ɛte me deɛ.

english_verse: When you cross deep rivers, I will be with you, and you won't drown. When you walk through fire, you won't be burned or scorched by the flames.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛnate nzue nu a, me ne wɔ yeɛ yɛwɔ berɛ ɔ, sɛ ɛpɛ asue mɔ a, bɛngɔfa wɔ ngɔhɔ; sɛ ɛnate see nu a, ɔngɔyera wɔ, na ye gyelɛ wuronyiwuronyi ne, ɔngɔyera wɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your God, the Holy One of Israel, the God who saves you. I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia, and the region of Seba in exchange for you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me ole AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ, Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne, wɔ Defoɛ ne, Mafa Misraim mayɛ wɔ ti nyɔboɛ mapɔ wɔ, Mafa Yitiopia ne Seba masesã wɔ.

english_verse: To me, you are very dear, and I love you. That's why I gave up nations and people to rescue you.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ wɔ nwo le mvasoɛ wɔ me nyunu, mapagya wɔ dibea, ná mekuro wɔ dwirɛ ne ati, mafa mmenia masesã wɔ, na mafa maen maen mɔ masi wɔ gya nu male wɔ ngoa.

english_verse: Don't be afraid! I am with you. From both east and west I will bring you together.
translation_verse: Nnɛsuro, ofikyɛ me ne wɔ yeɛ yɛwɔ berɛ ɔ; ngɔfa wɔ bosofoɛ ngofi eyia afiteleɛ ngɔwa, yeɛ ngɔboaboa wɔ noa ngofi eyia atɔleɛ.

english_verse: I will say to the north and to the south, “Free my sons and daughters! Let them return from distant lands.
translation_verse: Ngɔhã ngohyire sorɔ dɔ kyɛ, ‘Ma bɛ ate!’ Yeɛ ngɔhã ngohyire ngwaen dɔ kyɛ, ‘Nnɛsi bɛ ate!’ Fa me mma mmienzua mɔ fi dededede bra, ná fa me mma mmrasua mɔ fi aseɛ noa dɔ paa bra;

english_verse: They are my people— I created each of them to bring honor to me.” The Lord Alone Is God The Lord said:
translation_verse: ebiala bɔ bɛfa me dumaa bɛfrɛ ye ɔ, bɔ mmɔle ye kyɛ ɔhyɛ me animnyam ɔ, bɔ nwone ye, ná nyɔle ye ɔ.”

english_verse: Bring my people together. They have eyes and ears, but they can't see or hear.
translation_verse: Maen bɔ bɛ nye asi, nakoso bele anyeɛ ne, bɔ bɛ so ati, nakoso bele asoɛ ne, fa bɛ bra!

english_verse: Tell everyone of every nation to gather around. None of them can honestly say, “We told you so!” If someone heard them say this, then tell us about it now.
translation_verse: Ma maen maen amukoraati bɛboa bɛ noa neka horɛ, ná ma mmenia amukoraa beeyia nu. Bɛ nu nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔhã sɔ dwirɛ ne ɔ, ná okosa kohyire yɛ daa dwirɛ bɔ wasisi ne ɔ? Maa bɛfa b’adanzefoɛ bɛbra ma bɛhã bɛto bɛ deɛ ne aso, yeɛ maa bɛte, ná bɛhã kyɛ, ‘Ɔte nahorɛ.’

english_verse: My people, you are my witnesses and my chosen servant. I want you to know me, to trust me, and understand that I alone am God. I have always been God; there can be no others.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ɛmɔte m’adanzefoɛ, ɔne me somvoɛ bɔ maneanea nu maye ye ɔ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanwu me ná ɛmɔale me bali, ná ɛmɔate ye bo kyɛ me ole Ye. Banyɔ nyameɛ biala bɔ olili me nyunu wale ɔ, yeɛ ebiala ngofi me si ngɔwa.

english_verse: I alone am the Lord; only I can rescue you.
translation_verse: Me, me ole AWURADE, na defoɛ biala nne berɛ ko bɔ ɔboka me so ɔ.

english_verse: I promised to save you, and I kept my promise. You are my witnesses that no other god did this. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Me yeɛ ngane bɔ ɔbaasi ɔ, me yeɛ male ngoa ná mamaa bate ɔ, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né nyameɛ foforɛ biala ɔnne ɛmɔ nu ɔ, na ɛmɔte m’adanzefoɛ,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I am God now and forever. No one can snatch you from me or stand in my way. The Lord Will Prepare the Way
translation_verse: “Me ole Nyameɛ. Ofi tetetete, Me ole Ye, ebiala ngɔhora ngofoti nikyee ngofi me sa nu, sɛ meyɔ nikyee a, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔsesã ye ɔ?”

english_verse: I, the Lord, will rescue you! I am Israel's holy God, and this is my promise: For your sake, I will send an army against Babylon to drag its people away, crying as they go.
translation_verse: AWURADE, ɛmɔ Defoɛ, Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne, ɔnwa nyoo: “Ɔnate ɛmɔ ti, masoma maa bahɔ Babilɔn, kyɛ beebubu mmuralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram pambim nemɔ asi ne anu, na Kaldeafoɛ anigye esebɔlɛ ne, ɔkɔkakyi awuyebɔlɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord, your holy God, Israel's Creator and King.
translation_verse: Me ole AWURADE, ɛmɔ Krongronniɛ ne, ɛmɔ Hene ne, bɔ ɔbɔle Yisrael ne.”

english_verse: I am the one who cut a path through the mighty ocean.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ ɔpakye atee to ɛpo nu, bɔ ɔpɛ esaa to asue mbiri mɔ anu,

english_verse: I sent an army to chase you with chariots and horses; now they lie dead, unable to move. They are like an oil lamp with the flame snuffed out. Forget the Past The Lord said:
translation_verse: bɔ ɔmane teaseɛnam mɔ ne mbɔngɔ, ɛlɔen ne koɛhonɛfoɛ fite wale ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛne. Bɛtete beguale, na bangora dwɔso ko, onuane bɛ boso, na bɛ boso minini kyɛ kanea nyamaa.

english_verse: Forget what happened long ago! Don't think about the past.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔkaye edwirɛ bɔ wasisi daa ne, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔdwenedwene daa tete dwirɛ nemɔ anwo.

english_verse: I am creating something new. There it is! Do you see it? I have put roads in deserts, streams in thirsty lands.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea, mebaayɔ nikyee foforɛ bie, kyɛ ɔ́ba ɔ, aso ɛmɔnnwu ye? Ngɔpakye atee ngɔto ɛserɛ so, ná mama asue mɔ balela aseɛ pralaa so.

english_verse: Every wild animal honors me, even jackals and owls. I provide water in deserts— streams in thirsty lands for my chosen people.
translation_verse: Eburo ngaka kɔhyɛ me animnyam, ɛserɛ so ngyea ne soholi koso bɛkɔyɔ sɔ ala, ofikyɛ mema nzue ba ɛserɛ so, yeɛ mema asue mɔ bɛba aseɛ pralaa so, kyɛ mefa mema me maen bɔ maneanea nu maye ye ne maa ɔno,

english_verse: I made them my own nation, so they would praise me.
translation_verse: maen he, mabɔ ye mama me nwo, kyɛ bɛ́bɔ me nwo ayɛyelɛ dawure.

english_verse: I, the Lord, said to Israel: You have become weary of me, but not from worshiping me.
translation_verse: “Nakoso, O Yakob, anzɔne me, na mmom, me nwo afono wɔ, O Yisrael!

english_verse: You have not honored me by sacrificing sheep or other animals. And I have not burdened you with demands for sacrifices or sweet-smelling incense.
translation_verse: Amva wɔ mmoaen amma ammɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ amma me, yeɛ amva w’afɔleɛ mɔ anhyɛ me animnyam. Mamva afɔleɛ mɔ manyɛ wɔ so adesoa, yeɛ mammisa wɔ ɛyɛɛ mamva manha w’adwene.

english_verse: You have not brought delicious spices for me or given me the best part of your sacrificed animals. Instead, you burden me down with your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Amva sikaa andɔ ayirefona amma me, yeɛ w’afɔleɛ ɛloe nemɔ, amva amma me amma me ko anyi. Na mmom, ama wɔ bɔne ne ayɛ me so adesoa, yeɛ afa w’amumuyɛɛ ne agyegye me.

english_verse: But I wipe away your sins because of who I am. And so, I will forget the wrongs you have done.
translation_verse: “Me, me ole bɔ ɔnate me bɔbɔ me ti mekyikyi wɔ mmeraatolɛ ɔ, na mengɔkaye wɔ bɔne.

english_verse: Meet me in court! State your case and prove that you are right.
translation_verse: Kaye me, maa yɛsu aporowaa; bɔ wɔ kuro ma bebua wɔ be.

english_verse: Your earliest ancestor and all your leaders rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Wɔ nana bɔ oli moa ne, ɔyɔle bɔne, yeɛ wɔ kamafoɛ nemɔ koso, bɛyɔle mvomsoɛ betiale me.

english_verse: That's why I don't allow your priests to serve me; I let Israel be destroyed and your people disgraced.
translation_verse: Yiti, magua nekaa krongron berɛ mbanyi nemɔ nyunu ase, maye Yakob mama kyɛ musue ɔto ye, yeɛ maye Yisrael mama kyɛ bɛgoro ye nwo.

english_verse: People of Israel, I have chosen you as my servant.
translation_verse: “Afei tie, O me somvoɛ Yakob, Yisrael bɔ maneanea nu maye ye ɔ!

english_verse: I am your Creator. You were in my care even before you were born. Israel, don't be terrified! You are my chosen servant, my very favorite.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ ɔbɔle wɔ, bɔ ɔnwone wɔ wɔ eni akunu, bɔ ɔboka wɔ ne, ɔnwa nyoo: Nnɛsuro, O, me somvoɛ Yakob, wɔ, Yesurun bɔ maneanea nu maye wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I will bless the thirsty land by sending streams of water; I will bless your descendants by giving them my Spirit.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngohwie nzue ngogua aseɛ bɔ nzuhɔen ku ye ne aso, yeɛ ngɔma asue mmaa mmaa kɔwa aseɛ wosee ne aso; ngohwie me Sunzum ngogua wɔ boso ama so, ná mahwie me saleɛ magua wɔ mma so.

english_verse: They will spring up like grass or like willow trees near flowing streams.
translation_verse: Bekofifi kyɛ asue nwo ɛserɛ, kyɛ asue noa gyaka.

english_verse: They will worship me and become my people. They will write my name on the back of their hands.
translation_verse: Sona ko kɔhã kyɛ, ‘Nde AWURADE deɛ,’ né ko wora wafa Yakob dumaa wato ye nwo; yeɛ ko koso kɔhyerɛ ye sa nwo kyɛ, ‘AWURADE deɛ ɔ,’ na ɔkɔfa Yisrael dumaa kɔsɔ ye dumaa so.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the first and the last, the one and only God. Israel, I have rescued you! I am your King.
translation_verse: AWURADE, Yisrael Hene, bɔ ɔte ye Defoɛ ne, Asafo AWURADE ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe: “Me ole Ahyɛaseɛ, yeɛ me ole Ayieleɛ; nyameɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔboka me so ɔ.

english_verse: Can anyone compare with me? If so, let them speak up and tell me now. Let them say what has happened since I made my nation long ago, and let them tell what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔte kyɛ me ɔ? Maa ɔhã e! Maa ɔfa to dwaa, ná ɔfa to me nyunu. Nwa yeɛ ofi tetetete wahyire maen bɔ ngyekyele ye afebɔɔ ne, ɔne kyẽa bie nningyein bɔ bekosi ɔ? Maa ohyire yɛ bɔ ɔbaasisi ɔ.

english_verse: Don't tremble with fear! Didn't I tell you long ago? Didn't you hear me? I alone am God— no one else is a mighty rock. Idols Can't Do a Thing The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔ kunu tete ɛmɔ! Aso manga mangyire ɛmɔ mammɔ ye nwo dawure fi tetetete? Na ɛmɔte m’adanzefoɛ. Aso nyameɛ bie wɔ berɛ boka me so hɔ ɔ? Nyɔbotaen biala nne berɛ; ebie nne berɛ bɔ mese ɔ.” Bosoensolɛ te mbaen

english_verse: Those people who make idols are nothing themselves, and the idols they treasure are just as worthless. Worshipers of idols are blind, stupid, and foolish.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ amoen ne, bɛ mukoraa bɛte mmenia mbaen, yeɛ sɔ nningyein ne bɔ bɛ nye gye ye nwo ne, mvasoɛ nne so. B’adanzefoɛ nemɔ, bennwu nikye, yeɛ bɛnze, yiti bɛ nyunu kogua ase.

english_verse: Why make an idol or an image that can't do a thing?
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ wayɔ bosoen anaa wayɔ amoen bɔ mvasoɛ biala nne so ɔ?

english_verse: Everyone who makes idols and all who worship them are mere humans, who will end up sadly disappointed. Let them face me in court and be terrified. Idols and Firewood
translation_verse: Tie! Bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne ye ne amukoraa bɛ nyunu kogua ase, ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ belili adwii bɛyɔle ne, bɛte mmenia. Ma bɛ mukoraa beyia, maa beegyina berɛ, ɛserɛ kɔtɔ bɛ so, na bɛ nyunu kogua ase kɔbɔ nu.

english_verse: A metalworker shapes an idol by using a hammer and heat from the fire. In his powerful hand he holds a hammer, as he pounds the metal into the proper shape. But he gets hungry and thirsty and loses his strength.
translation_verse: Buralɛ dwumvoɛ fa buralɛ wura see nu, ɔfa bɔsobaka boro, na ɔfa ye sa bɔ nu ɔyɛ se ne siesie ye. Ɛhɔen ku ye ma ye anwoserɛ yie, ɔnno nzue, na ɔyɛ bɛtɛɛ.

english_verse: Some woodcarver measures a piece of wood, then draws an outline. The idol is carefully carved with each detail exact. At last it looks like a person and is placed in a temple.
translation_verse: Bakaa dwumvoɛ fa nyamaa susu bakaa kundunzii, ɔfa pɛnzere sesãsesã bakaa ne anwo, ɔfa buralɛ odi adwii ose bakaa ne, ɔfa asusudeɛ susu, na ose maa osoma sona, maa ɔyɛ nyemene kyɛ sona, kyɛ ogyina ye wɔ awuro.

english_verse: Either cedar, cypress, oak, or any tree from the forest may be chosen. Or even a pine tree planted by the woodcarver and watered by the rain.
translation_verse: Obu sida bakaa to, anaakyɛ ɔneanea nu pena ɛmee anaa eluii, na ɔyakyi ye maa ɔne ɛhɔayeɛ nu mmakaa begyina berɛ benyi; anaakyɛ odua sida, na esue tɔ gua so maa onyi.

english_verse: Some of the wood is used to make a fire for heating or for cooking. One piece is made into an idol, then the woodcarver bows down and worships it.
translation_verse: Sɔ bakaa ne kakyi eyein ma sona fa sɔ see, ɔfa ebie kua see ɔto, ɔfa sɔ see ɔto paanoo, ɔfa ebie koso ɔyɛ bosoen ɔsɔne ye; na ɔfa bakaa ne ose amoen ɔkoto ye.

english_verse: Afterwards, he bows down to worship the wooden idol. “Protect me!” he says. “You are my god.”
translation_verse: Na bakaa ne bɔ ɔkɔha ne, ɔfa ose nyameɛ bɔ ɔte ye amoen ɔ. Ɔkoto ye sɔne ye, ɔbɔ mbaeɛ kyire ye, na ɔkã kyɛ, “Pepɛ de me, ofikyɛ ɛte me nyameɛ!”

english_verse: They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
translation_verse: Na bɛ nu biala mva ngɔ adwenedwene nu, yeɛ olle nimdeɛ, anaa adwene biala bɔ ɔkɔmaa okobisa kyɛ, “Bakaa ne bue ne, nyerale ye see nu, nzusole see ne ndone paanoo, matoto naen wɔ so mali, aso odi kyɛ mefa ye ngaa ne meyɛ akyiwadeɛ nikyee anaa? Aso odi kyɛ mekoto bakaa kundunzii anaa?”

english_verse: How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods? The Lord Won't Forget His People
translation_verse: Nzoen yeɛ odi ɔ; ye adwene bɔ ɔte kãa ne amaa wamini, ɔngora mbepɛ nnne ye kra, yeɛ ɔngora mmisa ye nwo kyɛ, “Bɔ me sa famaa tira nu ye, aso nna nnakannaka nikyee ɔ?”

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my servant, so remember all of this. Israel, I created you, and you are my servant. I won't forget you.
translation_verse: O Yakob ne Yisrael, kaye sɔ dwirɛ hemɔ, ofikyɛ ɛte me somvoɛ; me yeɛ nwone wɔ ɔ, ɛte me somvoɛ. O Yisrael, me wora ngofi wɔ.

english_verse: Turn back to me! I have rescued you and swept away your sins as though they were clouds. Sing Praises to the Lord
translation_verse: Makyikyi wɔ mmeraatolɛ ne mafi berɛ kyɛ munungum kabii, ɔne wɔ bɔne mafi berɛ kyɛ munungum. Sa bra me berɛ, ofikyɛ maapɔ wɔ male wɔ.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to start singing! Tell the mountains and every tree in the forest to join in the song! The Lord has rescued his people; now they will worship him. The Lord Created Everything
translation_verse: O anwuro anwuro, ɛ́mɔto anigye dwein, ofikyɛ AWURADE yeɛ wayɔ sɔ ɔ; O aseɛ bo dɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ ese; O mmokaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔto anigye dwein serɛserɛ; O ɛhɔayeɛ mɔ ne nu mmakaa koso, ɛ́mɔyɔ sɔ! Ofikyɛ AWURADE apɔ Yakob wale ye, na wama ye animnyam wala ali wɔ Yisrael.

english_verse: Israel, I am your Lord, the source of your life, and I have rescued you. I created everything from the sky above to the earth below.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ ɔte wɔ Defoɛ, bɔ ɔnwone wɔ wɔ eni akunu ne, ɔnwa nyoo: “Me, AWURADE, me yeɛ nyɔle nningyein amukoraa ɔ, me ngome yeɛ ndrɛtrɛle ewienu nu ɔ, me yeɛ me ngome mmayebayele aseɛ nu ndole berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I make liars of false prophets and fools of fortunetellers. I take human wisdom and turn it into nonsense.
translation_verse: Kyẽa bie dwirɛ nwo musue bɔ ahɔmeɛ bɛye ne, me yeɛ memaa ɔyɛ mbaen ɔ, mema ngonyaayelɛfoɛ bɛyɛ ngwaseaa, mema nworɛfoɛ bɛ nworɛ ka nziɛ, na mekakyi bɛ nimdeɛ ngwaseasɛm.

english_verse: I will make the message of my prophets come true. They are saying, “Jerusalem will be filled with people, and the Lord will rebuild the towns of Judah.”
translation_verse: Me yeɛ mema me somvoɛ ye noa dwirɛ osi pi, ná mema me bɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛ ɔba nu ɔ. Me yeɛ mekã mekyire Yerusalem kyɛ, ‘Mmenia kɔtena wɔ nu,’ yeɛ mekã mekyire Yuda nguro kyɛ, ‘Bɛkɔkyekye wɔ bieku, na ngosa ngɔkyekye wɔ kurofoen nemɔ bieku.’

english_verse: I am the one who commands the sea and its streams to run dry.
translation_verse: Me yeɛ mekã mekyire buma kyɛ, ‘Wewe, ngɔma w’asue mɔ kɔwewe’.

english_verse: I am also the one who says, “Cyrus will lead my people and obey my orders. Jerusalem and the temple will be rebuilt.”
translation_verse: Me yeɛ mekã mefa Karose nwo kyɛ, ‘Ɔte me mmoaenneafoɛ, na ɔkɔma me botaeɛ amukoraati kɔwa nu’; yeɛ mekã mekyire Yerusalem kyɛ, ‘Bɛkɔkyekye wɔ bieku,’ yeɛ mekã mekyire asɔneyɛɛ sua ne kyɛ, ‘Bekosa bɛkɔto wɔ fapem ne.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one: I have taken hold of your right hand to help you capture nations and remove kings from power. City gates will open for you; not one will stay closed.
translation_verse: Ɛhe yeɛ AWURADE hã hyirele Karose bɔ wapopa ye ngoo ne ɔ, ye bɔ masɔ ye sa famaa nu kyɛ ngoli maen maen mɔ so ngonim wɔ ye nyunu, kyɛ ngɔsangyesangye ahemvo mɔ b’abrako nu, kyɛ ngobukyebukye anoa mɔ wɔ ye nyunu, bɔ bɛngɔtoto pambim mɔ nu ɔ:

english_verse: As I lead you, I will level mountains and break the iron bars on bronze gates of cities.
translation_verse: “Ngoli wɔ nyunu, ná madwa mmokaa mɔ maa bahã ase; ngobubu kɔɔbere anoa nemɔ anu, ná mapepɛ mmuralɛ bɔ bɛbrambram pambim mɔ si ne anu.

english_verse: I will give you treasures hidden in dark and secret places. Then you will know that I, the Lord God of Israel, have called you by name.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa anwonyadeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ awosii nu, ɔne agyapadeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ mvealeɛ nu ɔ ngɔma wɔ, amaa ɔnate so anwu kyɛ me, AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ, me yeɛ mmɔle wɔ dumaa mvrɛle wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Cyrus, you don't even know me! But I have called you by name and highly honored you because of Israel, my chosen servant.
translation_verse: Me somvoɛ Yakob ne Yisrael bɔ maneanea nu maye ye ne ati yeɛ mabɔ wɔ dumaa mafrɛ wɔ ɔ; na mabɔ wɔ abodin, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛnze me de.

english_verse: Only I am the Lord! There are no other gods. I have made you strong, though you don't know me.
translation_verse: Me ole AWURADE, Nyameɛ biala nne berɛ ko, Nyameɛ biala nne berɛ kyɛ me ala, mamo wɔ abrako, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛnze me de;

english_verse: Now everyone from east to west will learn that I am the Lord. No other gods are real.
translation_verse: na ɔnate so mmenia konwu ye kofi eyia afiteleɛ ne eyia atɔleɛ, kyɛ ebiala nne berɛ, sana me ngome. Me ole AWURADE, na ebiala nne berɛ ko.

english_verse: I create light and darkness, happiness and sorrow. I, the Lord, do all this.
translation_verse: Me yeɛ mebɔ kanea, ná mesa mebɔ awosii ɔ, me yeɛ mefa asomdwee meba, ná mesa mema amaneɛ ba ɔ. Me, AWURADE, me yeɛ meyɔ ɛhemɔ amukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: Tell the heavens to send down justice like showers of rain. Prepare the earth for my saving power to sprout and produce justice that I, the Lord, create. The Lord's Mighty Power The Lord said:
translation_verse: “O anwuro, tɔ gua ase, ma munungum ɔtɔ tenenee gua ase, ma aseɛ nu odwa, ná ngoalelɛ fi nu bra, ma tenenee fifi bra; me AWURADE, me yeɛ mmɔle ye ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, you have no right to argue with your Creator. You are merely a clay pot shaped by a potter. The clay doesn't ask, “Why did you make me this way? Where are the handles?”
translation_verse: “Sona bɔ ɔne Nyameɛ bɔ ɔbɔle ye ɔ bɛpere so ne, ye yaakɔ! Bua bɔ ɔne sona bɔ ɔnwone ye ɔ bɛpere so ne, ye yaakɔ! Aso ɛfaa obisa sona bɔ ɔfa ye nwo nikyee ne kyɛ, ‘Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛyɔ e’? Anaakyɛ: ‘Bɔ anwo ne, olle asaa?’

english_verse: Children don't have the right to demand of their parents, “What have you done to make us what we are?”
translation_verse: Sona bɔ okobisa ɔse kyɛ, ‘Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛbaawo ye e?’ ne, ye yaakɔ! Anaa bɔ okose brasua kyɛ, ‘Nzikyɛ yeɛ awo ye e?’ ne, ye yaakɔ!

english_verse: I am the Lord, the Creator, the holy God of Israel. Do you dare question me about my own nation or about what I have done?
translation_verse: AWURADE, Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne, bɔ ɔbɔle Yisrael ne, ɔnwa nyoo: “Bɔ ngɔyɔ ngɔfa me mma nwo ne, aso odi kyɛ ɛmɔbisa me hɔ ɔ? Anaa, odi kyɛ ɛmɔhyɛ me wɔ me sa noa adwuma nwo?

english_verse: I created the world and covered it with people; I stretched out the sky and filled it with stars.
translation_verse: Me yeɛ mmɔle aseɛ ɔ, yeɛ mmɔle sona ndole so ɔ; me bɔbɔ me sa yeɛ ɔtrɛtrɛle ewienu nu ɔ, na mvale ahyɛdeɛ mane b’asafo amukoraa.

english_verse: I have done the right thing by placing Cyrus in power, and I will make the roads easy for him to follow. I am the Lord All-Powerful! Cyrus will rebuild my city and set my people free without being paid a thing. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Alone Can Save
translation_verse: Me yeɛ makanyane ye wɔ tenenee nu ɔ, na ngɔtengyɛtengyɛ ye atee amukoraa, ye yeɛ ɔkɔkyekye me kuro ne ɔ, na ye yeɛ ɔkɔyakyi me mmenia bɔ bahye bɛ nnure ne ate maa bekosa bɛkɔhɔ, bɔ ongole bɛ ti nyɔboɛ anaa akyɛdeɛ biala ɔ,” Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: My people, I, the Lord, promise that the riches of Egypt and the treasures of Ethiopia will belong to you. You will force into slavery those tall people of Seba. They will bow down and say, “The only true God is with you; there are no other gods.”
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo: “Misraim anwonya ne Yitiopia dwaa nningyein, Sabeafoɛ, mmienzua ndendenn, bɛkɔwa wɔ berɛ bɛkɔɔyɛ wɔ deɛ, bekoli wɔ si, bɛkɔwa wɔ berɛ bɔ ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ gua bɛ ɔ. Bɛkɔkoto wɔ, ná basrɛ wɔ bahã kyɛ, ‘Amba, Nyameɛ gyi wɔ si, ebiala nne berɛ ko, nyameɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔboka ye so ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: People of Israel, your God is a mystery, though he alone can save.
translation_verse: O Yisrael Nyameɛ, Defoɛ ne, amba, wɔ ole Nyameɛ bɔ ɛfa wɔ nwo fea ɔ.

english_verse: Anyone who makes idols will be confused and terribly disgraced.
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa bɛkɔfɛre, na bɛ nyunu kogua ase, Bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ amoen ne, animguaseɛ kɔto bɛ kɔbɔ nu.

english_verse: But Israel, I, the Lord, will always keep you safe and free from shame. Everyone Is Invited
translation_verse: Nakoso Yisrael de, AWURADE fa ngoalelɛ afebɔɔ ode ye. Ɛfɛrelɛ ngɔhã ɛmɔ, yeɛ ɛmɔ nyunu ngogua ase le afebɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord alone is God! He created the heavens and made a world where people can live, instead of creating an empty desert. The Lord alone is God; there are no others.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE bɔ ɔbɔle anwuro, Nyameɛ bɔ ɔhyehyɛle aseɛ ná ɔyɔle ne, ye bɔ ɔbɔle aseɛ tole berɛ ne, ye bɔ wammɔ ye sesakaa wando berɛ, na mmom ɔbɔle ye kyɛ bɛtena so ne, ɔnwa nyoo: “Me ole AWURADE bɔ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔboka me so ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord did not speak in a dark secret place or command Jacob's descendants to search for him in vain. The Lord speaks the truth, and this is what he says
translation_verse: Nna mvealeɛ nu yeɛ ndwudwole ɔ, nna aseɛ so nekaa bie bɔ ɔte awosii ɔ; manga mangyire Yakob boso ama kyɛ, ‘Odi kyɛ ɛmɔpena me si atee wɔ basabasayɔlɛ nu.’ Me ole AWURADE bɔ medwudwo nahorɛ nu ɔ, edwirɛ bɔ ɔtengyɛ yeɛ mekã ɔ.

english_verse: to every survivor from every nation: “Gather around me! Learn how senseless it is to worship wooden idols or pray to helpless gods.
translation_verse: “Amaen maen mɔ nu ama bɔ ɛmɔanya ɛmɔ ti badidi nu ɔ, ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ noa bɛ́bra, ɛ́mɔbɔ nu bépingye wa! Bɛ mmakaa amoen nemɔ, mmenia bɔ bɛsoa bɛnate, bɔ bɛtɛbɔ mbaeɛ bekyire mmosoen bɔ bɛngora ngoa de ne, nimdeɛ biala nne bɛ ti anu.

english_verse: “Why don't you get together and meet me in court? Didn't I tell you long ago what would happen? I am the only God! There are no others. I bring about justice, and have the power to save.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔdwudwo, ɛ́mɔbɔ ɛmɔ nguro; maa bɛbɔ nu bɛhɔ agyina! Nwa yeɛ ɔhane sɔ dwirɛ ne tole berɛ fili tetetete ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ofi daa tete ne ɔfa tole dwaa ɔ? Aso nna me, AWURADE ɔ? Nyameɛ biala nne berɛ, sana me ngome, nde Nyameɛ bɔ ɔtengyɛ bɔ ode ngoa ɔ, ebiala nne berɛ, sana me ngome.

english_verse: “I invite the whole world to turn to me and be saved. I alone am God! No others are real.
translation_verse: “Aseɛ so maen maen amukoraa, ɛ́mɔsa bɛ si bɛ́bra me berɛ beenya ngoa! Ofikyɛ me yeɛ nde Nyameɛ ɔ, na ebiala nne berɛ ko.

english_verse: I have made a solemn promise, one that won't be broken: Everyone will bow down and worship me.
translation_verse: Mata me bɔbɔ me nwo ndaen, tenenee dwirɛ yeɛ ofi me noa nu wawa ɔ, edwirɛ bɔ mengɔhwe ngosa ɔ, kyɛ, ‘Nangoroma mukoraa bɛkɔkoto me, ná noa amukoraa bafa me bata ndaen.’

english_verse: They will admit that I alone can bring about justice. Everyone who is angry with me will be terribly ashamed and will turn to me.
translation_verse: “Amba, bɛkɔhã bɛkɔfa me nwo kyɛ, AWURADE ngome nu yeɛ menya tenenee ne anwoserɛ ɔ, na bɛ bɔ bafɛ ye so yaa ne, bɛkɔfa animguaseɛ yeɛ bɛkɔwa ye nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give victory and great honor to the people of Israel.”
translation_verse: AWURADE nu yeɛ Yisrael boso ama mukoraa bekoli ngonim bekonya animnyam ɔ.”

english_verse: The gods Bel and Nebo are down on their knees, as wooden images of them are carried away on weary animals.
translation_verse: Bel ɔbɔ ye ti ase, Nebo koto, b’amoen nemɔ teta ngaka ne nandwie mɔ si, ɛmɔ amoen mɔ bɔ ɔyɛ a ɛmɔsoa ne, afei de ɛmɔakyekye basoa ngaka bɔ bafɛ ɔ.

english_verse: They are down on their knees to rescue the heavy load, but the images are still taken to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Bɛkoto, bɛbɔ nu bɛbɔ bɛ ti ase, amoen nemɔ bɔ basoa ne, bɛ bɛngora bɛmbepɛ benne bɛ nwo, na bahye bɛ bɔbɔ nnure bafa bɛ bahɔ.

english_verse: You survivors in Israel, listen to me, the Lord. Since the day you were born, I have carried you along.
translation_verse: “O Yakob awuro ama, yeɛ Yisrael awuro ama bɔ baha ne amukoraa, bɔ madodo ɛmɔ ofite ɛmɔ aworɛ nu, bɔ magyi ɛmɔ fi bɛ kunu ɔ, ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ bétie me!

english_verse: I will still be the same when you are old and gray, and I will take care of you. I created you. I will carry you and always keep you safe.
translation_verse: Na ɔkwaadwu ɛmɔ aworowaabɔlɛ nu po, bɔ nde ala yeɛ nde ɔ, yeɛ ɔkwaadwu ɛmɔ egyeinfulɛ nu po, ngododo ɛmɔ. Me yeɛ mmɔle ɛmɔ ɔ, ngogyina ɛmɔ si, ngododo ɛmɔ ná mapepɛ male ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Some people hire a goldsmith and give silver and gold to be formed into an idol for them to worship.
translation_verse: Mmenia fura sikaa kɔkorɛ befi bɛ bɔtɔ nu, bɛkari ɛdwetɛ wɔ tonyi so, bɛbɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ dwumvoɛ paa maa ɔfa yɔ bosoen, na bebutu berɛ bɛsɔne ye.

english_verse: They carry the idol on their shoulders, then put it on a stand, but it cannot move. They call out to the idol when they are in trouble, but it doesn't answer, and it cannot help.
translation_verse: Bɛfa ye besie bɛ kɔme anwo, bɛsoa ye, besikye ye besie ye boso, berɛ ala yeɛ ogyi ɔ; na ɔngora ndu ye bo mvi nekaa bɔ ogyi ne. Sɛ sona sũ frɛ ye a, ɔngora ndɛ ye so, yeɛ ɔngora mbepɛ nnne ye mvi ye amaneɛ nu.

english_verse: Now keep this in mind, you sinful people. And don't ever forget it. The Lord Alone Is God
translation_verse: “Odi kyɛ ɛmɔkaye ɛhe ná ɛmɔdwene ye nwo, ɛmɔ mmeraatolɛfoɛ, odi kyɛ ɛmɔkaye!

english_verse: I alone am God! There are no other gods; no one is like me. Think about what happened many years ago.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔkaye daa tete nningyein bɔ osisili ne, ofikyɛ me ole Nyameɛ, na ebiala nne berɛ ko, me ole Nyameɛ, na ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ me ɔ.

english_verse: From the very beginning, I told what would happen long before it took place. I kept my word
translation_verse: Me yeɛ ofi ahyɛaseɛ ne, ngane ayieleɛ dwirɛ ɔ, ɔne kyɛ ofi tetetete yeɛ ngane bɔ onnya ossili nwo dwirɛ ɔ. Ngane kyɛ, ‘Me botaeɛ kogyina, na ngɔyɔ me nhyehyɛleɛ amukoraa.’

english_verse: and brought someone from a distant land to do what I wanted. He attacked from the east, like a hawk swooping down. Now I will keep my promise and do what I planned.
translation_verse: Ngɔfrɛ anomaa bɔ ɔkye ngaka di ɔ ngofi eyia afiteleɛ, biaa bɔ ofi maen bie aso dedeede bɔ ɔkɔyɔ me nhyehyɛleɛ ne ɔ. Mahã, na ngɔmaa ɔkɔwa nu; mahyehyɛ mato berɛ, na ngɔyɔ.

english_verse: You people are stubborn and far from being safe, so listen to me.
translation_verse: “Asoserɛfoɛ, ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ bétie me, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔ ne tenenee b’afia atee wale ɔ:

english_verse: I will soon come to save you. I am not far away and will waste no time; I take pride in Israel and will save Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Mama me tenenee ne apingye, ɔnne dede koraa, me ngoalelɛ ne, ɔngɔhyɛ né wawa. Ngɔma ngoalelɛ kɔwa Sion, na ngɔma m’animnyam kɔwa Yisrael so.”

english_verse: City of Babylon, You are delicate and untouched, but that will change. Surrender your royal power and sit in the dirt.
translation_verse: Dwu bra baatena asefuo nu, O, Babilɔn awa brasua ababunu, tena aseɛnwo berɛ bɔ engonya ahennie bia ngɔtena so ɔ, O Kaldeafoɛ bɛ wa brasua, ofikyɛ bɛngɔfrɛ wɔ brasua nomenome ne sokoo ko.

english_verse: Start grinding grain! Take off your veil. Strip off your fancy clothes and wade across rivers.
translation_verse: Fa nyɔboɛ mɔ bɔ beti so ɔ ná ti atokoɔ, ye wɔ ngatanyunu ne, dwa wɔ tena aguasoɛ ne gua berɛ, ma wɔ sɔ nwo gua berɛ, pɛ asue nemɔ.

english_verse: You will suffer the shame of going naked, because I will take revenge, and no one can escape.
translation_verse: Wɔ nwo kɔla so, na bekonwu w’animguaseɛ. Ngɔtɔ wereɛ, na mengonwu sona biala anwumvoin.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the holy God of Israel. I am their Savior.
translation_verse: Yɛ Defoɛ ne, ye dumaa ole Asafo AWURADE, Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne.

english_verse: Babylon, be silent! Sit in the dark. No longer will nations accept you as their queen.
translation_verse: O Kaldeafoɛ awa brasua, tena ase mua wɔ noa, kɔ ná kowura awosii nu, ofikyɛ bɛngɔfrɛ wɔ ahennie mɔ bɛ hemmaa ko.

english_verse: I was angry with my people. So I let you take their land and bring disgrace on them. You showed them no mercy, but were especially cruel to those who were old.
translation_verse: Mvɛle me maen so yaa, nguale m’agyapadeɛ nwo fiɛ, mvale bɛ nwurale wɔ sa, na annwu bɛ anwumvoin, na nworowaa po, ɛhyɛle bɛ so maa benwuni amaneɛ piri paa.

english_verse: You thought that you would be queen forever. You didn't care what you did; it never entered your mind that you might get caught.
translation_verse: Ɛhane kyɛ, ‘Ngoli hemmaa afebɔɔ,’ amaa ɔnate so andwene sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ anwo, yeɛ angaye b’ayieleɛ koso.

english_verse: You think that you alone are all-powerful, that you won't be a widow or lose your children. All you care about is pleasure, but listen to what I say.
translation_verse: Yiti afei tie sɔ dwirɛ ɛhe, wɔ bɔ ekuro anigye ɔ, bɔ wɔ so anu atɔ wɔ wɔ asetena nu ɔ, bɔ ɛkã ye wɔ wɔ ti anu kyɛ, ‘Me ɛne! Ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ me ɔ; mengɔyɛ kunaniɛ, yeɛ mengoli abawuo.’

english_verse: You hid behind evil like a shield and said, “No one can see me!” You were fooled by your wisdom and your knowledge; you felt sure that you alone were in full control.
translation_verse: “Ɛfale wɔ wora wurale w’amumuyɛɛyɔlɛ nu, na ɛhane kyɛ, ‘Sona biala nnwu me.’ Wɔ nworɛ ne wɔ nimdeɛ yeɛ bamaa amini ɔ, na ɛhane ye wɔ wɔ ti anu kyɛ, ‘Me ɛne! Ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ me ɔ.’

english_verse: Keep using your magic powers and your charms as you have always done. Maybe—just maybe— you will frighten somebody!
translation_verse: “Wɔ ngonyaayelɛ ne wɔ musueyelɛ worawora bɔ afi wɔ ngwadaa nu aye ne, kɔ so gyina pindinn wɔ nu e! Ebiaa okoyie wɔ yé wɔ nu, ebiaa ɔkɔma wɔ nwo kɔyɛ suro.

english_verse: You have worn yourself out, asking for advice from those who study the stars and tell the future month after month. Go ask them how to be saved from what will happen.
translation_verse: Foɛ pee bɔ batu wɔ ne, wama w’adwene ayɛ wɔ nwunyaenn, bɛ bɔ bɛnea nzramaa nu bɛkã nu dwirɛ ne, bɛ bɔ bedi nzramaa nwo ahɔen, bɛ bɔ ɛsraen fi a bɛkã bɔ okosi ɔ ne, maa bedwɔso bɛpepɛ bele wɔ e!

english_verse: People who trust the stars are as helpless as straw in a flaming fire. No one can even keep warm, sitting by a fire that feeds only on straw.
translation_verse: Tie, bɛte kyɛ ɛserɛ worowaa, see kɔyera bɛ, bɛngɔhora ngole bɛ nwo ngofi see wuronyiwuronyi ne sa nu, na ɛhe de, nna see bɔ otu sona nwo ɛyerɛ ɛne, yeɛ nna see bɔ bɛtena ye nwo bɛto hɔ ɛne!

english_verse: These are the fortunetellers you have done business with all of your life. But they don't know where they are going, and they can't save you.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ ɛne bɛ babɔ nu bayɔ adwuma, bɔ ɛne bɛ bali dwaa fite wɔ ngwadaa nu ne, sɔ yeɛ bɛte bɛma wɔ ɔ. Ebiala ali makyebu wafa ye atee, na ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔkɔpepɛ kole wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: People of Israel, you come from Jacob's family and the tribe of Judah. You claim to worship me, the Lord God of Israel, but you are lying.
translation_verse: O Yakob boso ama, ɛ́mɔtie dwirɛ he, ɛmɔ bɔ bɛfa Yisrael dumaa bɛfrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ, bɔ ɛmɔte Yuda bosofoɛ, bɔ ɛmɔfa AWURADE dumaa bɛta ndaen, bɔ ɛmɔbɔ Yisrael Nyameɛ dumaa, nakoso ɛmɔnyɔ sɔ nahorɛ ne tenenee nu ɔ.

english_verse: You call Jerusalem your home and say you depend on me, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛfrɛ bɛ nwo kyɛ bɛte kuro krongron ne anu ama, bɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto Yisrael Nyameɛ so ɔ; ye dumaa ole Asafo AWURADE.

english_verse: Long ago I announced what was going to be, then without warning, I made it happen.
translation_verse: “Mvili tetetete yeɛ ngane nningyein bɔ osisi ne anwo dwirɛ ɔ, ɔte me noa dwirɛ, na mva ndole dwaa; nyɔle bɛ mvum nu, na besisili.

english_verse: You heard what I said, and you have seen it happen. Now admit it's true! I will show you secrets you have never known.
translation_verse: “Ate dwirɛ ne, afei nea ye mukoraa; aso ɛmɔngɔbɔ ye dawure anaa? Ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, méma ɛte dwirɛ foforɛ, mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ mɔ bɔ ɛnze ɔ.

english_verse: Today I am doing something new, something you cannot say you have heard before.
translation_verse: Kekesaala ye ala yeɛ mabɔ bɛ ɔ, nna tetetete ɔ, ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, né ɛttele bɛ nwo dwirɛ le, amaa anga kyɛ, ‘Yoo, né mese ye dada.’

english_verse: You have never been willing to listen to what I say; from the moment of your birth, I knew you would rebel. The Lord Warns Israel
translation_verse: Ɛttele ye le, yeɛ ennwuni ye le, ofi tetetete yeɛ wɔ so ne, tokuro nne nu ɔ; ofikyɛ né mese kyɛ ɛte kanda, na ofi eni akunu yeɛ bɛfrɛ wɔ mmeraatolɛniɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am true to myself; I will be praised for not punishing and destroying you.
translation_verse: “Me dumaa ne ati, mafa me yaafɛlɛ ne makongɔm berɛ, na m’ayɛyelɛ ne ati, manya wɔ nwo aboterɛ, amaa ɔnate so mannua wɔ boso.

english_verse: I tested you in hard times just as silver is refined in a heated furnace.
translation_verse: Tie, mapɔ wɔ nwo, nakoso nna kyɛbɔ bɛpɔ ɛdwetɛ nwo ne ɔ, maso wɔ manea wɔ amaneɛ foonoo nu.

english_verse: I did this because of who I am. I refuse to be dishonored or share my praise with any other god.
translation_verse: Me bɔbɔ me ti, me bɔbɔ me ti yeɛ meyɔ sɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ, ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ begua me dumaa nwo fiɛ ɔ? Mengɔfa m’animnyam mengɔma ebie.

english_verse: Israel, my chosen people, listen to me. I alone am the Lord, the first and the last.
translation_verse: “Yɛ asoɛ tie me, O Yakob ne Yisrael bɔ mafrɛ wɔ ɔ! Me ole Ye, me ole bɔ oli moa ne, yeɛ me ala koso ole ayieleɛ ne.

english_verse: With my own hand I created the earth and stretched out the sky. They obey my every command. The Lord Speaks to the Nations
translation_verse: Me sa yeɛ ɔtole aseɛ fapem ɔ, yeɛ me sa famaa trɛtrɛle ewienu nu ɔ; na sɛ meto me sa mefrɛ bɛ a, bɛ mukoraa bɛbagyinagyina me nyunu.

english_verse: Gather around me, all of you! Listen to what I say. Did any of your idols predict this would happen? Did they say that my friend would do what I want done to Babylonia?
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ noa bétie! Bɛ nu nwa yeɛ wafa sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ wato dwaa ɔ? Na bɔ AWURADE kuro ye dwirɛ ne, ye yeɛ ɔkɔyɔ bɔ AWURADE ahyehyɛ atia Babilɔn ɔ, na ye tumi ne kɔho kotia Kaldeafoɛ.

english_verse: I was the one who chose him. I have brought him this far, and he will be successful.
translation_verse: Me, me yeɛ mahã ɔ, mafrɛ ye. Mafa ye mawa, na okoyie ye yé wɔ ye atee biala so.

english_verse: Come closer and listen! I have never kept secret the things I have said, and I was here before time began. It Is Best To Obey the Lord By the power of his Spirit the Lord God has sent me
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhwe bepingye me, ɛ́mɔtie sɔ dwirɛ he: Ofi ahyɛaseɛ ne, nndwudwole mvealeɛ nu, ofi mmerɛ bɔ osili ne, né nwɔ berɛ.” Na afei de, AWURADE Nyameɛ ɔne ye Sunzum basoma me.

english_verse: with this message: People of Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. For your own good, I teach you, and I lead you along the right path.
translation_verse: AWURADE, wɔ Defoɛ, Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne, ɔnwa nyoo: “Me ole AWURADE, wɔ Nyameɛ, bɔ ɔte paa ma wɔ ne, me yeɛ mekyirekyire wɔ ɔ, atee bɔ odi kyɛ ɛfa so ne, me yeɛ mefa wɔ mefa so ɔ.

english_verse: How I wish that you had obeyed my commands! Your success and good fortune would then have overflowed like a flooding river.
translation_verse: O, sɛ ahaa ɛyɛle asoɛ tiele me mmeraa dwirɛ a! Ahaa w’asomdwee kɔyɛ kyɛ asue, ahaa wɔ tenenee kɔyɛ kyɛ ɛpo asorɔkye;

english_verse: Your nation would be blessed with more people than there are grains of sand along the seashore. And I would never have let your country be destroyed.
translation_verse: ahaa wɔ boso ama kɔyɛ pee kyɛ anweaa, ahaa wɔ boso ama kɔyɛ pee kyɛ nyɔboseka. Ahaa mengokyikyi bɛ dumaa, anaa mengohu bɛ ngofi me nyunu.”

english_verse: Now leave Babylon! Celebrate as you go. Be happy and shout for everyone to hear, “The Lord has rescued his servant Israel!
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfi Babilɔn béfite bɛhɔ, ɛ́mɔnwati béfi Kaldeafoɛ nu, ɛ́mɔfa ahurusililɛ bɛ́bɔ ye nwo ese, ɛ́mɔbɔ ye nwo dawure, ɛ́mɔma odwu aseɛ so nekaa biala. Ɛ́mɔhã kyɛ, “AWURADE apɔ ye somvoɛ Yakob wale ye!”

english_verse: He led us through the desert and made water flow from a rock to satisfy our thirst.
translation_verse: Olili bɛ nyunu fale ɛserɛ so ne, nzuhɔen angu bɛ, ɔmane nzue pu fili nyɔbotaen ne anu mane bɛ, odwale nyɔbotaen ne anu, na nzue tengyɛ fili nu.

english_verse: But the Lord has promised that none who are evil will live in peace.”
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Bɔnefoɛ ye so anu ngodwo ye.”

english_verse: Everyone, listen, even you foreign nations across the sea. The Lord chose me and gave me a name before I was born.
translation_verse: O supɔ mɔ, ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ bétie me, dededede maen mɔ, ɛ́mɔtie! AWURADE frɛle me fili me ni akunu, ofi me ni akunu yeɛ ɔtole me dumaa ɔ.

english_verse: He made my words pierce like a sharp sword or a pointed arrow; he kept me safely hidden in the palm of his hand.
translation_verse: Ɔmane me noa dwirɛ yɛle kyɛ ngrandɛ nnaennaen, ɔfale me feale ye sa bo fɔnwoo nu, ɔfale me yɛle agyaen anoa tworɔntworɔn, na ɔfale me siele ye ndokue nu.

english_verse: The Lord said to me, “Israel, you are my servant; and because of you I will be highly honored.”
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, “O Yisrael, ɛte me somvoɛ, bɔ ɔnate wɔ so yeɛ bɛkɔhyɛ me animnyam ɔ.”

english_verse: I said to myself, “I'm completely worn out; my time has been wasted. But I did it for the Lord God, and he will reward me.”
translation_verse: Na nzele kyɛ, “Mafɛ mbaen, masɛkye m’anwoserɛ magua mbaen bɔ mvasoɛ amma so ɔ. Nakoso, nahorɛ nu, me ndɛenbualɛ wɔ AWURADE sa nu, yeɛ m’akatuaa wɔ Nyameɛ sa nu.”

english_verse: Even before I was born, the Lord God chose me to serve him and to lead back the people of Israel. So the Lord has honored me and made me strong.
translation_verse: Na afei AWURADE adwudwo, ye bɔ ɔnwone me wɔ me ni akunu kyɛ mmanyɛ ye somvoɛ, kyɛ nza mva Yakob mmrɛ ye, amaa ɔnate so Yisrael noa waboa wɔ ye nyunu, ofikyɛ manya AWURADE nyunu animnyam, yeɛ me Nyameɛ te m’anwoserɛ.

english_verse: Now the Lord says to me, “It isn't enough for you to be merely my servant. You must do more than lead back survivors from the tribes of Israel. I have placed you here as a light for other nations; you must take my saving power to everyone on earth.” The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Ɔnwa nyoo: “Kyɛ ɛkɔyɛ me somvoɛ, kyɛ ɛkɔpagya Yakob mmusua kure nemɔ, ɔne kyɛ ɛkɔfa Yisraelfoɛ bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ne ekosa kɔwa ne, aso ɔte adwuma ba? Ngosa ngɔfa wɔ ngɔyɛ kanea ngɔma maen maen mɔ, amaa ɔnate so ama me ngoalelɛ waadwu aseɛ so nekaa biala.”

english_verse: Israel, I am the holy Lord God, the one who rescues you. You are slaves of rulers and of a nation who despises you. Now this is what I promise: Kings and rulers will honor you by kneeling at your feet. You can trust me! I am your Lord, the holy God of Israel, and you are my chosen ones. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: AWURADE, Yisrael Defoɛ ne ye Krongronniɛ ne, ɔkã kyire bɔ bebu ye kra animtia, bɔ maen maen mɔ bekyi ye, bɔ ɔte maen mbanyi atianuserɛfoɛ bɛ somvoɛ ne kyɛ, “Ahemvo mɔ konwu ye bekodwɔso, atitirefoɛ koso, na bɛkɔfa bɛ nyunu bekobutu berɛ, ɔnate nahorɛniɛ AWURADE, Yisrael Krongronniɛ bɔ waneanea nu waye wɔ ne ati.”

english_verse: This is what the Lord says: I will answer your prayers because I have set a time when I will help by coming to save you. I have chosen you to take my promise of hope to other nations. You will rebuild the country from its ruins, then people will come and settle there.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo: “Mmerɛ bɔ odi kyɛ menwu wɔ anwumvoin ne, ndiele wɔ, ngoalelɛ kyẽa ne, mmokale wɔ. Manea wɔ so mafa wɔ mayɛ apam mama maen ne, kyɛ, odi kyɛ ɛma maen ne osa si ye gya nu, kyɛ, odi kyɛ ɛmaa bɛfa agyapadeɛ bɔ ɔla berɛ mbaen ne bɛtena so;

english_verse: You will set prisoners free from dark dungeons to see the light of day. On their way home, they will find plenty to eat, even on barren hills.
translation_verse: ná ɛkã kyire kukunufoɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔfite bɛbra!’ ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ awosii nu kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔbra pandann nu!’ Atee nemɔ noa yeɛ bekodidi ɔ, na pambaa amukoraa bɔ so te pralaa ne, bekonya aleɛ wɔ so.

english_verse: They won't go hungry or get thirsty; they won't be bothered by the scorching sun or hot desert winds. I will be merciful while leading them along to streams of water.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔen anaa nzuhɔen ngohũ bɛ, mvrama hyerɛhyerɛ ne eyia ngɔbɔ bɛ, ofikyɛ, bɔ onwu bɛ anwumvoin ne, ɔkɔyɛ bɛ taataa, na mbombonzue nwo yeɛ okoli bɛ nyunu kɔfa bɛ kɔhɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I will level the mountains and make roads.
translation_verse: Ngɔma me mmokaa mukoraa bɛkɔkakyi atee, na ngɔma m’atimbire mɔ kɔla so yɔɔ.

english_verse: Then my people will return from distant lands in the north and the west and from the city of Syene. The Lord's Mercy
translation_verse: Tie, ɛhemɔ kofi nziɛ nziɛ yeɛ bɛkɔwa ɔ, tie, ɛhemɔ kofi sorɔ ne eyia atɔleɛ, yeɛ ɛhemɔ kofi Sinim aseɛ so bɛkɔwa.

english_verse: Tell the heavens and the earth to celebrate and sing; command every mountain to join in the song. The Lord's people have suffered, but he has shown mercy and given them comfort.
translation_verse: O anwuro, ɛ́mɔto anigye dwein! O aseɛ, di ahurusi! O mmokaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ ese! Ofikyɛ AWURADE akyekye ye maen wora, na okonwu ye mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ne anwumvoin.

english_verse: The people of Zion said, “The Lord has turned away and forgotten us.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Sion ahã kyɛ, “AWURADE apo me, m’AWURADE ye wora afi me.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Could a mother forget a child who nurses at her breast? Could she fail to love an infant who came from her own body? Even if a mother could forget, I will never forget you.
translation_verse: “Aso brasua ye wora kɔhora kofi ɔwa bɔ otua nyɔfone noa, bɔ yeɛ ongonwu ye kunu ba anwumvoin ɔ? Yoo, sɛ sɔ mmrasua nemɔ bɛ wora fi po a, me de, me wora ngofi wɔ.

english_verse: A picture of your city is drawn on my hand. You are always in my thoughts!
translation_verse: Nea, makurukyire wɔ magua me sa kunu; na wɔ fasue nemɔ gyigyi me nyunu daa.

english_verse: “Your city will be built faster than it was destroyed— those who attacked it will retreat and leave.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛkyekye wɔ nguro nemɔ ne, bɛ nwo yɛ nyera tra bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ wɔ nguro nemɔ ɔ, na bɛ bɔ bɛsɛkye wɔ ne, bekofi wɔ nu bɛkɔhɔ.

english_verse: Look around! You will see your people coming home. As surely as I live, I, the Lord, promise that your city with its people will be as lovely as a bride wearing her jewelry.” Jerusalem's Bright Future
translation_verse: To wɔ nye anwuro nea bra yia, ɛhemɔ amukoraa baboa bɛ noa bɔ bɛ́ba wɔ berɛ ɔ. AWURADE nwa nyoo, kyɛ nde ase ye de, ɛkɔfa bɛ mukoraa ɛkɔhyehyɛ wɔ nwo kyɛ mbembenanneɛ, ɛkɔfa ekosiesie wɔ nwo kyɛbɔ atɔmvorɛ braa ɔyɔ ne ala.

english_verse: Jerusalem is now in ruins! Nothing is left of the city. But it will be rebuilt and soon overcrowded; its cruel enemies will be gone far away.
translation_verse: “Nahorɛ nu, wɔ nguro ne wɔ maen bɔ babɔ ye ne, ɔne w’aseɛ bɔ wakakyi kurofoen ne, afei de, ɔkɔyɛ kaaba kɔma wɔ mmenia bɔ bɛbaatena wɔ nu ne, na bɛ bɔ bɛbɔle wɔ tɔɔ ne de, bɛkɔhɔ dedeede.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a woman whose children were born while she was in deep sorrow over the loss of her husband. Now those children will come and seek room in the crowded city,
translation_verse: Na ngwadaa bɔ ɛwole bɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ wɔ mma fili wɔ sa ne anu ne, bɛkɔhã bekogua wɔ so anu bieku kyɛ, ‘Ɛwa te kãa ma me, trɛ nu maa nya nekaa ndena.’

english_verse: and Jerusalem will ask, “Am I really their mother? How could I have given birth when I was still mourning in a foreign land? Who raised these children? Where have they come from?”
translation_verse: Na afei ɛkɔhã ye wɔ wɔ ti anu kyɛ, ‘Mmaa hemɔ, nwa yeɛ ɔwole bɛ mane me ɔ? Ofikyɛ me mma fili me sa, na nyɛle angonam, bɛhyele me nnure bɛhɔle, bɛpole me, na ɛhemɔ de, nwa yeɛ ɔtetele bɛ ɔ? Nahorɛ nu, ɔhale me ngome, na ɛhemɔ de, befi nisua yeɛ bɛwale ɔ?’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God says: “I will soon give a signal for the nations to return your sons and your daughters to the arms of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: “Ɛ́mɔtie, mebaama me sa so mekyire maen maen mɔ, ngɔfa me frangaa ngɔpena berɛ ngohyire maen maen mɔ, na bɛkɔfa wɔ mma mmienzua mɔ bɛkɔbɔ bɛ hue so bɛkɔwa, yeɛ wɔ mma mmrasua mɔ koso, bɛkɔfa bɛ bekosie bɛ kɔme anwo bɛkɔwa.

english_verse: The kings and queens of those nations where they were raised will come and bow down. They will take care of you just like a slave taking care of a child. Then you will know that I am the Lord. You won't be disappointed if you trust me.” The Lord Is on Our Side
translation_verse: Ahemvo mɔ, bɛkɔyɛ wɔ baba mɔ bɔ bɛtete wɔ ɔ, yeɛ bɛ hemmaa mɔ kɔyɛ wɔ maame mɔ bɔ bɛma wɔ nyɔfone ɔ. Bɛkɔfa bɛ nyunu bekobutu ase bekobu ndwerɛ wɔ wɔ nyunu, ná batafe wɔ gya bo mvuture. Na afei ekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE, na bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ nye bɛto me so ne, bɛ nyunu ngogua ase.”

english_verse: He will make those cruel people dine on their own flesh and get drunk from drinking their own blood. Then everyone will know that the Lord is our Savior; the powerful God of Israel has rescued his people.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛhyɛ wɔ so ne, ngɔfa bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nwonaen maa bekoli, na bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ mogya kɔbo bɛ kyɛ nzaa. Na afei anwoɔnaen amukoraa konwu ye kyɛ me, AWURADE, me ole wɔ Ngoadefoɛ ne wɔ Defoɛ, Yakob ye Tuminiɛ ne.”

english_verse: The Lord says, “Children, I didn't divorce your mother or sell you to pay debts; I divorced her and sold you because of your sins.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo: “Ɛmɔ maame agyaayiralɛ krataa bɔ mva nyirale ye ne, ɔwɔ nisua? Anaa, nwa yeɛ mema ye kerɛ bɔ yiti mayɛ ɛmɔ atɔen mama ye ɔ? Ɛ́mɔtie, ɛmɔ amumuyɛɛ ti yeɛ nyɛle ɛmɔ atɔen ɔ, ɛmɔ mmeraatolɛ ti yeɛ nyirale ɛmɔ maame ɔ.

english_verse: I came and called out, but you didn't answer. Have I lost my power to rescue and save? At my command oceans and rivers turn into deserts; fish rot and stink for lack of water.
translation_verse: Mmale ne, nzu ati yeɛ né sona biala nne berɛ ɔ? Mvrɛle ne, aso né sona biala nne berɛ bɔ okosuro ɔ? Aso me sa te tikaape bɔ ɔngɔhora ngɔpepɛ ngole ɛmɔ ɔ? Anaakyɛ, nnne tumi bɔ mefa mepepɛ mede ɛmɔ anaa? Ɛ́mɔtie, metwi ɛpo nyunu maa ɔwewe, mema asue mɔ bɛkakyi aseɛ pralaa, na ɔnate kyɛ bɛ nu naen bennya nzue ti, nzuhɔen ku bɛ maa bewu bɛporɔ.

english_verse: I make the sky turn dark like the sackcloth you wear at funerals.” God's Servant Must Suffer
translation_verse: Mefa awosii tunn mekata anwuro nwo, na mefa ɛsɛen tena mekera bɛ.” Nyameɛ somvoɛ sotie

english_verse: he made me willing to listen and not rebel or run away.
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ abukye me so, manyɛ lɔen, yeɛ mangakyi me si mamma ye.

english_verse: I let them beat my back and pull out my beard. I didn't turn aside when they insulted me and spit in my face.
translation_verse: Mvale me si mane bɛ bɔ befi me mbire ne, mvale me so taa nu mane bɛ bɔ betutu kanza ne. Beguale me nyunu ase, bɛfefele nwɔserɛ beguale me nyunu, nakoso mamva me nyunu mamvea.

english_verse: But the Lord God keeps me from being disgraced. So I refuse to give up, because I know God will never let me down.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ gyi me si, yiti ɔnyɛ me nya, yiti matindim berɛ serɛserɛ kyɛ nyɔbotaen, na mese kyɛ me nyunu ngogua ase.

english_verse: The Lord God will help me and prove I am innocent. My accusers will wear out like moth-eaten clothes.
translation_verse: Tie, AWURADE Nyameɛ gyi me si, nwa yeɛ okobua me foɛ ɔ? Tie, bɛ mukoraa bɛkɔtete kyɛ ɛtena, na mvrɔlɔ koli.

english_verse: None of you respect the Lord or obey his servant. You walk in the dark instead of the light; you don't trust the name of the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ osuro AWURADE, ná ɔyɛ ye somvoɛ dwirɛ nwo sotie ɔ? Sona bɔ ɔnate awosii nu, bɔ onnya kanea ne, maa ɔfa ye wora wura AWURADE dumaa nu, ná ɔfa ye nwo to ye Nyameɛ so.

english_verse: Go ahead and walk in the light of the fires you have set. But with his own hand, the Lord will punish you and make you suffer.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔkua see, bɔ ɛmɔfa gyetia bɛpɛ bɛ nwo bɛbra beyia ɔ! Ɛmɔ see wuronyiwuronyi ne, ɔne gyetia bɔ ɛmɔasɔ ne, ɛ́mɔnate nu! Bɔ ɛmɔkonya bekofi me berɛ hɔ ɛne: amaneɛnwunɛ nu yeɛ ɛmɔkɔlela berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey the Lord, follow Abraham's example. He was the rock from which you were chipped.
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔtie me, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔbɔ tenenee bra ɔ, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔpena AWURADE si atee ɔ; ɛ́mɔnea nyɔbotaen bɔ bedwale ɛmɔ befili nu ne, ɔne kumaa bɔ nu yeɛ betuli ɛmɔ befili ne.

english_verse: God chose Abraham and Sarah to be your ancestors. The Lord blessed Abraham, and from that one man came many descendants.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nana Abraham ne Sara bɔ bɛwole ɛmɔ ne; ofikyɛ mvrɛle Abraham ne, né ɔte sona horɛ, nyirale ye, na mmaa ɔtale pee.

english_verse: Though Zion is in ruins, the Lord will bring comfort, and the city will be as lovely as the garden of Eden that he provided. Then Zion will celebrate; it will be thankful and sing joyful songs. The Lord's Victory Will Last
