translation_verse: AWURADE kɔkyekye Sion wora, ɔkɔkyekye ye kurofoen amukoraa wora, ye ɛserɛ ne, ɔkɔkakyi ye maa ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ Eden, ɔne ye aseɛ pralaa ne kyɛ AWURADE turo, na bekonwu anika ne anigye wɔ nu, yeɛ asennaa ne edweintolɛ.

english_verse: The Lord says: You are my people and nation! So pay attention to me. My teaching will cause justice to shine like a light for every nation.
translation_verse: “Me mmenia, ɛ́mɔtie me yé, me maen, yɛ asoɛ tie me; ofikyɛ mmeraa kofi me berɛ kɔwa, na me ndɛenbualɛ kɔyɛ kanea kɔma maen maen mɔ.

english_verse: Those who live across the sea are eagerly waiting for me to rescue them. I am strong and ready; soon I will come to save and to rule all nations.
translation_verse: Me tenenee ne apingye, me ngoalelɛ ne kɔye ye nwo ali, na me tumi kobua maen mɔ ndɛen; supɔ mɔ bɛ́nea me ate, na bɛ nye la me tumi ne aso.

english_verse: Look closely at the sky! Stare at the earth. The sky will vanish like smoke; the earth will wear out like clothes. Everyone on this earth will die like flies. But my victory will last; my saving power never ends.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye so bɛ́nea anwuro, ná ɛ́mɔhu bɛ nye ase bɛ́nea aseɛ; ofikyɛ anwuro kotu komini kyɛ nwosina, aseɛ kɔtete kyɛ ɛtena, na so ama kowuwu sɔ ala; nakoso me ngoalelɛ ne de, ɔkɔyɛ afebɔɔ, yeɛ me tenenee ne wora, ye bo ngɔpɛ le.

english_verse: If you want to do right and obey my teaching with all your heart, then pay close attention. Don't be discouraged when others insult you and say hurtful things.
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔtie me, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔse tenenee ɔ, maen bɔ me mmeraa wɔ b’ahone nu ɔ; nnɛma ɛmɔsuro mmenia animguaseɛ bɔ begua ɛmɔ ɔ, yeɛ nnɛmɔma bɛ nzoaapepɛlɛ ne obu ɛmɔ abasa nu.

english_verse: They will be eaten away like a moth-eaten coat. But my victory will last; my saving power will never end. A Prayer for the Lord's Help
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mvrɔlɔ koli bɛ kyɛ ɛtena, yeɛ alɔponɛ koli bɛ kyɛ gyese; nakoso me tenenee de, ɔkɔyɛ afebɔɔ, na me ngoalelɛ kɔtena berɛ kɔma aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa.”

english_verse: Wake up! Do something, Lord. Be strong and ready. Wake up! Do what you did for our people long ago. Didn't you chop up Rahab the monster?
translation_verse: O AWURADE tumi, kanyane wɔ nwo, kanyane wɔ nwo, kyire w’anwoserɛ! Kanyane wɔ nwo kyɛbɔ ɛyɔle ye daa daa ne, kyɛbɔ ɛyɔle ye daa tetetete aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ nu ne. Aso nna wɔ yeɛ ɛpepɛle Rahabo nu ahuronzi ahuronzi ná ɛfale nikyee sinane ɛpo nu sasrabɔnzam ne ɔ?

english_verse: Now those you have rescued will return to Jerusalem, singing on their way. They will be crowned with great happiness, never again to be burdened with sadness and sorrow. The Lord Gives Hope
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ AWURADE aapɔ bɛ ne, bekosa bɛkɔwa, bɛkɔfa ahurusililɛ bɛkɔwa Sion, anigye afebɔɔ kɔyɛ b’abotire; bekonya anika ne anwosɛpɛ, na aworabɔlɛ ne yealɛlilɛ kotu kofi bɛ so.

english_verse: I am the Lord, the one who encourages you. Why are you afraid of mere humans? They dry up and die like grass.
translation_verse: “Me, me yeɛ mekyekye ɛmɔ wora ɔ, na wɔ, nzikyɛ sona ole wɔ, bɔ esuro kuro sona bɔ owu ɔ, ɔne sona awa bɔ bɛyɔle ye kyɛ ndire ɔ;

english_verse: I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. But you have forgotten me, your Lord and Creator. All day long you were afraid of those who were angry and hoped to oppress you. Where are they now?
translation_verse: bɔ yeɛ ama wɔ wora afi AWURADE bɔ ɔbɔle wɔ ne, ye bɔ ɔtrɛtrɛle ewienu nu sinzele berɛ, bɔ ɔtole aseɛ fapem ne ɔ? Nhyɛsoɛniɛ ne, nzu ati yeɛ ye yaafɛlɛ bɔ osoma kyɛ onya wɔ a okohu wɔ ne ati, ɛma ɛserɛ tɔ wɔ so daa biala ɔ? Nhyɛsoɛniɛ ne, ye yaafɛlɛ ne odwu nisua?

english_verse: Everyone crying out in pain will be quickly set free; they will be rescued from the power of death and never go hungry.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ babɔ ye panwu ne, bɛkɔye ye bekofi nu ndɛndɛ; ongowu wɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu, yeɛ ye noa aleɛ ngɔbɔ ye.

english_verse: I will help them because I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful, who makes the ocean roar.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me ole AWURADE, wɔ Nyameɛ, bɔ ɔkã ɛpo nu ma ye asorɔkye bɔ wuruwuru ne, ye dumaa li Asafo AWURADE.

english_verse: I have told you what to say, and I will keep you safe in the palm of my hand. I spread out the heavens and laid foundations for the earth. Now I say, “Jerusalem, your people are mine.” A Warning to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Mafa me dwirɛ matua wɔ noa, mafa wɔ mafea me sa bo fɔnwoo nu, matrɛtrɛ ewienu nu, yeɛ mato aseɛ fapem, na mahã mahyire Sion kyɛ, ‘Ɛte me maen.’ ”

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up! You've drunk too much from the cup filled with the Lord's anger. You have swallowed every drop, and you can't walk straight.
translation_verse: Kanyane wɔ nwo, kanyane wɔ nwo! O Yerusalem, dwɔso! Wɔ bɔ ano AWURADE sa nu ɛyaafɛlɛ kulie ne noa, kulie bɔ ɔmaa bɛbo tendaenn ne, wɔ bɔ ano nu atu ye bo ne.

english_verse: Not one of your many children is there to guide you or to offer a helping hand.
translation_verse: Ye mma mukoraa bɔ wawo bɛ ne, nu biala anyɛ ye taataa; ye mma mukoraa bɔ watete bɛ ne, nu biala anzɔ ye sa.

english_verse: The Lord your God is angry, and on every street corner your children lie helpless, like deer trapped in nets.
translation_verse: Wɔ mma mɔ bɛ nye so aburu bɛ, beguagua mmorɔnoɛ mukoraa ngwandaa kyɛ kɛtɛbɔɔ bɔ owura ngaen nu ɔ, AWURADE ahone ahu bɛ so paa, wɔ Nyameɛ ahwi bɛ nyunu paa.

english_verse: You are in trouble and drunk, but not from wine. So pay close attention
translation_verse: Yiti wɔ bɔ ɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ, tie sɔ dwirɛ he e, wɔ bɔ abo, nakoso nna nzaa yeɛ wabo wɔ ɔ:

english_verse: to the Lord your God, who defends you and says, “I have taken from your hands the cup filled with my anger that made you drunk. You will never be forced to drink it again.
translation_verse: wɔ Mene, AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ odi ye maen dwirɛ ma ye ne, ɔnwa nyoo: “Tie, kulie bɔ ɔmaa bɛbo sesɛsesɛ ne, bɔ ɔte me yaafɛlɛ kulie ne, male mafi wɔ sa nu, ɛngɔno ye ko.

english_verse: Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up and be strong. Holy city of Zion, dress in your best clothes. Those foreigners who ruined your sacred city won't bother you again.
translation_verse: O Sion, kanyane wɔ nwo, kanyane wɔ nwo! kyire w’anwoserɛ e! O Yerusalem, kuro krongron, fa w’animnyam tena ne kera, ofikyɛ, ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo nde ne, bengowura wɔ nu ko.

english_verse: Zion, rise from the dirt! Free yourself from the rope around your neck. Suffering Will End
translation_verse: O Yerusalem bɔ bahye wɔ nnure ɔ, dwɔso poroporo wɔ nwo mvuture ne! O Sion awa brasua bɔ bahye wɔ nnure ɔ, nyangye ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ bɔ bafa bagua wɔ kɔme ne!

english_verse: The Lord says: My people, you were sold, but not for money; now you will be set free, but not for a payment.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Bandɔne wɔ banne huu, yiti nna sikaa yeɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔpɔ wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Long ago you went to Egypt where you lived as foreigners. Then Assyria was cruel to you,
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Daa daa bie, Misraim yeɛ me maen otu hɔle ɔɔyɛle ɛwɔfoɛ ɔ, na Asiriafoɛ hyɛle bɛ so mbaen.

english_verse: and now another nation has taken you prisoner for no reason at all. Your leaders groan with pain, and day after day my own name is cursed.
translation_verse: Na afei, nzikyɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ meyɔ ye wɔ wa ɔ? AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, ofikyɛ basesa me maen bahɔ mbaen. Bɛ bɔ bedi bɛ so ne, bɛmaa bɛbɔ awuye, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne; na daa biala bɛkekã musue dwirɛ betia me dumaa.

english_verse: My people, you will learn who I am and who is speaking because I am here. A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, me maen konwu me dumaa. Yiti sɔ kyẽa ne, bekonwu kyɛ me ala yeɛ mekã kyɛ, Yoo, Me ɔ.”

english_verse: What a beautiful sight! On the mountains a messenger announces to Jerusalem, “Good news! You're saved. There will be peace. Your God is now King.”
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔso ndɛenvɛen nate mmokaa nemɔ aso ne, kyɛbɔ ye gya bo osi yɛ nyemene ɔ! Ɔbɔ asomdwee nwo dawure, ɔso edwirɛ paa nwo ndɛenvɛen, ɔbɔ ngoalelɛ nwo dawure, na ose Sion kyɛ, “Wɔ Nyameɛ ne, odi hene.”

english_verse: Everyone on guard duty, sing and celebrate! Look! You can see the Lord returning to Zion.
translation_verse: Tie! W’awɛmvoɛ nemɔ bɛma bɛ komvi so, bɛbɔ nu bɛto ahurusi dwein, ofikyɛ bɛ nye tua AWURADE kyɛ osa ba Sion ɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, rise from the ruins! Join in the singing. The Lord has given comfort to his people; he comes to your rescue.
translation_verse: Yerusalem dandue mɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ nu bɛ́to dwein; ofikyɛ AWURADE akyekye ye maen wora, na waapɔ Yerusalem wale ye.

english_verse: The Lord has shown all nations his mighty strength; now everyone will see the saving power of our God. A Command To Leave Babylon
translation_verse: AWURADE ala ye tumi krongron ne ali, wama maen maen mukoraa banwu ye, na aseɛ so nekaa biala konwu yɛ Nyameɛ ngoalelɛ ne.

english_verse: Leave the city of Babylon! Don't touch anything filthy. Wash yourselves. Be ready to carry back everything sacred that belongs to the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsoa AWURADE ngukue nemɔ ne, ɛmɔhɔ, ɛmɔhɔ, ɛmɔfi berɛ bɛhɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bɛkã nikyee biala bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ; ɛ́mɔfi ye nu béfite bɛhɔ, ɛ́mɔte ɛmɔ nwo.

english_verse: You won't need to run. No one is chasing you. The Lord God of Israel will lead and protect you from enemy attacks. The Suffering Servant
translation_verse: Ɛmɔngofi berɛ bɛngɔhɔ ye ndɛndɛ so, yeɛ ɛmɔngɔnwati bɛngɔhɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE koli ɛmɔ nyunu, yeɛ Yisrael Nyameɛ ne kogyina ɛmɔ si. Nyameɛ somvoɛ n’amaneɛnwunɛ

english_verse: The Lord says: My servant will succeed! He will be given great praise and the highest honors.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, okoyie me somvoɛ ne yé, bɛkɔma ye anidie ná bama ye so, na ɔkɔyɛ titire paa.

english_verse: Many were horrified at what happened to him. But everyone who saw him was even more horrified because he suffered until he no longer looked human.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ ɔyɛle mmeni pee bɔ benwuni ye ne nwanwa, ofikyɛ ye nyunu mengyemengyele, bɔ né onzoma sona, bɔ né ye sona sue deɛ onzoma kuro sona deɛ ne ati,

english_verse: My servant will make nations worthy to worship me; kings will be silent as they bow in wonder. They will see and think about things they have never seen or thought about before.
translation_verse: sɔ ala yeɛ ɔkɔma maen maen mɔ bɛ nwo kodwiri bɛ ɔ; ɔnate ye ti ahemvo mɔ kɔtotɔ mmobo; ɔnate kyɛ, bɔ bɛhhã behhyirele bɛ ne, bekonwu ye; yeɛ bɔ bɛttele ne, bɛkɔte ye bo.

english_verse: Has anyone believed us or seen the mighty power of the Lord in action?
translation_verse: Edwirɛ bɔ yahã ne, nwa yeɛ wale wali ɔ? Nwa yeɛ AWURADE tumi ne wala ali wahyire ye ɔ?

english_verse: Like a young plant or a root that sprouts in dry ground, the servant grew up obeying the Lord. He wasn't some handsome king. Nothing about the way he looked made him attractive to us.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ofifili kyɛ bakaa horɔhorɔ bie wɔ ye nyunu, kyɛ ndii bɔ wafifi wɔ aseɛ wosee nu ɔ. Wannya sue anaa animnyam bɔ ɔkɔmaa yɛkɔnea ye ɔ, yeɛ wannya anwonyemene bɔ ɔkɔmaa yɛkohuro ye dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: He was hated and rejected; his life was filled with sorrow and terrible suffering. No one wanted to look at him. We despised him and said, “He is a nobody!”
translation_verse: Mmenia buli ye animtia, na bɛpole ye; ɔte sona bɔ ɔfale aworabɔlɛ nu ná onwuni yealɛ ɔ, bebuli ye animtia kyɛ sona bɔ mmenia nwu ye a bɛye bɛ nye bɛto buro ɔ, yeɛ yamva ye yanyɛ huu.

english_verse: He was wounded and crushed because of our sins; by taking our punishment, he made us completely well.
translation_verse: Nakoso, yɛ mmeraatolɛ ti yeɛ bepurale ye ɔ, yɛ amumuyɛɛ ti yeɛ bedwiridwirili ye nwo ɔ; yɛ asomdwee nwo asohwenɛ lale ye so, na ye nwo beabealɛ ne yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnya anwonyerɛsalɛ ɔ.

english_verse: All of us were like sheep that had wandered off. We had each gone our own way, but the Lord gave him the punishment we deserved.
translation_verse: Yɛ mukoraa yali makyebu kyɛ mmoaen, yɛ nu biala wamakye wafa ye bɔbɔ ye atee deɛ so, na AWURADE aprapra yɛ mukoraa yɛ amumuyɛɛ wagua ye so.

english_verse: He was painfully abused, but he did not complain. He was silent like a lamb being led to the butcher, as quiet as a sheep having its wool cut off.
translation_verse: Bɛfale ye bɛfale yealɛ nu, yeɛ bepurapurale ye, nakoso wammukye ye noa, kyɛ boaen bɔ bɛ ne ye kɔ akumyɛɛ ɔ, kyɛ boaen bɔ watɔ mumu wɔ bɛ bɔ bɛpepɛ ye nwiaa bɛ nyunu ɔ, sɔ ala yeɛ wammukye ye noa ɔ.

english_verse: He was condemned to death without a fair trial. Who could have imagined what would happen to him? His life was taken away because of the sinful things my people had done.
translation_verse: Bɛnate nhyɛsoɛ ne ndɛengyea so bɛfale ye bɛhɔle, na ye aberɛso ama mɔ, nwa yeɛ ɔdwene ye nwo kyɛ bapɛ ye ngoa so bafi ateasefoɛ aseɛ so ɔ, kyɛ me maen mmeraatolɛ ti yeɛ bepurale ye ɔ?

english_verse: He wasn't dishonest or violent, but he was buried in a tomb among cruel, rich people.
translation_verse: Bɛpɛle ye asieleɛ bɛfrale bɔnefoɛ mɔ deɛ, ɔne sikafoɛ mɔ deɛ wɔ ye wue nu, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ wanni nzɛmmɔne biala, yeɛ nnakannaka biala wamvi ye noa.

english_verse: The Lord decided his servant would suffer as a sacrifice to take away the sin and guilt of others. Now the servant will live to see his own descendants. He did everything the Lord had planned.
translation_verse: Nakoso né AWURADE kuro kyɛ odwiridwiri ye nwo ɔ, na ɔfale ye fale yealɛ nu. Na ɔnate kyɛ ɔfale ye kra bɔle bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ne ati, okonwu ye bosofoɛ, okonya ngoa tendenn, na ɔnate ye so yeɛ bɔ AWURADE kuro ne, ɔkɔwa nu ɔ.

english_verse: By suffering, the servant will learn the true meaning of obeying the Lord. Although he is innocent, he will take the punishment for the sins of others, so that many of them will no longer be guilty.
translation_verse: Okonwu ye kra amaneɛnwunɛ ne aso mvasoɛ maa ye ahone kɔtɔ ye kunu, na m’akoaa teneneeniɛ ne, ye nimdeɛ yeɛ ɔkɔfa kobua mmeni pee be ɔ, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔkɔsoa b’amumuyɛɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will reward him with honor and power for sacrificing his life. Others thought he was a sinner, but he suffered for our sins and asked God to forgive us.
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔfa ye kyɛfa ngɔma ye wɔ atitirefoɛ nu, na ɔne anwoserɛfoɛ bɛkɔhyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ ne, ofikyɛ ɔfale ye kra tole berɛ mane ewue, bɛhale ye bɛfrale mmeraatolɛfoɛ; nakoso ɔfale menni pee bɛ bɔne tole ye nwo so, na olili mmeraatolɛfoɛ bɛ ti dwirɛ mane bɛ.

english_verse: Sing and shout, even though you have never had children! The Lord has promised that you will have more children than someone married for a long time.
translation_verse: “To dwein, wɔ, mmotaen bɔ anwo ɔ, ma wɔ komvi so to ahurusi dwein, wɔ bɔ ennwuni aworɛ yealɛ le ɔ! Ofikyɛ brasua bɔ bɛpole ye ne, ye mma kɔyɛ pee kɔtra brasua bɔ ogya biaa ne,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: You and your descendants will take over the land of other nations. You will settle in towns that are now in ruins.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛkɔtrɛtrɛ nu kɔhɔ wɔ sa famaa so ne bɛen so, wɔ boso ama kɔfa maen maen mɔ bekoli so, na bɛkɔma mmenia kɔtenatena kurofoen nemɔ aso.

english_verse: Don't be afraid or ashamed and don't be discouraged. You won't be disappointed. Forget how sinful you were when you were young; stop feeling ashamed for being left a widow.
translation_verse: “Nnɛsuro, ofikyɛ wɔ nyunu ngogua ase, nnɛmaa ɔyɛ wɔ nya, ofikyɛ animguaseɛ ngɔhã wɔ, ofikyɛ wɔ wora kofi wɔ ndaluwa nu nyanzoen ne, yeɛ wɔ kunalilɛ nu animguaseɛ ne, ɛngɔkaye ye ko.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the Holy God of Israel, rules all the earth. He is your Creator and husband, and he will rescue you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔbɔle wɔ ne, ɔte ehu, ye dumaa li Asafo AWURADE, wɔ Defoɛ ole Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne, na bɛfrɛ ye ewiase amukoraa Nyameɛ.

english_verse: You were like a young wife, brokenhearted and crying because her husband had divorced her. But the Lord your God says, “I am taking you back!
translation_verse: Amba, AWURADE ato ye sa wafrɛ wɔ, kyɛ braa bɔ bayira ye, bɔ odi aworabɔlɛ ɔ, kyɛ mmerandeɛ nu braa bɔ biaa ne apo ye ɔ, wɔ Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I rejected you for a while, but with love and tenderness I will embrace you again.
translation_verse: Mbole wɔ mmerɛ kãa bie, nakoso ngogyina anwumvoinnwunɛ piri so ngɔfa wɔ ngɔbata me nwo.

english_verse: For a while, I turned away in furious anger. Now I will have mercy and love you forever! I, your protector and Lord, make this promise.” The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
translation_verse: Mvɛle ɛyaa piri paa, na mvale me nyunu mveale wɔ mmerɛ kãa bie, nakoso ngɔfa ɔdɔ bɔ olle ayieleɛ ɔ ngonwu wɔ anwumvoin, AWURADE, wɔ Defoɛ ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I once promised Noah that I would never again destroy the earth by a flood. Now I have promised that I will never again get angry and punish you.
translation_verse: “Na ɛhe te kyɛ Nowa mmerɛ ne ala: kyɛbɔ ndale ndaen kyɛ nnɛma Nowa nzueyilɛ ne oyi fa aseɛ so ko ne, sɔ ala yeɛ mata ndaen kyɛ mengɔfɛ wɔ so yaa ɔ, yeɛ mengohwi wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: Every mountain and hill may disappear. But I will always be kind and merciful to you; I won't break my agreement to give your nation peace. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, mmokaa kotutu kofi bɛ boso, yeɛ pambaa mɔ kɔwoso, nakoso me dɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne de, mengɔye mengofi wɔ so, na m’asomdwee apam ne, ongogu, AWURADE bɔ onwu wɔ anwumvoin ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you are sad and discouraged, tossed around in a storm. But I, the Lord, will rebuild your city with precious stones; for your foundation I will use blue sapphires.
translation_verse: “O wɔ bɔ edi yealɛ, bɔ mvrama atu afĩ wɔ, bɔ ebiala ngyekye wɔ wora ɔ, tie, ngɔfa nyɔboɛ nyemenenyemene yeɛ ngosisi wɔ sua mɔ ɔ, na ngɔfa nyɔboɛ bɔ oli safire ngɔto wɔ fapem ne.

english_verse: I will teach your children and make them successful.
translation_verse: AWURADE kohyirehyire wɔ mma mukoraa nikye, na wɔ mma konya asomdwee pee.

english_verse: You will be built on fairness with no fears of injustice; every one of your worries will be taken far from you.
translation_verse: Wɔ bo kotindim wɔ tenenee nu, ɛne nhyɛsoɛ b’afia atee kɔwale, ofikyɛ engosuro, yeɛ ɛne ahunundetelɛ b’afia atee kɔwale, ofikyɛ ongopingye wɔ.

english_verse: I will never send anyone to attack your city, and you will make prisoners of those who do attack.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie fa koɛ batoa wɔ a, ye de, nna me yeɛ mayɔ sɔ ɔ; yeɛ sɛ ebie fa ngondii batoa wɔ a, ɔnate wɔ ti okoli ngoguo.

english_verse: Don't forget that I created metalworkers who make weapons over burning coals. I also created armies that can bring destruction.
translation_verse: Tie, me yeɛ mmɔle buralɛ dwumvoɛ bɔ ofita ebunaen see nu, ná ɔbɔ akodeɛ maa akodeɛ ne fata adwuma bɔ bɛfa bɛyɔ ɔ. Nakoso me ala yeɛ mmɔle sɛkyefoɛ kyɛ ɔsɛkye nningyein ɔ.

english_verse: Weapons made to attack you won't be successful; words spoken against you won't hurt at all. My servants, Jerusalem is yours! I, the Lord, promise to bless you with victory.
translation_verse: Akodeɛ biala bɔ babɔ bafa batia wɔ ne, ɔngɔyɛ adwuma, yeɛ noa biala bɔ okodwɔso kotia wɔ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ nu ne, ɛkɔsa wɔ nwo maa okoli fɔ. AWURADE somvoɛ mɔ, b’agyapadeɛ ne bɛ tenenee bɔ ofi me berɛ hɔ ɛne, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: If you are thirsty, come and drink water! If you don't have any money, come, eat what you want! Drink wine and milk without paying a cent.
translation_verse: “Huuu, ɛmɔ bɔ nzuhɔen ku ɛmɔ ee, ɛmɔbra nzue ne anwo oo; ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔlle sikaa po ne, ɛmɔbra bɛɛtɔ ná beli oo! Ɛmɔbra bɛɛtɔ nzaa ne nyɔfonesue bɔ ɛmɔngɔfa sikaa yeɛ bɛkɔtɔ ɔ, bɔ nyɔboɛ biala ɔlla so ɔ.

english_verse: Why waste your money on what really isn't food? Why work hard for something that doesn't satisfy? Listen carefully to me, and you will enjoy the very best foods.
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔfa sikaa bɛtɔ nikyee bɔ nna aleɛ ahɔ ɔ, ɔne kyɛ ɛmɔsɛkye ɛmɔ anwoserɛ wɔ nikyee bɔ ɔmma ɛmɔ ko nyi nwo ɔ? Ɛ́mɔtie me yé, ná ɛ́mɔli bɔ ɔte paa ɔ, ná ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ kra nye gye aleɛ sɔkyee nwo.

english_verse: Pay close attention! Come to me and live. I will promise you the eternal love and loyalty that I promised David.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ bétie, ná ɛmɔbra me berɛ; ɛ́mɔtie, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔ kra anya ngoa. Me ne ɛmɔ yɛkɔyɛ apam afebɔɔ, bɔ ɔte me ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi bɔ nne ye ma Dawide ne.

english_verse: I made him the leader and ruler of the nations; he was my witness to them.
translation_verse: Tie, mafa ye mayɛ adanzeɛ mama maen maen mɔ, ɔte maen maen mɔ bɛ safohene, ɔne bɔ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: You will call out to nations you have never known. And they have never known you, but they will come running because I am the Lord, the holy God of Israel, and I have honored you. God's Words Are Powerful
translation_verse: Tie, ɛkɔto wɔ sa kɔfrɛ maen maen bɔ ɛnze bɛ ɔ, na maen maen bɔ bɛnze wɔ ɔ bekotu amirika bɛkɔwa wɔ berɛ, ɔnate AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ, Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne ati, ofikyɛ wahyɛ wɔ animnyam.

english_verse: Turn to the Lord! He can still be found. Call out to God! He is near.
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔpena AWURADE si atee, mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔpena ye a ɛmɔkonwu ye ɔ, ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ dwirɛ bɛ́to ye nyunu, mmerɛ bɔ opingye ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and your evil thoughts. Return to the Lord our God. He will be merciful and forgive your sins.
translation_verse: Ohia kyɛ bɔnefoɛ yakyi ye yɔleɛ, yeɛ sona bɔ ɔndengyɛ ne koso, maa ɔsesã ye adwene, maa osa bra AWURADE berɛ, na okonwu ye anwumvoin, maa ɔbra yɛ Nyameɛ berɛ, ofikyɛ ɔkɔfa bɔne ne kɔhyɛ kandinga paa.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My thoughts and my ways are not like yours.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nna m’adwene ole ɛmɔ adwene, yeɛ nna ɛmɔ atee ole m’atee, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, my thoughts and my ways are higher than yours.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ anwuro wɔ anwuro anwuro tra aseɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ m’atee bo ɛmɔ atee deɛ so ɔ, na m’adwene koso bo ɛmɔ adwene so.

english_verse: “Rain and snow fall from the sky. But they don't return without watering the earth that produces seeds to plant and grain to eat.
translation_verse: “Na kyɛbɔ esue ne asukɔtwea befi anwuro bɛtɔ begua ase, bɔ benza bɛngɔ, sana baloaloa aseɛ maa mmakaa bafifi, basu, maa wayɛ mmaa wama kuaniɛ, ɔne aleɛ wama bɔ odi ne,

english_verse: That's how it is with my words. They don't return to me without doing everything I send them to do.” God's People Will Celebrate
translation_verse: sɔ ala yeɛ me dwirɛ bɔ ofi me noa kɔwa ne ɔte ɔ. Ongosa ngɔwa me berɛ mbaen, na mmom sana wayɔ bɔ mekuro kyɛ meyɔ ɔ, ɔne kyɛ okoyie botaeɛ bɔ yiti yeɛ nzomane ye ɔ.

english_verse: When you are set free, you will celebrate and travel home in peace. Mountains and hills will sing as you pass by, and trees will clap.
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ ahurusililɛ nu yeɛ ɛmɔkɔfa bekofi berɛ ɔ, na ngoli ɛmɔ nyunu ma ɛmɔkɔhɔ asomdwee nu. Mmokaa ne pambaa mɔ bɛkɔto ahurusi dwein wɔ ɛmɔ nyunu, na eburo mmakaa mukoraa bɛkɔbɔ bɛ sa nu.

english_verse: Cypress and myrtle trees will grow in fields once covered by thorns. And then those trees will stand as a lasting witness to the glory of the Lord.
translation_verse: Nekaa bɔ ɛfone wɔ ne, ɛframmire kofifi berɛ kosi ye gya nu, sesea kofifi kosi agurɛ gya nu, na ɛhe kɔma AWURADE dumaa so, ɔkɔyɛ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ afebɔɔ bɔ ye bo ngɔpɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Be honest and fair! Soon I will come to save you; my saving power will be seen everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo: “Ɛ́mɔfa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ bɛ́bɔ bɛ bra, ná ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔngɔhyɛ biala né me ngoalelɛ ne wawa, na me tenenee ne kɔla ali.

english_verse: Foreigners who worship me must not say, “The Lord won't let us be part of his people.” Men who are unable to become fathers must no longer say, “We are dried-up trees.”
translation_verse: Amanvoraniɛ bɔ waafa ye nwo wabɔ AWURADE ne, nnɛmaa ose kyɛ, “Etulɛ ala yeɛ AWURADE kotu me kofi ye maen nu ɔ”; yeɛ sona bɔ ɔte sayɛɛ ne koso, nnɛmaa ose kyɛ, “Hmmm, me de mayɛ bakaa wuruwaa.”

english_verse: To them, I, the Lord, say: Respect the Sabbath, obey me completely, and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE nwa nyoo: “Sayɛɛ mɔ bɔ bedi m’afofingyẽa so, bɔ bɛyɔ bɔ mekuro ɔ, bɔ bedi m’apam ne aso ne,

english_verse: Then you will be like monuments in my temple with your names written on them. This will be much better than having children, because these monuments will stand there forever.
translation_verse: ngɔma bɛ ngayeɛ nikyee ne dumaa wɔ m’awuro ɔne me fasue ne akunu, na sɔ nningyein nemɔ bedi mu bɛtra mmaa mmienzua ne mmaa mmrasua. Ngɔma bɛ dumaa afebɔɔ bɔ ongomini le ɔ.

english_verse: Foreigners will follow me. They will love me and worship in my name; they will respect the Sabbath and keep our agreement.
translation_verse: “Yeɛ amanvrafoɛ bɔ bafa bɛ nwo baabɔ AWURADE kyɛ bɛbaaso ye, ná bahuro ye dumaa dwirɛ, ná bayɛ ye somvoɛ nen, ebiala bɔ odi afofikyẽa ne aso, bɔ ɔmva efiɛ nga ye ne, bɔ odi m’apam ne aso ne,

english_verse: I will bring them to my holy mountain, where they will celebrate in my house of worship. Their sacrifices and offerings will always be welcome on my altar. Then my house will be known as a house of worship for all nations.
translation_verse: ngɔfa sɔ mmenia ne ngɔwa me bokaa krongron ne aso, ná mamaa banya anika wɔ me mbaeɛbɔlɛ awuro. Bɛ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne b’afɔleɛ nemɔ, ɔkɔsɔ me nye wɔ m’afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso, ofikyɛ m’awuro ne, dumaa bɔ ɔkɔla so kɔma maen maen amukoraa ole mbaeɛbɔlɛ awuro.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together my people who were taken away, and let them join the others. God Promises To Punish Israel's Leaders
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ bɔ ɔboaboa Yisrael mmenia bɔ babɔ aya noa ne, ɔnwa nyoo: “Mmenia bɔ maboaboa bɛ noa mama ye ne, ngɔhɔ so ngɔboaboa ebieku noa ngɔboka ye so.”

english_verse: Come from the forest, you wild animals! Attack and gobble up your victims.
translation_verse: Eburo ngaka amukoraa, ɛmɔbra bɛɛtete nu pasapasa beli, yoo, ɛhɔayeɛ nu ngaka amukoraa.

english_verse: You leaders of Israel should be watchdogs, protecting my people. But you can't see a thing, and you never warn them. Dozing and daydreaming are all you ever do.
translation_verse: Ye awɛmvoɛ nemɔ bɛ nye asi, bɛ mukoraa nimdeɛ abɔ bɛ, bɛ mukoraa bɛte ngyea mumu, bɛngora po, na laleɛhyenɛ, asefuo nu lalɛ ne nnaa yeɛ watɔ bɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: You stupid leaders are a pack of hungry and greedy dogs that never get enough. You are shepherds who mistreat your own sheep for selfish gain.
translation_verse: Amba, bɛte ngyea adifuu, na bɛnze ahoyire. Bɛte mmoaenneafoɛ bɔ nimdeɛ abɔ bɛ ɔ, bɛ mukoraa bali makyebu baafa bɛ bɔbɔ b’atee so, na bɛ nu biala ɔdwene ye ngome ye yeeyɛlɛ nwo.

english_verse: You say to each other, “Let's drink till we're drunk! Tomorrow we'll do it again. We'll really enjoy ourselves.”
translation_verse: “Bɛkã kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔbra, mekwaafa nzaa meba, ɛ́mɔma yɛ́no nzaa serɛ yɛ́bo, na ɛhema koso ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ ɛnɛ ala, na ɔkɔtra so po!’ ”

english_verse: God's faithful people are dragged off and killed, and no one even cares. Evil sweeps them away,
translation_verse: Teneneeniɛ wu, na ebiala kunu nde ye, bɛpɛ anwoteefoɛ ngoa so bɔ ebiala nde ye bo ɔ. Ofikyɛ bɛpɛ teneneeniɛ ngoa so kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ edwirɛ tɛɛ bɔ ɔbaawa ne ɔngɔto ye ɔ.

english_verse: but in death they find peace for obeying God. The Lord Condemns Idolatry
translation_verse: Ɔkɔ nekaa bɔ asomdwee wɔ ɔ, na bɛ bɔ bɛnate tenenee atee so ne, bede bɛ nwome wɔ bɛ mba so.

english_verse: You people are unfaithful! You go to fortunetellers, and you worship idols. Now pay close attention!
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ de, bayifoɛ brasua mma, ɛ́mɔpingye wa, agyaasɛkyelɛniɛ ne gyanderaniɛ bosofoɛ.

english_verse: Who are you making fun of? Who are you sneering at? Look how your sins have made fools of you.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɛmɔgoro ye nwo ye? Nwa yeɛ ɛmɔsobi bɛ noa begua ye so ye? Nwa yeɛ ɛmɔkekã edwirɛ tɛɛ betia ye e? Aso nna mmeraatolɛ mmaa ole ɛmɔ? Nna kanda mmaa ole ɛmɔ?

english_verse: All you think about is sex under those green trees where idols are worshiped. You sacrifice your children on altars built in valleys under rocky slopes.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔ ne mmosoen bɛbɔ adwaman wɔ bakaa monɛ biala bo ɔ, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔkuku ɛmɔ mma mɔ wɔ bɔnza nemɔ anu wɔ nyɔbotaen ngumaa nemɔ anu ɔ?

english_verse: You have chosen to worship idols made of stone; you have given them offerings of wine and grain. Should I be pleased?
translation_verse: Bɔnza nu nyɔboɛ torometorome nemɔ anu yeɛ ɔte wɔ kyɛfa ɔ, bɛ yeɛ bɛte w’agyapadeɛ ɔ, bɛ yeɛ abɔ wɔ anonneɛ afɔleɛ ne aburoo afɔleɛ ama bɛ ɔ. Aso me kunu kodwo wɔ sɔ nningyein nemɔ anwo anaa?

english_verse: You have spread out your beds on the tops of high mountains, where you sacrifice to idols.
translation_verse: Mmokaa mbiri ndendenn so yeɛ asɛ wɔ bɛen ɔ, na dɔ yeɛ ɛfo ɛɛbɔle afɔleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Even in your homes you have placed pagan symbols all around your huge beds. Yes, you have rejected me, sold yourselves to your lovers, and gone to bed with them.
translation_verse: Anoa ne aponnwaa si yeɛ afa wɔ ngayeɛ nikyee ne asie ɔ; na ɔnate kyɛ apo me ne ati, aye wɔ nwo ato so, afo aala so, asɛ bɛen ne, ɛne bɛ bali ye noa bɔ ekole bɛ ɔ, wɔ nye gyele kyɛ ɛne bɛ kɔla ɔ, na enwuni bɛ nwo bɔ baye ne.

english_verse: You smear on olive oil and all kinds of perfume to worship the god Molech. You even seek advice from spirits of the dead.
translation_verse: Etuli atee ɛɛfale anaatere mane Moleke, ɛfale ayirefona pee yɛle wɔ nwo; ɛsomane wɔ bɔfoɛ mɔ maa bɛhɔle dedeede, na ɛsomane bɛ maa bɛhɔle ɛborɔ po.

english_verse: Though you tired yourself out by running after idols, you refused to stop. Your desires were so strong that they kept you going.
translation_verse: Wɔ yɔleɛ tɛɛ pee ne amaa afɛ, nakoso anga kyɛ, ‘Ɔte mbaen’; na mmom ɛhɔle so nyane nu anwoserɛ, na wɔ nwo anyɛ wɔ bɛtɛɛ.

english_verse: Did you forget about me and become unfaithful because you were more afraid of someone else? Have I been silent so long that you no longer fear me?
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ye nwo yɛ suro bɔ esuro ye ɔ, bɔ yiti anga nahorɛ ɔ, bɔ yiti angaye me ɔ, bɔ yiti andwene me nwo ɔ? Aso nna konn yeɛ mayɛ fi tetetete ɔ, bɔ ɔnate sɔ ati enzuro me ɔ?

english_verse: You think you're so good, but I'll point out the truth.
translation_verse: Wɔ tenenee ne wɔ yɔleɛ nemɔ, ngɔye bɛ ali ngohyire, na so ngɔwa mvasoɛ biala ngɔma wɔ.

english_verse: Ask your idols to save you when you are in trouble. Be careful though— it takes only a faint breath to blow them over. But if you come to me for protection, this land and my holy mountain will always belong to you. The Lord Helps the Helpless
translation_verse: Sɛ esu pena mmokalɛ a, ma wɔ mmosoen bɔ aboaboa bɛ noa nemɔ bɛpepɛ bele wɔ! Mvrama kopia bɛ mukoraa kɔhɔ, nwomeɛ kɔbɔ bɛ kɔhɔ. Nakoso sona bɔ ɔkɔɔbɔ ye nwo adwaa wɔ me nu ne de, ye yeɛ ɔkɔfa aseɛ ne kɔtena so ɔ, na me bokaa krongron ne kɔyɛ ye agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: Our holy God lives forever in the highest heavens, and this is what he says: Though I live high above in the holy place, I am here to help those who are humble and depend only on me.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne, bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ, bɔ ye dumaa ole Krongron ne, ɔnwa nyoo: “Anwuro ne nekaa krongron berɛ yeɛ nde ɔ, na sona bɔ wanya nnuhoɛ ne anwobrɛaseɛ ne, me ne ye yeɛ yɛte ɔ, amaa ɔnate so mama anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ bɛ sunzum anya ngoa, ná mama bɛ bɔ banya nnuhoɛ ne b’ahone anya ngoa.

english_verse: My people, I won't stay angry and keep on accusing you. After all, I am your Creator. I don't want you to give up in complete despair.
translation_verse: Mengɔbɔ kwaadu afebɔɔ, yeɛ m’ahone koso ngohu daa, anyɔ a, sona sunzum ne ye kra bɔ me yeɛ mabɔ ne, bɛkɔyɛ mmerɛ wɔ me nyunu.

english_verse: Your greed made me furious. That's why I punished you and refused to be found, while you kept returning to your old sinful ways.
translation_verse: Ye adifuu amumuyɛɛ ti yeɛ m’ahone huli ɔ, mburale ye, mvale me nyunu mveale ye, na mvɛle yaa, nakoso ɔhɔle so lili makyebu fale ye bɔbɔ ye atee so.

english_verse: I know what you are like! But I will heal you, lead you, and give you comfort, until those who are mourning
translation_verse: Manwu ye atee bɔ ɔnate so ɔ, na ngɔsa ye anwonyerɛ, ngɔyɛ ye taataa, ná makyekye ye wora, na ye mmenia bɔ bedi aworabɔlɛ ne, ngɔma bɛ noa dwirɛ kɔyɛ ayɛyelɛ.

english_verse: start singing my praises. No matter where you are, I, the Lord, will heal you and give you peace.
translation_verse: Asomdwee, asomdwee hã bɔ ɔwɔ nziɛ nziɛ ne bɔ opingye ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne; na ngɔsa ye anwonyerɛ.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, have promised that none who are evil will live in peace.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ ye so anu ngodwo ye, me Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: Shout the message! Don't hold back. Say to my people Israel: You've sinned! You've turned against the Lord.
translation_verse: “Tea nu serɛserɛ, nnɛkã wɔ komvi ase, ma wɔ komvi so kyɛ totorobɛndo, kã me maen ye mmeraatolɛ kyire ye, ɔne Yakob bosofoɛ bɛ bɔne kyire bɛ.

english_verse: Day after day, you worship him and seem eager to learn his teachings. You act like a nation that wants to do right by obeying his laws. You ask him about justice, and say you enjoy worshiping the Lord.
translation_verse: Hmmm, bɛpena me si atee daa biala, bekuro kyɛ benwu m’atee mɔ, kyɛ gyamea bɛte maen bie bɔ bɛyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ, bɔ bambo bɛ Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ ɔ. Bebisa ndɛen turoloo befi me berɛ, na bekuro kyɛ bekopingye Nyameɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You wonder why the Lord pays no attention when you go without eating and act humble. But on those same days that you give up eating, you think only of yourselves and abuse your workers.
translation_verse: Bɛnwa: ‘Nzu ati yeɛ yayɛ akɔngyere bɔ ennwu ye ɔ? Nzu ati yeɛ yabrɛ yɛ kra ase bɔ ɛnze ɔ?’ Ɛ́mɔtie, sɛ ɛmɔyɛ akɔngyere a, bɔ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔkuro yeɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ, na ɛmɔhyɛ ɛmɔ adwumayɔlɛfoɛ amukoraa so.

english_verse: Do you think the Lord wants you to give up eating and to act as humble as a bent-over bush? Or to dress in sackcloth and sit in ashes? Is this really what he wants on a day of worship?
translation_verse: Aso akɔngyere bɔ ɔsɔ me nye ɛhe, kyẽa bɔ sona brɛ ye kra ase ne anaa? Aso akɔngyere okyire bɛ ti ase bɔ bɛbɔ ye kyɛ ngyɛngyɛma, ɔne kyɛ ɛkɔtrɛtrɛ ɛsɛen tena ne nzoen nu ɛkɔla so ɔ? Eh, aso ɛhe yeɛ ɛfrɛ ye akɔngyere ɔ, ɔne kyẽa bɔ ɔsɔ AWURADE nye ne anaa?

english_verse: I'll tell you what it really means to worship the Lord. Remove the chains of prisoners who are bound unjustly. Free those who are abused!
translation_verse: “Aso nna akɔngyere he yeɛ ɔsɔ me nye ɔ: kyɛ ɛmɔkɔsangye nzɛmmɔne ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ, kyɛ ɛmɔkɔsangye mmenia kɔnnua nyamaa, kyɛ ɛmɔkɔma bɛ bɔ ɛmɔhyɛ bɛ so ɔ bekonya bɛ fawɔnwodi, ɔne kyɛ ɛmɔkobubu kɔnnua biala ɔ?

english_verse: Share your food with everyone who is hungry; share your home with the poor and homeless. Give clothes to those in need; don't turn away your relatives.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɛhɔen ku ye ne, aso onni kyɛ ɛma ye w’aleɛ ne bie anaa? Aso onni kyɛ ɛfa ehianiɛ anwumvoinniɛ ɛkɔ w’awuro anaa? Yeɛ, sɛ enwu bɔ ye nwo la so a, aso onni kyɛ ɛma ye tena maa ɔkera anaa? Yeɛ afei, onni kyɛ ɛbɔ wɔ nwoniɛ bɔ ohia mmokalɛ ɔ atianuserɛ.

english_verse: Then your light will shine like the dawning sun, and you will quickly be healed. Your honesty will protect you as you advance, and the glory of the Lord will defend you from behind.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛyɔ sɔ a, wɔ kanea kopukye kyɛ alehyeleɛ, na w’anwonyerɛsalɛ kɔwa ndɛndɛ. Wɔ tenenee koli wɔ nyunu moa, ná AWURADE animnyam agyina wɔ si.

english_verse: When you beg the Lord for help, he will answer, “Here I am!” Don't mistreat others or falsely accuse them or say something cruel.
translation_verse: Afei ɛkɔfrɛ, na AWURADE kɔtɛ wɔ so, ekosu kɔfrɛ, na ɔkɔhã kyɛ, Me ɛhe. “Sɛ ɛyakyi kɔnnua bɔ ɛfa to mmenia kɔme, anwunanwuna asaa tengyɛlɛ ne ɛsoentolɛ,

english_verse: Give your food to the hungry and care for the homeless. Then your light will shine in the dark; your darkest hour will be like the noonday sun.
translation_verse: sɛ ɛne bɔ ɛhɔen ku ye ɔ bɛkyɛ w’aleɛ, ná ɛma sona bɔ ɔyɛ anwumvo ɔ nikyee bɔ ohia hɔ a, ye de wɔ kanea kopukye awosii nu, na w’awosii kɔyɛ kyɛ eyia ketee.

english_verse: The Lord will always guide you and provide good things to eat when you are in the desert. He will make you healthy. You will be like a garden that has plenty of water or like a stream that never runs dry.
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔyɛ wɔ taataa daa biala, ɔkɔma wɔ kra ko koyi wɔ aseɛ katerepee so, ɔkɔma w’aporɛ nu kɔyɛ se, ɛkɔyɛ kyɛ turo bɔ mmerɛ biala nzue doadoa nu ɔ, kyɛ mbombonzue bɔ ɔnwewe ɔ.

english_verse: You will rebuild those houses left in ruins for years; you will be known as a builder and repairer of city walls and streets.
translation_verse: Wɔ nu ama kosa kɔkyekye wɔ kurofoen nemɔ, aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ daa daa nemɔ, ekosa kosi bɛ fapem nemɔ; na bɛkɔfrɛ wɔ: Bɔ osa si fasue bɔ wabubu ɔ, bɔ osiesie mmorɔnoɛ ma mmenia bɛtena so ɔ.

english_verse: Then you will truly enjoy knowing the Lord. He will let you rule from the highest mountains and bless you with the land of your ancestor Jacob. The Lord has spoken!
translation_verse: ye de ekonya anigye wɔ AWURADE nu; ngɔmaa ɛkɔfa aseɛ ne aso mmokaa nemɔ aso ngonim nu, ngɔfa wɔ nana Yakob agyapadeɛ ne ngɔma wɔ maa ekoli, ofikyɛ AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: The Lord hasn't lost his powerful strength; he can still hear and answer prayers.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie! AWURADE sa ɔtte tika bɔ ɔngora mbepɛ nnne ɔ, yeɛ ye so anu ɔnyɛ se bɔ ɔnde dwirɛ ɔ;

english_verse: Your sins are the roadblock between you and your God. That's why he doesn't answer your prayers or let you see his face.
translation_verse: na mmom ɛmɔ amumuyɛɛ yeɛ watete ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ Nyameɛ b’afia ɔ, na ɛmɔ bɔne ne amaa waye ye nye wato buro wafea ɛmɔ, bɔ ɔnate so ɔndɛ ɛmɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: Your talk is filled with lies and plans for violence; every finger on your hands is covered with blood.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ sa ahã mogya agua, ɛmɔ sa mmɛseka afɔrefɔre amumuyɛɛ, ɛmɔ noa ahã nnakannaka dwirɛ, yeɛ ɛmɔ temverema apɛ ngondombo.

english_verse: You falsely accuse others and tell lies in court; sin and trouble are the names of your children.
translation_verse: Ebiala ngyina edwirɛ paa so ɔnzama obiɛngo, ebiala mmɔ nahorɛ kuro wɔ badwafoɛ nyunu; bɛto soen mbaen mbaen, na bɛnga nahorɛ, bɛnwonzɛ nzɛmmɔne, na bɛwo amumuyɛɛ.

english_verse: You eat the deadly eggs of poisonous snakes, and more snakes crawl out from the eggs left to hatch. You weave spider webs,
translation_verse: Bɛkɔ ɛkyenebene ngyiremvua so abu bɛbobɔ bɛ, bɛnwo ananze ndendaen, ebiala bɔ odi bɛ ngyiremvua ne, owu, na sɛ ebie gyerɛgyerɛ bie a, ɛbɔnaa fi nu fite.

english_verse: but you can't make clothes with those webs or hide behind them. You're sinful and brutal.
translation_verse: Bɛ ndendaen ne, ɔngɔyɛ ɛtena, yeɛ bɛ yɔleɛ ne koso, bɛfa begurɔ bɛ nwo a ɔnyɛ yee. Bɛ yɔleɛ te abusudeɛ, na atutureasɛm ali bɛ ti.

english_verse: You hurry off to do wrong or murder innocent victims. All you think about is sin; you leave ruin and destruction wherever you go.
translation_verse: Bɛ gya tutu amirika kɔyɔ bɔne, na bɛngyɛ ye nwo ná bahã mogya bɔ odi be ɔ bagua; amumuyɛɛ nwo adwene ali bɛ ti, na nzɛmmɔne ne nningyein sɛkyelɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ b’atee nu ɔ.

english_verse: You don't know how to live in peace or to be fair with others. The roads you make are crooked; your followers cannot find peace. The People Confess Their Sins
translation_verse: Asomdwee atee de, bɛnze, yeɛ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ nne b’atee nu; bama b’atee akondokondo, na sona biala bɔ ɔfa so ne, onnya asomdwee.

english_verse: No one has come to defend us or to bring about justice. We hoped for a day of sunshine, but all we found was a dark, gloomy night.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, yɛ ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ afia atee awale, yeɛ tenenee koso yɛne ye abɔ nzahoɛ; yɛpena kanea, nakoso, nea, yɛte awosii nu, yɛ nye la hyireinn ate, nakoso yɛnate awosii kabii nu.

english_verse: We feel our way along, as if we were blind; we stumble at noon, as if it were night. We can see no better than someone dead.
translation_verse: Yɛfuafua yɛpena terɛ kyɛ anyesiniwaafoɛ, yɛfuafua kyɛ bɛ bɔ belle anyeɛ ɔ; yɛsoti eyia ketee kyɛ kɔngɔen ahɔ ɔ, na yɛte kyɛ awufoɛ wɔ anwoserɛfoɛ nu.

english_verse: We growl like bears and mourn like doves. We hope for justice and victory, but they escape us.
translation_verse: Yɛ mukoraa yɛpo kyɛ kwabrafo, yɛpene kyɛ mmubure, yɛpena pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ, nakoso ebie nne berɛ, yeɛ yɛpena ngoalelɛ, nakoso ɔne yɛ afia atee wale.

english_verse: How often have we sinned and turned against you, the Lord God? Our sins condemn us! We have done wrong.
translation_verse: Yɛ mmeraatolɛ asone pee wɔ wɔ nyunu, na yɛ bɔne di adanzeɛ tia yɛ, ofikyɛ yɛ mmeraatolɛ la yɛ nyunu, na yɛ amumuyɛɛ koso, yɛse:

english_verse: We have rebelled and refused to follow you. Our hearts were deceitful, and so we lied; we planned to abuse others and turn our backs on you.
translation_verse: Yato AWURADE mmeraa, yeɛ yapɛ ye ngondombo, yayakyi yɛ Nyameɛ si lilɛ, yɛ dwudwolɛ te nhyɛsoɛ ne ɛlɔenyɛlɛ, na yɛ ti anu nzusuleɛ bɔ ofite yɛ noa ne, ɔte nnakannaka.

english_verse: Injustice is everywhere; justice seems far away. Truth is chased out of court; honesty is shoved aside.
translation_verse: Yasumu ndɛen turoloo yahɔ nziɛ, yeɛ tenenee waagyina dedeede; ofikyɛ nahorɛ afi ase wɔ dwaaso, yeɛ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ onnya atee mma nu.

english_verse: Everyone tells lies; those who turn from crime end up ruined. The Lord Will Rescue His People When the Lord noticed that justice had disappeared, he became very displeased.
translation_verse: Amba, nahorɛ ayie, na ebiala bɔ ɔtwe ye nwo fi bɔne nwo ne, odi amia wɔ mmenia sa nu. AWURADE nwuni ye, na wanyɛ ye fɛ kyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ biala nne berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: It disgusted him even more to learn that no one would do a thing about it. So with his own powerful arm, he won victories for truth.
translation_verse: Onwuni kyɛ sona biala nne berɛ, na ɔyɛle ye nwanwa kyɛ kamafoɛ biala nne berɛ ɔ; yiti ye tumi maa onyane ngoalelɛ, na ye tenenee tiretirale ye nu.

english_verse: Justice was the Lord's armor; saving power was his helmet; anger and revenge were his clothes.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔfale tenenee wurale kyɛ buralɛ bɔ ɔkata bɛ hue so ɔ, yeɛ ɔfale ngoalelɛ buralɛ kyerɛ wurale ye ti; ɔfale wereɛtɔlɛ ataadeɛ wurale, na ɔfale nungunɛhwenɛ herale kyɛ ɛtena.

english_verse: Now the Lord will get furious and do to his enemies, both near and far, what they did to his people.
translation_verse: Okotua bɛ kerɛ kyɛbɔ bɛ yɔleɛ te ɔ, ye ahone kohu bɛ bɔ bekyi ye ɔ so, yeɛ okotua ye pɔfoɛ mɔ so kerɛ, yeɛ supɔ mɔ koso, okotua bɛ so kerɛ.

english_verse: He will attack like a flood in a mighty windstorm. Nations in the west and the east will then honor and praise his wonderful name.
translation_verse: Yiti bekosuro AWURADE dumaa bekofi eyia atɔleɛ, yeɛ bekosuro ye animnyam bekofi eyia afiteleɛ, ofikyɛ ɔkɔwa kyɛ asue bɔ ɔsẽ wuruwuru bɔ AWURADE mvrama fa ye kɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has promised to rescue the city of Zion and Jacob's descendants who turn from sin.
translation_verse: Defoɛ ne kɔwa Sion, ɔkɔwa kɔma Yakob boso ama bɔ bɛtwe bɛ nwo befi mmeraatolɛ nwo ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The Lord says: “My people, I promise to give you my Spirit and my message. These will be my gifts to you and your families forever. I, the Lord, have spoken.”
translation_verse: “Na me de, m’apam bɔ me ne bɛ yayɛ hɔ ɛne, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne: Me sunzum bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ so, yeɛ me dwirɛ bɔ mafa matua wɔ noa ne, ɛngɔyakyi ye hanɛ, wɔ bosofoɛ ngɔyakyi ye hanɛ, yeɛ wɔ bosofoɛ bɛ bosofoɛ ngɔyakyi ye hanɛ, ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkwaadwu afebɔɔ ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: Jerusalem, stand up! Shine! Your new day is dawning. The glory of the Lord shines brightly on you.
translation_verse: Dwɔso, ta hyireinn, ofikyɛ wɔ kanea ne wawa, yeɛ AWURADE animnyam ne apukye wɔ so.

english_verse: The earth and its people are covered with darkness, but the glory of the Lord is shining upon you.
translation_verse: Tie, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ awosii kɔkata aseɛ so, ná awosii kabii amundu so ama so de, nakoso wɔ de, AWURADE kopukye wɔ so, na ye animnyam ne kɔla ye nwo ali wɔ wɔ so.

english_verse: Nations and kings will come to the light of your dawning day. Crowds Are Coming to Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Maen maen mɔ bɛkɔwa wɔ kanea ne anu, yeɛ ahemvo mɔ koso bɛkɔwa kanea hyireinn bɔ wapukye wɔ so ne anu.

english_verse: Open your eyes! Look around! Crowds are coming. Your sons are on their way from distant lands; your daughters are being carried like little children.
translation_verse: To wɔ nye anwuro nea bra yia, bɛ mukoraa baboa bɛ noa, bɛ́ba wɔ berɛ; wɔ mma mmienzua befi dedeede yeɛ bɛ́ba ɔ, na wɔ mma mmrasua koso, badodo bɛ yeɛ bɛ́ba ɔ.

english_verse: When you see this, your faces will glow; your hearts will pound and swell with pride. Treasures from across the sea and the wealth of nations will be brought to you.
translation_verse: Afei ekonwu ye, na ɔkɔyɛ wɔ anika, wɔ nye kɔgye maa ekoli ahurusi, ofikyɛ ɛpo so anwonyadeɛ pee kobri kɔwa wɔ berɛ, na maen maen mɔ b’anwonya kɔwa wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: Your country will be covered with caravans of young camels from Midian and Ephah. The people of Sheba will bring gold and spices in praise of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Wɔ maen ne anu afupɔngɔ kɔyɛ pee, bɛte afupɔngɔ akrɔngrɔma bɔ befi Midian ne Efa; bɛ bɔ befi Hyeba ne amukoraa, bɛ́ba. Bɛsoso sikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛyɛɛ bɛ́ba, bɔ bɛ́bɔ AWURADE ayɛyelɛ nwo dawure ɔ.

english_verse: Every sheep of Kedar will come to you; rams from Nebaioth will be yours as well. I will accept them as offerings and bring honor to my temple.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔboaboa Kedare nyɛmmoa amukoraa noa bɛkɔbrɛ wɔ, Nebayote mmoaen nyii kɔyɛ wɔ deɛ, bɛkɔyɛ anyesɔ afɔleɛ wɔ m’afɔleɛ bokyea so, na ngɔhyɛ m’animnyam awuro ne animnyam.

english_verse: What is that sailing by like clouds or like doves flying home?
translation_verse: Nwa mɔ ole ɛhemɔ bɔ betu kyɛ munungum e, bɔ betu kyɛ mmubure bɔ bɛkwaawura bɛ saen nu e?

english_verse: On those distant islands your people are waiting for me, the Lord. Seagoing ships lead the way to bring them home with their silver and gold. I, the holy Lord God of Israel, do this to honor your people, so they will honor me. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt The Lord said:
translation_verse: Amba, supɔ mɔ kɔnwondɛ me, Tasise ɛlɛen mɔ yeɛ bekoli moa ɔ, bɛkɔfa wɔ mma mɔ bekofi dedeede bɛkɔwa bɔ b’ɛdwetɛ ne bɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ boka so, bɔ bɛbaafa bɛhyɛ AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ dumaa animnyam, ɔne Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne animnyam ɔ, ofikyɛ wahyɛ wɔ animnyam.

english_verse: Jerusalem, your city walls will be rebuilt by foreigners; their rulers will become your slaves. I punished you in my anger; now I will be kind and treat you with mercy.
translation_verse: Amanvorafoɛ kɔto wɔ fasue nemɔ, yeɛ b’ahemvo mɔ koso bɛkɔso wɔ, ofikyɛ m’ahonehulɛ ne anu, ndeane wɔ, nakoso me paayɛlɛ ne anu, manwu wɔ anwumvoin.

english_verse: Your gates will be open day and night to let the rulers of nations lead their people to you with all their treasures.
translation_verse: Wɔ pambim nemɔ bɛkɔlela berɛ too daa biala, eyia ne kɔngɔen bɛngɔtoto nu, amaa ɔnate so mmenia afa maen maen mɔ b’anwonya babrɛ wɔ bɔ b’ahemvo mɔ beli bɛ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ maen anaa ahennie bɔ ɔngɔso wɔ ne, okogu; na bɛkɔbɔ sɔ maen nemɔ bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Wood from Lebanon's best trees will be brought to you— the pines, the firs, and the cypress trees. It will be used in my temple to make beautiful the place where I rest my feet.
translation_verse: “Lebanon animnyam kɔwa wɔ berɛ, bɔ ɔte ye ɛframmire, pataboɛ ne ammire ne, bɔ ɛkɔfa kosiesie me nekaa krongron ne ɔ, na ngɔhyɛ nekaa bɔ me gya tia ne animnyam.

english_verse: The descendants of enemies who hated and mistreated you will kneel at your feet. They will say, “You are Zion, the city of the Lord, the holy One of Israel.”
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bɛhyɛle wɔ so ne, bɛ boso ama kɔwa bɛkɔɔkoto wɔ; yeɛ ebiala bɔ obuli wɔ animtia ne, okoobu ndwerɛ wɔ wɔ gya bo; bɛkɔfrɛ wɔ AWURADE Kuro, Yisrael Krongronniɛ ne, ye Sion.

english_verse: You were hated and deserted, rejected by everyone. But I will make you beautiful, a city to be proud of for all time to come.
translation_verse: “Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bapo wɔ, yeɛ bɛpɔ wɔ, bɔ sona biala ɔmma mbɛ nu wɔ wɔ nu ɔ, nakoso ngɔmaa ekonya animnyam afebɔɔ, bɔ ɔte aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa b’anigye nikye ɔ.

english_verse: You will drain the wealth of kings and foreign nations. You will know that I, the mighty Lord God of Israel, have saved and rescued you.
translation_verse: Ɛkɔno maen maen mɔ bɛ nyɔfonesue, yeɛ ekoli ahemvo mɔ b’anwonya, na ekonwu ye kyɛ me, AWURADE, me ole wɔ Ngoadefoɛ ne wɔ Defoɛ, Yakob ye Tuminiɛ ne.

english_verse: I will bring bronze and iron in place of wood and stone; in place of bronze and iron, I will bring gold and silver. I will appoint peace and justice as your rulers and leaders.
translation_verse: “Ngɔfa sikaa kɔkorɛ mmom ngoosi kɔɔbere gya nu, ngɔfa ɛdwetɛ mmom ngoosi buralɛ gya nu, ná kɔɔbere mmom waasi bakaa gya nu, ná buralɛ mmom waasi nyɔboɛ gya nu. Ngɔma asomdwee kɔyɛ wɔ so panyi kɔnea wɔ so, ná mama tenenee ayɛ wɔ mene.

english_verse: Violence, destruction, and ruin will never again be heard of within your borders. “Victory” will be the name you give to your walls; “Praise” will be the name you give to your gates.
translation_verse: Bɛngɔte basabasayɔlɛ nga ko wɔ w’aseɛ so, bɛngɔte nzɛmmɔne anaa nningyein sɛkyelɛ nga wɔ w’aseɛ ne aso kodwu ɛwɛen so; ɛkɔfrɛ wɔ fasue mɔ: Ngoalelɛ, ɔne wɔ kuro pambim mɔ: Ayɛyelɛ.

english_verse: You won't need the light of the sun or the moon. I, the Lord your God, will be your eternal light and bring you honor.
translation_verse: “Nna eyia yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ wɔ kanea alehyeleɛ ɔ ko, yeɛ nna ɛsraen yeɛ ɔkɔta hyireinn kɔma wɔ alesaleɛ nu ɔ, na mmom AWURADE yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ wɔ kanea afebɔɔ ɔ, na wɔ Nyameɛ kɔyɛ w’animnyam.

english_verse: Your sun will never set or your moon go down. I, the Lord, will be your everlasting light, and your days of sorrow will come to an end.
translation_verse: Wɔ yia ngɔtɔ ko, yeɛ wɔ ɛsraen koso ngowu, ofikyɛ AWURADE yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ wɔ kanea afebɔɔ ɔ, na w’aworabɔlɛ ngyẽa ne, ye bo kɔpɛ.

english_verse: Your people will live right and always own the land; they are the trees I planted to bring praise to me.
translation_verse: Wɔ mmenia ne amukoraa bɛkɔyɛ teneneefoɛ, bɛkɔfa aseɛ ne bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ afebɔɔ, bɛte bakaa bɔ malua bɔ wafefɛ ɔ, me sa noa adwuma bɔ ɔhyɛ me animnyam ɔ.

english_verse: Even the smallest family will be a powerful nation. I am the Lord, and when the time comes, I will quickly do all this.
translation_verse: Wɔ nu kaaba ne po, ɔkɔkakyi abusua, yeɛ bɔ ɔte kãa paa ne, ɔkɔkakyi anwoserɛ maen. Me, AWURADE, sɔ mmerɛ ne dwu a, ngɔmaa ɔkɔyɛ berɛ ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: The Spirit of the Lord God has taken control of me! The Lord has chosen and sent me to tell the oppressed the good news, to heal the brokenhearted, and to announce freedom for prisoners and captives.
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ Sunzum wɔ me so, ɔnate kyɛ AWURADE apopa me ngoo kyɛ nga nzɛmba ngyire bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ; wasoma me kyɛ mmangyekye bɛ bɔ bɛ wora abɔ ɔ bɛ wora, kyɛ nga ngyire bɛ bɔ bahye bɛ nnure ɔ kyɛ banya fawɔnwodi, ɔne bɛ bɔ babɔ bɛ panwu ɔ kyɛ bayakyi bɛ;

english_verse: This is the year when the Lord God will show kindness to us and punish our enemies. The Lord has sent me to comfort those who mourn,
translation_verse: kyɛ mmɔ AWURADE anwumvoinnwunɛ afoɛ ne nwo dawure, ɔne yɛ Nyameɛ wereɛtɔlɛ kyẽa ne nwo dawure, kyɛ ngyekye ebiala bɔ ye wora abɔ ɔ wora;

english_verse: especially in Jerusalem. He sent me to give them flowers in place of their sorrow, olive oil in place of tears, and joyous praise in place of broken hearts. They will be called “Trees of Justice,” planted by the Lord to honor his name.
translation_verse: kyɛ bɛ bɔ bedi aworabɔlɛ wɔ Sion ne, mva nyerɛen akomuade nzi nzoen gya nu mma bɛ, kyɛ mva anigye ngoo nzi aworabɔlɛ gya nu mma bɛ, kyɛ mva ayɛyelɛ tena nzi aworabɔlɛ gya nu, amaa ɔnate so bafrɛ bɛ tenenee mmakaa, bɔ AWURADE alua bɔ ɔhyɛ ye animnyam ɔ.

english_verse: They will hire foreigners to take care of their sheep and their vineyards.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ kogyina kɔnea ɛmɔ mmoaen so, amanvrafoɛ kɔyɛ ɛmɔ apaafoɛ ne bobe boo so neafoɛ,

english_verse: But they themselves will be priests and servants of the Lord our God. The treasures of the nations will belong to them, and they will be famous.
translation_verse: nakoso ɛmɔ de, bɛkɔfrɛ ɛmɔ AWURADE asɔfo, mmenia kɔhã kyɛ ɛmɔte yɛ Nyameɛ somvoɛ mɔ; ɛmɔkoli maen maen mɔ b’anwonya, na ɛmɔkɔfa b’anwonya nningyein ne bɛkɔhoahoa ɛmɔ nwo.

english_verse: They were terribly insulted and horribly mistreated; now they will be greatly blessed and joyful forever. The Lord Loves Justice
translation_verse: Bɔ ɛmɔkonya ye bekosi ɛmɔ animguaseɛ ne gya nu ne, ɔkɔyɛ mmɔhoɛ nyɔ, ɛmɔ nyanzoen ne, ɛmɔkoli ahurusi bekosi ye gya nu, yiti ɛmɔkonya ye mmɔhoɛ mmɔhoɛ wɔ ɛmɔ aseɛ ne aso, na ɛmɔkonya anika bɔ olle ayieleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, love justice! But I hate robbery and injustice. My people, I solemnly promise to reward you with an eternal agreement.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me, AWURADE, mekuro pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ, mekyi naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔte awue nikye ɔ, ngogyina pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ so ngɔma bɛ akatuaa, na me ne bɛ yɛkɔyɛ apam afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Your descendants will be known in every nation. All who see them will realize that they have been blessed, by me, the Lord. Celebrate and Shout
translation_verse: Bɛ boso ama konya dumaa piri wɔ maen maen mɔ nu, yeɛ bɛ mma koso bekonya dumaa piri wɔ maen maen mɔ nu; na ebiala bɔ okonwu bɛ ne, okole kɔto nu kyɛ bɛte maen bɔ AWURADE ayira ye ɔ.

english_verse: I celebrate and shout because of my Lord God. His saving power and justice are the very clothes I wear. They are more beautiful than the jewelry worn by a bride or groom.
translation_verse: Ngoli ahurusi piri paa wɔ AWURADE nu, me Nyameɛ nu yeɛ me kra di ahurusi ɔ; ofikyɛ wafa ngoalelɛ ataadeɛ wawura me, wafa tenenee tena wahera me, kyɛbɔ atɔmvorɛ biaa fa abotire siesie ye nwo ɔ, kyɛbɔ atɔmvorɛ braa fa ye mbembenanneɛ siesie ye nwo ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will bring about justice and praise in every nation on earth, like flowers blooming in a garden.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ aseɛ ma ndire fifi wɔ so, ná turo koso ma bɔ balua ye wɔ nu fifi ne, sɔ ala yeɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ kɔma tenenee ne ayɛyelɛ kofifi wɔ maen maen amukoraa nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, I will speak up for your good. I will never be silent till you are safe and secure, sparkling like a flame.
translation_verse: Sion ti mengɔhã me noa mengɔto nu, yeɛ Yerusalem ti mengɔyɛ konn, kɔpem kyɛ ye bebualɛ kopukye kyɛ alehyeleɛ kanea, ɔne kyɛ ye ngoalelɛ kopukye kyɛ ɛtɛen bɔ ogye ɔ.

english_verse: Your great victory will be seen by every nation and king; the Lord will even give you a new name.
translation_verse: Maen maen mɔ konwu wɔ bebualɛ ne, yeɛ ahemvo amukoraa bekonwu w’animnyam; bɛkɔfa dumaa foforɛ yeɛ bɛkɔfrɛ wɔ ɔ, bɔ ɔte dumaa bɔ okofi AWURADE noa nu kɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: You will be a glorious crown, a royal headband for the Lord your God.
translation_verse: Ɛkɔyɛ animnyam abotire wɔ AWURADE sa nu, ɔne ahemvo abotire wɔ wɔ Nyameɛ sa nu.

english_verse: Your name will no longer be “Deserted and Childless,” but “Happily Married.” You will please the Lord; your country will be his bride.
translation_verse: Bɛngɔfrɛ wɔ “Bɔ bapo ye ɔ” ko, yeɛ bɛngɔfrɛ w’aseɛ ne “Kurofoen” ko; na mmom bɛkɔfrɛ wɔ Hefesiba, yeɛ w’aseɛ ne koso bɛkɔfrɛ ye Bewela; ofikyɛ ɛla AWURADE ahone nwo, na okogya w’aseɛ ne.

english_verse: Your people will take the land, just as a young man takes a bride. The Lord will be pleased because of you, just as a husband is pleased with his bride.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ aberandeɛ gya ababunu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ wɔ mma mmienzua mɔ bekogya wɔ ɔ; yeɛ kyɛbɔ atɔmvorɛ biaa odi ahurusi wɔ atɔmvorɛ braa nwo ne, sɔ ala yeɛ wɔ Nyameɛ koli ahurusi wɔ wɔ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, on your walls I have stationed guards, whose duty it is to speak out day and night, without resting. They must remind the Lord
translation_verse: O Yerusalem, wɔ fasue nemɔ aso yeɛ mafa awɛmvoɛ magyinagyina ɔ; alehyeleɛ nu amukoraa ne alesaleɛ nu amukoraa bengomua bɛ noa. Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsu bɛfrɛ AWURADE ne, nnɛma ɛmɔyakyi bede bɛ nwome.

english_verse: and not let him rest till he makes Jerusalem strong and famous everywhere.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma ode ye nwome kɔpem kyɛ okosa kɔkyekye Yerusalem, ɔne kyɛ ɔkɔfa ye kɔyɛ kuro bɔ bɛkamvo ye wɔ aseɛ so amukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has given his word and made this promise: “Never again will I give to your enemies the grain and grapes for which you struggled.
translation_verse: AWURADE afa ye sa famaa ne ye tumi asaa ne wata ndaen kyɛ, “Amba, mengɔfa w’aburoo mengɔma wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ ma ɔngɔyɛ b’aleɛ ko, yeɛ amanvrafoɛ koso, bɛngɔno wɔ nzaa bɔ afɛ wɔ nwo ayɛ ne ko.

english_verse: As surely as you harvest your grain and grapes, you will eat your bread with thankful hearts, and you will drink your wine in my temple.”
translation_verse: Na mmom bɛ bɔ bɛboaboa ye noa ne, bɛ yeɛ bekoli ná baye AWURADE ayɛ ɔ; bɛ bɔ bɛboaboa bobe mmaa ne noa ne, bɛ yeɛ bɛkɔno ye wɔ me nekaa krongron n’aluo berɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, open your gates! Repair the road to the city and clear it of stones; raise a banner to help the nations find their way.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔworo, ɛ́mɔworo pambim nemɔ anu, ɛ́mɔsiesie atee ne bɛ́ma maen ne, ɛ́mɔye atimbire ne, ɛ́mɔye atimbire ne, ɛ́mɔtutu nyɔboɛ ne béfi so, ɛ́mɔfa frangaa bɛ́pena berɛ bɛ́ma maen maen mɔ.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord has said for all the earth to hear: “Soon I will come to save the city of Zion and to reward you.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, AWURADE abɔ ye dawure maa waadwu aseɛ so nekaa biala. Ɔnwa nyoo, “Ɛmɔhã behyire Sion awa brasua ne kyɛ, ‘Tie, wɔ ngoalelɛ ne ɔ́ba, tie, ye ngonim akatuaa ne boka ye so, na ye akatuaa ne li ye nyunu.’”

english_verse: Then you will be called, ‘The Lord's Own People, The Ones He Rescued!’ Your city will be known as a good place to live and a city full of people.”
translation_verse: Na bɛkɔfrɛ bɛ: Maen krongron, Mmenia bɔ AWURADE apɔ bɛ wale bɛ ɔ, na wɔ de, bɛkɔfrɛ wɔ: Bɔ baapena ye si atee banwu ye ɔ, Kuro bɔ bambo ye ɔ.

english_verse: Who is this coming from Bozrah in Edom with clothes stained red? Who is this hero marching in his glorious uniform? “It's me, the Lord! I have won the battle, and I can save you!”
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ofi Edom ɔ́ba e, bɔ ye ndaadeɛ nye gonn bɔ ofi Bosra ɔ́ba e? Ye bɔ ɔhera ɛtena nyemenenyemene ɔ, bɔ ole tumi pirikua otiatia ba e? “Me ɔ. Me bɔ mebɔ tenenee nwo dawure ne ɔ, Tuminiɛ bɔ mede ngoa ne ɔ.”

english_verse: I did this because I wanted to take revenge— the time had come to rescue my people.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ né madwene wereɛtɔlɛ kyẽa bie anwo, na m’afoɛ bɔ mefa mepepɛ mede me maen ne waso.

english_verse: No one was there to help me or to give support; my mighty arm won the battle, strengthened by my anger.
translation_verse: Ndole me nye neane, nakoso né bokafoɛ biala nne berɛ; me nwo dwirili me kyɛ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ okogyina me si ɔ; yiti me bɔbɔ me tumi yeɛ olili ngonim mane me ɔ, na m’ahonehulɛ koso gyinane me si.

english_verse: In my fury I trampled on nations and made them drunk; their blood poured out everywhere on earth.” The Lord's Goodness to His People
translation_verse: Me yaafɛlɛ nu yeɛ ndiatiale maen maen mɔ so ɔ, m’ahonehulɛ nu yeɛ mmaa bɛbole nzaa ɔ, na nhwiele bɛ mogya nguale aseɛ so.”

english_verse: I will tell about the kind deeds the Lord has done. They deserve praise! The Lord has shown mercy to the people of Israel; he has been kind and good.
translation_verse: Ngɔhã AWURADE ye dɔ pindinn ne, ɔne AWURADE ayɛyelɛ ne nwo dwirɛ, bɔ ɔfa bɔ AWURADE ayɔ ama yɛ amukoraa nwo, ɔne paa kandinga bɔ wafa wayɛ Yisrael awuro ama ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔnate ye anwumvoinnwunɛ so, ɔne kyɛbɔ ye dɔ pindinn ne piri ɔte ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord rescued his people, and said, “They are mine. They won't betray me.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔnwa: ‘Nahorɛ nu, bɛte me maen, mmaa bɔ bɛngɔpɛ ngondombo ɔ,’ na ɔyɛle bɛ Ngoadefoɛ.

english_verse: It troubled the Lord to see them in trouble, and his angel saved them. The Lord was truly merciful, so he rescued his people. He took them in his arms and carried them all those years.
translation_verse: Bɛ yealɛlilɛ amukoraa nu ne, ɔyɛle ye yea, na ye nyunu abɔfo ne, ɔpepɛ lele bɛ; ɔnate ye dɔ ne ye anwumvoinnwunɛ ne aso ɔpepɛ lele bɛ, ɔpagyale bɛ, na ododole bɛ wɔ daa tete mmerɛ ne amukoraa.

english_verse: Then the Lord's people turned against him and made his Holy Spirit sad. So he became their enemy and attacked them.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ de, bɛyɛle lɔen bɛmane ye Sunzum krongron ne wora bɔle; yiti ɔpɛle ye nwo yɛle bɛ pɔfoɛ, na ye bɔbɔ ɔho tiale bɛ.

english_verse: But his people remembered what had happened during the time of Moses. Didn't the Lord bring them and their leaders safely through the sea? Didn't he give them his Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Na afei ɔkayele daa tete mmerɛ ne, Mose ne ye maen, na obisale kyɛ, Ye bɔ ɔyele bɛ fili ɛpo nu, bɔ ɔte ye mmoaen so neafoɛ ne, ɔwɔ nisua? Ye bɔ ɔfale ye Sunzum krongron ne ɔɔtenane bɛ nu ne, ɔwɔ nisua?

english_verse: The glorious power of the Lord marched beside Moses. The Lord will be praised forever for dividing the sea.
translation_verse: Ye bɔ ɔmane ye animnyam asaa ne oolili Mose famaa so, ná ɔne ye bɛnatele ne, ye bɔ ɔpakyele nzue ne anu wɔ bɛ nyunu ɔfa nyane dumaa afebɔɔ mane ye nwo ne;

english_verse: He led his people across like horses running wild without stumbling.
translation_verse: ye bɔ ɔfale bɛ fale buma ne anu kyɛbɔ pɔngɔ fa ɛserɛ so ne, na banzoti.

english_verse: His Spirit gave them rest, just as cattle find rest when led into a valley. The name of the Lord was praised for doing these things. A Prayer for Mercy and Help
translation_verse: Na AWURADE Sunzum ne maa belele bɛ nwome kyɛ nandwie mɔ bɔ bɛtorotoro bɛkɔ bɔnza nu ɔ. Sɔ yeɛ ehyirele wɔ maen atee ɛfa nyane animnyam dumaa mane wɔ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Please, Lord, look down from your holy and glorious home in the heavens and see what's going on. Have you lost interest? Where is your power? Show that you care about us and have mercy!
translation_verse: To wɔ nye fi nyameɛso nea, to wɔ nye fi wɔ krongron ne w’animnyam atenaleɛ berɛ nea. Wɔ nungunɛ ne w’anwoserɛ ne, ɔwɔ nisua? Wɔ kunu tetelɛ ne w’anwumvoinnwunɛ ne, aye afi me nwo anaa?

english_verse: Our ancestors Abraham and Jacob have both rejected us. But you are still our Father; you have been our protector since ancient times.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte yɛ Baba ɔ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ Abraham nze yɛ, yeɛ Yisrael koso onne yɛ ndo nu; O AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ ɛte yɛ Baba ɔ, yɛ Defoɛ, wɔ dumaa ne ɔwɔ berɛ fi tetetete.

english_verse: Why did you make us turn away from you, our Lord? Why did you make us want to disobey you? Please change your mind! We are your servants, your very own people.
translation_verse: O AWURADE, nzu ati yeɛ amaa yali w’atee nwo makyebu, bɔ yayɛ asoserɛ maa yiti yɛnzuro wɔ e? Sa bra, ɔnate wɔ ngoaa ti, w’agyapadeɛ mmusua kure nemɔ ati.

english_verse: For a little while, your temple belonged to us; and now our enemies have torn it down.
translation_verse: Wɔ maen krongron ne, onyane w’agyapadeɛ ne mmerɛ kãa bie, nakoso yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ bahwi bafa wɔ nekaa krongron ne aso.

english_verse: We act as though you had never ruled us or called us your people.
translation_verse: Yayɛ kyɛ mmenia bɔ ellili bɛ so hene le ɔ, yayɛ kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛmva wɔ dumaa bɛmvrɛ bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Rip the heavens apart! Come down, Lord; make the mountains tremble.
translation_verse: O, sɛ ahaa ekosunzua ewienu nu ná ekodwu ase maa mmokaa kopusu wɔ wɔ nyunu a!

english_verse: Be a spark that starts a fire causing water to boil. Then your enemies will know who you are; all nations will tremble because you are nearby.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ see sɔ ndire worowaa nu, ɔne kyɛbɔ see ma nzue hu ne, ma wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ benwu wɔ dumaa, ná maen maen mɔ bɛ nwo ɔwosowoso bɛ wɔ wɔ nyunu!

english_verse: Your fearsome deeds have completely amazed us; even the mountains shake when you come down.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ ɛyɔle nningyein suronyisuronyi maa ofuni yɛ nu ne, edwuli ase, na mmokaa wosole wɔ wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: You help all who gladly obey and do what you want, but sin makes you angry. Only by your help can we ever be saved.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔbɔ tenenee bra wɔ anigye so ne, bɔ ɔkaye wɔ ɔfa w’atee so ne, ɛyɛ ye awaawaatuu. Tie, yɛ bɔne maa ɛfɛle yaa, yɛ bɔne nu yeɛ yɛtɛte ye dadadada ɔ, aso ekole yɛ ngoa anaa?

english_verse: We are unfit to worship you; each of our good deeds is merely a filthy rag. We dry up like leaves; our sins are storm winds sweeping us away.
translation_verse: Yɛ mukoraa yayɛ kyɛ nikyee bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ, na yɛ tenenee amukoraa ɔte kyɛ ndangurɛ fiɛ; yɛ mukoraa yɛkese kyɛ nyaa, na yɛ amumuyɛɛ pia yɛ kɔ kyɛ mvrama.

english_verse: No one worships in your name or remains faithful. You have turned your back on us and let our sins melt us away.
translation_verse: Ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔbɔ wɔ dumaa sɔne wɔ ɔ bɔ waye ye kunu wafa ye nwo wabɔ wɔ ɔ; ofikyɛ aye wɔ nye ato buro afea yɛ, na yɛ amumuyɛɛ ti ahũhũ yɛ.

english_verse: You, Lord, are our Father. We are nothing but clay, but you are the potter who molded us.
translation_verse: Nakoso, O AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ ɛte yɛ Baba ɔ, yɛ de, yɛte ɛfaa, na wɔ yeɛ ɛnwo yɛ ɔ; na yɛ mukoraa yɛte wɔ sa noa adwuma.

english_verse: Don't be so furious or keep our sins in your thoughts forever! Remember that all of us are your people.
translation_verse: O AWURADE, nnɛfɛ yaa piri, yeɛ nnɛkaye amumuyɛɛ afebɔɔ. Yɛsrɛ wɔ ala, kaye, yɛ mukoraa yɛte wɔ maen.

english_verse: Every one of your towns has turned into a desert, especially Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Wɔ nguro krongron nemɔ, bakakyi ɛserɛ, Sion akakyi ɛserɛ, yeɛ Yerusalem akakyi kurofoen.

english_verse: Zion's glorious and holy temple where our ancestors praised you has been destroyed by fire. Our beautiful buildings are now a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Yɛ awuro krongron nyemenenyemene bɔ yɛ nana mɔ bɛyele wɔ ayɛ wɔ nu ne, bafa see bayera ye, yeɛ nningyein bɔ bɛla yɛ ahone nwo ne amukoraa, bayɛ basaa.

english_verse: When you see these things, how can you just sit there and make us suffer more?
translation_verse: O AWURADE, aso ɛngɔfɛ yaa wɔ sɔ nningyein ne amukoraa nwo anaa? Aso ɛkɔyɛ konn ɛkɔprapra amaneɛ kogua yɛ so anaa?

english_verse: I, the Lord, was ready to answer even those who were not asking and to be found by those who were not searching. To a nation that refused to worship me, I said, “Here I am!”
translation_verse: “Nyɛle kyɛ ngotie bɛ bɔ bɛmbena me boso ne, nyɛle kyɛ ngɔma bɛ bɔ bɛmbena me si atee ne bekonwu me. Na ngane kyɛ, ‘Me ɛhe, me ɛhe!’ ngyirele maen bɔ wanye me dumaa ayɛ ne.

english_verse: All day long I have reached out to stubborn and sinful people going their own way.
translation_verse: Ndrɛtrɛle me sa nu daa mukoraa mane maen bɔ wayɛ lɔen ne, bɔ bɛnate atee bɔ ɔtte mayee so, bɔ bedi bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti piri ne;

english_verse: They keep making me angry by sneering at me, while offering sacrifices to idols in gardens and burning incense to them on bricks.
translation_verse: maen bɔ ye nye la ye nwo ɔkã me anyinga daa, bɔ bɛbobɔ afɔleɛ wɔ turo mɔ nu, bɛyera ɛyɛɛ wɔ mmerekese afɔleɛ mmokyea so;

english_verse: They spend their nights hiding in burial caves; they eat the meat of pigs, cooked in sauces made of stuff unfit to eat.
translation_verse: bɔ bɛtenatena asieleɛ mɔ nu, bɛtenatena mvealeɛ nu nekaa bie kɔngɔen, bɔ bedi prako naen, bɔ akyiwadeɛ turoo wɔ bɛ turonzemaa nu;

english_verse: And then they say to others, “Don't come near us! We're dedicated to God.” Such people are like smoke, irritating my nose all day.
translation_verse: mmenia bɔ bɛnwa: ‘Pingye dɔ, nnɛfa wɔ nwo kã me, ofikyɛ me de, me nwo te tra wɔ!’ Sɔ mmenia nemɔ bɛte kyɛ nwosina bɔ ɔkɔ me ti anu ɔ, bɛma m’ahone hu kyɛ see bɔ ogye daa biala ɔ.

english_verse: I have written this down; I won't keep silent. I'll pay them back just as their sins deserve.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, bahyerɛ yeɛ ɔla me nyunu ɔ: Mengɔyɛ konn, na mmom ngotua so kerɛ, yoo, ngotua so kerɛ maa ɔkɔbɔ bɛ ti so.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make them pay for their sins and for those of their ancestors— they have disgraced me by burning incense on mountains.
translation_verse: Ngɔhã ɛmɔ amumuyɛɛ ne ɛmɔ nana mɔ amumuyɛɛ ngɔbɔ nu ngotua so kerɛ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Na ɔnate kyɛ bɛyerale ɛyɛɛ wɔ mmokaa so, bɛgorole me nwo wɔ pambaa nemɔ aso ti, ngosusu bɛ yɔleɛ bɔ bayɔ ne, na ngotua so kerɛ.”

english_verse: Here is what the Lord says: A cluster of grapes that produces wine is worth keeping! So, because of my servants, I won't destroy everyone.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo: “Kyɛbɔ nzaa wɔ bobe betire biribiraa nu, maa mmenia bɛkã kyɛ, ‘Nnɛsɛkye ye, ofikyɛ saleɛ wɔ nu’ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ me somvoɛ mɔ ti ngɔyɔ ɔ, na mengohũhũ bɛ mukoraa.

english_verse: I have chosen the people of Israel and Judah, and I will bless them with many descendants. They will settle here in this land of mountains, and it will be theirs.
translation_verse: Ngɔye bosofoɛ mɔ ngofi Yakob nu, yeɛ ngɔye bɛ bɔ me mmokaa nemɔ kɔɔyɛ bɛ deɛ ɔ ngofi Yuda; bɛ bɔ maneanea nu maye bɛ ne yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ ɔ, na berɛ yeɛ me somvoɛ mɔ bɛkɔtena ɔ.

english_verse: My people will worship me. Then the coastlands of Sharon and the land as far as Achor Valley will turn into pastureland where cattle and sheep will feed and rest.
translation_verse: Saron kɔyɛ mmoaen kure mɔ bɛ nekaa bɔ bedidi ɔ, yeɛ Akɔre bɔnza kɔyɛ nekaa bɔ nandwie mɔ bɛkɔla bekole bɛ nwome ɔ, na sɔ nekaa nemɔ, bɛkɔyɛ me maen bɔ bapena me si atee ne bɛ deɛ.

english_verse: What will I, the Lord, do if any of you reject me and my holy mountain? What will happen to you for offering food and wine to the gods you call “Good Luck” and “Fate”?
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔpo AWURADE, bɔ ɛmɔ wora fi me bokaa krongron ne, bɔ ɛmɔto poen bɛma bosoen bɔ ɛmɔfrɛ ye Saleɛ, bɔ ɛmɔfa nzaa mvrafra begua kwangoa nu tɛkyɛɛ bɛma bosoen bɔ ɛmɔfrɛ ye Ngrabea ɔ;

english_verse: Your luck will end! I will see to it that you are slaughtered with swords. You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong.
translation_verse: na me koso ngɔma ɛmɔ kɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa, na ɛmɔ amukoraa bekobu ndwerɛ maa bekohu ɛmɔ; ofikyɛ mvrɛle ɛmɔ ne, ɛmɔandɛ me so, ndwudwole ne, ɛmɔandie, na mmom ɛmɔyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ me nye so ɔ, na bɔ menguro yeɛ ɛmɔyɔle ɔ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will give food and drink to my servants, and they will celebrate. But all of you sinners will go hungry and thirsty, overcome with disgrace.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE nwa nyoo: “Ɛ́mɔtie, me somvoɛ mɔ bekodidi, nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛhɔen kohũ ɛmɔ; ɛ́mɔtie, me somvoɛ mɔ bɛkɔno, nakoso ɛmɔ de, nzuhɔen kohũ ɛmɔ; ɛ́mɔtie, me somvoɛ mɔ bekoli ahurusi, nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔ nyunu kogua ase.

english_verse: My servants will laugh and sing, but you will be sad and cry out in pain.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, me somvoɛ mɔ bɛkɔto anigye dwein wɔ b’ahone nu, nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔkosu bekoli yealɛ wɔ ɛmɔ ahone nu, na ɛmɔkɔbɔ awuye bekoli aworabɔlɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, promise to see that you are killed and that my chosen servants use your names as curse words. But I will give new names to my servants.
translation_verse: Na me mmenia bɔ mapa nu maye bɛ ne, ɛmɔ dumaa bɔ ɛmɔkɔyakyi ye berɛ ne, ɔkɔyɛ b’amonwaa dwirɛ, na AWURADE Nyameɛ kohũhũ ɛmɔ; nakoso ye somvoɛ mɔ de, ɔkɔto bɛ dumaa foforɛ;

english_verse: I am God! I can be trusted. Your past troubles are gone; I no longer think of them. When you pray for someone to receive a blessing, or when you make a promise, you must do it in my name. I alone am the God who can be trusted. The Lord's New Creation
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so ebiala bɔ ɔkɔhã saleɛ dwirɛ kɔma ye nwo wɔ aseɛ ne aso ne, ɔkɔfa nahorɛlilɛ Nyameɛ ne yeɛ okoyira ye nwo ɔ; yeɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkɔta ndaen wɔ aseɛ ne aso ne, ɔkɔfa nahorɛlilɛ Nyameɛ ne yeɛ ɔkɔta ndaen ɔ; ofikyɛ bɛ wora kofi amaneɛ bɔ ɔtole bɛ daa ne, na mabu me nye magua so. Nyameɛso foforɛ ne aseɛ foforɛ

english_verse: I am creating new heavens and a new earth; everything of the past will be forgotten.
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ, tie, mebaabɔ nyameɛso foforɛ ne aseɛ foforɛ; na ɛmɔngɔkaye nningyein bɔ wapɛ nu wahɔ ne, yeɛ ɔngɔpe ɛmɔ ti anu ko.

english_verse: I will celebrate with Jerusalem and all its people; there will be no more crying or sorrow in that city.
translation_verse: Ngoli Yerusalem nwo ahurusi, na me nye kɔhã me maen nwo; bɛngɔte esuɛ wɔ nu ko, ɔne awuyebɔlɛ wɔ nu ko.

english_verse: No child will die in infancy; everyone will live a very long life. Anyone a hundred years old will be considered young, and to die younger than that will be considered a curse.
translation_verse: Adɔma bɔ bɛwo ye a ɔngyɛ né wawu ne, ebie ngosi ko wɔ kuro ne anu, yeɛ aworowaa bɔ wanyie ye afoɛ mukoraa di ne koso, sɔ ala; ofikyɛ bɔ okoli afoɛ ɛyaa koraka né wawu ne, bekobu ye akwadaa, yeɛ bɔnefoɛ bɔ okoli afoɛ ɛyaa koraka né wawu ne, bekobu ye kyɛ banoma ye.

english_verse: My people will live in the houses they build; they will enjoy grapes from their own vineyards.
translation_verse: Bekosisi sua bɛkɔtena nu, yeɛ bɛkɔyɛ bobe boo mɔ bekoli nu aleɛ.

english_verse: No one will take away their homes or vineyards. My chosen people will live to be as old as trees, and they will enjoy what they have earned.
translation_verse: Bengosi sua ngɔma sona foforɛ ngɔtena nu ko, yeɛ bengolua ngɔma sona foforɛ ngoli nu aleɛ. Na kyɛbɔ bakaa si nyi kyɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ me maen kɔyɛ ɔ, na me mmenia bɔ mapa nu maye bɛ ne, bekodidi bɛ sa noa adwuma nwo bɛkɔhyɛ.

english_verse: Their work won't be wasted, and their children won't die of dreadful diseases. I will bless their children and their grandchildren.
translation_verse: Bɛngɔyɔ adwuma ngɔfɛ mbaen, yeɛ bɛngɔwo mmaa bɔ bɛkɔpe bekowu ɔ; ofikyɛ bɛkɔyɛ bɛ bɔ AWURADE ayira bɛ ɔ bɛ bosofoɛ, bɛ ne bɛ mma mɔ.

english_verse: I will answer their prayers before they finish praying.
translation_verse: Anzana bɛbaasu bɛfrɛ ne po, né mama mmuayɛɛ, na begu so bedwudwo ne po, né matie.

english_verse: Wolves and lambs will graze together; lions and oxen will feed on straw. Snakes will eat only dirt! They won't bite or harm anyone on my holy mountain. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Pataku ne boaen ba bekodidi neka horɛ, gyata koli ndire kyɛ nandwie ala, na nnɛterɛ yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ ewoo aleɛ ɔ. Ebiala ngohũ anaa ongopura ebiala wɔ me bokaa krongron ne amukoraa so, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Heaven is my throne; the earth is my footstool. What kind of house could you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo: “Nyameɛso te m’ahennie bia, yeɛ aseɛ te me gya ndiasoɛ; nzikyɛ sua koraa yeɛ ɛmɔkosi bɛkɔma me ɔ, nisua yeɛ ngole me nwome ɔ?

english_verse: I have made everything; that's how it all came to be. I, the Lord, have spoken. The people I treasure most are the humble— they depend only on me and tremble when I speak.
translation_verse: Ɛhemɔ amukoraa mafa me sa yeɛ mayɔ ɔ, yiti ɛhemɔ amukoraa bɛte me deɛ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Nakoso sona bɔ ɔte sɔaa yeɛ mepena ɔ: bɔ ɔbrɛ ye nwo ase ná onya sunzum nu anwobrɛaseɛ ɔ, ɔne bɔ ɔfa anidie ma me dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You sacrifice oxen to me, and you commit murder; you sacrifice lambs to me and dogs to other gods; you offer grain to me and pigs' blood to idols; you burn incense to me and praise your idols. You have made your own choice to do these disgusting things that you enjoy so much.
translation_verse: “Sona bɔ oku nandwie ne, ɔte kyɛ bɔ oku mmenia ɔ ala, bɔ ɔfa boaen bɔ afɔleɛ ne, ɔte kyɛ bɔ obu kyea kɔme anu ɔ, bɔ ɔbɔ aburoo afɔleɛ ne, ɔte kyɛ bɔ ɔfa prako mogya bɔ afɔleɛ ɔ, bɔ ɔyera ɛyɛɛ ne, ɔte kyɛ sona bɔ ɔsɔ amoen ɔ. Bɛ de, bali bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti piri, na b’akyiwadeɛ nemɔ yeɛ bɛ kra nye gye ye nwo ɔ.

english_verse: You refused to answer when I called out; you paid no attention to my instructions. Instead, you did what I hated, knowing it was wrong. Now I will punish you in a way you dread the most. The Lord Will Help Jerusalem
translation_verse: Na me koso, ngɔneanea nu ngɔye asohwenɛ ngɔma bɛ, na bɔ besuro ne yeɛ ngɔmaa ɔkɔto bɛ ɔ; ofikyɛ mvrɛle ne, ebiala andɛ me so, ndwudwole ne, bandie, na mmom bɛyɔle bɔ ɔte bɔne wɔ me nye so ɔ, yeɛ bɔ me nye ngye ye nwo ne yeɛ bɛfale ɔ.”

english_verse: If you tremble when the Lord speaks, listen to what he says: “Some of your own people hate and reject you because of me. They make fun and say, ‘Let the Lord show his power! Let us see him make you truly happy.’ But those who say these things will be terribly ashamed.”
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE noa dwirɛ, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsuro ye ná ɛmɔdi ye dwirɛ so ɔ: “Ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ bɔ bɛpɔ ɛmɔ, bɔ ɔnate me dumaa ti bapo ɛmɔ ne, bɛnwa: ‘Yɛsrɛ kyɛ AWURADE ɔla ye animnyam ne ali, maa ɔnate so yɛnwu ɛmɔ anigye ne!’ Nakoso bɛ yeɛ bɛ nyunu kogua aseɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Do you hear that noise in the city and those shouts coming from the temple? It is the Lord shouting as he punishes his enemies.
translation_verse: “Dede piri bie fi kuro ne anu! Komviɛ bie fi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu! AWURADE bɔ otua ye pɔfoɛ mɔ yɔleɛ so kerɛ ne, ye komvi ɔ! Yerusalem foforɛ ne

english_verse: Have you ever heard of a woman who gave birth to a child before having labor pains?
translation_verse: “Ye ko onnya ɔhhale ye ne, né wawo; onnya onnwuni aworɛ yealɛ ne, né wawo baa bienzua.

english_verse: Who ever heard of such a thing or imagined it could happen? Can a nation be born in a day or come to life in a second? Jerusalem is like a mother who gave birth to her children as soon as she was in labor.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ wate sɔ dwirɛ ne bie le ɔ? Nwa yeɛ wanwu sɔ nikyee ne bie le ɔ? Aso ebie kɔhora kɔfa ɛlɛho kɔwo aseɛ? Aso ebie kɔhora kɔkyekye maen amono nu berɛ ala? Ofikyɛ Sion fole aworɛ so pɛ yeɛ ɔwole ye mma ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord is the one who makes birth possible. And he will see that Zion has many more children. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Baa ne, aso memaa ɔfa ye ti batɛ, bɔ memma bɛnwo ye ɔ? AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Me bɔ memaa bɛwo ne, aso ngotua awodeɛ noa ate anaa? Wɔ Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: If you love Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! If you were in sorrow because of the city, you can now be glad.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔkuro Yerusalem dwirɛ ɔ, odi kyɛ ɛmɔ ne ye bɛ nye kã, ná ɛmɔ ne ye bedi ahurusi; ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔdi ye nwo aworabɔlɛ ɔ, ɛmɔ ne ye beli ahurusi;

english_verse: She will nurse and comfort you, just like your own mother, until you are satisfied. You will fully enjoy her wonderful glory.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so ye aworakyekyerɛ nyɔfonesue ne, ɛmɔano bie bama bɛ ko ayi; amaa ɔnate so ye animnyam mmorosoɛ ne, ɛmɔafa anigye bano maa wate ɛmɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord has promised: “I will flood Jerusalem with the wealth of nations and make the city prosper. Zion will nurse you at her breast, carry you in her arms, and hold you in her lap.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE nwa nyoo: “Ɛ́mɔtie! Ngɔma asomdwee kɔtengyɛ kɔhɔ ye berɛ kyɛ asue, yeɛ maen maen mɔ b’anwonya kɔtengyɛ kɔhɔ ye berɛ kyɛ asue bɔ wabu wafa so ɔ. Afei ɛmɔkɔno nyɔfonesue ne, ɔkɔfa ɛmɔ kɔbɔ ye mvenu, ná wahã ɛmɔ angorɛ wɔ ye gya so.
