english_verse: When you see this happen, you will celebrate; your strength will return faster than grass can sprout. Then everyone will know that the Lord provides help for his servants, but he is angry with his enemies.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔnwu ye sɔ a, ɛmɔ nye kɔgye“‘, ɛmɔ bowue nu komia kyɛ ndire frɔmfrɔm, mmenia konwu kyɛ AWURADE tumi gyi ye somvoɛ mɔ si, na ye ahone hu ye pɔfoɛ mɔ so.

english_verse: The Lord will come down like a whirlwind with his flaming chariots. He will be furiously angry and punish his enemies with fire.
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔtie, AWURADE kɔfa see ne ye teaseɛnam mɔ bɔ bɛte kyɛ mvrama piri yeɛ ɔkɔwa ɔ,, kyɛ ɔbaafa ye ahonehulɛ ne otua so kerɛ ɛyaafɛlɛ so, ná ɔfa see wuronyiwuronyi ɔtea bɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's fiery sword will bring justice everywhere on this earth and execute many people. A Threat and a Promise
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE kɔfa see ne ye ngrandɛ yeɛ okobua anwoɔnaen mukoraa ndɛen ɔ, na bɛ bɔ AWURADE kohũ bɛ ne, bɛkɔsone pee.

english_verse: Some of you get yourselves ready and go to a garden to worship a foreign goddess. You eat the meat of pigs, lizards, and mice. But I, the Lord, will destroy you for this.
translation_verse: “Bɛ bɔ bɛpete bɛ nwo bɛte bɛ nwo wɔ turo nemɔ anu, wɔ sona ko bɔ ogyi afia berɛ ne asi, bɔ bedi prako naen, akyiwadeɛ ne mmurokuruwa ne, b’ayieleɛ koyie bɛ kɔbɔ nu, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I know everything you do and think! The time has now come to bring together the people of every language and nation and to show them my glory
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ mese bɛ yɔleɛ ne b’adwene: meba mebaboaboa maen mukoraa ne edwudwolɛ amukoraa noa, na bɛkɔwa bekoonwu m’animnyam ne.

english_verse: by proving what I can do. I will send the survivors to Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Meshech, Tubal, Javan, and to the distant islands. I will send them to announce my wonderful glory to nations that have never heard about me.
translation_verse: Ngɔyɔ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ wɔ bɛ nu, na bɛ bɔ bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ne, ngɔsoma bɛ maa bɛkɔhɔ maen maen mɔ berɛ: wɔ Tasise, Pule ne Lude bɔ bɛte agyaentolɛfoɛ ne, Tubal ne Yawan, dedeede supɔ mɔ bɔ bennya bɛttele me nga, bɔ bennya bennwuni m’animnyam ne; na bɛkɔɔbɔ m’animnyam nwo dawure wɔ maen maen mɔ so.

english_verse: They will bring your relatives from the nations as an offering to me, the Lord. They will come to Jerusalem, my holy mountain, on horses, chariots, wagons, mules, and camels. It will be like the people of Israel bringing the right offering to my temple.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔfa ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ amukoraa bekofi maen maen amukoraa so bɛkɔwa, maa ɔkɔyɛ afɔleɛ kɔma AWURADE. Mbɔngɔ so, teaseɛnam mɔ nu, seko nu, afunum mɔ so ne afupɔngɔ mɔ so yeɛ bɛkɔfa bɛ bɛkɔtenatena bɛkɔwa me bokaa krongron Yerusalem so ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, kyɛbɔ Yisraelfoɛ bɛfa b’aburoo afɔleɛ begua nzim bɔ ye nwo te ɔ nu bɛba AWURADE awuro nen.

english_verse: I promise that some of them will be priests and others will be helpers in my temple. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Na ngɔye bɛ nu biemɔ maa bɛkɔyɛ asɔfo ne Lewifoɛ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I also promise that you will always have descendants and will never be forgotten, just as the new heavens and the new earth that I create will last forever.
translation_verse: “AWURADE nwa nyoo: Kyɛbɔ anwuro foforɛ ne aseɛ foforɛ bɔ mebaayɔ ne kɔtena berɛ wɔ me nyunu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ bosofoɛ ne ɛmɔ dumaa kɔtena berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: On the first day of each month and on each Sabbath, everyone will worship me. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, ɛsraen foforɛ biala ne afofikyẽa biala, anwoɔnaen amukoraa kɔwa bɛkɔɔsɔne wɔ me nyunu, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: My people will go out and look at the dead bodies of those who turned against me. The worms there never die, the fire never stops burning, and the sight of those bodies will be disgusting to everyone.
translation_verse: “Na bekofite bɛkɔɔnea mmenia bɔ bayɛ me nwo lɔen nemɔ bɛ fuin, ofikyɛ bɛ nnɔboakoma nemɔ ngowu, bɛ see ne ngonua, na bɛkɔyɛ akyiwadeɛ bɛkɔma anwoɔnaen amukoraa.”

english_verse: My name is Jeremiah. I am a priest, and my father Hilkiah and everyone else in my family are from Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. This book contains the things that the Lord told me to say.
translation_verse: Yeremia bɔ ye baba ole Hilkia bɔ ɔte asɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Anatote wɔ Benyamin aseɛ so nemɔ anu ko ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe.

english_verse: The Lord first spoke to me in the thirteenth year that Josiah was king of Judah,
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele ye, wɔ Yosia bɔ ye baba ole Yuda hene Amon ne, ye ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nza ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: and he continued to speak to me during the rule of Josiah's son Jehoiakim. The last time the Lord spoke to me was in the fifth month of the eleventh year that Josiah's son Zedekiah was king. That was also when the people of Jerusalem were taken away as prisoners. The Lord Chooses Jeremiah
translation_verse: Edwirɛ ne sa wale ye berɛ wɔ Yehoakim bɔ ye baba ole Yuda hene Yosia n’aberɛ so, kɔpem Sedekia bɔ ye baba ole Yuda hene Yosia n’ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne ko n’ayieleɛ, maa oodwuli kyɛ bɛhyele Yerusalem nnure bɛhɔle wɔ bosome nnu ne anu ɔ. Nyameɛ frɛ Yeremia

english_verse: “Jeremiah, I am your Creator, and before you were born, I chose you to speak for me to the nations.”
translation_verse: “Anzana mebaanwo wɔ wɔ bɛ kunu ne, né mese wɔ, anzana ɛbaafi bɛ kunu ba ne, né mate wɔ nwo; na nduli wɔ nziele berɛ nyɛle wɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ mane Amaenmaensofoɛ.”

english_verse: I replied, “I'm not a good speaker, Lord, and I'm too young.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngane kyɛ, “Yieee, AWURADE Nyameɛ! Nahorɛ nu, menze dwudwo, ofikyɛ nde akwadaa.”

english_verse: “Don't say you're too young,” the Lord answered. “If I tell you to go and speak to someone, then go! And when I tell you what to say, don't leave out a word!
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Nnɛkã kyɛ, ‘Nde akwadaa’, ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ ngɔsoma wɔ wɔ bɛ berɛ ne amukoraa, odi kyɛ ɛkɔ ɔ, na edwirɛ biala bɔ ngɔfa ngɔsoma wɔ ne, odi kyɛ ɛkã ɔ.

english_verse: I promise to be with you and keep you safe, so don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Nnɛsuro bɛ nyunu, ngyi wɔ si, na ngɔpepɛ ngole wɔ,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The Lord reached out his hand, then he touched my mouth and said, “I am giving you the words to say,
translation_verse: Afei, AWURADE tengyɛle ye sa fa hane me noa. Na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, Tie, mafa me dwirɛ matua wɔ noa.

english_verse: and I am sending you with authority to speak to the nations for me. You will tell them of doom and destruction, and of rising and rebuilding again.”
translation_verse: Tie, ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, mama wɔ tumi wɔ maen maen ne ahennie mɔ so, kyɛ etutu bɛ bo ná edwiri bɛ gua ase, kyɛ ɛsɛkye bɛ ná ɛhã bɛ gua, kyɛ esi ná elua.”

english_verse: The Lord showed me something in a vision. Then he asked, “What do you see, Jeremiah?” I answered, “A branch of almonds that ripen early.”
translation_verse: Afei, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ, “Yeremia, bɔ enwu ye e, nzikyɛ ɛne?” Na mmuale kyɛ, “Menwu atonwaa bakaa ye mmaen.”

english_verse: “That's right,” the Lord replied, “and I always rise early to keep a promise.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Anwu ye amba. Ofikyɛ ngɔnea kyɛ me dwirɛ ne kɔyɔ adwuma ɔ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord showed me something else and asked, “What do you see now?” I answered, “I see a pot of boiling water in the north, and it's about to spill out toward us.”
translation_verse: AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me ye pɛen nyɔ so, na obisale me kyɛ, “Bɔ enwu ye e, nzikyɛ ɛne?” Na mmuale kyɛ, “Menwu kukue bɔ ohu, bɔ ye noa kyire sorɔ dɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I will pour out destruction all over the land.
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Sorɔ dɔ yeɛ musue kofi kɔwa aseɛ ne aso ama mukoraa bɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: Just watch while I send for the kings of the north. They will attack and capture Jerusalem and other towns, then set up their thrones at the gates of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, tie, ngɔto me sa ngɔfrɛ sorɔ dɔ ahennie nemɔ bɛ mmusua ne amukoraa, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Bɛkɔwa, na ebiala kɔfa ye ahennie bia koosie Yerusalem pambim ne noa, ɔne ye fasue ne amukoraa nwo kɔbra koyia, ɔne Yuda nguro amukoraa nwo.

english_verse: I will punish my people, because they are guilty of turning from me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate b’amumuyɛɛ amukoraa bɔ bayɔ ne ati, ngobua bɛ ndɛen, ofikyɛ bapo me, bayera ɛyɛɛ bama mmosoen mɔ, na basɔne bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ sa noa nnwumaa.

english_verse: Jeremiah, get ready! Go and tell the people what I command you to say. Don't be frightened by them, or I will make you terrified while they watch.
translation_verse: Nakoso wɔ de, bɔ w’abɔsoɛ ná dwɔso, na kã bɔ ngɔhyɛ wɔ kyɛ ɛhã ne amukoraa kyire bɛ. Nnɛma wɔ nwo wosowoso wɔ wɔ bɛ nyunu, anyɔ sɔ a, ngɔma wɔ nwo kɔwosowoso wɔ wɔ bɛ nyunu.

english_verse: My power will make you strong like a fortress or a column of iron or a wall of bronze. You will oppose all of Judah, including its kings and leaders, its priests and people.
translation_verse: Tie, ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, mafa wɔ mayɛ kuro bɔ babɔ ye nwo waen ɔ, buralɛ bonima ne kɔɔbere fasue matia maen ne amukoraa: Yuda ahemvo, ye atitire mɔ, ye asɔfo mɔ ne aseɛ ne aso ama.

english_verse: They will fight back, but they won't win. I, the Lord, give my word— I won't let them harm you.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔho bekotia wɔ, nakoso bɛngɔhora bengoli wɔ so ngonim, ofikyɛ ngyi wɔ si, na ngɔpepɛ ngole wɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: to go to Jerusalem and tell everyone that he had said: When you were my young bride, you loved me and followed me through the barren desert.
translation_verse: “Kɔ ná kɔbɔ ye dawure kyire Yerusalem kyɛ, AWURADE nwa nyoo: Mekaye wɔ ndaluwa nu anwofama ne, w’atɔmvorɛ mmerɛ nu ehurolɛ ne, mmerɛ bɔ elili me si wɔ ɛserɛ so, wɔ aseɛ bɔ né belluale so hwee ne aso ne.

english_verse: You belonged to me alone, like the first part of the harvest, and I severely punished those who mistreated you.
translation_verse: Né Yisrael te krongron ma AWURADE, ye fieso aleɛ bɔ olili moa fale hɔ ɛne; bɛ bɔ belili bie amukoraa belili fɔ; musue tole bɛ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: and I, the Lord, will speak. I was never unfair to your ancestors, but they left me and became worthless by following worthless idols.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo: “Nzikyɛ mvomsoɛ yeɛ ɛmɔ nana mɔ benwuni ye wɔ me nwo, bɔ ɔnate so bɛhwene bɛ nwo befili me nwo bɛhɔle dedeede beelili nningyein mbaen mbaen si, maa bɛ koso bɛkakyili mmenia mbaen ɔ?

english_verse: Your ancestors refused to ask for my help, though I had rescued them from Egypt and led them through a treacherous, barren desert, where no one lives or dares to travel.
translation_verse: Bammisa kyɛ, ‘AWURADE wɔ nisua? Ye bɔ ɔyele yɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne, bɔ olili yɛ nyunu fale yɛ fale ɛserɛ so, aseɛ pralaa ne ngumaa aseɛ so, wɔ aseɛ bɔ esue ndɔ wɔ so, bɔ so te awosii kabii ne, aseɛ bɔ ebiala mbɛ nu wɔ so, bɔ ebiala ɔtte so ne.’

english_verse: I brought you here to my land, where food is abundant, but you made my land filthy with your sins.
translation_verse: Mvale ɛmɔ mmale aseɛ bɔ ɔkye aleɛ ɔ so, kyɛ ɛmɔli so aleɛ ne so nningyein paa nemɔ. Nakoso ɛmɔdwuli m’aseɛ ne aso ne, ɛmɔfale efiɛ bɛhane ye, ná ɛmɔmane m’agyapadeɛ yɛle akyiwadeɛ.

english_verse: The priests who teach my laws don't care to know me. Your leaders rebel against me; your prophets give messages from Baal and worship false gods. The Lord Accuses His People
translation_verse: Asɔfo nemɔ bammisa kyɛ, ‘AWURADE wɔ nisua?’ Yeɛ bɛ bɔ bekyirekyire mmeraa ne anu ne, bɛnze me; bɛ neafoɛ nemɔ, bɛyɔle bɔne betiale me; bosoen Baal yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɛfale ye bɛhyɛle ngɔm ɔ, na belili nningyein bɔ mvasoɛ nne so ɔ si.

english_verse: I will take you to court and accuse you and your descendants *
translation_verse: “Yiti ngɔhɔ so ngɔbɔ ɛmɔ kwaadu, na ngɔbɔ ɛmɔ boso ama mɔ koso kwaadu, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: of a crime that no nation has ever committed before. Just ask anyone, anywhere, from the eastern deserts to the islands in the west.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔpɛ nu bɛhɔ Kipro supɔ nemɔ aso bɛɛnea, ɛ́mɔsoma maa bɛhɔ Kedare bɛneanea nu yé; ɛ́mɔnea sɛ edwirɛ sɔaa bie wasi berɛ le a!

english_verse: You will find that no nation has ever abandoned its gods even though they were false. I am the true and glorious God, but you have rejected me to worship idols.
translation_verse: Aso maen bie wasesã ye nyameɛ mɔ, bɔ ye po nna nyameɛ mɔ ahɔ ɔ? Nakoso me maen de, wafa nningyein bɔ mvasoɛ nne so ɔ wasesã ye animnyam.

english_verse: You, my people, have sinned in two ways— you have rejected me, the source of life-giving water, and you've tried to collect water in cracked and leaking pits dug in the ground.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me maen abɔ musue nyɔ: bapo me, me bɔ nde ngoa nzue mbombonzue ne, yeɛ baatu bɛ bɔbɔ b’abura mɔ, abura bɔ ye nwo adwudwa, bɔ nzue ngora nu gyina ɔ.

english_verse: People of Israel, you weren't born slaves; you were captured in war.
translation_verse: Aso Yisrael te kanganiɛ? Aso ɔte awuro sona? Nzu ati yeɛ wakakyi nikyee bɔ bɛbɔ apaa bɛfa e?

english_verse: Enemies roared like lions and destroyed your land; towns lie burned and empty.
translation_verse: Gyata akrɔngrɔma nemɔ bepo ye, babobɔ nu serɛserɛ paa. Bama ye aseɛ akakyi aseɛ pralaa; bayerayera ye nguro nemɔ, bɔ sona fee ɔtte so ɔ.

english_verse: Soldiers from the Egyptian towns of Memphis and Tahpanhes have cracked your skulls.
translation_verse: Afei koso, Memfisefoɛ ne Tapanesefoɛ basɛkye w’ahennie abotire ne.

english_verse: Your own sins will punish you, because it was a bitter mistake for you to reject me without fear of punishment. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken.
translation_verse: Wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ bɔne kɔbɔ wɔ ti so, na Nyameɛ si lilɛ bɔ ayakyi ne, sɔ suban ne kobua wɔ foɛ. Nwu ye ná kaye kyɛ ɔte aworabɔlɛ dwirɛ kyɛ ɛkɔpo AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ɔ; na me nwo suronyi ɔnne wɔ nu. AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Long ago you left me and broke all ties between us, refusing to be my servant. Now you worship other gods by having sex on hilltops or in the shade of large trees.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ofi tete yeɛ mmubuli wɔ kɔnnua nu, yeɛ mmubuli wɔ panwu nu ɔ, na ɛhane kyɛ, “Mengɔso wɔ!” Nahorɛ nu, ɛkotole mmosoen ɛbɔle adwaman wɔ bokaa tendenn biala so ne bakaa monɛ biala abo.

english_verse: You were a choice grapevine, but you have become a wild, useless vine. Israel Is Stained with Guilt
translation_verse: Nakoso nnuale wɔ kyɛ bobe paa, bɔ baneanea nu baye bafi ye mma paa nu ɔ. Na ɔyɛle sɛɛ bɔ akakyi bobe bakaa mbaen bɔ mvasoɛ nne wɔ so ɔ?

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Israel, you are stained with guilt, and no soap or bleach can wash it away.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛfa kondu bia, bɔ saminaen pee boka so ɔ, nakoso w’amumuyɛɛ te ngekalewa wɔ me nye so, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: You deny your sins and say, “We aren't unclean. We haven't worshiped Baal.” But think about what you do in Hinnom Valley. You run back and forth like young camels, as you rush to worship one idol after another.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ sɛɛ ati bɔ ɛkã kyɛ, “Me nwo ogguale fiɛ, mangɔanni Baal mɔ asi” ɔ? Nea w’atee bɔ ɔla bɔnza ne anu ne; nwu nikyee bɔ yeɛ ayɔ ɔ, afupɔngɔ akrɔngrɔma bɔ ye nwo yɛ nyera bɔ ohuru pepe ɔ,

english_verse: You are a female donkey sniffing the desert air, wanting to mate with just anyone. You are an easy catch!
translation_verse: eburo afunum bɔ odwu ɛserɛ so a né wadwu ye deɛ nu, bɔ ɔsɔ a, ɔsɔ mvrama mverɛ ɔ! Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔbrɛ ye akɔnnɔ ase ɔ? Ebiala bɔ ɔpena ye ne, ɔmvɛ; sɛ ye bosome so a, benwu ye.

english_verse: Your shoes are worn out, and your throat is parched from running here and there to worship foreign gods. “Stop!” I shouted, but you replied, “No! I love those gods too much.”
translation_verse: Nea yé ná amva wɔ gya angua ase, ná nzuhɔen amma wɔ komvi anwo. Nakoso ɛnwa, “Anyelasoɛ biala ɔnne berɛ, ofikyɛ mahuro ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ, na bɛ ala yeɛ ngogu bɛ so ɔ.’

english_verse: You and your leaders are more disgraceful than thieves— you and your kings, your priests and prophets
translation_verse: “Kyɛbɔ bɛkye awueniɛ a ye nyunu gua ase ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Yisrael maen nyunu agua ase ɔ: bɛ ne b’ahemvo, bɛ mbanyi mɔ, b’asɔfo ne bɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ

english_verse: worship stone idols and sacred poles as if they had created you and had given you life. You have rejected me, but when you're in trouble, you cry to me for help.
translation_verse: bɛkã bekyire bakaa kyɛ, ‘Me se ole wɔ,’ yeɛ bɛkã bekyire nyɔboɛ kyɛ, ‘Wɔ yeɛ ɛwole me ɔ.’ Ofikyɛ bɛ si yeɛ bakakyi bama me ɔ, na nna bɛ nyunu ɔ. Nakoso sɛ bɛkɔ amaneɛ nu a, bɛkã kyɛ, ‘Dwɔso pepɛ de yɛ e!’

english_verse: Go cry to the gods you made! There should be enough of them to save you, because Judah has as many gods as it has towns. Israel Rebels against the Lord
translation_verse: Nakoso wɔ mmosoen bɔ agyinagyina ama wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo ne, bɛwɔ nisua? Sɛ bɛkɔhora bɛkɔpepɛ bekole wɔ wɔ w’amaneɛ mmerɛ nu a, maa bedwɔso e! Ao Yuda, kyɛbɔ wɔ nguro nemɔ bɛ somaa te ne, sɔ ala yeɛ wɔ mmosoen nemɔ bɛ somaa te ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to Israel: You accuse me of not saving you, but I say you have rebelled.
translation_verse: “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔbɔ me kwaadwu ɔ? Ɛmɔ amukoraa bayɛ me nwo lɔen, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I tried punishing you, but you refused to come back to me, and like fierce lions you killed my prophets.
translation_verse: Ɛhwenɛ bɔ mahwe ɛmɔ mma mɔ bɛ so ne, wayɛ mbaen, bande fo. Ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔ ngrandɛ yeɛ wahũ ɛmɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ kyɛ gyata bɔ ye nye aboro ɔ.

english_verse: Now listen to what I say! Did I abandon you in the desert or surround you with darkness? You are my people, yet you have told me, “We'll do what we want, and we refuse to worship you!”
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ, sɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ he, ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE dwirɛ ne! Aso makakyi ɛserɛ so mama Yisrael, anaa makakyi aseɛ bɔ so te awosii kabii ɔ? Na nzu ati yeɛ me maen kã kyɛ, ‘Yɛle yɛ nwo, yɛngɔwa wɔ berɛ ko’ ɔ?

english_verse: A bride could not forget to wear her jewelry to her wedding, but you have forgotten me day after day.
translation_verse: Aso taluwa, ye wora kofi ye mbembenanneɛ, anaa atɔmvorɛ braa, ye wora kofi ye ataadeɛ? Nakoso me maen de, ye wora afi me, mmerɛ tendenn bɔ bɛka a bennwu ye noa ɔ.

english_verse: You are so clever at finding lovers that you could give lessons to a prostitute.
translation_verse: “Nea kyɛbɔ esi se atee bɔ ɛfa so kɔpena wɔ dɔfo mɔ ɔ! Yiti ɔnate so mmrasua bɔ bɛtte mayee po, ahyirehyire bɛ w’atee.

english_verse: You killed innocent people for no reason at all. And even though their blood can be seen on your clothes,
translation_verse: Ehiafoɛ bɔ bedi be ɔ, bɛ mogya yeɛ wayɛ wɔ ndaadeɛ nu ɔ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ angye bɛ kyɛ betu anoa bo de, nakoso ɛhe amukoraa si ne,

english_verse: you claim to be innocent, and you want me to stop being angry with you. So I'll take you to court, and we'll see who is right.
translation_verse: ɛnwa, ‘Medi be, amba, ɔngɔfɛ me so yaa.’ Afei ɔnate kyɛ ahã kyɛ, ‘Nnyɔle bɔne’ ne ati, mebaabua wɔ ndɛen.

english_verse: When Assyria let you down, you quickly ran to Egypt, but you'll find no help there,
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ ɛsẽ faen ná ɛsẽ faen bɔ ɛkakyi w’atee bɔ ɛnate so ye! Misraim kogua wɔ nyunu ase, kyɛbɔ Asiria guale wɔ nyunu ase ne.

english_verse: and you will leave in great sadness. I won't let you find help from those you trust.
translation_verse: Berɛ yeɛ ekofi kɔwa bɔ wɔ sa gua wɔ ti ɔ; ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ afa wɔ wora awura bɛ nu ne, AWURADE apo bɛ, na ɛngɔfa bɛ so ngɔyɛ yé.

english_verse: The Lord said to the people of Israel: If a divorced woman marries, can her first husband ever marry her again? No, because this would pollute the land. But you have more gods than a prostitute has lovers. Why should I take you back?
translation_verse: Mebisa ɛmɔ kyɛ, “Sɛ bienzua bie yira ɔye, ná braa ne fi ye berɛ kɔ, ná sɛ biaa foforɛ gya ye a, aso biaa ne kosa koogya ye bieku? Aso sɔ aseɛ ne nwo ngogua fiɛ petee? Ayɛ gyanderaniɛ ɛne wɔ kurofoɛ pee babɔ adwaman, nakoso ɛpena kyɛ esa ba me berɛ? AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Just try to find one hilltop where you haven't gone to worship other gods by having sex. You sat beside the road like a robber in ambush, except you offered yourself to every passerby. Your sins of unfaithfulness have polluted the land.
translation_verse: To wɔ nye nea mmokaa pralaa nemɔ aso! Nisua yeɛ bɛ ne wɔ ammɔ adwaman ɔ? Ɛte atee mɔ noa yeɛ ɛnwondɛ wɔ kurofoɛ mɔ, kyɛ Araboniɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ɛserɛ so ɔ. Afa w’adwaman ne wɔ bɔne yɔleɛ agua aseɛ ne anwo fiɛ.

english_verse: So I, the Lord, refused to let the spring rains fall. But just like a prostitute, you still have no shame for what you have done.

translation_verse: Ao, mmaa asoserɛfoɛ, ɛ́mɔsa bɛbra, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Me yeɛ nde ɛmɔ Mene ɔ; ngɔye sona ko ngofi kuro biala so, ná maye mmenia nyɔ mafi abusua biala anu, ná mafa ɛmɔ mawa Sion.

translation_verse: “ ‘Ngɔye neafoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛla m’ahone nwo ɔ ngɔma ɛmɔ, bɔ bɛkɔfa nimdeɛ ne nworɛ bɛkɔtete ɛmɔ ɔ.

translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔta pee ná ɛmɔsone wɔ aseɛ ne aso sɔ mmerɛ ne anu a, ye de bɛngɔhɔ so bɛngɔhã kyɛ, ‘AWURADE apam alaka ne.’ Ɔngɔwa bɛ ti anu, bɛngɔkaye, bɛngɔdwenedwene ye nwo, yeɛ bɛngɔyɛ ye foforɛ ko, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The whole city of Jerusalem will be my throne. All nations will come here to worship me, and they will no longer follow their stubborn, evil hearts.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, bɛkɔfrɛ Yerusalem AWURADE ahennie bia, na maen maen amukoraa bekooyia berɛ, wɔ AWURADE dumaa nu wɔ Yerusalem, na bɛngɔyɛ asoserɛ bɛngɔyɔ b’apɛdeɛ tɛɛ nemɔ ko.

translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, Yuda awuro ama kɔboka Yisrael awuro ama nemɔ aso, na aseɛ bɔ mva mane ɛmɔ nana mɔ maa ɔyɛle b’agyapadeɛ ne, bɛkɔbɔ nu bekofi sorɔ dɔ aseɛ ne aso bɛkɔwa so.

translation_verse: “ ‘Ndwenene kyɛ ngɔmaa ɛkɔyɛ titire paa wɔ me mma mɔ anu, na ngɔma wɔ aseɛ bɔ ɔkye aleɛ ɔ, bɔ ɔte maen mɔ b’agyapadeɛ paa paa ɔ. Na né medwene kyɛ ɛkɔfrɛ me ‘Me Baba’ bɔ ɛngɔyakyi me si lilɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But instead, you are like a wife who broke her wedding vows. You have been unfaithful to me. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People Confess Their Sins The Lord said:
translation_verse: Amba, brasua bɔ onni nahorɛ ne, kyɛbɔ onni nahorɛ mma ohu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Yisrael awuro ama, ɛmɔanni nahorɛ bamma me ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I will tell them, “Come back, and I will cure you of your unfaithfulness.” They will answer, “We will come back, because you are the Lord our God.

translation_verse: Amba, dede bɔ ɔwɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso ne, ɔne mmokaa nemɔ aso anigye ne, ɔte mbaen. Amba, AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ nu yeɛ Yisrael ngoalelɛ wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Since the days of our ancestors when our nation was young, that shameful god Baal has taken our crops and livestock, our sons and daughters.
translation_verse: “Nakoso ofi yɛ mmerandeɛ nu yeɛ sɔ animguaseɛ nikyee ne wamaa bɔ yɛ nana mɔ bafɛ bapena ne amukoraa wafi yɛsa ɔ: bɛ mmoaen ne bɛ nandwie, yeɛ bɛ mma mmienzua ne bɛ mma mmrasua.

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, if you really want to come back to me, get rid of those disgusting idols.

english_verse: Make promises only in my name, and do what you promise! Then all nations will praise me, and I will bless them.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem and Judah, don't be so stubborn! Your hearts have become hard, like unplowed ground where thornbushes grow.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔ AWURADE kã kyire Yudafoɛ ne Yerusalemfoɛ ɛhe: Ɛ́mɔso ɛmɔ mvofoen nemɔ, na nnɛma ɛmɔdua nningyein wɔ mmowue mmowue nu.

english_verse: With all your hearts, keep the agreement I made with you. But if you are stubborn and keep on sinning, my anger will burn like a fire that cannot be put out. Disaster Is Coming The Lord said: *

translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa frangaa bɛ́pena berɛ ma ye nye hyire Sion. Ɛ́mɔnwati bɛɛbɔ ɛmɔ nwo adwaa, nnɛma ɛmɔgyina berɛ, ofikyɛ mebaafa musue ne amaneɛ kandinga paa mefi sorɔ dɔ meba.

translation_verse: Ɔnate ɛhe ati, ɛ́mɔhera ɛsɛen tena, ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye ná ɛmɔsu: ofikyɛ AWURADE yaa kandinga bɔ wafɛ ye yɛ so ne, ye ahone ɔttɔle nzue nu.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “When all this happens, the king and his officials, the prophets and the priests will be shocked and terrified.”
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɔ kyẽa ne, ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ ɛhene ne ye mbanyi mɔ so, asɔfo nemɔ nwo kodwiri bɛ, na ɔkɔyɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ suro.”

english_verse: I said, “You are the Lord God. So why have you fooled everyone, especially the people of Jerusalem? Why did you promise peace, when a knife is at our throats?” The Coming Disaster
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngane kyɛ, “Aa, AWURADE Nyameɛ, ye de, amba alakalaka maen ye ne Yerusalem, ofikyɛ ɛhane kyɛ, ‘Okoyie ɛmɔ yé’, wɔ aberɛ bɔ ngrandɛ la bɛ komvi ɔ.”

translation_verse: W’atee bɔ ɛnate so, ɔne wɔ yɔleɛ yeɛ wama edwirɛ he ato wɔ ye. W’asefinɛ ɛne! Nea ye yealɛ! Ye yealɛ ne wahã w’ahone.” Yeremia di ye maen nwo aworabɔlɛ

english_verse: I see the enemy defeating us time after time, leaving everything in ruins. Even my own home is destroyed in a moment.
translation_verse: Amaneɛnwunɛ toa amaneɛnwunɛ so, ofikyɛ maen ne abɔ bɔkɔɔ. Mvum nu, me tena sua mɔ basɛkyesɛkye, yeɛ me mbɛmuɛ tena mɔ basɛkye amono nu.

english_verse: After this, I looked around. The earth was barren, with no form of life. The sun, moon, and stars had disappeared.
translation_verse: Ndole me nye nneane aseɛ so, na yieee, né ɔte sesakaa, bɔ nikye fee nne so ɔ; nneane ewienu, na né kanea nne berɛ.

english_verse: Farmland had become a desert, and towns were in ruins. The Lord's fierce anger had done all of this. The Death of Jerusalem
translation_verse: Ndole me nye nneane, na yieee, né aseɛ bɔ ɔkye aleɛ ne wakakyi ɛserɛ, na ye nguro amukoraa bakakyi kurofoen wɔ AWURADE nyunu, wɔ ye ɛyaa piri ne anyunu.

english_verse: The Lord said: I have made my decision, and I won't change my mind. This land will be destroyed, although not completely. The sky will turn dark, and the earth will mourn.

english_verse: I heard groaning and crying. Was it a woman giving birth to her first child? No, it was Jerusalem, gasping for breath and begging for help. “I'm dying!” she said. “They have murdered me.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mate esuɛ bie bɔ ɔte kyɛ brasua bɔ wafo aworɛ so ɔ deɛ, ɔne ɛpenenɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ brasua bɔ ɔwo ye bamuɛbaa ɔ, ye deɛ. Sion awa brasua ɔtee so, bɔ watrɛtrɛ ye sa nu ɔbɔ awuye kyɛ, “Edwirɛ ato me oo! Ɔnate awudifoɛ ti, me kra aboto!”

english_verse: I answered, “I know that you look for truth. You punished your people for their lies, but in spite of the pain, they became more stubborn and refused to turn back to you.”
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, aso nna nahorɛ yeɛ wɔ nye pena kyɛ onwu ye ɔ? Ahwe bɛ so, nakoso wanyɛ bɛ yea; ahũhũ bɛ, nakoso bamva ɛhe bandu bɛ nwo foɛ, bɛ nyunu porɛ bɔ babɔ ɔ, ɔtra nyɔboɛ, na bayɛ b’adwene kyɛ bɛngɔsakyera.

english_verse: Then I thought to myself, “These common people act like fools, and they have never learned what the Lord their God demands of them.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngane kyɛ, “Amba, mmenia hemɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo, adwene nne bɛ ti anu, ofikyɛ bɛnze AWURADE atee ne, ɔne bɛ Nyameɛ mmeraa ne.

translation_verse: Ngɔhɔ atitirefoɛ nemɔ berɛ, ngoodwudwo ngohyire bɛ; ofikyɛ bɛ de, bɛse AWURADE atee ne, ɔne bɛ Nyameɛ mmeraa ne.” Ofikyɛ bɛ mukoraa babubu kɔnnua ne anu, yeɛ babubu wɔ panwu ne anu.

english_verse: The people have rebelled and rejected the Lord too many times. So enemies will attack like lions from the forest or wolves from the desert. Those enemies will watch the towns of Judah, and like leopards they will tear to pieces whoever goes outside. Enemies Will Punish Judah The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yiti gyata kofi ɛhɔayeɛ nu koohũhũ bɛ, pataku kofi ɛserɛ so kɔɔtete bɛ nu pasapasa. Aboa tetɛ bɛ wɔ bɛ nguro nemɔ aso, na ebiala bɔ okofi kuro ne anu kofite ne, ɔkɔtete ye nu pasapasa, ofikyɛ bɛ mmeraatolɛ sone, na b’asefinɛ ne te piri.

translation_verse: “Ɛhe de, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né mafa wɔ bɔne mahyɛ wɔ? Wɔ mma mɔ bapo me, na bafa bɛ bɔ nna nyameɛ mɔ ahɔ ɔ bata ndaen. Mmane bɛ ko yili ne, bɛbɔle adwaman, na betuli bi bɛhɔle gyanderafoɛ awuro.

translation_verse: Bɛte pɔngɔ nyii branoa bɔ bekuro mmraa, bɔ ebiala sɔ obiɛngo aye nwo mverɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I will tell their enemies, “Go through my vineyard. Don't destroy the vines, but cut off the branches, because they are the people who don't belong to me.”
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔfo bɛhɔ ye bobe boo nemɔ anu bɛɛsɛkye bɛ, nakoso nnɛma ɛmɔsɛkye ye mukoraa bɔkɔɔ; ɛ́mɔpomba ye maen nemɔ, ofikyɛ nna AWURADE deɛ ɔ.

english_verse: In every way, Judah and Israel have been unfaithful to me. *
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Yisrael awuro ama ne Yuda awuro ama, banni nahorɛ bamma me koraa, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

translation_verse: Bapɛ AWURADE nwo ngondombo, na bahã kyɛ, ‘Ɔngɔyɔ huu, edwirɛ tɛɛ biala ngɔto yɛ, koɛ ngɔto yɛ, yeɛ ɛhɔen koso ngɔwa.

english_verse: They tell these lies in my name, so now they will be killed in war or starve to death.
translation_verse: Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ, bɛte mvrama mbaen, ofikyɛ edwirɛ ne, ɔnne bɛ nu. Bɛ noa dwirɛ ne kɔbɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti so!’”

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful. Jeremiah, I will tell you exactly what to say. Your words will be a fire; Israel and Judah will be the fuel.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ nwa: “Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔkã sɔ dwirɛ ne ati, tie, ngɔma me dwirɛ ne kɔkakyi see wɔ wɔ noa nu; maen he kɔkakyi eyein, na see kɔyera bɛ dwɛɛ.

english_verse: People of Israel, I have made my decision. An army from a distant country will attack you. I've chosen an ancient nation, and you won't understand their language.
translation_verse: Ao Yisrael awuro ama, ɛ́mɔtie, méma maen bie bɔ ofi dedeede ɔ ɔfa koɛ ɔbateta ɛmɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Ɔte maen bɔ ye nwo yɛ se ɔ, ɔte daa tete maen, maen bɔ ɛnde ye dwudwolɛ, bɔ ɛnde bɔ ɔkã ne abo ɔ.

english_verse: All of them are warriors, and their arrows bring death.
translation_verse: B’agyaen ndokue ne, ɔte kyɛ asieleɛ kumaa bɔ so la berɛ ɔ; bɛ mukoraa bɛte katakyie.

english_verse: This nation will eat your crops and livestock; they will leave no fruit on your vines or fig trees. And although you feel safe behind thick walls, your towns will be destroyed and your children killed. Israel Refused To Worship the Lord
translation_verse: Bekoli wɔ fieso aleɛ ne w’aleɛ; bekohũhũ wɔ mma mmienzua ne wɔ mma mmrasua; bekohũhũ wɔ mmoaen ne wɔ nandwie mɔ bekoli, bekobubu wɔ bobe ne borɔdoma mmakaa bekogua; wɔ nguro bɔ ato bɛ nwo fasue, bɔ afa wɔ wora awura bɛ nu ne, bɛkɔfa ngrandɛ bɛkɔsɛkye bɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, the enemy army won't kill everyone in Judah.
translation_verse: “Nakoso AWURADE nwa nyoo: Sɔ mmerɛ nemɔ anu po, mengonua ɛmɔ boso bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: And the people who survive will ask, “Why did the Lord our God do such terrible things to us?” Then tell them: I am the Lord, but you abandoned me and worshiped other gods in your own land. Now you will be slaves in a foreign country.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɛ wɔ mmenia nemɔ bisa kyɛ, ‘Nzu ati yeɛ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ wafa sɔ nningyein he amukoraa wali yɛ ne?’ a, bua bɛ kyɛ, ‘Kyɛbɔ ɛmɔapo me baaso nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ wɔ ɛmɔ maen ye anu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔkɔso ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ wɔ aseɛ bɔ nna ɛmɔ deɛ ahɔ ɔ so ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Tell these things to each other, you people of Judah, you descendants of Jacob.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbɔ ye dawure wɔ Yakob awuro, ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́to dwaa wɔ Yuda kyɛ,

english_verse: You fools! Why don't you listen when I speak? Why can't you understand
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔtie ɛhe, mmenia ngwaseafoɛ bɔ ɛmɔlle adwene ɔ, mmenia bɔ bele anyeɛ, nakoso bennwu nikye ɔ, bɔ bele asoɛ, nakoso bɛnde dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: that you should worship me with fear and trembling? I'm the one who made the shore to hold back the ocean. Waves may crash on the beach, but they can come no farther.
translation_verse: “Aso ɛmɔnzuro me? AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Aso ɛmɔ nwo nwosowoso ɛmɔ wɔ me nyunu? Me bɔ mvale anweaa ndole ɛwɛen mmane ɛpo, ɛwɛen bɔ otimu berɛ afebɔɔ bɔ ɔngora ye tra ɔ; ɔwɔ nu kyɛ asorɔkye bɔ, nakoso ɔngora mmɔ ndra ye; asorɔkye bu fa so, nakoso ɔngora mmu mva ɛwɛen ne aso.

english_verse: You stubborn people have rebelled and turned your backs on me.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɔ maen he, asoserɛ ne ɛlɔenyɛlɛ ali bɛ ti; bali makyebu bafa bɛ bɔbɔ b’atee so.

english_verse: You refuse to say, “Let's worship the Lord! He's the one who sends rain in spring and autumn and gives us a good harvest.”
translation_verse: Bɛndwene ye nwo kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔma yɛsuro AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔma esue tɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu, bamborɔ ne nyenyenzue, ná ɔnea kyɛ fieso nningyein koti mmerɛ bɔ yeɛ ɔsɛ ɔ nu.’

english_verse: A hunter traps birds and puts them in a cage, but some of you trap humans and make them your slaves.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔnefoɛ bafra me mmenia nu; bɛtetɛ kyɛ ebie bɔ osua nnomaa ngaen ɔ, besunzua ngaen bɛfa bɛkye mmenia.

english_verse: You are evil, and you lie and cheat to make yourselves rich. You are powerful
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ nnomaa ayi kɛndɛngu nu to ne, sɔ ala yeɛ nnakannaka ayi b’awuro mɔ nu to ɔ; yiti bayɛ atitire, yeɛ banya bɛ nwo tam.

english_verse: Look at the terrible things going on in this country. I am shocked!
translation_verse: Edwirɛ bɔ ɔyɛ suro ná ɔma bɛ nwo dwiri bɛ ɔ yeɛ wape maen ne anu ɔ:

english_verse: Prophets give their messages in the name of a false god, my priests don't want to serve me, and you—my own people— like it this way! But on the day of disaster, where will you turn for help?
translation_verse: ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bedi ngɔndorɔ, yeɛ asɔfo nemɔ bedi bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti piri; na sɔ yeɛ me maen ne kuro ɔ, nakoso odwu ayieleɛ ne a, ɛmɔkɔyɔ ye sɛ?

english_verse: Run for your lives, people of Benjamin. Get out of Jerusalem. Sound a trumpet in Tekoa and light a signal fire in Beth-Haccherem. Soon you will be struck by disaster from the north.
translation_verse: Ao Benyaminfoɛ, ɛ́mɔnwati béfi Yerusalem bɛɛbɔ ɛmɔ nwo adwaa! Ɛ́mɔhu totorobɛndo ne wɔ Tekoa, na ɛ́mɔma nwosina frangaa otu hɔ anwuro wɔ Bete Hakerem, ofikyɛ musue ne amaneɛ piri bie waye ye ti wafi sorɔ dɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem is a lovely pasture,
translation_verse: Mafa Sion awa brasua ne matoto taluwa anwonyemene sɔkyee nwo.

english_verse: but shepherds will surround it and divided up, then let their flocks eat all the grass.
translation_verse: Mmoaenneafoɛ ne bɛ mmoaen kure kɔwa ye so. Bekosi bɛ tena sua bɛkɔbra ye nwo bekoyia, na bɛ nu biala kodidi ye bɔbɔ ye nekaa.

english_verse: Kings will tell their troops, “If we reach Jerusalem in the morning, we'll attack at noon. But if we arrive later,
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔfa koɛ bɛɛteta ye; ɛ́mɔdwɔso maa yɛfa koɛ yɛɛtoa ye eyiagyina!” “Yawu oo, aleɛ pena sa, nɔsoa wawoɛ mɔ bayɛ ndendenn!”

english_verse: we'll attack after dark and destroy its fortresses.”
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔdwɔso bɛ́ma yɛɛfa koɛ yɛteta ye kɔngɔen, ná yɛɛbubu ye ahemvie nemɔ!”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I will command these armies to chop down trees and build a ramp up to the walls of Jerusalem. People of Jerusalem, I must punish you for your injustice.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔ Asafo AWURADE ɔkã hɔ ɛhe: “Ɛ́mɔbubu Yerusalem mmakaa bégua, ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́yɛ nyinasoɛ bɛ́fo bɛhɔ kuro ne anu. Ɔte kuro bɔ ɔfata kyɛ bɛtwe ye so ɔ, nhyɛsoɛ ngome yeɛ ɔwɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: Evil pours from your city like water from a spring. Sounds of injustice and violence echo within your walls; victims are everywhere, wounded and dying.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ abura pu ye nzue ba ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Yerusalem di nzɛmmɔne ɔ; atianuserɛ ne atutureasɛm yeɛ bɛte ye wɔ kuro ne anu ɔ; anwonyerɛ ne epuralɛ yeɛ menwu ye daa ɔ.

english_verse: Listen to me, you people of Jerusalem and Judah. I will abandon you, and your land will become an empty desert.
translation_verse: Ao Yerusalem, fa ɛhe tu wɔ nwo foɛ, wanyɛ sɔ a, me kra kɔhwe ye nwo kofi wɔ nwo, na ngɔmaa ɛkɔkakyi kurofoen, aseɛ bɔ sona biala ɔtte so ɔ.

english_verse: I will tell your enemies to leave your nation bare like a vine stripped of grapes. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah's Anger
translation_verse: Bɔ Asafo AWURADE kã hɔ ɛhe: “Bɛkɔyeye Yisraelfoɛ bɔ baha nemɔ anu, kyɛ bobe mmaa bɔ bɛyeye nu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ebie bɔ ɔtete bobe ne, osa fa ye sa tete bɔ waha mmaen ne aso ne gua kɛndɛen nu ɔ.”

english_verse: I have told the people that you, Lord, will punish them, but they just laugh and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ndwudwo ngyire ye mmɔ ye kɔkɔ maa otie ɔ? Nea, batuatua bɛ so, bɛngora bɛnde dwirɛ. Nea, AWURADE dwirɛ ne te ngorohoɛ dwirɛ ma bɛ; bɛ nye ngye ye nwo.

english_verse: Your anger against Judah flames up inside me, and I can't hold it in much longer. The Lord's Anger Will Sweep Everyone Away The Lord answered: Don't hold back my anger! Let it sweep away everyone— the children at play and all adults, young and old alike.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE ahonehulɛ ne wawura me nu tɛkyɛ bɔ mengora me nwo so hyɛ ɔ. “Ngɔfa me yaa piri ne ngɔhɔ ngwadaa so wɔ mmorɔnoɛ nemɔ aso, yeɛ mmerandeɛ kure ne aso; ofikyɛ bɛkɔhye biaa ne ɔye po, yeɛ nworowaa ne mmenia bɔ banyi paa ɔ koso.

english_verse: I'll punish the people of Judah and give to others their houses and fields, as well as their wives. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Na b’awuro mɔ kɔɔyɛ mmeni foforɛ deɛ, bɔ bɛ boo mɔ ne bɛ ye mɔ boka so ɔ; ofikyɛ ngɔtengyɛ me sa wɔ aseɛ ne aso ama bɛ so,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ofi bɛ nu kwahweabaa mɔ so bɔ ɔkwaadwu bɛ nu titire paa mɔ so ɔ, apoobɔlɛ ali ebiala ti; ofi ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ so bɔ ɔkwaadwu ɔsɔfo so po, ebiala nga nahorɛ.

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Bande bɛ nye bammia me maen ye ngena mɔ. Na bɛnwa, ‘Asomdwee oo, asomdwee oo,’ wɔ aberɛ bɔ asomdwee nne berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of their disgusting sins, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Rejected God's Way of Life
translation_verse: Akyiwadeɛ nningyein bɔ bɛyɔle ne, aso ɔyɛle bɛ animguaseɛ? Daabi, wanyɛ bɛ nya koraa, bɛ nye ammɔ bɛ dwɛ po. Yiti bɛ koso bɛkɔtotɔ wɔ mmenia bɔ bɛtotɔ nemɔ anu. Mmerɛ bɔ ngɔhwe bɛ so ne, bekowuwu, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The Lord said: My people, when you stood at the crossroads, I told you, “Follow the road your ancestors took, and you will find peace.” But you refused.
translation_verse: Bɔ AWURADE kã hɔ ɛhe: “Ɛ́mɔgyina atee nemɔ aso, ná ɛ́mɔnea; ɛ́mɔbisa bɛ́pena tete atimbire nemɔ, nekaa bɔ atee paa ne la ne, ná ɛ́mɔfa so, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanya nwomelelɛ bama ɛmɔ kra. Nakoso bɛnwa, ‘Yɛngɔfa so.’

english_verse: I also sent prophets to warn you of danger, but when they sounded the alarm, you paid no attention.
translation_verse: Asa koso, nyeyele awɛmvoɛ kyɛ bɛbɔ ɛmɔ kɔkɔ kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔtie totorobɛndo ne hulɛ ne!’ Nakoso bɛnwa, ‘Yɛngotie.’

english_verse: So I tell all nations on earth, “Watch what I will do!
translation_verse: Yiti, amaenmaen mɔ, ɛ́mɔtie, ná mmenia bɔ bayia nu, ɛ́mɔnwu nikyee bɔ ɔkɔto bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: My people ignored me and rejected my laws. They planned to do evil, and now the evil they planned will happen to them.”
translation_verse: Ao aseɛ, tie! Nea, mebaaprapra musue megua maen he aso; bɛ yɔleɛ ne, mmaa bɔ wasu hɔ ɛne, ofikyɛ bandie me noa dwirɛ, na me mmeraa koso, bapo.

english_verse: People of Judah, you bring me incense from Sheba and spices from distant lands. You offer sacrifices of all kinds. But why bother? I hate these gifts of yours!
translation_verse: Ɛyɛɛ bɔ bɛ ne ye fi Hyeba bɛba, yeɛ ayirefona bɔ bɛ ne ye fi dedeede maen bie aso bɛba ne, aso bɛ nwo le mvasoɛ ma me? Me nye ngye ɛmɔ ɛyeralɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ anwo, yeɛ ɛmɔ afɔleɛ mɔ koso bɛnzɔ me nye.

english_verse: So I will put stumbling blocks in your path, and everyone will die, including parents and children, neighbors and friends. An Army from the North
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ AWURADE kã hɔ ɛhe: ‘Tie, ngɔfa sundidua ngɔto maen he anyunu, bɔ seɛ mɔ ne mmaa mɔ bɛkɔfofo so bekofi ase ɔ; na abiɛngoɛ mɔ ne adamvoa mɔ bekowuwu.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Look toward the north, where a powerful nation has prepared for war.
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ AWURADE kã hɔ ɛhe: “Tie, mmenia bie fi sorɔ dɔ aseɛ ne aso bɛ́ba, maen piri bie kodwɔso kofi aseɛ noa dɔ paa.

english_verse: Its well-armed troops are cruel and never show mercy. Their galloping horses sound like ocean waves pounding on the shore. This army will attack you, lovely Jerusalem.”
translation_verse: Betiratira agyaen ne pealɛɛ; bɛ ti anu yɛ se, na bɛnze anwumvoin; bɛ komvi bobɔ nu kyɛ ɛpo asorɔkye, bɛtete mbɔngɔ so. Ao Sion awa brasua, baboa bɛ nwo bɛba wɔ so kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛkɔ koɛ ɔ!”

english_verse: Then the people said, “Just hearing about them makes us tremble with fear, and we twist and turn in pain like a woman giving birth.”
translation_verse: Yate sɔ dwirɛ ne, y’abasa nu agoho; ahunundetelɛ atɔ yɛ so, na yɛnwu yealɛ kyɛ brasua bɔ wafo aworɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Don't work in your fields or walk along the roads. It's too dangerous. The enemy is well armed
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔkɔ buro, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔnate atee so; ofikyɛ pɔfoɛ nemɔ ngrandɛ ne ahunundetelɛ bapɛ ɛmɔ nwo amukoraa bayia.

english_verse: and attacks without warning. So mourn, my people, as though your only child had died. Wear clothes made of sackcloth and roll in the ash pile.” The Lord's People Must Be Tested The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ao, me maen awa brasua, kera ɛsɛen tena, munumunu wɔ nwo wɔ nzoen nu, ná sũ hahii kyɛ esu bahorɛ ɔ, bɔ awuye yealɛ paa, ofikyɛ mvum nu yeɛ sɛkyefoɛ ne kɔwa yɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: And you'll find they are hard like bronze and iron. They are stubborn rebels, always spreading lies. *
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa bɛte asoserɛfoɛ bɔ bayɛ lɔen ɔ, bɛnate bedi nzekure; bɛte kɔɔbere ne buralɛ, bɛ mukoraa bɛte ngondombofoɛ.

english_verse: But you have ignored me and become even more stubborn and sinful than your ancestors ever were! Slaughter Valley The Lord said:
translation_verse: nakoso bandie me dwirɛ, yeɛ bandɛ me so, na mmom bɛsoale bɛ kɔme so kyeinn. Bɛyɔle bɔ ɔtte mayee bɛtrale bɛ nana mɔ.

english_verse: Stop taking advantage of foreigners, orphans, and widows. Don't kill innocent people. And stop worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: sɛ ɛmɔanhyɛ ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ, nyisiaa ne akunafoɛ mmrasua mɔ so, sɛ ɛmɔanga mogya bɔ odi be ɔ bangua wɔ wa, ná ɛmɔanzo nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ bamva banha ɛmɔ nwo a,

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! My temple is here in Jerusalem, but that doesn't mean I will protect you.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ wora bewura ngondombo dwirɛ hemɔ anu: ‘AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne, AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne, AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne ɛhe.’

english_verse: I will keep you safe only if you change your ways and are fair and honest with each other.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɛ ɛmɔsesã ɛmɔ atee bɔ ɛmɔnate so, ɔne ɛmɔ yɔleɛ nahorɛ nu, sɛ ɛmɔbua mmenia afia ndɛen bɔ ɔtengyɛ,

english_verse: Then I will let you enjoy a long life in this land I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: ye de ngɔma ɛmɔkɔtena wa, aseɛ bɔ daa ne mva mane ɛmɔ nana mɔ afebɔɔ ne aso.

english_verse: But just look at what is happening! You put your trust in worthless lies.
translation_verse: “Nakoso ngondombo dwirɛ bɔ ɔmmoka ɛmɔ ne yeɛ ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bɛto so ɔ.

english_verse: You steal and murder; you lie in court and are unfaithful in marriage. You worship idols and offer incense to Baal, when these gods have never done anything for you.
translation_verse: Aso ɛmɔkowua, ɛmɔkoli awue, ɛmɔkɔsɛkye agyaa, ɛmɔkɔta ngondombo ndaen, ɛmɔkɔyera ɛyɛɛ bɛkɔma Baal, ɛmɔkoli nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ bɔ ɛmɔnze bɛ ɔ bɛ si,

english_verse: And then you come into my temple and worship me! Do you think I will protect you so that you can go on sinning?
translation_verse: ná afei ɛmɔagyina me nyunu wɔ awuro ye bɔ me dumaa la so ɔ ye anu, ná ɛmɔahã kyɛ, ‘Edwirɛ tɛɛ biala ngɔto yɛ!’ ná ɛmɔahɔ so babɔ sɔ akyiwadeɛ bra he amukoraa?

english_verse: You are thieves, and you have made my temple your hideout. But I've seen everything you have done.
translation_verse: Awuro ye bɔ me dumaa la so ye, aso wakakyi awuefoɛ afealeɛ wɔ ɛmɔ nye so anaa? Tie, me bɔbɔ manwu bɔ ɔkɔ so ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Go to Shiloh, where my sacred tent once stood. Take a look at what I did there. My people Israel sinned, and so I destroyed Shiloh!
translation_verse: Afei, ɛmɔhɔ m’atenaleɛ bɔ né ɔwɔ Silo, nekaa bɔ nnili moa mvale me dumaa ndole so ne, ná ɛmɔɔnea nikyee bɔ ɔnate me maen Yisrael ye bɔne ti mva nyɔle ye ɔ.

english_verse: While you have been sinning, I have been trying to talk to you, but you refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Na afei, AWURADE nwa nyoo, ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔayɔ sɔ nningyein hemɔ amukoraa, bɔ ngɔle so ndwudwole ngyirele ɛmɔ dee bɔ ɛmɔandie ne, ná mvrɛle ɛmɔ ne, ɛmɔandɛ me so ne ati,

english_verse: Don't think this temple will protect you. Long ago I told your ancestors to build it and worship me here, but now I have decided to tear it down, just as I destroyed Shiloh.
translation_verse: yiti awuro he bɔ me dumaa la so, bɔ ɛmɔafa bɛ wora bawura nu ne, ɔne nekaa bɔ mva mane ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ nana mɔ ne, edwirɛ bɔ mamaa wato Silo ne yeɛ ngɔmaa ɔkɔto ye ɔ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people! I, the Lord, would refuse to listen.
translation_verse: “Yiti wɔ de, nnɛpa kyerɛ ma sɔ maen he, nnɛsũ ma bɛ, nnɛbɔ mbaeɛ ma bɛ, yeɛ nnɛsrɛ ma bɛ, ofikyɛ mengɔtɛ wɔ so.

english_verse: Do you see what the people of Judah are doing in their towns and in the streets of Jerusalem?
translation_verse: Bɔ bɛyɔ ye wɔ Yuda nguro nemɔ aso ne Yerusalem dwaa nemɔ aso ye, aso ennwu ye?

english_verse: Children gather firewood, their fathers build fires, and their mothers mix dough to bake bread for the goddess they call the Queen of Heaven. They even offer wine sacrifices to other gods, just to insult me.
translation_verse: Ngwadaa bubu eyein, seɛ mɔ sɔ see, na mmrasua mɔ fete mɔle bɛfa bɛto taterɛ bɛma bosoen bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Nyameɛso Hemmaa ne; na behwie anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɛma mmosoen foforɛ mɔ bɛfa bewura me apue.

english_verse: But they are not only insulting me; they are also harming themselves by doing these shameful things.
translation_verse: Me yeɛ bewura me apue ye? AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Aso nna bɛ bɔbɔ yeɛ bɛha bɛ nwo ɔ?

english_verse: And now, I, the Lord All-Powerful, will flood Judah with my fiery anger until nothing is left—no people or animals, no trees or crops. It Is Useless To Offer Sacrifices
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ kã hɔ ɛhe: Tie, m’ahonehulɛ ne me yaa piri ne, ngohwie ngogua ɛwa, kuro sona ne ngaka so, eburo mmakaa ne aseɛ so mmakaammaa so; ɔkɔyera bɔ ongonua ɔ.

english_verse: At the time I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I didn't command them to offer sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ kyẽa bɔ nyele ɛmɔ nana mɔ mvili Misraim aseɛ so mmale ne, mangã naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne afɔleɛbɔlɛ nwo dwirɛ mangyire bɛ, yeɛ manhyehyɛ ye nwo mmeraa biala mamma bɛ.

english_verse: Instead, I told them, “If you listen to me and do what I tell you, I will be your God, you will be my people, and all will go well for you.”
translation_verse: Nakoso mmeraa bɔ mva mane bɛ ole kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔtie me dwirɛ, na ngɔyɛ ɛmɔ Nyameɛ, ná ɛmɔ wora ɛmɔayɛ me maen. Na atee amukoraa bɔ nhyehyɛle mmane ɛmɔ ne, so ala yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa ɔ, amaa ɔnate so wayie ɛmɔ yé.’

english_verse: But your ancestors refused to listen. They were stubborn, and whenever I wanted them to go one way, they always went the other.
translation_verse: Nakoso bandie me dwirɛ, yeɛ banyɛ asoɛ bamma me. Na mmom, belili bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti piri bɛyɔle bɔne bɔ bekuro ɔ. Bɛkakyili bɛ si bɛmane me bɔ bannea me nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: Ever since your ancestors left Egypt, I have been sending my servants the prophets to speak for me.
translation_verse: Ofi kyẽa bɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ befili Misraim aseɛ so bɛwale bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ɔ, mahɔ so masoma me somvoɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ amukoraa dee wɔ ɛmɔ berɛ,

english_verse: Jeremiah, no matter what you do, the people won't listen.
translation_verse: “Yiti ɛkɔhã sɔ dwirɛ he amukoraa kohyire bɛ, nakoso bengotie wɔ dwirɛ. Ɛkɔfrɛ bɛ, nakoso bɛngɔtɛ wɔ so.

english_verse: So you must say to them: People of Judah, I am the Lord your God, but you have refused to obey me, and you didn't change when I punished you. And now, you no longer even pretend to be faithful to me.
translation_verse: Kã kyire bɛ kyɛ, ‘Maen bɔ wandie AWURADE ye Nyameɛ dwirɛ, ná wanne ɛtengyɛlɛ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ye wando nu ne, ye ɛhe. Nahorɛ ayie, watu wamini wafi bɛ noa.

english_verse: Shave your head bald and throw away the hair. Sing a funeral song on top of a barren hill. You people have made me angry, and I have abandoned you.
translation_verse: Tete wɔ ti nwiaa gyi gua; bɔ awuye wɔ mmokaa pralaa nemɔ aso, ofikyɛ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ bɔ bahu AWURADE ahone ne, wapo bɛ waye ye sa wafi bɛ bo.’

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by putting your disgusting idols in my temple, and now the temple itself is disgusting to me.
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ AWURADE nwa nyoo: Yudafoɛ bayɔ bɔne wɔ me nye so. Bagyinagyina b’akyiwadeɛ nningyein ne wɔ sua bɔ me dumaa la so ne anu, maa ɔnate so bafa efiɛ bahã ye.

english_verse: At Topheth in Hinnom Valley you have built altars where you kill your children and burn them as sacrifices to other gods. I would never think of telling you to do this.
translation_verse: Na basisi Tofete asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ bɔ ɔwɔ Hinom awa bɔnza ne anu ne, kyɛ bɛfa bɛyera bɛ mma mmienzua ne bɛ mma mmrasua wɔ see nu. Ɛhe te nikyee bɔ mamva ye nwo ahyɛdeɛ mamma bɛ ɔ, yeɛ wamma me ti anu po.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday that place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley, because you will bury your dead there until you run out of room,
translation_verse: Yiti tie, AWURADE nwa nyoo: Mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba bɔ bɛngɔfrɛ ye Tofete anaa Hinom Awa bɔnza ko, na mmom bɛkɔfrɛ ye Akumyɛɛ bɔnza. Ofikyɛ bekosie fuin wɔ Tofete alaa maa okoodwu kyɛ bennya nekaa ko ɔ.

english_verse: and then bodies will lie scattered on the ground. Birds and wild animals will come and eat, and no one will be around to scare them off.
translation_verse: Maen he anu ama bɛ fuin kɔyɛ aleɛ kɔma ewienu nnomaa ne aseɛnwo ngaka, na ebiala ngɔfoa bɛ maa bɛngɔnwati.

english_verse: When I am finished with your land, there will be deathly silence in the empty ruins of Jerusalem and the towns of Judah—no happy voices, no sounds of parties or wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Na Yuda nguro nemɔ anu ne Yerusalem dwaa nemɔ aso, ahurusililɛ nwo nga, anigye nwo nga, atɔmvorɛ biaa nwo nga, yeɛ atɔmvorɛ braa nwo nga, ngotu bɛ bo, ofikyɛ aseɛ ne kɔyɛ kurofoen.

english_verse: Then the bones of the dead kings of Judah and their officials will be dug up, along with the bones of the priests, the prophets, and everyone else in Jerusalem
translation_verse: “AWURADE nwa nyoo, sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, bekotu Yuda ahemvo mɔ mmowue, ye mbanyi mɔ mmowue, ye asɔfo mɔ mmowue, ye ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ mɔ mmowue ne Yerusalemfoɛ mmowue bekofi b’asieleɛ kumaa nemɔ anu.

english_verse: who loved and worshiped the sun, moon, and stars. These bones will be scattered and left lying on the ground like trash, where the sun and moon and stars can shine on them.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔfa bɛ bɛkɔsamo ɛhemɔ anyunu: eyia, ɛsraen ne nyameɛso abɔdeɛ amukoraa bɔ behurole bɛ dwirɛ, bɛsole bɛ, belili bɛ si, ná bɛhɔle bɛ berɛ abisa bɛsɔnene bɛ ne. Bɛngɔboaboa mmowue nemɔ anoa, yeɛ bengosie bɛ; bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ fofoɛ wɔ aseɛ so.

english_verse: Some of you people of Judah will be left alive, but I will force you to go to foreign countries, and you will wish you were dead. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken. The People Took the Wrong Road
translation_verse: Sɔ amumuyɛɛ abusua bɔ bɛkɔha ne amukoraa, nekaa biala bɔ mafoa bɛ maagua ne, bekohuro kyɛ bekowu tra kyɛ bɛkɔtena ngoa nu ɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The Lord said: People of Jerusalem, when you stumble and fall, you get back up, and if you take a wrong road, you turn around and go back.
translation_verse: “Kã kyire bɛ kyɛ, Bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: Sɛ mmenia befi ase a, benza bendwɔso ko anaa? Sɛ sona di makyebu a, aso onza ye si anaa?

english_verse: So why do you refuse to come back to me? Why do you hold so tightly to your false gods?
translation_verse: Na nzu ati yeɛ sɔ Yerusalemfoɛ ye, bafa asefinɛ bayɛ nnaa ye? Batira nnakannaka nu serɛserɛ, na bayɛ b’adwene kyɛ bengosa bɛ si.

english_verse: I listen carefully, but none of you admit that you've done wrong. Without a second thought, you run down the wrong road like horses running blindly into battle.
translation_verse: Mayɛ asoɛ matie, nakoso bɔ bɛkã ne, nahorɛ nne nu; ebiala nne berɛ bɔ onya ye bɔne nwo nnuhoɛ ɔ, bɔ ɔkã kyɛ, ‘Na nzikyɛ yeɛ mayɔ e?’ Ebiala wamakye waafa ye bɔbɔ ye atee so, kyɛ pɔngɔ bɔ ole amirika ɔkɔ koɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: Storks, doves, swallows, and thrushes all know when it's time to fly away for the winter and when to come back. But you, my people, don't know what I demand.
translation_verse: Akyemvona katakyie bɔ ɔwɔ ewienu ne po, ɔse ye mmerɛ; yeɛ aborɔma, nandwinoma ne bɔlanoma bɛse mmerɛ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛba ɔ; nakoso me maen de, benze AWURADE ahyɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: You say, “We are wise because we have the teachings and laws of the Lord.” But I say that your teachers have turned my words into lies!
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔkã kyɛ, ‘Yɛse nworɛ, na AWURADE mmeraa ne, yɛ berɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ ɔ’? Nakoso tie, nahorɛ nu, ngondombo bɔ ahyerɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bahyerɛ ne, wakakyi edwirɛ ne maa wayɛ anoanu.

english_verse: Your wise men have rejected what I say, and so they have no wisdom. Now they will be trapped and put to shame; they won't know what to do.
translation_verse: Nworɛfoɛ nyunu kogua ase, ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ bɛ so, ná wahye bɛ. Tie, AWURADE dwirɛ yeɛ bapo ye e, na nzikyɛ nworɛ yeɛ bɛse ɔ?

english_verse: I'll give their wives and fields to strangers. Everyone is greedy and dishonest, whether poor or rich. Even the prophets and priests cannot be trusted.
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔfa bɛ ye mɔ ngɔma mmenia foforɛ, ná mafa bɛ boo mɔ mama bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ, ofikyɛ ofi kwahweabaa so bɔ ɔkwaadwu atitire paa so, bɛ mukoraa bedi aminɛ; ofi ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ so bɔ ɔkwaadwu ɔsɔfo so, ebiala nate ngondombo atee so.

english_verse: All they ever offer to my deeply wounded people are empty hopes for peace.
translation_verse: Bande bɛ nye bammia me maen ngena mɔ. Na bɛnwa, ‘Asomdwee oo, asomdwee oo,’ wɔ aberɛ bɔ asomdwee nne berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: They should be ashamed of the way they live, but they don't even blush. And so, when I punish Judah, they will end up on the ground, dead like everyone else.
translation_verse: Akyiwadeɛ nningyein bɔ bɛyɔle ne, aso ɔyɛle bɛ animguaseɛ? Daabi, wanyɛ bɛ nya koraa, bɛ nye ammɔ bɛ dwɛ po. Yiti bɛ koso bɛkɔtotɔ wɔ mmenia bɔ bɛtotɔ nemɔ anu. Mmerɛ bɔ ngɔhwe bɛ so ne, bekowuwu, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I will wipe them out. They are vines without grapes; fig trees without figs or leaves. They have not done a thing that I told them! I, the Lord, have spoken. The People and Their Punishment
translation_verse: Ngonua bɛ boso amba, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Bengonwu bobe mmaa wɔ bobe bakaa so, yeɛ bengonwu borɔdoma wɔ borɔdoma bakaa so. Bɛ nyaa mɔ po kɔkese, na bɔ mva mane bɛ ne, okofi bɛ sa.

english_verse: The people of Judah say to each other, “What are we waiting for? Let's run to a town with walls and die there. We rebelled against the Lord, and we were sentenced to die by drinking poison.
translation_verse: Yɛtɛ te berɛ yɛyɔ nzu? Ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ noa, ná ɛ́mɔma yɛhɔ nguro bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue nemɔ anu yɛɛwuwu wɔ dɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ wanoma yɛ kyɛ yɛwuwu, na wama yɛ nzue bɔ ɛborɔ wɔ nu ɔ kyɛ yɛno, ofikyɛ yayɔ bɔne yatia AWURADE.

english_verse: We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Yɛ nye lale asomdwee ate, nakoso nikye paa biala wamvi nu wamma, yɛ nye lale anwonyerɛsalɛ mmerɛ ate, nakoso ahunundetelɛ mmom yeɛ watɔ yɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: Our enemies have reached the town of Dan in the north, and the snorting of their horses makes us tremble with fear. The enemy will destroy Jerusalem and our entire nation. No one will survive.”
translation_verse: “Bɛte bɛ mbɔngɔ nemɔ nwomeɛlelɛ ne befi Dan; bɛ mbɔngɔ nyii nemɔ, bɛ suɛ ne, ye dede ne ma aseɛ ne amukoraa woso. Ofikyɛ bɛ́ba bɛbasɛkye aseɛ ne, ɔne so nningyein amukoraa, bɛbaabɔ kuro ne, ná bekũkũ nu ama.

english_verse: “Watch out!” the Lord says. “I'm sending poisonous snakes to attack you, and no one can stop them.” Jeremiah Mourns for His People
translation_verse: Tie, mésoma ewoo mɔ, ɛbɔnaa bɔ ewoo ayire ngora bɛ ɔ, maa bɛba ɛmɔ so na bɛkɔkeka ɛmɔ,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ n’aworabɔlɛlilɛ

english_verse: I'm burdened with sorrow and feel like giving up.
translation_verse: M’anigye atu amini, aworabɔlɛ atira me, me kra wora abɔ wɔ me nu.

english_verse: In a foreign land my people are crying. Listen! You'll hear them say, “Has the Lord deserted Zion? Is he no longer its king?” I hear the Lord reply, “Why did you make me angry by worshiping useless idols?”
translation_verse: Tie, me maen awa brasua ye sufrɛ fi aseɛ ne ti kɔkã ye ti kyɛ, ‘Aso AWURADE nne Sion anaa? Aso ye Hene ne, ɔnne kuro ne anu anaa?’ “Nzu ati yeɛ bafa b’amoen nemɔ ne amaenmaenso mmosoen bawura me apue ye?”

english_verse: The people complain, “Spring and summer have come and gone, but still the Lord hasn't rescued us.”
translation_verse: Buberɛ ne apɛ nu, mmakaammaatelɛ mmerɛ ne wawa ayieleɛ, nakoso bellele yɛ ngoa.”

english_verse: My people are crushed, and so is my heart. I am horrified and mourn.
translation_verse: Ɔnate me maen awa brasua ye puralɛ ne ati, me koso mapura, mébɔ awuye, na ahunundetelɛ atɔ me so.

english_verse: If medicine and doctors may be found in Gilead, why aren't my people healed?
translation_verse: Aso ayire biala nne Gileade anaa? Aso safoɛ biala nne berɛ anaa? Nzu ati yeɛ me maen awa brasua bennya bɛssale ye anwonyerɛ ye?

english_verse: I wish that my eyes were fountains of tears, so I could cry day and night for my people who were killed.
translation_verse: Ao, ahaa né me ti te mbombonzue, ná me nye te abura bɔ opu moen ɔ. Ahaa eyia ne kɔngɔen ngosu me maen awa brasua ye mmenia bɔ bahũhũ bɛ ne!

english_verse: I wish I could go into the desert and find a hiding place from all who are treacherous and unfaithful to God. The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Ao, ahaa né manya ɛwɔfoɛ dabea wɔ ɛserɛ so, amaa mahora mayakyi me mmenia nu mahwe me nwo mafi bɛ nwo mahɔ! Ofikyɛ bɛ mukoraa bɛte agyaasɛkyelɛfoɛ ne nnakannakafoɛ fekue.

english_verse: The Lord replied: Lies come from the mouths of my people, like arrows from a bow. With each dishonest deed their power increases, and not one of them will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Bɛkondo bɛ temverema kyɛ agyaen bɛpɛ anoanu; nna nahorɛ ɔ, na mmom ngondombopɛlɛ yeɛ wamaa batindim wɔ aseɛ ye aso ɔ, ofikyɛ bɛyɔ bɔne bɛfoa bɔne so, na bɛnze me, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: They wear themselves out, always looking for a new way to cheat their friends.
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa bɛlakalaka bɛ mmango mɔ, ebiala nga nahorɛ; bɛbɔ mmɔden wɔ ngondombopɛlɛ nwo, bɛyɔ amumuyɛɛ, na ɔyɛ bɛ se kyɛ bɛkɔsakyera ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone takes advantage of everyone else, and no one will admit that I am God.
translation_verse: Nnakannaka nu yeɛ ɔte w’atenaleɛ ɔ! Nnakannaka ti benguro kyɛ bekonwu me ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: And so I will purify the hearts of my people just as gold is purified in a furnace. I have no other choice.
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ Asafo AWURADE kã ɛhe: “Ngɔpɔ bɛ nwo ngoso bɛ ngɔnea, na me maen awa brasua ne ati, nzikyɛ koraa yeɛ nyɔ ɔ?

english_verse: They say they want peace, but this lie is deadly, like an arrow that strikes when you least expect it.
translation_verse: Bɛ temverema te kyɛ agyaen bɔ odi awue ɔ; ɔkã ngondombo dwirɛ. Bɛkekã asomdwee dwirɛ bekyirekyire bɛ mmango mɔ, nakoso bɛ ti anu de, bɛbɔ porɛ kyɛ bɛkɔtetɛ bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Give me one good reason not to punish them as they deserve. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken. Jeremiah Weeps for His People
translation_verse: Aso onni kyɛ metwe bɛ so wɔ sɔ nningyein hemɔ nwo anaa? AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Na maen bɔ ɔte sɔaa, onni kyɛ me kra tɔ bɛ so wereɛ anaa?

english_verse: I weep for the pastureland in the hill country. It's so barren and scorched that no one travels there. No cattle can be found there, and birds and wild animals have all disappeared.
translation_verse: Mmokaa nemɔ ati, ngosu ngɔbɔ abubue, yeɛ ɛserɛ so nekaa bɔ ngaka didi ne ati, ngɔbɔ awuye, ofikyɛ bayera bɛ bɔ ebiala ngora mbɛ nu berɛ ɔ, na bɛnde nyɛmmoa suɛ; ewienu nnomaa yeɛ eburo ngaka koso, banwati bahɔ.

english_verse: I heard the Lord reply, “When I am finished, Jerusalem and the towns of Judah will be piles of ruins where only jackals live.” Why the Land Was Destroyed
translation_verse: Ngɔma Yerusalem kɔkakyi esire sire, ɛserɛ so ngyea atenaleɛ; ngɔma Yuda nguro kɔkakyi kurofoen, bɔ sona biala nne so ɔ.”

english_verse: I said to the Lord, “None of us can understand why the land has become like an uncrossable desert. Won't you explain why?”
translation_verse: “Nwa yeɛ ɔte nworɛniɛ bɔ ɔkɔte ɛhe abo ɔ? Na nwa yeɛ AWURADE noa wadwudwo wahyire ye bɔ odi kyɛ ɔbɔ ye dawure ɔ? Nzu ati yeɛ aseɛ ne ayɛ pralaa kyɛ ɛserɛ so, maa ɔnate so ebiala mva so ye?

english_verse: The Lord said: I destroyed the land because the people disobeyed me and rejected my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE nwa, “Ɔnate kyɛ bapo me mmeraa bɔ mahyehyɛ mama bɛ, bɔ bandie me dwirɛ, ná bannea so bammɔ bɛ bra,

english_verse: They were stubborn and worshiped Baal, just as their ancestors did.
translation_verse: na mmom bayɛ asoserɛ bali bɛ ti piri baali Baal mɔ si, kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ hyirehyirele bɛ ne ati ɔ.

english_verse: So I, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, promise them poison to eat and drink.
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ Asafo AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ kã ɛhe: Tie, abɔwee yeɛ ngɔfa ngɔma maen he koli ɔ, na nzue bɔ ɛborɔ wɔ nu yeɛ ngɔfa ngɔmaa bɛkɔno ɔ.

english_verse: I'll scatter them in foreign countries that they and their ancestors have never even heard of. Finally, I will send enemy soldiers to kill every last one of them. The Women Who Are Paid To Weep
translation_verse: Maen maen bɔ bɛ ne bɛ nana mɔ bɛttele bɛ nga le ne, so yeɛ ngɔbɔ bɛ ngɔsande ngɔhɔ ɔ; na ngɔsoma ngrandɛ maa okoli bɛ si kɔpem kyɛ ngonua bɛ boso ɔ.” Yerusalemfoɛ sũ pena mmokalɛ

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said, “Make arrangements now for the women who are paid to weep at funerals, especially the women who can cry the loudest.”
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ Asafo AWURADE kã ɛhe: “Ɛ́mɔdwene ye nwo, ná ɛ́mɔfrɛfrɛ mmrasua bɔ bɛbɔ awuye ne maa bɛbra; ɛ́mɔsoma maa bɛfrɛfrɛ mmrasua bɔ bɛse sũ ɔ maa bɛbra.

english_verse: The people answered, “Let them come quickly and cry for us, until our own eyes are flooded with tears.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma bɛyɛ ndɛndɛ besu yɛ, amaa ɔnate so yɛ nye aporo moen, ná yɛ nye so aporo nzue.

english_verse: Now those of us on Zion cry, ‘We are ruined! We can't stand the shame. Our homes have been destroyed, and we must leave our land.’
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛte awuye nga befi Sion kyɛ, ‘Ah! Kyɛbɔ edwirɛ asi ato yɛ hɔ ɛne oo! Yɛ nyunu agua ase bɔkɔɔ, ofikyɛ yatu yafi aseɛ ne aso, badwiri y’atenaleɛ mɔ bagua.’ ”

english_verse: “We ask you women to pay attention to what the Lord says. We will teach you a funeral song that you can teach your daughters and friends:
translation_verse: Ao mmrasua mɔ, ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE dwirɛ ne, ná ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ bétie ye noa dwirɛ ne; ɛmɔhyirehyire ɛmɔ mma mmrasua mɔ ɛsɛen dwein, ná ebiala ohyire obiɛngo awuyebɔlɛ.

english_verse: ‘We were in our fortress, but death sneaked in through our windows. It even struck down children at play and our strongest young men.’
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ewue afo waagyina yɛ mboma mɔ anu, wawura y’ahemvie mɔ anu, kyɛ ɔbaahũhũ ngwadaa nemɔ fi dwaa nemɔ aso, yeɛ mmerandeɛ nemɔ fi mmorɔnoɛ nemɔ aso.

english_verse: “The Lord has told us the ground will be covered with dead bodies, like ungathered stalks of grain or manure in a field.” What the Lord Likes Best
translation_verse: Dwudwo! Bɔ AWURADE kã hɔ ɛhe: ‘Mmenia fuin kɔsamo aseɛnwo, kyɛ fofoɛ bɔ ogua eburo ɔ, kyɛ ɛmo si bɔ bate bakyekye ye tire tire bɔ ebiala ngɔboaboa ye noa ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: If you feel you must brag, then have enough sense to brag about worshiping me, the Lord. What I like best is showing kindness, justice, and mercy to everyone on earth.
translation_verse: Na mmom ebiala bɔ ɔhoahoa ye nwo ne, odi kyɛ ɔhoahoa ye nwo kyɛ ole nimdeɛ, ná ɔse me kyɛ me ole AWURADE bɔ mefa ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi, ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ne nahorɛlilɛ yeɛ meyɛ me nningyein wɔ aseɛ ye aso ɔ. Na sɔ nningyein nemɔ yeɛ me nye gye bɛ nwo ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: Someday I will punish the nations of Egypt, Edom, Ammon, and Moab, and the tribes of the desert. The men of these nations are circumcised, but they don't worship me. And it's the same with you people of Judah. Your bodies are circumcised, but your hearts are unchanged.
translation_verse: Misraim, Yuda, Edom, Amonfoɛ yeɛ Moabo ne bɛ bɔ bɛte ɛserɛ so amukoraa bɔ bepiapia bɛ ti angyɛnu ɔ. Ofikyɛ sɔ maen nemɔ amukoraa bɛmbɛ bɛ bienzua, na Yisrael awuro ama amukoraa, b’ahone nu de, bɛmbɛ bɛ bienzua.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Listen to me, you people of Israel. Don't follow the customs of those nations who become frightened when they see something strange happen in the sky.
translation_verse: Bɔ AWURADE kã hɔ ɛhe: “Nnɛma ɛmɔsuasua amaen maen mɔ bɛ yɔleɛ nemɔ, yeɛ nnɛmɔma ewienu nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne yɛ ɛmɔ suro, ofikyɛ maen maen nemɔ yeɛ ɔyɛ bɛ suro ɔ.

english_verse: Their religion is worthless! They chop down a tree, carve the wood into an idol,
translation_verse: Maen maen nemɔ, b’amammerɛ nemɔ te nnakannaka. Ofikyɛ bebu ɛhɔayeɛ nu bakaa, na adwiililɛniɛ fa buralɛ ose.

english_verse: cover it with silver and gold, and then nail it down so it won't fall over.
translation_verse: Bɛfa ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ bɛboro ye nwo; bɛfa bɔsobaka ne nnadowaa bɛbobɔ nu, amaa wandutu wangua.

english_verse: An idol is no better than a scarecrow. It can't speak, and it has to be carried, because it can't walk. Why worship an idol that can't help or harm you? Jeremiah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Bɛ mmosoen nemɔ, bɛte kyɛ kakaammotobi bɔ bɛfa benwunanwuna fieso nnomaa ɔ; bendwudwo; odi kyɛ bɛsoa bɛ, ofikyɛ bɛngora nate. Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro bɛ, ofikyɛ bɛngɔhora bɛngɔyɔ ɛmɔ bɔne biala, yeɛ bɛngora bɛnyɔ nikye paa biala.”

english_verse: You are King of the nations. Everyone should worship you. No human anywhere on earth is wiser than you.
translation_verse: Ao maen maen mɔ Hene, nwa yeɛ onzuro wɔ ɔ? Ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛhe fata wɔ ɔ. Amaenmaenso nworɛfoɛ amukoraa nu, yeɛ b’ahennie amukoraa nu, ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Idols are worthless, and anyone who worships them is a fool!
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa bagyimi, yeɛ bɛte ngwaseafoɛ; mmosoen mɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ te mbaen.

english_verse: Idols are made by humans. A carver shapes the wood. A metalworker hammers out a covering of gold from Uphaz or of silver from Tarshish. Then the idol is dressed in blue and purple clothes.
translation_verse: Bɛfa ɛdwetɛ bɔ baboro ye taataa ɔ befi Tasise, yeɛ esikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ ofi Yufase ɔ bɛba. Bɛte adwiililɛfoɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ dwumvoɛ bɛ sa noa adwuma. Bɛ ndaadeɛ te bibire ne koogyan, ye mukoraa te adwiililɛfoɛ bɛ sa noa adwuma.

english_verse: You, Lord, are the only true and living God. You will rule for all time. When you are angry the earth shakes, and nations are destroyed.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE yeɛ ɔte nahorɛ Nyameɛ ne ɔ; ye yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne Ɛhene afebɔɔ ne ɔ. Sɛ ye ahone hu a, aseɛ woso, na amaen maen mɔ bɛngora ye yaafɛlɛ noa gyina.

english_verse: You told me to say that idols did not create the heavens and the earth, and that you, the Lord, will destroy every idol.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛmɔhã behyire bɛ kyɛ, nyameɛ mɔ bɔ nna bɛ yeɛ bɛbɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ne, bɛ boso kotu komini kofi aseɛ ye aso ne ewienu abo.

english_verse: With your wisdom and power you created the earth and spread out the heavens.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ole ye tumi bɔle aseɛ ɔ, ɔnate ye nworɛ so fale wiase timuni berɛ, na ɔnate ye nimdeɛ so yeɛ ɔtrɛle ewienu nu ɔ.

english_verse: The waters in the heavens roar at your command. You make clouds appear— you send the winds from your storehouse and make lightning flash in the rain.
translation_verse: Ɔma ye komvi so a, esue bobɔ nu wɔ ewienu, ɔma tutue fi aseɛ noa dɔ tu kɔ anwuro; esue tɔ a, ɔma agralaa tete, na ɔma mvrama tu fi nekaa bɔ osie ye nningyein ne.

english_verse: People who make idols are so stupid! They will be disappointed, because their false gods are not alive.
translation_verse: Ebiala te kwaseaa, na olle nimdeɛ; esikaa kɔkorɛ dwumvoɛ biala ye mmosoen mɔ gua ye nyunu ase, ofikyɛ ye mmosoen mɔ te nnakannaka, na nwomeɛ biala nne bɛ nu.

english_verse: Idols are merely a joke, and when the time is right, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Mvasoɛ nne bɛ so, bɛte nnakannaka adwuma; na b’asohwenɛ mmerɛ ne dwu a, bɛkɔsɛkye bɛ.

english_verse: But you, Israel's God, created all things, and you chose Israel to be your very own. Your name is the Lord All-Powerful. Judah Will Be Thrown from Its Land
translation_verse: Ye bɔ ɔte Yakob kyɛfa ne, ye de ɔtte kyɛ bɛ, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔbɔle nningyein amukoraa ɔ; Yisrael te maen bɔ ɔte ye agyapadeɛ ɔ, na ye dumaa ole Asafo AWURADE. Nnurehyelɛ bɔ ɔba ɔ

english_verse: I said to the people of Judah, “Gather your things; you are surrounded.
translation_verse: Wɔ bɔ ɛte kuro bɔ batua ye nu ɔ, boaboa wɔ nningyein noa fi aseɛ ne aso!

english_verse: The Lord said these troubles will lead to your capture, and he will throw you from this land like a rock from a sling.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: “Tie, ngofindi aseɛ ne aso ama ngofi aseɛ ne aso ngogua wɔ mmerɛ ye anu, na ngɔma amaneɛ kɔwa bɛ so maa bɛkɔte ye yealɛ.

english_verse: The people answered, “We are wounded and doomed to die. Why did we say we could stand the pain?
translation_verse: Me puralɛ ne ati, edwirɛ ato me oo! Me kena ne te piri. Nakoso ngane kyɛ, “Amba m’asohwenɛ ɛhe, na medi sɔ.”

english_verse: But I told them, “Our leaders were stupid failures, because they refused to listen to the Lord. And so we've been scattered like sheep.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ neafoɛ nemɔ bagyimi, na bɛmbena AWURADE si ate; yiti wanyie bɛ yé, na bɛ mmoaen amukoraa babɔ aya.

english_verse: “Sounds of destruction rumble from the north like distant thunder. Soon our towns will be ruins where only jackals live.” Jeremiah Prays
translation_verse: Tie, dede bie! Nea, ɔ́ba! Basabasa kandinga bie fi sorɔ dɔ aseɛ ne aso ɔ́ba, bɔ ɔbaama Yuda nguro mɔ bɛkakyi kurofoen ne ɛserɛ so ngyea atenaleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I know, Lord, that we humans are not in control of our own lives.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, mese kyɛ kuro sona ye asetena nu dwirɛ, ɔnne ye bɔbɔ ye sa nu; kyɛ kuro sona biala ye asetena nu, olle ye nwo.

english_verse: Correct me, as I deserve, but not in your anger, or I will be dead.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, tea me, nakoso nnɛmaa ɔbo so; nnɛfɛ yaa fa tea me, wanyɛ sɔ a, ebie ngɔha me nu.

english_verse: Our enemies refuse to admit that you are God or to worship you. They have wiped out our people and left our nation lying in ruins. So get angry and sweep them away!
translation_verse: Maen maen bɔ benze wɔ ne, ɔne mmenia bɔ bɛmmɔ wɔ dumaa bɛnzɔne wɔ ne, ma wɔ yaa piri ne ɔbra bɛ so, ofikyɛ bahu Yakob batete ye nu pasapasa; bannua ye boso, na bakakyi ye atenaleɛ kurofoen.

english_verse: The Lord God told me to say to the people of Judah and Jerusalem: I, the Lord, am warning you that I will put a curse on anyone who doesn't keep the agreement I made with Israel. So pay attention to what it says.
translation_verse: Kã kyire bɛ kyɛ, Bɔ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ kã ɛhe: Ebiala bɔ wanni sɔ apam dwirɛ ne aso ne, ɔte ɛnomalɛ ma ye,

english_verse: My commands haven't changed since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, a nation that seemed like a blazing furnace where iron ore is melted. I told your ancestors that if they obeyed my commands, I would be their God, and they would be my people.
translation_verse: apam bɔ nhyehyɛle mane ɛmɔ nana mɔ mmerɛ bɔ nyele bɛ mvili Misraim aseɛ so, buralɛ foonoo nu ne. Na ngane kyɛ, ɛ́mɔtie me dwirɛ, na ɛ́mɔli ahyɛdeɛ amukoraa bɔ mafa mama ɛmɔ ne aso. Ɔba ye sɔ a, ɛmɔkɔyɛ me maen, ná me koso mayɛ ɛmɔ Nyameɛ,

english_verse: Then I did what I had promised and gave them this wonderful land, where you now live. “Yes, Lord,” I replied, “that's true.”
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so, ndaen bɔ nda ngyirele ɛmɔ nana mɔ kyɛ ngɔma bɛ aseɛ bɔ nyɔfone sue ne woɛ tengyɛ wɔ so, kyɛbɔ ɔte ɛnɛ ala ye ne, mamaa wawa nu.” Yeɛ mmuale kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE, maa ɔbra nu sɔ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to everyone on the streets of Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah: Pay attention to the commands in my agreement with you.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Bɔ sɔ dwirɛ hemɔ amukoraa dawure wɔ Yuda nguro nemɔ anu ne Yerusalem mmorɔnoɛ nemɔ aso kyɛ, Ɛ́mɔtie sɔ apam he anu dwirɛ, ná ɛmɔli so.

english_verse: Ever since I brought your ancestors out of Egypt, I have been telling your people to obey me. But you and your ancestors
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ nyele ɛmɔ nana mɔ mvili Misraim aseɛ so mmale ne, mmɔle bɛ kɔkɔ kitii, na mahɔ so mabɔ bɛ kɔkɔ maa waadwu ɛnɛ kyɛ, Ɛ́mɔtie me dwirɛ.

english_verse: have always been stubborn. You have refused to listen, and instead you have done whatever your sinful hearts have desired. You have not kept the agreement we made, so I will make you suffer every curse that goes with it.
translation_verse: Nakoso bandie me dwirɛ, yeɛ banyɛ asoɛ bamma me, na mmom bɛ mukoraa belili bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti piri bɛyɔle bɔne bɔ bekuro ɔ. Yiti apam he anu dwirɛ amukoraa bɔ nhyɛle bɛ kyɛ beli so, nakoso banni so ne, mbraprale nguale bɛ so.”

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Jeremiah, the people of Judah and Jerusalem are plotting against me.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Yudafoɛ ne Yerusalemfoɛ babɔ porɛ tɛɛ.

english_verse: They have sinned in the same way their ancestors did, by turning from me and worshiping other gods. The northern kingdom of Israel broke the agreement I made with your ancestors, and now the southern kingdom of Judah has done the same.
translation_verse: Bɛ nana mɔ amumuyɛɛ bɔ bɛyɔle, bɔ banguro kyɛ bekotie me dwirɛ ne, basa baayɔ bie; baali nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ asi baso bɛ. Yisrael awuro ama ne Yuda awuro ama babu m’apam bɔ me ne bɛ nana mɔ yɛyɛle ne aso.

english_verse: Here is what I've decided to do. I will bring suffering on the people of Judah and Jerusalem, and no one will escape. They will beg me to help, but I won't listen to their prayers.
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: Nahorɛ nu, mebaaprapra musue bɔ bɛngɔhora bɛngɔnwati bengofi nu ɔ megua bɛ so; ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bekosu bɛkɔfrɛ me, nakoso mengɔtɛ bɛ so.

english_verse: Then they will offer sacrifices to their other gods and ask them for help. After all, the people of Judah have more gods than towns, and more shameful altars for Baal than there are streets in Jerusalem. But those gods won't be able to rescue the people of Judah from disaster.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Yuda, wɔ nyameɛ mɔ basone pee kyɛ wɔ nguro mɔ; afɔleɛ mmokyea bɔ ɛmɔasi bafa bagua ɛmɔ nyunu ase, bɔ ɛmɔyera ɛyɛɛ wɔ so bɛma Baal ne, bɛ somaa te kyɛ Yerusalem mmorɔnoɛ mɔ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't pray for these people or beg me to rescue them. If you do, I won't listen, and I certainly won't listen if they pray!
translation_verse: “Yiti wɔ de, nnɛpa kyerɛ ma sɔ maen he, yeɛ nnɛgyina bɛ gya nu fa abisadeɛ anaa mbaeɛ to me nyunu, ofikyɛ b’amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu, besu bɛfrɛ me a, mengɔtɛ bɛ so.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to the people of Judah: You are my chosen people, but you have no right to be here in my temple, doing such evil things. The sacrifices you offer me won't protect you from disaster, so stop celebrating.
translation_verse: Nzikyɛ yeɛ me dɔfo ole ye ɔyɔ wɔ m’awuro wa, wɔ aberɛ bɔ wayɔ sɔ amumuyɛɛ nningyein mɔ ɔ? Aso bɔhyɛlɛ ne naen afɔleɛ kɔhora kosi wɔ musue ne nwo ate, amaa ɔnate so ali ahurusi anaa?

english_verse: Once you were like an olive tree covered with fruit. But soon I will send a noisy mob to break off your branches and set you on fire.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bie, AWURADE tole wɔ dumaa ‘Olive Bakaa Monɛ, bɔ ɔyɛ nyemene bɔ osu mmaa paa ɔ’, nakoso ɔkɔfa mvrama bɔ otu serɛserɛ ɔ kɔto nu see kɔpomba ye mmaen mɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. You people of Judah were like a tree that I had planted, but you have made me angry by offering sacrifices to Baal, just as the northern kingdom did. And now I'm going to pull you up by the roots. The Plot To Kill Jeremiah *
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE bɔ oluale wɔ ne, wahã musue dwirɛ wagua wɔ so, ɔnate bɔne bɔ Yisrael awuro ama ne Yuda awuro ama bayɔ [batia bɛ nwo], bɔ bayera ɛyɛɛ bama Baal bafa bawura me apue ne ati. Bɛbɔ Yeremia ti so porɛ kyɛ bekohu ye

english_verse: Some people plotted to kill me. And like a lamb being led to the butcher, I knew nothing about their plans.
translation_verse: AWURADE ye hyirele me maa nwuni ye, na ɛlale bɛ bɔne yɔleɛ nemɔ ali hyirele me.

english_verse: But then the Lord told me that they had planned to chop me down like a tree— fruit and all— so that no one would ever remember me again.
translation_verse: Nakoso né nde kyɛ boaen akrɔngrɔma brɛfo bɔ bɛ́fa ye bɛ́kɔ akumyɛɛ ɔ. Na né menze kyɛ babɔ me ti so porɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma yɛsɛkye bakaa ne, ɔne ye mma ne, ɛ́mɔma yɛ́bu ye yɛ́fi ateasefoɛ aseɛ so, amaa ɔnate so bangaye ye dumaa ko!”

english_verse: I prayed, “Lord All-Powerful, you always do what is right, and you know every thought. So I trust you to help me and to take revenge.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Asafo AWURADE, wɔ bɔ ebua ndɛen turoloo, bɔ ɛpɛnzɛpɛnzɛ sona ahone nu ne ye ti anu ɔ, maa nwu wɔ wereɛtɔlɛ ne wɔ bɛ so, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ mafa me dwirɛ mawura wɔ sa ɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord said: Jeremiah, some men from Anathoth say they will kill you, if you keep on speaking for me.
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ AWURADE kã fa Anatotefoɛ nwo ɛhe. Bɛ yeɛ bɛpena wɔ beku wɔ, ná bɛnwa, “Nnɛfa AWURADE dumaa hyɛ ngɔm, wanyɔ sɔ a yɛkohu wɔ.”

english_verse: But I will punish them. Their young men will die in battle, and their children will starve to death.
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ Asafo AWURADE kã ɛhe: “Tie, ngɔhwe bɛ so, mmerandeɛ nemɔ kɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa, na ɛhɔen kɔma bɛ mma mmienzua ne bɛ mma mmrasua bekowuwu,

english_verse: And when I am finished, no one from their families will be left alive.
translation_verse: na bɛ nu biala ngɔha. Ofikyɛ ngɔprapra musue ngogua Anatotefoɛ so, wɔ b’asohwenɛ afoɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Whenever I complain to you, Lord, you are always fair. But now I have questions about your justice. Why is life easy for sinners? Why are they successful?
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, sɛ mebɔ wɔ kwaadu a, edi be kaenn. Nakoso maa mva me dwirɛ ndo wɔ nyunu. Nzu ati yeɛ oyie bɔnefoɛ yé e? Nzu ati yeɛ ngɔngɔnzaafoɛ amukoraa bɛ so anu atɔ bɛ ɔ?
