english_verse: You plant them like trees; you let them prosper and produce fruit. Yet even when they praise you, they don't mean it.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ edua bɛ ɔ, na betira ndii; benyi besu mmaa; wɔ dumaa lela bɛ noa, nakoso b’ahone de, ombingye wɔ.

english_verse: But you know, Lord, how faithful I've always been, even in my thoughts. So drag my enemies away and butcher them like sheep!
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE, wɔ de ɛse me. Anwu me aso me anea, na anwu kyɛbɔ nzi nde ɔ. Twe bɛ kɔ kyɛ mmoaen bɔ bɛ́fa bɛ bɛ́kɔ akumyɛɛ ɔ, na tu bɛ sie berɛ ma ehunɛ kyẽa ne.

english_verse: How long will the ground be dry and the pasturelands parched? The birds and animals are dead and gone. And all of this happened because the people are so sinful. They even brag, “God can't see the sins we commit.” The Lord Answers Jeremiah
translation_verse: Aseɛ ne kɔbɔ awuye koodwu kyinzu, na eboo biala so ndire kɔkese maa okoodwu kyinzu? Ofikyɛ aseɛ ne aso ama, b’amumuyɛɛ ti, ngaka ne nnomaa batu bamini, ofikyɛ mmenia nwa, “Ongonwu y’ayieleɛ.” Nyameɛ bua Yeremia

english_verse: Jeremiah, if you get tired in a race against people, how can you possibly run against horses? If you fall in open fields, what will happen in the forest along the Jordan River?
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛne mmenia bɔ bɛnate bɛ gya kunu po betu amirika, ná bɛmaa ɛfɛ a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né ahora ɛne mbɔngɔ batu amirika? Na sɛ aseɛ bɔ so la berɛ pralaa po efi ase wɔ so a, ye de Yɔɔdan ɛhɔayeɛ ne anu, ɛkɔyɛ ye sɛ?

english_verse: Even your own family has turned against you. They act friendly, but don't trust them. They're out to get you, and so is everyone else. The Lord Is Furious with His People
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ nwo ama ne wɔ bɔbɔ w’abusuafoɛ, bɛ po baye wɔ bama; amba, bɛ́bɔ wɔ tutue bedi wɔ si. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛkã edwirɛ fɛɛ bekyire wɔ de, nakoso nnede bɛ di.”

english_verse: I loved my people and chose them as my very own. But now I will reject them and hand them over to their enemies.
translation_verse: “M’awuro ne, mapo ye; m’agyapadeɛ ne, mayakyi ye si lilɛ. Me kra ye dɔfo ne, mafa ye mawura ye pɔfoɛ mɔ sa.

english_verse: My people have turned against me and roar at me like lions. That's why I hate them.
translation_verse: M’agyapadeɛ ne, wakakyi kyɛ ɛhɔayeɛ nu gyata wama me; wama ye komvi so wabobɔ nu wagua me so, yiti mepɔ ye.

english_verse: My people are like a hawk surrounded and attacked by other hawks. Tell the wild animals to come and eat their fill.
translation_verse: M’agyapadeɛ ne, ɔte kyɛ akorɔma anwo kyerekyerɛɛ ma me. Akorɔma mɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia. Ɛmɔhɔ bɛɛboaboa ngaka aboyaa amukoraa noa maa bɛbra bɛɛhye ye beli.

english_verse: My beautiful land is ruined like a field or a vineyard trampled by shepherds and stripped bare by their flocks.
translation_verse: Neafoɛ pee basɛkye me bobe boo ne, bahwi bafa me bue deɛ so, me bue deɛ nyemenenyemene ne, basɛkye ye pasaa.

english_verse: A destroying army marches along desert roads and attacks everywhere. They are my deadly sword; no one is safe from them.
translation_verse: Ɛserɛ so mmokaa pralaa ne amukoraa so, yeɛ sɛkyefoɛ nemɔ bawa ɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE ngrandɛ ne okũkũ mmenia, fi aseɛ ne noa kɔkã ye noa; asomdwee nne berɛ mma sona biala.

english_verse: My people, you planted wheat, but because I was furious, I let only weeds grow. You wore yourselves out and gained only shame! The Lord Will Have Pity on Other Nations
translation_verse: Balua atokoɔ, nakoso bate mmowue, bafɛ alaa, nakoso bannya ye nwo mvasoɛ biala. Ɔnate AWURADE yaa piri bɔ wafɛ ne ati, ɛmɔ fieso nningyein bɔ ɛmɔkonya ye ne, ɔkɔyɛ bɛ fɛre.”

english_verse: The Lord said: I gave this land to my people Israel, but enemies around it have attacked and robbed it. So I will uproot them from their own countries just as I will uproot Judah from its land.
translation_verse: Maen maen bɔnefoɛ bɔ me ne bɛ yɛbɔ wɛen, bɔ bɛte bɛ sa bɛkã agyapadeɛ bɔ mafa mama me maen Yisrael maa wayɛ ye deɛ ne, bɔ AWURADE kã fa bɛ nwo ole kyɛ, “Tie, ngotu bɛ bo ngofi b’aseɛ ne aso, na ngotu Yuda awuro ama bo ngofi bɛ nu.

english_verse: But later, I will have pity on these nations and bring them back to their own lands.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɛ metu bɛ bo mefi berɛ a, ngosa ngonwu bɛ anwumvoin, na ngosa ngɔfa bɛ nu biala ngɔwa ye agyapadeɛ nu ne ye aseɛ so.

english_verse: They once taught my people to worship Baal. But if they admit I am the only true God, and if they let my people teach them how to worship me, these nations will also become my people.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bɛkɔyere bɛ nwo bekosua me maen ye atee, ná bɛkɔfa me dumaa bɛkɔta ndaen kyɛ, ‘Kyɛ AWURADE te ase ye’, kyɛbɔ behyirele me maen maa bɛfale Baal bɛtale ndaen ne a, ye de bɛ bo kotimu wɔ me maen ne anu.

english_verse: However, if they don't listen to me, I will uproot them from their lands and completely destroy them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Nakoso maen bɔ wandie ne, ye de ngotu sɔ maen ne abo ngɔsɛkye ye pasaa. AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: The Lord told me, “Go and buy a pair of linen shorts. Wear them for a while, but don't wash them.”
translation_verse: Edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE sele me ɛhe, “Kɔ ná kɔtɔ nwera abɔsoɛ, na fa bɔ wɔ yaase; nakoso nnɛfa wura nzue nu.”

english_verse: So I bought a pair of shorts and put them on.
translation_verse: Yiti ngyinane AWURADE dwirɛ ne aso ngɔndɔle abɔsoɛ, na mva mmɔle me yaase.

english_verse: “Take off the shorts. Go to Parah and hide the shorts in a crack between some large rocks.”
translation_verse: “Abɔsoɛ bɔ aatɔ bɔ ɔbɔ wɔ yaase ne, dwɔso fa kɔ asue Yufreti noa, ná kɔfa fea nyɔbotaen tokuro bie anu wɔ dɔ.

english_verse: I went back and dug the shorts out of their hiding place, but the cloth had rotted, and the shorts were ruined.
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔle Yufreti noa, na nduli abɔsoɛ ne mvili nekaa bɔ mvu nwurale ne. Na yieee, né abɔsoɛ ne wakuko bɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ hwee a ɔnyɛ yee ɔ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will use Babylonia to destroy the pride of the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: Sɔ ala yeɛ Yuda anwomasoɛ ne Yerusalem anwomasoɛ kandinga ne, ngɔsɛkye ye ɔ.

english_verse: The people of Judah are evil and stubborn. So instead of listening to me, they do whatever they want and even worship other gods. When I am finished with these people, they will be good for nothing, just like this pair of shorts.
translation_verse: Bɔnefoɛ maen he, bɔ benguro kyɛ bekotie me dwirɛ, bɔ bedi bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti piri, bɔ bedi nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ si bɛso bɛ bɛsɔne bɛ ne, bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ sɔ abɔsoɛ he bɔ bɛfa bɛyɛ hwee a ɔnyɛ yee ne.

english_verse: These shorts were tight around your waist, and that's how tightly I held onto the kingdoms of Israel and Judah. I wanted them to be my people. I wanted to make them famous, so that other nations would praise and honor me, but they refused to obey me. Wine Jars The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ kyɛbɔ abɔsoɛ mata sona yaase ne, sɔ ala yeɛ mmane Yisrael awuro ama amukoraa ne Yuda awuro ama amukoraa bɛmatane me ɔ, amaa ɔnate so bayɛ me maen, me dumaa, m’ayɛyelɛ ne m’animnyam. Nakoso bandie. AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Nzaa ngomvo nemɔ

english_verse: Jeremiah, tell the people of Judah, “The Lord God of Israel orders you to fill your wine jars with wine.” They will answer, “Of course we fill our wine jars with wine! Why are you telling us something we already know?”
translation_verse: “Yiti kã sɔ dwirɛ he kyire bɛ kyɛ, bɔ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ kã ɛhe, ‘Nzaa ngomvo biala bɛfa nzaa begua nu maa oyi.’ Na bekose wɔ kyɛ, ‘Aso yɛnze kyɛ bɛfa nzaa begua nzaa ngomvo biala nu maa oyi ɔ?’

english_verse: Then say to them: I am the Lord, and what I'm going to do will make everyone in Judah and Jerusalem appear to be full of wine. And the worst ones will be the kings of David's family and the priests and the prophets.
translation_verse: Na ekose bɛ kyɛ, bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: Tie, ngɔfa nzaabolɛ ngɔto aseɛ ye aso ama amukoraati so: ahemvo bɔ bɛte Dawide ahennie bia so ɔ so, asɔfo so, ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ so ne Yerusalemfoɛ amukoraati so.

english_verse: Then I will smash them against each other like jars. I will have no pity on the young or the old, and they will all be destroyed. I, the Lord, have spoken. The People of Judah Will Be Taken Away
translation_verse: Na ngɔkekã bɛ ti ngɔbobɔ nu, seɛ mɔ ne mmaa mɔ po, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Mengonwu bɛ anwumvoin, mengɔma bengonya bɛ ti bengodidi nu, yeɛ me kunu ngɔtete me ngɔma bɛ, na mmom ngohũhũ bɛ.’ ” Bɛkɔpɛ bɛ asue

english_verse: People of Judah, don't be too proud to listen to what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie ná ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ, nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ anwomasoɛ, ofikyɛ AWURADE wadwudwo.

english_verse: You hope for light, but God is sending darkness. Evening shadows already deepen in the hills. So return to God and confess your sins to him before you trip and fall.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa animnyam bɛ́ma AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ koraka né wama awosii awa, koraka né ɛmɔasoti mmokaa so wɔ awosii nu; na aberɛ bɔ ɛmɔpena kanea ne, ɔkɔmaa ɔkɔkakyi ewue wawoɛ, na ɔkɔmaa ɔkɔkakyi awosii kabii.

english_verse: If you are too proud to listen, I will weep alone. Tears will stream from my eyes when the Lord's people are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔngotie de a, ɔnate ɛmɔ anwomasoɛ ti, me kra kosũ wɔ mvealeɛ nu; me nye kohwi moen pupuropupuro, na me nye kɔporo moen, ofikyɛ bahye AWURADE mmoaen kure ne nnure bahɔ.

english_verse: The Lord told me to tell you that your king and his mother must surrender their thrones and remove their crowns.
translation_verse: Kã kyire ɛhene ne ɛhemmaa ne kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase, ɛ́mɔtena ase, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ ahennie ne kɔtɔ ase, ɛmɔ animnyam ahennie abotire nyemene ne, ɔkɔtɔ ase.”

english_verse: The cities in the Southern Desert are surrounded; no one can get in or out. Everyone in Judah will be taken away.
translation_verse: Ngwaen dɔ nguro nemɔ, bɛkɔtoto nu, bɔ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ okobukye ɔ; Yuda amukoraa bɛkɔhye bɛ nnure, bɛkɔhye bɛ mukoraa nnure bɛkɔhɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, you were so proud of ruling the people of Judah. But where are they now? Look north, and you will see your enemies approaching.
translation_verse: “Ma wɔ nye so ná nea mmenia bɔ befi sorɔ dɔ bɛ́ba ne. Mmoaen kure bɔ bɛfa bewurale wɔ sa ne, ɔwɔ nisua, wɔ mmoaen kure nyemenenyemene ne?

english_verse: You once trusted them to help, but now I'll let them rule you. What do you say about that? You will be in pain like a woman giving birth.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔtwe wɔ so a, nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ ɛkɔhã ɔ? Ofikyɛ atete bɛ maa bayɛ safohene mɔ ɔne wɔ so panyi. Aso ɛngɔte yealɛ kyɛ brasua bɔ wafo aworɛ so ɔ?

english_verse: Do you know why your clothes were torn off and you were abused? It was because of your terrible sins.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛkã ye wɔ wɔ ti anu kyɛ, ‘Nzu ati yeɛ ɛhemɔ atoto me e?’ a, ɔnate w’amumuyɛɛ piri ne ati yeɛ wɔ nwo apa ma wɔ nziaseɛ nwo ala berɛ ɔ, ná baye wɔ gya bagua ase ye.

english_verse: Can you ever change and do what's right? Can people change the color of their skin, or can a leopard remove its spots? If so, then maybe you can change and learn to do right.
translation_verse: Aso Yitiopianiɛ kɔhora kɔsesã ye wereɛ, anaa aboa kɔhora kɔsesã ye nwo kyerekyerɛɛ ne? Ahaa ye de, ɛmɔ bɔ bɔne ali ɛmɔ ti ne, ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔkɔhora bɛkɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ.

english_verse: I will scatter you, just as the desert wind blows husks from grain tossed in the air.
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔbɔ ɛmɔ ngɔsande kyɛ afafu bɔ ɛserɛ so mvrama ɔbɔ ye kɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I won't change my mind. I, the Lord, have spoken. You rejected me and worshiped false gods. *
translation_verse: Wɔ kyɛfa deɛ ɛhe, wɔ bue deɛ bɔ masusu mama wɔ hɔ ɛne, ofikyɛ wɔ wora afi me, na afa wɔ wora awura ngondombo nu, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: You were married to me, but you were unfaithful. You even became a prostitute by worshiping disgusting gods on hilltops and in fields.
translation_verse: Me bɔbɔ ngɔpagya wɔ nziaseɛ ne ngɔfa ngomundu wɔ nyunu, na bekonwu wɔ animguaseɛ ne.

english_verse: So I'll rip off your clothes and leave you naked and ashamed for everyone to see. You are doomed! Will you ever be worthy to worship me again?
translation_verse: Manwu w’agyaasɛkyelɛ ne, wɔ ehurolɛ nu ndeateamuɛ ne, w’animguaseɛ gyandera ne, yeɛ w’akyiwadeɛ yɔleɛ wɔ eburo mmokaa nemɔ aso ne. Ao Yerusalem, wɔ yaakɔ! Ɔkwaadwu kyinzu koraka né wɔ nwo ate.

english_verse: When there had been no rain for a long time, the Lord told me to say to the people:
translation_verse: AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔlale ye ali hyirele Yeremia fale wawa piri ne anwo ne, ye ɛhe:

english_verse: Judah and Jerusalem weep as the land dries up.
translation_verse: Yuda di aworabɔlɛ, ye pambim mɔ ayɛ hodwoo; bɛlela ase aworabɔlɛ nu, na Yerusalem sufrɛ afo ahɔ anwuro.

english_verse: Rulers send their servants to the storage pits for water. But there's none to be found; they return in despair with their jars still empty.
translation_verse: Ye atitire mɔ bɛsoma bɛ somvoɛ mɔ kyɛ bɛɛpena nzue; bɛbadwu abura nemɔ anwo, nakoso bennya nzue, yiti bɛfa bɛ bua mɔ too besa bɛkɔ. Bɛ nyunu agua ase, bafɛre, na bɛkata bɛ ti so.

english_verse: There has been no rain, and farmers feel sick as they watch cracks appear in the dry ground.
translation_verse: Aseɛnwo ayɛ katerepee, ɔnate esue bɔ ɔndɔ ngua aseɛ ne aso ti; akuafoɛ nemɔ nyunu agua ase, na bɛkata bɛ ti so.

english_verse: A deer gives birth in a field, then abandons her newborn fawn and leaves in search of grass.
translation_verse: Ɛwanzane bɔ ɔwɔ buro po, ɔyakyi ɔwa adɔma berɛ, ɔnate kyɛ onnya aleɛ mma ye ne ati.

english_verse: Wild donkeys go blind from starvation. So they stand on barren hilltops and sniff the air, hoping to smell green grass. The Lord's People Pray
translation_verse: Eburo afunum mɔ begyigyi mmokaa pralaa nemɔ aso, bede nwomeɛ ndɛndɛ bɛpena mvrama kyɛ ɛserɛ so ngyea, bɛ nye so yɛ bɛ wusiwusi, ofikyɛ bennya nyaa benni.

english_verse: We rejected you and did evil, so we deserve to be punished. But if you rescue us, Lord, everyone will see how great you are.
translation_verse: “Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ y’amumuyɛɛ bua yɛ fɔ de, nakoso AWURADE, wɔ dumaa ti, boka yɛ. Yasa yɛ si paa, na yayɔ bɔne yatia wɔ.

english_verse: You're our only hope; you alone can save us now. You help us one day, but you're gone the next.
translation_verse: Ao Yisrael anyelasoɛ, ye Defoɛ wɔ amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu, nzu ati yeɛ ɛyɛ wɔ nwo kyɛ ɛwɔfoɛ wɔ aseɛ ye aso ɔ, kyɛ akwanduniɛ bɔ aleɛ asa bɔ ɔpena nekaa osikye ɔ?

english_verse: Did this disaster take you by surprise? Are you a warrior with your hands tied? You have chosen us, and your temple is here. Don't abandon us! The Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ ayɛ kyɛ ebie bɔ ye adwene ayɛ ye nwunyaenn ɔ, kyɛ katakyie bɔ ɔngora mbepɛ nne mmenia ɔ? Nakoso, ao AWURADE, ɛne yɛ yeɛ yɛte ɔ, na wɔ dumaa yeɛ ɔla yɛ so ɔ; nnɛyakyi yɛ nu!”

english_verse: My people, you love to wander away; you don't even try to stay close to me. So now I will reject you and punish you for your sins. I, the Lord, have spoken. Lying Prophets
translation_verse: Bɔ AWURADE kã kyire sɔ maen ye ɛhe, “Ɔyɛ bɛ fɛ kyɛ bekyinikyini ɔ, bɛnhyɛ bɛ nwo so wɔ bɛ hyininɛ nu. Yiti AWURADE nne bɛ ndo nu, afei ɔkɔkaye b’amumuyɛɛ, ná wahwe bɛ so wɔ bɛ bɔne nwo.”

english_verse: The Lord said, “Jeremiah, don't ask me to help these people.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Nnɛsrɛ ma maen he ye yeeyɛlɛ.

english_verse: They may even go without eating and offer sacrifices to please me and to give thanks. But when they cry out for my help, I won't listen, and I won't accept their sacrifices. Instead, I'll send war, starvation, and disease to wipe them out.”
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛyɔ akɔngyere a, mengotie bɛ sufrɛ. Yeɛ sɛ bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne aburoo afɔleɛ po a, mengole bɛ mengɔto nu. Na mmom ngɔfa ngrandɛ, ɛhɔen ne ewue anwonyerɛ ngohũhũ bɛ pasapasa.”

english_verse: I replied, “The other prophets keep telling everyone that you won't send starvation or war, and that you're going to give us peace.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngane kyɛ, “Aa, AWURADE Nyameɛ! Nea kyɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛkekã bekyire bɛ kyɛ, ‘Ngrandɛ ngohũhũ ɛmɔ, yeɛ ɛhɔen ngɔpe ɛmɔ wa, na mmom ngɔmaa ɛmɔkonya asomdwee bɔ odi mu ɔ wɔ ɛwa.’”

english_verse: The Lord answered: They claim to speak for me, but they're lying! I didn't even speak to them, much less choose them to be my prophets. Their messages come from worthless dreams, useless fortunetelling, and their own imaginations.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛfa me dumaa bɛhyɛ ngɔndorɔ. Nnzomane bɛ, mmmane bɛ ahyɛdeɛ biala, yeɛ nngane edwirɛ biala nngyirele bɛ. Ngondombo nyekyire, ngonyaayelɛ, edwirɛ mbaen mbaen ne bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti anu dwirɛ yeɛ bɛhyɛ ye nwo ngɔm bekyire ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Those lying prophets say there will be peace and plenty of food. But I say that those same prophets will die from war and hunger.
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ AWURADE kã fa sɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ nwo ɛhe: Bɛ yeɛ bɛfa me dumaa bɛhyɛ ngɔm, bɔ nna me yeɛ nzomane bɛ ɔ. Nakoso bɛnwa, ‘Koɛ ne ɛhɔen ngɔwa aseɛ he aso.’ Sɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ, ngrandɛ ne ɛhɔen yeɛ okohũhũ bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And everyone who listens to them will be killed, just as they deserve. Their dead bodies will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem, because their families will also be dead, and no one will be left to bury them.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛhyɛ ngɔm bekyire bɛ ne, bekogyi bɛ bekogua Yerusalem dwaaso, ɔnate ɛhɔen ne ngrandɛ ne ati. Na bengonya ebiala maa ongosie bɛ ne bɛ ye mɔ ne bɛ mma mmienzua mɔ ne bɛ mma mmrasua mɔ, ofikyɛ ngɔma b’amumuyɛɛ kɔbɔ bɛ ti so.

english_verse: Jeremiah, go and tell the people how you feel about all this. So I told them: “Tears will flood my eyes both day and night, because my nation suffers from a deadly wound.
translation_verse: “Yiti kã sɔ dwirɛ he kyire bɛ: ‘Ma me nye ɔporo moen kɔngɔen ne eyia, nnɛma ye bo pɛ; ofikyɛ me maen awa brasua ababunu ne, babɔ ye bato ase buramm; bapura ye piri paa.

english_verse: In the fields I see the bodies of those killed in battle. And in the towns I see crowds dying of hunger. But the prophets and priests go about their business, without understanding what has happened.” Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Sɛ mekɔ buro a, yieee, bɛ bɔ batotɔ ngrandɛ noa ɛhe! Yeɛ sɛ mewura kuro ne anu a, yieee, bɛ bɔ ɛhɔen ama babɔ anwonyerɛ ɛhe! Ofikyɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne ɔsɔfo po, bekyinikyini wɔ aseɛ bɔ bɛnze so ɔ so.’ ”

english_verse: Have you rejected Judah, Lord? Do you hate Jerusalem? Why did you strike down Judah with a fatal wound? We had hoped for peace and a time of healing, but all we got was terror.
translation_verse: Aso apo Yuda koraa? Sion nwo ayɛ wɔ kra tɛ anaa? Nzu ati yeɛ abobɔ yɛ agua berɛ maa yɛnnya ye noa ayire ye? Yɛ nye lale asomdwee ate, nakoso nikye paa biala wamvi nu wamma. Yɛ nye lale anwonyerɛsalɛ mmerɛ ate, nakoso, yieee, ahunundetelɛ mmom yeɛ watɔ yɛ so ɔ!

english_verse: We and our ancestors are guilty of rebelling against you.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, yɛde yɛ bɔne yɛto nu, yeɛ yɛde yɛ nana mɔ b’amumuyɛɛ yɛto nu, ofikyɛ yayɔ bɔne yatia wɔ.

english_verse: If you save us, it will show how great you are. Don't let our enemies disgrace your temple, your beautiful throne. Don't forget that you promised to rescue us.
translation_verse: Ɔnate wɔ dumaa ti, nnɛpo yɛ, nnɛgua w’animnyam ahennie bia ne anyunu ase; kaye, na nnɛpɛ w’apam bɔ ɛne yɛ yayɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Idols can't send rain, and showers don't fall by themselves. Only you control the rain, so we put our trust in you, the Lord our God.
translation_verse: Amaenmaenso mmosoen nemɔ, aso bɛ nu bie kɔhora kɔma esue kɔtɔ? Anaa ewienu kɔhora kɔma esue kɔnyenenyene? Ao AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ, aso nna wɔ ɔ? Ye sɔ ne ati, yafa yɛ wora yawura wɔ nu, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛyɔ ɛhemɔ amukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said to me: Even if Moses and Samuel were here, praying with you, I wouldn't change my mind. So send the people of Judah away.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Sɛ Mose ne Samuel po bɛbagyina me nyunu bɛpa kyerɛ a, me kra ngonwu maen he anwumvoin. Foa bɛ fi me nye so maa bɛhɔ!

english_verse: And when they ask where they are going, tell them that I, the Lord, have said: Some of you are going to die of horrible diseases. Others are going to die in war or from starvation. The rest will be led away to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bebisa wɔ kyɛ, ‘Nisua yeɛ yɛhɔ ɔ?’ a, bua bɛ kyɛ, bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: Bɛ bɔ odi kyɛ ewue anwonyerɛ ku bɛ ne, okohu bɛ, bɛ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛtotɔ ngrandɛ noa ne, bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa, bɛ bɔ odi kyɛ ɛhɔen kũkũ bɛ ne, okohũhũ bɛ, yeɛ bɛ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛkye bɛ nnure ne, bɛkɔhye bɛ nnure.’

english_verse: I will punish you in four different ways: You will be killed in war and your bodies dragged off by dogs, your flesh will be eaten by birds, and your bones will be chewed on by wild animals.
translation_verse: “Na ɛhawo ahoroɔ nna yeɛ ngɔprapra ngogua bɛ so ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Bɛ ole ngrandɛ bɔ okohũhũ bɛ ɔ, ngyea bɔ bɛkɔtete bɛ naen ɔ, yeɛ ewienu nnomaa ne aseɛ so ngaka aboyaa bɔ bekohũhũ mmenia ná bɛkɔtete bɛ naen ɔ.

english_verse: This punishment will happen because of the horrible things your King Manasseh did. And you will be disgusting to all nations on earth.
translation_verse: Na ngɔma aseɛ ye aso ahennie amukoraa bɛ nwo kodwiri bɛ wɔ bɛ nwo, ɔnate bɔ Yuda hene Hesekia awa Manase ɔyɔle ye wɔ Yerusalem ne ati.

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, who will feel sorry for you? Will anyone bother to ask if you are well?
translation_verse: “Ao Yerusalem, nwa yeɛ okonwu wɔ anwumvoin ɔ, anaakyɛ nwa yeɛ ɔkɔdodo wɔ ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔpɛne ye nye kobisa wɔ kyɛbɔ wɔ nwo si te ɔ?

english_verse: My people, you abandoned me and walked away. I am tired of showing mercy; that's why I'll destroy you
translation_verse: Apo me, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Asa wɔ si, yiti matengyɛ me sa wɔ wɔ so, na masɛkye wɔ’; manwu wɔ anwumvoin mafɛ.

english_verse: by scattering you like straw blown by the wind. I will punish you with sorrow and death, because you refuse to change your ways.
translation_verse: Mafa huhuamoa mahuhu bɛ so wɔ aseɛ ne aso pambim nemɔ anu; mahũhũ bɛ mma mɔ, masɛkye me maen ne; ofikyɛ banza bɛ si bamvi bɛ yɔleɛ anwo.

english_verse: There will be more widows in Judah than grains of sand on a beach. A surprise attack at noon! And the mothers in Jerusalem mourn for their children.
translation_verse: Mama b’akunafoɛ mmrasua mɔ basone pee batra mboanoa anweaa; mama bɛ bɔ bekũkũ mmenia ne, bahɔ mmerandeɛ mɔ bɛ ni mɔ so eyiagyina. Mama aworabɔlɛ ne ahunundetelɛ atɔ bɛ so mvum nu.

english_verse: A mother is in deep despair and struggles for breath. Her daylight has turned to darkness— she has suffered the loss of her seven sons. I will kill anyone who survives. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jeremiah Complains
translation_verse: Braa bɔ wawo nzoo ne, wayɛ hodwoo, ye nye so aburu ye, ye anyelasoɛ atu amini wɔ aberɛ bɔ aleɛ onnya ɔssane ɔ, bagua ye nyunu ase basopa ye; na bɛ ngaa nemɔ, ngɔmaa bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa wɔ bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ anyunu, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Yeremia fa ye dwirɛ to Nyameɛ nyunu

english_verse: I wish I had never been born! I'm always in trouble with everyone in Judah. I never lend or borrow money, but everyone curses me just the same.
translation_verse: Mooni ee! Edwirɛ ato me oo, kyɛ ɛwole me, kyɛ sona bɔ aseɛ ye aso ama amukoraa bɛ ne me di apereapereɛ, ná bɛko betia me ɔ! Mmmɔle ebie bosea nnnele nzihoɛ, yeɛ nnnele ebie bosea nnduale nzihoɛ, nakoso bɛ mukoraa bɛnoma me.

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “I promise to protect you, and when disaster comes, even your enemies will beg you for help.” The Enemy Cannot Be Defeated The Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE sele kyɛ: Amba, ngɔpepɛ ngole wɔ maa okoyie wɔ yé. Amba, ngɔma pɔfoɛ nemɔ bɛkɔkoto bɛkɔsrɛ wɔ wɔ amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu ne anwokyere mmerɛ nu.

english_verse: I will give them everything you own, because you have sinned everywhere in your country.
translation_verse: “Ɔnate wɔ bɔne amukoraa bɔ ayɔ ye wɔ w’aseɛ ne aso amukoraa ne ati, ngɔfa w’anwonyadeɛ ne wɔ sikaa ngɔhyɛ maa bɛkɔfẽ ye mbaen.

english_verse: My anger is a fire that cannot be put out, so I will make you slaves of your enemies in a foreign land. Jeremiah Complains Again
translation_verse: Ngɔfa wɔ ne wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ ngɔhɔ aseɛ bɔ ɛnze so ɔ so, ofikyɛ see bɔ wasɔ wɔ me yaafɛlɛ ne anu ne, ngɔmaa okogye kɔyera ɛmɔ.”

english_verse: You can see how I suffer insult after insult, all because of you, Lord. Don't be so patient with my enemies; take revenge on them before they kill me.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ de ɛse; kaye me ná baaboka me, na bɛ bɔ bɛtane me nye ne, tɔ bɛ so wereɛ ma me. W’aboterɛ ne ati, nnɛye me fi berɛ; nwu ye kyɛ ɔnate wɔ ti, bagua me nyunu ase.

english_verse: When you spoke to me, I was glad to obey, because I belong to you, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Nwuni wɔ dwirɛ ne, na ɔyɛle m’aleɛ, wɔ dwirɛ ne yɛle me anika, na ɔma m’ahone tɔle me kunu ofikyɛ wɔ, AWURADE Asafo Nyameɛ, wɔ dumaa yeɛ ɔla me so ɔ.

english_verse: I don't go to parties and have a good time. Instead, I keep to myself, because you have filled me with your anger.
translation_verse: Mandena ngorohoɛfoɛ bɛ dwaa bɔ bɛbɔ nu, yeɛ manni ahurusi, na ɔnate kyɛ wɔ sa la me so ne ati, ndele me nwo ndenane nekaa bie, ofikyɛ afa ɛyaafɛlɛ ayi me nu to.

english_verse: I am badly injured and in constant pain. Are you going to disappoint me, like a stream that goes dry in the heat of summer? The Lord Replies
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ m’amaneɛnwunɛ ye bo ɔmbɛ ye, bɔ me kena ɔngɔ ye, bɔ wayɛ koangɔ ye? Aso ɛ́yɛ kyɛ nnakannakaniɛ ma me, ɛ́yɛ kyɛ abura bɔ odi ngasi ɔ?

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: Stop talking like a fool! If you turn back to me and speak my message, I will let you be my prophet once again. I hope the people of Judah will accept what you say. But you can ignore their threats, *
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: “Sɛ esa wɔ si ɛba a, ngosa ngole wɔ, na ekoogyina me nyunu. Sɛ ɛkã edwirɛ bɔ odi mu, ná angekã edwirɛ mbaen mbaen a, ye de, ɛkɔyɛ kyɛ me kyeame. Bɛ yeɛ bekosa bɛkɔwa wɔ berɛ ɔ, nna wɔ yeɛ ɛkɔhɔ bɛ dɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I will be there to rescue you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ngɔpepɛ ngole wɔ ngofi bɔnefoɛ mɔ sa nu, na ngɔpɔ wɔ ngofi atianuserɛfoɛ bɛ sa nu.

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ,

english_verse: Jeremiah, don't get married and have children—Judah is no place to raise a family.
translation_verse: “Nnɛgya braa, yeɛ nnɛwo mmaa mmienzua anaa mmaa mmrasua wɔ wa.

english_verse: They will die of horrible diseases and of war and starvation. No one will give them a funeral or bury them, and their bodies will be food for the birds and wild animals. And what's left will lie on the ground like manure.
translation_verse: Ewue anwonyerɛ kohũhũ bɛ. Bengosu bɛ, yeɛ bengosie bɛ; bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ fofoɛ wɔ aseɛ ye aso. Ngrandɛ ne ɛhɔen yeɛ okohũhũ bɛ ɔ, na bɛ fuin kɔyɛ ewienu nnomaa ne aseɛ ye aso ngaka aboyaa b’aleɛ.

english_verse: When someone dies, don't visit the family or show any sorrow. I will no longer love or bless or have any pity on the people of Judah.
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: Nnɛkɔ awuro bɔ bɛyɛ sɛen wɔ nu ne anu, yeɛ nnɛkɔ dɔ kosũ, anaa nnɛkɔyɛ bɛ yaakɔ; ofikyɛ maye m’asomdwee mafi maen he aso, yeɛ me dɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne m’anwumvoinnwunɛ koso maye mafi bɛ so, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Rich and poor alike will die and be left unburied. No one will mourn and show their sorrow by cutting themselves or shaving their heads.
translation_verse: Atitire mɔ ne kwahweabaa mɔ, bekowuwu wɔ aseɛ ye aso. Bengosie bɛ, bengosu bɛ, yeɛ bengogyina bɛ wue ne aso bɛngɔtete bɛ nwonaen anaa bɛngɔbɔ tikwa.

english_verse: No one will bring food and wine to help comfort those who are mourning the death of their father or mother.
translation_verse: Ebiala ngɔnea awufoɛ nemɔ anwo ngɔma ɛsɛenvoɛ nemɔ aleɛ maa bɛngɔfa bɛngɔkyekye bɛ wora, yeɛ ebiala ngɔnea bɛ se ne bɛ ni mɔ wue anwo ngɔma bɛ nzaa ma bɛngɔno bɛngɔkyekye bɛ wora.

english_verse: Don't even set foot in a house where there is eating and drinking and celebrating.
translation_verse: Nnɛkɔ awuro bɔ bɛto poen wɔ nu ɔ nu ɛne bɛ kɔtena ase bedidi bɛno.

english_verse: Warn the people of Judah that I, the Lord All-Powerful, will put an end to all their parties and wedding celebrations.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔ Asafo AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ kã ɛhe: Ngɔma ahurusililɛ nwo nga, anigye nwo nga, atɔmvorɛ biaa nwo nga, yeɛ atɔmvorɛ braa nwo nga, ye bo kɔpɛ wɔ wa wɔ ɛmɔ aberɛ so, bɔ ɛmɔ nye tua ɔ.

english_verse: They will ask, “Why has the Lord our God threatened us with so many disasters? Have we done something wrong or sinned against him?”
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɛ ɛkã sɔ dwirɛ ne amukoraa kyire maen ne, ná sɛ bebisa kyɛ, ‘Nzu ati yeɛ AWURADE wahã sɔ musue dwirɛ kandinga he wagua yɛ so ye? Yɛ amumuyɛɛ ole sɛɛ? Bɔne beni yeɛ yayɔ yatia AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ɔ?’ a,

english_verse: Then tell them I have said: People of Judah, your ancestors turned away from me; they rejected my laws and teachings and started worshiping other gods.
translation_verse: ye de se bɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔ nana mɔ apo me, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne; baali nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ si baso bɛ basɔne bɛ, na bapo me, yeɛ banni me mmeraa so,

english_verse: And you have done even worse! You are stubborn, and instead of obeying me, you do whatever evil comes to your mind.
translation_verse: na ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔayɔ bɔne batra ɛmɔ nana mɔ ne ati ɔ. Na afei ɛ́mɔtie, ɛmɔ amukoraati ɛmɔdi ɛmɔ ti piri bɔ ɛmɔndie me dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: So I will throw you into a land that you and your ancestors know nothing about, a place where you will have to worship other gods both day and night. And I won't feel the least bit sorry for you.
translation_verse: Yiti ngotu ɛmɔ bo ngofi aseɛ ye aso ngɔhɔ aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ nana mɔ bɛnze so ɔ so, na berɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkɔso nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ eyia ne kɔngɔen ɔ, ofikyɛ mengonwu ɛmɔ anwumvoin.’ Yisraelfoɛ kofi nnurehyelɛ nu kosa kɔwa

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living Lord who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: “Yiti, tie, AWURADE nwa nyoo: Mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba bɔ bɛngɔhɔ so bɛngɔhã kyɛ, ‘AWURADE bɔ ɔyele Yisraelfoɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so ne, kyɛ ɔte ase ye de,’

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living Lord who rescued you from that country in the north and from the other countries where I had forced you to go. Someday I will bring you back to this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: na mmom bɛkɔhã kyɛ, ‘AWURADE bɔ ɔyele Yisraelfoɛ fili sorɔ dɔ aseɛ so, ɔne aseɛ amukoraa bɔ ɔfoane bɛ ooguale so ne, kyɛ ɔte ase ye de.’ Ofikyɛ ngosa ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa b’aseɛ bɔ mva mane bɛ nana mɔ ne aso.

english_verse: But for now, I am sending enemies who will catch you like fish and hunt you down like wild animals in the hills and the caves.
translation_verse: “Tie, ngɔsoma maa bɛkɔɔfrɛ mmenia pee bɔ bɛkye nzue nu naen ɔ bɛkɔwa, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, na bɛkɔɔhye bɛ. Na afei ngɔsoma maa bɛkɔɔfrɛ bɔfoɛ mɔ pee bɛkɔwa, na bɛkɔhyehye mmenia ne wɔ bokaa biala so ne pambaa biala so ne nyɔbotaen nu ndokuro ngumaa nu.

english_verse: I can see everything you are doing, even if you try to hide your sins from me.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me nye tua bɛ yɔleɛ amukoraa. Bɛmvea wɔ me nyunu, yeɛ b’amumuyɛɛ koso, so ɔngata wɔ me nye so.

english_verse: I will punish you double for your sins, because you have polluted my own land. You have filled it with lifeless idols that remind me of dead bodies. The Lord Gives Strength I prayed to the Lord:
translation_verse: Na ngoli moa ngotua bɛ b’amumuyɛɛ ne bɛ bɔne so kerɛ mmɔhoɛ nyɔ, ofikyɛ bagua m’aseɛ nwo fiɛ, na bafa bɛ nningyein fiɛ ne b’akyiwadeɛ mɔ fuin bayi m’agyapadeɛ ne aso to.”

english_verse: Our Lord, you are the one who gives me strength and protects me like a fortress when I am in trouble. People will come to you from distant nations and say, “Our ancestors worshiped false and useless gods,
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, m’anwoserɛ ne m’anwoserɛ afealeɛ, me nwo adwaabɔlɛ nekaa wɔ amaneɛnwunɛ kyẽa nu, wɔ berɛ yeɛ amaen maen bekofi aseɛ noa kɔkã ye noa bɛkɔwa bɛkɔɔhã kyɛ, “Amba, ngondombo yeɛ ɔte anwonyadeɛ bɔ yɛ nana mɔ benyane ye ɔ: ɔne nningyein mbaen mbaen bɔ mvasoɛ nne so ɔ.

english_verse: worthless idols made by human hands.”
translation_verse: Aso sona kɔhora kɔyɔ nyameɛ mɔ kɔfa? Asua! Ɛhemɔ bɛte nyameɛ mɔ!”

english_verse: Then the Lord replied, “That's why I will teach them about my power, and they will know that I truly am the Lord.”
translation_verse: “Yiti, tie, ngɔmaa bekonwu ye pɛen ko, ngɔmaa bekonwu me tumi ne m’anwoserɛ ne, na bekonwu kyɛ me dumaa ole AWURADE.”

english_verse: People of Judah, your sins cannot be erased. They are written on your hearts like words chiseled in stone or carved on the corners of your altars. *
translation_verse: Bafa buralɛ pɛn yeɛ bahyerɛ Yuda bɔne ɔ. Bafa pɛn ne noa bɔ ɔte dɛngyɛmmoɛ ne yeɛ bakurukyire ye wɔ b’ahone poen so ɔ, ɔne b’afɔleɛ mmokyea mmɛen nemɔ aso ɔ;

english_verse: One generation after another has set up pagan altars and worshiped the goddess Asherah everywhere in your country— on hills and mountains, and under large trees.
translation_verse: wɔ aberɛ bɔ bɛ mma mɔ bɛkaye b’afɔleɛ mmokyea ne b’Asera dosii wɔ mmakaa monɛ mɔ anwo ne pambaa ndendenn mɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: So I'll take everything you own, including your altars, and give it all to your enemies.
translation_verse: Ao, me bokaa bɔ ɛwɔ eburo ɔ, ɔnate wɔ bɔne asɔneyɛɛ mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ w’aseɛ ne amukoraa so ne ati, ngɔfa wɔ nningyein ne w’agyapadeɛ amukoraa ngɔmaa bɛkɔfẽ bɛkɔfa.

english_verse: You will lose the land that I gave you, and I will make you slaves in a foreign country, because you have made my anger blaze up like a fire that won't stop burning. Trust the Lord
translation_verse: Na w’agyapadeɛ bɔ mva mane wɔ ne, okofi wɔ sa, na ngɔmaa ɛkɔso wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ wɔ aseɛ bɔ ɛnze so ɔ so, ofikyɛ m’ahone bɔ wahu ne, ɛmɔasuso see begua nu maa ogye afebɔɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, have put a curse on those who turn from me and trust in human strength.
translation_verse: Bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: “Musue to sona bɔ ɔfa ye wora wura sona nu, ná ɔfa ye nwo to sona mmokalɛ so, ná ɔye ye adwene fi AWURADE so ɔ.

english_verse: They will dry up like a bush in salty desert soil, where nothing can grow.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ ɛserɛ so bakaa, na mmerɛ paa ba a, ongonwu ye; ɔkɔtena ɛserɛ so aseɛ katerepee so, ngyee aseɛ bɔ sona biala ɔtte so ɔ so.

english_verse: But I will bless those who trust me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ye wora wura AWURADE nu, bɔ AWURADE te ye anyelasoɛ ne de, onya saleɛ.

english_verse: They will be like trees growing beside a stream— trees with roots that reach down to the water, and with leaves that are always green. They bear fruit every year and are never worried by a lack of rain.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ bakaa bɔ balua ye asue noa, bɔ ye ndii tende kɔ asue ne anwo ɔ. Sɛ ahuhuro ba a, onzuro, ye nyaa kɔhɔ so kɔyɛ monɛ; afoɛ bɔ wawa kɔpe ne, ɔmva ye nwo, na ɔngɔyakyi mmaasulɛ le.”

english_verse: You people of Judah are so deceitful that you even fool yourselves, and you can't change.
translation_verse: Ahone te nnakannaka tra nikyee biala, ɔte kanda paa. Na nwa yeɛ okonwu nu dwirɛ ɔ?

english_verse: But I know your deeds and your thoughts, and I will make sure you get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Me AWURADE, me yeɛ mepɛnzɛpɛnzɛ adwene nu, ná meso ahone menea ɔ, kyɛ metua ebiala so kerɛ kyɛbɔ ye atee si te ɔ, ɔne kyɛbɔ ye yɔleɛ si te ɔ.

english_verse: You cheated others, but everything you gained will fly away, like birds hatched from stolen eggs. Then you will discover what fools you are. Jeremiah Prays to the Lord
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔpena anwonya bɔ wamva atee paa so ne, ɔte kyɛ akɔkɔhwereɛ bɔ obutu ngyiremvua bɔ nna ye yeɛ ɔtole ɔ so ɔ; onyi ɔkɔ ye nyunu kãa a, okofi ye sa, na ye ayieleɛ nu ɔkɔyɛ kwaseaa.

english_verse: Our Lord, your temple is a glorious throne that has stood on a mountain from the beginning.
translation_verse: Animnyam ahennie bia bɔ bama so fi ahyɛaseɛ yeɛ ɔte yɛ nekaa krongron ɔ!

english_verse: You are a spring of water giving Israel life and hope. But if the people reject what you have told me, they will be swept away like words written in dust.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, Yisrael anyelasoɛ! Ebiala bɔ ɔpo wɔ ne, ye nyunu kogua ase; bɛ bɔ bɛkakyi bɛ si bɛma me ne, bɛkɔhyerɛ bɛ dumaa wɔ aseɛ so, ofikyɛ bapo AWURADE bɔ ɔte ngoa asue ti ne. Yeremia pena AWURADE mmokalɛ

english_verse: You, Lord, are the one I praise. So heal me and rescue me! Then I will be completely well and perfectly safe.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, sa me anwonyerɛ, na ngɔte apɔ; pepɛ de me, na ngonya ngoa, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’ayɛyelɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The people of Judah say to me, “Jeremiah, you claimed to tell us what the Lord has said. So why hasn't it come true?”
translation_verse: Nea bɔ bɛkã bekyire me ɔ! Bɛnwa: “AWURADE dwirɛ ne, ɔwɔ nisua? Maa ɔbra e!”

english_verse: Our Lord, you chose me to care for your people, and that's what I have done. You know everything I have said, and I have never once asked you to punish them.
translation_verse: Nakoso me de, neafoɛ adwuma bɔ ɔkɔmaa ngoli wɔ si ne, mannwati mamvi ye nwo, yeɛ musue kyẽa ne, nnneane ye ate; wɔ bɔbɔ ɛse. Bɔ ofi me noa wale ne, ɔla wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: I trust you for protection in times of trouble, so don't frighten me.
translation_verse: Nnɛyɛ wɔ nwo ebie bɔ onwunanwuna me ɔ; amaneɛnwunɛ kyẽa nu, wɔ yeɛ ɛte m’afealeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Keep me from failure and disgrace, but make my enemies fail and be disgraced. Send destruction to make their worst fears come true. Resting on the Sabbath
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛtane me nye ne, ma bɛ nyunu ogua ase, nakoso me de, nnɛma me nyunu gua ase; ma ahunundetelɛ tɔ bɛ so, nakoso me de, nnɛma ahunundetelɛ tɔ me so; ma musue kyẽa ne ɔto bɛ, ná bubu bɛ nu gyeingyein! Afofikyẽalilɛ

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, stand at each city gate in Jerusalem, including the one the king uses, and speak to him and everyone else. Tell them I have said: I am the Lord, so pay attention.
translation_verse: ná se bɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔ Yuda ahemvo ne Yudafoɛ amukoraa, yeɛ Yerusalemfoɛ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔfa pambim nemɔ anu bewura kuro ne anu ɔ, ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE dwirɛ.

english_verse: If you value your lives, don't do any work on the Sabbath. Don't carry anything through the city gates or through the door of your house, or anywhere else. Keep the Sabbath day sacred! I gave this command to your ancestors, but they were stubborn and refused to obey or to be corrected. But if you obey,
translation_verse: “ ‘Nakoso AWURADE nwa nyoo: Sɛ ɛmɔtie me dwirɛ nahorɛ nu, ná ɛmɔamva nningyein bamva kuro ye pambim nemɔ anu banwura nu afofikyẽa, na mmom ɛmɔsie afofikyẽa ne krongron, ná ɛmɔanyɔ adwuma biala sɔ kyẽa ne a,

english_verse: then Judah and Jerusalem will always be ruled by kings from David's family. The king and his officials will ride through these gates on horses or in chariots, and the people of Judah and Jerusalem will be with them. There will always be people living in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: ye de, ahemvo ne nnehyeɛ bɔ bɛte Dawide bia so ne, bɛkɔfa pambim ye mɔ anu bekowura kuro ye anu bɔ bɛtete teaseɛnam mɔ nu ne mbɔngɔ so ɔ; bɛ ne bɛ nnehyeɛ mɔ ne Yudafoɛ ne Yerusalemfoɛ. Na mmenia kɔtena kuro ye aso afebɔɔ.

english_verse: and others will come here from the nearby villages, from the towns of Judah and Benjamin, from the hill country and the foothills to the west, and from the Southern Desert. They will bring sacrifices to please me and to give me thanks, as well as offerings of grain and incense.
translation_verse: Na mmenia kofi Yuda nguro mɔ so, nguro bɔ bapɛ Yerusalem nwo bayia nemɔ so, Benyamin aseɛ so, aseɛ frɛtɛɛ ne aso, mmokaa aseɛ nemɔ aso ne ngwaen dɔ aseɛ ne aso bɛkɔfa naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, afɔleɛ mɔ, aburoo afɔleɛ, ayirefona, ɔne ayɛyelɛ afɔleɛ bɛkɔwa AWURADE awuro.

english_verse: But if you keep on carrying things through the city gates on the Sabbath and keep treating it as any other day, I will set fire to these gates and burn down the whole city, including the fortresses.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔandie me dwirɛ, ná ɛmɔanzie afofikyẽa ne krongron, ná mmom sɛ ɛmɔsoa nningyein bɛfa Yerusalem pambim nemɔ anu afofikyẽa a, ye de ngɔto ye pambim nemɔ anu see, na ɔkɔyera Yerusalem ahemvie mɔ bɔ see ne ngonua ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: “Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop, and when you get there, I will tell you what to say to the people.”
translation_verse: “Dwɔso kɔ ngukuenwonɛniɛ n’awuro, na ngɔmaa ɛkɔte me noa dwirɛ wɔ dɔ.”

english_verse: I went there and saw the potter making clay pots on his pottery wheel.
translation_verse: Yiti nzili nu ngɔle ngukuenwonɛniɛ n’awuro, na nwuni kyɛ ole ye nningyein ɔyɔ ye adwuma.

english_verse: And whenever the clay would not take the shape he wanted, he would change his mind and form it into some other shape.
translation_verse: Na ngukuenwonɛniɛ ne, bua bɔ né ole ɛfaa ɔnwo ne, sɔ bua ne sɛkyele wɔ ye sa nu. Na ngukuenwonɛniɛ ne, osa fa nwone bua foforɛ, kyɛbɔ okuro kyɛ ɔyɔ ye ɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ,

english_verse: If I threaten to uproot and shatter an evil nation,
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔba ye kyɛ, mekã mefa maen bie anaa ahennie bie anwo kyɛ ngotutu ná mabubu ná masɛkye ye,

english_verse: but its people start disobeying me and doing evil, then I will change my mind and not help them at all.
translation_verse: nakoso ɔyɔ bɔne wɔ me nye so, bɔ ondie me dwirɛ a, ye de ngɔsesã m’adwene wɔ ngɔsoɛ bɔ nyɛle kyɛ ngɔmaa okonya ne anwo.

english_verse: So listen to me, people of Judah and Jerusalem! I have decided to strike you with disaster, and I won't change my mind unless you stop sinning and start living right.
translation_verse: Yiti afei, kɔ Yuda mmienzua ne Yerusalemfoɛ berɛ kose bɛ kyɛ, ‘Bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: Tie, medwene ɛmɔ nwo adwene tɛɛ, yeɛ mesusu tɛɛ mefa ɛmɔ nwo. Yiti odi kyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔsakyera befi ɛmɔ bɔne atee ne anwo, ná ɛmɔsesã ɛmɔ atee ne ɛmɔ yɔleɛ maa ɔyɛ paa. Yisrael po Nyameɛ

english_verse: But I know you won't listen. You might as well answer, “We don't care what you say. We have made plans to sin, and we are going to be stubborn and do as we please!”
translation_verse: “Nakoso bɛnwa, ‘Anyelasoɛ biala nne berɛ! Yɛ bɔbɔ yɛ ti anu dwirɛ yeɛ yɛkoli so ɔ, na yɛ nu biala kɔbɔ ye bra kyɛbɔ ye ti anu adwene tɛɛ ne kyire ye ɔ.’

english_verse: So I, the Lord, command you to ask the nations, and find out if they have ever heard of such a horrible sin as what you have done.
translation_verse: “Yiti bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: Ɛ́mɔbisa amaenmaen nemɔ: Nwa yeɛ wate edwirɛ he bie le ɔ? Ababunu Yisrael wayɔ nikyee bɔ ɔyɛ suro paa.

english_verse: The snow on Lebanon's mountains never melts away, and the streams there never run dry.
translation_verse: Lebanon asukɔtwea, aso ɔyakyi Sirion nyɔbotaen so falɛ anaa? Ye nzue yurukuku bɔ ɔtengyɛ fi dedeede ba ne, aso ɔwewe anaa?

english_verse: But you, my people, have turned from me to burn incense to worthless idols. You have left the ancient road to follow an unknown path where you stumble over idols.
translation_verse: Nakoso me maen de, ye wora afi me, bɛyera ɛyɛɛ mɔ bɛma mmosoen mbaen mbaen mɔ; bamaa basoti wɔ b’atee mɔ so, bafi atimbire daa nemɔ aso, bafa makyebu atee mɔ so, bɔ nna atimbire ahɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Your land will be ruined, and every passerby will look at it with horror and make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Bama b’aseɛ ne aso ayɛ pralaa, na wayɛ nikyee bɔ mmenia sobi bɛ noa begua so afebɔɔ ɔ. Ebiala bɔ ɔpɛ nu berɛ ne, ye nwo kodwiri ye, na okopusu ye ti.

english_verse: When your enemies attack, I will scatter you like dust blown by an eastern wind. Then, on that day of disaster, I will turn my back on you. The Plot against Jeremiah
translation_verse: Ngɔyɛ kyɛ eyia afiteleɛ mvrama ngɔbɔ bɛ ngɔsande wɔ pɔfoɛ ne nyunu.” B’amaneɛnwunɛ kyẽa ne ngɔfa me si yeɛ ngɔma bɛ ɔ, na nna me nyunu ɔ. Bɛbɔ Yeremia nwo porɛ

english_verse: Some of the people said, “Let's get rid of Jeremiah! We will always have priests to teach us God's laws, as well as wise people to give us advice, and prophets to speak the Lord's messages. So, instead of listening to Jeremiah any longer, let's accuse him of a crime.” Jeremiah Prays about His Enemies
translation_verse: Yeɛ besele kyɛ, “Ɛmɔbra maa yɛbɔ Yeremia nwo porɛ, ofikyɛ mmeraa ne ngotu ngomini ngofi ɔsɔfo berɛ, foɛtulɛ ngotu ngomini ngofi nworɛniɛ berɛ, yeɛ edwirɛ ne koso, ongotu ngomini ngofi ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ berɛ. Ɛmɔbra maa yɛpɛ dwirɛ yɛto ye so, na nnɛmɔmaa yɛtie ye dwirɛ biala.”

english_verse: Please, Lord, answer my prayer. Make my enemies stop accusing me of evil.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, tie me dwirɛ, ná tie bɔ me pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛkekã ɔ!

english_verse: I tried to help them, but they are paying me back by digging a pit to trap me. I even begged you not to punish them.
translation_verse: Aso bɔne yeɛ bɛfa betua paa so kerɛ ɔ? Nakoso bɛ de, batu kumaa kyɛ me kra ɔte tɔ nu. Kaye kyɛ ngyinane wɔ nyunu kyɛ mekã paa mema bɛ, bɔ ɔkɔma w’ahone kɔtɔ nzue nu wɔ bɛ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: But now I am asking you to let their children starve or be killed in war. Let women lose their husbands and sons to disease and violence.
translation_verse: Yiti maa ɛhɔen ohũhũ bɛ mma mɔ, maa bɛtotɔ ngrandɛ noa, bɛ ye mɔ, ma bɛ mma fi bɛ sa, maa bɛyɛ kunafoɛ. Ma ewue anwonyerɛ ohũhũ bɛ hu mɔ; ma bɛ mmerandeɛ mɔ totɔ ngrandɛ noa wɔ koɛ nu.

english_verse: These people have dug pits and set traps for me, Lord. Make them scream in fear when you send enemy troops to attack their homes.
translation_verse: Ma mmenia bɛte esuɛ befi b’awuro mɔ anu, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛfa koɛhonɛfoɛ kure ba bɛ so mvum nu ɔ, ofikyɛ batu kumaa kyɛ nde ndɔ nu, yeɛ basua ngaen kyɛ ɔhye me.

english_verse: The Lord said: Jeremiah, go to the pottery shop and buy a clay jar. Then take along some of the city officials and leading priests
translation_verse: Bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe, “Kɔtɔ ngukuenwonɛniɛ ye kulie. Fa maen ne anu mbanyi ne bie ne asɔfo mbanyi nemɔ bie boka wɔ nwo so,

english_verse: and go to Hinnom Valley, just outside Potsherd Gate. Tell the people that I have said:
translation_verse: ná kɔ Hinom Awa bɔnza bɔ ɔwɔ Nyangaa Bue Pambim ne noa ne anu. Na bɔ edwirɛ bɔ ngɔhã ngohyire wɔ ne dawure wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and you kings of Judah and you people of Jerusalem had better pay attention. I am going to bring so much trouble on this valley that everyone who hears about it will be shocked.
translation_verse: Kã kyɛ, ‘Ao Yuda ahemvo ne Yerusalemfoɛ, ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE dwirɛ. Bɔ Asafo AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ kã ɛhe: Tie, ngɔprapra musue ngogua ɛwa sɔa, bɔ ebiala bɔ ɔkɔte ne, ye kunu kɔte ye ɔ.

english_verse: The people of Judah stopped worshiping me and made this valley into a place of worship for Baal and other gods that have never helped them or their ancestors or their kings. And they have committed murder here, burning their young, innocent children as sacrifices to Baal. I have never even thought of telling you to do that.
translation_verse: Basisi Baal asɔneyɛɛ mɔ koso, kyɛ bɛyera bɛ mma mɔ wɔ see nu bɛfa bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɛma Baal. Ɛhe te nikyee bɔ nna me yeɛ nhyɛle bɛ kyɛ bɛyɔ ɔ, nngane, yeɛ ɔwwale m’adwene nu po.

english_verse: So watch out! Someday this place will no longer be called Topheth or Hinnom Valley. It will be called Slaughter Valley!
translation_verse: Yiti tie, AWURADE nwa nyoo: Mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba bɔ bɛngɔfrɛ ɛwa Tofete anaa Hinom Awa bɔnza ko, na mmom bɛkɔfrɛ ɛwa Akumyɛɛ bɔnza.

english_verse: You people of Judah and Jerusalem may have big plans, but here in this valley I'll ruin those plans. I'll let your enemies kill you, and I'll tell the birds and wild animals to eat your dead bodies.
translation_verse: Ngɔma Yuda ne Yerusalem nzusuleɛ kɔyɛ mbaen wɔ wa, na ngɔmaa bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa wɔ bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ nyunu, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛpena bɛ beku bɛ ɔ, bɛ sa nu. Na ngɔfa bɛ fuin ngɔma ewienu nnomaa ne aseɛ so ngaka aboyaa maa bekoli.

english_verse: I will turn Jerusalem into a pile of rubble, and every passerby will be shocked and horrified and will make insulting remarks.
translation_verse: Ngɔma kuro ye kɔkakyi kurofoen, ɔne nikyee bɔ mmenia sobi bɛ noa begua so ɔ. Na ebiala bɔ ɔpɛ nu berɛ ne, ye nwo kodwiri ye, na okosobi ye, ɔnate ye amaneɛ ne amukoraa ti.

english_verse: And while your enemies are trying to break through your city walls to kill you, the food supply will run out. You will become so hungry that you will eat the flesh of your friends and even of your own children.
translation_verse: Ngɔmaa bɛkɔpɛ bɛ nwo bekoli bɛ mma mmienzua ne bɛ mma mmrasua mɔ naen. Na ebiala koli obiɛngo naen, ɔnate kuro ne bɔ batua ye, ɔne amaneɛ bɔ bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛpena bɛ beku bɛ ne, bamaa wato bɛ ne ati.’

english_verse: Jeremiah, as soon as you have said this, smash the jar while the people are watching.
translation_verse: “Na afei, bɛ bɔ bɛboka wɔ so bɛ ne wɔ bɛ́kɔ ne, bɔ kulie ne wɔ bɛ nyunu,

english_verse: Then tell them that I have also said: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I warn you that I will shatter Judah and Jerusalem just like this jar that is broken beyond repair. You will bury your dead here in Topheth, but so many of you will die that there won't be enough room.
translation_verse: ná se bɛ kyɛ, ‘Bɔ Asafo AWURADE kã ɛhe: Kyɛbɔ sona ɔbɔ ngukuenwonɛniɛ ye bua bɔ bɛngora bɛnwo ye yé ko ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ngɔbɔ maen he ne kuro he ɔ. Bekosie mmenia wɔ Tofete alaa kɔpem kyɛ bengonya aseɛ bengosie bɛ ko ɔ.

english_verse: I will make Jerusalem as unclean as Topheth, by filling the city with your dead bodies. I will do this because you and your kings have gone up to the roofs of your houses and burned incense to the stars in the sky, as though they were gods. And you have given sacrifices of wine to foreign gods. Jeremiah Speaks in the Temple Courtyard
translation_verse: Na Yerusalem awuro mɔ ne Yuda ahemvo mɔ awuro mɔ, bɛ nwo kogua fiɛ te kyɛ Tofete berɛ, ɔnate awuro amukoraa bɔ bayera ɛyɛɛ wɔ bɛ ti afia bama ewienu nzramaa amukoraa, ɔne anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɔ babɔ bama nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ ne ati.’ ”

english_verse: I went to Topheth, where I told the people what the Lord had said. Then I went to the temple courtyard and shouted to the people,
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yeremia fili Tofete, nekaa bɔ AWURADE asoma ye kyɛ ɔɔhyɛ ngɔm ne ɔwale, na oogyinane AWURADE awuro ne aluo berɛ osele maen ne amukoraa kyɛ,

english_verse: “Listen, everyone! Some time ago, the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, warned you that he would bring disaster on Jerusalem and all nearby villages. But you were stubborn and refused to listen. Now the Lord is going to bring the disaster he promised.”
translation_verse: “Bɔ Asafo AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ kã ɛhe: Tie, musue bɔ ngane kyɛ ngɔprapra ngogua kuro ye ne ye nwo nguro amukoraa so ne, ngɔmaa ɔkɔwa bɛ so, ɔnate kyɛ basoa bɛ kɔme so kyeinn bɔ bandie me dwirɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Pashhur son of Immer was a priest and the chief of temple security. He heard what I had said,
translation_verse: Afei, Yimere awa ɔsɔfo Pasure bɔ né ɔte AWURADE awuro ne aso panyi ne, ɔtele kyɛ Yeremia ɔhyɛ sɔ ngɔm nemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: and so he hit me. Then he had me arrested and put in chains at the Benjamin Gate in the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Pasure bole ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yeremia, na ɔbɔle ye panwu wɔ Benyamin anoa piri bɔ opingye AWURADE awuro berɛ ne, ye sorɔ dɔ.

english_verse: The next day, when Pashhur let me go free, I told him that the Lord had said: No longer will I call you Pashhur. Instead, I will call you Afraid-of-Everything.
translation_verse: Na aleɛ hyene ne, Pasure yele Yeremia panwu ne, na Yeremia sele ye kyɛ, “Nna dumaa Pasure yeɛ AWURADE afa ato wɔ ɔ, na mmom Mago Misabibo.

english_verse: You will be afraid, and you will bring fear to your friends as well. You will see enemies kill them in battle. Then I will let the king of Babylonia take everyone in Judah prisoner, killing some and dragging the rest away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: Tie, méfa wɔ meyɛ anwunanwuna nikye mema wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo, ɔne wɔ mmango mɔ amukoraa; na bɛkɔtotɔ bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ ngrandɛ noa wɔ aberɛ bɔ wɔ nye tua ɔ. Na ngɔfa Yuda amukoraa ngowura Babilɔn hene sa. Ɔkɔhye bɛ nnure kɔsoa bɛ kɔhɔ Babilɔn, na ɔkɔfa ngrandɛ kohũhũ bɛ.

english_verse: Pashhur, you are guilty of telling lies and claiming they were messages from me. That's why I will let the Babylonians take you, your family, and your friends as prisoners to Babylonia, where you will all die and be buried. Jeremiah Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Na wɔ Pasure ne w’awuro ama mukoraa, ɛmɔkɔhɔ nnurehyelɛ nu, na ɛkɔhɔ Babilɔn, na dɔ yeɛ ekowu ɔ, dɔ yeɛ bekosie wɔ ɔ, ɛne wɔ mmango amukoraa bɔ ahyɛ ngɔndorɔ ahyire bɛ ne.” Yeremia fa ye dwirɛ to Nyameɛ nyunu

english_verse: You tricked me, Lord, and I was really fooled. You are stronger than I am, and you have defeated me. People never stop sneering and insulting me.
translation_verse: O AWURADE, alakalaka me, mamaa alakalaka me. W’anwoserɛ bo me deɛ so, na ali ngonim. Bɛgoro me nwo daa biala; ebiala sere me.

english_verse: You have let me announce only injustice and death. Your message has brought me nothing but insults and trouble.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmerɛ biala medwudwo a, odi kyɛ metea nu, metea nu kyɛ, “Basabasayɔlɛ ne Ɛsɛkyelɛ oo!” Ɔnate AWURADE dwirɛ ti, me nyunu gua ase, na bɛsere me daa biala.

english_verse: Sometimes I tell myself not to think about you, Lord, or even mention your name. But your message burns in my heart and bones, and I cannot keep silent.
translation_verse: Sɛ mekã kyɛ, “Mengɔkaye ye ko, anaa mengodwudwo wɔ ye dumaa nu ko” a, né ye dwirɛ ne ayɛ m’ahone nu kyɛ see bɔ ogye wɔ me mmowue nu ɔ. Mahyɛ me nwo so mafɛ, nakoso mengora.

english_verse: I heard the crowds whisper, “Everyone is afraid. Now's our chance to accuse Jeremiah!” All of my so-called friends are just waiting for me to make a mistake. They say, “Maybe Jeremiah can be tricked. Then we can overpower him and get even at last.”
translation_verse: Mate kyɛ mmeni pee bɛ́yɛ nwuhunwuhu kyɛ, “Anwunanwuna apɛ yɛ nwo ayia, Ɛmɔhã dwirɛ betia ye! Ɛ́mɔma yɛhã dwirɛ yɛtia ye!” Mmenia amukoraa bɔ me ne bɛ yɛnnyane edwirɛ biala ne, bɛpena m’asefinɛ, na bɛnwa: “Ebiaa ɔkɔmaa yɛkɔlakalaka ye, yɛkoli ye so ngonim, ná yatɔ ye so wereɛ.”

english_verse: But you, Lord, are a mighty soldier, standing at my side. Those troublemakers will fall down and fail— terribly embarrassed, forever ashamed.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE gyi me si kyɛ koɛhonɛniɛ bɔ ye nwo yɛ suro ɔ. Yiti bɛ bɔ bɛtane me nye ne, bekosoti, na bengoli ngonim. Bɛ nyunu kogua ase paa, ofikyɛ ongoyie bɛ yé. Na b’animguaseɛ afebɔɔ ne, mmenia wora ngofi ye le.

english_verse: Lord All-Powerful, you test those who do right, and you know every heart and mind. I have told you my complaints, so let me watch you take revenge on my enemies.
translation_verse: Nakoso Asafo AWURADE, wɔ bɔ eso teneneeniɛ nea ɔ, bɔ ɛse ahone nu ne bɛ ti nu dwirɛ ɔ, maa nwu bɛ so wereɛ bɔ ɛkɔtɔ ne, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ mafa me dwirɛ mato wɔ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: I sing praises to you, Lord. You rescue the oppressed from the wicked.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔto dwein bɛ́ye AWURADE ayɛ; ɛ́mɔye AWURADE ayɛ! Ofikyɛ wapepɛ wale anwumvoinniɛ ye kra wafi bɔnefoɛ sa nu.

english_verse: Put a curse on the day I was born! Don't bless that day.
translation_verse: Musue to kyẽa bɔ bɛwole me ɔ! Kyẽa bɔ me ni wole me ne, saleɛ ɔbɔ ye!

english_verse: Put a curse on the man who told my father, “Good news! You have a son.”
translation_verse: Musue to sona bɔ ɔfale amaneɛ ɔɔbɔle me se kyɛ, “Awo baa bienzua,” maa ye nye gyele paa ne.

english_verse: May that man be like the towns you destroyed without pity. Let him hear shouts of alarm in the morning and battle cries at noon.
translation_verse: Sɔ sona ne, maa ɔ́yɛ kyɛ nguro bɔ AWURADE sɛkyele bɛ bɔ wannwu bɛ anwumvoin ne; maa ɔte esuɛ ngyerɛmɔ, ná ɔte awuye eyiagyina,

english_verse: He deserves to die for not killing me before I was born. Then my mother's body would have been my grave.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ wangu me wɔ bɛ kunu maa me ni anyɛ m’asieleɛ maa manga ye kunu afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Why did I have to be born? Was it just to suffer and die in shame?
translation_verse: Nzu ati koraa yeɛ mvili bɛ kunu mvitele mmale, mma nwuni ɛfɛɛ ne aworabɔlɛ, maa animguaseɛ yili m’asetena nu to ye?

english_verse: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.” So they came to me and said,
translation_verse: Edwirɛ he yeɛ AWURADE lale ye ali hyirele Yeremia, mmerɛ bɔ Nana Sedekia somane Malkiya awa Pasure ne ɔsɔfo Maaseya awa Sefania wɔ Yeremia berɛ maa beesele ye kyɛ,

english_verse: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
translation_verse: “Mesrɛ wɔ, bisa AWURADE noa dwirɛ ma yɛ, ofikyɛ Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa ɔbaafa koɛ toa yɛ. Ebiaa AWURADE konwu yɛ anwumvoin kyɛbɔ ye anwanwadeɛ amukoraa te ne, amaa ɔnate so Nebukadenesa wayakyi yɛ wahɔ.”

english_verse: Then I told them that the Lord had said: People of Jerusalem, I, the Lord, give you the choice of life or death.
translation_verse: “Na se maen he kyɛ, ‘Bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: Tie, méfa ngoa atee ne ewue atee mésie ɛmɔ nyunu.

english_verse: The Babylonian army has surrounded Jerusalem, so if you want to live, you must go out and surrender to them. But if you want to die because of hunger, disease, or war, then stay here in the city.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔkɔtena kuro ye aso ne, okowu ngrandɛ noa, ɛhɔen ne ewue anwonyerɛ kohũ ye; yeɛ bɔ okofi kuro ye anu kofite kɔɔfa ye nwo kowura Kaldeafoɛ bɔ batua ɛmɔ kuro ne bɛ sa ne, okonya ye ti kodidi nu, na ye ngoa kɔyɛ kyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ.

english_verse: I have decided not to rescue Jerusalem. Instead, I am going to let the king of Babylonia burn it to the ground. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Warns the King of Judah *
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ matu me nye masie kuro he aso kyɛ ngɔfa bɔ ɔtte mayee ɔ ngoli ye, na mmom nna paa ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Bɛkɔfa bekowura Babilɔn hene sa, na ɔkɔfa see kɔyera ye.’

english_verse: Pay attention, you that belong to the royal family.
translation_verse: “Na kã ɛhe kyire Yuda hene awuro ama kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE dwirɛ:

english_verse: Each new day, make sure that justice is done, and rescue those who are being robbed. Or else my anger will flame up like a fire that never goes out.
translation_verse: Ao Dawide awuro ama! Bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: Ɛ́mɔbua ndɛen turoloo ngyerɛmɔ, na ebiala bɔ babɔ ye apoo ne, ɛ́mɔpepɛ bele ye béfi aminɛlilɛfoɛ bɛ sa nu, wanyɔ sɔ a, m’ahone kohu kyɛ see, na okogye bɔ ebiala ngɔhora ye nua ɔ, ɔnate ɛmɔ bɔne yɔleɛ nemɔ ati.’ ”

english_verse: Jerusalem, from your mountaintop you look out over the valleys and think you are safe. But I, the Lord, am angry,
translation_verse: Tie, wɔ bɔ ɛte bɔnza ne anu, wɔ bɔ ɛte aseɛ frɛtɛɛ so nyɔbotaen ɔ, meko metia wɔ, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔkekã kyɛ, ‘Nwa yeɛ okodwu kɔwa yɛ so ɔ, anaakyɛ nwa yeɛ okowura y’atenaleɛ mɔ nu ɔ?’ AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: and I will punish you as you deserve. I'll set your palace on fire, and everything around you will go up in smoke.
translation_verse: Nakoso ngɔhwe ɛmɔ so kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ yɔleɛ te ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Ngɔto ye ɛhɔayeɛ ne anu see, na ɔkɔyera nikyee biala bɔ wapɛ ye nwo wayia ɔ.”

english_verse: King Zedekiah of Judah sent for Pashhur son of Malchiah and for a priest named Zephaniah son of Maaseiah. Then he told them, “Talk with Jeremiah for me.” So they came to me and said,
translation_verse: Edwirɛ he yeɛ AWURADE lale ye ali hyirele Yeremia, mmerɛ bɔ Nana Sedekia somane Malkiya awa Pasure ne ɔsɔfo Maaseya awa Sefania wɔ Yeremia berɛ maa beesele ye kyɛ,

english_verse: “King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked Judah. Please ask the Lord to work miracles for our people, as he has done in the past, so that Nebuchadnezzar will leave us alone.”
translation_verse: “Mesrɛ wɔ, bisa AWURADE noa dwirɛ ma yɛ, ofikyɛ Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa ɔbaafa koɛ toa yɛ. Ebiaa AWURADE konwu yɛ anwumvoin kyɛbɔ ye anwanwadeɛ amukoraa te ne, amaa ɔnate so Nebukadenesa wayakyi yɛ wahɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord sent me to the palace of the king of Judah to speak to the king, his officials, and everyone else who was there. The Lord told me to say: I am the Lord, so pay attention! You have been allowing people to cheat, rob, and take advantage of widows, orphans, and foreigners who live here. Innocent people have become victims of injustice, and some of them have even been killed. But now I command you to do what is right and see that justice is done. Rescue everyone who has suffered from injustice.
translation_verse: Bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: Ɛ́mɔbua ndɛen turoloo, ná ɛ́mɔyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ. Na ebiala bɔ babɔ ye apoo ne, ɛ́mɔpepɛ bele ye béfi aminɛlilɛfoɛ bɛ sa nu. Nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ bɔne betia ɛwɔfoɛ, ayisiaa anaa kunaniɛ, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔsisi bɛ. Afei koso, nnɛma ɛmɔkã mogya bɔ odi be ɔ begua wɔ ɛwa.

english_verse: If you obey me, the kings from David's family will continue to rule Judah from this palace. They and their officials will ride in and out on their horses or in their chariots.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔdi sɔ dwirɛ he aso amba a, ye de ahemvo bɔ bɛte Dawide ahennie bia so, bɔ bɛtete teaseɛnam mɔ nu ne mbɔngɔ so, bɛ ne bɛ somvoɛ mɔ ne bɛ maen, bɛkɔfa awuro he anoa nemɔ anu bɛkɔwa nu.

english_verse: But if you ignore me, I promise in my own name that this palace will lie in ruins.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔandie edwirɛ hemɔ a, ye de meta me bɔbɔ me nwo ndaen kyɛ awuro he kɔkakyi dandue, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Listen to what I think about it: The palace of Judah's king is as glorious as Gilead or Lebanon's highest peaks. But it will be as empty as a ghost-town when I'm through with it.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔ AWURADE ɔkã fa Yuda hene awuro ama nwo ɛhe, “ ‘Ɛte kyɛ Gileade ma me, ɔne Lebanon ti afia; nakoso amba ngɔmaa ɛkɔkakyi aseɛ pralaa ne nguro bɔ sona nne so ɔ.

english_verse: I'll send troops to tear it apart, and its beautiful cedar beams will be used for firewood.
translation_verse: Na ngosiesie sɛkyefoɛ maa bekodwɔso bekotia wɔ, bɔ bɛ nu biala tira ye akodeɛ mɔ ɔ; bekobu wɔ sida mmakaa paa ne bekogua, ná bagyi bɛ bagua see nu.

english_verse: People from different nations will pass by and ask, “Why did the Lord do this to such a great city as Jerusalem?”
translation_verse: “ ‘Na maen maen pee kɔpɛ nu wɔ kuro he anwo, na sona biala kobisa obiɛngo kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ AWURADE afa ɛhe wali kuro piri he e?”

english_verse: Others will answer, “It's because the people worshiped foreign gods and broke the agreement that the Lord their God had made with them.” King Jehoahaz The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na bekobua kyɛ, “Ɔnate kyɛ bɛpole AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ apam ne, ná bɛɛsɔnene nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ bɛsole bɛ ne ati ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: King Josiah is dead, so don't mourn for him. Instead, mourn for his son King Jehoahaz, dragged off to another country, never to return.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔsu awufoɛ; yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔdodo ye, na mmom odi kyɛ ɛmɔsu bɔ ɔkɔ ne hahii, ofikyɛ ongosa ngɔwa ko, yeɛ ongonwu ye bɔbɔ ye maen ko.

english_verse: You put in big windows and used cedar paneling and red paint. But you were unfair and forced the builders to work without pay. *
translation_verse: bɔ ɔkã kyɛ, ‘Ngosi sua bɔ nu baye, bɔ ye aborɔsaen so pumbu mɔ anu te mbiri mbiri ɔ,’ bɔ ɔpepɛ mboma gua ye nwo ɔ, ná ɔfa sida samo so, ná ɔfa mbaen paa ɔma nu ɔ.

english_verse: More cedar in your palace doesn't make you a better king than your father Josiah. He always did right— he gave justice to the poor and was honest.
translation_verse: Sida bɔ afa ayɛ wɔ nwo buru ne nnu ne ati, ɛdwene kyɛ ɛte hene anaa? Aso wɔ baba wannidi wanno? Aso wammua ndɛen turoloo wammɔ bra bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ? Na ye sɔ ti, oyiele ye yé.

english_verse: That's what it means to truly know me. So he lived a comfortable life and always had enough to eat and drink.
translation_verse: Olili ehiafoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ bɛ dwirɛ mane bɛ, na oyiele ye yé. Aso ɛhe ngyire kyɛ né ɔse me? AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: But all you think about is how to cheat or abuse or murder some innocent victim.
translation_verse: Nakoso w’apoobɔlɛ anwonyadeɛ angome yeɛ wɔ nye ne w’ahone li ye si ɔ; ɔne kyɛ ɛkɔhã mogya bɔ odi be ɔ kogua, ɛkɔhyɛ mmenia so ná ekosisi bɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Jehoiakim, no one will mourn at your funeral. They won't turn to each other and ask, “Why did our great king have to die?”
translation_verse: Yiti Yehoakim bɔ ɔte Yuda hene Yosia awa ne, bɔ AWURADE kã fa ye nwo ɛhe: “Bengoli ye nwo aworabɔlɛ kyɛ, ‘Ayaa, nniɛma bienzua!’ anaa ‘Ayaa, nniɛma brasua!’ Bengoli ye nwo aworabɔlɛ kyɛ, “Ayaa, me mene!’ anaa ‘Ayaa, ye animnyam!’

english_verse: People of Jerusalem, the nations you trusted have been crushed. Go to Lebanon and weep; cry in the land of Bashan and in Moab.
translation_verse: Fo kɔ Lebanon kɔbɔ awuye, ma wɔ komvi so wɔ Basan; ná tea nu fi Abarim, ofikyɛ bahũhũ w’adɔfo mɔ amukoraa.

english_verse: When times were good, I warned you. But you ignored me, just as you have done since Israel was young.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né nningyein kɔ so yé ma wɔ ne, ndwudwo ngyirele wɔ, nakoso ɛnwa, ‘Mengotie.’ Efi wɔ ngwadaa nu, w’atee bɔ ɛnate so hɔ ɛne, ɛmva me noa dwirɛ nyɛ hwee.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced because of your sins. Your leaders will be swept away by the wind, and the nations you trusted will be captured and dragged to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Mvrama kɔsoa wɔ neafoɛ mɔ amukoraa kɔhɔ; na w’adɔfo amukoraa kɔhɔ nnurehyelɛ nu; na ɔnate wɔ bɔne yɔleɛ amukoraa ne ati, amba, ɛkɔfɛre, na wɔ nyunu kogua ase.

english_verse: Those who live in the palace paneled with cedar will groan with pain like women giving birth.
translation_verse: Ao, wɔ bɔ ɛte Lebanon bɔ anwo wɔ saen wɔ sida mmakaa nu ɔ, sɛ aworɛ nu yealɛ ba wɔ so kyɛbɔ aworɛ nu yealɛ kã brasua a, kyɛbɔ ekosi kɔbɔ awuye ɔ!”

english_verse: King Jehoiachin, son of Jehoiakim, even if you were the ring I wear as the sign of my royal power, I would still pull you from my finger.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo: Kyɛ nde ase ye, sɛ Konia bɔ ye baba ole Yuda hene Yehoakim yeɛ ɔte me nzɔanoɛ kaa bɔ owura me sa famaa po a, ahaa ngopuro wɔ ngofi me sa,

english_verse: I would hand you over to the enemy you fear, to King Nebuchadnezzar and his army, who want to kill you.
translation_verse: na ngɔfa wɔ ngowura bɛ bɔ bɛpena wɔ beku wɔ nemɔ sa, ɔne bɛ bɔ esuro bɛ nemɔ sa. Bɛ ole Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa ne Kaldeafoɛ.

english_verse: You and your mother were born in Judah, but I will throw both of you into a foreign country, where you will die,
translation_verse: Ngɔsoa wɔ ne eni bɔ ɔwole wɔ ɔ ngoogua maen foforɛ bie bɔ nna berɛ yeɛ bɛwole ɛmɔ ɔ so, na berɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkowu ɔ.

english_verse: Jehoiachin, you are unwanted like a broken clay pot. So you and your children will be thrown into a country you know nothing about.
translation_verse: Sɔ biaa Konia he, aso ɔte nyangaa bue bɔ bemmu ye, kukue bɔ ebiala nye ngye ye nwo ɔ? Nzu ati yeɛ bɛfoane ye ne ye boso ama beegyili bɛ beguale aseɛ bɔ bɛnze so ɔ so ɔ?

english_verse: Land of Judah, I am the Lord. Now listen to what I say!
translation_verse: Ao aseɛ, aseɛ, aseɛ, tie AWURADE dwirɛ!

english_verse: Erase the names of Jehoiachin's children from the royal records. He is a complete failure, and so none of them will ever be king. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: “Ɛmɔhyerɛ bɛfa biaa he anwo kyɛ, ɔte ebie bɔ olle ba ɔ, biaa bɔ ongoyie ye yé wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔte ase, ofikyɛ ongoyie ye boso ama nu biala yé maa ɔngɔtena Dawide ahennie bia so, bɔ okosa koli hene wɔ Yuda ɔ.”

english_verse: You leaders of my people are like shepherds that kill and scatter the sheep.
translation_verse: “Mmoaenneafoɛ bɔ bekũkũ me mmoaen kure ná bɛbɔ bɛ bɛsande ɔ, bɛ yaakɔ!” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: You were supposed to take care of my people, but instead you chased them away. So now I'll punish you severely and make you pay for your crimes!
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ kã fa me maen so neafoɛ nemɔ nwo ɛhe, “Ɛmɔabɔ me mmoaen kure ne basande, ɛmɔafoa bɛ maa bahɔ, na ɛmɔannea bɛ so. Yiti ngotu me nye ngosie ɛmɔ so, ɔnate ɛmɔ bɔne yɔleɛ ne ati, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I will bring the rest of my people home from the lands where I have scattered them, and they will grow into a mighty nation.
translation_verse: Na afei, me bɔbɔ ngɔboaboa me mmoaen ngaa nemɔ anoa ngofi maen maen bɔ mafoa bɛ maagua so nemɔ aso, na ngosa ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa bɛ nekaa bɔ bedidi ɔ, na bɛkɔwo bɛkɔta pee.

english_verse: I promise to choose leaders who will care for them like real shepherds. All of my people will be there, and they will never again be frightened.
translation_verse: Ngɔye mmoaenneafoɛ bɔ bɛkɔnea bɛ so ɔ, na bengosuro ko, bɛ kunu ngɔtete bɛ, yeɛ bɛ nu biala ngomini, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Someday I will appoint an honest king from the family of David, a king who will be wise and rule with justice.
translation_verse: “Tie, mmerɛ bie ɔba, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, bɔ ngɔma Mmaen bie bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ kodwɔso wɔ Dawide bosofoɛ nu. Okoli hene, na okoyie ye yé. Okobua ndɛen turoloo kɔyɛ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ wɔ aseɛ ne aso.

english_verse: As long as he is king, Israel will have peace, and Judah will be safe. The name of this king will be “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: Na ye aberɛ so, Yuda konya ye ti kodidi nu, na Yisrael kɔtena asomdwee nu. Na ye dumaa bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔfrɛ ye ole ‘AWURADE YƐ TENENEE.’

english_verse: A time will come when you will again worship me. But you will no longer call me the Living God who rescued Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: “Yiti tie, mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba, bɔ bɛngɔhã ye ko kyɛ, ‘AWURADE bɔ ɔyele Yisraelfoɛ fili Misraim aseɛ so wale ne, kyɛ ɔte ase ye,’

english_verse: Instead, you will call me the Living God who rescued you from the land in the north and from all the other countries where I had forced you to go. And you will once again live in your own land. Jeremiah Thinks about Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: na mmom bɛkɔhã kyɛ, ‘AWURADE bɔ ɔyele Yisrael awuro ama, ná olili bɛ nyunu fili sorɔ dɔ maen ne anu ne maen amukoraa bɔ mvoane bɛ ngonguale so ne, kyɛ ɔte ase ye.’ Na afei bɛkɔtena bɛ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ so.” Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ ne asɔfo ngondombofoɛ

english_verse: When I think of the prophets, I am shocked, and I tremble like someone drunk, because of the Lord and his sacred words.
translation_verse: Ɔnate me ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ ati, m’adwene ayɛ me basaa wɔ me nu, me mmowue nu amukoraa wosowoso me. Mayɛ kyɛ akɔnomnzaniɛ, kyɛ ebie bɔ nzaa abia ye ɔ, ɔnate AWURADE ɔne ye dwirɛ krongron ne ati.

english_verse: Those unfaithful prophets misuse their power all over the country. So God turned the pasturelands into scorching deserts. The Lord Will Punish Unfaithful Prophets
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ agyaasɛkyelɛfoɛ bayi aseɛ ne aso to; ɔnate ɛnomalɛ ne ati, aseɛ ne bɔ awuye, na ɛserɛ ne aso nekaa bɔ ngaka didi ne, berɛ ayɛ pralaa. B’atee te bɔne, na b’anwoserɛ ne ɔtte mayee.

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: You prophets and priests think so little of me, the Lord, that you even sin in my own temple!
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne ɔsɔfo bɛ munyɔ benzuro Nyameɛ; amba, m’awuro po manwu bɛ bɔne wɔ berɛ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Now I will punish you with disaster, and you will slip and fall in the darkness. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Yiti b’atee kɔyɛ bɛ kyɛ awosii nu atee bɔ so yɛ ndono ɔ, bɔ bekosumu bɛ maa bekofi ase wɔ so ɔ; ofikyɛ ngɔprapra musue ngogua bɛ so wɔ b’asohwenɛ afoɛ ne anu, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The prophets in Samaria were repulsive to me, because they preached in the name of Baal and led my people astray.
translation_verse: Nwuni nikyee bie bɔ ɔte ngwaseasɛm ɔ wɔ Samaria ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ anwo. Bɛfale Baal bɛhyɛle ngɔm, na bɛmane me maen Yisrael lili makyebu.

english_verse: And you prophets in Jerusalem are even worse. You're unfaithful in marriage and never tell the truth. You even lead others to sin instead of helping them turn back to me. You and the people of Jerusalem are evil like Sodom and Gomorrah.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yerusalem ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nwo koso, manwu nikyee bie bɔ ɔte anwodwiri ɔ: bɛsɛkye agyaa, yeɛ bɛpɛ ngondombo; bɛhyɛ bɔnefoɛ nguraen, maa ɔnate so ebiala ɔnzakyera mvi ye bɔne nwo; bɛ mukoraa bayɛ me nye so kyɛ Sodom; na nu ama koso bayɛ kyɛ Gomora.

english_verse: You prophets in Jerusalem have spread evil everywhere. That's why I, the Lord, promise to give you bitter poison to eat and drink. The Lord Gives a Warning The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ Asafo AWURADE kã fa ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ nwo ɛhe, “Tie, abɔwee yeɛ ngɔfa ngɔma bɛ maa bekoli ɔ; na ngɔma bɛ nzue bɔ ɛborɔ wɔ nu ɔ maa bɛkɔno, ofikyɛ Yerusalem ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ, bɛ bra fiɛ ne, wato wapete aseɛ ne aso amukoraa.”

english_verse: Don't listen to the lies of these false prophets, you people of Judah! The message they preach is something they imagined; it did not come from me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Bɔ Asafo AWURADE kã ɛhe: Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛhyɛ ngɔm bekyire ɛmɔ ne, nnɛma ɛmɔtie bɛ, na bɛlakalaka ɛmɔ. Bɛbɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti anu bɛkã nyekyire bɔ nna AWURADE noa dwirɛ ahɔ ɔ.

english_verse: These prophets go to people who refuse to respect me and who are stubborn and do whatever they please. The prophets tell them, “The Lord has promised everything will be fine.”
translation_verse: Bɛkɔ so bɛkã bekyire bɛ bɔ bebu me animtia ne kyɛ AWURADE nwa nyoo, ‘Ɛmɔkonya asomdwee’; na bɛkã bekyire ebiala bɔ odi ye ti piri ɔyɛ asoserɛ ne kyɛ, ‘Musue biala ngɔto ɛmɔ.’ ”

english_verse: But I, the Lord, tell you that these prophets have never attended a meeting of my council in heaven or heard me speak.
translation_verse: Na nwa yeɛ ɔne AWURADE batu agyina, bɔ ɔnate so wanwu ye dwirɛ ne ná wate ɔ? Nwa yeɛ wayɛ asoɛ wama ye dwirɛ ná wate ɔ?

english_verse: They are evil! So in my anger I will strike them like a violent storm.
translation_verse: Nea! AWURADE mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ne otu! Ɛyaa piri afite awa, mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo bɔ otu serɛserɛ ɔ; na okoofĩ bɔnefoɛ bɛ ti so serɛserɛ.

english_verse: I won't calm down, until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday you will understand exactly what I mean.
translation_verse: AWURADE ɛyaafɛlɛ ne ngɔhwe ngosa kɔpem kyɛ okoyie bɔ ɔyɔ ɔ, kɔpem kyɛ wayɔ bɔ wadwene ye nwo wɔ ye ti anu ɔ. Na ngyẽa bɔ oli nziɛ ne anu, ɛmɔkɔte ye bo yé paa.

english_verse: I did not send these prophets or speak to them, but they ran to find you and to preach their message.
translation_verse: Nnzomane sɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ, nakoso bele amirika; nngane edwirɛ nngyirele bɛ, nakoso bɛhyɛle ngɔm.

english_verse: If they had been in a meeting of my council in heaven, they would have told you people of Judah to give up your sins and come back to me.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ bɛmaa me ne bɛ yɛtuli agyina, yeɛ sɛ bɛmane me maen bɛtele me dwirɛ a, ahaa bɛmaa bɛsesane befili b’atee tɛɛ ne aso, ɔne bɛ bɔne yɔleɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: in heaven and on earth. There are no secret places where you can hide from me.
translation_verse: Aso ebie kɔhora kɔfea wɔ mvealeɛ nu bɔ mengonwu ye ɔ? AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Aso menyi nyameɛso ne aseɛ so tɛkyɛ anaa? AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim that I have given them a dream or a vision, and then they tell lies in my name.
translation_verse: Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛfa me dumaa bedi ngɔndorɔ ne, mate bɔ bɛkekã ɔ. Bɛnwa, ‘Mahye laleɛ, mahye laleɛ!’

english_verse: But everything they say comes from their own twisted minds. How long can this go on?
translation_verse: Ɔkwaadwu kyinzu yeɛ ɛhe kɔtena ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bedi ngɔndorɔ nemɔ bɛ ti anu ɔ? Amba, bɛte ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛbɔ bɛ ti anu bɛkekã nnakannaka dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: They tell each other their dreams and try to get my people to reject me, just as their ancestors left me and worshiped Baal.
translation_verse: Bɛ laleɛ mɔ bɔ bɛkekã bekyire bɛ nwo bɛ nwo nemɔ, bɛdwene kyɛ bɛkɔfa so bɛkɔma me maen ye wora kofi me dumaa, kyɛbɔ bɛ nana mɔ mane bɛ wora fili me dumaa bɛɛsole Baal ne.

english_verse: Their dreams and my truth are as different as straw and wheat. But when prophets speak for me, they must say only what I have told them.
translation_verse: Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ bɔ wahye laleɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔfa laleɛ ne to dwaa, na bɔ mafa me dwirɛ matua ye noa ne koso, odi kyɛ ɔkã me dwirɛ ne nahorɛ nu. Nzikyɛ ngitahoɛ yeɛ ɔla afafu ne atokoɔ b’afia ɔ? AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: My words are a powerful fire; they are a hammer that shatters rocks.
translation_verse: Me dwirɛ ne, aso ɔtte kyɛ see? AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Anaa ɔtte kyɛ bɔsobaka bɔ obubu nyɔbotaen nu ɔ?

english_verse: These unfaithful prophets claim I give them their dreams, but it isn't true. I didn't choose them to be my prophets, and yet they babble on and on, speaking in my name, while stealing words from each other. And when my people hear these liars, they are led astray instead of being helped. So I warn you that I am now the enemy of these prophets. I, the Lord, have spoken. News and Nuisance The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Tie, me nye sa bɛ bɔ begyina ngondombo laleɛ so bɛhyɛ ngɔm bɛkekã bekyire mmenia ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne; na bɛfa bɛ ngondombo ne bɛ suban tɛɛ so bɛma me maen di makyebu, wɔ aberɛ bɔ nnzomane bɛ, anaa mmvale ahyɛdeɛ mmmane bɛ ɔ. Yiti bɛ nwo ngɔwa mvasoɛ biala ngɔma maen he, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Jeremiah, when a prophet or a priest or anyone else comes to you and asks, “Does the Lord have news for us?” tell them, “You people are a nuisance to the Lord, and he will get rid of you.”
translation_verse: Sɛ sɔ maen ye, anaa ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne, anaa ɔsɔfo bie bisa wɔ kyɛ, ‘AWURADE ye adesoa ne ole nzu?’ a, ye de kã kyire bɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔte adesoa ne ɔ, na ngogyi ɛmɔ ngɔto, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.’

english_verse: If any of you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” I will punish you and your families, even if you are a prophet or a priest.
translation_verse: Na ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ, ɔsɔfo ne maen bɔ ɔkɔhã kyɛ, ‘AWURADE adesoa ne’, ngɔhwe sɔ sona ne ɔne ye awuro ama bɛ so.

english_verse: Instead, you must ask your friends and relatives, “What answer did the Lord give?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Yiti odi kyɛ ebiala obisa obiɛngo, ná ebiala obisa oliɛma kyɛ, ‘Nzikyɛ mmuayɛɛ yeɛ AWURADE ama ɔ?’ anaakyɛ ‘Nzikyɛ yeɛ AWURADE wahã ɔ?’

english_verse: It seems that you each have your own news! So if you say, “Here is news from the Lord,” you are twisting my words into a lie. Remember that I am your God, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE adesoa ne de, nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ noa bɛbɔ sɔ dwirɛ ne aso ko, ofikyɛ ebiala ye noa dwirɛ kɔkakyi ye adesoa; ofikyɛ ɛmɔasesã Nyameɛ teasefoɛ, Asafo AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ye noa dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: If you go to a prophet, it's all right to ask, “What answer did the Lord give to my question?” or “What has the Lord said?”
translation_verse: Yiti bisa ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne kyɛ, ‘Nzikyɛ mmuayɛɛ yeɛ AWURADE ama wɔ ɔ?’ anaakyɛ ‘Nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ AWURADE ahã ɔ?’

english_verse: I will pick you up and throw you far away. And I will abandon this city of Jerusalem that I gave to your ancestors.
translation_verse: yiti tie, me, me wora kofi ɛmɔ bɔkɔɔ, na ngɔpo ɛmɔ ne kuro bɔ mva mane ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ nana mɔ ne, na ngɔfoa ɛmɔ ngofi me nyunu.
