english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in a vision after King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia had come to Judah and taken King Jehoiachin, his officials, and all the skilled workers back to Babylonia. In this vision I saw two baskets of figs in front of the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa hyele Yekonia bɔ ye baba ole Yuda hene Yehoakim, ɔne Yuda mbanyi, adwiililɛfoɛ ne dwumvoɛ mɔ nnure fale bɛ fili Yerusalem hɔle Babilɔn. Ye si ye, AWURADE lale nyekyire ali hyirele me, na nwuni borɔdoma ngɛndɛen nyɔ bɔ begyigyi AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anyunu ɔ.

english_verse: One basket was full of very good figs that ripened early, and the other was full of rotten figs that were not fit to eat.
translation_verse: Né borɔdoma paa paa bɔ ɔte kyɛ borɔdoma bɔ bali moa bate ɔ wɔ kɛndɛen ko anu; nakoso kɛndɛen ko ne de, borɔdoma bɔ ɔtte mayee koraa bɔ bedi a ɔnyɛ yé yeɛ ɔwɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: “Jeremiah,” the Lord asked, “what do you see?” “Figs,” I said. “Some are very good, but the others are too rotten to eat.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bisale me kyɛ, “Yeremia, bɔ enwu ye e, nzikyɛ ɛne?” Na mmuale kyɛ, “Borɔdoma ɔ. Borɔdoma paa nemɔ, ɔte paa paa, yeɛ borɔdoma bɔ ɔtte mayee nemɔ, ɔtte mayee koraa bɔ bedi ɔnyɛ yé ɔ.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE sa lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ,

english_verse: People of Judah, the good figs stand for those of you I sent away as exiles to Babylonia,
translation_verse: “AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Bɛ bɔ bahye bɛ nnure bafi Yuda, bɔ maye bɛ mafi ɛwa mahɔ Kaldeafoɛ aseɛ so ne, ngobu bɛ kyɛ bɛte paa kyɛ borɔdoma paa hemɔ.

english_verse: where I am watching over them. Then someday I will bring them back to this land. I will plant them, instead of uprooting them, and I will build them up, rather than tearing them down.
translation_verse: Bɛ yeeyɛlɛ ti, ngɔma me nye kɔhɔ bɛ nwo, na ngosa ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa aseɛ he aso. Ngɔmaa bɛ bo kotimu, na mengɔma bɛngɔtɔ ase. Ngolua bɛ, na mengotutu bɛ bo.

english_verse: I will give them a desire to know me and to be my people. They will want me to be their God, and they will turn back to me with all their heart.
translation_verse: Na ngɔma bɛ nimdeɛ bɔ ɔkɔmaa bekonwu me kyɛ me ole AWURADE ɔ. Bɛkɔyɛ me maen, ná me wora mayɛ bɛ Nyameɛ, ofikyɛ bɛkɔfa b’ahone amukoraa bekosa bɛkɔwa me berɛ.

english_verse: The rotten figs stand for King Zedekiah of Judah, his officials, and all the others who were not taken away to Babylonia, whether they stayed here in Judah or went to live in Egypt.
translation_verse: “Nakoso AWURADE nwa nyoo: Kyɛbɔ borɔdoma bɔ ɔtte mayee, bɔ bedi a ɔnyɛ yé ne ɔte ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ngobu Yuda hene Sedekia ɔne ye mbanyi ne Yerusalemfoɛ ngaa bɔ bɛkɔha aseɛ he aso ne, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛte Misraim aseɛ so ne ɔ.

english_verse: I will punish them with a terrible disaster, and everyone on earth will tremble when they hear about it. I will force the people of Judah to go to foreign countries, where they will be cursed and insulted.
translation_verse: Na ngɔyakyi bɛ maa bɛkɔsoa bɛ bɛkɔhɔ aseɛ ye aso ahennie amukoraa so maa bekonwu amaneɛ, na ngɔmaa bɛkɔkakyi animguaseɛ nikye, anyandera dwirɛ, ngorohoɛ nikye ne ɛnomalɛ nikye wɔ nekaa amukoraa bɔ ngɔfoa bɛ ngoogua ne.

english_verse: War and hunger and disease will strike them, until they finally disappear from the land that I gave them and their ancestors.
translation_verse: Na ngɔsoma ngrandɛ, ɛhɔen ne ewue anwonyerɛ maa bɛkɔhɔ bɛ so, kɔpem kyɛ bɛ boso konua bɔkɔɔ kofi aseɛ bɔ mva mane bɛ ne bɛ nana mɔ ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has sent prophets to you time after time, but you refused to listen.
translation_verse: Na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ AWURADE hɔle so somane ye somvoɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ amukoraa maa bɛwale ɛmɔ berɛ de, nakoso ɛmɔandie, yeɛ ɛmɔanyɛ asoɛ bandie.

english_verse: They told you that the Lord had said: Change your ways! If you stop doing evil, I will let you stay forever in this land that I gave your ancestors.
translation_verse: Bɛhane kyɛ, ‘Odi kyɛ ɛmɔ anu biala sakyera ye adwene fi ye bɔne atee ne ye bɔne yɔleɛ nwo, ná ɛmɔtena aseɛ bɔ AWURADE fa mane ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ nana mɔ fi tete ne aso afebɔɔ.

english_verse: I don't want to harm you. So don't make me angry by worshiping idols and other gods.
translation_verse: Na onni kyɛ ɛmɔkodi nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ asi bɛso bɛ bɛsɔne bɛ; yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ sa noa adwuma behu m’ahone maa mefɛ yaa, amaa ɔnate so mambrapra amaneɛ mangua ɛmɔ so.’

english_verse: But you refused to listen to my prophets. So I, the Lord, say that you have made me angry by worshiping idols, and you are the ones who were hurt by what you did.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔandie me dwirɛ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Na ɛmɔafa ɛmɔ sa noa adwuma bahu m’ahone maa mafɛ yaa bɔ wakakyi ɛmɔ so amaneɛnwunɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You refused to listen to me,
translation_verse: “Yiti Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔandie me dwirɛ ne ati,

english_verse: and now I will let you be attacked by nations from the north, and especially by my servant, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia. You and other nearby nations will be destroyed and left in ruins forever. Everyone who sees what has happened will be shocked, but they will still make fun of you.
translation_verse: yiti ɛ́mɔtie, ngɔsoma maa bɛkɔɔfa sorɔ dɔ mmusua amukoraa ne me somvoɛ Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa bɛkɔwa, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, na ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa maa bɛkɔho bekotia maen he, ɔne so ama, ɔne maen hemɔ amukoraa bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia ɔ. Ngohũhũ bɛ pasaa, ná mamaa bayɛ anwodwiri nikye, maen bɔ mmenia sobi bɛ noa gua bɛ so ɔ, ɔne kurofoen afebɔɔ.

english_verse: I will put an end to your parties and wedding celebrations; no one will grind grain or be here to light the lamps at night.
translation_verse: Asa koso, ngotu ɛhemɔ bo ngofi bɛ berɛ: anigye dwein nwo nga, ahurusililɛ nwo nga, atɔmvorɛ biaa nwo nga, atɔmvorɛ braa nwo nga, nyɔkoa nga, yeɛ kaneatalɛ.

english_verse: This country will be as empty as a desert, because I will make all of you the slaves of the king of Babylonia for
translation_verse: Aseɛ ne amukoraa kɔkakyi kurofoen ne anwodwiri nikye, na maen maen hemɔ, bɛkɔso Babilɔn hene afoɛ aburasoo.

english_verse: When that time is up, I will punish the king of Babylonia and his people for everything they have done wrong, and I will turn that country into a wasteland forever.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, afoɛ aburasoo ne asi ne, Babilɔn hene ne sɔ maen ne bɔ ɔte Kaldeafoɛ b’aseɛ ne, ngɔhwe bɛ so, ɔnate b’amumuyɛɛ ti, na ngɔma aseɛ ne kɔyɛ kurofoen afebɔɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: My servant Jeremiah has told you what I said I will do to Babylonia and to the other nations, and he wrote it all down in this book. I will do everything I threatened.
translation_verse: Na me dwirɛ amukoraa bɔ mahã matia sɔ aseɛ ye, bɔ bahyerɛ ye mukoraa wɔ nwomaa he anu, bɔ Yeremia fa hyɛle ngɔm tiale maen maen mukoraa ne, ngɔmaa ɔkɔwa sɔ maen ne aso.

english_verse: I will pay back the Babylonians for every wrong they have done. Great kings from many other nations will conquer the Babylonians and force them to be slaves. The Cup Full of God's Anger
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ maen maen mɔ pee ne ahemvo atitire kɔfa bɛ kɔyɛ ngoaa. Na ngotua bɛ so kerɛ kyɛbɔ bɛ yɔleɛ ne bɛ sa noa adwuma te ɔ.” Nyameɛ afɛ maen maen mɔ so yaa

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel showed me a vision in which he said, “Jeremiah, here is a cup filled with the wine of my anger. Take it and make every nation drink some.
translation_verse: AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ sele me kyɛ, “Ɛyaafɛlɛ nzaa kwangoa he bɔ otira me sa nu ye, de, ná ma maen amukoraa bɔ ngɔsoma wɔ bɛ berɛ ne bɛno.

english_verse: They will vomit and act crazy, because of the war this cup of anger will bring to them.”
translation_verse: Bɛkɔno bɛkɔnate fofalifofali ná babobɔ laen, ɔnate ngrandɛ bɔ mésoma ye bɛ nu ne ati.”

english_verse: I took the cup from the Lord's hand, and I went to the kings of the nations and made each of them drink some.
translation_verse: Yiti nnele kwangoa ne wɔ AWURADE sa nu, na mmane maen maen amukoraa bɔ AWURADE somane me bɛ berɛ ne bɛnone.

english_verse: I started with Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and the king and his officials were removed from power in disgrace. Everyone still makes insulting jokes about them and uses their names as curse words.
translation_verse: Bɛ ɛhe: Yerusalem ne Yuda nguro, nu ahemvo ne nu nnehyeɛ, kyɛ bɛyɛ kurofoen, anwodwiri nikye, bɔ mmenia besobi bɛ noa gua bɛ so ɔ, ɔne ɛnomalɛ nikye, kyɛbɔ ɔte ɛnɛ ye;

english_verse: and all the foreigners who lived in the country. Next I went to the king of Uz, and then to the four kings of Philistia, who ruled from Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron, and what was left of Ashdod.
translation_verse: ne amanvrafoɛ amukoraa, Yuse aseɛ so ahemvo amukoraa, Filisti aseɛ so ahemvo amukoraa, yeɛ Asekelɔn, Gasa, Ekron ne Asedɔde ngaa ne;

english_verse: and to the kings of Tyre, Sidon, and their colonies across the sea.
translation_verse: Tiro ahemvo amukoraa, Sidon ahemvo amukoraa ne supɔ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ ɛpo asi ne b’ahemvo,

english_verse: After this, I went to the kings of Dedan, Tema, Buz, the tribes of the Arabian Desert,
translation_verse: Arabia ahemvo amukoraa, amanvrafoɛ bɔ bɛtete ɛserɛ so ɔ, b’ahemvo amukoraa;

english_verse: and the countries in the north, both near and far. I went to all the countries on earth, one after another, and finally to Babylonia.
translation_verse: sorɔ dɔ ahemvo amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ dede ne bɛ bɔ bepingye ɔ bɛ nu biala, yeɛ wiase ahennie amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ ye aso ɔ. Na ɛhemɔ asi ne, Sesake hene koso kɔno bie.

english_verse: The Lord had said to tell each king, “The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, commands you to drink from this cup that is full of the wine of his anger. It will make you so drunk that you will vomit. And when the Lord sends war against the nations, you will be completely defeated.”
translation_verse: “Na ekose bɛ kyɛ, ‘Asafo AWURADE, Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ɛ́mɔno ná ɛ́mɔbobo, ná ɛ́mɔfefe béfifi ase bɔ ɛmɔngodwɔso ko ɔ, ɔnate ngrandɛ bɔ ngɔfa ngɔwa ɛmɔ nu ne ati.’

english_verse: The Lord told me that if any of them refused to drink from the cup, I must tell them that he had said, “I, the Lord All-Powerful, command you to drink.
translation_verse: “Na sɛ bambene so kyɛ bekole kwangoa bɔ otira wɔ sa nu ne bɛkɔno a, ye de se bɛ kyɛ, ‘Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔno!

english_verse: Starting with my own city of Jerusalem, everyone on earth will suffer from war. So there is no way I will let you escape unharmed.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, tie, kuro bɔ me dumaa la so ne yeɛ médi moa meprapra musue megua ye so ɔ, na ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔkɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bekoli tɔtorɔtɔɔ anaa? Ɛmɔngɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bengoli tɔtorɔtɔɔ, ofikyɛ mebaasoma ngrandɛ meba aseɛ so ama amukoraa so, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.’

english_verse: The Lord told me to say: From my sacred temple I will roar like thunder, while I trample my people and everyone else as though they were grapes.
translation_verse: “Yiti, fa sɔ dwirɛ hemɔ amukoraa hyɛ ngɔm tia bɛ, ná se bɛ kyɛ, ‘AWURADE kofi anwuro anwuro kɔbobɔ nu, na ɔkɔtea nu kofi ye atenaleɛ krongron ne anu berɛ; ɔkɔbobɔ nu serɛserɛ kogua ye atenaleɛ so, na ɔkɔtea nu kyɛ bɛ bɔ bétwi bobe ɔ kogua aseɛ ye aso ama amukoraa so.

english_verse: My voice will be heard everywhere on earth, accusing nations of their crimes and sentencing the guilty to death. Disaster Is Coming
translation_verse: Dedeyɛlɛ ne kɔtrɛ kɔɔhã aseɛ noa dɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE abɔ maen maen mɔ kwaadu; okobua anwoɔnaen amukoraa ndɛen, na ɔkɔma bɔnefoɛ mɔ bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.’

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: You can see disaster spreading from far across the earth, from nation to nation like a horrible storm.
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Tie, musue piri ne ɔkɔtrɛ kofi maen so koodwu maen so, na mvrama piri bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ne okotu kofi aseɛ ne noa dɔ mɔ paa!

english_verse: When it strikes, I will kill so many people that their bodies will cover the ground like manure. No one will be left to bury them or to mourn. The Leaders of Judah Will Be Punished
translation_verse: “Na bɛ bɔ AWURADE kohũhũ bɛ sɔ kyẽa ne, bɛkɔsamo berɛ kofi aseɛ noa kɔkã ye noa. Bengosu bɛ, bɛngɔboaboa bɛ noa, yeɛ bengosie bɛ, na bɛkɔkakyi fofoɛ wɔ aseɛ so.

english_verse: The Lord's people are his flock, and you leaders were the shepherds. But now it's your turn to be butchered like sheep. You'll shatter like fine pottery dropped on the floor. So roll on the ground, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔ, mmoaenneafoɛ, ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye ná ɛ́mɔsu; mmoaen kure nemɔ so atitire mɔ, ɛ́mɔmunumunu ɛmɔ nwo wɔ nzoen nu, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ hunɛ ne ɛmɔ ayabɔlɛ ngyẽa ne wadwu, na ɛmɔkowuwu kyɛ mmoaen nyii bɔ balɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Listen to the cries of the shepherds, as the Lord's burning anger turns peaceful meadows into barren deserts.
translation_verse: Na asomdwee atenaleɛ nemɔ asɛkye pasaa, ɔnate AWURADE ɛyaafɛlɛ piri ne ati.

english_verse: Like a lion leaving its den, the Lord has abandoned his people to the destruction of war.
translation_verse: Wafi ye dabea kyɛ gyata; ofikyɛ bɛ maen ne akakyi kurofoen ɔnate pɔfoɛ ngrandɛ ne, ɔne ye ɛyaafɛlɛ piri ne ati.”

english_verse: The priests, the prophets, and everyone else in the temple heard what I said,
translation_verse: Yiti asɔfo nemɔ ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ ne maen ne amukoraa bɛtele kyɛ Yeremia ɔkã sɔ dwirɛ ne wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Soon after Jehoiakim became king of Judah, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Yehoakim bɔ ɔte Yuda hene Yosia awa ne, ye ahennie n’ahyɛaseɛ ne, AWURADE lale sɔ dwirɛ he ali kyɛ,

english_verse: But if you put me to death, you and everyone else in Jerusalem will be guilty of murdering an innocent man, because everything I preached came from the Lord.
translation_verse: Na mmom, ɛ́mɔnwu ye kyɛ amba, sɛ ɛmɔku me a, mogya bɔ odi be ɔ yeɛ ɛmɔkɔmaa ɔkɔbɔ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ deinn, kuro he ɔne nu ama bɛ ti so ɔ. Ofikyɛ nahorɛ nu, AWURADE yeɛ ɔsomane me ɛmɔ berɛ kyɛ mmanga sɔ dwirɛ ye amukoraa ngyire ɛmɔ maa ɔhɔ ɛmɔ so anu ɔ.”

english_verse: Jeremiah, I have a message for everyone who comes from the towns of Judah to worship in my temple. Go to the temple courtyard and speak every word that I tell you.
translation_verse: “AWURADE nwa nyoo: Gyina AWURADE awuro n’aluo berɛ, ná dwudwo kyire Yuda nguro nemɔ amukoraa bɔ bɛba AWURADE awuro berɛ bɛbasɔne ne. Na edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ mahyɛ wɔ kyɛ ɛhã hyire bɛ ne, kã kyire bɛ; nnɛye ko po fi nu.

english_verse: Maybe the people will listen this time. And if they stop doing wrong, I will change my mind and not punish them for their sins.
translation_verse: Ebiaa bekotie, ná ebiala wahwe ye nwo wafi ye bɔne atee nwo, amaa ɔnate so amaneɛ bɔ ɔnate bɛ bɔne yɔleɛ ti madwene ye nwo kyɛ ngɔprapra ngogua bɛ so ne, masesã m’adwene wɔ ye nwo.

english_verse: Tell them that I have said: You have refused to listen to me and to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Kã kyire bɛ kyɛ, ‘AWURADE nwa nyoo: Sɛ ɛmɔanyɛ sotie bamma me banni me mmeraa bɔ mahyehyɛ mama ɛmɔ ne aso,

english_verse: Again and again I have sent my servants the prophets to preach to you, but you ignored them as well. Now I am warning you that if you don't start obeying me at once,
translation_verse: ná ɛmɔandie me somvoɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɔ ngɔle so nzomane bɛ ɛmɔ berɛ ne bɛ noa dwirɛ, bɔ yeɛ ɛmɔandie ne,

english_verse: I will destroy this temple, just as I destroyed the town of Shiloh. Then everyone on earth will use the name “Jerusalem” as a curse word. Jeremiah on Trial
translation_verse: ye de, ngɔyɛ awuro he kyɛ Silo, na ngɔma kuro he kɔyɛ ɛnomalɛ nikyee ngɔma aseɛ ye aso maen maen amukoraa.’ ”

english_verse: and as soon as I finished, they all crowded around me and started shouting, “Why did you preach that the Lord will destroy this temple, just as he destroyed Shiloh? Why did you say that Jerusalem will be empty and lie in ruins? You ought to be put to death for saying such things in the Lord's name!” Then they had me arrested.
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ afa AWURADE dumaa ahyɛ ngɔm kyɛ, ‘Awuro he kɔyɛ kyɛ Silo, ná kuro ye koso kɔyɛ kurofoen, bɔ ebiala ngɔtena so ɔ’?” Na mmenia ne amukoraa bɛpɛle Yeremia nwo beyiale wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ.

english_verse: The royal officers heard what had happened, and they came from the palace to the new gate of the temple to be the judges at my trial.
translation_verse: Na Yuda mbanyi tele sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ nen, befili ahemvie berɛ bɛwale AWURADE awuro berɛ, na bɛtenatenane AWURADE awuro Anoa Foforɛ ne anu berɛ.

english_verse: While they listened, the priests and the prophets said to the crowd, “All of you have heard Jeremiah prophesy that Jerusalem will be destroyed. He deserves the death penalty.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ asɔfo nemɔ ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ besele mbanyi nemɔ ne maen ne amukoraa kyɛ, “Sɔ akoaa he, ɔfata kyɛ beku ye ɔ, ofikyɛ wahyɛ ngɔm watia kuro ye, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔate ne.”

english_verse: Then I told the judges and everyone else: The Lord himself sent me to tell you about the terrible things he will do to you, to Jerusalem, and to the temple. But if you change your ways and start obeying the Lord, he will change his mind.
translation_verse: Yiti kekesaala ye, ɛ́mɔsakyera ɛmɔ adwene ne ɛmɔ yɔleɛ, ná ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, na AWURADE kɔsesã ye adwene wɔ musue bɔ wahã kyɛ ɔkɔprapra kogua ɛmɔ so ne anwo.

english_verse: You must decide what to do with me. Just do whatever you think is right.
translation_verse: Na me mmom de, ɛ́mɔtie, nwɔ ɛmɔ sa nu. Bɔ ɔte paa ná ɔtengyɛ wɔ ɛmɔ nye so ne, ɛ́mɔfa beli me.

english_verse: The judges and the other people told the priests and prophets, “Since Jeremiah only told us what the Lord our God had said, we don't think he deserves to die.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ mbanyi nemɔ ne maen ne amukoraa besele asɔfo nemɔ ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Biaa he, ɔmvata kyɛ beku ye ɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ dumaa nu yeɛ ogyi bɔ wadwudwo wahyire yɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Then some of the leaders from other towns stepped forward. They told the crowd that
translation_verse: Yeɛ aseɛ ne aso mbanyi nemɔ bie bedwɔsole, na besele maen badwa ne amukoraa kyɛ,

english_verse: years ago when Hezekiah was king of Judah, a prophet named Micah from the town of Moresheth had said: “I, the Lord All-Powerful, say Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.”
translation_verse: “Moreseteniɛ Mika hyɛle ngɔm wɔ Yuda hene Hesekia aberɛ so, na osele Yudafoɛ amukoraa kyɛ, ‘Bɔ Asafo AWURADE kã ɛhe: Bekofundam Sion kyɛ eboo, Yerusalem kɔkakyi esire esire, na bokaa bɔ awuro ne gyi so ne, ɔkakyi ɛhɔayeɛ.’

english_verse: Then the leaders continued: No one put Micah to death for saying that. Instead, King Hezekiah prayed to the Lord with fear and trembling and asked him to have mercy. Then the Lord decided not to destroy Jerusalem, even though he had already said he would. People of Judah, if Jeremiah is killed, we will bring a terrible disaster on ourselves.
translation_verse: Aso Yuda hene Hesekia ne Yudafoɛ amukoraa behuni ye anaa? Aso wanzuro AWURADE, yeɛ aso wanzrɛ AWURADE kyɛ ɔlo ye, maa ɔnate so AWURADE wanzesã ye adwene wɔ musue bɔ ɔhane kyɛ ɔkɔprapra kogua bɛ so ne anwo anaa? Nakoso yɛ de, musue piri paa yeɛ ɛmɔmaa yɛtwetwe yɛbrɛ yɛ nwo ɔ!”

english_verse: Not long after Zedekiah became king of Judah, the Lord told me: Jeremiah, make a wooden yoke with leather straps, and place it on your neck.
translation_verse: Bɔ AWURADE sele me ɛhe, “Fa nyamaa ne mmakaa yɔ kɔnnua ná fa to wɔ kɔme.

english_verse: Then send a message to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon. Some officials from these countries are in Jerusalem, meeting with Zedekiah.
translation_verse: Na fa ma ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ bɔ bawa Yuda hene Sedekia berɛ wɔ Yerusalem ne maa bɛɛfa bɛma Edom hene, Moabo hene, Amonfoɛ hene, Tiro hene ne Sidon hene.

english_verse: So have them tell their kings that I have said: I am the All-Powerful Lord God of Israel,
translation_verse: Fa ahyɛdeɛ ma bɛ maa bɛɛhã behyire bɛ mene nemɔ kyɛ, ‘Asafo AWURADE, Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ɛ́mɔhã behyire ɛmɔ mene nemɔ kyɛ,

english_verse: and with my power I created the earth, its people, and all animals. I decide who will rule the earth,
translation_verse: “Me yeɛ mvale me tumi piri ne me tumi asaa mmɔle aseɛ, so mmenia ne so ngaka ɔ, na mefa mema ebiala bɔ me bɔbɔ mekuro ɔ.

english_verse: and I have chosen my servant King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to rule all nations, including yours. I will even let him rule the wild animals. All nations will be slaves of Nebuchadnezzar, his son, and his grandson. Then many nations will join together, and their kings will make slaves of the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Na maen maen amukoraa kɔso ye ne ɔwa ne ye anomaa, kɔpem kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ mahyehyɛ kyɛ ye maen ne ɔbra ayieleɛ ne okodwu ɔ; na afei maen maen pee ne ahemvo atitire kɔmaa ɔkɔso bɛ.

english_verse: This yoke stands for the power of King Nebuchadnezzar, and I will destroy any nation that refuses to obey him. Nebuchadnezzar will attack, and many will die in battle or from hunger and disease.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɛ maen bie anaa ahennie bie yɛ kyɛ ɔngɔso sɔ Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa, ná ɔngɔfa ye kɔme ngowura Babilɔn hene kɔnnua ne anu a, ye de ngɔfa ngrandɛ, ɛhɔen ne ewue anwonyerɛ ngɔhwe sɔ maen ne aso, kɔpem kyɛ ngɔfa ye so ngɔbɔ sɔ maen ne tɔɔ ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: You might have people in your kingdom who claim they can tell the future by magic or by talking with the dead or by dreams or messages from a god. But don't pay attention if any of them tell you not to obey Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Yiti, nnɛma ɛmɔtie ɛmɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ, ɛmɔ ahɔmeɛ, ɛmɔ mmenia bɔ bekyirekyire laleɛ bo, ɛmɔ ngonyaayelɛfoɛ, anaa ɛmɔ musueyelɛfoɛ bɔ bɛkekã bekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔngɔso Babilɔn hene’ ne.

english_verse: If you listen to such lies, I will have you dragged far from your country and killed.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngɔndorɔ yeɛ bedi bekyire ɛmɔ ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ bekotu ɛmɔ bo bekofi ɛmɔ aseɛ so maa ɛmɔkɔhɔ dedeede ɔ; kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ngɔfoa ɛmɔ ngofi ɛwa maa ɛmɔkowuwu ɔ.

english_verse: But if you and your nation are willing to obey Nebuchadnezzar, I will let you stay in your country, and your people will continue to live and work on their farms.
translation_verse: Nakoso maen biala bɔ ɔkɔfa ye kɔme kowura Babilɔn hene kɔnnua ne anu ná ɔkɔso ye ne, ngɔmaa ɔkɔha ye bɔbɔ ye aseɛ so, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Na bɛkɔyɔ so adwuma bɛkɔtena so.’ ”

english_verse: After I had spoken to the officials from the nearby kingdoms, I went to King Zedekiah and told him the same thing. Then I said: Zedekiah, if you and the people of Judah want to stay alive, you must obey Nebuchadnezzar and the Babylonians.
translation_verse: Sɔ dwirɛ ne amukoraa yeɛ nga ngyirele Yuda hene Sedekia ɔ. Ngane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ kɔme bewura Babilɔn hene ye kɔnnua ne anu, ná ɛ́mɔso ye ne ye maen, amaa ɛmɔanya ɛmɔ ti badidi nu.

english_verse: But if you refuse, then you and your people will die from war, hunger, and disease, just as the Lord has warned.
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛne wɔ maen bewuwu wɔ ngrandɛ, ɛhɔen ne ewue anwonyerɛ noa, kyɛbɔ AWURADE wahã wafa maen biala bɔ ɔngɔso Babilɔn hene nwo ne ɔ?

english_verse: Your prophets have told you that you don't need to obey Nebuchadnezzar, but don't listen to their lies.
translation_verse: Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛkekã bekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ‘Nnɛma ɛmɔso Babilɔn hene’ nen, nnɛma ɛmɔtie bɛ dwirɛ, ofikyɛ ngɔndorɔ yeɛ bedi bekyire ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Those prophets claim to be speaking for the Lord, but he didn't send them. They are lying! If you do what they say, he will have both you and them dragged off to another country and killed. The Lord has spoken.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nnzomane bɛ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Nakoso bɛfa me dumaa bedi ngɔndorɔ. Ye sɔ ne ati, ngɔfoa ɛmɔ ngofi wa, na ɛmɔ ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bedi ngɔndorɔ bekyire ɛmɔ ne, ɛmɔkowuwu.”

english_verse: When I finished talking to the king, I told the priests and everyone else that the Lord had said: Don't listen to the prophets when they say that very soon the Babylonians will return the things they took from my temple. Those prophets are lying!
translation_verse: Yeɛ nzele asɔfo nemɔ ne maen ne amukoraa kyɛ, “AWURADE nwa nyoo: Nnɛma ɛmɔtie ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛhyɛ ngɔm bekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔtie, ɔngɔhyɛ biala, bekosa bɛkɔfa AWURADE awuro berɛ nningyein nemɔ bekofi Babilɔn bɛkɔwa’ ne, ofikyɛ bédi ngɔndorɔ bekyire ɛmɔ.

english_verse: If you choose to obey the king of Babylonia, you will live. But if you listen to those prophets, this whole city will be nothing but a pile of rubble.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔtie bɛ dwirɛ; odi kyɛ ɛmɔso Babilɔn hene, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanya ɛmɔ ti badidi nu. Nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ kuro he ɔbɔ ɔ?

english_verse: If I really had spoken to those prophets, they would know what I am going to do. Then they would be begging me not to let everything else be taken from the temple and the king's palace and the rest of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bɛte ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ amba, ná sɛ AWURADE fa bɛ so dwudwo amba de a, ye de maa bɛkoto bɛsrɛ Asafo AWURADE, amaa ɔnate so nningyein bɔ waha AWURADE awuro berɛ, Yuda hene ahemvie berɛ, ne Yerusalem ne, wangɔanni Babilɔn.

english_verse: will be taken to Babylonia, where they will remain until I decide to bring them back to Jerusalem. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔsesa bɛ bɛkɔhɔ Babilɔn, na bɛkɔha dɔ kɔpem kyẽa bɔ me nye kɔwa bɛ so ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Na ngosa ngɔfa bɛ ngoogua wa bieku.”

english_verse: Later that same year, in the fifth month of the fourth year that Zedekiah was king, the prophet Hananiah son of Azzur from Gibeon came up to me in the temple. And while the priests and others in the temple were listening,
translation_verse: Sɔ afoɛ ne anu ala, wɔ Yuda hene Sedekia ahennie n’ahyɛaseɛ ne anu, bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu wɔ afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne anu, Hanania bɔ ye baba ole ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Asure bɔ ofi Gibeon ne, osele me wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ wɔ asɔfo nemɔ ne maen ne amukoraa bɛ nyunu kyɛ,

english_verse: And within two years, I will bring back to Jerusalem everything that he took from my temple and carried off to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Kyɛ odwu afoɛ nyɔ ne, AWURADE awuro nningyein amukoraa bɔ Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa sesa fili wa hɔle Babilɔn ne, ngosa ngɔfa ngɔwa wa.

english_verse: King Jehoiachin and the other people who were taken from Judah to Babylonia will be allowed to come back here as well. All this will happen because I will smash the power of the king of Babylonia!
translation_verse: Asa koso, Yekonia bɔ ye baba ole Yuda hene Yehoakim ne, ɔne mmenia amukoraa bɔ bɛhyele bɛ nnure befili Yuda bɛhɔle Babilɔn ne, ngosa ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa wa, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, ofikyɛ kɔnnua bɔ Babilɔn hene wafa wato ɛmɔ kɔme anu ne, ngobubu nu.”

english_verse: The priests and the others were still standing there, so I said:
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yeremia dwudwo hyirele ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hanania wɔ asɔfo ne mmenia amukoraa bɔ né begyigyi AWURADE awuro berɛ ne, bɛ nyunu.

english_verse: Hananiah, I hope the Lord will do exactly what you said. I hope he does bring back everything the Babylonians took from the temple, and that our people who were taken to Babylonia will be allowed to return home.
translation_verse: Na ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yeremia sele kyɛ, “Amen! AWURADE ɔ́yɔ ye sɔ ala; ngɔm bɔ ahyɛ ye, AWURADE ɔ́ma ɔbra nu, ná osa ɔfa AWURADE awuro berɛ nningyein, ɔne mmenia bɔ bahye bɛ nnure nemɔ amukoraa ofi Babilɔn ɔbra wa.

english_verse: But let me remind you and everyone else
translation_verse: Nakoso tie edwirɛ bɔ mekã maa ɛte, ná maen ne amukoraa bɛte ne.

english_verse: that long before we were born, prophets were saying powerful kingdoms would be struck by war, disaster, and disease.
translation_verse: Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ belili me ne wɔ yɛ nyunu moa bɛhyɛle ngɔm fi daa tete ne, bɛhyɛle ngɔm kyɛ koɛ, ɛhɔen ne ewue anwonyerɛ kɔwa maen maen pee ne ahennie mbiri mbiri mɔ so.

english_verse: Now you are saying we will have peace. We will just have to wait and see if that is really what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: Na ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ bɔ ɔhyɛ ngɔm kyɛ asomdwee kɔwa ne, sɛ sɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne ye dwirɛ ne ba nu a, ye de bekonwu ye kyɛ AWURADE yeɛ wasoma sɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne amba.”

english_verse: Hananiah grabbed the wooden yoke from my neck and smashed it.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hanania, ɔyele kɔnnua ne fili ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yeremia kɔme anu, na obubuli nu.

english_verse: Then he said, “The Lord says this is the way he will smash the power Nebuchadnezzar has over the nations, and it will happen in less than two years.” I left the temple,
translation_verse: Na Hanania dwudwole wɔ maen ne amukoraa bɛ nyunu kyɛ, “AWURADE nwa nyoo: Kyɛ odwu afoɛ nyɔ ne, sɔaa yeɛ ngobubu Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa kɔnnua ne anu ngofi maen maen amukoraa bɛ kɔme anu ɔ.” Na ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yeremia sili nu hɔle.

english_verse: to go back and say to Hananiah: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel. You smashed a wooden yoke, but I will replace it with one made of iron. I will put iron yokes on all the nations, and they will have to do what King Nebuchadnezzar commands. I will even let him rule the wild animals.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Asafo AWURADE, Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Mafa buralɛ kɔnnua mato maen hemɔ amukoraa bɛ kɔme anu, kyɛ bɛso Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa, na bɛkɔso ye. Mafa eburo ngaka po mawura ye sa.’”

english_verse: I gave the letter to Elasah and Gemariah, two men that King Zedekiah of Judah was sending to Babylon to talk with Nebuchadnezzar. In the letter, I wrote
translation_verse: Ɔfa manene Elasa bɔ ye baba ole Safan, yeɛ Gyemaria bɔ ye baba ole Hilkia, bɔ Nana Sedekia somane bɛ Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa berɛ wɔ Babilɔn ne. Krataa ne anu dwirɛ ɛhe:

english_verse: that the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, had said: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. Now I tell you
translation_verse: “Mmenia amukoraa bɔ mamaa bahye bɛ nnure bafi Yerusalem bahɔ Babilɔn ne, bɔ Asafo AWURADE, Yisrael Nyameɛ kã kyire bɛ ɛhe:

english_verse: to settle there and build houses. Plant gardens and eat what you grow in them.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔsisi sua bɛtenatena nu; ɛ́mɔyɔ eboo, ná ɛmɔli nu aleɛ.

english_verse: Get married and have children, then help your sons find wives and help your daughters find husbands, so they can have children as well. I want your numbers to grow, not to get smaller.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔgyigya mmraa ná ɛ́mɔwowo mmaa mmienzua ne mmaa mmrasua; ɛ́mɔgyigya mmraa bɛ́ma ɛmɔ mma mmienzua mɔ, ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ mma mmrasua bɛmoma biaa mɔ maa bɛwowo mmaa mmienzua ne mmaa mmrasua, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔata pee wɔ dɔ, ná ɛmɔ so ande.

english_verse: Pray for peace in Babylonia and work hard to make it prosperous. The more successful that nation is, the better off you will be.
translation_verse: Na kuro bɔ mamaa bahye ɛmɔ nnure bahɔ so ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔpena ye yeeyɛlɛ, ná ɛmɔbɔ mbaeɛ bekyire AWURADE bɛma ye, ofikyɛ kuro ne yeeyɛlɛ nu, yeɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔkɔyɛ yé ɔ.

english_verse: I will bless you with a future filled with hope—a future of success, not of suffering.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mese adwene horɛ bɔ medwene mefa ɛmɔ nwo ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne; yeeyɛlɛ nwo adwene, nna bɔne adwene ɔ; kyɛ ngɔma ɛmɔkonya ayieleɛ paa ne anyelasoɛ.

english_verse: You will turn back to me and ask for help, and I will answer your prayers.
translation_verse: Afei ɛmɔkosu bɛkɔfrɛ me, ɛmɔkɔwa bɛkɔɔbɔ mbaeɛ bekohyire me, na ngotie ɛmɔ.

english_verse: You will worship me with all your heart, and I will be with you
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkɔpena me si atee, na ɛmɔkonwu me, ofikyɛ ɛmɔkɔfa ɛmɔ ahone amukoraa bɛkɔpena me si atee.

english_verse: and accept your worship. Then I will gather you from all the nations where I scattered you, and you will return to Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ngɔmaa ɛmɔkonwu me, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Ngɔye ɛmɔ ngofi nnurehyelɛ nu, na ngɔboaboa ɛmɔ noa ngofi maen amukoraa ne nekaa amukoraa bɔ mafoa ɛmɔ maagua so ne, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Ngosa ngɔfa ɛmɔ ngɔwa nekaa bɔ mamaa bahye ɛmɔ nnure bafi berɛ bahɔ ne.

english_verse: You feel secure, because you think I have sent prophets to speak for me in Babylonia.
translation_verse: “Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔahã kyɛ, ‘AWURADE asiesie ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ wama yɛ wɔ Babilɔn’ ne ati,

english_verse: I had you taken from Jerusalem to Babylonia. But you had better listen to me now.
translation_verse: Na afei, ɛmɔ bɔ bahye ɛmɔ nnure amukoraa, bɔ maye ɛmɔ mafi Yerusalem mahɔ Babilɔn ne, ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE dwirɛ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, told me what would happen to Shemaiah, who was one of our people in Babylonia. After my letter reached Babylonia, Shemaiah wrote letters to the people of Jerusalem, including the priest Zephaniah son of Maaseiah, and the other priests. The letter to Zephaniah said:
translation_verse: “Asafo AWURADE, Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa: Ɔnate kyɛ ɛhyerɛle krataa wɔ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ dumaa nu ɛɛmane Yerusalemfoɛ amukoraa, yeɛ Sefania bɔ ye baba ole ɔsɔfo Maaseya ne asɔfo nemɔ amukoraa kyɛ,

english_verse: After the death of Jehoiada the priest, the Lord chose you to be the priest in charge of the temple security force. You know that anyone who acts crazy and pretends to be a prophet should be arrested and put in chains and iron collars.
translation_verse: ‘AWURADE afa wɔ wali sɔfo maa asi ɔsɔfo Yehoada gya nu, kyɛ ɛnea AWURADE awuro ne aso, ná ebiala bɔ wabɔ laen, nakoso ɔyɛ ye nwo ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne, ɛ́bɔ ye panwu, ná égua ye ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ.

english_verse: Jeremiah from the town of Anathoth is pretending to be a prophet there in Jerusalem, so why haven't you punished him?
translation_verse: Na afei, Anatoteniɛ Yeremia bɔ ɔyɛ ye nwo ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ wɔ ɛmɔ so ne, nzu ati yeɛ endwi ye nyunu ɔ?

english_verse: He even wrote a letter to the people here in Babylonia, saying we would be here a long time. He told us to build homes and to plant gardens and grow our own food.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wasoma maa baase yɛ wɔ Babilɔn kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔkɔhyɛ wɔ nnurehyelɛ nu, yiti ɛ́mɔsisi sua bɛtenatena nu, ɛ́mɔyeyɛ boo, ná ɛmɔli nu aleɛ.’ ”

english_verse: When Zephaniah received Shemaiah's letter, he read it to me.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo Sefania kengale sɔ krataa ne hyirele ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yeremia.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me what to write in a second letter
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Yeremia kyɛ,

english_verse: to the people of Judah who had been taken to Babylonia. In this letter, I wrote that the Lord had said: I, the Lord, have not chosen Shemaiah to be one of my prophets, and he has misled you by telling lies in my name.
translation_verse: “Mmenia amukoraa bɔ bahye bɛ nnure bahɔ ne, soma maa beese bɛ kyɛ, ‘Bɔ AWURADE kã fa Nehelamniɛ Semaya nwo ole kyɛ: Ɔnate kyɛ Semaya wahyɛ ngɔm wahyire ɛmɔ wɔ aberɛ bɔ nnzomane ye, ná wamaa ɛmɔale ngondombo bali ne ati,

english_verse: He has even talked you into disobeying me. So I will punish Shemaiah. He and his descendants won't live to see the good things I will do for my people. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: yiti AWURADE nwa nyoo: Tie, ngɔhwe Nehelamniɛ Semaya ne ye bosofoɛ bɛ so. Ongonya ye nwoniɛ bɔ ɔkɔtena maen he anu, bɔ okonwu nikye paa bɔ mebaayɔ mema me maen ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne; ofikyɛ wahã ɛlɔenyɛlɛ dwirɛ watia AWURADE.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God of Israel said, “Jeremiah, get a scroll and write down everything I have told you.
translation_verse: “AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Kyerɛ edwirɛ amukoraa bɔ mahã mahyire wɔ ne gua nwomaa nu.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me to say to Israel and Judah: Screams of terror are heard, with no word of peace.
translation_verse: “AWURADE nwa nyoo: Yate ahunundetelɛ nga, yate esurolɛ nga, nna asomdwee ɔ.

english_verse: Can men give birth? Then why do I see them looking so pale and clutching their stomachs like women in labor?
translation_verse: Afei, ɛ́mɔbisa ná ɛmɔnwu ye e, sɛ aso bienzua kɔhora kɔfo aworɛ so anaa? Nakoso ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ menwu kyɛ bienzua katakyie biala wasɔ ye sisia kyɛ brasua bɔ wafo aworɛ so ye, bɔ bɛ mukoraa bɛ nyunu ayɛ hoyaa ye?

english_verse: Now you are slaves of other nations, but I will break the chains and smash the yokes that keep you in slavery.
translation_verse: “Na Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɔ kyẽa ne, ngobubu ye kɔnnua ne anu ngofi wɔ kɔme anu, na ngɔtete nyamaa bɔ ɔkyekye wɔ ne anu, na amanvrafoɛ bɛngɔfa ye bɛngɔyɛ akoaa ko.

english_verse: Then you will be my servants, and I will choose a king for you from the family of David. *
translation_verse: Na mmom bɛkɔso AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ ne bɛ hene Dawide bɔ ngosiesie ye ngɔma bɛ ne.

english_verse: Israel, you belong to me, so don't be afraid. You deserved to be punished; that's why I scattered you in distant nations. But I am with you, and someday I will destroy those nations.
translation_verse: “Yiti wɔ, me somvoɛ Yakob, nnɛsuro, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Ao Yisrael, nnɛma wɔ kunu tete wɔ; ofikyɛ tie, ngɔpepɛ ngole wɔ ngofi dedeede, na wɔ boso ama mɔ, ngɔpepɛ ngole bɛ ngofi aseɛ bɔ bahye bɛ nnure bahɔ so ne aso. Yakob kosa kɔwa kɔɔtena asomdwee nu konn, na ebiala ngonwunanwuna ye.

english_verse: Then I will bring you and your descendants back to your land, where I will protect you and give you peace. Then your fears will be gone. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Heal Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngyi wɔ si kyɛ ngɔpepɛ ngole wɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne; na maen maen amukoraa bɔ mabɔ wɔ masande maagua so ne, ngɔbɔ bɛ tɔɔ, nakoso wɔ de, mengɔbɔ wɔ tɔɔ. Na mmom ngɔhwe wɔ so kyɛbɔ ɔfata ɔ, na mengɔma ɛngɔfa wɔ nwo ngoli tɔtorɔtɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said: My people, you are wounded and near death.
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ AWURADE nwa nyoo: Wɔ kena ne te kenangɔ, wɔ puralɛ ne yɛ suro.

english_verse: You are accused of a crime with no one to defend you, and you are covered with sores that no medicine can cure. *
translation_verse: Ebiala nne berɛ bɔ odi wɔ dwirɛ ma wɔ bɔ ɔkɔteta wɔ ngena nemɔ anu ɔ. Wɔ, kena ayire biala nne berɛ mma wɔ.

english_verse: Your friends have forgotten you; they don't care anymore. Even I have acted like an enemy. And because your sins are horrible and countless, I will be cruel as I punish you.
translation_verse: Wɔ dɔfo amukoraa bɛ wora afi wɔ; bɛmbena wɔ si atee, ofikyɛ mapura wɔ kyɛbɔ pɔfoɛ kopura wɔ ɔ; yeɛ mahwe wɔ so kyɛbɔ atianuserɛniɛ kɔhwe wɔ so ɔ, ofikyɛ w’amumuyɛɛ sone pee, yeɛ wɔ bɔne ayɛ buburugyaa.

english_verse: No one wants you as a friend or cares what happens to you. But I will heal your injuries, and you will get well. The Lord Will Rescue Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngɔmaa ekosa kɔte apɔ, yeɛ ngɔma wɔ ngena nemɔ kɔhɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Ofikyɛ bɛfrɛle wɔ: Bɔ bapɛ ye asue ɔ. ‘Sion bɔ ebiala mbena ye si atee ɔ!’

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, I will be kind to you and let you come home. Jerusalem now lies in ruins, but you will rebuild it, complete with a new palace.
translation_verse: “Bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: Tie, ngɔfa Yakob ɛtena sua mɔ ngosa ngofi nnurehyelɛ nu ngɔwa, na ngonwu ye atenaleɛ nemɔ anwumvoin. Bekosa bɛkɔkyekye kuro ne wɔ ye boso, ná bagyina ahemvie ne wɔ nekaa bɔ né ogyi daa ne.

english_verse: Other nations will respect and honor you. Your homes will be filled with children, and you will celebrate, singing praises to me.
translation_verse: Asennaa dwein kofi bɛ nu kɔwa, yeɛ esebɔlɛ koso kofi bɛ nu kɔwa. Ngɔmaa bɛkɔta bɛkɔyɛ pee, na bɛngɔyɛ kãa bie. Ngɔmaa bekonya animnyam koso, na bɛ nyunu ngogua ase.

english_verse: It will be just like old times. Your nation will worship me, and I will punish anyone who abuses you.
translation_verse: Bɛ mma mɔ kɔyɛ kyɛbɔ né bɛte daa ne ala, bɛ badwa ne kotindim wɔ me nyunu; na bɛ bɔ bɛtane bɛ nye ne, ngɔhwe bɛ mukoraa bɛ so.

english_verse: One of your own people will become your ruler. And when I invite him to come near me at the place of worship, he will do so. No one would dare to come near without being invited.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nu yeɛ b’atitirefoɛ kofi ɔ, yeɛ bɛ maenbulɛniɛ ne koso kofi bɛ nu. Ngɔmaa ɔkɔhwe kopingye, na okopingye me; ofikyɛ nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kosi ye hue kopingye me ɔ? AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: You will be my people, and I will be your God. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkɔyɛ me maen, ná me koso mayɛ ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.”

english_verse: I am furious! And like a violent storm I will strike those who do wrong.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, AWURADE mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ne! Ole ɛyaa otu kɔ, mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo bɔ ongyina ɔ, na okotu koofĩ bɔnefoɛ ti so.

english_verse: I won't calm down until I have finished what I have decided to do. Someday, you will understand what I mean.
translation_verse: AWURADE ɛyaa piri ne, ongosa ye si, kɔpem kyɛ bɔ wayɛ ye adwene kyɛ ɔkɔyɔ ne, ɔkɔyɔ koyie koraa ɔ. Ngyẽa bɔ oli nziɛ ne, ɛmɔkɔte ɛhe abo.

english_verse: The Lord said: Israel, I promise that someday all your tribes will again be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: “Sɔ mmerɛ ne, ngɔyɛ Yisrael mmusua nemɔ amukoraa bɛ Nyameɛ, na bɛ koso bɛkɔyɛ me maen, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: In the desert I was kind to those who escaped death. I gave them peace, and when the time is right, I'll do the same for you. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Will Rebuild Israel
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo: Bɛ bɔ benyane bɛ ti bedidili nu befili ngrandɛ noa ne, benyane adom wɔ ɛserɛ so, mmerɛ bɔ mmane Yisrael nyane ye nwome lele ne.

english_verse: Some time ago, the Lord appeared to me and told me to say: Israel, I will always love you; that's why I've been so patient and kind.
translation_verse: AWURADE yele ye nwo ali hyirele me fili dedeede kyɛ, amba, ɔdɔ bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ yeɛ mafa mahuro wɔ dwirɛ ɔ, maye m’ahone nu yeɛ mahwe wɔ mapingye ɔ.

english_verse: You are precious to me, and so I will rebuild your nation. Once again you will dance for joy and play your tambourines.
translation_verse: Ao Yisrael ababunu, ngosa ngɔma wɔ bo kotimu, na wɔ bo kotimu. Ekosa kɔfa w’akasaa ne kosiesie wɔ nwo, na ɛkɔfa ahurusililɛfoɛ b’abilie kosi nu kɔhɔ.

english_verse: You will plant vineyards on the hills of Samaria and enjoy the grapes.
translation_verse: Asa koso, ɛkɔyɔ bobe boo mɔ wɔ Samaria mmokaa nemɔ aso; akuafoɛ nemɔ bekolua, na bɛkɔte ye mma ne bekoli.

english_verse: Someday those who guard the hill country of Ephraim will shout, “Let's go to Zion and worship the Lord our God.” Israel Will Return to Its Own Land
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ kyẽa bie kɔwa bɔ awɛmvoɛ mɔ bɛkɔtea nu wɔ Efraim mmokaa aseɛ so kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔdwɔso oo! Ɛ́mɔma yɛfo yɛhɔ Sion, yɛhɔ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ berɛ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord says: Celebrate and sing for Israel, the greatest of nations. Offer praises and shout, “Come and rescue your people, Lord! Save what's left of Israel.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE nwa nyoo: “Ɛ́mɔfa anigye bɛ́to Yakob nwo dwein, ná ɛ́mɔbɔ ese bɛ́ma bɔ odi maen maen mɔ so ne; ɛ́mɔbɔ dawure, ɛ́mɔye ye ayɛ, ná ɛmɔhã kyɛ, ‘Ao AWURADE, pepɛ de wɔ maen, Yisrael ngaa ne.’

english_verse: I, the Lord, will bring my people back from Babylonia and everywhere else on earth. The blind and the lame will be there. Expectant mothers and women about to give birth will come and be part of that great crowd.
translation_verse: Tie, ngɔɔfa bɛ ngofi sorɔ dɔ aseɛ ne aso, ná maboaboa bɛ noa mafi aseɛ noa dɔ paa bɔ ɛhemɔ boka so ɔ: anyesiniwaafoɛ ne bubuafoɛ, mmrataen ne pemvoɛ mɔ, na bɛte fekue kandinga bɔ bekosa bɛkɔwa wa ɔ.

english_verse: They will weep and pray as I bring them home. I will lead them to streams of water. They will walk on a level road and not stumble. I am a father to Israel, my favorite children.
translation_verse: Bele esuɛ ne ngotosrɛ yeɛ bɛkɔwa ɔ, na ngoli bɛ nyunu. Ngɔmaa bɛkɔnate bɛkɔhɔ asue noa, wɔ atee bɔ ɔtengyɛ bɔ bengosoti wɔ so ɔ so; ofikyɛ me yeɛ nde Yisrael ye baba ɔ, na Efraim yeɛ ɔte me bamuɛbaa ɔ.

english_verse: Listen to me, you nations nearby or across the sea. I scattered the people of Israel, but I will gather them again. I will protect them like a shepherd guarding a flock;
translation_verse: “Ao maen maen mɔ, ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE noa dwirɛ, ná ɛ́mɔbɔ ye dawure wɔ supɔ mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ dedeede ɔ so, ná ɛmɔhã kyɛ, ‘Bɔ ɔbɔle Yisrael sandene ne, okosa kɔboaboa bɛ noa kɔnea bɛ so kyɛbɔ mmoaenneafoɛ nea ye mmoaen kure so ɔ.’

english_verse: My people will come to Mount Zion and celebrate; their faces will glow because of my blessings. I'll give them grain, grapes, and olive oil, as well as sheep and cattle. Israel will be prosperous and grow like a garden with plenty of water.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛkɔwa bɛkɔɔto dwein wɔ Sion bokaa ne ti afia, na bɛ nye kɔgye, ɔnate AWURADE paayɛlɛ ne ati, ɔne aleɛ, nzaa ne ngoo ne ati, yeɛ mmoaen akrɔngrɔma mɔ ne nandwie akrɔngrɔma mɔ ti. B’asetena nu kɔyɛ kyɛ eboo bɔ onya nzue ɔ, na bɛ wora ngɔbɔ ko koraa.

english_verse: Young women and young men, together with the elderly, will celebrate and dance, because I will comfort them and turn their sorrow into happiness.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ndaluwa kɔfa anigye bekogo abilie ne, mmerandeɛ ne nworowaa bɛ nye kɔgye kɔbɔ nu; ofikyɛ ngɔma bɛ suɛ kɔkakyi ahurusililɛ, ngɔkyekye bɛ wora, na ngɔma bɛ nye kɔgye kofi b’aworabɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: I will bless my people with more food than they need, and the priests will enjoy the choice cuts of meat. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Offers Hope
translation_verse: Ngɔfa aleɛ fɛɛ ngɔma asɔfo nemɔ bɛ kra ko koyi, na me maen konya me nningyein paa kɔma bɛ ko koyi, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: In Ramah a voice is heard, crying and weeping loudly. Rachel mourns for her children and refuses to be comforted, because they are dead. *
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo: “Bɛtele komviɛ bie wɔ Rama, awuye ne esuɛ hahii. Rahɛl sũ ye mma, ye mma nemɔ ati, bɛkyekye ye wora a, ondie, ofikyɛ bɛnne berɛ ko.”

english_verse: But I, the Lord, say to dry your tears. Someday your children will come home from the enemy's land. Then all you have done for them will be greatly rewarded.
translation_verse: Bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: Mua wɔ noa ná yakyi suɛ; nnɛma wɔ nye poro moen, ofikyɛ ekonya w’adwuma nwo akatuaa, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, na bekofi pɔfoɛ ne aseɛ so bekosa bɛkɔwa.

english_verse: The people of Israel moan and say to me, “We were like wild bulls, but you, Lord, broke us, and we learned to obey. You are our God— please let us come home.
translation_verse: Amba, mate kyɛ Efraim ɔ́bɔ abubue kyɛ, ‘Ahwe me so, na manya asohwenɛ, kyɛ nandwie ba bɔ bennya bɛffale kɔnnua bɛttole ye kɔme ɔ. Maa nza mmra, na ngosa ngɔwa, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛte AWURADE me Nyameɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When we were young, we strayed and sinned, but then we realized what we had done. We are ashamed and disgraced and want to return to you.”
translation_verse: Amba, nzale me si, na ye si ye, nzakyerale m’adwene. Na ye si ye bɔ me nye wale me nwo so ne, mvale me sa nguale m’ahone so; mvɛrele, na me nyunu guale ase, ofikyɛ mmɔle nyanzoen bra wɔ me mmerandeɛ nu.’

english_verse: People of Israel, you are my own dear children. Don't I love you best of all? Though I often make threats, I want you to be near me, so I will have mercy on you. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Aso Efraim, ɔte mma bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo ɔ? Aso ɔte baa bɔ me nye gye ye nwo ɔ? Mmerɛ pee bɔ metwi ye nyunu ne, yeɛ mekɔ so mekaye ye ɔ. Yiti me kunu tete me ma ye, amba, ngonwu ye anwumvoin, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: With rock piles and signposts, mark the road well, my dear people. The road by which you left by will now lead you home.
translation_verse: “Fa nningyein hyɛ atee ne nzorɛ, fa mmakaa penapena so. Hyɛ atee ne nzorɛ yé, atimbire bɔ ɛfale so hɔle ne. Ao Yisrael ababunu, sa wɔ si. Sa wɔ si bra wɔ nguro hemɔ aso.

english_verse: Will you ever decide to be faithful? I will make sure that someday things will be different, as different as a woman protecting a man. The Lord Will Bring Judah Home
translation_verse: Ao baa brasua bɔ ayɛ lɔen ɔ, w’adwene kɔyɛ wɔ ndaa ndaa maa okoodwu kyinzu? Ofikyɛ AWURADE abɔ nikyee foforɛ wɔ aseɛ so. Brasua kɔbɔ bienzua nwo waen.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I promise to set the people of Judah free and to lead them back to their hometowns. And when I do, they will once again say, “We pray that the Lord will bless his home, the sacred hill in Jerusalem where his temple stands.”
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE, Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, “Sɛ mesa mefa b’agyapadeɛ mewura bɛ sa a, bekosa bɛkɔhã sɔ dwirɛ ne wɔ Yuda aseɛ so ne ye nguro mɔ so kyɛ, ‘Ao tenenee atenaleɛ, ao bokaa krongron, AWURADE oyira wɔ!’

english_verse: The people will live in Jerusalem and in the towns of Judah. Some will be farmers, and others will be shepherds.
translation_verse: Na akuafoɛ mɔ ne bɛ bɔ bɛfa mmoaen kure bɛkɔ adidie ne, bɛkɔtena Yuda ne ye nguro nemɔ amukoraa so bɛkɔbɔ nu.

english_verse: Those who feel tired and worn out will find new life and energy,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛkra bɔ wayɛ hodwoo ne, ngɔmaa okole ye nwome, yeɛ ɛkra bɔ ye wora abɔ ne, ngɔmaa ye ko koyi.”

english_verse: and when they sleep, they will wake up refreshed.
translation_verse: Ɛhe maa ndingyele, na nneane, na me nnaa yɛle me fɛ.

english_verse: Someday, Israel and Judah will be my field where my people and their livestock will grow.
translation_verse: “Tie, mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba bɔ Yisrael awuro ama ne Yuda awuro ama mɔ, ngɔfa mmenia bosofoɛ ne ngaka bosofoɛ yeɛ ngolua ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: In the past, I took care to uproot them, to tear them down, and to destroy them. But when that day comes, I will take care to plant them and help them grow.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, kyɛbɔ nneane bɛ so kyɛ ngotutu bɛ bo, ngobubu nu, ngodwiri ngogua, ngɔsɛkye, ná mama musue ato bɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ngɔnea bɛ so ngosi ná malua ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: No longer will anyone go around saying, “Sour grapes eaten by parents leave a sour taste in the mouths of their children.”
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, bɛngɔhã ye ko kyɛ, ‘Seɛ mɔ bali abrɛbɛ bisii, na mmaa mɔ yeɛ bɛ gye anya ɔ.’

english_verse: When that day comes, only those who eat sour grapes will get the sour taste, and only those who sin will be put to death. The New Agreement with Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Nakoso ebiala kowu wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye amumuyɛɛ nwo; ebiala bɔ okoli abrɛbɛ bisii ne, ye bɔbɔ ye gye yeɛ okonya ɔ. Apam foforɛ ne

english_verse: The Lord said: The time will surely come when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and Judah.
translation_verse: “Tie, mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba bɔ me ne Yisrael awuro ama ne Yuda awuro ama yɛkɔyɛ apam foforɛ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: It will be different from the agreement I made with their ancestors when I led them out of Egypt. Although I was their God, they broke that agreement.
translation_verse: Ɔngɔyɛ kyɛ apam bɔ me ne bɛ nana mɔ yɛyɛle, mmerɛ bɔ nzɔle bɛ sa nyele bɛ mvili Misraim aseɛ so ne. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ me yeɛ né nde bɛ hu ɔ, nakoso bebuli m’apam ne aso, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Here is the new agreement that I, the Lord, will make with the people of Israel: “I will write my laws on their hearts and minds. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Nakoso apam bɔ me ne Yisrael awuro ama yɛkɔyɛ ɛhe: Sɔ mmerɛ ne asi ne, ngɔfa me mmeraa ngowura bɛ nu, na ngɔhyerɛ ye wɔ b’ahone nu; ngɔyɛ bɛ Nyameɛ, ná bɛ koso bayɛ me maen, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: “No longer will they have to teach one another to obey me. I, the Lord, promise that all of them will obey me, ordinary people and rulers alike. I will forgive their sins and forget the evil things they have done.”
translation_verse: Na ebiala ngohyirehyire obiɛngo ko, yeɛ ebiala ngose oliɛma kyɛ, ‘Nwu AWURADE,’ ofikyɛ ofi bɛ nu kwahweabaa so bɔ ɔkwaadwu bɛ nu titire paa so, bɛ mukoraa bekonwu me, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Ofikyɛ ngɔfa b’amumuyɛɛ ngɔhyɛ bɛ, na mengɔkaye bɛ bɔne ko.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful. I command the sun to give light each day, the moon and stars to shine at night, and ocean waves to roar.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ ɔfale eyia tuale berɛ kyɛ ɔta alehyeleɛ nu, ná ɔyɛle nhyehyɛleɛ mane ɛsraen ne nzramaa mɔ kyɛ bɛta alesaleɛ nu, ye bɔ ɔkã ɛpo nu maa ye asorɔkye bɔ, bɔ ye dumaa ole Asafo AWURADE ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe:

english_verse: I will never forget to give those commands, and I will never let Israel stop being a nation. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: “Sɔ nhyehyɛleɛ nemɔ, sɛ bɛ bo pɛ wɔ me nyunu a, yeɛ Yisrael boso ama koso bɛngɔhɔ so bɛngɔyɛ maen wɔ me nyunu afebɔɔ ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: Can you measure the heavens? Can you explore the depths of the earth? That's how hard it would be for me to reject Israel forever, even though they have sinned. I, the Lord, have spoken. Jerusalem Will Be Rebuilt
translation_verse: Bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: Sɛ bɛkora besusu nyameɛso anwuro anwuro, ná bɛkora betutu aseɛ nyinasoɛ bo bɛnea a, ye de ngɔpo Yisrael boso ama amukoraa, ɔnate bɔ bayɔ amukoraa ne ati, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The Lord said: Someday, Jerusalem will truly belong to me. It will be rebuilt with a boundary line running from Hananel Tower to Corner Gate.
translation_verse: “Tie, mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba, bɔ kuro ne, ofi Hananel abandenden bɔ ɔkwaadwu ndweasoɛ pambim ne, bekosa bɛkɔkyekye bɛkɔma AWURADE ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: From there, the boundary will go in a straight line to Gareb Hill, then turn toward Goah.
translation_verse: Na nyamaa bɔ bɛfa besusu nikyee ne, ɔkɔhɔ ye nyunu tee koodwu Garebo pambaa ne, ná wakondo wahɔ Gowa.

english_verse: Even that disgusting Hinnom Valley will be sacred to me, and so will the eastern slopes that go down from Horse Gate into Kidron Valley. Jerusalem will never again be destroyed.
translation_verse: Na efuin ne nzoen bɔnza ne amukoraa, ɔne aseɛ amukoraa bɔ ɔkwaadwu asue Kidron, bɔ ɔkwaadwu Pɔngɔ pambim ne ndweasoɛ so wɔ eyia afiteleɛ so ne, ɔkɔyɛ krongron kɔma AWURADE. Ye bo ngotutu ko, yeɛ bengodwiri bengogua ase ko le.”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me in the tenth year that Zedekiah was king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year that Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylonia.
translation_verse: Yuda hene Hesekia ye ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so buru, bɔ ɔte Nebukadenesa ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne mmɔtwɛ ne anu, AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔlale ye ali hyirele Yeremia ne, ye ɛhe.

english_verse: At that time, the Babylonian army had surrounded Jerusalem, and I was in the prison at the courtyard of the palace guards.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né Babilɔn hene ye lɔen batua Yerusalem. Né ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yeremia de, ɔla kuku nu wɔ aluo berɛ, wɔ Yuda hene ahemvie berɛ.

english_verse: Zedekiah had ordered me to be held there because I told everyone that the Lord had said: I am the Lord, and I am about to let the king of Babylonia conquer Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ né Yuda hene Sedekia wafa ye wato kuku nu, bɔ ɔnwa, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛhyɛ ngɔm kyɛ, ‘AWURADE nwa nyoo: Tie, ngɔfa kuro he ngowura Babilɔn hene sa maa okoli so ngonim,

english_verse: Then Zedekiah will be led away to Babylonia, where he will stay until I am finished with him. So, if you people of Judah fight against the Babylonians, you will lose. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔhwe Sedekia kɔhɔ Babilɔn, na dɔ yeɛ Sedekia kɔha alaa kɔpem kyɛ ngɔɔpasa ye nwo ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Ɛmɔ ne Kaldeafoɛ bɛkɔho koɛ de, nakoso ɛmɔngoli ngonim.’ ”

english_verse: Later, when I was in prison, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Na Yeremia hane kyɛ, “AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ,

english_verse: Jeremiah, your cousin Hanamel, the son of your uncle Shallum, will visit you. He must sell his field near the town of Anathoth, and because you are his nearest relative, you have the right and the responsibility to buy it and keep it in the family.
translation_verse: Tie, Hanamel bɔ ɔte wɔ baba aliɛma bienzua Salum awa ne, ɔkɔwa wɔ berɛ koose wɔ kyɛ, ‘Tɔ me boo bɔ ɔwɔ Anatote ne, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ele ye nwo ate kyɛ ɛtɔ maa ɔbadi wɔ sa nu ɔ.’

english_verse: Hanamel came, just as the Lord had promised. And he said, “Please buy my field near Anathoth in the territory of the Benjamin tribe. You have the right to buy it, and if you do, it will stay in our family.” The Lord had told me to buy it
translation_verse: Yeɛ me baba aliɛma bienzua awa Hanamel gyinane AWURADE dwirɛ so wale me berɛ wɔ kuku nu aluo berɛ, na osele me kyɛ, ‘Mesrɛ wɔ, tɔ me boo bɔ ɔwɔ Anatote bɔ ɔwɔ Benyamin maen nu ne, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ele ye nwo ate kyɛ agyapadeɛ ne ɔbadi wɔ berɛ ɔ; wɔ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔba wɔ sa nu; yiti tɔ ná fa. Na nwuni kyɛ edwirɛ ne, ɔte AWURADE dwirɛ.

english_verse: Lord God, you stretched out your mighty arm and made the sky and the earth. You can do anything.
translation_verse: ‘Ao, AWURADE Nyameɛ! Tie oo, wɔ yeɛ ele wɔ tumi piri ne wɔ tumi asaa bɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ɔ! Nikye fee nne berɛ bɔ ɔyɛ se ma wɔ ɔ;

english_verse: I had two copies of the bill of sale written out: an official copy containing the details of our agreement and another copy, without the details. Some witnesses and I signed the official copy, which was folded and tied, before being sealed shut with hot wax. Then I gave Hanamel the silver.
translation_verse: Na mvale aseɛ tɔnenɛ nwo ngrataa, bɔ bagyina mmeraa ne amammerɛ so bafa nzɔanoɛ basɔ ye noa ne, ɔne bɔ bamva nzɔanoɛ banzɔ ye noa ne,

english_verse: I told Baruch that the Lord had said: Take both copies of this bill of sale, one sealed shut and the other open, and put them in a clay jar so they will last a long time.
translation_verse: ‘Asafo AWURADE, Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: De sɔ adanzeɛ ngrataa hemɔ, aseɛ ne tɔnenɛ nwo ngrataa ne, bɔ bafa nzɔanoɛ basɔ ye noa, ɔne bɔ bamva nzɔanoɛ banzɔ ye noa ne, ná fa wura kukue bie anu, amaa wahora wahyɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, and I promise you that people will once again buy and sell houses, farms, and vineyards in this country. Jeremiah Questions the Lord
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Asafo AWURADE, Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa: Bekosa bɛkɔtotɔ sua ne eboo ne bobe boo mɔ bieku wɔ aseɛ he aso.’

english_verse: You show kindness for a thousand generations, but you also punish people for the sins of their parents. You are the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: wɔ bɔ ɛye wɔ ɔdɔ ali kyire mmenia apee apee, nakoso ɛprapra seɛ mɔ b’amumuyɛɛ nwo akatuaa gua bɛ mma mɔ so ɔ. Ao, Nyameɛ Piri, Tuminiɛ kandinga, ye dumaa ole Asafo AWURADE.

english_verse: With great wisdom you make plans, and with your great power you do all the mighty things you planned. Nothing we do is hidden from your eyes, and you reward or punish us as we deserve.
translation_verse: Wɔ bɔ wɔ nworɛ te totohyia, ná wɔ nnwumaa yɛ nwanwa ɔ; wɔ nye tua adasa b’atee amukoraa, kyɛ ɛkɔma ebiala ye atee bɔ ɔnate so ɔ ɔne ye yɔleɛ nwo akatuaa;

english_verse: You are famous because you worked miracles in Egypt, and you are still working them in Israel and in the rest of the world as well.
translation_verse: wɔ bɔ ɛyɔle nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ wɔ Misraim aseɛ so, ná ɛkɔso yɔ ye wɔ Yisrael ne adasa amukoraa nu maa waadwu ɛnɛ ɔ, ná afa ale dumaa maa waadwu ɛnɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You terrified the Egyptians with your miracles, and you reached out your mighty arm and rescued your people Israel from Egypt.
translation_verse: Ɛnate nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ ne anwoserɛ asaa ne tumi asaa ne nningyein suronyisuronyi so ɛyele wɔ maen Yisrael fili Misraim aseɛ so;

english_verse: Then you gave Israel this land rich with milk and honey, just as you had promised our ancestors.
translation_verse: na ɛfale sɔ aseɛ he mane bɛ, aseɛ bɔ nyɔfonesue ne woɛ tengyɛ wɔ so, bɔ ɛtale ndaen kyɛ ɛkɔfa kɔma bɛ nana mɔ ne.

english_verse: But when our ancestors took over the land, they did not obey you. And now you have punished Israel with disaster.
translation_verse: Na bɛwale aseɛ ne aso bɛɛfale. Nakoso bandie wɔ dwirɛ, yeɛ banni wɔ mmeraa ne aso. Na ahyɛdeɛ amukoraa bɔ ɛfa mane bɛ kyɛ beli so ne, banni so. Ye sɔ ati yeɛ aprapra musue he amukoraa agua bɛ so ye.

english_verse: Jerusalem is under attack, and we suffer from hunger and disease. The Babylonians have already built dirt ramps up to the walls of our city, and you can see that Jerusalem will be captured just as you said.
translation_verse: Ao nea, bagyinagyina nyinasoɛ mɔ wɔ kuro ne anwo kyɛ bɛfa betua kuro ne bedi so ngonim, na ɔnate ngrandɛ ne ɛhɔen ne ewue anwonyerɛ ne ati, bafa kuro ne bawura Kaldeafoɛ bɔ bafa koɛ bateta ye ne, bɛ sa. Edwirɛ bɔ ɛhane ne wawa nu, na nea, wɔ bɔbɔ enwu ye.

english_verse: So why did you tell me to get some witnesses and buy a field with my silver, when Jerusalem is about to be captured by the Babylonians? The Lord Explains about the Field
translation_verse: Nakoso, ao AWURADE Nyameɛ, ahã ahyire me kyɛ, “Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bafa kuro ne bawura Kaldeafoɛ nemɔ sa de, nakoso te sikaa tɔ eboo ne, ná pena ye nwo adanzefoɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Jeremiah, I am the Lord God. I rule the world, and I can do anything!
translation_verse: “Tie, me ole AWURADE, anwoɔnaen amukoraa Nyameɛ; aso nikyee bie yɔlɛ yɛ se ma me anaa?

english_verse: It is true that I am going to let King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia capture Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yiti Bɔ AWURADE kã ɛhe: Tie, ngɔfa kuro he ngowura Kaldeafoɛ nemɔ sa ne Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa sa, na okoli so ngonim.

english_verse: The Babylonian army is already attacking, and they will capture the city and set it on fire. The people of Jerusalem have made me angry by going up to the flat roofs of their houses and burning incense to Baal and offering wine sacrifices to other gods. Now these houses will be burned to the ground!
translation_verse: Na Kaldeafoɛ bɔ bafa koɛ bateta kuro he ne, bɛkɔwa bɛkɔɔto kuro he anu see, na bɛkɔyera ye ne sua mɔ bɔ mmenia ayera ɛyɛɛ wɔ bɛ ti afia bama Baal, ná basa babɔ anonneɛ afɔleɛ wɔ bɛ ti afia bama nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ kyɛ bɛfa bewura me apue ne.

english_verse: They have set up repulsive idols in my temple, and now it isn't a fit place to worship me.
translation_verse: Begyinagyinane bɛ nningyein bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ ɔ wɔ awuro bɔ me dumaa la so ne anu bɛfa beguale ye nwo fiɛ.

english_verse: And they led Judah into sin by building places to worship Baal in Hinnom Valley, where they also sacrificed their sons and daughters to the god Molech. I have never even imagined they would commit such disgusting sins.
translation_verse: Besisili Baal asɔneyɛɛ mɔ wɔ Hinom Awa bɔnza ne anu, kyɛ bɛfa bɛ mma mmienzua ne bɛ mma mmrasua bɛfa see nu bɛma Moleke, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ mamva ahyɛdeɛ mamma bɛ kyɛ bɛyɔ sɔ, yeɛ wamma me ti anu kyɛ bɛyɔ sɔ akyiwadeɛ ne bɛ́ma Yuda ɔyɔ bɔne.

english_verse: Jeremiah, what you said is true. The people of Jerusalem are suffering from hunger and disease, and so the king of Babylonia will be able to capture Jerusalem.
translation_verse: “Na afei, kuro he bɔ ɛmɔnwa, ‘Bɛnate ngrandɛ ne ɛhɔen ne ewue anwonyerɛ so bafa bawura Babilɔn hene sa’ ne, bɔ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ ɔkã fa ye nwo ɛhe:

english_verse: I am angry with the people of Jerusalem, and I will scatter them in foreign countries. But someday I will bring them back here and let them live in safety.
translation_verse: Tie, ngɔboaboa bɛ noa ngofi maen maen amukoraa bɔ nne ɛyaa, ahonehulɛ ne anyeborolɛ kandinga mvoane bɛ ngonguale so ne aso. Ngosa ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa wa, na ngɔmaa bɛkɔtena anwotɔ nu.

english_verse: They will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔyɛ me maen, ná me koso mayɛ bɛ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Even though I have brought disaster on the people, I will someday do all these good things for them.
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ AWURADE nwa nyoo: Kyɛbɔ maprapra musue kandinga he amukoraa magua maen he aso ne, sɔ ala yeɛ saleɛ amukoraa bɔ mafa mahyɛ bɛ bɔ ne, ngɔmaa ɔkɔwa bɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, when you bought the field, you showed that fields will someday be bought and sold again. You say that this land has been conquered by the Babylonians and has become a desert, emptied of people and animals.
translation_verse: Aseɛ he bɔ ɛmɔkã ye nwo dwirɛ kyɛ wayɛ kurofoen, bɔ sona anaa kaka biala ɔnne so ne, bafa bawura Kaldeafoɛ sa, na mmenia kɔtotɔ eboo wɔ so.

english_verse: But someday, people will again spend their silver to buy fields everywhere—in the territory of Benjamin, the region around Jerusalem and the towns of Judah, and in the hill country, the foothills to the west, and the Southern Desert. Buyers and sellers and witnesses will sign and seal the bills of sale for the fields. It will happen, because I will give this land back to my people. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Benyamin aseɛ so, aseɛ bɔ wapɛ Yerusalem nwo wayia nemɔ aso, Yuda nguro nemɔ aso, bokaa maen nguro nemɔ aso, bɔnza nu nguro nemɔ aso, yeɛ ngwaen dɔ nguro nemɔ aso, mmenia kɔte esikaa bɛkɔtotɔ eboo, bɛkɔyɛ ye nwo ngrataa, bɛkɔfa nzɔanoɛ bɛkɔsɔ ye noa, ná bapena ye nwo adanzefoɛ; ofikyɛ ngɔfa bɛ ngofi nnurehyelɛ nu ngosa ngɔwa, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: I was still being held prisoner in the courtyard of the palace guards when the Lord told me: I am the Lord, and I created the whole world.
translation_verse: “AWURADE bɔ ɔbɔle nikye ɔ, AWURADE bɔ ɔhyehyɛle fa tindimuni berɛ, bɔ ye dumaa ole AWURADE ne, ɔnwa nyoo:

english_verse: Ask me, and I will tell you things that you don't know and can't find out.
translation_verse: Sũ frɛ me, na ngobua wɔ, na ngɔla edwirɛ mbiri mbiri bɔ wafea wɔ bɔ ɛnze ɔ ali ngohyire wɔ.

english_verse: Then someday, I will heal this place and my people as well, and let them enjoy unending peace.
translation_verse: Tie, ngɔma kuro he anwo kɔsande ye ná wate apɔ, na ngɔsa bɛ anwonyerɛ. Na ngɔla asomdwee ne nahorɛlilɛ mmorosoɛ ali ngohyire bɛ.

english_verse: I will give this land to Israel and Judah once again, and I will make them as strong as they were before.
translation_verse: Na Yuda ne Yisrael mmenia bɔ bahye bɛ nnure bahɔ ne, ngɔmaa bekosa bɛkɔwa, na ngɔmaa bekosa bekotindim kyɛ bɛ daa ne ala.

english_verse: When that happens, all nations on earth will see the good things I have done for Jerusalem, and how I have given it complete peace. The nations will celebrate and praise and honor me, but they will also tremble with fear because of the powerful things I have done.
translation_verse: Na kuro he dumaa kɔyɛ anika, ayɛyelɛ ne animnyam kɔma me wɔ aseɛ ye aso maen amukoraa bɛ nyunu, na bɛkɔte nningyein paa amukoraa bɔ meyɔ mema bɛ ne; bekosuro, ná bɛ nwo kodwiri bɛ, ɔnate nningyein paa amukoraa ne asomdwee amukoraa bɔ ngɔfa ngɔma bɛ ne ati.

english_verse: Jeremiah, you say that this land is a desert without people or animals, and for now, you are right. The towns of Judah and the streets of Jerusalem are deserted, and people and animals are nowhere to be seen. But someday you will hear
translation_verse: “AWURADE nwa nyoo: Ɛwa bɔ ɛmɔnwa, ‘Wayɛ kurofoen bɔ sona anaa kaka biala ɔnne so’ ne, Yuda nguro ne Yerusalem dwaa mɔ so bɔ wayɛ kurofoen, bɔ sona anaa kuromani anaa kaka biala ɔnne so ne, bekosa bɛkɔte

english_verse: happy voices and the sounds of parties and wedding celebrations. And when people come to my temple to offer sacrifices to thank me, you will hear them say: “We praise you, Lord All-Powerful! You are good to us, and your love never fails.” The land will once again be productive.
translation_verse: ahurusililɛ nwo nga, anigye nwo nga, atɔmvorɛ biaa nwo nga, yeɛ atɔmvorɛ braa nwo nga; yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛto dwein bɛfa ayɛyelɛ afɔleɛ bɛba AWURADE awuro berɛ ɔ, bɛ nga kyɛ, Ɛ́mɔye Asafo AWURADE ayɛ, ofikyɛ AWURADE te paa, na ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne, ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ!’ Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bahye bɛ nnure bafi aseɛ ye aso bahɔ ne, ngosa ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa, kyɛ daa ne ala, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Now it is empty, without people or animals. But when that time comes, shepherds will take care of their flocks in pastures near every town in the hill country, in the foothills to the west, in the Southern Desert, in the land of the Benjamin tribe, and around Jerusalem and the towns of Judah. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord's Wonderful Promise
translation_verse: Mmokaa maen nguro nemɔ aso, bɔnza nu nguro nemɔ aso, ngwaen dɔ nguro nemɔ aso, Benyamin aseɛ so, Yerusalem nwo aseɛ nemɔ aso, yeɛ Yuda nguro nemɔ aso, sona bɔ ɔka mmoaen onwu bɛ somaa ne, okosa ɔkɔha bɛ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The Lord said: I made a wonderful promise to Israel and Judah, and the days are coming when I will keep it.
translation_verse: “Tie, mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba, bɔ ndɛenvɛen bɔ mva nhyɛle Yisrael awuro ama ne Yuda awuro ama bɛ bɔ ne, ngɔmaa ɔkɔwa nu ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I promise that the time will come when I will appoint a king from the family of David, a king who will be honest and rule with justice.
translation_verse: Sɔ ngyẽa nemɔ anu, sɔ mmerɛ ne, ngɔmaa Tenenee Mmaen bie kofifi kɔma Dawide; na okobua ndɛen turoloo, ná wayɔ bɔ ɔte tenenee ɔ wɔ aseɛ ne aso.

english_verse: In those days, Judah will be safe; Jerusalem will have peace and will be named, “The Lord Gives Justice.”
translation_verse: Sɔ ngyẽa nemɔ anu, Yuda konya ye ti kodidi nu, na Yerusalem kɔtena asomdwee nu. Na dumaa bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔfrɛ ye ole, ‘AWURADE Yɛ Tenenee.’

english_verse: The king of Israel will be one of David's descendants,
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ AWURADE nwa nyoo: Sona bɔ ɔkɔtena Yisrael awuro ama ahennie bia so ne, ɔngɔbɔ Dawide le,

english_verse: and there will always be priests from the Levi tribe serving at my altar and offering sacrifices to please me and to give thanks.
translation_verse: na sona bɔ ogyina me nyunu ɔbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, aburoo afɔleɛ ne afɔleɛ mɔ afebɔɔ ne, ɔngɔbɔ Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛte asɔfo ne le.”

english_verse: Then the Lord told me:
translation_verse: AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Yeremia kyɛ,

english_verse: I, the Lord, have an agreement with day and night, so they always come at the right time. You can't break the agreement I made with them,
translation_verse: “AWURADE nwa nyoo: Sɛ ɛmɔkɔhora bɛkɔsɛkye me ne eyia y’apam, yeɛ me ne kɔngɔen y’apam, amaa ɔnate so alehyeleɛ ne alesaleɛ bɛngɔwa mmerɛ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛba hɔ a,

english_verse: and you can't break the agreements I have made with David's family and with the priests from the Levi tribe who serve at my altar. A descendant of David will always rule as king of Israel,
translation_verse: ye de me ne me somvoɛ Dawide apam ne kɔhora kɔsɛkye, amaa ɔnate so ongonya baa bienzua bɔ ɔkɔtena ye ahennie bia so koli hene ɔ; na sɔ ala yeɛ me ne me somvoɛ mɔ Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛte asɔfo nemɔ y’apam ne ɔte ɔ.

english_verse: and there will be more descendants of David and of the priests from the Levi tribe than stars in the sky or grains of sand on the beach.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ bɛngɔhora ewienu nzramaa ka, ná bɛngɔhora mboanoa anweaa susu ne, sɔ alaa yeɛ ngɔmaa me somvoɛ Dawide ye boso ama, yeɛ Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛso me ne, bɛkɔta pee ɔ.”

english_verse: You've heard foreigners insult my people by saying, “The Lord chose Israel and Judah, but now he has rejected them, and they are no longer a nation.”
translation_verse: “Aso ɛttele kyɛ maen he bɛkekã kyɛ, ‘AWURADE apo mmusua nyɔ bɔ ɔneaneane nu yele bɛ ne’ ɔ? Ye sɔ ati, mmenia abu me maen animtia bɔ bemmu bɛ ko kyɛ bɛtte maen ɔ.

english_verse: Jeremiah, I will never break my agreement with the day and the night or let the sky and the earth stop obeying my commands.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE nwa nyoo: Sɛ me ne alehyeleɛ ne alesaleɛ y’apam, yeɛ anwuro ne aseɛ nhyehyɛleɛ ne, mamma bandindim a,

english_verse: In the same way, I will never reject the descendants of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob or break my promise that they will always have a descendant of David as their king. I will be kind to my people Israel, and they will be successful again.
translation_verse: ahaa ye de ngɔpo Yakob ne me somvoɛ Dawide bɛ boso ama, bɔ mengɔneanea nu mengɔye ye boso ama nemɔ anu ko maa ongoli hene wɔ Abraham, Yisake ne Yakob bɛ boso ama so ɔ. Ofikyɛ ngosa ngɔfa bɛ ngofi nnurehyelɛ nu ngɔwa, na ngonwu bɛ anwumvoin.”

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar had a large army made up of people from every kingdom in his empire. He and his army were attacking Jerusalem and all the nearby towns, when the Lord told me
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa ne ye koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraa ne aseɛ so ahennie amukoraa bɔ bewura ye bo, ɔne maen maen amukoraa bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtetale Yerusalem ne ye nwo nguro amukoraati ne, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Yeremia kyɛ,

english_verse: to say to King Zedekiah: I am the Lord, and I am going to let Nebuchadnezzar capture this city and burn it down.
translation_verse: “Bɔ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ kã ɛhe: Kɔ ná ɛne Yuda hene Sedekia beedwudwo, na se ye kyɛ, ‘Tie, ngɔfa kuro he ngowura Babilɔn hene sa, na ɔkɔto nu see kɔyera ye.

english_verse: You will be taken prisoner and brought to Nebuchadnezzar, and he will speak with you face to face. Then you will be led away to Babylonia.
translation_verse: Engonya wɔ ti ngodidi nu ngofi ye sa nu, na mmom ɛhyelɛ yeɛ bɛkɔhye wɔ bɛkɔfa wɔ bekowura ye sa ɔ. Wɔ nye kɔbɔ Babilɔn hene nyunu ma ye wora ye nye kɔbɔ wɔ nyunu. Ɔne wɔ bekodwudwo, na ɛkɔhɔ Babilɔn.

english_verse: You will die a peaceful death. People will mourn when you die, and they will light bonfires in your honor, just as they did for your ancestors, the kings who ruled before you.
translation_verse: na mmom ekowu asomdwee nu. Na kyɛbɔ bɛyerale ayirefona bɛmane wɔ nana mɔ bɔ belili wɔ nyunu moa belili hene ne, sɔ ala yeɛ mmenia kɔyera ayirefona bɛkɔma wɔ, ná basu wɔ kyɛ, “Yɛ mene, yaakɔ oo!” Ofikyɛ me yeɛ mahã edwirɛ ne ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: I went to Zedekiah and told him what the Lord had said.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yeremia hane sɔ dwirɛ ne amukoraa hyirele Yuda hene Sedekia wɔ Yerusalem,

english_verse: Meanwhile, the king of Babylonia was trying to break through the walls of Lachish, Azekah, and Jerusalem, the only three towns of Judah that had not been captured. The People Break a Promise
translation_verse: mmerɛ bɔ Babilɔn hene koɛhonɛfoɛ bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtetale Yerusalem ne Yuda nguro bɔ baha ne amukoraa, yeɛ Lakise ne Aseka ne; ofikyɛ bɛ ngome yeɛ né bɛte Yuda nguro bɔ baha bɔ babɔ bɛ nwo waen ɔ.

english_verse: King Zedekiah, his officials, and everyone else in Jerusalem made an agreement to free all Hebrew men and women who were slaves. No Jew would keep another as a slave. And so, all the Jewish slaves were given their freedom.
translation_verse: Na atitire nemɔ amukoraa ne maen ne amukoraa bɔ belele apam ne bɛtole nu kyɛ ebiala ɔyakyi ye kanganiɛ maa ɔfa ye nwo oli ne, kyɛ bienzua oo, kyɛ brasua oo, bɔ onni kyɛ ɔso bɛ ko ne, bɛ mukoraa bɛyɛle sotie, na bɛyakyili bɛ maa bɛfale bɛ nwo belili.

english_verse: That's when the Lord told me to say to the people:
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE dwirɛ fili AWURADE berɛ sele Yeremia kyɛ,

english_verse: I am the Lord God of Israel, and I made an agreement with your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt, where they had been slaves.
translation_verse: “AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Mmerɛ bɔ nyele ɛmɔ nana mɔ mvili ngoaasolɛ tebea nu wɔ Misraim aseɛ so mmale ne, me ne bɛ yɛyɛle apam kyɛ,

english_verse: As part of this agreement, you must let a Hebrew slave go free after six years of service. Your ancestors did not obey me,
translation_verse: ‘Afoɛ nzoo biala ayieleɛ, odi kyɛ ɛmɔ anu biala yakyi oliɛma Hebriniɛ biala bɔ batɔne ye bama wɔ, bɔ waso wɔ afoɛ nzia ɔ maa ɔfa ye nwo odi ofi wɔ sa nu.’ Nakoso ɛmɔ nana mɔ bandie me dwirɛ, yeɛ banyɛ asoɛ bamma me.

english_verse: but you decided to obey me and do the right thing by setting your Hebrew slaves completely free. You even went to my temple, and in my name you made an agreement to set them free. But you have abused my name, because you broke that agreement and forced your former slaves back into slavery.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔsesane ɛmɔ adwene bɛfale efiɛ bɛhane me dumaa, na ebiala osa ɔɔhyele ye kanganiɛ bienzua anaa brasua, bɔ wamaa wafa ye nwo wali kyɛbɔ né ye nye la so ne, na ɛmɔsa bɛfale bɛ bɛwale ngoaasolɛ nu maa bɛɛyɛle ɛmɔ nganga ne afaneɛ mɔ.

english_verse: You have disobeyed me by not giving your slaves their freedom. So I will give you freedom—the freedom to die in battle or from disease or hunger. I will make you disgusting to all other nations on earth.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE nwa nyoo: Ɛmɔandie me dwirɛ, na ebiala wamma oliɛma ne obiɛngo bannya bɛ fawɔnwodi. Nzaade AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛhe: Ɛ́mɔtie, me koso fawɔnwodi he yeɛ mefa mema ɛmɔ ɔ, kyɛ ngɔma ngrandɛ, ewue anwonyerɛ ne ɛhɔen kɔwa ɛmɔ so ɔ. Na ngɔmaa ɛmɔkɔyɛ anwodwiri nikyee wɔ aseɛ so ahennie amukoraa nu.

english_verse: You asked me to be a witness when you made the agreement to set your slaves free. And as part of the ceremony you cut a calf into two parts, then walked between the parts. But you people of Jerusalem have broken that agreement as well as my agreement with Israel. So I will do to you what you did to that calf.
translation_verse: Na mmenia bɔ babu m’apam ne aso, ná banni edwirɛ bɔ ɔwɔ apam bɔ bɛyɛle ye wɔ me nyunu ne aso ne, ngɔmaa bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ nandwie akrɔngrɔma bɔ bɛpakyele ye nu nyɔ bɛnatele bue nyɔ nemɔ b’afia ne,

english_verse: I will let your enemies take all of you prisoner, including the leaders of Judah and Jerusalem, the royal officials, the priests, and everyone else who walked between the two parts of the calf. These enemies will kill you and leave your bodies lying on the ground as food for birds and wild animals.
translation_verse: ngɔfa bɛ ngowura bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ ne mmenia bɔ bɛpena bɛ beku bɛ ɔ bɛ sa, na bɛ fuin kɔyɛ ewienu nnomaa ne aseɛ ye aso ngaka b’aleɛ.

english_verse: These enemies are King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia and his army. They have stopped attacking Jerusalem, but they want to kill King Zedekiah and his high officials. So I will command them to return and attack again. This time they will conquer the city and burn it down, and they will capture Zedekiah and his officials. I will also let them destroy the towns of Judah, so that no one can live there any longer.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, ngɔfa ahyɛdeɛ ngɔma, na ngosa ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa kuro ye aso, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne’. Bɛkɔfa koɛ bɛkɔteta kuro ye, bekoli so ngonim, na bɛkɔto nu see bɛkɔyera ye. Na ngɔma Yuda nguro nemɔ bɛkɔyɛ kurofoen bɔ sona fee ɔnne so ɔ.

english_verse: When Jehoiakim was king of Judah, the Lord told me,
translation_verse: Yuda hene Yehoakim bɔ ye baba ole Yosia ne, ye aberɛ so, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Yeremia kyɛ,

english_verse: “Go to the Rechabite clan and invite them to meet you in one of the side rooms of the temple. When they arrive, offer them a drink of wine.”
translation_verse: “Kɔ Rekabofoɛ nemɔ awuro, ná ɛne bɛ beedwudwo. Fa bɛ bra AWURADE awuro berɛ pumbu nemɔ ko anu, ná ma bɛ nzaa kyɛ bɛno.”

english_verse: So I went to Jaazaniah, the leader of the clan, and I invited him and all the men of his clan.
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔ mvale Yaasania bɔ ye baba ole Yeremia bɔ ye baba ole Habasinia, ɔne oliɛma mmienzua mɔ ne ye mma mmienzua amukoraa ne Rekabo abusua amukoraa.

english_verse: I brought them into the temple courtyard and took them upstairs to a room belonging to the prophets who were followers of Hanan son of Igdaliah. It was next to a room belonging to some of the officials, and that room was over the one belonging to Maaseiah, a priest who was one of the high officials in the temple.
translation_verse: Na mvale bɛ mmale Nyameɛ sona Yigidalia awa Hanan ye mma mmienzua nemɔ pumbu nu wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ. Sɔ pumbu ne, opingye atitire nemɔ pumbu, na ɔwɔ Maaseya bɔ ye baba ole anoa wɛmvoɛ Salum ye pumbu deɛ ne anwuro.

english_verse: I set out some large bowls full of wine together with some cups, and then I said to the Rechabites, “Have some wine!”
