english_verse: Our ancestors sinned, but they are dead, and we are left to pay for their sins.
translation_verse: Yɛ nana mɔ bayɔ bɔne, na bawuwu, na yɛ yeɛ yasoa b’amumuyɛɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Slaves are now our rulers, and there is no one to set us free.
translation_verse: Nganga mɔ yeɛ bedi yɛ so ɔ, na ebiala nne berɛ bɔ okole yɛ kofi bɛ sa nu ɔ.

english_verse: We are in danger from brutal desert tribes; we must risk our lives just to bring in our crops.
translation_verse: Yɛfa yɛ ngoa yɛto serewa koraka né yanya aleɛ yali, ɔnate ɛserɛ so ngrandɛ ne ati.

english_verse: Our skin is scorched from fever and hunger.
translation_verse: Yɛ nwonaen apini tunn kyɛ bokyea, ɔnate ɛhɔen kandinga ne ati.

english_verse: On Zion and everywhere in Judah our wives and daughters are being raped.
translation_verse: Bɛtole Sion mmrasua nemɔ mmɔnaa, yeɛ Yuda nguro nemɔ aso ndaluwa koso sɔ ala.

english_verse: Our rulers are strung up by their arms, and our nation's advisors are treated shamefully.
translation_verse: Bɛkyekye bɛ nnehyeɛ mɔ sa besinze berɛ beku bɛ, bɛmva anidie bɛmma mbanyi.

english_verse: Young men are forced to do the work of slaves; boys must carry heavy loads of wood.
translation_verse: Bɛhyɛle mmerandeɛ mɔ maa besili aburoo, na ngwadaa soa eyein bɔ bɛngora bɛ gya tu ɔ.

english_verse: Our leaders are not allowed to decide cases in court, and young people no longer play music.
translation_verse: Nworowaa mɔ bayakyi kuro berɛ pambim ne anu hɔlɛ, na mmerandeɛ bayakyi bɛ dweintolɛ ne.

english_verse: Our hearts are sad; instead of dancing, we mourn.
translation_verse: Y’ahone nu anigye atu amini, na y’abilie akakyi yealɛlilɛ.

english_verse: Zion's glory has disappeared! And we are doomed because of our sins.
translation_verse: Y’ahennie abotire ne, watu wafi yɛ ti so. Edwirɛ ato yɛ oo, ɔnate kyɛ yayɔ bɔne!

english_verse: We feel sick all over and can't even see straight;
translation_verse: Ɔnate ɛhe ati, yɛ wora abɔ. Ɛhemɔ ati, yɛ nye ayɛ musinamusina.

english_verse: our city is in ruins, overrun by wild dogs.
translation_verse: Sion bokaa ne ayɛ kurofoen, yiti eburo ngyea natenate so.

english_verse: You will rule forever, Lord! You are King for all time.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE, wɔ de ɛwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ; w’ahennie bia wɔ berɛ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: Bring us back to you! Give us a fresh start.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ma yɛ nye osa kakyi ɔbra wɔ berɛ, na yɛkosa yɛkɔwa. Maa yɛsa yɛpe yɛ daa nu.

english_verse: Or do you despise us so much that you don't want us?
translation_verse: Nakoso apo yɛ bɔkɔɔ, w’ahone ahu yɛ so paa.

english_verse: I saw a windstorm blowing in from the north. Lightning flashed from a huge cloud and lit up the whole sky with a dazzling brightness. The fiery center of the cloud was as shiny as polished metal,
translation_verse: Ndole me nye nneane, na yieee, mvrama piri bie tu fili sorɔ dɔ, munungum pirikua bie bɔ kanea hyireinn apɛ ye nwo ayia ɔ, bɔ ogye see ɔ, bɔ see n’afia ne ɔte kyɛ kɔɔbere bɔ ogye monyerɛnmonyerɛn ɔ.

english_verse: and in that center I saw what looked like four living creatures. They were somewhat like humans,
translation_verse: Yeɛ abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ bɛ sɛso nna befili see ne anu bɛwale. Sɔaa yeɛ né bɛ sue te ɔ: Né bɛ sue te kyɛ sona,

english_verse: except that each one had four faces and four wings.
translation_verse: nakoso né bɛ nu biala ye nyunu te nna, yeɛ né ebiala ye ndaa koso te nna.

english_verse: Their legs were straight, but their feet looked like the hoofs of calves and sparkled like bronze.
translation_verse: Né bɛ gya nemɔ tengyɛ fɔngɔnn, na bɛ gya kunu te kyɛ nandwie ba deɛ ne ala; na né bɛ nwo ta te kyɛ kɔɔbere bɔ bahwi ye nwo nahanaha ɔ.

english_verse: The four creatures were standing back to back with the tips of their wings touching. They moved together in every direction, without turning their bodies.
translation_verse: Bɛ ndaa ne, ko deɛ kɔkã obiɛngo deɛ; na bɛkɔ a, bɛkɔ bɛ nyunu tee bɔ ebiala ɔngakyi ye nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Each creature had the face of a human in front, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of a bull on the left, and the face of an eagle in back.
translation_verse: Sɔaa yeɛ bɛ nyunu ne osoma ɔ: Bɛ mmɛnna ne, ebiala le sona nyunu; ebiala le gyata nyunu wɔ ye famaa so; bɛ mmɛnna ne, ebiala le nandwie nyunu wɔ ye bɛen so, na ebiala le kɔleɛ nyunu [wɔ ye si].

english_verse: Two wings of each creature were spread out and touched the wings of the creatures on either side. The other two wings of each creature were folded against its body.
translation_verse: Sɔ yeɛ né bɛ nyunu te ɔ. Né bɛ ndaa ne anu trɛtrɛ kɔ anwuro; abɔdeɛ ko biala ndaa te nyɔ, na ndaa nyɔ ne, ko biala trɛ kɔkã obiɛngo deɛ, yeɛ bɛ ndaa nyɔ nyɔ katakata bɛ nwonaen ne anwo.

english_verse: The four living creatures went wherever the Spirit led them, and they moved together without turning their bodies, because each creature faced straight ahead.
translation_verse: Bɛ nu biala kɔ ye nyunu tee; nekaa bɔ sunzum ne kɔ ne, berɛ yeɛ bɛkɔ ɔ, na bɛngakyikakyi bɛ nwo.

english_verse: The creatures were glowing like hot coals, and I saw something like a flaming torch moving back and forth among them. Lightning flashed from the torch every time its flame blazed up.
translation_verse: Abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nemɔ bɛ sue ne, besoma see bɔ wasɔ gonn ɔ, besoma kanea bɔ ɔkɔ ye nyunu ne ye si wɔ abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nemɔ b’afia ɔ. Né see ne ta, na agralaa tete fili see ne anu.

english_verse: The creatures themselves moved as quickly as sparks jumping from a fire.
translation_verse: Né abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nemɔ bele amirika bedi akɔneaba kyɛ agralaa bɔ ɔte yerɛmyerɛm ɔ.

english_verse: I then noticed that on the ground beside each of the four living creatures was a wheel,
translation_verse: Na ngu so menea abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nemɔ nen, nwuni kango ko wɔ aseɛ so, bɔ ye nyunu nna ɔ, wɔ abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nemɔ nwo berɛ.

english_verse: so that they could move in any direction without turning.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛkɔ a, bɛfa bɛ bue nna ne yeɛ bɛnate ɔ, na bɛkɔ a, bɛngakyikakyi bɛ nwo.

english_verse: The rims of the wheels were large and frightening, and they had eyes all the way around them.
translation_verse: Na bɛ hangra ne, né ɔwale kɔ anwuro alaa maa ɔyɛ suro; na né anyeɛ tuatua bɛ mmɛnna nwo amukoraa bra yia.

english_verse: The creatures controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the four creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels were beside them.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛkɔ a, né bɛ koso bɛkɔ, yeɛ sɛ begyina a, né bɛ koso bagyina. Yeɛ sɛ bɛpagya bɛ nwo befi aseɛnwo a, kango nemɔ ne bɛ bɛpagya bɛ nwo, ofikyɛ abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ ne, ye sunzum wɔ kango nemɔ anu.

english_verse: Above the living creatures, I saw something that was sparkling like ice, and it reminded me of a dome. Each creature had two of its wings stretched out toward the creatures on either side, with the other two wings folded against its body.
translation_verse: Né batrɛtrɛ bɛ ndaa nu bɔ ebiala ndaa kɔkã obiɛngo deɛ wɔ nikyee tɛtrɛtɛɛ ne abo ɔ; na abɔdeɛ teasefoɛ nemɔ, né ebiala le ndaa nyɔ bɔ ɔkɔta ye nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Whenever the creatures flew, their wings roared like an ocean or a large army or even the voice of God All-Powerful. And whenever the creatures stopped, they folded their wings against their bodies.
translation_verse: Na bɛkɔ ne, ndele dede bɔ bɛ ndaa nemɔ yɔle ne, na né ɔte kyɛ asue mbiri bɔ bɛsẽ wuruwuru ɔ, kyɛ Tuminiɛ ne bɔ ɔbɔ nu kurudududu ɔ, kyɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ese ɔ. Na sɛ begyina a, né bahã bɛ ndaa ne ase.

english_verse: When the creatures stopped flapping their wings, I heard a sound coming from above the dome.
translation_verse: Na nikyee tɛtrɛtɛɛ bɔ ɔwɔ bɛ ti so anwuro ne, komviɛ bie fili nu wale; na begyinane, bɛhane bɛ ndaa ne beguale ase.

english_verse: I then saw what looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure in the shape of a human.
translation_verse: Nikyee tɛtrɛtɛɛ bɔ ɔwɔ bɛ ti so anwuro ne, né nikyee bie bɔ osoma ahennie bia bɔ bafa nyɔboɛ bɔ osoma safire bayɔ ɔ ɔwɔ ye ti so anwuro. Na nikyee bɔ osoma ahennie bia ne, né nikyee bie bɔ ye sue te kyɛ sona ɔ ɔwɔ so anwuro.

english_verse: From the waist up, it was glowing like metal in a hot furnace, and from the waist down it looked like the flames of a fire. The figure was surrounded by a bright light,
translation_verse: Na nekaa bɔ osoma ye sisia ne, ye anwuro, nwuni nikyee bie te kyɛ kɔɔbere bɔ ogye ɔ, kyɛ see bɔ ogye bra yia ɔ. Yeɛ bɔ osoma ye sisia ne, ye aseɛnwo wora, nwuni nikyee bie bɔ ɔte kyɛ see ɔ, na né wata wabra wayia ye nwo.

english_verse: as colorful as a rainbow that appears after a storm. I realized I was seeing the brightness of the Lord's glory! So I bowed with my face to the ground, and just then I heard a voice speaking to me.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ nyangondoen bɔ ɔwɔ munungum nu, wɔ kyẽa bɔ esue tɔ ɔ osi te ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ye nwo bɔ né wata hyireinn wabra wayia ne, ɔte ɔ. Ye sɛso ne, osoma AWURADE animnyam ne. Na nwuni ye ne, mvale me nyunu mmutuli berɛ, na ndele bɔ odwudwo ne komvi.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, I want you to stand up and listen.”
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, “Sona awa, dwɔso gyina wɔ gya so maa nga edwirɛ ngyire wɔ.”

english_verse: After he said this, his Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ odwudwo hyirele me ne, Sunzum ne wurale me nu, na ɔpagyale me maa ngyinane me gya so, na ndele kyɛ odwudwo kyire me ɔ.

english_verse: Ezekiel, I am sending you to the people of Israel. They are just like their ancestors who rebelled against me and refused to stop.
translation_verse: Osele me kyɛ, “Sona awa, mésoma wɔ wɔ Yisraelfoɛ berɛ, ɛlɔenyɛlɛ maen bɔ bayɛ me nwo lɔen ne berɛ; bɛ ne bɛ nana mɔ yeɛ batiatia me mmeraa so maa waadwu ɛnɛ ɔ.

english_verse: They are stubborn and hardheaded. But I, the Lord God, have chosen you to tell them what I say.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛte aniammɔwoho ne asoserɛfoɛ mmenia, na mésoma wɔ bɛ berɛ maa ekose bɛ kyɛ, ‘Bɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ ɔkã hɔ ɛhe oo.’

english_verse: Those rebels may not even listen, but at least they will know that a prophet has come to them.
translation_verse: Na sɛ betie oo, sɛ bandie oo, , kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ biala, bekonwu kyɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ wɔ bɛ nu.

english_verse: Don't be afraid of them or of anything they say. You may think you're in the middle of a thorn patch or a bunch of scorpions. But be brave
translation_verse: Na wɔ, Sona awa, nnɛsuro bɛ, yeɛ nnɛsuro bɛ noa dwirɛ. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛfone ne agurɛ nu yeɛ ɛla ɔ, yeɛ anyanyangyeleɛ mɔ nu yeɛ ɛte ɔ de, nakoso nnɛsuro bɛ noa dwirɛ, yeɛ nnɛsuro bɛ nyunu, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛte abusua bɔ bayɛ lɔen ɔ de.

english_verse: and preach my message to them, whether they choose to listen or not.
translation_verse: Na sɛ betie oo, sɛ bandie oo, wɔ de kã me noa dwirɛ ne kyire bɛ, ofikyɛ bɛte abusua bɔ bayɛ lɔen ɔ.

english_verse: Ezekiel, don't rebel against me, as they have done. Instead, listen to everything I tell you. And now, Ezekiel, open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.
translation_verse: “Na wɔ, Sona awa, tie bɔ méka mékyire wɔ ye. Nnɛyɛ lɔen kyɛ sɔ ɛlɔenyɛlɛ abusua ne. Bukye wɔ noa nu, ná di bɔ méfa méma wɔ ye.”

english_verse: Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll.
translation_verse: Na nneane nen, yieee, asaa bie tengyɛle wɔ me so, na nwuni kyɛ né otira nwomaa bɔ babobɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.
translation_verse: Ɔtrɛle nu wɔ me nyunu berɛ. Né bahyerɛ ye nyunu ne ye si, na né nu ahyerɛlɛ ne ɔte awuyebɔlɛ, esuɛ ne yealɛlilɛ.

english_verse: He handed me the scroll and said, “Eat this and fill up on it.” So I ate the scroll, and it tasted sweet as honey.
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, “Sona awa, nwomaa he bɔ mabobɔ, bɔ mafa mama wɔ ne, di maa wɔ ko yi.” Yiti nnili, na ɔyɛle me noa nu menemene kyɛ woɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, I am sending you to your own people.
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, “Sona awa, kɔ Yisrael awuro ama berɛ, ná kɔhã me dwirɛ ne kyire bɛ.

english_verse: They are Israelites, not some strangers who speak a foreign language you can't understand. If I were to send you to foreign nations, they would listen to you.
translation_verse: Nna maen pee bɔ ɛnde bɛ dwudwolɛ, anaa bɔ bɛ dwudwolɛ ne ɔyɛ se, bɔ yeɛ ɛnde bɛ dwudwolɛ ɔ bɛ berɛ ɔ. Amba, sɛ bɛ berɛ po yeɛ nzomane wɔ a, ahaa bekotie wɔ.

english_verse: But the people of Israel will refuse to listen, because they have refused to listen to me. All of them are stubborn and hardheaded,
translation_verse: Nakoso Yisrael awuro ama de, bengotie wɔ, ofikyɛ benguro kyɛ bekotie me; ofikyɛ Yisrael awuro ama amukoraa bɛte aniammɔwoho ne asoserɛ.

english_verse: Then go to the people who were brought here to Babylonia with you and tell them you have a message from me, the Lord God. Do this, whether they listen to you or not.
translation_verse: Si nu kɔ mmenia bɔ bahye bɛ nnure bahɔ ne berɛ, wɔ maen mmaa nemɔ berɛ kɔhã kyire bɛ. Sɛ betie oo, sɛ bandie oo, kã kyire bɛ kyɛ, ‘Bɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ kã hɔ ɛhe.’ ”

english_verse: The Spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord started to leave, I heard a loud, thundering noise behind me.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Sunzum ne mane me so, na ndele komviɛ bie bɔ ɔma aseɛ woso ɔ wɔ me si dɔ kyɛ, “Asennaa te AWURADE animnyam ne deɛ wɔ ye atenaleɛ berɛ!”

english_verse: It was the sound made by the creatures' wings as they brushed against each other, and by the rumble of the wheels beside them.
translation_verse: Na dede bɔ abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nemɔ bɛ ndaa bɔ otwitwi ye nwo ne ɔyɔ ne, ndele; yeɛ ndele bɛ nwo kango nemɔ bɛ dede ne, ɔne dede bɔ ɔma aseɛ woso ne.

english_verse: Then the Spirit carried me away. The Lord's power had taken complete control of me, and I was both annoyed and angry.
translation_verse: Sunzum ne mane me so fale me hɔle, na ngɔle ye yealɛlilɛ nu, ɔne sunzum nu anyeborolɛ so, na né AWURADE tumi ne wɔ me so paa.

english_verse: When I was back with the others living at Abib Hill near the Chebar River, I sat among them for seven days, shocked at what had happened to me. The Lord Appoints Ezekiel To Stand Watch (Ezekiel
translation_verse: Yeɛ bɛ bɔ bahye bɛ nnure bahɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Tel Abibo, bɔ bɛtete asue Kebare noa ne, mmale bɛ berɛ. Ndenane nekaa bɔ bɛte ne ɛlɛsoo, na me nwo dwirili me. Nyameɛ fa Hesekia si Yisrael so wɛmvoɛ (Hesekiel

english_verse: Seven days after I had seen the brightness of the Lord's glory, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Na ɛlɛsoo pɛle nu ne, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.
translation_verse: “Sona awa, mafa wɔ mayɛ Yisrael awuro ama so wɛmvoɛ; yiti tie me noa dwirɛ, ná fa bɔ bɛ kɔkɔ ma me.

english_verse: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways so they won't be punished. If you refuse, you are responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Sɛ mekã mekyire bɔnefoɛ kyɛ, ‘Ewue yeɛ ekowu ɔ,’ ná ammɔ ye kɔkɔ, anaa anga angyire bɔnefoɛ ne maa wandwe ye nwo wamvi ye bɔne nwo, amaa ɔnate so wannya ngoa a, ye de sɔ bɔnefoɛ ne kowu ye amumuyɛɛ nu de; nakoso ye mogya de, wɔ berɛ yeɛ ngobisa ngofi ɔ.

english_verse: However, if you do warn them, and they keep on sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɛbɔ bɔnefoɛ ne kɔkɔ, ná mmom wandwe ye nwo wamvi ye bɔne nwo, anaa ye amumuyɛɛ nwo a, ye de okowu ye amumuyɛɛ nu, nakoso wɔ de, apepɛ ale wɔ kra.

english_verse: Now suppose faithful people start sinning, and I decide to put stumbling blocks in their paths to make them fall. They deserve to die because of their sins. So if you refuse to warn them, I will forget about the times they were faithful, and I will hold you responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Yeɛ sɛ teneneeniɛ odi ye tenenee nwo makyebu ɔkɔyɔ amumuyɛɛ, ná mefa sundidua meto ye atee nu a, okowu. Na ɔnate kyɛ ammɔ ye kɔkɔ ne ati, okowu ye bɔne nu, na bɛngɔkaye ye tenenee bra bɔ ɔbɔle ne; nakoso ye mogya de, wɔ berɛ yeɛ ngobisa ngofi ɔ.

english_verse: But if you do warn them, and they listen to you and stop sinning, I will let them live. And you will be innocent. Ezekiel Cannot Talk
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɛbɔ teneneeniɛ kɔkɔ kyɛ nnɛmaa ɔyɔ bɔne, ná wanyɔ bɔne a, ye de okonya ngoa amba, ofikyɛ otiele kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne, na wɔ wora apepɛ ale wɔ kra.” Hesekia tɔ mumu

english_verse: The Lord took control of me and said, “Stand up! Go into the valley, and I will talk with you there.”
translation_verse: AWURADE tumi ne wale me so wɔ berɛ, na osele me kyɛ, “Dwɔso, si nu kɔ bɔnza ne anu dɔ, na dɔ yeɛ me ne wɔ yɛkodwudwo ɔ.”

english_verse: I immediately went to the valley, where I saw the brightness of the Lord's glory, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River, and I bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: Yiti ndwɔsole nzili nu ngɔle bɔnza ne anu, na yieee, né AWURADE animnyam ne gyi berɛ, bɔ ɔte kyɛ animnyam bɔ nwuni ye wɔ asue Kebare noa ne ala ɔ; na mvale me nyunu mmutuli ase.

english_verse: His Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said: Go back and lock yourself in your house!
translation_verse: Yeɛ Sunzum ne wurale me nu, na ɔmaa ngyinane me gya so, na ɔne me dwudwole, na osele me kyɛ, “Kɔ ná kɔto wɔ nwo anoa nu wɔ w’awuro.

english_verse: and I will make you unable to talk or to warn those who have rebelled against me.
translation_verse: Ngɔma wɔ temverema kɔmata wɔ nnaalɔ, na ɛkɔtɔ mumu bɔ ɛngɔhora bɛ nyunu twi ɔ, ofikyɛ bɛte abusua bɔ bayɛ lɔen ɔ.

english_verse: But the time will come, when I will tell you what to say, and you will again be able to speak my message. Some of them will listen; others will be stubborn and refuse to listen.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ me ne wɔ yɛdwudwo a, ngɔsangye wɔ temverema nyamaa ne maa ekose bɛ kyɛ, ‘Bɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ ɔkã hɔ ɛhe.’ Bɔ okotie ne, maa otie, yeɛ bɔ ongotie ne koso, yakyi ye, ofikyɛ bɛte abusua bɔ bayɛ lɔen ɔ.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, find a brick and sketch a picture of Jerusalem on it.
translation_verse: “Wɔ, Sona awa, fa nyɔboɛ tafaa to wɔ nyunu, kolikoli Yerusalem kuro ne gua so;

english_verse: Then prepare to attack the brick as if it were a real city. Build a dirt mound and a ramp up to the top and surround the brick with enemy camps. On every side put large wooden poles as though you were going to break down the gate to the city.
translation_verse: tua kuro ne, yɔ nyinasoɛ bɔ bɛkɔfo so bɛkɔhɔ kuro ne anu ɔ, boaboa anweaa sire wɔ ye si, kyekye asikyeleɛ pɛ ye nwo bra yia, ná fa nikyee bɔ bɛfa bedwiri fasue begua ɔ pɛ ye nwo bra yia.

english_verse: Set up an iron pan like a wall between you and the brick. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Afei fa buralɛ tɛtrɛtɛɛ, fa yɛ buralɛ fasue wɔ wɔ ne kuro ne b’afia, fa wɔ nye kyire ye, maa ɔyɛ kuro bɔ batua ye ɔ, ná tua ye serɛserɛ. Na ɛhe kɔyɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ kɔma Yisrael awuro ama.

english_verse: The brick stands for Jerusalem, so attack it! Stare at it and shout angry warnings.
translation_verse: Afei, fa wɔ nye kyire Yerusalem bɔ batua ye ne, bɔ wɔ sa nwo te kwaterekwa ɔ, ná hyɛ ngɔm tia kuro ne.

english_verse: Get a large bowl. Then mix together wheat, barley, beans, lentils, and millet, and make some bread. This is what you will eat for the
translation_verse: “Wɔ, fa atokoɔ, ayuo, aluaa, ngongo, aburoo ne ɛmo. Fa gua kukue ko anu, ná fa yɛ aleɛ. Na ngyẽa somaa bɔ ɛla hyerewaa so, bɔ ɔte ngyẽa ɛyaa nza ne aburahona ne, ye yeɛ ekoli ɔ.

english_verse: Use dried human waste to start a fire, then bake the bread on the coals where everyone can watch you.
translation_verse: Di sɔ aleɛ ne kyɛbɔ edi ayuo apiti ne ala. Fa sona ye bondua bɔ wahɔ ɔ kua see, ná toto sɔ aleɛ ne wɔ so wɔ bɛ nyunu berɛ.”

english_verse: When I scatter the people of Israel among the nations, they will also have to eat food that is unclean, just as you must do.
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE sele kyɛ, “Sɔ ala yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ bekoli b’aleɛ bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ, wɔ maen maen mɔ bɔ ngɔsoa bɛ ngɔhɔ so nemɔ anu ɔ.”

english_verse: I said, “Lord God, please don't make me do that! Never in my life have I eaten food that would make me unacceptable to you. I've never eaten anything that died a natural death or was killed by a wild animal or that you said was unclean.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ nzele kyɛ, “Ao, AWURADE Nyameɛ, me kra nwo ogguale fiɛ le; ofi me ngwadaa nu bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ɔ, nnnili kaka bɔ ye bɔbɔ wawu ɔ anaa bɔ kaka bie ahye ye ɔ le, yeɛ akyiwadeɛ naen biala ɔhhane me noa le.”

english_verse: The Lord replied, “Instead of human waste, I will let you bake your bread on a fire made from cow manure.
translation_verse: Yeɛ osele me kyɛ, “Yoo, mate. Nzaade ngɔmaa ɛkɔfa nandwie bii ekosi sona bondua gya nu, ná ato w’aleɛ ne wɔ so.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Jerusalem will starve. They will have so little food and water that they will be afraid and hopeless.
translation_verse: Osa sele me kyɛ, “Sona awa, tie, nekaa bɔ Yerusalem onya ye aleɛ fi ne, ngɔma ye bo kɔpɛ; na bɛkɔfa ahunundetelɛ bɛkɔkari aleɛ kaaba bie bekoli, na bɛkɔfa anwodwiri yeɛ bekosusu bɛ nzue bɛkɔno ɔ;

english_verse: Everyone will be shocked at what is happening, and, because of their sins, they will die a slow death.”
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so aleɛ ne nzue nwo ayɛ se ama bɛ; na ebiala nwu obiɛngo a, ye nwo kɔyɛ ye anwodwiri, na ɔnate bɛ bɔne ti bɛkɔfɔ bɛkɔtete.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a sharp sword and use it to cut off your hair and beard. Weigh the hair and divide it into three equal piles.
translation_verse: “Na wɔ, Sona awa, fa ngrandɛ nnaennaen, fa yɛ sona bɔ ɔye tire ɔ ye dɛmaa, ná fa poa wɔ ti nwiaa ne wɔ kanza. Fa tonyi kari nwiaa ne, ná kyɛ nu.

english_verse: After you attack the brick that stands for Jerusalem, burn one pile of your hair on the brick. Chop up the second pile and let the small pieces of hair fall around the brick. Throw the third pile into the wind, and I will strike it with my own sword.
translation_verse: Nu ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko ne, mmerɛ bɔ kuro ne tualɛ ne kɔwa ayieleɛ ne, fa see yera ye wɔ kuro n’afia berɛ. Ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko wora, fa ngrandɛ pepɛ nu wɔ kuro ne anwo bra yia. Yeɛ ngyɛmuɛ nza bɔ waha ne koso, pete gua mvrama nu, na ngɔhwe ngrandɛ ngɔfa ngɔfoa bɛ.

english_verse: Keep a few of the hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes.
translation_verse: Fa enwiaa ne anu kãa bie, ná fa kyekye w’ataadeɛ ne noa.

english_verse: Then pull out a few of those hairs and throw them in the fire, so they will also burn. This fire will spread, destroying everyone in Israel.
translation_verse: Sa fa enwiaa ne anu bie, gyi gua see ne anu yera ye wɔ nu. Na see kofi nu kɔsɔ kɔhɔ Yisrael awuro ama amukoraa so.

english_verse: I am the Lord God, and I have made Jerusalem the most important place in the world, and all other nations admire it.
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Yerusalem ɛhe; mafa ye magyina maen maen mɔ b’afia, bɔ aseɛ mɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia ɔ.

english_verse: But the people of Jerusalem rebelled and refuse to obey me. They ignored my laws and have become even more sinful than the nations around them.
translation_verse: Ɔnate amumuyɛɛ so wayɛ me nhyehyɛleɛ nwo lɔen watra maen maen mɔ; yeɛ m’ahyɛdeɛ koso, wayɛ ye nwo lɔen watra aseɛ mɔ bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia ne; ofikyɛ wapo me mmeraa, yeɛ wanni me dwirɛ so.

english_verse: So tell the people of Jerusalem: I am the Lord God! You have refused to obey my laws and teachings, and instead you have obeyed the laws of the surrounding nations. You have become more rebellious than any of them!
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔayɛ lɔen piri batra maen maen mɔ bɔ bapɛ ɛmɔ nwo bayia, ná ɛmɔanni me dwirɛ so, anaa me mmeraa so, na mmom ɛmɔali maen maen mɔ bɔ bapɛ ɛmɔ nwo bayia ne bɛ mmeraa so ne ati,

english_verse: Now all those nations will watch as I turn against you and punish you
translation_verse: yiti AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Tie, me ne wɔ yɛkoli, na ngɔhwe wɔ so bɔ maen maen mɔ bɛ nye tua ɔ

english_verse: for your sins. Your punishment will be more horrible than anything I've ever done or will ever do again.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate w’akyiwadeɛ yɔleɛ ne amukoraa ne ati, kyɛbɔ ngosi ngɔhwe wɔ so ne, nnyɔle sɔ bie le, yeɛ mengɔyɔ sɔ bie le ko.

english_verse: Parents will be so desperate for food that they will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. Those who survive this horror will be scattered in every direction.
translation_verse: Yiti seɛ mɔ bekoli bɛ mma mmienzua mɔ naen wɔ wɔ nu, yeɛ mmaa mmienzua wora bekoli seɛ mɔ naen. Ngɔhwe wɔ so, na bɛ bɔ bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ne amukoraa, ngɔto bɛ ngɔpete mvrama mukoraa nu.

english_verse: Your sins have disgusted me and made my temple unfit as a place to worship me. So I swear by my own life that I will cut you down and show you no pity.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ nde ase ye de, nahorɛ nu, ɔnate kyɛ afa wɔ bra fiɛ amukoraa ne akyiwadeɛ yɔleɛ amukoraa agua me nekaa krongron ne anwo fiɛ ne ati, me koso ngɔye me sa ngofi wɔ bo, bɔ mengɔkorɔkorɔ wɔ anaa mengonwu wɔ anwumvoin ɔ, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: A third of you will die here in Jerusalem from disease or starvation. Another third will be killed in war. And I will scatter the last third of you in every direction, then track you down and kill you.
translation_verse: Ewue anwonyerɛ ne ɛhɔen kohũhũ ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko wɔ wɔ nu; ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko koso bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa wɔ wɔ fasue ne asi; yeɛ ngyɛmuɛ nza bɔ waha ne wora, ngɔbɔ bɛ ngɔpete mvrama mukoraa nu, na ngɔhwe ngrandɛ ngɔfoa bɛ.

english_verse: You will feel my fierce anger until I have finished taking revenge. Then you will know that I, the Lord, was furious because of your disobedience.
translation_verse: “Sɔ yeɛ me yaafɛlɛ ne kɔyɔ bɛ nwo adwuma koyie ɔ, m’ahone kohu bɛ so maa m’ahone kɔtɔ nzue nu. Na sɛ m’ahone hu bɛ so a, yeɛ bekonwu ye kyɛ me, AWURADE, me nungunɛhwenɛ nu yeɛ mahã ɔ.

english_verse: will insult you and make fun of you, but they will also be shocked and terrified at what I did in my anger.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mebua wɔ ndɛen wɔ ahonehulɛ ne anyeborolɛ so, ná metwe wɔ so serɛserɛ a, ɛkɔkakyi animguaseɛ, ngorohoɛ nikye, kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne edwirɛ nwanwa kɔma maen maen bɔ bapɛ wɔ nwo bayia nemɔ; me AWURADE, me yeɛ mahã ɔ.

english_verse: I will destroy your crops until you starve to death, and disasters will strike you like arrows.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mema ɛhɔen ba bɛ so kyɛ agyaen suronyisuronyi, bɔ okohũhũ bɛ, bɔ ngɔto ngohũ ɛmɔ ne: ngɔma ɛmɔkɔhɔ so bekoli hɔen, na ngɔma nekaa bɔ ɛmɔnya b’aleɛ ɔ ye bo kɔpɛ.

english_verse: Starvation and wild animals will kill your children. I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and your enemies will strike you down with their swords. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ngɔsoma ɛhɔen piri ne ngaka aboyaa maa bɛkɔwa ɛmɔ so, bɛkɔma ɛmɔ mma mɔ bekofi ɛmɔ sa, ɛmɔkonwu ewue anwonyerɛ ne mogya, na ngɔfa ngrandɛ ne ngɔwa ɛmɔ so. Me, AWURADE, me yeɛ mahã sɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, face the hills of Israel and tell them:
translation_verse: “Sona awa, fa wɔ nye kyire Yisrael mmokaa nemɔ, ná hyɛ ngɔm tia bɛ,

english_verse: Listen, you mountains and hills, and every valley and gorge! I, the Lord, am about to turn against you and crush all the places where foreign gods are worshiped.
translation_verse: ná kã kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔ, Yisrael mmokaa, ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ. Bɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ ɔkã kyire mmokaa ne pambaa mɔ, asue mɔ ne bɔnza mɔ ɛhe: Ɛ́mɔtie, me, mebaafa ngrandɛ meba ɛmɔ so, na ngɔsɛkye ɛmɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: Every altar will be smashed, and in front of the idols I will put to death the people who worship them.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ afɔleɛ mmokyea nemɔ kodwiri kogua, ngobubu ɛmɔ mmosoen nemɔ, na ngogyi ɛmɔ mmenia bɔ batotɔ ne ngogua ɛmɔ mmosoen nemɔ anyunu.

english_verse: Dead bodies and bones will be lying around the idols and the altars.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa Yisraelfoɛ bɛ fuin nemɔ ngogua bɛ mmosoen nemɔ anyunu, ná mato ɛmɔ mmowue mapete ɛmɔ afɔleɛ mmokyea nemɔ anwo mabra mayia.

english_verse: Every town in Israel will be destroyed to make sure that each shrine, idol, and altar is smashed—everything the Israelites made will be a pile of ruins.
translation_verse: Kuro biala bɔ ɛmɔte so ne, ɔkɔkakyi kurofoen, ɛmɔ asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ kɔsɛkye kɔlela berɛ mbaen, na ɛmɔ afɔleɛ mmokyea nemɔ kodwiri kogua kɔsɛkye; ngobubu ɛmɔ mmosoen nemɔ ngogua ngɔsɛkye bɛ, ngobubu ɛmɔ amoen nemɔ ngogua, na ngɔsɛkye ɛmɔ sa noa adwuma nemɔ.

english_verse: All over the country, your people will die. And those who survive will know that I, the Lord, did these things.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ batotɔ ne, bɛkɔlela ɛmɔ nu, na ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: I will let some of the people live through this punishment, but I will scatter them among the nations,
translation_verse: “Nakoso ngɔma ɛmɔ nu biemɔ konya bɛ ti bekodidi nu. Bɛkɔnwati bekofi ngrandɛ noa bɛkɔhɔ maen maen nemɔ anu, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɛkɔbɔ aya bɛkɔhɔ maen maen mɔ so ne.

english_verse: where they will be prisoners. And when they think of me, they will realize that they disgraced me by rebelling and by worshiping idols. They will hate themselves for the evil things they did,
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ nu mmenia bɔ bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ne, bɛkɔkaye me wɔ maen maen bɔ bahye bɛ nnure bahɔ so nemɔ aso, ofikyɛ ngɔbrɛ b’adwaman ahone bɔ wapo me ne ase, yeɛ ngosi bɛ nye bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ adwaman bedi bɛ mmosoen mɔ si ne. Na bɔne bɔ bayɔ, ɔne akyiwadeɛ mukoraa bɔ bayɔ ne, ɔkɔma bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nwo kɔyɛ bɛ tɛ.

english_verse: and they will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings must be taken seriously.
translation_verse: Na bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE; na edwirɛ bɔ mahã, kyɛ ngɔprapra sɔ musue he ngogua bɛ so ne, manga ye mbaen.”

english_verse: The Lord God then said: Ezekiel, beat your fists together and stomp your feet in despair! Moan in sorrow, because the people of Israel have done disgusting things and now will be killed by enemy troops, or they will die from starvation and disease.
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, “Bɔ wɔ sa nu, fa wɔ gya pem pem berɛ, ná kã kyɛ, ‘Aa!’ Ɔnate Yisrael awuro ama b’akyiwadeɛ bɔne bɔ bayɔ ne amukoraa ti ɔ; ofikyɛ bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa, na ɛhɔen ne ewue anwonyerɛ kohũhũ bɛ.

english_verse: Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them!
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔwɔ dedeede ne, ewue anwonyerɛ yeɛ okohũ ye ɔ; bɔ opingye ne, ngrandɛ noa yeɛ ɔkɔtɔ ɔ; na bɔ waha bɔ mamaa wanya ye ti wadidi nu ne, ɛhɔen yeɛ ɔkɔmaa okowu ɔ. Sɔ yeɛ me yaafɛlɛ ne kɔyɔ bɛ nwo adwuma koyie ɔ.

english_verse: These people used to offer incense to idols at altars built on hills and mountaintops and in the shade of large oak trees. But when they see dead bodies lying around those altars, they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE, mmerɛ bɔ bɛ mmenia kɔtotɔ kɔlela bɛ mmosoen nemɔ afia, bɔ bɛkɔpɛ b’afɔleɛ mmokyea nemɔ anwo bɛkɔbra bekoyia ne, wɔ pambaa tendenn biala so, wɔ mmokaa mukoraa bɛ ti afia ne, wɔ bakaa monɛ biala bo, wɔ eluii kusuu mukoraa bo, nekaa biala bɔ bɛbɔle ayirefona afɔleɛ bɛmane bɛ mmosoen nemɔ amukoraa ne.

english_verse: I will make their country a barren wasteland, from the Southern Desert to the town of Diblah in the north. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Ngɔtengyɛ me sa ngɔhwe bɛ so, ngɔkakyi aseɛ ne kurofoen wɔ nekaa biala bɔ bɛte ɔ, yoo, ɔkɔyɛ pralaa kɔtra ɛserɛ so bɔ ɔkwaadwu Diblata ne. Na afei bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.”

english_verse: The Lord God said:
translation_verse: AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that I am saying: Israel will soon come to an end! Your whole country is about to be destroyed
translation_verse: “Wɔ, Sona awa, bɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ ɔkã kyire Yisrael maen hɔ ɛhe: Ayieleɛ! Aseɛ ndweasoɛ nna ne, b’ayieleɛ yeɛ wato bɛ ne.

english_verse: that I will show no pity. I will punish you for the evil you've done, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mengɔkorɔkorɔ wɔ, yeɛ mengonwu wɔ anwumvoin, na mmom ngɔhwe wɔ so wɔ wɔ yɔleɛ nwo, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ w’akyiwadeɛ yɔleɛ tɛwɔ wɔ nu ɔ, na afei ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: There's never been anything like the coming disaster.
translation_verse: “AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Musue! Nea, musue yeɛ ɔ́ba ne!

english_verse: And when it comes, your life will be over.
translation_verse: Ayieleɛ awa, ayieleɛ ne awa! Wadwɔso ɔ́ba wɔ so, nea kyɛ ɔ́ba ɔ!

english_verse: You people of Israel are doomed! Soon there will be panic on the mountaintops instead of celebration.
translation_verse: Ao, wɔ bɔ ɛte aseɛ ne aso ɔ, w’ayieleɛ ne awa. Mmerɛ ne adwu, kyẽa ne apingye, ɔte amaneɛ mmerɛ, na mmom ɔtte mmokaa so ahurusililɛ mmerɛ ko.

english_verse: I will let loose my anger and punish you for the evil things you've done. You'll get what you deserve.
translation_verse: Ɔngɔhyɛ biala, ngɔma m’ahone bɔ wahu ne kɔwa wɔ so, ngɔfɛ wɔ so yaa, ngobua wɔ ndɛen kyɛbɔ wɔ yɔleɛ te ɔ, na ngɔhwe wɔ so wɔ w’akyiwadeɛ yɔleɛ amukoraa nwo.

english_verse: Your sins are so terrible, that you'll get no mercy from me. Then you will know that I, the Lord, have punished you.
translation_verse: Mengɔkorɔkorɔ wɔ, yeɛ mengonwu wɔ anwumvoin, na mmom ngɔhwe wɔ so wɔ wɔ yɔleɛ nwo, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ w’akyiwadeɛ yɔleɛ tɛwɔ wɔ nu ɔ, na afei ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE bɔ metwe asoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and violent criminals run free. None of you will survive the disaster, and everything you own and value will be shattered.
translation_verse: Atutureasɛm wanyi wakakyi amumuyɛɛ mbire; bɛ nu biala ngonya ye ti ngodidi nu, b’ɛlɔen ne anu ko po, b’anwonyadeɛ ne anu ko po, na bɛngɔyɛ nhyɛsoɛ ko.

english_verse: and people who sell property will never get it back, because all of you must be punished for your sins. And I won't change my mind!
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔyɛ nningyein atɔen ne, sɛ ɔtɛ te ase a, ye sa ngɔhã bɔ watɔne ye ne ko, ofikyɛ nyekyire bɔ ɔfa b’anwonya mukoraa nwo ne, ɔngɔsesã. Na ɔnate b’amumuyɛɛ ti, ebiala ngonya ye ti ngoa.

english_verse: War, disease, and starvation are everywhere! People who live in the countryside will be killed in battle, and those who live in towns will die from starvation or deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Ngrandɛ wɔ eburo, yeɛ ewue anwonyerɛ ne ɛhɔen wɔ kuro; bɔ ɔwɔ buro ne, ɔkɔtɔ ngrandɛ noa; yeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ kuro ne koso, ɛhɔen ne ewue anwonyerɛ kohũ ye.

english_verse: Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety. All of you will moan because of your sins.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bɛkɔnwati bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ne, bɛkɔhɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso kyɛ bɔnza nu mmubure, na ɔnate bɛ mukoraa b’amumuyɛɛ ti, ebiala kɔpene.

english_verse: Your hands will tremble, and your knees go limp.
translation_verse: Asaa mukoraa nu kɔyɛ hodwoo, nangoroma mukoraa kɔyɛ mmerɛ kyɛ nzue.

english_verse: You will put on sackcloth to show your sorrow, but terror will overpower you. Shame will be written all over your faces, and you will shave your heads in despair.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔhera ɛsɛen tena, na ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ bɛ so. Bɛ mukoraa bɛ nyunu kogua ase, na bɛ mukoraa bɛ ti so kɔpa.

english_verse: Your silver and gold will be thrown into the streets like garbage, because those are the two things that led you into sin, and now they cannot save you from my anger. They are not even worth enough to buy food.
translation_verse: Bekogyi b’ɛdwetɛ bekogua mmorɔnoɛ so, bekobu bɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ kyɛ ye nwo agua fiɛ. Na b’ɛdwetɛ ne bɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ ne, ɔngɔhora ngɔpepɛ ngole bɛ wɔ AWURADE ahonehulɛ kyẽa ne. Bɛngɔhora ngɔma bɛ kra ko ngoyi, anaa ɔngɔma bɛ ko ngoyi; ofikyɛ ɔte amumuyɛɛ bɔ ɔto bɛ sundidua ɔ.

english_verse: You took great pride in using your beautiful jewelry to make disgusting idols of foreign gods. So I will make your jewelry worthless.
translation_verse: Bɛfale bɛ mbembenanneɛ nyemene nemɔ bɛhoahoale bɛ nwo, bɛfa bɛyɔle akyiwadeɛ amoen mɔ, bɔ ɔte bɛ nningyein bɔ mekyi ne. Ye sɔ ati, ngɔmaa ɔkɔkakyi bɛ so akyiwadeɛ nikye.

english_verse: They will break into my temple and leave it unfit as a place to worship me, but I will look away and let it happen.
translation_verse: Ngɔye me nye ngɔto buro bɔ mengɔtɛ bɛ so ɔ, amaa ɔnate so bagua me nekaa krongron ne anwo fiɛ, na awerɔm awuefoɛ kowura nu kogua ye nwo fiɛ.

english_verse: Your whole country is in confusion! Murder and violence are everywhere in Israel,
translation_verse: Yɔ ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ, ofikyɛ awuelilɛ ayi aseɛ ne aso to, nzɛmmɔnelilɛ ayi kuro ne anu to.

english_verse: so I will tell the most wicked nations to come and take over your homes. They will put an end to the pride you have in your strong army, and they will make your places of worship unfit to use.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa maen maen bɔ bɛ ti anu yɛ se paa ɔ ngɔwa maa bɛkɔɔfa b’awuro nemɔ. Ngɔma anwoserɛfoɛ b’anwomasoɛ ne bo kɔpɛ, na ngogua bɛ nekaa krongron nemɔ nwo fiɛ.

english_verse: You will be terrified and will desperately look for peace—but there will be no peace.
translation_verse: Amaneɛ ɔ́ba, na bɛkɔpena asomdwee si atee, nakoso bengonya bie.

english_verse: One tragedy will follow another, and you'll hear only bad news. People will beg prophets to give them a message from me. Priests will stop teaching my Law, and wise leaders won't be able to give advice.
translation_verse: Musue kɔwa kɔtoatoa so, yeɛ ngunga kɔwa kɔtoatoa so; bɛkɔpena nyekyire bekofi ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne berɛ, mmeraa ne anwo nimdeɛ kɔbɔ ɔsɔfo, yeɛ foɛtulɛ kɔbɔ mbanyi mɔ.

english_verse: Even your king and his officials will lose hope and cry in despair. Your hands will tremble with fear. I will punish you for your sins and treat you the same way you have treated others. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛhene ne koli yealɛ, aworabɔlɛ kotira atitirefoɛ, na aseɛ ne aso ama mɔ b’abasa nu kodwo. Ngotua bɛ so kerɛ kyɛbɔ bɛ yɔleɛ te ɔ, bɔ bayɔ ɔ so yeɛ ngogyina ngɔhwe bɛ so ɔ, na bekonwu ye kyɛ me ole AWURADE.”

english_verse: Six years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the leaders of Judah were meeting with me in my house. On the fifth day of the sixth month, the Lord God suddenly took control of me,
translation_verse: Afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ne, bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ne anu, ye elennu ne aso, né nde m’awuro bɔ Yuda mbanyi bɛtete me nyunu ɔ, na AWURADE Nyameɛ tumi wale me so wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: and I saw something in the shape of a human. This figure was like fire from the waist down, and it was bright as polished metal from the waist up.
translation_verse: Nneane, na nwuni sona sue bie bɔ ye sue ne te kyɛ see ɔ. Ofi ye nekaa bɔ osoma ye yaase ne bɔ ɔkwaadwu ase ne, ɔte see; yeɛ ofi ye yaase bɔ ɔkɔ ye anwuro ne koso, osoma nikyee bɔ wata ɔ, kyɛ kɔɔbere bɔ wasɔ gonn ɔ.

english_verse: It reached out what seemed to be a hand and grabbed my hair. Then in my vision the Lord's Spirit lifted me into the sky and carried me to Jerusalem. The Spirit took me to the north gate of the temple's inner courtyard, where there was an idol that disgusted the Lord and made him furious.
translation_verse: Ɔtengyɛle nikyee bie bɔ ye sue te asaa ɔ, ɔfa sɔle me ti nwiaa nu, na Sunzum ne mane me so hɔle anwuro ne ase b’afia, na ɔfale me wale Yerusalem wɔ nyekyire bɔ ofi Nyameɛ berɛ ɔ nu. Ɔfale me wale asɔneyɛɛ sua ne akunu dɔ anoa piri bɔ ye nye kyire sorɔ dɔ ne anyunu berɛ, nekaa bɔ nungunɛhwenɛ amoen bɔ ɔtwetwe nungunɛ ba ne ogyi ne.

english_verse: Then I saw the brightness of the glory of the God of Israel, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Na yieee! Né Yisrael Nyameɛ ye animnyam ne wɔ berɛ, bɔ ɔte kyɛ nyekyire bɔ nwuni ye bɔnza ne anu ne ala ɔ.

english_verse: God said to me, “Ezekiel, son of man, look north.” And when I did, I saw that repulsive idol by the altar near the gate.
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, “Sona awa, to wɔ nye nea sorɔ dɔ.” Yiti ndole me nye nneane sorɔ dɔ. Na yieee, afɔleɛ bokyea anoa ne, ye sorɔ dɔ, wɔ anoa nu berɛ yeɛ né nungunɛhwenɛ amoen ne ogyi ɔ.

english_verse: God then said, “Do you see the terrible sins of the people of Israel? Their sins are making my holy temple unfit as a place to worship me. Yet you will see even worse things than this.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ osa sele me kyɛ, “Sona awa, aso enwu bɔ bɛyɔ ye? Enwu akyiwadeɛ mbiri mbiri bɔ Yisraelfoɛ bɛyɔ ye wa, kyɛ bɛfa betu me befi me nekaa krongron ne anu maa mekɔ dededede ye? Na ekosa konwu akyiwadeɛ mbiri mbiri bieku.”

english_verse: Next, I was taken to the entrance of the courtyard, where I saw a hole in the wall.
translation_verse: Ɔfale me wale aluo berɛ anoa nu berɛ, na nneane nen, nwuni tokuro bie wɔ fasue ne anu.

english_verse: God said, “Make this hole bigger.” And when I did, I realized it was a doorway.
translation_verse: Yeɛ osele me kyɛ, “Sona awa, bɔngye fasue ne anu tokuro.” Na mmɔngyele fasue ne anu nen, nwuni anoa bie.

english_verse: “Go in,” God said, “and see what horrible and evil things the people are doing.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ osele me kyɛ, “Woro nu kɔnea akyiwadeɛ bra fiɛ bɔ bɛ́bɔ ye wa ɔ.”

english_verse: Inside, I saw that the walls were covered with pictures of reptiles and disgusting, unclean animals, as well as with idols that the Israelites were worshiping.
translation_verse: Yiti nworole nu ngɔneane. Na né bakurukyire ngaka mukoraa bɔ bɛtwe bɛ nwo ase ɔ, yeɛ ngaka mukoraa bɔ bekyi ɔ, ɔne Yisrael mmosoen amukoraa bagua fasue ne anwo babra bayia.

english_verse: Seventy Israelite leaders were standing there, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan. Each of these leaders was holding an incense burner, and the smell of incense filled the room.
translation_verse: Né mmienzua aburasoo bɔ bɛte Yisrael mbanyi ɔ, bɔ Safan awa Yaasania boka bɛ so ɔ begyigyi mmosoen nemɔ anyunu berɛ. Né ebiala tira ye see kulie, na ɛyɛɛ nwosina ne dwɔsole munguu.

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, do you see what horrible things Israel's leaders are doing in secret? They have filled their rooms with idols. And they say I can't see them, because they think I have already deserted Israel.
translation_verse: Afei obisale me kyɛ, “Sona awa, yeɛ anwu bɔ Yisrael awuro ama mbanyi bɛ́yɔ ye wɔ awosii nu ne, bɔ ebiala ɔwɔ ye sua bɔ ɔsɔne mmosoen mɔ nu nu ɔ? Ofikyɛ bɛnwa: ‘AWURADE nnwu yɛ, AWURADE apo aseɛ ne.’ ”

english_verse: But I will show you something even worse than this.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ osa sele me kyɛ, “Ekosa konwu akyiwadeɛ mbiri mbiri bieku bɔ bɛyɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: He took me to the north gate of the temple, where I saw women mourning for the god Tammuz.
translation_verse: Afei ɔfale me wale AWURADE awuro berɛ sorɔ dɔ anoa ne anu berɛ, na nwuni mmrasua bɔ bɛtete berɛ besu Tamuse ɔ.

english_verse: God asked me, “Can you believe what these women are doing? But now I want to show you something even worse.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ osele me kyɛ, “Sona awa, yeɛ anwu ye? Ekosa konwu akyiwadeɛ mbiri mbiri bɔ bɛtra ɛhemɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: God said, “Ezekiel, it's bad enough that the people of Judah are doing these disgusting things. But they have also spread violence and injustice everywhere in Israel and have made me very angry. They have disgraced and insulted me in the worst possible way.
translation_verse: Na obisale me kyɛ, “Sona awa, yeɛ anwu he? Aso ɔte edwirɛ baa kyɛ Yuda awuro ama bɛkɔbɔ akyiwadeɛ bra bɔ bɛbɔ ye wɔ ɛwa ye ɔ, bɔ bafa nzɛmmɔne bapete aseɛ ne aso amukoraa, bɔ besa behu m’ahone ɔ? Nea, kyɛ bɛ́nwaha bakaa nyaa ne wɔ bɛ bonyi noa ɔ.

english_verse: So in my fierce anger, I will punish them without mercy and refuse to help them when they cry out to me.”
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, ngɔhwe bɛ so anyeborolɛ so. Mengɔkorɔkorɔ bɛ, yeɛ mengonwu bɛ anwumvoin. Na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛkɔteatea nu bekosu bɛkɔfrɛ me de, nakoso mengɔtɛ bɛ so.”

english_verse: After that, I heard the Lord shout, “Come to Jerusalem, you men chosen to destroy the city. And bring your weapons!”
translation_verse: Afei ɔteane nu wɔ me so anu serɛserɛ kyɛ, “Ma kuro ne aso awɛmvoɛ nemɔ bɛhwe bepingye wa, ma ebiala ɔfa ye akodeɛ bɔ ɔfa kũkũ mmenia ɔ otira.”

english_verse: I saw six men come through the north gate of the temple, each one holding a deadly weapon. A seventh man dressed in a linen robe was with them, and he was carrying things to write with. The men went into the temple and stood by the bronze altar.
translation_verse: Na nwuni mmienzua nzia bie; befili anwuro dɔ anoa piri bɔ ye nye kyire sorɔ dɔ atee ne aso ne anu bɛwale. Né bɛ nu biala tira ye kodiawu akodeɛ; né biaa bie bɔ ɔhera nwera ɔ ɔboka bɛ so, na né wafa nikyee bɔ bɛfa bɛkyerɛ ɔ wasĩ. Na bewurale nu beegyinane kɔɔbere afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo berɛ.

english_verse: The brightness of God's glory then left its place above the statues of the winged creatures inside the temple and moved to the entrance. The Lord said to the man in the linen robe,
translation_verse: Na Yisrael Nyameɛ animnyam ne fili kɛrubim bɔ ɔwɔ so ne aso wale asɔneyɛɛ sua anoa ne anyunu berɛ, na ɔfrɛle biaa bɔ ɔhera nwera, bɔ wafa nikyee bɔ bɛfa bɛkyerɛ ɔ wasĩ ne.

english_verse: “Walk through the city of Jerusalem and mark the forehead of anyone who is truly upset and sad about the terrible things that are being done here.”
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele ye kyɛ, “Kohyini Yerusalem kuro ne anu, na mmenia bɔ ɔnate akyiwadeɛ bra mukoraa bɔ ɔkɔ so wɔ kuro ne anu ti bedi aworabɔlɛ ne yealɛ ne, hyɛ bɛ nzorɛ wɔ bɛ nwoma so.”

english_verse: He turned to the other six men and said, “Follow him and put to death everyone who doesn't have a mark on their forehead. Show no mercy or pity! Kill men and women, parents and children. Begin here at my temple, but be sure not to harm those who are marked.” The men immediately killed the leaders who were standing there.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔhũhũ bɛ bɔkɔɔ: nworowaa, mmerandeɛ, ndaluwa, ngwadaa ne mmrasua. Nakoso ebiala bɔ bahyɛ ye nzorɛ ne de, nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ sa bɛkã ye. Ɛ́mɔhyɛ ye bo béfi me nekaa krongron ne.” Yiti bɛhyɛle ye bo befili mbanyi bɔ bɛwɔ sua ne anyunu nemɔ aso.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Pollute the temple by piling the dead bodies in the courtyards. Now get busy!” They left and started killing the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yeɛ osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔgua sua ne anwo fiɛ, ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛ bɔ ɛmɔahũhũ bɛ ne béyi aluo berɛ to. Ɛ́mɔsi nu bɛhɔ!” Yiti besili nu bɛhɔle, na behuhuni mmenia wɔ kuro ne anu.

english_verse: I was then alone, so I bowed down and cried out to the Lord, “Why are you doing this? Are you so angry with the people of Jerusalem that everyone must die?”
translation_verse: Na begu so bɔ bekũkũ bɛ ne, ɔhale me ngome wɔ berɛ, na mvale me nyunu mmutuli berɛ ndeateane nu kyɛ, “Ao, AWURADE Nyameɛ, aso ɛbaanua bɛ bɔ baha wɔ Yisrael ne amukoraa bɛ boso wɔ wɔ yaafɛlɛ bɔ afɛ ye wɔ Yerusalem so ne anu anaa?”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “The people of Israel and Judah have done horrible things. Their country is filled with murderers, and Jerusalem itself is filled with violence. They think that I have deserted them, and that I can't see what they are doing.
translation_verse: Yeɛ obuale me kyɛ, “Yisrael awuro ama ne Yuda awuro ama b’amumuyɛɛ ne ɔte piri paa; mogya ayi aseɛ ne aso to, yeɛ ndɛengyea ayi kuro ne anu to; ofikyɛ bɛnwa: ‘AWURADE apo aseɛ ne, yeɛ AWURADE nnwu huu.’

english_verse: And so I will not have pity on them or forgive them. They will be punished for what they have done.”
translation_verse: Yiti me koso mengɔkorɔkorɔ bɛ, yeɛ mengonwu bɛ anwumvoin, na mmom ngɔma bɛ yɔleɛ kɔbɔ bɛ ti so.”

english_verse: Just then, the man in the linen robe returned and said, “I have done what you commanded.”
translation_verse: Na yieee, biaa bɔ ɔhera nwera, bɔ nikyee bɔ bɛfa bɛkyerɛ ɔ osĩ ye ne, ɔwale ɔɔhane kyɛ, “Mayɔ kyɛbɔ ɛhyɛle me kyɛ nyɔ ne ala.”

english_verse: I saw the dome that was above the four winged creatures, and on it was the sapphire throne.
translation_verse: Afei nneane, na nwuni nikyee bie bɔ osoma ahennie bia, bɔ osoma kyɛ bafa safire nyɔboɛ bayɔ ɔ, kyɛ ɔwɔ nikyee tɛtrɛtɛɛ bɔ ɔwɔ kɛrubim nemɔ anwuro ne aso.

english_verse: The Lord said to the man in the linen robe, “Walk among the four wheels beside the creatures and pick up as many hot coals as you can carry. Then scatter them over the city of Jerusalem.” I watched him as he followed the Lord's instructions.
translation_verse: Na osele biaa bɔ ɔhera nwera ne kyɛ, “Kango mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ kɛrubim nemɔ abo ne, kɔworo b’afia; fura see gonn bɔ ɔwɔ kɛrubim nemɔ b’afia ne, ná to pete kuro ne aso.” Na ɔworole nu bɔ me nye tua ɔ.

english_verse: The winged creatures were standing south of the temple when the man walked among them. A cloud filled the inner courtyard,
translation_verse: Né kɛrubim nemɔ begyigyi awuro ne ngwaen wɔ mmerɛ bɔ biaa ne worole nu ne, na munungum yili awuro ne akunu berɛ tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: and the brightness of the Lord's glory moved from above the creatures and stopped at the entrance of the temple. The entire temple was filled with his glory, and the courtyard was dazzling bright.
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE animnyam ne mane ye nwo so fili kɛrubim nemɔ aso hɔle awuro ne anoa nu dɔ, munungum ne yili awuro berɛ tɛkyɛ, na AWURADE animnyam ne yili aluo berɛ tɛkyɛ mane berɛ tale hyireinn.

english_verse: The sound of the creatures' wings was as loud as the voice of God All-Powerful and could even be heard in the outer courtyard.
translation_verse: Na dede bɔ kɛrubim nemɔ bɛ ndaa ne yɔle ne, né ɛte alaa kodwu bondua dɔ, bɔ ɔte kyɛ Tuminiɛ Nyameɛ ye komvi bɔ odwudwo ɔ.

english_verse: One of the four creatures reached its hand into the fire among them and gave him some of the hot coals. The man took the coals and left.
translation_verse: Na kɛrubo ne ko tengyɛle ye sa fili kɛrubim nemɔ b’afia hɔle see bɔ ɔwɔ kɛrubim nemɔ b’afia ne anwo. Ɔfale see ne bie, na ɔfa guale biaa bɔ ɔhera nwera ne sa nu. Biaa ne lele, na ofitele.

english_verse: I noticed again that each of the four winged creatures had what looked like human hands under their wings,
translation_verse: Né nikyee bie bɔ ye sue te kyɛ sona sa ɔ ɔwɔ kɛrubim nemɔ bɛ ndaa ne abo.

english_verse: and I saw the four wheels near the creatures. These wheels were shining like chrysolite.
translation_verse: Nneane, na nwuni kyɛ kango nna bɛwɔ kɛrubim nemɔ nwo berɛ, ko biala wɔ kɛrubo ko nwo, na né kango nemɔ bɛta hyɛmhyɛm kyɛ nyɔbosanyene.

english_verse: Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it,
translation_verse: Na bɛ mmɛnna ne, né bɛ sue te pɛ, bɔ ɔte kyɛbɔ kango ko wura kango ko anu ɔ.

english_verse: so that they could move in any direction without turning. The wheels moved together whenever the creatures moved.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛnate a, bɛfa bɛ bue nna ne yeɛ bɛnate ɔ; na bɛkɔ a, bɛngakyikakyi bɛ nwo. Na nekaa biala bɔ bɛ ti ne ɔnea ne, bɛkɔ berɛ tee, bɔ bɛkɔ a bɛngakyikakyi bɛ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: I also noticed that the wheels and the creatures' bodies, including their backs, their hands, and their wings, were covered with eyes.
translation_verse: Na bɛ mumua ne, bɛ sĩ, bɛ sa, bɛ ndaa ne bɛ kango nemɔ nwo ne, né anyeɛ tuatua bɛ nwo frefrɛɛ. Né bɛ mmɛnna bele kango mɔ.

english_verse: And I heard a voice calling these “the wheels that spin.”
translation_verse: Na kango nemɔ, ndele kyɛ bɛtole bɛ dumaa kyɛ, “Mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ kango.”

english_verse: Each of the winged creatures had four faces: the face of a bull, the face of a human, the face of a lion, and the face of an eagle.
translation_verse: Né ko biala ye nyunu te nna: bɔ oli moa ne te kɛrubo nyunu, bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne te sona nyunu, bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne te gyata nyunu, yeɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne te kɔleɛ nyunu.

english_verse: These were the same creatures I had seen near the Chebar River. They controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels stayed beside them.
translation_verse: Sɛ kɛrubim nemɔ begyina a, né kango nemɔ koso bagyina; yeɛ sɛ bɛpagya bɛ nwo so a, né bɛ koso bapagya bɛ nwo so baboka bɛ so, ofikyɛ abɔdeɛ teasefoɛ ne sunzum wura bɛ nu.

english_verse: Then I watched the brightness of the Lord's glory move from the entrance of the temple and stop above the winged creatures.
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE animnyam ne fili awuro n’anoa nu berɛ oogyinane kɛrubim nemɔ so anwuro.

english_verse: They spread their wings and flew into the air with the wheels at their side. They stopped at the east gate of the temple, and the Lord's glory was above them.
translation_verse: Yeɛ kɛrubim nemɔ momane bɛ ndaa so, na bɛpagyale bɛ nwo so befili aseɛ so bɛhɔle bɔ me nye tua ɔ. Na bɛkɔ ne, né kango nemɔ wɔ bɛ ngyɛnu, na beegyinane AWURADE awuro berɛ eyia afiteleɛ pambim ne anoa nu; na né Yisrael Nyameɛ animnyam ne ɔwɔ bɛ so anwuro.

english_verse: I knew for sure that these were the same creatures I had seen beneath the Lord's glory near the Chebar River.
translation_verse: Sɔ abɔdeɛ teasefoɛ nemɔ, bɛ yeɛ nwuni bɛ wɔ Yisrael Nyameɛ ye bo wɔ asue Kebare noa ne, na nwuni kyɛ bɛte kɛrubim.

english_verse: They had four wings with hands beneath them, and they had the same four faces as those near the River. Each creature moved straight ahead without turning.
translation_verse: Na bɛ nyunu sue ne, bɛte kyɛ nyunuɛ mɔ bɔ nwuni bɛ asue Kebare noa ne pɛpɛɛpɛ. Bɛ nu biala hɔle ye nyunu tee.

english_verse: and I told them everything the Lord had shown me.
translation_verse: Na ngane bɔ AWURADE ye hyirele me ne amukoraa ngyirele bɛ bɔ bahye bɛ nnure ne.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, these men are making evil plans and giving dangerous advice to the people of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, “Sona awa, mmenia bɔ bɛdwene amumuyɛɛ adwene ná besa betu foɛ tɛɛ wɔ kuro he anu ne, bɛ ɛne.

english_verse: They say things like, ‘Let's build more houses. This city is like a cooking pot over a fire, and we are the meat, but at least the pot keeps us from being burned in the fire.’
translation_verse: Bɛ yeɛ bɛnwa: ‘Mmerɛ bɔ bɛfa besisi sua ne onnya oddwuli. Kuro he ole turonzemaa ne, yeɛ yɛ ole naen ne.’

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit took control of me and told me to tell these leaders: I, the Lord God, know what you leaders are saying.
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE Sunzum wale me so, na osele me kyɛ, “Kã kyɛ AWURADE nwa nyoo: O Yisrael awuro ama, bɔ ɛmɔkã hɔ ɛne, ofikyɛ mese ɛmɔ ti anu adwene biala.

english_verse: You have murdered so many people that the city is filled with dead bodies!
translation_verse: Ɛmɔahũhũ mmenia pee wɔ kuro ye anu, na ɛmɔafa mmenia bɔ ɛmɔahũhũ bɛ ɔ bɛ fuin bayi mmorɔnoɛ nemɔ aso to.

english_verse: This city is indeed a cooking pot, but the bodies of those you killed are the meat. And so I will force you to leave Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Mmenia bɔ ɛmɔahũhũ bɛ bagua nu ne, bɛ ole naen ne, yeɛ kuro he ole turonzemaa ne; nakoso ɛmɔ de, ngotu ɛmɔ ngofi nu.

english_verse: and I'll send armies to attack you, just as you fear.
translation_verse: Ngrandɛ yeɛ ɛmɔsuro ye ɔ, yiti ngrandɛ yeɛ ngɔfa ngɔwa ɛmɔ so ɔ, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Then you will be captured and punished by foreign enemies.
translation_verse: Ngotu ɛmɔ ngofi kuro ne anu, ngɔfa ɛmɔ ngowura ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ sa, na ngobua ɛmɔ ndɛen.

english_verse: You will be killed in your own country, but not before you realize that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa, ngɔhwe ɛmɔ so wɔ Yisrael ɛwɛen so, na ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: You leaders claim to be meat in a cooking pot, but you won't be protected by this city. No, you will die at the border of Israel.
translation_verse: Sɔ kuro he ngɔyɛ ɛmɔ turonzemaa, yeɛ ɛmɔngɔyɛ naen wɔ nu; na ngobua ɛmɔ ndɛen wɔ Yisrael wɛen so.

english_verse: You will realize that while you were following the laws of nearby nations, you were disobeying my laws and teachings. And I am the Lord!
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE; ofikyɛ ɛmɔanni m’ahyɛdeɛ so, yeɛ ɛmɔanni me nhyehyɛleɛ so; na maen maen bɔ bapɛ ɛmɔ nwo bayia ne, bɛ yɔleɛ mmom yeɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔayɔ bie ɔ.”

english_verse: Before I finished speaking, Pelatiah dropped dead. I bowed down and cried out, “Please, Lord God, don't kill everyone left in Israel.” A Promise of Hope
translation_verse: Na ɔwale kyɛ, mmerɛ bɔ ngu so mehyɛ ngɔm ne, Benaya awa Pelatia wuli. Yeɛ mvale me nyunu mmutuli ase, na ndeane nu serɛserɛ kyɛ, “Ao, AWURADE Nyameɛ, aso ɛbaanua Yisraelfoɛ bɔ baha ne bɛ boso anaa?” Nyameɛ kɔye Yuda kofi nnurehyelɛ nu

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in Jerusalem claim that you and the other Israelites who were taken to Babylonia are too far away to worship me. They also claim that the land of Israel now belongs only to them.
translation_verse: “Sona awa, Yerusalemfoɛ bahã bahyire eliɛma nemɔ, w’abusuafoɛ, ɔne wɔ mmango mɔ bɔ bɛhyele bɛ nnure, yeɛ Yisrael awuro ama amukoraa kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi AWURADE nwo bɛhɔ dededede, na yɛ yeɛ bafa aseɛ he bama yɛ kyɛ yɛfa yɛyɛ yɛ deɛ ɔ.’

english_verse: But here is what I want you to tell the Israelites in Babylonia: It's true that I, the Lord God, have forced you out of your own country and made you live among foreign nations. But for now, I will be with you wherever you are, so that you can worship me.
translation_verse: Yiti kã kyɛ, ‘AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ nzesale bɛ ngɔle maen maen mɔ so dedeede de, yeɛ ndole bɛ mbetene aseɛ mɔ so de, nakoso nde nekaa krongron mema bɛ wɔ mmerɛ kãa bie, wɔ aseɛ mɔ bɔ bɛhɔle so nemɔ aso.

english_verse: And someday, I will gather you from the nations where you are scattered and let you live in Israel again.
translation_verse: Yiti kã kyɛ, ‘AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Mebaaboaboa ɛmɔ noa mefi maen maen nemɔ anu, ná meboaboa ɛmɔ noa mefi aseɛ mɔ bɔ mato ɛmɔ mapete so ne aso, na ngɔfa Yisrael aseɛ ne ngɔma ɛmɔ.’

english_verse: When that happens, I want you to clear the land of all those idols I hate so much.
translation_verse: Na bɛkɔwa berɛ, na bɛkɔye so nningyein tɛɛ mukoraa ne akyiwadeɛ mukoraa bekofi so.

english_verse: Then I will take away your stubbornness and make you eager to be completely faithful to me. You will want to obey me
translation_verse: Na ngɔma bɛ ahone ko, ngɔfa sunzum foforɛ ngowura bɛ nu, ngɔye nyɔboɛ ahone ne ngofi bɛ nwonaen nu, na ngɔma bɛ anwoɔnaen ahone,

english_verse: and all my laws and teachings. You will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so bali m’ahyɛdeɛ so, ná bafa me nhyehyɛleɛ babɔ bɛ bra, ná bayɛ ye nwo sotie, ná bayɛ me maen, ná me koso mayɛ bɛ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: But those who worship idols will be punished and get what they deserve. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord's Glory Leaves Jerusalem
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ bɔ b’adwene li bɛ nningyein tɛɛ ne b’akyiwadeɛ si ne de, ngɔma bɛ yɔleɛ kɔbɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti so, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: After the Lord had finished speaking, the winged creatures spread their wings and flew into the air, and the wheels were beside them. The brightness of the Lord's glory above them
translation_verse: Afei kɛrubim nemɔ momane bɛ ndaa so; né kango nemɔ wɔ bɛ ngyɛnu, na né Yisrael Nyameɛ animnyam ne ɔwɔ bɛ so anwuro.

english_verse: Then in my vision, the Lord's Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to the other exiles in Babylonia. The vision faded away,
translation_verse: Yeɛ Sunzum ne mane me so, na ɔnate Nyameɛ Sunzum so, wɔ nyekyire nu, ɔfale me hɔle mmenia bɔ bahye bɛ nnure bahɔ Kaldea nemɔ berɛ. Na afei nyekyire bɔ nwuni ye ne, ofili me so hɔle anwuro.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you are living among rebellious people. They have eyes, but refuse to see; they have ears, but refuse to listen.
translation_verse: “Sona awa, abusua bɔ bayɛ lɔen ɔ yeɛ ɛte bɛ nu ɔ. Bɛte mmenia bɔ bele anyeɛ bɔ odi kyɛ onwu nikye, nakoso bennwu nikye; bele asoɛ bɔ odi kyɛ ɔte dwirɛ, nakoso bɛnde dwirɛ, ofikyɛ bɛte ɛlɔenyɛlɛ abusua.

english_verse: So before it gets dark, here is what I want you to do. Pack a few things as though you were going to be taken away as a prisoner. Then go outside where everyone can see you and walk around from place to place. Maybe as they watch, they will realize what rebels they are.
translation_verse: Yiti wɔ, sona wa, bɔ wɔ nningyein borɛ kyɛ sona bɔ bahye ye nnure ɔ, tu fi berɛ kɔ eyia bɔ bɛ nye tua ɔ; yɛ kyɛ sona bɔ bahye wɔ nnure ɔ, ná tu fi nekaa bɔ ɛte ne kɔ nekaa foforɛ bɔ bɛ nye tua ɔ. Bɛte abusua bɔ bayɛ lɔen ɔ, nakoso ebiaa bɛkɔte ye bo.

english_verse: After you have done this, return to your house. Later that evening leave your house as if you were going into exile.
translation_verse: Ye wɔ nningyein borɛ ne fite eyia kyɛ sona bɔ bahye ye nnure ɔ ye deɛ, bɔ bɛ nye tua ɔ. Tu fi berɛ kɔ nɔsoa, bɔ bɛ nye tua ɔ, kyɛbɔ mmenia bɔ bɛsesa bɛ bɛkɔ nnurehyelɛ nu ne bɛyɔ ne ala.

english_verse: Dig through the wall of your house and crawl out, carrying the bag with you. Make sure everyone is watching.
translation_verse: Bɔngye fasue ne anu bɔ bɛ nye tua ɔ, ná fa nu fite.

english_verse: Lift the bag to your shoulders, and with your face covered, take it into the darkness, so that you cannot see the land you are leaving. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Ma borɛ ne aso to wɔ kɔme anwo bɔ bɛ nye tua ɔ, na aleɛ sa a, fa fite si nu kɔ. Fa nikyee mundu wɔ nyunu bɔ engonwu aseɛ ne ɔ, ofikyɛ mafa wɔ mayɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ mama Yisrael awuro ama.”

english_verse: I did everything the Lord had said. I packed a few things. Then as the sun was going down, and while everyone was watching, I dug a hole through one of the walls of my house. I pulled out my bag, then lifted it to my shoulders and left in the darkness.
translation_verse: Yeɛ nyɔle kyɛbɔ ɔhyɛle me kyɛ nyɔ ne ala. Me nningyein borɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ sona bɔ ɔkɔ nnurehyelɛ nu deɛ ne, nye mvitele eyia. Na odwuli nɔsoa ne, mvale me sa mmɔngyele fasue ne anu. Na me nningyein borɛ ne, mva ndole me kɔme anwo nzili nu mvale awosii nu ngɔle, bɔ né bɛ nye tua ɔ.

english_verse: reminded me that those rebellious people didn't even ask what I was doing.
translation_verse: “Sona awa, Yisrael awuro ama bɔ bɛte ɛlɔenyɛlɛ abusua ne, aso bammisa wɔ kyɛ, ‘Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛ́yɔ e?’

english_verse: So he sent me back to tell them: The Lord God has a message for the leader of Jerusalem and everyone living there!
translation_verse: Kã kyire bɛ kyɛ, ‘AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa: Sɔ dwirɛ ne, ɔfa panyi bɔ ɔla Yerusalem noa nwo, ɔne Yisrael awuro ama amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ kuro ne anu ɔ bɛ nwo.’

english_verse: I have done these things to show them what will happen when they are taken away as prisoners.
translation_verse: Kã kyɛ, ‘Nde sɛngyerɛnneɛ ma ɛmɔ, na bɔ nyɔle ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔyɛ bɛ ɔ. Bɛkɔhye bɛ nnure bɛkɔsesa bɛ bɛkɔhɔ.’

english_verse: The leader of Jerusalem will lift his own bag to his shoulders at sunset and leave through a hole that the others have dug in the wall of his house. He will cover his face, so he can't see the land he is leaving.
translation_verse: Na panyi bɔ ɔla bɛ noa ne, ɔkɔma ye nningyein borɛ so kɔto ye kɔme anwo awosii nu, ná wasi nu wahɔ. Bɛkɔbɔngye fasue ne anu, ná bafa nu bahɔ. Ɔkɔfa nikyee komundu ye nyunu, amaa ɔnate so wamva ye nye wannwu aseɛ ne.

english_verse: The Lord will spread out a net and trap him as he leaves Jerusalem. He will then be led away to the city of Babylon, but will never see that place, even though he will die there.
translation_verse: Ngɔtrɛtrɛ m’asawu nu ngogua ye so, na me ngaen kɔhye ye, na ngɔfa ye ngɔhɔ Babilɔn bɔ ɔwɔ Kaldeafoɛ b’aseɛ so ɔ. Nakoso ongonwu ye, na dɔ yeɛ okowu ɔ.

english_verse: His own officials and troops will scatter in every direction, and the Lord will track them down and put them to death.
translation_verse: Na mmenia mukoraa bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia bɔ bɛbɔ ye nwo waen, yeɛ ye koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraa, ngɔbɔ bɛ ngɔsande nekaa bɔ mvrama bɔ kɔ biala, na ngɔhwe ngrandɛ ne ngɔfa ngɔfoa bɛ.

english_verse: The Lord will force the rest of the people in Jerusalem to live in foreign nations, where they will realize that he has done all these things.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mebɔ bɛ mesande maa bɛkɔ maen maen nemɔ nu, ná meto bɛ mepete aseɛ nemɔ aso a, ye de bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: Some of them will survive the war, the starvation, and the deadly diseases. That way, they will be able to tell foreigners how disgusting their sins were, and that it was the Lord who punished them in this way. A Sign of Fear
translation_verse: Nakoso ngɔma bɛ nu kãa bie konya bɛ ti bekodidi nu bekofi ngrandɛ ne noa, kofi ɛhɔen ne ewue anwonyerɛ nu, amaa ɔnate so bato bɛ noa nu tui bahã b’akyiwadeɛ yɔleɛ amukoraa wɔ maen maen bɔ bɛkɔhɔ so nemɔ anu, na bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, shake with fear when you eat, and tremble when you drink.
translation_verse: “Sona awa, fa anwowosolɛ di w’aleɛ, ná fa ɛserɛ ne ahunundetelɛ no wɔ nzue;

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that I, the Lord, say that someday everyone in Jerusalem will shake when they eat and tremble when they drink. Their country will be destroyed and left empty, because they have been cruel and violent.
translation_verse: ná se aseɛ ne aso ama kyɛ, ‘Yerusalemfoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Yisrael aseɛ so ne, bɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ kã fa bɛ nwo ɛhe: Bɛkɔfa ahunundetelɛ bekoli b’aleɛ, ná bafa aworabɔlɛ bano bɛ nzue, ofikyɛ bɔ ɔwɔ b’aseɛ ne aso amukoraa kofi so, ɔnate so ama amukoraa b’amumuyɛɛ ne ati.

english_verse: Every town will lie in ruins, and the land will be a barren desert. Then they will know that I am the Lord. The Words of the Lord Will Come True
translation_verse: Nguro bɔ bɛtete so nemɔ kɔbɔ, aseɛ ne kɔkakyi kurofoen, na ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.” Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ba nu

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, you've heard people in Israel use the saying, “Time passes, and prophets are proved wrong.”
translation_verse: “Sona awa, anyandera he bɔ ɛmɔbu bɛfa Yisrael aseɛ nwo kyɛ, ‘Moa moa ala yeɛ ngyẽa ne ɔkɔ ɔ, nakoso nyekyire biala ɔmma nu’ ne, ye bo ole sɛɛ?

english_verse: Now tell the people that I, the Lord, am going to prove that saying wrong. No one will ever be able to use it again in Israel, because very soon everything I have said will come true!
translation_verse: Yiti kã kyire bɛ kyɛ, ‘AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa: Ngɔma sɔ anyandera he bo kɔpɛ, na bengobu sɔ anyandera ne ko wɔ Yisrael.’ Na mmom kã kyire bɛ kyɛ, ‘Ngyẽa ne apingye, na nyekyire biala kɔwa nu.

english_verse: The people will hear no more useless warnings and false messages.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngondombo nyekyire ne nnakannaka ngɔmhyɛlɛ ngɔtena Yisrael awuro ama mɔ bɛ nu ko.

english_verse: I will give them my message, and what I say will certainly happen. Warn those rebels that the time has come for them to be punished. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me ole AWURADE: ngodwudwo, na edwirɛ bɔ ngɔhã ne yeɛ ɔkɔwa nu ɔ. Mengɔtwetwe me gya ase wɔ edwirɛ ne anwo. Ofikyɛ, ɛlɔenyɛlɛ abusua, ɛmɔ aberɛ so, ngɔhã edwirɛ ne, na ngɔyɔ, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are also saying that your visions and messages are only about things in the future.
translation_verse: “Sona awa, tie, Yisrael awuro ama mɔ bɛnwa: ‘Nyekyire bɔ onya ye ne, ɔkɔhyɛ paa koraka né wawa nu; yeɛ mmerɛ bɔ ɔwɔ moa moa nwo ngɔm yeɛ ɔhyɛ ɔ.’

english_verse: So tell them that my words will soon come true, just as I have warned. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ɔnate sɔ ne ati, se bɛ kyɛ, ‘AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Mengɔtwetwe me gya ase wɔ me noa dwirɛ biala nwo ko, na mmom edwirɛ bɔ mahã ne, ɔkɔwa nu, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the prophets of Israel who say they speak in my name, but who preach messages that come from their own imagination. Tell them it's time to hear my message.
translation_verse: “Sona awa, hyɛ ngɔm tia Yisrael ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛhyɛ ngɔm ne, ná se bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ bɛ ti anu bɛhyɛ ngɔm ne kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE noa dwirɛ!’

english_verse: I, the Lord God, say those lying prophets are doomed! They don't see visions—they make up their own messages!
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Musue to ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ngwaseafoɛ bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ sunzum diedie bɛ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ bennwuni huu ɔ!

english_verse: Israel's prophets are no better than jackals that hunt for food among the ruins of a city.
translation_verse: O Yisrael, wɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bayɛ kyɛ kurofoen so safuboa mɔ.

english_verse: They don't warn the people about coming trouble or tell them how dangerous it is to sin against me.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ ahɔ a, ɛmɔamvo bangɔangyina fasue ne anu nekaa bɔ tokuro lela ne, yeɛ ɛmɔando fasue bamva Yisrael awuro ama nwo, amaa sɛ AWURADE kyẽa ne dwu a Yisrael wahora ye noa gyina.

english_verse: Those prophets lie by claiming they speak for me, but I have not even chosen them to be my prophets. And they still think their words will come true.
translation_verse: Bɛ noa dwirɛ te nnakannaka, yeɛ bɛhyɛ ngondombo ngɔm. Bɛnwa: ‘AWURADE nwa nyoo,’ wɔ aberɛ bɔ nna AWURADE yeɛ wasoma bɛ ɔ; nakoso bɛ nye la so kyɛ AWURADE kɔma bɛ dwirɛ ne kɔwa nu ɔ.

english_verse: They say they're preaching my messages, but they are full of lies—I did not speak to them!
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔkã kyɛ, ‘AWURADE nwa nyoo,’ wɔ aberɛ bɔ nngane huu a, aso nna nyekyire mbaen mbaen yeɛ ɛmɔanwu ye ɔ, ɔne ngondombo ngɔm yeɛ ɛmɔahyɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: So I am going to punish those lying prophets for deceiving the people of Israel with false messages.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, “Ɔnate ɛmɔ dwirɛ mbaen mbaen kekanɛ ɔne ɛmɔ ngondombo nyekyire ne ati, ɛ́mɔtie, meko metia ɛmɔ, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people. They will not be allowed to call themselves Israelites or even to set foot in Israel. Then they will realize that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Me tumi kɔho kotia ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛbɔ bɛ sɔ nu benwu nyekyire, ná bɛhyɛ ngondombo ngɔm ɔ. Bɛngɔboka me maen badwa ne aso, bɛngɔha bɛ ngɔfra Yisrael awuro ama so, yeɛ bɛ gya baa ngotia Yisrael aseɛ so, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Those prophets refuse to be honest. They tell my people there will be peace, even though there's no peace to be found. They are like workers who think they can fix a shaky wall by covering it with paint.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ bɛlakalaka me maen bɛkã kyɛ, ‘Asomdwee,’ wɔ aberɛ bɔ asomdwee nne berɛ ɔ; yeɛ sɛ maen ne to fasue a, sɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛfa ewure bɛkã ye nwo ne ati,

english_verse: But when I send rainstorms, hailstones, and strong winds, the wall will surely collapse.
translation_verse: kã kyire bɛ bɔ bɛfa ewure bɛkã ye nwo ne kyɛ: Fasue ne kodwiri kogua. Esue piri kɔtɔ, asukɔtwea kungumaboɔ kɔtɔ kogua, yeɛ mvrama piri kotu.

english_verse: People will then ask the workers why the paint didn't hold it up.
translation_verse: Na sɛ fasue ne dwiri gua a, aso mmenia ngobisa ɛmɔ kyɛ, ‘Ye nwo bɔ ɛmɔfale ewure bɛhane ne, ɔwɔ ni?’

english_verse: That wall is the city of Jerusalem. And I, the Lord God, am so angry that I will send strong winds, rainstorms, and hailstones to destroy it.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: M’ahone kohu maa ngɔma mvrama piri kotu; yeɛ ngɔfɛ yaa ngɔma esue piri kɔtɔ, na m’ahone kohu maa asukɔtwea kungumaboɔ mbiri mbiri kɔsɛkye ye.

english_verse: The lying prophets have tried to cover up the evil in Jerusalem, but I will tear down the city, all the way to its foundations. And when it collapses, those prophets will be killed, and everyone will know that I have done these things.
translation_verse: Fasue bɔ ɛmɔafa ewure bahã ye nwo ne, ngodwiri ye ngogua ase maa ye fapem ne nwo kɔla berɛ. Okobubu kogua maa ɛmɔkowuwu wɔ nu, na ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: The city of Jerusalem and its lying prophets will feel my fierce anger. Then I will announce that the city has fallen and that the lying prophets are dead,
translation_verse: Fasue ne, yeɛ mmenia bɔ bahã ye nwo ewure ne, sɔ yeɛ me yaafɛlɛ ne kɔyɔ bɛ nwo adwuma koyie ɔ. Na ngose ɛmɔ kyɛ, Fasue ne nne berɛ ko, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛhane ye nwo ewure ne koso bɛnne berɛ ko,

english_verse: because they promised my people peace, when there was no peace. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Women Who Wear Magic Charms The Lord said:
translation_verse: mekyire Yisrael ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛhyɛ Yerusalem nwo ngɔm, kyɛ banya ye nwo asomdwee nyekyire, wɔ aberɛ bɔ asomdwee biala nne berɛ ɔ, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne. Ngondombo ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ mmrasua

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, now condemn the women of Israel who preach messages that come from their own imagination.
translation_verse: “Na wɔ, Sona awa, wɔ maen ne anu mmrasua bɔ bɛbɔ bɛ ti anu bɛhyɛ ngɔm ne, tu wɔ nye sie bɛ so, ná hyɛ ngɔm tia bɛ kyɛ,

english_verse: Tell them they're doomed! They wear magic charms on their wrists and scarves on their heads, then trick others into believing they can predict the future. They won't get away with telling those lies.
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Musue kɔto ɛmɔ! Mmrasua bɔ bɛnwo ngonyaa nzɛbɛ begua mmenia sa kɔm amukoraa, ɔne eduku bɔ bɛpomba bɛma mmenia ti ahoroɔ amukoraa, bɔ ɔnate so bediedie mmenia kra bɛkɔ bɔne nu ɔ! Ɛmɔsua ngaen bɛkye me maen mmaa bɛ kra, bɔ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bɛ deɛ de, ɛmɔpena kyɛ onya ngoa ɔ?

english_verse: They charge my people a few handfuls of barley and a couple pieces of bread, and then give messages that are insulting to me. They use lies to sentence the innocent to death and to help the guilty go free. And my people believe them!
translation_verse: Ɔnate ayuo bɛ sa bum kãa bie, ɔne paanoo bue kãa bie ti, ɛmɔagua me nwo fiɛ wɔ me maen nyunu. Ɛmɔlakalaka me maen bɔ okuro nnakannaka tielɛ, na ɔnate so ɛmɔku mmenia bɔ bɛmvata ewue, yeɛ ɛmɔyakyi bɛ bɔ bɛfata ewue ɔ.

english_verse: I hate the magic charms they use to trick people into believing their lies. I will rip those charms from their wrists and set free the people they have trapped like birds.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ɛ́mɔtie, ɛmɔ ngonyaa nzɛbɛ bɔ ɛmɔfa bediedie mmenia kra bɛkye bɛ kyɛ nnomaa ne, mekyi, na ngɔtete ngofi ɛmɔ sa. Na mmenia kra bɔ ɛmɔdiedie bɛ bɛkye ne, ngɔsangye bɛ maa bekotu bɛkɔhɔ kyɛ nnomaa.

english_verse: I will tear the scarves from their heads and rescue my people from their power once and for all. Then they will know that I am the Lord God.
translation_verse: Ngɔtete ɛmɔ duku ne anu, ná mapepɛ male me mmenia mafi ɛmɔ sa nu, na bɛngɔyɛ kyɛ naen bɔ ɛmɔahye bɛ ɔ wɔ ɛmɔ sa nu, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: They do things I would never do. They lie to good people and encourage them to do wrong, and they convince the wicked to ruin their own lives by not turning from sin.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔafa ɛmɔ nnakannaka ne bama teneneefoɛ bɛ wora abɔ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ me de mmvale aworabɔlɛ nndole bɛ so. Ɛmɔsi bɔnefoɛ adua, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ɔngɔhwe ye nwo ngofi ye bɔne atee so ngonya ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: I will no longer let these women give false messages and use magic, and I will free my people from their control. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, ɛmɔngonwu ngondombo nyekyire ko, yeɛ ɛmɔngɔhyɛ ngɔm ko. Na ngole me mmenia ngofi ɛmɔ sa nu, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.”

english_verse: One day, some of Israel's leaders came to me and asked for a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yisrael mbanyi nemɔ bie wale me berɛ bɛɛtenane me nyunu.

english_verse: While they were there, the Lord said:
translation_verse: Na ɔwale kyɛ, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, these men have started worshiping idols, though they know it will cause them to sin even more. So I refuse to give them a message!
translation_verse: “Sona awa, mmenia hemɔ b’ahone bata bɛ mmosoen nemɔ anwo, na bafa amumuyɛɛ bɔ ɔte bɛ sundidua ne bato bɛ nyunu. Aso mma bebisa me, na ngyire bɛ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛyɔ anaa?

english_verse: Tell the people of Israel that if they sin by worshiping idols and then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will give them the answer their sins deserve.
translation_verse: Yiti dwudwo kyire bɛ ná se bɛ kyɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ebiala bɔ ofi Yisrael awuro ama nu, bɔ ɔkɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ berɛ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɔma ye ahone bata ye mmosoen mɔ nwo, ná ɔfa amumuyɛɛ bɔ ɔte ye sundidua ɔto ye nyunu ne, me AWURADE, kyɛbɔ ye mmosoen mɔ bɛ somaa te ne, me bɔbɔ ngɔma ye mmuayɛɛ.

english_verse: When they hear my message, maybe they will see that they need to turn back to me and stop worshiping those idols.
translation_verse: Na ɔba ye sɔ a, Yisrael awuro ama amukoraa bɔ ɔnate bɛ mmosoen ti bayakyi me si lilɛ ne, ngɔma b’adwene kɔwa me so.

english_verse: Now, Ezekiel, tell everyone in Israel: I am the Lord God. Stop worshiping those idols I hate so much and come back to me.
translation_verse: “Yiti kã kyire Yisrael awuro ama kyɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ɛ́mɔsakyera ɛmɔ adwene ná ɛ́mɔyakyi ɛmɔ mmosoen nemɔ si lilɛ; ná ɛ́mɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi ɛmɔ akyiwadeɛ amukoraa anwo.

english_verse: Suppose one of you Israelites or a foreigner living in Israel rejects me and starts worshiping idols. If you then go to a prophet to find out what I say, I will answer
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ofi Yisrael awuro ama nu, anaa ɛwɔfoɛ biala bɔ waatena Yisrael, bɔ ɔba ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ berɛ babisa me maa mekyire ye bɔ odi kyɛ ɔyɔ ɔ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ wahwe ye nwo wafi me nwo, wama ye ahone abata ye mmosoen mɔ nwo, ná wafa amumuyɛɛ bɔ ɔte ye sundidua wato ye nyunu ne, me AWURADE, me bɔbɔ ngɔma ye mmuayɛɛ.

english_verse: by turning against you. I will make you a warning to anyone who might think of doing the same thing, and you will no longer belong to my people. Then you will know that I am the Lord and that you have sinned against me.
translation_verse: Ngotu me nye ngosie sɔ sona ne aso, ngɔfa ye ngɔkakyi sɛngyerɛnneɛ ne ngorohoɛ dwirɛ, ngotu ye ngofi me maen nu, ná ɛmɔanwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: If a prophet gives a false message, I am the one who caused that prophet to lie. But I will still reject him and cut him off from my people,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne ma ye nwo ate maa bɛlakalaka ye, ná ɔkã dwirɛ a, ye de me AWURADE yeɛ malakalaka sɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne ɔ. Ngɔtengyɛ me sa ngɔhwe ye so, ná mahũ ye mafi me maen Yisrael nu.

english_verse: and anyone who goes to that prophet for a message will be punished in the same way.
translation_verse: B’amumuyɛɛ kɔbɔ bɛ ti so: ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne, ye asohwenɛ ne, ɔte kyɛ sona bɔ wahɔ abisa ɔ ye asohwenɛ deɛ ne ala;

english_verse: I will do this, so that you will come back to me and stop destroying yourselves with these disgusting sins. So turn back to me! Then I will be your God, and you will be my people. I, the Lord God, make this promise. Judgment on a Sinful Nation
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so Yisrael awuro ama banni makyebu ko banyakyi me si lilɛ, yeɛ bɛngɔfa bɛ mmeraatolɛ amukoraa bengogua bɛ nwo fiɛ ko; na mmom bɛkɔyɛ me maen maa me koso ngɔyɛ bɛ Nyameɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, suppose an entire nation sins against me, and I punish it by destroying the crops and letting its people and livestock starve to death.
