translation_verse: Né Nyameɛ turo Eden nu yeɛ ɛwɔ ɔ, nyɔboɛ mukoraa bɔ bɛ nyɔboɛ yɛ se ɔ yeɛ né ɔkata wɔ nwo ɔ. Bɛ ole: kanelian, topase ne yasepa, krisolite, bɛrile ne onike, safire, ɛmerade ne kabunkre. Sikaa kɔkorɛ yeɛ bɛfa bɛhyehyɛle wɔ nwo ɔ; na kyẽa bɔ bɛbɔle wɔ ne, yeɛ bɛhyehyɛle bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I appointed a winged creature to guard your home on my holy mountain, where you walked among gems that dazzled like fire.
translation_verse: Wɔ yeɛ ɛte kɛrubo bɔ bapopa ye ngoo bɔ ɔkata so ɔ, né ɛwɔ Nyameɛ bokaa krongron ne aso, na nyɔboɛ see afia yeɛ né edi akɔneaba ɔ.

english_verse: You were truly good from the time of your birth, but later you started doing wicked things.
translation_verse: Né mvomsoɛ biala nne wɔ nwo, ofi kyẽa bɔ bɛbɔle wɔ ɔ maa oodwuli kyɛ benwuni amumuyɛɛ wɔ wɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: You traded with other nations and became more and more cruel and evil. So I forced you to leave my mountain, and the creature that had been your protector now chased you away from the jewels.
translation_verse: Ngɔsoɛ wale wɔ dwaalilɛ ne anu maa ɔnate so basabasayɔlɛ yili wɔ nu tɛkyɛ, na ɛyɔle bɔne; yiti ɛkakyili nikyee bɔ ye nwo agua fiɛ ɔ, maa ɔnate so mvindini wɔ mvili Nyameɛ bokaa ne aso. Wɔ, kɛrubo bɔ ɛkataso ɔ, ngɔsɛkye wɔ pasapasa ngofi see nyɔboɛ nemɔ b’afia.

english_verse: It was your good looks that made you arrogant, and you were so famous that you started acting like a fool. That's why I threw you to the ground and let other kings sneer at you.
translation_verse: W’anwonyemene ti ɛyɛle anwomasoɛ, wɔ talɛ bɔ ɛta ti ɛsɛkyele wɔ nworɛ. Yiti mvindini wɔ ndole ase, nguale wɔ nyunu ase wɔ ahemvo mɔ bɛ nyunu, maa betuli bɛ nye beguale wɔ so.

english_verse: You have cheated so many other merchants that your places of worship are corrupt. So I set your city on fire and burned it down. Now everyone sees only ashes where your city once stood,
translation_verse: Ɛnate w’amumuyɛɛ worawora ne wɔ dwaalilɛ fiɛ ne aso agua wɔ nekaa krongron nemɔ nwo fiɛ; yiti mama see asɔ wɔ wɔ nu, na wayera wɔ, na mamaa atɔ nzoen wɔ aseɛ so, bɔ bɛ bɔ benwuni wɔ amukoraa bɛ nye tua ɔ.

english_verse: and the people of other nations are shocked. Your punishment was horrible, and you are gone forever. Judgment on Sidon and Peace for Israel
translation_verse: Mmenia amukoraa bɔ bɛse wɔ wɔ maen maen mɔ nu ne, wɔ ti bɛ nwo adwiri bɛ; w’ayieleɛ ayie wɔ pasaa, na engodwɔso ko le.” Sidon nwo ngɔm

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the city of Sidon
translation_verse: “Sona awa, fa wɔ nye kyire Sidon, ná hyɛ ngɔm tia ye.

english_verse: and tell its people: I, the Lord God, am your enemy! People will praise me when I punish you, and they will see that I am holy.
translation_verse: Kã kyɛ, ‘AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, “O Sidon, tie, meko metia wɔ, na m’animnyam kɔla ali wɔ wɔ nu. Na sɛ metwe ye so, ná mema me krongronyɛlɛ da ali wɔ ye nu a, ye de bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: I will send deadly diseases to wipe you out, and I will send enemies to invade and surround you. Your people will be killed, and you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngɔsoma ewue anwonyerɛ maa ɔkɔhɔ ye so, ngɔma mogya koguagua ye dwaa nemɔ aso, na ngrandɛ bɔ okofi nekaa biala kɔwa ye so ne, ɔkɔma mmenia kɔtotɔ wɔ ye nu, na afei bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: When that happens, the people of Israel will no longer have cruel neighbors that abuse them and make them feel as though they are in a field of thorns and briers. And the Israelites will know that I, the Lord God, have done these things. A Blessing for Israel
translation_verse: “Na Yisrael awuro ama de, maen maen amukoraa bɔ bapɛ bɛ nwo bayia, bɔ bebu bɛ animtia ne, bɛngɔkakyi bɛ so ɛfone anaa mmowue ngɔwowɔ bɛ ko. Na afei bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE Nyameɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God said: Someday I will gather the people of Israel from the nations where they are now scattered, and every nation will see that I am holy. The Israelites will once again live in the land I gave to my servant Jacob.
translation_verse: “AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Sɛ meboaboa Yisrael awuro ama bɛ noa mefi maen maen bɔ mabɔ bɛ masande mahɔ so ne aso, ná meye me krongronyɛlɛ ali wɔ bɛ nu, bɔ maen maen nemɔ bɛ nye tua ɔ a, bɛkɔtena bɛ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ bɔ mva mane me somvoɛ Yakob ne aso.

english_verse: They will be safe and will build houses and plant vineyards. They will no longer be in danger, because I will punish their hateful neighbors. Israel will know that I am the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔtena so asomdwee nu, na bekosisi sua bɛkɔyɔ bobe boo mɔ. Na maen maen amukoraa bɔ bapɛ bɛ nwo bayia, bɔ bebu bɛ animtia ne, sɛ metwe bɛ so a, bɛkɔtena asomdwee nu. Na bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ.”

english_verse: Ten years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the twelfth day of the tenth month. He said:
translation_verse: Afoɛ buru ne anu, bosome buru ne anu, ye eleburu ne nyɔ ne aso, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the king of Egypt. Tell him and his people
translation_verse: “Sona awa, fa wɔ nye kyire Misraim hene Faro dɔ, ná hyɛ ngɔm tia ye ne Misraim amukoraa.

english_verse: that I am saying: King of Egypt, you were like a giant crocodile lying in a river. You acted as though you owned the Nile and made it for yourself. But now I, the Lord God, am your enemy!
translation_verse: Dwudwo, ná se kyɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, “Tie, meko metia wɔ, Misraim hene Faro, wɔ, sasrabɔnzam piri bɔ ɛla w’asue mɔ nu, bɔ ɛnwa: ‘M’asue Naele te me bɔbɔ me deɛ, na me bɔbɔ yeɛ nyɔ mane me nwo ɔ.’

english_verse: I will put a hook in your jaw and pull you out of the water, and all the fish in your river will stick to your scaly body.
translation_verse: Nakoso ngɔfa koaa ngɔsosɔ w’awogyee, w’asue mɔ nu tire mɔ, ngɔmaa bɛkɔmatamata wɔ si boen ne anwo, ngɔhwe wɔ ngofi w’asue nemɔ anu, na w’asue nemɔ anu tire amukoraa bɛkɔmatamata wɔ si boen ne.

english_verse: I'll throw you and the fish into the desert, and your body will fall on the hard ground. You will be left unburied, and wild animals and birds will eat your flesh.
translation_verse: Ngofindi wɔ ngɔto ɛserɛ so, ɛne w’asue nemɔ anu tire amukoraa, ɛkɔɔtɔ aseɛ pralaa so, bɛngɔboaboa wɔ noa bengosie wɔ; na ngɔfa wɔ ngɔyɛ aleɛ ngɔma eburo ngaka ne ewienu nnomaa.

english_verse: Then everyone in Egypt will know that I am the Lord. You and your nation refused to help the people of Israel and were nothing more than a broken stick.
translation_verse: “Na Misraimfoɛ amukoraa bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE. Ɔnate kyɛ bɛte ngyɛngyɛma pɔmaa ma Yisrael awuro ama.

english_verse: When they reached out to you for support, you broke in half, cutting their arms and making them fall.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ bɛsosɔle wɔ nu ne, ebuli, na esinasinane bɛ bati amukoraa. Na bekisale wɔ ne koso, ebuli, na ɛmane bɛ dwongu amukoraa wosole.

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will send troops to attack you, king of Egypt. They will kill your people and livestock,
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Tie, mebaafa ngrandɛ meba wɔ so, na ngohũhũ wɔ nu mmenia ne ngaka.

english_verse: until your land is a barren desert. Then you will know that I have done these things. You claimed that you made the Nile River and control it.
translation_verse: Misraim aseɛ ne kɔkakyi kurofoen ne aseɛ pralaa, na bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE. “Ɔnate kyɛ ɔnwa, ‘Asue Naele te me bɔbɔ me deɛ, na me bɔbɔ yeɛ nyɔle ɔ.’

english_verse: Now I am turning against you and your river. Your nation will be nothing but an empty wasteland all the way from the town of Migdol in the north to Aswan in the south, and as far as the border of Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Yiti tie, meko metia wɔ, ɛne w’asue nemɔ amukoraa, na Misraim aseɛ ne, ngɔbɔ ye tɔɔ, ngɔkakyi ye kurofoen, ofi Migidol bɔ ɔkɔ Siene alaa bɔ ɔkwaadwu Yitiopia ɛwɛen so ɔ.

english_verse: No human or animal will even dare travel through Egypt, because no sign of life will be found there for
translation_verse: Kuro sona biala gya baa ngotia so, yeɛ kaka biala gya baa ngotia so, na ɔkɔla berɛ mbaen afoɛ aburanna bɔ ebiala ngɔtena so ɔ.

english_verse: They will once again live in their homeland in southern Egypt. But they will be a weak kingdom
translation_verse: na ngosa ngɔfa Misraim ngofi nnurehyelɛ nu ngɔwa, ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa Patrose aseɛ so, bɔ ɔte bɛ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ bɔ befi so ne, na bɛkɔkakyi ahennie bɔ wabrɛ ye nwo aseɛ ɔ wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: My own people Israel will never again depend on your nation. In fact, when the Israelites remember what happened to you Egyptians, they will realize how wrong they were to turn to you for help. Then the Israelites will know that I, the Lord God, did these things. King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia Will Conquer Egypt
translation_verse: Yisrael awuro ama ngɔfa bɛ wora ngowura Misraim nu ko, na mmom bɛkɔkaye kyɛ bɛyɔle amumuyɛɛ, mmerɛ bɔ bɛhɔle bɛ berɛ bɛɛpenane mmokalɛ ne. Na bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE Nyameɛ.”

english_verse: Twenty-seven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the first month. He said:
translation_verse: Na ɔwale kyɛ, afoɛ aburanyɔ ne nzoo ne anu, bosome bɔ oli moa ne, ye kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ,

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia has attacked the city of Tyre. He forced his soldiers to carry so many heavy loads that their heads were rubbed bald, and their shoulders were red and sore. Nebuchadnezzar and his army still could not capture the city.
translation_verse: “Sona awa, Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa mane ye lɔen bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtetale Tiro serɛserɛ. Koɛ ne anu, mmenia ti so tutuli, na bɛ bati fandifandili. Nakoso ɔne ye lɔen ne, ɛfɛɛ worawora bɔ bɛfɛle wɔ koɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛɛtoale Tiro ne anu ne, bannya ye nwo akatuaa biala bamvi berɛ.

english_verse: So now I will hand over the nation of Egypt to him. He will take Egypt's valuable treasures and give them to his own troops.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Tie, ngɔfa Misraim aseɛ ngɔma Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa. Ɔkɔsoa so mmenia worawora ne kɔhɔ, ɔkɔfa so nningyein kɔyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ, ɔkɔfẽ so nningyein kɔfa, na ɔkɔfa kɔyɛ ye akatuaa kɔma ye lɔen ne.

english_verse: Egypt will be his reward, because he and his army have been following my orders. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate adwuma bɔ wayɔ ne ati, mafa Misraim aseɛ mayɛ akatuaa mama ye, ofikyɛ bɛyɔle adwuma ne bɛmane me, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Ezekiel, when Egypt is defeated, I will make the people of Israel strong, and I will give you the power to speak to them. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_verse: “Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔma mmɛen bie kofifi kɔma Yisrael awuro ama, na ngɔma wɔ tumi maa ekobukye wɔ noa wɔ bɛ nu. Na afei bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Egypt that I am saying: Cry out in despair,
translation_verse: “Sona awa, hyɛ ngɔm ná se kyɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: “Ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye! Ah, ɛ́mɔbɔ kyẽa ne nwo awuye!

english_verse: because you will soon be punished! That will be a time of darkness and doom for all nations.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ kyẽa ne apingye, AWURADE kyẽa ne apingye, ɔkɔyɛ munungum kyẽa, ɔkɔyɛ maen maen mɔ b’amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ.

english_verse: Your own nation of Egypt will be attacked, and Ethiopia will suffer. You will be killed in battle, and your land will be robbed and left in ruins.
translation_verse: Ngrandɛ kɔwa Misraim so, ahunundetelɛ piri kɔtɔ Yitiopia so, mmerɛ bɔ apirafoɛ bɛkɔtotɔ wɔ Misraim ɔ, bɔ bɛkɔsesa ye nu nningyein worawora bɛkɔhɔ ɔ, bɔ bekodwiri ye nyinasoɛ bekogua ɔ.

english_verse: Soldiers hired from Ethiopia, Libya, Lydia, Arabia, Kub, as well as from Israel, will die in that battle.
translation_verse: “Yitiopia, Libia, Lude ne Arabia amukoraa ne Kubo, yeɛ aseɛ bɔ bɛ ne bɛ bayɛ apam ne aso ama, bɛ ne bɛ kɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa.

english_verse: All of your allies will be killed, and your proud strength will crumble. People will die from Migdol in the north to Aswan in the south. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: “AWURADE nwa nyoo: Bɛ bɔ bɛboka Misraim ne, bɛkɔtotɔ, na ye anwomasoɛ anwoserɛ ne kɔbrɛ ase: ofi Migidol bɔ ɔkwaadwu Siene ne, bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa wɔ berɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Your nation of Egypt will be the most deserted place on earth, and its cities will lie in complete ruin.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔyɛ maen bɔ wabɔ ɔ, kyɛ maen maen bɔ babɔ ne ala, na ye nguro kɔyɛ kurofoen, kyɛ nguro bɔ bayɛ kurofoen ne ala.

english_verse: I will set fire to your land, and anyone who defended your nation will die. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Na sɛ meto Misraim nu see, ná mekũkũ ye bokafoɛ amukoraa a, afei bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: On the same day I destroy Egypt, I will send messengers to the Ethiopians to announce their coming destruction. They think they are safe, but they will be terrified.
translation_verse: “Sɔ kyẽa ne, ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ kofi me berɛ bɛkɔfo ɛlɛen bekoonwunanwuna Yitiopiafoɛ bɔ bɛ de bɛnwa bɛ nwo atɔ bɛ ne, na amaneɛ kandinga kɔto bɛ wɔ Misraim amaneɛnwunɛ kyẽa ne; ofikyɛ, okosi amba!

english_verse: Your Egyptian army is very strong, but I will send King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia to completely defeat that army.
translation_verse: “AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ngɔfa Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa so ngonua Misraim mmenia worawora ne aboso.

english_verse: I will dry up the Nile River, then sell the land to evil buyers. I will send foreigners to turn your entire nation into a barren desert. I, the Lord, have spoken. Egypt's Proud Cities Will Lie in Ruins The Lord said to the people of Egypt:
translation_verse: Ngɔma asue Naele nu nzue kɔwewe, na ngɔyɛ aseɛ ne atɔen ngɔma nzɛmmɔnefoɛ. Ngɔfa ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ so ngɔsɛkye aseɛ ne ɔne so nningyein pasaa; me, AWURADE, yeɛ mahã ɔ.

english_verse: All the idols and images you Egyptians worship in the city of Memphis will be smashed. No one will be left to rule your nation, and terror will fill the land.
translation_verse: “AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ngɔsɛkye mmosoen nemɔ, na ngɔpra amoen mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Memfise ɔ bɛ boso. Bengonya ɛhene biala wɔ Misraim aseɛ so ko; na ngɔfa ahunundetelɛ ngɔto Misraim aseɛ so.

english_verse: The city of Pathros will be left in ruins, and Zoan will be burned to the ground. Thebes, your capital city, will also be destroyed!
translation_verse: Ngɔbɔ Patrose tɔɔ, na ngɔto Soan nu see, yeɛ ngɔhwe No ye so.

english_verse: The fortress city of Pelusium will feel my fierce anger, and all the troops stationed at Thebes will be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Ngɔma m’ahone kohu Pelusium bɔ ɔte Misraim anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne aso, na ngonua No mmenia worawora ne bɛ boso.

english_verse: I will set fire to your nation of Egypt! The city of Pelusium will be in anguish. Thebes will fall, and the people of Memphis will live in constant fear.
translation_verse: Ngɔto Misraim nu see, Perusium kɔfa yealɛ nu paa, mmenia kobubu No fasue bekogua bekowura nu, na amaneɛ kɔto Memfise so daa biala.

english_verse: The young soldiers in the cities of Heliopolis and Bubastis will die in battle, and the rest of the people will be taken prisoner.
translation_verse: Mmerandeɛ bɔ bɛwɔ On ɔne Pibesete, bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa, na bɛkɔhye sɔ nguro nemɔ nu mmenia nnure bɛkɔhɔ.

english_verse: You were so proud of your nation's power, but when I crush that power and kill that pride, darkness will fall over the city of Tahpanhes. A dark, gloomy cloud will cover the land as you are being led away into captivity.
translation_verse: Tehafenese koso, alehyeleɛ kɔkakyi awosii, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ngɔsɛkye Misraim tumi wɔ berɛ ne; na ye anwomasoɛ anwoserɛ ne, ɔkɔwa ayieleɛ, na munungum kɔkata ye so, na bɛkɔhye ye mma mmrasua mɔ nnure bɛkɔhɔ.

english_verse: When I'm through punishing Egypt, you will know that I am the Lord. Egypt's King Is Powerless
translation_verse: Sɔ yeɛ ngɔhwe Misraim so ɔ, na afei bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.”

english_verse: Eleven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the seventh day of the first month. He said:
translation_verse: Afoɛ buru ne ko ne anu, bosome bɔ oli moa ne anu, ye ɛlɛsoo ne aso, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I, the Lord, have defeated the king of Egypt! I broke his arm, and no one has wrapped it or put it in a sling, so that it could heal and get strong enough to hold a sword.
translation_verse: “Sona Awa, mabu Misraim hene Faro sa nu, na tie, bamva ayire bangyekye so, yeɛ bammɔ so borɛ bɔ ɔkɔmaa ɔkɔhɔ ɔ, bɔ ahaa ɔnate so nu kɔyɛ se maa ɔkɔhora kɔsɔ ngrandɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: So tell him that I am now his worst enemy. I will break both his arms—the good one and the broken one! His sword will drop from his hand forever,
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Tie, meko metia Misraim hene Faro, ngobu ye sa nu, asaa bɔ nu yɛ se ne, ɔne bɔ nu abu ne, na ngɔma ngrandɛ ne kofi ye sa nu kɔtɔ ase.

english_verse: and I will scatter the Egyptians all over the world.
translation_verse: Ngɔbɔ Misraimfoɛ ngɔsande ngɔhɔ maen maen mɔ nu, na ngɔto bɛ ngɔpete aseɛ mɔ so.

english_verse: I will strengthen the power of Babylonia's king and give him my sword to use against Egypt. I will also make the wounded king of Egypt powerless, and he will moan in pain and die in front of the Babylonian king. Then everyone on earth will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ngɔma Babilɔn hene sa nu kɔyɛ se, nakoso Faro de, ye sa nu kogoho. Na sɛ mefa me ngrandɛ mewura Babilɔn hene sa nu, ná ɔtwe ye wɔ Misraim maen so a, yeɛ bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: I will force the Egyptians to live as prisoners in foreign nations, and they will know that I, the Lord, have punished them.
translation_verse: Ngɔbɔ Misraimfoɛ ngɔsande maen maen mɔ nu, na ngɔto bɛ ngɔpete aseɛ mɔ so. Na afei bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.”

english_verse: Eleven years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the third month. He said:
translation_verse: Afoɛ buru ne ko ne anu, bosome nza ne anu, ye kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the king of Egypt and his people that I am saying: You are more powerful than anyone on earth. Now listen to this.
translation_verse: “Sona awa, kã kyire Misraim hene Faro ne ye lɔen worawora ne kyɛ, “Wɔ titireyɛlɛ nu, nwa yeɛ ɛte kyɛ ye ɔ?

english_verse: There was once a cedar tree in Lebanon with large, strong branches reaching to the sky.
translation_verse: Nea, Asiria te kyɛ Lebanon sida, ye mmaen nyemenenyemene, pusaa bɔ ye bo te fɔnwoo ɔ, na ɔwale paa kɔ anwuro, na ye ti anwuro kɔkã munungum ne anu dɔ.

english_verse: This tree had plenty of water to help it grow tall, and nearby streams watered the other trees in the forest.
translation_verse: Onyane nzue onyi yɛle piri, aseɛ bo dɔ mbombonzue maa ɔyɛle tendenn, ye mbombonzue pɛ ye mmakaa mɔ nwo bra yia na ye asue mɔ tengyɛ fa eburo mmakaa mukoraa bo.

english_verse: But this tree towered over those other trees, and its branches grew long and thick.
translation_verse: Yiti ye tendenn hɔle anwuro trale eburo mmakaa mukoraa; ye mmaen frɔmfrɔm nemɔ yɛle pee, yeɛ ye sa nemɔ yɛle ndendenn, ɔnate kyɛ onyane nzue pee.

english_verse: Birds built nests in its branches, and animals were born beneath it. People from all nations lived in the shade of this strong tree.
translation_verse: Ewienu nnomaa mukoraa bɛnwone bɛ saen wɔ ye mmaen frɔmfrɔm nemɔ anu; eburo ngaka mukoraa bɛwole bɛ mma wɔ ye mmaen nemɔ abo; na ye bo fɔnwoo ne anu yeɛ maen maen mbiri amukoraa bɛtenane ɔ.

english_verse: It had beautiful, long branches, and its roots found water deep in the soil.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle nyemene wɔ ye titireyɛlɛ ne anu, wɔ ye mmaen ndendenn ne anu, ofikyɛ ye ndii ne hɔle aseɛnwo, oodwuli nekaa bɔ nzue pee wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: None of the cedar trees in my garden of Eden were as beautiful as this tree; no tree of any kind had such long branches.
translation_verse: Sida mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Nyameɛ turo ne anu ne, bendwu ye, yeɛ asia mmakaa bendwu ye mmaen frɔmfrɔm nemɔ ɛfa enyaa toto ye mmaen mɔ nwo a ɔnyɛ yee, Nyameɛ turo ne anu bakaa biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔyɛ nyemene te kyɛ ye ɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, gave this tree its beauty, and I helped the branches grow strong. All other trees in Eden wanted to be just like it.
translation_verse: Mamaa wanya mmaen pee maa wayɛ nyemene, bɔ ɔnate so Eden turo nu mmakaa mukoraa, mmakaa bɔ bɛwɔ Nyameɛ turo ne anu ne, bɛ nye boro ye ɔ.

english_verse: King of Egypt, now listen to what I, the Lord God, am saying about that tree: The tree grew so tall that it reached the sky and became very proud and arrogant.
translation_verse: “Yiti AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ɔnate kyɛ onyi yɛle tendenn, bɔ ye ti anwuro ɔɔhane munungum ne anu dɔ, ná ɔyɛle ye tendenn nwo anwomasoɛ ne ati,

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will reject the tree and hand it over to a foreign ruler, who will punish it for its wickedness.
translation_verse: ngɔfa ye ngowura maen maen mɔ nu tuminiɛ ne sa; na ɔne ye koli amba kyɛbɔ ɔfata ɔ. Ɔnate ye amumuyɛɛ ti yeɛ matu ye bo mafi berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Cruel foreigners will chop it down and leave it wherever it falls. Branches and broken limbs will be scattered over the mountains and in the valleys. The people living in the shade of those branches will go somewhere else.
translation_verse: Na ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ, bɔ bɛte maen maen mɔ nufoɛ atianuserɛfoɛ paa ne, bebuli ye bɛtole, na bɛyakyili ye berɛ. Ye mmaen guale mmokaa so ne bɔnza mukoraa nu. Yeɛ ye mmaen frɔmfrɔm ne bubu guale aseɛ so asue mukoraa noa; na aseɛ so maen mukoraa befili ye bo fɔnwoo ne anu, na bɛhɔ bɛyakyili ye berɛ.

english_verse: Birds will then nest on the stump of the fallen tree, and wild animals will trample its branches.
translation_verse: Ewienu nnomaa mukoraa bɛkɔɔtenatena ye wuruwaa ne aso, yeɛ eburo ngaka mukoraa bɛkɔɔtenatena ye mmaen nemɔ aso.

english_verse: Never again will any tree dare to grow as tall as this tree, no matter how much water it has. Every tree must die, just as humans die and go down to the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Mayɔ sɔ, amaa ɔnate so asue noa mmakaa nu biala wamva ye tendenn wanhoahoa ye nwo, anaakyɛ wamma ye ti anwuro wangɔanga munungum ne anu dɔ. Na bakaa biala bɔ onya nzue ne, ongonyi ngɔhɔ anwuro sɔ; ofikyɛ ewue la berɛ ɔnwondɛ bɛ mukoraa, bɛkɔhɔ aseɛ bo dɔ bɛkɔɔboka adasa mmaa so, bɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛkɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu ne.

english_verse: On the day this tree dies and goes to the world below, I, the Lord God, will command rivers and streams to mourn its death. Every underground spring of water and every river will stop flowing. The mountains in Lebanon will be covered with darkness as a sign of their sorrow, and all the trees in the forest will wither.
translation_verse: “AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Kyẽa bɔ owuli hɔle ɛborɔ dɔ ne, mmaa besuni ye. Ɔnate ye ti, ngatale buma ne aso, na mamma ye nzue ne wanze. Nzili ye nzue pembepembe ne ate; na ɔnate ye ti, mama Lebanon ahera ɛsɛen tena; na ɔnate ye ti, eburo mmakaa mukoraa bɛ nwo tole.

english_verse: This tree will crash to the ground, and I will send it to the world below. Then the nations of the earth will tremble. The trees from Eden and the choice trees from Lebanon are now in the world of the dead, and they will be comforted when this tree falls.
translation_verse: Ye asetɔlɛ bɔ ɔtɔle berɛ tuu ne, mvale so mane maen maen mɔ bɛwosole, mmerɛ bɔ mvindini ye ne bɛ bɔ bɛkɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu ndole ɛborɔ dɔ ne. Na afei Eden mmakaa mukoraa, Lebanon mmakaa paa paa bɔ baneanea nu baye ɔ, mmakaa mukoraa bɔ benya nzue ɔ, bɛ wora kɔkyekye wɔ aseɛ bo dɔ.

english_verse: Those people who found protection in its shade will also be sent to the world below, where they will join the dead.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ batotɔ ngrandɛ noa, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛtenane ye bo fɔnwoo nu, wɔ maen maen mɔ nu ne, bɛ koso bɛ ne ye hɔle ɛborɔ dɔ.

english_verse: King of Egypt, all these things will happen to you and your people! You were like this tree at one time—taller and stronger than anyone on earth. But now you will be chopped down, just as every tree in the garden of Eden must die. You will be sent down to the world of the dead, where you will join the godless and the other victims of violent death. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Eden mmakaa nu beni yeɛ w’animnyam ne wɔ piri ɔne ye sɛ ɔ? Nakoso bɛkɔfa wɔ ne Eden mmakaa bɛkɔhɔ aseɛ bo; ɛkɔɔboka bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ so, ɔne bɛ bɔ batotɔ ngrandɛ noa ɔ so. “Ɛhe fa Faro ne ye lɔen worawora ne amukoraa anwo, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: Twelve years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the Lord spoke to me on the first day of the twelfth month. He said:
translation_verse: Afoɛ buru ne nyɔ ne anu, bosome buru ne nyɔ ne anu, kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ,

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the king of Egypt and tell him I am saying: You act like a lion roaming the earth; but you are nothing more than a crocodile in a river, churning up muddy water with your feet.
translation_verse: Sona awa, bɔ Misraim hene Faro nwo awuye, ná se ye kyɛ, “Ebu wɔ nwo kyɛ ɛte maen maen mɔ nu gyata akrɔngrɔma, nakoso ɛte kyɛ bonzu bɔ ɔla ɛpo nu ɔ; ehuru totɔ wɔ w’asue nemɔ anu, ɛfa wɔ gya boro nzue ne, na ɛponda b’asue nemɔ.

english_verse: King of Egypt, listen to me. I, the Lord God, will catch you in my net and let a crowd of foreigners drag you to shore.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ngɔfa maen maen pee bɛ so ngɔto m’asawu ngogua wɔ so, na bɛkɔtwetwe m’asawu ne bɛkɔhwe wɔ bekofite.

english_verse: I will throw you into an open field, where birds and animals will come to feed on your flesh.
translation_verse: Ngofindi wɔ ngɔto aseɛ so, ngogyi wɔ ngɔto buro, ngɔma ewienu nnomaa mukoraa bɛkɔɔtenatena wɔ so, na ngɔma aseɛ amukoraa so ngaka bekoli wɔ naen kɔma bɛ ko koyi.

english_verse: I will spread your rotting flesh over the mountains and in the valleys,
translation_verse: Ngɔto wɔ naen ngogua mmokaa nemɔ aso, na ngɔma wɔ fuin ne koyi bɔnza nemɔ anu tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: and your blood will flow throughout the land and fill up the streams.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa wɔ mogya ngɔloaloa aseɛ ne aso toonn maa okoodwu mmokaa nemɔ aso, na ekoyi asue kumaa nemɔ anu to.

english_verse: I will cover the whole sky and every star with thick clouds, so that the sun and moon will stop shining.
translation_verse: Sɛ menua wɔ boso a, ngɔkata ewienu, na ngɔma nzramaa mɔ kɔyɛ tunn; ngɔfa munungum ngɔkata eyia nyunu, na ɛsraen ngɔta.

english_verse: The heavens will become black, leaving your country in total darkness. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Ewienu nganea mukoraa bɔ bɛta ne, ngɔmaa bɛkɔyɛ wɔ so tunn, na ngɔfa awosii ngɔkata w’aseɛ ne aso, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Foreign nations you have never heard of will be shocked when I tell them how I destroyed you.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa ahunundetelɛ ngɔto maen maen pee bɛ so, mmerɛ bɔ ngɔhye wɔ nnure ngɔhɔ maen maen nemɔ so, aseɛ bɔ ɛnze so ne aso ne.

english_verse: They will be horrified, and when I flash my sword in victory on the day of your death, their kings will tremble in the fear of what could happen to them.
translation_verse: Ɔnate wɔ ti ngɔma maen maen pee bɛ nwo kodwiri bɛ; na mmerɛ bɔ ngɔnwaha me ngrandɛ wɔ bɛ nyunu ne, ɔnate wɔ ti awɔse kogua b’ahemvo mɔ. Na kyẽa bɔ ɛkɔtɔ ase ne, bɛ nwo kɔwosowoso bɛ, bɔ ebiala kɔpena ye ti ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: The king of Babylonia is coming to attack you, king of Egypt!
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Babilɔn hene ngrandɛ kɔwa wɔ so.

english_verse: Your soldiers will be killed by the cruelest army in the world, and everything you take pride in will be crushed.
translation_verse: Wɔ lɔen worawora ne, ngɔmaa bɛkɔtotɔ anwoserɛfoɛ bɛ ngrandɛ noa, mmenia bɔ bɛ mukoraa bɛ nwo yɛ suro paa wɔ maen maen mɔ nu ne. “Bekotu Misraim anwomasoɛ ne abo, na ye lɔen worawora amukoraa ne, bɛ boso konua.

english_verse: I will slaughter your cattle that graze by the river, and no people or livestock will be left to muddy its water.
translation_verse: Ngohũhũ ye nyɛmmoa mukoraa ngofi asue mbiri nemɔ anoa; sona gya ngɔma bɛngɔponda ko, yeɛ nyɛmmoa gya ngɔma bɛngɔponda ko.

english_verse: The water will be clear, and streams will be calm. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Na afei ngɔma b’asue nemɔ kɔgyene, na ngɔma b’asueba nemɔ kɔtengyɛ kyɛ ngoo, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Egypt will become a barren wasteland, and no living thing will ever survive there. Then you and your people will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ ngɔsɛkye Misraim aseɛ ne pasaa, bɔ ngɔsɛkye aseɛ ne aso nikyee biala maa ɔkɔla berɛ mbaen, bɔ ngohũhũ bɛ bɔ bɛte so amukoraa ne, yeɛ afei bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: This is your warning, and it will be used as a funeral song by foreign women to mourn the death of your people. I, the Lord God, have spoken. A Sad Ending for Egypt
translation_verse: Awuye he yeɛ bɛkɔfa bekosu ye ɔ: Maen maen mmaa mmrasua mɔ bekosu ye; bekosu Misraim ne ye lɔen worawora ne amukoraa, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, mourn for the Egyptians and condemn them to the world of the dead, where they will be buried alongside the people of other powerful nations.
translation_verse: “Sona awa, bɔ Misraim lɔen worawora ne ti so awuye, na bɛ ne maen maen atitire mɔ bɛ mma mmrasua nemɔ, gyi bɛ gua aseɛ bo dɔ maa bɛɛboka mmenia bɔ bahɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu dɔ ne aso.

english_verse: Say to them: You may be more beautiful than the people of other nations, but you will also die and join the godless in the world below.
translation_verse: ‘Nwa yeɛ w’anwonyemene tra ye ɔ? Dwu kɔ aseɛ bo dɔ kɔla bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ bɛ nwo berɛ.’

english_verse: You cannot escape! The enemy's sword is ready to slaughter every one of you.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔtotɔ wɔ bɛ bɔ batotɔ ngrandɛ noa ɔ bɛ nu. Mafa ye mawura ngrandɛ sa, yiti twe ye ne ye lɔen worawora ne amukoraa kɔ.

english_verse: Brave military leaders killed in battle will gladly welcome you and your allies into the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Na bɛ nu anwoserɛfoɛ nemɔ, bɛ ne bɛ bokafoɛ mɔ, bɛkɔhã bekohyire bɛ bekofi ɛborɔ dɔ kyɛ, ‘Bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ bɔ bafa ngrandɛ bahũhũ bɛ ne, bawa aseɛ bo baalela.’

english_verse: The graves of soldiers from Assyria are there. They once terrified people, but they were killed in battle and now lie deep in the world of the dead.
translation_verse: Bapɛ b’asieleɛ ne bato ɛborɔ kumaa ne abo dɔ paa, na ye lɔen ne apɛ ye asieleɛ ne nwo bayia. Bahũ bɛ mukoraa, batotɔ ngrandɛ noa, bɛ bɔ bɛmane ahunundetelɛ tɔle mmenia so wɔ ateasefoɛ aseɛ so ne.

english_verse: The graves of soldiers from Elam are there. The very sight of those godless soldiers once terrified their enemies and made them panic. But now they are disgraced and ashamed as they lie in the world of the dead, alongside others who were killed in battle.
translation_verse: Basɛ ye bɛen wɔ bɛ bɔ bahũhũ bɛ nemɔ anu, ɔne ye lɔen worawora ne amukoraa; b’asieleɛ apɛ ye nwo ayia. Bɛ mukoraa bɛte bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ, batotɔ ngrandɛ noa; ofikyɛ bɛmane bɛ nwo suronyi tɔle ateasefoɛ aseɛ so, na bɛ ne bɛ bɔ bahɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu ne, bɛso b’animguaseɛ, na bafa bɛ bafra bɛ bɔ batotɔ ngrandɛ noa ne.

english_verse: The graves of soldiers from Meshech and Tubal are there. These godless soldiers who terrified people were all killed in battle.
translation_verse: Berɛ yeɛ Meseke ne Tubal bɛwɔ ɔ, bɛ ne bɛ lɔen worawora ne amukoraa, na b’asieleɛ apɛ bɛ nwo ayia. Bɛ mukoraa bɛte bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ, batotɔ ngrandɛ noa; ofikyɛ bɛmane bɛ nwo suronyi tɔle mmenia so wɔ ateasefoɛ aseɛ so.

english_verse: They were not given a proper burial like the heroes of long ago, who were buried with their swords under their heads and with their shields over their bodies. These were the heroes who made their enemies panic.
translation_verse: Na bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ anwoserɛfoɛ bɔ batotɔ, bɔ bɛfale b’akodeɛ bɛhɔle ɛborɔ, bɔ bɛfale bɛ ngrandɛ besiele bɛ, bɔ b’amumuyɛɛ ahã bɛ mmowue ne, bɛ ne bɛ ngɔla ngɔbɔ nu; ɔwɔ nu kyɛ anwoserɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛmane bɛ nwo suronyi tɔle mmenia so wɔ ateasefoɛ aseɛ so de.

english_verse: You Egyptians will be cruelly defeated, and you will be buried alongside these other godless soldiers who died in battle.
translation_verse: Yiti, bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ mɔ nu yeɛ bekobubu wɔ nu ɔ, na ɛne bɛ bɔ batotɔ ngrandɛ noa yeɛ bɛkɔla bɛkɔbɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: The graves of kings and leaders from Edom are there. They were powerful at one time. Now they are buried in the world of the dead with other godless soldiers killed in battle.
translation_verse: Berɛ yeɛ Edom wɔ ɔ, ye ahemvo ne ye atitirefoɛ. B’anwoserɛ piri ne asi ne po, bafa bɛ bafra bɛ bɔ batotɔ ngrandɛ noa ɔ nu. Bɛ ne bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛkɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu ne yeɛ bɛkɔla bɛkɔbɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: The graves of the rulers of the north are there, as well as those of the Sidonians. Their powerful armies once terrified enemies. Now they lie buried in the world of the dead, where they are disgraced like other soldiers killed in battle.
translation_verse: “Berɛ yeɛ sorɔ dɔ atitirefoɛ amukoraa bɛwɔ ɔ, yeɛ Sidoniafoɛ amukoraa. Bɛ ne mmenia bɔ bahũ bɛ ɔ yeɛ bahɔ aseɛ bo dɔ ɔ. B’anwoserɛ bɔ bɛfa benwunanwunane mmenia ne asi ne po, animguaseɛ ahã bɛ. Bɛte bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ, bɛ ne bɛ bɔ batotɔ ngrandɛ noa yeɛ bɛlela berɛ ɔ, na bɛ ne bɛ bɔ bahɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu yeɛ bɛso b’animguaseɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God says: When your king of Egypt sees all of these graves, he and his soldiers will be glad they are not the only ones suffering.
translation_verse: “Na sɛ Faro ne ye koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraa benwu bɛ a, Faro kɔkyekye ye wora wɔ ye lɔen worawora bɔ batotɔ ngrandɛ noa ne anwo, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I sent him to terrify people all over the earth. But he and his army will be killed and buried alongside other godless soldiers in the world of the dead. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mama me nwo suronyi atɔ mmenia so wɔ ateasefoɛ aseɛ so, yiti ngɔfa Faro ngɔto bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ nu, ɔne ye lɔen worawora ne amukoraa, ngɔfa bɛ ngɔfra bɛ bɔ batotɔ ngrandɛ noa ɔ, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: and to sound a warning signal when the enemy is seen coming.
translation_verse: ná sɛ onwu ngrandɛ ne kyɛ ɔba maen ne aso, ná ohu totorobɛndo fa bɔ maen ne kɔkɔ a;

english_verse: Their past sins will be forgiven, and they will live because they have done right.
translation_verse: Ye bɔne bɔ wayɔ ne, mengɔkaye nu biala; wayɔ bɔ ɔte paa ne bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ, na amba, okonya ngoa.

english_verse: Twelve years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, a refugee who had escaped from Jerusalem came to me on the fifth day of the tenth month. He told me that the city had fallen.
translation_verse: Bɛhyele yɛ nnure bɛhɔle ne, ye afoɛ buru ne nyɔ ne anu, bosome buru ne anu, ye elennu ne aso, biaa bie bɔ wanwati wafi Yerusalem ɔ ɔwale me berɛ oosele me kyɛ, “Babɔ kuro ne!”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, warn your people by saying: Someday, I, the Lord, may send an enemy to invade a country. And suppose its people choose someone to stand watch
translation_verse: “Sona awa, dwudwo kyire wɔ maen mmaa, ná se bɛ kyɛ, Sɛ mefa ngrandɛ meba maen bie aso, ná sɛ maen ne anu ama bɛye bɛ nu bienzua ko bɛfa ye bɛyɛ wɛmvoɛ;

english_verse: If any of these people hear the signal and ignore it, they will be killed in battle. But it will be their own fault, because they could have escaped if they had paid attention.
translation_verse: Ɔtele totorobɛndo hulɛ ne, nakoso wamva kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne wanyɛ huu; ye mogya kɔbɔ ye bɔbɔ ye ti so. Nakoso ebiala bɔ otie kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne, onya ngoa ma ye kra.

english_verse: But suppose the person watching fails to sound the warning signal. The enemy will attack and kill some of the sinful people in that country, and I, the Lord, will hold that person responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ wɛmvoɛ ne onwu ngrandɛ ne kyɛ ɔba, ná wanhu totorobɛndo ne wamva wammɔ maen ne kɔkɔ, ná ngrandɛ ne ba ɔbaku bɛ nu bie a, ye de sɔ sona ne, ye amumuyɛɛ nu yeɛ wawu ɔ; nakoso ye mogya de, wɛmvoɛ ne berɛ yeɛ ngobisa ngofi ɔ.

english_verse: Ezekiel, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me.
translation_verse: “Yiti wɔ, Sona awa, mafa wɔ mayɛ Yisrael awuro ama bɛ wɛmvoɛ. Yiti tie me noa dwirɛ, ná fa bɔ bɛ kɔkɔ.

english_verse: When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways. But if you refuse to warn them, you are responsible for their death.
translation_verse: Sɛ mekã mekyire bɔnefoɛ kyɛ, ‘Bɔnefoɛ, ewue yeɛ ekowu ɔ,’ ná andwudwo ammɔ bɔnefoɛ ne kɔkɔ maa wanyakyi ye yɔleɛ a, sɔ bɔnefoɛ ne kowu ye amumuyɛɛ nu, nakoso ye mogya de, wɔ berɛ yeɛ ngobisa ngofi ɔ.

english_verse: If you do warn them, and they keep sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent. The Lord Is Always Fair (Ezekiel
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɛbɔ bɔnefoɛ ne kɔkɔ kyɛ ɔyakyi ye yɔleɛ, ná wanyakyi ye yɔleɛ a, ye amumuyɛɛ nu yeɛ okowu ɔ, nakoso wɔ de, ekonya ngoa kɔma wɔ kra. Ebiala kɔsoa ye bɔbɔ ye bɔne nwo asodie

english_verse: If good people start doing evil, they will be put to death, because they have sinned.
translation_verse: Sɛ teneneeniɛ kakyi ye si ma ye tenenee, ná ɔyɔ amumuyɛɛ a, nu yeɛ okowu ɔ.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people with you in Babylonia talk about you when they meet by the city walls or in the doorways of their houses. They say, “Let's ask Ezekiel what the Lord has said today.”
translation_verse: “Na wɔ Sona awa, wɔ maen mmaa nemɔ bɛkekã edwirɛ bɛfa wɔ nwo, bɛkekã ye wɔ fasue nemɔ anwo ne awuro nemɔ anoa nu. Bɛkekã bekyirekyire bɛ nwo ne b’eliɛma mɔ kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔbra beetie edwirɛ bɔ ofi AWURADE noa ne oo!’

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, the people of Israel are complaining that the punishment for their sins is more than they can stand. They have lost all hope for survival, and they blame me.
translation_verse: “Na wɔ, Sona awa, se Yisrael awuro ama kyɛ, Ɛmɔnwa: ‘Yɛ mmeraatolɛ ne yɛ bɔne wabu watia yɛ, ye sɔ ati yeɛ onyie yɛ yé ye; na ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né yanya ngoa?’

english_verse: Tell them that as surely as I am the living Lord God, I don't like to see wicked people die. I enjoy seeing them turn from their sins and live. So if the Israelites want to live, they must stop sinning and turn back to me.
translation_verse: Se bɛ kyɛ: Kyɛ nde ase ye, me nye ngye bɔnefoɛ ye wue nwo, na mmom me nye gye kyɛ bɔnefoɛ kɔyakyi ye yɔleɛ, ná okonya ngoa ɔ. AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne. Ɛ́mɔyakyi, ɛ́mɔyakyi ɛmɔ bɔne yɔleɛ ne! O Yisrael awuro ama, nzu ati yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔwuwu ɔ?

english_verse: Tell them that when good people start sinning, all the good they did in the past cannot save them from being punished. And remind them that when wicked people stop sinning, their past sins will be completely forgiven, and they won't be punished.
translation_verse: “Na wɔ, Sona awa, se wɔ maen mmaa kyɛ: Kyẽa bɔ teneneeniɛ kɔto mmeraa ne, ye tenenee ngɔpepɛ ngole ye; yeɛ kyẽa bɔ bɔnefoɛ kɔkakyi ye si kɔma ye bɔne yɔleɛ ne, ye bɔne yɔleɛ ne ngɔfa ye ngɔhɔ ewue nu. Yeɛ kyẽa bɔ teneneeniɛ kɔyɔ bɔne ne, ɔngɔhora ngogyina ye tenenee so ngonya ngoa.

english_verse: Suppose I promise good people that they will live, then later they start sinning and believe they will be saved by the good they did in the past. These people will certainly be put to death because of their sins. Their good deeds will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Sɛ mekã mekyire teneneeniɛ kyɛ, amba, okonya ngoa, ná sɛ ɔfa ye nwo to ye tenenee so, ná ɔbɔ amumuyɛɛ bra a, mengɔkaye ye tenenee bra ne anu biala, na mmom ye amumuyɛɛ bra ne anu ala yeɛ okowu ɔ

english_verse: Suppose I warn wicked people that they will die because of their sins, and they stop sinning and start doing right.
translation_verse: Yeɛ sɛ bɔnefoɛ koso mekã mekyire ye kyɛ, ‘Ewue ala yeɛ ekowu ɔ,’ nakoso sɛ ɔkakyi ye si ma ye bɔne, ná ɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ne bɔ ɔtengyɛ,

english_verse: For example, they need to return anything they have taken as security for a loan and anything they have stolen. Then if they stop doing evil and start obeying my Law, they will live.
translation_verse: ná sɛ bɔnefoɛ ne fa nikyee bɔ bafa basi ye berɛ awowaa ne osa ma ye mene, osa fa nikyee bɔ wawua ɔ ɔma ye mene, ná odi ngoa ahyɛdeɛ ne aso, bɔ ɔnyɔ amumuyɛɛ a, ye de, amba, okonya ngoa, ongowu.

english_verse: Ezekiel, your people accuse me of being unfair. But they are the ones who are unfair.
translation_verse: “Nakoso wɔ maen mmaa nwa, ‘AWURADE atee ndengyɛ’; wɔ aberɛ bɔ b’atee mmom yeɛ ɔndengyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And if wicked people stop sinning and start doing right, they will save themselves from punishment.
translation_verse: Yeɛ sɛ bɔnefoɛ kakyi ye si ma ye bɔne, ná ɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ne bɔ ɔtengyɛ a, nu yeɛ okonya ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: But the Israelites still think I am unfair. So warn them that they will be punished for what they have done. The News of Jerusalem's Fall
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔnwa: ‘AWURADE atee ndengyɛ.’ O Yisrael awuro ama, ngobua ɛmɔ nu biala ndɛen kyɛbɔ ye yɔleɛ te ɔ.” Yerusalem bɔlɛ nwo amaneɛbɔlɛ

english_verse: The evening before this man arrived at my house, the Lord had taken control of me. So when the man came to me the next morning, I could once again speak. What Will Happen to Those Left in Israel?
translation_verse: Na AWURADE tumi wale me so nɔsoa ne koraka yeɛ biaa bɔ wanwati ne ɔbaawa ɔ. Na anzana biaa ne ɔbaawa me berɛ ngyerɛmɔ nen, né AWURADE ate me noa ne, yiti ɔtele me noa ne, na mandɔ mumu ko.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in the ruined cities of Israel are saying, “Abraham was just one man, and the Lord gave him this whole land of Israel. There are many of us, and so this land must be ours.”
translation_verse: “Sona awa, mmenia bɔ bɛtete sɔ Yisrael aseɛ bɔ wakakyi kurofoen ne aso ne, bɛnwa, ‘Né Abraham te sona horɛ, yeɛ onyane aseɛ ne fa yɛle ye deɛ ɔ; nakoso yɛ de yɛsone, na yɛ mmom yeɛ bafa aseɛ ne bama yɛ kyɛ yɛfa yɛyɛ yɛ deɛ ɔ.’

english_verse: So, Ezekiel, tell them I am saying: How can you think the land is still yours? You eat meat with blood in it and worship idols. You commit murder
translation_verse: Yiti se bɛ kyɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ɛmɔdi naen bɔ ye mogya wɔ ye nu ɔ, ɛmɔsɔne ɛmɔ mmosoen nemɔ, yeɛ ɛmɔkã mogya begua; na ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né ɛmɔanya aseɛ ne bafa bayɛ ɛmɔ deɛ?

english_verse: and spread violence throughout the land. Everything you do is wicked; you are even unfaithful in marriage. And you claim the land is yours!
translation_verse: Ɛmɔngyɛ ye nwo né ɛmɔali awue, ɛmɔbɔ akyiwadeɛ bra, yeɛ ɛmɔ nu biala fa obiɛngo aye; na ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né ɛmɔanya aseɛ ne bafa bayɛ ɛmɔ deɛ?

english_verse: As surely as I am the living Lord God, you people in the ruined cities will be killed in battle. Those of you living in the countryside will be eaten by wild animals, and those hiding in caves and on rocky cliffs will die from deadly diseases.
translation_verse: Se bɛ kyɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Kyɛ nde ase ye, nahorɛ nu, bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ kurofoen nemɔ aso ne, bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa; bɔ ɔwɔ eburo ne koso, ngɔfa ye ngɔma ngaka aboyaa maa bɛkɔhye ye bekoli; yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ anwoserɛ afealeɛ mɔ nu, ɔne nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua ɔ mɔ nu koso, ewue anwonyerɛ yeɛ okohũ bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I will make the whole country an empty wasteland and crush the power in which you take such pride. Even the mountains will be bare, and no one will try to cross them.
translation_verse: Ngɔkakyi aseɛ ne kurofoen, na ɔkɔla berɛ mbaen, na ye anwomasoɛ anwoserɛ ne, ye bo kɔpɛ; yeɛ Yisrael mmokaa nemɔ kɔla berɛ mbaen bɔ ebiala ngɔfa so ɔ.

english_verse: I will punish you because of your sins, and I will turn your nation into a barren desert. Then you will know that I am the Lord. The People Listen, but Don't Change The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na b’akyiwadeɛ bra bɔ babɔ ne amukoraa, sɛ ɔnate ye ti mekakyi aseɛ ne kurofoen, ná memaa ɔda berɛ mbaen a, yeɛ afei bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: So they all come and listen to you, but they refuse to do what you tell them. They claim to be faithful, but they are forever trying to cheat others out of their money.
translation_verse: Bɛba wɔ berɛ kyɛbɔ maen bɛkwaayia ne ala, bɛtenatena wɔ nyunu kyɛ me maen, betie wɔ noa dwirɛ, nakoso benni so; ofikyɛ bɛma bɛ noa dwirɛ yɛ fɛfɛɛfɛ kyɛ bale bato nu, nakoso b’ahone nu de, b’anwonya fiɛ yeɛ bɛpena ɔ.

english_verse: They treat you as though you were merely singing love songs or playing music. They listen, but don't do anything you say.
translation_verse: Na tie, ɛte kyɛ edwein fɛfɛɛfɛ ma bɛ, kyɛ ebie bɔ ye komvi yɛ fɛ, bɔ ɔse sangoo bɔ paa ɔ ye dwein; ofikyɛ bɛte wɔ dwirɛ ne de, nakoso benni so.

english_verse: Soon they will be punished, just as you warned, and they will know that a prophet has been among them.
translation_verse: Na sɛ sɔ dwirɛ ne ba nu a, yoo, ɔkɔwa nu koso amba, yeɛ afei bekonwu kyɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ bie ɔne bɛ baatena le ɔ.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, Israel's leaders are like shepherds taking care of my sheep, the people of Israel. But I want you to condemn these leaders and tell them: I, the Lord God, say you shepherds of Israel are doomed! You take care of yourselves while ignoring my sheep.
translation_verse: Sona awa, hyɛ ngɔm tia Yisrael mmoaenneafoɛ nemɔ. Hyɛ ngɔm ná se mmoaenneafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, ‘AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ɛmɔ yaakɔ! Yisraelfoɛ mmoaenneafoɛ bɔ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔ nwo yeɛ ɛmɔnea so ɔ! Aso nna mmoaen nemɔ so yeɛ odi kyɛ mmoaenneafoɛ bɛnea ɔ?

english_verse: You drink their milk and use their wool to make your clothes. Then you butcher the best ones for food. But you don't take care of the flock!
translation_verse: Ɛloe ne yeɛ ɛmɔdi ɔ, mmoaen ne nwo nwiaa yeɛ ɛmɔfa bɛyɛ ɛtena bɛkera ɔ, ɛmɔku bɔ walɔ ne, nakoso mmoaen nemɔ de, ɛmɔnnea bɛ so.

english_verse: You have never protected the weak ones or healed the sick ones or bandaged those that get hurt. You let them wander off and never look for those that get lost. You are cruel and mean to my sheep.
translation_verse: Bɔ wayɛ mmerɛ ne, ɛmɔamma ye nwo anyɛ se; bɔ ɔnde apɔ ne, ɛmɔanza ye anwonyerɛ; bɔ wabubu ne, ɛmɔammɔ ye borɛ; bɔ bafoa ye maa wahɔ ne, ɛmɔamva ye bamma; bɔ wamini ne, ɛmɔangɔ ambena ye boso; na mmom nhyɛsoɛ ne atianuserɛ yeɛ ɛmɔfa bedi bɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: They strayed in every direction, and because there was no shepherd to watch them, they were attacked and eaten by wild animals.
translation_verse: Na bɛbɔle aya, ofikyɛ belle neafoɛ biala. Na bɛbɔle aya ne, bɛkakyili eburo ngaka aboyaa amukoraa bɛ noa aleɛ.

english_verse: So my sheep were scattered across the earth. They roamed on hills and mountains, without anyone even bothering to look for them.
translation_verse: Me mmoaen nemɔ bɛbɔ bɛsandele wɔ mmokaa mukoraa ne pambaa biala so. Amba, me mmoaen nemɔ bɛbɔle aya bɛhɔle aseɛ so nekaa biala, na ebiala ammisa bɛ boso, yeɛ ebiala ambena bɛ.

english_verse: Now listen to what I, the living Lord God, am saying to you shepherds. My sheep have been attacked and eaten by wild animals, because you refused to watch them. You never went looking for the lost ones, and you fed yourselves without feeding my sheep.
translation_verse: Kyɛ nde ase ye, susu amba kyɛ, me mmoaen akakyi nikyee bɔ ebiemɔ bɛfẽ bɛfa ɔ; bakakyi eburo ngaka amukoraa b’aleɛ, ofikyɛ belle mmoaenneafoɛ biala; yeɛ me mmoaenneafoɛ nemɔ bambena bɛ boso, na mmom mmoaenneafoɛ nemɔ bɛnea bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nwo so, na bɛnnea me mmoaen nemɔ aso, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: So I, the Lord, will punish you! I will rescue my sheep from you and never let you be their shepherd again or butcher them for food. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Lord Is the Good Shepherd
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Tie, meko metia mmoaenneafoɛ nemɔ; ngobisa me mmoaen nemɔ ngofi bɛ berɛ; ngɔmaa bɛkɔyakyi mmoaen nemɔ so nealɛ, maa ɔnate so mmoaenneafoɛ nemɔ bɛngɔnea bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nwo so ko. Na ngofoti me mmoaen nemɔ ngofi bɛ noa nu, amaa ɔnate so bangakyi bɛ noa aleɛ ko.

english_verse: The Lord God then said: I will look for my sheep and take care of them myself,
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Tie, me, me bɔbɔ ngɔɔpena me mmoaen nemɔ boso, na ngɔnea bɛ so.

english_verse: just as a shepherd looks for lost sheep. My sheep have been lost since that dark and miserable day when they were scattered throughout the nations. But I will rescue them
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ mmoaenneafoɛ ɔpena ye mmoaen bɔ babɔ aya ɔ bɛ boso, wɔ kyẽa bɔ ɔne bɛ wɔ berɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ngɔpena me mmoaen nemɔ bɛ boso ɔ; na ngɔye bɛ ngofi nekaa mukoraa bɔ babɔ aya bahɔ ɔ, wɔ munungum ne awosii kabii kyẽa ne.

english_verse: and bring them back from the foreign nations where they now live. I will be their shepherd and will let them graze on Israel's mountains and in the valleys and fertile fields.
translation_verse: Ngɔye bɛ ngofi maen maen nemɔ anu, ngɔboaboa bɛ noa ngofi aseɛ nemɔ aso, ná mafa bɛ mawa bɛ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ so. Na ngɔnea bɛ so wɔ Yisrael mmokaa nemɔ aso, wɔ asue bɔnza mɔ nu ne aseɛ ne aso nekaa biala bɔ bɛte ɔ.

english_verse: I promise to take care of them and keep them safe,
translation_verse: Me bɔbɔ deinn yeɛ ngɔnea me mmoaen nemɔ aso ɔ, na me bɔbɔ ngɔmaa bekobutubutu berɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: to look for those that are lost and bring back the ones that wander off, to bandage those that are hurt and protect the ones that are weak. I will also slaughter those that are fat and strong, because I always do right. Judgment on the Strong Sheep
translation_verse: Bɔ wamini ne, ngɔpena ye boso, yeɛ bɔ bafoa ye maa wahɔ ne, ngɔɔfa ye ngɔwa. Bɔ wabubu ne, ngɔbɔ ye borɛ, bɔ ɔnde apɔ ne, ngɔsa ye anwonyerɛ; na bɛ bɔ balɔ bɔ bɛ nwo yɛ se ne wora, ngɔnea bɛ so; na ngɔfa pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ yeɛ ngɔnea bɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God said to his sheep, the people of Israel: I will carefully watch each one of you to decide which ones are the strong sheep and which ones are weak.
translation_verse: “Na ɛmɔ, me mmoaen kure, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ɛ́mɔtie, mebaabua boaen ne boaen b’afia ndɛen, yeɛ boaen nyii ne abɔngye nyii b’afia ndɛen.

english_verse: Some of you eat the greenest grass, then trample down what's left when you finish. Others drink clean water, then step in the water to make the rest of it muddy.
translation_verse: Aso wanyɛ ɛmɔ anyesɔ kyɛ ɛmɔdidi nekaa bɔ berɛ ndire te paa ɔ, bɔ yeɛ ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ gya betiatia ɛmɔ ndire bɔ waha ne aso ɔ? Aso wanyɛ ɛmɔ anyesɔ kyɛ ɛmɔno nzue gyengɔgyengɔ ɔ, bɔ yeɛ ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ gya bɛponda bɔ waha ne ɔ?

english_verse: That means my other sheep have nothing fit to eat or drink.
translation_verse: Aso odi kyɛ me mmoaen bedi bɔ ɛmɔafa ɛmɔ gya batiatia so ne, ná bɛno bɔ ɛmɔafa ɛmɔ gya baponda ye ne anaa?

english_verse: So I, the Lord God, will separate you strong sheep from the weak.
translation_verse: “Bɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ ɔkã kyire bɛ hɔ ɛhe: Ɛ́mɔtie, me, me bɔbɔ ngobua mmoaen bɔ balɔ nemɔ, ɔne bɔ bafɔ nemɔ b’afia ndɛen.

english_verse: You strong ones have used your powerful horns to chase off those that are weak,
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ mvenu ne ɛmɔ bati besumusumu, ná ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ mmɛen bɛwowɔ bɛ bɔ bɛnde apɔ ne amukoraa, kɔpem kyɛ ɛmɔkɔbɔ bɛ kɔsande bɛkɔhɔ dedeede ne ati,

english_verse: but I will rescue them and no longer let them be mistreated. I will separate the good from the bad.
translation_verse: ngole me mmoaen nemɔ ngoa, bɛngɔyɛ ebiemɔ bɛ nikyee bɔ bɛfẽ bɛfa ɔ ko; na ngobua boaen ne boaen b’afia ndɛen.

english_verse: After that, I will give you a shepherd from the family of my servant King David. All of you, both strong and weak, will have the same shepherd, and he will take good care of you.
translation_verse: Ngɔma mmoaenneafoɛ ko kɔnea bɛ so. Ye ole me somvoɛ Dawide. Ɔkɔma bɛ aleɛ, ɔkɔma bɛ aleɛ ná wayɛ bɛ so mmoaenneafoɛ.

english_verse: He will be your leader, and I will be your God. I, the Lord, have spoken. A Bright Future for the Lord's Sheep The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Na me, AWURADE, ngɔyɛ bɛ Nyameɛ, na me somvoɛ Dawide yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ bɛ so panyi kotua bɛ noa ɔ; me, AWURADE, me yeɛ mahã ɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel are my sheep, and I solemnly promise that they will live in peace. I will chase away every wild animal from the desert and the forest, so my sheep will not be afraid.
translation_verse: “Me ne bɛ yɛkɔyɛ asomdwee apam, na ngotu ngaka aboyaa mɔ bo ngofi aseɛ ne aso, amaa ɔnate so batena ɛserɛ ne aso asomdwee nu, ná balela ɛhɔayeɛ nemɔ anu.

english_verse: They will live around my holy mountain, and I will bless them by sending more than enough rain
translation_verse: Bɛ ne aseɛ bɔ bapɛ me bokaa ne anwo bayia ne, ngɔmaa bɛkɔyɛ saleɛ, na ngɔma esue kɔtɔ wɔ ye mmerɛ nu; ɔkɔyɛ saleɛ esue.

english_verse: to make their trees produce fruit and their crops to grow. I will set them free from slavery and let them live safely in their own land. Then they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Eburo mmakaa bekosu bɛ mma, yeɛ aseɛ kɔhye aleɛ, na bɛ so anu kɔtɔ bɛ wɔ b’aseɛ so. Na mmerɛ bɔ ngobubu bɛ kɔnnua nu, ná ngole bɛ ngofi bɛ bɔ bafa bɛ bayɛ nganga nemɔ bɛ sa nu ne, yeɛ bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: Foreign nations will never again rob them, and wild animals will no longer kill and eat them. They will have nothing to fear.
translation_verse: Bɛngɔyɛ nikyee bɔ maen maen mɔ bɛfẽ bɛfa ɔ ko, yeɛ aseɛ so ngaka ngɔhye bɛ ko, na mmom bɛkɔtena ase asomdwee nu bɔ ebiala ngonwunanwuna bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I will make their fields produce large amounts of crops, so they will never again go hungry or be laughed at by foreigners.
translation_verse: Ngɔma bɛ eboo nyemenenyemene, bɔ ɛhɔen ngohũ bɛ ko wɔ aseɛ ne aso ɔ, bɔ maen maen mɔ ngɔgoro bɛ nwo ko ɔ.

english_verse: Then everyone will know that I protect my people Israel. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Na afei bekonwu kyɛ me, AWURADE, bɛ Nyameɛ ne, me ne bɛ yeɛ yɛwɔ berɛ ɔ; na bɛ, Yisrael awuro ama, bɛte me maen, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: They are my sheep; I am their God, and I take care of them.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔte me mmoaen kure, me mmoaen bɔ mema bɛ aleɛ ɔ, ɛmɔte mmenia, na me yeɛ nde ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ɔ, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the people of Edom
translation_verse: “Sona awa, fa wɔ nye kyire Sɛre bokaa, ná hyɛ ngɔm tia ye.

english_verse: and say to them: I, the Lord God, am now your enemy! And I will turn your nation into an empty wasteland,
translation_verse: Se ye kyɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Tie, Sɛre bokaa, meko metia wɔ, ngɔtengyɛ me sa ngɔhwe wɔ so, ngɔbɔ wɔ tɔɔ, na ngɔmaa ɛkɔla berɛ mbaen.

english_verse: leaving your towns in ruins. Your land will be a desert, and then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ngɔkakyi wɔ nguro mɔ kurofoen, na ɛkɔla berɛ mbaen, na afei ekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: People of Edom, not only have you been Israel's longtime enemy, you simply watched when disaster wiped out its people as punishment for their sins.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ asɔ ɛpɔen nu bɔ ɛngɔyakyi nu, bɔ afa ngrandɛ ahũhũ Yisraelfoɛ wɔ b’amaneɛ mmerɛ nu, wɔ bɛ sohwenɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo mmerɛ nu ne ati,

english_verse: And so, as surely as I am the living Lord God, you are guilty of murder and must be put to death.
translation_verse: yiti, kyɛ nde ase ye, ngɔmaa bɛkɔhã wɔ mogya bekogua, na mogya ne kɔfoa wɔ; ofikyɛ anzuro kyɛ ɛkɔhã mogya kogua ɔ, yiti mogya yeɛ ɔkɔfoa wɔ ɔ, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ.

english_verse: I will destroy your nation and kill anyone who travels through it.
translation_verse: Ngɔsɛkye Sɛre bokaa bɔkɔɔ, na ngɔmaa ɔkɔla berɛ mbaen, ngofoa ebiala bɔ ofi berɛ ɔkɔ ɔ, ɔne bɔ osa ba berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and your land will lie in ruins forever. No one will live in your towns ever again. You will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ngɔbɔ wɔ tɔɔ afebɔɔ, na ebiala ngɔtena wɔ nguro nemɔ aso; na afei ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: You thought the nations of Judah and Israel belonged to you, and that you could take over their territory. But I am their God,
translation_verse: “Na ɔnate kyɛ ɛhane kyɛ, ‘Maen nyɔ hemɔ ne aseɛ nyɔ hemɔ kɔyɛ me deɛ, na yɛkɔfa yɛkoli so,’ wɔ aberɛ bɔ né AWURADE wɔ berɛ ɔ,

english_verse: and as surely as I live, I will punish you for treating my people with anger and hatred. Then they will know that I, the Lord, am punishing you!
translation_verse: yiti, kyɛ nde ase ye, ɔnate ɛpɔen bɔ ɛpɔ bɛ, bɔ ɔmaa w’ahone huli bɛ so, ná wɔ nye borole bɛ ne, ngogyina so me ne wɔ yɛkoli. Na sɛ mebua wɔ ndɛen a, ngɔye me nwo ali wɔ bɛ nu, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: And you will finally realize that I heard you laugh at their destruction and say their land was yours to take.
translation_verse: Na afei ekonwu kyɛ me, AWURADE, mate musue dwirɛ amukoraa bɔ akekã atia Yisrael mmokaa mɔ ɔ. Ɛnwa: ‘Basɛkye bɔkɔɔ, bafa bɛ bawura yɛ sa kyɛ yɛli bɛ so.’

english_verse: You even insulted me, but I heard it all.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔfale ɛmɔ noa bɛkekane anwomasoɛ dwirɛ betiale me, ɛmɔkekane edwirɛ pee betiale me, na ndele.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate when I destroy you,
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Mmerɛ bɔ aseɛ amukoraa ye nye agye ne, wɔ de, ngɔbɔ wɔ tɔɔ.

english_verse: just as you celebrated when Israel was destroyed. Your nation of Edom will be nothing but a wasteland. Then everyone will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Yisrael awuro ama b’agyapadeɛ yɛle kurofoen ne, wɔ nye gyele, yiti me koso sɔ ala yeɛ ngɔfa ngɔyɛ wɔ ɔ. Ɛkɔkakyi kurofoen, wɔ, Sɛre bokaa, ɛne Edom amukoraa. Na afei bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.”

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, tell the mountains of Israel
translation_verse: Na wɔ, Sona awa, hyɛ ngɔm kyire Yisrael mmokaa nemɔ, ná kã kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔ, Yisrael mmokaa, ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE noa dwirɛ.

english_verse: that I, the Lord God, am saying: Your enemies sneered and said that you mountains belonged to them.
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Na ɔnate kyɛ pɔfoɛ ne hane ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ kyɛ, ‘Ehee! Tete asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ baayɛ yɛ deɛ’ ne ati,

english_verse: So all you mountains and hills, streams and valleys, listen to what I will do. Your towns may now lie in ruins, and nations may laugh and insult you.
translation_verse: yiti, ɛmɔ, Yisrael mmokaa, ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ: Edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ ɔkã kyire mmokaa ne pambaa mɔ, asue mɔ ne bɔnza mɔ, kurofoen mɔ ne nguro bɔ batu bafi so, bɔ maen maen bɔ bapɛ bɛ nwo bayia ne bafẽ bafa, ná basa bayɛ bɛ noa nu ngorohoɛ dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: But in my fierce anger, I will turn against those nations, and especially the Edomites, because they laughed at you the loudest and took over your pasturelands.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Nahorɛ nu, nungunɛ piri paa nu yeɛ mefa medwudwo metia maen maen ngaa nemɔ ɔ, ɔne Edom amukoraa; ofikyɛ bele anigye amukoraa ne animtia piri paa bɛfale m’aseɛ bɛyɛle bɛ deɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ bɛkɔfẽ so nningyein bɛkɔfa ɔ.

english_verse: so I will now insult and disgrace them. That is my solemn promise.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Meta ndaen kyɛ maen maen mɔ bɔ bapɛ ɛmɔ nwo bayia ne, bɛ bɔbɔ b’animguaseɛ kɔto bɛ.

english_verse: Trees will grow on you mountains of Israel and produce fruit for my people, because they will soon come home.
translation_verse: “Nakoso ɛmɔ, Yisrael mmokaa, ɛmɔkɔfefɛ ɛmɔ mmaen, na ɛmɔkosu ɛmɔ mmakaammaa bɛkɔma me maen Yisrael, ofikyɛ ɔngɔhyɛ né basa bawa.

english_verse: I will take care of you by plowing your soil and planting crops on your fertile slopes.
translation_verse: Tie, ngyi ɛmɔ asi, ngɔkakyi me nye ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ, bɛkɔsõ ɛmɔ so boo, ná balua ɛmɔ so nningyein.

english_verse: The people of Israel will return and rebuild your ruined towns and live in them.
translation_verse: Ngɔma mmenia kɔta pee wɔ ɛmɔ so, Yisrael awuro ama mukoraa, bɛ mukoraa, ɛmɔkɔtenatena nguro nemɔ aso, na ɛmɔkosa bɛkɔkyekye kurofoen nemɔ.

english_verse: Children will be born, and animals will give birth to their young. You will no longer be deserted as you are now, but you will be covered with people and treated better than ever. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ngɔma mmenia ne ngaka bɛkɔta pee wɔ ɛmɔ so; bɛkɔwowo bɛkɔsone pee. Ngɔmaa mmenia kɔtenatena ɛmɔ so kyɛ daa ne ala, na ngɔlo ɛmɔ ngɔtra bɔ nyɛle ɛmɔ daa ne, na afei ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: I will bring my people Israel home, and they will live on you mountains, because you belong to them, and your fertile slopes will never again let them starve.
translation_verse: Amba, ngɔma mmenia bɔ bɛte me maen Yisrael, bɛkɔnatenate ɛmɔ so; bɛkɔfa wɔ bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ, ɛkɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ, na ɛngɔma bengoli abawuo ko.

english_verse: It's true that you have been accused of not producing enough food and of letting your people starve.
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ɔnate kyɛ bɛkã bekyire wɔ kyɛ, ‘Ɛkye mmenia di, na ɛma wɔ maen di abawuo’ ne ati,

english_verse: But I, the Lord, promise that you won't hear other nations laugh and sneer at you ever again. From now on, you will always produce plenty of food for your people. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Lord Will Be Honored
translation_verse: Mengɔma ɛngɔte maen maen mɔ bɛ ngorohoɛ ne ko, wɔ nyunu ngogua ase wɔ maen maen mɔ bɛ nyunu ko, yeɛ ɛngɔma wɔ maen ngɔbɔ ko, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own country, they made the land unclean by the way they behaved, just as a woman's monthly period makes her unclean.
translation_verse: “Sona awa, mmerɛ bɔ né Yisrael awuro ama bɛte b’aseɛ so ne, bɛfale bɛ suban ne bɛ yɔleɛ beguale aseɛ ne anwo fiɛ. Na me nye so de, bɛ bra ne yɛle kyɛ brasua bɔ wabu ye sa ɔ ye nwo bɔ ɔnde ɔ.

english_verse: They committed murders and worshiped idols, which made the land even worse. So in my anger, I punished my people
translation_verse: Na mogya bɔ bɛhã beguale aseɛ ne aso, ɔne mmosoen bɔ bafa bagua ye nwo fiɛ ne ati, m’ahone huli bɛ so paa.

english_verse: Wherever they went, my name was disgraced, because foreigners insulted my people by saying I had forced them out of their own land.
translation_verse: Nakoso beedwuli maen maen nemɔ nu nen, nekaa biala bɔ bɛhɔle nen, beguale me dumaa krongron ne anwo fiɛ, ofikyɛ mmenia hane dwirɛ fale bɛ nwo kyɛ, ‘Ɛhemɔ yeɛ bɛte AWURADE maen ne ɔ, nakoso batu bafi ye aseɛ ne aso bahɔ.’

english_verse: so tell the Israelites that I am saying: You have disgraced my holy name among the nations where you now live. So you don't deserve what I'm going to do for you. I will lead you home to bring honor to my name
translation_verse: “Yiti se Yisrael awuro ama kyɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: O Yisrael awuro ama, nna ɛmɔ ti yeɛ mebaawoso me nwo ɔ, na mmom me dumaa krongron ne ati ɔ, dumaa bɔ ɛmɔagua ye nwo fiɛ wɔ maen maen bɔ ɛmɔhɔle so nemɔ anu ne.

english_verse: I will gather you from the foreign nations and bring you home.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngɔfa ɛmɔ ngofi maen maen mɔ nu, ngɔboaboa ɛmɔ noa ngofi aseɛ amukoraa so, ná masa mafa ɛmɔ mawa ɛmɔ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ so.

english_verse: I will sprinkle you with clean water, and you will be clean and acceptable to me. I will wash away everything that makes you unclean, and I will remove your disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa nzue gyengɔgyengɔ ngɔpete ɛmɔ nwo, na ɛmɔ nwo kɔte kofi ɛmɔ nwo bɔ ɔnde ne amukoraa nwo, na ngɔte ɛmɔ nwo ngofi ɛmɔ mmosoen amukoraa nwo.

english_verse: I will take away your stubborn heart and give you a new heart and a desire to be faithful. You will have only pure thoughts,
translation_verse: Ngɔma ɛmɔ ahone foforɛ, ngɔfa sunzum foforɛ ngowura ɛmɔ nu; ngɔye nyɔboɛ ahone bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ nu ne, na ngɔma ɛmɔ anwoɔnaen ahone.

english_verse: because I will put my Spirit in you and make you eager to obey my laws and teachings.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa me sunzum ngowura ɛmɔ nu, ngɔmaa ɛmɔkoli m’ahyɛdeɛ so, na ɛmɔkɔnea kyɛ ɛmɔkoli me nhyehyɛleɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: You will once again live in the land I gave your ancestors; you will be my people, and I will be your God.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkɔtena aseɛ bɔ mva mane ɛmɔ nana mɔ ne aso; ɛmɔkɔyɛ me maen, ná me wora mayɛ ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: I will protect you from anything that makes you unclean. Your fields will overflow with grain, and no one will starve.
translation_verse: Ngɔpepɛ ngole ɛmɔ ngofi ɛmɔ nwo bɔ ɔnde ne amukoraa nu; ngɔfrɛ aleɛ ngɔwa maa okobu, na mengɔma ɛhɔen biala ngɔwa ɛmɔ so.

english_verse: Your trees will be filled with fruit, and crops will grow in your fields, so that you will never again feel ashamed for not having enough food.
translation_verse: Ngɔma mmakaammaa ne fieso aleɛ kobu, amaa ɔnate so ɛhɔen angua ɛmɔ nyunu ase ko wɔ maen maen nemɔ anu.

english_verse: People of Israel, I'm not doing these things for your sake. You sinned against me, and you must suffer shame and disgrace for what you have done. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Na memaa ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ, nna ɛmɔ ti yeɛ mebaayɔ sɔ ɔ, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne. O Yisrael awuro ama, ɛmɔ bra ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔma ɔyɛ ɛmɔ nya, ná ɔyɛ ɛmɔ fɛre.

english_verse: After I have made you clean, I will let you rebuild your ruined towns and let you live in them.
translation_verse: “AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Kyẽa bɔ ngɔte ɛmɔ nwo ngofi ɛmɔ amumuyɛɛ amukoraa nwo ne, ngɔmaa ɛmɔkɔtenatena nguro nemɔ aso, na ɛmɔkosa bɛkɔkyekye kurofoen nemɔ.

english_verse: Your land will be plowed again, and nobody will be able to see that it was once barren.
translation_verse: Aseɛ bɔ né ɔla berɛ mbaen ne, ɛmɔkɔyɔ so boo. Daa ne de, ɔlale berɛ mbaen bɔ né ebiala bɔ ɔpɛ nu ɔ ye nye tua ɔ.

english_verse: Instead, they will say that it looks as beautiful as the garden of Eden. They won't see towns lying in ruins, but they will see your strong cities filled with people.
translation_verse: Na bekose kyɛ, ‘Aseɛ he bɔ né ɔla berɛ mbaen ye, ye yeɛ wakakyi kyɛ Eden turo e! Yeɛ nguro bɔ né babɔ bayɛ kurofoen ne, yeɛ afei mmenia tete so, bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue e!’

english_verse: Then the nearby nations that survive will know that I am the one who rebuilt the ruined places and replanted the barren fields. I, the Lord, make this promise.
translation_verse: Na afei maen maen mɔ bɔ baha bɔ bapɛ ɛmɔ nwo bayia ne, bekonwu kyɛ me, AWURADE, me yeɛ makyekye nguro bɔ babɔ nemɔ ɔ, kyɛ me yeɛ malua mmakaa wɔ aseɛ bɔ né ɔla berɛ mbaen ne aso ɔ. Me, AWURADE, me yeɛ mahã ɔ, na ngɔyɔ.

english_verse: I will once again answer your prayers, and I will let your nation grow until you are like a large flock of sheep.
translation_verse: “AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Asa koso, ngɔma Yisrael awuro ama bɛkɔsrɛ me maa ngɔyɔ ɛhe ngɔma bɛ: Ngɔmaa bɛkɔyɛ mmenia bɔ bata pee kyɛ mmoaen kure ɔ.

english_verse: The towns that now lie in ruins will be filled with people, just as Jerusalem was once filled with sheep to be offered as sacrifices during a festival. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ mmoaen kure krongron bɛ somaa te, kyɛbɔ Yerusalem mmoaen kure bɛ somaa te wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bedi aluolue wɔ nu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ mmenia kure kure koyi kurofoen nemɔ aso to ɔ. Na afei bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.”

english_verse: Some time later, I felt the Lord's power take control of me, and his Spirit carried me to a valley full of bones.
translation_verse: AWURADE tumi wale me so, ɔnate AWURADE Sunzum so ɔfale me fitele, na ɔfale me oogyinane bɔnza bie bɔ mmowue ayi nu to ɔ ye afia.

english_verse: The Lord showed me all around, and everywhere I looked I saw bones that were dried out.
translation_verse: Ɔfale me hyinini pɛle mmowue nemɔ anwo bra yiale. Eh! Né bɛsone pee paa yeɛ begua bɔnza ne anu ɔ, na né bɛ nwo ayɛ kokwakokwa paa.

english_verse: He said, “Ezekiel, son of man, can these bones come back to life?” I replied, “Lord God, only you can answer that.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ obisale me kyɛ, “Sona awa, aso mmowue hemɔ bekonya ngoa anaa?” Na mmuale kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE Nyameɛ, hmmm, wɔ yeɛ ɛse ɔ.”

english_verse: He then told me to say: Dry bones, listen to what the Lord is saying to you,
translation_verse: Yeɛ osa sele me kyɛ, “Hyɛ ngɔm gua mmowue hemɔ aso, ná se bɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔ, mmowue bɔ ɛmɔ nwo ayɛ kokwakokwa ɔ, ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE noa dwirɛ.

english_verse: “I, the Lord God, will put breath in you, and once again you will live.
translation_verse: Bɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ ɔkã kyire sɔ mmowue hemɔ ɛhe: Ɛ́mɔtie, ngɔma nwomeɛ koowura ɛmɔ nu, na ɛmɔkonya ngoa.

english_verse: I will wrap you with muscles and skin and breathe life into you. Then you will know that I am the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ngɔfa ndii ngɔsosɔ ɛmɔ nu, ngɔmaa anwoɔnaen kɔwa ɛmɔ nwo, ngɔfa wereɛ ngopuro ɛmɔ nwo, ngɔfa nwomeɛ ngowura ɛmɔ nu maa ɛmɔkonya ngoa, na ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.’ ”

english_verse: I did what the Lord said, but before I finished speaking, I heard a rattling noise. The bones were coming together!
translation_verse: Yiti kyɛbɔ ɔfale ahyɛdeɛ mane me ne, nhyɛle ngɔm. Na me noa wɔ so bɔ mehyɛ ngɔm ne, yieee, ndele dede kukurokukuro bie, mmowue nemɔ toatoale so, na mmowue nemɔ hã siesiele ye nyunu.

english_verse: I saw muscles and skin cover the bones, but they had no life in them.
translation_verse: Nneane, na yieee, nwuni kyɛ ndii awa bɛ nwo, anwoɔnaen awa bɛ nwo, yeɛ wereɛ apuro bɛ nwo; nakoso né nwomeɛ nne bɛ nu.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, now say to the wind, “The Lord God commands you to blow from every direction and to breathe life into these dead bodies, so they can live again.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ osele me kyɛ, “Hyɛ ngɔm frɛ nwomeɛ ne, Sona awa, hyɛ ngɔm, ná se nwomeɛ ne kyɛ, ‘AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Nwomeɛ ee, fi mvrama nna nemɔ anu bra oo, ná baale nwomeɛ gua mmenia hemɔ bɔ bahũhũ bɛ ne aso ma benya ngoa oo!”

english_verse: As soon as I said this, the wind blew among the bodies, and they came back to life! They all stood up, and there were enough to make a large army.
translation_verse: Yiti nhyɛle ngɔm kyɛbɔ ɔfale ahyɛdeɛ mane me ne ala. Nwomeɛ ne oowurale bɛ nu, benyane ngoa, bedwɔsole begyinagyinane bɛ gya so, na né bɛte ɛlɔen piri paa.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, the people of Israel are like dead bones. They complain that they are dried up and that they have no hope for the future.
translation_verse: Yeɛ osele me kyɛ, “Sona awa, mmowue hemɔ ole Yisrael awuro ama amukoraa. Tie, bɛnwa: ‘Yɛ mmowue nwo ayɛ kokwakokwa, yɛ anyelasoɛ atu amini, yeɛ waye ye sa wafi yɛ bo koraa.’

english_verse: So tell them, “I, the Lord God, promise to open your graves and set you free. I will bring you back to Israel,
translation_verse: Yiti hyɛ ngɔm ná se bɛ kyɛ, ‘AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: O me maen, ɛ́mɔtie, mebaabukyebukye ɛmɔ asieleɛ nemɔ aso, ngɔye ɛmɔ ngofi ɛmɔ asieleɛ nemɔ anu, na ngɔfa ɛmɔ ngɔhɔ Yisrael aseɛ so.

english_verse: and when that happens, you will realize that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Ao, me maen, mmerɛ bɔ ngobukyebukye ɛmɔ asieleɛ nemɔ aso, ná ngɔyeye ɛmɔ ngofi ɛmɔ asieleɛ nemɔ anu nen, ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: My Spirit will give you breath, and you will live again. I will bring you home, and you will know that I have kept my promise. I, the Lord, have spoken.” Judah and Israel Together Again
translation_verse: Ngɔfa me Sunzum ngowura ɛmɔ nu, na ɛmɔkonya ngoa, na ngɔmaa ɛmɔkɔɔtena ɛmɔ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ so; na afei ɛmɔkonwu ye kyɛ me, AWURADE, me yeɛ mahã ɔ, na mayɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.’ ”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, get a stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Judah.” Then get another stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Israel.”
translation_verse: “Sona awa, fa bakaa ná kyerɛ so kyɛ, ‘Ogyi berɛ ma Yuda, ɔne Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bɛboka ye so ne.’ Afei fa bakaa bieku, ná kyerɛ so kyɛ, ‘Ogyi berɛ ma Yosef bɔ ɔte Efraim bakaa ne, ɔne Yisraelfoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛboka ye so ne.’

english_verse: Hold these two sticks end to end, so they look like one stick.
translation_verse: Afei fa mmakaa nyɔ ne bɔ ye nwo ma ɔyɛ ko wɔ wɔ sa nu.

english_verse: tell them that I, the Lord, will join together the stick of Israel and the stick of Judah. I will hold them in my hand, and they will become one.
translation_verse: bua bɛ kyɛ, ‘AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ɛ́mɔtie, mebaafa Yosef bakaa ne bɔ otira Efraim sa nu ne, yeɛ afei Yisrael mmusua kure bɔ bɛboka ye so ne. Ngɔfa bɛ ngɔboka ye so, mekyire Yuda bakaa ne, maa bɛkɔyɛ bakaa ko, na bɛkɔyɛ ko wɔ me sa nu.’

english_verse: Hold these two sticks where they can be seen by everyone
translation_verse: Afei fa mmakaa bɔ ahyerɛhyerɛ so ne tira bɔ bɛ nye tua ɔ,

english_verse: and then say: I, the Lord God, will gather the people of Israel and bring them home from the foreign nations where they now live.
translation_verse: ná se bɛ kyɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ɛ́mɔtie, ngɔɔfa Yisraelfoɛ ngofi maen maen mɔ bɔ bahɔ so ne aso, ngɔboa bɛ noa ngofi nekaa biala, na ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa bɛ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ so.

english_verse: I will make them into one nation and let them once again live in the land of Israel. Only one king will rule them, and they will never again be divided into two nations.
translation_verse: Ngɔyɛ bɛ maen ko wɔ aseɛ ne aso, wɔ Yisrael mmokaa nemɔ aso. Ɛhene ko yeɛ okoli bɛ mukoraa bɛ so ɔ, bɛngɔyɛ maen nyɔ ko, na bɛ nu ngɔhyɛ ngɔyɛ ahennie nyɔ ko.

english_verse: They will no longer worship idols and do things that make them unacceptable to me. I will wash away their sin and make them clean, and I will protect them from everything that makes them unclean. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
translation_verse: Bɛngɔfa bɛ mmosoen ne b’akyiwadeɛ nningyein anaa bɛ mmeraatolɛ biala bengogua bɛ nwo fiɛ ko. Na mmom ngɔpepɛ ngole bɛ ngofi bɛ makyebu amukoraa bɔ bali bafa bayɛ bɔne ne anwo; ngɔte bɛ nwo, na bɛkɔyɛ me maen, ná me wora mayɛ bɛ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Their king will always come from the family of my servant King David and will care for them like a shepherd. The people of Israel will faithfully obey my laws. They and their descendants will live in the land I gave my servant Jacob, just as their ancestors did.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔtena aseɛ bɔ mva mane me somvoɛ Yakob, bɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ tenane so ne aso; na bɛ ne bɛ mma mɔ ne bɛ nnomaa mɔ bɛkɔtena berɛ daa, na me somvoɛ Dawide koli bɛ so panyi daa.

english_verse: I solemnly promise to bless the people of Israel with unending peace. I will protect them and let them become a powerful nation. My temple will stand in Israel for all time,
translation_verse: Asa koso, me ne bɛ yɛkɔyɛ asomdwee apam, ɔkɔyɛ me ne bɛ daa apam; ngɔmaa bekotindim, ngɔmaa bɛkɔta pee, na ngɔfa me nekaa krongron ne ngosie bɛ nu afebɔɔ.

english_verse: and I will live among my people and be their God.
translation_verse: Bɛ nu yeɛ m’atenaleɛ ne koso kogyina ɔ. Amba, ngɔyɛ bɛ Nyameɛ, ná bɛ wora bayɛ me maen.

english_verse: Every nation on earth will know that my temple is in Israel and that I have chosen the Israelites to be my people.
translation_verse: Na afei maen maen mɔ bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE bɔ mete Yisrael nwo ɔ, mmerɛ bɔ me nekaa krongron ne ogyi bɛ nu afebɔɔ ne.”

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog, that wicked ruler of the kingdoms of Meshech and Tubal in the land of Magog. Tell him:
translation_verse: “Sona awa, fa wɔ nye kyire Gɔgo, bɔ ɔwɔ Magɔgo aseɛ so ne, Meseke ne Tubal bɛ hene ne, ná hyɛ ngɔm tia ye.

english_verse: and I will make you powerless! I will put a hook in your jaw and drag away both you and your large army. You command cavalry troops that wear heavy armor and carry shields and swords.
translation_verse: Ngɔmaa ɛkɔfa wɔ nye kohyire neka foforɛ, ngɔfa koaa ngɔsosɔ w’awogyee, na ngɔhwe wɔ ne wɔ lɔen amukoraa ngofite, ɛne wɔ mbɔngɔ ne pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ, bɔ bɛ mukoraa bewurawura koɛ ndaadeɛ ahoroɔ, ɛlɔen piri paa bɔ bɛ mukoraa bewurawura buralɛ ataadeɛ, bɔ betiratira akokyɛm ne pealɛɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Your army includes soldiers from Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya,
translation_verse: Pɛsia, Kuse, ne Libia boka bɛ so, bɔ bɛ mukoraa bele akokyɛm ne buralɛ kyerɛ ɔ;

english_verse: as well as from Gomer and Beth-Togarmah in the north. Your army is enormous!
translation_verse: Gomɛre ne ye ɛlɔen amukoraa, Bete Togama bɔ ɔwɔ sorɔ dɔ paa ne ɔne ye lɔen amukoraa; maen pee paa yeɛ bɛboka wɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: because in a few years, I will command you to invade Israel, a country that was ruined by war. It was deserted for a long time, but its people have returned from the foreign nations where they once lived. The Israelites now live in peace in the mountains of their own land.
translation_verse: Na ngyẽa pee asi ne, wɔ sa kɔhã tumi. Na afoɛ bɔ oli nziɛ nemɔ anu, ɛkɔɔfa koɛ kɔtoa maen bɔ wanya ye anwotɔ wafi ngrandɛ noa ne, maen bɔ maboaboa so ama noa wɔ Yisrael mmokaa so mafi maen maen pee so ne, mmokaa bɔ né bɛlela berɛ mbaen ne. Maen maen mɔ nu yeɛ mvale so ama mvili ɔ, na bɛ mukoraa bɛ so anu atɔ bɛ wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: But you and your army will attack them like a fierce thunderstorm and surround them like a cloud.
translation_verse: Ɛkɔhɔ bɛ so kyɛ mvrama piri, ɛkɔyɛ kyɛ munungum kɔkata aseɛ ne aso, ɛne wɔ lɔen amukoraa ne maen maen pee bɔ bɛboka wɔ so ne.

english_verse: When that day comes, I know that you will have an evil plan
translation_verse: “AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Sɔ kyẽa ne, adwene biemɔ kɔwa wɔ ti anu, ɛkɔbɔ porɛ,

english_verse: to take advantage of Israel, that weak and peaceful country where people live safely inside towns that have no walls or gates or locks.
translation_verse: na ekose kyɛ, ‘Ngootua maen bɔ fasue nne ye nguro mɔ nwo ne, ngɔɔfa koɛ ngɔtoa mmenia bɔ bɛte berɛ konn asomdwee nu ne, bɔ bɛ mukoraa bɛtete nguro bɔ fasue nne bɛ nwo ɔ nu, bɔ belle pambim anaa mmuralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram pambim si ɔ;

english_verse: You will rob the people in towns that were once a pile of rubble. These people lived as prisoners in foreign nations, but they have returned to Israel, the most important place in the world, and they own livestock and property.
translation_verse: kyɛ ɛkwaafa koɛ nu nzesadeɛ ná ɛfẽ nningyein fa, kyɛ ɛkwaafa koɛ kɔtoa kurofoen mɔ bɔ afei de mmenia tete so ne, yeɛ mmenia bɔ baaboaboa bɛ noa bafi maen maen mɔ so ne, bɔ banya nyɛmmoa ne nningyein, mmenia bɔ bɛte aseɛ afia ne.

english_verse: The people of Sheba and Dedan, along with merchants from villages in southern Spain, will be your allies. They will want some of the silver and gold, as well as the livestock and property that your army takes from Israel.
translation_verse: Na Hyeba ne Dedan, yeɛ Tasise dwadifoɛ ne ye nguraa nu ama mukoraa bekobisa wɔ kyɛ, ‘Awa kyɛ ɛbaafa koɛ nu nzesadeɛ hɔ ɔ? Aboaboa wɔ lɔen noa kyɛ ɛbaafẽ nningyein kɔ anaa, kyɛ ɛbaasesa ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ, nyɛmmoa ne nningyein, ná ɛfa koɛ nu nzesadeɛ pee ɛkɔ anaa?’

english_verse: I, the Lord God, know that when you see my people Israel living in peace,
translation_verse: “Yiti, Sona awa, hyɛ ngɔm ná se Gɔgo kyɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Aso nna kyẽa bɔ me maen Yisrael ɔte asomdwee nu ne yeɛ ekonwu ye ɔ?

english_verse: You will attack my people like a storm-cloud that covers their land. I will let you invade my country Israel, so that every nation on earth will know that I, the Lord, am holy. Judgment on Gog
translation_verse: na ɛkɔɔfa koɛ kɔtoa me maen Yisrael kyɛ munungum bɔ ɔkɔta aseɛ ne aso ɔ. Na mmerɛ bɔ oli nziɛ ne, ngɔfa wɔ ngɔwa maa ɛkɔɔfa koɛ kɔtoa me maen ne, bɔ ɔnate so maen maen bekonwu me ɔ, na ɛhe kosi wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ngɔfa wɔ, Gɔgo, wɔ so ngɔla me krongronyɛlɛ ali bɔ bɛ nye tua ɔ.
