english_verse: The Lord said to Gog: Long ago, I ordered my prophets to warn the people of Israel that someday I would send an enemy to attack them. You, Gog, are that enemy, and that day is coming.
translation_verse: “AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Aso wɔ ole bɔ mvale me somvoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛte Yisrael ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ so ngane ye nwo dwirɛ daa tete ne, bɔ bɛhyɛle ngɔm sɔ mmerɛ ne afoɛ pee, kyɛ ngɔfa wɔ ngɔwa maa ɛkɔɔfa koɛ kɔtoa bɛ ne anaa?

english_verse: and in my anger I will send a terrible earthquake to shake Israel.
translation_verse: Na mekã ye wɔ me nungunɛhwenɛ ne m’ahonehulɛ wuruwuru ne anu kyɛ, sɔ kyẽa ne, aseɛ kɔwoso serɛserɛ wɔ Yisrael aseɛ so,

english_verse: Every living thing on earth will tremble in fear of me—every fish and bird, every wild animal and reptile, and every human. Mountains will crumble, cliffs will fall, and cities will collapse.
translation_verse: maa ɔnate so ɛpo nu naen, ewienu nnomaa, eburo ngaka, kaka biala bɔ ɔtwe ye nwo ase wɔ aseɛ so, yeɛ aseɛ so mmenia mukoraa bɛ nwo kɔwoso bɛ wɔ me nyunu. Mmokaa mukoraa bekodwiri bekogua, nyɔbotaen ndendenn mɔ kobubu kogua, yeɛ fasue biala kobu kogua ase.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the mountains of Israel turn against you. Your troops will be so terrified that they will attack each other.
translation_verse: Na ngɔfrɛ ngrandɛ maa ɔkɔwa ye so wɔ me mmokaa ne amukoraa so, na ebiala kɔfa ngrandɛ kɔhɔ obiɛngo so, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I will strike you with diseases and punish you with death. You and your army will be pounded with rainstorms, hailstones, and burning sulfur.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa ewue anwonyerɛ ne mogya yeɛ ngɔtea ye ɔ; na ngɔtɔ esue kandinga paa, asukɔtwea kungumaboɔ, see ne sɔfe yeɛ ngogua ye ne ye lɔen ɔne ye maen worawora bɔ bɛboka ye so ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: I will do these things to show the world that I, the Lord, am holy.
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔla me piri ne me krongronyɛlɛ ali. Na ngɔye me nwo ali ngɔma maen maen pee bekonwu me, na afei bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog and tell him: You are the ruler of Meshech and Tubal, but I, the Lord, am your enemy!
translation_verse: Na wɔ, Sona awa, hyɛ ngɔm tia Gɔgo ná kã kyɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Tie, wɔ Gɔgo bɔ edi Meseke ne Tubal so hene ɔ, meko metia wɔ!

english_verse: I will turn you around and drag you from the north until you reach the mountains of Israel.
translation_verse: Ngɔmaa ɛkɔkakyi wɔ nwo kosa kɔwa, ngɔhwe wɔ ngɔhɔ, na ngotu wɔ ngofi sorɔ dɔ paa maa ɛkɔɔfa koɛ kɔtoa Yisrael mmokaa nemɔ.

english_verse: I will knock the bow out of your left hand and the arrows out of your right hand,
translation_verse: Na afei ngobubu w’agyaen mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ wɔ sa bɛen nu ne, na ngɔma w’agyaen mmakaa bɔ bɛwɔ wɔ sa famaa nu ne kɔye kogua ase.

english_verse: and you and your army will die on those mountains. Then birds and wild animals will eat the flesh
translation_verse: Ɛkɔtɔ wɔ Yisrael mmokaa so, ɛne wɔ lɔen amukoraa ne maen maen bɔ bɛboka wɔ so ne yeɛ ɛmɔkɔtotɔ ɔ. Na ngɔfa wɔ ngɔma nnomaa ahoroɔ bɔ bɛkye ngaka bedi, ɔne ngaka aboyaa maa bekoli.

english_verse: of your dead bodies left lying in open fields. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Aseɛ pralaa so yeɛ ɛkɔtɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ me yeɛ mahã ɔ, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I will set fire to the land of Magog and to those nations along the seacoast that think they are so secure, and they will know that I am the Lord.
translation_verse: Magɔgo ne bɛ bɔ bɛtete asomdwee nu wɔ supɔ nemɔ aso ne, ngɔsoma see maa ɔkɔhɔ bɛ so, na bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE.

english_verse: My people Israel will know me, and they will no longer disgrace my holy name. Everyone on earth will know that I am the holy Lord God of Israel.
translation_verse: “Ngɔla me dumaa krongron ne ali wɔ me maen Yisrael nu, mengɔma bengogua me dumaa krongron ne nwo fiɛ ko; na maen maen nemɔ bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE, Yisrael nu Krongronniɛ ne.

english_verse: The day is coming when these things will happen, just as I have promised.
translation_verse: Tie, ɔbaasi, na okosi koso, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne. Kyẽa bɔ mahã ye nwo dwirɛ ne, ye ɛne.

english_verse: When that day comes, the people in the towns of Israel will collect the weapons of their dead enemies. They will use these shields, bows and arrows, spears, and clubs as firewood, and there will be enough to last for seven years.
translation_verse: “Na afei mmenia bɔ bɛtete Yisrael nguro nemɔ aso ne, bɛkɔɔfa akodeɛ nemɔ bekohua see; bɛkɔfa akokyɛm nemɔ, buralɛ ndaadeɛ, agyaen ne agyaen mmakaa, mmopura ne pealɛɛ nemɔ bɛkɔsɔ see, na bɛkɔfa bɛkɔsɔ see afoɛ nzoo.

english_verse: They will burn these weapons instead of gathering sticks or chopping down trees. That's how the Israelites will take revenge on those who robbed and abused them. I, the Lord, have spoken. The Burial of Gog The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na ɔnate sɔ ati, bɛngɔpena eyein wɔ eburo, yeɛ bengobubu ebie wɔ ɛhɔayeɛ nemɔ anu, ofikyɛ akodeɛ nemɔ yeɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔsɔ see ɔ. Na bɛ bɔ bɛfene bɛ nningyein ne, bɛ koso bɛkɔfẽ bɛ deɛ bie; yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛbɔle bɛ so apaa ne, bɛ koso bɛkɔbɔ bɛ so apaa bie, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: After Gog has been destroyed, I will bury him and his army in Israel, in Travelers' Valley, east of the Dead Sea. That graveyard will be so large that it will block the way of anyone who tries to walk through the valley, which will then be known as “The Valley of Gog's Army.”
translation_verse: “Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔma Gɔgo aseɛ bɔ bekosie ye so ɔ wɔ Yisrael, wɔ Akwandufoɛ Bɔnza bɔ ɔwɔ ɛpo eyia afiteleɛ ne anu, bɔnza bɔ osi akwandufoɛ atee ne. Berɛ yeɛ bekosie Gɔgo ne ye lɔen worawora ne amukoraa ɔ, na bɛkɔfrɛ berɛ Hamon Gɔgo Bɔnza.

english_verse: The Israelites will spend seven months burying dead bodies and cleaning up their land.
translation_verse: Na Yisrael awuro ama kɔfa ɛsraen nzoo yeɛ bekosie bɛ ɔ, kyɛ bɛfa bɛpete aseɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: Everyone will help with the burial, and they will be honored for this on the day the brightness of my glory is seen.
translation_verse: Aseɛ ne aso ama mukoraa kosie bɛ, na ɔkɔyɛ dumaa paa kɔma bɛ wɔ kyẽa bɔ ngɔla m’animnyam ali ne, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: After those seven months, the people will appoint a group of men to look for any dead bodies left unburied. This must be done for seven months to make sure that the land is no longer unclean.
translation_verse: Bekotu mmenia bekosie berɛ maa mmerɛ biala bekohyinihyini aseɛ ne aso bekosie efuin mɔ bɔ baha wɔ aseɛ ne aso ne, kyɛbɔ ɔnate so bɛkɔpete aseɛ ne anwo ɔ. Na ɛsraen nzoo ne, sɛ ɔso a yeɛ bekohyini bɛkɔpena efuin nemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Whenever they find a human bone, they will set up a marker next to it. Then the gravediggers will bury it in “The Valley of Gog's Army”
translation_verse: Na sɛ sɔ mmenia nemɔ bekyinikyini aseɛ ne aso, ná bɛ nu bie nwu sona bowue a, ɔkɔfa sɛngyerɛnneɛ bie kɔhyɛ berɛ nzorɛ, kɔpem kyɛ mmenia bɔ besie fuin nemɔ ne bekosie ye wɔ Hamon Gɔgo Bɔnza ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: near the town of “Gog's Army.” After that, the land will be pure again.
translation_verse: Sɔ yeɛ bɛkɔyɔ bɛkɔpete aseɛ ne anwo ɔ.

english_verse: Ezekiel, son of man, I am going to hold a feast on Israel's mountains and offer sacrifices there. So invite all the birds and wild animals to come from every direction and eat the meat of sacrifices and drink the blood. The birds and animals
translation_verse: “Na wɔ, Sona awa, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Se nnomaa ahoroɔ amukoraa ne eburo ngaka amukoraa kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔhã bɛ nwo bɛbɔ nu bɛbra, ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ noa béfi nekaa biala bɛbra m’afɔleɛ poentolɛ bɔ meto mema ɛmɔ ne abo. Ɔte Yisrael mmokaa so afɔleɛ poentolɛ kandinga, na ɛmɔkoli naen bɛkɔno mogya.

english_verse: will feast on the bodies of warriors and foreign rulers that I will sacrifice like sheep, goats, and bulls.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkoli katakyie mɔ bɛ naen, ná ɛmɔano aseɛ so ahemvo mɔ bɛ mogya, mmoaen nyii, mmoaen mmaa, mbɔngye, nandwie nyii, bɛ mukoraa bɛte Basan ngaka bɔ balɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I want the birds and animals to eat until they are full and drink until they are drunk.
translation_verse: Na m’afɔleɛ poentolɛ bɔ meto mema ɛmɔ ne abo, ɛmɔkoli ɛloe kɔpem kyɛ ɛmɔ ko koyi ɔ, yeɛ ɛmɔkɔno mogya kɔpem kyɛ ɛmɔkɔbo ɔ.

english_verse: They will come to my table and stuff themselves with the flesh of horses and warriors of every kind. I, the Lord God, have spoken. Israel Will Be Restored The Lord said:
translation_verse: Me poentolɛ ne abo, ɛmɔkoli mbɔngɔ, pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ, katakyie mɔ ne koɛhonɛfoɛ amukoraa naen kɔma ɛmɔ ko koyi,’ AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: When I punish the nations of the earth, they will see the brightness of my glory.
translation_verse: “Ngɔla m’animnyam ali wɔ maen maen mɔ nu, na maen maen nemɔ konwu me ndɛenbualɛ bɔ mabua ɔ, ɔne m’asohwenɛ bɔ mamaa wawa bɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel will know from then on that I am the Lord their God.
translation_verse: Na ofi sɔ kyẽa ne bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, Yisrael awuro ama konwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Foreign nations will realize that the Israelites were forced to leave their own land because they sinned against me. I turned my back on my people and let enemies attack and kill them.
translation_verse: Na maen maen mɔ konwu kyɛ Yisrael awuro ama b’amumuyɛɛ ti yeɛ ɔmaa bɛhyele bɛ nnure bɛhɔle ɔ: banni nahorɛ bamma me, yiti mvale me nyunu mveale bɛ, na mvale bɛ nwurale bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa, na bɛ mukoraa bɛtotɔle ngrandɛ noa.

english_verse: Their lives were wicked and corrupt, and they deserved to be punished.
translation_verse: Me ne bɛ lili ye kyɛbɔ bɛ fiɛ ne bɛ mmeraatolɛ te ɔ, na mvale me nyunu mveale bɛ.

english_verse: Now I will show mercy to the people of Israel and bring them back from the nations where they are living. They are Jacob's descendants, so I will bless them and show that I am holy.
translation_verse: “Yiti AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ngosa ngɔfa Yakob ngofi nnurehyelɛ nu ngɔwa, na ngonwu Yisrael awuro ama mukoraa anwumvoin, na ngɔhwe me dumaa krongron ne nwo nungunɛ.

english_verse: They will live safely in their own land, but will be ashamed when they remember their evil ways and how they disgraced me.
translation_verse: Bɛ wora kofi b’animguaseɛ ne nahorɛ amukoraa bɔ banni bamma me ɔ, mmerɛ bɔ bɛte b’aseɛ so asomdwee nu bɔ ebiala onnwunanwuna bɛ ɔ;

english_verse: Foreign nations will watch as I take the Israelites from enemy lands and bring them back home, and those nations will see that I am holy.
translation_verse: mmerɛ bɔ maafa bɛ mafi maen maen mɔ nu masa mawa, bɔ maaboaboa bɛ noa mafi bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ aseɛ mɔ so, ná mafa bɛ so mala me krongronyɛlɛ ali wɔ maen maen pee bɛ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: My people will realize that I, the Lord their God, sent them away as prisoners and now will bring them back to their own land.
translation_verse: Na afei bekonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ, bɔ mmaa bɛhyele bɛ nnure bɛhɔle maen maen so, ná afei maaboaboa bɛ noa mafa bɛ mawa bɛ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ so, bɔ manyakyi bɛ nu biala wɔ dɔ ko ɔ.

english_verse: Never again will I turn my back on the people of Israel, and my Spirit will live in them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: Mengɔfa me nyunu mengɔfea Yisrael awuro ama ko, ofikyɛ mahwie me Sunzum magua bɛ so, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: Twenty-five years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, and
translation_verse: Nyameɛ nyekyire ne anu, ɔfale me wale Yisrael aseɛ so, na ɔfale me oogyinane bokaa tendenn paa bie aso, bɔ né so te kyɛ kuro bɔ bakyekye ye wɔ ngwaen dɔ ɔ.

english_verse: He measured the entrance room at the far end of the passageway, and it was ten meters wide.
translation_verse: Afei osusuli ngurolo ne, né ɔte agyirɛ aburasia, na anoa piri ne asi berɛ yeɛ ɔte asa so ɔ.

english_verse: In my vision the Lord took me closer, and I saw a man who was sparkling like polished bronze. He was standing near one of the gates and was holding a tape measure in one hand and a measuring stick in the other.
translation_verse: Na ɔfale me wale berɛ nen, yieee, né biaa bie wɔ berɛ bɔ ye sue te kyɛ kɔɔbere ɔ. Né ogyi anoa piri ne anu berɛ, né otira nyamabire ne elemmire bɔ bɛfa besusu nikye ɔ.

english_verse: The man said, “Ezekiel, son of man, pay close attention to everything I'm going to show you—that's why you've been brought here. Listen carefully, because you must tell the people of Israel what you see.” The East Gate
translation_verse: Na biaa ne sele me kyɛ, “Sona awa, fa wɔ nye nea, ná fa wɔ so tie, ná ma w’adwene bra bɔ mebaala ye ali mekyire wɔ ne amukoraa so; ofikyɛ mvale wɔ mmale wa, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ngɔye ngohyire wɔ ɔ. Bɔ enwu ye amukoraa, bɔ ye dawure kyire Yisrael awuro ama.”

english_verse: at the end of the passageway. The man measured this room: It was four meters from the doorway to the opposite wall, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was one meter.
translation_verse: Afei osusuli pato nu berɛ atee bɔ ɔfa anoa piri ne anu nen, né ɔte agyirɛ mmɔtwɛ, ye mbuna nemɔ te agyirɛ nyɔ; pato nu berɛ anoa ne, né ye nye kyire awuro ne anu dɔ.

english_verse: The three guardrooms on each side of the passageway were the same size, and the walls that separated them were the same thickness.
translation_verse: Eyia afiteleɛ anoa piri ne, né pumbu nza wɔ ye bue biala. Né esusu bɛ mmɛsa a, bɛ mukoraa bɛte pɛ; na mbuna bɔ bɛwɔ ye bue biala ne, esusu a, bɛte pɛ.

english_verse: Next, the man measured the width of the passageway, and it was six and a half meters, but the two doors of the gate were only five meters wide.
translation_verse: Afei atee bɔ ɔkɔ anoa piri ne anu ne, osusuli ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu nen, né ɔte agyirɛ buru; yeɛ ye tendenn nu koso te agyirɛ buru ne nza.

english_verse: The man measured the distance from the back wall of one of these rooms to the same spot in the room directly across the passageway, and it was twelve and a half meters.
translation_verse: Afei osusuli anoa piri ne fili pumbu ko ye anwuro oodwuli pumbu ko koso ye anwuro, na ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ te agyirɛ aburanyɔ ne nnu, ofi anoa ko bɔ ɔkwaadwu anoa ko ne.

english_verse: Finally, he measured the total length of the passageway, from the outer wall to the entrance room, and it was
translation_verse: Efi anoanu berɛ anoa piri n’anyunu berɛ bɔ ɛkwaadwu ngurolo ne bɔ ɔwɔ anoa piri ne asi ne, ɔte agyirɛ aburannu.

english_verse: The three walls in the guardrooms had small windows in them, just like the ones in the entrance room. The walls along the passageway were decorated with carvings of palm trees. The Outer Courtyard
translation_verse: Né mboma bɔtɔfee mɔ lela pumbu nemɔ ne bɛ mbuna nemɔ anwo, ɔne bɛ mbuna mɔ bɔ bɛ nye kyire anoa piri bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia ne, yeɛ bɛ ngurolo nemɔ koso sɔ ala. Né mboma mɔ bapɛ ye kunu dɔ bayia, na né bali ayee bakaa adwii baguagua mbuna nemɔ anwo.

english_verse: The man then led me through the passageway and into the outer courtyard of the temple, where I saw
translation_verse: Afei ɔfale me hɔle aluo berɛ pato nu berɛ, na yieee, né pumbu mɔ ne atee wɔ berɛ bɔ bapɛ aluo berɛ nwo bayia ɔ; né pumbu aburasa yeɛ bɛwɔ atee ne anoa ɔ.

english_verse: In fact, everything along the passageway was also the same size, including the guardrooms, the walls separating them, the entrance room at the far end, and the windows. This gate, like the others, was
translation_verse: Né abrannaa apɛ ye nwo ayia, bɔ ye tendenn nu te agyirɛ aburanyɔ ne nnu, yeɛ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu koso te agyirɛ nnu.

english_verse: I saw the gates that led to the inner courtyard of the temple and noticed that they were higher than those leading to the outer courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gates, and it was
translation_verse: Afei osusuli abrannaa ne tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu, ofi aseɛnwo dɔ anoa piri n’anyunu bɔ ɔkwaadwu ye kunu dɔ aluo berɛ ne, na né ɔte agyirɛ ɛyaa ko wɔ ye eyia afiteleɛ so ne ye sorɔ.

english_verse: This gate also had three guardrooms on each side of a passageway. The measurements of these rooms, the walls between them, and the entrance room at the far end of the passageway were exactly the same as those of the east gate. The north gate was also
translation_verse: Na ye pumbu nemɔ, nza wɔ ye bue ko, yeɛ nza koso wɔ ye bue ko; na ye mbuna nemɔ ne abrannaa ne, esusu a bɛ ne anoa piri bɔ oli moa ne bɛte pɛ. Ye tendenn nu te agyirɛ aburannu, yeɛ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ aburanyɔ ne nnu.

english_verse: and the windows, the entrance room, and the carvings of palm trees were just like those in the east gate. The entrance room also faced the courtyard of the temple and had seven steps leading up to it.
translation_verse: Ye mboma nemɔ, ye abrannaa ne, ye ayee mmakaa adwii ne, esusu a ɔte kyɛ anoa piri bɔ ye nye nea eyia afiteleɛ so ne. Atweleɛ ndiasoɛ nzoo yeɛ ɛfa fo kɔ so ɔ, na ye abrannaa ne wɔ ye nyunu berɛ.

english_verse: Directly across the outer courtyard was a gate that led to the inner courtyard, just as there was for the east gate. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was
translation_verse: Né anoa piri bie wɔ ye kunu dɔ aluo berɛ bɔ ye nye kyire sorɔ dɔ anoa piri ne, kyɛbɔ ye nye kyire eyia afiteleɛ ne ɔ. Na osusuli, na efi anoa piri ko bɔ ɛkwaadwu ko ne, ɔte agyirɛ ɛyaa ko.

english_verse: The man then took me to the south gate. He measured the walls and the entrance room of this gate, and the measurements were exactly the same as those of the other two gates.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɔfale me hɔle ngwaen dɔ, na nwuni anoa piri bie bɔ ye nye nea ngwaen dɔ ɔ. Osusuli ye mbuna ne abrannaa ne, na né bɛte kyɛbɔ esusu ko nemɔ a bɛte ne ala.

english_verse: Seven steps led up to the gate; the entrance room was at the far end of the passageway and faced the courtyard of the temple. Carvings of palm trees decorated the walls along the passageway.
translation_verse: Né ole atweleɛ ndiasoɛ nzoo bɔ bɛfa bɛfo so ɔ; né abrannaa nemɔ wɔ bɛ nyunu berɛ; na né ayee mmakaa adwii wɔ ye mbuna nemɔ anwo, wɔ ye bue faen ne ye bue faen.

english_verse: And directly across the outer courtyard was a gate on the south side of the inner courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was also
translation_verse: Né anoa piri bie wɔ ye kunu dɔ aluo berɛ wɔ ye ngwaen dɔ; na osusuli fili anoa piri oodwuli anoa piri wɔ ngwaen dɔ, na né ɔte agyirɛ ɛyaa ko.

english_verse: We then went into the inner courtyard, through the gate on the south side of the temple. The man measured the gate, and it was the same size as the gates in the outer wall.
translation_verse: Afei ɔfale me fale ngwaen dɔ anoa piri ne anu hɔle ye kunu dɔ aluo berɛ, na osusuli ngwaen dɔ anoa piri nen; né ɔte kyɛbɔ esusu ko nemɔ a bɛte ne ala.

english_verse: The entrance room of this gate faced the outer courtyard, and carvings of palm trees decorated the walls of the passageway. Eight steps led up to this gate.
translation_verse: Ye abrannaa ne, né ye nye kyire aluo berɛ pato nu berɛ. Né ayee mmakaa adwii wɔ ye mbuna nemɔ anwo, na ye atweleɛ ndiasoɛ ne te mmɔtwɛ.

english_verse: Next, we went through the east gate to the inner courtyard. The man measured this gate, and it was the same size as the others.
translation_verse: Afei ɔfale me hɔle ye kunu dɔ aluo berɛ, wɔ eyia afiteleɛ so; na osusuli anoa piri nen, né ɔte kyɛbɔ esusu ko nemɔ a bɛte ne ala.

english_verse: The guardrooms, the walls separating them, and its entrance room had the same measurements as the other gates. The guardrooms and the entrance room had windows, and the gate was
translation_verse: Ye pumbu mɔ, mbuna mɔ ne ye abrannaa ne, bɛte kyɛbɔ esusu ko nemɔ a bɛte ne ala. Né mboma mɔ apɛ nu ɔne ye abrannaa ne aso babra bayia. Ye tendenn nu te agyirɛ aburannu, yeɛ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ aburanyɔ ne nnu.

english_verse: The entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and the walls in the passageway were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate.
translation_verse: Ye abrannaa ne, né ye nye kyire aluo berɛ pato nu berɛ. Né ayee adwii wɔ ye mbuna nemɔ anwo, wɔ ye bue faen ne ye bue faen, na ye atweleɛ ndiasoɛ ne te mmɔtwɛ.

english_verse: Then the man took me to the north gate. He measured it, and it was the same size as the others,
translation_verse: Afei ɔfale me hɔle sorɔ dɔ anoa piri ne anwo dɔ; osusuli, na né ɔte kyɛbɔ esusu ko nemɔ a bɛte ne ala.

english_verse: and like the other inner gates, its entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and its walls were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate. The Rooms for Sacrificing Animals
translation_verse: Ye mbuna ne, né ye nye kyire aluo berɛ pato nu berɛ. Né ayee adwii mɔ wɔ ye mbuna nemɔ anwo, wɔ ye bue faen ne ye bue faen, na ye atweleɛ ndiasoɛ ne te mmɔtwɛ.

english_verse: Inside the entrance room of the north gate, I saw four tables, two on each side of the room, where the animals to be sacrificed were killed. Just outside this room was a small building used for washing the animals before they were offered as sacrifices to please the Lord or sacrifices for sin or sacrifices to make things right.
translation_verse: Na abrannaa so berɛ anoa piri ne anu, né ɛpoen nyɔ gyigyi bue ko, yeɛ nyɔ koso begyigyi bue ko, bɔ so yeɛ beku naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ne foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ ngaka nemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: So there was a total of eight tables, four inside and four outside, where the animals were killed,
translation_verse: Né ɛpoen nna wɔ anoa piri ne bue faen, yeɛ ɛpoen nna koso wɔ ye bue dɔ. Ɛpoen nemɔ te mmɔtwɛ, bɔ so yeɛ beku afɔleɛ ngaka nemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: and where the meat was placed until it was sacrificed on the altar. Next to the tables in the entrance room were four stone tables
translation_verse: Né ndɔkorɔ bɔ ye ndendenn te bɛ sa mmɛseka ko ɔ owurawura terɛ ne anwo bra yia; na ɛpoen nemɔ aso yeɛ né bɛfa afɔleɛ naen nemɔ begua ɔ.

english_verse: The man then took me to the inner courtyard, where I saw two buildings, one beside the inner gate on the north and the other beside the inner gate on the south.
translation_verse: Na ye kunu dɔ anoa piri ne asi dɔ, né edweintolɛfoɛ bɛ pumbu mɔ wɔ ye kunu dɔ aluo berɛ, wɔ sorɔ dɔ anoa piri ne anwo, bɔ bɛ nye kyire ngwaen dɔ ɔ. Né ko wɔ eyia afiteleɛ ɛpoen piri ne anwo, bɔ ye nye kyire sorɔ dɔ ɔ.

english_verse: He said, “The building beside the north gate belongs to the priests who serve in the temple,
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, Sɔ pumbu he bɔ ye nye kyire ngwaen ne, asɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛnea awuro ne aso ne yeɛ ɔte bɛ deɛ ɔ;

english_verse: and the building beside the south gate belongs to those who serve at the altar. All of them are descendants of Zadok and are the only Levites allowed to serve as the Lord's priests.” The Inner Courtyard and the Temple
translation_verse: na pumbu bɔ ye nye kyire sorɔ dɔ ne, asɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛyɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso adwuma ne, ɔte bɛ deɛ. Bɛ ole Sadoke boso ama, bɔ bɛte Lewi boso ama, bɔ bɛ yeɛ bepingye AWURADE bɛsɔne ye ne.

english_verse: We walked to the porch of the temple, and the man measured the doorway of the porch: It was seven meters long, two and a half meters wide, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was one and a half meters.
translation_verse: Afei ɔfale me hɔle awuro berɛ abrannaa ne aso, na osusuli abrannaa so mbuna nemɔ. Né ye bue ko te agyirɛ nnu, yeɛ ye bue ko koso te agyirɛ nnu. Na anoa piri ne, ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu, ye bue ko te agyirɛ nza, yeɛ ye bue ko koso te agyirɛ nza.

english_verse: The porch itself was ten meters by six meters, with steps leading up to it. There was a column on each side of these steps.
translation_verse: Abrannaa ne tendenn nu, ɔte agyirɛ aburanyɔ, ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ buru ne ko. Ɔfale me fale atweleɛ ndiasoɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛfo bɛkɔ so ne aso. Né bonima mɔ gyigyi mbuna nemɔ anwo berɛ, ko wɔ ye bue faen, yeɛ ko wora wɔ ye bue dɔ.

english_verse: Next we went into the main room of the temple. The man measured the doorway of this room: It was
translation_verse: Afei ɔfale me hɔle asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, na osusuli mbuna nemɔ; ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu, ye bue ko te agyirɛ nzia, yeɛ ye bue ko wora ɔte agyirɛ nzia, bɔ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ ne ɛtena sua ne bɛte pɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Then the man walked to the far end of the temple's main room and said, “Beyond this doorway is the most holy place.” He first measured the doorway: It was one meter wide,
translation_verse: Osusuli ye tendenn nu, na né ɔte agyirɛ aburanyɔ, ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ aburanyɔ, wɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anyunu berɛ. Na osele me kyɛ, “Ɛwa yeɛ ɔte Krongron nu krongron ne ɔ.”

english_verse: The walls of the temple were thicker at the bottom than at the top, which meant that the storage rooms on the top level were wider than those on the bottom level. Steps led from the bottom level, through the middle level, and into the top level.
translation_verse: Ye ngyɛnu pumbu nemɔ, efi aseɛnwo bɔ ɛkɔ ye anwuro ne, né nu ɔ́yɛ ɔbaye. Na pumbu mɔ bɔ bapɛ sua ne anwo bayia ne, ɔtaataa so kɔ anwuro, bɔ ye sɔ ati efi aseɛnwo bɔ ɛkɔ ye anwuro ne, nu baye ɔ. Né atweleɛ wɔ berɛ bɔ ofi aseɛnwo pumbu ne anu ɔfa afia deɛ ne anu ɔkɔ anwuro deɛ ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: The temple rested on a stone base three meters high, which also served as the foundation for the storage rooms.
translation_verse: Nza nwuni kyɛ sua ne le abamma bɔ wapɛ sua ne anwo wabra wayia ɔ. Né ɔte ye ngyɛnu pumbu nemɔ nyinasoɛ. Ye tendenn nu, ɔne elemmire ne bɛte pɛ, ɔte agyirɛ nzia.

english_verse: The outside walls of the storage rooms were two and a half meters thick; there was nothing between these walls
translation_verse: Ye ngyɛnu pumbu nemɔ, bɛ si dɔ fasue ne, ye pipiripii te agyirɛ nnu. Na pato bɔ ɔwɔ sua ne ngyɛnu pumbu nemɔ

english_verse: One door led into the storage rooms on the north side of the temple, and another door led to those on the south side. The stone base extended two and a half meters beyond the outside wall of the storage rooms. The West Building and the Measurements of the Temple
translation_verse: Ye ngyɛnu pumbu nemɔ, atee la nu kɔ pato ne anu, anoa ko nye kyire sorɔ, yeɛ ko wora ye nye kyire ngwaen, na pato nu berɛ tɛtrɛtɛɛ te agyirɛ nnu bra yia.

english_verse: The distance across the front of the temple, including the open space on either side, was also
translation_verse: Yeɛ sua ne anyunu berɛ ne aluo berɛ, wɔ eyia afiteleɛ so, ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ ɛyaa ko.

english_verse: Finally, the man measured the length of the west building, including the side rooms on each end, and it was also
translation_verse: Afei osusuli sua ne tendenn nu bɔ ye nye kyire aluo berɛ wɔ eyia atɔleɛ, ɔne ye abrannaa nemɔ wɔ ye bue ko biala, na ɔte agyirɛ ɛyaa ko. Sua ne akunu dɔ ne aluo berɛ abrannaa ne;

english_verse: were paneled with wood all the way from the floor to the windows, while the doorways, the small windows, and the three side rooms were trimmed in wood.
translation_verse: aponnwaa nemɔ, mboma bɔtɔfee nemɔ, abrannaa bɔ wapɛ ye mmɛsa nwo wayia ne, né bafa bakaa badwura bɛ nwo babra bayia, ofi ye aseɛnwo bɔ ɔkwaadwu mboma nemɔ, ,

english_verse: The doorframe to the temple's main room was in the shape of a rectangle. The Wooden Altar In front of the doorway to the most holy place was something that looked like
translation_verse: Né asɔneyɛɛ sua aponnwaa nemɔ bɛte ahinanan. Nekaa krongron n’anyunu berɛ, né nikyee bie wɔ berɛ bɔ osoma

english_verse: a wooden altar. It was one and a half meters high and one meter square, and its corners, its base, and its sides were made of wood. The man said, “This is a reminder that the Lord is constantly watching over his temple.” The Doors in the Temple
translation_verse: bakaa afɔleɛ bokyea, bɔ ofi ye aseɛnwo bɔ ɔkwaadwu ye anwuro ne, ɔte agyirɛ nza ɔ, ye tendenn nu te agyirɛ nyɔ, [ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ nyɔ]. Na ye ndweasoɛ nemɔ, ye nyinasoɛ nemɔ ne ye fasue nemɔ te bakaa. Na biaa ne sele me kyɛ, “Ɛpoen he yeɛ ogyi AWURADE nyunu ne.”

english_verse: Both the doorway to the main room of the temple and the doorway to the most holy place had two doors,
translation_verse: Asɔneyɛɛ sua ne ne nekaa krongron ne, né bele anoa nyɔ nyɔ.

english_verse: and each door had two sections that could fold open.
translation_verse: Né anoa nemɔ te ndaandaa, na ɛkora buka nu biala nu nyɔ.

english_verse: The doors to the main room were decorated with carvings of winged creatures and palm trees just like those on the walls, and there was a wooden covering over the porch just outside these doors.
translation_verse: Né bali kɛrubim ne ayee adwii bagua asɔneyɛɛ sua anoa nemɔ anwo, kyɛbɔ bali bagua fasue nemɔ nwo ne ala. Afei koso, né bafa ndaboa babɔ pata wɔ abrannaa ne anyunu berɛ.

english_verse: The walls on each side of this porch had small windows and were also decorated with carvings of palm trees.
translation_verse: Né mboma bɔtɔfee, yeɛ ayee adwii wɔ ye bue dɔ ne ye bue faen, wɔ abrannaa ne ngyɛnu ne ye ngyɛnu.

english_verse: After the man and I left the temple and walked back to the outer courtyard, he showed me a set of rooms on the north side of the west building. This set of rooms was
translation_verse: Sua ne, ye tendenn nu wɔ ye sorɔ, ɔte agyirɛ ɛyaa ko, yeɛ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ aburannu.

english_verse: and at the east end of this wall was the door leading from the courtyard to these rooms. There was also a set of rooms on the south side of the west building.
translation_verse: Aluo berɛ pato fasue pipiripii ne, wɔ eyia afiteleɛ so, pato ne ɔne sua ne bɛ ndendeneɛ so, né pumbu mɔ bɛwɔ berɛ

english_verse: with doors that opened toward the north, and in front of them was a walkway five meters wide and
translation_verse: Né pato bie wɔ pumbu nemɔ anyunu berɛ, bɔ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ te agyirɛ buru ɔ; ye atee ne tendenn te agyirɛ ko, na b’anoa nemɔ nye nea sorɔ.

english_verse: The rooms on the top level were narrower than those on the middle level, and the rooms on the middle level were narrower than those on the bottom level.
translation_verse: Né anwuro pumbu nemɔ bɛte bɔtɔfee, ofikyɛ abrannaa nemɔ bafa bɛ bue, na bɛ bue bɔ bafa ne, ɔte piri tra bɔ bafa bafi aseɛnwo ne afia pumbu nemɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: The rooms on the bottom level supported those on the two upper levels, and so these rooms did not have columns like other buildings in the courtyard.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔte aborɔsaen bɔ ɔtoa so nza ɔ, nakoso bɛ de, belle mbuna kyɛbɔ aluo berɛ de ole bie ne; yiti bɛte bɔtɔfee bɛtra aseɛnwo ne afia deɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: These rooms were exactly like those on the north side, and they also had a walkway in front of them.
translation_verse: bɔ atee la bɛ nyunu berɛ ɔ. Bɛte kyɛ sorɔ dɔ pumbu nemɔ ala; bɛ tendenn ne bɛ tɛtrɛtɛɛ te pɛ, b’atee bɔ ɛfa nu fite amukoraa, kyɛbɔ besi bɛte ne, ɔne b’anoa nemɔ, bɛte kyɛ ɛhene mɔ ala.

english_verse: The door to these rooms was at the east end of the wall that stood in front of them.
translation_verse: Na pumbu nemɔ b’anoa mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ ngwaen dɔ ne, né anoa ko wɔ atunu berɛ, wɔ fasue ne nyunu berɛ wɔ eyia afiteleɛ so, sɛ ɛkwaawura nu a.

english_verse: The man then said to me: These rooms on the north and south sides of the temple are the sacred rooms where the Lord's priests will eat the most holy offerings. These offerings include the grain sacrifices, the sacrifices for sin, and the sacrifices to make things right.
translation_verse: Yeɛ osele me kyɛ, “Sorɔ dɔ pumbu nemɔ ne ngwaen dɔ pumbu nemɔ bɔ bɛwɔ pato n’anyunu berɛ ne, bɛ ole pumbu krongron nemɔ. Berɛ yeɛ asɔfo mɔ bɔ bepingye AWURADE ne bekoli krongron nu krongron afɔleɛ nningyein ne ɔ; berɛ yeɛ bɛkɔfa krongron nu krongron nningyein ne bekogua ɔ: aleɛ afɔleɛ, bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ne foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ, ofikyɛ berɛ te krongron.

english_verse: When the priests are ready to leave the temple, they must go through these rooms before they return to the outer courtyard. They must leave their sacred clothes in these rooms and put on regular clothes before going anywhere near other people. The Size of the Temple Area
translation_verse: Sɛ asɔfo nemɔ bɛbaawura nekaa krongron ne anu a, onni kyɛ befi berɛ bɛkɔ aluo berɛ pato ne anu dɔ, sana bepuro bɛ ndaadeɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔne ne begua berɛ koraka, ofikyɛ ndaadeɛ nemɔ te krongron. Odi kyɛ bɛfa ndaadeɛ mbaen bie bewura, koraka né bapingye nekaa bɔ mmenia le atee kyɛ bɛkɔ ne.”

english_verse: After the man had finished measuring the buildings inside the temple area, he took me back through the east gate and measured the wall around this area.
translation_verse: Na osusuli sua ne akunu dɔ yiele nen, ɔfale me fitele fale anoa piri bɔ ye nye kyire eyia afiteleɛ ne anu, na osusuli sua ne nwo bra yiale.

english_verse: He used his measuring stick to measure the east side of this wall; it was
translation_verse: Ɔfale elemmire bɔ bɛfa besusu nikyee ne osusuli eyia afiteleɛ bue nu dɔ bra yiale, na ɔfale elemmire ne susuli ne, né ɔte agyirɛ ɛyaa nnu.

english_verse: Then he measured the north side, the south side, and the west side of the wall, and they were each
translation_verse: Afei ɔpɛnene ye nwo hɔle eyia atɔleɛ bue nu dɔ, ɔfale elemmire bɔ bɛfa besusu nikyee ne osusuli, na ɔte agyirɛ ɛyaa nnu.

english_verse: and so the temple area was a perfect square. The wall around this area separated what was sacred from what was ordinary.
translation_verse: Osusuli ye bue nna ne. Né fasue wɔ ye nwo bra yia bɔ ye tendenn nu te agyirɛ ɛyaa nnu, ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ ɛyaa nnu, kyɛ ɔfa yɛ nekaa krongron berɛ ɔne nekaa mbaen ne b’afia mbɛmuɛ.

english_verse: The man took me back to the east gate of the temple,
translation_verse: Na ɛhe asi ne, ɔfale me wale anoa piri bɔ ye nye kyire eyia afiteleɛ so ne anu.

english_verse: meters high, was the place where sacrifices were burned, and the four corners of the top section looked like the horns of a bull. The steps leading up to the altar were on the east side. The Dedication of the Altar
translation_verse: Yieee! Yisrael Nyameɛ animnyam fili eyia afiteleɛ bue nu dɔ wale; na ye walɛ ne, ɔyɛle wuruwuruwuru kyɛ asue pee bɔ bɛsẽ ɔ, na ye animnyam mane aseɛ tale.

english_verse: This vision was like the one I had seen when God came to destroy Jerusalem and like the one I had seen near the Chebar River. I immediately bowed with my face to the ground,
translation_verse: Na nyekyire bɔ nwuni ne, osoma nyekyire bɔ nwuni ye wɔ mmerɛ bɔ mmale mmanzɛkyele kuro ne nen, na nyekyire nemɔ soma nyekyire bɔ nwuni ye asue Kebare noa ne; na mvale me nyunu mmutuli berɛ.

english_verse: and the Lord's glory came through the east gate and into the temple.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE animnyam ne, ɔfale anoa piri bɔ ye nye kyire eyia afiteleɛ ne anu wale awuro berɛ.

english_verse: The Lord's Spirit lifted me to my feet and carried me to the inner courtyard, where I saw that the Lord's glory had filled the temple.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Sunzum ne mane me so, na ɔfale me hɔle awuro ne kunu dɔ aluo berɛ; na yieee, AWURADE animnyam yili awuro ne anu tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: But if the people and their kings stop worshiping other gods and tear down those memorials, I will live among them forever.
translation_verse: Na afei de, odi kyɛ bɛye bɛ gyanderabɔlɛ, ɔne bɛ hene mɔ bɛ fuin befi me nwo bɛkɔ dedeede, na ngɔtena bɛ nu afebɔɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel must suffer shame for sinning against me, so tell them about my holy temple. Let them think about it,
translation_verse: “Na wɔ, Sona awa, kã kyɛbɔ awuro ne osi te ɔ kyire Yisrael awuro ama ma bɛ nyunu gua ase wɔ b’amumuyɛɛ nwo. Maa besusu kyɛbɔ osi te ɔ.

english_verse: then if they are truly sorry, describe for them the design and shape of the temple, the gates, the measurements, and how the buildings are arranged. Explain the regulations about worshiping there, then write down these things, so they can study and obey them.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bɛ nyunu gua ase wɔ bɔ bayɔ amukoraa nwo a, afei kyire bɛ kyɛbɔ awuro ne osi te ɔ, ɔne kyɛbɔ besi bɛhyehyɛle ye ɔ, ye anoa mɔ bɔ bɛfa nu befite, ɔne bɔ bɛfa nu bɛkɔ nu ɔ, sua ne sue amukoraa, ye nwo nhyehyɛleɛ amukoraa, kyɛbɔ basi basi ye amukoraa, ɔne ye nwo mmeraa amukoraa. Kyerɛ ye wɔ bɛ nyunu berɛ ma bɛnea kyɛbɔ basi basi ye amukoraa, ɔne ye nwo nhyehyɛleɛ amukoraa, ná beli so.

english_verse: The temple area on my holy mountain must be kept sacred! This is the most important law about the temple. The Altar
translation_verse: Awuro ne, ye nwo mmeraa ɛhe: Bokaa ne ti afia, ɔne ye nwo wɛen bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo wabra wayia amukoraa te krongron nu krongron. Tie, awuro ne nwo mmeraa ɛne.

english_verse: Each day for the next seven days, you must offer a goat and a bull and a ram as sacrifices for sin. These animals must have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Fa abɔngye ko bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ɛlɛho biala toonn ɛlɛsoo; yeɛ fa nandwie nyii ko ne mmoaen kure ne anu boaen nyii ko bɔ bellili nnɛen ɔ bɔ afɔleɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God said: Ezekiel, son of man, after the altar is built, it must be dedicated by offering sacrifices on it and by splattering it with blood. Here is what you must do:
translation_verse: Yeɛ osele me kyɛ, Sona awa, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Afɔleɛ bokyea ne nwo nhyehyɛleɛ ɛhe: Kyẽa bɔ bekosi afɔleɛ bokyea ne kyɛ bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ wɔ so, ná bɛpete mogya begua so ne,

english_verse: The priests of the Levi tribe from the family of Zadok the priest are the only ones who may serve in my temple—this is my law. So give them a young bull to slaughter as a sacrifice for sin.
translation_verse: Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛte asɔfo bɔ bɛte Sadoke bosofoɛ ne, bɔ yeɛ bepingye me bɛbaso me ne, fa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma ko ma bɛ ma bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Take some of the animal's blood and smear it on the four corners of the altar, some on the corners of the middle section, and some more on the rim around its edge. That will purify the altar and make it fit for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Fa ye mogya ne bie kekã afɔleɛ bokyea mmɛen nna nemɔ, ye afia nna nemɔ bɛ ndweasoɛ so, yeɛ ye bo kaa bɔ wapɛ ye nwo wabra wayia ne anwo. Yɔ sɔ fa te afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo, ná pata ma ye.

english_verse: Then take the body of the bull outside the temple area and burn it at the special place.
translation_verse: Afei fa bɔne nwo afɔleɛ nandwie nyii ne, ná yera ye wɔ awuro ne anu nekaa bɔ baye basie berɛ ne, wɔ nekaa krongron ne asi dɔ.

english_verse: The next day, a goat that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice for sin. Purify the altar with its blood, just as you did with the blood of the bull.
translation_verse: Na ye elenyɔ ne aso, fa abɔngye nyii bɔ ollili nnɛen ɔ bɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ; fa te afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo, kyɛbɔ bɛfale nandwie nyii ne bɛtele ye nwo ne.

english_verse: Then choose a young bull and a young ram that have nothing wrong with them,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛte ye nwo yie a, fa nandwie ko bɔ ollili nnɛen ɔ, ɔne mmoaen kure ne anu boaen nyii ko bɔ ollili nnɛen ɔ bɔ afɔleɛ;

english_verse: and bring them to my temple. The priests will sprinkle salt on them and offer them as sacrifices to please me.
translation_verse: fa bɛ bra AWURADE nyunu maa asɔfo nemɔ bɛfa ngyee bɛpete bɛ nwo, ná bɛfa bɛ bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE.

english_verse: The priests will purify the altar during those days, so that it will be acceptable to me and ready to use.
translation_verse: Ɛlɛsoo yeɛ odi kyɛ bɛfa bɛpata bɛma afɔleɛ bokyea ne, bɛfa bɛpete ye nwo, ná betu besie berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: From then on, the priests will use this altar to offer sacrifices to please me and sacrifices to ask my blessing. Then I will be pleased with the people of Israel. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Na sɛ sɔ ngyẽa ne so yie a, afei ofi ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso bɔ ɔkɔ ne, odi kyɛ asɔfo nemɔ bɛbɔ ɛmɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne asomdwee afɔleɛ ne wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso, na ngole ɛmɔ ngɔto nu, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: The man took me back to the outer courtyard, near the east gate of the temple area. I saw that the doors to this gate were closed.
translation_verse: Afei ɔfale me sale nziɛ wale nekaa krongron berɛ dwaaso anoa piri bɔ ye nye kyire eyia afiteleɛ ne anwo, na né bato nu.

english_verse: The Lord said: I, the Lord God of Israel, came through this gate, so it must remain closed forever! No one must ever use it.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Anoa piri he, nu ato; bengobukye, yeɛ sona biala ngɔfa nu ngɔwa nu, ofikyɛ AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ wafa nu wawa nu, yiti nu kɔhɔ so kɔto.

english_verse: The ruler of Israel may come here to eat a sacrificial meal that has been offered to me, but he must use only the entrance room of this gate. People Who Are Not Allowed in the Temple
translation_verse: Titireniɛ ne angome, ye yeɛ ɔkɔtena nu kodidi wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ. Ɔkɔfa anoa piri nu pato atee ne aso kɔwa nu, ná wasa wafa nu wafite.”

english_verse: Then the man took me through the north gate to the front of the temple. I saw that the brightness of the Lord's glory had filled the temple, and I immediately bowed with my face to the ground.
translation_verse: Afei ɔfale me fale sorɔ dɔ anoa piri atee ne aso wale awuro ne anyunu berɛ, na nneane, na yieee, AWURADE animnyam ne yili AWURADE awuro berɛ tɛkyɛ, na mvale me nyunu mutuli berɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said: Ezekiel, son of man, I am going to give you the laws for my temple. So pay attention and listen carefully to what kind of people are allowed to come in the temple, and what kind are not.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Sona awa, ma w’adwene bra so, gyene wɔ nye nea ye yé, ná fa wɔ so tie nhyehyɛleɛ mukoraa bɔ mebaahã mekyire wɔ mefa AWURADE awuro ne anwo, ɔne ye nwo mmeraa amukoraa nwo, ná nea ye yé nwu bɛ bɔ ɔfata kyɛ bɛba awuro ne anu, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛmvata kyɛ bɛba nekaa krongron ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: Tell those rebellious people of Israel: I, the Lord God, command you to stop your evil ways!
translation_verse: Na kã kyire mmenia bɔ bayɛ lɔen ne, bɔ bɛ ole Yisrael awuro ama ne, kyɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: O Yisrael awuro ama, wayɛ yee! Ɛmɔ akyiwadeɛ yɔleɛ ne amukoraa, ɛ́mɔpɛ so!

english_verse: My temple has been disgraced, because you have let godless, stubborn foreigners come here when sacrifices are being offered to me. You have sinned and have broken our solemn agreement.
translation_verse: Ye ole kyɛ, ɛmɔma amanvrafoɛ bɛba nu, ɛmɔma mmenia bɔ bɛte bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ wɔ ahone nu ne anwoɔnaen nu ɔ bɛba me nekaa krongron ne anu bɛbagua m’awuro ne anwo fiɛ, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔfa m’aleɛ, ɛloe ne mogya bɛbrɛ me ɔ. Na ɛmɔafa ɛmɔ akyiwadeɛ yɔleɛ ne amukoraa babu m’apam ne aso.

english_verse: Instead of following the proper ways to worship me, you have put foreigners in charge of worship at my temple.
translation_verse: Me nningyein krongron nemɔ, ɛmɔanyɔ bɛ nwo adwuma ne, na mmom mmeni foforɛ yeɛ ɛmɔafa bɛ kyɛ bɛyɔ me nekaa krongron berɛ adwuma ne ɔ.

english_verse: And so I, the Lord God, say that no godless foreigner who disobeys me will be allowed in my temple. This includes any foreigner living in Israel. The Levites Are Punished The Lord said:
translation_verse: “Yiti AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Amanvoraniɛ biala, bɔ ɔmbɛ ye bienzua wɔ ahone nu ne anwoɔnaen nu, amanvrafoɛ amukoraa bɔ baafra Yisraelfoɛ nu ne, onni kyɛ bewura me nekaa krongron ne anu.

english_verse: Some of the Levites turned their backs on me and joined the other people of Israel in worshiping idols. So these Levites must be punished!
translation_verse: Na Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛhwene bɛ nwo befili me nwo bɛhɔle dedeede, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ Yisrael lili makyebu beelili bɛ mmosoen mɔ si ne, bɛ sa kɔhã b’amumuyɛɛ nwo asohwenɛ.

english_verse: They will still be allowed to serve me as temple workers by guarding the gates and by killing the animals to be sacrificed and by helping the worshipers.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛkɔyɛ me nekaa krongron berɛ asomvoɛ bɛkɔyɛ awuro berɛ anoa piri nemɔ aso awɛmvoɛ, na bɛkɔyɔ awuro berɛ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma. Maen naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ kaka ne, ɔne afɔleɛ kaka ne, bɛ yeɛ bekohu ye ɔ, na bɛ yeɛ bekogyina mmenia ne anyunu bɛkɔso bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But because these Levites served the people of Israel when they worshiped idols, I, the Lord God, promise that the Levites will be punished. They did not stop the Israelites from sinning,
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ bɛyɔle ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma bɛmane Yisraelfoɛ wɔ bɛ mmosoen nemɔ anyunu maa ɔnate so ɔyɛle amumuyɛɛ sundidua mane Yisrael awuro ama ne ati, mafɛ bɛ so yaa kyɛ, bɛ sa kɔhã b’amumuyɛɛ nwo asohwenɛ, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: and now I will no longer let the Levites serve as my priests or come near anything sacred to me. They must suffer shame and disgrace for their disgusting sins.
translation_verse: Onni kyɛ bepingye me bɛyɔ ɔsɔfo adwuma bɛma me ɔ, yeɛ onni kyɛ bepingye me nningyein krongron nemɔ biala, ɔne me nningyein krongron paa nemɔ. Na ɔnate akyiwadeɛ yɔleɛ bɔ bayɔ ne ati, b’animguaseɛ mata bɛ.

english_verse: They will be responsible for all the hard work that must be done in the temple. Rules for Priests The Lord said:
translation_verse: Nakoso ngɔfa awuro ne anu adwuma ne ngowura bɛ sa, nu ɛsolɛ biala ne adwuma biala bɔ odi kyɛ bɛyɔ ye wɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: The priests of the Levi tribe who are descendants of Zadok the priest were faithful to me, even when the rest of the Israelites turned away. And so, these priests will continue to serve as my priests and to offer the fat and the blood of sacrifices.
translation_verse: “Nakoso Lewifoɛ bɔ bɛte asɔfo, bɔ bɛte Sadoke boso ama, bɔ bɛyɔle me nekaa krongron ne anu adwuma, mmerɛ bɔ Yisraelfoɛ belili makyebu befili me nwo ne, bɛ de, bekopingye me bɛkɔso me, na bekogyina me nyunu bɛkɔfa ɛloe ne mogya bɛkɔbrɛ me, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: They will come into my temple, where they will offer sacrifices at my altar and lead others in worship.
translation_verse: Bɛ yeɛ bɛkɔwa me nekaa krongron ne anu ɔ, na bɛ yeɛ bekopingye me poen nwo bɛkɔso me ɔ, na bɛkɔyɔ me ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne.

english_verse: When they come to the inner courtyard, they must wear their linen priestly clothes. My priests must never wear anything made of wool when they are on duty in this courtyard or in the temple.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɛ bɛba anoa piri bɔ ɔwɔ ye kunu dɔ aluo berɛ ne anu a, odi kyɛ bewura nwera ataadeɛ. Onni kyɛ bewura boaen nwiaa ataadeɛ biala, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɛ́yɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma wɔ ye kunu dɔ aluo berɛ anoa piri ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: Even their turbans and underwear must be made of linen to keep my priests from sweating when they work.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bɛbɔ nwera abotire, ná bewura nwera pieto. Onni kyɛ bɛfa nikyee biala bɔ ɔkɔmaa bekofi mvifire ɔ bɛbɔ abɔsoɛ.

english_verse: And before they leave to join the other people in the outer courtyard, they must take off their priestly clothes, then place them in the sacred rooms and put on their regular clothes. That way, no one will touch their sacred clothes and be harmed.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bɛbaahɔ maen ne berɛ wɔ aluo berɛ pato nu berɛ a, odi kyɛ bepuropuro ndaadeɛ bɔ bewura bɛyɔle ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma ne begua pumbu krongron nemɔ anu, ná bewura ndaadeɛ mbaen bie; amaa ɔnate so bɛ ndaadeɛ ne amma mmenia ne anyɛ krongron.

english_verse: Priests must never shave their heads when they are mourning. But they must keep their hair properly trimmed and not let it grow too long.
translation_verse: Onni kyɛ bɛpoa bɛ ti, onni kyɛ bɛma bɛ ti nwiaa fu pusaa; na mmom odi kyɛ bebubu bɛ ti so.

english_verse: They must not drink wine before going to the inner courtyard.
translation_verse: Onni kyɛ ɔsɔfo biala no nzaa wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔkɔhɔ sua ne akunu dɔ aluo berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: A priest must not marry a divorced woman; he can marry only a virgin from Israel or the widow of another priest.
translation_verse: Onni kyɛ begya kunaniɛ brasua anaa brasua bɔ ebie ayira ye ɔ; na mmom Yisrael awuro ama bɛ bosoniɛ brasua bɔ onnwuni biaa le ɔ, anaa kunaniɛ brasua bɔ né ohu te ɔsɔfo yeɛ bɛkora begya ye ɔ.

english_verse: Priests must teach my people the difference between what is sacred and what is ordinary, and between what is clean and what is unclean.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ bekyirekyire me maen nzonzoleɛ bɔ ɔla krongron nningyein ɔne nningyein mbaen b’afia ɔ, ná bɛmaa benwu nzonzoleɛ bɔ ɔla nningyein bɔ bɛ nwo nde ɔne bɔ bɛ nwo te ɔ b’afia.

english_verse: They will make decisions in difficult legal cases, according to my own laws. They must also observe the religious festivals my Law requires and must always respect the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Sɛ edwirɛ ba mmenia b’afia a, bɛ yeɛ bɛkɔyɛ ndɛenbualɛfoɛ ɔ, na bekogyina me ndɛenbualɛ so yeɛ bekobua ɔ. Odi kyɛ bedi me mmeraa ne m’ahyɛdeɛ so wɔ m’aluolue bɔ mahyehyɛ amukoraa nu, yeɛ odi kyɛ bedi m’afofingyẽa nemɔ so krongron nu.

english_verse: Touching a dead body will make a person unclean. So a priest must not go near a dead body, unless it is one of his parents or children, or his brother or unmarried sister.
translation_verse: Onni kyɛ bɛkɔ efuin nwo ma bɛ nwo gua fiɛ; sana seɛ anaa niɛ, baa bienzua anaa baa brasua, aliɛmaa bienzua, anaa aliɛmaa brasua bɔ onnya oggyale biaa ɔ ye fuin yeɛ bɛkora bɛkɔ ye nwo ma efiɛ kã bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If a priest touches a dead body, he is unclean and must go through a ceremony to make himself clean. Then seven days later,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔpete ye nwo yie a, odi kyɛ bɛma ɛlɛsoo pɛ nu,

english_verse: he must go to the inner courtyard of the temple and offer a sacrifice for sin. After that, he may once again serve as my priest. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: na kyẽa bɔ ɔ́kɔ nekaa krongron berɛ, wɔ ye kunu dɔ aluo berɛ, kyɛ ɔkwaayɔ ɛsɔnenɛ adwuma wɔ nekaa krongron berɛ nen, odi kyɛ ɔfa ye bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ɔba, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I myself will provide for my priests, and so they won't receive any land of their own.
translation_verse: “Na bɔ ɔkɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ de, me AWURADE yeɛ nde b’agyapadeɛ ɔ. Nnɛma ɛmɔma bɛ kyɛfa biala wɔ Yisrael, na me yeɛ nde bɛ kyɛfa ɔ.

english_verse: Instead, they will receive part of the grain sacrifices, as well as part of the sacrifices for sin and sacrifices to make things right. They will also be given everything in Israel that has been completely dedicated to me.
translation_verse: Aleɛ afɔleɛ, bɔne nwo afɔleɛ ne foɛlilɛ afɔleɛ yeɛ bekoli ɔ; ɔne nikyee biala bɔ batu basie berɛ wɔ Yisrael yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The first part of every harvest will belong to the priests. They will also receive part of all special gifts and offerings the Israelites bring to me. And whenever any of my people bake bread, they will give their first loaf as an offering to the priests, and I will bless the homes of the people when they do this.
translation_verse: Na fieso nningyein mukoraa nu mmaa bɔ oli moa ne, nu paa paa ne, ɔne afɔleɛ ahoroɔ biala bɔ ofi ɛmɔ afɔleɛ mukoraa nu ne, ɔkɔyɛ asɔfo nemɔ deɛ. Na ɛmɔ mɔle bɔ oli moa ne koso, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛma asɔfo nemɔ, amaa ɔnate so saleɛ awa ɛmɔ awuro.

english_verse: Priests must not eat any bird or animal that dies a natural death or that has been killed by a wild animal.
translation_verse: Onni kyɛ asɔfo nemɔ bedi nikyee biala bɔ ye bɔbɔ wawu, anaa bɔ kaka bie ahu ye ɔ, kyɛ anomaa oo, anaa kaka bie oo.

english_verse: So from now on, you must use honest weights and measures.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔ tonyi, ɛmɔ graa ne ɛmɔ galɔn nemɔ, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ turoloo.

english_verse: The Festival of Shelters will begin on the fifteenth day of the seventh month and will continue for seven days. On each day of this festival, the ruler will provide the same number of animals that he did each day during Passover, as well as the same amount of grain and olive oil for the sacrifices.
translation_verse: Bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne anu, ye eleburu ne nnu ne aso, aluolue ɛlɛsoo ne amukoraa, odi kyɛ ɔyɔ sɔ ala, kyɛ ɔkɔfa bɔne nwo afɔleɛ, naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, aleɛ afɔleɛ ne ngoo kɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: kilometers wide. This will belong to the people of Israel and will include the city of Jerusalem. Land for Israel's Ruler The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na sɔ aseɛ ne bɔ apɛ ato berɛ ne, susu nu bie bɔ ye tendenn nu te agyirɛ apee aburanyɔ ne nnu, bɔ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ apee buru ɔ, bɔ nu yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ nekaa krongron ne, krongron nu krongron ne ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God said: You leaders of Israel have cheated and abused my people long enough! I want you to stop sinning and start doing what is right and fair. You must never again force my people off their own land. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_verse: “AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: O Yisrael ahemvo mɔ, wayɛ yee! Ɛ́mɔyakyi asisie ne nhyɛsoɛ ne, ná mmom ɛ́mɔyɔ bɔ ɔte pɛpɛɛpɛ ne bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ. Nhyɛsoɛ so bɔ ɛmɔfa bede aseɛ befi me mmenia sa nu ne, ɛ́mɔyakyi, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The ephah will be the standard dry measure, and the bath will be the standard liquid measure. Their size will be based on the homer, which will equal ten ephahs or ten baths.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ graa ne galɔn ne bɛyɛ pɛ. Galɔn ko te angora ko bɔ bahyɛ nu buru ɔ, yeɛ graa ko te angora ko bɔ bahyɛ nu buru ɔ. Angora yeɛ bɛkɔfa bekosusu nikye ɔ.

english_verse: The same ceremony must also be done on the seventh day of the month, so that anyone who sins accidentally or without knowing it will be forgiven, and so that my temple will remain holy.
translation_verse: Bosome ne, ye kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne, ebiala bɔ ɔnate mvomsoɛ so, anaa bɔ ye adwene te kãa ti wayɔ bɔne ne, gyina ye gya nu yɔ sɔ. Na sɔ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔpata bɛma awuro ne ɔ.

english_verse: Leaders of Israel, the people must bring you one sixtieth of their grain harvests as offerings to me.
translation_verse: “Afɔleɛ bɔ odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛba hɔ ɛhe: Atokoɔ angora ko biala, graa ko ngyɛmuɛ nzia nu ko; yeɛ ayuo angora ko biala, graa ko ngyɛmuɛ nzia nu ko.

english_verse: They will also bring one percent of their olive oil. These things will be measured according to the bath, and ten baths is the same as one homer or one cor.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngoo nwo nhyehyɛleɛ ɛhe: ngoo angora asusudeɛ biala, ɛ́mɔfa galɔn ko nu ngyɛmuɛ buru, ;

english_verse: The people of Israel will bring you these offerings.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ aseɛ ne aso ama mukoraa bɛfa sɔ afɔleɛ ne bɛbrɛ Yisrael hene ne.

english_verse: But during New Moon Festivals, Sabbath celebrations, and other religious feasts, you leaders will be responsible for providing animals for the sacrifices, as well as the grain and wine. All these will be used for the sacrifices for sin, the grain sacrifices, the sacrifices to please me, and those to ask my blessing. I will be pleased and will forgive the sins of my people. The Festivals (Exodus
translation_verse: Ɛhene ne, ɔte ye asɛdeɛ kyɛ odwu aluolue nemɔ, ɛsraen foforɛ, afofingyẽa nemɔ ne Yisrael awuro ama b’aluolue amukoraa bɔ bahyehyɛ ne a, ɔkɔfa bɔne nwo afɔleɛ, aleɛ afɔleɛ ne anonneɛ afɔleɛ kɔwa ɔ. Ye yeɛ ɔkɔfa bɔne nwo afɔleɛ, aleɛ afɔleɛ, naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne asomdwee afɔleɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛpata bɛma Yisrael awuro ama ne kɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: Each day of the festival he is to bring seven bulls and seven rams as sacrifices to please me, and he must bring a goat as a sacrifice for sin. These animals must have nothing wrong with them.
translation_verse: Na aluolue ɛlɛsoo ne amukoraa, odi kyɛ ɔfa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma nzoo ne mmoaen nyii nzoo bɔ bellili nnɛen ɔ maa bɛbɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɛma AWURADE, ɛlɛho biala sɔ alaa ɛlɛsoo. Yeɛ ɛlɛho biala, odi kyɛ ɔfa abɔngye nyii ko maa bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God said: On the first day of the first month, a young bull that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice to purify the temple.
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Bosome bɔ oli moa ne, ye kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, fa nandwie akrɔngrɔma ko bɔ ollili nnɛen ɔ pete nekaa krongron ne anwo.

english_verse: The priest will take some blood from this sacrifice and smear it on the doorposts of the temple, as well as on the four corners of the altar and on the doorposts of the gates that lead into the inner courtyard.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo ne, odi kyɛ ɔfa bɔne nwo afɔleɛ mogya ne bie kekã awuro berɛ aponnwaa nemɔ anwo, afɔleɛ bokyea ne bo kaa ndweasoɛ nna ne anwo, yeɛ anoa piri aponnwaa bɔ ɔwɔ ye kunu dɔ aluo berɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: Beginning on the fourteenth day of the first month, and continuing for seven days, everyone will celebrate Passover and eat bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: “Bosome bɔ oli moa ne, ye eleburu ne nna ne aso, ɛ́mɔli Abɔtra aluolue ne, na ɛ́mɔli paanoo kabrɛdi ɛlɛsoo.

english_verse: On the first day, the ruler will bring a bull to offer as a sacrifice for his sins and for the sins of the people.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne ala, odi kyɛ ɛhene ne fa nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma ko ɔba maa bɛbɔ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ bɛma ye bɔbɔ ne aseɛ ne aso ama mukoraa.

english_verse: He will also provide nine kilograms of grain and three liters of olive oil to be offered with each bull and each ram.
translation_verse: Nandwie nyii biala, odi kyɛ ɔfa ye nwo aleɛ afɔleɛ graa ko ba; boaen nyii biala, ye nwo aleɛ afɔleɛ graa ko; yeɛ graa ko biala ye nwo ngoo towaa ko.

english_verse: The Lord said: The east gate of the inner courtyard must remain closed during the six working days of each week. But on the Sabbath and on the first day of the month, this gate will be opened.
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ye kunu dɔ aluo berɛ anoa piri bɔ ye nye kyire eyia afiteleɛ so ne, odi kyɛ bɛto nu elesia bɔ bɛfa bɛyɔ adwuma ne; nakoso afofikyẽa ne de, odi kyɛ bebukye; yeɛ ɛsraen foforɛ kyẽa ne koso, odi kyɛ bebukye.

english_verse: Israel's ruler will go from the outer courtyard into the entrance room of this gate and stand in the doorway while the priest offers sacrifices to ask my blessing and sacrifices to please me. The ruler will bow with his face to the ground to show that he has worshiped me. Then he will leave, and the gate will remain open until evening.
translation_verse: Ɛhene ne, ɔkɔfa aluo dɔ anoa piri abrannaa ne aso ɔkɔhɔ nu, na okoogyina anoa piri aponnwaa ne anwo. Asɔfo nemɔ kɔbɔ ye naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ɔne ye asomdwee afɔleɛ ne, na ɔkɔsɔne wɔ anoa piri aponnwaa ne anwo berɛ. Afei okofite, nakoso anoa piri ne de, onni kyɛ bɛto nu kɔpem kyɛ okodwu nɔsoa ɔ.

english_verse: Each Sabbath and on the first day of each month, the people of Israel must also come to the east gate and worship me.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ odi kyɛ aseɛ ne aso ama bɛsɔne wɔ sɔ anoa piri ne anu afofingyẽa nemɔ ne ɛsraen foforɛ nemɔ anu, wɔ AWURADE nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: On the Sabbath, the ruler will bring six lambs and one ram to be offered as sacrifices to please me. There must be nothing wrong with any of these animals.
translation_verse: Naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɛhene ne ɔbɔ ma AWURADE wɔ afofikyẽa ne, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nzia bɔ bellili nnɛen ɔne boaen nyii ko bɔ ollili nnɛen ɔ.

english_verse: With the ram, he is to offer nine kilograms of grain, and with each of the lambs, he can offer as much as he wants. He must also offer three liters of olive oil with every nine kilograms of grain.
translation_verse: Aleɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔfa boka boaen nyii ne aso ne, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ graa ko; yeɛ aleɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔfa boka mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nemɔ aso ne koso, ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ye sa kɔsõ so ɔ, ɔne graa ko biala ye nwo ngoo galɔn ko.

english_verse: The ruler is to bring six lambs, a bull, and a ram to be offered as sacrifices at the New Moon Festival. There must be nothing wrong with any of these animals.
translation_verse: Na ɛsraen foforɛ kyẽa ne, nandwie akrɔngrɔma ko bɔ ollili nnɛen, yeɛ mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nzia ne boaen nyii ko bɔ bellili nnɛen ɔ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔfa bɔ afɔleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: With the bull and the ram, he is to offer nine kilograms of grain, and with each of the lambs, he can offer as much as he wants. He must also offer three liters of olive oil with every nine kilograms of grain.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɔbɔ nandwie nyii ne nwo aleɛ afɔleɛ graa ko, boaen ne nwo aleɛ afɔleɛ graa ko, yeɛ mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nemɔ de, kyɛbɔ ye sa kɔsõ so ɔ, ɔne graa ko biala ye nwo ngoo galɔn ko.

english_verse: The ruler must come through the entrance room of the east gate and leave the same way.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛhene ne ɔkwaawura nu a, odi kyɛ ɔfa anoa piri abrannaa ne aso, na berɛ ala yeɛ okosa kɔfa kofite ɔ.

english_verse: When my people come to worship me during any festival, they must always leave by the opposite gate from which they came: Those who come in the north gate must leave by the south gate, and those who come in the south gate must leave by the north gate.
translation_verse: “Na sɛ aseɛ ne aso ama bɛba AWURADE nyunu wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bedi aluolue nemɔ a, ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa sorɔ dɔ anoa piri atee ne aso kɔwa nu kɔɔsɔne ne, ngwaen dɔ anoa piri atee ne aso yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔfa fite kɔ ɔ; yeɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa ngwaen dɔ anoa piri atee ne aso kɔwa nu ne, sorɔ dɔ anoa piri atee ne aso yeɛ odi kyɛ ɔfa fite kɔ ɔ. Onni kyɛ osa kɔfa anoa bɔ ɔfale nu wale ne anu, na mmom odi kyɛ ɔkɔ ye nyunu tee fite.

english_verse: Their ruler will come in at the same time they do and leave at the same time they leave.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛkwaawura nu a, odi kyɛ ɛhene ne ɔne bɛ bɛkɔ; yeɛ sɛ befite koso a, ɔne bɛ yeɛ bekofite ɔ.

english_verse: At all other festivals and celebrations, nine kilograms of grain will be offered with a bull, and nine kilograms will be offered with a ram. The worshipers can offer as much grain as they want with each lamb. Three liters of olive oil must be offered with every nine kilograms of grain.
translation_verse: “Na aluolue nemɔ ne nyianu ngyẽa nemɔ anu, aleɛ afɔleɛ ne kɔyɛ aleɛ graa ko ne nandwie nyii ko, aleɛ graa ko ne boaen nyii ko, na mmoaen akrɔngrɔma nemɔ nwo de, kyɛbɔ ye sa kɔsõ so ɔ, ɔne graa ko biala ye nwo ngoo galɔn ko.

english_verse: If the ruler voluntarily offers a sacrifice to please me or to ask my blessing, the east gate of the inner courtyard will be opened for him. He will offer his sacrifices just as he does on each Sabbath; then he will leave, and the gate will be closed.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛhene ne ɔbaabɔ akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE a, kyɛ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ oo, anaa asomdwee afɔleɛ oo, odi kyɛ bebukye anoa piri bɔ ye nye kyire eyia afiteleɛ ne bɛma ye, na odi kyɛ ɔbɔ ye naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ɔne ye asomdwee afɔleɛ ne kyɛbɔ ɔyɔ ye afofikyẽa ne ala. Afei odi kyɛ ofite, na ofite yie a, odi kyɛ bɛto anoa piri ne anu.

english_verse: Each morning a year-old lamb that has nothing wrong with it must be offered as a sacrifice to please me.
translation_verse: “Boaen akrɔngrɔma bɔ wali afoɛ ko bɔ ollili nnɛen ɔ yeɛ ɛlɛho biala odi kyɛ ɛfa babɔ naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE ɔ. Bɔ ye ngyerɛmɔ biala.

english_verse: Along with it, two kilograms of fine flour mixed with a liter of olive oil must be offered as a grain sacrifice. This law will never change—
translation_verse: Bɔ ye nwo aleɛ afɔleɛ ngyerɛmɔ biala, graa ko ye ngyɛmuɛ nzia, ɔne ngoo galɔn ko ye ngyɛmuɛ nza bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔfɔre esam paa ne ɔ, ná ɔyɛ daa biala aleɛ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE, nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ ɔla berɛ daa hɔ ɛne.

english_verse: The Lord God said: If the ruler of Israel gives some of his land to one of his children, it will belong to the ruler's child as part of the family property.
translation_verse: “AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo: Ɛhene ne, sɛ ɔfa agyapadeɛ ɔkyɛ ye mma mmienzua nemɔ anu bie a, agyapadeɛ ne kɔyɛ ye mma mmienzua nemɔ deɛ, b’agyapadeɛ bɔ waali bɛ sa hɔ ɛne.

english_verse: But if the ruler gives some of his land to one of his servants, the land will belong to the servant until the Year of Celebration, when it will be returned to the ruler. Only the ruler's children can keep what is given to them.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɔfa ye agyapadeɛ ne bie ɔkyɛ ye somvoɛ mmienzua nemɔ anu ko a, ye de agyapadeɛ ne kɔyɛ somvoɛ ne deɛ kɔpem fawɔnwodi afoɛ ne, na afei agyapadeɛ ne kosa kooli ɛhene ne sa. Ye mma angome yeɛ ye agyapadeɛ te bɛ deɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The man who was showing me the temple then took me back to the inner courtyard. We walked to the south side of the courtyard and stopped at the door to the sacred rooms that belonged to the priests. He showed me more rooms at the western edge of the courtyard
translation_verse: Afei ɔfale me ɔɔfale atee bɔ ɔla anoa piri ne ngyɛnu dɔ ne aso, maa yɛɛwurale asɔfo mɔ pumbu krongron mɔ bɔ bɛ nye nea sorɔ dɔ ne anu. Na nwuni nekaa bie wɔ eyia atɔleɛ so dɔ nziɛ nziɛ.

english_verse: Around the inside of these smaller courtyards was a low wall of stones, and against the wall were places to build fires.
translation_verse: Pato nna nemɔ akunu ne, né abamma wɔ nu bra yia, na né basisi mmokyea wɔ abamma nemɔ b’aseɛnwo berɛ babra bayia.

english_verse: The man said, “These are the kitchens where the temple workers will boil the meat that worshipers offer as sacrifices.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ osele me kyɛ, “Ɛhemɔ ole gyaale mɔ, nekaa bɔ awuro ne anu somvoɛ mɔ bɛkɔto mmenia nemɔ b’afɔleɛ bɔ bahu ye ne.”

english_verse: The man took me back to the temple, where I saw a stream flowing from under the entrance. It began in the south part of the temple, where it ran past the altar and continued east through the courtyard.
translation_verse: Afei osa fale me wale awuro berɛ anoa ne anu, na yieee, né nzue opu fi awuro berɛ aponnwaa ne abo ɔsẽ kɔ eyia afiteleɛ so dɔ . Né nzue ne ɔtengyɛ bagua ase fi awuro ne famaa so, wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne ngwaen.

english_verse: We walked out of the temple area through the north gate and went around to the east gate. I saw the small stream of water flowing east from the south side of the gate.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɔfale me fale sorɔ dɔ anoa piri ne anu maa yɛfitele; ɔfale me fale bondua dɔ bra yiale wale dwaaso anoa piri bɔ ye nye nea eyia afiteleɛ ne anwo, na nwuni kyɛ nzue ne ɔsẽ fi famaa so dɔ.

english_verse: The man said, “Ezekiel, son of man, pay attention to what you've seen.” We walked to the riverbank,
translation_verse: Yeɛ obisale me kyɛ, “Sona awa, aso anwu ɛhe?” Afei ɔfale me fale asue ne noa maa nzale me si.

english_verse: where I saw dozens of trees on each side.
translation_verse: Na nza mmale ne, nwuni mmakaa pee wɔ asue ne noa wɔ ye bue nyɔ ne.

english_verse: The man said: This water flows eastward to the Jordan River valley and empties into the Dead Sea, where it turns the salt water into fresh water.
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, “Asue he, ɔtengyɛ kɔ eyia afiteleɛ bue nu dɔ okogua Araba ne anu, na ɔtengyɛ kogua ɛpo nu a, ɔsa nzue ne anwonyerɛ.

english_verse: From En-Gedi to Eneglaim, people will fish in the sea and dry their nets along the coast. There will be as many kinds of fish in the Dead Sea as there are in the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Bekogyina ɛpo ne noa fi Ɛn Gedi bɔ ɔkwaadwu Ɛn Englaim, na berɛ yeɛ bɛkɔworɛ asawu mɔ nu ɔ. Nu naen mɔ kɔyɛ ahoroɔ pee, kyɛ ɛpo piri nu naen ahoroɔ pembepembe ne ala.

english_verse: But the marshes along the shore will remain salty, so that people can use the salt from them.
translation_verse: Nakoso ye boo ne ye asaa nemɔ anu de, bɛ nwo ngɔsa, bɛkɔha berɛ maa bekonya ngyee bekofi nu.

english_verse: Fruit trees will grow all along this river and produce fresh fruit every month. The leaves will never dry out, because they will always have water from the stream that flows from the temple, and they will be used for healing people. The Borders of the Land
translation_verse: Mmakaa ahoroɔ amukoraa bɔ bedi ɔ kofifi asue ne noa, wɔ ye bue nyɔ ne. Bɛ nyaa ngɔkese, yeɛ mmaa ngɔpa so. Bosome biala bekosu mmaa foforɛ, ofikyɛ nzue bɔ benya ye ne ofi nekaa krongron berɛ. Bekoli bɛ mma ne, né bafa bɛ nyaa koso bayɛ ayire.” Aseɛ ne wɛen mɔ

english_verse: The Lord God said to the people of Israel: When the land is divided among the twelve tribes of Israel, the Joseph tribe will receive two shares. Divide the land equally, because I promised your ancestors that this land would someday belong to their descendants. These are the borders of the land:
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔhyɛ bɛma ebiala deɛ ɔyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, ofikyɛ ndale ye nwo ndaen kyɛ ngɔfa ngɔma ɛmɔ nana mɔ, na aseɛ he kɔla berɛ kɔma ɛmɔ maa ɔkɔyɛ ɛmɔ agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: The northern border will begin at the Mediterranean Sea, then continue eastward to Hethlon, to Lebo-Hamath, then across to Zedad,
translation_verse: “Aseɛ ne, ye wɛen ɛhe: Ye sorɔ dɔ, ofi ɛpo piri ne, ɔnate Hetelon atee so bɔ ɔkwaafite Sedade,

english_verse: So the northern border will run between the Mediterranean Sea and Hazar-Enon, which is on the border between Damascus and Hamath.
translation_verse: Ɛwɛen ne fi ɛpo ne okodwu Hasa Enan, bɔ ɔwɔ Damasko sorɔ dɔ ɛwɛen so, ɔne Hamate sorɔ dɔ ɛwɛen ne aso. Ye sorɔ dɔ ɛwɛen ɛne.

english_verse: The eastern border will begin on the border between the two kingdoms of Hauran and Damascus. It will run south along the Jordan River, which separates the territories of Gilead and Israel, and it will end at the Dead Sea near the town of Tamar.
translation_verse: “Eyia afiteleɛ bue nu dɔ, ofi Hayuran ne Damasko ne Gileade, yeɛ ofi Yisrael aseɛ wɔ asue Yɔɔdan wɛen so, ɛ́mɔsusu befi ɛwɛen ne aso beedwu eyia afiteleɛ ɛpo ne; ɛhe yeɛ ɔte eyia afiteleɛ wɛen ɔ.

english_verse: The southern border will begin at Tamar, then run southwest to the springs near Meribath-Kadesh. It will continue along the Egyptian Gorge and will end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Ngwaen dɔ, ngwaen dɔ paa, ɛwɛen ne fi Tamar ɔkɔ alaa kodwu nzue bɔ ɔwɔ Meriba Kadese, na ɔfa Misraim bɔnza ne anwo kodwu ɛpo piri ne. Ngwaen dɔ ɛwɛen, wɔ ye ngwaen dɔ ɛne.

english_verse: The western border will run north along the Mediterranean Sea to a point just west of Lebo-Hamath.
translation_verse: “Eyia atɔleɛ bue nu dɔ ne, ɛpo piri ne kɔyɛ ɛwɛen maa okoodwu Hamate ndendeneɛ so. Eyia atɔleɛ ɛwɛen ɔ.

english_verse: That is the land to be divided among the tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: “Yiti ɛmɔhyɛ aseɛ he anu bɛfa, kyɛbɔ Yisrael mmusua kure nemɔ bɛte ɔ.

english_verse: It will belong to the Israelites and to any foreigners living among them whose children were born in Israel. These foreigners must be treated like any other Israelite citizen, and they will receive
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa serewagualɛ so bɛkyɛ maa ɔyɛ ɛmɔ agyapadeɛ, ɛmɔ ne amanvrafoɛ bɔ baatena ɛmɔ nu ná bawowo mmaa bagua ɛmɔ nu ne. Odi kyɛ ɛmɔbu bɛ kyɛ Yisrael mmaa bɔ bɛwole bɛ maen ne anu ne ala. Bɛ ne ɛmɔ yeɛ bekonya agyapadeɛ wɔ Yisrael mmusua kure nu ɔ.

english_verse: a share of the land given to the tribe where they live. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, abusua kure biala bɔ amanvraniɛ waatena nu ne, berɛ ala yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa ye agyapadeɛ bɛma ye ɔ, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: South of Judah's territory will be a special section of land. Its length will be twelve and a half kilometers, and its width will run from the eastern border of Israel west to the Mediterranean Sea. My temple will be located in this section of land.
translation_verse: “Bɔ ɔtoa Yuda aseɛ deɛ aso, ofi eyia afiteleɛ so kodwu eyia atɔleɛ so ne, ɔte aseɛ bɔ odi kyɛ ɛmɔpɛ bɛto berɛ ɔ. Odi kyɛ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu yɛ agyirɛ apee aburanyɔ ne nnu. Yeɛ ye tendenn nu, ofi eyia afiteleɛ kodwu eyia atɔleɛ so ne, odi kyɛ ɔne abusua biala ye aseɛ deɛ bɛyɛ pɛ; na ye afia berɛ yeɛ nekaa krongron ne kɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: An area in the center of this land will belong to me. It will be twelve and a half kilometers long and ten kilometers wide.
translation_verse: Aseɛ bɔ ɛmɔkɔpɛ bɛkɔto berɛ bɛkɔma AWURADE ne, odi kyɛ ye tendenn nu yɛ agyirɛ apee aburanyɔ ne nnu, yeɛ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu koso agyirɛ apee buru.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will give half of my sacred land to the priests. Their share will be twelve and a half kilometers long and five kilometers wide, and my temple will be right in the middle.
translation_verse: Aseɛ krongron ne, ɔkɔyɛ asɔfo nemɔ bɛ deɛ. Ye sorɔ dɔ tendenn nu kɔyɛ agyirɛ apee aburanyɔ ne nnu, eyia atɔleɛ bue nu dɔ tɛtrɛtɛɛ kɔyɛ agyirɛ apee buru, eyia afiteleɛ bue nu dɔ tɛtrɛtɛɛ kɔyɛ agyirɛ apee buru, yeɛ ye ngwaen dɔ tendenn nu kɔyɛ agyirɛ apee aburanyɔ ne nnu, bɔ AWURADE nekaa krongron ne kɔwa ye afia ɔ.

english_verse: Only priests who are descendants of Zadok will receive a share of this sacred land, because they remained faithful to me when the Levites and the rest of the Israelites started sinning.
translation_verse: Sɔ aseɛ ne kɔyɛ asɔfo mɔ bɔ basie bɛ nwo krongron ne bɛ deɛ, bɔ bɛ ole Sadoke boso ama nemɔ, bɔ bali me dwirɛ nwo nahorɛ, bɔ banni ye nwo makyebu wɔ mmerɛ bɔ Yisraelfoɛ belili ye nwo makyebu, kyɛbɔ Lewifoɛ belili ye nwo makyebu ne.

english_verse: The land belonging to the priests will be the most sacred area and will lie south of the area that belongs to the Levites.
translation_verse: Yiti b’aseɛ ne, ɔkɔyɛ aseɛ sonongo bɔ baye bafi aseɛ ne aso nekaa krongron ne anu ɔ, krongron nu krongron bɔ ɔne Lewifoɛ b’aseɛ bɔ wɛen ɔ.

english_verse: I will give the other half of my sacred land to the Levites. Their share will also be twelve and a half kilometers long and five kilometers wide,
translation_verse: Asɔfo nemɔ b’aseɛ ne, ye ngyɛnu berɛ, Lewifoɛ mɔ konya aseɛ bɔ ye tendenn nu te agyirɛ apee aburanyɔ ne nnu, bɔ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ apee buru ɔ. Ye tendenn amukoraa kɔyɛ agyirɛ apee aburanyɔ ne nnu, yeɛ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ apee buru.

english_verse: and they must never sell or trade any of this land—it is the best land and belongs to me.
translation_verse: Onni kyɛ bɛyɛ bie atɔen anaa bɛfa bɛsesã nikye; yeɛ onni kyɛ bɛma sɔ nekaa paa bɔ ɔwɔ aseɛ ne aso ne okodi ebie berɛ, ofikyɛ ɔte krongron ma AWURADE.

english_verse: South of my sacred land will be a section twelve and a half kilometers long and three kilometers wide. It will not be sacred, but will belong to the people of Israel and will include the city of Jerusalem, together with its houses and pastureland.
translation_verse: “Aseɛ ne bɔ waha ne, bɔ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ apee nnu, bɔ ye tendenn nu te agyirɛ apee aburanyɔ ne nnu ne, ɔkɔyɛ kuro berɛ aseɛ mbaen bie, nekaa bɔ bɛkɔtena ɔ, ɔne nekaa bɔ ngaka kɔhɔ adidie ɔ. Na kuro ne kɔwa ye afia.

english_verse: The land on the east and west sides of the city limits will be farmland for the people of Jerusalem; both sections will be five kilometers long and three kilometers wide.
translation_verse: Aseɛ bɔ waha bɔ ɔla aseɛ krongron ne ngyɛnu ne, ye eyia afiteleɛ so kɔyɛ agyirɛ apee buru, ye eyia atɔleɛ so kɔyɛ agyirɛ apee buru, na ɔkɔla aseɛ krongron ne ngyɛnu. So aleɛ yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ kuro berɛ adwumayɔlɛfoɛ b’aleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: People from the city will farm the land, no matter which tribe they belong to.
translation_verse: Na kuro berɛ adwumayɔlɛfoɛ, bɔ befi Yisrael mmusua kure amukoraa nu yeɛ bɛkɔyɔ adwuma ɔ.

english_verse: And so the center of this special section of land will be for my sacred land, as well as for the city and its property. The land will be a square, twelve and a half kilometers on each side.
translation_verse: Na sɔ aseɛ ne bɔ ɛmɔkɔpɛ bɛkɔto berɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɔyɛ ahinanan, bɔ ye bue ko biala te agyirɛ apee aburanyɔ ne nnu ɔ. Odi kyɛ ɛmɔpɛ aseɛ krongron ne ɔne kuro deɛ ne bɛto berɛ.

english_verse: The regions east and west of this square of land will belong to the ruler of Israel. His property will run east to the Jordan River and west to the Mediterranean Sea. In the very center of his property will be my sacred land, as well as the temple,
translation_verse: Na aseɛ bɔ waha berɛ bɔ ɔla aseɛ krongron ne bue nyɔ ne anwo, ɔne bɔ ɔla kuro deɛ ne anwo ne, ɔte ɛhene ne deɛ. Aseɛ bɔ ɔla aseɛ krongron ne anwo ne, ɔtrɛ fi agyirɛ apee aburanyɔ ne nnu okodwu eyia afiteleɛ ɛwɛen ne; yeɛ ɔtrɛ agyirɛ apee aburanyɔ ne nnu okodwu eyia atɔleɛ ɛwɛen ne; ɔwɔ mmusua kure nemɔ bɛ kyɛfa ne ndendeneɛ so, na ɔkɔyɛ ɛhene ne deɛ. Aseɛ krongron ne, yeɛ awuro berɛ nekaa krongron ne, bɛkɔwa ye afia.

english_verse: together with the share belonging to the Levites and the city of Jerusalem. The northern border of the ruler's property will be the land that belongs to Judah, and the southern border will be the land that belongs to Benjamin. The Division of Land among Tribes in the South The Lord God said:
translation_verse: Yiti Lewifoɛ b’aseɛ ne kuro berɛ aseɛ ne, bɛkɔla ɛhene n’aseɛ deɛ n’afia. Na ɛhene ne, ye aseɛ deɛ kɔla Yuda wɛen ne Benyamin wɛen deɛ b’afia.

english_verse: Gad's southern border is also the southern border of Israel. It will begin at the town of Tamar, then run southwest to the springs near Meribath-Kadesh. It will continue along the Egyptian Gorge and end at the Mediterranean Sea.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔtoa Gade aseɛ deɛ aso wɔ ngwaen dɔ, ye ngwaen dɔ paa ne, ɛwɛen ne fi Tamar ɔkɔ alaa kodwu nzue bɔ ɔwɔ Meriba Kadese, na ɔfa Misraim bɔnza ne anwo kodwu ɛpo piri ne.

english_verse: That's how the land of Israel will be divided among the twelve tribes. I, the Lord God, have spoken. The Gates of Jerusalem The Lord said:
translation_verse: Sɔ aseɛ ne yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa serewagualɛ so bɛkyɛ bɛma Yisrael mmusua kure mɔ maa ɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ ɔ, na ebiala bue deɛ bɔ okonya ye hɔ ɛne, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne. Kuro berɛ anoa mbiri nemɔ

english_verse: and so the total length of the wall will be ten kilometers. The new name of the city will be “The-Lord-Is-Here!”
translation_verse: Ɛpɛ kuro ne anwo kango bra yia a, ɔte agyirɛ apee buru ne mmɔtwɛ. Na ofi sɔ kyẽa ne bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, kuro ne dumaa li: “AWURADE wɔ berɛ.”

english_verse: In the third year that Jehoiakim was king of Judah, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylonia attacked Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yuda hene Yehoakim ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne anu, Babilɔn hene Nebukadenesa wale Yerusalem ootuale kuro ne.

english_verse: The Lord let Nebuchadnezzar capture Jehoiakim and take away some of the things used in God's temple. And when the king returned to Babylonia, he put these things in the temple of his own god.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE fale Yuda hene Yehoakim wurale ye sa, bɔ Nyameɛ awuro berɛ nningyein ne biemɔ boka so ɔ. Ɔsesale nningyein ne wale ye bosoen awuro wɔ Sinari aseɛ so, na ɔfale nningyein ne ooguale ye bosoen awuro berɛ nekaa bɔ besie nningyein ne.

english_verse: One day the king ordered Ashpenaz, his highest palace official, to choose some young men from the royal family of Judah and from other leading Jewish families.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana Nebukadenesa sele ye sayɛɛ panyi Asepenase kyɛ ɔyeye Yisraelfoɛ ne biemɔ, bɔ bɛte ahemvo mɔ bɛ bosofoɛ ɔne atitirefoɛ ɔ,

english_verse: The king said, “They must be healthy, handsome, smart, wise, educated, and fit to serve in the royal palace. Teach them how to speak and write our language
translation_verse: mmerandeɛ bɔ bellili nnɛen ɔ, anwonyemenefoɛ bɔ bɛse nworɛ, bɔ nimdeɛ ali bɛ ti, bɔ bɛkɔhora bekosua nwomaa, bɔ bɛkɔhora bɛkɔyɔ ɛsolɛ adwuma wɔ Nana ahemvie ɔ, ná ohyirehyire bɛ Kaldeafoɛ dwudwolɛ ne ye hyerɛlɛ.

english_verse: and give them the same food and wine that I am served. Train them for three years, and then they can become court officials.”
translation_verse: Na Nana hyehyɛle kyɛ ɛlɛho biala, odi kyɛ bɛma bɛ ye aleɛ bɔ odi, ɔne ye nzaa bɔ ɔno ne bie; kyɛ bɛ́tete bɛ afoɛ nza, na beyie a, ye si ye baagyina Nana nyunu baso ye.

english_verse: Four of the young Jews chosen were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, all from the tribe of Judah.
translation_verse: Bɛ nu biemɔ ole: Daniel, Hanania, Misael ne Asaria bɔ befi Yuda abusua kure nu ɔ.

english_verse: But the king's chief official gave them Babylonian names: Daniel became Belteshazzar, Hananiah became Shadrach, Mishael became Meshach, and Azariah became Abednego.
translation_verse: Yeɛ sayɛɛ panyi ne totole bɛ dumaa: Ɔtole Daniel dumaa Beltesasa, ɔtole Hanania dumaa Sadrake, ɔtole Misael dumaa Mesake, yeɛ ɔtole Asaria dumaa Abedinego.

english_verse: Daniel made up his mind to eat and drink only what God had approved for his people to eat. And he asked the king's chief official for permission not to eat the food and wine served in the royal palace.
