translation_verse: Nakoso Daniel yɛle ye adwene kyɛ ongoli Nana aleɛ ngɔno ye nzaa ne, ná ɔngɔfa ngogua ye nwo fiɛ. Yiti ɔsrɛle sayɛɛ panyi ne kyɛ ɔma ye ate, amaa ɔnate so wangua ye nwo fiɛ.

english_verse: God had made the official friendly and kind to Daniel.
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ mane sayɛɛ panyi ne lole Daniel onwuni ye anwumvoin.

english_verse: But the man still told him, “The king has decided what you must eat and drink. And I am afraid he will kill me, if you eat something else and end up looking worse than the other young men.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ sayɛɛ panyi ne sele Daniel kyɛ, “Mesuro me mene Nana bɔ wahyire aleɛ horɛ ne anonneɛ horɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛma ɛmɔ ne, ofikyɛ annea a né wanwu kyɛ ɛmɔ nyunu ayɛ bosabosaa watra mmerandeɛ bɔ ɛmɔ ne bɛ bɛbɔ tipɛen ne. Na ɔnate so ɛmɔkɔma Nana kɔte me ti kofi so.”

english_verse: The king's official had put a guard in charge of Daniel and his three friends. So Daniel said to the guard,
translation_verse: Yeɛ Daniel sele neafoɛ bɔ sayɛɛ panyi ne aye ye kyɛ ɔnea ye Daniel, Hanania, Misael ne Asaria so ne kyɛ,

english_verse: “For the next ten days, let us have only vegetables and water at mealtime.
translation_verse: “Mesrɛ wɔ, maa bɛma yɛ nyaanyaa ma yɛli ɔne nzue ma yɛno sɔ alaa eleburu, ná wɔ de nea kyɛbɔ wɔ somvoɛ mɔ bekosi bɛkɔyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When the ten days are up, compare how we look with the other young men, and decide what to do with us.”
translation_verse: Na afei yɛ sonaluwaa ne, fa toto mmerandeɛ bɔ bedi Nana aleɛ ne bie ne, bɛ deɛ nwo nea. Na afei gyina bɔ ekonwu ye ne aso maa ohyire kyɛbɔ ekosi kɔnea yɛ, wɔ somvoɛ mɔ yɛ so ɔ.”

english_verse: The guard agreed to do what Daniel had asked.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔpenene bɛ nzusuleɛ ne aso, na ɔmaa bɛfale sɔ tebea ne anu ɔneane alaa eleburu.

english_verse: Ten days later, Daniel and his friends looked healthier and better than the young men who had been served food from the royal palace.
translation_verse: Na eleburu ne dwuli nen, né bayɛ branoa tukutukuu batra mmerandeɛ amukoraa bɔ belili Nana aleɛ ne bie ne.

english_verse: After this, the guard let them eat vegetables instead of the rich food and wine.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate sɔ ati, somvoɛ ne amva aleɛ bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ bedi, ɔne nzaa bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛno ne wamma bɛ, na mmom ɔmane bɛ nyaanyaa.

english_verse: God made the four young men smart and wise. They read a lot of books and became well educated. Daniel could also tell the meaning of dreams and visions.
translation_verse: Na sɔ mmerandeɛ nna hemɔ de, Nyameɛ mane bɛ nimdeɛ ne ndeaseɛ wɔ nwomaasualɛ ne nworɛ amukoraa nu, na Daniel nyane nyekyire ne laleɛ mukoraa nu ndeaseɛ.

english_verse: At the end of the three-year period set by King Nebuchadnezzar, his chief palace official brought all the young men to him.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ Nana Nebukadenesa hyɛle kyɛ, sɛ odwu a bɛfa bɛ bɛbra ne odwuli nen, sayɛɛ panyi ne fale bɛ hɔle Nebukadenesa nyunu.

english_verse: The king interviewed them and discovered that none of the others were as outstanding as Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. So they were given positions in the royal court.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana ne bɛ lili ngɔmɔ, na onwuni kyɛ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ Daniel, Hanania, Misael ne Asaria wɔ bɛ mukoraa bɛ nu ɔ; yiti bɛmaa begyinane Nana nyunu bɛsole ye.

english_verse: From then on, whenever the king asked for advice, he found their wisdom was ten times better than that of any of his other advisors and magicians.
translation_verse: Na nworɛ dwirɛ ne edwirɛ bɔ ɔkye adwene biala bɔ Nana bisale bɛ ne, onwuni kyɛ bɛ mmuayɛɛ ne, ɔbo ngonyaayelɛfoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛnea nzramaa nu bɛkã nu dwirɛ amukoraa, bɔ bɛwɔ ye ahennie ne amukoraa nu ɔ bɛ deɛ so pɛen buru.

english_verse: Daniel served there until the first year of King Cyrus.
translation_verse: Na Daniel tenane berɛ maa oodwuli Nana Karose ahennie afoɛ bɔ oli moa ne.

english_verse: During the second year that Nebuchadnezzar was king, he had such horrible nightmares that he could not sleep.
translation_verse: Nebukadenesa ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu ne, ɔhyehyene laleɛ mɔ, na ɔhale ye sunzum, na nnafelɛ fili ye nye so.

english_verse: and said, “I am disturbed by a dream that I don't understand, and I want you to explain it.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana sele bɛ kyɛ, “Mahye laleɛ bie; ɔha me sunzum, bɔ mepena kyɛ mekaye laleɛ ne ná mete ye bo ɔ.”

english_verse: They answered in Aramaic, “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever! We are your servants. Please tell us your dream, and we will explain what it means.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Kaldeafoɛ nemɔ buale Nana wɔ Aramaeke dwudwolɛ nu kyɛ, “Nana, wɔ ngoa so oo! Wɔ somvoɛ mɔ, kã laleɛ ne yɛ, na yɛkohyire ye bo.”

english_verse: But the king replied, “No! I have made up my mind. If you don't tell me both the dream and its meaning, you will be chopped to pieces and your houses will be torn down.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana buale Kaldeafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Me de, edwirɛ bɔ mahã ne ala yeɛ mahã ɔ: Sɛ ɛmɔanga laleɛ ne bangyire me, ná ɛmɔangyire me ye bo a, ngɔmaa bɛkɔtete ɛmɔ nu pasapasa, yeɛ bɛkɔkakyi ɛmɔ awuro mɔ fofoɛ so.

english_verse: However, if you do tell me both the dream and its meaning, you will be greatly rewarded and highly honored. Now tell me the dream and explain what it means.”
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔkã laleɛ ne bekyire me, ná ɛmɔkyire me ye bo a, ye de ɛmɔkonya me berɛ akyɛdeɛ, akatuaa ne anidie kandinga. Yiti laleɛ ne, ɛmɔhã behyire me, ná ɛmɔhyire me ye bo.”

english_verse: “Your Majesty,” they said, “if you will only tell us your dream, we will interpret it for you.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ bebuale bieku kyɛ, “Nana, wɔ somvoɛ mɔ, kã laleɛ ne kyire yɛ, na yɛkohyire ye bo.”

english_verse: because you know what's going to happen if you don't come up with the answer. You've decided to make up a bunch of lies, hoping I might change my mind. Now tell me the dream, and that will prove that you can interpret it.”
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔanga laleɛ ne bangyire me a, edwirɛ bɔ mahã ne ala yeɛ ɔkɔto ɛmɔ ɔ. Ofikyɛ nnakannaka ne ngondombo yeɛ ɛmɔayɛ ɛmɔ adwene kyɛ ɛmɔkɔhã ye wɔ me nyunu, kɔpem mmerɛ bɔ ngɔsesã m’adwene ɔ. Yiti ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔhã laleɛ ne behyire me, na sɔ kɔmaa ngonwu ye kyɛ ɛmɔkɔhora bekohyire me ye bo.”

english_verse: His advisors explained, “Your Majesty, you are demanding the impossible! No king, not even the most famous and powerful, has ever ordered his advisors, magicians, or wise men to do such a thing.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Kaldeafoɛ nemɔ buale Nana kyɛ, “Ebiala nne aseɛ ye aso bɔ ɔkɔhora konya Nana dwirɛ ne anwo adwene ɔ; ofikyɛ edwirɛ sɔaa de, ɛhene, anaa meneɛ, anaa maenbulɛniɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ wafa wato ngonyaayelɛniɛ, anaa sona bɔ ɔnea nzramaa nu ɔkã nu dwirɛ, anaa Kaldeaniɛ biala nyunu le kyɛ ohyire ye bo ɔ.

english_verse: This made the king so angry that he gave orders for every wise man in Babylonia to be put to death, including Daniel and his three friends. God Tells Nebuchadnezzar's Dream to Daniel
translation_verse: Yiti ɔhyɛle mmeraa kyɛ behũhũ nworɛfoɛ nemɔ, na mmenia hɔle kyɛ bɛkwaapena Daniel ne ye mmango nemɔ abo so beku bɛ.

english_verse: Arioch was the king's official in charge of putting the wise men to death. He was on his way to have it done, when Daniel very wisely went to him
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana awɛmvoɛ nemɔ so safohene Arioke bɔ né wafite kyɛ ɔkwaahuhu Babilɔn nworɛfoɛ nemɔ nen, Daniel le nworɛ ne anidie ɔne ye bedwudwole.

english_verse: and asked, “Why did the king give such cruel orders?” After Arioch explained what had happened,
translation_verse: Obisale Nana safohene Arioke kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ Nana ahyɛ mmeraa suronyisuronyi sɔaa ɔ?” Yeɛ Arioke hane edwirɛ ne hyirele Daniel.

english_verse: Daniel rushed off and said to the king, “If you will just give me some time, I'll explain your dream.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Daniel hɔle Nana berɛ ɔɔsrɛle ye kyɛ ɔma ye mmerɛ, amaa ɔnate so wahyire Nana laleɛ ne abo wahyire ye.

english_verse: Daniel returned home and told his three friends.
translation_verse: Afei Daniel hɔle ye awuro, ɔɔbɔle ye mmango Hanania, Misael ne Asaria amaneɛ,

english_verse: Then he said, “Pray that the God who rules from heaven will be merciful and explain this mystery, so that we and the others won't be put to death.”
translation_verse: na osele bɛ kyɛ bɛsrɛ nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne ma onwu bɛ anwumvoin wɔ sɔ mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ he anwo, amaa ɔnate so bamva ye Daniel ne ye mmango nemɔ bamvra Babilɔn nworɛfoɛ nemɔ aso banguku bɛ.

english_verse: In a vision one night, Daniel was shown the dream and its meaning. Then he praised the God who rules from heaven:
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nyameɛ lale mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne ali hyirele Daniel wɔ kɔngɔen nyekyire nu. Na Daniel hyɛle nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne animnyam.

english_verse: “Our God, your name will be praised forever and forever. You are all-powerful, and you know everything.
translation_verse: Na Daniel sele kyɛ, “Animnyam hã Nyameɛ dumaa afebɔɔ, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ nworɛ ne tumi te ye deɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You control human events— you give rulers their power and take it away, and you are the source of wisdom and knowledge.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔsakyera mmerɛ ne ngyẽa nu ɔ, otu ahemvo mɔ bia so, yeɛ ɔfa ahemvo mɔ sie bia so; ɔma nworɛfoɛ benwu nworɛ, na ɔma bɛ bɔ b’adwene nu pi ɔ benya nimdeɛ;

english_verse: “You explain deep mysteries, because even the dark is light to you.
translation_verse: ɔda edwirɛ bɔ nu pi ɔ, ɔne mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ali, ɔse bɔ ɔwɔ awosii nu ɔ, na kanea ne ye yeɛ bɛte ɔ.

english_verse: You are the God who was worshiped by my ancestors. Now I thank you and praise you for making me wise and telling me the king's dream, together with its meaning.” Daniel Interprets the Dream
translation_verse: O, me nana mɔ Nyameɛ, meyɛ wɔ mmo meye wɔ ayɛ, kyɛ ama me nworɛ ne tumi, ná afei ala bɔ yasrɛ wɔ ne ali ahyire me ɔ, ofikyɛ ala Nana laleɛ ne ali ahyire yɛ.” Daniel kyire laleɛ ne abo

english_verse: Daniel went back to Arioch, the official in charge of executing the wise men. Daniel said, “Don't kill those men! Take me to the king, and I will explain the meaning of his dream.”
translation_verse: Afei Daniel hɔle Arioke bɔ Nana afa awura ye sa kyɛ ohũhũ Babilɔn nworɛfoɛ nemɔ ne berɛ, na oosele ye kyɛ, “Nnɛkũkũ Babilɔn nworɛfoɛ nemɔ! Fa me kɔ Nana nyunu, na ngohyire Nana laleɛ ne abo ngohyire ye.”

english_verse: Arioch rushed Daniel to the king and announced, “Your Majesty, I have found out that one of the men brought here from Judah can explain your dream.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Arioke yɛle ndɛndɛ fale Daniel hɔle Nana nyunu, na osele ye kyɛ, “Nana, mmenia bɔ bɛhyele bɛ nnure befili Yuda bɛwale ne, manya bɛ nu bienzua ko bɔ okohyire wɔ laleɛ ne abo ɔ.”

english_verse: The king asked Daniel, “Can you tell me my dream and what it means?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana bisale Daniel bɔ osa li Beltesasa ne kyɛ, “Ɛkɔhora kɔhã laleɛ horɛ bɔ ngyene ne, ná ekosa kohyire ye bo kohyire me?”

english_verse: Daniel answered: Your Majesty, not even the smartest person in all the world can do what you are demanding.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Daniel buale wɔ Nana nyunu berɛ kyɛ, “Nana, mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ bɔ abisa ye, nworɛfoɛ, bɛ bɔ bɛnea nzramaa nu bɛkã nu dwirɛ, ngonyaayelɛfoɛ anaa benewaafoɛ biala ngɔhora ngohyire wɔ ye bo;

english_verse: But the God who rules from heaven can explain mysteries. And while you were sleeping, he showed you what will happen in the future.
translation_verse: Nana, mmerɛ bɔ né ɛla wɔ bɛen so ne, bɔ kyẽa bie okosi ɔ nwo adwene wale wɔ ti anu, na bɔ ɔda mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ali ne yeɛ waye bɔ ɔbaasi ɔ wahyire wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: However, you must realize that these mysteries weren't explained to me because I am smarter than everyone else. Instead, it was done so that you would understand what you have seen.
translation_verse: Na me de, nna kyɛ nworɛ yeɛ mese metra ateasefoɛ amukoraa ti ɔ, yeɛ ɔmaa ɔnate so waye sɔ mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ he wahyire me ɔ. Na mmom, Nana, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ bekohyire ye bo bekohyire wɔ, ná afei ate edwirɛ bɔ ɔwale wɔ ti anu ne abo ti ɔ.

english_verse: Your Majesty, what you saw standing in front of you was a huge and terrifying statue, shining brightly.
translation_verse: “Nana, yieee, enwuni sonaluwaa kandinga bie. Sɔ sonaluwaa kandinga bɔ né wata hyireinn ne, né ogyi wɔ nyunu berɛ, na né ɔyɛ suro.

english_verse: Its head was made of gold, its chest and arms were silver, and from its waist down to its knees, it was bronze.
translation_verse: Sonaluwaa ne, ye ti ne te sikaa kɔkorɛ paa, ye hue ne ye sa te dwetɛ, ye ko ne ye sɔ te kɔɔbere,

english_verse: From there to its ankles it was iron, and its feet were a mixture of iron and clay.
translation_verse: ye gya te buralɛ, na ye gya tasaa ne, ye bue te buralɛ, yeɛ ye bue koso te ɛfaa.

english_verse: As you watched, a stone was cut from a mountain—but not by human hands. The stone struck the feet, completely shattering the iron and clay.
translation_verse: Na egu so bɔ ɛnea ne, nyɔboɛ bie bɔ nna sona sa yeɛ ofindini ye ɔ, ɔte ɔɔbɔle sonaluwaa ne gya tasaa bɔ ɔte buralɛ ne ɛfaa ne, na obubuli ye nyokonyoko.

english_verse: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were crushed and blown away without a trace, like husks of wheat at threshing time. But the stone became a tremendous mountain that covered the entire earth.
translation_verse: Afei buralɛ ne, ɛfaa ne, kɔɔbere ne, ɛdwetɛ ne ne sikaa kɔkorɛ ne, bɛ nu bubuli nyokonyoko komapɛ, na bɛyɛle kyɛ ahuhuro mmerɛ nu afafu bɔ ɔwɔ nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo ɔ; na mvrama bɔle bɛ hɔle bɔ bɛ boso minini ɔ. Nakoso nyɔboɛ bɔ ɔɔbɔle sonaluwaa ne de, ɔyɛle bokaa kandinga, na oyili aseɛ so tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: That was the dream, and now I'll tell you what it means.
translation_verse: “Laleɛ ne ɛne; na afei Nana, yɛbaahyire ye bo yɛkyire wɔ.

english_verse: Your Majesty, you are the greatest of kings, and God has highly honored you with power
translation_verse: Wɔ, Nana, ɛte ahemvo mɔ bɛ nu hene bɔ nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne wafa ahennie, tumi, anwoserɛ ne animnyam wama wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: After you are gone, another kingdom will rule, but it won't be as strong. Then it will be followed by a kingdom of bronze that will rule the whole world.
translation_verse: Efi berɛ a, ahennie bieku bɔ ye tumi ndwu wɔ deɛ ne ɔ kodwɔso; yeɛ afei ahennie bieku bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ɔ kɔwa bɔ ye ole kɔɔbere ne, na okoli hene wɔ aseɛ so amukoraa.

english_verse: This fourth kingdom will be divided—it will be both strong and brittle, just as you saw that the feet and toes were a mixture of iron and clay.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ ye gya mmɛseka bue te buralɛ, ná ye bue koso te ɛfaa ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ahennie ne bue bie nwo kɔyɛ se, ná ye bue bie koso kɔyɛ mmerɛ ɔ.

english_verse: This kingdom will be the result of a marriage between kingdoms, but it will crumble, just as iron and clay don't stick together.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ enwuni kyɛ buralɛ ne ɛfaa bali afra ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛ ne mmenia bekoli afra ɔ, nakoso bɛngɔmatamata so, kyɛbɔ buralɛ ne ɛfaa benni afra ne.

english_verse: During the time of those kings, the God who rules from heaven will set up an eternal kingdom that will never fall. It will be like the stone that was cut from the mountain, but not by human hands—the stone that crushed the iron, bronze, clay, silver, and gold. Your Majesty, in your dream the great God has told you what is going to happen, and you can trust this interpretation. Daniel Is Promoted
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ enwuni kyɛ nyɔboɛ bie, bɔ nna sona sa yeɛ ofindini ye ɔ, ɔte ofili bokaa so wale, bɔ obubuli buralɛ ne, kɔɔbere ne, ɛfaa ne, ɛdwetɛ ne ne sikaa kɔkorɛ ne nyokonyoko nen, Nana, sɔ ala yeɛ Nyameɛ piri ne waye bɔ kyẽa bie ɔbaasi ɔ wahyire wɔ ɔ. Laleɛ ne te nahorɛ, na ye bo hyirelɛ ne koso te turoloo.”

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar bowed low to the ground and worshiped Daniel. Then he gave orders for incense to be burned and a sacrifice of grain to be offered in honor of Daniel.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana Nebukadenesa fale ye nyunu butuli berɛ, ɔfale anidie mane Daniel, na ɔhyɛle kyɛ bɛbɔ aleɛ afɔleɛ ne ɛyɛɛ afɔleɛ bɛma Daniel.

english_verse: The king said, “Now I know that your God is above all other gods and kings, because he gave you the power to explain this mystery.”
translation_verse: Afei ɛhene ne sele Daniel kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu, ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔte nyameɛ mɔ nu Nyameɛ ne ahemvo mɔ nu Meneɛ, ɔne Nyameɛ bɔ ɔda mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ali ɔ, ofikyɛ ahora ala sɔ mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ he ali.”

english_verse: The king then presented Daniel with a lot of gifts; he promoted him to governor of Babylon Province and put him in charge of the other wise men.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɛhene ne bɔle Daniel aba so piri paa, na ɔmane ye akyɛdeɛ bɔ bedi mu ɔ pee, na ɔmaa ɔlale Babilɔn maen ne amukoraa noa, na ɔbɔle ye Babilɔn nworɛfoɛ amukoraa bɛ so panyi paa.

english_verse: At Daniel's request, the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to high positions in Babylon Province, and he let Daniel stay on as a palace official.
translation_verse: Afei Daniel srɛle ɛhene ne maa ɔfale Sadrake, Mesake ne Abedinego yɛle Babilɔn maen ne anu amukoraa so neafoɛ; na Daniel de, ɔtenane Nana ahemvie berɛ.

english_verse: and the king's high officials, governors, and advisors all crowded around them. The men were not burned, their hair wasn't scorched, and their clothes didn't even smell like smoke.
translation_verse: Yeɛ mbɔtam mbanyi, mbanyi, amrado mɔ ne Nana foɛtulɛfoɛ mɔ bɛbɔle nu bɛɛneane, na benwuni kyɛ see ne wannya sɔ mmenia nemɔ nwonaen so tumi, bɛ ti nwiaa anyera, b’ataadeɛ ne anyɛ hoyaa, yeɛ nwosina po mmo bɛ nwo.

english_verse: and he commanded his governors, advisors, treasurers, judges, and his other officials to come from everywhere in his kingdom to the dedication of the statue.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana Nebukadenesa somane maa bɛɛfale mbɔtam mbanyi, mbanyi mɔ, amrado mɔ, foɛtulɛfoɛ, fotoɛsoneafoɛ, badwafoɛ, ndɛenbualɛfoɛ ne mbɔtam nemɔ aso mbanyi amukoraa, kyɛ amoen bɔ Nana Nebukadenesa wagyina bɔ ɔbaala ye ali ne, bɛbra berɛ bie.

english_verse: Then an official stood up and announced: People of every nation and race, now listen to the king's command!
translation_verse: Yeɛ dawurebɔlɛniɛ ne teane nu serɛserɛ kyɛ, “Maen maen mɔ ee, mmenia ne edwudwolɛ mɔ ee, ahyɛdeɛ ne ole kyɛ,

english_verse: Trumpets, flutes, harps, and all other kinds of musical instruments will soon start playing. When you hear the music, you must bow down and worship the statue that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔte awɛen, dodobɛen, sangoo, bɛnda, atɛndɛbɛn, kyenneɛ ne sangoo ahoroɔ nga a, odi kyɛ ɛmɔbutu berɛ bɛsɔne amoen bɔ Nana Nebukadenesa wagyina ne.

english_verse: Some Babylonians used this as a chance to accuse the Jews to King Nebuchadnezzar.
translation_verse: Na sɔ mmerɛ ne, Kaldeafoɛ biemɔ bɛɛbɔle Yudafoɛ mɔ kwaadu yeayea.

english_verse: They said, “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever!
translation_verse: Besele Nana Nebukadenesa kyɛ, “Nana, wɔ ngoa so oo!

english_verse: You commanded everyone to bow down and worship the gold statue when the music played.
translation_verse: Nana, ahyɛ mmeraa kyɛ, sona biala bɔ ɔkɔte awɛen, dodobɛen, sangoo, bɛnda, atɛndɛbɛn, kyenneɛ ne sangoo ahoroɔ nga nen, odi kyɛ obutu berɛ sɔne sikaa kɔkorɛ amoen ne;

english_verse: And you said that anyone who did not bow down and worship it would be thrown into a flaming furnace.
translation_verse: na ebiala bɔ wammutu berɛ wanzɔne ye ne, odi kyɛ befindi ye bɛto see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi wɔ foonoo nu ne anu.

english_verse: Sir, you appointed three men to high positions in Babylon Province, but they have disobeyed you. Those Jews, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, refuse to worship your gods and the statue you have set up.”
translation_verse: Nana, Yudafoɛ biemɔ wɔ berɛ bɔ atu bɛ asie berɛ kyɛ bɛnea Babilɔn maen ne aso ɔ, bɔ bɛ ole Sadrake, Mesake ne Abedinego ɔ. Nana, sɔ mmenia nemɔ bɛmva wɔ dwirɛ bɛnyɛ huu oo; bɛnzɔne wɔ nyameɛ nemɔ, yeɛ bɛnzɔne sikaa kɔkorɛ amoen bɔ agyina ne.”

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar was furious. So he sent for the three young men and said,
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nebukadenesa fɛle yaa hahii hyɛle kyɛ bɛɛfa Sadrake, Mesake ne Abedinego bɛbra. Na bɛɛfale sɔ mmenia ne bɛwale Nana nyunu.

english_verse: “I hear that you refuse to worship my gods and the gold statue I have set up.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nebukadenesa bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ, Sadrake, Mesake ne Abedinego, aso ɔte nahorɛ kyɛ ɛmɔnzɔne me nyameɛ nemɔ, yeɛ ɛmɔnzɔne sikaa kɔkorɛ amoen bɔ magyina ne koso?

english_verse: Now I am going to give you one more chance. If you bow down and worship the statue when you hear the music, everything will be all right. But if you don't, you will at once be thrown into a flaming furnace. No god can save you from me.”
translation_verse: Afei de, sɛ ɛmɔaboaboa ɛmɔ nwo kyɛ sɛ ɛmɔte awɛen, dodobɛen, sangoo, bɛnda, atɛndɛbɛn, kyenneɛ ne sangoo ahoroɔ nga a, ɛmɔkobutu berɛ bɛkɔsɔne amoen bɔ magyina ne a, ye de ɛmɔ nwo sonn. Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔanzɔne ye de a, ye de bekofindi ɛmɔ bekogua see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi wɔ foonoo nu ne anu; na nyameɛ beni yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔpepɛ kole ɛmɔ kofi me sa nu ɔ?”

english_verse: The three men replied, “Your Majesty, we don't need to defend ourselves.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Sadrake, Mesake ne Abedinego buale Nana kyɛ, “Nana Nebukadenesa, Onhia kyɛ yɛma wɔ mmuayɛɛ wɔ sɔ dwirɛ he anwo ɔ.

english_verse: But even if he doesn't, we still won't worship your gods and the gold statue you have set up.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Nana, sɛ wanne yɛ po a, yɛ́maa enwu ye kyɛ yɛngɔso wɔ nyameɛ nemɔ, yeɛ yɛngɔsɔne sikaa kɔkorɛ amoen bɔ agyina ne.”

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar's face twisted with anger at the three men. And he ordered the furnace to be heated seven times hotter than usual.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nebukadenesa fɛle yaa hahii, na omunane Sadrake, Mesake ne Abedinego so paa. Na ɔhyɛle kyɛ behua foonoo see ne anu paa ma nu ɔyɛ hye pɛen nzoo ɔtra kyɛbɔ ɔyɛ a ye hyerɛ te ne.

english_verse: Next, he commanded some of his strongest soldiers to tie up the men and throw them into the flaming furnace.
translation_verse: Afei ɔhyɛle ye asraafoɛ mmienzua anwoserɛfoɛ nemɔ bie, kyɛ bɛkyekye Sadrake, Mesake ne Abedinego bɛfa bɛ beegua see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi wɔ foonoo nu ne anu.

english_verse: The king wanted it done at that very moment. So the soldiers tied up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego and threw them into the flaming furnace with all of their clothes still on, including their turbans. The fire was so hot that flames leaped out and killed the soldiers.
translation_verse: Na sɔ mmienzua nza ne, bɔ bɛ ole Sadrake, Mesake ne Abedinego bɔ né bakyekye bɛ ne, bɛte beguale see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi wɔ foonoo nu ne anu.

english_verse: Suddenly the king jumped up and shouted, “Weren't only three men tied up and thrown into the fire?” “Yes, Your Majesty,” his officers answered.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɔyɛle Nana Nebukadenesa nwanwa, na odwɔsole ndɛndɛ so, na obisale ye foɛtulɛfoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Aso nna mmienzua nza yeɛ yɛkyekyele bɛ yɛgyili bɛ yɛguale see ne anu ɔ?” Yeɛ bebuale Nana kyɛ, “Nana, ɔte nahorɛ.”

english_verse: “But I see four men walking around in the fire,” the king replied. “None of them is tied up or harmed, and the fourth one looks like a god.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ osele kyɛ, “Nakoso menwu mmenia nna bɔ basangye bɛ ɔ bɔ bɛnatenate see ne anu ɔ. Nikye fee ɔyyɔle bɛ, na ko bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne de, ye sue te kyɛ nyameɛ mɔ bɛ wa bie.”

english_verse: Nebuchadnezzar went closer to the flaming furnace and said to the three young men, “You servants of the Most High God, come out at once!” They came out,
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nebukadenesa pingyele see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi wɔ foonoo ne anu ne, na osele kyɛ, “Sadrake, Mesake ne Abedinego, Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ye somvoɛ mɔ, ɛ́mɔfi nu béfite bɛbra!” Yeɛ Sadrake, Mesake ne Abedinego befili see ne anu befitele.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar said: Praise their God for sending an angel to rescue his servants! They trusted their God and refused to obey my commands. Yes, they chose to die rather than to worship or serve any god except their own.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nebukadenesa sele kyɛ, “Sadrake, Mesake ne Abedinego Nyameɛ bɔ wasoma ye abɔfo maa waapepɛ wale ye somvoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛfale bɛ wora bewurale ye nu ne, animnyam hã ye. Bɛ yeɛ behwi bɛfale me, Nana, me mmeraa so ɔ, na bɛfale bɛ ngoa bɛtole serewa, bɔ banzo anaa banzɔne nyameɛ biala ɔ, sana bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: And I won't allow people of any nation or race to say anything against their God. Anyone who does will be chopped up and their houses will be torn down, because no other god has such great power to save.
translation_verse: Yiti, méhyɛ mmeraa kyɛ, maen, mmenia anaa edwudwolɛ biala bɔ ɔkɔhã dwirɛ kotia Sadrake, Mesake ne Abedinego Nyameɛ ne nen, ngɔmaa bɛkɔtete ye nu pasapasa, na bɛkɔfa ye awuro bɛkɔkakyi fofoɛ; ofikyɛ nyameɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔkora pepɛ de sona sɔaa ɔ.”

english_verse: After this happened, the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to even higher positions in Babylon Province.
translation_verse: Afei ɛhene ne mane Sadrake, Mesake ne Abedinego dibea piri paa wɔ Babilɔn aseɛ so.

english_verse: King Nebuchadnezzar sent the following letter to the people of all nations and races on the earth: Greetings to all of you!
translation_verse: Nana Nebukadenesa noa dwirɛ bɔ ɔfa kɔma maen maen amukoraa, mmenia mukoraa ne edwudwolɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ so ne, ye ɛhe: Ngɔsoɛ pee ɔbra ɛmɔ asetena oo!

english_verse: I am glad to tell about the wonderful miracles God Most High has done for me.
translation_verse: Nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ bɔ Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne wayɔ wama me ne, ɔyɛ me fɛ kyɛ ngɔfa ngɔto dwaa ɔ.

english_verse: His miracles are mighty and marvelous. He will rule forever, and his kingdom will never end.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ ye nzɛngyerɛnneɛ osi te mbiri mbiri ɔ! Kyɛbɔ anwoserɛ osi wɔ ye anwanwadeɛ nu ɔ! Ye ahennie te ahennie afebɔɔ, na ye tumi wɔ berɛ wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: I was enjoying a time of peace and prosperity,
translation_verse: “Me, Nebukadenesa, né nde m’awuro asomdwee nu, bɔ né nningyein ɔkɔ so yé ma me wɔ m’ahemvie ɔ.

english_verse: Then I commanded every wise man in Babylonia to appear in my court, so they could explain the meaning of my dream.
translation_verse: Yiti nhyɛle mmeraa kyɛ bɛfa Babilɔn nworɛfoɛ amukoraa bɛbra me nyunu, maa beehyire me laleɛ ne abo.

english_verse: After they arrived, I told them my dream, but they were not able to say what it meant.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngonyaayelɛfoɛ, bɛ bɔ bɛnea nzramaa nu bɛkã nu dwirɛ, Kaldeafoɛ ne ahɔmeɛ bɛwale. Ngane laleɛ ne ngyirele bɛ, nakoso bangora bangyire me ye bo.

english_verse: Finally, a young man named Daniel came in, and I told him the dream. The holy gods had given him special powers, and I had renamed him Belteshazzar after my own god.
translation_verse: Ye si ye, Daniel bɔ me nyameɛ Beltesasa dumaa yeɛ bɛfa bɛfrɛ ye, bɔ nyameɛ krongron mɔ bɛ sunzum wɔ ye nu ne, ɔwale me nyunu, na ngane laleɛ ne ngyirele ye kyɛ,

english_verse: I said, “Belteshazzar, not only are you the wisest of all advisors and counselors, but the holy gods have given you special powers to solve the most difficult mysteries. So listen to what I dreamed and tell me what it means:
translation_verse: “O Beltesasa, ngonyaayelɛfoɛ panyi, mese kyɛ nyameɛ krongron mɔ bɛ sunzum wɔ wɔ nu, yeɛ mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ biala mmo w’adwene so, yiti kã me laleɛ bɔ ngyene ne kyire me, ná kyire me ye bo.

english_verse: In my sleep I saw a very tall tree in the center of the world.
translation_verse: Bɔ nwuni ye wɔ me laleɛ ne anu, mmerɛ bɔ né nna mba so ne, ye ɛhe: Nwuni bakaa bie kyɛ ogyi aseɛ afia, na né ɔwale paa.

english_verse: It grew stronger and higher, until it reached to heaven and could be seen from anywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Bakaa ne nyini yɛle piri, na ɔyɛle se, na ye ti ne oodwuli nyameɛso, na benwuni ye wɔ aseɛ so nekaa biala.

english_verse: It was covered with leaves and heavy with fruit— enough for all nations. Wild animals enjoyed its shade, birds nested in its branches, and all creatures on earth lived on its fruit.
translation_verse: Ye nyaa yɛle nyemene, so mmaa yɛle pee, na ɔyɛle aleɛ mane ebiala. Eburo ngaka bɛɛlelale ye bo fɔnwoo ne anu, ewienu nnomaa bɛɛtenatenane ye mmaen nemɔ aso, na abɔdeɛ amukoraa benyane so aleɛ belili.

english_verse: “While I was in bed, having this vision, a holy angel came down from heaven
translation_verse: “Bɔ nwuni ye wɔ me laleɛ nu wɔ me mba so ne, mvum nu, wɛmvoɛ krongronniɛ bie fili nyameɛso dwu wale.

english_verse: and shouted: ‘Chop down the tree and cut off its branches; strip off its leaves and scatter its fruit. Make the animals leave its shade and send the birds flying from its branches.
translation_verse: Na ɔteane nu serɛserɛ sele kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔbu bakaa ne bɛ́to ase, ná ɛ́mɔpepɛ ye mmaen ne, ɛ́mɔporo ye nyaa ne, ná ɛ́mɔto ye mma ne bɛ́pete; ɛ́mɔma ngaka nemɔ béfi ye bo bɛ́nwati, ná ɛ́mɔma nnomaa nemɔ bétu béfi ye mmaen nemɔ aso.

english_verse: But leave its stump and roots in the ground, surrounded by grass and held by chains of iron and bronze. ‘Make sure that this ruler lives like the animals out in the open fields, unprotected from the dew.
translation_verse: Nakoso ye dosii ndii ne de, ɛ́mɔyakyi ye wɔ aseɛ ne anu, ɛ́mɔfa buralɛ nyamaa ne kɔɔbere nyamaa bɛ́kyekye ye wɔ ndire frɔmfrɔm nu. Ɛ́mɔma nyameɛso bosue ɔloa ye, ná ɛ́mɔma ɔne ngaka beli aseɛ so ndire.

english_verse: Give him the mind of a wild animal for seven long years.

translation_verse: “Nana, me mene, laleɛ ne, ye bo hyirelɛ ɛhe. Nana, nikyee bɔ Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne ɔbaafa yɔ wɔ ne yeɛ waye wahyire wɔ ne:

translation_verse: Bɛkɔfoa wɔ bekofi mmenia nu, na ɛne eburo ngaka yeɛ bɛkɔɔtena ɔ. Bɛkɔmaa ekoli ndire kyɛ nandwie, na nyameɛso bosue kɔloa wɔ. Ɛhe kɔto wɔ afoɛ nzoo, kɔpem kyɛ ekonwu ye kyɛ Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne yeɛ ole adasa ahennie so tumi ɔ, na ebiala bɔ okuro ne yeɛ ɔfa ma ye ɔ.

english_verse: But he gave orders not to disturb the stump and roots. This is to show that you will be king once again, after you learn that the God who rules from heaven is in control.

translation_verse: Yiti Nana, me foɛ bɔ mebaatu wɔ ye, de to nu: Bɔ bra bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ ná yakyi bɔne yɔlɛ; nwu bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ anwumvoin, ná yakyi amumuyɛɛ yɔlɛ, amaa ɔnate so ebiaa né wɔ so anu atɔ wɔ ahyɛ.” Laleɛ ne wale nu”

english_verse: About twelve months later, I was walking on the flat roof of my royal palace and admiring the beautiful city of Babylon, when these things started happening to me. translation_verse: Bɛkɔfoa wɔ bekofi mmenia nu, na ɛne eburo ngaka yeɛ bɛkɔɔtena ɔ. Bɛkɔmaa ekoli ndire kyɛ nandwie. Ɛhe kɔto wɔ afoɛ nzoo, kɔpem kyɛ ekonwu ye kyɛ Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne yeɛ ole adasa ahennie so tumi ɔ, na ebiala bɔ okuro ne yeɛ ɔfa ma ye ɔ.”

english_verse: This was no sooner said than done—I was forced to live like a wild animal; I ate grass and was unprotected from the dew. As time went by, my hair grew longer than eagle feathers, and my fingernails looked like the claws of a bird.

english_verse: At that time my mind was healed, and once again I became the ruler of my glorious kingdom. My advisors and officials returned to me, and I had greater power than ever before.

english_verse: One evening, King Belshazzar gave a great banquet for a thousand of his highest officials, and he drank wine with them.
translation_verse: Nana Bɛlsasa tole poen kandinga bie mane ye mbanyi apee ko, na ɔnone nzaa wɔ mmenia apee ne anyunu.

english_verse: He got drunk and ordered his servants to bring in the gold and silver cups his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the temple in Jerusalem. Belshazzar wanted the cups, so that he and all his wives and officials could drink from them.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ nzaa ne fale Bɛlsasa nye so ne, ɔhyɛle kyɛ bɛɛfa sikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ kulie mɔ bɔ ye baba Nebukadenesa ɔɔsesa fili Yerusalem asɔneyɛɛ sua nu wale ne bɛbra, ma ye ɛhene, ɔne ye mbanyi mɔ, ɔye mɔ ne ye sómaa mɔ bɛno nu.

english_verse: When the gold cups were brought in, everyone at the banquet drank from them and praised their idols made of gold, silver, bronze, iron, wood, and stone.
translation_verse: Bɛnone nzaa, na bɛyele sikaa kɔkorɛ, ɛdwetɛ, kɔɔbere, buralɛ, bakaa ne nyɔboɛ nyameɛ mɔ ayɛ.

english_verse: Suddenly a human hand was seen writing on the plaster wall of the palace. The hand was just behind the lampstand, and the king could see it writing.
translation_verse: Mvum nu, sona sa mmɛseka fitele berɛ, na ɔhyerɛle ɛhene n’ahemvie berɛ terɛ bɔ bama ye nwo ne anwo, wɔ kanea bakaa ne nyunu berɛ, na ɛhene ne nwuni asaa bɔ né ɔkyerɛ ne.

english_verse: The king called in his advisors, who claimed they could talk with the spirits of the dead and understand the meanings found in the stars. translation_verse: Na ɛhene ne teane nu sele kyɛ bɛɛfa bɛ bɔ bɛnea nzramaa nu bɛkã nu dwirɛ, Kaldeafoɛ ne benewaafoɛ bɛbra. english_verse: All of King Belshazzar's highest officials came in, but not one of them could read the writing or tell what it meant,
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana ye nworɛfoɛ ne amukoraa bɛwale berɛ, nakoso bangora ahyerɛlɛ ne kenga, yeɛ bangora bangyire ye bo bangyire Nana.

english_verse: and they were completely puzzled. Now the king was more afraid than ever before, and his face turned white as a ghost.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Bɛlsasa nwo dwirili ye paa, na ye nyunu yɛle bosaa, na ye mbanyi nemɔ yɛle basaa.

english_verse: I was told that the gods have given you special powers and that you are intelligent and very wise.

english_verse: But I have been told that you understand everything and that you can solve difficult problems. translation_verse: Nakoso mate kyɛ wɔ de, ɛkora kyire edwirɛ bo, yeɛ ekyirekyire edwirɛ bɔ ɔkye adwene ɔ koso nu. Sɛ ɛkora kenga ahyerɛlɛ ne, ná ekyire me ye bo a, ngɔfa kende ngɔhera wɔ, yeɛ ngɔfa sikaa kɔkorɛ atweaban ngɔto wɔ kɔme anu, na ɛkɔyɛ ɛhene bɔ ye tumi tɔ so nza ɔ wɔ ahennie ye anu.”

english_verse: The other men tried to find something wrong with the way Daniel did his work for the king. But they could not accuse him of anything wrong, because he was honest and faithful and did everything he was supposed to do.
translation_verse: Yeɛ mbanyi so neafoɛ nemɔ ne mbɔtam mbanyi nemɔ, bɛpenane ahennie ne bulɛ nwo dwirɛ bɔ ɔkɔma Daniel nwo kɔhyere ye ɔ, nakoso bannya mvomsoɛ anaa ye nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ biala, ofikyɛ né odi nahorɛ, na bannya ye nwo mvomsoɛ anaa bɔne biala.

english_verse: Finally, they said to one another, “We will never be able to bring any charge against Daniel, unless it has to do with his religion.”
translation_verse: Na sɔ mmenia nemɔ sele kyɛ, “Sɔ Daniel he, yɛngonya ye nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ biala ngɔfa ngɔbɔ ye kwaadu, sana ye Nyameɛ mmeraa nwo yeɛ yɛkonya bie ɔ.”

english_verse: They all went to the king and said: “Your Majesty, we hope you live forever!
translation_verse: Yeɛ mbanyi so neafoɛ nemɔ ne mbɔtam mbanyi nemɔ, bɛbɔle nu bɛhɔle ɛhene ne berɛ, na besele ye kyɛ, “Nana Dario, wɔ ngoa so oo!

english_verse: Order this to be written and then sign it, so it cannot be changed, just as no written law of the Medes and Persians can be changed.”
translation_verse: Yiti Nana, hyɛ mmeraa ne, ná fa wɔ sa wura ye bo bɔ ebiala ngɔhora ye sesã ɔ, kyɛbɔ Medese ne Pɛsia mmeraa bɔ bɛngora ye sesã ne ɔte ne.”

english_verse: So King Darius made the law and had it written down.
translation_verse: Yiti Nana Dario fale ye sa wurale krataa ne ne mmeraa ne abo.

english_verse: Daniel heard about the law, but when he returned home, he went upstairs and prayed in front of the window that faced Jerusalem. In the same way that he had always done, he knelt down in prayer three times a day, giving thanks to God.
translation_verse: Na Daniel tele kyɛ wafa ye sa wawura mmeraa ne abo nen, ɔhɔle ye awuro aborɔsaen ne aso, nekaa bɔ ye pia nu mboma mɔ bebukye a bɛ nye kyire Yerusalem ne. Na kyɛbɔ né daa ne ɔyɔ ne ala, ɛlɛho biala oguale ndwerɛ pɛen nza ɔbɔle mbaeɛ lale ase wɔ ye Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: The men who had spoken to the king watched Daniel and saw him praying to his God for help.
translation_verse: Yeɛ sɔ mmenia nemɔ bɛboale bɛ noa, na beenwuni Daniel kyɛ ɔbɔ mbaeɛ ɔfa ye abisadeɛ ɔto ye Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: The men then told the king, “That Jew named Daniel, who was brought here as a captive, refuses to obey you or the law that you ordered to be written. And he still prays to his god three times a day.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ besele ɛhene ne kyɛ, “Sɔ Daniel ne, bɔ ɔte mmenia bɔ bɛhyele bɛ nnure befili Yuda nemɔ anu ko ne, Nana, ommu wɔ, yeɛ ɔmva mmeraa bɔ wɔ sa wura ye bo ne nyɛ huu, na mmom ɛlɛho biala ɔbɔ ye mbaeɛ ne pɛen nza.”

english_verse: The king was really upset to hear about this, and for the rest of the day he tried to think how he could save Daniel.
translation_verse: Na ɛhene ne tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, ɔhale ye paa, na ɔyɛle ye adwene kyɛ ɔkɔpepɛ kole Daniel. Na ɔbɔle ye nwo mmɔden penane atee bɔ ɔkɔfa so kole ye ɔ maa oodwuli kyɛ eyia tɔle ɔ.

english_verse: At sunset the men returned and said, “Your Majesty, remember that no written law of the Medes and Persians can be changed, not even by the king.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ sɔ mmenia nemɔ boale bɛ noa bɛhɔle ɛhene ne berɛ beesele ye kyɛ, “Nana, nwu ye kyɛ, Medese ne Pɛsia mmeraa nu, sɛ Nana hyɛ mmeraa anaa ahyɛdeɛ biala a, bɛngora bɛnzesã ye.”

english_verse: So Darius ordered Daniel to be brought out and thrown into a pit of lions. But he said to Daniel, “You have been faithful to your God, and I pray that he will rescue you.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɛhene ne hyɛle maa bɛɛfale Daniel bɛwale, na begyili ye bɛtole gyata mɔ tuin ne anu. Na ɛhene ne sele Daniel kyɛ, “Wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ɛso ye daa ne, ɔpepɛ le wɔ!”

english_verse: A stone was rolled over the pit, and it was sealed. Then Darius and his officials stamped the seal to show that no one should let Daniel out.
translation_verse: Yeɛ bɛfale nyɔboɛ bie beenwini tuin ne anoa, na ɛhene ne fale ye bɔbɔ ye nzɔanoɛ pɛteaa ne ye mbanyi mɔ nzɔanoɛ mbɛteaa sɔle nyɔboɛ ne noa, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ebiala sesã bɔ wato Daniel a ɔngɔyɛ yee ɔ.

english_verse: All night long the king could not sleep. He did not eat anything, and he would not let anyone come in to entertain him.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɛhene ne sa hɔle ye ahemvie berɛ, obualale kɔngɔen ne, na wamma bamva bɔ ɔkɔfa kɔgyegye ye nye ɔ biala bammrɛ ye, na ye nye sorole.

english_verse: At daybreak the king got up and ran to the pit.
translation_verse: Na alebahyene ne, ɛhene ne dwɔsole, na ɔhane ye nwo hɔle gyata nemɔ bɛ tuin ne anwo berɛ.

english_verse: He was anxious and shouted, “Daniel, you were faithful and served your God. Was he able to save you from the lions?”
translation_verse: Na opingyele tuin ne anwo berɛ nen, ole ahunundetelɛ teane nu frɛle Daniel, na osele Daniel kyɛ, “Daniel, Nyameɛ teasefoɛ somvoɛ ee, wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ɛso ye daa ne, wahora wapepɛ wale wɔ wafi gyata nemɔ bɛ sa nu anaa?”

english_verse: Daniel answered, “Your Majesty, I hope you live forever!
translation_verse: Yeɛ Daniel buale ɛhene ne kyɛ, “Nana, wɔ ngoa so oo!

english_verse: My God knew that I was innocent, and he sent an angel to keep the lions from eating me. Your Majesty, I have never done anything to hurt you.”
translation_verse: Me Nyameɛ wasoma ye abɔfo maa waahã gyata nemɔ bɛ noa wato nu, yiti banyɔ me huu, ofikyɛ wanwu me kyɛ medi be wɔ ye nyunu; yeɛ Nana, wɔ nyunu koso nnyɔle bɔne biala.”

english_verse: The king was relieved to hear Daniel's voice, and he gave orders for him to be taken out of the pit. Daniel's faith in his God had kept him from being harmed.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɔyɛle ɛhene ne fɛ paa, na ɔhyɛle kyɛ bɛye Daniel befi tuin ne anu. Yiti bɛyele Daniel befili tuin ne anu, na bannwu kyɛ ye nwo nekaa biala wapuropuro ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔfale ye wora wurale ye Nyameɛ nu.

english_verse: And the king ordered the men who had brought charges against Daniel to be thrown into the pit, together with their wives and children. But before they even reached the bottom, the lions ripped them to pieces.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɛhene ne hyɛle maa bɛɛfale mmenia bɔ bɛbɔle Daniel kwaadu ne bɛwale, na ɔmaa beegyili bɛ beguale gyata mɔ bɛ tuin ne anu, bɛ ne bɛ mma ne bɛ ye mɔ; na bandwu tuin ne abo dɔ po yeɛ gyata nemɔ hyele bɛ ɔ, na bɛgorɔgorɔle bɛ mmowue mukoraa nu pasapasa.

english_verse: King Darius then sent this message to all people of every nation and race in the world: “Greetings to all of you!
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nana Dario hyerɛle krataa ɔɔmane maen maen, mmenia ne edwudwolɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ so amukoraa ɔ kyɛ, “Ngɔsoɛ pee ɔbra ɛmɔ asetena oo!

english_verse: I command everyone in my kingdom to worship and honor the God of Daniel. He is the living God, the one who lives forever. His power and his kingdom will never end.
translation_verse: Mahyɛ mmeraa kyɛ, m’ahennie maen bɔ medi so tumi ne amukoraa nu, odi kyɛ mmenia bɛma bɛ nwo wosowoso bɛ, ná besuro wɔ Daniel Nyameɛ ne nyunu, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ teasefoɛ bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ ɔ; ye ahennie ne, ɔngɔbɔ le, na ye tumi ne kɔtena berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: He rescues people and sets them free by working great miracles. Daniel's God has rescued him from the power of the lions.”
translation_verse: Ode ngoa, na ɔpepɛ de mmenia, na ɔyɔ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ wɔ nyameɛso ne aseɛ so, na ye yeɛ wapepɛ wale Daniel wafi gyata mɔ bɛ sa nu ɔ.”

english_verse: All went well for Daniel while Darius was king, and even when Cyrus the Persian ruled.
translation_verse: Yiti Daniel he, onyane ngɔsoɛ wɔ Dario ahennie aberɛ so ne Pɛsianiɛ Karose ahennie aberɛ so.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: In the first year of King Belshazzar of Babylonia, I had some dreams and visions while I was asleep one night, and I wrote them down. The four winds were stirring up the mighty sea,
translation_verse: Daniel nwa nyoo, “Nwuni ye wɔ me nyekyire ne anu kɔngɔen ne, yieee, nyameɛso mvrama nna nemɔ betuli ɛpo piri ne aso bɛmaa ɔyɛle bagyabagya.

english_verse: when suddenly four powerful beasts came out of the sea. Each beast was different.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngaka ngandinga nna befili ɛpo ne anu befitele, asora kyɛbɔ ko biala osi te ɔ.

english_verse: The first was like a lion with the wings of an eagle. As I watched, its wings were pulled off. Then it was lifted to an upright position and made to stand on two feet, just like a human, and it was given a human mind.
translation_verse: Né bɔ oli moa ne te kyɛ gyata, na né ole kɔleɛ ndaa. Na ngu so bɔ menea ne, betutuli ye ndaa nemɔ, bɛmane ye so befili aseɛnwo, bɛmaa ogyinane agyirɛ nyɔ so kyɛ sona, na bɛmane ye sona adwene.

english_verse: The second beast looked like a bear standing on its hind legs. It held three ribs in its teeth, and it was told, “Attack! Eat all the flesh you want.”
translation_verse: Nwuni kaka bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ɔ, na né ɔte kyɛ kwabrafo. Né wadwɔso wagyina berɛ watɔ wahɔ ye bue ko; né amveɛ mbaleɛ nza wura ye noa nu, wɔ ye gye nemɔ b’afia. Na besele ye kyɛ, ‘Dwɔso di naen pee!’

english_verse: The third beast was like a leopard—except that it had four wings and four heads. It was given authority to rule.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe asi ne, nneane, na nwuni kaka foforɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ aboa ɔ. Né ole anomaa ndaa nna wɔ ye si; né kaka ne ti te nna, na bɛmane ye tumi.

english_verse: The fourth beast was stronger and more terrifying than the others. Its huge teeth were made of iron, and what it didn't grind with its teeth, it smashed with its feet. It was different from the others, and it had horns on its head—ten of them.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe asi ne, nwuni kaka bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ɔ wɔ kɔngɔen laleɛ ne anu. Ye nwo yɛ suro, nwanwa, na ye nwo yɛ se paa. Né ole buralɛ agyee mbiri mbiri; oku na ɔtete nu pasapasa, na otiatia ye ngaa ne aso. Nzonzoleɛ wɔ ye ne ngaka mukoraa bɔ belili ye nyunu ne anu, na né ye mmɛen te buru.

english_verse: Just as I was thinking about these horns, a smaller horn appeared, and three of the other horns were pulled up by the roots to make room for it. This horn had the eyes of a human and a mouth that spoke with great arrogance. Judgment Daniel wrote:
translation_verse: Na ngu so menea mmɛen nemɔ nen, yieee, nwuni kyɛ mmɛen kaaba foforɛ bie wafifi mmɛen nemɔ b’afia ɔ. Na mmɛen bɔ beli moa nemɔ, bɛ nu nza bo tutuli maa sɔ mmɛen ne ootuale berɛ. Na nwuni kyɛ sɔ mmɛen ne ole anyeɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ sona deɛ ɔ, ɔne noa bɔ ɔkekã edwirɛ mbiri mbiri ɔ. Sona Awa ne

english_verse: Thrones were set up while I was watching, and the Eternal God took his place. His clothing and his hair were white as snow. His throne was a blazing fire with fiery wheels,
translation_verse: Na ngu so bɔ menea ne, nwuni kyɛ bafa ahennie bia mɔ baasiesie berɛ, na Bɔ Ɔwɔ Berɛ Fi Tetetete ne ɔɔtenane ase, ye tena ne te fufue kyɛ nwera, yeɛ ye ti nwiaa te horaenn kyɛ gyese; ye bia ne te see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi ɔ, na ye bia kɔba nemɔ, bɛte see bɔ ɔsɔ ɔ.

english_verse: and flames were dashing out from all around him. Countless thousands were standing there to serve him. The time of judgment began, and the books were opened.
translation_verse: See bɔ ɔsẽ kyɛ asue ɔ opu wale, opu fili ye nyunu berɛ wale, apee apee sole ye, yeɛ apee buru apee buru buburugyaa gyinagyinane ye nyunu; ndɛenbualɛ badwa ne tenane ase, na bebukyebukyele nwomaa nemɔ anu.

english_verse: I watched closely to see what would happen to this smaller horn because of the arrogant things it was saying. Then before my very eyes, the fourth beast was killed and its body destroyed by fire.
translation_verse: Ngɔle so nneane, ɔnate edwirɛ mbiri mbiri bɔ né mmɛen ne ɔkekã ne ati. Na nneane alaa kɔpem kyɛ behuni kaka ne ɔ, bɛsɛkyele ye fuin ne, na befindini bɛtole see bɔ ogye ɔ nu.

english_verse: The other three beasts had their authority taken from them, but they were allowed to live a while longer.
translation_verse: Na ngaka ngaa nemɔ koso de, belele bɛ sa nu tumi ne, nakoso bɛhyɛle mmerɛ kãa bɛmane bɛ maa bɛtenane ase.

english_verse: As I continued to watch the vision that night, I saw what looked like a son of man coming with the clouds of heaven, and he was presented to the Eternal God.
translation_verse: Kɔngɔen nu nyekyire nemɔ anu, nwuni ebie bɔ ɔte kyɛ Sona Awa, kyɛ ɔnate nyameɛso munungum nu ɔba ɔ, ɔhɔle Bɔ Ɔwɔ Berɛ Fi Tetetete ne nwo berɛ, na bɛmaa ɔhɔle ye nyunu berɛ.

english_verse: He was crowned king and given power and glory, so that all people of every nation and race would serve him. He will rule forever, and his kingdom is eternal, never to be destroyed. The Meaning of Daniel's Vision
translation_verse: Na ye yeɛ bɛmane ye tumi, animnyam ne ahennie, amaa ɔnate so maen maen mukoraa, mmenia mukoraa ne edwudwolɛ amukoraa baso ye. Ye tumi ne, ɔte tumi bɔ olle ayieleɛ bɔ ɔngɔpɛ nu le ɔ, na ye ahennie ne, ɔte ahennie bɔ ɔngɔbɔ le ɔ. Nyekyire ne bo hyirelɛ

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I was terrified by these visions, and I didn't know what to think.
translation_verse: “Me, Daniel, me sunzum wora bɔle wɔ me nu, na nyekyire bɔ nwuni ye ne hale me.

english_verse: “The four beasts are four earthly kingdoms.
translation_verse: ‘Sɔ ngaka mbiri nna nemɔ, bɛ ole ahemvo nna bɔ bɛbaadwɔso aseɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: But God Most High will give his kingdom to his chosen ones, and it will be theirs forever and ever.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne, ye anwoteefoɛ nemɔ bekonya ahennie ne, na bɛ sa kɔhã ahennie ne afebɔɔ mmerɛ bɔ olle ayieleɛ ɔ.’

english_verse: I wanted to know more about the fourth beast, because it was so different and much more terrifying than the others. What was the meaning of its iron teeth and bronze claws and of its feet that smashed what the teeth and claws had not ground and crushed?
translation_verse: “Na kaka bɔ ɔtɔ so nna, bɔ nzonzoleɛ wɔ ye ne bɛ ngaa ne amukoraa nu, bɔ ye nwo yɛ suro paa, bɔ ye gye te buralɛ, bɔ ye gya ne ye sa boen te kɔɔbere, bɔ oku ná ɔtete nu pasapasa, ná otiatia ye ngaa ne aso ne, né mepena kyɛ menwu kyɛbɔ ye bo kyire ɔ.

english_verse: I also wanted to know more about all ten of those horns on its head. I especially wanted to know more about the one that took the place of three of the others—the horn that had eyes and spoke with arrogance and seemed greater than the others.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ye ti so mmɛen buru nemɔ, mmɛen ko ne bɔ ofifili, bɔ bɛ nu nza bo tutuli maa ootuale berɛ, sɔ mmɛen ne bɔ ole anyeɛ ne noa bɔ ɔkekã edwirɛ mbiri mbiri, bɔ ye piri tra mmɛen ngaa nemɔ ne, né mepena kyɛ menwu kyɛbɔ ye bo kyire ɔ.

english_verse: While I was looking, this horn attacked God's chosen ones and was winning the battle.
translation_verse: Na ngu so bɔ menea ne, sɔ mmɛen ne fale koɛ toale anwoteefoɛ nemɔ, na olili bɛ so ngonim,

english_verse: Then God Most High, the Eternal God, came and judged in favor of his chosen ones, because the time had arrived for them to be given the kingdom.
translation_verse: kɔpem kyɛ Bɔ Ɔwɔ Berɛ Fi Tetetete ne wale ɔ, na obuale Anwuro Anwuroniɛ n’anwoteefoɛ nemɔ be, na mmerɛ ne dwuli maa anwoteefoɛ nemɔ bɛ sa hane ahennie ne.

english_verse: Then I was told by the one standing there: “The fourth beast will be a fourth kingdom to appear on earth. It will be different from all the others— it will trample the earth and crush it to pieces.
translation_verse: “Na ohyirele ye bo kyɛ, ‘Kaka bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne, ɔkɔyɛ ahennie bɔ ɔtɔ so nna wɔ aseɛ so, nzonzoleɛ kɔwa ye ne ahennie amukoraa nu, okoli aseɛ amukoraa so ngonim, okotiatia so ná wasɛkye ye pasapasa.

english_verse: All ten of those horns are kings who will come from this kingdom, and one more will follow. This horn will be different from the others, and it will conquer three other kings.
translation_verse: Na mmɛen buru nemɔ, ahemvo buru kodwɔso wɔ sɔ ahennie ne anu, na nziɛ ye, ɛhene foforɛ kodwɔso wɔ bɛ si; nzonzoleɛ kɔwa ye ne bɛ bɔ beli moa ne anu, na okoli ahemvo nza so ngonim.

english_verse: “This king will speak evil of God Most High, and he will be cruel to God's chosen ones. He will try to change God's Law and the sacred seasons. And he will be able to do this for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Okodwudwo kotia Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne, ɔkɔmaa Anwuro Anwuroniɛ n’anwoteefoɛ nemɔ bekoli amia, na ɔkɔyɛ ye adwene kyɛ ɔkɔsesã mmerɛ ne mmeraa, na bɛkɔfa anwoteefoɛ nemɔ bekowura ye sa afoɛ ko, afoɛ nyɔ ne bosome nzia.

english_verse: “Then the greatest kingdom of all will be given to the chosen ones of God Most High. His kingdom will be eternal, and all others will serve and obey him.”
translation_verse: Na bɛkɔfa ahennie ne tumi ɔne ahennie mɔ bɛ tumi bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro amukoraa bo bɛkɔma Anwuro Anwuroniɛ n’anwoteefoɛ maen ne. Ye ahennie ne te ahennie afebɔɔ, na tumi amukoraa kɔso ye, ná bayɛ sotie bama ye.’

english_verse: That was what I saw and heard. I turned pale with fear and kept it all to myself.
translation_verse: “Edwirɛ ne, ye ayieleɛ ɛne. Na me, Daniel de, edwirɛ ne hale me paa, me nwo yɛle me basaa, nakoso mvale edwirɛ ne nziele me ti anu.”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: In the third year of King Belshazzar of Babylonia, I had a second vision
translation_verse: Nana Bɛlsasa ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne anu, me Daniel, nyane nyekyire bie, na ɛhe sili wɔ nyekyire bɔ nnili moa nyane ye ne asi.

english_verse: when I looked up and saw a ram standing there with two horns on its head—both of them were long, but the second one was longer than the first.
translation_verse: Mmane me ti so, na yieee, nwuni boaen nyii bie kyɛ ogyi asue ne noa ɔ. Né ole mmɛen nyɔ, na mmɛen nyɔ ne, né bɛwoware, nakoso ko te tendenn tra ko, na bɔ ɔte tendenn ne yeɛ olili nziɛ wɔ bɛ fifilɛ ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: The ram went charging toward the west, the north, and the south. No other animals were strong enough to oppose him, and nothing could save them from his power. So he did as he pleased and became even more powerful.
translation_verse: Nwuni boaen nyii ne kyɛ osisi ɔkɔ eyia atɔleɛ ne sorɔ ne ngwaen. Kaka biala angora ye nyunu gyina, yeɛ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔhora pepɛ lele ebie fili ye sa nu ɔ. Ɔyɔle bɔ okuro ɔ, na ɔmomane ye nwo so.

english_verse: I kept on watching and saw a goat come from the west and charge across the entire earth, without even touching the ground. Between his eyes was a powerful horn,
translation_verse: Na ngu so bɔ menea ne, yieee, abɔngye nyii bie fili eyia atɔleɛ fale aseɛ so amukoraa wale bɔ né ye gya nga ase ɔ; na né abɔngye ne ole mmɛen pirikua bie bɔ otua ye nye nemɔ b’afia ɔ.

english_verse: and with tremendous anger the goat started toward the ram that I had seen beside the river.
translation_verse: Opingyele boaen nyii bɔ ole mmɛen nyɔ, bɔ nwuni ye kyɛ ogyi asue ne noa ne anwo berɛ, na ole ɛyaa tuli amirika anwoserɛ so hɔle ye so.

english_verse: The goat was so fierce that its attack broke both horns of the ram, leaving him powerless. Then the goat trampled on the ram, and no one could do anything to help.
translation_verse: Nwuni kyɛ waadwu boaen nyii ne anwo berɛ, ɔfɛle ye so yaa piri, na osili boaen nyii ne bubuli ye mmɛen nyɔ ne anu. Boaen nyii ne annya anwoserɛ wangyina ye nyunu, na abɔngye ne pemone ye tole berɛ tiatiale ye so, na ebiala angora wanne boaen nyii ne wamvi ye sa nu.

english_verse: After this, the goat became even more powerful. But at the peak of his power, his mighty horn was broken, and four other mighty horns took its place—one pointing to the north and one to the east, one to the south and one to the west.
translation_verse: Yiti abɔngye nyii ne momane ye nwo so paa, nakoso mmerɛ bɔ ye anwoserɛ ne yɛle piri paa nen, mmɛen piri ne buli, na mmɛen mbiri mbiri nna fifili ye boso bɔ bɛ nye kyire nyameɛso mvrama nna ne ɔ.

english_verse: A little horn came from one of these, and its power reached to the south, the east, and even to the holy land.
translation_verse: Mmɛen nemɔ anu, mmɛen kaaba bie fifili fili ko anu, onyini yɛle piri paa mane ye nye hyirele ngwaen, eyia afiteleɛ ne aseɛ nyemenenyemene ne.

english_verse: It became so strong that it attacked the stars in the sky, which were heaven's army. Then it threw some of them down to the earth and trampled on them.
translation_verse: Onyini tendenn alaa oodwuli nyameɛso lɔen ne anwo, na otutuli ɛlɔen ne bie ne nzramaa ne bie guale ase, na otiatiale bɛ so.

english_verse: It humiliated heaven's army and dishonored its leader by keeping him from offering the daily sacrifices. In fact, it was so terrible that it even disgraced the temple and wiped out true worship. It also did everything else it wanted to do.
translation_verse: Ɔnate mmeraatolɛ so mane ɛlɔen ne, yeɛ daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne oolili ye sa; ofindini nahorɛ tole ase, na bɔ ɔyɔle ne, onyane ngɔsoɛ.

english_verse: Then one of the holy angels asked another, “When will the daily sacrifices be offered again? What about this horrible rebellion? When will the temple and heaven's army no longer be trampled in the dust?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ ndele kyɛ krongronniɛ bie odwudwo, na krongronniɛ ko koso bisale bɔ odwudwole ne kyɛ, “Daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, musuebɔlɛ mmeraatolɛ ne, nekaa krongron berɛ bɔ waali ye sa ne, yeɛ ɛlɔen ne bɔ otiatiale bɛ so ne nwo nyekyire ne, mmerɛ beni yeɛ ɔkɔhɔ so koodwu ɔ?”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I was trying to figure out the meaning of the vision, when someone suddenly appeared there beside me.
translation_verse: Na me, Daniel, nyane nyekyire ne, ná nyɛle m’adwene kyɛ ngɔte ye bo nen, mvum nu, nwuni ebie bɔ ye sue te kyɛ sona ɔ kyɛ ogyi me nyunu berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And from beside the Ulai River, a voice like that of a human said, “Gabriel, help him understand the vision.”
translation_verse: Na ndele sona komvi wɔ asue Yulae noa, kyɛ ɔtea nu kyɛ, “Gabriel, kyire biaa ne nyekyire ne abo.”

english_verse: Gabriel came over, and I fell to the ground in fear. Then he said, “You are merely a human, but you need to understand that this vision is about the end of time.”
translation_verse: Yiti ɔwale nekaa bɔ né ngyi ne. Ɔwale ne, ɛserɛ hane me, na mvale me nyunu mmutuli berɛ. Na osele me kyɛ, “O Sona awa, te ye bo, kyɛ nyekyire ne gyi berɛ ma ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne.”

english_verse: While he was speaking, I fell facedown in a deep sleep. But he lifted me to my feet
translation_verse: Na ogu so bɔ odwudwo kyire me nen, nnale hatee, bɔ né me nyunu butu berɛ ɔ; na ɔsɔle me nu fale me gyinane berɛ.

english_verse: and said: Listen, and I will tell you what will happen at the end of time, when God has chosen to show his anger.
translation_verse: Na osele kyɛ, “Tie, ahonehulɛ ne ba ayieleɛ a, bɔ okosi ne, mebaala ye ali mekyire wɔ, ofikyɛ ɔfa ayieleɛ mmerɛ bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: The two horns of the ram are the kings of Media and Persia,
translation_verse: Boaen nyii bɔ enwuni ye kyɛ ole mmɛen nyɔ ne, begyi berɛ bɛma Media ne Pɛsia ahemvo.

english_verse: the goat is the kingdom of Greece, and the powerful horn between his eyes is the first of its kings.
translation_verse: Na abɔngye nyii awerɔm ne, ogyi berɛ ma Hela hene; yeɛ mmɛen pirikua bie bɔ otua ye nye nemɔ b’afia ne, ogyi berɛ ma ɛhene bɔ oli moa ne.

english_verse: After this horn is broken, four other kingdoms will appear, but they won't be as strong.
translation_verse: Na mmɛen bɔ so buli bɔ mmɛen nna befifili ye gya nu ne, okyire kyɛ ahennie nna kodwɔso maen ne anu, nakoso b’anwoserɛ ngodwu ye deɛ ne.

english_verse: When these rulers have become as evil as possible, their power will end, and then a king who is dangerous and cannot be trusted will appear.
translation_verse: Na sɛ b’ahennie ne ɔbaawa ayieleɛ a, mmerɛ bɔ mmeraatolɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛ bɔne yɔleɛ ahɔ so paa ne, ɛhene atianuserɛniɛ bie, bɔ otira kanda nworɛ ɔ kodwɔso.

english_verse: He will gain strength, but not on his own, and he will cause terrible destruction. He will wipe out powerful leaders and God's people as well.
translation_verse: Ye tumi kɔyɛ piri, nakoso nna ye bɔbɔ ye tumi ɔ, ɔkɔsɛkye nningyein maa ɔkɔyɛ anwodwiri, okonya ngɔsoɛ wɔ bɔ ɔkɔyɔ ɔ nu, okohũhũ anwoserɛfoɛ, na ɔkɔbɔ krongronfoɛ maen ne.

english_verse: His deceitful lies will make him so successful, that he will think he is really great. Suddenly he will kill many people, and he will even attack God, the Supreme Ruler. But God will crush him!
translation_verse: Na ye kanda ne ati, ɔkɔma nnakannaka kotira ndii wɔ ye aberɛ so, ye ti anu kɔyɛ ye fɛ maa ɔkɔhoahoa ye nwo, okohũhũ mmeni pee bɔ ɔngɔbɔ bɛ kɔkɔ ɔ, okodwɔso kotia ahemvo mɔ nu Hene ne, nakoso bekobu ye nu gyein wɔ aberɛ bɔ nna sona yeɛ wafa ye sa wahã ye ɔ.

english_verse: This vision about the evenings and mornings is true, but these things won't happen for a long time, so don't tell it to others.
translation_verse: Nɔsoa ne ngyerɛmɔ nyekyire bɔ mala ye ali ne, ɔte nahorɛ; nakoso nnɛbɔ nyekyire ne aso, ofikyɛ kyẽa bie dee yeɛ okosi ɔ.”

english_verse: After this, I was so worn out and weak that it was several days before I could get out of bed and go about my duties for the king. I was disturbed by this vision that made no sense to me.
translation_verse: Afei me, Daniel, me nwo yɛle me bɛtɛɛ, na me nwo yɛle me yea ngyẽa dɔnn. Afei ndwɔsole, na ndoale ɛhene n’adwuma ne aso; nakoso nyekyire ne mane me nwo dwirili me, ofikyɛ ebiala ande ye bo.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: Some years later, Darius the Mede, who was the son of Xerxes, had become king of Babylonia. And during his first year as king, I found out from studying the writings of the prophets that the Lord had said to Jeremiah, “Jerusalem will lie in ruins for
translation_verse: ye ahennie afoɛ bɔ oli moa ne anu, me, Daniel, mbɛnzɛmbɛnzɛle ngrataa nemɔ anu nwuni afoɛ aburasoo bɔ odi kyɛ ɔpɛ nu koraka né Yerusalem abɔ, bɔ ɔte AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔlale ye ali hyirele ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yeremia ne.

english_verse: Then, to show my sorrow, I went without eating and dressed in sackcloth and sat in ashes. I confessed my sins and earnestly prayed to the Lord my God: Our Lord, you are a great and fearsome God, and you faithfully keep your agreement with those who love and obey you.
translation_verse: Mmɔle mbaeɛ ngyirele AWURADE me Nyameɛ, na nne ndole nu ngane ye pefee kyɛ, “O AWURADE, Nyameɛ piri bɔ ye nwo yɛ suro, bɔ odi apam ne ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ɔ so ma bɛ bɔ bekuro ye dwirɛ ɔne bɛ bɔ bedi ye mmeraa dwirɛ so ɔ;

english_verse: But we have sinned terribly by rebelling against you and rejecting your laws and teachings.
translation_verse: yayɔ bɔne, yayɔ amumuyɛɛ, yayɔ bɔ bɛnyɔ ɔ, yayɛ lɔen, kyɛ yali wɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne anwo makyebu ɔ.

english_verse: We have ignored the message your servants the prophets spoke to our kings, our leaders, our ancestors, and everyone else.
translation_verse: Wɔ somvoɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ begyinane wɔ dumaa nu bedwudwo behyirele yɛ ahemvo mɔ, yɛ atitirefoɛ, yɛ nana mɔ ne aseɛ ne aso mmenia amukoraa ne, yandie bɛ.

english_verse: Lord God, you are merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against you
translation_verse: O AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ, yayɛ wɔ nwo lɔen, nakoso wɔ yeɛ ɛse anwumvoin ná ɛfa bɔne kyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and rejected your teachings that came to us from your servants the prophets.
translation_verse: Yandie AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ dwirɛ, ofikyɛ ye mmeraa bɔ ɔnate ye somvoɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ mɔ so hyehyɛ mane yɛ ne, yanni so.

english_verse: Everyone in Israel has stubbornly refused to obey your laws, and so those curses written by your servant Moses have fallen upon us.
translation_verse: Amba, Yisrael amukoraa abu wɔ mmeraa ne aso, bali makyebu bɔ bendie wɔ dwirɛ ɔ. Na ɛnomalɛ ne ndaen bɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ Nyameɛ somvoɛ Mose mmeraa ne anu ne, wawa yɛ so, ofikyɛ yayɔ bɔne yatia ye.

english_verse: You warned us and our leaders that Jerusalem would suffer the worst disaster in human history, and you did exactly as you had threatened.
translation_verse: Na ye dwirɛ bɔ ɔhane kyɛ ɔkɔmaa ɔkɔwa yɛ ne yɛ maenbulɛfoɛ bɔ bɛlale yɛ noa ne aso, kyɛ ɔkɔprapra amaneɛ kandinga kogua yɛ so ne, wamaa wawa nu; ofikyɛ bɔ wamaa wato Yerusalem ne, ebie ɔwwale wɔ ewiase nekaa biala le.

english_verse: We have not escaped any of the terrible curses written by Moses, and yet we have refused to beg you for mercy and to remind ourselves of how faithful you have always been.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ Mose mmeraa ne anu ne, musue he amukoraa atoto yɛ, nakoso yanzrɛ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ kyɛ onwu yɛ anwumvoin. Yɛhhwene yɛ nwo yɛffili yɛ amumuyɛɛ nwo, yeɛ yɛyyɛle yɛ adwene kyɛ yɛkotie wɔ nahorɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: And when you finally punished us with this horrible disaster, that was also the right thing to do, because we deserved it so much.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, AWURADE asiesie amaneɛ, na wamaa wato yɛ; ofikyɛ AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ ne, ɔtengyɛ wɔ bɔ ɔyɔ ɔ amukoraa nu; nakoso yɛ de, yandie ye dwirɛ.

english_verse: Our Lord God, with your own mighty arm you rescued us from Egypt and made yourself famous to this very day, but we have sinned terribly.
translation_verse: Na afei, AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɛnate wɔ tumi piri so ɛyele wɔ maen fili Misraim aseɛ so wale, bɔ ale dumaa maa waadwu ɛnɛ ɔ, yayɔ bɔne, yayɔ bɔ bɛnyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: In the past, you treated us with such kindness, that we now beg you to stop being so terribly angry with Jerusalem. After all, it is your chosen city built on your holy mountain, even though it has suffered public disgrace because of our sins and those of our ancestors.
translation_verse: O AWURADE, w’adaworoma, kyɛbɔ wɔ tenenee amukoraa te ne, gyina so ná yakyi ɛyaafɛlɛ ne w’ahone bɔ wahu wɔ wɔ kuro Yerusalem so, wɔ wɔ bokaa krongron ne aso ne. Na ɔnate yɛ bɔne ne yɛ nana mɔ b’amumuyɛɛ ti, Yerusalem ne wɔ maen bakakyi ngorohoɛ dwirɛ bama bɛ bɔ bapɛ yɛ nwo bayia ne amukoraa.

english_verse: I am your servant, Lord God, and I beg you to answer my prayers and bring honor to yourself by having pity on your temple that lies in ruins.
translation_verse: Yiti yɛ Nyameɛ, w’adaworoma, tie wɔ somvoɛ mbaeɛ ne ye sufrɛ; na ɔnate wɔ, AWURADE wɔ ti, ma wɔ ɛlolɛ ne ɔbra nekaa krongron bɔ wakakyi dandue ne aso.

english_verse: Forgive us! Hurry and do something, not only for your city and your chosen people, but to bring honor to yourself. The Seventy Weeks Daniel wrote:
translation_verse: O AWURADE, tie; O AWURADE, fa yɛ bɔne kyɛ yɛ; O AWURADE, tie yɛ ná boka yɛ; nnɛkyɛ, o me Nyameɛ, ɔnate wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ ti, ofikyɛ wɔ dumaa yeɛ ɔla wɔ kuro ne ne wɔ maen ne aso ɔ.” Gabriel kyirekyire nu kyire Daniel

english_verse: I was still confessing my sins and those of all Israel to the Lord my God, and I was praying for the good of his holy mountain,
translation_verse: Na me noa wɔ so bɔ medwudwo, bɔ mebɔ mbaeɛ, bɔ mekã me bɔne ne me maen Yisrael bɔne, bɔ mefa me sufrɛ meto AWURADE me Nyameɛ nyunu mema me Nyameɛ bokaa krongron ne nen,

english_verse: when Gabriel suddenly came flying in at the time of the evening sacrifice. This was the same Gabriel I had seen in my vision,
translation_verse: bɔ né ngu so mebɔ mbaeɛ nen, biaa Gabriel bɔ nnili moa nwuni ye wɔ nyekyire nu ne, otuli ndɛndɛ wale me nwo berɛ ɔɔfale ye sa hane me, wɔ nɔsoa afɔleɛbɔlɛ mmerɛ ne anu.

english_verse: and he explained: Daniel, I am here to help you understand the vision.
translation_verse: Na ohyirehyirele me sele me kyɛ, “O Daniel, mawa kyɛ mebaafa ndeaseɛ ne nimdeɛ mema wɔ.

english_verse: God thinks highly of you, and at the very moment you started praying, I was sent to give you the answer.
translation_verse: Ɛhyɛle wɔ sufrɛ ne abo nen, mmuayɛɛ bie fili nu wale, na mawa kyɛ mebaahã mekyire wɔ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ kuro wɔ dwirɛ paa; yiti te edwirɛ ne abo, ná dwene nyekyire ne anwo.

english_verse: For one week this foreigner will make a firm agreement with many people, and halfway through this week, he will end all sacrifices and offerings. Then the “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction will be put there. And it will stay there until the time God has decided to destroy this one who destroys.
translation_verse: Ɔne mmeni pee bɛkɔyɛ apam kitii afoɛ nzoo. Na afoɛ nzoo ne, ye bue ko, ɔkɔbera ngaka afɔleɛbɔlɛ ne aleɛ afɔleɛbɔlɛ. Busueniɛ ne, ɔkɔfa akyiwadeɛ amoen ne kosie asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, kɔpem kyɛ ɛsɛkyelɛ mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ ahyehyɛ ato berɛ ama busueniɛ ne ɔkɔto ye ɔ.

english_verse: In the third year of Cyrus the king of Persia, a message came to Daniel from God, and it was explained in a vision. The message was about a dreadful war, and it was true.
translation_verse: Pɛsia hene Karose ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne anu, lale dwirɛ ali hyirele Daniel bɔ bɛtole ye dumaa Beltesasa ne. Edwirɛ ne te nahorɛ, na ɔte dwirɛ bɔ ɔyɛ se ɔ. Daniel tele edwirɛ ne abo, na onyane nyekyire ne anu ndeaseɛ.

english_verse: Daniel wrote: For three weeks I was in sorrow.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, me Daniel, né medi aworabɔlɛ dapɛn nza.

english_verse: I ate no fancy food or meat, I drank no wine, and I put no olive oil on my face or hair.
translation_verse: Manni aleɛ fɛɛ biala, naen anaa nzaa biala anga me noa, yeɛ mambopa toonn dapɛn nza mumua.

english_verse: Then, on the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was standing on the banks of the great Tigris River,
translation_verse: Na bosome bɔ oli moa ne, ye eleburanyɔ ɛlɛnna ne aso, né ngyi asue piri Tigrise noa.

english_verse: when I looked up and saw someone dressed in linen and wearing a solid gold belt.
translation_verse: Ndole me nye anwuro nneane, na nwuni biaa bie bɔ ɔhera nwera bɔ wafa Yufase sikaa kɔkorɛ wayɛ abɔsoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: His body was like a precious stone, his face like lightning, his eyes like flaming fires, his arms and legs like polished bronze, and his voice like the roar of a crowd.
translation_verse: Ye sonaluwaa ne, ɔte kyɛ nyɔboɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye bɛrile, ye nyunu te kyɛ agralaa, ye nye mmaa te kyɛ see bɔ ogye wuronyiwuronyi ɔ, ye sa ne ye gya nwo te kyɛ ayaa bɔ bahwi ye nwo ɔ, na odwudwo a ye komvi te kyɛ ɛlɔen komvi.

english_verse: Although the people who were with me did not see the vision, they became so frightened that they scattered and hid.
translation_verse: Me, Daniel, me ngome yeɛ nwuni nyekyire ne ɔ; ofikyɛ mmenia bɔ né bɛboka me so ne, bannwu nyekyire ne bie, nakoso ɛserɛ kandinga hane bɛ, na bɛnwatili bɛɛfeale.

english_verse: and at the sound of his voice, I fell facedown in a deep sleep.
translation_verse: Afei ndele ye komvi, na ndele ye komvi nen, nde ndɔle berɛ nnafele hatee bɔ né me nyunu butu berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and then said, “Daniel, your God thinks highly of you, and he has sent me. So stand up and pay close attention.” I stood trembling, while the angel said:
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, “O Daniel, bɔ Nyameɛ kuro wɔ dwirɛ paa ɔ, tie edwirɛ bɔ mekã mekyire wɔ ye, ná dwɔso gyina berɛ, ofikyɛ basoma me wɔ berɛ.” Na ye noa wɔ so bɔ ɔkã sɔ dwirɛ ne kyire me nen, ndwɔso ngyinane berɛ bɔ né me nwo wosowoso me ɔ.

english_verse: Daniel, don't be afraid! God has listened to your prayers since the first day you humbly asked for understanding, and he has sent me here.
translation_verse: Yeɛ osele me kyɛ, “Daniel, nnɛsuro, ofikyɛ ofi kyẽa bɔ ɛyɛle w’adwene kyɛ ɛkɔte ye bo, ná ɛbrɛle wɔ nwo ase wɔ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu nen, wate wɔ sufrɛ ne, na wɔ sufrɛ ne ati yeɛ mawa ɔ.

english_verse: I will tell you what is written in The Book of Truth. But first, you must realize that no one except Michael, the guardian angel of Israel, is on my side.
translation_verse: Nakoso ngɔla bɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ nahorɛ nwomaa ne anu ali ngohyire wɔ: ebiala ngo bie mmoka me so ndia ɛhemɔ, sana Mikayɛl, ɛmɔ katakyie ne ngome.

english_verse: Now I have come here to give you another vision about what will happen to your people in the future.
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔkɔto wɔ maen ne wɔ mmerɛ bɔ oli nziɛ ne anu ne, mawa kyɛ mebaamaa ɛte ye bo. Ofikyɛ sɔ nyekyire he, ɔfa mmerɛ bie bɔ ɔbaawa ɔ nwo.”

english_verse: While this angel was speaking to me, I stared at the ground, speechless.
translation_verse: Na ɔhane sɔ dwirɛ ne hyirele me nen, mvale me nyunu mutuli berɛ, na ndɔle mumu.

english_verse: Then he appeared in human form and touched my lips. I said, “Sir, this vision has brought me great pain and has drained my strength.
translation_verse: Na yieee, ebie bɔ ɔte kyɛ mmenia mmaa sɛso ɔ ɔfale ye sa hane me noa, na mmukyele me noa ndwudwole. Na nzele bɔ ogyi me nyunu berɛ ne kyɛ, “O me mene, nyekyire ne ama me nwo ngaka atu amini, na mabɔ fuin.

english_verse: I am merely your servant. How can I possibly speak with someone so powerful, when I am almost too weak to get my breath?”
translation_verse: Me mene, wɔ somvoɛ, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né me ne me mene yahora yadwudwo? Ofikyɛ afei de, me nwo ngaka atu amini, na me nwomeɛ ayie.”

english_verse: The angel touched me a second time and said, “Don't be frightened! God thinks highly of you, and he intends this for your good, so be brave and strong.” At this, I regained my strength and replied, “Please speak! You have already made me feel much better.”
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, “O, wɔ bɔ Nyameɛ kuro wɔ dwirɛ paa ɔ, nnɛsuro, asomdwee hã wɔ, gyina pindinn, ná ma w’ahone yɛ se.” Na odwudwo hyirele me nen, me nwo yɛle me se, na ngane kyɛ, “Me mene, dwudwo, ofikyɛ ama me nwo ayɛ me se.”

english_verse: Then the angel said: Now do you understand why I have come? Soon I must leave to fight against the guardian angel of Persia. Then after I have defeated him, the guardian angel of Greece will attack me.
translation_verse: Yeɛ obisale kyɛ, “Aso ɛse nikyee bɔ yiti yeɛ mawa wɔ berɛ ye? Afei de, ngosa ngɔhɔ me ne Pɛsia katakyie ne yɛkɔɔho, na sɛ mesi nu mekɔ a, tie, Hela katakyie ne kɔwa.

english_verse: You also need to know that I protected and helped Darius the Mede in his first year as king. The Angel's Message to Daniel Part One: The Four Kings and Their Successors
translation_verse: Na me de, Medeseniɛ Dario ahennie afoɛ bɔ oli moa ne anu, ngyinane ye si kyɛ memaa otindim.

english_verse: What I am going to tell you is certain to happen. Four kings will rule Persia, one after the other, but the fourth one will become much richer than the others. In fact, his wealth will make him so powerful that he will turn everyone against the kingdom of Greece.
translation_verse: “Afei, ngohyire wɔ nahorɛ ne: Tie, ahemvo nza bieku kodwɔso wɔ Pɛsia, na bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne, okonya ye nwo kɔtra bɛ mukoraa. Na sɛ ɔnate ye anwonya ne ati onya anwoserɛ a, okosi ebiala adua maa okodwɔso kotia Hela ahennie maen ne.

english_verse: Then a mighty king will come to power and will be able to do whatever he pleases.
translation_verse: Afei ɛhene katakyie bie kodwɔso, ɔkɔfa tumi piri koli hene, na bɔ okuro biala yeɛ ɔkɔyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: But suddenly his kingdom will be crushed and scattered to the four corners of the earth, where four more kingdoms will rise. But these won't be ruled by his descendants or be as powerful as his kingdom.
translation_verse: Na sɛ onya nyinasoɛ yie a, afei ye ahennie ne kɔbɔ, na nu kɔhyehyɛ kɔhɔ nyameɛso mvrama nna nemɔ anu; nakoso ongooli ye bosofoɛ mɔ sa, yeɛ tumi bɔ bɛkɔfa bekoli hene ne ɔngɔyɛ kyɛ ye deɛ ne; ofikyɛ ye ahennie ne kogyigya, na okooli ebiemɔ mbaen bɛ sa nu.

english_verse: The king of the south will grow powerful. Then one of his generals will rebel and will rule an even larger kingdom.
translation_verse: “Na ngwaen dɔ hene ne konya tumi, nakoso ye safohene nemɔ anu ko konya tumi kɔtra ye, na ye tumi ne kɔyɛ tumi piri.

english_verse: Years later the southern kingdom and the northern kingdom will make a treaty, and the daughter of the king of the south will marry the king of the north. But she will lose her power. Then she, her husband, their child, and the servants who came with her will all be killed. After this,
translation_verse: Na afoɛ biemɔ asi ne, bɛkɔyɛ apam, na ngwaen dɔ hene ne, ɔwa brasua kɔwa sorɔ dɔ hene ne berɛ kyɛ ɔne ye bɛbaayɛ asomdwee apam; nakoso braa ne, ye tumi ne ngoli gyina, yeɛ biaa ne ne ye tumi koso ngoli gyina. Bɛkɔye braa ne bɛkɔma, ɔne sona bɔ ɔwole ye ɔ, ɔne bɔ ɔhyɛle ye nguraen wɔ sɔ mmerɛ ne anu ne.

english_verse: one of her relatives will become the ruler of the southern kingdom. He will attack the army of the northern kingdom and capture its fortresses.
translation_verse: “Nakoso braa ne boso ndii ne bie ye nye kofifi kosi ye gya nu, na ɔkɔfa ɛlɔen kɔwa, ɔkɔhɔ sorɔ dɔ hene n’ahemvie, ɔkɔfa koɛ kɔteta bɛ, na okoli bɛ so ngonim.

english_verse: Then he will carry their idols to Egypt, together with their precious treasures of silver and gold, but it will be a long time before he attacks the northern kingdom again. Some years later
translation_verse: Okosa kɔsesa bɛ mmosoen, b’amoen mɔ bɔ bahuro nikyee bafa bayɔ ɔ, b’ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa kɔkorɛ mbembenanneɛ kɔhɔ Misraim. Na afei afoɛ pee kɔpɛ nu bɔ ɔngɔfa koɛ ngɔtoa sorɔ dɔ hene ne ɔ.

english_verse: the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom, but he will be forced back to his own country.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔkɔhɔ ngwaen dɔ hene n’ahennie ne anu, na afei okosa kɔhɔ ye bɔbɔ ye aseɛ so.

english_verse: The sons of the king of the north will gather a huge army that will sweep down like a roaring flood, reaching all the way to the fortress of the southern kingdom.
translation_verse: “Ye mma mɔ bekodwɔso kyɛ bɛkɔ koɛ, bɛkɔboaboa ɛlɔen kandinga yuu noa. Bɛ nu ko kɔwa wii kyɛ asue bɔ wayi ɔ, na okosa kɔho koɛ ne alaa koodwu ye ahemvie.

english_verse: But this will make the king of the south angry, and he will defeat this large army from the north.
translation_verse: Ngwaen dɔ hene ne, ole ɛyaa kɔwa, na ɔkɔfa koɛ kɔɔteta sorɔ dɔ hene ne. Na ɛhe kɔma sorɔ dɔ hene ne kɔboaboa ɛlɔen kandinga noa, nakoso okoli ngoguo wɔ ye nyunu.

english_verse: The king of the south will feel proud because of the many thousands he has killed. But his victories won't last long,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔkye ɛlɔen ne nnure ɔfa bɛ kɔ a, anwomasoɛ kɔwa ye nu, na okohũhũ mmenia apee buru pee, nakoso ongoli ngonim ngɔhyɛ.

english_verse: because the king of the north will gather a larger and more powerful army than ever before. Then in a few years, he will start invading other countries.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sorɔ dɔ hene ne kɔboaboa ɛlɔen pee noa bɔ ye somaa tra daa deɛ ne ɔ, na okosa kɔwa; na afoɛ biemɔ asi ne, ɔkɔfa ɛlɔen kandinga ne koɛhonɛ nningyein pee kɔwa.

english_verse: At this time many of your own people will try to make this vision come true by rebelling against the king of the south, but their rebellion will fail.
translation_verse: “Na sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, mmeni pee kodwɔso kotia ngwaen dɔ hene ne, na wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ maen ne anu patapaafoɛ nemɔ, bɛkɔmoma bɛ nwo so kyɛ bɛma nyekyire ne ɔba nu, nakoso bekoli ngoguo.

english_verse: Then the army from the north will surround and capture a fortress in the south, and not even the most experienced troops of the southern kingdom will be able to make them retreat.
translation_verse: Afei, sorɔ dɔ hene ne kɔwa, ɔkɔkyekye nyinasoɛ bɔ begyina so bɛfo fasue ɔ, na okoli nguro mɔ bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue nemɔ so ngonim. Ngwaen dɔ lɔen nemɔ ngɔhora ye noa gyina, koɛhonɛfoɛ paa paa nemɔ po bengonya anwoserɛ bengogyina ye noa.

english_verse: The king who invaded from the north will do as he pleases, and he will even capture and destroy the holy land.
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa koɛ kɔɔtoa ye nen, bɔ okuro biala yeɛ ɔkɔyɔ ɔ, ebiala ngɔhora ye nyunu gyina, okoogyina aseɛ nyemenenyemene ne aso, na ɔkɔfa ye tumi kɔsɛkye aseɛ ne.

english_verse: In fact, he will decide to invade the south with his entire army. Then he will attempt to make peace by giving the king of the south a bride from the northern kingdom, but this won't be successful.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔfa kosie ye nye so kyɛ ɔkɔfa ye ahennie ne amukoraa nu tumi kɔwa; na ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛtengyɛ ɔ kɔwa, ɔkɔma ye brasua maa okogya, amaa ɔnate so wanya atee wabɔ ahennie maen ne; nakoso apam ne ngogyina, yeɛ so ngɔwa mvasoɛ ngɔma ye.

english_verse: Afterwards, this proud king of the north will invade and conquer many of the nations along the coast, but a military leader will defeat him and make him lose his pride.
translation_verse: Ye si ye, ɔkɔfa ye nye kohyire nzuenoa maen nemɔ, na okoli bɛ nu pee so ngonim; nakoso safohene bie kɔbrɛ ye ahandaen ne ase, na ɔkɔma ye ahandaen ne kɔsa ye noa nu.

english_verse: He will retreat to his fortresses in his own country, but on the way he will be defeated and never again be seen.
translation_verse: Afei ɔkɔkakyi ye nye kohyire ye bɔbɔ ye aseɛ so anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne, nakoso okosoti kofi ase, na bengonwu ye ko.

english_verse: The next king of the north will try to collect taxes for the glory of his kingdom. However, he will come to a sudden end in some mysterious way, instead of in battle or because of someone's anger. Part Two: The Evil King from the North
translation_verse: “Na ebie kodwɔso kosi ye gya nu bɔ ɔkɔsoma ɛtoɔdidelɛniɛ bie maa ɔkɔfa ɛtoɔ kɔtaataa ahennie n’animnyam, nakoso mmerɛ kãa bie asi ne, bekohu ye bɔ ɔngɔyɛ ɛyaa so anaa koɛ nu ɔ.” Siria hene busueniɛ ne

english_verse: The successor of this king of the north will be a worthless nobody, who doesn't even come from a royal family. He will suddenly appear and gain control of the kingdom by treachery.
translation_verse: “Busueniɛ bie kodwɔso kosi ye gya nu, bɔ ɔte sona bɔ bamva ahennie animnyam bia ne bamma ye ɔ. Okofu bɛ nu kɔwa, na ɔnate ye noa dwirɛ menemene so okole ahennie ne.

english_verse: Then he will destroy armies and remove God's chosen high priest.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔprapra ye pɔfoɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛ boso bɔkɔɔ, okohũhũ bɛ ne apam ne anu sona titire ne.

english_verse: He will make a treaty, but he will be deceitful and break it, even though he has only a few followers.
translation_verse: Na sɛ maen maen mɔ bɛ ne ye bɛyɛ apam beyie a, ɔkɔfa nnakannaka atee so; na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ mmenia kãa bie yeɛ bekoli ye si ɔ de, nakoso okonya tumi.

english_verse: Without warning, he will successfully invade a wealthy province, which is something his ancestors never did. Then he will divide among his followers all of its treasures and property. But none of this will last very long.
