translation_verse: Mvum nu, ɔkɔwa aseɛ ne aso nekaa mɔ bɔ aseɛ ne kye aleɛ ɔ, na ɔkɔyɔ bɔ ye baba mɔ ne ye nana mɔ banyɔ ye le ɔ. Ɔkɔhyɛ koɛ nu nningyein, koɛ nu nzesadeɛ ne anwodeɛ kɔma ye mmenia. Ɔkɔbɔ anwoserɛ afealeɛ mɔ nwo porɛ, nakoso ɛhe kɔhɔ so mmerɛ kãa bie.

english_verse: He will gather a large and powerful army, and with great courage he will attack the king of the south. The king of the south will meet him with a much stronger army, but he will lose the battle, because he will be betrayed
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔfa koɛhonɛfoɛ pee kɔkanyane ye tumi ne ye ahoneserɛ kotia ngwaen dɔ hene ne. Ngwaen dɔ hene ne, ɔkɔfa koɛhonɛfoɛ anwoserɛfoɛ pee kɔhɔ koɛ, nakoso ɔngɔhora gyina, ofikyɛ bɛkɔbɔ ye ti so porɛ.

english_verse: by members of the royal court. He will be ruined, and most of his army will be slaughtered.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ ye yeɛ ɔma bɛ aleɛ ne po, bɛkɔpena ye asefinɛ, bekopia ye koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ boso bɛkɔhɔ, na bekohũhũ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ pee.

english_verse: The two kings will meet around a table and tell evil lies to each other. But their plans will fail, because God has already decided what will happen.
translation_verse: Nakoso ahemvo nyɔ nemɔ de, nzɛmmɔne yeɛ ɔkɔwa bɛ ti anu ɔ, na bɛkɔtena didipono ko anwo bɛkɔhã ngondombo dwirɛ; nakoso bɛ porɛbɔlɛ ne kɔyɛ mbaen, ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ ne dwu a, yeɛ b’ayieleɛ kɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: Then the king of the north will return to his country with great treasures. But on the way, he will attack the religion of God's people and do whatever else he pleases.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔfa nningyein bɔ wasesa ɔ pee kosa kɔhɔ ye aseɛ so, na okotu ye nye kosie apam krongron ne aso, bɔ okuro yeɛ ɔkɔyɔ ɔ, ná afei okosa kɔhɔ ye bɔbɔ ye aseɛ so.

english_verse: At the time God has decided, the king of the north will invade the southern kingdom again, but this time, things will be different.
translation_verse: “Na mmerɛ bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ ne dwu a, okosa kɔwa ngwaen dɔ, nakoso sɔ mmerɛ he de, ɔngɔyɔ kyɛbɔ ɔyɔle ye daa ne.

english_verse: Ships from the west will come to attack him, and he will be discouraged. Then he will start back to his own country and take out his anger on the religion of God's faithful people, while showing kindness to those who are unfaithful.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Kitim ɛlɛen mɔ kɔho kotia ye, na ye abasa nu kobu maa okosa ye si. Osa ye si a, ɔkɔfa ye anyeborolɛ kogua apam krongron ne aso. Osa ye si a, ɔne mmenia bɔ bayakyi apam krongron ne aso lilɛ ne bɛkɔbɔ nu bɛkɔyɛ ko.

english_verse: He will send troops to pollute the temple and the fortress, and he will stop the daily sacrifices. Then he will set up that “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔma ye koɛhonɛfoɛ mɔ bɛkɔfa efiɛ bɛkɔhã nekaa krongron ne, bɔ ɔte anwoserɛ ne; bɛkɔbera daa biala naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne, na bekogyina akyiwadeɛ bɔ ɔbɔ maen ne.

english_verse: The king will use deceit to win followers from those who are unfaithful to God, but those who remain faithful will do everything possible to oppose him.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bebu apam ne aso ne, ɔkɔfa ye noa dwirɛ menemene kɔhwehwe bɛ kɔsɛkye b’adwene; nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛse bɛ Nyameɛ ne de, bekosi bɛ hue bɛkɔho bekotia sɔ nikyee ne.

english_verse: Wise leaders will instruct many of the people. But for a while, some of these leaders will either be killed with swords or burned alive, or else robbed of their possessions and thrown into prison.
translation_verse: Na maen ne anu mmenia bɔ b’adwene nu pi ne, bekohyirehyire nu bekohyire mmeni pee maa bɛkɔte ye bo; ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa de, bɛkɔyera bɛ, bɛkɔhye bɛ nnure, yeɛ bɛkɔbɔ bɛ nningyein apaa mmerɛ kãa.

english_verse: They will receive only a little help in their time of trouble, and many of their followers will be treacherous.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bɛtotɔ a, mmokalɛ kãa bie yeɛ bekonya ɔ, na mmeni pee bɔ bɛ noa dwirɛ te menemene ɔ bɛkɔɔfa bɛ nwo bɛkɔbɔ bɛ.

english_verse: Some of those who are wise will suffer, so that God will make them pure and acceptable until the end, which will still come at the time he has decided.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛte badwemma ne, nu biemɔ kɔtotɔ, maa ɔnate so bɛkɔfa bekosale bɛ nwo, bɛkɔfa bɛkɔte bɛ nwo, bɛkɔfa bɛkɔma bɛ nwo kɔyɛ fitaa koodwu ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne; ofikyɛ sɔ mmerɛ ne kɔwa kyɛbɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ ne ala.

english_verse: This king will do as he pleases. He will proudly claim to be greater than any god and will insult the only true God. Indeed, he will be successful until God is no longer angry with his people.
translation_verse: “Ɛhene ne kɔyɔ bɔ okuro ɔ; ɔkɔmoma ye nwo so kɔyɛ ye nwo konguronn kohyire kyɛ ɔtra nyameɛ biala, na ɔkɔhã edwirɛ nwanwa kotia nyameɛ mɔ nu Nyameɛ ne, na okonya ngɔsoɛ koodwu kyɛ ahonehulɛ ne kɔwa nu ɔ, ofikyɛ bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ ne, ɔkɔwa nu.

english_verse: This king will reject the gods his ancestors worshiped and the god preferred by women. In fact, he will put himself above all gods
translation_verse: Ɔngɔfa ye nana mɔ nyameɛ nemɔ ngɔyɛ huu, ongobu bɔ mmrasua kuro ye dwirɛ ne, yeɛ ɔngɔfa nyameɛ foforɛ biala ngɔyɛ huu, ofikyɛ ɔkɔmoma ye nwo so kɔtra bɛ mukoraa.

english_verse: and worship only the so-called god of fortresses, who was unknown to his ancestors. And he will honor it with gold, silver, precious stones, and other costly gifts.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔfa anidie kɔma nyameɛ bie bɔ ɔbɔ nguro mɔ nwo waen ɔ mmom okosi bɛ gya nu. Na nyameɛ bie bɔ ye nana mɔ bɛnze ye ne, ɔkɔfa sikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ, nyɔboɛ bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se ɔ, ɔne mbembenanneɛ yeɛ okoli ye ni ɔ.

english_verse: With the help of this foreign god, he will capture the strongest fortresses. Everyone who worships this god will be put in a position of power and rewarded with wealth and land. Part Three: The Time of the End
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔkwaateta kuro bɔ ye nwo yɛ se a, maen bie aso nyameɛ yeɛ ɔkɔfa ye wora kowura ye nu ɔ; na bɛ bɔ bekole ye bɛkɔto nu ne, ɔkɔfa anidie kɔhyɛ bɛ animnyam. Ɔkɔmaa bekoli mmeni pee so tumi, na ɔkɔhyɛ aseɛ ne anu kɔma bɛ maa ɔkɔyɛ b’akatuaa.

english_verse: At the time of the end, the king of the south will attack the kingdom of the north. But its king will rush out like a storm with war chariots, cavalry, and many ships. Indeed, his forces will flood one country after another,
translation_verse: “Na ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne dwu a, ngwaen dɔ hene ne kɔfa koɛ kɔɔteta ye. Nakoso sorɔ dɔ hene ne kɔfa teaseɛnam mɔ ne pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ ne ɛlɛen pee kɔhɔ ye so kyɛ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ, na ɔkɔfa koɛ kɔteta maen maen pee kohwi kɔfa bɛ so kyɛ asue bɔ wayi ɔ.

english_verse: and when they reach the holy land, tens of thousands will be killed. But the countries of Edom and Moab and the ruler of Ammon will escape.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔwa aseɛ nyemenenyemene ne aso, na mmenia pee kɔtotɔ, nakoso ɛhemɔ de, bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu bekofi ye sa nu: Edom, Moabo ne Amonfoɛ atitirefoɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: The king of the north will invade many countries, including Egypt,
translation_verse: Ɔkɔfa koɛ kɔɔteta maen maen mɔ, na Misraim aseɛ ngɔfa ye nwo ngoli.

english_verse: and he will take its rich treasures of gold and silver. He will also conquer Libya and Ethiopia.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔsesa sikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ mbembenanneɛ ne Misraim mbembenanneɛ amukoraa, na Libiafoɛ ne Yitiopiafoɛ bekoowura ye bo.

english_verse: But he will be alarmed by news from the east and the north, and he will become furious and cause great destruction.
translation_verse: Nakoso ngraa bɔ ɔkɔte kofi eyia afiteleɛ bue nu dɔ ɔne sorɔ dɔ ne, ɔkɔma ye kunu kɔtete ye, na okotu kɔtengyɛ kɔhɔ mmenia pee so anyeborolɛ so, kyɛ ɔkwaahũhũ bɛ onua bɛ boso.

english_verse: After this, he will set up camp between the Mediterranean Sea and Mount Zion. Then he will be destroyed, and no one will be able to save him.
translation_verse: Na okosisi ye ahemvie ɛtena sua mɔ wɔ ɛpo ne, ɔne bokaa krongron nyemenenyemene ne b’afia; nakoso ye ayieleɛ kɔto ye bɔ ongonya ebiala ma ɔngɔboka ye ɔ.”

english_verse: Many of those who lie dead in the ground will rise from death. Some of them will be given eternal life, and others will receive nothing but eternal shame and disgrace.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ balela wɔ aseɛnwo nnɛterɛ nu ne, bɛ nu pee kotingye, ebiemɔ kɔhɔ daa ngoa nu, yeɛ ebiemɔ wora bɛkɔhɔ animguaseɛ ne nyanzoen bɔ olle ayieleɛ ɔ nu.

english_verse: Everyone who has been wise will shine as bright as the sky above, and everyone who has led others to please God will shine forever like the stars.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛte mmadwemma ne, bɛkɔta kyɛbɔ ewienu ta ɔ; yeɛ bɛ bɔ behyirehyirele mmeni pee maa bɛfale tenenee atee so ne, bɛ wora bɛkɔta kyɛ nzramaa afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Daniel, I now command you to keep the message of this book secret until the end of time, even though many people will go everywhere, searching for the knowledge to be found in it. The End of Time
translation_verse: Nakoso wɔ, Daniel, nnɛbɔ edwirɛ ne aso, na fa nzɔanoɛ sɔ nwomaa ne noa kɔpem kyɛ ayieleɛ ne kɔwa ɔ. Mmeni pee kɔpere bɛ nwo bekoli akɔneaba, na nimdeɛ kɔsone.”

english_verse: Daniel wrote: I looked around and saw two other people—one on this side of the river and one on the other side.
translation_verse: Afei me, Daniel, nneane, na yieee, né mmienzua nyɔ foforɛ begyigyi berɛ. Ko wɔ asue ne noa bue ko, yeɛ ko wora ɔwɔ asue ne noa bue ko.

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me was dressed in linen and was standing upstream from them. So one of the two beside the river asked him, “How long before these amazing things happen?”
translation_verse: Na ko bisale biaa bɔ ɔhera nwera, bɔ ɔwɔ asue ne anye ne kyɛ, “Ɔkwaadwu kyinzu yeɛ sɔ anwanwadeɛ hemɔ bɛkɔwa ayieleɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: The angel then raised both hands toward heaven and said, “In the name of the God who lives forever, I solemnly promise that it will be a time, two times, and half a time. Everything will be over, when the suffering of God's holy people comes to an end.”
translation_verse: Na biaa bɔ ɔhera nwera, bɔ ɔwɔ asue ne anye ne, ndele ye mmuayɛɛ ne. Ɔpagyale ye sa famaa ne ye sa bɛen hyirele nyameɛso, na ɔfale Ɛdangama bɔ ɔte ase daa ne tale ndaen kyɛ, “Okoodwu afoɛ nza ne bue; na sɛ bede maen krongron ne tumi befi ye sa nu beyie a, yeɛ ɛhemɔ amukoraa kɔwa nu ɔ.

english_verse: I heard what the angel said, but I didn't understand. So I asked, “Sir, how will it all end?” The angel in my vision then replied:
translation_verse: Ndele, nakoso mande ye bo, yiti mmisale kyɛ, “O me mene, sɛɛ yeɛ ɛhemɔ bekooyie ɔ?”

english_verse: Daniel, go about your business, because the meaning of this message will remain secret until the end of time.
translation_verse: Na obuale kyɛ, “Daniel, wɔ de kɔ, ofikyɛ edwirɛ nemɔ te mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ, na bafa nzɔanoɛ basɔ ye noa kɔpem ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne.

english_verse: Many people will have their hearts and lives made pure and clean, but those who are evil will keep on being evil and never understand. Only the wise will understand.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔte mmeni pee nwo bɛkɔyɛ bɛ nwo fitaa kɔma bɛ nwo kɔyɛ sannwuu; nakoso bɔnefoɛ de, bɔ ɔtte mayee yeɛ bɛkɔyɔ ɔ, na bɔnefoɛ nemɔ anu biala ngɔte ye bo; nakoso badwemmafoɛ de, bɛkɔte ye bo.

english_verse: So, Daniel, be faithful until the end! You will rest, and at the end of time, you will rise from death to receive your reward.
translation_verse: Nakoso wɔ de, kɔ w’atee maa oodwu ayieleɛ ne; ekole wɔ nwome, na ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne dwu a, ekodwɔso konya wɔ kyɛfa bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ bama wɔ ne.”

english_verse: I am Hosea son of Beeri. When Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah, and when Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel, the Lord spoke this message to me. Hosea's Family
translation_verse: Yuda ahemvo Yusia, Yotam, Ahase ne Hesekia, yeɛ Yoase awa Yisrael hene Yeroboam, b’ahennie aberɛ so ne, AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔlale ye ali hyirele Beeri awa Hosea ne, ye ɛhe.

english_verse: The Lord said, “Hosea, Israel has betrayed me like an unfaithful wife. Marry such a woman and have children by her.”
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ AWURADE hyɛle ye bo fale Hosea so dwudwole ne, AWURADE sele Hosea kyɛ, “Kɔ ná kogya braa gyanderaniɛ, ná ɛne ye bɛwo gyanderafoɛ mmaa, ofikyɛ aseɛ ne wabɔ adwaman kandinga paa, na wali AWURADE nwo makyebu.”

english_verse: So I married Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, and we had a son.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔhɔle oogyale Diblaim awa brasua Gomɛre. Ɔne ye bɛnwonzɛle, na ɔwole baa bienzua.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Hosea, name your son Jezreel, because I will soon punish the descendants of King Jehu of Israel for the murders he committed in Jezreel Valley. I will destroy his kingdom,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE sele Hosea kyɛ, “To ye dumaa Yesreel; ofikyɛ ɔngɔhyɛ biala, ngɔtɔ Yehu awuro ama so wereɛ wɔ Yesreel mogya nwo, na ngɔma Yisrael awuro ama ahennie so kɔpɛ.”

english_verse: and in Jezreel Valley I will break the power of Israel.”
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ngobubu Yisrael agyaen nu wɔ Yesreel bɔnza ne anu.”

english_verse: Later, Gomer had a daughter, and the Lord said, “Name her Lo-Ruhamah, because I will no longer have mercy and forgive Israel.
translation_verse: Osa nwonzɛle, na ɔwole baa brasua. Na AWURADE sele Hosea kyɛ, “To ye dumaa Lo Ruhama, ofikyɛ mengonwu Yisrael awuro ama anwumvoin ko bɔ ɔkɔmaa ngɔfa bɛ bɔne ngɔhyɛ bɛ bieku ɔ.

english_verse: But I am the Lord God of Judah, and I will have mercy and save Judah by my own power—not by wars and arrows or swords and cavalry.”
translation_verse: Nakoso ngonwu Yuda awuro ama anwumvoin, na ngɔfa AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ so ngɔpepɛ ngole bɛ. Mengɔfa agyaen anaa ngrandɛ, anaa koɛ, anaa mbɔngɔ, anaa mbɔngɔhanɛfoɛ so yeɛ ngɔpepɛ ngole bɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: After Gomer had stopped nursing Lo-Ruhamah, she had another son.
translation_verse: Na ɔpɛle Lo Ruhama nyɔfone ne, ɔnwonzɛle, na ɔwole baa bienzua.

english_verse: Then the Lord said, “Name him Lo-Ammi, because these people are not mine, and I am not their God.” Hope for Israel
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE sele kyɛ, “To ye dumaa Lo Ami, ofikyɛ nna me maen ole ɛmɔ, yeɛ me wora nnde ɛmɔ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Someday it will be impossible to count the people of Israel, because there will be as many of them as there are grains of sand along the seashore. They are now called “Not My People,” but in the future they will be called “Children of the Living God.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Yisraelfoɛ bɛ somaa kɔyɛ kyɛ mboanoa anweaa, bɔ bɛngora ye susu anaa bɛngora ye ka ɔ. Na nekaa bɔ bɛhã behyirele bɛ kyɛ, “Nna me maen ole ɛmɔ” nen, berɛ yeɛ bɛkɔhã bekohyire bɛ kyɛ, “Nyameɛ teasefoɛ mma ole ɛmɔ” ɔ.

english_verse: Israel and Judah will unite and choose one leader. Then they will take back their land, and this will be a great day for Jezreel.
translation_verse: Yudafoɛ ne Yisraelfoɛ bɛkɔbɔ nu bekoyia, ná bɛkɔye panyi ko maa okotua bɛ noa. Na bekofi aseɛ ne aso bɛkɔwa, ofikyɛ Yesreel kyẽa ne kɔyɛ kyẽa piri.

english_verse: So let your brothers be called “My People” and your sisters be called “Shown Mercy.” The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhã behyire ɛmɔ aliɛma mmienzua mɔ kyɛ, “Ami” yeɛ ɛmɔ aliɛma mmrasua mɔ kyɛ, “Ruhama.” Yisrael te braa bɔ ɔfa ohu asi ɔ

english_verse: Accuse! Accuse your mother! She is no longer my wife, and now I, the Lord, am not her husband. Beg her to give up prostitution and stop being unfaithful,
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔdwudwo behyire ɛmɔ ani, ɛ́mɔdwudwo behyire ye, ofikyɛ nna me ye ɔ, yeɛ ye koso nna ohu ole me. Odi kyɛ ɔye ye gyanderabɔlɛ ne fi ye nye so, na ɔye ye agyaasɛkyelɛ ne fi ye nyɔfone mɔ b’afia.

english_verse: or I will strip her naked like the day she was born. I will make her barren like a desert, and she will die of thirst.
translation_verse: Wamma ye sɔ a, ngɔpa ye nwo maa ye nwo kɔla so kyɛ kyẽa bɔ bɛwole ye ɔ; ngɔmaa ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ aseɛ pralaa so, ná wayɛ kyɛ aseɛ katerepee, na ngɔmaa nzuhɔen kohũ ye maa okowu.

english_verse: You children are the result of her unfaithfulness, and I'll show you no pity.
translation_verse: Na mengonwu ye mma mɔ anwumvoin kaala, ofikyɛ bɛte gyandera mmaa.

english_verse: Your mother was unfaithful. She was disgraceful and said, “I'll run after my lovers. Everything comes from them— my food and drink, my linen and wool, my olive oil and wine.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛ maame abɔ gyandera; bɔ ɔnwonzɛle bɛ ne wabɔ nyanzoen bra, ofikyɛ ɔnwa, ‘Me kurofoɛ mɔ bɔ bɛma me me noa aleɛ, me nzue, me boaen nwiaa ne me gyese, me ngoo ne me nzaa ne, ngogu bɛ so.’

english_verse: I, the Lord, will build a fence of thorns to block her path.
translation_verse: Yiti, tie, ngɔfa mmowue ngotua w’atee. Ngɔto waen ngɔfa ye nwo, amaa ɔnate so wannwu ye atee nemɔ.

english_verse: She will run after her lovers, but not catch them; she will search, but not find them. Then she will say, “I'll return to my first husband. Life was better then.”
translation_verse: Ɔkɔpo ye kurofoɛ nemɔ aso, nakoso ɔngɔto bɛ; ɔkɔpena bɛ, nakoso ongonwu bɛ. Na ɔkɔhã kyɛ, ‘Ngosa ngɔhɔ ngoogya me hu daa ne, ofikyɛ né nningyein kɔ so yé ma me tra ɛnɛ.’

english_verse: She didn't know that her grain, wine, and olive oil were gifts from me, as were the gold and silver she used in worshiping Baal.
translation_verse: Hmmm, né ɔnze kyɛ me yeɛ mane ye aburoo ne nzaa ne ngoo, kyɛ me yeɛ mmaa onyane ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ pee, bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛmane Baal ne ɔ.

english_verse: So I'll hold back the harvest of grain and grapes. I'll take back my wool and my linen that cover her body.
translation_verse: Yiti ngosa ngɔwa ngoole m’aburoo wɔ ye buberɛ nu, yeɛ me nzaa wɔ ye mmerɛ nu, na ngosa ngole me kundu ne me gyese bɔ mva ngatale ye nwo ne.

english_verse: Then I'll strip her naked in the sight of her lovers. No one can rescue her.
translation_verse: Na afei ngɔla ye nyanzoen bra ne ali wɔ ye kurofoɛ nemɔ nyunu, na ebiala ngɔpepɛ ngole ye ngofi me sa nu.

english_verse: I'll stop Israel's celebrations— no more New Moon Festivals, Sabbaths, or other feasts.
translation_verse: Ngɔma ye ahurusililɛ ne amukoraa bo kɔpɛ, yeɛ ye aluolue ngyẽa mɔ, ye ɛsraen foforɛ mɔ, ye afofingyẽa ne ye aluolue bɔ bahyehyɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: She said, “My lovers gave me vineyards and fig trees as payment for sex.” Now I, the Lord, will ruin her vineyards and fig trees; they will become clumps of weeds eaten by wild animals.
translation_verse: Ngɔsɛkye ye bobe ne ye borɔdoma mmakaa nemɔ, bɔ wahã wafa bɛ nwo kyɛ, ‘M’akatuaa bɔ me kurofoɛ mɔ bafa bama me ne, ye ɛhe’ ne; ngɔkakyi bɛ ɛhɔayeɛ, na eburo ngaka koli.

english_verse: I'll punish her for the days she worshiped Baal and burned incense to him. I'll punish her for the times she forgot about me and wore jewelry and rings to attract her lovers. I, the Lord, have spoken! The Lord Will Help Israel
translation_verse: Ngyẽa bɔ ɔfa sɔnene Baal mɔ ne, ngɔhwe ye so wɔ ye nwo, mmerɛ bɔ ɔyerale ɛyɛɛ mane bɛ, bɔ ɔfale ye asomade ne ye mbembenanneɛ mɔ siesiele ye nwo, oolili ye kurofoɛ nemɔ asi mane ye wora fili me ne, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, will lure you into the desert and speak gently to you.
translation_verse: Yiti tie, ngɔma me hurolɛ kɔwa ye nu, ngɔfa ye ngɔhɔ ɛserɛ so, na ngɔhã ɛkorɔkorɔlɛ dwirɛ ngohyire ye.

english_verse: I will return your vineyards, and then Trouble Valley will become Hopeful Valley. You will say “Yes” to me as you did in your youth, when leaving Egypt.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa ye bobe boo mɔ ngɔma ye wɔ berɛ, na ngɔma Akɔre bɔnza ne kɔyɛ anyelasoɛ anoa’. Berɛ yeɛ ɔkɔma mmuayɛɛ kyɛ ye ndaluwa nu ɔ, kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ ofi Misraim aseɛ so wale ne.

english_verse: I promise from that day on, you will call me your husband instead of your master.
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ɛkɔfrɛ me ‘Yisi’, na ɛngɔfrɛ me ‘Baali’ ko, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I will no longer even let you mention the names of those pagan gods that you called “Master.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngɔye Baal mɔ dumaa ngofi ye noa nu, na bɛngɔbɔ bɛ dumaa bɛngɔkaye bɛ ko.

english_verse: And I will agree to let you live in peace—you will no longer be attacked by wild animals and birds or by weapons of war.
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔyɛ apam ngɔma bɛ, me ne eburo ngaka, ewienu nnomaa, yeɛ ngaka bɔ bɛtwe bɛ nwo ase ɔ. Ngobubu agyaen, ngrandɛ ne koɛhonɛ nu ngofi aseɛ ye aso, na ngɔmaa bɛkɔlela berɛ asomdwee nu.

english_verse: I will accept you as my wife forever, and instead of a bride price I will give you justice, fairness, love, kindness,
translation_verse: Na ngɔbɔ wɔ asiwa ngɔma me nwo afebɔɔ; amba, ngɔbɔ wɔ asiwa ngɔma me nwo wɔ tenenee nu, pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ nu, ɔdɔ ne anwumvoinnwunɛ nu.

english_verse: and faithfulness. Then you will truly know who I am.
translation_verse: Ngɔbɔ wɔ asiwa ngɔma me nwo wɔ nahorɛlilɛ nu, na ekonwu AWURADE.

english_verse: I will command the sky to send rain on the earth,
translation_verse: “Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ngotie, ngɔfa mmuayɛɛ ngɔma nyameɛso, na bɛ koso bɛkɔfa mmuayɛɛ bɛkɔma aseɛ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: and it will produce grain, grapes, and olives in Jezreel Valley.
translation_verse: Na aseɛ kɔfa mmuayɛɛ kɔma aburoo, nzaa ne ngoo, na bɛ koso bɛkɔfa mmuayɛɛ bɛkɔma Yesreel.

english_verse: I will scatter the seeds and show mercy to Lo-Ruhamah. I will say to Lo-Ammi, “You are my people,” and they will answer, “You are our God.”
translation_verse: Ngolua ye ngɔma me nwo wɔ aseɛ ne aso. Ngonwu bɔ mannwu ye anwumvoin ne anwumvoin, na ngose bɔ ɔtte me maen ne kyɛ, ‘Ɛte me maen,’ na bɛ koso bɛkɔhã kyɛ, ‘Ɛte me Nyameɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Once again the Lord spoke to me. And this time he said, “Hosea, fall in love with an unfaithful woman who has a lover. Do this to show that I love the people of Israel, even though they worship idols and enjoy the offering cakes made with fruit.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Sa kohuro braa adwamanbɔlɛniɛ bɔ ɔte agyaasɛkyelɛniɛ ne, kyɛbɔ AWURADE kuro Yisraelfoɛ dwirɛ, nakoso bɛso nyameɛ foforɛ mɔ, ná bekuro borɔdoma bɔ babobɔ ye kunguma ɔ.”

english_verse: Then I said, “Now you are mine! You will have to remain faithful to me, though it will be a long time before we sleep together.”
translation_verse: Na nzele ye kyɛ, “Odi kyɛ ɛne me tena mmerɛ tendenn; nnɛbɔ gyandera, yeɛ nnɛfa wɔ nwo ma biaa foforɛ, na me koso sɔ yeɛ ngɔyɔ ngɔma wɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: It will also be a long time before Israel has a king or before sacrifices are offered at the temple or before there is any way to get guidance from God.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Yisraelfoɛ kɔtena mmerɛ tendenn bɔ belle hene, bɔ belle dehyeɛ, bɔ bɛmmɔ afɔleɛ, bɔ belle amoen, bɔ belle asɔfo ataadeɛ ne abusua amoen ɔ,

english_verse: But later, Israel will turn back to the Lord their God and to David their king. At that time they will come to the Lord with fear and trembling, and he will be good to them.
translation_verse: na ye si, Yisraelfoɛ kosa kɔwa bɛkɔɔpena AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ ne bɛ hene Dawide si atee, na bekosuro AWURADE ne ye anwumvoinnwunɛ wɔ ngyẽa bɔ oli nziɛ nemɔ anu.

english_verse: Israel, listen as the Lord accuses everyone in the land! No one is faithful or loyal or truly cares about God.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ, ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE noa dwirɛ; ofikyɛ AWURADE ne aseɛ ne aso ama banya dwirɛ, ɔnate kyɛ nahorɛlilɛ, anwumvoinnwunɛ, ɔne Nyameɛ nwo nimdeɛ biala nne aseɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Cursing, dishonesty, murder, robbery, unfaithfulness— these happen all the time. Violence is everywhere.
translation_verse: Ndaentalɛ, anoanupɛlɛ, awuelilɛ, awue ne adwamanbɔlɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ so ɔ’. Bebu mmeraa so, na mogya alaa yeɛ bɛkã begua ɔ.

english_verse: And so your land is a desert. Every living creature is dying— people and wild animals, birds and fish. The Lord Warns the Priests
translation_verse: Yiti aseɛ ne di aworabɔlɛ, na bɔ ɔwɔ so amukoraa ayɛ hodwoo: eburo ngaka, ewienu nnomaa, yeɛ ɛpo nu naen po bekoyie.

english_verse: Don't accuse just anyone! Not everyone is at fault. My case is against you, the priests.
translation_verse: Nakoso nnɛma ebiala odwudwodwudwo, anaa ofu obiɛngo: ofikyɛ wɔ maen te kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛ ne ɔsɔfo banya dwudwolɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You and the prophets will stumble day and night; I'll silence your mothers.
translation_verse: Yiti ekosoti eyia, na ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne koso ɔne wɔ bekosoti kɔngɔen, na ngonua wɔ maame boso.

english_verse: You priests have rejected me, and my people are destroyed by refusing to obey. Now I'll reject you and forget your children, because you have forgotten my Law.
translation_verse: Nimdeɛ bɔ wabɔ me maen ne ati, bɛ boso konua; ɔnate kyɛ apo nimdeɛ ne ati, me koso mapo wɔ, kyɛ ɛngɔyɛ me sɔfo. Ɔnate kyɛ wɔ wora afi wɔ Nyameɛ mmeraa ne ati, me koso me wora kofi wɔ mma mɔ.

english_verse: By adding more of you priests, you multiply the number of people who sin. Now I'll change your pride into shame.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ bɛhɔle so bɛsonene ne, sɔ alaa yeɛ bɛhɔle so bɛyɔle bɔne betiale me ɔ; yiti b’animnyam ne, ngɔkakyi ye animguaseɛ.

english_verse: You encourage others to sin, so you can stuff yourselves on their sin offerings.
translation_verse: Me maen, bɔne yeɛ ɔte b’aleɛ ɔ, na b’amumuyɛɛ yeɛ wali bɛ ti ɔ.

english_verse: That's why I will punish the people for their deeds, just as I will punish you priests.
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔkɔto maen ne nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔkɔto ɔsɔfo ɔ; ngɔhwe bɛ so wɔ bɛ bɔne nwo, na ngotua bɛ kerɛ kyɛbɔ bɛ yɔleɛ te ɔ.

english_verse: Their food won't satisfy, and having sex at pagan shrines won't produce children. My people have rebelled
translation_verse: Bekodidi, nakoso bɛ ko ngoyi; bɛkɔbɔ gyandera, nakoso bɛngɔta pee, ofikyɛ bapo AWURADE.

english_verse: You expect wooden idols and other objects of wood to give you advice. Lusting for sex at pagan shrines has made you unfaithful to me, your God.
translation_verse: Me maen kɔ bɛ mmakaa berɛ abisa, na bɛ pɔmaa yeɛ ɔye bɛ musue ɔ, ofikyɛ gyanderabɔlɛ sunzum amaa bali makyebu, na bafi bɛ Nyameɛ nwo baabɔ gyandera.

english_verse: You offer sacrifices on mountaintops and hills, under oak trees, and wherever good shade is found. Your own daughters and daughters-in-law sell themselves for sex.
translation_verse: Bɛbobɔ afɔleɛ wɔ mmokaa ti afia, bɛyera ɛyɛɛ wɔ pambaa mɔ so, yeɛ eluii, tanure ne ɛmee mɔ abo, ofikyɛ bɛ bo te fɔnwoo. Yiti ɛmɔ mma mmrasua mɔ kɔbɔ gyandera, na ɛmɔ aye mɔ kɔsɛkye agyaa.

english_verse: But I won't punish them. You men are to blame, because you go to prostitutes and offer sacrifices with them at pagan shrines. Your own foolishness will lead to your ruin.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔ mma mmrasua mɔ bɛbɔ gyandera, anaa sɛ ɛmɔ aye mɔ bɛsɛkye agyaa a, mengɔhwe bɛ so; ofikyɛ mmienzua nemɔ bɔbɔ deinn bɛkɔ gyanderafoɛ nemɔ nekaa, na bɛ ne asɔneyɛɛ so gyanderafoɛ yeɛ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ɔ. Yiti maen bɔ nimdeɛ abɔ ye ne, ɔkɔbɔ.

english_verse: Israel, you are unfaithful, but don't lead Judah to sin. Stop worshiping at Gilgal or at sinful Bethel. And quit making promises in my name—the name of the living Lord.
translation_verse: Wɔ, Yisrael, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛbɔ gyandera de, nakoso Yuda de, onni kyɛ ɔyɔ sɔ bie. Nnɛma ɛmɔba Gilgal, nnɛma ɛmɔkɔ Bete Awen, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔta ndaen kyɛ, “Kyɛ AWURADE te ase ye.”

english_verse: You are nothing more than a stubborn cow— so stubborn that I, the Lord, cannot feed you like lambs in an open pasture.
translation_verse: Yisrael so yɛ se kyɛ nandwie beleɛ akrɔngrɔma bɔ ye so yɛ se ɔ. Afei AWURADE kɔma bɛ aleɛ kyɛ boaen ba bɔ ɔwɔ aseɛ tɛtrɛtɛɛ bɔ ndire wɔ so ɔ so.

english_verse: You people of Israel are charmed by idols. Leave those people alone!
translation_verse: Efraim afa ye nwo wabɔ mmosoen, yiti po ye bra ma ye.

english_verse: You get drunk, then sleep with prostitutes; you would rather be vulgar than lead a decent life.
translation_verse: Bɛno bɛ nzaa ngapealaa ne a, gyandera alaa yeɛ bɛbɔ ɔ; animguaseɛ yeɛ bɛ mbanyi mɔ bekuro ɔ.

english_verse: And so you will be swept away in a whirlwind for sacrificing to idols.
translation_verse: Mvrama bie amoa ye awura ye ndaa nu, na ɔnate bɛ bosoen sɔnenɛ afɔleɛ nemɔ ati, bɛ nyunu kogua ase.

english_verse: Listen, you priests! Pay attention, Israel! Listen, you members of the royal family. Justice was your duty. But at Mizpah and Mount Tabor you trapped the people.
translation_verse: Ao asɔfo, ɛ́mɔtie edwirɛ he, ɛmɔ, Yisrael awuro ama, ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ betie. Ao, ɛhene awuro ama, ɛ́mɔtie, ofikyɛ ndɛenbualɛ ne, ɔ́ba ɛmɔ so; ofikyɛ ɛmɔakakyi ngaen wɔ Misepa, ɔne ɛtɛen bɔ batrɛtrɛ nu wɔ Tabɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: At the place of worship you were a treacherous pit, and I will punish you.
translation_verse: Ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛ́pena kyɛ bédi awue piri paa, nakoso ngɔhwe bɛ mukoraa bɛ so.

english_verse: Israel, I know all about you, and because of your unfaithfulness, I find you unacceptable.
translation_verse: Mese Efraim, na Yisrael koso ɔmvea me; afei, ao Efraim, abɔ gyandera, na Yisrael nwo agua fiɛ.

english_verse: Your evil deeds are the reason you won't return to me, your Lord God. And your constant craving for sex keeps you from knowing me.
translation_verse: Bɛ yɔleɛ mma bɛ ate mma benza bɛmma bɛ Nyameɛ berɛ; ofikyɛ gyanderabɔlɛ sunzum wɔ bɛ nu, na bɛnze AWURADE.

english_verse: Israel, your pride testifies to your guilt; it makes you stumble, and Judah stumbles too.
translation_verse: Yisrael anwomasoɛ di adanzeɛ tia ye. Yiti Yisrael ne Efraim bekosoti wɔ b’amumuyɛɛ nu; Yuda koso ɔne bɛ yeɛ bekosoti ɔ.

english_verse: You offer sheep and cattle as sacrifices to me, but I have turned away and refuse to be found.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔfa bɛ mmoaen kure ne bɛ nandwie kure bɛkɔhɔ kyɛ bɛkwaapena AWURADE. Nakoso bengonwu ye; wahwe ye nwo wafea bɛ.

english_verse: You have been unfaithful to me, your Lord; you have had children by prostitutes. So at the New Moon Festival, you and your crops will be destroyed. The Lord Warns Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Banni nahorɛ bamma AWURADE, ofikyɛ bawowo somaa mmaa. Bosome foforɛ ne kɔsɛkye bɛ ne bɛ boo mɔ.

english_verse: Give a warning on the trumpet! Let it be heard in Gibeah, Ramah, and sinful Bethel. Benjamin, watch out!
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔhu awɛen wɔ Gibea, yeɛ ɛ́mɔhu totorobɛndo wɔ Rama. Ɛ́mɔbɔ dawure wɔ Bete Awen, yɛli wɔ si, ao Benyamin.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will punish and wipe out Israel. This is my solemn promise to every tribe of Israel.
translation_verse: Efraim kɔkakyi kurofoen wɔ asohwenɛ kyẽa ne anu; mafa edwirɛ bɔ ɔkɔwa nu amba ɔ mato dwaa wɔ Yisrael mmusua kure nemɔ anu.

english_verse: Judah's leaders are like crooks who move boundary markers; that's why I will flood them with my anger.
translation_verse: Yuda ahemvo mɔ, bayɛ kyɛ mmenia bɔ betutu wɛen ɔ, yiti m’ahone kohu bɛ so kyɛ nzue.

english_verse: Israel was brutally crushed. They got what they deserved for worshiping useless idols.
translation_verse: Bɛhyɛ Efraim so, babua ye fɔ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ nu, ofikyɛ ɔhyɛle da lili mmeraa mbaen mbaen si.

english_verse: Now I, the Lord, will fill Israel with maggots and make Judah rot.
translation_verse: Yiti nde kyɛ mvrɔlɔ mema Efraim, na nde kyɛ nikyee porɔlowaa mema Yuda awuro ama.

english_verse: When Israel and Judah saw their sickness and wounds, Israel asked help from Assyria and its mighty king. But the king cannot cure them or heal their wounds.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Efraim nwuni ye anwonyerɛ, ná Yuda nwuni ye kena ne yeɛ Efraim hɔle Asiria ɔ, na ɔsomane maa bɛhɔle Nana Yarebo berɛ. Nakoso wangora wanza ɛmɔ anwonyerɛ, yeɛ wangora wamma ɛmɔ kena ne wangɔ.

english_verse: So I'll become a fierce lion attacking Israel and Judah. I'll snatch and carry off what I want, and no one can stop me.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngɔyɛ kyɛ gyata ngɔma Efraim, yeɛ ngɔyɛ kyɛ gyata ba ngɔma Yuda awuro ama. Me, me yeɛ ngɔtete bɛ nu pasapasa ngɔhɔ ɔ; ngɔfa ngɔhɔ, na ebiala ngɔpepɛ ngole ye.

english_verse: Then I'll return to my temple until they confess their guilt and worship me, until they are desperate and beg for my help.
translation_verse: Ngosa ngɔhɔ m’atenaleɛ berɛ, kɔpem kyɛ bekole bɛ bɔne bɛkɔto nu, ná bɛkɔpena me si atee ɔ. B’amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu, bɛkɔpena me si atee ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: Let's return to the Lord. He has torn us to shreds, but he will bandage our wounds and make us well.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔbra, ɛ́mɔma yɛsa yɛhɔ AWURADE berɛ, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ watete yɛ nu pasapasa ɔ, na ɔkɔsa yɛ anwonyerɛ; wapura yɛ, na okosa kɔkyekye yɛ ngena nemɔ aso.

english_verse: In two or three days he will heal us and restore our strength that we may live with him.
translation_verse: Elenyɔ asi, ɔkɔmaa yɛkosa yɛkonya ngoa, yoo, ye ɛlɛsa ne aso, ɔkɔpagya yɛ, na yɛkɔtena ngoa nu wɔ ye nyunu.

english_verse: Let's do our best to know the Lord. His coming is as certain as the morning sun; he will refresh us like rain renewing the earth in the springtime. The Lord Speaks to Israel and Judah
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma yɛnwu ye, ɛ́mɔma yɛpere yɛpena AWURADE nwo nimdeɛ. Ye walɛ ne, osi pi kyɛ ngyerɛmɔ; na ɔkɔwa yɛ berɛ kyɛ esue, kyɛ bamborɔ bɔ ɔtɔ gua aseɛ so ɔ.”

english_verse: People of Israel and Judah, what can I do with you? Your love for me disappears more quickly than mist or dew at sunrise.
translation_verse: Ao Efraim, nzikyɛ yeɛ mva nyɔ wɔ ɔ? Ao Yuda, nzikyɛ yeɛ mva nyɔ wɔ ɔ? Ɛmɔ nahorɛlilɛ te kyɛ ngyerɛmɔ munungum, na ɔte kyɛ bosue bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ ndɛndɛ ɔ.

english_verse: That's why I slaughtered you with the words of my prophets. That's why my judgments blazed like the dawning sun.
translation_verse: Yiti nnate me ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ so mapɛ bɛ magua, mafa me noa nu dwirɛ mahũhũ bɛ, na me ndɛenbualɛ te kyɛ kanea bɔ ɔ́ta ɔ.

english_verse: I'd rather for you to be faithful and to know me than to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ anwumvoinnwunɛ yeɛ mépena ɔ, na nna afɔleɛbɔlɛ ɔ; na Nyameɛ nwo nimdeɛ mmom yeɛ mekuro metra naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ mɔ ɔ.

english_verse: At a place named Adam, you betrayed me by breaking our agreement.
translation_verse: Na mmom babu apam ne aso kyɛ Adam ala, berɛ yeɛ banni nahorɛ bamma me ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone in Gilead is evil; your hands are stained with the blood of victims.
translation_verse: Gileade te amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɛ kuro, mogya agua wɔ nu maa efiɛ ahã ye.

english_verse: You priests are like a gang of robbers in ambush. On the road to Shechem you murder and commit other horrible crimes.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ awerɔm awuefoɛ kure bɛtetɛ sona ne, sɔ ala yeɛ asɔfo kure bɛbɔ porɛ bedi awue ɔ. Bedi awue wɔ Sɛkem atee so, amba, bɛbɔ musue.

english_verse: I have seen a terrible thing in Israel— you are unfaithful and unfit to worship me.
translation_verse: Manwu anwodwiri nikyee wɔ Yisrael awuro ama nu. Berɛ yeɛ Efraim gyanderabɔlɛ ne wɔ ɔ; Yisrael nwo agua fiɛ.

english_verse: People of Judah, your time is coming too. The Lord Wants To Help Israel I, the Lord, would like to make my nation prosper again
translation_verse: Ao Yuda, wɔ koso wahyehyɛ buberɛ wama wɔ, mmerɛ bɔ ngosa ngɔfa me maen ngofi nnurehyelɛ nu ngɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: and to heal its wounds. But then I see the crimes in Israel and Samaria. Everyone is deceitful; robbers roam the streets.
translation_verse: Mésa Yisrael anwonyerɛ a, né Efraim amumuyɛɛ ne Samaria bɔne yɔleɛ ɔ́da ali, ofikyɛ benni nahorɛ. Awueniɛ abɔ awura nu, na awerɔm awuefoɛ bɛbɔ apaa wɔ dwaaso.

english_verse: No one realizes that I have seen their sins surround them like a flood.
translation_verse: Na bɛndwene ye nwo wɔ bɛ ti anu kyɛ mekaye bɛ bɔne yɔleɛ amukoraa ɔ. Afei bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ yɔleɛ apɛ bɛ nwo ayia, na me nye tua.

english_verse: The king and his officials take great pleasure in their sin and deceit.
translation_verse: Bɛfa bɔne yɔleɛ bɛma ɛhene ne nye gye, na bɛfa bɛ ngondombo bɛma atitirefoɛ mɔ koso bɛ nye gye.

english_verse: On the day their king was crowned, his officials got him drunk, and he joined in their foolishness.
translation_verse: Yɛ hene ne, ye kyẽa ne, ye mbanyi mɔ bɛnone nzaa bɛyɛle tendaenn; ɔne ngorohoɛfoɛ yeɛ betu nu ɔ.

english_verse: Their anger is a fire that smolders all night, then flares up at dawn.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ basiesie b’ahone kyɛ foonoo, wɔ nnakannaka atee so, b’ahone kɔ so hu kɔngɔen amukoraa, na ngyerɛmɔ ɔsɔ kyɛ see bɔ ógye ɔ.

english_verse: They are flames destroying their leaders. And their kings are powerless; none of them trust me.
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa bayɛ hye kyɛ foonoo, bekũkũ bɛ maenbulɛfoɛ mɔ; b’ahemvo amukoraa batotɔ, na bɛ nu biala nne berɛ bɔ osũ frɛ me ɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel have mixed with foreigners; they are a thin piece of bread scorched on one side.
translation_verse: Efraim afa ye nwo wabɔ maen maen mɔ; Efraim te apiti bɔ bangakyi ɔ.

english_verse: They don't seem to realize how weak and feeble they are; their hair has turned gray, while foreigners rule.
translation_verse: Ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ ale ye anwoserɛ ne, nakoso ɔnze, amba, ye ti so amukoraa afu gyein, nakoso ɔnze.

english_verse: I am the Lord, their God, but in all of their troubles their pride keeps them from returning to me. No Help from Foreign Nations The Lord said:
translation_verse: Yisrael anwomasoɛ di adanzeɛ tia ye, nakoso benza bɛmma AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ berɛ, yeɛ ɛhe amukoraa si ne, bɛmbena ye si ate.

english_verse: Israel is a senseless bird, fluttering back and forth between Egypt and Assyria.
translation_verse: Efraim te kyɛ abubure kwaseaa bɔ olle adwene ɔ; bɛpena mmokalɛ befi Misraim berɛ, yeɛ bɛkɔ Asiria berɛ.

english_verse: But I will catch them in a net as hunters trap birds; I threatened to punish them, and indeed I will.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛkɔ a, ngɔtrɛ me tɛen nu ngɔkata bɛ so, ngɔtete bɛ ngogua ase kyɛ ewienu nnomaa; ngɔhwe bɛ so, kyɛbɔ bɛ mmenia bate ne ala.

english_verse: Trouble and destruction will be their reward for rejecting me. I would have rescued them, but they told me lies.
translation_verse: Bɛ yaakɔ oo! Ofikyɛ banwati bafi me nwo bahɔ. Amaneɛ ato bɛ, ofikyɛ bayɛ me nwo lɔen. Ahaa mekuro kyɛ mepepɛ mede bɛ, nakoso bɛpepɛ me nwo ngondombo.

english_verse: They don't really pray to me; they just howl in their beds. They have rejected me for Baal and slashed themselves, in the hope that Baal will bless their crops.
translation_verse: Bemvi b’ahone nu benzu bɛmvrɛ me, na mmom bɛbɔ awuye wɔ bɛ bɛen so; bɛpepɛ bɛ nwo naen bɛpena aburoo ne nzaa, na bɛyɛ me nwo lɔen.

english_verse: I taught them what they know, and I made them strong. Now they plot against me
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ me yeɛ mama bɛ ndeteyɛɛ, yeɛ mamaa banya anwoserɛ ɔ, nakoso bɛbɔ me nwo porɛ.

english_verse: and refuse to obey. They are more useless than a crooked arrow. Their leaders will die in war for saying foolish things. Egyptians will laugh at them.
translation_verse: Besa bɛ si, nakoso bɛmma Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne berɛ, bayɛ kyɛ nnakannaka agyaen, b’atitirefoɛ mɔ kɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa; ɔnate bɛ noa dwirɛ mvamva ne ati, mmenia kɔfa ɛhe kɔgoro bɛ nwo wɔ Misraim aseɛ so.

english_verse: Sound a warning! Israel, you broke our agreement and ignored my teaching. Now an eagle is swooping down to attack my land.
translation_verse: “Fa totorobɛndo ne tua wɔ noa! Ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ kɔleɛ kɔwa AWURADE awuro ne aso, ofikyɛ babu m’apam ne aso, na bato me mmeraa ne.

english_verse: Israel, you say, “We claim you, the Lord, as our God.”
translation_verse: Bekosu bɛkɔfrɛ me kyɛ, ‘Me Nyameɛ, yɛ Yisraelfoɛ, yɛse wɔ.’

english_verse: But your enemies will chase you for rejecting our good agreement.
translation_verse: Yisrael agyi nikye paa ne wato, na pɔfoɛ ne kɔfoa ye.

english_verse: You chose kings and leaders without consulting me; you made silver and gold idols that led to your downfall.
translation_verse: Basisi ahemvo bɔ nna me yeɛ nzili ɔ, babobɔ mbanyi bɔ menze ye nwo hwee ɔ; bafa b’ɛdwetɛ ne esikaa kɔkorɛ bayɔ mmosoen bama bɛ nwo, bɔ ɔnate so ɔngɔma ongoyie bɛ yé ɔ.

english_verse: City of Samaria, I'm angry because of your idol in the shape of a calf. When will you ever be innocent again?
translation_verse: Ao Samaria, wapo wɔ nandwie ba ne, m’ahone ahu bɛ so; ɔkwaadwu kyinzu yeɛ bɛngɔbɔ anwotelɛ bra ɔ?

english_verse: Someone from Israel built that idol for you, but only I am God. And so it will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ye koso ofi Yisrael: dwumvoɛ yeɛ ɔyɔle ɔ, yiti nna Nyameɛ ɔ. Samaria nandwie ba ne, bekobubu ye nu pasapasa.

english_verse: If you scatter wind instead of wheat, you will harvest a whirlwind and have no wheat. Even if you harvest grain, enemies will steal it all.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bedua mvrama, na mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ yeɛ bɛkɔpɛ ɔ. Aburoo ne wambɛnzɛ, na ɔngɔfa mmaa. Sɛ ɔfa mmaa po a, ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ yeɛ bekoli ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, you are ruined, and now the nations consider you worthless.
translation_verse: Bahye Yisrael bame; afei bɛte kyɛ kukue bɔ mvasoɛ nne so ɔ, wɔ maen maen mɔ nu.

english_verse: You are like a wild donkey that goes its own way. You've run off to Assyria and hired them as allies.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ baapena mmokalɛ wɔ Asiria, eburo afunum bɔ ye ngome okyinikyini ɔ. Efraim abɔ bɛ bɔ bekuro ye ɔ mɔ paa.

english_verse: You can bargain with nations, but I'll catch you anyway. Soon you will suffer abuse by kings and rulers.
translation_verse: Amba, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛbɔ abiɛngoɛ mɔ paa wɔ maen maen nemɔ nu de, nakoso ngɔboa bɛ noa; na ahemvo mmaa mmaa mɔ hene ne, ye nhyɛsoɛ ne ati, bekoli aworabɔlɛ kãa.

english_verse: Israel, you have built many altars where you offer sacrifices for sin. But these altars have become places for sin.
translation_verse: Efraim asisi bɔne nwo afɔleɛ mmokyea pee, nakoso bakakyi ye so bɔneyɔlɛ afɔleɛ mmokyea.

english_verse: My instructions for sacrifices were written in detail, but you ignored them.
translation_verse: Mahyerɛ me mmeraa ne anu dwirɛ apee apee pee mama ye, nakoso bebuli bɛ kyɛ amanvrafoɛ nikye.

english_verse: You sacrifice your best animals and eat the sacrificial meals, but I, the Lord, refuse your offerings. I will remember your sins and punish you. Then you will return to Egypt.
translation_verse: M’ayɛyelɛ afɔleɛ ne, bɛfa naen bɛbɔ, bedi, nakoso AWURADE onne bɛ ndo nu. Afei ɔkɔkaye b’amumuyɛɛ, ɔkɔhwe bɛ so wɔ bɛ bɔne nwo, na bekosa bɛkɔhɔ Misraim.

english_verse: Israel, I created you, but you forgot me. You and Judah built palaces and many strong cities. Now I will send fire to destroy your towns and fortresses.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Yisrael wora afi bɔ ɔbɔle ye ɔ, wasisi asɔneyɛɛ sua mɔ; Yuda akyekye nguro pee bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue ɔ, nakoso ngɔtɔ see ngogua ye nguro nemɔ aso, na ɔkɔyera ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: Israel, don't celebrate or make noisy shouts like other nations. You have been unfaithful to your God. Wherever grain is threshed, you behave like prostitutes because you enjoy the money you receive.
translation_verse: Ao Yisrael, nnɛdi ahurusi! Nnɛma wɔ nye gye kyɛ maen maen nemɔ, ofikyɛ afi wɔ Nyameɛ si aabɔ gyandera. Ahuro gyanderaniɛ akatuaa, wɔ nekaa amukoraa bɔ bɛboro aburoo ɔ.

english_verse: and you will have to leave the land of the Lord. Some of you will go to Egypt; others will go to Assyria and eat unclean food.
translation_verse: Bɛngɔtena AWURADE aseɛ ne aso, na mmom Efraim kosa kɔhɔ Misraim, na bekoli nningyein bɔ bɛ nwo nde ɔ wɔ Asiria.

english_verse: You won't be able to offer sacrifices of wine to the Lord. None of your sacrifices will please him— they will be unclean like food offered to the dead. Your food will only be used to satisfy your hunger; none of it will be brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Bɛngɔbɔ anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɛngɔma AWURADE, yeɛ b’afɔleɛ mɔ ngɔsɔ ye nye. B’afɔleɛ kɔyɛ kyɛ ɛsɛenvoɛ aleɛ kɔma bɛ; ebiala bɔ okoli bie ne, ye nwo kogua fiɛ, ofikyɛ b’aleɛ ne, bɛ bɔbɔ yeɛ bekoli ɔ, na ɔngɔwa AWURADE awuro berɛ.

english_verse: You will no longer be able to celebrate the festival of the Lord.
translation_verse: Aluolue kyẽa bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ ne, AWURADE poentolɛ kyẽa ne dwu a, nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkɔyɔ ɔ?

english_verse: Even if you escape alive, you will end up in Egypt and be buried in Memphis. Your silver treasures will be lost among weeds; thorns will sprout in your tents.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, tie, ɔnate ehuhunɛ ne ati, mmenia nemɔ banwati bahɔ. Misraim kɔboa bɛ noa, na Memfise kosie bɛ. Ndetema kofifi nekaa bɔ bɛ dwetɛ nningyein paa gua ne, na agurɛ kofifi bɛ tena sua nemɔ anu.

english_verse: Israel, the time has come. You will get what you deserve, and you will know it. “Prophets are fools,” you say. “And God's messengers are crazy.” Your terrible guilt has filled you with hatred.
translation_verse: Asohwenɛ ngyẽa ne adwu berɛ, akatuaa ngyẽa ne adwu berɛ. Yisrael kobu ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne kyɛ ɔte kwaseaa, yeɛ sunzum nu sona ne kyɛ wabɔ laen, ɔnate w’amumuyɛɛ somaa ne, ɔne ɛpɔen piri ne ati.

english_verse: Israel, the Lord sent me to look after you. But you trap his prophets and flood his temple with your hatred.
translation_verse: Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne te Efraim wɛmvoɛ, me Nyameɛ maen ne, nakoso ngaensualɛniɛ asua ye ngaen wɔ ye atee amukoraa nu, na bɛpɔ ye wɔ ye Nyameɛ awuro.

english_verse: You are brutal and corrupt, as were the men of Gibeah. But God remembers your sin, and you will be punished. Sin's Terrible Results
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔbɔ bagua bɛ nwo fiɛ paa, kyɛ Gibea mmerɛ ne anu ala; yiti ɔkɔkaye b’amumuyɛɛ, na ɔkɔhwe bɛ so bɛ bɔne nwo.

english_verse: Israel, when I, the Lord, found you long ago it was like finding grapes in a barren desert or tender young figs. Then you worshiped Baal Peor, that disgusting idol, and you became as disgusting as the idol you loved.
translation_verse: Nwuni Yisrael kyɛ ɛserɛ so bobe mma. Nwuni ɛmɔ nana mɔ kyɛ bobe mma bɔ wali moa wasu wɔ ye sulɛ mmerɛ bɔ oli moa nu ɔ. Nakoso bedwuli Baal Peɔ nen, beguale bɛ nwo fiɛ bɛbɔle nyanzoen bra, na bɛ bɔbɔ bɛkakyili akyiwadeɛ te kyɛ nningyein bɔ né bekuro ne ala.

english_verse: And so, Israel, your glory will fly away like birds— your women will no longer be able to give birth.
translation_verse: Efraim de, b’animnyam kotu kɔhɔ kyɛ anomaa, aworɛ nne berɛ ko, nwonzɛen nne berɛ ko, yeɛ ebiala mva koɛ ko!

english_verse: Even if you do have children, I will take them all and leave you to mourn. I will turn away, and you will sink down in deep trouble.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛtete mmaa po a, ngɔmaa bekoli abawuo bɔ baa ko po ngɔha ɔ; amba, sɛ meyakyi bɛ nu a, bɛ yaakɔ!

english_verse: Israel, when I first met you, I thought of you as palm trees growing in fertile ground. Now you lead your people out, only to be slaughtered. Hosea's Advice
translation_verse: Nwuni Efraim kyɛ Tiro bɔ balua ye wɔ aseɛ paa so ɔ, nakoso Efraim kɔfa ye mma kɔɔma kodiawuniɛ ne.

english_verse: Our Lord, do just one thing for your people— make their women unable to have children or to nurse their babies. The Lord's Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, fa ma bɛ e! Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛkɔfa kɔma bɛ ɔ? Ma bɛ koɛ bɔ ɔpɔ baa, ɔne nyɔfone bɔ nzue nne nu ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, I first began to hate you because you did evil at Gilgal. Now I will chase you out of my house. No longer will I love you; your leaders betrayed me.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔne yɔleɛ amukoraa wɔ Gilgal, ofikyɛ berɛ yeɛ nhyɛle ye bo mbɔle bɛ ɔ. Ɔnate bɛ bɔne yɔleɛ ne ati, ngɔfoa bɛ ngofi m’awuro, mengohuro bɛ dwirɛ ko; b’atitire amukoraa bɛte ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ.

english_verse: Israel, you are a vine with dried-up roots and fruitless branches. Even if you had more children and loved them dearly, I would slaughter them all. Hosea Warns Israel
translation_verse: Bafa nikyee babɔ Efraim, bɛ ndii akese, bengosu mmaa. Sɛ bɛwo mmaa po a, ngohũ bɛ mma mɔ bɔ b’ahone la bɛ nwo paa ne.

english_verse: Israel, you disobeyed my God. Now he will force you to roam from nation to nation.
translation_verse: Me Nyameɛ kɔpo bɛ, ofikyɛ banyɛ sotie bamma ye, na bekohyinihyini maen maen mɔ so.

english_verse: You were a healthy vine covered with grapes. But the more grapes you grew, the more altars you built; the better off you became, the better shrines you set up for pagan gods.
translation_verse: Yisrael te bobe paa bɔ osu ye mma ɔ; kyɛbɔ ye mma begu so bɛsone ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ye afɔleɛ mmokyea begu so bɛsone ɔ; kyɛbɔ ye aseɛ ne osi yɛ nyemene ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛyɛle b’amoen mɔ nyemenenyemene ɔ.

english_verse: You are deceitful and disloyal. So you will pay for your sins, because the Lord will destroy your altars and images.
translation_verse: B’adwene ayɛ ndaa ndaa, afei odi kyɛ bɛsoa bɛ mvomsoɛ; AWURADE kobubu b’afɔleɛ mmokyea mɔ, na ɔkɔsɛkye b’amoen nemɔ.

english_verse: “We don't have a king,” you will say. “We don't fear the Lord. And what good are kings?”
translation_verse: Na afei de, bɛkɔhã kyɛ, “Yɛlle hene biala, ofikyɛ yanzuro AWURADE, na ɛhene de, nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔyɔ kɔma yɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Israel, you break treaties and don't keep promises; you turn justice into poisonous weeds where healthy plants should grow.
translation_verse: Bɛkekã edwirɛ mbaen mbaen; bɛta ndaen mbaen mbaen bɛfa bɛyeyɛ apam; yiti ndɛenbualɛ fifi wɔ bɛ nu kyɛ anafranaku, bɔ ofifi kofie so wɔ fieso ɔ.

english_verse: All who live in Samaria tremble with concern for the idols at sinful Bethel. The idol there was the pride of the priests, but it has been put to shame; now everyone will cry.
translation_verse: Bete Awen nandwie mmaa nemɔ ati, ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ Samariafoɛ so. Ofikyɛ ye mmenia koli ye nwo aworabɔlɛ, yeɛ ye ahɔmeɛ mɔ bɔ né bedi ye animnyam nwo ahurusi ne, bɛ koso sɔ ala, ɔnate kyɛ ye animnyam ne watu wamini wafi ye nu.

english_verse: It will be taken to Assyria and given to the great king. Then Israel will be disgraced for worshiping that idol.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔsoa bɛkɔhɔ Asiria bɛkɔɔyɛ akyɛdeɛ bɛkɔma Nana Yarebo; Efraim nyunu kogua ase, na Yisrael kɔfɛre ye bɔbɔ ye agyirɛ bɔ watu ɔ nwo.

english_verse: Like a twig in a stream, the king of Samaria will be swept away.
translation_verse: Samaria de, bɛkɔpɛ ye hene asue kyɛ asue nye ahure.

english_verse: The altars at sinful Bethel will be destroyed for causing Israel to sin; they will be grown over with thorns and thistles. Then everyone will beg the mountains and hills to cover and protect them. The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
translation_verse: Yisrael bɔne, bɔ ye ole Awen asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ ne, bɛkɔsɛkye bɛ. Mmowue ne ɛfone kofifi b’afɔleɛ mmokyea nemɔ aso; na bekose mmokaa nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔkata yɛ so”, ná base pambaa nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔdwiri begua yɛ so.”

english_verse: Israel, you have never stopped sinning since that time at Gibeah. That's why you will be attacked at Gibeah.
translation_verse: Ao Yisrael, ayɔ bɔne fi Gibea mmerɛ ne; berɛ yeɛ bɛtoale bɔne ne aso ɔ. Aso koɛ ammu amva amumuyɛɛfoɛ nemɔ aso wɔ Gibea?

english_verse: Your sins have doubled, and you are rebellious. Now I have decided to send nations to attack and put you in chains.
translation_verse: Mepena kyɛ metwe bɛ so, na maen maen mɔ bɛkɔboa bɛ noa, bekodwɔso bekotia bɛ, ɔnate b’amumuyɛɛ mmɔhoɛ ne ati.

english_verse: Once you were obedient like a calf that loved to thresh grain. But I will put a harness on your beautiful neck; you and Judah must plow and cultivate the ground.
translation_verse: Né Efraim te nandwie akrɔngrɔma bɔ batete ye bɔ aburoo borolɛ yeɛ okuro ɔ. Nakoso ngɔfa kɔnnua ngɔto ye kɔme nyemenenyemene ne anu, ngɔma Efraim kɔhwe nningyein ne, Yuda kofundam aseɛ ne, na Yakob kofurofuro nnɛterɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Plow your fields, scatter seeds of justice, and harvest faithfulness. Worship me, the Lord, and I will send my saving power down like rain.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔlua tenenee bɛ́ma ɛmɔ nwo, ɛ́mɔbu ye wɔ anwumvoinnwunɛ nu, ɛ́mɔso ɛmɔ hɔayeɛ too ne. Ofikyɛ mmerɛ aso kyɛ ɛmɔpena AWURADE si atee ɔ, kɔpem kyɛ ɔkɔwa kɔɔtɔ tenenee nzue kogua ɛmɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: You have planted evil, harvested injustice, and eaten the fruit of your lies. You trusted your own strength and your powerful forces.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔafundam bɔne yɔleɛ, ɛmɔapɛ amumuyɛɛ; ɛmɔali ngondombo mmaa. Ofikyɛ ɛfale wɔ nwo tole w’anwoserɛ so, wɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ ahoneserɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛ somaa so.

english_verse: So war will break out, and your fortresses will be destroyed. Your enemies will do to you what Shalman did to the people of Beth-Arbel— mothers and their children will be beaten to death against rocks.
translation_verse: Yiti koɛ nu bagyabagya kodwɔso wɔ wɔ maen ne anu, na bɛkɔsɛkye w’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne amukoraa, kyɛbɔ Salman sɛkyele Bete Arabel wɔ koɛhonɛ kyẽa ne anu ne; bɛtele niɛ mɔ beefini mmaa mɔ so maa niɛ nemɔ anu tetele pasapasa.

english_verse: Bethel, this will be your fate because of your evil. Israel, at dawn your king will be killed.
translation_verse: Ao Betel, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛkɔfa bekoli ɛmɔ ɔ, ɔnate ɛmɔ bɔne kandinga ne ati. Ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu yeɛ bɛkɔpɛ Yisrael hene asue koraa ɔ.

english_verse: When Israel was a child, I loved him, and I called my son out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Yisrael te akwadaa nen, né mekuro ye dwirɛ, na Misraim yeɛ mvrɛle mma bienzua ne mvili ɔ.

english_verse: But as the saying goes, “The more they were called, the more they rebelled.” They never stopped offering incense and sacrifices to the idols of Baal.
translation_verse: Na ngu so bɔ mefrɛ bɛ ne, né me nwo ala yeɛ befi bɛkɔ ɔ. Bɛbobɔle afɔleɛ mɔ bɛmane Baal mɔ, na bɛyerale ɛyɛɛ bɛmane amoen mɔ.

english_verse: I took Israel by the arm and taught them to walk. But they would not admit that I was the one who had healed them.
translation_verse: Me yeɛ ngyirekyirele Efraim natelɛ ɔ, ngyili ye wɔ me sa so, nakoso né bɛnze kyɛ me yeɛ nzale bɛ anwonyerɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I led them with kindness and with love, not with ropes. I held them close to me; I bent down to feed them.
translation_verse: Mvale anwumvoinnwunɛ nyamaa yeɛ ndwetwene bɛ ɔ, mvale ɔdɔ nyamaa; na nyɛle kyɛ ebie bɔ ɔsangye b’awogyee kɔnnua ɔ mmane bɛ, na ngunduni bɛ nwo berɛ mmane bɛ aleɛ.

english_verse: But they rejected me, and so must return to Egypt; now Assyria will rule them.
translation_verse: Ongosa ngɔhɔ Misraim aseɛ so, na mmom Asiria koli ye so hene, ofikyɛ bapo kyɛ bekosa bɛkɔwa me berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: My people are determined to reject me for a god they think is stronger, but he can't help.
translation_verse: Me maen asi bɛ hue kyɛ bɛtwe bɛ nwo befi me nwo, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛfrɛle bɛ kyɛ bɛhã bɛhɔ Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne anwo, nakoso bɛ nu biala wangamvo ye.

english_verse: Israel, I can't let you go. I can't give you up. How could I possibly destroy you as I did the towns of Admah and Zeboiim? I just can't do it. My feelings for you are much too strong.
translation_verse: Ao Efraim, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né maye wɔ mama? Ao Yisrael, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né maye me sa mafi wɔ bo? Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né masɛkye wɔ kyɛ Adema? Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né mabɔ wɔ tɔɔ kyɛ Seboyim? Me nyaa woso wɔ me kunu, ao, m’anwumvoinnwunɛ ayɛ piri paa.

english_verse: Israel, I won't lose my temper and destroy you again. I am the Holy God— not merely some human, and I won't stay angry.
translation_verse: Me yaafɛlɛ kandinga ne, mengɔye mengofite, mengosa mengɔsɛkye Efraim ko, ofikyɛ nde Nyameɛ, na nnde sona; nde Krongronniɛ bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ nu ɔ, na mengɔwa mengɔsɛkye kuro ne.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will roar like a lion, and my children will return, trembling from the west.
translation_verse: Bekoli AWURADE si. Afei ɔkɔbobɔ nu kyɛ gyata, na sɛ ɔbobɔ nu a, ye mmaa mɔ kofi eyia atɔleɛ bɛkɔwa bɔ bɛ nwo wosowoso bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: They will come back, fluttering like birds from Egypt or like doves from Assyria. Then I will bring them back to their homes. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel and Judah Compared
translation_verse: Bekofi Misraim bɛkɔwa bɔ bɛ nwo wosowoso bɛ kyɛ anomaa ɔ, ɔne Asiria aseɛ so bɛkɔwa bɔ bɛ nwo wosowoso bɛ kyɛ abubure ɔ, na ngɔfa bɛ ngɔtena b’awuro mɔ nu, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Israel is deceitful to me, their loyal and holy God; they surround me with lies, and Judah worships other gods.
translation_verse: Efraim afa ngondombo wapɛ me nwo wayia, yeɛ Yisrael awuro ama koso, bafa nnakannaka bapɛ me nwo bayia. Nakoso Yuda de, ɔtɛ ne Nyameɛ nate; na odi nahorɛ ma Krongronniɛ ne.

english_verse: All day long Israel chases wind from the desert; deceit and violence are found everywhere. Treaties are made with Assyria; olive oil is taken to Egypt. Israel and Judah Condemned
translation_verse: Efraim li mvrama si, na ogu eyia afiteleɛ mvrama so daa biala. Ɔma ye anoanupɛlɛ ne basabasayɔlɛ ɔkɔ so yɛ pee, bɛ ne Asiria bɛyɛ apam, na bɛsoa ngoo bɛkɔ Misraim.

english_verse: The Lord also brings charges against the people of Judah, the descendants of Jacob. He will punish them for what they have done.
translation_verse: AWURADE le dwirɛ tia Yuda. Ɔkɔhwe Yakob so kyɛbɔ ye yɔleɛ te ɔ, na okotua ye kerɛ kyɛbɔ ye nnwumaa te ɔ.

english_verse: Even before Jacob was born, he cheated his brother, and when he grew up, he fought against God.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔle oliɛma gya si wɔ bɛ kunu, na ole ye anwoserɛ ɔne Nyameɛ bɛfa bɛtetale so.

english_verse: At Bethel, Jacob wrestled with an angel and won; then with tears in his eyes, he asked for a blessing, and God spoke to us there.
translation_verse: Amba, ɔne abɔfo ne bɛtetale so, na olili ngonim, osuni, na ɔkoto srɛle ye. Onwuni Nyameɛ wɔ Betel, na berɛ yeɛ Nyameɛ ne yɛ dwudwole ɔ.

english_verse: God's name is the Lord, the Lord God All-Powerful.
translation_verse: AWURADE Asafo Nyameɛ, ye dumaa bɔ bɛfa bɛkaye ye ole AWURADE.

english_verse: So return to your God. Patiently trust him, and show love and justice.
translation_verse: “Yiti sa kɔ wɔ Nyameɛ berɛ, sɔ ɔdɔ ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ nu yé, ná fa wɔ wora wura Nyameɛ nu daa.”

english_verse: Israel, you enjoy cheating and taking advantage of others.
translation_verse: Kanaan tira ngondombo tonyi, na okuro aminɛlilɛ.

english_verse: You say to yourself, “I'm rich! I earned it all on my own, without committing a sin.” The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
translation_verse: Efraim nwa, “Aa, manya me nwo, manya anwonyadeɛ.” M’adwumayɔlɛ amukoraa nu, bannwu amumuyɛɛ biala wɔ me nu, bɔ ɔte bɔne ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, am still your God, just as I have been since the time you were in Egypt. Now I will force you to live in tents once again, as you did in the desert.
translation_verse: Ofi Misraim aseɛ so, me ole AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ. Ngɔmaa ekosa kɔtena ɛtena sua mɔ nu, kyɛ aluolue ngyẽa bɔ mahyehyɛ mato berɛ ne ala.

english_verse: I spoke to the prophets— often I spoke in visions. And so, I will send my prophets with messages of doom.
translation_verse: Mafa ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ so madwudwo, mama nyekyire asone, na mafa ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ so mabubu anyandera.

english_verse: Gilead is terribly sinful and will end up ruined. Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal on altars made of stones, but those stones will be scattered in every field.
translation_verse: Aso amumuyɛɛ wɔ Gileade? Amba, bɛte mbaen. Bɛfa nandwie nyii mɔ bɛbobɔ afɔleɛ wɔ Gilgal, amba, b’afɔleɛ mmokyea nemɔ, bɛte kyɛ nyɔboɛ kure bɔ ɔwɔ eburo ngofie mɔ b’afia ɔ.

english_verse: Jacob escaped to Syria where he tended sheep to earn himself a wife.
translation_verse: Yakob nwati hɔle Siria maen nu, Yisrael sole maa ɔfa nyane braa gyale, na braa ti, ɔneane mmoaen so.

english_verse: I sent the prophet Moses to lead Israel from Egypt and to keep them safe.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE nate ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ so yele Yisrael fili Misraim, na ɔnate ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ so ɔbɔle ye nwo waen.

english_verse: When your leaders spoke, everyone in Israel trembled and showed great respect. But you sinned by worshiping Baal, and you were destroyed.
translation_verse: Sɛ né Efraim odwudwo a, mmenia nwo wosowoso bɛ; ɔmane ye nwo so wɔ Yisrael, na ɔnate kyɛ ɔsɔnene Baal ne ati, ɔyɔle bɔne, na owuli.

english_verse: Now you continue to sin by designing and making idols of silver in the shape of calves. You are told to sacrifice to these idols— yes, even to kiss them.
translation_verse: Afei de, bɛkɔ so bɛyɔ bɔne, na behuro bɛ dwetɛ bɛfa bɛyɔ amoen bɛma bɛ nwo, amoen mɔ bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bafa ɛdwetɛ bali adwii bayɔ, bɔ ye mukoraa te dwumvoɛ sa noa adwuma ɔ. Bɛkã bɛfa bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ne, odi kyɛ bɛfe nandwie nyii akrɔngrɔma nemɔ noa.”

english_verse: And so, all of you will vanish like the mist or the dew of early morning, or husks of grain in the wind or smoke from a chimney.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ ngyerɛmɔ munungum, kyɛ bosue bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ ndɛndɛ ɔ, kyɛ afafu bɔ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ, ɔbɔ ye fi nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo ɔ, kyɛ nwosina bɔ otu fa mboma nu kɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, have been your God since the time you were in Egypt. I am the only God you know, the only one who can save.
translation_verse: Nakoso ofi Misraim aseɛ so, me ole AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ; onni kyɛ ɛso nyameɛ biala, sana me, na defoɛ biala nne berɛ, sana me.

english_verse: I took care of you in a thirsty desert.
translation_verse: Me, me yeɛ nwuni wɔ wɔ ɛserɛ so ɔ, wɔ aseɛ bɔ nzue nne so ɔ so.

english_verse: I fed you till you were satisfied, then you became proud and forgot about me.
translation_verse: Ndire bɔ belili ne, kyɛbɔ né ye paa si te nen, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛ ko yili ɔ; bɛ ko yili, na bɛyɛle anwomasoɛ, yiti bɛ wora fili me.

english_verse: Now I will attack like a lion, ambush you like a leopard,
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔyɛ bɛ so kyɛ gyata, ngɔyɛ kyɛ aboa ngɔtetɛ bɛ wɔ atee noa.

english_verse: and rip you apart like a bear robbed of her cubs. I will gnaw on your bones, as though I were a lion or some other wild animal.
translation_verse: Ngɔto ngɔhye bɛ kyɛ kwabrafo bɔ basesa ye mma mɔ bahɔ ɔ, na ngɔtete bɛ hue bɔ obutu b’ahone so ne anu; berɛ yeɛ ngohũhũ bɛ kyɛ gyata, kyɛbɔ kaka aboyaa kɔtete bɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, you are done for. Don't expect help from me.
translation_verse: Ao Yisrael, afrɛfrɛ w’asefinɛ ama wɔ nwo, nakoso me nu yeɛ wɔ mmokalɛ wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: In my anger, I gave you a king; in my fury, I took him away. Israel's Terrible Fate The Lord said:
translation_verse: Mvɛle yaa nzili hene mane ɛmɔ, na nyele ye mvili berɛ wɔ m’ahonehulɛ nu.

english_verse: Israel, your terrible sins are written down and stored away.
translation_verse: Babɔ Efraim amumuyɛɛ ne borɛ; ye bɔne nwo dwirɛ la berɛ.

english_verse: Should I, the Lord, rescue you from death and the grave? No! I call death and the grave to strike you like a plague. I refuse to show mercy.
translation_verse: Aso mbɔ bɛ mvi ɛborɔ tumi nu anaa? Aso mbepɛ nne bɛ mvi ewue nu anaa? Wɔ, ewue, wɔ yealɛ ne wɔ ni? Wɔ, ɛborɔ, wɔ sɛkyelɛ ne wɔ ni? Anwumvoinnwunɛ atu afi me nye so.

english_verse: No matter if you prosper more than the other tribes, I, the Lord, will wipe you out, just as a scorching desert wind dries up streams of water. I will take away your precious treasures.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ okonya ngɔsoɛ wɔ oliɛma mɔ nu, nakoso eyia afiteleɛ mvrama bɔ ɔte AWURADE mvrama ne, okotu kofi ɛserɛ so dɔ kɔwa, ye asue ti kɔwewe, yeɛ ye mbombonzue kɔwewe, na mvrama ne kɔsesa nningyein nyɔboɛ serɛ biala kofi nekaa bɔ osie ye nningyein ɔ.

english_verse: Samaria will be punished for turning against me. It will be destroyed in war— children will be beaten against rocks, and pregnant women will be ripped open.
translation_verse: Samaria kɔsoa ye foɛlilɛ, ofikyɛ wayɛ ye Nyameɛ nwo lɔen. Bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa, bɛkɔtete bɛ mma nnɔma mɔ ti bɛkɔbobɔ berɛ, na bɛkɔpakyepakye bɛ pemvoɛ mɔ kunu.

english_verse: Israel, return! Come back to the Lord, your God. Sin has made you fall.
translation_verse: Ao Yisrael, sa bra AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ berɛ, ofikyɛ w’amumuyɛɛ amaa afi ase.

english_verse: Return to the Lord and say, “Please forgive our sins. Accept our good sacrifices of praise instead of bulls.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔpena edwirɛ mɔ bɔ ɛmɔkɔhã ɔ, ná ɛ́mɔsa bɛbra AWURADE berɛ; ɛmɔhã behyire ye kyɛ, “Kyikyi amumuyɛɛ amukoraa; nwu yɛ anwumvoin de yɛ, na yɛkɔfa yɛ noa dwirɛ yɛkɔyɛ nandwie nyii yɛkɔbɔ afɔleɛ yɛkɔma wɔ.”

english_verse: Assyria can't save us, and chariots can't help. So we will no longer worship the idols we have made. Our Lord, you show mercy to orphans.” The Lord Promises To Forgive
translation_verse: Asiria ngɔpepɛ ngole yɛ, yɛngɔtenatena mbɔngɔ so, yeɛ yɛngɔhã ngohyire yɛ sa noa nnwumaa ko kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔte yɛ nyameɛ mɔ’, ofikyɛ wɔ nu yeɛ ayisiaaniɛ onya anwumvoinnwunɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, you have rejected me, but my anger is gone; I will heal you and love you without limit.
translation_verse: Ngɔsa bɛ nahorɛ bɔ benni ne anwonyerɛ, ngofia me kunu ngohuro bɛ dwirɛ, ofikyɛ me yaafɛlɛ ne, maye mafi bɛ so.

english_verse: I will be like the dew— then you will blossom like lilies and have roots like a tree.
translation_verse: Ngɔyɛ kyɛ bosue ngɔma Yisrael: ɔkɔfefɛ kyɛ sukooko, na okonya ndii kyɛ Lebanon.

english_verse: Your branches will spread with the beauty of an olive tree and with the aroma of Lebanon Forest.
translation_verse: Ye mmaen mɔ kɔtrɛtrɛ, ye anwonyemene kɔyɛ kyɛ olive bakaa, na ye nwo fona kɔyɛ kyɛ Lebanon.

english_verse: You will rest in my shade, and your grain will grow. You will blossom like a vineyard and be famous as the wine from Lebanon.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛte ye fɔnwoo ne abo ne, bekosa bɛkɔwa, bekosa bekonyi puronn kyɛ aburoo, bɛkɔfefɛ kyɛ bobe, na bɛ nwo fona kɔyɛ kyɛ Lebanon bobe nzaa.

english_verse: Israel, give up your idols! I will answer your prayers and take care of you. I am that glorious tree, the source of your fruit.
translation_verse: Ao Efraim, nzikyɛ yeɛ me ne mmosoen yɛle ye yɛyɔ bieku ɔ? Me yeɛ mema ye mmuayɛɛ, ná menea ye so ɔ; nde kyɛ ɛframmire monɛ bɔ ye nyaa mboro ɔ, na me so yeɛ enya wɔ mmakaammaa ɔ.

english_verse: If you are wise, you will know and understand what I mean. I am the Lord, and I lead you along the right path. If you obey me, we will walk together, but if you are wicked, you will stumble.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔse nworɛ bɔ ɔte edwirɛ hemɔ abo ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ye adwene nu pi bɔ ole bɛ nwo nimdeɛ ɔ? Ofikyɛ AWURADE atee tengyɛ, teneneefoɛ kɔfa so, nakoso mmeraatolɛfoɛ de, bekofi ase wɔ so.

english_verse: I am Joel the son of Pethuel. And this is the message the Lord gave to me. Locusts Cover the Land
translation_verse: AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔlale ye ali hyirele Petuel awa Yowel ne, ye ɛhe.

english_verse: Listen, you leaders and everyone else in the land. Has anything like this ever happened before?
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, mbanyi mɔ, ɛ́mɔtie ɛhe, ɛmɔ, aseɛ ne aso ama amukoraa, ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ betie! Aso sɔ dwirɛ he, wasi ɛmɔ aberɛ so le, anaa ɛmɔ nana mɔ b’aberɛ so po le?

english_verse: Swarm after swarm of locusts has attacked our crops, eating everything in sight.
translation_verse: Bɔ aketekyire ali maa waha ne, mmɛbɛ ali; bɔ mmɛbɛ bali maa waha ne, mmɛbɛ mbiri ali; bɔ mmɛbɛ mbiri bali maa waha ne, ɛsaa ali.

english_verse: Sober up, you drunkards! Cry long and loud; your wine supply is gone.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, akɔnomnzafoɛ, ɛ́mɔdwɔso ná ɛmɔsu, ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔno nzaa ɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye, ɔnate nzaa foforɛ ne ati, ofikyɛ batu bafi ɛmɔ noa.

english_verse: A powerful nation with countless troops has invaded our land. They have the teeth and jaws of powerful lions.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ maen bie wafa koɛ waateta m’aseɛ ne, bɛ nwo yɛ se, na bɛka bɛ a, bennwu bɛ noa. Bɛ gye te gyata gye, na b’awogyee te kyɛ gyata beleɛ.

english_verse: Our grapevines and fig trees are stripped bare; only naked branches remain.
translation_verse: Wasɛkye me bobe ne pasaa, wapomba me borɔdoma mmaen nemɔ: wawɔngyewɔngye ye si boen ne wagua; ye maen nemɔ nwo ayɛ hoyaa.

english_verse: Grieve like a young woman mourning for the man she was to marry.
translation_verse: Bɔ awuye kyɛ ababunu bɔ wahera ɛsɛen tena, bɔ odi ye ndaluwa nu biaa nwo kuna ɔ.

english_verse: Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple. His servants, the priests, are deep in sorrow.
translation_verse: Bayakyi aleɛ afɔleɛ ne anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɔlɛ wɔ AWURADE awuro. Asɔfo bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte AWURADE somvoɛ mɔ ne, bedi aworabɔlɛ.

english_verse: Barren fields mourn; grain, grapes, and olives are scorched and shriveled.
translation_verse: Eboo mɔ asɛkye, aseɛ di aworabɔlɛ, ofikyɛ fieso nningyein asɛkye, nzaa foforɛ bo apɛ, yeɛ ngoo so ate.

english_verse: Mourn for our farms and our vineyards! There's no wheat or barley growing in our fields.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, akuafoɛ, ɛ́mɔma ɔyɛ ɛmɔ fɛre, ɛmɔ, bobe boo so neafoɛ, ayuo ne atokoɔ ti odi kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ awuye, ofikyɛ fieso aleɛ mɔ asɛkye.

english_verse: Grapevines have dried up and so has every tree— figs and pomegranates, date palms and apples. All happiness has faded away. Return to God
translation_verse: Bobe ne akese, borɔdoma bakaa ne atwindwam, yeɛ akengaa, ayee ne aprɛ bakaa nemɔ koso sɔ ala; eburo mmakaa amukoraa bakese; ofikyɛ anigye atu amini afi adasa mmaa mɔ nu. AWURADE kyẽa ne

english_verse: Mourn, you priests who serve at the altar of my God. Spend your days and nights wearing sackcloth. Offerings of grain and wine are no longer brought to the Lord's temple.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, asɔfo mɔ, ɛ́mɔhera ɛsɛen tena ná ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye; ɛmɔ, afɔleɛ bokyea nwo somvoɛ mɔ, ɛ́mɔsu. Ɛmɔ, me Nyameɛ somvoɛ mɔ, ɛmɔbra nu, ɛ́mɔhera ɛsɛen tena kɔngɔen ne amukoraa, ofikyɛ bayakyi aleɛ afɔleɛ ne anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɔlɛ wɔ ɛmɔ Nyameɛ awuro.

english_verse: Tell the leaders and people to come together at the temple. Order them to go without eating and to pray sincerely.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔyɛ akɔngyere krongron, ɛ́mɔyɛ nyianu krongron. Ɛ́mɔboaboa mbanyi ne aseɛ ne aso mma amukoraa bɛ noa wɔ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ awuro, ná ɛ́mɔsu bɛfrɛ AWURADE.

english_verse: We are in for trouble! Soon the Lord All-Powerful will bring disaster.
translation_verse: Eh, sɔ kyẽa ne! Ofikyɛ AWURADE kyẽa ne wapingye, na ɔkɔwa kyɛ ɛsɛkyelɛ bɔ ofi Tuminiɛ ne berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Our food is already gone; there's no more celebrating at the temple of our God.
translation_verse: Aso aleɛ omminini bɔ yɛ nye tua ɔ, aso anigye ne ahurusi omminini offili yɛ Nyameɛ awuro anaa?

english_verse: Seeds dry up in the ground; no harvest is possible. Our barns are in bad shape, with no grain to store in them.
translation_verse: Nningyein bɔ balua ne, bakese wɔ aseɛ nwo, pata nemɔ lela berɛ too, aburoo pata nemɔ badwiri bagua, ofikyɛ aburoo anyɛ yé.

english_verse: Our cattle wander aimlessly, moaning for lack of pasture, and sheep are suffering.
translation_verse: Nea kyɛbɔ nyɛmmoa nemɔ bɛpenepene ɔ! Nandwie kure nemɔ bɛteetee, ofikyɛ bennya aleɛ benni; amba, mmoaen kure nemɔ benwu amaneɛ.

english_verse: I cry out to you, Lord. Grasslands and forests are eaten by the scorching heat.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, wɔ yeɛ mesu mefrɛ wɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ see ayera ngaka aleɛ wɔ ɛserɛ so, na see bɔ ogye ne wayera eburo mmakaa amukoraa.

english_verse: Wild animals have no water because of you; rivers and streams are dry, and pastures are parched.
translation_verse: Eburo ngaka koso besu bɛfrɛ wɔ, ofikyɛ asue mɔ nu nzue awewe, na see ayera ngaka aleɛ wɔ ɛserɛ so.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion, the Lord's sacred hill. Warn everyone to tremble! The judgment day of the Lord is coming soon.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔhu totorobɛndo wɔ Sion, ɛ́mɔbɔ ese wɔ me bokaa krongron ne aso! Aseɛ ne aso ama amukoraa, odi kyɛ ɛmɔma ɛmɔ nwo wosowoso ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ AWURADE kyẽa ne ɔ́ba, na wapingye.

english_verse: It will be dark and gloomy with storm clouds overhead. Troops will cover the mountains like thunderclouds. No army this powerful has ever been gathered before or will be gathered again.
translation_verse: Ɔte awosii ne kusuuyɛlɛ kyẽa, munungum ne awosii kabii kyẽa; koɛhonɛfoɛ anwoserɛfoɛ pee bɛkɔwa, bɔ ɔte kyɛ awosii bɔ wakata mmokaa nemɔ aso ɔ; bɛ sɛso ɔwwale le, ná bɛ si koso, ebie ngɔwa ko, wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ pee bɛ mmerɛ so.

english_verse: They look like horses and charge like cavalry.
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo te kyɛ mbɔngɔ, na betu amirika kyɛ pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ mɔ.

english_verse: They roar over mountains like noisy chariots, or a mighty army ready for battle. They are a forest fire that feasts on straw.
translation_verse: Behuruhuru kyɛ teaseɛnam mɔ bɔ bɛyɛ dede wɔ mmokaa so ɔ, kyɛ see bɔ ɔyera ngyɛngyɛma bɔ ɔyɛ tetɛtetɛ ɔ, kyɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ anwoserɛfoɛ bɔ begyi koɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: The very sight of them is frightening.
translation_verse: Amaenmaen mɔ, bɛ nwo dwiri bɛ wɔ bɛ nyunu, mmenia amukoraa nyunu yɛ bosaa.

english_verse: They climb over walls like warriors; they march in columns and never turn aside.
translation_verse: Betu amirika kyɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ anwoserɛfoɛ, bɛfo fasue kyɛ koɛhonɛfoɛ; ebiala fa ye atimbire so, na bɛmmakye bɛmvi b’atee so’.

english_verse: They charge straight ahead, without pushing each other; even arrows and spears cannot make them retreat.
translation_verse: Ebiala nzumu obiɛngo, na ebiala nate ye atee so; bɛbɔ bewura akodeɛ mɔ nu bɔ nikye fee nzi bɛ ate ɔ.

english_verse: They swarm over city walls and enter our homes; they crawl in through windows, just like thieves.
translation_verse: Betwi bɛfa kuro ne aso, betu amirika wɔ fasue nemɔ aso, bɛfo bɛkɔ awuro mɔ nu, na bɛfa mboma nu bewura nu kyɛ awuefoɛ.

english_verse: They make the earth tremble and the heavens shake; the sun and moon turn dark, and stars stop shining.
translation_verse: Aseɛ woso wɔ bɛ nyunu, anwuro kekã; eyia ne ɛsraen yɛ tunn, na nzramaa yakyi talɛ.

english_verse: The Lord God leads this army of countless troops, and they obey his commands. The day of his judgment is so terrible that no one can stand it. The Lord's Invitation
translation_verse: AWURADE tea nu serɛserɛ wɔ ye koɛhonɛfoɛ nyunu, ofikyɛ ye lɔen ne te piri paa, na bɔ odi ye dwirɛ so ne, ye nwo yɛ se. Ofikyɛ AWURADE kyẽa ne te piri, ɔyɛ suro paa, na nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora ye noa gyina ɔ?

english_verse: The Lord said: It isn't too late. You can still return to me with all your heart. Start crying and mourning! Go without eating.
translation_verse: “Na afei, odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ ahone amukoraa ne akɔngyere ne esuɛ ne aworabɔlɛlilɛ besa bɛba me berɛ,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Don't rip your clothes to show your sorrow. Instead, turn back to me with broken hearts. I am merciful, kind, and caring. I don't easily lose my temper, and I don't like to punish.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔsunzua ɛmɔ ahone nu, na nna ɛmɔ ndaadeɛ nu ɔ, ná ɛ́mɔsa bɛbra AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ berɛ. Ofikyɛ ɔdo mmenia na ɔse anwumvoin; ye ahone nhu ndɛ, ye ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ɔsone, na ɔsesã ye adwene ɔtwe bɔne nwo asohwenɛ sa.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. Perhaps I will change my mind and treat you with mercy. Then you will be blessed with enough grain and wine for offering sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔse ɔ? Ebiaa okosa ye si kɔsesã ye adwene, ná wayakyi saleɛ wama ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔkɔfa bɛkɔbɔ aleɛ afɔleɛ ne anonneɛ afɔleɛ bɛkɔma AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Sound the trumpet on Zion! Call the people together. Show your sorrow by going without food.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔhu totorobɛndo wɔ Sion, ɛ́mɔyɛ akɔngyere krongron, ɛ́mɔfrɛ nyianu krongron;

english_verse: Tell my servants, the priests, to cry inside the temple and to offer this prayer near the altar: “Save your people, Lord God! Don't let foreign nations make jokes about us. Don't let them laugh and ask, ‘Where is your God?’ ” The Lord Will Bless the Land
translation_verse: Asɔfo nemɔ, bɔ bɛ yeɛ bɛte AWURADE somvoɛ mɔ ne, odi kyɛ besu wɔ abrannaa ne, ɔne afɔleɛ bokyea ne b’afia, ná bɛkã kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE, nwu wɔ maen anwumvoin, nnɛma w’agyapadeɛ yɛ nikyee bɔ bebu ye animtia, maen maen mɔ noa nu ngorohoɛ dwirɛ. Nzu ati yeɛ bɛkekã ye wɔ maen maen mɔ nu kyɛ, ‘Bɛ Nyameɛ ne, ɔwɔ nisua?’ ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord was deeply concerned about his land and had pity on his people.
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE hwene ye aseɛ nwo nungunɛ, na onwuni ye maen anwumvoin.

english_verse: In answer to their prayers he said, “I will give you enough grain, wine, and olive oil to satisfy your needs. No longer will I let you be insulted by the nations.
translation_verse: Amba, AWURADE buale ye maen sele ye kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtie, ngɔbrɛ ɛmɔ aburoo, nzaa ne ngoo, na bɛkɔma ɛmɔ ko koyi; mengɔma ɛmɔngɔyɛ nikyee bɔ bebu ye animtia wɔ maen maen mɔ nu ɔ ko,

english_verse: An army attacked from the north, but I will chase it into a scorching desert. There it will rot and stink from the Dead Sea to the Mediterranean.” The Lord works wonders
translation_verse: na mmom ɛlɔen bɔ ofi sorɔ dɔ ne, ngɔye ye ngofi ɛmɔ so ngɔhɔ dedeede, na ngɔfoa ye ngɔhɔ aseɛ pralaa katerepee bie aso, bɔ ye nye kyire eyia afiteleɛ ɛpo, ná ye si kyire eyia atɔleɛ ɛpo; ye nwo pambaen kotu kɔwa, na ye mvaa ne kɔbɔ kɔwa, ofikyɛ wayɔ bɔne mbiri mbiri.

english_verse: and does great things. So tell the soil to celebrate
translation_verse: Ao aseɛ, nnɛsuro; ma wɔ nye gye, ná di ahurusi, ofikyɛ AWURADE ayɔ nningyein mbiri mbiri.

english_verse: and wild animals to stop being afraid. Grasslands are green again; fruit trees and fig trees are loaded with fruit. Grapevines are covered with grapes.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, eburo ngaka, nnɛma ɛmɔsuro, ofikyɛ ɛserɛ so ngaka aleɛ afefɛ; mmakaa su bɛ mma, borɔdoma ne bobe su biribiraa.

english_verse: People of Zion, celebrate in honor of the Lord your God! He is generous and has sent the autumn and spring rains in the proper seasons.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, Sion mma mɔ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye gye, ná ɛmɔli AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ nu ahurusi, ofikyɛ wama asuso atikye wama ɛmɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu, na wama bamborɔ watɔ wama ɛmɔ, asuso ɔne bamborɔ kyɛ daa ne ala.

english_verse: Grain will cover your threshing places; jars will overflow with wine and olive oil. The Lord Will Rescue His People
translation_verse: Nekaa bɔ bɛboro aburoo ne, aburoo koyi berɛ to, na nzaa ne ngoo koyi angora nemɔ maa okobu kɔfa so.

english_verse: I, the Lord your God, will make up for the losses caused by those swarms and swarms of locusts I sent to attack you.
translation_verse: Na afoɛ mɔ bɔ nzomane mmɛbɛ, mmɛbɛ mbiri, ɛsaa ne aketekyire, bɔ bɛte me koɛhonɛfoɛ anwoserɛfoɛ maa bɛwale ɛmɔ berɛ bɛɛsɛkyele nningyein ne, ngosa ngɔfa ngosi ɛmɔ gya nu.

english_verse: My people, you will eat until you are satisfied. Then you will praise me for the wonderful things I have done. Never again will you be put to shame.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔkodidi paa kɔma ɛmɔ ko koyi, ná ɛmɔaye AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ dumaa ayɛ, ofikyɛ wayɔ anwanwadeɛ wama ɛmɔ, na me maen nyunu ngogua ase le ko.

english_verse: Israel, you will know that I stand at your side. I am the Lord your God— there are no other gods. Never again will you be put to shame. The Lord Will Work Wonders The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ nwɔ Yisrael nu, na me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ, ebiala nne berɛ ko, na me maen nyunu ngogua ase le.

english_verse: Later, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your old men will have dreams, and your young men will see visions.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe asi ne, ngohwie me Sunzum ngogua anwoɔnaen amukoraa so, na ɛmɔ mma mmienzua ne ɛmɔ mma mmrasua kɔhyehyɛ ngɔm; ɛmɔ mbanyi mɔ kɔhyehye laleɛ, na ɛmɔ mmerandeɛ konwu nyekyire;

english_verse: In those days I will even give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women.
translation_verse: yeɛ ngohwie me Sunzum ngogua ngoaa mɔ ne afaneɛ mɔ so wɔ sɔ mmerɛ ne anu.

english_verse: I will work wonders in the sky above and on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Ngɔyɔ anwanwadeɛ wɔ anwuro ne aseɛ so, mogya ne see ne nwosina ningɔnn.

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before that great and terrible day when I appear.
translation_verse: Eyia kɔkakyi awosii, na ɛsraen kɔkakyi mogya koraka né AWURADE kyẽa kandinga bɔ ɔyɛ suro ne wawa.

english_verse: Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa ye nwo kɔto AWURADE dumaa so ne, okonya ye ti kodidi nu, ofikyɛ Sion bokaa so ne Yerusalem yeɛ bɛ bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ne bɛkɔtena ɔ, kyɛbɔ AWURADE ahã ne ala, na bɛ bɔ AWURADE frɛ bɛ ne, bɛkɔboka bɛ bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ne aso.”

english_verse: At that time I, the Lord, will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again.
