translation_verse: Yiti tie, sɔ ngyẽa nemɔ anu ne sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, bɔ ngosa ngɔfa Yuda ne Yerusalem ngofi nnurehyelɛ nu ngɔwa ne,

english_verse: Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land
translation_verse: ngɔboaboa maen maen amukoraa bɛ noa, ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa Yehosafate bɔnza ne anu, na berɛ yeɛ ngɔbɔ bɛ kwaadu ɔ, ɔnate me maen ne m’agyapadeɛ Yisrael bɔ babɔ bɛ basande maen maen mɔ so, ɔne m’aseɛ bɔ bahyɛ ne ati.

english_verse: and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
translation_verse: Bagua serewa bahyɛ me maen, bafa abɛɛmaa bale gyanderaniɛ, yeɛ batɔne abaayaa bale nzaa bano.

english_verse: You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, Tiro ne Sidon ne Filistia mboanoa amukoraa, nzikyɛ dwirɛ yeɛ ɛmɔafa bali me e? Aso ɛmɔtua me nikyee bie so kerɛ anaa? Na sɛ ɛmɔtua me so kerɛ a, ye de ngɔma ɛmɔ yɔleɛ ne kɔbɔ ɛmɔ ti so ndɛndɛ so ne amirika so,

english_verse: You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ɛmɔafa me dwetɛ ne me sikaa kɔkorɛ, na ɛmɔasoa me nningyein paa paa nyemene nemɔ baagua ɛmɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua mɔ nu.

english_verse: You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔatɔne Yudafoɛ ne Yerusalemfoɛ bama Helafoɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ɛmɔkɔye bɛ kofi b’aseɛ so bɛkɔhɔ dedeede ɔ.

english_verse: But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, ngɔkanyane bɛ ngofi nekaa bɔ ɛmɔaatɔne bɛ maa bahɔ ne, na ngɔma ɛmɔ yɔleɛ ne kɔbɔ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bɛ ti so.

english_verse: I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment in Judgment Valley
translation_verse: Ngɔtɔne ɛmɔ mma mmienzua ne ɛmɔ mma mmrasua nemɔ ngɔfa bɛ ngowura Yudafoɛ sa, na bɛ koso bɛkɔtɔne bɛ bɛkɔma Sabeafoɛ bɔ bɛte maen bɔ bɛwɔ dedeede ne, ofikyɛ edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE ahã hɔ ɛne.”

english_verse: Say to the nations: “Get ready for war! Be eager to fight. Line up for battle and prepare to attack.
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔbɔ ɛhe dawure wɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ mɔ nu kyɛ, Ɛ́mɔhyehyɛ koɛ, ɛ́mɔkanyane koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ. Ɛ́mɔma koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ amukoraa bɛbɔ bepingye; ɛ́mɔma bɛfo bɛbra.

english_verse: Make swords out of plows and spears out of garden tools. Strengthen every weakling.”
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔboro ɛmɔ kona mɔ bɛbɔ ngrandɛ, ná ɛ́mɔboro ɛmɔ asɔsɔaa mɔ bɛbɔ pealɛɛ; sona bɔ ɔyɛ mmerɛ ne, ɔhã kyɛ, Nde anwoserɛniɛ.

english_verse: Hurry, all you nations! Come quickly. Ask the Lord to bring his warriors along.
translation_verse: Maen maen amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔapɛ ye nwo babra bayia ɔ, ɛ́mɔyɛ ndɛ bɛbra, ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ noa wɔ berɛ. Ao AWURADE, ma wɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ bedwu bɛbra.

english_verse: You must come now to Judgment Valley, where the Lord will judge the surrounding nations.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ maen maen mɔ bɛkanyane bɛ nwo bɛba Yehosafate bɔnza ne anu, ofikyɛ berɛ yeɛ ngɔtena ngobua maen maen amukoraa bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia ne ndɛen ɔ.

english_verse: They are a field of ripe crops. Bring in the harvest! They are grapes piled high. Start trampling them now! If our enemy's sins were wine, every jar would overflow.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, ɛ́mɔfa dadeɛ koateɛ bɛhɔ, ofikyɛ buberɛ ne adwu; ɛ́mɔdwu bɛhɔ nu, ofikyɛ nekaa bɔ betwi nzaa ne wayi; angora nemɔ bayi babu bafa so, ofikyɛ b’amumuyɛɛ ne te piri.

english_verse: Crowds fill Decision Valley. The judgment day of the Lord will soon be here—
translation_verse: Ɛlɔen, ɛlɔen wɔ ndɛenbualɛ bɔnza ne anu; ofikyɛ AWURADE kyẽa ne apingye wɔ ndɛenbualɛ bɔnza ne anu.

english_verse: no light from the sun or moon, and stars no longer shine.
translation_verse: Eyia ne ɛsraen bakakyi awosii, ná nzramaa nemɔ bayakyi talɛ.

english_verse: From the heart of Jerusalem the Lord roars like a lion, shaking the earth and sky. But the Lord is a fortress, a place of safety for his people Israel. God Will Bless His People
translation_verse: AWURADE bobɔ nu fi Sion, na ɔma ye komvi so fi Yerusalem; anwuro ne aseɛ bɛwoso, nakoso AWURADE te ye maen anyelasoɛ, ɔne ye mma Yisrael b’anwoserɛ afealeɛ.

english_verse: I am the Lord your God. And you will know I live on Zion, my sacred hill, because Jerusalem will be sacred, untouched by foreign troops.
translation_verse: “Ɔnate so ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me ole AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ, bɔ nde Sion, me bokaa krongron ne aso ne. Afei, Yerusalem kɔyɛ nekaa krongron, na ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ ngɔpɛ nu berɛ ko.

english_verse: On that day, fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains. And your cattle and goats that graze on the hills will produce a lot of milk. Streams in Judah will never run dry; a stream from my house will flow in Acacia Valley.
translation_verse: “Na sɔ kyẽa ne, mmokaa nemɔ kɔpepe nzaa monɛ, nyɔfonesue kɔtengyɛ wɔ pambaa nemɔ aso, nzue kɔtengyɛ wɔ Yuda asue amukoraa nu, na asue ti kofite wɔ AWURADE awuro ne anu kɔɔloaloa Sitim bɔnza ne anu.

english_verse: Egypt and Edom were cruel and brutal to Judah, without a reason. Now their countries will become a barren desert,
translation_verse: “Misraim kɔbɔ, na Edom kɔyɛ ɛserɛ pralaa, ɔnate akakabenzɛm bɔ bali ye wɔ Yudafoɛ so ne ati, ofikyɛ bahã mogya bɔ odi be ɔ bagua wɔ b’aseɛ ne aso.

english_verse: but Judah and Jerusalem will always have people.
translation_verse: Nakoso Yuda de, ɔkɔtena berɛ afebɔɔ, yeɛ Yerusalem kɔtena berɛ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: I, the Lord, live on Mount Zion. I will punish the guilty and defend the innocent.
translation_verse: Bɛ mogya bɔ mandɔ so wereɛ ne, ngɔtɔ so wereɛ, ofikyɛ AWURADE te Sion.”

english_verse: I am Amos. And I raised sheep near the town of Tekoa when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel. Two years before the earthquake, the Lord gave me several messages about Israel,
translation_verse: Yuda hene Yusia aberɛ so, yeɛ Yisrael hene Yoase awa Yeroboam aberɛ so, afoɛ nyɔ koraka yeɛ aseɛ baawoso ne, Amose bɔ ɔboka Tekoa mmoaenneafoɛ nemɔ aso ne, edwirɛ bɔ onwuni ye fale Yisrael nwo ne, ye ɛhe.

english_verse: and I said: When the Lord roars from Jerusalem, pasturelands and Mount Carmel dry up and turn brown. Judgment on Syria
translation_verse: Na osele kyɛ, “AWURADE bobɔ nu fi Sion, na ɔma ye komvi so fi Yerusalem, aseɛ bɔ mmoaenneafoɛ benya ngaka aleɛ wɔ so ne, odi aworabɔlɛ, yeɛ bokaa Kamɛl ti afia ayɛ pralaa.” Damasko nwo ngɔm

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Syria for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged logs with spikes over the people of Gilead.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ɔnate Damasko ye amumuyɛɛ nza, eh, ɔne nna ne ati, mengɔhwe ye so hwenɛ ne mengosa; ofikyɛ bafa buralɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛboro aburoo ɔ bapɛkyɛ Gileade.

english_verse: Now I will burn down the palaces and fortresses of King Hazael and of King Benhadad.
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔto Hasael awuro nu see maa ɔkɔyera Ben Hadade anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: I will break through the gates of Damascus. I will destroy the people of Wicked Valley and the ruler of Beth-Eden. Then the Syrians will be dragged as prisoners to Kir. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Ngobubu buralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram Damasko pambim nemɔ asi ne, na bɛ bɔ bɛte Awen bɔnza ne anu ne, ngɔpɛ bɛ asue ngofi berɛ. Bɔ otira hɔtɔ ne, ngotu ye ngofi Bete Eden, na bɛkɔhye Siriafoɛ nnure bɛkɔhɔ Kire,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Gasa nwo ngɔm

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Philistia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ɔnate Gasa ye amumuyɛɛ nza, eh, ɔne nna ne ati, mengɔhwe ye so hwenɛ ne mengosa; ofikyɛ bɛsoale mmenia bɔ bahye bɛ nnure ne amukoraa bɛfale bɛ beewurale Edom sa.

english_verse: That's why I will burn down the walls and fortresses of the city of Gaza.
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔto Gasa fasue nu see maa ɔkɔyera ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: I will destroy the king of Ashdod and the ruler of Ashkelon. I will strike down Ekron, and that will be the end of the Philistines. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Phoenicia
translation_verse: Ngɔpɛ Asedɔdefoɛ asue ngofi berɛ, na bɔ otira hɔtɔ ne, ngɔpɛ ye asue ngofi Asekelɔn. Ngɔhwe Ekron so, na Filistifoɛ ngaa nemɔ kowuwu,” AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne. Tiro nwo ngɔm

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Phoenicia for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They broke their treaty and dragged off my people from town after town to sell them as slaves to the Edomites.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ɔnate Tiro ye amumuyɛɛ nza, eh, ɔne nna ne ati, mengɔhwe ye so hwenɛ ne mengosa; ofikyɛ bɛfale mmenia bɔ bahye bɛ nnure ne amukoraa beewurale Edom sa, na bangaye aliɛmaa apam ne.

english_verse: That's why I will send flames to burn down the city of Tyre along with its fortresses. Judgment on Edom
translation_verse: Na ngɔto Tiro fasue nu see maa ɔkɔyera ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ.” Edom nwo ngɔm

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Edom for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They killed their own relatives and were so terribly furious that they showed no mercy.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ɔnate Edom ye amumuyɛɛ nza, eh, ɔne nna ne ati, mengɔhwe ye so hwenɛ ne mengosa; ofikyɛ ɔfale ngrandɛ guli oliɛma so. Wanyɛ ye anwumvo, ɔmane ye ahone hɔle so huli, na ɔmane ye yaafɛlɛ piri ne hɔle so afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to wipe out the fortresses of Teman and Bozrah. Judgment on Ammon
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔto Teman nu see maa ɔkɔyera Bosra anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ.” Amon nwo ngɔm

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Ammon for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. In Gilead they ripped open pregnant women, just to take the land.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ɔnate Amonfoɛ b’amumuyɛɛ nza, eh, ɔne nna ne ati, mengɔhwe bɛ so hwenɛ ne mengosa; ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ bɛko bɛtrɛtrɛ bɛ wɛen nu ne, bɛpakyepakyele Gileade pemvoɛ mɔ kunu.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the walls and fortresses of Rabbah. Enemies will shout and attack like a whirlwind.
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔto Raba fasue nu see maa ɔkɔyera ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ; na gyegyeegye kɔhɔ so wɔ koɛhonɛ kyẽa ne, ná mvrama piri atu wɔ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ kyẽa ne.

english_verse: Ammon's king and leaders will be dragged away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Na bɛkɔhye bɛ hene ne nnure bɛkɔhɔ, ɔne ye mbanyi mɔ,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Moab for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They made lime from the bones of the king of Edom.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ɔnate Moabo ye amumuyɛɛ nza, eh, ɔne nna ne ati, mengɔhwe ye so hwenɛ ne mengosa; ofikyɛ ɔyerale Edom hene mmowue maa ɔtɔle nzoen.

english_verse: Now I will send fire to destroy the fortresses of Kerioth. Battle shouts and trumpet blasts will be heard as I destroy Moab
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔto Moabo nu see maa ɔkɔyera Kiriote anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ, na Moabo kowu wɔ bagyabagya nu, wɔ esebɔlɛ ne totorobɛndohulɛ nu.

english_verse: with its king and leaders. I, the Lord, have spoken! Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Ngɔpɛ ye maenbulɛniɛ ne asue ngofi ye nu, na ngohũhũ atitire nemɔ amukoraa ngɔboka ye so,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Yuda nwo ngɔm

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Judah for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They have rejected my teachings and refused to obey me. They were led astray by the same false gods their ancestors worshiped.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ɔnate Yuda ye amumuyɛɛ nza, eh, ɔne nna ne ati, mengɔhwe ye so hwenɛ ne mengosa; ofikyɛ bapo AWURADE mmeraa, banni ye mmeraa dwirɛ so. Bɛ nnakannaka bɔ ɔte atee bɔ bɛ nana mɔ fale so ne, wamaa bali makyebu.

english_verse: Now I will send fire on Judah and destroy the fortresses of Jerusalem. Judgment on Israel
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔto Yuda nu see maa ɔkɔyera Yerusalem anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ.” Yisrael nwo ngɔm

english_verse: The Lord said: I will punish Israel for countless crimes, and I won't change my mind. They sell honest people for money, and the needy are sold for the price of sandals.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ɔnate Yisrael ye amumuyɛɛ nza, eh, ɔne nna ne ati, mengɔhwe ye so hwenɛ ne mengosa; ofikyɛ bɛtɔne teneneeniɛ bɛfa bede ɛdwetɛ, yeɛ bɛtɔne ehianiɛ bɛfa bede mmaboa.

english_verse: They smear the poor in the dirt and push aside those who are helpless. My holy name is dishonored, because fathers and sons sleep with the same young women.
translation_verse: Bɛ yeɛ betiatia ehiafoɛ ti so bɛkã bɛ ti bewura nnɛterɛ nu, ná besisi mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ; ebie ne ɔse bɛ ne afaneɛ ko bɛda bɛfa begua me dumaa krongron ne anwo fiɛ.

english_verse: They lie down beside altars on clothes taken as security for loans. And they drink wine in my temple, wine bought with the money they received from fines.
translation_verse: Ndena bɔ bafa basi bɛ berɛ awowaa ne, bɛfa bɛsesɛ afɔleɛ bokyea biala anwo bɛda so, na bɛtɔ mmenia bedi a, nu nzaa ne, bɛno ye wɔ bɛ nyameɛ mɔ awuro.

english_verse: Israel, the Amorites were there when you entered Canaan. They were tall as cedars and strong as oaks. But I wiped them out— I destroyed their branches and their roots.
translation_verse: Nakoso Amoriniɛ bɔ ye tendenn te kyɛ sida bakaa ne, bɔ ye nwo yɛ se kyɛ eluii ne, nguni ye wɔ bɛ nyunu. Nzɛkyele ye mmakaammaa wɔ anwuro, yeɛ nzɛkyele ye ndii wɔ ye bo.

english_verse: I had rescued you from Egypt, and for forty years I had led you through the desert. Then I gave you the land of the Amorites.
translation_verse: Afei koso, nyele ɛmɔ mvili Misraim aseɛ so, na nnili ɛmɔ nyunu mvale ɛmɔ mvale ɛserɛ so afoɛ aburanna, kyɛ ɛmɔɔfa Amoriniɛ n’aseɛ ne bɛyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ.

english_verse: I chose some of you to be prophets and others to be Nazirites. People of Israel, you know this is true. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Na nyeyele ɛmɔ mma nemɔ bie nyɛle bɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ, yeɛ ɛmɔ mmerandeɛ nemɔ bie nyɛle bɛ nasiritefoɛ. Ao Yisraelfoɛ, aso nna sɔ yeɛ ɔte ɔ?,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: But you commanded the prophets not to speak their message, and you pressured the Nazirites into drinking wine.
translation_verse: “Nakoso ɛmɔmane nasiritefoɛ nemɔ nzaa maa bɛnone, na ɛmɔhyɛle ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, ‘Nnɛma ɛmɔhyɛ ngɔm!’

english_verse: And so I will crush you, just as a wagon full of grain crushes the ground.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, ngɔnyema ɛmɔ ngɔhɔ ase, kyɛbɔ teaseɛnam bɔ aburoo ayi ye to ne ɔnyema kɔ ase ɔ.

english_verse: No matter how fast you run, you won't escape. No matter how strong you are, you will lose your strength and your life.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛnwatilɛ kɔbɔ anwonyeralɛniɛ, anwoserɛniɛ ye anwoserɛ kotu komini, yeɛ katakyie ngɔhora ngɔpepɛ ngole ye nwo.

english_verse: Even if you are an expert with a bow and arrow, you will retreat. And you won't get away alive, not even if you run fast or ride a horse.
translation_verse: Agyaentolɛniɛ ngɔhora ngogyina ye gya so; sona bɔ ye gya bo so yɛ nyera ne, ɔngɔhora ngɔpepɛ ngole ye nwo, yeɛ pɔngɔhanɛniɛ ngɔhora ngɔpepɛ ngole ye nwo.

english_verse: You may be brave and strong, but you will run away, stripped naked. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, anwoserɛfoɛ nu ahoneserɛniɛ ne, ɔkɔnwati bɔ ye nwo la so ɔ,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: People of Israel, I rescued you from Egypt. Now listen to my judgment against you.
translation_verse: Ao Yisraelfoɛ, ɛ́mɔtie edwirɛ he bɔ AWURADE wahã wafa ɛmɔ nwo ɔ: bɔ mahã mafa abusua amukoraa bɔ nyele ɛmɔ mvili Misraim aseɛ so mmale ne nwo ɔ, kyɛ,

english_verse: Of all nations on earth, you are the only one I have chosen. That's why I will punish you because of your sins. The Work of a Prophet
translation_verse: “Aseɛ ye aso mmusua amukoraa, ɛmɔ angome yeɛ mese ɛmɔ ɔ; yiti ɔnate ɛmɔ amumuyɛɛ amukoraa ne ati, ngɔhwe ɛmɔ so.

english_verse: Can two people walk together without agreeing to meet?
translation_verse: “Aso mmenia nyɔ bɛkora betu nu, wɔ aberɛ bɔ bɛnyɛ adwene ɔ?

english_verse: Does a lion roar in the forest unless it has caught a victim? Does it growl in its den unless it is eating?
translation_verse: Aso gyata opo wɔ ɛhɔayeɛ nu, wɔ aberɛ bɔ onnyane kaka biala bɔ ɔkye ye di ɔ? Aso gyata akrɔngrɔma kɔtea nu wɔ nekaa bɔ ɔla ɔ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ onnyane kaka biala bɔ wahye ye ɔ?

english_verse: How can anyone catch a bird without using a net? Does a trap spring shut unless something is caught?
translation_verse: Aso anomaa kɔtɔ ngaen nu wɔ ase, wɔ aberɛ bɔ aleɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ bafa basua ye ngaen ɔ? Aso ngaen fandi fi aseɛnwo, wɔ aberɛ bɔ wangye hwee ɔ?

english_verse: Isn't the whole city frightened when the trumpet signals an attack? Isn't the Lord the one who brings disaster on a city?
translation_verse: Aso behu totorobɛndo wɔ kuro so, bɔ ɛserɛ nga berɛ ama ɔ? Aso amaneɛ to kuro, bɔ nna AWURADE yeɛ wamaa wawa ɔ?

english_verse: Whatever the Lord God plans to do, he tells his servants, the prophets.
translation_verse: Amba, AWURADE Nyameɛ ngɔyɔ nikyee biala, bɔ ɔngɔla ye mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne ali ngohyire ye somvoɛ mɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone is terrified when a lion roars— and ordinary people become prophets when the Lord God speaks. Samaria Is Doomed
translation_verse: Gyata bobɔ nu, na nwa yeɛ ongosuro ɔ? AWURADE Nyameɛ adwudwo, nwa yeɛ ɔngɔhyɛ ngɔm ɔ?”

english_verse: Here is a message for the leaders of Philistia and Egypt— tell everyone to come together on the hills of Samaria. Let them see the injustice and the lawlessness in that city.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbɔ ye dawure wɔ Asedɔde anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ anu, yeɛ Misraim aseɛ so anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ anu, ná ɛmɔhã kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ noa wɔ Samaria mmokaa nemɔ aso, ɛ́mɔnea basabasa mbiri mbiri bɔ ɔkɔ so wɔ nu ɔ, ɔne nhyɛsoɛ bɔ ɔkɔ so wɔ nu ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord has said that they don't even know how to do right. They have become rich from violence and robbery.
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛboaboa atianuserɛ ne awerɔm awue noa wɔ b’anwoserɛ afealeɛ mɔ anu ne, bɛnze kyɛbɔ bɛyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: And so the Lord God has sworn that they will be surrounded. Enemies will break through their defenses and steal their treasures.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, “Pɔfoɛ bie kɔpɛ aseɛ ne anwo koyia, okole w’anwoserɛ kofi wɔ sa nu, na ɔkɔfẽ w’anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ anu nningyein.”

english_verse: The Lord has promised that only a few from Samaria will escape with their lives and with some broken pieces of their beds and couches. It will be like when a shepherd rescues two leg bones and part of a sheep's ear from the jaws of a lion. The Altars at Bethel
translation_verse: Bɔ AWURADE kã hɔ ɛhe: “Kyɛbɔ mmoaenneafoɛ ɔpepɛ de agyirɛ nyɔ anaa asoɛ bue fi gyata noa nu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛkɔpepɛ bekole Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bɛtete Samaria wɔ mba ndweasoɛ so ne bɛen bue so ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful told me to speak this message against Jacob's descendants:
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ, Asafo Nyameɛ nwa, “Ɛ́mɔtie, ná ɛ́mɔbɔ Yakob awuro kɔkɔ kyɛ,

english_verse: When I, the Lord, punish Israel for their sins, I will destroy the altars at Bethel. Even the corners of the altar will be left in the dirt.
translation_verse: “Kyẽa bɔ ngɔhwe Yisrael so wɔ ye mmeraatolɛ nwo ne, ngɔhwe Betel afɔleɛ mmokyea nemɔ koso bɛ so, na bɛkɔpepɛ afɔleɛ mmokyea mmɛen nemɔ maa bekogua ase.

english_verse: I will tear down winter homes and summer homes. Houses decorated with ivory and all other mansions will be gone forever. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ngobubu prakasua mmerɛ sua ne ahuhuro mmerɛ sua nemɔ ngogua ase, ɛsoen gye sua nemɔ kɔsɛkyesɛkye, na awuro mbiri mbiri nemɔ kobubu kogua ase gyirigorɔɔ,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: You women of Samaria are fat cows! You mistreat and abuse the poor and needy, then you say to your husbands, “Bring us more drinks!”
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, ɛ́mɔtie, Basan nandwie mmeleɛ bɔ ɛmɔwɔ Samaria bokaa so ɔ, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔhyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ so, ná ɛmɔsisi ehiafoɛ ɔ; ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔkã bekyire ɛmɔ ahu mɔ kyɛ, ‘Fa bra maa yɛno’ ɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, have sworn by my own name that your time is coming. Not one of you will be left— you will be taken away by sharp hooks.
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ afa ye krongronyɛlɛ wata ndaen kyɛ, Ɛ́mɔtie, ngyẽa bie ɔba ɛmɔ so, bɔ bɛkɔfa buralɛ koateɛ bɛkɔhwe ɛmɔ bɛkɔhɔ, yeɛ bɛkɔfa koaa bɛkɔhwe ɛmɔ si ama mɔ bɛkɔhɔ.

english_verse: You will be dragged through holes in your city walls, and you will be thrown toward Harmon. I, the Lord, have spoken! Israel Refuses To Obey The Lord said:
translation_verse: Fasue ndokuro mɔ nu yeɛ ɛmɔkɔfa bekofite ɔ; ebiala kɔfa atee bɔ ɔla ye nyunu tee ɔ so, na bekofindi ɛmɔ bekogua Hamɔn,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Come to Bethel and Gilgal. Sin all you want! Offer sacrifices the next morning and bring a tenth of your crops on the third day.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔbra Betel bɛɛto mmeraa, ɛmɔbra Gilgal bɛma ɛmɔ mmeraatolɛ ɔyɛ pee; ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ afɔleɛ bɛbra ngyerɛmɔ biala, ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko bɛbra ɛlɛsa biala.

english_verse: Bring offerings to show me how thankful you are. Gladly bring more offerings than I have demanded. You really love to do this. I, the Lord God, have spoken! How the Lord Warned Israel
translation_verse: Ao ɛmɔ, Yisraelfoɛ, ɛ́mɔfa paanoo harewaa bɛ́bɔ asennaa afɔleɛ. Ɛ́mɔbɔ akyɛdeɛ afɔleɛ nwo dawure, ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́to dwaa, ofikyɛ bɔ ɛmɔkuro kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ hɔ ɛne,” AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I, the Lord, took away the food from every town and village, but still you rejected me.
translation_verse: “Mmane ɛmɔ noa aleɛ bɔle ɛmɔ wɔ ɛmɔ nguro nemɔ amukoraa so, yeɛ ɛhɔen wale ɛmɔ atenaleɛ nemɔ amukoraa nu, nakoso ɛmɔanza bamma me berɛ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Three months before harvest, I kept back the rain. Sometimes I would let it fall on one town or field but not on another, and pastures dried up.
translation_verse: “Asa koso, mama esue ayakyi tɔlɛ wama ɛmɔ wɔ aberɛ bɔ wahã bosome nza koraka né buberɛ adwu ɔ; mama esue watɔ wagua kuro ko aso, yeɛ mamma wandɔ wangua kuro ko aso. Esue tɔ guale eboo ko aso, na eboo bɔ esue wandɔ wangua so ne, nu nningyein yerale.

english_verse: People from two or three towns would go to a town that still had water, but it wasn't enough. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Yiti nguro nyɔ anaa nza so ama behyinihyinini bɛhɔle kuro ko aso bɛɛnone nzue, nakoso nzue ne wande bɛ; nakoso ɛmɔanza bamma me berɛ,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I dried up your grain fields; your gardens and vineyards turned brown. Locusts ate your fig trees and olive orchards, but even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Mafa fieso nningyein kesenɛ ne asukuo nwo amaneɛ mato ɛmɔ so. Mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔ turo mɔ, ɛmɔ bobe boo mɔ, ɛmɔ borɔdoma mmakaa ne ɛmɔ olive mmakaa yɛle pee ne, mmɛbɛ sɛkyele bɛ, nakoso ɛmɔanza bamma me berɛ,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I did terrible things to you, just as I did to Egypt— I killed your young men in war; I let your horses be stolen, and I made your camp stink with dead bodies. Even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Anwonyerɛ mɔ bɔ mva mmɔle Misraim ne, nzomane maa ɔɔbɔle ɛmɔ; mvale ngrandɛ ngukuni ɛmɔ mmerandeɛ mɔ; nzesale ɛmɔ mbɔngɔ mɔ ngɔle, mmane ɛmɔ asikyeleɛ nu pambaen ne wurale ɛmɔ bonyi anu, nakoso ɛmɔanza bamma me berɛ,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I destroyed many of you, just as I did the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah. You were a burning stick I rescued from the fire. But even then you rejected me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: “Nnuane ɛmɔ nu biemɔ boso kyɛbɔ me, Nyameɛ, nnuane Sodom ne Gomora bɛ boso ne. Na né ɛmɔte kyɛ gyetia bɔ baye bafi see bɔ ogye nu ɔ, nakoso ɛmɔanza bamma me berɛ,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Now, Israel, I myself will deal with you. Get ready to face your God!
translation_verse: “Ao Yisrael, yiti bɔ ngɔfa ngɔyɔ wɔ ɛhe; ao Yisrael, ɔnate kyɛ ngɔfa ɛhe ngɔyɔ wɔ ne ati, boaboa wɔ nwo koyia wɔ Nyameɛ.”

english_verse: I created the mountains and the wind. I let humans know what I am thinking. I bring darkness at dawn and step over hills. I am the Lord God All-Powerful!
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ tie, bɔ ɔhyehyɛle mmokaa mɔ, ná ɔbɔle mvrama ne, ye bɔ ɔye ye ti anu adwene kyire adasa mmaa, ɔma ngyerɛmɔ kakyi awosii, ná otiatia aseɛ ye aso asɔneyɛɛ mɔ so ne, ye dumaa ole AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Listen, nation of Israel, to my mournful message:
translation_verse: Ao Yisrael awuro ama, ɛ́mɔtie edwirɛ he bɔ mékã mefa ɛmɔ nwo, bɔ ɔte awuyebɔlɛ ye.

english_verse: You, dearest Israel, have fallen, never to rise again— you lie deserted in your own land, with no one to help you up.
translation_verse: “Ababunu Yisrael wafi ase bɔ ongodwɔso ko ɔ; bapo ye wɔ ye aseɛ so, bɔ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔkɔma ye so ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord keeps saying, “Israel, turn back to me and you will live!
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔ AWURADE kã kyire Yisrael awuro ama ɛhe, “Ɛ́mɔpena me si ate, na ɛmɔkonya ngoa.

english_verse: Don't go to Gilgal or Bethel or even to Beersheba. Gilgal will be dragged away, and Bethel will end up as nothing.”
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔpena Betel si ate, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔkɔ Gilgal, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔpɛ nu bɛkɔ Beɛ Seba; ofikyɛ bɛkɔhye Gilgal nnure bɛkɔhɔ amba, yeɛ Betel kɔbɔ.”

english_verse: Turn back to the Lord, you descendants of Joseph, and you will live. If you don't, the Lord will attack like fire. Bethel will burn to the ground, and no one can save it.
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔpena AWURADE si ate, na ɛmɔkonya ngoa; wamma ye sɔ a, ɔkɔwa Yosef awuro ama so kyɛ see, na ɔkɔyera ye, bɔ ebiala nne Betel bɔ okonua ye ɔ.

english_verse: You people are doomed! You twist the truth and trample on justice.
translation_verse: Ah, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔkakyi ndɛenbualɛ turoloo maa ɔyɛ kyɛ abɔwee, ná ɛmɔgyi tenenee bɛto ase ɔ!

english_verse: But the Lord created the stars and put them in place. He turns darkness to dawn and daylight to darkness; he scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth.
translation_verse: Ye bɔ ɔbɔle nzramaa kure ne Akɔtaen-ne-ye-mma, ye bɔ ɔkakyi awosii tunn maa ɔyɛ ngyerɛmɔ, ná ɔma eyia yɛ tunn kyɛ kɔngɔen, ye bɔ ɔfrɛfrɛ ɛpo nu nzue, ná ohwie gua aseɛ nyunu ne, ye dumaa ole AWURADE.

english_verse: God destroys mighty soldiers and strong fortresses. Choose Good Instead of Evil! The Lord said:
translation_verse: Ye bɔ obubu anwoserɛfoɛ maa bɛyɛ mmerɛ ndɛndɛ so, ná obubu anwoserɛ afealeɛ mɔ ɔ.

english_verse: you abuse the poor and demand heavy taxes from them. You have built expensive homes, but you won't enjoy them; you have planted vineyards, but you will get no wine.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔsisi bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo, ná ɛmɔbɔ bɛ apoo bede atokoɔ befi bɛ berɛ ne ati, nyɔboɛ bɔ badwa ɔ yeɛ ɛmɔafa basisi sua ɔ, nakoso ɛmɔngɔtena nu. Ɛmɔayɔ bobe boo nyemene mɔ de, nakoso ɛmɔngɔno nu bobe nzaa ne bie.

english_verse: I am the Lord, and I know your terrible sins. You cheat honest people and take bribes; you rob the poor of justice.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mese ɛmɔ mmeraatolɛ worawora ne, ɔne ɛmɔ bɔne mbiri mbiri ne. Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔteetee teneneefoɛ, ná ɛmɔde fea-ase-ma, ná ɛmɔbua bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ ndɛengyea wɔ nekaa bɔ bedi dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Times are so evil that anyone with good sense will keep quiet.
translation_verse: Ɔnate sɔ ati, nworɛfoɛ komua bɛ noa wɔ sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, ofikyɛ ɔte mmerɛ tɛɛ.

english_verse: If you really want to live, you must stop doing wrong and start doing right. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, will then be on your side, just as you claim I am.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔte paa mmom yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔpena ye si atee ɔ, na nna bɔ ɔte bɔne ɔ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanya ngoa, na AWURADE Asafo Nyameɛ kogyina ɛmɔ si, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔahã ne.

english_verse: Choose good instead of evil! See that justice is done. Maybe I, the Lord All-Powerful, will be kind to what's left of your people. Judgment Is Coming
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhyi bɔne ná ɛmɔhuro bɔ ɔte paa ɔ. Ɛ́mɔbua ndɛen turoloo wɔ nekaa bɔ bedi dwirɛ ne. Ebiaa AWURADE Asafo Nyameɛ, okonwu Yosef boso ama ngaa nemɔ anwumvoin.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has sworn: Noisy crying will be heard in every town and street. Even farmers will be told to mourn for the dead, together with those who are paid to mourn.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ, AWURADE, ɔnwa, “Bɛkɔbɔ awuye wɔ dwaa nemɔ amukoraa so, yeɛ bɛkɔkekã ye wɔ atimbire nemɔ amukoraa so kyɛ, ‘Ayaa! Ayaa!’ Na bɛkɔfrɛ kuafoɛ maa bekoosu, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛse sũ ɔ maa bɛkɔɔbɔ awuye.

english_verse: Your vineyards will be filled with crying and weeping, because I will punish you. I, the Lord, have spoken! When the Lord Judges
translation_verse: Na bɛkɔbɔ awuye wɔ bobe boo nemɔ amukoraa nu, ofikyɛ ngɔɔpɛ nu ngɔfa wɔ nu,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: You look forward to the day when the Lord comes to judge. But you are in for trouble! It won't be a time of sunshine; all will be darkness.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ yaakɔ, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔnea AWURADE kyẽa ne ate ɔ! Nzikyɛ yeɛ kyẽa ne kɔyɔ kɔma ɛmɔ ɔ? AWURADE kyẽa ne, ɔte awosii, na ɔtte hyireinn.

english_verse: You will run from a lion, only to meet a bear. You will escape to your house, rest your hand on the wall, and be bitten by a snake.
translation_verse: Wayɛ kyɛ sona bɔ wanwati gyata bɔ kwabrafo waayia ye ɔ; anaa wahɔ awuro waafa ye sa wafua fasue so, ná ewoo aha ye ɔ.

english_verse: The day when the Lord judges will be dark, very dark, without a ray of light. What the Lord Demands
translation_verse: Aso AWURADE kyẽa ne ɔngɔyɛ awosii? Aso ɔngɔyɛ awosii tuu bɔ hyireinn nne nu ɔ?

english_verse: I, the Lord, hate and despise your religious celebrations and your times of worship.
translation_verse: Mekyi ɛmɔ aluolue nemɔ, na mebu bɛ animtia, na me nye ngye ɛmɔ aluolue nyianu nemɔ anwo.

english_verse: No more of your noisy songs! I won't listen when you play your harps.
translation_verse: Fa wɔ dweintolɛ nwo gyegyegyegye ne fi me so kɔ; ofikyɛ mengotie wɔ sangoo dwein ne.

english_verse: But let justice and fairness flow like a river that never runs dry.
translation_verse: Na mmom odi kyɛ ɛmɔma ndɛenbualɛ turoloo tengyɛ kyɛ asue, ná tenenee ɔsẽ kyɛ asue piri.

english_verse: Israel, for forty years you wandered in the desert, without bringing offerings or sacrifices to me.
translation_verse: “Ao Yisrael awuro ama, afoɛ aburanna bɔ né ɛmɔwɔ ɛserɛ so ne, aso ɛmɔbɔle naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne aleɛ afɔleɛ bɛmane me?

english_verse: Now you will have to carry the two idols you made— Sakkuth, the one you call king, and Kaiwan, the one you built in the shape of a star.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔsoale ɛmɔ hene Sakute, ɔne ɛmɔ nzramaa amoen Kiyun bɔ ɛmɔayɔ bama ɛmɔ nwo ne.

english_verse: I will force you to march as captives beyond Damascus. I, the Lord God All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔpɛ ɛmɔ asue ngɔhɔ Damasko si dɔ,” AWURADE bɔ ye dumaa ole Asafo Nyameɛ ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Do you rulers in Jerusalem and in the city of Samaria feel safe and at ease? Everyone bows down to you, and you think you are better than any other nation. But you are in for trouble!
translation_verse: “Bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo atɔ bɛ wɔ Sion, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ wora bewura Samaria bokaa nu ɔ, maen maen mbanyi mɔ nu atitire mɔ bɔ Yisrael awuro ama bɛbapena mmokalɛ befi ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ, ɛmɔ yaakɔ!

english_verse: Look what happened to the cities of Calneh, powerful Hamath, and Gath in Philistia. Are you greater than any of those kingdoms?
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔpɛ nu bɛhɔ Kalene bɛɛnea, na ɛmɔfi berɛ a, ɛmɔhɔ kuro piri Hamate; afei ɛ́mɔtoro bɛhɔ Filistifoɛ kuro Gate. Aso bɛte paa bɛtra sɔ ahennie hemɔ? Anaa b’aseɛ te piri tra ɛmɔ aseɛ anaa?

english_verse: You are cruel, and you forget the coming day of judgment.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔtu kyẽa tɛɛ ne bɛhyɛ dedeede, nakoso ɛmɔ yɔleɛ de, basabasa yeɛ ɔfa ba ɔ!

english_verse: You rich people lounge around on beds with ivory posts, while dining on the meat of your lambs and calves.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔ yaakɔ! Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔla mba bɔ bafa ɛsoen gye bayɔ ɔ so, bɔ ɛmɔtwe ɛmɔ nu wɔ ɛmɔ bɛen so, bɔ ɛmɔku mmoaen kure ne anu mmoaen akrɔngrɔma mɔ, ɔne tuin ne anu nandwie akrɔngrɔma mɔ bedi ɔ;

english_verse: You sing foolish songs to the music of harps, and you make up new tunes, just as David used to do.
translation_verse: ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔto dwein basabasa bɛfa besuro sangoo so, ná ɛmɔyɔ edweintolɛ nningyein bɔ ɔte kyɛ Dawide deɛ ne ɔ;

english_verse: You drink all the wine you want and wear expensive perfume, but you don't care about the ruin of your nation.
translation_verse: ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔno nzaa awaa bɔ wayi to, bɔ ɛmɔfa sakyeɛfona paa bɛpopa, nakoso ɔmva ɛmɔ nwo kyɛ Yosef ɔbɔ ɔ!

english_verse: So you will be the first to be dragged off as captives; your good times will end.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛ yeɛ bekoli moa bɛkɔhye bɛ nnure bɛkɔhɔ ɔ, na bɛ bɔ bɛtengyɛ bɛ nu ne, b’anigye mmorosoɛ ne ye bo kɔpɛ.”

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful has sworn by his own name: “You descendants of Jacob make me angry by your pride, and I hate your fortresses. And so I will surrender your city and possessions to your enemies.”
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ wata ye nwo ndaen, , “Yakob ye anwomasoɛ ne yɛ me tɛ, yeɛ mekyi ye anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ; yiti ngɔfa kuro ne, ɔne bɔ ɔwɔ nu amukoraa ngowura pɔfoɛ mɔ sa.

english_verse: If only ten of you survive by hiding in a house you will still die.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɛ mmenia buru bɛka awuro ko anu a, bekowuwu.

english_verse: As you carry out a corpse to prepare it for burial, your relative in the house will ask, “Are there others?” You will answer, “No!” Then your relative will reply, “Be quiet! Don't dare mention the name of the Lord.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ abusuaniɛ, bɔ ye yeɛ odi kyɛ osie fuin ne, okuku fuin ne fi awuro ne anu, na obisa ebie wɔ awuro ne akunu dɔ kyɛ, “Aso sona bieku tɛ boka wɔ so wɔ berɛ anaa” a, okobua kyɛ, “Daabi.” Na ɔkɔhã kyɛ, “Mua wɔ noa. Onni kyɛ yɛbɔ AWURADE dumaa.”

english_verse: At the Lord's command, houses great and small will be smashed to pieces.
translation_verse: Tie, AWURADE afa ahyɛdeɛ wama, na bekobubu awuro piri ne bekogua gyirigorɔɔ, ná babu sua ba ne bagua ase bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Horses can't gallop on rocks; oceans can't be plowed. But you have turned justice and fairness into bitter poison.
translation_verse: Aso mbɔngɔ betu amirika wɔ nyɔbotaen so anaa? Aso bɛfa nandwie befundam berɛ anaa? Nakoso ɛmɔama ndɛenbualɛ akakyi ɛborɔ, yeɛ tenenee mma bakakyi anafranaku.

english_verse: You celebrate the defeat of Lo-Debar and Karnaim, and you boast by saying, “We did it on our own.”
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔhoahoa ɛmɔ anwo kyɛ ɛmɔali Lodeba kuro ne aso ngonim, bɔ ɛmɔkekã kyɛ, “Aso nna yɛ bɔbɔ y’anwoserɛ yeɛ yafa yali Karenaim so ngonim ɔ?”

english_verse: But the Lord God All-Powerful will send a nation to attack you people of Israel. They will capture Lebo-Hamath in the north, Arabah Creek in the south, and everything in between.
translation_verse: “Nakoso ao Yisrael awuro ama, ɛ́mɔtie, ngɔma maen bie kodwɔso kotia ɛmɔ,” AWURADE Asafo Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne. “Bɛkɔhyɛ ɛmɔ so fi Hamate tiwaa koodwu Araba bɔnza ne anu.”

english_verse: The Lord God showed me that he is going to send locusts to attack your crops. It will happen after the king has already been given his share of the grain and before the rest of the grain has been harvested.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ he yeɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ ye hyirele me ɔ: Yieee, né ɔnwo mmɛbɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ nningyein bɔ beluale ye nziɛ ne ɔhyɛ ye bo ofifi ɔ. .

english_verse: In my vision the locusts ate every crop in the land, and I said to the Lord, “Please forgive your nation. It's so weak. How can it survive?”
translation_verse: Na belili aseɛ ne aso ndire amukoraa beyiele nen yeɛ ngane kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE Nyameɛ, mesrɛ wɔ, fa kyɛ! Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né Yakob wahora wagyina ye noa? Ofikyɛ ɔte kãa paa.”

english_verse: Then the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of Fire
translation_verse: AWURADE hwe sale, “Ɔngɔwa ye sɔ,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The Lord showed me that he is going to send a ball of fire to burn up everything on earth, including the ocean.
translation_verse: Ɛhe yeɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ ye hyirele me ɔ: Tie, AWURADE Nyameɛ fale see kyɛ ɔbaafa bua ndɛen. Ɔyerale buma piri ne, na ɔyerale aseɛ nekaa bie koso.

english_verse: Then I said, “Won't you please stop? How can our weak nation survive?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngane kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE Nyameɛ, mesrɛ wɔ, nnɛma ɛhe ba nu! Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né Yakob wahora wagyina ye noa? Ofikyɛ ɔte kãa paa.”

english_verse: Again the Lord felt sorry and answered, “I won't let it be destroyed.” A Vision of a Measuring Line
translation_verse: AWURADE hwe sale: “Ɔngɔwa ye sɔ,” AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne. Ɛtengyɛlɛ susulɛ nyamaa ne

english_verse: The Lord showed me a vision of himself standing beside a wall and holding a string with a weight tied to the end of it. The string and weight had been used to measure the straightness of the wall.
translation_verse: Ɛhe yeɛ ɔye hyirele me ɔ: Tie, né AWURADE gyi fasue bie bɔ bafa ɛtengyɛlɛ susulɛ nyamaa basusu bato ɔ so. Né otira ɛtengyɛlɛ susulɛ nyamaa.

english_verse: Then he asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A measuring line,” I answered. The Lord said, “I'm using this measuring line to show that my people Israel don't measure up, and I won't forgive them any more.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE bisale me kyɛ, “Amose, bɔ enwu ye e, nzikyɛ ɛne?” Na mmuale kyɛ, “Ɛtengyɛlɛ susulɛ nyamaa.” Yeɛ AWURADE sele kyɛ, “Tie, ngɔfa ɛtengyɛlɛ susulɛ nyamaa ngɔto me maen Yisrael b’afia, mengobu me nye mengogua bɛ bɔne so ko.”

english_verse: Their sacred places will be destroyed, and I will send war against the nation of King Jeroboam.” Amos and Amaziah
translation_verse: Yisake asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ kɔkakyi kurofoen, Yisrael nekaa krongron nemɔ kɔkakyi aseɛ pralaa, na ngɔfa ngrandɛ ngɔho ngotia Yeroboam awuro ama.” Amose ne Amasia benya dwudwolɛ wɔ Betel

english_verse: Amaziah the priest at Bethel sent this message to King Jeroboam of Israel, “Amos is plotting against you in the very heart of Israel. Our nation cannot put up with his message for very long.
translation_verse: Afei Betel sɔfo Amasia tole ngraa ɔɔmane Yisrael hene Yeroboam kyɛ, “Amose abɔ wɔ nwo porɛ wɔ Yisrael awuro ama mɔ nu’. Ye noa dwirɛ ne amukoraa kɔbɔ maen ne.

english_verse: Here is what he is saying: ‘Jeroboam will be put to death, and the people will be taken to a foreign country.’ ”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Amose nwa: ‘Yeroboam kɔtɔ ngrandɛ noa, na bɛkɔhye Yisrael nnure bekofi bɛ bɔbɔ b’aseɛ so bɛkɔhɔ amba.’ ”

english_verse: Then Amaziah told me, “Amos, take your visions and get out! Go back to Judah and earn your living there as a prophet.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Amasia sele Amose kyɛ, “Ao, wɔ bɔ ɛse ase ɔ, nwati kɔ Yuda aseɛ so, ma wɔ sa hã wɔ noa aleɛ wɔ dɔ, ná hyɛ ngɔm wɔ dɔ,

english_verse: Don't do any more preaching at Bethel. The king worships here at our national temple.”
translation_verse: na mmom nnɛhyɛ ngɔm wɔ Betel ko. Ofikyɛ berɛ te Nana nekaa krongron, na osa te ahemvie.”

english_verse: I answered: I'm not a prophet! And I wasn't trained to be a prophet. I am a shepherd, and I take care of fig trees.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Amose buale Amasia kyɛ, “Me de, nnde ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ oo, yeɛ nnde ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ awa oo; na mmom nde mmoaenneafoɛ ne akyea mmakaa so hwɛsoniɛ,

english_verse: But the Lord told me to leave my herds and preach to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: na AWURADE yele me maa nyakyili mmoaen so nealɛ, na AWURADE sele me kyɛ, ‘Kɔ ná kɔhyɛ ngɔm kyire me maen Yisrael.’

english_verse: Now, listen to what the Lord says about you: Your wife will become a prostitute in the city, your sons and daughters will be killed in war, and your land will be divided among others. You will die in a country of foreigners, and the people of Israel will be dragged from their homeland.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE nwa nyoo, ‘Ɛye kɔyɛ gyanderaniɛ wɔ kuro ne anu, na wɔ mma mmienzua ne wɔ mma mmrasua kɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa, bɛkɔfa ɛwɛen bɛkɔto w’aseɛ nu bɛkɔhyɛ bɛkɔfa, ekowu wɔ aseɛ bɔ ye nwo agua fiɛ ɔ so, na amba, bɛkɔhye Yisrael nnure bekofi ye aseɛ so bɛkɔhɔ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord God showed me a basket of ripe fruit
translation_verse: Ɛhe yeɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ ye hyirele me ɔ: na tie, né ɔte borɔdoma bɔ waboro ɔ kɛndɛen ko.

english_verse: and asked, “Amos, what do you see?” “A basket of ripe fruit,” I replied. Then he said, “This is the end for my people Israel. I won't forgive them again.
translation_verse: Obisale me kyɛ, “Amose, bɔ enwu ye e, nzikyɛ ɛne?” Na mmuale kyɛ, “Borɔdoma bɔ waboro ɔ kɛndɛen ko.” Yeɛ AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Me maen Yisrael, b’ayieleɛ ato bɛ. Mengobu me nye mengogua bɛ bɔne so ko.”

english_verse: Instead of singing in the temple, they will cry and weep. Dead bodies will be everywhere. So keep silent! I, the Lord, have spoken!” Israel Is Doomed The Lord said:
translation_verse: Na asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu dwein kɔkakyi awuyebɔlɛ sɔ kyẽa ne, AWURADE Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne. Efuin pee kogua nekaa biala; na bekogyi bɛ bekogua nekaa biala konn!”

english_verse: You people crush those in need and wipe out the poor.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie ɛhe, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsisi mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ, kyɛ ɛmɔfa so ma aseɛ ne aso ehiafoɛ bedi amia,

english_verse: You say to yourselves, “How much longer before the end of the New Moon Festival? When will the Sabbath be over? Our wheat is ready, and we want to sell it now. We can't wait to cheat and charge high prices for the grain we sell. We will use dishonest scales
translation_verse: ná ɛmɔkã kyɛ, “Kyinzu yeɛ ɛsraen foforɛ ne kɔpɛ nu maa yɛkɔtɔne aburoo ɔ; yeɛ mmerɛ beni yeɛ afofikyẽa ne kɔpɛ nu kɔhɔ, maa yɛkobukyebukye atokoɔ pata anoa nemɔ ɔ? Yɛkosi olonka ne abo, ná yama sekel ne ayɛ piri, ná yafa tonyi bɔ bawura nu ɔ yasisi mmenia ɔ.

english_verse: and mix dust in the grain. Those who are needy and poor don't have any money. We will make them our slaves for the price of a pair of sandals.”
translation_verse: Ɛhe kɔmaa yɛkɔfa ɛdwetɛ yɛkɔtɔ ehiafoɛ, yɛkɔfa mmaboa yɛkɔtɔ bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo ɔ, ná yatɔne atokoɔ boso bɔ ɔtte mayee ne.

english_verse: I, the Lord, won't forget any of this, though you take great pride in your ancestor Jacob.
translation_verse: AWURADE ata Yakob anwomasoɛ ne anwo ndaen kyɛ, “Amba, me wora ngofi bɛ yɔleɛ nemɔ anu biala.

english_verse: Your country will tremble, and you will mourn. It will be like the Nile River that rises and overflows, then sinks back down.
translation_verse: Ɔnate sɔ ati, aso aseɛ ngɔwoso anaa, na so ama amukoraa, aso bengoli aworabɔlɛ anaa? Aseɛ ne amukoraa kohuhu kyɛ asue Naele bɔ wayi ɔ, bekohuruhuru ye, na afei ɔkɔhwe kyɛ Misraim asue Naele.

english_verse: On that day, I, the Lord God, will make the sun go down at noon, and I will turn daylight into darkness.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔma eyia kɔɔtɔ eyiagyina, na ngɔma awosii kɔwa aseɛ so eyia petee.

english_verse: Your festivals and joyful singing will turn into sorrow. You will wear sackcloth and shave your heads, as you would at the death of your only son. It will be a horrible day.
translation_verse: Ngɔkakyi ɛmɔ poentolɛ nemɔ aworabɔlɛlilɛ, yeɛ ɛmɔ dwein amukoraa awuyebɔlɛ; ngɔma ebiala kɔhera ɛsɛen tena, ná mama ebiala abɔ tikwa. Ngɔmaa ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ bahorɛ wue nwo aworabɔlɛlilɛ, ayieleɛ ne kɔyɛ kyɛ aworabɔlɛ kyẽa.

english_verse: I, the Lord, also promise you a terrible shortage, but not of food and water. You will hunger and thirst to hear my message.
translation_verse: “Tie, mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba, bɔ ngɔma ɛhɔen kandinga bie kɔwa aseɛ ne aso, bɔ nna aleɛ hɔen ɔ, yeɛ nna nzuhɔen ɔ, na mmom AWURADE dwirɛ tiele nwo hɔen ɔ”, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: You will search everywhere— from north to south, from east to west. You will go all over the earth, seeking a message from me, the Lord. But you won't find one.
translation_verse: Mmenia kohyini kofi mboanoa bɛkɔɔhã mboanoa, bekofi sorɔ bekoodwu eyia afiteleɛ; bekoli akɔneaba bɛkɔpena AWURADE dwirɛ si atee, nakoso bengonwu ye.

english_verse: Your beautiful young women and your young men will faint from thirst.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, nzuhɔen kɔma ndaluwa anwonyemene ne mmerandeɛ bɛ nye so koburu bɛ.

english_verse: You made promises to the goddess Ashimah at Samaria; you made vows to other gods at the shrines of Dan and Beersheba. So now you will fall and never get up.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛfa Samaria mmosoen bɛteta ndaen bɛkã kyɛ, ‘Ao Dan, kyɛ wɔ nyameɛ te ase ye e’, yeɛ ‘Kyɛ Beɛ Seba atee te ase ye’ ne, bekofifi ase bɔ bengodwɔso ko ɔ.”

english_verse: I saw a vision of the Lord standing by the temple altar, and he said, “Shake the columns until the tops fall loose, and the doorposts crumble. Then make the pieces fall on the people below. I will take a sword and kill anyone who escapes.
translation_verse: Nwuni AWURADE kyɛ ogyi afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Bonima abotire ne, fa nikyee bɔ so maa aponnwaa nemɔ bɛwoso, ná dwiri gua bɛ mukoraa bɛ ti so, na ngɔfa ngrandɛ ngohũhũ bɛ bɔ baha ne’. Bɔ ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ ɔnwati biala, ɔngɔhora nwati, yeɛ bɔ okofi nu kofite biala, ongonya ye ti ngodidi nu.

english_verse: “If they dig deep into the earth or climb to the sky, I'll reach out and get them.
translation_verse: “Sɛ betu bɔen bekodwu ɛborɔ po a, dɔ yeɛ me sa kɔye bɛ kofi ɔ. Sɛ bɛfo bɛkɔ nyameɛso po a, dɔ yeɛ ngɔye bɛ ngofi ngɔwa ase ɔ.

english_verse: If they escape to the peaks of Mount Carmel, I'll search and find them. And if they hide from me at the bottom of the ocean, I'll command a sea monster to bite them.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛkɔfea Kamɛl ti afia dɔ po a, ngɔpena bɛ ngɔye bɛ ngofi dɔ, na sɛ bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛfea me bekowura ɛpo ye bo dɔ po a, dɔ yeɛ ngɔfa ahyɛdeɛ ngɔma ewoo maa ɔkɔkekã bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I'll send a sword to kill them, wherever their enemies drag them off as captives. I'm determined to hurt them, not to help them.” His Name Is the Lord
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛkye bɛ nnure bɛkɔ bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ nyunu po a, dɔ yeɛ ngɔhyɛ ngrandɛ maa okohũhũ bɛ ɔ; na ngotu me nye ngosie bɛ so ngɔfa bɔ ɔtte mayee ɔ ngoli bɛ, na mmom nna paa ɔ.” AWURADE yeɛ obua wiase ndɛen ɔ

english_verse: When the Lord God All-Powerful touches the earth, it melts, and its people mourn. God makes the earth rise and then fall, just like the Nile River.
translation_verse: AWURADE, Asafo Nyameɛ, ye yeɛ ɔfa ye sa kã aseɛ maa ohuro, maa aseɛ ne aso ama mukoraa bedi aworabɔlɛ, ná aseɛ ne amukoraa huhu kyɛ asue Naele, ná ɔtwe kyɛ Misraim asue Naele ɔ.

english_verse: He built his palace in the heavens and let its foundations rest on the earth. He scoops up the ocean and empties it on the earth. His name is the Lord. The Lord Is God
translation_verse: Ye bɔ osi ye aborɔsaen wɔ ewienu, ná ɔfa ye ngatasoɛ obutu aseɛ so; ye bɔ ɔfrɛfrɛ ɛpo nu nzue, ná ohwie bɛ gua aseɛ ye aso ne, ye dumaa ole AWURADE.

english_verse: Israel, I am the Lord God, and the Ethiopians are no less important to me than you are. I brought you out of Egypt, but I also brought the Philistines from Crete and the Arameans from Kir.
translation_verse: “Ao Yisraelfoɛ, ɛmɔ, aso ɛmɔ bɛtte kyɛ Yitiopiafoɛ bɛmma me anaa? AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Aso manye Yisrael mamvi Misraim aseɛ so anaa? Aso manye Filistifoɛ mamvi Kafito, yeɛ manye Siriafoɛ mamvi Kire anaa?

english_verse: My eyes have seen what a sinful nation you are, and I'll wipe you out. But I will leave a few of Jacob's descendants. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Tie, AWURADE Nyameɛ watu ye nye wasie ahennie bɔ bɔne ali ye ti ne aso, na ngonua ye boso ngofi aseɛ ye aso. Nakoso mengonua Yakob awuro ama boso bɔkɔɔ,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: At my command, all of you will be sifted like grain. Israelites who remain faithful will be scattered among the nations. And the others will be trapped like trash in a sifter.
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ tie, ngɔfa ahyɛdeɛ ngɔma, na ngohuhu Yisrael awuro ama so wɔ maen maen amukoraa nu, kyɛbɔ behuhu aburoo so wɔ huhuamoa nu ɔ, nakoso aburoo ne kaaba ko po ngɔtɔ ase.

english_verse: Some of you are evil, and you deny that you will ever get caught. But you will be killed. The Lord's Promise to Israel
translation_verse: Me maen nu bɔnefoɛ amukoraa bɛkɔtotɔ ngrandɛ noa; bɛ yeɛ bɛkekã kyɛ, ‘Musue biala ngɔto yɛ anaa ɔngɔhora yɛ’ ne. AWURADE kosa kɔkyekye ye maen Yisrael

english_verse: In the future, I will rebuild David's fallen kingdom. I will build it from its ruins and set it up again, just as it used to be.
translation_verse: “Sɔ kyẽa ne, Dawide ɛtena sua bɔ watɔ ase ne, ngɔpagya ngosie berɛ, na ngɔpomba ye nekaa bɔ wasunzua nemɔ; ngɔpagya bɔ wabubu wagua ase ne ngogyina berɛ, ná masa masi ye kyɛbɔ né ɔte daa tete ne ala;

english_verse: Then you will capture Edom and the other nations that are mine. I, the Lord, have spoken, and my words will come true.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so bafa Edom ngaa ne bayɛ bɛ deɛ, ɔne maen maen amukoraa bɔ me dumaa la bɛ so ne bayɛ bɛ deɛ,” AWURADE bɔ ɔyɔ sɔ ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: You will have such a harvest that you won't be able to bring in all of your wheat before plowing time. You will have grapes left over from season to season; your fruitful vineyards will cover the mountains.
translation_verse: “Tie, mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba bɔ sona bɔ ofundam aseɛ ne, ye nwo kɔyɛ nyera kɔtra bɔ ɔte nnɔbaeɛ ɔ; bɔ otwi bobe nzaa ne, ye nwo kɔyɛ nyera kɔtra bɔ odua mmakaammaa ɔ; mmokaa nemɔ kɔpe nzaa menemene, na ɔkɔtengyɛ kɔfa pambaa nemɔ amukoraa so, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I'll make Israel prosper again. You will rebuild your towns and live in them. You will drink wine from your own vineyards and eat the fruit you grow.
translation_verse: Ngosa ngɔfa me maen Yisrael ngofi nnurehyelɛ nu ngɔwa, na bekosa bɛkɔkyekye kurofoen nemɔ bɛkɔtenatena so, bɛkɔyɛ bobe boo mɔ bɛkɔno bobe nzaa, na bɛkɔyɛ turo mɔ bekoli nu mmakaammaa ne.

english_verse: I'll plant your roots deep in the land I have given you, and you won't ever be uprooted again. I, the Lord God, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ngolua bɛ wɔ b’aseɛ so, na bɛ bo ngotutu ko le ngofi b’aseɛ bɔ mafa mama bɛ ne aso,” AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The Lord God gave Obadiah a message about Edom, and this is what we heard: “I, the Lord, have sent a messenger with orders for the nations to attack Edom.”
translation_verse: Nyekyire bɔ Obadia nyane ye ne, ye ɛhe: Bɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ kã fa Edom nwo ole kyɛ, Yate ngunga bie yafi AWURADE dɔ, na wasoma ɛbɔfoɛ mɔ wɔ maen maen mɔ berɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔdwɔso, ɛ́mɔma yɛdwɔso yɛɛfa koɛ yɛteta ye.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Edom: I will make you the weakest and most despised nation.
translation_verse: Tie, mamaa ayɛ kaaba wɔ maen maen mɔ nu; bebu wɔ animtia paa.

english_verse: You live in a mountain fortress, because your pride makes you feel safe from attack, but you are mistaken.
translation_verse: W’ahone nu anwomasoɛ ne alakalaka wɔ, wɔ bɔ ɛte nyɔbotaen ndokuro nu, bɔ w’atenaleɛ wɔ nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro ɔ, wɔ bɔ ɛkã ye wɔ wɔ ti anu kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kɔhwe me kɔto ase ɔ?”

english_verse: I will still bring you down, even if you fly higher than an eagle or nest among the stars. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Sɛ etu kɔ anwuro kyɛ kɔleɛ po, ná ɛkyekye wɔ saen wɔ nzramaa mɔ anu po a, berɛ yeɛ ngɔhwe wɔ ngofi ngɔto ase ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: If thieves break in at night, they steal only what they want. And people who harvest grapes always leave some unpicked. But, Edom, you are doomed!
translation_verse: Sɛ awuefoɛ bɛba wɔ so, sɛ awerɔm awuefoɛ bɛba wɔ so kɔngɔen a, aso bengowua alaa bɔ bɛ kunu kuro ɔ? Sɛ bobe telɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛba wɔ bobe boo nu a, aso ahaa bɛngɔyakyi bobe si ne bie wɔ so?

english_verse: Everything you treasure most will be taken from you.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ basi bafẽ Yisɔ nningyein ɔ! Kyɛbɔ basi bayɛ ye anwonyadeɛ bɔ wafa wafea ɔ dosodoso ɔ!

english_verse: Your allies can't be trusted. They will force you out of your own country. And your best friends will trick and trap you, even before you know it.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛ ne wɔ ayɛ apam ne amukoraa, baye wɔ bama, bafoa wɔ baadwu ɛwɛen ne aso; bɛ bɔ bɛ ne wɔ tu nu ne, bali wɔ so ngonim; wɔ mmango bɔ bedi wɔ aleɛ ne, basua wɔ ngaen, nakoso annya ye nwo adwene biala.

english_verse: Edom, when this happens, I, the Lord, will destroy all your marvelous wisdom.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, aso mengohũhũ nworɛfoɛ mengofi Edom, yeɛ nimdeɛfoɛ mengofi Yisɔ bokaa so? AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Warriors from the city of Teman will be terrified, and you descendants of Esau will be wiped out. The Lord Condemns Edom's Cruelty
translation_verse: Ao Teman, w’anwoserɛfoɛ nemɔ, ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ bɛ so, amaa ɔnate so sona biala bɔ ofi Yisɔ bokaa so ne, ɔkɔtɔ wɔ ngrandɛ noa. Bɔ yiti yeɛ Nyameɛ kɔhwe Edom so ɔ

english_verse: You were cruel to your relatives, the descendants of Jacob. Now you will be destroyed, disgraced forever.
translation_verse: Ɔnate atianuserɛ bɔ ɛbɔle eliɛma Yakob ne ati, animguaseɛ kobia wɔ, na wɔ boso konua afebɔɔ.

english_verse: You stood there and watched as foreigners entered Jerusalem and took what they wanted. In fact, you were no better than those foreigners.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, egyinane nekaa bie yele wɔ nye, sɔ kyẽa bɔ ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ sesale ye anwonyadeɛ bɛhɔle ne, bɔ amanvrafoɛ bewurale ye pambim mɔ nu, ná beguale serewa bɛhyɛle Yerusalem bɛfale ne, wɔ koso eli tole bɛ so.

english_verse: Why did you celebrate when such a dreadful disaster struck your relatives? Why were you so pleased when everyone in Judah was suffering?
translation_verse: Nakoso ahaa onni kyɛ wɔ nye gye wɔ eliɛma n’amaneɛnwunɛ kyẽa ne anwo, yeɛ ahaa onni kyɛ edi ahurusi wɔ Yuda mma bɔ né bekũkũ bɛ ne anwo. Afei ahaa onni kyɛ ɛkekã anwomasoɛ dwirɛ, wɔ b’aworabɔlɛ kyẽa ne anwo.

english_verse: In their time of torment, you ambushed refugees and handed them over to their attackers. The Lord Will Judge the Nations
translation_verse: Ahaa onni kyɛ egyina ngwandaa ne aso, kyɛ ekũkũ ye mmenia bɔ bɛnwatili nemɔ; yeɛ ahaa onni kyɛ ɛye bɛ bɔ baha nemɔ ma bɛ, wɔ aworabɔlɛ kyẽa ne anu.

english_verse: The day is coming when I, the Lord, will judge the nations. And, Edom, you will pay in full for what you have done.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE kyẽa ne wapingye wɔ maen maen amukoraa bɛ so. Kyɛbɔ ayɔ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔyɔ wɔ ɔ; wɔ yɔleɛ kɔbɔ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ ti so.

english_verse: I forced the people of Judah to drink the wine of my anger on my sacred mountain. Soon the neighboring nations must drink their fill— then vanish without a trace. Victory for Israel
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ kyɛbɔ ɛmɔano nzaa wɔ me bokaa krongron ne aso ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ amukoraa bɛkɔhɔ so bɛkɔno ɔ; amba, bɛkɔno, bɛkɔbo sram, na bɛ boso konua bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord's people who escape will go to Mount Zion, and it will be holy. Then Jacob's descendants will capture the land of those who took their land.
translation_verse: Nakoso Sion bokaa so yeɛ bɛ bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ne bɛkɔtena ɔ; berɛ kɔyɛ krongron, na Yakob boso ama bɛ sa kɔhã b’agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: The people of Israel who live in the Southern Desert will take the land of Edom. Those who live in the hills will capture Philistia, Ephraim, and Samaria. And the tribe of Benjamin will conquer Gilead.
translation_verse: Ngwaen dɔ ama kɔfa Yisɔ bokaa ne bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ, na aseɛ pralaa ne aso ama kɔfa Filistifoɛ aseɛ bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ; bɛkɔfa Efraim aseɛ ne Samaria aseɛ bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ, na Benyamin kɔfa Gileade kɔyɛ ye deɛ.

english_verse: Those who return from captivity will control Phoenicia as far as Zarephath. Captives from Jerusalem who were taken to Sepharad will capture the towns of the Southern Desert.
translation_verse: Yisraelfoɛ bɔ bɛhyele bɛ nnure bɛhɔle ne, bɛ lɔen ne kɔɔfa Kanaan aseɛ bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ koodwu Sarefate; na Yerusalemfoɛ bɔ bɛhyele bɛ nnure bɛhɔle bɔ bɛwɔ Sefarade ne, bɛkɔɔfa ngwaen dɔ nguro nemɔ bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ.

english_verse: Those the Lord has saved will live on Mount Zion and rule over Edom. Then the kingdom will belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na defoɛ mɔ kɔfo kɔhɔ Sion bokaa so bɛkɔɔyɛ Yisɔ bokaa ne aso maenbulɛfoɛ, na ahennie ne kɔyɛ AWURADE deɛ.

english_verse: One day the Lord told Jonah, the son of Amittai,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Amitae awa Yona kyɛ,

english_verse: to go to the great city of Nineveh and say to the people, “The Lord has seen your terrible sins. You are doomed!”
translation_verse: “Dwɔso kɔ Ninewe, sɔ kuro piri ne aso, ná bɔ ye dawure kyire bɛ kyɛ b’amumuyɛɛ wafo waadwu me nyunu.”

english_verse: Instead, Jonah ran from the Lord. He went to the seaport of Joppa and found a ship that was going to Spain. So he paid his fare, then got on the ship and sailed away to escape.
translation_verse: Nakoso Yona dwɔsole kyɛ ɔnwati fi AWURADE nyunu ɔkɔ Tasise. Ɔhɔle Yopa, na onwuni ɛlɛen bie bɔ ɔkɔ Tasise ɔ. Yiti otuale ye ɛlɛen sikaa ne, na ɔfo ɔtenane nu kyɛ ɔnwati fi AWURADE nyunu ɔne bɛ kɔ Tasise.

english_verse: But the Lord made a strong wind blow, and such a bad storm came up that the ship was about to be broken to pieces.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE somane mvrama bie bɔ ye noa yɛ hye ɔ maa otu fale ɛpo ne aso, na mvrama piri tu fale ɛpo ne aso, bɔ né ɛlɛen ne ɔpena odwudwa ɔ.

english_verse: The sailors were frightened, and they all started praying to their gods. They even threw the ship's cargo overboard to make the ship lighter. All this time, Jonah was down below deck, sound asleep.
translation_verse: Afei né ɛlɛenhanɛfoɛ nemɔ besuro. Yiti bɛ nu biala sũ frɛle ye nyameɛ, na befindini ɛlɛen ne anu nningyein beguale ɛpo ne anu, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔmaa ɛlɛen ne anu kɔyɛ nyera ɔ. Nakoso Yona de, né wadwu wahɔ ɛlɛen ne akunu dɔ paa waala hatee.

english_verse: The ship's captain went to him and said, “How can you sleep at a time like this? Get up and pray to your God! Maybe he will have pity on us and keep us from drowning.”
translation_verse: Yiti ɛlɛenhanɛfoɛ nemɔ so panyi ne wale ye berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, Hei! Wɔ bɔ alafe hatee ɔ, nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛpena kyire ye? Dwɔso, sũ frɛ wɔ nyameɛ, na ebiaa nyameɛ ne kɔdwene yɛ nwo ná yanwuwu.

english_verse: Finally, the sailors got together and said, “Let's ask our gods to show us who caused all this trouble.” It turned out to be Jonah.
translation_verse: Yeɛ besisele bɛ nwo bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Ɛmɔbra maa yɛgua serewa, amaa ɔnate so yanwu sona horɛ bɔ ye ti yeɛ sɔ musue he wato yɛ ye.” Yiti beguale serewa, na serewa ne yele Yona.

english_verse: They started asking him, “Are you the one who brought all this trouble on us? What business are you in? Where do you come from? What is your country? Who are your people?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ besele ye kyɛ, “Yɛsrɛ wɔ, nikye horɛ bɔ ye ti yeɛ musue he ato yɛ ne, kã kyire yɛ. Nzikyɛ adwuma yeɛ ɛyɔ ɔ? Efi nisua? Efi maen beni aso? Wɔ si fi ni?”

english_verse: Jonah answered, “I'm a Hebrew, and I worship the Lord God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”
translation_verse: Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Me, nde Hebriniɛ. Mesɔne AWURADE, nyameɛso Nyameɛ bɔ ɔbɔle ɛpo ne aseɛ wosee ne.’”

english_verse: When the sailors heard this, they were frightened, because Jonah had already told them he was running from the Lord. Then they said, “Do you know what you have done?”
translation_verse: Na afei mmenia nemɔ surole paa, na besele ye kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ayɔ sɔ nikyee ye?” Né mmenia nemɔ banwu kyɛ wanwati wafi AWURADE nyunu, ofikyɛ né wahã wahyire bɛ.

english_verse: The storm kept getting worse, until finally the sailors asked him, “What should we do with you to make the sea calm down?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ bebisale ye kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛfa yɛyɔ wɔ ɔ, bɔ ɔkɔmaa ɛpo ne kɔla dinn kɔma yɛ ɔ? Ofikyɛ né ɛpo ne tɛ gu so obu fa so.

english_verse: Jonah told them, “Throw me into the sea, and it will calm down. I'm the cause of this terrible storm.”
translation_verse: Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma me so, ɛ́mɔfindi me bɛto ɛpo ne anu, na ɛpo ne kɔla dinn kɔma ɛmɔ; ofikyɛ mese kyɛ ɔnate me ti yeɛ mvrama piri he otu fa ɛmɔ ti anwo ye.”

english_verse: The sailors tried their best to row to the shore. But they could not do it, and the storm kept getting worse every minute.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmenia nemɔ bɔle bɛ nwo mmɔden biala kyɛ bɛkã ɛlɛen ne bekodwu etii so, nakoso bangora, ofikyɛ né ɛpo ne tɛ gu so obu fa so oyia bɛ.

english_verse: So they prayed to the Lord, “Please don't let us drown for taking this man's life. Don't hold us guilty for killing an innocent man. All of this happened because you wanted it to.”
translation_verse: Yiti bɛteane nu besu bɛfrɛle AWURADE kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE, yɛsrɛ wɔ, akoaa he wue ne, nnɛmaa yiti yɛwuwu, yeɛ nnɛmaa yɛdi mogya bɔ odi be ɔ nwo fɔ, ofikyɛ wɔ, AWURADE, bɔ ekuro yeɛ ayɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: Then they threw Jonah overboard, and the sea calmed down.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛmane Yona so begyili ye bɛtole ɛpo ne anu, na ɛpo ne yakyili ebulɛ bɔ obu fa so ne.

english_verse: The sailors were so terrified that they offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made all kinds of promises.
translation_verse: Yeɛ mmenia nemɔ surole AWURADE paa, na bɛbobɔle afɔleɛ bɛmane AWURADE, na bɛbobɔle ye anohoba.

english_verse: The Lord sent a big fish to swallow Jonah, and Jonah was inside the fish for three days and three nights.
translation_verse: Na AWURADE siesiele tiré kandinga bie maa ɔmene Yona. Na Yona lili ɛlɛsa eyia ne kɔngɔen wɔ tiré ne kunu.

english_verse: From inside the fish, Jonah prayed to the Lord his God:
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yona bɔle mbaeɛ hyirele AWURADE ye Nyameɛ wɔ tiré ne akunu dɔ kyɛ,

english_verse: When I was in trouble, Lord, I prayed to you, and you listened to me. From deep in the world of the dead, I begged for your help, and you answered my prayer.
translation_verse: “Nzu mvrɛle AWURADE wɔ m’amaneɛnwunɛ nu, na otiele me; ndeane nu mvili ɛborɔ kunu dɔ, na etiele me sufrɛ.

english_verse: You threw me down to the bottom of the sea. The water was churning all around; I was completely covered by your mighty waves.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ egyili me tole buma nu, wɔ ɛpo afia, na nzue bɔ wayi ne pɛle me nwo yiale; w’asorɔkye amukoraa ne wɔ nzue wuruwuru ne, obu fale me so.

english_verse: I thought I was swept away from your sight, never again to see your holy temple.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngane kyɛ, ‘Afoa me afi wɔ nyunu, nakoso ngosa ngɔto me nye ngɔnea w’asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron ne.’

english_verse: I was almost drowned by the swirling waters that surrounded me. Seaweed had wrapped around my head.
translation_verse: Nzue ne pɛle me nwo bra yiale oodwuli me kra po, buma ne mene me, yeɛ ɛpo nu ndire brabrale me ti.

english_verse: I had sunk down deep below the mountains beneath the sea. I knew that forever, I would be a prisoner there. But, you, Lord God, rescued me from that pit.
translation_verse: Ndwu ngɔle mmokaa nemɔ abo dɔ paa, ndwu ngɔle aseɛ ne aso; aseɛ bɔ ye mmuralɛ bɔ ɔbrambram ye pambim mɔ asi ne, ɔhane me miane afebɔɔ ne. Nakoso ao AWURADE me Nyameɛ, ɛyele me ngoa fili ɛborɔ kumaa nu dɔ fite wale.

english_verse: When my life was slipping away, I remembered you— and in your holy temple you heard my prayer.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ me kra botole wɔ me nu ne, ngayele AWURADE, na me mbaeɛ dwuli wɔ berɛ, wɔ w’asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron ne anu.

english_verse: All who worship worthless idols turn from the God who offers them mercy.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne mmosoen bɔ bɛtte huu ne, bɛpo bɛ bɔbɔ b’anwumvoinnwunɛ.

english_verse: But with shouts of praise, I will offer a sacrifice to you, my Lord. I will keep my promise, because you are the one with power to save.
translation_verse: Nakoso ngɔfa asennaa komviɛ ngɔbɔ afɔleɛ ngɔma wɔ. Ngotua m’aboadeɛ bɔ maboa ne. AWURADE berɛ yeɛ ngoalelɛ fi ɔ!”

english_verse: The Lord commanded the fish to vomit up Jonah on the shore. And it did.
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE dwudwo hyirele tiré ne, na ɔɔfele Yona tole etii so.

english_verse: to go to that great city of Nineveh and preach his message of doom.
translation_verse: “Dwɔso kɔ Ninewe, sɔ kuro piri ne aso, ná kɔbɔ edwirɛ bɔ méka mékyire wɔ ne dawure kyire bɛ.”

english_verse: Jonah obeyed the Lord and went to Nineveh. The city was so big that it took three days just to walk through it.
translation_verse: Yiti Yona dwɔsole sili nu hɔle Ninewe, kyɛbɔ AWURADE hã hyirele ye ne ala. Né Ninewe te kuro piri paa, bɔ ɛlɛsa yeɛ bɛfa bɛnate befi ye ti bɛkɔka ye ti ɔ.

english_verse: After walking for a day, Jonah warned the people, “Forty days from now, Nineveh will be destroyed!”
translation_verse: Yona hyɛle ye bo owurale kuro ne anu, ɔnatele ɛlɛho, na ɔteane nu sele kyɛ, “Waha eleburanna né Ninewe abɔ oo!”

english_verse: They believed God's message and set a time when they would go without eating to show their sorrow. Then everyone in the city, no matter who they were, dressed in sackcloth.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Ninewefoɛ belele Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne belili. Bɛfa bɛtole dwaa kyɛ odi kyɛ ebiala obua da, na bɛherale ɛsɛen tena, ofi atitirefoɛ mɔ so bɔ ɔkwaadwu kwahweabaa mɔ so.

english_verse: When the king of Nineveh heard what was happening, he also dressed in sackcloth; he left the royal palace and sat in dust.
translation_verse: Na Ninewe hene tele edwirɛ bɔ wasi nen, ofili ye ahennie bia so dwɔsole, odwale ye ataadeɛ aguasoɛ guale, ɔfale ɛsɛen tena herale, na ɔtenane nzoen nu.

english_verse: When God saw that the people had stopped doing evil things, he had pity and did not destroy them as he had planned.
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ nwuni bɔ bɛyɔle ne, kyɛ bayakyi bɛ bɔne yɔleɛ ne, yiti Nyameɛ sesane ye adwene wɔ musue bɔ ɔhane kyɛ ɔkɔprapra kogua bɛ so ne anwo, na wamma wando bɛ.

english_verse: Jonah was really upset and angry.
translation_verse: Nakoso edwirɛ ne anyɛ Yona fɛ koraa, na ɔfɛle yaa hahii.

english_verse: So he prayed: Our Lord, I knew from the very beginning that you wouldn't destroy Nineveh. That's why I left my own country and headed for Spain. You are a kind and merciful God, and you are very patient. You always show love, and you don't like to punish anyone.
translation_verse: Na ɔbɔle mbaeɛ bisale AWURADE kyɛ, “Ao AWURADE, mesrɛ wɔ, mmerɛ bɔ né nwɔ me maen nu ne, aso nna edwirɛ he yeɛ ngane ɔ? Ye sɔ ti yeɛ nwatili kyɛ ahaa mekɔ Tasise ne, ofikyɛ mese kyɛ ɛte Nyameɛ bɔ ɛdo mmenia ná ɛse anwumvoin ɔ, w’ahone nhu ndɛ, wɔ ɔdɔ bɔ onni ngasi ne ɔte piri, na ɛsesã w’adwene wɔ musue bɔ ɛbaafa ba ɔ nwo.

english_verse: The Lord replied, “What right do you have to be angry?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE buale kyɛ, “Aso ɔte paa kyɛ ɛfɛ yaa ɔ?”

english_verse: Jonah then left through the east gate of the city and made a shelter to protect himself from the sun. He sat under the shelter, waiting to see what would happen to Nineveh.
translation_verse: Yiti Yona fili kuro ne anu, na ɔɔtenane kuro ne eyia afiteleɛ so. Ɔbɔle asese wɔ berɛ, na ɔtenane ye bo fɔnwoo ne abo, kyɛ ɔnea bɔ ɔkɔto kuro ne ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord made a vine grow up to shade Jonah's head and protect him from the sun. Jonah was very happy to have the vine,
translation_verse: Na AWURADE Nyameɛ siesiele ngomvo bakaa bie maa onyi katale Yona so, kyɛ ɔyɛ fɔnwoo ɔkata ye ti so, ná ɔye ye ofi ye amaneɛ ne anu. Yiti Yona nye gyele ngomvo bakaa ne anwo paa.

english_verse: but early the next morning the Lord sent a worm to chew on the vine, and the vine dried up.
translation_verse: Nakoso aleɛ hyene bɔ eyia opukye ne, Nyameɛ siesiele anyinaboa bie maa olili ngomvo bakaa ne maa bakaa ne wuli.

english_verse: During the day the Lord sent a scorching wind, and the sun beat down on Jonah's head, making him feel faint. Jonah was ready to die, and he shouted, “I wish I were dead!”
translation_verse: Na eyia pukyele ne, Nyameɛ somane eyia afiteleɛ mvrama hyerɛhyerɛ bie; eyia ne bɔle Yona ti afia maa ɔyɛle mmerɛ, bɔ ɔhale ye ngome a ahaa né wawu ɔ. Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɔte paa ma me kyɛ ngowu tra kyɛ ngɔtena ngoa nu ɔ.”

english_verse: But the Lord asked, “Jonah, do you have the right to be angry about the vine?” “Yes, I do,” he answered, “and I'm angry enough to die.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Nyameɛ bisale Yona kyɛ, “Aso ɔte paa kyɛ ngomvo bakaa ne ati ɛfɛ yaa ɔ?” Na obuale kyɛ, “Yoo, odi kyɛ mefɛ yaa bɔ mewu po a ahaa mekuro ɔ.”

english_verse: But the Lord said: You are concerned about a vine that you did not plant or take care of, a vine that grew up in one night and died the next.
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE sele kyɛ, “Ngomvo bakaa bɔ nna wɔ yeɛ ɛfɛle ye nwo, bɔ nna wɔ yeɛ ɛmaa onyini ɔ, bɔ oogyinane berɛ kɔngɔen, ná owuli kɔngɔen ne, ye po anwu ye anwumvoin.

english_verse: I am Micah from Moresheth. And this is the message about Samaria and Jerusalem that the Lord gave to me when Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah. Judgment on Samaria
translation_verse: AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔlale ye ali hyirele Moreseteniɛ Mika, wɔ Yuda ahemvo Yotam, Ahase ne Hesekia b’aberɛ so, bɔ onwuni ye fale Samaria ne Yerusalem nwo ne, ye ɛhe.

english_verse: Listen, all of you! Earth and everything on it, pay close attention. The Lord God accuses you from his holy temple.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, maen maen mɔ amukoraa; ao aseɛ ne bɔ ɔwɔ so amukoraa, ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ bétie, mesrɛ kyɛ AWURADE Nyameɛ ooli adanzeɛ otia ɛmɔ; kyɛ AWURADE ófi ye asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron ne anu yeɛ ɔ́yɔ sɔ ɔ.

english_verse: And he will come down to crush underfoot every pagan altar.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ tie, AWURADE fi ye atenaleɛ berɛ ɔ́ba, na okodwu kɔwa kootiatia aseɛ so asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso.

english_verse: Mountains will melt beneath his feet like wax beside a fire. Valleys will vanish like water rushing down a ravine.
translation_verse: Mmokaa nemɔ kohuro wɔ ye gya bo, na bɔnza nemɔ nu kodwudwa kyɛ amena bɔ ɔla see nye ɔ, kyɛ nzue bɔ bahwie bagua nekaa bɔ ɔtorotoro ɔ.

english_verse: This will happen because of the terrible sins of Israel, the descendants of Jacob. Samaria has led Israel to sin, and pagan altars at Jerusalem have made Judah sin.
translation_verse: Ɛhe amukoraa ɔnate Yakob mmeraatolɛ ti ɔ, yeɛ Yisrael awuro ama bɛ bɔne ti ɔ. Yakob mmeraatolɛ ole beni? Aso nna Samaria ɔ? Yeɛ Yuda asɔneyɛɛ mɔ ole beni? Aso nna bɛ ole Yerusalem?

english_verse: So the Lord will leave Samaria in ruins— merely an empty field where vineyards are planted. He will scatter its stones and destroy its foundations.
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔma Samaria kɔkakyi kurofoen wɔ eburo, ɔne aseɛ bɔ bɛyɛ so bobe boo ɔ. Ngodwiri ye nyɔboɛ mɔ ngogua bɔnza ne anu, ná mama ye fapem mɔ nwo alela berɛ.

english_verse: Samaria's idols will be smashed, and the wages of temple prostitutes will be destroyed by fire. Silver and gold from those idols will then be used by foreigners as payment for prostitutes. Judah Is Doomed
translation_verse: Bɛkɔnyoko ye amoen nemɔ amukoraa pasapasa, ná bafa see bayera ye adwuma akatuaa amukoraa. Ngɔsɛkyesɛkye ye mmosoen amukoraa bɔkɔɔ, ofikyɛ gyanderafoɛ akatuaa yeɛ ɔfa onyane bɛ ɔ, na bekosa bɛkɔfa bɛkɔyɛ gyanderafoɛ akatuaa.

english_verse: Because of this tragedy, I go barefoot and naked. My crying and weeping sound like howling wolves or ostriches.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ati, ngosu ngɔbɔ awuye; ngɔye me gya ngogua ase ngɔye me nwo ngɔto so; ngɔbɔ awuye kyɛ ɛserɛ so ngyea, ná mali aworabɔlɛ kyɛ patue.

english_verse: The nation is fatally wounded. Judah is doomed. Jerusalem will fall.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ye ngena nemɔ te kenangɔ; waadwu Yuda, waadwu me maen bɛ pambim ne anoa, waadwu Yerusalem.

english_verse: Don't tell it in Gath! Don't even cry. Instead, roll in the dust at Beth-Leaphrah.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔbɔ so wɔ Gate, nnɛma ɛmɔsu koraa; ɛ́mɔmunumunu bɛ nwo wɔ mvuture nu wɔ Bete Leafra.

english_verse: Depart naked and ashamed, you people of Shaphir. The town of Bethezel mourns because no one from Zaanan went out to help.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, Safirefoɛ, ɛ́mɔpɛ nu bɛhɔ bɔ ɛmɔ nwo so ná animguaseɛ ahã ɛmɔ ɔ; Saananfoɛ de, bamvite bamma; Bete Esel bɔ awuye, na ɔkɔye ye sa kofi ɛmɔ bo.

english_verse: Everyone in Maroth hoped for the best, but the Lord sent disaster down on Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Marotefoɛ bɛtole bɛ bo ase bɛnwondɛle mmerɛ paa; nakoso amaneɛnwunɛ yeɛ ofili AWURADE berɛ wale Yerusalem pambim ne anwo berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Get the war chariots ready, you people of Lachish. You led Jerusalem into sin, just as Israel did.
translation_verse: Lakisefoɛ, ɛ́mɔfa teaseɛnam bɛsosɔ kaka anwonyeralɛ ne: ye yeɛ ɔte bɔne bohyɛlɛ ma Sion awa brasua ne ɔ, ofikyɛ wɔ nu yeɛ benwuni Yisrael mmeraatolɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Now you will have to give a going-away gift to Moresheth. Israel's kings will discover that they cannot trust the town of Achzib.
translation_verse: Yiti odi kyɛ ɛfa akyɛdeɛ ma Moresete Gate, na Akisibofoɛ kɔyɛ nnakannaka mmenia kɔma Yisrael ahemvo.

english_verse: People of Mareshah, the Lord will send someone to capture your town. Then Israel's glorious king will be forced to hide in Adullam Cave.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ, Maresafoɛ, ngosa ngɔfa koliagyaa ngɔbrɛ ɛmɔ; na Yisrael animnyam ne kɔwa Adulam.

english_verse: Judah, shave your head as bald as a vulture and start mourning. Your precious children will be dragged off to a foreign country.
translation_verse: Tete wɔ ti ná bɔ tikwa, ɔnate wɔ mma bɔ bɛmaa enya anika ne ati; ma wɔ tikwa ne ɔyɛ kyɛ ɛpɛtɛ deɛ, ofikyɛ bɛkɔhye bɛ nnure bekofi wɔ nwo bɛkɔhɔ.

english_verse: Doomed! You're doomed! At night you lie in bed, making evil plans. And when morning comes, you do what you've planned because you have the power.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ besusu amumuyɛɛ nwo, ná bɛdwene bɔne nwo wɔ bɛ bɛen so ne, bɛ yaakɔ! Aleɛ kye a, bɛyɔ sɔ, ofikyɛ ye nwo tumi wura bɛ sa.

english_verse: You grab any field or house that you want; you cheat families out of homes and land.
translation_verse: Bɛ nye boro eboo mɔ, na bɛfa bɛ tumi bedide, yeɛ bɛ nye boro awuro mɔ, na bede bɛfa, yiti bɛhyɛ ebie ne ye awuro ama so, yeɛ ebie ne ye agyapadeɛ koso so.

english_verse: But here is what the Lord says: “I am planning trouble for you. Your necks will be caught in a noose, and you will be disgraced in this time of disaster.”
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE nwa nyoo: Tie, medwene kyɛ ngɔprapra musue ngogua abusua he aso, bɔ ɛmɔngɔhora bɛngɔye ye nyamaa bengofi ɛmɔ kɔme ɔ; yeɛ ɛmɔngɔhora bɛngɔnate bɛngɔmoma bɛ bati so, ofikyɛ sɔ mmerɛ ne te mmerɛ tɛɛ.

english_verse: When that happens, this sorrowful song will be sung about you: “Ruined! Completely ruined! The Lord has taken our land and given it to traitors.”
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, bekobu anyandera bɛkɔfa ɛmɔ nwo, ná basu babɔ awuye yeayea bahã kyɛ, “Edwirɛ piri ato yɛ oo! Wafa me maen agyapadeɛ ne bie oo! Nea kyɛbɔ wale wafi me sa nu ɔ! Wahyɛ yɛ boo mɔ wama bɛ bɔ bahye yɛ nnure ne.

english_verse: And so you will never again own property among the Lord's people.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛmɔngonya ebiala bɔ okogua serewa kɔfa nyamaa kɔhyɛ aseɛ ne wɔ AWURADE asafo nu ɔ.

english_verse: “Enough of your preaching!” That's what you tell me. “We won't be disgraced, so stop preaching!”
translation_verse: Bese bɛ bɔ bɛhyɛ ngɔm nemɔ kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔhyehyɛ ngɔm, nnɛma ebiala hyɛ ɛhemɔ nwo ngɔm kyire bɛ, amaa ɔnate so animguaseɛ anga yɛ.”

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, is it right for you to claim that the Lord did what he did because he was angry? Doesn't he always bless those who do right?
translation_verse: Ao Yakob boso ama, aso odi kyɛ bɛkã kyɛ, AWURADE Sunzum ne, aso olle aboterɛ anaa? Aso ye sa noa adwuma ɛhe? Aso me dwirɛ onziezie sona bɔ ye bra tengyɛ ɔ?

english_verse: My people, you have turned against one another! You have even stolen clothes right off the backs of innocent neighbors who pass by in peace.
translation_verse: Na ɛlɛsa ye, ɛmɔadwɔso batia me maen kyɛ pɔfoɛ, na bɛ bɔ bɛpɛ nu konn, bɔ bɛte mmenia bɔ benguro koɛ ne, ɛmɔpuro bɛ ndaadeɛ aguasoɛ.

english_verse: You take over lovely homes that belong to the women of my nation. Then you cheat their children out of the inheritance that comes from the Lord.
translation_verse: Me maen mmrasua nemɔ, ɛmɔatu bɛ bafi b’awuro nyemenenyemene nemɔ anu, na ɛmɔale m’animnyam bafi bɛ mma mɔ sa nu afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Get out of here, you crooks! You'll find no rest here. You're not fit to belong to the Lord's people, and you will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔdwɔso, ná ɛmɔhɔ, ofikyɛ nna ɛwa yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔde bɛ nwome ɔ; ofikyɛ ɛwa nwo agua fiɛ, na okohũ ɛmɔ ewue yealɛ paa.

english_verse: The only prophet you want is a liar who will say, “Drink and get drunk!” A Promise of Hope
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie nate ɔkekã edwirɛ mbaen mbaen ne ngondombo dwirɛ kyɛ, “Ngɔhyɛ nzaa ne nzaa serɛ nwo ngɔm ngohyire wɔ” a, ye yeɛ bekobu ye kyɛ ɔte maen ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to bring together the people of Israel who have survived. I will gather them, just as a shepherd brings sheep together, and there will be many.
translation_verse: Ao, Yakob, ngɔboa ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔ noa amba, amba, ngɔboa Yisrael ngaa ne bɛ noa; ngɔhã bɛ ngɔbɔ nu kyɛ Bosra mmoaen, kyɛ mmoaen kure bɔ begua bɛ tuin nu ɔ, na bɛkɔyɛ dede pee, ɔnate kyɛ bɛte mmenia bɔ bɛsone ne ati.

english_verse: but you prefer to do evil instead of what is right. You skin my people alive. You strip off their flesh,
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔkyi paa, ná ɛmɔkuro bɔne ɔ, ɛmɔwɔngye me maen bɛ nwo wereɛ, ɔne bɛ nwonaen fi bɛ mmowue nwo ɔ;

english_verse: Someday you will beg the Lord to help you, but he will turn away because of your sins.
translation_verse: Afei bekosu bɛkɔfrɛ AWURADE, nakoso ɔngɔtɛ bɛ so. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, ɔkɔye ye nye kɔfea bɛ, ofikyɛ bɛ yɔleɛ te bɔne.

english_verse: You lying prophets promise security for anyone who gives you food, but disaster for anyone who refuses to feed you. Here is what the Lord says to you prophets:
translation_verse: Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛma me maen di makyebu, bɔ ɛma bɛ aleɛ maa bedi a bɛkekã kyɛ, “Asomdwee oo, asomdwee oo”, nakoso sɛ ebie amma bɛ aleɛ maa banni a, bɛfa koɛ bɛtoa ye ne, bɔ AWURADE kã fa bɛ nwo ɛne.

english_verse: “You will live in the dark, far from the sight of the sun, with no message from me.
translation_verse: Yiti aleɛ kɔsã ɛmɔ, bɔ ɛmɔngonwu nyekyire biala ɔ, awosii kɔto ɛmɔ, bɔ ɛmɔngɔhyɛ ngɔm biala ɔ. Eyia bɔ ɔta ma ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ ne ɔkɔɔtɔ, na alehyeleɛ kɔkakyi bɛ so awosii tunn.

english_verse: You prophets and fortunetellers will all be disgraced, with no message from me.”
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛse ase ne, bɛ nyunu kogua ase, na ngonyaayelɛfoɛ kɔfɛre; amba, bɛ mukoraa bekomua bɛ noa, ofikyɛ mmuayɛɛ biala mvi Nyameɛ berɛ ɔmma.

english_verse: But the Lord has filled me with power and his Spirit. I have been given the courage to speak about justice and to tell you people of Israel that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Nakoso me de, AWURADE Sunzum ama me tumi, wama ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ne anwoserɛ ayi me tɛkyɛ, kyɛ mva Yakob ye mmeraatolɛ ndo ye nyunu, ná mva Yisrael koso ye bɔne ndo ye nyunu.

english_verse: So listen to my message, you rulers of Israel! You hate justice and twist the truth.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, ɛ́mɔtie, Yakob awuro atitire, yeɛ Yisrael awuro ama mbanyi bɔ ɛmɔkyi ndɛenbualɛ turoloo, ná ɛmɔkyea pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ amukoraa ɔ,

english_verse: You make cruelty and murder a way of life in Jerusalem.
