translation_verse: ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔnate mogya hã gualɛ so bɛkyekye Sion, ná ɛmɔfa amumuyɛɛ so bɛkyekye Yerusalem ɔ.

english_verse: You leaders accept bribes for dishonest decisions. You priests and prophets teach and preach, but only for money. Then you say, “The Lord is on our side. No harm will come to us.”
translation_verse: Bɛ nu mbanyi mɔ bede fea-ase-ma bebua ndɛengyea, nu asɔfo mɔ koso bɛyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ bede paa, yeɛ nu ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ, bɛhyɛ ngɔm bede sikaa’. Nakoso bɛfa bɛ nwo bɛto AWURADE so bɛkã kyɛ, “Aso AWURADE oggyi yɛ si? Musue biala ngɔto yɛ.”

english_verse: And so, because of you, Jerusalem will be plowed under and left in ruins. Thorns will cover the mountain where the temple now stands.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔnate ɛmɔ ti, bekofundam Sion kyɛ eboo; Yerusalem kɔkakyi esire sire, na bokaa bɔ awuro ne gyi so ne, ɔkɔkakyi ɛhɔayeɛ nu asɔneyɛɛ.

english_verse: In the future, the mountain with the Lord's temple will be the highest of all. It will reach above the hills, and every nation will rush to it.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔkɔwa kyɛ, ngyẽa bɔ oli nziɛ ne anu, bokaa bɔ AWURADE awuro ne gyi so ne, okotimu kɔyɛ tendenn paa wɔ mmokaa nemɔ anu, na ɔkɔhɔ anwuro kɔtra pambaa nemɔ. Mmenia kotu bi bɛkɔhɔ so,

english_verse: People of many nations will come and say, “Let's go up to the mountain of the Lord God of Jacob and worship in his temple.” The Lord will teach us his Law from Jerusalem, and we will obey him.
translation_verse: na maen maen pee kɔwa bɛkɔɔhã kyɛ, “Ɛmɔbra maa yɛfo yɛhɔ AWURADE bokaa ne aso, yɛhɔ Yakob Nyameɛ n’awuro berɛ, amaa ɔnate so wahyirehyire yɛ ye atee, ná yanate ye atimbire so.” Ofikyɛ Sion yeɛ mmeraa ne kofi kɔwa ɔ, na AWURADE dwirɛ ne kofi Yerusalem yeɛ ɔkɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: He will settle arguments between distant and powerful nations. They will pound their swords and their spears into rakes and shovels; they will never again make war or attack one another.
translation_verse: Okoli maen maen pee b’afia dwirɛ, na okohwi maen maen anwoserɛfoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ dedeede ɔ bɛ nyunu. Bɛkɔboro bɛ ngrandɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔbɔ kona, ná baboro bɛ pealɛɛ bafa babɔ asɔsɔaa. Maen bie ngɔhwe obiɛngo maen so ngrandɛ, yeɛ bengosua koɛhonɛ ko.

english_verse: Everyone will find rest beneath their own fig trees or grape vines, and they will live in peace. This is a solemn promise of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ebiala kɔtena ye bobe ne ye borɔdoma bakaa bo, na ebiala ngonwunanwuna bɛ, ofikyɛ Asafo AWURADE bɔbɔ yeɛ wate ye noa wahã ɔ.

english_verse: Others may follow their gods, but we will always follow the Lord our God. The Lord Will Lead His People Home
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ amaen maen amukoraa, bɛ nu biala nate wɔ ye nyameɛ dumaa nu, nakoso yɛ de, yɛkɔnate AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ dumaa nu afebɔɔ.

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will gather my people— the lame and the outcasts, and all others into whose lives I have brought sorrow.
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔboaboa mmubuafoɛ mɔ noa, na ngɔboaboa bɛ bɔ bapɛ bɛ asue mɔ noa, ɔne bɛ bɔ mafa bɛ mafa yealɛ nu ɔ bɛ noa, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Then the lame and the outcasts will belong to my people and become a strong nation. I, the Lord, will rule them from Mount Zion forever.
translation_verse: Na ngɔma mmubuafoɛ nemɔ kɔyɛ mmenia bɔ baha ɔ, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bapɛ bɛ asue ne, ngɔmaa bɛkɔyɛ anwoserɛ maen; na AWURADE koli bɛ so hene wɔ Sion bokaa so kekesaala ye ne afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem, why are you crying? Don't you have a king? Have your advisors gone? Are you suffering like a woman in childbirth?
translation_verse: Na afei, nzu ati yeɛ esu serɛserɛ ye? Aso ɛhene biala nne wɔ nu anaa? Aso wɔ foɛtulɛniɛ wawu anaa, bɔ enwu yealɛ kyɛ brasua bɔ aworɛ ahã ye e?

english_verse: Keep on groaning with pain, you people of Jerusalem! If you escape from your city to the countryside, you will still be taken as prisoners to Babylonia. But later I will rescue you from your enemies.
translation_verse: Ao Sion awa brasua, pene ná twe wɔ nwo kyɛ brasua bɔ wafo aworɛ so ɔ, ofikyɛ afei de, ekofi kuro ne anu kɔhɔ kɔɔtena eburo; na ɛkɔhɔ Babilɔn, berɛ yeɛ AWURADE kɔpepɛ kole wɔ ɔ; berɛ yeɛ AWURADE kɔpɔ wɔ kofi wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu ɔ.

english_verse: Zion, because of your sins you are surrounded by many nations who say, “We can hardly wait to see you disgraced.”
translation_verse: Na afei koso, maen maen pee baboa bɛ noa badwɔso batia wɔ. Bɛnwa, “Yɛpena kyɛ ye nwo gua fiɛ, ná yɛbɔ yɛ nye afɔleɛ wɔ Sion amaneɛnwunɛ ne anwo.”

english_verse: But they don't know that I, the Lord, have gathered them here to grind them like grain.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ de, bɛnze AWURADE adwene, yeɛ bɛnde ye nhyehyɛleɛ bo, ofikyɛ ɔkɔboaboa bɛ noa kyɛ ɛmo bɔ bakyekye ye tire tire bagua nekaa bɔ bɛboro ɛmo ɔ.

english_verse: Smash them to pieces, Zion! I'll let you be like a bull with iron horns and bronze hoofs. Crush those nations and bring their wealth to me, the Lord of the earth.
translation_verse: Ao Sion awa brasua, dwɔso ná boro, ofikyɛ wɔ mmɛen ne, ngɔyɛ ye buralɛ, yeɛ ngɔyɛ wɔ gya mmaboa ne koso kɔɔbere, na ɛkɔfa kɔsɛkye maen pee pasapasa. Ngotu b’anwonyadeɛ ngosie berɛ ngɔma AWURADE, yeɛ ngotu b’agyapadeɛ ngosie berɛ ngɔma aseɛ amukoraa Mene ne.

english_verse: Jerusalem, enemy troops have surrounded you; they have struck Israel's ruler in the face with a stick.
translation_verse: Ao koɛhonɛfoɛ awa brasua, afei boa wɔ noa koɛhonɛfoɛ kure kure; watua yɛ kuro ne; Yisrael maenbulɛniɛ ne, bɛkɔfa bakaa bɛkɔbɔ ye mvoka. Defoɛ ne kɔpepɛ kole Yerusalem

english_verse: Bethlehem Ephrath, you are one of the smallest towns in the nation of Judah. But the Lord will choose one of your people to rule the nation— someone whose family goes back to ancient times.
translation_verse: Nakoso wɔ, ao Betlehem Efrata, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛte kãa wɔ Yuda nguro nemɔ anu de, nakoso bɔ ɔkɔyɛ Yisrael maenbulɛniɛ ne, bɔ ye ahyɛaseɛ fi tete, bɔ ofi mmerɛ bɔ olle ahyɛaseɛ ne, wɔ yeɛ okofi wɔ nu kɔwa kɔma me ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will abandon Israel only until this ruler is born, and the rest of his family returns to Israel.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔkɔyakyi bɛ nu kɔɔpem mmerɛ bɔ braa bɔ wafo aworɛ so ne kɔwo ɔ. Na afei oliɛma ngaa nemɔ, bekosa bɛkɔɔboka Yisrael mma nemɔ aso.

english_verse: Like a shepherd taking care of his sheep, this ruler will lead and care for his people by the power and glorious name of the Lord his God. His people will live securely, and the whole earth will know his true greatness,
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔfa AWURADE anwoserɛ kogyina berɛ kɔma ye mmoaen kure aleɛ, wɔ AWURADE ye Nyameɛ animnyam ahennie dumaa nu. Bɛ bo kotimu, ofikyɛ afei ɔkɔyɛ titire koodwu aseɛ so nekaa biala.

english_verse: because he will bring peace. Assyria Will Be Defeated Let Assyria attack our country and our palaces. We will counterattack, led by a number of rulers
translation_verse: Na ye yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ asomdwee ne ɔ. Sɛ Asiria ɔba y’aseɛ ne aso, ná otiatia y’ahemvie nemɔ aso a, yɛkɔye neafoɛ nzoo ne atitirefoɛ mmɔtwɛ maa bekodwɔso bekotia ye.

english_verse: whose strong army will defeat the nation of Assyria. Yes, our leaders will rescue us, if those Assyrians dare to invade our land. The Survivors Will Be Safe
translation_verse: Na bɛkɔfa ngrandɛ bekoli Asiria aseɛ ne aso ngonim, yeɛ Nimrode aseɛ ne aso pambim mɔ anu; sɛ Asiria ɔba y’aseɛ ne aso, ná otiatia y’aseɛ nemɔ aso a, okole yɛ kofi ye sa nu.

english_verse: A few of Jacob's descendants survived and are scattered among the nations. But the Lord will let them cover the earth like dew and rain that refreshes the soil.
translation_verse: Na Yakob boso ama ngaa ne, bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ bosue bɔ ofi AWURADE berɛ ɔ wɔ maen maen pee bɛ nu, kyɛ nyenyenzue bɔ ogua ndire so ɔ, bɔ ɔmva ye nwo ndo sona so, anaa ɔnnwondɛ adasa mmaa ɔ.

english_verse: At present they are scattered, but later they will attack, as though they were fierce lions pouncing on sheep. Their enemies will be torn to shreds, with no one to save them;
translation_verse: Na Yakob boso ama ngaa ne, bɛkɔtena amaenmaensofoɛ nu wɔ maen maen pee bɛ nu, kyɛ gyata bɔ ɔwɔ ɛhɔayeɛ nu ngaka mɔ nu ɔ, kyɛ gyata ba bɔ ɔwɔ mmoaen kure mɔ nu ɔ, bɔ sɛ ɔbaasẽ kɔ a, otiatia bɛ so, ná ɔtete bɛ nu pasapasa bɔ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔkɔpepɛ kole bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: they will be helpless, completely destroyed. Idols Will Be Destroyed in Israel
translation_verse: Ɛkɔma wɔ sa so kotia bɛ bɔ bekyi wɔ ɔ, na wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ amukoraa bɛ boso konua.

english_verse: The Lord said: At that time I will wipe out your cavalry and chariots,
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ sɔ kyẽa ne, ngonua wɔ mbɔngɔ mɔ boso ngofi wɔ nu, na ngɔsɛkye wɔ teaseɛnam mɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: as well as your cities and your fortresses.
translation_verse: Ngɔbɔ w’aseɛ ne aso nguro mɔ, na ngodwiri w’anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne amukoraa ngogua.

english_verse: I will stop you from telling fortunes and practicing witchcraft.
translation_verse: Ngonyaayelɛ bɔ ɛye ne, ngotu ye bo, na engonya ahɔmeɛ ko.

english_verse: You will no longer worship the idols or stone images you have made— I will destroy them,
translation_verse: Ngɔsɛkye w’amoen mɔ pasaa, yeɛ ngɔsɛkye w’amoen bɔ agyinagyina nemɔ koso ngofi wɔ nu, na ɛngɔsɔne wɔ sa noa adwuma ko.

english_verse: together with the sacred poles and even your towns.
translation_verse: Ngotutu w’Asera dosii nemɔ abo ngofi wɔ nu, na ngɔbɔ wɔ nguro nemɔ pasaa.

english_verse: I will become furious and take revenge on the nations that refuse to obey me.
translation_verse: Na maen maen mɔ bɔ banyɛ sotie bamma me ne, nne ɛyaa ne ahonehulɛ ngɔtɔ bɛ so wereɛ.

english_verse: The Lord said to his people: Come and present your case to the hills and mountains.
translation_verse: Afei, ɛ́mɔtie edwirɛ bɔ AWURADE ɔkã ɔ. Dwɔso ná bɔ wɔ kuro wɔ mmokaa nemɔ nyunu, ná ma pambaa mɔ betie bɔ ɛkã ɔ.

english_verse: Israel, I am bringing charges against you— I call upon the mountains and the earth's firm foundation to be my witnesses.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, mmokaa mɔ, yeɛ aseɛ nyinasoɛ pindinn mɔ, ɛ́mɔtie AWURADE kwaadu bɔ ɔbɔ ne, ofikyɛ AWURADE ne ye maen banya edwudwolɛ, na ɔne Yisrael kɔbɔ nguro.

english_verse: My people, have I wronged you in any way at all? Please tell me.
translation_verse: “Ao me maen, mayɔ wɔ nzu? Nzikyɛ anwo yeɛ mayɛ wɔ so tɔsom ɔ? Bɔ me kwaadu e!

english_verse: I rescued you from Egypt, where you were slaves. I sent Moses, Aaron, and Miriam to be your leaders.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nyele wɔ mvili Misraim aseɛ so mmale, mbɔle wɔ mvili ngoaasolɛ nu, na nzomane Mose, Aarɔn ne Miriam maa belili wɔ nyunu.

english_verse: Don't forget the evil plans of King Balak of Moab or what Balaam son of Beor said to him. Remember how I, the Lord, saved you many times on your way from Acacia to Gilgal. True Obedience
translation_verse: Ao me maen, kaye porɛ bɔ Moabo hene Balake bɔle ɔ, ɔne mmuayɛɛ bɔ Beɔ awa Balaam ɔfa mane ye, ofi Sitim bɔ ɔkwaadwu Gilgal ɔ, amaa ɔnate so anwu AWURADE tenenee ne.” Bɔ AWURADE pena ɔ

english_verse: What offering should I bring when I bow down to worship the Lord God Most High? Should I try to please him by sacrificing calves a year old?
translation_verse: “Nzikyɛ yeɛ mva mmra AWURADE nyunu, ná mmamɔ me nu ase wɔ Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne nyunu ɔ? Mva naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ mɔ yeɛ mmra ye nyunu ɔ, bɔ ɔte nandwie akrɔngrɔma mɔ bɔ bali afoɛ ko anaa?

english_verse: Will thousands of sheep or rivers of olive oil make God satisfied with me? Should I sacrifice to the Lord my first-born child as payment for my terrible sins?
translation_verse: Aso AWURADE nye kɔgye mmoaen nyii apee apee nwo, anaakyɛ ngoo asue apee buru apee buru nwo? Aso mva me bamuɛbaa ndua me mmeraatolɛ nwo kerɛ, anaakyɛ mva me bɔbɔ me kunu ba ndua me kra bɔne nwo kerɛ anaa?

english_verse: The Lord God has told us what is right and what he demands: “See that justice is done, let mercy be your first concern, and humbly obey your God.” Cheating and Violence
translation_verse: Ao kuro sona, wala bɔ ɔte paa ɔ ali wahyire wɔ, nzikyɛ yeɛ AWURADE pena fi wɔ berɛ ɔ? Bɔ ɔpena ala ole kyɛ ɛkɔyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ, ekonwu anwumvoin, ɔne kyɛ ɛne wɔ Nyameɛ bɛkɔnate anwobrɛaseɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: I am the Lord, and you are wise to respect my power to punish. So listen to my message for the city of Jerusalem:
translation_verse: AWURADE komvi tea nu frɛ kuro ne, na bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ dumaa ne yeɛ bɛte nworɛfoɛ ɔ. Ɛ́mɔtie asohwenɛ ne, ɔne ye bɔ wahyehyɛ wato berɛ ne.

english_verse: You store up stolen treasures and use dishonest scales.
translation_verse: Nzɛmmɔne nu anwonyadeɛ, yeɛ tonyi bɔ bawura nu bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ ɔ, bɛtɛ wɔ bɔnefoɛ awuro anaa?

english_verse: But I, the Lord, will punish you for cheating with weights and with measures.
translation_verse: Aso sona bɔ otira bɔne asusudeɛ, ɔne nnakannaka tonyi ne, aso odi kyɛ mebua ye be anaa?

english_verse: Because of your sins, I will wound you and leave you ruined and defenseless.
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔbɔ wɔ maa ɛkɔbɔ anwonyerɛ, wɔ bɔne ti ngɔmaa ɛkɔyɛ pasapasa.

english_verse: You will eat, but still be hungry; you will store up goods, but lose everything— I, the Lord, will let it all be captured in war.
translation_verse: Ekodidi, nakoso wɔ ko ngoyi; ɛhɔen kandinga kɔwa wɔ wɔ nu, ɛkɔfa nningyein kosie, nakoso ɛngɔhora ngɔbɔ ye nwo waen; nakoso bɔ ɛkɔbɔ ye nwo waen ne, ngɔmaa okofi wɔ sa wɔ koɛ nu.

english_verse: You won't harvest what you plant or use the oil from your olive trees or drink the wine from grapes you grow.
translation_verse: Ekolua, nakoso engonya so aleɛ; ekohwi olive mma, nakoso engonya ye ngoo ne bie ngɔfa ngɔpopa; ekohwi bobe mma, nakoso engonya ye nzaa ne bie ngɔno.

english_verse: Jerusalem, this will happen because you followed the sinful example of kings Omri and Ahab. Now I will destroy you and your property. Then the people of every nation will make fun and insult you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ edi Omri ahyɛdeɛ so, ɔne Ahabo boso ama yɔleɛ amukoraa so, yeɛ ɛmɔdi bɛ foɛtulɛ so. Ɔnate so ngɔmaa ɛkɔyɛ pasapasa, na ngɔma wɔ nu ama bɛkɔkakyi ngorohoɛ nikye. Yiti ɛmɔkɔsoa me maen animguaseɛ.

english_verse: I feel so empty inside— like someone starving for grapes or figs, after the vines and trees have all been picked clean.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ ato me oo! Ofikyɛ mayɛ kyɛ ebie bɔ bate borɔdoma bayie, bɔ bate bobe si ne bayie, bɔ bennya ye mma biribiraa ne bie benni ɔ. Borɔdoma mma bɔ wali moa wasu, bɔ me komvi wɔ so ne, ebie nne berɛ.

english_verse: No one is loyal to God; no one does right. Everyone is brutal and eager to deceive everyone else.
translation_verse: Mmeni paa boso amini afi aseɛ ye aso, na teneneeniɛ biala nne mmenia nu; bɛ mukoraa bɛtetɛ bɛpena mogya bɛkã begua, na ebiala sua oliɛma ngaen ɔpena ye ɔkye ye.

english_verse: The most honest of them is worse than a thorn patch. Your doom has come! Lookouts sound the warning, and everyone panics.
translation_verse: Bɛ nu sona paa ne po ɔte kyɛ ɛfone, bɛ nu teneneeniɛ paa ne, ɔte mmowue anoa tworɔntworɔn; w’awɛmvoɛ mɔ kyẽa ne, ɔne w’asohwenɛ kyẽa ne ɔ́ba, bɛ basabasayɔlɛ mmerɛ ne wadwu.

english_verse: Don't trust anyone, not even your best friend, and be careful what you say to the one you love.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔde abiɛngoɛ bedi, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ wora bewura adamvoa nu. Ɛye bɔ ɔla wɔ kunu ne, ye po nea yé wɔ ngɔmɔ bɔ ɛne ye bedi ɔ nwo.

english_verse: Sons refuse to respect their own fathers, daughters rebel against their own mothers, and daughters-in-law despise their mothers-in-law. Your family is now your enemy.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ baa bienzua bu seɛ animtia, yeɛ baa brasua dwɔso tia oni; sia brasua dwɔso tia ye sia brasua, sona ye pɔfoɛ mɔ ole ye bɔbɔ deinn ye awuro ama.

english_verse: But I trust the Lord God to save me, and I will wait for him to answer my prayer. The Nation Turns to God
translation_verse: Yiti me de, AWURADE yeɛ me nye la ye so ɔ; ngɔfa me wora ngowura me ngoalelɛ Nyameɛ nu; me Nyameɛ kotie me.

english_verse: My enemies, don't be glad because of my troubles! I may have fallen, but I will get up; I may be sitting in the dark, but the Lord is my light.
translation_verse: Wɔ, me pɔfoɛ, nnɛdi me nwo ahurusi; sɛ mefi ase a, ngodwɔso, sɛ nde awosii nu a, AWURADE yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ me kanea ɔ.

english_verse: I have sinned against the Lord. And so I must endure his anger, until he comes to my defense. But I know that I will see him making things right for me and leading me to the light.
translation_verse: AWURADE ahonehulɛ ne, mede meto nu, ofikyɛ mayɔ bɔne matia ye, kɔpem kyɛ okoli me dwirɛ kɔma me, ná okobua ndɛen turoloo kɔma me ɔ. Ɔkɔye me kofite kɔwa hyireinn nu, na ngonwu ye tenenee ne.

english_verse: You, my enemies, said, “The Lord God is helpless.” Now each of you will be disgraced and put to shame. I will see you trampled like mud in the street. A Bright Future
translation_verse: Afei, me pɔfoɛ ne konwu ye, na animguaseɛ kɔhã ye, ye bɔ obisa me kyɛ, “AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔwɔ ni?” ne. Ngɔfa me nye ngɔnea ye, na afei bekotiatia ye so kyɛ dwaaso asaa.

english_verse: Towns of Judah, the day is coming when your walls will be rebuilt, and your boundaries enlarged.
translation_verse: Kyẽa bɔ odi kyɛ besi wɔ fasue nemɔ nen, sɔ kyẽa ne yeɛ bɛkɔtrɛ ɛwɛen ne anu bɛkɔhɔ dedeede ɔ.

english_verse: Those nations will suffer disaster because of what they did. Micah's Prayer and the Lord's Answer
translation_verse: Nakoso aseɛ ne kɔkakyi kurofoen, ɔnate so ama nemɔ ati, ɔnate bɛ yɔleɛ ti.

english_verse: Lead your people, Lord! Come and be our shepherd. Grasslands surround us, but we live in a forest. So lead us to Bashan and Gilead, and let us find pasture as we did long ago.
translation_verse: Wɔ pɔmaa ne, fa nea wɔ maen so, mmoaen kure bɔ bɛte w’agyapadeɛ, bɔ bɛ ngome bɛte ɛhɔayeɛ ne anu, wɔ Kamɛl so ne; maa bedidi wɔ Basan ne Gileade, kyɛ daa tete ne ala.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will work miracles just as I did when I led you out of Egypt.
translation_verse: Ngɔye anwanwadeɛ ali ngohyire ye, kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ efili Misraim aseɛ so ɛwale ne ala.

english_verse: Nations will see this and be ashamed because of their helpless armies. They will be in shock, unable to speak or hear,
translation_verse: Maen maen mɔ konwu ye, na bɛ nyunu kogua ase, b’anwoserɛ amukoraa si ne. Bɛkɔfa bɛ sa bɛkɔto bɛ noa, na bɛ so koti.

english_verse: because of their fear of me, your Lord and God. Then they will come trembling, crawling out of their fortresses like insects or snakes, lapping up the dust. No One Is Like God The people said:
translation_verse: Bɛkɔtafe nnɛterɛ kyɛ ewoo, kyɛ ngaka bɔ bɛtwe bɛ nwo ase ɔ. Bele anwopopolɛ bekofi b’anwoserɛ afealeɛ mɔ nu bekofite; bɛkɔfa esuronyi bɛkɔwa AWURADE yɛ Nyameɛ berɛ, na ɔnate wɔ ti bekosuro.

english_verse: Our God, no one is like you. We are all that is left of your chosen people, and you freely forgive our sin and guilt. You don't stay angry forever; you're glad to have pity
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ kyɛ wɔ, bɔ ɔfa amumuyɛɛ kyɛ, bɔ obu ye nye gua ye agyapadeɛ ngaa bɛ mmeraatolɛ so ɔ? Ɔmma ye yaafɛlɛ ndena berɛ afebɔɔ, ofikyɛ ye nye gye anwumvoinnwunɛ nwo.

english_verse: and pleased to be merciful. You will trample on our sins and throw them in the sea.
translation_verse: Okosa konwu yɛ anwumvoin, okoli y’amumuyɛɛ so ngonim; na ekofindi bɛ bɔne amukoraa kogua ɛpo buma ne anu.

english_verse: You will keep your word and be faithful to Jacob and to Abraham, as you promised our ancestors many years ago.
translation_verse: Ɛkɔye nahorɛlilɛ ali kohyire Yakob, ɔne anwumvoinnwunɛ ali kohyire Abraham, kyɛbɔ ata ye nwo ndaen ahyire yɛ nana mɔ fi daa tete ne.

english_verse: I am Nahum from Elkosh. And this is the message that I wrote down about Nineveh. The Fierce Anger of the Lord
translation_verse: Nyekyire bɔ ɔfa Ninewe nwo ɛhe. Elkoseniɛ Nahum ye nyekyire nwomaa ne ɛhe. Nyameɛ fɛ Ninewe so yaa

english_verse: The Lord is powerful, yet patient; he makes sure that the guilty are always punished. He can be seen in storms and in whirlwinds; clouds are the dust from his feet.
translation_verse: AWURADE ahone onhu ndɛ, ye tumi te piri; na ongobua bɔ odi fɔ ɔ be le. AWURADE atee la mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo, ɔne mvrama bɔ otu serɛserɛ ɔ nu, na munungum te ye gya bo mvuture.

english_verse: At the Lord's command, oceans and rivers dry up. Bashan, Mount Carmel, and Lebanon wither, and their flowers fade.
translation_verse: Ɔkã ɛpo nyunu, na ɔmaa ɔwewe, ɔwewe asue amukoraa; Basan ne Kamɛl kese, na Lebanon nyerɛen twindwam.

english_verse: At the sight of the Lord, mountains and hills tremble and melt; the earth and its people shudder and shake.
translation_verse: Mmokaa nemɔ woso wɔ ye nyunu, na pambaa nemɔ behuro, aseɛ yera wɔ ye nyunu, amba, wiase ne bɔ ɔwɔ nu amukoraa.

english_verse: Who can stand the heat of his furious anger? It flashes out like fire and shatters stones. The Power of Assyria Will Be Broken
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina ye ahonehulɛ ne nyunu ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina ye yaa noa hyerɛhyerɛ ne noa ɔ? Ye yaafɛlɛ ne hwie gua kyɛ see, na ɔma nyɔbotaen mɔ nu dwudwa.

english_verse: The Lord is good. He protects those who trust him in times of trouble.
translation_verse: AWURADE te paa, ɔte amaneɛnwunɛ mmerɛ nu anwoserɛ afealeɛ, na ɔse bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛ wora bewura ye nu ɔ.

english_verse: But like a roaring flood, the Lord chases his enemies into dark places and destroys them.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ bɔ bekyi ye de, ɔkɔfa nzue bɔ oyi bu fa so ɔ konua bɛ boso, na ɔkɔfoa ye pɔfoɛ mɔ kɔhɔ awosii nu.

english_verse: So don't plot against the Lord! He wipes out his enemies, and they never revive.
translation_verse: Nzikyɛ porɛ yeɛ ɛmɔbɔ bɛfa AWURADE nwo ye? Okonua ɛmɔ boso bɔkɔɔ, ye de, onua nikye boso bɔkɔɔ bɔ onnua ye ye pɛen nyɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: They are like drunkards overcome by wine, or like twisted thornbushes burning in a fire.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ batoatoa nu kyɛ mmowue, ná babobo kyɛ akɔnomnzafoɛ nen, ɔkɔyera bɛ kyɛ ɛserɛ worowaa.

english_verse: Assyria, one of your rulers has made evil plans against the Lord.
translation_verse: Ebie bɔ ɔdwene AWURADE nwo tɛɛ, bɔ ɔte foɛtulɛniɛ bɔnefoɛ ɔ, wɔ nu yeɛ wafi wawa ɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord says, “Assyria, no matter how strong you are, you will be cut down! My people Judah, I have troubled you before, but I won't do it again.
translation_verse: “Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛ nwo yɛ se, yeɛ bɛsone de, nakoso bekohũhũ bɛ bekogua ma bɛ boso konua. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ mamaa afa yealɛ nu de, nakoso mengɔma ɛngɔfa yealɛ nu ko, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I'll snap your chains and set you free from the Assyrians.”
translation_verse: Afei, ngobubu ye kɔnnua ne anu ngofi wɔ so, na ngɔtete wɔ nyamaa bɔ ɔkyekye wɔ nemɔ anu.”

english_verse: Assyria, this is what else the Lord says to you: “Your name will be forgotten. I will destroy every idol in your temple, and I will send you to the grave, because you are worthless.”
translation_verse: AWURADE ahyɛ wɔ nwo mmeraa kyɛ, “Wɔ dumaa komini kofi aseɛ ye aso: Na mmosoen bɔ base ne mmosoen bɔ bahuro nikyee bafa bayɔ ne, ngɔpra bɛ bo ngofi wɔ nyameɛ mɔ b’awuro. Ngofu w’asieleɛ, ofikyɛ wɔ nwo ayɛ fitii.”

english_verse: Look toward the mountains, people of Judah! Here comes a messenger with good news of peace. Celebrate your festivals. Keep your promises to God. Your evil enemies are destroyed and will never again invade your country.
translation_verse: Nea mmokaa nemɔ aso dɔ kyɛ ɔba ɔ, bɔ ɔso ndɛenvɛen, bɔ ɔbɔ asomdwee nwo dawure ne! Ao Yuda, di w’aluolue krongron nemɔ, tua w’aboadeɛ nemɔ, ofikyɛ bɔnefoɛ ne ngɔfa koɛ ngɔtoa wɔ ko, bama ye boso amini bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Nineveh, someone is coming to attack and scatter you. Guard your fortresses! Watch the road! Be brave! Prepare for battle!
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔsɛkye nikyee pasapasa ne, ɔ́ba wɔ so. Wɛne ɛwaen nemɔ, fa wɔ nye sra atee ne, bɔ w’abɔsoɛ, ná mia w’anwoserɛ nu paa.

english_verse: Their horses prance, and their armored chariots dart around like lightning or flaming torches.
translation_verse: Teaseɛnam nemɔ betu amirika kikikiki wɔ dwaa nemɔ aso, bedi akɔneaba wɔ mandamu nemɔ anu, bɛ nwo te kyɛ ɛtɛen, betu amirika kyɛ agralaa.

english_verse: An officer gives a command. But his soldiers stumble, as they hasten to build a shelter to protect themselves against rocks thrown down from the city wall.
translation_verse: Ɔto ye sa frɛ ye atitire mɔ, bɛkɔ a, bɛnate fofalifofali; bɛma bɛ nwo yɛ nyera bɛkɔ fasue ne anwo, na bɛhyehyɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ bɛ nwo waen ne.

english_verse: The river gates fly open, and panic floods the palace.
translation_verse: Babukyebukye asue nemɔ bɛ pambim nemɔ, na ahemvie ne kodwiri kogua.

english_verse: Nineveh is disgraced. The queen is dragged off. Her servant women mourn; they moan like doves, and they beat their breasts in sorrow.
translation_verse: Babɔ ye hemmaa kwaterekwa, bahye ye nnure bahɔ; ye ndaluwa mɔ bɛbɔ awuye, bɛpene kyɛ abubure, na bɛfa bɛ sa befi b’ahone.

english_verse: Nineveh is like a pond with leaking water. Shouts of “Stop! Don't go!” can be heard everywhere. But everyone is leaving.
translation_verse: Ninewe te kyɛ ɛkwaa fi tetetete, nakoso bɛkɔnwati bɛkɔhɔ. Bɛkɔtea nu kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔgyina berɛ oo! Ɛ́mɔgyina berɛ oo!” Nakoso ebiala ngɔpɛne ye nye ngɔnea ye si.

english_verse: Enemy soldiers shout, “The city is full of treasure and all kinds of wealth. Steal her silver! Grab her gold!”
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔfẽ ɛdwetɛ ne, ɛ́mɔfẽ sikaa kɔkorɛ ne. Anwonyadeɛ ne, ye bo ngotu, yeɛ nningyein nyɔboɛ serɛ biala wɔ nu!”

english_verse: What happened to this city? They were safer there than powerful lions in a den, with no one to disturb them.
translation_verse: Gyata mɔ b’atenaleɛ ne, ɔwɔ nisua? Nisua yeɛ gyata akrɔngrɔma nemɔ bedidi ɔ, nekaa bɔ gyata nyii ne gyata beleɛ bɛnate, nekaa bɔ ye mma mɔ bɛwɔ bɔ ebiala ɔnha b’adwene ɔ?

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful is against you, Nineveh. God will burn your chariots and send an army to kill those young lions of yours. You will never again make victims of others or send messengers to threaten everyone on this earth.
translation_verse: Tie, meko metia wɔ, na ngɔyera ye teaseɛnam nemɔ wɔ nwosina ne anu. Ngrandɛ kohũhũ wɔ gyata mmaa nemɔ, ngɔma wɔ noa aleɛ komini kofi aseɛ ye aso, na bɛngɔte wɔ bɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ komvi ko, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Doom to the crime capital! Nineveh, city of murder and treachery,
translation_verse: Awuelilɛ kuro, wɔ yaakɔ oo! Ngondombo ne awerɔm awue yeɛ wayi ye to ɔ, apaabɔlɛ bo ɔngɔpɛ wɔ ye nu.

english_verse: here is your fate— cracking whips, churning wheels; galloping horses, roaring chariots;
translation_verse: Mbirefinɛ pralalala, yeɛ teaseɛnam gya kirikirikiri, mbɔngɔ bɔ behuru bɛpepe, teaseɛnam mɔ bɔ behuruhuru.

english_verse: You were nothing more than a prostitute using your magical charms and witchcraft to attract and trap nations.
translation_verse: Na gyanderaniɛ ne, ɔnate ye gyanderabɔlɛ somaa ne ati, sɔ ngonyaayelɛfoɛ hemmaa anwonyemene ne, bɔ ɔfa ye adwamanbɔlɛ ɔtɔne maen maen mɔ, ná ɔfa ngonyaayelɛ ɔtɔne mmusua ɔ.

english_verse: But I, the Lord All-Powerful, am now your enemy. I will pull up your skirt and let nations and kingdoms stare at your nakedness.
translation_verse: Tie, meko metia wɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Ngopuro w’ataadeɛ ngɔfa wɔ nyunu, ngɔma maen maen mɔ bekonwu w’adagya, na ahennie mɔ bekonwu w’animguaseɛ.

english_verse: I will cover you with garbage, treat you like trash, and rub you in the dirt.
translation_verse: Ngogyi akyiwadeɛ fitii ngogua wɔ so, ngobu wɔ animtia, ngɔmaa ɛkɔkakyi nikyee bɔ mmenia tu bɛ nye begua ye so ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who sees you will turn away and shout, “Nineveh is done for! Is anyone willing to mourn or to give her comfort?” Nineveh's Fate Is Sealed
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, ebiala bɔ ye nye kɔbɔ wɔ so ne, ɔkɔnwati kofi wɔ nwo, na ɔkɔhã kyɛ, Ninewe akakyi kurofoen! Nwa yeɛ okoli ye nwo aworabɔlɛ ɔ? Nisua yeɛ ngonya aworakyekyerɛfoɛ ngɔma ye ɔ?

english_verse: Nineveh, do you feel safer than the city of Thebes? The Nile River was its wall of defense.
translation_verse: Aso ɛte paa tra No Amon bɔ ɔla asue piri ne noa, bɔ asue mɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia, bɔ ɛpo te ye ɛwaen, ná asue mɔ bɛte ye fasue ne?

english_verse: Thebes trusted the mighty power of Ethiopia and Egypt; the nations of Put and Libya were her allies.
translation_verse: Yitiopia ne Misraim bɛte ye anwoserɛ, anwoserɛ bɔ ye bo ɔmbɛ ɔ. Né Pute ne Libiafoɛ bɛte wɔ bokafoɛ mɔ.

english_verse: But she was captured and taken to a foreign country. Her children were murdered at every street corner. The members of her royal family were auctioned off, and her high officials were bound in chains.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛhyele ye nnure bɛhɔle, na ɔhɔle ngoaasolɛ nu; ye ngwadaa mɔ koso, bɛtele bɛ ti bɛbɔle mane bɛ nu tetele nzɔkanzɔka wɔ borɔnoɛ biala ngwandaa; beguale serewa bɛfa bɛhyɛle ye animnyamfoɛ nemɔ bɛfale, na beguale ye atitirefoɛ nemɔ amukoraa ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ.

english_verse: Nineveh, now it's your turn! You will get drunk and try to hide from your enemy.
translation_verse: Wɔ koso, ɛkɔno nzaa kɔbo, na ɛkɔɔfea, na ɔnate pɔfoɛ ne ati ɛkɔpena afealeɛ.

english_verse: Your fortresses are fig trees with ripe figs. Merely shake the trees, and fruit will fall into every open mouth.
translation_verse: W’anwoserɛ afealeɛ amukoraa kɔyɛ kyɛ borɔdoma mmakaa bɔ borɔdoma mmaa bɔ wali moa wasu ɔ wɔ so ɔ. Sɛ bɛwoso ye a, ɔtete gua sona bɔ odi ne noa nu.

english_verse: Your army is weak. Fire has destroyed the crossbars on your city gates; now they stand wide open to your enemy.
translation_verse: Nea! Wɔ koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ bɔ bɛwɔ wɔ nu ne, bakakyi mmrasua. W’aseɛ ne aso pambim nemɔ, bɛlela berɛ hambonnwu ma wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ, na see ayera mmuralɛ bɔ bɛbrambram wɔ pambim mɔ asi ne.

english_verse: Your city is under attack. Haul in extra water! Strengthen your defenses! Start making bricks! Stir the mortar!
translation_verse: Ɔnate kuro ne tualɛ ne ati, sesa nzue sie; miamia w’anwoserɛ afealeɛ nemɔ anu, dɔne nnɛterɛ fa pɛ mmerekese, ná miamia bɔ bɛfa bɛpɛ mmerekese ne anu yé.

english_verse: You will still go up in flames and be cut down by swords that will wipe you out like a field attacked by grasshoppers. So, go ahead and increase like a swarm of locusts!
translation_verse: Berɛ yeɛ see kɔyera wɔ ɔ, ngrandɛ ne konua wɔ boso, ɔkɔpesa wɔ kyɛ abɛbɛ piri, Wɔ de, ta pee kyɛ mmɛbɛ mbiri, ta pee kyɛ torɔka.

english_verse: More merchants are in your city than there are stars in the sky— but they are like locusts that eat everything, then fly away.
translation_verse: Ama wɔ dwaalilɛfoɛ nemɔ basone batra ewienu nzramaa; ɛsaa ne odi nningyein, na ɔnwati kɔ.

english_verse: Your guards and your officials are swarms of locusts. On a chilly day they settle on a fence, but when the sun comes out, they take off to who-knows-where.
translation_verse: W’atitire mɔ bɛte kyɛ mmɛbɛ, wɔ safohene mɔ bɛte kyɛ torɔka bɔ ɛyerɛ ba a, bɛtenatena ɛwaen so ɔ. Nakoso sɛ eyia pukye a, betu bɛkɔ, na ebiala nze nekaa bɔ bɛwɔ ɔ.

english_verse: King of Assyria, your officials and leaders are sound asleep, while your people are scattered in the mountains. Yes, your people are sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Ao Asiria hene, wɔ neafoɛ nemɔ balela, w’atitire nemɔ bɛtɔ ngosie, wɔ mmenia nemɔ babɔ aya wɔ mmokaa nemɔ aso bɔ ebiala ɔmmoaboa bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: You're fatally wounded. There's no hope for you. But everyone claps when they hear this news, because your constant cruelty has caused them pain.
translation_verse: Wɔ ngena nemɔ bɛte kenangɔ, na wɔ ngena nemɔ batu. Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔte wɔ nga ne, ɔkɔbɔ ye sa nu kogua wɔ so, ofikyɛ wɔ bɔne yɔleɛ bɔ ye bo mbɛ ne, nwa yeɛ amva angɔ ye so ɔ?

english_verse: I am Habakkuk the prophet. And this is the message that the Lord gave me. Habakkuk Complains to the Lord
translation_verse: Nyekyire bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Habakuku nyane ye ne, ye ɛhe. Habakuku adwobisa

english_verse: Our Lord, how long must I beg for your help before you listen? How long before you save us from all this violence?
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, ɔkwaadwu kyinzu yeɛ ngosu ngɔpena mmokalɛ, nakoso ɛngɔtɛ me so ɔ? Metea nu mekyire wɔ kyɛ, “Nhyɛsoɛ oo”, nakoso ɛngɔpepɛ ngole yɛ!

english_verse: Why do you make me watch such terrible injustice? Why do you allow violence, lawlessness, crime, and cruelty to spread everywhere?
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmaa me nye nwu amumuyɛɛ, ná ɛma me nye nwu nhyɛsoɛ e? Basabasayɔlɛ ne nhyɛsoɛ yeɛ me nye tua ɔ; apereapereɛ ne ngondii badwɔso.

english_verse: Laws cannot be enforced; justice is always the loser; criminals crowd out honest people and twist the laws around. The Lord Answers Habakkuk
translation_verse: Yiti mmeraa ne, ɔnyɛ adwuma, yeɛ ndɛenbualɛ turoloo nne berɛ, ofikyɛ bɔnefoɛ bapɛ teneneefoɛ nwo babra bayia, na ndɛengyea yeɛ ɔkɔ so ɔ. Nyameɛ ye Habakuku adwobisa ne noa

english_verse: Look and be amazed at what's happening among the nations! Even if you were told, you would never believe what's taking place now.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔto ɛmɔ nye bɛ́nea maen maen nemɔ anu, ɛ́mɔma ɔyɛ ɛmɔ nwanwa ná ɛmɔ nwo dwiri ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ mebaayɔ nikyee bie wɔ ɛmɔ aberɛ so, bɔ sɛ bɛkã bekyire ɛmɔ po a, ɛmɔngole bengoli ɔ.

english_verse: I am sending the Babylonians. They are fierce and cruel— marching across the land, conquering cities and towns.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ tie, mékanyane Kaldeafoɛ, sɔ atianuserɛ maen bɔ bɛ nwo yɛ nyera ne, bɔ bɛnate bɛfa aseɛ ye aso amukoraa bɛfa atenaleɛ mɔ bɔ nna bɛ deɛ ahɔ ɔ.

english_verse: How fearsome and frightening. Their only laws and rules are the ones they make up.
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo yɛ suro, yeɛ bɛ nye yɛ se, na bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛdwene kyɛ ɔte turoloo, ná ɔte paa ma bɛ ne yeɛ bɛyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Their cavalry troops are faster than leopards, more ferocious than wolves hunting at sunset, and swifter than hungry eagles suddenly swooping down.
translation_verse: Bɛ mbɔngɔ mɔ koso bɛ nwo yɛ nyera tra aboa, bɛte awerɔm bɛtra nɔsoa mbataku; bɛ pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ nemɔ behuru bɛpepe; amba, bɛ pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ nemɔ befi dedeede yeɛ bɛba ɔ; betu kyɛ kɔleɛ bɔ ɔpe ndɛen kɔkye naen di ɔ.

english_verse: They are eager to destroy, and they gather captives like handfuls of sand.
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa bɛba ye atianuserɛ so, bɛ nyunu ogye kyɛ eyia afiteleɛ mvrama, na bɛboaboa bɛ bɔ bahye bɛ nnure nemɔ noa kyɛ anweaa.

english_verse: They make fun of rulers and laugh at fortresses, while building dirt mounds so they can capture cities.
translation_verse: Bɛsere ahemvo mɔ, yeɛ bɛgoro atitirefoɛ mɔ anwo; bɛsere anwoserɛ afealeɛ biala, ofikyɛ bɛhonhɔn nnɛterɛ bɛfo so bɛfa kuro.

english_verse: Then suddenly they disappear like a gust of wind— those sinful people who worship their own strength. Habakkuk Complains Again
translation_verse: Na afei, bɛsɛkye nningyein bɛpɛ nu bɛkɔ kyɛ mvrama piri, awudifoɛ bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ b’anwoserɛ yeɛ ɔte bɛ nyameɛ ɔ!

english_verse: Holy Lord God, mighty rock, you are eternal, and we are safe from death. You are using those Babylonians to judge and punish others.
translation_verse: Ao, AWURADE me Nyameɛ, me Krongronniɛ, aso nna wɔ yeɛ ɛwɔ berɛ fi tetetete bɔ olle ahyɛaseɛ ɔ? Yɛngowu. Ao AWURADE, atu bɛ asie berɛ kyɛ bebua yɛ ndɛen; ao Nyɔbotaen, ama bɛ bo atimu kyɛ bɛhwe yɛ so.

english_verse: But you can't stand sin or wrong. So don't sit by in silence while they gobble up people who are better than they are.
translation_verse: Wɔ nye te krongron paa bɔ yiti ɛngora nnea bɔne, ná ɛngora nnea amumuyɛɛ ɔ. Na nzu ati yeɛ ɛnea nnakannakafoɛ, bɔ ahã wɔ noa ato nu, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɔnefoɛ oku sona bɔ ɔtengyɛ tra bɔnefoɛ ne ɔ?

english_verse: The people you put on this earth are like fish or reptiles without a leader.
translation_verse: Ayɛ mmenia kyɛ ɛpo nu naen, kyɛ abɔdeɛ bɔ bɛkongo bɔ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔla bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: Then an enemy comes along and takes them captive with hooks and nets. It makes him so happy
translation_verse: Bɛfa koaa bɛkye bɛ mukoraati, bɛfa b’asawu ne bɛtwe bɛ befite, bɛboa bɛ noa wɔ bɛ tɛen ne anu, yiti bedi ahurusi, na bɛ nye gye.

english_verse: that he offers sacrifices to his fishing nets, because they make him rich and provide choice foods.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma b’asawu ne, bɛyera ɛyɛɛ bɛma bɛ tɛen ne; ofikyɛ ɔnate bɛ so yeɛ bɛtena ase wɔ anwotɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: Will he keep hauling in his nets and destroying nations without showing mercy?
translation_verse: Yiti odi kyɛ bɛkɔ so bɛporoporo b’asawu ne anu, ná bɛkɔ so bekũkũ maen maen mɔ wɔ atianuserɛ nu daa anaa?

english_verse: While standing guard on the watchtower, I waited for the Lord's answer, before explaining the reason for my complaint.
translation_verse: Ngogyina m’apa bɔ megyina so mesra ne aso, ná magyina ndende wɔ abandenden ne aso. Ngɔwɛne ngɔnea bɔ ɔkɔhã kohyire me ɔ, ɔne mmuayɛɛ bɔ ɔkɔfa kɔma me wɔ m’adwobisa ne anwo ɔ.

english_verse: Then the Lord told me: “I will give you my message in the form of a vision. Write it clearly enough to be read at a glance.
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE buale me kyɛ, “Kyerɛ nyekyire ne, ná kyerɛ ye pefee gua nyɔboɛ taataa nemɔ aso, amaa ɔnate so mmenia bahora bakenga ye ndɛndɛ so.

english_verse: At the time I have decided, my words will come true. You can trust what I say about the future. It may take a long time, but keep on waiting— it will happen!
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nyekyire ne, ɔ́nwondɛ mmerɛ bɔ bahyehyɛ bato berɛ bama ye ɔ; ɔpe ndɛen kyɛ ɔkɔwa nu ɔ, na ɔngɔyɛ ngyɛkyerɛ. Sɛ ɔyɛ ngyɛkyerɛ po a, nwondɛ; ofikyɛ ɔkɔwa nu amba, ɔngɔyɛ ngyɛkyerɛ.

english_verse: “I, the Lord, refuse to accept anyone who is proud. Only those who live by faith are acceptable to me.” Trouble for Evil People
translation_verse: Tie, sona bɔ ɔte anwomasoɛ ne, ye kra ɔndengyɛ wɔ ye nu, nakoso teneneeniɛ de, ɔnate ye gyidie so yeɛ okonya ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: Wine is treacherous, and arrogant people are never satisfied. They are no less greedy than death itself— they open their mouths as wide as the world of the dead and swallow everyone.
translation_verse: Afei koso, nzaa te nnakannaka, anwomasoɛniɛ ne ngɔtena berɛ daa. Ye akɔnnɔ nu trɛ kyɛ ɛborɔ, ɔte kyɛ ewue bɔ ye ko nyi le ɔ. Ɔko boaboa maen maen amukoraa noa ma ye nwo, na ɔkye mmenia amukoraa nnure ɔfa.”

english_verse: But they will be mocked with these words: You're doomed! You stored up stolen goods and cheated others of what belonged to them.
translation_verse: Aso sɔ maen nemɔ amukoraa bɛngɔhã ye anyinga, aso bɛngɔhã ngorohoɛ dwirɛ bɛngɔfa ye nwo kyɛ, “Bɔ ɔsesa nningyein bɔ nna ye deɛ ahɔ ɔ ɔbɔ so ne, ye yaakɔ! Apoobɔlɛ nningyein bɔ ode ye, ɔkɔhɔ so koodwu kyinzu?”

english_verse: But without warning, those you owe will demand payment. Then you will become a frightened victim.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛma wɔ kerɛ ne, aso bengodwɔso bengotia wɔ mvum nu, na bɛ bɔ bekodwɔso wɔ so ne, bɛkɔma wɔ nwo kɔwosowoso wɔ. Na ɛkɔyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ kɔma bɛ.

english_verse: You robbed cities and nations everywhere on earth and murdered their people. Now those who survived will be as cruel to you.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ afẽ maen maen pee afa ne ati, maen ngaa nemɔ amukoraa koso bɛkɔfẽ wɔ bɛkɔfa, ofikyɛ ahã mmenia mogya agua, yeɛ ayɛ nhyɛsoɛ wɔ aseɛ ne aso, kuro ne aso, ɔne nu ama amukoraa bɛ so.

english_verse: You're doomed! You made your family rich at the expense of others. You even said to yourself, “I'm above the law.”
translation_verse: “Sona bɔ ɔnate atee tɛɛ so ɔpena anwonyadeɛ ma ye awuro, kyɛ ɔfa nwo ye saen wɔ anwuro, kyɛbɔ musue biala ngɔto ye ne, ye yaakɔ!”

english_verse: But you will bring shame on your family and ruin to yourself for what you did to others.
translation_verse: Ɛnate mmenia pee bɔ ahũhũ bɛ ne aso ahwehwe animguaseɛ abrɛ w’awuro, ayɔ bɔne atia wɔ kra.

english_verse: The very stones and wood in your home will testify against you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nyɔboɛ ne kofi fasue ne anu kɔtea nu, na mbuna ne kofi ndaboa ne anu kosuro so.

english_verse: You're doomed! You built a city on crime and violence.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔnate mogya hãgualɛ so ɔkyekye kuro, ná ɔnate amumuyɛɛ so ɔma kuro bo tindim ne, ye yaakɔ!

english_verse: But the Lord All-Powerful sends up in flames what nations and people work so hard to gain.
translation_verse: Tie, aso nna Asafo AWURADE yeɛ wahyehyɛ kyɛ mmenia bɛfɛ bɛyɔ adwuma ma see ɔyera ye, ná maen maen bɛfɛ bɛma nningyein bɔ ɔte mbaen ɔ.

english_verse: Just as water fills the sea, the land will be filled with people who know and honor the Lord.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ AWURADE animnyam nwo nimdeɛ koyi aseɛ so tɛkyɛ, kyɛbɔ nzue ayi ɛpo nu tɛkyɛ ne.

english_verse: Now you will be disgraced instead of praised. The Lord will make you drunk, and when others see you naked, you will lose their respect.
translation_verse: Animguaseɛ yeɛ wabia wɔ ɔ, nna animnyam ɔ; wɔ koso, no nzaa bo ma wɔ bienzua bɔ bambɛ ne ɔla so. AWURADE sa famaa nu kwangoa kɔkakyi kɔwa wɔ so, na animguaseɛ kɔkata w’animnyam ne aso.

english_verse: You destroyed trees and animals on Mount Lebanon; you were ruthless to towns and people everywhere. Now you will be terrorized. Idolatry Is Foolish
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nzɛmmɔne bɔ ayɔ atia Lebanon ne, ɔne ngaka mɔ huhunɛ bɔ ɔmaa besurole ne, okobu kosa wɔ, ofikyɛ ahã mmenia mogya agua, yeɛ ayɛ nhyɛsoɛ wɔ aseɛ ne aso, kuro ne aso, ɔne nu ama amukoraa bɛ so.

english_verse: What is an idol worth? It's merely a false god. Why trust a speechless image made from wood or metal by human hands?
translation_verse: Amoen bɔ adwiililɛniɛ wase ne, nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ so ɔ? Amoen bɔ bahuro nikyee bafa bayɔ ɔ, bɔ okyirekyire nnakannaka ɔ; adwiililɛniɛ ne, ɔfa ye wora owura ye bɔbɔ ye adwii bɔ wali, bɔ ɔte emumu amoen ne anu.

english_verse: What can you learn from idols covered with silver or gold? They can't even breathe. Pity anyone who says to an idol of wood or stone, “Get up and do something!”
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔkã kyire bakaa kyɛ, “Tingye”, ná ɔkã kyire nyɔboɛ mumu kyɛ, “Dwɔso! Ɔbaahyirehyire” ne, ye yaakɔ! Tie, bafa esikaa kɔkorɛ ne dwetɛ baboro ye nwo, nakoso nwomeɛ biala ɔnne ye nu.

english_verse: Let all the world be silent— the Lord is present in his holy temple.
translation_verse: Nakoso AWURADE wɔ ye asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron ne anu, na odi kyɛ aseɛ amukoraa yɛ konn wɔ ye nyunu.

english_verse: I know your reputation, Lord, and I am amazed at what you have done. Please turn from your anger and be merciful; do for us what you did for our ancestors.
translation_verse: Ao AWURADE, mate wɔ nga, na nzurole. Ao AWURADE, kanyane w’adwuma wɔ mmerɛ ye anu, wɔ mmerɛ ye anu maa benwu ye, na wɔ yaafɛlɛ nu po, nwu anwumvoin.

english_verse: You are the same Holy God who came from Teman and Paran to help us. The brightness of your glory covered the heavens, and your praises were heard everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ fi Teman wale, amba, Krongronniɛ ne fi bokaa Paran so wale. Sela Ye animnyam katale nyameɛso, yeɛ ye nwo ayɛyelɛ yili aseɛ so tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: Your glory shone like the sun, and light flashed from your hands, hiding your mighty power.
translation_verse: Ye nwo hyireinn ne te kyɛ agralaa; né mmɛen nyɔ fi ye sa nu, ná nu yeɛ né ye tumi ne ɔfea ɔ.

english_verse: Dreadful diseases and plagues marched in front and followed behind.
translation_verse: Né ewue anwonyerɛ li ye nyunu, na né ɛhawo nate ye gya bo.

english_verse: When you stopped, the earth shook; when you stared, nations trembled; when you walked along your ancient paths, eternal mountains and hills crumbled and collapsed.
translation_verse: Ɔte gyinane, na ɔwosole aseɛ. Ɔtole ye nye neane, na ɔbɔle maen maen mɔ sandene; mmokaa bɔ bɛwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ ne, bedwiri beguale, na daa tete pambaa nemɔ, bɛbɔle bɛ nu ase. Ye atee mɔ wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: The tents of desert tribes in Cushan and Midian were ripped apart.
translation_verse: Nwuni kyɛ Kusan ɛtena sua mɔ bɛwɔ amaneɛ nu, yeɛ Midian aseɛ so mbɛmuɛ tena mɔ bɛwosowoso.

english_verse: Your arrows were ready and obeyed your commands. You split the earth apart with rivers and streams;
translation_verse: Ɛhwene w’agyaen fili wɔ ndokue nu, kyɛbɔ mmusua kure nemɔ bɛ ndaen, bɔ ye ole wɔ dwirɛ ne, ɔte ɔ. Sela Afa asue mɔ ahyehyɛ aseɛ nu.

english_verse: mountains trembled at the sight of you; rain poured from the clouds; ocean waves roared and rose.
translation_verse: Mmokaa mɔ nwuni wɔ, na bɛ nwo wosowosole bɛ. Asue bɔ ɔsẽ wuruwuru ɔ pɛle nu hɔle, buma mane ye komvi so teateane nu, na ɔmane ye sa so hɔle anwuro.

english_verse: The sun and moon stood still, while your arrows and spears flashed like lightning.
translation_verse: Eyia ne ɛsraen begyinagyinane seinn wɔ b’atenaleɛ, mmerɛ bɔ w’agyaen nemɔ bɛ nwo tete yerɛmyerɛm bɛkɔ, bɔ wɔ pealɛɛ nwo hyɛmhyɛm ne ɔ́ta hyireinn ɔ.

english_verse: to rescue your people and save your chosen one. You crushed a nation's ruler and stripped his evil kingdom of its power.
translation_verse: Efite hɔle kyɛ ɛfa ngoalelɛ brɛ wɔ maen, kyɛ ɛfa brɛ wɔ sona bɔ apopa ye ngoo ne. Nzɛmmɔneniɛ n’awuro ne aso panyi ne, ɛpɛkyɛle ye, na ɛmane ye nwo lale so fi ye gya bo kodwu ye ti so.

english_verse: His troops had come like a storm, hoping to scatter us and glad to gobble us up. To them we were refugees in hiding— but you smashed their heads with their own weapons.
translation_verse: Ɛfale ye bɔbɔ ye pealɛɛ sinane bɔ ɔla ye koɛhonɛfoɛ nemɔ noa ne; bɛwale kyɛ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ɔ, kyɛ bɛbabɔ me bɛpete. Bɔ bɛ nye gye ye nwo ole kyɛ bekohu anwumvoin mmenia wɔ mvealeɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: Then your chariots churned the waters of the sea. Habakkuk's Response to God's Message
translation_verse: Ɛfale wɔ mbɔngɔ natele ɛpo nu, ɛfale nzue buma mbiri nemɔ anu.

english_verse: When I heard this message, I felt weak from fear, and my lips quivered. My bones seemed to melt, and I stumbled around. But I will patiently wait. Someday those vicious enemies will be struck by disaster. Trust in a Time of Trouble
translation_verse: Ndele nen, me kunu tele me; komviɛ ne mane me noa kekã bɔle so. M’aporɛ nu yɛle me hodwoo, na me nwo wosowosole me. Nakoso ngɔyɛ konn ngɔnwondɛ amaneɛnwunɛ kyẽa ne, kyɛ ɔkɔwa maen bɔ wafa koɛ waateta yɛ ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: Fig trees may no longer bloom, or vineyards produce grapes; olive trees may be fruitless, and harvest time a failure; sheep pens may be empty, and cattle stalls vacant—
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ borɔdoma mmɔ nyerɛen, bobe nemɔ benzu mmaa, olive sulɛ wali ngasi, eboo mɔ bɛngye aleɛ, mmoaen nemɔ bɛ boso ayera wɔ tuin ne anu, yeɛ nandwie biala nne tuin nemɔ anu,

english_verse: but I will still celebrate because the Lord God is my Savior.
translation_verse: nakoso me de, ngoli ahurusi wɔ AWURADE nu. Ngɔma me nye kɔgye wɔ me ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ nu.

english_verse: The Lord gives me strength. He makes my feet as sure as those of a deer, and he helps me stand on the mountains. To the music director: Use stringed instruments.
translation_verse: AWURADE Nyameɛ te m’anwoserɛ. Ɔma me gya tindim kyɛ kɛtɛbɔɔ deɛ, na ɔmaa menate m’asɔneyɛɛ nemɔ aso. Mefa mema edweinhyirelɛniɛ ne, kyɛ ɔ́fa me sangoo ne ɔ́to.

english_verse: I am Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the grandson of Gedaliah, the great-grandson of Amariah, and the great-great-grandson of Hezekiah. When Josiah son of Amon was king of Judah, the Lord gave me this message. Judgment on Judah
translation_verse: Yuda hene Yosia bɔ ɔte Amon awa ne, ye aberɛ so, AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔlale ye ali hyirele Sefania bɔ ye baba ole Kuse bɔ ye baba ole Gedalia bɔ ye baba ole Amaria bɔ ye baba ole Hesekia ne, ye ɛhe:

english_verse: I, the Lord, now promise to destroy everything on this earth—
translation_verse: “Ngɔpra nikyee biala boso bɔkɔɔ ngofi aseɛ so,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: people and animals, birds and fish. Everyone who is evil will crash to the ground, and I will wipe out the entire human race.
translation_verse: “Ngonua mmenia ne ngaka boso; ngonua ewienu nnomaa ne ɛpo nu naen boso, bɛ ne sundidua mɔ ne bɔnefoɛ mɔ. Ngonua kuro sona boso ngofi aseɛ so,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I will reach out to punish Judah and Jerusalem— nothing will remain of the god Baal; nothing will be remembered of his pagan priests.
translation_verse: “Ngɔtengyɛ me sa ngɔhwe Yuda so, yeɛ Yerusalemfoɛ amukoraa bɛ so; na ngokyikyi Baal nwo nikyee biala bɔ waha ɔ ye boso, ɔne ahɔmeɛ ne asɔfo bɔ bɛso bosoen ɔ bɛ dumaa boso ngofi wa;

english_verse: Not a trace will be found of those who worship stars from their rooftops, or bow down to the god Milcom, while claiming loyalty to me, the Lord.
translation_verse: yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne anwuro abɔdeɛ mɔ wɔ sua ti afia; yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne AWURADE bɛfa ye bɛta ndaen, nakoso bɛfa bosoen Milkom bɛta ndaen ɔ;

english_verse: Nothing will remain of anyone who has turned away and rejected me.
translation_verse: yeɛ bɛ bɔ bayakyi AWURADE sililɛ, bɛ bɔ bɛmbena AWURADE si atee bɔ bɛmva bɛ dwirɛ bɛndo ye nyunu ɔ.”

english_verse: Be silent! I am the Lord God, and the time is near. I am preparing to sacrifice my people and to invite my guests.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔyɛ konn wɔ AWURADE Nyameɛ nyunu! Ofikyɛ AWURADE kyẽa ne wapingye, yoo, AWURADE asiesie afɔleɛ, na wate bɛ bɔ wato ye sa wafrɛ bɛ nemɔ anwo.

english_verse: On that day I will punish national leaders and sons of the king, along with all who follow foreign customs.
translation_verse: AWURADE afɔleɛ kyẽa ne dwu a, ngɔhwe atitirefoɛ mɔ ne ɛhene mma nemɔ bɛ so, bɛ ne bɛ bɔ bewura maen bie sofoɛ mɔ bɛ ndaadeɛɔ.

english_verse: I will punish worshipers of pagan gods and cruel palace officials who abuse their power.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, ebiala bɔ ohuru fa aponnwaa so ne, ngɔhwe ye so, bɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛfa aminɛ ne apoo nningyein beyi bɛ mene awuro to ɔ.”

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise that on that day noisy crying will be heard from Fish Gate, New Town, and Upper Hills.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Sɔ kyẽa ne, bɛkɔte esuɛ bekofi Tire Pambim ne anu, bɛkɔte awuye bekofi borɔnoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne aso, yeɛ bɛkɔte nningyein sɛkyelɛ piri paa bekofi pambaa nemɔ aso.

english_verse: Everyone in Lower Hollow will mourn loudly, because merchants and money changers will be wiped out.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔtete nekaa bɔ bɛfrɛ berɛ Mɔɔta ɔ, ofikyɛ banua dwadifoɛ nemɔ amukoraa bɛ boso, banua bɛ bɔ bɛkari ɛdwetɛ ne amukoraa bɛ boso.

english_verse: I'll search Jerusalem with lamps and punish those people who sit there unworried while thinking, “The Lord won't do anything, good or bad.”
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, ngɔfa kanea ngohyini ngɔneanea Yerusalem nu, na ngɔhwe bɛ bɔ bafa bɔne bayɛ bɛ nwo buru ne nnu nemɔ bɛ so, bɛ bɔ bɛkã ye bɛ ti anu kyɛ, ‘AWURADE ngɔyɔ ye nwo huu, kyɛ paa oo, anaa tɛɛ oo.’

english_verse: Their possessions will be taken, their homes left in ruins. They won't get to live in the houses they build, or drink wine from the grapes in their own vineyards. A Terrible Day
translation_verse: Yiti bɛ nningyein kɔkakyi nningyein bɔ mmenia kɔfẽ kɔfa ɔ, na b’awuro mɔ kɔkakyi dandue. Bekosisi sua de, nakoso bɛngɔtena nu; bɛkɔyɔ bobe boo mɔ de, nakoso bɛngɔno ye nzaa ne bie.”

english_verse: The great day of the Lord is coming soon, very soon. On that terrible day, fearsome shouts of warriors will be heard everywhere.
translation_verse: AWURADE kyẽa piri ne wapingye, wapingye, na ɔpe ndɛen paa; esuɛ bɔ bɛkɔte ye AWURADE kyẽa ne nen, ɔkɔyɛ aworabɔlɛ kyɛ! Katakyie mɔ kosũ hahii.

english_verse: It will be a time of anger— of trouble and torment, of disaster and destruction, of darkness and despair, of storm clouds and shadows,
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, ɔte ahonehulɛ kyẽa, amaneɛ ne ahunundetelɛ kyẽa, ɛsɛkyelɛ ne ehunɛ kyẽa, awosii ne aworabɔlɛ kyẽa, munungum ne awosii kabii kyẽa,

english_verse: of trumpet calls and battle cries against fortified cities and mighty fortresses.
translation_verse: totorobɛndohulɛ ne koɛ nu ndeateamuɛ kyẽa bɔ ɔ́ba nguro bɔ bato bɛ nwo fasue ɔne abandenden ndendenn mɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord warns everyone who has sinned against him, “I'll strike you blind! Then your blood and your insides will gush out like vomit.
translation_verse: Ngɔma aworabɔlɛ kɔto mmenia bɔ ɔkɔmaa bɛkɔnate kyɛ anyesiniwaafoɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ bayɔ bɔne batia AWURADE; bekogyi bɛ mogya bekogua kyɛ mvuture, na bekogyi bɛ nwonaen ne bekogua kyɛ bondua.

english_verse: Not even your silver or gold can save you on that day when I, the Lord, am angry. My anger will flare up like a furious fire scorching the earth and everyone on it.”
translation_verse: B’ɛdwetɛ anaa bɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ, ɔngɔhora ngɔpepɛ ngole bɛ wɔ AWURADE ahonehulɛ kyẽa ne. Aseɛ amukoraa kɔyera wɔ ye nungunɛhwenɛ see ne anu, ofikyɛ ɔbaanua aseɛ ne aso ama mukoraa bɛ boso mvum nu.

english_verse: before it's too late. The Lord has set a time when his fierce anger will strike like a storm and sweep you away.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔtena berɛ maa ɔhyehyɛ sɔ koraka, kyẽa bɔ ɔsẽ kɔ kyɛ afafu bɔ mvrama bɔ ye kɔ ne, nnɛmɔma ɔba koraka, nnɛmɔma AWURADE ɛyaafɛlɛ piri ne ɔba ɛmɔ so koraka, nnɛmɔma AWURADE ahonehulɛ kyẽa ne ɔba ɛmɔ so koraka.

english_verse: If you humbly obey the Lord, then come and worship him. If you do right and are humble, perhaps you will be safe on that day when the Lord turns loose his anger. Judgment on Philistia
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, ɛ́mɔpena AWURADE, aseɛ ne asofoɛ bɔ ɛmɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase ɔ, bɔ ɛmɔdi AWURADE mmeraa dwirɛ so ɔ! Ɛ́mɔpena tenenee si atee, ɛ́mɔpena anwobrɛaseɛ si atee; ebiaa né wamaa ɛmɔanya ɛmɔ ti badidi nu wɔ AWURADE ahonehulɛ kyẽa ne. Filistifoɛ

english_verse: Gaza and Ashkelon will be deserted and left in ruins. Ashdod will be emptied in broad daylight, and Ekron uprooted.
translation_verse: Gasa kɔkakyi kuro bɔ batu bafi so ɔ, yeɛ Asekelɔn kɔkakyi kurofoen, bekotu Asedɔde bekofi berɛ eyiagyina, yeɛ bekotutu Ekron bo bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: To you people of Philistia who live along the coast, the Lord has this to say: “I am now your enemy, and I'll wipe you out!”
translation_verse: Mboanoafoɛ, ɛmɔ yaakɔ oo, Keretifoɛ maen ne! AWURADE dwirɛ ne obua ɛmɔ foɛ; O Kanaan bɔ ɔte Filistifoɛ aseɛ ɔ, ngɔbɔ wɔ tɔɔ, na bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ nu biala ngɔha wɔ wɔ nu.

english_verse: Your seacoast will be changed into pastureland and sheep pens.
translation_verse: Mboanoa aseɛ ne kɔkakyi nekaa bɔ ngaka didi ɔ, ɔne mmoaenneafoɛ bɛ namue ne mmoaennduin.

english_verse: The Lord God hasn't forgotten those survivors in Judah, and he will help them— his people will take your land to use for pasture. And when evening comes, they will rest in houses at Ashkelon. Judgment on Moab and Ammon *
translation_verse: Mboanoa aseɛ ne kɔyɛ Yuda awuro ama bɔ banya bɛ ti badidi nu ɔ bɛ deɛ, bɔ bɛkɔfa ngaka bɛkɔhɔ so adidie ɔ, na Asekelɔn awuro mɔ nu yeɛ bekobutubutu nɔsoa ɔ; ofikyɛ AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ kɔpɛ ye nye kɔnea bɛ, na ɔkɔfa bɛ bɔ bahye bɛ nnure nemɔ kosa kɔwa. Moabo ne Amon

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful, the God of Israel, said: I've heard Moab and Ammon insult my people and threaten their nation.
translation_verse: “Mate Moabo anyingahanɛ ne, yeɛ alapaa bɔ Amonfoɛ bɛfa bɛbɔ me maen ne, ɔne kyɛ bele anwomasoɛ bede me maen aseɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: And so, I swear by my very life that Moab and Ammon will end up like Sodom and Gomorrah— covered with thornbushes and salt pits forever. Then my people who survive will take their land.
translation_verse: Yiti, kyɛbɔ nde ase ye, amba, Moabo kɔkakyi kyɛ Sodom, yeɛ Amonfoɛ bɛkɔkakyi kyɛ Gomora, ndetema ne ngyee ngumaa aseɛ ne aseɛ pralaa afebɔɔ. Na me maen mmaa bɔ bɛkɔha ne, bɛkɔfẽ bɛ bɛkɔfa, yeɛ me maen mmaa bɔ bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ne, bɛkɔfa bɛkɔyɛ bɛ deɛ, Asafo AWURADE, Yisrael Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: This is how Moab and Ammon will at last be repaid for their pride— and for sneering at the nation that belongs to me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: B’anwomasoɛ ne, ye nwo akatuaa ɛne, ɔnate alapaa bɔ babɔ, ɔne anwomasoɛ bɔ bayɛ ye wɔ Asafo AWURADE maen ne aso ne ati.

english_verse: I will fiercely attack. Then every god on this earth will shrink to nothing, and everyone of every nation will bow down to me, right where they are. Judgment on Ethiopia
translation_verse: AWURADE nye kɔboro bɛ so, ofikyɛ okonua aseɛ so mmosoen amukoraa bɛ boso, na asue noa maen maen ne amukoraa, sona biala kɔsɔne ye wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye aseɛ so. Yitiopia ne Asiria

english_verse: People of Ethiopia, the sword of the Lord will slaughter you! Judgment on Assyria
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔ, Yitiopiafoɛ, ɛmɔ koso, me ngrandɛ noa yeɛ ɛmɔkɔtotɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord will reach to the north to crush Assyria and overthrow Nineveh.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔfa koɛ kɔɔteta sorɔ dɔ maen ne, na ɔkɔbɔ Asiria tɔɔ; ɔkɔkakyi Ninewe kurofoen maa ɔkɔyɛ pralaa kyɛ ɛserɛ so.

english_verse: Herds of wild animals will live in its rubble; all kinds of desert owls will perch on its stones and hoot in the windows. Noisy ravens will be heard inside its buildings, stripped bare of cedar.
translation_verse: Ngaka kure kure kɔɔlela nu, maen maen mɔ nu ngaka mukoraa: nandwinoma ne mbɛsɛ kɔtena ye sua buburuwaa nemɔ aso, bɛkɔte nnomaa suɛ wɔ ye mboma nemɔ anu, ye aponnwaa nemɔ kodwiri kogua, ofikyɛ ye sida bakaa mbuna nemɔ nwo kɔlela berɛ.

english_verse: This is the glorious city that felt secure and said, “I am the only one!” Now it's merely ruins, a home for wild animals. Every passerby simply sneers and makes vulgar signs.
translation_verse: Anwomasoɛ kuro bɔ né ye so anu atɔ ye ne, ye ɛne oo, ye bɔ osele ye nwo kyɛ, “Me ɛne, ebiala nne berɛ ko bɔ ɔte kyɛ me ɔ” ne. Nea kyɛbɔ wasi wakakyi kurofoen ɔ, kyɛbɔ wakakyi ngaka dabea ɔ! Ebiala bɔ ɔkɔpɛ nu berɛ ne, ɔkɔwoso ye ti kosobi ye noa.

english_verse: Too bad for that disgusting, corrupt, and lawless city!
translation_verse: Ye yaakɔ, kuro bɔ wayɛ lɔen bɔ ye nwo agua fiɛ ɔ, nhyɛsoɛ kuro ne!

english_verse: Forever rebellious and rejecting correction, Jerusalem refuses to trust or obey the Lord God.
translation_verse: Wandie AWURADE dwirɛ ne, wandie foɛtulɛ, wamva ye wora wanwura AWURADE nu, wandwe wambingye ye Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Its officials are roaring lions, its judges are wolves; in the evening they attack, by morning nothing is left.
translation_verse: Nu mbanyi mɔ bɛte gyata mɔ bɔ bɛbobɔ nu ɔ; ye maenbulɛfoɛ bɛte nɔsoa mbataku bɔ bɛnyakyi bowue po mma aleɛ ngye so ɔ.

english_verse: Jerusalem's prophets are proud and not to be trusted. The priests have disgraced the place of worship and abused God's Law.
translation_verse: Ye ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɛte anwohoahoafoɛ, nnakannaka mmenia, ye asɔfo mɔ begua nekaa krongron berɛ nwo fiɛ, na bɛmva mmeraa ne bɛnyɛ huu.

english_verse: All who do evil are shameless, but the Lord does right and is always fair. With the dawn of each day, God brings about justice.
translation_verse: AWURADE bɔ ɔwɔ ye nu de, ɔte teneneeniɛ, ɔnyɔ bɔ ɔtte mayee ɔ, ngyerɛmɔ biala ɔda ye pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ali, bɔ ɔnyakyi ye yɔlɛ koraa ɔ; nakoso bɔnefoɛ mɔ de, bɛnze nyanzoen.

english_verse: The Lord wiped out nations and left fortresses crumbling in the dirt. Their streets and towns were reduced to ruins and emptied of people.
translation_verse: “Mabɔ maen maen mɔ pasaa, b’abandenden nemɔ adwiri agua, mama bɛ dwaa nemɔ so ayɛ bɔfonn bɔ ebiala mva so ɔ; mabɔ bɛ nguro nemɔ tɔɔ bɔ sona biala anga, bɔ ebiala ɔtte nu ɔ.

english_verse: God felt certain that Jerusalem would learn to respect and obey him. Then he would hold back from punishing the city and not wipe it out. But everyone there was eager to start sinning again. Nations Will Turn to the Lord
translation_verse: Ngane kyɛ, ‘Esurolɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ esuro me ɔ, me ngyerɛkyerɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ etie ɔ, amaa ɔnate so mannua wɔ boso wɔ bɔ mahyehyɛ mama wɔ amukoraa nwo; nakoso ɛmɔkɔ so bɛma ɛmɔ yɔleɛ amukoraa yɛ bɔne.” Nyameɛ kɔpepɛ kole Yerusalem

english_verse: The Lord said: Just wait for the day when I accuse you nations. I have decided on a day, when I will bring together every nation and kingdom and punish them all in my fiery anger. I will become furious and destroy the earth.
translation_verse: “Yiti odi kyɛ ɛmɔnea me ate maa okodwu kyẽa bɔ ngodwɔso ngɔɔbɔ kwaadu ne, ofikyɛ ɔte me nhyehyɛleɛ kyɛ ngɔboaboa maen maen mɔ noa, kyɛ ngɔboaboa ahennie mɔ noa, ná ngɔma me yaafɛlɛ ne m’ahonehulɛ amukoraa kɔwa bɛ so ɔ; ofikyɛ me nungunɛ see ne, ɔkɔyera aseɛ amukoraa motoo,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I will purify each language and make those languages acceptable for praising me. Then, with hearts united, everyone will serve only me, the Lord.
translation_verse: “Sɔ mmerɛ ne, ngɔma maen maen mɔ bɛ noa dwirɛ kɔyɛ krongron, amaa ɔnate so bɛ mukoraa babɔ AWURADE dumaa, ná bayɛ ko baso ye.

english_verse: From across the rivers of Ethiopia, my scattered people, my true worshipers, will bring offerings to me.
translation_verse: Na me mmenia bɔ bɛsɔne me, bɔ babɔ aya bahɔ Yitiopia asue mɔ si dɔ ne, bɛkɔfa m’afɔleɛ bɛkɔbrɛ me.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't rebel against me and be put to shame. I'll do away with those who are proud and arrogant. Never will any of them strut around on my holy mountain.
translation_verse: “Sɔ mmerɛ ne, w’animguaseɛ yɔleɛ amukoraa bɔ ɛfa tole me mmeraa ne, ngɔye ngofi berɛ, na bɛ bɔ bedi anwomasoɛ nu ahurusi ne, ngotu bɛ bo ngofi wɔ nu, na ɛngɔyɛ ahandaen ko wɔ me bokaa krongron ne aso.

english_verse: But I, the Lord, won't destroy any of your people who are truly humble and turn to me for safety.
translation_verse: Anwumvoin mmenia ne awiɛmvoɛ mmenia yeɛ ngɔmaa bɛkɔha wɔ wɔ nu ɔ, na AWURADE dumaa yeɛ bɛkɔfa bɛ wora bekowura nu ɔ.

english_verse: The people of Israel who survive will live right and refuse to tell lies. They will eat and rest with nothing to fear. A Song of Celebration
translation_verse: Na mmenia bɔ bɛkɔha wɔ Yisrael ne, bɛngɔyɔ amumuyɛɛ biala, bɛngɔhã ngondombo dwirɛ biala, yeɛ nnakannaka dwirɛ biala ngofi bɛ noa; ofikyɛ bɛ de, bekoodidi ná balela berɛ, bɔ ebiala ngonwunanwuna bɛ ɔ.” Sion ngoalelɛ ahurusi dwein

english_verse: Zion, your punishment is over. The Lord has forced your enemies to turn and retreat. Your Lord is King of Israel and stands at your side; you don't have to worry about any more troubles.
translation_verse: AWURADE aye ndɛenbualɛ ne wafi wɔ so, wapia wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ wagua dɔ. AWURADE, Yisrael hene ne, ɔte wɔ nu, engosuro amaneɛ biala ko.

english_verse: Jerusalem, the time is coming, when it will be said to you: “Don't be discouraged or grow weak from fear!
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, bekose Yerusalem kyɛ, “O Sion, nnɛsuro, nnɛma w’abasa nu yɛ hodwoo.

english_verse: The Lord your God wins victory after victory and is always with you. He celebrates and sings because of you, and he will refresh your life with his love.” The Lord's Promise to His People
translation_verse: AWURADE wɔ Nyameɛ ne ɔte wɔ nu, ɔte katakyie ne defoɛ, ɔkɔfa anigye koli wɔ nwo ahurusi, ɔkɔfa ye ɔdɔ ne kɔyɛ wɔ foforɛ, na ɔkɔfa anigye kɔto wɔ nwo dwein.

english_verse: The Lord has promised: Your sorrow has ended, and you can celebrate.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bedi aworabɔlɛ ne, ngɔboaboa bɛ noa maa bekosa bekoli aluolue ne, amaa ɔnate so animguaseɛ anga wɔ ko.

english_verse: I will punish those who mistreat you. I will bring together the lame and the outcasts, then they will be praised, instead of despised, in every country on earth.
translation_verse: Tie, sɔ mmerɛ ne, me ne bɛ bɔ bɛhyɛ wɔ so ne yɛkoli. Ngɔpepɛ ngole wɔ mmubuafoɛ nemɔ, ngɔboaboa bɛ bɔ babɔ aya nemɔ noa, na ngɔmaa bekonya animnyam ne dumaa wɔ aseɛ amukoraa bɔ bagua bɛ nyunu ase wɔ so ne aso.

english_verse: I will lead you home, and with your own eyes you will see me bless you with all you once owned. Then you will be famous everywhere on this earth. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, ngɔfa ɛmɔ ngosa ngɔwa, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ngɔboaboa ɛmɔ noa ne anu. Ngɔma ɛmɔ konya dumaa ne animnyam wɔ aseɛ so maen maen amukoraa nu, mmerɛ bɔ ngɔfa ɛmɔ mmenia bɔ bahye bɛ nnure ngosa ngɔwa bɔ ɛmɔ nye tua ne,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: On the first day of the sixth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak his message to the governor of Judah and to the high priest. So Haggai told Governor Zerubbabel and High Priest Joshua
translation_verse: Nana Dario ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu, bosome nzia ne anu, kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, AWURADE fale ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hagae so hã hyirele Yuda amrado Serubabɛl bɔ ye baba ole Sɛtiɛl ne, ɔne ɔsɔfo panyi Yosua bɔ ye baba ole Yehosadake ne kyɛ,

english_verse: You harvest less than you plant, you never have enough to eat or drink, your clothes don't keep you warm, and your wages are stored in bags full of holes.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔalua pee, nakoso kaaba bie yeɛ ɛmɔanya bafi nu ɔ; ɛmɔdidi, nakoso ɛmɔ ko nyi; ɛmɔno nzaa, nakoso ɔmmo ɛmɔ; ɛmɔkera ɛtena, nakoso ebiala nwo nyɛ ye hye; yeɛ bɔ ode akatuaa ne, ode gua bɔtɔ bɔ ye bo atofitofi ɔ nu.

english_verse: But first, go to the hills and get wood for my temple, so I can take pride in it and be worshiped there.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛmɔhɔ bokaa ne aso bɛɛfa mmakaa bɛbra beesi awuro ne. Me nye kɔgye ye nwo, na ngɔla m’animnyam ali, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: You expected much, but received only a little. And when you brought it home, I made that little disappear. Why have I done this? It's because you hurry off to build your own houses, while my temple is still in ruins.
translation_verse: Né ɛmɔ nye la ate kyɛ ɛmɔkonya fieso nningyein pee, nakoso, ɛ́mɔnea, ɔyɛle aleɛ kaaba bie. Na ɛmɔfa bɛwale awuro nen, nhu nguale. Nzu ɔ? Bɔ Asafo AWURADE bisa hɔ ɛne. M’awuro ne bɔ wabubu wagua ne ati ɔ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɛmɔ de, ebiala nye aboro osi ye bɔbɔ ye awuro ɔ.

english_verse: That's also why the dew doesn't fall and your harvest fails.
translation_verse: Ɔnate sɔ ati, nyameɛso mma bosue ngua mma ɛmɔ ko, yeɛ aseɛ koso ngye aleɛ ko.

english_verse: And so, at my command everything will become barren—your farmland and pastures, your vineyards and olive trees, your animals and you yourselves. All your hard work will be for nothing.
translation_verse: Na mato me sa mafrɛ wawa kandinga paa maa wape aseɛ so, mmokaa so, aburoo so, nzaa monɛ so, ngoo so, nikyee biala bɔ benya befi aseɛ so ɔ so, mmenia so, nyɛmmoa so, ɔne ɛmɔ sa noa adwuma mukoraa so.”

english_verse: Zerubbabel and Joshua, together with the others who had returned from exile in Babylonia, obeyed the Lord's message spoken by his prophet Haggai, and they started showing proper respect for the Lord.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Sɛtiɛl awa Serubabɛl ne Yehosadake awa ɔsɔfo panyi Yosua ne maen mmaa ngaa ne amukoraa belili AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ dwirɛ so, ɔne ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Hagae dwirɛ so, kyɛbɔ AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ somane ye maa ɔhane ne; na maen ne surole wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: Haggai then told them that the Lord had promised to be with them.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Hagae bɔ ɔte AWURADE bɔfoɛ ne, ɔhane AWURADE ngraa ne hyirele maen ne kyɛ, “Ngyi ɛmɔ si, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: On the twenty-first day of the next month, the Lord told Haggai the prophet to speak this message to Governor Zerubbabel, High Priest Joshua, and everyone else:
translation_verse: “Kã kyire Yuda amrado Serubabɛl bɔ ye baba ole Sɛtiɛl ne, ɔne ɔsɔfo panyi Yosua bɔ ye baba ole Yehosadake ne, ɔne maen mmaa ngaa ne amukoraa kyɛ,

english_verse: just as I promised your ancestors when I brought them out of Egypt. Don't worry. My Spirit is right here with you.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ me ne ɛmɔ yɛyɛle apam wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔfili Misraim bɛwale ne, sɔ ala yeɛ me Sunzum te ɛmɔ nu ɔ, yiti nnɛma ɛmɔsuro.

english_verse: Soon I will again shake the heavens and the earth, the sea and the dry land.
translation_verse: Na Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Ɔngɔhyɛ biala, ngosa ngɔwoso anwuro ne aseɛ, ɛpo ne aseɛ wosee;

english_verse: I will shake the nations, and their treasures will be brought here. Then the brightness of my glory will fill this temple.
translation_verse: ngɔwoso maen maen mukoraa; na maen maen mukoraa b’anwonya kɔwa wa, na ngɔfa animnyam ngoyi awuro he tɛkyɛ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: and I promise that this new temple will be more glorious than the first one. I will also bless this city with peace. The Past and the Future
translation_verse: Na awuro he, ye nziɛ ye animnyam ne, ɔkɔyɛ piri kɔtra ye daa deɛ ne, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne; na ɛwa yeɛ ngɔma asomdwee ɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.’ ”

english_verse: to ask the priests for their opinion on the following matters:
translation_verse: “Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Adwobisa bɔ ɔfa mmeraa he anwo ne, bisa asɔfo nemɔ ma bɛye ye noa:

english_verse: Suppose meat ready to be sacrificed to God is being carried in the folds of someone's clothing, and the clothing rubs against some bread or stew or wine or olive oil or any other food. Would those foods that were touched then become acceptable for sacrifice? “Of course not,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: ‘Sɛ ebie fa naen bɔ ɔte krongron ɔ owura ye tena nu, ná ɔfa ye tena ne kã paanoo, anaa aleɛ bɔ bato, anaa nzaa, anaa ngoo, anaa aleɛ biala a, aso sɔ nikyee ne kɔyɛ krongron anaa?’ ” Yeɛ asɔfo nemɔ buale kyɛ, “Daabi.”

english_verse: Then Haggai said, “Suppose someone has touched a dead body and is considered unacceptable to worship God. If that person touches these foods, would they become unclean?” “Of course they would,” the priests answered.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Hagae bisale kyɛ, “Sɛ ebie fa ye nwo kã efuin maa ɔnate so ye nwo gua fiɛ, ná ɔfa ye nwo kã sɔ nningyein nemɔ anu bie a, aso sɔ nikyee ne nwo agua efiɛ anaa?” Yeɛ asɔfo nemɔ buale kyɛ, “Yoo, ye nwo agua fiɛ.”

english_verse: So the Lord told Haggai to say: That's how it is with this entire nation. Everything you do and every sacrifice you offer is unacceptable to me.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Hagae toale so sele kyɛ, “Sɔ ala yeɛ mmenia hemɔ bɛte ɔ, sɔ ala yeɛ maen he te wɔ me nyunu ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Sɔ ala yeɛ bɛ sa noa adwuma biala te ɔ; yeɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔ afɔleɛ bɛma me wɔ dɔ ne koso, ye nwo nde.

english_verse: But from now on, things will get better. Before you started laying the foundation for the temple,
translation_verse: Na ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, mesrɛ ɛmɔ, odi kyɛ ɛmɔdwenedwene bɔ okosi ɔ nwo. Na mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔnnya bɛttole nyɔboɛ ko bessiele nyɔboɛ ko aso wɔ AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu ne,

english_verse: That same day the Lord spoke to Haggai again and said:
translation_verse: AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali ye pɛen nyɔ so hyirele Hagae wɔ bosome ne anu, ye eleburanyɔ ne nna ne aso kyɛ,

english_verse: I made all of your hard work useless by sending mildew, mold, and hail—but you still did not return to me, your Lord.
translation_verse: Mvale fieso nningyein kesenɛ, asukuo ne asukɔtwea nzɛkyele ɛmɔ sa noa adwuma mukoraa; nakoso ɛmɔanza bamma me berɛ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Although you have not yet harvested any grain, grapes, figs, pomegranates, or olives, I will richly bless you in the days ahead. God's Promise to Zerubbabel
translation_verse: Aso aburoo ne bie waha wɔ pata so? Bobe ne borɔdoma ne akengaa ne olive mmakaa nemɔ, benzu mmaa. Ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, ngoyira ɛmɔ.”

english_verse: Tell Governor Zerubbabel of Judah that I am going to shake the heavens and the earth
translation_verse: “Kã kyire Yuda amrado Serubabɛl kyɛ: Mebaawoso anwuro ne aseɛ.

english_verse: and wipe out kings and their kingdoms. I will overturn war chariots, and then cavalry troops will start slaughtering each other.
translation_verse: Ngogu ahennie mɔ bɛ bia mɔ bɔkɔɔ; ngɔsɛkye maen maen mɔ b’ahennie anwoserɛ; ngɔhã teaseɛnam mɔ ne teaseɛnamhanɛfoɛ mɔ ngogua; mbɔngɔ ne pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ nemɔ kofifi ase, na ebiala kɔtɔ wɔ obiɛngo ngrandɛ noa.

english_verse: I am the prophet Zechariah, the son of Berechiah and the grandson of Iddo. In the eighth month of the second year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord told me to say:
translation_verse: Dario ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu, ye bosome mmɔtwɛ ne anu, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Sakaria bɔ ye baba ole Berekia bɔ ye baba ole Yido ne kyɛ,

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord All-Powerful, was very angry with your ancestors. But if you people will return to me, I will turn and help you.
translation_verse: Yiti se bɛ kyɛ, Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Ɛmɔsa bɛbra me berɛ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, na me koso ngosa ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Don't be stubborn like your ancestors. They were warned by the earlier prophets to give up their evil and turn back to me, but they paid no attention.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ nana mɔ, bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ belili moa nemɔ bɔle edwirɛ ne dawure behyirele bɛ kyɛ, ‘Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi ɛmɔ bɔne atee ne ɛmɔ bɔne yɔleɛ nwo,’ ne. Nakoso bandie, yeɛ bandɛ me so, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Where are your ancestors now? Not even prophets live forever.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ nana nemɔ, bɛwɔ nisua? Yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ koso, aso bɛte ngoa nu afebɔɔ?

english_verse: But my warnings and my words spoken by the prophets caught up with your ancestors. So they turned back to me and said, “Lord All-Powerful, you have punished us for our sins, just as you had planned.” First Vision: Horses and Riders
translation_verse: Nakoso me dwirɛ ne me nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ mva nduale me somvoɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ noa ne, aso bɛ nwo asohwenɛ wamma ɛmɔ nana mɔ so anaa? Yiti bɛsakyerale b’adwene, na besele kyɛ, ‘Kyɛbɔ Asafo AWURADE yɛle ye adwene kyɛ ɔne yɛ koli wɔ yɛ atee ne yɛ yɔleɛ nwo ne, sɔ ala yeɛ wamaa wato yɛ ɔ.’ ” Nyameɛ twe Sion ne Yerusalem nwo nungunɛ

english_verse: On the twenty-fourth day of Shebat, which was the eleventh month of that same year, the Lord spoke to me in a vision during the night: In a valley among myrtle trees, I saw someone on a red horse, with riders on red, brown, and white horses behind him.
translation_verse: “Nyane nyekyire kɔngɔen, na yieee, né biaa bie te pɔngɔ kɔkorɛ so! Né ogyi sesea mmakaa nemɔ anu wɔ bɔnza ne anu, na né mbɔngɔ kɔkorɛ, kyerekyerɛɛ ne fufue begyigyi biaa ne si dɔ.

english_verse: An angel was there to explain things to me, and I asked, “Sir, who are these riders?” “I'll tell you,” the angel answered.
translation_verse: Yeɛ mmisale kyɛ, ‘Me mene, na ɛhemɔ, nzikyɛ ɛne?’ Yeɛ abɔfo bɔ né ɔne me dwudwo ne buale me kyɛ, ‘Ngohyire wɔ bɔ bɛte ɔ.’

english_verse: At once, the man standing among the myrtle trees said, “These are the ones the Lord has sent to find out what's happening on earth.”
translation_verse: Yiti biaa bɔ né ogyi sesea mmakaa nemɔ anu dɔ ne, obuale kyɛ, ‘Ɛhemɔ yeɛ AWURADE asoma bɛ kyɛ beehyinihyini aseɛ so ɔ.’

english_verse: Then the riders spoke to the Lord's angel, who was standing among the myrtle trees, and they said, “We have gone everywhere and have discovered that the whole world is at peace.”
translation_verse: Na bebuale AWURADE abɔfo bɔ né ogyi sesea mmakaa nemɔ anu dɔ ne kyɛ, ‘Yahyinihyini aseɛ so, na yieee, né aseɛ amukoraa la berɛ dinn bɔ ode ye nwome ɔ.’

english_verse: So the angel told me to announce: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am very protective of Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yiti abɔfo bɔ né ɔne me yɛdwudwo ne, osele me kyɛ, ‘Bɔ ye dawure kyɛ, Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Metwe Yerusalem ne Sion nwo nungunɛ piri paa,

english_verse: For a while I was angry at the nations, but now I am furious, because they have made things worse for Jerusalem and are not the least bit concerned.
translation_verse: nakoso maen maen mɔ bɔ bɛ so anu atɔ bɛ ne de, mafɛ bɛ so yaa piri paa; ofikyɛ mvɛle yaa kaaba bie, nakoso maen maen nemɔ de, bɛmane amaneɛnwunɛ ne yɛle piri paa.

english_verse: And so, I will have pity on Jerusalem. The city will be completely rebuilt, and my temple will stand again.
translation_verse: Yiti AWURADE nwa nyoo: Anwumvoin yeɛ mafa mapɛ me nye maanea Yerusalem ɔ; berɛ yeɛ bekosi m’awuro ne ɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, na bɛkɔfa nyamaa bɔ bɛfa besusu nikyee ne yeɛ bekosusu Yerusalem ɔ.

english_verse: I also promise that my towns will prosper—Jerusalem will once again be my chosen city, and I will comfort the people of Zion. Second Vision: Animal Horns
translation_verse: Bɔ ye dawure bieku kyɛ, Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Me nguro nemɔ kosa konya ngɔsoɛ mmorosoɛ, na AWURADE kosa kɔkyekye Sion wora, na okosa kɔneanea nu kɔye Yerusalem.’ ” Mmɛen nna nemɔ

english_verse: Next, I saw four animal horns.
translation_verse: Afei, ndole me nye anwuro, na yieee, nwuni mmɛen nna.

english_verse: The angel who was sent to explain was there, and so I asked, “What do these mean?” His answer was, “These horns are the nations that scattered the people of Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem, and took away their freedom.” Then the Lord showed me four blacksmiths, and I asked, “What are they going to do?” He replied, “They are going to terrify and crush those horns.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ mmisale kyɛ, “Ɛhemɔ, nzikyɛ yeɛ bɛbaayɔ ɔ?” Na obuale kyɛ, “Mmɛen hemɔ yeɛ bɛbɔle Yuda bɛsandele bɔ ɔmaa ebiala wangora ye ti so ma ne. Nakoso tomvoɛ hemɔ bawa kyɛ bɛbaanwunanwuna bɛ, kyɛ maen maen bɔ bɛfale bɛ mmɛen bedwɔso betiale Yuda aseɛ bɛbɔle bɛ bɛsandele ne, bɛbaatutu bɛ mmɛen ne begua.”

english_verse: and I asked, “Where are you going?” “To measure Jerusalem,” was the answer. “To find out how wide and long it is.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ mmisale kyɛ, “Nisua yeɛ ɛkɔ ɔ?” Na obuale me kyɛ, “Mekwaasusu Yerusalem menea kyɛbɔ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ ne ye tendenn nu osi te ɔ.”

english_verse: The angel who had spoken to me came toward me, when another angel came up to him
translation_verse: Yieee, abɔfo bɔ ɔne me dwudwole ne hɔle ye nyunu, na abɔfo foforɛ hɔle ooyiale ye,

english_verse: and said, “Hurry! Tell that man with the measuring line that Jerusalem won't have any boundaries. It will be too full of people and animals even to have a wall.
translation_verse: na osele ye kyɛ, “Tu amirika kɔhã kyire aberandeɛ he kyɛ, ‘Yerusalem kɔyɛ kyɛ nguraa nguraa bɔ fasue nne bɛ nwo ɔ, ɔnate nu mmenia somaa ne nu nyɛmmoa somaa ti.

english_verse: The Lord himself has promised to be a protective wall of fire surrounding Jerusalem, and he will be its shining glory in the heart of the city.” A Call to Action
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me bɔbɔ, ngɔyɛ ye see fasue ngɔpɛ ye nwo ngɔbra ngoyia, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, na ngɔyɛ ye nu animnyam.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord says to his people, “Run! Escape from the land in the north, where I scattered you to the four winds.
translation_verse: Huuu, huuu! Ɛ́mɔnwati béfi sorɔ dɔ aseɛ ne aso oo, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne; ofikyɛ mabɔ ɛmɔ masande kyɛ anwuro mvrama nna ne, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Then the glorious Lord All-Powerful ordered me to say to the nations that had raided and robbed Zion: Zion is as precious to the Lord as are his eyes. Whatever you do to Zion, you do to him.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔ Asafo AWURADE kã hɔ ɛhe: Ye animnyam ne ati yeɛ ɔsomane me wɔ maen maen bɔ bɛfene ɛmɔ bɛfale nemɔ berɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa ye sa kɔhã ɛmɔ ne, né wafa ye sa wahã AWURADE nye kyiremvua.

english_verse: And so, he will put you in the power of your slaves, and they will raid and rob you. Then you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: “Tie, ngɔtengyɛ me sa ngɔhɔ bɛ so, na bɛ koso bɛkɔyɛ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ bɛkɔma bɛ ngoaa mɔ, na afei ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ Asafo AWURADE yeɛ wasoma me ɔ.

english_verse: City of Zion, sing and celebrate! The Lord has promised to come and live with you.
translation_verse: O Sion awa brasua, to dwein ná di ahurusi; ofikyɛ tie, méba, na ngɔɔtena wɔ nu, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: When he does, many nations will turn to him and become his people. At that time you will know that I am a prophet of the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, maen maen pee bɛkɔfa bɛ nwo kɔɔbɔ AWURADE, na bɛkɔyɛ me maen. Ngɔtena wɔ nu, amaa ɔnate so anwu ye kyɛ Asafo AWURADE yeɛ wasoma me wɔ berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Then Judah will be his part of the holy land, and Jerusalem will again be his chosen city.
translation_verse: AWURADE kɔfa Yuda kɔyɛ ye agyapadeɛ kyɛ ye kyɛfa deɛ wɔ aseɛ krongron ne aso, na okosa kɔfa Yerusalem kɔyɛ ye deɛ.”
