english_verse: Everyone, be silent! The Lord is present and moving about in his holy place.
translation_verse: Adasa mukoraa, ɛ́mɔyɛ konn wɔ AWURADE nyunu; ofikyɛ wawoso ye nwo wɔ ye atenaleɛ krongron berɛ.

english_verse: I was given another vision. This time Joshua the high priest was standing in front of the Lord's angel. And there was Satan, standing at Joshua's right side, ready to accuse him.
translation_verse: Afei ohyirele me ɔsɔfo panyi Yosua bɔ né ogyi AWURADE abɔfo ne nyunu berɛ ɔ, na né Satan gyi ye sa famaa so berɛ kyɛ ɔbɔ ye kwaadu.

english_verse: But the Lord said, “Satan, you are wrong. Jerusalem is my chosen city, and this man was rescued like a stick from a flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE sele Satan kyɛ, “Wɔ, Satan, AWURADE ohwi wɔ nyunu! AWURADE bɔ waneanea nu waye Yerusalem ne, ohwi wɔ nyunu! Ɛhe, aso nna gyetia bɔ baye bafi see nu ɔ?”

english_verse: So the angel told some of the people to remove Joshua's filthy clothes. Then he said to Joshua, “This means you are forgiven. Now I will dress you in priestly clothes.”
translation_verse: Na abɔfo ne sele bɛ bɔ begyigyi ye nyunu berɛ ne kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔpuropuro ye nwo ndaadeɛ fiɛ ne!” Na afei osele Yosua kyɛ, “Tie, maprapra w’amumuyɛɛ ne mafi wɔ so, na ngɔfa ndaadeɛ nyemenenyemene ngowura wɔ.”

english_verse: I spoke up and said, “Also put a clean priestly turban on his head.” Then they dressed him in priestly clothes and put the turban on him, while the Lord's angel stood there watching.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ngane kyɛ, “Maa bɛfa abotire bɔ ye nwo te ɔ bɛbɔ ye.” Yiti bɛfale abotire bɔ ye nwo te ɔ bɛbɔle ye, na bɛfale ndaadeɛ bewurale ye. Né AWURADE abɔfo ne ogyi berɛ.

english_verse: After this, the angel encouraged Joshua by telling him that the Lord All-Powerful had promised:
translation_verse: Na AWURADE abɔfo ne fa tole Yosua nyunu kyɛ,

english_verse: If you truly obey me, I will put you in charge of my temple, including the courtyard around it, and you will be allowed to speak at any time with the angels standing beside me.
translation_verse: “Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Sɛ ɛfa m’atee so ná edi m’ahyɛdeɛ so a, ye de ngɔfa m’awuro ne ngowura wɔ sa, na ɛkɔnea m’aluo berɛ so, na ngɔmaa ekonya atee ɛkɔboka bɛ bɔ begyigyi ɛwa nemɔ aso.

english_verse: Listen carefully, High Priest Joshua and all of you other priests. You are a sign of things to come, because I am going to bring my servant, the Chosen King.
translation_verse: Afei tie, ɔsɔfo panyi Yosua, ɛne wɔ mmango bɔ bɛtete wɔ nyunu berɛ ne, ofikyɛ bɛte anwanwafoɛ. Na tie, mebaafa MMAEN bɔ ɔte me somvoɛ ne meba.

english_verse: Joshua, I have placed in front of you a stone with seven sides. I will engrave something on that stone, and in a single day I will forgive this guilty country.
translation_verse: Tie, nyɔboɛ bɔ mafa mato Yosua nyunu, nyɔboɛ komapɛ bɔ ye nye nzoo ne. Tie, so yeɛ ngokolikoli ye ahyerɛlɛ ne ngogua ɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, na ngokyikyi aseɛ he amumuyɛɛ ne ngofi berɛ ɛlɛhomapɛ.

english_verse: Then each of you will live at peace and entertain your friends in your own vineyard and under your own fig trees.
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ɛmɔ nu biala kɔfrɛfrɛ ye mmango kɔwa ye bobe ne ye borɔdoma bakaa bo, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: The angel who explained the visions woke me from what seemed like sleep.
translation_verse: Abɔfo bɔ ɔne me dwudwole ne, osa wale bieku, na otingyele me kyɛ sona bɔ betingye ye befi ye nnafelɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: Then he asked, “What do you see?” “A solid gold lampstand with an oil container above it,” I answered. “On the stand are seven lamps, each with seven flames.
translation_verse: Na obisale me kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ enwu ye e?” Yeɛ mmuale kyɛ, “Menwu kanea bakaa bɔ ye mukoraa te sikaa kɔkorɛ, bɔ bua gyi ye ti afia, bɔ ye nganea nzoo wɔ so, bɔ dodobɛen nzoo wɔ kanea biala bɔ ɔwɔ ye ti afia ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: One olive tree is on the right side and another on the left of the oil container.
translation_verse: Né olive mmakaa nyɔ gyigyi ye nwo berɛ, ko wɔ bua ne famaa so, yeɛ ko wora ɔwɔ ye bɛen so.”

english_verse: So the angel explained that it was the following message of the Lord to Zerubbabel: I am the Lord All-Powerful. So don't depend on your own power or strength, but on my Spirit.
translation_verse: Na obuale me kyɛ, “AWURADE dwirɛ bɔ ɔkã kyire Serubabɛl ole kyɛ: Nna anwoserɛ ɔ, yeɛ nna tumi ɔ, na mmom me Sunzum ɔ. Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Zerubbabel, that mountain in front of you will be leveled to the ground. Then you will bring out the temple's most important stone and shout, “God has been very kind.”
translation_verse: Ao bokaa piri, wɔ ole nwa? Ɛkɔkakyi aseɛ frɛtɛɛ wɔ Serubabɛl nyunu. Na ɔkɔfa nyɔboɛ titire ne kɔwa wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɛbɔ ese kyɛ, ‘Nyameɛ lo ye oo, Nyameɛ lo ye oo!’ ”

english_verse: The Lord spoke to me again and said:
translation_verse: AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali bieku hyirele me kyɛ,

english_verse: Zerubbabel laid the foundation for the temple, and he will complete it. Then everyone will know that you were sent by me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: “Serubabɛl sa yeɛ wato awuro he fapem ɔ, na ye sa yeɛ okosi koyie ɔ. Na afei ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ Asafo AWURADE yeɛ wasoma me ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Those who have made fun of this day of small beginnings will celebrate when they see Zerubbabel holding this important stone. Those seven lamps represent my eyes—the eyes of the Lord—and they see everything on this earth.
translation_verse: Na adwuma ne bohyɛlɛ kaaba ne, ebiala bɔ wabu ye animtia ne, okoli ahurusi, mmerɛ bɔ okonwu kyɛ Serubabɛl otira nyamaa bɔ bɛfa bɛtengyɛtengyɛ sua wɔ ye sa nu ne. Na kanea nzoo hemɔ te AWURADE nye mɔ bɔ bɛbɔ mborɔkaa wɔ aseɛ so amukoraa ɔ.”

english_verse: Then I asked the angel, “What about the olive trees on each side of the lampstand? What do they represent?
translation_verse: Yeɛ mmisale ye kyɛ, “Olive mmakaa nyɔ hemɔ bɔ begyigyi kanea bakaa ne famaa so ne ye bɛen so ne, bɛte nzu?”

english_verse: And what is the meaning of the two branches from which golden olive oil flows through the two gold pipes?”
translation_verse: Na nza mmisale ye pɛen nyɔ so kyɛ, “Olive mmakaa mmaen nyɔ bɔ bɛwɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ dodobɛen nyɔ bɔ behwie sikaa kɔkorɛ ngoo befi nu ne, bɛte nzu?”

english_verse: “Don't you know?” he asked. “No sir, I don't,” was my answer.
translation_verse: Yeɛ obisale me kyɛ, “Yiti ɛnze bɔ ɛhemɔ bɛte ɔ?” Na mmuale kyɛ, “Me mene, daabi oo.”

english_verse: Then he told me, “These branches are the two chosen leaders who stand beside the Lord of all the earth.”
translation_verse: Afei osele kyɛ, “Ɛhemɔ ole abɔdeɛ nyɔ bɔ bapopa bɛ ngoo bɔ begyigyi aseɛ amukoraa Mene ne nwo berɛ ne.”

english_verse: When I looked the next time, I saw a flying scroll,
translation_verse: Nza ndole me nye anwuro, na yieee, nwuni nwomaa bie bɔ babobɔ bɔ otu ɔ!

english_verse: and the angel asked, “What do you see?” “A flying scroll,” I answered. “About nine meters long and four and a half meters wide.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ abɔfo ne bisale me kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ enwu ye e?” Na mmuale kyɛ, “Menwu nwomaa bɔ babobɔ bɔ otu ɔ; ye tendenn nu te agyirɛ aburanyɔ, yeɛ ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu te agyirɛ buru.”

english_verse: Then he told me: This scroll puts a curse on everyone in the land who steals or tells lies. The writing on one side tells about the destruction of those who steal, while the writing on the other side tells about the destruction of those who lie.
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, “Ɛhe te ɛnomalɛ bɔ okyinikyini fa aseɛ so amukoraa ɔ. Ebiala bɔ okowua ne, bɔ ɔwɔ ye bue faen ne yeɛ bekogyina so bɛkɔpɛ ye asue bekofi wa ɔ; yeɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkɔta ndaen mbaen ne, bɔ ɔwɔ ye bue faen ne yeɛ bekogyina so bɛkɔpɛ ye asue bekofi wa ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful has said, “I am sending this scroll into the house of everyone who is a robber or tells lies in my name, and it will remain there until every piece of wood and stone in that house crumbles.” Seventh Vision: A Woman in a Basket
translation_verse: Ngɔsoma ye maa ɔkɔhɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne, na okowura awueniɛ n’awuro, yeɛ bɔ ɔfa me dumaa ta ndaen mbaen ɔ awuro; okosikye ye awuro berɛ, na ɔkɔyera awuro ne, nu mmakaa ne nu nyɔboɛ.” Braa bɔ ɔte asusudeɛ kɛndɛen nu ne

english_verse: Now the angel who was there to explain the visions came over and said, “Look up and tell me what you see coming.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ abɔfo bɔ ɔne me dwudwole ne wale moa oosele me kyɛ, “To wɔ nye anwuro ná nea nikye horɛ bɔ ɔ́kɔ ne.”

english_verse: “I don't know what it is,” was my reply. “It's a big basket,” he said. “And it shows what everyone in the land has in mind.”
translation_verse: Na mmisale ye kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ nikyee ɛne?” Yeɛ obuale kyɛ, “Ɛhe te asusudeɛ kɛndɛen bɔ ofi wa kɔ ɔ.” Osa sele kyɛ, “Ɛhe te b’amumuyɛɛ wɔ aseɛ amukoraa so.”

english_verse: The lead cover of the basket was opened, and in the basket was a woman.
translation_verse: Na yieee, bebukyele kɛndɛen ne ti bɔ ɔte sum ne aso, na né braa bie te kɛndɛen ne anu.

english_verse: “This woman represents evil,” the angel explained. Then he threw her back into the basket and slammed the heavy cover down tight.
translation_verse: Yeɛ abɔfo ne sele kyɛ, “Ɛhe te Amumuyɛɛ.” Na ɔnyemane braa ne aso wurale asusudeɛ kɛndɛen ne anu, na ɔfale ye ti sum nonɛnonɛ ne butuli so.

english_verse: Right after this I saw two women coming through the sky with wings outstretched like a stork in the wind. Suddenly they lifted the basket into the air,
translation_verse: Afei ndole me nye anwuro, na yieee, nwuni mmrasua nyɔ kyɛ bɛba ɔ. Né mvrama wɔ bɛ ndaa nu. Né bele ndaa te kyɛ akyemvona katakyie ndaa, na bɛmane kɛndɛen ne aso bɛfale aseɛ ne nyameɛso b’afia.

english_verse: and I asked the angel, “Where are they taking the basket?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ mmisale abɔfo bɔ ɔne me dwudwole ne kyɛ, “Nisua yeɛ ɛhemɔ bɛfa asusudeɛ kɛndɛen ne bɛkɔ e?”

english_verse: “To Babylonia,” he answered, “where they will build a house for the basket and set it down inside.”
translation_verse: Na obuale me kyɛ, “Bɛfa bɛkɔ Sinari aseɛ so, ná bekosi sua bɛma ye wɔ berɛ; na beyie a, bɛkɔfa asusudeɛ kɛndɛen ne bekosie ye nyinasoɛ ne aso.”

english_verse: Finally, I looked up and saw four chariots coming from between two bronze mountains.
translation_verse: Nza ndole me nye anwuro, na yieee, nwuni teaseɛnam nna kyɛ befi mmokaa nyɔ b’afia bɛba ɔ. Né mmokaa nemɔ te kɔɔbere mmokaa.

english_verse: The first chariot was pulled by red horses, and the second by black horses;
translation_verse: Teaseɛnam bɔ oli moa ne, mbɔngɔ bɔ bɛsosɔ ye ne bɛte kɔkorɛ; teaseɛnam bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne, mbɔngɔ bɔ bɛsosɔ ye ne bɛte bire;

english_verse: “Sir,” I asked the angel. “What do these stand for?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ mmisale abɔfo bɔ ɔne me dwudwole ne kyɛ, “Me mene, na ɛhemɔ, nzikyɛ ɛne?”

english_verse: Then he explained, “These are the four winds of heaven, and now they are going out, after presenting themselves to the Lord of all the earth.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo ne buale me kyɛ, “Ɛhemɔ ole nyameɛso sunzum nna ne, bɔ begyinagyina aseɛ amukoraa Mene ye nyunu berɛ beyie a befi berɛ bɛkɔ ne.

english_verse: The chariot with black horses goes toward the north, the chariot with white horses goes toward the west, and the one with spotted horses goes toward the south.”
translation_verse: Teaseɛnam bɔ mbɔngɔ bire bɛsosɔ ye ne, befi berɛ bɛkɔ sorɔ dɔ maen ne anu; yeɛ fufue nemɔ koso befi berɛ bedi bɛ si, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo te kyerekyerɛɛ ne koso bɛkɔ ngwaen dɔ maen ne anu.”

english_verse: The horses came out eager to patrol the earth, and the angel told them, “Start patrolling the earth.” When they had gone on their way,
translation_verse: Na anwoserɛfoɛ nemɔ wale nen, né bɛpe ndɛen bekyinikyini aseɛ so. Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ beehyinihyini aseɛ so.” Na beehyinihyinini aseɛ so.

english_verse: he shouted to me, “Those that have gone to the country in the north will do what the Lord's Spirit wants them to do there.” The Chosen Leader
translation_verse: Na ɔteane nu sele me kyɛ, “Nea, bɛ bɔ bɛ́kɔ sorɔ dɔ maen ne anu ne, bama me Sunzum kunu adwo ye fɔnwoo wɔ sorɔ dɔ maen ne anu.” Yerusalem foforɛ ne

english_verse: The Lord said to me:
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ,

english_verse: Tell him that I, the Lord All-Powerful, say, “Someone will reach out from here like a branch and build a temple for me. I will name him ‘Branch,’ and he will rule with royal honors. A priest will stand beside his throne, and the two of them will be good friends.
translation_verse: Amba, ye yeɛ okosi AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne ɔ, okonya ahennie animnyam ne, ɔkɔtena ye ahennie bia so koli hene, okoli sɔfo wɔ ye ahennie bia ne aso, na asomdwee bɔ odi mu ɔ kɔwa bɛ munyɔ b’afia.”

english_verse: This crown will be kept in my temple as a reminder and will be taken care of by Heldai, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and Josiah.”
translation_verse: Na abotire nemɔ kɔyɛ ngayeɛ nikyee kɔma Helem, Tobiya, Yedaya ne Sefania awa Hen wɔ AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu.

english_verse: When people from distant lands come and help build the temple of the Lord All-Powerful, you will know that the Lord is the one who sent me. And this will happen, if you truly obey the Lord your God.
translation_verse: “Na bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ nziɛ nziɛ ne, bɛkɔwa bɛkɔɔboka wɔ AWURADE asɔneyɛɛ sua ne silɛ nu, na afei ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ Asafo AWURADE yeɛ wasoma me ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ. Na sɛ ɛmɔyɛ AWURADE ɛmɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ nwo sotie bɔkɔɔ a, sɔ dwirɛ ne kɔwa nu.”

english_verse: On the fourth day of Chislev, the ninth month of the fourth year that Darius was king of Persia, the Lord again spoke to me.
translation_verse: Nana Dario ahennie afoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne anu, AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele Sakaria wɔ bosome ngona bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Kislewi ne anu, ye ɛlɛnna ne aso.

english_verse: It happened after the people of Bethel had sent Sharezer with Regem-Melech and his men to ask the priests in the Lord's temple and the prophets to pray for them. So they prayed, “Should we mourn and go without eating during the fifth month, as we have done for many years?”
translation_verse: ná bebisa Asafo AWURADE awuro berɛ asɔfo mɔ ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Aso nni aworabɔlɛ ná ngye hɔen wɔ bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu ne anu, kyɛbɔ mayɔ ye afoɛ worawora ye anu ye anaa?”

english_verse: It was then that the Lord All-Powerful told me to say to everyone in the country, including the priests: For
translation_verse: “Bisa aseɛ ne aso ama mukoraa ne asɔfo nemɔ kyɛ: Mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔhyele hɔen ná ɛmɔlili aworabɔlɛ wɔ bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu, ɔne nzoo ne anu, bɔ afoɛ aburasoo ɛhe ne, aso me ti yeɛ ɛmɔhyele hɔen ne ɔ?

english_verse: And when you eat and drink, isn't it for your own enjoyment?
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔdidi ná ɛmɔno koso a, aso nna ɛmɔ bɔbɔ yeɛ ɛmɔdidi bɛno bɛma bɛ nwo ɔ?

english_verse: My message today is the same one I commanded the earlier prophets to speak to Jerusalem and its villages when they were prosperous, and when all of Judah, including the Southern Desert and the hill country, was filled with people.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né mmenia tete Yerusalem bɔ né wanya ngɔsoɛ, bɔ né ye nguro mɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia, bɔ né mmenia tete ye ngwaen dɔ ne aseɛ pralaa ne aso ne, aso nna sɔ dwirɛ hemɔ yeɛ AWURADE fale daa ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ aso bɔle ye dawure ɔ?”

english_verse: So once again, I, the Lord All-Powerful, tell you, “See that justice is done and be kind and merciful to one another!
translation_verse: “Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Ɛ́mɔbua ndɛen turoloo, ná ebiala ɔla anwumvoinnwunɛ ne adɔeɛ ali ohyire obiɛngo;

english_verse: Don't mistreat widows or orphans or foreigners or anyone who is poor, and stop making plans to hurt each other.”
translation_verse: nnɛma ɛmɔsisi kunafoɛ, ayisiaa, ɛwɔfoɛ ne ehianiɛ; yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔ nu biala dwene obiɛngo nwo adwene tɛɛ.”

english_verse: But everyone who heard those prophets, stubbornly refused to obey. Instead, they turned their backs on everything my Spirit had commanded the earlier prophets to preach. So I, the Lord, became angry
translation_verse: Bɛyɛle bɛ so serɛ kyɛ twerɛboɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ bɛngɔte mmeraa ne ne edwirɛ bɔ Asafo AWURADE nate ye Sunzum so mane daa ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛbɔle ye dawure ne ɔ. Yiti Asafo AWURADE ahone huli piri paa.

english_verse: and said, “You people paid no attention when I called out to you, and now I'll pay no attention when you call out to me.”
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ ɔfrɛle ná bandie ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛfrɛle bɔ me koso mandie ɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said to me:
translation_verse: Na Asafo AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me bieku kyɛ,

english_verse: I love Zion so much that her enemies make me angry.
translation_verse: “Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Metwe Sion nwo nungunɛ piri paa, ɛyaa piri paa yeɛ mefa metwe ye nwo nungunɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I will return to Jerusalem and live there on Mount Zion. Then Jerusalem will be known as my faithful city, and Zion will be known as my holy mountain.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo: Ngosa ngɔwa Sion, na ngɔɔtena Yerusalem, na bɛkɔfrɛ Yerusalem kyɛ: Nahorɛ Kuro; yeɛ Asafo AWURADE bokaa ne koso kyɛ, Bokaa Krongron.

english_verse: Very old people with walking sticks will once again sit around in Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Mmienzua nworowaa ne mmrasua nworowaa kɔhɔ so kɔtenatena Yerusalem dwaaso, na bekotiratira pɔmaa, ɔnate kyɛ bɛkɔyɛ nworowaa posoposo.

english_verse: This may seem impossible for my people who are left, but it isn't impossible for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Maen he anu mmenia bɔ baha ne, sɛ ɔyɛ bɛ nye so nwanwa wɔ mmerɛ he anu a, aso me koso ɔkɔyɛ me nye so nwanwa anaa? Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I will save those who were taken to lands in the east and the west,
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Tie, ngɔpepɛ ngole me maen ngofi eyia afiteleɛ maen ne sa nu, ɔne eyia atɔleɛ maen ne sa nu;

english_verse: and I will bring them to live in Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, faithful to bring about justice.
translation_verse: na ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa maa bɛkɔɔtena Yerusalem; bɛkɔyɛ me maen, na me koso mayɛ bɛ Nyameɛ, wɔ nahorɛ ne tenenee nu.”

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful! So don't give up. Think about the message my prophets spoke when the foundation of my temple was laid.
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Ɛ́mɔmia ɛmɔ nye, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔasi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne, ɛmɔ bɔ sɔ mmerɛ ye anu ɛmɔate edwirɛ hemɔ bafi ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛ noa ne, ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ berɛ ofi kyẽa bɔ bɛtole Asafo AWURADE awuro ne fapem nen.

english_verse: Before that time, neither people nor animals were rewarded for their work, and no one was safe anywhere, because I had turned them against each other.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, anzana sɔ mmerɛ ne baawa ne, né akatuaa biala nne berɛ mma sona, yeɛ né ebie koso nne berɛ mma kaka. Na sɛ né ebie ɔkɔ oo, anaa ɔba oo, pɔfoɛ ne ati, né olle asomdwee biala, ofikyɛ nganyane sona biala maa odwɔso tiale obiɛngo.

english_verse: My people, only a few of you are left, and I promise not to punish you as I did before.
translation_verse: Nakoso kekesaala ye de, maen he mmenia bɔ baha ne, me ne bɛ ngoli ye kyɛbɔ nyɔle ye daa ne, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Instead, I will make sure that your crops are planted in peace and your vineyards are fruitful, that your fields are fertile, and the dew falls from the sky.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nningyein lualɛ kɔyɛ asomdwee nu, bobe kosu ye mma, aseɛ kɔhye aleɛ, anwuro kɔtɔ ye bosue, na maen he mmenia bɔ baha ne, ngɔmaa bekonya ɛhemɔ amukoraa.

english_verse: People of Judah and Israel, you have been a curse to the nations, but I will save you and make you a blessing to them. So don't be afraid or lose courage.
translation_verse: O Yuda awuro ama ne Yisrael awuro ama, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔakakyi amoenwaa dwirɛ wɔ maen maen mɔ nu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ngole ɛmɔ ngoa ɔ, na ɛmɔkɔyɛ saleɛ. Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro, na mmom ɛ́mɔmia ɛmɔ nye.”

english_verse: When your ancestors made me angry, I decided to punish you with disasters, and I didn't hold back.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Kyɛbɔ nyɛle m’adwene kyɛ me ne ɛmɔ yɛkoli ye weewee, mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ huli m’ahone, bɔ manzesã m’adwene ne, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne,

english_verse: Now you no longer need to be afraid. I have decided to treat Jerusalem and Judah with kindness.
translation_verse: sɔ ala koso yeɛ mayɛ m’adwene sɔ mmerɛ ye anu kyɛ ngɔyɛ Yerusalem ne Yuda awuro ama paa ɔ. Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro!

english_verse: But you must be truthful with each other, and in court you must give fair decisions that lead to peace.
translation_verse: Ɛhemɔ yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ: Odi kyɛ ebiala kã nahorɛ kyire obiɛngo; nekaa bɔ ɛmɔdi dwirɛ ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔbua ndɛen turoloo bɔ ɔfa asomdwee ba ɔ;

english_verse: Don't ever plan evil things against others or tell lies under oath. I, the Lord, hate such things. A Time of Celebration
translation_verse: nnɛma ɛmɔ nu biala nya obiɛngo nwo adwene tɛɛ, nnɛma ɛmɔ nye gye ngondombo ndaentalɛ nwo, ofikyɛ mekyi sɔ nningyein ne amukoraa, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful told me to say:
translation_verse: Yeɛ Asafo AWURADE lale ye dwirɛ ali hyirele me kyɛ,

english_verse: People of Judah, I, the Lord, demand that whenever you go without food as a way of worshiping me, it should become a time of celebration. No matter if it's the fourth month, the fifth month, the seventh month, or the tenth month, you should have a joyful festival. So love truth and live at peace.
translation_verse: “Asafo AWURADE nwa: Bosome bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne anu akɔngyere ne, nnu ne anu akɔngyere ne, nzoo ne anu akɔngyere ne, ɔne buru ne anu akɔngyere ne, bɛkɔyɛ ahurusililɛ, anwosɛpɛlɛ ne anigye aluolue kɔma Yuda awuro ama. Yiti ɛmɔhuro nahorɛ ne asomdwee.

english_verse: I tell you that people will come here from cities everywhere.
translation_verse: “Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Okosa kosi bieku kyɛ, maen maen nemɔ bɛ nguro pee nufoɛ kɔwa;

english_verse: Those of one town will go to another and say, “We're going to ask the Lord All-Powerful to treat us with kindness. Come and join us.”
translation_verse: kuro ko anu ama kɔhɔ kuro ko aso koose kyɛ, ‘Ɛ́mɔma yɛhã yɛ nwo yɛɛkoto yɛsrɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu, ná yɛpena Asafo AWURADE si atee; me koso ngɔhɔ bie.’

english_verse: Many people from strong nations will come to Jerusalem to worship me and to ask me to treat them with kindness.
translation_verse: Amba, maen maen pee ne maen maen bɔ bɛ nwo yɛ se ɔ bɛkɔwa bɛkɔɔpena Asafo AWURADE si atee wɔ Yerusalem, na bɛkɔkoto bɛkɔsrɛ wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: When this happens, ten people from nations with different languages will grab a Jew by his clothes and say, “Let us go with you. We've heard that God is on your side.” I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: sɔ mmerɛ ne, edwudwolɛ biala nu mmenia buru bɔ befi maen maen mɔ nu ɔ bɛkɔsosɔ Yudaniɛ ko ataadeɛ noa, na bekose kyɛ, ‘Yɛne ɛmɔ kɔhɔ, ofikyɛ yate kyɛ Nyameɛ gyi ɛmɔ si.’ ”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord: His eyes are on everyone, especially the tribes of Israel. So he pronounces judgment against the cities of Hadrach and Damascus.
translation_verse: AWURADE dwirɛ ne ɔko tia Hadrake aseɛ, na ɔkɔho kotia Damasko koso. Na adasa mmaa bɛ nye kɔkakyi kɔwa AWURADE berɛ, kyɛbɔ Yisrael mmusua kure amukoraa bɛ nye kɔkakyi kɔwa ye berɛ ne.

english_verse: Judgment will also fall on the nearby city of Hamath, as well as on Tyre and Sidon, whose people are clever.
translation_verse: Hamate bɔ ɔwɔ ɛwɛen so dɔ ne koso edwirɛ ne ko tia ye; Tiro ne Sidon koso sɔ ala, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ besusu kyɛ bɛse nworɛ.

english_verse: Tyre has built a fortress and piled up silver and gold, as though they were dust or mud from the streets.
translation_verse: Tiro sili anwoserɛ afealeɛ fale, ɔboaboale ɛdwetɛ noa kyɛ mvuture, ɔne sikaa kɔkorɛ paa noa kyɛ mmorɔnoɛ so nnɛterɛ.

english_verse: Now the Lord will punish Tyre with poverty; he will sink its ships and send it up in flames.
translation_verse: Tie, AWURADE kole ye anwodeɛ ne kofi ye sa nu, ɔkɔsɛkye ye tumi ne wɔ ɛpo nu, na see yeɛ ɔkɔyera ye motoo ɔ.

english_verse: Both Ashkelon and Gaza will tremble with fear; Ekron will lose all hope. Gaza's king will be killed, and Ashkelon emptied of its people.
translation_verse: Asekelɔn konwu ye, na ɛserɛ kɔhã ye, Gasa koso sɔ ala, na ahunundetelɛ kɔtɔ ye so, yeɛ Ekron, ofikyɛ ye anyelasoɛ kɔyɛ basaa. Ɛhene ne kowu kofi Gasa, na Asekelɔn kɔkakyi kurofoen.

english_verse: A mob of half-breeds will settle in Ashdod, and the Lord himself will rob Philistia of pride.
translation_verse: Mmenia firaman firaman yeɛ bɛkɔtena Asedɔde ɔ, na ngotu Filistia b’anwomasoɛ ne abo.

english_verse: No longer will the Philistines eat meat with blood in it or any unclean food. They will become part of the people of our God from the tribe of Judah. And God will accept the people of Ekron, as he did the Jebusites.
translation_verse: Ngɔye ye naen mogya mogya ne ngofi ye noa nu, ɔne ye nikyee bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ ne ngofi ye gye nemɔ b’afia. Na mmenia bɔ bɛkɔha ne, bɛkɔyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ ye deɛ, bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ Yuda nu mbanyi nemɔ bie, na Ekron kɔyɛ kyɛ Yebusifoɛ.

english_verse: God says, “I will stand guard to protect my temple from those who come to attack. I know what's happening, and no one will mistreat my people ever again.” The Lord Tells about the Coming King
translation_verse: Afei ɔnate ɛlɔen ne ati, ngɔto waen ngɔfa m’awuro ne anwo, ɔnate mmenia bɔ bɛpɛ nu berɛ bɛkɔ, ɔne bɛ bɔ besa bɛba ne ati, na nhyɛsoɛniɛ biala ngɔpɛ nu ngɔfa bɛ nu berɛ ko, ofikyɛ afei de, mefa me nye menea.

english_verse: Everyone in Jerusalem, celebrate and shout! Your king has won a victory, and he is coming to you. He is humble and rides on a donkey; he comes on the colt of a donkey.
translation_verse: O Sion awa brasua, di ahurusi paa! O Yerusalem awa brasua, bɔ ese! Tie, wɔ Hene ne ɔ́ba wɔ berɛ, ɔtengyɛ, na ye yeɛ ngoalelɛ wɔ ye berɛ ɔ, odwo, na ɔte afunum so, afunum akrɔngrɔma so, bɔ ɔte afunum beleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I, the Lord, will take away war chariots and horses from Israel and Jerusalem. Bows that were made for battle will be broken. I will bring peace to nations, and your king will rule from sea to sea. His kingdom will reach from the Euphrates River across the earth. The Lord Promises To Rescue Captives
translation_verse: Ngonua teaseɛnam mɔ boso ngofi Efraim, ngonua mbɔngɔ boso ngofi Yerusalem, yeɛ ngonua koɛhonɛ agyaen boso. Ɔkɔhã asomdwee dwirɛ kohyire maen maen mɔ, ye ahennie kofi ɛpo kɔɔhã ɛpo, okofi asue ne kɔɔhã aseɛ noa dɔ.

english_verse: When I made a sacred agreement with you, my people, we sealed it with blood. Now some of you are captives in waterless pits, but I will come to your rescue
translation_verse: Na wɔ koso, ɔnate w’apam mogya ne ati, wɔ mmenia bɔ begua kuku nu ne, ngɔye bɛ ngofi kumaa bɔ nzue nne nu ne anu.

english_verse: and offer you hope. Return to your fortress, because today I will reward you with twice what you had.
translation_verse: O, ɛmɔ, kukunufoɛ bɔ ɛmɔanya anyelasoɛ ɔ, ɛ́mɔsa bɛbra anwoserɛ afealeɛ ne anu; na ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, mefa meto dwaa kyɛ, ngɔfa ye mmɔhoɛ nyɔ ngosi wɔ gya nu.

english_verse: I will use Judah as my bow and Israel as my arrow. I will take the people of Zion as my sword and attack the Greeks. The Lord Will Protect His People
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ makondo Yuda mayɛ m’agyaen, mafa Efraim mayɛ agyaen bakaa mawura nu, O Sion, ngɔkanyane wɔ mma mmienzua mɔ maa bekodwɔso bekotia Hela mma mmienzua mɔ, na ngɔfa wɔ ngɔyɛ kyɛ katakyie ngrandɛ.

english_verse: Like a cloud, the Lord God will appear over his people, and his arrows will flash like lightning. God will sound his trumpet and attack in a whirlwind from the south.
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE kɔye ye nwo ali wɔ bɛ so, ye agyaen ne kɔhɔ kyɛ agralaa, AWURADE Nyameɛ kohu totorobɛndo, na ɔkɔfa ngwaen dɔ mvrama bɔ ɔpɛ ye nwo ne anu yeɛ ɔkɔhɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful will protect his people, and they will trample down the sharpshooters and their slingshots. They will drink and get rowdy; they will be as full as a bowl at the time of sacrifice.
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE kɔbɔ bɛ nwo waen, bekoli ngonim, bekohwi bɛkɔfa taya nyɔboɛ so, bɛkɔno, na bɛkɔbɔ ese kyɛ ebiaa babobo ne, bɛ ko koyi kyɛ talie, kyɛ afɔleɛ bokyea ndweasoɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: The Lord God will save them on that day, because they are his people, and they will shine on his land like jewels in a crown.
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ kole bɛ ngoa, ɔnate kyɛ bɛte ye maen mmoaen kure, ofikyɛ bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ mbembenanneɛ bɔ betuatua abotire nu bɔ bɛta wɔ ye aseɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: How lovely they will be. Young people will grow there like grain in a field or grapes in a vineyard.
translation_verse: Ah, kyɛbɔ osi te paa ɔ, kyɛbɔ ye nwo si yɛ nyemene ɔ! Aburoo kɔma mmerandeɛ mɔ kɔyɛ tukutukuu, na nzaa monɛ koso kɔma ndaluwa kɔyɛ sɔ ala.

english_verse: I, the Lord, am the one who sends storm clouds and showers of rain to make fields produce. So when the crops need rain, you should pray to me.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔsrɛ AWURADE maa ɔtɔ esue wɔ bamborɔ mmerɛ nu; AWURADE bɔ ɔma esue muna ne, ye yeɛ ɔma esue tɔ pee ma mmenia ɔ, na ɔtɔ ma ebiala maa onya fieso aleɛ.

english_verse: You can't believe idols and fortunetellers, or depend on the hope you receive from witchcraft and interpreters of dreams. But you have tried all of these, and now you are like sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ abusua amoen nemɔ kekã ngwaseasɛm, ahɔmeɛ nemɔ benwu nnakannaka dwirɛ, na bɛ laleɛ nu dwirɛ bɔ bɛkekã ne, ɔte ngondombo; bɛkyekye ɛmɔ wora mbaen. Yiti maen ne kyinikyini kyɛ mmoaen, bɛyɛ anwumvo, ofikyɛ neafoɛ biala nne berɛ.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, am fiercely angry with you leaders, and I will punish you. I care for my people, the nation of Judah, and I will change this flock of sheep into charging war horses.
translation_verse: “M’ahone ahu mmoaenneafoɛ nemɔ so, na ngɔhwe mbɔngye nemɔ so; ofikyɛ Asafo AWURADE kɔɔpasa ye mmoaen kure bɔ ye ole Yuda awuro ama ne anwo, na ɔkɔfa bɛ kɔyɛ kyɛ ye anidie pɔngɔ wɔ koɛ nu.

english_verse: From this flock will come leaders who will be strong like cornerstones and tent pegs and weapons of war.
translation_verse: Ye nu yeɛ ndweasoɛ nyɔboɛ ne kofi ɔ, ye nu yeɛ pɛmbɛen ne kofi ɔ, ye nu yeɛ koɛhonɛ agyaen ne kofi ɔ, ye nu yeɛ maenbulɛniɛ biala kofi ɔ.

english_verse: They will join in the fighting, and together they will trample their enemies like mud. They will fight, because I, the Lord, will be on their side. And they will crush the enemy cavalry.
translation_verse: Na bɛkɔyɛ kyɛ katakyie mɔ bɔ betiatia bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ so wɔ mmorɔnoɛ so nnɛterɛ nu wɔ koɛ nu ɔ. Bɛkɔho koɛ, ofikyɛ AWURADE gyi bɛ si, na pɔngɔhanɛfoɛ bɔ bɛtete pɔngɔ so ɔ bɛ nyunu kogua ase.

english_verse: I will strengthen the kingdoms of Judah and Israel. And I will show mercy because I am the Lord, their God. I will answer their prayers and bring them home. Then it will seem as though I had never rejected them.
translation_verse: “Ngɔma Yuda awuro ama b’ahone kɔyɛ se, na ngɔpepɛ ngole Yosef awuro ama. Ngosa ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa ngɔɔbɔ bɛ atenaseɛ, ofikyɛ manwu bɛ anwumvoin, ngɔyɛ bɛ kyɛ nna bɛ yeɛ mbole bɛ ne, ofikyɛ me ole AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ, na ngotie bɛ sufrɛ.

english_verse: Israel will be like a tribe of warriors celebrating with wine. When their children see this, they will also be happy because of me, the Lord.
translation_verse: Efraim kɔyɛ kyɛ katakyie, na bɛ ti anu kɔyɛ bɛ fɛfɛɛfɛ kyɛ bano nzaa ɔ. Amba, bɛ mma konwu ye, na bekoli ahurusi, na bɛ ti anu kɔyɛ bɛ fɛfɛɛfɛ wɔ AWURADE nu.

english_verse: I will give a signal for them to come together because I have rescued them. And there will be as many as ever before.
translation_verse: “Ngɔbɔ mvrɛma ngɔfrɛ bɛ ngɔboaboa bɛ noa, ofikyɛ mapɔ bɛ male bɛ, na bɛkɔta pee kyɛbɔ bɛtale pee ne.

english_verse: Although I scattered my people in distant countries, they won't forget me. Once their children are raised, they will return—
translation_verse: Ngolualua bɛ wɔ maen maen mɔ so, na bɛkɔkaye me wɔ maen maen mɔ so dedeede dɔ, na bɛ ne bɛ mma mɔ bekonya ngoa ná basa bawa.

english_verse: I will bring them home from Egypt and Assyria, then let them settle as far as Gilead and Lebanon, until the land overflows with them.
translation_verse: Ngosa ngɔye bɛ ngofi Misraim aseɛ so ngɔwa, yeɛ ngɔboaboa bɛ noa ngofi Asiria; na ngɔfa bɛ ngɔwa Gileade ne Lebanon aseɛ so, na berɛ aseɛ po, ɔkɔyɛ kãa kɔma bɛ.

english_verse: My people will go through an ocean of troubles, but I will overcome the waves and dry up the deepest part of the Nile. Assyria's great pride will be put down, and the power of Egypt will disappear.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔɔfa anwokyere ɛpo ne anu, okoli ɛpo nu asorɔkye ne aso ngonim, na asue Naele nu buma mukoraa kɔwewe. Ɔkɔbrɛ Asiria anwomasoɛ ne ase, na Misraim ɛhɔtɔ ne, ye boso komini.

english_verse: I'll strengthen my people because of who I am, and they will follow me. I, the Lord, have spoken!
translation_verse: Ngɔmaa bekogyina pindinn wɔ AWURADE nu, na ye dumaa nu yeɛ bɛkɔnate ɔ,” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Lebanon, open your gates! Let the fire come in to destroy your cedar trees.
translation_verse: Wɔ, Lebanon, bukyebukye w’anoa nemɔ ma see ne ɔyera wɔ sida nemɔ.

english_verse: Cry, you cypress trees! The glorious cedars have fallen and are rotting. Cry, you oak trees of Bashan! The dense forest has been chopped down.
translation_verse: Wɔ, ɛframmire, bɔ awuye, ofikyɛ sida atutu atɔ ase, ofikyɛ animnyam mmakaa nemɔ basɛkye. Basan eluii mɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye, ofikyɛ babu ɛhɔayeɛ too ne bagua.

english_verse: Listen! Shepherds are crying. Their glorious pastures have been ruined. Listen! Lions are roaring. The forests of the Jordan Valley are no more to be found. Worthless Shepherds
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie mmoaenneafoɛ nemɔ b’awuyebɔlɛ ne, ofikyɛ b’animnyam ne atɔ ase. Ɛ́mɔtie gyata akrɔngrɔma nemɔ bɛ bobɔlɛ bɔ bɛbobɔ nu ne, ofikyɛ asue Yɔɔdan nwo ɛhɔayeɛ ne wayɛ pralaa.

english_verse: The Lord my God said to me: Tend those sheep doomed for slaughter!
translation_verse: AWURADE me Nyameɛ nwa nyoo, “Mmoaen kure bɔ bɛ́fa bɛ bɛ́kɔ akumyɛɛ ne, yɛ bɛ so neafoɛ.

english_verse: The people who buy and butcher them go unpunished, while everyone who sells them says, “Praise the Lord! I'm rich.” Not even their shepherds have pity on them.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛtɔ bɛ ne, bekuku bɛ bɛfa bɛ nwo bedi. Yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ bɛ atɔen ne koso, bɛkã kyɛ, ‘Animnyam hã AWURADE, ofikyɛ manya me nwo’; yeɛ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ neafoɛ nemɔ koso bennwu bɛ anwumvoin.

english_verse: Tend those sheep because I, the Lord, will no longer have pity on the people of this earth. I'll turn neighbor against neighbor and make them slaves of a king. They will bring disaster on the earth, and I'll do nothing to rescue any of them.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mengonwu aseɛ ne aso ama anwumvoin ko, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Tie, ngɔma mmenia kɔtotɔ, bɔ ebiala kɔtɔ wɔ obiɛngo sa nu, ɔne ye hene sa nu ɔ. Bɛkɔyɛ aseɛ ne pasaa, na mengɔpepɛ mengole bɛ nngofi bɛ sa nu.”

english_verse: So I became a shepherd of those sheep doomed to be slaughtered by the sheep dealers. And I gave names to the two sticks I used for tending the sheep: One of them was named “Mercy” and the other “Unity.”
translation_verse: Na ngɔyɛ akumyɛɛ mmoaen kure ne aso neafoɛ, nganga, bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwumvo wɔ mmoaen kure ne anu ne. Mvale pɔmaa nyɔ. Ndole ko dumaa: Ɛlolɛ, yeɛ ko ne wora ndole ye dumaa: Koyɛlɛ, na nneane mmoaen kure ne aso.

english_verse: In less than a month, I became impatient with three shepherds who didn't like me, and I got rid of them.
translation_verse: Na bosome ko anu, nnuane mmoaenneafoɛ nza nemɔ bɛ boso mvili berɛ. Bɛ nwo yɛle me kra ahi, na me koso me nwo yɛle bɛ kra tɛ.

english_verse: Then I said, “I refuse to be your shepherd. Let the sheep that are going to die, go on and die, and those that are going to be destroyed, go on and be destroyed. Then let the others eat one another alive.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ nzele kyɛ, “Mengɔyɛ ɛmɔ neafoɛ ko. Bɔ odi kyɛ owu ne, ówu; bɔ odi kyɛ ye boso nua ne, ye boso ónua; na bɛ bɔ baha ne, ebiala óli obiɛngo naen.”

english_verse: On that same day, I broke the stick named “Mercy” to show that the Lord had canceled his agreement with all people.
translation_verse: Afei mvale me pɔmaa bɔ oli Ɛlolɛ ne, na mmuli nu, kyɛ mefa mepɛ m’apam bɔ me ne maen amukoraa yayɛ ne anu.

english_verse: The sheep dealers who saw me knew at once that this was a message from the Lord.
translation_verse: Yiti nu pɛle sɔ kyẽa ne, na mmoaen kure ne anu biemɔ bɔ né bɛyɛ anwumvo, bɔ né bɛ nye tua me ne, benwuni kyɛ AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I told them, “Pay me my wages, if you think you should; otherwise, forget it.” So they handed me my wages, a measly
translation_verse: Yeɛ AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Gyi gua ngukuenwonɛniɛ ne berɛ.” Nyɔboɛ bɔ odi mu bɔ bɛbɔle kyɛ bɛfa bɛtɔ me hɔ ɛne. Yiti mvale ɛdwetɛ aburasa ne, na ngyi nguale ngukuenwonɛniɛ ne berɛ wɔ AWURADE awuro berɛ.

english_verse: Then I broke the stick named “Unity” and canceled the ties between Judah and Israel.
translation_verse: Yeɛ mmuli me pɔmaa bɔ oli Koyɛlɛ ne anu, kyɛ mefa mepɛ aliɛmaayɛlɛ bɔ ɔla Yuda ne Yisrael b’afia ne anu.

english_verse: Next, the Lord said to me, “Act like a shepherd again—this time a worthless shepherd.
translation_verse: Afei AWURADE sele me kyɛ, “Sa fa mmoaenneafoɛ kwaseaa ye nningyein bɔ ɔfa nea mmoaen so ɔ tira.

english_verse: Once more I am going to let a worthless nobody rule the land—one who won't care for the strays or search for the young or heal the sick or feed the healthy. He will just dine on the fattest sheep, leaving nothing but a few bones.”
translation_verse: Tie, mebaama mmoaenneafoɛ bie odwɔso wɔ aseɛ ne aso, bɔ ɔngɔdwene bɛ bɔ bamini ne anwo, bɔ ɔngɔpena akrɔngrɔma nemɔ si atee, bɔ ɔngɔyɛ bɛ bɔ bapura nemɔ ayire, bɔ ɔngɔma bɛ bɔ bɛte apɔ ne aleɛ ɔ; na mmom okohu bɛ bɔ balɔ ne koli, ná watete bɛ gya boen nu pasapasa.

english_verse: You worthless shepherd, deserting the sheep! I hope a sword will cripple your arm and blind your right eye.
translation_verse: Mmoaenneafoɛ tɛɛ bɔ ɔto mmoaen nemɔ asaworam ne, ye yaakɔ! Ngrandɛ kɔpɛ ye sa, yeɛ okotu ye nye famaa. Ye sa kowu bɔkɔɔ, na ye nye famaa kosi bɔkɔɔ.”

english_verse: This is a message from the Lord about Israel: I am the Lord! I stretched out the heavens; I put the earth on its foundations and gave breath to humans.
translation_verse: AWURADE noa dwirɛ bɔ ɔfa Yisrael nwo ɛhe: AWURADE bɔ ɔtrɛtrɛle ewienu nu, bɔ ɔtole aseɛ fapem, bɔ ɔnwone sona sunzum wɔ ye nu ne, ɔnwa nyoo:

english_verse: I have decided that Jerusalem will become a bowl of wine that makes the neighboring nations drunk. And when Jerusalem is attacked, Judah will also be attacked.
translation_verse: “Tie, mebaafa Yerusalem meyɛ nzaabolɛ kulie mema maen maen bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia amukoraa; na bekotua Yuda wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bekotua Yerusalem ne anu.

english_verse: But I will turn Jerusalem into a heavy stone that crushes anyone who tries to lift it. When all nations on earth surround Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔfa Yerusalem ngɔyɛ nyɔboɛ nonɛnonɛ ngɔma maen maen amukoraa, ebiala bɔ ɔkɔpagya ye ne, okopura piri paa, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ aseɛ so maen maen amukoraa bɛkɔboa bɛ noa bekodwɔso bekotia ye de.

english_verse: I will blind every horse and make them panic, and every rider will be confused. But at the same time, I will watch over Judah.
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔte anyesotanɛ ngogua pɔngɔ biala so, yeɛ ngɔte ɛlaenbɔlɛ ngɔto bɔ ɔte ye so ne aso. Nakoso Yuda awuro ama de, ngɔlo bɛ, na ngɔprapra anyesiniwaa ngogua maen maen mɔ bɛ pɔngɔ biala so.

english_verse: Then every clan in Judah will realize that I, the Lord All-Powerful, am their God, and that I am the source of their strength.
translation_verse: Na Yuda mbanyi mɔ kɔkekã ye wɔ bɛ ti anu kyɛ, ‘Yerusalemfoɛ bɛte m’anwoserɛ wɔ Asafo AWURADE bɛ Nyameɛ nu.’

english_verse: At that time I will let the clans of Judah be like a ball of fire in a wood pile or a fiery torch in a hay stack. Then Judah will send the surrounding nations up in smoke. And once again the city of Jerusalem will be filled with people.
translation_verse: “Sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔfa Yuda mbanyi ngɔyɛ kyɛ see bɔ ogye wɔ eyein mɔ b’afia ɔ, kyɛ ɛtɛen bɔ ogye wɔ aburoo nyaa b’afia ɔ. Bɛkɔyera maen maen amukoraa bɔ bapɛ bɛ nwo bayia ɔ, wɔ famaa so ne bɛen so, na mmenia kosa kɔtena Yerusalem wɔ ye boso, wɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: But I will first give victory to Judah, so the kingdom of David and the city of Jerusalem in all of their glory won't be thought of more highly than Judah itself.
translation_verse: “AWURADE koli moa kɔpepɛ kole Yuda ɛtena sua mɔ, amaa ɔnate so Dawide awuro ama animnyam ne Yerusalemfoɛ b’animnyam bambagya bandra Yuda.

english_verse: I, the Lord God, will protect Jerusalem. Even the weakest person there will be as strong as David, and David's kingdom will rule as though my very own angel were its leader.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, AWURADE kɔbɔ Yerusalemfoɛ nwo waen; na bɛ nu biala bɔ ɔyɛ mmerɛ ne, sɔ kyẽa ne, ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ Dawide; yeɛ Dawide awuro ama kɔyɛ kyɛ Nyameɛ, kyɛ AWURADE abɔfo bɔ oli bɛ nyunu ne.

english_verse: I am determined to wipe out every nation that attacks Jerusalem. Mourning for the One Pierced with a Spear
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔfa ngosie me nye so kyɛ ngɔbɔ maen maen amukoraa bɔ bafa koɛ baateta Yerusalem ɔ. Awuyebɔlɛ kyẽa

english_verse: I, the Lord, will make the descendants of David and the people of Jerusalem feel deep sorrow and pray when they see the one they pierced with a spear. They will mourn and weep for him, as parents weep over the death of their only child or their first-born.
translation_verse: “Ngohwie ɛlolɛ ne sufrɛ sunzum ngogua Dawide awuro ama ne Yerusalemfoɛ so, amaa ɔnate so bafa bɛ nye bato me bɔ basina me ne aso; na bekosu ye kyɛbɔ sona su ye bahorɛ ɔ, yeɛ bekosu ye hahii kyɛbɔ sona sũ ye bamuɛbaa ɔ.

english_verse: On that day the people of Jerusalem will mourn as much as everyone did for Hadad Rimmon on the flatlands near Megiddo.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, awuyebɔlɛ piri paa kɔwa Yerusalem bɔ ɔte kyɛ Hadadrimon awuyebɔlɛ wɔ Megido bɔnza nu ne.

english_verse: Everyone of each family in the land will mourn, and the men will mourn separately from the women. This includes those from the family of David, and the families of Nathan,
translation_verse: Aseɛ ne kɔbɔ awuye, abusua biala kɔbɔ ye deɛ, Dawide awuro ama b’abusua ne kɔbɔ bɛ deɛ, yeɛ bɛ ye mɔ kɔbɔ bɛ deɛ; Natan awuro abusua, bɛkɔbɔ bɛ deɛ, yeɛ bɛ ye mɔ kɔbɔ bɛ deɛ;

english_verse: In the future there will be a fountain, where David's descendants and the people of Jerusalem can wash away their sin and guilt.
translation_verse: “Sɔ kyẽa ne, bekobukye mbombonzue bɛkɔma Dawide awuro ama ne Yerusalemfoɛ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔte bɛ nwo bekofi bɔne ne efiɛ nwo.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful says: When that time comes, I will get rid of every idol in the country, and they will be forgotten forever. I will also do away with their prophets and those evil spirits that control them.
translation_verse: “Sɔ kyẽa ne, ngonunu mmosoen dumaa boso ngofi aseɛ ne aso, bɔ ɔnate so bɛngɔkaye bɛ ko ɔ; yeɛ ngotu ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne sunzum tɛɛ bo ngofi aseɛ ne aso, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: If any such prophets ever appear again, their own parents must warn them that they will die for telling lies in my name—the name of the Lord. If those prophets don't stop speaking, their parents must then kill them with a sword.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, sɛ ebie kɔso ɔhyɛ ngɔm a, ɔse ne oni bɔ bɛwole ye ɔ bekose ye kyɛ, ‘Onni kyɛ ɛtena ngoa nu ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛkã ngondombo dwirɛ wɔ AWURADE dumaa nu.’ Na sɛ ɔhyɛ ngɔm a, ɔse ne oni bɔ bɛwole ye ɔ bɛkɔfa nikyee bekosina ye.

english_verse: Those prophets will be ashamed of their so-called visions, and they won't deceive anyone by dressing like a true prophet.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ biala hyɛ ngɔm a, ye nyunu kogua ase wɔ ye nyekyire nwo, yeɛ bengowura enwiaa ataadeɛ aguasoɛ ngɔfa ngɔlakalaka mmenia.

english_verse: Instead, they will say, “I'm no prophet. I've been a farmer all my life.”
translation_verse: Na mmom ɔkɔhã kyɛ, ‘Nnde ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ, nde kuaniɛ; ofikyɛ mayɛ kua fi me ngwadaa nu.’

english_verse: And if any of them are asked why they are wounded, they will answer, “It happened at the house of some friends.” A Wounded Shepherd and Scattered Sheep
translation_verse: Na sɛ ebie bisa ye kyɛ, ‘Ngena ngena bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ sa nu ye koso ɛ?’ a, okobua kyɛ, ‘Epuralɛ bɔ bepurale me wɔ me damvo mɔ awuro ne, ye ɛne.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: My sword, wake up! Attack my shepherd and friend. Strike down the shepherd! Scatter the little sheep, and I will destroy them.
translation_verse: O ngrandɛ, dwɔso tia me mmoaenneafoɛ ne, ɔne sona bɔ ɔte me nwoniɛ ne,” Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. “Pura mmoaenneafoɛ ne, na mmoaen ne kɔbɔ aya, na ngɔkakyi me sa ngɔhɔ mmaa mmaa nemɔ aso.

english_verse: Nowhere in the land will more than a third of them be left alive.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, aseɛ ne aso amukoraa, bekohũhũ nza nu ngyɛmuɛ nyɔ, nakoso nza nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne de, bɛkɔyakyi bɛ wɔ so, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Then I will purify them and put them to the test, just as gold and silver are purified and tested. They will pray in my name, and I will answer them. I will say, “You are my people,” and they will reply, “You, Lord, are our God!”
translation_verse: Na ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko ne, ngɔfa bɛ ngɔfa see nu, ngɔpɔ bɛ nwo kyɛbɔ bɛpɔ ɛdwetɛ nwo ɔ, na ngohwi bɛ nwo kyɛbɔ betwi sikaa kɔkorɛ nwo ɔ. Bekosu bɛkɔfrɛ me dumaa, na me wora ngotie bɛ. Ngɔhã kyɛ, ‘Bɛte me maen’ na bɛ wora bɛkɔhã kyɛ, ‘AWURADE yeɛ ɔte me Nyameɛ ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: The Lord will have his day. And when it comes, everything that was ever taken from Jerusalem will be returned and divided among its people.
translation_verse: Tie, AWURADE kyẽa ne ɔ́ba, bɔ koɛ nu nzesadeɛ bɔ basesa ye wɔ wɔ nu ne, bɛkɔhyɛ ye wɔ wɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: But first, he will bring many nations to attack Jerusalem—homes will be robbed, women raped, and half of the population dragged off, though the others will be allowed to remain.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngɔboaboa maen maen mukoraa bɛ noa maa bɛkɔfa koɛ bɛkɔteta Yerusalem, bɛkɔho bɛkɔfa kuro ne, bɛkɔfẽ awuro nemɔ anu nningyein, ná bato mmrasua nemɔ mmɔnaa. Kuro ne anu ama ne, bɛkɔhye nu bue nnure bɛkɔhɔ, nakoso maen ne ngaa de, bengohu bɛ ngofi kuro ne anu.

english_verse: The Lord will attack those nations like a warrior fighting in battle.
translation_verse: Na afei AWURADE kotu kɔtengyɛ ɔne sɔ maen maen nemɔ bɛkɔɔho, kyɛbɔ ɔhone koɛ wɔ koɛ kyẽa ne ala.

english_verse: He will take his stand on the Mount of Olives east of Jerusalem, and the mountain will split in half, forming a wide valley that runs from east to west.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, ye gya kogyinagyina Olive bokaa bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ndendeneɛ so wɔ eyia afiteleɛ ne aso. Olive bokaa ne anu kodwa nyɔ kofi eyia afiteleɛ koodwu eyia atɔleɛ maa ɔkɔyɛ bɔnza kandinga paa, maa ɔnate so bokaa ne bue kɔhwe kɔhɔ sorɔ dɔ, ná ye bue koso wahwe wahɔ ngwaen dɔ.

english_verse: Then you people will escape from the Lord's mountain, through this valley, which reaches to Azal. You will run in all directions, just as everyone did when the earthquake struck in the time of King Uzziah of Judah. Afterwards, the Lord my God will appear with his holy angels.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkɔnwati bɛkɔhɔ me mmokaa nemɔ bɛ bɔnza ne anu, ofikyɛ mmokaa nemɔ bɔnza ne kɔtrɛ alaa koodwu Asal. Amba, ɛmɔkɔnwati, kyɛbɔ aseɛwosolɛ maa ɛmɔnwatili wɔ Yuda hene Yusia aberɛ so ne. Na afei AWURADE me Nyameɛ kɔwa, bɔ krongronfoɛ amukoraa bɛboka ye so ɔ.

english_verse: It will be a bright day that won't turn cloudy or cold.
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, kanea ngɔta, ɛyerɛ ngɔwa, yeɛ ɛborɔ ngogua.

english_verse: And the Lord has decided when it will happen—this time of unending day.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔyɛ kyẽa sonongo bɔ AWURADE yeɛ ɔse ɔ. Nna alehyeleɛ ɔ, yeɛ nna alesaleɛ ɔ; na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, nɔsoa ne, ɔkɔyɛ hyireinn.

english_verse: In both summer and winter, life-giving streams will flow from Jerusalem, half of them to the Dead Sea in the east and half to the Mediterranean Sea in the west.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, ngoa nzue kɔtengyɛ kofi Yerusalem; ye bue kɔhɔ eyia afiteleɛ ɛpo ne anu, yeɛ ye bue kɔhɔ eyia atɔleɛ ɛpo ne anu; na ɔkɔtengyɛ ahuhuro ne prakasua mmerɛ.

english_verse: Then there will be only one Lord who rules as King and whose name is worshiped everywhere on earth.
translation_verse: AWURADE koli hene wɔ aseɛ amukoraa so; na sɔ kyẽa ne, AWURADE kɔyɛ sonongo, yeɛ ye dumaa kɔyɛ sonongo.

english_verse: Here is what the Lord will do to those who attack Jerusalem: While they are standing there, he will make their flesh rot and their eyes fall from their sockets and their tongues drop out.
translation_verse: Na maen maen amukoraa bɔ bafa koɛ baatoa Yerusalem ne, ɛhawo he yeɛ AWURADE kɔprapra kogua bɛ so ɔ: Bɛ nwonaen kɔporɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɛtɛ gyigyi bɛ gya so ɔ, bɛ nye kɔporɔ wɔ bɛ nye tokuro ne anu, yeɛ bɛ temverema kɔporɔ wɔ bɛ noa nu.

english_verse: The Lord will make them go into a frenzy and start attacking each other,
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, AWURADE kɔma ahunundetelɛ piri kɔtɔ bɛ so, maa ɔnate so ebiala kɔpari kɔsɔ obiɛngo sa, na bɛkɔbobɔ bɛ nwo.

english_verse: until even the people of Judah turn against those in Jerusalem. This same terrible disaster will also strike every animal nearby, including horses, mules, camels, and donkeys. Finally, everything of value in the surrounding nations will be collected and brought to Jerusalem—gold, silver, and piles of clothing.
translation_verse: Na mbɔngɔ, yoma, afupɔngɔ, afunum ne ngaka mukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ asikyeleɛ nemɔ anu ne, ɛhawo bɔ ɔkɔto bɛ ne, ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ sɔ hawo ne ala. Maen maen mukoraa bɛkɔsɔne AWURADE

english_verse: Afterwards, the survivors from those nations that attacked Jerusalem will go there each year to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful, and to celebrate the Festival of Shelters.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, maen maen amukoraa bɔ bɛfale koɛ bɛɛtoale Yerusalem ne, bɛ nu ama bɔ bekonya bɛ ti bekodidi nu ne, afoɛnoa biala bɛkɔɔsɔne Ɛhene Asafo AWURADE, ná bali Asese aluolue ne.

english_verse: No rain will fall on the land of anyone in any country who refuses to go to Jerusalem to worship the King, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Na aseɛ so mmusua mukoraa, bɛ nu biala bɔ wamma Yerusalem wammanzɔne Ɛhene Asafo AWURADE nen, esue ngɔtɔ ngɔma bɛ.

english_verse: This horrible disaster will strike the Egyptians and everyone else who refuses to go there for the celebration.
translation_verse: Sɔ asohwenɛ ne yeɛ ɔkɔwa Misraim so ɔ, na maen maen amukoraa bɔ bɛmma nni Asese aluolue ne nen, sɔ asohwenɛ ne yeɛ ɔkɔto bɛ ɔ. Krongronyɛlɛ mmerɛ

english_verse: At that time the words “Dedicated to the Lord” will be engraved on the bells worn by horses. In fact, every ordinary cooking pot in Jerusalem will be just as sacred to the Lord All-Powerful as the bowls used at the altar. Any one of them will be acceptable for boiling the meat of sacrificed animals, and there will no longer be a need to sell special pots and bowls.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, kukue biala bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ne Yuda ne, ɔkɔyɛ krongron kɔma Asafo AWURADE, na sona biala bɔ ɔbɔ afɔleɛ nen, ɔkɔɔfa nu bie kɔtõ afɔleɛ naen ne wɔ nu; na sɔ kyẽa ne, Kanaanniɛ ngɔtena Asafo AWURADE awuro berɛ ko.

english_verse: I am Malachi. And this is the message that the Lord gave me for Israel. The Lord's Love for Israel
translation_verse: AWURADE noa dwirɛ bɔ ɔnate Malaki so ɔfa brɛle Yisrael ne, ye ɛhe.

english_verse: Israel, I, the Lord, have loved you. And yet you ask in what way have I loved you. Don't forget that Esau was the brother of your ancestor Jacob, but I chose Jacob
translation_verse: AWURADE nwa nyoo, “Mahuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ.” Nakoso ɛmɔbisa kyɛ, “Atee beni aso yeɛ ahuro yɛ dwirɛ ɔ?” Yisɔ, aso nna Yakob aliɛma ɔ?” AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. “Nakoso ngurole Yakob dwirɛ,

english_verse: instead of Esau. And I turned Esau's hill country into a barren desert where jackals roam.
translation_verse: yeɛ mbɔle Yisɔ ɔ. Mama ye mmokaa nemɔ aso ayɛ pralaa, yeɛ mafa ye agyapadeɛ ne mawura ɛserɛ so ngyea bɛ sa.”

english_verse: Esau's descendants may say, “Although our nation Edom is in ruins, we will rebuild it.” But I, the Lord All-Powerful, promise to tear down whatever they build. Then everyone will know that I will never stop being angry with them as long as they are so sinful.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Edom kã kyɛ, “Babɔ yɛ maen ne de, nakoso yɛkosa yɛkosi bɔ badwiri bagua ne” a, bɔ Asafo AWURADE ɔkã ole kyɛ, “Bekosi de, nakoso ngodwiri ngogua. Na mmenia kɔto bɛ dumaa kyɛ, “Amumuyɛɛfoɛ maen,” ne “Maen bɔ AWURADE afɛ bɛ so yaa afebɔɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: Israel, when you see this, you will shout, “The Lord's great reputation reaches beyond our borders.” Judgment against Priests
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ nye konwu ye, na ɛmɔkose kyɛ, “AWURADE ye piri ne, ɔtrɛ kɔ Yisrael wɛen ne asi dɔ!”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something to say to you priests. Children respect their fathers, and servants respect their masters. I am your father and your master, so why don't you respect me? You priests have insulted me, and now you ask, “How did we insult you?”
translation_verse: Baa di ɔse ni, yeɛ akoaa di ye mene ni. Na sɛ nde Seɛ de a, né nzaade m’anidie wɔ nisua? Na sɛ nde meneɛ de a, né nzaade esurolɛ bɔ besuro me ne ɔwɔ nisua? Ɛmɔ, asɔfo mɔ bɔ ɛmɔbu me dumaa animtia ɔ, bɔ Asafo AWURADE ose ɛmɔ hɔ ɛne. Nakoso ɛmɔbisa kyɛ, ‘Atee beni aso yeɛ yabu wɔ dumaa animtia ɔ?’

english_verse: You embarrass me by offering worthless food on my altar. Then you ask, “How have we embarrassed you?” You have done it by saying, “What's so great about the Lord's altar?”
translation_verse: Ɛmɔfa aleɛ bɔ ye nwo agua efiɛ ɔ bɛbɔ afɔleɛ wɔ m’afɔleɛ bokyea so, nakoso ɛmɔbisa kyɛ, ‘Atee beni aso yeɛ yagua wɔ nwo fiɛ ɔ?’ Ye ole kyɛ, ɛmɔdwene kyɛ AWURADE poen ne de, ɛkora bu ye animtia.

english_verse: But isn't it wrong to offer animals that are blind, lame, or sick? Just try giving those animals to your governor. That certainly wouldn't please him or make him want to help you.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔfa kaka anyesiniwaa bɛbabɔ afɔleɛ a, aso ɔtte bɔne hɔ ɔ? Yeɛ sɛ ɛmɔfa kaka agyabuburuwaa anaa bɔ ɔnde apɔ ɔ bɛbabɔ afɔleɛ a, aso ɔtte bɔne hɔ ɔ? Nzaade fa kɔma w’amrado nea! Aso ɛkɔsɔ ye nye, anaa ɔkɔnea wɔ nyunu anaa? Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I am the Lord God All-Powerful, and you had better try to please me. You have sinned. Now see if I will have mercy on any of you.
translation_verse: Nzaade, mesrɛ ɛmɔ, ɛ́mɔsrɛ Nyameɛ ma ɔlo yɛ e! Na sɛ akyɛdeɛ bɔ otira ɛmɔ sa nu hɔ ɛne a, ye de ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né walo ɛmɔ? Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I wish someone would lock the doors of my temple, so you would stop wasting time building fires on my altar. I am not pleased with you priests, and I refuse to accept any more of your offerings.
translation_verse: O, ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ ɔkɔɔtoto anoa nemɔ anu ɔ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔangɔ anzɔ m’afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso see mbaen. Me kunu ndwo wɔ ɛmɔ nwo, yeɛ mengole ɛmɔ sa nu afɔleɛ ne, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: But even you priests insult me by saying, “There's nothing special about the Lord's altar, and these sacrifices are worthless.”
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔagua ye nwo fiɛ, bɔ ɛmɔnwa: AWURADE poen ne anwo agua efiɛ, ɛkora bu so nningyein ne so aleɛ po animtia.

english_verse: You get so disgusted that you even make vulgar signs at me. And for an offering, you bring stolen animals or those that are lame or sick. Should I accept these?
translation_verse: Ɛmɔsa bɛkã kyɛ, Eh, nzikyɛ ɛfɛɛ ɛhe? Na ɛmɔsobi bɛ noa begua so, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Kaka bɔ ɛmɔali aminɛ banya ye, anaa kaka bɔ wabubu, anaa bɔ ɔnde apɔ ɔ yeɛ ɛmɔfa bɛbabɔ afɔleɛ ɔ. Aso odi kyɛ mede ɛhe mefi ɛmɔ berɛ anaa? Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Instead of offering the acceptable animals you have promised, you bring me those that are unhealthy. I will punish you for this, because I am the great King, the Lord All-Powerful, and I am worshiped by nations everywhere.
translation_verse: Musue to nnakannaka sona bɔ ɔfa kaka nyii bɔ ɔwɔ ye mmoaen kure nu ɔ ɔhyɛ bɔ, nakoso ɔfa bɔ wali nnɛen ɔ ɔbɔ afɔleɛ ma AWURADE ɔ. Ofikyɛ nde Ɛhene piri, na me dumaa nwo suronyi tɔ maen maen mɔ so, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, have something else to say to you priests.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔ, asɔfo mɔ, sɔ ahyɛdeɛ he, ɔkɔ ma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: You had better take seriously the need to honor my name. Otherwise, when you give a blessing, I will turn it into a curse. In fact, I have already done this, because you haven't taken to heart your duties as priests.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔanyɛ sotie, yeɛ sɛ ɛmɔamva banzie ɛmɔ ahone nu kyɛ ɛmɔkɔfa animnyam bɛkɔma me dumaa a, ngɔprapra musue ngogua ɛmɔ so, na ngɔnoma ɛmɔ saleɛ ne, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne; yoo, manoma bɛ dada, ofikyɛ ɛmɔmva benzie ɛmɔ ahone nu.

english_verse: I will punish your descendants and rub your faces in the manure from your animal sacrifices, and then be done with you.
translation_verse: Tie, ngohwi ɛmɔ bosofoɛ bɛ nyunu, na ngɔfa bondua ngɔpete ɛmɔ nyunu, ɛmɔ aluolue ngaka bondua ne, na bekogyi ɛmɔ ne bondua ne bekogua.

english_verse: I am telling you this, so I can continue to keep my agreement with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me yeɛ nzomane maa bɛfale sɔ mmeraa dwirɛ ne bɛbrɛle ɛmɔ ɔ, amaa ɔnate so me ne Lewi apam ne watindim, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I blessed him with a full life, as I had promised, and he kept his part of the agreement by honoring me and respecting my name.
translation_verse: M’apam ne yɛle ngoa ne asomdwee mane ye, na mva mane ye kyɛ osuro. Osurole me, na me dumaa nwo suronyi tɔle ye so.

english_verse: He taught the truth and never told lies, and he led a lot of people to turn from sin, because he obeyed me and lived right.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ mmeraa ne yɛle ye noa dwirɛ, na amumuyɛɛ biala wamvite ye noa. Asomdwee ne pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ nu yeɛ ɔne me natele ɔ, na ɔmane mmeni pee bɛyakyili amumuyɛɛyɔlɛ.

english_verse: You priests should be eager to spread knowledge, and everyone should come to you for instruction, because you speak for me, the Lord All-Powerful.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, bɔ odi kyɛ ofite ɔsɔfo noa ole nimdeɛ, na ye noa dwirɛ nu yeɛ odi kyɛ mmenia bɛpena mmeraa ne ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔte Asafo AWURADE bɔfoɛ.

english_verse: But you have turned your backs on me. Your teachings have led others to do sinful things, and you have broken the agreement I made with your ancestor Levi.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔali makyebu bafi atee ne aso; ɛmɔafa ɛmɔ noa dwirɛ bama mmeni pee basoti bafi mmeraa ne anwo; ɛmɔagua Lewi apam ne anwo fiɛ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: So I caused everyone to hate and despise you, because you disobeyed me and failed to treat all people alike. A Broken Agreement
translation_verse: Yiti, me koso, maprapra animguaseɛ magua ɛmɔ so, yeɛ mabrɛ ɛmɔ ase wɔ maen maen amukoraa bɛ nyunu, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔmva m’atee so, ná mmom ɛmɔbua ndɛengyea ne ala.” Yisrael anni nahorɛ amma Nyameɛ

english_verse: Don't you know that we all have God as our Father? Didn't the one God create each of us? Then why do you cheat each other by breaking the agreement God made with your ancestors?
translation_verse: Aso nna Seɛ komapɛ yeɛ yɛ mukoraa yɛle ye ɔ? Aso nna Nyameɛ komapɛ yeɛ ɔbɔle yɛ ɔ? Na ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ ebiala pepɛ ngondombo okyire obiɛngo, bɔ yɛfa yɛgua yɛ nana mɔ apam ne anwo fiɛ ɔ?

english_verse: You people in Judah and Jerusalem have been unfaithful to the Lord. You have disgraced the temple that he loves, and you have committed the disgusting sin of marrying the worshipers of other gods.
translation_verse: Yuda anni nahorɛ, na bɛbɔ akyiwadeɛ bra wɔ Yisrael ne Yerusalem; ofikyɛ AWURADE nekaa krongron bɔ ɔla ye ahone nwo ne, Yuda agua ye nwo fiɛ, na wagya bosoen ɛwɔfoɛ bie ɔwa brasua.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will no longer let those who are guilty belong to his people, even if they eagerly decide to offer the Lord a gift.
translation_verse: Na bienzua biala bɔ ɔyɔ sɔ, kyɛ okyirekyire oo, anaa osua oo, AWURADE konua ye boso ama mukoraa bɛ bo kofi Yakob ɛtena sua nu, bɔ ebiala ngɔha bɔ ɔkɔfa afɔleɛ kɔbrɛ Asafo AWURADE ɔ.

english_verse: And what else are you doing? You cry noisily and flood the Lord's altar with your tears, because he isn't pleased with your offerings and refuses to accept them.
translation_verse: Nikyee bieku bɔ ɛmɔsa bɛyɔ ɛhe: ɛmɔfa ɛmoenporolɛ, esuɛ ne awuyebɔlɛ bɛkata AWURADE afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso; ofikyɛ onne afɔleɛ ne ndo nu ko, yeɛ ye nye nzɔ bɔ ofi ɛmɔ berɛ ne ko.

english_verse: And why isn't God pleased? It's because he knows that each of you men has been unfaithful to the wife you married when you were young. You promised that she would be your partner, but now you have broken that promise.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔbisa kyɛ, “Nzu ati ɔ?” Hmmm, ofikyɛ, ɛne wɔ mmerandeɛ nu braa ɛmɔ agyaa ne, AWURADE te nu danzeniɛ. Nakoso anni nahorɛ amma ye, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɔte w’anwokaniɛ ne w’apam braa de.

english_verse: Didn't God create you and your wife to become like one person? And why did he do this? It was so you would have children, and then lead them to become God's people. Don't ever be unfaithful to your wife.
translation_verse: Aso Nyameɛ wanyɔ ɛmɔ sona komapɛ bɔ ngoa sunzum wɔ ɛmɔ nu ɔ? Na nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔpena ɔ? Kyɛ ɛmɔkɔwo mmaa bɔ Nyameɛ surolɛ wɔ bɛ nu ɔ. Yiti ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ ɛmɔ sunzum nwo, na nnɛma ebiala fa ye mmerandeɛ nu braa ɔfa nnakannaka atee so.

english_verse: The Lord God All-Powerful of Israel hates anyone who is cruel enough to divorce his wife. So take care never to be unfaithful!
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mekyi agyaayiralɛ, AWURADE Yisrael Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɛne; yeɛ sona bɔ ɔfa nzɛmmɔne kata ye tena so ɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Yiti ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ ɛmɔ sunzum nwo, ná ɛmɔammɔ sɔ nnakannaka bra ne.

english_verse: You have worn out the Lord with your words. And yet, you ask, “How did we do that?” You did it by saying, “The Lord is pleased with evil and doesn't care about justice.”
translation_verse: Ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ dwirɛ bedwane AWURADE so anu. Nakoso ɛmɔnwa, “Atee beni aso yeɛ yadwane ye so anu ɔ?” Bɔ ɛmɔkã ne, ye ɛhe: “Ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne ne, ɔte paa wɔ AWURADE nyunu, na ode ye to nu.” Yeɛ ɛmɔbisa kyɛ, “Nyameɛ bɔ obua ndɛen ne, ɔwɔ nisua?”

english_verse: I, the Lord All-Powerful, will send my messenger to prepare the way for me. Then suddenly the Lord you are looking for will appear in his temple. The messenger you desire is coming with my promise, and he is on his way. A Day of Change
translation_verse: “Tie, mebaasoma me bɔfoɛ maa odi me nyunu osiesie atee nu. Na AWURADE bɔ ɛmɔpena ye ne, bɔ ye ole apam bɔfoɛ bɔ ɔla ɛmɔ ahone nwo ne, ɔkɔhɔ ye asɔneyɛɛ sua nu mvum nu. Tie, ɔ́ba, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: On the day the Lord comes, he will be like a furnace that purifies silver or like strong soap in a washbasin. No one will be able to stand up to him.
translation_verse: Nakoso kyẽa bɔ ɔ́ba ne, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina ye noa ɔ? Ɔye ye nwo ali a, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina ye nyunu ɔ? “Ofikyɛ ɔte kyɛ sona bɔ ohuro buralɛ ɔ ye see ne, ɔne bɔ ɔkɔ atapoɛ ɔ ye saminaen;

english_verse: The Lord will purify the descendants of Levi, as though they were gold or silver. Then they will bring the proper offerings to the Lord,
translation_verse: ɔkɔtena ase kyɛ dwumvoɛ bɔ ohuro ɛdwetɛ ɔye ye nwo fiɛ ɔ: ɔkɔte Lewi boso ama mɔ bɛ nwo, okohwi bɛ nwo kyɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ, amaa ɔnate so bafa tenenee afɔleɛ babrɛ AWURADE.

english_verse: and the offerings of the people of Judah and Jerusalem will please him, just as they did in the past. Don't Cheat God
translation_verse: Na afei, Yuda ne Yerusalem b’afɔleɛ kɔsɔ AWURADE nye kyɛ daa tete mmerɛ afoɛ mɔ bɔ bapɛ nu bahɔ deɛ ne ala.

english_verse: The Lord All-Powerful said: I'm now on my way to judge you. And I will quickly condemn all who practice witchcraft or cheat in marriage or tell lies in court or rob workers of their pay or mistreat widows and orphans or steal the property of foreigners or refuse to respect me.
translation_verse: “Na afei ngɔhwe ngopingye ɛmɔ ngobua ndɛen. Ngoli adanzeɛ ndɛndɛ so ngotia ngonyaayelɛfoɛ, agyaasɛkyelɛfoɛ, bɛ bɔ bɛta ngondombo ndaen, bɛ bɔ besisi paafoɛ wɔ b’akatuaa nwo, bɛ bɔ bedi kunafoɛ ne nyisiaa aminɛ, bɛ bɔ besisi ɛwɔfoɛ ná benzuro me ɔ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Descendants of Jacob, I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I never change. That's why you haven't been wiped out,
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ me, AWURADE, menzesã; yiti ɛmɔ, Yakob boso ama, ɛmɔ boso ngonua.

english_verse: even though you have ignored and disobeyed my laws ever since the time of your ancestors. But if you return to me, I will return to you. And yet you ask, “How can we return?”
translation_verse: Ofi ɛmɔ nana mɔ aberɛ so yeɛ ɛmɔali me nhyehyɛleɛ nwo makyebu bɔ ɛmɔanni so ɔ. Ɛ́mɔsa bɛbra me berɛ, na me koso ngosa ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Nakoso ɛmɔnwa: ‘Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né yasa yawa?’

english_verse: You people are robbing me, your God. And, here you are, asking, “How are we robbing you?” You are robbing me of the offerings and of the ten percent that belongs to me.
translation_verse: Aso odi kyɛ sona di Nyameɛ ndurum anaa? Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔdi me ndurum. Na ɛmɔbisa kyɛ, ‘Atee beni aso yeɛ yɛdi wɔ ndurum ɔ?’ Ɛmɔdi ye wɔ buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ɔne afɔleɛbɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: That's why your whole nation is under a curse.
translation_verse: Ɛnomalɛ yeɛ mafa manoma ɛmɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔdi me ndurum, mekyire maen ne amukoraa.

english_verse: I am the Lord All-Powerful, and I challenge you to put me to the test. Bring the entire ten percent into the storehouse, so there will be food in my house. Then I will open the windows of heaven and flood you with blessing after blessing.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne amukoraa bɛbra nekaa bɔ besie nningyein ne, amaa ɔnate so aleɛ awa m’awuro. Ɛ́mɔfa béso me bɛ́nea, sɛ mengobukye nyameɛso mboma mengɔma ɛmɔ a, sɛ mengohwie saleɛ ngogua ɛmɔ so ma ongobu ngɔfa so a, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: I will also stop locusts from destroying your crops and keeping your vineyards from producing.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ ti ngosi sɛkyefoɛ ne ate, amaa ɔnate so wanzɛkye ɛmɔ aseɛ so aleɛ ne; yeɛ ɛmɔ fieso bobe amui ne ngɔporo ngogua, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: Everyone of every nation will talk about how I have blessed you and about your wonderful land. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Na afei, maen maen amukoraa bɛkɔfrɛ ɛmɔ Bɛ bɔ Banya Saleɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔkɔyɛ anika maen, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: You have said horrible things about me, and yet you ask, “What have we said?”
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔkekã edwirɛ yeayea betia me, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Nakoso ɛmɔbisa kyɛ, ‘Nzikyɛ dwirɛ yealɛ yeɛ yahã yatia wɔ ɔ?’

english_verse: Here is what you have said: “It's foolish to serve the Lord God All-Powerful. What do we get for obeying God and from going around looking sad?
translation_verse: Ɛmɔahã kyɛ, ‘Ɔte mbaen kyɛ sona kɔso Nyameɛ ɔ. Mvasoɛ beni yeɛ ɔwɔ so kyɛ yɛkoli ye nhyehyɛleɛ so, ɔne kyɛ yɛkɔnate Asafo AWURADE nyunu wɔ nnuhoɛ nu ɔ?

english_verse: See how happy those arrogant people are. Everyone who does wrong is successful, and when they put God to the test, they always get away with it.” Faithfulness Is Rewarded
translation_verse: Na afei de, yɛbu ahandaenfoɛ kyɛ bɛ yeɛ banya saleɛ ɔ; amba, bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ bra tɛɛ ne yeɛ benya ngɔsoɛ ɔ; amba, bɛ bɔ beso Nyameɛ bɛnea ne yeɛ benya bɛ ti bedidi nu ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: All those who truly respected the Lord and honored his name started discussing these things, and when God saw what was happening, he had their names written as a reminder in his book.
translation_verse: Yeɛ bɛ bɔ besuro AWURADE ne, bedwudwo behyirehyirele bɛ nwo. AWURADE yɛle asoɛ tiele, na ɔtele; na bɛ bɔ besuro AWURADE ná bedi ye dumaa ni ne, bɛhyerɛle bɛ dumaa wɔ ngayeɛ nwomaa nu wɔ AWURADE nyunu.

english_verse: Then the Lord All-Powerful said: You people are precious to me, and when I come to bring justice, I will protect you, just as parents protect an obedient child.
translation_verse: Asafo AWURADE nwa nyoo: Kyẽa bɔ ngobua ndɛen ne, bɛkɔyɛ me bɔbɔ me deɛ, na ngonwu bɛ anwumvoin kyɛbɔ seɛ onwu ɔwa bɔ ɔso ye ɔ anwumvoin ɔ.

english_verse: Then everyone will once again see the difference between those who obey me by doing right and those who reject me by doing wrong.
translation_verse: Na afei ɛmɔkosa bɛkɔwa, na ɛmɔkonwu nzonzoleɛ bɔ ɔla teneneeniɛ ne bɔnefoɛ b’afia ɔ, yeɛ bɔ ɔla sona bɔ ɔso Nyameɛ ne bɔ ɔnzo ye ɔ b’afia ɔ.

english_verse: The day of judgment is certain to come. And it will be like a red-hot furnace with flames that burn up proud and sinful people, as though they were straw. Not a branch or a root will be left. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Tie, kyẽa ne ɔ́ba bɔ ɔkɔyera kyɛ foonoo ɔ; na amba, ahandaenfoɛ amukoraa, bɛ ne bɔnefoɛ biala bɛkɔyɛ ngyɛngyɛma. Na kyẽa bɔ ɔbaawa ne, ɔkɔyera bɛ, bɔ ɔngɔyakyi bɛ ndii anaa bɛ mmaen ɔ, AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: But for you that honor my name, victory will shine like the sun with healing in its rays, and you will jump around like calves at play.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsuro me dumaa ne de, tenenee eyia bɔ anwonyerɛsalɛ wɔ ye ndaa nu ɔ okopukye kɔma ɛmɔ; na ɛmɔkofite bekohuru bɛkɔpepe kyɛ nandwie akrɔngrɔma mɔ bɔ babukye bɛ bafi bɛ tuin nu ɔ.

english_verse: When I come to bring justice, you will trample those who are evil, as though they were ashes under your feet. I, the Lord All-Powerful, have spoken!
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔkotiatia bɔnefoɛ mɔ so; ofikyɛ kyẽa bɔ ngɔyɔ sɔ ne, bɛkɔyɛ nzoen wɔ ɛmɔ gya bo, Asafo AWURADE noa dwirɛ ɛne. Kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne bɔhyɛlɛ

english_verse: Don't ever forget the laws and teachings I gave my servant Moses on Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: “Me somvoɛ Mose mmeraa, nhyehyɛleɛ ne ahyɛdeɛ bɔ nhyɛle ye wɔ Horebo mva mane Yisrael amukoraa ne, odi kyɛ ɛmɔkaye.

english_verse: I, the Lord, promise to send the prophet Elijah before that great and terrible day comes.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, ngɔsoma ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Elia wɔ ɛmɔ berɛ koraka né AWURADE kyẽa piri bɔ ɔyɛ suro ne wawa.

english_verse: He will lead children and parents to love each other more, so that when I come, I won't bring destruction to the land.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔma mmaa mɔ bɛkɔla seɛ mɔ b’ahone nwo, ná seɛ mɔ koso bala mmaa mɔ b’ahone nwo, amaa ɔnate so mamma mambrapra ɛnomalɛ mangua aseɛ ne aso.”

english_verse: “A virgin will have a baby boy, and he will be called Immanuel,” which means “God is with us.”
translation_verse: “Tie, ababunu ne kɔnwonzɛ kɔwo baa bienzua, na bɛkɔto ye dumaa Yimanuel, .”

english_verse: more to the birth of the Messiah. The Birth of Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: Asɔre wole Sadoke; Sadoke wole Akim, na Akim wole Elihude.

english_verse: This is how Jesus Christ was born. A young woman named Mary was engaged to Joseph from King David's family. But before they were married, she learned that she was going to have a baby by God's Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ besi bɛwole Yesu Kristo nwo dwirɛ ɛhe: Bɛfale oni Maria bɛbɔle Yosef asiwa. Wangɔ agyaa bo, na benwuni kyɛ ɔnate Sunzum Krongron so ɔnwonzɛ.

english_verse: Joseph was a good man and did not want to embarrass Mary in front of everyone. So he decided to quietly call off the wedding.
translation_verse: Né ohu Yosef te sona bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ, na né onguro kyɛ okogua Maria nyunu ase ne ati, ɔyɛle ye adwene kyɛ okoyira ye kudɛɛ.

english_verse: While Joseph was thinking about this, an angel from the Lord appeared to him in a dream. The angel said, “Joseph, the baby that Mary will have is from the Holy Spirit. Go ahead and marry her.
translation_verse: Na ogu so ɔfa ɛhe nwo adwene ne, Awurade abɔfo yele ye nwo ali hyirele ye wɔ laleɛ nu, na osele ye kyɛ, “Yosef, Dawide bosoniɛ, nnɛsuro kyɛ ɛkɔfa ɛye Maria ɛkɔwa w’awuro ɔ; ɔnate kyɛ bɔ ɔnwonzɛ ye ne ofi Sunzum Krongron nu.

english_verse: Then after her baby is born, name him Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.”
translation_verse: Ɔkɔwo baa bienzua, né ato ye dumaa Yesu, ɔnate kyɛ ye yeɛ okole ye mmenia kofi bɛ bɔne nu ɔ.”

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said,
translation_verse: Na ɛhe amukoraa sili maa bɔ Awurade nate ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne aso hane ne wale nu. Ɔhane kyɛ,

english_verse: After Joseph woke up, he and Mary were soon married, just as the Lord's angel had told him to do.
translation_verse: Na Yosef tingyele fili nnaa nu ne, ɔyɔle bɔ Awurade abɔfo ne hyɛle ye kyɛ ɔyɔ ne, na ɔɔfale ɔye ne wale awuro.

english_verse: But they did not sleep together before her baby was born. Then Joseph named him Jesus.
translation_verse: Nakoso Yosef ne ye banna maa odwuli kyɛ ɔwole bamuɛbaa bienzua ɔ, na Yosef tole ye dumaa Yesu.

english_verse: When Jesus was born in the village of Bethlehem in Judea, Herod was king. During this time some wise men from the east came to Jerusalem
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ bɛwole Yesu wɔ Betlehem bɔ ɔwɔ Yudea, wɔ ɛhene Herode aberɛ so nen, nworɛfoɛ biemɔ fili eyia afiteleɛ maen nu dɔ bɛwale Yerusalem,

english_verse: and said, “Where is the child born to be king of the Jews? We saw his star in the east and have come to worship him.”
translation_verse: na bebisale kyɛ, “Yudafoɛ hene bɔ bawo ye ne, nisua yeɛ ɔwɔ ɔ? Ofikyɛ yanwu ye nzramaa wɔ eyia afiteleɛ dɔ, na yawa kyɛ yɛbaasɔne ye.”

english_verse: When King Herod heard about this, he was worried, and so was everyone else in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na ɛhene Herode tele edwirɛ he nen, ɔhale ye, Yerusalemfoɛ amukoraa koso sɔ ala.

english_verse: Herod brought together the chief priests and the teachers of the Law of Moses and asked them, “Where will the Messiah be born?”
translation_verse: Yiti ɔfrɛfrɛle maen ne anu asɔfo mbanyi ne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ amukoraa maa beeyiale, na obisale bɛ penane neka horɛ bɔ bɛkɔwo Kristo ne ɔ.

english_verse: They told him, “He will be born in Bethlehem, just as the prophet wrote,
translation_verse: Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Betlehem bɔ ɔwɔ Yudea; na sɔ yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne wahyerɛ ɔ, kyɛ,

english_verse: ‘Bethlehem in the land of Judea, you are very important among the towns of Judea. From your town will come a leader, who will be like a shepherd for my people Israel.’ ”
translation_verse: ‘Wɔ, Betlehem bɔ ɛwɔ Yuda aseɛ so ɔ, wɔ dibea wɔ Yuda atitirefoɛ nu ɔtte ba; ɔnate kyɛ wɔ nu yeɛ maenbulɛniɛ bɔ ɔbaanea me maen Yisrael so ne okofi kɔwa ɔ.’ ”

english_verse: Herod secretly called in the wise men and asked them when they had first seen the star.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Herode frɛle nworɛfoɛ nemɔ kudɛɛ, na obisale bɛ mmerɛ deinn bɔ nzramaa ne fitele ɔ.

english_verse: He told them, “Go to Bethlehem and search carefully for the child. As soon as you find him, let me know. I also want to go and worship him.”
translation_verse: Afei ɔsomane bɛ Betlehem, na osele kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ, ná ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye boro bɛpena akwadaa ne; na sɛ ɛmɔnwu ye a, ɛmɔɔbɔ me amaneɛ, ná me koso ngɔnzɔne ye bie.”

english_verse: The wise men listened to what the king said and then left. And the star they had seen in the east went on ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.
translation_verse: Betiele ɛhene ne dwirɛ ne beyiele, ná besili nu kyɛ bɛkɔ nen, yieee, nzramaa bɔ benwuni ye wɔ eyia afiteleɛ dɔ ne lili bɛ nyunu moa alaa oogyinane nekaa bɔ adɔma ne la ne ye anwuro.

english_verse: They were thrilled and excited to see the star.
translation_verse: Na benwuni nzramaa ne nen, ɔyɛle bɛ fɛ soma.

english_verse: When the men went into the house and saw the child with Mary, his mother, they knelt down and worshiped him. They took out their gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh and gave them to him.
translation_verse: Na bɛworole awuro ne anu nen, benwuni adɔma ne ne oni Maria, na bɛkotole bɛsɔnene ye. Afei bɛsangyele bɛ nningyein nu, na bɛhyɛle ye esikaa kɔkorɛ, ayirefona ne korobo.

english_verse: Later they were warned in a dream not to return to Herod, and they went back home by another road. The Escape to Egypt
translation_verse: Né babɔ bɛ kɔkɔ wɔ laleɛ nu kyɛ nnɛmaa besa bɛkɔ Herode dɔ ko, yiti bɛfale atee foforɛ so besa bɛhɔle bɛ maen nu. Yosef fa adɔma ne nwati kɔ Misraim

english_verse: After the wise men had gone, an angel from the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream and said, “Get up! Hurry and take the child and his mother to Egypt! Stay there until I tell you to return, because Herod is looking for the child and wants to kill him.”
translation_verse: Nworɛfoɛ nemɔ hɔle ne asi ne, yieee, Awurade abɔfo yele ye nwo ali wɔ laleɛ nu hyirele Yosef, na osele ye kyɛ, “Herode pena akwadaa ne ku ye, yiti dwɔso fa akwadaa ne ne oni nwati kɔ Misraim, ná tena dɔ maa oodwu kyɛ ngose wɔ kyɛ esa bra ɔ.”

english_verse: That night, Joseph got up and took his wife and the child to Egypt,
translation_verse: Na odwɔsole nen, ɔfale akwadaa ne ne oni bokale ye nwo so, na ofili berɛ hɔle Misraim.

english_verse: where they stayed until Herod died. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “I called my son out of Egypt.” The Killing of the Children
translation_verse: Ɔtenane dɔ maa oodwuli kyɛ ɛhene Herode wuli ɔ. Na ɛhe mane bɔ Awurade nate ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne so hane ne wale nu kyɛ, “Mafrɛ mma bienzua mafi Misraim.” Herode kuku ngwadaammaa wɔ Betlehem

english_verse: When Herod found out that the wise men from the east had tricked him, he was very angry. He gave orders for his men to kill all the boys who lived in or near Bethlehem and were two years old and younger. This was based on what he had learned from the wise men.
translation_verse: Na Herode nwuni kyɛ nworɛfoɛ nemɔ balakalaka ye nen, ɔfɛle yaa hahii. Na ɔsomane maa beehuhuni ngwadaa mmienzua amukoraa bɔ bali afoɛ nyɔ ne bɛ bɔ bendwu ɔ, bɔ bɛwɔ Betlehem ne ye mbɔtam amukoraa; kyɛbɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔtele dwirɛ ne fili nworɛfoɛ nemɔ berɛ ne osi kyire ne.

english_verse: So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet Jeremiah had said,
translation_verse: Na ɛhe mane ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yeremia dwirɛ bɔ ɔhane ne wale nu kyɛ,

english_verse: “In Ramah a voice was heard crying and weeping loudly. Rachel was mourning for her children, and she refused to be comforted, because they were dead.” The Return from Egypt
translation_verse: “Bɛtele komviɛ bie wɔ Rama, awuye ne esuɛ hahii, Rahɛl sũ ye mma; Bɛkyekye ye wora a ondie, ofikyɛ bɛnne berɛ ko.” Yosef fi Misraim sa ba Nasarɛte

english_verse: After King Herod died, an angel from the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph while he was still in Egypt.
translation_verse: Herode wue asi ne, yieee, Awurade abɔfo yele ye nwo ali wɔ laleɛ nu hyirele Yosef wɔ Misraim

english_verse: The angel said, “Get up and take the child and his mother back to Israel. The people who wanted to kill him are now dead.”
translation_verse: sele kyɛ, “Dwɔso, fa akwadaa ne ne oni sa kɔ Yisrael aseɛ so, ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ né bɛpena akwadaa ne beku ye ne, bawu.”

english_verse: Joseph got up and left with them for Israel.
translation_verse: Yiti Yosef dwɔsole fale akwadaa ne ne oni bokale ye nwo so, na osa wale Yisrael aseɛ so.

english_verse: But when he heard that Herod's son Archelaus was now ruler of Judea, he was afraid to go there. Then in a dream he was told to go to Galilee,
translation_verse: Nakoso Yosef tele kyɛ Arkelao yeɛ wali ɔse Herode bia wayɛ Yudea hene nen, osurole kyɛ ɔkɔhɔ berɛ ɔ. Nyameɛ ye hyirele ye wɔ laleɛ nu, yiti ɔhɔle Galilea manzini nu.
