english_verse: and they went to live there in the town of Nazareth. So the Lord's promise came true, just as the prophet had said, “He will be called a Nazarene.”
translation_verse: Na ɔhɔle kuro bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Nasarɛte so ɔɔtenane berɛ. Na ɛhe mane bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ hane ne wale nu kyɛ, “Bɛkɔfrɛ ye Nasarɛteniɛ.”

english_verse: Do something to show you have really given up your sins.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ okyire kyɛ ɛmɔasakyera ɛmɔ adwene amba ɔ.

english_verse: He said, “Turn back to God! The kingdom of heaven will soon be here.”
translation_verse: Ɔnwa, “Ɛ́mɔsakyera ɛmɔ adwene, ofikyɛ nyameɛso ahennie ne apingye!”

english_verse: John wore clothes made of camel's hair. He had a leather strap around his waist and ate grasshoppers and wild honey.
translation_verse: Né Yohane wura afupɔngɔ nwiaa ataadeɛ, na né ɔbɔ nwomaa abɔsoɛ. Aleɛ bɔ né odi ole mmɛbɛ mbiri ne woɛ.

english_verse: From Jerusalem and all Judea and from the Jordan River Valley crowds of people went to John.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ befi Yerusalem, Yudea amukoraa ne bɛ bɔ befi Yɔɔdan nwo amukoraa bebiri bɛwale ye berɛ;

english_verse: They told how sorry they were for their sins, and he baptized them in the river.
translation_verse: na bɛhane bɛ bɔne maa ɔbɔle bɛ asu wɔ asue Yɔɔdan nu.

english_verse: Many Pharisees and Sadducees also came to be baptized. But John said to them: You bunch of snakes! Who warned you to run from the coming judgment?
translation_verse: Na onwuni kyɛ Farasiifoɛ ne Sadusiifoɛ nemɔ anu pee bɛba maa ɔbɔ bɛ asu nen, osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ewoo mmaa bɔ ɔte kyɛ ɛmɔ ɔ! Nwa yeɛ otuli ɛmɔ foɛ paa kyɛ ɛ́mɔnwati béfi ahonehulɛ bɔ ɔba ne anu ɔ?

english_verse: An ax is ready to cut the trees down at their roots. Any tree that doesn't produce good fruit will be chopped down and thrown into a fire.
translation_verse: Bafa akumaa ne babɔ bakaa ne ndii nu dada. Yiti bakaa biala bɔ onzu mmaa paa ne, bekobu ye, ná bagyi bato see nu.

english_verse: His threshing fork is in his hand, and he is ready to separate the wheat from the husks. He will store the wheat in a barn and burn the husks in a fire that never goes out. The Baptism of Jesus (Mark
translation_verse: Otira ye huhuamoa nu; ɔkɔprapra ye nekaa bɔ ɔboro aburoo ne monomono. Ɔkɔboaboa ye aburoo ne noa kogua pata so, nakoso afafu ne de, ɔkɔfa see bɔ onnua le ɔ yeɛ ɔkɔyera ye ɔ.” Yohane bɔ Yesu asu (Marko

english_verse: Jesus left Galilee and went to the Jordan River to be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu fili Galilea wale Yohane berɛ wɔ Yɔɔdan noa kyɛ ɔbɔ ye asu.

english_verse: But John kept objecting and said, “I ought to be baptized by you. Why have you come to me?”
translation_verse: Yohane yɛle kyɛ ahaa osi ye ate, Ɔnwa, “Wɔ yeɛ ɛfata kyɛ ɛbɔ me asu ɔ, na afei wɔ yeɛ ɛ́ba me berɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “For now this is how it should be, because we must do all God wants us to do.” Then John agreed.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Ma ate maa yɛyɔ ye sɔ kekesaala ye, na yɛyɔ bɔ Nyameɛ ahyehyɛ ne.” Yiti Yohane penene so.

english_verse: So Jesus was baptized. And as soon as he came out of the water, the sky opened, and he saw the Spirit of God coming down on him like a dove.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ ɔbɔle Yesu asu yiele nen, Yesu fili nzue ne anu fitele pɛ, yieee, anwuro bukyele , na onwuni Nyameɛ Sunzum ne kyɛ abubure odwu ba ye so,

english_verse: Then a voice from heaven said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: na yieee, edwudwolɛ bie fili nyameɛso wale kyɛ, “Mma bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo ná me nye gye ye nwo paa ne ɛhe.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard that John had been put in prison, he went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Yesu tele kyɛ bafa Yohane bato kuku nu nen, ofili Galilea.

english_verse: But instead of staying in Nazareth, Jesus moved to Capernaum. This town was beside Lake Galilee in the territory of Zebulun and Naphtali.
translation_verse: Otu fili Nasarɛte ɔɔtenane Kapanɔm bɔ ɔwɔ mboanoa, wɔ Sebulɔn ne Nafetali mbɔtam.

english_verse: After Jesus had gone without eating for
translation_verse: Ɔhyele hɔen eleburanna, eyia ne kɔngɔen, na ɛhɔen huni ye.

english_verse: Then the devil came to him and said, “If you are God's Son, tell these stones to turn into bread.”
translation_verse: Na bɔ oso mmenia nea ne wale ye berɛ oosele ye kyɛ, “Sɛ wɔ ole Nyameɛ Awa ne a, hyɛ nyɔboɛ hemɔ ma paanoo.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “The Scriptures also say, ‘Don't try to test the Lord your God!’ ”
translation_verse: Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Bahyerɛ ye bieku kyɛ, ‘Nneso Awurade wɔ Nyameɛ nea!’ ”

english_verse: Finally, the devil took Jesus up on a very high mountain and showed him all the kingdoms on earth and their power.
translation_verse: Yeɛ abɔnzam fale ye bieku hɔle bokaa tendenn bie aso, na ohyirele ye ewiase ahennie amukoraa ne nu animnyam;

english_verse: The devil said to him, “I will give all this to you, if you will bow down and worship me.”
translation_verse: na osele ye kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛkɔkoto kɔsɔne me a, ahaa ngɔfa ɛhemɔ amukoraa ngɔma wɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Go away Satan! The Scriptures say: ‘Worship the Lord your God and serve only him.’ ”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Dwɔso berɛ kɔ dɔ, Satan! Ofikyɛ Bahyerɛ kyɛ, ‘Sɔne Awurade wɔ Nyameɛ, na ye ngome twe yeɛ so ye ɔ!’ ”

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said,
translation_verse: Na ɛhe mane ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya dwirɛ bɔ ɔhane ne wale nu kyɛ,

english_verse: “Listen, lands of Zebulun and Naphtali, lands along the road to the sea and across the Jordan. Listen Galilee, land of the Gentiles!
translation_verse: “Sebulɔn aseɛ ne Nafetali aseɛ, bɔ ɔwɔ ɛpo atee ne aso dɔ, wɔ Yɔɔdan si, Galilea bɔ ɔte Amaenmaensofoɛ aseɛ;

translation_verse: Na berɛ ne ala, bɛyakyili b’asawu nemɔ berɛ beelili ye si.

english_verse: While Jesus was walking along the shore of Lake Galilee, he saw two brothers. One was Simon, also known as Peter, and the other was Andrew. They were fishermen, and they were casting their net into the lake.
translation_verse: Né Yesu nate Galilea mboanoa, na onwuni aliɛmaa nyɔ bɔ bɛ ole Simɔn bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Petro, ɔne oliɛma Andrea kyɛ begua asawu ɛpo nu ɔ, ofikyɛ né bɛte mmenia bɔ bɛkɔ po ɔ.

english_verse: Jesus walked on until he saw James and John, the sons of Zebedee. They were in a boat with their father, mending their nets. Jesus asked them to come with him.
translation_verse: Ɔhɔle moa kãa nen, onwuni aliɛmaa nyɔ bieku, bɔ bɛ ole Sebedeo awa Yakobo ɔne oliɛma Yohane, kyɛ bɛ ne bɛ baba Sebedeo bɛte ɛlɛen nu bɛpomba b’asawu ɔ. Na ɔfrɛle bɛ.

english_verse: At once they left the boat and their father and went with Jesus. Jesus Teaches, Preaches, and Heals (Luke
translation_verse: Na berɛ ne ala, bɛyakyili ɛlɛen ne ne bɛ baba berɛ beelili ye si. Yesu ka nzɛmba na osa sa anwonyerɛ (Luka

english_verse: Jesus went all over Galilee, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the good news about God's kingdom. He also healed every kind of disease and sickness.
translation_verse: Yesu hyinini Galilea amukoraa yɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ wɔ bɛ nyianu sua nemɔ anu, ɔhane ahennie ne nwo nzɛmba ne, na ɔsale anwonyerɛ ne anwommerɛlɛ ahoroɔ wɔ maen ne anu.

english_verse: News about him spread all over Syria, and people with every kind of sickness or disease were brought to him. Some of them had a lot of demons in them, others were thought to be crazy, and still others could not walk. But Jesus healed them all.
translation_verse: Ye nwo dwirɛ trɛ hɔle Siria amukoraa, na bɛfale bɛ bɔ bɛnde apɔ amukoraa bɔ anwonyerɛ ne anwondutuo ahoroɔ ayɛ bɛ ɔ, bɛ bɔ sunzummɔne wɔ bɛ so ɔ, ɔne bɛ bɔ ɛpɛlɛ ne apreprɛ wɔ bɛ so ɔ bɛbrɛle ye, na ɔsale bɛ anwonyerɛ.

english_verse: Large crowds followed Jesus from Galilee and the region around the ten cities known as Decapolis. They also came from Jerusalem, Judea, and from across the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Na mmenia pee fili Galilea ne Dekapoli, Yerusalem, Yudea, yeɛ Yɔɔdan si dɔ beelili ye si.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the crowds, he went up on the side of a mountain and sat down. Blessings (Luke
translation_verse: Yesu nwuni ɛlɔen ne nen, ɔhɔle bokaa bie aso, na ɔtenane ase nen, ye asuafoɛ nemɔ wale ye nwo berɛ,

english_verse: You must obey God's commands better than the Pharisees and the teachers of the Law obey them. If you don't, I promise you will never get into the kingdom of heaven. Anger
translation_verse: Yiti mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔ tenenee andra ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne Farasiifoɛ deɛ a, ye de ɛmɔ gya baa ngotia nyameɛso ahennie ne anu. Ɛyaafɛlɛ nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ (Luka

english_verse: So if you are about to place your gift on the altar and remember that someone is angry with you,
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ ɛfa w’ayɛyɛdeɛ ba afɔleɛ bokyea nwo, ná berɛ ɛkaye kyɛ eliɛma ne wɔ le dwirɛ a,

english_verse: God blesses those people who depend only on him. They belong to the kingdom of heaven!
translation_verse: “Sunzum nu ehiafoɛ banya saleɛ, ofikyɛ bɛ yeɛ nyameɛso ahennie ne te bɛ deɛ ɔ.

english_verse: God blesses those people who grieve. They will find comfort!
translation_verse: “Bɛ bɔ bɛ wora abɔ ne banya saleɛ, ofikyɛ bɛ yeɛ bɛkɔkyekye bɛ wora ɔ.

english_verse: God blesses those people who are humble. The earth will belong to them!
translation_verse: “Anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ banya saleɛ, ofikyɛ bɛ yeɛ bekonya aseɛ ne maa ɔkɔyɛ b’agyapadeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: God blesses those people who are merciful. They will be treated with mercy!
translation_verse: “Bɛ bɔ benwu bɛ mmango anwumvoin ne banya saleɛ, ofikyɛ bɛ yeɛ bekonwu bɛ anwumvoin ɔ.

english_verse: God blesses those people whose hearts are pure. They will see him!
translation_verse: “Bɛ bɔ bɛ ti anu te fufue ne banya saleɛ, ofikyɛ bɛ yeɛ bekonwu Nyameɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You are the light for the whole world. A city built on top of a hill cannot be hidden,
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔte wiase kanea. Kuro bɔ ɔla bokaa so ne, ɔngora mvea.

english_verse: But I tell you not to swear by anything when you make a promise! Heaven is God's throne, so don't swear by heaven.
translation_verse: Na me de, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, Nnɛma ɛmɔta ndaen koraa. Nnɛma ɛmɔfa anwuro bɛta ndaen, ɔnate kyɛ ɔte Nyameɛ ahennie bia,

english_verse: The earth is God's footstool, so don't swear by the earth. Jerusalem is the city of the great king, so don't swear by it.
translation_verse: anaa aseɛ, ɔnate kyɛ ɔte ye gya ndiasoɛ; anaa Yerusalem, ɔnate kyɛ ɔte Ɛhene berembɔn ne kuro.

english_verse: You are the salt for everyone on earth. But if salt no longer tastes like salt, how can it make food salty? All it is good for is to be thrown out and walked on.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔte aseɛ ye aso ngyee. Nakoso sɛ ngyee nu fɛɛ tu a, nzikyɛ yeɛ bɛkɔfa bekowura ye maa okosa kɔkakyi ngyee ɔ? Bɛfa bɛyɔ hwee a ɔnyɛ yee ko, sana begyi begua maa mmenia tiatia so.

english_verse: and no one lights a lamp and puts it under a clay pot. Instead, it is placed on a lampstand, where it can give light to everyone in the house.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ bɛnzɔ kanea ná bafa bawura ɛkorɛ bo ɔ; na mmom bɛfa besie kanea bakaa so, amaa wata wama ebiala bɔ ɔwɔ awuro berɛ anwu ase.

english_verse: Don't suppose I came to do away with the Law and the Prophets. I did not come to do away with them, but to give them their full meaning.
translation_verse: “Nnɛma ɛmɔsusu kyɛ mmale kyɛ mebaatu Mose mmeraa ne ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne megua. Mamma kyɛ mebaatu megua, na mmom mmale kyɛ mebaasi bɛ pi.

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Do not murder” and “A murderer must be brought to trial.”
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔate kyɛ bɛhã behyirele mbanyi mɔ kyɛ, ‘Nnɛdi awue, na ebiala bɔ okoli awue ne okoli fɔ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ nu.’

english_verse: But I promise you if you are angry with someone, you will have to stand trial. If you call someone a fool, you will be taken to court. And if you say that someone is worthless, you will be in danger of the fires of hell.
translation_verse: Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfɛ oliɛma so yaa nen, okoli fɔ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ nu; ebiala bɔ okose oliɛma kyɛ ɔte sona mbaen nen, okoli fɔ badwa nyunu. Ebiala bɔ okose kyɛ, ‘Wɔ kwaseambane’ nen, okoli fɔ, na ɔkɔhɔ abɔnzam see nu.

english_verse: leave your gift there in front of the altar. Make peace with that person, then come back and offer your gift to God.
translation_verse: yakyi w’ayɛyɛdeɛ ne to afɔleɛ bokyea ne nyunu berɛ, ná kɔ ɛne eliɛma ne bɛɛbɔ nu koraka né afa w’ayɛyɛdeɛ ne aabɔ afɔleɛ ne.

english_verse: Before you are dragged into court, make friends with the person who has accused you of doing wrong. If you don't, you will be handed over to the judge and then to the officer who will put you in jail.
translation_verse: “Sona bɔ wasama wɔ ne, ɛne ye bésiesie ɛmɔ afia ndɛndɛ, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛne ye bɛ gya gyi atee so bɛkɔ mbanyi nyunu ɔ. Anyɔ a, sona bɔ wasama wɔ ne kɔfa wɔ kowura ndɛenbualɛniɛ sa, ná ndɛenbualɛniɛ ne koso wafa wɔ wawura wɛmvoɛ ne sa, ná bafa wɔ bato kuku nu.

english_verse: I promise you will not get out until you have paid the last cent you owe. Marriage
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire wɔ kyɛ, sɛ andua kerɛ ne amu pɛsɛɛ a, bɛngɔye wɔ ma engofite ngɔhɔ le. Agyaasɛkyelɛ nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ

english_verse: You have been taught that a man who divorces his wife must write out divorce papers for her.
translation_verse: “Bahã ye bieku kyɛ, ‘Ebiala bɔ okoyira ɔye ne, odi kyɛ ɔkyerɛ agyaayiralɛ krataa ma ye.’

english_verse: You know our ancestors were told, “Don't use the Lord's name to make a promise unless you are going to keep it.”
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔate ye bieku kyɛ bɛhã behyirele tetefoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, ‘Nnɛta ndaen mbaen, na mmom fa bɔ aboa Awurade ne ma ye!’

english_verse: When you make a promise, say only “Yes” or “No.” Anything else comes from the devil. Revenge (Luke
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ ‘Yoo’ yɛ ‘Yoo’ ná ɛmɔ ‘Daabi’ yɛ ‘Daabi.’ Ɛhe pa ye nwo a, bɔ ɛmɔkɔhã biala fi bɔne nu. Nnɛfa bɔne tua bɔne so (Luka

english_verse: You know you have been taught, “An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.”
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔate kyɛ bɛnwa: ‘Anyeɛ si anyeɛ gya nu, na agyee si agyee gya nu.’

english_verse: But I tell you not to try to get even with a person who has done something to you. When someone slaps your right cheek, turn and let that person slap your other cheek.
translation_verse: Nakoso me de, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɔne betua ebie bɔ wayɔ ɛmɔ bɔne ɔ so kerɛ. Sɛ ebie pakye wɔ nye famaa so a, kakyi bɛen ne koso ma ye.

english_verse: If someone sues you for your shirt, give up your coat as well.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie sama wɔ kyɛ ode w’ataadeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ye bo ne a, maa ɔfa w’ataadeɛ aguasoɛ ne ɔboka so.

english_verse: If a soldier forces you to carry his pack one kilometer, carry it two kilometers.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie hyɛ wɔ so kyɛ ɛnate pɛ kwanzii ko a, ɛne ye bɛhɔ kwanzii nyɔ.

english_verse: When people ask you for something, give it to them. When they want to borrow money, lend it to them. Love (Luke
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie srɛ wɔ dɔ nikyee a, fa ma ye; yeɛ sɛ ebie pena kyɛ ɔfɛmo wɔ dɔ nikyee a, nnɛfa bɔ ye atianuserɛ. Kuro wɔ pɔfoɛ dwirɛ (Luka

english_verse: You have heard people say, “Love your neighbors and hate your enemies.”
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔate kyɛ bahã ye kyɛ, ‘Kuro ebiɛngo dwirɛ, ná pɔ wɔ pɔfoɛ.’

english_verse: But I tell you to love your enemies and pray for anyone who mistreats you.
translation_verse: Nakoso me de, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛ́mɔhuro ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ dwirɛ, ná ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ bɛ́ma bɛ bɔ bɛtane ɛmɔ nye ɔ;

english_verse: Then you will be acting like your Father in heaven. He makes the sun rise on both good and bad people. And he sends rain for the ones who do right and for the ones who do wrong.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔayɛ ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne mma. Ɔnate kyɛ ɔma ye yia bɔ bɔnefoɛ mmenia ne mmeni paa so, na ɔtɔ esue gua teneneefoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛndengyɛ ɔ so.

english_verse: If you love only those people who love you, will God reward you for this? Even tax collectors love their friends.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bɛ bɔ bekuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkuro bɛ dwirɛ de a, ye de nzu akatuaa yeɛ ɛmɔkonya ɔ? Ɛtoɔdidelɛfoɛ po, aso nna sɔ ala yeɛ bɛyɔ ɔ?

english_verse: If you greet only your friends, what's so great about this? Don't even unbelievers do that?
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ ngome yeɛ ɛmɔbisa bɛ ahye a, nzu yeɛ ɛmɔayɔ maa wabo so ɔ? Ewiasefoɛ po, aso nna sɔ ala yeɛ bɛyɔ ɔ?

english_verse: But you must always act like your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nwo te, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne ye nwo te ne.

english_verse: When you do good deeds, don't try to show off. If you do, you won't get a reward from your Father in heaven.
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔnea yé ná ɛmɔanyɔ ɛmɔ tenenee yɔleɛ wɔ mmenia nyunu, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ bekonwu ɛmɔ ɔ. Ɔba ye sɔ a, ɛmɔngonya akatuaa biala ngofi ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne berɛ.

english_verse: When you give to the poor, don't let anyone know about it.
translation_verse: Na wɔ de, sɛ ɛyɔ adɔeɛ a, nnɛma wɔ sa bɛen nwu bɔ wɔ sa famaa yɔ ɔ,

english_verse: When you pray, don't be like those show-offs who love to stand up and pray in the synagogues and on the street corners. They do this just to look good. I can assure you that they already have their reward.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛmɔbɔ mbaeɛ a, nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ kyɛ nyaatwomfoɛ nemɔ; ofikyɛ bɛ de, bekuro kyɛ begyinagyina ndende wɔ nyianu sua nemɔ nu ne mmorɔnoɛ so bɛbɔ mbaeɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ mmenia konwu bɛ ɔ. Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, banya b’akatuaa dada.

english_verse: When you pray, go into a room alone and close the door. Pray to your Father in private. He knows what is done in private and will reward you.
translation_verse: Na wɔ de, sɛ ɛ́bɔ mbaeɛ a, kɔ wɔ sua nu, to w’anoa ne anu, ná bɔ mbaeɛ kyire wɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ mvealeɛ nu ne, na wɔ Baba bɔ onwu mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne, ɔkɔma wɔ so akatuaa.

english_verse: When you pray, don't talk on and on as people do who don't know God. They think God likes to hear long prayers.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛmɔbɔ mbaeɛ a, nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ ndoatoa kyɛ bosoensolɛfoɛ bɛyɔ ne; ofikyɛ bɛdwene kyɛ bɛ dwudwolɛ tendetende ne yeɛ ɔkɔmaa bekotie bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't be like them. Your Father knows what you need even before you ask.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ kyɛ bɛ; ofikyɛ ɛmɔ Baba ɔse bɔ ɛmɔhia ɔ koraka ná ɛmɔabisa ye.

english_verse: You should pray like this: Our Father in heaven, help us to honor your name.
translation_verse: Yiti sɔaa yeɛ ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ: ‘Yɛ Baba bɔ ɛwɔ nyameɛso ɔ, Wɔ dumaa nwo te.

english_verse: Come and set up your kingdom, so that everyone on earth will obey you, as you are obeyed in heaven.
translation_verse: W’ahennie ɔbra, Maa yɛyɔ w’apɛdeɛ wɔ aseɛ so, kyɛbɔ bɛyɔ ye wɔ nyameɛso ne.

english_verse: If you forgive others for the wrongs they do to you, your Father in heaven will forgive you.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛmɔfa mmenia mvomsoɛ bɛkyɛ bɛ a, ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne koso kɔfa ɛmɔ deɛ kɔhyɛ ɛmɔ.

english_verse: But if you don't forgive others, your Father will not forgive your sins. Worshiping God by Going without Eating
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔamva mmenia mvomsoɛ bangyɛ bɛ a, ye de ɛmɔ Baba ne koso ɔngɔfa ɛmɔ mvomsoɛ ngɔhyɛ ɛmɔ. Akɔngyere nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ

english_verse: Instead, comb your hair and wash your face.
translation_verse: Na wɔ de, sɛ ɛyɛ akɔngyere a, toli wɔ ti anu, ná nwunzi wɔ nyunu,

english_verse: Then others won't know you are going without eating. But your Father sees what is done in private, and he will reward you. Treasures in Heaven (Luke
translation_verse: ná mmenia bannwu kyɛ ɛyɛ akɔngyere ɔ; sana wɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ mvealeɛ nu ne; na wɔ Baba bɔ onwu mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne, ɔkɔma wɔ so akatuaa. Nyameɛso agyapadeɛ (Luka

english_verse: But more than anything else, put God's work first and do what he wants. Then the other things will be yours as well.
translation_verse: Na ɛ́mɔli moa bɛ́pena Nyameɛ ahennie ne ye tenenee ne mmom, na ɔkɔfa ɛhemɔ amukoraa ɔkɔboka so kɔma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Don't worry about tomorrow. It will take care of itself. You have enough to worry about today.
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔdwene ɛhema deɛ nwo, ofikyɛ ɛhema bɔbɔ deinn ɔkɔdwene ye nwo. Kyẽa biala nu adwenedwene sone ma sɔ kyẽa ne.”

english_verse: Don't store up treasures on earth! Moths and rust can destroy them, and thieves can break in and steal them.
translation_verse: “Nnɛma ɛmɔboaboa agyapadeɛ noa bɛma bɛ nwo wɔ aseɛ ye aso, nekaa bɔ mvrɔlɔ di ná odi naakye, ná awuefoɛ bubu kɔ nu bekowua ne.

english_verse: Instead, store up your treasures in heaven, where moths and rust cannot destroy them, and thieves cannot break in and steal them.
translation_verse: Na mmom ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ agyapadeɛ noa bésie nyameɛso, nekaa bɔ mvrɔlɔ nni, ná onni naakye, ná awuefoɛ mmubu ngɔ nu ngonwua ɔ.

english_verse: Your heart will always be where your treasure is. Light (Luke
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, nekaa bɔ w’agyapadeɛ wɔ ne, berɛ yeɛ w’ahone koso wɔ ɔ. Nipadua kanea (Luka

english_verse: But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark. If the light inside you is dark, you surely are in the dark. Money (Luke
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ wɔ nye te wusiwusi a, wɔ nipadua ne amukoraa kɔyɛ awosii. Yiti sɛ kanea bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ nu ne te awosii a, né ye awosii ne te kabii paa! Nyameɛ ne anwonyadeɛ (Luka

english_verse: You cannot be the slave of two masters! You will like one more than the other or be more loyal to one than the other. You cannot serve both God and money. Worry (Luke
translation_verse: “Sona biala ngora nzo meneɛ nyɔ; ofikyɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, ɔkɔpɔ ko, né wahuro ko dwirɛ; anaakyɛ ɔkɔso ko nahorɛ nu, né wabu ko animtia. Ɛmɔngɔhora ngɔso Nyameɛ ne anwonyadeɛ.

english_verse: Don't worry and ask yourselves, “Will we have anything to eat? Will we have anything to drink? Will we have any clothes to wear?”
translation_verse: “Yiti nnɛmaa ɛmɔdwenedwene bɛkã kyɛ, ‘Nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛkoli ɔ, anaa nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛkɔno ɔ, anaa nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛkɔhera ɔ.

english_verse: I tell you not to worry about your life. Don't worry about having something to eat, drink, or wear. Isn't life more than food or clothing?
translation_verse: “Yiti mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ asetena nu adwenedwene tɔ ɛmɔ so, kyɛ nzu yeɛ ɛmɔkoli ɔ; anaakyɛ nzu yeɛ ɛmɔkɔno ɔ, anaakyɛ ɛmɔ nipadua nwo, kyɛ nzu yeɛ ɛmɔkɔhera ɔ. Aso ngoa nwo nhia ndra aleɛ? Aso nipadua nwo nhia ndra ɛtena anaa?

english_verse: Look at the birds in the sky! They don't plant or harvest. They don't even store grain in barns. Yet your Father in heaven takes care of them. Aren't you worth much more than birds?
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea ewienu nnomaa: bɛnyɔ boo, bɛngɔmva eboo so aleɛ, yeɛ bɛmmoaboa aleɛ bengua pata so; nakoso ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne ɔma bɛ aleɛ. Aso ɛmɔ nwo nhia ndra bɛ?

english_verse: Why worry about clothes? Look how the wild flowers grow. They don't work hard to make their clothes.
translation_verse: “Na nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔdwenedwene ndena nwo ɔ? Ɛ́mɔnea eburo sukooko, ɔne kyɛbɔ besi benyi ɔ. Bɛnyɔ adwuma, yeɛ bɛndo gyese.

english_verse: But I tell you that Solomon with all his wealth wasn't as well clothed as one of them.
translation_verse: Nakoso mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, Solomon animnyam amukoraa nu ne po, ye anwosiesie ne ando ɛhemɔ anu ko po.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. God will surely do even more for you! Why do you have such little faith?
translation_verse: Na sɛ Nyameɛ siesie eburo ndire bɔ ogyi berɛ ɛnɛ maa ɔyɛ nyemene, ná ɛhema bapɛ bayera ye foonoo nu po a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ ongosiesie ɛmɔ ma ɔngɔbo so ɔ? Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔ gyidie te kãa ɔ!

english_verse: Only people who don't know God are always worrying about such things. Your Father in heaven knows you need all of these.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ewiasefoɛ yeɛ bedi ɛhemɔ amukoraa si ɔ. Na ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne, ɔse kyɛ ɛmɔhia ɛhemɔ amukoraa.

english_verse: Don't condemn others, and God won't condemn you.
translation_verse: “Nnɛma ɛmɔbua ndɛen, ná Nyameɛ koso wammua ɛmɔ ndɛen,

english_verse: God will be as hard on you as you are on others! He will treat you exactly as you treat them.
translation_verse: ɔnate kyɛ ndɛen horɛ bɔ ɛmɔkobua ne, ye ala yeɛ bɛkɔfa bekobua ɛmɔ ɔ; na nikye horɛ bɔ ɛmɔkɔfa bekosusu ne, ye ala yeɛ bɛkɔfa bekosusu bɛkɔma ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You can see the speck in your friend's eye, but you don't notice the log in your own eye.
translation_verse: Na nzu ati yeɛ enwu baka sii bɔ ɔla eliɛma nye so, nakoso mbuna bɔ ɔla wɔ nye so de ennwu ye ɔ?

english_verse: How can you say, “My friend, let me take the speck out of your eye,” when you don't see the log in your own eye?
translation_verse: Anaakyɛ, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né ahã ahyire eliɛma kyɛ, ‘Maa nye wɔ nye so baka sii mma wɔ,’ wɔ aberɛ bɔ wɔ koso mbuna la wɔ nye so ɔ?

english_verse: You're nothing but show-offs! First, take the log out of your own eye; then you can see how to take the speck out of your friend's eye.
translation_verse: Nyaatwomniɛ! Di moa ye wɔ nye so mbuna ne koraka, na ɔkɔmaa ekonwu nikyee yé, na ahora aye baka sii bɔ ɔla eliɛma nye so ne.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give good things to people who ask.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ po bɔ ɛmɔte bɔnefoɛ ɔ, sɛ ɛmɔse kyɛbɔ ɛmɔma ɛmɔ mma mɔ nningyein paa a, nzaade ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ ɔngɔfa nningyein paa ngɔma bɛ bɔ bebisa ye ɔ?

english_verse: Would any of you give your hungry child a stone, if the child asked for some bread?
translation_verse: Anaakyɛ ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ ɔwa bisa ye paanoo a, ɔkɔma ye nyɔboɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Ask, and you will receive. Search, and you will find. Knock, and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔbisa, na ɛmɔ sa kɔha ye; ɛmɔpena, na ɛmɔkonwu ye; ɛ́mɔbɔ nu, na bekobukye ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive. Everyone who searches will find. And the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ obisa ne, ye sa ka ye; na bɔ ɔpena ne, onwu ye; yeɛ bɔ ɔbɔ nu ne, bebukye ye.

english_verse: Would you give your child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Anaakyɛ obisa ye tiré a, ɔkɔma ye ewoo ɔ?

english_verse: Treat others as you want them to treat you. This is what the Law and the Prophets are all about. The Narrow Gate (Luke
translation_verse: Yiti nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔpena kyɛ mmenia yɔ ma ɛmɔ ne, ɛmɔ koso ɛ́mɔyɔ sɔ ala bɛ́ma bɛ; ofikyɛ porɛ bɔ mmeraa ne ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ gyi so hɔ ɛne. Anoa kaaba ne anoa piri (Luka

english_verse: Anyone who hears and obeys these teachings of mine is like a wise person who built a house on solid rock.
translation_verse: “Yiti ebiala bɔ ɔte me dwirɛ he ná odi so nen, ngɔfa ye ngɔtoto nworɛniɛ bie bɔ osili ye sua wɔ nyɔbotaen so ɔ nwo.

english_verse: But the gate to life is very narrow. The road that leads there is so hard to follow that only a few people find it. A Tree and Its Fruit (Luke
translation_verse: Anoa bɔ ɔte bɔtɔfee ne atee bɔ ɔte kyenɔnn ne yeɛ ɔkɔ ngoa nu ɔ, na mmenia kaaba bie yeɛ benwu ye ɔ. Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ (Luka

english_verse: Watch out for false prophets! They dress up like sheep, but inside they are wolves who have come to attack you.
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ ngondombo ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nwo; bɛfa boaen nwomaa bedwira bɛ nwo bɛba ɛmɔ berɛ, nakoso bɛ nu de, bɛte pataku adifuufoɛ.

english_verse: You can tell what they are by what they do. No one picks grapes or figs from thornbushes.
translation_verse: Bɛ yɔleɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkɔfa bekonwu bɛ ɔ. Aso bɛtete bobe wɔ mmowue so, anaakyɛ bɛtete borɔdoma wɔ ɛfone so?

english_verse: A good tree produces good fruit, and a bad tree produces bad fruit.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ bakaa paa biala osu mmaa paa ɔ, nakoso bakaa tɛɛ de osu mmaa tɛɛ.

english_verse: A good tree cannot produce bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot produce good fruit.
translation_verse: Bakaa paa ngɔhora ngosu mmaa tɛɛ, yeɛ bakaa tɛɛ koso ngɔhora ngosu mmaa paa.

english_verse: Every tree producing bad fruit will be chopped down and burned.
translation_verse: Bakaa biala bɔ onzu mmaa paa nen, bɛpɛ bɛto, na begyi bɛto see nu.

english_verse: You can tell who the false prophets are by their deeds. A Warning (Luke
translation_verse: Yiti bɛ yɔleɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkɔfa bekonwu bɛ ɔ. Menze wɔ (Luka

english_verse: Anyone who hears my teachings and doesn't obey them is like a foolish person who built a house on sand.
translation_verse: “Na ebiala bɔ ɔte me dwirɛ he na onni so nen, ngɔfa ye ngɔtoto kwaseaa bie bɔ osili ye sua siele anweaa so ɔ nwo.

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and the winds blew and beat against that house. Finally, it fell with a crash.
translation_verse: Esue piri bie tɔle, na nzue yili, mvrama tuli oofini sua ne, na obuli, na obuli gyirigorɔɔ.” Yesu le tumi

english_verse: Not everyone who calls me their Lord will get into the kingdom of heaven. Only the ones who obey my Father in heaven will get in.
translation_verse: “Nna ebiala bɔ ose me kyɛ ‘Awurade, Awurade’ ne, yeɛ ɔkɔhɔ nyameɛso ahennie ne anu ɔ, na mmom sana bɔ ɔyɔ me Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne ye apɛdeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: On the day of judgment many will call me their Lord. They will say, “We preached in your name, and in your name we forced out demons and worked many miracles.”
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, mmenia pee yeɛ bekose me kyɛ, ‘Awurade, Awurade, aso yamva wɔ dumaa yanhyɛ ngɔm; aso yamva wɔ dumaa yandu sunzummɔne mɔ; aso yamva wɔ dumaa yanyɔ anwanwadeɛ pee?’

english_verse: But I will tell them, “I will have nothing to do with you! Get out of my sight, you evil people!” Two Builders (Luke
translation_verse: Na ɛhe yeɛ ngɔpakye nu ngose bɛ kyɛ, ‘Menze ɛmɔ koraa, ɛ́mɔfi me so bɛhɔ, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔndengyɛ ɔ!’ Nyɔbotaen ne anweaa so suasilɛ (Luka

english_verse: Rain poured down, rivers flooded, and winds beat against that house. But it was built on solid rock, and so it did not fall.
translation_verse: Esue piri bie tɔle, na nzue yili, mvrama tuli oofini sua ne, nakoso wammu, ɔnate kyɛ bɛtole ye fapem ne wɔ nyɔbotaen so.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, the crowds were surprised at his teaching.
translation_verse: Yesu yiele sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ kã nen, ɛlɔen ne nwo dwirili bɛ wɔ ye ngyerɛkyerɛ ne anwo,

english_verse: He taught them like someone with authority, and not like their teachers of the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ohyirehyirele bɛ kyɛ ebie bɔ ole tumi ɔ, na mmom nna kyɛ b’ahyerɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: But the ones who should have been in the kingdom will be thrown out into the dark. They will cry and grit their teeth in pain.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Ahennie mma nemɔ de, bekogyi bɛ bekogua nziɛ dɔ awosii nu; na berɛ yeɛ esuɛ ne agyeenwosenɛ wɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: That evening many people with demons in them were brought to Jesus. And with only a word he forced out the evil spirits and healed everyone who was sick.
translation_verse: Na odwuli nɔsoa nen, bɛfale mmenia pee bɔ sunzummɔne wɔ bɛ so ɔ bɛwale Yesu berɛ. Ɔfale ye noa dwirɛ tutuli sunzummɔne nemɔ, na ɔsale bɛ bɔ bɛnde apɔ ne amukoraa anwonyerɛ.

english_verse: Suddenly a man with leprosy came and knelt in front of Jesus. He said, “Lord, you have the power to make me well, if only you wanted to.”
translation_verse: Na yieee, kwataniɛ bie wale ooguale ndwerɛ wɔ ye nyunu berɛ, na osele kyɛ, “Awurade, sɛ ekuro a, ɛkɔhora kɔma me nwo kofi.”

english_verse: Jesus put his hand on the man and said, “I want to! Now you are well.” At once the man's leprosy disappeared.
translation_verse: Na Yesu tengyɛle ye sa fa hane ye, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Mekuro, wɔ nwo fi!” Na berɛ ne ala ye kwata ne hɔle.

english_verse: “I will go and heal him,” Jesus replied.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Ngɔwa ngɔɔsa ye anwonyerɛ.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he was so surprised that he turned and said to the crowd following him, “I tell you in all of Israel I've never found anyone with this much faith!
translation_verse: Na Yesu tele bɔ ɔhane nen, ɔyɛle ye nwanwa, na osele mmenia bɔ beli ye si ne kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, Yisrael po, nnwuni gyidie piri bɔ ɔte sɔaa ɔ.

english_verse: “Lord, my servant is at home in such terrible pain that he can't even move.”
translation_verse: “Awurade, m’akoaa nde apɔ, wabubu ɔla awuro, na onwu amaneɛ soma.”

english_verse: Many people will come from everywhere to enjoy the feast in the kingdom of heaven with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
translation_verse: Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, mmenia pee kofi eyia afiteleɛ ne eyia atɔleɛ bɛkɔwa, na bɛ ne Abraham ne Yisake ne Yakob bɛkɔtena bekodidi wɔ nyameɛso ahennie ne anu.

english_verse: Then Jesus said to the officer, “You may go home now. Your faith has made it happen.” Right then his servant was healed. Jesus Heals Many People (Mark
translation_verse: Na Yesu sele asraafoɛ ɛyaa so panyi ne kyɛ, “Kɔ, na kyɛbɔ ale ali ne, ɔ́yɛ sɔ ma wɔ!” Na sɔ mmerɛ ne ala, ye akoaa ne nwo sandene ye. Yesu sa Petro sia anwonyerɛ (Marko

english_verse: Suddenly they shouted, “Jesus, Son of God, what do you want with us? Have you come to punish us before our time?”
translation_verse: Na yieee, bɛteateane nu kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛne wɔ le yɔ ɔ, wɔ, Nyameɛ Awa? Ɛwale wa kyɛ ɛbaateetee yɛ koraka ná mmerɛ ne adwu anaa?”

english_verse: Everyone in town came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged him to leave their part of the country.
translation_verse: Na yieee, kurotue ne amukoraa bɛbɔle twi beeyiale Yesu, na benwuni ye nen, bɛsrɛle ye kyɛ ofi bɛ mbɔtam berɛ hɔ.

english_verse: Jesus went to the home of Peter, where he found that Peter's mother-in-law was sick in bed with fever.
translation_verse: Yesu wale Petro awuro, na onwuni kyɛ ebunu ahye ye sia brasua wato berɛ.

english_verse: He took her by the hand, and the fever left her. Then she got up and served Jesus a meal.
translation_verse: Na ɔɔsɔle ye sa, na ebunu ne tu fili ye nwo, na odwɔsole sole ye.

english_verse: So God's promise came true, just as the prophet Isaiah had said, “He healed our diseases and made us well.” Some Who Wanted To Go with Jesus (Luke
translation_verse: Na ɛhe mane bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya hane ne wale nu kyɛ, “Ye yeɛ ɔfale yɛ anwommerɛlɛ, ná ɔsoale yɛ anwonyerɛ mɔ.” Bɛ bɔ bekuro kyɛ bedi Yesu si (Luka

english_verse: When Jesus saw the crowd, he went across Lake Galilee.
translation_verse: Yesu nwuni mmenia pee bɔ bapɛ ye nwo bayia nen, ɔhyɛle kyɛ bɛkɔhɔ asue ne asi dɔ.

english_verse: A teacher of the Law of Moses came up to him and said, “Teacher, I'll go anywhere with you!”
translation_verse: Na ahyerɛlɛniɛ bie wale oosele Yesu kyɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, nekaa biala bɔ ɛkɔhɔ ne, me ne wɔ yɛkɔhɔ.”

english_verse: Another disciple said to Jesus, “Lord, let me wait till I bury my father.”
translation_verse: Na sona foforɛ bɔ né ɔboka asuafoɛ nemɔ so ɔ sele ye kyɛ, “Awurade, ma me ate ma ngonzie me baba koraka.”

english_verse: so the disciples went over to him and woke him up. They said, “Lord, wake up! Save us before we drown!”
translation_verse: Na bɛhɔle ye berɛ beetingyele ye besele kyɛ, “Awurade, de yɛ, na yawu yayie!”

english_verse: After Jesus left in a boat with his disciples,
translation_verse: Yesu tenane ɛlɛen nu nen, ye asuafoɛ nemɔ lili ye si.

english_verse: a terrible storm suddenly struck the lake, and waves started splashing into their boat. Jesus was sound asleep,
translation_verse: Na yieee, mvrama piri bie hyɛle ye bo tuli ɛpo ne aso, maa ɔnate so asorɔkye bɔ katale ɛlɛen ne aso; nakoso ye de, né walafe.

english_verse: The men in the boat were amazed and said, “Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him.” Two Men with Demons in Them (Mark
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle mmenia nemɔ nwanwa, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Sona beni koraa ɛhe, bɔ mvrama ne ɛpo po betie ye e!” Yesu tutu sunzummɔne (Marko

english_verse: After Jesus had crossed the lake, he came to shore near the town of Gadara and started down the road. Two men with demons in them came to him from the tombs. They were so fierce that no one could travel that way.
translation_verse: Yesu dwuli Gadarafoɛ aseɛ so wɔ asue ne asi dɔ nen, mmenia nyɔ bie bɔ bele sunzummɔne ɔ befili asieleɛ ngumaa nu befitele beeyiale ye. Na ɔnate b’awerɔm ne ati, né ebiala ngora mva atee ne aso.

english_verse: Not far from there a large herd of pigs was feeding.
translation_verse: Né mbrako kure pee bie bedidi wɔ nziɛ nziɛ dɔ.

english_verse: So the demons begged Jesus, “If you force us out, please send us into those pigs!”
translation_verse: Na sunzummɔne nemɔ srɛle ye kyɛ, “Sɛ etu yɛ a, foa yɛ ma yɛɛwura mbrako kure ye anu.”

english_verse: Jesus told them to go, and they went out of the men and into the pigs. All at once the pigs rushed down the steep bank into the lake and drowned.
translation_verse: Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ!” Yiti befili bɛ nu befitele, na beewurale mbrako nemɔ anu. Na yieee, mbrako kure ne amukoraa bepiane bɛ nwo wii bɛtorotorole bokaa twɔndworɔnn ne beeguale ɛpo ne anu, na bewuwuli wɔ nzue ne anu.

english_verse: The people taking care of the pigs ran to the town and told everything, especially what had happened to the two men.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ bɛnea mbrako nemɔ so ne bɛnwatili, na bɛhɔle kuro ne anu bɛɛhane edwirɛ bɔ wasi ne amukoraa, ɔne bɔ ɔfa bɛ bɔ né sunzummɔne wɔ bɛ so ne anwo.

english_verse: Jesus got into a boat and crossed back over to the town where he lived.
translation_verse: Yesu tenane ɛlɛen nu pɛle asue ne, na osa wale ye bɔbɔ ye kuro.

english_verse: Jesus heard them and answered, “Healthy people don't need a doctor, but sick people do.
translation_verse: Yesu tele sɔ dwirɛ ne nen, osele bɛ kyɛ, “Bɛ bɔ bɛte apɔ ne, benhia safoɛ, na mmom bɛ bɔ bɛnde apɔ yeɛ behia ye ɔ.

english_verse: No one pours new wine into old wineskins. The wine would swell and burst the old skins. Then the wine would be lost, and the skins would be ruined. New wine must be put into new wineskins. Both the skins and the wine will then be safe. A Dying Girl and a Sick Woman (Mark
translation_verse: Yeɛ bɛmva nzaa monɛ bengua nwomaa ngotoku daa nu. Sɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, ngotoku nemɔ kote, na nzaa ne kohwie kogua, na ngotoku nemɔ kɔsɛkye. Na mmom bɛfa nzaa monɛ begua nwomaa ngotoku monɛ nu, ná bɛ munyɔ banzɛkye.” Yairo awa brasua ne braa bie bɔ mogya tu ye ne (Marko

english_verse: News about this spread all over that part of the country. Jesus Heals Two Blind Men
translation_verse: Na sɔ dwirɛ ne trɛ hɔle mbɔtam berɛ amukoraa. Yesu sa anyesiniwaafoɛ nyɔ anwonyerɛ

english_verse: Some teachers of the Law of Moses said to themselves, “Jesus must think he is God!”
translation_verse: Na ahyerɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bie sisele bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Sɔ biaa he ɔkã musue dwirɛ.”

english_verse: But Jesus knew what was in their minds, and he said, “Why are you thinking such evil things?
translation_verse: Nakoso Yesu nwuni b’adwene, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔdwene adwene tɛɛ sɔ ɔ?

english_verse: But I will show you that the Son of Man has the right to forgive sins here on earth.” So Jesus said to the man, “Get up! Pick up your mat and go on home.”
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ Sona Awa ne ole tumi wɔ aseɛ so, kyɛ ɔfa bɔne kyɛ ti ɔ,” na afei osele bubuaniɛ ne kyɛ, “Dwɔso, fa wɔ bɛen ne ná kɔ awuro!”

english_verse: The man got up and went home.
translation_verse: Na odwɔsole sili nu hɔle ye awuro.

english_verse: Go and learn what the Scriptures mean when they say, ‘Instead of offering sacrifices to me, I want you to be merciful to others.’ I didn't come to invite good people to be my followers. I came to invite sinners.” People Ask about Going without Eating (Mark
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhɔ beesua kyɛbɔ edwirɛ he ye bo kyire ɔ, ‘Anwumvoinnwunɛ yeɛ mekuro ɔ, na nna afɔleɛbɔlɛ ɔ.’ Ofikyɛ mamma kyɛ mebaafrɛ teneneefoɛ, na mmom bɔnefoɛ.” Akɔngyere nwo adwobisa (Marko

english_verse: As Jesus was leaving that place, two blind men began following him and shouting, “Son of David, have pity on us!”
translation_verse: Yesu fili berɛ kyɛ ɔkɔ nen, anyesiniwaafoɛ nyɔ lili ye si bɛteateane nu kyɛ, “Dawide Awa, nwu yɛ anwumvoin!”

english_verse: As Jesus and his disciples were on their way, some people brought to him a man who could not talk because a demon was in him.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ befitele bɔ bɛkɔ ne, ebiemɔ fale emumu bie bɔ sunzummɔne wɔ ye so ɔ bɛbrɛle Yesu.

english_verse: As Jesus was leaving, he saw a tax collector named Matthew sitting at the place for paying taxes. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.” Matthew got up and went with him.
translation_verse: Yesu fili berɛ bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ nen, onwuni biaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Mateo kyɛ ɔte nekaa bɔ bedide ɛtoɔ ɔ, na osele ye kyɛ, “Di me si.” Na odwɔsole lili ye si.

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples were having dinner at Matthew's house. Many tax collectors and other sinners were also there.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ ɔtenane ase kyɛ odidi wɔ awuro nen, yieee, ɛtoɔdidelɛfoɛ ne bɔnefoɛ pee bɛwale, na bɛ ne Yesu ne ye asuafoɛ nemɔ bɛtenane ase kyɛ bedidili.

english_verse: Some Pharisees asked Jesus' disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and other sinners?”
translation_verse: Na Farasiifoɛ nemɔ nwuni ye sɔ nen, bebisale ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔ kyerɛkyerɛniɛ ne ɔne ɛtoɔdidelɛfoɛ ne bɔnefoɛ bedidi ye?”

english_verse: While Jesus was still speaking, an official came and knelt in front of him. The man said, “My daughter has just now died! Please come and place your hand on her. Then she will live again.”
translation_verse: Yesu gu so bɔ ɔkã ɛhemɔ kyire bɛ nen, yieee, panyi bie wale ɔɔkotole ye nyunu berɛ, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Mma brasua awu kekesaala ye, nakoso bra baafa wɔ sa gua ye so, na okonya ngoa.”

english_verse: Jesus turned. He saw the woman and said, “Don't worry! You are now healed because of your faith.” At that moment she was healed.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu kakyili ye nwo, na onwuni braa ne nen, osele kyɛ, “Mma brasua, ma w’ahone tɔ wɔ kunu! Wɔ gyidie ale wɔ.” Na berɛ ne ala braa ne tele apɔ.

english_verse: After Jesus had forced the demon out, the man started talking. The crowds were so amazed they began saying, “Nothing like this has ever happened in Israel!”
translation_verse: Yesu tuli sunzummɔne ne nen, emumu ne dwudwole; na ɔyɛle ɛlɔen ne nwanwa maa bɛhane kyɛ, “Yɛnnwuni ɛhe bie le wɔ Yisrael!”

english_verse: Some followers of John the Baptist came and asked Jesus, “Why do we and the Pharisees often go without eating, while your disciples never do?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yohane asuafoɛ nemɔ wale Yesu berɛ beebisale ye kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ yɛne Farasiifoɛ yɛtaa yɛyɔ akɔngyere, ná w’asuafoɛ nemɔ de bɛnyɔ akɔngyere ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: The friends of a bridegroom aren't sad while he is still with them. But the time will come when he will be taken from them. Then they will go without eating.
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né atɔmvorɛ bo ama bɛ wora abɔ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ atɔmvorɛ biaa ne ɔne bɛ wɔ berɛ ɔ? Mmerɛ bie kɔwa bɔ bɛkɔfa atɔmvorɛ biaa ne bekofi bɛ nwo bɛkɔhɔ ɔ, na afei bekoli abuadaa.

english_verse: No one uses a new piece of cloth to patch old clothes. The patch would shrink and tear a bigger hole.
translation_verse: Na ebiala mva ɛtena monɛ sii nda ataadeɛ daa nu, ofikyɛ ndetamuɛ ne te fi ataadeɛ ne anu, na ye tetelɛ ne yɛ piri.

english_verse: She had said to herself, “If I can just touch his clothes, I will be healed.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔhane ye ye ti anu kyɛ, “Sɛ mefa me sa mekã ye ataadeɛ ne ngome po a, ngɔte apɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples got up and went with the man.
translation_verse: Yiti Yesu dwɔsole ɔne ye asuafoɛ nemɔ belili ye si.

english_verse: A woman who had been bleeding for twelve years came up behind Jesus and barely touched his clothes.
translation_verse: Na yieee, braa bie bɔ mogya atu ye afoɛ buru ne nyɔ ɔ fale Yesu si, na ɔfale ye sa hane ye ataadeɛ noa bɔ banwo ne.

english_verse: When Jesus went into the home of the official and saw the musicians and the crowd of mourners,
translation_verse: Na Yesu dwuli panyi n’awuro berɛ, ná onwuni awɛenhulɛfoɛ ne mmenia bɔ bɛteatea nu nen,

english_verse: he said, “Get out of here! The little girl isn't dead. She is just asleep.” Everyone started laughing at Jesus.
translation_verse: osele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma me ate, ofikyɛ abaayaa ne owwuli, na mmom walafe.” Na bɛserele ye.

english_verse: But after the crowd had been sent out of the house, Jesus went to the girl's bedside. He took her by the hand and helped her up.
translation_verse: Na ɔmaa mmenia ne fitele nen, owurale nu ɔɔsɔle abaayaa ne sa, na odwɔsole.

english_verse: After Jesus had gone indoors, the two blind men came up to him. He asked them, “Do you believe I can make you well?” “Yes, Lord,” they answered.
translation_verse: Odwuli awuro nen, anyesiniwaafoɛ nemɔ wale ye berɛ, na Yesu bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Aso ɛmɔde bedi kyɛ ngɔhora ngɔsa ɛmɔ anwonyerɛ?” Na bebuale kyɛ, “Yoo, Awurade.”

english_verse: Jesus touched their eyes and said, “Because of your faith, you will be healed.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu fale ye sa hane bɛ nye, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ gyidie te ne, ɔ́yɛ sɔ ala ma ɛmɔ!”

english_verse: They were able to see, and Jesus strictly warned them not to tell anyone about him.
translation_verse: Na bɛ nye tetele. Na Yesu bɔle bɛ noa kitii kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea yé ná ebiala ande!”

english_verse: But they left and talked about him to everyone in that part of the country. Jesus Heals a Man Who Could Not Talk
translation_verse: Nakoso befili berɛ ne, bɛbɔle Yesu nwo dawure wɔ mbɔtam berɛ amukoraa. Yesu sa emumu bie anwonyerɛ

english_verse: But the Pharisees said, “The leader of the demons gives him the power to force out demons.” Jesus Has Pity on People
translation_verse: Nakoso Farasiifoɛ nemɔ hane kyɛ, “Sunzummɔne mɔ panyi ye tumi yeɛ ɔfa tutu sunzummɔne mɔ ɔ.” Yesu nwu mmenia nemɔ anwumvoin

english_verse: Jesus went to every town and village. He taught in their synagogues and preached the good news about God's kingdom. Jesus also healed every kind of disease and sickness.
translation_verse: Yesu hɔle nguro ne nguraa ne amukoraa so aporɔ yɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ wɔ bɛ nyianu sua nemɔ anu, ɔhane ahennie ne nwo nzɛmba, na ɔsale anwonyerɛ ne anwommerɛlɛ amukoraa.

english_verse: When he saw the crowds, he felt sorry for them. They were confused and helpless, like sheep without a shepherd.
translation_verse: Na onwuni mmenia pembepembe ne, bɛyɛle ye anwumvo, ofikyɛ né bafɛ, na né bɛsamo berɛ kyɛ mmoaen bɔ belle neafoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: He said to his disciples, “A large crop is in the fields, but there are only a few workers.
translation_verse: Yeɛ osele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Nnɔbaeɛtelɛ adwuma ne sone, nakoso adwumayɔlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛte kãa.

english_verse: Ask the Lord in charge of the harvest to send out workers to bring it in.”
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔsrɛ nnɔbaeɛtelɛ Mene ne, ná ɔma adwumayɔlɛfoɛ bɛbra ye nnɔbaeɛtelɛ adwuma ne anu.”

english_verse: Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew the tax collector, James the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus were also apostles.
translation_verse: Filipo ne Batolomeo; Tɔmase ne Mateo bɔ ɔte ɛtoɔdidelɛniɛ ne; Yakobo bɔ ye baba ole Alfeo ne, yeɛ Tadeo;

english_verse: But when someone arrests you, don't worry about what you will say or how you will say it. At that time you will be given the words to say.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bɛfa ɛmɔ bɛkɔ a, nnɛma ɛmɔdwenedwene kyɛbɔ ɛmɔkodwudwo anaa bɔ ɛmɔkɔhã ɔ nwo; ofikyɛ nyameɛ kɔfa bɔ odi kyɛ ɛmɔkã ɔ kɔma ɛmɔ wɔ sɔ mmerɛ ne ala nu.

english_verse: Go only to the people of Israel, because they are like a flock of lost sheep.
translation_verse: na mmom ɛmɔhɔ mmoaen bɔ bamini bɔ bɛ ole Yisrael awuro ama ne berɛ.

english_verse: I am sending you like lambs into a pack of wolves. So be as wise as snakes and as innocent as doves.
translation_verse: “Ɛ́mɔtie! mésoma ɛmɔ kyɛ mmoaen maa ɛmɔkɔ mbataku nu. Yiti ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye la berɛ kyɛ ewoo, ná ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase kyɛ mmubure.

english_verse: The others were Simon, known as the Eager One, and Judas Iscariot, who later betrayed Jesus. Instructions for the Twelve Apostles (Mark
translation_verse: Kanaanniɛ Simɔn, yeɛ Yudase Yiskariote bɔ ɔyele Yesu mane ne. Asomafoɛ nemɔ adwuma (Marko

english_verse: Jesus sent out the twelve apostles with these instructions: Stay away from the Gentiles and don't go to any Samaritan town.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia buru ne nyɔ nemɔ yeɛ Yesu somane bɛ ɔ, na ɔfale ahyɛdeɛ mane bɛ kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔkɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ nemɔ berɛ, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔkɔ Samariafoɛ kuro biala so;

english_verse: And don't carry a traveling bag or an extra shirt or sandals or a walking stick. Workers deserve their food.
translation_verse: nnɛma ɛmɔfa ateetulɛ bɔtɔ, anaa ndaadeɛ nyɔ, anaa mbaboa, anaa pɔmaa, ofikyɛ adwumayɔlɛniɛ fata kyɛ ye sa kã ye aleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: So when you go to a town or a village, find someone able and willing to have you as their guest and stay with them until you leave.
translation_verse: “Kuro anaa akuraa biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔhɔ nu ne, ɛ́mɔpena sona bɔ okole ɛmɔ ɔ, na ɛmɔ ne ye bɛ́tena berɛ kɔpem mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔkofi berɛ bɛkɔhɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I promise you the day of judgment will be easier for the towns of Sodom and Gomorrah than for that town. Warning about Trouble (Mark
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ndɛenbualɛ kyẽa ne, amaneɛ bɔ ɔkɔto Sodom ne Gomora aseɛ ne nen, ongodwu bɔ ɔkɔto sɔ kuro ne. Ndaneanyeɛ nwo ngɔmhyɛlɛ (Marko

english_verse: Brothers and sisters will betray one another and have each other put to death. Parents will betray their own children, and children will turn against their parents and have them killed.
translation_verse: “Aliɛmaa kɔye aliɛmaa kɔma maa bekohu ye, seɛ kɔye baa kɔma, na mmaa kodwɔso kotia awofoɛ maa bekohu bɛ.

english_verse: Watch out for people who will take you to court and have you beaten in their synagogues.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ kuro sona nwo, ɔnate kyɛ bɛkɔfa ɛmɔ bɛkɔhɔ mbanyi badwa nu, ná bafi ɛmɔ mbire wɔ bɛ nyianu sua mɔ nu.

english_verse: Because of me, you will be dragged before rulers and kings to tell them and the Gentiles about your faith.
translation_verse: Ɔnate me ti bɛkɔfa ɛmɔ bekogyina amrado mɔ ne ahemvo nyunu, na ɔkɔyɛ adanzeɛ kohyire bɛ ne Amaenmaensofoɛ.

english_verse: But you will not really be the one speaking. The Spirit from your Father will tell you what to say.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, nna ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔdwudwo ɔ, na mmom ɛmɔ Baba Sunzum ne yeɛ ɔfa ɛmɔ so dwudwo ɔ.

english_verse: Everyone will hate you because of me. But if you remain faithful until the end, you will be saved.
translation_verse: Ɔnate me dumaa ti, mmenia mukoraa kɔpɔ ɛmɔ; nakoso bɔ okotindim koodwu ayieleɛ nen, ye yeɛ bekole ye ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: When people mistreat you in one town, hurry to another one. I promise you before you have gone to all the towns of Israel, the Son of Man will come.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bɛtane ɛmɔ nye wɔ kuro ko aso a, ɛ́mɔnwati bɛhɔ foforɛ so. Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛmɔngoyie Yisrael nguro amukoraa so kyini koraka né Sona Awa ne awa.

english_verse: Students are not better than their teacher, and slaves are not better than their master.
translation_verse: “Suaniɛ ndra ye kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, yeɛ akoaa ndra ye mene.

english_verse: It is enough for students to be like their teacher and for slaves to be like their master. If people call the head of the family Satan, what will they say about the rest of the family? The One To Fear (Luke
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ suaniɛ yɛ kyɛ ye kyerɛkyerɛniɛ a, odi kyɛ ɔma ye nye sɔ; yeɛ akoaa koso sɛ ɔyɛ kyɛ ye mene a, odi kyɛ ɔma ye nye sɔ. Na sɛ bafrɛ awuro mene ne Beɛsebul de a, nzaade ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ bɛngɔfa dumaa tɛɛ pee bɛngɔfrɛ ye awuro ama ɔ? Bɔ odi kyɛ yɛsuro ye ɔ (Luka

english_verse: Don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but they cannot harm your soul. Instead, you should fear God who can destroy both your body and your soul in hell.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro bɛ bɔ beku anwoɔnaen ne, ná koso bɛngora bengu ɛkra ne; na mmom ɛ́mɔsuro bɔ ɔkora sɛkye anwoɔnaen ne ɛkra ne amunyɔ wɔ abɔnzam see nu ne.

english_verse: Aren't two sparrows sold for only a penny? But your Father knows when any one of them falls to the ground.
translation_verse: Aso bɛndɔne akatipire nyɔ pɛsaa? Nakoso bɛ nu ko po nde ndɔ ase bɔ ɛmɔ Baba ne ɔnze ye nwo bie ɔ.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔ ti nwiaa po baha ye mukoraa.

english_verse: So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Luke
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔsuro! Ɛmɔ nwo hia tra ngatipire pee. Kyɛ ɛkɔbɔ Yesu dumaa, ɔne kyɛ ɛkɔpo ye ɔ (Luka

english_verse: If you tell others you belong to me, I will tell my Father in heaven you are my followers.
translation_verse: “Yiti ebiala bɔ ɔkɔbɔ me dumaa wɔ mmenia nyunu ne, me koso ngɔbɔ ye dumaa me Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne nyunu.

english_verse: But if you reject me, I will tell my Father in heaven you don't belong to me. Not Peace, but Trouble (Luke
translation_verse: Nakoso ebiala bɔ ɔkɔpo me wɔ mmenia nyunu ne, me koso ngɔpo ye me Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne nyunu. Nna asomdwee, na mmom koɛ (Luka

english_verse: Don't think I came to bring peace to the earth! I came to bring trouble, not peace.
translation_verse: “Nnɛma ɛmɔdwene kyɛ mvale asomdwee mmale aseɛ so. Nna asomdwee yeɛ mva mmale ɔ, na mmom ngrandɛ.

english_verse: I came to turn sons against their fathers, daughters against their mothers, and daughters-in-law against their mothers-in-law.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmale kyɛ mebaatete nu ma baa bienzua dwɔso tia ɔse; ná baa brasua adwɔso atia oni, ná sia brasua adwɔso atia ohyireni.

english_verse: Your worst enemies will be in your own family.
translation_verse: Na sona awuro ama kɔyɛ ye pɔfoɛ.

english_verse: If you love your father or mother or even your sons and daughters more than me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: “Na ebiala bɔ okuro ɔse anaa oni dwirɛ tra me ne, ɔmvata me; yeɛ bɔ okuro ɔwa bienzua anaa ɔwa brasua dwirɛ tra me ne, ɔmvata me.

english_verse: And unless you are willing to take up your cross and follow me, you are not fit to be my disciples.
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ ɔmva ye mmeamudua ná onni me si nen, ɔmvata me.

english_verse: If you try to save your life, you will lose it. But if you give it up for me, you will surely find it. Rewards (Mark
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ okonya ye ngoa ne, ɔkɔhwere ye; na ebiala bɔ me ti ye ngoa kofi ye sa ne, okonya ye. Akatuaa (Marko

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes a prophet, just because that person is a prophet, will be given the same reward as a prophet. Anyone who welcomes a good person, just because that person is good, will be given the same reward as a good person.
translation_verse: Na bɔ ode ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ to nu ɔnate kyɛ onwu ye kyɛ ɔte ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne ati nen, ye sa kɔha ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ akatuaa. Yeɛ bɔ ode teneneeniɛ to nu ɔnate kyɛ onwu ye kyɛ ɔte teneneeniɛ ne ati nen, ye sa kɔha teneneeniɛ akatuaa.

english_verse: Anyone who welcomes you welcomes me. And anyone who welcomes me also welcomes the one who sent me.
translation_verse: “Bɔ ode ɛmɔ to nu nen, ode me koso to nu; yeɛ bɔ ode me to nu nen, ode bɔ ɔsomane me ne koso to nu.

english_verse: And anyone who gives one of my most humble followers a cup of cool water, just because that person is my follower, will be rewarded.
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔma mmaa mmaa hemɔ anu ko nzue frɔlɔɔ kwangoa ko, ɔnate kyɛ onwu ye kyɛ ɔte suaniɛ ne ati nen, nahorɛ nu mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ye akatuaa ngɔbɔ ye.”

english_verse: As John's followers were going away, Jesus spoke to the crowds about John: What sort of person did you go out into the desert to see? Was he like tall grass blown about by the wind?
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ béfi berɛ bɛ́kɔ nen, Yesu hyɛle ye bo hane edwirɛ bɔ ɔfa Yohane nwo ɔ hyirele ɛlɔen ne kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛmɔsili nu bɛhɔle ɛserɛ so dɔ bɛɛneane ɔ? Elemmire bɔ mvrama wosowoso ye anaa?

english_verse: John the Baptist did not go around eating and drinking, and you said, “That man has a demon in him!”
translation_verse: Yohane wale ne, onnidi, yeɛ ɔnno, na bɛnwa: ‘Ole sunzummɔne.’

english_verse: After Jesus had finished instructing his twelve disciples, he left and began teaching and preaching in the towns.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Yesu dwudwo hyirele ye asuafoɛ buru ne nyɔ ne yiele nen, ofili berɛ hɔle kyɛ ɔkwaayɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ ná ɔkã nzɛmba wɔ bɛ nguro nemɔ aso.

english_verse: John was in prison when he heard what Christ was doing. So John sent some of his followers
translation_verse: Na Yohane la kuku nu nen, ɔtele nnwumaa bɔ né Kristo yɔ ɔ, na ɔsomane ye asuafoɛ maa

english_verse: to ask Jesus, “Are you the one we should be looking for? Or must we wait for someone else?”
translation_verse: beebisale ye kyɛ, “Aso wɔ ole bɔ ɔ́ba ne, anaa odi kyɛ yɛnea foforɛ ate?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Go and tell John what you have heard and seen.
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ bɛɛhã bɔ ɛmɔte, ɔne bɔ ɛmɔnwu ye ɔ behyire Yohane:

english_verse: The blind are now able to see, and the lame can walk. People with leprosy are being healed, and the deaf can hear. The dead are raised to life, and the poor are hearing the good news.
translation_verse: anyesiniwaafoɛ nwu nikye, bubuafoɛ nate, kwatafoɛ nwo fi, asotiniwaafoɛ te dwudwolɛ, awufoɛ tingye, na bɛkã nzɛmba ne bekyire ehiafoɛ.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who doesn't reject me because of what I do.”
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ nnde sundidua mma ye ne, wanya saleɛ.”

english_verse: What kind of man did you go out to see? Was he someone dressed in fine clothes? People who dress like that live in the king's palace.
translation_verse: Anaakyɛ nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛmɔsili nu bɛhɔ bɛɛneane ɔ? Sona bɔ owura ndaadeɛ nyemenenyemene anaa? Ɛ́mɔtie, bɛ bɔ bewura ndaadeɛ nyemenenyemene ne de, ahemvo mɔ b’awuro yeɛ bɛte ɔ.

english_verse: What did you really go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was. I tell you that he was more than a prophet.
translation_verse: Anaakyɛ nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛmɔsili nu bɛhɔ bɛɛneane ɔ? Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ anaa? Yoo, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɔtra ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ po.

english_verse: I tell you no one ever born on this earth is greater than John the Baptist. But whoever is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than John.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, bɛ bɔ mmrasua awo bɛ amukoraa, bɛ nu biala oddwɔsole bɔ odi mu tra Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane ɔ. Nakoso bɔ ɔte kãa koraa wɔ nyameɛso ahennie ne anu ne po odi mu tra ye.

english_verse: From the time of John the Baptist until now, violent people have been trying to take over the kingdom of heaven by force.
translation_verse: Na ofi Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane aberɛ so bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, nyameɛso ahennie ne ɔ́ba anyeborolɛ so; na bɛ bɔ bɛ nye aboro ne bɛfa ye anyeborolɛ so.

english_verse: And if you believe them, John is Elijah, the prophet you are waiting for.
translation_verse: na sɛ ɛmɔkuro kyɛ ɛmɔde bɛto nu a, ye ole Elia bɔ ɔ́ba ne.

english_verse: You people are like children sitting in the market and shouting to each other,
translation_verse: “Na nwa mɔ nwo yeɛ ngɔfa ɛnɛmmafoɛ ngɔtoto ɔ? Bɛte kyɛ ngwadaa bɔ bɛtete dwaaso, bɔ bɛ́frɛfrɛ bɛ mmango kyɛ,

english_verse: “We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not mourn!”
translation_verse: ‘Yɛhuli awɛen yɛhyirele ɛmɔ, na ɛmɔango; yɛbɔle awuye yɛhyirele ɛmɔ, na ɛmɔ wora ammɔ’

english_verse: But the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, and you say, “That man eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners.” Yet Wisdom is shown to be right by what it does. The Unbelieving Towns (Luke
translation_verse: Na Sona Awa ne wale ne, odidi, yeɛ ɔno, na bɛnwa: ‘Ɛ́mɔnea, adifuu ne akɔnomnzaniɛ, ɛtoɔdidelɛfoɛ ne bɔnefoɛ adamvo!’ Nakoso nworɛ nate ye nnwumaa so di be.” Korasin, Betesaeda ne Kapanɔm (Luka

english_verse: In the towns where Jesus had worked most of his miracles, the people refused to turn to God. So Jesus was upset with them and said:
translation_verse: Nguro bɔ Yesu yɔle ye nnwumaa mbiri mbiri pee wɔ nu ne, banzakyera b’adwene, yiti ɔhyɛle ye bo hwili bɛ nyunu kyɛ,

english_verse: People of Capernaum, do you think you will be honored in heaven? You will go down to hell! If the miracles that took place in your town had happened in Sodom, it would still be standing.
translation_verse: Na wɔ, Kapanɔm, bɛkɔma wɔ so bɛkɔhɔ nyameɛso anaa? Daabi. Bekogyi wɔ bɛkɔto abɔnzam see nu. Ofikyɛ, nnwumaa mbiri mbiri bɔ bɛyɔle bɛ wɔ wɔ nu ne, sɛ bɛyɔle bɛ wɔ Sodom a, ahaa ɔtɛwɔ berɛ maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

english_verse: So I tell you on the day of judgment the people of Sodom will get off easier than you. Come to Me and Rest (Luke
translation_verse: Yiti mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ndɛenbualɛ kyẽa ne, amaneɛ bɔ ɔkɔto Sodom aseɛ ne, ongodwu bɔ ɔkɔto wɔ ne!” Yesu ye Baba ne kyire (Luka

english_verse: At that moment Jesus said: My Father, Lord of heaven and earth, I am grateful that you hid all this from wise and educated people and showed it to ordinary people.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, Yesu hane kyɛ, “Baba, anwuro ne aseɛ Mene, meda wɔ ase kyɛ afa edwirɛ hemɔ afea nworɛfoɛ ne nimdeɛfoɛ, ná aye ahyire ngokwaammaa ɔ.

english_verse: Yes, Father, this is what pleased you.
translation_verse: Yoo, Baba, sɔ yeɛ ɔte nikyee bɔ ɔyɛ nyemene wɔ wɔ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: My Father has given me everything, and he is the only one who knows the Son. The only one who truly knows the Father is the Son. But the Son wants to tell others about the Father, so they can know him too.
translation_verse: Me Baba afa nningyein amukoraa awura me sa; na ebiala nze Baa ne, sana Baba ne; yeɛ ebiala nze Baba ne, sana Baa ne ne ebiala bɔ Baa ne kuro kyɛ ɔda ye adi kyire ye ɔ.

english_verse: If you are tired from carrying heavy burdens, come to me and I will give you rest.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ ɛmɔayɔ adwuma bafɛ ná bafa adesoa nonɛnonɛ basoa ɛmɔ ne, ɛmɔbra me berɛ, na ngɔmaa ɛmɔkole ɛmɔ nwome.

english_verse: Take the yoke I give you. Put it on your shoulders and learn from me. I am gentle and humble, and you will find rest.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa me kɔnnua ne bɛ́to bɛ nwo so, na ɛ́mɔsua me, ofikyɛ medwo na mebrɛ me nwo ase wɔ ahone nu, na ɛmɔkonya nwomelelɛ bɛkɔma ɛmɔ kra.

english_verse: This yoke is easy to bear, and this burden is light.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me kɔnnua ne yɛ mmerɛ, yeɛ m’adesoa ne anu yɛ nyera.”
