translation_verse: Na ɔhɔle ye bɔbɔ ye kuro nen, ɔyɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ hyirele bɛ wɔ bɛ nyianu sua nu maa bɛ nwo dwirili bɛ, na bebisale kyɛ, “Nisua yeɛ biaa he onyane sɔ nworɛ ne anwanwadeɛ tumi hemɔ fili ɔ?

english_verse: Isn't he the son of the carpenter? Isn't Mary his mother, and aren't James, Joseph, Simon, and Judas his brothers?
translation_verse: Bakaa dwumvoɛ ne, aso nna ɔwa ne ɛhe? Aso bɛmvrɛ ye maame Maria? Aso nna oliɛma mmienzua mɔ ole Yakobo ne Yosef ne Simɔn ne Yudase?

english_verse: Don't his sisters still live here in our town? How can he do all this?”
translation_verse: Aso nna oliɛma mmrasua mukoraa yeɛ yɛne bɛ wɔ ɛwa ye? Na nisua koraa yeɛ biaa he oonyane ɛhemɔ amukoraa ɔ?”

english_verse: So the people were upset because of what he was doing. But Jesus said, “Prophets are honored by everyone, except the people of their hometown and their own family.”
translation_verse: Yiti bɛpole ye. Na Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Anidie mmɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ, sana ye bɔbɔ ye kuro ne ye awuro.”

english_verse: And because the people did not have any faith, Jesus did not work many miracles there.
translation_verse: Na wanyɔ anwanwadeɛ pee wɔ berɛ, ɔnate elelɛ bɔ banne banni ne ati.

english_verse: When Jesus got out of the boat, he saw the large crowd. He felt sorry for them and healed everyone who was sick.
translation_verse: Ofili ɛlɛen ne anu dwuli ná onwuni mmenia wora nen, bɛyɛle ye anwumvo, na ɔsale bɛ nu ayarefoɛ nemɔ anwonyerɛ.

english_verse: “Come on!” Jesus said. Peter then got out of the boat and started walking on the water toward him.
translation_verse: Na obuale kyɛ, “Bra!” Yiti Petro fili ɛlɛen ne anu dwuli natele nzue n’anye so kyɛ ɔkɔ Yesu nwo dɔ.

english_verse: so much he swore to give her whatever she wanted.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔbɔle anohoba tale ndaen foale so kyɛ ɔkɔfa nikyee biala bɔ okobisa ɔ kɔma ye.

english_verse: and told his officials, “This is John the Baptist! He has come back from death, and that's why he has the power to work these miracles.”
translation_verse: na osele ye somvoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane ne, ye ɛne; watingye wafi awufoɛ nu, yiti yeɛ ɔmaa wanya tumi bɔ ɔkora yɔ anwanwadeɛ hemɔ ye?”

english_verse: But the girl's mother told her to say, “Here on a serving plate I want the head of John the Baptist!”
translation_verse: Na oni mane ye adwene tɛɛ kyɛ ɔhã kyɛ, “Fa Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane ye ti bɔ ɔla prɛte nu ɔ ma me ɛwa ala!”

english_verse: It was taken on a serving plate to the girl, and she gave it to her mother.
translation_verse: Bɛfale ye ti ne bɔ ɔla prɛte nu ɔ bɛbrɛle abaayaa ne, na ye koso ɔɔfa mane oni.

english_verse: John's followers took his body and buried it. Then they told Jesus what had happened. Jesus Feeds Five Thousand (Mark
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yohane asuafoɛ nemɔ wale bɛɛfale ye fuin ne besiele ye, na bɛɛbɔle Yesu amaneɛ. Yesu ma mmenia apee nnu aleɛ (Marko

english_verse: But when Peter saw how strong the wind was, he was afraid and started sinking. “Save me, Lord!” he shouted.
translation_verse: Nakoso onwuni mvrama bagyabagya ne nen, ɛserɛ hane ye; na ɔhyɛle ye bo kyɛ ɔmono nen, ɔteane nu kyɛ, “Awurade, de me!”

english_verse: But they said, “We have only five small loaves of bread and two fish.”
translation_verse: Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Yɛlle aleɛ biala wɔ wa, sana paanoo nnu ne tiré nyɔ.”

english_verse: After Jesus heard about John, he crossed Lake Galilee to go to some place where he could be alone. But the crowds found out and followed him on foot from the towns.
translation_verse: Yesu tele edwirɛ bɔ wasi nen, ɔfale ɛlɛen ofili berɛ hɔle nekaa bie bɔ berɛ te dinn ɔ. Nakoso ɛlɔen ne tele nen, bɛfale ase befili nguro nemɔ aso bɛpole ye.

english_verse: Jesus replied, “They don't have to leave. Why don't you give them something to eat?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Onhia kyɛ bɛkɔ ɔ, ɛ́mɔma bɛ nikyee ma beli!”

english_verse: Jesus asked his disciples to bring the food to him,
translation_verse: Na osele kyɛ, “Ɛmɔfa bɛbrɛ me wa.”

english_verse: and he told the crowd to sit down on the grass. Jesus took the five loaves and the two fish. He looked up toward heaven and blessed the food. Then he broke the bread and handed it to his disciples, and they gave it to the people.
translation_verse: Afei ɔmane ɛlɔen ne bɛtenatenane ase wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso. Na ɔfale paanoo nnu ne tiré nyɔ ne, ɔtole ye nye neane nyameɛso, oyirale so, obubuli nu, na ɔfale paanoo ne mane ye asuafoɛ nemɔ, na asuafoɛ nemɔ koso bɛfa bɛmane ɛlɔen ne.

english_verse: After everyone had eaten all they wanted, Jesus' disciples picked up twelve large baskets of leftovers.
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa bedidili bɛmane bɛ ko yili; na ye bo mboporoka ne, asuafoɛ nemɔ boaboa guale ngɛndɛen buru ne nyɔ nu maa beyili fokyefokyee.

english_verse: At once, Jesus made his disciples get into a boat and start back across the lake. But he stayed until he had sent the crowds away.
translation_verse: Berɛ ne ala, Yesu hyɛle asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ bɛ́fo ɛlɛen nu beli moa bɛhɔ asue ne asi dɔ, ná ye de ogua ɛlɔen ne ate koraka.

english_verse: Then he went up on a mountain where he could be alone and pray. Later in the evening, he was still there.
translation_verse: Na oguale ɛlɔen ne ate yiele nen, ye ngome ɔhɔle bokaa bie so kyɛ ɔkwaabɔ mbaeɛ. Na aleɛ dwole nen, né ye ngome yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: By this time the boat was a long way from the shore. It was going against the wind and was being tossed around by the waves.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né ɛlɛen ne adwu ɛpo n’afia dɔ bɔ asorɔkye ohuruhuru ye ɔ, ofikyɛ né mvrama ne ɔbɔ yia bɛ.

english_verse: A little while before morning, Jesus came walking on the water toward his disciples.
translation_verse: Na alebahyene ne, Yesu natele ɛpo n’anye so hɔle bɛ dɔ.

english_verse: When they saw him, they thought he was a ghost. They were terrified and started screaming.
translation_verse: Na asuafoɛ nemɔ nwuni ye kyɛ ɔnate ɛpo n’anye so nen, besurole, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Ɛnwomee ɔ!” Na ɛserɛ hane bɛ maa bɛteateane nu.

english_verse: At once, Jesus said to them, “Don't worry! I am Jesus. Don't be afraid.”
translation_verse: Na berɛ ne ala, Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ ahone tɔ ɛmɔ kunu, me ɔ; nnɛma ɛmɔsuro!”

english_verse: Peter replied, “Lord, if it really is you, tell me to come to you on the water.”
translation_verse: Na Petro buale ye kyɛ, “Awurade, sɛ wɔ ahɔ a, nzaade maa mva nzue n’anye so mmra wɔ dɔ.”

english_verse: At once, Jesus reached out his hand. He helped Peter up and said, “You surely don't have much faith. Why do you doubt?”
translation_verse: Na ndɛndɛ, Yesu tengyɛle ye sa sɔle ye nu, na osele ye kyɛ, “O, wɔ bɔ wɔ gyidie te kãa ɔ! Nzu ati yeɛ esuli aporowaa ɔ?”

english_verse: When Jesus and Peter got into the boat, the wind died down.
translation_verse: Na bɛtenane ɛlɛen ne anu nen, mvrama ne yakyili tulɛ.

english_verse: The men in the boat worshiped Jesus and said, “You really are the Son of God!” Jesus Heals Sick People in Gennesaret (Mark
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ ɛlɛen ne anu ne, bɛɛsɔnene ye, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Amba, wɔ ole Nyameɛ Awa ne.” Yesu sa anwonyerɛ wɔ Gɛnesarɛte (Marko

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples crossed the lake and came to shore near the town of Gennesaret.
translation_verse: Bɛpɛle nzue ne, na beedwuli Gɛnesarɛte aseɛ so.

english_verse: The people found out he was there, and they sent word to everyone who lived in this part of the country. So they brought all the sick people to Jesus.
translation_verse: Na berɛ ama nwuni ye sona horɛ nen, bɛsomane mmenia maa bɛhɔle mbɔtam berɛ amukoraa, na bɛfale bɛ bɔ bɛnde apɔ amukoraa bɛbrɛle ye;

english_verse: They begged him just to let them touch his clothes, and everyone who did was healed.
translation_verse: na bɛsrɛle ye kyɛ ɔma bɛfa bɛ sa bɛhã ye ataadeɛ noa ala; na mmenia wora bɔ bɛfale bɛ sa bɛhane ye ne, bɛtele apɔ.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Every plant that my Father in heaven did not plant will be pulled up by the roots.
translation_verse: Na obuale kyɛ, “Bakaa biala bɔ nna me Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne yeɛ oluale nen, bekotutu ye bo.

english_verse: “Why don't your disciples obey what our ancestors taught us to do? They don't even wash their hands before they eat.”
translation_verse: “Nzu ati yeɛ w’asuafoɛ nemɔ benni mbanyi mɔ b’amammerɛ ne aso ɔ? Ofikyɛ bennwunzi bɛ sa koraka né badidi.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: Why do you disobey God and follow your own teaching?
translation_verse: Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɔnate ɛmɔ amammerɛ ti ɛmɔbu Nyameɛ mmeraa dwirɛ so ɔ?

english_verse: But you let people get by without helping their parents when they should. You let them say that what they have has been offered to God.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔnwa: ‘Sɛ ebie kã kyire ɔse anaa oni kyɛ, ‘Nikyee biala bɔ ahaa ekonya kofi me berɛ nen, mafa mama Nyameɛ’ a, ye de onhia kyɛ sɔ sona ne odi ɔse anaa oni ni ɔ.

english_verse: It is useless for you to worship me, when you teach rules made up by humans.” What Really Makes People Unclean (Mark
translation_verse: Bɛsɔne me mbaen, na mmenia nhyehyɛleɛ yeɛ bekyirekyire ɔ!’ ” Bɔ ogua sona nwo fiɛ ɔ (Marko

english_verse: Stay away from those Pharisees! They are like blind people leading other blind people, and all of them will fall into a ditch.”
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔtɛ bɛ so! Bɛte anyesiniwaafoɛ bɔ bekyire anyesiniwaafoɛ atee ɔ. Na sɛ anyesiniwaaniɛ kyire anyesiniwaaniɛ atee a, bɛ munyɔ bɛkɔtɔ kumaa nu.”

english_verse: Jesus did not say a word. But the woman kept following along and shouting, so his disciples came up and asked him to send her away.
translation_verse: Nakoso Yesu andɛ ye so. Na ye asuafoɛ nemɔ wale bɛɛsrɛle ye kyɛ, “Maa ɔhɔ, ofikyɛ ɔteatea nu di yɛ si!”

english_verse: The food you put into your mouth doesn't make you unclean and unfit to worship God. The bad words that come out of your mouth are what make you unclean.”
translation_verse: “Nna bɔ ɔkɔ sona noa nu yeɛ ogua ye nwo fiɛ ɔ, na mmom bɔ ofi sona noa nu ba ne yeɛ ogua ye nwo fiɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Then his disciples came over to him and asked, “Do you know you insulted the Pharisees by what you said?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ ye asuafoɛ nemɔ wale beesele ye kyɛ, “Farasiifoɛ nemɔ bɛtele sɔ dwirɛ ne nen, aso ɛse kyɛ wanyɛ bɛ fɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Peter replied, “What did you mean when you talked about the things that make people unclean?”
translation_verse: Na Petro sele ye kyɛ, “Anyandera he, kyire yɛ ye bo.”

english_verse: Jesus then said: Don't any of you know by now what I am talking about?
translation_verse: Na obuale kyɛ, “Na ɛmɔ koso, ɛnɛ ne ɛnɛ ye, ɛmɔnde ye bo anaa?

english_verse: Don't you know that the food you put into your mouth goes into your stomach and then out of your body?
translation_verse: Aso ɛmɔnnwu ye kyɛ nikyee biala bɔ ɔkɔ bɛ noa nu ne okogua bɛ kunu, ná afei ɔsẽ kogua yaen nu ɔ?

english_verse: But the words that come out of your mouth come from your heart. And they are what make you unfit to worship God.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɔ ofi bɛ noa nu ba ne de, ofi b’ahone nu yeɛ ɔba ɔ, na ye yeɛ ogua sona nwo fiɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Out of your heart come evil thoughts, murder, unfaithfulness in marriage, vulgar deeds, stealing, telling lies, and insulting others.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ahone nu yeɛ adwenemmɔne, awuelilɛ, agyaasɛkyelɛ, adwamanbɔlɛ, awue, adanzewia ne musue dwirɛ fi ba ɔ.

english_verse: These are what make you unclean. Eating without washing your hands will not make you unfit to worship God. A Woman's Faith (Mark
translation_verse: Sɔ nningyein nemɔ yeɛ begua sona nwo fiɛ ɔ, na sɛ annwunzi wɔ sa ná edidi a, ongua sona nwo fiɛ.” Amaenmaensoniɛ braa bie gyidie (Marko

english_verse: Jesus said, “I was sent only to the people of Israel! They are like a flock of lost sheep.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “Mmoaen bɔ bamini bɔ bɛ ole Yisrael awuro ama ne, bɛ ngome bɛ berɛ yeɛ bɛsomane me ɔ.”

english_verse: Large crowds came and brought many people who were paralyzed or blind or lame or unable to talk. They placed them, and many others, in front of Jesus, and he healed them all.
translation_verse: Na mmenia pee fale mbakye, mmubuafoɛ, anyesiniwaafoɛ, emumu mɔ ne ayarefoɛ foforɛ pee bɛwale ye berɛ; na bɛfale bɛ beeguale ye gya bo, na ɔsale bɛ anwonyerɛ.

english_verse: Jesus left and went to the territory near the towns of Tyre and Sidon.
translation_verse: Afei Yesu fili berɛ hɔle Tiro ne Sidon mbɔtam.

english_verse: Suddenly a Canaanite woman from there came out shouting, “Lord and Son of David, have pity on me! My daughter is full of demons.”
translation_verse: Na yieee, Kanaanniɛ braa bie bɔ ofi mbɔtam berɛ ɔ wale, na ɔteane nu kyɛ, “O Awurade, Dawide Awa, nwu me anwumvoin, na sunzummɔne bie ɔha mma brasua paa.”

english_verse: The woman came closer. Then she knelt down and begged, “Please help me, Lord!”
translation_verse: Na braa ne wale ooguale ndwerɛ wɔ Yesu nyunu berɛ srɛle ye kyɛ, “Awurade, boka me!”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “It isn't right to take food away from children and feed it to dogs.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “Ɔtte mayee kyɛ bɛkɔfa mmaa mɔ b’aleɛ bekogyi bekogua ngyea berɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: “Lord, this is true,” the woman said, “but even puppies get the crumbs that fall from their owner's table.”
translation_verse: Na braa ne hane kyɛ, “Amba, Awurade, nakoso ngyea mmaa nemɔ bedi aleɛ ne boso bɔ ɔporo fi bɛ mene poen so gua ase ne.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Dear woman, you really do have a lot of faith, and you will be given what you want.” At that moment her daughter was healed. Jesus Heals Many People
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Mmobraa, wɔ gyidie te piri! Ɔ́yɛ sɔ ma wɔ kyɛbɔ ɛpena ɔ.” Na berɛ ne ala, ɔwa brasua ne tele apɔ. Yesu sa mmenia pee anwonyerɛ (Marko

english_verse: From there, Jesus went along Lake Galilee. Then he climbed a hill and sat down.
translation_verse: Afei Yesu fili berɛ ɔɔfale Galilea ɛpo ne noa. Na ɔhɔle bokaa bie so ɔɔtenane ase.

english_verse: Everyone was amazed at what they saw and heard. People who had never spoken could now speak. The lame were healed, the paralyzed could walk, and the blind were able to see. Everyone was praising the God of Israel. Jesus Feeds Four Thousand (Mark
translation_verse: Yiti ɔyɛle ɛlɔen ne nwanwa, mmerɛ bɔ benwuni kyɛ emumu dwudwo, ná mbakye nwo asa, ná mmubuafoɛ nate, ná anyesiniwaafoɛ benwu nikye ne; na bɛhyɛle Yisrael Nyameɛ animnyam. Yesu ma mmenia apee nna aleɛ (Marko

english_verse: Jesus called his disciples together and told them, “I feel sorry for these people. They have been with me for three days, and they don't have anything to eat. I don't want to send them away hungry. They might faint on their way home.”
translation_verse: Afei Yesu frɛle ye asuafoɛ nemɔ, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Mmenia hemɔ bɛyɛ me anwumvo, ofikyɛ bali me nwo wa ɛlɛsa ɛhe, bɔ nikye fee nne berɛ bɔ bekoli ɔ; na menguro kyɛ ngɔmaa bɛkɔfa ɛhɔen bekosa bɛkɔhɔ ɔ, anyɛ a, né bapepɛ bafi atunu.”

english_verse: His disciples said, “This place is like a desert. Where can we find enough food to feed such a crowd?”
translation_verse: Na asuafoɛ nemɔ bisale ye kyɛ, “Nisua yeɛ yɛkonya aleɛ wɔ ɛserɛ ye aso wa, bɔ ɔkɔso mmenia wora he di ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus asked them how much food they had. They replied, “Seven small loaves of bread and a few little fish.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Paanoo nyɛɛ yeɛ ɛmɔle ye wɔ berɛ ɔ?” Bebuale kyɛ, “Nzoo, ɔne tiré mmaa mmaa kãa bie.”

english_verse: After Jesus had told the people to sit down,
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu mane ɛlɔen ne tenatenane ase.

english_verse: he took the seven loaves of bread and the fish and gave thanks. He then broke them and handed them to his disciples, who passed them around to the crowds.
translation_verse: Afei ɔfale paanoo nzoo ne ne tiré ne, ɔlale ase, na obubuli nu, ɔfa mane ye asuafoɛ nemɔ, na asuafoɛ nemɔ koso bɛfa bɛmane ɛlɔen ne.

english_verse: Everyone ate all they wanted, and the leftovers filled seven large baskets.
translation_verse: Na bɛ mukoraa bedidili bɛmane bɛ ko yili; na bɛsesale ye bo mboporoka ne beguale ngɛndɛen nzoo nu maa beyili fokyefokyee.

english_verse: Don't you know by now that I am not talking to you about bread? Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees!
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔnnwu ye kyɛ nna paanoo yeɛ mekã ye nwo dwirɛ ɔ? Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ Farasiifoɛ ne Sadusiifoɛ mɔle harewaa nwo!”

english_verse: When Jesus and his disciples were near the town of Caesarea Philippi, he asked them, “What do people say about the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ Yesu dwuli Kaesarea Filipi mbɔtam nen, obisale ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Mmenia nwa Sona Awa ne ole nwa?”

english_verse: Finally, the disciples understood that Jesus wasn't talking about the yeast used to make bread, but about the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees. Who Is Jesus? (Mark
translation_verse: Afei bɛtele ye bo kyɛ nna paanoo harewaa yeɛ osele bɛ kyɛ bɛ́nea bɛ nwo yé wɔ ye nwo ɔ, na mmom Farasiifoɛ ne Sadusiifoɛ bɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ nwo. Petro kyire sona horɛ bɔ Yesu te ɔ (Marko

english_verse: He told them: If the sky is red in the evening, you say the weather will be good.
translation_verse: [Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ odwu nɔsoa a, ɛmɔnwa: ‘Ewienu kɔte, ofikyɛ ewienu ayɛ kɔɔ.’

english_verse: But if the sky is red and gloomy in the morning, you say it is going to rain. You can tell what the weather will be like by looking at the sky. But you don't understand what is happening now.
translation_verse: Na ngyerɛmɔ de, ɛmɔnwa: ‘Mvrama kotu ɛnɛ, ofikyɛ ewienu ayɛ kɔɔ ne kusuu.’ Ɛmɔse kyɛbɔ besi bekyire ewienu dwirɛ bo ɔ, nakoso mmerɛ ne nwo nzɛngyerɛnneɛ de, ɛmɔngora nu kyire.]

english_verse: The disciples answered, “Some people say you are John the Baptist or maybe Elijah or Jeremiah or some other prophet.”
translation_verse: Na bebuale kyɛ, “Ebiemɔ nwa: Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane; ebiemɔ koso nwa: Elia; yeɛ ebiemɔ nwa Yeremia anaa ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ nu ko.”

english_verse: From then on, Jesus began telling his disciples what would happen to him. He said, “I must go to Jerusalem. There the nation's leaders, the chief priests, and the teachers of the Law of Moses will make me suffer terribly. I will be killed, but three days later I will rise to life.”
translation_verse: Ofi sɔ mmerɛ ne, Yesu hyɛle ye bo hyirele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, odi kyɛ ɔkɔ Yerusalem ná okonwu amaneɛ pee wɔ maen mbanyi ne asɔfo mbanyi ne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ mɔ bɛ sa nu, ná beku ye, ná ye ɛlɛsa so otingye.

english_verse: Jesus then warned them, “Watch out! Guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea yé; ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ Farasiifoɛ ne Sadusiifoɛ mɔle harewaa nwo!”

english_verse: The disciples talked this over and said to each other, “He must be saying this because we didn't bring along any bread.”
translation_verse: Na bɛdwenedwenene ye nwo bɛhane kyɛ, “Yamva paanoo yamma ne ati ɔ.”

english_verse: The Son of Man will soon come in the glory of his Father and with his angels to reward all people for what they have done.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, Sona Awa ne ɔne ye abɔfo mɔ bɛkɔwa ye Baba animnyam nu, na okotua ebiala kerɛ kyɛbɔ ye yɔleɛ si te ɔ.

english_verse: So I will call you Peter, which means “a rock.” On this rock I will build my church, and death itself will not have any power over it.
translation_verse: Na me, mekã mekyire wɔ kyɛ: Wɔ ole Petro, na nyɔbotaen he aso yeɛ ngosi m’asɔre ngosie ɔ, na ewue tumi ngɔhora ngoli so ngonim.

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “But who do you say I am?”
translation_verse: Na obisale bɛ kyɛ, “Na ɛmɔ koso, ɛmɔnwa nwa ole me?”

english_verse: Simon Peter spoke up, “You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God.”
translation_verse: Na Simɔn Petro buale kyɛ, “Wɔ ole Kristo ne, Nyameɛ teasefoɛ n’Awa ne.”

english_verse: Jesus told him: Simon, son of Jonah, you are blessed! You didn't discover this on your own. It was shown to you by my Father in heaven.
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “Anya saleɛ, Yona awa, Simɔn! Ofikyɛ nna anwoɔnaen ne mogya yeɛ baye he bahyire wɔ ɔ, na mmom me Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne ɔ.

english_verse: I will give you the keys to the kingdom of heaven, and God in heaven will allow whatever you allow on earth. But he will not allow anything you don't allow.
translation_verse: Ngɔfa nyameɛso ahennie nzafoaa ngowura wɔ sa, na nikyee biala bɔ ɛkɔkyekye ye wɔ aseɛ so nen, bɛkɔkyekye ye wɔ nyameɛso; yeɛ nikyee biala bɔ ɛkɔsangye nu wɔ aseɛ so nen, bɛkɔsangye nu wɔ nyameɛso.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples not to tell anyone he was the Messiah. Jesus Speaks about His Suffering and Death (Mark
translation_verse: Na ɔhyɛle asuafoɛ nemɔ kitii kyɛ nnɛmaa bɛbɔ so bekyire ebiala kyɛ ye ole Kristo ne. Yesu hyɛ ye wue ne ye tingyelɛ nwo ngɔm (Marko

english_verse: Peter took Jesus aside and told him to stop talking like that. He said, “God would never let this happen to you, Lord!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Petro fale ye hɔle ahameɛ, na ɔhyɛle ye bo ohwili ye nyunu kyɛ, “Nyameɛ pa gua, Awurade! Ɛhe ngɔto wɔ le!”

english_verse: Jesus turned to Peter and said, “Satan, get away from me! You're in my way because you think like everyone else and not like God.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkakyili ye nwo sele Petro kyɛ, “Dwɔso berɛ kɔ dɔ, Abɔnzam! Ɛte sundidua ma me; ofikyɛ nna Nyameɛ adwene yeɛ ɛdwene ɔ, na mmom ɛdwene kuro sona adwene.”

english_verse: Then Jesus said to his disciples: If any of you want to be my followers, you must forget about yourself. You must take up your cross and follow me.
translation_verse: Na Yesu sele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Sɛ ebie kuro kyɛ odi me si a, maa ɔpa ye nwo si, ná ɔfa ye mmeamudua, ná oli me si.

english_verse: If you want to save your life, you will destroy it. But if you give up your life for me, you will find it.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ okuro kyɛ ode ye kra ngoa nen, ɔkɔhwere ye; nakoso ebiala bɔ ɔnate me ti ɔkɔhwere ye ngoa nen, ye sa kɔhã ye.

english_verse: What will you gain, if you own the whole world but destroy yourself? What would you give to get back your soul?
translation_verse: Na sɛ sona nya ewiase amukoraa ná ɔhwere ye kra a, nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ okonya ɔ? Anaakyɛ, nzikyɛ yeɛ sona kɔhora kɔfa kɔsesã ye kra ngoa ɔ?

english_verse: I promise you some of those standing here will not die before they see the Son of Man coming with his kingdom.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, mmenia biemɔ gyigyi wa bɔ bengonwu ewue kɔpem kyɛ bekonwu Sona Awa ne kyɛ ɔ́ba ye ahennie nu ɔ.”

english_verse: There in front of the disciples, Jesus was completely changed. His face was shining like the sun, and his clothes became white as light.
translation_verse: Na ɔsesane wɔ bɛ nyunu berɛ, ye nyunu tale kyɛ eyia, na ye ndaadeɛ yɛle hyɛnn kyɛ kanea.

english_verse: Then the disciples understood Jesus was talking to them about John the Baptist. Jesus Heals a Boy (Mark
translation_verse: Afei asuafoɛ nemɔ nyane ndeaseɛ kyɛ Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane nwo dwirɛ yeɛ né ɔkã kyire bɛ ɔ. Yesu tu sunzummɔne fi abɛɛmaa bie nu (Marko

english_verse: Six days later Jesus took Peter and the brothers James and John with him. They went up on a very high mountain where they could be alone.
translation_verse: Na ye elesia asi ne, Yesu fale Petro ne Yakobo ne oliɛma Yohane bokale ye nwo so, na ɔfale bɛ hɔle bokaa tendenn bie aso.

english_verse: All at once Moses and Elijah were there talking with Jesus.
translation_verse: Na yieee, Mose ne Elia bɛyele bɛ nwo ali behyirele bɛ, na bɛ ne Yesu dwudwole.

english_verse: So Peter said to him, “Lord, it is good for us to be here! Let us make three shelters, one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
translation_verse: Na Petro sele Yesu kyɛ, “Awurade, ɔte paa kyɛ yɛtena wa ɔ; na sɛ ekuro a, ngɔbɔ asese nza wɔ wa, wɔ deɛ ko, Mose deɛ ko, yeɛ Elia deɛ ko.”

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the shadow of a bright cloud passed over them. From the cloud a voice said, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him. Listen to what he says!”
translation_verse: Ogu so odwudwo ne ala, yieee, munungum hyɛnhyɛnn bie ɔɔkatale bɛ so, na edwudwolɛ bie fili munungum ne anu hane kyɛ, “Mma bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo ná me nye gye ye nwo paa ne ɛhe; ɛ́mɔtie ye!”

english_verse: When the disciples heard the voice, they were so afraid they fell flat on the ground.
translation_verse: Na asuafoɛ nemɔ tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, bɛfale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli berɛ, na ɛserɛ hane bɛ paa.

english_verse: But Jesus came over and touched them. He said, “Get up and don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Na Yesu wale ɔɔsosɔle bɛ nu hane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔdwɔso, na nnɛma ɛmɔsuro!”

english_verse: When they opened their eyes, they saw only Jesus.
translation_verse: Na bɛpagyale bɛ ti so nen, bannwu ebiala, sana Yesu ngome.

english_verse: The disciples asked Jesus, “Don't the teachers of the Law of Moses say Elijah must come before the Messiah does?”
translation_verse: Na asuafoɛ nemɔ bisale ye kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ahyerɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛnwa odi kyɛ Elia di moa ba koraka ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus told them, “Elijah certainly will come and get everything ready.
translation_verse: Na obuale kyɛ, “Odi kyɛ Elia di moa ba amba, ná ɔbatoto nningyein mukoraa yé;

english_verse: In fact, he has already come. But the people did not recognize him and treated him just as they wanted to. They will soon make the Son of Man suffer in the same way.”
translation_verse: nakoso mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, Elia awa dada, na bannwu ye, na bɛfale bɔ bekuro biala belili ye. Na sɔ ala yeɛ Sona Awa ne koso konwu amaneɛ wɔ bɛ sa nu ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus and his disciples returned to the crowd. A man knelt in front of him
translation_verse: Bedwuli ɛlɔen ne anwo berɛ nen, biaa bie wale Yesu berɛ, oguale ndwerɛ wɔ ye nyunu, na ɔsrɛle ye kyɛ,

english_verse: and said, “Lord, have pity on my son! He has a bad case of epilepsy and often falls into a fire or into water.
translation_verse: “Awurade, nwu mma bienzua ye anwumvoin, ofikyɛ ɔpɛ, na onwu amaneɛ paa; na ɔtaa pɛ tɔ see nu, yeɛ ɔtaa pɛ tɔ nzue nu.

english_verse: I brought him to your disciples, but none of them could heal him.”
translation_verse: Mvale ye mmrɛle w’asuafoɛ nemɔ, nakoso bangora banza ye anwonyerɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said, “You people are too stubborn to have any faith! How much longer must I be with you? Why do I have to put up with you? Bring the boy here.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “O ɛnɛmmafoɛ asoserɛfoɛ bɔ ɛmɔlle gyidie ɔ! Me ne ɛmɔ yɛtena maa odwu kyinzu? Nya ɛmɔ nwo aboterɛ maa odwu kyinzu? Ɛ́mɔfa ye bɛbrɛ me wa!”

english_verse: Then Jesus spoke sternly to the demon. It went out of the boy, and right then he was healed.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu teateane sunzummɔne ne, na ofili ye nu fitele, na akwadaa ne tele apɔ berɛ ne ala.

english_verse: Later the disciples went to Jesus in private and asked him, “Why couldn't we force out the demon?”
translation_verse: Na asuafoɛ nemɔ wale Yesu berɛ bɛ ne ye beetuli asure bebisale ye kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ yɛ de yangora yandu ye ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: It is because you don't have enough faith! But I can promise you this. If you had faith no larger than a mustard seed, you could tell this mountain to move from here to there. And it would. Everything would be possible for you. Jesus Again Speaks about His Death (Mark
translation_verse: Na sɔ nikyee he de, kyɛbɔ osi te ne, ye bo ngora tu, sana mbaeɛ ne ɛhɔenhyelɛ yeɛ otu ye ɔ.] Yesu wue ne ye tingyelɛ nwo ngɔm (Marko

english_verse: While Jesus and his disciples were going from place to place in Galilee, he told them, “The Son of Man will be handed over to people
translation_verse: Na bɛboale bɛ noa wɔ Galilea nen, Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Bɛkɔye Sona Awa ne bekowura mmenia sa;

english_verse: who will kill him. But three days later he will rise to life.” All of this made the disciples very sad. Paying the Temple Tax
translation_verse: na bekohu ye, na ye ɛlɛsa so okotingye.” Na ɔyɛle bɛ aworabɔ paa. Yesu tua asɔneyɛɛ sua nwo toɔ

english_verse: When Jesus and the others arrived in Capernaum, the collectors for the temple tax came to Peter and asked, “Does your teacher pay the temple tax?”
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ beedwuli Kapanɔm nen, asɔneyɛɛ sua nwo ɛtoɔdidelɛfoɛ wale Petro berɛ beebisale ye kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ kyerɛkyerɛniɛ ne, aso ondua ɛtoɔ ne anaa?”

english_verse: “Yes, he does,” Peter answered. After they had returned home, Jesus went up to Peter and asked him, “Simon, what do you think? Do the kings of this earth collect taxes and fees from their own people or from foreigners?”
translation_verse: Na obuale kyɛ, “Otua.” Na Petro wale awuro nen, Yesu lili moa bisale ye kyɛ; “Simɔn, ɛdwene ye nwo sɛ? Nwa mɔ dɔ yeɛ aseɛ so ahemvo mɔ bedide ndɔ anaa ɛtoɔ ɔ? Bɛ mma mɔ dɔ, anaa amanvrafoɛ mɔ dɔ?”

english_verse: Peter answered, “From foreigners.” Jesus replied, “Then their own people don't have to pay.
translation_verse: Na Petro buale kyɛ, “Amanvorafoɛ mɔ dɔ.” Yeɛ Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Nzaade né mmaa nemɔ bɛ nwo atɔ bɛ.

english_verse: But we don't want to cause trouble. So go cast a line into the lake and pull out the first fish you hook. Open its mouth, and you will find a coin. Use it to pay your taxes and mine.”
translation_verse: Nakoso, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ yɛngɔyɛ sundidua yɛngɔma bɛ ne ati, kɔ ɛpo nu kɔto koaa; na tiré bɔ ekoli moa kɔhye ye ne, sɛ ebukye ye noa nu a, ekonwu sikaa prɛnprɛn wɔ nu, na fa kotua me ne wɔ yɛ deɛ.”

english_verse: If your eye causes you to sin, poke it out and get rid of it. You would be better off to go into life with only one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fires of hell. The Lost Sheep (Luke
translation_verse: Yeɛ sɛ wɔ nye to wɔ sundidua a, tu ná gyi to! Ɔte paa ma wɔ kyɛ ɛkɔfa anyeɛ ko kɔhɔ ngoa nu tra kyɛ ɛkɔfa anyeɛ nyɔ, ná bekogyi wɔ bɛkɔto amaneɛnwunɛ see nu ɔ. Boaen bɔ wamini ne nwo anyandera (Luka

english_verse: Don't you think you should show pity to someone else, as I did to you?”
translation_verse: Aso onni kyɛ ahaa wɔ koso enwu ebiɛngo akoaa anwumvoin kyɛbɔ nwuni wɔ anwumvoin ne anaa?’

english_verse: But if you are as humble as this child, you are the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔbrɛ ye nwo ase kyɛ akwadaa he nen, ye yeɛ ɔte titire paa wɔ nyameɛso ahennie ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: And when you welcome one of these children because of me, you welcome me. Temptations To Sin (Mark
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ okole akwadaa bɔ ɔte kyɛ he kɔto nu wɔ me dumaa nu nen, né wale me wato nu.” Sundiduatolɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ (Marko

english_verse: If the follower refuses to listen to them, report the matter to the church. Anyone who refuses to listen to the church must be treated like an unbeliever or a tax collector. Allowing and Not Allowing
translation_verse: Na sɛ wandie bɛ koso a, kɔhã kyire asɔre ne. Na sɛ wandie asɔre ne koso a, ye de bu ye kyɛ bosoensolɛniɛ ne ɛtoɔdidelɛniɛ.

english_verse: It will be terrible for people who cause even one of my little followers to sin. Those people would be better off thrown into the deepest part of the ocean with a heavy stone tied around their necks!
translation_verse: “Na ebiala bɔ ɔkɔto ngwadaammaa hemɔ bɔ bede me bedi ye anu ko sundidua nen, ahaa ɔte paa ma sɔ sona ne kyɛ bɛkɔfa nyɔboɛ kandinga bɔ bɛfa beti aburoo bekosinze ye kɔme, ná bagyi ye bato ɛpo buma nu maa wamono ɔ.

english_verse: If your hand or foot causes you to sin, chop it off and throw it away! You would be better off to go into life paralyzed or lame than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into the fire that never goes out.
translation_verse: “Sɛ wɔ sa anaa wɔ gya to wɔ sundidua a, pɛ ná gyi to! Na ɔte paa ma wɔ kyɛ ɛkɔfa asaa ko anaa agyirɛ ko ɛkɔhɔ ngoa nu tra kyɛ ɛkɔfa asaa nyɔ anaa agyirɛ nyɔ, ná bekogyi wɔ bɛkɔto daa see nu ɔ.

english_verse: If one of my followers sins against you, go and point out what was wrong. But do it in private, just between the two of you. If that person listens, you have won back a follower.
translation_verse: “Sɛ eliɛma yɛ wɔ tɛɛ a, kɔhã ye mvomsoɛ kyire ye wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛne ye bɛ munyɔ pɛ yeɛ bɛwɔ berɛ ɔ. Sɛ otie wɔ a, anya eliɛma.

english_verse: Don't be cruel to any of these little ones! I promise you their angels are always with my Father in heaven.
translation_verse: [Ɔnate kyɛ, Sona Awa ne wale kyɛ ɔbaale bɛ bɔ bamini nemɔ ngoa.]

english_verse: That's how it is with your Father in heaven. He doesn't want any of these little ones to be lost. When Someone Sins (Luke
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne, onguro kyɛ ngwadaa hemɔ nu ko po komini ɔ. Sɛ ebie yɛ wɔ tɛɛ a

english_verse: But if that one refuses to listen, take along one or two others. The Scriptures teach that every complaint must be proven true by two or more witnesses.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ wandie a, fa sona ko anaa nyɔ boka wɔ nwo so, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ mmenia nyɔ anaa nza kɔyɛ edwirɛ ne nwo adanzefoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I promise you God in heaven will allow whatever you allow on earth, but God will not allow anything you don't allow.
translation_verse: “Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔkyekye ye wɔ aseɛ ye aso nen, bɛkɔkyekye ye nyameɛso; yeɛ nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔsangye nu wɔ aseɛ ye aso nen, bɛkɔsangye nu nyameɛso.

english_verse: I promise that when any two of you on earth agree about something you are praying for, my Father in heaven will do it for you.
translation_verse: “Nahorɛ nu, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ bieku kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔ nu nyɔ yɛ adwene ko aseɛ ye aso wɔ nikyee biala bɔ bekobisa nwo a, me Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne kɔyɔ kɔma bɛ.

english_verse: Whenever two or three of you come together in my name, I am there with you. An Official Who Refused To Forgive
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nekaa biala bɔ mmenia nyɔ anaa nza koyia nu me dumaa nu nen, né nwɔ b’afia wɔ berɛ.” Yesu bu bɔnefakyɛ nwo anyandera

english_verse: Peter came up to the Lord and asked, “How many times should I forgive someone who does something wrong to me? Is seven times enough?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Petro wale Yesu berɛ oobisale ye kyɛ, “Awurade, pɛen nyɛɛ yeɛ nniɛma yɛ me tɛɛ a, mva ngyɛ ye ɔ? Pɛen nzoo anaa?”

english_verse: This story will show you what the kingdom of heaven is like: One day a king decided to call in his officials and ask them to give an account of what they owed him.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ati, nyameɛso ahennie ne, ɔte kyɛ ɛhene bie bɔ né ɔpena kyɛ ɔne ye ngoaa bebu ngondaa ɔ.

english_verse: As he was doing this, one official was brought in who owed him
translation_verse: Na ɔhyɛle ngondaabulɛ ne abo nen, bɛfale ko bɔ ɔma ye kerɛ talɛnde apee buru ɔ bɛwale ye berɛ.

english_verse: But he didn't have any money to pay what he owed. The king ordered him to be sold, along with his wife and children and all he owned, in order to pay the debt.
translation_verse: Né ɔngɔhora kerɛ ne tua, yiti ye mene ne hyɛle kyɛ bɛtɔne ye, ɔne ɔye ne ye mma, yeɛ bɔ ole ye amukoraa, ná bɛfa betua kerɛ ne.

english_verse: The official got down on his knees and began begging, “Have pity on me, and I will pay you every cent I owe!”
translation_verse: Yiti akoaa ne yakyili ye nwo tole aseɛnwo berɛ wɔ ye nyunu berɛ, na ɔsrɛle ye kyɛ, ‘Me mene, nya me nwo aboterɛ kãa, na ngotua ye mukoraa ngɔma wɔ.’

english_verse: The king felt sorry for him and let him go free. He even told the official that he did not have to pay back the money.
translation_verse: Na akoaa ne mene ne nwuni ye anwumvoin, ɔyakyili ye, na ɔfale kerɛ ne hyɛle ye.

english_verse: The man got down on his knees and began begging, “Have pity on me, and I will pay you back.”
translation_verse: Yiti obiɛngo akoaa ne guale ndwerɛ srɛle ye kyɛ, ‘Nya me nwo aboterɛ kãa, na ngotua ye mukoraa ngɔma wɔ.’

english_verse: But the first official refused to have pity. Instead, he went and had the other official put in jail until he could pay what he owed.
translation_verse: Nakoso wambene, na ɔmaa bɛhyele ye bɛtole kuku nu kɔpem kyɛ okotua kerɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: When some other officials found out what had happened, they felt sorry for the man who had been put in jail. Then they told the king what had happened.
translation_verse: Na ye mmango ngoaa nemɔ nwuni bɔ wasi nen, ɔyɛle bɛ yea paa, na bɛɛhane bɔ wasi ne amukoraa behyirele bɛ mene.

english_verse: The king called the first official back in and said, “You're an evil man! When you begged for mercy, I said you did not have to pay back a cent.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ye mene ne frɛle ye sele ye kyɛ, ‘Wɔ, akoaa atianuserɛniɛ! Mvale wɔ kerɛ ne amukoraa ngyɛle wɔ, ɔnate kyɛ ɛpale me kyerɛ.

english_verse: The king was so angry that he ordered the official to be tortured until he could pay back everything he owed.
translation_verse: Na ye mene ne fɛle yaa, na ɔfale ye wurale kukunufoɛ so neafoɛ mɔ bɛ sa, kɔpem kyɛ okotua ye kerɛ ne amukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: That is how my Father in heaven will treat you, if you don't forgive each of my followers with all your heart.
translation_verse: “Na sɛ ɛmɔanye ɛmɔ kunu fitaa bamva ɛmɔ aliɛma mvomsoɛ bangyɛ ye a, sɔ ala yeɛ me Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne koso kɔyɛ ɛmɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: When Jesus finished teaching, he left Galilee and went to the part of Judea east of the Jordan River.
translation_verse: Na Yesu hane sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ yiele nen, ofili Galilea hɔle Yudea mbɔtam, wɔ asue Yɔɔdan si;

english_verse: Some people are unable to marry because of birth defects or because of what someone has done to their bodies. Others stay single in order to serve God better. Anyone who can accept this teaching should do so.” Jesus Blesses Little Children (Mark
translation_verse: Ebiemɔ ngora ngya braa, ofikyɛ sɔ yeɛ bɛwole bɛ ɔ; ebiemɔ koso de, sona yeɛ wayɛ bɛ sɔ ɔ; yeɛ ebiemɔ wora, nyameɛso ahennie ne ati yeɛ bɛ bɔbɔ bayɛ bɛ nwo sɔ ɔ. Bɔ ɔkɔhora kole sɔ dwirɛ ne kɔto nu ne, maa ole to nu.” Yesu yirayira ngwadaa (Marko

english_verse: Large crowds followed him, and he healed their sick.
translation_verse: na mmenia pee belili ye si, na ɔsale bɛ anwonyerɛ wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: Some Pharisees wanted to test Jesus. They came up to him and asked, “Is it right for a man to divorce his wife for just any reason?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Farasiifoɛ wale ye berɛ beesole ye bɛneane, na bebisale ye kyɛ, “Aso mmeraa ma ate kyɛ ɔnate edwirɛ biala so, ebie kora yira ɔye anaa?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Don't you know in the beginning the Creator made a man and a woman?
translation_verse: Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Aso ɛmɔkkenngale kyɛ ahyɛaseɛ ne, Ɛdangama bɔ ɔbɔle sona nen, bienzua ne brasua yeɛ ɔbɔle bɛ ɔ?

english_verse: That's why a man leaves his father and mother and gets married. He becomes like one person with his wife.
translation_verse: Na ɔhane kyɛ, ‘Ɛhe ati yeɛ bienzua kɔyakyi ɔse ne oni berɛ, ná wafa ye nwo waabata ɔye nwo, ná bɛ munyɔ bayɛ anwoɔnaen ko.’

english_verse: Then they are no longer two people, but one. And no one should separate a couple God has joined together.”
translation_verse: Yiti bɛtte nyɔ ko, na mmom bɛte anwoɔnaen ko. Ye sɔ ati, bɔ Nyameɛ ahã abɔ nu ne, nnɛma sona biala tete nu.”

english_verse: The Pharisees asked Jesus, “Why did Moses say a man could write out divorce papers and send his wife away?”

english_verse: You Pharisees and teachers of the Law of Moses are in for trouble! You're nothing but show-offs. You travel over land and sea to win one follower. And when you have done so, you make that person twice as fit for hell as you are.

english_verse: You are in for trouble! You are supposed to lead others, but you are blind. You teach that it doesn't matter if a person swears by the temple. But you say it does matter if someone swears by the gold in the temple.

english_verse: You blind fools! Which is greater, the gold or the temple that makes the gold sacred?
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ, ngwaseafoɛ ne anyesiniwaafoɛ! Beni yeɛ odi mu ɔ? Esikaa kɔkorɛ ne, anaakyɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne bɔ ɔma sikaa kɔkorɛ ne nwo te ne?

translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ ofite wale ne, wangora dwudwo kyire bɛ, yiti benwuni kyɛ wanwu nikyee bie wɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu dɔ; wangora dwudwo, na ɔfale ye sa yeɛ ɔyɛle nzɛngyerɛnneɛ hyirele bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When Zechariah's time of service in the temple was over, he went home.
translation_verse: Na ɔwale kyɛ, ye solɛ adwuma mmerɛ wale ayieleɛ ne, ofili berɛ hɔle ye awuro.

english_verse: Soon after this, his wife was expecting a baby, and for five months she did not leave the house. She said to herself,
translation_verse: Na ngyẽa biemɔ asi ne, ɔye Elisabɛte nwonzɛle, na ɔfale ye nwo siele ɛsraen nnu, na ɔhane kyɛ,

english_verse: “What the Lord has done for me will keep people from looking down on me.” An Angel Tells about the Birth of Jesus
translation_verse: “Sɔaa yeɛ Awurade aboka me ɔ, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ walo me wapa ɛfɛrelɛ bɔ mafɛre mmenia nyunu ne wagua ɔ.” Bɛhyɛ Yesu aworɛ nwo ngɔm

english_verse: One month later God sent the angel Gabriel to the town of Nazareth in Galilee
translation_verse: Na nwonzɛen ne lili bosome nzia ne, Nyameɛ somane abɔfo Gabriel maa ɔhɔle Galilea kuro bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Nasarɛte so,

english_verse: with a message for a virgin named Mary. She was engaged to Joseph from the family of King David.
translation_verse: maa ɔhɔle ababunu bie berɛ. Né bafa ye babɔ biaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Yosef, bɔ ofi Dawide abusua nu ɔ asiwa; na ababunu ne dumaa li Maria.

english_verse: The angel greeted Mary and said, “You are truly blessed! The Lord is with you.”
translation_verse: Na abɔfo ne wale ye berɛ oosele kyɛ, “Asomdwee hã wɔ! Wɔ bɔ balo wɔ ɔ, Awurade gyi wɔ si!”

english_verse: Mary was confused by the angel's words and wondered what they meant.
translation_verse: Na edwirɛ ne hale ye paa, na ɔdwenene ye nwo kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ ahyebisalɛ ɛhe?”

english_verse: Then the angel told Mary, “Don't be afraid! God is pleased with you,
translation_verse: Na abɔfo ne sele ye kyɛ, “Maria, nnɛsuro, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ alo wɔ.

english_verse: and you will have a son. His name will be Jesus.
translation_verse: Na tie, ɛkɔnwonzɛ, ná awo baa bienzua, ná ato ye dumaa Yesu.

english_verse: He will be great and will be called the Son of God Most High. The Lord God will make him king, as his ancestor David was.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔyɛ sona titire, na bɛkɔfrɛ ye Anwuro Anwuroniɛ n’Awa; na Awurade Nyameɛ kɔfa ye nana Dawide ahennie bia ne kɔma ye,

english_verse: He will rule the people of Israel forever, and his kingdom will never end.”
translation_verse: na okoli Yakob awuro so hene afebɔɔ, na ye ahennie ne olle ayieleɛ.”

english_verse: Mary asked the angel, “How can this happen? I am not even married!”
translation_verse: Na Maria bisale abɔfo ne kyɛ, “Nnwuni biaa le, na ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né ɛhe awa nu?”

english_verse: The angel answered, “The Holy Spirit will come down to you, and God's power will come over you. So your child will be called the holy Son of God.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo ne buale ye kyɛ, “Sunzum Krongron ne kɔwa wɔ so, na Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne, ye tumi komundu wɔ so; yiti baa krongron bɔ ɛkɔwo ye ne, bɛkɔfrɛ ye Nyameɛ Awa.

english_verse: Your relative Elizabeth is also going to have a son, even though she is old. No one thought she could ever have a baby, but in three months she will have a son.
translation_verse: Na tie, wɔ busuaniɛ Elisabɛte bɔ bɛnwa ɔte mmotaen ne, ɔnwonzɛ baa bienzua ɛsraen nzia ɛhe; ye bɔ wayɛ aworowaa posoposo ne;

english_verse: Mary said, “I am the Lord's servant! Let it happen as you have said.” And the angel left her. Mary Visits Elizabeth
translation_verse: Yeɛ Maria buale kyɛ, “Yieee, nde Awurade afaneɛ; maa ɔyɛ berɛ ma me kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ ne te ɔ.” Na abɔfo ne yakyili ye berɛ hɔle. Maria kɔpasa Elisabɛte nwo

english_verse: A short time later Mary hurried to a town in the hill country of Judea.
translation_verse: Na sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, Maria yɛle ndɛndɛ sili nu hɔle mmokaa so Yuda kuro bie anu,

english_verse: She went into Zechariah's home, where she greeted Elizabeth.
translation_verse: na ɔhɔle Sakaria awuro, na obisale Elisabɛte ahye.

english_verse: When Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, her baby moved within her. The Holy Spirit came upon Elizabeth.
translation_verse: Na Elisabɛte tele Maria ahyebisalɛ nen, akwadaa ne huruli wɔ ye kunu; na Sunzum Krongron yili Elisabɛte tɛkyɛ,

english_verse: Then in a loud voice she said to Mary: God has blessed you more than any other woman! He has also blessed the child you will have.
translation_verse: na ɔteane nu serɛserɛ kyɛ, “Wɔ yeɛ anya saleɛ wɔ mmrasua mukoraa nu ɔ, na bayira baa bɔ ɔla wɔ kunu ne!

english_verse: Why should the mother of my Lord come to me?
translation_verse: Yieee, ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ m’Awurade ani ɔba bapasa me nwo ɔ?

english_verse: As soon as I heard your greeting, my baby became happy and moved within me.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, mmerɛ bɔ ndele w’ahyebisalɛ ne pɛ, yeɛ akwadaa ne le anika ohuruli wɔ me kunu ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord has blessed you because you believed that he will keep his promise. Mary's Song of Praise
translation_verse: Na saleɛ te bɔ wale wali ɔ deɛ, ofikyɛ edwirɛ mɔ bɔ Awurade amaa baahã bahyire ye ne, ɔkɔwa nu.” Maria ye Nyameɛ ayɛ

english_verse: Mary said: With all my heart I praise the Lord,
translation_verse: Na Maria hane kyɛ, “Me kra kamvo Awurade,

english_verse: and I am glad because of God my Savior.
translation_verse: na me sunzum di ahurusi wɔ me Ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ nu;

english_verse: God cares for me, his humble servant. From now on, all people will say God has blessed me.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ wakaye ye afaneɛ awiɛmvoɛ! Yieee, ofikyɛ ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa bɛkɔfrɛ me bɔ wanya saleɛ ɔ;

english_verse: God All-Powerful has done great things for me, and his name is holy.
translation_verse: ɔnate kyɛ, Tuminiɛ ne ayɔ nikyee piri wama me, na ye dumaa ole krongron.

english_verse: He always shows mercy to everyone who worships him.
translation_verse: Na ye anwumvoinnwunɛ ne, ɔwɔ bɛ bɔ besuro ye ɔ so, wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: The Lord has used his powerful arm to scatter those who are proud.
translation_verse: Wafa ye basa wayɔ nningyein mbiri mbiri, na wapanzam ahandaenfoɛ b’adwene nzusuleɛ nu.

english_verse: God drags strong rulers from their thrones and puts humble people in places of power.
translation_verse: Watu tumifoɛ mɔ wafi b’ahennie bia so, na wapagya awiɛmvoɛ mɔ so.

english_verse: God gives the hungry good things to eat, and sends the rich away with nothing.
translation_verse: Wama bɛ bɔ ɛhɔen ku bɛ ɔ bali aleɛ paa ma bɛ ko ayi, yeɛ wama esikafoɛ bafa nzanza bahɔ.

english_verse: God helps his servant Israel and is always merciful to his people.
translation_verse: Waboka ye akoaa Yisrael, ofikyɛ wakaye ye anwumvoinnwunɛ ne,

english_verse: The Lord made this promise to our ancestors, to Abraham and his family forever!
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ ɔhã hyirele yɛ nana mɔ, Abraham ne ye bosofoɛ afebɔɔ ne.”

english_verse: Mary stayed with Elizabeth about three months. Then she went back home. The Birth of John the Baptist
translation_verse: Na Maria lili Elisabɛte nwo berɛ kɔyɛ ɛsraen nza, na osa hɔle ye kuro. Elisabɛte wo Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane

english_verse: When Elizabeth's son was born,
translation_verse: Elisabɛte aworɛ dwuli ne, ɔwole baa bienzua.

english_verse: her neighbors and relatives heard how kind the Lord had been to her, and they too were glad.
translation_verse: Na ye mandamu berɛ ama ne ye abusuafoɛ bɛtele kyɛbɔ Awurade asi alo ye paa nen, bɛ ne ye bɛ nye gyele.

english_verse: Eight days later they did for the child what the Law of Moses commands. They were going to name him Zechariah, after his father.
translation_verse: Na ɔwale kyɛ, ye ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso, bɛwale kyɛ bɛbaapɛ akwadaa ne bienzua; na ahaa bɛpena kyɛ bɛfa ye bɛto ye baba Sakaria;

english_verse: But Elizabeth said, “No! His name is John.”
translation_verse: nakoso oni hane kyɛ, “Daabi, bɛkɔfrɛ ye Yohane.”

english_verse: The people argued, “No one in your family has ever been named John.”
translation_verse: Na besele ye kyɛ, “Ebiala nne w’abusua nu bɔ oli sɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: So they motioned to Zechariah to find out what he wanted to name his son.
translation_verse: Na bele bɛ sa bɛyɛle nzɛngyerɛnneɛ bebisale ye baba, dumaa horɛ bɔ okuro kyɛ bɛfa bɛto ye ɔ.

english_verse: Zechariah asked for a writing tablet. Then he wrote, “His name is John.” Everyone was amazed.
translation_verse: Ohyirele kyɛ bɛma ye nikyee bɔ bɛkyerɛ so ɔ, na ɔhyerɛle so kyɛ, “Ye dumaa li Yohane.” Na ɔyɛle bɛ mukoraa nwanwa.

english_verse: All the neighbors were frightened because of what had happened, and everywhere in the hill country people kept talking about these things.
translation_verse: Na ɛserɛ hane mandamu berɛ ama amukoraa. Na sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ trɛ hɔle Yudea mmokaa maen ne anu amukoraa.

english_verse: Everyone who heard about this wondered what this child would grow up to be. They knew the Lord was with him. Zechariah Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bɛtele ne amukoraa, bɛdwenene ye nwo paa, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Akwadaa he de, ɔkɔyɛ nzikyɛ sona ɛhe?” Ɔnate kyɛ né Awurade tumi wɔ ye so. Sakaria hyɛ ngɔm

english_verse: The Holy Spirit came upon Zechariah, and he began to speak:
translation_verse: Na Sunzum Krongron yili ye baba Sakaria tɛkyɛ, na ɔhyɛle ngɔm kyɛ,

english_verse: Praise the Lord, the God of Israel! He has come to save his people.
translation_verse: “Animnyam hã Awurade, Yisrael Nyameɛ ne, ɔnate kyɛ waapasa ye maen nwo, na wapɔ ye wale ye,

english_verse: Our God has given us a mighty Savior from the family of David his servant.
translation_verse: na wama ngoalelɛ awɛen so wama yɛ wɔ ye akoaa Dawide awuro;

english_verse: Long ago the Lord promised by the words of his holy prophets
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ ɔnate ye ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ krongron so fi tetetete dwudwole,

english_verse: to save us from our enemies and from everyone who hates us.
translation_verse: kyɛ okole yɛ kofi yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu, ɔne bɛ bɔ bekyi yɛ mukoraa bɛ sa nu,

english_verse: God said he would be kind to our people and keep his sacred promise.
translation_verse: kyɛ okonwu yɛ nana mɔ anwumvoin, ná wakaye ye apam krongron ne.

english_verse: He told our ancestor Abraham
translation_verse: Ndaen bɔ ɔta hyirele yɛ nana Abraham

english_verse: that he would rescue us from our enemies. Then we could serve him without fear,
translation_verse: kyɛ ɔkɔmaa bekole yɛ bekofi yɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ sa nu, ná yaso ye bɔ esurolɛ nne nu,

english_verse: by being holy and good as long as we live.
translation_verse: wɔ anwotelɛ ne tenenee nu, wɔ ye nyunu yɛ ngoa ngyẽa mukoraa ne.

english_verse: You, my son, will be called the prophet of God Most High. You will go ahead of the Lord to get everything ready for him.
translation_verse: Na wɔ, akwadaa he, bɛkɔfrɛ wɔ Anwuro Anwuroniɛ ne, ye ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ; ɔnate kyɛ ekoli Awurade nyunu moa ekosiesie ye atee nu,

english_verse: You will tell his people that they can be saved when their sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: ná afa ngoalelɛ nwo nimdeɛ ama ye maen, wɔ bɛ bɔne fakyɛ nu,

english_verse: God's love and kindness will shine upon us like the sun that rises in the sky.
translation_verse: ɔnate yɛ Nyameɛ anwumvoinnwunɛ bɔ ɔma ye kunu tete ye ne anu. Na ye sɔ ati yeɛ alehyeleɛ bɔ ofi anwuro ɔ wapukye wɔ yɛ so ye,

english_verse: On us who live in the dark shadow of death this light will shine to guide us into a life of peace.
translation_verse: kyɛ ɔkɔta kɔma bɛ bɔ bɛtete awosii nu ɔne ewue wawoɛ nu ɔ, ná wayɛ yɛ taataa wahɔ asomdwee atee so.”

english_verse: As John grew up, God's Spirit gave him great power. John lived in the desert until the time he was sent to the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Na akwadaa ne nyini, na ɔyɛle se sunzum nu, na ɔtenane ɛserɛ so maa oodwuli kyẽa bɔ ɔyele ye nwo ali hyirele Yisrael ɔ.

english_verse: About that time Emperor Augustus gave orders for the names of all the people to be listed in record books.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ sɔ ne anu, Kaesare Augusto hyɛle mmeraa kyɛ bɛha ewiase mmenia amukoraa, ná bɛhyerɛ bɛ dumaa.

english_verse: At this time a man named Simeon was living in Jerusalem. Simeon was a good man. He loved God and was waiting for him to save the people of Israel. God's Spirit came to him
translation_verse: Na sɔ mmerɛ ne, né biaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Simeon ɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem. Né ɔtengyɛ, yeɛ osuro Nyameɛ, na né ɔ́nwondɛ Yisrael aworakyekyerɛ ne, yeɛ afei né Sunzum Krongron wɔ ye so.

english_verse: These first records were made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
translation_verse: Ɛhe yeɛ ɔte mmeniahalɛ bɔ oli moa ɔ, mmerɛ bɔ né Kirineo ɔte amrado wɔ Siria ne.

english_verse: Everyone had to go to their own hometown to be listed.
translation_verse: Na mmenia mukoraa bɛhɔle bɛ kuro bɛɛhyerɛle bɛ dumaa.

english_verse: So Joseph had to leave Nazareth in Galilee and go to Bethlehem in Judea. Long ago Bethlehem had been King David's hometown, and Joseph went there because he was from David's family.
translation_verse: Na Yosef koso, ofili Nasarɛte bɔ ɔwɔ Galilea sili nu hɔle Dawide kuro Betlehem bɔ ɔwɔ Yudea, ɔnate kyɛ né ofi Dawide awuro ne ye abusua nu.

english_verse: Mary was engaged to Joseph and traveled with him to Bethlehem. She was soon going to have a baby,
translation_verse: Ɔɔhyerɛle ye ne ye asiwa Maria bɔ né y’aworɛ apingye ne dumaa.

english_verse: she gave birth to her first-born son. She dressed him in baby clothes and laid him on a bed of hay, because there was no room for them in the inn. The Shepherds
translation_verse: Ɔwole ye bamuɛbaa bienzua, na ɔfale ɛtena kyekyele ye nwo, na ɔfale ye tole alaka bɔ nyɛmmoa didi nu ɔ nu, ɔnate kyɛ bannya ɛwɔfoɛ sua banzikye nu. Abɔfo ne ne mmoaenneafoɛ nemɔ

english_verse: That night in the fields near Bethlehem some shepherds were guarding their sheep.
translation_verse: Né mmoaenneafoɛ biemɔ bɛwɔ porɛ ne anu berɛ ɛserɛ so, bɔ bɛ́nea bɛ mmoaen kure so kɔngɔen ne ɔ.

english_verse: All at once an angel came down to them from the Lord, and the brightness of the Lord's glory flashed around them. The shepherds were frightened.
translation_verse: Na Awurade abɔfo yele ye nwo ali hyirele bɛ, na Awurade animnyam tale bɛ nwo bra yiale, na ɛserɛ hane bɛ paa.

english_verse: But the angel said, “Don't be afraid! I have good news for you, which will make everyone happy.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo ne sele bɛ kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔsuro, na ɛ́mɔtie, ndɛenvɛen bɔ ɔte anigye piri paa bɔ ɔkɔyɛ maen maen amukoraa bɛ deɛ yeɛ mefa mebrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ;

english_verse: This very day in King David's hometown a Savior was born for you. He is Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ɛnɛ kyẽa ye, bawo Ngoadefoɛ bɔ ye ole Kristo, Awurade ne, bama ɛmɔ wɔ Dawide kuro.

english_verse: You will know who he is, because you will find him dressed in baby clothes and lying on a bed of hay.”
translation_verse: Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ kɔma ɛmɔ ɔ: Ɛmɔkonwu adɔma bɔ bafa ɛtena bakyekye ye nwo bɔ ɔla alaka bɔ nyɛmmoa didi nu ɔ nu.”

english_verse: Suddenly many other angels came down from heaven and joined in praising God. They said:
translation_verse: Na berɛ ne ala, nyameɛso asafo kure pembepembe bɛɛbokale abɔfo ne so bɛyele Nyameɛ ayɛ kyɛ,

english_verse: “Praise God in heaven! Peace on earth to everyone who pleases God.”
translation_verse: “Animnyam hã Nyameɛ wɔ anwuro anwuro, na asomdwee hã mmenia bɔ bɛsɔ ye nye ɔ wɔ aseɛ aso!”

english_verse: After the angels had left and gone back to heaven, the shepherds said to each other, “Let's go to Bethlehem and see what the Lord has told us about.”
translation_verse: Na abɔfo nemɔ fili bɛ nwo berɛ bɛhɔle nyameɛso ne, mmoaenneafoɛ nemɔ sisele bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma yɛhɔ Betlehem yɛɛnea edwirɛ he bɔ wasi, bɔ Awurade aye ahyire yɛ ye.”

english_verse: They hurried off and found Mary and Joseph, and they saw the baby lying on a bed of hay.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛhane bɛ nwo bɛhɔle, na beenwuni Maria ne Yosef, ɔne adɔma ne kyɛ ɔla alaka bɔ nyɛmmoa didi nu ɔ nu.

english_verse: When the shepherds saw Jesus, they told his parents what the angel had said about him.
translation_verse: Na benwuni ye nen, bɛhane akwadaa ne nwo dwirɛ bɔ bɛhã behyirele bɛ ne behyirele bɛ.

english_verse: But Mary kept thinking about all this and wondering what it meant.
translation_verse: Na Maria de, ɔfale edwirɛ hemɔ amukoraa siele, na ɔdwenene ye nwo wɔ ye ti anu.

english_verse: As the shepherds returned to their sheep, they were praising God and saying wonderful things about him. Everything they had seen and heard was just as the angel had said.
translation_verse: Na mmoaenneafoɛ nemɔ besa bɛhɔle, na bɛhyɛle Nyameɛ animnyam bɛyele ye ayɛ wɔ bɔ benwuni ye ɔne bɔ bate ne amukoraa nwo, bɔ ɔte kyɛbɔ bɛhã behyirele bɛ ne pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ. Bɛto adɔma ne dumaa

english_verse: Eight days later Jesus' parents did for him what the Law of Moses commands. And they named him Jesus, just as the angel had told Mary when he promised she would have a baby. Simeon Praises the Lord
translation_verse: Na odwuli ɛlɛbɔtwɛ bɔ né bɛbaapɛ ye bienzua ne, bɛtole ye dumaa Yesu, dumaa bɔ abɔfo ne fa tole ye koraka yeɛ bɛnwonzɛ ye ne. Bɛfa adɔma ne bɛkɔ Yerusalem

english_verse: The time came for Mary and Joseph to do what the Law of Moses says a mother is supposed to do after her baby is born. They took Jesus to the temple in Jerusalem and presented him to the Lord,
translation_verse: Na bɛ nwo petenɛ mmerɛ dwuli, kyɛbɔ Mose mmeraa ne kyire ne, bɛfale ye bɛhɔle Yerusalem kyɛ bɛkwaafa ye bɛma Awurade;

english_verse: The Law of the Lord also says parents have to offer a sacrifice, giving at least a pair of doves or two young pigeons. So that is what Mary and Joseph did.
translation_verse: na bɛɛbɔle afɔleɛ kyɛbɔ bahã ye wɔ Awurade mmeraa ne anu ne, bɔ ɔte mmorɔma nyɔ anaa mmorɔnoma mmaa nyɔ. Simeon da Nyameɛ ase

english_verse: and told him that he would not die until he had seen Christ the Lord.
translation_verse: Né Sunzum Krongron aye ahyire ye kyɛ, ongonwu ewue, sana wafa ye nye wanwu Kristo bɔ ɔte Awurade deɛ ne koraka.

english_verse: When Mary and Joseph brought Jesus to the temple to do what the Law of Moses says should be done for a new baby, the Spirit told Simeon to go into the temple.
translation_verse: Na Sunzum ne kanyane ye maa ɔhɔle asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu berɛ. Na mmerɛ bɔ awofoɛ ne fale akwadaa Yesu bɛwale kyɛ bɛbaayɔ kyɛbɔ mmeraa ne ahyehyɛ bɛma ye ne,

english_verse: Simeon took the baby Jesus in his arms and praised God,
translation_verse: Simeon lele akwadaa ne tole ye sa so, na ɔyele Nyameɛ ayɛ kyɛ,

english_verse: “Lord, I am your servant, and now I can die in peace, because you have kept your promise to me.
translation_verse: “Awurade, afei de yakyi w’akoaa ate asomdwee nu, kyɛbɔ wɔ dwirɛ ne ɔte ne;

english_verse: and foreign nations will also see this.
translation_verse: bɔ asiesie wɔ maen maen amukoraa bɛ nyunu ne,

english_verse: Your mighty power is a light for all nations, and it will bring honor to your people Israel.”
translation_verse: kanea bɔ ɔkɔla wɔ ali kohyire Amaenmaensofoɛ ɔ bɔ ɔte wɔ maen Yisrael animnyam ne.”

english_verse: Jesus' parents were surprised at what Simeon had said.
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔhã fale akwadaa ne nwo ne yɛle ye baba ne ye maame nwanwa.

english_verse: Then he blessed them and told Mary, “This child of yours will cause many people in Israel to fall and others to stand. The child will be like a warning sign. Many people will reject him,
translation_verse: Na Simeon yirayirale bɛ, na osele oni Maria kyɛ, “Nea, akwadaa he yeɛ bafa ye basie berɛ bama mmenia pee b’asefinɛ ne bɛ dwɔsolɛ wɔ Yisrael ɔ, ɔne sɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ mmenia bekodwudwo bekotia

english_verse: The prophet Anna was also there in the temple. She was the daughter of Phanuel from the tribe of Asher, and she was very old. In her youth she had been married for seven years, but her husband died.

translation_verse: Na sɔ mmerɛ ne anu ala, Yesu sale mmenia pee anwonyerɛ ne ɛhawo, na otutuli bɛ sunzummɔne mɔ, na mmenia pee bɔ bɛ nye asi koso, ɔmaa benwuni nikye.

english_verse: Jesus said to the messengers sent by John, “Go and tell John what you have seen and heard. Blind people are now able to see, and the lame can walk. translation_verse: Na Yohane bɔfoɛ nemɔ hɔle ne, ɔhyɛle ye bo hane edwirɛ bɔ ɔfa Yohane nwo ɔ hyirele ɛlɔen ne kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛmɔsili nu bɛhɔle ɛserɛ so dɔ bɛɛneane ɔ? Elemmire bɔ mvrama wosowoso ye anaa?

translation_verse: Anaakyɛ nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛmɔsili nu bɛhɔ bɛɛneane ɔ? Sona bɔ owura ndaadeɛ nyemenenyemene anaa? Ɛ́mɔtie, bɛ bɔ bewura ndaadeɛ paa ná banya asetena nu anigye ne de, ahemvie yeɛ bɛwɔ ɔ!

english_verse: What then did you go out to see? Was he a prophet? He certainly was! I tell you that he was more than a prophet.
translation_verse: Anaakyɛ nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛmɔsili nu bɛhɔ bɛɛneane ɔ? Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ anaa? Yoo, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɔtra ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ po.

translation_verse: Ye ole bɔ bahyerɛ ye nwo dwirɛ kyɛ, ‘Tie, mésoma me bɔfoɛ maa odi wɔ nyunu, bɔ okoli wɔ nyunu moa kosiesie w’atee nu ɔ.’

english_verse: No one ever born on this earth is greater than John. But whoever is least important in God's kingdom is greater than John.
translation_verse: Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, bɛ bɔ mmrasua awo bɛ amukoraa, bɛ nu biala nne berɛ bɔ odi mu tra Yohane ɔ; nakoso bɔ ɔte kãa koraa wɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu ne, odi mu tra ye.”

english_verse: Everyone had been listening to John. Even the tax collectors had obeyed God and had done what was right by letting John baptize them.
translation_verse: (Na mmenia amukoraa bɔ bɛtele sɔ dwirɛ nen, bɛ ne ɛtoɔdidelɛfoɛ belele Nyameɛ bɛtole nu kyɛ ye dwirɛ te nahorɛ, na bɛmaa bɛbɔle bɛ Yohane asubɔlɛ ne bie.

english_verse: But the Pharisees and the experts in the Law of Moses refused to obey God and be baptized by John.
translation_verse: Nakoso Farasiifoɛ ne mmeraa nwo nimdeɛfoɛ nemɔ de, bɛpole Nyameɛ botaeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ ma bɛ ne, na bamma bammɔ bɛ asu.)

english_verse: Jesus went on to say: What are you people like? What kind of people are you?
translation_verse: Na Awurade sele kyɛ, “Nwa mɔ nwo yeɛ ngɔfa ɛnɛmmafoɛ ngɔtoto ɔ? Na bɛte kyɛ nwa mɔ koraa?

english_verse: You are like children sitting in the market and shouting to each other, “We played the flute, but you would not dance! We sang a funeral song, but you would not cry!”
translation_verse: Bɛte kyɛ ngwadaa bɔ bɛtete dwaaso, bɔ bɛ́frɛfrɛ bɛ nwo bɛ nwo kyɛ, ‘Yɛhuli awɛen yɛhyirele ɛmɔ, na ɛmɔango; yɛbɔle awuye yɛhyire ɛmɔ, na ɛmɔanzu.’

english_verse: But because the Son of Man goes around eating and drinking, you say, “Jesus eats and drinks too much! He is even a friend of tax collectors and sinners.”
translation_verse: Sona Awa ne awa, bɔ odidi ná ɔno ɔ, na ɛmɔnwa: ‘Ɛ́mɔnea, adifuu ne akɔnomnzaniɛ, ɛtoɔdidelɛfoɛ ne bɔnefoɛ adamvo!’

translation_verse: Nakoso nworɛ ye mma mukoraa bebua ye be.” Braa bɔnefoɛ bie

translation_verse: Farasiifoɛ nemɔ anu ko tole ye sa frɛle Yesu kyɛ ɔbra ma bedidi; na ɔhɔle Farasiifoɛ n’awuro ɔɔtenane ase kyɛ odidi.

english_verse: When a sinful woman in that town found out that Jesus was there, she bought an expensive bottle of perfume.
translation_verse: Na yieee, braa bɔnefoɛ bie bɔ né ɔwɔ kuro berɛ ɔ, ɔtele kyɛ ɔwɔ Farasiiniɛ n’awuro berɛ odidi nen, ɔfale sakyeɛfona towaa ko bɔ wayi ɔ wale,

english_verse: The Pharisee who had invited Jesus saw this and said to himself, “If this man really were a prophet, he would know what kind of woman is touching him! He would know that she is a sinner.”
translation_verse: Na Farasiiniɛ bɔ ɔtole ye sa frɛle ye ne, onwuni ye sɔ nen, ɔhane ye wɔ ye ti anu kyɛ, “Sɛ biaa he ɔte ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ a, braa bɔ ɔsosɔ ye nu ye, ahaa okonwu ye suban ne brasua horɛ, ofikyɛ ɔte bɔnefoɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to the Pharisee, “Simon, I have something to say to you.” “Teacher, what is it?” Simon replied.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu buale sele ye kyɛ, “Simɔn, maa nga edwirɛ kãa bie ngyire wɔ.” Na obisale kyɛ “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, nzikyɛ dwirɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus told him, “Two people were in debt to a moneylender. One of them owed him
translation_verse: Na osele kyɛ, “Né mmenia nyɔ bie bɛma ebie bɔ ɔbɔ bosea ɔ kerɛ. Ko ma ye kerɛ denare ɛyaa nnu, yeɛ ko koso ma ye kerɛ aburannu.

english_verse: But Jesus told the woman, “Because of your faith, you are now saved. May God give you peace!”
translation_verse: Na osele braa ne kyɛ, “Wɔ gyidie ale wɔ, kɔ asomdwee nu!”

english_verse: Since neither of them could pay him back, the moneylender said that they didn't have to pay him anything. Which one of them will like him more?”
translation_verse: Bangora kerɛ ne tua, yiti ɔfa hyɛle bɛ munyɔ. Yiti kyire me bɛ nu horɛ bɔ okohuro biaa ne dwirɛ paa ɔ?”

english_verse: He turned toward the woman and said to Simon, “Have you noticed this woman? When I came into your home, you didn't give me any water so I could wash my feet. But she has washed my feet with her tears and dried them with her hair.
translation_verse: Na ɔkakyili ye nye hyirele braa ne dɔ nen, osele Simɔn kyɛ, “Anwu braa he? Mmale w’awuro nen, amma me nzue ma mannwunzi me gya bo, nakoso ye de, ole ye nye moen wanwunzi me gya bo, na wafa ye ti nwiaa wanunu.

english_verse: You didn't greet me with a kiss, but from the time I came in, she has not stopped kissing my feet.
translation_verse: Amve me noa, nakoso ye de, ofi mmerɛ bɔ mmale wa ye, ɔyyakyili me gya nwo felɛ.

english_verse: You didn't even pour olive oil on my head, but she has poured expensive perfume on my feet.
translation_verse: Amva olive ngoo ambopa me ti so, nakoso ye de, wafa sakyeɛfona wapopa me gya bo.

english_verse: So I tell you that all her sins are forgiven, and that is why she has shown great love. But anyone who has been forgiven for only a little will show only a little love.”
translation_verse: Yiti mekã mekyire wɔ, ye bɔne worawora ne, bafa bahyɛ ye, ofikyɛ wala ɔdɔ piri paa ali. Nakoso sona bɔ bafa bɔne kãa bie bahyɛ ye ne, ɔdɔ kãa bie yeɛ ɔye ye ali ɔ.”

english_verse: Then Jesus said to the woman, “Your sins are forgiven.”
translation_verse: Na osele braa ne kyɛ, “Bafa wɔ bɔne bahyɛ wɔ.”

english_verse: Some other guests started saying to one another, “Who is this who dares to forgive sins?”
translation_verse: Na mmenia bɔ né bɛne ye te poen nwo ne, bɛhyɛle ye bo besisele bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Nwa ɛhe, bɔ ɔfa bɔne po kyɛ ye?”

english_verse: and so were some women who had been healed of evil spirits and all sorts of diseases. One of the women was Mary Magdalene, who once had seven demons in her.
translation_verse: yeɛ mmrasua biemɔ bɔ otuli sunzummɔne fili bɛ nu ná ɔsale bɛ anwonyerɛ ɔ koso, yeɛ Maria bɔ oli Magdalene, bɔ otuli sunzummɔne nzoo fili ye nu ne,

translation_verse: Na bɔ beguale aseɛ paa so ne, bɛ ole mmenia bɔ bɛte dwirɛ ne a, bɛfa ahone paa ɔne bɔ nu te ɔ bɛsɔ nu bum, na begyina pindinn besu mmaa. Kanea nwo mvasoɛ (Marko

translation_verse: Na biaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Yairo ɔ wale, ɔte nyianu sua nu panyi. Ɔtole ye nwo yele Yesu gya bo, na ɔsrɛle ye kyɛ ɔbra ye awuro;
