translation_verse: Na Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Ama mmuayɛɛ yé; yɔ sɔ, na ekonya ngoa.”

english_verse: But the man wanted to show that he knew what he was talking about. So he asked Jesus, “Who are my neighbors?”
translation_verse: Nakoso ye de, né ɔpena kyɛ obua ye nwo be ne ati, obisale Yesu kyɛ, “Na nwa yeɛ ɔte mmiɛngo ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: As a man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, robbers attacked him and grabbed everything he had. They beat him up and ran off, leaving him half dead.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu buale kyɛ, “Biaa bie fili Yerusalem kyɛ ɔ́torotoro kɔ Yeriko, na oolili amia wɔ awerɔm awuefoɛ bɛ sa nu. Na bepuropurole ye nwo ndaadeɛ, bepurapurale ye, na bɛyakyili ye berɛ bɛhɔle bɔ né ɔpena wu ɔ.

english_verse: A priest happened to be going down the same road. But when he saw the man, he walked by on the other side.
translation_verse: Na ɔwale kyɛ, ɔsɔfo bie ɔɔfale atee ne aso; na onwuni ye nen, ɔfale atee ne bue dɔ hɔle.

english_verse: Later a temple helper came to the same place. But when he saw the man who had been beaten up, he also went by on the other side.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ Lewiniɛ bie oofitele ye so ɔ; na onwuni ye nen, ɔfale atee ne bue dɔ hɔle.

english_verse: A man from Samaria then came traveling along that road. When he saw the man, he felt sorry for him
translation_verse: Nakoso Samarianiɛ bie, bɔ né otu atee ɔ oofitele nekaa bɔ ɔwɔ ne, na onwuni ye ne, ɔyɛle ye anwumvo.

english_verse: and went over to him. He treated his wounds with olive oil and wine and bandaged them. Then he put him on his own donkey and took him to an inn, where he took care of him.
translation_verse: Na ɔhɔle ye nwo berɛ, ɔfale ngoo ne nzaa guaguale ye apirakuro ne anu, na ɔkyekyele so. Afei ɔfale ye siele ye bɔbɔ ye kaka ne aso, na ɔfale ye hɔle ɛwɔfoɛ sua nu ɔɔneane ye.

english_verse: The next morning he gave the innkeeper two silver coins and said, “Please take care of the man. If you spend more than this on him, I will pay you when I return.”
translation_verse: Na aleɛ hyene ne, ɔyele denare nyɔ mane sona bɔ ɔnea ɛwɔfoɛ sua ne aso ne, na osele ye kyɛ, ‘Nea ye, na kerɛ biala bɔ ɛkɔbɔ wɔ ye nwo bieku ne, mesa meba a ngotua wɔ kerɛ.’

english_verse: Then Jesus asked, “Which one of these three people was a real neighbor to the man who was beaten up by robbers?”
translation_verse: Yiti mmenia nza ye, bɛ nu nwa yeɛ ɛdwene kyɛ ɔyɛle biaa bɔ olili amia wɔ awerɔm awuefoɛ mɔ bɛ sa nu ne obiɛngo ɔ?”

english_verse: The expert in the Law of Moses answered, “The one who showed pity.” Jesus said, “Go and do the same!” Martha and Mary
translation_verse: Na obuale kyɛ, “Ye de, ko bɔ onwuni ye anwumvoin ne ɔ.” Yeɛ Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Kɔ, na wɔ koso, kɔyɔ sɔ ala!” Yesu kɔ Maata ne Maria awuro

english_verse: The Lord and his disciples were traveling along and came to a village. When they got there, a woman named Martha welcomed him into her home.
translation_verse: Na ɔwale kyɛ bɛ́kɔ nen, oodwuli akuraa bie anu; na braa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Maata ɔ ɔfale ye oosikyele ye wɔ ye awuro.

english_verse: She had a sister named Mary, who sat down in front of the Lord and was listening to what he said.
translation_verse: Né Maata le aliɛma brasua bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Maria ɔ, na ɔɔtenane Yesu gya bo berɛ otiele ye ngyerɛkyerɛ.

english_verse: Martha was worried about all that had to be done. Finally, she went to Jesus and said, “Lord, doesn't it bother you that my sister has left me to do all the work by myself? Tell her to come and help me!”
translation_verse: Nakoso Maata de, ɔmane ɛwɔfoɛsolɛ nwo adwuma hiane ye paa; yiti ɔwale Yesu nwo berɛ oosele kyɛ, “Awurade, aso ennwu kyɛ nniɛma ye wayakyi ɛsolɛ adwuma ne wato me ngome me so ye? Kã kyire ye maa ɔɔsɔ me nu.”

english_verse: The Lord answered, “Martha, Martha! You are worried and upset about so many things,
translation_verse: Na Awurade buale ye kyɛ, “Maata, Maata, ɛdwenedwene, na ɛha wɔ nwo wɔ nningyein pee nwo;

english_verse: but only one thing is necessary. Mary has chosen what is best, and it will not be taken away from her.”
translation_verse: nikyee komapɛ yeɛ ohia ɔ: Na Maria de, bɔ ɔte paa ne yeɛ waneanea nu waye ɔ, na ɛhe de, bengole bengofi ye sa nu.”

english_verse: So I tell you to ask and you will receive, search and you will find, knock and the door will be opened for you.
translation_verse: “Yiti mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ: Ɛ́mɔbisa, na bɛkɔfa bɛkɔma ɛmɔ; ɛ́mɔpena, na ɛmɔkonwu ye; ɛ́mɔbɔ nu, na bekobukye ɛmɔ.

english_verse: As bad as you are, you still know how to give good gifts to your children. But your heavenly Father is even more ready to give the Holy Spirit to anyone who asks. Jesus and the Ruler of Demons (Matthew
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔ po bɔ ɛmɔte bɔnefoɛ ɔ ɛmɔse kyɛbɔ ɛmɔma ɛmɔ mma mɔ nningyein paa a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ ɛmɔ Baba bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne ɔngɔfa Sunzum Krongron ngɔma bɛ bɔ bebisa ye ɔ?” Bɛto Yesu soen (Mateo

english_verse: And suppose your friend answers, “Don't bother me! The door is bolted, and my children and I are in bed. I cannot get up to give you something.”
translation_verse: Na okobua ye kofi ye sua nu dɔ kyɛ, ‘Nnɛha me! Mato m’anoa nu, na me mma lela me nwo wa wɔ mba so, na mengɔhora dwɔso mengɔma wɔ nikyee biala.’

english_verse: Which one of you fathers would give your hungry child a snake if the child asked for a fish?
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ ɔte seɛ ná ɔwa bisa ye [paanoo a, ɔkɔma ye nyɔboɛ ɔ? Anaakyɛ obisa ye] tiré a, ɔkɔma ye ewoo ɔ?

english_verse: So Jesus told them, “Pray in this way: ‘Father, help us to honor your name. Come and set up your kingdom.
translation_verse: Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛmɔbɔ mbaeɛ a, ɛmɔhã kyɛ, ‘Baba [bɔ ɛwɔ nyameɛso so ɔ,] Wɔ dumaa nwo ɔte; w’ahennie ɔbra.

english_verse: Forgive our sins, as we forgive everyone who has done wrong to us. And keep us from being tempted.’ ”
translation_verse: ná fa yɛ bɔne kyɛ yɛ, ofikyɛ yɛ koso yɛfa ebiala bɔ ɔfõ yɛ ɔ ye deɛ yɛkyɛ ye. Na nnɛfa yɛ kɔ nzɔhwɛ nu.’ ”

english_verse: Everyone who asks will receive, everyone who searches will find, and the door will be opened for everyone who knocks.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ obisa ne, ye sa kã ye; na ebiala bɔ ɔpena ne, onwu ye; yeɛ bɔ ɔbɔ nu ne, bebukye ye.

english_verse: Just as Jonah was a sign to the people of Nineveh, the Son of Man will be a sign to the people of today.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ né Yona te sɛngyerɛnneɛ ma Ninewefoɛ nen, sɔ ala yeɛ Sona Awa ne kɔyɛ kɔma ɛnɛmmafoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: While Jesus was still talking, a woman in the crowd spoke up, “The woman who gave birth to you and nursed you is blessed!”
translation_verse: Na ɔwale kyɛ ogu so ɔkã edwirɛ hemɔ nen, braa bie bɔ ɔwɔ mmenia ne anu ɔ ɔteane nu sele ye kyɛ, “Koɛ bɔ ɔwole wɔ, ɔne nyɔfone bɔ ɛnone ne, banya saleɛ!”

english_verse: Jesus forced a demon out of a man who could not talk. And after the demon had gone out, the man started speaking, and the crowds were amazed.
translation_verse: Ɛlɛho bie, né Yesu otu sunzummɔne bie bɔ ɔte mumu ɔ. Na ɔwale kyɛ sunzummɔne ne tu fili ye nu nen, emumu ne dwudwole, na ɔyɛle ɛlɔen ne nwanwa.

english_verse: Others wanted to put Jesus to the test. So they asked him to show them a sign from God.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ebiemɔ koso besole ye bɛneane, na bebisale nzɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ ofi nyameɛso ɔ befili ye berɛ.

english_verse: Jesus knew what they were thinking, and he said: A kingdom where people fight each other will end up in ruin. And a family that fights will break up.
translation_verse: Nakoso ye de, né ɔse b’adwene ne ati, osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ahennie biala bɔ ɔne ye nwo ko ne, ogu; yeɛ awuro bɔ ɔne ye nwo ko ne, ɔbɔ.

english_verse: If Satan fights against himself, how can his kingdom last? Yet you say that I force out demons by the power of Beelzebul.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Satan koso ɔne ye nwo ko a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né ye ahennie agyina? Ofikyɛ, ɛmɔnwa Beɛsebul tumi yeɛ mefa metutu sunzummɔne mɔ ɔ.

english_verse: If I use his power to force out demons, whose power do your own followers use to force them out? They are the ones who will judge you.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Beɛsebul tumi yeɛ mefa metutu sunzummɔne mɔ de a, né nzaade nwa tumi yeɛ ɛmɔ mma mɔ bɛfa betutu bɛ ɔ? Yiti bɛ yeɛ bɛkɔyɛ ɛmɔ ndɛenbualɛfoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When a strong man arms himself and guards his home, everything he owns is safe.
translation_verse: “Sɛ kwabranoa ole akodeɛ ɔwɛne ye awuro a, ye anwodeɛ nwo sonn.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You love the front seats in the synagogues, and you like to be greeted with honor in the market.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔ Farasiifoɛ, ɛmɔ yaakɔ! Ofikyɛ, mbanyi bia yeɛ ɛmɔkuro wɔ nyianu sua mɔ nu ɔ, ɔne kyɛ mmenia kobisa ɛmɔ ahye wɔ dwaaso ɔ.

english_verse: A teacher of the Law of Moses spoke up, “Teacher, you said cruel things about us.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ mmeraa nwo nimdeɛfoɛ nemɔ anu ko sele ye kyɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, sɛ ɛkã sɔ de a, né awɔ yɛ koso safure!”

english_verse: When an evil spirit leaves a person, it travels through the desert, looking for a place to rest. But when it doesn't find a place, it says, “I will go back to the home I left.”
translation_verse: “Sɛ sunzummɔne tu fi sona nu a, okokyinikyini aseɛ katerepee mɔ so pena nekaa bɔ okole ye nwome ɔ; na onnya bie a, ɔkã kyɛ, ‘Ngosa ngɔhɔ me sua bɔ mvili nu mmale ne anu.’

english_verse: When it gets there and finds the place clean and fixed up,
translation_verse: Na ɔba a, ɔbanwu ye kyɛ bapoapoa nu ná basiesie berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: it goes off and finds seven other evil spirits even worse than itself. They all come and make their home there, and that person ends up in worse shape than before. Being Really Blessed
translation_verse: Afei ɔkɔ kɔfa sunzum nzoo foforɛ bɔ bedi bɔne bɛtra ye ɔ ɔboka ye nwo so, na bɛbawura nu bɛtena berɛ. Na sɔ sona ne, ye asetena bɔ oli nziɛ ne te bɔne asetena tra daa ne.” Nyameɛ dwirɛ nwo sotie ma saleɛ

english_verse: Jesus replied, “That's true, but the people who are really blessed are the ones who hear and obey God's message!” A Sign from God (Matthew
translation_verse: Nakoso osele kyɛ, “Bɛ bɔ bɛte Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne ná bedi so ne mmom yeɛ banya saleɛ ɔ!” Ɛnɛmmafoɛ pena sɛngyerɛnneɛ (Mateo

english_verse: The Pharisee was surprised that he did not wash his hands before eating.
translation_verse: Na Farasiiniɛ ne nwuni kyɛ Yesu annwunzi ye sa koraka yeɛ odidi nen, ɔyɛle ye nwanwa.

english_verse: You Pharisees are in for trouble! You give God a tenth of the spices from your gardens, such as mint and rue. But you cheat people, and you don't love God. You should be fair and kind to others and still give a tenth to God.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔ Farasiifoɛ, ɛmɔ yaakɔ! Ofikyɛ, ɛmɔfa ɛmeɛ, ɛmanyire ne nyaanyaa biala buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko bɛma, nakoso ɛmɔbu bɛ nye begua pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ ne Nyameɛ nwo dɔ so. Na ɛhemɔ yeɛ ahaa odi kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ, bɔ ɛmɔnyakyi ye ngaa nemɔ koso yɔlɛ ɔ.

english_verse: As crowds were gathering around Jesus, he said: You people of today are evil! You keep looking for a sign from God. But what happened to Jonah is the only sign you will be given.
translation_verse: Na mmenia yɛle berɛ birikabirika nen, ɔhyɛle ye bo hane kyɛ, “Ɛnɛmmafoɛ te bɔnefoɛ. Bɛpena sɛngyerɛnneɛ, nakoso bɛngɔma bɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ biala, sana Yona sɛngyerɛnneɛ deɛ ne ala.

english_verse: When the judgment comes, the Queen of the South will stand there with you and condemn you. She traveled a long way to hear Solomon's wisdom, and yet here is something far greater than Solomon.
translation_verse: Ngwaen dɔ hemmaa ne, ɔne ɛnɛmmafoɛ bekodwɔso wɔ ndɛenbualɛ ne anu, na ɔkɔbɔ bɛ kwaadu, ofikyɛ ofili aseɛ noa dɔ paa wale ootiele Solomon nworɛ dwirɛ; na tie, bɔ odi mu tra Solomon wɔ wa!

english_verse: The people of Nineveh will also stand there with you and condemn you. They turned to God when Jonah preached, and yet here is something far greater than Jonah. Light (Matthew
translation_verse: Ninewefoɛ ne ɛnɛmmafoɛ bekodwɔso wɔ ndɛenbualɛ ne anu, na bɛkɔbɔ bɛ kwaadu, ofikyɛ Ninewefoɛ tele Yona nzɛmba nen, bɛsakyerale b’adwene; na tie, bɔ odi mu tra Yona wɔ wa! Nipadua kanea (Mateo

english_verse: No one lights a lamp and then hides it or puts it under a clay pot. A lamp is put on a lampstand, so everyone who comes into the house can see the light.
translation_verse: “Ebiala nzɔ kanea mva mvea anaa ɔmva nwura ɛkorɛ bo; na mmom ɔfa sie kanea bakaa so, amaa bɛ bɔ bɛba awuro berɛ ne banwu ye hyireinn ne.

english_verse: Your eyes are the lamp for your body. When your eyes are good, you have all the light you need. But when your eyes are bad, everything is dark.
translation_verse: Wɔ nye te nipadua ne kanea. Yiti sɛ wɔ nye nwu nikyee yé a, wɔ nipadua ne amukoraa te hyireinn; nakoso sɛ wɔ nye te wusiwusi a, wɔ nipadua ne amukoraa koso te awosii.

english_verse: So be sure your light isn't darkness.
translation_verse: Yiti nea yé né kanea bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ nu ne wangakyi awosii.

english_verse: You fools! Didn't God make both the outside and the inside?
translation_verse: Ngwaseafoɛ! Bɔ ɔyɔle bɛ nwo ne, aso nna ye ala yeɛ ɔyɔle nu ne koso ɔ?

english_verse: Yes, you are really in for trouble. You build monuments to honor the prophets your own people murdered long ago.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ yaakɔ! Ofikyɛ, ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ behuhuni bɛ ne, ɛmɔto b’asieleɛ so.

english_verse: When Jesus finished speaking, a Pharisee invited him home for a meal. Jesus went and sat down to eat.
translation_verse: Yesu noa wɔ so bɔ odwudwo nen, Farasiiniɛ bie tole ye sa frɛle ye kyɛ ɔbra ma beedidi. Yiti ɔhɔle nu ɔɔtenane ase kyɛ odidi.

english_verse: So the Lord said to him: You Pharisees clean the outside of cups and dishes, but on the inside you are greedy and evil.
translation_verse: Na Awurade sele ye kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ Farasiifoɛ de, ɛmɔnwunzi kwangoa ne prɛte nwo, nakoso ɛmɔ nu de, apoo ne bɔne yɔleɛ ayi ye tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: If you would only give what you have to the poor, everything you do would please God.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɔ ɔwɔ nu ne bɛyɛ adɔeɛ, na tie, nikyee biala nwo kɔte kɔma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: But you are in for trouble! You are like unmarked graves that people walk on without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ yaakɔ! Ofikyɛ, ɛmɔte kyɛ asieleɛ mɔ bɔ bennwu bɛ, bɔ mmenia nate so nakoso bɛnze ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: You teachers are also in for trouble! You load people down with heavy burdens, but you won't lift a finger to help them carry the loads.
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Mmeraa nwo nimdeɛfoɛ, ɛmɔ koso, ɛmɔ yaakɔ! Ofikyɛ, ɛmɔfa nningyein bɔ ye soalɛ yɛ yea ɔ bɛsoa mmenia, nakoso ɛmɔ bɔbɔ de, ɛmɔndengyɛ ɛmɔ sa mmɛseka ko po bɛmva bɛnga nningyein ne.

english_verse: You must think that was the right thing for your people to do, or else you would not have built monuments for the prophets they murdered.
translation_verse: Yiti, ɛmɔdi ɛmɔ nana mɔ yɔleɛ ne nwo adanzeɛ, na ɛmɔpene so, kyɛ bɛ yeɛ behuhuni bɛ ɔ, yeɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔto b’asieleɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: Because of your evil deeds, the Wisdom of God said, “I will send prophets and apostles to you. But you will murder some and mistreat others.”
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ati koso yeɛ Nyameɛ Nworɛ ne kã kyɛ, ‘Ngɔsoma ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne asomafoɛ maa bɛkɔhɔ bɛ berɛ; na bekohu biemɔ, ná batane ebiemɔ anye.’

english_verse: You people living today will be punished for all the prophets who have been murdered since the beginning of the world.
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ amukoraa bɛ mogya bɔ bahã bagua fi ewiase ahyɛaseɛ ne, ye nwo asodie la ɛnɛmmafoɛ so,

english_verse: This includes every prophet from the time of Abel to the time of Zechariah, who was murdered between the altar and the temple. You people will certainly be punished for all of this.
translation_verse: ofi Abel mogya so kodwu Sakaria bɔ behuni ye wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne ne nekaa krongron berɛ b’afia ne, ye mogya so. Yoo, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ye nwo asodie kɔla ɛnɛmmafoɛ so.

english_verse: You teachers of the Law of Moses are really in for trouble! You carry the keys to the door of knowledge about God. But you never go in, and you keep others from going in.
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔ, mmeraa nwo nimdeɛfoɛ, ɛmɔ yaakɔ! Ofikyɛ, ɛmɔafa nimdeɛ safoaa ne; ɛmɔ bɔbɔ a, ɛmɔangɔ nu, nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛ́kɔ nu ne koso, ɛmɔsi bɛ ate.”

english_verse: Jesus was about to leave, but the teachers and the Pharisees wanted to get even with him. They tried to make him say what he thought about other things,
translation_verse: Na Yesu fili berɛ bɔ ɔkɔ nen, ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne Farasiifoɛ mɔ hyɛle ye bo bɛfɛle ye so yaa, na bɛfale edwirɛ pee bɛtetale ye bɛfa bɛgyegyele ye,

english_verse: so they could catch him saying something wrong.
translation_verse: kyɛ ebiaa ɔkɔhã dwirɛ bɔ ɔkɔma ye noa kɔtɔ ɔ.

english_verse: As thousands of people crowded around Jesus and were stepping on each other, he told his disciples: Be sure to guard against the dishonest teaching of the Pharisees! It is their way of fooling people.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né mmenia apee apee bahyere so bɔ betiatia bɛ nwo so ɔ. Na Yesu hyɛle ye bo lili moa sele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ Farasiifoɛ mɔle harewaa bɔ ye ole nyaatwomyɛlɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: God gives such beauty to everything that grows in the fields, even though it is here today and thrown into a fire tomorrow. Won't he do even more for you? You have such little faith!
translation_verse: Na sɛ Nyameɛ siesie eburo ndire bɔ ogyi berɛ ɛnɛ maa ɔyɛ nyemene, ná ɛhema bapɛ bayera ye foonoo nu po a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ ongosiesie ɛmɔ ma ɛmɔ nwo ngɔyɛ nyemene ngɔtra so ɔ? Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔ gyidie te kãa ɔ!

english_verse: But put God's work first, and these things will be yours as well. Treasures in Heaven (Matthew
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔpena Nyameɛ ahennie ne mmom, na ɔkɔfa ɛhemɔ amukoraa kɔboka ɛmɔ so. Nyameɛso agyapadeɛ (Mateo

english_verse: My friends, don't be afraid of people. They can kill you, but after that, there is nothing else they can do.
translation_verse: “Me damvo mɔ, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, nnɛma ɛmɔsuro bɛ bɔ beku anwoɔnaen ne, ná ye si ye bɛngora hwee yɔ ko ɔ.

english_verse: Even the hairs on your head are counted. So don't be afraid! You are worth much more than many sparrows. Telling Others about Christ (Matthew
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ ti nwiaa po baha ye mukoraa. Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔsuro, na ɛmɔ nwo hia tra ngatipire pee!” Kyɛ ekole Yesu kɔto nu, ɔne kyɛ ɛkɔpo ye ɔ (Mateo

english_verse: My little group of disciples, don't be afraid! Your Father wants to give you the kingdom.
translation_verse: “Fekue kaaba, nnɛma ɛmɔsuro! Ofikyɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ Baba ne fɛ kyɛ ɔkɔfa ahennie ne kɔma ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Sell what you have and give the money to the poor. Make yourselves moneybags that never wear out. Make sure your treasure is safe in heaven, where thieves cannot steal it and moths cannot destroy it.

translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire wɔ kyɛ: Bɔ yɛse yeɛ yɛkã ɔ, na bɔ yanwu ye yeɛ yɛdi ye nwo adanzeɛ ɔ; nakoso ɛmɔnne yɛ adanzeɛ ne benni.

english_verse: If you don't believe when I talk to you about things on earth, how can you possibly believe if I talk to you about things in heaven?
translation_verse: Sɛ mahã aseɛ so dwirɛ mahyire ɛmɔ, ná ɛmɔnne benni a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ yeɛ sɛ mekã nyameɛso dwirɛ mekyire ɛmɔ a, ɛmɔkole koli ɔ?

english_verse: No one has gone up to heaven except the Son of Man, who came down from there.
translation_verse: Ebiala nne berɛ bɔ wafo wahɔ nyameɛso ɔ, sana bɔ ofi nyameɛso odwu wale ne, Sona Awa ne [bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne.]

english_verse: And the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as the metal snake was lifted up by Moses in the desert.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ Mose mane ewoo ne aso wɔ ɛserɛ so nen, sɔ ala yeɛ odi kyɛ bɛma Sona Awa ne aso ɔ,

english_verse: Then everyone who has faith in the Son of Man will have eternal life.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so ebiala bɔ okole ye koli ne wanya daa ngoa.

english_verse: God loved the people of this world so much that he gave his only Son, so that everyone who has faith in him will have eternal life and never really die.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ si hurole wiase dwirɛ nen, yiti yeɛ ɔmaa ɔfale Ɔwa komapɛ [bɔ ɔwole ye] ne mane ɔ, amaa ɔnate so ebiala bɔ okole ye koli ne wammini, na mmom wanya daa ngoa.

english_verse: God did not send his Son into the world to condemn its people. He sent him to save them!
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ, Nyameɛ anzoma Ɔwa ne maa wamma wiase kyɛ oobua wiase ndɛen, na mmom kyɛ ɔkɔfa ye so kole wiase ɔ.

english_verse: No one who has faith in God's Son will be condemned. But everyone who doesn't have faith in him has already been condemned for not having faith in God's only Son.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ode ye di ne, bemmua ye foɛ; nakoso bɔ onne nni ne de, babua ye foɛ dada, ofikyɛ onne Nyameɛ Awa komapɛ ne dumaa nni.

english_verse: The light has come into the world, and people who do evil things are judged guilty because they love the dark more than the light.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔte ndɛenbualɛ ɔ, kyɛ kanea ne awa wiase, nakoso mmenia hurole awosii trale kanea ne; ofikyɛ bɛ yɔleɛ te bɔne.

english_verse: People who do evil hate the light and won't come to the light, because it clearly shows what they have done.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne ne, okyi kanea ne, na ɔmma kanea ne nwo, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ye yɔleɛ ngɔla ali ɔ.

english_verse: But everyone who lives by the truth will come to the light, because they want others to know that God is really the one doing what they do. Jesus and John the Baptist
translation_verse: Nakoso ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔ ɔte nahorɛ ne de, ɔba kanea ne anwo, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ye yɔleɛ kɔla ali pefee kyɛ wayɛ sotie wama Nyameɛ ɔ.” Asubɔlɛniɛ Yohane adanzeɛ foforɛ

english_verse: Later, Jesus and his disciples went to Judea, where he stayed with them for a while and was baptizing people.
translation_verse: Na ɛhemɔ asi ne, Yesu ne ye asuafoɛ nemɔ bɛhɔle Yudea aseɛ so; ɔne bɛ tenane berɛ, na ɔbɔle asu.

english_verse: John's followers got into an argument with a Jewish man about a ceremony of washing.
translation_verse: Na bɛ nwo petenɛ nwo aporowaasulɛ wale Yohane asuafoɛ nemɔ ne Yudafoɛ b’afia.

english_verse: They went to John and said, “Rabbi, you spoke about a man when you were with him east of the Jordan. He is now baptizing people, and everyone is going to him.”
translation_verse: Na bɛwale Yohane berɛ beesele ye kyɛ, “Rabi, biaa bɔ né ɛne ye bɛwɔ asue Yɔɔdan si dɔ, bɔ elili ye nwo adanzeɛ nen, tie, ye koso ɔ́bɔ asu, na mmenia mukoraa bébiri bɛ́kɔ ye berɛ.”

english_verse: John replied: No one can do anything unless God in heaven allows it.
translation_verse: Na Yohane buale kyɛ, “Sona biala ngɔhora ngonya nikyee biala, sana bɛfa befi nyameɛso bɛma ye.

english_verse: You surely remember how I told you that I am not the Messiah. I am only the one sent ahead of him.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bedi me adanzeɛ kyɛ ngane kyɛ, ‘Nna me ole Kristo ne, na mmom basoma me maa mali ye nyunu moa.’

english_verse: At a wedding the groom is the one who gets married. The best man is glad just to be there and to hear the groom's voice. That's why I am so glad.
translation_verse: Bɔ atɔmvorɛ braa ne ɔte ye deɛ ne, ye ole atɔmvorɛ biaa ne. Na atɔmvorɛ biaa n’adamvo bɔ ogyina berɛ, ná otie ye ne de, ɔma ye nye gye paa wɔ atɔmvorɛ biaa ne komvi nwo; yiti afei de, m’anigye ne wali mu.

english_verse: Jesus must become more important, while I become less important. The One Who Comes from Heaven
translation_verse: Ye de, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔkɔ ye nyunu tra me, ná me de, medi nziɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: God's Son comes from heaven and is above all others. Everyone who comes from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks about earthly things. The one who comes from heaven is above all others.
translation_verse: Bɔ ofi nyameɛso ba ne, odi mu tra mmenia mukoraa. Bɔ ofi aseɛ so ne, ɔte aseɛ so deɛ, na aseɛ so dwirɛ yeɛ ɔkã ɔ; na bɔ ofi nyameɛso ba ne, odi mu tra mmenia mukoraa.

english_verse: He speaks about what he has seen and heard, and yet no one believes him.
translation_verse: Odi bɔ wanwu ye ɔ ɔne bɔ wate ɔ nwo adanzeɛ, nakoso ebiala nne ye adanzeɛ ne ndo nu.

english_verse: But everyone who does believe him has shown that God is truthful.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ode ye adanzeɛ ne to nu ne, osi ye pi kyɛ Nyameɛ te nahorɛniɛ.

english_verse: The Son was sent to speak God's message, and he has been given the full power of God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Na bɔ Nyameɛ asoma ye ne, ɔkã Nyameɛ dwirɛ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ fa Sunzum ne ɔma mmorosoɛ.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has given him everything.
translation_verse: Baba ne kuro Baa ne dwirɛ, na wafa nningyein mukoraa wawura ye sa.

english_verse: Everyone who has faith in the Son has eternal life. But no one who rejects him will ever share in that life, and God will be angry with them forever.
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ ode Baa ne di ne, ole daa ngoa; yeɛ bɔ ɔnyɛ sotie mma Baa nen, ongonya ngoa, na Nyameɛ ahonehulɛ ba ye so.

english_verse: Jesus left Judea and started for Galilee again.
translation_verse: Yiti ofili Yudea, na osa sili nu hɔle Galilea.

english_verse: This time he had to go through Samaria,
translation_verse: Né ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔkɔpɛ nu Samaria.

english_verse: “You are a Jew,” she replied, “and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink of water when Jews and Samaritans won't have anything to do with each other?”
translation_verse: Na Samarianiɛ braa ne sele ye kyɛ, “Ɛte Yudaniɛ, yeɛ me koso nde Samarianiɛ brasua, osi sɛɛ bɔ ɛsrɛ me dɔ nzue bɔ ɛkɔno ɔ?” Ɔhane sɔ, ofikyɛ né Yudafoɛ bɛ ne Samariafoɛ bɛnga.

english_verse: “Sir,” the woman said, “you don't even have a bucket, and the well is deep. Where are you going to get this life-giving water?
translation_verse: Na braa ne sele ye kyɛ, “Yɛ mene, elle nikyee bɔ bɛfa bɛto nzue ɔ, yeɛ abura ne anu koso wale; yiti nisua yeɛ ekonya sɔ ngoa nzue ne kofi ɔ?

english_verse: Our ancestor Jacob dug this well for us, and his family and animals got water from it. Are you greater than Jacob?”
translation_verse: Yɛ nana Yakob bɔ ɔmane yɛ abura he, bɔ ye bɔbɔ ɔnone nu nzue ne bie, bɔ ye mma ne ye nyɛmmoa koso bɛnone bie ne, aso edi mu tra ye anaa?”

english_verse: But no one who drinks the water I give will ever be thirsty again. The water I give will become in that person a flowing fountain that gives eternal life.”
translation_verse: Nakoso ebiala bɔ ɔkɔno nzue bɔ ngɔma ye bie ne de, nzuhɔen ngohũ ye le. Na nzue bɔ ngɔfa ngɔma ye ne, ɔkɔyɛ nzue abura wɔ ye nu bɔ opu kɔ daa ngoa nu ɔ.”

english_verse: The woman replied, “Sir, please give me a drink of that water! Then I won't get thirsty and have to come to this well again.”
translation_verse: Braa ne sele ye kyɛ, “Yɛ mene, ma me sɔ nzue ye bie, ná nzuhɔen angu me, ná mamma wa kyɛ mebaato nzue.”

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Go and bring your husband.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Kɔfrɛ ehu, ná ɛne ye bɛbra.”

english_verse: The woman answered, “I don't have a husband.” “That's right,” Jesus replied, “you're telling the truth. You don't have a husband. You have already been married five times, and the man you are now living with isn't your husband.”
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ɛne mmienzua nnu yeɛ batena ɔ; na bɔ ɛne ye bɛwɔ berɛ kekesaala ye po ne, nna ehu ɔ. Ahã nahorɛ wɔ ɛhe anwo.”

english_verse: The woman said, “Sir, I can see that you are a prophet.
translation_verse: Braa ne sele ye kyɛ, “Yɛ mene, menwu ye kyɛ ɛte ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ.

english_verse: My ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews say Jerusalem is the only place to worship.”
translation_verse: Yɛ nana mɔ bɛsɔnene wɔ bokaa he aso; na ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔnwa Yerusalem ole nekaa bɔ odi kyɛ yɛsɔne ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus said to her: Believe me, the time is coming when you won't worship the Father either on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Mmobraa, de me di, mmerɛ ne ɔ́ba bɔ nna bokaa he aso anaa Yerusalem yeɛ ɛmɔkɔsɔne Baba ne ɔ.

english_verse: You Samaritans don't really know the one you worship. But we Jews do know the God we worship, and by using us, God will save the world.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔsɔne bɔ ɛmɔnze ye ɔ; nakoso yɛ de, yɛsɔne bɔ yɛse ye ɔ, ofikyɛ Yudafoɛ nu yeɛ ngoalelɛ ne ofi ɔ.

english_verse: But a time is coming, and it is already here! Even now the true worshipers are being led by the Spirit to worship the Father according to the truth. These are the ones the Father is seeking to worship him.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ ne ɔ́ba, na wawa, bɔ bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne nahorɛ nu ne, bɛkɔsɔne Baba ne wɔ sunzum nu ne nahorɛ nu; ofikyɛ sɔ mmenia ne yeɛ Nyameɛ pena kyɛ bɛsɔne ye ɔ.

english_verse: God is Spirit, and those who worship God must be led by the Spirit to worship him according to the truth.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ te sunzum, na bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne ye ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛsɔne ye wɔ sunzum nu ne nahorɛ nu.”

english_verse: The woman said, “I know that the Messiah will come. He is the one we call Christ. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ braa ne sele ye kyɛ, “Mese kyɛ Mɛsaya ne ɔ́ba, na sɛ ɔba a, ye yeɛ okohyire yɛ nningyein amukoraa ɔ.”

english_verse: “I am that one,” Jesus told her, “and I am speaking to you now.”
translation_verse: Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Me bɔ me ne wɔ yɛdwudwo ye, me ole ye.”

english_verse: The disciples returned about this time and were surprised to find Jesus talking with a woman. But none of them asked him what he wanted or why he was talking with her.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne ala yeɛ ye asuafoɛ nemɔ bɛwale ɔ, na ɔyɛle bɛ nwanwa kyɛ ɔne braa ne bedwudwo ɔ, nakoso ebiala ammisa kyɛ, “Ɛpena nzu?” Anaakyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛne ye bedwudwo ɔ?”

english_verse: The woman left her water jar and ran back into town, where she said to the people,
translation_verse: Yeɛ braa ne yakyili ye bua ne berɛ, osa hɔle kuro ne anu dɔ, na oosele berɛ ama kyɛ,

english_verse: “Come and see a man who told me everything I have ever done! Could he be the Messiah?”
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔbra bɛɛnea oo, biaa bie bɔ wahã bɔ mayɔ amukoraa wahyire me ɔ! Aso nna ye ole Kristo ne anaa?”

english_verse: Everyone in town went out to see Jesus.
translation_verse: Yiti befili kuro ne anu bɛwale Yesu berɛ.

english_verse: While this was happening, Jesus' disciples were saying to him, “Teacher, please eat something.”
translation_verse: Na sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, asuafoɛ nemɔ srɛle ye kyɛ, “Rabi, didi.”

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I have food you don't know anything about.”
translation_verse: Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Nne aleɛ bɔ medi bɔ ɛmɔnze ɔ.”

english_verse: His disciples started asking each other, “Has someone brought him something to eat?”
translation_verse: Yiti asuafoɛ nemɔ bisabisale bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Ebie abrɛ ye aleɛ maa wali anaa?”

english_verse: Jesus said: My food is to do what God wants! He is the one who sent me, and I must finish the work that he gave me to do.
translation_verse: Na Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “M’aleɛ ole kyɛ ngɔyɔ bɔ ɔsomane me n’apɛdeɛ, na ngoyie ye adwuma ne ɔ.

english_verse: You may say there are still four months until harvest time. But I tell you to look, and you will see that the fields are ripe and ready to harvest.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ a ɛmɔnga kyɛ, ‘Waha bosome nna né buberɛ adwu’? Ɛ́mɔtie, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ ti so, ná ɛ́mɔnea fieso, kyɛ nningyein nemɔ bati kyɛ bebu ɔ.

english_verse: Even now the harvest workers are receiving their reward by gathering a harvest that brings eternal life. Then everyone who planted the seed and everyone who harvests the crop will celebrate together.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ obu ne, onya akatuaa, na ɔboaboa mmaa ne noa kɔ daa ngoa nu; na sona bɔ odua ne ɔne bɔ obu ne, benya anigye bɛbɔ nu.

english_verse: So the saying proves true, “Some plant the seed, and others harvest the crop.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, edwirɛ ne ɔte nahorɛ kyɛ, ‘Ebie dua, né ebie wora wabu.’

english_verse: I am sending you to harvest crops in fields where others have done all the hard work.
translation_verse: Nzomane ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔɔbu bɔ ɛmɔanyɔ ye nwo adwuma ɔ; ebiemɔ ayɔ adwuma ne, na ɛmɔate b’adwuma nwo nnɔbaeɛ ne.”

english_verse: A lot of Samaritans in that town put their faith in Jesus because the woman had said, “This man told me everything I have ever done.”
translation_verse: Na Samariafoɛ pee bɔ befi kuro ne anu ne, belele ye belili, ɔnate braa n’adanzeɛ bɔ olili ye kyɛ, “Wahã bɔ mayɔ amukoraa wahyire me” ne ati.

english_verse: They came and asked him to stay in their town, and he stayed on for two days.
translation_verse: Yiti mmerɛ bɔ Samariafoɛ nemɔ bɛwale ye nwo berɛ nen, bɛsrɛle ye kyɛ ɔtena bɛ berɛ; na olili bɛ nwo berɛ elenyɔ.

english_verse: Many more Samaritans put their faith in Jesus because of what they heard him say.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate Yesu noa dwirɛ ne ati, mmenia pee bɔ bɛtra daa deɛ ne ɔ bele belili.

english_verse: They told the woman, “We no longer have faith in Jesus just because of what you told us. We have heard him ourselves, and we are certain that he is the Savior of the world!” Jesus Heals an Official's Son (Matthew
translation_verse: Na besele braa ne kyɛ, “Afei de, nna wɔ noa dwirɛ ne ati yeɛ ɔmaa yɛde yɛdi ɔ, na mmom yɛ bɔbɔ yate, na yanwu kyɛ amba, ye ole ewiase Ngoadefoɛ ne.” Yesu sa panyi bie awa anwonyerɛ

english_verse: Jesus had said, “Prophets are honored everywhere, except in their own country.” Then two days later he left
translation_verse: Na Yesu bɔbɔ lili adanzeɛ kyɛ, ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ olle anidie wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye kuro.”

english_verse: and went to Galilee. The people there welcomed him, because they had gone to the festival in Jerusalem and had seen everything he had done.
translation_verse: Na odwuli Galilea nen, Galileafoɛ yɛle ye awaawaatuu. Né banwu bɔ ɔyɔle amukoraa wɔ Yerusalem, wɔ aluolue ne abo ne, ofikyɛ bɛ koso bɛhɔle aluolue ne abo bie.

english_verse: While Jesus was in Galilee, he returned to the village of Cana, where he had turned the water into wine. There was an official in Capernaum whose son was sick.
translation_verse: Afei Yesu sa hɔle Kana bɔ ɔwɔ Galilea, nekaa bɔ ɔkakyili nzue nzaa nen. Né biaa titireniɛ bie wɔ Kapanɔm bɔ ɔwa nde apɔ ɔ.

english_verse: And when the man heard that Jesus had come from Judea, he went and begged him to keep his son from dying.
translation_verse: Na ɔtele kyɛ Yesu afi Yudea wawa Galilea nen, osili nu hɔle ye berɛ ɔɔsrɛle ye kyɛ ɔbra ɔɔsa ɔwa ne anwonyerɛ, ɔnate kyɛ né ɔla awusu.

english_verse: Jesus told the official, “You won't have faith unless you see miracles and wonders!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Ɛmɔngole ngoli, sana ɛmɔanwu anwanwadeɛ ne nzɛngyerɛnneɛ koraka.”

english_verse: The man replied, “Lord, please come before my son dies!”
translation_verse: Na biaa titireniɛ ne sele ye kyɛ, “Yɛ mene, bra, nnɛma mma ne wu koraka.”

english_verse: Jesus then said, “Your son will live. Go on home to him.” The man believed Jesus and started back home.
translation_verse: Na Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Kɔ, ɛwa ne ate apɔ!” Na biaa ne lele Yesu dwirɛ bɔ ɔhã hyirele ye ne lili, na ɔhɔle.

english_verse: Some of the official's servants met him along the road and told him, “Your son is better!”
translation_verse: Na ɔ́kɔ nen, ye ngoaa mɔ wale beeyiale ye; na bɛhã behyirele ye kyɛ, “Ɛwa ne ate apɔ.”

english_verse: He asked them when the boy got better, and they answered, “The fever left him yesterday at one o'clock.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ obisale bɛ mmerɛ horɛ bɔ ye nwo hyɛle ye bo sandele ye ɔ. Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Anoma eyia dɔngo yeɛ ɛfokyɛlɛ ne fili ye nwo ɔ.”

english_verse: The boy's father realized that at one o'clock the day before, Jesus had told him, “Your son will live!” So the man and everyone in his family put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Na ye baba ne nwuni kyɛ sɔ mmerɛ ne ala yeɛ Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Ɛwa ne ate apɔ” ɔ. Yiti ɔne ye awuroama amukoraa bele belili.

english_verse: This was the second miracle that Jesus worked after he left Judea and went to Galilee.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ole nzɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ bɔ Yesu yɔle ɔ, mmerɛ bɔ ofili Yudea wale Galilea nen.

english_verse: Later, Jesus went to Jerusalem for another Jewish festival.
translation_verse: Ɛhe asi ne, Yudafoɛ aluolue dwuli, na Yesu hɔle Yerusalem.

english_verse: In the city near the sheep gate was a pool with five porches, and its name in Hebrew was Bethzatha.
translation_verse: Né ɛkwaa bie wɔ Yerusalem Mmoaen Pambim ne nwo, bɔ Hebri dwudwolɛ nu bɛfrɛ ye Betesaeda ɔ; na né apata nnu bɔ atee lela bɛ bo ɔ bɛwɔ ɛkwaa ne anwo berɛ.

english_verse: Beside the pool was a man who had been sick for
translation_verse: Né biaa bie wɔ berɛ bɔ ye nwo ayɛ ye yea afoɛ aburasa ne mmɔtwɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You have not believed his message, because you refused to have faith in the one he sent.
translation_verse: yeɛ ɛmɔmma ye dwirɛ ne ndena ɛmɔ nu, ofikyɛ bɔ ɔsomane ye ne, ɛmɔnne ye benni.

english_verse: When Jesus saw the man and realized that he had been crippled for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be healed?”
translation_verse: Na Yesu nwuni ye kyɛ ɔla berɛ, na onwuni kyɛ wala berɛ wahyɛ nen, obisale ye kyɛ, “Ɛpena kyɛ wɔ nwo sa anaa?”

english_verse: The man answered, “Sir, I don't have anyone to put me in the pool when the water is stirred up. I try to get in, but someone else always gets there first.”
translation_verse: Na yarefoɛ ne buale kyɛ, “Me mene, nnne ebiala bɔ sɛ nzue ne ponda a, ɔfa me kɔto ɛkwaa ne anu ɔ; na sɛ mekwaatɔ nu a, né ebie ali me nyunu moa waatɔ nu.”

english_verse: Jesus told him, “Pick up your mat and walk!”
translation_verse: Na Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Dwɔso, fa wɔ bɛen ne, ná nate!”

english_verse: Right then the man was healed. He picked up his mat and started walking around. The day on which this happened was a Sabbath.
translation_verse: Na berɛ ne ala, biaa ne tele apɔ; ɔfale ye bɛen ne, na ɔnatele. Né sɔ kyẽa ne te afofikyẽa.

english_verse: When the Jewish leaders saw the man carrying his mat, they said to him, “This is the Sabbath! No one is allowed to carry a mat on the Sabbath.”
translation_verse: Yiti Yudafoɛ nemɔ sele biaa bɔ ye nwo asa ne kyɛ, “Ɛnɛ te afofikyẽa, yiti mmeraa mma ate kyɛ ɛkɔsoa wɔ bɛen ɔ.”

english_verse: But he replied, “The man who healed me told me to pick up my mat and walk.”
translation_verse: Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Biaa bɔ ɔsale me anwonyerɛ ne, ye yeɛ osele me kyɛ, ‘Fa wɔ bɛen ne, ná nate’ ɔ.”

english_verse: They asked him, “Who is this man that told you to pick up your mat and walk?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ bebisale ye kyɛ, “Biaa beni yeɛ osele wɔ kyɛ, ‘Fa wɔ bɛen ne, ná nate’ ɔ?”

english_verse: But he did not know who Jesus was, and Jesus had left because of the crowd.
translation_verse: Na biaa bɔ ye nwo asa ne, né ɔnze sona horɛ, ofikyɛ né Yesu ahwe ye nwo wafi berɛ, yeɛ afei né mmenia pee wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: Later, Jesus met the man in the temple and told him, “You are now well. But don't sin anymore or something worse might happen to you.”
translation_verse: Nziɛ ye, Yesu nwuni ye wɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, na osele ye kyɛ “Nea, ate apɔ, nnɛyɔ bɔne ko, ná nikyee tɛɛ bɔ ɔtra ɛhe ɔ wanyɛ wɔ.”

english_verse: The man left and told the leaders that Jesus was the one who had healed him.
translation_verse: Biaa ne sili nu hɔle, na ɔɔbɔle Yudafoɛ nemɔ amaneɛ kyɛ Yesu yeɛ ɔsale ye anwonyerɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: They started making a lot of trouble for Jesus because he did things like this on the Sabbath.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate sɔ ati, Yudafoɛ nemɔ tanene Yesu nye, ofikyɛ ɔyɔle sɔ afofikyẽa.

english_verse: But Jesus said, “My Father has never stopped working, and this is why I keep on working.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Me Baba gu so ɔyɔ adwuma maa waadwu bekye, na me koso méyɔ adwuma.”

english_verse: Now the leaders wanted to kill Jesus for two reasons. First, he had broken the law of the Sabbath. But even worse, he had said God was his Father, which made him equal with God. The Son's Authority
translation_verse: Na ɔnate sɔ ati, Yudafoɛ mɔ mane bɛ nye borole kyɛ bekohu ye ɔ, kyɛ, nna afofikyẽa ngome yeɛ wabu so ɔ; na mmom ɔnwa Nyameɛ te ye bɔbɔ ye Baba, bɔ ɔfa kyire kyɛ ɔne Nyameɛ bɛte pɛ ɔ. Yesu ma bɛ mmuayɛɛ

english_verse: Jesus told the people: I tell you for certain the Son cannot do anything on his own. He can do only what he sees the Father doing, and he does exactly what he sees the Father do.
translation_verse: Na Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, Baa ne bɔbɔ ngora nyɔ hwee, sana bɔ onwu Baba ne kyɛ ɔyɔ ɔ; ofikyɛ nikyee biala bɔ ɔyɔ ne, ebie ala yeɛ Baa ne koso ɔyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: The Father loves the Son and has shown him everything he does. The Father will show him even greater things, and you will be amazed.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Baba ne kuro Baa ne dwirɛ, na okyire ye nikyee biala bɔ ye bɔbɔ ɔyɔ ɔ; na okohyire ye nnwumaa mbiri mbiri bɔ bɛtra ɛhemɔ ɔ, ná wayɛ ɛmɔ nwanwa.

english_verse: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Son gives life to anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ Baba ne tingye awufoɛ, ná ɔma bɛ ngoa nen, sɔ ala yeɛ Baa ne koso ɔma bɛ bɔ okuro ɔ ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: The Father doesn't judge anyone, but he has made his Son the judge of everyone.
translation_verse: Baba ne mmua ebiala ndɛen, na mmom wafa ndɛenbualɛ amukoraa wawura Baa ne sa,

english_verse: The Father wants all people to honor the Son as much as they honor him. When anyone refuses to honor the Son, this is the same as refusing to honor the Father who sent him.
translation_verse: kyɛ mmenia amukoraa beli Baa ne ni, kyɛbɔ bedi Baba ne ni nen. Na ebiala bɔ onni Baa ne ni nen, onni Baba ne bɔ ɔsomane ye ne koso ni.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who hears my message and has faith in the one who sent me has eternal life and will never be condemned. They have already gone from death to life.
translation_verse: “Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ebiala bɔ ɔte me dwirɛ, ná ode bɔ ɔsomane me ne di nen, ole daa ngoa; bengobua ye foɛ, na mmom wapɛ nu wafi ewue nu wahɔ ngoa nu.

english_verse: I tell you for certain the time will come, and it is already here, when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God. And those who listen to it will live!
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, mmerɛ ne ɔ́ba, na wawa dada, bɔ awufoɛ bɛkɔte Nyameɛ Awa ne komvi, na bɛ bɔ bɛte ne, bekonya ngoa.

english_verse: The Father has the power to give life, and he has given that same power to the Son.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ Baba ne ole ngoa wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye nu nen, sɔ ala yeɛ wafa wama Baa ne kyɛ ye koso onya ngoa wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye nu ɔ;

english_verse: And he has given his Son the right to judge everyone, because he is the Son of Man.
translation_verse: na wama ye tumi kyɛ obua ndɛen, ɔnate kyɛ ye ole Sona Awa ne.

english_verse: Don't be surprised! The time will come when all of the dead will hear the voice of the Son of Man,
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma ɛhe yɛ ɛmɔ nwanwa, ofikyɛ mmerɛ ne ɔ́ba, bɔ bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ asieleɛ nu amukoraa bɛkɔte ye komvi ɔ,

english_verse: and they will come out of their graves. Everyone who has done good things will rise to life, but everyone who has done evil things will rise and be condemned.
translation_verse: na bekofite bɛkɔwa, na bɛ bɔ bayɔ bɔ ɔte paa ne, bɛkɔhɔ ngoa ewutingyelɛ nu; nakoso bɛ bɔ bayɔ bɔne ne de, bɛkɔhɔ ndɛenbualɛ ewutingyelɛ nu.

english_verse: I cannot do anything on my own. The Father sent me, and he is the one who told me how to judge. I judge with fairness, because I obey him, and I don't just try to please myself. Witnesses to Jesus
translation_verse: “Me de, mengora memva me tumi menyɔ hwee; kyɛbɔ mete ne, yeɛ mebua ndɛen ɔ, na me ndɛenbualɛ te turoloo. Ɔnate kyɛ nna me bɔbɔ m’apɛdeɛ yeɛ mepena ɔ, na mmom bɔ ɔsomane me n’apɛdeɛ.

english_verse: If I speak for myself, there is no way to prove I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Sɛ medi me bɔbɔ me nwo adanzeɛ a, m’adanzeɛ ne ɔtte nahorɛ.

english_verse: But there is someone else who speaks for me, and I know what he says is true.
translation_verse: Ebie wɔ berɛ bɔ odi me nwo adanzeɛ ɔ, na mese kyɛ adanzeɛ bɔ odi fa me nwo ne ɔte nahorɛ.

english_verse: You sent messengers to John, and he told them the truth.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔsomane mmenia maa bɛhɔle Yohane berɛ, na olili nahorɛ ne nwo adanzeɛ.

english_verse: I don't depend on what people say about me, but I tell you these things so that you may be saved.
translation_verse: Na me de, nna sona berɛ yeɛ mede adanzeɛ mefi ɔ, na mmom mekã sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ɛmɔkonya ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: John was a lamp that gave a lot of light, and you were glad to enjoy his light for a while.
translation_verse: Ɔte kanea bɔ ógye ná ɔta ɔ, na ɛmɔhurole kyɛ ɛmɔ nye kɔhã ye kanea ne anu kãa.

english_verse: But something more important than John speaks for me. I mean the things that the Father has given me to do! All of these speak for me and prove that the Father sent me.
translation_verse: Na me de, m’adanzeɛ ne ɔtra Yohane deɛ ne; ofikyɛ nnwumaa bɔ Baba ne wafa wama me kyɛ nyɔ nyie nen, sɔ nnwumaa hemɔ ala bɔ meyɔ ne, bedi me nwo adanzeɛ kyɛ Baba ne yeɛ wasoma me ɔ.

english_verse: The Father who sent me also speaks for me, but you have never heard his voice or seen him face to face.
translation_verse: Na Baba ne bɔ ɔsomane me ne, ye bɔbɔ wali me nwo adanzeɛ. Ɛmɔttele ye komvi le, yeɛ ɛmɔnnwuni ye sue le;

english_verse: You search the Scriptures, because you think you will find eternal life in them. The Scriptures tell about me,
translation_verse: Ɛmɔpɛnzɛpɛnzɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne anu, ofikyɛ ɛmɔdwene kyɛ ɛmɔle daa ngoa wɔ nu; na ye ala yeɛ odi me nwo adanzeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: but you refuse to come to me for eternal life.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔnguro kyɛ ɛmɔkɔwa me berɛ, ná ɛmɔanya ngoa.

english_verse: I don't care about human praise,
translation_verse: “Membena animnyam memvi mmenia berɛ,

english_verse: but I do know that none of you love God.
translation_verse: na mese kyɛ Nyameɛ nwo dɔ ɔnne ɛmɔ nu.

english_verse: I have come with my Father's authority, and you have not welcomed me. But you will welcome people who come on their own.
translation_verse: Me Baba dumaa nu yeɛ mmale ɔ, nakoso ɛmɔnne me bɛndo nu; na sɛ ebie ba ye bɔbɔ ye dumaa nu a, ye de ɛmɔkole ye bɛkɔto nu.

english_verse: How could you possibly believe? You like to have your friends praise you, and you don't care about praise that the only God can give!
translation_verse: Ɔkɔyɛ sɛ né ɛmɔale bali, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔhyehyɛ ɛmɔ nwo ɛmɔ nwo animnyam, bɔ ɛmɔmbena animnyam bɔ ofi Nyameɛ komapɛ ne berɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Don't think that I will be the one to accuse you to the Father. You have put your hope in Moses, yet he is the very one who will accuse you.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔdwene kyɛ me yeɛ ngɔbɔ ɛmɔ kwaadu wɔ me Baba ne nyunu ɔ; bɔ ɔbɔ ɛmɔ kwaadu ne wɔ berɛ, na ye ole Mose bɔ ɛmɔafa ɛmɔ nye bato ye so ne.

english_verse: Moses wrote about me, and if you had believed Moses, you would have believed me.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔlele Mose belili a, ahaa ɛmɔkole me koso bekoli; ofikyɛ ɔhyerɛle me nwo dwirɛ.

english_verse: But if you don't believe what Moses wrote, how can you believe what I say?
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔnne bɔ ɔhyerɛle ne benni a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né ɛmɔale me noa dwirɛ bali?”

english_verse: The disciples gathered them up and filled twelve large baskets with what was left over from the five barley loaves.
translation_verse: Yiti ayuo paanoo nnu bɔ mmenia ne bali maa waha ne, bɛboaboale ye boso mboporoka ne noa beguale ngɛndɛen buru ne nyɔ nu maa beyili fokyefokyee.

english_verse: The disciples wanted to take him into the boat, but suddenly the boat reached the shore where they were headed. The Bread That Gives Life
translation_verse: Na bele anigye bɛmaa ɔɔtenane ɛlɛen ne anu; na berɛ ne ala, ɛlɛen ne dwuli mboanoa nekaa bɔ bɛkɔ ne. Ɛlɔen ne pena Yesu

english_verse: They replied, “What miracle will you work, so that we can have faith in you? What will you do?
translation_verse: Yeɛ besele ye kyɛ, “Nzaade, nzɛngyerɛnneɛ beni yeɛ ɛkɔyɔ, bɔ yɛkonwu ye, bɔ ɔkɔmaa yɛkole wɔ yɛkoli ɔ? Nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛkɔyɔ ɔ?

english_verse: No one can come to me, unless the Father who sent me makes them want to come. But if they do come, I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Na ebiala ngora mma me berɛ, sana Baba ne bɔ ɔsomane me ne ɔtwetwe ye ba; na ngotingye ye wɔ ayieleɛ kyẽa ne.

english_verse: “There is a boy here who has five small loaves of barley bread and two fish. But what good is that with all these people?”
translation_verse: “Abɛɛmaa bie wɔ wa bɔ ole ayuo paanoo nnu ne tiré nyɔ ɔ; nakoso ɛhe de, aso ɔkɔso mmenia wora he di?”

english_verse: The ground was covered with grass, and Jesus told his disciples to tell everyone to sit down. About
translation_verse: Na Yesu hane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma mmenia ne bɛ́tenatena ase!” Né nzenzaen pee wɔ berɛ. Na mmienzua bɔ bɛkɔyɛ apee nnu ɔ bɛtenatenane ase.

english_verse: They got into a boat and started across for Capernaum. Later that evening Jesus had still not come to them,
translation_verse: bɛtenane ɛlɛen nu, na bɛpɛle ɛpo ne kyɛ bɛkɔ Kapanɔm. Né aleɛ asa, na né Yesu onnya ɔwwale bɛ nwo berɛ.

english_verse: Jesus crossed Lake Galilee, which was also known as Lake Tiberias.
translation_verse: Ɛhe asi ne, Yesu pɛle Galilea ɛpo bɔ besa bɛfrɛ ye Tiberia ɛpo ne hɔle ye si dɔ.

english_verse: A large crowd had seen him work miracles to heal the sick, and those people went with him.
translation_verse: Na mmenia pembepembe lili ye si; ɔnate kyɛ né banwu nzɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ ɔyɔ fa sale mmenia anwonyerɛ ne.

english_verse: Philip answered, “Don't you know that it would take almost a year's wages just to buy only a little bread for each of these people?”
translation_verse: Na Filipo buale ye kyɛ, “Denare ɛyaa nyɔ po ɔngɔso paanoo bɔ ebiala konya kaala koli ɔ tɔ.”

english_verse: Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, was one of the disciples. He spoke up and said,
translation_verse: Na ye asuafoɛ nemɔ nu ko bɔ oli Andrea, Simɔn Petro aliɛma ne, osele ye kyɛ,

english_verse: Jesus took the bread in his hands and gave thanks to God. Then he passed the bread to the people, and he did the same with the fish, until everyone had plenty to eat.
translation_verse: Na Yesu fale paanoo ne, ɔlale ase, na ɔhyɛ mane bɛ bɔ bɛtete berɛ ne; na sɔ ala yeɛ ɔyɛle tiré ne koso ɔ, somaa biala bɔ behia ɔ.

english_verse: The people ate all they wanted, and Jesus told his disciples to gather up the leftovers, so that nothing would be wasted.
translation_verse: Na bɛ ko yili nen, osele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔboaboa mboporoka bɔ waha ne noa, ná ebie ammini.”

english_verse: Jesus realized that they would try to force him to be their king. So he went up on a mountain, where he could be alone. Jesus Walks on the Water (Matthew
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu nwuni kyɛ bɛbaahye ye mbendene so bɛfa ye bedi hene, yiti ɔhwene ye nwo, na ye ngome ɔhɔle bokaa ne aso dɔ bieku. Yesu nate ɛpo nye so (Mateo

english_verse: The people who had stayed on the east side of the lake knew that only one boat had been there. They also knew that Jesus had not left in it with his disciples. But the next day
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyene nen, ɛlɔen bɔ bɛhale ɛpo ne asi dɔ ne, benwuni kyɛ ɛlɛen biala nne berɛ kyɛ ɛlɛen ko bɔ ye asuafoɛ nemɔ bɛfole ne, nakoso nna Yesu ne ye asuafoɛ nemɔ yeɛ bɛtenane ɛlɛen ne anu ɔ, na mmom ye asuafoɛ nemɔ angome yeɛ bɛhɔle ɔ.

english_verse: Don't work for food that spoils. Work for food that gives eternal life. The Son of Man will give you this food, because God the Father has given him the right to do so.”
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ aleɛ bɔ ɔsɛkye ɔ nwo adwuma, na mmom ɛ́mɔyɔ aleɛ bɔ ɔtena berɛ kɔ daa ngoa nu, bɔ Sona Awa ne kɔfa kɔma ɛmɔ ne nwo adwuma; ofikyɛ ye yeɛ Baba Nyameɛ wale ye wato nu wama ye tumi ɔ.”

english_verse: One of the prophets wrote, “God will teach all of them.” And so everyone who listens to the Father and learns from him will come to me.
translation_verse: Bahyerɛ ye wɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nwomaa ne anu kyɛ, ‘Bɛ mukoraa bɛkɔyɛ mmenia bɔ Nyameɛ ahyirehyire bɛ ɔ.’ Ebiala bɔ wate, ná wasua wafi Baba ne berɛ nen, ɔba me berɛ.

english_verse: They started arguing with each other and asked, “How can he give us his flesh to eat?”
translation_verse: Na ɛhe mane Yudafoɛ nemɔ bɛpɛle bɛ nwo besuli bɛ nwo aporowaa kyɛ, “Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né biaa he wahora wafa ye nwonaen wamaa yali?”

english_verse: That evening, Jesus' disciples went down to the lake.
translation_verse: Na odwuli nɔsoa nen, ye asuafoɛ nemɔ hɔle mboanoa,

english_verse: and a strong wind was making the water rough.
translation_verse: Ɛpo ne aso yɛle bagyabagya, ɔnate kyɛ né mvrama serɛserɛ bie otu.

english_verse: When the disciples had rowed for five or six kilometers, they saw Jesus walking on the water. He kept coming closer to the boat, and they were terrified.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ bɛhane ɛlɛen ne kɔyɛ kwanzii nza anaa nna nen, benwuni Yesu kyɛ ɔnate ɛpo n’anye so ɔba b’ɛlɛen ne nwo; na ɛserɛ hane bɛ.

english_verse: But he said, “I am Jesus! Don't be afraid!”
translation_verse: Na Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Me ɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔsuro!”

english_verse: some boats from Tiberias sailed near the place where the crowd had eaten the bread for which the Lord had given thanks.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛlɛen biemɔ fili Tiberia bɛwale bepingyele nekaa bɔ Awurade lale ase, ná belili paanoo ne.

english_verse: They saw that Jesus and his disciples had left. Then they got into the boats and went to Capernaum to look for Jesus.
translation_verse: Na ɛlɔen ne nwuni kyɛ Yesu nne berɛ, ná ye asuafoɛ nemɔ koso bɛnne berɛ nen, bɛ koso bɛfofole ɛlɛen nemɔ anu bɛhɔle Kapanɔm bɛɛpenane Yesu. Yesu ole ngoa paanoo ne

english_verse: They found him on the west side of the lake and asked, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
translation_verse: Na beenwuni ye wɔ ɛpo ne asi dɔ nen, bebisale ye kyɛ, “Rabi, mmerɛ beni yeɛ ɛwale wa ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that you are not looking for me because you saw the miracles, but because you ate all the food you wanted.
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, nna kyɛ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ ɛmɔnwuni ye ne ati yeɛ ɛmɔpena me ɔ, na mmom paanoo bɔ ɛmɔlili mane ɛmɔ ko yili ne ati ɔ.

english_verse: “What exactly does God want us to do?” the people asked.
translation_verse: Yeɛ bebisale ye kyɛ “Nzikyɛ yeɛ odi kyɛ yɛyɔ, bɔ yɛyɔ a ɔte Nyameɛ nnwumaa ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “God wants you to have faith in the one he sent.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ adwuma ɛhe, kyɛ ɛmɔkole bɔ wasoma ye ne bekoli ɔ.”

english_verse: For example, when our ancestors were in the desert, they were given manna to eat. It happened just as the Scriptures say, ‘God gave them bread from heaven to eat.’ ”
translation_verse: Yɛ nana mɔ belili mana wɔ ɛserɛ so, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye kyɛ, ‘Ɔmane bɛ paanoo fili nyameɛso maa belili.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus then told them, “I tell you for certain that Moses wasn't the one who gave you bread from heaven. My Father is the one who gives you the true bread from heaven.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, nna Mose yeɛ ɔmane ɛmɔ paanoo bɔ ofi nyameɛso ne ɔ; na mmom me Baba yeɛ ɔma ɛmɔ nahorɛ paanoo bɔ ofi nyameɛso ɔ.

english_verse: And the bread that God gives is the one who came down from heaven to give life to the world.”
translation_verse: Nyameɛ paanoo ne ole bɔ ofi nyameɛso ba ase, ná ɔma wiase ngoa ne.”

english_verse: The people said, “Sir, give us this bread and don't ever stop!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ besele ye kyɛ, “Awurade, ma yɛ paanoo he daa.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am the bread that gives life! No one who comes to me will ever be hungry. No one who has faith in me will ever be thirsty.
translation_verse: Na Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Me ole ngoa paanoo ne; ebiala bɔ ɔba me berɛ nen, ɛhɔen ngohũ ye le; yeɛ ebiala bɔ ode me di ne, nzuhɔen ngohũ ye le.

english_verse: I have told you already that you have seen me and still do not have faith in me.
translation_verse: Nga ngyirele ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔanwu me, nakoso ɛmɔnne benni.

english_verse: Everything and everyone that the Father has given me will come to me, and I won't turn any of them away.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ Baba ne ɔfa bɛ ma me ne, bɛ mukoraa bɛkɔwa me berɛ; na ebiala bɔ ɔba me berɛ ne, mengɔto ye ngɔye le.

english_verse: I didn't come from heaven to do what I want! I came to do what the Father wants me to do. He sent me,
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ mvi nyameɛso mawa ase, nna kyɛ mebaayɔ me bɔbɔ m’apɛdeɛ, na mmom bɔ ɔsomane me n’apɛdeɛ.

english_verse: and he wants to make certain that none of the ones he has given me will be lost. Instead, he wants me to raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔsomane me n’apɛdeɛ ole kyɛ: bɔ ɔfa mane me ne amukoraa, mengɔma nu ko po ngomini ɔ, na mmom ngotingye ye wɔ ayieleɛ kyẽa ne.

english_verse: My Father wants everyone who sees the Son to have faith in him and to have eternal life. Then I will raise them to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ole me Baba n’apɛdeɛ, kyɛ ebiala bɔ onwu Baa ne, ná ode ye di ne, okonya daa ngoa; na ngotingye ye wɔ ayieleɛ kyẽa ne.”

english_verse: The people started grumbling because Jesus had said he was the bread that had come down from heaven.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yudafoɛ nemɔ bɛpenepenene bɛ komvi beguale ye so, ofikyɛ ɔhane kyɛ, “Me ole paanoo bɔ ofili nyameɛso wale ase ne.”

english_verse: They were asking each other, “Isn't he Jesus, the son of Joseph? Don't we know his father and mother? How can he say that he has come down from heaven?”
translation_verse: Na bɛhane kyɛ, “Aso nna ɛhe ole Yesu, Yosef awa ne, bɔ yɛse ye baba ne ye maame ɔ? Ɔyɛle sɛɛ bɔ afei ɔkã kyɛ, ‘Mvi nyameɛso yeɛ mmale ase ɔ?’ ”

english_verse: Jesus told them: Stop grumbling!
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔpenepene ɛmɔ komvi.

english_verse: The only one who has seen the Father is the one who has come from him. No one else has ever seen the Father.
translation_verse: Nna kyɛ sona bie anwu Baba ne, sana bɔ ofi Nyameɛ berɛ ne, na ye yeɛ wanwu Baba ne ɔ.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that everyone who has faith in me has eternal life.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ebiala bɔ ode di ne, ole daa ngoa.

english_verse: I am the bread that gives life!
translation_verse: Me ole ngoa paanoo ne.

english_verse: Your ancestors ate manna in the desert, and later they died.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ nana mɔ belili mana wɔ ɛserɛ so, na bewuwuli.

english_verse: But the bread from heaven has come down, so that no one who eats it will ever die.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ole paanoo bɔ ofi nyameɛso ba ase ne, kyɛ sona oli bie, ná wanwu.

english_verse: I am that bread from heaven! Everyone who eats it will live forever. My flesh is the life-giving bread I give to the people of this world.
translation_verse: Me ole ngoa paanoo bɔ ofi nyameɛso wale ase ne; na sɛ ebie di paanoo he bie a, ɔkɔtena ase daa; na paanoo bɔ ngɔfa ngɔma wiase ngoa ne, ye ole me nwonaen.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I tell you for certain that you won't live unless you eat the flesh and drink the blood of the Son of Man.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔanni Sona Awa ne nwonaen, ná ɛmɔanno ye mogya a, ye de ɛmɔlle ngoa wɔ ɛmɔ nu.

english_verse: But if you do eat my flesh and drink my blood, you will have eternal life, and I will raise you to life on the last day.
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ odi me nwonaen ná ɔno me mogya nen, ole daa ngoa, na ngotingye ye wɔ ayieleɛ kyẽa ne.

english_verse: My flesh is the true food, and my blood is the true drink.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ me nwonaen te aleɛ amba, yeɛ me mogya te anonneɛ amba.

english_verse: If you eat my flesh and drink my blood, you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ odi me nwonaen ná ɔno me mogya nen, ɔte me nu, na me koso nde ye nu.

english_verse: The living Father sent me, and I have life because of him. Now everyone who eats my flesh will live because of me.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ Baba teasefoɛ ne ɔsomane me nen, sɔ ala yeɛ Baba ne ati nde ase ɔ; yiti ebiala bɔ odi me nwonaen nen, me ti ɔkɔtena ase.

english_verse: The bread that comes down from heaven isn't like what your ancestors ate. They died, but whoever eats this bread will live forever.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ole paanoo bɔ ofi nyameɛso wale ase ne. Bɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ belili ná bewuwuli ne, nna sɔ yeɛ ɔte ɔ; na paanoo he de, ebiala bɔ odi ne, ɔkɔtena ngoa nu daa.”

english_verse: Jesus was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum when he said these things. The Words of Eternal Life
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né ɔ́yɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ wɔ Kapanɔm nyianu sua nu yeɛ ɔhane sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ ɔ. Daa ngoa nwo dwirɛ

english_verse: Many of Jesus' disciples heard him and said, “This is too hard for anyone to understand.”
translation_verse: Na ye asuafoɛ nemɔ anu pee bɛtele sɔ dwirɛ nen, bɛhane kyɛ, “Ngyerɛkyerɛ he de, ɔyɛ se; nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kotie ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus knew that his disciples were grumbling. So he asked, “Does this bother you?
translation_verse: Nakoso Yesu nwuni kyɛ ye asuafoɛ nemɔ bɛ́penepene bɛ komvi wɔ ɛhe anwo nen, osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛhe to ɛmɔ sundidua anaa?

english_verse: What if you should see the Son of Man go up to heaven where he came from?
translation_verse: Né nzaade sɛ ɛmɔnwu Sona Awa ne kyɛ ɔ́kɔ anwuro, nekaa bɔ né ɔwɔ daa ne koso ɛ?

english_verse: The Spirit is the one who gives life! Human strength can do nothing. The words that I have spoken to you are from that life-giving Spirit.
translation_verse: Sunzum ne yeɛ ɔma ngoa ɔ; na anwoɔnaen ne de, ɔtte huu. Edwirɛ bɔ mahã mahyire ɛmɔ ne, ɔte sunzum ne ngoa.

english_verse: But some of you refuse to have faith in me.” Jesus said this, because from the beginning he knew who would have faith in him. He also knew which one would betray him.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ nu biemɔ wɔ berɛ bɔ benne benni ɔ.” Na ofi ahyɛaseɛ ne, né Yesu se bɛ bɔ benne benni ɔ; ɔne sona bɔ ɔkɔye ye kɔma ne.

english_verse: Then Jesus said, “You cannot come to me, unless the Father makes you want to come. That is why I have told these things to all of you.”
translation_verse: Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɔnate ɛhe ati yeɛ mahã mahyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ebiala ngɔhora ngɔwa me berɛ, sana Baba ne afa ye wama me.”

english_verse: Because of what Jesus said, many of his disciples turned their backs on him and stopped following him.
translation_verse: Na ofi sɔ mmerɛ ne, ye asuafoɛ nemɔ anu pee besale bɛ si, na bɛ ne ye annate ko.

english_verse: Jesus then asked his twelve disciples if they also were going to leave him.
translation_verse: Yiti Yesu bisale mmenia buru ne nyɔ ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ koso, ɛmɔpena kyɛ ɛmɔkɔ bie anaa?”

english_verse: Simon Peter answered, “Lord, there is no one else that we can go to! Your words give eternal life.
translation_verse: Na Simɔn Petro buale ye kyɛ, “Awurade, nwa berɛ yeɛ yɛkɔhɔ ɔ? Wɔ yeɛ ele daa ngoa dwirɛ ɔ;

english_verse: We have faith in you, and we are sure that you are God's Holy One.”
translation_verse: na yale yali, na yanwu ye kyɛ wɔ ole Nyameɛ ye Krongronniɛ ne.”

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “I chose all twelve of you, but one of you is a demon!”
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Aso nna me yeɛ maneanea nu maye ɛmɔ, mmenia buru ne nyɔ ye ɔ? Nakoso, aso ɛmɔ nu ko ɔtte abɔnzam?”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. He would later betray Jesus, even though he was one of the twelve disciples.
translation_verse: Né ɔne Yudase Yiskariote, Simɔn awa ne; ofikyɛ ye yeɛ né ɔbaaye ye ma ɔ, nakoso né ɔte asuafoɛ buru ne nyɔ nemɔ anu ko.

english_verse: Jesus decided to leave Judea and to start going through Galilee because the leaders of the people wanted to kill him.
translation_verse: Na ɛhemɔ asi ne, Yesu hyinini Galilea; wanguro kyɛ ɔkɔhɔ Yudea, ofikyɛ né Yudafoɛ nemɔ bɛpena ye beku ye.

english_verse: It was almost time for the Festival of Shelters,
translation_verse: Né Yudafoɛ Asese aluolue ne apingye.

english_verse: and Jesus' brothers said to him, “Why don't you go to Judea? Then your disciples can see what you are doing.
translation_verse: Yiti oliɛma nemɔ sele ye kyɛ, “Fi wa kɔ Yudea, ná w’asuafoɛ nemɔ benwu nnwumaa bɔ ɛ́yɔ ne.

english_verse: No one does anything in secret, if they want others to know about them. So let the world know what you are doing!”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔpena kyɛ mmenia benwu ye nen, ɔnyɔ ye nningyein mvea. Sɛ ɛyɔ ɛhemɔ de a, ye de da wɔ nwo ali kyire wiase.”

english_verse: Even Jesus' own brothers had not yet become his followers.
translation_verse: Na oliɛma nemɔ po banne ye banni.

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My time hasn't yet come, but your time is always here.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Me de, me mmerɛ ne onnya oddwuli; nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔ mmerɛ ne ɔwɔ berɛ daa.

english_verse: The people of this world cannot hate you. They hate me, because I tell them that they do evil things.
translation_verse: Wiase ngora mbɔ ɛmɔ, nakoso me yeɛ ɔpɔ me ɔ, ofikyɛ medi adanzeɛ kyɛ ye yɔleɛ te bɔne.

english_verse: Go on to the festival. My time hasn't yet come, and I am not going.”
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔhɔ aluolue ne abo. Na me de, mengɔhɔ aluolue ne abo, ɔnate kyɛ me mmerɛ ne onnya oddwuli.”

english_verse: Jesus said this and stayed on in Galilee. Jesus at the Festival of Shelters
translation_verse: Na ɔhã hyirele bɛ sɔ nen, ɔhale Galilea berɛ.

english_verse: After Jesus' brothers had gone to the festival, he went secretly, without telling anyone.
translation_verse: Na oliɛma nemɔ hɔle aluolue ne abo nen, ye si ye, ye koso ɔhɔle ye bo bie; wanye ye nwo ali, na mmom ɔfale ye nwo feale.

english_verse: During the festival the leaders of the people looked for Jesus and asked, “Where is he?”
translation_verse: Né Yudafoɛ nemɔ bɛpenane ye wɔ aluolue ne abo, na bebisale kyɛ, “Ɔwɔ nisua?”

english_verse: The crowds even got into an argument about him. Some were saying, “Jesus is a good man,” while others were saying, “He is lying to everyone.”
translation_verse: Na mmenia nemɔ yɛle nwuhunwuhu pee bɛfale ye nwo. Ebiemɔ hane kyɛ, “Ɔte sona paa.” Yeɛ ebiemɔ koso nwa, “Daabi, ɔlakalaka mmenia.”

english_verse: But the people were afraid of their leaders, and none of them talked in public about him.
translation_verse: Nakoso né besuro Yudafoɛ nemɔ, yiti ebiala anye ye nyunu wanga ye nwo dwirɛ.

english_verse: When the festival was about half over, Jesus went into the temple and started teaching.
translation_verse: Na bedwuli aluoluelilɛ n’afia nen, Yesu hɔle asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu ɔɔyɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ.

english_verse: The leaders were surprised and said, “How does this man know so much? He has never been taught!”
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛle Yudafoɛ nemɔ nwanwa maa bɛhane kyɛ, “Ɔyɛle sɛɛ bɔ biaa he nyane nimdeɛ sɔa ɔ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ ossuane nwomaa biala ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I am not teaching something I thought up. What I teach comes from the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Me ngyerɛkyerɛ ne ɔtte me deɛ, na mmom ɔte bɔ ɔsomane me ne deɛ.

english_verse: If you really want to obey God, you will know if what I teach comes from God or from me.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie kuro kyɛ ɔyɔ ye apɛdeɛ a, okonwu ye kyɛ, ngyerɛkyerɛ ne ofi Nyameɛ berɛ, anaakyɛ mefa me bɔbɔ me tumi yeɛ medwudwo hɔ a.

english_verse: If I wanted to bring honor to myself, I would speak for myself. But I want to honor the one who sent me. This is why I tell the truth and not a lie.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔbɔ ye ti anu dwudwo ne, ɔpena ye bɔbɔ ye animnyam; nakoso bɔ ɔpena animnyam ma bɔ ɔsomane ye nen, ye ole nahorɛniɛ ne, na ngondombo biala nne ye nu.

english_verse: Didn't Moses give you the Law? Yet none of you obey it! So why do you want to kill me?
translation_verse: Aso Mose amva mmeraa ne wamma ɛmɔ? Nakoso ɛmɔ nu biala nni mmeraa ne aso. Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔpena me beku me ɔ?”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “You're crazy! What makes you think someone wants to kill you?”
translation_verse: Na ɛlɔen ne buale kyɛ “Ele sunzummɔne! Nwa yeɛ ɔpena wɔ ku wɔ ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I worked one miracle, and it amazed you.
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Nyɔle anwanwadeɛ ko, na ɔyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa nwanwa.

english_verse: in order to obey the Law of Moses. Why are you angry with me for making someone completely well on the Sabbath?
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔpɛ ebie bienzua afofikyẽa, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ɛmɔngobu Mose mmeraa so a, né nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔafɛ me so yaa kyɛ mama sona mumua wate apɔ wɔ afofikyẽa ɔ?

english_verse: Some of the people from Jerusalem were saying, “Isn't this the man they want to kill?
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yerusalemfoɛ nemɔ bie hane kyɛ, “Aso nna biaa he yeɛ bɛpena ye beku ye ne?

english_verse: Yet here he is, speaking for everyone to hear. And no one is arguing with him. Do you suppose the authorities know he is the Messiah?
translation_verse: Nea, ɔwɔ wa odwudwo petee nu, nakoso benze ye huu! Mbanyi nemɔ, aso bɛse amba kyɛ ɛhe ole Kristo ne anaa?

english_verse: But how could that be? No one knows where the Messiah will come from, but we know where this man comes from.”
translation_verse: Nakoso biaa he de, yɛse nekaa bɔ ofi ɔ; na Kristo ne de, sɛ ɔba a, ebiala ngonwu nekaa bɔ ofi ɔ.”

english_verse: As Jesus was teaching in the temple, he shouted, “Do you really think you know me and where I came from? I didn't come on my own! The one who sent me is truthful, and you don't know him.
translation_verse: Na Yesu gu so bɔ ɔyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu nen, ɔteane nu hane kyɛ, “Ɛmɔse me, yeɛ ɛmɔse nekaa bɔ mvi ɔ. Nakoso nna me bɔbɔ me tumi so yeɛ mva mmale ɔ; na bɔ ɔsomane me ne te nahorɛniɛ, na ɛmɔnze ye.

english_verse: But I know the one who sent me, because I came from him.”
translation_verse: Me de, mese ye, ofikyɛ mvi ye berɛ, na ye yeɛ ɔsomane me ɔ.”

english_verse: Some of the people wanted to arrest Jesus right then. But no one even laid a hand on him, because his time had not yet come.
translation_verse: Na ahaa bɛpena ye bɛkye ye; nakoso ebiala amva ye sa wanga ye, ofikyɛ né ye mmerɛ ne onnya oddwuli.

english_verse: A lot of people in the crowd put their faith in him and said, “When the Messiah comes, he surely won't perform more miracles than this man has done!” Officers Sent To Arrest Jesus
translation_verse: Nakoso mmenia nemɔ anu pee belele ye belili, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Kristo ne, sɛ ɔba a, aso ɔkɔyɔ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ pee kɔtra bɔ biaa he wayɔ ye?” Yesu kosa kɔhɔ Nyameɛ berɛ

english_verse: When the Pharisees heard the crowd arguing about Jesus, they got together with the chief priests and sent some temple police to arrest him.
translation_verse: Farasiifoɛ mɔ bɛtele kyɛ ɛlɔen ne bɛ́yɛ nwuhunwuhu bɛkekã sɔ dwirɛ ne bɛfa ye nwo. Yiti Farasiifoɛ ne asɔfo mbanyi mɔ betuli asomvoɛ mɔ kyɛ bɛhɔ bɛɛhye ye.

english_verse: But Jesus told them, “I will be with you a little while longer, and then I will return to the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Me ne ɛmɔ kɔtena mmerɛ kãa bie, na afei ngɔhɔ bɔ ɔsomane me ne berɛ.

english_verse: You will look for me, but you won't find me. You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkɔpena me, na ɛmɔngonwu me; na nekaa bɔ nwɔ ne, ɛmɔngɔhora ngɔwa berɛ bie.”

english_verse: The people asked each other, “Where can he go to keep us from finding him? Is he going to some foreign country where our people live? Is he going there to teach the Greeks?
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yudafoɛ nemɔ sisele bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Nisua yeɛ biaa he ɔbaahɔ bɔ yɛngonwu ye ɔ? Ɔbaahɔ bɛ bɔ babɔ aya bahɔ Helafoɛ mɔ nu ne berɛ ɔkɔyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ kyire Helafoɛ anaa?

english_verse: What did he mean by saying that we will look for him, but won't find him? Why can't we go where he is going?” Streams of Life-Giving Water
translation_verse: Sɛɛ yeɛ ɔpena kyɛ okyire ɔ? Ɔnwa, ‘Ɛmɔkɔpena me, na ɛmɔngonwu me; na nekaa bɔ nwɔ ne, ɛmɔngɔhora ngɔwa berɛ bie.’ ” Ngoa nzue nwo dwirɛ

english_verse: On the last and most important day of the festival, Jesus stood up and shouted, “If you are thirsty, come to me and drink!
translation_verse: Na kyẽa bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo, bɔ ɔte aluolue ne anu kyẽa piri ne, Yesu dwɔso gyinane, na ɔteane nu hane kyɛ, “Sɛ nzuhɔen ku ebie a, ɔbra me berɛ ɔɔno nzue oo.

english_verse: Have faith in me, and you will have life-giving water flowing from deep inside you, just as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ Ahyerɛlɛ ne ahã ne, ebiala bɔ ode me di ne, ‘Ngoa asue mɔ kɔtengyɛ kofi ye kunu.’ ”

english_verse: Jesus was talking about the Holy Spirit, who would be given to everyone that had faith in him. The Spirit had not yet been given to anyone, since Jesus had not yet been given his full glory. The People Take Sides
translation_verse: Na ɛhe de, ɔhã fale Sunzum ne nwo, bɔ mmenia bɔ bede ye bedi ne bɛbaanya ye ɔ; né Sunzum ne onnya ɔwwale, ofikyɛ né bennya bɛhhyɛle Yesu animnyam. Mmenia ne anu ahyehyɛ

english_verse: When the crowd heard Jesus say this, some of them said, “He must be the Prophet!”
translation_verse: Na mmenia ne tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, bɛ nu biemɔ hane kyɛ, “Ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne ɛhe amba!”

english_verse: Others said, “He is the Messiah!” Others even said, “Can the Messiah come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Yeɛ ebiemɔ koso hane kyɛ, “Kristo ne ɛhe!” Nakoso ebiemɔ hane kyɛ, “Kristo ne, Galilea yeɛ okofi kɔwa hɔ anaa?

english_verse: The Scriptures say that the Messiah will come from the family of King David. Doesn't this mean that he will be born in David's hometown of Bethlehem?”
translation_verse: Ahyerɛlɛ ne, aso wanga kyɛ Kristo ne kɔyɛ Dawide bosoniɛ, na Betlehem kuro bɔ Dawide tenane so ne anu yeɛ okofi ɔ?”

english_verse: The people started taking sides against each other because of Jesus.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate ye ti mmenia ne anu hyehyɛle.

english_verse: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid a hand on him. The Leaders Refuse To Have Faith in Jesus
translation_verse: Na bɛ nu biemɔ penane kyɛ bɛkɔhye ye ɔ, nakoso ebiala amva ye sa wanga ye. Bangora bangye Yesu

english_verse: When the temple police returned to the chief priests and Pharisees, they were asked, “Why didn't you bring Jesus here?”
translation_verse: Na asomvoɛ nemɔ sa hɔle asɔfo mbanyi ne Farasiifoɛ nemɔ berɛ nen, bebisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔamva ye bamma ɔ?”

english_verse: They answered, “No one has ever spoken like this man!”
translation_verse: Na asomvoɛ nemɔ buale kyɛ, “Sona biala nne berɛ bɔ wadwudwo kyɛ biaa he ɔ le!”

english_verse: The Pharisees said to them, “Have you also been fooled?
translation_verse: Yeɛ Farasiifoɛ nemɔ buale bɛ kyɛ, “Walakalaka ɛmɔ koso anaa?

english_verse: Not one of the chief priests or the Pharisees has faith in him.
translation_verse: Mbanyi nemɔ anu bie anaa Farasiifoɛ nemɔ anu bie wale ye wali hɔ ɔ?

english_verse: And these people who don't know the Law are under God's curse anyway.”
translation_verse: Na mmenia hemɔ bɔ bɛnze mmeraa ne ne, ɛnomalɛ yeɛ banoma bɛ ɔ!”

english_verse: Nicodemus was there at the time. He was a member of the council, and was the same one who had earlier come to see Jesus. He said,
translation_verse: Na Nikodemo bɔ mmerɛ bie ɔwale Yesu berɛ [kɔngɔen] ne, bɔ ɔte bɛ nu ko ne, osele bɛ kyɛ,

english_verse: “Our Law doesn't let us condemn people before we hear what they have to say. We cannot judge them before we know what they have done.”
translation_verse: “Yɛ mmeraa ne, aso obua sona foɛ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ yɛttiele ye noa dwirɛ ná yɛnnwuni bɔ wayɔ ɔ?”

english_verse: Then they said, “Nicodemus, you must be from Galilee! Read the Scriptures, and you will find that no prophet is to come from Galilee.” A Woman Caught in Sin
translation_verse: Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Gyamea wɔ koso efi Galilea hɔ ɔ? Neanea Ahyerɛlɛ ne anu, na ekonwu ye kyɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ biala ngodwɔso ngofi Galilea le.” [

english_verse: Everyone else went home,
translation_verse: Na ebiala hɔle ye awuro ngoko ngoko.]

english_verse: but Jesus walked out to the Mount of Olives.
translation_verse: Na Yesu hɔle Olive Bokaa ne aso.

english_verse: Then early the next morning he went to the temple. The people came to him, and he sat down and started teaching them.
translation_verse: Na aleɛ hyene ngyerɛmɔ tutututu ne, osa wale asɔneyɛɛ sua nu berɛ, na ɛlɔen ne amukoraa bɛwale ye berɛ, na ɔtenane ase yɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ hyirele bɛ.

english_verse: The Pharisees and the teachers of the Law of Moses brought in a woman who had been caught in bed with a man who wasn't her husband. They made her stand in the middle of the crowd.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ahyerɛlɛfoɛ ne Farasiifoɛ bɛfale braa bie bɔ baafite ye so wɔ adwamanbɔlɛ nu ɔ bɛwale, na bɛfale ye beegyinane b’afia berɛ.

english_verse: Then they said, “Teacher, this woman was caught sleeping with a man who isn't her husband.
translation_verse: Na besele Yesu kyɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, baafite braa he aso wɔ adwamanbɔlɛ nu pɛɛ.

english_verse: The Law of Moses teaches that a woman like this should be stoned to death! What do you say?”
translation_verse: Na Mose hyɛle yɛ wɔ mmeraa ne anu kyɛ, sona sɔaa, odi kyɛ yɛboro ye nyɔboɛ. Na wɔ koso, sɛɛ yeɛ ɛkã fa ye nwo ɔ?”

english_verse: They asked Jesus this question, because they wanted to test him and bring some charge against him. But Jesus simply bent over and started writing on the ground with his finger.
translation_verse: Bɛhane ɛhe bɛfa besuale ye ngaen, kyɛbɔ bekonya edwirɛ bie bɛkɔfa bɛkɔbɔ ye kwaadu ɔ. Na Yesu kunduni berɛ, na ɔfale ye sa mmɛseka hyerɛhyerɛle aseɛnwo berɛ.

english_verse: They kept on asking Jesus about the woman. Finally, he stood up and said, “If any of you have never sinned, then go ahead and throw the first stone at her!”
translation_verse: Na begu so bebisabisa ye dwirɛ nen, ɔtengyɛle ye nu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ nu ko bɔ bɔne nne ye nwo ne, maa oli moa ɔto nyɔboɛ bɔ ye.”

english_verse: Once again he bent over and began writing on the ground.
translation_verse: Na okunduni berɛ bieku fale ye sa mmɛseka hyerɛle aseɛnwo berɛ.

english_verse: Jesus stood up and asked her, “Where is everyone? Isn't there anyone left to accuse you?”
translation_verse: Na Yesu tengyɛle ye nu ne, wannwu ebiala te kyɛ braa ne angome, na osele ye kyɛ, “Mmobraa, wɔ kwaadubɔlɛfoɛ nemɔ, bɛwɔ nisua? Ebiala ammua wɔ foɛ anaa?”

english_verse: “No sir,” the woman answered. Then Jesus told her, “I am not going to accuse you either. You may go now, but don't sin anymore.” Jesus Is the Light for the World
translation_verse: Na obuale kyɛ, “Daabi, me Mene, ebiala ammua me foɛ.” Yeɛ Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Me koso memmua wɔ foɛ; kɔ, na nnɛkɔyɔ bɔne ko.” Yesu ole wiase kanea ne

english_verse: Once again Jesus spoke to the people. This time he said, “I am the light for the world! Follow me, and you won't be walking in the dark. You will have the light that gives life.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu sele bɛ bieku kyɛ, “Me ole wiase kanea ne; ebiala bɔ oli me si ne, ɔngɔnate awosii nu le, na okonya ngoa kanea ne.”

english_verse: The Pharisees objected, “You are the only one speaking for yourself, and what you say isn't true!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Farasiifoɛ nemɔ sele ye kyɛ, “Edi wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo adanzeɛ; w’adanzeɛ ne ɔtte nahorɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Even if I do speak for myself, what I say is true! I know where I came from and where I am going. But you don't know where I am from or where I am going.
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ medi me bɔbɔ me nwo adanzeɛ po a, m’adanzeɛ ne te nahorɛ; ofikyɛ mese nekaa bɔ mvi mmale ɔ, ɔne nekaa bɔ mékɔ ɔ. Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔnze nekaa bɔ mvi mmale ɔ anaa nekaa bɔ mékɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You judge in the same way that everyone else does, but I don't judge anyone.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔbu anwoɔnaen nu ndɛen; na me de, memmua ebiala ndɛen.

english_verse: If I did judge, I would judge fairly, because I would not be doing it alone. The Father who sent me is here with me.
