translation_verse: Sɛ ye po mebua ndɛen a, me ndɛenbualɛ te nahorɛ, ofikyɛ nna me ngome yeɛ mebua ndɛen ɔ, na mmom me ne Baba ne bɔ ɔsomane me ne.

english_verse: Your Law requires two witnesses to prove that something is true.
translation_verse: Bahyerɛ ye wɔ ɛmɔ mmeraa ne anu kyɛ: Mmenia nyɔ b’adanzeɛ te nahorɛ.

english_verse: I am one of my witnesses, and the Father who sent me is the other one.
translation_verse: Medi me bɔbɔ me nwo adanzeɛ, yeɛ Baba ne bɔ ɔsomane me ne koso odi me nwo adanzeɛ.”

english_verse: “Where is your Father?” they asked. “You don't know me or my Father!” Jesus answered. “If you knew me, you would know my Father.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ bebisale ye kyɛ, “Nisua yeɛ wɔ Baba wɔ ɔ?” Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “Ɛmɔnze me, yeɛ ɛmɔnze me Baba ne koso; na sɛ ɛmɔse me a, ahaa ɛmɔkonwu me Baba koso.”

english_verse: Jesus said this while he was still teaching in the place where the temple treasures were stored. But no one arrested him, because his time had not yet come. You Cannot Go Where I Am Going
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né ɔyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ wɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, wɔ nekaa bɔ fotoɛ alaka nemɔ begyigyi ne yeɛ ɔhane sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ ɔ; nakoso ebiala angye ye, ofikyɛ né ye mmerɛ ne onnya oddwuli. Yesu fi nyameɛso

english_verse: Jesus also told them, “I am going away, and you will look for me. But you cannot go where I am going, and you will die with your sins unforgiven.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu sele bɛ bieku kyɛ, “Me de, mékɔ, na ɛmɔkɔpena me, na ɛmɔkowu ɛmɔ bɔne nu; na nekaa bɔ mékɔ ne, ɛmɔngɔhora ngɔwa berɛ.”

english_verse: The people asked, “Does he intend to kill himself? Is that what he means by saying we cannot go where he is going?”
translation_verse: Yiti Yudafoɛ nemɔ hane kyɛ, “Ɔbaahu ye nwo anaa, bɔ yiti yeɛ ɔnwa, ‘Nekaa bɔ mékɔ ne, ɛmɔngɔhora ngɔwa berɛ’ ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You are from below, but I am from above. You belong to this world, but I don't.
translation_verse: Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔfi aseɛnwo wa, na me de, mvi anwuro. Ɛmɔfi wiase wa, na me de, mmvi wiase ye anu.

english_verse: This is why I said you will die with your sins unforgiven. If you don't have faith in me for who I am, you will die, and your sins will not be forgiven.”
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ati yeɛ nzele ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛmɔkowu ɛmɔ bɔne nu ne; na sɛ ɛmɔanne banni kyɛ me ole ye a, ɛmɔkowu ɛmɔ bɔne nu.”

english_verse: “Who are you?” they asked Jesus. Jesus answered, “I am exactly who I told you at the beginning.
translation_verse: Na bebisale ye kyɛ, “Nwa ole wɔ?” Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Bɔ mvi ahyɛaseɛ ne nga ngyirele ɛmɔ ne ala.

english_verse: There is a lot more I could say to condemn you. But the one who sent me is truthful, and I tell the people of this world only what I have heard from him.”
translation_verse: Na nne ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ pee mekã, ɔne ɛmɔ nwo ndɛen mebua; na bɔ ɔsomane me ne te nahorɛniɛ. Na bɔ nde mvili ye berɛ ne ala yeɛ mekã mekyire wiase ɔ.”

english_verse: No one understood that Jesus was talking to them about the Father.
translation_verse: Bande ye bo kyɛ Baba ne nwo dwirɛ yeɛ né ɔkã kyire bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Jesus went on to say, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, you will know who I am. You will also know that I don't do anything on my own. I say only what my Father taught me.
translation_verse: Yiti Yesu hane kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛmɔnya bɛma Sona Awa ne so a, yeɛ ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ me ole ye ɔ; na memva me bɔbɔ me tumi menyɔ nikye fee, na mmom kyɛbɔ Baba ne hyirehyirele me ne, sɔ ala yeɛ mekã ɔ.

english_verse: The one who sent me is with me. I always do what pleases him, and he will never leave me.”
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔsomane me ne, ɔboka me so; ɔyyakyili me ngome nu, ofikyɛ meyɔ bɔ ɔsɔ ye nye mmerɛ biala.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, many of the people put their faith in him. The Truth Will Set You Free
translation_verse: Na ogu so bɔ ɔkã sɔ nen, mmenia pee belele ye belili. Nahorɛ ne kɔyɛ ɛmɔ nnehyeɛ

english_verse: Jesus told the people who had faith in him, “If you keep on obeying what I have said, you truly are my disciples.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu sele Yudafoɛ bɔ belele ye belili ne kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛmɔtira me dwirɛ ne anu a, ye de ɛmɔte m’asuafoɛ amba,

english_verse: You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
translation_verse: na ɛmɔkonwu nahorɛ ne, na nahorɛ ne kɔyɛ ɛmɔ nnehyeɛ.”

english_verse: They answered, “We are Abraham's children! We have never been anyone's slaves. How can you say we will be set free?”
translation_verse: Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Abraham bosofoɛ ole yɛ; na yɛyyɛle ebiala ngoaa le. Ɔyɛle sɛɛ bɔ ɛkã kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔkɔyɛ nnehyeɛ ɔ?’ ”

english_verse: Jesus replied: I tell you for certain that anyone who sins is a slave of sin!
translation_verse: Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne ne, ɔte bɔne akoaa.

english_verse: And slaves don't stay in the family forever, though the Son will always remain in the family.
translation_verse: Akoaa nga awuro afebɔɔ; na baa de, ɔte berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: If the Son gives you freedom, you are free!
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ Baa ne ɔyɛ ɛmɔ nnehyeɛ a, ɛmɔkɔyɛ nnehyeɛ amba.

english_verse: I know that you are from Abraham's family. Yet you want to kill me, because my message isn't really in your hearts.
translation_verse: Mese kyɛ ɛmɔte Abraham bosofoɛ, nakoso ɛmɔpena me beku me, ofikyɛ me dwirɛ ne onnya nekaa ndena wɔ ɛmɔ nu.

english_verse: I am telling you what my Father has shown me, just as you are doing what your father has taught you. Your Father Is the Devil
translation_verse: Bɔ manwu ye wɔ me Baba berɛ ne, ye yeɛ mekã ɔ, na ɛmɔ de, bɔ ɛmɔate bafi ɛmɔ baba berɛ yeɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: The people said to Jesus, “Abraham is our father!” Jesus replied, “If you were Abraham's children, you would do what Abraham did.
translation_verse: Bebuale ye kyɛ, “Yɛ nana ole Abraham.” Na Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛmɔte Abraham nnomaa a, ahaa ɛmɔkɔyɔ bɔ Abraham yɔle ɔ;

english_verse: Instead, you want to kill me for telling you the truth that God gave me. Abraham never did anything like that.
translation_verse: na afei de, ɛmɔpena me beku me, me bɔ mahã nahorɛ bɔ nde mvili Nyameɛ berɛ mahyire ɛmɔ ne. Abraham de, wanyɔ sɔ!

english_verse: But you are doing exactly what your father does.” “Don't accuse us of having someone else as our father!” they said. “We just have one father, and he is God.”
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ baba yɔleɛ yeɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ.” Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Yɛ de yɛtte adwaman mmaa; yɛ Baba te komapɛ twe, ye ole Nyameɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: If God were your Father, you would love me, because I came from God and now I am here. He sent me. I did not come on my own.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛmɔ Baba ole Nyameɛ a, ahaa ɛmɔkohuro me dwirɛ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ nu yeɛ mvi mmale ɔ. Mamva me bɔbɔ me tumi so yeɛ mmale ɔ, na ye yeɛ ɔsomane me ɔ.

english_verse: Why can't you understand what I am talking about? Can't you stand to hear what I am saying?
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔnde me dwirɛ bo ɔ? Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔngora bendie me dwirɛ.

english_verse: Your father is the devil, and you do exactly what he wants. He has always been a murderer and a liar. There is nothing truthful about him. He speaks on his own, and everything he says is a lie. Not only is he a liar himself, but he is also the father of all lies.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔ baba bɔ ɛmɔfi ye nu ole abɔnzam, na ɛmɔ baba n’apɛdeɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkuro kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ. Ɔte wudiniɛ fi ahyɛaseɛ ne; na ollili nahorɛ le, ɔnate kyɛ nahorɛ biala nne ye nu. Sɛ ɔkã ngondombo dwirɛ a, kyɛbɔ ye sue te ne ala yeɛ ɔkã ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔte ngondomboniɛ ne ngondombo baba.

english_verse: Everything I have told you is true, and you still refuse to have faith in me.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ mekã nahorɛ ne ati, ɛmɔnne me benni.

english_verse: Can any of you accuse me of sin? If you cannot, why won't you have faith in me? After all, I am telling you the truth.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ obua me foɛ wɔ bɔne bie nwo ɔ? Na sɛ mekã nahorɛ ne a, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔnne me benni ɔ?

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to God will listen to his message. But you refuse to listen, because you don't belong to God. Jesus and Abraham
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ofi Nyameɛ nu ne, otie Nyameɛ dwirɛ. Na nikyee ti bɔ ɔmaa ɛmɔndie ne ole kyɛ, nna Nyameɛ nu yeɛ ɛmɔfi ɔ.” Yesu ne Abraham

english_verse: The people told Jesus, “We were right to say that you are a Samaritan and that you have a demon in you!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yudafoɛ nemɔ buale ye kyɛ, “Aso nna nahorɛ yeɛ yahã ne anaa, kyɛ ɛte Samarianiɛ na ele sunzummɔne?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I don't have a demon in me. I honor my Father, and you refuse to honor me.
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “Me de, nnne sunzummɔne; na mmom medi me Baba ni, na ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔnni me ni.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you obey my words, you will never die.”
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, sɛ ebie di me dwirɛ so a, ongowu le.”

english_verse: Then the people said, “Now we are sure that you have a demon. Abraham is dead, and so are the prophets. How can you say that no one who obeys your words will ever die?
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yudafoɛ nemɔ sele ye kyɛ, “Afei yeɛ yanwu kyɛ ele sunzummɔne ɔ. Abraham wuli, yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ koso bewuwuli ɔ, nakoso wɔ de ɛnwa, ‘Sɛ ebie di me dwirɛ so a, ongowu le.’

english_verse: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?”
translation_verse: Edi mu tra yɛ nana Abraham bɔ owuli ne anaa? Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ koso bewuwuli. Ɛdwene kyɛ ɛte nzu koraa?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If I honored myself, it would mean nothing. My Father is the one who honors me. You claim that he is your God,
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “Sɛ mehyɛ me nwo animnyam a, m’animnyam ne ɔtte huu. Me Baba bɔ ɛmɔnwa ɔte ɛmɔ Nyameɛ nen, ye yeɛ ɔhyɛ me animnyam ɔ.

english_verse: even though you don't really know him. If I said I didn't know him, I would be a liar, just like all of you. But I know him, and I do what he says.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔnze ye, na me de, mese ye. Na sɛ mekã kyɛ menze ye a, ngɔyɛ ngondomboniɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ ala. Nakoso mese ye, na medi ye dwirɛ so.

english_verse: Your father Abraham was really glad to see me.”
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle ɛmɔ nana Abraham fɛ kyɛ né okonwu me kyẽa ne ɔ; onwuni ye, na ye nye gyele.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “I tell you for certain that even before Abraham was, I was, and I am.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu sele bɛ kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, anzana Abraham baawa ne, né nwɔ berɛ.”

english_verse: The people picked up stones to kill Jesus, but he hid and left the temple.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛsesale nyɔboɛ kyɛ bɛto bɛbɔ ye, na Yesu fale ye nwo feale, na ɔfale mmenia ne anu fili asɔneyɛɛ sua nu berɛ hɔle.

english_verse: As Jesus walked along, he saw a man who had been blind since birth.
translation_verse: Na Yesu ɔ́pɛ nu kɔ nen, onwuni ebie bɔ ye nye asi fi mmerɛ bɔ bɛwole ye ɔ.

english_verse: Jesus' disciples asked, “Teacher, why was this man born blind? Was it because he or his parents sinned?”
translation_verse: Na ye asuafoɛ nemɔ bisale ye kyɛ, “Rabi, nwa yeɛ ɔyɔle bɔne ɔ, biaa he anaa ye awofoɛ, bɔ ɔmaa ɔnate so bɛwole ye anyesiniwaaniɛ ye?”

english_verse: “No, it wasn't!” Jesus answered. “But because of his blindness, you will see God work a miracle for him.
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “Nna biaa he, anaa ye awofoɛ yeɛ bɛyɔle bɔne ɔ; na mmom kyɛ Nyameɛ nnwumaa kɔla ali wɔ ye nu ti ɔ.

english_verse: As long as it is day, we must do what the one who sent me wants me to do. When night comes, no one can work.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ alehyeleɛ wɔ berɛ ye de, ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛyɔ bɔ ɔsomane me ne nnwumaa; na alesaleɛ ɔ́ba bɔ ebiala ngɔhora ngɔyɔ adwuma ɔ.

english_verse: While I am in the world, I am the light for the world.”
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ nwɔ wiase ye de, me ole wiase kanea ne.”

english_verse: After Jesus said this, he spit on the ground. He made some mud and smeared it on the man's eyes.
translation_verse: Na ɔhane sɔ nen, ɔfele nwɔserɛ guale aseɛnwo, na ɔfale nwɔserɛ ne frale nnɛterɛ, na ɔfale nnɛterɛ ne wasale biaa ne nye so,

english_verse: Then he said, “Go wash off the mud in Siloam Pool.” The man went and washed in Siloam, which means “One Who Is Sent.” When he had washed off the mud, he could see.
translation_verse: na osele ye kyɛ, “Kɔ, ná konwunzi so wɔ ɛkwaa Siloam nu,” . Yiti osili nu hɔle oonwunzini so, na osa wale nen, né onwu nikye.

english_verse: The man's neighbors and the people who had seen him begging wondered if he really could be the same man.
translation_verse: Na mandamu berɛ ama ne bɛ bɔ banwu ye le kyɛ mmerɛ bie né ɔsrɛsrɛ nikyee ne, bebisale kyɛ, “Nna biaa he yeɛ né ɔte berɛ ɔsrɛsrɛ nikyee ye?”

english_verse: Some of them said he was the same beggar, while others said he only looked like him. But he told them, “I am that man.”
translation_verse: Ebiemɔ hane kyɛ, “Ye ɔ.” Yeɛ ebiemɔ koso hane kyɛ, “Daabi, osoma ye mbaen.” Na ye bɔbɔ osele kyɛ, “Me bɔbɔ me ala ɔ.”

english_verse: “Then how can you see?” they asked.
translation_verse: Na bebisale ye kyɛ, “Ɔyɛle sɛɛ yeɛ wɔ nye ne tele ɔ?”

english_verse: He answered, “Someone named Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. He told me to go and wash it off in Siloam Pool. When I did, I could see.”
translation_verse: Na obuale kyɛ, “Biaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Yesu ne, ye yeɛ ɔdɔnene nnɛterɛ fa wasale me nye so ɔ, na ɔhã hyirele me kyɛ, ‘Kɔ ɛkwaa Siloam nu konwunzi so.’ Na ngɔnwunzini so, yiti yeɛ ɔmaa menwu nikyee ye.”

english_verse: “Where is he now?” they asked. “I don't know,” he answered. The Pharisees Try To Find Out What Happened
translation_verse: Yeɛ bebisale ye kyɛ, “Ɔwɔ nisua?” Na obuale kyɛ, “Menze.” Farasiifoɛ feefee nu

english_verse: The day when Jesus made the mud and healed the man was a Sabbath. So the people took the man to the Pharisees.
translation_verse: Na kyẽa bɔ Yesu dɔnene nnɛterɛ ná ɔfa tele ye nye ne, né ɔte afofikyẽa.

english_verse: They asked him how he was able to see, and he answered, “Jesus made some mud and smeared it on my eyes. Then after I washed it off, I could see.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Farasiifoɛ nemɔ koso besa bisale ye kyɛbɔ osi yɛle bɔ afei de onwu nikye ɔ. Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɔfale nnɛterɛ wasale me nye so, yeɛ ngɔnwunzini so ɔ, yiti yeɛ menwu nikyee ye.”

english_verse: Some of the Pharisees said, “This man Jesus doesn't come from God. If he did, he would not break the law of the Sabbath.” Others asked, “How could someone who is a sinner work such a miracle?” Since the Pharisees could not agree among themselves,
translation_verse: Yeɛ Farasiifoɛ ne anu biemɔ hane kyɛ, “Sɔ biaa ne, nna Nyameɛ berɛ yeɛ ofi ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ onni afofikyẽa so.” Na ebiemɔ koso bɛhane kyɛ, “Ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né sona bɔ ɔte bɔnefoɛ ɔ wahora wayɔ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ ɔte sɔaa ɔ?” Na bɛ nu hyehyɛle.

english_verse: they asked the man, “What do you say about this one who healed your eyes?” “He is a prophet!” the man told them.
translation_verse: Yiti besa bebisale anyesiniwaaniɛ ne kyɛ, “Wɔ koso, nzikyɛ yeɛ ɛkã fa ye nwo ɔ, ye bɔ ɔtele wɔ nye ne?” Na osele kyɛ, “Ɔte ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ.”

english_verse: But the Jewish leaders would not believe that the man had once been blind. They sent for his parents
translation_verse: Nakoso Yudafoɛ nemɔ de, banne ye nwo dwirɛ ne banni, kyɛ né ye nye asi, na afei de onwu nikye ɔ, kɔpem kyɛ bɛfrɛle biaa bɔ onwu nikyee n’awofoɛ,

english_verse: and asked them, “Is this the son that you said was born blind? How can he now see?”
translation_verse: na bebisale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ awa bɔ ɛmɔnwa bɛwole ye anyesiniwaaniɛ ne, ye ɛhe anaa? Ɔyɛle sɛɛ bɔ afei de onwu nikyee ye?”

english_verse: The man's parents answered, “We are certain that he is our son, and we know that he was born blind.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ye awofoɛ buale bɛ kyɛ, “Yɛ de, yɛse kyɛ yɛ wa ɛne, na yɛwole ye ɔ né ye nye asi;

english_verse: But we don't know how he got his sight or who gave it to him. Ask him! He is old enough to speak for himself.”
translation_verse: nakoso kyɛbɔ osi yɛle bɔ afei onwu nikyee ye de, yɛnze; yeɛ yɛnze bɔ ɔtele ye nye ne ɔ. Ɛ́mɔbisa ye, wanyi, na ye bɔbɔ okodwudwo kɔma ye nwo!”

english_verse: The leaders called the man back and said, “Swear by God to tell the truth! We know that Jesus is a sinner.”
translation_verse: Yiti besa bɛfrɛle biaa bɔ mmerɛ bie né ɔte anyesiniwaaniɛ ne, na besele ye kyɛ, “Fa animnyam ma Nyameɛ! Yɛ de, yɛse kyɛ biaa he ɔte bɔnefoɛ.”

english_verse: The man replied, “I don't know if he is a sinner or not. All I know is that I used to be blind, but now I can see!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ obuale kyɛ, “Sɛ ɔte bɔnefoɛ a, me de menze; nikyee komapɛ yeɛ mese ɔ: ahaa né nde anyesiniwaaniɛ, nakoso kekesaala ye de menwu nikye.”

english_verse: “What did he do to you?” they asked. “How did he heal your eyes?”
translation_verse: Na bebisale ye kyɛ, “Ɔyɛle wɔ sɛ koraa? Ɔtele wɔ nye ne sɛ?”

english_verse: The man answered, “I have already told you once, and you refused to listen. Why do you want me to tell you again? Do you also want to become his disciples?”
translation_verse: Na obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Mahã mahyire ɛmɔ dada, nakoso ɛmɔandie. Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔpena kyɛ betie ye bieku ɔ? Ɛmɔ koso, ɛmɔpena kyɛ ɛmɔyɛ ye asuafoɛ anaa?”

english_verse: The leaders insulted the man and said, “You are his follower! We are followers of Moses.
translation_verse: Yeɛ bɛpepɛle ye nzoaa besele kyɛ, “Wɔ yeɛ ɛte ye suaniɛ ɔ; na yɛ de, yɛte Mose asuafoɛ.

english_verse: We are sure God spoke to Moses, but we don't even know where Jesus comes from.”
translation_verse: Yɛse kyɛ Nyameɛ dwudwo hyirele Mose, nakoso sɔ biaa he de, yɛnze nekaa bɔ ofi ɔ!”

english_verse: “How strange!” the man replied. “He healed my eyes, and yet you don't know where he comes from.
translation_verse: Na biaa ne buale bɛ kyɛ, “Edwirɛ nwanwa ɛhe! Ɛmɔnze nekaa bɔ ofi ɔ, nakoso me de, ɔtele me nye!

english_verse: We know that God listens only to people who love and obey him. God doesn't listen to sinners.
translation_verse: Yɛse kyɛ Nyameɛ ndie bɔnefoɛ mɔ, nakoso sɛ ebie sɔne Nyameɛ ná ɔyɛ ye apɛdeɛ a, ye yeɛ Nyameɛ tie ye ɔ.

english_verse: And this is the first time in history anyone has ever given sight to someone born blind.
translation_verse: Ofi wiase ahyɛaseɛ, yɛttele ye le kyɛ ebie ate sona bɔ bɛwole ye anyesiniwaaniɛ ɔ ye nye.

english_verse: Jesus could not do anything unless he came from God.”
translation_verse: Sɛ nna Nyameɛ berɛ yeɛ biaa he ofi a, ahaa ɔngɔhora ngɔyɔ huu.”

english_verse: The leaders told the man, “You have been a sinner since the day you were born! Do you think you can teach us anything?” Then they said, “You can never come back into any of our synagogues!”
translation_verse: Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Bɛwole wɔ bɛtole bɔne nu buroburoburo, na afei wɔ yeɛ ekyirekyire yɛ ɔ?” Na bɛfoane ye befili nyianu sua ne anu. Anyesiniwaaniɛ ne de Yesu di

english_verse: When Jesus heard what had happened, he went and found the man. Then Jesus asked, “Do you have faith in the Son of Man?”
translation_verse: Na Yesu tele kyɛ bafoa ye bafi nyianu sua ne anu, na onwuni ye nen, obisale ye kyɛ, “Ede Sona Awa ne di anaa?”

english_verse: He replied, “Sir, if you will tell me who he is, I will put my faith in him.”
translation_verse: Na obuale kyɛ, “Me Mene, nwa ole ye, ná nne ye nni?”

english_verse: “You have already seen him,” Jesus answered, “and right now he is talking with you.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Anwu ye, na bɔ ɔne wɔ bedwudwo ne, ye ɛne.”

english_verse: The man said, “Lord, I put my faith in you!” Then he worshiped Jesus.
translation_verse: Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Awurade, mede medi!” Na ɔkotole sɔnene ye. Sunzum nu anyesiniwaafoɛ

english_verse: Jesus told him, “I came to judge the people of this world. I am here to give sight to the blind and to make blind everyone who can see.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu hane kyɛ, “Ndɛenbualɛ ti yeɛ mmale wiase ɔ, amaa ɔnate so bɛ bɔ bennwu nikyee ne banwu nikye; ná bɛ bɔ benwu nikyee ne koso bakakyi anyesiniwaafoɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “If you were blind, you would not be guilty. But now that you claim to see, you will keep on being guilty.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛmɔte anyesiniwaafoɛ a, ahaa ɛmɔnni bɔne nwo fɔ; nakoso ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔnwa ‘Yɛnwu nikye’ ne ati, ɛmɔ bɔne mata ɛmɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain only thieves and robbers climb over the fence instead of going in through the gate to the sheep pen.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ebiala bɔ ɔmva anoa ne anu ngɔ mmoaennduin ne anu, ná mmom ɔfo fa nekaa bie ɔkɔ nu nen, ɔte awueniɛ ne awerɔm awueniɛ;

english_verse: But the gatekeeper opens the gate for the shepherd, and he goes in through it. The sheep know their shepherd's voice. He calls each of them by name and leads them out.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ anoa wɛmvoɛ ne obukye ye ɔ; mmoaen nemɔ bɛte ye komvi, na ɔfa ye bɔbɔ ye mmoaen bɛ dumaa yeɛ ɔfa frɛ bɛ maa befite ɔ.

english_verse: When he has led out all of his sheep, he walks in front of them, and they follow, because they know his voice.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔma ye bɔbɔ ye mmoaen nemɔ befite a, odi bɛ nyunu, na mmoaen nemɔ di ye si, ofikyɛ bɛse ye komvi ngome.

english_verse: The sheep will not follow strangers. They don't recognize a stranger's voice, and they run away.
translation_verse: Na ɛwɔfoɛ de, bengoli ye si, na mmom bɛkɔnwati bekofi ye nwo; ɔnate kyɛ bɛnze ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ komvi.

english_verse: Jesus told the people this story. But they did not understand what he was talking about. Jesus Is the Good Shepherd
translation_verse: Yesu buli bɛ anyandera he, nakoso bande edwirɛ bɔ ɔhã hyirele bɛ ne abo.” Yesu te mmoaennduin anoa ne.

english_verse: Jesus said: I tell you for certain that I am the gate for the sheep.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu sele bɛ bieku kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, me ole mmoaen nemɔ b’anoa ne.

english_verse: Everyone who came before me was a thief or a robber, and the sheep did not listen to any of them.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ belili me nyunu moa bɛwale ne amukoraa bɛte awuefoɛ ne awerɔm awuefoɛ, na mmoaen nemɔ bandie bɛ.

english_verse: I am the gate. All who come in through me will be saved. Through me they will come and go and find pasture.
translation_verse: Me ole anoa ne; na sɛ ebie fa me so kɔ nu a, bekole ye ngoa; na okoli nu akɔneaba, na okonya nekaa bɔ okodidi ɔ.

english_verse: A thief comes only to rob, kill, and destroy. I came so everyone would have life, and have it fully.
translation_verse: Awueniɛ ne ɔmma, sana ɔbaawua, ná oku, ná ɔsɛkye; nakoso me de, mmale kyɛ bekonya ngoa, ná banya ye mmorosoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I am the good shepherd, and the good shepherd gives up his life for his sheep.
translation_verse: “Me ole mmoaenneafoɛ paa ne. Mmoaenneafoɛ paa ne, ɔfa ye ngoa to berɛ ma mmoaen ne.

english_verse: Hired workers are not like the shepherd. They don't own the sheep, and when they see a wolf coming, they run off and leave the sheep. Then the wolf attacks and scatters the flock.
translation_verse: Nakoso paaniɛ bɔ nna ye ole mmoaenneafoɛ ne, bɔ mmoaen ne bɛtte ye deɛ nen, sɛ onwu kyɛ pataku ba a, ɔyakyi mmoaen ne berɛ nwati; na pataku ne bakye bɛ, na ɔbɔ bɛ sande.

english_verse: Hired workers run away because they don't care about the sheep.
translation_verse: Paaniɛ ne nwati, ofikyɛ ɔte paaniɛ, na mmoaen ne nwo nhia ye.

english_verse: I am the good shepherd. I know my sheep, and they know me.
translation_verse: Me ole mmoaenneafoɛ paa ne; mese me deɛ, na me deɛ koso se me,

english_verse: Just as the Father knows me, I know the Father, and I give up my life for my sheep.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ Baba ne se me, ná me koso mese Baba ne nen; na mefa me ngoa meto berɛ mema mmoaen ne.

english_verse: I have other sheep that are not in this sheep pen. I must also bring them together, when they hear my voice. Then there will be one flock of sheep and one shepherd.
translation_verse: Na nne mmoaen foforɛ biemɔ bɔ bɛ de nna mmoaen kure he anu yeɛ befi ɔ; na ɔsɛ kyɛ mefa bɛ koso meba ɔ, na bɛkɔte me komvi. Yiti mmoaen kure ne kɔyɛ komapɛ ɔne mmoaenneafoɛ ko.

english_verse: The Father loves me, because I give up my life, so I may receive it back again.
translation_verse: “Na ye sɔ ati, Baba ne kuro me dwirɛ, ofikyɛ mefa me ngoa meto berɛ, amaa ɔnate so masa mafa ye bieku.

english_verse: No one takes my life from me. I give it up willingly! I have the power to give it up and the power to receive it back again, just as my Father commanded me to do.
translation_verse: Ebie nne mvi me sa nu, na mmom me bɔbɔ yeɛ mefa meto berɛ ɔ. Ye nwo tumi wura me sa kyɛ mefa meto berɛ ɔ, yeɛ ye nwo tumi wura me sa kyɛ mesa mefa ye bieku ɔ; na ahyɛdeɛ he yeɛ nya mvili me Baba berɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The people took sides because of what Jesus had told them.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate edwirɛ hemɔ ati, Yudafoɛ nemɔ anu hyehyɛle bieku.

english_verse: Many of them said, “He has a demon in him! He is crazy! Why listen to him?”
translation_verse: Bɛ nu pee hane kyɛ, “Ole sunzummɔne, na wabɔ laen. Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔtie ye ɔ?”

english_verse: But others said, “How could anyone with a demon in him say these things? No one like this could give sight to a blind person!” Jesus Is Rejected
translation_verse: Na ebiemɔ koso hane kyɛ, “Sona bɔ ole sunzummɔne ne, nna sɔ yeɛ ye noa dwirɛ te ɔ. Sunzummɔne kɔhora kɔte anyesiniwaafoɛ nye anaa?” Yudafoɛ po Yesu

english_verse: That winter, Jesus was in Jerusalem for the Temple Festival.
translation_verse: Na Asɔneyɛɛ sua nwo petenɛ aluolue ne dwuli wɔ Yerusalem, na né ɔte prakasua mmerɛ.

english_verse: One day he was walking in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch,
translation_verse: Né Yesu natenate asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, wɔ Solomon abrannaa so.

english_verse: and the people gathered all around him. They said, “How long are you going to keep us guessing? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yudafoɛ nemɔ bɛɛpɛle ye nwo beyiale, na bebisale ye kyɛ, “Ɛkɔmaa yɛkɔnwondɛ yɛkoodwu kyinzu? Sɛ wɔ ole Kristo ne a, kã ye pefee kyire yɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus answered: I have told you, and you refused to believe me. The things I do by my Father's authority show who I am.
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Mahã mahyire ɛmɔ, na ɛmɔnne benni. Nnwumaa bɔ meyɔ wɔ me Baba dumaa nu ne, bedi me nwo adanzeɛ.

english_verse: But since you are not my sheep, you don't believe me.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔnne benni, ofikyɛ nna me mmoaen ne anu yeɛ ɛmɔfi ɔ.

english_verse: My sheep know my voice, and I know them. They follow me,
translation_verse: Me mmoaen nemɔ bɛte me komvi, mese bɛ, na bedi me si.

english_verse: and I give them eternal life, so that they will never be lost. No one can snatch them out of my hand.
translation_verse: Mema bɛ daa ngoa, na bengomini le; na ebiala ngofoti bɛ ngofi me sa nu.

english_verse: My Father gave them to me, and he is greater than all others. No one can snatch them from his hands,
translation_verse: Me Baba bɔ ɔfale bɛ mane me ne, ɔte piri tra ebiala; na ebiala ngɔhora ngofoti bɛ ngofi me Baba sa nu.

english_verse: and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Me ne Baba ne yɛte ko.”

english_verse: Once again the people picked up stones in order to kill Jesus.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yudafoɛ nemɔ sesale nyɔboɛ bieku kyɛ bɛkwaafa bɛboro ye.

english_verse: But he said, “I have shown you many good things my Father sent me to do. Which one are you going to stone me for?”
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “Nnwumaa paa pee bɔ ofi me Baba ne berɛ yeɛ mayɔ mahyire ɛmɔ ɔ; na bɛ nu beni ati yeɛ ɛmɔbaaboro me nyɔboɛ ye?”

english_verse: They answered, “We are not stoning you because of any good thing you did. We are stoning you because you did a terrible thing. You are just a man, and here you are claiming to be God!”
translation_verse: Na Yudafoɛ nemɔ buale kyɛ, “Nna adwuma paa bie ti yeɛ yɛbaaboro wɔ nyɔboɛ ɔ; na mmom musue dwirɛ ti ɔ; ofikyɛ ɛte kuro sona, nakoso ɛyɛ wɔ nwo kyɛ Nyameɛ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: In your Scriptures doesn't God say, “You are gods”?
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale bɛ kyɛ, “Aso nna ɛmɔ mmeraa ne anu yeɛ bahyerɛ ye kyɛ, ‘Ngane kyɛ, ɛmɔte nyameɛ mɔ?’

english_verse: You can't argue with the Scriptures, and God spoke to those people and called them gods.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔfrɛle bɛ bɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne wale bɛ berɛ ne nyameɛ mɔ, bɔ ebie ngora nzɛkye Ahyerɛlɛ ne a,

english_verse: So why do you accuse me of a terrible sin for saying that I am the Son of God? After all, it is the Father who prepared me for this work. He is also the one who sent me into the world.
translation_verse: né nzu ati yeɛ bɔ Baba ne ayɛ ye krongron, ná wasoma ye maa wawa wiase ne, ɛmɔkã ye nwo dwirɛ kyɛ, ‘Ahã musue dwirɛ,’ ofikyɛ ngane kyɛ, ‘Nyameɛ Awa ne ole me?’

english_verse: If I don't do as my Father does, you should not believe me.
translation_verse: Na sɛ nna me Baba nnwumaa yeɛ meyɔ hɔ a, ye de nnɛma ɛmɔde me bedi.

english_verse: But if I do what my Father does, you should believe because of that, even if you don't have faith in me. Then you will know for certain that the Father is one with me, and I am one with the Father.
translation_verse: Na sɛ meyɔ, ná ɛmɔnne me benni po a, nnwumaa ne de odi kyɛ ɛmɔde bedi, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanwu ye, ná ɛmɔale bali kyɛ Baba ne ɔte me nu, na me koso nde Baba ne nu.”

english_verse: Again they wanted to arrest Jesus. But he escaped
translation_verse: Na bɛbɔle mmɔden bieku kyɛ bɛkɔhye ye ɔ, nakoso onyane ye nwo tetele fili bɛ sa nu hɔle.

english_verse: and crossed the Jordan to the place where John had earlier been baptizing. While Jesus was there,
translation_verse: Na Yesu pɛle asue Yɔɔdan hɔle ye si dɔ bieku, nekaa bɔ Yohane lili moa bɔle asu ne, na ɔtenane berɛ.

english_verse: many people came to him. They were saying, “John didn't work any miracles, but everything he said about Jesus is true.”
translation_verse: Na mmenia pee bɛwale ye berɛ, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Yohane anyɔ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ biala de, nakoso edwirɛ biala bɔ Yohane hã fale biaa he nwo ne, ɔte nahorɛ.”

english_verse: A lot of those people also put their faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Na mmenia pee belele ye belili wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: The sisters sent a message to the Lord and told him that his good friend Lazarus was sick.
translation_verse: Yiti oliɛma mmrasua nemɔ bɛsomane maa bɛwale Yesu berɛ beesele ye kyɛ, “Yieee, Awurade, bɔ ekuro ye dwirɛ ne, anwonyerɛ abɔ.”

english_verse: When Jesus heard this, he said, “His sickness won't end in death. It will bring glory to God and his Son.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu tele ɛhe nen, ɔhane kyɛ, “Sɔ anwonyerɛ he, nna ewue anwonyerɛ ɔ; na mmom Nyameɛ animnyam ti ɔ, amaa ɔnate ɛhe aso bahyɛ Nyameɛ Awa ne animnyam.”

english_verse: But he stayed where he was for two more days.
translation_verse: Na ɔtele kyɛ ye nwo yɛ ye yea nen, olili elenyɔ wɔ nekaa bɔ né ɔwɔ ne.

english_verse: Then he said to his disciples, “Now we will go back to Judea.”
translation_verse: Na nziɛ ye, osele ye asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔma yɛsa yɛhɔ Yudea!”

english_verse: “Teacher,” they said, “the people there want to stone you to death! Why do you want to go back?”
translation_verse: Na asuafoɛ nemɔ sele ye kyɛ, “Rabi, anomasi wa ala yeɛ Yudafoɛ bɛyɛle kyɛ bɛkɔboro wɔ nyɔboɛ ɔ, na esa kɔ dɔ bieku anaa?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Aren't there twelve hours in each day? If you walk during the day, you will have light from the sun, and you won't stumble.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu buale kyɛ, “Aso nna dɔnhwere buru ne nyɔ yeɛ ɔte ɛlɛho ɔ? Sɛ ebie nate eyia a, onzoti, ofikyɛ onwu ewiase kanea ne.

english_verse: But if you walk during the night, you will stumble, because you don't have any light.”
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ebie nate kɔngɔen a, osoti, ofikyɛ kanea biala nne ye nu.”

english_verse: Then he told them, “Our friend Lazarus is asleep, and I am going there to wake him up.”
translation_verse: Yesu hane sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ nen, ye si ye osele bɛ kyɛ, “Yɛ damvo Lasarɔso walafe, nakoso mekwaatingye ye.”

english_verse: They replied, “Lord, if he is asleep, he will get better.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ ye asuafoɛ nemɔ sele kyɛ, “Awurade, sɛ walafe de a, nzaade ɔkɔte apɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus really meant that Lazarus was dead, but they thought he was talking only about sleep.
translation_verse: Na Yesu de, Lasarɔso wue nwo dwirɛ yeɛ ɔhane ɔ; nakoso bɛ de, besusuli kyɛ nnafelɛ nwo dwirɛ yeɛ ɔhane ɔ.

english_verse: I am glad I wasn't there, because now you will have a chance to put your faith in me. Let's go to him.”
translation_verse: na ɛmɔ ti ɔyɛ me fɛ kyɛ né nne dɔ ɔ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔale bali. Nakoso ɛmɔma yɛhɔ ye dɔ!”

english_verse: Thomas, whose nickname was “Twin,” said to the other disciples, “Come on. Let's go, so we can die with him.” Jesus Brings Lazarus to Life
translation_verse: Yeɛ Tɔmase bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Ata ne, osele ye mmango asuafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔma yɛ koso yɛhɔ bie, ná yɛne ye yɛɛwu!” Yesu ole ewutingyelɛ ne ngoa ne

english_verse: When Jesus got to Bethany, he found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days.
translation_verse: Na Yesu dwuli berɛ nen, onwuni kyɛ Lasarɔso ali asieleɛ ne anu ɛlɛnna dada.

english_verse: Bethany was less than three kilometers from Jerusalem,
translation_verse: Né Betania pingye Yerusalem, ɔkɔyɛ kwanzii nyɔ;

english_verse: and many people had come from the city to comfort Martha and Mary because their brother had died.
translation_verse: na né Yudafoɛ pee bawa berɛ kyɛ bɛbaayɛ Maata ne Maria yaakɔ, ɔnate b’eliɛma ne ati.

english_verse: When Martha heard that Jesus had arrived, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed in the house.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ Maata tele kyɛ Yesu ɔ́ba nen, ooyiale ye; na Maria de, né ɔte awuro berɛ.

english_verse: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Maata sele Yesu kyɛ, “Awurade, sɛ né ɛwɔ wa a, ahaa nniɛma bienzua ne anwu.

english_verse: Jesus told her, “Your brother will live again!”
translation_verse: Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Eliɛma bienzua ne, okotingye bieku.”

english_verse: Martha answered, “I know he will be raised to life on the last day, when all the dead are raised.”
translation_verse: Na Maata sele ye kyɛ, “Mese kyɛ ewutingyelɛ ne anu, kyẽa bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ne, okosa kotingye.”

english_verse: Jesus then said, “I am the one who raises the dead to life! Everyone who has faith in me will live, even if they die.
translation_verse: Na Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Me ole ewutingyelɛ ne ɔne ngoa ne; ebiala bɔ ode me di ne, sɛ owu po a, okonya ngoa.

english_verse: “Yes, Lord!” she replied. “I believe you are the Christ, the Son of God. You are the one we hoped would come into the world.”
translation_verse: Na obuale ye kyɛ, “Yoo, Awurade, mede medi kyɛ wɔ ole Kristo ne, Nyameɛ Awa ne bɔ ɔ́ba wiase ne.”

english_verse: After Martha said this, she went and privately said to her sister Mary, “The Teacher is here, and he wants to see you.”
translation_verse: Na ɔhane ɛhe nen, osa hɔle ɔɔfrɛle oliɛma Maria hã hyirele ye kudɛɛ kyɛ, “Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ ne, wawa, na ɔfrɛ wɔ.”

english_verse: As soon as Mary heard this, she got up and went out to Jesus.
