english_verse: It was before Passover, and Jesus knew that the time had come for him to leave this world and to return to the Father. He had always loved his followers in this world, and he loved them to the very end.
translation_verse: Na Abɔtra aluolue ne ɔbaadwu ne, né Yesu se kyɛ ye dɔnhwere ne adwu kyɛ ofi wiase wa ɔkɔ Baba ne berɛ ɔ, na kyɛbɔ ohurole ye bɔbɔ ye deɛ bɔ bɛwɔ wiase dwirɛ nen, ohurole bɛ dwirɛ oodwuli ayieleɛ.

english_verse: Even before the evening meal started, the devil had made Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, decide to betray Jesus.
translation_verse: Na nɔsoa bɔ bɛbaadidi nen, né abɔnzam anya afa awura Yudase Yiskariote, Simɔn awa ne, ye ti anu kyɛ ɔye Yesu ma.

english_verse: Jesus knew he had come from God and would go back to God. He also knew that the Father had given him complete power.
translation_verse: Né Yesu se kyɛ Baba ne afa nningyein amukoraa wawura ye sa, kyɛ ofi Baba ne berɛ yeɛ ɔwale ɔ, na ɔ́kɔ Baba ne berɛ;

english_verse: So during the meal Jesus got up, removed his outer garment, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
translation_verse: yiti odwɔsole yakyili adidie ne, ɔyele ye ataadeɛ guale berɛ; na ɔfale nzasrɛ pɛle ye bo.

english_verse: He put some water into a large bowl. Then he began washing his disciples' feet and drying them with the towel he was wearing.
translation_verse: Afei ohwiele nzue guale ayaa nu, na ɔhyɛle ye bo nwunzini asuafoɛ nemɔ bɛ gya bo, na ɔfale nzasrɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ne nununi bɛ gya bo.

english_verse: But when he came to Simon Peter, this disciple asked, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
translation_verse: Na odwuli Simɔn Petro so nen, Petro sele ye kyɛ, “Awurade, wɔ yeɛ afei enwunzi me gya bo ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “You don't really know what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Bɔ meyɔ ye, ɛnde ye bo kekesaala ye, na nziɛ ye ɛkɔte ye bo.”

english_verse: “You will never wash my feet!” Peter replied. “If I don't wash you,” Jesus told him, “you don't really belong to me.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Petro sele ye kyɛ, “Mengɔma engonwunzi me gya bo le!” Na Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Sɛ mannwunzi wɔ gya bo a, né ɛnne me bue nu.”

english_verse: Peter said, “Lord, don't wash just my feet. Wash my hands and my head.”
translation_verse: Na Simɔn Petro sele ye kyɛ, “Awurade, nnɛnwunzi me gya bo ngome, na me sa ne me ti so koso.”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “People who have bathed and are clean all over need to wash just their feet. And you, my disciples, are clean, except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Yesu sele ye kyɛ, “Sona bɔ wabia ne, onhia ebialɛ, sana ye gya bo nwunzinɛ, na ye nwo amukoraa afi; na ɛmɔ nwo afi, nakoso nna ɛmɔ amukoraa ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus knew who would betray him. That is why he said, “except for one of you.”
translation_verse: Né Yesu se bɔ ɔbaaye ye ma ne; ye sɔ ati yeɛ ɔhane kyɛ, “Nna ɛmɔ amukoraa yeɛ ɛmɔ nwo afi ɔ.”

english_verse: After Jesus had washed his disciples' feet and had put his outer garment back on, he sat down again. Then he said: Do you understand what I have done?
translation_verse: Na oyiele bɛ gya bo nwunzini ne, ɔfale ye ataadeɛ ne wurale, osa tenane ase, na obisale bɛ kyɛ, “Naa ɛmɔanwu bɔ mayɔ mama ɛmɔ ne?

english_verse: You call me your teacher and Lord, and you should, because that is who I am.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔfrɛ me Kyerɛkyerɛniɛ ne Awurade, na bɔ ɛmɔkã ne ɔte nahorɛ, ofikyɛ nde sɔ.

english_verse: I have set the example, and you should do for each other exactly what I have done for you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mama ɛmɔ ye nwo nhwɛsoɛ, na kyɛbɔ mayɔ mama ɛmɔ ne, ɛmɔ koso bɛ́yɔ sɔ ala.

english_verse: I tell you for certain that servants are not greater than their master, and messengers are not greater than the one who sent them.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, akoaa ndra ye mene; yeɛ somafoɛ ndra bɔ ɔsomane ye ne.

english_verse: I am not talking about all of you. I know the ones I have chosen. But what the Scriptures say must come true. And they say, “The man who ate with me has turned against me!”
translation_verse: “Nna ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛ nwo dwirɛ yeɛ mekã ɔ, na me de, mese bɛ bɔ maneanea nu maye bɛ ɔ. Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔkɔma Ahyerɛlɛ ne kɔwa nu kyɛ, ‘Sona bɔ ɔne me to asaa didi ne, ye yeɛ waye me wama ɔ.’

english_verse: I am telling you this before it all happens. Then when it does happen, you will believe who I am.
translation_verse: Afei mekã ɛhe mekyire ɛmɔ koraka né wasi, amaa sɛ osi a, ɛmɔale bali kyɛ me ole Ye.

english_verse: So the disciple leaned toward Jesus and asked, “Lord, which one of us are you talking about?”
translation_verse: Yiti, ye bɔ né watena wakisa Yesu ne, obisale ye kyɛ, “Awurade, nwa ɔ?”

english_verse: After Jesus had said these things, he was deeply troubled and told his disciples, “I tell you for certain that one of you will betray me.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu hane sɔ yiele nen, ye wora bɔle sunzum nu, na ɔfa tole dwaa kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛmɔ nu ko kɔye me kɔma.”

english_verse: Jesus' favorite disciple was sitting next to him at the meal,
translation_verse: Na asuafoɛ nemɔ anu ko bɔ Yesu kuro ye dwirɛ paa ne, né watena wakisa Yesu.

english_verse: and Simon motioned for this disciple to find out which one Jesus meant.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Simɔn Petro bɔle ye nye hyirele ye sele ye kyɛ, “Bisa ye sona horɛ bɔ ɔne ye ɔ.”

english_verse: But because Judas was in charge of the money, some of them thought that Jesus had told him to buy something they needed for the festival. Others thought that Jesus had told him to give some money to the poor.
translation_verse: Ebiemɔ susuli kyɛ, Yudase yeɛ osie sikaabɔtɔ ne ati, yiti yeɛ ɔmaa Yesu sele ye kyɛ: Nningyein bɔ yɛkohia ye aluolue ne, kɔtɔ fa sie; anaakyɛ ɔɔyɛ ehiafoɛ adɔeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Judas took the piece of bread and went out. It was already night. The New Command
translation_verse: Yiti olele paanoo sii ne yiele nen, berɛ ne ala yeɛ ofite hɔle ɔ, na né aleɛ asa. Yesu ma ye asuafoɛ ahyɛdeɛ foforɛ

english_verse: Then, after God is given glory because of him, God will bring glory to him, and God will do it very soon.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Nyameɛ anya ye nu animnyam a, Nyameɛ koso kɔhyɛ ye animnyam wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye nu, na ɔkɔhyɛ ye animnyam ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: My children, I will be with you for only a little while longer. Then you will look for me, but you won't find me. I tell you just as I told the people, “You cannot go where I am going.”
translation_verse: Me ngwadaammaa, mmerɛ kãa bie yeɛ waha bɔ me ne ɛmɔ yɛkɔtena ɔ. Ɛmɔkɔpena me, na kyɛbɔ nga ngyirele Yudafoɛ ne kyɛ, ‘Nekaa bɔ mekɔ ne, ɛmɔngɔhora berɛ bie ba’ nen, sɔ ala yeɛ mekã mekyire ɛmɔ koso kekesaala ye ɔ.

english_verse: Simon Peter asked, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “You can't go with me now, but later on you will.”
translation_verse: Na Simɔn Petro bisale ye kyɛ, “Awurade, nisua yeɛ ɛ́kɔ ɔ?” Yesu buale kyɛ, “Nekaa bɔ mékɔ ne, ɛngɔhora ngoli me si kekesaala ye; nakoso ekoli me si nziɛ ye.”

english_verse: Peter asked, “Lord, why can't I go with you now? I would die for you!”
translation_verse: Na Petro bisale ye kyɛ, “Awurade, nzu ati yeɛ mengɔhora mengoli wɔ si kekesaala ye ɔ? Ngɔfa me ngoa ngɔto berɛ ngɔma wɔ!”

english_verse: “Would you really die for me?” Jesus asked. “I tell you for certain before a rooster crows, you will say three times that you don't even know me.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Aso ɛkɔfa wɔ ngoa kɔto berɛ kɔma me? Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire wɔ kyɛ, akɔ ngɔbɔ né ahã ye pɛen nza kyɛ ɛnze me.”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples, “Don't be worried! Have faith in God and have faith in me.
translation_verse: “Nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ wora bɔ! Ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔle Nyameɛ beli, ná ɛmɔle me koso beli.

english_verse: There are many rooms in my Father's house. I wouldn't tell you this, unless it was true. I am going there to prepare a place for each of you.
translation_verse: Atenaleɛ pee wɔ me Baba awuro; na sɛ nna sɔ yeɛ ɔte hɔ a, aso ahaa mahã mahyire ɛmɔ kyɛ mekɔ mekosiesie nekaa mema ɛmɔ?

english_verse: After I have done this, I will come back and take you with me. Then we will be together.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mekɔ ná mekosiesie nekaa mema ɛmɔ a, ngosa ngɔwa, ná maafa ɛmɔ mahɔ me bɔbɔ me berɛ, ná nekaa bɔ nwɔ ne, ɛmɔ koso bawa berɛ bie.

english_verse: You know the way to where I am going.”
translation_verse: Nekaa bɔ mekɔ ne, [ɛmɔse, na] ɛmɔse atee ne.”

english_verse: Thomas said, “Lord, we don't even know where you are going! How can we know the way?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Tɔmase bisale ye kyɛ, “Awurade, yɛnze nekaa bɔ ɛ́kɔ ɔ; na ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né yahora yanwu atee ne?”

english_verse: “I am the way, the truth, and the life!” Jesus answered. “Without me, no one can go to the Father.
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale ye kyɛ; “Me ole atee ne, nahorɛ ne, ɔne ngoa ne; ebiala mma Baba ne berɛ, sana ɔnate me so.

english_verse: If you had really known me, you would have known the Father. But from now on, you do know him, and you have seen him.”
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔse me a, ahaa ɛmɔanwu me Baba ne koso; na ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, ɛmɔse ye, na ɛmɔanwu ye.”

english_verse: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That is all we need.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Filipo sele ye kyɛ, “Awurade, kyire yɛ Baba ne, na bɔ yɛhia hɔ ala ɛne.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Philip, I have been with you for a long time. Don't you know who I am? If you have seen me, you have seen the Father. How can you ask me to show you the Father?
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Filipo, me ne ɛmɔ yɛwɔ berɛ dadadada ye, aso ɛnze me? Ebiala bɔ wanwu me ne, wanwu Baba ne; na nzu ati yeɛ ɛkã kyɛ, ‘Kyire yɛ Baba ne’ ɔ?

english_verse: Don't you believe that I am one with the Father and that the Father is one with me? What I say isn't said on my own. The Father who lives in me does these things.
translation_verse: Aso enne nni kyɛ nwɔ Baba ne nu, ná Baba ne koso ɔwɔ me nu ɔ? Edwirɛ mɔ bɔ mekã mekyire ɛmɔ ne, nna me bɔbɔ me tumi yeɛ mefa mekã ɔ; na mmom Baba ne bɔ ɔte me nu ne, ye yeɛ ɔyɔ ye nnwumaa ne ɔ.

english_verse: Have faith in me when I say that the Father is one with me and that I am one with the Father. Or else have faith in me simply because of the things I do.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔle me beli kyɛ nwɔ Baba ne nu, ná Baba ne koso ɔwɔ me nu ɔ; na sɛ ɔtte sɔ de a, nzaade nnwumaa ne ala ti ɛmɔle me beli!

english_verse: I tell you for certain that if you have faith in me, you will do the same things I am doing. You will do even greater things, now that I am going back to the Father.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ: Ebiala bɔ ode me di nen, ye koso ɔkɔyɔ nnwumaa bɔ meyɔ ne bie, na ɔkɔyɔ bɔ ɔte mbiri mbiri tra ɛhemɔ ɔ; ofikyɛ me de, mékɔ me Baba ne berɛ.

english_verse: Ask me, and I will do whatever you ask. This way the Son will bring honor to the Father.
translation_verse: Na nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔsrɛ ye me dumaa nu ne, ngɔyɔ, amaa ɔnate so Baba ne anya animnyam wɔ Baa ne nu.

english_verse: I will do whatever you ask me to do. The Holy Spirit Is Promised
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔsrɛ nikyee biala me dumaa nu a, ngɔyɔ.” Sunzum Krongron nwo bɔhyɛ

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: If you love me, you will do as I command.
translation_verse: “Sɛ ɛmɔkuro me dwirɛ a, ɛmɔli m’ahyɛdeɛ so.

english_verse: Then I will ask the Father to send you the Holy Spirit who will help you and always be with you.
translation_verse: Na me de, ngobisa Baba ne, na ɔkɔma ɛmɔ Aworakyekyerɛniɛ foforɛ, ná ɔne ɛmɔ baatena daa,

english_verse: The Spirit will show you what is true. The people of this world cannot accept the Spirit, because they don't see or know him. But you know the Spirit, who is with you and will keep on living in you.
translation_verse: bɔ ye ole nahorɛ Sunzum bɔ ewiase ngora nne ye ndo nu ne; ofikyɛ onnwu ye, yeɛ ɔnze ye. Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔse ye, ofikyɛ ɔne ɛmɔ yeɛ bɛte ɔ, na ɔkɔtena ɛmɔ nu.

english_verse: I won't leave you like orphans. I will come back to you.
translation_verse: “Mengɔyakyi ɛmɔ nyisiaafoɛ, ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ.

english_verse: In a little while the people of this world won't be able to see me, but you will see me. And because I live, you will live.
translation_verse: Waha kãa bie né wiase nnwu me ko, nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔkonwu me; ɔnate kyɛ nde ase, na ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔkɔtena ase.

english_verse: Then you will know I am one with the Father. You will know you are one with me, and I am one with you.
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne, ɛmɔkonwu kyɛ nwɔ Baba ne nu, ná ɛmɔwɔ me nu, ná me wora nwɔ ɛmɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: If you love me, you will do what I have said, and my Father will love you. I will also love you and show you what I am like.
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ ole m’ahyɛdeɛ ná odi so nen, ye yeɛ okuro me dwirɛ ɔ; na bɔ okuro me dwirɛ nen, me Baba kohuro ye dwirɛ, ngohuro ye dwirɛ, na ngɔye me nwo ali ngohyire ye.”

english_verse: The other Judas, not Judas Iscariot, then spoke up and asked, “Lord, what do you mean by saying that you will show us what you are like, but you will not show the people of this world?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yudase bisale ye kyɛ, “Awurade, nzu ati yeɛ ɛbaaye wɔ nwo ali ekyire yɛ, na ɛnye ngyire wiase ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied: If anyone loves me, they will obey me. Then my Father will love them, and we will come to them and live in them.
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Sɛ ebie kuro me dwirɛ a, okoli me dwirɛ so, na me Baba kohuro ye dwirɛ, na yɛkɔwa ye berɛ, ná yaayɔ yɛ atenaleɛ wɔ ye berɛ.

english_verse: But anyone who doesn't love me, won't obey me. What they have heard me say doesn't really come from me, but from the Father who sent me.
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ onguro me dwirɛ nen, onni me dwirɛ so; na edwirɛ bɔ ɛmɔte ye, ɔtte me deɛ, na mmom ɔte Baba ne bɔ ɔsomane me ne deɛ.

english_verse: I have told you these things while I am still with you.
translation_verse: “Mahã edwirɛ hemɔ mahyire ɛmɔ, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ me ne ɛmɔ yɛwɔ berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But the Holy Spirit will come and help you, because the Father will send the Spirit to take my place. The Spirit will teach you everything and will remind you of what I said while I was with you.
translation_verse: Na Aworakyekyerɛniɛ ne, bɔ ye ole Sunzum Krongron ne, bɔ Baba ne kɔsoma ye wɔ me dumaa nu ne, ye yeɛ okohyirehyire ɛmɔ nikyee biala ɔ, na ɔkɔkaye ɛmɔ bɔ mahã mahyire ɛmɔ ne amukoraa.

english_verse: I give you peace, the kind of peace only I can give. It isn't like the peace this world can give. So don't be worried or afraid.
translation_verse: “Asomdwee yeɛ mefa meyakyi ɛmɔ ɔ, m’asomdwee yeɛ mefa mema ɛmɔ ɔ; nna kyɛbɔ wiase fa ma ne yeɛ mefa mema ɛmɔ ɔ. Nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ wora bɔ, yeɛ nnɛmɔma ɛserɛ tɔ ɛmɔ so.

english_verse: You have already heard me say I am going and I will also come back to you. If you really love me, you should be glad I am going back to the Father, because he is greater than I am.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔtele kyɛ nga ngyirele ɛmɔ kyɛ, ‘Mékɔ, na ngosa ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ.’ Sɛ ɛmɔkuro me dwirɛ a, ahaa ɔkɔyɛ ɛmɔ fɛ kyɛ mékɔ Baba ne berɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ Baba ne odi mu tra me.

english_verse: I am telling you this before I leave, so when it does happen, you will have faith in me.
translation_verse: Afei mahã mahyire ɛmɔ koraka ná wawa nu; amaa sɛ ɔba nu a, ɛmɔale bali.

english_verse: I cannot speak with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. But he has no power over me.
translation_verse: Me ne ɛmɔ yɛngodwudwo pee ko, ɔnate kyɛ bɔ odi wiase he aso ne, ɔ́ba, na olle tumi biala wɔ me so.

english_verse: I obey my Father, so everyone in the world might know that I love him. It is time for us to go now.
translation_verse: Nakoso kyɛbɔ Baba ne fale ahyɛdeɛ mane me ne, sɔ ala yeɛ meyɔ ɔ, amaa ɔnate so ewiase anwu kyɛ mekuro Baba ne dwirɛ. Ɛ́mɔdwɔso, ɛ́mɔma yɛfi wa yɛhɔ!”

english_verse: Jesus said to his disciples: I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
translation_verse: “Me ole nahorɛ bobe ne, yeɛ me Baba ole kuaniɛ ne.

english_verse: He cuts away every branch of mine that doesn't produce fruit. But he trims clean every branch that does produce fruit, so that it will produce even more fruit.
translation_verse: Me nwo mmaen biala bɔ onzu mmaa ne, ɔpɛ to; na mmaen biala bɔ osu mmaa ne de, ɔye ye nwo, amaa ɔnate so wasu mmaa pee.

english_verse: You are already clean because of what I have said to you.
translation_verse: Ɔnate edwirɛ bɔ mahã mahyire ɛmɔ ne ati, ɛmɔ nwo afi dada.

english_verse: Stay joined to me, and I will stay joined to you. Just as a branch cannot produce fruit unless it stays joined to the vine, you cannot produce fruit unless you stay joined to me.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtena me nu, ná me koso ndena ɛmɔ nu. Na kyɛbɔ mmaen bɔbɔ ngora nzu mmaa, bɔ sana ɔtena bobe ne anu nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔngɔhora ɔ, sana ɛmɔtena me nu.

english_verse: I am the vine, and you are the branches. If you stay joined to me, and I stay joined to you, then you will produce lots of fruit. But you cannot do anything without me.
translation_verse: “Me ole bobe ne, na ɛmɔ ole mmaen nemɔ. Ebiala bɔ ɔtena me nu, ná me koso metena ye nu ne, ye yeɛ osu mmaa pee ɔ; ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔkwati me a, ɛmɔngɔhora nikye fee yɔ.

english_verse: If you don't stay joined to me, you will be thrown away. You will be like dry branches that are gathered up and burned in a fire.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ebie wandena me nu a, begyi ye bɛto kyɛ bakaa mmaen, na ɔkese; na bɛboaboa mmaen nemɔ noa begua see nu bɛyera bɛ.

english_verse: Stay joined to me and let my teachings become part of you. Then you can pray for whatever you want, and your prayer will be answered.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔtena me nu, ná me dwirɛ tena ɛmɔ nu a, ɛmɔkobisa bɔ ɛmɔkuro biala, na ɔkɔyɛ berɛ kɔma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: When you become fruitful disciples of mine, my Father will be honored.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe anu yeɛ ɛmɔhyɛ me Baba animnyam ɔ, sɛ ɛmɔsu mmaa pee a, na ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa ɛmɔyɛ m’asuafoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I have loved you, just as my Father has loved me. So remain faithful to my love for you.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ Baba ne ahuro me dwirɛ nen, sɔ ala yeɛ me koso mahuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ ɔ; ɛmɔhɔ so bɛtena me dɔ nu!

english_verse: If you obey me, I will keep loving you, just as my Father keeps loving me, because I have obeyed him.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔdi m’ahyɛdeɛ so a, ɛmɔkɔtena me dɔ nu, kyɛbɔ mali me Baba ahyɛdeɛ so ná nde ye dɔ nu ne.

english_verse: I have told you this to make you as completely happy as I am.
translation_verse: “Mahã ɛhemɔ mahyire ɛmɔ, kyɛbɔ m’anika kɔtena ɛmɔ nu, ná ɛmɔ anika wali mu ɔ.

english_verse: Now I tell you to love each other, as I have loved you.
translation_verse: M’ahyɛdeɛ ne ɛhe: kyɛ ɛmɔhurohuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ, kyɛbɔ mahuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: The greatest way to show love for friends is to die for them.
translation_verse: Ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ole ɔdɔ bɔ ɔtra ɛhe ɔ, kyɛ ebie kɔfa ye ngoa kɔto berɛ kɔma ye damvo mɔ ɔ.

english_verse: And you are my friends, if you obey me.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔdi m’ahyɛdeɛ so a, ye de ɛmɔte me damvo mɔ.

english_verse: Servants don't know what their master is doing, and so I don't speak to you as my servants. I speak to you as my friends, and I have told you everything my Father has told me.
translation_verse: Memvrɛ ɛmɔ ngoaa ko, ofikyɛ akoaa nze bɔ ye mene ɔyɔ ɔ; na mmom mafrɛ ɛmɔ me damvo mɔ, ɔnate kyɛ edwirɛ biala bɔ mate mafi me Baba berɛ ne, mala ye ali mahyire ɛmɔ.

english_verse: You did not choose me. I chose you and sent you out to produce fruit, the kind of fruit that will last. Then my Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Nna ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔaneanea nu baye me ɔ, na mmom me yeɛ maneanea nu maye ɛmɔ ɔ. Na matu ɛmɔ masie berɛ kyɛ ɛmɔhɔ beesu mmaa, ná ɛmɔ mmaa ne bɛhɔ so bɛtena berɛ; na nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔkobisa Baba ne wɔ me dumaa nu nen, ɔkɔfa kɔma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: So I command you to love each other. The World's Hatred
translation_verse: Ahyɛdeɛ he yeɛ mefa mema ɛmɔ ɔ, kyɛ ɛmɔhurohuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ. Ewiase ndaneanyeɛ ne ɛpɔlɛ

english_verse: If the people of this world hate you, just remember that they hated me first.
translation_verse: “Sɛ wiase pɔ ɛmɔ a, ɛ́mɔnwu ye kyɛ wali moa wapɔ me koraka yeɛ ɔpɔ ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: If you belonged to the world, its people would love you. But you don't belong to the world. I have chosen you to leave the world behind, and this is why its people hate you.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔfi wiase a, ahaa wiase kohuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ kyɛ ye bɔbɔ ye deɛ. Na ɔnate kyɛ nna wiase yeɛ ɛmɔfi ɔ, na mmom me yeɛ maneanea nu maye ɛmɔ mafi wiase ne ati, yiti yeɛ ɔma wiase pɔ ɛmɔ ne.

english_verse: Remember how I told you that servants are not greater than their master. So if people mistreat me, they will mistreat you. If they do what I say, they will do what you say.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔkaye edwirɛ bɔ nga ngyirele ɛmɔ ne, kyɛ, ‘Akoaa ndra ye mene.’ Sɛ bɛtanene me nye a, bɛkɔtane ɛmɔ koso bɛ nye; sɛ belili me dwirɛ so a, bekoli ɛmɔ deɛ so koso.

english_verse: People will do to you exactly what they did to me. They will do it because you belong to me, and they don't know the one who sent me.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate me dumaa ti bɛkɔfa ɛhemɔ amukoraa bekoli ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ bɛnze bɔ ɔsomane me ne.

english_verse: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. But now they have no excuse for their sin.
translation_verse: Sɛ mamma manga dwirɛ ne mangyire bɛ a, ahaa benni bɔne nwo foɛ; na afei de, belle bɛ bɔne nwo nyeanoɛ biala.

english_verse: Everyone who hates me also hates my Father.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔpɔ me ne, ɔpɔ me Baba ne koso.

english_verse: I have done things no one else has ever done. If they had not seen me do these things, they would not be guilty. But they did see me do these things, and they still hate me and my Father too.
translation_verse: Sɛ manyɔ nnwumaa bɔ ebiala ɔyyɔle bie le wɔ bɛ nu a, ahaa benni bɔne nwo foɛ; na afei de, banwu ye, nakoso bapɔ me ne me Baba.

english_verse: This is why the Scriptures are true when they say, “People hated me for no reason.”
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ama edwirɛ bɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ bɛ mmeraa ne anu ne wawa nu kyɛ, ‘Bɛpɔle me mbaen.’

english_verse: I will send you the Spirit who comes from the Father and shows what is true. The Spirit will help you and will tell you about me.
translation_verse: “Na Aworakyekyerɛniɛ ne, nahorɛ Sunzum bɔ ofi Baba ne berɛ, bɔ ngɔsoma ye ngɔbrɛ ɛmɔ ngofi Baba ne berɛ ne, sɛ ɔba a, ye yeɛ okoli me nwo adanzeɛ ɔ;

english_verse: Then you will also tell others about me, because you have been with me from the beginning.
translation_verse: na ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔkoli adanzeɛ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ ne me anate alaa fi ahyɛaseɛ ne.”

english_verse: I am telling you these things, so that you will not turn away.
translation_verse: “Mahã ɛhemɔ mahyire ɛmɔ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔngɔyakyi ɛmɔ gyidie nu ɔ.

english_verse: You will be chased out of the synagogues. And the time will come when people will kill you and think they are doing God a favor.
translation_verse: Bekotu ɛmɔ bekofi nyianu sua mɔ nu. Ye po mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba, bɔ ebiala bɔ okohũ ɛmɔ ne, ɔkɔdwene kyɛ ɔyɔ sɔ fa so Nyameɛ.

english_verse: They will do these things because they don't know either the Father or me.
translation_verse: Na bɛkɔfa sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ bekoli ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ bennya bennwuni Baba ne anaa me.

english_verse: I am saying this to you now, so that when the time comes, you will remember what I have said. The Work of the Holy Spirit I was with you at the first, and so I didn't tell you these things.
translation_verse: Na mahã ɛhemɔ mahyire ɛmɔ, amaa sɛ mmerɛ ne dwu a, ɛmɔakaye kyɛ nga ngyirele ɛmɔ. Na manga ɛhemɔ mangyire ɛmɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne, ɔnate kyɛ né me ne ɛmɔ yeɛ yɛwɔ berɛ ɔ. Sunzum Krongron n’adwuma

english_verse: But now I am going back to the Father who sent me, and none of you asks me where I am going.
translation_verse: “Afei de, mékɔ bɔ ɔsomane me ne berɛ; nakoso ɛmɔ nu biala mmisa me kyɛ, ‘Nisua yeɛ ɛ́kɔ ɔ?’

english_verse: You are very sad from hearing all of this.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ mahã ɛhemɔ mahyire ɛmɔ ne ati, aworabɔlɛ ayi ɛmɔ ahone nu tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: But I tell you I am going to do what is best for you. This is why I am going away. The Holy Spirit cannot come to help you until I leave. But after I am gone, I will send the Spirit to you.
translation_verse: Nakoso mekã nahorɛ mekyire ɛmɔ; ɔte paa ma ɛmɔ kyɛ mékɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ sɛ mangɔ a, Aworakyekyerɛniɛ ne ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ; na sɛ mekɔ a, ngɔsoma ye maa ɔkɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ.

english_verse: The Spirit will come and show the people of this world the truth about sin and God's justice and the judgment.
translation_verse: Na ye de, sɛ ɔba a, ɔkɔma wiase konwu ye mvomsoɛ wɔ bɔne ne tenenee ne ndɛenbualɛ nwo.

english_verse: They are wrong about God's justice, because I am going to the Father, and you won't see me again.
translation_verse: tenenee nwo, ofikyɛ mékɔ me Baba ne berɛ, na ɛmɔngonwu me ko;

english_verse: And they are wrong about the judgment, because God has already judged the ruler of this world.
translation_verse: ndɛenbualɛ nwo, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ abua bɔ odi wiase he aso ne ndɛen dada.

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but right now it would be more than you could understand.
translation_verse: “Edwirɛ pee wɔ berɛ bɔ nne ye mekã mekyire ɛmɔ ɔ, nakoso ɛmɔngɔhora ngɔsɔ nu kekesaala ye.

english_verse: The Spirit shows what is true and will come and guide you into the full truth. The Spirit doesn't speak on his own. He will tell you only what he has heard from me, and he will let you know what is going to happen.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ye, nahorɛ Sunzum ne, ɔba a, okohyire ɛmɔ atee kɔhɔ nahorɛ ne amukoraa nu. Ofikyɛ ɔngɔfa ye bɔbɔ ye tumi yeɛ okodwudwo ɔ, na mmom edwirɛ biala bɔ ɔkɔte ne yeɛ ɔkɔhã ɔ, na ɔkɔla nningyein bɔ bɛbaasisi ɔ ali kohyire ɛmɔ.

english_verse: The Spirit will bring glory to me by taking my message and telling it to you.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔkɔhyɛ me animnyam ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔkɔfa me deɛ ne, ná wala ye ali wahyire ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Everything the Father has is mine. This is why I have said that the Spirit takes my message and tells it to you. Sorrow Will Turn into Joy
translation_verse: Baba ne, bɔ ole ye amukoraa te me deɛ; yiti yeɛ ngane kyɛ: Ɔkɔfa me deɛ ne, ná wala ye ali wahyire ɛmɔ. Aworabɔlɛ kɔkakyi anigye

english_verse: Jesus told his disciples, “For a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.”
translation_verse: “Waha kãa bie né ɛmɔnnwu me ko; yeɛ afei waha kãa bie ɛmɔkonwu me. [Ofikyɛ mékɔ Baba ne berɛ].”

english_verse: They said to each other, “What does Jesus mean by saying that for a little while we won't see him, but after a while we will see him? What does he mean by saying he is going to the Father?
translation_verse: Yeɛ ye asuafoɛ ne anu biemɔ bisabisale bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Edwirɛ he bɔ ɔkã kyire yɛ ye, ye bo kyire sɛɛ: ‘Waha kãa bie né ɛmɔnnwu me ko; yeɛ afei waha kãa bie ɛmɔkonwu me’; yeɛ ‘Ofikyɛ mékɔ Baba ne berɛ’?

english_verse: What is this ‘little while’ that he is talking about? We don't know what he means.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ bɛhane kyɛ: Ye bo kyire sɛɛ, bɔ ɔnwa, ‘Waha kãa bie’ ɔ? Yɛnde bɔ ɔkã ne bo.”

english_verse: Jesus knew they had some questions, so he said: You are wondering what I meant when I said that for a little while you won't see me, but after a while you will see me.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu nwuni kyɛ bɛpena kyɛ bebisa ye dwirɛ, yiti osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛhe nwo yeɛ ɛmɔbisabisa ɛmɔ nwo ye, kyɛ mahã kyɛ: ‘Waha kãa bie né ɛmɔnnwu me ko; yeɛ afei waha kãa bie ɛmɔkonwu me.’

english_verse: I tell you for certain that you will cry and be sad, but the world will be happy. You will be sad, but later you will be happy.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ: Ɛmɔkosu ná ɛmɔabɔ awuye, nakoso wiase koli ahurusi; na ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔ wora kɔbɔ, nakoso ɛmɔ aworabɔlɛ ne kɔkakyi ahurusililɛ.

english_verse: When a woman is about to give birth, she is in great pain. But after it is all over, she forgets the pain and is happy, because she has brought a child into the world.
translation_verse: Sɛ aworɛ kã brasua a, onwu yealɛ, ɔnate kyɛ ye mmerɛ adwu; nakoso sɛ ɔwo baa ne pɛ a, ɔngaye yealɛ ne ko, ɔnate anigye bɔ wanya ye kyɛ wawo sona wawa wiase ne ati.

english_verse: You are now very sad. But later I will see you, and you will be so happy that no one will be able to change the way you feel.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ koso, kekesaala ye de, ɛmɔdi aworabɔlɛ, nakoso ngonwu ɛmɔ bieku, na ɛmɔ ahone kɔtɔ ɛmɔ kunu; na ɛmɔ anigye ne, ebiala ngole ngofi ɛmɔ sa nu.

english_verse: When that time comes, you won't have to ask me about anything. I tell you for certain the Father will give you whatever you ask for in my name.
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne dwu a, ɛmɔngobisa me nikye fee. Nahorɛ nu paa, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ: Nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔsrɛ Baba ne wɔ me dumaa nu ne, ɔkɔfa kɔma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: You have not asked for anything in this way before, but now you must ask in my name. Then it will be given to you, so you will be completely happy.
translation_verse: Na ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, ɛmɔnnya bebbisale nikyee biala wɔ me dumaa nu. Ɛ́mɔbisa, na ɛmɔ sa kɔhã ye, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔ anigye ne wali mu.” Yesu ali wiase so ngonim

english_verse: I have used examples to explain to you what I have been talking about. But the time will come when I will speak to you plainly about the Father and will no longer use examples like these.
translation_verse: “Mahã ɛhemɔ mahyire ɛmɔ wɔ anyandera nu; na mmerɛ bie ɔ́ba bɔ mengodwudwo ngohyire ɛmɔ wɔ anyandera nu ko ɔ, na mmom ngɔhã Baba ne nwo dwirɛ ngohyire ɛmɔ pefee.

english_verse: You will ask the Father in my name, and I won't have to ask him for you.
translation_verse: Na sɔ kyẽa ne yeɛ ɛmɔkɔsrɛ wɔ me dumaa nu ɔ; na menga mengyire ɛmɔ kyɛ ngɔfa ngɔto Baba ne nyunu ngɔma ɛmɔ;

english_verse: God the Father loves you because you love me, and you believe I have come from him.
translation_verse: ɔnate kyɛ Baba ne bɔbɔ okuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔkuro me dwirɛ, na ɛmɔale bali kyɛ Baba ne berɛ yeɛ mvi mmale ɔ.

english_verse: I came from the Father into the world, but I am leaving the world and returning to the Father.
translation_verse: Baba ne berɛ yeɛ mvi mmale wiase ɔ; na afei de, méfi wiase, na mékɔ Baba ne berɛ.”

english_verse: The disciples said, “Now you are speaking plainly to us! You are not using examples.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ye asuafoɛ nemɔ sele ye kyɛ, “Ehee, afei de, edwudwo pefee, na endwudwo anyandera nu.

english_verse: At last we know that you understand everything, and we don't have any more questions. Now we believe you truly have come from God.”
translation_verse: Afei de, yanwu kyɛ ɛse nningyein amukoraa, na enhia kyɛ ebie kobisa wɔ dwirɛ ɔ. Na ɛhe maa yɛde yɛdi kyɛ efi Nyameɛ berɛ yeɛ ɛwale ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus replied: Do you really believe me?
translation_verse: Na Yesu bisale bɛ kyɛ, “Afei de, ɛmɔde bedi?

english_verse: The time will come and is already here when all of you will be scattered. Each of you will go back home and leave me by myself. But the Father will be with me, and I won't be alone.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, mmerɛ ne ɔ́ba, na wanya wawa, bɔ ɛmɔkɔbɔ aya, bɔ ebiala kɔhɔ ye kuro ɔ, na ɛmɔkɔyakyi me ngome nu; nakoso ɔhhale me ngome, ofikyɛ Baba ne boka me so.

english_verse: I have told you this, so that you might have peace in your hearts because of me. While you are in the world, you will have to suffer. But cheer up! I have defeated the world.
translation_verse: Mahã ɛhemɔ mahyire ɛmɔ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanya me nu asomdwee. Ɛmɔkɔfa amaneɛ nu wɔ wiase de, nakoso ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ ahone tɔ ɛmɔ kunu! Mali wiase so ngonim.”

english_verse: After Jesus had finished speaking to his disciples, he looked up toward heaven and prayed: Father, the time has come for you to bring glory to your Son, in order that he may bring glory to you.
translation_verse: Na Yesu dwudwole yiele nen, ɔmane ye nye so hyirele nyameɛso, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Baba, dɔnhwere ne adwu. Hyɛ Ɛwa ne animnyam, ná Baa ne koso ɔhyɛ wɔ animnyam;

english_verse: And you gave him power over all people, so he would give eternal life to everyone you give him.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ ama ye tumi wɔ anwoɔnaen amukoraa so, kyɛ ɔma ebiala bɔ afa ama ye ne daa ngoa ne.

english_verse: Eternal life is to know you, the only true God, and to know Jesus Christ, the one you sent.
translation_verse: Na daa ngoa ne ɛhe: kyɛ bekonwu wɔ, nahorɛ Nyameɛ komapɛ ne, ɔne bɔ asoma ye ne, Yesu Kristo ne.

english_verse: I have brought glory to you here on earth by doing everything you gave me to do.
translation_verse: Mahyɛ wɔ animnyam wɔ aseɛ so; mayie adwuma bɔ ɛfa mane me kyɛ nyɔ ne.

english_verse: Now, Father, give me back the glory I had with you before the world was created.
translation_verse: Afei, O Baba, animnyam bɔ nne ye wɔ berɛ koraka yeɛ ewiase baawa ne, fa hyɛ me animnyam wɔ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: You have given me some followers from this world, and I have shown them what you are like. They were yours, but you gave them to me, and they have obeyed you.
translation_verse: “Mmenia bɔ ɛyele bɛ fili wiase fa mane me ne, mala wɔ dumaa ali mahyire bɛ. Bɛte wɔ deɛ, na ɛfale bɛ mane me, na bali wɔ dwirɛ so.

english_verse: They know that you gave me everything I have.
translation_verse: Afei de, bɛse kyɛ nningyein amukoraa bɔ afa ama me ne, befi wɔ berɛ;

english_verse: I told my followers what you told me, and they accepted it. They know I came from you, and they believe you are the one who sent me.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ edwirɛ bɔ ɛfa mane me ne, mafa mama bɛ; na bɛ koso basɔ nu, na banwu ye amba kyɛ wɔ berɛ yeɛ mvi mmale ɔ, na bale bali kyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛsomane me ɔ.

english_verse: I am praying for them, but not for those who belong to this world. My followers belong to you, and I am praying for them.
translation_verse: “Mésrɛ mema bɛ; menzrɛ memma wiase, na mmom bɛ bɔ afa bɛ ama me ne, ofikyɛ bɛte wɔ deɛ.

english_verse: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine, and they will bring glory to me.
translation_verse: Me nningyein amukoraa te wɔ deɛ, yeɛ wɔ deɛ koso te me deɛ, na manya animnyam wɔ bɛ nu.

english_verse: Holy Father, I am no longer in the world. I am coming to you, but my followers are still in the world. So keep them safe by the power of the name you have given me. Then they will be one with each other, just as you and I are one.
translation_verse: Afei de, nne wiase ko, nakoso ɛhemɔ de bɛwɔ wiase wa; na me de, méba wɔ berɛ. Baba Krongron, bɛ bɔ afa bɛ ama me ne, fa bɛ sie wɔ wɔ dumaa nu, amaa ɔnate so bayɛ ko, kyɛbɔ yɛte ko ne.

english_verse: While I was with them, I kept them safe by the power you have given me. I guarded them, and not one of them was lost, except the one who had to be lost. This happened so that what the Scriptures say would come true.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né me ne bɛ yɛwɔ wiase ne, mvale bɛ bɔ afa bɛ ama me ne nziele wɔ wɔ dumaa nu. Mabɔ bɛ nwo waen, na bɛ nu biala ammini, sana baa bɔ wamini ne; bɔ ɔnate so Ahyerɛlɛ ne awa nu ɔ.

english_verse: I am on my way to you. But I say these things while I am still in the world, so my followers will have the same complete joy that I do.
translation_verse: Na afei de, méba wɔ berɛ, na mekã edwirɛ hemɔ wɔ wiase wa, amaa ɔnate so banya m’anigye maa wali mu wɔ bɛ nu.

english_verse: I have told them your message. But the people of this world hate them, because they don't belong to this world, just as I don't.
translation_verse: Mafa wɔ dwirɛ ne mama bɛ; na wiase apɔ bɛ, ofikyɛ nna wiase yeɛ befi ɔ, kyɛbɔ me koso mmvi wiase ne.

english_verse: Father, I don't ask you to take my followers out of the world, but keep them safe from the evil one.
translation_verse: Menzrɛ wɔ kyɛ ɛye bɛ fi wiase, na mmom kyɛ: Bɔ bɛ nwo waen fi bɔnefoɛ ne sa nu.

english_verse: They don't belong to this world, and neither do I.
translation_verse: Nna wiase yeɛ befi ɔ, kyɛbɔ me koso mmvi wiase ne.

english_verse: Your word is the truth. So let this truth make them completely yours.
translation_verse: Yɛ bɛ krongron wɔ wɔ nahorɛ ne anu; wɔ dwirɛ ne te nahorɛ.

english_verse: I am sending them into the world, just as you sent me.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ ɛsomane me wɔ wiase ne, sɔ ala yeɛ me koso masoma bɛ wɔ wiase ɔ.

english_verse: I have given myself completely for their sake, so they may belong completely to the truth.
translation_verse: Meyɛ me nwo krongron mema bɛ, amaa ɔnate so bɛ koso bayɛ krongron wɔ nahorɛ ne anu.

english_verse: I am not praying just for these followers. I am also praying for everyone else who will have faith because of what my followers will say about me.
translation_verse: “Nna ɛhemɔ angome yeɛ mebɔ mbaeɛ mema bɛ ɔ, na mmom bɛ bɔ ɔnate bɛ dwirɛ so bekole me bekoli ne koso,

english_verse: I want all of them to be one with each other, just as I am one with you and you are one with me. I also want them to be one with us. Then the people of this world will believe that you sent me.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so bɛ mukoraa bayɛ ko; kyɛbɔ wɔ, Baba, ɛwɔ me nu, ná me koso nwɔ wɔ nu ne, ná bɛ koso bayɛ ko wɔ yɛ nu, ná wiase ole li kyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛsomane me ɔ.

english_verse: I have honored my followers in the same way you honored me, in order that they may be one with each other, just as we are one.
translation_verse: Na animnyam bɔ ɛfa mane me ne, mafa mama bɛ, amaa ɔnate so bayɛ ko, kyɛbɔ yɛte ko ne.

english_verse: I am one with them, and you are one with me, so they may become completely one. Then this world's people will know that you sent me. They will know that you love my followers as much as you love me.
translation_verse: Nwɔ bɛ nu, na ɛwɔ me nu, na bali mu wɔ koyɛlɛ nu; na ɔnate so wiase konwu kyɛ wɔ yeɛ asoma me ɔ, na ekuro bɛ dwirɛ kyɛbɔ ekuro me dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: Father, I want everyone you have given me to be with me, wherever I am. Then they will see the glory you have given me, because you loved me before the world was created.
translation_verse: “Baba, bɛ bɔ afa bɛ ama me ne, mekuro kyɛ nekaa bɔ nwɔ ne, bɛ koso bɛbaboka me so wɔ berɛ, amaa ɔnate so banwu m’animnyam bɔ ɛfa mane me ne; ofikyɛ ehurole me dwirɛ koraka yeɛ ewiase ahyɛaseɛ ɔba ɔ.

english_verse: Good Father, the people of this world don't know you. But I know you, and my followers know that you sent me.
translation_verse: O Baba Teneneeniɛ, wiase annwu wɔ, na me de, manwu wɔ; na ɛhemɔ banwu kyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛsomane me ɔ.

english_verse: I told them what you are like, and I will tell them even more. Then the love you have for me will become part of them, and I will be one with them.
translation_verse: Mala wɔ dumaa ali mahyire bɛ, na ngɔla ye ali ngohyire; amaa ɔnate so ehurolɛ bɔ ekuro me dwirɛ ne watena bɛ nu, ná me koso matena bɛ nu.”

english_verse: One of the high priest's servants was there. He was a relative of the servant whose ear Peter had cut off, and he asked, “Didn't I see you in the garden with that man?”
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne ngoaa nemɔ anu ko, bɔ ye busuaniɛ yeɛ Petro pɛle ye so ne, obisale kyɛ, “Aso mannwu wɔ ne ye wɔ turo ne anu dɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus again asked, “Who are you looking for?” “We are looking for Jesus from Nazareth,” they answered.
translation_verse: Yeɛ obisale bɛ bieku kyɛ, “Ɛmɔpena nwa?” Na bebuale kyɛ, “Yesu, Nasarɛteniɛ ne.”

english_verse: This time Jesus replied, “I have already told you that I am Jesus. If I am the one you are looking for, let these others go.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yesu buale kyɛ, “Mahã mahyire ɛmɔ kyɛ me ɛhe; yiti sɛ me yeɛ ɛmɔpena me a, ye de ɛ́mɔma ɛhemɔ bɛhɔ!”

english_verse: Then everything will happen, just as I said, ‘I did not lose anyone you gave me.’ ”
translation_verse: Na ɛhe mane edwirɛ bɔ ɔhane ye kyɛ, “Bɛ bɔ afa bɛ ama me ne, mamma bɛ nu biala wammini ne” wale nu.

english_verse: Simon Peter had brought along a sword. He pulled it out and struck at Malchus, the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Simɔn Petro bɔ né otira ngrandɛ ne, ɔhwene, na ɔfa bɔle ɔsɔfo panyi paa n’akoaa pɛle ye so famaa. Akoaa ne dumaa li Malkose.

english_verse: The Roman officer and his men, together with the temple police, arrested Jesus and tied him up.
translation_verse: Yeɛ asraafoɛ kure ne ne bɛ safohene ne ne Yuda asomvoɛ nemɔ bɛhyele Yesu, na bɛkyekyele ye.

english_verse: but asked him, “Aren't you one of that man's followers?” “No, I am not!” Peter answered.
translation_verse: Yeɛ afaneɛ bɔ ɔwɛne anoa ne bisale Petro kyɛ, “Wɔ koso, biaa he asuafoɛ nemɔ, aso nna bɛ nu ko ole wɔ?” Na obuale kyɛ, “Daabi oo.”

english_verse: It was cold, and the servants and temple police had made a charcoal fire. They were warming themselves around it, when Peter went over and stood near the fire to warm himself. Jesus Is Questioned by the High Priest (Matthew
translation_verse: Né ngoaa nemɔ ne asomvoɛ nemɔ bahua see begyigyi ye nwo, ofikyɛ né ɛyerɛ wɔ nu. Né bɛ́to see ne, na né Petro koso ogyi bɛ nwo berɛ ɔto see ne bie. Ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne bisa Yesu dwirɛ (Mateo

english_verse: The high priest questioned Jesus about his followers and his teaching.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne bisale Yesu dwirɛ fale ye asuafoɛ nemɔ ne ye ngyerɛkyerɛ nwo.

english_verse: Why are you questioning me? Why don't you ask the people who heard me? They know what I have said.”
translation_verse: Nzu ati yeɛ ebisa me ɔ? Bisa bɛ bɔ betiele me ne, na bɔ nga ngyirele bɛ ne, bɛ yeɛ bɛse bɔ ngane ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus was still tied up, and Annas sent him to Caiaphas the high priest. Peter Again Denies that He Knows Jesus (Matthew
translation_verse: Yeɛ Anase maa bɛfale nyamaa bɛkyekyele ye bɛfale ye bɛɛmane ɔsɔfo panyi paa Kaifa. Petro po Yesu bieku (Mateo

english_verse: ) Pilate went back out and said, “I don't find this man guilty of anything!
translation_verse: ) Na ɔhane sɔ dwirɛ nen, afei ofite hɔle Yudafoɛ nemɔ berɛ bieku, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Me de, mennwu foɛ biala bɔ odi ɔ.

english_verse: It was early in the morning when Jesus was taken from Caiaphas to the building where the Roman governor stayed. But the crowd waited outside. Any of them who had gone inside would have become unclean and would not be allowed to eat the Passover meal.
translation_verse: Yeɛ bɛfale Yesu befili Kaifa berɛ bɛhɔle amrado n’aluo berɛ; na né ɔte ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu. Nakoso bɛ bɔbɔ de, bangɔ amrado n’aluo berɛ bie, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ bɛ nwo ngogua fiɛ, ná bahora bali Abɔtra ne ɔ.

english_verse: Pilate came out and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”
translation_verse: Yiti Pilato fite wale bɛ berɛ oobisale bɛ kyɛ, “Nzikyɛ kwaadu yeɛ ɛmɔfa bɛbɔ sɔ biaa ye ɔ?”

english_verse: They answered, “He is a criminal! That's why we brought him to you.”
translation_verse: Na bebuale ye kyɛ, “Sɛ akoaa he ɔtte mmeraatolɛniɛ a, ahaa yamva ye yammrɛ wɔ.”

english_verse: And so what Jesus said about his death would soon come true.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe sili mane Yesu dwirɛ bɔ ɔhã fale ewue horɛ bɔ okowu ne nwo wale nu.

english_verse: Pilate then went back inside. He called Jesus over and asked, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Pilato wurale amrado aluo berɛ bieku, na ɔfrɛle Yesu bisale ye kyɛ, “Wɔ ole Yudafoɛ Hene ne anaa?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “Are you asking this on your own or did someone tell you about me?”
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “Wɔ bɔbɔ yeɛ ɛ́bɔ wɔ ti anu ɛkã ɔ, anaakyɛ ebiemɔ yeɛ bahã me nwo dwirɛ bahyire wɔ ɔ?”

english_verse: “You know I'm not a Jew!” Pilate said. “Your own people and the chief priests brought you to me. What have you done?”
translation_verse: Na Pilato buale ye kyɛ, “Nde Yudaniɛ anaa? Wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ maen ne asɔfo mbanyi yeɛ bɛfale wɔ bɛbrɛle me ɔ; nzikyɛ yeɛ ayɔ ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus answered, “My kingdom doesn't belong to this world. If it did, my followers would have fought to keep me from being handed over to our leaders. No, my kingdom doesn't belong to this world.”
translation_verse: Yesu buale kyɛ, “M’ahennie ne, offi wiase wa. Sɛ m’ahennie ne ofi wiase wa a, ahaa m’asomvoɛ mɔ bɛkɔho, bɔ ɔnate so bɛngɔfa me bengowura Yudafoɛ mɔ sa ɔ; nakoso m’ahennie ne offi wiase wa.”

english_verse: “So you are a king,” Pilate replied. “You are saying that I am a king,” Jesus told him. “I was born into this world to tell about the truth. And everyone who belongs to the truth knows my voice.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Pilato bisale ye kyɛ, “Yiti ɛte ɛhene ɛne?” Na Yesu buale kyɛ, “Wɔ yeɛ ɛkã kyɛ nde ɛhene ɔ. Me de, ɛhe ati yeɛ bɛwole me ɔ, na ɛhe ati yeɛ mawa wiase ɔ, kyɛ mebaali nahorɛ ne nwo adanzeɛ. Na ebiala bɔ ofi nahorɛ ne anu ne, otie me dwirɛ.”

english_verse: Pilate asked Jesus, “What is truth?” Jesus Is Sentenced to Death (Matthew
translation_verse: Na Pilato bisale ye kyɛ, “Nahorɛ, ye ole nzu?” Bebua Yesu ewue foɛ (Mateo

english_verse: And since I usually set a prisoner free for you at Passover, would you like for me to set free the king of the Jews?”
translation_verse: Nakoso yeɛ ɛmɔle amanneɛ kyɛ meyakyi sona ko mema ɛmɔ Abɔtra aluolue mmerɛ nu. Yiti ɛmɔkuro kyɛ meyakyi Yudafoɛ Hene ne mema ɛmɔ anaa?”

english_verse: They shouted, “No, not him! We want Barabbas.” Now Barabbas was a terrorist.
translation_verse: Na bɛteateane nu bieku kyɛ, “Nna akoaa he ɔ, na mmom Baraba!”

english_verse: Pilate gave orders for Jesus to be beaten with a whip.
translation_verse: Afei Pilato fale Yesu ofini ye mbire.

english_verse: The soldiers made a crown out of thorn branches and put it on Jesus. Then they put a purple robe on him.
translation_verse: Na asraafoɛ nemɔ nwone mmowue abotire, na bɛfa bepurole ye ti, na bɛfale ataadeɛ kɔkorɛ bie beguale ye so.

english_verse: They came up to him and said, “Hey, you king of the Jews!” They also hit him with their fists.
translation_verse: Bɛwale ye nwo berɛ, na besele kyɛ, “Yudafoɛ Hene, wɔ ngoa so oo!” Na bɛbobɔle ye nye so.

english_verse: Once again Pilate went out. This time he said, “I will have Jesus brought out to you again. Then you can see for yourselves that I have not found him guilty.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Pilato fite wale bieku, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔtie, méfa ye mebrɛ ɛmɔ, ma ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ mennwu kyɛ odi fɔ biala ɔ.”

english_verse: Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said, “Here is the man!”
translation_verse: Yiti Yesu fite wale; né ɔbɔ mmowue abotire ne, na owura ataadeɛ kɔkorɛ ne. Yeɛ Pilato sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea, biaa ne ɛhe!”

english_verse: When the chief priests and the temple police saw him, they yelled, “Nail him to a cross! Nail him to a cross!” Pilate told them, “You take him and nail him to a cross! I don't find him guilty of anything.”
translation_verse: Na asɔfo mbanyi nemɔ ne awɛmvoɛ nemɔ benwuni ye ne, bɛteateane nu kyɛ, “Bɔ ye mmeamudua nu! Bɔ ye mmeamudua nu!” Na Pilato sele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bɛfa ye bɛɛbɔ ye mmeamudua nu! Ofikyɛ me de, mennwu kyɛ odi fɔ biala ɔ.”

english_verse: The crowd replied, “He claimed to be the Son of God! Our law says that he must be put to death.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Yudafoɛ nemɔ buale ye kyɛ, “Yɛ de, yɛle mmeraa, na yɛ mmeraa ne kyire kyɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ owu ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔyɛle ye nwo Nyameɛ Awa ne.”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he was terrified.
translation_verse: Na Pilato tele edwirɛ he nen, ɛserɛ hane ye trale daa ne.

english_verse: He went back inside and asked Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus did not answer.
translation_verse: Osa wurale amrado aluo berɛ, na obisale Yesu kyɛ, “Efi nisua?” Nakoso Yesu amma ye mmuayɛɛ.

english_verse: “Why won't you answer my question?” Pilate asked. “Don't you know I have the power to let you go free or to nail you to a cross?”
translation_verse: Yiti Pilato sele ye kyɛ, “Engodwudwo me nwo? Ɛnze kyɛ tumi wura me sa kyɛ mekora meyakyi wɔ, yeɛ tumi wura me sa kyɛ mekora mebɔ wɔ mmeamudua nu ɔ?”

english_verse: Jesus replied, “If God had not given you the power, you couldn't do anything at all to me. But the one who handed me over to you did something even worse.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu buale ye kyɛ, “Sɛ bamva bamvi nyameɛso bamma wɔ a, ahaa elle tumi biala wɔ me so; yiti bɔ ɔyele me mane wɔ ne, ye yeɛ ye bɔne te piri ɔ.”

english_verse: Then Pilate wanted to set Jesus free. But the crowd again yelled, “If you set this man free, you are no friend of the Emperor! Anyone who claims to be a king is an enemy of the Emperor.”
translation_verse: Na ofi sɔ mmerɛ ne, Pilato penane atee bɔ ɔkɔfa so kɔyakyi ye ɔ, nakoso Yudafoɛ nemɔ teateane nu kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛyakyi sɔ akoaa he a, ye de nna wɔ damvo ole Kaesare; na ebiala bɔ ɔyɛ ye nwo ɛhene ne, ɔko tia Kaesare.”

english_verse: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out. Then he sat down on the judge's bench at the place known as “The Stone Pavement.” In Aramaic this pavement is called “Gabbatha.”
translation_verse: Na Pilato tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, ɔfale Yesu fite wale, na ɔtenane ndɛenbualɛ bia nu, wɔ nekaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ berɛ Nyɔboɛ Pato nu, bɔ Hebri dwudwolɛ nu bɛfrɛ ye Gabata.

english_verse: It was about noon on the day before Passover, and Pilate said to the crowd, “Look at your king!”
translation_verse: Né ɔte Abɔtra nwo anwoboaboa kyẽa; kɔyɛ eyiagyina. Na Pilato sele Yudafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔnea, ɛmɔ Hene ne ɛhe!”

english_verse: Then Pilate handed Jesus over to be nailed to a cross. Jesus Is Nailed to a Cross (Matthew
translation_verse: Na ɔyele ye mane bɛ kyɛ bɛɛbɔ ye mmeamudua nu. Bɛbɔ Yesu mmeamudua nu (Mateo

english_verse: The soldiers first broke the legs of the other two men who were nailed there.
translation_verse: Yiti asraafoɛ nemɔ wale beebubuli bɔ oli moa ne gya nu, ɔne ko bɔ ɔboka so bɔ bɛbɔle ye ne Yesu mmeamudua nu ne koso ye deɛ.

english_verse: So the chief priests went to Pilate and said, “Why did you write that he is King of the Jews? You should have written, ‘He claimed to be King of the Jews.’ ”
translation_verse: Na Yudafoɛ asɔfo mbanyi nemɔ sele Pilato kyɛ, “Nnɛkyerɛ ye kyɛ, ‘Yudafoɛ Hene Ne,’ na mmom kyerɛ ye kyɛ, ‘Biaa he hane kyɛ: Me Ole Yudafoɛ Hene ne.’ ”

english_verse: When Jesus saw his mother and his favorite disciple with her, he said to his mother, “This man is now your son.”
translation_verse: Na Yesu nwuni ye maame ne suaniɛ bɔ okuro ye dwirɛ paa ne kyɛ begyigyi berɛ nen, osele ye maame kyɛ, “Mmobraa, nea, ɛwa ɛhe!”

english_verse: and he carried his cross to a place known as “The Skull.” In Aramaic this place is called “Golgotha.”
translation_verse: Yiti bɛfale Yesu bɛhɔle. Na ɔsoale ye mmeamudua ne fili berɛ oodwuli nekaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ berɛ “Tire Kokuroka so,” bɔ Hebri nu bɛfrɛ ye Golgota.

english_verse: There Jesus was nailed to the cross, and on each side of him a man was also nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Berɛ yeɛ bɛbɔle ye mmeamudua nu ɔ, bɔ mmenia nyɔ bɛboka ye so ɔ, wɔ ye bue nyɔ ne, bɔ Yesu wɔ b’afia ɔ.

english_verse: Pilate ordered the charge against Jesus to be written on a board and put above the cross. It read, “Jesus of Nazareth, King of the Jews.”
translation_verse: Na Pilato hyerɛle edwirɛ bie bɔle mmeamudua n’anwuro kyɛ, “Yesu, Nasarɛteniɛ, Yudafoɛ Hene Ne.”

english_verse: The words were written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek. The place where Jesus was taken wasn't far from the city, and many of the people read the charge against him.
translation_verse: Yudafoɛ pee bɛkengale sɔ ahyerɛlɛ he, ɔnate kyɛ nekaa bɔ bɛbɔle Yesu mmeamudua nu ne, opingye kuro ne; na bɛhyerɛle edwirɛ ne wɔ Hebri, Roman ne Hela dwudwolɛ nu.

english_verse: But Pilate told them, “What is written will not be changed!”
translation_verse: Na Pilato buale kyɛ, “Bɔ mahyerɛ ne ala yeɛ mahyerɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The soldiers said to each other, “Let's not rip it apart. We will gamble to see who gets it.” This happened so the Scriptures would come true, which say, “They divided up my clothes and gambled for my garments.” The soldiers then did what they had decided.
translation_verse: Yeɛ besisele bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Nnɛmɔma yɛsunzua nu, na mmom ɛ́mɔma yɛgua so serewa yɛnwu bɔ ɔkɔyɛ ye deɛ ɔ.” Na ɛhe mane Ahyerɛlɛ ne wale nu kyɛ, “Bɛhyɛle me ndena bɛfale, yeɛ beguale serewa wɔ m’ataadeɛ so.”

english_verse: Jesus' mother stood beside his cross with her sister and Mary the wife of Clopas. Mary Magdalene was standing there too.
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ asraafoɛ nemɔ yɔle hɔ ɛne. Na mmenia hemɔ yeɛ né begyi bepingye Yesu mmeamudua ne nwo ɔ: ye maame, ye maame aliɛma brasua, Klopa aye Maria, yeɛ Maria Magdalene.

english_verse: But when they came to Jesus, they saw he was already dead, and they did not break his legs.
translation_verse: Nakoso bedwuli Yesu so, ná benwuni kyɛ wawu dada nen, bammubu ye gya nu.

english_verse: In the place where Jesus had been nailed to a cross, there was a garden with a tomb that had never been used.
translation_verse: Na nekaa bɔ bɛbɔle ye mmeamudua nu ne, né turo bie wɔ berɛ. Né asieleɛ foforɛ bie bɔ bennya bɛffale sona bɛttole nu le ɔ ɔwɔ turo ne anu.

english_verse: Jesus knew that he had now finished his work. And in order to make the Scriptures come true, he said, “I am thirsty!”
translation_verse: Na ɛhe asi ne, bɔ Yesu nwuni kyɛ wanya wayie nikyee biala nen, , ɔhane kyɛ, “Nzuhɔen ku me.”

english_verse: A jar of cheap wine was there. Someone then soaked a sponge with the wine and held it up to Jesus' mouth on the stem of a hyssop plant.
translation_verse: Né nzaa kekarekekare bie wɔ kulie nu tɛkyɛ ogyi berɛ. Na bɛfale eminaen bɛbɔle nzaa kekarekekare ne anu, bɛfa betuale bakaa bie noa, na bɛfa bɛhane ye noa.

english_verse: kilograms of spices made from myrrh and aloes. This was the same Nicodemus who had visited Jesus one night.
translation_verse: Na Yesu lele nzaa kekarekekare ne nen, ɔhane kyɛ, “Mayie.” Na osili ye ti ase, na ɔhale nu. Asraafoɛ fa pealɛɛ wɔ Yesu mvenu

english_verse: The next day would be both a Sabbath and the Passover. It was a special day for the Jewish people, and they did not want the bodies to stay on the crosses during this day. So they asked Pilate to break the men's legs and take their bodies down.
translation_verse: Né sɔ kyẽa ne te Anwoboaboa kyẽa, na kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ efuin nemɔ bɛngɔha mmeamudua nemɔ so wɔ afofikyẽa ne, yiti Yudafoɛ bɛɛsrɛle Pilato kyɛ ɔma bebubu bɛ gya nu, ná bɛye bɛ bɛbra ase.

english_verse: One of the soldiers stuck his spear into Jesus' side, and blood and water came out.
translation_verse: Nakoso asraafoɛ nemɔ anu ko fale pealɛɛ wɔle ye mvenu, na berɛ ne ala, mogya ne nzue fili nu wale.

english_verse: We know this is true, because it was told by someone who saw it happen. Now you can have faith too.
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ onwuni ɛhe nen, wali ye nwo adanzeɛ; ye adanzeɛ ne te nahorɛ, na ye de, ɔse kyɛ ɔkã nahorɛ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔ koso bale bali.

english_verse: All this happened so that the Scriptures would come true, which say, “No bone of his body will be broken”
translation_verse: Na ɛhemɔ sili mane Ahyerɛlɛ ne wale nu kyɛ, “Ye bowue ko po, bengobu nu.”

english_verse: and “They will see the one in whose side they stuck a spear.” Jesus Is Buried (Matthew
translation_verse: Afei koso, Ahyerɛlɛ foforɛ kã kyɛ, “Bekotu bɛ nye bekogua bɔ bɛwɔle ye pealɛɛ ne aso.” Besie Yesu (Mateo

english_verse: The tomb was nearby, and since it was the time to prepare for the Sabbath, they were in a hurry to put Jesus' body there.
translation_verse: Né ɔte Yudafoɛ anwoboaboa kyẽa, yiti bɛfale Yesu bɛɛtole nu, ofikyɛ né asieleɛ ne pingye berɛ.

english_verse: Joseph from Arimathea was one of Jesus' disciples. He had kept it secret though, because he was afraid of the Jewish leaders. But now he asked Pilate to let him have Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission, and Joseph took it down from the cross.
translation_verse: Na nziɛ ye, Yosef bɔ ofi Arimatea, bɔ ɔte Yesu suaniɛ, bɔ Yudafoɛ nwo suronyi ti ɔfeafea ye nwo ɔyɔ sɔ ɔ, ɔɔsrɛle Pilato kyɛ ɔma ye ate ma ɔye Yesu fuin ne, na Pilato mane ye ate. Yiti ɔwale ɔɔyele ye fuin ne.

english_verse: The two men wrapped the body in a linen cloth, together with the spices, which was how the Jewish people buried their dead.
translation_verse: Yeɛ bɛyele Yesu fuin ne, bɛfale ayire ne bɛyɛle ye nwo, na bɛfale nwera ne bɛkyekyele ye nwo, kyɛbɔ Yudafoɛ fuin sielɛ te ɔ.

english_verse: Thomas replied, “You are my Lord and my God!”
translation_verse: Na Tɔmase buale ye kyɛ, “M’Awurade ne me Nyameɛ!”

english_verse: On Sunday morning while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been rolled away from the entrance.
translation_verse: Na dapɛn ne anu kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, ngyerɛmɔ tutuutu bɔ né awosii tɛwɔ nu ne, Maria Magdalene wale asieleɛ ne aso, na onwuni kyɛ baye nyɔboɛ ne bafi asieleɛ ne noa.

english_verse: The disciple who got there first then went into the tomb, and when he saw it, he believed.
translation_verse: Yeɛ suaniɛ ko ne bɔ olili moa wɔ asieleɛ ne aso ne, ye koso owurale nu, na onwuni ye sɔ, na ole lili.

english_verse: Although Thomas the Twin was one of the twelve disciples, he wasn't with the others when Jesus appeared to them.
translation_verse: Na Tɔmase , bɔ ɔte asuafoɛ buru ne nyɔ nemɔ anu ko ne, Yesu wale ne, né ɔnne bɛ nu berɛ bie.

english_verse: and saw two angels inside. They were dressed in white and were sitting where Jesus' body had been. One was at the head and the other was at the foot.
translation_verse: na onwuni abɔfo nyɔ bɔ bewura ndaadeɛ fufue ɔ kyɛ bɛtete berɛ; ko te ye sorɔ, yeɛ ko te ye ngwaen, wɔ nekaa bɔ bɛfale Yesu bɛtole ne.

translation_verse: Pɛntekɔso kyẽa ne dwuli ne, né agyidifoɛ nemɔ amukoraa baboa bɛ noa neka horɛ.

english_verse: Suddenly there was a noise from heaven like the sound of a mighty wind! It filled the house where they were meeting.
translation_verse: Na mvum nu, dede bie bɔ ɔte kyɛ mvrama bɔ ye noa yɛ hye ɔ ofili nyameɛso wale, na ooyili awuro bɔ né bɛwɔ nu ne anu tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit took control of everyone, and they began speaking whatever languages the Spirit let them speak.
translation_verse: Na Sunzum Krongron yili bɛ mukoraa bɛ nu tɛkyɛ, na bɛhyɛle ye bo bedwudwole edwudwolɛ foforɛ biemɔ, kyɛbɔ Sunzum ne fa mane bɛ kyɛ bɛhã ɔ.

english_verse: Many religious Jews from every country in the world were living in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Né Yudafoɛ nyamesurofoɛ biemɔ bɔ befi ewiase maen maen amukoraa nu te Yerusalem.

english_verse: And when they heard this noise, a crowd gathered. But they were surprised, because they were hearing everything in their own languages.
translation_verse: Na bɛtele sɔ dwudwolɛ woo nen, mmenia pee wale beeyiale, na ɔyɛle bɛ nwanwa paa; ofikyɛ bɛ nu biala tele kyɛ agyidifoɛ ne dwudwo wɔ ye bɔbɔ bɔ ótie ne kuro dwudwolɛ nu.

english_verse: They were excited and amazed, and said: Don't all these who are speaking come from Galilee?
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo dwirili bɛ, na ɔyɛle bɛ nwanwa maa bɛhane kyɛ, “Mmenia hemɔ amukoraa bɔ bedwudwo ye, aso bɛtte Galileafoɛ anaa!

english_verse: Then why do we hear them speaking our very own languages?
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛle sɛɛ bɔ yɛ mukoraa yɛte kyɛ bédwudwo wɔ yɛ bɔbɔ yɛ kuro dwudwolɛ nu ye?

english_verse: Some of us are from Parthia, Media, and Elam. Others are from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,
translation_verse: Yɛfi Patia, Medese, ne Elam; Mesopotamia, Yudea, ne Kapadokia; Ponto ne Asia,

english_verse: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, parts of Libya near Cyrene, Rome,
translation_verse: Frigyea ne Pamfilia, Misraim ne Libia aseɛ bɔ opingye Kirene. Yɛ nu biemɔ koso fi Rome,

english_verse: Crete, and Arabia. Some of us were born Jews, and others of us have chosen to be Jews. Yet we all hear them using our own languages to tell the wonderful things God has done.
translation_verse: Yudafoɛ ne Amaenmaensofoɛ bɔ baaboka Yudasom so ɔ, ebiemɔ koso befi Krete ne Arabia, nakoso yɛ mukoraa yɛte kyɛ bɛ́fa yɛ bɔbɔ yɛ dwudwolɛ bɛka Nyameɛ anwanwadwuma bɔ wayɔ ɔ!”

english_verse: Everyone was excited and confused. Some of them even kept asking each other, “What does all this mean?”
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa bɛ nwo dwirili bɛ, na b’adwene yɛle bɛ naa; na bebisabisale bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Na ɛhe bo kyire sɛɛ?”

english_verse: Others made fun of the Lord's followers and said, “They are drunk.” Peter Speaks to the Crowd
translation_verse: Nakoso ebiemɔ koso serele bɛ bɛhane kyɛ, “Nzaa foforɛ yeɛ wabo bɛ ɔ!” Petro ma bɛ mmuayɛɛ

english_verse: Peter stood with the eleven apostles and spoke in a loud and clear voice to the crowd: Friends and everyone else living in Jerusalem, listen carefully to what I have to say!
translation_verse: Petro ne asuafoɛ buru ne ko nemɔ bedwɔsole, na ɔmane ye komvi so dwudwole serɛ hyirele ɛlɔen ne kyɛ, “Yudea mmienzua ne ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔte Yerusalem amukoraa, ɛ́mɔyɛ asoɛ betie me, ná ɛ́mɔma ngyire ɛmɔ ɛhe abo.

english_verse: You are wrong to think that these people are drunk. After all, it is only nine o'clock in the morning.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia hemɔ, nna nzaa yeɛ wabo bɛ kyɛbɔ ɛmɔsusu ne; bekye po yeɛ wabɔ ngyerɛmɔ nnɔngono ɔ.

english_verse: But this is what God told the prophet Joel to say,
translation_verse: Na mmom ɛhe ole bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yowel hane kyɛ,

english_verse: “When the last days come, I will give my Spirit to everyone. Your sons and daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams.
translation_verse: ‘Nyameɛ nwa: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ, ngyẽa bɔ oli nziɛ ne anu, ngohwie me Sunzum ngogua anwoɔnaen amukoraa so, na ɛmɔ mma mmienzua ne ɛmɔ mmrasua kɔhyɛ ngɔm; ɛmɔ mmerandeɛ mɔ konya nyekyire, na ɛmɔ mbanyi mɔ kɔhyehye laleɛ;

english_verse: In those days I will give my Spirit to my servants, both men and women, and they will prophesy.
translation_verse: amba, me ngoaa ne m’afaneɛ mɔ so yeɛ sɔ ngyẽa nemɔ anu ngohwie me Sunzum ngogua ɔ, na bɛkɔhyɛ ngɔm.

english_verse: “I will work miracles in the sky above and wonders on the earth below. There will be blood and fire and clouds of smoke.
translation_verse: Na ngɔma anwanwadeɛ kɔwa nyameɛso wɔ anwuro, yeɛ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ wɔ aseɛ so wɔ ase; mogya, see ne nwosina munguu kɔwa;

english_verse: The sun will turn dark, and the moon will be as red as blood before the great and wonderful day of the Lord appears.
translation_verse: Eyia kɔkakyi awosii, na ɛsraen kɔyɛ kyɛ mogya koraka ná Awurade animnyam kyẽa piri ne awa.

english_verse: Then the Lord will save everyone who asks for his help.”
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔwa kyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔkɔbɔ Awurade dumaa ne, okonya ngoa.’

english_verse: Now, listen to what I have to say about Jesus from Nazareth. God proved he sent Jesus to you by having him work miracles, wonders, and signs. All of you know this.
translation_verse: “Yisraelfoɛ, ɛmɔtie edwirɛ he! Yesu bɔ ofi Nasarɛte ne, ɔte sona bɔ Nyameɛ yele ye tumi ne hyirele ɛmɔ wɔ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ bɔ Nyameɛ fale ye so yɔle, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bɛse ne, ofikyɛ ɛhe amu sili ɛmɔ nyunu.

english_verse: God had already planned and decided that Jesus would be handed over to you. So you took him and had evil men put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Na sɔ Yesu ne, bɛyele ye bɛmane, ɔnate kyɛ né Nyameɛ ayɔ sɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne, yeɛ né koso ɔse sɔ dada. Na ɛmɔfale bɔnefoɛ so bɛbɔle ye mmeamudua nu behuni ye.

english_verse: But God set him free from death and raised him to life. Death could not hold him in its power.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ tingyele ye; olele ye fili ewue sa nu, ofikyɛ ɔyɛ se ma ewue kyɛ okonya ye so tumi ɔ.

english_verse: What David said are really the words of Jesus, “I always see the Lord near me, and I will not be afraid with him at my right side.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ Dawide hane ye nwo dwirɛ kyɛ, ‘Nwuni Awurade wɔ me nyunu mmerɛ biala, ofikyɛ ɔwɔ me sa famaa so, na mengosuro.

english_verse: Because of this, my heart will be glad, my words will be joyful, and I will live in hope.
translation_verse: Yiti m’ahone lili ahurusi, na me temverema nwo sandele ye; na me nwonaen koso kɔla wɔ anyelasoɛ nu.

english_verse: The Lord won't leave me in the grave. I am his holy one, and he won't let my body decay.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛngɔyakyi me kra ma ɔngɔha ɛborɔ, yeɛ ɛngɔma wɔ Krongronniɛ ne ɔngɔporɔ wɔ ngɔporɔ ɛborɔ kumaa nu.

english_verse: He has shown me the path to life, and he makes me glad by being near me.”
translation_verse: Ahyire me ngoa atee; na ɔnate kyɛ ɛne me wɔ berɛ ne ati, ngonya anika mmorosoɛ.’

english_verse: My friends, it is right for me to speak to you about our ancestor David. He died and was buried, and his tomb is still here.
translation_verse: “Aliɛmaa mɔ, odi kyɛ mepakye nu mekã yɛ nana Dawide nwo dwirɛ mekyire ɛmɔ, kyɛ owuli, na besiele ye; na ye asieleɛ wɔ yɛ wa kekesaala ye.

english_verse: But David was a prophet, and he knew that God had made a promise he would not break. He had told David someone from his own family would someday be king.
translation_verse: Né ɔte ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ, na né ɔse kyɛ Nyameɛ ata ndaen wahã wahyire ye kyɛ ɔkɔma ye bosofoɛ nemɔ ko koli ye bia.

english_verse: David knew this would happen, and so he told us Christ would be raised to life. He said God would not leave him in the grave or let his body decay.
translation_verse: Onwuni bɔ kyẽa bie okosi ɔ, yiti ɔhane Kristo wutingyelɛ ne nwo dwirɛ kyɛ, ‘Wanyakyi ye wɔ ɛborɔ; na ye nwonaen amborɔ kumaa nu.’

english_verse: All of us can tell you that God has raised Jesus to life!
translation_verse: “Nyameɛ atingye sɔ Yesu ne wafi ewue nu, na yɛ mukoraa yɛte ɛhe nwo adanzefoɛ.

english_verse: Jesus was taken up to sit at the right side of God, and he was given the Holy Spirit, just as the Father had promised. Jesus is also the one who has given the Spirit to us, and this is what you are now seeing and hearing.
translation_verse: Yiti Nyameɛ mane ye so hɔle ye sa famaa so; na onyane Sunzum Krongron bɔhyɛ ne fili Baba ne berɛ, na ɛhe yeɛ wahwie wagua yɛ so bɔ ɛmɔnwu ye ná ɛmɔte ye.

english_verse: David didn't go up to heaven. So he wasn't talking about himself when he said, “The Lord told my Lord to sit at his right side,
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ nna Dawide yeɛ ɔhɔle nyameɛso ne, na mmom ye bɔbɔ ɔhane kyɛ, ‘Awurade hã hyirele m’Awurade kyɛ: Tena me sa famaa so

english_verse: until he made my Lord's enemies into a footstool for him.”
translation_verse: kɔpem kyɛ ngɔfa wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ ngɔyɛ wɔ gya bo ndiasoɛ ɔ.’

english_verse: Everyone in Israel should then know for certain that God has made Jesus both Lord and Christ, even though you put him to death on a cross.
translation_verse: “Yiti ma Yisrael awuro ama mukoraa benwu ye tofee kyɛ, Yesu he bɔ ɛmɔbɔle ye mmeamudua nu ne ala yeɛ Nyameɛ ayɛ ye Awurade ɔne Kristo ne ɔ.” Agyidifoɛ foforɛ apee nza

english_verse: When the people heard this, they were very upset. They asked Peter and the other apostles, “Friends, what should we do?”
translation_verse: Na bɛtele sɔ dwirɛ ne nen, opusuli bɛ paa, na bebisale Petro ne asomafoɛ ngaa nemɔ kyɛ, “Aliɛmaa mɔ, nzu yeɛ yɛ́yɔ ɔ?”

english_verse: Peter said to them, “Turn to God and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Na Petro buale bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔsakyera ɛmɔ adwene ná ɛ́mɔma bɛbɔ ɛmɔ nu biala asu wɔ Yesu Kristo dumaa nu, ma ɛ́mɔnya bɔnefakyɛ; na ɛmɔkonya Sunzum Krongron akyɛdeɛ ne.

english_verse: This promise is for you and your children. It is for everyone our Lord God will choose, no matter where they live.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ anohoba ne wɔ berɛ ma ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ mma ne bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ dedeede, ɔne ebiala bɔ Awurade, yɛ Nyameɛ, kɔfrɛ ye kɔwa ye berɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Peter told them many other things as well. Then he said, “I beg you to save yourselves from what will happen to all these evil people.”
translation_verse: Na Petro fale edwirɛ tole dwirɛ nwo dwudwole pee, na otuli bɛ foɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo béfi ɛnɛmmafoɛ nzɛmmɔnefoɛ hemɔ anwo!”

english_verse: They spent their time learning from the apostles, and they were like family to each other. They also broke bread and prayed together. Life among the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Na betuli bɛ nwo besiele berɛ besuane asomafoɛ nemɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne b’abiɛngoɛfalɛ ne paanoobubulɛ ne mbaeɛbɔlɛ. Agyidifoɛ nemɔ asetena

english_verse: Everyone was amazed by the many miracles and wonders that the apostles worked.
translation_verse: Asomafoɛ ne yɔle nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ pee, na bɛ nwo yɛle sona biala suro.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers often met together, and they shared everything they had.
translation_verse: Agyidifoɛ ne amukoraa bɛhɔle so beyiale neka horɛ, na ebiala nningyein yɛle obiɛngo deɛ.

english_verse: They would sell their property and possessions and give the money to whoever was in need.
translation_verse: Bɛtɔnene b’agyapadeɛ ne bɛ nwo nningyein, na bɛhyɛle sikaa ne bɛmane ebiala kyɛbɔ ohia ɔ.

english_verse: Day after day they met together in the temple. They broke bread together in different homes and shared their food happily and freely,
translation_verse: Na alehyeleɛ biala, beyiale asɔneyɛɛ sua nu ngabonu nu, belili adi wɔ b’awuro mɔ nu, na bɛfale anigye ne ahone bɔ nu te ɔ bedidili;

english_verse: while praising God. Everyone liked them, and each day the Lord added to their group others who were being saved.
translation_verse: bɛkamvole Nyameɛ, na maen ne anu ama mukoraa hurole bɛ dwirɛ. Alehyeleɛ biala Awurade fale bɛ bɔ olele bɛ ngoa ne bokale bɛ so.

english_verse: The time of prayer was about three o'clock in the afternoon, and Peter and John were going into the temple.
translation_verse: Ɛlɛho bie, ɔbɔle eyia nnɔnmmiɛnza bɔ ɔte dɔnhwere bɔ bɛbɔ mbaeɛ wɔ nu ne, Petro ne Yohane besili nu kyɛ bɛkɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu.

english_verse: A man who had been born lame was being carried to the temple door. Each day he was placed beside this door, known as the Beautiful Gate. He sat there and begged from the people who were going in.
translation_verse: Né ebiemɔ bɛso biaa bie bɔ wabubu fi mmerɛ bɔ bɛwole ye ɔ, bɔ daa biala bɛfa ye bɛbato asɔneyɛɛ sua n’anoa bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Anoa Nyemene ne anyunu berɛ, kyɛ ɔsrɛsrɛ nikyee fi bɛ bɔ bɛkwaawura asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu nemɔ berɛ.

english_verse: The man saw Peter and John entering the temple, and he asked them for money.
translation_verse: Na onwuni Petro ne Yohane kyɛ bɛkɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu nen, ɔsrɛle bɛ kyɛ benwu ye anwumvoin ná bɛto ye sa nu.

english_verse: But they looked straight at him and said, “Look up at us!”
translation_verse: Bɛneane ye haa, na Petro sele ye kyɛ, “Nea yɛ!”

english_verse: The man stared at them and thought he was going to get something.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔneane bɛ haa, na né ɔdwene kyɛ okonya nikyee bie kofi bɛ berɛ.

english_verse: But Peter said, “I don't have any silver or gold! But I will give you what I do have. In the name of Jesus Christ from Nazareth, get up and start walking.”
translation_verse: Na Petro sele ye kyɛ, “Ɛdwetɛ ne sikaa de, nnne bie, na bɔ nne ye ne yeɛ mefa mema wɔ ɔ. Nasarɛteniɛ Yesu Kristo dumaa nu, dwɔso nate!”

english_verse: Peter then took him by the right hand and helped him up. At once the man's feet and ankles became strong,
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔle biaa ne sa famaa ne mane ye so, na berɛ ne ala ye gya nu ne ye aporɛ so yɛle ye se.

english_verse: and he jumped up and started walking. He went with Peter and John into the temple, walking and jumping and praising God.
translation_verse: Ohuru gyinane ye gya so, ɔhyɛle ye bo natele, ɔne bɛ wurale asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, na ohuruhuruli yele Nyameɛ ayɛ.

english_verse: Everyone saw him walking around and praising God.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ né bɛwɔ berɛ ne, benwuni ye kyɛ ɔnate ná ɔye Nyameɛ ayɛ,

english_verse: They knew he was the beggar who had been lying beside the Beautiful Gate, and they were completely surprised. They could not imagine what had happened to the man. Peter Speaks in the Temple
translation_verse: na mmerɛ bɔ benwuni kyɛ ye yeɛ né ɔtena “Anoa Nyemene” ne anu ɔsrɛsrɛ sikaa nen, ɔyɛle bɛ nwanwa, na bɛ nwo dwirili bɛ wɔ ye tebea foforɛ bɔ wahɔ nu ne nwo. Petro ka nzɛmba wɔ Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua nu

english_verse: While the man kept holding on to Peter and John, the whole crowd ran to them in amazement at the place known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Biaa ne te hale Petro ne Yohane so wɔ nekaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ berɛ Solomon Abrannaa nu, na ɔyɛle mmenia ne amu nwanwa; yiti bɛbɔle twi bɛhɔle bɛ nwo berɛ.

english_verse: Peter saw that a crowd had gathered, and he said: Friends, why are you surprised at what has happened? Why are you staring at us? Do you think we have some power of our own? Do you think we were able to make this man walk because we are so religious?
translation_verse: Na Petro nwuni ye sɔ nen, osele ɛlɔen ne kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ, Yisraelfoɛ, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔama ɛhe ayɛ ɛmɔ nwanwa ɔ, anaakyɛ nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔnea yɛ haa ye, kyɛ ebiaa yɛnate yɛ bɔbɔ yɛ tumi ne yɛ tenenee so yeɛ yɛmaa ɔnatele ɔ?

english_verse: The God that Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and our other ancestors worshiped has brought honor to his Servant Jesus. He is the one you betrayed. You turned against him when he was being tried by Pilate, even though Pilate wanted to set him free.
translation_verse: Abraham ne Yisake ne Yakob Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte yɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ ne, ɔhyɛle Ɔwa Yesu animnyam, nakoso ɛmɔyele ye bɛmane mbanyi mɔ, na ɛmɔgyinane Pilato nyunu bɛpole ye wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ahaa né wayɛ ye adwene kyɛ ɔyakyi ye ɔ.

english_verse: You rejected Jesus, who was holy and good. You asked for a murderer to be set free,
translation_verse: Ɛmɔpole Krongronniɛ ne Teneneeniɛ ne, na mmom ɛmɔpale kyerɛ maa bɛyakyili kodiawuniɛ ne bɛmane ɛmɔ.

english_verse: and you killed the one who leads people to life. But God raised him from death, and all of us can tell you what he has done.
translation_verse: Na ngoa Hene ne de, ɛmɔhuni ye; na ye yeɛ Nyameɛ tingyele ye fili awufoɛ nu ɔ, na yɛ yeɛ yɛte ye nwo adanzefoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You see this man, and you know him. He put his faith in the name of Jesus and was made strong. Faith in Jesus made this man completely well while everyone was watching.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate ye dumaa nu, ye dumaa nu gyidie so, yeɛ wama sɔ bubuaniɛ he bɔ ɛmɔnwu ye ná ɛmɔse ye ne wanya anwoserɛ ɔ. Amba, gyidie bɔ ɔnate Yesu so yeɛ wamaa wate apɔ bɔkɔɔ wɔ ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛ nyunu wa ye.

english_verse: My friends, I am sure you and your leaders didn't know what you were doing.
translation_verse: “Na kekesaala ye de, aliɛmaa mɔ, mese kyɛ ɛselɛ bɔ ɛmɔnze ti yeɛ ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ mbanyi mɔ bɛfale sɔ lili ye ɔ.

english_verse: But God had his prophets tell that his Messiah would suffer, and now he has kept this promise.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ ama bɔ ɔfale ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne amu so ha tole berɛ daa tete ne kyɛ ye Kristo ne konwu amaneɛ ne awa nu.

english_verse: So turn to God! Give up your sins, and you will be forgiven.
translation_verse: Sɔ ati ɛmɔsakyera ɛmɔ adwene na ɛmɔbra Nyameɛ berɛ, na ɔkɔfa ɛmɔ bɔne kɔhyɛ ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Then the time will come when the Lord will give you fresh strength. He will send you Jesus, his chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔyɔ sɔ a, sunzum nu anwoserɛ kofi Awurade berɛ kɔwa; na ɔkɔsoma Yesu bɔ ye ole Kristo ne, bɔ waye ye wama ɛmɔ dada ne,

english_verse: But Jesus must stay in heaven until God makes all things new, just as his holy prophets promised long ago.
translation_verse: bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ nyameɛso ode ye kɔpem mmerɛ bɔ bɛkɔhyehyɛ nningyein bɔ Nyameɛ nate ye ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ krongron noa dwirɛ so, fi tetete hane ne amukoraa foforɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Moses said, “The Lord your God will choose one of your own people to be a prophet, just as he chose me. Listen to everything he tells you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Mose hane kyɛ, ‘Awurade, ɛmɔ Nyameɛ kɔsoma ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ko maa ɔkɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ kyɛbɔ wasoma me ne, na sɔ sona ne kɔyɛ ɛmɔ nu ko. Odi kyɛ ɛmɔtie ye na ɛmɔyɔ nikyee biala bɔ ɔkɔha kohyire ɛmɔ ne.

english_verse: No one who disobeys this prophet will be one of God's people any longer.”
translation_verse: Na sona biala bɔ wandie sɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ nen, bɛkɔye ye bekofi Nyameɛ mmenia ne anu, na basɛkye ye.’

english_verse: Samuel and all the other prophets who came later also spoke about what is now happening.
translation_verse: Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ amukoraa bɔ bɛso ngraa fi Samuel aberɛ so, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛwale nziɛ ye ne, bɛbɔle bɔ ɔ́kɔ so ɛnɛ ye anwo dawure.

english_verse: You are really the ones God told his prophets to speak to. And you were given the promise God made to your ancestors. He said to Abraham, “All nations on earth will be blessed because of someone from your family.”
translation_verse: Anohoba bɔ Nyameɛ nate ye ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ so bɔle ne te ɛmɔ deɛ, yeɛ Nyameɛ ne ɛmɔ nana mɔ apam ne koso, ɛmɔboka so, kyɛbɔ ɔha hyirele Abraham kyɛ, ‘Ngɔfa wɔ bosofoɛ so ngoyira ewiase abusua mukoraa.’

english_verse: God sent his chosen Son to you first, because God wanted to bless you and make each one of you turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati, Nyameɛ Somvoɛ bɔ ɔyele ye ne, ɔsomane ye maa olili moa wale ɛmɔ berɛ, kyɛ oyira ɛmɔ na ɔma ebiala hwe ye nwo fi ye bɔne nwo.”

english_verse: The apostles were still talking to the people, when some priests, the captain of the temple guard, and some Sadducees arrived.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ begu so bedwudwo bekyire mmenia nemɔ nen, asɔfo nemɔ ne asɔneyɛɛ sua ne aso safohene ne Sadusiifoɛ nemɔ bɛwale bɛ so.

english_verse: These men were angry because the apostles were teaching the people that the dead would be raised from death, just as Jesus had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Bɛfɛle ɛyaa paa, ofikyɛ né asomafoɛ nyɔ ne yɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ bekyire mmenia nemɔ kyɛ Yesu awu atingye, bɔ odi adanzeɛ koso kyɛ awufoɛ kotingye ɔ.

english_verse: It was already late in the afternoon, and they arrested Peter and John and put them in jail for the night.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati bɛhyele bɛ beeguale kuku nu kyɛ aleɛ kye a yeɛ bɛ ne bɛ koli ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ né aleɛ adwo.

english_verse: But a lot of people who had heard the message believed it. So by now there were about
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛtele edwirɛ ne, bɛ nu pee bele belili, na mmenia ne somaa ɔɔyɛle kɔyɛ apee nnu.

english_verse: The next morning the leaders, the elders, and the teachers of the Law of Moses met in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyene ne, Yuda atitirefoɛ ne maen mbanyi ne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ bɛwale beeyiale wɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: The high priest Annas was there, as well as Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and other members of the high priest's family.
translation_verse: Bɛ ne ɔsɔfo panyi paa Anase, yeɛ Kaifa ne Yohane ne Aleksandro ne bɛ bɔ befi ɔsɔfo panyi paa n’abusua nu amu yeɛ beyiale ɔ.

english_verse: They brought in Peter and John and made them stand in the middle while they questioned them. They asked, “By what power and in whose name have you done this?”
translation_verse: Bɛfale bɛ beegyinane bɛ nyunu berɛ, na bebisale bɛ kyɛ, “Tumi beni yeɛ ɛmɔgyi so, anaa dumaa beni yeɛ ɛmɔfale so bɛyɔle sɔ nikyee ne ɔ?”

english_verse: Peter was filled with the Holy Spirit and told the nation's leaders and the elders:
translation_verse: Na Petro bɔ Sunzum Krongron ayi ye tɛkyɛ ne, obuale bɛ kyɛ, “Maen atitirefoɛ ne mbanyi mɔ,

english_verse: You are questioning us today about a kind deed in which a man who could not walk was healed.
translation_verse: sɛ ɛnɛ ɛmɔbisa yɛ dwirɛ bɛfa bubuaniɛ he anwonyerɛsalɛ nwo, kyɛ atee bɔ ɔfale so tele apɔ nwo a,

english_verse: But there is something we must tell you and everyone else in Israel. This man is standing here completely well because of the power of Jesus Christ from Nazareth. You put Jesus to death on a cross, but God raised him to life.
translation_verse: ye de ɛmɔ amukoraa ne Yisrael maen amukoraa, ɔsɛ kyɛ Nasarɛteniɛ Yesu Kristo bɔ ɛmɔbɔle ye mmeamudua nu, ná Nyameɛ tingyele ye fili awufoɛ nu ne, ye dumaa nu yeɛ wama biaa he bɔ ogyi ɛmɔ nyunu wa ye ye nwo asa ɔ.

english_verse: He is the stone you builders thought was worthless, and now he is the most important stone of all.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ole ‘Nyɔboɛ bɔ ɛmɔ suasilɛfoɛ apo ye, nakoso waayɛ ndweasoɛ nyɔboɛ titire ɔ.’
