english_verse: Only Jesus has the power to save! His name is the only one in all the world that can save anyone.
translation_verse: Na ngoalelɛ nne ebiala nu; ofikyɛ dumaa biala nne nyameɛso bo bɔ bafa bama wɔ adasa mmaa nu bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ bede yɛ ngoa wɔ nu ɔ.”

english_verse: The officials were amazed to see how brave Peter and John were, and they knew that these two apostles were only ordinary men and not well educated. The officials were certain these men had been with Jesus.
translation_verse: Na benwuni kyɛ Petro ne Yohane b’ahone yɛ se, ná besa benwuni kyɛ bɛte kwahweabaa mɔ bɔ bɛnze nwomaa nen, ɔyɛle bɛ nwanwa; na afei benwuni kyɛ bɛne Yesu yeɛ bɛnatele ɔ.

english_verse: But they could not deny what had happened. The man who had been healed was standing there with the apostles.
translation_verse: Na benwuni biaa bɔ wate apɔ bɔ ogyi bɛ nwo berɛ nen, bannya edwirɛ biala banga bandia bɛ.

english_verse: The officials commanded them to leave the council room. Then the officials said to each other,
translation_verse: Yiti bɛmaa bɛhwene bɛ nwo befili badwa nu berɛ bɛhɔle ahameɛ, na bɛhɔle agyina

english_verse: “What can we do with these men? Everyone in Jerusalem knows about this miracle, and we cannot say it didn't happen.
translation_verse: bebisale bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Mmenia hemɔ koraa, nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛ́fa yɛ́yɛ bɛ ɔ? Ofikyɛ wala ali wɔ ebiala bɔ ɔwɔ Yerusalem ɔ nyunu kyɛ ɔnate bɛ so yeɛ sɛngyerɛnneɛ sonongo he wasi ɔ, na yɛngɔhora yɛngɔkata so.

english_verse: But to keep this thing from spreading, we will warn them never again to speak to anyone about the name of Jesus.”
translation_verse: Na kyɛ ɔkɔyɛ ná edwirɛ ne ngotene maen ne anu ne, ɛ́mɔma yɛbɔ bɛ kɔkɔ kyɛ nnɛmaa bɛbɔ Yesu dumaa bɛka edwirɛ bekyire ebiala ko.”

english_verse: So they called the two apostles back in and told them they must never, for any reason, teach anything about the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛfrɛle bɛ maa besa bɛwale dwaa ne anu, na bɛberale bɛ kitii kyɛ atee biala nne berɛ kyɛ bekodwudwo anaakyɛ bɛkɔyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ wɔ Yesu dumaa nu ɔ.

english_verse: Peter and John answered, “Do you think God wants us to obey you or to obey him?
translation_verse: Na Petro ne Yohane buale bɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ ɔte paa wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu kyɛ yɛtie ɛmɔ yɛtra Nyameɛ a, nzaade ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛ́mbua;

english_verse: We cannot keep quiet about what we have seen and heard.”
translation_verse: ɔnate kyɛ, bɔ yɛ yanwu ye ná yate ne de, yɛngɔhora yɛngɔyakyi ye hanɛ.”

english_verse: The officials could not find any reason to punish Peter and John. So they threatened them and let them go. The man who was healed by this miracle was more than
translation_verse: Biaa bɔ ɔnate anwanwadeɛ he aso nyane ayaresa nen, né ɔbo afoɛ aburanna. Agyidifoɛ bɔ mbaeɛ srɛ anwoserɛ

english_verse: As soon as Peter and John had been set free, they went back and told the others everything the chief priests and the leaders had said to them.
translation_verse: Bɛyakyili Petro ne Yohane nene, besa bɛwale bɛ mmango nemɔ berɛ, na bɛhane bɔ asɔfo mbanyi ne maen mbanyi nemɔ bɛhane ne amukoraati behyirele bɛ.

english_verse: When the rest of the Lord's followers heard this, they prayed together and said: Master, you created heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them.
translation_verse: Na bɛtele sɔ dwirɛ nen, bɛyɛle ko bɛmane bɛ komvi so bɛbɔle mbaeɛ behyirele Nyameɛ kyɛ, “Awurade Nyameɛ bɔ ɛbɔle anwuro ne aseɛ ne ɛpo ne bɔ ɔwɔ bɛ nu amukoraa ɔ,

english_verse: And by the Holy Spirit you spoke to our ancestor David. He was your servant, and you told him to say: “Why are all the Gentiles so furious? Why do people make foolish plans?
translation_verse: wɔ bɔ ɛnate Sunzum Krongron so edwudwo fale yɛ nana Dawide bɔ ɔte wɔ somvoɛ ne so kyɛ, ‘Nzu ati yeɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ bɛfɛ yaa hahii, ná maen maen mɔ bɛyɛ nzusuleɛ mbaen ɔ?

english_verse: The kings of earth prepare for war, and the rulers join together against the Lord and his Messiah.”
translation_verse: Aseɛ so ahemvo mɔ besiesie bɛ nwo bɛma koɛ, na atitirefoɛ beyia neka horɛ bedwɔso betia Awurade ne ye Kristo ne.’

english_verse: Here in Jerusalem, Herod and Pontius Pilate got together with the Gentiles and the people of Israel. Then they turned against your holy Servant Jesus, your chosen Messiah.
translation_verse: Ɔte nahorɛ, Herode ne Pontio Pilato ne Amaenmaensofoɛ ne Yisrael maen beyiale sɔ kuro he anu bɛbɔle wɔ Ɛwa Krongron Yesu bɔ apopa ye ngoo ne ti so porɛ.

english_verse: They did what you in your power and wisdom had already decided would happen.
translation_verse: Beyiale nu bɛfale adwene bɛyɔle nikyee biala kyɛbɔ wɔ tumi ne wɔ nhyehyɛleɛ aha ato berɛ kyɛ okosi ne.

english_verse: Lord, listen to their threats! We are your servants. So make us brave enough to speak your message.
translation_verse: Awurade, kekesaala ye de, nea b’anwunanwuna ye ná ma wɔ ngoaa ahoneserɛ bɔ yɛkɔfa yɛkɔhã wɔ dwirɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: Show your mighty power, as we heal people and work miracles and wonders in the name of your holy Servant Jesus.
translation_verse: Kyire wɔ tumi wɔ anwonyerɛsalɛ nu na boka maa yɛgyina wɔ Somvoɛ Krongron Yesu dumaa nu yɛyɔ anwanwadeɛ ne nzɛngyerɛnneɛ.”

english_verse: After they had prayed, the meeting place shook. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and bravely spoke God's message. Sharing Possessions
translation_verse: Beyiele mbaeɛ ne bɔ nen, nekaa bɔ beyiale ne wosole. Sunzum Krongron yili bɛ tɛkyɛ, na bɛfale ahoneserɛ bɛbɔle Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne dawure. Agyidifoɛ kyɛ bɛ nningyein ma bɛ nwo

english_verse: The group of followers all felt the same way about everything. None of them claimed that their possessions were their own, and they shared everything they had with each other.
translation_verse: Agyidifoɛ fekue ne mane b’adwene yɛle ko. Ebiala le tole nu kyɛ ye nikyee biala bɔ ole ye ne ɔtte ye ngome ye deɛ, na mmom ɔte ebiala bɔ ɔwɔ fekue ne anu deɛ.

english_verse: In a powerful way the apostles told everyone that the Lord Jesus was now alive. God greatly blessed his followers,
translation_verse: Asomafoɛ ne fale tumi so lili Awurade Yesu wutingyelɛ ne nwo adanzeɛ, na Nyameɛ hwiele adom pee guale bɛ mukoraa so.

english_verse: and no one went in need of anything. Everyone who owned land or houses would sell them and bring the money
translation_verse: Bɛ nu biala nne berɛ bɔ nikyee hiane ye ɔ, ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bele aseɛ mɔ ne sua mɔ ne, bɛtɔnetɔnene bɛ, na bɛfale sikaa bɔ benya befili nu ne

english_verse: to the apostles. Then they would give the money to anyone in need.
translation_verse: bɛbrɛle asomafoɛ ne; na bɛ koso bɛhyɛ bɛmane ebiala nyane bie, kyɛbɔ ohia ɔ.

english_verse: Ananias and his wife Sapphira also sold a piece of property.
translation_verse: Na biaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Anania ne ɔye Safira bɛtɔnene b’agyapadeɛ.

english_verse: But they agreed to cheat and keep some of the money for themselves. So when Ananias took the rest of the money to the apostles,
translation_verse: Ɔne ɔye bɛyɛle adwene ko, na biaa ne fale sikaa bɔ benyane ne bie feale; yeɛ ɔfale ye ngaa ne brɛle asomafoɛ nemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Peter said, “Why has Satan made you keep back some of the money from the sale of the property? Why have you lied to the Holy Spirit?
translation_verse: Na Petro bisale ye kyɛ, “Anania, nzu ati yeɛ ama abɔnzam ate maa walakalaka wɔ maa ali Sunzum Krongron ne ndurum, na afa aseɛ bɔ ɛtɔnene ne sikaa ne bie afea ɔ?

english_verse: The property was yours before you sold it, and even after you sold it, the money was still yours. What made you do such a thing? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God!”
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né ennya ɛttɔnene ye nen, aso né ɔtte wɔ deɛ? Na ɛtɔnene ye yiele ne koso, esikaa ne aso ɔtte wɔ deɛ? Na ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ afa sɔ adwene he ɔ? Nna kuro sona, na Nyameɛ mmom yeɛ ali ye ndurum ɔ.”

english_verse: As soon as Ananias heard this, he dropped dead, and everyone who heard about it was frightened.
translation_verse: Anania tele sɔ dwirɛ ne pɛ, ɔpɛ fini, na owuli berɛ ne ala; na bɛ bɔ bɛtele ne amu besurole.

english_verse: Some young men came in and wrapped up his body. Then they took it out and buried it.
translation_verse: Na mmerandeɛ ne dwɔsole bɛfale nikyee bɛkyekyele ye nwo, na bɛfale ye befitele beesiele ye.

english_verse: Three hours later Sapphira came in, but she did not know what had happened to her husband.
translation_verse: Kɔyɛ dɔnhwere nza asi ne, ɔye ne koso wale; né ɔttele bɔ wato ohu ne nwo hwee.

english_verse: Peter asked her, “Tell me, did you sell the property for this amount?” “Yes,” she answered, “that's the amount.”
translation_verse: Na Petro sele ye kyɛ, “Ka nahorɛ kyire me, ɛmɔtɔnene ɛmɔ aseɛ nen, esikaa bɔ ɛmɔnyane hɔ ɛhe?” Na braa ne buale ye kyɛ, “Yoo, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛnyane ɔ.”

english_verse: Then Peter said, “Why did the two of you agree to test the Lord's Spirit? The men who buried Ananias are by the door, and they will carry you out!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ Petro sele ye kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔahã ɛmɔ ti bapura kyɛ ɛmɔso Awurade Sunzum ne bɛnea ɔ? Nea, mmenia bɔ besiele ehu ne bɛwɔ anoanu berɛ, na bɛkɔsoa wɔ koso bekofi wa bɛkɔhɔ.”

english_verse: At once she fell at Peter's feet and died. When the young men came back in, they found Sapphira lying there dead. So they carried her out and buried her beside her husband.
translation_verse: Na berɛ ne ala, ɔpɛ fini ye nyunu berɛ wuli. Na mmerandeɛ nemɔ besa bɛwale ne, benwuni kyɛ ye koso wawu; yiti bɛmane ye so bɛhɔle, na besiele ye ohu ne nwo berɛ.

english_verse: The church members were afraid, and so was everyone else who heard what had happened. Peter's Unusual Power
translation_verse: Na esuronyi pirikua hane asɔre mma ne amu ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛtele edwirɛ ne amukoraa. Nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ

english_verse: The apostles worked many miracles and wonders among the people. All of the Lord's followers often met in the part of the temple known as Solomon's Porch.
translation_verse: Na nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ pee fale asomafoɛ nemɔ so lale ali wɔ maen ne anu. Né bɛ mukoraa bayɛ adwene ko bayia nu wɔ Solomon Abrannaa so.

english_verse: Many men and women started having faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmienzua ne mmrasua pee bɔ belele Awurade belili ne hɔle so bokale agyidifoɛ fekue ne aso.

english_verse: Then sick people were brought out to the road and placed on mats. It was hoped that Peter would walk by, and his shadow would fall on them and heal them.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate bɔ né asomafoɛ nemɔ bɛyɔ ne ati, mmenia soale ayarefoɛ bɛwale dwaaso, na bɛfale bɛ beguale mba ne bɛen so, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná Petro pɛ nu a, ye wawoɛ kɔtɔ bɛ nu bie so ɔ.

english_verse: A lot of people living in the towns near Jerusalem brought those who were sick or troubled by evil spirits, and they were all healed. Trouble for the Apostles
translation_verse: Na nguro bɔ bapɛ Yerusalem nwo bayia ne, bɛ nu mmenia pee fale b’ayarefoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bele sunzummɔne ɔ bɛwale, na bɛ mukoraa bɛtele apɔ. Bɛtane asomafoɛ ne nye

english_verse: They arrested the apostles and put them in the city jail.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ati, bɛhyehyele asomafoɛ nemɔ, na bɛfale bɛ beguale kuku nu.

english_verse: But that night an angel from the Lord opened the doors of the jail and led the apostles out. The angel said,
translation_verse: Nakoso kɔngɔen ne, Awurade abɔfo wale oobukyele kuku nu anoa nemɔ, na ɔyele bɛ fili kuku nu berɛ fitele, na osele kyɛ,

english_verse: “Go to the temple and tell the people everything about this new life.”
translation_verse: “Ɛmɔhɔ beegyina asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, ná ɛmɔbɔ sɔ ngoa foforɛ he amukoraa nwo dawure behyire mmenia.”

english_verse: So they went into the temple before sunrise and started teaching. The high priest and his men called together their council, which included all of Israel's leaders. Then they ordered the apostles to be brought to them from the jail.
translation_verse: Na bɛtele sɔ dwirɛ nen, bɛhɔle asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu alebahyene, bɛɛyɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ. Na ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛboka ye so ne wale, na bɛtole asaa bɛfrɛle badwafoɛ nemɔ ne Yisrael mbanyi mukoraa maa beyiale, na bɛsomane mmenia kyɛ bɛɛye asomafoɛ ne befi kuku nu dɔ bɛbra.

english_verse: The temple police who were sent to the jail did not find the apostles. They returned and said,
translation_verse: Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua nu awɛmvoɛ nemɔ dwuli berɛ nen, bannwu bɛ wɔ kuku nu berɛ; na besa bɛwale badwafoɛ ne berɛ beesele bɛ kyɛ,

english_verse: “We found the jail locked tight and the guards standing at the doors. But when we opened the doors and went in, we didn't find anyone there.”
translation_verse: “Yɛnwuni kyɛ batoto kuku nu anoa nemɔ anu yé, bɔ asraafoɛ begyigyi anoa nemɔ asi ɔ; nakoso yɛbukyele nen, yannwu sona biala wɔ nu!”

english_verse: The captain of the temple police and the chief priests listened to their report, but they did not know what to think about it.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua nu safohene ne ne asɔfo mbanyi nemɔ tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, bɛyɛle basaa; né bɛngora benwu nikye horɛ bɔ wato asomafoɛ nemɔ ɔ, ɔne edwirɛ bɔ ɔkɔwa ye si ɔ.

english_verse: Just then someone came in and said, “Now those men you put in jail are in the temple, teaching the people!”
translation_verse: Yeɛ ebie wale badwafoɛ ne berɛ ɔɔbɔle bɛ amaneɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔtie! Mmenia nemɔ bɔ ɛmɔhyele bɛ beguale kuku nu nen, begyigyi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu dɔ bɛyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ bekyire mmenia.”

english_verse: The captain went with some of the temple police and brought the apostles back. But they did not use force. They were afraid that the people might start throwing stones at them.
translation_verse: Yeɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua so safohene ne ne ye asraafoɛ nemɔ hɔle bɛɛfale asomafoɛ nemɔ bɛwale. Banyɔ ye patapaa so, ofikyɛ né besuro kyɛ mmenia kɔboro bɛ nyɔboɛ. Asomafoɛ nemɔ gyi Yuda badwa nyunu

english_verse: When the apostles were brought before the council, the high priest said to them,
translation_verse: Bɛfale asomafoɛ ne bɛwale maa beegyinane dwaa bɔ babɔ ne anu, na ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne sele bɛ kyɛ,

english_verse: “We told you plainly not to teach in the name of Jesus. But look what you have done! You have been teaching all over Jerusalem, and you are trying to blame us for his death.”
translation_verse: “Aso yammera ɛmɔ kitii kyɛ nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ wɔ sɔ sona he dumaa nu anaa? Nakoso ɛmɔama ɛmɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne ato apete Yerusalem amukoraa, na ɛmɔpena kyɛ bɛma sɔ sona he wue ne bɔ yɛ ti so!”

english_verse: Peter and the apostles replied: We don't obey people. We obey God.
translation_verse: Yeɛ Petro ne asomafoɛ ngaa ne buale kyɛ, “Ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛtie Nyameɛ yɛtra kuro sona.

english_verse: You killed Jesus by nailing him to a cross. But the God our ancestors worshiped raised him to life
translation_verse: Yɛ nana mɔ Nyameɛ tingyele Yesu bɔ ɛmɔbɔle ye mmeamudua nu behuni ye ne fili ewue nu.

english_verse: and made him our Leader and Savior. Then God gave him a place at his right side, so that the people of Israel would turn back to him and be forgiven.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ Nyameɛ mane ye so siele ye sa famaa so bɔle ye panyi, na ɔyɛle ye Ngoadefoɛ kyɛ ohyire Yisrael maen atee ma benya adwenesakyera na banya bɔnefakyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: We are here to tell you about all this, and so is the Holy Spirit, who is God's gift to everyone who obeys God.
translation_verse: Na yɛne Sunzum Krongron ne bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ akyɛdeɛ ma bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ sotie bɛma Nyameɛ ne yɛte edwirɛ he nwo adanzefoɛ.” Gamaliɛl tu badwafoɛ nemɔ foɛ

english_verse: When the council members heard this, they became so angry they wanted to kill the apostles.
translation_verse: Na bɛtele sɔ dwirɛ nen, b’ahone huli, na bɛbɔle porɛ kyɛ bekohũ asomafoɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: But one of the members was the Pharisee Gamaliel, a highly respected teacher. He ordered the apostles to be taken out of the room for a little while.
translation_verse: Na badwafoɛ nemɔ anu ko dwɔsole. Ɔte Farasiiniɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Gamaliɛl. Né ɔte mmeraa kyerɛkyerɛniɛ bɔ maen ne anu ama mukoraa bebu ye ɔ; na ɔmaa bɛfale asomafoɛ nemɔ befitele kãa.

english_verse: Then he said to the council: Men of Israel, be careful what you do with these men.
translation_verse: Na osele badwafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Yisraelfoɛ, ɛ́mɔnea yé wɔ nikyee bɔ ɛmɔpena kyɛ ɛmɔfa bɛyɛ sɔ mmenia hemɔ ne anwo.

english_verse: Later, when the people of our nation were being counted, Judas from Galilee showed up. A lot of people followed him, but he was killed, and all his followers were scattered.
translation_verse: Ɛhe asi ne, Yudase bɔ ofi Galilea wale wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né bɛka mmenia ɔ, ɔhwene ɛlɔen lili ye si, na ye koso behuni ye, na ye mmenia bɔ beli ye si ne bɔle aya.

english_verse: So I advise you to stay away from these men. Leave them alone. If what they are planning is something of their own doing, it will fail.
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ mekã mekyire ɛmɔ ɛhe: Nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ nikye fee betia sɔ mmenia hemɔ; ɛ́mɔyakyi bɛ. Ofikyɛ sɛ bɛ nhyehyɛleɛ he anaa b’adwuma he ofi mmenia berɛ a, ongogyina.

english_verse: But if God is behind it, you cannot stop it anyway, unless you want to fight against God. The council members agreed with what he said,
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ofi Nyameɛ berɛ a, ɛmɔngɔhora bengogu ye, na sɛ ɛmɔannea yé a, Nyameɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkɔho bekotia ye ɔ.”

english_verse: and they called the apostles back in. They had them beaten with a whip and warned them not to speak in the name of Jesus. Then they let them go.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛfale ye foɛtulɛ ne. Na bɛfale asomafoɛ nemɔ besa bɛwale badwa nu berɛ nen, befini bɛ mbire, na bɛkanzole bɛ kitii kyɛ nnɛma bedwudwo wɔ Yesu dumaa nu, na bɛyakyili bɛ maa bɛhɔle.

english_verse: The apostles left the council and were happy, because God had considered them worthy to suffer for the sake of Jesus.
translation_verse: Na bele anigye befili badwa nu berɛ bɛhɔle, kyɛ babu bɛ kyɛ bɛfata kyɛ Yesu dumaa ti animguaseɛ ɔto bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Every day they spent time in the temple and in one home after another. They never stopped teaching and telling the good news that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Na alehyeleɛ biala, bɛhɔle asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu ne awuro awuro mɔ nu bɛyɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ, na bɛhane Yesu nwo nzɛmba kyɛ ye ole Kristo ne.

english_verse: A lot of people were now becoming followers of the Lord. But some of the ones who spoke Greek started complaining about the ones who spoke Aramaic. They complained that the Greek-speaking widows were not given their share when the food supplies were handed out each day.
translation_verse: Na sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, bɔ né asuafoɛ nemɔ bɛ́kɔ so bɛ́sone pee ne, Helafoɛ nemɔ bɛyɛlɛ nwuhunwuhu betiale Hebrifoɛ nemɔ, ofikyɛ né bebu bɛ nye begua Helafoɛ akunafoɛ mmrasua mɔ so, sɛ ɔba daa biala nningyein hyɛlɛ nu a.

english_verse: The twelve apostles called the whole group of followers together and said, “We should not give up preaching God's message in order to serve at tables.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ati, asomafoɛ buru ne nyɔ nemɔ bɛfrɛle asuafoɛ kure ne maa beeyiale, na besele bɛ kyɛ, “Onhia kyɛ yɛyakyi Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne hanɛ yɛto berɛ, ná yɛfa aleɛhyɛlɛ yɛyɛ yɛ adwuma ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, choose seven men who are respected and wise and filled with God's Spirit. We will put them in charge of these things.
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔye ɛmɔ nu mmienzua nzoo bɔ ebiala bu bɛ, nworɛfoɛ bɔ Sunzum Krongron ayi bɛ tɛkyɛ, na yɛfa bɛ yɛsie sɔ adwuma he noa,

english_verse: We can spend our time praying and serving God by preaching.”
translation_verse: na yɛ koso yanya mmerɛ yatu yɛ nwo yasie berɛ yama mbaeɛbɔlɛ ne nzɛmbahanɛ.”

english_verse: This suggestion pleased everyone, and they began by choosing Stephen. He had great faith and was filled with the Holy Spirit. Then they chose Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and also Nicolaus, who worshiped with the Jewish people in Antioch.
translation_verse: Asomafoɛ nemɔ nzusuleɛ ne yɛle agyidifoɛ ne amu fɛ, yiti bɛyele Setefano bɔ gyidie ne Sunzum Krongron ayi ye tɛkyɛ, Filipo, Prokoro, Nikanɔ, Timon, Pamena yeɛ Amaenmaensoniɛ Nikolao bɔ ofi Antiokia ná koso wasɔ Yudasom nu ɔ.

english_verse: These men were brought to the apostles. Then the apostles prayed and placed their hands on the men to show they had been chosen to do this work.
translation_verse: Bɛmaa beegyinane asomafoɛ ne nyunu berɛ, na bɛfale bɛ sa beguale bɛ so bɛbɔle mbaeɛ bɛmane bɛ.

english_verse: God's message spread, and many more people in Jerusalem became followers. Even a large number of priests put their faith in the Lord. Stephen Is Arrested
translation_verse: Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne hɔle so trɛle; agyidifoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Yerusalem yɛle pee; asa koso Yuda asɔfo pee bɛɛbokale agyidifoɛ nemɔ aso. Bɛhyele Setefano

english_verse: God gave Stephen the power to work great miracles and wonders among the people.
translation_verse: Setefano bɔ adom ne tumi ayi ye tɛkyɛ ne yɔle nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ wɔ maen ne anu.

english_verse: But some men from Cyrene and Alexandria were members of a group who called themselves “Free Men.” They started arguing with Stephen. Some others from Cilicia and Asia also argued with him.
translation_verse: Na mmenia bie bɔ banya fawɔnwodi bafi ngoaasolɛ nu, na bɛtaa bɛkɔ nyianu sua nu ne, bɛ ne ye amva anyeɛ. Sɔ mmenia ne te Yudafoɛ bɔ befi Kirene ne Aleksandria, na ebiemɔ koso te Yudafoɛ bɔ befi Kilikia ne Asia, na bɛhyɛle ye bo bɛ ne Setefano suli aporowaa.

english_verse: But they were no match for Stephen, who spoke with the great wisdom that the Spirit gave him.
translation_verse: Nakoso bangora bangyina nworɛ ne sunzum bɔ Setefano fa dwudwole ne noa.

english_verse: So they talked some men into saying, “We heard Stephen say terrible things against Moses and God!”
translation_verse: Yiti bɛpesa bewurale mmenia biemɔ noa maa bɛhane kyɛ, “Yɛtele kyɛ ɔkã musue dwirɛ otia Mose ne Nyameɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: They turned the people and their leaders and the teachers of the Law of Moses against Stephen. Then they all grabbed him and dragged him in front of the council.
translation_verse: Na besili maen ne ne maen mbanyi ne ahyerɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ adua, na bɛwale ye so bɛɛhyele ye, na bɛfale ye bɛhɔle badwa ne anyunu.

english_verse: Some men agreed to tell lies about Stephen, and they said, “This man keeps on saying terrible things about this holy temple and the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Na bɛmane adanzewiafoɛ beegyinane berɛ bɛhane kyɛ, “Sɔ biaa he, ɔnyakyi musue dwirɛ bɔ ɔkekã tia nekaa krongron he ne mmeraa ne;

english_verse: We have heard him claim that Jesus from Nazareth will destroy this place and change the customs Moses gave us.”
translation_verse: ofikyɛ yɛtele kyɛ ɔkã kyɛ sɔ Yesu ne bɔ ofi Nasarɛte ne, okodwiri ɛwa kogua, ná wasa wasesã amanneɛ bɔ Mose hyehyɛle mane yɛ ne!”

english_verse: Then all the council members stared at Stephen. They saw that his face looked like the face of an angel.
translation_verse: Badwafoɛ ne amukoraa neane Setefano haa, na benwuni kyɛ ye nyunu ayɛ kyɛ abɔfo nyunu.

english_verse: The high priest asked Stephen, “Are they telling the truth about you?”
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne bisale kyɛ, “Aso ɛhemɔ te nahorɛ?”

english_verse: Stephen answered: Friends, listen to me. Our glorious God appeared to our ancestor Abraham while he was still in Mesopotamia, before he had moved to Haran.
translation_verse: Na Setefano buale kyɛ, “Aliɛmaa mɔ ne me baba mɔ, ɛ́mɔtie me! Animnyam Nyameɛ ne ɔyele ye nwo ali hyirele yɛ nana Abraham mmerɛ bɔ né ɔwɔ Mesopotamia ne, koraka yeɛ ɔbaahɔ kɔtena Haran ɔ,

english_verse: God told him, “Leave your country and your relatives and go to a land that I will show you.”
translation_verse: na ɔhã hyirele ye kyɛ, ‘Fi w’aseɛ so ne w’abusua nu tu kɔ aseɛ bɔ mebaahyire wɔ ne aso!’

english_verse: Then Abraham left the land of the Chaldeans and settled in Haran. After his father died, Abraham came and settled in this land where you now live.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati Abraham tu fili Kaldeafoɛ aseɛ so ɔɔtenane Haran. Ye baba wue asi ne, Nyameɛ maa ofili berɛ ɔɔtenane aseɛ he bɔ ɛnɛ ɛmɔte so ye aso.

english_verse: God didn't give him any part of it, not even a square meter. But God did promise to give it to him and his family forever, even though Abraham didn't have any children.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ amva aseɛ ne nekaa biala wamma Abraham bɔ okyire kyɛ ye deɛ ɔ, aseɛ agyirɛ ko po wamma ye; nakoso Nyameɛ bɔle ye anohoba kyɛ ɔkɔfa kɔma ye, na ɔkɔyɛ ye ne ye bosofoɛ deɛ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ né onnya ɔwwole baa biala.

english_verse: God said Abraham's descendants would live for a while in a foreign land. There they would be slaves and would be mistreated
translation_verse: Na bɔ Nyameɛ hã hyirele ye hɔ ɛhe: ‘Wɔ bosofoɛ kɔyɛ ɛwɔfoɛ wɔ amanvoɛ maen so, na bɛkɔfa bɛ kɔyɛ ngoaa na bahyɛ bɛ anyeborolɛ afoɛ ɛyaa nna.

english_verse: But he also said, “I will punish the nation that makes them slaves. Then later they will come and worship me in this place.”
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ wɔ bosofoɛ nemɔ kɔso bɛ ne, ngobua sɔ mmenia ne ndɛen, na ɛhe asi ne, wɔ bosofoɛ bekofi sɔ maen ne anu bɛkɔɔsɔne me wɔ wa.’

english_verse: God said to Abraham, “Every son in each family must be circumcised to show you have kept your agreement with me.” So when Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him. Later, Isaac circumcised his son Jacob, and Jacob circumcised his twelve sons.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ɔmane Abraham bienzuapɛlɛ apam. Na Abraham wole Yisake, na olili ɛlɛbɔtwɛ nen, ɔpɛle ye bienzua; Yisake wole Yakob, yeɛ Yakob wole yɛ nana mbanyi buru ne nyɔ nemɔ.

english_verse: These men were our ancestors. Joseph was also one of our famous ancestors. His brothers were jealous of him and sold him as a slave to be taken to Egypt. But God was with him
translation_verse: “Na ɔnate kyɛ né Yakob mma ne nye boro b’eliɛma Yosef ne ati, bɛtɔnene ye maa ɔɔyɛle akoaa wɔ Misraim. Nakoso Nyameɛ gyinane ye si,

english_verse: and rescued him from all his troubles. God made him so wise that the Egyptian king Pharaoh thought highly of him. The king even made Joseph governor over Egypt and put him in charge of everything he owned.
translation_verse: ɔyele ye fili ye amaneɛnwunɛ amukoraa nu. Ɔmane ye adom ne nworɛ wɔ Misraim hene Faro nyunu, na ɛhene ne fale ye sili Misraim ne ye awuro so amukoraa amrado.

english_verse: Everywhere in Egypt and Canaan the grain crops failed. There was terrible suffering, and our ancestors could not find enough to eat.
translation_verse: Afei ɛhɔen piri bie wale Misraim ne Kanaan aseɛ so amukoraa, bɔ ɔfale anwokyere pirikua wale ɔ; na yɛ nana mɔ bannya aleɛ nekaa biala.

english_verse: But when Jacob heard there was grain in Egypt, he sent our ancestors there for the first time.
translation_verse: Na Yakob tele kyɛ aleɛ wɔ Misraim nen, olili moa somane yɛ nana mɔ maa bɛhɔle dɔ.

english_verse: It was on their second trip that Joseph told his brothers who he was, and the king learned about Joseph's family.
translation_verse: Bɛ hɔlɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne aso, Yosef lale ye nwo ali hyirele oliɛma nemɔ, na Faro koso nwuni Yosef abusuafoɛ.

english_verse: Joseph sent for his father and his relatives. In all, there were
translation_verse: Na Yosef fale ngraa maa beesele ye baba Yakob ne ye abusuafoɛ ne amukoraa kyɛ bɛbra. Né bɛ mukoraa bɛte aburasoo ne nnu.

english_verse: His father went to Egypt and died there, just as our ancestors did.
translation_verse: Yiti Yakob hɔle Misraim; na berɛ yeɛ owuli ɔ, ɔne yɛ nana nemɔ.

english_verse: Later their bodies were taken back to Shechem and placed in the tomb that Abraham had bought from the sons of Hamor.
translation_verse: Bɛfale Yakob ne Yosef fuin ne besa bɛwale Sɛkem beesiele bɛ wɔ asieleɛ bɔ Abraham fale ɛdwetɛ ɔtɔ fili Hamɔ mma nemɔ berɛ wɔ Sɛkem ne anu.

english_verse: Finally, the time came for God to do what he had promised Abraham. By then the number of our people in Egypt had greatly increased.
translation_verse: “Mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ anohoba bɔ ɔbɔle Abraham pingyele nen, né yɛ mmenia bɔ bɛwɔ Misraim ne asone pee,

english_verse: Another king was ruling Egypt, and he didn't know anything about Joseph.
translation_verse: maa oodwuli kyɛ ɛhene bie bɔ ɔnze Yosef wale oolili Misraim so.

english_verse: He tricked our ancestors and was cruel to them. He even made them leave their babies outside, so they would die.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔfale nnakannaka atee so hyɛle yɛ mmenia nemɔ so ɔ; na ɔhyɛle yɛ nana mɔ ma bɛtotole bɛ mma nnɔma mɔ beguale, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ bekowuwu ɔ.

english_verse: During this time Moses was born. He was a very beautiful child, and for three months his parents took care of him in their home.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne yeɛ bɛwole Mose ɔ. na né ye nwo yɛ nyeme, na Nyameɛ hurole ye dwirɛ. Na bɛneane ye bosome nza wɔ ye baba awuro.

english_verse: Then when they were forced to leave him outside, the king's daughter found him and raised him as her own son.
translation_verse: Na bɛyele ye befitele bɛɛyakyili ye nekaa bie nen, Faro awa brasua hɔle ɔɔfale ye tetele ye ɔfale ye yɛle ɔwa.

english_verse: Moses was given the best education in Egypt. He was a strong man and a powerful speaker.
translation_verse: Bɛfale Misraim nworɛ amukoraa yeɛ bɛtetele Mose ɔ, na onyane nimdeɛ wɔ ye dwudwolɛ ne ye brabɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: One day he saw an Egyptian mistreating one of them. So he rescued the man and killed the Egyptian.
translation_verse: Onwuni kyɛ Misraimniɛ ɔhyɛ Yisraelniɛ so anyeborolɛ so, yiti ɔɔbokale bɔ bɛ́hyɛ ye so ne, na ɔyɔle bie tuale Misraimniɛ ne kerɛ huni ye.

english_verse: Moses thought the rest of his people would realize God was going to use him to set them free. But they didn't understand.
translation_verse: Né Mose dwene kyɛ ye bɔbɔ ye mmenia nemɔ konwu ye kyɛ Nyameɛ baafa ye so ode bɛ, nakoso bannwu ye sɔ.

english_verse: The next day Moses saw two of his own people fighting, and he tried to make them stop. He said, “Men, you are both Israelites. Why are you so cruel to each other?”
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyene ne, onwuni Yisraelfoɛ nyɔ kyɛ bɛko; ɔyɛle kyɛ ɔpata bɛ, na osele bɛ kyɛ, ‘O, biamɔ adwo! Ɛmɔte aliɛmaa, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔpɛ bɛ nwo bɛko ye?’

english_verse: But the man who had started the fight pushed Moses aside and asked, “Who made you our ruler and judge?
translation_verse: Na ko bɔ né osisi obiɛngo ne sumuni Mose hɔle ahameɛ, na obisale ye kyɛ, ‘Nwa yeɛ ɔfale wɔ sili yɛ so panyi ne ndɛenbualɛniɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Are you going to kill me, just as you killed that Egyptian yesterday?”
translation_verse: Ɛpena kyɛ eku me koso kyɛbɔ anoma ehuni Misraimniɛ ne anaa?’

english_verse: When Moses heard this, he ran away to live in the country of Midian. His two sons were born there.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ Mose tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, ɔnwatili, na ɔɔyɛle ɛwɔfoɛ wɔ Midian aseɛ so, na ɔwole mmaa mmienzua nyɔ wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: Forty years later, an angel appeared to Moses from a burning bush in the desert near Mount Sinai.
translation_verse: “Na afoɛ aburanna pɛle nu ne, abɔfo yele ye nwo ali hyirele Mose wɔ ngyɛkyerɛ bɔ né ogye ne anu wɔ ɛserɛ bie bɔ opingye Sinai Bokaa ne.

english_verse: Moses was surprised by what he saw. He went closer to get a better look, and the Lord said,
translation_verse: Mose nwuni sɔ nikyee nen, ɔyɛle ye nwanwa, na ɔbɔ pingyele ngyɛkyerɛ ne kyɛ ɔkwaanea nikye horɛ; na ɔtele Awurade dwudwolɛ kyɛ,

english_verse: “I am the God who was worshiped by your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.” Moses started shaking all over and didn't dare to look at the bush.
translation_verse: ‘Me ole wɔ nana mɔ Nyameɛ, Abraham ne Yisake ne Yakob Nyameɛ.’ Na Mose nwo wosowosole ye, na wangora wandindim wangɔannea ye ko.

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Take off your sandals, because the place where you are standing is holy.
translation_verse: Na Awurade sele ye kyɛ, ‘Ye wɔ gya kunu mbaboa ne, ofikyɛ nekaa bɔ egyi ne te aseɛ krongron.

english_verse: With my own eyes I have seen the suffering of my people in Egypt. I have heard their groans and have come down to rescue them. Now I am sending you back to Egypt.”
translation_verse: Manwu amaneɛ bɔ me mmenia nwu ye wɔ Misraim. Mate b’esuɛ koso, na madwu mawa ase kyɛ mebaaye bɛ mefi ngoaasolɛ nu. Yiti bra ma nzoma wɔ ma ɛhɔ Misraim.’

english_verse: This was the same Moses that the people rejected by saying, “Who made you our leader and judge?” God's angel had spoken to Moses from the bush. And God had even sent the angel to help Moses rescue the people and be their leader.
translation_verse: “Sɔ Mose he bɔ Yisraelfoɛ pole ye na besele ye kyɛ, ‘Nwa yeɛ ɔfale wɔ sili yɛ so panyi ne ndɛenbualɛniɛ?’ nen, ye komapɛ ne ala yeɛ Nyameɛ somane ye kyɛ, ɔfa abɔfo bɔ ɔyele ye nwo ali hyirele ye wɔ ngyɛkyerɛ ne anu so na ɔɔyɛ bɛ so panyi ne defoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: In Egypt and at the Red Sea and in the desert, Moses rescued the people by working miracles and wonders for
translation_verse: Mose yeɛ ɔyele Yisraelfoɛ fili Misraim ɔ, na ɔyɔle nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ wɔ Misraim aseɛ so, Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ ne aso ne ɛserɛ so afoɛ aburanna.

english_verse: Moses is the one who told the people of Israel, “God will choose one of your people to be a prophet, just as he chose me.”
translation_verse: Mose komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔhã hyirele Yisraelfoɛ kyɛ, ‘Nyameɛ kɔsoma ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ aliɛma ɔ maa ɔkɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ, kyɛbɔ wasoma me ne.’

english_verse: Moses brought our people together in the desert, and the angel spoke to him on Mount Sinai. There he was given these life-giving words to pass on to us.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Yisrael ɛlɔen ne yiale ɛserɛ so nen, né Mose boka bɛ so; ɔne yɛ nana mɔ yeɛ né bɛwɔ berɛ ɔ, afei koso né ɔne abɔfo bɔ odwudwo hyirele ye wɔ Sinai Bokaa ne aso ne wɔ berɛ, na olele Nyameɛ ngoa dwirɛ ne mane yɛ.

english_verse: But our ancestors refused to obey Moses. They rejected him and wanted to go back to Egypt.
translation_verse: “Nakoso yɛ nana mɔ andie Mose, behwi bɛfale ye dwirɛ so, na ɔhale bɛ ngome a, ahaa né bɛwɔ Misraim.

english_verse: Then they made an idol in the shape of a calf. They offered sacrifices to the idol and were pleased with what they had done.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu, bɛyɔle ohoni bie bɔ ye sue te kyɛ nandwie ba, na bɛfa bɛyɛle amoen bɛsɔle, na ɔnate bɛ sa noa adwii ne ati bɛtole poen bedidili bɛnone.

english_verse: God turned his back on his people and left them. Then they worshiped the stars in the sky, just as it says in the Book of the Prophets, “People of Israel, you didn't offer sacrifices and offerings to me during those
translation_verse: Yiti Nyameɛ yele ye nye, na ɔyele bɛ mane kyɛ bɛsɔne nyameɛso nzramaa, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nwomaa ne anu kyɛ, ‘O Yisrael awuro ama! Afoɛ aburanna bɔ ɛmɔlili ye wɔ ɛserɛ so ne, aso ɛmɔfale ngaka ne aleɛ bɛbɔle afɔleɛ bɛmane me?

english_verse: Instead, you carried the tent where the god Molech is worshiped, and you took along the star of your god Rephan. You made those idols and worshiped them. So now I will have you carried off beyond Babylonia.”
translation_verse: Na mmom ɛmɔsoale bosoen Moloke ɛtena sua ɔne ɛmɔ nyameɛ Refan nzramaa; bɛte ohoni mɔ bɔ ɛmɔyɔle kyɛ ɛmɔsɔne bɛ ɔ. Ɛhe ati ngɔpɛ ɛmɔ asue maa ɛmɔkɔhɔ Babilɔn asi dɔ.’

english_verse: The tent where our ancestors worshiped God was with them in the desert. This was the same tent that God had commanded Moses to make. And it was made like the model that Moses had seen.
translation_verse: “Né yɛ nana mɔ le ɛtena sua wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso bɔ okyire kyɛ Nyameɛ ne bɛ bɛwɔ berɛ ɔ. Na kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ hyɛle Mose kyɛ ɔyɔ ɛtena sua nen, kyɛbɔ osi nwuni ye ne ala yeɛ ɔyɔle ye ɔ.

english_verse: Later it was given to our ancestors, and they took it with them when they went with Joshua. They carried the tent along as they took over the land from those people that God had chased out for them. Our ancestors used this tent until the time of King David.
translation_verse: Na nziɛ ye, yɛ nana mɔ koso bɛ sa hane ɛtena sua ne fili bɛ baba mɔ berɛ, na bɛ ne Yosua fa wale maen maen bɔ Nyameɛ foane bɛ fili yɛ nana mɔ nyunu nemɔ aseɛ so. Na olili bɛ sa nu maa oodwuli Dawide aberɛ so.

english_verse: He pleased God and asked him if he could build a house of worship for the people of Israel.
translation_verse: Dawide nyane Nyameɛ nyunu adom, na ɔsrɛle ye kyɛ ɔma ye ate maa osi sua ma Yakob Nyameɛ.

english_verse: And it was finally King Solomon who built a house for God.
translation_verse: Nakoso Solomon yeɛ osili sua mane Nyameɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But the Most High God doesn't live in houses made by humans. It is just as the prophet said, when he spoke for the Lord,
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro anwuro ne, ɔndena sua bɔ kuro sona wafa ye sa wasi ɔ nu, kyɛbɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne kã kyɛ,

english_verse: “Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool. What kind of house will you build for me? In what place will I rest?
translation_verse: ‘Nyameɛso te m’ahennie bia, yeɛ aseɛ te me gya ndiasoɛ. Nzikyɛ sua koraa yeɛ ɛmɔkosi bɛkɔma me ɔ? Awurade noa dwirɛ ɛne, Anaakyɛ nisua yeɛ ngɔtena ngole me nwome ɔ?

english_verse: You stubborn and hardheaded people! You are always fighting against the Holy Spirit, just as your ancestors did.
translation_verse: Na Setefano toale so hane kyɛ, “Yisraelfoɛ asoserɛfoɛ, ɛmɔapini b’ahone, yeɛ afei ɛmɔaprapra bɛ so asi wɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne anwo. Ɛmɔte kyɛ ɛmɔ nana mɔ ala, bɔ dáa ɛmɔsi Sunzum Krongron ne ate ɔ!

english_verse: Is there one prophet that your ancestors didn't mistreat? They killed the prophets who told about the coming of the One Who Obeys God. And now you have turned against him and killed him.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ nemɔ anu beni yeɛ ɛmɔ nana mɔ bandane ye nye ɔ? Na behuni bɛ bɔ belili moa bɛbɔle Teneneneniɛ ne walɛ ne nwo dawure ne, ye bɔ afei de ɛmɔaye ye bama bahu ye ne,

english_verse: Angels gave you God's Law, but you still don't obey it. Stephen Is Stoned to Death
translation_verse: na mmeraa bɔ abɔfo nemɔ fa wale ne, ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔlele ɔ, nakoso ɛmɔanni so!” Bɛboro Setefano nyɔboɛ

english_verse: But Stephen was filled with the Holy Spirit. He looked toward heaven, where he saw our glorious God and Jesus standing at his right side.
translation_verse: Nakoso né Sunzum Krongron ahyɛ Setefano ma, ɔtole ye nye neane nyameɛso, na onwuni Nyameɛ animnyam ne, ɔne Yesu kyɛ ogyi Nyameɛ sa famaa so.

english_verse: Then Stephen said, “I see heaven open and the Son of Man standing at the right side of God!”
translation_verse: Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔnea, menwu kyɛ anwuro abukye, na Sona Awa ne gyi Nyameɛ sa famaa so.”

english_verse: The council members shouted and covered their ears. At once they all attacked Stephen
translation_verse: Berɛ ne ala badwafoɛ ne teane nu serɛserɛ, bɛfale bɛ sa betuatuale bɛ so, na bɛbɔle twi bɛɛto bɛhyɛle ye so.

english_verse: and dragged him out of the city. Then they started throwing stones at him. The men who had brought charges against him put their coats at the feet of a young man named Saul.
translation_verse: Bɛhwene ye befili kuro ne anu bɛɛborole ye nyɔboɛ. Na adanzefoɛ nemɔ yeyele bɛ ndaadeɛ mane aberandeɛ bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Sɔɔlo kyɛ ɔnea so ma bɛ.

english_verse: As Stephen was being stoned to death, he called out, “Lord Jesus, please welcome me!”
translation_verse: Na bɛwɔ so bɔ bɛboro Setefano nyɔboɛ ne, ɔhɔle so bɔle mbaeɛ kyɛ, “Awurade Yesu, de me sunzum!”

english_verse: He knelt down and shouted, “Lord, don't blame them for what they have done.” Then he died.
translation_verse: Afei oguale ndwerɛ, na ɔteane nu serɛserɛ kyɛ, “Awurade, fa bɛ bɔne he kyɛ bɛ!” Ɔhane sɔ ne, owuli.

english_verse: Saul started making a lot of trouble for the church. He went from house to house, arresting men and women and putting them in jail. The Good News Is Preached in Samaria
translation_verse: Nakoso Sɔɔlo de, ɔbɔle mmɔden ala kyɛ ɔkɔha asɔre ne; owurawurale awuro mɔ nu hyehyele agyidifoɛ mmienzua ne mmrasua maa bɛfale bɛ beguale kuku nu. Filipo ka nzɛmba ne wɔ Samaria

english_verse: The Lord's followers who had been scattered went from place to place, telling the good news.
translation_verse: Na agyidifoɛ bɔ bɛbɔle aya ne, behyinini bɛhane nzɛmba ne.

english_verse: Philip went to the city of Samaria and told the people about Christ.
translation_verse: Filipo hɔle Samaria kuro bie aso, na ɔhane Kristo nwo dwirɛ hyirele berɛ ama.

english_verse: They crowded around Philip because they were eager to hear what he was saying and to see him work miracles.
translation_verse: Na ɛlɔen ne tele bɔ Filipo hane ne, ná benwuni nzɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ ɔyɔle nen, bɛ mukoraa bɛyɛle adwene ko betiele ye,

english_verse: Many people with evil spirits were healed, and the spirits went out of them with a shout. A lot of paralyzed and lame people were also healed.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ sunzummɔne mɔ teateane nu serɛserɛ betutu befili mmeni pee nu, na mmubuafoɛ ne mbakye pee benyane ayaresa.

english_verse: Everyone in that city was very glad because of what was happening.
translation_verse: Yiti kuro berɛ ama lili ahurusi piri paa.

english_verse: For some time a man named Simon had lived there and had amazed the people of Samaria. He practiced witchcraft and claimed to be somebody great.
translation_verse: Né biaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Simɔn bɔ ɔte kuro berɛ ne wali moa wafa ngonyaa wanwunya Samariafoɛ nye so, na ɔyɛle ye nwo kyɛ sona bɔ odi mu wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: Everyone, rich and poor, crowded around him. They said, “This man is the power of God called ‘The Great Power.’ ”
translation_verse: Na bɛ mukoraa betiele ye, ofi ngwadaa so kodwu mbanyi so, na bɛhane kyɛ: Biaa he ole Nyameɛ Tumi Piri ne.

english_verse: For a long time, Simon had used witchcraft to amaze the people, and they kept crowding around him.
translation_verse: Bɛyɛle asoɛ betiele ye paa, ɔnate kyɛ né wafa ye ngonyaa ne wanwunya bɛ nye so wahyɛ.

english_verse: But when they believed what Philip was saying about God's kingdom and about the name of Jesus Christ, they were all baptized.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ belele Filipo nzɛmba bɔ ɔfa Nyameɛ ahennie ne, ɔne Yesu Kristo dumaa nwo belili nen, mmienzua ne mmrasua maa bɛbɔle bɛ asu.

english_verse: Even Simon believed and was baptized. He stayed close to Philip, because he marveled at all the miracles and wonders.
translation_verse: Simɔn bɔbɔ po lele Yesu Kristo lili, na bɛbɔle ye asu beyiele ne, wande ye nwo wamvi Filipo nwo; na onwuni anwanwadeɛ ne nzɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ né Filipo yɔ nen, ye nwo dwirili ye.

english_verse: The apostles in Jerusalem heard that some people in Samaria had accepted God's message, and they sent Peter and John.
translation_verse: Asomafoɛ bɔ né bɛwɔ Yerusalem ne, bɛtele kyɛ Samariafoɛ basɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne anu nen, bɛsomane Petro ne Yohane maa bɛhɔle bɛ berɛ.

english_verse: When the two apostles arrived, they prayed that these people would be given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Bedwuli berɛ ne, bɛbɔle mbaeɛ bɛmane agyidifoɛ ne kyɛ benya Sunzum Krongron ne.

english_verse: Before this, the Holy Spirit had not been given to any of them, though some of them had been baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ né babɔ bɛ asu wɔ Awurade Yesu dumaa nu de, nakoso né Sunzum Krongron ne nnya ɔwwale bɛ so.

english_verse: Peter and John then placed their hands on everyone who had faith in the Lord, and they were given the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Afei Petro ne Yohane fale bɛ sa guale bɛ so, na benyane Sunzum Krongron ne.

english_verse: Simon noticed that the Spirit was given only when the apostles placed their hands on the people. So he brought money
translation_verse: Simɔn nwuni kyɛ asomafoɛ ne fa bɛ sa gua agyidifoɛ nemɔ so a benya Sunzum Krongron ne, yiti ɔmane Petro ne Yohane sikaa,

english_verse: and said to Peter and John, “Let me have this power too! Then anyone I place my hands on will also be given the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔma me koso tumi he bie, amaa sona biala bɔ ngɔfa me sa ngogua ye so ne wanya Sunzum Krongron ne.”

english_verse: Peter said to him, “You and your money will both end up in hell if you think you can buy God's gift!
translation_verse: Na Petro buale ye kyɛ, “Abue bu wɔ ne wɔ sikaa ne, ofikyɛ ɛdwene kyɛ ɛkɔhora kɔfa sikaa kɔtɔ Nyameɛ akyɛdeɛ ne!

english_verse: You don't have any part in this, and God sees that your heart isn't right.
translation_verse: Yɛ dwumadie ne ɛbboka so, yeɛ elle kyɛfa biala koso wɔ nu, ɔnate kyɛ wɔ nzusuleɛ ndengyɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: Get rid of these evil thoughts and ask God to forgive you.
translation_verse: Yiti sakyera w’adwene fi wɔ bɔne he nwo, na srɛ Awurade kyɛ sɛ ɔkɔyɛ yee a, ɔfa wɔ nzusuleɛ tɛɛ he hyɛ wɔ.

english_verse: I can see that you are jealous and bound by your evil ways.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ manwu kyɛ wɔ nye boro nikyee paa, na ɛte bɔne akoaa.”

english_verse: Simon said, “Please pray to the Lord, so that what you said won't happen to me.”
translation_verse: Na Simɔn sele Petro ne Yohane kyɛ, “Mepa ɛmɔ kyerɛ, ɛmɔbɔ mbaeɛ bɛsrɛ Awurade bɛma me, na bɔ ɛmɔaha ye anu biala ando me.”

english_verse: After Peter and John had preached about the Lord, they returned to Jerusalem. On their way they told the good news in many villages of Samaria. Philip and an Ethiopian Official
translation_verse: Na belili adanzeɛ ná bɛhane Awurade dwirɛ ne nen, besa bɛhɔle Yerusalem. Na békɔ nen, bɛhane nzɛmba ne wɔ Samaria nguraa pee nu. Filipo ne Yitiopia panyi ne

english_verse: The Lord's angel said to Philip, “Go south along the desert road that leads from Jerusalem to Gaza.”
translation_verse: Na Awurade abɔfo sele Filipo kyɛ, “Dwɔso ná fa ngwaen dɔ atee bɔ ofi Yerusalem ɔtoro kɔ Gasa ne aso.” Ɛhe te ɛserɛ so atee.

english_verse: So Philip left. An important Ethiopian official happened to be going along that road in his chariot. He was the chief treasurer for Candace, the Queen of Ethiopia. The official had gone to Jerusalem to worship
translation_verse: Na odwɔso hɔle. Na onwuni Yitiopianiɛ bie, bɔ ɔte Yitiopia hemmaa Kandake ye sayɛɛ titire, bɔ ɔnea ye fotoɛ amukoraa so ɔ; bɔ ɔwale Yerusalem ɔɔsɔnene ɔ.

english_verse: and was now on his way home. He was sitting in his chariot, reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.
translation_verse: Né ɔte ye teaseɛnam nu osa kɔ, na né ɔ́kenga ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya nwomaa ne.

english_verse: The Spirit told Philip to catch up with the chariot.
translation_verse: Na Sunzum ne sele Filipo kyɛ, “Kɔ teaseɛnam ne anwo berɛ!”

english_verse: Philip ran up close and heard the man reading aloud from the book of Isaiah. Philip asked him, “Do you understand what you are reading?”
translation_verse: Yiti Filipo tuli amirika hɔle ye nwo berɛ, ɔtele kyɛ ɔ́kenga ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya nwomaa ne, na obisale ye kyɛ, “Aso ɛte bɔ ɛ́kenga ye bo?”

english_verse: The official answered, “How can I understand unless someone helps me?” He then invited Philip to come up and sit beside him.
translation_verse: Na obuale ye kyɛ, “Ngɔyɛ sɛɛ né mate ye bo, sana ebie kyirekyire me nu.” Na ɔsrɛle Filipo kyɛ ɔɔfo tena ye teaseɛnam ne anu bie.

english_verse: The man was reading the passage that said, “He was led like a sheep on its way to be killed. He was silent as a lamb whose wool is being cut off, and he did not say a word.
translation_verse: Né ɔkenga Ahyerɛlɛ ne anu dwirɛ he: “Bɛfale ye bɛhɔle kyɛ boaen bɔ bɛ́fa ye bɛkɔ akumyɛɛ ɔ, anaakyɛ boaen ba bɔ watɔ mumu wɔ sona bɔ ɔpepɛ ye nwiaa nyunu ɔ, wammukye ye noa.

english_verse: He was treated like a nobody and did not receive a fair trial. How can he have children, if his life is snatched away?”
translation_verse: Beguale ye nyunu ase, na bebuale ye ndɛengyea. Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kohyire ye boso ama ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ bapɛ ye ngoa so bafi aseɛ so.”

english_verse: The official said to Philip, “Tell me, was the prophet talking about himself or about someone else?”
translation_verse: Na sayɛɛ ne bisale Filipo kyɛ, “Mepa wɔ kyerɛ, nwa nwo dwirɛ yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne ɔkã ne? Ye bɔbɔ ye nwo, anaakyɛ ebie nwo ɔ?”

english_verse: So Philip began at this place in the Scriptures and explained the good news about Jesus.
translation_verse: Na Filipo dwudwole, na ɔhyɛle ye bo fale Ahyerɛlɛ he anu dwirɛ hane Yesu nwo nzɛmba ne hyirele ye.

english_verse: As they were going along the road, they came to a place where there was some water. The official said, “Look! Here is some water. Why can't I be baptized?”
translation_verse: [Na Filipo buale kyɛ, “Sɛ ede di bɔkɔɔ wɔ w’ahone nu de a, bɛbɔ wɔ asu a ɔyɛ yee.” Na ye koso obuale ye kyɛ, “Mede medi kyɛ Yesu Kristo ole Nyameɛ Awa ne.”]

english_verse: He ordered the chariot to stop. Then they both went down into the water, and Philip baptized him.
translation_verse: Na ɔmane teaseɛnam ne gyinane, na bɛ munyɔ bedwu bɛhɔle nzue ne anu, Filipo ne sayɛɛ ne, na ɔbɔle ye asu.

english_verse: After they had come out of the water, the Lord's Spirit took Philip away. The official never saw him again, but he was very happy as he went on his way.
translation_verse: Na befili nzue ne anu befitele nen, Awurade Sunzum hwimini Filipo hɔle, na sayɛɛ ne annwu ye ko, nakoso ɔfale anigye toale ye ateetulɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Philip later appeared in Azotus. He went from town to town, all the way to Caesarea, telling people about Jesus.
translation_verse: Na Filipo de, oofitele Asoto, na ɔpɛ nu kɔ nen, ɔhane nzɛmba ne wɔ nguro ne amukoraati so tonn oodwuli Kaesarea.

english_verse: Saul preached with such power that he completely confused the Jewish people in Damascus, as he tried to show them that Jesus is the Messiah.
translation_verse: Nakoso Sɔɔlo hɔle so nyane anwoserɛ wɔ ye nzɛmbahanɛ nu. Ye adanzeɛ bɔ olili kyɛ Yesu ole Kristo ne lale berɛ turoloo bɔ aporowaa biala nne ye nwo ɔ. Na Yudafoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Damasko ne annya edwirɛ biala ko bɔ bɛha bɛfa bebua ye ɔ.

english_verse: Now get up and go into the city, where you will be told what to do.”
translation_verse: nakoso dwɔso ná kɔ kuro ne anu dɔ, na bɛkɔhã bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛyɔ ɔ bekohyire wɔ.”

english_verse: I will show him how much he must suffer for worshiping in my name.”
translation_verse: Na ngohyire ye amaneɛ bɔ me dumaa ti odi kyɛ onwu ye ɔ.”

english_verse: When Saul arrived in Jerusalem, he tried to join the followers. But they were all afraid of him, because they did not believe he was a true follower.
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo hɔle Yerusalem, na ɔyɛle kyɛ ɔfa ye nwo bɔ asuafoɛ nemɔ, nakoso bɛ mukoraa besurole ye, ofikyɛ banne ye banni kyɛ ɔte suaniɛ.

english_verse: and he has seen a vision. He saw a man named Ananias coming to him and putting his hands on him, so he could see again.”
translation_verse: na wanwu biaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Anania wɔ nyekyire nu kyɛ ɔ́ba ye berɛ bafa ye sa gua ye so maa osa nwu nikye.”

english_verse: Suddenly something like fish scales fell from Saul's eyes, and he could see. He got up and was baptized.
translation_verse: Berɛ ne ala, nikyee bie bɔ ɔte kyɛ tiré si boen fili Sɔɔlo nye so tutu guale ase, na osa nwuni nikye; na odwɔsole maa bɛbɔle ye asu.

english_verse: Saul kept on threatening to kill the Lord's followers. He even went to the high priest
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne, né adwene biala nne Sɔɔlo ti anu te kyɛ anwunanwuna ne kodiawu adwene bɔ ɔfa ko tia Awurade asuafoɛ nemɔ ɔ. Yiti ɔhɔle ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne berɛ

english_verse: and asked for letters to the leaders of the synagogues in Damascus. He did this because he wanted to arrest and take to Jerusalem any man or woman who had accepted the Lord's Way.
translation_verse: ɔɔsrɛle ye berɛ tumi krataa, bɔ ɔkɔfa kɔhɔ Damasko nyianu sua nemɔ nu, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ na onwu ebiala bɔ ɔnate Awurade nwo gyidie atee so a, bienzua oo, brasua oo, wahora wahye ye, ná wafa ye wawa Yerusalem.

english_verse: When Saul had almost reached Damascus, a bright light from heaven suddenly flashed around him.
translation_verse: Ɔpene atee so, ná ɔhale kãa maa odwu Damasko nen, mvum nu, kanea bie fili nyameɛso tale brale ye nwo yiale.

english_verse: He fell to the ground and heard a voice saying, “Saul! Saul! Why are you so cruel to me?”
translation_verse: Ɔpɛ fini, na ɔtele edwudwolɛ bie kyɛ, “Sɔɔlo, Sɔɔlo! Nzu ati yeɛ ɛtane me nye ye?”

english_verse: “Who are you?” Saul asked. “I am Jesus,” the Lord answered. “I am the one you are so cruel to.
translation_verse: Na obuale kyɛ, “Wɔ nwa ɛne, Awurade?” Na osele kyɛ, “Me ole Yesu bɔ ɛtane ye nye ne, [ɔyɛ se kyɛ ekotu wɔ gya kɔfa kɔwɔ nandwiehanɛniɛ ye pɔmaa noa buralɛ ɔ],

english_verse: The men with Saul stood there speechless. They had heard the voice, but they had not seen anyone.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ né bɛ ne Sɔɔlo tu atee ne gyinane, bɛtotɔle mmobo; ofikyɛ bɛtele edwudwolɛ ne de, nakoso bannwu sona biala.

english_verse: Saul got up from the ground, and when he opened his eyes, he could not see a thing. Someone then led him by the hand to Damascus,
translation_verse: Sɔɔlo fili aseɛnwo berɛ dwɔsole, ɔtetele ye nye, nakoso né onnwu ase. Yiti bɛsosɔle ye sa bɛ ne ye hɔle Damasko.

english_verse: and for three days he was blind and did not eat or drink.
translation_verse: Ngyẽa ɛlɛsa, né onnwu hwee, né onnidi ná ɔnno hwee.

english_verse: A follower named Ananias lived in Damascus, and the Lord spoke to him in a vision. Ananias answered, “Lord, here I am.”
translation_verse: Né gyidiniɛ bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Anania wɔ Damasko. Né Awurade aha ahyire ye wɔ nyekyire nu kyɛ, “Anania!” Na obuale kyɛ, “Me ɛhe, Awurade.”

english_verse: The Lord said to him, “Get up and go to the house of Judas on Straight Street. When you get there, you will find a man named Saul from the city of Tarsus. Saul is praying,
translation_verse: Na Awurade sele ye kyɛ, “Dwɔso kɔ borɔnoɛ bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye ‘Turoloo’ ne aso, na kɔ Yudase awuro kɔpena biaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Sɔɔlo bɔ ofi Taaso. Sɔ Sɔɔlo ne gu so ɔbɔ mbaeɛ,

english_verse: Ananias replied, “Lord, a lot of people have told me about the terrible things this man has done to your followers in Jerusalem.
translation_verse: Na Anania buale kyɛ, “Awurade, mmeni pee bahã biaa he nwo dwirɛ, ɔne bɔne worawora bɔ wafa wali w’anwoteefoɛ wɔ Yerusalem ɔ bahyire me.

english_verse: Now the chief priests have given him the power to come here and arrest anyone who worships in your name.”
translation_verse: Afei koso wale tumi wafi asɔfo mbanyi nemɔ berɛ, na wawa wa kyɛ ɔbaahye ebiala bɔ ɔbɔ wɔ dumaa ɔ.”

english_verse: The Lord said to Ananias, “Go! I have chosen him to tell foreigners, kings, and the people of Israel about me.
translation_verse: Na Awurade sele ye kyɛ, “Wɔ de, kɔ, ofikyɛ maye ye kyɛ ɔso me, ná ɔbɔ me dumaa nwo dawure hyire Amaenmaensofoɛ ne ahemvo ne Yisrael mma.

english_verse: Ananias left and went into the house where Saul was staying. Ananias placed his hands on him and said, “Saul, the Lord Jesus has sent me. He is the same one who appeared to you along the road. He wants you to be able to see and to be filled with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Yiti Anania sili nu hɔle. Owurale awuro ne anu, ɔfale ye sa guale ye so, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Aliɛmaa Sɔɔlo, Awurade Yesu bɔ ɔyele ye nwo ali hyirele wɔ wɔ atee bɔ efi so wale ne aso ne, wasoma me wɔ wɔ berɛ, kyɛ esa nwu nikye, ná Sunzum Krongron oyi wɔ tɛkyɛ.”

english_verse: Then he ate and felt much better. Saul Preaches in Damascus For several days Saul stayed with the Lord's followers in Damascus.
translation_verse: Afei odidili, na ye nwo yɛle ye se, na olili agyidifoɛ nemɔ nwo berɛ ngyẽa pee wɔ Damasko. Sɔɔlo kã nzɛmba wɔ Damasko

english_verse: Soon he went to the synagogues and started telling people that Jesus is the Son of God.
translation_verse: Ɔhɔle nyianu sua nemɔ nu berɛ ne ala, ɔɔhane Yesu nwo dwirɛ kyɛ ye ole Nyameɛ Awa ne.

english_verse: Everyone who heard Saul was amazed and said, “Isn't this the man who caused so much trouble for those people in Jerusalem who worship in the name of Jesus? Didn't he come here to arrest them and take them to the chief priests?”
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle bɛ bɔ bɛtele ye dwirɛ ne amu nwanwa, na bebisale kyɛ, “Aso nna biaa he yeɛ Yerusalem ohuhuni mmenia bɔ bɛbɔ Yesu dumaa ne? Aso nna ɛhe ati yeɛ wawa wa ɔ, kyɛ ɔbaahyehye agyidifoɛ ne fa bɛ kɔma asɔfo mbanyi nemɔ ɔ?”

english_verse: Later some of them made plans to kill Saul,
translation_verse: Ngyẽa kãa asi ne, Yudafoɛ ne yiale, na bɛbɔle Sɔɔlo ti so porɛ kyɛ bekohu ye,

english_verse: but he found out about it. He learned that they were guarding the gates of the city day and night in order to kill him.
translation_verse: nakoso ɔtele bɛ porɛ ne nwo bie. Bɛbɔle kuro n’anoa nemɔ nwo nzra eyia ne kɔngɔen kyɛ bɛ sa kɔha ye na bahu ye ɔ.

english_verse: Then one night his followers let him down over the city wall in a large basket. Saul in Jerusalem
translation_verse: Nakoso Sɔɔlo asuafoɛ nemɔ fale ye besiele kɛndɛenmboho bie nu ɛlɛho bie kɔngɔen, na bedwurale ye bɛfale fasue ne aso. Sɔɔlo kɔ Yerusalem

english_verse: Then Barnabas helped him by taking him to the apostles. He explained how Saul had seen the Lord and how the Lord had spoken to him. Barnabas also said when Saul was in Damascus, he had spoken bravely in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Nakoso Banaba fale ye hɔle asomafoɛ nemɔ berɛ, na ɔmaa benwuni kyɛbɔ Sɔɔlo si nwuni Awurade wɔ atunu, ɔne kyɛ odwudwo hyirele ye ɔ, ɔne kyɛbɔ osili ye ahone hane nzɛmba ne wɔ Yesu dumaa nu wɔ Damasko ɔ.

english_verse: Saul moved about freely with the followers in Jerusalem and told everyone about the Lord.
translation_verse: Afei Sɔɔlo ne asomafoɛ nemɔ bɛtenane, ɔne bɛ hyinini Yerusalem, na osili ye ahone hane nzɛmba ne wɔ Awurade dumaa nu.

english_verse: He was always arguing with the Jews who spoke Greek, and so they tried to kill him.
translation_verse: Asa koso, ɔhane bie hyirele Yudafoɛ bɔ bɛkã Hela dwudwolɛ; ɔne bɛ suli aporowaa, na bɛyɛle kyɛ bekohũ ye.

english_verse: But the followers found out about this and took Saul to Caesarea. From there they sent him to the city of Tarsus.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ agyidifoɛ nemɔ tele sɔ dwirɛ nen, bɛfale Sɔɔlo bɛhɔle Kaesarea, na bɛmaa ɔhɔle Taaso.

english_verse: The church in Judea, Galilee, and Samaria now had a time of peace and kept on worshiping the Lord. The church became stronger, as the Holy Spirit encouraged it and helped it grow. Peter Heals Aeneas
translation_verse: Yiti asɔre nemɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Yudea ne Galilea ne Samaria mukoraa benyane asomdwee, na benyini nyamesom nu. Na bɛnate Awurade surolɛ ne Sunzum Krongron aworakyekyerɛ nu bɛsone pee. Petro sa Yinea anwonyerɛ wɔ Lida

english_verse: While Peter was traveling from place to place, he visited the Lord's followers who lived in the town of Lydda.
translation_verse: Na ɔwale kyɛ Petro hyinini bɛ mukoraa bɛ so, na ɔɔsrale anwoteefoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Lida ne koso.

english_verse: There he met a man named Aeneas, who for eight years had been sick in bed and could not move.
translation_verse: Berɛ yeɛ oonwuni bubuaniɛ biaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Yinea bɔ wali bɛen so afoɛ mmɔtwɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Peter said to Aeneas, “Jesus Christ has healed you! Get up and make up your bed.” At once he stood up.
translation_verse: Na Petro sele ye kyɛ, “Yinea, Yesu Kristo ama wɔ nwo asa; dwɔso na bobɔ wɔ bɛen ne.” Na berɛ ne ala Yinea dwɔsole.

english_verse: Many people in the towns of Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas and became followers of the Lord. Peter Brings Dorcas Back to Life
translation_verse: Na Lidafoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Saron mboanoa nwuni biaa ne, na bɛfale bɛ nwo bɛmane Awurade. Petro tingye Tabita wɔ Yopa

english_verse: In Joppa there was a follower named Tabitha. Her Greek name was Dorcas, which means “deer.” She was always doing good things for people and had given much to the poor.
translation_verse: Né gyidiniɛ braa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Tabita wɔ Yopa. . Braa he fale paayɛlɛ ne ehiafoɛ adɔeɛyɛlɛ yɛle ye adwuma.

english_verse: But she got sick and died, and her body was washed and placed in an upstairs room.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmerɛ ne anu anwonyerɛ bɔle ye, na owuli. Bebiale ye, na bɛdedale ye wɔ sua bie anu wɔ aborɔsaen so.

english_verse: Joppa wasn't far from Lydda, and the followers heard that Peter was there. They sent two men to say to him, “Please come with us as quickly as you can!”
translation_verse: Yopa ne Lida anwa biala. Yiti mmerɛ bɔ Yopa agyidifoɛ tele kyɛ Petro wɔ Lida nen, bɛsomane mmenia nyɔ maa beesele ye kyɛ, “Yɛsrɛ wɔ, ma wɔ nwo yɛ nyera ná bra yɛ wa.”

english_verse: At once, Peter went with them. The men took Peter upstairs into the room. Many widows were there crying. They showed him the coats and clothes that Dorcas had made while she was still alive.
translation_verse: Yiti Petro dwɔsole, na ɔne bɛ hɔle. Oodwuli berɛ, na bɛne ye hɔle aborɔsaen ne aso. Yeɛ akunafoɛ mmrasua ne amukoraa beegyinagyinane ye nwo berɛ bɔ né besũ ɔ, na bɛfale ndaadeɛ ne ndena bɔ Dɔkase pombale wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né ɔne bɛ wɔ berɛ ne behyirele ye.

english_verse: After Peter had sent everyone out of the room, he knelt down and prayed. Then he turned to the body of Dorcas and said, “Tabitha, get up!” The woman opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.
translation_verse: Na Petro mane bɛ mukoraa befitele, oguale ndwerɛ bɔle mbaeɛ, ɔkakyili ye nye hɔle efuin ne anwo na ɔhane kyɛ, “Tabita, dwɔso!” Ɔtetele ye nye, na onwuni Petro nen, odwɔsole tenane berɛ.

english_verse: He took her by the hand and helped her to her feet. Peter called in the widows and the other followers and showed them that Dorcas had been raised from death.
translation_verse: Petro sɔle ye sa maa odwɔso gyinane berɛ. Na ɔfrɛle agyidifoɛ nemɔ, akunafoɛ mmrasua nemɔ koso boka so, na ɔfale bɔ wawu watingye ne mane bɛ.

english_verse: Everyone in Joppa heard what had happened, and many of them put their faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ he tenele Yopa mukoraa, na mmeni pee lele Awurade lili.

english_verse: Peter stayed on for a while in Joppa in the house of a man named Simon, who made leather.
translation_verse: Na Petro tenane Yopa lili ngyẽa pee wɔ Simɔn bie bɔ owura naen nwomaa ayire ɔ ye awuro.

english_verse: In Caesarea there was a man named Cornelius, who was the captain of a group of soldiers called “The Italian Unit.”
translation_verse: Né biaa bie wɔ Kaesarea bɔ ye dumaa li Kɔneleo ɔ. Ɔte asraafoɛ ɛyaa so panyi wɔ fekue bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Yitalia Fekue ne anu.

english_verse: Cornelius was a very religious man. He worshiped God, and so did everyone else who lived in his house. He had given a lot of money to the poor and was always praying to God.
translation_verse: Ɔte nyamesuroniɛ bɔ ɔne ye awuro ama mukoraati besuro Nyameɛ ɔ. Osa yɔle adɔeɛ pee mane Yudafoɛ ehiafoɛ, na né ɔtaa bɔ mbaeɛ kyire Nyameɛ.

english_verse: One afternoon at about three o'clock, Cornelius had a vision. He saw an angel from God coming to him and calling him by name.
translation_verse: Ɛlɛho bie eyia kɔyɛ nnɔnmmiɛnza onyane nyekyire. Nyameɛ abɔfo wale ye awuro na onwuni ye pefee. Na abɔfo ne bɔle ye dumaa kyɛ, “Kɔneleo!”

english_verse: Cornelius was surprised and stared at the angel. Then he asked, “What is this all about?” The angel answered, “God has heard your prayers and knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: Ɔfale esuronyi neane abɔfo ne haa na ɔhane kyɛ, “Yɛ mene, nzikyɛ dwirɛ ɔ?” Na obuale ye kyɛ, “Wɔ mbaeɛ ne w’adɔeɛ bɔ ayɔ ama ehiafoɛ ne adwu Nyameɛ nyunu, na ye wora offili wɔ.

english_verse: Now send some men to Joppa for a man named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Yiti kekesaala ye, soma mmenia maa bɛhɔ Yopa bɛɛfa Simɔn bie bɔ besa bɛfrɛ ye Petro ne bɛbra.

english_verse: He is staying with Simon the leather maker, who lives in a house near the sea.”
translation_verse: Ɔte Simɔn bie bɔ owura naen nwomaa ayire, bɔ ye awuro wɔ mboanoa ne berɛ.”

english_verse: After saying this, the angel left. Cornelius called in two of his servants and one of his soldiers who worshiped God.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo ne dwudwo hyirele Kɔneleo yiele, ná ɔhɔle nen, Kɔneleo frɛle ye somvoɛ nemɔ anu nyɔ ne asraaniɛ nyamesuroniɛ ko bɔ ɔboka Kɔneleo somvoɛ nemɔ aso ɔ.

english_verse: He explained everything to them and sent them off to Joppa.
translation_verse: Ɔhane bɔ wasi ne amukoraa hyirele bɛ, na ɔsomane bɛ Yopa.

english_verse: The next day about noon these men were coming near Joppa. Peter went up on the roof of the house to pray
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyene, na ɔbɔle kɔyɛ eyia duabien nen, né bɛwɔ atee so bɔ bapingye Yopa ɔ; na sɔ mmerɛ ne, Petro fole sua frɛtɛɛ so anwuro kyɛ ɔkwaabɔ mbaeɛ.

english_verse: and became very hungry. While the food was being prepared, he fell sound asleep and had a vision.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔen huni ye bɔ né ɔpena nikyee kã ye noa ɔ; na begu so bɔ bɛto aleɛ ne nen, ngɔle nyekyire tebea nu.

english_verse: He saw heaven open, and something came down like a huge sheet held up by its four corners.
translation_verse: Na onwuni kyɛ anwuro abukye, na nikyee bie bɔ ɔte kyɛ nwera pirikua, bɔ basosɔ ye noa nna ne anu odwu ba ase ɔ.

english_verse: In it were all kinds of animals, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Né ngaka amukoraa nu bie wɔ nu, ndɔteboa ne bɛ bɔ bɛtwe bɛ nwo ase ne ewienu nnomaa.

english_verse: A voice said to him, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Na komviɛ bie sele ye kyɛ, “Petro, dwɔso ná ku bɛ di!”

english_verse: But Peter said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never eaten anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Na Petro sele kyɛ, “Daabi, Awurade, ofikyɛ nnnili nikyee biala bɔ bekyi na ye nwo nde le.”

english_verse: The voice spoke to him again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Na ɔtele dwudwolɛ bieku kyɛ, “Nikyee biala bɔ Nyameɛ ate ye nwo kyɛ beli ne, nnɛbu ye kyɛ ɔte akyiwadeɛ.”

english_verse: This happened three times before the sheet was suddenly taken back to heaven.
translation_verse: Ɛhe hɔle so alaa pɛen nza, na besa bɛfale sɔ nikyee ne bɛhɔle nyameɛso.

english_verse: Peter was still wondering what all this meant, when the men sent by Cornelius came and stood at the gate. They had found their way to Simon's house
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Petro ne ye nwo besu aporowaa ɔpena nyekyire he abo nen, né mmenia bɔ Kɔneleo asoma bɛ ne babisabisa alaa baanwu Simɔn awuro. Né begyigyi awuro n’anoa nu berɛ.

english_verse: and were asking if Simon Peter was staying there.
translation_verse: Na bɛfrɛle bebisale kyɛ, “Simɔn bie bɔ besa bɛfrɛ ye Petro ne, ɔte wa anaa?”

english_verse: While Peter was still thinking about the vision, the Holy Spirit said to him, “Three men are here looking for you.
translation_verse: Na Petro gu so ɔdwenedwene nyekyire ne nwo nen, Sunzum ne sele ye kyɛ, “Nea, mmenia nza bie bɛpena wɔ.

english_verse: Peter went down and said to the men, “I am the one you are looking for. Why have you come?”
translation_verse: Yiti Petro dwu hɔle mmenia bɔ Kɔneleo somane bɛ wɔ ye berɛ nemɔ nwo berɛ, na osele kyɛ, “Me ole sona bɔ ɛmɔpena ye ne; ɛmɔ atee so?”

english_verse: They answered, “Captain Cornelius sent us. He is a good man who worships God and is liked by the Jewish people. One of God's holy angels told Cornelius to send for you, so he could hear what you have to say.”
translation_verse: Na bɛbɔle b’amaneɛ kyɛ, “Asraafoɛ ɛyaa so panyi Kɔneleo yeɛ ɔsomane yɛ ɔ. Ɔte sona paa, nyamesuroniɛ, na Yuda maen ne amukoraa bɔ ye dumaa paa. Na Nyameɛ abɔfo aye ahyire ye kyɛ ɔto ye sa frɛ wɔ ma ɛbra ye awuro, na otie wɔ noa dwirɛ.”

english_verse: Peter invited them to spend the night. The next morning, Peter and some of the Lord's followers in Joppa left with the men who had come from Cornelius.
translation_verse: Yiti Petro fale bɛ hɔle awuro, na ɔmaa besiele nningyein bɛmane ye. Na aleɛ hyene ne, Petro boaboale ye nwo ɔne bɛ hɔle; agyidifoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Yopa ne bie koso ne ye hɔle. Petro kɔ Kɔneleo awuro

english_verse: The next day they arrived in Caesarea where Cornelius was waiting for them. He had also invited his relatives and close friends.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyene bieku ne, bedwuli Kaesarea. Né Kɔneleo ɔnea bɛ ate, na né wato ye sa wafrɛ ye abusuafoɛ ne ye damvo paa mɔ maa baayia nu.

english_verse: When Peter arrived, Cornelius greeted him. Then he knelt at Peter's feet and started worshiping him.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ Petro yɛle kyɛ owura awuro ne anu ne, Kɔneleo hɔle ooyiale ye, na ɔtole ye nwo yele ye gya bo sɔnene ye.

english_verse: But Peter took hold of him and said, “Stand up! I am nothing more than a human.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Petro maa odwɔsole, na osele ye kyɛ, “Dwɔso, na me koso nde kuro sona.”

english_verse: As Peter entered the house, he was still talking with Cornelius. Many people were there,
translation_verse: Né Petro gu so ɔne Kɔneleo bedi ngɔmɔ, owurale awuro ne anu, na onwuni kyɛ mmenia pee bayia berɛ.

english_verse: and Peter said to them, “You know that we Jews are not allowed to have anything to do with other people. But God has shown me that he doesn't think anyone is unclean or unfit.
translation_verse: Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔse kyɛ otia mmeraa kyɛ Yudaniɛ ɔkɔfa ye nwo kɔbɔ Amaenmaensoniɛ anaakyɛ ɔkɔhɔ ye awuro kɔɔsra ye ɔ. Nakoso Nyameɛ aye ahyire me kyɛ onni kyɛ mebu sona biala kyɛ ɔbboka yɛ so, anaakyɛ ye nwo nde.

english_verse: I agreed to come here, but I want to know why you sent for me.”
translation_verse: Yiti yeɛ ɔmaa mambopo me ti wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔtole bɛ sa bɛfrɛle me ne. Na afei mepena kyɛ menwu nikyee bɔ yiti yeɛ ɛmɔsomane kyɛ bɛɛfa me ne.”

english_verse: Cornelius answered: Four days ago at about three o'clock in the afternoon I was praying at home. Suddenly a man in bright clothes stood in front of me.
translation_verse: Kɔneleo buale kyɛ, “Ɛlɛnna ɛhe, kɔyɛ bekye sɔa ala, né mebɔ mbaeɛ wɔ m’awuro wa eyia nnɔnmmiɛnza. Na nwuni bienzua bie bɔ owura ataadeɛ hyɛnn kyɛ ogyi me nyunu,

english_verse: He said, “Cornelius, God has heard your prayers, and he knows about your gifts to the poor.
translation_verse: na osele me kyɛ, ‘Kɔneleo, Nyameɛ ate wɔ mbaeɛbɔlɛ, na ye wora offili w’adɔeɛ bɔ ayɔ ama ehiafoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Now send to Joppa for Simon Peter. He is visiting in the home of Simon the leather maker, who lives near the sea.”
translation_verse: Yiti soma mmenia ma bɛhɔ Yopa bɛɛfa Simɔn bie bɔ besa bɛfrɛ ye Petro ne bɛbra. Ɔte Simɔn bie bɔ owura naen nwomaa ayire, bɔ ye awuro wɔ mboanoa ne berɛ.’

english_verse: I sent for you at once, and you have been good enough to come. All of us are here in the presence of the Lord God, so that we can hear what he has to say.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati berɛ ne ala nzomane kyɛ bɛɛfa wɔ bɛbra, na wɔ koso ayɔ nikyee kyɛ awa ɔ. Yiti kekesaala ye, yɛ mukoraa yayia Nyameɛ nyunu wɔ wa, kyɛ yɛbaatie nikyee biala bɔ Awurade ahyɛ wɔ kyɛ ɛha hyire yɛ ɔ.” Petro noa dwirɛ wɔ Kɔneleo awuro

english_verse: Peter then said: Now I am certain that God treats all people alike.
translation_verse: Na Petro sele kyɛ, “Nahorɛ nu, manwu kyɛ Nyameɛ nyɛ nyeyemuɛ,

english_verse: God is pleased with everyone who worships him and does right, no matter what nation they come from.
translation_verse: na mmom maen biala nu, ebiala bɔ osuro ye, ná ɔyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ne, ode ye to nu.

english_verse: This is the same message that God gave to the people of Israel, when he sent Jesus Christ, the Lord of all, to offer peace to them.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔse edwirɛ bɔ ɔfa brɛle Yisrael ɔ, mmerɛ bɔ ɔnate Yesu Kristo so ɔbɔle asomdwee nzɛmba ne nwo dawure ne; ye yeɛ ɔte ebiala Awurade ɔ.

english_verse: You surely know what happened everywhere in Judea. It all began in Galilee after John had told everyone to be baptized.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔse edwirɛ bɔ bɛbɔle ye dawure wɔ Yudea amukoraa, bɔ bɛhyɛle ye bo wɔ Galilea, asubɔlɛ bɔ Yahane hane ye nwo dwirɛ ne asi ne:

english_verse: God gave the Holy Spirit and power to Jesus from Nazareth. He was with Jesus, as he went around doing good and healing everyone who was under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ fale Sunzum Krongron ne tumi popale Yesu bɔ ofi Nasarɛte; kyɛbɔ ohyinihyini yɛlɛ paa, ɔsale bɛ bɔ abɔnzam hyɛ bɛ so amukoraa anwonyerɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ boka ye so.

english_verse: We all saw what Jesus did both in Israel and in the city of Jerusalem. Jesus was put to death on a cross.
translation_verse: Yɛte nikyee biala bɔ ɔyɔle wɔ Yisrael maen nu ne Yerusalem mukoraa nwo adanzefoɛ. Bɛbɔle ye mmeamudua nu behuni ye,

english_verse: But three days later, God raised him to life and let him be seen.
translation_verse: nakoso ye ɛlɛsa ne aso Nyameɛ tingyele ye fili ewue nu, na ɔmaa ɔyele ye nwo ali pefee hyirele.

english_verse: Not everyone saw him. He was seen only by us, who ate and drank with him after he was raised from death. We were the ones God chose to tell others about him.
translation_verse: Wanye ye nwo ali wangyire mmenia mukoraa, sana yɛ bɔ yɛte adanzefoɛ bɔ Nyameɛ aye yɛ dada nen; bɔ ye wutingyelɛ asi ne, yɛne ye didili na yɛnone ne.

english_verse: God told us to announce clearly to the people that Jesus is the one he has chosen to judge the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Na ɔhyɛle yɛ kyɛ yɛbɔ nzɛmba ne dawure yɛhyire mmenia mukoraa, ná yɛli adanzeɛ kyɛ, ye yeɛ Nyameɛ aye ye kyɛ ɔyɛ ateasefoɛ ne awufoɛ ndɛenbualɛniɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Every one of the prophets has said that all who have faith in Jesus will have their sins forgiven in his name.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ Nyameɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne amukoraa lili ye nwo adanzeɛ kyɛ ebiala bɔ ode ye di ne, ɔnate ye dumaa nu konya bɔnefakyɛ ɔ.” Amaenmaensofoɛ nya Sunzum Krongron ne

english_verse: While Peter was still speaking, the Holy Spirit took control of everyone who was listening.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Petro gu so odwudwo ne, Sunzum Krongron ne wale mmenia mukoraa bɔ betie ye dwirɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Some Jewish followers of the Lord had come with Peter, and they were surprised that the Holy Spirit had been given to Gentiles.
translation_verse: Na agyidifoɛ bɔ befi bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ nu bɔ bɛne Petro wale ne, ɔyɛle bɛ nwanwa kyɛ bahwie Sunzum Krongron akyɛdeɛ ne bagua Amaenmaensofoɛ mɔ koso so ɔ,

english_verse: Now they were hearing Gentiles speaking unknown languages and praising God. Peter said,
translation_verse: ɔnate kyɛ bɛtele kyɛ mmenia ne akakyi bɛ temverema bɛ́kã dwudwolɛ foforɛ ná bɛkamvo Nyameɛ ɔ. Na Petro hane kyɛ,

english_verse: “These Gentiles have been given the Holy Spirit, just as we have! I am certain that no one would dare stop us from baptizing them.”
translation_verse: “Sɔ mmenia hemɔ anya Sunzum Krongron ne kyɛbɔ yɛ koso yɛnyane ne ala. Aso ebie kɔhora kosi bɛ ate kyɛ nnɛmaa bɛfa nzue bɛbɔ bɛ asu anaa?”

english_verse: Peter ordered them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ, and they asked him to stay on for a few days.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔmaa bɛbɔle bɛ asu wɔ Awurade dumaa nu. Yeɛ bɛsrɛle ye kyɛ oli bɛ nwo berɛ kɔyɛ ɛlɛsa ko.

english_verse: The apostles and the followers in Judea heard that Gentiles had accepted God's message.
translation_verse: Na asomafoɛ nemɔ ne aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Yudea ne bɛtele kyɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ nemɔ koso bale Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne bali.

english_verse: So when Peter came to Jerusalem, some of the Jewish followers started arguing with him. They wanted Gentile followers to be circumcised, and
translation_verse: Yiti mmerɛ bɔ Petro wale Yerusalem nen, bɛ bɔ bɛte bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bɛne ye nyane dwudwolɛ

english_verse: they said, “You stayed in the homes of Gentiles, and you even ate with them!”
translation_verse: kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛhɔle bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ nemɔ berɛ, ná ɛne bɛ sa didili ne!”

english_verse: Then Peter told them exactly what had happened:
translation_verse: Na Petro hyɛle ye bo fale ye mukoraati bɔle bɛ amaneɛ ngoko ngoko kyɛ,

english_verse: I was in the town of Joppa and was praying when I fell sound asleep and had a vision. I saw heaven open, and something like a huge sheet held by its four corners came down to me.
translation_verse: “Né nwɔ Yopa kuro nu mebɔ mbaeɛ, na ngɔle nyekyire tebea nu, na nyekyire nu, nwuni nikyee bie bɔ ɔte kyɛ nwera pirikua, bɔ basosɔ ye noa nna ne anu, bɔ odwu fi nyameɛso ba ase ɔ, na oogyinane me nwo berɛ.

english_verse: When I looked in it, I saw animals, wild beasts, reptiles, and birds.
translation_verse: Nneane ye haa, na nwuni ndɔteboa, ngaka aboyaa, ngaka bɔ bɛtwe bɛ nwo ase ne ewienu nnomaa.

english_verse: I heard a voice saying to me, “Peter, get up! Kill these and eat them.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ ndele komviɛ bie kyɛ, ‘Petro, dwɔso ná ku bɛ di!’

english_verse: But I said, “Lord, I can't do that! I've never taken a bite of anything that is unclean and not fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Nakoso ngane kyɛ, ‘Daabi Awurade, nikyee biala bɔ bekyi anaa bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ, ɔhhane me noa le.’

english_verse: The voice from heaven spoke to me again, “When God says that something can be used for food, don't say it isn't fit to eat.”
translation_verse: Na komviɛ ne fili nyameɛso sili so bieku kyɛ, ‘Nikyee biala bɔ Nyameɛ ate ye nwo ne, nnebu ye kyɛ ɔte akyiwadeɛ.’

english_verse: This happened three times before it was all taken back into heaven.
translation_verse: Ɛhe hɔle so alaa pɛen nza, na afei besa bɛtwetwene nikyee ne amukoraati bɛhɔle nyameɛso.

english_verse: Suddenly three men from Caesarea stood in front of the house where I was staying.
translation_verse: Na berɛ ne ala, mmenia nza bie bɔ né basoma bɛ me berɛ fi Kaesarea ɔ, bɛwale beegyinane awuro bɔ né nde nu n’anoa nu.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit told me to go with them and not to worry. Then six of the Lord's followers went with me to the home of a man
translation_verse: Na Sunzum ne hã hyirele me kyɛ me ne bɛ yɛhɔ, na nnɛmaa meyɛ nyeyemuɛ. Sɔ aliɛmaa nzia hemɔ koso bɛbokale me so yeɛ yɛhɔle biaa n’awuro berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: who told us that an angel had appeared to him. The angel had ordered him to send to Joppa for someone named Simon Peter.
translation_verse: Na ɔhã hyirele yɛ kyɛbɔ osi nwuni abɔfo bie kyɛ ogyi ye awuro berɛ, ná osele ye, Kɔneleo, kyɛ, ‘Soma mmenia ma bɛhɔ Yopa bɛɛfa Simɔn bie bɔ besa bɛfrɛ ye Petro ne bɛbra,

english_verse: Then Peter would tell him how he and everyone in his house could be saved.
translation_verse: na ɔkɔhã edwirɛ kohyire wɔ bɔ ɔnate so ɛne w’awuro ama amukoraati ɛmɔkonya daa ngoa ɔ.’

english_verse: After I started speaking, the Holy Spirit was given to them, just as the Spirit had been given to us at the beginning.
translation_verse: Na nhyɛle ye bo kyɛ medwudwo ne ala yeɛ Sunzum Krongron ne wale bɛ so, kyɛbɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne ɔwale yɛ so ne ala.

english_verse: I remembered that the Lord had said, “John baptized with water, but you will be baptized with the Holy Spirit.”
translation_verse: Na ngayele Awurade dwirɛ bɔ ɔhane kyɛ, ‘Yohane fale nzue yeɛ ɔbɔle asu ɔ, na ɛmɔ de, bɛkɔfa Sunzum Krongron yeɛ bɛkɔbɔ ɛmɔ asu ɔ.’

english_verse: God gave those Gentiles the same gift that he gave us when we put our faith in the Lord Jesus Christ. So how could I have gone against God?
translation_verse: Na sɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔfale akyɛdeɛ komapɛ ne mane bɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔfa mane yɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ yɛlele Awurade Yesu Kristo yɛlili ne a, né me ole nwa bɔ mekora mesi Nyameɛ ate ɔ?”

english_verse: When they heard Peter say this, they stopped arguing and started praising God. They said, “God has now let Gentiles turn to him, and he has given life to them!” The Church in Antioch
translation_verse: Agyidifoɛ ne tele ye sɔ nen, banga ye nwo hwee ko, na bɛyele Nyameɛ ayɛ kyɛ, “Nzaade Nyameɛ ama Amaenmaensofoɛ koso adwenesakyera nwo ate bɔ ɔfa bɛ kɔ daa ngoa nu ɔ.” Antiokia Asɔre ne

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers had been scattered because of the terrible trouble that started when Stephen was killed. They went as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, but they told the message only to the Jews.
translation_verse: Setefano hunɛ ne asi ne, ayaayaadeɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛyɔle agyidifoɛ ne maa bɛbɔle aya. Ebiemɔ nwatili alaa beefitele Fonikia, Kipro ne Antiokia, na Yudafoɛ ngome yeɛ bɛhane nzɛmba ne behyirele bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Some of the followers from Cyprus and Cyrene went to Antioch and started telling Gentiles the good news about the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Na agyidifoɛ nemɔ bie koso bɔ né bɛwɔ Kipro ne Kirene hɔle Antiokia bɛɛbɔle Awurade Yesu nzɛmba ne dawure behyirele Helafoɛ koso.
