translation_verse: Nakoso, mesrɛ ɛmɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔ abasa nu bu! Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ nu biala ngɔhwere ye ngoa, sana ɛlɛen ne ngome yeɛ ɔkɔsɛkye ɔ.

english_verse: I belong to God, and I worship him. Last night he sent an angel
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, ɛnɛ kɔngɔen ye, Nyameɛ bɔ nde ye deɛ ná meso ye n’abɔfo wale me berɛ,

english_verse: to tell me, “Paul, don't be afraid! You will stand trial before the Emperor. And because of you, God will save the lives of everyone on the ship.”
translation_verse: na osele me kyɛ, ‘Pɔɔlo, nnɛsuro, na odi kyɛ ekogyina Kaesare nyunu. Na tie, ɔnate wɔ ti Nyameɛ ale bɛ bɔ bɛ ne wɔ tu atee ne amukoraa bɛ ngoa.’

english_verse: Cheer up! I am sure that God will do exactly what he promised.
translation_verse: Yiti, biamɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔ abasa nu bu! Na mede Nyameɛ medi kyɛ bɔ ɔhã hyirele me ne kɔyɛ berɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: But we will first be shipwrecked on some island.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔsɛ kyɛ mvrama ne bɔ yɛ kogua supɔ bie aso.”

english_verse: They cut the anchors loose and let them sink into the sea. At the same time they untied the ropes that were holding the rudders. Next, they raised the sail at the front of the ship and let the wind carry the ship toward the beach.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛpepɛle sɛkyɛ nemɔ nyamaa nu maa beguale ɛpo nu, na besa bɛsangyele ɛlɛen ne sitiya nyamaa nemɔ. Afei bɛfale ɛtena pirikua bie bɛkatale ɛlɛen ne nyunu maa mvrama ne bɔle ye hɔle moa, na ɔfale yɛ hɔle mboanoa.

english_verse: The sailors wanted to escape from the ship. So they lowered the lifeboat into the water, pretending that they were letting down some anchors from the front of the ship.
translation_verse: Afei ɛlɛenhanɛfoɛ nemɔ yɛle kyɛ bɛnwati befi ɛlɛen ne anu; yiti bɛyakyili ɛlɛen ba ne anu bɛtole nzue ne anu, na bɛyɛle kanda nikyee bie kyɛ bɛkwaayakyi sɛkyɛ nemɔ nu begua nzue ne anu wɔ y’ɛlɛen ne nyunu dɔ.

english_verse: The sailors were afraid that we might hit some rocks, and they let down four anchors from the back of the ship. Then they prayed for daylight.
translation_verse: Né besuro kyɛ yɛkɔɔfofo nyɔbotaen bie so; yiti bɛyakyili sɛkyɛ nna nu befili ɛlɛen ne abo dɔ beguale nzue ne anu, na yɛfa yɛnwondɛle alehyeleɛ.

english_verse: But Paul said to Captain Julius and the soldiers, “If the sailors don't stay on the ship, you won't have any chance to save your lives.”
translation_verse: Na Pɔɔlo sele asraafoɛ ɛyaa so panyi ɔne asraafoɛ nemɔ kyɛ, “Sɛ ɛlɛenhanɛfoɛ nemɔ anyakyi nwatilɛ bandena ɛlɛen ne anu a, ye de ɛmɔngonya ngoa.”

english_verse: The soldiers then cut the ropes that held the lifeboat and let it fall into the sea.
translation_verse: Yiti asraafoɛ nemɔ pepɛle ɛlɛen ba ne nyamaa nu, na bɛmaa nzue ne fale ye hɔle.

english_verse: Just before daylight Paul begged the people to eat something. He told them, “For
translation_verse: Aleɛ baahye ne, Pɔɔlo srɛle bɛ mukoraa kyɛ bedidi. Na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Eleburu ne nna ɛhe yeɛ ɛmɔafa ahunundetelɛ batena bahye hɔen bɔ bellili hwee ɔ.

english_verse: I beg you to eat something. Your lives depend on it. Do this and not one of you will be hurt.”
translation_verse: Yiti mesrɛ ɛmɔ, ɛmɔdidi kãa ná ɛmɔnya anwoserɛ, ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔ nu biala ti nwiaa ko po ngotu ngomini.”

english_verse: After Paul had said this, he took a piece of bread and gave thanks to God. Then in front of everyone, he broke the bread and ate some.
translation_verse: Na ɔhane sɔ dwirɛ nen, ɔfale paanoo, ɔlale Nyameɛ ase wɔ bɛ mukoraa bɛ nyunu berɛ, obubuli nu, na ɔhyɛle ye bo didili.

english_verse: They all felt encouraged, and each of them ate something.
translation_verse: Afei bɛ mukoraa bɛ wora kyekyele, na ebiala didili.

english_verse: and after everyone had eaten, they threw the cargo of wheat into the sea to make the ship lighter. The Shipwreck
translation_verse: Afei ebiala ko yili yiele nen, begyili ɛlɛen ne anu atokoɔ ne beguale ɛpo nu maa ɛlɛen ne anu yɛle nyera. Ɛlɛen ne butuli

english_verse: Morning came, and the ship's crew saw a coast they did not recognize. But they did see a cove with a beach. So they decided to try to run the ship aground on the beach.
translation_verse: Aleɛ hyene ne, né ɛlɛenhanɛfoɛ nemɔ ngora nwu aseɛ horɛ bɔ yadwu so ɔ; nakoso benwuni mboanoa nekaa bie bɔ ɔla ase ɔ, na bɛyɛle kyɛ bɛbɔ mmɔden bɛka ɛlɛen ne bɛkɔ berɛ.

english_verse: But it ran aground on a sandbank. The front of the ship stuck firmly in the sand, and the rear was being smashed by the force of the waves.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛlɛen ne fofole anweaa sire bie aso, na ɔhale berɛ; ye ti ne timuni bɔ betu ye a ondu ɔ, na asorɔkye bɔ né ɔbɔ serɛserɛ ne koso bubuli ye bo ne.

english_verse: The soldiers decided to kill the prisoners to keep them from swimming away and escaping.
translation_verse: Asraafoɛ nemɔ bɔle porɛ kyɛ bekohu kukunufoɛ ne ná bɛ nu biala wammia wannwati wangɔ.

english_verse: But Captain Julius wanted to save Paul's life, and he did not let the soldiers do what they had planned. Instead, he ordered everyone who could swim to jump into the water and head for shore.
translation_verse: Nakoso né asraafoɛ ɛyaa so panyi ne kuro kyɛ ode Pɔɔlo ngoa; yiti wambene so. Na mmom ɔhyɛle kyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛkɔhora bia ne beli moa begua nzue ne anu bɛhɔ etii so;

english_verse: Then he told the others to hold on to planks of wood or parts of the ship. At last, everyone safely reached shore.
translation_verse: na afei bɛ ngaa ne koso bɛpo bɛ; ebie butubutu ndaboa nemɔ so, na ebiemɔ koso bebutubutu ɛlɛen buburuwaa asiiasii nemɔ so. Yiti kyɛbɔ ɔyɛle bɔ yɛ mukoraa yɛnyane yɛ ti ngoa yɛwale etii so hɔ ɛne o.

english_verse: When we came ashore, we learned that the island was called Malta.
translation_verse: Yɛnyane yɛ ti ngoa yɛyiele nen, yɛtele kyɛ bɛfrɛ sɔ supɔ ne Mɔɔta.

english_verse: The local people were very friendly, and they welcomed us by building a fire, because it was rainy and cold.
translation_verse: Supɔ ne aso ama yɛle yɛ paa paa. Esue bɔ né ɔtɔ ne fale ɛyerɛ wale, yiti behuane see bɛmaa yɛ mukoraa yɛtenane ye nwo.

english_verse: After Paul had gathered some wood and had put it on the fire, the heat caused a snake to crawl out, and it bit him on the hand.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo sesale nwuaka guale see ne anu, na ɔnate see ne hyerɛ ne ati, ewoo bie fili nwuaka ne anu fitele, na ɔbrabrale ye sa.

english_verse: When the local people saw the snake hanging from Paul's hand, they said to each other, “This man must be a murderer! He didn't drown in the sea, but the goddess of justice will kill him anyway.”
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ supɔ ne aso ama nwuni kyɛ ewoo ne abrabra ye sa nen, besisele bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Aporowaa biala nne ye nwo, biaa he te wudiniɛ. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ wanya ye ti ngoa wafi ɛpo nu de, nakoso ye bɔne nwo asohwenɛ bɔ oli ye si ngɔma ongonya ngoa.”

english_verse: Paul shook the snake off into the fire and wasn't harmed.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔpetene ewoo ne tole see ne anu bɔ ɛhwee anyɛ ye ɔ.

english_verse: The people kept thinking that Paul would either swell up or suddenly drop dead. They watched him for a long time, and when nothing happened to him, they changed their minds and said, “This man is a god.”
translation_verse: Né berɛ ama ne dwene kyɛ ɔngɔhyɛ biala ye nwo konwunwu, anaakyɛ ɔkɔpɛ kofi kowu. Nakoso bɛneane alaa bɔ ɛhwee biala anyɛ ye ne, benyane adwene foforɛ, na bɛhane kyɛ, “Bosoen bie ɔ!”

english_verse: The governor of the island was named Publius, and he owned some of the land around there. Publius was very friendly and welcomed us into his home for three days.
translation_verse: Berɛ ne nekaa bɔ supɔ ne aso panyi Publio aseɛ wɔ ne anwa biala. Olele yɛ nyemene so, na yɛlili ye awuro berɛ ɛlɛsa.

english_verse: His father was in bed, sick with fever and stomach trouble, and Paul went to visit him. Paul healed the man by praying and placing his hands on him.
translation_verse: Né ebunu ahye Publio baba ato berɛ; asa koso né ahunundulɛ aha ye. Pɔɔlo hɔle ye berɛ ɔɔbɔle mbaeɛ mane ye, na ɔfale ye sa guale ye so maa ɔtele apɔ.

english_verse: After this happened, everyone on the island brought their sick people to Paul, and they were all healed.
translation_verse: Na sɔ dwirɛ ne sili nen, supɔ ne aso ayarefoɛ mukoraa wale maa Pɔɔlo sale bɛ anwonyerɛ.

english_verse: The people were very respectful to us, and when we sailed, they gave us everything we needed. From Malta to Rome
translation_verse: Bɛhyɛle yɛ nningyein pee paa, na nziɛ ye yɛfi berɛ yɛkɔ ne, bɛmane yɛ nningyein bɔ yɛkohia wɔ yɛ ateetulɛ ne anu ɔ. Yɛfili Mɔɔta yɛhɔle Rome

english_verse: Three months later we sailed in a ship that had been docked at Malta for the winter. The ship was from Alexandria in Egypt and was known as “The Twin Gods.”
translation_verse: Bosome nza pɛle nu, na afei yɛfole ɛlɛen bie bɔ “Bosoen Ndaa” sɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ ye nyunu, bɔ ofi Aleksandria yɛhɔle. Né ɛlɛen ne ali prakasua mmerɛ ne wɔ supɔ ne aso.

english_verse: We arrived in Syracuse and stayed for three days.
translation_verse: Yɛɛgyinane kuro bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Sirako so, na yɛlili berɛ ɛlɛsa.

english_verse: From there we sailed to Rhegium. The next day a south wind began to blow, and two days later we arrived in Puteoli.
translation_verse: Yɛfili berɛ yɛkondone y’atee ne alaa yɛɛdwuli kuro bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Regyiom so. Aleɛ hyene ne, mvrama bie bɔle fili ngwaen, na ye elenyɔ ne aso yɛɛdwuli kuro bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Puteoli so.

english_verse: There we found some of the Lord's followers, who begged us to stay with them. A week later we left for the city of Rome.
translation_verse: Yɛnwuni agyidifoɛ biemɔ berɛ, na bɛsrɛle yɛ kyɛ yɛli bɛ nwo berɛ ɛlɛsoo. Yiti yɛɛdwuli Rome.

english_verse: Some of the followers in Rome heard about us and came to meet us at the Market of Appius and at the Three Inns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and was encouraged. Paul in Rome
translation_verse: Rome agyidifoɛ tele yɛ nga nen, bɛwale tonn beeyiale yɛ wɔ Apeɔse dwaanu ɔne nekaa bie bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Ɛwɔfoɛ Sua Nza nu. Na Pɔɔlo nwuni bɛ ne, ɔlale Nyameɛ ase, na ɔmaa ye ahone tɔle ye kunu.

english_verse: We arrived in Rome, and Paul was allowed to live in a house by himself with a soldier to guard him.
translation_verse: Yɛdwuli Rome nen, Pɔɔlo de, bɛmane ye ate kyɛ ɔne asraaniɛ bɔ ɔnea ye so ne bɛɛtena nekaa bɔ Pɔɔlo bɔbɔ okuro ɔ. Pɔɔlo ka nzɛmba wɔ Rome

english_verse: Three days after we got there, Paul called together some of the Jewish leaders and said: My friends, I have never done anything to hurt our people, and I have never gone against the customs of our ancestors. But in Jerusalem I was handed over as a prisoner to the Romans.
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛsa ne aso, Pɔɔlo tole ye sa frɛle Yudafoɛ mbanyi bɔ bɛwɔ Rome maa beyiale, na osele bɛ kyɛ, “Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ manyɔ tɛɛ biala mandia yɛ mmenia anaakyɛ yɛ nana mɔ amanneɛ ne de, nakoso Yudafoɛ maa bɛtole me kuku nu wɔ Yerusalem, na bɛfale me bewurale Romanfoɛ sa.

english_verse: They looked into the charges against me and wanted to release me. They found that I had not done anything deserving death.
translation_verse: Roman mbanyi neaneane me dwirɛ ne anu yiele nen, ahaa bɛpena kyɛ bɛyakyi me, ofikyɛ bannwu nikyee biala bɔ mayɔ bɔ ɔmaa mefata ehunɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Jewish leaders disagreed, so I asked to be tried by the Emperor. But I don't have anything to say against my own nation.
translation_verse: Nakoso Yudafoɛ ambene so, yiti ɛhe maa ngane kyɛ bɛye dwirɛ ne bɛhɔ Kaesare gya so; na ɔtte kyɛ ebiaa me ne me maen yɛbaabɔ nguro ɔ.

english_verse: I am bound by these chains because of what we people of Israel hope for. This is why I have called you here to talk about this hope of ours.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ati yeɛ ɔmaa ndole me sa mvrɛle ɛmɔ kyɛ me ne ɛmɔ yɛbaali ngɔmɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔnate Yisrael anyelasoɛ ti yeɛ bagua me ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ ye.”

english_verse: The leaders replied, “No one from Judea has written us a letter about you. And not one of them has come here to report on you or to say anything against you.
translation_verse: Na besele ye kyɛ, “Yɛnnyane krataa biala bɔ ɔfa wɔ nwo yɛffili Yudea; asa koso aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ befi dɔ bɛba ne anu biala nne berɛ bɔ waabɔ amaneɛ, anaakyɛ waahã wɔ nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But we would like to hear what you have to say. We understand that people everywhere are against this new group.”
translation_verse: Nakoso yɛpena kyɛ ekyire yɛ w’adwene, ɔnate kyɛ yɛse kyɛ nekaa biala mmenia dwudwo tia sɔ som he.”

english_verse: They agreed on a time to meet with Paul, and many of them came to his house. From early morning until late in the afternoon, Paul talked to them about God's kingdom. He used the Law of Moses and the Books of the Prophets to try to win them over to Jesus.
translation_verse: Bɛ ne Pɔɔlo hyɛle kyẽa, na kyẽa ne dwuli ne, mmeni pee wale ye berɛ wɔ nekaa bɔ ɔte ne. Ɔhane Nyameɛ ahennie ne nwo dwirɛ, na ohyirehyirele nu hyirele bɛ. Na ɔfale Mose mmeraa ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ dwirɛ ne hyirele bɛ Yesu nwo dwirɛ tonn fite ngyerɛmɔ ma aleɛ dwole.

english_verse: Some of the leaders agreed with what Paul said, but others did not.
translation_verse: Bɛ nu biemɔ lele bɔ ɔhane ne lili, nakoso ebiemɔ de, banne banni.

english_verse: Since they could not agree among themselves, they started leaving. But Paul said, “The Holy Spirit said the right thing when he sent Isaiah the prophet
translation_verse: Bɛ ne bɛ nwo anyɛ adwene; na anzana bɛbaafi berɛ bɛkɔ ne, Pɔɔlo ha hyirele bɛ kyɛ “Edwirɛ bɔ Sunzum Krongron ne nate ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ Yesaya so ha hyirele ɛmɔ nana mɔ ne te nahorɛ turoloo!

english_verse: to tell our ancestors, ‘Go to these people and tell them: You will listen and listen, but never understand. You will look and look, but never see.
translation_verse: Ɔnwa: ‘Kɔhã kyire mmenia hemɔ kyɛ, Ye tielɛ de ɛmɔkotie, nakoso ɛmɔngɔte ye bo; ye nealɛ de ɛmɔkɔnea, nakoso ɛmɔngonwu ye.

english_verse: All of you have stubborn hearts. Your ears are stopped up, and your eyes are covered. You cannot see or hear or understand. If you could, you would turn to me, and I would heal you.’ ”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ maen he b’adwene ala, batuatua bɛ so, yeɛ bamuamua bɛ nye. Anyɛ a, né bɛ nye anwu nikye, né bɛ so ate dwirɛ, né b’adwene ate dwirɛ bo, ná basa bawa me berɛ maa masa bɛ anwonyerɛ.’ ”

english_verse: Paul said, “You may be sure that God wants to save the Gentiles! And they will listen.”
translation_verse: Na ɔhane sɔ dwirɛ nen, Yudafoɛ nemɔ fale aporowaasulɛ kyengyekyengye bedwɔso bɛhɔle.]

english_verse: For two years Paul stayed in a rented house and welcomed everyone who came to see him.
translation_verse: Afoɛ nyɔ mumua yeɛ Pɔɔlo tenane sua bɔ né ye bɔbɔ otua ye kerɛ nu ɔ, na berɛ yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛɛsrale ye ne amukoraa bɛwale ɔ.

english_verse: He bravely preached about God's kingdom and taught about the Lord Jesus Christ, and no one tried to stop him.
translation_verse: Ɔhane Nyameɛ ahennie ne nwo dwirɛ; ɔyɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ fale Awurade Yesu Kristo nwo, na osili ye ahone yɔle sɔ nikyee ne bɔ ebiala anzi ye ate ɔ.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of Christ Jesus. God chose me to be an apostle, and he appointed me to preach the good news
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo, Yesu Kristo akoaa, bɔ bafrɛ me kyɛ mmanyɛ somafoɛ, ná batu me basie berɛ bama Nyameɛ nzɛmba ne,

english_verse: that he promised long ago by what his prophets said in the holy Scriptures.
translation_verse: bɔ ɔnate ye ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ so hyɛle ye nwo bɔ tole berɛ wɔ Ahyerɛlɛ Krongron ne anu,

english_verse: This good news is about his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ! As a human, he was from the family of David. But the Holy Spirit proved that Jesus is the powerful Son of God, because he was raised from death.
translation_verse: bɔ bafa tumi baye ye bahyire kyɛ Nyameɛ Awa, kyɛbɔ anwotelɛ Sunzum te ne, awufoɛ tingyelɛ nu, Yesu Kristo, yɛ Awurade,

english_verse: Jesus was kind to me and chose me to be an apostle, so that people of all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: bɔ ɔnate ye so yeɛ yanya adom ne asomafoɛ adwuma bɔ yɛfa yɛma amaen maen mukoraa bɛyɛ sotie wɔ gyidie ne dumaa ne anwo,

english_verse: You are some of those people chosen by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: bɔ ɛmɔ bɔ bafrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔɔyɛ Yesu Kristo deɛ ne koso ɛmɔboka so ɔ.

english_verse: This letter is to all of you in Rome. God loves you and has chosen you to be his very own people. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: Mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ Nyameɛ kuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ bɔ ɛmɔwɔ Rome, bɔ wafrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔɔyɛ anwoteefoɛ ɔ. Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. Pɔɔlo bɔ asennaa mbaeɛ

english_verse: First, I thank God in the name of Jesus Christ for all of you. I do this because people everywhere in the world are talking about your faith.
translation_verse: Bɔ oli moa ɔ, ɔnate ɛmɔ amukoraa ti mefa Yesu Kristo so meda me Nyameɛ ase, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ gyidie ne nwo dwirɛ adwu wiase nekaa biala.

english_verse: God has seen how I never stop praying for you, while I serve him with all my heart and tell the good news about his Son.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bɔ meso ye sunzum nu, ná mebɔ Ɔwa ne nzɛmba ne dawure ne, odi me adanzeɛ kyɛ nnyakyili ɛmɔ dumaa bɔlɛ le wɔ me mbaeɛbɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: In all my prayers, I ask God to make it possible for me to visit you.
translation_verse: Mesrɛ Nyameɛ daa kyɛ ɔyɛ ye pɛ kyɛ ɔkɔma me ate maa ngɔɔpasa ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I want to see you and share with you the same blessings that God's Spirit has given me. Then you will grow stronger in your faith.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me wora dɔ ɛmɔ, kyɛ ngɔfa sunzum nu akyɛdeɛ ngɔbrɛ ɛmɔ, ná wahyɛ ɛmɔ nguraen;

english_verse: What I am saying is that we can encourage each other by the faith that is ours.
translation_verse: mekyire kyɛ, ɔnate ɛmɔ gyidie ne me deɛ so, yɛ mukoraa yɛkonya aworakyekyerɛ wɔ yɛ nu.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that I have often planned to come for a visit. But something has always kept me from doing it. I want to win followers to Christ in Rome, as I have done in many other places.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, mekuro kyɛ ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ, mmerɛ pee yeɛ mayɛ m’adwene kyɛ ngɔɔpasa ɛmɔ nwo ɔ, amaa me nzɛmbahanɛ ne asakyera ɛmɔ nu bie, kyɛbɔ wayɛ wama Amaenmaensofoɛ ngaa nen, nakoso ɔyɛ a né nikyee foforɛ bie asi m’ate.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if people are civilized and educated, or if they are uncivilized and uneducated. I must tell the good news to everyone. That's why I am eager to visit all of you in Rome. The Power of the Good News
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati yeɛ mepere kyɛ ngɔhã nzɛmba ne ngohyire ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔwɔ Rome ne koso ɔ. Tumi wɔ nzɛmba ne anu

english_verse: I am proud of the good news! It is God's powerful way of saving all people who have faith, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Na nzɛmba ne nwo nyɛ me nya, ofikyɛ ɔte Nyameɛ tumi bɔ ɔkɔ ngoalelɛ nu ma bɛ bɔ bede bedi amukoraa, Yudafoɛ yeɛ beli moa ɔ, yeɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ koso bɛtoa berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The good news tells how God accepts everyone who has faith, but only those who have faith. It is just as the Scriptures say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.” Everyone Is Guilty
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nzɛmba ne kyire kyɛ, Nyameɛ siesie kuro sona ne ye afia maa bɛyɛ ko: na ɛhe gyi gyidie ngome so. Kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Teneneeniɛ de, ɔnate ye gyidie so yeɛ okonya ngoa ɔ.” Adasa di bɔne nwo fɔ

english_verse: From heaven God shows how angry he is with all the wicked and evil things that sinful people do to crush the truth.
translation_verse: Na bɛda Nyameɛ ahonehulɛ ne ali befi nyameɛso bɛfa betia mmenia bɔ benzuro Nyameɛ ná bɛ yɔleɛ ndengyɛ, bɔ bɛfa b’amumuyɛɛ so besi nahorɛ ne nwo atee ɔ.

english_verse: They know everything that can be known about God, because God has shown it all to them.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ nikyee biala bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ benwu ye fa Nyameɛ nwo ne, wala ye ali pefee wahyire bɛ.

english_verse: God's eternal power and character cannot be seen. But from the beginning of creation, God has shown what these are like by all he has made. That's why those people don't have any excuse.
translation_verse: Ofi mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ bɔle wiase ɔ, ye tumi afebɔɔ ne ɔne ye Nyameɛ sue te nikyee bɔ yɛmva yɛ nye nnwu ye ɔ, nakoso waye bɛ ali wahyire yɛ wɔ ye abɔdeɛ nu, yiti belle nyeanoɛ biala.

english_verse: They know about God, but they don't honor him or even thank him. Their thoughts are useless, and their stupid minds are in the dark.
translation_verse: Né bɛse Nyameɛ de, nakoso banhyɛ ye animnyam kyɛ Nyameɛ, banna ye ase, na mmom b’adwene yɛle ngwaseaa adwene, na bɛ ti anu adwene yɛle awosii.

english_verse: They claim to be wise, but they are fools.
translation_verse: Bɛdwenene kyɛ bɛse nworɛ, nakoso bɛte ngwaseafoɛ.

english_verse: They don't worship the glorious and eternal God. Instead, they worship idols that are made to look like humans who cannot live forever, and like birds, animals, and reptiles.
translation_verse: Bɛfale Nyameɛ bɔ onwu ɔ n’animnyam bɛsesane honi mɔ bɔ bɛte kyɛ kuro sona bɔ owu ɔ, ɔne nnomaa ne ndɔteboa ne ngaka bɔ bɛtwe bɛ nwo ase ɔ.

english_verse: So God let these people go their own way. They did what they wanted to do, and their filthy thoughts made them do shameful things with their bodies.
translation_verse: Yiti Nyameɛ pole b’akɔnnɔ fiɛ bra ne mane bɛ maa beguaguale bɛ nwo bɛ nwo nipadua nwo fiɛ.

english_verse: They gave up the truth about God for a lie, and they worshiped God's creation instead of God, who will be praised forever. Amen.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nahorɛ bɔ ɔfa Nyameɛ nwo ne bɛfa bɛsesane ngondombo. Bɛsɔnene na bɛsole abɔdeɛ, na bɛyakyili Ɛdangama Nyameɛ bɔ saleɛ te ye deɛ afebɔɔ ne! Amen.

english_verse: God let them follow their own evil desires. Women no longer wanted to have sex in a natural way, and they did things with each other that were not natural.
translation_verse: Ɔnate sɔ ati, Nyameɛ pole b’animguaseɛ akɔnnɔ bra ne mane bɛ. Bɛ mmrasua mɔ ne bɛ mmango mmrasua bɛlelale bɔ otia abɔdeɛ nu nhyehyɛleɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Men behaved in the same way. They stopped wanting to have sex with women and had strong desires for sex with other men. They did shameful things with each other, and what has happened to them is punishment for their foolish deeds.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ mmienzua yakyili kyɛ bɛ ne mmrasua kɔla ɔ, na bɛsosɔle kyɛ kyea bɛmane bɛ nwo. Mmienzua ne mmienzua beguaguale bɛ nwo fiɛ, na bɛ sa hane bɛ bɔne ne nwo akatuaa bɔ ɔfata ɔ.

english_verse: Since these people refused even to think about God, he let their useless minds rule over them. That's why they do all sorts of indecent things.
translation_verse: Bɛpole kyɛ bekonwu Nyameɛ nwo nimdeɛ, yiti Nyameɛ pole bɛ bɔbɔ b’adwene fiɛ ne mane bɛ, maa bɛyɔle nningyein bɔ ɔmvata ɔ.

english_verse: They are evil, wicked, and greedy, as well as mean in every possible way. They want what others have, and they murder, argue, cheat, and are hard to get along with. They gossip,
translation_verse: Sɔ bɔne hemɔ ayi bɛ ti anu tɛkyɛ, amumuyɛɛ, aborɛ, anyeboroborolɛ, ɛpɔen, anyeborolɛ, awuelilɛ, patapaa, nnakannaka, kanda, nzekure;

english_verse: They know God has said that anyone who acts this way deserves to die. But they keep on doing evil things, and they even encourage others to do them.
translation_verse: Bɛse Nyameɛ mmeraa ne kyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ sɔ nningyein nemɔ ne, ewue yeɛ ɔfata bɛ ɔ. Nna kyɛ bɛyɔ sɔ nningyein hemɔ angome, na mmom bɛhyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ sɔ ne nguraen.

english_verse: Some of you accuse others of doing wrong. But there is no excuse for what you do. When you judge others, you condemn yourselves, because you are guilty of doing the very same things.
translation_verse: Yiti kuro sona, wɔ ole nwa bɔ ebua ebiɛngo ndɛen ɔ? Sɛ ebua ebiɛngo ndɛen a, né ebua wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo ndɛen. Ofikyɛ wɔ bɔ ebua sɔ ndɛen ne, wɔ koso ɛyɔ sɔ yɔleɛ ne bie.

english_verse: We know that God is right to judge everyone who behaves in this way.
translation_verse: Na yɛse kyɛ Nyameɛ ndɛen bɔ obua bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ sɔ nningyein ne te nahorɛ.

english_verse: Do you really think God won't punish you, when you behave exactly like the people you accuse?
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ ɛyɔ sɔ nningyein nemɔ, na sɛ ebua bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ bie ne ndɛen a, aso esusu kyɛ Nyameɛ ndɛenbualɛ ne kɔpa wɔ ti?

english_verse: You surely don't think much of God's wonderful goodness or of his patience and willingness to put up with you. Don't you know that the reason God is good to you is because he wants you to turn to him?
translation_verse: Aso ɛmva Nyameɛ paayɛlɛ mmorosoɛ ne ye aboterɛ pee ne nyɛ hwee hɔ ɔ? Ɛnze kyɛ Nyameɛ paayɛlɛ ne ɔboka wɔ maa ɛsakyera w’adwene hɔ ɔ?

english_verse: But you are stubborn and refuse to turn to God. So you are making things even worse for yourselves on that day when he will show how angry he is and will judge the world with fairness.
translation_verse: Ɛnze kyɛ ɛyɔ asoserɛ na epini w’ahone a, né ɛboaboa Nyameɛ yaa piri paa noa ma wɔ nwo wɔ ɛyaafɛlɛ piri kyẽa bɔ Nyameɛ baabua ye tenenee ndɛen ne ɔ?

english_verse: God will reward each of us for what we have done.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ kotua sona biala nikyee bɔ wayɔ ɔ nwo kerɛ.

english_verse: He will give eternal life to everyone who has patiently done what is good in the hope of receiving glory, honor, and life that lasts forever.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bemia bɛ nye bɛyɔ paa, na bɛpena animnyam, anidie ne daa ngoa nen, bɛ yeɛ Nyameɛ kɔma bɛ daa ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: But he will show how angry and furious he can be with every selfish person who rejects the truth and wants to do evil.
translation_verse: Yiti Nyameɛ kɔfɛ bɛ bɔ bɛte pɛsɛmangomenya ná bɛyɛ nahorɛ ne nwo asoserɛ, ná afei bedi bɔne si ne aso yaa piri paa, ná wamaa banwu amaneɛ.

english_verse: All who are wicked will be punished with trouble and suffering. It doesn't matter if they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Amaneɛnwunɛ ne ahometrɛ kɔwa sona biala bɔ odi bɔne so; Yudafoɛ yeɛ beli moa ɔ, yeɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ toa berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But all who do right will be rewarded with glory, honor, and peace, whether they are Jews or Gentiles.
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ kɔma bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ paa mukoraa animnyam, anidie ne asomdwee. Yudafoɛ yeɛ beli moa ɔ, yeɛ Helafoɛ toa berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: God doesn't have any favorites!
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ nnea sona nyunu mmua ndɛen.

english_verse: Those people who don't know about God's Law will still be punished for what they do wrong. And the Law will be used to judge everyone who knows what it says.
translation_verse: Amaenmaensofoɛ bɔ bɛnze Mose mmeraa ne, sɛ bɛyɔ bɔne a, nna Mose mmeraa so yeɛ bekogyina bekobua bɛ ndɛen maa bekomini ɔ. Nakoso Yudafoɛ bɔ bɛ de bɛse Mose mmeraa nen, sɛ bɛyɔ bɔne a, Mose mmeraa ne aso yeɛ bekogyina bekobua bɛ ndɛen ɔ.

english_verse: God accepts those who obey his Law, but not those who simply hear it.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nna bɛ bɔ bɛse mmeraa ne yeɛ bɛte teneneefoɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ, na mmom bɛ bɔ bedi mmeraa ne aso yeɛ bekobua bɛ be ɔ.

english_verse: This proves that the conscience is like a law written in the human heart. And it will show whether we are forgiven or condemned,
translation_verse: Bɛ yɔleɛ kyire kyɛ, bahyerɛ bɔ mmeraa ne hyɛ sona kyɛ ɔyɔ ne wɔ b’ahone nu, yeɛ bɛ tiboa koso di adanzeɛ kyɛ ɛhe te nahorɛ. Ofikyɛ ɔtɔ mmerɛ bie a, b’adwene bɔ bɛ kwaadu; na ɔtɔ mmerɛ bie koso a, b’adwene bua bɛ be.

english_verse: when God appoints Jesus Christ to judge everyone's secret thoughts, just as my message says. The Jews and the Law
translation_verse: Yiti kyɛbɔ me nzɛmba ne okyire ne, sɔ kyẽa ne, Nyameɛ kɔfa Yesu Kristo so kobua sona biala ye mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ nwo ndɛen ɔ. Yudafoɛ nni mmeraa ne so

english_verse: Some of you call yourselves Jews. You trust in the Law and take pride in God.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛfrɛ wɔ nwo Yudaniɛ, na ɛfa wɔ nwo to mmeraa ne aso, na ɛfa Nyameɛ hoahoa wɔ nwo;

english_verse: By reading the Scriptures you learn how God wants you to behave, and you discover what is right.
translation_verse: na sɛ ɛse Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ, na asua fi mmeraa ne anu anwu bɔ ɔte paa ɔ;

english_verse: You are sure that you are a guide for the blind and a light for all who are in the dark.
translation_verse: na sɛ ede di kyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛse anyesiniwaafoɛ atee kyire ɔ, na esa te bɛ bɔ bɛte awosii nu kanea,

english_verse: And since there is knowledge and truth in God's Law, you think you can instruct fools and teach young people.
translation_verse: ɔne kyɛ ɛte bɛ bɔ bɛnze nworɛ ɔ bɛ foɛtulɛniɛ, ɔne ngokwaammaa kyerɛkyerɛniɛ, na sɛ w’adwene si wɔ pi kyɛ ɛse mmeraa ne anu nimdeɛ ne nahorɛ,

english_verse: But how can you teach others when you refuse to learn? You preach it is wrong to steal. But do you steal?
translation_verse: na afei esa kyire ebiemɔ nikyee a, nzu ati yeɛ engyire wɔ nwo nikye ɔ? Wɔ bɔ edwudwo tia awue ne, aso wɔ bɔbɔ ewua?

english_verse: You say people should be faithful in marriage. But are you faithful? You hate idols, yet you rob their temples.
translation_verse: Wɔ bɔ ɛkã kyɛ nnɛmaa bɛsɛkye agyaa ne, aso ɛsɛkye agyaa? Wɔ bɔ ekyi mmosoen nen, aso ɛyɔ musue nikyee wɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua nu?

english_verse: You take pride in the Law, but you disobey the Law and bring shame to God.
translation_verse: Wɔ bɔ ɛfa mmeraa ne hoahoa wɔ nwo ne, aso ebu mmeraa ne aso gua Nyameɛ nyunu ase anaa?

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures tell us, “You have made foreigners say insulting things about God.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Ɔnate ɛmɔ Yudafoɛ ti, Amaenmaensofoɛ bedwudwo betia Nyameɛ.”

english_verse: Being circumcised is worthwhile, if you obey the Law. But if you don't obey the Law, you are no better off than people who are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Sɛ edi mmeraa ne aso de a, né wɔ bienzua bɔ bapɛ ne nwo le mvasoɛ, nakoso sɛ ebu mmeraa ne aso de a, né ɛte kyɛ ebie bɔ bɛppɛle ye bienzua koraa ɔ.

english_verse: In fact, if they obey the Law, they are as good as anyone who is circumcised.
translation_verse: Sɛ Amaenmaensoniɛ bɔ bɛppɛle ye bienzua ɔ odi mmeraa ne anu dwirɛ so a, aso bengobu ye kyɛ bapɛ ye bienzua anaa?

english_verse: So everyone who obeys the Law, but has never been circumcised, will condemn you. Even though you are circumcised and have the Law, you still don't obey its teachings.
translation_verse: Nzaade bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ bɔ bedi mmeraa ne aso ne, bekobua ɛmɔ bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ bɔ ɛmɔse mmeraa ne ná koso ɛmɔbu mmeraa ne aso ne ndɛen.

english_verse: Just because you live like a Jew and are circumcised doesn't make you a real Jew.
translation_verse: Nna Yudaniɛ kaenn ole bɔ bapɛ ye bienzua anwoɔnaen nu ɔ. Yeɛ bienzuapɛlɛ paa koso ɔtte bɛ nye so nikye.

english_verse: To be a real Jew you must obey the Law. True circumcision is something that happens deep in your heart, not something done to your body. And besides, you should want praise from God and not from humans.
translation_verse: Na mmom Yudaniɛ kaenn ole sona bɔ ɔte Yudaniɛ wɔ ahone nu ɔ; ɔte sunzum nu nikye, na ɔtte anwoɔnaen nu nikye. Nna kuro sona, na mmom Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔye sɔ sona ne ayɛ ɔ.

english_verse: It is good in a lot of ways! First of all, God's messages were spoken to the Jews.
translation_verse: Ye nwo le mvasoɛ atee pee so! Bɔ oli moa ɔ, Nyameɛ fale ye noa dwirɛ wurale Yudafoɛ bɛ sa.

english_verse: If our evil deeds show how right God is, then what can we say? Is it wrong for God to become angry and punish us? What a foolish thing to ask.
translation_verse: Sɛ yɛ bɔne boka ma Nyameɛ tenenee da adi petee a, ye de yɛkɔha ye sɛ? Yiti sɛ Nyameɛ fɛ yɛ so yaa a né wayɛ tɛɛ anaa? .

english_verse: But the answer is, “No.” Otherwise, how could God judge the world?
translation_verse: Dabida! Sɛ Nyameɛ nga nahorɛ a, nzaade ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né wabua wiase ndɛen?

english_verse: Since your lies bring great honor to God by showing how truthful he is, you may ask why God still says you are a sinner.
translation_verse: Na sɛ me ngondombo ma Nyameɛ nahorɛ da di petee maa onya animnyam a, né nzu ati yeɛ bebua me ndɛen kyɛ nde bɔnefoɛ ɔ?

english_verse: You might as well say, “Let's do something evil, so that something good will come of it!” Some people even claim that we are saying this. But God is fair and will judge them as well. No One Is Good
translation_verse: Ebiemɔ to yɛ soen kyɛ yɛnwa, “Ɛ́mɔma yɛyɔ bɔne ná paa fi nu bra.” Na bekobua bɛ ye nwo ndɛen kyɛbɔ ɔfata ɔ. Kuro sona biala ndengyɛ (Edwein

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean that we Jews are better off than the Gentiles? No, it doesn't! Jews, as well as Gentiles, are ruled by sin, just as I have said.
translation_verse: Sɛ sɔ yeɛ ɔte hɔ a, né yɛ Yudafoɛ yɛte paa yɛtra Amaenmaensofoɛ anaa? Dabida! Ɔnate kyɛ yali moa yahyire kyɛ Yudafoɛ ne Amaenmaensofoɛ mukoraa wura bɔne tumi bo.

english_verse: The Scriptures tell us, “No one is acceptable to God!
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Sona biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔte teneneeniɛ ɔ, ko po nne berɛ;

english_verse: Not one of them understands or even searches for God.
translation_verse: sona biala nne berɛ bɔ ole ndeaseɛ ɔ. Ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔpena Nyameɛ si atee ɔ.

english_verse: They have all turned away and are worthless. There isn't one person who does right.
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa bali makyebu; bɛ nu biala nwo olle mvasoɛ, ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔyɔ paa ɔ, ko po nne berɛ.

english_verse: Their words are like an open pit, and their tongues are good only for telling lies. Each word is as deadly as the fangs of a snake,
translation_verse: Bɛ noa dwirɛ te asieleɛ bɔ so abukye ɔ, na bɛfa bɛ temverema bɛlakalaka mmenia, ewoo noa borɔ wɔ bɛ noa nu.

english_verse: and they say nothing but bitter curses.
translation_verse: Amoenwaa ne edwirɛ yealɛ ayi bɛ noa nu tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: These people quickly become violent.
translation_verse: Bɛ nwo yɛ nyera wɔ awuelilɛ nu,

english_verse: Wherever they go, they leave ruin and destruction.
translation_verse: na nekaa biala bɔ bekotia ne, bɛma basabasayɔlɛ ne amaneɛnwunɛ ba berɛ.

english_verse: They don't know how to live in peace.
translation_verse: Asomdwee atee de bɛnze,

english_verse: They don't even fear God.”
translation_verse: yeɛ Nyameɛ surolɛ nne bɛ nu.”

english_verse: We know that everything in the Law was written for those who are under its power. The Law says these things to stop anyone from making excuses and to let God show that the whole world is guilty.
translation_verse: Afei yɛse kyɛ nikyee biala bɔ mmeraa ne kã ne, ɔkã kyire bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ mmeraa ne abo ɔ. Na ɔnate sɔ ne ati, ebiala ngɔhora ngɔhã ngɔtete ye nwo, na Nyameɛ kobua wiase amukoraa ndɛen.

english_verse: God doesn't accept people simply because they obey the Law. No, indeed! All the Law does is to point out our sin. God's Way of Accepting People
translation_verse: Yiti bengogyina mmeraa nnwumaa so bengobua sona biala be wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, ofikyɛ mmeraa ne de, ɔma sona nwu ye bɔne. Kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ siesie ye ne sona afia ɔ

english_verse: Now we see how God does make us acceptable to him. The Law and the Prophets tell how we become acceptable, and it isn't by obeying the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Nakoso afei de, Nyameɛ ala ye tenenee ali bɔ wamva mmeraa ne aso ɔ; na mmeraa ne ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ bedi ɛhe nwo adanzeɛ.

english_verse: God treats everyone alike. He accepts people only because they have faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ nate sona gyidie bɔ ɔwɔ Yesu Kristo nu so yeɛ ɔfa siesie ye ne kuro sona afia ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ Nyameɛ nyɛ nyeyemuɛ.

english_verse: All of us have sinned and fallen short of God's glory.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmenia mukoraa bayɔ bɔne, na Nyameɛ animnyam abɔ bɛ.

english_verse: But God treats us much better than we deserve, and because of Christ Jesus, he freely accepts us and sets us free from our sins.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ nate ye adom bɔ ɔfa kyɛ mbaen ne aso obua bɛ be wɔ Kristo Yesu nu ngoalelɛ ne anu.

english_verse: What is left for us to brag about? Not a thing! Is it because we obeyed some law? No! It is because of faith.
translation_verse: Afei nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛfa yɛhoahoa yɛ nwo ɔ? Yɛlle hwee! Kyɛ yɛdi mmeraa ne aso anaa? Anaakyɛ yɛ yɔleɛ paa ti ɔ? Daabi, na mmom ɔnate gyidie so.

english_verse: We see that people are acceptable to God because they have faith, and not because they obey the Law.
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ yɛse ole kyɛ Nyameɛ nate gyidie so yeɛ ɔyɛ bɔnefoɛ teneneeniɛ ɔ, na nna kyɛ mmeraa ne bɔ odi so ti ɔ.

english_verse: Does God belong only to the Jews? Isn't he also the God of the Gentiles? Yes, he is!
translation_verse: Anaa Nyameɛ te Yudafoɛ ngome bɛ Nyameɛ? Aso ɔtte Amaenmaensofoɛ koso bɛ Nyameɛ? Ɔte bɛ koso bɛ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: There is only one God, and he accepts Gentiles as well as Jews, simply because of their faith.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ te komapɛ twe, na okogyina bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ bɛ gyidie so kobua bɛ be; yeɛ okogyina bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ koso bɛ gyidie so kobua bɛ be.

english_verse: Do we destroy the Law by our faith? Not at all! We make it even more powerful.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔnate gyidie he ati yɛto mmeraa ne yɛgua anaa? Dabida! Na mmom yɛde mmeraa ne yɛto nu.

english_verse: Well then, what can we say about our ancestor Abraham?
translation_verse: Yɛ anwoɔnaen nu nana Abraham, bɔ onyane ye ne, nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛkã yɛfa ye nwo ɔ?

english_verse: If he became acceptable to God because of what he did, then he would have something to brag about. But he would never be able to brag about it to God.
translation_verse: Sɛ Nyameɛ nate Abraham nnwumaa so yeɛ obuale ye be de a, nzaade Abraham le nikyee fa hoahoa ye nwo, nakoso nna Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.”
translation_verse: Na sɛɛ yeɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne ɔkã ɔ? “Abraham lele Nyameɛ lili, na obuli ye gyidie ne kyɛ tenenee mane ye.”

english_verse: Money paid to workers isn't a gift. It is something they earn by working.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔyɔ adwuma ne, bemmu ye akatuaa kyɛ akyɛdeɛ, na mmom ɔte adwuma bɔ ɔyɔ ne nwo akatuaa.

english_verse: But you cannot make God accept you because of something you do. God accepts sinners only because they have faith in him.
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ ɔmva ye nwo ndo nnwumaa paa so, na mmom ode Nyameɛ bɔ obua bɔnefoɛ be di nen, Nyameɛ bu sɔ sona ne gyidie kyɛ tenenee ma ye.

english_verse: In the Scriptures David talks about the blessings that come to people who are acceptable to God, even though they don't do anything to deserve these blessings. David says,
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati yeɛ Dawide hane kyɛ, sona bɔ Nyameɛ akwati nnwumaa paa na wabu ye teneneeniɛ ne, saleɛ te ye deɛ. Ɔnwa:

english_verse: “What a blessing when God forgives our sins and our evil deeds. What a blessing when the Lord erases our sins from his book.”
translation_verse: Sona bɔ Awurade ngɔfa ye bɔne nwo ngondaa ngogua ye so ne, wanya saleɛ.”

english_verse: Are these blessings meant for circumcised people or for those who are not circumcised? Well, the Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith in him.
translation_verse: Na sɔ saleɛ ne, ɔba bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ ngome so, anaakyɛ bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ koso so? Ofikyɛ yɛkã kyɛ, “Nyameɛ buli Abraham gyidie ne kyɛ tenenee mane ye.

english_verse: But when did this happen? Was it before or after Abraham was circumcised? Of course, it was before.
translation_verse: Obuale ye be wɔ atee beni aso? Anzana bɛbaapɛ ye bienzua, anaakyɛ mmerɛ bɔ bɛpɛle ye bienzua ne? Bambɛ ye bienzua koraka, na mmom anzana bɛbaapɛ ye bienzua ne.

english_verse: Abraham let himself be circumcised to show he had been accepted because of his faith even before he was circumcised. This makes Abraham the father of all who are acceptable to God because of their faith, even though they are not circumcised.
translation_verse: Na bɛpɛle ye bienzua maa ɛhe yɛle sɛngyerɛnneɛ ne nzorɛhyɛlɛ bɔ ɔnate gyidie so onyane ye wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né bennya bɛppɛle ye bienzua ɔ. Na ɛhe kyire kyɛ, ebiala bɔ ɔte gyidiniɛ bɔ bennya bɛppɛle ye bienzua ne, Abraham te ye nana, amaa ɔnate so babu bɛ tenenee.

english_verse: This also makes Abraham the father of everyone who is circumcised and has faith in God, as Abraham did before he was circumcised. The Promise Is for All Who Have Faith
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ Abraham te bɛ bɔ bapɛ bɛ bienzua ne bɛ nana ɔ; nna bɛ bienzuapɛlɛ ne ngome po, na mmom bɛfa gyidie bɔ yɛ nana Abraham nyane ye koraka yeɛ bɛpɛ ye bienzua ne bɛyɛ nhwɛsoɛ. Gyidie nu yeɛ yɛnya Nyameɛ bɔhyɛ ɔ

english_verse: God promised Abraham and his descendants that he would give them the world. This promise wasn't made because Abraham had obeyed a law, but because his faith in God made him acceptable.
translation_verse: Bɔhyɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛmane Abraham ne ye bosofoɛ kyɛ ewiase kɔyɛ bɛ deɛ nen, sɔ bɔhyɛ ne wamva mmeraa ne aso yeɛ ɔwale ɔ, na mmom ɔnate gyidie nwo tenenee so.

english_verse: If Abraham and his descendants were given this promise because they had obeyed a law, then faith would mean nothing, and the promise would be worthless.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛ bɔ bedi mmeraa ne aso yeɛ anohoba ne ɔte bɛ deɛ de a, nzaade né gyidie ɔtte hwee, na anohoba ne koso ayɛ mbaen.

english_verse: God becomes angry when his Law is broken. But where there isn't a law, it cannot be broken.
translation_verse: Mmeraa ne twetwe ahonehulɛ piri ne ba, na nekaa bɔ mmeraa nne berɛ nen, mmeraatolɛ nne berɛ.

english_verse: Everything depends on having faith in God, so that God's promise is assured by his gift of undeserved grace. This promise isn't only for Abraham's descendants who have the Law. It is for all who are Abraham's descendants because they have faith, just as he did. Abraham is the ancestor of us all.
translation_verse: Yiti bɔhyɛ ne gyi gyidie so, amaa ɔnate so bɔhyɛ ne wagyina adom so, ná watindim berɛ wama ye bosofoɛ amukoraa. Bɔhyɛ ne ɔtte bɛ bɔ bedi mmeraa ne aso ngome bɛ deɛ, na mmom ɔte ebiala bɔ wanya gyidie kyɛbɔ Abraham nyane ye ne koso deɛ; ofikyɛ ɔte yɛ mukoraa yɛ nana,

english_verse: The Scriptures say that Abraham would become the ancestor of many nations. This promise was made to Abraham because he had faith in God, who raises the dead to life and creates new things.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Mafa wɔ mayɛ amaenmaen pee bɛ nana.” Yiti Nyameɛ bɔ Abraham lele ye lili ne, ye bɔ otingye awufoɛ fi ewue nu, ná ɔfa ye noa dwirɛ ma nikyee bɔ ɔnne berɛ kora yɛ berɛ ne, ye nyunu de, Abraham te yɛ nana.

english_verse: God promised Abraham a lot of descendants. And when it all seemed hopeless, Abraham still had faith in God and became the ancestor of many nations.
translation_verse: Ye bɔ mmerɛ bɔ anyelasoɛ nne berɛ ne, ogyinane anyelasoɛ so ole lili, amaa ɔnate so wayɛ amaenmaen pee bɛ nana, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ hã hyirele ye kyɛ, “Sɔ yeɛ wɔ bosofoɛ bɛkɔyɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: But Abraham never doubted or questioned God's promise. His faith made him strong, and he gave all the credit to God.
translation_verse: Wanzu aporowaa wamma ye adwene anyɛ ye naa wɔ Nyameɛ bɔhyɛ ne anwo, na mmom ogyinane pindinn wɔ gyidie nu ɔhyɛle Nyameɛ animnyam.

english_verse: Abraham was certain that God could do what he had promised.
translation_verse: Na ole lili paa kyɛ Nyameɛ kɔhora kɔma ye anohoba bɔ wabɔ ye ne kɔwa nu.

english_verse: just as we read in the Scriptures. But these words were not written only for Abraham.
translation_verse: Na sɔ dwirɛ he: “Nyameɛ buli ye gyidie ne kyɛ tenenee mane ye” ne, bangyerɛ bamma ye ngome.

english_verse: They were written for us, since we will also be accepted because of our faith in God, who raised our Lord Jesus to life.
translation_verse: Bɛhyerɛ bɛmane yɛ koso. Yɛ bɔ yɛde bɔ otingyele y’Awurade Yesu fili awufoɛ nu yɛdi ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bekobu yɛ gyidie bɛkɔma yɛ ɔ;

english_verse: God gave Jesus to die for our sins, and he raised him to life, so that we would be made acceptable to God.
translation_verse: ye bɔ ɔnate yɛ bɔne ti behuni ye, ná ɔnate yɛ bebualɛ ti betingyele ye ɔ.

english_verse: By faith we have been made acceptable to God. And now, thanks to our Lord Jesus Christ, we have peace with God.
translation_verse: Afei de, ɔnate gyidie so yɛne Nyameɛ y’afia ayɛ ko ne ati, yɛnate y’Awurade Yesu Kristo so yanya asomdwee wɔ Nyameɛ nu.

english_verse: Christ has also introduced us to God's gift of undeserved grace on which we now take our stand. So we are happy, as we look forward to sharing in the glory of God.
translation_verse: Ɔnate ye so yeɛ yafa gyidie so yanya adom he bɔ yɛgyi so ye; na yɛhoahoa yɛ nwo Nyameɛ animnyam nwo anyelasoɛ nu.

english_verse: But that's not all! We gladly suffer, because we know that suffering helps us to endure.
translation_verse: Nna ɛhe angome, na mmom yɛhoahoa yɛ nwo wɔ yɛ amaneɛnwunɛ nu koso, ɔnate kyɛ yɛse kyɛ amaneɛnwunɛ ma sona nya animia;

english_verse: And endurance builds character, which gives us a hope
translation_verse: na animia ma suahunu, yeɛ suahunu koso ma anyelasoɛ.

english_verse: that will never disappoint us. All of this happens because God has given us the Holy Spirit, who fills our hearts with his love.
translation_verse: Na anyelasoɛ nni ngasi, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ nate ye Sunzum Krongron bɔ ɔfa mane yɛ ne aso wafa ye ɔdɔ somaa ne wawura yɛ ahone nu.

english_verse: Christ died for us at a time when we were helpless and sinful.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né yɛtɛ yɛ mmerɛ ne, mmerɛ bɔ wahyehyɛ wato berɛ ne anu, Kristo wu mane bɔnefoɛ.

english_verse: No one is really willing to die for an honest person, though someone might be willing to die for a truly good person.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ se kyɛ ebie kowu kɔma teneneeniɛ ɔ. Bɔ ɔte teneneeniɛ de, ebiaa ebie kosi ye ahone kyɛ okowu kɔma ye.

english_verse: But God showed how much he loved us by having Christ die for us, even though we were sinful.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ hyirele kyɛbɔ osi kuro yɛ dwirɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ né yɛtɛ te bɔnefoɛ ne yeɛ Kristo wu mane yɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But there is more! Now that God has accepted us because Christ sacrificed his life's blood, we will also be kept safe from God's anger.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ ɔnate ye mogya so wabua yɛ be de a, né nzaade ɔkɔfa Kristo so kole yɛ kofi ye ahonehulɛ ne anu maa ɔkɔbo so.

english_verse: Even when we were God's enemies, he made peace with us, because his Son died for us. Yet something even greater than friendship is ours. Now that we are at peace with God, we will be saved by the life of his Son.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né yɛte Nyameɛ pɔfoɛ nen, Nyameɛ nate Ɔwa ne wue so siesiele yɛ ne ye afia. Na kekesaala ye bɔ yɛne Nyameɛ ayɛ ko ye de, ɔnate teasefoɛ Yesu so okole yɛ ngoa maa ɔkɔbo so.

english_verse: And in addition to everything else, we are happy because God sent our Lord Jesus Christ to make peace with us. Adam and Christ
translation_verse: Nna ɛhe angome, na mmom yɛnate y’Awurade Yesu Kristo bɔ wasiesie yɛ ne Nyameɛ afia ne so yanya anika wɔ Nyameɛ nu. Ewue nate Adam so awa mmenia mukoraa so

english_verse: Adam sinned, and that sin brought death into the world. Now everyone has sinned, and so everyone must die.
translation_verse: Yiti kyɛbɔ bɔne nate sona ko so wale wiase, na ye bɔne fale ewue wale nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ewue to petene mmenia mukoraa so ɔ, ofikyɛ kuro sona biala ayɔ bɔne.

english_verse: Sin was in the world before the Law came. But no record of sin was kept, because there was no Law.
translation_verse: Né bɔne wɔ wiase dada koraka yeɛ mmeraa ne ba ɔ, na mmom nekaa bɔ mmeraa nne berɛ nen, bemmu bɔne nwo ngondaa.

english_verse: Yet death still had power over all who lived from the time of Adam to the time of Moses. This happened, though not everyone disobeyed a direct command from God, as Adam did. In some ways Adam is like Christ who came later.
translation_verse: Nakoso ofi Adam so kɔpem Mose so, ewue nyane tumi wɔ kuro sona biala so; na bɛ bɔ banyɔ bɔne kyɛ Adam deɛ ne po, onyane bɛ so tumi. Adam te bɔ ɔba ne mvandoho. Sona fa Kristo so nya ngoa

english_verse: But the gift of God's undeserved grace was very different from Adam's sin. That one sin brought death to many others. Yet in an even greater way, Jesus Christ alone brought God's gift of undeserved grace to many people.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ mvomsoɛ ne ɔte ne, nna sɔ yeɛ adom akyɛdeɛ ne ɔte ɔ. Ofikyɛ sɛ ɔnate sona ko bɔne so mmenia pee nyane ewue de a, nzaade né Nyameɛ adom, ɔne ye akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Yesu Kristo nu ne sone maa ɔbo so ma mmenia pee.

english_verse: There is a lot of difference between Adam's sin and God's gift. That one sin led to punishment. But God's gift made it possible for us to be acceptable to him, even though we have sinned many times.
translation_verse: Afei adom akyɛdeɛ ne, ɔtte kyɛ musue bɔ sona ko bɔne bɔ ɔyɔle ɔ fa wale ne. Ofikyɛ ndɛenbualɛ bɔ sona ko bɔne fa wale ole foɛbualɛ; nakoso Nyameɛ adom akyɛdeɛ ne de, bɔne pee yɔlɛ si po ne, adom akyɛdeɛ ne abua yɛ be.

english_verse: Death ruled like a king because Adam had sinned. But that cannot compare with what Jesus Christ has done. God has treated us with undeserved grace, and he has accepted us because of Jesus. And so we will live and rule like kings.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔnate sona ko bɔne so ewue nyane tumi wɔ sona ko ne so a, ye de bɛ bɔ banya adom mmorosoɛ ne tenenee akyɛdeɛ ne, bɛnate sona ko bɔ ye ole Yesu Kristo ne so bekoli ngonim.

english_verse: Everyone was going to be punished because Adam sinned. But because of the good thing that Christ has done, God accepts us and gives us the gift of life.
translation_verse: Yiti kyɛbɔ sona ko bɔne fale foɛbualɛ brɛle mmenia mukoraa nen, sɔ ala yeɛ sona ko tenenee fale bebualɛ ne ngoa brɛle mmenia mukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: Adam disobeyed God and caused many others to be sinners. But Jesus obeyed him and will make many people acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Afei kyɛbɔ ɔnate sona ko asoserɛ so ti mmeni pee yɛle bɔnefoɛ nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔnate sona ko sotie so mmeni pee kɔyɛ teneneefoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Law came, so that the full power of sin could be seen. Yet where sin was powerful, God's gift of undeserved grace was even more powerful.
translation_verse: Mmeraa ne de ɔwale maa bɔne trɛle, nakoso nekaa bɔ bɔne trɛle nen, Nyameɛ adom ne trɛle maa ɔbole so.

english_verse: Sin ruled by means of death. But God's gift of grace now rules, and God has accepted us because of Jesus Christ our Lord. This means that we will have eternal life.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ bɔne nate ewue nu lili hene nen, sɔ ala yeɛ Nyameɛ adom koso kɔnate tenenee nu koli hene ɔ, na ɔkɔfa y’Awurade Yesu Kristo so kɔfa yɛ kɔhɔ daa ngoa nu.

english_verse: What should we say? Should we keep on sinning, so that God's gift of undeserved grace will show up even better?
translation_verse: Afei yɛkã ye sɛ? Yiti yɛhɔ so yɛyɔ bɔne, amaa yanya Nyameɛ adom ne mmorosoɛ anaa?

english_verse: No, we should not! If we are dead to sin, how can we go on sinning?
translation_verse: Dabida! Yɛ bɔ yawu yafi bɔne nu ne, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ ná yahɔ so yatena bɔne nu?

english_verse: Don't you know that all who share in Christ Jesus by being baptized also share in his death?
translation_verse: Anaa ɛmɔnze kyɛ yɛ bɔ bɛbɔle yɛ asu wɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne, bɛbɔle yɛ asu bɛhɔle ye wue nu ɔ?

english_verse: When we were baptized, we died and were buried with Christ. We were baptized, so we would live a new life, as Christ was raised to life by the glory of God the Father.
translation_verse: Yiti basie yɛ ne ye wɔ asubɔlɛ nu bahɔ ye wue nu. Ofikyɛ kyɛbɔ Baba n’animnyam tumi ne tingyele Kristo fili awufoɛ nu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛnate ngoa foforɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: If we shared in Jesus' death by being baptized, we will be raised to life with him.
translation_verse: Sɛ yɛne ye ayɛ ko wɔ ye wue nu de a, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛne ye kɔyɛ ko wɔ ye wutingyelɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: We know that the persons we used to be were nailed to the cross with Jesus. This was done, so our sinful bodies would no longer be the slaves of sin.
translation_verse: Yɛse kyɛ babɔ yɛ sona sue daa ne ne Kristo mmeamudua nu, kyɛbɔ yɛ bɔne nipadua ne kowu na yanyɛ bɔne ngoaa ko ɔ.

english_verse: We know sin doesn't have power over dead people.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sona biala bɔ wawu ne, wanya fawɔnwodi wafi bɔne tumi bo.

english_verse: As surely as we died with Christ, we believe we will also live with him.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ yɛne Kristo awu de a, nzaade yɛde yɛdi kyɛ yɛne ye kɔtena ngoa nu koso.

english_verse: We know that death no longer has any power over Christ. He died and was raised to life, never again to die.
translation_verse: Yɛse kyɛ batingye Kristo bafi awufoɛ nu, na ongowu ko le; ewue olle tumi wɔ ye so ko.

english_verse: When Christ died, he died for sin once and for all. But now he is alive, and he lives only for God.
translation_verse: Na ye wue ne, owu lili bɔne so ngonim pɛen ko; na ase bɔ ɔte kekesaala ye ne, ɔte ma Nyameɛ.

english_verse: In the same way, you must think of yourselves as dead to the power of sin. But Christ Jesus has given life to you, and you live for God.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ odi kyɛ ɛmɔbu ɛmɔ nwo kyɛ bɔne olle ɛmɔ so tumi ko ɔ, na ɛmɔte ase wɔ Kristo Yesu nu ma Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Don't let sin rule your body. After all, your body is bound to die, so don't obey its desires
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛmɔma bɔne di ɛmɔ nipadua so hene bɔ ɔkɔmaa ɛmɔkɔyɛ sotie kɔma ye akɔnnɔdeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: or let any part of it become a slave of evil. Give yourselves to God, as people who have been raised from death to life. Make every part of your body a slave that pleases God.
translation_verse: Afei, nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nipadua akwaa biala bɛma bɔne ná wamva wanyɔ amumuyɛɛ, na mmom ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bɛ́ma Nyameɛ kyɛ bɛ bɔ befi ewue nu bahɔ ngoa nu ɔ. Ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ nwo amukoraa bɛ́ma ye, ná ɔfa yɔ tenenee nnwumaa.

english_verse: Don't let sin keep ruling your lives. You are ruled by God's undeserved grace and not by the Law. Slaves Who Do What Pleases God
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma bɔne di ɛmɔ so hene, ofikyɛ nna mmeraa bo yeɛ ɛmɔwura ɔ, na mmom ɛmɔwura Nyameɛ adom bo. Yɛte tenenee ngoaa

english_verse: What does all this mean? Does it mean we are free to sin, because we are ruled by God's gift of undeserved grace and not by the Law? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Afei nzikyɛ bieku? Ɔnate kyɛ yɛwwura mmeraa bo, na mmom yɛwura adom bo ne ati, yiti odi kyɛ yɛyɔ bɔne anaa? Dabida!

english_verse: Don't you know that you are slaves of anyone you obey? You can be slaves of sin and die, or you can be obedient slaves of God and be acceptable to him.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔnze kyɛ sona bɔ ɛmɔyɛ sotie bɛma ye ne, sɔ sona ne yeɛ ɛmɔte ye ngoaa ɔ, ɛmɔte ngoaa bɛma sona bɔ ɛmɔyɛ sotie bɛma ye ɔ, kyɛ bɔne bɔ ɔfa wɔ kɔ ewue nu oo, anaakyɛ sotie bɔ ɔfa wɔ kɔ tenenee nu oo?

english_verse: You used to be slaves of sin. But I thank God that with all your heart you followed the example set forth in the teaching you received.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔma yɛla Nyameɛ ase! Ofikyɛ ɛmɔayɛ bɔne ngoaa le, na afei de ɛmɔafa b’ahone mukoraa bayɛ sotie bama nahorɛ, bɔ ɛmɔanya bafi ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛmane ɛmɔ ne anu ne.

english_verse: Now you are set free from sin and are slaves who please God.
translation_verse: Na afei ɛmɔanya fawɔnwodi bafi bɔne nu, na ɛmɔayɛ tenenee ngoaa.

english_verse: I am using these everyday examples, because in some ways you are still weak. You used to let the different parts of your body be slaves of your evil thoughts. But now you must make every part of your body serve God, so that you will belong completely to him.
translation_verse: Ɔnate ɛmɔ anwoɔnaen mmerɛyɛlɛ ti yeɛ mafa kuro sona atee so madwudwo mahyire ɛmɔ ɔ. Na kyɛbɔ mmerɛ bie ɛmɔfale ɛmɔ nwonaen akwaa bɛyɛle ngoaa bɛmane efiɛ ne amumuyɛɛ mbiri mbiri ne, sɔ ala yeɛ odi kyɛ afei ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nwonaen akwaa besie berɛ bɛma tenenee bɛkɔ krongronyɛlɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: When you were slaves of sin, you didn't have to please God.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né ɛmɔte bɔne ngoaa nen, né ɛmɔ ne tenenee afia atete.

english_verse: But what good did you receive from the things you did? All you have to show for them is your shame, and they lead to death.
translation_verse: Daa bra bɔ ɛmɔbɔle ne, bɔ ɛnɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ nya ye, nzikyɛ mvasoɛ yeɛ ɛmɔnya befili nu ɔ? Sɔ nningyein nemɔ, b’ayieleɛ te ewue.

english_verse: Now you have been set free from sin, and you are God's slaves. This will make you holy and will lead you to eternal life.
translation_verse: Na kekesaala ye de, bale ɛmɔ bafi bɔne nu amaa ɛmɔayɛ Nyameɛ ngoaa. Ye so mvasoɛ bɔ ɛmɔnya ole kyɛ, ɛmɔayɛ krongron bɔ ye ayieleɛ ole daa ngoa.

english_verse: Sin pays off with death. But God's gift is eternal life given by Jesus Christ our Lord.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔne akatuaa ole ewue; na Nyameɛ adom akyɛdeɛ ole daa ngoa wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo nu.

english_verse: My friends, you surely understand enough about law to know that laws only have power over people who are alive.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, aso ɛmɔnze anaa? Medwudwo mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛse mmeraa ne ɔ. Sɛ sona te ase a, yeɛ mmeraa kyekye ye ɔ.

english_verse: For example, the Law says that a man's wife must remain his wife as long as he lives. But once her husband is dead, she is free
translation_verse: Yiti brasua bɔ ogya biaa nen, mmeraa kyekye ye bata ohu ne wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ohu ne te ase ɔ; na sɛ ohu ne wu de a, mmeraa ngyekye ye mmata ohu ne ko.

english_verse: to marry someone else. However, if she goes off with another man while her husband is still alive, she is said to be unfaithful.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ ohu te ase, ná ɔkɔ biaa foforɛ nwo a, né bɛfrɛ ye agyaasɛkyelɛniɛ. Nakoso sɛ ohu ne wu de a, sɔ mmeraa ne ngyekye ye ko, na afei sɛ okogya biaa foforɛ a, né ye de ɔssɛkyele agyaa.

english_verse: That is how it is with you, my friends. You are now part of the body of Christ and are dead to the power of the Law. You are free to belong to Christ, who was raised to life so we could serve God.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ koso bɛnate Kristo nipadua so ɛmɔawu bama mmeraa ne ɔ, bɔ ɔnate so ebiala te obiɛngo deɛ ɔ, bɔ ɛmɔte bɔ batingye ye bafi ewue nu ne deɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ yɛkosu mmaa yɛkɔma Nyameɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When we thought only of ourselves, the Law made us have sinful desires. It made every part of our bodies into slaves who are doomed to die.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né yɛwɔ anwoɔnaen nu ne de, yɛ bɔne akɔnnɔdeɛ bɔ mmeraa ne kanyane ye ne, ɔyɔle adwuma wɔ yɛ nwonaen akwaa nu osuli mmaa hɔle ewue.

english_verse: But the Law no longer rules over us. We are like dead people, and it cannot have any power over us. Now we can serve God in a new way by obeying his Spirit, and not in the old way by obeying the written Law. The Battle with Sin
translation_verse: Na afei de, bale yɛ bafi mmeraa ne abo, ofikyɛ bɔ daa ne ɔfale yɛ yɛle ngoaa nen, kekesaala ye de olle yɛ so tumi ko. Yiti yɛwwura daa mmeraa bɔ bɛhyerɛle ne abo ko, na mmom yɛwura Sunzum nu ngoa foforɛ ne abo. Mmeraa ne bɔne

english_verse: Does this mean that the Law is sinful? Certainly not! But if it had not been for the Law, I would not have known what sin is really like. For example, I would not have known what it means to want something that belongs to someone else, unless the Law had told me not to do this.
translation_verse: Afei yɛkɔhã ye sɛ? Kyɛ mmeraa ne ɔtte mayee anaa? Dabida! Na sɛ nna mmeraa ne ahɔ a, ahaa menze bɔne. Sɛ mmeraa ne anga kyɛ, “Nnɛma wɔ nye boro ebie nikyee” a, ahaa menze kyɛbɔ besi bɛma bɛ nye boro nikye ɔ.

english_verse: It was sin that used this command as a way of making me have all kinds of desires. But without the Law, sin is dead.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɔne nate mmeraa ne aso nyane atee fale anyeboroborolɛ ahoroɔ wurale me nu. Sɛ mmeraa ne nne berɛ a, bɔne te nikyee bɔ wawu ɔ.

english_verse: Before I knew about the Law, I was alive. But as soon as I heard that command, sin came to life,
translation_verse: Makwati mmeraa ne matena ase le; nakoso mmeraa ne wale nen, bɔne tingyele na nwuli.

english_verse: and I died. The very command that was supposed to bring life to me, instead brought death.
translation_verse: Afei mmeraa bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa ngoa ba ne, ɔfale ewue brɛle me.

english_verse: Sin used this command to trick me, and because of it I died.
translation_verse: Na bɔne fale mmeraa ne aso nyane atee lakalakale me huni me.

english_verse: Still, the Law and its commands are holy and correct and good.
translation_verse: Yiti mmeraa ne te krongron, na ahyɛdeɛ ne koso te krongron, ɔte tenenee, na ɔte paa.

english_verse: Am I saying something good caused my death? Certainly not! It was sin that killed me by using something good. Now we can see how terrible and evil sin really is.
translation_verse: Aso ɛhe kyire kyɛ nikyee bɔ ɔte paa ne ɔmaa nyane ewue anaa? Dabida! Nakoso kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ na bekonwu bɔne pefee kyɛ ɔte bɔne ne ati, bɔne nate bɔ ɔte paa so maa nwuli, amaa ɔnate ahyɛdeɛ ne aso banwu ye kyɛ bɔne te nikyee bie bɔ ɔtte mayee koraa ɔ. Paa ne bɔne di me nu apereapereɛ

english_verse: We know that the Law is spiritual. But I am merely a human, and I have been sold as a slave to sin.
translation_verse: Yɛse kyɛ mmeraa ne te sunzum nu nikye, na me de, nde anwoɔnaen, bɔ batɔne me bama bɔne ɔ.

english_verse: In fact, I don't understand why I act the way I do. I don't do what I know is right. I do the things I hate.
translation_verse: Bɔ me bɔbɔ meyɔ ne, mende ye bo. Ofikyɛ bɔ mekuro kyɛ meyɔ ne, menyɔ, na mmom bɔ menguro ne yeɛ meyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Although I don't do what I know is right, I agree that the Law is good.
translation_verse: Na sɛ meyɔ bɔ menguro kyɛ meyɔ ne de a, né okyire kyɛ mepene so kyɛ mmeraa ne te paa.

english_verse: So I am not the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Né nzaade, né nna me yeɛ mekɔ so meyɔ sɔ nikyee ne ɔ, na mmom bɔne bɔ ɔte me nu ne yeɛ ɔyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I know that my selfish desires won't let me do anything that is good. Even when I want to do right, I cannot.
translation_verse: Mese kyɛ nikyee paa biala ɔtte me nu: mekyire me bɔne nipadua ne. Ofikyɛ ɔhale me ngome a, ahaa paa yeɛ meyɔ ɔ, nakoso mengora ye yɔ.

english_verse: Instead of doing what I know is right, I do wrong.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ menyɔ paa bɔ mekuro ne, na mmom bɔne bɔ menguro ne yeɛ meyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: And so, if I don't do what I know is right, I am no longer the one doing these evil things. The sin that lives in me is what does them.
translation_verse: Afei sɛ meyɔ bɔ menguro ne de a, ye de nna me nye kaenn yeɛ mefa meyɔ ɔ, na mmom bɔne bɔ ɔte me nu ne ɔ.

english_verse: The Law has shown me that something in me keeps me from doing what I know is right.
translation_verse: Yiti mete nga kyɛ mmeraa bie yɔ adwuma wɔ me nu: na mmerɛ biala bɔ mepena kyɛ meyɔ paa nen, né bɔne aye ye ti.

english_verse: With my whole heart I agree with the Law of God.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me nye gye Nyameɛ mmeraa nwo wɔ me nu paa.

english_verse: But in every part of me I discover something fighting against my mind, and it makes me a prisoner of sin that controls everything I do.
translation_verse: Nakoso menwu mmeraa foforɛ bie wɔ me nwonaen akwaa nu, bɔ ɔko tia mmeraa bɔ ɔwɔ m’adwene nu ɔ, bɔ ɔkye me nnure ma bɔne mmeraa bɔ ɔwɔ me nwonaen akwaa nu ɔ.

english_verse: What a miserable person I am. Who will rescue me from this body that is doomed to die?
translation_verse: Aa, meyɛ anwumvo! Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔpepɛ kole me kofi sɔ ewue nipadua he anu ɔ?

english_verse: Thank God! Jesus Christ will rescue me. So with my mind I serve the Law of God, although my selfish desires make me serve the law of sin.
translation_verse: Mefa y’Awurade Yesu Kristo so meda Nyameɛ ase! Yiti m’adwene nu de, nde Nyameɛ mmeraa n’akoaa, nakoso me nwonaen nu de, nde bɔne akoaa.

english_verse: If you belong to Christ Jesus, you won't be punished.
translation_verse: Afei de, foɛbualɛ biala nne berɛ mma bɛ bɔ bɛte Kristo Yesu nu ne.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit will give you life that comes from Christ Jesus and will set you free from sin and death.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Kristo Yesu nu ngoa Sunzum mmeraa ne, wapepɛ wale me wafi bɔne ne ewue mmeraa ne anu.

english_verse: The Law of Moses cannot do this, because our selfish desires make the Law weak. But God set you free when he sent his own Son to be like us sinners and to be a sacrifice for our sin. God used Christ's body to condemn sin.
translation_verse: Na bɔ mmeraa ne wangora wanyɔ, bɔ ɔnate kyɛ anwoɔnaen ne maa ɔyɛle mmerɛ ne ati, Nyameɛ ayɔ. Ɔsomane Ɔwa komapɛ ne maa ɔyɛle ye nwo kyɛ kuro sona, bɔ ole bɔne nwonaen ɔ, na ɔfa buale bɔne foɛ wɔ anwoɔnaen nu,

english_verse: He did this, so that we would do what the Law commands by obeying the Spirit instead of our own desires.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so mmeraa ne nwo tenenee wawa nu wɔ yɛ nu, yɛ bɔ yɛnnate anwoɔnaen nu, na mmom yɛnate Sunzum nu ne.

english_verse: People who are ruled by their desires think only of themselves. Everyone who is ruled by the Holy Spirit thinks about spiritual things.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ anwoɔnaen nu ne, bɛdwene anwoɔnaen nu nningyein nwo; nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Sunzum nu ne de, bɛdwene Sunzum nu nningyein nwo.

english_verse: If our minds are ruled by our desires, we will die. But if our minds are ruled by the Spirit, we will have life and peace.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛma anwoɔnaen nu adwenedwene bada wɔ so a, ɔne ewue yeɛ bɛnate ɔ; nakoso Sunzum nu adwenedwene de, ɔma ngoa ne asomdwee.

english_verse: Our desires fight against God, because they do not and cannot obey God's laws.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ anwoɔnaen nu adwenedwene pɔ Nyameɛ, ɔngora mmerɛ ye nwo ase nwura Nyameɛ mmeraa bo, ɔngora nyɔ sɔ amba.

english_verse: If we follow our desires, we cannot please God.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bedi anwoɔnaen n’ahyɛdeɛ so ne, bɛngora bɛnzɔ Nyameɛ nye.

english_verse: You are no longer ruled by your desires, but by God's Spirit, who lives in you. People who don't have the Spirit of Christ in them don't belong to him.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔnni anwoɔnaen nhyehyɛleɛ so, na mmom Sunzum nhyehyɛleɛ so, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ Sunzum te ɛmɔ nu. Na ebiala bɔ olle Kristo Sunzum ne, ɔtte Kristo deɛ.

english_verse: But Christ lives in you. So you are alive because God has accepted you, even though your bodies must die because of your sins.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Kristo te ɛmɔ nu de a, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɔnate bɔne ti ɛmɔ nipadua ne awu de, nakoso ɔnate tenenee ti ɛmɔ Sunzum ne le ngoa.

english_verse: My dear friends, we must not live to satisfy our desires.
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛmma anwoɔnaen ne kerɛ, ná wawa kyɛ yatena ase yama anwoɔnaen ne.

english_verse: If you do, you will die. But you will live, if by the help of God's Spirit you say “No” to your desires.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɛ ɛmɔbɔ ɛmɔ bra kyɛbɔ anwoɔnaen ne kuro a, ɛmɔkowu. Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔfa Sunzum ne beku anwoɔnaen nnwumaa de a, ɛmɔkonya ngoa.

english_verse: Only those people who are led by God's Spirit are his children.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ sona biala bɔ Nyameɛ Sunzum ne ɔyɛ ye taataa ne, ɔte Nyameɛ awa.

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make us slaves who are afraid of him. Instead, we become his children and call him our Father.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔannya ngoaayɛlɛ sunzum bɔ ɔkɔmaa ɛmɔkosa bekosuro ɔ; na mmom baayɛlɛ Sunzum yeɛ ɛmɔanya ɔ, bɔ ɔmaa yɛtea nu kyɛ: “Abba! Baba!”

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us sure that we are his children.
translation_verse: Sunzum ne bɔbɔ ɔne yɛ sunzum bedi adanzeɛ kyɛ yɛte Nyameɛ mma.

english_verse: His Spirit lets us know that together with Christ we will be given what God has promised. We will also share in the glory of Christ, because we have suffered with him. A Wonderful Future for God's People
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛte Nyameɛ mma de a, ye de yɛle agyapadeɛ, yɛle agyapadeɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nu, yɛne Kristo yɛbɔ nu yɛle agyapadeɛ; nakoso sana yɛne ye nwu amaneɛ koraka, amaa ɔnate so bahyɛ yɛ ne ye animnyam. Yɛkonya animnyam kyẽa bie

english_verse: I am sure what we are suffering now cannot compare with the glory that will be shown to us.
translation_verse: Mebu amaneɛ bɔ yɛnwu ye kekesaala ye ne kyɛ, yɛngora yɛngɔfa ngɔtoto animnyam bɔ bɛbaala ye ali bekyire yɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: In fact, all creation is eagerly waiting for God to show who his children are.
translation_verse: Na abɔdeɛ ɔnwondɛ serɛserɛ kyɛ bɛkɔla Nyameɛ mma nemɔ ali ɔ.

english_verse: Meanwhile, creation is confused, but not because it wants to be confused. God made it this way in the hope
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛfale abɔdeɛ bewurale nikyee mbaen bie abo, bɔ nna ye bɔbɔ ye pɛ ahɔ ɔ; na mmom bɔ ɔfale ye wurale sɔ nikyee ne abo wɔ anyelasoɛ nu ne, ye pɛ ɔ;

english_verse: that creation would be set free from decay and would share in the glorious freedom of his children.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ abɔdeɛ ne bɔbɔ deinn, bɛkɔpepɛ bekole ye bekofi ngoaasolɛ porɔlowaa nu bɛkɔhɔ Nyameɛ mma fawɔnwodi animnyam ne anu.

english_verse: We know that all creation is still groaning and is in pain, like a woman about to give birth.
translation_verse: Yɛse kyɛ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye, abɔdeɛ amukoraa ɔpene, na wafo aworɛ so bɔ onwu amaneɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Spirit makes us sure about what we will be in the future. But now we groan silently, while we wait for God to show that we are his children. This means that our bodies will also be set free.
translation_verse: Nakoso nna abɔdeɛ ngome, na mmom yɛ bɔbɔ koso bɔ yanya Sunzum nu mmaa bɔ oli moa ne, yɛpene wɔ yɛ nu, mmerɛ bɔ yɛnwondɛ kyɛ bɛkɔfa yɛ bɛkɔyɛ mmaa ɔ, bɔ ɔte ɛpepɛlɛ bɔ bɛkɔpepɛ bekole yɛ nipadua ne ɔ.

english_verse: And this hope is what saves us. But if we already have what we hope for, there is no need to keep on hoping.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛnate anyelasoɛ so yeɛ belele yɛ ngoa ɔ; na anyelasoɛ bɔ bɛ nye nwu ye ne de, ɔtte anyelasoɛ. Ofikyɛ bɔ sona ye nye tua ne, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né wanya ye nwo anyelasoɛ?

english_verse: However, we hope for something we have not yet seen, and we patiently wait for it.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛ nye la bɔ yɛnnwu ye so a, ye de yɛfa aboterɛ yɛwondɛ.

english_verse: In certain ways we are weak, but the Spirit is here to help us. For example, when we don't know what to pray for, the Spirit prays for us in ways that cannot be put into words.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ Sunzum ne boka yɛ wɔ yɛ mmerɛyɛlɛ nu ɔ, ofikyɛ yɛnze kyɛbɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛbɔ mbaeɛ ɔ. Nakoso Sunzum ne bɔbɔ ogyina yɛ gya nu, na ɔfa ɛpenenɛ bɔ bɛngora bɛmva edwudwolɛ bɛnga ɔ so ɔsrɛ ma yɛ.

english_verse: All of our thoughts are known to God. He can understand what is in the mind of the Spirit, as the Spirit prays for God's people.
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔpɛnzɛpɛnzɛ mmenia ti anu adwene nu ne, ɔse Sunzum ne ti anu adwene, ofikyɛ Sunzum ne srɛ ma anwoteefoɛ kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ pɛ si te ɔ

english_verse: We know that God is always at work for the good of everyone who loves him. They are the ones God has chosen for his purpose,
translation_verse: Yɛse kyɛ bɛ bɔ bekuro Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne, bɔ okosi biala ɔboka bɛ, bɛ bɔ ɔnate ye nhyehyɛleɛ so wafrɛ bɛ ne.

english_verse: and he has always known who his chosen ones would be. He had decided to let them become like his own Son, so his Son would be the first of many children.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ onwuni bɛ siele ne, osa tuli bɛ siele berɛ, kyɛ benya Ɔwa ne sue ne bie, amaa ɔnate so wayɛ aliɛmaa mɔ pee nu bamuɛbaa.

english_verse: God then accepted the people he had already decided to choose, and he has shared his glory with them. God's Love
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ otuli bɛ siele berɛ ne, osa frɛle bɛ; na bɛ bɔ ɔfrɛle bɛ ne, obuale bɛ be koso, na bɛ bɔ obuale bɛ be ne, ɔhyɛle bɛ animnyam koso. Nyameɛ ɔdɔ bɔ ɔwɔ Yesu Kristo nu ɔ

english_verse: What can we say about all this? If God is on our side, can anyone be against us?
translation_verse: Afei nzikyɛ yeɛ yɛkɔhã kɔfa ɛhemɔ nwo ɔ? Sɛ Nyameɛ gyi yɛ si a, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔho kotia yɛ ɔ.

english_verse: God did not keep back his own Son, but he gave him for us. If God did this, won't he freely give us everything else?
translation_verse: Sɛ wamva ye bɔbɔ Ɔwa wammɔ atianuserɛ, na mmom yɛ mukoraa yɛ ti ɔyele ye mane a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ ɔngɔfa nningyein mukoraa ngɔboka ye so ngɔma yɛ ɔ?

english_verse: If God says his chosen ones are acceptable to him, can anyone bring charges against them?
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔbɔ bɛ bɔ Nyameɛ waneanea nu waye bɛ ne kwaadu ɔ? Nyameɛ yeɛ obua be ɔ.

english_verse: Or can anyone condemn them? No indeed! Christ died and was raised to life, and now he is at God's right side, speaking to him for us.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ obua foɛ ɔ? Yesu Kristo bɔ owuli ná otingyele fili awufoɛ nu ne, bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ sa famaa so, bɔ ɔsrɛ ma yɛ ne.

english_verse: Can anything separate us from the love of Christ? Can trouble, suffering, and hard times, or hunger and nakedness, or danger and death?
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔte yɛ kofi Kristo ɔdɔ ne anwo ɔ? Amaneɛnwunɛ anaa anwokyere anaa ndaneanyeɛ anaa ɛhɔen anaa kwaterekwa anaa amaneɛnwunɛ anaa ngrandɛ?

english_verse: It is exactly as the Scriptures say, “For you we face death all day long. We are like sheep on their way to be butchered.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Ɔnate wɔ ti beku yɛ daa biala; na bebu yɛ kyɛ mmoaen bɔ bɛkwaahũ bɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: In everything we have won more than a victory because of Christ who loves us.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛhemɔ amukoraa nu ne, yɛfa bɔ okuro yɛ dwirɛ ne aso yɛdi ngonim mmorosoɛ.

english_verse: I am sure that nothing can separate us from God's love—not life or death, not angels or spirits, not the present or the future,
translation_verse: Na mese ye pefee kyɛ ewue anaa ngoa, anaa abɔfo mɔ, anaa ewienu atumifoɛ, anaa nningyein bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ kekesaala ye, anaa nningyein bɔ ɔbaawa, anaa tumi,

english_verse: and not powers above or powers below. Nothing in all creation can separate us from God's love for us in Christ Jesus our Lord!
translation_verse: anaa anwuro, anaa kumaa kuronn, anaa abɔdeɛ nu nikyee biala ngɔhora ngɔtete yɛ ngofi Nyameɛ ɔdɔ bɔ ɔwɔ yɛ Awurade Kristo Yesu nu ne anwo le.

english_verse: I am a follower of Christ, and the Holy Spirit is a witness to my conscience. So I tell the truth and I am not lying when I say
translation_verse: Meka nahorɛ ne wɔ Kristo nu, membɛ ngondombo; na me tiboa koso di me adanzeɛ wɔ Sunzum Krongron nu.

english_verse: my heart is broken and I am in great sorrow.
translation_verse: kyɛ medi aworabɔlɛ pee ne yealɛ daa wɔ m’ahone nu.

english_verse: I would gladly be placed under God's curse and be separated from Christ for the good of my own people.
translation_verse: Ɔhale me ngome a, ahaa mayɛ abusudeɛ sona maa mahwere Kristo, ɔnate ngoalelɛ bɔ m’anwoɔnaen nu aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ bɛte abusuafoɛ ne bekonya ye ne ati.

english_verse: They have those famous ancestors, who were also the ancestors of the Christ. I pray that God, who rules over all, will be praised forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Bɛ yeɛ yɛ nana mbanyi mɔ bɛte bɛ deɛ ɔ; na anwoɔnaen nu, bɛ bosoniɛ ole Kristo bɔ ɔte nningyein mukoraa so Nyameɛ bɔ bayira ye afebɔɔ ne. Amen.

english_verse: It cannot be said that God broke his promise. After all, not all of the people of Israel are the true people of God.
translation_verse: Nna kyɛ ebiaa Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne ayɛ mbaen ɔ, ofikyɛ nna bɛ bɔ befi Yisrael nu amukoraa yeɛ bɛte Yisraelfoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: In fact, when God made the promise to Abraham, he meant only Abraham's descendants by his son Isaac. God was talking only about Isaac when he promised
translation_verse: Ɛhe kyire kyɛ nna anwoɔnaen nu mma yeɛ bɛte Nyameɛ mma ɔ; na mmom bɔhyɛ ne mma yeɛ bebu bɛ kyɛ ye bosofoɛ kaenn ɔ.

english_verse: Sarah, “At this time next year I will return, and you will already have a son.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ bɔhyɛ ne hane kyɛ, “Afoɛ bieku bekye sɔa ngosa ngɔwa ne, né Sara awo baa bienzua.”

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to the twin sons of Isaac and Rebekah.
translation_verse: Nna kyɛ ɛhe ngome, na Rebɛka koso ɔne biaa ko bɛnwonzɛle, bɔ ye ole yɛ nana Yisake ne.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say that the Lord liked Jacob more than Esau.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Ngurole Yakob dwirɛ, nakoso Yisɔ de, mbɔle ye.”

english_verse: Are we saying God is unfair? Certainly not!
translation_verse: Afei, yɛkɔhã ye sɛ? Aso Nyameɛ te nyeyemuɛ anaa? Dabida!

english_verse: The Lord told Moses that he has pity and mercy on anyone he wants to.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔhã hyirele Mose kyɛ, “Bɔ ngonwu ye anwumvo ne yeɛ ngonwu ye anwumvoin ɔ, yeɛ bɔ ye nwo kɔyɛ me aworabɔ ne yeɛ ye nwo kɔyɛ me aworabɔ ɔ.”

english_verse: Everything then depends on God's mercy and not on what people want or do.
translation_verse: Yiti oggyi bɔ kuro sona okuro anaa bɔ ɔkɔyɔ so, na mmom ogyi Nyameɛ anwumvoinnwunɛ so.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says to the king of Egypt, “I let you become king, so that I could show you my power and be praised by all people on earth.”
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ati yeɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne sele Faro kyɛ, “Mapagya wɔ, kyɛbɔ ngɔfa wɔ so ngɔma me tumi kɔla ali wɔ wɔ nu, ná babɔ me dumaa wɔ aseɛ so amukoraa ɔ.”

english_verse: Everything depends on what God decides to do, and he can either have pity on people or make them stubborn. God's Anger and Mercy
translation_verse: Na sɛ sɔ yeɛ ɔte de a, nzaade sona biala bɔ Nyameɛ kuro ye dwirɛ yeɛ onwu ye anwumvoin ɔ; yeɛ sona biala bɔ Nyameɛ kuro ne, yeɛ opini ye ahone ɔ. Pɔɔlo kyire Nyameɛ yaa ne ye anwumvoin bo

english_verse: Someone may ask, “How can God blame us, if he makes us behave in the way he wants us to?”
translation_verse: Afei ebie kobisa me kyɛ, “Nzaade nzu ati yeɛ Nyameɛ tɛnwu sona nwo mvomsoɛ ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kosi Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ nwo atee ɔ?”

english_verse: But, my friend, I ask, “Who do you think you are to question God? Does the clay have the right to ask the potter why he shaped it the way he did?
translation_verse: Nzaade kuro sona, wɔ ole nwa bɔ ɛne Nyameɛ di nyeyeanoɛ ɔ? Bua ngora mmisa bɔ ɔnwone ye ne kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɛnwone me sɔa ɔ?”

english_verse: Doesn't a potter have the right to make a fancy bowl and a plain bowl out of the same lump of clay?”
translation_verse: Ngukuenwonɛniɛ ne, aso olle ɛfaa so tumi, kyɛ ɔfa ɛfaa torɛ komapɛ ne ala ɔnwo bua ko maa ɔyɛ nyemenenyemene ná ɔnwo ko koso maa ɔyɛ bibirikyii ɔ?

english_verse: God wanted to show his anger and reveal his power against everyone who deserved to be destroyed. But instead, he patiently put up with them.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ Nyameɛ ayɔ ɔ. Ɔyɛle kyɛ ahaa ɔkɔla ye yaafɛlɛ piri ne ye tumi ali. Nakoso onyane aboterɛ mane bɛ bɔ ɔfɛle bɛ nwo yaa bɔ b’ayieleɛ ole ewue ne.

english_verse: He did this by showing how glorious he is when he has pity on the people he has chosen to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Afei koso ɔyɛle kyɛ ɔkɔla ye animnyam mmorosoɛ ne ali kohyire bɛ bɔ wanwu bɛ anwumvoin ne, ofikyɛ wasiesie bɛ wasie berɛ dada kyɛ bɛfata ye animnyam ne.

english_verse: Whether Jews or Gentiles, we are those chosen ones,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wamvrɛ yɛ wamvi Yudafoɛ ngome nu, na mmom ɔfrɛle yɛ fili Amaenmaensofoɛ koso nu bie.

english_verse: just as the Lord says in the book of Hosea, “Although they are not my people, I will make them my people. I will treat with love those nations that have never been loved.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ Hosea nwomaa ne anu kyɛ, “Mmenia bɔ ahaa bɛtte me deɛ ne, ngɔfrɛ bɛ ‘Me mmenia,’ na bɔ manguro ye dwirɛ ne, ngɔfrɛ ye ‘Me dɔfo.’

english_verse: “Once they were told, ‘You are not my people.’ But in that very place they will be called children of the living God.”
translation_verse: Na nekaa bɔ besele bɛ kyɛ, ‘Ɛmɔtte me maen’ ne, berɛ ala yeɛ bɛkɔfrɛ bɛ Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne mma ɔ.”

english_verse: And this is what the prophet Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “The people of Israel are as many as the grains of sand along the beach. But only a few who are left will be saved.
translation_verse: Yesaya koso pakyele nu ha fale Yisraelfoɛ nwo serɛserɛ kyɛ, “Yisraelfoɛ sone pee kyɛ mboanoa anweaa de, nakoso bɛ nu kãa bie yeɛ bekole bɛ ngoa ɔ;
