english_verse: The Lord will be quick and sure to do on earth what he has warned he will do.”
translation_verse: ofikyɛ Awurade kɔma ye dwirɛ kɔwa nu ndɛndɛ so ne nyeranyera so wɔ aseɛ so.”

english_verse: Isaiah also said, “If the Lord All-Powerful had not spared some of our descendants, we would have been destroyed like the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah.” Israel and the Good News
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ Yesaya hã tole berɛ kyɛ, “Sɛ Asafo Awurade wanyakyi mmaa wamma yɛ a, ahaa yayɛ kyɛ Sodom, ná yakakyi kyɛ Gomora.” Yesu Kristo nu gyidie maa yɛyɛ teneneefoɛ

english_verse: What does all of this mean? It means that the Gentiles were not trying to be acceptable to God, but they found that he would accept them if they had faith.
translation_verse: Afei, yɛkɔhã ye sɛ? Amaenmaensofoɛ bɔ bandwene ye nwo le kyɛ bɛkɔpena tenenee si atee nen, bɛnate gyidie so banya tenenee.

english_verse: It also means that the people of Israel were not acceptable to God. And why not? It was because they were trying to be acceptable by obeying the Law instead of by having faith in God. The people of Israel fell over the stone that makes people stumble,
translation_verse: Nzu ati ɔ? Ofikyɛ bamva gyidie so bambere tenenee, na mmom bɛfale bɛ nnwumaa bɔ bɛyɔle ɔ so. Yiti besotili wɔ sundiboɔ ne aso,

english_verse: just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a stone to make people stumble and fall. But those who have faith in that one will never be disappointed.”
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Tie, méfa nyɔboɛ bie méto Sion bɔ ɔkɔyɛ sundiboɔ kɔma mmenia ɔ, nyɔbotaen bɔ ɔkɔmaa bekofi ase ɔ; nakoso ebiala bɔ okole ye koli ne, ye nyunu ngogua ase.”

english_verse: Dear friends, my greatest wish and my prayer to God is for the people of Israel to be saved.
translation_verse: Nniɛma mɔ, m’ahone nu dwirɛ ne me mbaeɛ bɔ mebɔ mekyire Nyameɛ mema Yisrael ole kyɛ bekonya daa ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: I know they love God, but they don't understand
translation_verse: Medi bɛ nwo adanzeɛ kyɛ bele Nyameɛ nwo dɔ; nakoso bɛ mmɔdenbɔlɛ ne oggyi nahorɛ nimdeɛ so.

english_verse: what makes people acceptable to him. So they refuse to trust God, and they try to be acceptable by obeying the Law.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛnze atee bɔ Nyameɛ fa so siesie ye ne mmenia b’afia ɔ, na mmom bɛyɛle kyɛ bɛkɔfa bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ tenenee atee so; yiti bammrɛ bɛ nwo ase bamma Nyameɛ atee bɔ ɔfa so yɛ kuro sona teneneeniɛ ne.

english_verse: But Christ makes the Law no longer necessary for those who become acceptable to God by faith. Anyone Can Be Saved
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ Kristo di mu tra mmeraa ne ati, amaa ɔnate so ebiala bɔ ode di ne babua ye be. Daa ngoa wɔ berɛ ma ebiala

english_verse: Moses said a person could become acceptable to God by obeying the Law. He did this when he wrote, “If you want to live, you must do all the Law commands.”
translation_verse: Mose hyerɛle fale tenenee bɔ ebie di mmeraa ne aso a ɔyɛ ne nwo kyɛ, “Sona bɔ odi mmeraa n’ahyɛdeɛ so ne, ɔkɔfa so konya nu ngoa.”

english_verse: But people whose faith makes them acceptable to God will never ask, “Who will go up to heaven to bring Christ down?”
translation_verse: Na tenenee bɔ ogyi gyidie so ne, ɔkã kyɛ, “Nnɛkã ye wɔ w’ahone nu kyɛ, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔfo kɔhɔ nyameɛso ɔ?” ;

english_verse: Neither will they ask, “Who will go down into the world of the dead to raise him to life?”
translation_verse: anaakyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ okodwu kɔhɔ kumaa kuronguronn ne anu ɔ?” .

english_verse: All who are acceptable because of their faith simply say, “The message is as near as your mouth or your heart.” And this is the same message we preach about faith.
translation_verse: Nzikyɛ yeɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne ɔkã ɔ? “Edwirɛ ne apingye wɔ, ɔwɔ wɔ noa ne w’ahone nu,” .

english_verse: So you will be saved, if you honestly say, “Jesus is Lord,” and if you believe with all your heart that God raised him from death.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɛ ɛfa wɔ noa kã ye pefee kyɛ Yesu te Awurade, ná ede di wɔ w’ahone nu kyɛ Nyameɛ atingye ye afi awufoɛ nu a, ekonya daa ngoa.

english_verse: God will accept you and save you, if you truly believe this and tell it to others.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, sona fa ye ahone yeɛ ode di ɔkɔ tenenee nu ɔ; na ye noa yeɛ ɔfa kã ye pefee onya daa ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say no one who has faith will be disappointed,
translation_verse: Na Ahyerɛlɛ ne kã kyɛ, “Ebiala bɔ ode ye di ne, ye nyunu ngogua ase.”

english_verse: no matter if that person is a Jew or a Gentile. There is only one Lord, and he is generous to everyone who asks for his help.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nzonzoleɛ biala nne Yudaniɛ ne Helaniɛ nu; Awurade komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔte bɛ mukoraa bɛ Mene ɔ, na oyira ebiala bɔ osũ frɛ ye ɔ.

english_verse: All who call out to the Lord will be saved.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔbɔ Awurade dumaa ne, okonya ngoa.

english_verse: How can people have faith in the Lord and ask him to save them, if they have never heard about him? And how can they hear, unless someone tells them?
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ ná mmenia basu bafrɛ ye wɔ abrɛ bɔ benne ye benni ɔ? Na ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ ná bale bɔ bɛttele ye nwo dwirɛ le ɔ bali? Na ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ ná bate, wɔ abrɛ bɔ nzɛmbahanɛniɛ nne berɛ ɔ?

english_verse: And how can anyone tell them without being sent by the Lord? The Scriptures say it is a beautiful sight to see even the feet of someone coming to preach the good news.
translation_verse: Na sɛ banzoma mmenia a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ ná babɔ edwirɛ ne dawure? Kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye kyɛ, “Bɛ bɔ bɛso ndɛenvɛen bɛnate ne, kyɛbɔ bɛ gya bo osi yɛ nyemene ɔ!”

english_verse: Yet not everyone has believed the message. For example, the prophet Isaiah asked, “Lord, has anyone believed what we said?”
translation_verse: Nakoso nna bɛ mukoraa yeɛ bayɛ sotie bama nzɛmba ne ɔ. Ofikyɛ Yesaya kã kyɛ, “Awurade, nwa yeɛ wale yɛ noa dwirɛ ne wali ɔ?”

english_verse: But am I saying that the people of Israel did not hear? No, I am not! The Scriptures say, “The message was told everywhere on earth. It was announced all over the world.”
translation_verse: Nakoso mebisa kyɛ, bennya bɛttele anaa? Amba, bate, ofikyɛ, “Bɛ komvi adwu aseɛ so nekaa biala, na bɛ dwirɛ adwu wiase nekaa biala.”

english_verse: Did the people of Israel understand or not? Moses answered this question when he told that the Lord had said, “I will make Israel jealous of people who are a nation of nobodies. I will make them angry with people who don't understand a thing.”
translation_verse: Mesa mebisa kyɛ, yiti Yisrael ande edwirɛ ne bo anaa? Mose lili moa hane kyɛ, “Ngɔma ɛmɔ nye kɔboro mmenia bɔ bɛ de nna me maen ahɔ ɔ; na ngɔfa maen bɔ b’adwene te nganga ɔ ngohu ɛmɔ ahone.”

english_verse: Isaiah was fearless enough to tell that the Lord had said, “I was found by people who were not looking for me. I appeared to the ones who were not asking about me.”
translation_verse: Afei Yesaya sili ye ahone hane kyɛ, “Bɛ bɔ bambena me si atee ne, banwu me, na maye me nwo ali mahyire bɛ bɔ bammisa me boso ɔ.”

english_verse: And Isaiah said about the people of Israel, “All day long the Lord has reached out to people who are stubborn and refuse to obey.”
translation_verse: Na ɔfa Yisrael nwo de, ɔhane kyɛ, “Alehyeleɛ biala, matrɛ me sa nu kyɛ ngole asoserɛfoɛ mmenia bɔ bayɛ me so lɔen ɔ.”

english_verse: Am I saying that God has turned his back on his people? Certainly not! I am one of the people of Israel, and I myself am a descendant of Abraham from the tribe of Benjamin.
translation_verse: Afei mebisa, aso Nyameɛ wapo ye maen anaa? Dabida! Ofikyɛ me bɔbɔ nde Yisraelniɛ, nde Abraham bosoniɛ, mvi Benyamin abusua kure nu.

english_verse: God did not turn his back on his chosen people. Don't you remember reading in the Scriptures how Elijah complained to God about the people of Israel?
translation_verse: Nyameɛ de, ɔppole ye maen bɔ onwuni bɛ siele dada ne. Aso ɛmɔnze edwirɛ bɔ Ahyerɛlɛ ne kã fa Elia nwo, kyɛbɔ ɔbɔle Yisrael kwaadu hyirele Nyameɛ ne?

english_verse: He said, “Lord, they killed your prophets and destroyed your altars. I am the only one left, and now they want to kill me.”
translation_verse: kyɛ, “Awurade, bahu wɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ, na badwiri w’afɔleɛ mmokyea koso bagua; na waha me ngome, na bɛpena me beku me.”

english_verse: This means that only a chosen few of the people of Israel found what all of them were searching for. And the rest of them were stubborn,
translation_verse: Afei de nzikyɛ bieku? Yisrael sa anga nikyee bɔ né ɔpena ne. Bɛ bɔ waneanea nu waye bɛ ne, bɛ sa hane ye; nakoso bɛ ngaa ne de, bɛyɛle asoserɛ,

english_verse: It is the same way now. God treated the people of Israel with undeserved grace, and so a few of them are still his followers.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ kekesaala ye Nyameɛ nate ye adom so wasa nu waye bɛ ngaa ne ɔ.

english_verse: This happened because of God's undeserved kindness and not because of anything they have done. It could not have happened except for God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔnate adom so de a, nzaade Nyameɛ frɛlɛ ne oggyi nnwumaa so ko, na sɛ ogyi nnwumaa so de a, ahaa adom ne ɔtte adom ko.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “God made them so stupid that their eyes are blind, and their ears are still deaf.”
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Nyameɛ ama bɛ adwene bɔ wala ɔ, anyeɛ bɔ onnwu nikye ɔ, asoɛ bɔ ɔnde dwirɛ ɔ maa waadwu ɛnɛ kyẽa ye.”

english_verse: Then David said, “Turn their meals into bait for a trap, so that they will stumble and be given what they deserve.
translation_verse: Na Dawide kã kyɛ, “Ma bɛ poentolɛ ɔyɛ kafoli ne ngaen, sundidua ne asohwenɛ ma bɛ!

english_verse: Blindfold their eyes! Don't let them see. Bend their backs beneath a burden that will never be lifted.” Gentiles Will Be Saved
translation_verse: Ma bɛ nye so ɔyɛ tunn bɔ bennwu hwee ɔ, ná ma bɛ nu kundu daa.”

english_verse: Do I mean that the people of Israel fell, never to get up again? Certainly not! Their failure made it possible for the Gentiles to be saved, and this will make the people of Israel jealous.
translation_verse: Yiti mebisa kyɛ, aso basoti bɔ bɛpena befi ase anaa? Dabida! Na mmom ɔnate b’asoserɛ ne aso yeɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ banya ngoalelɛ ɔ, bɔ ɔkɔma Yisrael kɔhwe ye nwo kora ɔ.

english_verse: But if the rest of the world's people were helped so much by their sin and loss, they will be helped even more by their full return.
translation_verse: Na sɛ b’asoserɛ fale saleɛ brɛle wiase, ná b’asefinɛ koso fale saleɛ brɛle Amaenmaensofoɛ a, ye de sɛ osa ode Yisrael to nu bɔkɔɔ a, saleɛ mmorosoɛ yeɛ ɔkɔwa ɔ! Amaenmaensofoɛ daa ngoa

english_verse: I am now speaking to you Gentiles, and as long as I am an apostle to you, I will take pride in my work.
translation_verse: Afei medwudwo mekyire ɛmɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ; na ɔnate kyɛ nde Amaenmaensofoɛ somafoɛ ne ati, mefa me solɛ adwuma mehoahoa me nwo;

english_verse: I hope in this way to make some of my own people jealous enough to be saved.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ me bɔbɔ me mmenia Yudafoɛ bɛ nye kɔboro ɔ, bɔ ɔnate so bɛ nu biemɔ konya daa ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: When Israel rejected God, the rest of the people in the world were able to turn to him. So when God makes friends with Israel, it will be like bringing the dead back to life.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔnate bɛ polɛ bɔ Nyameɛ pole bɛ ne ati Nyameɛ ne adasa mmaa benyane ngabonu a, nzaade sɛ besa bɛba Nyameɛ berɛ a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ koraa? Ɔkɔyɛ daa ngoa bɔ ofi awufoɛ nu ɔ!

english_verse: If part of a batch of dough is made holy by being offered to God, then all of the dough is holy. If the roots of a tree are holy, the rest of the tree is holy too.
translation_verse: Sɛ bakaammaa bɔ bekoli moa bɛkɔte ne te krongron ma Nyameɛ a, nzaade ye ngaa bɔ waha ne amukoraa te krongron; na sɔ ala yeɛ sɛ bakaa ndii ne te krongron a, ye mmaen ne koso te krongron ɔ.

english_verse: You Gentiles are like branches of a wild olive tree made to be part of a cultivated olive tree. You have taken the place of some branches that were cut away from it. And because of this, you enjoy the blessings that come from being part of that cultivated tree.
translation_verse: Babubu olive bakaa bɔ bahyɛ da balua ne mmaen ne bie bagua, na bafa ɛmɔ, Amaenmaensofoɛ bɔ ɛmɔte kyɛ olive bakaa bɔ ogyi ye buro ne basi bɛ gya nu, amaa ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔanya kyɛfa wɔ bakaa ne ndii ne ye nzue nu.

english_verse: But don't think you are better than the branches that were cut away. Just remember you are not supporting the roots of this tree. Its roots are supporting you.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɛmɔhoahoa bɛ nwo bekyire bakaa mmaen bɔ bɛpɛle bɛ beguale ne. Sɛ ɛmɔhoahoa bɛ nwo a, ɛmɔkaye kyɛ nna ɛmɔ yeɛ ɛmɔtira ndii ne anu ɔ, na mmom ndii ne yeɛ betira ɛmɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: Maybe you think those branches were cut away, so you could be put in their place.
translation_verse: Afei ɛkɔha kyɛ, “Amba, bebubuli bakaa mmaen ne beguale kyɛbɔ bɛkɔfa me bekosi bɛ gya nu ɔ.”

english_verse: That's true enough. But they were cut away because they did not have faith, and you are where you are because you do have faith. So don't be proud, but be afraid.
translation_verse: Ɔte amba, bebubuli bɛ beguale, ofikyɛ né benne benni, nakoso wɔ de, wɔ gyidie ti yeɛ ɔmaa ɛtɛ mata bakaa ne nwo ɔ. Yiti nnɛhoahoa wɔ nwo, na mmom suro.

english_verse: If God cut away those natural branches, couldn't he do the same to you?
translation_verse: Na sɛ Nyameɛ amva bakaa mmaen bɔ bɛhyɛle da beluale ne nwo wangyɛ bɛ a, nzaade ɔngɔfa wɔ koso wɔ nwo ngɔhyɛ wɔ.

english_verse: Now you see both how kind and how hard God can be. He was hard on those who fell, but he was kind to you. And he will keep on being kind to you, if you keep on trusting in his kindness. Otherwise, you will be cut away too.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ enwu Nyameɛ ye anwumvoinnwunɛ ne ɔne ye anyeborolɛ ne. Ɔma ye nye boro bɛ bɔ bali makyebu ne aso; na wɔ de, Nyameɛ da ye paayɛlɛ ali kyire wɔ, nakoso sana ɛtena ye paayɛlɛ ne anu, na wamma ye sɔ de a, ɔkɔpɛ wɔ kɔto.

english_verse: If those other branches will start having faith, they will be made a part of that tree again. God has the power to put them back.
translation_verse: Na Yisraelfoɛ po, sɛ bɛyakyi elelɛ bɔ benne benni ne a, Nyameɛ kɔfa bɛ kowura bɛ boso, ofikyɛ ole tumi kyɛ osa fa bɛ wura bɛ boso ɔ.

english_verse: After all, it wasn't natural for branches to be cut from a wild olive tree and to be made part of a cultivated olive tree. So it is much more likely that God will join the natural branches back to the cultivated olive tree. The People of Israel Will Be Brought Back
translation_verse: Na sɛ bapɛ ɛmɔ bafi olive bakaa bɔ ogyi eburo nwo, ná bakwati abɔdeɛ mmeraa bafa ɛmɔ bamata olive bakaa bɔ bahyɛ da balua nwo a, nzaade a ɔkɔyɛ mmerɛ kɔma Nyameɛ kyɛ ɔkɔfa olive bakaa bɔ bahyɛ da balua ne bɔbɔ mmaen kosa kɔmata ye bɔbɔ ye bakaa nwo. Nyameɛ nwu mmenia mukoraa anwumvoin

english_verse: My friends, I don't want you Gentiles to be too proud of yourselves. So I will explain the mystery of what has happened to the people of Israel. Some of them have become stubborn, and they will stay like that until the complete number of you Gentiles has come in.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ he yeɛ mekuro kyɛ ɛmɔnwu ye ɔ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔammu ɛmɔ nwo nworɛfoɛ bandra so. Ye ole kyɛ, Yisrael ye bue bie bayɛ asoserɛ, maa okoodwu kyɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ somaa bɛkɔwa Nyameɛ berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: In this way all of Israel will be saved, as the Scriptures say, “From Zion someone will come to rescue us. Then Jacob's descendants will stop being evil.
translation_verse: Yiti bekole Yisrael amukoraa ngoa, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Defoɛ ne kofi Sion yeɛ ɔkɔwa ɔ, na ɔkɔye amumuyɛɛ biala kofi Yakob nu.

english_verse: This is what the Lord has promised to do when he forgives their sins.”
translation_verse: Na apam bɔ me ne bɛ yɛkɔyɛ hɔ ɛne, mmerɛ bɔ ngɔye bɛ bɔne ngofi berɛ ne.”

english_verse: The people of Israel are treated as God's enemies, so the good news can come to you Gentiles. But they are still the chosen ones, and God loves them because of their famous ancestors.
translation_verse: Na ɔfa Nzɛmba ne anwo de, ɔnate ɛmɔ ti bɛte pɔfoɛ mɔ; nakoso ɔfa bɛ bɔ waneanea nu waye bɛ ne anwo de, ɔnate bɛ nana mɔ ti, bɛla Nyameɛ ahone nwo;

english_verse: God doesn't take back the gifts he has given or disown the people he has chosen.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ Nyameɛ adom akyɛdeɛ ne ye frɛlɛ ne, ɔnzesã ye adwene wɔ ye nwo.

english_verse: At one time you Gentiles rejected God. But now Israel has rejected God, and you have been shown mercy.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ koso mmerɛ bie ɛmɔanne Nyameɛ banni, nakoso afei de, ɔnate elelɛ bɔ banni ne aso wanwu ɛmɔ anwumvoin nen,

english_verse: And because of the mercy shown to you, they will also be shown mercy.
translation_verse: sɔ ala koso yeɛ kekesaala ye bayɛ asoserɛ ɔ, amaa ɔnate anwumvoin bɔ wanwu ɛmɔ ne aso, bɛ koso wanwu bɛ anwumvoin.

english_verse: All people have disobeyed God, and that's why he treats them as prisoners. But he does this, so that he can have mercy on all of them.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ abu mmenia mukoraa kyɛ bɛte asoserɛfoɛ, amaa ɔnate so wanwu bɛ mukoraa anwumvoin. Pɔɔlo ye Nyameɛ ayɛ

english_verse: Who can measure the wealth and wisdom and knowledge of God? Who can understand his decisions or explain what he does?
translation_verse: O! Nyameɛ anwonya ne ye nworɛ ne ye nimdeɛ nu pi! Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kohyirehyire ye porɛ bɔ wabɔ nu ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ɔse ye atee bɔ ɔfa so yɔ ye nningyein, anaa nwa yeɛ ɔkɔte ye bo koyie ɔ?

english_verse: “Has anyone known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?
translation_verse: “Nwa yeɛ ɔse Awurade adwene ɔ, anaa nwa yeɛ ɔte ye foɛtulɛniɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Has anyone loaned something to the Lord that must be repaid?”
translation_verse: Anaakyɛ nwa yeɛ wali moa wahyɛ ye nikye, bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔyɔ bie tua ye kerɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Everything comes from the Lord. All things were made because of him and will return to him. Praise the Lord forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔbɔle nikyee biala ɔ, na ye tumi yeɛ ɔma nikyee biala te ase ma ye ɔ. Animnyam hã Nyameɛ daa daa! Amen.

english_verse: Dear friends, God is good. So I beg you to offer your bodies to him as a living sacrifice, pure and pleasing. That's the most sensible way to serve God.
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ngyi Nyameɛ anwumvoinnwunɛ so mesrɛ ɛmɔ, kyɛ ɛ́mɔtu ɛmɔ nipadua bésie berɛ kyɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔte ase ɔ, bɔ ɔte krongron ná ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ, na ɛhe yeɛ ɔte ɛmɔ nyamesom bɔ ɔfata ɔ.

english_verse: Don't be like the people of this world, but let God change the way you think. Then you will know how to do everything that is good and pleasing to him.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ ɛmɔ nwo kyɛ wiase he, na mmom ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ adwene nu foforɛyɛlɛ ne ɔsakyera ɛmɔ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanwu bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ ɔ, bɔ ɔte paa, ɔsɔ anyeɛ ná odi mu ɔ.

english_verse: I realize God has treated me with undeserved grace, and so I tell each of you not to think you are better than you really are. Use good sense and measure yourself by the amount of faith that God has given you.
translation_verse: Ɔnate adom akyɛdeɛ bɔ wafa wama me ne ati, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ nnɛma ɛmɔ nu biala bu ye nwo kyɛ odi mu tra kyɛbɔ ɔte ɔ. Na mmom ɛmɔdwene anwobrɛaseɛ adwene kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ gyidie bɔ wafa wama ebiala ne si te ɔ.

english_verse: A body is made up of many parts, and each of them has its own use.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ yɛle akwaa pee wɔ nipadua ko nu, ná nzonzoleɛ wɔ akwaa nemɔ amukoraa b’adwuma nu ne,

english_verse: That's how it is with us. There are many of us, but we each are part of the body of Christ, as well as part of one another.
translation_verse: sɔ ala yeɛ yɛ koso bɔ yɛsone ne, yɛte nipadua komapɛ wɔ Kristo nu ɔ. Ebiala te sonongo de, nakoso yɛ mukoraa yatoatoa nu yayɛ nipadua ko.

english_verse: God has also given each of us different gifts to use. If we can prophesy, we should do it according to the amount of faith we have.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛfa yɛ adom akyɛdeɛ ahoroɔ ne yɛyɛ adwuma kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ alo yɛ ɔ. Sɛ ɔte ngɔmhyɛlɛ a, ɛmɔma yɛhyɛ ngɔm kyɛbɔ yɛ gyidie te ɔ;

english_verse: If we can serve others, we should serve. If we can teach, we should teach.
translation_verse: sɛ ɔte ɛsolɛ a, ɛmɔma yɛso; sɛ ɔte ngyerɛkyerɛ a, ɛmɔma yɛhyirehyire;

english_verse: If we can encourage others, we should encourage them. If we can give, we should be generous. If we are leaders, we should do our best. If we are good to others, we should do it cheerfully. Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: sɛ ɔte nguraenhyɛlɛ a, ɛmɔma yɛhyɛ. Sɛ ebie yɛ adɔeɛ a, maa ɔye ye kunu ɔyɛ; ebiala bɔ ɔnea mmenia so ne, maa ɔyere ye nwo; na bɔ ɔse anwumvoin ne, maa ɔte ye nyunu yɔ.

english_verse: Be sincere in your love for others. Hate everything that is evil and hold tight to everything that is good.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ ɔdɔ ɔyɛ kaenn; ɛ́mɔhyi bɔne, ná ɛ́mɔtira bɔ ɔte paa ɔ nu serɛserɛ.

english_verse: Love each other as brothers and sisters and honor others more than you do yourself.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhurohuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ kyɛ aliɛmaa mɔ, ná ɛ́mɔli moa bɛ́fa anidie bɛ́moma bɛ nwo bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Never give up. Eagerly follow the Holy Spirit and serve the Lord.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ mmɔdenbɔlɛ ɔkɔ ase, ɛ́mɔyɛ hye wɔ sunzum nu, ná ɛ́mɔso Awurade.

english_verse: Let your hope make you glad. Be patient in time of trouble and never stop praying.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnya anigye wɔ anyelasoɛ nu, ɛ́mɔnya aboterɛ wɔ amaneɛnwunɛ nu, ná ɛmɔhɔ so bɛbɔ mbaeɛ daa.

english_verse: Take care of God's needy people and welcome strangers into your home.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔboka anwoteefoɛ wɔ bɔ ohia bɛ ɔ nwo, ná ɛ́mɔbɔ mmɔden wɔ ɛwɔfoɛsolɛ nwo.

english_verse: Ask God to bless everyone who mistreats you. Ask him to bless them and not to curse them.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔyirayira bɛ bɔ bɛtane ɛmɔ nye ɔ, ɛ́mɔyirayira bɛ, na nnɛma ɛmɔnoma bɛ.

english_verse: When others are happy, be happy with them, and when they are sad, be sad.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ ne bɛ bɔ bɛ nye aha ne nye ha, na ɛmɔ ne bɛ bɔ besu ne besu.

english_verse: Be friendly with everyone. Don't be proud and feel that you know more than others. Make friends with ordinary people.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛ́yɛ adwene ko; na nnɛma ɛmɔmoma ɛmɔ nwo so, na mmom ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase. Nnɛma ɛmɔbu ɛmɔ nwo nworɛfoɛ.

english_verse: Don't mistreat someone who has mistreated you. But try to earn the respect of others,
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɔne betua ebiala bɔne kerɛ. Na mmom ɛ́mɔdwene bɔ ɔte paa wɔ mmenia mukoraa bɛ nye so ɔ nwo.

english_verse: and do your best to live at peace with everyone.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔkɔhora a, ɛmɔ bue nu de, ɛmɔ ne ebiala bɛ́tena asomdwee nu.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't try to get even. Let God take revenge. In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I am the one to take revenge and pay them back.”
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔtotɔ ɛmɔ nwo wereɛ, na mmom ɛ́mɔyakyi bɛ́ma Nyameɛ ahonehulɛ ne. Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Wereɛtɔlɛ te me deɛ, na ngotua so kerɛ, Awurade noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “If your enemies are hungry, give them something to eat. And if they are thirsty, give them something to drink. This will be the same as piling burning coals on their heads.”
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ ɛhɔen ku wɔ pɔfoɛ a, ma ye nikyee ma oli; yeɛ sɛ nzuhɔen ku ye a, ma ye nzue ma ɔno; ofikyɛ sɛ ɛyɔ sɔ a, ɛkɔboaboa see nzramaa noa ekogua ye ti afia.

english_verse: Don't let evil defeat you, but defeat evil with good.
translation_verse: Nnɛma bɔne di wɔ so ngonim, na mmom fa paa di bɔne so ngonim.

english_verse: Obey the rulers who have authority over you. Only God can give authority to anyone, and he puts these rulers in their places of power.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ sona biala brɛ ye nwo ase wura maen mbanyi tumi bo, ofikyɛ tumi biala nne berɛ, sana bɔ ofi Nyameɛ berɛ ɔ; na tumi mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ berɛ ne, Nyameɛ yeɛ wahyehyɛ wato berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: People who oppose the authorities are opposing what God has done, and they will be punished.
translation_verse: Yiti ebiala bɔ odwɔso tia maen mbanyi nen, né wadwɔso watia bɔ Nyameɛ ahyehyɛ wato berɛ ne; na ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ sɔ nen, okonya ye nwo foɛbualɛ.

english_verse: Rulers are a threat to evil people, not to good people. There is no need to be afraid of the authorities. Just do right, and they will praise you for it.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛ yɔleɛ te paa ne, maen mbanyi nwo nyɛ suro mma bɛ, na mmom bɛ nwo yɛ suro ma bɛ bɔ benni dwirɛ paa ɔ. Aso enguro kyɛ ekosuro bɔ tumi wura ye sa anaa? Nzaade di dwirɛ paa, na ɔkɔkamvo wɔ.

english_verse: After all, they are God's servants, and it is their duty to help you. If you do something wrong, you ought to be afraid, because these rulers have the right to punish you. They are God's servants who punish criminals to show how angry God is.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wɔ yeeyɛlɛ ti bɛte Nyameɛ somvoɛ. Nakoso sɛ ɛyɔ bɔne de a, ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ esuro ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ bendira ɛhɔtɔ ne mbaen! Bɛte Nyameɛ somvoɛ bɔ bɛtɔ wereɛ bɛma bɛ yaafɛlɛ ba sona bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne so ɔ.

english_verse: But you should obey the rulers because you know it is the right thing to do, and not just because of God's anger.
translation_verse: Yiti, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔbrɛ bɛ nwo ase bewura bɛ bo; nna kyɛ ɛmɔkɔnwati bekofi Nyameɛ yaafɛlɛ piri ne anu angome ti ɔ, na mmom ɛmɔ tiboa koso ti ɔ.

english_verse: You must also pay your taxes. The authorities are God's servants, and it is their duty to take care of these matters.
translation_verse: Ɛhe koso ati yeɛ ɛmɔtua toɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ mbanyi nemɔ bɛte Nyameɛ somvoɛ mɔ bɔ daa biala bɛyɔ sɔ adwuma ne ɔ.

english_verse: Let love be your only debt! If you love others, you have done all that the Law demands.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma ebiala kerɛ, sana ɔdɔ bɔ ɛmɔfa bekurokuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ ɔ; ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ okuro obiɛngo dwirɛ nen, né wali mmeraa ne aso.

english_verse: In the Law there are many commands, such as, “Be faithful in marriage. Do not murder. Do not steal. Do not want what belongs to others.” But all of these are summed up in the command that says, “Love others as much as you love yourself.”
translation_verse: Mmeraa ne nwa, “Nnɛsɛkye agyaa, nnɛdi awue, nnɛwua, [nnɛdi adanzewia], nnɛma wɔ nye boro ebie nikye.” Na sɛ mmeraa dwirɛ biala boka so a, babɔ ye porɛ wɔ edwirɛ he anu kyɛ, “Kuro ebiɛngo dwirɛ kyɛ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo.”

english_verse: No one who loves others will harm them. So love is all that the Law demands. The Day When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Sɛ ekuro ebiɛngo dwirɛ a, ɛnyɛ ye bɔne; yiti ɔdɔ yeɛ mmeraa ne gyi so ɔ.

english_verse: You know what sort of times we live in, and so you should live properly. It is time to wake up. You know that the day when we will be saved is nearer now than when we first put our faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Na ɛhemɔ asi ne, ɛmɔse mmerɛ ne, kyɛ mmerɛ aso kyɛ ɛmɔtingye befi nnaa nu ɔ. Ofikyɛ yɛ ngoalelɛ ne wapingye watra mmerɛ bɔ yɛɛyɛle agyidifoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Night is almost over, and day will soon appear. We must stop behaving as people do in the dark and be ready to live in the light.
translation_verse: Aleɛ sane ɔ ahyɛ, na alehyeleɛ apingye. Yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛgyi awosii nu yɔleɛ nemɔ yɛgua, ná yɛfa kanea nu akodeɛ yɛwura.

english_verse: So behave properly, as people do in the day. Don't go to wild parties or get drunk or be vulgar or indecent. Don't quarrel or be jealous.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma yɛbɔ bra paa bɔ ɔfata alehyeleɛ ɔ, na nna kyɛ anigye mmorosoɛ ne nzaabolɛ nu, nna adwamanbɔlɛ ne ahohwie nu, ngondii ne anyeboroborolɛ nu.

english_verse: Let the Lord Jesus Christ be as near to you as the clothes you wear. Then you won't try to satisfy your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Na mmom ɛ́mɔfa Awurade Yesu Kristo akodeɛ ne bewura, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔdi anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ si bɛyɔ ye apɛdeɛ bɛma ye.

english_verse: Welcome all the Lord's followers, even those whose faith is weak. Don't criticize them for having beliefs that are different from yours.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔyɛ mmerɛ wɔ gyidie nu ne, ɛ́mɔle ye bɛto nu, na nnɛma ɛmɔ ne ye su aporowaa fa nikyee bɔ ɛmɔ ne ye nyɛ adwene nwo.

english_verse: Some think it is all right to eat anything, while those whose faith is weak will eat only vegetables.
translation_verse: Ebie de di kyɛ ɔkora odi nikyee biala, yeɛ sona bɔ ɔyɛ mmerɛ ne de, odi nyaanyaa ngome.

english_verse: But you should not criticize others for eating or for not eating. After all, God welcomes everyone.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ odi ne, ɔnzɛ kyɛ obu sona bɔ onni ne animtia; yeɛ sona bɔ onni ne koso, ɔnzɛ kyɛ obua sona bɔ odi ne ndɛen, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ale ye ato nu.

english_verse: What right do you have to criticize someone else's servants? Only their Lord can decide if they are doing right, and the Lord will make sure that they do right.
translation_verse: Wɔ ole nwa bɔ ebua ebie akoaa ndɛen ɔ? Ye bɔbɔ ye mene yeɛ okohyire kyɛ ɔsɔ ye nye anaa ɔnzɔ ye nye ɔ. Na ɔkɔsɔ ye nye, ofikyɛ Awurade kora maa ɔsɔ ye nye.

english_verse: Some of the Lord's followers think one day is more important than another. Others think all days are the same. But each of you should make up your own mind.
translation_verse: Sona bie bu kyẽa ko kyɛ ɔte paa tra kyẽa foforɛ, yeɛ ebie koso dwene kyɛ ngyẽa mukoraa te pɛ. Ɛ́mɔma yɛ mukoraa yɛsi y’adwene pi.

english_verse: Any followers who count one day more important than another day do it to honor their Lord. And any followers who eat meat give thanks to God, just like the ones who don't eat meat.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔdwene kyɛ kyẽa bie te paa nen, ɔyɔ sɔ fa hyɛ Awurade animnyam. Yeɛ sona bɔ odi nikyee bie nen, odi fa hyɛ Awurade animnyam, ofikyɛ ɔda Nyameɛ ase. Sɔ ala yeɛ sona bɔ onni ne koso, ɔyɔ sɔ fa hyɛ Awurade animnyam ɔ, na ɔda Nyameɛ ase.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for God, rather than for ourselves.
translation_verse: Yɛ nu biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔte ase ma ye nwo ɔ, yeɛ yɛ nu biala nne berɛ bɔ owu ma ye nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Whether we live or die, it must be for the Lord. Alive or dead, we still belong to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛte ase a, yɛte yɛma Awurade, yeɛ yɛwu koso a, yɛwu yɛma Awurade. Yiti sɛ yɛte ase oo, sɛ yɛwu oo, yɛte Awurade deɛ.

english_verse: This is because Christ died and rose to life, so that he would be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati yeɛ Kristo wuli na otingyele ɔ, amaa wayɛ awufoɛ ne teasefoɛ b’Awurade.

english_verse: Why do you criticize other followers of the Lord? Why do you look down on them? The day is coming when God will judge all of us.
translation_verse: Na wɔ, nzu ati yeɛ ebua eliɛma ndɛen ɔ? Anaakyɛ wɔ koso, nzu ati yeɛ ebu eliɛma animtia ɔ? Ofikyɛ yɛ mukoraa yɛkogyina Nyameɛ ndɛenbualɛ bia ne nyunu.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “I swear by my very life that everyone will kneel down and praise my name!”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Awurade nwa, kyɛ nde ase ye de, nangoroma mukoraa bɛkɔkoto me, na noa mukoraa kɔbɔ Nyameɛ dumaa.

english_verse: And so, each of us must give an account to God for what we do. Don't Cause Problems for Others
translation_verse: Yiti yɛ nu biala kobu ye bɔbɔ ye nwo ngondaa kohyire Nyameɛ. Nnɛma ebiɛngo fi ase

english_verse: We must stop judging others. We must also make up our minds not to upset anyone's faith.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛyakyi kyɛ yɛkobua yɛ nwo yɛ nwo ndɛen ɔ. Na mmom ɛ́mɔma yɛyɛ y’adwene kyɛ yɛngɔfa pambim anaa sundidua yɛngɔto yɛ biɛngo atee nu ɔ.

english_verse: The Lord Jesus has made it clear to me that God considers all foods fit to eat. But if you think some foods are unfit to eat, then for you they are not fit.
translation_verse: Mese, na m’adwene koso si pi wɔ Awurade Yesu nu kyɛ, nikyee biala nne berɛ bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ; na mmom ye nwo nde ma sona bɔ obu aleɛ ne kyɛ ye nwo nde ɔ.

english_verse: If you are hurting others by the foods you eat, you are not guided by love. Don't let your appetite destroy someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Sɛ aleɛ bɔ edi ne ma ebiɛngo di aworabɔlɛ a, ye de né engyire ɔdɔ ko. Nnɛfa w’aleɛ bɔ edi ne sɛkye ebiɛngo bɔ Kristo wu mane ye ne.

english_verse: Don't let your right to eat bring shame to Christ.
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛma bɔ ɔte paa ma wɔ ne nya dumaa tɛɛ maa bɛka ye nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't about eating and drinking. It is about pleasing God, about living in peace, and about true happiness. All this comes from the Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ahennie ne ɔtte aleɛ ne anonneɛ, na mmom ɔte tenenee, asomdwee ne anika bɔ ofi Sunzum Krongron ne berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If you serve Christ in this way, you will please God and be respected by people.
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ ɔso Kristo wɔ atee sɔ ne aso ne, ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye, na mmenia bu ye.

english_verse: We should try to live at peace and help each other have a strong faith.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛmɔma yɛli nningyein bɔ bɛma asomdwee ɔne bɔ ɔfa ngɔsoɛ brɛ yɛ si.

english_verse: Don't let your appetite destroy what God has done. All foods are fit to eat, but it is wrong to cause problems for others by what you eat.
translation_verse: Aleɛ ti nnɛsɛkye Nyameɛ adwuma. Nikyee biala nwo te amba de, nakoso ɔtte mayee kyɛ ekoli aleɛ bie bɔ ɔkɔma eliɛma kɔyɛ bɔne ɔ.

english_verse: It is best not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything else that causes problems for other followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɔte paa kyɛ engoli naen anaa ɛngɔno nzaa anaa ɛngɔyɔ nikyee biala bɔ ɔkɔyɛ sundidua kɔma eliɛma ɔ.

english_verse: What you believe about these things should be kept between you and God. You are fortunate, if your actions don't make you have doubts.
translation_verse: Wɔ de, wɔ gyidie bɔ ele ye fa sɔ nningyein nemɔ nwo ne, maa ɔha wɔ ne Nyameɛ b’afia. Sona bɔ ye tiboa mmua ye foɛ wɔ nikyee bɔ ɔyɔ a ɔse kyɛ ɔte paa nwo ne, wanya saleɛ.

english_verse: But if you do have doubts about what you eat, you are going against your beliefs. And you know that is wrong, because anything you do against your beliefs is sin.
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ ye adwene yɛ ye naa ne, sɛ odi a, babua ye foɛ, ofikyɛ wamvi gyidie nu yeɛ olili ɔ. Ofikyɛ nikyee biala bɔ nna gyidie nu yeɛ ofi ne, ɔte bɔne.

english_verse: If our faith is strong, we should be patient with the Lord's followers whose faith is weak. We should try to please them instead of ourselves.
translation_verse: Yɛ bɔ yɛ nwo yɛ se wɔ gyidie nu ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛsoa bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo nyɛ se nemɔ bɛ mmerɛyɛlɛ, na ɔnzɛ kyɛ yɛyɔ bɔ ɔkɔma yɛ nwo kɔtɔ yɛ angome.

english_verse: We should think of their good and try to help them by doing what pleases them.
translation_verse: Na mmom ɛ́mɔma yɛ nu biala ɔyɔ bɔ ɔkɔma obiɛngo nwo kɔtɔ ye ɔ, bɔ ɔte paa ma ye, bɔ ɔkɔmaa okonyi gyidie nu ɔ.

english_verse: Even Christ did not try to please himself. But as the Scriptures say, “The people who insulted you also insulted me.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Kristo koso wanyɔ bɔ ɔkɔma ye ngome ye nwo kɔtɔ ye ɔ, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Bɛ bɔ bɛbɔle wɔ alapaa ne, b’alapaa ne waagua me so.”

english_verse: And the Scriptures were written to teach and encourage us by giving us hope.
translation_verse: Na nikyee biala bɔ bɛhyerɛ bɛtole berɛ tetetete ne, bɛhyerɛle maa ɔyɛle ngyerɛkyerɛ mane yɛ, kyɛ yɛfa aboterɛ ne Ahyerɛlɛ ne anu aworakyekyerɛ so yɛnya anyelasoɛ.

english_verse: God is the one who makes us patient and cheerful. I pray that he will help you live at peace with each other, as you follow Christ.
translation_verse: Me mbaeɛ ole kyɛ aboterɛ ne aworakyekyerɛ Nyameɛ ne ɔma ɛmɔfa adwene ko bɛtena, kyɛbɔ ɔfata Kristo Yesu ɔ,

english_verse: Then all of you together will praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. The Good News Is for Jews and Gentiles
translation_verse: amaa ɛmɔabɔ nu bafa noa ko bahyɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte y’Awurade Yesu Kristo Baba ne animnyam. Nzɛmba ne te Yudafoɛ ne Amaenmaensofoɛ deɛ

english_verse: Honor God by accepting each other, as Christ has accepted you.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔle ɛmɔ nwo ɛmɔ nwo bɛto nu, kyɛbɔ Kristo ale ɛmɔ ato nu ne, amaa Nyameɛ anya animnyam.

english_verse: I tell you that Christ came as a servant of the Jews to show that God has kept the promises he made to their famous ancestors. Christ also came,
translation_verse: Na mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, Kristo yɛle somvoɛ mane bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ fa hyirele Nyameɛ nahorɛlilɛ, kyɛ ɔma bɔhyɛ bɔ bɛhyɛle yɛ nana mɔ ne otindim,

english_verse: so that the Gentiles would praise God for being kind to them. It is just as the Scriptures say, “I will tell the nations about you, and I will sing praises to your name.”
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ bɛkɔhyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam wɔ ye anwumvoinnwunɛ nwo ɔ, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye kyɛ, “Yiti ngɔkamvo wɔ wɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ nu; na ngɔto edwein ngɔye wɔ dumaa ayɛ.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say to the Gentiles, “Come and celebrate with God's people.”
translation_verse: Na osa kã ye kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ, Amaenmaensofoɛ, ɛmɔ ne ye maen beli ahurusi.”

english_verse: Again the Scriptures say, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles. All you nations, come and worship him.”
translation_verse: Ɔkã ye bieku kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ, Amaenmaensofoɛ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔye Awurade ayɛ, maen maen amukoraa, ɛ́mɔkamvo ye!”

english_verse: Isaiah says, “Someone from David's family will come to power. He will rule the nations, and they will put their hope in him.”
translation_verse: Yesaya kã ye bieku kyɛ, “Yese ndii ne kɔwa, ye yeɛ okodwɔso kooli Amaenmaensofoɛ so hene ɔ, na ye so yeɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ kɔfa bɛ nye bɛkɔto ɔ.”

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives hope, will bless you with complete happiness and peace because of your faith. And may the power of the Holy Spirit fill you with hope. Paul's Work as a Missionary
translation_verse: Na mesrɛ kyɛ, anyelasoɛ Nyameɛ ne ɔfa gyidie nu anigye ne asomdwee amukoraa owura ɛmɔ nu tɛkyɛ, amaa ɔnate Sunzum Krongron tumi so ɛmɔanya anyelasoɛ mmorosoɛ. Pɔɔlo krataa ne botaeɛ

english_verse: My friends, I am sure that you are very good and that you have all the knowledge you need to teach each other.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, me bɔbɔ mede meto nu kyɛ paayɛlɛ ali ɛmɔ ti, kyɛ ɛmɔle nimdeɛ amukoraa, na ɛmɔkora betutu ɛmɔ nwo foɛ.

english_verse: But I have spoken to you plainly and have tried to remind you of some things. God treated me with undeserved grace!
translation_verse: Nakoso atee bie aso de, masi m’ahone mahyerɛ mabrɛ ɛmɔ, kyɛ mefa mebɔ ɛmɔ ngayeɛ; ɔnate adom bɔ Nyameɛ wafa walo me ne ati,

english_verse: He chose me to be a servant of Christ Jesus for the Gentiles and to do the work of a priest in the service of his good news. God did this so that the Holy Spirit could make the Gentiles into a holy offering, pleasing to him.
translation_verse: kyɛ nyɛ Kristo Yesu somvoɛ mma Amaenmaensofoɛ, ná nyɛ Nyameɛ nzɛmba ne nwo asɔfodwuma, ná Amaenmaensofoɛ bɛ́yɛ afɔleɛ bɔ ɔsɔ anyeɛ, bɔ Sunzum Krongron wate bɛ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Because of Christ Jesus, I can take pride in my service for God.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ mafa me nwo mabɔ Kristo Yesu nwo ti, mefa m’adwuma bɔ meyɔ mema Nyameɛ ne mehoahoa me nwo.

english_verse: In fact, all I will talk about is how Christ let me speak and work, so that the Gentiles would obey him.
translation_verse: Mengosi me hue mengɔhã nikyee biala nwo dwirɛ, sana bɔ Kristo nate me so wayɔ bɔ ɔma Amaenmaensofoɛ bɛyɛ sotie wɔ bɛ dwirɛ ne bɛ nnwumaa nu,

english_verse: Indeed, I will tell how Christ worked miracles and wonders by the power of the Holy Spirit. I have preached the good news about him all the way from Jerusalem to Illyricum.
translation_verse: nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ tumi so, Sunzum Krongron tumi so. Yiti mabɔ Kristo nzɛmba ne amukoraa nwo dawure mafi Yerusalem ne ye nwo nguro mɔ so maadwu Yilirikum.

english_verse: But I have always tried to preach where people have never heard about Christ. I am like a builder who doesn't build on someone else's foundation.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati me botaeɛ ole kyɛ ngɔbɔ nzɛmba ne dawure nekaa biala bɔ bennya bɛttele Kristo dumaa le ɔ, amaa ɔnate so mandoa ebie fapem bɔ wato ɔ so,

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “All who haven't been told about him will see him, and those who haven't heard about him will understand.” Paul's Plan To Visit Rome
translation_verse: na mmom kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Bɛ bɔ bɛhhane ye nwo dwirɛ behhyirele bɛ le ne, bekonwu ye yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛttele ye nwo dwirɛ le ne, bɛkɔte ye bo.” Pɔɔlo kuro kyɛ ɔkɔ Rome

english_verse: My work has always kept me from coming to see you.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔtaa si me atee bɔ yiti ɔmma mennya atee memma ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Now there is nothing left for me to do in this part of the world, and for years I have wanted to visit you.
translation_verse: Nakoso kekesaala ye de, mayie m’adwuma wɔ manzini hemɔ anu wa, yeɛ nyɛle m’adwene kyɛ ngɔɔpasa ɛmɔ nwo ɔ afoɛ pee awa,

english_verse: So I plan to stop off on my way to Spain. Then after a short, but refreshing, visit with you, I hope you will quickly send me on.
translation_verse: Na mekuro kyɛ mebaasẽ mekɔ Sepania a, ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ, ná manya ɛmɔ nwo anika mmerɛ kãa, ná afei ɛmɔaboka me maa matoa m’ateetulɛ ne aso mahɔ berɛ.

english_verse: I am now on my way to Jerusalem to deliver the money that the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia collected for God's needy people.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Makedonia ne Akaia asɔremma banya anika bakekã bɛ sa ase kyɛ ngɔmva mmoka anwoteefoɛ ehiafoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Yerusalem ne.

english_verse: This is something they really wanted to do. But sharing their money with the Jews was also like paying back a debt, because the Jews had already shared their spiritual blessings with the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle bɛ fɛ kyɛ bɛkɔyɔ sɔ ɔ; nahorɛ nu, ɔte b’asɛdeɛ kyɛ bɛboka bɛ ɔ. Ofikyɛ sɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ banya Yudafoɛ sunzum nu saleɛ ne bie de a, nzaade ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛ koso bɛfa b’anwoɔnaen nu saleɛ ne bie bɛboka bɛ.

english_verse: After I have safely delivered this money, I will visit you and then go on to Spain.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ meyie sɔ adwuma ye, ná mefa ndoboa bɔ baye ne mema bɛ a, ngɔfa ɛmɔ berɛ ná matoa so mahɔ Sepania.

english_verse: And when I do arrive in Rome, I know it will be with the full blessings of Christ.
translation_verse: Na mese kyɛ meba ɛmɔ berɛ a, ngɔfa Kristo nzɛmba ne anu saleɛ mmorosoɛ yeɛ ngɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, by the power of the Lord Jesus Christ and by the love that comes from the Holy Spirit, I beg you to pray sincerely with me and for me.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, méfa y’Awurade Yesu Kristo ɔne Sunzum ne dɔ mesrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛ́mɔboka me wɔ mbaeɛ bɔ ɛmɔbɔ bekyire Nyameɛ bɛma me ne anu,

english_verse: Pray that God will protect me from the unbelievers in Judea, and that his people in Jerusalem will be pleased with what I am doing.
translation_verse: ná ɔpepɛ le me fi bɛ bɔ benne nni bɔ bɛwɔ Yudea ne bɛ sa nu, ná me dwumadie bɔ mekwaali ye wɔ Yerusalem ne wasɔ anwoteefoɛ nemɔ nye;

english_verse: Ask God to let me come to you and have a pleasant and refreshing visit.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate Nyameɛ pɛ so mafa anigye mawa ɛmɔ berɛ, ná ɛmɔakyekye me wora.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will be with all of you. Amen.
translation_verse: Asomdwee Nyameɛ ne ɔne ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛtena. Amen.

english_verse: I have good things to say about Phoebe, who is a leader in the church at Cenchreae.
translation_verse: Medi y’eliɛma brasua Fobi bɔ ɔte asɔre somvoɛ wɔ Kɛnkrea ne mekyire ɛmɔ,

english_verse: Welcome her in a way that is proper for someone who has faith in the Lord and is one of God's own people. Help her in any way you can. After all, she has proved to be a respected leader for many others, including me.
translation_verse: kyɛ ɛ́mɔle ye bɛto nu wɔ Awurade nu, kyɛbɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ anwoteefoɛ bɛyɔ ɔ. Afei ɛ́mɔfa mmokalɛ biala bɔ ohia fi ɛmɔ berɛ bɛboka ye; ofikyɛ ɔte sona bɔ waboka mmeni pee ne me bɔbɔ koso.

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila. They have not only served Christ Jesus together with me,
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbisa Prisika ne Akwila ahye bɛ́ma me, bɛte nniɛma adwumayɔlɛfoɛ wɔ Kristo Yesu nu;

english_verse: but they have even risked their lives for me. I am grateful for them and so are all the Gentile churches.
translation_verse: bɛ yeɛ bɛfale bɛ ngoa bɛtole serewa bɛmane me ɔ. Nna me ngome yeɛ meda bɛ ase ɔ, na mmom Amaenmaensofoɛ asɔre ne amukoraa koso bɛda bɛ ase.

english_verse: Greet the church that meets in their home. Greet my dear friend Epaenetus, who was the first person in Asia to have faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbisa asɔre bɔ ɔwɔ b’awuro ne ahye bɛ́ma me. Ɛ́mɔbisa me dɔfo Ɛpaneto bɔ olili moa lele Kristo lili wɔ Asia ne ahye bɛ́ma me.

english_verse: Greet Mary, who has worked so hard for you.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbisa Maria bɔ wayere ye nwo wayɔ adwuma wama ɛmɔ ne ahye bɛ́ma me.

english_verse: Greet my relatives Andronicus and Junia, who were in jail with me. They are highly respected by the apostles and were followers of Christ before I was.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbisa Androniko ne Yunia bɔ bɛte m’abusuafoɛ ne mmiɛngo kukunufoɛ ɔ ahye bɛ́ma me; bele dumaa wɔ asomafoɛ nemɔ nu, na belili moa bɛyɛle Akristofoɛ bɛyakyili me.

english_verse: Greet Ampliatus, my dear friend whose faith is in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbisa Ampliato, bɔ ɔte me dɔfo wɔ Awurade nu ahye bɛ́ma me.

english_verse: Greet Urbanus, who serves Christ along with us. Greet my dear friend Stachys.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbisa Yubano, bɔ ɔte yɛ biɛngo adwumayɔlɛniɛ wɔ Kristo nu, ɔne me dɔfo Setaki ahye bɛ́ma me.

english_verse: Greet Apelles, a faithful servant of Christ. Greet Aristobulus and his family.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbisa Apele bɔ bale ye bato nu kyɛ odi nahorɛ ma Kristo ne ahye bɛ́ma me. Ɛ́mɔbisa Aristobulo abusuafoɛ ahye bɛ́ma me.

english_verse: Greet Herodion, who is a relative of mine. Greet Narcissus and the others in his family, who have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbisa m’abusuaniɛ Herodion ahye bɛ́ma me. Ɛ́mɔbisa Nakisu abusuafoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Awurade nu ne ahye bɛ́ma me.

english_verse: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who work hard for the Lord. Greet my dear friend Persis. She also works hard for the Lord.
translation_verse: Mébisa Trifana ne Trifosa bɔ bɛte Awurade adwumayɔlɛfoɛ nemɔ ahye. Mébisa me dɔfo Pɛɛsi bɔ wayɔ Awurade adwuma pee ne ahye.

english_verse: Greet Rufus, that special servant of the Lord, and greet his mother, who has been like a mother to me.
translation_verse: Mébisa Rufu bɔ ɔbɔ mmɔden paa wɔ Awurade adwuma nu, ɔne ye maame bɔ wafa me wayɛ ɔwa ne ahye.

english_verse: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, and Hermas, as well as our friends who are with them.
translation_verse: Mébisa Asinkrito, Flɛgɔn, Hɛme, Patroba, Hɛma ne aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ bɛboka bɛ so nemɔ ahye.

english_verse: Greet Philologus, Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all of God's people who are with them.
translation_verse: Mébisa Filologo, Yulia, Nereuse ne oliɛma brasua, Olimpa ne anwoteefoɛ bɔ bɛ ne bɛ wɔ berɛ ne amu ahye.

english_verse: Be sure to give each other a warm greeting. All of Christ's churches greet you.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔyɛ bɛ nwo awaawaatuu krongron nu. Kristo asɔre ne amukoraa bebisa ɛmɔ ahye. Foɛtulɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to watch out for anyone who causes trouble and divides the church by refusing to do what all of you were taught. Stay away from them!
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, metu ɛmɔ foɛ kyɛ, ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ mmenia bɔ bɛfa mbakyembakyemuɛ ne sundidua bɛba, bɔ otia ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ ɛmɔasua ne. Ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi bɛ nwo!

english_verse: They want to serve themselves and not Christ the Lord. Their flattery and fancy talk fool people who don't know any better.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɔ mmenia nemɔ bɛnzo y’Awurade Kristo, na mmom bɛso bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ko. Na bɛfa bɛ noa dwirɛ fɛɛ ne anoanubobɔlɛ bɛlakalaka mmenia bɔ b’adwene te nganga ɔ.

english_verse: I am glad that everyone knows how well you obey the Lord. But still, I want you to understand what is good and not have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: Ebiala ate ɛmɔ sotie bɔ ɛmɔayɛ bama nzɛmba ne ɔ, yiti me nye gye ɛmɔ nwo, nakoso mekuro kyɛ ɛmɔnwu nworɛ bɛfa bɔ ɔte paa nwo, ná ɛmɔte ɛmɔ nwo béfi bɔ ɔte bɔne nwo.

english_verse: Then God, who gives peace, will soon crush Satan under your feet. I pray that our Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Na ɔngɔhyɛ koraa asomdwee Nyameɛ ne kɔbɛtɛ Abɔnzam wɔ ɛmɔ gya bo. Y’Awurade Yesu Kristo ɔlo ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Timothy, who works with me, sends his greetings, and so do my relatives, Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater.
translation_verse: Mmiɛngo adwumayɔlɛniɛ Timoteo ne Lukio ne Yason ne Sosipatro bɔ bɛte m’abusuafoɛ ɔ bebisa ɛmɔ ahye.

english_verse: I, Tertius, also send my greetings. I am a follower of the Lord, and I wrote this letter.
translation_verse: Me, Tɛtio, bɔ ngyerɛle sɔ krataa he ne, mebisa ɛmɔ ahye wɔ Awurade nu.

english_verse: Gaius welcomes me and the whole church into his home, and he sends his greetings. Erastus, the city treasurer, and our dear friend Quartus send their greetings too. Paul's Closing Prayer
translation_verse: Y’Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne ɔyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛ deɛ.] Pɔɔlo mbaeɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ

english_verse: Praise God! He can make you strong by means of my good news, which is the message about Jesus Christ. For ages and ages this message was kept secret,
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔkora ma ɛmɔ tindim, kyɛbɔ me nzɛmba ne Yesu Kristo nwo nzɛmba ne ɔte ne, kyɛbɔ mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛfeale daa tete ne ɔte ne,

english_verse: but now at last it has been told. The eternal God commanded his prophets to write about the good news, so that all nations would obey and have faith.
translation_verse: nakoso afei de bala ye ali, na bɛnate bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɛhyerɛle ne aso bala ye ali bahyire maen amukoraati, kyɛbɔ Ɛdangama Nyameɛ ye ahyɛdeɛ te ne, amaa ɔnate so maen maen amukoraa bale bali ná bayɛ sotie bama ye.

english_verse: And now, because of Jesus Christ, we can praise the only wise God forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bɔ ye ngome twe yeɛ ɔte nworɛniɛ ne, animnyam ɔ́fa Yesu Kristo so ɔ́yɛ ye deɛ daa daa! Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Sosthenes, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Krataa he fi me Pɔɔlo, bɔ Nyameɛ nate ye pɛ so wafrɛ me kyɛ nyɛ Kristo Yesu somafoɛ ɔ, ɔne aliɛmaa Sositene berɛ.

english_verse: To God's church in Corinth. Christ Jesus chose you to be his very own people, and you worship in his name, as we and all others do who call him Lord.
translation_verse: Yɛfa yɛbrɛ Nyameɛ asɔre bɔ ɔwɔ Korinto, bɛ bɔ ɔnate Yesu Kristo ti bafrɛ bɛ maa baayɛ krongron; mekyire ɛmɔ bɔ bafrɛ ɛmɔ ne bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ nekaa biala maa ɛmɔayɛ anwoteefoɛ, na ɛmɔ ne yɛ bɔ nu bɔ Yesu Kristo dumaa kyɛ y’Awurade ɔ.

english_verse: My prayer is that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. Saleɛ wɔ Kristo nu

english_verse: I never stop thanking my God for treating you with undeserved grace by giving you Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Ɔnate ɛmɔ ti daa meda me Nyameɛ ase, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ nate Yesu Kristo so walo ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Now you are certain that everything we told you about our Lord Christ Jesus is true.
translation_verse: Kristo nwo nzɛmba ne atira ndii wɔ ɛmɔ nu,

english_verse: You are not missing out on any blessings, as you wait for him to return.
translation_verse: bɔ ɔmaa ɛmɔ ndɔ sii wɔ adom akyɛdeɛ biala nu, wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɛmɔnwondɛ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo walɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: And until the day Christ does return, he will keep you completely innocent.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ okogyina ɛmɔ si pindinn koodwu ayieleɛ, amaa ɛmɔanni nikyee biala nwo fɔ wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo kyẽa ne.

english_verse: God can be trusted, and he chose you to be partners with his Son, our Lord Jesus Christ. Taking Sides
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bɔ wafrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔ ne Ɔwa, y’Awurade Yesu Kristo bɛfa abiɛngoɛ ne, odi nahorɛ. Asɔre nu mbakyembakyemuɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, as a follower of our Lord Jesus Christ, I beg you to get along with each other. Don't take sides. Always try to agree in what you think.
translation_verse: Nniɛma mɔ, mefa y’Awurade Yesu Kristo dumaa mesrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛ́mɔyɛ ko ná mbakyembakyemuɛ amma ɛmɔ nu; na ɛ́mɔyɛ ko wɔ adwene ko ne porɛ bɔlɛ ko nu.

english_verse: Several people from Chloe's family have already reported to me that you keep arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Nniɛma mɔ, Kloe awuro ama mɔ baatia me gya so kyɛ ɛmɔ afia nwo koraa.

english_verse: Has Christ been divided up? Was I nailed to a cross for you? Were you baptized in my name?
translation_verse: Aso bahyehyɛ Kristo nu hɔ ɔ? Pɔɔlo yeɛ bɛbɔle ye mmeamudua nu bɛmane ɛmɔ ɔ, anaakyɛ Pɔɔlo dumaa nu yeɛ bɛbɔle ɛmɔ asu bewurale ɔ?

english_verse: I thank God that I didn't baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius.
translation_verse: Meda Nyameɛ ase kyɛ mammɔ ɛmɔ nu biala asu, sana Krispo ne Gayɔso ngome,

english_verse: Not one of you can say that you were baptized in my name.
translation_verse: na ebiala anga kyɛ bɛbɔle ye asu wɔ me dumaa nu.

english_verse: I did baptize the family of Stephanas, but I don't remember if I baptized anyone else.
translation_verse: Mekaye kyɛ mmɔle Setefana awuro ama koso asu; na mengaye kyɛ mmɔle ebiala asu mmokale bɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: Christ did not send me to baptize. He sent me to tell the good news without using words that sound wise and would make the cross of Christ lose its power. Christ Is God's Power and Wisdom
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Kristo anzoma me kyɛ mmamɔ asu, na mmom ɔsomane me kyɛ mmanga nzɛmba ne, bɔ memva kuro sona nworɛ yeɛ mekã ɔ, amaa Kristo mmeamudua ne wanyɛ mbaen. Kristo te Nyameɛ tumi ne ye nworɛ

english_verse: The message about the cross doesn't make any sense to lost people. But for those of us who are being saved, it is God's power at work.
translation_verse: Kristo mmeamudua ne nwo dwirɛ te ngwaseasɛm ma bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ so bemini ne, nakoso ɔte Nyameɛ tumi ma yɛ bɔ ogu so ode yɛ ngoa ne.

english_verse: What happened to those wise people? What happened to those experts in the Scriptures? What happened to the ones who think they have all the answers? Didn't God show that the wisdom of this world is foolish?
translation_verse: Nzaade, né nworɛfoɛ gyi ye sɛ? Nimdeɛfoɛ koso begyi ye sɛ? Bɛ bɔ babe aporowaasulɛ nu wɔ ewiase wa ne koso begyi ye sɛ? Aso Nyameɛ mmane wiase wa nworɛ ɔkkakyili ngwaseasɛm?

english_verse: God was wise and decided not to let the people of this world use their wisdom to learn about him. Instead, God chose to save only those who believe the foolish message we preach.
translation_verse: Ɔnate Nyameɛ nworɛ ne ati, adasammaa bangora bamva bɛ nworɛ so bannwu Nyameɛ. Yiti ɔsɔle Nyameɛ nye kyɛ ɔkɔfa edwirɛ bɔ yɛkã, bɔ bebu ye ngwaseasɛm ne aso kole bɛ bɔ bede bedi ne ngoa.

english_verse: Jews ask for miracles, and Greeks want something that sounds wise.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Yudafoɛ bɛpena nzɛngyerɛnneɛ, yeɛ Helafoɛ koso bɛpena ewiase nworɛ.

english_verse: But we preach that Christ was nailed to a cross. Most Jews have problems with this, and most Gentiles think it is foolish.
translation_verse: Nakoso yɛ de, yɛbɔ Kristo bɔ bɛbɔle ye mmeamudua nu ne nwo dawure. Ɛhe te sundidua ma Yudafoɛ, yeɛ ɔte ngwaseasɛm ma Helafoɛ.

english_verse: Our message is God's power and wisdom for the Jews and the Greeks that he has chosen.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bafrɛ bɛ ne de, Yudafoɛ oo, Helafoɛ oo, Kristo te Nyameɛ tumi ne ye nworɛ ma bɛ.

english_verse: Even when God is foolish, he is wiser than everyone else, and even when God is weak, he is stronger than everyone else.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ Nyameɛ nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ bebu ye ngwaseasɛm ne, nworɛ wɔ nu tra adasammaa nworɛ; yeɛ bɔ bebu ye kyɛ ɔte Nyameɛ mmerɛyɛlɛ nen, anwoserɛ wɔ nu tra adasammaa anwoserɛ.

english_verse: My dear friends, remember what you were when God chose you. The people of this world didn't think that many of you were wise. Only a few of you were in places of power, and not many of you came from important families.
translation_verse: Afei aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔkaye ɛmɔ frɛlɛ bɔ ɔfrɛle ɛmɔ ne. Sɛ ɛnea ye sona bue nu de a, ɛmɔ nu kãa bie yeɛ né bele dibea anaa bɛte nnehyeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But God chose the foolish things of this world to put the wise to shame. He chose the weak things of this world to put the powerful to shame.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ fale bɔ ewiase bu ye kyɛ ɔte ngwaseasɛm ne kyɛ ɔfa gua ewiase nworɛfoɛ nyunu ase; na ɔfale bɔ ewiase bu ye kyɛ ɔyɛ mmerɛ ne, kyɛ ɔfa gua anwoserɛfoɛ nyunu ase,

english_verse: What the world thinks is worthless, useless, and nothing at all is what God has used to destroy what the world considers important.
translation_verse: na ewiase nningyein bɔ ye nwo olle mvasoɛ, ɔne bɔ bemmu ye ne yeɛ Nyameɛ waneanea nu waye ɔ, yeɛ nningyein bɔ ɔnne berɛ ɔ, kyɛ ɔfa sɛkye bɔ ewiase bu ye kyɛ ye nwo hia ne,

english_verse: God did all this to keep anyone from bragging to him.
translation_verse: amaa sona biala anhoahoa ye nwo wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: You are God's children. He sent Christ Jesus to save us and to make us wise, acceptable, and holy.
translation_verse: Ngoa bɔ ɛmɔle ye wɔ Yesu nu ne fi Nyameɛ berɛ, na Nyameɛ afa Kristo ayɛ yɛ nworɛ, yɛ tenenee, yɛ fawɔnwodi ne krongronyɛlɛ.

english_verse: So if you want to brag, do what the Scriptures say and brag about the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati, bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Ebiala bɔ ɔhoahoa ye nwo ne, maa ɔhoahoa ye nwo wɔ Awurade nu.”

english_verse: Friends, when I came and told you the mystery that God had shared with us, I didn't use big words or try to sound wise.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, mmale ɛmɔ berɛ kyɛ mebaali Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne nwo adanzeɛ mekyire ɛmɔ ne, mamma kyɛ sona bɔ ye noa ate anaakyɛ ɔse nworɛ ɔ.

english_verse: In fact, while I was with you, I made up my mind to speak only about Jesus Christ, who had been nailed to a cross.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nyɛle m’adwene kyɛ membena kyɛ menwu nikye fee wɔ ɛmɔ nwo, sana Kristo ne ye mmeamudua ne aso wue.

english_verse: At first, I was weak and trembling with fear.
translation_verse: Na mvale anwobrɛaseɛ ne esuronyi ne anwopopolɛ yeɛ me ne ɛmɔ yɛtenane ɔ.

english_verse: When I talked with you or preached, I didn't try to prove anything by sounding wise. I simply let God's Spirit show his power.
translation_verse: Mamva sona nworɛ ne tetateta yeɛ ngane me dwirɛ ná nyɔle me ngyerɛkyerɛ ɔ; na mmom mvale Sunzum ne ɔne tumi yeɛ nyɔle adwuma ɔ,

english_verse: That way you would have faith because of God's power and not because of human wisdom.
translation_verse: amaa ɛmɔ gyidie wanggyina sona nworɛ so, na mmom wagyina Nyameɛ tumi so. Nyameɛ nworɛ

english_verse: We do use wisdom when speaking to people who are mature in their faith. But it isn't the wisdom of this world or of its rulers, who will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Nakoso nworɛ dwirɛ yeɛ yɛkã yɛkyire bɛ bɔ banyi sunzum nu ɔ. Ɔtte wiase he anu nworɛ, yeɛ ɔtte wiase atumifoɛ deɛ bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ ne bie.

english_verse: We speak of God's hidden and mysterious wisdom that God decided to use for our glory long before the world began.
translation_verse: Na mmom mworɛ bɔ yɛbɔ ye nwo dawure ne te Nyameɛ mvealeɛ nu nworɛ, bɔ kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná yanya animnyam ti, ɔhyehyɛ tole berɛ koraka yeɛ ɔbɔ wiase ɔ.

english_verse: The rulers of this world didn't know anything about this wisdom. If they had known about it, they would not have nailed the glorious Lord to a cross.
translation_verse: Ewiase atumifoɛ biala ande nworɛ he abo, ofikyɛ sɛ bɛtele ye bo a, ahaa bammɔ animnyam Hene ne mmeamudua nu.

english_verse: But it is just as the Scriptures say, “What God has planned for people who love him is more than eyes have seen or ears have heard. It has never even entered our minds!”
translation_verse: Nakoso bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Bɔ anyeɛ nnwuni ye, anaa bɔ asoɛ ɔttele ye le, anaa bɔ ebiala ɔddwenene ye nwo le ne, yeɛ ɔte nikyee bɔ Nyameɛ asiesie ama bɛ bɔ bekuro ye dwirɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: God's Spirit has shown you everything. His Spirit finds out everything, even what is deep in the mind of God.
translation_verse: Nakoso yɛ yeɛ Nyameɛ nate ye Sunzum so waye wahyire yɛ ɔ. Ofikyɛ Sunzum ne pɛnzɛpɛnzɛ nikyee biala nu, ɔne Nyameɛ mvealeɛ nu nhyehyɛleɛ po.

english_verse: You are the only one who knows what is in your own mind, and God's Spirit is the only one who knows what is in God's mind.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔse kuro sona ti anu dwirɛ ɔ? Sana sɔ sona ne sunzum bɔ ɔte ye nu ne. Sɔ ala yeɛ ebiala koso nze Nyameɛ ti anu dwirɛ ɔ, sana Nyameɛ Sunzum ne yeɛ ɔse ɔ.

english_verse: But God has given us his Spirit. This is why we don't think the same way that the people of this world think. This is also why we can recognize the blessings God has given us.
translation_verse: Nna ewiase wa sunzum yeɛ yanya ye ɔ, na mmom Sunzum bɔ ofi Nyameɛ berɛ yeɛ yanya ye ɔ; na ɛhe maa yɛte akyɛdeɛ bɔ Nyameɛ afa ama yɛ ne bo.

english_verse: Every word we speak was taught to us by God's Spirit, not by human wisdom. And this same Spirit helps us teach spiritual things to spiritual people.
translation_verse: Bɔ yɛkã ne, yɛmva kuro sona nworɛ yeɛ yɛfa yɛkyirekyire ɔ, na mmom bɔ Sunzum Krongron ne okyirekyire ɔ; na yɛfa sunzum nu nningyein yɛtoto sunzum nu nningyein nwo.

english_verse: This is why only someone who has God's Spirit can understand spiritual blessings. Anyone who doesn't have God's Spirit thinks these blessings are foolish.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ Nyameɛ Sunzum nne ye nu ne, onnya akyɛdeɛ bɔ befi Sunzum ne berɛ ne, ofikyɛ akyɛdeɛ ne te sɔ sona ne nye so ngwaseasɛm; yeɛ ɔngora nde bɛ bo koso, ofikyɛ Sunzum ne yeɛ ɔboka sona maa ɔte akyɛdeɛ ne bo ɔ.

english_verse: People who are guided by the Spirit can make all kinds of judgments, but they cannot be judged by others.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ Nyameɛ Sunzum wɔ ye nu ne, onwu nikye tɛɛ ne paa mukoraa, na ye de, ebiala ngora mmua ye ndɛen.

english_verse: The Scriptures ask, “Has anyone ever known the thoughts of the Lord or given him advice?” But we understand what Christ is thinking.
translation_verse: “Na nwa yeɛ ɔse Awurade ti anu dwirɛ ná watu ye foɛ ɔ?” Nakoso yɛ de, yɛle Kristo adwene.

english_verse: My friends, you are acting like the people of this world. That's why I could not speak to you as spiritual people. You are like babies as far as your faith in Christ is concerned.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, mangora me ne ɛmɔ andwudwo kyɛ mmenia bɔ Nyameɛ Sunzum ne ayi bɛ tɛkyɛ ɔ, na mmom kyɛ anwoɔnaenufoɛ bɔ bɛte nnɔma wɔ Kristo nu ɔ.

english_verse: So I had to treat you like babies and feed you milk. You could not take solid food, and you still cannot,
translation_verse: Nyɔfonesue yeɛ mva maa ɛmɔnone ɔ; na mamma ɛmɔ aleɛ bɔ nu yɛ se ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ né ɛmɔnnya beddwuli kyɛ bedi aleɛ bɔ nu yɛ se ɔ. Na kekesaala ye po, ɛmɔnnya beddwuli.

english_verse: because you are not yet spiritual. You are jealous and argue with each other. This proves you are not spiritual and you are acting like the people of this world.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ brabɔlɛ tɛte kyɛ ewiasefoɛ abrabɔ. Na aberɛ bɔ anyeboroborolɛ ne apindapinda wɔ ɛmɔ afia ye de, aso ɛhe ngyire kyɛ ɛmɔte anwoɔnaenufoɛ bɔ ɛmɔ yɔleɛ te kyɛ ewiasefoɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Some of you say you follow me, and others claim to follow Apollos. Isn't this how ordinary people behave?
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔ nu ko kã kyɛ, “Me de nwɔ Pɔɔlo bue nu” ná ko kã kyɛ, “Me de nwɔ Apolo bue nu” a, aso nna kuro sona yɔleɛ yeɛ ɛmɔyɔ ye?

english_verse: Apollos and I are merely servants who helped you to have faith. It was the Lord who made it all happen.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo te nzu? Apolo te nzu? Yɛte Nyameɛ ngoaa bɔ ɛmɔnate yɛ so bele belili ɔ, na yɛ nu ko biala le adwuma kyɛbɔ Awurade afa awura ye sa ɔ.

english_verse: I planted the seeds, Apollos watered them, but God made them sprout and grow.
translation_verse: Me de nnuale, yeɛ Apolo wora oguaguale so nzue ɔ, nakoso Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔmaa onyini ɔ.

english_verse: What matters isn't those who planted or watered, but God who made the plants grow.
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ oluale ne, ɔne bɔ oguaguale so nzue ne, bɛ de bɛtte huu; na mmom Nyameɛ bɔ ɔmaa onyini ne yeɛ ɔte piri ɔ.

english_verse: The one who plants is just as important as the one who waters. And each one will be paid for what they do.
translation_verse: Bɔ oluale ne, ɔne bɔ oguaguale so nzue ne, bɛ mukoraa pɛ, na bɛ nu biala sa kɔha ye akatuaa kyɛbɔ ye bɔbɔ ye adwuma si te ɔ.

english_verse: Apollos and I work together for God, and you are God's garden and God's building. Only One Foundation
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ yɛ de, yɛte Nyameɛ adwumayɔlɛfoɛ, bɔ yɛ ne ye bɔ nu yɛyɔ adwuma ɔ; na ɛmɔte ye boo, Nyameɛ sua.

english_verse: God treated me with undeserved grace and let me become an expert builder. I laid a foundation on which others have built. But we must each be careful how we build,
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ Nyameɛ ama me adom ne ati, ndole fapem kyɛ suasilɛniɛ nimdeɛniɛ, na sona foforɛ koso ɔ́to bie toa so. Na ebiala bɔ ɔto bie toa so ne, ɔnea kyɛ ɔkɔto ye yé ɔ.

english_verse: Whatever we build on this foundation will be tested by fire on the day of judgment. Then everyone will find out if we have used gold, silver, and precious stones, or wood, hay, and straw.
translation_verse: ebiala adwuma kɔye ye nwo ali. Ndɛenbualɛ kyẽa ne kɔmaa ɔkɔla ali, ofikyɛ see kɔma ebiala adwuma kɔla ali, na see ne koso ebiala adwuma bɔ wayɔ ɔ kɔnea.

english_verse: We will be rewarded if our building is left standing.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie adwuma bɔ wayɔ wafa watoa fapem ne aso kora gyina see ne noa a, okonya ye nwo akatuaa.

english_verse: But if it is destroyed by the fire, we will lose everything. Yet we ourselves will be saved, like someone escaping from flames.
translation_verse: Na sɛ see ne yera ebie adwuma a, ɔkɔhwere nikye; ye bɔbɔ de, Nyameɛ kole ye ngoa, nakoso ɔte kyɛ watutu wafa see nu ɔ.

english_verse: All of you surely know you are God's temple and his Spirit lives in you.
translation_verse: Aso ɛmɔnze kyɛ ɛmɔte Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua na Nyameɛ Sunzum te ɛmɔ nu ɔ?

english_verse: Together you are God's holy temple, and God will destroy anyone who destroys his temple.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ ebie sɛkye Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua a, Nyameɛ koso kɔsɛkye ye, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua te krongron, na ɛmɔ ole ye Asɔneyɛɛ sua ne.

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves! If any of you think you are wise in the things of this world, you will have to become foolish before you can be truly wise.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ebiala lakalaka ye nwo. Sɛ ɛmɔ nu bie dwene kyɛ ɔse wiase nworɛ a, maa ɔyɛ kwaseaa ná wanwu nworɛ.

english_verse: This is because God considers the wisdom of this world to be foolish. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God catches the wise when they try to outsmart him.”
translation_verse: Na ewiase nworɛ te ngwaseasɛm wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Nworɛfoɛ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ kanda yeɛ ɔfa sua bɛ ngaen kye bɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “The Lord knows that the plans made by wise people are useless.”
translation_verse: Osa kã ye bieku kyɛ, “Awurade se kyɛ nworɛfoɛ bɛ nzusuleɛ te mbaen.”

english_verse: So stop bragging about what anyone has done. Paul and Apollos and Peter all belong to you. In fact, everything is yours, including the world, life, death, the present, and the future. Everything belongs to you,
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo oo, Apolo oo, Kefa oo, ewiase oo, ngoa oo, ewue oo, ɛnɛ deɛ oo, anaa kyẽa bie deɛ oo, bɛ mukoraa bɛte ɛmɔ deɛ,

english_verse: and you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
translation_verse: na ɛmɔte Kristo deɛ, yeɛ Kristo koso te Nyameɛ deɛ.

english_verse: Think of us as servants of Christ who have been given the work of explaining God's mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ebiala bu yɛ kyɛ yɛte Kristo asomvoɛ ne Nyameɛ mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ so neafoɛ.

english_verse: And since our first duty is to be faithful to the one we work for,
translation_verse: Afei koso, bɔ bɛpena ye wɔ somvoɛ mɔ nwo ole kyɛ bekoli nahorɛ ɔ.

english_verse: it doesn't matter to me if I am judged by you or even by a court of law. In fact, I don't judge myself.
translation_verse: Na me de, ɔmva me nwo kyɛ ɛmɔ anaa sona biala kobua me ndɛen ɔ; me bɔbɔ po memmua me nwo ndɛen.

english_verse: I don't know of anything against me, but this doesn't prove I am right. The Lord is my judge.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me tiboa mmua me foɛ, nakoso ɛhe ngyire kyɛ mendɔ sii. Na Awurade yeɛ obua me ndɛen ɔ.

english_verse: So don't judge anyone until the Lord returns. He will show what is hidden in the dark and what is in everyone's heart. Then God will be the one who praises each of us.
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔbua ndɛen koraka ná mmerɛ ne wadwu, koraka né Awurade awa, na ye yeɛ ɔkɔye mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ bɔ ɔwɔ awosii nu kofite ɔ, ná wasa mmenia ti anu nzusuleɛ wagua dwaaso. Na afei ebiala konya ɛkamvolɛ bɔ ɔfata ye ɔ kofi Nyameɛ berɛ.

english_verse: Friends, I have used Apollos and myself as examples to teach you the meaning of the saying, “Follow the rules.” I want you to stop saying one of us is better than the other.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔ ti yeɛ mafa me ne Apolo yɛ nwo mayɛ mvandoho ye, amaa ɛmɔasua yɛ, ná ɛmɔammu bɔ bahyerɛ bato berɛ ne aso, ná ɛmɔ nu biala wamva sona bie wanhoahoa ye nwo wambɛ sona foforɛ poa.

english_verse: What is so special about you? What do you have that you were not given? And if it was given to you, how can you brag?
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ osele wɔ kyɛ asora wɔ ngome ɔ? Nzu yeɛ ele ye bɔ nna Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔfa mmane wɔ ɔ? Na sɛ ɔfa mane wɔ de a, nzu ati yeɛ ɛfa hoahoa wɔ nwo kyɛ nna akyɛdeɛ ahɔ ɔ?

english_verse: Are you already satisfied? Are you now rich? Have you become kings while we are still nobodies? I wish you were kings. Then we could have a share in your kingdom.
translation_verse: Nna ɛmɔ ɔ! Ɛmɔ sa ahã bɔ ɛmɔpena ɔ dada! Ɛmɔanya bɛ nwo bayie. Ɛmɔakwati yɛ bayɛ bɛ nwo ahemvo! Me kunu a, ahaa ɛmɔte ahemvo amba, amaa yɛne ɛmɔ abɔ nu yali hene.

english_verse: It seems to me that God has put us apostles in the worst possible place. We are like prisoners on their way to death. Angels and the people of this world just laugh at us.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔyɛ me kyɛ Nyameɛ wafa yɛ asomafoɛ wasie berɛ kyɛ mmenia bɔ babua bɛ kumfɔ ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ yayɛ ahyerɛ yama ewiase ne abɔfo mɔ ne adasa mmaa.

english_verse: Because of Christ we are thought of as fools, but Christ has made you wise. We are weak and hated, but you are powerful and respected.
translation_verse: Kristo ti yayɛ ngwaseafoɛ, nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔayɛ nworɛfoɛ wɔ Kristo nu! Yɛyɛ mmerɛ, nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔ nwo yɛ se. Ɛmɔ de, bedi ɛmɔ nni, nakoso yɛ de, bemmu yɛ.

english_verse: Even today we go hungry and thirsty and don't have anything to wear except rags. We are mistreated and don't have a place to live.
translation_verse: Ɛnɛ ne ɛnɛ ye, ɛhɔen ne nzuhɔen ku yɛ, yɛ nwo la so, bɛkã yɛ mbire, yeɛ yɛlle amandena,

english_verse: We work hard with our own hands, and when people abuse us, we wish them well. When we suffer, we are patient.
translation_verse: na yɛyere yɛ nwo yɛfa yɛ bɔbɔ yɛ sa yɛyɔ adwuma. Bɛbɔ yɛ alapaa a, yɛyirayira bɛ. Bɛtane yɛ nye a, yɛgyina pindinn.

english_verse: When someone curses us, we answer with kind words. Until now we are thought of as nothing more than the trash and garbage of this world.
translation_verse: Bɛsɛkye yɛ dumaa a, yɛne bɛ nyaka. Yayɛ kyɛ ewiase fiɛ, na yayɛ nningyein mukoraa boso wura maa waadwu ɛnɛ.

english_verse: I am not writing to embarrass you. I want to help you, just as parents help their own dear children.
translation_verse: Mengyerɛ ɛhe memma ngua ɛmɔ nyunu ase, nakoso mefa metu ɛmɔ foɛ kyɛ me mma bɔ mekuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Ten thousand people may teach you about Christ, but I am your only father. You became my children when I told you about Christ Jesus,
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔle foɛtulɛfoɛ apee buru wɔ Kristo nu po a, ɛmɔ baba mɔ de, bɛnzone, ofikyɛ ɔnate nzɛmba ne aso mayɛ ɛmɔ baba wɔ Yesu Kristo nu.

english_verse: and I want you to be like me.
translation_verse: Yiti mesrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔsua me.

english_verse: This is why I sent Timothy to you. I love him like a son, and he is a faithful servant of the Lord. Timothy will tell you what I do to follow Christ and how it agrees with what I always teach about Christ in every church.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati, mésoma mma Timoteo bɔ mekuro ye dwirɛ ná odi nahorɛ wɔ Awurade nu ne wɔ ɛmɔ berɛ, kyɛ ɔɔkayekaye ɛmɔ me Kristo nu brabɔlɛ, kyɛbɔ mekyirekyire ye asɔre biala nu wɔ nekaa biala ne.

english_verse: Some of you think I am not coming for a visit, and so you are bragging.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ nu biemɔ di tutureasɛm kyɛ gyamea mengɔɔsra ɛmɔ.

english_verse: But if the Lord lets me come, I will soon be there. Then I will find out if the ones who are doing all this bragging really have any power.
translation_verse: Sɛ Awurade ma me ate a, ɔngɔhyɛ biala ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ, ná maanwu bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ anwomasoɛ nemɔ bɛ tumi, na nna bɔ bɛkekã hɔ ɔ.

english_verse: God's kingdom isn't just a lot of words. It is power.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ahennie ne oggyi edwudwolɛ mbaen so, na mmom ogyi tumi so.

english_verse: What do you want me to do when I arrive? Do you want me to be hard on you or to be kind and gentle?
translation_verse: Beni yeɛ ɛmɔkuro ɔ? Kyɛ ngɔfa mbire, anaakyɛ ngɔfa ɔdɔ ne anwobrɛaseɛ ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ?

english_verse: I have heard terrible things about some of you. In fact, you are behaving worse than Gentiles. A man is even sleeping with his own stepmother.
translation_verse: Baahã ye susu amba kyɛ ɛmɔ nu biemɔ bɔ adwaman, bɔ ye sɛso nne ewiasefoɛ po nu ɔ, ofikyɛ ebie fa ye baba aye.

english_verse: You are proud, when you ought to feel bad enough to chase away anyone who acts like this.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔhoahoa bɛ nwo! Ɛmɔ wora mmom yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔbɔ ɔ, ná ɛmɔye sona bɔ wabɔ sɔ musue ne befi ɛmɔ nu.

english_verse: You must then hand that man over to Satan. His body will be destroyed, but his spirit will be saved when the Lord Jesus returns.
translation_verse: odi kyɛ ɛmɔye sɔ sona ne bewura Abɔnzam sa maa ɔsɛkye ye nwoɔnaen ne, amaa ye sunzum anya daa ngoa wɔ Awurade Yesu kyẽa ne.

english_verse: Stop being proud! Don't you know how a little yeast can spread through the whole batch of dough?
translation_verse: Ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɛmɔhoahoa ɛmɔ nwo. Ɛmɔnze kyɛ mɔle harewaa kãa bie yeɛ ɔfra mɔle torɛ ne amukoraa nu maa ɔkeka ɔ.

english_verse: Get rid of the old yeast! Then you will be like fresh bread made without yeast, and this is what you are. Our Passover lamb is Christ, who has already been sacrificed.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔye mɔle harewaa daa ne befi ɛmɔ nu amaa ɛmɔayɛ mɔle torɛ foforɛ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔte kabrɛdi ne ala. Ofikyɛ bafa Kristo bɔ ɔte y’Abɔtra boaen ne babɔ afɔleɛ bama yɛ.

english_verse: So don't celebrate the festival by being evil and sinful, which is like serving bread made with yeast. Be pure and truthful and celebrate by using bread made without yeast.
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛmɔma yɛfa mɔle harewaa daa ne, bɔ ɔte bɔne ne amumuyɛɛ yɛdi aluolue ne, na mmom ɛ́mɔma yɛfa mɔle kabrɛdi bɔ ɔte adwene bɔ nu te ɔne nahorɛlilɛ ne yeɛ yɛli ɔ.

english_verse: In my other letter I told you not to have anything to do with immoral people.
translation_verse: Krataa bɔ ngyerɛle ɛmɔ ne anu, ngane kyɛ nnɛma ɛmɔ ne adwamanbɔlɛfoɛ besã.

english_verse: But I wasn't talking about the people of this world. You would have to leave this world to get away from everyone who is immoral or greedy or who cheats or worships idols.
translation_verse: Mangyire kyɛ ewiasefoɛ bɔ bɛbɔ adwaman anaa bɛte anyeboroborolɛfoɛ, anaa awuefoɛ, anaa bɛ bɔ bɛso bosoensolɛfoɛ ofikyɛ ɔba ye sɔ de a, né odi kyɛ ɛmɔtu befi wiase wa.

english_verse: I was talking about your own people who are immoral or greedy or worship idols or curse others or get drunk or cheat. Don't even eat with them!
translation_verse: Na afei bɔ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ ole kyɛ, nnɛma ɛmɔ ne ebiala bɔ ɔfrɛ ye nwo aliɛmaa bɔ ɔbɔ adwaman, anaa ɔte anyeboroborolɛ, anaa ɔte bosoensolɛniɛ, anaa ɔte tuture, anaa akɔnomnzaniɛ anaa awueniɛ besã, nnɛma ɛmɔ ne ye to asaa bedidi po.

english_verse: God judges everyone else. The Scriptures say, “Chase away any of your own people who are evil.”
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ yeɛ okobua bɛ bɔ bɛnne ɛmɔ fekue ne anu ndɛen ɔ. Yiti ɛmɔfoa amumuyɛɛniɛ ne béfi ɛmɔ nu.

english_verse: When one of you has a complaint against another, do you take your complaint to a court of sinners? Or do you take it to God's people?
translation_verse: Ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ ɛmɔ nu bie ne oliɛma nya edwirɛ a, ɔkora fa kɔ ewiasefoɛ badwa nyunu na ɔmva ngɔ anwoteefoɛ mɔ nyunu ɔ?

english_verse: Don't you know that God's people will judge the world? And if you are going to judge the world, can't you settle small problems?
translation_verse: Ɛmɔnze kyɛ anwoteefoɛ yeɛ bɛbaabua wiase ndɛen hɔ ɔ? Na sɛ ɛmɔbaabua wiase ndɛen a, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔngora benziesie edwirɛ mmaa mmaa hemɔ ɔ?

english_verse: Don't you know we will judge angels? And if this is so, we can surely judge everyday matters.
translation_verse: Aso ɛmɔnze kyɛ yɛkobua abɔfo mɔ po ndɛen ɔ? Nzaade, nzu ati yeɛ yɛngora nziesie ɛwa asetena nu dwirɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Why do you take everyday complaints to judges who are not respected by the church?
translation_verse: Na sɛ asetena nu wɔndwiwɔndwi ba a, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔfa bɛkɔ mmenia bɔ asɔre ne mmu bɛ ɔ, bɛ gya so ɔ?

english_verse: I say this to your shame. Aren't any of you wise enough to act as a judge between one follower and another?
translation_verse: Meka ɛhe ma ɛmɔfɛre. Aso nworɛniɛ komapɛ po nne ɛmɔ nu bɔ ɔkɔhora kosiesie aliɛmaa ne aliɛmaa b’afia dwirɛ ɔ,

english_verse: Why should one of you take another to be tried by unbelievers?
translation_verse: bɔ yeɛ aliɛmaa fa aliɛmaa kɔ bɛ bɔ benne nni gya so maa bebua bɛ ndɛen ɔ?

english_verse: When one of you takes another to court, all of you lose. It would be better to let yourselves be cheated and robbed.
translation_verse: Manzoen bɔ ɛmɔ ne bɛ nwo twe ne kyire kyɛ ɛmɔali ngoguo. Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔmma bɛnyɔ ɛmɔ tɛɛ mmom ɔ? Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔmma benzisi ɛmɔ mmom ɔ?

english_verse: Don't you know that evil people won't have a share in the blessings of God's kingdom? Don't fool yourselves! No one who is immoral or worships idols or is unfaithful in marriage or is a pervert or behaves like a homosexual
translation_verse: Ɛmɔnze kyɛ bɔnefoɛ ngɔhɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu hɔ ɔ? Nnɛma ɛmɔlakalaka bɛ nwo: adwamanbɔlɛfoɛ, bosoensolɛfoɛ, agyaasɛkyelɛfoɛ, mmrasua bɔ bɛ ne mmrasua da, mmienzua bɔ bɛ ne mmienzua da,

english_verse: will share in God's kingdom. Neither will any thief or greedy person or drunkard or anyone who curses and cheats others.
translation_verse: awuefoɛ, anyeboroborolɛfoɛ, akɔnomnzafoɛ, nzekurebɔlɛfoɛ ne apoobɔlɛfoɛ ngɔhɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu.

english_verse: Some of you used to be like that. But now the name of our Lord Jesus Christ and the power of God's Spirit have washed you and made you holy and acceptable to God. Honor God with Your Body
translation_verse: Na sɔ yeɛ né ɛmɔ nu biemɔ bɛte ɔ, nakoso ɔnate Awurade Yesu Kristo dumaa ne yɛ Nyameɛ Sunzum ne ati, Nyameɛ abia ɛmɔ, wate ɛmɔ nwo, na wabua ɛmɔ be. Fa wɔ nipadua hyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do anything we want to.” But I tell you not everything is good for us. So I refuse to let anything have power over me.
translation_verse: “Nne nikyee biala nwo ate.” Nakoso nna nikyee biala yeɛ ɔte paa ɔ. “Nne nikyee biala nwo ate.” Nakoso mengɔmaa nikyee fee ngɔfa me ngɔyɛ akoaa.
