english_verse: You also say, “Food is meant for our bodies, and our bodies are meant for food.” But I tell you that God will destroy them both. We are not supposed to do indecent things with our bodies. We are to use them for the Lord who is in charge of our bodies.
translation_verse: “Bɛbɔle aleɛ bɛmane koɛ, yeɛ koɛ wora bɛbɔle ye bɛmane aleɛ.” Nakoso Nyameɛ kɔsɛkye bɛ munyɔ. Nipadua nne berɛ ma adwamanbɔlɛ, na mmom ɔwɔ berɛ ma Awurade, yeɛ Awurade koso wɔ berɛ ma nipadua.

english_verse: God will raise us from death by the same power he used when he raised our Lord to life.
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ tingyele Awurade, na ɔnate ye tumi ne aso okotingye yɛ koso.

english_verse: Don't you know that your bodies are part of the body of Christ? Is it right for me to join part of the body of Christ to a prostitute? No, it isn't!
translation_verse: Ɛmɔnze kyɛ ɛmɔ nipadua ne te Kristo akwaa anaa? Aso mva Kristo akwaa ne nyɛ adwamanbɔlɛniɛ akwaa anaa? Nyameɛ pa gua!

english_verse: Don't you know that a man who does that becomes part of her body? The Scriptures say, “The two of them will be like one person.”
translation_verse: Gyamea ɛmɔnze kyɛ sona bɔ ɔkɔfa ye nwo kɔha adwamanbɔlɛniɛ ne, né ɔne ye bayɛ anwoɔnaen ko hɔ ɔ? Ofikyɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne nwa, “Bɛ munyɔ bɛkɔyɛ anwoɔnaen ko.”

english_verse: But anyone who is joined to the Lord is one in spirit with him.
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ ɔfa ye nwo bata Awurade ne, ɔne ye bɛyɛ ko sunzum nu.

english_verse: Don't be immoral in matters of sex. That is a sin against your own body in a way no other sin is.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔyakyi adwamanbɔlɛ! Bɔne biala bɔ sona yɔ ne nga ye nipadua, nakoso sona bɔ ɔbɔ adwaman ne yɔ bɔne tia ye bɔbɔ ye nipadua.

english_verse: You surely know that your body is a temple where the Holy Spirit lives. The Spirit is in you and is a gift from God. You are no longer your own.
translation_verse: Anaa ɛmɔnze kyɛ ɛmɔ nipadua ne te Sunzum Krongron bɔ Nyameɛ afa ama ɛmɔ, bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ nu n’asɔneyɛɛ sua ɔ, na ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔlle bɛ nwo ɔ?

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So use your body to honor God.
translation_verse: Bɛtɔle ɛmɔ nyɔboɛ serɛ. Yiti ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ nipadua bɛhyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam.

english_verse: Now I will answer the questions you asked in your letter. You asked, “Is it best for people not to marry?”
translation_verse: Afei, ɔfa nningyein bɔ ɛmɔhyerɛle bɛbrɛle me nemɔ nwo de, ahaa ɔte paa kyɛ bienzua mva ye nwo nga brasua ɔ.

english_verse: Well, having your own husband or wife should keep you from doing something immoral.
translation_verse: Nakoso adwamanbɔlɛ nwo nzɔhwɛ ti, ɔsɛ kyɛ bienzua biala nya ye bɔbɔ ɔye, na brasua biala nya ye bɔbɔ ohu.

english_verse: Husbands and wives should be fair with each other about having sex.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ huɛ ne yɔ bɔ ɔfata ɔ ma ɔye, na yeɛ ne koso yɔ sɔ ala ma ohu.

english_verse: A wife belongs to her husband instead of to herself, and a husband belongs to his wife instead of to himself.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ yeɛ ne de, olle ye bɔbɔ ye nipadua so tumi, nakoso ohu le so tumi. Sɔ ala yeɛ huɛ ne koso olle ye bɔbɔ ye nipadua so tumi ɔ, nakoso ɔye le so tumi.

english_verse: So don't refuse sex to each other, unless you agree not to have sex for a little while, in order to spend time in prayer. Then Satan won't be able to tempt you because of your lack of self-control.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔtua ɛmɔ nwo nnaa, sana ɛmɔ munyɔ ɛmɔapene so kyɛ ɛmɔtu mmerɛ kãa bie besie berɛ ma mbaeɛbɔlɛ; na ɛhe asi ye, ɛmɔasa bayia nu bieku, ná abɔnzam amva ɛmɔ anwohyɛsoɛ nu mmerɛyɛlɛ so wanzo ɛmɔ wannea.

english_verse: In my opinion that is what should be done, though I don't know of anything the Lord said about this matter.
translation_verse: Bɔ mekã ye, ɔtte kyɛ mmeraa yeɛ mehyɛ mema ɛmɔ ɔ, na mmom ɔte atee yeɛ mekyire ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I wish all of you were like me, but God has given different gifts to each of us.
translation_verse: Ɔhale me ngome a, ahaa mmenia amukoraa bɛte kyɛ me, nakoso ebiala le ye ti anwo adom akyɛdeɛ bɔ Nyameɛ afa ama ye ɔ; asora ebiala deɛ.

english_verse: My advice for the unmarried and for widows is that it is acceptable for them to remain single, just as I am.
translation_verse: Afei mekã mekyire asigyafoɛ ne akunafoɛ kyɛ, ahaa ɔte paa kyɛ bɛkɔhɔ so bɛkɔtena anwokwa nu kyɛbɔ nde ye.

english_verse: But if you don't have enough self-control, then go ahead and get married. After all, it is better to marry than to burn with desire.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ bɛngɔhora bɛngɔhyɛ bɛ nwo so de a, maa begya bie. Ofikyɛ ɔte paa kyɛ ekogya bie tra kyɛ wɔ nwo kɔhyere wɔ ɔ. Agyaayiralɛ nwo dwirɛ

english_verse: I instruct married couples to stay together, and this is exactly what the Lord himself taught. A wife who leaves her husband
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bagya bie ne de, bɔ mekã ye, nna me mmeraa ɔ, na mmom Awurade deɛ ɔ. Nnɛma brasua yira ohu.

english_verse: should either stay single or go back to her husband. And a husband should not leave his wife.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ braa ne yira a, ye ngome ɔtena anwokwa, anaakyɛ ɔne ohu besiesie b’afia na besa bɛbɔ nu. Huɛ koso, nnɛmaa oyira ɔye.

english_verse: I don't know of anything else the Lord said about marriage. All I can do is to give you my own advice. If your wife isn't a follower of the Lord, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce her.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ ngaa ne de, me yeɛ mekã ɔ, na nna Awurade ɔ: sɛ gyidiniɛ bienzua agya wiaseniɛ ná sɛ braa ne pene so kyɛ ɔne ye kɔtena a, nnɛma biaa ne yira ye.

english_verse: If your husband isn't a follower, but is willing to stay with you, don't divorce him.
translation_verse: Yeɛ sɛ gyidiniɛ brasua agya wiaseniɛ ná sɛ biaa ne pene so kyɛ ɔne ye kɔtena a, nnɛma braa ne yira ye.

english_verse: Your husband or wife who isn't a follower is made holy by having you as a partner. This also makes your children holy and keeps them from being unclean in God's sight.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wiaseniɛ huɛ ne, ɔnate ɔye so yeɛ ye nwo te ɔ; sɔ ala koso yeɛ wiaseniɛ yeɛ ne, ɔnate ohu so yeɛ ye nwo te ɔ. Na sɛ wamma ye sɔ de a, ahaa ɛmɔ mma mɔ nwo kogua fiɛ, nakoso kyɛbɔ ɔte ye de, bɛ nwo te wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: If your husband or wife isn't a follower of the Lord and decides to divorce you, then you should agree to it. You are no longer bound to that person. After all, God chose you and wants you to live at peace.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ wiaseniɛ ne kuro kyɛ oyira a, atee wɔ berɛ. Na sɛ ɔba ye sɔ a, mmeraa ngyekye gyidiniɛ bienzua anaa brasua ne, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ afrɛ yɛ kyɛ yɛtena asomdwee nu.

english_verse: And besides, how do you know if you will be able to save your husband or wife who isn't a follower? Obeying the Lord at All Times
translation_verse: Gyidiniɛ braa, sɛ ɔnate wɔ so yeɛ bekole ehu ngoa a, aso ɛse? Wɔ gyidiniɛ biaa koso, sɛ ɔnate wɔ so yeɛ bekole ɛye ngoa a, aso ɛse? Ma tebea bɔ ɛwɔ nu sɔ wɔ nye

english_verse: In every church I tell the people to stay as they were when the Lord Jesus chose them and God called them to be his own. Now I say the same thing to you.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ né ebiala si te bɔ Nyameɛ frɛle ye ne, ma sɔ sona ne ɔhɔ so bɔ ye bra kyɛbɔ Awurade ahyire ye ɔ. Nhyehyɛleɛ he yeɛ mayɔ mama asɔre biala ɔ.

english_verse: Being circumcised or uncircumcised isn't really what matters. The important thing is to obey God's commands.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bapɛ wɔ bienzua oo, bɛppɛle wɔ bienzua oo, onhia; na mmom Nyameɛ mmeraa ne aso lilɛ yeɛ ohia ɔ.

english_verse: So don't try to change what you were when God chose you.
translation_verse: Ebiala hɔ so tena tebea bɔ né ɔwɔ nu koraka yeɛ Nyameɛ baafrɛ ye ne anu.

english_verse: Are you a slave? Don't let that bother you. But if you can win your freedom, you should.
translation_verse: Bɛfrɛle wɔ ne, sɛ né ɛte akoaa a, nnɛmaa ɔha wɔ. Nakoso sɛ ɛkɔhora konya wɔ fawɔnwodi de a, pere kyɛ ekonya ye ɔ.

english_verse: When the Lord chooses slaves, they become his free people. And when he chooses free people, they become slaves of Christ.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ né ɔte akoaa koraka yeɛ Awurade frɛle ye ne, wayɛ Awurade dehyeɛ. Sɔ ala yeɛ ebiala bɔ né ɔte dehyeɛ koraka yeɛ bɛfrɛle ye ne, wayɛ Kristo akoaa ɔ.

english_verse: God paid a great price for you. So don't become slaves of anyone else.
translation_verse: Bɛtɔle ɛmɔ nyɔboɛ serɛ, yiti nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ kuro sona ngoaa.

english_verse: Stay what you were when God chose you. Unmarried People
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, tebea biala bɔ bɛfrɛle ebiala nu ne, nu ala yeɛ ɔne Nyameɛ bɛtena ɔ. Agyaa nwo foɛtulɛ

english_verse: I don't know of anything the Lord said about people who have never been married. But I will tell you what I think. And you can trust me, because the Lord has treated me with kindness.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔfa mmabunu nwo ne de, nnyane ahyɛdeɛ biala mmvili Awurade berɛ, nakoso mekyire m’adwene kyɛ ebie bɔ Awurade anwu ye anwumvoin ti ɔ́kã nahorɛ ɔ.

english_verse: We are now going through hard times, and I think it is best for you to stay as you are.
translation_verse: Sɛ menea kekesaala ye anwokyere ye a, mesusu kyɛ ahaa ɔte paa ma sona biala kyɛ ɔkɔtena tebea bɔ ɔwɔ nu ye ala nu.

english_verse: If you are married, stay married. If you are not married, don't try to get married.
translation_verse: Sɛ egya braa a, nnɛyɛ w’adwene kyɛ ekoyira ye. Sɛ eggya bie koso a, nnɛyɛ w’adwene kyɛ ekogya bie ɔ.

english_verse: It isn't wrong to marry, even if you have never been married before. But those who marry will have a lot of trouble, and I want to protect you from this.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ egya braa de a, ɛyyɔle bɔne, yeɛ sɛ ababunu koso gya biaa a, ɔyyɔle bɔne. Asetena nu dwirɛ fa asodie bɔ nu yɛ no ɔ to awarefoɛ so, na ɛhe yeɛ ahaa mekuro kyɛ ɔpa ɛmɔ ti ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, what I mean is that the Lord will soon come, and it won't matter if you are married or not.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, mekyire kyɛ, mmerɛ bɔ waha ne te tika, yiti ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɛ bɔ begya braa ne, odi kyɛ bɛbɔ bɛ bra kyɛ beggya bie ɔ;

english_verse: It will be all the same if you are crying or laughing, or if you are buying or are completely broke.
translation_verse: bɛ bɔ besũ ne, odi kyɛ bɛbɔ bɛ bra kyɛ benzũ ɔ; bɛ bɔ bɛ nye agye ne, odi kyɛ bɛbɔ bɛ bra kyɛ bɛ nye ɔggyele ɔ; bɛ bɔ bɛtɔ nningyein ne, odi kyɛ bɛbɔ bɛ bra kyɛ belle huu ɔ;

english_verse: It won't make any difference how much good you are getting from this world or how much you like it. This world as we know it is now passing away.
translation_verse: na bɛ bɔ bedi wiase nningyein si ne, odi kyɛ bɛbɔ bɛ bra kyɛ sɔ nningyein nemɔ nwo nhia ɔ. Ofikyɛ, ewiase bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ kekesaala ye ne ɔpɛ nu kɔ.

english_verse: I want all of you to be free from worry. An unmarried man worries about how to please the Lord.
translation_verse: Menguro kyɛ dadwene biala kɔha ɛmɔ ɔ. Bienzua sigyaniɛ dwene Awurade adwuma nwo, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔsɔ Awurade nye ɔ.

english_verse: But a married man has more worries. He must worry about the things of this world, because he wants to please his wife.
translation_verse: Nakoso bienzua bɔ ogya braa de, ɔdwenedwene wiase nningyein nwo, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔsɔ ɔye nye ɔ, na ɔma ye adwene yɛ ndaa ndaa.

english_verse: So he is pulled in two directions. Unmarried women and women who have never been married worry only about pleasing the Lord, and they keep their bodies and minds pure. But a married woman worries about the things of this world, because she wants to please her husband.
translation_verse: Brasua sigyaniɛ anaa ababunu dwenedwene Awurade adwuma nwo, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ krongron wɔ nipadua ne sunzum nu ɔ; nakoso brasua bɔ ogya biaa de, ɔdwenedwene wiase nningyein nwo, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ kɔsɔ ohu nye ɔ.

english_verse: What I am saying is for your own good—it isn't to limit your freedom. I want to help you to live right and to love the Lord above all else.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ ngɔsoɛ ti yeɛ ɔmaa mekã he ɔ, mengã menhyɛ ɛmɔ so; na mmom mepena kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ, na ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nwo amukoraa bɛso Awurade.

english_verse: But suppose you are engaged to someone old enough to be married, and you want her so much that all you can think about is getting married. Then go ahead and marry. There is nothing wrong with that.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie bɔ asiwa ná asiwa ne so agyaa, ná sɛ biaa ne ngora nhyɛ ye nwo so wɔ ye asiwa ne anwo a, maa begya bɛ nwo, kyɛbɔ biaa ne pena ne ala. Ɔtte bɔne.

english_verse: But it is better to have self-control and to make up your mind not to marry.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ bienzua bie si ye adwene pi, bɔ ebie nhyɛ ye, na ɔkora hyɛ ye nwo so kyɛ onnya oggyale ye asiwa ne a, né wabɔ mmɔden.

english_verse: It is perfectly all right to marry, but it is better not to get married at all.
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ ogya ye asiwa ne, wabɔ mmɔden, nakoso bɔ wangya braa ne wabɔ mmɔden watra so.

english_verse: A wife should stay married to her husband until he dies. Then she is free to marry again, but only to a man who is a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Sɛ brasua ahu te ase a, ɔngora nne ohu ndete nu; nakoso sɛ ohu ne wu de a, né ɔne ye batete nu, na ɔkora gya bienzua biala bɔ okuro ɔ, wɔ Awurade nu ngome.

english_verse: However, I think I am obeying God's Spirit when I say she would be happier to stay single.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔtena berɛ anwokwa na wangya biaa ko a, ɔte paa ma ye. Ɛhe te me bɔbɔ me nzusuleɛ, na mede medi kyɛ Nyameɛ Sunzum boka me so.

english_verse: In your letter you asked me about food offered to idols. All of us know something about this subject. But knowledge makes us proud of ourselves, while love makes us helpful to others.
translation_verse: Afei, ɔfa bosoen so aleɛ nwo dwirɛ de, yɛse kyɛ yɛ mukoraa yɛle nimdeɛ. Nimdeɛ ma sona moma ye nwo so, nakoso ɔdɔ de ɔma ngɔsoɛ.

english_verse: In fact, people who think they know so much don't know anything at all.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ebie dwene kyɛ ole nimdeɛ a, né onnya nnyane nimdeɛ bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ onya ɔ.

english_verse: But God has no doubts about who loves him.
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ okuro Nyameɛ dwirɛ nen, ye yeɛ Nyameɛ se ye ɔ.

english_verse: Even though food is offered to idols, we know that none of the idols in this world are alive. After all, there is only one God.
translation_verse: Na ɔfa bosoen so aleɛlilɛ nwo de, yɛse kyɛ bosoen de, ɔtte huu wɔ wiase wa, na Nyameɛ te komapɛ twe.

english_verse: Many things in heaven and on earth are called gods and lords, but none of them really are gods or lords.
translation_verse: Ye po sɛ nikyee biemɔ bɔ bɛfrɛ bɛ nyameɛ wɔ berɛ a, sɛ bɛwɔ nyameɛso oo, anaa aseɛ so oo, kyɛbɔ nyameɛ pee ne meneɛ pee wɔ berɛ ne,

english_verse: We have only one God, and he is the Father. He created everything, and we live for him. Jesus Christ is our only Lord. Everything was made by him, and by him life was given to us.
translation_verse: yɛ de, yɛse kyɛ Nyameɛ komapɛ twe yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ɔ. Ye ole Baba ne bɔ ɔbɔle nningyein mukoraa ná yɛ koso yɛte ase yɛma ye ne; yeɛ Awurade komapɛ twe yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ɔ, ye ole Yesu Kristo, bɔ ɔnate ye so bɛbɔle nningyein mukoraa ne, na yɛ koso ɔnate ye so yeɛ yɛte ase ɔ.

english_verse: Not everyone knows these things. In fact, many people have grown up with the belief that idols have life in them. So when they eat meat offered to idols, they are bothered by a weak conscience.
translation_verse: Nakoso nna mmenia mukoraa yeɛ bele nimdeɛ he ɔ. Mmenia biemɔ adwene ahɔ bosoensolɛ nu kyengyekyengye bɔ ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye po, sɛ bedi sɔ aleɛ ne bie a, b’adwene yɛ bɛ kyɛ amba bedi bosoen so aleɛ, na ɔma bɛ tiboa bɔ ɔyɛ mmerɛ ne gua bɛ nwo fiɛ.

english_verse: But food doesn't bring us any closer to God. We are no worse off if we don't eat, and we are no better off if we do.
translation_verse: Aleɛ ngora mma yɛnzɔ Nyameɛ nye. Sɛ yanni a, yɛnhwere hwee, yeɛ sɛ yɛdi koso a, yɛnnya ngɔsoɛ biala.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for someone with a weak conscience, just because you have the right to eat anything.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛ́mɔnea yé ná sɔ fawɔnwodi bɔ ɛmɔle ye wɔ ɛhe nwo ne, wanyɛ sundidua wamma bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ mmerɛ ne.

english_verse: You know all this, and so it doesn't bother you to eat in the temple of an idol. But suppose a person with a weak conscience sees you and decides to eat food that has been offered to idols.
translation_verse: Na sɛ sona bie bɔ ye tiboa yɛ mmerɛ nwu wɔ bɔ ele nimdeɛ ne kyɛ edidi bosoen asɔneyɛɛ sua nu a, aso ɛhe ngɔwɔ ye kɔme asi ma ongoli bosoen so aleɛ ne bie?

english_verse: Then what you know has destroyed someone Christ died for.
translation_verse: Na eliɛma bɔ ɔyɛ mmerɛ, bɔ Kristo wu mane ye ne, aso ɔnate wɔ nimdeɛ ti ɔsɛ kyɛ owu anaa?

english_verse: When you sin by hurting a follower with a weak conscience, you sin against Christ.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ sɔ bɔne ne bɛfa betia bɛ tiboa bɔ ɔyɛ mmerɛ ne a, né ɛmɔayɔ batia Kristo.

english_verse: So if I hurt one of the Lord's followers by what I eat, I will never eat meat as long as I live.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ aleɛ to aliɛmaa sundidua a, nzaade mengoli sɔ aleɛ ne le, ná mamma wamvi ase.

english_verse: I am free. I am an apostle. I have seen the Lord Jesus and have led you to have faith in him.
translation_verse: Me bɔbɔ nnne me nwo hɔ ɔ? Aso nnde somafoɛ anaa? Nnwuni y’Awurade Yesu Kristo hɔ ɔ? Nna me sa noa adwuma wɔ Awurade nu ole ɛmɔ hɔ ɔ?

english_verse: Others may think that I am not an apostle, but you are proof that I am an apostle to you.
translation_verse: Sɛ nnde somafoɛ mma ebiemɔ a, ɛmɔ de, nde somafoɛ ma ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔte me somafoɛyɛlɛ nzɔanoɛ wɔ Awurade nu.

english_verse: When people question me, I tell them
translation_verse: Sɔa yeɛ meye me noa mekyire bɛ bɔ bɛfeefee me bra nu ne ɔ:

english_verse: that Barnabas and I have the right to our food and drink.
translation_verse: Aso yɛlle ye nwo ate kyɛ yɛdidi ná yɛno anaa?

english_verse: We each have the right to marry one of the Lord's followers and to take her along with us, just as the other apostles and the Lord's brothers and Peter do.
translation_verse: Aso yɛlle ye nwo ate kyɛ yɛne aliɛmaa brasua bɔ ɔte yɛ ye tu atee, kyɛbɔ asomafoɛ ngaa nemɔ ne Awurade aliɛma mɔ ne Kefa bɛyɔ ne?

english_verse: Are we the only ones who have to support ourselves by working at another job?
translation_verse: Anaakyɛ me ne Banaba de, yɛ ngome twe yeɛ onni kyɛ yɛyakyi kyɛ yɛyɔ adwuma yɛnea yɛ nwo ɔ?

english_verse: Do soldiers pay their own salaries? Don't people who raise grapes eat some of what they grow? Don't shepherds get milk from their own goats?
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔ koɛ ná ye bɔbɔ yeɛ otua ye nwo kerɛ ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ɔyɔ mmakaammaa boo bɔ onni ye mma ne bie ɔ? Anaakyɛ nwa yeɛ ɔnea nandwie so ná ɔnno bɛ nyɔfonesue ne bie ɔ?

english_verse: I am not saying this on my own authority. The Law of Moses tells us not to muzzle an ox when it is grinding grain. But was God concerned only about an ox?
translation_verse: Na bahyerɛ ye Mose mmeraa ne anu kyɛ, “Sɛ nandwie boro aburoo a, nnɛkyekye ye noa.” Aso nandwie yeɛ ye nwo hia Nyameɛ ɔ?

english_verse: No, he wasn't! He was talking about us. This was written in the Scriptures so that all who plow and all who grind the grain will look forward to sharing in the harvest.
translation_verse: Anaakyɛ nna yɛ ti yeɛ ɔmaa ɔhane sɔ ɔ? Ɔte nahorɛ kyɛ yɛ ti yeɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, odi kyɛ sona bɔ ofundam aseɛ ne fundam ye anyelasoɛ nu, na bɔ ɔboro aburoo ne koso boro ye anyelasoɛ nu kyɛ okonya nu bie ɔ.

english_verse: When we told the message to you, it was like planting spiritual seed. So we have the right to accept material things as our harvest from you.
translation_verse: Yalua sunzum nu mmaa wɔ ɛmɔ nu, na sɛ ɛmɔboka yɛ wɔ anwoɔnaen nu nningyein nu a, aso né ɛmɔayɔ bɔ ɔtra so anaa?

english_verse: If others have the right to do this, we have an even greater right. But we haven't used this right of ours. We are willing to put up with anything to keep from causing trouble for the message about Christ.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebiemɔ le atee bɛkora benya nningyein befi ɛmɔ berɛ a, né yɛ de yɛlle ye nwo ate kyɛ yɛnya bɔ ɔtra sɔ anaa? Nakoso yɛ de, yamva sɔ atee ne aso; na mmom yɛmiane yɛ nye yɛpenene nikyee biala so, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ na yanzi Kristo nzɛmba ne nwo atee ɔ.

english_verse: Don't you know that people who work in the temple make their living from what is brought to the temple? Don't you know that a person who serves at the altar is given part of what is offered?
translation_verse: Aso ɛmɔnze, kyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ nningyein krongron nemɔ nwo adwuma ne, benya bɛ noa aleɛ befi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu ɔ? Yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛso wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo ne, benya afɔleɛbɔlɛ nningyein ne bie ɔ?

english_verse: In the same way, the Lord wants everyone who preaches the good news to make a living from preaching this message.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ Awurade ahyehyɛ kyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛkã nzɛmba ne, bekodidi nzɛmba ne nwo ɔ.

english_verse: But I have never used these privileges of mine, and I am not writing this because I want to start now. I would rather die than have someone rob me of the right to take pride in this.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmmisale ɛmɔ asɛdeɛ he nwo hwee; yeɛ mengyerɛ krataa he memmrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ sɔ asɛdeɛ ne bɛma me. Ofikyɛ, kyɛ ebie kɔma me nwo hoahoalɛ kɔyɛ mbaen de, nzaade maa nwu.

english_verse: I don't have any reason to brag about preaching the good news. Preaching is something God told me to do, and if I don't do it, I am doomed.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mekã nzɛmba ne a, né ongyire kyɛ mva nhoahoa me nwo, ɔnate kyɛ ɔte adwuma bɔ odi kyɛ meyɔ ɔ. Na sɛ mangã nzɛmba ne a, me yaakɔ!

english_verse: If I preach because I want to, I will be paid. But even if I don't want to, it is still something God has sent me to do.
translation_verse: Sɛ me bɔbɔ me pɛ yeɛ mefa mekã nzɛmba ne a, ye po mefata akatuaa, nakoso sɛ nna me bɔbɔ me pɛ yeɛ mefa mekã hɔ a, nzaade bɔ bafa bawura me sa ne ala yeɛ meyɔ ne.

english_verse: What pay am I given? It is the chance to preach the good news free of charge and not to use the privileges that are mine because I am a preacher.
translation_verse: Yiti akatuaa beni yeɛ menya ɔ? M’akatuaa ole kyɛ ngɔhã Kristo nzɛmba ne bɔ memmisa ebie dɔ hwee ɔ, ná afei asɛdeɛ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛyɔ bɛma me wɔ nzɛmba ne anwo koso memmisa ɔ.

english_verse: I am not anyone's slave. But I have become a slave to everyone, so I can win as many people as possible.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ebiala nni me so de, nakoso mayɛ me nwo akoaa mama mmenia mukoraa, amaa ɔnate so me sa ahã mmenia pee.

english_verse: When I am with the Jews, I live like a Jew to win Jews. They are ruled by the Law of Moses, and I am not. But I live by the Law to win them.
translation_verse: Nyɛle me nwo Yudaniɛ mane Yudafoɛ amaa me sa ahã Yudafoɛ. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ nnwura mmeraa bo de, nakoso nyɛle me nwo kyɛ nwura mmeraa bo mane bɛ bɔ bewura mmeraa bo ne, amaa me sa ahã bɛ bɔ bewura mmeraa bo ne.

english_verse: And when I am with people who are not ruled by the Law, I forget about the Law to win them. Of course, I never really forget about the law of God. In fact, I am ruled by the law of Christ.
translation_verse: Nyɛle me nwo kyɛ nne mmeraa bo mane bɛ bɔ bɛnne mmeraa bo ne. Nna kyɛ ebiaa menni Nyameɛ mmeraa so hɔ ɔ, na mmom nwura Kristo mmeraa bo, amaa me sa ahã bɛ bɔ bɛnne mmeraa bo ne.

english_verse: When I am with people whose faith is weak, I live as they do to win them. I do everything I can to win everyone I possibly can.
translation_verse: Nyɛle me nwo kyɛ meyɛ mmerɛ wɔ gyidie nu mane bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ mmerɛ wɔ gyidie nu ne, amaa me sa ahã bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ mmerɛ wɔ gyidie nu ne. Mayɛ mmenia mukoraa bɛ sona, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná atee biala aso, mama bɛ nu biemɔ banya daa ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: I do all this for the good news, because I want to share in its blessings. A Race and a Fight
translation_verse: Nzɛmba ne ati yeɛ meyɔ ɛhe amukoraa ɔ, amaa me koso manya nu saleɛ ne bie.

english_verse: You know that many runners enter a race, and only one of them wins the prize. So run to win!
translation_verse: Ɛmɔnze kyɛ amirikatulɛfoɛ betu amirika a, ebiala pere kyɛ okoli ngonim ɔ, nakoso bɛ nu ko yeɛ onya ngonim abasobɔdeɛ ne ɔ? Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔtu amirika ne kyɛ ɛmɔkonya abasobɔdeɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: Athletes work hard to win a crown that cannot last, but we do it for a crown that will last forever.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ otu amirika pere ngonim ne, ɔhyɛ ye nwo so wɔ nikyee biala nu. Bɛyɔ sɔ ná banya abotire abasobɔdeɛ bɔ ɔsɛkye ɔ, nakoso yɛ de, yɛnya abotire abasobɔdeɛ bɔ ɔnzɛkye ɔ.

english_verse: I don't run without a goal. And I don't box by beating my fists in the air.
translation_verse: Yiti me de, mendu amirika asunzumabo, yeɛ mendo me twɔleɛ kyɛ ebie bɔ ɔto ye deɛ gua mvrama nu ɔ.

english_verse: I keep my body under control and make it my slave, so I won't lose out after telling the good news to others.
translation_verse: Na mmom mehyɛ me nipadua ne anyeborolɛ maa odi yealɛ, ama nzɛmba bɔ mekã mekyire amanvoɛ ye, me bɔbɔ mambɛ me nwo manhwere nu saleɛ.

english_verse: Friends, I want to remind you that all our ancestors walked under the cloud and went through the sea.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, mepena kyɛ ɛmɔnwu ye fa yɛ nana mɔ nwo kyɛbɔ munungum ne munduni bɛ mukoraa bɛ so, ná bɛ mukoraa bɛfale ɛpo ne anu ne.

english_verse: This was like being baptized and becoming followers of Moses.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle bɛ mukoraa asu wɔ Mose nu, wɔ munungum ne ɛpo ne anu.

english_verse: All of them also ate the same spiritual food
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa belili sunzum nu aleɛ komapɛ ne ala,

english_verse: and drank the same spiritual drink, which flowed from the spiritual rock that followed them. That rock was Christ.
translation_verse: na bɛ mukoraa bɛnone sunzum nu anonneɛ komapɛ ne ala. Ofikyɛ, sunzum nu Nyɔbotaen bɔ né oli bɛ si ne, nu nzue yeɛ bɛnone ɔ, na sɔ Nyɔbotaen ne ole Kristo.

english_verse: But most of them did not please God. So they died, and their bodies were scattered all over the desert.
translation_verse: Nakoso, Nyameɛ nye angye bɛ nu pee bɛ nwo, yiti bewuwuli wɔ ɛserɛ ne aso.

english_verse: What happened to them is a warning to keep us from wanting to do the same evil things.
translation_verse: Na ɛhemɔ te kɔkɔbɔlɛ ma yɛ, amaa yanni bɔne si kyɛbɔ belili ne.

english_verse: They worshiped idols, just as the Scriptures say, “The people sat down to eat and drink. Then they got up to dance around.” So don't worship idols.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔso bosoen kyɛbɔ bɛ nu biemɔ yɔle ne, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Mmenia ne tenane ase bedidili bɛnone ná bedwɔso begole.”

english_verse: Some of those people did shameful things, and in a single day about
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma yɛbɔ adwaman kyɛbɔ bɛ nu biemɔ yɔle na mmenia apee aburanyɔ ne nza totɔle ɛlɛhomapɛ ne.

english_verse: Some of you say, “We can do whatever we want to!” But I tell you not everything may be good or helpful.
translation_verse: Bɛtaa bɛkã kyɛ, “Yɛle nikyee biala nwo ate”, nakoso nna nikyee biala yeɛ ɔte paa ɔ; yeɛ nna nikyee biala yeɛ ɔma ngɔsoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And don't try to test Christ, as some of them did and were later bitten by poisonous snakes.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma yɛso Kristo yɛnea kyɛbɔ bɛ nu biemɔ yɔle ná ewoo kekale bɛ maa bewuwuli ne.

english_verse: Don't even grumble, as some of them did and were killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Yeɛ nnɛmɔma yɛpenepene yɛ komvi kyɛbɔ bɛ nu biemɔ yɔle ná ewue abɔfo oohuhuni bɛ ne.

english_verse: These things happened to them as a warning to us. All this was written in the Scriptures to teach us who live in these last days.
translation_verse: Ɛhe amukoraa tole bɛ maa ɔyɛle kɔkɔbɔlɛ, na bɛhyerɛ bɛtole berɛ bɛfa betuli yɛ foɛ, yɛ bɔ wiase ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne wato yɛ ne.

english_verse: Even if you think you can stand up to temptation, be careful not to fall.
translation_verse: Yiti ma ebiala bɔ ɔdwene kyɛ ogyi berɛ ne ɔ́nea yé ná wamvi ase.

english_verse: You are tempted in the same way that everyone else is tempted. But God can be trusted not to let you be tempted too much, and he will show you how to escape from your temptations.
translation_verse: Nzɔhwɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ wato ɛmɔ bɔ sona nnwuni bie le ɔ. Nakoso ɔnate kyɛ Nyameɛ di nahorɛ ne ati, ɔngɔma ate ngɔma nzɔhwɛ bɔ ɔbo ɛmɔ anwoserɛ so ngɔto ɛmɔ. Na mmom, okohyire ɛmɔ atee bɔ ɛmɔkɔfa so bekɔnwati bekofi nzɔhwɛ ne anu ɔ, amaa ɛmɔahora bagyina ye noa.

english_verse: My friends, you must keep away from idols.
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi bosoensolɛ nwo.

english_verse: I am speaking to you as people who have enough sense to know what I am talking about.
translation_verse: Medwudwo mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛse nworɛ ɔ, yiti ɛmɔdwene bɔ mekã ye nwo.

english_verse: When we drink from the cup we ask God to bless, isn't that sharing in the blood of Christ? When we eat the bread we break, isn't that sharing in the body of Christ?
translation_verse: Yɛda Awurade Adidie kulie bɔ bayira so ne nwo ase a, aso ongyire kyɛ yɛne Kristo mogya ne afa abiɛngoɛ anaa? Paanoo bɔ yɛbubu ne, aso ongyire kyɛ yɛne Kristo nipadua ne afa abiɛngoɛ anaa?

english_verse: By sharing in the same loaf of bread, we become one body, even though there are many of us.
translation_verse: Paanoo ne te komapɛ, na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ yɛsone de, nakoso yɛte nipadua komapɛ, ofikyɛ paanoo komapɛ ne ala yeɛ yɛ mukoraa yɛdi ɔ.

english_verse: Aren't the people of Israel sharing in the worship when they gather around the altar and eat the sacrifices offered there?
translation_verse: Ɛmɔnea Yisraelfoɛ! Aso bɛ bɔ bedi afɔlebɔdeɛ nen, bɛ ne afɔleɛ bokyea ne bennyane abiɛngoɛfalɛ anaa?

english_verse: Am I saying that either the idols or the food sacrificed to them is anything at all?
translation_verse: Afei sɛɛ koraa yeɛ mekyire ɔ? Bosoen te nzu koraa, anaakyɛ bosoen so aleɛ te nzu koraa?

english_verse: No, I am not! This food is really sacrificed to demons and not to God. I don't want you to have anything to do with demons.
translation_verse: Mekyire kyɛ aleɛ bɔ bosoensolɛfoɛ bɛfa bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ne, bɛfa bɛma sunzummɔne mɔ, na bɛmva bɛmma Nyameɛ; yiti menguro kyɛ ɛmɔ ne sunzummɔne mɔ kɔbɔ afɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You cannot drink from the cup of demons and still drink from the Lord's cup. You cannot eat at the table of demons and still eat at the Lord's table.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔngɔhora bɛngɔno Awurade kulie noa, ná ɛmɔano sunzummɔne mɔ koso bɛ kulie noa. Ɛmɔngɔhora bengodidi Awurade poen so, ná ɛmɔasa badidi sunzummɔne mɔ bɛ poen so.

english_verse: We would make the Lord jealous if we did this. And we are not stronger than the Lord. Always Honor God
translation_verse: Anaa yɛpena kyɛ yɛwura Awurade apue maa ɔtwe nungunɛ hɔ ɔ? Yɛbu ye kyɛ yɛ nwo yɛ se tra ye anaa? Yɔ nningyein mukoraa hyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam

english_verse: However, when you buy meat in the market, go ahead and eat it. Keep your conscience clear by not asking where the meat came from.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔli naen biala bɔ bɛtɔne ye dwaanu, na ɔnate sona tiboa ti nnɛma ɛmɔbisabisa ye nwo dwirɛ biala.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “The earth and everything in it belong to the Lord.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ “Aseɛ ne bɔ ɔwɔ so amukoraa te Awurade deɛ.”

english_verse: If an unbeliever invites you to dinner, and you want to go, then go. Eat whatever you are served. Don't cause a problem for someone's conscience by asking where the food came from.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie bɔ ɔtte gyidiniɛ frɛ ɛmɔ adidie, ná ɛmɔpene so kyɛ ɛmɔkɔhɔ a, bɔ ɔkɔfa kosie ɛmɔ nyunu biala, ɛmɔli. Sona tiboa ti nnɛma ɛmɔbisa ye nwo dwirɛ biala.

english_verse: But if you are told it has been sacrificed to idols, don't cause a problem by eating it. I don't mean a problem for yourself, but for the one who told you. Why should my freedom be limited by someone else's conscience?
translation_verse: Mengyire ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bɛ tiboa, na mmom mekyire sona bɔ ɔha hyirele ɛmɔ ne tiboa. Nzu ati yeɛ ebie tiboa bua bɔ mekuro kyɛ meyɔ nwo ndɛen ɔ?

english_verse: If I give thanks for what I eat, why should anyone accuse me of doing wrong?
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ mefa asennaa medi a, nzu ati yeɛ ebie kã me nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ fa bɔ mala ye nwo ase nwo ɔ?

english_verse: When you eat or drink or do anything else, always do it to honor God.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ ɛmɔdidi oo, sɛ ɛmɔno oo, nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔyɛ ne, ɛ́mɔyɔ ye mukoraa bɛfa bɛhyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam.

english_verse: Don't cause problems for Jews or Greeks or anyone else who belongs to God's church.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔkɔha Yudafoɛ anaa Helafoɛ anaa Nyameɛ asɔre ne;

english_verse: I always try to please others instead of myself, in the hope that many of them will be saved.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ mebɔ mmɔden kyɛ ngɔsɔ mmenia mukoraa nye wɔ nikyee biala nu ne. Membena me ngome me yeeyɛlɛ, na mmom mmeni soma yeeyɛlɛ, kyɛbɔ bekonya daa ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: You must follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ. Rules for Worship
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔsuasua me, kyɛbɔ me koso mesuasua Kristo ne. Bɛ ti so katalɛ wɔ asɔre sua nu

english_verse: I am proud of you, because you always remember me and obey the teachings I gave you.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, mekamvo ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔkaye me wɔ nikyee biala nu, na ɛmɔdi ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ mva mane ɛmɔ ne aso.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that Christ is the head of all men, and a man is the head of a woman. But God is the head of Christ.
translation_verse: Na mepena kyɛ ɛmɔte ye bo kyɛ Kristo te bienzua biala mene, brasua koso ohu te ye mene, na Nyameɛ koso te Kristo mene.

english_verse: This means that any man who prays or prophesies with something on his head brings shame to his head.
translation_verse: Bienzua biala bɔ ɔbɔ mbaeɛ anaa ɔhyɛ ngɔm ná ɔkata ye ti so ne, onni ye mene ni.

english_verse: But any woman who prays or prophesies without something on her head brings shame to her head. In fact, she may as well shave her head.
translation_verse: Nakoso brasua biala bɔ ɔbɔ mbaeɛ anaakyɛ ɔhyɛ ngɔm ná wangata ye ti so ne, onni ye mene ni; na ɔte kyɛ wabɔ tikwa ne ala.

english_verse: A woman should wear something on her head. It is a disgrace for a woman to shave her head or cut her hair. But if she refuses to wear something on her head, let her cut off her hair.
translation_verse: Na sɛ brasua angata ye ti so de a, ye de maa ɔtete ye ti; nakoso sɛ ɔte animguaseɛ ma brasua kyɛ ɔkɔtete ye ti, anaakyɛ ɔkɔbɔ tikwa a, ye de maa ɔkata so.

english_verse: Men were created to be like God and to bring honor to God. This means a man should not wear anything on his head. Women were created to bring honor to men.
translation_verse: Bienzua de, onhia kyɛ ɔkata ye ti so ɔ, ɔnate ɔte Nyameɛ animnyam ne ye sue; nakoso brasua de, ɔye bienzua animnyam kyire.

english_verse: It was the woman who was made from a man, and not the man who was made from a woman.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bammɔ bienzua bamvi brasua nu, na mmom brasua yeɛ bɛbɔle ye befili bienzua nu ɔ.

english_verse: He wasn't created for her. She was created for him.
translation_verse: Afei koso, nna brasua ti yeɛ bɛbɔle bienzua ɔ, na mmom bienzua ti yeɛ bɛbɔle brasua ɔ.

english_verse: And so, because of this, and also because of the angels, a woman ought to wear something on her head, as a sign of her authority.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ti, odi kyɛ brasua nya ngatasoɛ wɔ ye ti so, ɔnate abɔfo mɔ ti.

english_verse: As far as the Lord is concerned, men and women need each other.
translation_verse: Nakoso Awurade nyunu de, bienzua ngɔ nyakyi brasua, yeɛ brasua koso ngɔ nyakyi bienzua;

english_verse: It is true that the first woman came from a man, but all other men have been given birth by women. Yet God is the one who created everything.
translation_verse: ɔnate kyɛ, kyɛbɔ bɛbɔle brasua befili bienzua nu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ brasua koso wo bienzua ɔ, na nningyein mukoraa fi Nyameɛ nu.

english_verse: Ask yourselves if it is proper for a woman to pray without something on her head.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔte paa kyɛ brasua bɔ mbaeɛ kyire Nyameɛ bɔ wangata ye ti so a, ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bébua.

english_verse: But long hair is a beautiful way for a woman to cover her head.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ brasua de, ye ti fu gua ye nwo a ɔte ye animnyam. Ofikyɛ bɛfale nwiaa bɛmane ye kyɛ ɔfa kata ye ti so.

english_verse: This is how things are done in all of God's churches, and this is why none of you should argue about what I have said. Rules for the Lord's Supper
translation_verse: Na sɛ ebie su ɛhe nwo aporowaa a, yɛ de yɛnne nhyehyɛleɛ foforɛ biala yɛndo nu, yeɛ Nyameɛ asɔre nemɔ koso benne bɛndo nu. Awurade Adidie (Mateo

english_verse: Your worship services do you more harm than good. I am certainly not going to praise you for this.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe bɔ mekã mekyire ɛmɔ ye, mengamvo ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ sɛ ɛmɔyia nu a, ɛmɔnyɔ nikye paa, na mmom bɔ ɔtte mayee yeɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I am told you can't get along with each other when you worship, and I am sure that some of what I have heard is true.
translation_verse: Bɔ oli moa ɔ, sɛ ɛmɔyia nu kyɛ asɔre a, mete kyɛ mbakyembakyemuɛ ba ɛmɔ nu, na mede medi kyɛ bɛ nu bie te nahorɛ.

english_verse: You are bound to argue with each other, but it is easy to see which of you have God's approval.
translation_verse: Yoo, ye nwo kohia kyɛ fekue fekue kɔwa ɛmɔ nu ɔ, na ɛhe kɔma ɛmɔ nu mmenia bɔ bɛnate nahorɛ atee so ne, bɛ nwo kɔla nzorɛ.

english_verse: You even start eating before everyone gets to the meeting, and some of you go hungry, while others get drunk.
translation_verse: ɔnate kyɛ sɛ ɛmɔdidi a, ebiala di ye aleɛ deɛ koraka; na ɛhɔen ku ebie ne, né ebie koso nzaa abo ye.

english_verse: The Lord meant that when you eat this bread and drink from this cup, you tell about his death until he comes.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ biala bɔ ɛmɔkoli paanoo he ná ɛmɔkɔno kulie he noa nen, ɛmɔbɔ Awurade wue ne dawure kodwu mmerɛ bɔ ɔkɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: If you fail to understand that you are the body of the Lord, you will condemn yourselves by the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ odi ná ɔno ye wɔ atee bɔ ɔmvata so nen, odi ná ɔno ɔfa ndɛenbualɛ ɔbrɛ ye bɔbɔ ye nwo; ofikyɛ wammu [Awurade] nipadua ne.

english_verse: After the meal, Jesus took a cup of wine in his hands and said, “This is my blood, and with it God makes his new agreement with you. Drink this and remember me.”
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ bedidi beyiele nen, ɔfale kulie ne, na ɔhane kyɛ, “Kulie he te apam foforɛ me mogya nu; mmerɛ biala bɔ ɛmɔkɔno ne, ɛ́mɔyɔ he bɛ́fa bɛ́kaye me.”

english_verse: I have already told you what the Lord Jesus did on the night he was betrayed. And it came from the Lord himself. He took some bread in his hands.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, bɔ nya mvili Awurade berɛ ne yeɛ me koso mva mane ɛmɔ ɔ: kyɛ, kɔngɔen ne bɔ bɛyele Awurade Yesu bɛmane ne, ɔfale paanoo,

english_verse: Then after he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “This is my body, which is given for you. Eat this and remember me.”
translation_verse: ɔlale ase, na obubuli nu, na ɔhane kyɛ, “[Ɛmɔle beli.] Ɛhe te me nipadua bɔ bébubu bɛ́ma ɛmɔ ɔ; ɛ́mɔyɔ he bɛ́fa bɛ́kaye me.”

english_verse: But if you eat the bread and drink the wine in a way that isn't worthy of the Lord, you sin against his body and blood.
translation_verse: Yiti sona biala bɔ okoli paanoo he, anaakyɛ ɔkɔno Awurade kulie ne noa wɔ atee bɔ ɔmvata so ne, okoli Awurade nipadua ne ye mogya nwo fɔ.

english_verse: This is why you must examine the way you eat and drink.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ ebiala ɔbaali paanoo ne bie, ná ɔno kulie ne noa bie a, maa ɔpɛnzɛpɛnzɛ ye nu ɔnea koraka.

english_verse: This is why many of you are sick and weak and why a lot of others have died.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati yeɛ ɛmɔ nu pee bayɛ mmerɛ ná bɛ nwo yɛ bɛ yea, na pee koso bawuwu ɔ.

english_verse: If we carefully judge ourselves, we won't be punished.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛpɛnzɛpɛnzɛ yɛ nu nahorɛ nu a, bengobua yɛ ndɛen.

english_verse: But when the Lord judges and punishes us, he does it to keep us from being condemned with the rest of the world.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ Awurade bua yɛ ndɛen a, ɔtwe yɛ so, amaa ɔnate so bamva yɛ bamvra wiase so bammua yɛ ndɛen.

english_verse: My dear friends, you should wait until everyone gets there before you start eating.
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, sɛ ɛmɔyia nu kyɛ ɛmɔbaadidi a, ɛ́mɔnwondɛnwondɛ bɛ nwo.

english_verse: If you really are hungry, you can eat at home. Then you won't condemn yourselves when you meet together. After I arrive, I will instruct you about the other matters.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛhɔen ku ebie a, maa odidi awuro koraka, ná ɛmɔammanyia nu bandwetwe ndɛenbualɛ bamma bɛ nwo. Edwirɛ bɔ wahã ne de, meba a yeɛ ngɔhã ye nwo bie ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, you asked me about spiritual gifts.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɔfa sunzum nu akyɛdeɛ nemɔ nwo de, membena kyɛ mefa nikyee biala mesie ɛmɔ.

english_verse: I want you to remember that before you became followers of the Lord, you were led in all the wrong ways by idols that cannot even talk.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔse kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ né ɛmɔte wiasefoɛ nen, ɛmɔmaa bɛlakalakale ɛmɔ maa ɛmɔhyinini mmosoen emumu mɔ so.

english_verse: Now I want you to know that if you are led by God's Spirit, you will say that Jesus is Lord, and you will never curse Jesus.
translation_verse: Yiti mepena kyɛ ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ, ebiala bɔ Nyameɛ Sunzum fa ye so dwudwo ne ngora nga kyɛ, “Musue ha Yesu!” Yeɛ ebiala koso ngora nga kyɛ, “Yesu te Awurade,” sana Sunzum Krongron ne te ye nu.

english_verse: There are different kinds of spiritual gifts, but they all come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Adom akyɛdeɛ gua ahoroɔ, nakoso Sunzum komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔfa ma ɔ.

english_verse: There are different ways to serve the same Lord,
translation_verse: Ɛsolɛ nnwumaa gua ahoroɔ, nakoso ofi Awurade komapɛ ne ala berɛ.

english_verse: and we can each do different things. Yet the same God works in all of us and helps us in everything we do.
translation_verse: Dwumadie koso gua ahoroɔ, nakoso Nyameɛ komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔfa yɛ mukoraa so odi dwumaa ne ɔ.

english_verse: The Spirit has given each of us a special way of serving others.
translation_verse: Nakoso yɛ mukoraa yɛ ngɔsoɛ ti, Sunzum ne ɔye ye nwo ali wɔ yɛ nu biala nu.

english_verse: Some of us can speak with wisdom, while others can speak with knowledge, but these gifts come from the same Spirit.
translation_verse: Sunzum ne ma sona ko kã nworɛ dwirɛ, né Sunzum komapɛ ne ala abukye sona foforɛ adwene nu ama ye nimdeɛ.

english_verse: To others the Spirit has given great faith or the power to heal the sick
translation_verse: Ye komapɛ ne ala ɔma ebie gyidie, né wasa walo ebie koso wama ye anwonyerɛsalɛ tumi.

english_verse: or the power to work mighty miracles. Some of us are prophets, and some of us recognize when God's Spirit is present. Others can speak different kinds of languages, and still others can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Sunzum ne ma sona ko anwanwadeɛyɔlɛ tumi, né wama sona foforɛ koso ngɔmhyɛlɛ tumi. Ɔma ebie anyeɛ bɔ ɔfa nwu sunzum ahoroɔ nu nzonzoleɛ ɔ; ɔma ebie edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ tumi, né wama ebie koso tumi bɔ ɔfa kyire edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ bo ɔ.

english_verse: But it is the Spirit who does all this and decides which gifts to give to each of us. One Body with Many Parts
translation_verse: Sunzum komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔyɔ ɛhemɔ amukoraa ɔ, na ɔma ebiala akyɛdeɛ kyɛbɔ ye bɔbɔ okuro ɔ. Nipadua akwaa gua ahoroɔ

english_verse: Some of us are Jews, and others are Gentiles. Some of us are slaves, and others are free. But God's Spirit baptized each of us and made us part of the body of Christ. Now we each drink from that same Spirit.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ yɛ mukoraa: Yudafoɛ oo, Helafoɛ oo, ngoaa oo, nnehyeɛ oo, Sunzum komapɛ ne ala yeɛ bɛfa bɛbɔle yɛ asu maa yɛɛyɛle nipadua ko ɔ, na Sunzum komapɛ ne ala yeɛ wahwie wagua yɛ mukoraa yɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: Our bodies don't have just one part. They have many parts.
translation_verse: Nipadua n’akwaa ɔtte ko, na mmom bɛsone.

english_verse: Suppose a foot says, “I'm not a hand, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the foot still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Sɛ agyirɛ kã kyɛ, “Me de, nnde asaa, yiti mmmoka nipadua ne aso” a, ɛhe ngyire kyɛ ɔbboka nipadua ne aso.

english_verse: Or suppose an ear says, “I'm not an eye, and so I'm not part of the body.” Wouldn't the ear still belong to the body?
translation_verse: Na sɛ asoɛ kã kyɛ, “Me de, nnde anyeɛ, yiti mmmoka nipadua ne aso” a, ɛhe ngyire kyɛ ɔbboka nipadua ne aso.

english_verse: If our bodies were only an eye, we couldn't hear a thing. And if they were only an ear, we couldn't smell a thing.
translation_verse: Na sɛ nipadua ne amu te anyeɛ a, ahaa ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né wate dwirɛ? Yeɛ sɛ nipadua ne amu te asoɛ a, ahaa ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né wafofã nikye?

english_verse: But God has put all parts of our body together in the way that he decided is best.
translation_verse: Na nekaa bɔ Nyameɛ kuro biala yeɛ ɔfale nipadua akwaa biala tuale ɔ.

english_verse: A body isn't really a body, unless there is more than one part.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ye mukoraa te akwaa komapɛ a, ahaa nipadua ne wɔ ni?

english_verse: It takes many parts to make a single body.
translation_verse: Ɔte nahorɛ kyɛ nipadua n’akwaa sone de, nakoso nipadua ne te komapɛ.

english_verse: That's why the eyes cannot say they don't need the hands. That's also why the head cannot say it doesn't need the feet.
translation_verse: Yiti anyeɛ ngora nga ngyire asaa kyɛ, “Wɔ nwo nhia me.” Yeɛ tire wora ɔngora nga ngyire agyirɛ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔ nwo nhia me.”

english_verse: In fact, we cannot get along without the parts of the body that seem to be the weakest.
translation_verse: Na mmom nipadua n’akwaa bɔ yɛ de yɛdwene kyɛ bɛyɛ mmerɛ ne, sɛ bɛnne nu a, yɛyɔ hwee a ɔnyɛ yee.

english_verse: We take special care to dress up some parts of our bodies. We are modest about our personal parts,
translation_verse: Yeɛ nipadua n’akwaa bɔ yɛsusu kyɛ bɛmvata anidie somaa nen, bɛ po yeɛ yɛma bɛ anidie pee ɔ, na yɛsiesie nipadua n’akwaa bɔ bɛwɔ mvealeɛ nu ne yé.

english_verse: but we don't have to be modest about other parts. God put our bodies together in such a way that even the parts that seem the least important are valuable.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ y’akwaa bɔ bɛnne mvealeɛ nu ne nhia sɔ nziesie ne. Nakoso kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ wasi wahyehyɛ nipadua nen, akwaa bɔ yɛmmu ye ne po yeɛ wama ye anidie pee ɔ,

english_verse: He did this to make all parts of the body work together smoothly, with each part caring about the others.
translation_verse: amaa mbakyembakyemuɛ amma nipadua ne anu, na mmom akwaa biala nwo ahia ama obiɛngo.

english_verse: If one part of our body hurts, we hurt all over. If one part of our body is honored, the whole body will be happy.
translation_verse: Sɛ akwaa ko nwo kã a, ɔkã bɛ mukoraa. Yeɛ sɛ bɛhyɛ akwaa ko animnyam a, ɔyɛ ye ne akwaa ngaa ne amu fɛ.

english_verse: Together you are the body of Christ. Each one of you is part of his body.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔte Kristo nipadua ne, na ɛmɔ nu ko biala te ye akwaa ne bie.

english_verse: First, God chose some people to be apostles and prophets and teachers for the church. But he also chose some to work miracles or heal the sick or help others or be leaders or speak different kinds of languages.
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ atu ebiemɔ asie berɛ wɔ asɔre ne anu. Bɔ oli moa ɔ: kyɛ asomafoɛ, bɔ ɔtoa berɛ ɔ, kyɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ, bɔ ɔtɔ nza, kyɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ; yeɛ afei bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ anwanwadeɛ, bɛ bɔ bele anwonyerɛsalɛ akyɛdeɛ, bokafoɛ, asɔre mbanyi, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛkã edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ.

english_verse: Not everyone is an apostle. Not everyone is a prophet. Not everyone is a teacher. Not everyone can work miracles.
translation_verse: Aso bɛ mukoraa yeɛ bɛte asomafoɛ ɔ? Bɛ mukoraa yeɛ bɛte ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ɔ? Bɛ mukoraa yeɛ bɛte akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ɔ? Bɛ mukoraa yeɛ bɛyɔ anwanwadeɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Not everyone can heal the sick. Not everyone can speak different kinds of languages. Not everyone can tell what these languages mean.
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa yeɛ bele anwonyerɛsalɛ akyɛdeɛ ɔ? Bɛ mukoraa yeɛ bɛkã edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ ɔ? Bɛ mukoraa yeɛ bekyire edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ bo ɔ?

english_verse: I want you to desire the best gifts. So I will show you a much better way.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa bɛ nye besie akyɛdeɛ bɔ bɛ nwo hia paa nemɔ aso. Afei ɛ́mɔma ngyire ɛmɔ atee paa paa ne.

english_verse: What if I could speak all languages of humans and even of angels? If I did not love others, I would be nothing more than a noisy gong or a clanging cymbal.
translation_verse: Sɛ mekã mmenia ne abɔfo mɔ dwudwolɛ ahoroɔ ná nnne ɔdɔ a, né nde kyɛ ayaa bɔ ɔgyegye mbaen anaakyɛ akasaa bɔ ɔwoso mbaen ɔ.

english_verse: What if I could prophesy and understand all mysteries and all knowledge? And what if I had faith that moved mountains? I would be nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Sɛ nne ngɔmhyɛlɛ akyɛdeɛ, ná mete mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ amukoraa ne nimdeɛ mukoraa bo, ná nne gyidie mukoraa bɔ ɔmaa mekora metutu mmokaa bo, nakoso nnne ɔdɔ a, né nnde huu.

english_verse: What if I gave away all that I owned and let myself be burned alive? I would gain nothing, unless I loved others.
translation_verse: Sɛ mefa me nwo nningyein mukoraa mekyɛ, na mefa me nipadua mema kyɛ bɛyera ye, na nnne ɔdɔ a, mennya mvasoɛ biala so.

english_verse: rude. Love isn't selfish or quick tempered. It doesn't keep a record of wrongs that others do.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔ mma ye nye ndra ye ndo nwiaa, ɔtte pɛsɛmangomenya, ɔmvɛ yaa mbaen mbaen, yeɛ ɔmva bɔne nzie ye ti anu.

english_verse: Love rejoices in the truth, but not in evil.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔ nye ngye bɔne nwo, na mmom ye nye gye nahorɛ nwo.

english_verse: Love never fails! Everyone who prophesies will stop, and unknown languages will no longer be spoken. All that we know will be forgotten.
translation_verse: Ɔdɔ bo ngɔpɛ le, nakoso ngɔmhyɛlɛ bo kɔpɛ, edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ kɔpɛ nu kɔhɔ, yeɛ nimdeɛ koso kotu komini.

english_verse: We don't know everything, and our prophecies are not complete.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ yɛ nimdeɛ ne yɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛ nni mu,

english_verse: But what is perfect will someday appear, and what isn't perfect will then disappear.
translation_verse: nakoso bɔ odi mu ne ba a, bɔ onni mu ne kotu komini.

english_verse: When we were children, we thought and reasoned as children do. But when we grew up, we quit our childish ways.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né nde akwadaa ne, ndwudwole kyɛ akwadaa, ndwenene kyɛ akwadaa, me ndeaseɛ yɛle kyɛ akwadaa. Nakoso nyɛle panyi ye de, mayakyi ngwadasɛm ne.

english_verse: Now all we can see of God is like a cloudy picture in a mirror. Later we will see him face to face. We don't know everything, but then we will, just as God completely understands us.
translation_verse: Kekesaala ye de, yɛnwu nikyee wusiwusi wɔ neanu nu. Nakoso kyẽa bie yɛkonwu ye pefee. Kekesaala ye de, bɔ mese ne onni mu, nakoso kyẽa bie okoli mu kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ koso se me ne.

english_verse: For now there are faith, hope, and love. But of these three, the greatest is love.
translation_verse: Afei nningyein nza yeɛ bɛwɔ berɛ ɔ: gyidie, anyelasoɛ, yeɛ ɔdɔ, nakoso ɔdɔ di mu tra bɛ mu.

english_verse: Love should be your guide. Be eager to have the gifts that come from the Holy Spirit, especially the gift of prophecy.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma ɔdɔ yɛ ɛmɔ botaeɛ, ná ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye boro bɛpena sunzum akyɛdeɛ, ye titire, kyɛ ɛmɔkɔhyɛ ngɔm ɔ.

english_verse: If you speak languages that others don't know, God will understand what you are saying, though no one else will know what you mean. You will be talking about mysteries that only the Spirit understands.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ sona bɔ ɔkã edwudwolɛ bɔ ebie nde ye bo ne, ondwudwo ngyire mmenia, na mmom odwudwo kyire Nyameɛ, ofikyɛ ebiala nde ye dwirɛ ne bo; nakoso Sunzum ne nate ye so kã mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ.

english_verse: But when you prophesy, you will be understood, and others will be helped. They will be encouraged and made to feel better.
translation_verse: Nakoso sona bɔ ɔhyɛ ngɔm de, mmenia ngɔsoɛ, foɛtulɛ ne aworakyekyerɛ ti yeɛ ɔyɔ sɔ ɔ.

english_verse: By speaking languages that others don't know, you help only yourself. But by prophesying you help everyone in the church.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ ɔkã edwudwolɛ bɔ ebie nde ye bo nen, ɔyɔ sɔ ma ye bɔbɔ ye ngɔsoɛ; nakoso bɔ ɔhyɛ ngɔm ne de, ɔyɔ sɔ ma asɔre ne ngɔsoɛ.

english_verse: I am glad for you to speak unknown languages, although I prefer that you would prophesy. In fact, prophesying does much more good than speaking unknown languages, unless someone can help the church by explaining what you mean.
translation_verse: Mekuro kyɛ ahaa ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛkã edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ, nakoso bɔ mekuro paa ole kyɛ ɛmɔkɔhyɛ ngɔm ɔ. Ofikyɛ sona bɔ ɔhyɛ ngɔm ne, ɔyɔ sɔ fa ngɔsoɛ brɛ asɔre ne tra bɔ ɔkã edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ ɔ; sana bekyire edwirɛ ne bo koraka né asɔre ne anya ngɔsoɛ.

english_verse: My friends, what good would it do, if I came and spoke unknown languages to you and didn't explain what I meant? How would I help you, unless I told you what God had shown me or gave you some knowledge or prophecy or teaching?
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, sɛ meba ɛmɔ berɛ ná mekã edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ a, mvasoɛ beni yeɛ ɛmɔkonya bekofi me nwo ɔ? Sana mefa nyekyire anaa nimdeɛ anaa ngɔmhyɛlɛ anaa ngyerɛkyerɛ so yeɛ medwudwo mekyire ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: If a bugle call isn't clear, how would you know to get ready for battle?
translation_verse: Na sɛ behu totorobɛndo ná nu anna berɛ yé a, nwa yeɛ okosiesie ye nwo kɔhɔ koɛ ɔ?

english_verse: This is how it is when you speak unknown languages. If no one can understand what you are talking about, you will only be talking to the wind.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ koso sɛ ɛmɔkã edwudwolɛ bɔ ebie nde ye bo a, ebiala ngɔte bɔ ɛmɔkã ne bo ɔ. Ɔte kyɛ ɛmɔdwudwo bekyire mvrama ɔ.

english_verse: But if I don't understand the language that someone is using, we will be like foreigners to each other.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ mende dwudwolɛ bie bo a, sona bɔ ɔkã sɔ dwudwolɛ ne bu me pɔtɔniɛ, yeɛ me koso mebu ye pɔtɔniɛ.

english_verse: If you really want spiritual gifts, choose the ones that will be most helpful to the church.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ koso, ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔpere bɛpena Sunzum n’akyɛdeɛ ne ati, odi kyɛ ɛmɔma bɛ nye boro bɛpena akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔkɔma asɔre ne ngɔsoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When we speak languages that others don't know, we should pray for the power to explain what we mean.
translation_verse: Yiti sona bɔ ɔkã edwudwolɛ bɔ ebie nde ye bo ne, maa ɔbɔ mbaeɛ kyɛ ɔkɔhora kohyire ye bo ɔ.

english_verse: For example, if I use an unknown language in my prayers, my spirit prays but my mind is useless.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɛ mebɔ mbaeɛ wɔ edwudwolɛ bɔ ebie nde ye bo nu a, me sunzum yeɛ ɔbɔ mbaeɛ ne ɔ, nakoso m’adwene de, ɔnyɔ ye nwo hwee.

english_verse: Then what should I do? There are times when I should pray with my spirit, and times when I should pray with my mind. Sometimes I should sing with my spirit, and at other times I should sing with my mind.
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔyɛ ye sɛ? Ngɔfa sunzum ne ngɔbɔ mbaeɛ, ná mafa m’adwene koso mabɔ mbaeɛ. Ngɔfa sunzum ne ngɔto dwein ná mafa m’adwene koso mato dwein.

english_verse: Suppose some strangers are in your worship service, when you are praising God with your spirit. If they don't understand you, how will they know to say, “Amen”?
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛbɔ asennaa mbaeɛ wɔ sunzum nu a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né ebie bɔ ɔnde ye bo ɔ wasuro w’asennaa mbaeɛ ne aso “Amen”, wɔ aberɛ bɔ ɔnze bɔ ɛkã ɔ?

english_verse: You may be worshiping God in a wonderful way, but no one else will be helped.
translation_verse: Na sɛ w’asennaa mbaeɛ ne te paa sɛɛ ala po a, ɔngora mma sona foforɛ ngɔsoɛ.

english_verse: I thank God that I speak unknown languages more than any of you.
translation_verse: Meda me Nyameɛ ase kyɛ mekã dwudwolɛ ahoroɔ metra ɛmɔ amukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: But words that make sense can help the church. This is why in church I would rather speak five words that make sense than to speak
translation_verse: Nakoso asɔre sua nu de, mekuro kyɛ ngɔfa m’adwene ngɔhã edwirɛ nnu bɔ ɔkɔyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ kɔma ebiemɔ tra kyɛ ngɔhã edwirɛ apee buru edwudwolɛ bɔ ebie nde ye bo nu.

english_verse: My friends, stop thinking like children. Think like mature people and be as innocent as tiny babies.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔdwene kyɛ ngwadaa, bɔne nu de, ɛ́mɔyɛ kyɛ nnɔma na mmom adwene nu ɛ́mɔyɛ mbanyi.

english_verse: In the Scriptures the Lord says, “I will use strangers who speak unknown languages to talk to my people. They will speak to them in foreign languages, but still my people won't listen to me.”
translation_verse: Bahyerɛ ye mmeraa ne anu kyɛ, “Ngɔfa mmenia bɔ bɛkã edwudwolɛ foforɛ ne amanvrafoɛ mɔ dwudwolɛ so yeɛ ngodwudwo ngohyire mmenia hemɔ ɔ; nakoso po bengotie me dwirɛ, Awurade noa dwirɛ ɛne.”

english_verse: Languages others don't know may mean something to unbelievers, but not to the Lord's followers. Prophecy, on the other hand, is for followers, not for unbelievers.
translation_verse: Yiti edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ de, ɔtte sɛngyerɛnneɛ mma agyidifoɛ, na mmom ɔte sɛngyerɛnneɛ ma bɛ bɔ benne nni ɔ; yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛ wora ɔtte bɛ bɔ benne benni deɛ, na mmom ɔte agyidifoɛ deɛ.

english_verse: Suppose everyone in your worship service started speaking unknown languages, and some outsiders or some unbelievers come in. Won't they think you are crazy?
translation_verse: Na sɛ asɔremma ne amu beyia neka horɛ, na bɛ mukoraa bɛkã edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ, na sɛ ebiemɔ mbaen anaa bɛ bɔ benne benni ba berɛ a, aso bɛngɔhã kyɛ ɛmɔabobɔ laen?

english_verse: But suppose all of you are prophesying when those unbelievers and outsiders come in. They will realize that they are sinners, and they will want to change their ways because of what you are saying.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔhyɛ ngɔm, ná sɛ ebie bɔ onne nni anaa ebie mbaen ba berɛ a, edwirɛ bɔ ɔkɔte ne amu kobua ye ndɛen na wapusu ye.

english_verse: They will tell what is hidden in their hearts. Then they will kneel down and say to God, “We are certain that you are with these people.” Worship Must Be Orderly
translation_verse: Ye ti anu mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ kɔla ali, ɔkɔfa ye nyunu kobutu berɛ kɔsɔne Nyameɛ, ná wahã kyɛ Nyameɛ wɔ ɛmɔ nu amba. Asɔre nu sɔnenɛ nwo nhyehyɛleɛ

english_verse: My friends, when you meet to worship, you must do everything for the good of everyone there. That's how it should be when someone sings or teaches or tells what God has said or speaks an unknown language or explains what the language means.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, mekyire sɛɛ koraa? Sɛ ɛmɔyia nu a, ebie le edwein to, ebie le ngyerɛkyerɛ kyire, ebie le edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ kã, ebie le nyekyire, ebie le edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ nwo ngyerɛaseɛ. Ɛmɔma ebiala yɔ ye deɛ bɔ ɔma ngɔsoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: No more than two or three of you should speak unknown languages during the meeting. You must take turns, and someone should always be there to explain what you mean.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie kã edwudwolɛ bɔ ebie nde ye bo a, maa bɛyɛ mmenia nyɔ, anaakyɛ wabo so koraa ne, mmenia nza, na bɛha ye ngoko ngoko, na sona ko hyire ye bo.

english_verse: If no one can explain, you must keep silent in church and speak only to yourself and to God.
translation_verse: Na sɛ sona biala nne berɛ bɔ okyire ye bo de a, ye de maa omua ye noa wɔ asɔre ne anu, na ɔne ye ngome ne ye Nyameɛ beli ngitahoɛ.

english_verse: Two or three persons may prophesy, and everyone else must listen carefully.
translation_verse: Na ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne de, ma mmenia nyɔ anaa nza bedwudwo, na bɛ ngaa ne bua edwirɛ ne nwo ndɛen.

english_verse: If someone sitting there receives a message from God, the speaker must stop and let the other person speak.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ebie wɔ berɛ ná onya nyekyire a, ye de ma bɔ ogu so odwudwo ne yakyi dwudwolɛ.

english_verse: Let only one person speak at a time, then all of you will learn something and be encouraged.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔkɔhora bɛkɔhyɛ ngɔm ngoko ngoko, ná ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔanya nu nikyeesualɛ ne aworakyekyerɛ.

english_verse: A prophet should be willing to stop and let someone else speak.
translation_verse: Ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ sunzum mɔ wura ngɔmhyɛfoɛ nemɔ abo.

english_verse: God wants everything to be done peacefully and in order. When God's people meet in church,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ de, ɔtte basabasayɔlɛ Nyameɛ, na mmom ɔte asomdwee Nyameɛ. Na kyɛbɔ bɛyɔ ye anwoteefoɛ asɔre mukoraa nu ne,

english_verse: the women must not be allowed to speak. They must keep quiet and listen, as the Law of Moses teaches.
translation_verse: ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ mmrasua mɔ bemua bɛ noa wɔ asɔre mɔ nu. Ofikyɛ belle ye nwo ate kyɛ bedwudwo ɔ, na mmom bɛbrɛ bɛ nwo ase kyɛbɔ mmeraa ne kã ne.

english_verse: If there is something they want to know, they can ask their husbands when they get home. It is disgraceful for women to speak in church.
translation_verse: Sɛ bɛpena edwirɛ bie anu betie a, maa bebisa bɛ hu mɔ wɔ awuro; ofikyɛ ɔte animguaseɛ ma brasua kyɛ okodwudwo asɔre sua nu ɔ.

english_verse: God's message did not start with you people, and you are not the only ones it has reached.
translation_verse: Nzu ati ɔ! Ɛmɔ dɔ yeɛ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne fi wale hɔ ɔ, anaakyɛ ɛmɔ ngome bɛ dɔ yeɛ wadwu ɔ?

english_verse: If you think of yourself as a prophet or a spiritual person, you will know I am writing only what the Lord has commanded.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie bu ye nwo kyɛ ɔte ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ anaakyɛ ole sunzum nu akyɛdeɛ a, maa ɔte ye bo kyɛ bɔ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ ye te Awurade ahyɛdeɛ.

english_verse: So don't pay attention to anyone who ignores what I am writing.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ebie nne ɛhe ndo nu a, koso nne ye ndo nu.

english_verse: My friends, be eager to prophesy and don't stop anyone from speaking languages that others don't know.
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔma ɛmɔ nye boro ngɔmhyɛlɛ nwo, yeɛ nnɛmaa ɛmɔsi edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ hanɛ nwo ate.

english_verse: But do everything properly and in order.
translation_verse: Na ɛ́mɔfa atee paa so bɛ́yɔ nikyee biala pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to remember the message I preached and that you believed and trusted.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, afei mekaye ɛmɔ nzɛmba bɔ nga ngyirele ɛmɔ, bɔ ɛmɔle bɛtole nu, ná ɛmɔ gyi so ne.

english_verse: You will be saved by this message, if you hold firmly to it. But if you don't, your faith was all for nothing.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔsɔ bɔ nga ngyirele ɛmɔ ne anu yé a, ɔnate so ɛmɔkonya daa ngoa; na sɛ wamma ye sɔ de a, né ɛmɔale bali mbaen.

english_verse: I told you the most important part of the message exactly as it was told to me. This part is: Christ died for our sins, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, edwirɛ bɔ ye nwo hia paa yeɛ nyane ɔ, ná me koso mva mmrɛle ɛmɔ kyɛ, yɛ bɔne ti yeɛ Kristo wuli ɔ, kyɛbɔ Ahyerɛlɛ ne kã ne.

english_verse: He was buried, and three days later he was raised to life, as the Scriptures say.
translation_verse: Besiele ye, na ye ɛlɛsa so odwɔso fili ewue nu, kyɛbɔ Ahyerɛlɛ ne kã ne.

english_verse: Christ appeared to Peter, then to the twelve.
translation_verse: Ɔyele ye nwo ali hyirele Kefa, na nziɛ ye buru ne nyɔ ne koso benwuni ye.

english_verse: After this, he appeared to more than five hundred other followers. Most of them are still alive, but some have died.
translation_verse: Ɛhe asi ye, ɔyele ye nwo ali hyirele agyidifoɛ bɔ bɛbo ɛyaa nnu mmerɛ komapɛ, bɔ bɛ nu pee tɛte ase, ná ebiemɔ koso balela ɔ.

english_verse: He also appeared to James, then to all of the apostles.
translation_verse: Ɛhe asi ye, ɔyele ye nwo ali hyirele Yakobo, na afei asomafoɛ ne amukoraa benwuni ye.

english_verse: Finally, he appeared to me, even though I am like someone who was born at the wrong time.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, ɔyele ye nwo ali hyirele me koso bɔ nde kyɛ ebie bɔ wandwu oni aworɛ ná wawo ye ɔ.

english_verse: I am the least important of all the apostles. In fact, I caused so much trouble for God's church that I don't even deserve to be called an apostle.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ me yeɛ nde asomafoɛ nemɔ nu kãa paa ɔ; memvata kyɛ bɛfrɛ me somafoɛ, ɔnate kyɛ ndanene Nyameɛ asɔre ne nye.

english_verse: But God treated me with undeserved grace! He made me what I am, and his grace wasn't wasted. I worked much harder than any of the other apostles, although it was really God's grace at work and not me.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ adom ti yeɛ nde kyɛ bɔ nde ye, na ye adom bɔ ɔfa lole me ne wanyɛ mbaen. Mayɔ adwuma matra bɛ mukoraa, nakoso nna me mmɔdenbɔlɛ ɔ, na mmom Nyameɛ adom bɔ ɔboka me ne ɔ.

english_verse: But it doesn't matter if I preached or if they preached. All of you believed the message just the same. God's People Will Be Raised to Life
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ me ahɔ oo, sɛ bɛ ahɔ oo, nzɛmba komapɛ ne ala yeɛ yɛkã ɔ, yeɛ ɛmɔ koso bele belili ɔ. Ewutingyelɛ nwo dwirɛ

english_verse: If we preach that Christ was raised from death, how can some of you say the dead will not be raised to life?
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛkã Kristo nwo nzɛmba kyɛ wadwɔso wafi ewue nu a, ɔwale ye sɛ bɔ ɛmɔ nu biemɔ kã kyɛ awufoɛ ewutingyelɛ nne berɛ ɔ?

english_verse: If they won't be raised to life, Christ himself wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Na sɛ awufoɛ ewutingyelɛ nne berɛ de a, nzaade né bandingye Kristo.

english_verse: And if Christ wasn't raised to life, our message is worthless, and so is your faith.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bandingye Kristo de a, nzaade yɛ nzɛmbahanɛ ne te mbaen, yeɛ ɛmɔ gyidie koso te mbaen.

english_verse: If the dead won't be raised to life, we have told lies about God by saying he raised Christ to life, when he really did not.
translation_verse: Né nzaade yato Nyameɛ soen, ofikyɛ yali Nyameɛ nwo adanzeɛ kyɛ watingye Kristo, wɔ aberɛ bɔ wandingye ye ɔ, sɛ ɔtte nahorɛ kyɛ ewutingyelɛ wɔ berɛ de a.

english_verse: So if the dead won't be raised to life, Christ wasn't raised to life.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɛ awufoɛ ndwɔso de a, né nzaade bandingye Kristo.

english_verse: Unless Christ was raised to life, your faith is useless, and you are still living in your sins.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bandingye Kristo de a, nzaade ɛmɔ gyidie te mbaen, na ɛmɔtɛte ɛmɔ bɔne nu.

english_verse: And those people who died after putting their faith in him are completely lost.
translation_verse: Né nzaade Kristo nu agyidifoɛ koso bɔ balela ne bamini.

english_verse: If our hope in Christ is good only for this life, we are worse off than anyone else.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ngoa he ngome nu yeɛ yɛle anyelasoɛ wɔ Kristo nu de a, né nzaade yɛyɛ anwumvo yɛtra mmenia mukoraa. Ewutingyelɛ nwo anyelasoɛ

english_verse: But Christ has been raised to life! And he makes us certain that others will also be raised to life.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔte nahorɛ kyɛ batingye Kristo bafi ewue nu amaa wayɛ bɛ bɔ balela ne anu bakaa mmaa bɔ oli moa ɔ.

english_verse: Just as we will die because of Adam, we will be raised to life because of Christ.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ ewue nate sona ko so wale ne, sɔ ala yeɛ awufoɛ ewutingyelɛ koso nate sona ko so wawa ɔ.

english_verse: Adam brought death to all of us, and Christ will bring life to all of us.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ ɔnate Adam ti mmenia mukoraa nya ewue ne, sɔ ala yeɛ Kristo ti bɛ mukoraa bekonya ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: But we must each wait our turn. Christ was the first to be raised to life, and his people will be raised to life when he returns.
translation_verse: Nakoso bekotingye ebiala wɔ ye nnidisoɛ so: Kristo bɔ ɔte bakaa mmaa bɔ oli moa ne, na afei bɛ bɔ bɛte Kristo deɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔkɔye ye nwo ali ne, bɛ koso batoa so.

english_verse: Then after Christ has destroyed all powers and forces, the end will come, and he will give the kingdom to God the Father.
translation_verse: Afei yeɛ né ayieleɛ ne awa ɔ, bɔ okoli ahennie ne anwoserɛ ne tumi mukoraa so, ná wafa Ahennie ne wawura Baba Nyameɛ sa.

english_verse: Christ will rule until he puts all his enemies under his power,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ odi hene maa okodwu kyɛ ɔkɔfa ye pɔfoɛ mukoraa kɔyɛ ye gya bo ndiasoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: and the last enemy he destroys will be death.
translation_verse: Pɔfoɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo koraa bɔ okoli ye so ngonim ole ewue.

english_verse: When the Scriptures say he will put everything under his power, they don't include God. It was God who put everything under the power of Christ.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wafa nningyein mukoraa wayɛ ye gya bo ndiasoɛ. Nakoso sɛ ɔkã kyɛ nningyein mukoraa ayɛ ye gya bo ndiasoɛ a, nu la pefee kyɛ bɔ ɔfale nningyein mukoraa yɛle ye gya bo ndiasoɛ ne de, ɔbboka so.

english_verse: After everything is under the power of God's Son, he will put himself under the power of God, who put everything under his Son's power. Then God will mean everything to everyone.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bɛfa nningyein mukoraa bewura ye bo beyie a, afei yeɛ né Baa ne bɔbɔ koso kɔfa ye nwo kowura bɔ ɔfale nningyein mukoraa wurale ye bo ne bo ɔ, ná afei Nyameɛ ali nningyein mukoraa so hene.

english_verse: If the dead are not going to be raised to life, what will people do who are being baptized for them? Why are they being baptized for those dead people?
translation_verse: Nzaade bɛ bɔ begyina awufoɛ gya nu maa bɛbɔ bɛ asu bɛma bɛ ne, nzikyɛ yeɛ bɛpena bekyire ɔ? Na sɛ awufoɛ ndingye de a, nzu ati yeɛ mmenia gyina awufoɛ gya nu maa bɛbɔ bɛ asu ɔ?

english_verse: and face death every day? The pride that I have in you because of Christ Jesus our Lord is what makes me say this.
translation_verse: Mesi ye pi mekyire ɛmɔ, aliɛmaa mɔ, ɔnate kyɛ mefa ɛmɔ mehoahoa me nwo wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo nyunu ne ati, ewue li me mvanvando daa biala.

english_verse: What do you think I gained by fighting wild animals in Ephesus? If the dead are not raised to life, “Let's eat and drink. Tomorrow we die.”
translation_verse: Na sɛ anwoɔnaen nu mvasoɛ ti yeɛ me ne ngekaboa yɛhone Ɛfeso de a, né mvasoɛ beni yeɛ ngonya ɔ? Yiti sɛ awufoɛ ngodwɔso de a, nzaade “ɛmɔma yɛdidi na yɛno, ofikyɛ ɛhema né yawu.”

english_verse: Don't fool yourselves. Bad friends will destroy you.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma bɛlakalaka ɛmɔ, na “abiɛngoɛ tɛɛ sɛkye bra paa.”

english_verse: Be sensible and stop sinning. You should be embarrassed that some people still don't know about God. What Our Bodies Will Be Like
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa adwene paa ná ɛ́mɔyakyi bɔne yɔlɛ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ nu biemɔ belle Nyameɛ nwo nimdeɛ. Mekã he maa ɛmɔ nyunu gua ase. Nipadua bɔ batingye ye ɔ

english_verse: Some of you have asked, “How will the dead be raised to life? What kind of bodies will they have?”
translation_verse: Ebie kobisa kyɛ, “Na ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né batingye awufoɛ? Na nzikyɛ nipadua yeɛ bɛkɔfa bekodwɔso ɔ?”

english_verse: Don't be foolish. A seed must die before it can sprout from the ground.
translation_verse: Kwaseaa! Sɛ edua nikyee a, ongofifi, sana owu koraka.

english_verse: Wheat seeds and all other seeds look different from the sprouts that come up.
translation_verse: Yeɛ bɔ ekolua ne koso, nna ye ole bakaa ne mumua bɔ okofifi kɔwa ne, na mmom ɔte kyɛ ayuo anaa aburoo bɔ batutu ɔ komapɛ twe.

english_verse: This is because God gives everything the kind of body he wants it to have.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ maa onyi yɛ bakaa horɛ kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ kuro ɔ, na edua aburoo a, omvifi ayuo.

english_verse: People, animals, birds, and fish are each made of flesh, but none of them are alike.
translation_verse: Anwoɔnaen mukoraa nzɛ. Kuro sona nwonaen ngome, ndɔteboa deɛ ngome, nnomaa deɛ ngome, yeɛ nzue nu naen koso deɛ ngome.

english_verse: Everything in the heavens has a body, and so does everything on earth. But each one is very different from all the others.
translation_verse: Anwuro abɔdeɛ wɔ berɛ, yeɛ aseɛ so abɔdeɛ koso wɔ berɛ, nakoso asora anwuro abɔdeɛ animnyam, yeɛ asora aseɛ so abɔdeɛ animnyam.

english_verse: The sun isn't like the moon, the moon isn't like the stars, and each star is different.
translation_verse: Eyia animnyam ngome, yeɛ ɛsraen animnyam koso ngome. Nzramaa mɔ koso b’animnyam gua ahoroɔ, ofikyɛ asora nzramaa biala ne ye animnyam.

english_verse: That's how it will be when our bodies are raised to life. These bodies will die, but the bodies that are raised will live forever.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ awufoɛ ewutingyelɛ ne koso te ɔ. Bɔ bedua ne porɔ, na bɔ betingye ye ne de, ɔmborɔ.

english_verse: These ugly and weak bodies will become beautiful and strong.
translation_verse: Bedua ye animguaseɛ nu, na betingye ye animnyam nu. Bedua a, né ɔyɛ mmerɛ, na betingye ye tumi nu.

english_verse: As surely as there are physical bodies, there are spiritual bodies. And our physical bodies will be changed into spiritual bodies.
translation_verse: Bedua ye anwoɔnaen nu, na betingye ye a, ɔte sunzum nu nipadua. Anwoɔnaen nu nipadua wɔ berɛ, yeɛ sunzum nu nipadua koso wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: The first man was named Adam, and the Scriptures tell us that he was a living person. But Jesus, who may be called the last Adam, is a life-giving spirit.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Adam bɔ oli moa ne ɔɔyɛle ɛkra teasefoɛ;” na Adam bɔ oli nziɛ ne ɔɔyɛle sunzum bɔ ɔma ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: We see that the one with a spiritual body did not come first. He came after the one who had a physical body.
translation_verse: Nna bɔ ɔte sunzum ne yeɛ oli moa ɔ, na mmom anwoɔnaen deɛ ne ba koraa né sunzum deɛ ne awa.

english_verse: The first man was made from the dust of the earth, but the second man came from heaven.
translation_verse: Bele nnɛterɛ yeɛ bɛbɔle sona bɔ oli moa ne ɔ, ofi nnɛterɛ nu. Sona bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne ole Awurade bɔ ofi nyameɛso ne.

english_verse: Everyone on earth has a body like the body of the one who was made from the dust of the earth. And everyone in heaven has a body like the body of the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ bɔ ofi nnɛterɛ nu ne te ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛfale nnɛterɛ bɛbɔle bɛ ne bɛte ɔ; na kyɛbɔ nyameɛsoniɛ ne te ne, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛte nyameɛso deɛ ne bɛte ɔ.

english_verse: Just as we are like the one who was made out of earth, we will be like the one who came from heaven.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ yanya bɔ ofi nnɛterɛ nu ne sona sue nen, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛkonya bɔ ofi nyameɛso ne sue ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that our bodies of flesh and blood will decay. This means they cannot share in God's kingdom, which lasts forever.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, bɔ mekyire ole kyɛ, anwoɔnaen ne mogya ngɔhora ngonya Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu kyɛfa, yeɛ bɔ ɔporɔ ne koso ngonya bɔ ɔmborɔ ne anu kyɛfa.

english_verse: I will explain a mystery to you. Not every one of us will die, but we will all be changed.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔtie, mekã mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ mekyire ɛmɔ; yɛ mukoraa yɛngɔlela, na yɛkɔkakyi.

english_verse: It will happen suddenly, quicker than the blink of an eye. At the sound of the last trumpet the dead will be raised. We will all be changed, so we will never die again.
translation_verse: Na mvum nu, kyɛ ɛbɔ wɔ nye perɛ ne, totorobɛndo bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ne kohu. Ofikyɛ bekohu totorobɛndo ne, na bekotingye awufoɛ bɛkɔhɔ tebea bɔ bɛmborɔ ɔ nu, na yɛ de yɛkɔkakyi.

english_verse: Our dead and decaying bodies will be changed into bodies that won't die or decay.
translation_verse: Na odi kyɛ bɔ ɔporɔ ne fa bɔ ɔmborɔ ne wura, na nipadua he bɔ owu ne afa nipadua bɔ onwu ne wawura.

english_verse: The bodies we now have are weak and can die. But they will be changed into bodies that are eternal. Then the Scriptures will come true, “Death has lost the battle!
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ nipadua he bɔ ɔporɔ ne fa nipadua bɔ ɔmborɔ ne wura, na nipadua he bɔ owu ne fa nipadua bɔ onwu ne wura a, afei yeɛ né bɔ bahyerɛ ne awa nu kyɛ, “Basɛkye ewue bali ye so ngonim bɔkɔɔ!

english_verse: Where is its victory? Where is its sting?”
translation_verse: Wɔ, ewue, wɔ noa borɔ wɔ ni? Wɔ, ewue, wɔ ngonim wɔ ni?”

english_verse: Sin is what gives death its sting, and the Law is the power behind sin.
translation_verse: Ewue noa borɔ ole bɔne, na bɔne koso tumi ole mmeraa ne.

english_verse: But thank God for letting our Lord Jesus Christ give us the victory!
translation_verse: Nakoso yɛda Nyameɛ bɔ ɔnate y’Awurade Yesu Kristo so maa yɛdi ngonim ne ase.

english_verse: My dear friends, stand firm and don't be shaken. Always keep busy working for the Lord. You know that everything you do for him is worthwhile.
translation_verse: Yiti nniɛma mɔ, ɛmɔgyina pindinn, nnɛma ɛmɔhimhim, na daa biala ɛmɔhɔ so bɛyɔ Awurade adwuma, ofikyɛ ɛmɔse kyɛ ɛmɔ fɛɛ wɔ Awurade adwuma nu ngɔyɛ mbaen.

english_verse: When you collect money for God's people, I want you to do exactly what I told the churches in Galatia to do.
translation_verse: Ɔfa ndoboa bɔ bedide bɛkɔma anwoteefoɛ nwo nen, nhyehyɛleɛ bɔ mayɛ mama Galatia asɔre nemɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔli so ɔ.

english_verse: That is, each Sunday each of you must put aside part of what you have earned. If you do this, you won't have to take up a collection when I come.
translation_verse: Dapɛn biala nu kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne, ɛmɔ nu biala ɔ́fa bɔ Nyameɛ afa alo ye ne bie osie, amaa sɛ meba a, ye nwo anhia kyɛ ɛmɔkɔkekã bɛ sa ase ɔ.

english_verse: Choose some followers to take the money to Jerusalem. I will send them on with the money and with letters which show that you approve of them.
translation_verse: Sɛ meba a, mmenia bɔ ɛmɔkɔye bɛ kɔma bɛ adanzeɛ krataa ne, ngɔsoma bɛ maa bɛkɔfa ɛmɔ akyɛdeɛ ne bɛkɔhɔ Yerusalem.

english_verse: If you think I should go along, they can go with me. Paul's Travel Plans
translation_verse: Na sɛ ohia kyɛ me ne bɛ kɔ a, me ne bɛ yɛkɔhɔ. Pɔɔlo ateetulɛ nwo nhyehyɛleɛ

english_verse: After I have gone through Macedonia, I hope to see you
translation_verse: Ngɔfa Makedonia koraa né mawa ɛmɔ berɛ, ofikyɛ mayɛ m’adwene kyɛ ngɔfa Makedonia.

english_verse: and visit with you for a while. I may even stay all winter, so that you can help me on my way to wherever I will be going next.
translation_verse: Ebiaa ngɔhyɛ ɛmɔ anwo berɛ kãa, anaa ngoli prakasua ne ɛmɔ berɛ, na afei nziɛ ye ɛmɔaboka me bagua me ate maa mahɔ nekaa bɔ mekɔ ɔ.

english_verse: If the Lord lets me, I would rather come later for a longer visit than to stop off now for only a short visit.
translation_verse: Menguro kyɛ me nye bɔ ɛmɔ so ala a, né masa mahɔ ɔ, na mmom me nye la so kyɛ sɛ Awurade ma ate a, ngɔhyɛ ɛmɔ nwo berɛ kãa.

english_verse: I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,
translation_verse: Nakoso ngɔtena Ɛfeso wa maa okoodwu Pɛntekɔso.

english_verse: because there is a wonderful opportunity for me to do some work here. But there are also many people who are against me.
translation_verse: Atee piri bie bɔ ngɔfa so ngɔyɔ adwuma, bɔ ye nwo kɔwa mvasoɛ abukye ama me wɔ wa, nakoso me pɔfoɛ sone.

english_verse: When Timothy arrives, give him a friendly welcome. He is doing the Lord's work, just as I am.
translation_verse: Sɛ Timoteo ba a, ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ ɔnne ɛmɔ ngɔtena wɔ ahunudetelɛ nu ɔ, ɔnate kyɛ ɔyɔ Awurade adwuma kyɛbɔ meyɔ ne ala.

english_verse: Don't let anyone mistreat him. I am looking for him to return to me together with the other followers. So when he leaves, send him off with your blessings.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ebiala bu ye animtia, na mmom ɛmɔgua ye ate asomdwee nu ma osa bra me wa, ofikyɛ menea ye ne aliɛmaa nemɔ ate.

english_verse: I have tried hard to get our friend Apollos to visit you with the other followers. He doesn't want to come just now, but he will come when he can. Personal Concerns and Greetings
translation_verse: Ɔfa aliɛmaa Apolo nwo de, mahyɛ ye nguraen pee kyɛ ɔne aliɛmaa nemɔ bɛɛpasa ɛmɔ nwo, nakoso onnya ɔyyɛle ye adwene kyɛ ɔkɔwa kekesaala ye; na sɛ atee ba nu a, ɔkɔwa. Ahyebisalɛ ne ngraa

english_verse: Keep alert. Be firm in your faith. Stay brave and strong.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔwɛne, ɛmɔgyina pindinn wɔ gyidie nu, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ ahone yɛ se, ná ɛ́mɔmia ɛmɔ nye.

english_verse: Show love in everything you do.
