translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa ɔdɔ bɛyɔ ɛmɔ nningyein mukoraa.

english_verse: You know that Stephanas and his family were the first in Achaia to have faith in the Lord. They have done all they can for God's people. My friends, I ask you
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔse Setefana ne ye abusuafoɛ nwo dwirɛ; bɛ yeɛ belili moa bɛyɛle agyidifoɛ wɔ Akaia ɔ, na batu bɛ nwo basie berɛ bama anwoteefoɛ solɛ.

english_verse: to obey leaders like them and to do the same for all others who work hard with you.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛma sɔ mmenia ne, ɔne ebiala bɔ ɔne yɛ di sɔ dwumadie ne ɔ.

english_verse: I was glad to see Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus. Having them here was like having you.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ me fɛ kyɛ Setefana ne Fotunato ne Akaiko bawa ɔ, ofikyɛ baasi ɛmɔ gya nu;

english_verse: They made me feel much better, just as they made you feel better. You should appreciate people like them.
translation_verse: na bama m’ahone atɔ me kunu kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ deɛ tɔlɛ ɛmɔ kunu ne. Yiti ɛ́mɔnea mmenia bɔ bɛte sɔ ne yé.

english_verse: Greetings from the churches in Asia. Aquila and Priscilla, together with the church that meets in their house, send greetings in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Asɔre mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Asia ne, bebisa ɛmɔ ahye. Akwila ne Prisika ne asɔremma bɔ beyia b’awuro ne koso bebisa ɛmɔ paa.

english_verse: All the Lord's followers send their greetings. Give each other a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa nemɔ amu bebisa ɛmɔ. Ɛmɔfa awaawaatuu krongron bɛtotɔ ɛmɔ nwo nu.

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL.
translation_verse: Me bɔbɔ, Pɔɔlo, me sa noa ahyerɛlɛ yeɛ mefa mebisa ɛmɔ ahye ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God will put a curse on everyone who doesn't love the Lord. And may the Lord come soon.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie nguro Awurade Yesu Kristo dwirɛ a, musue to ye! Y’Awurade bra! .

english_verse: I pray the Lord Jesus will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Yɛ Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne ɛmɔ bɛtena.

english_verse: I love everyone who belongs to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Me dɔ ne ɛmɔ tena wɔ Kristo Yesu nu. Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Jesus Christ, and from Timothy, who is also a follower. To God's church in Corinth and to all of God's people in Achaia.
translation_verse: Krataa he fi me, Pɔɔlo, bɔ ɔnate Nyameɛ pɛ so nde Kristo Yesu somafoɛ berɛ. Me ne aliɛmaa Timoteo yeɛ yɛhyerɛle ɔ. Yɛ́fa yɛbrɛ Nyameɛ asɔre bɔ ɔwɔ Korinto, ɔne anwoteefoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ Akaia mukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul Gives Thanks
translation_verse: Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. Pɔɔlo da Nyameɛ ase

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ! The Father is a merciful God, who always gives us comfort.
translation_verse: Animnyam hã Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte y’Awurade Yesu Kristo Baba ne, anwumvoinnwunɛ Baba ne aworakyekyerɛ mukoraa Nyameɛ ne,

english_verse: He comforts us when we are in trouble, so that we can share this same comfort with others in trouble.
translation_verse: bɔ ɔkyekye yɛ wora wɔ y’amaneɛnwunɛ mukoraa nu, amaa yɛ koso yahora yafa aworakyekyerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ fa kyekye yɛ wora ne yakyekye bɛ bɔ benwu amaneɛ ahoroɔ ɔ bɛ wora.

english_verse: We share in the terrible sufferings of Christ, but also in the wonderful comfort he gives.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ yɛnwu Kristo amaneɛ worawora ne bie ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛnate Kristo so yɛnya aworakyekyerɛ mmorosoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: We suffer in the hope that you will be comforted and saved. And because we are comforted, you will also be comforted, as you patiently endure suffering like ours.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛnwu amaneɛ a, né ɛmɔ aworakyekyerɛ ne ɛmɔ ngoalelɛ ti ɔ; yeɛ sɛ yɛnya aworakyekyerɛ a, né ɛmɔ aworakyekyerɛ ti ɔ, bɔ sɛ ɛmɔle aboterɛ begyina amaneɛ bɔ yɛ koso yɛnwu ye ne noa bie a, ɛmɔ sa kã ye ne.

english_verse: You never disappoint us. You suffered as much as we did, and we know that you will be comforted as we were.
translation_verse: Yiti y’anyelasoɛ bɔ yele yɛma ɛmɔ ne gyi berɛ pindinn, ofikyɛ yɛse kyɛ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ ne yɛ nwu amaneɛ ye ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ ne yɛ konya aworakyekyerɛ ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know what a hard time we had in Asia. Our sufferings were so horrible and so unbearable that death seemed certain.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, kyɛbɔ yɛ nwo si hyerele yɛ wɔ Asia nen, yɛmbena kyɛ yɛfa yɛsie ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ yɛ nwo hyerele yɛ paa maa ɔbole yɛ so, na afei yɛ ngoa nwo anyelasoɛ mukoraa tu minini.

english_verse: In fact, we felt sure we were going to die. But this made us stop trusting in ourselves and start trusting God, who raises the dead to life.
translation_verse: Yɛ bɔbɔ ala yɛtele nga wɔ yɛ nu kyɛ yawu yayie, nakoso ɛhe maa yamva yɛ nwo yando yɛ nwo so; na mmom yɛfale yɛ nwo yɛtole Nyameɛ bɔ otingye awufoɛ ne so.

english_verse: God saved us from the threat of death, and we are sure that he will do it again and again.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔyele yɛ fili ewue suronyisuronyi sɔa nu ɔ, na ɔkɔpepɛ kole yɛ; ye yeɛ yafa yɛ wora yawura ye nu ɔ, kyɛ okosa kɔpepɛ kole yɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Please help us by praying for us. Then many people will give thanks for the blessings we receive in answer to all these prayers. Paul's Change of Plans
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔboka yɛ wɔ mbaeɛbɔlɛ nu, amaa mmeni pee bala Nyameɛ ase ama yɛ kyɛ wafa mmeni soma mbaeɛ so wafa sɔ adom ye walo yɛ ɔ. Pɔɔlo anwohoahoa

english_verse: We can be proud of our clear conscience. We have always lived honestly and sincerely, especially when we were with you. And we were guided by God's gift of undeserved grace instead of by the wisdom of this world.
translation_verse: Bɔ yɛfa yɛhoahoa yɛ nwo ɛhe: yɛ tiboa di yɛ adanzeɛ kyɛ yafa nahorɛlilɛ ne nyamesuro yeɛ yabɔ yɛ bra wɔ wiase ɔ, nganga yɛ ne ɛmɔ asetena nu. Yamva ewiase nworɛ so yeɛ yɛbɔle yɛ bra ɔ, na mmom yɛnate Nyameɛ adom so.

english_verse: I am not writing anything you cannot read and understand. I hope you will understand it completely,
translation_verse: Na yɛngyerɛ hwee yɛmmrɛ ɛmɔ sana bɔ ɛmɔkɔhora ye kenga ná ɛmɔkɔte ye bo ɔ. Mede medi kyɛ ɛmɔkɔte ye bo bekoyie bɔkɔɔ,

english_verse: just as you already partly understand us. Then when our Lord Jesus returns, you can be as proud of us as we are of you.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ ɛmɔate yɛ bo bue bue ne, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔafa yɛ bahoahoa ɛmɔ nwo kyɛbɔ yɛ koso yɛkɔfa ɛmɔ yɛkɔhoahoa yɛ nwo wɔ Awurade Yesu kyẽa ne. Pɔɔlo tu ye ateetulɛ hyɛ kyẽa

english_verse: I was so sure of your pride in us that I had planned to visit you first of all. In this way you would have the blessing of two visits from me—
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ m’adwene si pi wɔ ɛhe anwo ne ati, nyɛle m’adwene kyɛ medi moa meba ɛmɔ berɛ, amaa ɛmɔanya saleɛ mmɔhoɛ.

english_verse: once on my way to Macedonia and again on my return from there. Then you could send me on to Judea.
translation_verse: Nyɛle kyɛ sɛ mesẽ mekɔ Makedonia a, ahaa ngɔɔpasa ɛmɔ nwo, yeɛ sɛ mvi dɔ mesa meba koso a, masa maapasa ɛmɔ nwo, ná ɛmɔagua m’ate maa mahɔ Yudea.

english_verse: Do you think I couldn't make up my mind about what to do? Or do I seem like someone who says “Yes” or “No” simply to please others?
translation_verse: Nzusuleɛ he bɔ nyɛle ye, aso okyire kyɛ m’adwene yɛ me ndaa ndaa anaa? Aso meyɛ me nhyehyɛleɛ wɔ anwoɔnaen nu, bɔ mekã “Yoo” a, né mesa mekyire “Daabi” ɔ?

english_verse: God can be trusted, and so can I, when I say our answer to you has always been “Yes” and never “No.”
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ di nahorɛ ngome ye de, yɛnga “Yoo” na yasa yahã “Daabi” yahyire ɛmɔ.

english_verse: This is because Jesus Christ the Son of God is always “Yes” and never “No.” And he is the one Silas, Timothy, and I told you about.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ Awa Yesu Kristo bɔ me ne Silwano ne Timoteo yɛhane ye nwo dwirɛ yɛhyirele ɛmɔ ne, ɔnga “Yoo” na wasa wahã “Daabi”; na mmom mmerɛ biala ɔma ye “Yoo” yɛ yoo.

english_verse: Christ says “Yes” to all God's promises. This is why we have Christ to say “Amen” for us to the glory of God.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ bɔhyɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ye nu amukoraa te “Yoo.” Na ɔnate sɔ ne ati, ye so yeɛ yɛfa yɛkã “Amen” yɛhyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam ɔ.

english_verse: And so God makes it possible for you and us to stand firmly together with Christ. God is also the one who chose us
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ yeɛ wamaa yɛ ne ɛmɔ yatindim wɔ Kristo nu ɔ, watu yɛ wasie berɛ kyɛ yɛyɔ ye adwuma.

english_verse: and put his Spirit in our hearts to show that we belong only to him.
translation_verse: Wafa ye nzɔanoɛ wahyɛ yɛ nzorɛ, na wama ye Sunzum ne atena yɛ nu asi yɛ nzolɛhyɛlɛ ne agyinayɛɛ.

english_verse: God is my witness that I stayed away from Corinth, just to keep from being hard on you.
translation_verse: Na afei mefrɛ Nyameɛ kyɛ oli me adanzeɛ; né membena kyɛ mebɔ ɛmɔ wora ti yeɛ manza mamma Korinto ɔ.

english_verse: We are not bosses who tell you what to believe. We are working with you to make you glad, because your faith is strong.
translation_verse: Nna kyɛ yɛhyɛ ɛmɔ so wɔ ɛmɔ gyidie nwo ɔ, na mmom kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ nye kɔha ti yeɛ yɛ ne ɛmɔ yɔ adwuma yɛbɔ nu ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ gyidie gyi berɛ pindinn.

english_verse: I have decided not to make my next visit with you so painful.
translation_verse: Yiti nyɛle m’adwene kyɛ mengɔfa aworabɔlɛ mengosa mengɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ ko.

english_verse: If I make you feel bad, who would be left to cheer me up, except the people I had made to feel bad?
translation_verse: Na sɛ mema ɛmɔ wora bɔ a, nwa bieku yeɛ ɔkɔma me nye kɔha ɔ? Nna mmenia komapɛ bɔ mama ɛmɔ wora abɔ ye ala ɔ?

english_verse: The reason I want to be happy is to make you happy. I wrote as I did because I didn't want to visit you and be made to feel bad, when you should make me feel happy.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ati yeɛ ɔmaa ngyerɛle ɛmɔ krataa hene ɔ, amaa sɛ meba a, mmenia bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛgyegye me nye ne, bamma me wora ammɔ. Ofikyɛ mede ɛmɔ amukoraa medi kyɛ sɛ me nye gye a, né ebiala nye agye.

english_verse: At the time I wrote, I was suffering terribly. My eyes were full of tears, and my heart was broken. But I didn't want to make you feel bad. I only wanted to let you know how much I cared for you. Forgiveness
translation_verse: Mvale ahometrɛ ne aworabɔlɛ worawora nu, ɔne me nye moenporolɛ pee yeɛ ngyerɛle ɛmɔ ɔ. Manyɛ kyɛ mema ɛmɔ wora bɔ, na mmom né mepena kyɛ ɛmɔnwu kyɛ mekuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ soma. Fa bɔne kyɛ

english_verse: I don't want to be hard on you. But if one of you has made someone feel bad, I am not really the one who has been made to feel bad. Some of you are the ones.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ebie ama aworabɔlɛ bie awa a, nna me ngome yeɛ wama me wora abɔ ɔ; na mmom atee bie aso, sɛ mékã ye kyɛbɔ medwudwolɛ noa ngɔyɛ hye a, ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔboka so.

english_verse: Most of you have already pointed out the wrong that person did, and this is punishment enough for what was done.
translation_verse: Na ɔte paa bɔkɔɔ ma sɔ sona ne kyɛ mmeni soma ahwi ye nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: When people sin, you should forgive and comfort them, so they won't give up in despair.
translation_verse: Yiti ohia kyɛ ɛmɔfa ye nwo bɛkyɛ ye ná ɛmɔkyekye ye wora, amaa aworabɔlɛ ne ammu ye kɔme anu.

english_verse: You should make them sure of your love for them.
translation_verse: Mesrɛ ɛmɔ ala kyɛ ɛmɔhɔ so behuro ye dwirɛ.

english_verse: I also wrote because I wanted to test you and find out if you would follow my instructions.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ati yeɛ ɔmaa ngyerɛle krataa ye ɔ, amaa ɔnate so maso ɛmɔ manea sɛ ɛmɔayɛ sotie wɔ nningyein mukoraa nu a.

english_verse: I will forgive anyone you forgive. Yes, for your sake and with Christ as my witness, I have forgiven whatever needed to be forgiven.
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ ɛmɔkɔfa ye nwo bɛkɔhyɛ ye ne, me koso mefa mekyɛ ye. Na sɛ mafa edwirɛ bie mahyɛ a, sona bɔ mva ngyɛle ye ne, ɔnate ɛmɔ ti yeɛ mafa mahyɛ ye wɔ Kristo nyunu ɔ;

english_verse: I have done this to keep Satan from getting the better of us. We all know what goes on in his mind.
translation_verse: amaa Abɔnzam anni yɛ aminɛ, ofikyɛ yɛse ye atee bɔ ɔnate so ɔ. Pɔɔlo fili Troase

english_verse: When I went to Troas to preach the good news about Christ, I found that the Lord had already prepared the way.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ ngɔle Troase kyɛ mekwaahã Kristo nzɛmba nen, Awurade bukyele atee mane me.

english_verse: But I was worried when I didn't find my friend Titus there. So I left the other followers and went on to Macedonia.
translation_verse: Nakoso wanyɛ me fɛ paa biala, ofikyɛ mannwu nniɛma Tito wɔ berɛ. Yiti ngrale berɛ ama, na nzili nu ngɔle Makedonia. Ngonim wɔ Kristo nu

english_verse: I am grateful that God always makes it possible for Christ to lead us to victory. God also helps us spread the knowledge about Christ everywhere, and this knowledge is like the smell of perfume.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bɔ daa ɔmaa yɛdi ngonim wɔ Kristo nu, ná afei osa fa yɛ so ma ye nwo nimdeɛ woroworo nekaa biala kyɛ ayirefona ne, yɛda ye ase.

english_verse: A lot of people try to get rich from preaching God's message. But we are God's sincere messengers, and by the power of Christ we speak our message with God as our witness.
translation_verse: Yɛ de, yɛtte kyɛ mmeni pee bɔ bɛnate besi Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne aso kongo ne. Na mmom yɛbɔ Kristo nwo dawure nahorɛ nu wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu kyɛ mmenia bɔ Nyameɛ asoma bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Are we once again bragging about ourselves? Do we need letters to you or from you to tell others about us? Some people do need letters telling about them.
translation_verse: Aso yɛsa yɛhyɛ ye bo yɛkamvo yɛ nwo yɛkyire anaa? Anaa ohia kyɛ yɛfa krataa bɔ odi yɛ nwo adanzeɛ yɛbakyire ɛmɔ, anaakyɛ yɛde bie yɛfi ɛmɔ berɛ, kyɛbɔ ebiemɔ de bɛyɔ ne?

english_verse: But you are our letter, and you are in our hearts for everyone to read and understand.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ ole yɛ nwo adanzeɛ krataa bɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ y’ahone nu ɔ, bɔ mmenia mukoraa nwu ye ná bɛkenga ɔ;

english_verse: You are like a letter written by Christ and delivered by us. But you are not written with pen and ink or on tablets made of stone. You are written in our hearts by the Spirit of the living God.
translation_verse: na ɔda ali pefee kyɛ ɛmɔte Kristo krataa bɔ ɔnate yɛ dwumadie so wahyerɛ ɔ. Wamva ayirebire, na mmom ɔfale Nyameɛ teasefoɛ Sunzum yeɛ ɔhyerɛle ɔ. Nna nyɔboɛ poen so, na mmom sona ahone poen so yeɛ ɔhyerɛle ɔ.

english_verse: We are sure about all this. Christ makes us sure in the very presence of God.
translation_verse: Sɔ gyidie ne yeɛ ɔnate Kristo so yanya ye wɔ Nyameɛ nu ɔ;

english_verse: We don't have the right to claim that we have done anything on our own. God gives us what it takes to do all we do.
translation_verse: nna kyɛ yɛfata kyɛ yɛsusu kyɛ yɛ bɔbɔ yɛ mmɔdenbɔlɛ yeɛ yɛfa yɛyɔ nikyee bie ɔ, na mmom yeɛ mmɔdenbɔlɛ ne fi Nyameɛ berɛ.

english_verse: He makes us worthy to be the servants of his new agreement that comes from the Holy Spirit and not from a written Law. After all, the Law brings death, but the Spirit brings life.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ wamaa yafata kyɛ yɛyɛ apam foforɛ ne nwo asomvoɛ ɔ, nna mmeraa bɔ bahyerɛ ɔ nu, na mmom Sunzum nu, ofikyɛ bɔ bahyerɛ ne ma ewue, nakoso Sunzum ne de ɔma ngoa. Apam foforɛ n’animnyam

english_verse: The Law of Moses brought only the promise of death, even though it was carved on stones and given in a wonderful way. Still the Law made Moses' face shine so brightly the people of Israel could not look at it, even though it was a fading glory.
translation_verse: Ewue nwo ɛsom bɔ bɛhyerɛ beguale nyɔboɛ so ne mane animnyam kandinga ma yiti Yisraelfoɛ bangora bannea Mose nyunu ɔnate kyɛ né ɔta hyireinn ne, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ né sɔ animnyam ne okyikyi. Sɛ ye sɔ de a,

english_verse: So won't the agreement the Spirit brings to us be even more wonderful?
translation_verse: ye de ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ Sunzum nu ɛsom ne ngonya animnyam bɔ ɔtra so ɔ?

english_verse: If something that brings the death sentence is glorious, won't something that makes us acceptable to God be even more glorious?
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛsom bɔ obua mmenia foɛ ne le animnyam a, nzaade ɛsom bɔ ɔma mmenia yɛ tenenee n’animnyam kɔbo so koraa!

english_verse: In fact, the new agreement is so wonderful that the Law is no longer glorious at all.
translation_verse: Amba, ɛnea a, bɔ daa né ole animnyam ne, kekesaala de, olle animnyam biala po, ofikyɛ ɛnɛ deɛ n’animnyam tra daa deɛ ne bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: The Law was given with a glory that faded away. But the glory of the new agreement is much greater, because it will never fade away.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bɔ ogu so ɔpɛ nu kɔ ne nyane animnyam a, nzaade bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ n’animnyam bo so koraa.

english_verse: This wonderful hope makes us feel like speaking freely.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ yanya sɔ anyelasoɛ ne ati, yɛkora yɛsi y’ahone yɛdwudwo.

english_verse: We are not like Moses. His face was shining, but he covered it to keep the people of Israel from seeing the brightness fade away.
translation_verse: Yɛ de, yɛtte kyɛ Mose bɔ ɔfale ngatanyunu katale ye nyunu, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná Yisraelfoɛ bangora bangyene bɛ nye bannea ye nyunu animnyam bɔ né okyikyi ne ɔ.

english_verse: The people were stubborn, and something still keeps them from seeing the truth when the Law is read. Only Christ can take away the covering that keeps them from seeing.
translation_verse: Nakoso b’adwene lili naakye, bɔ ɛnɛ ne ɛnɛ ye po sɛ bɛkenga apam daa ne a, ngatanyunu komapɛ ne ala tɛwɔ berɛ bɔ bennya bɛyyele ɔ, ofikyɛ sana Kristo nu angome yeɛ ngatanyunu ne ye fi berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When the Law of Moses is read, they have their minds covered over
translation_verse: Na ɔbaadwu ɛnɛ ye po, sɛ bɛkenga Mose nwomaa ne a, ngatanyunu ne tɛkata bɛ ndeaseɛ so.

english_verse: with a covering that is removed only for those who turn to the Lord.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ sona fa ye nwo bɔ Awurade a, ɔkɔye ngatanyunu ne kɔma ye.

english_verse: The Lord and the Spirit are one and the same, and the Lord's Spirit sets us free.
translation_verse: Afei, Awurade ole Sunzum ne, na nekaa bɔ Awurade Sunzum wɔ ne, fawɔnwodi wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: So our faces are not covered. They show the bright glory of the Lord, as the Lord's Spirit makes us more and more like our glorious Lord.
translation_verse: Baye yɛ mukoraa yɛ nyunu ngatanyunu ne, yiti yɛnwu Awurade animnyam ne kyɛ yɛnea neanu nu ɔ, na Awurade Sunzum ne gu so ɔsesã yɛ maa yɛnya ye sue ne bie yɛfi animnyam nu yahɔ animnyam nu.

english_verse: God has been kind enough to trust us with this work. This is why we never give up.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ti, kyɛ Nyameɛ wanwu yɛ anwumvoin wafa ɛsom he wawura yɛ sa ye, yɛngɔpa aba.

english_verse: We don't do shameful things that must be kept secret. And we don't try to fool anyone or twist God's message around. God is our witness that we speak only the truth, so others will be sure we can be trusted.
translation_verse: Na yagyi nyanzoen bra bɔ bɛbɔ ye mvealeɛ nu ne yagua; yɛmmɔ nnakannaka bra, yeɛ yɛngã Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne yɛngyea ye; na mmom yɛfa nahorɛ ne bɔ yɛye ye ali ne aso maa mmenia de yɛ to nu wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: If there is anything hidden about our message, it is hidden only to someone who is lost.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛ nzɛmba ne aso akata a, so akata ama bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ so bemini ne.

english_verse: The god who rules this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers. They cannot see the light, which is the good news about our glorious Christ, who shows what God is like.
translation_verse: Bɛ yeɛ ewiase wa nyameɛ ama bɛ bɔ benne benni ne, b’adwene ali naakye, amaa Kristo bɔ ole Nyameɛ sue n’animnyam nzɛmba kanea ne, wanda bɛ so.

english_verse: We are not preaching about ourselves. Our message is that Jesus Christ is Lord. He also sent us to be your servants.
translation_verse: Nna yɛ bɔbɔ yɛ nwo dawure yeɛ yɛbɔ ɔ, na mmom Kristo Yesu bɔ ɔte Awurade ne, ye nwo dawure yɛbɔ ɔ, na yɛsa yɛbɔ dawure kyɛ ɔnate Yesu ti yayɛ ɛmɔ ngoaa.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God commanded light to shine in the dark.” Now God is shining in our hearts to let you know that his glory is seen in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔmane kanea fili awosii nu tale ne, wata hyireinn wɔ y’ahone nu, kyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam nwo nimdeɛ kanea bɔ ɔwɔ Yesu Kristo nyunu ne.

english_verse: We are like clay jars in which this treasure is stored. The real power comes from God and not from us.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɔ agyapadeɛ bɔ yanya ye ne wɔ ngukue nu, na ɛhe maa ɔda adi kyɛ sɔ tumi totohyia ne te Nyameɛ deɛ, na nna yɛ deɛ ɔ.

english_verse: We often suffer, but we are never crushed. Even when we don't know what to do, we never give up.
translation_verse: Yɛnwu amaneɛ wɔ nikyee biala nu, nakoso ommu y’abasa nu; yɛ nwo ahyere yɛ, nakoso yɛle anyelasoɛ.

english_verse: In times of trouble, God is with us, and when we are knocked down, we get up again.
translation_verse: Bɛtane yɛ nye, nakoso Nyameɛ de ɔppole yɛ; babɔ yɛ bɛto ase, nakoso bɛsɛkyele yɛ.

english_verse: We face death every day because of Jesus. Our bodies show what his death was like, so his life can also be seen in us.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ yɛte ase ye de, ɔnate Yesu ti daa biala bɛma ewue di yɛ mvanvando, amaa ɔnate so Yesu ngoa ne koso ala ali wɔ yɛ nwonaen bɔ owu ne anu.

english_verse: This means that death is working in us, but life is working in you.
translation_verse: Yiti ewue li yɛ mvanvando, nakoso ɛmɔ de ngoa wɔ ɛmɔ nu.

english_verse: In the Scriptures it says, “I spoke because I had faith.” We have this same kind of faith. So we speak
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ yɛ koso yɛle sɔ gyidie sunzum ne ala bie, kyɛbɔ wahyerɛ kyɛ, “Male mali, yiti madwudwo” ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛ koso yɛde yɛdi, yiti yɛdwudwo ɔ.

english_verse: because we know that God raised the Lord Jesus to life. And just as God raised Jesus, he will also raise us to life. Then he will bring us into his presence together with you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ yɛse kyɛ, bɔ otingyele Awurade Yesu fili ewue nu ne kotingye yɛ kɔboka Yesu so, ná wafa ɛmɔ ne yɛ wahɔ ye nyunu.

english_verse: All of this has been done for you, so more and more people will know how kind God is and will praise and honor him. Faith in the Lord
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ ti yeɛ sɔ nikyee ne wɔ berɛ ɔ, amaa mmeni pee bɔ Nyameɛ adom ɔtrɛ kɔ bɛ berɛ ne, bafa asennaa mmorosoɛ bahyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam. Yɛte ase wɔ gyidie nu

english_verse: We never give up. Our bodies are gradually dying, but we ourselves are being made stronger each day.
translation_verse: Ɔnate ɛhe ati, yɛmma y’abasa nu mmu. Na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ anwoɔnaen he bɔ anyeɛ nwu ye ne gu so ɔsɛkye de, nakoso sunzum nu de, yɛnyi frɔmfrɔm alehyeleɛ biala.

english_verse: These little troubles are getting us ready for an eternal glory that will make all our troubles seem like nothing.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ kekesaala ye amaneɛ kãa bɔ yɛnwu ye ne, osiesie yɛ ma animnyam kandinga bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ, bɔ ɔtra so ɔ.

english_verse: Things that are seen don't last forever, but things that are not seen are eternal. This is why we keep our minds on the things that cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Yiti yɛmva yɛ nye yɛnzie nningyein bɔ anyeɛ nwu ye so, na mmom yɛfa yɛsie bɔ anyeɛ nnwu ye so; ofikyɛ bɔ anyeɛ nwu ye ne ngyɛ ná wapɛ nu, nakoso bɔ anyeɛ nnwu ye ne de ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Our bodies are like tents that we live in here on earth. But when these tents are destroyed, we know that God will give each of us a place to live. These homes will not be buildings someone has made, but they are in heaven and will last forever.
translation_verse: Na yɛse kyɛ sɛ yɛ aseɛ ye aso ɛtena sua ne sɛkye a, yɛkonya awuro bɔ ofi Nyameɛ berɛ, bɔ nna sona yeɛ osili ɔ, bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso afebɔɔ.

english_verse: While we are here on earth, we sigh because we want to live in that heavenly home.
translation_verse: Ɛtena sua he anu de, yɛpene, ofikyɛ yɛpere kyɛ bɛkɔfa nyameɛso awuro ne bekopuro bɔ yɛte nu ne aso.

english_verse: We want to put it on like clothes and not be naked.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛfa nyameɛso deɛ ne yɛpuro so a, yɛ nwo ngɔla so.

english_verse: These tents we now live in are like a heavy burden, and we groan. But we don't do this just because we want to leave these bodies that will die. It is because we want to change them for bodies that will never die.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ yɛwɔ ɛtena sua he anu ye de, yɛpene. Nna kyɛ ebiaa yɛpena kyɛ bepuro befi yɛ nwo ɔ, na mmom yɛpena kyɛ bɛfa nyameɛso deɛ ne bepuro so, amaa ngoa abungam bɔ owu so bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: God is the one who makes all this possible. He has given us his Spirit to make us certain he will do it.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ yeɛ wasiesie yɛ wama sɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ye ɔ, na wafa ye Sunzum ne wasi ye agyinayɛɛ.

english_verse: So always be cheerful! As long as we are in these bodies, we are away from the Lord.
translation_verse: Yiti mmerɛ biala yɛle anyelasoɛ. Na yɛse kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ yɛwɔ awuro wɔ anwoɔnaen he anu ye de, yɛ ne Awurade afia atee wale;

english_verse: But we live by faith, not by what we see.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ gyidie yeɛ yɛfa yɛnate ɔ, nna bɔ anyeɛ nwu ye ɔ.

english_verse: We should be cheerful, because we would rather leave these bodies and be at home with the Lord.
translation_verse: Yɛle anyelasoɛ, na yɛkuro kyɛ yɛfi sɔ anwoɔnaen he anu ná yɛne Awurade yaatena.

english_verse: But whether we are at home with the Lord or away from him, we still try our best to please him.
translation_verse: Yiti yafa yasie yɛ nye so kyɛ, sɛ yɛwɔ anwoɔnaen he anu oo, sɛ yɛnne nu oo, yɛkɔsɔ Awurade nye.

english_verse: After all, Christ will judge each of us for the good or the bad that we do while living in these bodies. Bringing People to God
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, odi kyɛ yɛ mukoraa yɛkogyina Kristo ndɛenbualɛ bia ne nyunu. Na bɔ sona biala wayɔ ye wɔ sɔ anwoɔnaen he anu ne, kyɛ paa oo, anaa bɔne oo, okonya ye nwo akatuaa. Yesu ahã yɛ ne Nyameɛ abɔ nu

english_verse: We know what it means to respect the Lord, and we encourage everyone to turn to him. God himself knows what we are like, and I hope you also know what kind of people we are.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ yɛse kyɛbɔ Awurade nwo suronyi si te ɔ ne ati, yɛbɔ mmɔden kyɛ yɛkɔma mmenia kosuro ye ɔ. Nyameɛ se kyɛbɔ yɛsi yɛte ɔ, na mede medi kyɛ ɛmɔ tiboa koso ma ɛmɔse kyɛbɔ yɛsi yɛte ɔ.

english_verse: We are not trying once more to brag about ourselves. But we want you to be proud of us, when you are with those who are not sincere and brag about what others think of them.
translation_verse: Yɛngamvo yɛ nwo ngyire ɛmɔ ko, na mmom yɛma ɛmɔnya atee ɛmɔfa yɛ bɛhoahoa ɛmɔ anwo, amaa ɛmɔanya nyeanoɛ bama mmenia bɔ bɛmva bɔ ɔwɔ ahone nu, na mmom bɛfa bɛ nye so nikyee bɛhoahoa bɛ nwo ne.

english_verse: If we seem out of our minds, it is between God and us. But if we are in our right minds, it is for your good.
translation_verse: Sɛ y’adwene asɛkye a, wasɛkye wama Nyameɛ; yeɛ sɛ y’adwene nu la berɛ a, ɔla ma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: We are ruled by Christ's love for us. We are certain that if one person died for everyone else, then all of us have died.
translation_verse: Na Kristo dɔ ne di yɛ so, ofikyɛ yɛde yɛto nu kyɛ sɛ sona ko wu mane mmenia mukoraa a, nzaade mmenia mukoraa bawu.

english_verse: And Christ did die for all of us. He died so we would no longer live for ourselves, but for the one who died and was raised to life for us.
translation_verse: Owu mane mmenia mukoraa, amaa bɛ bɔ bɛte ase ne bandena bamma bɛ nwo ko, na mmom batena bama bɔ bɛ ti owuli ná otingyele ne. Abɔdeɛ foforɛ

english_verse: We are careful not to judge people by what they seem to be, though we once judged Christ in this way.
translation_verse: Yiti ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, yɛmva dasaniɛ adwene yɛnzusu kyɛbɔ sona si te ɔ, na sɛ sɔ yeɛ daa ne yɛfa yɛsusuli Yesu a, ɛnɛ de yɛnyɔ ye sɔ ko.

english_verse: Anyone who belongs to Christ is a new person. The past is forgotten, and everything is new.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ ebie fa ye nwo bɔ Kristo a, né wayɛ abɔdeɛ foforɛ, nningyein daa ne apɛ nu; amba nningyein mukoraa ayɛ foforɛ.

english_verse: God has done it all! He sent Christ to make peace between himself and us, and he has given us the work of making peace between himself and others.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ yeɛ wayɔ ɛhe amukoraa ɔ. Ɔnate Yesu Kristo so wafa yɛ wabata ye nwo, na wafa ngabonu he nwo dwumadie wawura yɛ sa:

english_verse: What we mean is that God was in Christ, offering peace and forgiveness to the people of this world. And he has given us the work of sharing his message about peace.
translation_verse: kyɛ, Nyameɛ nate Kristo so wahwe ewiase wabata ye nwo, wammu bɛ bɔne nwo ngondaa wandia bɛ, na wafa ngabonu he nwo dawurebɔlɛ wawura yɛ sa.

english_verse: We were sent to speak for Christ, and God is begging you to listen to our message. We speak for Christ and sincerely ask you to make peace with God.
translation_verse: Yiti yɛte ɛbɔfoɛ ma Kristo bɔ Nyameɛ fa yɛ so tu foɛ ɔ; na yɛgyi Kristo gya nu yɛsrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nwo ate ma Nyameɛ fa ɛmɔ bata ye nwo.

english_verse: Christ never sinned! But God treated him as a sinner, so Christ could make us acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔ wanyɔ bɔne ne, Nyameɛ maa fale ye kakyili bɔne mane yɛ, amaa ɔnate ye so yanya Nyameɛ tenenee ne bie.

english_verse: We work together with God, and we beg you to make good use of God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Yɛte bokafoɛ wɔ Nyameɛ adwuma nu, yiti yɛsrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ, nnɛmɔma Nyameɛ adom bɔ ɛmɔanya ye ne yɛ mbaen.

english_verse: In the Scriptures God says, “When the time came, I listened to you, and when you needed help, I came to save you.” That time has come. This is the day for you to be saved.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ ɔnwa: “Mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu ndiele wɔ, na mmokale wɔ wɔ ngoalelɛ kyẽa ne. Menwa ɛnɛ te adom mmerɛ, ɛnɛ te ngoalelɛ kyẽa.” Asomafoɛ amaneɛnwunɛ

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with our work, and so we try hard not to cause problems.
translation_verse: Yɛndo ebiala sundidua, ná ebiala angã yɛ som ne nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ.

english_verse: But in everything and in every way we show we truly are God's servants. We have always been patient, though we have had a lot of trouble, suffering, and hard times.
translation_verse: Na mmom yɛye yɛ nwo ali yekyire kyɛ yɛte Nyameɛ asomvoɛ wɔ atee biala so: wɔ aboterɛ pee nu, amaneɛ nu, anwokyere nu, ateetee nu;

english_verse: We have been beaten, put in jail, and hurt in riots. We have worked hard and have gone without sleep or food.
translation_verse: ɛbolɛ nu, kuku nu nnaa nu, basabasayɛlɛ nu, ɛfɛɛ nu, ɛpɛsilɛ nu, ɛhɔen hunɛ nu;

english_verse: But we have kept ourselves pure and have been understanding, patient, and kind. The Holy Spirit has been with us, and our love has been real.
translation_verse: anwotelɛ bra nu, nimdeɛ nu, animia nu, paayɛlɛ nu, Sunzum Krongron nu, ɔdɔ kaenn nu,

english_verse: We have spoken the truth, and God's power has worked in us. In all our struggles we have said and done only what is right.
translation_verse: nahorɛ dwirɛ hanɛ nu, Nyameɛ tumi nu, yeɛ tenenee akodeɛ wɔ yɛ bɛen ne famaa so.

english_verse: Whether we were honored or dishonored or praised or cursed, we always told the truth about ourselves. But some people said we did not.
translation_verse: Bedi yɛ ni ná basa bagua yɛ nyunu ase, bɛkã yɛ nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ ná basa baye yɛ ayɛ; yɛkã nahorɛ nakoso bɛnwa yɛte nnakannaka,

english_verse: We are unknown to others, but well known to you. We seem to be dying, and yet we are still alive. We have been punished, but never killed,
translation_verse: bayɛ kyɛ bɛnze yɛ nakoso bɛse yɛ paa, yayɛ kyɛ yawu nakoso amba, yɛte ase, bɛhyɛ yɛ anyeborolɛ, nakoso behhuni yɛ;

english_verse: and we are always happy, even in times of suffering. Although we are poor, we have made many people rich. And though we own nothing, everything is ours.
translation_verse: yayɛ kyɛ yɛ wora abɔ nakoso yɛ nye gye daa, yayɛ kyɛ ehiafoɛ nakoso yɛma mmeni pee benya bɛ nwo, yayɛ kyɛ yɛlle huu nakoso yɛle nningyein mukoraa.

english_verse: Friends in Corinth, we are telling the truth when we say there is room in our hearts for you.
translation_verse: O Korintofoɛ, yapakyepakye nu yadwudwo yahyire ɛmɔ, yaye y’ahone nu dwirɛ mukoraa yahyire ɛmɔ.

english_verse: We are not holding back on our love for you, but you are holding back on your love for us.
translation_verse: Yahyire kyɛ ɛmɔbata y’ahone nwo, nakoso ɛmɔ de ɛmɔngyire kyɛ yɛbata ɛmɔ ahone nwo.

english_verse: I speak to you as I would speak to my own children. Please make room in your hearts for us. The Temple of the Living God
translation_verse: Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ wora ɛmɔmaa yɛnwu ye kyɛ yɛ koso yɛbata ɛmɔ ahone nwo. Ɛhe de medwudwo mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ me mma oo. Yɛte Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua

english_verse: Stay away from people who are not followers of the Lord! Can someone who is good get along with someone who is evil? Are light and darkness the same?
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɛ nwo bɛbɔ mmenia bɔ benne benni ɔ, ofikyɛ abiɛngoɛfalɛ beni yeɛ ɔla tenenee ne amumuyɛɛ b’afia ɔ? Anaakyɛ abiɛngoɛfalɛ beni yeɛ ɔla kanea ne awosii b’afia ɔ?

english_verse: Is Christ a friend of Satan? Can people who follow the Lord have anything in common with those who don't?
translation_verse: Koyɛlɛ beni yeɛ ɔwɔ Kristo ne Belia b’afia ɔ? Anaakyɛ abiɛngoɛfalɛ beni yeɛ ɔla gyidiniɛ ne sona bɔ onne nni b’afia ɔ?

english_verse: Do idols belong in the temple of God? We are the temple of the living God, as God himself says, “I will live with these people and walk among them. I will be their God, and they will be my people.”
translation_verse: Nzikyɛ ngitahoɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne mmosoen b’afia ɔ? Ofikyɛ yɛte Nyameɛ teasefoɛ n’asɔneyɛɛ sua, na Nyameɛ waha ne, “Me ne bɛ kɔtena, na me ne bɛ yanate, Ngɔyɛ bɛ Nyameɛ, na bɛ wora bayɛ me maen.”

english_verse: The Lord also says, “Leave them and stay away! Don't touch anything that isn't clean. Then I will welcome you
translation_verse: Yiti Awurade nwa nyoo: “Ɛ́mɔfi bɛ nu befite, ná ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo béfi bɛ nwo; nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bɛkã nikyee bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ, na ngole ɛmɔ.

english_verse: and be your Father. You will be my sons and my daughters, as surely as I am God, the All-Powerful.”
translation_verse: Ngɔyɛ ɛmɔ Baba na ɛmɔ wora ɛmɔayɛ me mma mmienzua ne mmrasua. Bɔ Tuminiɛ Awurade kã hɔ ɛne.”

english_verse: My friends, God has made us these promises. So we should stay away from everything that keeps our bodies and spirits from being clean. We should honor God and try to be completely like him. The Church Makes Paul Happy
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɔnate kyɛ yanya bɔhyɛ hemɔ ne ati, ɛ́mɔma yɛte yɛ nwo yɛfi nikyee biala bɔ ogua anwoɔnaen ne sunzum nwo fiɛ nwo, ná yɛfa Nyameɛ surolɛ nu yɛma yɛ bra yɛ krongron. Pɔɔlo wora kyekye

english_verse: Make a place for us in your hearts! We haven't mistreated or hurt anyone. We haven't cheated anyone.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔfa yɛ bɛbata ɛmɔ ahone nwo; yɛyyɛle ebiala tɛɛ, yɛssɛkyele ebiala, yeɛ yɛllili ebiala aminɛ.

english_verse: I am not saying this to be hard on you. But, as I have said before, you will always be in our thoughts, whether we live or die.
translation_verse: Menga he memmua ɛmɔ foɛ, ofikyɛ mali moa mahã kyɛ ɛmɔbata y’ahone nwo, bɔ sɛ ewue nu oo, ngoa nu oo, yɛne ɛmɔ ala.

english_verse: I trust you completely. I am always proud of you, and I am greatly encouraged. In all my trouble I am still very happy.
translation_verse: Mede ɛmɔ medi paa, na mefa ɛmɔ mehoahoa me nwo koso paa. Me wora akyekye paa, na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ yɛfa amaneɛ nu de, nakoso m’anika abu afa so koraa.

english_verse: After we came to Macedonia, we didn't have any chance to rest. We were faced with all kinds of problems. We were troubled by enemies and troubled by fears.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ yɛhɔle Makedonia nen, yɛfɛle yɛ nwonaen nu paa, na ɛhawo wale yɛ so wɔ nekaa biala: ngondii pɛle yɛ nwo yiale, na yɛ bɔbɔ yɛ nu koso ɛserɛ hane yɛ.

english_verse: But God cheers up people in need, and this is what he did when he sent Titus to us.
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ bɔ ɔkyekye bɛ bɔ bɛ wora abɔ wora ne, ɔfale Tito walɛ ne aso kyekyele yɛ wora.

english_verse: Of course, we were glad to see Titus, but what really made us glad is the way you cheered him up. He told how sorry you were and how concerned you were about me. And this made me even happier.
translation_verse: Nna ye walɛ ne angome, na mmom aworakyekyerɛ bɔ onya fili ɛmɔ berɛ ne koso boka so. Ofikyɛ ɔbɔle yɛ amaneɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ wora dɔ me, aworabɔlɛ aha ɛmɔ, na ɛmɔgyi me si, na ɛhe maa nyane anika mmorosoɛ.

english_verse: I don't feel bad anymore, even though my letter hurt your feelings. I did feel bad at first, but I don't now. I know that the letter hurt you for a while.
translation_verse: Sɛ mvale me krataa ne mmamɔle ɛmɔ wora po a, nnuni me nwo, nakoso kekesaala ye de nnnuni me nwo. Ofikyɛ manwu kyɛ sɔ krataa ne mane ɛmɔ wora bɔle wɔ mmerɛ kãa bie ala.

english_verse: Now I am happy, but not because I hurt your feelings. It is because God used your hurt feelings to make you turn back to him, and none of you were harmed by us.
translation_verse: Na kekesaala ye de me nye ahã, nna kyɛ ɛmɔ wora bɔ ɔbɔle ne ati ɔ, na mmom ɛmɔ aworabɔlɛ ne maa ɛmɔnyane adwenesakyera. Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ fale ɛmɔ aworabɔlɛ ne aso lili dwumaa, yiti yanyɛ ɛmɔ tɛɛ biala.

english_verse: When God makes you feel sorry enough to turn to him and be saved, you don't have anything to feel bad about. But when this world makes you feel sorry, it can cause your death.
translation_verse: Aworabɔlɛ bɔ ɔnate Nyameɛ surolɛ so ba ne ma adwenesakyera bɔ ɔfa sona kɔ ngoalelɛ nu ɔ, na ɔmma sona nnu ye nwo. Nakoso ewiase aworabɔlɛ de ɔfa sona kɔ ewue nu.

english_verse: Just look what God has done by making you feel sorry! You sincerely want to prove you are innocent. You are angry. You are shocked. You are eager to see that justice is done. You have proved that you were completely right in this matter.
translation_verse: Na sɔ aworabɔlɛ he bɔ ɔnate Nyameɛ surolɛ so wawa ye, ɛmɔnea dwumadie paa bɔ wali wɔ ɛmɔ nu ɔ: bɛ noa yelɛ nu, ahinzɛm nu, ɛserɛ nu, me nwo aworadɔlɛ, ɛmɔ mmɔdenbɔlɛ nu, ɔne wereɛtɔlɛ nu. Na atee biala so ɛmɔahyire kyɛ ɛmɔnni fɔ wɔ ɛhemɔ nwo.

english_verse: When I wrote you, it wasn't to accuse the one who was wrong or to take up for the one who was hurt. I wrote, so God would show you how much you do care for us.
translation_verse: Nna bɔ wayɔ ebie tɛɛ, anaa bɔ ebie ayɔ ye tɛɛ ti yeɛ ngyerɛle krataa ne mmrɛle ɛmɔ ɔ; na mmom ngyerɛ mmrɛle ɛmɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná mmɔden bɔ ɛmɔbɔ wɔ yɛ nwo ne ala ali ama ɛmɔ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: And we were greatly encouraged. Although we were encouraged, we felt even better when we saw how happy Titus was, because you had shown he had nothing to worry about.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, yɛ wora akyekye. Nna yɛ wora ngome yeɛ wakyekye ɔ, na Tito anika ne koso ama yɛ anika mmorosoɛ; ofikyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛbokale maa onyane aworakyekyerɛ.

english_verse: We had told him how much we thought of you, and you did not disappoint us. Just as we have always told you the truth, so everything we told him about you has also proved to be true.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mvale ɛmɔ nhoahoale me nwo ngyirele ye a, ɛmɔamma me nyunu angua ase. Na kyɛbɔ edwirɛ biala bɔ yɛhã yɛhyirele ɛmɔ te nahorɛ nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ nwo bɔ yɛhoahoale yɛhyirele Tito ne koso ayɛ nahorɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Titus loves all of you very much, especially when he remembers how you obeyed him and how you trembled with fear when you welcomed him.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Tito kaye kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔyɛle sotie bɛmane ye, ɔne kyɛbɔ ɛmɔsi bɛfale esuronyi ne anwopopolɛ belele ye nyemene so ne a, né okuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ soma.

english_verse: It makes me really glad to know I can depend on you.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔyɛ me fɛ kyɛ manya gyidie wɔ ɛmɔ nu wɔ nikyee biala nu ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, we want you to know that the churches in Macedonia have shown others God's gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛpena kyɛ ɛmɔnwu adom bɔ Nyameɛ afa alo Makedonia asɔre nemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Although they were going through hard times and were very poor, they were glad to give generously.
translation_verse: B’anwokyere ne nzɔhwɛ kandinga ne asi, benyane anika mmorosoɛ wɔ bɛ hiaa ne anu maa bɛyele bɛ kunu bɛyɔle adɔeɛ kandinga paa.

english_verse: They gave as much as they could afford and even more, simply because they wanted to.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛyele bɛ kunu bɛyɔle adɔeɛ kyɛbɔ bɛkɔhora ɔ, na medi bɛ nwo adanzeɛ kyɛ bɛmane bɔ ɔbo b’anwoserɛ so po.

english_verse: They even asked and begged us to let them have the joy of giving their money for God's people.
translation_verse: Na bɛkoto bɛsrɛle yɛ pee kyɛ yɛle b’akyɛdeɛ ne, ná yɛma bɛ koso bɛɛboka anwoteefoɛ nemɔ bie.

english_verse: And they did more than we had hoped. They gave themselves first to the Lord and then to us, just as God wanted them to do.
translation_verse: Nna bɔ yɛsusuli ne ngome po yeɛ bɛyɔle ɔ, na mmom ɔnate Nyameɛ pɛ so belili moa bɛfale bɛ nwo bɛmane Awurade, na afei bɛyɔle sɔ bɛmane yɛ koso.

english_verse: Titus was the one who got you started doing this good thing, so we begged him to help you finish what you had begun.
translation_verse: Na yasrɛ Tito bɔ olili moa hyɛle adwuma ne abo ne kyɛ ɔɔtoa so ná oyie sɔ adom adwuma ne wɔ ɛmɔ nu.

english_verse: You do everything better than anyone else. You have stronger faith. You speak better and know more. You are eager to give, and you love us better. Now you must give more generously than anyone else.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ ɛmɔbɔ mmɔden mmorosoɛ wɔ nikyee biala nu: gyidie nu, edwudwolɛ nu, nimdeɛ nu, mmɔdenbɔlɛ nu, ɔne kyɛbɔ ɛmɔsi bekuro yɛ dwirɛ ɔ nu ne, ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ sɔ adɔeɛ adom he koso ɛmɔkɔfa bɛkɔyɔ adwuma mmorosoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I am not ordering you to do this. I am simply testing how real your love is by comparing it with the concern that others have shown.
translation_verse: Mendwudwo nhyɛsoɛ so, na mmom mefa ebiemɔ mmɔdenbɔlɛ metoto ɔdɔ bɔ ɛmɔle ye ne anwo menea kyɛ sɛ ɔte kaenn a.

english_verse: You know our Lord Jesus Christ treated us with undeserved grace by giving up all his riches, so you could become rich.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔse kyɛbɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne si te ɔ: né wanya ye nwo, nakoso ɔnate ɛmɔ ti ɔyɛle hianiɛ, amaa ɛmɔafa ye hiaa ne aso banya bɛ nwo.

english_verse: A year ago you were the first ones to give, and you gave because you wanted to. So listen to my advice.
translation_verse: Nzusuleɛ bɔ meyɔ ɛhe, na ɔte paa ma ɛmɔ. Ɛmɔ yeɛ afoɛ hene ɛmɔlili moa benyane adwene kyɛ ɛmɔkɔboka ɔ, na ɛmɔ koso ala yeɛ ɛmɔlili moa bɛkekane bɛ sa ase ɔ.

english_verse: I think you should finish what you started. If you give according to what you have, you will prove you are as eager to give as you were to think about giving.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛmɔbɔ mmɔden beyie sɔ adɔeɛ adwuma ne bɛfa bɛfoa adwene bɔ ɛmɔnyane ye ne aso, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ anwoserɛ kohyire ɔ.

english_verse: It doesn't matter how much you have. What matters is how much you are willing to give from what you have.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔaye bɛ kunu kyɛ ɛmɔkɔboka a, nikyee bɔ sona le ye fa ma ne yeɛ ɔsɔ anyeɛ ɔ, na nna nikyee bɔ olle bie ne ɔ.

english_verse: I am not trying to make life easier for others by making life harder for you. But it is only fair
translation_verse: Yɛngyire kyɛ ɛ́mɔma ebiemɔ nwo tɔ bɛ ná ɛmɔ de ɛmɔ nwo hyere ɛmɔ,

english_verse: for you to share with them when you have so much, and they have so little. Later, when they have more than enough, and you are in need, they can share with you. Then everyone will have a fair share,
translation_verse: na mmom kyɛ mmokalɛ ne kɔyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ yeɛ yɛpena ɔ. Na kekesaala ye bɔ ɛmɔ sa nu le bie ye, ɔte paa kyɛ ɛmɔkɔye bɛ kofi anwokyere nu, amaa sɛ ɛmɔ wora ɛmɔ nwo kyere ɛmɔ ná bele bie a, bɛ koso baboka ɛmɔ, amaa mmokalɛ ne ayɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

english_verse: just as the Scriptures say, “Those who gathered too much had nothing left. Those who gathered only a little had all they needed.” Titus and His Friends
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Bɔ ɔboaboale pee noa ne annya ye ma wammo so, yeɛ bɔ ɔboaboale kãa bie noa ne koso anhia nikye fee.” Pɔɔlo soma Tito wɔ Korinto

english_verse: I am grateful that God made Titus care as much about you as we do.
translation_verse: Yɛda Nyameɛ ase kyɛ wafa ɛmɔ nwo mmɔden bɔ yɛbɔ ne ala wawura Tito ahone nu ɔ.

english_verse: When we begged Titus to visit you, he said he would. He wanted to because he cared so much for you.
translation_verse: Nna yɛ nikyeesrɛlɛ ne ngome yeɛ wasɔ nu ɔ, na mmom ɔnate ye mmɔdenbɔlɛ ti ɔfa ye bɔbɔ ye pɛ ɔ́ba ɛmɔ berɛ.

english_verse: With Titus we are also sending one of the Lord's followers who is well known in every church for spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Na yɛ́soma ye ne aliɛmaa bɔ ɔnate nzɛmbahanɛ mmɔdenbɔlɛ ti bɛkamvo ye wɔ asɔre ne amukoraa nu ne.

english_verse: The churches chose this follower to travel with us while we carry this gift that will bring praise to the Lord and show how much we hope to help.
translation_verse: Asa koso, asɔre mma ne aneanea nu baye ye kyɛ ɔne yɛ nate wɔ sɔ adom adwuma bɔ yafa yato yɛ nwo so ne anu, na yɛyɔ sɔ yɛfa yɛhyɛ Awurade animnyam, ná yɛsa yɛkyire yɛ mmɔdenbɔlɛ.

english_verse: We don't want anyone to find fault with the way we handle your generous gift.
translation_verse: Yɛmbena kyɛ ebiala nya yɛ nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ kã fa sɔ adɔeɛ nningyein bɔ yɛnea so ye nwo.

english_verse: But we want to do what pleases the Lord and what people think is right.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ yafa yasie yɛ nye so kyɛ yɛtoto nikyee biala pɛpɛɛpɛ, nna Awurade ngome nyunu, na kuro sona koso nyunu.

english_verse: We are also sending someone else with Titus and the other follower. We approve of this man. In fact, he has already shown us many times that he wants to help. And now he wants to help even more than ever, because he trusts you so much.
translation_verse: Na yɛ́soma y’eliɛma bɔ yanwu ye atee pee so kyɛ ɔbɔ mmɔden wɔ nningyein pee nu ne maa ɔboka bɛ so. Na kekesaala ye de po, okuro kyɛ ɔboka paa, ofikyɛ wanya gyidie piri paa wɔ ɛmɔ nu.

english_verse: Titus is my partner, who works with me to serve you. The other two followers are sent by the churches, and they bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: Tito de, ɔte mmiɛngo ne nniɛma adwumayɔlɛniɛ ma ɛmɔ, na aliɛmaa nemɔ wora bɛte asɔre nemɔ somafoɛ, bɛte Kristo animnyam.

english_verse: Treat them in such a way that the churches will see your love and will know why we bragged about you.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔye ɔdɔ ali behyire bɛ, na ɛ́mɔma ɔyɛ adanzeɛ wɔ asɔre nemɔ nyunu kyɛ m’anwohoahoa wɔ ɛmɔ nwo ne te nahorɛ.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the money you plan to give for God's people.
translation_verse: Onhia po kyɛ mekyerɛ mmokalɛ bɔ yɛkwaafa yɛboka anwoteefoɛ ne nwo krataa mebrɛ ɛmɔ.

english_verse: I know how eager you are to give. And I have proudly told the Lord's followers in Macedonia that you people in Achaia have been ready for a whole year. Now your desire to give has made them want to give.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, mese kyɛ ɛmɔkuro kyɛ ɛmɔkɔboka, na mefa ɛmɔ mehoahoa me nwo mekyire Makedoniafoɛ kyɛ, ofi afoɛ hene yeɛ ɛmɔ, Akaiafoɛ, ɛmɔaboaboa bɛ nwo kyɛ ɛmɔkɔboka ɔ, na ɛmɔ mmɔdenbɔlɛ ne akanyane mmeni pee.

english_verse: This is why I am sending Titus and the two others to you. I want you to be ready, just as I promised. This will prove we were not wrong to brag about you.
translation_verse: Nakoso mesoma aliɛmaa hemɔ amaa ɛmɔaboaboa ɛmɔ nwo ná y’anwohoahoa wɔ ɛmɔ nwo ne anyɛ mbaen; na kyɛbɔ ngane ne, mese kyɛ ɛmɔaboaboa ɛmɔ nwo.

english_verse: Some followers from Macedonia may come with me, and I want them to find that you have the money ready. If you don't, I would be embarrassed for trusting you to do this. But you would be embarrassed even more.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Makedoniafoɛ ne me ba ná benwu kyɛ ɛmɔyyɔle ye nwo hwee a, yɛ nyunu kogua ase wɔ sɔ anwohoahoa ye nwo, na ɛmɔ deɛ de bɛnga ye ko.

english_verse: So I have decided to ask Titus and the others to spend some time with you before I arrive. This way they can arrange to collect the money you have promised. Then you will have the chance to give because you want to, and not because you feel forced to.
translation_verse: Yiti madwene ye nwo kyɛ, ohia kyɛ mesrɛ aliɛmaa hemɔ maa bedi yɛ nyunu moa bɛbapasa ɛmɔ nwo, na bɛboaboa akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɛmɔahyɛ ye nwo bɔ ne noa; amaa wanyɛ kyɛ nhyɛsoɛ akyɛdeɛ, na mmom wafi ɛmɔ ahone nu. Akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ

english_verse: Remember this saying, “A few seeds make a small harvest, but a lot of seeds make a big harvest.”
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ, bɔ odua mmakaammaa kãa bie ne, okobu kãa bie; na bɔ odua pee ne, okobu pee.

english_verse: Each of you must make up your own mind about how much to give. But don't feel sorry that you must give and don't feel you are forced to give. God loves people who love to give.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ ebiala asusu ye nwo wɔ ye adwene nu ne, maa ɔfa sɔ ma, na wanyɛ kyɛ ɔtwetwe ye gya ase anaakyɛ ɔyɛ ye nhyɛsoɛ nu; ofikyɛ bɔ ɔye ye kunu fitaa fa nikyee kyɛ ne yeɛ Nyameɛ kuro ye dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: God can bless you with everything you need, and you will always have more than enough to do all kinds of good things for others.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ kora ma ɛmɔnya saleɛ amukoraa mmorosoɛ, amaa mmerɛ biala ɛmɔ sa ahã nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔhia ɔ, na ɛmɔkonya ye mmorosoɛ na ɛmɔafa bie baboka adwuma paa.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “God freely gives his gifts to the poor, and always does right.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Ɔye ye kunu fa nningyein kyekyɛ paa, ɔkyɛ ehiafoɛ nikye, ye tenenee wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.”

english_verse: God gives seed to farmers and provides everyone with food. He will increase what you have, so you can give even more to those in need.
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ bɔ ɔma kuaniɛ bakaammaa maa odua ná ɔma ye aleɛ maa odi ne, ɔkɔma ɛmɔ mmakaammaa mmorosoɛ ná wama ɛmɔ adɔeɛ ne asu mmaa pee.

english_verse: You will be blessed in every way, and you will be able to keep on being generous. Then many people will thank God when we deliver your gift.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔkonya ɛmɔ nwo wɔ nikyee biala nu ná ɛmɔafa bie bayɔ adɔeɛ, na ɔnate yɛ so mmenia kɔla Nyameɛ ase wɔ ɛmɔ adɔeɛ ne nwo.

english_verse: What you are doing is much more than a service that supplies God's people with what they need. It is something that will make many others thank God.
translation_verse: Nna bɔ anwoteefoɛ ne hia ngome yeɛ ɛmɔ mmokalɛ ne ma bɛ sa kã ɔ, na mmom ɔmaa bɛfa asennaa pee koso bɛma Nyameɛ.

english_verse: The way in which you have proved yourselves by this service will bring honor and praise to God. You believed the message about Christ, and you obeyed it by sharing generously with God's people and with everyone else.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmokalɛ he di ɛmɔ nwo adanzeɛ, na ɔkɔmaa bɛkɔhyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam wɔ ɛmɔ sotie wɔ Kristo nzɛmba ne nwo, ɔne mmokalɛ bɔ ɛmɔfa boka bɛ ne mmenia mukoraa nwo,

english_verse: Now they are praying for you and want to see you, because God used you to bless them so very much.
translation_verse: na bɛkɔbɔ mbaeɛ bɛkɔma ɛmɔ ná bɛ wora adɔ ɛmɔ, ɔnate Nyameɛ adom mmorosoɛ bɔ ɛmɔanya ne ati.

english_verse: Thank God for his gift that is too wonderful for words!
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma yɛla Nyameɛ ase wɔ ye akyɛdeɛ bɔ olle kabea ne anwo.

english_verse: Do you think I am a coward when I am with you and brave when I am far away? Well, I ask you to listen, because Christ himself was humble and gentle.
translation_verse: Me, Pɔɔlo, mefa Kristo anwobrɛaseɛ ne ye dwolɛ bɔ odwo ne aso metu ɛmɔ foɛ; me bɔ me nye bɔ ɛmɔ nyunu a meyɛ me nwo anwumvoin anwumvoin, nakoso mefi ɛmɔ berɛ a mema m’ahone yɛ se wɔ ɛmɔ so ne.

english_verse: Some people have said we act like the people of this world. So when I arrive, I expect I will have to be firm and forceful in what I say to them. Please don't make me treat you that way.
translation_verse: Mesrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ sɛ meba ɛmɔ berɛ a, nnɛmɔyɛ maa meye m’ahoneserɛ ne ali; ofikyɛ mede medi kyɛ mekora mefa m’ahoneserɛ ne mekɔ mmenia biemɔ bɔ bebu yɛ kyɛ yɛnate anwoɔnaen nu atee so ne, bɛ so.

english_verse: We live in this world, but we don't act like its people
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔwɔ nu kyɛ yɛbɔ yɛ bra wɔ anwoɔnaen nu de, nakoso yɛngo anwoɔnaen nu koɛ.

english_verse: or fight our battles with the weapons of this world. Instead, we use God's power that can destroy fortresses. We destroy arguments
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ y’akodeɛ bɔ yɛfa yɛko ne ɔtte anwoɔnaen nu akodeɛ, na mmom ɔte Nyameɛ tumi akodeɛ bɔ yɛfa yɛdwiri anwoserɛ afealeɛ mɔ yɛgua ɔ.

english_verse: and every bit of pride that keeps anyone from knowing God. We capture people's thoughts and make them obey Christ.
translation_verse: Yɛfa yɛdi ngonim wɔ aporowaasulɛ nu ne nikyee biala bɔ ɔma ye nwo so tia Nyameɛ nwo nimdeɛ so, na yɛkakyi sona biala adwene maa ɔyɛ sotie ma Kristo.

english_verse: And when you completely obey him, we will punish anyone who refuses to obey.
translation_verse: Na yasiesie yɛ nwo kyɛ sɛ ɛmɔ sotieyɛlɛ di mu bɔkɔɔ a, yɛkotua asoserɛ biala so kerɛ.

english_verse: You judge by appearances. If any of you think you are the only ones who belong to Christ, then think again. We belong to Christ as much as you do.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma yɛnea bɔ yɛ nye tua ɔ: sɛ ebie bu ye nwo kyɛ ɔte Kristo deɛ a, maa ɔdwene ye nwo bieku kyɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔte Kristo deɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛ wora yɛte Kristo deɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Maybe I brag a little too much about the authority that the Lord gave me to help you and not to hurt you. Yet I am not embarrassed to brag.
translation_verse: Awurade tumi bɔ ɔfa mane yɛ kyɛ yɛma ɛmɔnya ngɔsoɛ, na nna kyɛ yɛsɛkye ɛmɔ ne, sɛ mefa yɛ tumi ne mehoahoa me nwo maa ɔbo so kãa po a, ɔnyɛ me nya.

english_verse: And I am not trying to scare you with my letters.
translation_verse: Na menguro kyɛ meyɛ me nwo kyɛ mefa me ngrataa menwunanwuna ɛmɔ;

english_verse: Some of you are saying, “Paul's letters are harsh and powerful. But in person, he is a weakling and has nothing worth saying.”
translation_verse: ofikyɛ mmenia kekã kyɛ, “Ye ngrataa te anwunanwuna na nu sa yɛ se, nakoso sɛ ɔba wa a, ye noa yɛ mmerɛ, yeɛ ye noa dwirɛ koso mbɛ asue.”

english_verse: Those people had better understand that when I am with you, I will do exactly what I say in my letters.
translation_verse: Na méma sɔ mmenia ne bɛte ye bo kyɛ, bɔ yɛkyerɛ ye krataa nu wɔ mmerɛ bɔ yɛnne ɛmɔ berɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛwɔ ɛmɔ berɛ a yɛyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: We won't dare compare ourselves with those who think so much of themselves. But they are foolish to compare themselves with themselves.
translation_verse: Ɔnzɛ kyɛ yɛfa yɛ nwo yɛsusu, anaa yɛtoto ebiemɔ bɔ bɛkamvo bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nwo ne, ofikyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛfa bɛ nwo besusu bɛ nwo bɛ nwo, na basa bafa batoto bɛ nwo bɛ nwo ne, bɛnze nworɛ.

english_verse: We won't brag about something we don't have a right to brag about. We will only brag about the work God has sent us to do, and you are part of that work.
translation_verse: Nakoso yɛ de, yɛngɔhoahoa yɛ nwo ma ɔngɔbo so, na mmom kyɛbɔ asusudeɛ bɔ Nyameɛ afa ama yɛ kyɛ yɛdwu ɛmɔ berɛ ne ɔte ne ala.

english_verse: We are not bragging more than we should. After all, we did bring the message about Christ to you.
translation_verse: Na yɛndwe yɛ nu ma ɔndra so kyɛ ebiaa yandwu ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ yɛ yeɛ yɛlili moa yɛfale Kristo nwo nzɛmba ne yɛpɛle atee yɛtoale ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: We don't brag about what others have done, as if we had done those things ourselves. But I hope as you become stronger in your faith, we will be able to reach many more of the people around you. That has always been our goal.
translation_verse: Yɛ de, yɛnhoahoa yɛ nwo ma ɔndra so, yɛmva ebiemɔ adwuma bɔ bayɔ yɛnhoahoa yɛ nwo. Na mmom yɛle anyelasoɛ kyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔ gyidie nyi a, ɔkɔma dwumadie bɔ Nyameɛ afa awura yɛ sa wɔ ɛmɔ berɛ ne kɔtrɛ,

english_verse: Then we will be able to preach the good news in other lands where we cannot take credit for work someone else has already done.
translation_verse: amaa yahora yaha nzɛmba ne wɔ nekaa foforɛ mɔ, na yamva ebie adwuma bɔ wayɔ ye dada wɔ nekaa bie yanhoahoa yɛ nwo.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you want to brag, then brag about the Lord.”
translation_verse: “Ma ebiala bɔ ɔhoahoa ye nwo ne, ɔfa Awurade hoahoa ye nwo.”

english_verse: You may brag about yourself, but the only approval that counts is the Lord's approval.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nna sona bɔ ɔkamvo ye nwo ne yeɛ ɔsɔ Awurade nye ɔ, na mmom bɔ Awurade kamvo ye ne yeɛ ɔsɔ ye nye ɔ.

english_verse: Please put up with a little of my foolishness.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔfa me ngwaseasɛm ne sɔ ala ma me a, ahaa mekuro. Mesrɛ ɛmɔ ala ɛmɔfa ye sɔ!

english_verse: I am as concerned about you as God is. You were like a virgin bride I had chosen only for Christ.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ nungunɛ ne bie yeɛ metwe wɔ ɛmɔ nwo ɔ. Ofikyɛ mafa ɛmɔ mabɔ asiwa mama biaa komapɛ, ye ole Kristo, na ngɔfa ɛmɔ ngɔma ye kyɛ ababunu bɔ ye nwo te ná onnwuni biaa le ɔ.

english_verse: But now I fear that you will be tricked, just as Eve was tricked by that lying snake. I am afraid that you might stop thinking about Christ in an honest and sincere way.
translation_verse: Nakoso mesuro kyɛ, kyɛbɔ ewoo ne fale anyeteɛ nworɛ lakalakale Hawa nen, sɔ ala yeɛ bɛkɔsɛkye ɛmɔ adwene maa ɛmɔkɔhwe bɛ nwo bekofi Kristo bɔ ɛmɔafa bɛ nwo bama ye nahorɛ nu ne anwo ɔ.

english_verse: We told you about Jesus, and you received the Holy Spirit and accepted our message. But you let some people tell you about another Jesus. Now you are ready to receive another spirit and accept a different message.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɛ ebie ba ɛmɔ berɛ bakã Yesu foforɛ bie nwo dwirɛ bɔ yɛhhane, anaakyɛ sɛ ɛmɔnya sunzum foforɛ bɔ ɔne bɔ ɛmɔlili moa benyane ye ne bɛtte ko, anaakyɛ nzɛmba foforɛ bɔ ɔne bɔ ɛmɔale bato nu ne bɛtte ko a, naa ɛmɔfa anika bɛsɔ nu!

english_verse: I think I am as good as any of those super apostles.
translation_verse: Nakoso menne menni kyɛ sɔ “asomafoɛ atitire” nemɔ bɛtra me ɔ.

english_verse: I may not speak as well as they do, but I know as much. And this has already been made perfectly clear to you.
translation_verse: Na sɛ me noa yeɛ ɔttele po a, nimdeɛ nu de mebɔ mmɔden; na nikyee biala nu yala ɛhe ali yahyire ɛmɔ wɔ atee biala so.

english_verse: Was it wrong for me to lower myself and honor you by preaching God's message free of charge?
translation_verse: Na sɛ mmrɛle me nwo ase maa ɛmɔnyane ngɔsoɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ngane Nyameɛ nzɛmba ne ngyirele ɛmɔ, bɔ mammisa ɛmɔ berɛ hwee ne a, né bɔne beni yeɛ mayɔ ɔ?

english_verse: I robbed other churches by taking money from them to serve you.
translation_verse: Asɔre biemɔ mmokalɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛbokale me ne, mefa ye kyɛ mawua bɛ; ofikyɛ mvale sɔ akatuaa ne neane me nwo nzole ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Even when I was in need, I still didn't bother you. In fact, some of the Lord's followers from Macedonia brought me what I needed. I have not been a burden to you in the past, and I will never be a burden.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ me nwo hyerele me wɔ ɛmɔ berɛ ne, mamva m’anwokyere mangua ebiala so, ofikyɛ aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ befi Makedonia bɛwale ne bɛfale nikyee biala bɔ mehia bɛbrɛle me. Yiti kyɛbɔ neane me nwo daa wɔ nikyee biala nu ne, ngɔhɔ so ngɔyɔ ye sɔ ala, na manyɛ ɛmɔ so tɔsom.

english_verse: As surely as I speak the truth about Christ, no one in Achaia can stop me from bragging about this.
translation_verse: Kristo nwo nahorɛ dwirɛ wɔ me nu, yiti ebiala ngɔhora ngɔma mengɔyakyi me nwo hoahoalɛ wɔ Akaia manzini nu.

english_verse: And it isn't because I don't love you. God himself knows how much I do love you.
translation_verse: Nzu ati ɔ? Aso menguro ɛmɔ dwirɛ hɔ ɔ? Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔse ɔ.

english_verse: I plan to go on doing just what I have always done. Then those people won't be able to brag about doing the same things we are doing.
translation_verse: Ngɔhɔ so ngɔyɔ bɔ meyɔ ne ala, na ɛhe ngɔma mmenia ngonya edwirɛ biala ngogyina so ná bafa bahoahoa bɛ nwo kyɛ bɛyɔ b’adwuma kyɛ yɛ deɛ ne ala.

english_verse: Anyway, they are no more than false apostles and dishonest workers. They only pretend to be apostles of Christ.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɔ mmenia ne te asomafoɛ ngondombofoɛ, adwumayɔlɛfoɛ nnakannakafoɛ bɔ bɛkakyi bɛ nwo kyɛ Kristo asomafoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And it is no wonder. Even Satan tries to make himself look like an angel of light.
translation_verse: Na ɔnyɛ nwanwa! Ofikyɛ Abɔnzam po kakyi ye nwo kyɛ nahorɛ abɔfo.

english_verse: So why does it seem strange for Satan's servants to pretend to do what is right? Someday they will get exactly what they deserve. Paul's Sufferings for Christ
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ ye asomafoɛ mɔ koso bɛkakyi bɛ nwo kyɛ tenenee somvoɛ mɔ a, ɔnyɛ nwanwa, na b’ayieleɛ koyie bɛ kyɛbɔ bɛ yɔleɛ te ɔ. Pɔɔlo fa amaneɛnwunɛ hoahoa ye nwo

english_verse: I don't want any of you to think I am a fool. But if you do, then let me be a fool and brag a little.
translation_verse: Mesi so bieku, nnɛma ebiala dwene kyɛ nnne adwene. Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔbu me kyɛ nnne adwene po a, ɛ́mɔfa me sɔ ala, ná me koso nhoahoa me nwo kãa.

english_verse: When I do all this bragging, I do it as a fool and not for the Lord.
translation_verse: Sɔ anwohoahoa ye nwo dwirɛ bɔ mekã ye, nna Awurade tumi yeɛ mefa mekã ɔ, na mmom mekã ye kyɛ sona bɔ nnne adwene ɔ.

english_verse: Yet if others want to brag about what they have done, so will I.
translation_verse: Mmeni pee hoahoa bɛ nwo wɔ anwoɔnaen atee so, yiti me wora ngɔhoahoa me nwo bie.

english_verse: And since you are so smart, you will gladly put up with a fool.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔle ngwaseafoɛ nwo aboterɛ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔte nworɛfoɛ.

english_verse: In fact, you let people make slaves of you and cheat you and steal from you. Why, you even let them strut around and slap you in the face.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ebie fa ɛmɔ yɛ ngoaa, anaa odi ɛmɔ aminɛ, anaa osisi ɛmɔ, anaa ɔmoma ye nwo so, anaa ɔpakye ɛmɔ nye so po a, ɛmɔnya ye nwo aboterɛ.

english_verse: I am ashamed to say we are too weak to behave in such a way. If they can brag, so can I, but it is a foolish thing to do.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ me nya kyɛ mekã kyɛ yɛ de yɛbrɛle yɛ nwo ase soma ɔ. Nakoso bɔ ebie kora fa hoahoa ye nwo ne, medwudwo kyɛ ebiaa nnne adwene de oo, me wora mekora mefa mehoahoa me nwo bie.

english_verse: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Jews? So am I. Are they from the family of Abraham? Well, so am I.
translation_verse: Bɛte Hebrifoɛ anaa? Me wora nde bie. Bɛte Yisraelfoɛ anaa? Me wora nde bie. Bɛte Abraham boso ama anaa? Me wora nde bie.

english_verse: Are they servants of Christ? I am a fool to talk this way, but I serve him better than they do. I have worked harder and have been put in jail more times. I have been beaten with whips more and have been in danger of death more often.
translation_verse: Bɛte Kristo asomvoɛ anaa? Medwudwo kyɛ ebiaa nnne adwene de oo, metra bɛ: mayɔ adwuma serɛ matra bɛ, mala kuku nu somaa matra bɛ, babo me pee batra bɛ, yeɛ ewue ato afo me pee atra bɛ.

english_verse: Three times the Romans beat me with a big stick, and once my enemies stoned me. I have been shipwrecked three times, and I even had to spend a night and a day in the sea.
translation_verse: Baha me mbire koso pɛen nza, baboro me nyɔboɛ ko, ɛlɛen abutu me pɛen nza, yeɛ ɛpo koso fale me lili akɔneaba alehyeleɛ ne alesaleɛ ko.

english_verse: During my many travels, I have been in danger from rivers, robbers, my own people, and foreigners. My life has been in danger in cities, in deserts, at sea, and with people who only pretended to be the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Matu atee pee na mali amia wɔ nzue so, awuefoɛ sa nu, me bɔbɔ me nwo ama bɛ sa nu, Amaenmaensofoɛ sa nu, kuro nu nningyein suronyi, ɛserɛ so suronyi, ɛpo so suronyi, yeɛ aliɛmaa ngondombofoɛ sa nu.

english_verse: I have worked and struggled and spent many sleepless nights. I have gone hungry and thirsty and often had nothing to eat. I have been cold from not having enough clothes to keep me warm.
translation_verse: Mayɔ adwuma mafɛ, mmerɛ pee mennya nnaa menna, ɛhɔen ne nzuhɔen ku me, metaa mekye hɔen, ɛyerɛ ku me, yeɛ ndaadeɛ bɔ ngowura abɔ me.

english_verse: Besides everything else, each day I am burdened down, worrying about all the churches.
translation_verse: Nna ɛhemɔ ngome, na mmom asɔre ne amukoraa nwo dadwene koso la me so ɛlɛho biala.

english_verse: When others are weak, I am weak too. When others are tricked into sin, I get angry.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔyɛ mmerɛ a, ná me wora nnyɛle mmerɛ ɔ? Nwa yeɛ bɛmaa ɔkɔ bɔne nu a memvɛ yaa ɔ?

english_verse: If I have to brag, I will brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Na sɛ odi kyɛ mehoahoa me nwo a, nningyein bɔ okyire kyɛ meyɛ mmerɛ yeɛ ngɔfa ngɔhoahoa me nwo ɔ.

english_verse: God, the Father of our Lord Jesus, knows I am not lying. And God is to be praised forever!
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte y’Awurade Yesu Kristo Baba, bɔ ɛkamvolɛ te ye deɛ daa daa ne, ɔse kyɛ membɛ ngondombo.

english_verse: The governor of Damascus at the time of King Aretas had the city gates guarded, so he could capture me.
translation_verse: Ngɔle Damasko nen, amrado bɔ owura Nana Aretase bo ne fale asraafoɛ gyinagyinane kuro ne anu kyɛ bɛhye me,

english_verse: But I escaped by being let down in a basket through a window in the city wall.
translation_verse: nakoso bɛfale me besiele kɛndɛenmboho bie anu, na bedwurale me bɛfale mboma bɔ ɔwɔ fasue ne anu maa nwati mvili ye sa nu.

english_verse: I have to brag. There is nothing to be gained by it, but I must brag about the visions and other things that the Lord has shown me.
translation_verse: Ye nwo nhia kyɛ ngɔhoahoa me nwo ɔ, nakoso ngɔhã Awurade nyekyire, ɔne bɔ waye wahyire me nwo dwirɛ.

english_verse: I am planning to visit you for the third time. But I still won't make a burden of myself. What I really want is you, and not what you have. Children are not supposed to save up for their parents, but parents are supposed to take care of their children.
translation_verse: Ye pɛen nza ɛhe yeɛ maboaboa me nwo kyɛ meba ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ. Memmanyɛ ɛmɔ so tɔsom, ofikyɛ membena ɛmɔ dɔ nikye fee, na mmom mepena ɛmɔ bɔbɔ deinn. Ofikyɛ nna mmaa yeɛ bɛpena nikyee bɛyakyi awofoɛ ɔ, na mmom awofoɛ yeɛ bɛpena bɛyakyi mmaa ɔ.

english_verse: As I said, only God really knows if this man was in his body at the time.
translation_verse: Mese kyɛ behwimini sɔ sona ne bɛhɔle Paradise. Nakoso sɛ ɛhe sili wɔ anwoɔnaen nu oo, sɛ nna anwoɔnaen nu ahɔ oo, me de menze, Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔse ɔ.

english_verse: But he was taken up into paradise, where he heard things too wonderful to tell.
translation_verse: Na berɛ yeɛ ɔtele edwirɛ bɔ kuro sona ngora nga bie, yeɛ atee koso nne berɛ kyɛ ɔkã ɔ.

english_verse: I will brag about that man, but not about myself, except to say how weak I am.
translation_verse: Sɔ sona ne yeɛ ngɔfa ye ngɔhoahoa me nwo ɔ, nakoso me bɔbɔ me nwo de mengɔhoahoa; sana me mmerɛyɛlɛ nwo yeɛ ngɔhoahoa me nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Yet even if I did brag, I would not be foolish. I would simply be speaking the truth. But I will try not to say too much. That way, none of you will think more highly of me than you should because of what you have seen me do and say.
translation_verse: Na sɛ mekuro kyɛ mehoahoa me nwo po a, mengɔyɛ kwaseaa, ofikyɛ nahorɛ yeɛ ngɔhã ɔ. Nakoso mayakyi m’anwohoahoa ne po, anyɔ a né bɔ ebie nwu ye anaa bɔ ɔte fi me berɛ ne ati wabu me watra so.

english_verse: Of course, I am now referring to the wonderful things I saw. One of Satan's angels was sent to make me suffer terribly, so that I would not feel too proud.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ na mamva anwanwadeɛ nyekyire hemɔ mammoma me nwo so soma ne ati, bɛfale ɛhawo bie bawura me nwonaen nu, bɔ ɔte Abɔnzam bɔfoɛ, kyɛ ɔma nwu yealɛ, ná mammoma me nwo so.

english_verse: Three times I begged the Lord to make this suffering go away.
translation_verse: Ɔnate ɛhe ati, nzrɛle Awurade pɛen nza kyɛ ɔye sɔ nikyee ne fi me so.

english_verse: But he replied, “My gift of undeserved grace is all you need. My power is strongest when you are weak.” So if Christ keeps giving me his power, I will gladly brag about how weak I am.
translation_verse: Nakoso obuale me kyɛ, “M’adom ne ala sone ma wɔ, ofikyɛ sona mmerɛyɛlɛ nu yeɛ me tumi ne ye ye nwo ali paa paa ɔ.” Yiti ngɔfa anika piri paa ngɔhoahoa me nwo wɔ me mmerɛyɛlɛ nu, amaa Kristo tumi ne wawura me nu.

english_verse: Yes, I am glad to be weak or insulted or mistreated or to have troubles and sufferings, if it is for Christ. Because when I am weak, I am strong. Paul's Concern for the Lord's Followers at Corinth
translation_verse: Na ɔnate Kristo ti, me nye gye wɔ mmerɛyɛlɛ nu, alapaa bɔ bɛbɔ me nu, anwokyere nu, ndaneanyeɛ nu, aworabɔlɛ nu; ofikyɛ sɛ meyɛ mmerɛ a, yeɛ me nwo yɛ se ɔ. Korintofoɛ nwo hia Pɔɔlo

english_verse: I have been making a fool of myself. But you forced me to do it, when you should have been speaking up for me. I may be nothing at all, but I am as good as those super apostles.
translation_verse: Mayɛ kwaseaa mahoahoa me nwo, nakoso ɛmɔ yeɛ bamaa mayɛ sɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔkamvo me bekyire ɔ. Na sɛ nnde huu po a, sɔ “asomafoɛ atitire” nemɔ de bɛndra me wɔ atee biala so.

english_verse: When I was with you, I was patient and worked all the powerful miracles and signs and wonders of a true apostle.
translation_verse: Nningyein bɔ bedi asomafoɛ paa nwo adanzeɛ ne, nyɔle ye wɔ ɛmɔ berɛ wɔ aboterɛ mukoraa ne nzɛngyerɛnneɛ, anwanwadeɛ ne tumi nnwumaa nu ɔ.

english_verse: You missed out on only one blessing the other churches received. That is, you didn't have to support me. Forgive me for doing you wrong.
translation_verse: Nzikyɛ paa yeɛ nyɔ mane asɔre ngaa nemɔ bɔ mbɛle ɛmɔ nyakyili ɔ? Sana m’anwokyere ye ala bɔ mamva mangua ɛmɔ so ye. Na sɛ ɛhe nwo yeɛ mayɔ tɛɛ hɔ a, nzaade ɛmɔfa bɛhyɛ me.

english_verse: So I will gladly give all I have and all I am. Will you love me less for loving you too much?
translation_verse: Na me de, ɔkɔyɛ me fɛ kyɛ ɔnate ɛmɔ kra ti ngɔhwere me nikyee biala, ɔne me bɔbɔ me mumua ne. Na sɛ mekuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ pee sɔa a, né nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔ de ɛmɔkuro me dwirɛ kãa bie ɔ?

english_verse: You agree that I wasn't a burden to you. Maybe that's because I was trying to catch you off guard and trick you.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ manyɛ ɛmɔ so tɔsom de, nakoso ɛmɔdwene kyɛ nde anyeteɛ sona, na nnakannaka yeɛ mafa manya ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Were you cheated by any of those I sent to you?
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ nzomane bɛ ɛmɔ berɛ ne, aso mafa bɛ so mali ɛmɔ aminɛ anaa?

english_verse: I urged Titus to visit you, and I sent another follower with him. But Titus didn't cheat you, and we felt and behaved the same way he did.
translation_verse: Nzrɛle Tito, na nzomane ye ne aliɛmaa ne kyɛ bɛbra ɛmɔ berɛ. Aso Tito, olili ɛmɔ aminɛ anaa? Ɔne me yɛ dwumadie ne ɔtte ko anaa? Anaakyɛ nna agyirɛ komapɛ ne ala yeɛ yɛtuli ɔ?

english_verse: Have you been thinking all along that we have been defending ourselves to you? Actually, we have been speaking to God as followers of Christ. But, my friends, we did it all for your good.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔdwene kyɛ yɛ noa yeɛ yɛye yɛkyire ɛmɔ ɔ? Daabi. Yɛdwudwo Kristo dumaa nu wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu; na aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔ ngɔsoɛ ti yeɛ ɔmaa yɛkã ɛhe amukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: I am afraid when I come, we won't be pleased with each other. I fear that some of you may be arguing or jealous or angry or selfish or gossiping or insulting each other. I even fear that you may be proud and acting like a mob.
translation_verse: Na mesuro ye si kyɛ sɛ meba a, ngoonwu ɛmɔ wɔ atee bɔ menguro so, ná ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔanwu me wɔ atee bɔ ɛmɔnguro so. Ebiaa ngɔɔto ɛmɔ ne ngondii, ahoɔyea, ɛyaafɛlɛ, pɛsɛmangomenya, bɛ gya ndii nu pepɛlɛ, nzekure, anwomasoɛ ne basabasayɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: I am afraid God will make me ashamed when I visit you again. I will feel like crying because many of you have never given up your old sins. You are still doing things that are immoral, indecent, and shameful.
translation_verse: Ebiaa meba bieku a, me Nyameɛ kɔbrɛ me ase wɔ ɛmɔ nyunu maa ngoli ɛmɔ nu pee nwo aworabɔlɛ wɔ mmenia somaa bɔ daa bayɔ bɔne, ná kekesaala ye bɛtɛyɔ ná banzakyera b’adwene wɔ brabɔlɛ fiɛ, adwamanbɔlɛ ne ahuhubra nwo ti.

english_verse: I am on my way to visit you for the third time. And as the Scriptures say, “Any charges must be proved true by at least two or three witnesses.”
translation_verse: Meba ɛmɔ berɛ he a, né ye pɛen nza so ɛne. Na kwaadu biala, odi kyɛ benya adanzefoɛ nyɔ anaa nza noa dwirɛ bɛfa bɛfoa so.

english_verse: During my second visit I warned you that I would punish you and anyone else who doesn't stop sinning. I am far away from you now, but I give you the same warning.
translation_verse: Mmɔle bɛ bɔ daa ne bɛyɛle bɔne, ne bɛ bɔ baha ne amukoraa kɔkɔ, na kekesaala ye bɔ nne ɛmɔ berɛ ye koso, mesi so bieku, kyɛbɔ nyɔle ye mmerɛ bɔ nzrale ɛmɔ ye pɛen nyɔ so ne kyɛ, sɛ meba berɛ bieku a, mengɔfa bɛ nwo ngɔhyɛ bɛ.

english_verse: This should prove to you that I am speaking for Christ. When he corrects you, he won't be weak. He will be powerful!
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔpena adanzeɛ bɔ okyire kyɛ Kristo yeɛ ɔfa me so dwudwo ɔ. Kristo nyɛ mmerɛ wɔ ɛmɔ so, na mmom ye tumi yɔ adwuma wɔ ɛmɔ nu.

english_verse: Although he was weak when he was nailed to the cross, he now lives by the power of God. We are weak, just as Christ was. But you will see that we will live by the power of God, just as Christ does.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛbɔle ye mmeamudua nu wɔ mmerɛyɛlɛ nu de, nakoso ɔnate Nyameɛ tumi so ɔte ase. Yɛ koso, yɛyɛ mmerɛ wɔ ye nu, nakoso yɛnate Nyameɛ tumi so yɛne ye kɔtena ase.

english_verse: Test yourselves and find out if you really are true to your faith. If you pass the test, you will discover that Christ is living in you. But if Christ isn't living in you, you have failed.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔneanea ɛmɔ ahone nu bɛnea sɛ ɛmɔtɛtira gyidie ne anu a. Ɛ́mɔso ɛmɔ nwo bɛnea. Aso ɛmɔnnwu ye kyɛ Yesu Kristo te ɛmɔ nu anaa? Sana ebiaa né ɛmɔabɔ ase wɔ gyidie nu.

english_verse: I hope you will discover we have not failed.
translation_verse: Nakoso mede medi kyɛ ɛmɔkonwu ye kyɛ yɛ de, yɛbbɔle ase wɔ gyidie nu.

english_verse: We pray you will stop doing evil things. We don't pray like this to make ourselves look good, but to get you to do right, even if we are failures.
translation_verse: Na yɛsrɛ Nyameɛ kyɛ ɛmɔngɔyɔ bɔne. Yɛngyire kyɛ yɛ de yɛsɔ anyeɛ oo, daabi! na mmom ɛmɔ de yɛpena kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ebie a yayɛ kyɛ bɛbɔ babɔ ase wɔ gyidie nu ne.

english_verse: All we can do is to follow the truth and not fight against it.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ yɛngɔhora yɛngɔyɔ nikye fee ngotia nahorɛ ne, na mmom kyɛ yɛkogyina yɛkɔma nahorɛ ne yeɛ yɛkɔhora kɔyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Even though we are weak, we are glad that you are strong, and we pray you will do even better.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛyɛ mmerɛ, na ɛmɔ de ɛmɔyɛ se a, né yɛ nye agye; na yɛ mbaeɛ ole kyɛ ɛmɔkoli mu ɔ.

english_verse: I am writing these things to you before I arrive. This way I won't have to be hard on you when I use the authority the Lord has given me. I was given this authority, so I could help you and not destroy you.
translation_verse: Yiti mekyerɛ krataa he mebrɛ ɛmɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ nne ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ, amaa sɛ meba a, Awurade tumi bɔ wafa wama me ne, mamva so me ne ɛmɔ yanni ye weewee. Ofikyɛ nna ɛmɔ asefinɛ, na mmom ɛmɔ ngɔsoɛ ti yeɛ nyane sɔ tumi ne ɔ. Ngraalilɛ ne mbaeɛ

english_verse: Goodbye, my friends. Do better and pay attention to what I have said. Try to get along and live peacefully with each other. Now I pray that God, who gives love and peace, will be with you.
translation_verse: Afei aliɛmaa mɔ, mekra ɛmɔ oo! Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nwo te, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ wora kyekye, ɛmɔnya adwene ko, ɛmɔtena asomdwee nu, na ɔdɔ ne asomdwee Nyameɛ ɔne ɛmɔ kɔtena.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. All God's people send their greetings.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔyɛ ɛmɔ nwo awaawaatuu krongron nu.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ.

english_verse: Christ obeyed God our Father and gave himself as a sacrifice for our sins to rescue us from this evil world.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔfale ye ngoa tole berɛ mane yɛ bɔne ɔ, amaa ɔnate so waye yɛ wafi kekesaala ye bɔne wiase ye anu, kyɛbɔ yɛ Baba Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ te ne.

english_verse: God will be given glory forever and ever. Amen. The Only True Message
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ animnyam ɔhã ye afebɔɔ ɔ. Amen. Nzɛmba ne te komapɛ twe

english_verse: I am shocked that you have so quickly turned from God, who chose you with his gift of undeserved grace. You have believed another message,
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ me nwanwa kyɛ wangyɛ biala yeɛ ɛmɔtwe ɛmɔ nwo befi ye nwo ɔ, ye bɔ ɔfrɛle ɛmɔ wale Kristo adom ne anu, ná ɛmɔkwaali nzɛmba foforɛ si ɔ.

english_verse: when there is really only one true message. But some people are causing you trouble and want to make you turn away from the good news about Christ.
translation_verse: Nakoso nzɛmba foforɛ biala nne berɛ; na mmom mmenia biemɔ wɔ berɛ bɔ bɛha ɛmɔ, bɔ bɛpena kyɛ bɛsesã Kristo nzɛmba ne ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from our message to you! It doesn't matter if that person is one of us or an angel from heaven.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ yɛ, anaa abɔfo bie fi nyameɛso po ba bakã nzɛmba foforɛ bɔ ɔne yɛ deɛ bɔ yahã yahyire ɛmɔ ne bɛnzɛ a, ye de ye yaakɔ!

english_verse: I have said it before, and I will say it again. I hope God will punish anyone who preaches anything different from what you have already believed.
translation_verse: Yahã ye daa, na mekã ye bieku, sɛ ebie bakã nzɛmba foforɛ bɔ ɔne yɛ deɛ bɔ ɛmɔale bato nu ne bɛnzɛ a, abue bu ye!

english_verse: I am not trying to please people. I want to please God. Do you think I am trying to please people? If I were doing that, I would not be a servant of Christ. How Paul Became an Apostle
translation_verse: Afei, kuro sona, anaa Nyameɛ yeɛ mepena kyɛ ɔkamvo me ɔ? Anaa mepena kyɛ mesɔ adasa nye? Sɛ kuro sona yeɛ ngu so mesɔ ye nye a, ahaa nnde Kristo akoaa. Kyɛbɔ Pɔɔlo yɛle Yesu Kristo somafoɛ ɔ

english_verse: My friends, I want you to know that no one made up the message I preach.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, mepena kyɛ ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ nzɛmba bɔ nga ngyirele ɛmɔ ne, nna kuro sona deɛ ɔ.

english_verse: It wasn't given or taught to me by some mere human. My message came directly from Jesus Christ when he appeared to me.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ mannya mamvi kuro sona berɛ, yeɛ bangyire me koso; na mmom Yesu Kristo yeɛ ɔyele ye ali hyirele me ɔ.

english_verse: You know how I used to live as a Jew. I was cruel to God's church and even tried to destroy it.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔate me daa brabɔlɛ bɔ né nwɔ nu wɔ Yudasom nu, ɔne kyɛbɔ ndanene Nyameɛ asɔre ne nye anyeborolɛ so, na mmɔle mmɔden kyɛ ngɔsɛkye ye ɔ.

english_verse: I was a much better Jew than anyone else my own age, and I obeyed every law our ancestors had given us.
translation_verse: Na nyane ngɔsoɛ wɔ Yudasom nu ndrale Yudafoɛ pee bɔ me ne bɛ bɔ tipɛen, na nzɔle me nana mɔ amammerɛ ne anu serɛserɛ.

english_verse: to show me his Son, so I would announce his message to the Gentiles. I didn't talk this over with anyone.
translation_verse: kyɛ ɔkɔla Ɔwa ne ali kohyire me, amaa ɔnate so mahã ye nwo nzɛmba ne mahyire Amaenmaensofoɛ ne, berɛ ne ala manzusu ye nwo mangyire sona biala.
