english_verse: I didn't say a word, not even to the men in Jerusalem who were apostles before I was. Instead, I went at once to Arabia, and afterwards I returned to Damascus.
translation_verse: Yeɛ mangɔ asomafoɛ bɔ belili me nyunu moa ne berɛ wɔ Yerusalem, na mmom ngɔle Arabia, na nziɛ ye nza male Damasko bieku.

english_verse: Three years later I went to visit Peter in Jerusalem and stayed with him for
translation_verse: Na afoɛ nza si ne, ngɔ nzrale Kefa wɔ Yerusalem, na nnili ye berɛ eleburu ne nnu.

english_verse: The only other apostle I saw was James, the Lord's brother.
translation_verse: Nakoso mannwu asomafoɛ ne anu biala, sana Awurade aliɛma Yakobo.

english_verse: And in the presence of God I swear I am telling the truth.
translation_verse: Na edwirɛ bɔ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ ye, Nyameɛ nyunu, membɛ ngondombo.

english_verse: Later, I went to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe asi ne, ngɔle Siria ne Kilikia mbɔtam.

english_verse: But no one who belonged to Christ's churches in Judea had ever seen me in person.
translation_verse: Né Kristo asɔre mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Yudea ne bennwuni me nyunu le.

english_verse: They had only heard that the one who had been cruel to them was now preaching the message that he had once tried to destroy.
translation_verse: Bɔ né bate hɔ ala ɛhe: “Sona bɔ né daa ɔtane yɛ nye ne, afei de ɔbɔ gyidie bɔ ahaa ɔpena kyɛ ɔsɛkye ye ne nwo dawure.”

english_verse: And because of me, they praised God.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate me ti bɛhyɛle Nyameɛ animnyam.

english_verse: Fourteen years later I went to Jerusalem with Barnabas. I also took along Titus.
translation_verse: Afoɛ buru ne nna si ne, me ne Banaba yɛhɔle Yerusalem bieku, na mvale Tito koso mmokale me nwo so.

english_verse: But I went there because God had told me to go, and I explained the good news I had been preaching to the Gentiles. Then I met privately with the ones who seemed to be the most important leaders. I wanted to make sure my work in the past and my future work would not be for nothing.
translation_verse: Nyane nyekyire ti yeɛ ngɔle berɛ ɔ, na mvale nzɛmba bɔ mekã mekyire Amaenmaensofoɛ ne ndole bɛ nyunu; nakoso mbanyi nemɔ de, nga ngyirele bɛ wɔ ahameɛ, amaa adwuma bɔ meyɔ, ɔne bɔ mayɔ ye daa ne anyɛ mbaen.

english_verse: Titus went to Jerusalem with me. He was a Greek, but still he wasn't forced to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Nakoso Tito po bɔ ɔte Helaniɛ na ɔboka me so ne, banhyɛ ye kyɛ ɔpɛ ye bienzua.

english_verse: We went there because of those who pretended to be followers and had sneaked in among us as spies. They had come to take away the freedom Christ Jesus had given us, and they were trying to make us their slaves.
translation_verse: Na aliɛmaa mɔ ngondombofoɛ bɛfeafeale bɛ nwo bɛwale berɛ bie kyɛ bɛbaatetɛ bɛpena yɛ fawɔnwodi bɔ yanya ye wɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne nwo ate, na bamaa yaawura ngoaasolɛ nu.

english_verse: But we wanted you to have the true message. This is why we didn't give in to them, not even for a second.
translation_verse: Na yɛ de, yamma bɛ ate mmerɛ kaala po, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná nahorɛ bɔ ɔwɔ nzɛmba ne anu ahɔ so atena berɛ ama ɛmɔ daa ɔ.

english_verse: Some of them were supposed to be important leaders, but I didn't care who they were. God doesn't have any favorites! None of these so-called special leaders added anything to my message.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bebu bɛ nwo kyɛ bedi mu ne, bɛte nzikyɛ mmenia koraa po a, me de ɔmva me nwo; ofikyɛ Nyameɛ de ɔnyɛ nyeyemuɛ, na bɛ bɔ bebu bɛ nwo kyɛ bedi mu ne bamva hwee bammoka so.

english_verse: They realized God had sent me with the good news for Gentiles, and he had sent Peter with the same message for Jews.
translation_verse: Na mmom benwuni kyɛ bafa bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ nu nzɛmbahanɛ ne bawura me sa, kyɛbɔ bafa bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ nu deɛ bawura Petro sa ne.

english_verse: God, who had sent Peter on a mission to the Jews, was now using me to preach to the Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔnate Petro so yɔle asomafoɛ adwuma wɔ bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ nu ne, ye komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔnate me so lili dwumaa wɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: James, Peter, and John realized that God had given me the message about his gift of undeserved grace. And these men are supposed to be the backbone of the church. They even gave Barnabas and me a friendly handshake. This was to show that we would work with Gentiles and that they would work with Jews.
translation_verse: Na Yakobo, Kefa ne Yohane bɔ agyidifoɛ ne bu bɛ kyɛ bɛte bonima ma asɔre ne nwuni adom bɔ manya ye nen, besomane me ne Banaba sa nu bɛfa behyirele kyɛ bale yɛ bato nu: kyɛ yɛɛha nzɛmba ne yɛhyire Amaenmaensofoɛ, na bɛ wora bɛɛhã ye bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ dɔ.

english_verse: They only asked us to remember the poor, and this was something I had always been eager to do. Paul Corrects Peter at Antioch
translation_verse: Bɛsrɛle yɛ nikyee komapɛ, kyɛ yɛkaye ehiafoɛ; na né ɛhe te nikyee bɔ mekuro kyɛ meyɔ ɔ. Pɔɔlo twi Petro nyunu wɔ Antiokia

english_verse: When Peter came to Antioch, I told him face to face that he was wrong.
translation_verse: Na Petro wale Antiokia nen, ndwili ye nyunu, ofikyɛ né wayɔ mvomsoɛ bie.

english_verse: He used to eat with Gentile followers of the Lord, until James sent some Jewish followers. Peter was afraid of the Jews and soon stopped eating with Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, anzana ɛbɔfoɛ biemɔ bɛbaafi Yakobo berɛ bɛba nen, né Petro ne Amaenmaensofoɛ nemɔ to asaa bedidi. Nakoso bɛwale nen, ɔhwene ye nwo fili bɛ nwo, ofikyɛ né osuro bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: He and the others hid their true feelings so well that even Barnabas was fooled.
translation_verse: Na Yudafoɛ ngaa ne koso yɔle sɔ mvomsoɛ ne bie, na bɛ suban tɛɛ ne mane Banaba koso hwene ye nwo bie.

english_verse: But when I saw they were not really obeying the truth that is in the good news, I corrected Peter in front of everyone and said: Peter, you are a Jew, but you live like a Gentile. So how can you force Gentiles to live like Jews?
translation_verse: Na nwuni kyɛ bakwati nahorɛ bɔ ɔwɔ nzɛmba ne anu nen, nzele Petro wɔ bɛ mukoraa bɛ nyunu kyɛ, “Sɛ wɔ bɔ ɛte Yudaniɛ ɛbɔ wɔ bra kyɛ Amaenmaensoniɛ, na ɛnyɛ kyɛ Yudaniɛ a, nzu ati yeɛ ɛhyɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ kyengyekyengye maa bɛbɔ bɛ bra kyɛ Yudafoɛ ɔ?” Gyidie yeɛ ode Yudafoɛ ne Amaenmaensofoɛ ngoa ɔ

english_verse: We are Jews by birth and are not sinners like Gentiles.
translation_verse: Yɛ de, bɛwole yɛ Yudafoɛ, na bannwo yɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ bɔnefoɛ.

english_verse: But we know that God accepts only those who have faith in Jesus Christ. No one can please God by simply obeying the Law. So we put our faith in Christ Jesus, and God accepted us because of our faith.
translation_verse: Nakoso yɛse kyɛ ɔnate sona gyidie wɔ Yesu Kristo nu so yeɛ Nyameɛ bua ye be ɔ, na mmom ɔnnate mmeraa ne aso lilɛ. Yɛ koso yale Kristo yali, amaa ɔnate sɔ gyidie ne aso Nyameɛ abua yɛ be, na nna kyɛ mmeraa ne aso lilɛ ti ɔ; ofikyɛ nna mmeraa ne aso lilɛ yeɛ Nyameɛ kɔfa kobua sona biala be ɔ.

english_verse: When we Jews started looking for a way to please God, we discovered that we are sinners too. Does this mean that Christ is the one who makes us sinners? No, it doesn't!
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ yɛbɔ mmɔden kyɛ ɔnate Kristo so bekobua yɛ be ye, na sɛ benwu yɛ kyɛ yɛte bɔnefoɛ a, né ɛhe kyire kyɛ Kristo te bɔne somvoɛ anaa? Nyameɛ pa gua!

english_verse: But if I tear down something and then build it again, I prove that I was wrong at first.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ mesa mesi bɔ madwiri magua ne bieku a, nzaade né nde mmeraatolɛniɛ.

english_verse: It was the Law itself that killed me and freed me from its power, so I could live for God. I have been nailed to the cross with Christ.
translation_verse: Na mede mvale mmeraa ne aso nwu mane mmeraa ne, kyɛbɔ ngɔtena ase ngɔma Nyameɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I don't turn my back on God's gift of undeserved grace. If we can be acceptable to God by obeying the Law, it was useless for Christ to die.
translation_verse: Membo Nyameɛ adom ne, ofikyɛ sɛ tenenee nate mmeraa ne aso yeɛ ɔba a, né nzaade Kristo awu mbaen!

english_verse: You stupid Galatians! I told you exactly how Jesus Christ was nailed to a cross. Has someone now put an evil spell on you?
translation_verse: O Galatiafoɛ bɔ ɛmɔndwene ɔ! Nwa yeɛ odwumvale ɛmɔ sɔa ye; Aso nna ɛmɔ nyunu yeɛ behyirehyirele nu pefee kyɛ bɛbɔle Yesu Kristo mmeamudua nu ɔ?

english_verse: I want to know only one thing. How were you given God's Spirit? Was it by obeying the Law of Moses or by hearing about Christ and having faith in him?
translation_verse: Edwirɛ he yeɛ mepena kyɛ ɛmɔye ye noa ɔ: ɔnate mmeraa ne aso lilɛ so yeɛ ɛmɔnyane Sunzum ne, anaakyɛ ɔnate nzɛmba bɔ ɛmɔtele ná ɛmɔle belili ne aso?

english_verse: How can you be so stupid? Do you think that by yourself you can complete what God's Spirit started in you?
translation_verse: Sɔ yeɛ ɛmɔndwene ɔ? Ɛmɔfale Sunzum ne yeɛ bɛhyɛle ye bo ɔ, na nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔfa anwoɔnaen beyie ɔ?

english_verse: Have you gone through all of this for nothing? Is it all really for nothing?
translation_verse: Amaneɛ pee bɔ ɛmɔnwuni ye ne, aso wayɛ mbaen? Dabida, ɔngɔyɛ mbaen!

english_verse: God gives you his Spirit and works miracles in you. But does he do this because you obey the Law of Moses or because you have heard about Christ and have faith in him?
translation_verse: Yiti Nyameɛ bɔ ɔma ɛmɔ Sunzum ne ná ɔyɔ anwanwadeɛ wɔ ɛmɔ nu ne, ɔnate mmeraa ne aso lilɛ yeɛ ɔyɔ ɔ, anaa ɔnate nzɛmba bɔ ɛmɔtele ná ɛmɔle lili ne aso? Abraham te yɛ nhwɛsoɛ

english_verse: The Scriptures say that God accepted Abraham because Abraham had faith.
translation_verse: “Na kyɛbɔ Abraham lele Nyameɛ lili ná obuli ye tenenee mane ye ne,

english_verse: And so, you should understand that everyone who has faith is a child of Abraham.
translation_verse: sɔ ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ, bɛ bɔ bele gyidie ne yeɛ bɛte Abraham bosofoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Long ago the Scriptures said God would accept the Gentiles because of their faith. This is why God told Abraham the good news that all nations would be blessed because of him.
translation_verse: Na Ahyerɛlɛ ne hã tole berɛ kyɛ Nyameɛ kɔfa gyidie so yeɛ okobua Amaenmaensofoɛ mɔ be ɔ, na Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne lili moa sele Abraham kyɛ, “Ɔnate wɔ so yeɛ Nyameɛ koyirayira maen maen amukoraa ɔ.”

english_verse: This means everyone who has faith will share in the blessings given to Abraham because of his faith.
translation_verse: Abraham nyane gyidie, yiti ebiala bɔ ole gyidie ne, bayira ye ne Abraham.

english_verse: Anyone who tries to please God by obeying the Law is under a curse. The Scriptures say, “Everyone who doesn't obey everything in the Law is under a curse.”
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ mmeraa ne aso lilɛ so yeɛ ɔfa ye nwo to ne, ye yaakɔ! Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Ebiala bɔ onni nikyee biala so kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ mmeraa nwomaa ne anu, ná ɔnyɔ ne, ye yaakɔ!.”

english_verse: No one can please God by obeying the Law. The Scriptures also say, “The people God accepts because of their faith will live.”
translation_verse: Afei ɔla berɛ pefee kyɛ ɔnate mmeraa ne aso de, ebiala nni be wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu; ofikyɛ teneneeniɛ de, ɔnate ye gyidie so yeɛ okonya ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: The Law isn't based on faith. It promises life only to people who obey its commands.
translation_verse: Na mmeraa ne de, oggyi gyidie so; nakoso ebiala bɔ odi so ne okonya nu ngoa.”

english_verse: But Christ rescued us from the Law's curse, when he became a curse in our place. This is because the Scriptures say that anyone who is nailed to a tree is under a curse.
translation_verse: Kristo ɔɔyɛle abusudeɛ mane yɛ, na ɔnate so wapɔ yɛ wafi mmeraa musue nu; ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Banoma sona biala bɔ basinze ye wɔ bakaa so ɔ.”

english_verse: And because of what Jesus Christ has done, the blessing promised to Abraham was taken to the Gentiles. This happened so that by faith we would be given the promised Holy Spirit. The Law and the Promise
translation_verse: Na ɛhe sili kyɛbɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ kɔfa Kristo Yesu so bekonya Abraham saleɛ ne bie ɔ, amaa yafa gyidie so yanya Sunzum bɔ Nyameɛ fa bɔle anohoba ne. Mmeraa ne ne bɔhyɛ ne

english_verse: My friends, I will use an everyday example to explain what I mean. Once someone agrees to something, no one else can change or cancel the agreement.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, mefa asetena nu dwirɛ meyɛ mvandoho: sɛ ebie yɔ nzamanzeɛ na ɔfa ye sa wura ye bo a, sona biala ngora nzesã ye, yeɛ ɔngora mva bie mmoka so.

english_verse: That is how it is with the promises God made to Abraham and his descendant. The promises were not made to many descendants, but only to one, and that one is Christ.
translation_verse: Abraham ne ye bosoniɛ yeɛ Nyameɛ hyɛle bɛ bɔ ɔ. Ɔnga kyɛ, “Wɔ bosofoɛ,” bɔ okyire mmeni pee; na mmom okyire sona horɛ: “Wɔ bosoniɛ,” bɔ ye ole Kristo.

english_verse: If we have to obey the Law in order to receive God's blessings, those blessings don't really come to us because of God's promise. But God was kind to Abraham and made him a promise.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɛ Nyameɛ agyapadeɛ ne gyi mmeraa ne aso a, nzaade oggyi bɔhyɛ so ko; nakoso Nyameɛ nate bɔhyɛ so yeɛ ɔfale agyapadeɛ ne hyɛle Abraham ɔ. Mmeraa ne le botaeɛ

english_verse: What is the use of the Law? It was given later to show that we sin. But it was only supposed to last until the coming of that descendant who was given the promise. In fact, angels gave the Law to Moses, and he gave it to the people.
translation_verse: Afei mmeraa ne botaeɛ ole sɛɛ? Mmeraatolɛ ti yeɛ ɔmaa bɛfa bɛbokale so ɔ, kɔpem kyɛ Abraham bosoniɛ bɔ yiti yeɛ bɛhyɛle bɔ ne ɔkɔwa ɔ. Nyameɛ hyehyɛle mmeraa ne, na ɔnate abɔfo mɔ so yeɛ ɔhyehyɛle ye wɔ ndamgyinaniɛ bie sa nu ɔ.

english_verse: There is only one God, and the Law did not come directly from him. Slaves and Children
translation_verse: Ndamgyinaniɛ de ogyi mmenia nyɔ b’afia, nakoso Nyameɛ de ɔte komapɛ.

english_verse: Does the Law disagree with God's promises? No, it doesn't! If any law could give life to us, we could become acceptable to God by obeying that law.
translation_verse: Aso ɛhe kyire kyɛ mmeraa ne tia Nyameɛ bɔhyɛ nemɔ anaa? Dabida! Ofikyɛ sɛ bɛmane sona mmeraa bie bɔ ɔkora ma daa ngoa de a, nzaade ahaa ɔte amba kyɛ sona nate mmeraa so yeɛ ɔyɛ tenenee ɔ.

english_verse: But the Scriptures say that sin controls everyone, so that God's promises will be for anyone who has faith in Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Nakoso Ahyerɛlɛ ne kyire kyɛ abɔdeɛ mukoraa wura bɔne bo; kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná bafa bɔhyɛ bɔ ogyi Yesu Kristo nu gyidie so ne bama agyidifoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The Law controlled us and kept us under its power until the time came when we would have faith.
translation_verse: Na anzana gyidie baawa ne, bɛfale yɛ bewurale mmeraa bo bɛwɛnene yɛ bɛmane gyidie bɔ né bɛbaala ye ali bekyire ne.

english_verse: In fact, the Law was to be our teacher until Christ came. Then we could have faith and be acceptable to God.
translation_verse: Yiti mmeraa ne yɛle yɛ neafoɛ maa oodwuli kyɛ Kristo wale ɔ, amaa ɔnate gyidie so Nyameɛ abua yɛ be.

english_verse: But once a person has learned to have faith, there is no more need to have the Law as a teacher.
translation_verse: Nakoso kekesaala ye bɔ gyidie wɔ berɛ ye de, yɛwwura neafoɛ ne bo ko.

english_verse: All of you are God's children because of your faith in Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛnate gyidie so bɛte Nyameɛ mma wɔ Kristo Yesu nu.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was as though you had put on Christ in the same way you put on new clothes.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ amukoraa bɔ babɔ ɛmɔ asu wɔ Kristo nu ne, ɛmɔafa Kristo bahera.

english_verse: Faith in Christ Jesus is what makes each of you equal with each other, whether you are a Jew or a Greek, a slave or a free person, a man or a woman.
translation_verse: Yiti Yudaniɛ ne Helaniɛ oo, akoaa ne dehyeɛ oo, bienzua ne brasua oo, nzonzoleɛ biala nne bɛ nu ko; ofikyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛte ko wɔ Kristo Yesu nu.

english_verse: So if you belong to Christ, you are now part of Abraham's family, and you will be given what God has promised.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔte Kristo deɛ a, nzaade ɛmɔte Abraham bosofoɛ, na ɛmɔnate bɔhyɛ ne aso bɛte koliagyaa.

english_verse: Children who are under age are no better off than slaves, even though everything their parents own will someday be theirs.
translation_verse: Ɛhe yeɛ mekyire ɔ: mmerɛ bɔ koliagyaa ne te akwadaa ne de, nzonzoleɛ biala nne ye ne akoaa bɛ nu, nakoso agyapadeɛ ne amukoraa te ye deɛ.

english_verse: This is because children are placed in the care of guardians and teachers until the time their parents have set.
translation_verse: Na ole mmenia bɔ bɛnea ye ne ye agyapadeɛ ne aso kɔpem mmerɛ bɔ ye baba ne ahyehyɛ ato berɛ ne.

english_verse: This is how it was with us. We were like children ruled by the powers of this world.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ né yɛte ɔ: mmerɛ bɔ né yɛte ngwadaa ne, bɛfale yɛ bɛyɛle ngoaa bewurale ewiase sunzum tumi bo.

english_verse: But when the time was right, God sent his Son, and a woman gave birth to him. His Son obeyed the Law,
translation_verse: Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ ahyehyɛ ato berɛ ne dwuli ne, ɔsomane Ɔwa ne maa ɔwale. Brasua yeɛ ɔwole ye ɔ, na bɛwole ye bewurale mmeraa ne abo,

english_verse: so he could set us free from the Law, and we could become God's children.
translation_verse: kyɛ oole bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ mmeraa ne abo ne, na yɛɛyɛ Nyameɛ mma.

english_verse: Now that we are his children, God has sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts. And his Spirit tells us that God is our Father.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔte mmaa ne ati, Nyameɛ asoma Ɔwa ne Sunzum maa waatena ɛmɔ ahone nu, bɔ ɔtea nu kyɛ “Abba! Baba!”

english_verse: You are no longer slaves. You are God's children, and you will be given what he has promised. Paul's Concern for the Galatians
translation_verse: Afei ɛtte akoaa ko, na mmom ɛte baa, na sɛ ɛte baa de a, nzaade ɔnate Kristo so ɛte Nyameɛ koliagyaa. Galatiafoɛ nwo hia Pɔɔlo

english_verse: Before you knew God, you were slaves of gods that are not real.
translation_verse: Daa ne bɔ né ɛmɔnze Nyameɛ nen, ɛmɔyɛle ngoaa bɛmane abɔdeɛ mɔ bɔ nna nyameɛ mɔ ahɔ ɔ.

english_verse: But now you know God, or better still, God knows you. How can you turn back and become the slaves of those weak and pitiful powers?
translation_verse: Nakoso kekesaala ye bɔ ɛmɔanwu Nyameɛ ye, anaa Nyameɛ anwu ɛmɔ ye de, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔsa bɛ si bieku bɛkɔ sunzum mɔ bɔ bɛyɛ mmerɛ na bɛ nwo anwumvoin berɛ, na ɛmɔpena kyɛ ɛmɔkɔyɛ bɛ ngoaa bieku ɔ?

english_verse: You even celebrate certain days, months, seasons, and years.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔbu ngyẽa bie ne bosome biemɔ ne mmerɛ bie ne afoɛ biemɔ kyɛ bedi mu.

english_verse: I am afraid I have wasted my time working with you.
translation_verse: Mesuro kyɛ ebiaa ɛmɔ nwo fɛɛ bɔ mafɛ ne ayɛ mbaen.

english_verse: My friends, I beg you to be like me, just as I once tried to be like you. Did you mistreat me
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, mesrɛ ɛmɔ, ɛ́mɔyɛ kyɛ me, kyɛbɔ me koso mayɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ ye. Ɛmɔyyɔle me tɛɛ biala.

english_verse: when I first preached to you? No you didn't, even though you knew I had come there because I was sick.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔse kyɛ né me nwo mva me ti yeɛ ɔmaa nnili moa ngane nzɛmba ne ngyirele ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: My illness must have caused you some trouble, but you didn't hate me or turn me away because of it. You welcomed me as though I were one of God's angels or even Christ Jesus himself.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ m’anwonyerɛ ne yɛle nzɔhwɛ mane ɛmɔ, nakoso ɛmɔammu me animtia, yeɛ ɛmɔambo me; na mmom ɛmɔlele me nyemene so kyɛ nyameɛso abɔfo, kyɛ ɛmɔkɔyɛ Kristo Yesu ne ala.

english_verse: Where is that good feeling now? I am sure if it had been possible, you would have taken out your own eyes and given them to me.
translation_verse: Afei anika bɔ ɛmɔnyane ye ne wɔ ni? Ofikyɛ medi ɛmɔ nwo adanzeɛ kyɛ sɛ ɔkɔyɛ yé po a, ahaa ɛmɔtutuli ɛmɔ nye bɛmane me.

english_verse: Am I now your enemy, just because I told you the truth?
translation_verse: Na sɛ meka nahorɛ mekyire ɛmɔ a, nzu ati yeɛ mayɛ ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ ɔ?

english_verse: Those people may be paying you a lot of attention, but it isn't for your good. They only want to keep you away from me, so you will pay them a lot of attention.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia nemɔ yɛ bɛ nwo kyɛ bekuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ, nakoso belle ɛmɔ nwo adwene paa. Bɛpena kyɛ bɛtoto me ne ɛmɔ afia, na ɛmɔ nye aha bɛ nwo.

english_verse: It is always good to give your attention to something worthwhile, even when I am not with you.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔte paa kyɛ mmenia konya ɛmɔ nwo adwene paa ná bahuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ daa ɔ, ná nna kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ me ne ɛmɔ yɛwɔ berɛ angome.

english_verse: My children, I am in terrible pain until Christ may be seen living in you.
translation_verse: Me mma ngwadaa, mesa medi ɛmɔ nwo yealɛ kyɛ brasua bɔ aworɛ aha ye ɔ kɔpem kyɛ Kristo sue ne kɔtena ɛmɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: I wish I were with you now. Then I would not have to talk this way. You really have me puzzled. Hagar and Sarah
translation_verse: Ɔhale me ngome a, ahaa nwɔ ɛmɔ berɛ kekesaala ye, na manwu kyɛbɔ nzi nga ye ɔ, ofikyɛ m’adwene nzi me pi wɔ ɛmɔ nwo! Pɔɔlo fa Hagar ne Sara yɛ mvandoho

english_verse: Some of you would like to be under the rule of the Law of Moses. But do you know what the Law says?
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔhã behyire me, ɛmɔ bɔ bɛpena kyɛ bewura mmeraa bo ne, ɛmɔnde bɔ mmeraa ne kã ne anaa?

english_verse: In the Scriptures we learn that Abraham had two sons. The mother of one of them was a slave, while the mother of the other one had always been free.
translation_verse: Bahyerɛ kyɛ né Abraham le mmaa mmienzua nyɔ; ko te afaneɛ awa, yeɛ ko koso te dehyeɛ awa.

english_verse: The son of the slave woman was born in the usual way. But the son of the free woman was born because of God's promise.
translation_verse: Bɔ oni te afaneɛ ne bɛwole ye anwoɔnaen nu atee so, nakoso bɔ oni te dehyeɛ ne de, bɛnate bɔhyɛ so yeɛ bɛwole ye ɔ.

english_verse: All of this has another meaning as well. Each of the two women stands for one of the agreements God made with his people. Hagar, the slave woman, stands for the agreement that was made at Mount Sinai. Everyone born into her family is a slave.
translation_verse: Ɛhemɔ te mvandoho, ofikyɛ mmrasua nyɔ ne gyi berɛ ma apam nyɔ. Ko bɔ ɔwo ye mma deɛ gua ngoaasolɛ nu ne ole Hagar, na ofi Sinai Bokaa ne aso.

english_verse: Hagar also stands for Mount Sinai in Arabia and for the present city of Jerusalem. She and her children are slaves.
translation_verse: Hagar gyi berɛ ma Sinai bokaa ne bɔ ɔwɔ Arabia, na osa gyi berɛ ma ɛnɛ Yerusalem, ofikyɛ Yerusalem ne ye mma wɔ ngoaasolɛ nu.

english_verse: But our mother is the city of Jerusalem in heaven above, and she isn't a slave.
translation_verse: Nakoso nyameɛso Yerusalem ne de, ɔnne ngoaasolɛ nu, na ɔte yɛ maame.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about her, “You have never had children, but now you can be glad. You have never given birth, but now you can shout. Once you had no children, but now you will have more children than a woman who has been married for a long time.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Ma wɔ nye gye, wɔ, mmotaen bɔ ɛnwo ɔ! Di ahurusi né tea nu, wɔ bɔ ennwu aworɛ yealɛ ɔ! Ofikyɛ brasua bɔ bɛpole ye ne, ole mmaa pee tra brasua bɔ ogya biaa ne.”

english_verse: My friends, you were born because of this promise, just as Isaac was.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, kyɛbɔ Yisake te bɔhyɛ ba ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛ koso yɛte bɔhyɛ mma ɔ.

english_verse: But the child who was born in the natural way made trouble for the child who was born because of the Spirit. The same thing is happening today.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ sɔ mmerɛ ne, akwadaa bɔ bɛnate anwoɔnaen nu atee so bɛwole ye ne osi tanene bɔ bɛnate Sunzum nu bɛwole ye ne nye nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛnɛ koso ɔte ɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Get rid of the slave woman and her son! He won't be given anything. The son of the free woman will receive everything.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Ahyerɛlɛ ne nwa nzɛ? Ɔnwa, “Foa afaneɛ ne ne ɔwa ne; ofikyɛ afaneɛ n’awa ne, ɔne dehyeɛ n’awa ne, bɛngɔbɔ nu bengoli bia.”

english_verse: My friends, we are children of the free woman and not of the slave.
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛtte afaneɛ ne mma, na mmom yɛte dehyeɛ ne mma.

english_verse: Christ has set us free! This means we are really free. Now hold on to your freedom and don't ever become slaves of the Law again.
translation_verse: Kristo ama yɛ fawɔnwodi amaa yayɛ nnehyeɛ. Yiti ɛ́mɔgyina pindinn, na nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ nwo bewura ngoaasolɛ nu ko.

english_verse: I, Paul, promise you that Christ won't do you any good if you get circumcised.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie! Me, Pɔɔlo, mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ sɛ ɛmɔmaa bɛpɛ ɛmɔ bienzua a, Kristo nwo ngɔwa mvasoɛ biala ngɔma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: And if you try to please God by obeying the Law, you have cut yourself off from Christ and his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔpena kyɛ bɛfa mmeraa ne aso bebua ɛmɔ be nen, ɛmɔ ne Kristo afia atete, na Nyameɛ adom abɔ ɛmɔ.

english_verse: But the Spirit makes us sure God will accept us because of our faith in Christ.
translation_verse: Na yɛ de, gyidie yeɛ yɛfa yɛnate Sunzum ne so bɔ yanya tenenee nwo anyelasoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If you are a follower of Christ Jesus, it makes no difference whether you are circumcised or not. All that matters is your faith that makes you love others.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɛ yɛne Kristo Yesu yɛ ko de a, bienzuapɛlɛ oo, nna bienzuapɛlɛ oo, ye nwo nhia, na mmom gyidie bɔ ɔnate ɔdɔ so yɔ adwuma yeɛ ohia ɔ.

english_verse: You were doing so well until someone made you turn from the truth.
translation_verse: Né ɛmɔtu amirika ne paa! Na afei nwa yeɛ osili ɛmɔ ate bɔ ɔmaa ɛmɔyɛ nahorɛ ne nwo asoserɛ ɔ?

english_verse: And that person was certainly not sent by the one who chose you.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔfrɛle ɛmɔ ne, nna ye yeɛ osele ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ sɔ ɔ.

english_verse: A little yeast can change a whole batch of dough,
translation_verse: Mɔle harewaa kãa bie yeɛ ɔma mɔle torɛ ne amu keka ɔ.

english_verse: but you belong to the Lord. This makes me certain you will do what I say, instead of what someone else tells you to do. Whoever is causing trouble for you will be punished.
translation_verse: Mede ɛmɔ medi wɔ Awurade nu kyɛ ɛmɔngonya adwene foforɛ biala. Na mmom ebiala bɔ ɔha ɛmɔ nen, sɛ ɔte nzikyɛ sona po a, okonya ye nwo akatuaa.

english_verse: My friends, if I still preach that people need to be circumcised, why am I in so much trouble? The message about the cross would no longer be a problem, if I told people to be circumcised.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, sɛ mekɔ so mekã kyɛ bienzuapɛlɛ nwo hia a, nzu ati yeɛ bɛkɔ so bɛtane me nye ɔ? Nzaade ahaa mmeamudua ne sundidua ne ɔnne berɛ ko.

english_verse: I wish everyone who is upsetting you would not only get circumcised, but would cut off much more!
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔhale me ngome a, ahaa bɛ bɔ bɛsɛkye ɛmɔ adwene ne atutu bɛ bienzua bo bagua!

english_verse: My friends, you were chosen to be free. So don't use your freedom as an excuse to do anything you want. Use it as an opportunity to serve each other with love.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, bafrɛ ɛmɔ bawa fawɔnwodi nu; yiti nnɛmɔma fawɔnwodi ne diedie ɛmɔ kɔ anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ nu, na mmom ɛ́mɔfa ɔdɔ so bɛso bɛ nwo ngoko ngoko.

english_verse: All the Law says can be summed up in the command to love others as much as you love yourself.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ babɔ mmeraa ne amukoraa porɛ komapɛ kyɛ, “Kuro ebiɛngo dwirɛ kyɛ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo.”

english_verse: But if you keep attacking each other like wild animals, you had better watch out or you will destroy yourselves. God's Spirit and Our Own Desires
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔkeka ná ɛmɔpurapura ɛmɔ nwo de a, ɛ́mɔnea yé ná ɛmɔangukũ ɛmɔ nwo. Sunzum ne, ɔne sona sue

english_verse: If you are guided by the Spirit, you won't obey your selfish desires.
translation_verse: Bɔ mekã ɛhe: ɛ́mɔnate Sunzum nu, na nnɛma ɛmɔdi anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ si.

english_verse: The Spirit and your desires are enemies of each other. They are always fighting each other and keeping you from doing what you feel you should.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ ko tia Sunzum ne, na Sunzum koso ko tia anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ ne. Bɛ munyɔ benyia, yiti ɔmaa ɛmɔngora nyɔ nikyee bɔ ɛmɔkuro kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: But if you obey the Spirit, the Law of Moses has no control over you.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ Sunzum ne kyire ɛmɔ atee a, ye de nna mmeraa bo yeɛ ɛmɔwura ɔ.

english_verse: People's desires make them give in to immoral ways, filthy thoughts, and shameful deeds.
translation_verse: Anwoɔnaen dwumadie bɔ odi da adi pefee. Bɛ ɛhe: agyaasɛkyelɛ, adwamanbɔlɛ, efiɛ, ahohwie,

english_verse: envious. They get drunk, carry on at wild parties, and do other evil things as well. I told you before, and I am telling you again: No one who does these things will share in the blessings of God's kingdom.
translation_verse: anyeboroborolɛ, awuelilɛ, nzaabolɛ, ewiase anigye mbaen mbaen ɔne nningyein bɔ ɔtete sɔa ɔ. Mebɔ ɛmɔ ɛhemɔ nwo kɔkɔ, kyɛbɔ mabɔ ɛmɔ kɔkɔ daa ne, kyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ sɔ nningyein nemɔ ngɔhɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu.

english_verse: God's Spirit makes us loving, happy, peaceful, patient, kind, good, faithful,
translation_verse: Nakoso Sunzum ne de, ɔma ɔdɔ, anigye, asomdwee, aboterɛ, adɔeɛyɛlɛ, paayɛlɛ, gyidie,

english_verse: gentle, and self-controlled. There is no law against behaving in any of these ways.
translation_verse: anwobrɛaseɛ, anwohyɛsoɛ. Mmeraa biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔko tia ɛhemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: And because we belong to Christ Jesus, we have killed our selfish feelings and desires.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bɛte Kristo Yesu deɛ ne, babɔ anwoɔnaen ne ne ye akɔnnɔ, ɔne bɔ ɔhyɛ anwoɔnaen ne aso mmeamudua nu.

english_verse: God's Spirit has given us life, and so we should follow the Spirit.
translation_verse: Sɛ Sunzum ne ama yɛ ngoa a, nzaade ɛmɔma Sunzum ne koso li yɛ nyunu wɔ asetena nu.

english_verse: But don't be conceited or make others jealous by claiming to be better than they are.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma yɛmoma yɛ nwo so, yɛfefɛ yɛ nwo yaa ná yɛma yɛ nye boro yɛ biɛngo.

english_verse: My friends, you are spiritual. So if someone is trapped in sin, you should gently lead that person back to the right path. But watch out, and don't be tempted yourself.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, sɛ ɛmɔ nu bie yɔ bɔne a, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔte sunzum nufoɛ ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa aboterɛ bɛtengyɛtengyɛ ye. Nakoso nea wɔ nwo yé ná wɔ wora angɔ nzɔhwɛ nu.

english_verse: You obey the law of Christ when you offer each other a helping hand.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbokaboka bɛ nwo, na sɔ yeɛ ɔmaa ɛmɔdi Kristo mmeraa ne aso pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If you think you are better than others, when you really aren't, you are wrong.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɛ ebie dwene kyɛ odi mu, nakoso ɔtte huu a, ɔlakalaka ye bɔbɔ ye nwo.

english_verse: Do your own work well, and then you will have something to be proud of. But don't compare yourself with others.
translation_verse: Yiti ma oso ye bɔbɔ ye adwuma nea, na ɛhe kɔmaa ɔkɔfa nikyee bɔ ye bɔbɔ wayɔ kɔhoahoa ye nwo, na ɔngɔfa ebie deɛ.

english_verse: We each must carry our own load.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ebiala kɔsoa ye bɔbɔ ye adesoa.

english_verse: Share every good thing you have with anyone who teaches you what God has said.
translation_verse: Ma ebiala bɔ osua nzɛmba ne, ɔma ye kyerɛkyerɛniɛ ye nikyee paa biala bɔ ole ɔ bie.

english_verse: You cannot fool God, so don't make a fool of yourself! You will harvest what you plant.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔlakalaka bɛ nwo, na bɛgoro Nyameɛ nwo. Ofikyɛ bɔ sona dua ne ala yeɛ okobu ɔ.

english_verse: If you follow your selfish desires, you will harvest destruction, but if you follow the Spirit, you will harvest eternal life.
translation_verse: Na bɔ sona biala dua ye wɔ anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ nu ne, okonya ewue kofi anwoɔnaen nu; nakoso bɔ odua ye wɔ Sunzum nu ne, okonya daa ngoa kofi Sunzum nu.

english_verse: Don't get tired of helping others. You will be rewarded when the time is right, if you don't give up.
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛmɔma yɛfɛ paayɛlɛ nwo; ofikyɛ sɛ yamba aba a, yɛkonya ye nwo saleɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu.

english_verse: We should help people whenever we can, especially if they are followers of the Lord. Final Warnings
translation_verse: Yiti mmerɛ bɔ atee wɔ berɛ ma yɛ ye de, ɛ́mɔma yɛyɔ mmenia amukoraa paa, nganga bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ agyidifoɛ abusua fekue ne anu ne. Kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne ahyebisalɛ

english_verse: You can see what big letters I make when I write with my own hand.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔnea ahyerɛlɛ mbiri bɔ mafa me bɔbɔ me sa mahyerɛ mabrɛ ɛmɔ ye!

english_verse: Those people who are telling you to get circumcised are only trying to show how important they are. And they don't want to get into trouble for preaching about the cross of Christ.
translation_verse: Mmenia bɔ bɛpena anwoɔnaen nu animnyam nen, bɛ yeɛ bɛhyɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔpɛ ɛmɔ bienzua ɔ. Na bɛyɔ sɔ kyɛbɔ Kristo mmeamudua ne ati mmenia ngɔtane bɛ nye ɔ.

english_verse: They are circumcised, but they don't obey the Law of Moses. All they want is to brag about having you circumcised.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bapɛ bɛ bienzua ne po, bɛ bɔbɔ benni mmeraa ne aso; nakoso bɛpena kyɛ ɛmɔpɛ ɛmɔ bienzua, amaa ɔnate so bahoahoa bɛ nwo ɛmɔ nwonaen nu.

english_verse: But I will never brag about anything except the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. Because of his cross, the world is dead as far as I am concerned, and I am dead as far as the world is concerned.
translation_verse: Na me de, Nyameɛ pa gua kyɛ ngɔfa nikyee bie ngɔhoahoa me nwo, sana y’Awurade Yesu Kristo mmeamudua ne ngome; ofikyɛ ɔnate mmeamudua ne aso babɔ wiase mmeamudua nu bama me, na me koso babɔ me mmeamudua nu bama wiase.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are circumcised or not. All that matters is that you are a new person.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie pɛ ye bienzua oo, wambɛ ye bienzua oo, nu biala nwo nhia; kyɛ bɛkɔwo wɔ foforɛ yeɛ ohia ɔ.

english_verse: If you follow this rule, you will belong to God's true people. God will treat you with undeserved kindness and will bless you with peace.
translation_verse: Na mmenia amukoraa bɔ bedi nhyehyɛleɛ he aso ne, asomdwee ne anwumvoinnwunɛ ɔyɛ bɛ, ɔne Yisrael bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ deɛ ne ye deɛ.

english_verse: On my own body are scars that prove I belong to Christ Jesus. So I don't want anyone to bother me anymore.
translation_verse: Ofi ɛnɛ bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, nnɛma ebiala ha me; ofikyɛ manya Yesu etwa wɔ me nipadua nwo.

english_verse: My friends, I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you! Amen.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, y’Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne ɛmɔ sunzum bɛtena. Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus. To God's people who live in Ephesus and are faithful followers of Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo bɔ ɔnate Nyameɛ pɛ so nde Kristo Yesu somafoɛ ne, mefa mebrɛ anwoteefoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Ɛfeso bɔ bɛte Kristo Yesu nu agyidifoɛ ne.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Christ Brings Spiritual Blessings
translation_verse: Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. Sunzum nu saleɛ wɔ Kristo nu

english_verse: Praise the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ for the spiritual blessings that Christ has brought us from heaven!
translation_verse: Animnyam hã Nyameɛ, y’Awurade Yesu Kristo Baba ne, bɔ wafa sunzum nu saleɛ amukoraa bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso wayira yɛ wɔ Kristo nu ne,

english_verse: Before the world was created, God had Christ choose us to live with him and to be his holy and innocent and loving people.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ ɔneaneane nu yele yɛ wɔ ɔdɔ nu, Kristo nu koraka yeɛ bɛbaahyɛ wiase bo, kyɛ yɛyɛ krongron bɔ ngekalewa biala nne yɛ nwo wɔ ye nyunu ne.

english_verse: God was kind and decided that Christ would choose us to be God's own adopted children.
translation_verse: Na ɔneaneane nu yele yɛ siele berɛ kyɛ ɔnate Yesu Kristo so ɔkɔfa yɛ kɔyɛ ye mma, kyɛbɔ ye nhyehyɛleɛ botaeɛ te ne;

english_verse: God treated us with undeserved grace because of the Son he dearly loves, and so we should praise God.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so yaye ye animnyam adom bɔ ɔnate ye ahone nu Ba ne aso wafa walo yɛ ne ayɛ.

english_verse: and by what Christ has done, God has shown us his own mysterious ways.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ wamaa yanwu ye mvealeɛ nu apɛdeɛ, kyɛbɔ ye nhyehyɛleɛ botaeɛ bɔ ɔhyehyɛle ye wɔ Kristo nu ne ɔte ɔ.

english_verse: Then when the time is right, God will do all he has planned, and Christ will bring together everything in heaven and on earth.
translation_verse: Na sɔ nhyehyɛleɛ ne kyire kyɛ mmerɛ ne adwu kyɛ ɔkɔboaboa abɔdeɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ nyameɛso ne aseɛ so noa ɔkɔbɔ nu wɔ Kristo nu.

english_verse: God always does what he plans, and this is why he appointed Christ to choose us.
translation_verse: Na ye bɔ ɔyɔ ye nikyee biala kyɛbɔ ye nhyehyɛleɛ ne ye pɛ osi te ne, wafa Kristo so waneanea nu waye yɛ kyɛ yɛyɛ ye deɛ;

english_verse: He did this so we Jews would bring honor to him and be the first ones to have hope because of him.
translation_verse: kyɛ yɛ bɔ yɛlili moa yɛnyane Kristo nu gyidie ne yɛɛyɛ ye animnyam ne ayɛyelɛ.

english_verse: Christ also brought you the truth, which is the good news about how you can be saved. You put your faith in Christ and were given the promised Holy Spirit to show you belong to God.
translation_verse: Na ye nu yeɛ ɛmɔ koso, ɛmɔtele nahorɛ dwirɛ bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ ngoalelɛ nwo nzɛmba ne ɔ. Ye ala nu koso yeɛ ɛmɔle belili ɔ, na ɔfale Sunzum Krongron bɔ wahyɛ ye nwo bɔ ne hyɛle ɛmɔ nzorɛ kyɛ ɛmɔte ye deɛ,

english_verse: The Spirit also makes us sure we will be given what God has stored up for his people. Then we will be set free, and God will be honored and praised. Paul's Prayer
translation_verse: bɔ osi yɛ agyapadeɛ ne agyinayɛɛ ɔ. Na ɛhe te elelɛ bɔ wafa wale bɛ bɔ wafa bɛ wayɛ ye deɛ wama ye animnyam ayɛyelɛ ne. Pɔɔlo mbaeɛ

english_verse: I have heard about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: Yiti me koso, ofi mmerɛ bɔ ndele ɛmɔ gyidie wɔ Awurade Yesu nu ɔne anwoteefoɛ amukoraa nwo dɔ bɔ ɛmɔle ye ne,

english_verse: So I never stop being grateful for you, as I mention you in my prayers.
translation_verse: nnyakyili ɛmɔ nwo asennaa, na mekaye ɛmɔ wɔ me mbaeɛbɔlɛ nu:

english_verse: I ask the glorious Father and God of our Lord Jesus Christ to give you his Spirit. The Spirit will make you wise and let you understand what it means to know God.
translation_verse: kyɛ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo Nyameɛ, bɔ ɔte animnyam Baba ne, ɔ́ma ɛmɔ nworɛ ne nyekyire sunzum wɔ ye nwo nimdeɛ nu,

english_verse: My prayer is that light will flood your hearts and you will understand the hope given to you when God chose you. Then you will discover the glorious blessings that will be yours together with all God's people.
translation_verse: ná óbukye ɛmɔ adwene nu ma ɛmɔnya ndeaseɛ, amaa ɛmɔanwu anyelasoɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ye frɛlɛ bɔ wafrɛ ɛmɔ ne anu, ɔne ye agyapadeɛ animnyam anwonya wɔ anwoteefoɛ nu.

english_verse: I want you to know about the great and mighty power that God has for us followers. It is the same wonderful power he used
translation_verse: Mesrɛ kyɛ, ɔma ɛmɔnwu ye tumi totohyia bɔ ɔbo so ma yɛ bɔ yɛde yɛdi ne, kyɛbɔ ye anwoserɛ tumi nikyeeyɔlɛ

english_verse: when he raised Christ from death and let him sit at his right side in heaven.
translation_verse: bɔ ɔfa lili dwumaa wɔ Kristo nu, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ otingyele ye fili awufoɛ nu ne ɔte ne. Ɔfale ye ɔɔtenane ye sa famaa so wɔ nyameɛso,

english_verse: There Christ rules over all forces, authorities, powers, and rulers. He rules over all beings in this world and will rule in the future world as well.
translation_verse: na ɔte ahennie, tumi, anwoserɛ ne meneɛ amukoraa so hene, ɔne dumaa biala bɔ bɛfa bɛfrɛ ɔ, bɔ nna wiase wa angome, na mmom ewiase bɔ ɔbaawa ne koso anu.

english_verse: God has put all things under the power of Christ, and for the good of the church he has made him the head of everything.
translation_verse: Na wafa nningyein amukoraa wawura Kristo gya bo, na wafa ye wayɛ nningyein amukoraa so tire wama asɔre ne,

english_verse: The church is the body of Christ and is filled with Christ who completely fills everything.
translation_verse: bɔ ɔte ye nipadua ne, bɔ ɔma nningyein mukoraa di mu wɔ nningyein mukoraa nu ne.

english_verse: In the past you were dead because you sinned and fought against God.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ de, ahaa ɛmɔte awufoɛ wɔ mvomsoɛ ne bɔne nu,

english_verse: You followed the ways of this world and obeyed the devil. He rules the world, and his spirit has power over everyone who doesn't obey God.
translation_verse: bɔ daa ne, ɛmɔbɔle ɛmɔ bra kyɛbɔ wiase brabɔlɛ te ɔ, bɔ ɛmɔlili ewienu tumi panyi ne si, bɔ ɔte sunzum bɔ kekesaala ye odi dwumaa wɔ asoserɛfoɛ nu ne.

english_verse: Once we were also ruled by the selfish desires of our bodies and minds. We had made God angry, and we were going to be punished like everyone else.
translation_verse: Na sɔ nningyein nemɔ anu yeɛ daa ne, yɛ mukoraa yɛfale so yɛbɔle yɛ bra wɔ anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ nu, ná yɛlili anwoɔnaen ne adwene apɛdeɛ si ɔ; na kyɛbɔ yɛ sue te ne, yɛyɛle mmenia bɔ Nyameɛ ahone ahu bɛ so ɔ, kyɛ mmenia bɔ baha ne ala.

english_verse: God raised us from death to life with Christ Jesus, and he has given us a place beside Christ in heaven.
translation_verse: Na watingye yɛ ne ye, na wafa yɛ ne ye waatena nyameɛso dɔ wɔ Kristo Yesu nu,

english_verse: God did this so in the future world he could show how truly good and kind he is to us because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: kyɛ ewiase bɔ ɔ́ba ne anu ɔkɔla ye adom anwonya mmorosoɛ ne ali wɔ paayɛlɛ bɔ ɔyɛ yɛ Kristo Yesu nu ne anu.

english_verse: You were saved by faith in God, who treats us much better than we deserve. This is God's gift to you, and not anything you have done on your own.
translation_verse: Na adom yeɛ bɛnate gyidie so bale ɛmɔ ngoa ɔ, nna bɔ ɛmɔayɔ hɔ ɔ, ɔte Nyameɛ akyɛdeɛ;

english_verse: It isn't something you have earned, so there is nothing you can brag about.
translation_verse: nna ɛmɔ nnwumaa ti ɔ, ná ebiala amva anhoahoa ye nwo.

english_verse: God planned for us to do good things and to live as he has always wanted us to live. This is why he sent Christ to make us what we are. United by Christ
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ yɛte ye adwiililɛ bɔ wali ɔ, bɔ ɔbɔle yɛ Kristo Yesu nu mane nnwumaa paa bɔ Nyameɛ asiesie ato berɛ kyɛ yɛfa yɛbɔ yɛ bra ɔ. Yɛte ko wɔ Kristo nu

english_verse: Don't forget that you are Gentiles. In fact, you used to be called “uncircumcised” by those who take pride in being circumcised.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔkaye kyɛ, daa ne, ahaa né ɛmɔte Amaenmaensofoɛ wɔ anwoɔnaen nu. Na bɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ bɛ nwo bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ, bɔ bɛ sa mbaen yeɛ bɛfa bɛpɛ ye anwoɔnaen nu ne, né bɛfrɛ ɛmɔ bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ.

english_verse: At that time you did not know about Christ. You were foreigners to the people of Israel, and you had no part in the promises God had made to them. You were living in this world without hope and without God,
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔkaye kyɛ, sɔ mmerɛ ne, né ɛmɔ ne Kristo b’afia atete; né ɛmɔte amanvrafoɛ bɔ bɛnga ɛmɔ bɛmmoka Yisrael maen mmaa so ɔ; né ɛmɔte ɛwɔfoɛ wɔ apam bɔhyɛ ahoroɔ ne anwo, bɔ né ɛmɔlle anyelasoɛ biala, bɔ né ɛmɔlle Nyameɛ wɔ wiase ɔ.

english_verse: and you were far from God. But Christ offered his life's blood as a sacrifice and brought you near God.
translation_verse: Nakoso afei de, Kristo nu, ɛmɔ bɔ ahaa né ɛmɔwɔ dedeede ne, ɛmɔafa Kristo mogya ne aso bapingye.

english_verse: Christ has made peace between Jews and Gentiles, and he has united us by breaking down the wall of hatred that separated us. Christ gave his own body
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ye yeɛ ɔte yɛ asomdwee ɔ, wahã nyɔ ne wabɔ nu wayɛ ye ko, na wadwiri ɛpɔen fasue bɔ ɔla yɛ afia ne wagua,

english_verse: to destroy the Law of Moses with all its rules and commands. He even brought Jews and Gentiles together as though we were only one person, when he united us in peace.
translation_verse: ɔnate kyɛ waye ɛpɔen bɔ ɔte mmeraa dwirɛ ahoroɔ bɔ ɔwɔ ahyɛdeɛ nu ne wafi berɛ wɔ ye nwonaen nu, na wahã bɛ munyɔ ne wabɔ nu wayɛ bɛ sona foforɛ ko, wɔ ye bɔbɔ ye nu ama asomdwee awa,

english_verse: On the cross Christ did away with our hatred for each other. He also made peace between us and God by uniting Jews and Gentiles in one body.
translation_verse: na wafa mmeamudua ne aso wasiesie yɛ munyɔ ne ne Nyameɛ y’afia, wɔ nipadua ko nu, na ɔnate so watu ɛpɔen ne bo.

english_verse: Christ came and preached peace to you Gentiles, who were far from God, and peace to us Jews, who were near God.
translation_verse: Na ɔwale ɔɔbɔle asomdwee nwo dawure hyirele ɛmɔ bɔ né ɛmɔwɔ dedeede ne, ɔne bɛ bɔ bepingye ne;

english_verse: And because of Christ, all of us can come to the Father by the same Spirit.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ye so yeɛ yɛ munyɔ ne yɛnate Sunzum komapɛ nu yɛnya atee yɛkɔ Baba ne berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You Gentiles are no longer strangers and foreigners. You are citizens with everyone else who belongs to the family of God.
translation_verse: Yiti afei de, ɛmɔtte ɛwɔfoɛ ne amanvrafoɛ ko, na mmom ɛmɔ ne anwoteefoɛ nemɔ bɛte maen mmaa ne Nyameɛ awuro ama.

english_verse: You are like a building with the apostles and prophets as the foundation and with Christ as the most important stone.
translation_verse: Bafa ɛmɔ basie asomafoɛ nemɔ ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ fapem bɔ Yesu Kristo bɔbɔ yeɛ ɔte ye ndweasoɛ nyɔboɛ titire ne aso.

english_verse: Christ is the one who holds the building together and makes it grow into a holy temple for the Lord.
translation_verse: Ye nu yeɛ bɔ bahyehyɛ ne ngorabata amukoraa basosɔ ɔ, na ɔpagya kɔ anwuro kɔyɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua krongron wɔ Awurade nu;

english_verse: And you are part of that building Christ has built as a place for God's own Spirit to live.
translation_verse: bɔ ye nu yeɛ bɛ́fa ɛmɔ koso besi maa ɔyɛ Nyameɛ atenaleɛ wɔ Sunzum nu ɔ.

english_verse: Christ Jesus made me his prisoner, so I could help you Gentiles.
translation_verse: Ɔnate ɛhe ati, me Pɔɔlo, nde Kristo Yesu kukununiɛ mema ɛmɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ.

english_verse: You have surely heard about God's gift of undeserved grace in choosing me to help you.
translation_verse: Na mesusu kyɛ ɛmɔate Nyameɛ adwuma nwo adom bɔ ɛmɔ ti wafa walo me ne,

english_verse: In fact, this letter tells you a little about how God has shown me his mysterious ways.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ ɔnate nyekyire so maa nwuni mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne, kyɛbɔ mahyerɛ ye nwo dwirɛ kãa dada ne.

english_verse: As you read the letter, you will also find out how well I really do understand the mystery about Christ.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔkenga he a, ɛmɔkonwu kyɛbɔ mesi mete Kristo mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne bo ɔ,

english_verse: No one knew about this mystery until God's Spirit told it to his holy apostles and prophets.
translation_verse: mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ bɔ banna ye ali bangyire mmenia mmaa wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ biemɔ anu, kyɛbɔ kekesaala ye de Sunzum ne waye wahyire ye asomafoɛ ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ krongron mɔ ne.

english_verse: And the mystery is this: Because of Christ Jesus, the good news has given the Gentiles a share in the promises God gave to the Jews. God has also let the Gentiles be part of the same body.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ma Amaenmaensofoɛ koso bele kyɛfa wɔ nu, bɛwɔ nipadua komapɛ ne ala nu bie, na bɛnate nzɛmba ne aso banya kyɛfa wɔ ye bɔhyɛ ne anu wɔ Kristo Yesu nu.

english_verse: God treated me with kindness. His power worked in me, and it became my job to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Na nzɛmba he anwo yeɛ bayɛ me somvoɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ adom akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔnate ye tumi adwumayɔlɛ so wafa walo me ne ɔte ne.

english_verse: I am the least important of all God's people. But God was kind and chose me to tell the Gentiles that because of Christ there are blessings that cannot be measured.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ me yeɛ nde kãa paa wɔ anwoteefoɛ ne amukoraa nu ɔ, nakoso Nyameɛ amaa manya sɔ adom he, kyɛ mmɔ Kristo anwonya bɔ ɔbo sona ndeaseɛ so ne dawure ngyire Amaenmaensofoɛ;

english_verse: God, who created everything, wanted me to help everyone understand the mysterious plan that had always been hidden in his mind.
translation_verse: kyɛ mmukye mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ he aso ngyire adasa mmaa mukoraa, ofikyɛ ofi tete yeɛ wafea wɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔbɔle nningyein mukoraa ne anu ɔ;

english_verse: Then God would use the church to show the powers and authorities in the spiritual world that he has many different kinds of wisdom.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ afei ɔnate asɔre ne aso, Nyameɛ nworɛ ne kɔla ye nwo ali wɔ atee ahoroɔ so kohyire ahennie ne tumi ahoroɔ bɔ bɛwɔ anwuro dɔ ɔ.

english_verse: God did this according to his eternal plan. And he was able to do what he had planned because of all Christ Jesus our Lord had done.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe te ye nhyehyɛleɛ afebɔɔ bɔ ɔnate y’Awurade Yesu Kristo so wawa nu ɔ.

english_verse: Christ now gives us courage and confidence, so we can come to God by faith.
translation_verse: Na gyidie bɔ yanya ye wɔ Kristo nu ne ati, yɛkora yɛsi y’ahone yɛkɔ Nyameɛ nyunu wɔ anyelasoɛ nu.

english_verse: This is why you should not be discouraged when I suffer for you. After all, it will bring honor to you. Christ's Love for Us
translation_verse: Yiti mesrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ, nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ abasa nu bu wɔ amaneɛ bɔ ɔnate ɛmɔ ti menwu ye ne anwo, ofikyɛ ɔte ɛmɔ animnyam. Kristo dɔ

english_verse: I kneel in prayer to the Father.
translation_verse: Ɔnate ɛhe ati, mekoto mesrɛ [y’Awurade Yesu Kristo] Baba,

english_verse: All beings in heaven and on earth receive their life from him.
translation_verse: bɔ ye nu yeɛ abusua biala bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne aseɛ so onya ye dumaa fi ne,

english_verse: God is wonderful and glorious. I pray that his Spirit will make you become strong followers
translation_verse: kyɛ ófi ye animnyam anwonya nu ma ɛmɔfa ye Sunzum so benya tumi nu anwoserɛ wɔ ɛmɔ nu, wɔ sona sue ne anu,

english_verse: and that Christ will live in your hearts because of your faith. Stand firm and be deeply rooted in his love.
translation_verse: amaa Kristo afa gyidie so watena ɛmɔ ahone nu, ná ɛ́mɔatira ndii batindim wɔ ɔdɔ nu,

english_verse: I pray that you and all God's people will understand what is called wide or long or high or deep.
translation_verse: amaa ɛmɔahora bɛne anwoteefoɛ amukoraa bate kyɛbɔ osi trɛ, osi te tendenn, osi wale, ɔne kyɛbɔ osi te kuronn ɔ bo,

english_verse: I want you to know all about Christ's love, although it is too wonderful to be measured. Then your lives will be filled with all that God is.
translation_verse: ná ɛmɔanwu Kristo ɔdɔ ne bɔ ɔbo nimdeɛ so ne, amaa ɔnate so Nyameɛ sue ne amukoraa wayi ɛmɔ nu tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: I pray that Christ Jesus and the church will forever bring praise to God. His power at work in us can do far more than we dare ask or imagine. Amen.
translation_verse: animnyam hã ye wɔ asɔre ne anu ne Kristo Yesu nu wɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ amukoraa nu daa daa afebɔɔ. Amen.

english_verse: As a prisoner of the Lord, I beg you to live in a way that is worthy of the people God has chosen to be his own.
translation_verse: Yiti afei me, Awurade kukununiɛ, mesrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛ́mɔbɔ bra bɔ ɔfata ɛfrɛlɛ bɔ bafa bafrɛ ɛmɔ ne,

english_verse: Always be humble and gentle. Patiently put up with each other and love each other.
translation_verse: anwobrɛaseɛ ne awiɛmvoɛyɛlɛ amukoraati nu, aboterɛ nu, ná ɛmɔhurohuro ebiala dwirɛ kyɛbɔ ebiala te ɔ wɔ ɔdɔ nu;

english_verse: Try your best to let God's Spirit keep your hearts united. Do this by living at peace.
translation_verse: ɛ́mɔbɔ mmɔden bɛ́ma Sunzum koyɛlɛ ne ɔ́tena berɛ wɔ asomdwee ngabonu nu.

english_verse: All of you are part of the same body. There is only one Spirit of God, just as you were given one hope when you were chosen to be God's people.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nipadua komapɛ ne Sunzum komapɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ bafrɛ ɛmɔ koso wɔ anyelasoɛ komapɛ nu wɔ ɛmɔ frɛlɛ ne anu ne;

english_verse: We have only one Lord, one faith, and one baptism.
translation_verse: Awurade komapɛ, gyidie komapɛ, asubɔlɛ komapɛ;

english_verse: There is one God who is the Father of all people. Not only is God above all others, but he works by using all of us, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: yɛ mukoraa yɛ Nyameɛ ne Baba komapɛ bɔ odi yɛ mukoraa so ɔ, odi dwumaa wɔ yɛ mukoraa nu, na ɔte yɛ mukoraa nu. Sunzum Krongron akyɛdeɛ

english_verse: Christ has generously divided out his gifts to us.
translation_verse: Nakoso bafa adom balo yɛ nu biala, kyɛbɔ Kristo asusu ye akyɛdeɛ wafa wama ɔ.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “When he went up to the highest place, he led away many prisoners and gave gifts to people.”
translation_verse: Yiti ɔnwa: “Mmerɛ bɔ ɔfo hɔle anwuro anwuro nen; ɔhyele pee nnure ɔne bɛ hɔle, na ɔmane mmenia akyɛdeɛ.”

english_verse: When it says, “he went up,” it means that Christ had been deep in the earth.
translation_verse: (Na sɛ ɔkã kyɛ: Ɔfo hɔle anwuro anwuro a, aso né ongyire kyɛ olili moa odwu hɔle aseɛ bo dɔ koraka?

english_verse: This also means that the one who went deep into the earth is the same one who went into the highest heaven, so he would fill the whole universe.
translation_verse: Na bɔ odwu wale ne, ye ala yeɛ ɔfo hɔle anwuro trale nyameɛso amukoraa ne, amaa wayi nningyein amukoraa nu tɛkyɛ.)

english_verse: Christ chose some of us to be apostles, prophets, missionaries, pastors, and teachers,
translation_verse: Na ye akyɛdeɛ ne ama ebiemɔ ayɛ asomafoɛ, ebiemɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ, ebiemɔ nzɛmbahanɛfoɛ, ebiemɔ neafoɛ mɔ, yeɛ ebiemɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ,

english_verse: so his people would learn to serve and his body would grow strong.
translation_verse: kyɛ bɛfa bɛtete anwoteefoɛ bɛma ɛsolɛ adwuma ne, amaa Kristo nipadua ne anya ngɔsoɛ,

english_verse: This will continue until we are united by our faith and by our understanding of the Son of God. Then we will be mature, just as Christ is, and we will be completely like him.
translation_verse: kodwu kyɛ yɛ mukoraa yɛkonya Nyameɛ Awa ne nwo gyidie ɔne ye nwo nimdeɛ wɔ koyɛyɛlɛ nu, ná yayɛ mmenia bɔ yanyi yayie, bɔ yanya Kristo ye sue tebea ne tɛkyɛ ɔ,

english_verse: We must stop acting like children. We must not let deceitful people trick us by their false teachings, which are like winds that toss us around from place to place.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so yangɔ so yanyɛ ngwadaammaa bɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ mvrama biala ɔbɔ bɛ papapapa fa bɛ di akɔneaba ɔ, mmenia nnakannaka nu, bɔ bɛfa kanda nworɛ so bɛdɛɛdɛɛ ne.

english_verse: Love should always make us tell the truth. Then we will grow in every way and be more like Christ, the head
translation_verse: Na mmom, ɛ́mɔma yɛli nahorɛ yɛfa ɔdɔ nu yɛnyi wɔ nningyein amukoraa nu, wɔ Kristo bɔ ye yeɛ ɔte tire ne anu,

english_verse: of the body. Christ holds it together and makes all of its parts work perfectly, as it grows and becomes strong because of love. The Old Life and the New Life
translation_verse: ye bɔ ye nu yeɛ nipadua ne amukoraa ayɛ mumua, ɔnate akwaa ahoroɔ bɔ wahã watoatoa nu wasiesie so pɛpɛɛpɛ, bɔ ebiala ɔyɔ ye adwuma kyɛbɔ ɔfata ne ati, na ɔma nipadua ne nyi, na ɔpagya ye nwo wɔ ɔdɔ nu. Brabɔlɛ foforɛ wɔ Kristo nu

english_verse: As a follower of the Lord, I order you to stop living like stupid, godless people.
translation_verse: Yiti mesi ɛhe pi, ná medi adanzeɛ wɔ Awurade nu, kyɛ nnɛma ɛmɔbɔ ɛmɔ bra ko kyɛbɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ ngaa nemɔ bɛyɔ ye wɔ b’adwene mbaen mbaen nu ne.

english_verse: Their minds are in the dark, and they are stubborn and ignorant and have missed out on the life that comes from God. They no longer have any feelings about what is right,
translation_verse: Bɛ de, awosii akata bɛ ndeaseɛ so, na ɔnate ndeaseɛ bɔ belle bie, ná bayɛ asoserɛ ne ati, ngoa bɔ Nyameɛ fa ma ne wabɔ bɛ.

english_verse: and they are so greedy they do all kinds of indecent things.
translation_verse: Bɛnze nyanzoen ko, bama ahohwibra ali bɛ ti, na bɛbɔ bra fiɛ bɔ nikye fee nzi bɛ ate ɔ.

english_verse: But this isn't what you were taught about Jesus Christ. He is the truth, and you heard about him and learned about him.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔate ye nwo dwirɛ amba, yeɛ bayɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ bahyire ɛmɔ wɔ ye nu, kyɛbɔ Yesu nu nahorɛ ne ɔte ne.

english_verse: You were told that your foolish desires will destroy you and that you must give up your old way of life with all its bad habits.
translation_verse: Brabɔlɛ daa bɔ ɛmɔbɔle ne, ɔte ɛmɔ sona sue daa, na ɔte porɔlowaa wɔ nnakannaka akɔnnɔ nu, yiti ɛ́mɔgyi bégua,

english_verse: Let the Spirit change your way of thinking
translation_verse: ná ɛ́mɔma bɛyɛ ɛmɔ foforɛ wɔ ɛmɔ adwene sunzum nu,

english_verse: and make you into a new person. You were created to be like God, and so you must please him and be truly holy. Rules for the New Life
translation_verse: ná ɛ́mɔfa sona sue foforɛ bɔ Nyameɛ bɔle ye kyɛ ye sɛso wɔ nahorɛ tenenee ne anwotelɛ nu ne bewura.

english_verse: We are part of the same body. Stop lying and start telling each other the truth.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔyakyi ngondombopɛlɛ, ná ebiala li nahorɛ ohyire obiɛngo; ofikyɛ yɛte yɛ nwo yɛ nwo akwaa.

english_verse: Don't get so angry that you sin. Don't go to bed angry
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfɛ yaa, nakoso nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ bɔne! Nnɛmɔma eyia kɔtɔ ɛmɔ yaafɛlɛ so,

english_verse: If you are a thief, quit stealing. Be honest and work hard, so you will have something to give to people in need.
translation_verse: Nnɛma awueniɛ wua ko, na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔbɔ mmɔden ɔfa ye sa yɔ adwuma bɔ ɔfata ɔ; amaa wanya bie wafa waboka sona bɔ wahia ye ɔ.

english_verse: Stop all your dirty talk. Say the right thing at the right time and help others by what you say.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma edwirɛ fiɛ biala fi ɛmɔ noa, na mmom edwirɛ paa bɔ ɔfata ná ɔma ngɔsoɛ ɔ, ná walo bɛ bɔ betie ne.

english_verse: Don't make God's Spirit sad. The Spirit makes you sure that someday you will be free from your sins.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ Sunzum Krongron bɔ bafa bahyɛ ɛmɔ nzorɛ bama ngoalelɛ kyẽa ne, nnɛma ɛmɔbɔ ye wora.

english_verse: Stop being bitter and angry and mad at others. Don't yell at one another or curse each other or ever be rude.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔgyi amvamviri, ahonetɛɛ, ɛyaafɛlɛ, basabasayɔlɛ, ɛsoentolɛ ne bra fiɛ biala bégua.

english_verse: Instead, be kind and merciful, and forgive others, just as God forgave you because of Christ.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhurohuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ, ɛ́mɔnwu ɛmɔ nwo anwumvoin, ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛhyehyɛ ɛmɔ nwo, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ nate Kristo so wafa wahyɛ ɛmɔ ne.

english_verse: Do as God does. After all, you are his dear children.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔsua Nyameɛ, kyɛ ye mma bɔ ɛmɔla ye ahone nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Let love be your guide. Christ loved us and offered his life for us as a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa ɔdɔ bɛbɔ ɛmɔ bra, kyɛbɔ Kristo koso hurole yɛ dwirɛ ná ɔfale ye ngoa tole berɛ mane yɛ kyɛ ayɛyɛdeɛ ne afɔleɛ fonafona mane Nyameɛ ne.

english_verse: You are God's people, so don't let it be said that any of you are immoral or indecent or greedy.
translation_verse: Na adwamanbɔlɛ, bra fiɛ amukoraa anaa anyeboroborolɛ nwo dwirɛ po, ɔnzɛ kyɛ ofite ɛmɔ nu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔfata anwoteefoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't use dirty or foolish or filthy words. Instead, say how thankful you are.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma nyanzoen dwirɛ, ngwaseasɛm anaa aseresɛm bɔ ɔmvata ɔ nwo dwirɛ fite ɛmɔ nu, na mmom asennaa.

english_verse: Being greedy, indecent, or immoral is just another way of worshiping idols. You can be sure people who behave in this way will never be part of the kingdom that belongs to Christ and to God. Living as People of Light
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔse ye dada kyɛ, adwamanbɔlɛniɛ anaa bra fiɛ bɔlɛniɛ anaa anyeboroborolɛniɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ ole agyapadeɛ wɔ Kristo ne Nyameɛ ahennie ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: Don't let anyone trick you with foolish talk. God punishes everyone who disobeys him and says foolish things.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma ebiala fa edwirɛ mbaen mbaen lakalaka ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ sɔ nningyein nemɔ ati yeɛ Nyameɛ ahonehulɛ ba asoserɛfoɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: So don't have anything to do with anyone like that.
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔ ne bɛ bɛbɔ afɛ;

english_verse: You used to be like people living in the dark, but now you are people of the light because you belong to the Lord. So act like people of the light
translation_verse: ofikyɛ daa ne, né ɛmɔte awosii, nakoso kekesaala ye de, ɛmɔte kanea wɔ Awurade nu. Ɛ́mɔbɔ ɛmɔ bra kyɛ kanea mma,

english_verse: and make your light shine. Be good and honest and truthful,
translation_verse: ofikyɛ kanea mmaa bɔ osu ne, ɔda ali wɔ bra paa ne tenenee ne nahorɛ amukoraa nu;

english_verse: as you try to please the Lord.
translation_verse: na ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔso bɔ ɔsɔ Awurade nye ne bɛnea.

english_verse: Don't take part in doing those worthless things that are done in the dark. Instead, show how wrong they are.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ awosii nnwumaa bɔ onzu mmaa ne bie, na mmom ɛ́mɔpa bɛ nwo tena!

english_verse: It is disgusting even to talk about what is done in the dark.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bra bɔ bɛbɔ ye mvealeɛ nu ne, ɔyɛ nya kyɛ ɛmɔkɔfa ɛmɔ noa bɛkɔbɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: Light shows up everything, just as the Scriptures say, “Wake up from your sleep and rise from death. Then Christ will shine on you.”
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati yeɛ ɔkã kyɛ, “Wɔ bɔ alafe ne, tingye, ná dwɔso fi awufoɛ nu, na Kristo kɔta kɔma wɔ.”

english_verse: These are evil times, so make every minute count.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ mmerɛ so yé, ofikyɛ ngyẽa ne te ngyẽa tɛɛ.

english_verse: Don't be stupid. Instead, find out what the Lord wants you to do.
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ mmenia bɔ adwene nne bɛ ti anu ɔ, na mmom ɛ́mɔyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛte Awurade apɛdeɛ bo ɔ.

english_verse: Don't destroy yourself by getting drunk, but let the Spirit fill your life.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔbo nzaa, ofikyɛ ɔne basabasayɔlɛ yeɛ bɛnate ɔ; na mmom ɛ́mɔma Sunzum ne oyi ɛmɔ tɛkyɛ.

english_verse: When you meet together, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, as you praise the Lord with all your heart.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa sangoo dwein, ayɛyelɛ dwein ne sunzum nu dwein bedwudwo behyirehyire ɛmɔ nwo; ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ ahone amukoraa bɛto Awurade nwo dwein;

english_verse: Always use the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to thank God the Father for everything. Wives and Husbands
translation_verse: na mmerɛ biala ne nikyee biala nu, ɛ́mɔfa asennaa bɛ́ma Baba Nyameɛ wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo dumaa nu.

english_verse: A wife should put her husband first, as she does the Lord.
translation_verse: Yeɛ mɔ, ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛ́ma ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bɛ hu mɔ, kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɛma Awurade ne.

english_verse: A husband is the head of his wife, as Christ is the head and the Savior of the church, which is his own body.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ huɛ ne ɔte yeɛ ne ti, kyɛbɔ Kristo koso ɔte asɔre ne ti ne, na ye yeɛ ɔte Ngoadefoɛ ma nipadua ne ɔ.

english_verse: A husband should love his wife as much as Christ loved the church and gave his life for it.
translation_verse: Huɛ mɔ, ɛ́mɔhuro ɛmɔ aye mɔ, kyɛbɔ Kristo koso hurole asɔre ne dwirɛ, ná ɔfale ye ngoa tole berɛ mane ye,

english_verse: He made the church holy by the power of his word, and he made it pure by washing it with water.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ ɔkɔfa nzue ebialɛ nu kɔte ye nwo wɔ edwirɛ ne anu kɔyɛ ye krongron ɔ,

english_verse: Christ did this, so he would have a glorious and holy church, without faults or spots or wrinkles or any other flaws.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ okosiesie asɔre ne animnyam nu kɔma ye nwo, bɔ ngekalewa anaa ɛpombonɛ, anaa nikyee fiɛ biala nne ye nwo, na mmom wayɛ krongron bɔ mvomsoɛ nne ye nwo ɔ.

english_verse: In the same way, a husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself. A husband who loves his wife shows he loves himself.
translation_verse: Na sɔ ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ huɛ mɔ bekuro bɛ ye mɔ dwirɛ kyɛ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nipadua ɔ. Ofikyɛ sona bɔ okuro ɔye dwirɛ nen, okuro ye bɔbɔ ye nwo dwirɛ.

english_verse: None of us hate our own bodies. We provide for them and take good care of them, just as Christ does for the church,
translation_verse: Na ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔpɔ ye bɔbɔ ye nwonaen ɔ, na mmom ɔma ye aleɛ, ɔnea so yé, kyɛbɔ Kristo koso ɔyɛ asɔre nen.

english_verse: because we are each part of his body.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ yɛte ye nipadua n’akwaa.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “A man leaves his father and mother to get married, and he becomes like one person with his wife.”
translation_verse: Na ye sɔ ati yeɛ bienzua kɔyakyi ɔse ne oni berɛ, ná wafa ye nwo waabata ɔye nwo, ná bɛ munyɔ bayɛ anwoɔnaen ko.

english_verse: This is a great mystery, but I understand it to mean Christ and his church.
translation_verse: Ɛhe te mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ piri paa, na me de, Kristo ne asɔre ne nwo dwirɛ mmom yeɛ mekã ɔ.

english_verse: So each husband should love his wife as much as he loves himself, and each wife should respect her husband.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ nu biala kuro ɔye dwirɛ kyɛ ye bɔbɔ ye nwo, na yeɛ ne koso, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔfa anidie ma ohu.

english_verse: Children, you belong to the Lord, and you do the right thing when you obey your parents. The first commandment with a promise says,
translation_verse: Mmaa, ɛ́mɔtie ɛmɔ awofoɛ dwirɛ wɔ Awurade nu, ofikyɛ sɔ yeɛ ɔte paa ɔ.

english_verse: “Obey your father and your mother,
translation_verse: “Di ɛse ne eni ni” ,

english_verse: and you will have a long and happy life.”
translation_verse: “amaa wayie wɔ yé, ná anyi ahyɛ wɔ aseɛ ye aso.”

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. Raise them properly. Teach them and instruct them about the Lord. Slaves and Masters
translation_verse: Seɛ mɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔhu ɛmɔ mma mɔ b’ahone, na mmom ɛ́mɔtete bɛ wɔ Awurade ndeteyɛɛ ne foɛtulɛ nu. Ngoaa ne meneɛ

english_verse: Slaves, you must obey your earthly masters. Show them great respect and be as loyal to them as you are to Christ.
translation_verse: Ngoaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔye ɛmɔ ahone nu bɛ́fa esuronyi ne anwowosolɛ bɛ́yɛ sotie bɛ́ma ɛmɔ anwoɔnan nu meneɛ mɔ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔyɔ bɛma Kristo ne;

english_verse: Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. You are slaves of Christ, so with your whole heart you must do what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ solɛ ne ɔyɛ bɛ nye so nikyee mbaen, kyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔ mmenia nye ɔ, na mmom kyɛ Kristo ngoaa bɔ baye b’ahone nu bɛyɔ Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ,

english_verse: Gladly serve your masters, as though they were the Lord himself, and not simply people.
translation_verse: bɔ baye bɛ kunu sefaa bɛyɔ ɛsolɛ adwuma, kyɛ bɛyɔ bɛma Awurade, na nna kuro sona ɔ.

english_verse: You know that you will be rewarded for any good things you do, whether you are slaves or free.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔse kyɛ nikye paa biala bɔ sona yɔ ne, sɛ ɔte akoaa oo, dehyeɛ oo, okonya ye nwo akatuaa kofi Awurade berɛ.

english_verse: Slave owners, you must treat your slaves with this same respect. Don't threaten them. They have the same Master in heaven that you do, and he doesn't have favorites. The Fight against Evil
translation_verse: Meneɛ mɔ, ɛmɔ koso ɛ́mɔyɛ bɛ sɔ ala, nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ bɛ so ahupoo; ofikyɛ ɛmɔse kyɛ bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ ne bɛ Meneɛ ne ɔwɔ nyameɛso, bɔ ye de, ɔnyɛ mmenia nu nyeyemuɛ ɔ. Nyameɛ akodeɛ

english_verse: Finally, let the mighty strength of the Lord make you strong.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nwo yɛ se wɔ Awurade nu, ɔne ye anwoserɛ tumi ne anu.

english_verse: Put on all the armor that God gives, so you can defend yourself against the devil's tricks.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa Nyameɛ akodeɛ ne amukoraa bewura, amaa ɛmɔahora bagyina baho batia abɔnzam nnakannaka.

english_verse: We are not fighting against humans. We are fighting against forces and authorities and against rulers of darkness and powers in the spiritual world.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nna yɛne anwoɔnaen ne mogya yeɛ yɛdi ahoɛ ɔ; na mmom yɛne mbanyililɛ ne tumi mɔ ne ewiase awosii nu tumifoɛ ne ewienu dɔ sunzummɔne mɔ.

english_verse: So put on all the armor that God gives. Then when that evil day comes, you will be able to defend yourself. And when the battle is over, you will still be standing firm.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔfa Nyameɛ akodeɛ ne amukoraa bewura, amaa ɛmɔahora bagyina wɔ kyẽa tɛɛ ne anu; na sɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɛhe amukoraa beyie a, né ɛmɔagyina pirim.

english_verse: Be ready! Let the truth be like a belt around your waist, and let God's justice protect you like armor.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔgyina pindinn, ɛ́mɔfa nahorɛ bɛyɛ abɔsoɛ bɛbɔ ɛmɔ yaase, ná ɛ́mɔfa tenenee bɛyɛ buralɛ bɛkata ɛmɔ hue so,

english_verse: Your desire to tell the good news about peace should be like shoes on your feet.
translation_verse: ná ɛ́mɔfa asomdwee nzɛmba ne nwo mmɔdenbɔlɛ bɛyɛ mbaboa bewura.

english_verse: Let your faith be like a shield, and you will be able to stop all the flaming arrows of the evil one.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe amukoraa si ne, ɛ́mɔfa gyidie akokyɛm bétira, na ye yeɛ ɛmɔkɔhora bɛkɔfa bekonua bɔnefoɛ n’agyaen mɔ bɔ begye ne amukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: Let God's saving power be like a helmet, and for a sword use God's message that comes from the Spirit.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa ngoalelɛ buralɛ kyerɛ, ɔne Sunzum ngrandɛ ne, bɔ ye ole Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne.

english_verse: Never stop praying, especially for others. Always pray by the power of the Spirit. Stay alert and keep praying for God's people.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa mbaeɛbɔlɛ ne ngotosrɛ amukoraa bɛ́bɔ mbaeɛ daa wɔ Sunzum nu. Yiti ɛ́mɔwɛne, ná ɛmɔhɔ so bɛsrɛ bɛma anwoteefoɛ amukoraa,

english_verse: Pray that I will be given the message to speak and that I may fearlessly explain the mystery about the good news.
translation_verse: yeɛ ɛ́mɔsrɛ bɛ́ma me koso, amaa sɛ mebukye me noa kyɛ medwudwo a, bama me dwirɛ bɔ nga ɔ, ná mahora masi m’ahone mabɔ nzɛmba ne anu mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne dawure;

english_verse: I was sent to do this work, and this is the reason I am in jail. So pray that I will be brave and will speak as I should. Final Greetings
translation_verse: bɔ ye nwo bɔfoɛ bɔ nde ti yeɛ bagua me ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ ye; amaa mahora masi m’ahone mahã, kyɛbɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ mekã ɔ. Ngraalilɛ

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will give peace, love, and faith to every follower!
translation_verse: Asomdwee ne ɔdɔ ne gyidie bɔ ofi Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ.

english_verse: May God be kind to everyone who keeps on loving our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ befi b’ahone nu bekuro y’Awurade Yesu Kristo dwirɛ amukoraa ne, adom ɔyɛ bɛ deɛ.

english_verse: From Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus. To all God's people who belong to Christ Jesus at Philippi and to all your bishops and deacons.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo ne Timoteo, bɔ yɛte Kristo Yesu ngoaa, yɛfa yɛbrɛ Kristo Yesu nu anwoteefoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ Filipi, bɔ neafoɛ mɔ ne asomvoɛ mɔ bɛboka so ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Paul's Prayer for the Church in Philippi
translation_verse: Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. Pɔɔlo bɔ mbaeɛ ma Filipi agyidifoɛ

english_verse: Every time I think of you, I thank my God.
translation_verse: Ngayeɛ bɔ mekaye ɛmɔ amukoraa nu ne, meda me Nyameɛ ase.

english_verse: And whenever I mention you in my prayers, it makes me happy.
translation_verse: Daa biala, me mbaeɛbɔlɛ amukoraa nu, mebɔ mbaeɛ mema ɛmɔ amukoraa wɔ anigye so;

english_verse: This is because you have taken part with me in spreading the good news from the first day you heard about it.
translation_verse: ɔnate ɛmɔ abiɛngoɛfalɛ bɔ ɛmɔanya ye wɔ nzɛmba ne anu fi kyẽa bɔ oli moa ne toonn maa waadwu ɛnɛ ne ati;

english_verse: God is the one who began this good work in you, and I am certain that he won't stop before it is complete on the day that Christ Jesus returns.
translation_verse: na mede medi kyɛ, ye bɔ ɔhyɛle adwuma paa bo wɔ ɛmɔ nu ne, ɔkɔhɔ so kɔyɔ koyie maa okoodwu Yesu Kristo kyẽa ne.

english_verse: You have a special place in my heart. So it is only natural for me to feel the way I do. All of you have helped in the work God has given me, as I defend the good news and tell about it here in jail.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔla m’ahone nwo, yiti ɔte paa kyɛ medwene ɛmɔ amukoraa nwo sɔ ɔ. Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔ ne me yanya kyɛfa wɔ adom ne anu, me kuku nu nnaa nu, ɔne mmerɛ bɔ ngyinane pindinn mane nzɛmba ne, ná nzili so ngane ne.

english_verse: God himself knows how much I want to see you. He knows I care for you in the same way Christ Jesus does.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ di me adanzeɛ, kyɛ Kristo Yesu nu ɔdɔ yeɛ ngyi so bɔ me wora dɔ ɛmɔ amukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that your love will keep on growing and you will fully know and understand
translation_verse: Na me mbaeɛ ole kyɛ, ɔdɔ bɔ ɛmɔle ye ne ɔkɔhɔ so konyi wɔ nimdeɛ ne ndeaseɛ amukoraa nu,

english_verse: how to make the right choices. Then you will still be pure and innocent when Christ returns. And until that day,
translation_verse: amaa ɛmɔahora banwu nningyein bɔ ɔte paa, ná ɛmɔayɛ mmenia bɔ ɛmɔ bra te sannwuu bɔ ngekalewa biala nne ɛmɔ nwo ɔ, maa waadwu Kristo kyẽa ne,

english_verse: Jesus Christ will keep you busy doing good deeds that bring glory and praise to God. What Life Means to Paul
translation_verse: ná tenenee mmaa bɔ ɔnate Yesu Kristo so yeɛ ɔba ne, wayi ɛmɔ nu tɛkyɛ wayɛ animnyam ne asennaa wama Nyameɛ. Yɛte ase yɛma Kristo

english_verse: My dear friends, I want you to know that what has happened to me has helped to spread the good news.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, mekuro kyɛ ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ, bɔ wato me ne, waboka wama nzɛmba ne atrɛ mmom,

english_verse: The Roman guards and all the others know I am here in jail because I serve Christ.
translation_verse: na ɔnate so wala ali wɔ amrado ahemviefoɛ nemɔ amukoraa nu ne mmenia ngaa nemɔ anu kyɛ, Kristo ti yeɛ nna kukunu ɔ,

english_verse: Some are preaching about Christ because they are jealous and envious of us. Others are preaching because they want to help.
translation_verse: Ɔte amba kyɛ, ebiemɔ wɔ berɛ bɔ bele sona nwo anyeboro ne apereapereɛ yeɛ bɛkã Kristo nwo dwirɛ ne ɔ, nakoso ebiemɔ de, bele adwene paa yeɛ bɛkã ɔ.

english_verse: They love Christ and know I am here to defend the good news about him.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bele adwene paa yeɛ bɛkã ne, befi ɔdɔ nu yeɛ bɛkã ɔ; ofikyɛ bɛse kyɛ nzɛmba ne nwo adanzeɛlilɛ ti yeɛ nna nu wa ye;

english_verse: But the ones who are jealous of us are not sincere. They just want to cause trouble for me while I am in jail.
translation_verse: nakoso ebiemɔ de, bɛkã Kristo nwo nzɛmba ne ngondii so, bɛnga ye nahorɛ nu, na bɛdwene kyɛ bɛyɔ sɔ a bɛkɔma me nwo kɔhyere me wɔ me kukunu nna ye anu.

english_verse: But that doesn't matter. All that matters is that people are telling about Christ, whether they are sincere or not. This is what makes me glad. I will keep on being glad,
translation_verse: Onhia po! Atee biala so, kyɛ bɛpati bɛyɔ oo, anaakyɛ bɛyɔ ye nahorɛ nu oo, Kristo nwo dwirɛ komapɛ ne ala yeɛ bɛkã ɔ; na ɛhe maa medi ahurusi, amba, ngɔhɔ so ngoli ahurusi.

english_verse: because I know that your prayers and the help that comes from the Spirit of Christ Jesus will keep me safe.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mese kyɛ ɔnate ɛmɔ mbaeɛbɔlɛ ne Yesu Kristo Sunzum mmokalɛ so, ɛhe kɔkakyi ngoalelɛ kɔma me,

english_verse: I honestly expect and hope I will never do anything to be ashamed of. Whether I live or die, I always want to be as brave as I am now and bring honor to Christ.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ m’anyelasoɛ paa ne nikyee bɔ menea ye ate ne ɔte ne, kyɛ me nyunu ngogua ase wɔ nikyee biala nu, na mmom ngonya ahoneserɛ, kyɛbɔ daa ɔte ne, kekesaala ye koso, na sɛ nde ase oo, sɛ mewu oo, bɛkɔkamvo Kristo wɔ me nipadua nu.

english_verse: If I live, it will be for Christ, and if I die, I will gain even more.
translation_verse: Na me de, nde ase ma Kristo, na ewue te mvasoɛ ma me.

english_verse: I don't know what to choose. I could keep on living and doing something useful.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ase bɔ nde wɔ anwoɔnaen nu ye, yeɛ ɔmaa menya ngɔsoɛ wɔ m’adwuma nu a, ye de né mennwu bɛ nu horɛ bɔ mva ɔ.

english_verse: It is a hard choice to make. I want to die and be with Christ, because this would be much better.
translation_verse: Ɛhe amaa mayɛ anianiani. Ahaa mekuro kyɛ ngofi wa me ne Kristo yɛkɔɔtena, ofikyɛ ɛhene mmom yeɛ ɔte paa koraa ɔ,

english_verse: But I know that all of you still need me. This is why I am sure I will stay on to help you grow and be happy in your faith.
translation_verse: Mesi pi wɔ ɛhe anwo, na mese kyɛ ngɔhɔ so ngɔtena ase, na me ne ɛmɔ amukoraa yɛkɔhɔ so yɛkɔtena, ná ɛmɔanya ngɔsoɛ ne gyidie nu anigye,

english_verse: Then, when I visit you again, you will have good reason to take great pride in Christ Jesus because of me.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate me ti ɛmɔahoahoa ɛmɔ nwo mmorosoɛ wɔ Kristo Yesu nu, ɔnate ɛwalɛ bɔ mebaawa ɛmɔ berɛ bieku ne ati.

english_verse: Above all else, you must live in a way that brings honor to the good news about Christ. Then, whether I visit you or not, I will hear that all of you think alike. I will know that you are working together and are struggling side by side to get others to believe the good news.
translation_verse: Nzaade ohia kyɛ ɛmɔma ɛmɔ brabɔlɛ fata Kristo nzɛmba ne, amaa sɛ mebapasa ɛmɔ nwo oo, sɛ mamma oo, mate ɛmɔ nga kyɛ ɛmɔagyina pindinn wɔ sunzum ko nu, bɔ ɛmɔayɛ adwene ko bɛpere bɛma nzɛmba ne nwo gyidie,

english_verse: Be brave when you face your enemies. Your courage will show them that they are going to be destroyed, and it will show you that you will be saved. God will make all of this happen,
translation_verse: bɔ ɛmɔmma ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ bennwunanwuna ɛmɔ wɔ nikyee biala nu ɔ. Na ɛhe te eminilɛ bɔ bekomini ne nwo nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ma bɛ; nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɔte ngoalelɛ bɔ ofi Nyameɛ berɛ ma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: and he has blessed you. Not only do you have faith in Christ, but you suffer for him.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ de, bafa balo ɛmɔ kyɛ ɔnate Kristo ti, nna kyɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔde ye bedi ngome, na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ye ti ɛmɔnwu amaneɛ koso;

english_verse: You saw me suffer, and you still hear about my troubles. Now you must suffer in the same way.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ koɛ komapɛ bɔ ɛmɔnwuni kyɛ meko, ná afei ɛmɔkɔ so bɛte kyɛ nwɔ nu ne, ye ala yeɛ ɛmɔko ɔ.

english_verse: Christ encourages you, and his love comforts you. God's Spirit unites you, and you are concerned for others.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ Kristo nu nguraenhyɛlɛ bie wɔ berɛ, sɛ ɔdɔ aworakyekyerɛ bie wɔ berɛ, sɛ Sunzum nu abiɛngoɛfalɛ bie wɔ berɛ, sɛ ahunundetelɛ ne anwumvoinnwunɛ bie wɔ berɛ a,

english_verse: Now make me completely happy! Live in harmony by showing love for each other. Be united in what you think, as if you were only one person.
translation_verse: ye de, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdwene adwene ko, ɛmɔnya ɔdɔ ko, ɛmɔnya koyɛlɛ ne adwene ko maa m’anigye osi pi.

english_verse: Don't be jealous or proud, but be humble and consider others more important than yourselves.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔfa pɛsɛmangomenya anaa nduhoɛ bɛyɔ nikyee biala, na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa anwobrɛaseɛ adwene bebu ɛmɔ mmango mɔ bɛtra ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔ nwo.

english_verse: Care about them as much as you care about yourselves
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔ nu biala pena ye ngome ye deɛ, na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔma ye mmango deɛ koso hia ye.

english_verse: and think the same way that Christ Jesus thought:
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma adwene bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne ala yeɛ ɔ́tena ɛmɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: Christ was truly God. But he did not try to remain equal with God.
translation_verse: Ye bɔ ɔwɔ Nyameɛ tebea nu de, nakoso wambere wanyɛ ye nwo kyɛ ɔne Nyameɛ bɛte pɛ ɔ,
