english_verse: Instead he gave up everything and became a slave, when he became like one of us.
translation_verse: na mmom ɔfale ye dibea tole berɛ fale akoaa tebea tole ye nwo so, na bɛwole ye maa ɔɔyɛle dasaniɛ ye sɛso.

english_verse: Then God gave Christ the highest place and honored his name above all others.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ati, Nyameɛ koso apagya ye piri paa, na wama ye dumaa bɔ ɔbo dumaa biala so ɔ,

english_verse: So at the name of Jesus everyone will bow down, those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth.
translation_verse: kyɛ Yesu dumaa nu yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ nangoroma mukoraa bɛkoto, bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso, bɔ ɔwɔ aseɛ so, ɔne bɔ ɔwɔ aseɛ bo dɔ ɔ,

english_verse: And to the glory of God the Father everyone will openly agree, “Jesus Christ is Lord!” Lights in the World
translation_verse: na noa biala ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔkã ye pefee kyɛ Yesu Kristo te Awurade ná ɔfa hyɛ Baba Nyameɛ animnyam. Ngoalelɛ nwo mmɔdenbɔlɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, you always obeyed when I was with you. Now that I am away, you should obey even more. So work with fear and trembling to discover what it really means to be saved.
translation_verse: Yiti mmiɛngo paa mɔ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔyɛ sotie daa ne, nna kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ me ne ɛmɔ yɛwɔ berɛ ne angome, na mmom afei bɔ nne ɛmɔ berɛ ye de po, ɔtra so; ɛ́mɔfa esuronyi ne anwowosowolɛ béli ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔ ngoalelɛ nwo dwumaa ma oli mu,

english_verse: God is working in you to make you willing and able to obey him.
translation_verse: ɔnate kyɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔyɔ adwumaa wɔ ɛmɔ nu maa ɛmɔkuro kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ, ná ɛmɔyɔ nnwumaa kyɛbɔ ɔsɔ ye nye ɔ.

english_verse: Do everything without grumbling or arguing.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔfa nwuhunwuhu ne aporowaasulɛ bɛyɔ nikyee biala,

english_verse: Then you will be the pure and innocent children of God. You live among people who are crooked and evil, but you must not do anything they can say is wrong. Try to shine as lights among the people of this world,
translation_verse: amaa ɛmɔayɛ mmenia bɔ edwirɛ nne bɛ nwo bɔ bɛ nwo sonn, Nyameɛ mma bɔ ngekalewa biala nne ɛmɔ nwo wɔ bɔnefoɛ maen bɔ bali makyebu, bɔ ɛmɔta wɔ bɛ nu kyɛ kanea bɔ ɔwɔ wiase,

english_verse: as you hold firmly to the message that gives life. Then on the day when Christ returns, I can take pride in you. I can also know that my work and efforts were not useless.
translation_verse: wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔtira ngoa dwirɛ ne anu serɛserɛ ɔ; amaa wayɛ m’anwohoahoa wɔ Kristo kyẽa ne, kyɛ amirika bɔ nduli ne wanyɛ mbaen, yeɛ me fɛɛ adwumaa ne koso wanyɛ mbaen.

english_verse: Your faith in the Lord and your service are like a sacrifice offered to him. And my own blood may have to be poured out with the sacrifice. If this happens, I will be glad and rejoice with you.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔba kyɛ behwie me begua kyɛ afɔlebɔdeɛ wɔ ɛmɔ gyidie solɛ nwo a, ɔyɛ me fɛ, na me ne ɛmɔ amukoraa yɛdi ahurusi.

english_verse: In the same way, you should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus
translation_verse: Na sɔ ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔma ɛmɔ nye gye, ná ɛmɔ ne me yɛdi ahurusi ɔ. Pɔɔlo soma Timoteo ne Epafrodito

english_verse: I want to be encouraged by news about you. So I hope the Lord Jesus will soon let me send Timothy to you.
translation_verse: Me nye la so wɔ Awurade Yesu nu, kyɛ ɔngɔhyɛ biala ngɔsoma Timoteo maa ɔkɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ, na sɛ ɔfa ɛmɔ nwo amaneɛ babɔ me a, ɔkɔma me wora kɔkyekye.

english_verse: I don't have anyone else who cares about you as much as he does.
translation_verse: Ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔne m’adwene te ko, kyɛ ye bɔ ɛmɔ yeeyɛlɛ hia ye ɔ.

english_verse: The others think only about what interests them and not about what concerns Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa bɛpena bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ deɛ, na mmom nna bɔ ɔte Yesu Kristo deɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But you know what kind of person Timothy is. He has worked with me like a son in spreading the good news.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ de, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔdi ye nwo adanzeɛ ne, ɛmɔse kyɛbɔ yasi yayɛ kyɛ seɛ ne baa bɔ yɛso wɔ nzɛmba ne nwo ɔ.

english_verse: I hope to send him to you, as soon as I find out what is going to happen to me.
translation_verse: Sɛ menya menwu kyɛbɔ me dwirɛ ne ɔkwaasi pɛ a, ye yeɛ me nye la ye so kyɛ ngɔsoma ye ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: And I feel sure the Lord will also let me come soon.
translation_verse: Na m’anyelasoɛ wɔ Awurade nu kyɛ ɔngɔhyɛ biala me bɔbɔ koso ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ.

english_verse: I think I ought to send my dear friend Epaphroditus back to you. He is a follower and a worker and a soldier of the Lord, just as I am. You sent him to look after me,
translation_verse: Nakoso madwene ye nwo kyɛ ohia kyɛ mesoma nniɛma Epafrodito ɛmɔ berɛ. Ɔte mmiɛngo adwumayɔlɛniɛ ne mmiɛngo asraaniɛ, ɛmɔ bɔfoɛ ne me bokafoɛ;.

english_verse: but now he is eager to see you. He is worried, because you heard he was sick.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ye wora dɔ ɛmɔ amukoraa, na ɔha ye kyɛ ɛmɔtele kyɛ anwonyerɛ bɔle ye ɔ.

english_verse: In fact, he was very sick and almost died. But God was kind to him, and also to me, and he kept me from being burdened down with sorrow.
translation_verse: Amba, ewue anwonyerɛ bɔle ye. Nakoso Nyameɛ nwuni ye anwumvoin; nna ye ngome, na me koso onwuni me anwumvoin bie, na wamma me wora ammɔ somaa.

english_verse: Now I am more eager than ever to send Epaphroditus back again. You will be glad to see him, and I won't have to worry any longer.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ati po yeɛ ɔmaa mabɔ mmɔden masoma ye ɔ, amaa sɛ ɛmɔnwu ye bieku a, ɛmɔ nye agye, ná me koso m’aworabɔlɛ ne so ate.

english_verse: Be sure to give him a cheerful welcome, just as people who serve the Lord deserve.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔle ye nyemene so wɔ Awurade nu, na ɛ́mɔfa anidie bɛ́ma mmenia bɔ bɛte kyɛ ye ne amukoraa.

english_verse: He almost died working for Christ, and he risked his own life to do for me what you could not.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, Kristo adwuma ne ati ɔhale kãa maa owuli, na ɔfale ye ngoa tole serewa gyinane ɛmɔ gya nu kyɛ ɔkɔso me.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, be glad that you belong to the Lord. It doesn't bother me to write the same things to you that I have written before. In fact, it is for your own good.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye gye wɔ Awurade nu. Ɔnha me kyɛ ngosa ngɔhyerɛ nikyee komapɛ ne ala ngɔbrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ, na ye sɔ te paa ma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Watch out for those people who behave like dogs! They are evil and want to do more than just circumcise you.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ ngyea nemɔ nwo; ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ adwumayɔlɛfoɛ bɔnefoɛ nemɔ nwo, ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé wɔ bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ ne.

english_verse: But we are the ones who are truly circumcised, because we worship by the power of God's Spirit and take pride in Christ Jesus. We don't brag about what we have done,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ yɛ yeɛ yɛte bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ ɔ, bɔ yɛsɔne Nyameɛ wɔ sunzum nu, bɔ yɛhoahoa yɛ nwo wɔ Kristo Yesu nu, ná yɛmva yɛ nwo yɛndo anwoɔnaen so ɔ.

english_verse: I was circumcised when I was eight days old, and I am from the nation of Israel and the tribe of Benjamin. I am a true Hebrew. As a Pharisee, I strictly obeyed the Law of Moses.
translation_verse: Ye ɛlɛbɔtwɛ ne aso yeɛ bɛpɛle me bienzua ɔ. Mvi Yisrael bosofoɛ nu, mvi Benyamin abusua kure nu, Hebrifoɛ nu Hebriniɛ; na mmeraa ne aso lilɛ de, nde Farasiiniɛ;

english_verse: And I was so eager I even made trouble for the church. I did everything the Law demands in order to please God.
translation_verse: mmɔdenbɔlɛ nu, ndanene asɔre ne nye; mmeraa ne anu tenenee koso, me nwo sonn.

english_verse: But Christ has shown me that what I once thought was valuable is worthless.
translation_verse: Nakoso nningyein bɔ ahaa ɔte mvasoɛ ma me ne, Kristo ti mebu ye kyɛ wafi me sa.

english_verse: Nothing is as wonderful as knowing Christ Jesus my Lord. I have given up everything else and count it all as garbage. All I want is Christ
translation_verse: Amba, ɔnate m’Awurade Kristo Yesu nwo nimdeɛ mmorosoɛ ne ati, mebu nningyein amukoraa kyɛ bafi me sa. Ɔnate ye ti nningyein amukoraa afi me sa, nakoso mebu bɛ kyɛ fofoɛ so wura mbaen, amaa ɔnate so manya Kristo;

english_verse: and to know that I belong to him. I could not make myself acceptable to God by obeying the Law of Moses. God accepted me simply because of my faith in Christ.
translation_verse: amaa wanwu me wɔ ye nu, kyɛ me de, nnne me bɔbɔ me tenenee bɔ ofi mmeraa ne anu ɔ, na mmom bɔ ɔnate Kristo nu gyidie so ɔba ɔ, tenenee bɔ ofi Nyameɛ berɛ, bɔ ɔnate gyidie so ɔ.

english_verse: All I want is to know Christ and the power that raised him to life. I want to suffer and die as he did,
translation_verse: Me botaeɛ ole kyɛ ngonwu ye ne ye wutingyelɛ tumi ne, kyɛ ngonwu ye amaneɛ ne bie, kyɛ ɔkɔmaa ngɔyɛ kyɛ ye wɔ ewue nu,

english_verse: so that somehow I also may be raised to life. Running toward the Goal
translation_verse: ná sɛ ɔkɔyɛ yee a, manya awufoɛ nu ewutingyelɛ ne. Tu amirika kɔ botaeɛ ne nwo

english_verse: I have not yet reached my goal, and I am not perfect. But Christ has taken hold of me. So I keep on running and struggling to take hold of the prize.
translation_verse: Nna kyɛ ebiaa me sa anya ahã ye, anaakyɛ mali mu mayie ɔ; na mmom mepere mekɔ me nyunu kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ me deɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ Kristo Yesu koso wafa me wayɛ ye deɛ ne.

english_verse: My friends, I don't feel I have already arrived. But I forget what is behind, and I struggle for what is ahead.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, menzusu kyɛ wanya wayɛ me deɛ; nakoso nikyee komapɛ yeɛ meyɔ ɔ: mema me wora fi bɔ wapɛ nu wahɔ ɔ, na metwe me nu kyɛ ngodwu bɔ ɔla me nyunu ne anwo ɔ.

english_verse: I run toward the goal, so I can win the prize of being called to heaven. This is the prize God offers because of what Christ Jesus has done.
translation_verse: Mepere mekɔ me nyunu kyɛ ngodwu botaeɛ ne anwo ngonya ngonimlilɛ abasobɔdeɛ ne, bɔ ɔte anwuro frɛlɛ bɔ Nyameɛ nate Yesu Kristo so wafrɛ me ne.

english_verse: All of us who are mature should think in this same way. And if any of you think differently, God will make it clear to you.
translation_verse: Yiti yɛ nu pee bɔ yanyi wɔ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ nu ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛnya sɔ adwene ne, na sɛ ɛmɔle adwene foforɛ wɔ nikyee bie nwo a, ye koso Nyameɛ kɔla ye ali kohyire ɛmɔ.

english_verse: But we must keep going in the direction that we are now headed.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɔ yanya ye dada ne, ɛ́mɔma yɛhɔ so yɛsɔ nu bum.

english_verse: My friends, I want you to follow my example and learn from others who closely follow the example we set for you.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔsuasua me, ná ɛ́mɔnea bɛ bɔ bɛ bra te sɔ ala ne, kyɛbɔ yɛte nhwɛsoɛ ma ɛmɔ ne.

english_verse: I often warned you that many people are living as enemies of the cross of Christ. And now with tears in my eyes, I warn you again
translation_verse: Mali moa mahã edwirɛ he mahyire ɛmɔ pee paa, na kekesaala ye koso, nne me nye moen mesi so bieku kyɛ, mmenia pee wɔ berɛ bɔ bɛ brabɔlɛ maa bɛyɛ Kristo mmeamudua ne pɔfoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: that they are headed for hell! They worship their stomachs and brag about the disgusting things they do. All they can think about are the things of this world.
translation_verse: Bɛ yeɛ b’ayieleɛ te ɛsɛkyelɛ ɔ, bɛ nyameɛ ole bɛ ko, b’animguaseɛ nu yeɛ b’animnyam wɔ ɔ, na aseɛ so nningyein ngome yeɛ bɛdwene ye nwo ɔ.

english_verse: But we are citizens of heaven and are eagerly waiting for our Savior to come from there. Our Lord Jesus Christ
translation_verse: Nakoso yɛ de, nyameɛso yeɛ ɔte yɛ maen ɔ. Berɛ yeɛ yɛnwondɛ kyɛ yɛ Ngoadefoɛ bɔ ye ole Awurade Yesu Kristo ne okofi kɔwa ɔ;

english_verse: has power over everything, and he will make these poor bodies of ours like his own glorious body.
translation_verse: na tumi bɔ ɔkora maa ɔfa nnningyein amukoraa wura ye bo ne, ɔkɔfa kɔsakyera yɛ awiɛmvoɛ nipadua ne maa ɔkɔyɛ kyɛ ye animnyam nipadua ne.

english_verse: Dear friends, I love you and long to see you. Please keep on being faithful to the Lord. You are my pride and joy. Paul Encourages the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ mekuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ ná me wora dɔ ɛmɔ ɔ, m’anigyeɛ ne m’abotire; ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔla m’ahone nwo ɔ, ɛ́mɔgyina pindinn wɔ Awurade nu.

english_verse: Euodia and Syntyche, you belong to the Lord, so I beg you to stop arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Mekoto mesrɛ Yiwodia, yeɛ mekoto mesrɛ Sintike kyɛ bɛma b’adwene yɛ ko wɔ Awurade nu.

english_verse: And, my true partner, I ask you to help them. These women have worked together with me and with Clement and with the others in spreading the good news. Their names are now written in the book of life.
translation_verse: Yeɛ mesrɛ wɔ koso, mmiɛngo konnuasoalɛniɛ nohorɛniɛ, kyɛ boka mmrasua hemɔ, ofikyɛ bɛbokale me so yeɛ yɛyɔle nzɛmba ne nwo adwuma ɔ, bɛne Klɛmente ne mmiɛngo adwumayɔlɛfoɛ ngaa nemɔ bɔ bahyerɛ bɛ dumaa wɔ ngoa nwomaa ne anu ne.

english_verse: Always be glad because of the Lord! I will say it again: Be glad.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye gye wɔ Awurade nu daa. Mesi so bieku kyɛ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye gye!

english_verse: Always be gentle with others. The Lord will soon be here.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma mmenia amukoraa bénwu ɛmɔ animia ne. Awurade apingye!

english_verse: Don't worry about anything, but pray about everything. With thankful hearts offer up your prayers and requests to God.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma nikye fee ha ɛmɔ; na mmom nikyee biala nu, ɛ́mɔfa mbaeɛbɔlɛ ne ngotosrɛ ne asennaa bɛ́fa bɔ ohia ɛmɔ ɔ bɛ́to Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: Then, because you belong to Christ Jesus, God will bless you with peace that no one can completely understand. And this peace will control the way you think and feel.
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ asomdwee bɔ ɔbo ndeaseɛ amukoraa so ne, ɔkɔnea ɛmɔ ahone ne ɛmɔ adwene so wɔ Kristo Yesu nu.

english_verse: Finally, my friends, keep your minds on whatever is true, pure, right, holy, friendly, and proper. Don't ever stop thinking about what is truly worthwhile and worthy of praise.
translation_verse: Afei aliɛmaa mɔ, medwura edwirɛ ne kyɛ, nikyee biala bɔ ɔte nahorɛ, bɔ ɔte animnyam, bɔ ɔtengyɛ, bɔ ye nwo te, bɔ ɔyɛ nyemene, bɔ ole dumaa paa; sɛ bra paa bie wɔ berɛ a, sɛ ayɛyelɛ bie wɔ berɛ a, sɔ nningyein nemɔ yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdwenedwene bɛ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: You know the teachings I gave you, and you know what you heard me say and saw me do. So follow my example. And God, who gives peace, will be with you. Paul Gives Thanks for the Gifts He Was Given
translation_verse: Bɔ ɛmɔasua ne bɔ ɛmɔanya ye ɔne bɔ ɛmɔate ne bɔ ɛmɔanwu ye wɔ me nwo ne, ye ala ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ. Na asomdwee Nyameɛ ne ɛmɔ kɔtena. Pɔɔlo da Filipifoɛ ase

english_verse: The Lord has made me very grateful that at last you have thought about me once again. Actually, you were thinking about me all along, but you didn't have any chance to show it.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛ me fɛ paa wɔ Awurade nu kyɛ afei de ɛmɔasa bahyɛ ye bo bɛdwene me nwo bieku ɔ; ɛmɔdwene me nwo de, nakoso atee amma nu amma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: I am not complaining about having too little. I have learned to be satisfied with whatever I have.
translation_verse: Mengyire kyɛ me nwo ahyere me ti ɔ, ofikyɛ me de, masua maa wakokwa me, bɔ tebea biala bɔ nwɔ nu ne mema me nye gye ɔ.

english_verse: I know what it is to be poor or to have plenty, and I have lived under all kinds of conditions. I know what it means to be full or to be hungry, to have too much or too little.
translation_verse: Manwu anwokyere, yeɛ manwu anwonya koso. Nekaa biala ne nikyee biala nu, sɛ ɛhɔen yeɛ oku me oo, sɛ me ko yi oo; sɛ nne bie oo, sɛ nnne bie oo, wakokwa me,

english_verse: Christ gives me the strength to face anything.
translation_verse: na mekora meyɔ nnningyein amukoraa wɔ Kristo bɔ ɔma me anwoserɛ ne anu.

english_verse: It was good of you to help me when I was having such a hard time.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔte paa kyɛ ɛmɔbokale me wɔ m’anwokyere nu ɔ.

english_verse: My friends at Philippi, you remember what it was like when I started preaching the good news in Macedonia. After I left there, you were the only church that became my partner by giving blessings and by receiving them in return.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ Filipifoɛ koso, ɛmɔse kyɛ nzɛmba n’ahyɛseɛ ne, mmerɛ bɔ mvili Makedonia ngɔle ne, asɔre biala wammoka me wɔ akyɛdeɛ manɛ ne ye lelɛ nu, sana ɛmɔ ngome ala.

english_verse: I am not trying to get something from you, but I want you to receive the blessings that come from giving.
translation_verse: Nna kyɛ mepena akyɛdeɛ hɔ ɔ; na mmom mepena mmaa bɔ ɔkɔma ɛmɔ ngondaa ne kɔsone ɔ.

english_verse: I have been paid back everything, and with interest. I am completely satisfied with the gifts you sent with Epaphroditus. They are like a sweet-smelling offering or like the right kind of sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Manya pee, na manya ye mukoraa maa wabo so, ɔsone. Epafrodito afa ɛmɔ akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɛmɔfa manene ne wabrɛ me. Ɔte ayɛyɛdeɛ fonafona, afɔlebɔdeɛ bɔ Nyameɛ kuro ná ɔsɔ ye nye ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God will take care of all your needs with the wonderful blessings that come from Christ Jesus!
translation_verse: Na me Nyameɛ kɔma ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔhia amukoraa, kyɛbɔ ye anwonya ne te ɔ, animnyam nu, wɔ Kristo Yesu nu.

english_verse: May God our Father be praised forever and ever. Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Animnyam hã yɛ Baba Nyameɛ daa. Amen. Ngraa

english_verse: Give my greetings to all who are God's people because of Christ Jesus. The Lord's followers here with me send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbisa anwoteefoɛ ne amukoraa ahye wɔ Kristo Yesu nu bɛ́ma me. Aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ bɛne me wɔ wa ne koso bebisa ɛmɔ ahye.

english_verse: All of God's people send their greetings, especially those in the service of the Emperor.
translation_verse: Anwoteefoɛ ne amukoraa bebisa ɛmɔ ahye, nganga bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Kaesare awuro ne.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless your life!
translation_verse: Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne ɔne ɛmɔ sunzum tena. Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, chosen by God to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, and from Timothy, who is also a follower.
translation_verse: Me Pɔɔlo, ɔnate Nyameɛ pɛ so nde Kristo Yesu somafoɛ ɔ. Krataa he fi me ne aliɛmaa Timoteo berɛ.

english_verse: To God's people who live in Colossae and are faithful followers of Christ. I pray that God our Father will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! A Prayer of Thanks
translation_verse: Yɛfa yɛbrɛ anwoteefoɛ ne aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ bedi nahorɛ wɔ Kristo nu bɔ bɛwɔ Kolose ɔ. Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ [ne Awurade Yesu Kristo] berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. Asennaa

english_verse: Each time we pray for you, we thank God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Daa biala sɛ yɛ́bɔ mbaeɛ yɛma ɛmɔ a, yɛfa asennaa yɛma Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte y’Awurade Yesu Kristo Baba ne.

english_verse: We have heard of your faith in Christ and of your love for all God's people,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ yate ɛmɔ gyidie bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne, ɔne ehurolɛ bɔ ɛmɔkuro anwoteefoɛ amukoraa bɛ dwirɛ ne nga;

english_verse: because what you hope for is kept safe for you in heaven. You first heard about this hope when you believed the true message, which is the good news.
translation_verse: ɔnate anyelasoɛ bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ ma ɛmɔ wɔ nyameɛso. Na ɛhe yeɛ ɛmɔate ye dada wɔ nahorɛ dwirɛ bɔ ye ole nzɛmba ne,

english_verse: The good news is spreading all over the world with great success. It has spread in this same way among you, ever since the first day you learned the truth about God's wonderful kindness
translation_verse: bɔ bɛfa bɛbrɛle ɛmɔ ne anu. Na onyi, yeɛ osu mmaa wɔ wiase amukoraa, kyɛbɔ wasu mmaa wɔ ɛmɔ nu fi kyẽa bɔ ɛmɔtele ná ɛmɔnwuni Nyameɛ adom wɔ nahorɛ nu ne,

english_verse: from our good friend Epaphras. He works together with us for Christ and is a faithful worker for you.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ ɛmɔasua bafi y’eliɛma somvoɛ Epafra, bɔ ɔte Kristo somvoɛ nahorɛniɛ ma ɛmɔ ne berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: He is also the one who told us about the love that God's Spirit has given you. The Person and Work of Christ
translation_verse: Na wasa wahã ɛmɔ ɔdɔ bɔ ofi Sunzum Krongron berɛ ne nwo dwirɛ wahyire yɛ.

english_verse: We have not stopped praying for you since the first day we heard about you. In fact, we always pray that God will show you everything he wants you to do and that you may have all the wisdom and understanding his Spirit gives.
translation_verse: Ɔnate ɛhe ati, ofi kyẽa bɔ yɛtele sɔ dwirɛ ne ɔ, yɛyyakyili ɛmɔ nwo mbaeɛbɔlɛ le. Na yɛsrɛ kyɛ ɔma ɛmɔnya ye apɛdeɛ nwo nimdeɛ mmorosoɛ wɔ sunzum nu nworɛ ne ndeaseɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: Then you will live a life that honors the Lord, and you will always please him by doing good deeds. You will come to know God even better.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe kɔmaa ɛmɔkɔhora kɔbɔ bra bɔ ɔfata Awurade, ná ɔsɔ ye nye wɔ atee biala so. Na ɔkɔmaa ɛmɔkosu mmaa wɔ nnwumaa paa mukoraati nu, ná ɛmɔanyi Nyameɛ nimdeɛ nu.

english_verse: His glorious power will make you patient and strong enough to endure anything, and you will be truly happy.
translation_verse: Yɛsrɛ kyɛ ɔma ɛmɔ tumi amukoraa ma ɛmɔgyina pindinn, kyɛbɔ ye animnyam tumi te ne, ná ɛmɔahora bafa aboterɛ ne animia amukoraa bagyina wɔ anigye nu,

english_verse: I pray that you will be grateful to God for letting you have part in what he has promised his people in the kingdom of light.
translation_verse: ná yafa asennaa yama Baba ne bɔ wamaa yafata kyɛ yɛnya kyɛfa wɔ anwoteefoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ kanea nu b’agyapadeɛ ne bie ɔ.

english_verse: God rescued us from the dark power of Satan and brought us into the kingdom of his dear Son,
translation_verse: Wapepɛ wale yɛ wafi awosii tumi nu, na waasikye yɛ wɔ Ɔwa bɔ okuro ye dwirɛ n’Ahennie nu;

english_verse: who forgives our sins and sets us free.
translation_verse: na ye nu yeɛ yanya ngoalelɛ bɔ ɔte bɔnefakyɛ ɔ. Enwu Kristo a né anwu Nyameɛ

english_verse: Christ is exactly like God, who cannot be seen. He is the first-born Son, superior to all creation.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ bɔ anyeɛ onnwu ye ne ye sɛso ɔ, abɔdeɛ amukoraa nu farebae.

english_verse: Everything was created by him, everything in heaven and on earth, everything seen and unseen, including all forces and powers, and all rulers and authorities. All things were created by God's Son, and everything was made for him.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ye nu yeɛ bɛbɔle nningyein amukoraa, bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne aseɛ so ɔ; bɔ benwu ye ɔ ne bɔ bennwu ye ɔ; ahennie oo, meneɛ oo, mbanyililɛ oo, tumililɛ oo, nningyein mukoraa bɛnate ye so yeɛ bɛbɔle ɔ, na bɛbɔle bɛ bɛmane ye.

english_verse: God's Son was before all else, and by him everything is held together.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ né ɔwɔ berɛ koraka yeɛ bɛbɔ nikyee biala ɔ, na ye yeɛ otira bɛ mukoraa bɛ ngoa nyamaa nu ɔ.

english_verse: He is the head of his body, which is the church. He is the very beginning, the first to be raised from death, so that he would be above all others.
translation_verse: Ɔte nipadua ne bɔ ye ole asɔre ne ti; ɔte nikyee biala ahyɛaseɛ, awufoɛ tingyelɛ nu farebae, na ɛhe maa ɔyɛ nningyein amukoraa nu bɔ oli moa ɔ.

english_verse: God himself was pleased to live fully in his Son.
translation_verse: Na ɔsɔle Nyameɛ nye kyɛ ye sue ne amukoraa kɔtena Kristo nu ɔ.

english_verse: And God was pleased for him to make peace by sacrificing his blood on the cross, so that all beings in heaven and on earth would be brought back to God.
translation_verse: Ɔnate ye so Nyameɛ ahwe nningyein mukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ so ne nyameɛso wabata ye bɔbɔ ye nwo; na ɔnate ye mmeamudua nu mogya ne aso yeɛ wama sɔ asomdwee ye awa ɔ.

english_verse: You used to be far from God. Your thoughts made you his enemies, and you did evil things.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ de, ahaa né ɛmɔte ɛlɔenyɛlɛfoɛ mɔ ne pɔfoɛ mɔ, wɔ adwene nu ne bɔne nnwumaayɔlɛ mu.

english_verse: But his Son became a human and died. So God made peace with you, and now he lets you stand in his presence as people who are holy and faultless and innocent.
translation_verse: Nakoso kekesaala ye de, ɔnate Kristo wue ne aso wahwe ɛmɔ wabata ye nwonaen nipadua, amaa ɔnate so wafa ɛmɔ wawa ye nyunu kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛte krongron, bɔ ngekalewa nne bɛ nwo ná benni fɔ ɔ.

english_verse: But you must stay deeply rooted and firm in your faith. You must not give up the hope you received when you heard the good news. It was preached to everyone on earth, and I myself have become a servant of this message. Paul's Service to the Church
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔsɔ gyidie ne anu serɛ na ɛmɔahora bagyina pindinn. Na afei ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɛmɔtwe bɛ nwo befi nzɛmba ne anu anyelasoɛ nwo, na ɛhe yeɛ ɛmɔtele, bɔ babɔ ye nwo dawure bahyire abɔdeɛ mukoraa wɔ wiase, bɔ me Pɔɔlo nde ye nwo somvoɛ ye. Pɔɔlo somvoɛ adwuma

english_verse: I am glad I can suffer for you. I am pleased also that in my own body I can continue the suffering of Christ for his body, the church.
translation_verse: Na afei, ɔnate ɛmɔ ti me nye gye wɔ m’amaneɛnwunɛ nu; na menya Kristo amaneɛnwunɛ ne anu kyɛfa wɔ me nwonaen nu mema ye nipadua ne, bɔ ɔte asɔre ne.

english_verse: God's plan was to make me a servant of his church and to send me to preach his complete message to you.
translation_verse: Ɔnate ɛmɔ ti Nyameɛ afa sɔ adwuma ye wawura me sa, na wamaa mayɛ somvoɛ mama asɔre ne, kyɛ mmɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne dawure ma ebiala te,

english_verse: For ages and ages this message was kept secret from everyone, but now it has been explained to God's people.
translation_verse: mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ bɔ ofi tete ne aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ so bafa bafea ɔ, nakoso kekesaala ye de baye bahyire anwoteefoɛ.

english_verse: God did this because he wanted you Gentiles to understand his wonderful and glorious mystery. And the mystery is that Christ lives in you, and he is your hope of sharing in God's glory.
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ ole kyɛ, ɔkɔma anwoteefoɛ konwu animnyam anwonya bɔ ɔwɔ mvealeɛ dwirɛ ne anu wɔ Amaenmaensofoɛ nu. Mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne ole Kristo bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ nu ne, na ɔte animnyam ne nwo anyelasoɛ.

english_verse: We announce the message about Christ, and we use all our wisdom to warn and teach everyone, so all of Christ's followers will grow and become mature.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ yɛbɔ ye nwo dawure ɔ, na yɛbɔ kuro sona biala kɔkɔ, yɛfa nworɛ mukoraa yɛkyirekyire sona biala, amaa ɔnate so yafa sona biala yawa Kristo nyunu wɔ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛlɛ nu.

english_verse: This is why I work so hard and use the mighty power he gives me.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe anwo yeɛ meyɔ adwuma mefɛ ɔ, na mepere mekɔ me nyunu, kyɛbɔ ye anwoserɛ adwuma bɔ ɔyɔ ye me nu tumi so ne ɔte ɔ.

english_verse: I want you to know what a struggle I am going through for you, for God's people at Laodicea, and for all of those followers who have never met me.
translation_verse: Mekuro kyɛ ɛmɔnwu mmɔden paa bɔ mebɔ mema ɛmɔ, yeɛ afei bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Laodikea, ɔne ebiala bɔ onnwuni me nyunu le ɔ.

english_verse: I do it to encourage them. Then as their hearts are joined together in love, they will be wonderfully blessed with complete understanding. And they will truly know Christ. Not only is he the key to God's mystery,
translation_verse: Meyɔ ɛhe kyɛbɔ bɛ wora kɔkyekye ná bayɛ ko wɔ ɔdɔ nu, ná banya ndeaseɛ bɔ osi pi, ɔne kyɛ bekonwu Nyameɛ mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne, bɔ ye ole Kristo ɔ.

english_verse: but all wisdom and knowledge are hidden away in him.
translation_verse: Na ye nu yeɛ bafa nworɛ ne nimdeɛ agyapadeɛ mukoraa basie ɔ.

english_verse: I tell you these things to keep you from being fooled by fancy talk.
translation_verse: Meka ɛhe kyɛbɔ ebie ngɔbobɔ ye noa nu ngɔfa ngɔlakalaka ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Even though I am not with you, I keep thinking about you. I am glad to know that you are living as you should and your faith in Christ is strong. Christ Brings Real Life
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ anwoɔnaen nu de nna me ne ɛmɔ yeɛ yɛwɔ dɔ ɔ, nakoso me ne ɛmɔ yɛwɔ dɔ sunzum nu. Na ɔyɛ me fɛ kyɛ ɛmɔgyi berɛ pindinn ná ɛmɔ gyidie koso atindim wɔ Kristo nu ɔ. Kristo nu brabɔlɛ

english_verse: You have accepted Christ Jesus as your Lord. Now keep on following him.
translation_verse: Yiti kyɛbɔ ɛmɔale Awurade Kristo Yesu bato nu nen, ɛmɔhɔ so bɛnate wɔ yde nu.

english_verse: Plant your roots in Christ and let him be the foundation for your life. Be strong in your faith, just as you were taught. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔtira ndii wɔ ye nu, ná ɛ́mɔnea ye so bɛbɔ bɛ bra, ná ɛ́mɔtindim wɔ gyidie nu kyɛbɔ behyirehyirele ɛmɔ ne, ná ɛ́mɔla Nyameɛ ase daa.

english_verse: Don't let anyone fool you by using senseless arguments. These arguments may sound wise, but they are only human teachings. They come from the powers of this world and not from Christ.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea yé ná ebiala amva ewiase nworɛ ne nnakannaka mbaen bɔ ɔnate tetesɛm ne wiase sunzum nu dwirɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ so, bɔ ɔnnate Kristo so ɔ wamva ɛmɔ wanyɛ ngoaa.

english_verse: And you are fully grown because you belong to Christ, who is over every power and authority.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔali mu bɔkɔɔ wɔ ye nu, ye bɔ ɔte tumi ne ahennie amukoraa bɛ ti.

english_verse: Christ has also taken away your selfish desires, just as circumcision removes flesh from the body.
translation_verse: Na ye nu koso yeɛ bapɛ ɛmɔ bienzua bɔ bamva bɛ sa yeɛ bɛpɛle ɔ; na bɔ ɔwɔ anwoɔnaen nipadua nu bɔ bapuro bagua berɛ ne, bapuro bagua wɔ Kristo bienzuapɛlɛ nu.

english_verse: And when you were baptized, it was the same as being buried with Christ. Then you were raised to life because you had faith in the power of God, who raised Christ from death.
translation_verse: Besiele ɛmɔ ne Kristo wɔ asubɔlɛ nu, na ɔnate ɛmɔ gyidie wɔ Nyameɛ tumi dwumadie bɔ ɔfa tingyele ye fili ewue nu ne ati, batingye ɛmɔ ne ye koso.

english_verse: You were dead, because you were sinful and were not God's people. But God let Christ make you alive, when he forgave all our sins.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ bɔ ahaa né ɛmɔte awufoɛ, ɔnate ɛmɔ mvomsoɛ ne ɛmɔ nwonaen bɔ né bienzuapɛlɛ nne nu ne ati nen, Nyameɛ amaa ɛmɔanya ye ngoa ne bie, na wafa yɛ mvomsoɛ amukoraa wahyɛ yɛ,

english_verse: God wiped out the charges that were against us for disobeying the Law of Moses. He took them away and nailed them to the cross.
translation_verse: na wakyikyi ahyɛdeɛ ne anu ahyerɛlɛ bɔ otia yɛ bɔ bɛfa bɛbɔle yɛ kwaadu ne, na waye wafi berɛ wafa wabɔ mmeamudua ne anu.

english_verse: There Christ defeated all powers and forces. He let the whole world see them being led away as prisoners when he celebrated his victory.
translation_verse: Olele mbanyililɛ ne tumililɛ bɛ sa nu tumi, na ɔlale bɛ ali pefee wɔ badwa nu, na olili bɛ so ngonim wɔ mmeamudua ne aso.

english_verse: Don't let anyone tell you what you must eat or drink. Don't let them say you must celebrate the New Moon festival, the Sabbath, or any other festival.
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛmɔma ebiala bua ɛmɔ ndɛen fa aleɛ anaa anonneɛ, anaa aluolue, anaa ɛsraen foforɛ anaa afofingyẽa nwo.

english_verse: These things are only a shadow of what was to come. But Christ is real!
translation_verse: Ɛhemɔ te nningyein bɔ ɔba nemɔ wawoɛ, nakoso ye paapaa ne ole Kristo.

english_verse: Don't be cheated by people who make a show of acting humble and who worship angels. They brag about seeing visions. But it is all nonsense, because their minds are filled with selfish desires.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma sona biala bɔ ɔpati brɛ ye nwo ase, bɔ ɔsɔne abɔfo mɔ, bɔ ɔnwa wanya nyekyire, bua ɛmɔ foɛ; ofikyɛ ye adwene mbaen yeɛ ɔfa tu ye nwo yɔ sɔ ɔ.

english_verse: They are no longer part of Christ, who is the head of the whole body. Christ gives the body its strength, and he uses its joints and muscles to hold it together, as it grows by the power of God. Christ Brings New Life
translation_verse: Sɔ sona ne wapo kyɛ okotira Tire ne bɔ nipadua ne fa ye aporɔ so ne ye ndii so onya aleɛ ná ɔtoatoa nu ne, na onyi wɔ enyinɛ bɔ ofi Nyameɛ berɛ ɔ nu. Pɔɔlo bɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ tɛɛ nwo kɔkɔ

english_verse: You died with Christ. Now the forces of the universe don't have any power over you. Why do you live as if you had to obey such rules as,
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔ ne Kristo banya bawu bafi wiase sunzum nu ngyerɛkyerɛ nu a, nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔbɔ ɛmɔ bra kyɛ ɛmɔtɛwɔ wiase ɔ? Nzu ati yeɛ ɛmɔdi ahyɛdeɛ sɔaa mɔ so ɔ:

english_verse: “Don't handle this. Don't taste that. Don't touch this.”?
translation_verse: “Bɛ nwo nga he, benni he, bɛnzɔ he anu?”

english_verse: After these things are used, they are no longer good for anything. So why be bothered with the rules that humans have made up?
translation_verse: Na ɛhemɔ te nningyein bɔ bɛfa bedi dwumaa ɔsɛkye ɔ, yeɛ bɛpɛ nu bɛkɔ; ofikyɛ bɛte kuro sona ahyɛdeɛ ne ngyerɛkyerɛ.

english_verse: Obeying these rules may seem to be the smart thing to do. They appear to make you love God more and to be very humble and to have control over your body. But they don't really have any power over our desires.
translation_verse: Osoma kyɛ nworɛ wɔ sɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne anu, bɔ ɔma sona sɔ ɛsom nu kateree ɔ, bɛpati bɛyɛ anwobrɛaseɛ, na bɛhyɛ nipadua ne anyeborolɛ; nakoso mvasoɛ biala nne ɛhemɔ so, yeɛ bɛngora benzi anwoɔnaen nu akɔnnɔ atee.

english_verse: You have been raised to life with Christ. Now set your heart on what is in heaven, where Christ rules at God's right side.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ ɛmɔ ne Kristo banya batingye de a, ɛ́mɔpena nningyein bɔ ɔwɔ anwuro ne si atee, nekaa bɔ Kristo te Nyameɛ sa famaa so ne.

english_verse: Think about what is up there, not about what is here on earth.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdwene nningyein bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso nwo, na ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdwene aseɛ so nningyein nwo.

english_verse: You died, which means that your life is hidden with Christ, who sits beside God.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔawu, na bafa ɛmɔ ngoa ne Kristo basie Nyameɛ nu.

english_verse: Christ gives meaning to your life, and when he appears, you will also appear with him in glory.
translation_verse: Na kyẽa bɔ Kristo bɔ ɔte yɛ ngoa ne ɔkɔla ye nwo ali nen, yeɛ bɛkɔla ɛmɔ koso ne ye ali wɔ animnyam nu ɔ. Bra daa ne bra foforɛ

english_verse: Don't be controlled by your body. Kill every desire for the wrong kind of sex. Don't be immoral or indecent or have evil thoughts. Don't be greedy, which is the same as worshiping idols.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔhu aseɛ so suban bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ nu ne: adwamanbɔlɛ, brabɔlɛ fiɛ, ahohwibra, akɔnnɔ bɔne bɔ ɔhyɛ sona so, ɔne anyeboroborolɛ; ofikyɛ anyeboroborolɛ te bosoensolɛ.

english_verse: God is angry with people who disobey him by doing these things.
translation_verse: Ɔnate ɛhemɔ ati yeɛ Nyameɛ ahonehulɛ ne ɔba asoserɛfoɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: And this is exactly what you did, when you lived among people who behaved in this way.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ né ɛmɔwɔ sɔ tebea ne anu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔbɔle ɛmɔ bra ɔ.

english_verse: But now you must stop doing such things. You must quit being angry, hateful, and evil. You must no longer say insulting or cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Nakoso kekesaala ye de, ɛ́mɔgyi ɛhemɔ amukoraa bégua: ɛyaafɛlɛ, ahone tɛɛ, ɛpɔen, musue dwirɛ ne edwudwolɛ fiɛ.

english_verse: And stop lying to each other. You have given up your old way of life with its habits.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔpepɛ ngondombo bekyirekyire ɛmɔ nwo, ofikyɛ ɛmɔagyi ɛmɔ suban daa ne, ɔne ye yɔleɛ tɛɛ ne bagua,

english_verse: Each of you is now a new person. You are becoming more and more like your Creator, and you will understand him better.
translation_verse: na ɛmɔanya sona sue foforɛ, na ye bɔ ɔbɔle yɛ ne, ogu so ɔyɛ yɛ foforɛ ba nimdeɛ nu maa ye sɛso yɛ kyɛ ye bɔbɔ ne ala.

english_verse: It doesn't matter if you are a Greek or a Jew, or if you are circumcised or not. You may even be a barbarian or a Scythian, and you may be a slave or a free person. Yet Christ is all that matters, and he lives in all of us.
translation_verse: Yiti Helaniɛ oo, Yudaniɛ oo; bienzuapɛlɛniɛ oo, bɛmbɛ-bɛ-bienzuafoɛ oo; pɔtɔniɛ oo, bɔ ye nye butu ase oo; akoaa oo, dehyeɛ oo, nzonzoleɛ biala nne b’afia, ofikyɛ Kristo wɔ berɛ ma bɛ mukoraa, na ɔte bɛ mukoraa bɛ nu.

english_verse: God loves you and has chosen you as his own special people. So be gentle, kind, humble, meek, and patient.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔte mmenia bɔ Nyameɛ aneanea nu waye ɛmɔ ɔ, anwoteefoɛ ne adɔfo, yiti ɛ́mɔfa anwumvoinnwunɛ, paayɛlɛ, awiɛmvoɛ yɔbea ɔne anwobrɛaseɛ ne aboterɛ bɛbɔ ɛmɔ bra.

english_verse: Put up with each other, and forgive anyone who does you wrong, just as Christ has forgiven you.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnya aboterɛ bɛmoma ɛmɔ nwo; ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ abiɛngo mvomsoɛ bɛhyɛ ye. Na sɛ ebie ne obiɛngo benya edwudwolɛ a, ɛ́mɔfa bɛhyehyɛ bɛ nwo, kyɛbɔ Awurade afa ahyɛ ɛmɔ ne.

english_verse: Love is more important than anything else. It is what ties everything completely together.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔtra so ɔ, ɛ́mɔye ɔdɔ behyire, na ɛhe yeɛ ɔkã nningyein mukoraa bɔ nu maa bedi mu ɔ.

english_verse: Each one of you is part of the body of Christ, and you were chosen to live together in peace. So let the peace that comes from Christ control your thoughts. And be grateful.
translation_verse: Afei ɛ́mɔma Kristo asomdwee ne oli ɛmɔ bra so, na ɛhe ati yeɛ bɛfrɛle ɛmɔ maa ɛmɔɔyɛle nipadua ko ɔ. Na nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ boniayɛ.

english_verse: Let the message about Christ completely fill your lives, while you use all your wisdom to teach and instruct each other. With thankful hearts, sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma Kristo dwirɛ ne oyi ɛmɔ nu tɛkyɛ, ɛmɔhyirehyire ná ɛ́mɔfa nworɛ mukoraa betutu ɛmɔ nwo foɛ. Ɛ́mɔto sangoo dwein, ayɛyelɛ dwein, ɔne sunzum nu dwein bɔ ɔte ahone nu asennaa bɛ́ma Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Whatever you say or do should be done in the name of the Lord Jesus, as you give thanks to God the Father because of him. Some Rules for Christian Living
translation_verse: Na nikyee biala bɔ ɛmɔyɔ wɔ edwudwolɛ anaa yɔleɛ nu ne, ɛmɔyɔ ye mukoraa wɔ Awurade Yesu dumaa nu, na ɛmɔfa asennaa bɛfa ye so bɛma Baba Nyameɛ. Gyidiniɛ asetena nu ngyerɛkyerɛ

english_verse: A wife must put her husband first. This is her duty as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: Yeɛ mɔ, ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛ́ma ɛmɔ ahu mɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔsɛ wɔ Awurade nu ɔ.

english_verse: A husband must love his wife and not abuse her.
translation_verse: Huɛ mɔ, ɛmɔhuro ɛmɔ aye mɔ, na nnɛma ɛmɔteetee bɛ.

english_verse: Children must always obey their parents. This pleases the Lord.
translation_verse: Ngwadaa, ɛ́mɔyɛ sotie bɛ́ma ɛmɔ awofoɛ mɔ wɔ nikyee biala nu, na ɛhe yeɛ ɔsɔ Awurade nye ɔ.

english_verse: Parents, don't be hard on your children. If you are, they might give up.
translation_verse: Seɛ mɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔhyɛ ɛmɔ mma mɔ anyeborolɛ, ná b’abasanu ammu.

english_verse: Slaves, you must always obey your earthly masters. Try to please them at all times, and not just when you think they are watching. Honor the Lord and serve your masters with your whole heart.
translation_verse: Ngoaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔyɛ sotie bɛ́ma ɛmɔ anwoɔnaen nu meneɛ mɔ wɔ nikyee biala nu. Nnɛma ɛmɔyɔ ye bɛ nye so mbaen, kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ma sona kamvo ɛmɔ ɔ, na mmom ɛ́mɔfia ɛmɔ kunu bɛyɔ ye kyɛ mmenia bɔ besuro Awurade ɔ.

english_verse: Do your work willingly, as though you were serving the Lord himself, and not just your earthly master.
translation_verse: Na adwuma biala bɔ ɛmɔyɔ ne, ɛ́mɔfi ɛmɔ ahone nu bɛ́yɔ ye kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɛma Awurade, na nna kuro sona.

english_verse: In fact, the Lord Christ is the one you are really serving, and you know he will reward you.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, ɛmɔse kyɛ Awurade berɛ yeɛ ɛmɔkonya ɛmɔ agyapadeɛ bɔ ɔte akatuaa ne ɔ, ofikyɛ Awurade Kristo yeɛ ɛmɔso ye ɔ.

english_verse: But Christ has no favorites! He will punish evil people, just as they deserve.
translation_verse: Nakoso sona bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne ne, okonya bɔne bɔ ɔyɔ ne nwo akatuaa, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ nyɛ sona nu nyeyemuɛ

english_verse: Slave owners, be fair and honest with your slaves. Don't forget that you have a Master in heaven.
translation_verse: Meneɛ mɔ, edwirɛ bɔ ɔte pɛpɛɛpɛ ná ɔtengyɛ yeɛ ɛ́mɔfa beli ɛmɔ ngoaa mɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔse kyɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔle Meneɛ wɔ nyameɛso. Pɔɔlo tu Kolosefoɛ foɛ

english_verse: Never give up praying. And when you pray, keep alert and be thankful.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhɔ so bɛbɔ mbaeɛ, ná ɛ́mɔfa asennaa bɛwɛne wɔ mbaeɛbɔlɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Be sure to pray that God will make a way for us to spread his message and explain the mystery about Christ, even though I am in jail for doing this.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ bɛ́ma yɛ koso, kyɛ Nyameɛ bukye edwirɛ ne nwo atee ma yɛ, ma yɛbɔ Kristo mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne dawure, edwirɛ bɔ yiti yeɛ nna kukunu ye.

english_verse: Please pray that I will make the message as clear as possible.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔsrɛ bɛ́ma me kyɛ ngyirekyire nu pefee kyɛbɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ mekyire nu ɔ.

english_verse: When you are with unbelievers, always make good use of the time.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛnne yɛ fekue ne anu ne, ɛ́mɔnate nworɛ nu wɔ bɛ nu, na nnɛma ɛmɔsɛkye ɛmɔ mmerɛ mbaen.

english_verse: Be pleasant and hold their interest when you speak the message. Choose your words carefully and be ready to give answers to anyone who asks questions. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ noa dwudwolɛ yɛ fɛ kyɛ ngyee, amaa ɛmɔanwu mmuayɛɛ paa bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa bebua ebiala ɔ. Ngraa bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ

english_verse: Tychicus is the dear friend, who faithfully works and serves the Lord with us, and he will give you the news about me.
translation_verse: Tihiko kɔɔfa me nwo dwirɛ kɔbɔ ɛmɔ amaneɛ. Ɔte aliɛmaa bɔ mekuro ye dwirɛ paa ne nahorɛ adwumayɔlɛniɛ, ɔne mmiɛngo somvoɛ wɔ Awurade nu.

english_verse: I am sending him to cheer you up by telling you how we are getting along.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati yeɛ masoma ye ɛmɔ berɛ ɔ, amaa ɛmɔanwu kyɛbɔ yɛ nwo si te ɔ, ná wakyekye ɛmɔ wora,

english_verse: Onesimus, the dear and faithful follower from your own group, is coming with him. The two of them will tell you everything that has happened here.
translation_verse: na masoma ye ne Onesimo, aliɛmaa nahorɛniɛ bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo, bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ nu ko ne, Na bɛkɔhã bɔ wasi wa amukoraa bekohyire ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Aristarchus is in jail with me. He sends greetings to you, and so does Mark, the cousin of Barnabas. You have already been told to welcome Mark, if he visits you.
translation_verse: Mmiɛngo kukununiɛ Aristako bisa ɛmɔ ahye; Banaba awosea Marko bɔ ɛmɔnyane ye nwo ngraa ne koso sɔ ala, .

english_verse: Jesus, who is known as Justus, sends his greetings. These three men are the only Jewish followers who have worked with me for the kingdom of God. They have given me much comfort.
translation_verse: Yesu bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Yusto ne koso obisa ɛmɔ ahye. Ɛhemɔ ngome yeɛ bɛte bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛne me yɛyɔ Nyameɛ ahennie ne nwo adwuma ɔ, na bɛte aworakyekyerɛ ma me. Epafra, Luka ne Dema

english_verse: Your own Epaphras, who serves Christ Jesus, sends his greetings. He always prays hard that you may fully know what the Lord wants you to do and that you may do it completely.
translation_verse: Kristo Yesu akoaa Epafra bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ nu ko ne, obisa ɛmɔ ahye. Daa biala ɔkaye ɛmɔ paa wɔ ye mbaeɛbɔlɛ nu, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔkogyina pindinn, ná ɛmɔ adwene asi pi wɔ Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ mukoraa nu ɔ.

english_verse: I have seen how much trouble he has gone through for you and for the followers in Laodicea and Hierapolis.
translation_verse: Medi ye nwo adanzeɛ kyɛ wabɔ mmɔden paa wama ɛmɔ ne Laodikeafoɛ ne Hirapolifoɛ.

english_verse: Our dear doctor Luke sends you his greetings, and so does Demas.
translation_verse: Yɛ dɔfo safoɛ Luka ɔne Dema bebisa ɛmɔ ahye.

english_verse: Give my greetings to the followers at Laodicea, especially to Nympha and the church that meets in her home.
translation_verse: Mebisa aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Laodikea; yeɛ afei Nimva ne asɔre bɔ ɔwɔ ye awuro ne ahye.

english_verse: After this letter has been read to your people, be sure to have it read in the church at Laodicea. And you should read the letter that I have sent to them.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔkenga krataa he wɔ ɛmɔ nu beyie a, ɛ́mɔma bɛkenga ye wɔ Laodikeafoɛ asɔre nu koso. Ɛmɔ koso odi kyɛ ɛmɔkenga Laodikeafoɛ krataa bɔ bɛkɔfa bɛkɔbrɛ ɛmɔ ne.

english_verse: Remind Archippus to do the work that the Lord has given him to do.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhã behyire Akipo kyɛ, “Nea kyɛ ɛkɔyɔ ɛsolɛ adwuma bɔ anya afi Awurade berɛ ne ekoyie pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: I am signing this letter myself: PAUL. Don't forget that I am in jail. I pray that God will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Me Pɔɔlo, me bɔbɔ me sa noa ahyerɛlɛ he yeɛ mefa mebisa ɛmɔ bisabisa ɔ. Ɛ́mɔkaye kyɛ ndɛla kuku nu. Adom ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God the Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ. I pray that God will be kind to you and will bless you with peace!
translation_verse: Krataa he fi Pɔɔlo, Silwano ne Timoteo berɛ. Yɛfa yɛbrɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo asɔre bɔ ɔwɔ Tɛsalonika ne. Adom ne asomdwee [bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ] ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. Tɛsalonikafoɛ brabɔlɛ ne gyidie

english_verse: We thank God for you and always mention you in our prayers. Each time we pray,
translation_verse: Ɔnate ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛ ti, mmerɛ biala yɛfa asennaa yɛma Nyameɛ, na yɛbɔ ɛmɔ dumaa wɔ yɛ mbaeɛbɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: we tell God our Father about your faith and loving work and about your firm hope in our Lord Jesus Christ. The Thessalonians' Faith and Example
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ biala yɛkaye ɛmɔ gyidie adwuma, ɔne ɛmɔ adwumayɔlɛ bɔ ofi ɔdɔ nu, ɔne ɛmɔ anyelasoɛ bɔ ogyi berɛ pindinn wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo nu ne, wɔ yɛ Baba Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: My dear friends, God loves you, and we know he has chosen you to be his people.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ Nyameɛ kuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ ɔ, yɛse kyɛ waneanea nu waye ɛmɔ.

english_verse: When we told you the good news, it was with the power and assurance that come from the Holy Spirit, and not simply with words. You knew what kind of people we were and how we helped you.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, nna yɛ noa dwirɛ ngome so yeɛ yɛnate yɛfale nzɛmba ne yɛbrɛle ɛmɔ ɔ; na mmom yɛnate tumi ne Sunzum Krongron koso so yeɛ yɛfa yɛbrɛle ɛmɔ ɔ, na yɛse ye pefee kyɛ nzɛmba ne te nahorɛ. Na ɛmɔse kyɛbɔ ɔnate ɛmɔ ti yɛsi yɛbɔle yɛ bra wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né yɛwɔ ɛmɔ berɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: So, when you accepted the message, you followed our example and the example of the Lord. You suffered, but the Holy Spirit made you glad.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔsuasuane yɛ ne Awurade; na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛmɔnwuni amaneɛ pee wɔ edwirɛ ne anwo de, nakoso ɛmɔfale anika bɔ ofi Sunzum Krongron berɛ bɛsɔle nu.

english_verse: You became an example for all the Lord's followers in Macedonia and Achaia.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ama ɛmɔayɛ nhwɛsoɛ bama agyidifoɛ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ Makedonia ne Akaia ɔ.

english_verse: And because of you, the Lord's message has spread everywhere in those regions. Now the news of your faith in God is known all over the world, and we don't have to say a thing about it.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, nna Awurade nwo dwirɛ ne ngome yeɛ wafi ɛmɔ berɛ waadwu Makedonia ne Akaia ɔ; na mmom ɛmɔ gyidie wɔ Nyameɛ nu nwo dwirɛ koso watrɛ wahɔ nekaa biala, yiti onhia kyɛ yɛkɔhã ye nwo dwirɛ ko.

english_verse: Everyone is talking about how you welcomed us and how you turned away from idols to serve the true and living God.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia nemɔ bɔbɔ deinn bɛkã kyɛbɔ ɛmɔsi belele yɛ nyemene so, ɔne kyɛbɔ ɛmɔasi bahwe bɛ nwo bafi mmosoen nwo bawa Nyameɛ berɛ, kyɛ ɛmɔkɔso Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne nahorɛniɛ ne,

english_verse: They also tell how you are waiting for his Son Jesus to come from heaven. God raised him from death, and on the day of judgment Jesus will save us from God's anger.
translation_verse: ná ɛmɔnwondɛ Ɔwa ne bɔ otingyele ye fili awufoɛ nu ne kyɛ okofi nyameɛso kɔwa ɔ; Yesu bɔ ɔpepɛ de yɛ fi ahonehulɛ bɔ ɔ́ba ne anu ne.

english_verse: My friends, you know our time with you wasn't wasted.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔse kyɛ yɛ walɛ bɔ yɛwale ɛmɔ berɛ ne wanyɛ mbaen.

english_verse: As you remember, we had been mistreated and insulted at Philippi. But God gave us the courage to tell you the good news about him, even though many people caused us trouble.
translation_verse: Na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ yɛlili moa yɛnwuni amaneɛ, ná bɛbɔle yɛ alapaa wɔ Filipi, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔse ne, nakoso yɛsili y’ahone wɔ yɛ Nyameɛ nu kyɛ yɛkɔhã Nyameɛ nzɛmba ne yɛkohyire ɛmɔ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ bɛko betia yɛ ɔ.

english_verse: We didn't have any hidden motives when we won you over, and we didn't try to fool or trick anyone.
translation_verse: Yɛ dwirɛ bɔ yɛhane ne, oggyi ngondombo anaa adwene tɛɛ biala so, yeɛ nnakannaka biala nne nu;

english_verse: God was pleased to trust us with his message. We didn't speak to please people, but to please God who knows our motives.
translation_verse: na mmom kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ abu yɛ kyɛ yɛfata, ná wafa nzɛmba ne wawura yɛ sa ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛdwudwo ɔ; nna kyɛ yɛfa yɛsɔ mmenia nye, na mmom Nyameɛ bɔ ɔse yɛ ti anu dwirɛ ne yeɛ yɛfa yɛsɔ ye nye ɔ.

english_verse: You also know we didn't try to flatter anyone. God himself knows what we did wasn't a cover-up for greed.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔse kyɛ yanga adɛfɛdɛfɛ dwirɛ biala; yeɛ yammutubutu edwirɛ so yamva yambena adifuu nikye, Nyameɛ te yɛ danzeniɛ!

english_verse: But as apostles, we could have demanded help from you. After all, Christ is the one who sent us. We chose to be like children or like a mother nursing her baby.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ né yɛwɔ ɛmɔ berɛ nen, yɛdwole yɛ nwo ase te kyɛ brataen bɔ ɔnea ye mma ɔ.

english_verse: We cared so much for you, and you became so dear to us, that we were willing to give our lives for you when we gave you God's message.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate ɛmɔ nwo dɔ bɔ yɛle ye ne ati, nna Nyameɛ nzɛmba ne ngome yeɛ yɛhã yɛhyirele ɛmɔ ɔ, na mmom yɛfale yɛ nwo yɛbɔle afɔleɛ koso yɛmane ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ yɛhurole ɛmɔ dwirɛ soma.

english_verse: My dear friends, you surely haven't forgotten our hard work and hardships. You remember how night and day we struggled to make a living, so we could tell you God's message without being a burden to anyone.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔkaye kyɛbɔ yɛsi yɛyɔle adwuma, ɔne yɛ fɛɛ bɔ yɛfɛle ɔ. Yɛyɔle adwuma eyia ne kɔngɔen kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ na yanyɛ ɛmɔ nu biala so tɔsom, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né yɛkã Nyameɛ nzɛmba ne yɛkyire ɛmɔ ne.

english_verse: Both you and God are witnesses that we were pure and honest and innocent in our dealings with you followers of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔdi adanzeɛ, Nyameɛ koso sɔ ala, kyɛ yɛ suban bɔ yɛyele ye ali yɛhyirele ɛmɔ bɔ bɛte agyidifoɛ ne, ɔte krongron, ye nwo te, na ngekalewa biala nne ye nwo.

english_verse: You also know we did everything for you that parents would do for their own children.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔse kyɛ yɛtuli ɛmɔ nu biala foɛ, yɛkyekyele ɛmɔ wora kyɛbɔ seɛ si yɛ ye mma ɔ, na yɛhyɛle ɛmɔ nguraen,

english_verse: We begged, encouraged, and urged each of you to live in a way that would honor God. He is the one who chose you to share in his own kingdom and glory.
translation_verse: kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ bra bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ bɔ wafrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔɔnya kyɛfa wɔ ye Ahennie ne ye animnyam nu ne nye. Tɛsalonikafoɛ sɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne anu

english_verse: We always thank God that you believed the message we preached. It came from him, and it isn't something made up by humans. You accepted it as God's message, and now he is working in you.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe koso ati yeɛ yɛda Nyameɛ ase daa ɔ, ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ yɛfale Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne yɛbrɛle ɛmɔ nen, ɛmɔsɔle nu kyɛ nna kuro sona dwirɛ ɔ, na mmom kyɛ ɔte Nyameɛ dwirɛ amba; na ɛhe yeɛ ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔte agyidifoɛ ne, ɔyɔ adwuma wɔ ɛmɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, you did just like God's churches in Judea and like the other followers of Christ Jesus there. And so, you were mistreated by your own people, in the same way they were mistreated by their people.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, Nyameɛ asɔre mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ Yudea wɔ Yesu Kristo nu ne, agyirɛ bɔ betuli ne, ebiala yeɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔatu ne; ofikyɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔanwu amaneɛ wɔ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔ mmenia bɛ sa nu, kyɛbɔ Yudafoɛ fa yɛle bɛ koso ne ala.

english_verse: Those evil people killed the Lord Jesus and the prophets, and they even chased us away. God doesn't like what they do and neither does anyone else.
translation_verse: Bɛ yeɛ behuni Awurade Yesu ne bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ ɔ, ná bɛtanene yɛ nye maa yɛnwatili ɔ. Bɛnzɔ Nyameɛ nye, yeɛ bɛko betia mmenia amukoraa.

english_verse: They keep us from speaking his message to the Gentiles and from leading them to be saved. They have always gone too far with their sins. Now God has finally become angry and will punish them. Paul Wants To Visit the Church Again
translation_verse: Na bɛberale yɛ kyɛ nnɛmaa yɛkã edwirɛ ne yɛkyire Amaenmaensofoɛ maa benya daa ngoa. Na ɛhe ma bɛ bɔne kwangoa ne oyi tɛkyɛ daa, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ahonehulɛ ne wanya wawa bɛ so wayie! Pɔɔlo wora dɔ Tɛsalonikafoɛ

english_verse: My friends, we were kept from coming to you for a while, but we never stopped thinking about you. We were eager to see you and tried our best to visit you in person.
translation_verse: Yɛ de, aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛfili ɛmɔ nwo berɛ mmerɛ kãa bie wɔ anwoɔnaen nu, na nna y’ahone nu ɔ; yiti yɛ wora dɔ ɛmɔ soma, na yɛpere kyɛ yɛkonwu ɛmɔ bieku ɔ.

english_verse: We really wanted to come. I myself tried several times, but Satan always stopped us.
translation_verse: Ahaa yɛpena kyɛ yɛsa yɛba ɛmɔ berɛ. Me bɔbɔ, Pɔɔlo, mabɔ ye nwo mmɔden pee, nakoso Abɔnzam sili yɛ ate.

english_verse: After all, when the Lord Jesus appears, who else but you will give us hope and joy and be like a glorious crown for us?
translation_verse: Na nzikyɛ yeɛ ɔte y’anyelasoɛ, anaa y’anigye, anaa yɛ ngonim abotire bɔ yɛkɔfa yɛkɔhoahoa yɛ nwo wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo nyunu wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔkɔwa ne ɔ? Aso nna ɛmɔ ɔ?

english_verse: You alone are our glory and joy!
translation_verse: Amba, ɛmɔte y’animnyam ne y’anigye.

english_verse: Finally, we couldn't stand it any longer. We decided to stay in Athens by ourselves
translation_verse: Afei de, né yɛsɔ nu a ɔnzɔ ko. Yiti yɛyɛle kyɛ yɛ ngome yɛkɔha Atense,

english_verse: and send our friend Timothy to you. He works with us as God's servant and preaches the good news about Christ. We wanted him to make you strong in your faith and to encourage you.
translation_verse: na yɛsomane aliɛmaa Timoteo bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ somvoɛ, ná ɔne yɛ yɔ Kristo nzɛmba ne nwo adwuma ne, kyɛ ɔɔhyɛ ɛmɔ nguraen ná ɔma ɛmɔ gyidie gyina pindinn;

english_verse: We didn't want any of you to be discouraged by all these troubles. You knew we would have to suffer,
translation_verse: amaa sɔ amaneɛnwunɛ hemɔ ammo ɛmɔ nu biala so. Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔse kyɛ amaneɛnwunɛ bɔ odi kyɛ yɛnwu ye hɔ ala ɛne.

english_verse: because when we were with you, we told you this would happen. And we did suffer, as you well know.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, mmerɛ bɔ né yɛwɔ ɛmɔ berɛ nen, yɛlili moa yɛhã yɛhyirele ɛmɔ kyɛ yɛkonwu amaneɛ, na kyɛbɔ ɛmɔse nen, sɔ ala koso yeɛ wasi ɔ.

english_verse: At last, when I could not wait any longer, I sent Timothy to find out about your faith. I hoped Satan had not tempted you and made all our work useless.
translation_verse: Ɔnate ɛhe ati, mmerɛ bɔ né mesɔ nu a ɔnzɔ ne, nzomane ye kyɛ ɔɔnea kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ gyidie si gyi ɔ; na mesuro kyɛ ebiaa né abɔnzam aso ɛmɔ anea ama y’adwuma bɔ yɛyɔle ne wayɛ mbaen.

english_verse: Timothy has now come back from his visit with you and has told us about your faith and love. He also said that you always have happy memories of us and that you want to see us as much as we want to see you.
translation_verse: Nakoso afei de, Timoteo afi ɛmɔ berɛ wasa wawa yɛ wa, na wafa ɛmɔ gyidie ne ɔdɔ nwo dwirɛ fɛɛ waabɔ yɛ amaneɛ kyɛ daa ɛmɔkaye yɛ paa, na ɛmɔ wora dɔ yɛ, kyɛbɔ yɛ koso yɛ wora dɔ ɛmɔ ne ala.

english_verse: My friends, even though we have a lot of trouble and suffering, your faith makes us feel better about you.
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, y’anwokyere ne amaneɛnwunɛ mukoraa nu ne, ɛmɔ gyidie ne amaa yanya ɛmɔ nwo aworakyekyerɛ;

english_verse: Your strong faith in the Lord is like a breath of new life.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ, sɛ ɛmɔgyina pindinn wɔ Awurade nu a, né afei yanya ngoa.

english_verse: How can we possibly thank God enough for all the happiness you have brought us?
translation_verse: Anigye wora bɔ ɔnate ɛmɔ ti yanya ye wɔ yɛ Nyameɛ nyunu ye, nzikyɛ asennaa bieku yeɛ yɛkɔhora yɛkɔfa yɛkɔma Nyameɛ wɔ ɛmɔ nwo ɔ?

english_verse: Day and night we sincerely pray that we will see you again and help you to have an even stronger faith.
translation_verse: Yɛfa y’ahone amukoraa alehyeleɛ ne alesaleɛ yɛsrɛ kyɛ ɔma yɛnwu ɛmɔ nyunu, ná yɛpagya bɔ ɔtɔ sii wɔ ɛmɔ gyidie nu ne.

english_verse: We pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus will let us visit you.
translation_verse: Yɛsrɛ kyɛ yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne bɔbɔ ne y’Awurade Yesu bebukye ate bɛma yɛbra ɛmɔ berɛ.

english_verse: May the Lord make your love for each other and for everyone else grow by leaps and bounds. This is how our love for you has grown.
translation_verse: Yɛsrɛ kyɛ Awurade ɔma ehurolɛ bɔ ɛmɔkurokuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ, ɔne mmenia mukoraa nwo dɔ ne onyi mmorosoɛ so, kyɛbɔ yɛ koso yɛkuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ ne ala,

english_verse: And when our Lord comes with all his people, I pray he will make your hearts pure and innocent in the sight of God the Father.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so wasi ɛmɔ ahone pi, ná wayɛ ɛmɔ krongron bɔ ngekalewa biala nne nu wɔ yɛ Baba Nyameɛ nyunu, wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo ne ye anwoteefoɛ amukoraa walɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Finally, my dear friends, since you belong to the Lord Jesus, we beg and urge you to live as we taught you. Then you will please God. You are already living that way, but try even harder.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, yɛ́srɛ ɛmɔ, ná yɛtu ɛmɔ foɛ wɔ Awurade Yesu nu kyɛ, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔsuane kyɛbɔ ɛmɔkosi bɛkɔbɔ bɛ bra bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye befili yɛ berɛ nen, ɛmɔhɔ so bɛyɔ ye mmorosoɛ kyɛbɔ ɛmɔyɔ ne ala.

english_verse: Remember the instructions we gave you as followers of the Lord Jesus.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔse ahyɛdeɛ bɔ yɛnate Awurade Yesu so yɛfa yɛmane ɛmɔ ne.

english_verse: God wants you to be holy, so don't be immoral in matters of sex.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ ɛhe: kyɛ ɛmɔ nwo kɔte, ná ɛmɔkɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo bekofi adwamanbɔlɛ nwo,

english_verse: Don't be a slave of your desires or live like people who don't know God.
translation_verse: na mmom ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɛmɔma akɔnnɔ tɛɛ hyɛ ɛmɔ so kyɛbɔ maen maen nufoɛ bɔ bɛnze Nyameɛ ɔ bɛyɔ ne.

english_verse: You must not cheat any of the Lord's followers in matters of sex. Remember, we warned you that he punishes everyone who does such things.
translation_verse: Na ɔnzɛ kyɛ ebiala yɔ oliɛma tɛɛ anaa osisi ye wɔ ɛhe anwo, ofikyɛ yali moa yabɔ ɛmɔ kɔkɔ kitii kyɛ Awurade kɔtɔ ɛhemɔ amukoraa so wereɛ.

english_verse: God didn't choose you to be filthy, but to be pure.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, Nyameɛ amvrɛ yɛ wamma efiɛ nu, na mmom anwotelɛ nu.

english_verse: So if you don't obey these rules, you are not really disobeying us. Instead, you are disobeying God, who gives you his Holy Spirit.
translation_verse: Yiti ebiala bɔ ɔpo ngyerɛkyerɛ he nen, nna kuro sona yeɛ ɔpo ye ɔ, na mmom Nyameɛ bɔ wafa ye Sunzum Krongron ne wama yɛ ne.

english_verse: We don't have to write you about the need to love each other. God has taught you to do this,
translation_verse: Onhia kyɛ ngɔhyerɛ ngɔkɔbrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔhurohuro ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ bɛ dwirɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ahyirehyire ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔhurohuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ.

english_verse: and you already have shown your love for all his people in Macedonia. But, my dear friends, we ask you to do even more.
translation_verse: Na amba, sɔ suban ne ala koso yeɛ ɛmɔala ye ali bahyire aliɛmaa mɔ amukoraa bɔ bɛwɔ Makedonia amukoraa ɔ. Nakoso, aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛsrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔhɔ so bɛyɔ ye mmorosoɛ,

english_verse: Try your best to live quietly, to mind your own business, and to work hard, just as we taught you to do.
translation_verse: ná ɛ́mɔbɔ mmɔden brɛbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase, ɛ́mɔdwene ɛmɔ nwo, ná ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ sa bɛyɔ adwuma, kyɛbɔ yɛhã yɛhyirele ɛmɔ ne;

english_verse: Then you will be respected by people who are not followers of the Lord, and you won't have to depend on anyone. The Lord's Coming
translation_verse: amaa ɛmɔabɔ bɛ bra kyɛbɔ ɔfata wɔ ewiasefoɛ nu, ná nikye fee anhia ɛmɔ. Awurade walɛ ne

english_verse: My friends, we want you to understand how it will be for those followers who have already died. Then you won't grieve over them and be like people who don't have any hope.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛkuro kyɛ ɛmɔnwu nahorɛ bɔ ɔfa bɛ bɔ balela nemɔ anwo, ná ɛmɔ wora ammɔ kyɛ mmenia bɔ baha bɔ belle anyelasoɛ ne.

english_verse: We believe Jesus died and was raised to life. We also believe that when God brings Jesus back again, he will bring with him all who had faith in Jesus before they died.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛde yɛdi kyɛ Yesu wuli ná osa tingyele de a, nzaade Nyameɛ kɔfa bɛ bɔ balela nemɔ kɔfa Yesu so kɔboka ye so kɔwa.

english_verse: Our Lord Jesus told us that when he comes, we won't go up to meet him ahead of his followers who have already died.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe de, yɛnate Awurade dwirɛ so yeɛ yɛkã yɛkyire ɛmɔ ɔ, kyɛ yɛ bɔ yɛte ase, ná yɛtena ngoa nu yɛkoodwu Awurade walɛ ne anu ne, yɛngosa bɛ bɔ balela nemɔ anwo.

english_verse: With a loud command and with the shout of the chief angel and a blast of God's trumpet, the Lord will return from heaven. Then those who had faith in Christ before they died will be raised to life.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Awurade bɔbɔ kɔfa esebɔlɛ, abɔfo panyi komvi ne Nyameɛ totorobɛndo komvi kofi nyameɛso kodwu kɔwa, na Kristo nu awufoɛ bekoli moa bekodwɔso,

english_verse: Next, all of us who are still alive will be taken up into the clouds together with them to meet the Lord in the sky. From that time on we will all be with the Lord forever.
translation_verse: na afei yɛ bɔ yɛte ase, bɔ yaha ne, ɔne bɛ koso, bɛkɔfa yɛ munungum nu maa yɛkooyia Awurade wɔ ewienu, na sɔ yeɛ yɛne Awurade kɔtena daa ɔ.

english_verse: Encourage each other with these words.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔfa edwirɛ hemɔ bɛ́kyekye ɛmɔ wora.

english_verse: I don't need to write you about the time or date when all this will happen.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, mmerɛ ne ne ngyẽa ne de, onhia kyɛ yɛkɔhyerɛ ye nwo dwirɛ yɛkɔbrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: You surely know that the Lord's return will be as a thief coming at night.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔse ye pefee kyɛ Awurade kyẽa ne kɔwa kyɛbɔ awueniɛ ba kɔngɔen ɔ.

english_verse: People will think they are safe and secure. But destruction will suddenly strike them like the pains of a woman about to give birth. And they won't escape.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ mmenia kɔhã kyɛ, “Yɛle asomdwee ne anwotɔ” nen, yeɛ ewue kɔto bɛ mvum nu kyɛ koɛhalɛ bɔ ɔka brasua bɔ wafo aworɛ so ɔ, na bengonya bɛ ti bengodidi nu.

english_verse: My dear friends, you don't live in darkness, and so that day won't surprise you like a thief.
translation_verse: Nakoso aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔ de ɛmɔnne awosii nu, ná kyẽa ne waafũ ɛmɔ nu kyɛ awueniɛ.

english_verse: You belong to the light and live in the day. We don't live in the night or belong to the dark.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛmɔte kanea mma ne alehyeleɛ mma. Yɛtte alesaleɛ anaa awosii mmaa.

english_verse: Others may sleep, but we should stay awake and be alert.
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛmɔma yɛdafe kyɛbɔ ebiemɔ bɛyɔ ne; na mmom ɛ́mɔma yɛwɛne, ná yɛma yɛ nye la berɛ.

english_verse: But we belong to the day. So we must stay sober and let our faith and love be like a suit of armor. Our firm hope that we will be saved is our helmet.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɔnate kyɛ yɛte alehyeleɛ mma ne ati, ɛ́mɔma yɛ nye la berɛ ná yɛfa gyidie ne ɔdɔ yɛyɛ koɛ buralɛ yɛkata yɛ hue so, na yɛfa ngoalelɛ nwo anyelasoɛ yɛyɛ koɛ buralɛ kyerɛ yɛwura.

english_verse: God doesn't intend to punish us, but wants us to be saved by our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ amvrɛ yɛ amma ye yaafɛlɛ nu, na mmom kyɛ yɛfa y’Awurade Yesu Kristo so yɛnya daa ngoa.

english_verse: Christ died for us, so we could live with him, whether we are alive or dead when he comes.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ owu mane yɛ ɔ, amaa sɛ yɛte ase oo, yɛwu oo, yɛne ye yaatena.

english_verse: This is why you must encourage and help each other, just as you are already doing. Final Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔtutu ɛmɔ nwo foɛ, ná ɛ́mɔbokaboka ɛmɔ nwo, kyɛbɔ ɛmɔyɔ ne ala. Foɛtulɛ ne ngraalilɛ

english_verse: My friends, we ask you to be thoughtful of your leaders who work hard and tell you how to live for the Lord.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛsrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛ́mɔfa anidie bɛ́ma bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ adwuma wɔ ɛmɔ nu, ná bedi ɛmɔ so panyi wɔ Awurade nu, ná betu ɛmɔ foɛ ne;

english_verse: Show them great respect and love because of their work. Try to get along with each other.
translation_verse: na ɔnate b’adwuma ti ɛ́mɔfa anidie paa ne ɔdɔ bɛ́ma bɛ. Ɛ́mɔtena asomdwee nu.

english_verse: My friends, we beg you to warn anyone who isn't living right. Encourage anyone who feels left out, help all who are weak, and be patient with everyone.
translation_verse: Afei koso aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛsrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ, ɛ́mɔbɔ bɛ bɔ bɛnate basabasa nemɔ kɔkɔ, ɛ́mɔkyekye bɛ bɔ b’abasa nu abu nemɔ wora, ɛ́mɔboka bɛ bɔ bayɛ mmerɛ ne, ná ɛ́mɔnya sona biala nwo aboterɛ.

english_verse: Don't be hateful to people, just because they are hateful to you. Rather, be good to each other and to everyone else.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea yé ná ebiala amva bɔne andua bɔne kerɛ, na mmom ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ daa biala ɛmɔkɔyɔ paa bɛkɔmoma ɛmɔ nwo ne mmenia amukoraa.

english_verse: Always be joyful
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔli ahurusi daa;

english_verse: and never stop praying.
translation_verse: nnɛma ɛmɔyakyi mbaeɛbɔlɛ le!

english_verse: Whatever happens, keep thanking God because of Jesus Christ. This is what God wants you to do.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa asennaa bɛ́ma Nyameɛ wɔ nikyee biala nu, ofikyɛ ɛhe yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ wɔ Kristo Yesu nu ma ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't turn away God's Spirit
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔnua Sunzum Krongron see ne;

english_verse: or ignore prophecies.
translation_verse: nnɛma ɛmɔbu ngɔmhyɛlɛ animtia,

english_verse: Put everything to the test. Accept what is good
translation_verse: na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔso nningyein amukoraa bɛnea: na bɔ ɔte paa ne, ɛ́mɔsɔ nu yé,

english_verse: and don't have anything to do with evil.
translation_verse: ná ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi bɔne sue mukoraa nwo.

english_verse: I pray that God, who gives peace, will make you completely holy. And may your spirit, soul, and body be kept healthy and faultless until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: Na asomdwee Nyameɛ ne, yɛsrɛ kyɛ ye bɔbɔ ɔte ɛmɔ nwo bɔkɔɔ, ná ɔnea ɛmɔ sunzum ne ɛmɔ kra ne ɛmɔ nipadua so, bɔ ngekalewa biala ngɔwa ye nwo kɔpem kyɛ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo kɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: The one who chose you can be trusted, and he will do this.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔfrɛ ɛmɔ ne odi nahorɛ, na ɔkɔyɔ koso amba.

english_verse: Friends, please pray for us.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ bɛma yɛ.

english_verse: Give the Lord's followers a warm greeting.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔyɛ aliɛmaa nemɔ amukoraa awaawaatuu krongron nu.

english_verse: In the name of the Lord I beg you to read this letter to all his followers.
translation_verse: Méfa ahyɛdeɛ mema ɛmɔ wɔ Awurade nu kyɛ, ɛ́mɔkenga krataa he behyire agyidifoɛ nemɔ amukoraati.

english_verse: I pray that our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Y’Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne ɛmɔ bɛtena. Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, Silas, and Timothy. To the church in Thessalonica, the people of God our Father and of the Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Krataa he fi Pɔɔlo, Silwano ne Timoteo berɛ, na yɛfa yɛbrɛ Tɛsalonika asɔre ne bɔ ɔte yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo deɛ ne.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! When Christ Returns
translation_verse: Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. Ndɛenbualɛ wɔ Kristo walɛ ne anu

english_verse: My dear friends, we always have good reason to thank God for you, because your faith in God and your love for each other keep growing all the time.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ ti daa yɛda Nyameɛ ase kyɛbɔ ɔfata ɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔ gyidie kɔ so nyi mmorosoɛ, na ɔdɔ bɔ ɛmɔle ma bɛ nwo bɛ nwo ne ɔte piri.

english_verse: This is why we brag about you to all of God's churches. We tell them how patient you are and how you keep on having faith, even though you are going through a lot of trouble and suffering.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ animia ne gyidie wɔ ɛmɔ nye bɔ bɛtane ne anu, ɔne amaneɛ mukoraa bɔ ɛmɔmia bɛ nye benwu ye ne ati, yɛfa ɛmɔ yɛhoahoa yɛ nwo wɔ Nyameɛ asɔre nemɔ nu.

english_verse: All this shows that God judges fairly and is making you fit to share in his kingdom for which you are suffering.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe kyire kyɛ Nyameɛ ndɛenbualɛ te turoloo, bɔ ɔkɔma ɛmɔ kɔfata Nyameɛ ahennie bɔ yiti yeɛ ɛmɔnwu amaneɛ ne.

english_verse: It is only right for God to punish everyone who is causing you trouble,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔtengyɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu kyɛ okotua bɛ bɔ bɛma ɛmɔnwu amaneɛ ne so kerɛ ɔ,

english_verse: but he will give you relief from your troubles. God will do the same for us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with his powerful angels
translation_verse: ná ɔkɔma ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔwɔ amaneɛ nu ne, ɛmɔ ne yɛ yɛkonya nwomelelɛ, kyẽa bɔ bɛkɔla Awurade Yesu ne ye abɔfoɛ anwoserɛfoɛ ali bekofi nyameɛso, wɔ see wuronyiwuronyi nu ne,

english_verse: and with a flaming fire. Our Lord Jesus will punish anyone who doesn't know God and won't obey his message.
translation_verse: na ɔkɔtɔ bɛ bɔ bɛnze Nyameɛ, ɔne bɛ bɔ bayɛ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo nzɛmba ne nwo asoserɛ nemɔ so wereɛ.

english_verse: Their punishment will be eternal destruction, and they will be kept far from the presence of our Lord and his glorious strength.
translation_verse: Ɔkɔtɔ sɔ mmenia nemɔ so wereɛ kɔsɛkye bɛ pasapasa afebɔɔ, ná afei wahwe bɛ wafi Awurade nyunu ne ye animnyam tumi nwo.

english_verse: This will happen on the day when the Lord returns to be praised and honored by all who have faith in him and belong to him. This includes you, because you believed what we said.
translation_verse: Sɔ kyẽa ne, ɔkɔwa ma ye anwoteefoɛ kɔhyɛ ye animnyam, na agyidifoɛ mukoraa anwu ye anwanwa adwuma; ofikyɛ ɛmɔale yɛ adanzeɛ bɔ yɛli yɛhyirele ɛmɔ ne bali.

english_verse: God chose you, and we keep praying that God will make you worthy of being his people. We pray for God's power to help you do all the good things you hope to do and your faith makes you want to do.
translation_verse: Yiti daa yɛbɔ mbaeɛ yɛma ɛmɔ, kyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ obu ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔfata ye frɛlɛ ne, ná ɔfa ye tumi so ma ɛmɔhora bɛyɔ paa biala bɔ ɛmɔpena kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɔ, ná ɔma ɛmɔ gyidie adwuma li mu;

english_verse: Then, because of the undeserved grace of God and our Lord Jesus Christ, you will bring honor to the name of our Lord Jesus, and he will bring honor to you.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so bahyɛ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo dumaa animnyam wɔ ɛmɔ nu, na ɛmɔ koso bahyɛ ɛmɔ animnyam wɔ ye nu, kyɛbɔ yɛ Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne te ɔ.

english_verse: When our Lord Jesus returns, we will be gathered up to meet him. So I ask you, my friends,
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, bɔ ɔfa y’Awurade Yesu Kristo walɛ ne ne nwo, ɔne yɛ noa boalɛ bɔ yɛkwaafa yɛyia ye ne nwo de, yɛsrɛ kyɛ nnɛmɔma ɔyɛ ɛmɔ ti anu kesenee,

english_verse: not to be easily upset or disturbed by people who claim the Lord has already come. They may say they heard this directly from the Holy Spirit, or from someone else, or even that they read it in one of our letters.
translation_verse: Nyekyire, anaa edwirɛ anaa krataa bɔ ebiemɔ nwa ofi yɛ berɛ ne, bɔ okyire kyɛ Awurade kyẽa ne wawa nen, nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ ti anu yɛ ɛmɔ kesenee ndɛndɛ wɔ ye nwo, anaa nnɛmɔma ɔha ɛmɔ.

english_verse: But don't be fooled! People will rebel against God. Then before the Lord returns, the wicked one who is doomed to be destroyed will appear.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma ebiala lakalaka ɛmɔ wɔ atee biala so; ofikyɛ sɔ kyẽa ne ngɔwa, sana ɛlɔenyɛlɛ ne ba koraka; na afei bala amumuyɛɛniɛ ne ali koraka, baa bɔ wamini ne.

english_verse: He will brag and oppose everything holy or sacred. He will even sit in God's temple and claim to be God.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ odwɔso tia, na osa ma ye nwo so tra nikyee biala bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Nyameɛ ná bɛsɔne ye ɔ; na ɔkɔtena Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua nu kɔfrɛ ye nwo kyɛ ye ole Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Don't you remember I told you this while I was still with you?
translation_verse: Aso ɛmɔngaye kyɛ ngane ɛhemɔ ngyirele ɛmɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ né nwɔ ɛmɔ berɛ nen?

english_verse: You already know what is holding this wicked one back until it is time for him to come.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔse nikye horɛ bɔ kekesaala ye osi ye ate ɔ, amaa bala ye ali wɔ ye mmerɛ nu.

english_verse: His mysterious power is already at work, but someone is holding him back. And the wicked one won't appear until this someone is out of the way.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mvealeɛ nu amumuyɛɛ wahyɛ ye adwuma bo dada, na bɔ osi ye ate kekesaala ye ne, ɔkɔhɔ so kosi ye ate, kɔpem kyɛ bɛkɔye bɔ osi ye ate ne bekofi berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Then he will appear, but the Lord Jesus will kill him simply by breathing on him. He will be completely destroyed by the Lord's glorious return.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe asi ye yeɛ bɛkɔma amumuyɛɛniɛ ne nwo kɔla ali ɔ. Na Awurade Yesu kɔfa ye noa nu nwomeɛ kohũ ye, ná afei wafa ye animnyam walɛ ne wasɛkye ye bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: When the wicked one appears, Satan will pretend to work all kinds of miracles, wonders, and signs.
translation_verse: Amumuyɛɛniɛ ne kɔfa abɔnzam dwumadie so yeɛ ɔkɔwa ɔ, na okonya tumi kɔyɔ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne nnakannaka anwanwadeɛ mukoraa.

english_verse: Lost people will be fooled by his evil deeds. They could be saved, but they will refuse to love the truth and accept it.
translation_verse: Na ɔkɔfa nnakannaka ne amumuyɛɛ atee mukoraa so konya bɛ bɔ begu so bemini ne, ofikyɛ bɛyɛle asoserɛ wɔ nahorɛ bɔ ɔma daa ngoa ne nwo.

english_verse: So God will make sure they are fooled into believing a lie.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati Nyameɛ kɔsoma nnakannaka tumi maa okoli dwumaa wɔ bɛ nu, na bale ngondombo bali.

english_verse: All of them will be punished, because they would rather do evil than believe the truth. Be Faithful
translation_verse: Yiti bekobua bɛ bɔ banne nahorɛ ne banni, na mmom bɛ nye gye bɔ ɔndengyɛ nwo ne amukoraa ndɛen. Baye ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔnya ngoa

english_verse: My friends, the Lord loves you, and it is only natural for us to thank God for you. God chose you to be the first ones to be saved. His Spirit made you holy, and you put your faith in the truth.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ Awurade kuro ɛmɔ dwirɛ ɔ, ɔte yɛ asɛdeɛ kyɛ ɔnate ɛmɔ ti daa yɛda Nyameɛ ase ɔ. Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ fi ahyɛaseɛ ne yeɛ waneanea nu waye ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛ́mɔnya daa ngoa, bɔ ɔnate Sunzum nu anwotelɛ ne nahorɛ gyidie nu ɔ.

english_verse: God used our preaching as his way of inviting you to share in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Ɔnate yɛ nzɛmba ne aso yeɛ wafrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔɔnya kyɛfa wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo animnyam nu ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, this is why you must remain faithful and follow closely what we taught you in person and by our letters.
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔgyina pindinn, na ɛmɔsɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ yɛnate yɛ noa dwirɛ anaa krataa so yafa yahyire ɛmɔ ne anu yé.

english_verse: God our Father loves us. He treats us with undeserved grace and has given us eternal comfort and a wonderful hope. We pray that our Lord Jesus Christ and God our Father
translation_verse: Na afei, Y’Awurade Yesu Kristo bɔbɔ ne yɛ Baba Nyameɛ, bɔ okuro yɛ dwirɛ, ná walo yɛ wama yɛ daa asomdwee ne anyelasoɛ paa ne,

english_verse: will encourage you and help you always to do and say the right thing.
translation_verse: ɔ́kyekye ɛmɔ wora, ná ɔma ɛmɔ anwoserɛ wɔ edwirɛ ne adwuma paa mukoraa nu.

english_verse: Finally, our friends, please pray for us. This will help the message about the Lord to spread quickly, and others will respect it, just as you do.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ bɛ́ma yɛ, kyɛ Awurade nzɛmba ne onya atee trɛ ndɛndɛ ná onya animnyam, kyɛbɔ wanya ye wɔ ɛmɔ berɛ ne.

english_verse: Pray that we may be kept safe from worthless and evil people. After all, not everyone has faith.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔsrɛ bɛ́ma yɛ kyɛ Nyameɛ ole yɛ fi amumuyɛɛfoɛ ne bɔnefoɛ sa nu, ofikyɛ nna mmenia mukoraa yeɛ bele gyidie ɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord can be trusted to make you strong and protect you from harm.
translation_verse: Nakoso Awurade di nahorɛ; ɔkɔma ɛmɔ kogyina pindinn, ná wabɔ ɛmɔ nwo waen wafi bɔnefoɛ ne sa nu.

english_verse: He has made us sure that you are obeying what we taught you and that you will keep on obeying.
translation_verse: Na y’adwene si pi wɔ ɛmɔ nwo wɔ Awurade nu, kyɛ edwirɛ bɔ yɛfale ye nwo ahyɛdeɛ yɛmane ɛmɔ ne, ɛmɔdi so, na ɛmɔkɔhɔ so bekoli so.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will guide you to be as loving as God and as patient as Christ. Warnings against Laziness
translation_verse: Yɛsrɛ Awurade kyɛ obukye ɛmɔ adwene nu ma ɛmɔte Nyameɛ ɔdɔ ne Kristo aboterɛ ne bo. Ɔsɛ kyɛ ebiala yɔ adwuma

english_verse: My dear friends, in the name of the Lord Jesus, I beg you not to have anything to do with any of your people who loaf around and refuse to obey the instructions we gave you.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, yɛle y’Awurade Yesu Kristo dumaa yɛhyɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ, aliɛmaa biala bɔ ɔnatenate basabasa ná onni ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ onya fili yɛ berɛ ne aso ne, ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi ye nwo.

english_verse: You surely know that you should follow our example. We didn't waste our time loafing,
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ bɔbɔ ɛmɔse kyɛ ohia kyɛ ɛmɔsuasua yɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ né yɛwɔ ɛmɔ berɛ ne, yanyɛ foen;

english_verse: and we didn't accept food from anyone without paying for it. We didn't want to be a burden to any of you, so night and day we worked as hard as we could.
translation_verse: yeɛ yanni ebiala aleɛ bɔ yandua ye kerɛ ɔ. Na mmom yɛyerele yɛ nwo yɛyɔle adwuma eyia ne kɔngɔen, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ yɛngɔyɛ ɛmɔ nu biala so tɔsom ɔ.

english_verse: We had the right not to work, but we wanted to set an example for you.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ngyire kyɛ yɛlle ye nwo ate kyɛ yɛkobisa ɛmɔ dɔ nikyee biala ɔ, na mmom yɛfale yɛ nwo yɛyɛle mvandoho kyɛ ɛmɔsua yɛ.

english_verse: We also gave you this rule: If you don't work, you don't eat.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né yɛwɔ ɛmɔ berɛ nen, yɛmane ɛmɔ ahyɛdeɛ kyɛ, sona biala bɔ onguro kyɛ ɔyɔ adwuma ne, onni kyɛ odidi ɔ.

english_verse: Now we learn that some of you just loaf around and won't do any work, except the work of a busybody.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ yatete ye kyɛ mmenia biemɔ wɔ ɛmɔ nu bɔ bɛnatenate basabasa, bɔ bɛnyɔ adwuma biala, na mmom bɛfa bɛ noa bɛtoto mmenia dwirɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: So, for the sake of our Lord Jesus Christ, we ask and beg these people to settle down and start working for a living.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia nemɔ, yɛ́hyɛ bɛ wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo dumaa nu, ná yɛtu bɛ foɛ kyɛ, odi kyɛ bɛyɔ b’adwuma konn bɛfa bɛpena bɛ noa aleɛ.

english_verse: Dear friends, you must never become tired of doing right.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, nnɛmɔma paayɛlɛ yɛ ɛmɔ yea.

english_verse: Be on your guard against any followers who refuse to obey what we have written in this letter. Put them to shame by not having anything to do with them.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ebie ngotie bɔ yahã ye wɔ krataa ye anu a, ɛmɔhyɛ sɔ sona ne nzorɛ, na nnɛma ɛmɔ ne ye bɛbɔ afɛ, ná ɛ́mɔma ɔfɛre.
