english_verse: Don't consider them your enemies. Instead, speak kindly to them as you would to any other follower. Final Prayer
translation_verse: Nakoso nnɛma ɛmɔbu ye kyɛ ɔte ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ, na mmom ɛ́mɔbɔ ye kɔkɔ kyɛ aliɛmaa. Ngraalilɛ

english_verse: I pray that the Lord, who gives peace, will always bless you with peace. May the Lord be with all of you.
translation_verse: Yɛsrɛ kyɛ asomdwee Awurade ne bɔbɔ ɔma ɛmɔ asomdwee daa wɔ atee biala so. Awurade ne ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛtena.

english_verse: From Paul. God our Savior and Christ Jesus commanded me to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, who gives us hope.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo, Kristo Yesu somafoɛ, kyɛbɔ yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ ne Kristo Yesu bɔ ɔte yɛ anyelasoɛ ne hyɛle ne,

english_verse: Timothy, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind and merciful to you. May they bless you with peace! Warning against False Teaching
translation_verse: mefa mebrɛ Timoteo, bɔ ɔte me bɔbɔ mma wɔ gyidie nu ne. Adom, anwumvoinnwunɛ ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne yɛ Awurade Kristo Yesu berɛ ɔyɛ wɔ deɛ. Ngyerɛkyerɛ tɛɛ nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: When I was leaving for Macedonia, I asked you to stay on in Ephesus and warn certain people there to stop spreading their false teachings.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né mekɔ Makedonia nen, nzrɛle wɔ kyɛ ɛtena Ɛfeso, ná etu mmenia biemɔ foɛ kyɛ nnɛmaa bekyirekyire ngyerɛkyerɛ foforɛ,

english_verse: You needed to warn them to stop wasting their time on senseless stories and endless lists of ancestors. Such things only cause arguments. They don't help anyone to do God's work that can only be done by faith.
translation_verse: yeɛ nnɛmaa bɛha bɛ nwo wɔ ɛhoaa ne afilie nu aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ nwo dwirɛ bɔ ye bo mbɛ ɔ, bɔ ɔfa aporowaasulɛ ba tra nyamesom paa ne bɔ ɔwɔ gyidie nu ne.

english_verse: You must teach people to have genuine love, as well as a good conscience and true faith.
translation_verse: Na kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne, ye botaeɛ ole ɔdɔ bɔ ofi ahone bɔ nu te ɔ nu, tiboa paa ne gyidie kaenn nu.

english_verse: There are some who have given up these for nothing but empty talk.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe yeɛ mmenia biemɔ bali makyebu bafi ye nwo baali aporowaasulɛ mbaen mbaen si,

english_verse: They want to be teachers of the Law of Moses. But they don't know what they are talking about, even though they think they do.
translation_verse: bɔ bekuro kyɛ bɛyɛ mmeraa akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ, nakoso edwirɛ bɔ bɛkã ne, ɔne nningyein bɔ besi bɛ hue bɛkã bɛ nwo dwirɛ ne, bɛnde bɛ bo ɔ.

english_verse: We know the Law is good, if it is used in the right way.
translation_verse: Na yɛse kyɛ mmeraa ne te paa, sɛ ebie di so kyɛbɔ ɔfata hɔ a.

english_verse: We also understand it wasn't given to control people who please God, but to control lawbreakers, criminals, godless people, and sinners. It is for wicked and evil people, and for murderers, who would even kill their own parents.
translation_verse: Yeɛ yɛse kyɛ mmeraa ne ɔnne berɛ mma teneneeniɛ, na mmom ɔwɔ berɛ ma mmeraatolɛfoɛ, asoserɛfoɛ, bɛ bɔ benzuro Nyameɛ, bɔnefoɛ, bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo nde, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo agua fiɛ ɔ, bɛ bɔ beku bɛ se ne bɛ ni, awudifoɛ,

english_verse: The Law was written for people who are sexual perverts or who live as homosexuals or are kidnappers or liars or won't tell the truth in court. It is for anything else that opposes the correct teaching
translation_verse: adwamanbɔlɛfoɛ, mmienzua bɔ bɛne mmienzua bɛda ɔ, bɛ bɔ bɛtɔne mmenia, ngondombofoɛ, ndaentolɛfoɛ, yeɛ nikyee biala bɔ ɔboka so bɔ otia ngyerɛkyerɛ paa ɔ;

english_verse: of the good news the glorious and wonderful God has given me. Being Thankful for God's Kindness
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ saleɛ Nyameɛ animnyam nzɛmba bɔ bafa bawura me sa ne ɔte ne. Nyameɛ se anwumvoin

english_verse: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who has given me the strength for my work because he knew he could trust me.
translation_verse: Meda y’Awurade Kristo Yesu bɔ wama me anwoserɛ ne ase; ofikyɛ wabu me nahorɛniɛ wafa me wawura ɛsolɛ adwuma ne anu.

english_verse: I used to say terrible and insulting things about him, and I was cruel. But Christ had mercy on me because I didn't know what I was doing, and I had not yet put my faith in him.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ daa ne de, ngekane musue dwirɛ ndiale ye, ndanene ye nye, nyɛle ye so patapaa; nakoso onwuni me anwumvoin, ofikyɛ né menze bɔ meyɔ ɔ, na nyɔle ye wɔ elelɛ bɔ né menne menni ne anu.

english_verse: Christ Jesus our Lord treated me with undeserved grace and has greatly blessed my life with faith and love just like his own.
translation_verse: Na y’Awurade adom ne wale me so mmorosoɛ, wɔ gyidie ne ɔdɔ bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu ɔ.

english_verse: “Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners.” This saying is true, and it can be trusted. I was the worst sinner of all!
translation_verse: Ɛhe te nahorɛ dwirɛ bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ bede bɛto nu bɔkɔɔ ɔ, kyɛ Kristo Yesu wale wiase oolele bɔnefoɛ bɔ nde bɛ hene ne ngoa.

english_verse: But since I was worse than anyone else, God had mercy on me and let me be an example of the endless patience of Christ Jesus. He did this so that others would put their faith in Christ and have eternal life.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛhe ati yeɛ onwuni me anwunvoin ɔ, kyɛ me bɔ nni moa ne anu, Yesu Kristo kɔla ye aboterɛ amukoraa ali maa ɔkɔyɛ nhwɛsoɛ kɔma bɛ bɔ bekole ye bekoli bɛkɔhɔ daa ngoa nu ne.

english_verse: I pray that honor and glory will always be given to the only God, who lives forever and is the invisible and eternal King! Amen.
translation_verse: Afei, anidie ne animnyam hã daa daa Hene ne, bɔ ɔte ase daa, bɔ anyeɛ nnwu ye, Nyameɛ komapɛ twe ne, afebɔɔ! Amen.

english_verse: Timothy, my son, the instructions I am giving you are based on what some prophets once said about you. If you follow these instructions, you will fight like a good soldier.
translation_verse: Mma Timoteo, ahyɛdeɛ he yeɛ mefa mewura wɔ sa ɔ, kyɛbɔ ngɔm dwirɛ bɔ mmerɛ bie bɛhã bɛfale wɔ nwo ne ɔte ne, kyɛ ɔ́hyɛ wɔ nguraen, ná fa ko koɛ paa ne,

english_verse: You will be faithful and have a clear conscience. Some people have made a mess of their faith because they didn't listen to their consciences.
translation_verse: ná nya gyidie ne tiboa paa bɔ ebiemɔ de bagyi bato nekaa bie, ná bafi ase wɔ gyidie nu ne.

english_verse: Two of them are Hymenaeus and Alexander. I have given these men over to the power of Satan, so they will learn not to oppose God.
translation_verse: Bɛ nu biemɔ ole Himeneo ne Aleksandro bɔ maye bɛ mama Satan, kyɛ besua kyɛbɔ bɛngɔkekã musue dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: First of all, I ask you to pray for everyone. Ask God to help and bless them all, and tell God how thankful you are for each of them.
translation_verse: Afei, bɔ oli moa wɔ ye mukoraati nu ɔ, metu foɛ kyɛ, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdi ngotosrɛ, mbaeɛbɔlɛ, odima ne asennaa nwo dwumaa bɛma mmenia amukoraa,

english_verse: Pray for kings and others in power, so we may live quiet and peaceful lives as we worship and honor God.
translation_verse: ahemvo ne bɛ bɔ tumi wura bɛ sa amukoraati, amaa ɔnate so yatena ase konn, ná yɛ so anu atɔ yɛ, nyamesom paa ne anidie brabɔlɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: This kind of prayer is good, and it pleases God our Savior.
translation_verse: Na sɔ te paa, na ɔsɔ yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ nye,

english_verse: God wants everyone to be saved and to know the whole truth, which is,
translation_verse: ye bɔ okuro kyɛ mmenia amukoraa benya daa ngoa ná bɛba nahorɛ nimdeɛ ne anu ne.

english_verse: There is only one God, and Christ Jesus is the only one who can bring us to God. Jesus was truly human, and he gave himself to rescue all of us.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ te komapɛ twe, na Nyameɛ ne adasa mmaa b’afia ndamgyinaniɛ te komapɛ, bɔ ye ole Kristo Yesu;

english_verse: This is why God chose me to be a preacher and an apostle of the good news. I am telling the truth. I am not lying. God sent me to teach the Gentiles about faith and truth.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ati yeɛ batu me basie berɛ bayɛ me nzɛmbahanɛniɛ ne somafoɛ ɔ, , nde Amaenmaensofoɛ nu kyerɛkyerɛniɛ wɔ gyidie ne nahorɛ nu. Asɔre nu nhyehyɛleɛ

english_verse: I want everyone everywhere to lift innocent hands toward heaven and pray, without being angry or arguing with each other.
translation_verse: Yiti mekuro kyɛ mmienzua bɛbɔ mbaeɛ wɔ nekaa biala, bɛma asaa bɔ ye nwo te ɔ so, bɔ ɛyaafɛlɛ anaa aporowaasulɛ nne nu ɔ.

english_verse: I would like for women to wear modest and sensible clothes. They should not have fancy hairdos, or wear expensive clothes, or put on jewelry made of gold or pearls.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala koso yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ mmrasua mɔ bɛfa anwobrɛaseɛ bewura ndaadeɛ bɔ ɔfata, bɔ ongua bɛ nyunu ase ɔ; bɔ nna tire bɔ babɔ ye mmɛsa, sikaa kɔkorɛ, afire paa anaa ndena nyɔboɛserɛ ahɔ ɔ;

english_verse: Women who claim to love God should do helpful things for others,
translation_verse: na mmom nnwumaa paa bɔ ɔfata mmrasua bɔ bɛda nyamesom ali ɔ.

english_verse: and they should learn by being quiet and paying attention.
translation_verse: Ma brasua ɔyɛ konn osua edwirɛ ne wɔ anwobrɛaseɛ mukoraati nu.

english_verse: They should be silent and not be allowed to teach or to tell men what to do.
translation_verse: Brasua de, memma ye ate kyɛ ɔyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ anaa oli bienzua so; na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ omua ye noa.

english_verse: After all, Adam was created before Eve,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ belili moa bɛbɔle Adam koraka yeɛ bɛbɔ Hawa ɔ.

english_verse: and the man Adam wasn't the one who was fooled. It was the woman Eve who was completely fooled and sinned.
translation_verse: Nna Adam yeɛ bɛlakalakale ye ɔ; na mmom brasua ne yeɛ bɛlakalakale ye maa ɔtone mmeraa ɔ.

english_verse: But women will be saved by having children, if they stay faithful, loving, holy, and modest.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɔtena gyidie ne ɔdɔ ne krongronyɛlɛ ne anwobrɛaseɛ nu a, bekole ye ngoa wɔ ye mmaaworɛ nu.

english_verse: It is true that anyone who desires to be a church official wants to be something worthwhile.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ nahorɛ ɛhe: Sɛ ebie kuro neafoɛ adwuma a, né wafa adwuma paa.

english_verse: That's why officials must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. They must be self-controlled, sensible, well-behaved, friendly to strangers, and able to teach.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ neafoɛ ne ɔyɛ sona bɔ ngekalewa biala nne ye bra nu ɔ, ɔye yɛ komapɛ, ye nye la berɛ, ye nye dwo ase, ye suban te paa, okuro ɛwɔfoɛsolɛ, ɔse ngyerɛkyerɛ yɛ,

english_verse: They must not be heavy drinkers or troublemakers. Instead, they must be kind and gentle and not love money.
translation_verse: ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ akɔnomnzaniɛ, ahupoo, na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ odwo; ɔnzɛ kyɛ okuro ngondii, anaa ɔma ye nye boro sikaa.

english_verse: Church officials must be in control of their own families, and they must see that their children are obedient and always respectful.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ sona bɔ ɔkora bu ye bɔbɔ ye awuro yé, ná ɔtete ye mma maa bebu ye wɔ atee biala so ɔ.

english_verse: If they don't know how to control their own families, how can they look after God's people?
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɛ ebie nze kyɛbɔ osi bu ye bɔbɔ ye awuro yé a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ né wahora wanea Nyameɛ asɔre so?

english_verse: They must not be new followers of the Lord. If they are, they might become proud and be doomed along with the devil.
translation_verse: Ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ sona bɔ ɔte gyidiniɛ foforɛ ɔ, ná wammoma ye nwo so ma wannya abɔnzam foɛbualɛ ne bie.

english_verse: Finally, they must be well-respected by people who are not followers. Then they won't be trapped and disgraced by the devil. Church Officers
translation_verse: Afei koso, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ ebie bɔ mmenia bɔ bɛnne yeɛ fekue ne anu ɔ bɛbɔ ye dumaa paa ɔ, ná ye nyunu angua ase ma wandɔ abɔnzam ngaen nu. Asɔre nu asomvoɛ

english_verse: Church officers should be serious. They must not be liars, heavy drinkers, or greedy for money.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ asɔre nu asomvoɛ mɔ bɛyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛ nyunu le animnyam ɔ, bɔ bɛkã nahorɛ, na mmom bɛtte akɔnomnzafoɛ ne adifuufoɛ ɔ;

english_verse: And they must have a clear conscience and hold firmly to what God has shown us about our faith.
translation_verse: ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛfa tiboa bɔ ommua bɛ foɛ ɔ bɛsɔ gyidie mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne anu.

english_verse: They must first prove themselves. Then if no one has anything against them, they can serve as officers.
translation_verse: Maa beli moa beso bɛ bɛnea koraka, na sɛ edwirɛ biala nne bɛ nwo a, né afei bamaa bayɛ asomvoɛ.

english_verse: Women must also be serious. They must not gossip or be heavy drinkers, and they must be faithful in everything they do.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛ ye mɔ koso bɛyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛ nyunu le animnyam ɔ, bɔ bɛmmɔ nzekure, na mmom bɛ nwo dwo, ná bedi nahorɛ wɔ nikyee biala nu ɔ.

english_verse: Church officers must be faithful in marriage. They must be in full control of their children and everyone else in their home.
translation_verse: Asɔre nu asomvoɛ mɔ, ɔsɛ kyɛ ebiala ɔye yɛ komapɛ, yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛkora bɛ mma ne bɛ bɔbɔ b’awuro so nea ɔ.

english_verse: Those who serve well as officers will earn a good reputation and will be highly respected for their faith in Christ Jesus. The Mystery of Our Religion
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ somvoɛ adwuma ne yé ne, benya dumaa paa ne nyinasoɛ pindinn wɔ gyidie bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne anu. Mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ piri ne

english_verse: I hope to visit you soon. But I am writing these instructions,
translation_verse: Me nye la so kyɛ ɔngɔhyɛ biala ngɔwa wɔ berɛ, nakoso mekyerɛ ɛhemɔ mebrɛ wɔ koraka,

english_verse: so if I am delayed, you will know how everyone who belongs to God's family ought to behave. After all, the church of the living God is the strong foundation of truth.
translation_verse: amaa sɛ ɔba kyɛ mekyɛ ná mmmale a, anwu kyɛbɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛbɔ wɔ bra wɔ Nyameɛ awuro, bɔ ɔte Nyameɛ teasefoɛ n’asɔre, nahorɛ nyinasoɛ ne fapem ne anu.

english_verse: Here is the great mystery of our religion: Christ came as a human. The Spirit proved that he pleased God, and he was seen by angels. Christ was preached to the nations. People in this world put their faith in him, and he was taken up to glory.
translation_verse: Aporowaa biala nne ye nwo kyɛ nyamesom nu mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne ɔte piri: Nyameɛ lale ye nwo ali anwoɔnaen nu, olili be wɔ Sunzum nu; abɔfo mɔ nwuni ye, bɛbɔle ye nwo dawure wɔ maen maen nu; belele ye belili wɔ wiase, na bɛfale ye bɛhɔle nyameɛso animnyam nu.

english_verse: God's Spirit clearly says that in the last days many people will turn from their faith. They will be fooled by evil spirits and by teachings that come from demons.
translation_verse: Sunzum ne kã ye pefee kyɛ mmerɛ bɔ oli nziɛ ne anu, ebiemɔ koli makyebu bekofi gyidie ne anwo bekooli ngondombo sunzum mɔ ne sunzummɔne mɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ si,

english_verse: They will also be fooled by the false claims of liars whose consciences have lost all feeling. These liars
translation_verse: bɔ ɔnate ngondombo nnakannakafoɛ bɔ bɛ tiboa awu so ɔ.

english_verse: will forbid people to marry or to eat certain foods. But God created these foods to be eaten with thankful hearts by his followers who know the truth.
translation_verse: Bɛ yeɛ bɛbera agyaa, ná bɛhyɛ kyɛ sona otua aleɛ bɔ Nyameɛ bɔle kyɛ bɛ bɔ bede bedi, ná banwu nahorɛ ne bɛfa asennaa beli ɔ.

english_verse: Everything God created is good. And if you give thanks, you may eat anything.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ abɔdeɛ biala te paa, na sɛ yɛfa asennaa yɛsɔ nu de a, ye de ɔnzɛ kyɛ yɛkyi nikyee fee ɔ;

english_verse: What God has said and your prayer will make it fit to eat. Paul's Advice to Timothy
translation_verse: ofikyɛ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne mbaeɛ yeɛ bɛfa bɛte ye nwo ɔ. Kristo Yesu somvoɛ paa

english_verse: If you teach these things to other followers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus. You will show you have grown up on the teachings about our faith and on the good instructions you have obeyed.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛfa sɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ hemɔ ekyire aliɛmaa nemɔ a, ɛkɔyɛ Kristo Yesu somvoɛ paa bɔ bafa gyidie nwo dwirɛ ne ngyerɛkyerɛ paa bɔ eli ye si ne batete ye ɔ.

english_verse: Don't have anything to do with worthless, senseless stories. Work hard to be truly religious.
translation_verse: Nakoso daa tete dwirɛ mbaen mbaen mɔ bɔ bɛmmoka ne de, twe wɔ nwo fi ye nwo, ná bɔ nyamesom paa nwo mmɔden;

english_verse: We have put our hope in the living God, who is the Savior of everyone, but especially of those who have faith. This is why we work and struggle so hard.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati yeɛ yɛyere yɛ nwo yɛyɔ adwuma serɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ yafa yɛ nye yato Nyameɛ teasefoɛ, bɔ ɔte mmenia amukoraa, nganga agyidifoɛ Ngoadefoɛ ne aso.

english_verse: Teach these things and tell everyone to do what you say.
translation_verse: Fa ɛhemɔ tu foɛ paa, ná fa kyirekyire.

english_verse: Don't let anyone make fun of you, just because you are young. Set an example for other followers by what you say and do, as well as by your love, faith, and purity.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ebiala bu wɔ animtia kyɛ ɛte aberandeɛ ɔ, na mmom ma agyidifoɛ bɛyɛ nhwɛsoɛ wɔ edwudwolɛ nu, brabɔlɛ nu, ɔdɔ nu, gyidie nu ne anwotelɛ nu.

english_verse: Until I arrive, be sure to keep on reading the Scriptures in worship, and don't stop preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Tu wɔ nwo sie berɛ ma Ahyerɛlɛ ne kengalɛ wɔ badwa nu, nzɛmbahanɛ ne ngyerɛkyerɛ kɔpem kyɛ ngɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: Use the gift you were given when the prophets spoke and the group of church leaders blessed you by placing their hands on you.
translation_verse: Adom akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔnate ngɔmhyɛlɛ so ɔne mbanyi mɔ sa bɔ bɛfa beguale wɔ so bɛfa bɛmane wɔ ne, nnɛbu wɔ nye gua so.

english_verse: Remember these things and think about them, so everyone can see how well you are doing.
translation_verse: Bɔ mmɔden wɔ sɔ nningyein hemɔ anwo, tu wɔ nwo sie berɛ ma bɛ bɔkɔɔ, amaa ɔnate so wɔ ngɔsoɛ ala ali ama ebiala anwu ye.

english_verse: Be careful about the way you live and about what you teach. Keep on doing this, and you will save not only yourself, but the people who hear you.
translation_verse: Nea wɔ nwo yé ɔne wɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ nwo yé, kɔ so tira nu; ofikyɛ sɛ ɛyɔ sɔ a, ekole wɔ nwo ne w’atiefoɛ ngoa.

english_verse: Don't correct an older man. Encourage him, as you would your own father. Treat younger men as you would your own brother,
translation_verse: Nnɛtwi panyi nyunu, na mmom tu ye foɛ kyɛ wɔ baba; yeɛ yɛ mmerandeɛ nemɔ kyɛ eliɛma mmienzua;

english_verse: and treat older women as you would your own mother. Show the same respect to younger women that you would to your sister.
translation_verse: yɛ mmrasua mbanyi nemɔ kyɛ wɔ maame mɔ; yeɛ yɛ ndaluwa nemɔ kyɛ eliɛma mmrasua wɔ anwotelɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: Take care of any widow who is really in need.
translation_verse: Boka mmrasua akunafoɛ bɔ belle bie ɔ.

english_verse: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they should learn to serve God by taking care of her, as she once took care of them. This is what God wants them to do.
translation_verse: Na sɛ brasua kunaniɛ bie ole mmaa anaa nnomaa a, maa beli moa besua kyɛ bɛkɔla nyamesom paa ali wɔ awuro, kyɛ bɛkɔnea b’awofoɛ ɔ; ofikyɛ sɔ yeɛ ɔte paa ná ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ.

english_verse: A widow who is really in need is one who doesn't have any relatives. She has faith in God, and she keeps praying to him night and day, asking for his help.
translation_verse: Brasua kunaniɛ bɔ olle bie, bɔ waha ye ngome ne, ɔfa ye nye to Nyameɛ so, na otu ye nwo sie berɛ ma ngotosrɛ ne mbaeɛ kɔngɔen ne eyia.

english_verse: A widow who thinks only about having a good time is already dead, even though she is still alive.
translation_verse: Nakoso brasua kunaniɛ bɔ wama ahohwibra ali ye ti ne de, ɔte teaseawuo.

english_verse: Tell all this to everyone, so they will do the right thing.
translation_verse: Fa ɛhemɔ tu foɛ paa, ná bannya bɛ nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ banga.

english_verse: People who don't take care of their relatives, and especially their own families, have given up their faith. They are worse than someone who doesn't have faith in the Lord.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie nnea ye abusuafoɛ, nganga ye awuroama a, né wapo gyidie ne, na wafõ watra sona bɔ onne nni ɔ.

english_verse: For a widow to be put on the list of widows, she must be at least
translation_verse: Nnɛfa brasua kunaniɛ biala boka so, sana wali afoɛ aburasia bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, bɔ ogyale biaa komapɛ ɔ;

english_verse: She must also be well-known for doing all sorts of good things, such as raising children, giving food to strangers, welcoming God's people into her home, helping people in need, and always making herself useful.
translation_verse: bɔ bedi ye ne ye nnwumaa paa nwo adanzeɛ: kyɛ watete mmaa, kyɛ waso ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ, kyɛ wanwunzi anwoteefoɛ gya bo, kyɛ waboka bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ anwokyere nu, ɔne kyɛ watu ye nwo wasie berɛ wama nnwumaa paa mukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: Don't put young widows on the list. They may later have a strong desire to get married. Then they will turn away from Christ
translation_verse: Na akunafoɛ mmrasua bɔ bennyini ne, nnɛfa bɛ boka so; ofikyɛ sɛ b’akɔnnɔ ne ɔbo anwofama bɔ banya ye bama Kristo ne aso a, né bekuro kyɛ begya biaa,

english_verse: and become guilty of breaking their promise to him.
translation_verse: na ɔnate sɔ ti bedi b’anohoba bɔ belili moa bɛbɔle ne nwo fɔ.

english_verse: Besides, they will become lazy and get into the habit of going from house to house. Next, they will start gossiping and become busybodies, talking about things that are none of their business.
translation_verse: Afei koso, besua akwadworɔ, na bekyinikyini awuro mɔ nu; nna kyɛ bɛyɛ foen ngome, na mmom bɛyɛ asɛmbɛ ne nzekure, na bɛkekã edwirɛ bɔ ɔmvata ɔ.

english_verse: I would prefer that young widows get married, have children, and look after their families. Then the enemy won't have any reason to say insulting things about us.
translation_verse: Yiti mekuro kyɛ akunafoɛ ndaluwa nemɔ begyigya mmiaa ná bɛwo, ná bɛnea b’awuro so yé, ná yamma pɔfoɛ ne ate ma wangekã yɛ nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ;

english_verse: If a woman who is a follower has any widows in her family, she should help them. This will keep the church from having that burden, and then the church can help widows who are really in need. Church Leaders
translation_verse: Sɛ brasua gyidiniɛ bie ole abusuafoɛ akunafoɛ mmrasua a, maa ɔnea bɛ; ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɔyɛ adesoa da asɔre ne aso, amaa ɔnate so asɔre ne ahora anea akunafoɛ mmrasua bɔ belle bie ne.

english_verse: Church leaders who do their job well deserve to be paid twice as much, especially if they work hard at preaching and teaching.
translation_verse: Mbanyi bɔ bɛte bɛ nye bɛnea asɔre ne aso ne, ɛ́mɔfa anidie mmɔhoɛ bɛ́ma bɛ, nganga, bɛ bɔ bɛbɔ mmɔden wɔ nzɛmbahanɛ ne ngyerɛkyerɛ nu ne;

english_verse: It is just as the Scriptures say, “Don't muzzle an ox when you are using it to grind grain.” You also know the saying, “Workers are worth their pay.”
translation_verse: ofikyɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne nwa, “Sɛ nandwie boro aburoo a, nnɛkyekye ye noa,” yeɛ “Adwumayɔlɛniɛ fata kyɛ ye sa kã ye akatuaa.”

english_verse: Don't listen to any charge against a church leader, unless at least two or three people bring the same charges.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie bɔ asɔre panyi bie kwaadu a, nnede to nu, sana ate afi adanzefoɛ nyɔ anaa nza noa.

english_verse: But if any of the leaders should keep on sinning, they must be corrected in front of the whole group, as a warning to everyone else.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bɔne ali bɛ ti ne, kã bɛ nyunu wɔ asɔre mma ne amukoraa nyunu, amaa ɔnate so bɛ ngaa ne basuro.

english_verse: In the presence of God and Christ Jesus and their chosen angels, I order you to follow my instructions! Be fair with everyone, and don't have any favorites.
translation_verse: Ngyi Nyameɛ ne Awurade Kristo Yesu ne abɔfo bɔ baneanea nu baye bɛ ne anyunu mehyɛ wɔ kyɛ, di nhyehyɛleɛ hemɔ so, bɔ ɛnnea sona nyunu anaa ɛnyɛ nyeyemuɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't be too quick to accept people into the service of the Lord by placing your hands on them. Don't sin because others do, but stay close to God.
translation_verse: Nnɛpe ndɛen fa wɔ sa gua ebie so, yeɛ nnɛfa wɔ nwo dide ebiemɔ bɔne nu: Ma wɔ bra yɛ sannwuu!

english_verse: Stop drinking only water. Take a little wine to help your stomach trouble and the other illnesses you often have.
translation_verse: Nnɛno nzue ngome ko, na ɔnate wɔ ko bɔ ɔha wɔ, ɔne fonɔnfonɔn bɔ ɛtaa yɛ ne ati, no bobe nzaa kãa.

english_verse: Some people get caught in their sins almost at once, even before the time of judgment. But other people's sins don't show up until later.
translation_verse: Mmenia biemɔ bɛ bɔne la dwaaso, na odi bɛ nyunu kɔ ndɛenbualɛ nu; nakoso ebiemɔ deɛ de, ɔda ali nziɛ ye.

english_verse: It is the same with good deeds. Some are easily seen, but none of them can be hidden.
translation_verse: Na sɔ ala yeɛ nnwumaa paa bɛda ali pefee ɔ, na sɛ banna ali po a, bɛngora bɛmvea.

english_verse: If you are a slave, you should respect and honor your owner. This will keep people from saying bad things about God and about our teaching.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ ngoaasolɛ nu amukoraa, maa bebu bɛ mene mɔ kyɛ anidie amukoraa fata bɛ, amaa ɔnate so Nyameɛ dumaa ne ngyerɛkyerɛ ne nwo angua fiɛ.

english_verse: If any of you slaves have owners who are followers, you should show them respect. After all, they are also followers of Christ, and he loves them. So you should serve and help them the best you can. False Teaching and True Wealth These are the things you must teach and tell the people to do.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛ mene mɔ te agyidifoɛ nen, nnɛmaa bɛfa ye kyɛ bɛte aliɛmaa ti bebu meneɛ nemɔ animtia; na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛyere bɛ nwo bɛso bɛ yé; ofikyɛ bɛ bɔ benya bɛ solɛ ne nwo mvasoɛ ne, bɛte agyidifoɛ ne adɔfo. Sɔ nningyein hemɔ yeɛ kyirekyire, ná tu ye nwo foɛ ɔ. Ngondombo ngyerɛkyerɛ

english_verse: Anyone who teaches something different disagrees with the correct and godly teaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie yɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ foforɛ, ná wambene y’Awurade Yesu Kristo nahorɛ dwirɛ ne ɔne ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ ɔkɔ nyamesom paa nu ne aso a,

english_verse: Those people who disagree are proud of themselves, but they don't really know a thing. Their minds are sick, and they like to argue over words. They cause jealousy, disagreements, unkind words, evil suspicions,
translation_verse: sɔ sona ne moma ye nwo so, na ɔnze huu, aporowaasulɛ ne aporowaasulɛ kyengyekyengye ali ye ti; na bɔ ofi nu ba ole anyeboroborolɛ, mbakyembakyemuɛ, nzekure, mmenia nwo adwenemmɔne,

english_verse: and nasty quarrels. They have wicked minds and have missed out on the truth. These people think religion is supposed to make you rich.
translation_verse: manzoenhwenɛ wɔ mmenia bɔ b’adwene awu ɔ nu, bɔ bɛne nahorɛ abɔ nzahoɛ, bɔ besusu kyɛ nyamesom paa ma sona nya ye nwo ɔ.

english_verse: And religion does make your life rich, by making you content with what you have.
translation_verse: Nakoso nyamesom paa bɔ ɔma wɔ kunu dwo wɔ ne, ɔte anwonya piri;

english_verse: We didn't bring anything into this world, and we won't take anything with us when we leave.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ yamva hwee yamma wiase, yeɛ yɛngɔhora ngɔfa hwee ngofi wiase ngɔhɔ.

english_verse: So we should be satisfied just to have food and clothes.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ yɛle bɔ yɛdi ɔne bɔ yɛfa yɛkata yɛ nwo a, ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛma yɛ nye sɔ.

english_verse: People who want to be rich fall into all sorts of temptations and traps. They are caught by foolish and harmful desires that drag them down and destroy them.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛpena kyɛ benya bɛ nwo ne, bɛtɔ nzɔhwɛ ne ngaen ne ngwaseaa akɔnnɔ bɔ ɔtte mayee mma sona, bɔ ɔfa bɛ kɔ ɛsɛkyelɛ ne eminilɛ nu ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: The love of money causes all kinds of trouble. Some people want money so much they have given up their faith and caused themselves a lot of pain. Fighting a Good Fight for the Faith
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔne amukoraa ndii ole sikanyeboro, bɔ ebiemɔ ali ye si bali makyebu bafi gyidie ne anwo, bɔ yiti bahwehwe aworabɔlɛ pee babrɛ bɛ nwo ɔ. Pɔɔlo tu Timoteo foɛ

english_verse: Timothy, you belong to God, so keep away from all these evil things. Try your best to please God and to be like him. Be faithful, loving, dependable, and gentle.
translation_verse: Na wɔ, Nyameɛ sona, wɔ de, twe wɔ nwo fi ɛhemɔ anwo, ná fa tenenee, nyamesom paa, gyidie, ɔdɔ, animia ne anwobrɛaseɛ sie wɔ nye so.

english_verse: Fight a good fight for the faith and claim eternal life. God offered it to you when you clearly told about your faith, while so many people listened.
translation_verse: Ko gyidie koɛ paa ne; sɔ daa ngoa bɔ bɛfrɛle wɔ bɛwale nu, bɔ ɛpakyele nu hane ye yé wɔ adanzefoɛ pee bɛ nyunu ne anu.

english_verse: Now I ask you to make a promise. Make it in the presence of God, who gives life to all, and in the presence of Christ Jesus, who openly told Pontius Pilate about his faith.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ bɔ ɔma nningyein amukoraa ngoa, ɔne Kristo Yesu bɔ ɔpakyele nu hane ye yé, ná olili adanzeɛ wɔ Pontio Pilato nyunu ne, metu wɔ foɛ wɔ bɛ nyunu,

english_verse: Promise to obey completely and fully all that you have been told until our Lord Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: kyɛ, di ahyɛdeɛ ne aso bɔ ngekalewa anaa edwirɛ biala ngɔwa ye nwo, kɔpem y’Awurade Yesu Kristo ye nwo aliyelɛ ne.

english_verse: The glorious God is the only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords. At the time that God has already decided, he will send Jesus Christ back again.
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔkɔma ɛhe kɔla ali wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu ole saleɛniɛ ne Tuminiɛ komapɛ twe ne, ahemvo mɔ nu Hene ne meneɛ mɔ nu Meneɛ ne,

english_verse: Only God lives forever! And he lives in light that no one can come near. No human has ever seen God or ever can see him. God will be honored, and his power will last forever. Amen.
translation_verse: bɔ ye ngome twe yeɛ onwu, ná ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ, bɔ ɔte kanea bɔ ebie ngora mbingye ye nu, bɔ ebiala nnwuni ye le, ná ebiala ngɔhora ngonwu ye ne. Ye yeɛ anidie ne daa tumi te ye deɛ ɔ! Amen. Pɔɔlo tu sikafoɛ foɛ

english_verse: Warn the rich people of this world not to be proud or to trust in wealth that is easily lost. Tell them to have faith in God, who is rich and blesses us with everything we need to enjoy life.
translation_verse: Dwudwo kyire sikafoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ wiase, kyɛ nnɛmaa bɛmoma bɛ nwo so, anaakyɛ nnɛmaa bɛfa bɛ nye bɛto anwonyadeɛ bɔ ɔpɛ nu kɔ ɔ so; na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛfa bɛ nye bɛto Nyameɛ bɔ ɔma yɛ nningyein amukoraa mmorosoɛ ma yɛ nye gye ne aso.

english_verse: Instruct them to do as many good deeds as they can and to help everyone. Remind the rich to be generous and share what they have.
translation_verse: Bɔ bɛ kɔkɔ kyɛ bɛ́yɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ, kyɛ bɛyɛ sikafoɛ wɔ nnwumaa paa nu, ná bɛye bɛ kunu bɛyɛ adɔeɛ,

english_verse: This will lay a solid foundation for the future, so they will know what true life is like.
translation_verse: ná bɛ́fa bɛ́to fapem paa besie berɛ bɛma bɛ nwo kyẽa bie; amaa ɔnate so bɛ sa ahã daa ngoa ne. Ayieleɛ

english_verse: Timothy, guard what God has placed in your care! Don't pay any attention to godless and stupid talk that sounds smart but really isn't.
translation_verse: O Timoteo, nea bɔ bafa bawura wɔ sa ne aso yé. Twe wɔ nwo fi edwudwolɛ fiɛ ne aporowaasulɛ mbaen mbaen bɔ bɛyɛ mvomsoɛ bebu ye kyɛ ɔte nimdeɛ ne nwo.

english_verse: Some people have even lost their faith by believing this talk. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Na ɛhe yeɛ ebiemɔ bale bato nu, ná bali makyebu bafi gyidie ne anwo ɔ. Adom ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus. God himself chose me to be an apostle, and he gave me the promised life that Jesus Christ makes possible.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo bɔ ɔnate Nyameɛ pɛ so nde Kristo Yesu somafoɛ, kyɛbɔ ngoa bɔhyɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu te ne,

english_verse: Timothy, you are like a dear child to me. I pray that God our Father and our Lord Christ Jesus will be kind and merciful to you and will bless you with peace! Do Not Be Ashamed of the Lord
translation_verse: mefa mebrɛ mma Timoteo bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo ɔ. Adom, anwumvoinnwunɛ ne asomdwee bɔ ofi Baba Nyameɛ ne y’Awurade Kristo Yesu berɛ ɔyɛ wɔ deɛ. Asennaa ne nguraenhyɛlɛ

english_verse: Night and day I mention you in my prayers. I am always grateful for you, as I pray to the God my ancestors and I have served with a clear conscience.
translation_verse: Mefa asennaa mema Nyameɛ bɔ mefa tiboa paa meso ye, kyɛbɔ me nana mɔ bɛsole ye ne, kyɛ daa biala mekaye wɔ wɔ me mbaeɛ nu eyia ne kɔngɔen.

english_verse: I remember how you cried, and I want to see you, because this would make me truly happy.
translation_verse: Na mekaye wɔ nye moen ne a, ɔma me wora dɔ wɔ kyɛ ngonwu wɔ paa ɔ, ná ahaa me nye agye.

english_verse: I also remember the genuine faith of your mother Eunice. Your grandmother Lois had the same sort of faith, and I am sure you have it as well.
translation_verse: Na ɔmaa mekaye wɔ nahorɛ gyidie ne, gyidie bɔ wɔ nana Loyese ne wɔ maame Yunise belili moa benyane ye ne, na mede medi kyɛ wɔ koso ele bie.

english_verse: So I ask you to make full use of the gift God gave you when I placed my hands on you. Use it well.
translation_verse: Yiti mékaye wɔ kyɛ, Nyameɛ akyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ wɔ nu, bɔ mvale me sa nguale wɔ so maa enyane ye ne, maa ɔyɛ hye wɔ wɔ nu;

english_verse: God's Spirit doesn't make cowards out of us. The Spirit gives us power, love, and self-control.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ Nyameɛ amma yɛ esurolɛ sunzum, na mmom tumi ne ɔdɔ ne anwohyɛsoɛ sunzum.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to speak for our Lord. And don't be ashamed of me, just because I am in jail for serving him. Use the power that comes from God and join with me in suffering for telling the good news.
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛma y’Awurade adanzeɛlilɛ ne ɔyɛ wɔ nya, anaa me bɔ nde ye kukununiɛ ne me nwo yɛ wɔ nya; na mmom nya kyɛfa wɔ nzɛmba ne nwo amaneɛnwunɛ nu, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ tumi ɔte ne.

english_verse: God saved us and chose us to be his holy people. We did nothing to deserve this, but God planned it because he is so kind. Even before time began God planned for Christ Jesus to show kindness to us.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ oolele yɛ ná ɔfale ɛfrɛlɛ krongron frɛle yɛ ɔ, nna kyɛ yɛ nnwumaa ti ɔ; na mmom kyɛbɔ ye bɔbɔ ye nhyehyɛleɛ ne adom bɔ wafa walo yɛ wɔ Kristo Yesu nu fi tetetete ne ɔte ne.

english_verse: Now Christ Jesus has come to offer us God's gift of undeserved grace. Christ our Savior defeated death and brought us the good news. It shines like a light and offers life that never ends.
translation_verse: Na afei de, ɔnate yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Yesu Kristo nwo aliyelɛ ne aso wala ye ali. Ye bɔ watu ewue bo, ná ɔnate nzɛmba ne aso wala ngoa ɔne tebea bɔ ewue nne nu ɔ ali wahyire ɔ.

english_verse: My work is to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher.
translation_verse: Na nzɛmba he ati yeɛ babɔ me dumaa bayɛ me nzɛmbahanɛniɛ ne somafoɛ ne kyerɛkyerɛniɛ ɔ.

english_verse: This is why I am suffering now. But I am not ashamed! I know the one I have faith in, and I am sure he can guard until the last day what he has trusted me with.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate ɛhe ati yeɛ menwu amaneɛ hemɔ ye, nakoso ɔnyɛ me nya; ofikyɛ mese bɔ male ye mali ne, na mede medi kyɛ ɔkora ɔbɔ bɔ mafa mawura ye sa ne nwo waen maa okoodwu Kyẽa ne.

english_verse: Now follow the example of the correct teaching I gave you, and let the faith and love of Christ Jesus be your model.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ paa mɔ bɔ ate afi me berɛ ne, sɔ ye nwo nhwɛsoɛ nu yé, gyidie ne ɔdɔ bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne anu.

english_verse: You have been trusted with a wonderful treasure. Guard it with the help of the Holy Spirit, who lives within us.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ ne bɔ bafa bawura wɔ sa ne, fa Sunzum Krongron bɔ ɔte yɛ nu ne aso nea so yé.

english_verse: You know that everyone in Asia has turned against me, especially Phygelus and Hermogenes.
translation_verse: Ɛse kyɛ bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ Asia amukoraa bayakyi me nu bahɔ; Figɛlo ne Hɛmogen koso bɛboka so.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will be kind to the family of Onesiphorus. He often cheered me up and wasn't ashamed of me when I was put in jail.
translation_verse: Mesrɛ Awurade kyɛ onwu Onesiforo awuro ama anwumvoin, ofikyɛ ɔkyekyele me wora mmerɛ pee, na me ngɔnzɔngɔnzɔ ne anyɛ ye nya.

english_verse: Then after he arrived in Rome, he searched everywhere until he found me.
translation_verse: Ɔwale Rome nen, ɔpenane me dee fɛle koraa yeɛ onwu me ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will ask God to show mercy to Onesiphorus on the day of judgment. You know how much he helped me in Ephesus.
translation_verse: Mesrɛ Awurade kyɛ ɔma Awurade nwu ye anwumvoin wɔ Kyẽa ne. Na wɔ bɔbɔ ɛse ɛsolɛ worawora bɔ ɔsole me wɔ Ɛfeso ɔ.

english_verse: Timothy, my child, you must let Christ Jesus make you strong by his gift of undeserved grace.
translation_verse: Yiti mma, ma wɔ nwo yɛ se wɔ adom bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne anu.

english_verse: You have often heard me teach. Now I want you to tell these same things to followers who can be trusted to tell others.
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɛte fili me berɛ wɔ adanzefoɛ pee bɛ nyunu ne, fa wura mmenia bɔ bedi nahorɛ bɔ bɛkɔhora bekohyirehyire ebiemɔ koso ɔ bɛ sa.

english_verse: As a good soldier of Christ Jesus you must endure your share of suffering.
translation_verse: Na wɔ koso, mia wɔ nye nwu amaneɛ kyɛ Kristo Yesu sraaniɛ paa.

english_verse: Soldiers on duty don't work at outside jobs. They try only to please their commanding officer.
translation_verse: Sraaniɛ bɔ ogyi koɛ noa nen, ɔmva daadaa asetena nu dwirɛ mɔ ngyekye ye nwo, ofikyɛ okuro kyɛ ɔsɔ bɔ ɔfale ye adwuma ne nye.

english_verse: No one wins an athletic contest without obeying the rules.
translation_verse: Na bɛmva ngonim abotire ne bɛmmɔ amirikatulɛniɛ, sana odi amirikatulɛ ne nwo mmeraa so.

english_verse: And farmers who work hard are the first to eat what grows in their field.
translation_verse: Kuaniɛ bɔ ɔyɔ adwuma ne, ye yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ odi moa di nu aleɛ ne bie ɔ.

english_verse: If you keep in mind what I have told you, the Lord will help you understand completely.
translation_verse: Dwene bɔ mekã ne anwo, ofikyɛ Awurade kɔma wɔ nikyee biala nu ndeaseɛ.

english_verse: Keep your mind on Jesus Christ! He was from the family of David and was raised from death, just as my good news says.
translation_verse: Kaye Yesu Kristo, Dawide bosoniɛ ne bɔ otingyele fili awufoɛ nu, kyɛbɔ me nzɛmba ne te ne,

english_verse: And because of this message, I am locked up in jail and treated like a criminal. But God's good news isn't locked in jail,
translation_verse: nzɛmba ne bɔ yiti yeɛ menwu amaneɛ ná babɔ me panwu kyɛ wudiniɛ ne; nakoso Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne de, bɛbbɔle ye panwu.

english_verse: and so I am willing to put up with anything. Then God's special people will be saved and given eternal glory because they belong to Christ Jesus.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔnate mmenia bɔ baneanea nu baye bɛ ne ati, memia me nye menwu amaneɛ mukoraa, amaa ɔnate so bɛ koso banya ngoalelɛ bɔ ɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne ɔne animnyam afebɔɔ ne.

english_verse: Here is a true message: “If we died with Christ, we will live with him.
translation_verse: Nahorɛ dwirɛ ɛhe: “Sɛ yɛne ye yawu a, yɛne ye yɛkɔtena ase koso;

english_verse: If we don't give up, we will rule with him. If we deny that we know him, he will deny that he knows us.
translation_verse: sɛ yɛmia yɛ nye yɛtindim a, yɛne ye koli hene koso; sɛ yɛpo ye a, ye koso ɔkɔpo yɛ;

english_verse: If we are not faithful, he will still be faithful. Christ cannot deny who he is.” An Approved Worker
translation_verse: sɛ yɛnni nahorɛ a, ye de, odi nahorɛ daa, ofikyɛ ɔngora mbɛ ngondombo.” Adwumayɔlɛniɛ bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ

english_verse: Don't let anyone forget these things. And with God as your witness, you must warn them not to argue about words. These arguments don't help anyone. In fact, they ruin everyone who listens to them.
translation_verse: Kaye bɛ wɔ nningyein hemɔ nwo, ná bɔ bɛ kɔkɔ wɔ Awurade nyunu, kyɛ nnɛmaa besu edwirɛ mɔ nwo aporowaa bɔ mvasoɛ biala nne so ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔsopa bɛ bɔ betie ne.

english_verse: Do your best to win God's approval as a worker who doesn't need to be ashamed and who teaches only the true message.
translation_verse: Bɔ mmɔden paa kyɛ ɛkɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye, kyɛ adwumayɔlɛniɛ bɔ ye adwuma nwo nyɛ ye nya ɔ, kyɛ sona bɔ okyirekyire nahorɛ dwirɛ ne pɛpɛɛpɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Keep away from worthless and useless talk. It only leads people farther away from God.
translation_verse: Twe wɔ nwo fi edwirɛ mbaen mbaen bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ nwo, ofikyɛ odiedie mmenia fa bɛ kɔ musue nu.

english_verse: That sort of talk is like a sore that won't heal. And Hymenaeus and Philetus have been talking this way
translation_verse: Bɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne, ɔtrɛ kyɛ anwonyerɛ tɛɛ bɔ odidi anwoɔnaen ɔ, na bɛ nu biemɔ ole Himeneo ne Fileto,

english_verse: by teaching that the dead have already been raised to life. This is far from the truth, and it is destroying the faith of some people.
translation_verse: bɔ bali nahorɛ ne nwo makyebu bekyirekyire kyɛ ewutingyelɛ apɛ nu ahɔ dadaada, ná bɛfa bɛsɛkye ebiemɔ gyidie ɔ.

english_verse: But the foundation God has laid is solid. On it is written, “The Lord knows who his people are. So everyone who worships the Lord must turn away from evil.”
translation_verse: Nakoso Nyameɛ fapem ne, ogyi berɛ pindinn, bɔ nzɔanoɛ he sɔ ye noa ɔ: “Awurade se bɛ bɔ bɛte ye deɛ”, yeɛ “Ma ebiala bɔ ɔbɔ Awurade dumaa ne ɔhwe ye nwo fi amumuyɛɛ nwo.”

english_verse: In a large house some dishes are made of gold or silver, while others are made of wood or clay. Some of these are special, and others are not.
translation_verse: Nna esikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ nningyein ngome yeɛ bɛwɔ awuro piri nu ɔ, na mmom mmakaa ne ɛfaa deɛ koso wɔ nu bie. Bɛfa anidie bɛma bɛ nu biemɔ, yeɛ ebiemɔ de bɛmva anidie bɛmma bɛ.

english_verse: This is also how it is with people. The ones who stop doing evil and make themselves pure will become special. Their lives will be holy and pleasing to their Master, and they will be able to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: Na sɛ sona te ye nwo fi bɔ bɛmva anidie bɛmma ye ne anwo a, ɔkɔyɛ nikyee bɔ bɛfa anidie bɛma ye ɔ, bɔ bate ye nwo, bɔ ye mene fa yɛ nikyee a ɔyɛ yé ɔ, ná wasiesie ye nwo wama adwuma paa biala.

english_verse: Run from temptations that capture young people. Always do the right thing. Be faithful, loving, and easy to get along with. Worship with people whose hearts are pure.
translation_verse: Yiti twe wɔ nwo fi mmerandeɛ nu akɔnnɔ nwo, ná fa wɔ nye sie tenenee, gyidie, ɔdɔ ne asomdwee so, ɛne bɛ bɔ befi ahone bɔ nu te ɔ nu bɛfrɛ Awurade bɛbɔ nu ne.

english_verse: Stay away from stupid and senseless arguments. These only lead to trouble,
translation_verse: Nakoso ngwaseaa aporowaasulɛ ne edwirɛ mbaen mbaen de, twe wɔ nwo fi ye nwo, ofikyɛ ɛse kyɛ bɛne ngondii yeɛ bɛnate ɔ.

english_verse: and God's servants must not be troublemakers. They must be kind to everyone, and they must be good teachers and very patient.
translation_verse: Ɔnzɛ kyɛ Awurade akoaa kuro ngondii, na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔbrɛ ye nwo ase ma ebiala, ɔkora yɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ, ná onya aboterɛ,

english_verse: Be humble when you correct people who oppose you. Maybe God will lead them to turn to him and learn the truth.
translation_verse: ná ɔfa anwobrɛaseɛ nu dwudwo kyire bɛ bɔ bɛne ye nyɛ adwene ɔ. Ofikyɛ ebiaa né Nyameɛ amaa basakyera b’adwene ná banwu nahorɛ ne,

english_verse: They have been trapped by the devil, and he makes them obey him, but God may help them escape.
translation_verse: ná banya bɛ ti badidi nu bafi abɔnzam bɔ wahye bɛ nnure kyɛ bɛyɔ ye apɛdeɛ ne, ye ngaen nu.

english_verse: You can be certain that in the last days there will be some very hard times.
translation_verse: Nakoso kaye kyɛ, ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne, mmerɛ bɔ nu yɛ se ɔ kɔwa.

english_verse: People will love only themselves and money. They will be proud, stuck-up, rude, and disobedient to their parents. They will also be ungrateful, godless,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmenia kɔyɛ pɛsɛmangomenya, sikanyeboro, anwohoahoa, anwomasoɛ, musue dwirɛ kekanɛfoɛ, bɛkɔyɛ awofoɛ so asoserɛ, boniayɛfoɛ, mmenia bɔ bɛmva krongronyɛlɛ bɛnyɛ huu,

english_verse: heartless, and hateful. Their words will be cruel, and they will have no self-control or pity. These people will hate everything good.
translation_verse: bengonya sona nwo dɔ, amvamvirifoɛ, ɛsoentolɛfoɛ, bɛ bɔ bɛnhyɛ b’akɔnnɔ so ɔ, bɛ bɔ bɛ ti anu te awosii, bɛ bɔ bɛpo nikye paa biala,

english_verse: They will be sneaky, reckless, and puffed up with pride. Instead of loving God, they will love pleasure.
translation_verse: bɛ bɔ bɛye bɛ mmango mɔ bɛma, asobrakyeɛfoɛ, bekoli bɛ ti piri, ná bahuro anigye batra Nyameɛ;

english_verse: Even though they will make a show of being religious, their religion won't be real. Don't have anything to do with such people.
translation_verse: bɛkɔyɛ bɛ nwo kyɛ basɔ nyamesom paa ne anu, nakoso bɛpo tumi bɔ ɔwɔ nu ne. Twe wɔ nwo fi sɔ mmenia nemɔ nwo. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ

english_verse: Some men fool whole families, just to get power over those women who are slaves of sin and are controlled by all sorts of desires.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia ne, bɛ nu biemɔ wurawura awuro mɔ nu, na bɛlakalaka mmrasua bɔ b’adwene te nganga, bɔ bɔne ayɛ bɛ so adesoa, ná akɔnnɔ ahoroɔ ahyɛ bɛ so ɔ benya bɛ;

english_verse: These women always want to learn something new, but they never can discover the truth.
translation_verse: mmrasua bɔ bekuro kyɛ daa besua nikye, nakoso bɛngɔhora bengonwu nahorɛ ne le ɔ.

english_verse: Just as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people are enemies of the truth. Their minds are sick, and their faith isn't real.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ Yane ne Yambrɛ bedwɔso betiale Mose nen, sɔ ala yeɛ sɔ mmenia nemɔ koso bɛko betia nahorɛ ne ɔ. Bɛte mmenia bɔ b’adwene ali naakye, ná babɔ ase wɔ gyidie nu ɔ.

english_verse: But they won't get very far with their foolishness. Soon everyone will know the truth about them, just as Jannes and Jambres were found out. Paul's Last Instructions to Timothy
translation_verse: Nakoso bɔ bɛyɔ ne ongoosi pasiliwa biala, ofikyɛ bɛ ngwaseasɛm ne kɔla ali wɔ mmenia amukoraa nyunu, kyɛbɔ mmenia nyɔ ne deɛ yɛle ne. Foɛtulɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ

english_verse: trouble and suffering in the cities of Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. Yet the Lord rescued me from all those terrible troubles.
translation_verse: ndaneanyeɛ bɔ wato me, m’amaneɛ bɔ ɔtole me wɔ Antiokia, Yikoniom ne Lisetra, ɔne ndaneanyeɛ ahoroɔ bɔ ɔtole me ne; nakoso Awurade lele me fili ye mukoraa nu.

english_verse: In fact, anyone who belongs to Christ Jesus and wants to live right will have trouble from others.
translation_verse: Amba, sona biala bɔ ɔpena kyɛ ɔbɔ bra bɔ ɔsɔ anyeɛ wɔ Kristo Yesu nu ne, bɛkɔtane ye nye.

english_verse: But evil people who pretend to be what they are not will become worse than ever, as they fool others and are fooled themselves.
translation_verse: Na amumuyɛɛfoɛ ne aminɛlilɛfoɛ bɛkɔhɔ so bɛkɔlɔ asukɔ wɔ bɔne nu; bɛkɔlakalaka mmenia, ná mmenia koso alakalaka bɛ.

english_verse: Keep on being faithful to what you were taught and to what you believed. After all, you know who taught you these things.
translation_verse: Nakoso wɔ de, bɔ asua ɔne bɔ ale ali ne, kɔ so sɔ nu yé, ofikyɛ sona bɔ esua fili ye berɛ ne, ɛse kyɛbɔ osi te ɔ,

english_verse: Since childhood, you have known the Holy Scriptures that are able to make you wise enough to have faith in Christ Jesus and be saved.
translation_verse: ɔne kyɛbɔ ofi wɔ ngwadaa nu yeɛ anwu Ahyerɛlɛ Krongron ne kyɛ ɔkora maa enwu nworɛ bɔ ɔnate Yesu Kristo nu gyidie so ɔfa wɔ kɔ ngoalelɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: Everything in the Scriptures is God's Word. All of it is useful for teaching and helping people and for correcting them and showing them how to live.
translation_verse: Ahyerɛlɛ ne amukoraa fi Nyameɛ nwomeɛ nu yeɛ ɔwale ɔ, na ɔte paa ma ngyerɛkyerɛ, ɔma sona nwu ye mvomsoɛ, bɛfa bɛtengyɛtengyɛ sona, na bɛfa bɛtete sona wɔ tenenee atee so,

english_verse: The Scriptures train God's servants to do all kinds of good deeds.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so Nyameɛ sona wayɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ bɔ bama ye ndeteyɛɛ bɔ odi mu ɔ bama nnwumaa paa amukoraa.

english_verse: When Christ Jesus comes as king, he will be the judge of everyone, whether they are living or dead. So with God and Christ as witnesses, I command you
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ ne Kristo Yesu bɔ ɔbaabua ateasefoɛ ne awufoɛ ndɛen ne, ɔne ye nwo aliyelɛ ne ye ahennie ne, mefa mehyɛ wɔ kyɛ;

english_verse: to preach God's message. Do it willingly, even if it isn't the popular thing to do. You must correct people and point out their sins. But also cheer them up, and when you instruct them, always be patient.
translation_verse: bɔ edwirɛ ne dawure, ná kɔ so yɔ, kyɛ mmerɛ paa nu oo, anaa mmerɛ tɛɛ nu oo. Maa mmenia benwu bɛ mvomsoɛ, twi bɛ nyunu, tu foɛ, wɔ ndoboaseɛ ne aboterɛ amukoraa nu.

english_verse: The time is coming when people won't listen to good teaching. Instead, they will look for teachers who will please them by telling them only what they are itching to hear.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmerɛ bie kɔwa bɔ mmenia ngotie ngyerɛkyerɛ bɔ ɔte paa ne, na mmom bɛ so anu bɔ ɔyɛ bɛ fɛ ne ati, bɛkɔboaboa akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ noa maa bɛkɔhã edwirɛ bɔ bɛpena kyɛ bɛte ɔ.

english_verse: They will turn from the truth and eagerly listen to senseless stories.
translation_verse: Bekotuatua bɛ so wɔ nahorɛ ne anwo, ná baatie ɛhoaa mmom.

english_verse: But you must stay calm and be willing to suffer. You must work hard, telling the good news and to do your job well.
translation_verse: Nakoso wɔ de, ma wɔ nye la berɛ wɔ nikyee biala nu, mia wɔ nye fa amaneɛ nu, yɔ nzɛmbahanɛniɛ adwuma ne, ná yie wɔ solɛ adwuma ne bɔkɔɔ.

english_verse: Now the time has come for me to die. My life is like a drink offering being poured out on the altar.
translation_verse: Na me de, mmerɛ ne adwu bɔ bɛbaafa me bɛbɔ afɔleɛ ɔ, na mmerɛ ne apingye kyɛ ngofi wa ɔ.

english_verse: I have fought well. I have finished the race, and I have been faithful.
translation_verse: Koɛ paa ne, maho; amirika ne, matu mayie; gyidie ne, masɔ nu.

english_verse: So a crown will be given to me for pleasing the Lord. He judges fairly, and on the day of judgment he will give a crown to me and to everyone else who wants him to appear with power. Personal Instructions
translation_verse: Na bɔ waha bɔ ɔla berɛ ma me ole tenenee abotire bɔ Awurade, ndɛenbualɛniɛ tenenee ne ɔkɔfa kɔbɔ m’aba so sɔ Kyẽa ne ɔ; bɔ nna me ngome, na mmom bɛ bɔ bekuro ye nwo aliyelɛ ne amukoraa koso ɔkɔbɔ b’aba so bie. Pɔɔlo wora dɔ Timoteo

english_verse: Come to see me as soon as you can.
translation_verse: Bɔ mmɔden bra me wa ndɛndɛ.

english_verse: Demas loves the things of this world so much that he left me and went to Thessalonica. Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus has gone to Dalmatia.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Dema ahuro kekesaala ye wiase ye dwirɛ, na wayakyi me nu wasi nu wahɔ Tɛsalonika; Kreseke ahɔ Galatia, yeɛ Tito ahɔ Dalmatia.

english_verse: Only Luke has stayed with me. Mark can be very helpful to me, so please find him and bring him with you.
translation_verse: Luka ngome twe yeɛ ɔne me wɔ wa ɔ. Ɛba a, fa Marko boka wɔ nwo so bra, ofikyɛ ye nwo hia me paa wɔ ɛsolɛ adwuma ne anu.

english_verse: I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.
translation_verse: Masoma Tihiko wɔ Ɛfeso.

english_verse: When you come, bring the coat I left at Troas with Carpus. Don't forget to bring the scrolls, especially the ones made of leather.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛba a, fa m’ataadeɛ aguasoɛ bɔ mva nyakyili Kapuse wɔ Troase ne brɛ me, yeɛ nwomaa nemɔ koso, nganga nwomaa bɔ so te kokwakokwa nemɔ.

english_verse: Alexander, the metalworker, has hurt me in many ways. But the Lord will pay him back for what he has done.
translation_verse: Kɔɔbere dwumvoɛ Aleksandro wafa edwirɛ bɔ ɔtte mayee koraa wali me. Awurade kotua ye kerɛ kyɛbɔ ye yɔleɛ te ɔ.

english_verse: Alexander opposes what we preach, so you had better watch out for him.
translation_verse: Wɔ koso nea wɔ nwo yé wɔ ye nwo, ofikyɛ ɔho tiale yɛ dwirɛ ne anyeborolɛ so.

english_verse: When I was first put on trial, no one helped me. In fact, everyone deserted me. I hope it won't be held against them.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ né meye me noa bɔ oli moa mefa mesa me nwo ne, ebiala wammangyina me si; bɛ mukoraa bɛyakyili me nu bɛhɔle. Na mesrɛ kyɛ nnɛmaa benya ye nwo asohwenɛ.

english_verse: But the Lord stood beside me. He gave me the strength to tell his full message, so that all Gentiles would hear it. And I was kept safe from hungry lions.
translation_verse: Nakoso Awurade gyinane me si mane me anwoserɛ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ bɔ ɔkɔfa me so kɔbɔ edwirɛ ne dawure bɔkɔɔ kɔma Amaenmaensofoɛ amukoraa bɛkɔte ɔ. Yiti ɔpepɛ lele me fili gyata noa nu.

english_verse: The Lord will always keep me from being harmed by evil, and he will bring me safely into his heavenly kingdom. Praise him forever and ever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Awurade kɔpepɛ kole me kofi musue amukoraa nu, na okole me kɔhɔ ye nyameɛso ahennie ne anu. Ye yeɛ animnyam ɔte ye deɛ daa daa afebɔɔ ɔ. Amen. Ngraalilɛ

english_verse: Give my greetings to Priscilla and Aquila and to the family of Onesiphorus.
translation_verse: Mebisa Prisika ne Akwila, yeɛ Onesiforo awuro ama ahye.

english_verse: Erastus stayed at Corinth. Trophimus was sick when I left him at Miletus.
translation_verse: Eraseto hale Korinto, na Trofimo de, nyakyili ye Mileto bɔ né ɔnde apɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Do your best to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, and Claudia send you their greetings, and so do the rest of the Lord's followers.
translation_verse: Bɔ mmɔden dwu wa koraka né prakasua ne awa. Yubulo ne Pudɛn ne Lino ne Klɔdia ne aliɛmaa nemɔ amukoraa bebisa wɔ ahye.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord will bless your life and will be kind to you.
translation_verse: Awurade [Yesu Kristo] ne wɔ sunzum bɛtena. Adom ɔ́yɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. Amen.

english_verse: From Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ. I encourage God's own people to have more faith and to understand the truth about religion.
translation_verse: Pɔɔlo, bɔ nde Nyameɛ akoaa ne Yesu Kristo somafoɛ mema bɛ bɔ Nyameɛ aneanea nu waye bɛ ɔ bɛ gyidie ɔne nahorɛ ne nwo nimdeɛ bɔ ɔma nyamesom paa ɔ,

english_verse: Then they will have the hope of eternal life God promised long ago. And God never tells a lie!
translation_verse: daa ngoa nwo anyelasoɛ nu, ngoa bɔ Ɛdangama Nyameɛ bɔ ɔmbɛ ngondombo ne ɔfa hyɛle bɔ koraka yeɛ ɔbɔ aleɛ ɔ;

english_verse: So, at the proper time, God our Savior gave this message and told me to announce what he had said.
translation_verse: na mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu, ɔlale ye dwirɛ ne ali wɔ nzɛmbahanɛ bɔ ɔte yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ bɔ wafa wawura me sa ne;

english_verse: Titus, because of our faith, you are like a son to me. I pray that God our Father and Christ Jesus our Savior will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! What Titus Was To Do in Crete
translation_verse: na mékyerɛ mebrɛ Tito, bɔ ɛte me bɔbɔ mma wɔ gyidie komapɛ ne ala nu ɔ. Adom, anwumvoinnwunɛ ne asomdwee bɔ ofi Baba Nyameɛ ne yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ wɔ deɛ. Suban bɔ ɔfata asɔre so neafoɛ

english_verse: I left you in Crete to do what had been left undone and to appoint leaders for the churches in each town. As I told you,
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ati yeɛ nyakyili wɔ wɔ Krete ɔ, kyɛ ɛ́nea toto nningyein bɔ waha ne pɛpɛɛpɛ, ná ɛyeye mbanyi mɔ wɔ kuro biala so, kyɛbɔ ngane kyɛ ɛyɔ ne:

english_verse: they must have a good reputation and be faithful in marriage. Their children must be followers of the Lord and not have a reputation for being wild and disobedient.
translation_verse: Bɔ ngekalewa biala nne ye bra nu; bɔ ɔye te komapɛ, bɔ ye mma mɔ bɛte agyidifoɛ bɔ bɛnyɛ basabasa anaa asoserɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Church officials are in charge of God's work, and so they must also have a good reputation. They must not be bossy, quick-tempered, heavy drinkers, bullies, or dishonest in business.
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔfata neafoɛ ɛhe: ɔnzɛ kyɛ benwu ngekalewa wɔ ye bra nu, ofikyɛ ɔte Nyameɛ awuro so neafoɛ; ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɔmoma ye nwo so, onya ahone, ɔyɛ akɔnomnzaniɛ, patapaa, anaa adifuu sona;

english_verse: Instead, they must be friendly to strangers and enjoy doing good things. They must also be sensible, fair, pure, and self-controlled.
translation_verse: na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔma ye nye gye ɛwɔfoɛsolɛ nwo, okuro bɔ ɔte paa, ɔte ebie bɔ ye adwene nu pi, ɔtengyɛ, ye nwo te, ná ole anwohyɛsoɛ ɔ;

english_verse: They must stick to the true message they were taught, so their good teaching can help others and correct everyone who opposes it.
translation_verse: ɔsɛ kyɛ otira nahorɛ dwirɛ ne anu bum kyɛbɔ behyirele ye ne, amaa ɔnate so wahora wafa ngyerɛkyerɛ paa watu foɛ, ná wama aporowaasulɛfoɛ bɛ mvomsoɛ ala ali.

english_verse: There are many who don't respect authority, and they fool others by talking nonsense. This is especially true of some Jewish followers.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmeni pee wɔ berɛ bɔ bɛte asoserɛfoɛ, nzekurebɔlɛfoɛ, nnakannakafoɛ, nganga bienzuapɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ,

english_verse: But you must make them be quiet. They are after money, and they upset whole families by teaching what they should not.
translation_verse: bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛmaa bemua bɛ noa ɔ. Bɛ yeɛ mvasoɛ fiɛ ti bekyirekyire bɔ ɔnzɛ kyɛ bekyire ɔ, na bɛfa bɛsɛkye abusuafoɛ mukoraa b’adwene.

english_verse: It is like one of their own prophets once said, “The people of Crete always tell lies. They are greedy and lazy like wild animals.”
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nu sona ko, bɔ ɔte bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ɔ, ɔhane kyɛ, “Kretefoɛ bɛte ngondombofoɛ daa biala, ngaka amumuyɛɛfoɛ, ɛfoen mmenia bɔ bɛte adifuu ɔ.”

english_verse: This surely is a true saying. And you should be hard on such people, so you can help them grow stronger in their faith.
translation_verse: Sɔ adanzeɛ he te nahorɛ, yiti twi bɛ nyunu paa, amaa ɔnate so bagyina pindinn wɔ gyidie ne anu;

english_verse: Don't pay any attention to any of those senseless Jewish stories and human commands. These are made up by people who won't obey the truth.
translation_verse: ná banyɛ asoɛ bamma Yudafoɛ tete dwirɛ bɔ nahorɛ nne nu ne, ɔne mmenia bɔ bɛpo nahorɛ ne ɔ b’ahyɛdeɛ.

english_verse: Everything is pure for someone whose heart is pure. But nothing is pure for an unbeliever with a dirty mind. That person's mind and conscience are destroyed.
translation_verse: Nikyee biala nwo te ma bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo te ɔ; nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛ nwo nde ná benne benni ne de, nikye fee nwo nde mma bɛ; ofikyɛ b’adwene ne bɛ tiboa nwo agua fiɛ

english_verse: Such people claim to know God, but their actions prove they really don't. They are disgusting. They won't obey God, and they are too worthless to do anything good.
translation_verse: Bekyire kyɛ bɛse Nyameɛ, nakoso bɛfa bɛ yɔleɛ bɛpo ye; bɛte akyiwadeɛyɔlɛ mmenia, asoserɛfoɛ, bɔ bɛngora bɛnyɔ nikye paa biala ɔ.

english_verse: Titus, you must teach only what is correct.
translation_verse: Na wɔ de, ngyerɛkyerɛ sannwuu yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ekyire ɔ.

english_verse: Tell the older men to have self-control and to be serious and sensible. Their faith, love, and patience must never fail.
translation_verse: Kyirekyire ngɔkoraa nemɔ ma bɛ nye la berɛ, bɛyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛfata anidie ɔ, benya anwohyɛsoɛ, begyina pindinn wɔ gyidie nu, ɔdɔ nu ne animia nu.

english_verse: Tell the older women to behave as those who love the Lord should. They must not gossip about others or be slaves of wine. They must teach what is proper,
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ kyirekyire nworowaa nemɔ ma bɛbɔ bra bɔ ɔte krongron ɔ. Ɔnzɛ kyɛ bedi nzekure anaa bɛyɛ akɔnomnzafoɛ; na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ bekyirekyire bɔ ɔte paa ɔ,

english_verse: so the younger women will be loving wives and mothers.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so bafa batete ndaluwa nemɔ maa bahuro bɛ hu mɔ, ɔne bɛ mma mɔ dwirɛ,

english_verse: Each of the younger women must be sensible and kind, as well as a good homemaker, who puts her own husband first. Then no one can say insulting things about God's message.
translation_verse: ná badwene adwene paa, banea bɛ nwo so yé, basiesie b’awuro, bayɛ paa, babrɛ bɛ nwo ase bama bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ hu mɔ, ná mmenia annya edwirɛ tɛɛ banga bamva Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne anwo.

english_verse: Tell the young men to have self-control in everything.
translation_verse: Na mmerandeɛ nemɔ koso, sɔ ala yeɛ tu bɛ foɛ ma benya anwohyɛsoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Always set a good example for others. Be sincere and serious when you teach.
translation_verse: Na nningyein mukoraa nu, tu wɔ nwo sie berɛ yɛ yɔleɛ paa nwo nhwɛsoɛ: Wɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ nu, da nahorɛlilɛ ne ahoneserɛ ali,

english_verse: Use clean language that no one can criticize. Do this, and your enemies will be too ashamed to say anything against you.
translation_verse: edwirɛ paa bɔ bengonya ye nwo dwirɛ bɛngɔhã ɔ; amaa ɔnate so ebiala bɔ ɔne wɔ bɛnyɛ adwene ne ye nyunu agua ase, bɔ ongonya yɛ nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ biala ngɔhã ɔ.

english_verse: Tell slaves always to please their owners by obeying them in everything. Slaves must not talk back to their owners
translation_verse: Ngoaa mɔ koso, tu bɛ foɛ kyɛ bɛbrɛ bɛ nwo ase bɛma bɛ mene mɔ, ná bɛ́sɔ bɛ nye wɔ atee biala so; ɔnzɛ kyɛ bɛyɛ bɛ so nyeyeanoɛ,

english_verse: or steal from them. They must be completely honest and trustworthy. Then everyone will show great respect for what is taught about God our Savior. God's Kindness and the New Life
translation_verse: anaa bɛyɛ bɛ so awue mmaa mmaa; na mmom ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛda nahorɛ paa amukoraa ali, amaa ɔnate so bama yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne wanya anidie wɔ nikyee biala nu.

english_verse: God has shown us undeserved grace by coming to save all people.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ adom bɔ ɔfa ngoalelɛ brɛ adasa mmaa mukoraa ne, waye ye nwo ali.

english_verse: He taught us to give up our wicked ways and our worldly desires and to live decent and honest lives in this world.
translation_verse: Na okyirekyire yɛ, kyɛ, yɛ́gyi bra fiɛ ne wiase akɔnnɔ yɛ́gua, kyɛ yɛ́nya anwohyɛsoɛ, ná yɛ́fa tenenee ne nyamesom paa yɛtena wiase he anu,

english_verse: We are filled with hope, as we wait for the glorious return of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: wɔ mmerɛ bɔ yɛnwondɛ anyelasoɛ bɔ ɔte saleɛ, bɔ ɔte yɛ Nyameɛ piri ne yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Yesu Kristo animnyam walɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: He gave himself to rescue us from everything evil and to make our hearts pure. He wanted us to be his own people and to be eager to do right.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔfale ye ngoa tole berɛ mane yɛ ɔ, kyɛbɔ okole yɛ kofi amumuyɛɛ amukoraa nu, ná wate yɛ nwo wafa yɛ wayɛ ye bɔbɔ ye mmenia sonongo bɔ bɛbɔ nnwumaa paa nwo mmɔden ɔ.

english_verse: Teach these things, as you use your full authority to encourage and correct people. Make sure you earn everyone's respect.
translation_verse: Fa tumi amukoraa kã ɛhemɔ, tu ye nwo foɛ, ná twi bɛ nyunu. Nnɛma ebiala fa wɔ nyunu twitwi ase.

english_verse: Remind your people to obey the rulers and authorities and not to be rebellious. They must always be ready to do something helpful
translation_verse: Kaye bɛ ma bɛbrɛ bɛ nwo ase bɛma maen mbanyi ne bɛ bɔ tumi wura bɛ sa ɔ, kyɛ bɛyɛ sotie, ná bésiesie bɛ nwo bɛ́ma nnwumaa paa biala;

english_verse: and not say cruel things or argue. They should be gentle and kind to everyone.
translation_verse: kyɛ, nnɛmaa bɛkã ebiala nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ, nnɛmaa bɛyɛ tuturefoɛ; na mmom bédwo bɛ nwo ase, ná bɛfa anidie bɔ odi mu ɔ bɛma mmenia mukoraa.

english_verse: We used to be stupid, disobedient, and foolish, as well as slaves of all sorts of desires and pleasures. We were evil and jealous. Everyone hated us, and we hated everyone.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ daa ne de, né yɛ koso yɛte ngwaseafoɛ, asoserɛfoɛ, bɛmaa yɛlili makyebu, yɛyɛle anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ ne anigye ahoroɔ ngoaa, yɛfale nzɛmmɔne ne anyeboroborolɛ yɛbɔle yɛ bra, mmenia pɔle yɛ, na yɛ wora yɛpɔle bɛ.

english_verse: God our Savior showed us how good and kind he is.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Nyameɛ ɔlale ye paayɛlɛ ne ye ɔdɔ ali hyirele adasa mmaa ne,

english_verse: He saved us because of his mercy, and not because of any good things we have done. God washed us by the power of the Holy Spirit. He gave us new birth and a fresh beginning.
translation_verse: bɔ nna kyɛ tenenee nnwumaa bie bɔ yayɔ ti ɔ; na mmom ye bɔbɔ ye anwumvoinnwunɛ ti ɔ, na ɔfale aworɛ foforɛ ebialɛ nu ne foforɛyɛlɛ wɔ Sunzum Krongron so olele yɛ ngoa.

english_verse: God sent Jesus Christ our Savior to give us his Spirit.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔnate yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Yesu Kristo so ohwie guale yɛ so mmorosoɛ ɔ,

english_verse: Jesus treated us much better than we deserve. He made us acceptable to God and gave us the hope of eternal life.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate ye adom so wabua yɛ be, bɔ ɔkɔma yɛ sa kɔhã daa ngoa nwo anyelasoɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: This message is certainly true. These teachings are useful and helpful for everyone. I want you to insist that the people follow them, so that all who have faith in God will be sure to do good deeds.
translation_verse: Ɛhe te edwirɛ nahorɛ, na mekuro kyɛ esi edwirɛ hemɔ so paa, amaa ɔnate so bɛ bɔ bale Nyameɛ bali ne badwene kyɛbɔ bɛkɔbɔ nnwumaa paa nwo mmɔden ɔ. Sɔ nningyein nemɔ yeɛ ɔte paa ɔ, na mvasoɛ wɔ so ma sona.

english_verse: But don't have anything to do with stupid arguments about ancestors. And stay away from disagreements and quarrels about the Law of Moses. Such arguments are useless and senseless.
translation_verse: Nakoso twe wɔ nwo fi ngwaseaa aporowaasulɛ nwo, aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ nwo dwirɛ nwo, mbakyembakyemuɛ nwo, yeɛ mmeraa ne nwo aporowaasulɛ nwo; ofikyɛ mvasoɛ nne so, na bɛte mbaen.

english_verse: Warn troublemakers once or twice. Then don't have anything else to do with them.
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ ɔfa mbakyembakyemuɛ ba ne, sɛ edwudwo kyire ye ko anaa ye pɛen nyɔ so yie a, nnɛne ye bɔ afɛ ko.

english_verse: You know their minds are twisted, and their own sins show how guilty they are. Personal Instructions and Greetings
translation_verse: Na nwu ye kyɛ, sona bɔ ɔte sɔ ne, wali makyebu, ɔte bɔnefoɛ, na obua ye bɔbɔ ye nwo foɛ. Ngraalilɛ

english_verse: I plan to send Artemas or Tychicus to you. After he arrives, please try your best to meet me at Nicopolis. I have decided to spend the winter there.
translation_verse: Sɛ mesoma Atɛma anaa Tihiko maa ɔba wɔ berɛ a, bɔ mmɔden kyɛ ɛkɔwa me berɛ wɔ Nikopoli; ofikyɛ berɛ yeɛ mayɛ m’adwene kyɛ ngooli prakasua mmerɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: When Zenas the lawyer and Apollos get ready to leave, help them as much as you can, so they won't have need of anything.
translation_verse: Bɔ mmɔden kyɛ ekogua mmeraa nwo nimdeɛniɛ Sena ɔne Apolo ate; nea kyɛ bengohia hwee ɔ.

english_verse: Greetings to you from everyone here. Greet all of our friends who share in our faith. I pray that the Lord will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛne me wɔ wa ne amukoraa bebisa wɔ ahye. Bisa bɛ bɔ bekuro yɛ dwirɛ wɔ gyidie nu ne ahye . Adom ɔyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛ deɛ.

english_verse: and to the church that meets in your home. It is also to our dear friend Apphia and to Archippus, who serves the Lord as we do.
translation_verse: ɔne y’eliɛma brasua Apia, yɛ biɛngo sraaniɛ Akipo, ɔne asɔre bɔ ɔwɔ w’awuro ne.

english_verse: I pray that God our Father and our Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you and will bless you with peace! Philemon's Love and Faith
translation_verse: Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi yɛ Baba Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo berɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ! Filemon ɔdɔ ne ye gyidie

english_verse: Philemon, each time I mention you in my prayers, I thank God.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ biala bɔ mekaye wɔ wɔ mbaeɛbɔlɛ nu ne, mefa asennaa mema me Nyameɛ,

english_verse: I hear about your faith in our Lord Jesus and about your love for all God's people.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ɔdɔ bɔ ele ye ma anwoteefoɛ amukoraa ɔne wɔ gyidie wɔ Awurade Yesu nu ne, mete ye nga.

english_verse: As you share your faith with others, I pray they may come to know all the blessings Christ has given us.
translation_verse: Na me mbaeɛ ole kyɛ, nningyein paa amukoraa bɔ ɔnate Kristo so ɔwɔ wɔ nu ne, bɛ nwo nimdeɛ kɔma wɔ gyidie nnwumaa ne kɔla ali piri paa.

english_verse: My friend, your love has made me happy and has greatly encouraged me. It has also cheered the hearts of God's people. Paul Speaks to Philemon about Onesimus
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa, ɔdɔ bɔ ele ye ne, wamaa yanya anigye ne nguraenhyɛlɛ pee, ofikyɛ ama anwoteefoɛ ne amukoraa bɛ wora akyekye. Pɔɔlo di Onesimo ti dwirɛ

english_verse: But I would rather ask you to do it simply because of love. Yes, as someone in jail for Christ,
translation_verse: nakoso ɔnate ɔdɔ ti, mekuro kyɛ mesrɛ wɔ mmom, me Pɔɔlo bɔ mayɛ akoraa, bɔ kekesaala ye nza nde Yesu Kristo kukununiɛ ɔ.

english_verse: I beg you to help Onesimus! He is like a son to me because I led him to Christ here in jail.
translation_verse: Mepa wɔ kyerɛ mema mma Onesimo bɔ mayɛ ye baba wɔ me kuku nu nnaa ye anu ɔ.

english_verse: Sending Onesimus back to you makes me very sad.
translation_verse: Mésoma ye maa osa ba wɔ berɛ; ɔte sona bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo ɔ.

english_verse: I would like to keep him here with me, where he could take your place in helping me while I am here in prison for preaching the good news.
translation_verse: Ahaa mekuro kyɛ memaa ɔtena me nwo wa, ná ogyina wɔ gya nu ɔso me, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ nzɛmba ne ati nna kukunu ye;

english_verse: But I won't do anything unless you agree to it first. I want your act of kindness to come from your heart, and not be something you feel forced to do.
translation_verse: nakoso menguro kyɛ ngɔfa wɔ si ngɔyɔ nikyee biala ɔ, ná wɔ paayɛlɛ ne anyɛ kyɛ mehyɛ wɔ ɔ, na mmom wafi w’ahone nu.

english_verse: Perhaps Onesimus was taken from you for a little while so you could have him back for good,
translation_verse: Ebiaa ɛhe ati yeɛ ofili wɔ nwo mmerɛ kãa bie ɔ, amaa ɔnate so afa ye ayɛ wɔ deɛ bɔkɔɔ;

english_verse: but not as a slave. Onesimus is much more than a slave. To me he is a dear friend, but to you he is even more, both as a person and as a follower of the Lord.
translation_verse: bɔ nna kyɛ kanganiɛ ko, na mmom ye dibea bo kanganiɛ so, kyɛ aliɛmaa bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo paa ɔ, na wɔ de, ɔte sɔ ma wɔ tra so koraa, wɔ anwoɔnaen ne Awurade nu.

english_verse: If you consider me a friend because of Christ, then welcome Onesimus as you would welcome me.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ ebu me kyɛ ebiɛngo de a, nzaade de ye nyemene so kyɛbɔ ekole me ne ala.

english_verse: If he has cheated you or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
translation_verse: Sɛ wayɛ wɔ tɛɛ bie, anaakyɛ ɔma wɔ kerɛ a, bu kerɛ ne ma me.

english_verse: With my own hand I write: I, PAUL, WILL PAY YOU BACK. But don't forget you owe me your life.
translation_verse: Me Pɔɔlo, me bɔbɔ me sa noa ahyerɛlɛ ɛhe: Ngotua wɔ kerɛ bɔ ɔma wɔ ɔ; na ahaa menguro kyɛ mefa me noa mebɔ so kyɛ wɔ sona mumua ne po ɔma me kerɛ.

english_verse: My dear friend and follower of Christ our Lord, please cheer me up by doing this for me.
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa, maa nya anigye bie mvi wɔ berɛ wɔ Awurade nu; kyekye me wora wɔ Kristo nu.

english_verse: I am sure you will do all I have asked, and even more.
translation_verse: Mede wɔ medi kyɛ ekotie me ti yeɛ mekyerɛ wɔ krataa ye ɔ, na mese kyɛ bɔ mebisa wɔ ye, ɛkɔyɔ maa ɔkɔbo so po.

english_verse: Please get a room ready for me. I hope your prayers will be answered, and I can visit you.
translation_verse: Afei koso, siesie ɛwɔfoɛ sua ma me, na me nye la so kyɛ, ɔnate ɛmɔ mbaeɛ so ngonya atee ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ. Ngraalilɛ

english_verse: Epaphras is also here in jail for being a follower of Christ Jesus. He sends his greetings,
translation_verse: Epafra bɔ ɔte mmiɛngo kukununiɛ wɔ Kristo Yesu nu,

english_verse: and so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, who work together with me.
translation_verse: yeɛ Marko, Aristako, Dema ne Luka bɔ bɛte mmiɛngo adwumayɔlɛfoɛ ne, bebisa wɔ ahye.

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus Christ will be kind to you!
translation_verse: Yɛ Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne ɛmɔ sunzum bɛtena.

english_verse: Long ago in many ways and at many times God's prophets spoke his message to our ancestors.
translation_verse: Daa tete ne, mmerɛ pee nu ne atee ahoroɔ so yeɛ Nyameɛ nate ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ so dwudwo hyirele yɛ nana mɔ ɔ;

english_verse: But now at last, God sent his Son to bring his message to us. God created the universe by his Son, and everything will someday belong to the Son.
translation_verse: nakoso ngyẽa bɔ oli nziɛ ye anu de, wafa Ɔwa ne aso yeɛ wadwudwo wahyire yɛ ɔ, ye bɔ wama agyapadeɛ amukoraa wayɛ ye deɛ, ye bɔ ɔnate ye so yeɛ ɔbɔle wiase amukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: God's Son has all the brightness of God's own glory and is like him in every way. By his own mighty word, he holds the universe together. After the Son had washed away our sins, he sat down at the right side of the glorious God in heaven.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔte Nyameɛ animnyam hyireinn ne, ɔne ye sue kaenn, na ole ye tumi dwirɛ ne yeɛ otira nningyein mukoraa nu ɔ. Na ɔtele yɛ nwo fili yɛ bɔne nwo yiele nen, ɔɔtenane Tuminiɛ Nyameɛ sa famaa so wɔ nyameɛso. Nyameɛ Awa ne tra abɔfo mɔ

english_verse: He had become much greater than the angels, and the name he was given is far greater than any of theirs. God's Son Is Greater than Angels
translation_verse: Nyameɛ mane Baa ne trale abɔfo mɔ, kyɛbɔ dumaa bɔ ye sa aha ye ne koso bo bɛ deɛ so ne.

english_verse: God has never said to any of the angels, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!” Neither has God said to any of them, “I will be his Father, and he will be my Son!”
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, abɔfo mɔ nu beni yeɛ Nyameɛ ahã ahyire ye le kyɛ, “Ɛte Mma, na ɛnɛ mayɛ wɔ Baba” ɔ? Anaakyɛ, “Ngɔyɛ ye Baba, na ye wora wayɛ Mma” ɔ?

english_verse: When God brings his first-born Son into the world, he commands all of his angels to worship him.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ baasoma ye bamuɛbaa ne maa ɔba wiase ne de, ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɔsɛ kyɛ Nyameɛ abɔfo mukoraa bɛsɔne ye.”

english_verse: And when God speaks about the angels, he says, “I change my angels into wind and my servants into flaming fire.”
translation_verse: Na bɔ Nyameɛ ha fale abɔfo mɔ nwo ɛhe: “Nyameɛ yɛ ye abɔfo mɔ mvrama, na ɔyɛ ye somvoɛ mɔ see bɔ ogye ɔ.”

english_verse: But God says about his Son, “You are God, and you will rule as King forever! Your royal power brings about justice.
translation_verse: Nakoso Ɔwa ne de, bɔ ɔha fale ye nwo ɛhe: “O Nyameɛ, w’ahennie bia wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ! W’Ahennie hɔtɔ ne te teenenee hɔtɔ.

english_verse: You loved justice and hated evil, and so I, your God, have chosen you. I appointed you and made you happier than any of your friends.”
translation_verse: Ekuro tenenee, na ekyi amumuyɛɛ. Ɛhe ati Nyameɛ, wɔ Nyameɛ aye wɔ; wafa anika ngoo wapopa wɔ maa wabo wɔ mmango mɔ deɛ so.”

english_verse: The Scriptures also say, “In the beginning, Lord, you were the one who laid the foundation of the earth and created the heavens.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ sa hane kyɛ yoo: “Wɔ, Awurade, ahyɛaseɛ ne, ɛtole aseɛ fapem, na anwuro te wɔ sa noa adwuma;

english_verse: They will all disappear and wear out like clothes, but you will last forever.
translation_verse: bɛ mukoraa bɛkɔsɛkye, nakoso wɔ de, ɛwɔ berɛ daa; bɛ mukoraa bɛkɔyɛ daa kyɛ ataadeɛ yɛ daa ɔ,

english_verse: You will roll them up like a robe and change them like a garment. But you are always the same, and you will live forever.”
translation_verse: ekobubu bɛ kyɛ ɛtena, na bɛkɔsesã bɛ kyɛ ataadeɛ; nakoso wɔ de, kyɛbɔ ɛte ne ala yeɛ ɛte ɔ, na ɛwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.”

english_verse: God never said to any of the angels, “Sit at my right side until I make your enemies into a footstool for you!”
translation_verse: Na abɔfo mɔ nu beni yeɛ Nyameɛ ahã ahyire ye le kyɛ, “Tena me sa famaa so kodwu kyɛ ngɔfa wɔ pɔfoɛ mɔ ngɔyɛ wɔ gya bo ndiasoɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: Angels are merely spirits sent to serve people who are going to be saved.
translation_verse: Aso bɛ mukoraa bɛtte sunzum asomvoɛ mɔ, bɔ ɔsoma bɛ maa bɛkɔɔso mmenia bɔ bekonya ngoalelɛ ɔ?

english_verse: We must give our full attention to what we were told, so we won't drift away.
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, odi kyɛ yɛsɔ nahorɛ dwirɛ bɔ yate ne anu yé ná yammini.

english_verse: The message spoken by angels proved to be true, and all who disobeyed or rejected it were punished as they deserved.
translation_verse: Na sɛ edwirɛ bɔ abɔfo mɔ hane ne te nahorɛ, ná mmeraatolɛ biala ne asoserɛ biala nyane ye so akatuaa kyɛbɔ ɔfata hɔ a,

english_verse: So if we refuse this great way of being saved, how can we hope to escape? The Lord himself was the first to tell about it, and people who heard the message proved to us that it was true.
translation_verse: nzaade sɛ yɛpo ngoalelɛ piri bɔ ɔte sɔa de a, yɛkɔyɛ sɛɛ ná yafa yɛ nwo yali? Awurade lili moa bɔle ngoalelɛ he nwo dawure, na bɛ bɔ bɛtele ne koso lili ye nwo adanzeɛ maa yɛnwuni kyɛ ɔte nahorɛ.

english_verse: God himself showed that his message was true by working all kinds of powerful miracles and wonders. He also gave his Holy Spirit to anyone he chose to. The One Who Leads Us To Be Saved
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ koso yɔle nzɛngyerɛnneɛ ne anwanwadeɛ ne tumi nnwumaa ahoroɔ, na ɔmane Sunzum Krongron akyɛdeɛ ne, kyɛbɔ ye apɛdeɛ si te ɔ fa lili edwirɛ ne nwo adanzeɛ. Kristo fa yɛ kɔ daa ngoa nu

english_verse: We know that God did not put the future world under the power of angels.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nna abɔfo mɔ bo yeɛ Nyameɛ fale ewiase bɔ ɔ́ba bɔ yɛkã ye nwo dwirɛ ne owurale ɔ.

english_verse: Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says to God, “What makes you care about us humans? Why are you concerned for weaklings such as we?
translation_verse: Na mmom bahã ye nekaa bie kyɛ, “Dasaniɛ te nzu koraa bɔ ɛdwene ye nwo ɔ? Anaakyɛ sona awa te nzu, bɔ wɔ nye ku ye nwo ɔ?

english_verse: You made us lower than the angels for a while. Yet you have crowned us with glory and honor.
translation_verse: Ɛmaa ɔhɔle ase bie trale abɔfo mɔ, ɛfale animnyam ne anidie bɔle ye abotire, [ɛfale wɔ sa noa adwuma wurale ye sa,]

english_verse: And you have put everything under our power!” God has put everything under our power and has not left anything out of our power. But we still don't see it all under our control.
translation_verse: na ɛfale nningyein mukoraa wurale ye gya bo.” Na sɛ ɔkã kyɛ Nyameɛ fale “nningyein mukoraa wurale ye bo” a, né okyire kyɛ nikyee biala nne berɛ bɔ wamva wanwura ye bo ɔ. Nakoso kekesaala ye de, yɛnnya yɛnnwuni kyɛ wafa nningyein mukoraa wawura ye bo.

english_verse: What we do see is Jesus, who for a little while was made lower than the angels. Because of God's gift of undeserved grace, Jesus died for everyone. And now that Jesus has suffered and died, he is crowned with glory and honor!
translation_verse: Nakoso yɛnwu Yesu kyɛ, Nyameɛ maa ɔhɔle ase kãa trale abɔfo mɔ, amaa ɔnate Nyameɛ adom ti wawu wama adasa mukoraa. Na ɔnate ye wue bɔ owuli ne ati, Nyameɛ afa animnyam ne anidie wabɔ ye abotire.

english_verse: Everything belongs to God, and all things were created by his power. So God did the right thing when he made Jesus perfect by suffering, as Jesus led many of God's children to be saved and to share in his glory.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ye bɔ ɔbɔle nningyein mukoraa na nningyein mukoraa te ye deɛ ne, bɔ ɔnate Yesu so fa ye mma kɔ animnyam nu ne, né ɔfata kyɛ ɔma bɛ ngoalelɛ safohene Yesu ɔfa amaneɛnwunɛ nu odi mu.

english_verse: Jesus and the people he makes holy all belong to the same family. This is why he isn't ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔte mmenia nwo fi bɛ bɔne nwo ne, ɔne mmenia bɔ ɔte bɛ nwo ne amukoraa bɛ Baba te ko; na ɔnate sɔ ne ati, ɔnyɛ ye nya kyɛ ɔkɔfrɛ bɛ oliɛma mɔ ɔ.
