english_verse: He even said to God, “I will tell them your name and sing your praises when they come together to worship.”
translation_verse: Ɔnwa yoo: “Ngɔbɔ wɔ dumaa ngohyire nniɛma mɔ, na ngɔto dwein ngɔye wɔ ayɛ wɔ agyidifoɛ badwa nu.”

english_verse: He also said, “I will trust God.” Then he said, “Here I am with the children God has given me.”
translation_verse: Osa hane kyɛ, “Ngɔfa me wora ngowura ye nu.” Na osa hane ye bieku kyɛ, “Me ɛhe, me ne mmaa bɔ Nyameɛ afa bɛ ama me ne.”

english_verse: We are people of flesh and blood. This is why Jesus became one of us. He died to destroy the devil, who had power over death.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ mmaa nemɔ te anwoɔnaen ne mogya ne ati, Yesu bɔbɔ yɛle ye nwo kyɛ bɛ ala, ɔfale sɔ sona sue ne bie, amaa ɔnate ye wue ne aso wasɛkye abɔnzam bɔ ye yeɛ ole ewue so tumi ne;

english_verse: But he also died to rescue all of us who live each day in fear of dying.
translation_verse: ná wale bɛ bɔ ɔnate esurolɛ bɔ besuro ewue ti bayɛ ngoaa mmerɛ bɔ bɛte ase mukoraa nu ne.

english_verse: Jesus clearly did not come to help angels, but he did come to help Abraham's descendants.
translation_verse: Na ɔte nahorɛ kyɛ nna abɔfo mɔ yeɛ oolele bɛ ɔ, na mmom Abraham boso ama yeɛ oolele bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: He had to be one of us, so he could serve God as our merciful and faithful high priest and sacrifice himself for the forgiveness of our sins.
translation_verse: Ɛhe ati, né ohia kyɛ ɔyɛ kyɛ oliɛma nemɔ wɔ atee biala so, amaa wahora wayɛ sɔfo panyi paa bɔ odi nahorɛ, bɔ ɔse anwumvoin wɔ Nyameɛ dwumadie nu, ná wafa ye nwo wayɛ mbata wama adasa bɔne.

english_verse: And now that Jesus has suffered and was tempted, he can help anyone else who is tempted.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ ye bɔbɔ besole ye bɛneane ná onwuni amaneɛ ne ati, ɔkora boka bɛ bɔ bɛwɔ nzɔhwɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, God has chosen you to be his holy people. So think about Jesus, the one we call our apostle and high priest!
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ anwoteefoɛ bɔ Nyameɛ afrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ, ɛ́mɔnea Somafoɛ Yesu bɔ ɔte yɛ dwirɛ bɔ yɛkã ne anwo ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne kyɛ,

english_verse: Jesus was faithful to God, who appointed him, just as Moses was faithful in serving all God's people.
translation_verse: olili nahorɛ mane bɔ otuli ye siele berɛ ne, kyɛbɔ Mose koso lili nahorɛ wɔ Nyameɛ awuro mukoraa nu ne.

english_verse: But Jesus deserves more honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house deserves more honor than the house.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ suasilɛfoɛ le animnyam paa tra sua nen, sɔ ala koso yeɛ Yesu le animnyam tra Mose ɔ.

english_verse: Of course, every house is built by someone, and God is really the one who built everything.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, sua biala kuro sona yeɛ osi ɔ, nakoso Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔyɔ nningyein mukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: Moses was a faithful servant and told God's people what would be said in the future.
translation_verse: Mose de, olili nahorɛ wɔ Nyameɛ awuro mukoraa nu kyɛ somvoɛ, na olili nningyein bɔ né Nyameɛ baahã ye nwo dwirɛ ne nwo adanzeɛ.

english_verse: But Christ is the Son in charge of God's people. And we are those people, if we keep on being brave and don't lose hope. A Rest for God's People
translation_verse: Nakoso Kristo de, odi Nyameɛ awuro so kyɛ Baa. Yiti yɛ ole ye awuro ne, nakoso sana yɛsɔ yɛ gyidie ne yɛ anwohoahoa bɔ ɔwɔ yɛ anyelasoɛ nu yé kodwu ayieleɛ. Nyameɛ mmenia nwomelelɛ

english_verse: It is just as the Holy Spirit says, “If you hear God's voice today,
translation_verse: Yiti kyɛbɔ Sunzum Krongron kã hɔ ɛhe: “Ɛnɛ, sɛ ɛmɔte Nyameɛ dwudwolɛ a,

english_verse: don't be stubborn! Don't rebel like those people who were tested in the desert. *
translation_verse: nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ asoserɛ, kyɛbɔ bɛyɛle ye so lɔen, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ besole ye bɛneane wɔ ɛserɛ so ne.

english_verse: For forty years your ancestors tested God and saw the things he did.
translation_verse: Berɛ yeɛ ɛmɔ nana mɔ gyegyele me besole me bɛneane, na benwuni me nnwumaa afoɛ aburanna ɔ.

english_verse: “Then God got tired of them and said, ‘You people never show good sense, and you don't understand what I want you to do.’
translation_verse: Yiti mvɛle sɔ aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ ne so yaa, na ngane kyɛ, ‘Daa biala bedi bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ ti piri, na bɛnze atee bɔ mefa so meyɔ me nningyein ɔ.’

english_verse: God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ”
translation_verse: Yiti nne ɛyaa ndale ndaen kyɛ, ‘Bengowura me nwomelelɛ ne anu bie le!’ ”

english_verse: My friends, watch out! Don't let evil thoughts or doubts make any of you turn from the living God.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔnea yé na ɛmɔ nu biala annya adwene tɛɛ bɔ ɔmma onne nni ɔ, na wandwe ye nwo wamvi Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne nwo.

english_verse: You must encourage one another each day. And you must keep on while there is still a time that can be called “today.” If you don't, then sin may fool some of you and make you stubborn.
translation_verse: Na mmom ɛmɔtutu bɛ nwo foɛ kyẽa biala bɔ bɛfrɛ ye “Ɛnɛ” ne, na bɔne annakalaka ɛmɔ nu biala amma wanyɛ asoserɛ.

english_verse: We were sure about Christ when we first became his people. So let's hold tightly to our faith until the end.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛsɔ gyidie bɔ yɛlili moa yɛnyane ye ne anu yé yɛkɔ ayieleɛ a, ye de yɛle kyɛfa wɔ Kristo nu.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn like those who rebelled.”
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ bɛkã kyɛ, “Ɛnɛ, sɛ ɛmɔte Nyameɛ dwudwolɛ a, nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ asoserɛ, kyɛbɔ bɛyɛle ye so lɔen ne.”

english_verse: Who were those people that heard God's voice and rebelled? Weren't they the same ones that came out of Egypt with Moses?
translation_verse: Nwa mɔ yeɛ bɛtele Nyameɛ dwudwolɛ, nakoso bɛyɛle ye so lɔen ne? Aso nna bɛ bɔ Mose yele bɛ fili Misraim ne amu ɔ?

english_verse: And who did God say would never enter his place of rest? Weren't they the ones that disobeyed him?
translation_verse: Nyameɛ ndaen bɔ ɔtale kyɛ, “bengowura me nwomelelɛ ne anu bie le” nen, né ɔne nwa mɔ? Aso nna bɛ bɔ bɛyɛle asoserɛ ne ɔ?

english_verse: We see that those people did not enter the place of rest because they did not have faith.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe maa yɛnwu ye kyɛ banwura nwomelelɛ ne anu, ɔnate kyɛ banne banni.

english_verse: The promise to enter the place of rest is still good, and we must take care that none of you miss out.
translation_verse: Yiti kyɛbɔ bɔhyɛ bɔ ɔfa ye nwomelelɛ nu hɔlɛ nwo tɛwɔ berɛ ye de, ɛ́mɔma yɛnea yé ná wamma ye kyɛ ɛmɔ nu biala sa anga ye.

english_verse: We have heard the message, just as they did. But they failed to believe what they heard, and the message did not do them any good.
translation_verse: Bɛhane nzɛmba ne behyirele yɛ kyɛbɔ bɛhã behyirele bɛ ne ala, nakoso ye nwo amma mvasoɛ amma bɛ; ofikyɛ bamva gyidie banzɔ edwirɛ bɔ bɛtele ne anu.

english_verse: Only people who have faith will enter the place of rest. It is just as the Scriptures say, “God became angry and told the people, ‘You will never enter my place of rest!’ ” God said this, even though everything has been ready from the time of creation.
translation_verse: Na yɛ bɔ yale yali ne yeɛ yɛwura sɔ nwomelelɛ ne anu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔhane kyɛ, “Yiti nne ɛyaa ndale ndaen kyɛ, ‘Bengowura me nwomelelɛ ne anu bie!’ ” Oyiele ye nnwumaa yɔle fi ewiase ahyɛaseɛ ne.

english_verse: In fact, somewhere the Scriptures say that by the seventh day, God had finished his work, and so he rested.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ wahã kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne nwo dwirɛ wɔ nekaa bie kyɛ, “Na kyẽa bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo nen, Nyameɛ lele ye nwome wɔ ye nnwumaa mukoraa nu.”

english_verse: We also read that he later said, “You people will never enter my place of rest!”
translation_verse: Na ɔkã sɔ dwirɛ he bieku wɔ wa kyɛ, “Bengowura me nwomelelɛ ne anu bie!”

english_verse: This means that the promise to enter is still good, because those who first heard about it disobeyed and did not enter.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ belili moa bɛtele nzɛmba ne, bannya sɔ nwomelelɛ bɔhyɛ ne, ofikyɛ bɛyɛle asoserɛ; nakoso sɔ nwomelelɛ bɔhyɛ ne tɛwɔ berɛ ma ebiemɔ.

english_verse: Much later God told David to make the promise again, just as I have already said, “If you hear his voice today, don't be stubborn!”
translation_verse: Yiti Nyameɛ asa ahyɛ kyẽa foforɛ ato berɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye “Ɛnɛ” ɔ. Na afoɛ pee asi ne, ɔfale Dawide so hane edwirɛ bɔ bali moa bahã ne kyɛ, “Ɛnɛ, sɛ ɛmɔte Nyameɛ dwudwolɛ a, nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ asoserɛ.”

english_verse: If Joshua had really given the people rest, there would not be any need for God to talk about another day of rest.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Yosua maa benyane nwomelelɛ ne a, ahaa nziɛ ye Nyameɛ wangã kyẽa foforɛ nwo dwirɛ ko.

english_verse: On that day God's people will rest from their work, just as God rested from his work.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ wawura Nyameɛ nwomelelɛ ne anu nen, ye koso wale ye nwome wɔ ye nnwumaa nwo, kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ lele ye nwome wɔ ye deɛ nwo ne.

english_verse: We should do our best to enter the place of rest, so none of us will disobey and miss going there, as they did.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛbɔ mmɔden yɛwura sɔ nwomelelɛ ne anu, amaa ɔnate so ebiala wanyɔ sɔ asoserɛ ne wamvi ase.

english_verse: God's word is alive and powerful! It is sharper than any double-edged sword. His word can cut through our spirits and souls and through our joints and marrow, until it discovers the desires and thoughts of our hearts.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne te ase na anwoserɛ wɔ nu, na ɔyɛ nna tra sɛpɔ biala. Ɔpɛ tonn kɔworo ɛkra ne sunzum b’afia, sona aporɛ so ne ye bowue nu fonyi b’afia, na ɔpɛnzɛpɛnze ahone ne adwene nu nzusuleɛ mukoraa nu.

english_verse: Nothing is hidden from God! He sees through everything, and we will have to tell him the truth. Jesus Is the Great High Priest
translation_verse: Abɔdeɛ biala mvea wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, ye bɔ odi kyɛ yɛbu ngondaa yɛkyire ye ne, nikyee biala mvea ye, na ye nye tua nningyein mukoraa. Yesu te yɛ sɔfo panyi paa

english_verse: We have a great high priest, who has gone into heaven, and he is Jesus the Son of God. This is why we must hold on to what we have said about him.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔma yɛsɔ yɛ gyidie nu serɛ, ofikyɛ yɛle ɔsɔfo panyi paa, Nyameɛ Awa Yesu bɔ wafa ewienu wahɔ nyameɛso ɔ.

english_verse: Jesus understands every weakness of ours, because he was tempted in every way that we are. But he did not sin!
translation_verse: Yɛ sɔfo panyi paa he de, ɔtte ebie bɔ ɔngora nnwu yɛ anwumvoin wɔ yɛ mmerɛyɛlɛ nu ɔ; na mmom ɔte ebie bɔ besole ye bɛneane wɔ atee biala so kyɛ yɛ ala, nakoso wanyɔ bɔne ɔ.

english_verse: So whenever we are in need, we should come bravely before the throne of our merciful God. There we will be treated with undeserved grace, and we will find help.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛsi y’ahone yɛbra adom ahennie bia ne nyunu, amaa ɔnate so wanwu yɛ anwumvoin, ná yanya adom bɔ ɔkɔboka yɛ ɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu.

english_verse: Every high priest is appointed to help others by offering gifts and sacrifices to God because of their sins.
translation_verse: Bɛye ɔsɔfo panyi paa biala befi mmenia nu maa ogyina bɛ gya nu wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu, na ɔfa ayɛyɛdeɛ ne afɔleɛ srɛ bɔnefakyɛ.

english_verse: A high priest has weaknesses of his own, and he feels sorry for foolish and sinful people.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ ye bɔbɔ ɔtɔ sii wɔ nningyein pee nu ne ati, ɔkora nwu bɛ bɔ bɛnze na bɛyɔ mvomsoɛ ne anwumvoin.

english_verse: This is why he must offer sacrifices for his own sins and for the sins of others.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate sɔ ne ati, nna mmenia bɛ bɔnefakyɛ afɔleɛ ngome yeɛ ɔbɔ ɔ; na mmom odi kyɛ ɔbɔ ye bɔbɔ ye deɛ koso.

english_verse: But no one can have the honor of being a high priest simply by wanting to be one. Only God can choose a priest, and God is the one who chose Aaron.
translation_verse: Ebiala ngora mva sɔ dibea ne ndo ye nwo so, na mmom sana Nyameɛ afrɛ ye kyɛbɔ ɔfrɛle Aarɔn nen.

english_verse: This is how it was with Christ. He became a high priest, but not just because he wanted the honor of being one. It was God who told him, “You are my Son, because today I have become your Father!”
translation_verse: Sɔ ala koso yeɛ Kristo amva sɔ dibea ne wando ye nwo so kyɛ ɔte sɔfo panyi paa ɔ, na mmom Nyameɛ bɔbɔ hã hyirele ye kyɛ, “Ɛte Mma, ɛnɛ mayɛ wɔ Baba.”

english_verse: In another place, God says, “You are a priest forever just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Na Nyameɛ asa aha ye nekaa foforɛ kyɛ, “Ɛte sɔfo afebɔɔ, kyɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛke deɛ ne ala.”

english_verse: God had the power to save Jesus from death. And while Jesus was on earth, he begged God with loud crying and tears to save him. He truly worshiped God, and God listened to his prayers.
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ né Yesu wɔ aseɛ ye aso wa nen, ɔfale esuɛ ne ye nye moen teateane nu fale ye mbaeɛ ne nikyeesrɛlɛ tole Nyameɛ bɔ ɔkora ye ye fi ewue nu ne nyunu, na ɔnate ye nyamesuro ti Nyameɛ tiele ye.

english_verse: Jesus is God's own Son, but still he had to suffer before he could learn what it really means to obey God.
translation_verse: Na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɔte Baa de, nakoso osuane sotie fili ye amaneɛnwunɛ ne anu;

english_verse: Suffering made Jesus perfect, and now he can save forever all who obey him.
translation_verse: na olili mu yiele nen, ɔɔyɛle ngoa bɔ olle ayieleɛ ti mane bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ sotie bɛma ye nemɔ amukoraa,

english_verse: This is because God chose him to be a high priest like Melchizedek. Warning against Turning Away
translation_verse: na Nyameɛ yɛle ye sɔfo panyi paa kyɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛke deɛ ne ala. Kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: Much more could be said about this subject. But it is hard to explain, and all of you are slow to understand.
translation_verse: Yɛle ɛhe nwo dwirɛ pee paa yɛkã, nakoso nu hyirehyirelɛ kɔyɛ se; ofikyɛ ɛmɔkyɛ koraa né ɛmɔate dwirɛ bo.

english_verse: By now you should have been teachers, but once again you need to be taught the simplest things about what God has said. You need milk instead of solid food.
translation_verse: Wahyɛ bɔ ahaa odi kyɛ kekesaala ye ɛmɔyɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ɔ, nakoso ɛmɔtɛhia sona bɔ ɔkɔhyɛ ye bo kosa kohyirehyire ɛmɔ Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne ɔ. Ɛmɔnhia aleɛ bɔ nu yɛ se ɔ, na mmom ɛmɔtɛhia nyɔfonesue.

english_verse: People who live on milk are like babies who don't really know what is right.
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ nyɔfonesue te ye aleɛ nen, ye nimdeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ tenenee nwo te kãa, ofikyɛ ɔte akwadaa.

english_verse: Solid food is for mature people who have been trained to know right from wrong.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ bɔ banyi ne de, aleɛ bɔ nu yɛ no yeɛ ɔfata bɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ basua banwu ye, na bɛkora benwu nzonzoleɛ bɔ ɔwɔ paa ne tɛɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: We must try to become mature and start thinking about more than just the basic things we were taught about Christ. We shouldn't need to keep talking about why we ought to turn from deeds that bring death and why we ought to have faith in God.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛyakyi Kristo nwo ngwadaa ngwadaa ngyerɛkyerɛ ne, ná yɛfa yɛ ti yɛwura mbanyi nikyeesualɛ nu. Ɔnzɛ kyɛ yɛkɔhyɛ ye bo bieku yɛpena yɔleɛ basabasa nwo adwenesakyera ne Nyameɛ nu gyidie ko;

english_verse: And we shouldn't need to keep teaching about baptisms or about the laying on of hands or about people being raised from death and the future judgment.
translation_verse: asubɔlɛ ahoroɔ nwo ngyerɛkyerɛ, asaa bɔ bɛfa begua sona so, awufoɛ ewutingyelɛ ne ndɛenbualɛ bɔ olle ayieleɛ ne.

english_verse: Let's grow up, if God is willing.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe yeɛ sɛ Nyameɛ ma ye nwo ate a, yɛkɔyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: A field is useful to farmers, if there is enough rain to make good crops grow. In fact, God will bless such a field.
translation_verse: Aseɛ bɔ ɔmeme nzue bɔ ɔtaa tɔ gua so, na ofifi aleɛ bɔ ye nwo hia ma mmenia bɔ bɛ ti yeɛ bɛyɔ so boo nen, Nyameɛ yira ye.

english_verse: But land that produces only thornbushes is worthless. It is likely to fall under God's curse, and in the end it will be set on fire.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ofifi mmowue ne ɛfone de a, ye de mvasoɛ biala nne ye so; ɔngyɛ né Nyameɛ apaye ye, na ye ayieleɛ ole kyɛ ɔfa see sɛkye ye.

english_verse: My friends, we are talking this way. But we are sure that you are doing those really good things people do when they are being saved.
translation_verse: Nakoso aliɛmaa mɔ, sɛ yɛkã sɔ po a, y’adwene si yɛ pi wɔ ɛmɔ nwo, kyɛ atee paa bɔ ɔkɔ ngoalelɛ nu yeɛ ɛmɔnate so ɔ.

english_verse: God is always fair. He will remember how you helped his people in the past and how you are still helping them. You belong to God, and he won't forget the love you have shown his people.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ de, ɔtte asisie bɔ ɔkobu ye nye kogua ɛmɔ mmɔdenbɔlɛ, ɔne ɔdɔ bɔ ɔnate ye dumaa ti ɛmɔaye ye ali bahyire anwoteefoɛ, ná ɛmɔtɛyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: We wish each of you would always be eager to show how strong and lasting your hope really is.
translation_verse: Na yɛpena kyɛ ɛmɔ nu biala kɔ so bɔ mmɔden sɔ ala kɔ ayieleɛ, amaa ɛmɔ sa ahã bɔ ɛmɔ nye la so ne.

english_verse: Then you would never be lazy. You would be following the example of those who had faith and were patient until God kept his promise to them. God's Promise Is Sure
translation_verse: Yɛnguro kyɛ ɛmɔkɔyɛ nyaanyaa, na mmom yɛkuro kyɛ ɛmɔsua bɛ bɔ bɛnate gyidie ne aboterɛ so benya Nyameɛ bɔhyɛ ne. Nyameɛ hyɛ Abraham bɔ

english_verse: No one is greater than God. So he made a promise in his own name when he said to Abraham,
translation_verse: Mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ hyɛle Abraham bɔ nen, ɔnate kyɛ ebiala nne berɛ bɔ ɔtra ye bɔbɔ bɔ ɔkɔfa ye kɔta ndaen ne ati, ɔtale ye bɔbɔ ye nwo ndaen

english_verse: “I, the Lord, will bless you with many descendants!”
translation_verse: kyɛ, “Amba, ngoyira wɔ ná mama wɔ boso ama bata pee.”

english_verse: Then after Abraham had been very patient, he was given what God had promised.
translation_verse: Abraham nyane aboterɛ nwondɛle, na ye sa hane bɔhyɛ ne.

english_verse: When anyone wants to settle an argument, they make a vow by using the name of someone or something greater than themselves.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ amba, sona fa ebie bɔ odi mu tra ye ɔ, ye dumaa yeɛ ɔta ndaen ɔ, na ndaen bɔ ɔfa foa so ne ma aporowaasulɛ biala so pɛ.

english_verse: So when God wanted to prove for certain his promise to his people could not be broken, he made a vow.
translation_verse: Yiti mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ yɛle kyɛ ɔkɔma bɛ bɔ bɔhyɛ ne te bɛ deɛ konwu ye pefee kyɛ ɔnzesã ye adwene nen, ɔfale ndaen foale so.

english_verse: God cannot tell lies! And so his promises and vows are two things that can never be changed. We have run to God for safety. Now his promises should greatly encourage us to take hold of the hope that is right in front of us.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔnate nningyein nyɔ bɔ ɔnzesã, bɔ okyire kyɛ Nyameɛ ngɔhora ngɔpɛ ngondombo ne wamaa yɛ bɔ yanwati yaafea ye nu ne yanya nguraenhyɛlɛ mmorosoɛ, na yasɔ anyelasoɛ bɔ ɔla yɛ nyunu ne anu yé.

english_verse: This hope is like a firm and steady anchor for our souls. In fact, hope reaches behind the curtain and into the most holy place.
translation_verse: Na anyelasoɛ he te sɛkyɛ bɔ otira yɛ kra nu ɔ; ɔnde, na ɔkɔworo ɛtena bɔ onwi nyameɛso Asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu kɔ Krongron nu Krongron ne anu.

english_verse: Jesus has gone there ahead of us, and he is our high priest forever, just like Melchizedek.
translation_verse: Berɛ yeɛ Yesu ali moa ahɔ ama yɛ ɔ, na waayɛ ɔsɔfo panyi paa afebɔɔ kyɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛke deɛ ne ala.

english_verse: Melchizedek was both king of Salem and priest of God Most High. He was the one who went out and gave Abraham his blessing, when Abraham returned from killing the kings.
translation_verse: Sɔ Mɛlkisɛdɛke ne, ɔte Salem hene, na osa te Anwuro Anwuro Nyameɛ ne ye sɔfo. Mmerɛ bɔ Abraham fi koɛ bɔ oohuhuni ɛhene biemɔ na osa ba nen, Mɛlkisɛdɛke ooyiale ye, na oyirale ye;

english_verse: Then Abraham gave him a tenth of everything he had. The meaning of the name Melchizedek is “King of Justice.” But since Salem means “peace,” he is also “King of Peace.”
translation_verse: na Abraham buli ye nningyein mukoraa nu buru tuli ko mane ye. Sɔ Mɛlkisɛdɛke he dumaa ne bo kyire “Tenenee hene,” yeɛ ɔnate kyɛ ɔte Salem hene ne ati, ye bo sa kyire “asomdwee hene.”

english_verse: We are not told he had a father or mother or ancestors or beginning or end. He is like the Son of God and will be a priest forever.
translation_verse: Olle niɛ, olle seɛ, olle abusua biala, ye ngyẽa olle ahyɛaseɛ, yeɛ ye ngoa koso olle ayieleɛ. Ɔte kyɛ Nyameɛ Awa ne, na ɔte sɔfo afebɔɔ. Mɛlkisɛdɛke tra Abraham

english_verse: Notice how great Melchizedek was! Our famous ancestor Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had taken from his enemies.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea kyɛbɔ ye sona titire si te ɔ! Abraham bɔ ɔte yɛ nana ne po, koɛ nu nzesadeɛ bɔ onyane ye ne, ɔmane ye buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko.

english_verse: The Law teaches that even Abraham's descendants must give a tenth of what they possess. And they are to give this to their own relatives, who are the descendants of Levi and are priests.
translation_verse: Né Lewi abusua bɔ betira asɔfo dwumadie ne anu ne, bele ahyɛdeɛ wɔ mmeraa ne anu kyɛ béle buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko befi b’eliɛma mɔ Yisraelfoɛ berɛ, wɔ aberɛ bɔ bɛ koso bɛte Abraham bosofoɛ kyɛ bɛ ala ɔ.

english_verse: Although Melchizedek wasn't a descendant of Levi, Abraham gave him a tenth of what he had. Then Melchizedek blessed Abraham, who had been given God's promise.
translation_verse: Na biaa bɔ ye abusua ɔtte bɛ deɛ ne bie ne, olele buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko fili Abraham berɛ, na osa yirale bɔ né bɔhyɛ ne te ye deɛ ne.

english_verse: Everyone agrees a person who gives a blessing is greater than the one who receives the blessing.
translation_verse: Na aporowaa biala nne ye nwo kyɛ bɔ odi mu ne yeɛ oyira bɔ ɔte kãa ɔ.

english_verse: Priests are given a tenth of what people earn. But all priests die, except Melchizedek, and the Scriptures teach that he is alive.
translation_verse: Na ɛwa, mmenia bɔ bewu ɔ yeɛ bede buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne ɔ; nakoso dɔ de, bɔ bedi ye nwo adanzeɛ kyɛ ɔte ase ne yeɛ ode ɔ.

english_verse: Levi's descendants are now the ones who receive a tenth from people. We could even say that when Abraham gave Melchizedek a tenth, Levi also gave him a tenth.
translation_verse: Na yɛkɔhora yɛkɔhã kyɛ, Lewi bɔbɔ po bɔ ode buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne, ye koso ɔfale Abraham so tuale buru nu ngyɛmuɛ ko ne bie;

english_verse: This is because Levi was born later into the family of Abraham, who gave a tenth to Melchizedek.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ, né bennya bɛwwole ye de, nakoso né ɔwɔ ye nana Abraham mogya nu wɔ mmerɛ bɔ Mɛlkisɛdɛke yiale Abraham ne.

english_verse: Even though the Law of Moses says the priests must be descendants of Levi, those priests cannot make anyone perfect. So there needs to be a priest like Melchizedek, rather than one from the priestly family of Aaron.
translation_verse: Ɔnate Lewi abusua kure asɔfo dwumadie ne aso yeɛ maen ne nyane mmeraa ne ɔ. Na sɛ bɛ dwumadie bɔ ɔte kyɛ Aarɔn deɛ ne lili mu a, ahaa bɛ nu bie yeɛ bɛyele ye maa ɔyɛle sɔfo ɔ. Nzaade ahaa ye nwo nhia kyɛ ɔsɔfo foforɛ bieku kɔɔyɛ kyɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛke deɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: And when the rules for selecting a priest are changed, the Law must also be changed.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, sɛ bɛsesã asɔfolilɛ nwo nhyehyɛleɛ ne a, né ohia kyɛ bɛsesa mmeraa ne koso.

english_verse: The person we are talking about is our Lord, who came from a tribe that had never had anyone to serve as a priest at the altar.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ sɔ dwirɛ he fa ye nwo ne, ofi abusua kure foforɛ nu, yeɛ ye abusuaniɛ biala koso ɔyyɔle afɔleɛ bokyea nwo adwuma le.

english_verse: Everyone knows he came from the tribe of Judah, and Moses never said priests would come from that tribe.
translation_verse: Na ebiala se ye pefee kyɛ y’Awurade fi Yuda abusua nu; yeɛ Mose koso ammɔ sɔ abusua kure he dumaa wammata sɔfolilɛ nwo. Mɛlkisɛdɛke sɛso sɔfo

english_verse: All of this becomes clearer, when someone who is like Melchizedek is appointed to be a priest.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔma edwirɛ ne nye la berɛ pefee ole kyɛ, ɔsɔfo foforɛ adwɔso bɔ ye sɛso te kyɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛke ɔ.

english_verse: That person wasn't appointed because of his ancestors, but because his life can never end.
translation_verse: Nna kuro sona abusua nu nhyehyɛleɛ ne ye mmeraa so yeɛ bɛfa bɛyele ye ɔ; na mmom ɔnate ngoa bɔ ye bo ngɔpɛ le tumi so yeɛ ɔyɛle sɔfo ɔ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say about him, “You are a priest forever, just like Melchizedek.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ odi ye nwo adanzeɛ kyɛ, “Ɛte sɔfo afebɔɔ, kyɛ Mɛlkisɛdɛke deɛ ne ala.”

english_verse: In this way a weak and useless command was put aside,
translation_verse: Atee ko aso de, batu daa nhyehyɛleɛ ne bagua; ɔtɔ sii, yeɛ mvasoɛ koso nne so

english_verse: because the Law cannot make anything perfect. At the same time, we are given a much better hope, and it can bring us close to God.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ mmeraa ne amma nikyee biala anni mu. Nakoso atee foforɛ so de, anyelasoɛ bɔ ɔte paa tra daa deɛ ne wɔ berɛ, bɔ yɛfa so yɛpingye Nyameɛ ɔ.

english_verse: This means that Jesus guarantees us a better agreement with God.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ma Yesu di apam bɔ odi mu tra so ɔ nu agyinamuɛ. Kristo te sɔfo afebɔɔ

english_verse: There have been a lot of other priests, and all of them have died.
translation_verse: Asa koso, né asɔfo nemɔ sone, ofikyɛ ewue amma bɛ ate amma bandoa b’adwuma so;

english_verse: But Jesus will never die, and so he will be a priest forever!
translation_verse: nakoso ɔnate kyɛ Yesu te ase afebɔɔ ne ati, ye sɔfolilɛ dwumadie ne koso wɔ berɛ afebɔɔ.

english_verse: He is forever able to save the people he leads to God, because he always lives to speak to God for them.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔkora de bɛ bɔ bɛfa ye so bɛba Nyameɛ berɛ ne ngoa bɔkɔɔ; ofikyɛ ɔte ase afebɔɔ, na odi bɛ ti dwirɛ ma bɛ.

english_verse: Jesus is the high priest we need. He is holy and innocent and faultless, and not at all like us sinners. Jesus is honored above all beings in heaven,
translation_verse: Yiti ɔsɔfo panyi paa bɔ ɔte sɔa yeɛ ɔfata kyɛ yɛnya ɔ. Ɔte krongron, mvomsoɛ anaa bɔne biala nne ye nwo, baye ye basie ahameɛ bafi bɔnefoɛ nu, na babɔ ye panyi paa wɔ nyameɛso.

english_verse: and he is better than any other high priest. Jesus doesn't need to offer sacrifices each day for his own sins and then for the sins of the people. He offered a sacrifice once for all, when he gave himself.
translation_verse: Ye de, ɔtte kyɛ asɔfo mbanyi paa hene mɔ, onhia kyɛ ɛlɛho biala odi moa bɔ ye bɔbɔ ye bɔne nwo afɔleɛ koraka na wabɔ maen deɛ, na mmom ɔfale ye nwo bɔle afɔleɛ pɛnko.

english_verse: The Law appoints priests who have weaknesses. But God's promise, which came later than the Law, appoints his Son. And he is the perfect high priest forever.
translation_verse: Mmeraa ne de, ɔyɛ mmenia bɔ mvomsoɛ wɔ bɛ nwo asɔfo mbanyi paa, nakoso Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ bɔ ndaen la so, bɔ mmeraa ne asi yeɛ ɔwale ne de, ɔyɛ Baa bɔ odi mu bɔkɔɔ ne ɔsɔfo panyi paa afebɔɔ.

english_verse: What I mean is we have a high priest who sits at the right side of God's great throne in heaven.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ bɔ yɛkã ne, porɛ bɔ ogyi so paa ɛhe: ɔsɔfo panyi paa sɔaa yeɛ yɛle ye ɔ, na ɔte Tuminiɛ n’ahennie bia ne famaa so wɔ nyameɛso.

english_verse: He also serves as the priest in the most holy place inside the real tent there in heaven. This tent of worship was set up by the Lord, not by humans.
translation_verse: Na odi ye sɔfo ne wɔ nekaa krongron ne anu, ɔne ɛtena sua kaenn bɔ nna dasaniɛ, na mmom Awurade yeɛ osili ɔ nu.

english_verse: Since all priests must offer gifts and sacrifices, Christ also needed to have something to offer.
translation_verse: Bɛye ɔsɔfo panyi paa biala kyɛ ɔfa ayɛyɛdeɛ ne afɔlebɔdeɛ ma Nyameɛ; na ye sɔ ne ati, ohia kyɛ ɔsɔfo panyi paa he koso nya nikyee fa bɔ afɔleɛ.

english_verse: If he were here on earth, he would not be a priest at all, because here the Law appoints other priests to offer sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔwɔ aseɛ ye aso a, ahaa ɔngɔyɛ sɔfo po, ofikyɛ asɔfo mɔ wɔ berɛ bɔ begyina mmeraa ne aso bɛfa ayɛyɛdeɛ bɛma ɔ.

english_verse: But the tent where they serve is just a copy and a shadow of the real one in heaven. Before Moses made the tent, he was told, “Be sure to make it exactly like the pattern you were shown on the mountain!”
translation_verse: Na bɛ dwumadie ne, ɔte nyameɛso deɛ ne nwo nhwɛsoɛ, ɔne wawoɛ; ofikyɛ anzana Nyameɛ baama Mose si ɛtena sua nen, osele ye kyɛ, “Nea kyɛ ɛkɔyɔ nikyee biala maa ye sɛso kɔyɛ kyɛ bɔ mva ngyirele wɔ wɔ bokaa ne aso nen pɛpɛɛpɛ.”

english_verse: Now Christ has been appointed to serve as a priest in a much better way, and he has given us much assurance of a better agreement.
translation_verse: Nakoso kekesaala ye de, Kristo sa ahã sɔfodwuma bɔ odi mu bɔkɔɔ tra bɛ deɛ ne, ofikyɛ apam bɔ odi mu, na afei ogyi bɔhyɛ bɔ odi mu so yeɛ ɔte nu ndamgyinaniɛ ɔ. Apam foforɛ nwo bɔhyɛ

english_verse: If the first agreement with God had been all right, there would not have been any need for another one.
translation_verse: Na sɛ apam bɔ oli moa ne ɔndɔ sii a, ahaa né ye nwo nhia kyɛ yɛkonya apam bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ɔ.

english_verse: But the Lord found fault with it and said, “I tell you the time will come, when I will make a new agreement with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ nwuni mvomsoɛ wɔ ye mmenia nwo, yiti ɔhane kyɛ, “Tie, mmerɛ bie kɔwa, bɔ me ne Yisrael awuro ama ne Yuda awuro ama yɛkɔhyehyɛ apam foforɛ ɔ, Awurade noa dwirɛ ɛne;

english_verse: It won't be like the agreement that I made with their ancestors, when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke their agreement with me, and I stopped caring about them!
translation_verse: na ɔngɔyɛ kyɛ apam bɔ me ne bɛ nana mɔ hyehyɛle wɔ kyẽa bɔ nzɔle bɛ sa nyele bɛ mvili Misraim aseɛ so ne; ɔnate kyɛ bangɔso banni m’apam ne aso, na me koso nyele me nye mvili bɛ so, Awurade noa dwirɛ ɛne.

english_verse: “But now I tell the people of Israel this is my new agreement: ‘The time will come when I, the Lord, will write my laws on their minds and hearts. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Na sɔ ngyẽa ne asi ne, apam bɔ me ne Yisrael awuro ama yɛkɔhyehyɛ hɔ ɛhe, Awurade noa dwirɛ ɛne: Ngɔfa me mmeraa ngowura b’adwene nu, na mahyerɛ ye wɔ b’ahone nu, ngɔyɛ bɛ Nyameɛ, na bɛ wora bayɛ me mmenia.

english_verse: Not one of them will have to teach another to know me, their Lord.’ “All of them will know me, no matter who they are.
translation_verse: Na bɛ nu biala ngohyirehyire obiɛngo, anaa ɔngɔhã ngohyire oliɛma kyɛ ‘Nwu Awurade,’ ofikyɛ bɛ mukoraa, fite ngwadaa so kodwu mbanyi so bekonwu me.

english_verse: I will treat them with kindness, even though they are wicked. I will forget their sins.”
translation_verse: Ngonwu b’amumuyɛɛ nwo anwumvoin, na mengɔkaye bɛ bɔne ne bɛ mvomsoɛ ko.”

english_verse: When the Lord talks about a new agreement, he means that the first one is out of date. And anything that is old and useless will soon disappear.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Nyameɛ kã kyɛ “Apam foforɛ” a, né obu bɔ oli moa ne kyɛ wayɛ daa; yeɛ nikyee biala bɔ ye mmerɛ ogu so ɔpɛ nu ná ɔyɛ daa nen, ɔngyɛ né watu wamini.

english_verse: The first promise included rules for worship and a tent for worship here on earth.
translation_verse: Na afei, né apam bɔ oli moa ne le ɛsɔnenɛ nwo nhyehyɛleɛ, ɔne aseɛ he aso nekaa krongron bɔ bɛsɔne ɔ.

english_verse: The first part of the tent was called the holy place, and a lampstand, a table, and the sacred loaves of bread were kept there.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, besili ɛtena sua; bɔ bedi moa befite so ne bɛfrɛ ye Nekaa Krongron. Né kanea bakaa, ɛpoen ne paanoo krongron wɔ sɔ pumbu ne anu.

english_verse: The gold altar for burning incense was in this holy place. The gold-covered sacred chest was also there, and inside it were three things. First, there was a gold jar filled with manna. Then there was Aaron's walking stick that sprouted. Finally, there were the flat stones with the Ten Commandments written on them.
translation_verse: Né sɔ nningyein hemɔ wɔ nu: esikaa kɔkorɛ afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ bɛyera ɛyɛɛ so, apam alaka bɔ bafa sikaa kɔkorɛ baboro ye nwo amu ɔ, sikaa kɔkorɛ kutusi bɔ mana wɔ nu ɔ, Aarɔn pɔmaa bɔ ɔfefɛle ne, ɔne nyɔboɛ nyɔ bɔ bahyerɛ apam ne bagua so ne.

english_verse: On top of the chest were the glorious creatures with wings opened out above the place of mercy. Now isn't the time to go into detail about these things.
translation_verse: Né animnyam kɛrubim mɔ batrɛtrɛ bɛ ndaa nu wɔ mbata bia ne aso wɔ alaka ne aso. Nakoso kekesaala ye de, yɛngɔhora yɛngɔhã sɔ nningyein hemɔ nwo dwirɛ ngoko ngoko.

english_verse: But this is how everything was when the priests went each day into the first part of the tent to do their duties.
translation_verse: Kyɛ bahyehyɛ berɛ nningyein hɔ ɛne, na asɔfo nemɔ kɔ ɛtena sua bɔ oli moa ne anu ɛlɛho biala bɛkɔyɔ b’adwuma.

english_verse: However, only the high priest could go into the second part of the tent, and he went in only once a year. Each time he carried blood to offer for his sins and for any sins that the people had committed without meaning to.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne anu de, ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne ngome yeɛ afoɛnoa biala ɔkɔ berɛ komapɛ twe ɔ; na ɔfa kaka mogya kɔbɔ ye bɔbɔ, ɔne maen ne amu bɛ bɔne nwo afɔleɛ.

english_verse: All of this is the Holy Spirit's way of saying no one could enter the most holy place while the tent was still the place of worship.
translation_verse: Na Sunzum Krongron kyire nu pefee kyɛ, mmerɛ bɔ né ɛtena sua ne tɛwɔ berɛ ne de, né bennya bebbukyele atee bɔ bɛfa so bɛkɔ krongron nu krongron ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: This also has a meaning for today. It shows we cannot make our consciences clear by offering gifts and sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe te mvandoho ma ɛnɛ mmerɛ ye, bɔ mmenia fa ayɛyɛdeɛ ne afɔleɛ bɛma, nakoso ɔngora mma sona bɔ ɔsɔne Nyameɛ ne tiboa mmua ye be.

english_verse: These rules are merely about such things as eating and drinking and ceremonies for washing ourselves. And rules about physical things will last only until the time comes to change them for something better.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔfa aleɛ, anonneɛ, ɔne bɛ nwo petenɛ ahoroɔ ngome nwo; na ɛhemɔ te anwoɔnaen nu nziesie bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ kodwu mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ kɔhyehyɛ nikyee biala foforɛ ɔ. Kristo afɔleɛ ne di mu

english_verse: Christ came as the high priest of the good things that are now here. He also went into a much better tent that wasn't made by humans and that doesn't belong to this world.
translation_verse: Nakoso Kristo de, wawa kyɛ nningyein paa bɔ ɔbaawa ne nwo sɔfo panyi paa, na wafa ɛtena sua bɔ ɔte titire na odi mu tra so ɔ nu. Ɛhe de, nna kuro sona yeɛ osili ɔ, yeɛ ɔbboka ewiase abɔdeɛ so koso,

english_verse: Then Christ went once for all into the most holy place and freed us from sin forever. He did this by offering his own blood instead of the blood of goats and bulls.
translation_verse: na wawura Krongron nu Krongron ne anu berɛ komapɛ. Wamva mbɔngye ne nandwie mmaa mogya yeɛ ɔɔbɔle afɔleɛ ɔ, na mmom ye bɔbɔ ye mogya yeɛ ɔfa bɔle afɔleɛ nyane daa ngoa mane yɛ ɔ.

english_verse: According to the Law of Moses, those people who become unclean are not fit to worship God. Yet they will be considered clean, if they are sprinkled with the blood of goats and bulls and with the ashes of a sacrificed calf.
translation_verse: Na sɛ nandwie nyii mogya ne mbɔngye mogya ne nandwie ba nzoen bɔ bɛfa bɛpete mmenia bɔ efiɛ aha bɛ nwo ne, ɔkora ma bɛ nwo te anwoɔnaen nu de a,

english_verse: But Christ was sinless, and he offered himself as an eternal and spiritual sacrifice to God. This is why his blood is much more powerful and makes our consciences clear. Now we can serve the living God and no longer do things that lead to death.
translation_verse: nzaade Kristo bɔ ɔnate Sunzum bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ ne aso fale ye nwo bɔle afɔleɛ bɔ ngekalewa biala nne ye nwo mane Nyameɛ nen, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ ye mogya ngɔte yɛ tiboa nwo ngofi yɔleɛ mbaen mbaen nwo ma yɛngɔso Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne ɔ? Kristo te yɛ ndamgyinaniɛ

english_verse: Christ died to rescue those who had sinned and broken the old agreement. Now he brings his chosen ones a new agreement with its guarantee of God's eternal blessings!
translation_verse: Ye sɔ ne ati, Yesu te apam foforɛ ne anu ndamgyinaniɛ. Ɔnate kyɛ, ɔfale ye wue bɔ owuli ne yele adasa fili bɛ bɔne bɔ bɛyɔle ye wɔ apam bɔ oli moa ne anu; amaa bɛ bɔ Nyameɛ afrɛ bɛ ne banya agyapadeɛ afebɔɔ bɔhyɛ ne.

english_verse: In fact, making an agreement of this kind is like writing a will. This is because the one who makes the will must die before it is of any use.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie yɔ nzamanzeɛ a, sana benwu ye pefee kyɛ sona bɔ ɔyɔle ne wawu;

english_verse: In other words, a will doesn't go into effect as long as the one who made it is still alive.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ sɛ sona bɔ ɔyɔle sɔ nzamanzeɛ ne tɛte ase de a, ye de nzamanzeɛ ne nyɔ adwuma, sana owu koraka.

english_verse: Blood was also used to put the first agreement into effect.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate ɛhe ati yeɛ apam bɔ oli moa ne po anyɛ adwuma kɔpem kyɛ bɛfale mogya bɛbɔle ye atenaseɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Moses told the people all the Law said they must do. Then he used red wool and a hyssop plant to sprinkle the people and the book of the Law with the blood of bulls and goats and with water.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, mmerɛ bɔ Mose kengale ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔwɔ mmeraa ne anu hyirele maen ne amukoraa yiele nen, ɔfale nandwie mmaa ne mbɔngye mogya frale nzue, na ɔfale sufiɛ ne adaabene bɔle nu fa petene mmeraa nwomaa ne, ɔne mmenia ne amukoraa bɛ so.

english_verse: He told the people, “With this blood God makes his agreement with you.”
translation_verse: Na ɔhane kyɛ, “Ɛhe te mogya bɔ osi apam bɔ Nyameɛ ahyehyɛ ama ɛmɔ ne agyinayɛɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: Moses also sprinkled blood on the tent and on everything else used in worship.
translation_verse: Sɔ ala koso yeɛ ɔfale mogya ne petene ɛtena sua ne, ɔne nningyein mukoraa bɔ bɛfa bɛsɔne Nyameɛ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: The Law says that almost everything must be sprinkled with blood, and no sins can be forgiven unless blood is offered. Christ's Great Sacrifice
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ mmeraa ne kyire ne, ɔpena yɛ kyɛ mogya yeɛ bɛfa bɛte nningyein amukoraa nwo ɔ, na sɛ mogya angua a, bɔnefakyɛ nne berɛ. Kristo afɔleɛ ne kyikyi bɔne biala

english_verse: These things are only copies of what is in heaven, and so they had to be made holy by these ceremonies. But the real things in heaven must be made holy by something better.
translation_verse: Nzaade, nningyein bɔ bɛte nyameɛso deɛ ne nwo nhwɛsoɛ ne, né ohia kyɛ bɛte bɛ nwo wɔ atee sɔa so; nakoso nyameɛso deɛ nemɔ de, afɔleɛ bɔ odi mu tra so yeɛ bɛfa bɛte bɛ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: This is why Christ did not go into a tent made by humans and was only a copy of the real one. Instead, he went into heaven and is now there with God to help us.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, Kristo anwura nekaa krongron bɔ kuro sona sili, ná osa te nyameɛso deɛ paa ne nwo nhwɛsoɛ ne anu; na mmom wahɔ nyameɛso berɛ deinn, na kekesaala ye odi yɛ ti dwirɛ ma yɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: Christ did not have to offer himself many times. He wasn't like a high priest who goes into the most holy place each year to offer the blood of an animal.
translation_verse: Nakoso Kristo de, wangɔ berɛ kyɛ ɔkwaafa ye nwo bɔ afɔleɛ mmerɛ pee, kyɛbɔ ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne de afoɛnoa biala ɔfa mogya bɔ nna ye deɛ ahɔ ɔkɔ Krongron nu Krongron ne anu nen.

english_verse: If he had offered himself every year, he would have suffered many times since the creation of the world. But instead, near the end of time he offered himself once and for all, so he could be a sacrifice that does away with sin.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔtte sɔ de a, ahaa ɔsɛ kyɛ Kristo taa nwu amaneɛ fite kyɛ Ɛdangama bɔle aleɛ ɔ. Nakoso waye ye nwo ali komapɛ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ewiase kɔ ye ayieleɛ ye, na wafa ye bɔbɔ ye nwo wabɔ afɔleɛ wakyikyi bɔne.

english_verse: We die only once, and then we are judged.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ kuro sona wu komapɛ twe na ye si ye Nyameɛ bua ye ndɛen nen,

english_verse: So Christ died only once to take away the sins of many people. But when he comes again, it will not be to take away sin. He will come to save everyone who is waiting for him.
translation_verse: sɔ ala yeɛ Kristo bɔ bɛfale ye bɛbɔle afɔleɛ komapɛ kyɛ ɔsoa mmeni pee bɛ bɔne ne, okosa kɔwa ye pɛen so ɔ; ɔmmangyikyi bɔne, na mmom ɔbaale bɛ bɔ bɛ́nea ye ate nemɔ ngoa.

english_verse: The Law of Moses is like a shadow of the good things to come. This shadow isn't the good things themselves, because it cannot free people from sin by the sacrifices offered year after year.
translation_verse: Mmeraa ne de, ole nningyein paa bɔ bɛbaawa ne wawoɛ, na nna bɛ bɔbɔ deinn ɔ. Yiti ɔngora mma bɛ bɔ bɛsɔne Nyameɛ ne, bɛmva afoɛnoa afoɛnoa afɔleɛbɔlɛ ne aso benni mu.

english_verse: If there were worshipers who already have their sins washed away and their consciences made clear, there would not be any need to go on offering sacrifices.
translation_verse: Na sɛ afɔleɛ ne te mmenia bɔ bɛsɔne Nyameɛ nwo pɛnko de a, ahaa bɛ tiboa mmua bɛ foɛ ko kyɛ bedi bɔne nwo fɔ; afei koso ahaa afɔleɛbɔlɛ ne amukoraa bo apɛ.

english_verse: When Christ came into the world, he said to God, “Sacrifices and offerings are not what you want, but you have given me my body.
translation_verse: Yiti mmerɛ bɔ Kristo wale wiase nen, osele kyɛ, “Anguro afɔleɛ ne ayɛyɛdeɛ, na mmom asiesie nipadua ama me.

english_verse: No, you are not pleased with animal sacrifices and offerings for sin.”
translation_verse: Wɔ nye angye naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ ne bɔne nwo afɔleɛ nwo.

english_verse: Then Christ said, “And so, my God, I have come to do what you want, as the Scriptures say.”
translation_verse: Na afei ngane kyɛ, ‘O Nyameɛ, mawa kyɛ mebaayɔ w’apɛdeɛ, kyɛbɔ bahyerɛ bafa me nwo wɔ mmeraa nwomaa ne anu nen.’ ”

english_verse: The Law teaches that offerings and sacrifices must be made because of sin. But why did Christ mention these things and say that God did not want them?
translation_verse: Olili moa hane kyɛ, “Anguro, yeɛ afei koso wɔ nye angye afɔleɛ, anaa ayɛyɛdeɛ, anaa naen yeralɛ afɔleɛ, anaa bɔne nwo afɔleɛ nwo.” Nakoso mmeraa ne kyire kyɛ bɛyɔ sɔ.

english_verse: Well, it was to do away with offerings and sacrifices and to replace them. This is what he meant by saying to God, “I have come to do what you want.”
translation_verse: Na osa hane kyɛ, “O Nyameɛ, mawa kyɛ mebaayɔ w’apɛdeɛ.” Yiti Nyameɛ apɛ bɔ oli moa ne anu wafa bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne wasi ye gya nu.

english_verse: So we are made holy because Christ obeyed God and offered himself once for all.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate apɛdeɛ he aso bafa Yesu Kristo nipadua afɔleɛ ne aso bate yɛ nwo pɛnko.

english_verse: The priests do their work each day, and they keep on offering sacrifices that can never take away sins.
translation_verse: Ɔsɔfo biala gyina ndende daa biala yɔ ye sɔfodwuma ne, na afɔleɛ ko ne ala bɔ ɔbɔ ye daa daa ne ngora ngyikyi bɔne.

english_verse: But Christ offered himself as a sacrifice that is good forever. Now he is sitting at God's right side,
translation_verse: Nakoso Yesu de, ɔbɔle bɔne nwo afɔleɛ komapɛ twe bɔ odi mu afebɔɔ yiele nen, ɔtenane Nyameɛ sa famaa so,

english_verse: and he will stay there until his enemies are put under his power.
translation_verse: na ofi sɔ mmerɛ ne, ɔnwondɛ kyɛ Nyameɛ kɔfa ye pɔfoɛ mɔ kɔyɛ ye gya bo ndiasoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: By his one sacrifice he has forever set free from sin the people he brings to God.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔnate afɔleɛ komapɛ bɔ ɔbɔle ne aso wama bɛ bɔ Nyameɛ te bɛ nwo ne ali mu afebɔɔ.

english_verse: The Holy Spirit also speaks of this by telling us that the Lord said,
translation_verse: Na Sunzum Krongron ne koso di adanzeɛ kyire yɛ, ofikyɛ olili moa hane kyɛ,

english_verse: “When the time comes, I will make an agreement with them. I will write my laws on their minds and hearts.
translation_verse: “Awurade nwa nyoo: Sɛ sɔ ngyẽa ne pɛ nu a, apam bɔ me ne bɛ kɔhyehyɛ hɔ ɛhe: Ngɔfa me mmeraa ngowura b’ahone nu, na mahyerɛ ye wɔ b’adwene nu.”

english_verse: Then I will forget about their sins and no longer remember their evil deeds.”
translation_verse: Na osa hane kyɛ, “Mengɔkaye bɛ bɔne ne b’amumuyɛɛ ko.”

english_verse: When sins are forgiven, there is no more need to offer sacrifices. Encouragement and Warning
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ bafa ɛhemɔ bahyɛ de a, nzaade bɔnefakyɛ afɔleɛ nne berɛ ko. Twe pingye Nyameɛ

english_verse: My friends, the blood of Jesus gives us courage to enter the most holy place
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɔnate kyɛ yanya nguraenhyɛlɛ kyɛ ɔnate Yesu mogya ne ati yɛkora yɛkɔ nekaa krongron ne anu berɛ;

english_verse: by a new way that leads to life! And this way takes us through the curtain that is Christ himself.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ wafa ɛtena bɔ onwi pumbu n’anoa nu, bɔ ɔte ye nwonaen ne aso wabukye ngoa atee foforɛ wama yɛ,

english_verse: We have a great high priest who is in charge of God's house.
translation_verse: ná asa koso yɛle ɔsɔfo panyi paa bɔ ɔnea Nyameɛ awuro ne aso ɔ ne ati,

english_verse: So let's come near God with pure hearts and a confidence that comes from having faith. Let's keep our hearts pure, our consciences free from evil, and our bodies washed with clean water.
translation_verse: yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛfa nahorɛ ahone ne gyidie bɔ osi pi, ɔne ahone bɔ bate ye nwo bafi bɔne tiboa nu, ɔne nipadua bɔ bafa nzue gyengɔgyengɔ babia ye ɔ yɛhwe yɛpingye Nyameɛ.

english_verse: We must hold tightly to the hope we say is ours. After all, we can trust the one who made the agreement with us.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma yɛsɔ anyelasoɛ dwirɛ bɔ yɛgyi so ne anu serɛ, ofikyɛ bɔ ɔhyɛle bɔ ne, odi nahorɛ.

english_verse: We should keep on encouraging each other to be thoughtful and to do helpful things.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma yɛpena atee bɔ yɛkɔfa so yɛkɔbokaboka yɛ nwo bɔ ɔkɔmaa yɛkohyire ɔdɔ ná yayɔ nnwumaa paa ɔ.

english_verse: Some people have given up the habit of meeting for worship, but we must not do that. We should keep on encouraging each other, especially since you know that the day of the Lord's coming is getting closer.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma yɛyakyi yɛ nwo yɛ nwo nyianuyɛlɛ, kyɛbɔ ebiemɔ de bayakyi ye yɔlɛ nen; na mmom ɛ́mɔma yɛhɔ so yɛtutu yɛ nwo yɛ nwo foɛ, nganga kekesaala ye bɔ ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ Kyẽa ne apingye ye. Bɛnnwati Nyameɛ bo

english_verse: No sacrifices can be made for people who decide to sin after they find out about the truth.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛnya yɛnya nahorɛ ne nwo nimdeɛ, na ye si ye yɛ nye la ye nwo yɛkɔ so yɛyɔ bɔne de a, ye de bɔnefakyɛ afɔleɛ biala nne berɛ ko;

english_verse: They are God's enemies, and all they can look forward to is a terrible judgment and a furious fire.
translation_verse: na mmom bɔ waha ala ole kyɛ yɛkɔnwondɛ ndɛenbualɛ bɔ ɔyɛ suro ne, ɔne see bɔ ɔbaayera Nyameɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ ne.

english_verse: If two or more witnesses accused someone of breaking the Law of Moses, that person could be put to death.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie to Mose mmeraa ne ná mmenia nyɔ anaa nza di adanzeɛ tia ye a, bɛfa anwumvoin bɛto ahameɛ beku ye.

english_verse: But it is much worse to dishonor God's Son and to disgrace the blood of the promise that made us holy. And it is just as bad to insult the Holy Spirit, who shows us mercy.
translation_verse: Sɛ ɔte sɔ de a, nzaade sona bɔ okobu Nyameɛ Awa ne animtia, ná wabu apam mogya bɔ bafa bate ye nwo ne kyɛ ye nwo nde, ná wafa adom Sunzum ne nyunu watwitwi ase ne, nzikyɛ asohwenɛ yeɛ ɛmɔsusu kyɛ ɔfata ye ɔ?

english_verse: We know that God has said he will punish and take revenge. We also know that the Scriptures say the Lord will judge his people.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, yɛse bɔ ɔhane kyɛ, “Wereɛtɔlɛ te me deɛ, na ngotua so kerɛ;” na ye ala yeɛ osa hane kyɛ, “Awurade kobua ye mmenia ndɛen.”

english_verse: It is a terrible thing to fall into the hands of the living God!
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛ suro kyɛ ɛkɔma Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne sa kɔsɔ wɔ nu ɔ!

english_verse: Don't forget all the hard times you went through when you first received the light.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔkaye mmerɛ bie bɔ wapɛ nu ɔ, bɔ ɛmɔɔyɛle agyidifoɛ nen, ɛmɔmiane bɛ nye bɛfale amaneɛ pee nu ne.

english_verse: Sometimes you were abused and mistreated in public, and at other times you shared in the sufferings of others.
translation_verse: Né ɔtɔ mmerɛ bie a, begua ɛmɔ nyunu ase na bɛhyɛ ɛmɔ anyeborolɛ wɔ badwa nu; né ɔtɔ mmerɛ bie koso a, ɛmɔfa bɛ bɔ benwu amaneɛ bɛyɛ bɛ mmango.

english_verse: You were kind to people in jail. And you gladly let your possessions be taken away, because you knew you had something better, something that would last forever.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔnwuni bɛ bɔ begua kuku nu anwumvoin, na mmerɛ bɔ bɛfene ɛmɔ nningyein bɛfale ne, ɛmɔle anigye bɛpenene so, ofikyɛ ɛmɔse kyɛ ɛmɔle nningyein paa bɔ ɔtra so wɔ nyameɛso afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Keep on being brave! It will bring you great rewards.
translation_verse: Yiti nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ abasanu bu, ofikyɛ ye nwo akatuaa piri bie wɔ berɛ.

english_verse: Learn to be patient, so you will please God and be given what he has promised.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ɛmɔmia ɛmɔ nye, amaa ɛmɔahora bayɔ Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ ná ɛmɔ sa ahã ye bɔhyɛ ne.

english_verse: As the Scriptures say, “God is coming soon! It won't be very long.
translation_verse: “Ofikyɛ waha kãa bie, né bɔ ɔ́ba ne wawa; na ɔngɔhyɛ biala.

english_verse: The people God accepts will live because of their faith. But he isn't pleased with anyone who turns back.”
translation_verse: Na teneneeniɛ de, ɔnate ye gyidie so yeɛ okonya ngoa ɔ; nakoso sɛ osa ye si de a, me kra nye ngɔgye ye nwo.”

english_verse: We are not like those people who turn back and get destroyed. We will keep on having faith until we are saved.
translation_verse: Nakoso yɛ de, yɛbboka mmenia bɔ besa bɛ si bɛkɔ sɛkyelɛ nu ne aso; na mmom yɛboka bɛ bɔ bede bedi ná bɛ kra nya daa ngoa ne aso.

english_verse: Faith makes us sure of what we hope for and gives us proof of what we cannot see.
translation_verse: Gyidie te nikyee bɔ y’anyelasoɛ si pi wɔ nu, ɔne kyɛ yɛkole nikyee bɔ anyeɛ nnwu ye yɛkɔto nu ɔ.

english_verse: It was their faith that made our ancestors pleasing to God.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ daa ama mɔ sɔle Nyameɛ nye ɔ.

english_verse: Because of our faith, we know that the world was made at God's command. We also know that what can be seen was made out of what cannot be seen.
translation_verse: Ɔnate gyidie so yɛnya ndeaseɛ kyɛ Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ yeɛ ɔfa bɔle aleɛ ɔ, yiti nningyein bɔ anyeɛ nwu bɛ ne, bammɔ bɛ bamvi nningyein bɔ anyeɛ nwu bɛ ɔ nu. Abel

english_verse: Because Abel had faith, he offered God a better sacrifice than Cain did. God was pleased with him and his gift, and even though Abel is now dead, his faith still speaks for him.
translation_verse: Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Abel bɔle afɔleɛ paa bɔ ɔtra Kein deɛ ne, ná ɔsɔle Nyameɛ nye ɔ. Ɔnate ye gyidie so Nyameɛ buli ye kyɛ ɔtengyɛ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ lili y’ayɛyɛdeɛ ne nwo adanzeɛ. Na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ Abel awu de, nakoso ɔnate ye gyidie so ɔtɛ dwudwo. Henɔke

english_verse: Enoch had faith and did not die. He pleased God, and God took him up to heaven. This is why his body was never found.
translation_verse: Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ behwimini Henɔke bɛhɔle bɔ wanwu ɔ. Ebiala annwu ye, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ fale ye hɔle. Na anzana bɛbaafa ye bɛkɔ nyameɛso nen, né ye nwo adanzeɛ kyire kyɛ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye.

english_verse: But without faith no one can please God. We must believe that God is real and rewards everyone who searches for him.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ olle gyidie ne, ɔngora nzɔ Nyameɛ nye, ofikyɛ odi kyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔba Nyameɛ berɛ ne onya gyidie kyɛ Nyameɛ wɔ berɛ, na oyira bɛ bɔ bɛ nye aboro bɛpena ye boso ɔ. Nowa

english_verse: Because Noah had faith, he was warned about something that had not yet happened. He obeyed and built a boat that saved him and his family. In this way the people of the world were judged, and Noah was given the blessings that come to everyone who pleases God.
translation_verse: Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Nowa le suronyi tiele kyẽa bie nningyein bɔ né bɛbaasi ne nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ ɔ, na ɔbobɔle ɛlɛen alaka bɔ ɔne ye awuro ama bɛfale so benyane ngoa ɔ. Ɔnate ɛhe aso Nowa buale wiase foɛ, na ɔɔyɛle tenenee bɔ ɔnate gyidie so benya ye ne koliagyaa. Abraham

english_verse: Abraham had faith and obeyed God. He was told to go to the land that God had said would be his, and he left for a country he had never seen.
translation_verse: Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Abraham tiele Nyameɛ frɛlɛ ne, ná otu hɔle maen bɔ ɔfa hyɛle ye bɔ kyɛ ɔkɔmaa ɔkɔyɛ ye agyapadeɛ ne aso ɔ; na otu fili ye maen nu bɔ né ɔnze nekaa bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Because Abraham had faith, he lived as a stranger in the promised land. He lived there in a tent, and so did Isaac and Jacob, who were later given the same promise.
translation_verse: Ɔnate gyidie so ɔɔyɛle amanvraniɛ kyɛ ɔwɔ maen foforɛ so ɔ, wɔ aseɛ bɔ Nyameɛ fa hyɛle ye bɔ ne aso, ná ɔne Yisake ne Yakob bɔ bɛte sɔ bɔhyɛ komapɛ ne ala koliagyaa ne bɛtenane ɛtena sua nu.

english_verse: Abraham did this, because he was waiting for the eternal city God had planned and built.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, né ɔnwondɛ kuro bɔ Nyameɛ akyekye ná wahyehyɛ bɔ ye fapem gyi berɛ pindinn ne. Sara ne tetefoɛ biemɔ gyidie

english_verse: Even when Sarah was too old to have children, she had faith that God would do what he had promised, and she had a son.
translation_verse: Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Sara bɔ né wabo aworɛ so ne hora nwonzɛle wole ɔ, ofikyɛ obuli bɔ ɔhyɛle bɔ ne kyɛ odi nahorɛ.

english_verse: Her husband Abraham was almost dead, but he became the ancestor of many people. In fact, there are as many of them as there are stars in the sky or grains of sand along the seashore.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔnate biaa komapɛ he, bɔ né wayɛ aworowaa na wapingye ewue ne aso yeɛ bɛwole ye bosofoɛ, bɔ bɛ somaa te kyɛ ewienu nzramaa ne mboanoa anweaa bɔ bɛka a bennwu bɛ noa ɔ.

english_verse: Every one of those people died. But they still had faith, even though they had not received what they had been promised. They were glad just to see these things from far away, and they agreed that they were only strangers and foreigners on this earth.
translation_verse: Gyidie nu yeɛ sɔ mmenia hemɔ amukoraa bewuli ɔ. Bɛ sa anga bɔhyɛ ne, nakoso befitele dedeede na benwuni bɔhyɛ ne nwo nningyein nen, bele belili, na bele bɛtole nu kyɛ bɛte ɛwɔfoɛ ne amanvrafoɛ wɔ aseɛ he aso.

english_verse: When people talk this way, it is clear they are looking for a place to call their own.
translation_verse: Na mmenia bɔ bɛkã sɔ dwirɛ nen, bekyire kyɛ bɛpena maen bɔ ɔte bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ deɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If they had been talking about the land where they had once lived, they could have gone back at any time.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bɛhɔle so bɛdwenene maen bɔ betu befili so ne anwo a, ahaa benyane ate besale bɛ si bɛhɔle.

english_verse: But they were looking forward to a better home in heaven. This is why God wasn't ashamed for them to call him their God. He even built a city for them.
translation_verse: Nakoso afei, maen paa bɔ ɔte nyameɛso maen yeɛ bɛpena ɔ. Yiti ɔnyɛ Nyameɛ nya kyɛ bɛkɔfrɛ ye bɛ Nyameɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ wasiesie kuro bie wama bɛ.

english_verse: Abraham had been promised that Isaac, his only son, would continue his family. But when Abraham was tested, he had faith and was willing to sacrifice Isaac,
translation_verse: Né Nyameɛ ahã ahyire ye kyɛ, “Ɔnate Yisake so yeɛ ekonya wɔ bosofoɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: because he was sure that God could raise people to life. This was just like getting Isaac back from death.
translation_verse: Na Abraham nyane adwene kyɛ Nyameɛ kora tingye sona fi awufoɛ nu po, yiti sɛ ɛfa ye anyandera nu a, ye sa hane Yisake fili ewue nu kyɛ awufoɛ bɔ Nyameɛ tingye bɛ ne ala.

english_verse: Isaac had faith, and he promised blessings to Jacob and Esau.
translation_verse: Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Yisake fa yirayirale Yakob ne Yisɔ wɔ kyẽa bie nningyein nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Later, when Jacob was about to die, he leaned on his walking stick and worshiped. Then because of his faith he blessed each of Joseph's sons.
translation_verse: Gyidie so yeɛ mmerɛ bɔ Yakob baawu ne, ɔfa yirayirale Yosef mma nyɔ ne ɔ, na ofuale ye pɔmaa so dwɔso sɔnene Nyameɛ.

english_verse: And right before Joseph died, he had faith that God would lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. So he told them to take his bones with them.
translation_verse: Yosef nate gyidie so yeɛ ɔka kãa maa owu ne, ɔhane kyɛ Nyameɛ kɔye Yisraelfoɛ kofi Misraim ɔ; na ohyirele kyɛbɔ owu a besi bɛyɛ ye mmowue ɔ. Mose

english_verse: Because Moses' parents had faith, they kept him hidden until he was three months old. They saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid to disobey the king's orders.
translation_verse: Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ mmerɛ bɔ bɛwole Mose nen, ye awofoɛ fale ye feale tonn bosome nza ɔ; ofikyɛ benwuni kyɛ ye nwo yɛ nyemene, na banzuro kyɛ bekobu ɛhene ne mmeraa ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: Then after Moses grew up, his faith made him refuse to be called the king's grandson.
translation_verse: Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Mose nyini ne, ɔpole kyɛ bɛkɔfrɛ ye Faro awa brasua n’awa ɔ,

english_verse: He chose to be mistreated with God's people instead of having the good time that sin could bring for a little while.
translation_verse: na mmom ohurole kyɛ ɔne Nyameɛ mmenia bekonwu amaneɛ tra kyɛ okoli fɛɛ wɔ bɔne nu mmerɛ kãa bie ɔ.

english_verse: Moses knew that the treasures of Egypt were not as wonderful as what he would receive from suffering for the Messiah, and he looked forward to his reward.
translation_verse: Na onwuni kyɛ sɛ ɔnate Kristo ti begua wɔ nyunu ase a, ye nwo le mvasoɛ tra kyɛ ekonya Misraim anwonyadeɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ né ye nye la kyẽa bie akatuaa so.

english_verse: Because of his faith, Moses left Egypt. Moses had seen the invisible God and wasn't afraid of the king's anger.
translation_verse: Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Mose tu fili Misraim bɔ wanzuro ɛhene ne yaafɛlɛ ɔ, na ogyinane pindinn kyɛ sona bɔ ye nye tua Ɛdangama Nyameɛ bɔ bennwu ye ne.

english_verse: His faith also made him celebrate Passover. He sprinkled the blood of animals on the doorposts, so that the first-born sons of the people of Israel would not be killed by the destroying angel.
translation_verse: Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ ɔfa hyehyɛle Abɔtra ne, ɔne mogya petenɛ wɔ b’anoa nyunu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔyɛ ná ewue abɔfo ne wanguku bɛ bamuɛbaa nemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Because of their faith, the people walked through the Red Sea on dry land. But when the Egyptians tried to do it, they were drowned.
translation_verse: Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Yisraelfoɛ pɛle Ɛpo Kɔkorɛ ne kyɛ bɛnate etii so ɔ, nakoso Misraimfoɛ yɛle kyɛ bɛpɛ ye bie nen, asue ne fale bɛ hɔle.

english_verse: God's people had faith, and when they had walked around the city of Jericho for seven days, its walls fell down.
translation_verse: Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ Yeriko fasue ne, bɛpɛle ye nwo bɛbra beyiale ɛlɛsoo ne, odwiri guale ɔ.

english_verse: Rahab had been a prostitute, but she had faith and welcomed the spies. So she wasn't killed with the people who disobeyed.
translation_verse: Ɔnate gyidie so yeɛ bangu gyanderaniɛ Rahabo bammoka bɛ bɔ banne banni nemɔ aso ɔ, ofikyɛ olele bɛ bɔ bɛɛsrale maen ne anu besiele ne nyemene so.

english_verse: What else can I say? There isn't enough time to tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets.
translation_verse: Na nzikyɛ bieku koraa yeɛ nga ɔ? Ɔnate kyɛ sɛ mekã mmenia te kyɛ Gideon, Barake, Samson, Yɛfeta, Dawide, Samuel ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ nwo dwirɛ a, ahaa mmerɛ kotia me.

english_verse: Their faith helped them conquer kingdoms, and because they did right, God made promises to them. They closed the jaws of lions
translation_verse: Bɛ yeɛ ɔnate gyidie so bɛhone belili ahennie ahoroɔ so ngonim ɔ, begyinane bɛmane tenenee, bɛ sa hane bɔhyɛ mɔ, bɛhane gyata mɔ noa bɛtole nu;

english_verse: and put out raging fires and escaped from the swords of their enemies. Although they were weak, they were given the strength and power to chase foreign armies away.
translation_verse: benuane see wuronyiwuronyi, benyane bɛ ti ngoa bɔ bandotɔ ngrandɛ noa ɔ, benyane anwoserɛ befili mmerɛyɛlɛ nu, bɛ nwo yɛle se wɔ koɛ nu, na bɛfoane amanvrafoɛ asraafoɛ maa bɛnwatili.

english_verse: Some women received their loved ones back from death. Many of these people were tortured, but they refused to be released. They were sure they would get a better reward when the dead are raised to life.
translation_verse: Mmrasua sa hane b’awufoɛ bɔ batingye bafi ewue nu ɔ. Ebiemɔ koso bɛhyɛle bɛ anyeborolɛ behuni bɛ, nakoso bambene kyɛ bekonya bɛ nwo bɛkɔtete ɔ, amaa ɔnate so banya ewutingyelɛ paa ne.

english_verse: Others were made fun of and beaten with whips, and some were chained in jail.
translation_verse: Beguale ebiemɔ nyunu ase, na besa befini bɛ mbire, yeɛ ebiemɔ wora bɛbɔle bɛ panwu bɛfale bɛ beguale kuku nu.

english_verse: Still others were stoned to death or sawed in two or killed with swords. Some had nothing but sheep skins or goat skins to wear. They were poor, mistreated, and tortured.
translation_verse: Bɛborole bɛ nyɔboɛ, bɛfale sralaa bedwudwale bɛ nu, yeɛ bɛtotɔle ngrandɛ noa; bewurale mmoaen nwomaa ne mbɔngye nwomaa behyinini, belili hiaa, bɛtanene bɛ nye, na benwuni amaneɛ.

english_verse: The world did not deserve these good people, who had to wander in deserts and on mountains and had to live in caves and holes in the ground.
translation_verse: Bammu wiase kyɛ nikyee bɔ odi mu ma bɛ ɔ, behyinihyini ɛserɛ ne mmokaa so, na bɛtenane aseɛ so nyɔboɛ bɔ wasi sua, ɔne ngumaa mɔ nu.

english_verse: All of them pleased God because of their faith! But still they died without being given what had been promised.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia hemɔ amukoraa, ɔnate bɛ gyidie ti bɛsɔle Nyameɛ nye, nakoso bɛ sa anga bɔhyɛ ne;

english_verse: This was because God had something better in store for us. And he did not want them to reach the goal of their faith without us.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ Nyameɛ ayɔ nhyehyɛleɛ paa bɔ ɔtra so wato berɛ wama yɛ, na ɛhe kyire kyɛ sana yɛboka bɛ so koraka na bali mu.

english_verse: Such a large crowd of witnesses is all around us! So we must get rid of everything that slows us down, especially the sin that just won't let go. And we must be determined to run the race that is ahead of us.
translation_verse: Yɛ de, yɛle adanzefoɛ pembepembe bɔ bapɛ yɛ nwo bayia ɔ, yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛgyi nikyee biala bɔ osi yɛ ngɔsoɛ nwo ate, ɔne bɔne bɔ ɔngyɛ na wakyekye yɛ ne yɛgua, ná yɛ́mia yɛ nye yɛtu amirika bɔ ɔla yɛ nyunu ne.

english_verse: We must keep our eyes on Jesus, who leads us and makes our faith complete. He endured the shame of being nailed to a cross, because he knew later on he would be glad he did. Now he is seated at the right side of God's throne!
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma yɛnea Yesu bɔ ɔte yɛ gyidie ahyɛaseɛ ne ayieleɛ ne. Na ɔnate anigye bɔ né ɔla ye nyunu ne ati, omiane ye nye fale amaneɛ ne animguaseɛ wue nu wɔ mmeamudua ne aso, na waatena Nyameɛ ahennie bia ne famaa so.

english_verse: So keep your mind on Jesus, who put up with many insults from sinners. Then you won't get discouraged and give up.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea Yesu bɔ ogyinane pindinn wɔ bɔnefoɛ ɛpɔen worawora noa ne, amaa ɛmɔ koso b’abasanu ammu na ɛmɔ wora ammɔ.

english_verse: None of you have yet been hurt in your battle against sin.
translation_verse: Na apereapereɛ bɔ ɛmɔ ne bɔne bedi ye, ɛmɔnnya bɛffale ɛmɔ ngoa bɛppɛle so.

english_verse: But you have forgotten that the Scriptures say to God's children, “When the Lord punishes you, don't make light of it, and when he corrects you, don't be discouraged.
translation_verse: Anaakyɛ ɛmɔ wora afi nguraenhyɛlɛ dwirɛ bɔ Nyameɛ kã kyire ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔte ye mma ne hɔ ɔ? Ɔnwa yoo: “Mma, sɛ Awurade tea wɔ a, ɔyɛ a nnɛfa di angorɛ, yeɛ sɛ otwi wɔ nyunu koso a, ɔyɛ a nnɛma w’aba nu bu.

english_verse: The Lord corrects the people he loves and disciplines those he calls his own.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, bɔ Awurade kuro ye dwirɛ ne yeɛ ɔtea ye ɔ, na baa biala bɔ ode ye to nu ne yeɛ otwi ye nyunu ɔ.”

english_verse: Be patient when you are being corrected! This is how God treats his children. Don't all parents correct their children?
translation_verse: Sɛ ɛmɔnwu amaneɛ a, ɛ́mɔbu ye kyɛ ɔtea ɛmɔ, Nyameɛ yɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ye mma, ofikyɛ baa beni ala yeɛ ɔse ndea ye ɔ?

english_verse: God corrects all his children, and if he doesn't correct you, then you don't really belong to him.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ Nyameɛ andea ɛmɔ kyɛbɔ ɔyɛ ye mma mukoraa ne a, né nzaade ɛmɔtte ye mma paapaa, na mmom ɛmɔte adwaman mmaa.

english_verse: Our earthly fathers correct us, and we still respect them. Isn't it even better to be given true life by letting our spiritual Father correct us?
translation_verse: Afei koso, yɛle seɛ mɔ wɔ aseɛ ye aso bɔ bɛtea yɛ ɔ, na yɛfa ebuo yɛma bɛ. Sɛ ɔte sɔ de a, aso onhia kyɛ yɛbrɛ yɛ nwo ase bɔ ɔtra so yɛma yɛ sunzum nu Seɛ ne na yanya ngoa anaa?

english_verse: Our human fathers correct us for a short time, and they do it as they think best. But God corrects us for our own good, because he wants us to be holy, as he is.
translation_verse: Bɛ de, bɛteane yɛ mmerɛ kãa bie anu, kyɛbɔ bɛnea a ɔte paa ma bɛ ɔ; nakoso Nyameɛ de, yɛ yeeyɛlɛ ti yeɛ ɔtea yɛ ɔ, amaa ɔnate so yanya kyɛfa wɔ ye krongronyɛlɛ ne anu.

english_verse: It is never fun to be corrected. In fact, at the time it is always painful. But if we learn to obey by being corrected, we will do right and live at peace.
translation_verse: Kekesaala ye de, ɛtealɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ ɔma yɛ nye gye ɔ, na mmom ɔma yɛ wora bɔ. Nakoso ɛhe asi ne, bɛ bɔ bafa sɔ ɛtealɛ ne batea bɛ ne, bɛ sa kã akatuaa bɔ ɔte tenenee ne asomdwee ɔ. Foɛtulɛ ne kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: Now stand up straight! Stop your knees from shaking
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ sa bɔ nu agoho, ɔne ɛmɔ nangoroma bɔ nu ayɛ hodwoo ne anu yɛ se.

english_verse: and walk a straight path. Then lame people will be healed, instead of getting worse. Warning against Turning from God
translation_verse: Na ɛ́mɔsiesie atimbire bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ bɛ́ma ɛmɔ gya, amaa ɔnate so agyirɛ bɔ ɔtte mayee ne wando wamvo ye nwo, ná mmom wanya ayaresa.

english_verse: Try to live at peace with everyone! Live a clean life. If you don't, you will never see the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbɔ mmɔden bɛ ne mmenia mukoraa bɛtena asomdwee nu, ná ɛmɔbɔ bra bɔ ye nwo te ɔ, ofikyɛ sɛ ɛmɔ bra anyɛ krongron a, ɛmɔngonwu Awurade.

english_verse: Make sure no one misses out on God's wonderful kindness. Don't let anyone become bitter and cause trouble for the rest of you.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea yé na Nyameɛ adom ne ammɔ ɛmɔ, na ɛmɔ nu biala anyɛ ye nwo bakaa ndii weewee, bɔ ɔfa ɛhawo brɛ mmeni pee na ogua bɛ nwo fiɛ ɔ;

english_verse: Watch out for immoral and ungodly people like Esau, who sold his future blessing for only one meal.
translation_verse: na ebiala anyɛ adwamanbɔlɛniɛ anaakyɛ bɔ nyamesuro nne ye nu kyɛ Yisɔ, bɔ ɔtɔnene ye bamuɛbaa dibea fa lele aleɛ talie komapɛ twe ne.

english_verse: You know how he later wanted it back. But there was nothing he could do to change things, even though he begged his father and cried.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔse kyɛ ɛhe asi ne, ohurole kyɛ ahaa okonya ɔse saleɛ ne, nakoso wamva wamma ye. Na ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɔporole moen fa penane de, nakoso wannwu atee biala bɔ ɔfa so kakyi bɔ wayɔ ne ɔ.

english_verse: You have not come to a place like Mount Sinai that can be seen and touched. There is no flaming fire or dark cloud or storm
translation_verse: Nna bokaa bɔ bɛfa bɛ sa bɛkã ye ne anwo yeɛ ɛmɔawa ɔ: bokaa bɔ né ogye see ne, nekaa bɔ né awosii kabii ne munungum ne mvrama piri wɔ ne,

english_verse: or trumpet sound. The people of Israel heard a voice speak. But they begged it to stop,
translation_verse: nekaa bɔ bɛtele totorobɛndo hulɛ ne, ɔne komviɛ totohyia bɔ ɔmaa bɛsrɛle kyɛ nnɛma Nyameɛ dwudwo kyire bɛ ko ne.

english_verse: because they could not obey its commands. They were even told to kill any animal that touched the mountain.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ bangora Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ ne noa gyina. Ɔnwa, “Sɛ kaka po fa ye nwo kã bokaa ne a bɛboro ye nyɔboɛ .”

english_verse: The sight was so frightening that Moses said he shook with fear.
translation_verse: Na bɔ osili berɛ ne, kyɛbɔ ye suronyi si te ne ati, ɔmaa Mose hane kyɛ, “Mesuro, na me nwo wosowoso me.”

english_verse: You have now come to Mount Zion and to the heavenly Jerusalem. This is the city of the living God, where thousands and thousands of angels have come to celebrate.
translation_verse: Na mmom ɛmɔawa Sion bokaa ne anwo, ɔne Nyameɛ teasefoɛ ne kuro, bɔ ɔte nyameɛso Yerusalem ne anu, yeɛ abɔfo kure kure bɔ bɛka a bennwu bɛ noa, bɔ bɛyɛ anigye nyianu ɔ bɛ berɛ.

english_verse: Here you will find all of God's dearest children, whose names are written in heaven. And you will find God himself, who judges everyone. Here also are the spirits of those good people who have been made perfect.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔawa Nyameɛ bamuɛbaa nemɔ bɔ bahyerɛ bɛ dumaa wɔ nyameɛso ne bɛ nyianu, ɔne Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte adasa mukoraa ndɛenbualɛniɛ ne berɛ, ɔne teneneefoɛ sunzum bɔ bali mu bayie nemɔ berɛ.

english_verse: And Jesus is here! He is the one who makes God's new agreement with us, and his sprinkled blood says much better things than the blood of Abel.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔawa Yesu bɔ ɔte apam foforɛ ne anu ndamgyinaniɛ, ɔne mogya bɔ bɛfa bɛpetene bɔ ɔkã nningyein paa nwo dwirɛ tra Abel deɛ ne berɛ. Sotie nwo hia

english_verse: Make sure you obey the one who speaks to you. The people did not escape, when they refused to obey the one who spoke to them at Mount Sinai. Do you think you can possibly escape, if you refuse to obey the one who speaks to you from heaven?
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea yé na ɛmɔambo bɔ odwudwo ne dwirɛ. Na sɛ bɛ bɔ bɛpole kyɛ bekotie bɔ odwudwole wɔ aseɛ ye aso ne, benyane ye nwo asohwenɛ de a, nzaade ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ bɔ sɛ yɛpo bɔ odwudwo kyire yɛ fi nyameɛso ne dwirɛ a, yɛngonya ye nwo asohwenɛ ɔ?

english_verse: When God spoke the first time, his voice shook only the earth. This time he has promised to shake the earth once again, and heaven too.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ sɔ mmerɛ ne ye komvi mane aseɛ wosole ɔ, nakoso kekesaala ye de wahyɛ bɔ kyɛ, “Nna aseɛ angome yeɛ mebaawoso ye bieku ɔ, na anwuro koso boka so.”

english_verse: The words “once again” mean that these created things will someday be shaken and removed. Then what cannot be shaken will last.
translation_verse: Na sɔ dwirɛ he: “Woso ye bieku” ne kyire kyɛ abɔdeɛ mɔ kɔwoso ná baye bɛ bafi berɛ, amaa nningyein bɔ bɛngora bɛnwoso ne bahɔ so batena berɛ.

english_verse: We should be grateful we were given a kingdom that cannot be shaken. And in this kingdom we please God by worshiping him and by showing him great honor and respect.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ yanya Ahennie bɔ ɔnwoso ne ati, ɛ́mɔma yɛ́fa asennaa yɛma Nyameɛ ná yɛfa esuronyi ne ebuo yɛsɔne ye kyɛbɔ ɔsɔ anyeɛ ɔ,

english_verse: Our God is like a destructive fire!
translation_verse: ofikyɛ yɛ Nyameɛ ne te see bɔ ɔyera nikye ɔ.

english_verse: Keep being concerned about each other as the Lord's followers should.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhɔ so behurohuro bɛ nwo dwirɛ kyɛ aliɛmaa.

english_verse: Be sure to welcome strangers into your home. By doing this, some people have welcomed angels as guests, without even knowing it.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea kyɛ ɛmɔkole ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ wɔ ɛmɔ awuro ɔ, ofikyɛ ebiemɔ fale sɔ atee he aso besikyele Nyameɛ abɔfo mɔ wɔ b’awuro bɔ né bɛnze ɔ.

english_verse: Remember the Lord's people who are in jail and be concerned for them. Don't forget those who are suffering, but imagine you are there with them.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔkaye kukunufoɛ, kyɛ ebiaa ɛmɔ ne bɛ yeɛ begua kuku nu ɔ; ɔne bɛ bɔ benwu amaneɛ, kyɛ ebiaa ɛmɔ ne bɛ yeɛ benwu amaneɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: Have respect for marriage. Always be faithful to your partner, because God will punish anyone who is immoral or unfaithful in marriage.
translation_verse: Odi kyɛ ebiala di agyaa ni, na nnɛma ebiala gua agyaa mba nwo fiɛ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ kobua adwamanbɔlɛfoɛ ne agyaasɛkyelɛfoɛ ndɛen.

english_verse: Don't fall in love with money. Be satisfied with what you have. The Lord has promised that he will not leave us or desert us.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔye sikanyeboro befi ɛmɔ brabɔlɛ nu, ná ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye sɔ bɔ ɛmɔanya ɔ; ofikyɛ ye bɔbɔ wahã kyɛ, “Mengoli wɔ ngasi, yeɛ mengɔye me sa wɔ wɔ bo le.”

english_verse: This should make you feel like saying, “The Lord helps me! Why should I be afraid of what people can do to me?”
translation_verse: Yiti yɛkora yɛsi y’ahone yɛkã kyɛ, “Awurade te me bokafoɛ, mengosuro nikye fee. Kuro sona kɔhora kɔyɔ me nzu?”

english_verse: Don't forget about your leaders who taught you God's message. Remember what kind of lives they lived and try to have faith like theirs.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔkaye ɛmɔ mbanyi mɔ bɔ bɛhane Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne behyirele ɛmɔ ne. Ɛ́mɔnea bɛ brabɔlɛ ayieleɛ ná ɛmɔsua bɛ gyidie.

english_verse: Jesus Christ never changes! He is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ Yesu Kristo te anoma nen, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔte ɛnɛ, ɔne afebɔɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Don't be fooled by any kind of strange teachings. It is better to receive strength from God's gift of undeserved grace than to depend on certain foods. After all, these foods don't really help the people who eat them.
translation_verse: Onni kyɛ ɛmɔma ngyerɛkyerɛ foforɛ ahoroɔ biala twe ɛmɔ fi atee paa ne aso, ofikyɛ ɔte paa kyɛ Nyameɛ adom ne yeɛ ɔhyɛ y’ahone nguraen ɔ, na nna aleɛ bɔ mmenia bɔ bedi ne bennya ye nwo mvasoɛ biala hɔ ɔ.

english_verse: But we have an altar where even the priests who serve in the place of worship have no right to eat.
translation_verse: Yɛle afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ bɛ bɔ bedi dwumaa wɔ ɛtena sua ne anu ne, belle ye nwo ate kyɛ bedi so nikyee biala ɔ.

english_verse: After the high priest offers the blood of animals as a sin offering, the bodies of those animals are burned outside the camp.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ngaka bɔ ɔsɔfo panyi paa ne fa bɛ mogya ba nekaa krongron ne anu babɔ bɔnefakyɛ afɔleɛ ne, bɛyera bɛ fuin nemɔ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ.

english_verse: This is why we should go outside the camp to Jesus and share in his disgrace.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔma yɛhɔ ye berɛ wɔ asikyeleɛ ne asi dɔ ná ye animguaseɛ ne bie ɔha yɛ.

english_verse: On this earth we don't have a city that lasts forever, but we are waiting for such a city.
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, kuro biala nne aseɛ ye aso bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ ma yɛ ɔ, na kuro bɔ ɔbaawa ne mmom yeɛ yɛpena ye si atee ɔ.

english_verse: Our sacrifice is to keep offering praise to God in the name of Jesus.
translation_verse: Yiti mmerɛ biala ɛ́mɔma yɛ́fa ayɛyelɛ yɛyɛ afɔleɛ yɛfa Yesu so yɛma Nyameɛ, na ɛhe te yɛ noa afɔleɛ bɔ yɛfa yɛhyɛ ye dumaa animnyam ɔ.

english_verse: But don't forget to help others and to share your possessions with them. This too is like offering a sacrifice that pleases God.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔbu ɛmɔ nye begua so kyɛ ɛmɔkɔyɔ paa ná ɛmɔkɔbokaboka bɛ nwo ɔ, ofikyɛ sɔ afɔleɛ nemɔ yeɛ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ.

english_verse: Obey your leaders and do what they say. They are watching over you, and they must answer to God. So don't make them sad as they do their work. Make them happy. Otherwise, they won't be able to help you at all.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔyɛ sotie bɛ́ma ɛmɔ mbanyi mɔ ná ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛma bɛ; ofikyɛ bɛnea ɛmɔ kra so, na bekobu bɛ nwo ngondaa ɔ, Ɛ́mɔyɛ sotie bɛ́ma bɛ amaa bayɔ b’adwuma wɔ anika so; na banyɔ ye aworabɔlɛ nu, ofikyɛ ɛhe nwo ngɔwa mvasoɛ biala ngɔma ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Pray for us. Our consciences are clear, and we always try to live right.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhɔ so bɛbɔ mbaeɛ bɛma yɛ; ofikyɛ yɛde yɛdi kyɛ yɛ tiboa mmua yɛ foɛ, na yɛkuro kyɛ daa yɛdi dwirɛ paa wɔ yɛ brabɔlɛ nu.

english_verse: I especially want you to pray that I can visit you again soon. Final Prayers and Greetings
translation_verse: Na mesrɛ ɛmɔ pee kyɛ ɛmɔbɔ mbaeɛ, kyɛ ngonya atee ngosa ngɔwa ɛmɔ berɛ bieku ndɛndɛ ɔ. Mbaeɛbɔlɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ

english_verse: God gives peace, and he raised our Lord Jesus Christ from death. Now Jesus is like a Great Shepherd whose blood was used to make God's eternal agreement with his flock.
translation_verse: Asomdwee Nyameɛ bɔ ɔnate apam bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ afebɔɔ mogya ne aso tingyele y’Awurade Yesu bɔ ɔte Mmoaenneafoɛ panyi ne fili awufoɛ nu ne,

english_verse: I pray God will make you ready to obey him and that you will always be eager to do right. May Jesus help you do what pleases God. To Jesus Christ be glory forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: ɔ́ma ɛmɔ anwoserɛ wɔ nikyee paa biala nu ma ɛmɔyɔ ye apɛdeɛ; ná ɔ́fa Yesu Kristo so ma ɛmɔli dwumaa bɔ ɔsɔ ye nye ɔ. Animnyam hã ye afebɔɔ. Amen. Ngraalilɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ

english_verse: My friends, I have written only a short letter to encourage you, and I beg you to pay close attention to what I have said.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, mesrɛ ɛmɔ kyɛ ɛmɔnya aboterɛ betie me foɛtulɛ he, ofikyɛ me krataa bɔ mahyerɛ ɛmɔ ye ɔnware biala.

english_verse: By now you surely must know that our friend Timothy is out of jail. If he gets here in time, I will bring him with me when I come to visit you.
translation_verse: Mema ɛmɔte kyɛ baye y’eliɛma Timoteo bafi kuku nu, na sɛ ɔbadwu wa ndɛ de a, mebaasra ɛmɔ a, me ne ye kɔwa.

english_verse: Please give my greetings to your leaders and to the rest of the Lord's people. His followers from Italy send you their greetings.
translation_verse: Yɛbisa ɛmɔ mbanyi nemɔ mukoraa ne anwoteefoɛ ne amukoraa bisabisa. Aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ befi Yitalia koso bebisa ɛmɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to all of you!
translation_verse: Nyameɛ adom ne ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛtena. Amen.

english_verse: From James, a servant of God and of our Lord Jesus Christ. Greetings to the twelve tribes scattered all over the world. Faith and Wisdom
translation_verse: Yakobo bɔ nde Nyameɛ ne Awurade Yesu Kristo akoaa, mefa mebrɛ abusua kure buru ne nyɔ bɔ babɔ aya bahɔ maen maen so ne. Mebisa ɛmɔ bisabisa. Gyidie ne nworɛ

english_verse: My friends, be glad, even if you have a lot of trouble.
translation_verse: Nniɛma mɔ, sɛ nzɔhwɛ ahoroɔ toto ɛmɔ a, ɛ́mɔbu ye kyɛ ɔte anigye nikye;

english_verse: You know you learn to endure by having your faith tested.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ɛmɔse kyɛ ɛmɔ gyidie nwo nzɔhwɛ yeɛ ɔmaa ɛmɔfa animia begyina ɔ.

english_verse: But you must learn to endure everything, so you will be completely mature and not lacking in anything.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ animia ne ɔyɔ ye adwuma yie pɛpɛɛpɛ, amaa ɛmɔali mu bɔkɔɔ bɔ siitɔlɛ biala nne ɛmɔ nu ɔ.

english_verse: If any of you need wisdom, you should ask God, and it will be given to you. God is generous and won't correct you for asking.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔ nu bie tɔ sii nworɛ nu a, maa obisa Nyameɛ bɔ ɔye ye kunu fa ma mmenia, bɔ ɔmva animguaseɛ mmata ye nwo ne, na ɔkɔfa kɔma ye.

english_verse: But when you ask for something, you must have faith and not doubt. Anyone who doubts is like an ocean wave tossed around in a storm.
translation_verse: Nakoso maa obisa ye gyidie nu, bɔ ye adwene nyɛ ye naa ɔ; ofikyɛ sona bɔ ye adwene yɛ ye naa ne, ɔte kyɛ ɛpo asorɔkye bɔ mvrama bɔ ye fa ye di akɔneaba ɔ.

english_verse: If you are that kind of person, you can't make up your mind, and you surely can't be trusted. So don't expect the Lord to give you anything at all. Poor People and Rich People
translation_verse: ofikyɛ sona bɔ ye adwene yɛ ye ndaa ndaa ne, ɔngora nzi ye adwene pi wɔ nikyee biala bɔ ɔyɔ nu. Ehiaa ne anwonyadeɛ

english_verse: Any of God's people who are poor should be glad he thinks so highly of them.
translation_verse: Ma gyidiniɛ awiɛmvoɛ ɔhoahoa ye nwo wɔ ɛpagyalɛ bɔ bapagya ye ne anu,
