english_verse: But any who are rich should be glad when God makes them humble. Rich people will disappear like wild flowers
translation_verse: yeɛ sikaniɛ koso, wɔ ase bɔ babrɛ ye ne anu, ofikyɛ ɔkɔpɛ nu kɔhɔ kyɛ eburo ndire nyerɛen.

english_verse: scorched by the burning heat of the sun. The flowers lose their blossoms, and their beauty is destroyed. This is how the rich will disappear, as they go about their business. Trials and Temptations
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ eyia pukye bɔ gyireingyirein, na ɔyera ndire ne; ye nyerɛen ne poro gua, na ye nyemene sɛkye. Na sɔ ala yeɛ sikaniɛ koso kɔpɛ nu kɔhɔ wɔ bɔ ɔyɔ nu ɔ. Nzɔhwɛ

english_verse: God will bless you, if you don't give up when your faith is being tested. He will reward you with a glorious life, just as he rewards everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ omia ye nye fa nzɔhwɛ nu ne, onya saleɛ; ofikyɛ sɛ ɔkora gyina nzɔhwɛ ne noa a, okonya ngoa abotire bɔ Awurade afa ahyɛ bɛ bɔ bekuro ye dwirɛ bɔ ne.

english_verse: Don't blame God when you are tempted! God cannot be tempted by evil, and he doesn't use evil to tempt others.
translation_verse: Na sɛ béso ebie bɛnea a, nnɛmaa ɔkã kyɛ, “Nyameɛ yeɛ oso me nea ɔ”; ofikyɛ bɔne bie ngora nzo Nyameɛ nnea, yeɛ ye koso onzo sona biala nnea.

english_verse: We are tempted by our own desires that drag us off and trap us.
translation_verse: Na mmom sona bɔbɔ ye akɔnnɔ yeɛ odiedie ye ná ɔlakalaka ye oso ye nea ɔ.

english_verse: Our desires make us sin, and when sin is finished with us, it leaves us dead.
translation_verse: Na sɛ akɔnnɔ ne ɔnwonzɛ a, ɔwo bɔne; yeɛ sɛ bɔne koso onyi yie a, ɔwo ewue.

english_verse: Don't be fooled, my dear friends.
translation_verse: Nniɛma mɔ bɔ ɛmɔla m’ahone nwo ɔ, nnɛmɔma bɛlakalaka ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Every good and perfect gift comes down from the Father who created all the lights in the heavens. He is always the same and never makes dark shadows by changing.
translation_verse: Akyɛdeɛ paa amukoraa ne akyɛdeɛ bɔ odi mu amukoraa fi nyameɛso, na ofi kanea Baba ne berɛ yeɛ ɔba ase ɔ. Na ye yeɛ ɔngakyi ná ɔnyɛ ye nwo kyɛ wawoɛ bɔ ɔsesã ɔ.

english_verse: He wanted us to be his own special people, and so he sent the true message to give us new birth. Hearing and Obeying
translation_verse: Ɔnate ye bɔbɔ ye pɛ so yeɛ ɔfale nahorɛ dwirɛ ne wole yɛ ɔ, kyɛ yɛyɛ ye abɔdeɛ ne anu nikyee bɔ oli moa ɔ. Sotie ma saleɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, you should be quick to listen and slow to speak or to get angry.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa adɔfo mɔ, ɛ́mɔtie ɛhe yé. Ɔsɛ kyɛ sona biala yɛ ndɛ tie, nnɛmaa ɔpe ndɛen dwudwo, nnɛmaa ɔpe ndɛen fɛ yaa;

english_verse: If you are angry, you cannot do any of the good things God wants done.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ sona yaafɛlɛ ɔnyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nye so ɔ.

english_verse: You must stop doing anything immoral or evil. Instead be humble and accept the message planted in you to save you.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔgyi bra fiɛ ne bɔne yɔleɛ amukoraa bégua, ná ɛ́mɔfa anwobrɛaseɛ betira edwirɛ bɔ balua ye wɔ ɛmɔ nu ne anu, na ye yeɛ ɔkora de ɛmɔ kra ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: Obey God's message! Don't fool yourselves by just listening to it.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔyɔ bɔ edwirɛ ne kã ne, na nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ atiefoɛ ngome bɛfa bɛlakalaka ɛmɔ nwo.

english_verse: If you hear the message and don't obey it, you are like people who stare at themselves in a mirror
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɛ ebie te edwirɛ ne tiefoɛ, ná ɔnyɔ bɔ edwirɛ ne kã ne a, ɔte kyɛ sona bɔ ɔnea ye nyunu sue neanu nu ɔ.

english_verse: and forget what they look like as soon as they leave.
translation_verse: Onwu ye nwo, na ofi berɛ, na berɛ ne ala ye wora fi kyɛbɔ osi soma ɔ.

english_verse: But you must never stop looking at the perfect law that sets you free. God will bless you in everything you do, if you listen and obey, and don't just hear and forget.
translation_verse: Nakoso sona bɔ ɔgyene ye nye nea fawɔnwodi mmeraa bɔ odi mu ne anu, ná ɔtena nu, ná wanyɛ tiefoɛ aworafireniɛ, na mmom odi so ɔyɔ nen, bekoyira ye wɔ bɔ ɔyɔ ɔ nu.

english_verse: If you think you are being religious, but can't control your tongue, you are fooling yourself, and your religion is useless.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie dwene kyɛ ɔte nyamesomniɛ, ná wannea ye dwudwolɛ so yé, ná mmom ɔlakalaka ye nwo a, sɔ sona ne nyamesom te mbaen.

english_verse: Religion that pleases God the Father must be pure and spotless. You must help needy orphans and widows and not let this world make you evil.
translation_verse: Nyameɛsom bɔ ye nwo te bɔ efiɛ nne ye nwo wɔ Baba Nyameɛ nyunu ɛhe: kyɛ ɛkɔɔnea nyisiaa ne akunafoɛ wɔ b’amaneɛnwunɛ nu, ɔne kyɛ ɛkɔhwe wɔ nwo kofi wiase bra basabasa nu ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, if you have faith in our glorious Lord Jesus Christ, you won't treat some people better than others.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ bɔ ɛmɔtira y’Awurade Yesu Kristo bɔ ɔte animnyam Hene ne gyidie nu ɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔfa nyeyemuɛ bɛbata ye nwo.

english_verse: Suppose a rich person wearing fancy clothes and a gold ring comes to one of your meetings. And suppose a poor person dressed in worn-out clothes also comes.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ebie bɔ owura sikaa kɔkorɛ mbɛteaa ne ataadeɛ nyemene ba ɛmɔ nyianu sua nu, ná sɛ ehianiɛ koso bɔ owura ataadeɛ turuwaa koso ba berɛ bie,

english_verse: You must not give the best seat to the one in fancy clothes and tell the one who is poor to stand at the side or sit on the floor.
translation_verse: ná sɛ ɛmɔfa anidie bɛma bɔ owura ndaadeɛ nyemene ne, ná ɛmɔkã bekyire ye kyɛ, “Tena bia paa he aso,” ná ɛmɔkã bekyire ehianiɛ ne koso kyɛ, “Wɔ de, gyina dɔ” anaakyɛ “Tena ase wɔ me gya bo wa” a,

english_verse: This is the same as saying that some people are better than others, and you would be acting like a crooked judge.
translation_verse: aso né ɛhe ngyire kyɛ ɛmɔayɔ nyeyemuɛ, bɔ ɔmɔayɛ adwenemmɔne ndɛenbualɛfoɛ ɔ?

english_verse: My dear friends, pay attention. God has given a lot of faith to the poor people in this world. God has also promised them a share in his kingdom that he will give to everyone who loves him.
translation_verse: Nniɛma mɔ bɔ ɛmɔla m’ahone nwo ɔ, ɛ́mɔtie! Aso Nyameɛ ɔnneneane nu ɔyyele wiase ahiafoɛ kyɛ bɛyɛ gyidie nu anwonyafoɛ, ná benya agyapadeɛ wɔ ahennie ne anu, ahennie bɔ wafa wahyɛ bɛ bɔ bekuro ye dwirɛ ne bɔ ne?

english_verse: You mistreat the poor. But isn't it the rich who boss you around and drag you off to court?
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔbu ehianiɛ animtia! Aso nna sikafoɛ yeɛ bɛhyɛ ɛmɔ so ɔ, aso nna bɛ yeɛ bɛtwe ɛmɔ bɛkɔ badwafoɛ nyunu ɔ?

english_verse: Aren't they the ones who make fun of your Lord?
translation_verse: Aso nna bɛ yeɛ bɛkã musue dwirɛ betia animnyam dumaa bɔ bɛfa bɛfrɛ ɛmɔ ne?

english_verse: You will do all right, if you obey the most important law in the Scriptures. It is the law that commands us to love others as much as we love ourselves.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ ɛmɔdi dehyeɛ mmeraa ne aso nahorɛ nu, kyɛbɔ Ahyerɛlɛ ne kã kyɛ, “Kuro ebiɛngo dwirɛ kyɛ wɔ bɔbɔ wɔ nwo” ne a, ye de né ɛmɔayɛ nikye.

english_verse: But if you treat some people better than others, you have done wrong, and the Scriptures teach that you have sinned.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔnea sona nyunu bɛyɛ nyeyemuɛ a, né ɛmɔayɔ bɔne, na mmeraa ne bua ɛmɔ ndɛen kyɛ mmeraatolɛfoɛ.

english_verse: If you obey every law except one, you are still guilty of breaking them all.
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ okoli mmeraa ne aso, ná ɔkɔto nu komapɛ po nen, né wali ye mukoraati nwo fɔ.

english_verse: The same God who told us to be faithful in marriage also told us not to murder. So even if you are faithful in marriage, but murder someone, you still have broken God's Law.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, bɔ ɔhane kyɛ, “Nnɛsɛkye agyaa” nen, ye ala yeɛ ɔhane kyɛ, “Nnɛdi awue” ɔ. Na sɛ anzɛkye agyaa, nakoso edi awue a, né ayɛ ebie bɔ wato mmeraa ne ɔ.

english_verse: Speak and act like people who will be judged by the law that sets us free.
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ ɛmɔkã ne, ɛ́mɔyɔ sɔ, kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛkɔfa fawɔnwodi mmeraa ne aso bekobua bɛ ndɛen ɔ.

english_verse: Do this, because on the day of judgment there will be no pity for those who have not had pity on others. But even in judgment, God is merciful! Faith and Works
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ anwumvoinnwunɛ nne ndɛenbualɛ nu mma bɔ wannwu anwumvoin ɔ; na anwumvoinnwunɛ hoahoa ye nwo di ndɛenbualɛ so ngonim. Gyidie ne nnwumaa

english_verse: My friends, what good is it to say you have faith, when you don't do anything to show you really do have faith? Can this kind of faith save you?
translation_verse: Nniɛma mɔ, sɛ ebie kã kyɛ ole gyidie, nakoso olle nnwumaa a, né mvasoɛ beni yeɛ ɔwɔ so ɔ? Sɔ gyidie ne, ɔkɔhora kole ye ngoa anaa?

english_verse: If you know someone who doesn't have any clothes or food,
translation_verse: Sɛ aliɛmaa bienzua anaa aliɛmaa brasua bie nwo la so, ná ye noa aleɛ abɔ ye,

english_verse: you shouldn't just say, “I hope all goes well for you. I hope you will be warm and have plenty to eat.” What good is it to say this, unless you do something to help?
translation_verse: ná ɛmɔ nu ko kã kyire bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfa asomdwee bɛhɔ oo, ɛ́mɔnya tena bɛ́kata ɛmɔ nwo oo, ná ɛmɔ ko yi oo,” nakoso ɛmɔamma bɛ nningyein bɔ nipadua ne hia a, mvasoɛ beni yeɛ ɔwɔ so ɔ?

english_verse: Faith that doesn't lead us to do good deeds is all alone and dead!
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ gyidie ngome koso ɔte ɔ. Sɛ nnwumaa nne nu a, ɔte wuruwaa.

english_verse: Suppose someone disagrees and says, “It is possible to have faith without doing kind deeds.” I would answer, “Prove that you have faith without doing kind deeds, and I will prove that I have faith by doing them.”
translation_verse: Amba, ebie kɔhã kyɛ, “Ele gyidie, yeɛ me wora nne nnwumaa.” “Kyire me wɔ gyidie bɔ nnwumaa nne nu ɔ, na me koso ngɔfa me nnwumaa ngohyire wɔ me gyidie.”

english_verse: You surely believe there is only one God. That's fine. Even demons believe this, and it makes them shake with fear.
translation_verse: Yeɛ ede di kyɛ Nyameɛ te komapɛ? Ayɔ nikye, sunzummɔne mɔ po bede bedi, na bɛ nwo wosowoso bɛ.

english_verse: Does some stupid person want proof that faith without deeds is useless?
translation_verse: Wɔ bɔ wadwene te kãa ɔ! Ɛpena kyɛ bɛkã bekyire wɔ kyɛ gyidie bɔ nnwumaa nne nu ne ɔte wuruwaa anaa?

english_verse: Well, our ancestor Abraham pleased God by putting his son Isaac on the altar to sacrifice him.
translation_verse: Aso nna nnwumaa so yeɛ begyina bebuale yɛ nana Abraham be, mmerɛ bɔ ɔfale ɔwa Yisake tole afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso kyɛ ɔfa ye bɔ afɔleɛ ne?

english_verse: Now you see how Abraham's faith and deeds worked together. He proved his faith was real by what he did.
translation_verse: Yeɛ anwu kyɛ ye gyidie ne ye nnwumaa bɛbɔle nu bɛyɔle adwuma, na ɔnate nnwumaa ne aso yeɛ gyidie ne lili mu ɔ.

english_verse: This is what the Scriptures mean by saying, “Abraham had faith in God, and God accepted him.” That's how Abraham became God's friend.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe mane Ahyerɛlɛ ne wale nu kyɛ, “Abraham lele Nyameɛ lili, na obuli sɔ tenenee mane ye”; na bɛfrɛle ye Nyameɛ damvo.

english_verse: You can now see that we please God by what we do and not only by what we believe.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ma ɛmɔnwu ye kyɛ begyina sona nnwumaa so yeɛ bebua ye be ɔ, na bengyina ye gyidie ngome so.

english_verse: For example, Rahab had been a prostitute. But she pleased God when she welcomed the spies and sent them home by another way.
translation_verse: Na sɔ ala koso, aso nna nnwumaa so yeɛ begyina bebuale adwamanbɔlɛniɛ Rahabo be ɔ, mmerɛ bɔ olele ɛbɔfoɛ nemɔ, ná ɔmaa bɛfale atee foforɛ so bɛhɔle ne?

english_verse: Anyone who doesn't breathe is dead, and faith that doesn't do anything is just as dead!
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ nipadua bɔ sunzum nne nu ne ɔte wuruwaa nen, sɔ ala yeɛ gyidie bɔ nnwumaa nne nu ne ɔte wuruwaa ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, we should not all try to become teachers. In fact, teachers will be judged more strictly than others.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ nu somaa yɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ, na ɛmɔse kyɛ bekobua yɛ foɛ piri mmom.

english_verse: All of us do many wrong things. But if you can control your tongue, you are mature and able to control your whole body.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ yɛ mukoraa yɛfõ wɔ atee pee so. Na sɛ ebie nyɔ mvomsoɛ wɔ bɔ ɔkã nu a, né ɔte sona bɔ odi mu, bɔ ɔkora hyɛ ye nipadua amukoraa so ɔ.

english_verse: By putting a bit into the mouth of a horse, we can turn the horse in different directions.
translation_verse: Yɛfa buralɛ yɛwura mbɔngɔ noa nu maa betie yɛ, na yɛtengyɛtengyɛ bɛ maa bɛfa yɛ bɛkɔ nekaa biala bɔ yɛkuro ɔ.

english_verse: It takes strong winds to move a large sailing ship, but the captain uses only a small rudder to make it go in any direction.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea ɛlɛen mɔ koso. Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ bɛte mbiri paa, bɔ mvrama piri yeɛ ɔfa bɛ kɔ ɔ de, nakoso bɛfa tabɔnga kaaba bie yeɛ bɛtengyɛtengyɛ bɛ maa bɛkɔ nekaa bɔ ɛlɛenhanɛniɛ ne kuro ɔ.

english_verse: Our tongues are small too, and yet they brag about big things. It takes only a spark to start a forest fire!
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ temverema koso ɔte nipadua akwaa kaaba bie ɔ, nakoso ɔkekã edwirɛ mbiri mbiri hoahoa ye nwo. Ɛ́mɔtie, see kaaba bie yeɛ ɔyera ɛhɔayeɛ too ɔ!

english_verse: The tongue is like a spark. It is an evil power that dirties the rest of the body and sets a person's entire life on fire with flames that come from hell itself.
translation_verse: Temverema koso te see. Temverema te ewiase bɔ ɔndengyɛ bɔ wafra y’akwaa mɔ nu ɔ; ɔbɔ musue maa ɔkã nipadua ne amukoraa, ɔfa see to mmenia asetena nu, na abɔnzam see nu yeɛ onya ye see ne fi ɔ.

english_verse: All kinds of animals, birds, reptiles, and sea creatures can be tamed and have been tamed.
translation_verse: Na ngaka aboyaa ne nnomaa ne ngaka bɔ bɛkongo ne ɛpo nu ngaka amukoraa, sona kora tete bɛ brɛ bɛ ase, na wabrɛ bɛ ase maa batie ye.

english_verse: But our tongues get out of control. They are restless and evil, and always spreading deadly poison.
translation_verse: Nakoso temverema de, sona biala ngora mmrɛ ye ase; ɔte busueniɛ bɔ bɛmmɔ ye kyɛnn so ɔ, na ɛborɔ bɔ ye noa yɛ hye yeɛ wayi ye tɛkyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: My dear friends, with our tongues we speak both praises and curses. We praise our Lord and Father, and we curse people who were created to be like God, and this isn't right.
translation_verse: Noa komapɛ ne anu yeɛ saleɛ ne amoenwaa fi ɔ. Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɔba ye sɔ ɔ!

english_verse: Can clean water and dirty water both flow from the same spring?
translation_verse: Asue ti komapɛ ne, aso opu nzue bɔ ɔyɛ fɛ ne bɔ ɔyɛ wee ɔ?

english_verse: Can a fig tree produce olives or a grapevine produce figs? Does fresh water come from a well full of salt water? Wisdom from Above
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, aso borɔdoma bakaa kora su olive mmaa? Anaakyɛ bobe kora su borɔdoma mmaa? Sɔ ala yeɛ asue ti komapɛ ne ngora mbu nzue ngyee ngyee ne nzue paa ɔ. Nyameɛso nworɛ

english_verse: Are any of you wise or sensible? Then show it by living right and by being humble and wise in everything you do.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ nu nwa yeɛ ɔte nworɛniɛ ne nimdeɛniɛ ɔ? Maa ɔfa bra paa ohyire ye nnwumaa wɔ anwobrɛaseɛ bɔ nworɛ wɔ nu ɔ nu.

english_verse: But if your heart is full of bitter jealousy and selfishness, don't brag or lie to cover up the truth.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ anyeboroborolɛ tɛɛ ne pɛsɛmangomenya wɔ ɛmɔ ahone nu a, ye de nnɛma ɛmɔhoahoa ɛmɔ nwo, yeɛ nnɛma ɛmɔpɛ ngondombo betia nahorɛ ne.

english_verse: This kind of wisdom doesn't come from above. It is earthly and selfish and comes from the devil himself.
translation_verse: Sɔ nworɛ he de, nna anwuro yeɛ ofi ɔ, na mmom ɔte aseɛ so deɛ; nna sunzum nu deɛ ɔ, na ɔte sunzummɔne mɔ deɛ.

english_verse: Whenever people are jealous or selfish, they cause trouble and do all sorts of cruel things.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nekaa bɔ anyeboroborolɛ ne pɛsɛmangomenya wɔ ne, berɛ yeɛ basabasa ne bɔne yɔleɛ amukoraa wɔ ɔ.

english_verse: But the wisdom that comes from above leads us to be pure, friendly, gentle, sensible, kind, helpful, genuine, and sincere.
translation_verse: Nakoso nworɛ bɔ ofi anwuro ne de, bɔ oli moa ɔ, ye nwo te, okuro asomdwee, ye nwo dwo, ye so yɛ mmerɛ, anwumvoinnwunɛ ne bra paa ayi ye tɛkyɛ, na nyeyemuɛ anaa nyaatwom nne nu.

english_verse: When peacemakers plant seeds of peace, they will harvest justice.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bɛpena asomdwee si atee, bɔ bedua ye asomdwee nu ne, bɛte tenenee mmaa.

english_verse: Why do you fight and argue with each other? Isn't it because you are full of selfish desires that fight to control your body?
translation_verse: Koɛ ne ngondii bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ nu ne, nisua yeɛ ofi ba ɔ? Ɛmɔ akɔnnɔ bɔ ɔne ɛmɔ nwonaen akwaa mɔ bɛko ne, aso nna nu yeɛ ofi ba ɔ?

english_verse: You want something you don't have, and you will do anything to get it. You will even kill! But you still cannot get what you want, and you won't get it by fighting and arguing. You should pray for it.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔpena, na ɛmɔnnya ye; yiti ɛmɔdi awue; ɛmɔ nye boro kyɛ ɛmɔkonya ye, na ɛmɔngora benya ye; yiti ɛmɔko, na ɛmɔdi ahoɛ. Ɛmɔ sa nga ye, ofikyɛ ɛmɔmmisa.

english_verse: Yet even when you do pray, your prayers are not answered, because you pray just for selfish reasons.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔbisa, na ɛmɔ sa nga ye, ofikyɛ nna adwene paa yeɛ ɛmɔfa bebisa ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔkɔmaa ɛmɔkɔfa bɛkɔyɔ bɔ ɛmɔ akɔnnɔ kuro ɔ.

english_verse: You people aren't faithful to God! Don't you know if you love the world, you are God's enemies? And if you decide to be a friend of the world, you make yourself an enemy of God.
translation_verse: Agyaasɛkyelɛfoɛ! Ɛmɔnze kyɛ sɛ ɛmɔfa wiase abiɛngoɛ a, né ɛmɔpɔ Nyameɛ ɔ? Yiti ebiala bɔ okuro kyɛ ɔfa wiase abiɛngoɛ ne, ɔte Nyameɛ pɔfoɛ.

english_verse: Do you doubt the Scriptures that say, “God truly cares about the Spirit he has put in us”?
translation_verse: Anaakyɛ ɛmɔdwene kyɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne kã ye mbaen, kyɛ, “Ɔtwe ye sunzum bɔ ɔte yɛ nu ne nwo nungunɛ” ɔ?

english_verse: In fact, God treats us with even greater kindness, just as the Scriptures say, “God opposes everyone who is proud, but he blesses all who are humble with undeserved grace.”
translation_verse: Nakoso adom bɔ ɔfa ma ne, ɔsone pee. Na ye sɔ ati yeɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne kã kyɛ, “Nyameɛ nye sa anwomasoɛfoɛ, na ɔdo anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ.”

english_verse: Surrender to God! Resist the devil, and he will run from you.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ nwo béwura Nyameɛ bo. Ɛ́mɔyere ɛmɔ nwo bési abɔnzam ate, na ɔkɔnwati kofi ɛmɔ nwo.

english_verse: Come near to God, and he will come near to you. Clean up your lives, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you people who can't make up your mind.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhwe bepingye Nyameɛ, na ye koso ɔkɔhwe kopingye ɛmɔ. Ɛmɔ, bɔnefoɛ mɔ, ɛ́mɔnwunzi ɛmɔ sa, ná ɛ́mɔte ɛmɔ ahone nu, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔ adwene yɛ ɛmɔ ndaa ndaa ɔ!

english_verse: Be sad and sorry and weep. Stop laughing and start crying. Be gloomy instead of glad.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔli yealɛ, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ wora bɔ, ná ɛ́mɔsu! Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ aserekyekye kakyi aworabɔlɛ, ná ɛmɔ ahurusililɛ kakyi anwumvoin anwumvoin.

english_verse: Be humble in the Lord's presence, and he will honor you. Saying Cruel Things about Others
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase wɔ Awurade nyunu, na ɔkɔma ɛmɔ so. Nnɛbua ebiɛngo ndɛen

english_verse: My friends, don't say cruel things about others! If you do, or if you condemn others, you are condemning God's Law. And if you condemn the Law, you put yourself above the Law and refuse to obey either it
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔkekã ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ. Na ebiala bɔ ɔkã oliɛngo nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ anaa obua ye ndɛen ne, ɔkã mmeraa ne nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ, na obua mmeraa ne ndɛen. Na sɛ ebua mmeraa ne ndɛen a, né ɛnyɔ bɔ mmeraa ne kã ne, na mmom ɛte ye so ndɛenbualɛniɛ.

english_verse: or God who gave it. God is our judge, and he can save or destroy us. What right do you have to condemn anyone? Warning against Bragging
translation_verse: Mmeraahyɛlɛniɛ ne ndɛenbualɛniɛ komapɛ yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ɔ; ye ole bɔ ɔkora ode ngoa ná ɔsɛkye ne. Yiti wɔ ole nwa bɔ ebua ebiɛngo ndɛen ɔ? Nnɛfa ɛhema tu wɔ nwo

english_verse: You should know better than to say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to the city. We will do business there for a year and make a lot of money!”
translation_verse: Afei ɛ́mɔtie, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔkã kyɛ, “Ɛnɛ anaa ɛhema, yɛkɔhɔ kuro he anaa ɛhene aso yɛkooli berɛ afoɛ ko, yɛkɔtɔ ná yayɛ nningyein atɔen, ná yanya mvasoɛ.”

english_verse: What do you know about tomorrow? How can you be so sure about your life? It is nothing more than mist that appears for only a little while before it disappears.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔnze bɔ okosi ɛhema ɔ. Ɛmɔ ngoa te nzu? Ofikyɛ ɔte etutue bɔ ɔba mmerɛ kãa bie, ná afei watu wamini ɔ.

english_verse: You should say, “If the Lord lets us live, we will do these things.”
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔkã mmom ɛhe: “Sɛ Awurade boka ná yɛte ngoa nu a, yɛkɔyɔ he anaa ɛhene.”

english_verse: Yet you are stupid enough to brag, and it is wrong to be so proud.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔhoahoa ɛmɔ nwo wɔ ɛmɔ anwomasoɛ nu; na sɔ anwomasoɛ ne amukoraa te bɔne.

english_verse: If you don't do what you know is right, you have sinned.
translation_verse: Yiti ebiala bɔ ɔse paa bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔyɔ, nakoso ɔnyɔ ne, ɔte bɔne ma ye.

english_verse: You rich people should cry and weep! Terrible things are going to happen to you.
translation_verse: Afei ɛmɔ, esikafoɛ, ɔnate amaneɛ bɔ ɔ́ba ɛmɔ so ne ati, ɛ́mɔsu ná ɛ́mɔbɔ awuye!

english_verse: Your treasures have already rotted, and moths have eaten your clothes.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ anwonyadeɛ ne aporɔ, na mvrɔlɔ ali ɛmɔ ndena.

english_verse: Your money has rusted, and the rust will be evidence against you, as it burns your body like fire. Yet you keep on storing up wealth in these last days.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ ne ɛdwetɛ ali naakye, na bɛ nwo naakye ne kɔyɛ adanzeɛ kotia ɛmɔ, na okodidi ɛmɔ nwonaen kyɛ see. Ɛmɔaboaboa agyapadeɛ noa wɔ ngyẽa bɔ oli nziɛ ye anu.

english_verse: You refused to pay the people who worked in your fields, and now their unpaid wages are shouting out against you. The Lord All-Powerful has surely heard the cries of the workers who harvested your crops.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie! Apaafoɛ bɔ bɛyɔle ɛmɔ fieso adwuma ne, b’akatuaa bɔ ɛmɔnate asisie so bɛfa besiele ne, ɔtea nu; na bɛ bɔ bɛtele ɛmɔ fieso nnɔbaeɛ ne, bɛ suɛ ne waadwu Asafo Awurade so anu.

english_verse: While here on earth, you have thought only of filling your own stomachs and having a good time. But now you are like fat cattle on their way to be butchered.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ asetena nu wɔ aseɛ ye aso te anigye ne ahohwibra; na ɛmɔayɛ bɛ nwo twɔtwɔfee bama akumyɛɛ kyẽa ne.

english_verse: You have condemned and murdered innocent people, who couldn't even fight back. Be Patient and Kind
translation_verse: Ɛmɔabua teneneeniɛ foɛ bahũ ye, wɔ aberɛ bɔ onzi ɛmɔ ate ɔ. Ndoboaseɛ ne mbaeɛbɔlɛ

english_verse: My friends, be patient until the Lord returns. Think of farmers who wait patiently for the autumn and spring rains to make their valuable crops grow.
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔnya ndoboaseɛ maa oodwu kyɛ Awurade kɔwa ɔ. Ɛ́mɔtie, kuaniɛ bɔ ɔnwondɛ ma aseɛ kye aleɛ bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se ne, onya ye nwo aboterɛ maa okodwu kyɛ feefee ne asuso kotikye ɔ.

english_verse: Be patient like those farmers and don't give up. The Lord will soon be here!
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ koso, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔnya aboterɛ, ɛ́mɔmia ɛmɔ nye, ofikyɛ Awurade walɛ ne apingye.

english_verse: Don't grumble about each other or you will be judged, and the judge is right outside the door.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, nnɛma ɛmɔbobɔ kwaadu betiatia ɛmɔ nwo, ná bammua ɛmɔ ndɛen. Ɛ́mɔnea, ndɛenbualɛniɛ ne ogyi anoa nu berɛ.

english_verse: My friends, follow the example of the prophets who spoke for the Lord. They were patient, even when they had to suffer.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bedwudwole Awurade dumaa nu ne, ɛ́mɔfa bɛ bɛ́yɛ amaneɛnwunɛ ne aboterɛ nwo nhwɛsoɛ.

english_verse: In fact, we praise the ones who endured the most. You remember how patient Job was and how the Lord finally helped him. The Lord did this because he is so merciful and kind.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtie, bɛ bɔ bemiane bɛ nye bɛfale amaneɛ nu ne, yɛbu bɛ kyɛ banya saleɛ. Yeɛ ɛmɔate Yob amaneɛnwunɛ nu animia ne, na ɛmɔanwu kyɛbɔ Awurade maa osi yiele ye ɔ, kyɛbɔ Awurade anwumvoinnwunɛ sone, ná osa le tema maa ɔbo so ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, above all else, don't take an oath. You must not swear by heaven or by earth or by anything else. “Yes” or “No” is all you need to say. If you say anything more, you will be condemned.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛhe amukoraa asi ne, nnɛma ɛmɔta ndaen! Nnɛma ɛmɔfa nyameɛso anaa aseɛ anaa nikyee biala bɛta ndaen. Na mmom ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ “Yoo” yɛ yoo, ná ɛmɔ “Daabi” yɛ daabi, ná bammua ɛmɔ foɛ. Gyidie mbaeɛbɔlɛ

english_verse: If you are having trouble, you should pray. And if you are feeling good, you should sing praises.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ nu bie onwu amaneɛ anaa? Maa ɔbɔ mbaeɛ. Ebie nye agye anaa? Maa ɔto ayɛyelɛ dwein.

english_verse: If you are sick, ask the church leaders to come and pray for you. Ask them to put olive oil on you in the name of the Lord.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔ nu bie nde apɔ anaa? Maa ɔfrɛ asɔre mbanyi mɔ ma bɛɛbɔ mbaeɛ bɛma ye, ná bɛfa ngoo bɛpopa ye wɔ Awurade dumaa nu.

english_verse: If you have faith when you pray for sick people, they will get well. The Lord will heal them, and if they have sinned, he will forgive them.
translation_verse: Gyidie mbaeɛ kole yarefoɛ ne ngoa, na Awurade kɔpagya ye; na sɛ wayɔ bɔne a, ɔkɔfa kɔhyɛ ye.

english_verse: If you have sinned, you should tell each other what you have done. Then you can pray for one another and be healed. The prayer of an innocent person is powerful, and it can help a lot.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔkekã ɛmɔ mvomsoɛ behyirehyire ɛmɔ nwo, ná ɛ́mɔbobɔ mbaeɛ bɛma ɛmɔ nwo, amaa ɛmɔate apɔ. Na teneneeniɛ mbaeɛ bɔ nu yɛ se ne, ɔkora yɔ nikyee biala.

english_verse: Elijah was just as human as we are, and for three and a half years his prayers kept the rain from falling.
translation_verse: Né Elia te sona kyɛ yɛ ala, na ɔbɔle mbaeɛ serɛserɛ kyɛ nnɛma esue tɔ, na esue andɔ aseɛ so alaa afoɛ nza ne bosome nzia.

english_verse: But when he did pray for rain, it fell from the skies and made the crops grow.
translation_verse: Na afei ɔbɔle mbaeɛ bieku, na nyameɛso tɔle nzue, na aseɛ suli ye aleɛ.

english_verse: My friends, if any followers have wandered away from the truth, you should try to lead them back.
translation_verse: Nniɛma mɔ, sɛ ɛmɔ nu bie di nahorɛ ne nwo makyebu, ná ebie sa fa ye ba a,

english_verse: If you turn sinners from the wrong way, you will save them from death, and many of their sins will be forgiven.
translation_verse: ɛ́mɔkaye kyɛ, ebiala bɔ ɔkɔfa bɔnefoɛ kofi ye makyebu atee so kosa kɔwa ne, okole ye kra kofi ewue nu, na ɔkɔkata bɔne pee so.

english_verse: From Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ. To God's people who are scattered like foreigners in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia.
translation_verse: Petro, Yesu Kristo somafoɛ, méfa mebrɛ bɛ bɔ babɔ aya bahɔ Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia ne Bitinia,

english_verse: God the Father decided to choose you as his people, and his Spirit has made you holy. You have obeyed Jesus Christ and are sprinkled with his blood. I pray that God will be kind to you and will keep on giving you peace! A Real Reason for Hope
translation_verse: bɛ bɔ Baba Nyameɛ waneanea nu waye bɛ fi tetetete, bɔ ɔnate Sunzum Krongron so wate bɛ nwo wama Yesu Kristo nwo sotie ɔne ye mogya nu anwopetenɛ ne: Adom ne asomdwee mmorosoɛ ɔyɛ ɛmɔ deɛ. Anyelasoɛ bɔ ngoa wɔ nu

english_verse: Praise God, the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God is so good, and by raising Jesus from death, he has given us new life and a hope that lives on.
translation_verse: Animnyam hã Nyameɛ, y’Awurade Yesu Kristo Baba ne, bɔ ɔnate ye anwumvoinnwunɛ mmorosoɛ ti wafa Yesu Kristo awufoɛ nu ewutingyelɛ ne aso wawo yɛ foforɛ maa yanya anyelasoɛ bɔ ngoa wɔ nu,

english_verse: God has something stored up for you in heaven, where it will never decay or be ruined or disappear.
translation_verse: maa yanya agyapadeɛ bɔ ɔmborɔ, bɔ ngekalewa nne ye nwo, bɔ ɔmbɛ nu ngɔ, bɔ bafa basie nyameɛso bama ɛmɔ

english_verse: You have faith in God, whose power will protect you until the last day. Then he will save you, just as he has always planned to do.
translation_verse: bɔ bɛnate gyidie so bɛbɔ ɛmɔ nwo waen wɔ Nyameɛ tumi nu, bɔ ɔkɔ ngoalelɛ bɔ basiesie kyɛ bɛbaala ye ali wɔ mmerɛ bɔ oli nziɛ ne anu ne.

english_verse: On that day you will be glad, even if you have to go through many hard trials for a while.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe nu yeɛ ɛmɔdi ahurusi paa ɔ, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ kekesaala ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔ wora bɔ kãa, ɔnate nzɔhwɛ ahoroɔ ne ati,

english_verse: Your faith will be like gold that has been tested in a fire. And these trials will prove that your faith is worth much more than gold that can be destroyed. They will show that you will be given praise and honor and glory when Jesus Christ returns.
translation_verse: amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔ gyidie ne—bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se tra sikaa kɔkorɛ, bɔ ɔwɔ nu kyɛ beso bɛnea wɔ see nu po, nakoso ɔsɛkye ne—wakakyi ayɛyelɛ, anidie ne animnyam wɔ Yesu Kristo nwo aliyelɛ ne anu.

english_verse: You have never seen Jesus, and you don't see him now. But still you love him and have faith in him, and no words can tell how glad and happy
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɛmɔnnwuni ye, nakoso ɛmɔkuro ye dwirɛ; ɔwɔ nu kyɛ kekesaala ye de ɛmɔnnwu ye, nakoso ɛmɔde ye bedi, na ɛmɔanya anigye bɔ olle kabea bɔ animnyam wɔ nu ɔ,

english_verse: you are to be saved. This is why you have faith.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ɛmɔgu so benya ɛmɔ gyidie ne nwo akatuaa, bɔ ɔte ngoalelɛ ma ɛmɔ kra ɔ.

english_verse: Some prophets told how God would treat you with undeserved grace, and they searched hard to find out more about the way you would be saved.
translation_verse: Na ɔfa ngoalelɛ he anwo de, ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛhyɛle adom bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ deɛ ne nwo ngɔm ne, bɛfeefeele nu, na bɛpɛnzɛpɛnzɛle nu.

english_verse: The Spirit of Christ was in them and was telling them how Christ would suffer and would then be given great honor. So they searched to find out exactly who Christ would be and when this would happen.
translation_verse: Bɛbɔle mmɔden kyɛ bekonwu mmerɛ horɛ, anaa mmerɛ ahoroɔ mɔ bɔ Kristo Sunzum bɔ né ɔte bɛ nu ne ɔda ye ali ɔ, mmerɛ bɔ olili moa lili Kristo amaneɛnwunɛ nwo adanzeɛ, ɔne animnyam bɔ ɔtoa so ne.

english_verse: But they were told that they were serving you and not themselves. They preached to you by the power of the Holy Spirit, who was sent from heaven. And their message was only for you, even though angels would like to know more about it. Chosen To Live a Holy Life
translation_verse: Na bɛlale ye ali behyirele bɛ kyɛ, nna bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ nwo, na mmom yɛ yeɛ né bɛyɔ ɛsolɛ adwuma ne bɛma yɛ ɔ, wɔ edwirɛ mɔ bɔ kekesaala ye yɛbɔ ye dawure yɛkyire ɛmɔ ne anu, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛnate Sunzum Krongron bɔ basoma ye fi nyameɛso so bɛɛhane nzɛmba ne behyirele ɛmɔ ne. Na sɔ dwirɛ nemɔ yeɛ abɔfo mɔ po bekuro kyɛ benwu nu ɔ. Brabɔlɛ bɔ ye nwo te ɔ

english_verse: Be alert and think straight. Put all your hope in how God will treat you with undeserved grace when Jesus Christ appears.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔsiesie ɛmɔ adwene ma osi pi, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye la berɛ, ná ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ anyelasoɛ amukoraa ówura adom bɔ Yesu Kristo kɔfa kɔbrɛ ɛmɔ wɔ ye nwo aliyelɛ ne anu.

english_verse: Behave like obedient children. Don't let your lives be controlled by your desires, as they used to be.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔyɛ kyɛ ngwadaa bɔ bɛ so yɛ mmerɛ ɔ, na akɔnnɔ bra bɔ daa ne né ɛmɔnze ti ɛmɔbɔle ne, nnɛma ɛmɔsa bekodi ye si.

english_verse: Always live as God's holy people should, because God is the one who chose you, and he is holy.
translation_verse: Na mmom, kyɛbɔ bɔ ɔfrɛle ɛmɔ ne ɔte krongron ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛ́mɔyɛ krongron wɔ ɛmɔ brabɔlɛ amukoraa nu ɔ.

english_verse: That's why the Scriptures say, “I am the holy God, and you must be holy too.”
translation_verse: Ɔnate kyɛ, bahyerɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔyɛ krongron, ofikyɛ me, nde krongron.”

english_verse: You say that God is your Father, but God doesn't have favorites! He judges all people by what they do. So you must honor God while you live as strangers here on earth.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔfrɛ bɔ ɔnnea sona nyunu yeɛ obua ndɛen kyɛbɔ ebiala nnwumaa te ɔ kyɛ Baba a, ye de ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfa esuronyi bɛbɔ ɛmɔ bra wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔaayɛ amanvrafoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You were rescued from the useless way of life you learned from your ancestors. But you know you were not rescued by such things as silver or gold that don't last forever.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛmɔse kyɛ, bra fiɛ bɔ ɛmɔ nana mɔ fa yakyili ɛmɔ ne, nna nningyein bɔ bɛporɔ te kyɛ ɛdwetɛ anaa sikaa kɔkorɛ yeɛ bɛfa bɛyɛle ɛmɔ ti nyɔboɛ bɛpɔle ɛmɔ befili nu ɔ,

english_verse: Christ was chosen even before the world was created, but because of you, he did not come until these last days.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ bɛyele ye besiele berɛ koraka yeɛ bɛbaabɔ wiase ɔ, nakoso ɔnate ɛmɔ ti yeɛ bala ye ali bahyire wɔ mmerɛ bɔ oli nziɛ ye anu ɔ.

english_verse: And when he did come, it was to lead you to have faith in God, who raised him from death and honored him in a glorious way. This is why you have put your faith and hope in God.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate ye so yeɛ ɛmɔde Nyameɛ bɔ otingyele ye fili awufoɛ nu ná ɔhyɛle ye animnyam ne bedi ɔ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanya gyidie ne anyelasoɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nu.

english_verse: You obeyed the truth, and your souls were made pure. Now you sincerely love each other. But you must keep on loving with all your heart.
translation_verse: Asoɛmmerɛlɛ bɔ ɛmɔayɛ bama nahorɛ ne ne ati, wamaa ɛmɔate ɛmɔ kra nwo, na ɛhe amaa ɛmɔahurohuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ wɔ nahorɛ nu, yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔfi ɛmɔ ahone nu bekurokuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ.

english_verse: The Scriptures say, “Humans wither like grass, and their glory fades like wild flowers. Grass dries up, and flowers fall to the ground.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ “Anwoɔnaen amukoraa te kyɛ ndire, na sona animnyam amukoraa te kyɛ ndire bɔ wabɔ nyerɛen ɔ. Ndire kese, na ye nyerɛen poro gua;

english_verse: But what the Lord has said will stand forever.” Our good news to you is what the Lord has said.
translation_verse: nakoso Awurade dwirɛ de, otimu berɛ afebɔɔ.” Na edwirɛ he ole nzɛmba bɔ babɔ ye dawure bahyire ɛmɔ ne.

english_verse: Stop being hateful! Quit trying to fool people, and start being sincere. Don't be jealous or say cruel things about others.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔgyi bɔne yɔleɛ amukoraa, nnakannaka amukoraa, nyaatwomyɛlɛ, ɛpɔen ne nzekure amukoraa bégua.

english_verse: Be like newborn babies who are thirsty for the pure spiritual milk that will help you grow and be saved.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔte kyɛ nnɔma bɔ bawo bɛ foforɛ ɔ, yiti ɛ́mɔpena sunzum nu nyɔfonesue bɔ ye nwo te ɔ, amaa ɔnate so ɛmɔanyi nu bahɔ ngoalelɛ nu,

english_verse: You have already found out how good the Lord really is.
translation_verse: mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔanwu kyɛ Awurade te paa ne.

english_verse: Come to Jesus Christ. He is the living stone people have rejected, but which God has chosen and highly honored.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔbra ye berɛ, ngoa nyɔboɛ ne, bɔ mmenia apo ye, nakoso Nyameɛ de, waneanea nu waye ye, bɔ odi mu ne;

english_verse: And now you are living stones being used to build a spiritual house. You are also a group of holy priests, and with the help of Jesus Christ you will offer sacrifices that please God.
translation_verse: na ɛmɔ koso, ɛmɔte kyɛ ngoa nyɔboɛ mɔ, na ɛ́mɔma bɛ́fa ɛmɔ bési sunzum nu sua ma ɛmɔyɛ asɔfokure krongron, amaa ɛmɔafa Yesu Kristo so babɔ sunzum nu afɔleɛ bɔ ɔsɔ Nyameɛ nye ɔ.

english_verse: It is just as God says in the Scriptures, “Look! I am placing in Zion a choice and precious cornerstone. No one who has faith in this one will be disappointed.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔwɔ Ahyerɛlɛ ne anu kyɛ: “Tie, méfa ndweasoɛ nyɔboɛ titire bɔ maneanea nu maye ye, ná odi mu ɔ meto Sion, na ebiala bɔ ode ye di ne, ye nyunu ngogua ase.”

english_verse: You are followers of the Lord, and this stone is precious to you. But it isn't precious to those who refuse to follow him. They are the builders who tossed aside the stone that turned out to be the most important one of all.
translation_verse: Na ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔde ye bedi ne de, odi mu ma ɛmɔ; nakoso bɛ bɔ benne benni ne de, “Nyɔboɛ bɔ suasilɛfoɛ bɛpole ye ne, ye ala yeɛ waayɛ sua ne ndweasoɛ nyɔboɛ titire ɔ;

english_verse: They disobeyed the message and stumbled and fell over this stone, because they were doomed.
translation_verse: yeɛ ɔte sundidua nyɔboɛ ne sundiduatolɛ nyɔbotaen ma bɛ.” Na befi ase, ofikyɛ bɛyɛ edwirɛ ne nwo asoserɛ, kyɛbɔ b’ayieleɛ nhyehyɛleɛ te ne ala.

english_verse: But you are God's chosen and special people. You are a group of royal priests and a holy nation. God has brought you out of darkness into his marvelous light. Now you must tell all the wonderful things he has done. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ɛmɔte mmenia bɔ baneanea nu baye ɛmɔ ɔ, nnehyeɛ asɔfokure, maen krongron, maen bɔ wafa ye wayɛ ye deɛ ɔ, kyɛ ɛmɔɔbɔ bɔ ɔfrɛle ɛmɔ fili awosii nu wale ye kanea bɔ ɔyɛ nwanwa ne anu ne, ye ayɛyelɛ ne dawure.

english_verse: “Once you were nobody. Now you are God's people. At one time no one had mercy on you. Now God has treated you with kindness.” Live as God's Servants Should
translation_verse: Daa ne de, né ahaa ɛmɔtte maen, nakoso afei de, ɛmɔte Nyameɛ maen; daa ne de, né onnwuni ɛmɔ anwumvoin, nakoso afei de, wanwu ɛmɔ anwumvoin. Nyameɛ ngoaa

english_verse: Dear friends, you are foreigners and strangers on this earth. So I beg you not to surrender to those desires that fight against you.
translation_verse: Adɔfo mɔ, mesrɛ ɛmɔ, ɛmɔte ɛwɔfoɛ ne amanvrafoɛ, yiti anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ bɔ ɔko tia ɛmɔ kra ne, ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo befi ye nwo.

english_verse: Always let others see you behaving properly, even though they may still accuse you of doing wrong. Then on the day of judgment, they will honor God by telling the good things they saw you do.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ nemɔ bɛkekã ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ kyɛ ɛmɔte bɔnefoɛ de, nakoso ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ bra yɛ sannwuu wɔ bɛ nu, amaa banwu ɛmɔ bra paa ne, ná bahyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam wɔ kyẽa bɔ ɔkɔwa ne.

english_verse: The Lord wants you to obey all human authorities, especially the Emperor, who rules over everyone.
translation_verse: Ɔnate Awurade ti, ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛ́ma tumililɛ amukoraa: kyɛ ɛhene berembɔn ne ahɔ oo,

english_verse: You must also obey governors, because they are sent by the Emperor to punish criminals and to praise good citizens.
translation_verse: anaa amrado mɔ bɔ ɔsoma bɛ maa bɛkɔtwe nzɛmmɔnefoɛ so, ná bɛkamvo bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ahɔ oo.

english_verse: God wants you to silence stupid and ignorant people by doing right.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔ Nyameɛ kuro kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɛhe: kyɛ ɛmɔkɔfa ɛmɔ bra paa ne bɛkɔhã ngwaseafoɛ noa bɛkɔto nu ɔ.

english_verse: You are free, but still you are God's servants, and you must not use your freedom as an excuse for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔbɔ ɛmɔ bra kyɛ fawɔnwodifoɛ, nakoso nnɛma ɛmɔfa ɛmɔ fawɔnwodi ne bɛkatakata ɛmɔ nyunu bɛyɔ bɔ ɔte bɔne ɔ; na mmom ɛ́mɔbɔ ɛmɔ bra kyɛ Nyameɛ ngoaa.

english_verse: Respect everyone and show special love for God's people. Honor God and respect the Emperor. The Example of Christ's Suffering
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa anidie bɛ́ma mmenia amukoraa! Ɛ́mɔhurohuro aliɛmaa mɔ agyidifoɛ dwirɛ! Ɛ́mɔsuro Nyameɛ! Ɛ́mɔfa anidie bɛ́ma ɛhene ne! Kristo amaneɛnwunɛ te nhwɛsoɛ

english_verse: Servants, you must obey your masters and always show respect to them. Do this, not only to those who are kind and thoughtful, but also to those who are cruel.
translation_verse: Ngoaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔfa esuronyi amukoraa bɛbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛ́ma ɛmɔ mene mɔ. Nna meneɛ mɔ bɔ bɛte paa ná bedwo angome, na mmom meneɛ atianuserɛfoɛ koso bɛboka so.

english_verse: God will bless you, even if others treat you unfairly for being loyal to him.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛhe te animnyam, kyɛ wɔ tiboa se Nyameɛ ti, emia wɔ nye edi aworabɔlɛ enwu amaneɛ bɔ ɔmvata ɔ.

english_verse: You don't gain anything by being punished for some wrong you have done. But God will bless you, if you have to suffer for doing something good.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔtte mayee, ná bɛbo ɛmɔ wɔ ye nwo a, nzikyɛ animnyam yeɛ ɛmɔnya ɔ? Nakoso sɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa, ná ɛmɔmia ɛmɔ nye benwu ye nwo amaneɛ a, ɔsɔ anyeɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: After all, God chose you to suffer as you follow in the footsteps of Christ, who set an example by suffering for you.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ati yeɛ bɛfrɛle ɛmɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ ɔnate yɛ ti Kristo koso nwuni amaneɛ, na ɔfa yɛle nhwɛsoɛ mane yɛ, kyɛ ɛmɔ koso ɛ́mɔtu ye agyirɛ ne bie.

english_verse: Christ did not sin or ever tell a lie.
translation_verse: Ye de, wanyɔ bɔne, biala, yeɛ ngondombo dwirɛ biala amvi ye noa.

english_verse: Although he was abused, he never tried to get even. And when he suffered, he made no threats. Instead, he had faith in God, who judges fairly.
translation_verse: Bɛpepɛle ye nzoaa nen, wangakyi wamma bɛ; mmerɛ bɔ né onwu amaneɛ nen, wannwunanwuna; na mmom ɔfale ye nwo wurale bɔ obua ndɛen turoloo ne sa.

english_verse: Christ carried the burden of our sins. He was nailed to the cross, so we would stop sinning and start living right. By his cuts and bruises you are healed.
translation_verse: Ye bɔbɔ yeɛ ɔsoale yɛ bɔne wɔ ye nipadua nu hɔle bakaa ne aso ɔ, kyɛ, sɛ yawu yafi bɔne nu de a, ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛtena ase yɛma tenenee. Na ye nwo beabealɛ ne yeɛ wafa wasa ɛmɔ anwonyerɛ ɔ.

english_verse: You had wandered away like sheep. Now you have returned to the one who is your shepherd and protector.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ, ahaa né ɛmɔte kyɛ mmoaen bɔ bamini ɔ, nakoso kekesaala ye de, ɛmɔasa bawa ɛmɔ kra so Neafoɛ ne Wɛmvoɛ ne berɛ.

english_verse: If you are a wife, you must put your husband first. Even if he opposes our message, you will win him over by what you do. No one else will have to say anything to him,
translation_verse: Yeɛ mɔ, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bɛ́ma ɛmɔ bɔbɔ bɛ hu mɔ ɔ; na sɛ ɔba kyɛ bɛ nu biemɔ benne edwirɛ ne benni a, bafa bɛ ye mɔ suban so, bɔ nna bɛ noa dwirɛ ahɔ ɔ basakyera;

english_verse: because he will see how you honor God and live a pure life.
translation_verse: sɛ benwu ɛmɔ brabɔlɛ sannwuu bɔ esurolɛ wɔ nu ne a.

english_verse: Don't depend on things like fancy hairdos or gold jewelry or expensive clothes to make you look beautiful.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ nwo siesielɛ ne ɔyɛ anwoɔnaen nu nikye, bɔ ɔte tirebɔlɛ, sikaa kɔkorɛ mbembenanneɛ, anaa ndena paa heralɛ;

english_verse: Be beautiful in your heart by being gentle and quiet. This kind of beauty will last, and God considers it very special.
translation_verse: na mmom ɛ́mɔma ɔyɛ ahone nu nikyee bɔ anyeɛ nnwu ye, sunzum bɔ odwo, ɔbrɛ ye nwo ase, nikyee bɔ ɔmborɔ, bɔ ɔte nikyee nyɔboɛserɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: Long ago those women who worshiped God and put their hope in him made themselves beautiful by putting their husbands first.
translation_verse: Na sɔ atee he aso yeɛ daa tete mmrasua krongron bɔ bɛfale bɛ wora bewurale Nyameɛ nu ne besiesiele bɛ nwo ɔ, na bɛbrɛle bɛ nwo ase bɛmane bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ hu mɔ,

english_verse: For example, Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him her master. You are her true children, if you do right and don't let anything frighten you.
translation_verse: kyɛbɔ Sara yɛle sotie mane Abraham ná ɔfrɛle ye ye mene ne. Na sɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa, ná ɛmɔamma ɛserɛ anzi ɛmɔ ate a, ye de ɛmɔte ye mma mmrasua.

english_verse: If you are a husband, you should be thoughtful of your wife. Treat her with honor, because she isn't as strong as you are, and she shares with you in the gift of life. Then nothing will stand in the way of your prayers. Suffering for Doing Right
translation_verse: Huɛ mɔ, ɛmɔ koso, ɛmɔ ne ɛmɔ aye mɔ bɛ́tena ndeaseɛ nu sɔ ala. Ɛ́mɔfa anidie bɛ́ma ɛmɔ aye mɔ, kyɛ bɛte mmenia bɔ bɛyɛ mmerɛ ɔ, kyɛ bɛboka ɛmɔ so yeɛ ɛmɔle kyɛfa wɔ ngoa adom ne anu ɔ; ná nikye fee wanzi ɛmɔ mbaeɛ ate. Paayɛlɛ nu amaneɛnwunɛ

english_verse: Finally, all of you should agree and have concern and love for each other. You should also be kind and humble.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, ɛmɔ amukoraa ɛ́mɔnya adwene ko, ɛ́mɔnwunwu ɛmɔ nwo anwumvoin, ɛmɔhurohuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ kyɛ aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔnya tema bɛ́ma ɛmɔ nwo, na ɛ́mɔdwene anwobrɛaseɛ adwene.

english_verse: Don't be hateful and insult people just because they are hateful and insult you. Instead, treat everyone with kindness. You are God's chosen ones, and he will bless you. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔfa bɔne betua bɔne so, anaa nzoaapepɛlɛ betua nzoaapepɛlɛ so; na mmom ɛ́mɔyirayira; ofikyɛ ɛhe ati yeɛ bɛfrɛle ɛmɔ ɔ, kyɛ ɛmɔɔnya saleɛ.

english_verse: “Do you really love life? Do you want to be happy? Then stop saying cruel things and quit telling lies.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sona biala bɔ okuro ngoa ná ɔpena kyɛ onwu asetena paa nen, nnɛmaa ɔfa ye noa kekã musue dwirɛ, yeɛ nnɛma nnakannaka dwirɛ fite ye noa.

english_verse: Give up your evil ways and do right, as you find and follow the road to peace.
translation_verse: Maa ohyi bɔne ná ɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ; maa ɔpena asomdwee boso ná oli ye si.

english_verse: The Lord watches over everyone who obeys him, and he listens to their prayers. But he opposes everyone who does evil.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Awurade nye wɔ teneneefoɛ so, na ɔyɛ asoɛ ma bɛ mbaeɛ; nakoso bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ bɔne de, Awurade nye sa bɛ.

english_verse: Can anyone really harm you for being eager to do good deeds?
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔfa besie ɛmɔ nye so kyɛ ɛmɔyɔ bɔ ɔte paa a, nwa yeɛ ɔkɔha ɛmɔ ɔ?

english_verse: Even if you have to suffer for doing good things, God will bless you. So stop being afraid and don't worry about what people might do.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ tenenee ti ɛmɔnwu amaneɛ a, ɔte saleɛ ma ɛmɔ. Nnɛmɔma bɛ nwo suronyi tɔ ɛmɔ so, yeɛ nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ kunu tete ɛmɔ;

english_verse: Honor Christ and let him be the Lord of your life. Always be ready to give an answer when someone asks you about your hope.
translation_verse: na mmom ɛ́mɔma Awurade Kristo ɔyɛ krongron wɔ ɛmɔ ahone nu. Na mmerɛ biala, ɛ́mɔboaboa ɛmɔ nwo bésie, amaa sɛ ebie bisa ɛmɔ dwirɛ fa anyelasoɛ bɔ ɔwɔ ɛmɔ nu ne nwo a, ɛmɔahora baye ye noa bahyire ye wɔ anwobrɛaseɛ ne anidie nu.

english_verse: Give a kind and respectful answer and keep your conscience clear. This way you will make people ashamed for saying bad things about your good conduct as a follower of Christ.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ tiboa obua ɛmɔ be, amaa sɛ bɛto ɛmɔ soen a, bɛ bɔ bɛkekã ɛmɔ Kristo nu bra paa ne nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ ne, bɛ nyunu agua ase.

english_verse: You are better off to obey God and suffer for doing right than to suffer for doing wrong.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Nyameɛ kuro kyɛ ɛmɔnwu bra paa nu amaneɛ a, ye sɔ te paa tra kyɛ ɛmɔkonwu amaneɛ wɔ bɔneyɔlɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: Christ died once for our sins. An innocent person died for those who are guilty. Christ did this to bring you to God, when his body was put to death and his spirit was made alive.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Kristo koso nwuni bɔne nwo amaneɛ pɛenko; ye bɔ ɔtengyɛ ne, onwuni amaneɛ mane bɛ bɔ bɛndengyɛ ɔ, amaa ɔnate so wafa yɛ wahɔ Nyameɛ berɛ. Behuni ye wɔ anwoɔnaen nu, nakoso bɛfale ye bɛwale ngoa nu wɔ Sunzum nu,

english_verse: Christ then preached to the spirits that were being kept in prison.
translation_verse: na nu koso yeɛ ɔɔbɔle nzɛmba ne dawure hyirele sunzum mɔ bɔ begua kukunu,

english_verse: They had disobeyed God while Noah was building the boat, but God had been patient with them. Eight people went into that boat and were brought safely through the flood.
translation_verse: bɔ daa tete mmerɛ bɛyɛle asoserɛ, mmerɛ bɔ Nyameɛ nwondɛle aboterɛ nu wɔ Nowa aberɛ so, bɔ né ɔ́bobɔ ɛlɛen alaka ne. Sɔ mmerɛ ne, mmenia kãa bie, bɔ bɛte mmɔtwɛ ɔ yeɛ bɛfale nzue so belele bɛ ngoa ɔ.

english_verse: Those flood waters were like baptism that now saves you. But baptism is more than just washing your body. It means turning to God with a clear conscience, because Jesus Christ was raised from death.
translation_verse: Na sɔ nzue ne sɛso, ye ole asubɔlɛ bɔ ode ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔ ngoa ɛnɛ ne. Ɔtte anwoɔnaen nu fiɛ nwunzinɛ, na mmom ɔte tiboa paa nwo abisadeɛ bɔ yɛfa Yesu Kristo wutingyelɛ ne aso yɛfa yɛto Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: Christ is now in heaven, where he sits at the right side of God. All angels, authorities, and powers are under his control.
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ɔhɔle nyameɛso ne, na ɔte Nyameɛ sa famaa so; na abɔfo mɔ ne anwoserɛ mɔ ne tumi mɔ babrɛ bɛ nwo ase bawura ye bo.

english_verse: Christ suffered here on earth. Now you must be ready to suffer as he did, because suffering shows that you have stopped sinning.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ ɔnate yɛ ti yeɛ Kristo nwuni amaneɛ wɔ anwoɔnaen nu ne, ɛmɔ koso, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔnya sɔ adwene ne ná ɛmɔmia ɛmɔ nye; ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ wanwu anwoɔnaen nu amaneɛ ne, wayakyi bɔne yɔlɛ;

english_verse: It means you have turned from your own desires and want to obey God for the rest of your life.
translation_verse: na anwoɔnaen nu asetena mmerɛ bɔ waha ne, ɔndena ase mma sona akɔnnɔ ko, na mmom ɔtena ase ma Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ.

english_verse: You have already lived long enough like people who don't know God. You were immoral and followed your evil desires. You went around drinking and partying and carrying on. In fact, you even worshiped disgusting idols.
translation_verse: Yɛbɔle yɛ bra kyɛ Amaenmaensofoɛ wɔ y’asetena mmerɛ bɔ wapɛ nu ne anu, na yɛbɔle yɛ bra wɔ ahohwibra, akɔnnɔ, nzaabolɛ, bɔne nu anigye, asanzabra, yeɛ bosoensolɛ bɔ ɔte akyiwadeɛ ɔ nu.

english_verse: Now your former friends wonder why you have stopped running around with them, and they curse you for it.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɛ bɛ nwanwa kyɛ afei de, ɛmɔmva ɛmɔ nwo bɛmmɔ bɛ wɔ sɔ bra fiɛ basabasa ne anu ɔ, yiti bɛkekã ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ.

english_verse: But they will have to answer to God, who judges the living and the dead.
translation_verse: Nakoso bekobu ye nwo ngondaa bekohyire bɔ wasiesie ye nwo kyɛ ɔbaabua ateasefoɛ ne awufoɛ ndɛen ne.

english_verse: The good news has even been preached to the dead, so that after they have been judged for what they have done in this life, their spirits will live with God.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe ati yeɛ bɛhane nzɛmba ne behyirele awufoɛ mɔ po ɔ, amaa ɔnate so babua bɛ ndɛen kyɛ mmenia bɔ bɛwɔ anwoɔnaen nu ɔ, ná batena ase wɔ sunzum nu kyɛ Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Everything will soon come to an end. So be serious and be sensible enough to pray.
translation_verse: Nakoso nningyein amukoraa ayieleɛ apingye; yiti ɛ́mɔnya adwene paa ná ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye la berɛ ma mbaeɛbɔlɛ.

english_verse: Most important of all, you must sincerely love each other, because love wipes away many sins.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔtra so ɔ, ɛmɔhurohuro ɛmɔ nwo dwirɛ nahorɛ nu, ofikyɛ ɔdɔ kata bɔne pee so.

english_verse: Welcome people into your home and don't grumble about it.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔte ɛmɔ nyunu bɛso ɛmɔ nwo ɛmɔ nwo wɔfoɛ.

english_verse: Each of you has been blessed with one of God's many wonderful gifts to be used in the service of others. So use your gift well.
translation_verse: Na kyɛbɔ ɛmɔ nu biala wanya adom akyɛdeɛ ne, ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́so ɛmɔ nwo ɛmɔ nwo, kyɛ Nyameɛ adom ahoroɔ ne nwo neafoɛ paa mɔ.

english_verse: If you have the gift of speaking, preach God's message. If you have the gift of helping others, do it with the strength that God supplies. Everything should be done in a way that will bring honor to God because of Jesus Christ, who is glorious and powerful forever. Amen. Suffering for Being a Christian
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie dwudwo a, maa ɔhã ye kyɛ Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ɔ; sɛ ebie ɔyɔ ɛsolɛ adwuma a, maa ɔfa anwoserɛ bɔ Nyameɛ afa ama ye ne ɔso; amaa ɔnate so bafa Yesu Kristo so bahyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam wɔ nningyein amukoraa nu. Ye yeɛ animnyam ne tumi te ye deɛ daa daa ɔ. Amen. Kristofoɛ amaneɛnwunɛ

english_verse: Dear friends, don't be surprised or shocked that you are going through testing that is like walking through fire.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, amaneɛ yeayea bɔ ɔtoto ɛmɔ bɔ bɛfa beso ɛmɔ bɛnea ne, nnɛmɔma ɔyɛ ɛmɔ nwanwa, kyɛ ebiaa ɔte nikyee foforɛ bie yeɛ ɔtoto ɛmɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Be glad for the chance to suffer as Christ suffered. It will prepare you for even greater happiness when he makes his glorious return.
translation_verse: Na mmom, ɛ́mɔma ɔyɛ ɛmɔ fɛ kyɛ ɛmɔnwu Kristo amaneɛ ne bie ɔ, amaa sɛ bɛye ye animnyam ne ali a, ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔali ahurusi ná ɛmɔ nye agye.

english_verse: Count it a blessing when you suffer for being a Christian. This shows that God's glorious Spirit is with you.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔnate Kristo dumaa ti bɛbɔ ɛmɔ alapaa a, ɔte saleɛ ma ɛmɔ; ofikyɛ animnyam sunzum, Nyameɛ sunzum ne, ɔwɔ ɛmɔ so.

english_verse: But you deserve to suffer if you are a murderer, a thief, a crook, or a busybody.
translation_verse: Nakoso nnɛmɔma ɛmɔ nu bie yɛ wudiniɛ anaa awueniɛ anaa bɔnefoɛ anaa ɔyɛ ebie dwirɛ nwo nwondononwondono ná onwu ye nwo amaneɛ.

english_verse: Don't be ashamed to suffer for being a Christian. Praise God that you belong to him.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ebie te Kristoniɛ ti, ná onwu amaneɛ a, nnɛmaa ɔyɛ ye nya; na mmom maa ɔhyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam kyɛ sɔ dumaa ne la ye so ɔ.

english_verse: God has already begun judging his own people. And if his judgment begins with us, imagine how terrible it will be for those who refuse to obey his message. The Scriptures say,
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmerɛ ne adwu kyɛ ndɛenbualɛ hyɛ ye bo wɔ Nyameɛ awuro ɔ. Na sɛ bɛfa yɛ bɛhyɛ ye bo a, nzaade bɛ bɔ bɛyɛ Nyameɛ nzɛmba ne nwo asoserɛ ne de, okoyie bɛ sɛ?

english_verse: “If good people barely escape, what will happen to sinners and to others who don't respect God?”
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɔyɛ se kyɛ bekole sona bɔ ɔtengyɛ ngoa a, né nzaade sona bɔ onzuro Nyameɛ, yeɛ bɔnefoɛ begyi ye sɛ?

english_verse: If you suffer for obeying God, you must have complete faith in your faithful Creator and keep on doing right.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛ bɔ ɔnate Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ ti benwu amaneɛ ne, maa bɛfa bɛ kra bewura Ɛdangama bɔ ɔte nahorɛniɛ ne sa, ná bɛhɔ so bɛyɔ bɔ ɔte paa ɔ.

english_verse: Church leaders, I am writing to encourage you. I too am a leader, as well as a witness to Christ's suffering, and I will share in his glory when it is shown to us.
translation_verse: Yiti me bɔ nde ɛmɔ aliɛma panyi ɔne Kristo amaneɛnwunɛ nwo danzeniɛ, bɔ ngosa ngonya kyɛfa wɔ animnyam bɔ bɛbaaye ye ali ne anu ne, métu ɛmɔ nu mbanyi nemɔ foɛ kyɛ,

english_verse: Just as shepherds watch over their sheep, you must watch over everyone God has placed in your care. Do it willingly in order to please God, and not simply because you think you must. Let it be something you want to do, instead of something you do merely to make money.
translation_verse: ɛ́mɔnea Nyameɛ mmoaen kure bɔ owura ɛmɔ sa ne aso, bɔ nna nhyɛsoɛ so ɔ, na mmom kyɛ ɛmɔkofia ɛmɔ kunu bɛkɔnea bɛ so kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ pena ɔ; bɔ nna adifuu ti ɔ, na mmom kyɛ ofi ɛmɔ ahone nu ti ɔ;

english_verse: Don't be bossy to those people who are in your care, but set an example for them.
translation_verse: bɔ ɔnzɛ kyɛ ɛmɔhyɛ bɛ bɔ bewura ɛmɔ sa ne aso, na mmom kyɛ ɛ́mɔyɛ nhwɛsoɛ bɛ́ma mmoaen kure ne ɔ.

english_verse: Then when Christ the Chief Shepherd returns, you will be given a crown that will never lose its glory.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Mmoaenneafoɛ panyi ne ɔye ye nwo ali a, ɛmɔkonya animnyam abotire bɔ ɔnzɛkye koraa ne.

english_verse: All of you young people should obey your elders. In fact, everyone should be humble toward everyone else. The Scriptures say, “God opposes proud people, but he helps everyone who is humble.”
translation_verse: Sɔ ala yeɛ ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔte mmabunu ne koso, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase bewura mbanyi mɔ bo ɔ. Ɛmɔ amukoraa, ɛ́mɔfa anwobrɛaseɛ bɛ́hera, ná ɛ́mɔfa bɛ́so ɛmɔ nwo ngoko ngoko, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ nye sa anwomasoɛfoɛ, na ɔdo anwobrɛaseɛfoɛ.

english_verse: Be humble in the presence of God's mighty power, and he will honor you when the time comes.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔbrɛ ɛmɔ nwo ase béwura Nyameɛ tumi asaa ne abo, ná wama ɛmɔ so wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɔsɛ ɔ nu.

english_verse: God cares for you, so turn all your worries over to him.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔfa ɛmɔ dadwene amukoraa begua ye so, ofikyɛ ɔdwene ɛmɔ nwo.

english_verse: Be on your guard and stay awake. Your enemy, the devil, is like a roaring lion, sneaking around to find someone to attack.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔdwo ɛmɔ nwo ase, ɛ́mɔma ɛmɔ nye la berɛ; ofikyɛ ɛmɔ pɔfoɛ abɔnzam odi akɔneaba, opo kyɛ gyata, na ɔpena sona bɔ okonya ye kɔhye ye ɔ.

english_verse: But you must resist the devil and stay strong in your faith. You know that all over the world the Lord's followers are suffering just as you are.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔgyina pindinn wɔ gyidie nu bɛ́fa bési ye ate, ofikyɛ ɛmɔse kyɛ bafa sɔ amaneɛnwunɛ ne bato ɛmɔ aliɛma mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ ewiase amukoraa ɔ so, kyɛ bɛ koso benwu bie.

english_verse: But God shows undeserved kindness to everyone. That's why he appointed Christ Jesus to choose you to share in his eternal glory. You will suffer for a while, but God will make you complete, steady, strong, and firm.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔnwu amaneɛ wɔ mmerɛ kãa bie beyie a, adom mukoraa Nyameɛ, bɔ wafrɛ yɛ wawa ye animnyam afebɔɔ nu wɔ Kristu Yesu nu ne, okosiesie ɛmɔ maa ɛmɔkoli mu, ɔkɔma ɛmɔkogyina pindinn, ɔkɔma ɛmɔ anwoserɛ ná wama ɛmɔagyina pirim.

english_verse: God will be in control forever! Amen. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ animnyam ne tumi te ye deɛ afebɔɔ ɔ. Amen. Ngraalilɛ

english_verse: Silvanus helped me write this short letter, and I consider him a faithful follower of the Lord. I wanted to encourage you and tell you how kind God really is, so you will keep on having faith in him.
translation_verse: Silwano bɔ mebu ye kyɛ ɔte aliɛmaa nahorɛniɛ ne, mafa ye so yeɛ mahyerɛ edwirɛ tikaape he mabrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ. Na mefa metu ɛmɔ foɛ ná medi adanzeɛ kyɛ, ɛhe te Nyameɛ nohorɛ adom ne, yiti ɛ́mɔgyina pindinn wɔ nu.

english_verse: Greetings from the Lord's followers in Babylon. They are God's chosen ones. Mark, who is like a son to me, sends his greetings too.
translation_verse: Asɔre bɔ ɔwɔ Babilɔn, bɔ baneanea nu baye ye kyɛ ɛmɔ ne, obisa ɛmɔ ahye; mma Marko koso obisa ɛmɔ ahye.

english_verse: Give each other a warm greeting. I pray that God will give peace to everyone who belongs to Christ.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔyɛ ɛmɔ nwo awaawaatuu wɔ ɔdɔ nu. Asomdwee hã ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔwɔ Kristo Yesu nu amukoraa. Amen.

english_verse: From Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ. To everyone who shares with us in the privilege of believing that our God and Savior Jesus Christ will do what is just and fair.
translation_verse: Simɔn Petro bɔ nde Yesu Kristo akoaa ne somafoɛ ne, mefa mebrɛ bɛ bɔ ɔnate yɛ Nyameɛ ne Ngoadefoɛ Yesu Kristo tenenee so banya gyidie bɔ odi mu kyɛ yɛ deɛ ne ala ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God will be kind to you and will let you live in perfect peace! May you keep learning more and more about God and our Lord Jesus. Living as the Lord's Followers
translation_verse: Mesrɛ kyɛ adom ne asomdwee ɔyɛ pee ma ɛmɔ, wɔ Nyameɛ ne y’Awurade Yesu nwo nimdeɛ nu. Bafrɛ yɛ kyɛ yɛɛnyi gyidie nu

english_verse: We have everything we need to live a life that pleases God. It was all given to us by God's own power, when we learned he had invited us to share in his wonderful goodness.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ tumi ne afa nikyee biala bɔ yɛhia ye wɔ asetena nu ne nyamesom paa nu ɔ wahyɛ yɛ, na wafa ye bɔ wafrɛ yɛ wahɔ ye bɔbɔ ye animnyam ne ye paayɛlɛ nu ne, ye nwo nimdeɛ so.

english_verse: God made great and marvelous promises, so his nature would become part of us. Then we could escape our evil desires and the corrupt influences of this world.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate ɛhemɔ aso yeɛ wafa ye bɔhyɛ mbiri mbiri bɔ odi mu ne wahyɛ yɛ ɔ; amaa ɔnate ɛhemɔ aso ɛmɔanwati bafi prɔlowaa bɔ ɔwɔ wiase bɔ ɔnate akɔnnɔ so yeɛ ɔba ne anu, ná ɛmɔanya Nyameɛ sue ne bie.

english_verse: Do your best to improve your faith by adding goodness, understanding,
translation_verse: Na ye sɔ ne ati, ɛ́mɔbɔ mmɔden bɛ́fa bra paa bɛ́foa ɛmɔ gyidie so; ɛ́mɔfa nimdeɛ bɛfoa bra paa so;

english_verse: If you keep growing in this way, it will show that what you know about our Lord Jesus Christ has made your lives useful and meaningful.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔle sɔ suban paa hemɔ mmorosoɛ a, bɛngɔma ɛmɔngɔtena berɛ mbaen anaa ɛmɔngɔyɛ mmenia bɔ benzu mmaa wɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo nwo nimdeɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: But if you don't grow, you are like someone who is nearsighted or blind, and you have forgotten that your past sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sona biala bɔ sɔ suban nemɔ wabɔ ye ne, ɔte anyesiniwaaniɛ, ye nye so yɛ ye wusiwusi, na ye wora afi kyɛ bate ye nwo bafi ye bɔne bɔ wayɔ ye daa ne nwo ɔ.

english_verse: My friends, you must do all you can to show God has really chosen and selected you. If you keep on doing this, you won't stumble and fall.
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔbɔ mmɔden bétira ɛfrɛlɛ bɔ bafrɛ ɛmɔ ne, ɔne ɛnealɛ bɔ baneanea nu baye ɛmɔ ne anu yé, ofikyɛ sɛ ɛmɔyɔ ɛhemɔ a, ɛmɔngofi ase le.

english_verse: Then our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ will give you a glorious welcome into his kingdom that will last forever.
translation_verse: Na ɔba ye sɔ a, bɛkɔma ɛmɔ atee mmorosoɛ bɔ ɔkɔ y’Awurade ne yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Yesu Kristo ahennie afebɔɔ ne anu.

english_verse: You are holding firmly to the truth you were given. But I am still going to remind you of these things.
translation_verse: Yiti mengobu me nye mengogua so kyɛ ngɔkaye ɛmɔ wɔ ɛhemɔ anwo daa biala, ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛmɔse sɔ dada, na ɛmɔatira ndii wɔ nahorɛ bɔ ɛmɔanya ye ne anu.

english_verse: In fact, I think I should keep on reminding you until I leave this body.
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ nwɔ ɛtena sua ye anu ye de, menea a, ɔte paa kyɛ ngɔbɔ ɛmɔ so maa ɔkɔkanyane ɛmɔ ɔ,

english_verse: And our Lord Jesus Christ has already told me that I will soon leave it behind.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ mese kyɛ, ɔngɔhyɛ biala, bɛkɔye ɛtena sua ne bekofi me nwo, kyɛbɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo wala ye ali wahyire me ne.

english_verse: This is why I am doing my best to make sure that each of you remembers all of this after I am gone. The Message about the Glory of Christ
translation_verse: Na mébɔ mmɔden menea kyɛ, mefi wiase wa mekɔ a, nziɛ ye ɛmɔkɔkaye ɛhemɔ daa biala. Petro di Kristo animnyam nwo adanzeɛ

english_verse: When we told you about the power and the return of our Lord Jesus Christ, we were not telling clever stories someone had made up. But with our own eyes we saw his true greatness.
translation_verse: Amba, edwirɛ bɔ yahã yahyire ɛmɔ yafa y’Awurade Yesu Kristo tumi ne ye walɛ ne anwo ne, yamva kanda ɛhoaatolɛ so, na mmom yɛ bɔbɔ yɛte ye animnyam totohyia bɔ yɛnwuni ye ne nwo adanzefoɛ.

english_verse: God, our great and wonderful Father, truly honored him by saying, “This is my own dear Son, and I am pleased with him.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmerɛ bɔ onyane anidie ne animnyam fili Baba Nyameɛ berɛ, ná komviɛ bie fili Animnyam Totohyia ne berɛ wale ye berɛ kyɛ, “Mma bɔ ɔla m’ahone nwo ná me nye gye ye nwo paa ne ɛhe” nen,

english_verse: We were there with Jesus on the holy mountain and heard this voice speak from heaven.
translation_verse: yɛtele sɔ komviɛ ne kyɛ ofi nyameɛso yeɛ ɔwale ɔ, ofikyɛ né yɛne ye yeɛ yɛwɔ bokaa krongron ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: All of this makes us even more certain that what the prophets said is true. So you should pay close attention to their message, as you would to a lamp shining in some dark place. You must keep on paying attention until daylight comes and the morning star rises in your hearts.
translation_verse: Na yɛsa yɛle ngɔmhyɛlɛ dwirɛ bɔ ɔma y’adwene si pi paa tra sɔ ɔ. Na ɛhe yeɛ ohia paa kyɛ ɛmɔnea ye yé, kyɛ kanea bɔ ɔta awosii nu maa okoodwu kyɛ aleɛ kɔhye, ná ngyerɛmɔ nzramaa kɔta ɛmɔ ahone nu ɔ.

english_verse: But you need to realize that no one alone can understand any of the prophecies in the Scriptures.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdi moa bɛte ɛhe bo: kyɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ne anu ngɔmhyɛlɛ biala nne berɛ bɔ ye bohyirelɛ ne fale sona so yeɛ ɔwale ɔ,

english_verse: The prophets did not think these things up on their own, but they were guided by the Spirit of God.
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛ biala wamva kuro sona pɛ so wamma le, na mmom Nyameɛ mmenia krongron bedwudwole, kyɛbɔ Sunzum Krongron ne ɔkanyane bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Sometimes false prophets spoke to the people of Israel. False teachers will also sneak in and speak harmful lies to you. But these teachers don't really belong to the Master who paid a great price for them, and they will quickly destroy themselves.
translation_verse: Na ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ bedwɔsole maen ne anu, kyɛbɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ bekodwɔso wɔ ɛmɔ nu koso ne. Bɛ yeɛ bɛkɔfeafea bɛ nwo bɛkɔfa ngyerɛkyerɛ tɛɛ bɔ ɔsɛkye mmenia bekoowura nu ɔ, na bɛkɔpo Awurade bɔ ɔɔpɔle bɛ ná olele bɛ ne po, na bɛkɔtwetwe ɛsɛkyelɛ bɔ ɔba ndɛndɛ ɔ bɛkɔbrɛ bɛ nwo.

english_verse: Many people will follow their evil ways and cause others to tell lies about the true way.
translation_verse: Na mmeni pee bekoli b’asanzabra ne asi, na ɔnate bɛ ti mmenia kɔkekã nahorɛ ne nwo dwirɛ tɛɛ.

english_verse: They will be greedy and cheat you with smooth talk. But long ago God decided to punish them, and God doesn't sleep.
translation_verse: Na bɛ nye bɔ ɔboro nikyee ne ati, bɛkɔfa nnakannaka dwirɛ bekodidi ɛmɔ nwo. Na ofi tetetete, ndɛen bɔ babua bɛ ne ɔndwetwe ye ase, yeɛ b’asohwenɛ koso ɔndɔ ngosie.

english_verse: God did not have pity on the angels that sinned. He had them tied up and thrown into the dark pits of hell until the time of judgment.
translation_verse: Na sɛ Nyameɛ amva abɔfo mɔ bɔ bɛyɔle bɔne ne nwo wangyɛ bɛ, ná mmom ogyili bɛ guale ɛborɔ kumaa kuronguronn awosii kabii nu, ná ɔbɔle bɛ panwu kyɛ ɔfa nwondɛ ndɛenbualɛ ne a;

english_verse: And during Noah's time, God did not have pity on the ungodly people of the world. He destroyed them with a flood, though he did save eight people, including Noah, who preached the truth.
translation_verse: ná sɛ wamva daa tete wiase nwo wangyɛ ye, na mmom olele Nowa bɔ ɔte tenenee nzɛmbahanɛniɛ, ɔne mmenia nzoo bɔ bɛboka ye so ne, ná ɔfale nzueyilɛ ɔɔkatale amumuyɛɛfoɛ wiase so a;

english_verse: God punished the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah by burning them to ashes, and this is a warning to anyone else who wants to sin.
translation_verse: ná sɛ obuale Sodom ne Gomora nguro foɛ ɔbɔle bɛ tɔɔ, ɔsɛkyele bɛ maa bɛyerale bɛtɔle nzoen, ná ɔfa yɛle nhwɛsoɛ mane bɛ bɔ nziɛ ye bɛkɔbɔ amumuyɛɛ bra a;

english_verse: This shows that the Lord knows how to rescue godly people from their sufferings and to punish evil people while they wait for the day of judgment.
translation_verse: né nzaade Awurade se atee bɔ ɔfa so ɔpepɛ de bɛ bɔ besuro ye ɔ fi nzɔhwɛ nu, ɔne kyɛbɔ ɔtwe bɛ bɔ bɛndengyɛ so ɔfa nwondɛ ndɛenbualɛ kyẽa ne ɔ,

english_verse: The Lord is especially hard on people who disobey him and don't think of anything except their own filthy desires. They are reckless and proud and are not afraid of cursing the glorious beings in heaven.
translation_verse: nganga bɛ bɔ bedi anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ fiɛ si, ná bebu tumililɛ animtia ɔ. Besi b’ahone, bedi bɛ ti piri, na benzuro kyɛ bɛkɔkekã dwirɛ bekotia animnyamfoɛ nemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Although angels are more powerful than these evil beings, even the angels don't dare to accuse them to the Lord.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo mɔ po bɔ b’anwoserɛ ne bɛ tumi te piri tra bɛ ne, bɛngeka edwirɛ bendia bɛ bɛmmɔ bɛ kwaadu wɔ Awurade nyunu.

english_verse: These people are no better than senseless animals that live by their feelings and are born to be caught and killed. They speak evil of things they don't know anything about. But their own corrupt deeds will destroy them.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɔ mmenia hemɔ, bɔ bɛte kyɛ ngaka bɔ adwene nne bɛ ti anu, bɔ bɛwole bɛ kyɛ bɛhye bɛ behũ bɛ ne, bɛkekã dwirɛ betia nikyee biala bɔ bɛnde ye bo ɔ, na bɛ bɔbɔ bɛ sɛkyelɛ nu yeɛ bekowuwu ɔ,

english_verse: They have done evil, and they will be rewarded with evil. They think it is fun to have wild parties during the day. They are immoral, and the meals they eat with you are spoiled by the shameful and selfish way they carry on.
translation_verse: na ɔkɔyɛ bɛ bɔne yɔleɛ ne nwo akatuaa. Bɛ nye gye kyɛ bɛkɔbɔ ahohwibra eyia ketee ɔ. Bɛte ngekaleawa ne nnɛen, na bɛbɔ ahohwibra wɔ b’anigye nu, wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɛne ɛmɔ didi ɔ.

english_verse: All they think about is having sex with someone else's husband or wife. There is no end to their wicked deeds. They trick people who are easily fooled, and their minds are filled with greedy thoughts. But they are headed for trouble!
translation_verse: Bele agyaasɛkyelɛ anyeɛ, bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne a ɔnde ye ɔ, bɛlakalaka akra bɔ bennya bettirale ndii ɔ, balɔ asukɔ wɔ adifuu nu. Bɛte mmenia bɔ banoma bɛ ɔ!

english_verse: They have left the true road and have gone down the wrong path by following the example of the prophet Balaam. He was the son of Beor and loved what he got from being a crook.
translation_verse: Bayakyi nahorɛ atee ne berɛ bali makyebu, na baafa Beɔ awa Balaam atee so, ye bɔ ohurole kyɛ okonya mvasoɛ kofi amumuyɛɛyɔlɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: But a donkey corrected him for this evil deed. It spoke to him with a human voice and made him stop his foolishness.
translation_verse: Nakoso behwili ye nyunu wɔ ye mmeraatolɛ nwo; afupɔngɔ bɔ ɔngora dwudwo ɔ ɔfale sona komvi dwudwole fa sili ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne ngwaseasɛm ne ate.

english_verse: These people are like dried up water holes and clouds blown by a windstorm. The darkest part of hell is waiting for them.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia nemɔ, bɛte abura mɔ bɔ nzue nne nu ɔ, ɔne munungum bɔ mvrama bɔ ye huu kɔ ɔ; na bɛ yeɛ basiesie awosii kabii bato berɛ bama bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: They brag out loud about their stupid nonsense. And by being vulgar and crude, they trap people who have barely escaped from living the wrong kind of life.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɛbobɔ bɛ noa nu bɛkekã anwomasoɛ dwirɛ mbaen mbaen, na bɛnate anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ nu bɛfa ahohwisɛm bɛlakalaka bɛ bɔ begu so bɛnwati befi mmenia bɔ bɛbɔ azanzabra nemɔ bɛ mvomsoɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: They promise freedom to everyone. But they are merely slaves of filthy living, because people are slaves of whatever controls them.
translation_verse: Bɛfa fawɔnwodi bɛbɔ bɛ anohoba, wɔ aberɛ bɔ bɛ bɔbɔ bɛte prɔlowaa ngoaa ɔ. Ofikyɛ nikyee biala bɔ odi sona so ne, ye yeɛ sona ne te ye akoaa ɔ.

english_verse: When they learned about our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they escaped from the filthy things of this world. But they are again caught up and controlled by these filthy things, and now they are in worse shape than they were at first.
translation_verse: Na sɛ bɛnate y’Awurade ne yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Yesu Kristo nwo nimdeɛ so banwati bafi wiase bra fiɛ nu, ná nziɛ ye bɛma sɔ bra fiɛ ne osa kye bɛ odi bɛ so a, ye de bɛ nziɛ ye asetena ne ɔte bɔne tra bɛ daa asetena ne.

english_verse: They would have been better off if they had never known about the right way. Even after they knew what was right, they turned their backs on the holy commandments they were given.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ sɛ bannwu tenenee atee ne po a, ahaa ɔte paa ma bɛ, tra kyɛ banwu ye bayie, ná afei nziɛ ye bakakyi bɛ nwo bafi ahyɛdeɛ krongron bɔ bɛfa bɛmane bɛ ne anwo ɔ.

english_verse: What happened to them is just like the true saying, “A dog will come back to lick up its own vomit. A pig that has been washed will roll in the mud.”
translation_verse: Bɔ wato bɛ ne, ɔte kyɛbɔ nohorɛ anyandera ne kã ne, kyɛ: “Kyea fe a, osa kodi,” yeɛ “Ebia prako a, osa kɔbo ye asaa bɔ ɔla nu ne.”

english_verse: what God's prophets said would happen. You must never forget what the holy prophets taught in the past. And you must remember what the apostles told you our Lord and Savior has commanded us to do.
translation_verse: kyɛ, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔkaye edwirɛ mɔ bɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ krongron nemɔ bɛhane ye daa ne, ɔne y’Awurade ne yɛ Ngoadefoɛ ahyɛdeɛ bɔ ɔfale yɛ bɔ yɛte ye asomafoɛ so wahã ne.

english_verse: But first you must realize that in the last days some people won't think about anything except their own selfish desires. They will make fun of you
translation_verse: Na ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔdi moa bɛte ɛhe bo, kyɛ, ngyẽa bɔ oli nziɛ ye anu, ngorohoɛfoɛ kodwɔso, na bekoli bɛ bɔbɔ b’akɔnnɔ si bekoli ngorohoɛ;

english_verse: and say, “Didn't your Lord promise to come back? Yet the first leaders have already died, and the world hasn't changed a bit.”
translation_verse: ná babisa kyɛ, “Ye walɛ ne nwo bɔhyɛ ne, ɔyɛle sɛɛ bɔ ɔwwale nu ɔ? Ofikyɛ, ofi mmerɛ bɔ yɛ nana mɔ bɛlelale ɔ, kyɛbɔ nikyee biala te fi mmerɛ bɔ Ɛdangama bɔle aleɛ ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔte ɔ!”

english_verse: They will say this because they want to forget that long ago the heavens and the earth were made at God's command. The earth came out of water and was made from water.
translation_verse: Bɛboapa bɛyɛ kyɛ bɛnze kyɛ, ofi tetetete ne, né anwuro wɔ berɛ, na aseɛ fi nzue nu yeɛ ɔwale ɔ, ofi nzue nu yeɛ ootimuni berɛ ɔ, na ɔnate Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ so.

english_verse: Later it was destroyed by the waters of a mighty flood.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate so ala yeɛ nzue yili sɛkyele wiase bɔ né ɔwɔ berɛ wɔ b’aberɛ so ne ɔ.

english_verse: But God has commanded the present heavens and earth to remain until the day of judgment. Then they will be set on fire, and ungodly people will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Na anwuro ne aseɛ bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ ye, ɔnate ye noa dwirɛ komapɛ ne ala so yeɛ otira nu ɔ, na wasiesie ye wama see, na ɔfa nwondɛ ndɛenbualɛ ne amumuyɛɛfoɛ kyẽa ne.

english_verse: The Lord isn't slow about keeping his promises, as some people think he is. In fact, God is patient, because he wants everyone to turn from sin and no one to be lost.
translation_verse: Awurade ndwetwe ye gya ase wɔ ye bɔhyɛ nwo, kyɛbɔ ebiemɔ bɛdwene kyɛ ɔkyɛ ne. Aboterɛ mmom yeɛ ole ye wɔ yɛ nwo ɔ, ɔmbena kyɛ sona biala mini, na mmom ɔpena kyɛ ebiala ba adwenesakyera nu.

english_verse: The day of the Lord's return will surprise us like a thief. The heavens will disappear with a loud noise, and the heat will melt the whole universe. Then the earth and everything on it will be seen for what they are.
translation_verse: Nakoso Awurade kyẽa ne kɔwa kyɛ awueniɛ ba [kɔngɔen] ɔ. Na nu yeɛ anwuro kɔbɔ nu kurudududu serɛserɛ kotu komini. See kɔma ewienu abɔdeɛ mɔ kohuro, na aseɛ ne so nningyein amukoraa kɔyera.

english_verse: Everything will be destroyed. So you should serve and honor God by the way you live.
translation_verse: Na sɛ sɔ yeɛ sɔ nningyein ne amukoraa bɛkɔsɛkye a, nzaade nzikyɛ mmenia yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔyɛ ɔ? Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔtira bra krongron ne nyamesom paa nu,

english_verse: You should look forward to the day when God judges everyone, and you should try to make it come soon. On that day the heavens will be destroyed by fire, and everything else will melt in the heat.
translation_verse: wɔ mmerɛ bɔ ɛmɔnwondɛ ná ɛmɔpere kyɛ Nyameɛ kyẽa ne kɔwa ndɛ ɔ. Nu yeɛ see kɔtɔ anwuro nu kɔyera ye, na see kɔma ewienu abɔdeɛ mɔ kohuro.

english_verse: But God has promised us a new heaven and a new earth, where justice will rule. We are really looking forward to this!
translation_verse: Nakoso kyɛbɔ ye bɔhyɛ te ne, yɛ nye la nyameɛso foforɛ ne aseɛ foforɛ bɔ tenenee te nu ɔ ate. Foɛtulɛ bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ

english_verse: My friends, while you are waiting, you should make certain the Lord finds you pure, spotless, and living at peace.
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɔnate kyɛ ɛmɔnwondɛ sɔ nningyein hemɔ ne ati, ɛ́mɔbɔ mmɔden kyɛ okonwu ɛmɔ wɔ asomdwee nu, bɔ ngekalewa anaa nnɛen biala nne ɛmɔ nwo ɔ.

english_verse: Don't forget that the Lord is patient because he wants people to be saved. This is also what our dear friend Paul said when he wrote you with the wisdom God had given him.
translation_verse: Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔnwu Awurade aboterɛ ne kyɛ ɔte ngoalelɛ, kyɛbɔ y’eliɛma dɔfo Pɔɔlo koso nate nworɛ bɔ bafa bama ye ne aso ɔhyerɛ brɛle ɛmɔ ne.

english_verse: Paul talks about these same things in all his letters, but part of what he says is hard to understand. Some ignorant and unsteady people even destroy themselves by twisting what he said. They do the same thing with other Scriptures too.
translation_verse: Na ɔkã sɔ nningyein nemɔ nwo dwirɛ wɔ ye ngrataa ne amukoraa nu. Nu dwirɛ nemɔ bie ye botelɛ yɛ se; na ɛhe yeɛ mmenia bɔ bɛnze huu bɔ bɛ bo onnya ottindimuni ne, bekyirekyire ye bo bɛkyea ye, kyɛbɔ bɛyɛ Ahyerɛlɛ ngaa nemɔ koso ne, maa bɛ bɔbɔ bemini ɔ.

english_verse: My dear friends, you have been warned ahead of time! So don't let the errors of evil people lead you down the wrong path and make you lose your balance.
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔse ɛhemɔ dada, yiti ɛ́mɔla ɛmɔ nwo so, ná mmeraatolɛfoɛ mvomsoɛ ne wandwetwe ɛmɔ wangɔ, ná ɛmɔamvi ase bamvi nekaa bɔ ɛmɔatindim ne.

english_verse: Let the gift of undeserved grace and the understanding that come from our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ help you keep on growing. Praise Jesus now and forever! Amen.
translation_verse: Na mmom, ɛmɔhɔ so benyi wɔ y’Awurade ne yɛ Ngoadefoɛ Yesu Kristo adom ne ye nwo nimdeɛ nu. Ye yeɛ animnyam hã ye kekesaala ye ɔne daa daa ɔ. Amen.

english_verse: The Word that gives life was from the beginning, and this is the one our message is about. Our ears have heard, our eyes have seen, and our hands have touched this Word.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ fi ahyɛaseɛ ne, bɔ yate, bɔ yafa yɛ nye yanwu ye, bɔ yanea, ná yafa yɛ sa yahã ye, bɔ ɔfa ngoa dwirɛ ne anwo ne;

english_verse: The one who gives life appeared! We saw it happen, and we are witnesses to what we have seen. Now we are telling you about this eternal life that was with the Father and appeared to us.
translation_verse: sɔ ngoa ne yele ye nwo ali, na yanwu ye, yɛdi ye nwo adanzeɛ, na daa ngoa bɔ né ɔne Baba ne wɔ berɛ na afei bɛyele ye ali behyirele yɛ ne yeɛ yɛbɔ ye nwo dawure yɛkyire ɛmɔ ye.

english_verse: We are telling you what we have seen and heard, so you may share in this life with us. And we share in it with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Bɔ yanwu ye ná yate ne yeɛ yɛ koso yɛbɔ ye dawure yɛkyire ɛmɔ ɔ, amaa ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔ ne yɛ atira abiɛngoɛ; na y’abiɛngoɛ he, yɛne Baba ne, ɔne Ɔwa Yesu Kristo yeɛ yatira ɔ.

english_verse: We are writing to tell you these things, because this makes us truly happy. God Is Light
translation_verse: Na yɛ́kyerɛ ɛhe yɛbrɛ ɛmɔ, amaa ɛmɔ anigye ne wali mu. Nyameɛ te kanea

english_verse: Jesus told us God is light and doesn't have any darkness in him. Now we are telling you.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ bɔ yate yafi ye berɛ ná yɛ́bɔ ye dawure yɛkyire ɛmɔ ɛhe: Nyameɛ te kanea, na awosii kaala nne ye nu.

english_verse: If we say we share in life with God and keep on living in the dark, we are lying and are not living by the truth.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ yɛkã kyɛ yɛne ye atira abiɛngoɛ, nakoso yɛnate awosii nu a, né ye de yɛlaka, na yɛmmɔ yɛ bra wɔ nahorɛ nu.

english_verse: But if we live in the light, as God does, we share in life with each other. And the blood of his Son Jesus washes all our sins away.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ yɛnate kanea nu, kyɛbɔ ye koso ɔwɔ kanea nu ne a, né yɛ ne yɛ nwo yɛ nwo yatira abiɛngoɛ, na Ɔwa Yesu Kristo mogya ne te yɛ nwo fi bɔne mukoraa nu.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we are fooling ourselves, and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Sɛ yɛkã kyɛ yɛnyɔ bɔne a, né yɛlakalaka yɛ nwo, na né nahorɛ ne ɔnne yɛ nu.

english_verse: But if we confess our sins to God, he can always be trusted to forgive us and take our sins away.
