translation_verse: Nakoso ɔnate kyɛ odi nahorɛ ná ɔtengyɛ ne ati, sɛ yɛkã yɛ bɔne yɛkyire ye a, ɔkɔfa kɔhyɛ yɛ ná wate yɛ nwo wafi bɔ ɔndengyɛ mukoraa nwo.

english_verse: If we say we have not sinned, we make God a liar, and his message isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛkã kyɛ yɛyyɔle bɔne a, né yama wayɛ ngondomboniɛ, yeɛ ye dwirɛ ne koso ɔtte yɛ nu.

english_verse: My children, I am writing this so you won't sin. But if you do sin, Jesus Christ always does the right thing, and he will speak to the Father for us.
translation_verse: Me ngwadaa mɔ, mekyerɛ he mebrɛ ɛmɔ amaa ɛmɔanyɔ bɔne. Nakoso sɛ ebie yɔ bɔne a, yɛle kamafoɛ wɔ Baba ne nyunu bɔ ye ole teneneeniɛ Yesu Kristo.

english_verse: Christ is the sacrifice that takes away our sins and the sins of all the world's people.
translation_verse: Ɔte yɛ bɔne nwo mbata; nna yɛ ngome yɛ deɛ nwo; na mmom ɔte wiase amukoraa koso bɔne nwo mbata.

english_verse: When we obey God, we are sure we know him.
translation_verse: Sɛ yɛdi ye ahyɛdeɛ so a, yeɛ okyire kyɛ yɛse ye ɔ.

english_verse: But if we claim to know him and don't obey him, we are lying and the truth isn't in our hearts.
translation_verse: Na sona bɔ ɔkã kyɛ, “Mese ye”, nakoso onni ye ahyɛdeɛ so ne, ɔte ngondomboniɛ, na nahorɛ nne ye nu.

english_verse: We truly love God only when we obey him as we should, and then we know we belong to him.
translation_verse: Nakoso ebiala bɔ odi ye dwirɛ so ne yeɛ Nyameɛ dɔ ne di mu wɔ ye nu amba ɔ. Ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu kyɛ yɛ ne ye atira abiɛngoɛ ɔ.

english_verse: If we say we are his, we must follow the example of Christ. The New Commandment
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ ɔnwa ɔne Nyameɛ atira abiɛngoɛ nen, odi kyɛ ye koso ɔbɔ ye bra kyɛbɔ Kristo bɔle ye deɛ ne. Ahyɛdeɛ foforɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, I am not writing to give you a new commandment. It is the same one you were first given, and it is the message you heard.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, nna ahyɛdeɛ foforɛ, na mmom ahyɛdeɛ daa ne ala bɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne ɛmɔnyane ye ne yeɛ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ. Na sɔ ahyɛdeɛ daa ne ole edwirɛ bɔ ɛmɔate fite ahyɛaseɛ ne.

english_verse: But it really is a new commandment, and you know its true meaning, just as Christ does. You can see the darkness fading away and the true light already shining.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛnea a, ahyɛdeɛ foforɛ yeɛ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ, na ɔte nahorɛ wɔ ye nu ne ɛmɔ nu; ofikyɛ awosii ne gu so ɔpɛ nu kɔ, na nahorɛ kanea ne ata dada.

english_verse: If we claim to be in the light and hate someone, we are still in the dark.
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ ɔkã kyɛ ɔwɔ kanea ne anu, nakoso ɔpɔ oliɛma ne, ɔtɛte awosii nu.

english_verse: But if we love others, we are in the light, and we don't cause problems for them.
translation_verse: Sona bɔ okuro oliɛma dwirɛ ne te kanea ne anu, na nikye fee nne ye nu bɔ ɔto ebie sundidua ɔ.

english_verse: If we hate others, we are living and walking in the dark. We don't know where we are going, because we can't see in the dark.
translation_verse: Nakoso ebiala bɔ ɔpɔ oliɛma ne te awosii nu, ɔnate awosii nu, na ɔnze nekaa bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ, ofikyɛ awosii ne ama ye nye asi.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because your sins have been forgiven in the name of Christ.
translation_verse: Me ngwadaa mɔ, mekyerɛ he mebrɛ ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɔnate Kristo dumaa ti bafa ɛmɔ bɔne bahyɛ ɛmɔ.

english_verse: Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Ngya mɔ, mekyerɛ he mebrɛ ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔse bɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne né ɔwɔ berɛ ne. Mmerandeɛ mɔ, mekyerɛ he mebrɛ ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔali bɔnefoɛ ne so ngonim. Ngwadaa mɔ koso, mekyerɛ he mebrɛ ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔse Baba ne.

english_verse: Children, I am writing you, because you have known the Father. Parents, I am writing you, because you have known the one who was there from the beginning. Young people, I am writing you, because you are strong. God's message is firm in your hearts, and you have defeated the evil one.
translation_verse: Ngya mɔ, mahyerɛ he mabrɛ ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔse bɔ né ɔwɔ berɛ ahyɛaseɛ ne. Mmerandeɛ mɔ koso mahyerɛ he mabrɛ ɛmɔ, ofikyɛ ɛmɔatindim, Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne te ɛmɔ nu, na ɛmɔali bɔnefoɛ ne so ngonim.

english_verse: Don't love the world or anything that belongs to the world. If you love the world, you cannot love the Father.
translation_verse: Nnɛma ɛmɔkuro ewiase anaa nu nningyein dwirɛ. Na sɛ ebie kuro ewiase dwirɛ a, né Baba ne dɔ nne ye nu.

english_verse: Our foolish pride comes from this world, and so do our selfish desires and our desire to have everything we see. None of this comes from the Father.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ bɔ ɔwɔ wiase amukoraa: anwoɔnaen akɔnnɔ, anyeboroborolɛ, asetena nu anwohoahoa offi Baba ne berɛ, na mmom ofi wiase.

english_verse: The world and the desires it causes are disappearing. But if we obey God, we will live forever. The Enemy of Christ
translation_verse: Ewiase ne nu akɔnnɔ gu so ɔpɛ nu kɔ, nakoso sona bɔ ɔyɔ Nyameɛ apɛdeɛ ne te ase afebɔɔ. Kristo pɔfoɛ ne nwo kɔkɔbɔlɛ

english_verse: Children, this is the last hour. You heard that the enemy of Christ would appear at this time, and many of Christ's enemies have already appeared. So we know the last hour is here.
translation_verse: Me mma mɔ, ayieleɛ mmerɛ ne apingye. Na kyɛbɔ ɛmɔate ye daa kyɛ antikristo ne ɔ́ba ne, sɔ ala yeɛ kekesaala ye antikristo pee bawa ɔ; na ɛhe maa yɛnwu ye kyɛ ayieleɛ ne ala ɛne.

english_verse: These people came from our own group, yet they were not really part of us. If they had been part of us, they would have stayed with us. But they left, which proves they did not belong to our group.
translation_verse: Befi yɛ nu yeɛ bɛhɔle ɔ, nakoso né bɛmmɔ yɛ fekue ne bie. Ofikyɛ sɛ bɛbɔ yɛ fekue ne bie a, ahaa bɛ ne yɛ hɔle so tenane. Na bafi yɛ nu maa wala ali kyɛ bɛ mukoraa bɛmmɔ yɛ fekue ne bie.

english_verse: Christ, the Holy One, has blessed you, and now all of you understand.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ de, Krongronniɛ ne wapopa ɛmɔ ngoo, yiti ɛmɔse nikyee biala.

english_verse: I did not need to write you about the truth, since you already know it. You also know that liars do not belong to the truth.
translation_verse: Nna kyɛ ɛmɔnze nahorɛ ne ti yeɛ mekyerɛ he mebrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ, na mmom kyɛ ɛmɔse, na afei ɛmɔsa bɛse kyɛ ngondombo biala mvi nahorɛ nu mma.

english_verse: And a liar is anyone who says Jesus isn't truly Christ. Anyone who says this is an enemy of Christ and rejects both the Father and the Son.
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ ɔte ngondomboniɛ ɔ? Sona bɔ onne Yesu ndo nu kyɛ ye ole Kristo ne. Sɔ sona ne te antikristo, ofikyɛ onne Baba ne ɔne Baa ne ndo nu.

english_verse: If we reject the Son, we reject the Father. But if we say we accept the Son, we have the Father.
translation_verse: Sona biala bɔ onne Baa ne ndo nu ne, onne Baba ne koso ndo nu, nakoso ebiala bɔ ode Baa ne to nu ne, ode Baba ne koso to nu.

english_verse: Keep thinking about the message you first heard, and you will always be one in your heart with the Son and with the Father.
translation_verse: Yiti ɛ́mɔma edwirɛ bɔ ɛmɔate bafi ahyɛaseɛ ne ɔtena ɛmɔ nu. Na sɛ bɔ ɛmɔate bafi ahyɛaseɛ ne tena ɛmɔ nu a, ɛmɔ koso ɛmɔkɔtena Baa ne ne Baba ne nu daa.

english_verse: The Son has promised us eternal life.
translation_verse: Na bɔ wafa wahyɛ yɛ bɔ ole daa ngoa.

english_verse: I am writing to warn you about those people who are misleading you.
translation_verse: Bɔ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ ye fa bɛ bɔ bɛlakalaka ɛmɔ ne nwo.

english_verse: But Christ has blessed you with the Holy Spirit. Now the Spirit stays in you, and you don't need any teachers. The Spirit is truthful and teaches you everything. So stay one in your heart with Christ, just as the Spirit has taught you to do. Children of God
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ de, ngoo bɔ wafa wapopa ɛmɔ ne, ɔte ɛmɔ nu, yiti onhia kyɛ ebie kohyirehyire ɛmɔ ɔ. Na sɔ ngoopalɛ ne ala kyirekyire ɛmɔ nikyee biala, ɔkã nahorɛ, ɔmbɛ ngondombo, na kyɛbɔ wahyirehyire ɛmɔ ne, ɛmɔli so.

english_verse: Children, stay one in your hearts with Christ. Then when he returns, we will have confidence and won't have to hide in shame.
translation_verse: Na afei me ngwadaa mɔ, ɛmɔhɔ so bɛtena ye nu, amaa sɛ ye walɛ ne dwu ná ɔye ye nwo ali a, yahora yasi y’ahone, na yamvɛre wɔ ye nyunu.

english_verse: You know Christ always does right and everyone who does right is a child of God.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ɛmɔse kyɛ ɔte teneneeniɛ a, nzaade ɛmɔse kyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ne te Nyameɛ awa.

english_verse: Think how much the Father loves us. He loves us so much that he lets us be called his children, as we truly are. But since the people of this world did not know who Christ is, they don't know who we are.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea ɔdɔ sonongo bɔ Baba ne wafa walo yɛ ɔ, bɔ ɔmaa bɛfrɛ yɛ Nyameɛ mma ɔ, na yɛte ye mma koso amba. Na ɔnate ɛhe ati ewiase nze yɛ, ofikyɛ onnwuni ye.

english_verse: My dear friends, we are already God's children, though what we will be hasn't yet been seen. But we do know when Christ returns, we will be like him, because we will see him as he truly is.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, kekesaala ye yɛte Nyameɛ mma, na kyɛbɔ kyẽa bie yɛkosi yɛkɔyɛ ne de, onnya ɔllale ali. Nakoso yɛse kyɛ sɛ ɔye ye nwo ali a, yɛkɔyɛ kyɛ ye ala, ofikyɛ yɛkonwu ye kyɛbɔ ɔte ɔ.

english_verse: This hope makes us keep ourselves holy, just as Christ is holy.
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ ole sɔ anyelasoɛ ne wɔ Kristo nu ne, ɔte ye nwo kyɛbɔ Kristo nwo te ne.

english_verse: Everyone who sins breaks God's law, because sin is the same as breaking God's law.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne ne, ɔto mmeraa, ofikyɛ bɔne te mmeraatolɛ.

english_verse: You know Christ came to take away our sins. He isn't sinful,
translation_verse: Ɛmɔse kyɛ ɔwale kyɛ ɔbaasoa yɛ bɔne kɔ; na ye de bɔne nne ye nwo.

english_verse: and people who stay one in their hearts with him won't keep on sinning. If they do keep on sinning, they don't know Christ, and they have never seen him.
translation_verse: Yiti ebiala bɔ ɔte ye nu ne, ɔnyɔ bɔne; yeɛ ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne ne, onnwuni ye, anaa ɔnze ye.

english_verse: Children, don't be fooled. Anyone who does right is good, just like Christ himself.
translation_verse: Me ngwadaa mɔ, nnɛmɔma ebiala lakalaka ɛmɔ. Ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔ ɔtengyɛ ne, ɔte tenenee kyɛbɔ Kristo te tenenee ne.

english_verse: Anyone who keeps on sinning belongs to the devil. He has sinned from the beginning, but the Son of God came to destroy all that he has done.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔne te abɔnzam sona, ofikyɛ ofi ahyɛaseɛ ne yeɛ abɔnzam yɔ bɔne ɔ. Na ɔnate ɛhe ati yeɛ Nyameɛ Awa ne ɔɔlale ye nwo ali kyɛ ɔbaasɛkye abɔnzam nnwumaa.

english_verse: God's children cannot keep on being sinful. His life-giving power lives in them and makes them his children, so they cannot keep on sinning.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ Nyameɛ awo ye ne, ɔnyɔ bɔne, ofikyɛ ye sue ne te ye nu, na ɔngora nyɔ bɔne, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ yeɛ wawo ye ɔ.

english_verse: You can tell God's children from the devil's children, because those who belong to the devil refuse to do right or to love each other. Love Each Other
translation_verse: Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu nzonzoleɛ bɔ ɔla abɔnzam ne Nyameɛ mma b’afia ɔ: ebiala bɔ ɔyɔ bɔ ɔndengyɛ anaa bɔ onguro oliɛma dwirɛ ne, ɔtte Nyameɛ awa. Kuro ebiɛngo dwirɛ

english_verse: From the beginning you were told we must love each other.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ bɔ ɛmɔate fi ahyɛaseɛ ne ɛhe: kyɛ yɛhurohuro yɛ nwo dwirɛ.

english_verse: Don't be like Cain, who belonged to the devil and murdered his own brother. Why did he murder him? He did it because his brother was good, and he was evil.
translation_verse: Nnɛmɔyɛ kyɛ Kein bɔ ɔte abɔnzam sona, bɔ ohuni oliɛma ne. Na nzu ati yeɛ ohuni oliɛma ne ɔ? Ofikyɛ né ye yɔleɛ ndengyɛ, nakoso oliɛma ne deɛ de, né ɔtengyɛ.

english_verse: My friends, don't be surprised if the people of this world hate you.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, sɛ ewiase pɔ ɛmɔ a, nnɛmɔma ɔyɛ ɛmɔ nwanwa.

english_verse: Our love for each other proves we have gone from death to life. But if you don't love each other, you are still under the power of death.
translation_verse: Yɛse kyɛ yɛfi ewue nu yawa ngoa nu, ofikyɛ yɛkuro aliɛmaa nemɔ dwirɛ. Na bɔ onguro oliɛma dwirɛ ne tɛte ewue nu.

english_verse: If you hate each other, you are murderers, and we know murderers do not have eternal life.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ɔpɔ oliɛma ne te wudiniɛ, na kyɛbɔ ɛmɔse ne, daa ngoa ndena wudiniɛ biala nu.

english_verse: We know what love is because Jesus gave his life for us. This is why we must give our lives for each other.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu kyɛbɔ ɔdɔ si te ɔ: Kristo fale ye ngoa tole berɛ mane yɛ, na yɛ koso odi kyɛ yɛfa yɛ ngoa yɛto berɛ yɛma aliɛmaa nemɔ.

english_verse: If we have all we need and see one of our own people in need, we must have pity on that person, or else we cannot say we love God.
translation_verse: Nakoso sɛ ebie le wiase anwonyadeɛ, ná sɛ onwu kyɛ oliɛma nwo kyere ye, ná wannwu ye anwumvoin a, né Nyameɛ dɔ ne te ye nu sɛ?

english_verse: Children, you show love for others by truly helping them, and not merely by talking about it.
translation_verse: Me ngwadaa mɔ, nnɛmɔma yɛfa yɛ noa mbaen anaa temverema fɛɛ yɛkuro mmenia dwirɛ, na mmom ɛ́mɔma yɛyɔ ye wɔ yɔleɛ nu ne nahorɛ nu. Yɛ wora wura Nyameɛ nu

english_verse: When we love others, we know we belong to the truth, and we feel at ease in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu ye kyɛ nahorɛ ne wɔ yɛ nu ɔ, amaa y’ahone atɔ yɛ kunu wɔ ye nyunu:

english_verse: But even if we don't feel at ease, God is greater than our feelings, and he knows everything.
translation_verse: sɛ yɛ tiboa bua yɛ foɛ a, Nyameɛ te piri tra yɛ tiboa, na ɔse nikyee biala.

english_verse: Dear friends, if we feel at ease in the presence of God, we will have the courage to come near him.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, sɛ yɛ tiboa mmua yɛ foɛ a, ye de yɛsi y’ahone yɛkɔ Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: He will give us whatever we ask, because we obey him and do what pleases him.
translation_verse: Na nikyee biala bɔ yɛbisa ne, ɔfa ma yɛ, ofikyɛ yɛdi ye ahyɛdeɛ so, na yɛyɔ bɔ ɔsɔ ye nye ɔ.

english_verse: God wants us to have faith in his Son Jesus Christ and to love each other. This is also what Jesus taught us to do.
translation_verse: Na ye ahyɛdeɛ ne kyire kyɛ yɛle ɔwa Yesu Kristo dumaa ne yɛli, ná yɛhurohuro yɛ nwo dwirɛ kyɛbɔ wafa ahyɛdeɛ wama yɛ ne.

english_verse: If we obey God's commandments, we will stay one in our hearts with him, and he will stay one with us. The Spirit he has given us is proof that we are one with him.
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ odi Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ so ne, ɔte ye nu, na ye koso ɔte ye nu. Na bɔ ɔmaa yɛnwu kyɛ ɔte yɛ nu ole Sunzum ne bɔ wafa wama yɛ ne.

english_verse: Dear friends, don't believe everyone who claims to have the Spirit of God. Test them all to find out if they really do come from God. Many false prophets have already gone out into the world,
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, nna sunzum biala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛmɔde ye bedi ɔ, na mmom ɛmɔso sunzum nemɔ bɛnea sɛ aso bɛte Nyameɛ deɛ anaa; ofikyɛ ngondombo ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ pee badwɔso wɔ wiase.

english_verse: and you can know which ones come from God. His Spirit says that Jesus Christ had a truly human body.
translation_verse: Ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu Nyameɛ Sunzum ɔ: Sunzum biala bɔ ode to nu kyɛ Yesu Kristo awa anwoɔnaen nu ne te Nyameɛ deɛ.

english_verse: But when someone doesn't say this about Jesus, you know this person has a spirit that doesn't come from God and is the enemy of Christ. You knew this enemy was coming into the world and now is already here.
translation_verse: Nakoso sunzum biala bɔ onne ndo nu kyɛ Yesu Kristo awa anwoɔnaen nu ne, ɔtte Nyameɛ deɛ, na mmom ɔte antikristo bɔ ɛmɔate kyɛ ɔba ná wanya wawa wiase ne deɛ.

english_verse: Children, you belong to God, and you have defeated these enemies. God's Spirit is in you and is more powerful than the one who is in the world.
translation_verse: Me ngwadaa mɔ, ɛmɔ de ɛmɔte Nyameɛ deɛ na ɛmɔali bɛ so ngonim; ofikyɛ bɔ ɔte ɛmɔ nu ne, ɔte piri tra bɔ ɔwɔ wiase ne.

english_verse: These enemies belong to this world, and the world listens to them, because they speak its language.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛ de bɛte wiase deɛ, yiti ewiase dwirɛ yeɛ bɛkã ɔ, na ewiase koso tie bɛ dwirɛ.

english_verse: We belong to God, and everyone who knows God will listen to us. But the people who don't know God won't listen to us. This is how we can tell the Spirit that speaks the truth from the one that tells lies.
translation_verse: Yɛ de, yɛte Nyameɛ deɛ, na ebiala bɔ ɔse Nyameɛ ne, otie yɛ dwirɛ; nakoso bɔ ɔtte Nyameɛ deɛ ne de ondie yɛ dwirɛ. Na ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu nahorɛ Sunzum ne ngondombo sunzum ɔ. Nyameɛ sue te ɔdɔ

english_verse: My dear friends, we must love each other. Love comes from God, and when we love each other, it shows we have been given new life. We are now God's children, and we know him.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔma yɛhurohuro yɛ nwo dwirɛ, ofikyɛ ɔdɔ fi Nyameɛ berɛ, na ebiala bɔ ole ɔdɔ ne te Nyameɛ awa, na ɔse Nyameɛ.

english_verse: God is love, and anyone who doesn't love others has never known him.
translation_verse: Nakoso ebiala bɔ olle ɔdɔ ne, ɔnze Nyameɛ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ te ɔdɔ.

english_verse: God showed his love for us when he sent his only Son into the world to give us life.
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ Nyameɛ yele ye dɔ ne ali wɔ yɛ nu ɛhe: Nyameɛ somane Ɔwa komapɛ twe ne maa ɔwale wiase, amaa ɔnate ye so yanya ngoa.

english_verse: Real love isn't our love for God, but his love for us. God sent his Son to be the sacrifice by which our sins are forgiven.
translation_verse: Bɔ okyire ɔdɔ ɛhe: nna kyɛ yɛ yeɛ yɛhurole Nyameɛ dwirɛ ɔ, na mmom ye yeɛ ohurole yɛ dwirɛ ná ɔsomane Ɔwa ne maa ɔɔyɛle yɛ bɔne nwo mbata ɔ.

english_verse: Dear friends, since God loved us this much, we must love each other.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, sɛ sɔ yeɛ Nyameɛ kuro yɛ dwirɛ a, ye de odi kyɛ yɛ koso yɛkurokuro yɛ nwo dwirɛ.

english_verse: No one has ever seen God. But if we love each other, God lives in us, and his love is truly in our hearts.
translation_verse: Ebiala nye nnwuni Nyameɛ le, nakoso sɛ yɛkurokuro yɛ nwo dwirɛ a, Nyameɛ tena yɛ nu, na ye dɔ ne di mu bɔkɔɔ wɔ yɛ nu.

english_verse: God has given us his Spirit. This is how we know we are one with him, just as he is one with us.
translation_verse: Ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu kyɛ yɛte ye nu ná ye koso ɔte yɛ nu ɔ: ye ole kyɛ wafa ye bɔbɔ ye Sunzum ne wama yɛ.

english_verse: God sent his Son to be the Savior of the world. We saw his Son and are now telling others about him.
translation_verse: Yanwu ye, na yɛdi adanzeɛ kyɛ Baba ne somane Baa ne maa ɔɔyɛle wiase Ngoadefoɛ.

english_verse: God stays one with everyone who openly says Jesus is the Son of God. This is how we stay one with God
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ ɔpakye nu kã kyɛ Yesu ole Nyameɛ Awa nen, Nyameɛ te ye nu, na ye koso ɔte Nyameɛ nu.

english_verse: and are sure God loves us. God is love. If we keep on loving others, we will stay one in our hearts with God, and he will stay one with us.
translation_verse: Yanwu yɛ nwo dɔ bɔ Nyameɛ le ye ne, yeɛ yɛde yɛdi koso. Nyameɛ te ɔdɔ, na ebiala bɔ ole ɔdɔ ne te Nyameɛ nu, na Nyameɛ koso te ye nu.

english_verse: If we truly love others and live as Christ did in this world, we won't be worried about the day of judgment.
translation_verse: Ɛhe anu yeɛ ɔdɔ di mu wɔ yɛ nu ɔ, amaa yanya anyelasoɛ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ kyẽa ne; ofikyɛ kyɛbɔ ɔte ne, sɔ ala yeɛ yɛte wɔ wiase wa ɔ.

english_verse: A real love for others will chase those worries away. The thought of being punished is what makes us afraid. It shows we have not really learned to love.
translation_verse: Esuronyi nne ɔdɔ nu, na mmom ɔdɔ bɔ odi mu ne, otutu esuronyi bo, ofikyɛ esuronyi ne asohwenɛ nwo ahunundetelɛ yeɛ bɛnate ɔ, na ebiala bɔ osuro ne, ye ɔdɔ nni mu.

english_verse: We love because God loved us first.
translation_verse: Yɛkuro ye dwirɛ, ofikyɛ ye yeɛ olili moa hurole yɛ dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: But if we say we love God and don't love each other, we are liars. We cannot see God. So how can we love God, if we don't love the people we can see?
translation_verse: Na sɛ ebie kã kyɛ “Mekuro Nyameɛ dwirɛ”, nakoso ɔpɔ oliɛma a, né ɔte ngondomboniɛ, ofikyɛ sɛ ebie nguro oliɛma bɔ onwu ye ne dwirɛ a, ɔkɔyɛ sɛɛ ná wahora wahuro Nyameɛ bɔ onnwu ye ne dwirɛ?

english_verse: The commandment that God has given us is: “Love God and love each other!”
translation_verse: Na ahyɛdeɛ bɔ wafa wama yɛ ɛhe: ebiala bɔ okuro Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne, odi kyɛ okuro oliɛma koso dwirɛ.

english_verse: If we believe Jesus is truly Christ, we are God's children. Everyone who loves the Father will also love his children.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ ode di kyɛ Yesu ole Kristo ne te Nyameɛ awa. Na ebiala bɔ okuro Baba ne dwirɛ ne, okuro Baa ne koso dwirɛ.

english_verse: If we love and obey God, we know we will love his children.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛkuro Nyameɛ dwirɛ ná yɛdi ye ahyɛdeɛ so a, ɛhe yeɛ ɔmaa yɛnwu kyɛ yɛkuro Nyameɛ mma dwirɛ ɔ.

english_verse: We show our love for God by obeying his commandments, and they are not hard to follow.
translation_verse: Sɛ yɛdi Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ so a yeɛ okyire kyɛ yɛkuro ye dwirɛ ɔ, na ye ahyɛdeɛ ne aso lilɛ koso nyɛ se.

english_verse: Every child of God can defeat the world, and our faith is what gives us this victory.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nikyee biala bɔ Nyameɛ awo ye ne, odi wiase so ngonim, na yɛ gyidie yeɛ ole ngonim bɔ yɛfa yɛdi wiase so ne.

english_verse: No one can defeat the world without having faith in Jesus as the Son of God. Who Jesus Is
translation_verse: Nwa yeɛ odi wiase so ngonim ɔ? Ye ole sona bɔ ode di kyɛ Yesu ole Nyameɛ Awa ne ɔ. Yesu nwo adanzeɛ

english_verse: Water and blood came out from the side of Jesus Christ. It wasn't just water, but water and blood. The Spirit tells about this, because the Spirit is truthful.
translation_verse: Yesu Kristo yeɛ ole bɔ bafa nzue ne mogya bali ye walɛ ne nwo adanzeɛ ne. Nna nzue ngome, na mmom nzue ne mogya. Na Sunzum ne yeɛ odi adanzeɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ Sunzum ne ole nahorɛ ne.

english_verse: In fact, there are three who tell about it.
translation_verse: Adanzefoɛ nza yeɛ bɛwɔ berɛ ɔ:

english_verse: They are the Spirit, the water, and the blood, and they all agree.
translation_verse: Sunzum ne, nzue ne, yeɛ mogya ne, na bɛ mmɛsa b’adanzeɛ ne te ko.

english_verse: We believe what people tell us. But we can trust what God says even more, and God is the one who has spoken about his Son.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛde kuro sona adanzeɛ yɛto nu a, nzaade Nyameɛ adanzeɛ deɛ ne di mu tra so. Ofikyɛ ɛhe te Nyameɛ adanzeɛ bɔ wali wafa Ɔwa ne nwo ɔ.

english_verse: If we have faith in God's Son, we have believed what God has said. But if we don't believe what God has said about his Son, it is the same as calling God a liar.
translation_verse: Yiti ebiala bɔ ode Nyameɛ Awa ne di ne, ole sɔ adanzeɛ ne wɔ ye ahone nu. Nakoso ebiala bɔ onne Nyameɛ nni ne, ɔma Nyameɛ yɛ ngondomboniɛ, ofikyɛ onne adanzeɛ bɔ Nyameɛ wali wafa Ɔwa ne nwo nni.

english_verse: God has also said he gave us eternal life and this life comes to us from his Son.
translation_verse: Adanzeɛ ne ɛhe: Nyameɛ ama yɛ daa ngoa, na sɔ ngoa ne wɔ Ɔwa ne anu.

english_verse: And so, if we have God's Son, we have this life. But if we don't have the Son, we don't have this life. Knowing about Eternal Life
translation_verse: Yiti ebiala bɔ ode Baa ne di ne ole ngoa, nakoso bɔ onne Baa ne nni ne de, olle ngoa. Bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ

english_verse: All of you have faith in the Son of God, and I have written to let you know you have eternal life.
translation_verse: Mekyerɛ ɛhemɔ mebrɛ ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔde Nyameɛ Awa ne dumaa bedi ne, amaa ɛmɔanwu kyɛ ɛmɔle daa ngoa, na ɛmɔahɔ so bale Nyameɛ Awa ne dumaa bali.

english_verse: We are certain God will hear our prayers when we ask for what pleases him.
translation_verse: Na anyelasoɛ bɔ yɛle wɔ ye nu ne ole kyɛ, sɛ yɛbisa nikyee biala kyɛbɔ ye pɛ te a, otie yɛ.

english_verse: And if we know God listens when we pray, we are sure our prayers have already been answered.
translation_verse: Na sɛ yɛse kyɛ bɔ yɛbisa biala otie yɛ de a, nzaade yɛse kyɛ yɛ sa ahã nningyein bɔ yɛbisa ye ne dada.

english_verse: Suppose you see one of our people commit a sin that isn't a deadly sin. You can pray, and this person will be given eternal life. But the sin must not be one that is deadly.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie nwu oliɛma kyɛ ɔyɔ bɔne bɔ ɔmva ye ngɔ ewue nu a, maa ɔbɔ mbaeɛ ɔma ye, na Nyameɛ kɔfa ye mbaeɛ ne aso kɔma ye ngoa. Mekyire bɛ bɔ bɛyɔ bɔne bɔ ɔmva bɛ ngɔ ewue nu ɔ. Nakoso bɔne bie wɔ berɛ bɔ ɔfa sona kɔ ewue nu ɔ, na ɛhe de mengyire kyɛ ɔbɔ ye nwo mbaeɛ.

english_verse: Everything that is wrong is sin, but not all sins are deadly.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔndengyɛ biala te bɔne, nakoso nna ye mukoraa yeɛ ɔfa sona kɔ ewue nu ɔ.

english_verse: We are sure God's children do not keep on sinning. God's own Son protects them, and the devil cannot harm them.
translation_verse: Yɛse kyɛ ebiala bɔ Nyameɛ awo ye ne, ɔnyɔ bɔne; na mmom bɔ Nyameɛ awo ye ne, ɔnea ye nwo so, na bɔnefoɛ ne mva ye sa nga ye.

english_verse: We are certain we come from God and the rest of the world is under the power of the devil.
translation_verse: Yɛse kyɛ yɛte Nyameɛ deɛ, yeɛ ewiase amukoraa wura bɔnefoɛ ne bo.

english_verse: We know that Jesus Christ the Son of God has come and has shown us the true God. And because of Jesus, we now belong to the true God who gives eternal life.
translation_verse: Yɛsa yɛse kyɛ Nyameɛ Awa ne awa, na wabukye y’adwene nu maa yanwu nahorɛniɛ ne. Yɛne Ɔwa Yesu Kristo bɔ ɔte nahorɛniɛ ne atira abiɛngoɛ, na ye yeɛ ɔte nahorɛ Nyameɛ ne ɔne daa ngoa ne ɔ.

english_verse: Children, you must stay away from idols.
translation_verse: Me ngwadaa mɔ, ɛmɔhwe ɛmɔ nwo béfi mmosoen nwo.

english_verse: From the church leader. To a very special woman and her children. I truly love all of you, and so does everyone else who knows the truth.
translation_verse: Krataa he fi me bɔ nde panyi berɛ. Mefa mebrɛ braa bɔ baneanea nu baye ye ne ɔne ye mma. Mekuro bɛ dwirɛ nahorɛ nu, na nna me ngome, na mmom mmenia mukoraa bɔ banwu nahorɛ ne wora bekuro bɛ dwirɛ,

english_verse: We love you because the truth is now in our hearts, and it will be there forever.
translation_verse: ɔnate nahorɛ ne bɔ ɔte yɛ nu ná ɔne yɛ kɔtena afebɔɔ ne ati.

english_verse: I pray that God the Father and Jesus Christ his Son will be kind and merciful to us! May they give us peace and truth and love. Truth and Love
translation_verse: Baba Nyameɛ ne Ɔwa Awurade Yesu Kristo bɛlo yɛ ná bɛ́ma yɛ asomdwee, ná bénwu yɛ anwumvoin wɔ nahorɛ ne ɔdɔ nu. Nahorɛ ne ɔdɔ

english_verse: I was very glad to learn that some of your children are obeying the truth, as the Father told us to do.
translation_verse: Ɔyɛle me fɛ paa, kyɛ nwuni kyɛ wɔ mma nemɔ bie nate nahorɛ ne anu kyɛbɔ Baba ne hyɛle yɛ ne ala.

english_verse: Dear friend, I am not writing to tell you and your children to do something you have not done before. I am writing to tell you to love each other, which is the first thing you were told to do.
translation_verse: Yiti afei, bra panyi, mesrɛ wɔ kyɛ ɛ́mɔma yɛhurohuro yɛ nwo dwirɛ; nna kyɛ mmeraa foforɛ yeɛ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ ɔ, na mmom mmeraa bɔ yɛnyane ye fili ahyɛaseɛ ne ala ɔ.

english_verse: Love means we do what God tells us. And from the beginning, he told you to love him.
translation_verse: Na ɔdɔ ole kyɛ yɛkoli ye ahyɛdeɛ ne aso ɔ’. Na ahyɛdeɛ ne, kyɛbɔ yate fi ahyɛaseɛ ne ole kyɛ yɛtena ɔdɔ nu.

english_verse: Many liars have gone out into the world. These deceitful liars are saying Jesus Christ did not have a truly human body. But they are liars and the enemies of Christ.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nnakannakafoɛ pee bawa wiase, na bɛ yeɛ benne bɛndo nu kyɛ Yesu Kristo awa anwoɔnaen nu waayɛ kuro sona ɔ. Na sona biala bɔ ɔyɔ sɔ ne, ɔte ngondomboniɛ ne antikristo.

english_verse: So be sure not to lose what we have worked for. If you do, you won't be given your full reward.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔnea ɛmɔ nwo yé, amaa bɔ ɛmɔafɛ banya ye ne wamvi ɛmɔ sa, na mmom ɛmɔanya ye nwo akatuaa mukoraa.

english_verse: Don't keep changing what you were taught about Christ, or else God will no longer be with you. But if you hold firmly to what you were taught, both the Father and the Son will be with you.
translation_verse: Sona biala bɔ onni Kristo ngyerɛkyerɛ so ná mmom ɔfa bie bata ye nwo ne, ɔnze Nyameɛ. Nakoso sona biala bɔ odi Kristo ngyerɛkyerɛ so ne, ɔse Baba ne ne Baa ne.

english_verse: If people won't agree to this teaching, don't welcome them into your home or even greet them.
translation_verse: Sɛ ebiala ba ɛmɔ berɛ nna ottira sɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ ye a, nnɛma ɛmɔsikye ye ɛmɔ awuro anaa nnɛma ɛmɔyɛ ye akwaaba.

english_verse: Greeting them is the same as taking part in their evil deeds. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ebiala bɔ ɔyɛ ye akwaaba ne, ɔyɔ ye yɔleɛ tɛɛ ne bie. Ayieleɛ

english_verse: I have much more to tell you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink. I want to come and talk to you in person, because this will make us really happy.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ pee wɔ berɛ bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ mekã mekyire ɛmɔ ɔ, nakoso mengɔfa krataa ne pɛn mengɔhyerɛ mengɔbrɛ ɛmɔ; na mmom mepena kyɛ mebafua ɛmɔ nwo ná manwu ɛmɔ nyunu maa yali ngɔmɔ, amaa y’anigye ali mu.

english_verse: Greetings from the children of your very special sister.
translation_verse: Eliɛmaa brasua bɔ baneanea nu baye ye ne, ye mma mɔ bébisa ɛmɔ ahye.

english_verse: From the church leader. To my dear friend Gaius. I love you because we follow the truth,
translation_verse: Krataa ye fi me bɔ nde panyi berɛ. Mefa mebrɛ Gayɔso bɔ mekuro ye dwirɛ wɔ nahorɛ nu ɔ.

english_verse: dear friend, and I pray all goes well for you. I hope you are as strong in body, as I know you are in spirit.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa, mebɔ mbaeɛ mema wɔ kyɛ nikyee biala hɔ so yé ma wɔ, ná enya anwoserɛ anwoɔnaen nu, kyɛbɔ nningyein kɔ so yé ma wɔ kra ne.

english_verse: It makes me very happy when the Lord's followers come by and speak openly of how you obey the truth.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ nyane anigye pee mmerɛ bɔ aliɛmaa nemɔ bɛwale belili wɔ nahorɛlilɛ nwo adanzeɛ, kyɛbɔ amba ɛfa nahorɛlilɛ bɔ wɔ bra ne.

english_verse: Nothing brings me greater happiness than to hear that my children are obeying the truth. Working Together
translation_verse: Nikyee biala mma me anigye bɔ ɔtra so te kyɛ ngɔte kyɛ me mma mɔ nate nahorɛ ne anu ɔ. Gayɔso kamvolɛ

english_verse: Dear friend, you have always been faithful in helping other followers of the Lord, even the ones you didn't know before.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa, nikyee biala bɔ ɛyɔ ma aliɛmaa nemɔ ne, yeɛ afei ɛwɔfoɛ mɔ po ne, ɛyɔ ye nahorɛ nu.

english_verse: They have told the church about your love. They say you were good enough to welcome them and to send them on their mission in a way God's servants deserve.
translation_verse: Bɛ yeɛ bali wɔ dɔ ne nwo adanzeɛ bahyire asɔre ne ɔ. Na ɔte paa kyɛ ekogua bɛ ate kama bɔ ɔfata Nyameɛ solɛ ɔ.

english_verse: When they left to tell others about the Lord, they decided not to accept help from anyone who wasn't a follower.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɔnate ye ti yeɛ besili nu bɛhɔle ɔ, na banne hwee bamvi Amaenmaensofoɛ berɛ.

english_verse: We must support people like them, so we can take part in what they are doing to spread the truth.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔsɛ kyɛ yɛboka sɔ mmenia nemɔ, amaa yɛ ne bɛ yayɛ aliɛmaa adwumayɔlɛfoɛ wɔ nahorɛ ne anu. Diotrefe ne Demetrio

english_verse: I wrote to the church. But Diotrephes likes to be the number-one leader, and he won't pay any attention to us.
translation_verse: Mahyerɛ krataa maama asɔre ne, nakoso Diotrefe bɔ okuro kyɛ ɔyɛ ye nwo panyi tra ebiala ne, onne yɛ ndo nu.

english_verse: So if I come, I will remind him of how he has been attacking us with gossip. Not only has he been doing this, but he refuses to welcome any of the Lord's followers who come by. And when other church members want to welcome them, he puts them out of the church.
translation_verse: Yiti sɛ meba a, ngɔfa bɔ ɔyɛ ne ngɔto dwaa: odi nzekure yeayea fa yɛ nwo. Nna ɛhe angome, afei koso onzikye aliɛmaa mɔ wɔ ye awuro. Asa koso osi bɛ bɔ bekuro kyɛ bede aliɛmaa nemɔ bɛto nu ne ate, na ɔfoa bɛ fi asɔre ne anu.

english_verse: Dear friend, don't imitate the evil deeds of others, but follow the example of people who do kind deeds. They are God's children, but those who are always doing evil have never seen God.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa, nnɛdi tɛɛ si na mmom di paa si. Sona biala bɔ ɔyɔ paa ne te Nyameɛ deɛ, na sona bɔ ɔyɔ tɛɛ ne, onnwuni Nyameɛ.

english_verse: Everyone speaks well of Demetrius, and so does the true message that he teaches. I also speak well of him, and you know what I say is true. Final Greetings
translation_verse: Mmenia mukoraa di Demetrio nwo adanzeɛ paa, yeɛ ye yɔleɛ koso di ye nwo adanzeɛ paa. Yɛ koso yɛdi ye nwo adanzeɛ, na ɛmɔse kyɛ y’adanzeɛ ne te nahorɛ. Ayieleɛ

english_verse: I have much more to say to you, but I don't want to write it with pen and ink.
translation_verse: Edwirɛ pee wɔ berɛ bɔ ahaa ɔsɛ kyɛ mekyerɛ mebrɛ wɔ ɔ, nakoso menguro kyɛ mefa krataa ne pɛn mekyerɛ ɔ;

english_verse: I hope to see you soon, and then we can talk in person.
translation_verse: na mmom ɔngɔhyɛ biala ngonwu wɔ dɔ, ná manwu wɔ nyunu ná yali ngɔmɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God will bless you with peace! Your friends send their greetings. Please give a personal greeting to each of our friends.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ ma wɔ asomdwee. Wɔ mmango mɔ bebisa wɔ ahye. Bisa yɛ mmango mɔ ahye ma yɛ ngoko ngoko.

english_verse: From Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James. To all who are chosen and loved by God the Father and are kept safe by Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Yuda bɔ nde Yesu Kristo akoaa ne Yakobo aliɛma, mefa mebrɛ bɛ bɔ bafrɛ bɛ, bɔ bɛla Baba Nyameɛ ahone nwo, bɔ wafa bɛ wasie wɔ Yesu Kristo nu ɔ.

english_verse: I pray that God will greatly bless you with mercy, peace, and love! False Teachers
translation_verse: Mesrɛ kyɛ anwumvoinnwunɛ, asomdwee ne ɔdɔ ɔsone pee ma ɛmɔ. Gyina ma gyidie ne

english_verse: My dear friends, I really wanted to write you about God's saving power at work in our lives. But instead, I must write and ask you to defend the faith that God has once for all given to his people.
translation_verse: Aliɛmaa mɔ, mabɔ mmɔden amukoraa kyɛ mekyerɛ ngoalelɛ bɔ yɛ mukoraa yanya ye ne nwo dwirɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ, na ye nwo ahia kyɛ mekyerɛ mebrɛ ɛmɔ, ná metu ɛmɔ foɛ, kyɛ ɛ́mɔpere bégyina pindinn bɛ́ma gyidie bɔ bafa bama anwoteefoɛ pɛnko ne.

english_verse: Some godless people have sneaked in among us and are saying, “God treats us much better than we deserve, and so it is all right to be immoral.” They even deny we must obey Jesus Christ as our only Master and Lord. But long ago the Scriptures warned that these godless people were doomed.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ mmenia biemɔ bawuawua bɛ nwo baawura ɛmɔ nu, mmenia bɔ ofi tetetete bahyerɛ bɛ nwo dwirɛ bato berɛ bama ndɛenbualɛ he, amumuyɛɛfoɛ bɔ bafa yɛ Nyameɛ adom ne bakakyi ahowibra, ná bɛpo Awurade Yesu Kristo bɔ ɔte yɛ Meneɛ komapɛ ne ɔ. Akyerɛkyerɛfoɛ ngondombofoɛ

english_verse: Don't forget what happened to those people the Lord rescued from Egypt. Some of them did not have faith, and he later destroyed them.
translation_verse: Ɔwɔ nu kyɛ ɛmɔse ɛhemɔ dada de, nakoso mepena kyɛ mebɔ ɛmɔ so, kyɛ Awurade bɔ olele maen ne fili Misraim aseɛ so ne, nziɛ ye, ohuhuni bɛ bɔ banne banni ne.

english_verse: You also know about the angels who didn't do their work and left their proper places. God chained them with everlasting chains and is now keeping them in dark pits until the great day of judgment.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo mɔ bɔ bannea bɛ dibea so yé, ná mmom bɛyakyili bɛ bɔbɔ b’atenaleɛ berɛ ne, wabɔ bɛ afebɔɔ panwu wafa bɛ wasie awosii kabii nu, na ɔfa nwondɛ kyẽa piri ndɛenbualɛ ne.

english_verse: We should also be warned by what happened to the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and the nearby towns. Their people became immoral and committed all sorts of sexual sins. Then God made an example of them and punished them with eternal fire.
translation_verse: Na sɔ ala yeɛ Sodom ne Gomora ne nguro bɔ bapɛ bɛ nwo bayia, bɔ bɛyɛle kyɛ ɛhemɔ, bɔ bɛlɔle asukɔ wɔ adwamanbɔlɛ nu, ná bɛbɔle nnaa nu musue ne, bafa bɛ bayɛ see afebɔɔ nwo nhwɛsoɛ bato berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The people I am talking about are behaving just like those dreamers who destroyed their own bodies. They reject all authority and insult angels.
translation_verse: Na sɔ ala yeɛ sɔ laleɛhyenɛfoɛ nemɔ begua bɛ nwonaen nwo fiɛ ɔ. Bebu tumililɛ animtia, na bɛkekã dwirɛ betia animnyamfoɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: Even Michael, the chief angel, didn't dare to insult the devil, when the two of them were arguing about the body of Moses. All Michael said was, “The Lord will punish you!”
translation_verse: Nakoso mmerɛ bɔ abɔfo panyi Mikayɛl ne abɔnzam bɛpereperele Mose fuin nwo ne, Mikayɛl anzi ye hue wanga dwirɛ wandia ye wammua ye ndɛen, na mmom ɔhane kyɛ, “Awurade hwi wɔ nyunu!”

english_verse: But these people insult powers they don't know anything about. They are like senseless animals that end up getting destroyed, because they live only by their feelings.
translation_verse: Nakoso mmenia hemɔ de, bɛkekã dwirɛ tɛɛ betia nikyee biala bɔ bɛnde ye bo ɔ; na nikyee bɔ befi bɛ sona sue nu bɛse, kyɛ ngaka bɔ adwene nne bɛ ti anu ne, ye ala yeɛ ogua bɛ nwo fiɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Now they are in for real trouble. They have followed Cain's example and have made the same mistake that Balaam did by caring only for money. They have also rebelled against God, just as Korah did. Because of all this, they will be destroyed.
translation_verse: Bɛ yaakɔ! Ofikyɛ batu Kein agyirɛ ne bie, na adifuu ti bafa bɛ nwo baawura Balaam nnakannaka dwirɛ ne anu, na bekowuwu wɔ Kora ɛlɔenyɛlɛ ne anu.

english_verse: These people are filthy minded, and by their shameful and selfish actions they spoil the meals you eat together. They are like clouds blown along by the wind, but never bringing any rain. They are like leafless trees, uprooted and dead, and unable to produce fruit.
translation_verse: Sɔ mmenia nemɔ, bɛte ngekalewa wɔ ɛmɔ ɔdɔ adidie bo, bɛne ɛmɔ didi a, bɛte mmoaenneafoɛ bɔ bɛ ngome bɛ ko yeɛ ohia bɛ ɔ, bɛte munungum bɔ nzue nne nu bɔ mvrama fa ye kyinikyini ɔ; mmakaa bɔ odwu bɛ sulɛ a benzu mma ɔ, bawu pɛen nyɔ, bɔ bɛ bo atutu ɔ,

english_verse: Their shameful deeds show up like foam on wild ocean waves. They are like wandering stars forever doomed to the darkest pits of hell.
translation_verse: bɛte ɛpo asorɔkye bɔ obu fa so, bɔ opu bɛ bɔbɔ b’animguaseɛ gua ɔ, nzramaa mɔ bɔ bekyinikyini bɔ basiesie awosii kabii bama bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Enoch was the seventh person after Adam, and he was talking about these people when he said: Look! The Lord is coming with thousands and thousands of holy angels
translation_verse: Na sɔ mmenia nemɔ yeɛ Henɔke, bɔ ɔte aworɛ ndoatoasoɛ nzoo fi Adam so ne, ɔhyɛle ngɔm fale bɛ nwo kyɛ, “Tie, Awurade ne ye anwoteefoɛ apee apee bɛ́ba;

english_verse: to judge everyone. He will punish all those ungodly people for all the evil things they have done. The Lord will surely punish those ungodly sinners for every evil thing they have ever said about him.
translation_verse: kyɛ ɔbaabua ebiala ndɛen, na okobua amumuyɛɛfoɛ amukoraa foɛ wɔ b’amumuyɛɛ yɔleɛ amukoraa nwo, ɔne edwirɛ tɛɛ amukoraa bɔ bɔnefoɛ amumuyɛɛfoɛ bakekã batia ye ɔ nwo.”

english_verse: These people grumble and complain and live by their own selfish desires. They brag about themselves and flatter others to get what they want. More Warnings
translation_verse: Ɛhemɔ te mmenia bɔ bɛ kunu ndwo, somoɛbɔlɛfoɛ, bedi bɛ bɔbɔ b’akɔnnɔ si, bɛfa bɛ noa bɛhoahoa bɛ nwo, na adifuu ti bɛdɛfɛdɛfɛ mmenia. Gyidie nwo foɛtulɛ

english_verse: My dear friends, remember the warning you were given by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.
translation_verse: Yiti aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛ́mɔkaye edwirɛ bɔ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo asomafoɛ mɔ bahã bato berɛ ne.

english_verse: They told you that near the end of time, selfish and godless people would start making fun of God.
translation_verse: Bɛhã behyirele ɛmɔ kyɛ, “Mmerɛ bɔ oli nziɛ ne anu, ngorohoɛfoɛ kodwɔso, na bekoli bɛ bɔbɔ b’akɔnnɔ si.”

english_verse: And now these people are already making you turn against each other. They think only about this life, and they don't have God's Spirit.
translation_verse: Bɛ yeɛ bɛfa mbakyembakyemuɛ bɛba ɔ, Sunzum ne ɔnne bɛ nu, na bɛte mmenia bɔ bedi anwoɔnaen si ɔ.

english_verse: Dear friends, keep building on the foundation of your most holy faith, as the Holy Spirit helps you to pray.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ de, aliɛmaa mɔ, ɛmɔhɔ so benyi wɔ ɛmɔ gyidie krongron paa ne anu, ná ɛ́mɔbɔ mbaeɛ wɔ Sunzum Krongron nu;

english_verse: And keep in step with God's love, as you wait for our Lord Jesus Christ to show how kind he is by giving you eternal life.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔhɔ so bɛtena Nyameɛ ɔdɔ nu, ná ɛ́mɔnwondɛ y’Awurade Yesu Kristo anwumvoinnwunɛ ne bɛhɔ daa ngoa nu.

english_verse: Be helpful to all who may have doubts.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ b’adwene yɛ bɛ naa ne, ɛ́mɔnwu bɛ anwumvoin;

english_verse: Rescue any who need to be saved, as you would rescue someone from a fire. Then with fear in your own hearts, have mercy on everyone who needs it. But hate even the clothes of those who have been made dirty by their filthy deeds. Final Prayer
translation_verse: ebiemɔ koso, ɛ́mɔhwe bɛ béfi see nu bele bɛ ngoa; ebiemɔ koso, ɛ́mɔfa anwowosolɛ benwu bɛ anwumvoin, nakoso ɛmɔhyi ndaadeɛ po bɔ bɛ nwonaen ayɛ ngekalewa wɔ nu ne. Ayieleɛ

english_verse: Offer praise to God our Savior because of our Lord Jesus Christ! Only God can keep you from falling and make you pure and joyful in his glorious presence. Before time began and now and forever, God is worthy of glory, honor, power, and authority. Amen.
translation_verse: Nyameɛ komapɛ bɔ ɔnate y’Awurade Yesu Kristo so ɔte yɛ Ngoadefoɛ ne, animnyam, ahennie, anwoserɛ ne tumi ɔyɛ ye deɛ daa, kekesaala ne afebɔɔ. Amen.

english_verse: This is what God showed to Jesus Christ, so that he could tell his servants what must happen soon. Christ then sent his angel with the message to his servant John.
translation_verse: Ɛhe te Yesu Kristo nwo aliyelɛ bɔ Nyameɛ fa mane ye kyɛ ɔla ye ali hyire ye ngoaa mɔ ma benwu edwirɛ mɔ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛba nu ndɛndɛ ɔ; na ɔsomane ye abɔfo maa ɔɔye hyirele ye akoaa Yohane,

english_verse: And John told everything he had seen about God's message and about what Jesus Christ had said and done.
translation_verse: bɔ odi Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne ne Yesu Kristo adanzeɛ ne nwo adanzeɛ, ɔne bɔ onwuni ye ne amukoraa nwo adanzeɛ ɔ.

english_verse: God will bless everyone who reads this prophecy to others, and he will bless everyone who hears and obeys it. The time is almost here.
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ ɔkenga nyekyire ne kyire, ɔne bɛ bɔ betie, ná betira bɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ nu ne anu ne, ɔte saleɛ ma bɛ; ofikyɛ mmerɛ ne apingye. Ahyebisalɛ

english_verse: From John to the seven churches in Asia. I pray that you will be blessed with kindness and peace from God, who is and was and is coming. May you receive kindness and peace from the seven spirits before the throne of God.
translation_verse: Yohane yeɛ mefa mebrɛ asɔre nzoo bɔ bɛwɔ Asia ne ɔ: Adom ne asomdwee bɔ ofi bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ kekesaala ye ne, bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ dada ne, bɔ ɔbaawa ne, ɔne bɔ ofi Sunzum nzoo bɔ bɛwɔ ye ahennie bia ne anyunu ne,

english_verse: May kindness and peace be yours from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness. Jesus was the first to conquer death, and he is the ruler of all earthly kings. Christ loves us, and by his blood he set us free from our sins.
translation_verse: ɔne bɔ ofi Yesu Kristo bɔ ɔte danzeniɛ nahorɛniɛ ne, awufoɛ nu bamuɛbaa ne aseɛ so ahemvo mɔ bɛ hene ne berɛ ne, ɔbra ɛmɔ so. Ye bɔ okuro yɛ dwirɛ, ná wafa ye mogya wanwunzi yɛ nwo wafi yɛ bɔne nu,

english_verse: He lets us rule as kings and serve God his Father as priests. To him be glory and power forever and ever! Amen.
translation_verse: ná wayɛ yɛ ahennie maen ne asɔfo wama ye Baba Nyameɛ ne, animnyam ne tumi ɔyɛ ye deɛ daa daa, Amen.

english_verse: Look! He is coming with the clouds. Everyone will see him, even the ones who stuck a sword through him. All people on earth will weep because of him. Yes, it will happen! Amen.
translation_verse: Ɛmɔnea! Ɔnate munungum nu ɔ́ba, anyeɛ biala konwu ye, yeɛ bɛ bɔ bɛwɔle ye pealɛɛ ne po bekonwu ye; na ɔnate ye ti aseɛ so mmusua kure amukoraa bɛkɔbɔ awuye. Na sɔ ala yeɛ okosi ɔ. Amen.

english_verse: The Lord God says, “I am Alpha and Omega, the one who is and was and is coming. I am God All-Powerful!” A Vision of the Risen Lord
translation_verse: Awurade nwa Nyameɛ nwa, “Me ole Alfa ne Omega ne, bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ kekesaala ye ne, bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ dada ne, bɔ ɔbaawa ne, nikyee biala so Tuminiɛ ne.” Yohane nwu Kristo wɔ ye animnyam nu

english_verse: I am John, a follower together with all of you. We suffer because Jesus is our king, but he gives us the strength to endure. I was sent to Patmos Island, because I had preached God's message and had told about Jesus.
translation_verse: Me, Yohane, bɔ nde ɛmɔ aliɛma ne ɛmɔ abiɛngoɛ wɔ Yesu Kristo amaneɛnwunɛ ne ahennie ne animia nu ɔ, ɔnate Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne ne Yesu Kristo adanzeɛ ne ati, né nwɔ Supɔ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Patemo so.

english_verse: On the Lord's day the Spirit took control of me, and behind me I heard a loud voice that sounded like a trumpet.
translation_verse: Né nwɔ Sunzum nu wɔ Awurade kyẽa ne, na ndele komviɛ piri bie wɔ me si dɔ, bɔ ɔte kyɛ totorobɛndo ɔ kyɛ,

english_verse: The voice said, “Write in a book what you see. Then send it to the seven churches in Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and Laodicea.”
translation_verse: “[Me ole Alfa ne Omega ne, ahyɛaseɛ ne ayieleɛ ne.] Kyerɛ bɔ enwu ye ne gua nwomaa nu, ná fa kɔma asɔre nzoo nemɔ, fa kɔ Ɛfeso, Simina, Pɛgamɔm, Tiatira, Sadise, Filadɛɛfia ne Laodikea.”

english_verse: When I turned to see who was speaking to me, I saw seven gold lampstands.
translation_verse: Na ngakyili me nwo kyɛ menea komviɛ bɔ odwudwo kyire me ne, na mbɛle me nye ne, nwuni esikaa kɔkorɛ kanea bakaa nzoo;

english_verse: There with the lampstands was someone who seemed to be the Son of Man. He was wearing a robe that reached down to his feet, and a gold cloth was wrapped around his chest.
translation_verse: na kanea bakaa nemɔ b’afia ne, nwuni ebie bɔ ɔte kyɛ Sona Awa ne, bɔ owura ataadeɛ tendenn, bɔ wafa sikaa kɔkorɛ abɔsoɛ wabɔ ye afia ɔ.

english_verse: His head and his hair were white as wool or snow, and his eyes looked like flames of fire.
translation_verse: Ye ti ne ye nwiaa te fufue kyɛ gyese, hyɛnn kyɛ asukɔtwea; na ye nye mmaa te kyɛ see bɔ ogye ɔ;

english_verse: His feet were glowing like bronze being heated in a furnace, and his voice sounded like the roar of a waterfall.
translation_verse: ye gya nwo te kyɛ ayaa bɔ bahwi ye nwo nyemenenyemene ɔ, kyɛ bɔ bafa see bapɔ ye nwo ɔ, na ye komvi te kyɛ asue pee bɔ bɛsẽ wuruwuru ɔ.

english_verse: He held seven stars in his right hand, and a sharp double-edged sword was coming from his mouth. His face was shining as bright as the sun at noon.
translation_verse: Né otira nzramaa nzoo wɔ ye sa famaa nu, na sɛpɔ nnaennaen fili ye noa nu fitele, na ye nyunu te kyɛ eyia bɔ ɔbɔ gyireingyirein ɔ.

english_verse: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead person. But he put his right hand on me and said: Don't be afraid! I am the first, the last,
translation_verse: Na mmerɛ bɔ nwuni ye ne, nde ndɔle ye gya bo kyɛ ebie bɔ wawu ɔ, nakoso ɔfale ye sa famaa tole me so sele me kyɛ, “Nnɛsuro! Me ole Ahyɛaseɛ ne Ayieleɛ ne,

english_verse: and the living one. I died, but now I am alive forever, and I have the keys to death and the world of the dead.
translation_verse: ɔne bɔ ɔte ase ne. Nwuli, na tie, nde ase afebɔɔ, na ndira ewue ne ɛborɔ nzafoaa.

english_verse: Write what you have seen and what is and what will happen after these things.
translation_verse: Yiti kyerɛ bɔ anwu ye, bɔ ɔwɔ berɛ kekesaala ye, ɔne bɔ nziɛ ye ɔbaasi ne.

english_verse: I will explain the mystery of the seven stars you saw at my right side and the seven gold lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches, and the lampstands are the seven churches.
translation_verse: Na nzramaa nzoo bɔ enwuni bɛ wɔ me sa famaa nu, ɔne sikaa kɔkorɛ kanea bakaa nzoo ne, bɛ nwo mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ɛhe: Nzramaa nzoo ne bɛte asɔre nzoo nemɔ b’abɔfo mɔ, yeɛ kanea bakaa nzoo bɔ enwuni bɛ ne bɛte asɔre nzoo ne.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Ephesus: I am the one who holds the seven stars in my right hand, and I walk among the seven gold lampstands. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Kyerɛ kɔma Ɛfeso asɔre ne anu abɔfo ne kyɛ: Bɔ otira nzramaa nzoo wɔ ye sa famaa nu, bɔ ɔnate sikaa kɔkorɛ kanea bakaa nemɔ b’afia ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe:

english_verse: I know everything you have done, including your hard work and how you have endured. I know you won't put up with anyone who is evil. When some people pretended to be apostles, you tested them and found out they were liars.
translation_verse: Mese wɔ nnwumaa, wɔ fɛɛ ne w’animia, ɔne kyɛbɔ ɛngora nzosɔ bɔnefoɛ so, ná mmom aso bɛ bɔ bɛnwa bɛte asomafoɛ nakoso bɛtte asomafoɛ ɔ anea, na anwu bɛ kyɛ bɛte ngondombofoɛ.

english_verse: You have endured and gone through hard times because of me, yet you have not given up.
translation_verse: Mese kyɛ anya animia paa, na ɔnate me dumaa ti anwu amaneɛ, nakoso w’abasa nu mmu.

english_verse: But I do have something against you! And it is this: You don't have as much love as you used to.
translation_verse: Nakoso mebɔ wɔ kwaadu, ofikyɛ ayakyi ɔdɔ bɔ elili moa nyane ye ne anu.

english_verse: Think about where you have fallen from, and then turn back and do as you did at first. If you don't turn back, I will come and take away your lampstand.
translation_verse: Yiti kaye tebea bɔ efili nu fini ase ne, ná sakyera w’adwene, ná yɔ nnwumaa bɔ ɛyɔle ye daa ne! Na sɛ anyɔ sɔ a, ngɔwa wɔ so ndɛndɛ, ná maaye wɔ kanea bakaa ne mafi ye boso, sana ɛsakyera w’adwene.

english_verse: But there is one thing you are doing right. You hate what the Nicolaitans are doing, and so do I.
translation_verse: Nakoso ayɔ paa he, kyɛ ekyi Nikolatafoɛ nnwumaa bɔ me koso mekyi ne.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. I will let everyone who wins the victory eat from the life-giving tree in God's wonderful garden. The Letter to Smyrna
translation_verse: Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie bɔ Sunzum ne kã kyire asɔre nemɔ ne: Bɔ odi ngonim ne, ngɔma ye ngoa bakaa bɔ ogyi Nyameɛ Paradise ne anu mma maa okoli. Simina asɔre ne ngraa

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Smyrna: I am the first and the last. I died, but now I am alive! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Kyerɛ kɔma Simina asɔre ne anu abɔfo ne kyɛ: Bɔ ɔte ahyɛaseɛ ne ayieleɛ, bɔ owuli ná osa te ase ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe:

english_verse: I know how much you suffer and how poor you are, but you are rich. I also know the cruel things being said about you by people who claim to be God's people. But they are not really God's people. They are a group that belongs to Satan.
translation_verse: Mese w’amaneɛnwunɛ ne wɔ hiaa, , yeɛ mese bɛ bɔ bɛnwa bɛte Yudafoɛ nakoso bɛtte Yudafoɛ ne, ná mmom bɛte Satan nyianu sua ne, bɛ musue dwirɛ kekanɛ ne.

english_verse: Don't worry about what you will suffer. The devil will throw some of you into jail, and you will be tested and made to suffer for ten days. But if you are faithful until you die, I will reward you with a glorious life.
translation_verse: Nnɛsuro amaneɛ biala bɔ ɛbaanwu ye ɔ. Tie, abɔnzam kɔfa ɛmɔ nu biemɔ kogua kuku nu, kyɛ ɔfa so ɛmɔ nea, na ɛmɔkonwu amaneɛ eleburu. Di nahorɛ kodwu ewue nu, na ngɔma wɔ ngoa abotire.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. Whoever wins the victory will not be hurt by the second death. The Letter to Pergamum
translation_verse: Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie bɔ Sunzum ne kã kyire asɔre nemɔ ne: Bɔ odi ngonim ne, ewue bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne ngɔwa ye so.’ Pɛgamɔm asɔre ne ngraa

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Pergamum: I am the one who has the sharp double-edged sword! Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Kyerɛ kɔma Pɛgamɔm asɔre ne anu abɔfo ne kyɛ, ‘Bɔ otira sɛpɔ nnaennaen ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe:

english_verse: I know you live where Satan has his throne. But you have kept true to my name. Right there where Satan lives, my faithful witness Antipas was taken from you and put to death. Even then you did not give up your faith in me.
translation_verse: [Mese wɔ nnwumaa], mese nekaa bɔ ɛte ɔ, nekaa bɔ Satan ahennie bia gyi ne; nakoso atira me dumaa ne anu bum, na ambo me gyidie ne, mmerɛ bɔ behuni m’adanzeniɛ nahorɛniɛ Antipa wɔ ɛmɔ berɛ ne po, nekaa bɔ Satan te ne.

english_verse: I do have a few things against you. Some of you are following the teaching of Balaam. Long ago he told Balak to teach the people of Israel to eat food that had been offered to idols and to be immoral.
translation_verse: Nakoso mebɔ wɔ kwaadu kãa, ofikyɛ ele mmenia biemɔ wɔ wɔ berɛ bɔ basɔ Balaam ngyerɛkyerɛ nu ɔ, ye bɔ ohyirele Balake kyɛ ɔto Yisraelfoɛ sundidua ma beli bosoen so aleɛ, ná bɛbɔ adwaman ɔ.

english_verse: Now some of you are following the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
translation_verse: Asa koso, ele ebiemɔ wɔ wɔ nu bɔ basɔ Nikolatafoɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ [bɔ mekyi ne] anu ɔ.

english_verse: Turn back! If you don't, I will come quickly and fight against these people. And my words will cut like a sword.
translation_verse: Yiti sakyera w’adwene! Na sɛ anyɔ sɔ a, ngɔwa wɔ so ndɛndɛ, na ngɔfa me noa nu ngrandɛ ne me ne bɛ yɛkɔho.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. To everyone who wins the victory, I will give some of the hidden food. I will also give each one a white stone with a new name written on it. No one will know that name except the one who is given the stone. The Letter to Thyatira
translation_verse: Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie bɔ Sunzum ne kã kyire asɔre nemɔ ne: Bɔ odi ngonim ne, ngɔma ye mvealeɛ nu mana ne bie maa okoli, na ngɔma ye nyɔboɛ fufue, na nyɔboɛ ne aso yeɛ bahyerɛ dumaa foforɛ bɔ ebiala nze bagua ɔ, sana sona bɔ onya ye ne angome.’ Tiatira asɔre ne ngraa

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Thyatira: I am the Son of God! My eyes are like flames of fire, and my feet are like bronze. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Kyerɛ kɔma Tiatira asɔre ne anu abɔfo ne kyɛ, ‘Nyameɛ Awa ne, bɔ ye nye mmaa te kyɛ see bɔ ogye, bɔ ye gya nwo te kyɛ ayaa bɔ bahwi ye nwo nyemenenyemene ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe:

english_verse: I know everything about you, including your love, your faith, your service, and how you have endured. I know you are doing more now than you have ever done before.
translation_verse: Mese wɔ nnwumaa, wɔ ɔdɔ, wɔ gyidie, wɔ ɛsolɛ, w’animia, ɔne wɔ kekesaala ye nnwumaa bɔ ɔtra daa deɛ ne ɔ.

english_verse: But I still have something against you because of that woman Jezebel. She calls herself a prophet, and you let her teach and mislead my servants to do immoral things and to eat food offered to idols.
translation_verse: Nakoso mebɔ wɔ kwaadu kãa, ofikyɛ ɛma braa Yesebɛl bɔ ɔfrɛ ye nwo ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ne ate, kyɛ ɔyɛ ngyerɛkyerɛ ná ɔlakalaka me ngoaa mɔ ma bɛbɔ adwaman ná beli bosoen so aleɛ.

english_verse: I gave her a chance to turn from her sins, but she did not want to stop doing these immoral things.
translation_verse: Mama ye mmerɛ kyɛ ɔfa sakyera fi ye adwamanbɔlɛ nu, nakoso wanzakyera.

english_verse: I am going to strike down Jezebel. Everyone who does these immoral things with her will also be punished, if they don't stop.
translation_verse: Na tie, ngɔma anwonyerɛ kɔbɔ ye kɔto bɛen so, na bɛ bɔ bɛne ye sɛkye agyaa ne, ngɔprapra amaneɛ pirikua ngogua bɛ so, sana bɛsakyera b’adwene wɔ bɛ yɔleɛ nwo.

english_verse: I will even kill her followers. Then all the churches will see that I know everyone's thoughts and feelings. I will treat each of you as you deserve.
translation_verse: Ngohũhũ ye mma mɔ, na asɔre nemɔ amukoraa bekonwu kyɛ me yeɛ mepɛnzɛpɛnzɛ sona ti anu ne ahone nu dwirɛ nu ɔ; na ngɔma ɛmɔ nu biala akatuaa kyɛbɔ ye nnwumaa te ɔ.

english_verse: Some of you in Thyatira don't follow Jezebel's teaching. You don't know anything about what her followers call the “deep secrets of Satan.” So I won't burden you down with any other commands.
translation_verse: Nakoso ɛmɔ ngaa bɔ baha Tiatira, bɔ ɛmɔnni sɔ ngyerɛkyerɛ ne aso, bɔ ɛmɔanzua bɔ mmenia frɛ ye Satan mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne de, ɛmɔ yeɛ mekã mekyire ɛmɔ kyɛ, mengɔfa adesoa foforɛ mengɔto ɛmɔ so.

english_verse: But until I come, you must hold firmly to the teaching you have.
translation_verse: Yiti bɔ ɛmɔanya ye ne, ɛ́mɔsɔ nu yé kɔpem kyɛ ngɔwa ɔ.

english_verse: I will give power over the nations to everyone who wins the victory and keeps on obeying me until the end.
translation_verse: Na bɔ odi ngonim, ɔne bɔ ɔsɔ me nnwumaa nu kodwu ayieleɛ ne, ngɔma ye maen maen mɔ so tumi;

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie bɔ Sunzum ne kã kyire asɔre nemɔ ne.

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Sardis: I have the seven spirits of God and the seven stars. Listen to what I say. I know what you are doing. Everyone may think you are alive, but you are dead.
translation_verse: “Kyerɛ kɔma Sadise asɔre ne anu abɔfo ne kyɛ: Bɔ ole Nyameɛ Sunzum nzoo ne nzramaa nzoo ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe: Mese wɔ nnwumaa; ale dumaa kyɛ ɛte ase, nakoso awu.

english_verse: Wake up! You have only a little strength left, and it is almost gone. So try to become stronger. I have found that you are not completely obeying God.
translation_verse: Tingye, ná kanyane bɔ waha wɔ wɔ nu bɔ ɔpena wu ne; ofikyɛ mennwu kyɛ wɔ nnwumaa di mu wɔ me Nyameɛ nyunu ɔ.

english_verse: Remember the teaching you were given and heard. Hold firmly to it and turn from your sins. If you don't wake up, I will come when you least expect it, just as a thief does.
translation_verse: Yiti kaye bɔ behyirele wɔ, ɔne bɔ ɛtele ne; sɔ nu yé na sakyera w’adwene. Na sɛ anwɛne a, ngɔwa wɔ so kyɛ awueniɛ, na engonwu dɔnhwere horɛ bɔ ngɔfa ngɔwa wɔ so ɔ.

english_verse: A few of you in Sardis have not dirtied your clothes with sin. You will walk with me in white clothes, because you are worthy.
translation_verse: Nakoso ele mmenia kãa bie wɔ Sadise bɔ bɛ de begguale b’ataadeɛ nwo fiɛ ɔ; na bɛne me kɔnate bɔ bewura ndaadeɛ fufuɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ bɛfata sɔ.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will wear white clothes. Their names will not be erased from the book of life, and I will tell my Father and his angels that they are my followers.
translation_verse: Na bɔ odi ngonim ne, bɛkɔfa ataadeɛ fufue sɔ bekowura ye, na mengokyikyi ye dumaa mengofi ngoa nwomaa ne anu; na mmom ngɔbɔ ye dumaa wɔ me Baba ne ye abɔfo mɔ nyunu.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Philadelphia
translation_verse: Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie bɔ Sunzum ne kã kyire asɔre nemɔ ne. Filadɛɛfia asɔre ne ngraa

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Philadelphia: I am the one who is holy and true, and I have the keys that belonged to David. When I open a door, no one can close it. And when I close a door, no one can open it. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Kyerɛ kɔma Filadɛɛfia asɔre ne anu abɔfo ne kyɛ, ‘Krongronniɛ ne nahorɛniɛ ne, bɔ otira Dawide safoaa ne, bɔ obukye a ebiala ndo nu, bɔ ɔto nu a ebiala mmukye ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe:

english_verse: I know everything you have done. And I have placed before you an open door no one can close. You were not very strong, but you obeyed my message and did not deny you are my followers.
translation_verse: Mese wɔ nnwumaa. Na tie, mafa anoa bɔ babukye ɔ masie wɔ nyunu, na ebiala ngɔhora nu to; ɔwɔ nu kyɛ w’anwoserɛ te kãa bie, nakoso ali me dwirɛ so, na ambo me dumaa.

english_verse: Now you will see what I will do with those people who belong to Satan's group. They claim to be God's people, but they are liars. I will make them come and kneel down at your feet. Then they will know that I love you.
translation_verse: Tie, ngɔfa bɛ bɔ befi Satan nyianu sua nu, bɔ bɛnwa bɛte Yudafoɛ, nakoso bɛtte sɔ ne, na mmom bɛpɛ ngondombo ne ngɔma wɔ. Tie, ngɔmaa bɛkɔɔkoto wɔ gya bo, ná banwu kyɛ mekuro wɔ dwirɛ.

english_verse: You obeyed my message and endured. So I will protect you from the time of testing everyone in all the world must go through.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ ali m’animia dwirɛ so ne ati, me koso ngɔbɔ wɔ nwo waen ngofi nzɔhwɛ mmerɛ bɔ ɔbaawa wiase amukoraa so ne anu, nzɔhwɛ bɔ ɔbaaso aseɛ ye aso ama nea ne.

english_verse: I am coming soon. So hold firmly to what you have, and no one will take away the crown you will be given as your reward.
translation_verse: Méba ndɛndɛ, yiti sɔ bɔ anya ye ne anu yé, ná ebiala anne w’abotire ne.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will be made into a pillar in the temple of my God, and they will stay there forever. I will write on each of them the name of my God and the name of his city. It is the new Jerusalem my God will send down from heaven. I will also write on them my own new name.
translation_verse: Na bɔ odi ngonim ne, ngɔyɛ ye bonima wɔ me Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu; na ongofi nu ngofite ko. Na me Nyameɛ dumaa, ɔne me Nyameɛ kuro dumaa, bɔ ɔte Yerusalem foforɛ ne, bɔ ofi nyameɛso ɔba ase fi me Nyameɛ berɛ, ɔne me dumaa foforɛ ne, ngɔhyerɛ ngogua ye nwo.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches. The Letter to Laodicea
translation_verse: Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie bɔ Sunzum ne kã kyire asɔre nemɔ ne!’ Laodikea asɔre ne ngraa

english_verse: This is what you must write to the angel of the church in Laodicea: I am the one called Amen! I am the faithful and true witness and the source of God's creation. Listen to what I say.
translation_verse: “Kyerɛ kɔma Laodikea asɔre ne anu abɔfo ne kyɛ: Amen, nahorɛniɛ ne nahorɛ danzeniɛ ne, Nyameɛ abɔdeɛ farebae ne, ye noa dwirɛ ɛhe:

english_verse: I know everything you have done, and you are not cold or hot. I wish you were either one or the other.
translation_verse: Mese wɔ nnwumaa: wɔ ahɔ a ɛtte frɔlɔɔ, yeɛ ɛnyɛ hye koso. Na ɔhale me ngome a, ahaa ɛte frɔlɔɔ anaa ɛyɛ hye.

english_verse: But since you are lukewarm and neither cold nor hot, I will spit you out of my mouth.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ ayɛ nnedɛɛnnedɛɛ, ná anyɛ frɔlɔɔ anaa anyɛ hye ne ati, ngɔfe wɔ ngofi me noa nu.

english_verse: You claim to be rich and successful and to have everything you need. But you don't know how bad off you really are. You are pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ɛnwa, ‘Manya me nwo, nne agyapadeɛ, na menhia nikyee fee.’ Nakoso ɛnze kyɛ ɛyɛ anwumvo, wɔ nwo yɛ aworabɔ, wahia wɔ, wɔ nye asi, ná wɔ nwo la so ɔ.

english_verse: Buy your gold from me. It has been refined in a fire, and it will make you rich. Buy white clothes from me. Wear them and you can cover up your shameful nakedness. Buy medicine for your eyes, so you will be able to see.
translation_verse: Yiti metu wɔ foɛ kyɛ, tɔ nningyein hemɔ fi me berɛ: sikaa kɔkorɛ bɔ bafa see bate ye nwo ɔ, amaa ɔnate so anya sikaa; ataadeɛ fufue bɔ ekowura bɔ ɔngɔma w’animguaseɛ adagya ne nwo ngɔla berɛ ɔ, yeɛ anyeɛ ayire bɔ ɛkɔfa kogua wɔ nye so, bɔ ɔkɔmaa ekonwu nikye ɔ.

english_verse: I correct and punish everyone I love. So make up your minds to turn away from your sins.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ mekuro bɛ dwirɛ ne, metwi bɛ nyunu, yeɛ metwe bɛ so; yiti ma wɔ nye boro ná sakyera w’adwene.

english_verse: Listen! I am standing and knocking at your door. If you hear my voice and open the door, I will come in and we will eat together.
translation_verse: Tie! Ngyi anoa ne asi mebɔ nu; na sɛ ebie te me komvi ná okobukye anoa ne a, ngowura nu ngɔwa ye berɛ, ná me ne ye yaadidi, ná ɔne me koso adidi.

english_verse: Everyone who wins the victory will sit with me on my throne, just as I won the victory and sat with my Father on his throne.
translation_verse: Na bɔ odi ngonim ne, ngɔmaa ɔne me kɔtena m’ahennie bia so, kyɛbɔ me koso mali ngonim ná me ne me Baba yatena ye ahennie bia so ne.

english_verse: If you have ears, listen to what the Spirit says to the churches.
translation_verse: Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie bɔ Sunzum ne kã kyire asɔre nemɔ ne.

english_verse: After this, I looked and saw a door that opened into heaven. Then the voice that had spoken to me at first and that sounded like a trumpet said, “Come up here! I will show you what must happen next.”
translation_verse: Na ɛhe asi ne, ndole me nye, na nwuni kyɛ babukye anoa bie wɔ nyameɛso. Na komviɛ bɔ nnili moa ndele bɔ ɔte kyɛ totorobɛndo bɔ odwudwu hyirele me, osele me kyɛ, “Fo bra anwuro wa, na ngohyire wɔ nningyein bɔ ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛhemɔ asi ne besisi ɔ.”

english_verse: Right then the Spirit took control of me, and there in heaven I saw a throne and someone sitting on it.
translation_verse: Na berɛ ne ala, né nwɔ Sunzum nu. Na yieee, né ahennie bia bie gyi nyameɛso, bɔ ebie te ahennie bia ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: The one who was sitting there sparkled like precious stones of jasper and carnelian. A rainbow that looked like an emerald surrounded the throne.
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔte so ne, ɛnea a, ɔte kyɛ nyɔboɛ bɔ oli yasepa ne kokwaboba, yeɛ nyangondoen bɔ ɛnea, ɔte kyɛ dɛngyɛmmoɛ ɔ wapɛ ahennie bia ne anwo wayia.

english_verse: Twenty-four other thrones were in a circle around that throne. And on each of these thrones there was an elder dressed in white clothes and wearing a gold crown.
translation_verse: Né ahennie bia aburanyɔ ne nna bapɛ ahennie bia ne anwo bayia, na nwuni mbanyi aburanyɔ ne nna bɔ bewurawura ndaadeɛ fufue, bɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ abotire bobɔ bɛ ɔ kyɛ bɛtete ahennie bia nemɔ so.

english_verse: Flashes of lightning and roars of thunder came out from the throne in the center of the circle. Seven torches, which are the seven spirits of God, were burning in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Na agralaa ne komviɛ ahoroɔ ne nu bobɔlɛ kurudududu fili ahennie bia ne anu wale. Na see nganea nzoo bɔ bɛte Nyameɛ Sunzum nzoo ne, né begye wɔ ahennie bia ne anyunu berɛ.

english_verse: Also in front of the throne was something that looked like a glass sea, clear as crystal. Around the throne in the center were four living creatures covered front and back with eyes.
translation_verse: Né nikyee bie bɔ ɔte kyɛ neanu po, bɔ ye nye te kaenn kyɛ neanu ɔ ɔwɔ ahennie bia ne anyunu berɛ. Yeɛ né abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nna bɔ anyeɛ tuatua bɛ nyunu ne bɛ si ɔ bɛwɔ ahennie bia ne anwo wɔ ye afia berɛ.

english_verse: The first creature was like a lion, the second one was like a bull, the third one had the face of a human, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.
translation_verse: Abɔdeɛ teasefoɛ bɔ oli moa ne te kyɛ gyata, bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne te kyɛ nandwie ba, bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne nyunu soma kuro sona, yeɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne te kyɛ kɔleɛ bɔ otu ɔ.

english_verse: Each of the four living creatures had six wings, and their bodies were covered with eyes. Day and night they never stopped singing, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord, the all-powerful God, who was and is and is coming!”
translation_verse: Na abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nna ne, nu biala le ndaa nzia, na anyeɛ tuatua bɛ nwo ne bɛ nu amukoraa, na alehyeleɛ ne alesaleɛ biala bɛto dwein bɔ bɛnyakyi ɔ, kyɛ, “Tuminiɛ Awurade Nyameɛ, ɔte krongron, krongron, krongron ye yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ fi tetetete, ɔwɔ berɛ kekesaala ye, ná ɔbaawa ne!

english_verse: The living creatures kept praising, honoring, and thanking the one who sits on the throne and who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Na sɛ abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nemɔ bɛfa animnyam, anidie ne asennaa bɛma bɔ ɔte ahennie bia ne aso, bɔ ɔte ase afebɔɔ ne a,

english_verse: “Our Lord and God, you are worthy to receive glory, honor, and power. You created all things, and by your decision they are and were created.”
translation_verse: “Y’Awurade ne yɛ Nyameɛ, ɛfata kyɛ ede animnyam, anidie ne tumi, ofikyɛ wɔ yeɛ ɛbɔle nningyein amukoraati, wɔ pɛ ti yeɛ bɛwɔ berɛ ɔ, na wɔ pɛ ti yeɛ ɛbɔle bɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: In the right hand of the one sitting on the throne I saw a scroll that had writing on the inside and on the outside. And it was sealed in seven places.
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔte ahennie bia ne aso ne, ye sa famaa nu, nwuni nwomaa bie bɔ babobɔ ɔ, bɔ bahyerɛ ye nyunu ne ye si, bɔ bafa nzɔanoɛ nzoo basɔ ye noa ɔ.

english_verse: I saw a mighty angel ask with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and break its seals?”
translation_verse: Na nwuni abɔfo anwoserɛniɛ bie bɔ ɔteane nu bisale kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ ɔfata kyɛ obukye nwomaa bɔ babobɔ ne anu ná ɔtete ye nzɔanoɛ nemɔ ɔ?”

english_verse: No one in heaven or on earth or under the earth was able to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Na ebiala nne nyameɛso, anaa aseɛ so, anaa aseɛ bo bɔ ɔhora bukyele nwomaa bɔ babobɔ ne anu anaa ɔneane nu ɔ.

english_verse: I cried hard because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
translation_verse: Na nzuni pee, ofikyɛ bannya ebiala bɔ ɔfata kyɛ obukye nwomaa bɔ babobɔ ne anu anaakyɛ ɔnea nu ɔ.

english_verse: Then one of the elders said to me, “Stop crying and look! The one who is called both the ‘Lion from the Tribe of Judah’ and ‘King David's Great Descendant’ has won the victory. He will open the scroll and its seven seals.”
translation_verse: Yeɛ mbanyi nemɔ nu ko sele me kyɛ, “Nea, nnɛsũ, na Yuda abusua kure nu Gyata ne, Dawide Ndii ne, wali ngonim bɔ okobukye nwomaa ne anu, ná ɔkɔtete ye nzɔanoɛ nzoo nemɔ anu ɔ.”

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a Lamb standing in the center of the throne surrounded by the four living creatures and the elders. The Lamb looked as if it had once been killed. It had seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven spirits of God, sent out to all the earth.
translation_verse: Na nneane, na yieee, ahennie bia ne ne abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nna ne ne mbanyi nemɔ b’afia berɛ, né Boaen Ba bie gyi berɛ bɔ osoma kyɛ bahũ ye ɔ. Ole mmɛen nzoo ne anyeɛ nzoo, bɔ bɛte Nyameɛ Sunzum nzoo bɔ wasoma bɛ wɔ aseɛ so amukoraa ɔ.

english_verse: The Lamb went over and took the scroll from the right hand of the one who sat on the throne.
translation_verse: Oolele nwomaa bɔ babobɔ ne fili bɔ ɔte ahennie bia so ne sa famaa nu.

english_verse: Then they sang a new song, “You are worthy to receive the scroll and open its seals, because you were killed. And with your own blood you bought for God people from every tribe, language, nation, and race.
translation_verse: Na bɛtole dwein foforɛ bie kyɛ, “Ɛfata kyɛ ede nwomaa bɔ babobɔ ne ná ebukye ye nzɔanoɛ nemɔ ɔ; ofikyɛ behuni wɔ, na afa wɔ mogya atɔ adasa mmaa ama Nyameɛ afi mmusua kure ne edwudwolɛ ne mmenia ne maen biala nu,

english_verse: You let them become kings and serve God as priests, and they will rule on earth.”
translation_verse: na ayɛ bɛ ahennie maen ne asɔfo ama yɛ Nyameɛ, na bekoli aseɛ so hene.”

english_verse: As I looked, I heard the voices of a large number of angels around the throne and the voices of the living creatures and of the elders. There were millions and millions of them,
translation_verse: Afei ndole me nye, na ndele abɔfo pembepembe bɔ bapɛ ahennie bia ne ne abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nemɔ ne mbanyi nemɔ nwo bayia ɔ bɛ komvi; na né bɛ somaa te apee buru apee buru ahoroɔ ne apee apee.

english_verse: and they were saying in a loud voice, “The Lamb who was killed is worthy to receive power, riches, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and praise.”
translation_verse: Na bɛteane nu bɛhane kyɛ, “Boaen Ba bɔ behuni ye ne, ɔfata kyɛ ode tumi, anwonya, nworɛ, anwoserɛ, anidie, animnyam ne saleɛ!”

english_verse: Then I heard all beings in heaven and on the earth and under the earth and in the sea offer praise. Together, all of them were saying, “Praise, honor, glory, and strength forever and ever to the one who sits on the throne and to the Lamb!”
translation_verse: Na abɔdeɛ biala bɔ ɔwɔ nyameɛso ne aseɛ so ne aseɛ bo ne ɛpo nu ne bɔ ɔwɔ bɛ nu amukoraa, ndele kyɛ bɛkã kyɛ, “Saleɛ ne anidie ne animnyam ne tumi ɔyɛ bɔ ɔte ahennie bia ne aso ne ɔne Boaen Ba ne deɛ afebɔɔ.”

english_verse: The four living creatures said “Amen,” while the elders knelt down and worshiped.
translation_verse: Na abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nna nemɔ sele kyɛ, “Amen.” Yeɛ mbanyi nemɔ bɛfale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli berɛ bɛsɔnene [bɔ ɔte ase afebɔɔ ne].

english_verse: At the same time I saw the Lamb open the first of the seven seals, I heard one of the four living creatures shout with a voice like thunder. It said, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Na nwuni kyɛ Boaen Ba ne wate nzɔanoɛ nemɔ anu ko noa, yeɛ ndele kyɛ abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nna nemɔ anu ko ole komviɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ esue bɔ ɔbɔ nu kurudududu ɔ ɔkã, “Baanea!”

english_verse: Then I saw a white horse. Its rider carried a bow and was given a crown. He had already won some victories, and he went out to win more.
translation_verse: Nneane, na nwuni pɔngɔ fufue bie. Na bɔ ɔte ye so ne, né otira agyaen; na bɛmane ye abotire, na ofili berɛ hɔle oolili ngonim, na ɔhɔle so lili ngonim.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Na ɔtele nzɔanoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne noa nen, ndele kyɛ abɔdeɛ teasefoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne ɔkã kyɛ, “Baanea!”

english_verse: Then another horse came out. It was fiery red. And its rider was given the power to take away all peace from the earth, so people would slaughter one another. He was also given a big sword.
translation_verse: Na pɔngɔ foforɛ kɔkorɛ gonn bie yele ye ti, na bɛmane bɔ ɔte ye so ne tumi kyɛ ɔye asomdwee fi aseɛ so, ná behũhũ bɛ nwo bɛ nwo, na bɛmane ye ngrandɛ pirikua bie.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature say, “Come out!” Then I saw a black horse, and its rider had a balance scale in one hand.
translation_verse: Na ɔtele nzɔanoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne noa nen, ndele kyɛ abɔdeɛ teasefoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne ɔkã kyɛ, “Baanea!” Nneane, yieee, pɔngɔ bire bie, na né bɔ ɔte ye so ne otira tonyi.

english_verse: I heard what sounded like a voice from somewhere among the four living creatures. It said, “A liter of wheat will cost you a whole day's wages! Three liters of barley will cost you a day's wages too. But don't ruin the olive oil or the wine.”
translation_verse: Na ndele komviɛ bie mvili abɔdeɛ teasefoɛ nna nemɔ b’afia berɛ kyɛ, “Aburoo kongo ko te denare ko, yeɛ atokoɔ kongo nza te denare ko; nakoso ngoo ne nzaa de, nnɛsɛkye bɛ.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth living creature say, “Come out!”
translation_verse: Na ɔtele nzɔanoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne noa nen, ndele kyɛ abɔdeɛ teasefoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne ɔkã kyɛ, “Baanea!”

english_verse: Then I saw a pale green horse. Its rider was named Death, and Death's Kingdom followed close behind. They were given power over one fourth of the earth, and they could kill its people with swords, famines, diseases, and wild animals.
translation_verse: Nneane, na nwuni pɔngɔ hoyaa bie; na bɔ ɔte ye so ne dumaa li Ewue, na Ɛborɔ li ye si. Na bɛmane bɛ tumi wɔ aseɛ ngyɛmuɛ nna nu ko so, kyɛ bɛfa ngrandɛ, ɛhɔen, anwonyerɛ ne aseɛ so ngaka aboyaa behũhũ bɛ.

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the fifth seal, I saw under the altar the souls of everyone who had been killed for speaking God's message and telling about their faith.
translation_verse: Na ɔtele nzɔanoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu ne noa ne, bɛ bɔ ɔnate Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne ne b’adanzeɛ bɔ belili ti behuni bɛ ne, nwuni bɛ kra mɔ wɔ afɔleɛ bokyea ne abo.

english_verse: They shouted, “Master, you are holy and faithful! How long will it be before you judge and punish the people of this earth who killed us?”
translation_verse: Na bɛteane nu serɛserɛ kyɛ, “O, Awurade Tuminiɛ, Krongronniɛ ne Nahorɛniɛ, engobua ndɛen, yeɛ ɛngɔtɔ bɛ bɔ bɛte aseɛ so wereɛ wɔ yɛ mogya nwo maa okoodwu kyinzu?”

english_verse: Then each of those who had been killed was given a white robe and told to rest for a little while. They had to wait until the complete number of the Lord's other servants and followers would be killed.
translation_verse: Yeɛ bɛmane bɛ nu ko biala ataadeɛ fufue, na besele bɛ kyɛ bɛnwondɛ mmerɛ kãa bie bieku, ma oodwu kyɛ bɛ mmango asomvoɛ ne b’eliɛma mɔ bɔ bekohũhũ bɛ kyɛ bɛ koso ala ne bɛ somaa ɔkɔsõ ɔ.

english_verse: When I saw the Lamb open the sixth seal, I looked and saw a great earthquake. The sun turned as dark as sackcloth, and the moon became red as blood.
translation_verse: Na ɔtele nzɔanoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ne noa ne, nneane, na yieee, aseɛ wosole serɛserɛ; na eyia yɛle tunn kyɛ brisie, na ɛsraen yɛle kyɛ mogya;

english_verse: The stars in the sky fell to earth, just like figs shaken loose by a windstorm.
translation_verse: na ewienu nzramaa tutu guale ase te kyɛ borɔdoma bɔ mvrama piri woso ye ɔporo ye mma amui gua ɔ.

english_verse: Then the sky was rolled up like a scroll, and all mountains and islands were moved from their places.
translation_verse: Na ewienu tu minini te kyɛ nwomaa bɔ babobɔ ɔ, na mmokaa ne supɔ mukoraa tutu fili bɛ boso.

english_verse: The kings of the earth, its famous people, and its military leaders hid in caves or behind rocks on the mountains. They hid there together with the rich and the powerful and with all the slaves and free people.
translation_verse: Na aseɛ so ahemvo, atitirefoɛ, esikafoɛ, safohene mɔ, anwoserɛfoɛ, yeɛ ngoaa ne nnehyeɛ amukoraa bɛfeafeale ngumaa mɔ nu ne mmokaa so nyɔbotaen mɔ nu.

english_verse: Then they shouted to the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us! Hide us from the one who sits on the throne and from the anger of the Lamb.
translation_verse: Na besele mmokaa ne nyɔbotaen nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔdwiri begua yɛ so, ná ɛ́mɔfa yɛ bɛfea béfi bɔ ɔte ahennie bia ne aso ne nyunu, ɔne Boaen Ba n’ahonehulɛ nu;

english_verse: That terrible day has come! God and the Lamb will show their anger, and who can face it?”
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ye ahonehulɛ kyẽa piri ne adwu, na nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora kogyina ye noa ɔ?”

english_verse: “Don't harm the earth or the sea or any tree! Wait until I have marked the foreheads of the servants of our God.”
translation_verse: kyɛ, “Nnɛma ɛmɔha aseɛ anaa ɛpo anaa mmakaa, kɔpem kyɛ yɛkɔfa nzɔanoɛ yɛkɔteta yɛ Nyameɛ ngoaa mɔ bɛ nwoma so ɔ.”

english_verse: and said, “Amen! Praise, glory, wisdom, thanks, honor, power, and strength belong to our God forever and ever! Amen!”
translation_verse: bɛhane kyɛ, “Amen! Saleɛ ne animnyam ne nworɛ ne asennaa ne anidie ne tumi ne anwoserɛ te yɛ Nyameɛ deɛ afebɔɔ! Amen.”

english_verse: After this, I saw a large crowd with more people than could be counted. They were from every race, tribe, nation, and language, and they stood before the throne and before the Lamb. They wore white robes and held palm branches in their hands,
translation_verse: Na ɛhe asi ne, nneane, na nwuni ɛlɔen kandinga bɔ sona biala ngɔhora bɛ ka ɔ, bɔ befi maen maen, mmusua kure, mmenia ne edwudwolɛ amukoraa nu, kyɛ begyigyi ahennie bia ne nyunu ne Boaen Ba ne nyunu, bɔ bewurawura ndaadeɛ fufue, ná betiratira ɛberɛ ɔ.

english_verse: as they shouted, “Our God, who sits upon the throne, has the power to save his people, and so does the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Na bɛteane nu serɛserɛ kyɛ, “Ngoalelɛ te yɛ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte ahennie bia ne aso ne ɔne Boaen Ba ne deɛ!”
