english_verse: The angels who stood around the throne knelt in front of it with their faces to the ground. The elders and the four living creatures knelt there with them. Then they all worshiped God
translation_verse: Né abɔfo nemɔ amukoraa bapɛ ahennie bia ne ne mbanyi nemɔ ne abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nna nemɔ nwo bayia, na bɛfale bɛ nyunu bebutubutuli ase wɔ ahennie bia ne nyunu, na bɛsɔnene Nyameɛ

english_verse: One of the elders asked me, “Do you know who these people are that are dressed in white robes? Do you know where they come from?”
translation_verse: Na afei mbanyi nemɔ nu ko bisale me kyɛ, “Ɛhemɔ bɔ bewura ndaadeɛ fufue ye, nwa mɔ ɛne, na nisua yeɛ befi bɛwale ɔ?”

english_verse: “Sir,” I answered, “you must know.” Then he told me: “These are the ones who have gone through the great suffering. They have washed their robes in the blood of the Lamb and have made them white.
translation_verse: Na mmuale ye kyɛ, “Me mene, wɔ yeɛ ɛse ɔ.” Na osele me kyɛ, “Ɛhemɔ ole bɛ bɔ bafa amaneɛ piri ne anu bafite, ná bapo bɛ ndaadeɛ maa wayɛ fufue wɔ Boaen Ba ne mogya nu ɔ.

english_verse: And so they stand before the throne of God and worship him in his temple day and night. The one who sits on the throne will spread his tent over them.
translation_verse: Na ye sɔ ati yeɛ bɛwɔ Nyameɛ ahennie bia ne nyunu, ná bɛsɔne ye alehyeleɛ ne alesaleɛ wɔ ye asɔneyɛɛ sua nu ɔ; na bɔ ɔte ahennie bia ne aso ne, ɔkɔfa ye tena sua ne kɔkata bɛ so.

english_verse: They will never hunger or thirst again, and they won't be troubled by the sun or any scorching heat.
translation_verse: Ɛhɔen ngohũ bɛ ko, yeɛ nzuhɔen ngohũ bɛ ko, eyia ngɔyera bɛ, yeɛ ahuhuro biala ngohũ bɛ.

english_verse: “The Lamb in the center of the throne will be their shepherd. He will lead them to streams of life-giving water, and God will wipe all tears from their eyes.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Boaen Ba bɔ ɔwɔ ahennie bia n’afia berɛ ne, ɔkɔyɛ bɛ Neafoɛ, ɔkɔyɛ bɛ taataa kɔhɔ ngoa asue mɔ ti, na Nyameɛ kokyikyi bɛ nye abo moen amukoraa.”

english_verse: When the Lamb opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.
translation_verse: Na Boaen Ba ne tele nzɔanoɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne noa nen, nyameɛso yɛle dinn kɔyɛ dɔnhwere bue.

english_verse: I noticed that the seven angels who stood before God were each given a trumpet.
translation_verse: Na nwuni abɔfo nzoo bɔ begyigyi Nyameɛ nyunu ne, na bɛmane bɛ totorobɛndo nzoo.

english_verse: Another angel, who had a gold container for incense, came and stood at the altar. This one was given a lot of incense to offer with the prayers of God's people on the gold altar in front of the throne.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo foforɛ bɔ otira sikaa kɔkorɛ ɛyɛɛ kulie ɔ oogyinane afɔleɛ bokyea ne anwo; na bɛmane ye ɛyɛɛ pee kyɛ ɔfa boka anwoteefoɛ amukoraa mbaeɛ so ɔbɔ afɔleɛ, wɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ ɔwɔ ahennie bia ne nyunu ne aso.

english_verse: Then the smoke of the incense, together with the prayers of God's people, went up to God from the hand of the angel.
translation_verse: Na ɛyɛɛ nwosina ne, ɔbokale anwoteefoɛ mbaeɛ ne aso fili abɔfo ne sa nu fo hɔle Nyameɛ nyunu.

english_verse: After this, the angel filled the incense container with fire from the altar and threw it on the earth. Thunder roared, lightning flashed, and the earth shook. The Trumpets
translation_verse: Afei abɔfo ne fale ɛyɛɛ kulie ne, ɔfale afɔleɛ bokyea ne aso see ne bie guale nu maa oyili, na ogyi tole aseɛ so. Na komviɛ ahoroɔ wale, ɔbobɔle nu kurudududu, agralaa tetele, na aseɛ wosole. Totorobɛndo nzoo nemɔ

english_verse: The seven angels now got ready to blow their trumpets.
translation_verse: Afei abɔfo nzoo bɔ betiratira totorobɛndo nzoo ne, bɛboaboale bɛ nwo kyɛ bɛbaahu.

english_verse: When the first angel blew his trumpet, hail and fire mixed with blood were thrown down on the earth. A third of the earth, a third of the trees, and a third of all green plants were burned.
translation_verse: Abɔfo bɔ oli moa ne huli ye totorobɛndo ne, na asukɔtwea ne see bɔ bɛne mogya bali afra ɔ bɛwale, na bɛto beguale aseɛ so. Na aseɛ ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko yerale, mmakaa ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko yerale, yeɛ ndire monɛ amukoraa koso yerale.

english_verse: When the second angel blew his trumpet, something like a great fiery mountain was thrown into the sea. A third of the sea turned to blood,
translation_verse: Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne huli ye totorobɛndo ne. Na begyili nikyee bie bɔ ɔte kyɛ bokaa piri bɔ see asɔ nu ogye buruburu ɔ bɛtole ɛpo nu, na ɛpo ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko kakyili mogya;

english_verse: a third of the living creatures in the sea died, and a third of the ships were destroyed.
translation_verse: na ɛpo nu abɔdeɛ bɔ bele ngoa ɔ, ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko wuwuli, yeɛ ɛlɛen mɔ ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko sɛkyesɛkyele.

english_verse: When the third angel blew his trumpet, a great star fell from heaven. It was burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on a third of the springs of water.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne huli ye totorobɛndo ne, na nzramaa pirikua bie bɔ ogye kyɛ tɛen ɔ otu fili nyameɛso, na oofini asue mɔ ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko nu, ɔne mbombonzue mɔ nu.

english_verse: The name of the star was Bitter, and a third of the water turned bitter. Many people died because the water was so bitter.
translation_verse: Nzramaa ne dumaa li Weewee. Na nzue mɔ ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko yɛle weewee, na nzue ne mane mmenia pee wuwuli, ofikyɛ ɔte weewee.

english_verse: When the fourth angel blew his trumpet, a third of the sun, a third of the moon, and a third of the stars were struck. They each lost a third of their light. So during a third of the day there was no light, and a third of the night was also without light.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne huli ye totorobɛndo ne, na ɛhe wosole eyia ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko, ɛsraen ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko, yeɛ nzramaa mɔ ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko, yiti bɛ ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko kakyili awosii; na alehyeleɛ nu ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko annya kanea, na alesaleɛ nu koso sɔ ala yeɛ osili ɔ.

english_verse: Then I looked and saw a lone eagle flying across the sky. It was shouting, “Trouble, trouble, trouble to everyone who lives on earth! The other three angels are now going to blow their trumpets.”
translation_verse: Na nneane, na ndele kyɛ kɔleɛ bie otu faa wɔ nyameɛso afia dɔ, ná ɔtea nu kã kyɛ, “Totorobɛndo ngaa bɔ abɔfo nza nemɔ bɛbaahu ne, bɛ komvi ne ati, bɛ bɔ bɛte aseɛ so ɔ, bɛ yaakɔ oo, bɛ yaakɔ oo, bɔ yaakɔ oo!”

english_verse: When the fifth angel blew his trumpet, I saw a star fall from the sky to earth. It was given the key to the tunnel that leads down to the deep pit.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu ne huli ye totorobɛndo ne, na nwuni kyɛ nzramaa bie watu wafi nyameɛso waatɔ aseɛ so, na bɛfale aseɛ bo dɔ kumaa kuronguronn ne noa safoaa bɛmane ye.

english_verse: As it opened the tunnel, smoke poured out like the smoke of a great furnace. The sun and the air turned dark because of the smoke.
translation_verse: Obukyele aseɛ bo dɔ kumaa kuronguronn ne noa, na nwosina bɔ ɔte kyɛ foonoo piri nu nwosina fili kumaa ne anu wale, na ɔnate nwosina ne ati, eyia ne ewienu yɛle kabii.

english_verse: Locusts came out of the smoke and covered the earth. They were given the same power that scorpions have.
translation_verse: Na mmɛbɛ mbiri fili nwosina ne anu wale aseɛ so, na bɛmane bɛ tumi bɔ ɔte kyɛ aseɛ so anyanyangyeleɛ mɔ tumi ɔ.

english_verse: The locusts were told not to harm the grass on the earth or any plant or any tree. They were to punish only those people who did not have God's mark on their foreheads.
translation_verse: Na bɛhã behyirele bɛ kyɛ, nnɛmaa bɛkeka aseɛ so ndire, anaa nyaa monɛ biala, anaa bakaa biala; sana mmenia bɔ Nyameɛ nzɔanoɛ ne ɔnne bɛ nwoma so nemɔ ngome.

english_verse: The locusts were allowed to make them suffer for five months, but not to kill them. The suffering they caused was like the sting of a scorpion.
translation_verse: Bamma bɛ ate kyɛ behũhũ bɛ, na mmom kyɛ bɛkeka bɛ tonn bosome nnu. Na bɛ kekalɛ ne, ɔte kyɛ anyanyangyeleɛ bɔ ɔka sona ɔ ye deɛ.

english_verse: In those days people will want to die, but they will not be able to. They will hope for death, but it will escape from them.
translation_verse: Na sɔ mmerɛ ne, mmenia kɔpena ewue si atee, nakoso bengonwu ye; bekohuro kyɛ bekowu ɔ, nakoso ewue kɔnwati bɛ.

english_verse: These locusts looked like horses ready for battle. On their heads they wore something like gold crowns, and they had human faces.
translation_verse: Na mmɛbɛ mbiri nemɔ, bɛ sue te kyɛ mbɔngɔ bɔ basiesie bɛ bama koɛ ɔ; nikyee bie wɔ bɛ ti so bɔ ɔte kyɛ sikaa kɔkorɛ abotire ɔ, na bɛ nyunu soma sona nyunu;

english_verse: Their hair was like a woman's long hair, and their teeth were like those of a lion.
translation_verse: bele nwiaa te kyɛ brasua nwiaa, yeɛ bɛ gye te kyɛ gyata gye.

english_verse: On their chests they wore armor made of iron. Their wings roared like an army of horse-drawn chariots rushing into battle.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔkata bɛ hue so ne, ɔte kyɛ buralɛ bɔ ɔkata bɛ hue so ɔ; na dede bɔ bɛ ndaa nemɔ bɛyɔ ne, ɔte kyɛ mbɔngɔ pee bɔ teaseɛnam mɔ sosɔ bɛ, bɔ betu amirika bɛkɔ koɛ ɔ bɛ deɛ.

english_verse: Their tails were like a scorpion's tail with a stinger that had the power to hurt someone for five months.
translation_verse: Bele dua te kyɛ anyanyangyeleɛ, bɛka, na bɛ tumi bɔ bɛfa bɛha mmenia tonn bosome nnu ne, bɛ dua nu yeɛ ɔwɔ ɔ.

english_verse: Their king was the angel in charge of the deep pit. In Hebrew his name was Abaddon, and in Greek it was Apollyon.
translation_verse: Bele bɔ odi bɛ so hene, bɔ ye ole aseɛ bo dɔ kumaa kuronguronn nu abɔfo ne, bɔ ye dumaa li Abadɔn wɔ Hebri dwudwolɛ nu, yeɛ Hela dwudwolɛ nu koso oli Apolɔn.

english_verse: The first horrible thing has now happened! But wait. Two more horrible things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Musue ko apɛ nu. Na tie, waha musue nyɔ bɔ bɛbaawa ɔ.

english_verse: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet. I heard a voice speak from the four corners of the gold altar that stands in the presence of God.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ne huli ye totorobɛndo ne, na sikaa kɔkorɛ afɔleɛ bokyea bɔ ogyi Nyameɛ nyunu ne, ndele kyɛ komviɛ bie afi ye mmɛen nna nemɔ anu,

english_verse: The voice spoke to this angel and said, “Release the four angels who are tied up beside the great Euphrates River.”
translation_verse: ná ɔkã kyire abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia bɔ otira totorobɛndo ne kyɛ, “Sangye abɔfo nna bɔ bakyekye bɛ wɔ asue piri Yufreti noa ne.”

english_verse: The four angels had been prepared for this very hour and day and month and year. Now they were set free to kill a third of all people.
translation_verse: Yiti bɛsangyele abɔfo nna bɔ basiesie bɛ bama sɔ dɔnhwere ne, sɔ kyẽa ne, sɔ bosome ne, ɔne sɔ afoɛ ne, kyɛ behũhũ adasa mmaa ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko.

english_verse: By listening, I could tell there were more than
translation_verse: Na ndele kyɛ ɛlɔen bɔ bɛtete mbɔngɔ so ne bɛ somaa te apepesrala sɔ alaa ɛyaa nyɔ.

english_verse: In my vision their riders wore fiery-red, dark-blue, and yellow armor on their chests. The heads of the horses looked like lions, with fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Na mbɔngɔ mɔ ne bɛ bɔ bɛtete bɛ so ne, kyɛbɔ nzi nwuni bɛ wɔ me nyekyire ne anu ne, ye ɛhe: Bele see ne afasebire ne sɔfe buralɛ bɔ ɔkata bɛ hue so ɔ, na mbɔngɔ nemɔ bɛ ti te kyɛ gyata ti, na see ne nwosina ne sɔfe fili bɛ noa nu wale.

english_verse: One third of all people were killed by the three terrible troubles caused by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur.
translation_verse: Na sɔ hawo nza hemɔ, bɔ bɛ ole see, nwosina ne sɔfe bɔ ofi bɛ noa nu ba ne, bɛfale so behuhuni adasa ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko.

english_verse: The horses had powerful mouths, and their tails were like poisonous snakes that bite and hurt.
translation_verse: Na mbɔngɔ nemɔ bɛ tumi wɔ bɛ noa ne bɛ dua nu, ofikyɛ bɛ dua te kyɛ ewoo, bɔ tire tua so bɔ bɛfa bepura ɔ.

english_verse: The people who lived through these terrible troubles did not turn away from the idols they had made, and they did not stop worshiping demons. They kept on worshiping idols that were made of gold, silver, bronze, stone, and wood. Not one of these idols could see, hear, or walk.
translation_verse: Nakoso adasa mmaa ngaa bɔ ɛhawo hemɔ wangukũ bɛ ne, banzakyera b’adwene bamvi bɛ sa noa nnwumaa nwo, banyakyi sunzummɔne mɔ sɔnenɛ, yeɛ banyakyi sikaa kɔkorɛ, ɛdwetɛ, kɔɔbere, nyɔboɛ ne bakaa amoen mɔ bɔ bɛngora bennwu nikye, anaa bɛnde dwirɛ, anaa bɛnnate ɔ sɔnenɛ;

english_verse: No one stopped murdering or practicing witchcraft or being immoral or stealing.
translation_verse: yeɛ banzakyera b’adwene bamvi b’awuelilɛ ne bɛ ngonyaayelɛ ne b’adwamanbɔlɛ ne b’awue nwo.

english_verse: I saw another powerful angel come down from heaven. This one was covered with a cloud, and a rainbow was over his head. His face was like the sun, his legs were like columns of fire,
translation_verse: Afei nwuni abɔfo foforɛ anwoserɛniɛ bie kyɛ ofi nyameɛso odwu ba ase; né wafa munungum wahera, nyangondoen wɔ ye ti so, ye nyunu te kyɛ eyia, na ye gya te kyɛ see bonima.

english_verse: and with his hand he held a little scroll that had been unrolled. He stood there with his right foot on the sea and his left foot on the land.
translation_verse: Né otira nwomaa kaaba bie bɔ babukye nu ɔ wɔ ye sa nu. Na otuli ye gya famaa siele ɛpo so, yeɛ otuli ye gya bɛen siele aseɛ so.

english_verse: Then he shouted with a voice that sounded like a growling lion. Thunder roared seven times.
translation_verse: Na ɔteane nu serɛserɛ kyɛ gyata bɔ ɔbobɔ nu ɔ. Na ɔteane nu nen, agralaa nzoo ne bobɔle nu kurudududu.

english_verse: After the thunder stopped, I was about to write what it had said. But a voice from heaven shouted, “Keep it secret! Don't write these things.”
translation_verse: Na agralaa nzoo ne bobɔle nu kurudududu nen, nyɛle kyɛ mekyerɛ, nakoso ndele kyɛ komviɛ bie fi nyameɛso ɔkã kyire me kyɛ, “Edwirɛ bɔ agralaa kurudududu nzoo nemɔ bahã ne, sɔ ye noa, na nnɛkyerɛ.”

english_verse: The angel I had seen standing on the sea and the land then held his right hand up toward heaven.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo bɔ nwuni ye kyɛ ogyi ɛpo ne aseɛ so ne, ɔmane ye sa [famaa] so hyirele nyameɛso,

english_verse: He made a promise in the name of God who lives forever and who created heaven, earth, the sea, and every living creature. The angel said, “You won't have to wait any longer.
translation_verse: na ɔfale bɔ ɔte ase afebɔɔ, bɔ ɔbɔle anwuro ne bɔ ɔwɔ nu, aseɛ ne ne bɔ ɔwɔ nu, yeɛ ɛpo ne bɔ ɔwɔ nu ne tale ndaen kyɛ, “Mmerɛ biala nne berɛ ko,

english_verse: God told his secret plans to his servants the prophets, and it will all happen by the time the seventh angel sounds his trumpet.”
translation_verse: na mmom mmerɛ bɔ abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne kohu ye totorobɛndo ne, yeɛ Nyameɛ mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ne kɔwa nu ɔ, kyɛbɔ ɔhane ye nwo dwirɛ hyirele ye ngoaa ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nemɔ ne.”

english_verse: Once again the voice from heaven spoke to me. It said, “Go and take the open scroll from the hand of the angel standing on the sea and the land.”
translation_verse: Na komviɛ bɔ nde mvili nyameɛso ne odwudwo hyirele me bieku kyɛ, “Nwomaa kaaba bɔ babukye nu, bɔ ɔwɔ abɔfo bɔ ogyi ɛpo ne aseɛ so ye sa nu ne, kole.”

english_verse: When I went over to ask the angel for the little scroll, the angel said, “Take the scroll and eat it! Your stomach will turn sour, but the taste in your mouth will be sweet as honey.”
translation_verse: Yiti ngɔle abɔfo ne nwo berɛ, na nzele ye kyɛ, “Fa nwomaa kaaba ne ma me.” Na osele me kyɛ, “De ná di; na ɔkɔyɛ weewee wɔ wɔ kunu, nakoso ɔkɔyɛ menemene kyɛ woɛ wɔ wɔ noa nu.”

english_verse: I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it. The taste was sweet as honey, but my stomach turned sour.
translation_verse: Na nnele nwomaa kaaba ne mvili abɔfo ne sa nu nnili; na ɔyɛle me noa nu menemene kyɛ woɛ, nakoso nni nyiele nen, ɔyɛle me kunu dɔ weewee.

english_verse: Then some voices said, “Keep on telling what will happen to the people of many nations, races, and languages, and also to kings.”
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, “Ɔsɛ kyɛ ɛhyɛ ngɔm fa mmenia, maen maen, edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ ne ahemvo pee nwo bieku.”

english_verse: But don't measure the courtyard outside the temple building. Leave it out. It has been given to those people who don't know God, and they will trample all over the holy city for
translation_verse: Nakoso asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anwo aluo dɔ de, yakyi to berɛ, nnɛsusu; ofikyɛ bafa berɛ bama Amaenmaensofoɛ, na bekohwi bɛkɔfa kuro krongron ne aso bosome aburanna ne nyɔ.

english_verse: My two witnesses will wear sackcloth, while I let them preach for
translation_verse: Na ngɔma m’adanzefoɛ nyɔ bɛkɔhera ɛsɛen tena bɛkɔhyɛ ngɔm ngyẽa apee ko ɛyaa nyɔ ne aburasia.”

english_verse: These two witnesses are the two olive trees and the two lampstands that stand in the presence of the Lord who rules the earth.
translation_verse: Na ɛhemɔ ole olive bakaa nyɔ ne ne kanea bakaa nyɔ bɔ begyigyi aseɛ Mene nyunu ne.

english_verse: Any enemy who tries to harm them will be destroyed by the fire that comes out of their mouths.
translation_verse: Na sɛ ebie yɛ kyɛ ɔha bɛ a, see fi bɛ noa nu bayera bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ; yeɛ sɛ ebie yɛ kyɛ ɔha bɛ a, sɔ ala yeɛ ɔsɛ kyɛ beku ye ɔ.

english_verse: They have the power to lock up the sky and to keep rain from falling while they are prophesying. And whenever they want to, they can turn water to blood and cause all kinds of terrible troubles on earth.
translation_verse: Bele tumi kyɛ bɛto ewienu nu, bɔ esue ndɔ wɔ mmerɛ bɔ bɛhyɛ ngɔm ɔ; yeɛ bele nzue mɔ so tumi kyɛ bɛmaa bɛkakyi mogya, ɔne tumi bɔ ɔmaa bɛfa ɛhawo biala bɛto aseɛ so, mmerɛ pee biala bɔ bekuro ɔ.

english_verse: After the two witnesses have finished preaching God's message, the beast that lives in the deep pit will come up and fight against them. It will win the battle and kill them.
translation_verse: Na sɛ beyie b’adanzeɛlilɛ ne a, kaka bɔ ofi aseɛ bo dɔ kumaa kuronguronn ne anu ɔfo ba ne, ɔkɔfa koɛ kɔɔteta bɛ, na okoli bɛ so ngonim ná wahũ bɛ.

english_verse: Their bodies will be left lying in the streets of the same great city where their Lord was nailed to a cross. And this city is spiritually like the city of Sodom or the country of Egypt.
translation_verse: Na bɛ fuin nemɔ kɔlela kuro piri ne dwaaso, kuro bɔ sunzum nu bɛfrɛ ye Sodom ne Misraim ne, nekaa bɔ bɛbɔle b’Awurade koso mmeamudua nu ne.

english_verse: For three and a half days the people of every nation, tribe, language, and race will stare at the bodies of these two witnesses and refuse to let them be buried.
translation_verse: Na mmenia kofi maen maen ne mmusua kure ne edwudwolɛ ahoroɔ nu bekotu bɛ nye bekogua bɛ fuin nemɔ so ɛlɛsa ne bue, na bɛngɔma bengosie bɛ fuin nemɔ.

english_verse: Everyone on earth will celebrate and be happy. They will give gifts to each other, because of what happened to the two prophets who caused them so much trouble.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bɛte aseɛ so ɔ bekoli bɛ nwo ahurusi, na bɛ nye kɔgye ná bamanemane bɛ nwo akyɛdeɛ; ofikyɛ sɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ nyɔ nemɔ bɛfale ɛhawo bɛtole bɛ bɔ bɛte aseɛ so ɔ so.

english_verse: But three and a half days later, God will breathe life into their bodies. They will stand up, and everyone who sees them will be terrified.
translation_verse: Nakoso ngyẽa ɛlɛsa ne bue asi ne, ngoa sunzum fili Nyameɛ nu oowurale bɛ nu, na bedwɔso begyinane bɛ gya so, na ɛserɛ piri paa hane bɛ bɔ benwuni bɛ ne.

english_verse: The witnesses then heard a loud voice from heaven, saying, “Come up here.” And while their enemies were watching, they were taken up to heaven in a cloud.
translation_verse: Na bɛtele kyɛ komviɛ piri bie fi nyameɛso odwudwo kyire bɛ kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔfo bɛbra wa!” Na bɛfale munungum nu bɛfo bɛhɔle nyameɛso bɔ bɛ pɔfoɛ mɔ bɛ nye tua bɛ ɔ.

english_verse: At that same moment there was a terrible earthquake that destroyed a tenth of the city. Seven thousand people were killed, and the rest were frightened and praised the God who rules in heaven.
translation_verse: Na aseɛ wosole wɔ sɔ dɔnhwere ne ala nu, na kuro ne ngyɛmuɛ buru nu ko bu guale, na aseɛwosolɛ ne huni mmenia apee nzoo; na ɛserɛ hane bɛ bɔ baha ne, na bɛhyɛle nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne animnyam.

english_verse: The second horrible thing has now happened! And the third one will be here soon. The Seventh Trumpet
translation_verse: Musue bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne wapɛ nu. Na tie, musue bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne ɔ́ba ndɛndɛ. Totorobɛndo bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne

english_verse: At the sound of the seventh trumpet, loud voices were heard in heaven. They said, “Now the kingdom of this world belongs to our Lord and to his Chosen One! And he will rule forever and ever!”
translation_verse: Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne huli ye totorobɛndo ne, na komviɛ mbiri mbiri bobɔle nu wɔ nyameɛso kyɛ, “Ewiase ahennie wayɛ yɛ Awurade ne ye Kristo ne deɛ, na okoli hene afebɔɔ.”

english_verse: They said, “Lord God All-Powerful, you are and you were, and we thank you. You used your great power and started ruling.
translation_verse: na bɛhane kyɛ, “Yɛfa asennaa yɛma wɔ, O Tuminiɛ Awurade Nyameɛ bɔ ɛwɔ berɛ, ná ɛwɔ berɛ fi tetetete ɔ, ofikyɛ afa wɔ tumi pirikua ne, na ali hene.

english_verse: When the nations got angry, you became angry too! Now the time has come for the dead to be judged. It is time for you to reward your servants the prophets and all your people who honor your name, no matter who they are. It is time to destroy everyone who has destroyed the earth.”
translation_verse: Maen maen mɔ fɛle yaa, na w’ahonehulɛ ne adwɔso, na mmerɛ adwu kyɛ ebua awufoɛ ndɛen, ná ɛma wɔ ngoaa, ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne anwoteefoɛ ne bɛ bɔ besuro wɔ dumaa, kwahweabaa mɔ ne atitirefoɛ akatuaa ɔ, ɔne kyɛ ɛkɔsɛkye bɛ bɔ bɛsɛkye aseɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: The door to God's temple in heaven was then opened, and the sacred chest could be seen inside the temple. I saw lightning and heard roars of thunder. The earth trembled and huge hailstones fell to the ground.
translation_verse: Afei bebukyele Nyameɛ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne wɔ nyameɛso, na benwuni ye apam alaka ne wɔ asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu. Na agralaa tetele, komviɛ mɔ, ɔbobɔle nu kurudududu, aseɛ wosole, na asukɔtwea tɔle piri paa.

english_verse: She was about to give birth, and she was crying because of the great pain.
translation_verse: Né ɔnwonzɛ, yeɛ afei né aworɛ ahã ye maa onwu aworɛ nu amaneɛ ɔteatea nu.

english_verse: Something else appeared in the sky. It was a huge red dragon with seven heads and ten horns, and a crown on each of its seven heads.
translation_verse: Na sɛngyerɛnneɛ bieku lale ye nwo ali wɔ nyameɛso: na yieee, sasrabɔnzam pirikua kɔkorɛ bie bɔ ye ti nzoo, ye mmɛen buru, bɔ ahennie abotire nzoo bobɔ ye ti nemɔ ɔ.

english_verse: With its tail, it dragged a third of the stars from the sky and threw them down to the earth. Then the dragon turned toward the woman, because it wanted to eat her child as soon as it was born.
translation_verse: Na ɔfale ye dua piane ewienu nzramaa ngyɛmuɛ nza nu ko, na ogyili bɛ guale aseɛ so. Na sasrabɔnzam ne oogyinane braa bɔ wafo aworɛ so ne nyunu berɛ, kyɛ ɔwo ala a ɔkye ɔwa ne di.

english_verse: The woman gave birth to a son, who would rule all nations with an iron rod. The boy was snatched away. He was taken to God and placed on his throne.
translation_verse: Ɔwole baa bienzua, bɔ ye yeɛ ɔbaafa buralɛ pɔmaa di maen maen amukoraa so ɔ. Na ɔwa ne, behwimini ye bɛhɔle Nyameɛ ne ye ahennie bia ne nwo.

english_verse: The woman ran into the desert to a place that God had prepared for her. There she would be taken care of for
translation_verse: Na braa ne nwati hɔle ɛserɛ so, nekaa bɔ Nyameɛ asiesie ama ye kyɛ bɛnea ye so ngyẽa apee ko ɛyaa nyɔ ne aburasia ne.

english_verse: A war broke out in heaven. Michael and his angels were fighting against the dragon and its angels.
translation_verse: Na afei koɛ sili nyameɛso. Mikayɛl ne ye abɔfo mɔ bɛfale koɛ bɛtetale sasrabɔnzam ne; na sasrabɔnzam ne ne ye abɔfo mɔ bɛhone;

english_verse: But the dragon lost the battle. It and its angels were forced out of their places in heaven
translation_verse: nakoso bangora koɛ ne noa gyina, na bannya atenaleɛ wɔ nyameɛso ko.

english_verse: and were thrown down to the earth. Yes, that old snake and his angels were thrown out of heaven! That snake, who fools everyone on earth, is known as the devil and Satan.
translation_verse: Yiti betuli sasrabɔnzam kandinga ne befili berɛ, sɔ daa tetetete ewoo ne, bɔ bɛfrɛ ye Abɔnzam ne Satan ne, bɔ ɔlakalaka wiase amukoraa ne; befindini ye bɛtole aseɛ so, na befindini ye ne ye abɔfo mɔ yeɛ bɛtole ɔ.

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven shout, “Our God has shown his saving power, and his kingdom has come! God's own Chosen One has shown his authority. Satan accused our people in the presence of God day and night. Now he has been thrown out!
translation_verse: Na ndele komviɛ pirikua bie wɔ nyameɛso kyɛ, “Afei yeɛ ngoalelɛ ne tumi ne ahennie ayɛ yɛ Nyameɛ deɛ, ná tumi ayɛ ye Kristo ne deɛ ɔ, ofikyɛ bafindi y’eliɛma mɔ bɛ kwaadubɔlɛniɛ ne bato ase, ye bɔ ɔbɔ bɛ kwaadu alehyeleɛ ne alesaleɛ wɔ Nyameɛ nyunu ne.

english_verse: “Our people defeated Satan because of the blood of the Lamb and the message of God. They were willing to give up their lives.
translation_verse: Na bɛfale Boaen Ba ne mogya so ne b’adanzeɛ dwirɛ so yeɛ belili ye so ngonim ɔ, na banzuro kyɛ bɛkɔfa bɛ ngoa bɛkɔpɛ so ɔ.

english_verse: “The heavens should rejoice, together with everyone who lives there. But pity the earth and the sea, because the devil was thrown down to the earth. He knows his time is short, and he is very angry.”
translation_verse: Yiti nyameɛso ne ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔte nyameɛso ɔ, ɛ́mɔli ahurusi! Nakoso aseɛ ne ɛpo de, bɛ yaakɔ! Ɔnate kyɛ abɔnzam le ɛyaa pirikua wadwu waatoa ɛmɔ wɔ dɔ, ofikyɛ ɔse kyɛ ye mmerɛ aha tikaape bie.” Sasrabɔnzam ne ko koɛ bieku wɔ aseɛ so

english_verse: When the dragon realized it had been thrown down to the earth, it tried to make trouble for the woman who had given birth to a son.
translation_verse: Na sasrabɔnzam ne nwuni kyɛ bafindi ye bato aseɛ so nen, otuli ye nye siele braa bɔ ɔwole baa bienzua ne aso.

english_verse: But the woman was given two wings like those of a huge eagle, so she could fly into the desert. There she would escape from the snake and be taken care of for a time, two times, and half a time.
translation_verse: Nakoso bɛmane braa ne kɔleɛ pirikua bie ndaa nyɔ, kyɛ ɔfa tu fi ewoo ne nyunu hɔ ɛserɛ so, wɔ ye atenaleɛ, nekaa bɔ bɛkɔnea ye mmerɛ ne mmerɛ ne mmerɛ bue ne.

english_verse: The snake then spewed out water like a river to sweep the woman away.
translation_verse: Na ewoo ne puli ye noa nu nzue bɔ ɔte kyɛ asue ɔ olili braa ne si, kyɛ asue ne fa ye hɔ.

english_verse: But the earth helped her and swallowed the water that had come from the dragon's mouth.
translation_verse: Nakoso aseɛ bokale braa ne; na aseɛ bukyele ye noa nu, na ɔmene asue bɔ sasrabɔnzam ne pu fili ye noa nu ne.

english_verse: This made the dragon terribly angry with the woman. So it started a war against the rest of her children. They are the people who obey God and are faithful to what Jesus did and taught.
translation_verse: Afei sasrabɔnzam ne fɛle braa ne so yaa, na ɔɔfale koɛ toale ye bosofoɛ ngaa bɔ bedi Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ so, ná betira Yesu Kristo adanzeɛ nu ne.

english_verse: The dragon stood on the beach beside the sea.
translation_verse: Na oogyinane mboanoa anweaa so.

english_verse: I looked and saw a beast coming up from the sea. This one had ten horns and seven heads, and a crown was on each of its ten horns. On each of its heads were names that were an insult to God.
translation_verse: Na nwuni kaka bie bɔ ole tire nzoo, ɔne mmɛen buru kyɛ ofi ɛpo nu ofite ɔ. Né ahennie abotire buru bobɔ ye mmɛen nemɔ, na musue abodin mɔ wɔ ye ti nemɔ anwo.

english_verse: The beast I saw had the body of a leopard, the feet of a bear, and the mouth of a lion. The dragon handed over its own power and throne and great authority to this beast.
translation_verse: Na kaka bɔ nwuni ye ne ɔte kyɛ aboa, ye gya te kyɛ kwabrafo gya, na ye noa te kyɛ gyata noa. Na sasrabɔnzam ne fale ye tumi ne ye ahennie bia ne anwoserɛ piri ne mane ye.

english_verse: One of its heads seemed to have been fatally wounded, but now it was well. Everyone on earth marveled at this beast,
translation_verse: Na nwuni kyɛ, ye ti nemɔ anu ko soma kyɛ babɔ ye fɛɛ kandinga, nakoso né ye puralɛ kena ne ahɔ. Na kaka ne nwo yɛle aseɛ so ama amukoraa nwanwa maa belili ye si.

english_verse: and they worshiped the dragon who had given its authority to the beast. They also worshiped the beast and said, “No one is like this beast! No one can fight against it.”
translation_verse: Na bɛkotole sasrabɔnzam bɔ ɔmane kaka ne tumi ne; na bɛkotole kaka ne bɛhane kyɛ, “Nwa yeɛ ɔte kyɛ kaka ne ɔ? Nwa yeɛ ɔkɔhora ne ye bɛkɔho ɔ?”

english_verse: The beast was allowed to brag and claim to be God, and for
translation_verse: Na bɛmane kaka ne noa bɔ ɔfa kekã edwirɛ mbiri mbiri ne musue dwirɛ ɔ, na bɛmane ye ate maa olili tumi bosome aburanna ne nyɔ.

english_verse: The beast cursed God, and it cursed the name of God. It even cursed the place where God lives, as well as everyone who lives in heaven with God.
translation_verse: Na obukyele ye noa kekane musue dwirɛ tiale Nyameɛ, ɔkekane musue dwirɛ tiale ye dumaa ne ye tena sua ne bɛ bɔ bɛte nyameɛso ɔ.

english_verse: It was allowed to fight against God's people and defeat them. It was also given authority over the people of every tribe, nation, language, and race.
translation_verse: Na bɛmane ye ate kyɛ ɔfa koɛ teta anwoteefoɛ, ná oli bɛ so ngonim. Na bɛmane ye tumi wɔ mmusua kure ne edwudwolɛ mɔ ne maen amukoraa so.

english_verse: The beast was worshiped by everyone whose name wasn't written before the time of creation in the book of the Lamb who was killed.
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bɛte aseɛ so amukoraa bɛkɔkoto ye: bɛ bɔ bamvi wiase bohyɛlɛ bangyerɛ bɛ dumaa wɔ Boaen Ba bɔ behuni ye ne ngoa nwomaa ne anu ne.

english_verse: If you have ears, then listen!
translation_verse: Bɔ ole asoɛ ne, maa otie!

english_verse: If you are doomed to be captured, you will be captured. If you are doomed to be killed by a sword, you will be killed by a sword. This means God's people must learn to endure and be faithful!
translation_verse: Sɛ ebie kye nnure a, ye koso bɛkɔhye ye nnure; sɛ ebie fa ngrandɛ ku a, ye koso ɔsɛ kyɛ bɛfa ngrandɛ beku ye. Na ɛwa yeɛ anwoteefoɛ b’animia ne gyidie wɔ ɔ. Kaka bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne

english_verse: I now saw another beast. This one came out of the ground. It had two horns like a lamb, but spoke like a dragon.
translation_verse: Na nwuni kaka foforɛ bie bɔ ofi aseɛ nu fite wale ɔ; né ole mmɛen nyɔ te kyɛ boaen ba, na odwudwo kyɛ sasrabɔnzam.

english_verse: It worked for the beast whose fatal wound had been healed. And it used all its authority to force the earth and its people to worship that beast.
translation_verse: Na ɔfa kaka bɔ oli moa n’anwoserɛ amukoraa yɔ ye nnwumaa, na ɔma aseɛ ne bɛ bɔ bɛte so ɔ bɛkoto kaka bɔ oli moa bɔ ye puralɛ kena ahɔ ne.

english_verse: It worked mighty miracles, and while people watched, it even made fire come down from the sky.
translation_verse: Na ɔyɔ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ mbiri mbiri, na ɔma see po fi nyameɛso ba aseɛ so bɔ mmenia nye tua ɔ.

english_verse: This second beast fooled people on earth by working miracles for the first one. Then it talked them into making an idol in the form of the beast that did not die after being wounded by a sword.
translation_verse: Na nzɛngyerɛnneɛ bɔ wanya ye nwo tumi kyɛ ɔyɔ ye wɔ kaka ne nyunu ne, ɔfa so lakalaka bɛ bɔ bɛte aseɛ so ɔ; na ose bɛ bɔ bɛte aseɛ so ɔ kyɛ, bɛ́yɔ ohoni bɛma kaka bɔ ngrandɛ apura ye, nakoso ɔtɛ te ase ne.

english_verse: It was allowed to put breath into the idol, so it could speak. Everyone who refused to worship the idol of the beast was put to death.
translation_verse: Na bɛmane ye tumi kyɛ ɔma kaka ne honi ne sunzum, ná kaka ne honi ne po odwudwo, ná ɔma behũ mmenia wora bɔ bɛngoto kaka ne honi ne.

english_verse: All people were forced to put a mark on their right hand or forehead. Whether they were powerful or weak, rich or poor, free people or slaves,
translation_verse: Na ɔhyɛ mmenia mukoraati: kwahweabaa mɔ ne atitire, esikafoɛ ne ehiafoɛ, nnehyeɛ ne nganga maa bɛhyɛ bɛ nzorɛ wɔ bɛ sa famaa nwo, anaa bɛ nwoma so;

english_verse: they all had to have this mark, or else they could not buy or sell anything. This mark stood for the name of the beast and for the number of its name.
translation_verse: maa ɔnate so ebiala ngora ndɔ nikye anaa ɔnyɛ ye atɔen, sana sona bɔ ole nzorɛhyɛlɛ ne, bɔ ɔte kaka ne dumaa anaa ye dumaa ngondaa nzorɛhyɛlɛ ne ngome

english_verse: You need wisdom to understand the number of the beast! But if you are smart enough, you can figure this out. Its number is
translation_verse: Ɛhe hia ma nworɛ. Ebiala bɔ ole ndeaseɛ ne, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔsesẽ kaka ne ngondaa ne, ofikyɛ ɔte sona ngondaa, na ye ngondaa ne te ɛyaa nzia ne aburasia ne nzia.

english_verse: Then I heard a sound from heaven that was like a roaring flood or loud thunder or even like the music of harps.
translation_verse: Na ndele komviɛ bie mvili nyameɛso bɔ ɔte kyɛ asue pee bɔ bɛsẽ wuruwuru, ɔne esue bɔ ɔbɔ nu kurudududu serɛserɛ ɔ. Na komviɛ bɔ ndele ne, ɔte kyɛ sangoobɔlɛfoɛ bɔ bɛbɔ bɛ sangoo ɔ.

english_verse: And a new song was being sung in front of God's throne and in front of the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn that song, except the
translation_verse: Na bɛtole edwein foforɛ bie wɔ ahennie bia ne ne abɔdeɛ teasefoɛ nna ne ne mbanyi nemɔ nyunu. Na ebiala angora anzua sɔ dwein ne, sana apee sɔ alaa ɛyaa ko ne aburanna ne nna ne bɔ bale bɛ ngoa bafi aseɛ so ne angome.

english_verse: All of these are pure virgins, and they follow the Lamb wherever he leads. They have been rescued to be presented to God and the Lamb as the most precious people on earth.
translation_verse: Ɛhemɔ ole bɛ bɔ bamva mmrasua bangua bɛ nwo fiɛ, ofikyɛ basie bɛ nwo krongron. Bɛ yeɛ bedi Boaen Ba ne si bɛkɔ nekaa biala bɔ ɔkɔ ɔ. Bɛ yeɛ bale bɛ ngoa bafi adasa mmaa nu, ná bayɛ bɛ fieso aleɛ bɔ oli moa bama Nyameɛ ne Boaen Ba ne ɔ.

english_verse: They never tell lies, and they are innocent. The Messages of the Three Angels
translation_verse: Bɛ yeɛ bɛppɛle ngondombo le ɔ, ofikyɛ ngekalewa biala nne bɛ nwo. Abɔfo nza ne

english_verse: I saw another angel. This one was flying across the sky and had the eternal good news to announce to the people of every race, tribe, language, and nation on earth.
translation_verse: Na afei nwuni abɔfo foforɛ bɔ watu nate nyameɛso afia dɔ, bɔ otira nzɛmba afebɔɔ ne kyɛ ɔkwaabɔ ye dawure kyire bɛ bɔ bɛte aseɛ so: maen maen ne mmusua kure ne edwudwolɛ ne mmenia amukoraa.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Worship and honor God! The time has come for him to judge everyone. Kneel down before the one who created heaven and earth, the oceans, and every stream.”
translation_verse: Na ɔteane nu sele kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔsuro Nyameɛ ná ɛ́mɔfa animnyam bɛ́ma ye, ofikyɛ ye ndɛenbualɛ mmerɛ ne adwu; na ɛ́mɔsɔne ye bɔ ɔbɔle nyameɛso ne aseɛ, ɛpo ne asue ti amukoraa ne.”

english_verse: A second angel followed and said, “The great city of Babylon has fallen! This is the city that made all nations drunk and immoral. Now God is angry, and Babylon has fallen.”
translation_verse: Na abɔfo foforɛ bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ɔ lili ye si sele kyɛ, “Babilɔn abɔ! Wabɔ! Kuro piri ne, ofikyɛ wama maen maen amukoraa bano ye adwamanbɔlɛ ahonehulɛ nzaa ne bie.”

english_verse: Finally, a third angel came and shouted: Here is what will happen if you worship the beast and the idol and have the mark of the beast on your hand or forehead.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nza lili bɛ si, na ɔteane nu sele kyɛ, “Sɛ ebie koto kaka ne ne ye honi ne, ná ode ye nzorɛhyɛlɛ ne wɔ ye nwoma so, anaa ye sa nwo a,

english_verse: You will have to drink the wine that God gives to everyone who makes him angry. You will feel his mighty anger, and you will be tortured with fire and burning sulfur, while the holy angels and the Lamb look on.
translation_verse: sɔ sona ne koso kɔno Nyameɛ ahonehulɛ nzaa bɔ wahwie ye gyengɔgyengɔ wagua ye yaafɛlɛ kulie nu ne bie; na bɛkɔteetee ye wɔ see ne sɔfe nu wɔ abɔfo krongron mɔ nyunu ne Boaen Ba ne nyunu.

english_verse: If you worship the beast and the idol and accept the mark of its name, you will be tortured day and night. The smoke from your torture will go up forever and ever, and you will never be able to rest.
translation_verse: Na nwosina bɔ ofi bɛ teeteelɛ nu ne, ɔkɔ anwuro afebɔɔ. Na bɛ bɔ bɛkoto kaka ne ne ye honi ne, yeɛ ebiala bɔ ode ye nzorɛhyɛlɛ dumaa nen, bengonya bɛ nwome biala bengole wɔ alehyeleɛ nu ne alesaleɛ nu.

english_verse: God's people must learn to endure. They must also obey his commands and have faith in Jesus.
translation_verse: Na ɛhe hia anwoteefoɛ animia, bɛ bɔ bedi Nyameɛ ahyɛdeɛ so ná betira Yesu gyidie nu ne.”

english_verse: Then I heard a voice from heaven say, “Put this in writing. From now on, the Lord will bless everyone who has faith in him when they die.” The Spirit answered, “Yes, they will rest from their hard work, and they will be rewarded for what they have done.” The Earth Is Harvested
translation_verse: Na ndele kyɛ komviɛ bie fi nyameɛso odwudwo kyire me kyɛ, “Kyerɛ ɛhe: ‘Awufoɛ bɔ bewu Awurade nu fi kekesaala ye bɔ ɔkɔ ne, banya saleɛ.’ ” Na Sunzum ne nwa, “Amba, bekole bɛ nwome wɔ bɛ fɛɛ nwo, ofikyɛ bɛ nnwumaa li bɛ si.” Aseɛ ye aso nnɔbaeɛ telɛ

english_verse: I looked and saw a bright cloud, and someone who seemed to be the Son of Man was sitting on the cloud. He wore a gold crown on his head and held a sharp sickle in his hand.
translation_verse: Afei nneane, na yieee, munungum fufue bie, na ebie bɔ ɔte so ɔ ɔte kyɛ Sona Awa ne, bɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ abotire bɔ ye, ná otira dadeɛ koateɛ nnaennaen bi ɔ.

english_verse: An angel came out of the temple and shouted, “Start cutting with your sickle! Harvest season is here, and all crops on earth are ripe.”
translation_verse: Na abɔfo foforɛ bie fili asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu fitele, na ɔfale komviɛ kandinga teane nu hyirele bɔ ɔte munungum ne aso ne kyɛ, “Fa wɔ dadeɛ koateɛ ne ná tete, ofikyɛ nnɔbaeɛ telɛ adwu, na aseɛ so nnɔbaeɛ aboro.”

english_verse: The one on the cloud swung his sickle and harvested the crops.
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔte munungum ne aso ne hwene ye dadeɛ koateɛ ne siele aseɛ so, na ɔtele aseɛ so nnɔbaeɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: Another angel with a sharp sickle then came out of the temple in heaven.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo foforɛ fili nyameɛso asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu fitele, na né ye koso otira dadeɛ koateɛ nnaennaen bie.

english_verse: After this, an angel with power over fire came from the altar and shouted to the angel who had the sickle. He said, “All grapes on earth are ripe! Harvest them with your sharp sickle.”
translation_verse: Na abɔfo foforɛ bɔ ole see so tumi ɔ ofili afɔleɛ bokyea ne anu fitele, na ɔfale komviɛ kandinga teane nu hyirele bɔ otira dadeɛ koateɛ nnaennaen ne kyɛ, “Fa wɔ dadeɛ koateɛ nnaennaen ne tete aseɛ so bobe mmaa biribiraa ne, ofikyɛ ye mma ne aboro.”

english_verse: The angel swung his sickle on earth and cut off its grapes. He threw them into a pit where they were trampled on as a sign of God's anger.
translation_verse: Yiti abɔfo ne hwene ye dadeɛ koateɛ ne siele aseɛ so, na ɔtetele aseɛ so bobe mmaa nemɔ, na ogyi guale Nyameɛ ahonehulɛ kumaa piri bɔ betwi nzaa wɔ nu ne anu.

english_verse: The pit was outside the city, and when the grapes were mashed, blood flowed out. The blood turned into a river that was about
translation_verse: Na betiatiale bobe mmaa ne aso wɔ kumaa bɔ betwi nzaa wɔ nu ne anu, wɔ kuro ne bondua, na mogya fili kumaa bɔ betwi nzaa wɔ nu ne anu hɔle anwuro oodwuli pɔngɔ tendenn, na ɔtengyɛle hɔle kɔyɛ kwanzii ɛyaa nyɔ.

english_verse: After this, I looked at the sky and saw something else that was strange and important. Seven angels were bringing the seven last terrible troubles. When these are ended, God will no longer be angry.
translation_verse: Afei nwuni sɛngyerɛnneɛ foforɛ bie bɔ ɔte pirikua ná ɔyɛ nwanwa ɔ wɔ nyameɛso: Abɔfo nzoo bɔ betiratira ɛhawo nzoo bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ, bɔ yeɛ ɔpɛ Nyameɛ ahonehulɛ ne abo ɔ.

english_verse: Then I saw something that looked like a glass sea mixed with fire, and people were standing on it. They were the ones who had defeated the beast and the idol and the number that tells the name of the beast. God had given them harps,
translation_verse: Na nwuni nikyee bie bɔ ɔte kyɛ neanu po bɔ ɔne see bali afra ɔ. Na bɛ bɔ bali kaka ne ne ye honi ne, yeɛ ye nzorɛhyɛlɛ ne ye dumaa nwo ngondaa so ngonim ne, né begyigyi neanu po ne aso bɔ betiratira Nyameɛ sangoo ɔ.

english_verse: and they were singing the song his servant Moses and the Lamb had sung. They were singing, “Lord God All-Powerful, you have done great and marvelous things. You are the ruler of all nations, and you do what is right and fair.
translation_verse: Né bɛto Nyameɛ akoaa Mose dwein ne Boaen Ba ne dwein kyɛ, “Tuminiɛ Awurade Nyameɛ, wɔ nnwumaa te mbiri mbri na ɔyɛ nwanwa. Maen maen mɔ Hene, w’atee tengyɛ, na ɔte nahorɛ.

english_verse: Lord, who doesn't honor and praise your name? You alone are holy, and all nations will come and worship you, because you have shown that you judge with fairness.”
translation_verse: O, Awurade, nwa yeɛ ongosuro wɔ ná ɔngɔhyɛ wɔ dumaa animnyam ɔ? Ofikyɛ wɔ ngome yeɛ ɛte krongron ɔ. Maen maen amukoraa kɔwa kɔɔkoto wɔ, ofikyɛ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ turoloo ne ala ali.”

english_verse: After this, I noticed something else in heaven. The sacred tent used for a temple was open.
translation_verse: Na ɛhemɔ asi ne, nneane, na nwuni kyɛ babukye adanzeɛ ɛtena sua asɔneyɛɛ sua ne wɔ nyameɛso.

english_verse: And the seven angels who were bringing the terrible troubles were coming out of it. They were dressed in robes of pure white linen and wore belts made of pure gold.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo nzoo nemɔ bɔ betiratira ɛhawo nzoo ne, befili asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu befitele, bɔ né bewurawura nwera fufue hyɛnn, ná bafa sikaa kɔkorɛ abɔsoɛ babobɔ b’afia ɔ.

english_verse: One of the four living creatures gave each of the seven angels a bowl made of gold. These bowls were filled with the anger of God who lives forever and ever.
translation_verse: Yeɛ abɔdeɛ ateasefoɛ nna nemɔ, bɛ nu ko mane abɔfo nzoo nemɔ sikaa kɔkorɛ kulie nzoo, bɔ Nyameɛ bɔ ɔte ase afebɔɔ ne, ye ahonehulɛ ayi bɛ tɛkyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: The temple quickly filled with smoke from the glory and power of God. No one could enter it until the seven angels had finished pouring out the seven last troubles.
translation_verse: Na nwosina bɔ ofi Nyameɛ animnyam nu ɔne ye tumi nu ne, ɔyɛle asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu munguu, na ebiala angora anwura asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu kɔpem kyɛ abɔfo nzoo nemɔ bɛ hawo ne bo pɛle ɔ.

english_verse: From the temple I heard a voice shout to the seven angels, “Go and empty the seven bowls of God's anger on the earth.”
translation_verse: Afei ndele komviɛ piri bie bɔ ofi asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu kyɛ odwudwo kyire abɔfo nzoo nemɔ kyɛ, “Ɛmɔhɔ beehwie bɔ ɔwɔ Nyameɛ ahonehulɛ kulie nzoo ne anu begua aseɛ so.”

english_verse: The first angel emptied his bowl on the earth. At once ugly and painful sores broke out on everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol.
translation_verse: Yiti abɔfo bɔ oli moa ne hɔle oohwiele bɔ ɔwɔ ye kulie ne anu guale aseɛ so, na kena bɔ ɔbo mvamva ná otutu ɔ tutuli mmenia bɔ bele kaka ne nzorɛhyɛlɛ ne, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛkotole ye honi ne.

english_verse: The second angel emptied his bowl on the sea. At once the sea turned into blood like that of a dead person, and every living thing in the sea died.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne hwiele bɔ ɔwɔ ye kulie ne anu guale ɛpo nu, na ɔkakyili kyɛ efuin mogya, na ɛpo ne anu ngaka amukoraa wuwuli.

english_verse: The third angel emptied his bowl into the rivers and streams. At once they turned to blood.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nza ne hwiele bɔ ɔwɔ ye kulie ne anu guale asue mɔ ne asue ti mɔ nu, na bɛkakyili mogya.

english_verse: Then I heard the angel, who has power over water, say, “You have always been, and you always will be the holy God. You had the right to judge in this way.
translation_verse: Na ndele kyɛ nzue mɔ so abɔfo ne ɔkã kyɛ, “O Krongronniɛ, wɔ bɔ ɛwɔ berɛ, ná ɛwɔ berɛ fi tetetete ɔ, ɛtengyɛ, ofikyɛ sɔ yeɛ abua ndɛen ɔ.

english_verse: They poured out the blood of your people and your prophets. So you gave them blood to drink as they deserve!”
translation_verse: Na ɔnate kyɛ bahwie anwoteefoɛ ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ mogya bagua ne ati, wɔ koso ama bɛ mogya maa bano, na bɔ ɔfata bɛ hɔ ɛne.”

english_verse: After this, I heard the altar shout, “Yes, Lord God All-Powerful, your judgments are honest and fair.”
translation_verse: Na ndele komviɛ bie bɔ ofi afɔleɛ bokyea ne anu kyɛ, “Amba, O Tuminiɛ Awurade Nyameɛ, wɔ ndɛenbualɛ te nahorɛ na ɔtengyɛ.”

english_verse: The fourth angel emptied his bowl on the sun, and it began to scorch people like fire.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nna ne hwiele bɔ ɔwɔ ye kulie ne anu guale eyia so; na bɛmane ye see tumi kyɛ ɔbɔ gyireingyirein ɔyera mmenia.

english_verse: Everyone was scorched by its great heat, and all of them cursed the name of God who had power over these terrible troubles. But no one turned to God and praised him.
translation_verse: Na ahuhuro kandinga mane mmenia nwo yerayerale bɛ, na bɛkekane musue dwirɛ betiale Nyameɛ bɔ ole sɔ ɛhawo nemɔ so tumi ne, na banzakyera b’adwene banhyɛ ye animnyam.

english_verse: The fifth angel emptied his bowl on the throne of the beast. At once darkness covered its kingdom, and its people began biting their tongues in pain.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu ne hwiele bɔ ɔwɔ ye kulie ne anu guale kaka n’ahennie bia ne aso, na ye ahennie ne kakyili awosii; na mmenia fale yealɛ bɛpesale bɛ temverema.

english_verse: And because of their painful sores, they cursed the God who rules in heaven. But still they did not stop doing evil things.
translation_verse: Na ɔnate ye yealɛ ne bɛ nwo ngena ngena ne ati, bɛkekane musue dwirɛ betiale nyameɛso Nyameɛ ne, na banzakyera b’adwene bamvi bɛ yɔleɛ nwo.

english_verse: The sixth angel emptied his bowl on the great Euphrates River, and it completely dried up to make a road for the kings from the east.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ne hwiele bɔ ɔwɔ ye kulie ne anu guale asue piri Yufreti nu, na nu nzue ne wewele, kyɛbɔ okosiesie atee kɔto berɛ kɔma ahemvo mɔ bɔ befi eyia afiteleɛ dɔ ɔ.

english_verse: An evil spirit that looked like a frog came out of the mouth of the dragon. One also came out of the mouth of the beast, and another out of the mouth of the false prophet.
translation_verse: Na nwuni sunzum nza bie bɔ bɛ nwo nde, bɔ bɛte kyɛ ɛporohyɛen ɔ, kyɛ befi sasrabɔnzam ne noa nu, kaka ne noa nu, yeɛ ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ngondomboniɛ ne noa nu befite.

english_verse: These evil spirits had the power to work miracles. They went to every king on earth, to bring them together for a war against God All-Powerful. But that will be the day of God's great victory.
translation_verse: Bɛte sunzummɔne sunzum mɔ bɔ bɛyɔ nzɛngyerɛnneɛ, bɔ bɛkɔ wiase amukoraa ahemvo mɔ so aporɔ bɛboaboa bɛ noa bɛma koɛ wɔ Tuminiɛ Nyameɛ ye kyẽa piri ne ɔ.

english_verse: Those armies came together in a place that in Hebrew is called Armagedon.
translation_verse: Na bɛboaboale bɛ noa wɔ nekaa bie bɔ Hebri dwudwolɛ nu bɛfrɛ berɛ Amagedon.

english_verse: As soon as the seventh angel emptied his bowl in the air, a loud voice from the throne in the temple shouted, “It's done!”
translation_verse: Na abɔfo bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne hwiele bɔ ɔwɔ ye kulie ne anu guale mvrama nu. Na komviɛ piri bie fili asɔneyɛɛ sua ne anu, fili ahennie bia ne anu, kyɛ, “Wayie!”

english_verse: There were flashes of lightning, roars of thunder, and the worst earthquake in all history.
translation_verse: Na agralaa tetele, komviɛ bie wale, ɔbobɔle nu kurudududu; na aseɛwosolɛ kandinga wale, bɔ ofi mmerɛ bɔ mmenia wale aseɛ so ɔ, aseɛwosolɛ piri sɔa ebie ɔwwale le ɔ.

english_verse: The great city of Babylon split into three parts, and the cities of other nations fell. So God made Babylon drink from the wine cup filled with his anger.
translation_verse: Kuro piri ne anu hyɛle bue nza, na maen maen nguro mɔ bɔle; na kuro piri Babilɔn nwo ngayeɛ wale Nyameɛ nyunu, kyɛ ɔkɔmaa ɔkɔno ye yaafɛlɛ hahii nzaa kulie ne.

english_verse: Every island ran away, and the mountains disappeared.
translation_verse: Na supɔ biala nwatili, na bannwu mmokaa biala ko.

english_verse: One of the seven angels who had emptied the bowls came over and said to me, “Come on! I will show you how God will punish that shameless prostitute who sits on many oceans.
translation_verse: Afei abɔfo nzoo bɔ betiratira kulie nzoo ne, bɛ nu ko wale me berɛ oosele me kyɛ, “Bra ma ngyire wɔ ndɛenbualɛ bɔ bafa babua adwamanbɔlɛniɛ pirikua bɔ ɔte nzue pee so ne ɔ.

english_verse: Every king on earth has slept with her, and her shameless ways are like wine that has made everyone on earth drunk.”
translation_verse: Ye yeɛ ewiase ahemvo mɔ bɛne ye babɔ adwaman, ná ye adwamanbɔlɛ nzaa ne wabobo aseɛsofoɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: With the help of the Spirit, the angel took me into a desert, where I saw a woman sitting on a red beast. The beast was covered with names that were an insult to God, and it had seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Yiti ɔfale me wurale sunzum nu hɔle ɛserɛ so. Na nwuni braa bie bɔ ɔte kaka kɔkorɛ bie aso, bɔ musue dumaa mɔ wɔ ye nwo amukoraa, bɔ ole tire nzoo ne mmɛen buru ɔ.

english_verse: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet robes, and she wore jewelry made of gold, precious stones, and pearls. In her hand she held a gold cup filled with the filthy and nasty things she had done.
translation_verse: Né braa ne hera ɛtena kɔkorɛ gonn ne afasebire. Né wafa sikaa kɔkorɛ ne mbembenanneɛ ne afire paa wasiesie ye nwo, na né otira sikaa kɔkorɛ kulie bɔ akyiwadeɛ mɔ ne ye adwamanbɔlɛ fiɛ ne wayi ye tɛkyɛ ɔ.

english_verse: On her forehead a mysterious name was written: I AM THE GREAT CITY OF BABYLON, THE MOTHER OF EVERY IMMORAL AND FILTHY THING ON EARTH.
translation_verse: Né bahyerɛ dumaa bie bagua ye nwoma so kyɛ, “Mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ! Babilɔn pirikua ne! Aseɛ so adwamanbɔlɛfoɛ ne akyiwadeɛ mɔ bɛ maame!”

english_verse: I could tell that the woman was drunk on the blood of God's people who had given their lives for Jesus. This surprising sight amazed me,
translation_verse: Na nwuni kyɛ anwoteefoɛ mogya ne Yesu adanzefoɛ mogya wabo braa ne; na nwuni ye nen, ɔyɛle me nwanwa paa.

english_verse: and the angel said: Why are you so amazed? I will explain the mystery about this woman and about the beast she is sitting on, with its seven heads and ten horns.
translation_verse: Na abɔfo ne bisale me kyɛ, “Nzu ati yeɛ ɔyɛ wɔ nwanwa ye? Na braa ne ne kaka bɔ ɔsoa ye, bɔ ole tire nzoo ne mmɛen buru ne, ngɔhã bɛ nwo mvealeɛ nu dwirɛ ngohyire wɔ.

english_verse: The beast you saw is one that used to be and no longer is. It will come back from the deep pit, but only to be destroyed. Everyone on earth whose names were not written in the book of life before the time of creation will be amazed. They will see this beast that used to be and no longer is, but will be once more.
translation_verse: Kaka bɔ enwuni ye ne, mmerɛ bie né ɔwɔ berɛ, nakoso afei de, ɔnne berɛ; na ɔbaafi aseɛ bo dɔ kumaa kuronguronn ne anu fite ba, ná wahɔ ɛsɛkyelɛ nu. Na bɛ bɔ bɛte aseɛ so bɔ bamvi wiase ahyɛaseɛ bangyerɛ bɛ dumaa wɔ ngoa nwomaa ne anu ne, sɛ benwu kaka ne a, ɔkɔyɛ bɛ nwanwa, kyɛ mmerɛ bie né ɔwɔ berɛ, ɔnne berɛ, nakoso ɔwɔ berɛ ɔ.

english_verse: Anyone with wisdom can figure this out. The seven heads that the woman is sitting on stand for seven hills. These heads are also seven kings.
translation_verse: “Na ɛhe hia adwene bɔ nworɛ wɔ nu ɔ: Tire nzoo ne te mmokaa nzoo bɔ braa ne te so ɔ.

english_verse: Five of the kings are dead. One is ruling now, and the other one has not yet come. But when he does, he will rule for only a little while.
translation_verse: Bɛte ahemvo nzoo. Bɛ nu nnu atɔ ase, ko wɔ berɛ, yeɛ ko ne onnya ɔwwale; na sɛ ɔba a, ɔsɛ kyɛ ɔtena berɛ mmerɛ kãa bie.

english_verse: You also saw a beast that used to be and no longer is. That beast is one of the seven kings who will return as the eighth king, but only to be destroyed.
translation_verse: Na kaka bɔ mmerɛ bie né ɔwɔ berɛ, ná afei de ɔnne berɛ ko ne, ye komapɛ ne ala yeɛ ɔtɔ so mmɔtwɛ ɔ, nakoso ɔboka nzoo ne aso, na ɔkɔ ɛsɛkyelɛ nu.

english_verse: The ten horns you saw are ten more kings, who have not yet come into power, and they will rule with the beast for only a short time.
translation_verse: “Na mmɛen buru bɔ enwuni bɛ ne, bɛte ahemvo buru bɔ bɛ sa onnya ɔhhane ahennie ɔ, nakoso bɛne kaka ne bekonya tumi kyɛ ahemvo dɔnhwere ko.

english_verse: They all think alike and will give their power and authority to the beast.
translation_verse: Bɛ mukoraa bayɛ adwene ko, na bɛkɔfa b’anwoserɛ ne bɛ tumi bɛkɔma kaka ne.

english_verse: These kings will go to war against the Lamb. But he will defeat them, because he is Lord over all lords and King over all kings. His followers are chosen and special and faithful.
translation_verse: Bɛkɔfa koɛ bɛkɔteta Boaen Ba ne, na Boaen Ba ne koli bɛ so ngonim; ofikyɛ ɔte meneɛ mɔ nu Meneɛ ne ahemvo mɔ nu Hene; na bɛ bɔ bɛboka ye so ne, wafrɛ bɛ, waneanea nu waye bɛ, na bedi nahorɛ.”

english_verse: The oceans you saw the prostitute sitting on are crowds of people from all races and languages.
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, “Nzue mɔ bɔ enwuni bɛ, bɔ adwamanbɔlɛniɛ ne ɔte so ne, bɛte mmenia, ɛlɔen, maen maen ne edwudwolɛ mɔ.

english_verse: The ten horns and the beast will start hating the shameless woman. They will strip off her clothes and leave her naked. Then they will eat her flesh and throw the rest of her body into a fire.
translation_verse: Na mmɛen buru bɔ enwuni bɛ ne, bɛ ne kaka ne bɛkɔpɔ adwamanbɔlɛniɛ ne; bɛkɔyɛ ye pasapasa ná baye ye nwo bato so, bekoli ye naen, ná bafa see bayera ye.

english_verse: God is the one who made these kings all think alike and decide to give their power to the beast. And they will do this until what God has said comes true.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ Nyameɛ amaa banya adwene ko kyɛ bɛ́ma ye nhyehyɛleɛ bra nu, kyɛ bénya adwene ko, ná bɛfa b’ahennie ne bɛma kaka ne, kɔpem kyɛ Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ ne kɔwa nu ɔ.

english_verse: The woman you saw is the great city that rules over all kings on earth.
translation_verse: Na braa bɔ enwuni ye ne, ye ole kuro piri bɔ odi aseɛ so ahemvo mɔ so hene ne.”

english_verse: I saw another angel come from heaven. This one had great power, and the earth was bright because of his glory.
translation_verse: Na ɛhemɔ asi ne, nwuni abɔfo foforɛ kyɛ ofi nyameɛso odwu ba ɔ. Né ole tumi piri, na ye animnyam tale aseɛ so.

english_verse: The angel shouted, “Fallen! Powerful Babylon has fallen and is now the home of demons. It is the den of every filthy spirit and of all unclean birds, and every dirty and hated animal.
translation_verse: Na ɔteane nu serɛserɛ kyɛ, “Kuro piri Babilɔn abɔ, wabɔ! Wakakyi sunzummɔne mɔ b’atenaleɛ ne sunzum fiɛ amukoraa b’awuro ne nnomaa bɔ bɛ nwo nde ná bekyi ɔ amukoraa b’atenaleɛ.

english_verse: Babylon's evil and immoral wine has made all nations drunk. Every king on earth has slept with her, and every merchant on earth is rich because of her evil desires.”
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ maen maen amukoraa bano ye adwamanbɔlɛ nzaa ne bie, na aseɛ so ahemvo mɔ bɛne ye babɔ adwaman, na aseɛ so dwadifoɛ bɛnate ye anwonya tam mmorosoɛ ne aso banya bɛ nwo.”

english_verse: Then I heard another voice from heaven shout, “My people, you must escape from Babylon. Don't take part in her sins and share her punishment.
translation_verse: Na nza ndele komviɛ foforɛ mvili nyameɛso kyɛ, “Me mmenia, ɛ́mɔfi ye nu béfite, ná ɛmɔanyɔ ye bɔne yɔleɛ ne bie, ná ye hawo ne bie amma ɛmɔ so.

english_verse: Her sins are piled as high as heaven. God has remembered the evil she has done.
translation_verse: Ofikyɛ ye bɔne yɔleɛ noa aboa waadwu nyameɛso, na Nyameɛ akaye ye amumuyɛɛ nemɔ.

english_verse: Treat her as she has treated others. Make her pay double for what she has done. Make her drink twice as much of what she mixed for others.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔtua ye so kerɛ kyɛbɔ otuale ɛmɔ so kerɛ ne, ɛ́mɔtua ye so kerɛ mmɔhoɛ nyɔ, kyɛbɔ ye yɔleɛ te ɔ; kwangoa bɔ nu yeɛ ɔfrafrale ne, ɛ́mɔfra ye mmɔhoɛ nyɔ bɛ́ma ye.

english_verse: That woman honored herself with a life of luxury. Reward her now with suffering and pain. “Deep in her heart Babylon said, ‘I am the queen! Never will I be a widow or know what it means to be sad.’
translation_verse: Kyɛbɔ osi hyɛle ye nwo animnyam pee ná ɔgyele ye nye wɔ anwonya nu ne, sɔ ala yeɛ ɛ́mɔma ye amaneɛnwunɛ ne aworabɔlɛ ɔ́yɛ pee ɔ. Ofikyɛ ɔhane ye wɔ ye ti anu kyɛ, ‘Nde ɛhemmaa bɔ nde berɛ ɔ, nnde kunaniɛ, na mengoli aworabɔlɛ le.’

english_verse: And so, in a single day she will suffer the pain of sorrow, hunger, and death. Fire will destroy her dead body, because her judge is the powerful Lord God.”
translation_verse: Yiti ye hawo ne, ɔkɔwa ye so ɛlɛhomapɛ: ewue ne aworabɔlɛ ne ɛhɔen, na bɛkɔfa see bɛkɔyera ye motoo, ofikyɛ Awurade Nyameɛ bɔ obua ye ndɛen ne, ɔte anwoserɛniɛ.”

english_verse: Every king on earth who slept with her and shared in her luxury will mourn. They will weep, when they see the smoke from that fire.
translation_verse: Na aseɛ so ahemvo mɔ bɔ bɛne ye bɔle adwaman ná bɛne ye gyele bɛ nye anwonya nu ne, sɛ benwu nwosina bɔ ofi ye yeralɛ ne anu a, bɛkɔbɔ ye nwo awuye ná basu ye.

english_verse: Her sufferings will frighten them, and they will stand at a distance and say, “Pity that great and powerful city! Pity Babylon! In a single hour her judgment has come.”
translation_verse: Na ye amaneɛnwunɛ ne bɔ besuro ne ati, bekogyinagyina dedeede bɛkɔhã kyɛ, “Yaakɔ oo, yaakɔ oo! Wɔ, kuro piri Babilɔn, kuro bɔ wɔ nwo yɛ se, dɔnhwere komapɛ nu yeɛ wɔ ndɛenbualɛ awa ye!”

english_verse: Every merchant on earth will mourn, because there is no one to buy their goods.
translation_verse: Na aseɛ so dwadifoɛ mɔ bekosu ye ná bali ye nwo aworabɔlɛ, ofikyɛ ebiala nndɔ bɛ dwaa nningyein nemɔ ko:

english_verse: There won't be anyone to buy their gold, silver, jewels, pearls, fine linen, purple cloth, silk, scarlet cloth, sweet-smelling wood, fancy carvings of ivory and wood, as well as things made of bronze, iron, or marble.
translation_verse: esikaa kɔkorɛ, ɛdwetɛ, nyɔboɛ bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se paa ɔ, afire paa, nwera paa, kende, serekye ne ago, mmakaa fonafona amukoraa, nningyein bɔ bafa ɛsoen gye bali adwii bayɔ amukoraa, nningyein bɔ bafa ndaboa paa, kɔɔbere, buralɛ ne nyɔbosanyene bayɔ amukoraa;

english_verse: No one will buy their cinnamon, spices, incense, myrrh, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, cattle, sheep, horses, chariots, slaves, and other humans.
translation_verse: ɛsaa, pɛprɛ, ɛyɛɛ, krobo, ayirefona, nzaa, ngoo, esam paa, atokoɔ, nyɛmmoa, mmoaen, mbɔngɔ, teaseɛnam mɔ, nganga ne mmenia kra.

english_verse: Babylon, the things your heart desired have all escaped from you. Every luxury and all your glory will be lost forever. You will never get them back.
translation_verse: “Mmakaammaa bɔ né wɔ kra komvi wɔ so ne, wafi wɔ nwo wahɔ, w’anwonyadeɛ paa ne w’animnyam amukoraa wabɔ wɔ, na engonwu bɛ ko!”

english_verse: The merchants had become rich because of her. But when they saw her sufferings, they were terrified. They stood at a distance, crying and mourning.
translation_verse: Na dwadifoɛ bɔ belili sɔ nningyein nemɔ nwo dwaa, bɔ kuro ne ati benyane bɛ nwo ne, ɔnate ye amaneɛnwunɛ ne ati bekoogyina dedeede, na bekosu bɛkɔbɔ awuye kyɛ,

english_verse: Then they shouted, “Pity the great city of Babylon! She dressed in fine linen and wore purple and scarlet cloth. She had jewelry made of gold and precious stones and pearls.
translation_verse: “Yaakɔ oo, yaakɔ oo! Kuro piri bɔ né ɔhera nwera paa, kende ne ago, ná ɔfa sikaa kɔkorɛ, mbembenanneɛ ne afire paa siesie ye nwo ɔ!

english_verse: Yet in a single hour her riches disappeared.” Every ship captain and passenger and sailor stood at a distance, together with everyone who does business by traveling on the sea.
translation_verse: Dɔnhwere komapɛ anu yeɛ sɔ anwonya ne amukoraa wayɛ mbaen ye!” Na ɛlɛenhanɛfoɛ mbanyi amukoraa, ɛlɛen nu akwandufoɛ amukoraa, ɛlɛen nu adwumayɔlɛfoɛ ne ɛpo so dwadifoɛ amukoraa begyinagyinane dedeede,

english_verse: When they saw the smoke from her fire, they shouted, “This was the greatest city ever!”
translation_verse: na benwuni nwosina bɔ ofi ye yeralɛ ne anu nen, bɛteateane nu kyɛ, “Kuro beni yeɛ né ɔne kuro piri he bɛsɛ ɔ?”

english_verse: They cried loudly, and in their sorrow they threw dust on their heads, as they said, “Pity the great city of Babylon! Everyone who sailed the seas became rich from her treasures. But in a single hour the city was destroyed.
translation_verse: Na bɛsesale mvuture beguaguale bɛ ti so, na besuni bɛbɔle awuye kyɛ, “Yaakɔ oo, yaakɔ oo! Kuro piri he bɔ ɔnate ye anwonya ti bɛ bɔ bele ɛlɛen wɔ ɛpo so amukoraa benyane bɛ nwo wɔ nu ɔ! Dɔnhwere komapɛ nu yeɛ babɔ ye bɔkɔɔ ye!”

english_verse: The heavens should be happy with God's people and apostles and prophets. God has punished her for them.”
translation_verse: O, nyameɛso ne anwoteefoɛ ne asomafoɛ ne ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ, ɛ́mɔli ye nwo ahurusi, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ atɔ ye so wereɛ wama ɛmɔ!”

english_verse: A powerful angel then picked up a huge stone and threw it into the sea. The angel said, “This is how the great city of Babylon will be thrown down, never to rise again.
translation_verse: Yeɛ abɔfo anwoserɛniɛ bie tamone nyɔboɛ bɔ ɔte kyɛ nyɔboɛ kandinga bɔ bɛfa beti aburoo, na ogyi tole ɛpo nu hane kyɛ, “Sɔaa yeɛ bɛbaafindi kuro piri Babilɔn bɛto wɔ anyeborolɛ so ɔ, na bengonwu ye ko.

english_verse: The music of harps and singers and of flutes and trumpets will no longer be heard. No workers will ever set up shop in that city, and the sound of grinding grain will be silenced forever.
translation_verse: Na bɛngɔte sangoobɔlɛfoɛ, edweintolɛfoɛ, aweɛnhulɛfoɛ ne totorobɛndohulɛfoɛ nga wɔ wɔ nu ko, bengonwu adwiililɛ nu dwumvoɛ biala wɔ wɔ nu ko, yeɛ bɛngɔte nyɔboɛ bɔ bɛfa beti aburoo ɔ nga wɔ wɔ nu ko;

english_verse: Lamps will no longer shine anywhere in Babylon, and couples will never again say wedding vows there. Her merchants ruled the earth, and by her witchcraft she fooled all nations.
translation_verse: kanea ye hyireinn ngɔta wɔ wɔ nu ko, na bɛngɔte atɔmvorɛ biaa ne atɔmvorɛ braa komvi wɔ wɔ nu ko; ofikyɛ wɔ dwadifoɛ yeɛ né bɛte atitire wɔ aseɛ so ɔ, na ɛfale wɔ ngonyaayelɛ lakalakale maen maen amukoraa.

english_verse: On the streets of Babylon is found the blood of God's people and of his prophets, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: Na ye nu yeɛ benwuni ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ ne anwoteefoɛ ne mmenia amukoraa bɔ bahũ bɛ wɔ aseɛ so ɔ bɛ mogya ɔ.”

english_verse: After this, I heard what sounded like a lot of voices in heaven, and they were shouting, “Praise the Lord! To our God belongs the glorious power to save,
translation_verse: Na ɛhemɔ asi ne, ndele komviɛ bie bɔ ɔte kyɛ ɛlɔen kandinga komvi piri ɔ wɔ nyameɛso kyɛ, “Haleluya! Ngoalelɛ ne animnyam ne anidie ne tumi te [Awurade] yɛ Nyameɛ deɛ;

english_verse: because his judgments are honest and fair. That filthy prostitute ruined the earth with shameful deeds. But God has judged her and made her pay the price for murdering his servants.”
translation_verse: ofikyɛ ye ndɛenbualɛ te nahorɛ na ɔtengyɛ, ɔnate kyɛ wabua adwamanbɔlɛniɛ kandinga bɔ ɔfale ye adwamanbɔlɛ guale aseɛ nwo fiɛ ne ndɛen, na watɔ ye so wereɛ wɔ ye ngoaa mɔ bɛ mogya nwo.”

english_verse: Then the crowd shouted, “Praise the Lord! Smoke will never stop rising from her burning body.”
translation_verse: Na besa besele kyɛ, “Haleluya! Ye nwosina ne tu kɔ anwuro afebɔɔ.”

english_verse: From the throne a voice said, “If you worship and fear our God, give praise to him, no matter who you are.”
translation_verse: Na komviɛ bie fili ahennie bia ne anu teane nu kyɛ, “Ɛ́mɔye yɛ Nyameɛ ayɛ, ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔte ye ngoaa ne ɛmɔ bɔ ɛmɔsuro ye amukoraa, kwahweabaa mɔ ne atitire!”

english_verse: Then I heard what seemed to be a large crowd that sounded like a roaring flood and loud thunder all mixed together. They were saying, “Praise the Lord! Our Lord God All-Powerful now rules as king.
translation_verse: Na ndele komviɛ bie bɔ ɔte kyɛ ɛlɔen kandinga komvi, kyɛ asue pee bɔ bɛsẽ wuruwuru ne agralaa bɔ ɔbobɔ nu kurudududu ɔ, bɔ ɔkã kyɛ, “Haleluya! Ofikyɛ Awurade yɛ Nyameɛ Tuminiɛ ne, odi hene.

english_verse: So we will be glad and happy and give him praise. The wedding day of the Lamb is here, and his bride is ready.
translation_verse: Ɛ́mɔma yɛ nye gye ná yɛli ahurusi, ná yɛhyɛ ye animnyam, ofikyɛ Boaen Ba n’atɔmvorɛfalɛ ne wadwu, na ɔye ne asiesie ye nwo wayie.

english_verse: She will be given a wedding dress made of pure and shining linen. This linen stands for the good things God's people have done.”
translation_verse: Na bɛfale nwera paa bɔ ɔte fufue, bɔ ye nwo te ɔ bɛmane braa ne kyɛ ɔfa hera.” Na nwera paa ne ole anwoteefoɛ bɛ tenenee.”

english_verse: Then the angel told me, “Put this in writing. God will bless everyone who is invited to the wedding feast of the Lamb.” The angel also said, “These things God has said are true.”
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ. “Kyerɛ ɛhe: Bɛ bɔ bato bɛ sa bafrɛ bɛ kyɛ bɛbra Boaen Ba n’atɔmvorɛ poentolɛ bo ne, banya saleɛ.” Na osele me kyɛ, “Ɛhemɔ te Nyameɛ noa dwirɛ bɔ ɔte nahorɛ ɔ.”

english_verse: I knelt at the feet of the angel and began to worship him. But the angel said, “Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you and everyone else who tells about Jesus. Don't worship anyone but God. Everyone who tells about Jesus does it by the power of the Spirit.” The Rider on the White Horse
translation_verse: Yeɛ mvale me nyunu mmutuli ase wɔ ye gya bo kyɛ mesɔne ye, nakoso osele me kyɛ, “Nea, nnɛyɔ sɔ! Ofikyɛ me koso nde ebiɛngo akoaa, wɔ ne eliɛma mɔ bɔ betira Yesu adanzeɛ ne anu ne. Sɔne Nyameɛ! Ofikyɛ Yesu adanzeɛ ne, ye ole ngɔmhyɛlɛ sunzum ne.” Defoɛ ne nwo nyekyire

english_verse: I looked and saw heaven was open, and a white horse was there. Its rider was called Faithful and True, and he is always fair when he judges or goes to war.
translation_verse: Na nwuni kyɛ nyameɛso abukye, na yieee, pɔngɔ fufue bie yele ye ti. Na bɔ ɔte ye so ne, bɛfrɛ ye Kanayɔ ne Nahorɛniɛ, na tenenee nu yeɛ obua ndɛen ná ɔko koɛ ɔ.

english_verse: He had eyes like flames of fire, and he was wearing a lot of crowns. His name was written on him, but he was the only one who knew what the name meant.
translation_verse: Ye nye mmaa te kyɛ see bɔ ogye ɔ, na ahennie abotire pee bobɔ ye ti; na né ole dumaa bie bɔ bahyerɛ bɔ ebiala nze ɔ, sana ye bɔbɔ.

english_verse: The rider wore a robe that was covered with blood, and he was known as “The Word of God.”
translation_verse: Né owura ataadeɛ bie bɔ bafa bawura mogya nu ɔ, na ye dumaa li “Nyameɛ Dwirɛ.”

english_verse: He was followed by armies from heaven that rode on white horses and were dressed in pure white linen.
translation_verse: Na ɛlɔen bɔ bɛwɔ nyameɛso, bɔ bewurawura nwera paa, fufue bɔ ye nwo te ɔ, né bɛtete mbɔngɔ fufue so beli ye si.

english_verse: From his mouth a sharp sword went out to attack the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod and will show the fierce anger of God All-Powerful by trampling the grapes in the pit where wine is made.
translation_verse: Na ngrandɛ nnaennaen bie bɔ ɔkɔfa kɔbobɔ maen maen ɔ ofili ye noa nu fitele, na ye yeɛ ɔkɔfa buralɛ pɔmaa koli bɛ so ɔ. Na ye yeɛ otiatia Tuminiɛ Nyameɛ ye ahonehulɛ suronyisuronyi kumaa bɔ betwi nzaa nu ne aso ɔ.

english_verse: On the part of the robe that covered his thigh was written, “KING OF KINGS AND Lord OF LordS.”
translation_verse: Né ole dumaa bie bɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ ye ataadeɛ nu ne ye sɔ nwo kyɛ, “Ahemvo mɔ nu Hene ne meneɛ mɔ nu Meneɛ.”

english_verse: I then saw an angel standing on the sun, and he shouted to all the birds flying in the sky, “Come and join in God's great feast!
translation_verse: Na nwuni kyɛ abɔfo bie ogyi eyia so ɔ. Na ɔteane nu serɛserɛ frɛle nnomaa amukoraa bɔ betu bɛfa ewienu kyɛ, “Ɛmɔbra beeyia Nyameɛ poentolɛ piri ne abo,

english_verse: You can eat the flesh of kings, rulers, leaders, horses, riders, free people, slaves, important people, and everyone else.”
translation_verse: ná ɛmɔɔli ahemvo mɔ naen, safohene mɔ naen, katakyie mɔ naen, mbɔngɔ ne mbɔngɔhanɛfoɛ mɔ naen, mmenia mukoraa, nnehyeɛ ne nganga, kwahweabaa mɔ ne atitire mɔ bɛ naen.”

english_verse: I also saw the beast and all kings of the earth come together. They fought against the rider on the white horse and against his army.
translation_verse: Na nwuni kyɛ kaka ne ne aseɛ so ahemvo ne bɛ lɔen baboaboa bɛ noa, kyɛ bɛkwaafa koɛ bɛteta bɔ ɔte pɔngɔ ne aso ne ɔne ye lɔen.

english_verse: But the beast was captured and so was the false prophet. This is the same prophet who had worked miracles for the beast, so he could fool everyone who had the mark of the beast and worshiped the idol. The beast and the false prophet were thrown alive into a lake of burning sulfur.
translation_verse: Na bɛhyele kaka ne, ɔne ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ngondomboniɛ ne koso bɔ ɔyɔle nzɛngyerɛnneɛ wɔ ye nyunu, bɔ ɔfa lakalakale bɛ bɔ bale kaka ne nzorɛhyɛlɛ ne, ɔne bɛ bɔ bɛkotole ye honi ne. Na befindini bɛ munyɔ anyekaenn so beguale see abura bɔ sɔfe ogye wɔ nu ne anu.

english_verse: But the rest of their army was killed by the sword that came from the mouth of the rider on the horse. Then birds stuffed themselves on the dead bodies.
translation_verse: Na bɛ ngaa ne de, bɔ ɔte pɔngɔ ne aso ne ngrandɛ noa yeɛ bɛtotɔle ɔ, ngrandɛ bɔ ofi ye noa nu ba ne; na nnomaa mukoraa belili bɛ naen mane bɛ ko yili.

english_verse: I saw thrones, and sitting on those thrones were the ones who had been given the right to judge. I also saw the souls of the people who had their heads cut off because they had told about Jesus and preached God's message. They were the same ones who had not worshiped the beast or the idol, and they had refused to let its mark be put on their foreheads or hands. They will come to life and rule with Christ for
translation_verse: Afei nwuni ahennie bia mɔ, na bɛmane bɛ bɔ bɛtete so nemɔ tumi kyɛ bebua ndɛen. Na bɛ bɔ ɔnate Kristo adanzeɛ ne Nyameɛ dwirɛ ne ati bɛpepɛle bɛ ti ne, nwuni bɛ kra mɔ. Bɛ de, banzɔne kaka ne anaa ye honi ne, yeɛ banne ye nzorɛhyɛlɛ ne wɔ bɛ nwoma so, anaa bɛ sa nwo. Benyane ngoa bieku, na bɛne Kristo belili hene afoɛ apee ko.

english_verse: These people are the first to be raised to life, and they are especially blessed and holy. The second death has no power over them. They will be priests for God and Christ and will rule with them for
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ ɔboka ewutingyelɛ bɔ oli moa ne aso ne, wanya saleɛ, na ɔte krongron. Sɔ mmenia ne, ewue bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne olle bɛ so tumi, na mmom bɛkɔyɛ Nyameɛ ne Kristo asɔfo, na bɛne ye koli hene afoɛ apee ko. Abɔnzam ali ngoguo

english_verse: He will fool the countries of Gog and Magog, which are at the far ends of the earth, and their people will follow him into battle. They will have as many followers as there are grains of sand along the beach,
translation_verse: na okofite kɔwa kɔɔlakalaka maen maen mɔ bɔ bɛwɔ aseɛ ndweasoɛ nna ne aso: Gɔgo ne Magɔgo, kyɛ ɔboaboa bɛ noa maa bɛkɔ koɛ; na bɛ somaa te kyɛ mboanoa anweaa.

english_verse: and they will march all the way across the earth. They will surround the camp of God's people and the city God loves. But fire will come down from heaven and destroy the whole army.
translation_verse: Bɛfo bɛhɔle aseɛ so nekaa biala, na bɛpɛle anwoteefoɛ asikyeleɛ ne nwo beyiale, ɔne kuro bɔ Nyameɛ kuro ye dwirɛ ne. Na see [fili Nyameɛ berɛ] wɔ nyameɛso wale ase ɔɔyerale bɛ.

english_verse: Then the devil who fooled them will be thrown into the lake of fire and burning sulfur. He will be there with the beast and the false prophet, and they will be in pain day and night forever and ever. The Judgment at the Great White Throne
translation_verse: Na abɔnzam bɔ ɔlakalakale bɛ ne de, befindini ye bɛtole see ne sɔfe abura ne anu, nekaa bɔ kaka ne ne ngɔmhyɛlɛniɛ ngondomboniɛ ne bɛwɔ ne, na bɛkɔfa bɛ bɛkɔfa yealɛ nu alehyeleɛ ne alesaleɛ nu afebɔɔ. Bebua awufoɛ ndɛen

english_verse: I saw a great white throne with someone sitting on it. Earth and heaven tried to run away, but there was no place for them to go.
translation_verse: Afei nwuni ahennie bia fufue pirikua bie ɔne bɔ ɔte so ne, bɔ aseɛ ne nyameɛso nwati fili ye nyunu ne; na bannya nekaa bamma bɛ.

english_verse: I also saw all the dead people standing in front of that throne. Every one of them was there, no matter who they had once been. Several books were opened, and then the book of life was opened. The dead were judged by what those books said they had done.
translation_verse: Na nwuni awufoɛ, kwahweabaa mɔ ne atitire kyɛ begyigyi ahennie bia ne nyunu. Bebukyebukyele nwomaa nemɔ anu, besa bebukyele nwomaa foforɛ bie bɔ ɔte ngoa nwomaa ne anu. Na begyinane edwirɛ bɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ nwomaa nemɔ anu so bebuale awufoɛ ndɛen, kyɛbɔ bɛ nnwumaa te ɔ.

english_verse: The sea gave up the dead people who were in it, and death and its kingdom also gave up their dead. Then everyone was judged by what they had done.
translation_verse: Na ɛpo yele awufoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ ye nu ne wale. Ewue ne Ɛborɔ yeyele awufoɛ bɔ bɛwɔ bɛ nu ne bɛwale. Na bebuale bɛ nu biala ndɛen kyɛbɔ bɛ nnwumaa te ɔ.

english_verse: Afterwards, death and its kingdom were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death.
translation_verse: Afei befindini Ewue ne Ɛborɔ beguale see abura ne anu. Ewue bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ɛne.

english_verse: Anyone whose name wasn't written in the book of life was thrown into the lake of fire.
translation_verse: Na ebiala bɔ bannwu kyɛ bahyerɛ ye dumaa wɔ ngoa nwomaa ne anu ne, begyili ye bɛtole see abura ne anu.

english_verse: I saw a new heaven and a new earth. The first heaven and the first earth had disappeared, and so had the sea.
translation_verse: Na nwuni nyameɛso foforɛ ne aseɛ foforɛ; ofikyɛ né nyameɛso bɔ oli moa ne ne aseɛ bɔ oli moa ne bapɛ nu bahɔ, yeɛ né ɛpo nne berɛ ko.

english_verse: I heard a loud voice shout from the throne: God's home is now with his people. He will live with them, and they will be his own. Yes, God will make his home among his people.
translation_verse: Na ndele kyɛ komviɛ piri bie fi ahennie bia ne anu ɔkã kyɛ, “Tie, Nyameɛ ɛtena sua ne ɔwɔ adasa mmaa nu, na ɔkɔtena nu wɔ bɛ nu, bɛkɔyɛ ye maen, na Nyameɛ bɔbɔ ɔne bɛ kɔtena, [ná wayɛ bɛ Nyameɛ.]”

english_verse: He will wipe all tears from their eyes, and there will be no more death, suffering, crying, or pain. These things of the past are gone forever.
translation_verse: Okokyikyi bɛ nye abo moen amukoraa. Na ewue nne berɛ ko, aworabɔlɛ ne esuɛ ne yealɛ biala nne berɛ ko, ofikyɛ nningyein daa nemɔ bapɛ nu bahɔ.

english_verse: Then the one sitting on the throne said: I am making everything new. Write down what I have said. My words are true and can be trusted.
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔte ahennie bia ne aso ne hane kyɛ, “Tie! Meyɔ nningyein mukoraa foforɛ.” Na osa sele me kyɛ, “Kyerɛ ɛhe, ofikyɛ edwirɛ hemɔ te turoloo ne nahorɛ.”

english_verse: Everything is finished! I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will freely give water from the life-giving fountain to everyone who is thirsty.
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, “Wayie! Me ole Alfa ne Omega, Ahyɛaseɛ ne Ayieleɛ. Ebiala bɔ nzuhɔen ku ye ne, ngɔfa ngoa asue ti nu nzue ngɔma ye kyɛkyɛ.

english_verse: All who win the victory will be given these blessings. I will be their God, and they will be my people.
translation_verse: Ebiala bɔ odi ngonim ne, okonya ɛhemɔ amukoraa, na ngɔyɛ ye Nyameɛ, ná ye koso wayɛ mma.

english_verse: But I will tell you what will happen to cowards and to everyone who is unfaithful or dirty-minded or who murders or is sexually immoral or uses witchcraft or worships idols or tells lies. They will be thrown into that lake of fire and burning sulfur. This is the second death. The New Jerusalem
translation_verse: Na bɛ bɔ bɛte serɛ, bɛ bɔ benne benni, akyiwadeɛyɔlɛfoɛ, awudifoɛ, adwamanbɔlɛfoɛ, ngonyaayelɛfoɛ, bosoensolɛfoɛ ne ngondombofoɛ amukoraa de, abura bɔ see ne sɔfe begye wɔ nu ne anu yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ bɛ bue deɛ ɔ, na ewue bɔ ɔtɔ so nyɔ ne ɛhe.”

english_verse: I saw one of the seven angels who had the bowls filled with the seven last terrible troubles. The angel came to me and said, “Come on! I will show you the one who will be the bride and wife of the Lamb.”
translation_verse: Na abɔfo nzoo bɔ betiratira kulie nzoo ne, bɔ ɛhawo nzoo bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ne bayi bɛ tɛkyɛ ne, bɛ nu ko wale me berɛ oosele me kyɛ, “Bra, na ngohyire wɔ Atɔmvorɛ braa ne, Boaen Ba n’aye ne.”

english_verse: Then with the help of the Spirit, he took me to the top of a very high mountain. There he showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down from God in heaven.
translation_verse: Na ɔfale me sunzum nu hɔle bokaa pirikua tendenn bie aso, na ohyirele me kuro krongron Yerusalem ne kyɛ ofi Nyameɛ berɛ wɔ nyameɛso odwu ba ɔ.

english_verse: The glory of God made the city bright. It was dazzling and crystal clear like a precious jasper stone.
translation_verse: Né ole Nyameɛ animnyam, na ye hyireinn ne ɔte kyɛ nyɔboɛ bɔ ye nyɔboɛ yɛ se paa bɔ bɛfrɛ ye yasepa, bɔ ye nye te kaenn kyɛ neanu ɔ.

english_verse: The city had a high and thick wall with twelve gates, and each one of them was guarded by an angel. On each of the gates was written the name of one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
translation_verse: Né ole fasue pirikua tendenn, bɔ anoa mbiri buru ne nyɔ wɔ nu, bɔ abɔfo buru ne nyɔ begyigyi anoa nemɔ anu ɔ. Né bahyerɛ Yisrael mma abusua kure buru ne nyɔ nemɔ bɛ dumaa bagua anoa nemɔ nwo.

english_verse: Three of these gates were on the east, three were on the north, three more were on the south, and the other three were on the west.
translation_verse: Anoa nemɔ, nza wɔ eyia afiteleɛ, nza wɔ sorɔ, nza wɔ ngwaen, yeɛ nza wɔ eyia atɔleɛ.

english_verse: The city was built on twelve foundation stones. On each of the stones was written the name of one of the Lamb's twelve apostles.
translation_verse: Kuro ne, ye fasue ne gyi fapem buru ne nyɔ so, bɔ Boaen Ba n’asomafoɛ buru ne nyɔ nemɔ bɛ dumaa guagua so ɔ.

english_verse: The angel who spoke to me had a gold measuring stick to measure the city and its gates and its walls.
translation_verse: Na bɔ ɔne me dwudwole ne, né otira sikaa kɔkorɛ pɔmaa bɔ bɛfa besusu nikye ɔ, kyɛ ɔbaafa susu kuro ne, ye anoa nemɔ ne ye fasue ne.

english_verse: The city was shaped like a cube, because it was just as high as it was wide. When the angel measured the city, it was about
translation_verse: Kuro ne bɔ ɔla berɛ ne, ɔte ahinanan, ye tendenn ne ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ bɛte pɛ. Na ɔfale ye pɔmaa ne susuli kuro ne, ɔte kwanzii apee ko ɛyaa nnu; ye tendenn nu ne ye tɛtrɛtɛɛ nu ne kyɛbɔ osi kɔ anwuro ne bɛte pɛ.

english_verse: Then the angel measured the wall, and by our measurements it was about
translation_verse: Osa susuli ye fasue ne, ɔte agyirɛ ɛyaa ko aburanna ne nna, bɔ ɔte kyɛbɔ sona susu ye nikyee ɔ, kyɛbɔ abɔfo ne deɛ te ɔ.

english_verse: The wall was built of jasper, and the city was made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Bɛfale nyɔboɛ bɔ bɛfrɛ ye yasepa yeɛ bɛtole ye fasue ne ɔ, na kuro ne bɔbɔ deinn de ɔte sikaa kɔkorɛ paa, bɔ ye nye te kaenn kyɛ neanu ɔ.

english_verse: the fifth was onyx, the sixth was carnelian, the seventh was chrysolite, the eighth was beryl, the ninth was topaz, the tenth was chrysoprase, the eleventh was jacinth, and the twelfth was amethyst.
