translation_verse: bɔ ɔtɔ so nnu ne te sadonike, bɔ ɔtɔ so nzia ne te kanelian, bɔ ɔtɔ so nzoo ne te krisolite, bɔ ɔtɔ so mmɔtwɛ ne te bɛrile, bɔ ɔtɔ so ngona ne te topase, bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne te krisoprase, bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne ko ne te yasinte, bɔ ɔtɔ so buru ne nyɔ ne te amɛtise.

english_verse: Each of the twelve gates was a solid pearl. The streets of the city were made of pure gold, clear as crystal.
translation_verse: Na anoa buru ne nyɔ nemɔ bɛte mbembenanneɛ buru ne nyɔ; bɛfale mbembenanneɛ ko yeɛ bɛyɔle anoa ko biala ɔ. Na kuro ne dwaaso te sikaa kɔkorɛ paa bɔ ye nye te kaenn kyɛ neanu ɔ.

english_verse: I did not see a temple there. The Lord God All-Powerful and the Lamb were its temple.
translation_verse: Na mannwu asɔneyɛɛ sua biala wɔ kuro ne anu, ofikyɛ Tuminiɛ Awurade Nyameɛ ne Boaen Ba ne yeɛ bɛte nu asɔneyɛɛ sua ɔ.

english_verse: And the city did not need the sun or the moon. The glory of God was shining on it, and the Lamb was its light.
translation_verse: Na kuro ne nhia kyɛ eyia kɔbɔ nu anaa ɛsraen kɔta nu ɔ, ofikyɛ Nyameɛ animnyam ta wɔ nu, na Boaen Ba ne yeɛ ɔte ye kanea ɔ.

english_verse: Nations will walk by the light of that city, and kings will bring their riches there.
translation_verse: Maen maen kɔnate ye kanea ne anu, na aseɛ so ahemvo bɛkɔfa b’animnyam [ne anidie] bɛkɔwa nu.

english_verse: Its gates are always open during the day, and night never comes.
translation_verse: Bɛngɔtoto ye anoa nemɔ anu alehyeleɛ nu koraa, yeɛ aleɛ ngɔsa berɛ;

english_verse: The glorious treasures of nations will be brought into the city.
translation_verse: na bɛkɔfa maen maen mɔ b’animnyam ne b’anidie bɛkɔwa nu.

english_verse: But nothing unworthy will be allowed to enter. No one who is dirty-minded or who tells lies will be there. Only those whose names are written in the Lamb's book of life will be in the city.
translation_verse: Nakoso nikyee biala bɔ ye nwo nde, yeɛ bɔ ɔbɔ akyiwadeɛ bra, anaa bɔ ɔpɛ ngondombo ɔ de, ongowura nu; sana bɛ bɔ bahyerɛ bɛ dumaa wɔ Boaen Ba ne ngoa nwomaa ne anu angome.

english_verse: The angel showed me a river that was crystal clear, and its waters gave life. The river came from the throne where God and the Lamb were seated.
translation_verse: Afei ohyirele me ngoa nzue asue bɔ ye nye te kaenn kyɛ neanu, bɔ ɔtengyɛ fi Nyameɛ ne Boaen Ba n’ahennie bia ne anu

english_verse: Then it flowed down the middle of the city's main street. On each side of the river are trees that grow a different kind of fruit each month of the year. The fruit gives life, and the leaves are used as medicine to heal the nations.
translation_verse: kɔfa kuro ne dwaaso afia ɔ. Na asue ne bue nyɔ ne, né ngoa bakaa bɔ osu mmaa ahoroɔ buru ne nyɔ ɔ gyi berɛ, na osu ye mma bosome biala. Na bakaa ne nyaa yeɛ bɛfa bɛsa maen maen mɔ anwonyerɛ ɔ.

english_verse: God's curse will no longer be on the people of that city. He and the Lamb will be seated there on their thrones, and its people will worship God
translation_verse: Musue nikyee biala nne berɛ ko, na mmom Nyameɛ ne Boaen Ba ne, b’ahennie bia ne yeɛ ɔwɔ berɛ ɔ, na ye ngoaa kɔsɔne ye;

english_verse: and will see him face to face. God's name will be written on the foreheads of the people.
translation_verse: Bekonwu ye nyunu, na ye dumaa kɔbobɔ bɛ nwoma so.

english_verse: Never again will night appear, and no one who lives there will ever need a lamp or the sun. The Lord God will be their light, and they will rule forever. The Coming of Christ
translation_verse: Na aleɛ ngɔsa berɛ ko; yeɛ benhia kanea anaa eyia ye hyireinn; ofikyɛ Awurade Nyameɛ yeɛ ɔkɔyɛ bɛ kanea ɔ, na bekoli hene afebɔɔ.

english_verse: Then I was told: These words are true and can be trusted. The Lord God controls the spirits of his prophets, and he is the one who sent his angel to show his servants what must happen very soon.
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, “Edwirɛ hemɔ te turoloo ne nahorɛ. Na Awurade, ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ sunzum mɔ Nyameɛ ne, wasoma ye abɔfo kyɛ ɔɔye edwirɛ mɔ bɔ odi kyɛ bɛba nu ndɛndɛ ɔ ohyire ye ngoaa mɔ.”

english_verse: Remember, I am coming soon! God will bless everyone who pays attention to the message of this book.
translation_verse: “Tie, méba ndɛndɛ. Ebiala bɔ otira nwomaa he anu ngɔmhyɛlɛ dwirɛ nu ne, onya saleɛ.”

english_verse: My name is John, and I am the one who heard and saw these things. Then after I had heard and seen all this, I knelt down and began to worship at the feet of the angel who had shown it to me.
translation_verse: Na me, Yohane, yeɛ nwuni nningyein hemɔ, ná ndele ɔ. Na ndele ná nwuni ye nen, mmutuli berɛ wɔ abɔfo bɔ ohyirele me sɔ nningyein hemɔ ne ye gya bo kyɛ mesɔne ye.

english_verse: But the angel said, Don't do that! I am a servant, just like you. I am the same as a follower or a prophet or anyone else who obeys what is written in this book. God is the one you should worship.
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, “Nea, nnɛyɔ sɔ! Ofikyɛ me koso nde ebiɛngo akoaa, wɔ ne eliɛma mɔ ngɔmhyɛlɛfoɛ, yeɛ bɛ bɔ betira nwomaa he anu dwirɛ nu ne. Sɔne Nyameɛ!”

english_verse: Don't keep the prophecies in this book a secret. These things will happen soon.
translation_verse: Na osele me kyɛ, “Ngɔmhyɛlɛ dwirɛ bɔ ɔwɔ nwomaa he anu ne, nnɛfa nzɔanoɛ sɔ ye noa, ofikyɛ mmerɛ ne apingye.

english_verse: Evil people will keep on being evil, and everyone who is dirty-minded will still be dirty-minded. But good people will keep on doing right, and God's people will always be holy.
translation_verse: Bɔ ɔndengyɛ ne, ɔhɔ so yɛ sona bɔ ɔndengyɛ ɔ; yeɛ bɔ ye nwo nde ne, ɔhɔ so yɛ sona bɔ ye nwo nde ɔ. Bɔ ɔtengyɛ ne, ɔhɔ so yɛ sona bɔ ɔtengyɛ ɔ, yeɛ bɔ ɔte krongron ne, ɔhɔ so yɛ sona bɔ ɔte krongron ɔ.”

english_verse: Then I was told: I am coming soon! And when I come, I will reward everyone for what they have done.
translation_verse: “Tie, méba ndɛndɛ; na ndira m’akatuaa kyɛ mefa mebrɛ ebiala kyɛbɔ ye nnwumaa te ɔ.

english_verse: I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last, the beginning and the end.
translation_verse: Me ole Alfa ne Omega, ahyɛaseɛ ne ayieleɛ, bɔ oli moa ne bɔ ɔpɛ ye bo ɔ.”

english_verse: God will bless all who have washed their robes. They will each have the right to eat fruit from the tree that gives life, and they can enter the gates of the city.
translation_verse: Bɛ bɔ bɛpo bɛ ndaadeɛ ne, banya saleɛ, kyɛbɔ bekonya ngoa bakaa ne nwo atee, ná bafa anoa ne anu bahɔ kuro ne anu ɔ.

english_verse: But outside the city will be dogs, witches, immoral people, murderers, idol worshipers, and everyone who loves to tell lies and do wrong.
translation_verse: Na kuro ne asi dɔ yeɛ ngyea, ngonyaayelɛfoɛ, adwamanbɔlɛfoɛ, awudifoɛ, bosoensolɛfoɛ ne bɛ bɔ bekuro ngondombopɛlɛ ná bɛpɛ ɔ bɛ mukoraa bɛwɔ ɔ.

english_verse: I am Jesus! And I am the one who sent my angel to tell all of you these things for the churches. I am David's Great Descendant, and I am also the bright morning star.
translation_verse: “Me, Yesu, yeɛ masoma m’abɔfo kyɛ ooli ɛhemɔ nwo adanzeɛ hyire ɛmɔ wɔ asɔre nemɔ anu ɔ. Me ole Dawide ndii ne ye bosoniɛ, ngyerɛmɔ Nzramaa bɔ ɔta ne.”

english_verse: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” Everyone who hears this should say, “Come!” If you are thirsty, come! If you want life-giving water, come and take it. It's free!
translation_verse: Na Sunzum ne ne atɔmvorɛ braa ne nwa, “Bra!” Ma ebiala bɔ ɔte ne ɔhã kyɛ, “Bra!” Ma ebiala bɔ nzuhɔen ku ye ne ɔbra. Ma ebiala bɔ okuro ne oole ngoa nzue ne mbaen. Ayieleɛ

english_verse: Here is my warning for everyone who hears the prophecies in this book: If you add anything to them, God will make you suffer all the terrible troubles written in this book.
translation_verse: Mebɔ ebiala bɔ ɔte nwomaa he anu ngɔmhyɛlɛ dwirɛ ne kɔkɔ kyɛ: Sɛ ebie fa edwirɛ bieku boka ɛhemɔ aso a, Nyameɛ kɔprapra ɛhawo ahoroɔ bɔ bahyerɛ ye wɔ nwomaa he anu ne kogua ye so.

english_verse: If you take anything away from these prophecies, God will not let you have part in the life-giving tree and in the holy city described in this book.
translation_verse: Yeɛ sɛ ebie ye ngɔmhyɛlɛ nwomaa he anu dwirɛ ne bie fi nu a, Nyameɛ kɔye ye bue deɛ kofi ngoa bakaa ne ne kuro krongron bɔ bahyerɛ bɛ nwo dwirɛ wɔ nwomaa he anu ne anu.

english_verse: The one who has spoken these things says, “I am coming soon!” So, Lord Jesus, please come soon!
translation_verse: Bɔ odi edwirɛ hemɔ nwo adanzeɛ ne, ɔnwa, “Amba, méba ndɛndɛ!” Amen. Awurade Yesu, bra!

english_verse: I pray that the Lord Jesus will be kind to all of you.
translation_verse: Yɛ Awurade Yesu Kristo adom ne ɔyɛ ɛmɔ amukoraa bɛ deɛ. [Amen.]
